title: Excellent choice for our needs
text: Accessible as situated really close to the tube, rail and bus services. Close enough to the event we were attending to wal there so very convenient. Very clean, comfortable and excellent customer service.

title: Great base budget hotel in london
text: Whilst you don't think of Tottenham Hale as being the place to stay but we stayed overnight at the Premier Inn which is perfectly located by the bus station and staff were lovely and nothing was too much trouble. Its a new hotel and the room was lovely, great size wall mounted TV and super comfy bed that we enjoyed relaxing in, temperature control in your room so you pick your own temperature to suit your needs .. The location is perfect for you to get to anywhere in London as you also have Victoria tube line station on your doorstep as well as plenty of buses making this an affordable way to staying in London at cheaper prices. You have Pizza Hut , KFC , burger king and subway including a tesco store right on your door step for a quick fix whilst working out where in London you want to spend your time or chilling bavk in the hotel that has a restaurant and bar. We gave already booked to go back in January. Definitely recommend

title: Great opportunity
text: The hotel is 30 mins from Stansted by train, and has most of the connections nearby. Easy to get there, and to move around. New build, so has still the new smell, however the modern things are time to time confusing (automatic check-in was not so easy at 10pm, staff is being ultimate between restaurant and reception, etc). we have been there 4 of us, then the room was not that comfy anymore, but still acceptable and for the price great value. the breakfast was nicely done, and the staff was helpful. the surrounding... yeah... consider 2x to go out after 9-10pm.

title: Prime location
text: Staff was cheerful., polite & so helpful. Near bus & train station. Nice area for a walk by the canal. Opposite a retail park. Area is modern. There is a busy road but plenty of pedestrian crossing. The rooms are typical of Premier Inn, comfortable & clean. Only one wish that they had more TV channels

title: Very Good Hotel
text: This Hotel is very good, located at 4 stations of St Pancras International (Zone 3). No parking. Continental Breakfast cost 6.99£, UK breakfast cost 8.99£ Rooms is very good, good bed, good pillow, TV LCD, sleep quality is excellent.

title: Holiday
text: Location was very good because trains and buses was nearby to all areas, but the smell of the drains was very bad and lifts was not working. Parking is very limited. Rooms was good. We did not eat in because we a vegan.

title: Close to transport network
text: We were looking for somewhere to stop for a few nights away from the centre of London at a reasonable B&B rate. This is just a couple of minutes' walk away from the bus, rail and underground (Victoria line) services and suited us down to the ground. They had one or two supplier problems with the cooked breakfast one morning, but still managed to serve up a decent, "set you up for the day" selection. Will definitely use it again - it's a Premier Inn and you know exactly what you're going to get!

title: Terrific staff, lovely breakfast
text: While the room is a bit small, the beds were comfy and the room was spotless, we had a smashing breakfast on one morning, excellent value and very tasty. Good tele in the room with most channels. would stay here again

title: Clean, comfortable, good value
text: Smooth check in and check out by friendly staff. Clean and comfortable room and very quiet considering the location. Tea/coffee making, desk and TV all provided. Spacious bathroom with bath and shower over. I didn't take breakfast this visit so can't comment on that. Location is very close to public transport, buses, national rail and Victoria line almost opposite making this hotel not that far from Central London in time. Good value too as prices generally lower than nearer the centre. Will be back again for sure.

title: Lovely little hotel!
text: Great clean and comfy rooms just what you need! And very good value for money! A very short walk to local shops, busses and trains. We really enjoyed our stay and will defiantly be visiting again! Great hotel!

title: Great hotel and convenient
text: This is a great hotel with a really convenient location. I’ve stayed here a few times and each time has been good. It’s very quiet and the rooms are comfortable. The restaurant is good, not fantastic. Recommended.

title: Nice hotel
text: You know what you are getting with Premier Inns, comfy beds, clean and modern rooms, they know what they are doing. This hotel was quite new when we visited but everything still went smooth, very helpful staff who couldn't do enough for us, we had a small issue with the pressure on the shower, the manager wanted to fix it there and then and apologised etc, we had already showered so wasn't too bothered, we was only letting them know for the next customers. They let us leave our case there whilst we went out for the day even after we had checked out. We had the meal deal and the kids got their free brekki, result! A really good stay thanks.

title: Mr
text: What a lovely friendly atmosphere I find everytime I come to this hotel. The entire staff go above and beyond there normal duties to make you feel so welcome and to enjoy your stay . I have used this hotel on many occasions and will even go out my way to stay at this premiere inn. They are not just staff I have made friends with them all as well. The work ethic from this great team should be passed around other branches of hotels to learn from. Thanks again for another great stay.

title: Staff rude and only 1 towel provided for 2 people
text: Firstly we got there and the lift was out of service. We were put on the 6th floor and had to climb the stairs. I explained my wife is heavily pregnant and after a 5 minute wait only then they put it on the 2nd floor which my wife had to slowly climb the stairs. We got to our room and found there was only 1 tower and 1 hand towel. I went to reception to explain myself and wife was staying in the hotel and needed another towel. Again after a 5 minute wait the additional towel and hand towel was provided. The following morning we left to head to central London. On our return at around 10 30pm we got to the room, and again only 1 towel and 1 hand towel. I again went to reception and was met by a rude staff member who didn't even apologise and went into the back got a towel. I explained we also need a hand towel which he responded with we dont have any left. Once again no apology. I was very disappointed in the service I recieved and this happened on 2 separate occasions not just the one.

title: All good except check in
text: Hopeless staff at check in meant that I had to wait ages for a breakfast refund and there was even a suggestion I wouldn't get one even though I was cancelling it the day before. Room was fine and quiet, leading to a good night's sleep. Great location.

title: Wedding visit
text: Would recommend this Premier Inn it’s local to Tubes Buses and trains. It is just what you would expect when staying at a Premier Inn. The only down side is the distance you need to travel to park your car. When you have children and luggage this is difficult

title: Not as good as other Premier Inns
text: I like Premier Inn, I've stayed at a few now. Usually you know exactly what to expect - Clean, comfy, quiet, good night's sleep and a decent breakfast. This wasn't as good as the others though. It was, clean and comfortable but there was some noise from traffic at night and the breakfast was poor. Food had been left out too long and was overcooked and chewy and some of it cold. No fried eggs without asking and then breakfast was even colder by the time it arrived. Based totally on the breakfast I would go to another Premier Inn next time I'm in London or even a different chain.

title: All excellent except the air con
text: Lovely hotel - well positioned, clean, friendly staff, quiet, comfortable firml bed. Breakfast was not amazing but pleasant. We couldn't sleep though because it was impossible to open the window and the air con made the air very dry and unpleasant to breathe. What a shame. Oh, and we only had one bath towel between two - I notice another reviewer had the same problem. Just asked at reception and we were given an extra towel without fuss.

title: A beautiful surprise
text: After we suffered from a previous hotel experience... we spent two nights in premier in... it was very comfortable stay,, very nice 👍 staff smiling caring helpful.. the room was very clean with a big double bed and cosy one ,, excellent bathroom... every thing you needed it's there a very good price... I'm going back in November Thanks for your professionalism..

title: Lovely stay
text: I had a lovely stay at this Premier Inn last week. It is two minutes from the tube station, but you cannot hear any noise at all. It is also next to a retail park which has places like Aldi, KFC, Boots, Next, etc. As soon as I walked in, a member of staff I think called Nathan greeted me and he was so friendly and polite. I have found most of the staff in Premier Inns I've stayed in across the country are friendly and helpful, but he was definitely the nicest I've ever met! The room was very modern and like new, with a big comfy bed, sofa, and big bath. Free wifi was a bonus. Will definitely stay again.

I really like the stay in there. Probably my daughter will stay there too. We have a niece leaving close to Tottenham. Staff very friendly and always say good morning to us. We were so happy to find a place like this.

title: Just right!
text: As usual, the Premier Inn provided a warm welcome from its staff and was just right in every way. They are great value for money, clean, are in great locations and the staff are always available to help.

title: Great value and location
text: All staff were very friendly, excellent location. Located next to the Stansted line and tube line. Would recommend this hotel to all, two minute walk to tube station. Very clean, hotel room is very quiet

title: What a fantastic hotel.
text: It may seem like an out of town and not a great area but its a 3 min walk to the tube, which is on the Victoria line which runs through the night at the weekend. I found this basic hotel most luxurious, it felt a better class than the price. room was spotless, quiet, looked great as did the bathroom. water pressure was awesome. All the staff were so friendly, happy and lovely. breakfast was great, plentiful and very good quality. I will be back for sure.

title: Another great visit
text: We were greeted with such a warm welcome on arrival. It was great to see the same receptionist that was there on our previous visit. Check in was fast. We had a quick glass of wine before heading out to visit our daughter, and again to see the same waitress that was also there from our previous visit, and the staff were so friendly and chatty. A thank you also the lovely guy from the north of Ireland, who always stops to say hello to us, and always makes sure we are happy. He was so accommodating when we asked if our daughter could join us for breakfast on our last morning at the Premier Inn. On behalf of my daughters and myself, we would like to express our gratitude for another great visit. See you all again very soon. xx

title: London zone 3 cheap and good
text: Little far from Centre but nice. Excellent room to sleep, good breakfast, near to stansted express line and to the tube. Clean and smart. Walks 100 mt and keep train or underground for a 15/20 minutes to zone 1. Some useful shops in front of hotel.

title: Nice weekend
text: My wife and I stayed at Premier Inn, Tottenham Hale for 2 nights. It was our son's birthday so we went to a show and had a meal in the West End. The hotel is nice and clean and the room was perfect for a couple visiting for the weekend.

title: Overnight stop
text: A friendly team, clean and comfortable room and hotel with small but excellent restaurant. Location on outskirts is easy for moving around central London with it being close to transport links with Tube Bus and main line stations. Good hot tasty breakfast freshly cooked.

title: great location, comfy beds and good brekkie
text: perfect location a stones throw from Tottenham Hale underground. No parking - had to walk 10 minutes and pay £10 but this was as advertised. Bed and pillows were sooooo comfy and breakfast was really good.

title: Convenient Base
text: All the usual comforts of the Premier Inn brand and adjacent to Tottenham Hale stations for the Victoria Line fast link to central London. Also next to the direct line to Stansted Airport and London Liverpool Street. Great base for exploring with local buses running from the bus station to Crouch End, Enfield, and Archway. Our room with great air conditioning/heating compact but with everything needed to relax after a long day out and about. Friendly staff throughout though the one negative maid knocking on the door at 9am to service the room. When we tried to explain this was a little early we realised she (though very pleasant) spoke barely any English at all. Views from the room (807) across to the new Spurs football stadium under construction

title: Stay for wedding locally
text: Much better than I anticipated. The room was clean and comfortable and the breakfast was excellent. I had not had reason to,stay at a Premier Inn before and had not expected very much. I was mistaken, the hotel was very good and I would gladly stay there again.

title: Really comfortable stay
text: Excellent value and good location. The room was very clean and the bed was particularly comfortable. We did an excellent walk from the Premier Inn down the river Lea to Limehouse. Also easy to access central London from nearby tube station.

title: Good value
text: The Premier Inn provides a good value and service. The location is very good, being one of the only hotel nearby Tottenham Hale. The Hot Breakfast (at a standard charge) is good too, with excellent food quality. The only minor issues I got were the noise of the ventilation system and the fact that my room was not provided with a safety lock.

title: Excellent Service
text: We are staying at this hotel. Good location, good view and excellent service. Fast food shops, supermarkets, petrol station, Transport for London's Underground and National Rail's Station, Bus Station are all within 3-5 minutes walking distance.

title: Fantastic value for money stay
text: Spotlessly clean room, comfy bed and lovely staff. Would deff stay again if I was i this part of London. Nice breakfast with cooked to order option and plenty of choices. Only downside was no on site parking

title: Wifi Wifi WIFI
text: Provision of wifi was really poor, unresolved until we left. we reported the poor quality but nothing was done to resolve this matter. We were not even asked or offered the money back. The room was generally presentable but the lack of wifi in this day and age is not right. This meant we couldn't emails from the phones or laptops.

title: Clean and Welcoming
text: We stayed here recently as we were over for a Tottenham game. The location of the hotel is ideal, 2 minute walk from overland and underground stations for onward travel to Stansted or Central London. The room we had was perfect, a decent size, clean and tidy. Check in staff were very welcoming and helpful. This was our first time staying here, I can safely say it won’t be our last. 5 Stars

title: 95% perfect but still worth 5 stars.
text: As Premier Inn is advertised as being so luxurious it’s so tempting to think look Travelodge first for good standard and cheaper. This for last night proved otherwise. Convieniently located for the all night Saturday tube my friend booked a room for us. The pre-paid booking-in automatic system and contactless room cards couldn’t have been easier. No queuing to book in or push-in door cards to find they don’t work at places that use this now dated system. The room and en suite were spotless.. although when I showered I did find a brunette had left a 6” strand of hair. My only two other “negatives” are that the bed was softer than I go for and felt the mattress was engulfing us. The shower was fantastic but we had to use the hand basin soap dispenser as the shower and hair gel one had run empty. But it was in easy reach thankfully. The room overall was great, good quality and quiet. A quality tv picture for watching a bit of the World Cup on before we went out. When booking in even though automated and worked very well a receptionist did ask if all ok and smiled at us. What a lovely welcome. Coming back in early Sunday morning the young man on reception saw us looking for our entry cards which we got out and without our beckoning assistance got up and let us in anyhow with genuine friendliness. He also without hesitation on our saying we had used the tea and milk up and any chance of some more gave us some from the store, ensuring we had enough. Fantastic customer service. We will add to our list of recommended list of places to stay.

title: Premier Inn Denial
text: Upon arrival at Tottenham Hale, the Premier Inn was incredibly easy to find

title: Bon Appetite
text: Pay attention - It's no worse than any other part of London - and is literally a 60second walk from Tottenham Hale Underground (or overground) station. You are 4!stops away from Kings Cross station (8minutes travel time) with direct connections to every part of London and the rooms are a fraction of the price...8 minutes !!! The restaurant, reception and rooms are quality. Great deal regarding breakfast with 15's and under eating free and the option to get a two course dinner for £16 Bargain (Car park is off site...2 minute drive away, 5 minute walk back. 24hr security though, the Irish manager sold it well so he did..) Picture view from station

title: Excellent
text: I visit many hotels in all across the country and all are very well but this is the best in all. It has big swimming pool and garden also. The food is very tasty and delicious. So visit please visit this hotel.

title: Finsbury Park Gig
text: Great place to stay when going to the gig at Finsbury Park (Mr Liam Gallagher on 29 June). The room was clean and fresh and a stone throw from the Tube Station and direct link rail to Stanstead Airport. The hotel has its own restaurant and bar however directly across the road is a retail park with Subway, Burger King, KFC and Costa coffee along with a Lidl and Iceland which was essential to buy ice for the beverages in the room to keep them cool. I would recommend this Hotel and will use it again

title: Good value hotel, good location.
text: We stayed at this hotel for a family visit. Fantastic nights sleep in a really comfy bed. Very spacious clean room with a nice bathroom. Really quiet despite being located in a very busy area.Having to pay £10 for offsite parking was annoying.

title: Family trip to London
text: My family stayed at this hotel for two nights as we toured the attractions of London. The hotel is in a convenient location for anyone travelling from Stansted Airport. The facilities are very good value for money and the staff very helpful - we wouldn't hesitate to recommend Premier Inn.

title: Great stay, very impressed
text: We stayed here on a Friday night and we both were very impressed with the hotel. We paid £67 which is a great price and as soon as we walked to reception we were greeted by a nice member of staff to walk us through check in. All automated which is a nice change and off to our room we went. Good size room, fantastic shower and lovely comfy bed. Good sized tv to watch a good selection of channels. Very clean, warm and central location. We will be back.

title: Excellent value
text: Right next to the tube. Great value. Efficient check in a machine to save waiting for reception staff. Large beds, great shower. Parking options limited but you don't need car if travelling to central London as tube and train are in your doorstep.

title: Beyond expectations!!
text: I chose this hotel as I was visiting family in north London but also wanted a bit of independence. It was truly wonderful . Every member of staff was so friendly and helpful I was very impressed. Rooms were spotless, very comfortable and the size was pleasantly surprising.

title: Nice Stay
text: We have a pleasure and comfort stay. The place is ideal for travellers from Stansted Airport and the hotel area is a transport node. But first of all, the team was the best advantage off all. Kindly people, very helpfull and professionals 100% .

title: Good place to stay but ...
text: Good place to stay - clean, close to a tube , cheaper than ones in the down town But it is old and pretty far... And watch out their room rate since it fluctuates a lot. Don't make a reservation early. You may find they offer the better price and You won't get refund or compensation.

title: Good hotel, excellent location.
text: I stayed here for two nights while on business in North London. The staff are helpful and friendly. The rooms clean and functional. I stayed in room 5012 which had nice view. Two other observations about the rooms - 1) There is no space in the bathroom for the clean towels. It was weird to find the towels on the bed. Funny though since the wall behind the bathroom door appears to have enough space to put up some shelves. 2) The toilet paper dispenser really wastes paper. The sheets are really tiny and you have to keep tugging to get them out. Since the sheets are also very thin, many of them tear while they're being tugged at. Very frustrating. So much so that I want round the corner to Asda Living and bought proper toilet 'roll'. The hotel is across the road from Tottenham Hale (Victoria Line) tube station. The station also has direct trains to Stanstead airport and Stratford via Liverpool Street. There's a whole bunch of shops and places to eat across the road. Can't fault it for convenience. Just bring your own toilet roll.

title: Premier Service in Premier Inn Totteham Hale London
text: Good location , just 200 meters to under ground station of fast Victoria Line . Room was big enough, clean , quite. Bathroom is large enough, well designed, water preasure and hot water were all good during our stay. English breakfast was fresh and ready to service always. Very friendly staff willing to serve you well at all time.

title: Good value - excellent disabled persons bathroom
text: Easy to book, remote check in etc. Bathrooms have full disabled persons support bars, grips and alarms. Very helpful member of staff when the key card would not print on check in. Breakfast was self service with a comprehensive selection for a very reasonable price.

title: Quite pleasant hotel, you'll sleep like a baby.
text: The service is superb. Front desk employees were so welcoming. The room was well kept, thumbs up to housekeeping. I was most impressed wit the bed, it was comfortable and we slept like babies. My partner said he was well please with the overall experience of the room. I Will definitely stay there again. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone who wants a great place to relax and find comfort. It's location is ideal, you can grab a bit to eat or do some quick shopping at the Tottenham Hale shopping area. I'm

title: Brilliant Hotel, Brilliant Location, Brilliant Staff!
text: We just got home tonight after spending Thursday, Friday and Saturday nights at this hotel. It was quite simply brilliant! The room was lovely, and very comfortable for my wife and I, and our two kids aged 15 and 10. Upon arrival we were greeted by the guy on the front desk. He was very welcoming and helpful. We actually arrived early into Stansted airport, therefore we were about 4 hours early for check-in, but he managed to get our room ready so we could get the kids up to the room for a much need afternoon sleep - this was a prime example of staff going that extra mile for customers, so well done, we appreciated it! The location of the hotel was great, with only a few stops to central London! We will definitely be back to London, and we will definitely use this hotel. Great job Premier Inn Tottenham Hale!

title: Overnight stay
text: Excellent location for our purposes with good on site facilities (restaurant) and a friendly staff team. Despite location by a busy road junction room was very quiet. Good quality buffet with excellent choice for breakfast

title: Consistency always!
text: I have stayed here 4 times and each time you know what you are getting. Across the road from Tottenham Hale Tube station and modern rooms with Samsung TV and free wifi. Rooms are clean and breakfast and restaurant great service!

title: Flying visit
text: Premier inn was chosen initially due to its proximity to my family..staff were friendly and welcoming and nothing was too much trouble .very clean everywhere.food good .i will be staying here in each of my visits in future..recommend

title: Great place to stay
text: We only stayed one night but you always know what to expect from a Premier Inn. Nice welcome, cosy bed, clean room and in the morning an all you can eat breakfast. The staff are friendly and helpful. The location is perfect for travelling in to the centre of London. Would stay there again.

title: Fantastic Stay
text: Stay here quite often - at least once a month. Have always had the best welcome from the most friendliest of staff. Sarah at reception offers a warm welcome and then to see her again for her expert knowledgeable service in the restaurant is great. So nice that practically everyone there can help with any part of our stay so not having to wait for a hotel staff member for something as the restaurant staff are trained too. The girls always have a smile on their faces it's a lovely place and we will always book here before anywhere else. Have tried other places and the service and atmosphere is nothing like this.

title: Really helpful lovely stay
text: This premier inn is perfect for a stay in London with a young family! Premier inn is over the road from the tube station which allows for an easy/ quick route into london! All staff at the premier inn were very friendly and helpful even sorting us out a new room in the early hours of the morning when our young daughter was physically sick. This made the what could have been stressful event easy and meant that both our children were relaxed In clean new room within 45 min of my daughters sickness. Breakfast was lovely great price for an all you can eat and with the children eating for free it allowed us to fill up before going to explore our capital! Well done Tottenham Hale we will defiantly be back and will let others know about you

title: Absolutely Terrible
text: This new hotel looks all bright and attractive on the website but it's been out of total greed. Arrived to sketchy car park signs and ended up driving round the block past the hotel five times and ended up parking on a petrol station to ring the hotel. No one picked up the phone and Premier Inn cut me off three times after being on hold after being charged 13p a minute. Finally found the car park on a housing estate which was three quarters of a mile walk from the hotel. I am a female away on business alone and the walk was disturbing laden with my bags. Yes this a shiny new hotel but anyone who is elderly, disabled or a lone traveller should avoid booking into this dreadful place. The staff are very obliging and extremely pleasant, they must be so tired of taking the wrath from upset customers at the bad planning in the positioning of this hotel. The lady on reception said it was a constant problem since the hotel opened.

title: Good value for money
text: Good value for money and very good location a few walking minutes from railway and victoria line.Victoria line is one of the best underground line due to frequency and operational service. You can reach most central london location in about half an hour

title: London
text: Great value and close to the tube. The room was very nice and cosy with air conditioning which was used on hotter days. The bathroom was like new and quite roomy. We were drawn there by the location which was a few steps from the Tottenham Hale tube station.

title: Excellent
text: In general all on this hotel It exceeded my expectations. The location is perfect, near the subway and rail stations. The cleanliness of the hotel was great and the room was very comfortable and spacious. All is good!!!!

title: Good for this price
text: The room was really nice and clean. Even though the window was well isolated so you couldn’t hear any noice. The air conditioner wasn’t too loud. Breakfast was good but the coffee isn’t the best. As in every bigger hotel, you’re producing so much rubbish with small packages of jam or other things. That’s always a shame!!

title: A good room.
text: This hotel is in a good location near to the train station and is well known by the taxi drivers. There were a few problems, no phone in the bed room

title: Exellent
text: Brilliant staff with in priemer Inn Tottenham Hale so pleasant and helpful nothing was to much when asked for something they went beyond their duty Each member had a smile on their face we encounter the best weekend for our base in Tottenham Hale Premier Inn

title: Clean, Good Breakfast - Great price
text: We had a double room that was clean and spacious. It had tea/coffee making facilities, enough for 2 each. Comfortable bed. Good quality TV. The bathroom was nice with a Bath and "in bath shower" and a supply of gels for showering and hair washing. We had breakfast, this had a good selection of traditional full breakfast or continental offerings - buffet style, eat as much as you like. The machine coffee was surprisingly good. At an overall cost of £79 for 2 including breakfast, this was good value. We arrived early for check-in but they were very accommodating and allowed us to check in early, very nice and friendly staff - very good customer service

title: Fantastic
text: Stayed in Premier inn in Tottenham a few times in last few months and its an absolutely outstanding hotel. Cleanliness is brillant . Staff are very good they go above and beyond what you would expect of them and are always friendly and smiling. Location is excellent . Highly recommend this hotel

title: Good nights sleep. Very convenient location.
text: I stayed here for business overnight. It's very convenient for the train just a hop, skip and jump away from the station with trains heading to Liverpool Street either direct or just a couple of stops on the way. The room was as you would expect from a new Premier Inn though I wasn't able to heat the room, only cool it. I just turned off the air-con and it was pleasant enough. I could hear the person in the adjoining room much clearer than I would have liked but it did not disrupt my sleep. General tip for any hotel, take earplugs. No amount of soundproofing deals with very noisy neighbours. :)

title: Lovely staff
text: Spent one night here after having booked into a very dodgy hotel in Wood Green. Couldnt stay there so booked into Premier. It was like coming home, knowing we would be safe, clean and comfortable. Jo (I think) on reception was most welcoming and very helpful. Got a taxi for us and told us the charge in advance. Used same taxi coming home from gig, they were very prompt and efficient. Hotel immaculate. Asked for extra towel/tea no problem. Chap in the morning (poss manager) also very attentive. Couldnt falut it.

title: Excellent location and views of London
text: Couldn't fault this hotel. You know what to expect from Premier Inn. Superb location right next to Tottenham Hale tube and rail station. Many amenities, fast food restaurants etc right outside too. Excellent views from the front towards central London. Highly recommended.

title: Excellent staff
text: Tottenham Hale probably not the most attractive of places to stay but business needs. But once inside, a very pleasant experience. Staff were the most pleasant I’ve ever met in a Premier Inn (& they’re all usually pretty good). Used the restaurant on both nights & food was great & reasonably priced. Waitresses & reception were all really friendly & very helpful. They certainly work hard here & all seem to multitask which meant you never waited long for assistance. Only slight down side

title: tottenham revisited
text: i just spent the best weekend here. its so central i got off the stanstead express crossed the bus lane n was there. the room was spotless clean n large fab shower, tv hairdryer coffee facilities all for 70 quid no brekkie 2 nights. the staff were friendly n kind n smiley. it was safe n cosy 2 good caffs one by Mannions pub on broad lane and N15 caffe on broad lane( their version of bubble n squeak is spuds n peas rather than cabbage) costa coffee near by boots, jd sports, bnq, etc.great drink in elbow room 1.25 double spirits. san marco fab italian in bruce grove or curry in woodgrn opposite bus depot. i miss my prem inn bed

title: First time at Premier Inn - no complaints!
text: We live locally but ended up staying for a night whilst our bathroom was out of action during building work. The room was spacious, comfortable and clean. Despite its location in a busy part of Tottenham it was also quiet - save for some noise from the corridor coming though the door, but this has to be expected. The staff were friendly and professional, from check in to breakfast.

title: Highly recommended
text: I echo the sentiments of a previous review. You know what you're getting with a Premier Inn but Tottenham Hale is made outstanding by the quality of the staff. On arrival, I was met with a warm and friendly welcome on Reception. I was then ushered into the restaurant, so that I would not miss the opportunity of a meal before service ended for the day, and was greeted by a friendly, efficient waitress who took the time to stop for a chat . The rump steak with peppercorn sauce, served with mushrooms, peas, tomatoes and sweet potato fries was one of the best meals I've had in a long time and was cooked to perfection. Highly recommended.

title: Ideal Accodomation for Spurs Matches.
text: We chose this Premiere Inn because of its location being near to the THFC football stadium and Tottenham Hale transport links to London easily within walking distance. We didn't realise that it was a brand new hotel only opening the same day we arrived but this didn't prevent an organised bag-drop with all the necessary information for checking-in later. We found all the staff extremely helpful during our stay they are a credit to Premier Inn especially those who helped with a delicious Sunday am breakfast. Our stay was upto the usual high standards of a Premier Inn with one small gripe which is only providing two coffee sachets and 2 tiny milk containers in guests rooms this meant having to ask staff for extra supplies for next mornings hot drinks. A bit mean! My visitors tip would have to include the driver dropping off all cases and passengers at the entrance to the hotel first before driving about half mile to the Premier Inn (signed) car park facility which is near to Student Accomodation and beyond Tottenham Hale Rail and Bus Station. It is further than you think after a long journey especially with luggage. We will use thus hotel again when we next visit London combined with watching another Spurs game.

title: Excellent and brilliant location.
text: New premier inn and rooms are clean. The staff are very helpful. Perfectly located only a few steps on tube to centre. I booked 6 months in advance and price was fraction of the price of central hotels. Will visit again and highly recommend.

title: Nice and new but awkward for parking
text: Hotel is clean, efficient and reasonably priced. Exactly what you would expect from Premier Inn. To drop off people it's possible to park in the shopping car park opposite but it's very busy and the spaces are very narrow if you have a big car or 4x4. The nominated car park is 10 minutes walk although not well sign posted and your navigator may have trouble with the one way system, mine did. Having said that £10 for the night isn't too bad locally. The problem is when it's raining! The hotel don't offer customers a loan umbrella (how hard is that to fix? And get free advertising along the route). Access to tube and bus is great. Breakfast isn't cheap but pretty good although to get hot eggs ask for yours specially, don't take from the buffet unless you see them served up. A better than average Premier Inn overall.

title: Stayed for a month
text: This is the second time I have stayed for a month at this Premier Inn and I can’t recommend it enough. Joanne and all the staff are always smiling whatever the time of day. The best Premier Inn in the country...

title: Best Premier Inn
text: Stayed here for one night 03/06/17. Staff were very helpful, informative and happy. We were made to feel very welcome and breakfast was top notch. We always try and stay in Premier Inn's when out and about in the UK and they are always good, but I feel this one is the best I've stayed in so far.

title: Perfect stay
text: Fantastic Location, only a three minutes walk from the station, and just nine minutes to Kings Cross and fourteen minutes to Oxford Circus by tube. Very convenient with several supermarkets, KFC and Burger King surrounding the Hotel, and I guess most important: The way you are treated by the staff. Especially Joanne! What a smiling, positive and caring person!

title: Convenience
text: Usual comfort you expect from Premier Inn. Extremely handy for Stansted express and tube into city. Staff I encountered were lovely and helpful. Didn't quite get the booking we reserved but it didn't ruin the weekend. The only thing that lets it down in comparison to other Premier Inns is the lack of a proper bar (no draught beers) only bottles served in the restaurant. Handy retail park beside it. The staff work very very hard and are always friendly I hope they're appreciated by the company.

title: Night out in London
text: Fantastic service from the staff and a great sleep after a night out. Also had dinner and breakfast onsite food was top quality and modern seating. Fyi there is only a short stay 3 hours max parking outside then you have the choice of using a secure car park for 10 pound a night or there's a couple of streets round the corner a 5 min walk away that you can park without a permit between Friday and Sunday ( 'reception staff can point you in the right direction)

title: Great location and value for money
text: Great hotel for visiting London at a great price not far from city center. 4 Tube stops from Kings Cross. So easy to get to with train and tube. usual Premiere inn quality. lots of shops cafes and shopping surround it.

title: Great service, shame about slightlybtured rooms and noise
text: Amazing service.rooms on the tired side, and customers who seem to think keeping doors open and shouting across is a normal thing as well as sharing music Again, better service than the Marriotts I have been staying in

title: Brilliant
text: Fab hotel lovely clean room, the loveliest staff iv ever had the pleasure to meet Notting is too much trouble a warm smile and hello every time they meet you. Breakfast is first class everything you can think of- always a member of staff there to help if you need anything. Can't wait to come back. Thank you premier inn.

title: Super friendly and helpful
text: I received a warm welcome from reception and noticed how busy the restaurant area was, it felt a welcoming place to stay. My room was a good size, the bed divine! I had such a good nights sleep and it was quiet. Housekeeping need to be commended as the bathroom was spotless! Good shower too. The breakfast at £8.99 is super value for money and I felt really comfortable eating there. As I travel alone so often eating by myself never gets any easier but I felt at ease. The staff were again very friendly and the food fantastic. One of the staff members even took the time to walk out of the building with me to show me directions. Can't fault the staff here, cleanliness and value. Definitely a place to stay and right by the tube so Location great.

title: Good location, Good Price
text: I was in North London for Business and Premier Inn Tottenham hale was a good decision, since station was just next to Hotel so since my flight was from Stansted it just 36 minutes with Stansted express, Tube and Bust station outside your door, save time and money for the movements. Also if you don't have enough time to go you can make some quick and easy shopping at the shopping area outside of the hotel.

title: Excellent Value for London
text: I have stayed here several times as my son stays close by. It is fantastic value for money and only a 3 min walk to Tottenham Hale station which gets you direct to Central London in 15-20 mins. Tottenham Hale also is a stop for the Stansted Express so there is nothing not to like :) If there is a downside then it is that there is no parking on site if you are travelling by car.You can park at Hale village (10 mins walk) at £10/day)

title: Handy location for transport and shops
text: Being only a couple of minutes from Tottenham Hale tube/train and bus stations the location is ideal for getting around London. There was a direct train every 30 mins to the Olympic Park (Stratford) which takes just 10 mins. Otherwise the tube takes you to Kings Cross and central London in 10/15 mins. Plenty of food outlets close to hotel (but more fast food - KFC, Pizza Hut etc) and Lidl supermarket across the road. Bar area isn't very drinking friendly and seems to close very early but wasn't an issue for us. WiFi was a bit patchy - had to keep logging back in. Overall very happy with it considering the price.

title: Great place and convenient
text: Always welcome and polite staff. Joanne looks after regular guests politely and professionally allocating best rooms for people classing the hotel as a second home! Can't recommend it too much as it might become fully booked and where would I stay then!

title: amazing
text: amazing little family holiday to London loved the location due to tube station being a stone through away , also had shops take away food and restaurants right next door as well . great find and staff are amazing with great breakfast

title: Convenient location, value for money
text: Stayed here as attending a gig at Finsbury park. The location was excellent for this venue and the airport which is why we choose it. Also it was very reasonably priced. The staff were very helpful and friendly. Rooms were clean although noticeable less so than another premier inn we had just come from which was pristine. May have been the marks on wall and water damaged bathroom celling that just gave it a bit of a more tired look. Bed sheet were spotless. Its very close to train station and busy road but did not hear a thing was so quiet inside the hotel.

title: Affordable Pleasant stay
text: Tottenham Hale Inn , is one of the best hotel in London. Friendly, clean, good qualitity, very close to tube station and train station to stanted airport .. I recommend. Lots of shops near by. Very affordable ,a good point.

title: Great value and spotless
text: Located by Tottenham Hale station. The hotel is brand new and spotless. Service was excellent and the rooms a good size for a budget. The hotel has no car park but parking at Tottenham Hale Village is 5 mins walk away at £10 per day. They state no drop off but you can park in the retail park outside the front door free for 3 hours. Visit Beavertown brewery by the car park!

title: Nothing too much trouble for Jo
text: Family of six up to London to see the Para Athletics got into Premier Inn Saturday afternoon with a great smiley welcome from Jo Self service all went well but got to the rooms and there were just two beds in each when we needed six. A short wait and a cup of tea from the restaurant staff and Jo sorted out the right rooms and made them up herself. She is a star. Usual great breakfast in the morning, one if the reasons I go to Premier Inns. Thank you

title: Brill
text: Very clean and central to shops restaurants and public transport to get around London. Had a great 4 days definitely will be my first choice when going back to London plus staff always on hand if needed .

title: Great Hotel and super staff
text: Just home from a weekend break at this hotel. We chose this hotel as our daughter lives just a few tube stops away. Hotel is located across the road from the tube, so super handy for getting around. From the moment we arrived we found the staff friendly, helpful and happy to assist with all our needs. Check in was efficient & got good direction on arrival to dining room and bedroom. Room was lovely, stayed in room 707, lovely quite room with lovely comfy bed and pillows. Ate breakfast both mornings and a good selection to choose from, staff very good at clearing away dirty dishes, again breakfast area spotlessly clean. We will most definitely be returning to this hotel, a great place to stay when visiting beautiful London.

title: London
text: Excellent location very close to both London Underground and overground rail services. Shops nearby if you need anything. Great breakfast both continental and full English and it also had a good evening menu.

title: Great value for money!
text: Really clean and well appointed - good room with tea/coffee making facilities and shower gel etc provided. Really good buffet style English breakfast included in price. Excellent value for money accommodation- highly recommended.

title: Bit out of the way, but nice enough
text: Close to the park, but a good walk out to local restaurants, shops and tube, bus stop not far away. Pleasant accommodation, but can be pricy depending on season. Nearby road can also be noisy at time. Good breakfast but served a bit late if you’re working in town.

title: Great Place to Stay
text: Stayed in this hotel recently for two nights and thought it was great value for money! [£70 a night for two] Good breakfast, helpful staff and just a short 10 minute stroll from the tube. Brilliant and would highly recommend the hotel.

title: London
text: It was the best stay in London. Everything was excellent. The breakfast was so english.

title: A weekend break for mummy and daddy!
text: We arrived here on Friday around 12ish and was welcomed (even though very early for checkin) by a lovely friendly receptionist who gave us the option of choosing between 2 rooms so off we went to explore! The first room was divine but the shower room too small for my liking so we carried on and checked the other room which was wonderful. We were in room 17 which was in the eves of the roof but had a wonderful bathroom and lovely furnishings. The whole guest house was clean and tidy and all the staff that we met were professional and helpful. Our only criticism was the breakfast, we ate it on the first morning but not the second. It looked like it had been there for a while and didn’t get us excited BUT I totally understand that if you don’t have many guests it’s hard to know who’s going to be there to enjoy it. We would definitely stay here again as it was incredible value for money and only 3 stops and 15 minutes on the train to Victoria. Balham was a delight this weekend

title: Bumped from a pre-booked double to a pokey twin
text: We had booked a double room at the Balham Lodge on the basis of a friends recommendation of it being the most handy for a wedding reception we were to attend. The booking was made by phone several months in advance (A man named Kofi) and reconfirmed by phone in the week prior to our arrival as we had called to check whether there would be anywhere for us to change, anticipating our early arrival would mean the room might not be ready. We were duly told it would be no problem, Upon arrival I was met with a rather nonchalant greeting from the duty staff member (Kristian, he later told me upon request) who told us our room would not be ready for a while. Not a problem I told him, could he just let us know where we could change. He informed us there was nowhere to change but that if we wanted to move to one of the other twin rooms he could let us stay in there. The other TWIN rooms? I questioned. But we had booked a double. He protested that the system said we had a twin reserved and that all the doubles were already fully occupied. I protested that I had booked a double, months in advance but he insisted I had booked a twin. Now, 10 years ago this would not have been a problem to a party animal singleton as I would have simply checked in, changed, gone to the wedding, got drunk, come back, fallen asleep, got up, eaten a hang-over beating breakfast and departed. However, the reason I know I booked a double room is that these days I am married. Not only am I married, but upon arrival my wife was seven months pregnant, suffering from backache and having difficulty sleeping at the best of times. Somebody had messed up big time. Either the booking was taken incorrectly or, given the lodge was full, our single night booking had been bumped in preference of a more lucrative duration stay. Either way, the lounging receptionist didn't appear at all bothered. He said the best he could do was give us the room booked. We were not entirely amused when he "kindly" offered it at the double rate as opposed to the £6 more expensive single rate. After hauling our luggage up the stairs to room 9, we entered to discover that not only was it a twin, but it was a twin designed for people who disliked each other and wished to keep a considerable distance and preferably no clear line of sight between themselves. With my wife in tears, I sat on the exceptionally narrow single bed and sank dramatically into it's folds. There was no way a heavily pregnant woman with backache could sleep on this very cheap mattress. We were now stumped as we only had an hour before we needed to be at the wedding so there was little scope for finding an alternative. She made a desperate emergency call to some friends who lived in Streatham and explained the situation. Fortunately they were willing to offer us their bed for the evening. We therefore got changed, loaded the car and I returned the room key. The laid back dude on reception was suddenly startled into action claiming we only came there so we could get changed. No, you insolent cock, we came there to spend the night in the double room we had booked. It just so happens the room was not reserved for us as expected so we choose not to part with our money for sub-standard accommodation, a receptionist with attitude and a painful, sleepless night for my wife. Perhaps with an online booking option available the situation might change. You have however been warned.

title: Excellent hotel.
text: Here for work, excellent value for money. However the cook in the morning was the only downside as I have never been spoken/treated to like this in a long time, so apart from the rude lady in the breakfast area I would highly recommend. Would have love to have returned for the duration of my time, (end of February) but this unfortunate episode has lost a customer. Excellent on the desk, but poor people skills from the rude woman in the kitchen.

title: Need of a t l c, lovelyreception staff
text: We visited again due to the location, close to the tube link, Quiet area. I did feel a few changes could be made to the bedroom , ie a fresh lick of paint, mirror on the dressing table, charging socket for a toothbrush. hook in the shower to hang a dressing gown, Disappointing breakfast. Coffee was filter coffee which was left warming in the pot and therfore stewed - I would have preferred more but didn't like to ask,More cereal choices would be great and more fruit juices. Also when breakfast is being served till 10am do not assume you can go down 9.45Am. Staff are ready to clear away at 10.

title: Very disappointed
text: Good location and 10 mins walk to the tube and a pretty building BUT we didn’t enjoy our stay. Room 15 has a very very uncomfortable bed and a tiny old fashioned shower. Despite it being October the room was like a furnace and the fan didn’t work. Despite having paid for 2 nights we left after one - I won’t be going back

title: Convenient location
text: Convenient hotel for us as attending concert at Clapham Common, 30 minute walk, 10 minute walk from Balham station. We had room 17 in the attic, would not be ideal for tall people as sloped ceilings. Room very spacious and clean. We unfortunately didn't sleep great as room so warm, had a large fan but noisy to leave on, other option was open windows but road,voices on main road outside. Breakfast okay, not very warm. Helpful receptionist.

title: Just Comfortable Shower Unworkable - Complaint Ignored
text: Stayed here for a couple of nights recently arrived with high expectations,Unfortunately my expectations were not met. Extremely small ensuite bathroom (tiny shower) water stayed in the sink and shower for over a half an hour making even the simplest task of hand washing impossible - brought the problem to the owners attention who said she look at it - didn't bother to fix it - completely unacceptable. Room was on the small side for 3 sharing. On a good note the breakfast was very good. In addition its a good walk to the underground station/shops about 10min.

title: Fantastic guest house!
text: We were delighted that our room (1) was beautiful. Nicely decorated, such a comfy bed, and a sofa, coffee table, desk, chair and wardrobe. The bath has two showers which you could use at the same time

title: Always a comfortable stay
text: I have stayed here twice and wouldn't hesitate to stay again. Parking is a bit tight but otherwise everything is really good. Clean, warm and comfortable with really helpful staff. Breakfast is good so what's not to like.

title: Nice hotel, terrible food
text: The room was nice, clean and tidy though rather warm. But breakfast was awful! Flaccid watery bacon, tasteless mushrooms, tasteless tomatoes and hash browns that were bendy and inedible. The coffee was like coal tar and there was no decaff option. We are unlikely to go back.

title: Very pleasant
text: I stayed here for two nights last weekend it's clean comfortable extra pillows if needed plenty of tea and coffee supplied car parking on the road on the side of the lodge was free after four o clock the breakfast was also included in the price and it was good

title: Lovely Guesthouse
text: This was our 2nd visit to Balham Lodge. It is a nice little guesthouse and the staff are very helpful and polite. It may not be 5 star luxury but very good value for money and clean. There are complimentary tea and coffee in your room, along with a TV. Ideal for the one night stay in London. Would highly recommend.

title: Impressed!
text: Booked this on booking.com and wasn't sure what it was going to be like - especially as we were allowed to book four adults into one room! However, as soon as we arrived we realised it was going to be great. The out side is inviting and the inside was clean and tidy. We were able to park securely out the back for free which was great. The reception was 24h check in which was great as we didn't arrive back from our event until just after 11pm. The staff were all friendly and helpful. The room was perfect! Large TV, really comfortable bed, a fan and a super bathroom with a great shower. Breakfast was included. It was a buffet style and was fine- I think if we'd come down for breakfast earlier it may have been fresher but that was our fault for sleeping later! The breakfast area was very clean and the ladies working were efficient. I was super impressed with this find. It was a half hour walk to Clapham Common where our event was but even for a weekend in a different part of London- I'd definitely use again!

title: Excellent value for money.
text: Excellent value for money. 10min walk to Balham underground and links to city. Good shops and nice pubs around. Very clean room, very friendly staff & good brekkie in morning time. Would definitely use again.

title: Weekend break
text: Highly recommend Balham Lodge for a short stay. Spotlessly clean throughout and very friendly staff. The room was quite small (booked a single) but perfect for two nights. Great to be able to open the window and an oscillating fan kept me cool during an unusually warm spring weekend in London. Only had the breakfast one morning after deciding that there was so much choice for great breakfast in Balham. There was only one other car in the car park at the same time as me so I never had any problems parking. Would definitely stay here again.

title: If you need to be in Balham...
text: If you need to be in Balham or Brixton then OK. Stayed 1 night, tiny room (no. 2), breakfast good, free parking, £60 'nuff said.

title: What a pleasant, and lovely surprise for an amazing price in London
text: I found Balham Lodge in an internet search for lodging for when I needed to come up to the area. Rather than stay in a pricey London hotel - even Travel Lodges/Premier Inn was looking at £80 plus....I found this. What a wonderful surprise. Easy to find and book, and answered my questions about parking. £50 for the night , a lovely ensuite room, full cooked breakfast and ample free parking. The room was stunning, and absolutely spotless. Lovely furnishings, comfortable bed, wooden floors, tasteful and a home away from home Very modern but with a homely twist. Well recommended. The breakfast area was clean and breakfast plentiful with staff on hand. Very friendly staff, and 24 hour access which was great as I returned very late from my event. I took some photographs of the room to show people as it was very very good for the money.

title: Hidden gem
text: My daughter and I stayed here for 2 nights in a twin room. We got a warm welcome and given a choice of rooms. We chose a room upstairs which was absolutely charming. So nice to get a room with character. It looked as if had been recently decorated and was very clean and fresh. The bathroom was small but modern and there was plenty of hot water. Breakfast was buffet style with plenty of choice. The hotel was 10 mins walk from Balham station which was perfect for us. We would definitely stay here again.

title: Balham Dodge...if you can
text: Stayed one night for a business trip. Friends who live nearby recommended the Balham Lodge. Further from Balham tube station than I'd expected, but that's not their fault. Checked in around 8pm. Not a terribly friendly process. Not rude, just not very interested. Had booked a standard double, was upgraded to a superior double. Heaven knows what the standard rooms must be like! On the good side the tv was large and the shower was powerful. On the down side the furnishings were old and tired. Noisy in the early evening, could hear the people in the room above me. Did not feel at all homely. But then I suppose that depends on what type of home you live in. Didn't have breakfast. Checkout was easy and the receptionist in the morning was more friendly. Overall clean and decent. But nothing to really look forward to.

title: A place like home
text: Did a lot of research before travelling, finally decided on Balham lodge since almost every reviewer spoke well about the place, well, u need to experience this place to really appreciate it. Lovely place, great staff, wonderfull breakfast, about a mile from a tube and train station, a little off the center of city, but the senerity is overwhelming. My dad and i stayed here for 3 weeks, came back from laundry one day, and Mrs Araba asked, why spend money on laundry?, i was then allowed use of the the hotel laundry (since they dont do laundry) and their kitchen to cook my launch and dinner - imagine, i call it 'A PLACE LIKE HOME. - EXCELLENT.A

title: Overnight stay
text: Arrived at 11.30pm after a family wedding. Rooms cosy & functional - showers & bathroom clean. Staff friendly Breakfast was excellent, tasty and fresh. Overcharged when paid bill but rectified quickly and promptly.

title: Good Enough and Fair Value
text: I stayed at Balham Lodge on a Friday night in early October, arriving at 1500 and leaving at 1000 the next day. I arrived and left by train. Balham rail station and underground are a 10-15 minute walk away. I can't tell you about how it works for cars or parking. I had not been to Balham before. Its shopping centre, including restaurants and supermarkets, is near to the station and seemed OK to me. It's not picturesque inner London, it's workaday suburbia, conveniently close to all the Inner London attractions. It's not downtrodden inner city. Middling OK. Balham Lodge is a corner property, very close to a large park. The road in front of it has two lanes, one in each direction, and is normally busy for London, but not horribly large and noisy. The house is set back a little from the road and the path to the front door is well kept. Balham Lodge is a house of the Heaver Estate, built in Queen Anne style, with oriole windows, and some very ornate red brickwork, in about 1889. I think there were originally 21 similar properties along Bedford Hill. Some of these will be evident to you, if you walk to Balham Lodge from Balham (this is also a bus route, and there are many taxis outside Balham Station. Balham Station connects you to London Victoria, London Bridge, and Clapham Junction stations, as well as to Watford and Milton Keynes to the north.) Some of the Heaver estate houses were bombed in the second world war. And some have deteriorated and not been well looked after. This is a pity, because, as late nineteenth property goes, they are rather beautiful buildings. The owners of Balham Lodge have striven to return the building to a little of its former glory, though the necessities of cramming rooms into the property have presumably subdivided some spaces. My 'standard double' room (I was alone) was at the top of the first flight of stairs - number 6, on the left. It was L-shaped, with rather a gloomy entrance 'hall' containing a low, period-effect, wardrobe, whose paintwork had seen better days. But I run ahead of myself... I agree with other reviewers, who have commented that reception was friendly. I thought it was efficient, relaxed and organised. The reception desk is staffed 24-hours and they don't like guests to take keys out of the building. The property fits the genre, 'guest house.' It's neither a standard 'B&B' nor a standard hotel. It does fit my stereotype of a 'guest house.' The floor of my L-shaped bedroom was not carpeted. It wasn't lino either. It was some sort of laminate or wood-effect. Judging by the sound when people walked round on the floor above me, the room above was also not carpeted. The double bed was exactly as in the above picture, but in my room, it only just fitted the space allocated to it, lengthwise, so the space between the end of the bed and the wall, for part of the way, was manageable but narrow. There was a period effect bedside table on each side of the bed, each containing a lamp and rather shaky shades. The lamps worked fine, though. There was a tiny tear in the bed sheet. The duvet was warm, and there were spare blankets in the wardrobe. The pillows were fine. The other leg of the 'L' in my room led to a sash window, looking out on the back of the property and the side road. There were net curtains, as well as curtains you could draw. The bottom half of the window would open, but, irritatingly, wouldn't stay open. There was a small chest, with a kettle on it, whose flex did not reach the plug point. It was stationed on a tray, with cups and teabags, and coffee. By turning the tray, I managed to put the kettle in range of the plug point. The one radiator, under the window, was not on, but there was what looked like a tower fan heater. I didn't try it. There was a good booklet with information for guests - detailed and well-written. I never managed to make the wall TV work, but since I don't have a TV at home, I'm seriously out of date on remotes. I'm also useless at asking for help - far too shy. So we won't blame the hotel for these technical issues. I thought the shower room was very nearly too small, by any standards. It was just about OK, size-wise but might have posed a problem for a large or aged person. The plug didn't fit the sink. I wet shave, and I'm grumpy first thing in the morning, so this was seriously irritating. Goodness knows how much hot water I wasted, trying to keep the sink full: it was a losing battle. As fast as I filled it, it emptied. The mattress was fine, and the room was peaceful at night. The breakfast room is called The Conservatory, and is at the back of the property, with the option of eating on a patio behind it. The choice of cereals was adequate. The breakfast staff were friendly and kind. Other guests said hello. A wide-screen TV was blaring out BBC Breakfast Time news. Everything was 'help yourself.' They don't offer the range of cereals, or fruit, or cold meats, or cheeses, you find in many of the budget chains now. But it was good enough. There was a toaster. There was bread. There was yoghourt. There were fruit juices. There was fresh fruit. I don't think that full English breakfast really works, on a buffet. Balham Lodge, more wisely than other hotels, didn't attempt to keep fried eggs warm (they need to be fresh and sizzling from the pan). They did have scrambled egg and boiled egg on the hotplates. The scrambled egg was acceptable, but nothing like how it is, if it is cooked fresh and as the guest likes it to be. There are cheaper B&B's around, who give you a decent fresh-cooked English breakfast. Hash browns and sausages survive hot plates better, and were fine. I found the heaps and heaps of shoulder bacon in one tub a bit dispiriting, and almost sufficient to turn me into a vegetarian. Great that it was lean bacon, but, kept warm that way, it tastes more like boiled gammon than fried bacon, as it would be in the traditional English breakfast. The mushrooms were dreadful and a complete waste of time and space. Seeing mushrooms treated like that almost turned me into a carnivore. They weren't mushrooms, they were mushroom segments. When will the world of catering learn that it's only worth serving mushrooms if you cook them lightly and serve them fast? (You see, I was still grumpy, even at breakfast). The coffee, in a cona flask, wasn't very not and felt like it had been around too long. No choice of whole milk, semi-skimmed, or skimmed. Bad news. I liked the breakfast room, I liked the staff, I liked the guests, but I didn't rate the breakfast. Overall, the question I'm left with, having paid £90 for all that, is how to be fair to Balham Lodge, which was spotlessly clean everywhere, warm, friendly and welcoming. It has to be compared with comparable London guest houses. I haven't stayed in enough of them to know what is a fair price, in that kind of location. It was good enough and I thank its staff for their contribution to that.

title: Great value, lovely hotel
text: Stayed here whilst attending a wedding and it was lovely. The staff were really helpful and kind and the room was clean and well looked after. The breakfast room was really nice and the food was great. Would recommend.

title: Lovely hotel, will be back soon.
text: Stayed for one night as part of two couples. Both our room and the other couples room were lovely. The furnishings, the look and feel of the rooms were very nice. This was true of the hotel as a whole! The staff were friendly and very helpful. The nearest tube station a 15/20 mins walk but plenty to do in the area in terms of restaurants and pubs. The breakfast was all you can eat self device which is great. However, the quality of some of the hot food could be better but nothing too much to worry about as there was plenty of choice. Many thanks Balham Lodge!

title: Surprisingly good.
text: We decided last minute to stay overnight for the madness gig on Clapham Common, as you can imagine you don't get much of a choice when you book when the nutty boys are in town. We booked on booking.com and didn't really have high hopes. Well a good 15 minutes walk from the tube and what a lovely surprise, beautiful frontage, a warm welcome and very clean. Room 17 on the top floor was clean fairly spacious and well appointed, TV, fan, and tea and coffee facilities. That's pretty much it, but what else do you need? 3/4 size double bed, comfy enough but maybe just a bit small for us. The one area they lost a point was the immaculate clean bathroom where I struggled with the shower pressure, not really a huge issue but not a 5* reward. Breakfast was included in my £90, but we didn't make it. Thank you Balham Lodge, you are more than worth the your fee. I cannot comment about surroundings except you have a few pubs scattered around the area. Certainly worth a visit.

title: A bed for the night
text: I stay in the Balham lodge when visiting London for business. It has comfortable beds, good wifi and an excellent all you can eat breakfast. It has its own parking for 4 to 5 residents but there is parking on adjacent residential roads which is free and close enoughto be monitored on the cctv. Always a pleasant stay and would recommend.

title: Recommended, and l'll return.
text: My gratitude to all the staff at Balham Lodge who made all guests welcome. They work extremely hard and are a super team. Super location for bus and tube services, and local shopping. I will certainly recommend Balham Lodge to family, friends and colleagues. Kind regards, Raymond O'Connor

title: Good, clean and reasonably priced
text: I stayed for one night, the receptionist and check it was very friendly and helpful. I was given room 11 at the front of the hotel, it was very clean and bright, a room for three, although I was there by myself (I had booked the last available room). The shower was clean with fresh towels and had a lovely modern decor. Breakfast was the standard affair good choice of hot English breakfast, cereals, fruit, croissants and tea/coffee and fresh juice. The road is quite noisy but then again you are in London! The only negative was the single beds in the triple room were rather narrow - I'm not big and felt they were a tad small. I had a lovely stay and would recommend the Balham Lodge.

title: Quaint Accommodation
text: Have spent three nights here. Rooms are nicely decorated and spotlessly clean and beds are comfy. Staff have been very friendly and helpful. There is a wonderful breakfast each morning. It is a ten minute walk to the shops, eateries and train. A bus stop is outside. A great place to base yourself for easy access into London.

title: Weekend trip to London
text: We went to London for my Girlfriends Birthday and we found this amazing Lodge little out side of London (about 15 min by Tube) The Rooms are typical englisch, adorable and clean. Typical Englisch Breakfast nothing fancy but tasty and good. We are looking forward of saying there again, next time.

title: Just ok - wouldn't stay again
text: Stayed at the end of April 2016 for 2 nights. Walls are paper thin so you can hear everything. Bathroom small and shower was poor - went all over the place and created swimming pool in bathroom. Bed very 'springy'. Breakfast is a buffet - not freshly made so scrambled eggs in a bay Marie etc. staff are very pleasant but I think a stay at a travel lodge of Ibis would be better. Good location - 15 min walk from tube.

title: Sufficient for your needs
text: I wouldn't rave about this hotel, but I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again. It's a nice place for the price. It's about a 10-15 min walk to the closest tube, but there's a huge park close by. Bathrooms, although ensuites, were unreasonably small....VERY SMALL. as in walk in, and you can touch toilet sink, back of shower, without moving. Being only 9 rooms...there wasn't a lot of choice..but it's an old building, and is definitey not sound proof..we were next to the front door, and you could hear everything...including the phone being answered. Breakfast was ok...but nothing special, tho it is hot. However, we went 35 min before it closed, and they coffee was done...my friend asked to make another pot (he was willing to make it himself) and they said he had to have instant instead :( The same lady who does this runs the housekeeping, and although the place was clean, we were literally chased from the room at checkout time. It didn't leave a good taste in my mouth. The hotel itself was OK....hard to rave about it tho.

title: Friendly staff make you feel very welcome
text: Stayed at Balham Lodge for 1 night, the staff were very friendly and helpful, the room was spacious and clean, with tv, tea and coffee facilities in the room, it was nice and warm on a cold evening, the bathroom was spotless there was plenty of choice for breakfast. It had off street parking. And had a small room for relaxing or to watch tv with tea and coffee facilities. About a 10 minute walk to the train station and main street, quick taxi service that you can book through reception. I was very impressed with this hotel and would definitely stay here again when in the area.

title: Good find
text: Looking for a place for just one night. This could not have been better when compared to other options around. Cosy, clean, well decorated with character, comfortable, warm on a very cold night. Reasonable breakfast. Good for continental but cooked passable. My room was small but very adequate for the job. Shower room very compact but clean, very nicely decorated with lovely towels (a test for me - hate smelly mucky looking worn towels) and lovely soaps. A treat. Fit for purpose and far nicer and better value than on offer from Travelodge. I would book again.

title: A hidden gem
text: My husband and I stayed here for five nights in October/November and we were pleasantly surprised. We were greeted by the ever so friendly owner of Balham Lodge who checked us in and brought a tray of coffee and tea and biscuits to our room on arrival, which was such a lovely touch, especially after just getting off a long flight from LA. Our room was lovely and clean and so was the ensuite bathroom. Every morning we would make our way to the gorgeous breakfast room downstairs for a full buffet breakfast, which was delicious. The Balham tube station is only minutes walk away and are many shops etc. I will be recommending Balham lodge to friends and family and will definitely be returning. Many thanks to all the staff who made our stay so comfortable.

title: Love this place so much
text: Love this place. Lovely rooms. Nice staff. Use of all the kitchen area which was handy. Breakfast lovely. Parking at rear. Close to local shops bars etc. And sky tv in rooms. That sealed it for me. When I'm working away and come back to watch sky sports etc. Is a good fit for me. Will use time and time again when working sw London.

title: Great find
text: Spotlessly clean in a perfect location for our family visit. Efficient service checking in and out and at breakfast but a little smile would have been nice especially at breakfast. Will be staying again on our next visit as its a bargain for London and is great value

title: A better hotel for the price in London you will not find.
text: Four of us stayed here for one night and cannot recommend this guest house highly enough. The building is beautiful with so many original features. The rooms are plain and simple, but beautifully decorated and spotlessly clean. The breakfast is a hot buffet and again, perfectly fine and in a very pleasant breakfast room with French doors out onto the patio. It also has the advantage of some on-site parking. We would certainly stay again.

title: value for money
text: The room we stayed in was lovely and clean. A little on edge if you're a night owl though because I was worried about disturbing the room attached next door. Window does open to cool the room down and there's a big fan. There's a little traffic noise but it is London! Staff were fantastic! So polite and helpful. Breakfast is a plus. A little cooler than I'd like but it came as a deal so essentially it's a free cooked breakfast. There's a community lounge that's nice. It's only a 12 min walk to the station on the way theres a big sainbury for essentials and its a easy commute to Waterloo for only £7.20 return. If its late when you get back taxis are outside balham station it's only a fiver back to the hotel. Lovely little stay for the money. Cheaper and quieter than right in the centerfield.

title: Great Hotel! Value for money
text: I stayed here with my boyfriend for a night. The hotel is clean and modern (pictures online don't do it justice!). Balham underground station is a 10-15 minute walk away. Free wifi! Lovely breakfast. We were pleasantly surprised! We will come again.

title: Great value
text: The staff are extremely friendly and keen to make you welcome. The room was tidy and functional without being overwhelming. Breakfast was decent but could do with being a touch hotter. Free parking was a real bonus. Overall it was a good experience for a great price. I will be visiting again.

title: We visit fairly regularly, just goodd value for mony!
text: Both my daughters now live or at uni around Balham so we regularly stay in this area. This must now be about our fourth stay at Balham Lodge if not more. We have always found the hotel to be very friendly, its spotlessly clean and appears well cared for. We stayed in room 8 this time which is at the back of the hotel is a large room on London standards and we found it quite comfortable. As I have said before, this is not the Ritz, but neither is the nightly rate! The breakfast is ok but again as said before could be better, just some more upmarket ingredients would make a real difference, even if that added a few pounds to the nightly rate. The hotel doesn’t have lots of add-on’s there is no gym or swimming pool or cafes, but there is a laundry and you are encouraged eat food brought into the hotel in the dining room. The décor does look a little dated, but don’t be fooled, that is in keeping with the age of the building and I suspect by design more than anything. I would give this hotel four stars, that means good for me, five stars is exceptional. It gets four stars because for London Balham Lodge offers good value for money and because of the standards of cleanliness in the hotel. Improve the quality of the breakfast and I could be tempted to give it five stars!

title: Good first impression but...
text: A nice plave overall but... Breakfast was in a small crowded room at the back with THREE members of staff watching. I was repremanded for opening a glass door to reach a bottle of water and told it was chargable. I asked why this cabinet wasn't locked or marked "items for sale" but there was no response.

title: Fantastic place at a very good price,
text: I stayed in Balham Lodge so I could visit my son who lives very close by. It is very convenient for the tube (aboout 10 mins walk) and is at a very reasonable price for location. The rooms are incredibly clean and a good size and there is also a well equipped TV room just off reception. I had read reviews about the noise being an issue but I had the window open all night and slept very well both nights without hearing too much from the road.
