My only issue with the stay was that the receptionist who received me on the 1st night was very rude and not at all welcoming or helpful, she gave no information and only uttered the words 'you can pay now.' In fairness the other lady who I saw on reception was the complete opposite in being warm, friendly and helpful it just got the stay off to a bad start. The breakfast is buffet style and a good standard and set me up for the day. I would stay again due to convenience, price and the whole feel of the place, if it wasnt for the one disappointing staff member then they would get a 5* review from me.

title: Great value for money!! Lovely place!
text: Me & my friend stayed here last weekend as we had a festival to go to near by. The hotel was perfect for us very clean, free parking & friendly staff. We didn't make breakfast as we had a lay in instead but wish we had as the hotel looked so nice I bet the food was good too. We really appreciated the late check out as well midday is a great time. Overall great for what we needed couldn't have asked for more! Also the night receptionist was extra helpful calling us taxis even in the early hours of the morning.

title: A great place to stay
text: Had an excellent time at Balham lodge rooms were clean and comfortable, staff were very helpful , breakfest was good full english and only a short walk into Balham tube what a good place to stay would highly reccommend prices were very reasonable, my sister in law and I loved it. We will be back.

title: Wedding
text: We chose this travel lodge because it was most convenient to where the wedding was being held. On the whole our stay was ok but the room was very basic and extremely hot. But we found the staff to be very obliging and nothing seemed too much trouble we any requests we had.

title: An excellent place to stay in London
text: We loved the place - excellent conditions, beautiful bathroom, and a very large well-furnished IKEA-style bedroom. The place was spotlessly clean - we were kind of surprised having in mind the reputation of hostels and budget hotels in the UK. The staff was very helpful. The breakfast was plentiful and varied and we even got afternoon coffee/tea with biscuits upon arrival! The only downside is that our room faced a busy road and it was rather noisy most of the time but I guess if we had had a room facing the back yard it would have been different. Overall, we had an unforgettable experience at Balham Lodge and we will definitely return when we go back to London.

title: Great digs in Balham for extended stay..
text: My husband and I stayed here last September and it was a wonderful , attractive, friendly,convenient place to stay while we visited family and saw London..good value for the $ and lovely people running the place.

title: Very good value
text: Seamless check-in, clean rooms, no noise whatsoever from the trains (but we were on the other side of the building from the tracks), comfortable beds and overall a really good-value stay. It's basic but for a London hotel it was cheap and exactly what we were after.

title: Our second visit
text: Hiya this was our second visit to Balham Lodge, it was back in October but the system has only just let me put another review on. Second visit very similar to first in many ways, still very clean, the staff were very helpful - we needed to change rooms part way through our stay as we booked late and they only had two single rooms for the first night (we knew that at time of booking). Picking up on an issue raised within another review at one time we spoke to the staff about access - its something I am interested in both through work and because I am visually impaired - because of the age of the building permission to install a lift has been refused, which does raise an issue for people with poor mobility, but don't dismiss this hotel because of that do check with the staff as some of the rooms on the ground floor aren't too difficult to get in. Still the same view as from our first stay - this hotel offers really good value for money, no its not Claredgies but it is very clean and firnedly. Will stay again when in Balham.

title: Nice Hotel and Very Good Value
text: I stayed in this hotel recently while visiting relatives in Balham. It was very reasonably priced for London and situated about ten minutes walk from Balham Tube and Railway Stations which was very convenient for travel around London. Our room was very clean with a well appointed bathroom. Staff at the reception were very pleasant and helpful. I would certainly use the hotel again when staying in the area.

title: A Good Choice for a Weekend Stay
text: We wanted to stay in the Streatham/Tooting area and chose Balham Lodge due to its reviews on Trip Advisor, it was everything previous reviewers have reported, not in the same league as Claridges but friendly and very clean. The bedrooms are arranged over a number of flights of stairs so guests with mobility problems need to ask for a room on the ground floor, the stair issue was exasperated by the cleaners leaving mops and buckets on the stairs whilst cleaning the rooms! We were really looking forward the breakfast advertised in Reception but whilst the bacon was really good the scrambled eggs were dreadful and swimming in water. When we booked we were aware that there was car parking for four cars but realised after squeezing the car in the car park that the parking outside was unrestricted at the weekends which meant we could have had ready access to our vehicle and save on taxi fares.

title: Very good value
text: We we're in London for sort of extended weekend. We chose Balham Lodge because of good reviews on internet and for reasonable price. And we weren't disappointed. Clean, super friendly, decent breakfast, on a peaceful place. Not much of a traffic noises or other interferences. Only a ten(ish) minute walk to train and underground station, where deaparts regular trains to the city. All and all very good value for money.

title: Excellent Value
text: Friendly staff, well priced and not far from the center of London, next to a nice park, if you like to take a morning jog, ideal! Takes 10 mins to walk to the underground or overground station (Balham) Train 15 mins to Victoria, 35 mins with underground to Leicester Square. The area (Balham) has lots of nice restaurants and bars where you can relax after spending the day in the center of town. Highly recommended.

title: Very clean
text: Stayed for one night as had a night out in London near by. The receptionist didn't give us a great welcome and hardly said two words to us. Room was very small but expected that. Breakfast was a bit of a let down seemed like no love went into the food and again the staff here didn't welcome us - we ended up going out for food. Having said all this it was the cheapest place in the area, very clean and comfy so was happy over all.

title: Friendly welcome
text: Reasonably priced, friendly welcome and very clean all round. Ensuite bathroom clean, though could do with new shower head. Excellent breakfast and fresh coffee - none of the instant stuff oh no. Practical and 10 minute walk from the station.

title: Very good
text: Was in Balham for a birthday party and chose this guest house because of the reviews on trip advisor.. Very satisfied with our stay. A beautiful building, with lots of character and charm. Spotlessly clean. Stayed in room 9 at the front of the building on our first night, then another family member had a single room, number 14. Some traffic noise from front room but not unbearably so. Back room quieter. Breakfast adequate but some sections needed replenished on both days. Overall, very happy and would book again as we visit this area at least twice a year.

title: Please remember this is not the Ritz!
text: I sense people are very slightly nervous of staying at Balham Lodge and I wonder why? I think some of the photos do not do justice to the Lodge, they tend to make it look a little old fashioned and perhaps there is a thought its uncared for. We booked late wanting to stay three night, they could only fit us in for two night but even that would mean a room change - not an issue we clearly knew that at time of booking. The Lodge is Victorian with many Edwardian features which have been retained, like the lovely stained glass front door, almost certainly the original staircase and I suspect many of the original window frames - the hotel is within a conservation area so they are probably near impossible to replace! First impressions, The decorations are in keeping with the age of the building but very clearly modern, The hotel is spotlessly clean throughout. It is situated on the edge of Tooting Bec common which is lovely. The first night was in room 13 which is on the back of the hotel and overlooks the gardens its a good sized room, It has what appears to be Edwardian furniture and one of the old fashioned styled beds (from Ikea I think!) that can be seen in the photos, it has a smallish shower room with modern, spotlessly clean fittings.For Balham, it has something of an unusual feature - opening windows and fresh air! Its away from the traffic so was comparatively quite at night. I did however find the room a little dark some lighter wall covering would help there but hey! Second night was in room 11 which is a family room this has two beds, again the old styled ones one a double and a single. Its a good sized room, again with a shower room, again modern and all spotlessly clean. This room is on the front of the hotel so does suffer somewhat from the noise of the traffic on the main road but it does quieten down at night. My wife found the bed in this room a little hard compared to 11 - I found it better! On our third night - thanks to somebody not showing up - we were back in room 13 and the Travelodge was cancelled. The breakfast, always a big issue on tripadvisor! I found it a little underwhelming on the first day, however there was good choice for a small hotel including some lovely fresh fruit. We had to leave early on our last day, so went down for breakfast a little early, this caused no problem, we felt what we had was much better than on the first day. We have visited Balham three times - our daughter is at Uni and has a flat in Balham. We have stayed in the travelodge twice - see our review. We will be back there in October so would we stay at Balham Lodge again? We have already booked.

title: Comfortable and enjoyable stay.
text: We came to London for the weekend for the first time. We saw all places we wanted and needed to. Easy to get to, 10min from subway. Great value for money. Friendly service and good Breakfast for a early morning start.

title: Good B&B in London
text: We stayed here for 2 x nights as we could not bear to return to the travelodge at the Balham station and what a difference, for only a few pounds extra. Room was clean, no frills. Breakfast was good. If you plan to stay in Balham than this is the place.We would return in the future.

title: It was Almost perfect...
text: Stayed here with my hubby And two kids for three nights. The receptionist are so polite and kind. They are always ready to help you. The room is clean, front with windows so even if there's no AC the electric fan was enough. The toilet is always clean. I appreciate the tea/coffee corner because only few b&b provides it. The breakfast is simple but good enough to start your vacation days in good mood. Sadly our morning starts in a bad mood. On the first morning my child 6 years old saw a box of chocolate cereal in the buffet room. I asked the old lady if my baby can have the chocolate cereal but the old lady answerede so rude " no! Don't touch it. This is not for you only these cereals. ( pointing at the glass tube where there three kinds of classic cereals and no chocolate one) I asked her again" my baby can't have a chocolate cereals?" She replied looking almost angry "no no!". I looked around and saw another family with kids that are eating chocolate cereals. Since I don't want to argue I decided to ignore. The night when we return my baby asked if we could buy cereals outside for the next morning. There I decide to ask the receptionist about the cereals. He answered me saying sorry about the attitude of the old lady. He said if it was in the kitchen then it's all for our guest. Then he went to the kitchen and gave me two boxes of cereals. The next morning the old lady looked at us as if we did something wrong. Then stared at me most of the time and whisper with giggle with the other younger lady. I was so disturbed of her attitude. I'm wondering maybe because I'm the only Asian and that is the reason she never greet us or smile to us. She even yelled at my husband at the parking lot saying " Don't block the way! Move there do you understand?!" Then to Other guests she is sweet and always smile. Apart from these episodes every morning, we loved our stay.

title: Good place to stay
text: Stayed 3 nights friendly welcoming staff, very nice rooms, you could hear some noise from other guests at night in adjoining but not a major. Limited parking but staff were very accomadating in allowing me to leave my car parked for 3 days. Good food at breakfast, overall a good place to stay.

title: Convenient location and Great Breakfast
text: We stayed one night in June and thought the Lodge was very clean and it was just like the pictures on the website. The room was adequate, no frills but all you would need for just a few nights. We were a couple and had twin beds but they were comfortable, it was very breezy and cool, we opened the windows and slept very well. The staff was very friendly, easy check-in and check-out. The breakfast, which was included, was great. Would stay again.

title: Beautiful hotel and great value
text: Stayed here in November, originally for 3 nights but stayed for over a week as they were able to find a room even though they were fully booked over the weekend. A lovely room, beautiful furniture, very clean and excellent helpful staff. The 24 hour reception made it easy to use as you did not have to worry about what time you had to get back to the hotel. Extremely good value, I had a double room for some night and a single for others. The double was very comfortable for not a lot more. I was visiting family, so it was perfect to have accomodation within walking distance of their house. I would recommend this hotel to anyone, as it is very clean, nice breakfasts, in a good position and a lovely pld building

title: Very pleasant hotel
text: Very close to tube and to my daughter's place. I found the staff of this hotel very helpful. The place was very clean. Nice breakfast room and I appreciated the walk in shower! Nice wooden floor which could be noisy at times with people above my room.

title: Clean, Friendly, Good Value
text: I reserved a single room for two nights through their reassuringly professional website. Arrived to find I'd been given a room which although small, had a very comfortable double bed. The greeting from the receptionist was friendly and efficient and this continued with others as they came on to their shift. (24 hour reception). Breakfast was in the dining room at the back of the house. Help yourself to cereal, juice, yoghurt, freshly brewed coffee, toast. There were hot receptacles for scrambled egg, bacon, hash browns, sausages, baked beans, tomatoes etc (but fried egg by request). During my stay, a couple of the staff were tending and hosing the front garden. The entire building seems very well cared for. The en-suite shower works well and you're supplied with bars of soap and shower shampoo. A TV and a floor-standing air conditioner was supplied in the room (but no tea making facilities). Balham Underground is an easy 10 minute walk away.

title: Balham Lodge - UK's best kept secret!!!
text: UK'S BEST KEPT SECRET!!! The Balham Lodge was absolutely superb! Araba and the staff are so so friendly and you feel totally welcome from the minute you step foot in the front door. The location is fantastic (easy access to the city centre via. the Northern line), shops and restaurants near by, a bus station directly outside the front of the lodge, great breakfast, totally comfortable and clean....I can't wait to return!! Being an 18 year-old female in an unfamilar city - Araba and the staff made sure I was ok and really looked out for me. The Balham Lodge is the place to go!!! Excellent, excellent, excellent!!!

title: Really nice hotel.
text: Easily reached by train, nice quiet neighbourhood, clean room, good bathroom. Very nice staff! 24h receptionist, ok wi-fi, TV in the room. And an excellent breakfast included in the very affordable price. Truly recommendable :-)

title: Comfortable and very reasonably priced
text: We stayed here when visiting the area for a family wedding but found it was equally well placed for a trip to central London. Even with luggage, the guest house was within walking distance of Balham station. The room was spotlessly clean and the beds were comfortable. Our room was on the top floor and very quiet. Breakfast was buffet style and the food was well cooked. The staff, particularly those on the 24 hour reception, were very friendly and helpful. If we needed to stay in a guest house in this area again we would definitely see if this one had vacancies.

title: A warm welcome & a warm place to stay!
text: I was really impressed with the level of service at such a reasonable rate in London. The welcome was warm & genuine, with really helpful staff - its a pleasure to see people take a genuine pride in their work. The place was immaculate, yet still homely. 10mins walk to a fabulous comedy club called The Bedford + lots of places to eat & close to Underground & main bus routes. I have already recommended this place to a colleague & will defo be going back. :-)

title: Fantastic little hotel
text: Lovely hotel, pretty room, lovely and clean. Didn't have time for breakfast but really lovely little hotel with great facilities. Good transport links (regular bus outside takes you to Balham) Very good price, thoroughly recommended.

title: Great value, good comfort
text: I stayed there recently for four nights with my 12 years old son. The price (£62, per night breakfast included) was very reasonable, especially for London. English breakfast itself (eggs, sausages, hash browns, beans and mushrooms) was good, staff friendly, reception is manned for 24-hours. The room was clean, and had all furnishing, equipment and toiletry expected for a hotel in this price range. The major flaw in the room was its ceiling – the room (# 17) is on the top floor, right under the roof , so the ceiling descends and is rater low over one side of the bed, I have bumped my head into it once or twice… Location is good, but not ideal for a typical tourist: the hotel is about 10-15 minutes’ walk from Balham station, the bus stop (line #315) is right under doorstep, but the bus interval is about 30 minutes. Underground ride to city center/major attractions is 20-30 minutes, so you usually spend 30-45 minutes each way. Surrounding area makes good, safe impression, even at night, there are several restaurants, grocery shops and large Sainsbury’s supermarket near Balham station. My bottom line: Great value, good comfort, I would recommend it and will come back on my next trip to London.

title: Small Room with Terrible Breakfast
text: Firstly the hotel is lovely - decor tasteful and elegant and the reception staff brilliant. What lets this hotel down is the breakfast offering which is dissapointing. On presentation quality of ingredients and flavour. We were really disappointed by the buffet styled steel tins of food whose contents had been boiling away for a good 3hours. Room 2 is also very small - you can just about walk around the bed which in itself is small for a double, being by reception it's not the quietest of rooms either. The bathroom is tiny and very crampt to day the least with there only being enough room to turn around. It's has so much going for it - the room they can't change but the breakfast needs to be addressed.

title: Really Poor Breakfast
text: Nice Decor and room, however the breakfast buffet was a disappointment. Corner shop croissants. Old fruit. Soft hash browns and yucky scrambled eggs. felt like a high school canteen buffet. We were disappointed, because we stayed here as the price seemed reasonable with breakfast included, however if I was to visit again. I would eat breakfast out.

title: Fantastic
text: What a lovely little gem this place is! A short walk from Balham tube station takes you there....a beautifully converted period property with fabulous attention to detail, clean comfortable rooms and included in the price is a tasty hot or cold filling breakfast to set you up for the day ahead. Perfect place to stay for a night out at the Hideaway club in nearby Streatham or only a few tube stops away from all that central London has to offer! Can't wait to return :)

title: A gem found !!
text: I booked this hotel after reading reviews on trip advisor and I have to say the reviews were spot-on!! I was looking for somewhere to stay in south London for a couple of days so that we could visit my husbands family who all live in or around the Balham area,and our previous experience of London hotels has been very poor- BUT what a gem we have found here !!Firstly ,the staff are so friendly and nothing was too much trouble-they even let us look at two rooms, so that we could choose the one that we preferred.We chose room 9 and although it was at the front of the building, was very quiet.It was so clean,had everything in it that we needed- and the beds (it is a twin room)were extremely comfortable - I slept like a log!! Breakfast was excellent - maybe the only slight criticism I would have is that there was no fresh fruit - but overall it was certainly more than acceptable. My husband and I would go for a little walk after breakfast as Tooting Common is only about 50 yards from the hotel and is a haven of peace and tranquility - also we saw plenty of wildlife there. All in all I would thoroughly recommend this hotel highly and we will definately return.

title: Good value for London
text: This ticked the boxes for me. We needed three rooms and these were good value. The location is a little way out from the west end but was fine for our stay. Also I prefer somewhere with a bit of character and this is an attractive building in a nice area. As I recall breakfast was an OK help-yourself buffet.

title: Great for a London stopover.
text: Despite an initial run in with a cleaner who bashed our car with a bin store gate (and didn't apologise), we found this to be a very pleasant guest house. Having a car park at all was great in London, although I understand the on street parking is at a reasonable rate. The receptionist was excellent and had moved us to a nice big room near the top of the house overlooking the rear of the property and car park. We arrived early, having asked to leave our car in car park during the day but our room was available at 10.30am - fab! The en suite bathroom was small with a shower curtain (a pet hate of ours!) and the hot water took an age to come through, but when it did my shower was good and had decent water pressure. A few noisy internal doors slamming shut but apart from that, very comfortable. The breakfast buffet selection was very good, although fresh mushrooms and tomatoes would be better than tinned. Good location too, with plenty of restaurants plus the Tube within 12 minutes walk.

title: Brilliant in every way
text: Fabulous value, wonderful service, great rooms. The only reason we didn't score the room 5, was the bed frame was a bit damaged. This didn't affect our comfort but if it were mended it would be a 5 star. Breakfast was excellent. Full English buffet style. I would have liked fruit salad but the cooked breakfast was really good. The great benefit for us was the off road parking and close proximity to St George's, Tooting. Reception staff were polite, welcoming and very child friendly, helping us with bags and children to the room. There are tea and coffee making facilities in the room, tv, very clean bathroom. The room we had was very spacious and tastefully furnished overlooking the courtyard. Our only regret was we couldn't stay longer. We will definitely return in a couple of months.

title: Shhh, keep it quiet.
text: You WILL NOT find anywhere else within 20 mins of the City at this price, nevermind the quality. I'll be coming back time and time again. Staff are eccentric, and absolutely brilliant. I'm fussy, but can't really mark it under 5 in any category - 6 for value for money.

title: Shame about the breakfast
text: My wife and i stayed at the Balham Lodge Guest House for one night Friday 17th April 2009. The cost for bed and breakfast in a double room was £62. If only the owners could sort out the breakfast i would certainly uprate this Hotel to above average. Breakfast is served from 7.30 until 10.30. Unfortunately, we arrived for breakfast at 9.50 to find the hot service area totally denude of food with the exception of a few cold scraps in each of the serving trays. Maybe at 7.30 it's a different story but for us not the ideal start to the day. On a more positive note the room was good. very clean, good shower and large comfortable bed. The location is reasonable with a 10-15 min walk from either Balham or Tooting Bec Underground Stations. On the basis of our Breakfast experience i would not return or recommend to a friend.

title: Great place to stay
text: Stayed 2 nights in this hotel. Clean rooms and helpful friendly staff. Small private carpark a bonus. Easy walking distance to Baham.I was staying in a single room- small but very clean- and the 24 hr reception made me feel very safe. I was visiting friends and will definatly stay there again.

title: Very comfortable
text: We stayed for two nights at this B&B earlier this month and were pleasantly surprised. A beautiful house with obvious attention to detail with a stained glass front door and a warm welcome on arrival. The room we stayed in was at the front of the house so the road noise was noticeable but not too much of a drama and didn't stop us sleeping. The room and the ensuite were clean and the shower was great! Breakfast was good with a reasonable selection available. Would recommend and if in the area again wouldn't hesitate to use.

title: Good value for money
text: My husband and I stayed here for one night, in a double room on a Saturday night. The B&B is really good value compared to most other hotels nearby. It's in a good location, close to Balham station and Clapham is also very close by. Breakfast was good - cooked breakfast options served as a buffet which my hubby loved! The rooms are nicely done, nothing to write home about but they are clean and well kept. The bathrooms are a tad small but the shower is pretty good. Reception staff are helpful and friendly. All in all, a good night's stay.

title: Outstanding Value for the London Area
text: Great little B&B excellent value. Paid £65 for one night in a twin room. I found the room to be very clean and quiet it was right at the top of the house but I didn't find the stairs a problem. Unlike some reviewers I didn't find the room noisy either, maybe because of the location. The room was quite large, the beds comfortable and the shower hot and powerful. Yes the bathroom is small but entirely adequate, they even provide a small selection of toiletries. There are tea and coffeee making facilities in the room, a flat screen TV and even a safe which is free to use. The breafast is buffet stlyle with both hot and cold choices. The tube and rail stations are within 10-15 mins walking distance so access to central London is quick and easy. I really have nothing bad to say about this hotel.

title: A great B&B in Balham
text: Before we set off for London, I emailed the hotel to check the car parking facilites. They replied promptly and advised there were spaces available. We were allocated Room 16 at the top of the building. The twin bedded room was bright, clean and comfortable. There was a good selection of teas provided too. I particularly liked the wooden window blinds. They were easily adjusted and could even be opened back to view the street. The staff were all very helpful and polite and the buffet breakfast in the bright and airy dining room was good. There were bus stops either side of the road, enabling us to visit family in Streatham, and it was only a 10 minute walk or short bus ride to Balham to get the train or tube into London.

title: Average hotel in Balham
text: I'm just back from a 2 night stay at the Balham Lodge. The breakfast was nice and the staff were friendly and helpful. Unfortunately, the shower was small and lacked power. The bed was noisy and creaked with the slightest movement. Not a terrible place to stay but I'm sure there is better around. Just make sure you get a good deal.

title: Booking mixup
text: We booked a executive double suite with Hostelworld but upon arrival the receptionist told us we had booked a single executive suite and blamed her manager for the mixup.They had no doubles available but not to worry since the single suite had a double bed. It was in fact a small double (4 ft wide) so good job my wife is smaller than me since I'm 6ft 4in! The room was small but clean and mattress soft. However the room (no 3) is next to the breakfast room and we were disturbed by staff preparing breakfast at 7am-why can't they talk quietly? we complained and were told No 3 was a noisy room-thanks! The hotel is in a convenient situation for London and next to tooting bec common but if we go again we will confirm booking with the hotel to ensure we have a double room on the first floor.

title: Excellent Value
text: Very clean and tidy, superb value for London and an easy bus rude from Balham Tube. A great find and thoroughly recommended

title: Beautiful, friendly and spotlessly-clean B&B!
text: First impressions... ...beautiful, full of character, immaculately clean B&B. Also very impressed with excellent off-street parking! Very friendly gentleman on reception allowed us to order our take-away to the lodge, allowed us to use the breakfast room and even provided us with plates and cutlery. As a group of friends that had not seen each other in a long time (and were on a budget!) this really made out evening and we we're all very impressed with the kind and friendly service. However, a little more friendliness towards breakfast late-comers was needed! Breakfast is from 7.30 - 10.30. After working all week and then being at a party in Balham til late the night before we were in no huury to get up early for breakfast on our day off! Two of us arrived just before 10 and had breakfast...no crossiants left though :-( and two friends came down about 10.15. I understand the ladies looking after the breakfast room were in a hurry to get cleaned up but telling us to hurry up (twice!) seemed a little unfriendly. Be sure to have breakfast before 10am! However, that is the only (minor) bad-point of our stay. The Balham lodge is an excellent bed and breakfast. Highly recommended....we would not consider anywhere else to stay in the area and will most certainly be back! :-)

title: cute, short walk to tube, quiet town
text: Highlights: cozy B&B, away from the craziness of central London but short walk to tube/train station and short tube ride, good traditional English breakfast served buffet style, free parking when available, in town there are restaurants and some shops (we took day trips into central London then headed back to Balham for dinner to avoid the hectic city

title: Good overall choice
text: We were trying to do London on the cheap this Feburary and decided to stay at the Balham Lodge. We paid 54 pounds for a double room including breakfast which is excellent value for London. The location- not ideal. The lodge is about 10 minutes walk from the tube station Balham which is on the northern line in zone 3. It took quite a while to get anywhere but I guess that's London for you. If you want to be in the centre this is not for you! Balham- a great place! In the evenings we used to go out to bars and restaurants in Balham which was great. They had a really good variety of differnt things, Pizza, Steakhouse, Chinese, Indian, Moroccan, various Cafes- whatever you want. Some nights we just got a salad from the salad bar at Sainsbury's (near the station) and ate it in our room. The lodge- better than I thought! For 27 pounds per person per night, what do you expect? I have stayed in hostels in London, in a shared dorm for about the same price and here at the Balham Lodge I get a whole room (okay, i had to share it with my boyfriend

title: Excellent
text: This hotel is tremendous value for money. Rooms are spacious, clean and modern. Indeed the whole hotel has a very modern feel about it.It is located in a quiet area some 15mins walk from the tube station. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Breakfast was provided and this was very good with a choice of "full English ", fruit or cereals and tea / coffee. I would have no hesitation in staying here again and would definately recommend the Balham Lodge. Thank you for a lovely stay.

title: Okay for a night's stay
text: The good: Good location and the room was decorated to a decent standard. Travel kettle and teabags etc in the room.Very nicely refurbished property. Offroad parking for a couple of cars. The not-quite-so-good: Room was small (room 1 opposite reception) with a tiny shower/toilet. One of the hottest days of the year so it was very hot and sticky during the night and only one window opened. Just a shame they tried to cram in as many rooms as possible, but it was good for one night's stay. Breakfast is plentiful but on the cheapside (croissants tasted of the plastic packaging, cheap sausages, rubbery bacon etc). You will have to pay for parking (before 1630 week days) if you can't get into their car park.

title: Value for money and great place to stay
text: This is one of my favourite hostels. All the things you need from a good hostel. Locker room for luggage provided although I wouldn't say that it is the safest place to put your luggage prior to checking in. But good enough. Laundry room, with ironing facility and hairdryer (yesss). The pantry room was the loveliest one with vibrant interior

title: Excellent
text: Great and friendly staff, clean and tidy private and public places, joyful and cosy lobby. All major London attractions at the doorstep, lots of cafes and pubs around. A very pleasant stay indeed. Highly recommended!

title: Great spot in London!
text: Great place, great crowd, great decoration! A bit expensive, as everything is in London... Close to underground stations, theaters and so on. They can book pub crawls, tours, buses to cities nearby. I highly recommend this place.

title: Good location, clean with friendly staff
text: If you objective is to shop, sightsee or attend a play or show this YHA is truly in central London. 10 min walk max to Oxford St, Regent's Park or the nearest underground station. 30 min walk or so to Bond St, Regent St, Piccadilly Circus and Soho. Nearby are plenty of eateries. Alternatively there is a Tesco Express 1-2 street away if you want to prepare a simple meal as there is sizeable and well equipped kitchen. The quad room can be a little tight for longer stay (>7 days) but otherwise, good for family or small group as it comes with its own toilet and shower.

title: Excellent.
text: Really good, every London trip (6x in 3yrs?), I try and stay in a dorm in this YHA. One of the busiest in the UK, yet they make time for you such that you feel you're a valued member, which is a great attribute. But really, it's the very helpful and friendly staff which make this YHA hostel in central London so special. Good kitchen and public spaces, spotlessly clean and tidy, lots of events going on, food and drink available, laundry, storage room, lockers in the rooms, TV if you feel the need also. Cracking central London location, a supermarket, pubs and restaurants only 2mins away, Oxford Street tube 6 mins walk.

title: Convenient location at a good price
text: Overall: Hostel was generally good, the biggest positives being the location and price. Location: A short walk from Great Portland Street Underground Station (CIRCLE, METROPOLITAN and HAMMERSMITH&CITY lines), as well as being close to Oxford Street...making it really convenient for a visit to Central London. Bed/Room: Bunk room was 8 person sized...the beds were comfortable but the room was very warm, even with an open window. There is a bedside light and plug socket for each bunk, although this has been unplugged and used by the person in the bunk below. The room included a small sink and large wardrobe/cupboard space which is lockable. There are also toilets and shower off the main corridor. The corridor light remained on all night, causing light to be seen entering from under the door...minor issue which could be easily improved by using a motion sensor. Services: Free Wifi was available in the communal areas only. Luggage storage was helpful (£2 for medium locker, £3 for large locker) which was available throughout stay and on day of departure. Food/Drink is available, as well as a communal kitchen. Staff: All of the staff were friendly and helpful. Safety: The property did feel reasonably safe, with keycards to access stairwell, room as well as communal areas. The luggage storage seemed safe, and the in-room cupboards were lockage using a padlock. The area around the hostel was good, and did feel safe after dark. Info: 24h Reception desk, check out on day of departure= before 10am. Price was good (I think £26 for a bunk in a shared room for the date when i stayed...I am sure this may vary.

title: Ups and Downs
text: There is an elevator, which is great, but as the other reviewer mentioned, it is extremely slow. There is Cloud wifi in the common eating/reception area. In your room, you will not get signal. The common kitchen in the basement is clean, and there are large refrigerators for storing food--a great service and essential if you are trying to see London on a budget. The whole building (and all of London) was absolutely sweltering when we were there. London buildings can't accommodate the high temperatures more common now, so the basement kitchen and all the sleeping rooms were simply oven-hot the whole time we were there. It was impossible to be comfortable, even at night. The windows open only a tiny bit, and it is just not enough to cool the place down. There was air conditioning in the reception area. The beds are typical hostel pallets on a hard support.

title: New, Modern and Very Clean. But a few niggles......
text: I normally stay at YHA St Pancras when in London, but as it’s closed (as of March 2009) for refurbishment – I stayed here instead. I got a shock when I discovered that it was brand spanking new! It’s located in the Fitzrovia district – a sleepy little corner of Central London near Regent’s Park and about 8-9 blocks north of frenetic Oxford Street and Soho. The good news is that it is a good few blocks back from busy Euston and Tottenham Court Roads, so traffic noise isn’t a problem. It’s mostly an office district so as you can imagine it’s totally dead at weekends plus there are some good alternative restaurants a short walk away if you don’t fancy the razzmatazz of the West End. It’s accessible too from a Tube perspective - Great Portland Street on the Circle/Metropolitan line is a short walk away which is good for getting to St Pancras/King’s Cross, but not so good however if you are wanting a direct and fast link to the West End – for that you’ll need to walk to either Warren Street (Northern/Victoria lines) or Regent’s Park (Bakerloo line) which are both a wee bit further away. Security is not a problem either, as it has a modern swipe card system like a hotel to access the elevator and dorm areas – and also means there is no grumpy concierge to deal with if you are coming back late at night. The whole place was, being brand new – spotlessly clean everywhere and ultra modern. Security shouldn’t be a worry either, as there is a modern hotel-style swipe card system for access to the elevator, guest areas and the rooms themselves. It also dispenses with the need for a grumpy concierge at the front door late at night. On the ground floor there is a café-bar type thing next to reception, and breakfast is optional at £4 (not inclusive like in the other YHA London hostels) – not a bad thing as the quality of the food on offer is always a bit hit and miss in my experience. There are also big screen TVs, large sofas and high speed internet terminals. But there were quite a few disappointments. First of all it’s not the dorms or really the location that are the problem – it’s all the infrastructure bits. Clearly the YHA has skimped on a few things to save money when building the place and it shows. Firstly there is only one puny little elevator serving the whole building, that is not only slow, but at peak times is frequently ‘oversubscribed’. Secondly the luggage area which is barely the size of a box room, with nowhere near enough lockers. When I turned up early at the hostel before 2pm, I was given a key for the luggage room – big mistake as I had to literally climb over dozens of cases piled on top of each other to try and claim the last morsel of empty floor space. Thirdly the communal showers and bathrooms are tiny – no I’ll take that back – microscopic!! As far as I can gather, some of the dorm rooms are en-suite, but the one I was staying in wasn’t and I had to use the communal facilities in the corridor. The bathroom I could barely get into because the door was so narrow, the shower had no shelf or anything to put your clothes on whilst you were showering and the floor was like a swimming pool so you couldn’t just dump your stuff there instead. The alternative was to walk around the corridors half naked…. The shower itself was not terribly hot either, nor did the water come out very fast either. Pretty shambolic given that the thing is supposed to be brand new…. One last tip is make sure you have a beefy enough padlock for the dorm lockers – the latches are those stupid rotary type ones which don’t work if you have a padlock with a spindly shank on it. Overall I was pleased with this hostel – it’s new, ultra clean and ultra modern. It’s a pity about the niggles though – these were basic things that should be perfect given how swanky and modern the rest of the building is. I’ll probably wait for the St Pancras one to re-open again for my next trip.

title: The best hostel I've been in London
text: And I've been in quite a few. YHA has everything. Great and friendly staff that is always ready to help. Simple but comfy rooms with nice beds and clean toilets. Make-up and hair-dressing area for all of us girly enough. And funny toilet reminders. And the location is the best! Peace from the hassle of the city but only 10 minutes to Oxford St. and Soho. Perfection!

title: Avoid Room 5
text: Room 5 should be avoided at all costs. It has no window and a very noisy 'comfort cooling' system. The room was not meant to be 'en-suite' but it did not even have a washbasin, users are obliged to share the washbasin in the small sit-down toilet with visitors from another room - surprised that this is within EU regulations. It has been decades since I have stayed in a UK Youth Hostel bunk room without a washbasin or a proper washroom.

title: Quick Stopover
text: This hostel was very clean, efficient and welcoming. The food was simple but perfectly suited my needs. The dorm room was quiet and I actually got a good nights sleep. The hostel was excellent value for money

title: Modern, secure, convenient
text: It was difficult for me to find initially, but it is within a ten minute walk of Oxford Circus station. It was very clean, very modern

title: Spacious Room
text: Stayed in an ensuite female dorm room. The room was clean and the staff was friendly. Left luggage facilites were available. It is close to Great Portland street underground station! Would return again.

title: Great Base for Weekend in Town
text: I'm a YHA member so used to the format and overall experience. This hostel is a modern and lively option, for those looking for value & location. The location as other reviewers note is excellent for reaching Central London locations. Bolsover Street is a fairly quiet location with supermarkets and restaurants (Pizza Express

title: Great for a first time visitor
text: Real friendly easy going staff, meet some great people defiantly recommend. Great bar and toilet facilities real good value for money recommend doing the pub crawl meet lots of fun people in the same boat as me real friendly great night out.

title: One of the best places to sleep in London !
text: With all the good advices I read on the internet, I couldn't wait to try this hostel by myself and I wasn't disappointed at all ! The staff is very nice ! I came in too early to check-in so I left my suitcase in a luggage room. The access to the stairs/elevators/luggage room is secured by a card you're given when you check-in. Regarding the common areas, everything was great : the reception/bar/dining room is nice, well-decorated and clean, there is a laundry room with a hair dryer and a hair straightener and also a kitchen (I haven't used it at all though so I can't give any advice on that). My room was nice and clean. It was a 6-bedded en-suite room. The room wasn't that big but there was enough space between the beds and I really appreciated the closets ! Also the shower room and toilets are in separated room and if both are busy, another shower and toilets were available just in the corridor. I'm planning on coming back to London with some friends in a couple of month and will definitely book in this hostel :)

title: Wonderful location. I liked lobby the most.
text: We were 4 of us this week: 2 girls & 2 boys. pluses: Location is very close to metro and street is quiet and nice Atmosphere - Staff is relax and friendly Good drinks and food - can have sheaper then somewhere in the city Lobby area is very cool, especially at night time I should say that it was clean everywhere 24 hour reception You can play Wii when children are not around (: I liked the placement of bathrooms and toilets - you need just leave your room. minuses: Rooms are not very convinient (in my opinion), I did not feel myself very comfortable. There were 8 persons in the room, and when I made my boocking it was indicated that it will be a room for 4 persons. Surprise-surprise! I can't explain the smell in the room. We were sleeping with opened window, but it did not help much. Some tips and info before going: No free towels - either take yours or be ready to pay 3.50 pounds Internet is 1 pound for a 20 mins session You can't have alcohol from the bar after midnight (: In total - very good place, there are some not very nice moments like terribly snoring roommade or this owful smell, but it could be anywhere. So YES I do recommend to go there.

title: Excellent trip ruined by inconsiderate guest
text: Great staff great location inconsiderate guests why won’t hostels say something about the few inconsiderate guests who leave on mobile devices (not on silent) so that others can sleep well. They shouldn’t have to but sadly this menace would put me off using a hostel again

title: Easy, clean, enjoyable stay. :))
text: Me and two friends booked a bed in the communal dorms, cause we wanted a bed for the night after a festival but didnt want to pay for a hotel- & for £14 we got everything we wanted! The room was spotless, with an ensuite & a fan whcih was very very appreciated. You have your own card to open all the doors which made things easy. They have a luggage store, so while you can only check in at 2, youre more than welcome to leave bags downstairs- lockers available. The staff are all so lovely and extemely helpful- and if we weren’t exhausted im sure we’d have made use of the social spaces. In all a great sleep and got exactly what we wanted at great value!

title: Very nice super clean
text: A nice place to stay, easy to go to all attractions,, you can ask for special bunk bed .. top or bottom . near underground station , very helpful staff, super clean, well equipped kitchen was great idea , they even got a scale to weigh your luggage

title: Excellent Location for even better price!
text: Had to travel down to London at the last minute with a couple days notice and thankfully came across this gem. Tremendous location in the heart of London at an ideal price. Was almost slightly sceptical before coming down due to the price being so great however other reviews on here calmed me down immediately. Staff were always on hand to help with any queries and did so with a smile on their face making the couple nights stay very comfortable. Having paid the extra for breakfast in the morning it was also a fair selection for the price paid. Only reason I did not rate 5 stars is the lack of wifi in the rooms which affected me most when working. The lounge/bar area is a nice area to be but would have been ideal to gain access up the stairs. All in all though for the price that you're paying for this is merely a small issue for this excellent venue, I will be back when I next have to travel down and have even recommended the place to others already.

title: Great London Hostel
text: Really amazing location, staff is outrageously helpful and welcoming. Breakfast is stunning, I woke up early just for a croissant! Beds are comfortable, the clean team is really on point, the place is spotless. Secure and Safe, really central. Perfect stay !

title: 4 bed private
text: We stayed in the summer and it was quite warm in the room, although a fan was provided. There is also not much space for 4 of us, but we have everything we needed for 2 nights stay. The beds were comfortable and the toilet is clean. The self catering facility was very well equipped, we couldn't have asked for more.

title: Our stay at YHA
text: We stay at YHA in a private room for 4 people. Everything was clean and the bathroom was also very good. The shower was powerful and the water was indeed hot! (If you have stayed at other hostels, you might recognize that this is a common issue) The kitchen for the guests was also very good, it had everything we needed and we could enjoy a very good breakfast and other meals, when we wanted. I'd definitely recommend this stay to other people.

title: Good Location
text: I stayed here with my mum mid-April in a 4 bed dorm as a twin wasnt available. We chose the hostel due to its location and self catering facilities. The hostel location is great. A maximum 10 min walk to Oxford St and about 5 to Great Portland St tube. Both a Tesco and Sainsburys are within a short walk. The surrounding streets are pretty quiet. I had emailed in advance to ask for a quieter room. We were right next to the lift well, the noise as the lift clunked to the floor was far from quiet. The young child in a near by room screaming for hours one night, was also far from quiet. Our room faced the back of the hostel, which was the Great Portland side and there was a bit of noise at night with the window open. Ear plugs are a must. The room was very small, it wouldnt be very much fun with strangers being on top of each other. It was also very hot at night. We slept with the window open and doonas off and were still hot. However, it have a very good curtain. The staff were variable. The self catering kitchen was well equipped but painful to get to with the lift that seamed to constantly be confused as to what floor it should go to. The location of this hostel is hard to beat but I would have to think hard before I stayed here again.

title: Hacknon
text: We were a part of a big group for a conference nearby. The facilities are great, there's a nice atmosphere in the bar, everything was clean and the staff were superb. I would definitely stay there again.

title: Great Hostel, good location.
text: My 8 nights at YHA London Central were surprisingly good. This is the first hostel I've ever stayed in, what a great way to start. The staff were helpful, the rooms were small but clean, and the kitchen was in pretty good condition. The only time it was noisy was on the weekend - which is to be expected I suppose. It's in a good location - within walking distance to Oxford St, Regent St, Carnaby St, and Soho. Overall, it's worthy of it's rating.

title: Best place to stay
text: This is a little gem in the heart of London. Place is spotless. You can cook your own food you will feel like home. Most of the staff are friendly but Laura is super super friendly the best staff I give her 10 out of 10. She give the place life and soul.

title: EXCELLENT value central London. Wheelchair accessible too!!! Warm friendly and 24hr reception
text: Who would have thought you could stay in central London for £15 night? (£17 normally minus trip-advisor discount offer currently running)?!! Fantastic. My first time staying in a hostel in London ..always stayed in hotels before, and hostels elsewhere...it neber occured to me to even look for ahostel in London.. but, tbh unless a special occassion, will never stay in hotel again in London now. Warm, friendly, 24hr reception means if like me you've arrived in London, met your friends and want to make the most of your time together before parting company and get carried away with the time you don't have to worry about being locked out. There is free wifi in reception and lounge area, not sure if it's in the rooms, and computers for those without tablets or uk internet deals on their sims, plus comfy couches to lounge on and chill, unobtrusive tv, books to read, puzzles to play if that is your thing, aswell as cafe and pizzas and great breakfasts oh and it is licensed too. You can have a drink, have a chill, read the hints on the walls of places to go or join the tours they have on each night there is something..and yet, in the room I could hear no disturbence and I was in a downstairs room. As a wheelchair user I did not know what to expect and was bit wary but the downstairs room was simple but warm and comfortable and being accessible had a full wet room ensuite. No sharing with those down the corridor, just those in the room. There were 6 beds in my female dorm and it was not a problem. Obviously other rooms may have shared facilities, need to check on booking. Just great in the wheelchair though not having to trundle down corridor in whatever state. Cupboard for belongings and box under the bed, coat hooks and comfy mattresses. Do have to phone in person to check availability of bed in accessible room if needed as not option on website but always best to check anyway. Excellent location and tescos at end of the road.

title: Ok... Would not stay there again.
text: First, the good things about the hostel: Location (close to everything, with lots of restaurants, cafes and supermarkets nearby)

title: Great hostel, but prefer the 4-bed room!
text: Stayed at this hostel for 12 nights and I had a good time. Except from the noisy snoring that bugged me during my whole stay, the hostel itself was great. Clean bedrooms and bathrooms, nice breakfast (athough its not included, it was 3,95 for a sandwich, soft drink and a fruit), top location and the staff was there when I needed them. One of them even let me sleep in another room for a night so I could get away from the little pigs in my room. The down point for me was that the room was too small for 6 people and it could get hot and smelly when it was full. But I spent one night at a 4 bed room and it was much better. Would definitely stay here again!

title: Very clean and reasonably priced!
text: I stayed one night in the YHA London Central. It has an EXCELLENT location right by Oxford Street and Tottenham Court Road. The facilities are spotlessly clean and the atmosphere is young and lively. 24/7 coffee bar and reception is nice. All single sex rooms, free linens, but a charge for towels. I paid around 20 pounds and was in an 8 person room. My complaints were that the rooms were a little hot and stuffy and that the lockers in the rooms didn't actually lock. Also, wifi is not free as I had thought the website implied. Unfortunately, the other women in my room woke me up at 5 AM, but regardless, it was a nice stay.

title: Awesome
text: The best Hostel I've been in London! Everything is clean, the staff was perfect! The price could be better but is so cool that you don't care about the money. Euston is the closer tube station and is 5 minutes walk! One day I will come back!!!!!!

title: They Saved London Hostels For Me
text: I was meant to stay at another hostel but after the first stay (at said hostel) I wasn't game for a second. I instead found the YHA which, despite costing a bit more, was much better

title: Great hostel!
text: I've travelled to London a few times so far and YHA London was my first choice every time! The hostel has a good location, with a walking distance to Oxford Street and two tube stations nearby. The rooms are a bit small but very clean. My first experience with YHA Central was at the tie of the Eyjafjallajökull incident, and the staff has been extremely nice and helpful by extending out stay day by day, without asking for confirmation for the next day given the fact that we were awaiting news from our airline company any minute. YHA Central also has a fully equipped kitchen downstairs and a nice cozy cafe with fair prices. There are a few supermarkets nearby which makes it very easy and convenient to cook your own meal if you'd like to. I would strongly recommend YHA Central to anyone looking for good value for money, and a decent hostel with a central location.

title: 6 Bed Private Room
text: My family and I stayed here during our tour of the UK for a couple nights. The staff was wonderful and the location was great with walking distance to stores, pubs, and tube stations. The room with 3 bunk beds was nice as it gave us all a bed to sleep on. The private bathroom made it convenient having 2 younger children. This is a hostel, so do not expect all the usual hotel extras in your room. No tv, no WiFi, no towels, but it did have AC. The only negative I really had was the mold around the skylight window we had in our room. This needed a good deep cleaning.

title: Nice clean hostel
text: We stayed here for the olympics and it was everything we needed, a nice quiet clean room. The bathrooms and showers were immaculate and the location could not have got any better for central london. Staff were friendly and helpful. Downsides are that the place doesn't really have a vibe as can be common with some yha's. Although the kitchen was well equiped it was missing a key ingedient of an oven which was strange. However as i mentioned above you are in the middle of the city with every possible type of food outlet on your doorstep.

title: Overall okay
text: The hostel was overall okay, however.. the rooms are tiny (barely enough standing space) and the bathroom in our private room had no drainage for the shower.. so water got everywhere and then was trekked into the rest of the room. Other then the "adequate" rooms... the lounge/communal area was quite nice. Very friendly environment and the wifi was good (when it was working), staff offered food and beverages (at a cost) and just overall is a nice place to chill out.

title: Great central London hostel
text: The YHA London Central was a great value hostel with a good location and is clean and modern. It's well located near Regent Street and has a bus stop only one block away, Great Portland tube station only 2 blocks away and a short walk to Euston, St Pancras or Kings Cross station. I'll certainly stay again.

title: As the name says central
text: had 6 nights here and a pretty good stay. Had a private room with my daughter but a shared bathroom which was OK. Washers and dryers available for a small price and iron for free. Good kitchen facilities in the basement with plenty of room to store your food. Good coffee bar upstairs with basics such as pizza etc. ATM on site and computers at a price. Books and board games available also a TV but dont know if you can actually watch it , always on but never any volume.Location is very good,a walk to a few differant tube stations, so a few differant choices of lines. The front desk organised a mini cab to St Pancras and it was a good price and there when requested. Overall a good stay and would stay there again.

title: Humid, Smelly Rooms
text: After traveling throughout Europe for the last 6 weeks, I have to say that YHA London Central had one of the worst sleeping situations. Poor ventilation combined with the poor hygiene of travelers caused the room each morning to smell like the inside of a locker room. We woke up dripping in sweat, and the smell of the room was just disgusting. So many different people moved in and out of the 6 bedroom dorm each day that it was nauseating. No one got any sleep, as people kept moving in and out early in the morning and late at night. Location is poor. YHA is not located very close to the Tube. Service was good. I highly recommend the Camden Pub Crawl. That was fun. If I ever went back to London, I would probably avoid the YHA and choose a nicer, cleaner hostel with a better location.

title: Good base
text: Hotel is located on a nice quiet street within easy walking distance of many of London's sites. ~5minute walk from tube and also from tesco which is convenient for picking up some snacks. Staff were friendly and chatty which was nice. Rooms are decent with comfortable beds and lockers. The bathroom was alright already the water from the showerhead in my room went absolutely everywhere and you could stay dry standing in the middle of the shower. Great value its location and cleanliness!

title: Looking for chocolates on your pillows? Only here if your mate leaves his Kit Kat unattended.
text: If you want pampering, look elsewhere. If you are looking for Queen size beds, with chocolates on your pillow, there is a Mariott I might direct you to. If you want a great place to stay, near the center of London for only $$, this is it. We were a group of 3 gents, looking for a place that would be able to shelter us for 7 nights, recently in London. We simply wanted a warm bed, a shower and a lock on the room we were to be leaving our luggage in. That is exactly what you get for about $125 Canadian a night for 3 people. The beds were bunk beds. The showers had warm water. You can rent towels downstairs for the entire week for a few dollars, as none come with the room. There is no in room safe. That would be your luggage with a lock on it. There is an onsite laundromat in the basement for washing those few pieces you'd like to wear daily. There is an onsite lounge that has fabulous quick meals for next to nothing, and a bar that is simply the cheapest place to drink in London, save for you buying your own bottle. The staff are wonderful. Right from the moment you check in, to helping you find a pub crawl to join (omg). The elevator broke down, but the staff were quick to put up a cheerful sign saying that it would be up and running very soon. And it was. All you could ask for in a room. TV? One in the lounge, if you really need one. :)

title: Did it’s job
text: I thought £5 for a basic breakfast was slightly steep and wifi in the rooms would be good, but other than that it was fine. Common spaces were nice, rooms were hot and shower was a bit tricky but really you get what you pay for here. Good location I thought

title: The best hostel ever
text: I was wit my boyfriend and one more couple in a 4 bed dorm, and it was awsome! clean, quite, and the stuff was very friendly! It is in a walking distance of Oxford street and not so far from Piccadily so we walked all the time :)

title: Short Walk from Underground Station (Great Portland St)
text: The hostel is in a convenient location, easy to find from Great Portland Street Underground Station (if you check a map in advance so you know where you are going). 5 minute walk. Check in at reception was unprofessional, with staff more interested in a personal conversation between themselves than checking me in, although the staff when I left the next morning were more attentive and friendly. Facilities in the room were modern and clean, with a charging power point next to each bed. I did not use any other facilities in the hostel as I arrived relatively late and left early, but I did go to the self catering kitchen to get drinking water, and it looked quite well equipped.

title: Good stay
text: Bar/dining area are good for meeting people. Each bed had its own charging outlet and light. Shower pressure was good. Great location. Staff was friendly and events were hosted to get travellors together.

title: Awesome 3 days Family Vacation
text: We had our 11 year old with us and he enjoyed our stay. Food was reasonably priced and portions are generous. Free WiFi. Clean and informations are readily accessible. All the staff are friendly and helpful. Location is perfect and so central to everything. This is our second time at YhA and it has always been an enjoyable stay. From New Zealand Thank you YHA.

title: Central for london and not pricey
text: I had a lot of fun here. It is central in London dimensons: i didnt take the tube in my whole stay though my foot were hurting a bit after a week. The staff is super friendly, they organize lots of activities, the food is cheap and delicious and the kitchen facilities are good. The only bad side: i saw a mouse in the kitchen coming from someone elses food cabinet. I told the guy at the counter but he did nothing. But well London is full of mice, what can they do.

title: Fuss free stay
text: Staying at YHA hostel makes me feels assured about the cleanliness of the rooms and my safety. It has a good location and definitely value for money. Staff at the reception is really friendly and helpful.

title: London Central
text: I really enjoy the hostel, have stayed twice now. It is a great location, very well run and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The cleaning staff do a great job of maintaining the facilities. Would recommend it to anyone and I will stay there when I next visit London.

title: Great Hostel
text: It was my first stay at a YHA hostel but I don't think it will be my last. The best part of my stay was definitely the staff, they were super friendly and helpful, always there if we needed anything. Rooms were a little bit small but not unbearable. Staying in a dorm with an ensuite I felt like the bathrooms could do with a little renovation. Our sink was missing a knob and constantly dripped, the shower was also tiny, so tiny that I kept hitting my elbows on the walls. In saying all this however, it is a hostel so as long as you're not expecting a five star hotel, you'll be fine. Lockers are a great size and fit everything inside. The front desk is well equipped with a variety of items if you've forgotten anything. Location is good, not right in the city centre but still central enough that you can get to all the main attractions quite easily.

title: One night stand in London
text: We arrived to London after 1 a.m. and wanted to find a nice room for 6 people as close as possible to Westminster and as cheap as possible. YHA Central is perfect from all relevant points of view. It is excellently situated, with relatively cheap rooms, and we all were satisfied with its standards. Of course, walls are rather thin and beds creaky, but we had all we needed. Great experience!

title: Excellent staff, fantastic location, fun, safe, clean & cheap- perfect!
text: I stayed at YHA London Central as part of a reunion of friends I made while backpacking around the world. I had stayed in many YHA's in Australia and New Zealand and quite a few HI hostels around the world but I had never stayed in a hostel in my own country. I have to say that from the moment I walked into the ultra modern lobby area with its huge tube map I was impressed. The reception team were very helpful and friendly checking us in and offered some suggestions as to where we might go for a fun night out and even offered us a late check out service as they knew we were going to out late. The room was basic but very clean and the bed power sockets and bed lights are a nice touch- the beds themselves were surprisingly comfortable. The ensuite was again basic but clean and the shower had a good pressure. My friends found the new 'Beauty Room' in the basement a great addition as it is fitted with huge mirrors, hairstraighteners and hairdryers. After a great night out in Camden, we were delighted to discover a smiling night receptionist making us delicious pizza and offering us lots of tap water. The following morning we were happy to find breakfast still available at 11.00 and tucked into a very reasonably priced continental style breakfast served with coffee of your choice. On the negative side, no free wi fi is a bit disapointing, though when I was talking to a staff member they informed me that the price has been reduced and they hope that it will be free soon. Some of my group had long a go forgotten about the YHA/HI being a membership organisation and were surprised to have to pay a little extra (always read the small print!). Overall, very impressed by this hostel and the friendly, international team really reflected the mix of guests that were hanging out in the cafe/bar. Will definately reccommend this to friends visiting London.

title: I'll be staying here again, no doubt.
text: The staff: friendly and helpful. The rooms: spacious and clean (6 bed, female dorm). Common area: fun and spacious with plenty of sights and activities advertised. Hot meals and licensed. Location: on a quiet street and only a 2 minute walk from a Great Portland Street tube station. Internet: had to pay for use of computers (expensive) and wi-fi (I did not use the wi-fi). My only complaint was that the internet was a bit expensive. I would recommend this hostel.

title: Comfortable but lacks atmosphere
text: YHA London Central offers plenty of good facilities for a hostel. Comfortable beds, ensuite bathroom, decent enough food and drink. But suffered from a lack of a friendly atmosphere so guests were not as willing to relax as be as social as much as they might be. This was not the fault of the staff who were really friendly and helpful but the austere style of YHA hostels. The main social area suffered from being a reception, lounge, dining room and bar all in one that failed to adequately be any of these things. The four bed dorms are small and can't be used for anything other then sleeping but you will get a good nights sleep and a hot shower in the morning. Breakfast costs extra but it is tasty and includes tea, expresso coffee, croissants, yoghurt, toast, and cereal. Lack of wifi in rooms is disappointing but mostly worked well in the common areas.

title: YHA are better than hotels
text: Great central location with modern rooms and facilities. Kitchen and quiet dining area with a more lively ground floor area with bar, restaurant and plenty of plugs to charge with. Continental breakfast that’s cheaper than going out and option to cool your own with plenty of food storage and fridges to self cater. Friendly staff and comfortable beds with good large lockers. Great value with savings if a member.

title: Affordable, clean and in a great location
text: We stayed here for 5 nights in a 6 bed room with an ensuite bathroom and shower. The rooms were clean and all the furniture seemed almost brand new. The common room had a wonderful atmosphere and everyone who worked there was extremely nice and helpful with everything. The location is perfect. It's on a quiet street so you can sleep peacefully at night but at the same time you're less than 10 minutes away from Oxford street and a few other tube stations.

title: Friendly people who take good care for geusts
text: It wasn't my first time at YHA London Central, I love to come there. It's a nice place, you find all you need, and it's easy to reach it by underground. It won't take you long to find placed you want to see in London. The hostel is clean, food is okay, breakfast fine, but most of all, I really love the persons that work here!!!

title: Great !
text: I splend 3 nights in YHA central and it was great ! It's located near underground, bus stops, and Oxford Street is very close. People are very nice and the room was clean. The food is good and the breakfast is full ! Great experience !

title: Nice, but really just trying to get the money out of you.
text: This hostel is in a good location. The rooms are decent. The bathrooms are ok. But I felt like a bit of a floating dollar sign here. Need money for everything. Only wifi in the lounge downstairs which we guessed might be to get you to buy stuff. That might be wrong but its just the impression the place gives. Staff are nice but mixed on how much help they will give. This place seemed better suited to groups of friends rather than a solo traveler like myself.

title: Horrible !
text: Sooo noisy ! everytime someone uses the water we hear a horrible sound, the walls are so thin we can hear all conversations And it's quite expansive for what it is ! The only advice : go anywhere else !

title: pretty nice hostel
text: I stayed here from December 22-26 in 2013. i stayed in a 4 bed room with my 3 friends. good things: We had our own bathroom and did not have to worry about locking up our things every time we left. Our room was really clean and the staff was nice and helpful. It was the perfect distance from oxford street, so we didnt hear the cars all night but also was nice to be so close to a main road. I loved the location because it was so close to the great Portland tube station! the security was amazing! there was 24 hour front desk and the front doors only opened with a room key at night (like when i was dark so even 8pm). you also needed a key to use the elevators and stairs. down side- no free wifi, you had to pay and it was only available in the lobby. It also was not very strong wifi and you could only share/ use 2 devices per wifi password Overall great location, safe, clean and good price!!

title: Meh, just alright
text: I stayed here for two weeks and it was just alright. It has a decent lounge area, but the room itself that I stayed in was so small. There were six of us crammed into an extremely tight space--I've been in rooms with 12 people where I felt more comfortable. The shower seemed to have some maintenance issues with the flooring, and most showers I took were cold. Plus, an entire floor shares the shower and bathroom (one of each), and so if you needed to use either it could take a while before others were done. I'm not sure if this is typical of hostels in London but I've had much better hostel experiences elsewhere that I paid a lot less for. I don't think I'd recommend this one to a friend.

title: YHA Hostels
text: I have been staying at YHA hostels on and off for the last 5 years. I have had a consistently good experience. The staff have always been very welcoming, friendly and helpful. even when the are busy they do not make you feels rushed. All fo the rooms I have stayed in have been very clean and to an excellent standard. The facilities are excellent and well maintained. If you shower late in the morning the water will not be as hot as earlier in the morning but is still OK. Overall, I highly commend YHA hostels in London and their staff. Personally, I have had nothing but a good experience at the YHA.

title: Cheap, clean, safe, great location
text: Me and my friend stayed here for 3 nights as we wanted a cheap weekend down in London. If we went down to London again, I would 100% stay here - it is in a really nice and great location, just a stones throw away from the train/tube and has a massive Tesco at the end of the road, and is within walking distance of many attractions. We were a bit dubious at first, as the term 'hostel' makes you think of somewhere shabby and dirty - this was the complete opposite. The whole hostel is very modern, the lobby was bright and clean with a very helpful tube map on the wall, and the reception/dining area was lovely - decorated very trendy with flags of the world, comfortable sofas, flat screen tv, computer terminals and lots and lots of information leaflets of attractions. We shared a room with 8 bunk beds. Couldn't have felt safer, the bed linen was fresh and bright green, and each had a decent sized wardrobe and personal lamp next to the bed. There was a toilet and shower room next door, both were very clean and lots of hot water. All in all, from paying about £90 each for 3 nights it couldn't have got any better - would highly recommend if you want a cheap great place to stay in London, though obviously it isn't for couples as they are single sex rooms!

title: Great!
text: This is my favourite hostel in London, it's safe, clean, comfy and in a brilliant location. Rooms are small but come with ensuite shower and toilets which is great for the middle of the night, and beds have a small shelf with nightlight so you can organise yourself. There are lockers in each room but remember to bring a padlock.

title: Great location, great hostel!
text: I had the chance to spend three nights in this int'l hostel in London

title: Fantastic central London location
text: This made a brilliant budget base for my daughter and I when we spent a couple of days sightseeing and going to the theatre. We had a room together with the loo and shower just across the corridor. All clean and comfortable.

title: Great location, friendly staff, affordable!
text: Everything you want in a nice hostel - good security, location, value, and quality. The staff were friendly and very helpful. The location is just a short distance from Great Portland Street station, and there are a number of pubs nearby.

title: Perfect for a short stay in London
text: Stayed here with some friends in June. If you're weary about sharing a room with strangers I can honestly tell you it's totally fine. The dorms are gender assigned which made me feel so so safe. It's in a nice area, I didn't see anything bad happen and no rough people seemed to be around. 15 min walk to Oxford Street, 2 min walk to nearest tube station which will bring you to most places e.g. Liverpool Street station if you got the Stagnated Express like myself, or even Baker Street if you're going to Madame Tussauds. Check-in was very fast, I was able to store luggage in a store room. Price is unbeatable for central London. I will definitely return!!

title: Absolutely great kind of hostel
text: I stayed at a female 6-bed room. It was absolutely comfortable, there were in-room lockers big enough to fit medium-sized luggage and/or backpack. Bathroom was spacious as well, and was appropriate for physically handicapped people. The shower was out of the room, across the hall. There was a luggage room to leave your stuff until check-in and/or after check-out, which was big, but the lockers couldn't fit a regular backpack (just small ones), so you had to leave your belongings out of them, unlocked (an act of faith I'm personally not very comfortable with).
