Staff was very friendly. Location was very good, just blocks away from Regent St and subway stations. Did not have free WiFi. Had a really big living/dining room, and kitchen space where you could order up a meal (i.e. pizza, snacks, beverages). As far as hostels go, this would be one of the very best.

title: A modern hostel in the heart of London
text: I've just had a three night stay here and will start by saying the staff are excellent. After I'd booked I sustained a knee injury which made it difficult for me to use the top bunk, but the reception staff were happy to try and find me a room which had lower bunks available. The hostel is situated just a short walk from Great Portland Street and Oxford Circus tube stations making it easy to get around London during your stay. Hot food is available, but is limited to pizzas or light snacks, there is a Tesco Metro supermarket just around the corner (New Cavendish Street) if you want to use the hostels self catering facilities (I never checked these out so can't comment). There's a reasonable choice of alcoholic beverages available too. The room was what I have come to expect of YHA hostels, the room was clean and each bunk has it's own power socket, light and small shelf. There's also a lift to all floors. Now some advice :) If you've pre-paid for breakfast, get there early to avoid the rush, even in November the common room was full of people at breakfast time. If you're going to leave luggage in their luggage room, place it near the door if you can, even if the room's empty at the time. There's a good chance that when you return to collect your luggage the room will be full and it'll be difficult to get to luggage left in the corner. In summary - Great location, great staff, comfortable room (for the price)

title: Great option for family in London
text: We were looking for a hotel in London that provided enough actual beds for our family of five, this really was the only option, and it turned out to be a great choice. The family room with en suite was perfect. Towels and bedding were provided, the room was spotless. It is not plush by any means, but we were looking for a base camp with a dedicated bed for each person. The service was excellent, 24 hour cafe was nice. We never felt out of place, as all age groups and other families were present. Good location to the underground as well.

title: Perfect location, affordable price
text: We were 6 in a room with private bathroom. Very clean, young staff, convenient with buses and tube. The only negative aspect: the room was very hot, with only a small fan. I'll go back again the next time I'll be in London!

title: Hostel with excellent location & friendly staff
text: - Excellent location (almost 10 min. walk from Oxford circus station) - Friendly helpful staff - Beauty room for free with hair dryer & hair straightener - very nice chill-out area - WIFI available only in reception

title: Great find! Great hostel & location.. highly recommend
text: Can't get any better for a hostel. Facilities modern, very clean and great location (3 blocks from Great Portland St. station, 15 min. walk to Oxford Circus). Safety was big concern and we felt very secure. Key card access to hostel after dark, & to elevator. Staff was very friendly & helpful... created a good environment. Great board games.. e.g. Operation. Large common kitchen w/ mini-fridges to store your food. Very quiet neighbourhood. Only noise noticed was doors closing. If you can afford it is worth it to get a private room (only 2 showers per floor if you stay in a common room). If you're going to be staying in another YHA hostel it's worth it to get a membership - an additional fee per person per night will be charged upon check-in if you aren't a YHA member.

title: Better places to stay.
text: The receptionist was miserable and non communicative. I swear she rolled her eyes when I walked towards her. The room was clean and tidy but please will someone descale the shower head the water goes everywhere. Difficulty sleeping due to noise until 3am and the ridiculous flat pillow. Wouldn’t stay here again due to staff attitude and noise levels. There are better places to stay not what I expect from a youth hostel.

title: Lovely staffs, lovely hostel!
text: Recently stayed for a couple of nights while having a short break in London. This hostel has perfect location, super friendly and helpful staff. Especially I was greeted by this lovely girl Minn who was very kind for suggesting places to eat nearby and helping in everything! She made our stay even more amazing. I would definitely come back here next time I visit London. :)

title: A decent economical stay for London
text: I liked the YHA London Central. The only problem I had was the heat. It was very sunny & hot in London (and hey I'm not complaining) there was no a/c or a fan that worked and the window did not open much. I really thought I was going to melt trying to sleep. It was uncomfortable. Now with that, I understand London is never that hot and usually a/c wouldn't be needed so I never bothered about a/c when booking. The bathrooms were okay and at times messy. I don't find the hostel at fault for this, it's people who don't clean up after themselves. The hostel is in a good location for the tube. It's close to a nice park as well. The lobby is very nice. Check the boards for activities and free walks. I did join in on one and really liked the tour. The do have food in the lobby as well as breakfast and snacks. It has a nice atmosphere and a chance to meet other travelers from around the world. The staff was friendly and very helpful.

title: Busy hostel 10 min walk from Oxford st
text: Busy hostel close to the heart of London. Easy to walk to tube stations and Oxford street. Comfortable beds and lockers provided. Take your own padlock. Dorms very hot at night even with fans on all night and street lights light rooms brightly. Breakfast good value. Great base but don't expect to sleep well.

title: Nice Place
text: Wonderful kitchen facitilites. It was worth coming back for meals. Rooms were very clean, but croweded. The shower rooms were tiny and had no place to hang your towel and clothes. Staff was wonderful and very helpful. London hotels are very expensive and we were grateful for economic accomodations with a full kitchen. Definately for the younger crowd, but my young daughters and I felt very comfortable.

title: YHA Central - for 60+ guests
text: It has been 5 years since I used YHA in London. Travelling from Rome to London I decided to return to Central YHA. I am quite comfortable taking this option although anyone in their 60s or 70s needs to understand that this is a youth hostel and NOT a hotel. I was not the oldest resident - from what I could see. I took (as before) a 6 bed dorm. As in times past, I only saw the other guys fleetingly and I had nothing to complain about. It may have been different had they all been part of a group (which can be a bit noisy). You are supplied with a secure locker (for which you need your own lock) and this is where I put valuables such as spare cash and passport and anything else of value. It is quite a large locker. Shower and toilet were fine as en suite. The YHA location is 1st class a hundred metres down the road from Great Portland Street tube station. If you have a heavy case be prepared to carry it up a few slights of stairs as you exit the tube station. The YHA has a lift to all floors and it has an eatery on the ground floor that serves breakfasts and supper… I used it quite a bit during my 3 days/nights there. Great value in terms of saving money on accommodation. You need to be a bit intrepid but everyone is very helpful.

title: Clean and convenient for central London
text: I spent 3 nights here on my first non-family trip to London and was very satisfied overall with my stay. The facilities were kept very clean, although I believe in peak times the one bathroom and shower near my basement room would not satisfy demand. My room was clean with a locker and light beside the bed which is practical, and I soon got used to the rumbling of the tube passing by underneath, although unfortunately the WiFi would not connect in my room. Having to swipe your card to gain access from the hallway to the rooms adds extra security which is always appreciated. Overall it's a good, reasonably priced placed to stay when passing through London

title: Value for money! Central location, highly recommended!
text: Value for money! Good points: Central location, comfortable double deckers, clean rooms, good wifi, friendly staff, big self-serving kitchen, great advise on what to do London. Things you put up with: Bearable small toilets, you have to pay for breakfast (or make a run to the nearest Tesco Express). YHA is run as a non-profit, so we are very grateful to have this hostel to help us see London on a budget, yet with very comfortable lodging. Lastly, we lost our Oyster Card, and the lady found it & kept it for us. Many thanks for a great stay!

title: Good time at Yha Londen Central
text: Excellente place. Very good location. Nice common places. good bar. Complet kitchen with everything to cook your meals. Airy rooms with lockers and some of them in suite. Very clean toilets and showers. laundry toom, hair dryers, iron. But the most important thing is the kindness and helpfulness of the staff at reception.

title: YHA London Central
text: I stayed here for a night with 3 friends, as part of a weekend away in London. We needed a budget priced room, and got exactly that..clean, en-suite, safe, central and really helpful staff on reception/cafe. The room had bunk beds and was on the bijou-side...but fine for our single night stay.

title: Very rude staff.
text: Had breakfast this morning. A very rude girl came to me, shouted at me: 'Did you pay'. I was totally shocked. She did not even apologize to me after finding out I paid the breakfast on my first day upon my arrival. I didn't expect any morning greeting from her, but not the way she questioned me. Sooooo rude. I thought everything was over, but she came to me later on asking me if I took any picture of her and other people... Excuse me... There were so many people around taking pictures and she didn't bark at them. I was again verbally abused by her. She was afraid that I would put her face picture up, of course I was NOT interested at all. The place is centrally located but it is such a shame having someone rude as one of their team members.

title: Will definitely return
text: Stayed here for 3 nights with 2 friends we booked a private room sign private bathroom. The location is great only a few mins walk to oxford st and 2 diff tube stops. Room was comfy enough and the staff were really friendly and helpful. Also has a bar/cafe downstairs with great prices. Will definitely be back!

title: Perfect location, great hostel, value for money
text: I stayed here for two nights while I was working in London. Fantastic value for money. Slept in a single sex 6 bed room with ensuite. Could have been tricky if we had all wanted to use bathroom at the same time but fortunately we didn't. The cafe/bar is good an reasonable and it is ideally placed for central London and is just opposite Kings Cross St Pancras. Modern, clean and pleasant bar to sit in in with evening with free wi-fi. Perfect.

title: Nice and clean hostel
text: I was there from dec 26 to jan 4. It was a very nice hostel with great facilities. The kitchen is well equipped and it also has a loundry room which I didnt use. I tried once the breakfast and was very good. The people at reception were very friendly and helpful. I had a problem with sleeping in a top bunk bed and asked for a bottom one and they kindly changed me into a different room. The only drawback is that I expected to be staying in a place with more atmosphere...I was travelling on my own and wanted to meet new people and that was not the case... Another thing I want to point out is that their internet connection broke down twice during my ten days there!! So almost five days without it!! They should do something about it in case it happens very often and it would be great if the rooms had wifi signal. All in all it was a good place. Clean, comfy and safe!

title: No Wifi
text: Be aware there is no wifi in the rooms and the wifi in the common area is very poor. I could not connect at all for most of my trip. This made planning my days very difficult and really impacted the quality of my trip. For travellers, especially traveling alone (as I was), wifi is essential and not having wifi in the rooms so that people have to sit in your restaurant is not okay.

title: Stay at London Central
text: Very well located in central London, with Regents parc just next door. Nice and friendly people to welcome you. Good premises for self cooking with all facilities and very clean. The only bad part was the heat int the bedroom due to the sun : very hot all night and day !

title: Perfect as always
text: This is my third time in a row staying in this hostel. Perfect as always. Bright and clean. Nice friendly staffs. Brilliant position. Very convenient no matter you wanna go west or east. Choosing where i wanna stay when i visit London is such a no-brainer for me. YHA London Central will always be on the top of the short list.

title: Perfect location
text: Perfect location as the hostel is right near Kings Cross and St Pancras train stations and tube.The price is reasonable for the centre of London. There are good facilities with a cafe, internet access, lockers, kitchen and 24 hour reception. My only (minor) qualm was that the room was very very warm at night, making it a little difficult to sleep. However, would definitely stay again.

title: Nice location, decent place, horrible Wifi
text: First I was gonna give only 3 stars, but finding a decent hostel in London is extremely hard, and this one was the best one from the ones I've seen. THE GOOD: The location is great, super central and you can walk to many places. Even though it's central it's not on a busy street so the rooms are pretty quiet. It's pretty clean and the mattresses are quite comfortable. The staff is super nice and helpful and the lobby/restaurant is a nice play to hang out. THE BAD: Rooms are pretty small (but that's normal for London I guess). Beds don't have that curtain thing for more privacy. The Wifi is absolutely terrible, doesn't work in the rooms at all and even in the lobby you have to be lucky for it to work. The breakfast is a bit expensive compared to other hostels. I would stay here again, for a few nights it's okay.

title: Good value and Great Ambiance
text: Staff are friendly and helpful perfect location (5min walk from Oxford St & Oxford Circus tube Station). 20 min walk to London Zoo or British Museum. We stayed in a 4 bed room (bunks) - mattresses on bottom bunks were a bit ordinary as cheap foam and are used as seats if you are in your room. We had our own bathroom which was great. Common area is kept clean and is spacious. Reception open 24 hours for assistance, food and drinks. We didnt find the common room excessively noisey with people checking in and out and gathering together for conversations. Everyone had headphones if listening to devices. One power point in our room did not work. I'd stay here again - just for the friendly staff, service and location. We were in a room on 5th floor with one lift sometimes the wait was a bit long but this was usually during peak periods such as breakfast and dinner times. We just timed our visits to the room during these periods. Quieter on the 5th floor.

title: You get what you pay for!
text: Honestly never stayed in a hostel before and was a little hesitant about this place at first due to cleanliness and noise, but its really not as bad as people may think. It does look more spacious in pictures, and the rooms are quite tiny but you get what you pay for, and for this location in London, its very reasonable. Not just for youngsters and students, this place has a mixture of families with kids,couples, teenagers, adults and even elderly. Its fairly clean which is so important for me and what I would look for anywhere I stay! Cleaning of rooms are done daily, the toilets in the corridors are kept clean and fresh, although no towels provided, but this was fine as we brought our own. It did get extremely hot in the rooms and there is no air-con, but staff do provide fans. The location is definitely a plus as its close to everything in the city and it was easy to take taxi's anywhere nearby, Staff seemed nice and willing to help, WiFi could be improved as its only available in public areas and not in the rooms, but all in all, for this price in London its very good value and if you want to be close to all amenities and your on a budget, this is the place to stay!

title: First time in hostel - Very nice experience
text: Have stayed in hostel for the first time with three other guys for two nights. Everything was fine. Hotel is very centrally located and there is everything you need in sorrounding area. We have booked 4-bed en-suite room, which was cleand and bunk beds very ok to sleep. Selection of food during breakfast was basic, but good for hostel and price 4,99. Bar is offering a big selection of drinks for the best prices. Hotel staff was very nice and helpful, that is what i appreciate the most. Very good option to stay in the city centre, to get a good service and pay very reasonable price.

title: Good
text: I have just been here for the first time, I thought it was just like a very poor place , but it wasn't,it had a very good environment and most of staff who work there were very nice, also I made a friend who is a staff there, it made my trip so happy.And there was so many Chinese travellers so you can try to make friends with them and you can also exchange the trip details in your language, I think it will be quite good. And I met some Japanese,Malaysian, Tawaniese and Russian there as well. By the way,the room which I lived was a dorm room which is sharing with 8 people as same sex,and it was quite nice. But the Bathroom and Toliet are quite small there, and the laundry you need to pay extra , like £5 something. To be conclude, the hostel is very good which I have been for travelling in different places. I will come again when I come to the UK again.

title: Great New Hotel! Our New Favorite in the Paddington area
text: We prefer to stay in this area because of it's close proximity to Hyde Park, Paddington Station and Lancaster Gate Tube Station. One can even walk to Oxford Street or Knight's Bridge if they wanted a little exercise. The area is a proper little neighborhood where we have been staying for both business and pleasure for over 20 years. The hotel we usually stay in was fully booked this trip and luckily I came across this gem which opened a month ago. We were greeted at the door by Leo who helped us into the hotel with our bags and as we were leaving the hotel prior to our final departure to the airport, he tagged and and stored all of our belongings and kept them until we returned to collect them. Every staff member we interacted with were highly professional, helpful and friendly! The hotel was nicely appointed and spotlessly clean. We had a standard room which was on the small side but was very comfortable. It had a sink, counter space, microwave, toaster, regular refrigerator with a large complimentary bottle of still water( not stocked with things for sale) and dishes and cutlery for two. The bed was very comfortable and had luxurious linens and towel. The shower was modern and spacious with both a rain shower head and a hand shower and nice amenities. We have a new favorite hotel in London where we travel very often for both business and pleasure and will stay there in December when we plan to return. Congratulations to the staff and management - we were impressed!

title: Superb!
text: Westbourne Hyde Park is an excellent hotel in a nice and tranquil location, with great transport links. Stayed for 4 nights with two adult daughters in a suite, which was good size for the three of us (would be a bit cramped for four adults). The rooms were very clean and as ours was at the back of the hotel as requested, there was no disturbing noise coming from the streets. Staff was flexible and friendly. I would definitely recommend this hotel if you’re travelling to London and wish to stay in a nice central area.

title: Faulty fire alarm, otherwise perfect stay
text: Would have given 5 stars but had 1 morning thoroughly ruined (explained below)... Location is perfect, quiet area within an easy walk of 2 underground stations and a great 24h bus line, lots of restaurants, and Hyde park The included cellphone with internet and international calls is a very nice touch. We were given a wheelchair accessible room (just what was available), which is actually a bit roomier them the standard rooms. 1 major issue: we were woken up by our rooms smoke detector falsely going off, followed by the sprinkler over the kitchenette, which spayed fire retardant all over our stuff!! We were moved into a suite with continental breakfast and a bottle of wine provided to our room, and laundry service paid for the affected clothing... But it was a very unpleasant way to wake up and ended costing us precious touring time.

title: Amazing experience - great hotel and most friendly staff
text: Great location- on your right its Marble Arch and on the left is Paddington tube station and the eating joints. Rooms were comfortable and clean. Very courteous staff especially Antonio, Sateesh and Mariaa. Special thanks to Ravi to went out of the way to organize taxi to hotel and provide information on varies places to visit. YOU guys are the best!!

title: Deluxe studio - wow
text: Arrived here for two nights with my partner as we were going to a concert and then the theatre. The price was very good for London and we wanted somewhere with a kitchenette for breakfast/brunch. Very close to Paddington and Lancaster Gate tube station which was good for travelling from St Pancras. Located in a nice area but by a main road. On arrival we were greeted very promptly by a receptionist who knew her stuff and took time explaining things to us. We were on the second floor and on the roadside - still quite high up. The room was small but what you expect from London, it was just big enough for the two of us. Everything was shiny clean and well presented. The bathroom was amazing - especially the shower! The lighting was good however the fan was noisy and continued making noises once the light was turned off. The kitchenette was smaller than originally thought but is understandable. Two hobs, a microwave and a kettle, along with two glasses, wine glasses and cutlery. Was quite disappointed that there was no toaster and we had to attempt to grill bread in the microwave on the grill option. There was also no washing up liquid or plug which was a bit of a pain. The bed was big and the pillows were very comfy. A lot of drawer storage space. Hairdryer was also very good and powerful. Will definitely be considering booking again if we return to London.

title: Excellent stay in London Paddington
text: This is a brand new hotel with a friendly staff and excellent location and amenities. The room has a Nespresso machine and a superb designed bathroom (the shower is the best one I've seen). You can reach anywhere quickly. I recommend the hotel.

title: Top-notch hotel with good location
text: Lovely spacious rooms, best bathroom I’ve ever encountered in UK, a useful little kitchenette... No minibar, but capsule coffee machine and a fridge which you can stock up yourself, do the trick just fine. There is a complimentary water bottle in the fridge for the first night. The location is very handy, near Lancaster Gate tube station. This hotel has pretty much everything you could want, except for a restaurant. Only downside is the noise from the street, which cannot be helped until the Brits figure out the benefits of double or triple-glazing!

title: nice, clean boutique hotel
text: We stayed here for 5 nights recently, my wife, son and me. The room was clean and modern but had a few quirky things. No door between the bedroom and living area and my son had to go thru the bedroom to get to the bathroom. Also a room key is needed to activate the electric and temperature controls. The service and front desk were fantastic, held our back prior to check in and held them after check out as our flight was later on in the day

title: Good value and good size room
text: Extremely friendly staff nice room with great shower no breakfast but that did not bother us as plenty of place nearby. Location is good as very close to lancaster gate tube with access to all London attractions

title: Winter Wonderland
text: Great location close to Hyde Park/Kensington Gardens - several restaurants I the vicinity all reasonably priced. Good size room for 3 adults - good facilities - helpful staff at reception. Shame they had run out of pastries on Saturday morning when we arrived but it was 11.00 am !! We made up for it on Sunday.

title: Great stay
text: Have stayed in this area before but first time at this hotel - will be back! The location is great: to the station and tube but also to Hyde and Kensington parks which are nice walks to Buckingham Palace. Lots of places close by to eat, have a coffee or to have a glass of wine. The hotel itself was great - the staff were friendly and helpful, the accomodation was great (3 of us were sharing) and the facilities were great all round (kitchen area had everything you need and the coffee machine was very welcome - no problem getting stocked up again when we asked at reception). The beds were very comfortable including the bed settee and th3 standard of cleanliness was very good. Plenty of shops around if you wanted to buy ingredients/ food to make something yourself. No complaints at all!

title: birthday weekend in London
text: Stayed Saturday 9th December. Birthday weekend for my youngest son. Great check in, efficient polite very helpful. On arrival to our room on the top (5th floor) we were treated to birthday balloons all over the sofa bed (fully made up as a double) as requested and a plate of chocolate chip muffins with a hand written birthday note to my son from the staff. Beautiful room quite spacious, as I was staying with my two sons one 23 and the birthday boy 13 I had requested a twin room with sofa bed. Great in room facilities for self catering, bottle of water in the fridge good selection of tea's etc and Nespresso cafe machine. Moulton Brown toiletries excellent shower pressure, bath robes and complimentary slippers. the hotel is relatively new and the hotel is immaculately clean and well maintained. Lovely friendly staff very helpful. Excellently placed for Paddington only 5-6 mins walk very easy tube access and again 5-6 mins walk to Hyde Park (we went to Winter Wonderland in the snow). Will definitely stay again as our train station is Paddington. Highly recommend.

title: Good location and good price
text: The hotel is in good location and close to underground station. London padengton station only 10 minutes walk. The price is okay. The hotel is new will clean. Problem it don't have restaurant or cafe shop in the hotel. It's main No breakfast in the hotel. But can find restaurants near bye.

title: Westbourne hotel
text: Very friendly staff and welcome - accommodated my extra requests including late check out. My only gripe is that they have no food facilities for breakfast but rooms do accommodate self-catering if needed.

title: Exceptionally helpful staff
text: There was a slight problem with dampness in the carpet near the shower, due to rather gross carelessness of the previous guests, I would imagine, but once the management realized this issue was not going to be fixed in a few minutes, they gave us a very nice larger room at no extra cost. We were there for a week, and they spent that week doing everything possible to make our stay perfect, and it was, indeed, perfect - everything lovely and clean. There are not many shops nearby, but that makes it a quiet area, and the traffic noise outside was well muffled. Having Hyde Park so close nearby was also a great plus - very nice to walk there. We are pretty diligent walkers, and found ourselves walking to Oxford Street and other well-known places several times during the week. The only remotely negative thing we could say was just that the hotel didn't have breakfast facilities, but we knew that in advance, and there were nice little places nearby which made this really no problem at all. We fully expect to stay here again in a year or two.

title: London Stay
text: The hotel staff were extremely helpful and the room was fabulous. Very clean and very modern for a London hotel. Close to the central line to very easy travelling anywhere. I come to London a lot and will definately be using them again. Not that it is important but loads of TV channels unlike most London hotels. Worth trying the Westbourne!!

title: Excellent hotel all around
text: Excellent location and excellent hotel all around! Does not yet have breakfast, but plenty places nearby. Everything new. Room is of average size, but smartly arranged. Pleasant staff. Incredible price for London!

title: Fabulous!
text: We arrived to the hotel earlier than expected but the wonderful staff were helpful and we checked in early and had access to the room straight away! The room had everything you could need and was neat and tidy. The hotel was a couple of minutes walk from Lancaster Gate tube station on the central line which was perfect and a couple of minutes walk from hyde park which was ideal! There was also a bar in the hotel although I know there were many other places nearby. They also kept our bags for us on the last day, which was perfect! Overall it was a great stay with the only downside being the view (which was a brick wall) but we just kept the voile shut! I would definitely recommend the hotel. The staff were friendly and helpful and we really enjoyed the stay!

title: Peaceful & Posh Near Hyde Park
text: Lovely smaller hotel with exceptional staff and well-appointed, modern rooms. Perfect location just a few blocks from Paddington Station, and close to Hyde Park -- makes getting anywhere in the city a breeze. Is now my hotel of choice in London, hands down!

title: Wonderful stay ❤️
text: Excellent service and wonderful staff! Nice rooms with high standard And well fitted pentry. Clean. Near Hyde park and underground and buses to all over London. Five minutes to Paddington and stores and restaurants

title: Brand spanking new
text: Brand new hotel, in fact, when I was there they were still finishing it off. I had a good stay, it is very handy for running in Hyde Park. Bed was a little short though (I'm only 5'10") and my toes were a bit squashed at the end. One light fitting was bare as it hadn't yet been fitted. AC goes off when you leave the room so constantly warm (it was a heat wave). Room is a good size for London, plenty of room for my case etc. I had an adjoining room which I am not keen on, it wasn't locked either. Make sure you make a request if you would prefer a room without an internal door. Kitchenette can be really useful if you are away on business and don't fancy going out. Staff were friendly and everything was clean a had a quality feel.

title: Amazing hotel!
text: My husband and I spent 5 nights in The Westbourne Hyde Park. This outstanding hotel is in a good location, 5 min walking to the Lancaster Gate tube station and easy walking to Oxford St. We loved staying really close to Hyde Park. The staff, with no exception, is top notch. Room was a good size for us, spotlessly clean, well appointed, tastefully decorated in each and every detail. Comfortable bed and soft linens. Nice bathroom with a powerful rainfall shower, but a soap dish and a shampoo dispenser would be helpful. There is an equipped kitchen in the room with all we needed to cook fast meals during our stay. Good coffee and tea selection was supplied and a Nespresso coffee machine was very useful. We highly recommend this hotel and we are looking forward to return there.

title: Best hotel we've ever stayed in!!!
text: Everything exceeded our expectations from service to the room itself. Truly an outstanding hotel and incredible value for money. When we visit London again we will never look elsewhere. One of the best hotels we have ever stayed in and one of the best nights sleep we have ever had. The staff (each and every one of them) are an asset to the hotel and keep this establishment to the high standard that we experienced. We can't wait to come back!!!

title: Great experience
text: Very efficient, great rooms, fantastic for business travellers. Rooms were very quiete with blackout curtains, essential for people with jetlag. A five minute walk from Paddington an added bonus, easy to get to from the Heathrow express

title: Great value and location
text: Stayed for one night recently and very pleasantly surprised from the moment I arrived to the moment I left. Attentive friendly staff who seem genuinely proud and enthused to be part of this little hotel. The room I booked wasn't ready (I was early) so they immediately changed it to one that was. Small, but very well equipped modern rooms. Immaculately clean, amenities (Nespresso machine etc) typically associated with far more expensive hotels. 7-8 minute walk from Paddington, 3-4 minute walk to Lancaster gate Tube.

title: Hyde Park
text: I was upgraded to a mini suite, so I can't tell you about the usual rooms. My bed was insanely comfortable. It is a quiet neighborhood, but very close to Hyde Park and to public transportation. I loved the decor, and the staff was very friendly.

title: Enjoyable stay with my teenage daughter
text: I'd like to than the personnel for the flexibility to arrange us the stay in this hotel after some misfortune other bookings. I felt that my request was handled extremely professional, friendly and sincerely. The personnel was super friendly for us, all times. Special thanks to Christofer and Satish (?) for organising the transfer. The room we got was perfect for us. It was facing back of the building and we had no problem of any noise, even when we slept the window ajar (which is actually nice, as in many holes you cannot even get the window open for outdoor air!). The bed was comfortable and we slept very well. The room temperature was good and we had no problems with aircos or anything that might sometimes disturb your sleep. The room was spacious enough, clean and nice, modern decorated. The bathroom was spacious, as it was built also for good accessibility. Only thing I missed was a shelve or something for your toiletries close to the sink, but those thick, soft bath towels made up for it. The kitchenette was handy to have, but for us not necessary. Nespresso machine was a nice surprice! The location is close to the Paddington and Lancaster Gate tube stations, and good bus lines to for example to Oxford street. Final tip: If you like running during your stay, the Kensington park is just around the corner with it's great paths for a good morning run.

title: A Great Venue & Location with Warm @ Welcoming Staff
text: Located short walk from Paddington Station, the Westbourne was so convenient. We caught the Heathrow Express from airport and walked to the hotel. We stored our luggage at the hotel as was still very early in the day and walked around the street to Kensington Gardens. The Lancaster Gate Undreground Station is opposite there and so convenient. When it eas time to check-in the staff were most helpful. Our room was well appointed and very clean and comfortable. We always received a warm greeting from the Reception Staff each morning as we left for the day and when returned in the evening. We were given a late check out on our last day and a warm farewell from the staff.

title: Very good service
text: Very good service from the personale and good hotel rooms, and the hotel was very clean, next time we are in London, we will absolute use the hotel again, the hotel are not very long from the metro 5 min on walk

title: Awesome stay
text: the hotel is at a nice location, very close to the central line station and a bit longer walk (5-7 mins) to the Paddington station. the neighborhood is quiet which is probably hard to find in central London, but some small deli and cafe are just around the corner. If you value sleep quality like me you would love here. I would say the room is on the small side but it is super cozy and has everything we need. The BEST thing about the room is the shower head!!! the water pressure is so fantastic almost like a waterfall!!! I also love how the mirror and lighting in the bathroom are especially suitable for girls who need to do makeups, which are details commonly ignored by most hotels. Two little tiny complains: the two single beds in our room are actually put together, and it doesn't have much room for us to separate them by ourselves. And the housekeeping did not replace/clean the dirty fork and spoon I put in the sink. But in all, I would definitely stay here again!!

title: Excellent value for the location
text: Very well presented and appointed room. Maybe a little small. Very clean and well maintained. Very helpful staff. We were pleased to find a hotel for a reasonable cost which was so close to the Tube, Hyde Park, Oxford Street etc.

title: Kensington Charmer!
text: Just spent 5 nights at this charming property in the Kensington area while attending Wimbledon. Have previously been to London so staying next to the major sites was not important (Buckingham Palace, Parliament, etc). Selected this property based on tripadvisor reviews, rate and proximity to the Heathrow Express which terminates at Paddington Station – perhaps a 10 min walk. Loved the location. Lots of pubs and restaurants within 5-15 minute walk – loved the neighborhood feel you got walking the nearby streets.. Yes, the hotel does not offer breakfast but so many quaint options nearby – including breakfast in the nearby Italian Gardens café. If can be a bit of a walk to sites such as Buckingham Palace or Oxford Street – over 30 minutes – but we do enjoy a good walk. The tube is also nearby to take you anywhere you want to go! Room was modern and the bottled water and in room Nepresso were appreciated daily. One comment on the bathroom – if you are tall you will hit your head on the towel rack so BEWARE! Also the mirror in the bathroom is not hung to accommodate a tall person either! Such a minor inconvenience. WIFI was free and no issues connecting multiple devices. Staff was extremely friendly. Would recommend this property to anyone.

title: Outstanding Room - Incredible Value
text: The hotel and staff are incredible, the room exceeded all of my expectations - this is what i would expect from something twice the rate i am paying - my only frustration has been the rudeness of other guests, parents letting their children run up and down the hallways screaming etc, you may want to bring earplugs.

title: Good stay
text: It was a good stay. We had just one night no hot water in the shower but they fix it fast. The room was nice. There was a kitchen and a big fridge. Near by the station and a little supermarket. Good location

title: Great stay
text: Very attentive, friendly staff, lovely room with all mod cons. Beautiful flowers and decor and lovely little bar downstairs (although didn't make use of it). Perfect for our over night stay in London.

title: Great hotel!
text: I stayed here with my mom for 5 days and we really enjoyed it! Super nice room, comfortable beds with big pillows, a kitchen area for those who doesn't want or can eat out every day. Close to both subway and several busses. Would absolutely recommend!

title: Love it!
text: Great located hotel, near subway station. Super fresh rooms, great beds, friendly staff. By far the best hotel I've ever stayed at in London. Next time I will go back to London I will be staying at The Westbourne Hyde Park.

title: Brilliant find
text: Close to Paddington station, Hyde Park and Lancaster Gate underground station The Westbourne was a brilliant find. Rooms have cooking amenities as well as comfortable beds. Staff were all friendly and helpful. Would highly recommend a stay, we will definitely be returning.

title: excellent stay
text: clean and recently refurbished. Very helpful staff. Overall excellent. l definitely recommend it. The nespresso machine in the room was welcome. The street is relatively quiet at night. A couple of pleasant restaurants and deli stores in the vicinity.

title: Slick decor
text: Nicely decorated & furnished hotel within easy walking distance of Hyde Park, Lancaster Gate tube station and Paddington, set on a beautiful Georgian street. Very clean and slick with a good standard of fittings. Rooms come with everything you'd expect, nice toiletries and even a hot plate, sink and fridge. However, the hotel is small and if you happen to arrive when other people are already waiting to check in (as I unfortunately did), you can be waiting a long time to check in as there are only 2 desks.

title: Clean, cozy, and conveniently located
text: The hotel was wthin easy walking distance from Paddington station where the Heathrow Express departs. The room was simple, clean, and relaxing. The hotel staff was kind. I would use the hotel again when I visit London.

title: Wonderful stay
text: The hotel was perfect. Everywhere was impeccably clean and tidy and the rooms were compact but a nice size. The only one thing I did find slightly annoying, was the fact that there was no plug socket in the bathroom, which made styling my hair in the dimmer light of the kitchen a little difficult. Apart from this there is nothing to fault. It’s in a great location, a 3 min walk to the nearest tube station (Lancaster Gate) which is on the central line, about a 30 min walk to Oxford Street and a 10 minute walk to Hyde Park. The staff are lovely and very helpful, we will definitely be back again.

title: A real find
text: We found this hotel via the web for a one night stay on 2nd January 2018. It was excellent. The room was well designed to incorporate a small kitchenette as well as sleeping accommodation. Very good bathroom with a shower that worked properly. The staff were all very helpful and the location was very convenient- just minutes from Lancaster Gate tube. A real find and we shall certainly stay again.

title: Perfect
text: Location is great, right by Lancaster tube station facing Hyde park. So can walk or catch the tube easily. Rooms are well presented with high end spec. Everywhere was spotlessly clean and staff were very helpful should you need directions. There is even a smartphone in room at your disposal with free calls and internet. Will definitely be returning to this hotel.

title: Very clean
text: Pros: location, clean and new. Cons: some staff members seem to be not very well familiar with the check in procedures or the city itself. The rooms are tiny but it is okay. No breakfast, but plenty of places nearby.. Staff also seem to be apathetic from time to time

title: Beautiful hotel, helpful staff
text: We stayed several days in London on our recent trip to the UK. The hotel was beautiful and close to transit. The staff responded quickly to all my emails due to a check-in that was delayed due to weather and a lost item left in the room after checkout. Can't say enough good things about how helpful everyone was.

title: Excellent option by Hyde Park
text: Thoroughly enjoyable stay in a very clean & well presented hotel. Staff are extremely friendly & helpful. Rooms are small but spotless & well equipped including the useful kitchenette & Nespresso machine. Great location by Hyde Park with good access to local restaurants etc.

title: Nice stay
text: Had two days here to see family in London and a show. It's a good hotel, comfortable, very clean and central. The room was very warm on arrival, but once we had sorted the aircon it was fine. It was well equipped with a corner kitchen area too. I would be happy to stay again.

title: Would stay here again
text: Fantastic Clean modern efficient Aparthotel Friendly staff Relaxed atmosphere Great air con in every room Late bar Adjoining suites if required Great bathrooms Slippers dressing gowns coffee machines full sized fridge micro wave Enemies products in the bathrooms Decent hairdryers Only opened in oct 2016 so still feels clean and new

title: Absolutely outstanding
text: Booked a hotel room at the hotel across the road, was completely unimpressed with the standards of the room. Went over to the Westbourne Hotel where they were extremely helpful and very kindly offered us a room with them for a small extra charge. The staff were impeccably friendly and as the weather was not permitting for what we had wished to complete during our stay we actually then booked another night with this hotel!

title: Amazing Hotel
text: Stayed at this hotel on the 1st of October 2017 and I can honestly say it was an amazing place. The staff were very pleasant and offered us an upgrade to a suite because we had stayed there previously. Could not believe the suite they gave me it was beautiful with catering facilities as well. The bed was perfect and I slept like a baby. Would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting the area as worth every penny.

title: Great Stay Highly Recommended
text: We stayed in the Westbourne due to its proximity to Paddington, Hyde Park and Lancaster Gate Tube. The welcome was great and the reception and bar are spotless and really nicely furnished. The room itself is standard small size for London, but where it scores highly is the little kitchenette area which has a fridge, hob, kettle, coffee maker and microwave. Super handy if you are staying for a few days. The beds are super comfy and bathroom really nicely kitted out with a great shower. The bar is great and anywhere that does bottles of Bottega Processco for under £25 in London is always going to be a winner. So for comfort, price, value for money and location this is a great little hotel and highly recommend it...will definitely come back next time we're in London.

title: Recently refurbished hotel
text: We stayed 3 nights and the price was very reasonable. Great to stay in a freshly refurbished hotel with every thing so new. We had a small problem with the fan in our bathroom that would not turn off. The staff were so good in particular Christiansen (forgive me if I got the name wrong). This man is a real asset to the hotel plus the young gentleman on the door who could not do enough to help us. It makes such a difference when the staff go out of their way. They moved us to another room due to the fan issue. At our request we asked for the top floor as we found there was some noise on lower floors as you can hear people walking on the floor boards. The rooms are a little small however for 2 people over 3 days the size is ok. Great to be able to microwave food and there are hot plates if you want to make eggs or something small. Couple of things for the hotel as feedback. The shower needs a shelf to rest soap or shampoo. There was no dishwashing liquid in the kitchenette. It would also be helpful to offer access to self service washing machines in the hotel. Travellers often look for hotels who offer a machine to wash their own clothes especially if they have been travelling for a few weeks. Overall a nice, clean, friendly and convenient hotel. Close to Waitrose supermarket to pick up some food. Well done team and thank you for a great stay

title: Lovely renovated hotel in fabulous area
text: Now, where to start from? We booked two rooms for a week during Xmas Holidays. The customer service was fantastic from the moment we reserved the rooms. We arrived and the reception team was exceptionally helpful and this was for the whole duration of our stay. The rooms are spacious. We stayed in room 208. Very nice view over the street road and the sizing was fine if you have a baby cot, however maybe for a week stay and the fact we booked direct with them they probably should have given us an upgrade. However, the room is nice. All necessary facilities are there. The small kitchens in the room are very convenient for families with children. What I would suggest to consider is maybe a breakfast room, as the hotel does not offer breakfast or maybe a restaurant as there were many moments we would have preferred to stay in rather than trying to find a restaurant for dinner in the evenings and the other thing was maybe a good bartender especially in the evenings, when you come back from sightseeing, we would love to have some nice cocktails at the lobby. There is a small bar but offering very basic drinks. Rather than that the hotel is very well located and close to Lancaster Gate undergound. Close to a bus stop with many buses running to several places. Fully renovated with a choice of very nice colors. All in all a very good stay and definitely when we return to London will be our first choice!

title: Convenient Bayswater location close to Hyde Park
text: Needed a value-for-money central London hotel for one night and this didn't disappoint. Sleekly modern excellent location 2 minutes from Lancaster Gate Tube and Hyde Park. Comfortable, well-appointed room with great shower. Slightly bizarre breakfast arrangements with continental breakfast served in small reception lounge area but inexpensive. Helpful staff. Mini apartment with microwave useful for longer stays.

title: Very pleasant boutique hotel
text: We enjoyed our stay at The Westbourne Hotel, the staff were all very friendly and helpful at the front desk. The rooms looked fresh and were clean, the bed very comfortable with crisp good quality bedding. There are tea and Nespresso coffee machines in the room, along with a mini kitchenette consisting of fridge, microwave, toaster and two ring burners. The only thing I would have to mention, only one day of our stay, my room was filled with the smell of onions and garlic frying from the room next door, but opening the windows let it all out. Most people didn't seem to cook much - at least I don't think. There are so many little restaurants around the corner, as the hotel does not have dining facilities, it wasn't a problem. I think breakfast is served in a sister hotel down the road, but we didn't try that. In all I think it was very good value for central London, steps from Hyde Park and the tube station too.

title: Nice location
text: This boutique hotel is one of the best I tried in London clean and quiet and internet is good .. the only thing is the complementary water it’s not for free it will cost you 4£ - 8£ for one bottle .. and the reception they are always stressed

title: Neat and well appointed
text: Very clean, looks recently refurbished. Provision of light breakfast (at extra cost) was very welcome. Staff most friendly and knowledgable. The bedroom was rather small if you are travelling with luggage.

title: Beautiful Hotel with amazing Staff
text: We arrived at Westbourne at 9:00 am in the morning after a 6 hour flight. So pleased we could get into our room. We had a Suite, some of the special touches were the slippers, robe. Also, an assortment of teas and teas and coffee. Such a nice stuff, Close to Victoria station

title: Holiday
text: I booked to stay at this hotel as was meeting some friends who were over from Australia. I booked the 2-3 October but when I was booking on Expedia which I had never used before and won’t again something happened with the booking and it booked me down for the 30-1 which I knew wasn’t right anyway they would change for the date I wanted and wouldn’t refund my money either which was disgusting. So just be warned when booking this hotel.

title: Great place!
text: After reading reviews decided to stay here. It lived up to all the positive comments. Staff were very polite and helpful! The room are small but it is in London after all. Walking distance to Paddington and Hyde park.

title: Great hôtel !
text: The staff is very nice and professionnal. We booked for 4 nights and came back because we had a problem with our new appartment they were very helpfull !!! Tea and cofee are free and there s all the plates ,glasses, cutteries .... Very well located near Lancaster gare and paddington station Aldo close to Hyde park ! I recommand it !

title: Great location near Paddington Station
text: Great little hotel within walking distance of Paddington station. Room was clean and well appointed, quiet and I had a great nights sleep. Was traveling on business and the internet connection was great, so no issues working. Staff was very attentive and helpful.

title: Perfectly Wonderful
text: I have been staying at this hotel in London since it opened two years ago. I have been staying in London for 30 years and in that time have regularly stayed at only 3 hotels. Once I find one I stick with it until it closes or raises the price too much. I was without a regular hotel for about 2 years between my last one and this one. It was a great day when I found the Westbourne. This hotel fills a niche between low price hotels that show it, and high price hotels that aren't worth it. Everything about this place is fantastic. Someone was really thinking when they designed the rooms. They are good sized, have a kitchenette with a real refrigerator, and microwave. The internet is well covered in the rooms and fast for a hotel. The hotel goes out of their way to help you. I have arrived at 7am into Heathrow and they have gotten me into a room by 10am, earlier in one case. The hotel is clean and only 3 blocks from Paddington. There is a great little french food store around the corner called Leclerc & Laurant. You can pick up some things there and bring it back to your kitchen and save some money on eating out. Each room has an Nespresso machine. The bed is great, sheets are thick, and hotel is very quiet on the backside. I'll be staying here for a long while.

title: El-Sharkawi
text: Great hotel! booked the hotel for a one night stay as a walk in with my brother, ended up staying two weeks. Very friendly and helpful staff, great service in general. We took the suite, which was very spacious and modern. Great location as well. I reiterate, the service was exceptional, credits to the front desk. We will for sure be back!

title: Great Place
text: Very nice hotel in a perfect location. 5 min walk to either Paddington or Lancaster Gate Tube Stations so you’ve got all directions covered to explore, and plenty of bus options as well. 5 min walk from Hyde Park and only a 15 min walk into Notting Hill where we had breaky every morning at either Granger & Co. or Ottolenghi, both incredible. Rooms much larger than we expected, lovely bed with blockout blinds, very clean and didn’t have any problems during our 8 night stay. Great place

title: When you compare price and quality we can only say : The Westbourne is excelent !!
text: The staff really makes an effort to comfort their geusts !! Big compliments on that !! The rooms are nice, very well equipped, only the ventilation of the bathroom is to noisy ! But this is not an issue !! We'll be back soon !! KR Charles from Maastricht...

title: Good location if coming from Heathrow on the Heathrow Express
text: The staff were very friendly. The place in general, and the room in particular, was spotless. It was also very close to Paddington Station, so it was easy to walk there. On the negative side, no breakfast is provided, but then, if you get a bit organized, you have facilities in your room to prepare your own, even if you go for the full English option. Also, there were two doors to get into the room, the first one into a very small hall, and the second into the room proper. Both of them were pretty heavy, so it was a bit tricky (if not funny for someone looking from the outside!) for me, travelling on my own and with two suitcases, to make it into the room. Excellent shower and very comfortable bed.

title: Nice Little Hotel
text: Chose the hotel mainly due to location - close to Paddington (5 min walk) and Hyde Park(2 min walk). Not a moment that I regretted the decision. Arrived early morning (pre 7AM) in London, took a chance to call the hotel for (really) early checkin, surprisingly a very pleasant front desk staff (Maria) confirmed room availability and even if there was no room available by the time I reach the hotel - she will make sure it will be ready within the hour. Great start! Arrived at the hotel around 8AM - as promised, room was ready! Smooth check in process, very friendly and helpful staff all around. Room is rather small, expected for London, but super clean, bright and nicely designed with all of the modern outfits. Housekeeping does their work well too! Highly recommended and included in my comeback list!

title: Great hotel and location
text: My friend and I stayed at the WHP for one week in August 2017 and had a wonderful experience. The rooms are cozy but they didn't seem too crammed. We had requested two twin beds which were perfect size and comfortable. The room was furnished with a desk, two beds, two nightstands, and an accent chair. There was a tiny kitchenette in the room as well which had a stove, sink, microwave, kettle, toaster, plates, utensils, pots, and a table with two bar stools. There was also an espresso machine in the room in addition to the tea/coffee options. They provided real milk in the fridge (not the powdered stuff). The TV was smart and also had plenty of local channels. The closet had bath robes, slippers, iron/ironing board as well as a safe. The rooms and lobby looked very clean, newly renovated. The staff were incredibly polite and friendly. The location is great, walking distance to Hyde Park, Kensington Gardens, Kensington Palace, Lancaster Gate Station, and Paddington Station.

title: Great Staff
text: Located just five minutes walk from Paddington Station it's ideal for exploring Hyde Park and surrounding area. Great staff - pleasant and professional and the room was spotlessly clean with a wonderful bathroom. I'll certainly be using it again.

title: Great value, would stay again
text: Very happy with our 2 night stay at this hotel -- great location, near restaurants, upscale rooms, helpful staff. We were travelling with our 7-month-old and I was able to reserve a travel cot (crib) in advance. It was already in our room when we got there. Hassle-free all around and good value for money.

title: There’s a smell
text: We stayed at Westbourne Hyde Park for four nights , five days. First off , location was amazing... we lugged our suitcases from Paddington Station (via Heathrow Express) and we did not mind it at all. The staff is very helpful and welcoming when we arrived

title: Great hotel and location
text: Great location close to Paddington, Lancaster Gate underground station, and Hyde Park. Walking distance to restaurants and grocery stores. Helpful staff. Very clean and quiet suite. Fully equipped kitchen with a Nespresso machine. Great AC.

title: A great experience
text: We are just back from a 4 night stay. After an air condition malfunction our first night, we were moved to another room the next day and then had a wonderful and comfortable experience at the hotel. The room was nice and the bed comfortable, the bathroom modern with a great shower. The best part of the room was the kitchenette which was a great convenience. The staff is helpful. The location is terrific in a pretty and quiet area, a 3 minute walk to the Lancaster Gate station and steps away from Hyde Park. Highly recommend a stay at this hotel.

title: Fantastic hotel close to Oxford St and Hyde Park!
text: Stayed for 7 nights and could not fault our stay at all! Our room was very clean and tidy, plenty of room and didn't feel confined at all. Had our windows open daily for fresh air and to here the local traffic going about their day.. Half hour walk to Oxford St. Hyde Park and Paddington Station only a 5 minute walk away! Highly Recommend! *****

title: Lovely hotel
text: Stayed here for the second time. Lovely hotel in a good location. Very close to Paddington station and within walking distance of Notting Hill, Kensington and Hyde Park. Would definitely recommend for a long or short stay

title: Poor Management Skills
text: I had reserved an 11-night stay with this hotel and was excited to try a new hotel in London. I go to london once a year and usually stay on Park Lane. I am travelling from the USA and did my due diligence in contacting the hotel well in advance (40 days) to provide them with additional information of having a small service dog with me. I received a lengthy email from the reservation's manager, Emilia rudely insinuated, that I can be dishonest about my service dog intentions and to provide documentation for proof. Appalled at her form of welcoming, I wrote back with my opinion of her request and asked to have the GM contact me. Well....the GM, Kiren contacted me via email not to apologize for the misunderstanding or apologize for his reservation manager's rude behavior, but instead defended her actions and stood ground for their decision because as he put it, "in the past guests were dishonest with the service dog request". Even more astonished to Mr. Kiren's response, I wrote back stating how it was illegal to question any guest for their service dog need due to privacy and medical condition which is covered under the privacy act and disability act. I have always stood proud of london and their customer service skills, therefore was shocked to actually have two managers defend their unprofessional behavior. Furthermore, I am surprised that upper management allows such behavior towards their guests from these two. The outcome was that I was not convinced of this hotel's customer service skills and grew concerned for my experience being there for 11 nights. Ultimately, it was a wiser decision to cancel my reservation with them as a result of this communication and spend my 11 nights at a 5 star property on Park Lane that has welcomed me and my service dog with open arms and hospitality from their first communication response to my needs. I tried to explain to Mr. Kiren how I came from the hospitality background (Hilton and Four Seasons Hotels) and we were consistently trained to provide excellent level of care to our guests and never question a service dog needs. Unfortunately, Mr. Kiren and Emilia must not have had that training degree nor has the WHP group requested that standard from them apparently. Shame on this establishment that has hired individuals such as these two who are allowed to communicate with their guests in such discriminatory manner. Do not waste your holiday at this establishment, go somewhere where they actually care for your experience.

title: Probably the worst stay we ever had in a hotel
text: I usually don't share on tripadvisor in English, but I will exceptionally change that to comment about this property and the awful stay we had last weekend. The least we can ask in a hotel is to sleep and have a good night's rest. On a good note, because there are a few, the hotel is brand new, or has been newly refurbished (don't expect soundproof walls and sealing however) The beds are very comfortable as well as the sheets and duvet. The towels are extremely soft. One bottle of water is offered on the first day. And nespresso coffee is complimentary. That could have been a lovely stay. Two things have encouraged my rating : - The fact I had not enough sleep. - The hotel doesn't have a restaurant and does not even provide breakfast. When we arrived at 1PM, our room was not ready, no problem, we left our luggage and went into the city to come back only in the evening at 9PM after a long day walk. We entered the room, very nice and well decorated, and unpacked. We noticed a loud noise from ventilation from the bathroom, and working in a hotel, we expected it to stop after a while with the light of the bathroom off. To make sure, I called the reception and got confirmed it would stop after 15'. Pretty long... Unfortunately, it did not for all night long, and as my wife felt asleep, I renounced to call for a room change at this time. Moreover we could hear the guests above walking. The next day despite the efforts of the reception team, it could not be stopped and they had no other choice than offering us to move to another room. In this second room, as nice as the first one, we expected to have a good night. This was without the very loud noise of drilling next-door at 8.30AM. After a call to the reception, it stopped for while and then started more softly, probably in a room further away. We then decided to prepared and leave. Special mention to the Front Office Manager, who apologized again at check-out and offered us the same voucher of 15% discount for a future stay, that could be found in the room. If I thought I would ever come back to this hotel, I would have taken the voucher myself...

title: Somebody was thinking, when they designed the rooms. Fantastic
text: I stayed here for only one night in June 2017. My flight landed at Heathrow at 5am. I called the hotel and asked them if I could check in early. The type of room I reserved was full the night before, so they didn't have any of those. They could have said, "You'll have to wait until one of the single rooms checks out and is cleaned before you can checkin." But at 6am I was standing in the hotel lobby, and they let me have a better room immediately, rather than making me wait for my type of room to vacate. The staff was extremely helpful. I had to put something in the safe and after I did, I couldn't get the safe to unlock. So I called the desk, and turns out, the battery was low for the keypad. So they came and changed the battery at 6:15am. Whoever designed the room thought of everything. I was in room 3 on the ground floor and it was extremely quiet.

title: Great Hotel, wonderful staff and a perfect location
text: Really lovely hotel, 5 min walk from Paddington Station, rooms very well equipped, spotless and excellent facilities. Staff couldn't be more helpful or friendly and we had rooms on ground floor and the 5th - both of us had a great nights sleep - they are studios with separate sitting/kitchen area, a good base if staying for the week. Wifi good too as we needed to work. No food/breakfast here but about 50m away is a selection of cafes etc. Will be using this hotel again!

title: Strongly recommend
text: Good staff , service and location . Friendly, hospitality and warm hotel . Near the Hyde Park by 3mins waking. Convenient to buy food and drinks coz Small grocery shops nearby. There are two stations around , Lancaster gate and paddington station, easier to get there from the Heathrow airport. U can take buses the regent street ,oxford street even the china town directly . Free tea and coffee provided In the room. Very enjoyed staying there 6 nights .

title: Great location and price!
text: We were glad to stay in this hotel with our baby! Great location close to the best part of Hyde Park! Every room has small but good equipped kitchen! Even thou the check in was a bit slow the staff was very kind and friendly! Hope next time we will be able to enjoy evening drink in lobby bar!

title: Comfort and Convenience
text: Located near two underground stations (Paddington and Lancaster Gate), and the green expanse of Hyde Park, the Westbourne Hotel is also near a street full of Italian restaurants. The rooms are small but include a small fridge and stove-stop, plus wine glasses, cutlery, and dishes.. The decor is tastefully modern and the bed comfortable. A continental breakfast is available in the bar for a reasonable price. The staff is very helpful and friendly. This is a good place to begin a stay in London.

title: great hotel
text: I stayed with my 15 year old daughter and it was great. The hotel is new so everything was great and the staff were wonderful. very close to paddington station so airport to hotel was easy. Hyde park just around the corner, easy walking to oxford st, albert hall and the museums.

title: Good hotel near Hyde Park
text: This is a quaint boutique hotel only a few blocks from Hyde Park. We had a slight problem when we first checked in as we were put into a handicap room where the shower just had a curtain and the water leaked onto the carpet. They said they were sold out. But they moved us into a standard room the next day. I read another review and we also experienced being jolted out of bed with the fire alarm going off at 5am one night, which we were told was from a pipe burst on the floor above. Anyway, it is clean and modern room with a kitchenette in the room and a small bar in the lobby. We asked for a quiet room and it was on the backside of the hotel, which was quiet. Just a few blocks from Paddington Station, which was great and so convenient on the Heathrow Express as it only takes 15 minutes from the airport. We found a cute breakfast place near the station called Raffles, only 3.50 pounds for a full English Breakfast. Great price and service. And Taormina? an authentic Italian restaurant around the corner from the hotel. Visit the Swan bar up the street, English and quaint. Live music on Friday nights. Good places, since the food in London is nothing to write home about. The front desk staff is outstanding and extremely helpful and accommodating. Kudos to them. We would stay again.

title: Citybreak
text: Excellent hotel with very friendly staff. Location approximately fifteen minutes walk along north Hyde Park to Oxford street shopping. Would recommend this boutique hotel as the room was spotless and a nice quite location.

title: awesome place : great location
text: would definitely stay here again .. excellent staff , clean spacious room, and 5 min walk to paddington station and the tube. checked in at 1300 .. refrigerator and comfy beds a bonus. only negative was that there were no washcloths haha

title: Perfect stay in the heart of London!
text: The hotel is very welcoming and has a friendly service.The rooms are a great size and are very clean with all the necessities.Just minutes walking to the train station,underground and Hyde Park!We had a great stay in London:)

title: Great Hotel
text: This is new and well renowated hotel. The room was fresh and bathroom a pleasure. In the room was capsulo coffee maker, hot water boiler, fridge with complimentary coffees and tea. We arrived very early on friday morning and left our bags there, got a ticket to for them. Staff was very helpful and polite. We loved our stay there. Hotel is short distance from Paddington station. And there are few shops close by. Hotel is also very close to Kensington Park. Just walk down the street.

title: Brilliant location, new and clean rooms, great value
text: The hotel is very new and modern, and definitely value for the money you pay. I travelled with family and we had a suite, which had one double bed, and sofa-bed that could fit two. The personnel was lovely, and provided us with everything we needed like extra duvet and such. One great plus is the kitchenette, which has everything you need for at least preparing breakfast, which we did daily. Rooms are nice size for the standards in London, the one we stayed in is more than enough for two guests and ok for three. Sofa-bed isn't the comfiest contraption but good enough for a few nights. One little nuisance was that Lancaster Gate tube station was closed the same day we arrived for the next 6 months or so, hence there was a bit of a walk to the nearest central line tube station (Queensway). This is good to consider if you travel before July 2017, which is when the station opens again. Nevertheless, the location is brilliant and the area nice and safe, which is partly why we chose this particular hotel.

title: Beautiful
text: We stayed at The Westbourne for 3 nights. Staff here are top of the line for sure. Room was extremely clean and comfortable well worth the money. We really felt like we go a great deal here. Small kitchen that was great for our breakfast before heading out for the day. Very close to Paddington Station and a very short walk to Hyde Park. I would defiantly go back to this hotel. It's in a wonderful area of town. Lots of great places to eat and visit.

title: Perfect
text: The hotel and its location is perfect and the staff is very kind. Close to everything, yet quiet and calm. The rooms are well equipped, but the most essential thing is you feel welcome which is not a given in London. Very recommendable.

title: Clean & Cosy
text: Overall sastified with the location, cleanliness and comfort of the room thou the room looks a bit bigger in the pictures. Great to have the room serviced daily however there are some minor issues. The kitchenette is useful however no dishwashing liquid or sponge to do the dishes, was available. Additionally the salt and pepper shaker was empty. The small but comfy room would have more space if one piece of furniture was removed. Currently there is a chair, table, bag rack all in the same corner. My biggest peeve was the small bathroom. Shower door opens outwards while bathroom door opens inwards. To exit the bathroom with the door opening inwards into a cramped bathroom is not the best! Otherwise a good stay!

title: Good stay
text: Stayed in the suite for 2 nights. Convenient location with a less than 5 minute walk to/from Paddington Station. Extremely hassle free if you are considering the Heathrow Express too. There are several mini marts in the vicinity. Check out Bizarro, an Italian restaurant nearby which was fabulous for our first meal in London. Bed was very comfortable although the toilet was a tad small. But most of the amenities work great. Will definitely stay again!

title: great boutique hotel in a prime location for an even better price!
text: We highly recommend the Westbourne for your travels to London. We were 2 blocks from Padington station which can get you anywhere, and 2 blocks from Kensington and Hyde Park. The staff was amazing - kind and accommodating. The hotel was really clean and new. The rooms were a little small but we made do. Didn't spend much time there.

title: Nice new clean hotel in Paddington.
text: Its fresh, its new. The rooms are a bit small, and they only have one upgrade. But thats fine, as long as its clean. The staff was polite and helpfull. I ordered a cab, but a should have just grabed one outside, since there are cabs driving through the street all the time.

title: Clean roomy at a reasonable price.
text: We stayed here after visiting Proms in the Park, so the location couldn't have been much better. The hotel staff were pleasant. The room was clean with a small kitchenette, although we did have to turn the fridge on!! A double room in the centre of London for £150, can't grumble!!!

title: Lovely place to stay
text: Excellent service and lovely hotel. The facilities were fantastic and nothing was too much trouble. The location is great- it’s very close to Hyde Park and Lancaster Gate tube station. We would definitely stay again.

title: Listened to roaring lion at dawn!
text: Birthday treat for husband after being Zoo Keepers for the day! A well organised and well thought out experience, checked in at 5.30pm to our lodge with its pretty verandah set in a small garden area with serval other lodges next to the Lion's den - very clean, cute bedroom tho the shower is very basic. We rendezvoused at 7pm, received a glass of bubbly and escorted by interesting & knowledgeable keepers around the zoo, unfortunately it was cold dark and raining that night but we still enjoyed it! Our inclusive buffet meal was very nice and we ate at a large communal table in a private room next to the Zoo restaurant. Afterwards we enjoyed another walk and went to prepare the enrichment boxes for the animals. Awoke to sounds of animals and the lion calling - we left our window open especially! Buffet breakfast in the restaurant was fab & we enjoyed another walk with interesting guides in the sunshine. Love Charlie the penguin! This is a great learning and entertaining experience & not just overnight accommodation. Highly recommend to all.

title: Amazing Birthday Treat
text: We stayed in Peacock lodge this weekend and really do need to compliment London Zoo and the keepers on a fantastic stay. The Lodge is warm, cosy and very comfortable even though you are not in it for long. The area around the lodges is lovely and really well thought out. The keepers looking after you on the stay are amazing, so friendly, helpful and knowledgeable they really made it special. We arrived early on the Saturday and spent the day in the zoo which really helped as we could take our time and see all the animals we really wanted to see. The animals you see on the tour can change and you have to be flexible but the keepers give you a really personal insight into the animals you see and it is clear to see they are much loved by the staff. The food was great and we really did not want for anything, except maybe letting visitors back into the zoo on the Sunday morning! We weren't ready to share it with them :) Thank you for a great stay.

title: Much better than expected for newly opened experience!!
text: I bought an overnight stay in the Gir Lion Lodge at London Zoo as a 'unique' birthday present for my husband. Once he'd got over the shock of thinking he was being taken to India for just two days, I think we both got quite excited (albeit a little dubious) about what was in store...but there was no need for any nerves. Although you can enter the zoo from 10am on the day of your stay, we decided to go in around 1:30pm as we were a little worried (having never been to London Zoo before) that there wouldn't be enough for us to see if we went too early on (this turned out not to be the case!) We started on the 'southern' side of the Zoo, using the tunnels to get to the other side of the road. If I'm being honest I'm glad we started here, it was mostly birds and (for us) the least interesting and least-cared for area of the whole site (better to start there and everything else was better!). It did look a little tired, but the large aviary with the sacred ibis birds and kites was interesting. Like I say, pleased we started there as everything else from there was much better, and I think I would have felt quite disappointed had we made the effort to go there part-way through the day and it was what we saw. Think it is going through a period of renovation, so hopefully that will cheer it up anyway. So, down side over with, the rest of the zoo was brilliant - if you take the time to actually look at it. We kept commenting on the fact that so many people were just walking past animals without bothering to even take two minutes to look or watch them - surely the whole point of a trip to the zoo is to watch the animals?! Taking time out in the bat house for 5-10 minutes is a must (fascinating creatures) and the butterfly house/lemur experience too - such fun!! Highlights for me were the Mangabey monkeys, the Okapis (make sure you go inside to see them when they're not outside in the enclosure!) and the Pygmy Hippos. Having taken some time to look around the zoo we went to 'check in', which you can do any time from 4:30pm.
