My room was on the second floor up a quaint staircase: the decor is dated but it seems clean enough. The room was, to say the least, small. There was a single bed and a desk, and no air-con: the window was slightly open and gave a reasonable breeze, though the road noise could be a bit irksome if you don't (as I do) sleep the sleep of the dead. The blind on the window was hefty and kept the light out nicely. There were plenty of hangers and a couple of coat-hooks. The bathroom was very small indeed, though I guess you don't spend much time in there

title: Great food, room comfortable but noisy
text: We stayed here for one night on our Anniversary as we were seeing Les Mis. The "hotel" is effectively an old pub with rooms above. The staircase to the rooms was to the side of the Lounge bar, but had it's own access from the street as well. I was slightly disappointed with the room, as the photo made it look very modern. It was a small room and they had modernised it by putting feature wallpaper on the wall behind the bed. The room was roughly 10' x 10' very clean and tidy. Bathroom was modern although the toilet made a bit of an exended noise after flushing, but not enough to make it a problem. The bed was comfortable and so were the pillows. The room did not smell and had tea and coffee making facility and an LCD tv on the wall. Noise from the corridor was slight, but noise from the road was horrendous. I could not sleep hardly at all. In their defence they do provide ear plugs!!! Seeing the ear plugs on the dressing table, you just knew it was going to be noisy! My husband slept fine as he used the ear plugs, however, I don't like them, so I didn't get much sleep. We had a meal in the pub and it was fantastic and a full english breakfast was included in the price we paid and that also was fantastic. All in all I wouldn't hesistate to stay here again if I could be guaranteed a room that did not have such bad traffic noise (we were on the side of the hotel, first floor). We paid £93 through laterooms, and felt that it was good value for London. My husband has stayed in some swanky hotels on business in London and said you would find it hard to find a hotel on a main street in London without road noise. So if you don't mind ear plugs, then you will have a faultless stay at this hotel and wonderfully cooked meals.

title: Fabulous well cooked food
text: I met a friend here for dinner. We just wanted to catch up and the pub environment was good. Not too noisy and we easily found a quiet corner to chat. We both ordered fish and chips. One of the best I've had. Great crispy batter and divine chips. Highly recommended.

title: Cheeky beer
text: Decided to have a couple of beers before heading back to Euston,was shocked how big and smart it was inside,...friendly staff and and great atmosphere,well worth a visit before heading home.... Ideally situated

title: Great hotel, great location.
text: Stayed here in early February 2018. Check in was fast and pleasant. Room was a good size and beds were comfy. Hotel is ideal for people looking to make the most out of their stay In London as it is mere metres from Waterloo train station. Staff are friendly and helpful. Main plus point for me was that the bathroom was well ventilated and didn’t turn into a sauna after a shower!! I’d highly recommend this hotel.

title: Good location, but mediocre service.
text: For the location, it's okay value - although there's not a huge amount immediately nearby. Check in was a mess. We showed up after the specified check-in time, and our room wasn't ready - we were actually check in to a room that hadn't been cleaned. Kinda gross, to say the least. They did then prioritise cleaning the room, but we were still sitting around in a pub in the early afternoon for another half an hour after a long haul flight. The girl who checked us in was nice about it, but the manager was very dismissive. I felt like our custom didn't particularly matter to them. Important FYI - there's no lift, and the staircase is very narrow. Main entrance is through the pub, except after hours where there's an on-street entrance down an alley.... On the other hand, the room was nice and smart (once cleaned!) and very modern. Comfy too, with a decent bathroom.

title: Overnight Visit
text: Lovely location right opposite the train station. The staff were really friendly and helpful. The breakfast was large and tasted good. Had a room at the top of the building so had a good workout going up and down to the room. Would stay again on our next trip to London.

title: The Place to stay
text: The hospitality in the Wellington is something you don't normally find in big cities, but here they are friendly and have so much information to help you enjoy your stay in London. The host Mark is a charismatic character and knows how to treat his guests. Highly recommend the pub food menu... steak and ale pie was my fav. Breakfast caters for all with a gluten free and great vegetarian option. If you don't stay here, you're missing out

title: The place to be
text: Visited this hotel with friends, we had a fabulous time. Mark and his staff are wonderful, nothing was too much trouble and the food was tasty, well presented and great value for money. We all loved listening to Mark's anecdotes and we were made to feel very much at home. Lots of advice on where to go and what to do! If you visit London stay here, you'll certainly not regret it. Thanks Mark for making our trip to London so good.

title: London Get Away
text: Me and my partner stayed for the weekend and would highly recommend. The staff were friendly and helpful. The breakfast had variety and was delicious. And the room was cosy and clean. Though the bathroom was quiet small and if you're tall like us it was a struggle but we had a laugh with it. If you're a light sleeper (like me) then take earplugs, the walls are slightly thin and I was able to hear people walking in and out of their rooms, as well as the trains going past.

title: Great Location
text: The location couldn't be much better, just across the road from Waterloo station and a few minutes walk to the London Eye and just a little more to Westminster. The rooms are small, but clean With free bottle of drinking water, coffee and tea making facilities, a TV set and somewhat old fashioned. We stayed 4 Nights and were not too much disturbed by the noise from the Trains. We never used the supplied ear plugs and slept well. If you travel with 2 big suitcases, it could be a slight problem to place them without blocking the access to the bed. The bathroom was clean and ok, with a shower that must be among the best I've had at any hotel, very good pressure and lots of hot water and doors that didn't let a drop of water get through to the floor. The staff was friendly and helpful and the downstairs pub/bar was nice and a good place to sink a pint of real ale on our way out or back. A full English breakfast, well prepared, was included and served in the ground floor bar. For the location, and included breakfast, we found The Wellington exellent value (for London that is) and will certainly stay there again next time.

title: A gem of a hotel
text: Stayed here now three times and on every occasion it has been very good Firstly it is very reasonably priced for a central London hotel. Secondly the rooms are always clean and in the three rooms we have stayed in the bathrooms excellent with modern power showers and really nice toiletries, big fluffy towels etc. Breakfast is freshly cooked to order and served downstairs in the bar which is always very bright and well cleaned. The Wellington Pub is a lively and friendly place in the evening and serves perfectly good food so if after a busy day in town you just fancy "staying in" for the night then its a perfect place to go! No lift and steep stairs so not ideal if you have any mobility issues. Otherwise a great place to stay!

title: A great hotel for a short stop in London
text: This hotel is perfect for a short stay I think its proximity to Waterloo would be amazingly useful for most travellers, and the quirky room decor was really bright and current. We had a concert to attend at the o2, and this was an easy trip and return late at night. The only real problems were the tiny basins in the bathroom, and the noise from the trains, but that is not surprising in such a major city.

title: Great Location
text: The rooms have been redone to a good standard there is a noise from the train station but this is expected due to the location of the hotel. The only dissatisfaction was that despite all the great work that has been done the decorative pillow on the bed had blood on it which was not acceptable and a let down to an otherwise great room

title: What a brilliant base for seeing London
text: Great place to stay. Convenient for Waterloo station and accessing London. Breakfast fantastic. Rooms are very clean and lovely decoration. Good sized ensure. Generally brilliantly. Host, Manager Mark, and his staff are very welcoming and helpful We will beback

title: Mind the gap
text: When they say this hotel is near Waterloo station, they ain't joking! Be warned, if you don't like train noise, you probably won't like it here, because it is right next to the tracks, but at the same time you CANNOT beat it for location - close to everything you could need. A very warm welcome, loved the little touches of the bottled water and earplugs in the room, bed very comfy (even if the carpet had seen better decades), facilities fine. This isn't the kind of place you'd go for a romantic getaway, or a long stay, but it does perfectly for a city break, and they quite happily store your luggage for you on the day you check out. Again, despite the train tracks, I have to say I slept very well! The breakfast was yummy and freshly cooked to order. I would stay here again.

title: Central location
text: Great stay at this central London pub. Fab location right opposite Waterloo. Fantastic full English breakfast. Friendly staff, especially pub manager Mark, who go above and beyond to make your stay enjoyable. Looking forward to next stay.

title: Great location and lovely hotel
text: I stayed at the Wellington for three nights over Christmas and enjoyed the experience. The location was ideal as I was going on a Thames cruise from Westminster Pier on Christmas Day and going to a show at The Festival Hall in Boxing Day. I was greeted by a friendly receptionist and check in was easy. There were a lot of stairs to my room but even as a 68 year old grandmother I did not find this a problem. The room was clean and comfortable. This is an historic building and the bar is absolutely beautiful with a fantastic mural. Hot breakfast is ordered

title: One night
text: Excellent hotel and well positioned, opposite the Waterloo train station. Clean and comfortable. Valerie made us feel at home and very accommodating on our requests. Excellent vibe at night with sports bar, many televisions. Excellent breakfast.

title: Perfect Central Hotel
text: What a find! You couldn't find a friendlier more helpful person than Mark, the manager. The room I stayed in was compact but had everything I needed, really comfortable bed, excellent shower and spotlessly clean. Great breakfast too. I was able to get an early check-in, extra tea bags and fresh milk for my room. I really cannot praise Mark and his staff enough. It's in such a good location for theatres, The London Eye and the Southbank Centre and right next to Waterloo station. I have no hesitation in recommending The Wellington and will definitely stay here again if I need a place to stay in town.

title: Absolute rip off
text: I have never EVER stayed somewhere like this before..... All the staff seem to not speak a fluent word of English and I found incredibly rude, no smiles or anything. I wasn't asked how our stay was on departure and I found the staff incredibly unhelpful and unapproachable. As soon as you walk into the 'hotel' part it stinks. The carpets are all stained and there's a Henry Hoover which seems to live in a corner of a hallway which could also do with being plugged in and used. The fire exit door was ajar for the whole of our stay which I felt uncomfortable with as our room was right next to it, anyone could walk up the steps and walk into the hotel. We gathered it was open to air out the damp smell throughout the place. There was mould on the walls in the bathroom and the shower absolutely reeked when I opened the door of damp mould. The cold tap wouldn't turn on. I booked a double room and got twin beds placed apart. It's never a good sign when you walk in and there's earplugs by your bedside - very noisy location. The worst of it all was the smell of our room - it absolutely stank of stale cigerettes. I assumed it was because the staff must go out the fire exit (directly next to our room) and smoke so I sprayed the room with deodrant, closed the side windows and opened another window at the front of the room to air it out. We went out for SIX hours and when we come back it smelt excatly the same. Someone must of smoked after a drunken night and the room wasn't cleaned properly. We didn't even eat the breakfast we was entitled to as I just wanted to get out the place, completly ruined our stay in London. Cannot believe the amount they charge for a room, literally unbelieve I wouldn't of paid more than £30 for that nights stay.

title: very good value
text: Excellenty customer service from staff all the way to manager Mark. Very central, clean, good breakfast. Will be my regular place to stay when visiting the city. My 19 year old grandaughter, from the USA, stayed there recently and was watched over by the staff and felt very safe.

title: Convenient location, not cheap, not luxury & quite noisy
text: Conveniently located right over from Waterloo Station so you can be in the City in ten minutes. That proximity means it's close to the train lines (very close) and you will hear them, starting from around 5am. It didn't bother me too much, but I can imagine some people would hate it. The room was described as a luxury double, and whilst nice it certainly wasn't "luxury". And not at all cheap, comparable in price with other London hotels which I'm sure would be quieter and closer to "luxury".

title: Pros and cons
text: My husband and I booked a one night stay following a party as we didn't want to rush to Waterloo for the last train home. I checked in during my lunch hour, which was pretty painless, although rather embarrassingly I had to ask the girl behind the bar to assist me up the 3 flights of stairs with my suitcase as I have a bad back and no one offered to help me. First impressions were not good. There is a dirty brown carpet and a musty smell as you proceed up the stairs. The room was small but clean with tea and coffee making facilities and a couple of packets of biscuits, which is a welcome touch, so that was fine. However, the bathroom was musty smelling which was a bit off putting as you couldn't open the window which looked out onto the train tracks. You presumably could be seen from the window by people passing on the train too! On the plus side, the bed was very comfortable and we weren't particularly troubled by train noise as we used the ear plugs and they don't seem to run between 1am to 5am. The shower was an excellent pressure and the hair dryer was decent. The cooked breakfast was excellent and you could also choose pastries, cereal and fruit which was great. Shame the OJ ran out though as when I asked if it could be refilled I was told the lady couldn't leave the bar to refil it! All in all for £95 I probably wouldn't stay here again and would return to the Ibis Blackfriars even though the price has risen. However, for tourists who are on a budget it is in an excellent location opposite Waterloo and just a ten minute walk over the bridge to the heart of Theatreland and a few more minutes to Covent Garden, so the location is excellent and it shouldn't be discounted. If the carpets are replaced that may make a big difference.

title: Ok, but not worth the price.
text: I stayed there for two nights. The location is great. The room is clean. If you have the window open you'll hear the sounds of the city. So if you are a light sleeper, I wouldn't recommend this hotel. WiFi is not fast but OK for browsing a few pages, not when you need to do your work. The breakfast is OK, they have a few warm dishes like eggs, English breakfast and pancakes. But I must confess, I expect more of a hotel which charge 143 pound a night.

title: Nice hotel shame so close to the railway line
text: I booked the Wellington as it was next door to where I was attending a course, and was so close to Waterloo Station. I was impressed by the rooms, although small they were modern, clean, had a comfy bed, good shower and TV. The bar was busy, it had a nice feel and reasonably priced drinks, food looked good but didn't eat there. Breakfast was good and the waitress provided a friendly efficient service. All the staff I had contact with were friendly. My only qualm was that the room was so close to the train tracks I was wakened by the trains from 5am, not the hotels fault though. I'd recommend if you stop you take a pair of ear plugs (or maybe the hotel could supply FOC?) I'd recommend the hotel, and would probably stop there again if I was in the area

title: Just about ok
text: The hotel was in a good location for us which is why we booked it. It was not overly cheap. It was above a pub and we had to climb a lot of stairs to get to our room as there is no lift. The room was quite small but neatly decorated with a new bathroom. My bed was quite uncomfortable and seemed to slant off on one side. The breakfast was good if somewhat slow arriving. The staff were friendly. The room was sort of half cleaned after our first night with the beds not made properly and tea and coffee not replenished plus the toilet not cleaned. All in all a bit too much money for the quality offered.

title: Excellent hotel, nice, clean, and in a superb location
text: The hotel is just outside Waterloo station, which makes its location perfect for business or sightseeing. The bar downstairs is also lovely, always full, but soundproof with respect to the rooms, where nothing could be heard. The single room was really nice, clean, big, comfortable... even if the price paid is quite low with respect to other Hotels in the city centre The only drawback is that there's no lift. It wasn't a problem for me with a small trolley, but with a heavy suitcase it can be challenging.

title: A gem
text: We booked this hotel because of it being central and close to Waterloo Station. I didn't expect much but was pleasantly surprised. The pub is definitely traditional and very well kept. If you're looking for peace and quiet, this is not your place because the pub is open to the public and close to a main road but it was very enjoyable. The staff was friendly and helpful and room very modern. The bathroom in particular was extremely modern and sexy.

title: great little place near waterloo station and in walking distance to the theatre district
text: ideal place to stay if you are going to watch a show in aldwich theatre area ( just a stroll over the bridge ) it is really a pub you are staying in with friendly owners and clean rooms.....and good food... the breakfast was superb and price was probably one of the cheapest in this area ( 99 pound for a saturday night )... location is right across the road from waterloo station -couldnt be better..... TIP -it has its own website for booking which is cheaper than all the others !! we shopped around the area to find something cheaper but could not !!! hope this review helps...

title: Nice place for a quiet pint and a read of the newspaper
text: Popped in on my way home via Waterloo. This is a really deceptive pub, the outside looks ordinary but the inside is quite spectacular. Really nice décor inside, plenty of seating with two sizeable bars. Managed to order a lager and read the paper without any noisy TVs or music. Quite a find, definitely will return.

title: Excellent service for our party of 30+
text: A few weeks ago I arranged with The Wellington (Pub bit) to have an area reserved for a party of 25/30 people for the evening of the 27th January, which they were absolutely happy to do. I arrived half an hour early to find lots of people in the designated area but notices on each of the tables stating that the area was reserved from 6pm. At around 6pm Roger came across and asked the few remaining people to move to another area of the pub which everyone did without question and he then moved tables to the edge so we had a nice area of floor space for people to mingle. I had about 30 people coming and going throughout the evening, some eating, some just drinking. People were served quickly, the food was quick to arrive and was of a good quality and well priced. We all had an amazing evening made all the better by the level of service we received. I have also been to the pub with a couple of friends on a few occasions before and always had good service. It is such a handy place to meet being just outside Waterloo tube station entrance. I would recommend to anyone who wants well priced food in an easy to find location. Well done everyone.

title: Great stay.
text: My friend and I stayed at Wellington for 3 nights and had a wonderful time! First of all, the location couldn't be better. As you exit Waterloo station you come across Wellington just in front of you! You can easily get to many places on foot as well, so it's probably one of the best locations we've found so far Our room was in third floor (27), the stairs are a bit narrow but it was no problem at all. The room was calm and quiet, except for the creaky noises from early trains in the morning, but far from unbearable unless you really have trouble with sleeping. Room in itself was impeccable: new and modern decorated, clean and comfy. LOVE the bathroom!! Breakfast menu was very good and complete, and the staff was very lovely to us. Had a couple issues with our keycards which they promptly fixed. So all in all, I'd totally recommend this hotel for any travellers to London! If we do come back again, we'll certainly stay at Wellington!

title: Good place for a drink
text: The pub has lots of outside seating, is very close to Waterloo Station and is a hub of activity. We stopped for a couple of drinks after seeing a show on our way back to the station. Staff were excellent and the place was buzzing. Well worth a stop. I cannot give information on rooms or food as we only stopped for drinks.

title: Good pub for a drink
text: Good pub for a drink near Southbank, only around 10 minutes from Waterloo station. Its a small pub but there is an outside area. A variety of beers on tap. Service was good and prices were as expected.

title: A mixed bag at The Wellington
text: So....here's the breakdown: + Location - right across the street from Waterloo Station

title: Shower poor, staff members non existent, unable to get to the car park after check out
text: The shower was horrendous and was all i can describe as a dribble. I saw one staff member in the whole 48 hours i was there. Was locked in to the hotel after checkout due to checking out and not being able to access it due to checking out and returning my keycard to the front desk

title: Business Trip
text: Had a few locations to get to around South London this week and found this hotel an ideal central point. The hotel and room I had (-1) was very clean and pleasant, the restaurant is small with no bar but has plenty of choice and a great bunch of staff to look after you, thank you to Cheila, Alma and Elaine (and the chefs) for the excellent service they provided, from check in to service within the restaurant, and guiding guests to the local area. The food ( and service) was excellent, have stayed at a number of hotels in London in the last 5 years and found this one to be one of the best. Great to be able to park my car, and leave it in a secure car park at the hotel, overall an excellent experience, with plenty of easy access to public transport.

title: Easy commute to city centre.
text: Up there with previous stays at Premier Inn locations. Would definitely book again. Unfortunate issue with room temperature/air con on this occasion (didnt report), but did not dampen our overall thoughts on the quality of our stay.

title: Great Stay
text: We stayed here on a weekend in the city. To start its a fair bit from the main tourist areas, but thats what we wanted. Its a fair track from the Underground, we made the mistake of getting off at Stockwell, Clapham Common is the one - and its about 15 mins walk from there - nice walk mind!! Room was lovely, not an old hotel by any means. Hotel facilities looked nice but we didn't use any of them. Only disappointing thing was that we wanted a beer just at midnight - bar shut even though the bar man was there. Great stay, would definitely reccomend

title: Ideal location for SW4 festival
text: Rates were really good, rooms clean and tidy, hotel is still new and fresh, breakfast had a good selection, but best of all the staff were friendly and always happy to help whether its extra towel, pillows or a jug of ice, nothing was too much trouble. This hotel had everything we needed, comfy bed, air con, tea and coffee, tv, plenty of power points to charge phones etc. Location was ideal with local shops just 1 minute walk away handy to buy drinks etc and Clapham Common 10 minute walk away. Would happily stay here again.

title: Very pleasant stay
text: Very good location, great for transport in to London. Quiet....really, really quiet. Best nights sleep I can remember. The quality of food could be improved. The staff are very attentive and helpful. Would stay again.

title: Clapham Common family meet up
text: Stay at this modern, friendly, clean facility with excellent transport connections to all areas. Clapham Common is within walking distance with a friendly village feel and some great eateries with a varied selection.

title: A good choice
text: Our family of 3 stayed in a family room for 4 nights and used this hotel as our base for seeing London. The location might not suit some tourists as there is no tube stop nearby, but we used the buses (eg 87 towards Waterloo or 345 to South Kensington) to get to places like the London Eye (c. 30 minutes) or the Natural History Museum (c. 35 minutes). Right next to the hotel is a Local Sainsbury's with a Tesco Express opposite. We bought things for breakfast there to save money. There are a few restaurants nearby, but to eat out we took the bus to either Clapham Common or Battersea (both 5-10 minutes away). The room was very clean with great beds and a nice bathroom. There was no fridge. The air con was controlled centrally and was a bit cold for us, but the staff changed the settings so we could adjust it manually. Our room (19) overlooked a walled garden and was really quiet. The staff were great! I spoke to a number of different staff members for information on buses, taxis and local information and they were all helpful and friendly. I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting London who is comfortable getting around on buses or is happy to use taxis (NB it costs 15UKP to get to Victoria and 40UKP to get to Heathrow by taxi). Tourists unfamiliar with London may be better off paying more to stay somewhere more central.

title: Comfortable, clean and lovely staff
text: The hotel room was very clean and comfortable as is usual with Premier Inn, and the staff were very nice and helpful. The bar restaurant area is quite small and the location is not that easy to get to from central London.

title: Affordable and well connected London stay.
text: A very nice hotel if you plan to tour London without blowing a hole in your pocket for stay. Though the tube station is a little far, bus connections are from the hotel doorsteps. Bus 87 connects to central London.

title: Special break
text: Stayed here last week. A fair walk from underground station on Clapham Common. Clean room, flat pillows. On arrival greeted by 2 female staff very helpful after that saw no one. Reception always unmanned no one to ask for a pillow or extra milk. Restaurant poor ate there once. Did have a drink in what they call the bar just seats in restaurant difficult again to find staff. Good bus service to Waterloo and Kensington.

title: Great hotel
text: We stayed here in March for a christening check in was easy and our room was floor 4 the windows are frosted but that didn’t bother us the room was clean and quiet. The hotel is easy reach from Clapham Common tube stop(10 min walk) and has many shops and food places around so if you forget anything Tesco and sainsbury are a stones throw away. Breakfast was good and the staff very friendly as our friends live close by we will definitely be back.

title: london show and stay over
text: we arrived about 8ish aftet seeing a london show, check in was easy and fast, young girl on reception was very friendly and chatty (Zoe I think) she was runny around doing most of the work whilst no other staff was about. dinner was ok, could do with a lil more options. slept great! rooms clean and quiet. breakfast was lovely! but still not better than bar and block(b ham) would stay again.

title: Enjoyable and Comfortable
text: This is a new hotel and has only been open for a few of months. The rooms are large with plenty of space. There is a work desk and adequate hanging space. The beds are comfortable. The general fitout is "standard" Premier Inns. The shortcomings are lack of a bagstand and small fridge. The location in Wandsworth Rd near the corner of Queenstown Rd is a heavy traffic one. None of this noise entered the room. It is a long walk from Clapham Junction station and nearly as far to Clapham Common Tube station. Both are easily accessed by frequent bus services, even on a Sunday morning. The breakfast is comprehensive and good value. The evening meal service is "fair average quality" PUB FOOD masquerading as something better. Better value can be found elsewhere.

title: Comfortable hotel, easy access to central London
text: We stayed at the Clapham Premier Inn because of the price. The bed was (as they always are at Premier Inn) very comfortable, there are good blackout curtains, the temperature controls were good (once we got used to them), and it was quiet. We were able to get into the city easily on bus 87 to the Clapham Junction Train station and then by train (6 minutes) to Victoria Station. Bus service was also good (although long) between center city and the hotel. The rooms were immaculate and the staff was helpful. We stayed here four nights and would stay here again. While there are not a lot of amenities, we had all we needed, and we couldn't have found a better value.

title: Great Stay
text: We stayed here as we were going to the Madness concert at Clapham Common. It was the first time we had been to a Premier Inn with no staff at reception, but it was easy to follow the automated check in process and the fact that the lifts would not work without the room card made it feel secure. The room was spotless and there was never any noise from other rooms. The restaurant was busy at breakfast, but the staff were very friendly and efficient. The hotel is very reasonably priced. We had a great stay and I would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Great hotel
text: Hotel was in a lovely location we travelled from Swansea by train into Paddington got on the underground to Clapham Common then bus 137 took us to the street corner of our hotel was great. Near Clapham Common had a lovely stroll there. The hotel, staff, rooms, breakfast were all excellent and paid a good price for a 3 night stay with breakfast. Would definately stay again

title: Good hotel in good location.
text: Good hotel in good location. Average price for a hotel in this area. Good sized, clean comfortable rooms. Clapham Common tube station is a 10-15 minute walk. Hotel staff helpful and friendly. 10 minute walk to local restaurants and bars.

title: A quiet and comfortable new hotel
text: A new hotel on a dependable and frequent bus route close to the south circular as the hotel does not have parking on-site. Despite this possible disadvantage the rooms, furniture and of course the beds extremely comfortable. The hotel was clean and up to the standards that you always get from Premier Inn accommodation.

title: Great stay.
text: The staff were all lovely and helpful. The hotel was very clean. We had a drink and a bar snack which were all good and reasonably priced. This was a great hotel for the start of the London to Brighton cycle.

title: lovely stay
text: very close to London (but a long walk to the tube station) but a lovely area. clean bedding and towels. cozy bed. good shower. very reasonable cost. staff were exceptionally friendly throughout, (especially the lady at check-in) food was also good, good value and served by great staff. happy to recommend. a little warm in the room but considering the weather outside, it was bearable.

title: Premier Inn London Clapham
text: Convenient location. Clean hotel and room. Helpful and friendly staff. 5 minute taxi ride from Clapham Common Underground station. Room was a bit warm but I did not try to adjust the air conditioning (there were no instructions).

title: Good choice for famillies
text: I was visiting London with my family (2 toddlers) and this hotel was a fantastic choice. The staff is very nice, the rooms are very comfortable and clean, good breakfast. The subway is not far but there are a lot of bus next to the hotel that can take you efficiently to almost all city attractions.

title: Family visit for family christening
text: Rooms and overall service very good, our major complaint was two of the rooms needed cots for 6 and 4 month old babies we thought the ones provided were below standard expected, very shaky and awful mattress if that’s what they where, very hard felt like planks of wood covered in cotton cover, unable to let babies sleep on them, these need replacing, hope they are before we return in May.

title: Nice stay
text: 2nd time here, lovely clean hotel in central location, nice clean room, only downside was the room and hotel was quite hot could do with turning the hot air system down a bit, had meal deal breakfast was nice evening meal was lovely

title: We would stay here again
text: Stayed for 5 nights and would stay here again. The most important thing aspect of hotels for us is a comfortable bed, blockout curtains and a hot shower. This hotel had all of this including a bath which was a nice addition. The only thing that was missing was a room safe, which would have been handy. The breakfast cooked by Tony the chef was generally outstanding. When observing breakfast room staff it is obvious that there is an "A" team and a "B" team. The connections to Clapham Common station are numerous and the proximity of Sainsburys and Tesco within about 50metres is excellent. We often grabbed a sandwich for our day out, a cheap and reliable lunch! We highly recommend this place.

title: Excellent comfortable and convenient stay
text: My husband and I enjoyed our stay at Premier Inn Clapham . We were very happy with the room, bed and breakfast. The service was as usual excellent . This is my third or fourth stay at this Premier Inn and my daughter has also stayed with her children this year.

title: Clean and Calm
text: Clean and Calm, and nice members team. I recommand this hotel. Good value for money. Very good sleep quality. Clapham is a good and familiar aera. Bus close to the hotel. Park and metro also close (clapham common station)

title: A really nice hotel
text: Clean, comfortable, great staff. A really nice room with everything needed. A bit out of the way, but right on a bus route. Breakfast was excellent too! Nothing to complain about at all and I would recommend it to anyone for a budget stay in London.

title: Just a quick one night stop.
text: We only stayed here for the one night but I was majoy impressed with my room! It was modern with a large double bed and a little couch/ bed on the side. Lighting was perfect and plugs within reachable places to the bed. Good quality amenities and the a hair dryer that worked! We didnt get to sample breakfast because we had to leave so early but could smell it cooking! Wish we could have had some!

title: Premier Inn Clapham Amazing
text: Staff were so friendly and helpful.So nice to meet such nice natural people who actually do care! The room was great.But it was the staff who made it.I was travelling on my own for the most part of my stay and they took the time to talk to me and were very helpful.

title: Dreadful stay
text: Me and my boyfriend stayed in the premier in on the 3rd for one night and was awful. Our bath was filled with black pubic hair, cups had stains in there, air con wouldn’t work and our room was so warm it was making the windows steam up. No tea bags or coffee sachets were in our room. But the strangest thing to happen to us was both of us said in the morning that we saw a man in our room?? Staff at reception was rude and wouldn’t tell us if we’d paid for breakfast and was rude anencephaly ignored us when we left. Overall disappointed and wouldn’t stay in this hotel again.

title: Good, could be better
text: New hotel convenient to where we were going but we had some issues. First, twin room turned out to be a small single bed and a large double, not what we wanted or expected. We were told this is PI policy and stated on the website, if so I can't see where. Second, windows don't open, more PI policy but I hate that and hate having to use AC to regulate temperature. Third, duvet was far too heavy, even with AC on cool, need lighter for summer. Breakfast looked great value at £10.50 for apparently unlimited hot food or £7.95 for unlimited continental, but all we wanted was a coffee and croissant so this was no use to us, forced us out to the (very nice) café round the corner.Apart from that, nice clean room, comfortable bed, pleasant stay, great at the price we got (£62) but would think twice at the more usual price points. Summary: could be better.

title: Very good value for money in a reasonable situation
text: Clean, confortable, and very good attention. Very simple but nothing missing. And the situation is reasonable as is connected by bus with most of the relevant places in London. A very good alternativa for a short stay in London

title: Great stay at Premier Inn Clapham
text: Had a great long weekend in London visiting family In Clapham. Location was good, tube about a 15-20 minute walk away, on main bus route too. Rooms were very clean and modern, breakfast was good with a choice that suited our tastes, staff were very pleasant and helpful, will stay again.

title: Visit Clapham
text: Overnight stay in Clapham made so much easier by welcoming hotel and staff. Taxis available Asap Food okay (breakfast) did not savour evening food so not able to comment .Site easily accessible .A good weekend away .

title: Excellent stay in London
text: Nice and clean hotel which is in a convenient location. Comfortable beds, perfect sleep... It is really close to bus station. App. 15 mins bus to touristic places. You should try Premier Inn Breakfast. Highly recommend this stay...

title: Great hotel with a great location
text: Fantastic hotel in a really good location a walk to Clapham common tube. (10 min) or plenty of buses just down the rd. Really clean room with lovely staff. Brrakfast was brill especially as kids eat free. We will return!

title: Lovely family friendly hotel
text: We stayed here with two young children. The room had a double bed and two single beds and was spotlessly clean. We drove to the hotel and parked in their carpark which cost £10 a night. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. We used the buses to get around as the bus stop was right outside the hotel whereas the station was a 10-15 walk. The number 87 bus takes you into Trafalger Square and the number 77 bus takes you to County Hall (London Eye area). The buses came every 5-10 minutes and only cost £1.50 each way (children under 16 free). Would definitely stay here again.

title: Good trip to london
text: Location in south london. Easy to get to centre buy bus, or to clapham common underground station by bus. Hotel - Very good experience. Room and bed comfortable apart from room feeling warm when i'd set air conditioning at lowest setting. Staff polite and pleasant. Gave advice on how to get around and see the sights. Helped when I wanted to change room and change pre booked meal deal options. Only issue was one of our meals at dinner was delivered when others were half way through the meal. Also there was no draft beer only bottles. Overall good value for money for a Hotel in London as i booked well in advance

title: very good price for familly with 2 children
text: great price for a stay for 2 adults and 2 small children (under 7 years), beds are very comfortable, rooms very quiet, I would definitely stay there again visiting London. Distance to museums/centre of London not more than 40minutes by metro/bus

title: Exam Trip
text: We stayed in this hotel as we where sitting exams nearby so the location was perfect as it was within walking distance. We were really surprised at how nice the hotel was and the staff were amazing. Really friendly, helpful and efficient. The rooms were spacious, clean and more importantly the bathrooms were modern and spotless. Would definitely recommend this hotel.

title: Terrible organisation
text: We stayed at the Premier Inn Clapham for my daughters graduation. We booked two family rooms. When we arrived at the hotel at 2pm the machine to register the cards was not working so we could not access our rooms until the evening. On top of this, when we finally did get into our rooms at gone 10pm we found that they had not been made up. Only bedding was supplied for the double bed but the 2 other beds and bedding for each room had not been supplied. After going back to reception, we were given bedding to set the beds up ourselves which was actually infact dirty. On top of this, the air conditioning was control centrally and we couldn't turn this off. It was set to 19 degrees which was extremeley cold and uncomfortable especially for my mother (who is in her 80's). On top of this the control for the TV did not work and we also had one towel per room (so one between 4 of us). We will not stay here again.

title: Great staff
text: Excellent staff and quality of accommodationThe chef was overworked but performed really well and the food was goodthe waiting staff and manager were attentiveThe room was a bit too warmBut generally an excellent stay

title: Great value for money. Clean, quiet and comfortable. Excellent breakfast choices.
text: Stayed here on visit to London for concert at Brixton Academy. Great location. Room on ground floor as suggested by staff was very quiet. Comfortable and great room size. All rooms in this hotel have a bath. Great breakfast choices. Staff at this hotel were excellent and very helpful. Especially young guy serving at breakfast. Great customer rapport. Cannot fault, but a few more teabags and milk in room would be good.

title: Clean hotel, good facilities, over-priced breakfast and rude staff
text: Booked an evening for me and my partner just to get away a bit and enjoy a change of scenery. I had checked in before my partner, but made sure that reception had his name for when he would check in and collect his key card. However, when he arrived he was interrogated as to what his business was trying to enter the hotel. Frankly, the staff member who was at reception treated him very rudely - not the way you'd expect a paying customer to be treated by someone in the hospitality industry.

title: Great new Premier Inn
text: I checked-in online prior to arrival but collecting our key from the machine at the front desk was easy and quick. The lady at the front desk was very helpful and friendly and wished us a good stay. The location was ideal for our stay and it is also located near a small Sainsbury's and Tesco as well as restaurants so it is easy to find somewhere to eat. (It is very quiet inside) It also has good transport links to the nearest stations of Clapham Junction and Battersea Park which are a short bus ride away from a nearish bus stop. The room was clean, spacious and quiet. At night it was very dark and quiet for being in the city, which made for a good night's sleep. The only very slight criticism is the temperature of the room which was pretty warm and the air-con was fairly weak. That being said if we'd left it on while we were out it would probably have cooled the room sufficiently. This is a very small critique as everything else during our stay was excellent.

title: High Quality Premier Inn
text: Very easy check in. Staff were polite and very helpful. The hotel is relatively new and it has modern, clean rooms. The hotel was very quiet and I had the best night's sleep for a long time - usually I sleep very poorly. Car parking under the hotel was very convenient and secure.

title: Create for Brixton gigs
text: Stayed with friends for a concert at Brixton Acadamy by the mighty Shed Seven. Clean rooms, good rates, lovely fresh breakfast and a short taxi ride into the main bars or Brixton. Special mention to front of house Cheila, a lovely smile to greet you at all times.

title: Nice hotel
text: I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. It is very new, so everything was very clean and fresh. The room was a nice size, with really comfy bed and was very quiet. Everything worked well and the staff were friendly. There aren't many shops or restaurants in the vicinity, but there is a Sainsburys Local next door and a Tescos Extra across the street which are handy. There is no tube stop nearby, but the 87 bus stops directly outside and this takes you into Whitehall and Trafalgar Square, via Vauxhall, in about 30 minutes. So if you're after somewhere that's in the heart of the action this may not be for you, but if you're after good quality accommodation near the centre then this is a great option.

title: Consistently very good
text: I stay here quite regularly for business and it's always very good. The rooms are well thought through and everything you might need is there. The staff change quite often but they are always friendly and helpful.

title: Great hotel and staff
text: I stayed here for one night as I had an appointment at the US embassy which is a quick bus ride to from the hotel. I arrived early from a flight and although I couldn’t check in the staff held my bags for me whilst I went for a walk of the local area. There are shops, restaurants and coffee shops all within a short distance to the hotel. There is limited parking at this hotel, I’d advise you to call and book parking if you are driving. I caught a bus from Vauxhall tube station, it was less than 10mins and there are plenty of buses that take you past the hotel. My room was on the 4th (top) floor and I had views of the shard and the London eye, super clean room, it almost looked new, air con was great and much needed in the summer heat. I ate at the hotel on the evening and the food and service was great, breakfast the next day was also great and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. When I went to the embassy I left my bag again with a very helpful member of staff (Manager?) She was very polite and as with all the staff a credit to the hotel. I would recommend this hotel, it’s not to big so there was no noise at all during my time there, food great, staff excellent. Thank you for making my stay a great one.

title: Nice hotel
text: Lovely hotel, service slow at times not many staff about Good location bus to Clapham Common just around the corner Would stay again. It was silent in the hotel never heard any noise during the night. Good nights sleep Tesco and Sainsbury's just over the road Breakfast was nice

title: A very convenient hotel to stay
text: A very convenient hotel when you need to stay in this area of London. Very good Quality/Price ratio. People very kind. Very well connected with the center of London and a very quiet area. A very good breakfast.

title: Lovely family friendly hotel with fantastic service
text: We stayed here on our way to the Olympia Horse Show. The hotel was immaculate and comfortable. The restaurant service from Zoe was brilliant, nothing was too much trouble and she made everyone feel welcomed. Brilliant again Premier Inn!

title: Suprsingly great
text: New hotel in immaculate condition. Great quality of room and bed. Staff really helpful and ensured we got dinner even though kitchen was closing. Car park directly beneath hotel. Better than many 5 start hotels I've been to.

title: Idea location
text: Lovely hotel, always clean. I stay here alot for work. Bus runs frequently outside. Does have a parking lot underneath for £10 a day, but not many spaces. Sainsbury and Tesco are literally a stone's throw away for snacks etc and pizza hut just a 5 min walk away. Beds are comfortable and has air con

title: Stay in London
text: Excellent value for money and room very clean and comfortable bed. The location was very close to Tesco and Sainsbury’s express and nice coffee shopsBrilliant bus routes to get into central London Will book again for next visit in June

title: Excellent
text: Stayed here the 3rd Jan till the 12th and was a great hotel and a very fair price. Very Close to London and also clapham town is a sort walk away. The staff in this hotel is extremely attentive and always smile and sat hello the rooms are so comfy and the beds are amazing will come back soon.

title: Excellent place to stay in London
text: The perfect place to stay in London. Always a great standard and rooms are great , large and also a comfortable bed . WillAlways stay her while in London as it’s a nice location and Clapham has the common to stroll around after a busy time in the London. Highly recommend it .

title: Shaneace
text: The rooms were really tidy and had everything we needed, my only thing to say would be the price of the breakfast. Also the parking facility was very good and easy to access. I would recommend this hotel.

title: Christmas Stay
text: Used the Premier Inn as extra beds for relatives at Christmas. Check in was really easy and efficient. Particularly impressed with the security arrangements. Needed card to access any areas of the hotel after reception. Made female relative feel very secure.Rooms were very comfortable. They were clean and fresh.We did not eat at the Inn. BUt the restaurant looks inviting.

title: New year stay
text: Stayed here as we were going to Battersea Park for New year and it was close by, buses to central London close by a ten minute walk to Clapham Common high street, some parking is available. Good breakfast.

title: new addition in Clapham
text: modern, well equipped and comfortable hotel. short walk to the tube.so easy to get into Central London for sightseeing. friendly and helpful staff. Close to restaurants and shops in Clapham. Good soundproofing. No traffic noise

title: Great hotel, fantastic , helpfull friendly staff. Highly recommend, would definitely stay again.
text: Great stay. A short enjoyable bus ride into London was very easy, either long way round from outside hotel to Tate, Trafalger and Westminster along the river, or a shorter, straight route to Hyde park via Slone Square and Knitsbridge from a stop just round the corner from hotel. You really dont need to bother with underground, you see far more on the bus anyway and at 1.50 a trip it's an excellent way to see the sights. Hotel staff were wonderful, the young man with dreadlocks who helped us to store our bags to the lady on night duty who made us a cup of tea as we waited for our very late and long 7 hour coach journey home at midnight. Staff are a credit to this Premier inn and we would highly recommend this hotel for anyone staying in London.

title: nice and friendly
text: still a pretty new hotel, Everything was nice its a ways away from the inner city but the bus stop is right around the corner and takes you to the train to get to the inner city, The walk from the train station to the hotel if you want to walk around to see everything is a 16 min walk. the rooms are clean the bedding is comfy shower is good, no phone, microwave, or fridge in room but I didn't need it really. The breakfast is really good the restaurant is ok had a few issues but was accommodated for it which was very nice. The staff was always helpful with getting around the city or making sure we were ok. The night manager was extremely pleasant I wish I would have gotten her name but I do remember her tag saying Queen Bee and we had a laugh about it. I would stay here again the prices were great and so were the staff and rooms

title: clapham premier stay
text: The location is a walk from aClapham Common tube and an Uber charged about £16 from Kings cross station. Check in was a bit frought but the people were really friendly and helpful. I asked for and got extra pillows and towels. Breakfast was excellent. We will be back. I am always a poor sleeper at a hotel so no fault of premier inn’s

title: Awful check in experience
text: Stayed here Monday 28th august to attend a gig at Clapham Common. Checked in online as I was informed on the email it would save time on arrival. We arrived at 2:15pm and the self service machines were not recognising the details so stood in a long queue for 40 minutes. Missing some of the gig we were attending. The one member of staff on the desk was very unhelpful and didn't seem to know what she was doing. There were no rooms available even tho I'd already paid in advance and triple the rate. Also was woken 3 times in the morning by maids banging on the door and talking very loudly in the room next door. Felt like they wanted us out as soon as possible so they could clean for the next guests even tho it was only 9am. Not what we expected for £149 a night!!

title: Excellent budget option
text: Great hotel nicely designed and the rooms are super modern with air conditioning and large flat screen TVs. The location is on bus routes but I used taxis to get around which was easy and inexpensive. There's a Tesco express across the street which is useful for meal deals etc... I liked this hotel and would return for business in the area. For purely visiting central London I would seek a different option.

title: Great value, great staff, great room
text: I've stayed at the Premier Clapham a number of times. The rooms are always clean and comfortable. The staff are excellent (as they are in all Premiers I've stayed in). The hotel is in a good location, asy to catch buses from right outside, good connection to Tube and main rail

title: Another good visit, but anyone with mobility problems be aware of the long distances to the accessible rooms
text: This is the 2nd time I have stayed in this hotel and I really like it. I arrived on Friday evening and as I use a mobility scooter the staff were very helpful in taking some of my things up to my room. It is a long way to the accessible rooms with 4 doors between the room and reception, but the room itself is nice, fairly light and has openable windows-yay! This time the room I stayed in was overlooking the Thames and as it was a nice weekend weather-wise it was a pleasant view and felt very cheerful. I also had a wet room which is essential for me, and it was perfectly adequate. I had dinner on the 1st night: the starter I had was smoked salmon and avocado with rocket and ciabatta bread-really delicious. Then I went for salmon again and had salmon fillet with green veg, skin-on potatoes and Bearnaise sauce, which was delicious but the sauce was nothing like I was expecting and was more runny and buttery rather than the thick Bearnaise sauce you normally get. I then had the mini dessert, cheesecake with a decaf tea. Altogether a delicious meal and as I had gone for the meal deal it was only £2 extra for the 3 courses! Brilliant! Breakfast was a nice selection of cooked items: the scrambled egg tasted really fresh, not rubbery like it can be sometimes when left standing for too long, and the bacon was lovely. Not a huge selection of cereals but ok, and either toast or croissants, as well as crumpets and other delights! There may have been fruit salad as well but I was late to breakfast! My only criticism of the hotel as I have said before in a review is that it is a very long way with 4 doors to reception, and if you are a solo traveller in a wheelchair or on a scooter it is awkward with the doors, but if you are someone who is still able to walk but only short distances: you may find it is too far-I would have done without my scooter. It would be very nice if all hotels could manage to adapt the layout to put the accessible rooms as close to the lift as possible, but I realise that is simply not possible in the older hotels. Well done Premier Inn yet again: you made me feel very welcome and I enjoyed my stay very much with the friendly and helpful staff! The picture is the view from my room at night!

title: Highly Recommended
text: This is a band new hotel near Clapham Common. My friend & I took a twin room for 3 nights as we were doing the London Moonwalk. The room was clean, comfortable with all expected amenities including good wi-fi. You can do an automatic check-in on-line if you are into such things but there is always a member of staff about with a friendly smile and helpful information. Breakfast is a good choice of full or continental and better than I have had in previous hotels I. This chain. It was also quiet and felt secure. You need a key card for the lift and door to get in your corridor. The transport links are good. Northern line to Clapham Common tube and 137 bus to hotel. This bus will also take you all the way to Oxford Street. It is a nice area and we went to a great Italian restaurant nearby. Wished we'd had more time to explore the area but we did walk 26.2 miles on through central London on the Saturday night! I will use this hotel again and not bother with a more central location.

title: London trip
text: The site was in a location we needed. The rooms were clean and comfortable. Great hot water and pressure in the shower. Large selection at breakfast however one or two items were a little over cooked fpr my taist. The staff were happy and helpful.

title: Premier Inn Clapham
text: The entrance area, corridors and bedroom were very clean

title: Great staff, good location in Clapham
text: Cant fault this Premier Inn, the staff were fantastic, very bubbly and helped us sort out a minor issue. Breakfast was as expected from a Premier Inn, good selection and good quality. I nicer hotel to other Premier Inns in London.

title: Lovely little premier inn
text: I booked a 3 night stay here with my family so we could go and see the sights. On arrival it wasn't what we expected but never judge a book by its cover! Inside was modern, clean and lovely. We were greated by a lovely lady called Elaine, she was very friendly and helpful. Our room faced the main street but you would have never known, we couldn't hear a thing! It was perfectly situated for travelling into London, 2 bus stops outside, a 10 min walk to Clapham common tube station and 25 mins from the train station at the junction (would recommend jumping on a bus with your luggage). We travelled everyday from the hotel into London with ease. My children haven't stayed in many hotels and really enjoyed the buffet breakfast which is free for kids, my self and my husband thought the breakfast was lovely too. We did have evening meal in the hotel aswell and that was lovely, the curry is nice, the steak was cooked to perfection and the pizzas are all hand made. It was just a lovely place to stay and will hopefully be back next year.

title: Great for the Price
text: Easily accessible from pubic transport this hotel is well work the savings. By far the best asset this hotel has is its staff. Very friendly, sociable and willing to help. Unfortunately they still have the new paint smell lingering and can be a tad unpleasant, especially as there is not opening in our window. Breakfast was decent standard We were issued with a disabled room with extra space which was nice however the shower was a wet room and no ideal after a long day when a long shower was needed Would defiantly return for the price

title: a tripmember
text: i hope the air-condition has not the noise. i first to live in the premia inn,i like the hotel but the breakfiest is more expensive.it was a good stay for me .the bus station is near the hotel,and there is 2 local supermarket.there is convenniene,the stay was comfortable.

title: Does what it says on the tin!
text: Whilst not a luxurious hotel it was ideal for our stay 'south of the river' in London. The staff were exceptionally helpful, beds comfortable and provision of disability facilities very good. We will stay there again

title: Pleasant Stay
text: Nice and clean hotel. Good size room and bathroom. Bed comfy. No outside noise. Had dinner in restaurant was fine. Didn't wake up in time for breakfast(!) Hotel is excellent value for money. Definitely recommend.

title: Great stay
text: As always premier inn do exactly what it says on the tin. A great stay at a good price. Good location for clapham, helpful staff with a tesco and sainsbury express within metres of the hotel. Even left our bags for the day to avoid carrying them around all day at no extra cost

title: Forget the Ritz and the Grosvenor House, stay at the Premier Inn in Clapham.
text: Absolutely fantastic genuinely friendly service from the complete team of staff, excellent quality and range of breakfast, served with a smile. And make sure you take advantage of the drink at reception on arrival. If you have questions, ask a member of staff. They will go out their way to make sure you get what you want and do so with a friendly smile. Pleasure to stay here

title: Convenient stay
text: Stayed overnight. Convenient for the city. Tube and buses right on the doorstep. Although we used taxis. Comfortable room. Although a bit stuffy. (Windows don't open) Breakfast was the usual PI standard. Staff were lovely. Handy Sainsbury's and Tescos just round the corner. The only thing that I'd count against not just this PI but P.Inns in general is the introduction of automated, receptionist-less check-ins. They're just so impersonal. At the end of a long journey I want to checkin by talking to a real live person. Not an automated touch screen.

title: Excellent location in Clapham
text: We were visiting our son who lives in Clapham and the location of this new hotel was excellent as it is in a good shopping area and near the Common. The staff were very helpful and the room was nice and quiet.

title: Great and efficient !
text: Stayed over for business decided to stay over and meet up with friends arrival host was pleasant and the check in machine was efficient. had a good nights sleep and it was great that I didnt have to get out too early 12 is great.

title: Excellent
text: An excellent stay had by all of us, it was very comfortable at the hotel and the service was excellent. It was very easy to get in and out of the city of London and all the attractions, we used the bus to travel in and out as it was nearer to the hotel but the closest tube was about 20 mins walk or 5 mins on the bus.

title: Lovely Clean Hotel, with Fantastic Staff
text: Stayed here in a family room on a Saturday night whilst visiting relatives nearby. From the minute we entered and met the lady on reception (such a lovely lady, can't remember her name, but she had a great accent and told us she was even learning Polish!!) we had a lovely stay. We had an immaculate family room (the LED mirror was a big hit with the teenage daughter) The bathroom was brand new and such a nice change from experiencing dated and tatty ones. Plenty of towels too. We decided to have a meal in the Thyme restaurant on site, again the lady from reception was busily helping out, and the other lady Zoe (i think) was just as welcoming and funny. The food was great (I had the haddock and chips, and although the fish was beautiful it did sadly have a look of something out of a box, though quality was splendid - Head office, you may want to re-think how these look). Next morning breakfast was also excellent, a vast choice and although the staff were rushed off their feet (very busy sunday morning) they were very attentive and helpful and "smiley". Inly downside to the hotel is the lack of parking, but there is plenty of parking on the nearby residential roads, and you do not have to pay saturday or sunday, though beware during the week charges apply and you have to pay and display which can work out rather costly. I would happily stay here again with the family when we next come to London to visit relatives.

title: Great new Premier Inn
text: Stayed one night in this new Premier Inn. Faultless. Lovely room, clean and quiet, great night's sleep and good quality breakfast plus ALL the staff without exception were smiling and attentive. Another winner for Premier Inn.

title: Overall good stay
text: Lovely Hotel which is located about a 10-15 minute walk from Clapham Common underground. Nicely done out, very clean. Good breakfast. Only two issues- one, the pillows were very flat and two, there was a couple of staff who were rude but it didn't put a dampener on our weekend. Would stay again.

title: London
text: Couldn't recommend this enough....the good friendly staff and great for jumping on a bus into the center of London , the room was very clean and comfortable with a bed that you want to take home! Well done premier inn.

title: A very pleasant stay in SW London
text: From the time we arrived we found this hotel a very pleasant and comfortable stay. The staff were all very attentive to the guests. This hotel has only been open for a few months, and If this standard continues then this will be a very popular stay.

title: Nice place to get thing done
text: Nice quiet and good bed to get a good sleep in a small room like all Europe, but I liked the location very accesible to get the bus and good breakfast buffet. This is good place to get thing done in a very efficient way they deliver what they said.

title: Family wedding!
text: Lovely little hotel, newly opened. Chosen as convenient to attend family wedding. Rooms very clean, great comfortable beds as always with premier inns. Breakfast was very tasty but as the hotel was busy, some items became unavailable such as yogurt. Bar was limited but satisfactory. The staff were amazing! So friendly and helpful, nothing was too much trouble. Would definitely recommend and look forward to a return visit!

title: Lou
text: Wow stayed here with family and it was fantastic Mimi was absolutely amazing she went way over the top for us wouldn't of know buses if it wasn't for her.haha. and Courtney again just amazing thank you to them for making our stay on to remember

title: Overnight stay, excellent staff !
text: Friendly and helpful staff, which was very welcome after a long day ! the checking in was quick and simple enabling me to get into the room and relax quickly. The service was good and again quick, the room and whole hotel was very clean and tidy.

title: Clean, friendly and convenient
text: Can't fault it. Efficient check-in, large, clean room. Staff very friendly and efficient. Good food both at breakfast and dinner. Transport links - bus stop to central London right outside. Will be back.

title: Good hotel but a bit out of the way
text: Cannot fault the hotel all new fixtures and it's well laid out. The only downside is the location, it's a bit out of the way and the nearest tube is a bit of a walk away. It was too much for us we had to get a taxi to Clapham Common.

title: School Exchange
text: The hotel room was fairly spacious. The toilets however,do not have toothbrushes and other amenities provided:) But overall,it is a nice place to stay:) Location is great as well,there are nearby shopping malls to go to like "Boots"-great shop! And there are many restaurants around the area to get food and night snacks!:D

title: Lovely friendly hotel
text: We stayed in the Premier Inn on Wandsworth road in October for two nights, it was really nice, the beds were so comfortable and spotless clean although there is a stale smell in the corridor of the 1st floor, maybe it was a one off but I’m sure a few air fresheners would sort this out. Staff were the friendliest I have ever come across, the two girls on duty on Halloween weekend were really nice. we didn’t eat there but the breakfast looked good. Buses are just around the corner and it’s only a 15 minute walk to Clapham Junction. Will definitely go back for my next trip to London.

title: Six days in a sunny London
text: We have been very well and will speak well of you to our friends. The room was comfortable with good food and services and also the location was good. Public transport of the zona very efficient. We will definitely be returning to the Premier Inn.

title: Worth the stay
text: This hostel is one of the best I've stayed in. Great location. The staff were very friendly and welcoming and the place had a good vibe. It could have been a bit cleaner, and to be honest I wouldn't have slept without earplugs (I had a private room) as people were constantly slamming doors and being quite noisy at night. That being said, I don't expect a hostel to be quiet, but thankfully earplugs always work for me :) !!

title: The Best Place!
text: Great place to stay! Absolutely amazing staff, it is the best location one can get, literary right next to Hyde park, and inside, the rooms have space, the equipment is new and clean, big kitchen as well, big lounge, you will fall in live with it, definately 100 points!!

title: Much less than expected
text: Stayed in this hostel for 5 nights. Expected it to be supernice according to its rating in many tourist websites, but my expectations were ruined. I cannot say it is a very bad place to stay, no. But definitely it doesn't deserve to be top-rated here. The atmosphere is not nice, i mean yes, there are different events, watching movies and others. But the whole atmosphere of the place is not so unique and friendly. The rooms are very small, only 1 charging point for a person (since everybody has minimum 1 phone and 1 tablet/laptop - it is already not enough). The bathroom is one of the worst parts of my whole staying there. Very dirty, old, and gross. The room is not airconditioned, it is very hot at night. The breakfast (even though it is almost free) is not perfect, and the kitchen room is not so pleasent to have a breakfast in. Also, if you have a room on the 4th floor, it will be really tiring to get there. High steps and long stairs, no elevator of course. If you realize that you forgot something in your room, when you leave the hostel - the best idea would be to forget about coming back and take it :) I've been not at many hostels, but i have places to compare with. And this hostel, unfortunatelly, seems to be one of the worst in my personal experience. Maybe in London it is considered as a nice hostel, I don't know.

title: Good location, could use some updates
text: Pros: The location is excellent. I was just a few minutes walk from the Natural History Museum and Victoria & Albert Museum. The Gloucester Rd tube stop is also nearby, as are several bus stops. The price was also very reasonable. I paid around $50 per night. It was nice to have a bathroom attached to our room rather than having to walk down the hallway. The cons: I've seen comments that they are updating their outlets, but our room must not have been updated yet. I left my phone in the communal charging outlet (no personal chargers by the beds in this room), and someone stole my adaptor. I had to pay another 5 pounds to rent a new adaptor. No towels were available for rent, so I had to use (clean) hand towels left by previous guests. As others have mentioned, the lack of a lift made it really tough to handle a lot of tiny stairs with heavy luggage. I'm not sure if I would have even asked the front desk people for help--they weren't very friendly. Lockers are under the bottom bunk

title: Good Hostel
text: The beds were clean and the building was well situated. The staff was nice and helpful. However, our room was on the sixth floor and there were no elevators, and the bathroom was kind of dirty and smelled weird. Overall it was a decent place, not outstanding but ok.

title: Nice place to stay
text: It's friendly, clean and you can meet lots of people in a relaxed environment. For sure a good place to be if you're travelling with friends. You can be sure to find a neighborhood discreet and charming. Also, it's a few meters away from the beautiful Hyde Park, don't miss it!

title: Great value for London
text: Location: If you're looking for something busy and loud, this isn't for you. South Kensington is a 'posh' area. While I was there, it was really common to see Aston Martins and Ferraris on the streets. But you'd definitely get some peace and quiet in that area. Transportation: About a 17-20 minutes walk to Gloucester Road Station or South Kensington Stration. Bear in mind I am 5'3". Staff: Friendly, friendly, friendly and helpful! :D Cleanliness: Clean overall! However if you are in 10-bed dorm, of course don't expect the ensuite toilet to be spotless. However, the staff cleans it every morning. Convenience: Kind of close to shops. About 10-15 minutes walk to restaurants. Mostly fancy restaurants though. However there are some overpriced 24 hour kiosks too. There are more choices near the subways. Waitrose supermarket in near Gloucester Road Station. Sightseeing: Super near Kensington Gardens and Palace, Hyde Park, Royal Albert Hall. About a 10-15 minutes walk to the Science Museum and Natural History Museum (all museums are free). Facilities: There's a good vibe at the hostel. Nice, like minded, young travelers. You can use the internet on a desktop for free. There happens to be a movie playing every night. Free basic breakfast. Overall, great hostel. I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 because of the location. London is huge, Trust me, after a day of endless walking, you'd probably want to get back to the hostel as soon as possible after taking the subway. Also, try to get the 1st, 2nd or 3rd floor. There is no elevator!

title: Great place!
text: I was there in October, it was my first time in London and this hostel was one of my favourite things about it! It's a 2 min walk from Hyde park and a 10 min walk from National History Museum, V&A Museum and Science Museum. Also, the South Kensington tube station is really close. The staff was very friendly and everyone else also, the atmosphere in the hostel is great, regardless if it's 7 a.m. or 11 p.m. We met some great people, cooked and laughed together or just chilled in the beautiful living room. The kitchen is big, there are 3 stoves and 3 fridges. Our room was clean and the bathroom also. There are these cages under each bed where you can put your luggage, but in the reception there are also little safes where you can store you valuables. Definitely worth the money!

title: Nice visit
text: I booked a prived room for 2 people and it was really comfortable, although small, but that’s expected from a hostel. The staff was extremely nice and generous, they served some food for dinner. There’s also breakfast por only 1 pound they donate for charity, and it’s pretty good.

title: Brilliant base for London
text: I only stayed here one night as I was catching a bus from Victoria Coach Station across the Channel early in the morning. The staff were extremely friendly and the value for money is also great. The best thing about this hostel is the common room. So homely, and lots of Aussie banter (none of it wankerish either thankfully) - felt like I was back in Melbourne almost. Will definitely come back to this hostel again when in London.

title: Terrible place, wonderful location
text: When traveling solo, you don’t need much at time but cleanliness. That is why I always do a thorough research before booking any place. When looked at this hostel, it raved about being super clean but to my disappointment, it was completely the opposite. First, you are given one of the bunk beds, marked with a note. There are previous sticky marks on the side of the bed from other reservations being stuck, which I found unwelcoming. When opening the bed sheets, I could see how torn the bed linen was and despite having stayed in a hostel many times before, I’ve never encountered such poor state. I don’t wanna imagine the state of the mattress or pillows. Have they ever been taken care of? Before flying to London, I emailed them to ask about the possibility of paying for using towels. They said there was no problem. To my amazement, the towels belonged to previous owners, who must have obviously forgotten them there. I do not have a problem with that policy but it should be warned in advance. The problem came when trying to pick one of those towels: they had terrible stains and they were non-appealing to anyone. When I entered the bathroom, there were empty bottles of shampoo and gel, left there by previous guests, absolutely covered by dust. Only when I pointed out at this fact to the receptionist, they were quickly removed. When asked to be refunded for the following night stay since the state of the room was not as advertised, the receptionist couldn’t do much about it since it all depends on the manager’s decision, who is off weekends ironically, so if you have a problem at that time, you’re stuck. They said that they need a 24h notice but taking into account my flight landed at 8 pm and got to the hostel by 10, how can I know before getting to that place that the hostel was gonna be in such an awful condition? To sum up: Lack of hygiene, lack of customer service... Choose any other hostel while staying in London

title: Worth the extra money!
text: This hostel is worth the extra money per night. It is located in an absolutely stunning building on a quiet street within spitting distance of the park. The staff was very friendly and always cleaning. The breakfast was great and I appreciated the luggage cages under the bed and small lockers for valuables at reception.

title: Wow! Great value and excellent location
text: I was looking for something cheaper and in good location. I've already stayed in some hostels in earl's court and it was disastrous. But Astor Hyde Park was really nice! There was quite a lot of space in our room. I stayed in six room ensuite for 15GBP/night and was pleasantly surprised about the place. I'm not used to stay in hostels so I didn't bring my own padlock and they did not have any in hostel, so I left my things unlocked. Fortunately everything was ok, even though I stayed in room with complete strangers while most of them stayed only for one night. The location was excellent! I love south kensington, it is safe place, rather calm. I wasn't afraid while walking alone on street even late in the night. I would definitely recommend this place to all travelers in London.

title: Great London Hostel!
text: I have stayed at Astor Hyde Park a couple of times and it is such a beautiful hostel I can't wait for my next visit!
