The guy working at the desk has a massive knowledge of London city and is always more than happy to open up a map with you a fill you with a load of cool things to do in the city! With the tube station just a walk away and buses and bicycles on your door step the location is prime! They also have free adaptors, padlocks and hairdryers and breakfast is just £1 for charity with vegetarian and vegan options! Everything is clean and secure, more so the building is absolutely beautiful! Thank you to all of the staff for making my times in London GREAT! Can't wait to stay with you again!

title: Great stay in London
text: I stayed at Astor Hyde Park Hostel for 7 nights in a 10 beds mix dorm. The room with bathroom was very clean as well for the kitchen downstairs. I haven't spoke to a lot of the employees but for the few ones i spoke too they were really friendly and helpful (especially Andrew). Because this hostel is in a very old building they don't have a lot of plugs in the rooms by the beds so a bit harder to charge your electronics close to you, The hostel is really well located in South Kensington so not too far from all the major points of interest. Free wifi is available in all the hostel and if you don't have padlocks or towels you can borrow some by giving a deposit. I also have a few negative points. First, there's no lifts so it can be really hard to bring all your bags (but again it's an old building). And finally, in very hot temperature, the rooms are like ovens with only one fan (wich is not enough in my opinion for 10 persons) Overall it was a really nice stay and would recomend it to friends and family.

title: Good hostel
text: I stayed here with my friend about 2 week ago. We had booked 2 beds in 4 bed ensuite room. It was quite small, but our roommates told us thah they've seen even smaller while travelling through England. Our bathroom was better than I expected, new and clean, unlike the room itself, but still, nothing terrible or anything like that. Hostel is located in a very fancy area and everything around you is very, very expensive. There are 2 tube stations that are 10-15 minutes away by walking, but what nobody mentioned, there are buses right around corner that will take you anywhere (10 minutes drive to Oxford street). There are many cool museaums just minutes away from hostel, which is great. Breakfast is free, and very basic, bread and jam + cereals. What we were surprised by is that after you finish eating, you have to stand in line and do your dishes, even though there is bunch of staff thats not doing anything. Otherwise, they were nice. Strange policy I guess. Oh and yes, WI FI does not work in the rooms, but it works fine in the lounge area (which is really beautiful) and in the lobby. All in all, good value for money.

title: Comfortable stay
text: Really nice hostel on a good location. The building is really old, but well renovated and it sure adds a sort of touch to your stay. The dormroom where we were staying in (22) was really spacious and had a ensuite bathroom. Also really silent considering for a dorm room. Couldn't hear any people walking in the corridors etc. Only negative thing, no A/C so warm. The staff was really nice and helpful and the common room/kitchen etc were really accessible and comfortable. The FREE breakfast was great for a hostel

title: Nice location, nice price
text: I would stay there again. It´s clean enough, young people, nice location. All for a fair price.

title: I don't reviews but had too for here ...YOU NEED TO READ THIS!
text: I'd never done a hostel before! Not going to lie the first night I was petrified of going in! I'm 23 years old, I found myself lost in the a big city far away from rural Wales and I knew no one. I'd been offered employment in london and had to wait three weeks to move into an apartment looking for somewhere affordable I stumbled upon the DIAMOND that is Astor. Its in amazing area, Its clean and the staff are literally like a little family which made the stay that little bit more special....There's events on pretty much every night which get everyone involved! There's a Homely lounge room with a projector, a huge clean kitchen (in the kitchen and the lounge there's always someone that's picked up the hostels acoustic or on there piano which I found just the coolest thing ever) & the bedrooms are also to a high standard being fully clean everyday having stayed in a few different rooms over the three weeks ! Astor is a socially diverse welcoming place filled with people from around the world I have learnt so much from being here & loved every crazy minute of it....This place brings random combinations of people together which is genuinely magic I have mad some friends for life my stay was a true experience ! Tad emotional Leaving !! hahah

title: Will be better once problems sorted out...
text: This is a hostel, and we did book a double room so I don't feel like I can complain but I just have to say that this was the smallest room I have ever seen! It was tiny, but very clean nonetheless. We had some problems as the hostel had only just opened, like no shower curtain so water went everywhere, and it took me a while to figure out the heating which I still think was only working sporadically. But the kitchen was good and we cooked with everyone else and had some good nights in the common area. We stayed 7 nights. There is a bit of a walk to the tube, but the bus is very close and just as handy, especially at night obviously when the tube is shut. This was great and very easy to get back late. My major complaint was that the room was advertised with a TV but there was no TV in the room - it had not been installed yet - you could see the wires where it should be. I do not think you should advertise something and charge people for a service you don't provide. I'm sure by now these problems would have been fixed as work was still going and it's taken me a while to get around to writing this review!

title: A good hostel for young travellers
text: A nice, clean hostel in the nice part of London, South Kensington. Hyde Park is very close so you can easily walk. We lived in the third floor, remember there is no elevator, but the hostel is only young people so it isn't a problem. What to be aware of: The tube is 11 minutes away by foot, but the bus is close by. Gloucester Station is the closest tube station. Breakfast is two types of toast and four types of cereal. It is only £ 1 and it is something you donate to charity. It is food but nothing more than that. The kitchen is the hostels biggest weakness, having bad seating (it was difficult to find a place to sit in the morning even though there wasn't that many people) and three refrigerators to share among all visitors, they were all stuffed. It is possible to rent towels for £ 1, locks for a deposit of £ 5. The same goes for a few other things. All in all, a really nice place for a good price.

title: Clean,great location and good atmosphere
text: Enjoyed my stay at this hostel. The Location is excellent and tube stations and shops are a 5-10 minute walk away right in central London near parks and museums . The hostel is popular with backpackers from north america and australia so a good atmosphere and great way to meet fellow backpackers. The breakfast was quite basic but plentiful and the self catering facilities were decent and you had access to the kitchen and dining area throughout the day. The common room is also pretty neat with free access to Computer and sofas and projector pretty cosy. The rooms themselves are clean although if you get bed in the middle you dont have any curtains so lacking abit of privacy and hostel is abit on the expensive side but generally a pleasant visit made some great people and would come again. The hostel also provides a locker and padlock with a refundable deposit !

title: Nice, Clean Hostel in Great Location
text: We stayed for two nights in a 4 bed ensuite dorm and two nights in a private double room. Both rooms were quite functional. The location of the hostel was fantastic, one block away from Hyde Park and about a 10 min walk to the nearest underground station. The hostel wasn't too loud, it was clean and the staff were very helpful and friendly. I would say the only downside was that in the 4 bed dorm room the internet didn't work very well and that the private double was very expensive.

title: Amazing location, great value.
text: My friend and I were traveling through Europe and London was our first stop. Astor Hyde park was an amazing location- a long walk to most of the major attractions- but in an amazing neighborhood, super close to Hyde Park (half a block away) which was convenient for relaxing in the park during the afternoon. We never felt unsafe which was a huge deal for us. The rooms were quite boring, but clean. Our room had very bad ventilation and no fan so was quite hot all the time. We asked if a fan could be provided but nothing was done. Breakfast was good, average selection. The staff were amazing at suggesting restaurants and things to do, and every night at the hostel there was an activity (mainly drinking related) which helped to meet new people and have a good time. Very good place to stay.

title: Shoebox.... No room to bend down to put my socks on
text: When we arrived at 8am we had to wait outside as nobody answered the door bell the three times we rang it. I eventually snuck in as someone was going out the door. We had booked a private room with ensuite which cost a reasonable dollar. The room was very small and we had to store our backpacks on the bed in order to move about the room. Free Wi-fi in the room which was great. Breakfast was ordinary but okay if you are 19 and just want some bread and jam. Overall, this hostel is fine if you are young and don't care too much. The fire alarm was set off during the night, youth running up and down the stairs and the place is generally ran by teenagers, friendly ones though! Just lacked a clean and organised vibe.

title: Great place for youth!
text: Astor Hyde Park was a fantastic hostel in London. For London, the price was very competitive, and well worth the money. The rooms were kept very clean, the lockers were spacious (but quite noisy - hard not to disturb others!). Great communal area with strong wifi signal (not so strong in the rooms though!). The first night people werent very social, but with organized events over the weekend the group bonded and I now have very fond memories of my stay. Staff are excellent! Happy to help you out with anything and everything. Breakfast was fairly standard, but The kitchen area was excellent. Definitely recommend this hostel!

title: I am always coming back
text: Although the place has a really low atmosphere for meet people and everything, it kind of does not matter because of the location. It is amazing, like, unbelievably amazing. The Hyde Park is right there in one corner, an the Natural History Museum in the other. It is in the best location in London, everything is shine and pretty, for just 25 pounds a night! The hostel is as clean as a hostel can be, and it has a really nice common room! Oh, there is a Whole Foods market really close by. Just take care with the washing machine, it is really tricky. I have had washing clothes there 3 times and I’ve lost money in all of them, because I, stupidly, always put the money in the dryer machine first.

title: Average Hostel
text: Friendly and involved staff, hostel also hosts fun events and pub crawl. Cleanliness was okay, not the best bathroom. Large kitchen and movie space is nice and convenient. Great location - super close to loads of museums!

title: Great
text: Extremely friendly staff, great location next to Hyde Park. The price is one of the cheapest for Hostels in London, especially in this location. I would completely recommend this hostel. Definitely a good choise.

title: Good value
text: The rooms are very clean and big. The staff was very helpful. They give you locks, adaptors forma free. Breakfast is good too. There is a very big kitchen with everything you need to Cook. The neighbourhood is very safe and Nice and quiet. There are three bike stations nearby which made it very easy for us to move around. The only thing that could be improved is the ventilation system the bathrooms have, which is very bad and even if the bathrooms are clean, they always smell badly.

title: Impressed
text: Having not stayed in a hostel for a long time, I didn’t know what to expect. This is a fabulous place. We had a twin room with ensuite. Very clean, tv, kettle and even a couple of After Eights. Just around the corner from the Albert Hall. Do take ID - I didn’t know you had to and luckily we had ours with us. Didn’t try the breakfast - but looked very sociable in there. Highly recommended.

title: Cool chill place
text: Stayed 10 nights in the hostel. Cool place, nice and serious staff, perfect for people who want to work without being bothered and at the same time, enjoy the London life. Few négatif point : only one small bathroom for 10 person, you cannot sit on your bed ( no Space in between the 2 bunk bed).

title: Very nice place, cool atmosphere, great staff
text: I was there in September and the place was very nice, clean and friendly. Very well located. Not super teenager style, which was good. Not super noisy. I had a room with a bathroom from all of us. We were 8. But it was ok. The girl at the reception was super super nice, gave me some nice recommendations and even called a friend I was supposed to meet to tell him to pick me up, cause she didn't want me to get lost. Super sweet! I liked it.

title: Recommended!
text: Have been at Astor Hyde Park several times and always felt really great and safe in a great and friendly environment! £ 1.00 breakfast (donated to charity), wide choice of room (4, 6, 10 beds), people from all over the world! Such an amazing and great experience! Location is great! 10 minutes walking southbound to Gloucester Road station and 5 minutes from the nearest bus stop walking northbound. Hyde Park is really close, Natural History Museum and Royal Albert Hall as well. Highly recommended!

title: Perfect Location!
text: Super convent location only about 5 minutes away from Hyde park, Victoria & Albert Museum, and the Natural History museum. The #10 bus from kings cross is right up the street and the Gloucester road tube station is about 10 minutes away. They have a free breakfast of toast and cereal, the cost is an optional 1£ donations to the homeless. Both the dorms and the kitchens are cleaned daily. The dorm I stayed in was downstairs, but surprisingly bright thanks to a large skylight. They have large lockers underneath the beds for easy storage and extra storage rooms for larger luggage. The have lots of things available to rent at the front desk and only ask for a deposit. Internet was a bit spotty in the dorm, but they had lots of public space available to hang out in. Really great hostel!

title: Love this place
text: Had a fantastic experience. The staff were very friendly, and the room (we had a twin with private bathroom) was small but had everything you needed and was clean. The beds were comfortable, and the charity breakfast in the morning was brilliant value - they only ask you donate a pound and you can eat and drink as much cereal, toast, coffee and tea as you want. The staff put events on in the evening for the more sociable. Would definitely stay again.

title: Basic but still ok
text: Comparing other places in London, this hostel has top location eventhough you have to walk app 10min to nearest underground station. Staff is friendly and helpful. They take 5 pounds deposit for the room key another 5 for pad lock (if you do not have your own) and another 5 for towels, so make sure you bring all that with you or be prepared. Beds are comfortable and there is almost no creaking noice. Bathroom was reasonably cleaned for a “private dorm” bathroom. Breakfast is free, but you are offered a donation of 1 pound (or more) which goes for charity. Wifi ok, little less signal when in room, but not a big issue.

title: Would definitely stay here sgain
text: This hostel is in a great location, with a choice of bus stops and stations within a short walking distance. This was my first time ever staying in a hostel and it certainly was a great introduction to the hostel world. I stayed there twice during my month long trip in the UK! All the staff are very welcoming, friendly and helpful! There are no lifts in the building but staff are always happy to help carry bags up and down the stairs. The £1 breakfast is simple but a good (and cheap) way to start the day! The wifi is strong and fast throughout the building. There are events that you can get involved in every night if you choose to (the one I attended was mostly staff but still a lot of fun) Would definitely highly recommend Astor Hyde Park, and will definitely stay again when I return to London!

title: Such a pleasant enviroment
text: I was in Astor hostel last week with my 4 girlfriends. We have the room on 5th floor so we have our privacy in everything. It was my first time staying in a hostel and i will definitely stay there again and again.The place in Kensington was great and such a rich neighborhood.10minutes from the underground station and just 2minutes from the bus station of Royal Albert Hall. Everyone from the staff , even in the morning ,was smiley and extremely happy. It was quiet very clean and i feel the safety i feel in my own house. Please taste the peanutbutter in breakfast yummy yummy !

title: Good place to stay for a night
text: I've spent here one night and found many pluses and minuses of this place. Pluses: -great location, close to the underground, to Hyde Park (of course) and to a lovely area with great food -it is very clean -the building looks lovely from the outside -the staff is nice and helpful -the luggage storage is secure -the lounge is amazing, great place to chill and meet people Minuses: -there is only one bathroom in each dorm so sometimes you need to wait long to be able to use it (especially in the morning when everyone prepares to check out) -the room and the bathroom are quite old and could do with some renovation -there is no side lamp with the bed -there is no plug next to the bed, only at one end of the room which is not ideal as you don't want to leave your valuable far away -there is no lift so it is tricky to get your luggage up to the room Overall, I enjoyed my stay but would probably look for something different next time.

title: Awesome stay
text: This hostel is a really great place to stay in London. It is 5min walk from Hyde park and about 10min walk from a tube station. The hostel is in a really nice part of London and it felt like a safe area to be walking alone at night. The staff were very friendly and helpful and the rooms were clean with comfortable beds with thick warm bedding. Excellent free wifi! The only downside would be the bathrooms as there was no fan. This meant there was a lot of condensation after a shower. If a few people had showers in a row, the walls were dripping with water, the sink was wet, the toilet was wet...not very pleasant. Otherwise I really enjoyed my stay here and would highly recommend it!

title: Location, clean and a free concert!
text: The Astro has a great location, central and quiet just off Hyde Park. Beautiful old building, refined common areas. Rooms were very, very tidy, clean. The bathroom was actually incredible for hostel standards. Dare I say sparkling? There was a funny smell in the room (Backpackers? Socks? General older building?) but windows open and it's not a big deal. Later found this to be an overflowing shower which did flood the bathroom floor. Likely spreading onto carpet. There is no lift, so if you're lucky number 5 (level 5), your quads are going to be well conditioned. Brekkie for 1£. Free wifi. For a central London hostel this did the trick for a solid price.

title: central, british and friendly staff!
text: We have had a nice experience at Astor Hyde Park. The staff are really friendly(mostly are aussie), and the location is really cool! Is in front of the Hyde Park and there is a lot of bus stops around the hostel. Breakfast is not so good

title: Loved this hostel!!
text: SO many great things about this hostel. #1 location. So close to tube stations, super trendy neighborhood, easy to walk places and catch the tube to tourist spots #2 the building itself. the buidling is incredible just to look at. the common room in the front is great to get ideas from other travellers, meet up with people (and this is generally the only spot the wifi worked for us) #3 staff was super helpful. they had maps and recommendations and spot on directions. they provide a map with free walking tours of London and East London...HIGHLY recommend these especially if you are on a budget. All you need to do is tip your tour guide at the end. Its a basic tour with good information 2 hours or less thats not overwhelming and helps you narrow down places you would like to see from there. #4 rooms. we had a private room with bathroom so definitely more expensive than the other rooms but i cannot say enough good things. definitely worth the cost. shower was clean bed had linens that were clean and 2 doors to entry which felt safe and a bit more secluded for 2 females travelling together. kitchen area downstairs was great for making something if you want or bringing food down and chatting with others. be advissed this hostel is definitely geared towards the younger crowd, take into consideration late nights noise etc but we had a fantastic time

title: It was fine, but there are plenty of better places around
text: As far as hostels go, this was pretty average. Location was alright, maybe a bit far from the tube, but still manageable. Good bus routes nearby though. The facilities in the bedrooms weren't great though. In particular, there were no power outlets near each bed which meant you had to leave your valuable electronics (often the most expensive thing you have on you as a backpacker!) out in the middle of the room while you sleep to charge them. It did not feel safe. Further, there were no little lights above each bed, so sometimes inconsiderate roommates would come back and turn the light on to the whole room in the middle of the night to pack. And perhaps worst of all, the light to the bathroom was located outside the bathroom, right above one of the bedheads - so people wanting to go to the bathroom have to put their hand about 10cm away from another guest. Very unpleasant. Also, note that there is no lift for the luggage. On the plus side, a very cheap breakfast, free wifi was good, and staff were pleasant enough. I've stayed at many other hostels in London, and I won't bother returning to this one. It's fine, but there are better options for the same price.

title: Recommend !
text: Stayed here on my last night in London only for 4 hours to crash but I loved the hostel. Spacious and good value for money. Well connected by bus and train services. The best shared dorm among the 3 hostels I stayed in London. Wish I booked my stay here on all my nights in the city. Thumbs up if you are thinking to book a room here.

title: Great location
text: Good hostel in a great location. Close to Hyde park and about ten min walk to the tube. Easy check in, great security. The dorm is bright and airy. Beds are hard, shower isn't great and steps can be steep. Overall I liked it, staff were friendly and I would stay again

title: Amazing in every way!
text: Everything about the Astor Hyde Park is sublime. It's set in an absolutely beautiful town house in possibly the nicest neighbourhood in London. Fortunately the staff match the calibre of the surroundings. There is always fun activities to do, friendly people to chat to and amazing things to explore. The cleaning is impeccable, the breakfast unbelievably good (and for the benefit of charity!) and the receptionists are so knowledgeable about London. It's impossible not to find something for your taste after a chat with them. I cannot recommend highly enough. Thanks to Manny the manager, Beks the receptionist and Paloma and the rest of the guys for making my stay so exceptional.

title: Great value for money!
text: I've stayed from 29 June-3 July and had a wonderful stay. It's simply value for money. Best things were their staff. They attended to any maintenance issues asap, e.g. flickering bathroom lighting fixture in Room 36 and have organized activities daily. I have enjoyed the Thursday movie night featuring Kingsmen. Guests have come from all over the world and so are their staff. It's also a multi-cultural experience. Breakfast is for charity and only costs a pound. Locks, adapter & wifi are provided free but just need a security deposit. Stores and bus stations are just nearby. Just pack light because the stairs are a bit high.

title: Close to Hyde Park, Ok for Overnight
text: Pros: * In a nice neighbourhood * Close to South Kensington high street * Friendly staff * Affordable * Option of a pound £1 breakfast where the money goes to charity * Affordable Cons: * Far from the tube / especially annoying if you need to get to paddington to get to the airport. * Room number 2 has a disgusting smell like an old toilet * Room number 2 has a glass roof with no ability to block out the light * Sink in bathroom of room number 2 didn't drain * No wifi in rooms

title: Unbeatable!
text: Best ever experience...charming stately building on a beautiful street minutes walk from Hyde Park. Super clean, fantastic facilities, awesome high ceiling spacious rooms with very comfortable and generous sized beds. Staff were always exceptionally helpful and more than happily printed various documents for me on three occasions. Does it get any better? HIGHLY recommended.

title: Clean, quiet and an inexpensive hostel
text: Located a few blocks away from the V&A Museum, the Natural History Museum, the Science Museum, the Hyde Park and the South Kensingston Underground Station, this hostel provides a very nice atmosphere. One of the great surprises I got once I arrived was the comfortable bed. And after a good night sleep, nothing is better than a free breakfast. If you want to sleep in London for less than 25 Sterling per night, then this is a great option. Just be aware that you'll be sharing the bedroom.

title: Great Location!
text: Visited last December 2012 on a stop over from Wales to Bournemouth. Easy check-in, friendly staff, great big common area with good wi-fi. Beds are comfortable enough but I wish there were more bathroom cubicles. Heating was fairly alright. I didn't take the free breakfast but the kitchen/dining area is pretty nice and lots of people hang out there at night. Best thing about the place is its location - obviously near Hyde Park and Gloucester Road tube station is about two blocks away. Good value hostel, over-all!

title: Nice hostel
text: It is a nice reconstructed hostel, only be careful not to get a room with ensuit that is in the hall - then everybody else will use your bathroom which can be annoying. (these are two rooms on the first floor and one on the third I think). Nice big kitchen, a lot of long-stay habitants and close to Hyde park, some people complain about location (a bit far from tube) but I find it great as I can walk everywhere I want without having to take public transport and tube is just max. 10mins walk if I need it, buses (also the night ones) just around the corner. we´ve stayed there twice and planning to stay there again when in London

title: Grim experience
text: Only positive was location. Otherwise dreadful experience. Cramped stuffy room, loads of dust under the bed and I mean a lot especially when the storage drawer was pulled out from under bed. stairs leading up to room not hoovered. Staff encountered were not friendly. Bathroom not a pleasant experience. Fortunately only stayed a few nights and had booked accomodation at another hostel which was thankfully had a pleasant stay. Would not stay here again. uuhh makes my skin crawl

title: good location, friendly staff!
text: ive stayed here on march of 2015 for 4 days, the staff was very friendly, the place was clean and the location excellent! the hostel has activities everyday which i unfortunately didn't participate in but they all sounded pretty fun. i printed some stuff and they didn't charge me anything, yay :D definitely would go again if im ever back in london!

title: Clean and quiet
text: My stay here was very pleasant. I stayed in a 6 room mix room and didn't have any issues. Breakfast was only a 1 pound donation but I'd recommend buying your own items to have more variety. Probably the worst complaint I have about this place are the stairs. Oh my, those were a beast but required since there isn't a lift/elevator. However, the staff was super friendly and helpful.

title: Not for me..
text: We stayed here in July for 2 nights, a quick stop before travelling on to the rest of Europe... We stayed in a private room with ensuite. The room was small and very basic, bed, drawers & rubbish bin. The bathroom was actually the better part of the room. Our room looked onto a alleyway, the second door leading onto the alleyway could not be opened and the only window we had could only be opened about 30 centimetres a security measure i think? Was very hot during the night though so we slept with the window open and it was still hot. Also there were no drapes so we were up as soon as the sun came up which didn't help with our jetlag. The breakfast is very basic but still nice that they include it. The hostel staff are really great always friendly and know quite a lot! The hostel also organises pub crawls and drinks etc but we were so tired from sightseeing all day and the jet lag so we only went to the drinks they had in the hostel. The hostel is located sort of between Gloucester Rd & South Kensington tube stations, about 10 minutes each way and Hyde Park is only just up the road. Unfortunately there are no places to really eat that are close by.. While this place might be ok for some, it was too far away for us and we'd definitely stay somewhere else next time.

title: Good youth hostel
text: I stayed in this hostel for only 2 of my nights in London and I wish I had booked more. The dining room and lounge were great places to meet other travelers and the staff seemed happy to be there. The walls are covered with events and activities that you can do nearby. With Hyde park less than a block away, the location is good with the nearest subway/tube station about a 10 minute walk away. The area is a really nice residential area.

title: Clean, central, friendly
text: I stayed here recently in a private room - it had everything you would need and the hostel location is very central. Not much in South Kensington in terms of late bars but good restaurants and surrounding places to go- hostel is about a 5-10 min walk from the tube station and from the natural history museum and there are hop on bus tour stops in the area.

title: Avoid, avoid, avoid and yup, avoid some more!
text: I don't think that there is anywhere on earth with worse staff. The two Australian staff members I encountered are the most unprofessional, racist/regionalist jobsworths I've unfortunately had to deal with. Zero common sense, unhelpful and lie to your face when you query rules etc. On top of that, the hostel is filthy with questionable 'security'. Don't be fooled by the hostels attempts to look all cool and fun on its instagram and Facebook accounts - that is sadly far, far from the reality. Save yourself the hassle and look elsewhere.

title: Great hostel, excellent location
text: This hostel was in a great location very central. The staff were very friendly and the rooms were clean. We were here for 5 nights and had multiple room mates and never had a problem. No lifts so be prepared to lugg your suitcase/backpack up huge flights of stairs.

title: Good and not so good things...
text: I stayed there for a week....overall it was a good experience, considering: + +Everything is clean. They clean up every room everyday. +There's a big lounge area with a huge screen (where we could watch the world cup), +Some of the staff was helpful (Laura was a sweetheart) +Nice big kitchen, breakfast included and OK (coffee, tea, cereals, bread and jams) +They provide padlocks and towels for free (with a deposit which they give back once you return those things) +Pretty safe, you are given a key to enter +The area is super nice and posh. Next to Kensington Gardens and the museums. About 8 blocks (10-15min) from South Kensington tube station. Safe neighbourhood, a bit far from some attractions, but hey, tube and buses are great in London, so... - -My room was on the 4th floor....and there's no elevator/lift!! The guys at the reception (MEN!) didn't even offer to help with my luggage. Not even when I got there 1 hour before check-in time and had to carry my luggage to the luggage room downstairs and then up again...(1 hour before??? Come on, guys!) -I got a few things stolen from my room. Of course it probably was my mistake to leave a shopping-bag with dirty clothes I was about to take to the laundry and flip flops out of the "locker", but still....suggestion: lock EVERYTHING up! -I agree with what others commented about the aussie guy. I thought it was something personal, but apparently he is like that to everybody. He couldn't care less or be less helpful or inviting.

title: good location, disappointing staff
text: The location of this place is really central and it's a clean environment. this is where it ends. we liked most staff members however DAN at the front desk was incredibly unhelpful, rude and made us feel very uncomfortable, he is a horrible human

title: Good location hostel in a really safe neighbourhood!
text: I stayed here once in 2013 in a private room with my boyfriend and again in Sept 2016 for a week for a solo trip. I chose to go back because I was familiar with the location and knew it was really quiet and very very safe. :) This time I stayed in a 6 bed female dorm. I happened to stay during the hottest week in London record, so the rooms were a little uncomfortable (obviously the hostel can't control the weather!), and the bathroom would essentially become a steam room even when showering with lukewarm water for 5 minutes. Intense! The beds definitely could use a reading light, or personal lights. People would come in late and turn on the overhead light and wake everyone else up. I brought a flashlight so I could read at night when the lights were out and move around without turning on all the lights. Breakfast is now 1 pound (obviously not expensive, but the food is very basic). It was included the last time I was there, so I didn't eat it this time. It's a good deal if you like cereal and toast, I guess. My room was only on the second floor this time, so it was easy with my bags. The private room was much higher up and it was definitely a struggle. There always seemed to be something going on, as I got invited to go out a couple of times, and the front desk staff we always very friendly and helpful. I probably wouldn't stay here again unless I was in a private room, the older I get the more I value not having to fight with five other ladies for a bathroom. :) But for younger folks who are keen on the hostelling life this is a great choice! You really can't beat the price, it's about 50 CAD per night. The location is awesome, and you are close to 3 tube lines that will get you just about anywhere you need to go. The hotel is only about a 7 minute walk away from the tube station, I don't know how slow people are walking to have it take 15 mins. :) If you bring your own lock you don't have to pay for one at the front desk!

title: Disgusting
text: This was the only hostel I went to that I hated. The bathroom was disgusting. The service wasn't great and it wasn't cheap. The only redeeming quality it had was its proximity to Hyde park. I would not stay here again. Does not look like the pictures.

title: Great hostel to stay!
text: I went to this hostel twice and stayed 5 nights the first time and 4 nights the second time. The hostel is situated in an amazing part of London, Hyde Park is juste around the corner. Beds are comfortable, but the only downside would be the absence of curtains, which makes it hard to fall asleep and to stay asleep! (maybe that's not the case anymore) Big furnished kitchen, which was important for us. The tube station is not near but not that far (approx. 10 min walk) I would recommend this hostel all the way!

title: Ask for a receipt !
text: Don't forget to ask for a receipt if you pay in cash ! They didn't give me a receipt, and I forgot to ask for it. Some weeks after my stay I found that they charged again the price in my bank account (they had the number of my card since my first stay a year ago), but I had paid in cash some days before my stay!. So I was charged twice, I complained but finally couldn't get my money back. I even decided to go to the bank to change my card and its number. Oh and also be prepared to hear loud music from the kitchen until 1 or 2 a.m. if you are in the rooms of the ground floor. I'll never go back to that hostel (Astor H.P. in Queensgate street).

title: Great location!
text: We stayed in the private double room, it was a bit smaller than we thought. And the bed was not very nice for two.. The place itself was excellent! Friendly staff, nice sitting room, kitchen and CLEAN. Just a good atmosphere! Breakfast was simple, some serials, bread and jam. The location is perfect, very close to the tube (10min walk) and hyde park is very close.

title: Great Hostel in London
text: Astor Hyde Park was a breath of fresh air! While it was definitely still a budget hostel (we had a total of six people in our room), the building was nice and spacious, the lounges had TVs and coin-paid internet, and everything was clean and kept up well. The staff were super helpful and friendly(and we had a LOT of annoying questions for them), and they were always available. I felt safe and comfortable staying here, even though my preference in the future would be a private room with just my traveling companion(s). For those looking to meet people and party, this is also a great place for you! My friend and I preferred to do our own thing, but it seemed like the staff put on a lot of parties and events as well as nights out, which seemed pretty popular. My only real issue was that the hostel was located a bit of a walk from the tube station. A fifteen-minute walk is normally not a problem for me, but in freezing temperatures and snow, it’s NOT the greatest! If walking is an issue for you, you may need to seek out something a little more conveniently located, but otherwise this was a great hostel and very affordable!

title: 9 nights in the female dorm
text: Pros: BEAUTIFUL neighbourhood, across the street from Kensington Gardens, access to tube station serving two core lines, friendly people. cozy and large lounge and kitchen areas, good tips on posters on the walls, secure, high ceilings, cheap breakfast Cons: no lights or outlets at beds, creaky beds and floors, steep staircase, 12-minute walk to tube, loud people dragging suitcases down rows of stairs in the morning, lame breakfast, lame shower, lockers a bit finicky, wifi spotty at times

title: Great location, value and features
text: Myself and 3 friends stayed in a private room with ensuite and were very impressed with our overall experience. The place was clean,neat, modern (although in a beautiful old building) and had great features. The common lounge area was great, free wifi is always a bonus and the kitchen area and 1£ charity breakfasts were always a good start to the morning. Great location close to tube stations and bus stops in quite a nice area, and very security conscious. The only minor annoyance for us was that we were on ground floor and didnt really get the wifi signal in our room. Also the luggage storage area is a massive pain to haul your suitcase to. But these are minor things and all in all we had a great time.

title: Great staff, tiny room
text: Firstly the good points: the staff at this hostel were fantastic - really friendly and helpful. There was also plenty of information on things to see and do around London at reception. The location of the hostel was great - very close to Hyde Park and the tube. The cleanliness was about average for a hostel. It wasn't super clean but wasn't unhygenic. Unfortunately our room (located on the 6th floor after a long flight of steps) was absolutely tiny. If you have played Twister you will be well-equipped to navigate your way around the room. It was so small you couldn't pull the cages under the beds out all the way. I've been told that it's only the 4-bedroom dorm that is small so if you do stay here, ask for one of the larger dorms. There may be more people, but at least you'll have room to move.

title: Perfect Stay
text: While travelling London for a week with my boyfriend, we stayed in a private en-suite here and loved it! The room was always clean and it was very convenient playing the extra money to have a bathroom/shower attached to your room. The breakfast was easy and filling and the free wifi was very helpful. Even the beds are comfortable! The location is beautiful and I always felt safe walking around the area. Only a 10/15mins walk to the tube, restaurants and museums, too! Do understand that it is primarily run by teens. The fire alarm went off at least 4/5 times, (always a false alarm) and you may be awoken in the night by loud teens running around after drinking. But if you're easy going and little things like that won't bother you, you will love this hostel! I would definitely stay there again if I'm ever in London. HEADS UP. Don't get this confused with "Astor's Hyde Park" which is different entirely. This is Astor Hyde Park on Queensgate.

title: Nice Hostel in a good neighborhood
text: As the title suggests Astor Hyde Hostel is a very nice clean organized hostel. Extremely close to various museums and Hyde Park. About a 10-15 minute walk from Gloucester underground. Staff are friendly and helpful. Dorms and bathrooms are clean and they have a nice lounge and dining areas. Only downside is it's in a posh neighbourhood and therefore will need to travel to get to lively pubs and clubs. However if you just want to go to a bar to relax with a drink there are plenty of those around as well.

title: Posh hostel in a great area of London
text: Great hostel located in a upscale area of London, love the fact Hyde park is nearby. The actual hostel itself is within a beautiful building, the staff are very helpful, the facilities excellent and you feel like you have plenty of room which is not always the case in hostels- also enjoyed the breakfast which was a very inexpensive £1 cost. Will be staying here again no doubt 👍

title: Beautiful location.
text: This was by far the best hostel I stayed in while in London. In fact, I've stayed here 3 times now. The beds are comfortable, the bathrooms clean, the breakfasts plentiful and the wi-fi always in working order. The location is the best thing of all. It's just a short stroll to the left to get to the museum quarter, with the Natural History Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum being highlights for me. Turn right, and in all of 2 minutes you're in Hyde Park. There's a tube station a 10 minute amble away, and 2 bus stops just around the corner, which provide a service late into the night straight to or from many of West End's theatres. Best of all, Kensington just feels safe. So if you're travelling alone (I was), and walking around here late at night in the dark, you don't feel as though you constantly have to look over your shoulder or into dark alleys. It's just a great area, and the people at the hostel are so friendly that you're bound to find some buddies to hang out with!

title: Comfy beds, nice staff, awesome common area
text: Not as close to the Gloucester Road train station as Meininger but offers more character and bigger bathrooms. I would suggest staying in larger occupancy rooms as they are closer to ground level and offer a balcony which makes them less stuffy. God bless you if your room is on the fourth floor because it's a work out to get up there! This place is not wheelchair friendly (and doesn't claim to be.) The common area is great, you can always find people watching netflix on the projector or just chatting and hanging out.

title: Too expensive for such a room
text: The room was small and uncomfortable. We were on the first floor and we couldn't close the window. The taps in the room were broken. The only good point was that the place was quiet clean. It was also far from the lively districts, and the

title: Clean, Friendly, Worth it!
text: We stayed two nights in London of which the first was at Astor Hyde Park Hostel. It was a pleasant experience. We stayed in an 8 man dorm, which was clean, neat and didn't smell funny. The front desk was helpful and informative, however they did charge me £2 to rent an old shabby bath towel. Compared to other hostels in London, for the price (£22), it was super. I will call again.

title: Very nice place to stay!
text: I stayed in a shared room, very nice and comfortable, clean. The staff very helpful with everything. A nice thing was the breakfast for just £ 1, which is donated for charity :) Close to Hyde Park in a good neighborhood with easy access to public transportation

title: Affordable stay in nice neighbourhood
text: Had a wonderful stay in Astor Hyde Park. It's located in a beautiful old Victorian Town house in the nice neighbourhood of Kensington. Close to the underground, Hyde and Kensington Park, shops and places to eat affordably. Nice staff, even let us stay in the lounge with a film whilest waiting on the cab at 3 AM. Breakfasts were simple but decent. Only downside was the boiling hot room temperatures, but hey, what are these odds in London? :)

title: Nice Clean Stay
text: This is a nice clean, quiet hostel. The only problem we had was that there are only 4 power points in a room for 6 and they are all in one corner - not great when everyone has a phone to charge at night. Also the shower didn't have an exhaust fan and was extremely hot and stuffy. But other than that a nice place for a sleep.

title: Worth it!
text: Without knowing London was hard to pick a hostel to stay. But I was lucky, very lucky! The location could not be better. Access to all means of transportation just steps away. Even, there is a bike station right in front, which you can rent for a super cheap price. The atmosphere of the hostel is super nice and quiet. The rooms were very clean and everything was well organized. The staff was kind and always willing to help. The region of Kensington can be expensive, but the price of hosting is fair. The hostel has a well-equipped kitchen where you can prepare your dinner without being bothered. I had a great time there. When I return to London I will stay there again undoubt...

title: WOW
text: I stayed at the Astor in Hyde Park for 6 nights and it was awesome! It was my first time staying at hostel and be on my own and for me to be greeted with this for my first experience I'm speechless. The staff are awesome and are more then welcome to help you with anything especially Jax and Hayley! The beds are super comfy and I felt so safe there

title: Central, affordable, friendly staff
text: Pro: - Location: very central, next to Hyde Park and Royal Albert Hall,10 mins walk to Gloucester Road or South Kensington tube station. - Staff: friendly, attentive and helpful. Especially Jax and her colleagues at the reception were very nice and gave good advice on nightlife, culture, pubs, restaurants, getting around and so on. Charo and the girl from Portugal (forgot her name) were also very friendly and nice. - WiFi: free, reliable, good connection all over the hostel - Breakfast: cheap, just £1 charity donation - Order and cleanliness: was really good but not perfect Con: - Rooms: no shelfs, light switches, reading lights and sockets next to bunk beds. Not enough storage for clothes, luggage etc. - Beds: too small for tall people, I'm 1.91m / 6'3" and I couldn't lie straight - Breakfast: I'd rather pay £1-2 more to have more choice such as cheese, sausage, eggs. All in all a very pleasant stay for a very affordable price (considering the central London location). Would always come back to Astor Hyde Park Hostel.

title: Buzzing Hostel!
text: This hostel is brilliant! The location is brilliant, only a 10 min walk from the Tube station (Gloucester St.) and it's on a really nice area. The staff are really helpful and good fun too. They organise nights out and meals for really cheap. You are allowed drink in the hostel which is always good, nothing worse than having to hide your drinking habits! There is a really good lounge area with leather couches and and there is another area with a pool table! The rooms were really clean, and the toilets were always clean too. The showers in the En Suites were amazing. The Breakfast was grand, toast and cereal. There are safes you can rent which is really handy for storing extra money, passports, boarding cards and things like that. Also the luggage rooms were really secure and were extremely handy. There are lots of restaurants and shops close by(10min walk) and some 24 hour shops too. Its only a 5 min walk from The Science Museum which is great, also the Natural History Museum is at the end of the street! Overall this hostel Rocks and i can't fault it at all!

title: Great Hostel
text: This was a great hostel. I liked that there was an age restriction as people were around my age (20s). I liked that the hostel had lockers under the bed you could lock your stuff in. The staff were all young, hip and helpful. The breakfast was nothing special, but what I expected for staying in a hostel. I had fun during a pub crawl the hostel sold tickets to. I also liked that there was a lounge to just hang out in.

title: Would go back
text: I stayed in a double with en-suite facilities

title: Very good hostel near Hyde Park
text: Good location. Good price. Clean beds and stuff. Friendly staff and people around. Breakfast included - cereals, tea, coffee, milk, bread, jam and stuff available, toasters, kettle... just all you need. Also you can leave your luggages in the locked room. Free wi-fi in some areas. We stayed one night in December 2012.

title: It's fine
text: The good: the rooms, bathrooms and common areas are very clean. Everything is as secure as it could possibly be (a video camera buzz-in left-luggage room, card-locks on the rooms, etc). Lots of advice and tips for stuff to do. The staff is friendly and helpful. The not-so-great: while the hostel is in a neighborhood that feels quite safe, it is not near much that is very interesting (except the V&A and kensington gardens) and it is a bit of a hike to the tube station (0.7 miles to south kensington, 0.6 miles to kensington). Not terribly convenient. The downright irritating: this issue may seem minor, but has become a massive inconvenience - in a 10-bed dorm room, there are only 4 outlets for charging. And since everyone travels with a million electronic devices these days (myself included) and it is absolutely impossible to divide 4 outlets 10 ways, I am now camped out in the hallway at midnight writing a review of this hostel instead of asleep in my bunk for the third night in a row - because I need to charge my phone, which is also my alarm, and all the outlets have been claimed since I checked in 3 days ago. Really really bothersome.

title: Great place
text: I really enjoyed my stay at Astor Hyde Park. It is located in an amazing location, very central and with the park just a few steps away. The building is beautiful, the rooms and the bathrooms very clean and the common room is huge and cosy. The staff was very helpful and friendly, more than the average I’ve met in other hostels. I’d totally recommend this hostel if you’re travelling to London and I’ll definitely go back there next time I’m in the city.

title: Pretty good and worth it
text: For the price, this hostel is pretty darn good. Clean hygeine, friendly staff, 1 pound breakfast with proceeds going to charity, and situated near everything. Each bed has a safe compartment at the bottom which you could deposit your bag in, and you could secure it with a padlock. Padlock is free with a 5 quid refundable deposit.

title: lousy, old and far away from metro stop and insincere! breakfast is a nightmare! wi-fi does not work with i-phones!
text: First of all, the hostel is far from the metro stop. what kind of road description says 200m before the END of the road??!!! instead of saying 1km after the traffic light, they wrote 200m before the end of the road!! this is just a very bad way to trick people. as I had little time to book the hostel and as I saw the text metro and 200m as a normal person I assumed it was 200 m after the traffic light. BUT NO!! it is 200 m before the end of the road which is nearly 1 km! after!!! that is real b.s! internet comes and goes and even when it is working it does not work with i-phone! addition to that, the bathrooms are awful, not even the smallest rack that you can put your soap or toilet bag on, all the material in the lobby is old and used up. it is very easy to say that the owners just built the hostel and went away. not even a single attention to detail. for the breakfast there are only 2 toasters, and the slowest ones in the world, for a hostel of probably more than 100 people. this means you have to wait at least 10 min. to get your bread toasted! before this hostel I stayed at Palmers Lodge - Swiss Cottage but I had to leave after 3 days because they were fully booked. it is just an awesome hostel. you really feel you are treated nicely whereas the astor makes you feel worthless. DO NOT STAY HERE! after my first night I cancelled the rest of my reservation and moved to meininger which is just 100m from the metro stop. cheaper, really decent and great value.

title: Great hostel at a perfect location!
text: A nice and cheap hostel at an amazing location. The staff is really helpful and makes your stay perfect! Just around the corner of Hyde park and near several museums. The Kensington area is a wonderful place to stay! Therefore highly recommendable to stay in this hostel when spending a few days in London!

title: Convenient and comfortable
text: The location of this hostel is a big win, within walking distance to 2 tube stations and a bus stop, as well as being just around the corner from the Natural History Museum, the Science Museum and Hyde Park, and a short walk from Tesco. The staff were really nice and friendly and the facilities were pretty good as well. The breakfast was good with just the simple cereal and toast but the kitchen also offered cooking facilities. Beds were comfy, rooms were a decent size and internet was good. Bathrooms were clean as well!

title: Great stay!
text: Staff were super friendly and it was very clean. Only complaint is that there was no air condition. Other than that it was fantastic. Great location, 20 minute walk to the subway, close to grocery stores and pubs

title: Great location, ok hostel
text: The location of this hostel is fantastic - it is so central, literally right around the corner from the Royal Albert Hall (and Hyde Park at the end of the road). We had a private room /bathroom - it was absolutely tiny (expected in London, but we did struggle to find a spot to put our bags down) but the room & bathroom were fairly clean & modern. The wifi was patchy from our room, but fine downstairs. Our room was on the 4th floor I think, so quite a lot of stairs to go up - it was very hot while we were there in July, so a fan would have been great (although there wouldn't be any space to put it!). The kitchen is in the basement - we didn't use it but it seemed well equipped (more difficult to self-cater as it is a fairly big hostel). The breakfast was ok - cereal, bread rolls (not sure why there was no bread for toast), milk and a cordial-like juice. The staff were also ok - friendly, but not the best at communication (there was no-one there when we arrived to check-in as the power had gone out {no note to explain that they were sorting it out} and also no-one there when we went to collect our bags about 20 minutes after checking out & leaving bags in reception - so we had to wait). Overall, the hostel is in an excellent location and the rooms are ok - good for a few days if you want to explore central London & if you will be out a lot. I'm not sure whether I'd stay again - probably not.

title: Great place in excellent location
text: The location is absolutely amazing, in one of the best neighborhoods in London, with many options of leisure (such as Hyde Park) and transport within a few minutes walk. The staff is awesome and super friendly, the activities that they organize such as pub crawls and nights out on some clubs are very nice, was a great opportunity to make friends! The hostel infrastructure is also great, the common areas are really nice and rooms had a lot of plugs although it was very hot inside (but this is a problem you will find in every building in London whenever the weather is really hot as it was in the beginning of July). Overall the cost x benefit was incredible. It's the best hostel I've stayed so far and I will definitely stay there again on my next trip to London!!

title: Great for meeting people! Okay location
text: The hostel was very friendly to backpackers and offered a lot of different ideas as to what to do in london. There were a lot of younger people staying there!! The location was in a very safe neighbourhood but it was, however, pretty far from most restaurants and shops.

title: Nice place, but some issues
text: I liked a lot of things about this hotel. Very comfy bed, nice gadgets and amenities in the room, convenient location, and good wifi. However, they charged me a different (higher) price on check out than I had confirmed on my original itinerary, and was told that my reservation "was a bit funny" - not sure what that means. I was told they would check with the man ager and email me (which they did not), and the price was only corrected when I followed up a couple of weeks later. Also, there was an annoying clanging sound in the room that I mentioned to the front desk but nothing was done about. Shame, because it's almost excellent.

title: Highly recommended, great hospitality
text: Everything was amazing, good food, comfy bed and great location, we loved staying in this neighborhood. Luca at the reception gave us the best suggestion and offered a superb service. Wonderful place to visit, has it all. Thank you!

title: Beautiful experience
text: Nobu hotel is a beautiful modern hotel with very friendly and helpful staff (especially Barbara). The room is comfortable. Japanese food at the hotel restaurant is delicious. Spent time at the hotel was very pleasant.

title: New Year’s Eve
text: Another amazing stay at Nobu, staff as always incredible, even fitted my wife and I into the restaurant without a booking. Took our dogs who were given the ‘Nobu’ treatment. Loved everything about it as always. Thankyou.

title: Best stay at hotel ever!
text: During our time at the Nobu hotel in Shoreditch, we were treated like royalty and waited on hand and foot. Our stay was Made all the more pleasant by the very thoughtful concierge Michael. We will definitely be returning!

title: Incredible Hotel, best anniversary weekend ever!
text: I booked this hotel and restaurant for me and my boyfriend’s anniversary. I booked the weekend brunch package (which includes a bottle of champagne, Brunch the next day and a late check out at 4pm) with a studio suite, as well as dinner in the Nobu restaurant the night we arrived. I booked this as I have been to both the other Nobus in London for dinner, and have been blown away by the Omakase menu every time. I was slightly nervous as I was paying a lot of money for this stay, and it is a relatively new hotel which can sometimes have a few issues. Nonetheless, I was pleasantly looking forward to my stay. Right from booking, I was treated with an extremely high standard of respect and care. As I was booking this stay as a surprise for my boyfriend, he knew about where we were going but didn’t know much else. Justine, from the restaurant reservations team went above and beyond to help me with my booking. She got me booked into the restaurant for dinner and Brunch the next day as part of my package, helped me secretly order coffees and pastries to my room in the morning as another surprise, set up rose petals and a bottle of champagne upon arrival, and just generally dealt with every single query I had. I spent the week before my stay feeling relaxed as I was so comfortable with the details for my upcoming stay. When we arrived we were immediately welcomed. We were offered a glass of prosecco however I knew it wouldn’t be free so turned it down! We were escorted to the room by a lovely bellboy. The room we were given was absolutely fabulous, quite large and very nicely designed. The only bit we didn’t like was the seemingly bare ceilings, it looked like they hadn’t been finished however after visiting another restaurant in shoreditch we realised that this was just the trend of the town. The rose petals were beautifully laid on the bed, champagne was on ice and we even got a complimentary box of chocolates and a plate that said happy anniversary on it. I was blown away by these little gestures they did to make our stay so special. The food in the Nobu restaurant was of course impeccable. We had the Omakase menu and just as before it was the most delicious thing I’ve ever had. Would 100% recommend it to anyone, yes it is expensive but so worth it. I had one of the best sleeps of my life in that kind size bed! Felt like I was being swallowed by a massive marshmallow. The next morning the surprise breakfast I booked didn’t come, there seemed to be a mix up so I had to call and order it again. This was not a problem but meant I got it about half an hour after I wanted it which was a shame. The Nobu weekend brunch was again incredible, the sushi buffet was phenomenal and the main course was delicious. I made 2 trips to the desert bar! I brought some macaroons back for my family and was going to take them but then the waiter offered me a box, so I thought great I’ll fill it up! May be cheap of me but after what I paid for the stay I will be taking as much as I can get! The staff were very lovely and didn’t judge me at all. Overall, this is one of the nicest hotel stays I’ve ever had. The bedroom was amazing and the food was beyond compare. If you’re celebrating a special occasion, go ahead and treat yourself to this hotel because you wont regret it.

title: NO!-bu
text: Booked this hotel because it was new and a funky part of London. The hotel was very clearly not finished work was still going on in all areas. In fact they were silicone sealing around the lift call button as I went to press it! Areas of the hotel were off reach as they were not finished including the outside terrace. The room despite being the largest type available at the hotel was really under-whelming and TINY (yes I know this is London). Through the first night I was woken multiple times by disturbances in the corridor outside the room – this appeared to be between a hotel guest and security but was very loud and went on for a considerable length of time. I was awoken at 8am by the sound of loud drilling in the hotel – as I stated earlier it’s a building site. Breakfast – first morning sat down and was immediately told that most of the menu wasn’t available on the breakfast inclusive rate (a first experience for me in any hotel). I chose the full English and it was ….OK. Second morning came down to breakfast at 10am to be told breakfast was only available in-room – there was no mention of this anywhere in the hotel and this was again the first time I have experienced this at any hotel anywhere in the world. In summary I wouldn’t bother with this hotel – it’s a Nobu restaurant and bar with some rooms tacked on as an afterthought

title: Great stay
text: We are in London to drop our daughter off to university and also our 20th anniversary. The hotel took great care of us. There was a fruit plate with "happy anniversary" written on it in our room when we arrived and we were upgraded. Great special attention. I definitely recommend. Breakfast was great - loved the cold press juices.

title: Great Hotel and even better staff
text: Thank you to Pedro and the entire team for a wonderful stay! Glad to find this new gem, definitely my new favorite spot. The rooms are generous in size, the bed is super comfortable. I especially enjoy the desk / sofa setting, perfect for unwinding/dining alone and for work. Actually finished an entire deadline just on this table with convenience outlets for all of my devices. The abundance of closet space is definitely a plus, especially if you are travelling for business and have different attires. My colleague unfortunately lost her luggage on the way to London, Fabrizio from the team went over and beyond, located and coordinated the luggage on her behalf and gave her a late checkout.

title: Good hotel, bad and expensive breakfast.
text: Stayed a weekend, nice rooms and hotel in general, but the breakfast was not up to the standards of the rest of the hotel. Mind the waiters that don't tell you that the coffee they first ask if you want is superexpensive and not included in the 18 £ breakfast buffet, which do include coffee....

title: Mixed feelings!
text: We stayed at Nobu Shoreditch for 3 nights in early March. It is brand new hotel and have to admit it looks a bit odd. However, I quite like it. Rooms are relatively small, minimalistic but stylishy furnished. It is immaculately clean, beds are extremely comfortable but only queen size. Cushions, duvets and beddings are the top notch. Same refers to towels and bathrobes. The black and white flip-flops are fantastic. Japanese teapot and teas is very nice touch. And that's about where the positive things end. Nobu is the 1st hotel I've ever stayed outside the rural Sub-Saharan Africa which doesn't have the coffee facility in rooms. I understand it is Japanese style hotel but I would still assume that majority of the guests drink coffee in the morning. Adding couple of single servings bags of coffee is not expensive. The sound insulation is literally nonexistent. We could clearly hear people talking in room next to ours. The same refers to luggage being rolled in the corridors but also trolleys of the chambermaids. Young people working at the reception are trying to smile but all look under pressure and nervous. It is not acceptable for serious hotel to have concierge who has never heard of the famous restaurant I wanted to book. After repeating 3 times the name of the restaurant I've had to write it down. I know it is new hotel and majority of the staff are young and without the prior experience in hospitality business. But it might be a good idea to hire the head receptionist and concierge who work(ed) in one of the Mayfair hotels to train these kids. If/once these things are sorted out Nobu Shoreditch might become a proper London hotel.

title: Quick business trip to the City
text: Not impressed with the breakfast service. Got hit with a £5 extra charge for a couple of rashers of bacon with my full breakfast. Very odd and not advised beforehand. Rooms are good albeit breakfast offering lets the side down.

title: BEST 40th BIRTHDAY EVER!!
text: From the moment we reached the front door we were treated to a red carpet reception with our bags efficiently collected by the doormen, checked in seamlessly by the front of house crew and personally escorted to our suite by the manager Matthew. We were treated as though were were VIPs and in keeping with NOBU’s philosophy of “doing a job well no matter how humble that job”, the service we received from all staff members was EXCEPTIONAL! A special thank you to our waiter during Saturday brunch, Charles, who anticipated and met our every need. A truly memorable stay at an unforgettable hotel. We, Cerina and Tenda, highly recommend NOBU HOTEL SHOREDITCH.

title: Is this Nobu ???????
text: Never again ! First of all please try to find it ! It's super hidden in a super sleepy Shorditch corners, even london taxi driver was going mad, now Hotel rather hostel as ..... no service what so ever. All staff is very busy but not with guests...just with themselvs. as looks like they are not use to them and still in pre- opening pace, that a side or Besides, when you think Nobu- you think great food and busy place, this one is completely opposite. No one in the restaurant with average and super overpriced menu. Staff is very friendly but seriously unprofessional and left alone by misterious Nobu management. I think you should do, you do best ! Restaurants in busy places but wait a bit with hotels as clearly you need mooooooore time and definitely moooooore experience.

title: Yuzu at its best
text: Planned a visit to Nobu in Shoreditch and enjoyed every minute.The Japanese Kinto hand brew coffee has to be the best I have ever had - very well balanced and as explained by the waitress, requires four pours. The yuzu tart that we chose to accompany the coffee was superb with a slight tang.

title: affordable cool hotel in east london
text: Minimalist, japanese style hotel. Kind of same as all the Nobu development around the world. Best thing is you have nobu restaurant as your room service. Cool property. Service was a bit slow but acceptable. Cool cocktails.

title: Loved it, would highly recommend!
text: I absolutely loved it here! The rooms are amazing, the bathroom design is absolutely gorgeous, love the gold accents! The dining was incredible. The facilities are fab, especially the gym and the sauna! The staff are very kind and helpful. When I arrived a young man called Luke was kind enough to give me a tour and he was so lovely, literally genuinely seemed like he was happy to help me and all of my silly demands and questions ahaha. I felt so comfortable here. And I will be staying again! :)

title: New hotel but not perfect
text: Grabbed 1 night for £226. The hotel was next to a building site but overall was good. Bar had a good selection although I hate the 12.5% service charge when I simply buy a beer from the bar (welcome to London). Arrived back at 3.30am to friendly staff. At 9am drills/workmen woke me and they continued until I checked out at 11.30am. Bed was comfy, TV massive. I didn't try the breakfast. I'd visit again.

title: Home away from home
text: I’ve been coming to this hotel regularly for the last 9 months. Every time I stay I like it more. This past week I requested a free upgrade which understandably they did not give me, as it meant too many nights not cashing in. Unfortunately, they assigned me a room on the first floor, quite noisy in early morning and with a couple minor issues on top. I complained in the morning to reception. They told me they would fix it. At 5pm I received an email saying that they would change my room, asking when I would be there to move my stuff. When I answered 9pm, they offered to move everything for me, and I came back to a new upgraded room on the 5th floor. The staff is excellent: Helpful, discrete, smart and efficient. A special mention to the spanish and german team in reception, Gabby and the rest of the team. Room service menu is very good, beds are excellent and tv connectivity very convenient. Decoration is relaxing and warm, and scarce at the same time. I normally go with a corporate rate, and that did include a served breakfast, which was good but quantities were poor and was a bit slow. They have now replaced it with a buffet of excellent quality and variety of Japanese, spanish and continental breakfast. It’s also quick and convenient. Gym is good, never crowded, and spotless. Food in the restaurant is expensive, but to be expected at Nobu. Downsides: - No loyalty program, shame given what I spend there, - Expensive room service (portions slightly small) Will continue to go there as much as possible.

title: Best Place Ever
text: Where can I begin, from the moment the taxi dropped us off at the hotel we were greeted by the doorman, walked inside and were treated like royalty. Kavi and India one of the hotel employees went above and beyond to make our stay great. Besides the hotel opening up only a week prior to our arrival, it was a great location and the rooms were great. We had the honor to meet the GM Gigi and she was awesome! You must eat at Nobu great ambience. There was a GQ and Warner Brothers music private event and it was star studded weekend including London's new favorite Californians us! Will definitely stay here next year upon our return and will always tell everyone planning on going to London they must stay here at the Nobu Hotel!

title: Cool design in fun neighborhood
text: We stayed for only one night this December. Rooms have some cool Asian inspired design elements but I wouldn't say that I was wowed. Service was good and friendly but not spectacular. They fixed everything we asked for but you don't get that extra feeling that you do in a top notch place. We both had dinner and breakfast at the restaurant. The place looks great. We have never dined at a Nobu restaurant before so we enjoyed trying that out. The food delivered and the cocktails were very good. Dinner was Saturday evening and it was bit crowded and buzzing. A few hours later we sat there again and at first we were the only people there. The whole place was zen quiet. Is this really the same place? Fun feeling. I like the surrounding Shoreditch area with lots of street art and quite a lot of stores and cafes that aren't part of the usual suspects that you find everywhere. And I didn't mind the 10 minute walk to Liverpool Street Station if you want go elsewhere in the city.

title: Wonderful service
text: I stayed for one night with my wife for her birthday: all our family joined us for dinner in the restaurant. We could not fault anything. The room was beautifully designed, and very comfortable. The food in the restaurant was memorable, with friendly and efficient service. But most impressive was the help we got on reception, particularly from the manager Martine, when it turned out that there was a problem with our booking (our fault). She not only sorted it out for us most efficiently but could not have been warmer or more welcoming, culminating in a birthday sweetmeats delivery to our room. We will come again !

title: Comfortable Stay
text: The best part of the two night stay was the room which was quiet and very comfortable. The meal for six colleagues at the Nobu restaurant was fine but service very slow. Most staff were helpful although it is perhaps a hotel that is a little too much into itself beyond actual substance. The location is good for all that Shoreditch now has to offer.

title: On point!
text: Everything in the hotel was on point. The rooms are amazing. The vibe in the hotel is exactly what you would expect. I had an English breakfast with a Japanese twist and it was on another level. Bed was super comfortable. If you want a trendy modern hotel this is it. Excellent.

title: A polished kind of Shoreditch
text: Nobu Hotel Shoreditch is properly sleek.. with minimalist rooms that are delightfully tranquil considering they are in the heart of such a pulsatingly vibrant & trendy part of London. The famed restaurant its self does urban chic to a luxury level with great cocktails, amazing sushi & the added bonuses of an open kitchen and outdoor multi level terrace overlooking it all. Expensive. Yes. A little way to go before they settle into effortless service to match the effortlessly cool design.. but it's most of the way there!

title: Amazing weekend
text: Had a fantastic weekend at Nobu Shoredich. Great modern hotel, with fantastic staff and a bonus (for me) is dog friendly. We stayed in a suite, that while a little small is well appointed, with a massive comfy bed, 55" TV, Nespresso coffee maker etc etc. It also has a terrace

title: 3rd stay, a fantastic experince! Great design, location and staff.
text: We loved staying at the Nobu on our third visit since they opened in the Summer. Great design, the rooms are very comfortable and clean. The staff are professional and helpful. They made our visit over the Christmas holiday very pleasant and personal. We will be back again soon!

title: Slick, chic and fabulous
text: I have just recently stayed at Nobu and have nothing but praise for this gorgeous gem of a hotel. I purely visited Shoreditch to experience the Nobu effect! I am not a big fan of Japanese food or in fact Shoreditch but this was of no importance as I had such a fantastic time.The staff were incredible and were soon to help me in my quest of non Japanese food restaurants and interesting and quirky places to visit in the surrounding area. This hotel may be fabulous and a slick operation but to me what shines through are the staff!! In particular two members of the Nobu family, Henrik and Simona. What a credit they are to this hotel. Unbelievably helpful, patient, funny and kind. What more could you want in lovely Hotel staff! I most definitely will be back, fan or no fan of Japanese food and Shoreditch!

title: Details, details....
text: In so many ways, the Nobu is trying its hardest and often hitting the mark. The room attendants do an impeccable job, separate heating for the bathroom vs living space is a luxurious and very practical touch, and the bar is a fabulous mix of zen chic. But unfortunately I also got to experience the sincere and well-meaning issue resolution skills of management. Perhaps its a side-effect of Nobu pitching itself as a relaxed and soothing oasis...so when things don't work well, it grates even more. The most significant fail on this trip was the fact that I selected the hotel (with breakfast included) specifically because it said on its website that it had a buffet breakfast option. I'm a shamelessly fussy eater and hate being one of those annoying guests who asks for a variation to every item on my plate. I especially hate being that person at 7am in the morning. So I book places with buffet breakfasts to avoid the issue. To their credit, the manager I spoke to was very polite and the restaurant staff tried to give me what I asked for. But this awkward situation was really the exact thing I was trying to avoid by booking this place with a buffet breakfast in the first place! But the detail that really grated: 4 days after I raised the issue, the website still said breakfast was buffet style.... Overall, Nobu seems green. I wish I'd loved the experience because I travel to London a lot, but with so much competition I will try somewhere else next.

title: Too new to be judged
text: It was too early to be Judged. The hotel was newly opened with uncompleted upper floor. Service was very friendly, but not so trained. Room was almost new and super clean with organic amenities in the bathroom. Since I traveled from Asia, it left me the feeling ‘NY meets Asia’ furnitures and interiors.
