text: Stayed here while attending a wedding around the corner. Staff were great and very welcoming! Rooms were very clean, tidy and extremely comfortable. Breakfast came with the room... which was delicious! Would stay again!

title: The Half Moon is THE place...to stay
text: We were looking for a nice place in the neighborhood for family reunions and a possiblity to spend long weekends for future visits. What we have found is far more than we could have expected! The Half Moon is THE place...uterly charming in every way, rooms are cozy, generous in size, bed is super comfy, bathroom has the right mix of style and meets all needs of the modern traveller. The Staff is exceptionally nice and charming. Bar and Restaurant are State of the Art, not to forget to mention the award winning breakfast served. A buffet and a la carte menue with complimentary coffees and teas any style are top-notch. Every single dish a warm welcoming and a perfect Start into the day (skip lunch for sure).

title: Great hotel with dim lighting
text: We had 5 rooms for 2 nights whilst working in the area. The Staff were excellent and the hotel is very comfortable. The only area for improvement was the lighting. The hotel was stuffed full of trendy LED filament lamps that looked great but didn't provide sufficient light. Maybe it's an age thing but I like some areas of a room to be well lit. Food looks better if you can see it properly.

title: Friday family dinner
text: Great food, convivial atmosphere and efficient service. Very nice restaurant and very comfortable for a pleasant night out at the end of the week. Should have bread on the menu with olive oil etc. We had to have a special order which was a little strange but they were very helpful in meeting our needs (at no charge!)

title: Great pub/hotel
text: Great stay. Recently refurbished. Clean and tidy. Helpful friendly staff. Good breakfast. Not cheap but average for the area. City location but close to Brockwell Park and Herne Hill station with direct services to Victoria.

title: AMAZING PLACE!!
text: Great location. Amazing pup. Unreal room. Superb Breakfast. Will definitely be staying again but for longer. The service we had from the minute we walked inside was 5*. The room was incredible, everything was on hand & the finish was grade A.

title: Beautifully appointed rooms, amazing staff and great breakfast
text: We had to unexpectedly stay here for a couple of nights due to a problem at home. It's close to Herne Hill station and there are several local bus routes that go into central London. The pub has a restaurant and there's a great pizza place and an excellent fish and chip shop close by. I hadn't been to the Half Moon since its refurbishment and was really impressed with the restoration. We had a huge room which was beautifully furnished and decorated, including a period fireplace. The bed was huge and very comfortable. We had a lovely walk-in shower, large fluffy towels, bathrobes, slippers and the complimentary bath products are good quality. There is a fridge with a bottle of free water and a pint of milk - there's also a coffee machine and decent tea provided. Everything about the room shows a fine eye for detail and an appeciation of quality. The only thing I would add is that the hotel wouldn't suit a light sleeper as it's on a busy junction and above a pub. We were on the first floor - we didn't hear any noise from the bar below us but there is traffic noise and voices of people outside. The breakfast was fabulous with a range of hot and cold choices - the hot food is all freshly cooked and really good quality. The greatest asset the hotel has is the staff. Everyone was really kind and helpful, carrying our bags for us and ordering a cab when we left. You would have to go a long way to experience this level of quality in London at these prices.

title: Fawlty Fish
text: Happened across the newly refurbished restaurant as part of a works do and had a pretty good basic club sandwich and chips. The service was slow but we weren't in too much of a hurry so it didn't matter. And then the fish and chips arrived for a fellow diner who is allergic to eggs. I cannot tell you how unappetising the fish looked on his plate - naked no less. I wish I'd taken a picture! Not skinned, not made to look edible, limp, slimy - we all gasped in horror! Surely they could have dressed it, skinned it, boned it...done something to it rather than just slap it on the plate.

title: Lovely stay, very clean and good breakfast
text: The rooms were very clean and well equipped. Bathrooms too. You couldn't hear noise from the pub below which was good but the windows were thin and sirens on main raod audible til 11pm approx. - ears plugs good if your a light sleeper. Also the coffee was not to our taste but no biggy. Good tea bags in rooms! Lovely hosts and breakfast quick and tasty.

title: Really lovely stay
text: We had a really lovely stay, the staff are really friendly and helpful and we also enjoyed a very good breakfast. We stayed in a small room but it was very well presented and had everything we needed, we would stay again.

title: Quirky location, compact rooms but fantastic breakfasts!
text: Quirky decor, interesting location, fantastic breakfasts, helpful staff but very compact rooms. Ours wouldn't easily accommodate a medium sized suitcase without us tripping over it. There's no communal lounge area. Transport into Central London is possible via the overground rail station nearby, but for the convenience of the tube use the bus to Brixton. An uber from Central London costs £11-16.

title: Dinner in the restaurant
text: Well looked after and catered for, the newly refurbished Half Moon pub is a delight. Recommend for anything from a drink to dinner & a stay in the hotel. Had a wonderful 2 course meal - decent portions. Would massively recommend dessert, I had the crumble which was really quite outstanding.

title: Fantastic
text: We stayed here as it was close to our Sons home. We were a little apprehensive as it was a pub but we had no need to worry. The Staff were brilliant, very relaxed and friendly, the room was amazing with aircon (which was welcome as it was 33 degrees outside) and beautifully decorated. It was spotlessly clean and the bed was really comfortable. Breakfast was really good, our Son came to join us and the staff said he could eat with us as their guest which we thought was a really nice gesture. You would pay at least 3 times the price in central London and yet Herne Hill is a 10 min train ride to Blackfriars bridge and you don’t need to use the tube!! Perfect stay, thanks to everyone at the Half Moon!

title: One night stay
text: Character-full room. Handy setting. Interesting building and pub. Courteous staff. No milk in room but otherwise fine. It did seem a bit overpriced - £160 for two above a busy pub. Had a good sleep despite being next to a busy road.

title: Good location and standard
text: Refreshing change from a standard hotel with huge room and bathroom and quirky stylish touches with comfort. Only down side is that it is London Central price bracket. Staff were all very welcoming and helpful and the overall mix of dining and outside garden bar area made for a good stay

title: Faultless stay
text: Beautiful, clean, recently renovated room with lovely free-standing bath in bathroom. Nice little touches like nespresso machine and teapigs were appreciated. Breakfast was perfect - a choice of lovely pastries, cereals, drinks etc whilst we waited for our hot food to arrive (you can order as much as you like, all included in the price of the room) - our host Karen was amazing, super attentive and welcoming and really made our stay :)

title: Best Hotel Pub in London
text: While this is outside the main areas of attraction, the Half Moon is just a short cab ride or tube ride from the city center

title: Beautiful
text: We stayed in the suite which had a king sized bed and 2 sofa beds (already made up as beds). It's a huge room, full of character. Lots of windows with blackout curtains. Everyone had a really good sleep followed by an amazing breakfast served by really friendly staff who made my 3 small boys feel very welcome and completely at ease.

title: Highly recommend- superb service, great food very comfortable, clean room.
text: A little Gem! Exceeded our expectations . It was beautifully presented, the food was delicious, the staff were friendly and our room was just lovely. The restaurant was clean tidy and set out well. On arrival we were greeted and shown to our room. It was cosy and decorated in keeping with the building. The bed was confy and aided a good sleep!! We would stay here again and have already shared The Half Moons details with others! Well done to you all and Thank You!

title: Lovely place to stay
text: Booked here to see leftfield at Brixton academy, as we needed somewhere close and cheap. It was about the same price as most travelodge type places and thought we could walk to Brixton. Didn't know what to expect as it wasn't opened when we booked, and what a pleasant surprise! Had the most wonderful room, in a superb location. Free roadside parking in the next Street. Right next to the railway. Had everything we needed or could ask for. I suspect the prices will have doubled next time we try to stay here, or its full booked as it is truly amazing.

title: Great
text: Attending our daughters birthday party at the Workshop. Other family members also stayed at the hotel. Our stay coincided with the Lambeth Country Festival! The hotel was so busy and we thought we would be kept awake with the noise. Not so. Great nights sleep.

title: Easter Sunday Lunch
text: At the princely sum of £18 one would expect a freshly prepared Sunday roast and lamb on the menu. Instead we received tasteless overcooked beef with a bowl of overcooked veg, hard roast potatoes and dry Yorkshire pudding. All of which had clearly been sitting on the side all day. I asked for a glass of tap water, nothing came. No one came to ask how the food was or offer us drinks and no one came to clear the table! While the restoration of the Half Moon is very beautiful the food service and prices are abysmal. I shall not return.

title: Well placed hotel for our needs
text: We were attending a family party and the Half Moon was within ten minutes walk from the venue so was extremely convenient. The room (Bean) we had was very small but we were aware of this in advance. The air conditioning in the room worked extremely well in the very hot weather as without it, it would have been very hot. The shower in the en suite was great. The room was well equipped but we felt that the pod coffee machine was not necessary as instant tea and coffee has always been sufficient for our needs. The staff were very welcoming, cheerful and helpful. More variety in cereals and fruit at breakfast would have been welcome.

title: Excellent
text: I would recommend this Boutique Hotel. It was amazing. The service was great and very obliging. The way to the train station to Victoria was reachable in one minute. So we had in that case also a really good connection to the underground station. The rooms have been very individual and furnished really lovely. The bed was comfortable.

title: Hidden Gem
text: We had a really lovely stay at The Half Moon Hotel. It's a hidden gem with beautiful boutique bedrooms. We had dinner & breakfast in the hotel and both were excellent. The staff couldn't do enough for us.

title: Everything was excellent
text: First Class, the room had everything we needed. Its recently been refurbished so all fittings and deco are virtually new. Room and food and especially the staff make this a great place to say and eat. Will definitely return

title: A great last minute find
text: We only booked the Half Moon 48 hours before our stay and what a find, we were given excellent and friendly service from the minute we entered the premises. Loved the room and the mix of quirky modern design and the wealth of original Victorian features. Food and wine were also excellent at lunchtime. We will return, convienient for central London just 15 to 20 minutes from St Pancras or Victoria from Herne Hill Station,

title: Book it! You won't regret it!
text: I personally prefer small boutique hotels are they are unique and in this case, exceptional. Super friendly staff, amazing room (specially for music lovers and coffee people) that had everything you need and more (comfiest bed and bathrobes, toiletries and great taste deco) and superb a la carte breakfast with proper coffee and delicious food. I know that there's always room for improvement but I think this time my stay was flawless. I can't wait to be back. Thank you Half Moon Hotel!

title: Excellent !
text: We enjoyed our experience at Half Moon pub. The welcome was warm, very clean rooms, attentive staff. The food was excellent, breakfast very and hearty. We recommand this hôtel. Thank you very much for everything.

title: Lovely stay
text: Really lovely atmousphere, room was clean, elegant and had all we needed. We recieved a warmwelcome although it took a while to get noticed at check in. Bed was extreamly comfortable and slept well. Breakfast was fantastic. Outside garden was great too. Would definlately reccommend and return.

title: Birthday trip
text: I booked this hotel for the night before my birthday as I was staying in London. The rooms are exactly as the pictures are and are brilliant, the breakfast in the morning was amazing and as it was my birthday I was given 2 candles in an amazing pancake. We are definitely going to stay again.

title: Great place
text: We stayed for one night as it was close to a concert we were attending, the location was great, easy to get too. The reception we received was welcoming, the pub has a good vibe, the sun was shining and there were quite a few people enjoying the beer garden. Our room was excellent, really interesting furniture and colours, and everything we needed. There were robes, slippers and a fridge with water, milk and beer! The room had a coffee machine, tea making facilities (and biscuits) The bathroom was well stocked with toiletries and had a large shower. Perfect!! The bed was so comfortable it was difficult to get out of it, but it was worth it for the breakfast. Breakfast was in a lovely dining room, the produce was excellent quality and the service was fab. We would definitely return and would recommend this as a great place to stay. The area itself had some really interesting independent shops, bars and cafes, definitely worth exploring some more.

title: Fabulous hotel near Brixton area
text: Stayed here when attending a concert at the Brixton Academy - was very happy indeed with the quality of the hotel and of the service overall. The rooms are really very nice and quite quirky. East connectivity and just 10 minutes by car to the concert venue.

title: Lovely Traditional Pub Stay
text: I wanted to stay in an English pub and The Half Moon was everything I imagined a pub stay to be. I loves the clawfoot bathtub and the stain glass windows. Breakfast was delicious and the staff welcoming and extremely helpful. Plus, all the benefits of a pub like mulled wine on a cold night. Very festive!

title: Outstanding 5star
text: I'm usually very honest with reviews and keen to point out negatives, however the half moon blew away our expectations, from the warm welcome, (on a very busy festival day) decor, service, cleanliness, breakfast all amazing and will definitely be returning. Tip bring ear plugs it's on a main road, a little noisy bit nothing that bothered us. We stayed in Mitchell on 2nd floor and were also shown a suite on 1st floor both truly amazing rooms.

title: Nice pub, toilets smell like sweet chilli!
text: Good for drinks, and the toilet smell made me hungry! Went with friends on a Friday night after dinner and it was pretty busy. Staff were a bit slow at the part of the bar we were in, but apart from that it was nice.

title: Review
text: Fantastic place to stay. Hotel very clean..... location was brilliant for us with easy access to the train into central London. The staff where amazing and very accomidating. Food was also great. Defiantly would return.

title: Nick & Joy
text: All done at short notice. Booked by phone and everything done as promised. Good information about rooms and rates. Lack of parking could have been a deal breaker but we were able to park for free elsewhere.

title: I great location and beautiful rooms..
text: The well remodelled original period spacious rooms and garden make for a luxury and relaxing atmosphere plus fantastic location. Very special place for the price, with excellent food and outside roomy comfortable seating.

title: Very enjoyable stay
text: I had a very enjoyable stay at the Half Moon. I regularly visit London for meetings and stay overnight. This includes some of the larger mainstream hotels including the Hilton, Ramada, premier and so on. I was exceptional impressed with the service provided at the Half Moon, and in terms of the customer service provided, the amenities and the many little extras in the rooms, I certainly feel it compared more favourably than the chain hotels already referred to. It’s a busy venue in the evening and there is a train track running nearby. Please do not let this put you off. I’m a very sensitive (light sleeper) and the noise in the external environment was not an issue. A nice park is very close by for those who may enjoy an early morning job/stroll. The service at breakfast was amazing. Karen who was all-hands-on deck was warm, humouring and especially helpful. She had a natural giving nature which was endearing and it the kind of welcoming customer service which is just not forced (as you see in other places with the fake smile).

title: Gorgeous room , fab service !!
text: Beautifully decorated room , every convenience , fabulous shower , will definitely return. We had a family function close by which was great , but was almost disappointed at not eating at the hotel as there was a fantastic vibe in the bar , and breakfast the next morning was delicious.

title: Fabulous, no other words
text: A fantastic discovery which you would like to keep a secret. I can see the Hall Moon being a very popular destination. Not only excellent value for money but brilliantly located. The hotel and restaurant have all the feel of Hotel du Vin in its original incarnation ( without the wine list) but the attention to detail in the rooms is to be commended and the styling and thought and branding that makes this an experience. The beds and mattresses are super luxurious. Do be aware that the Half Moon is on a busy junction for cars and trains so do not expect it to be very quiet. The ground floor is a super busy pub and restaurant too. Traffic noise is part and parcel of the experience of staying in London.

title: Pub. An oasis for walkers with dogs or beer lovers.
text: What a lovely pub. After a very interesting walk we asked if dogs were allowed and were bowled over by the fact that they were not only welcome but spoilt as well. The beer was good and although we didn't eat, the food looked good. Memories are funny things but our memory of this pub is a welcoming pub with good ale and a fantastic staff. we enjoyed our visit.

title: Absolutely charming!
text: This place is fabulous! It’s boutique decoration is a feast to the eye. The staff is amazing, extremely helpful, friendly and make your stay extraordinary! Food is really good too!!! It’s very close to the train station and only 2 station away from Victoria and therefore easy access to the city centre.

title: Excellent!
text: Beautiful room, didn't expect to have complimenty drinks in the fridge so that was a bonus! Comfy bed, felt right at home 😊 Although the fire alarm went off in the middle of the night this didn't ruin our stay at all.

title: Bank holiday break
text: What a gorgeous place, completely taken away by the room we were given. I bid for the very kindly donated nights stay at a children’s charity event. The room was done to a very high standard, the bed was very comfortable and the room facilities spot on. The restaurant was lovely and food prepared and served wonderful. Thanks!!

title: Perfect!
text: I'm not normally one for reviews but had to comment on the brilliant service that I received from the staff at The Half Moon, especially Ann-Marie! The suit I had was amazing and it really felt like home from home.... more than met my expectations.

title: Loved it!
text: Though we had some minor issues with our room, it was still utterly fabulous -- the Armstrong suite is the roomiest accommodation I can possibly imagine in the center of south London for a family of 3 or 4. It's in the heart of the city, so there are some sirens and sounds of the city at night. But the bus and the train are seconds from the front door and the breakfast was the heartiest most delicious I've ever had at any hotel anywhere.

title: Waited ages
text: We stopped off here for a pint on the way home from playing football on a Saturday late afternoo. The place wasn’t too busy but there were only two bar staff working across the two large bar sections, which resulted in a ridiculous wait to be served drinks. The barmaid was receiving some very irate criticism from a woman who felt she had been waiting too long, when clearly this wasn’t her fault at all. This was a failure by Management to adequately staff the bar, resulting in angry customers and an obviously unhappy barmaid. It’s a shame because the pub is nice and has some decent beers on offer.

title: Service issues fro staff
text: Very nice room with classical styling with nice stained glasses with really nice historic landscapes. Noise could be expected in London. However the hotel is placed on the corner of an intersection. Ambulances use to make a lot of noise crossing the intersection.

title: Great food and atmosphere service very average
text: Met some friends here for lunch We sat out the back in the beautiful beer garden (it has a play ground for the children but it was closed for maintenance work) The drinks were good and the place is very well decorated and has a great relaxed atmosphere to relax and enjoy your afternoon We had some lunch the menu is small but has some great choices I had the seared gnocchi it was delicious well presented and came fairly quickly after we ordered The only thing that let this place down was the service The bar staff were a little pre occupied and didn't seem very friendly and we ate around 1.45pm and when we left at 3.30pm the plates from our lunch and the glasses from throughout the afternoon had still not been cleared Overall a great place for lunch

title: A haven of comfort in a bustling city
text: Lovely traditional London Pub with quirky rooms only 2 mins walk from train station. Traffic noise is far quieter than we anticipated and the rooms of good standard and bed very comfy. Breakfast is very good and serve really late in the morning, so you can have a lie in! Staff very helpful and friendly. Would definitely return.

title: Fab local pub.... Friendly, nice beer selection and good food.
text: We’re super lucky to have this pub as a local. It’s a beautiful building - really well restored. A good menu with plenty of options (including vege), reasonably priced and great staff. Sam is our favourite but Paul and the rest of the team are fab. All relaxed, friendly and efficient. They have regular events, live jazz once a month and a big outdoor space. Separate restaurant space if you don’t fancy dining in the main pub (although we love it). You must visit!

title: fantastic food and atmosphere
text: my daughter has recently moved to the area and we were checking out the sunday roasts and chose the pub for its lively feel. i can honestly say this was one of the best roast beefs i have had in a long time. all home cooking... no aunt bessies roast potatoes here only the real thing. this tradtional but also modern pub had such a great vibe and full of happy smiley people. the service was great not rushed but not sloppy either. only thing you really need to bear in mind is that you're paying london prices so may be a coupla quid more than you're used to but definately not over-priced. all in all we'd definately go back...fab !!

title: Great building, food and beer
text: Hidden Victorian architectural Gem in South London serving good food, great beer with really neat hotel rooms. Fantastic value and great service (especially from the terrific Monica!). You won't be disappointed.

title: Poor service, average Sunday roast.
text: This is my local pub and it is beautiful inside. Unfortunately, each time I have been the service has been terrible with bar staff chatting rather than serving, staff being told about a problem and not doing and anything about it and general bad service.I finally thought I better review after having a Sunday roast with friends in the restaurant area. When lunch arrived there were no green vegetables and not much gravy so we asked for both. After eating some of the lunch we waited for the veg and gravy. Eventually we had to ask staff and were told they had ran out of green veg. They eventually came over with one jug of gravy which they were unsure of it was veggie or not (we had one vegetarian in the group). Generally the service was really poor. The food was ok but didn't feel like a Sunday roast with all the trimmings (Yorkshire pudding, meat, roast potato and carrot). There are plenty of places close by which are cheaper and much more delicious. I was very disappointed!

title: Lovely room, great food!
text: I booked this as a surprise for my partner as we were going to a gig at the Brixton academy, well what can I say a lovely warm welcome on arrival! Complementary beers in the fridge and a large roll top bath, for this price and near enough in central London it was a fantastic stay. Surprisingly quiet given the proximity of the road and railway station - I will be booking again!

title: Exceptional Hotel
text: I stayed here for one night when going to a gig in Brixton. After a long day of travelling, the busy bar and bustling restaurant could not have been more welcoming. The room was incredible, bed divine and the home cooked breakfast in the morning was everything I needed after a big night out. Staff were incredibly welcoming and courteous. I can't speak highly enough of this place and would recommend for anyone visiting South London.

title: Defintely coming back
text: Gorgeous pub/hotel. With very friendly and helpful staff. Always on reach for any questions. Location is also fantastic. Close to some shops and a beautiful park. We had breakfast and dinner there - fantastic quality

title: Lovely corner or London
text: Really stylish hotel with a buzzing pub underneath. We stayed on the 2nd floor and the room we had (mitchel) was a really really cool space. Lovely breakfast and super friendly staff. And Brockwell Park is a lovely walk to take afterwards.

title: Fantastic find in London!
text: We chose this hotel in South London as we were visiting a friend not far away. As soon as we arrived we knew we'd found something a bit different and quite special for London. The staff were friendly and welcoming and as soon as we saw our room we we loved it! Spacious, high ceilings, great decor, period features and the new 'bits' had been done really sympathetically. It was just lovely and if I could score more than 5 on Trip Adviser, I would! Breakfast service on day 1 was a little slow and disorganised, but nothing too major. The choice on the breakfast menu was good, with lots of alternatives to the traditional 'full English' (though that was there for anyone who wanted it). It was the little touches that really made it - fresh milk in your room, 'proper coffee' machine, complimentary water and beer in the bedroom fridge etc. etc. It was a lovely place to stay and we'll definitely be going back!

title: Beautiful rooms, clumsy service
text: New to hotel business, the HalfMoon might have some service kinks to work out, including: - Communication between shifts - memory of guests and needs - housekeeping service - meeting in-room booklet description of rooms (for example - irons, speaker, etc...) - no room service even though the restaurant is below Rooms are beautifully designed and staff is very kind.

title: Great little hotel/pub
text: Overnight business trip. Really pleasant room. Well styled and thoughtful even down to complementary bottle of ale. Reception staff were very helpful and the ladies at breakfast were delightful. Couldn't have been more helpful.

title: Amazing space, ridiculous pricing
text: I visited the Half Moon this evening, me and a friend went in for a pint of the finest local brew by Canopy Brewery. I was staggered to see that they think it's acceptable to charge £5.90 per pint. Keep in mind that at Canopy Brewery itself, based around 50 metres away, they charge £4.00, and it tastes better. The barman justified the price because of "alcohol tax", which is laughable at best. It's bitterly disappointing, this is such a beautiful space, but they seem to be paying for the renovation by extorting customers.

title: Awful
text: What a shocking place. Hardly anything on the menu, caesar salad couldn’t be served without anchovy’s it came with no chicken. Apple crumble without apples. Over priced. Poor menu. Waitress kept coming out to deliver bad news regarding our order, never been to a place like it. DONT GO HERE!!!!

title: Excellent new hotel in Herne Hill near station, park and ameneties.
text: Excellent new hotel with good service from arrival. Room decor were really fun and well equipped. Decent shower and comfortable beds. Aircon is a welcome facility as the road is busy and can be noisy with the windows open at the front. Food is good but not cheap.

title: Excellent
text: Great atmosphere food excellent staff very friendly made very much welcome roast dinner was very good and service was great bedrooms clean and tidy staff looked after us the whole time we where there great place too stay 5 stars

title: Lovely pub with rooms

title: Superb service, accommodation and food
text: Great accommodation

title: Excellent Service and Beautiful Property
text: The review title says it all. The property is close to the train station and is around 10-15 minutes to the center. I enjoyed my stay at the property and would definitely come back when I'm in London.

title: nice stay in Herne Hill
text: The food, drink service and room were all top notch, this made a great weekend and gave us a great base for a nice weekend in London. We would certainly stay at the half moon again and would recommend the hotel

title: Excellent pub with rooms
text: We thoroughly enjoyed the warm ambience of our short stay here last weekend. The staff are all very friendly and helpful and the suite we had was simply exceptional. Breakfast was delicious too. The road and train noise were disappointing but then we live in a quite street so others might not find the noise so much of an issue. It wont stop us returning !

title: Great stay
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this quirky very well done up hotel. The staff are so lovely and the breakfast yummy. Herne Hill overground station is just round the corner and Brixton tube station about 15mins walk. Certainly recommend, thank you.

title: Beautiful room, shame the service doesnt reflect
text: I stayed the night before and night of my wedding with the rest of our families. Absolutely beautiful rooms, but the service from the hotel staff didn't reflect. Our families encounted a chaotic and confused check in, loss of power in their room and I had to clear cups, glasses and rubbish in my wedding dress the night of my wedding as this wasn't done by housekeeping - despite requesting. Water, tea, cups, glasses and toilet paper were also not replenished. This level of service just isn't in line with the beauty of the rooms, fantastic food in the dining room or price paid for all the above!!

title: Bad lighting
text: Nice staff greeted us for our Christmas stay.We were visiting family nearby. Our room was a good size with good bedding and a nice bathroom( would have been better without the dead palm) However, the lighting in the room is terrible with an overhead light and bedside lights, one of which didn't work. I can see what they were aiming for but the vintage furniture and dark walls are not my style and very miserable on a winter day. Breakfast was good with plenty of choice. There was a problem with a leaking orange juice bottle and the juice was running all over the table and the floor. At the price they charge this should not happen. We had dinner once for our party of eight from a restricted Christmas menu which was OK. There seemed to be an issue with our of the waitress when we asked for the bill to be charged to our room but this was soon sorted by a very helpful young man. If we can find an alternative we will not stay here again but we may struggle.

title: Welcoming, comfortable, great breakfast
text: The title pretty much says it all - a friendly and easy place to lay one's head for the night - and the breakfast (included in room price) was really very good. From check-in to poached eggs, the staff were friendly, obliging and all you'd want really. We won't bother looking for anywhere else next time we're in HH.

title: good choice
text: In a small town. The hotel is very near the train station, easy to go everywhere. Three stops to Victoria Station. Reasonable pricing. However,a bit noisy to sleep as near the street. Excellent breakfast!

title: Lovely friendly staff and atmosphere - and the foods good too!
text: I organised a lunchtime birthday party for twelve people at this venue. The staff made this very easy and couldn't have been more eager to please and help. In the event it all went off extremely well and we were well looked after. The restaurant is lovely and bright with sunlight able to pour in through the large windows - unlike most pub eating areas which tend to be rather dark and heavy. The food was good and everyone was pleased with their choice. Their portions are large - but somehow we all managed to do it justice! Thank you to Ann-Marie and her staff for making this such a great event and allowing me, as the organiser, to be totally relaxed. For us its a great local venue and I recommend that if you haven't tried it, then go!!

title: Lovely stay but expensive
text: We reallly enjoyed everything about our stay - the room, service, breakfast, etc hence the rating Score. Noise could be an issue if you were at the front (busy road) and popular pub downstairs. And it was too expensive.

title: nights stay at the half moon
text: very excellent rooms, with beautiful decor. although situated above a lovely pub the noise from downstairs was minimal and never affected our sleep. recommend to anyone and will definitely be going back

title: Superb
text: Prime location in south London adjacent to herne hill Station . Fabulous bar with professional staff and great atmosphere . Rooms were clean and good size , some noise from traffic but only as you’d expect in such a central location . Lots of cool bars shops nearby , fabulous breakfast, eggs cooked to order and very reasonsbly priced, stay here , your won’t be disappointed

title: Absolutely amazing
text: I have never encountered better customer service. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. They tried to cater to my every need and I had a great time chatting with them. My room was very neat and tidy and the the hotel being near Westfield Shopping Centre and Central Line I couldn't have asked for a better location. This hotel is highly recommended. Hopefully I'll be coming here many times in the future.

title: Convenient location, calm and cosy room
text: I have stayed in this hotel several times, because it is well situated with direct connections to Heathrow airport (purple line) and the city center (red line). Its location is also very good for shopping (Westfield and TK Maxx within walking distances). The hotel is rather small with family-like atmosphere. Rooms are refurbished and renovated, with a TV, a fridge and a kettle in each room. Breakfast is good (although finishes too early at 9am). People at reception are very friendly and helpful. Our room was cleaned and towels were changed every day. I would stay there again.

title: Friendly Staff
text: A great place to stay with knowledgeable and friendly Staff, very nice breakfast and breakfast room, and a good location right in between Sheperd's Bush and Hammersmith. Bus stops are right outside, and it's also an easy walk to trains. I'll be back again.

title: 5 stars

title: amazing service

title: Comfortable stay
text: We got a very warm welcome and everyone was very friendly. It was a nice updated clean room. Overall was happy. Having hairdryer fixed would be better as we had to ask. It's also a good location and breakfast is just wow. Generally very happy with hotel. U made us feel like family. That's a lot from me and Susan.

title: Great Stay at Comfotel Prpl
text: My short stay at Comfotel Prpl near Shepherd's Bush was comfortable. Mr. Badar our host was really supportive. The breakfast was nice too. For a continental breakfast the choices of food items were great. We could occasionally use the microwave as well.

title: budget hotel but a bit fancy

title: Hotel great - breakfast poor
text: You check in at hotel next door but it was great, chap very friendly and check in quick. . No room to swing a cat but cosy, well equipped, TV with digital channels and great bathroom. Still gave 4 stars as the check in was so good and room so comfy. There is a cafe across the road so all good in the end.

title: Everything was fine.

title: Lovely stay

title: Ideal and will visit again

title: Cannot review this property, as got sent across the road to the 'Euro Hotel' and it was HORRIBLE!
text: BEWARE: You might not stay at this hotel! Booked this hotel as corporate travel for a business trip. Arrived at the hotel, and there was a sign on the door saying to go to the 'Euro Hotel' (Across the road) to check in there instead. Arrived at the Euro hotel, and checked in, but was told that our room was actually in that hotel instead - but was reassured there was no difference. There DEFINITELY is a difference! title: Best Value for Money in London!!
text: This hotel is exactly what you need for a couple of nights in London - it is basic but has everything you need if you’re staying for leisure. We had a double room en-suite. It was small but had modern decor and great facilities such as a fridge and a hairdryer! This hotel is handily situated a short 10 minute walk from Shepard’s bush underground station. There are plenty of restaurants, fast food places, coffee shops, etc in the immediate area. Check in and out was really quick - no problems. Staff were very friendly and more than happy to accommodate us. We left our bags as we arrived before check in and even after checking our, they were happy to let us leave our bags again while we explored the city for the day. We also had breakfast include in our price. There were pastries, a small selection of hot food and cereals. Amazing for the price of £60 for a double room AND breakfast in London! I would highly recommend if you’re looking for a budget hotel in London.

title: Business meeting!

title: Hotel with every inch of space used and ship cabin like rooms, but with nice value/money ratio
text: The value/money ratio keeps the overall impression of this place above average. Especially the location is nice, close to underground stations, with bars, food and grocery stores nearby, but not so busy. The rooms are super tiny, actually, I think I haven't seen smaller rooms, but the fact is that for short stay, it is absolutely sufficient. I appreciate that the facilities seems new and fresh and there is no major issue with cleanliness. With exception of mold in a shower and thick layer of sediment on the shower head which feels distasteful in otherwise modernly furnished bathroom. It is a pity since I think this is an easy to solve issue. Breakfast is quite limited and does not look like at the pictures. There is one kind of sliced cheese, one kind of vegetables (tomato), eggs, beans, hash brown, instant coffee, no meat and packaged pastry without taste. If breakfast was optional I would go to nearby café for breakfast the next day.

title: Mr Valentyn
text: Very friendly hotel in a beautiful part of Shepherds Bush. Visitet it with 5 colleagues this month. Great breakfast and clean rooms.two tube station just 5 mints distance . Room was very clean and freah Thanks!

title: Good Position but grimy and unfriendly
text: We arrived a little early, so went to see if we could check in. We were not asked for any confirmation or ID but were given a keycard for a room. When we went in it was not ready, so we said we would come back later. On return we were provided with a different room, which at first glance seemed nice, newly refurbished. When I looked a little closer I realised it was not just dusty but was dirty. Luckily I had some baby wipes with me so wiped around the bathroom, as this had grime and pubic hairs. We did not dare use the toilet brush, as the brown residue put us off. There was a lot of dust around the bedroom, and the crockery was stained, along with the pillows. We were glad to see a fridge, but when we opened it noticed a pubic hair in there too. We were also missing a bath mat, so had to use a towel... and only had one clothes hanger. The breakfast was classed as continental but was actually quite good as Eggs, beans and toast was available, and were warm. Just a shame that the crockery and glassware was chipped, which as well as being unhygienic is a hazard. The staff were not very friendly, and shouted at one customer who did not clear the table themselves of dirty dishes. Breakfast the following day was more busy, and tables had not been cleared. We ended up having to clear and wipe our own table, and were told that there were no clean cups, so could not have tea. Breakfast was ok, but not as good as the previous. Again staff were most unfriendly. At check out I went to hand in my keycard. Reception was very abrupt, just being asked have i paid for everything. No hello or thank you. I would definitely come back to this location but I think I would stay at different accommodation that is cleaner and friendlier.

title: Friendly staff
text: Excellent location, close to Westfield shopping mall and restaurants. The tube is less than 250M. The room is comfortable with clean beddings. The front desk Manager-Badar, has been fantastic. Will surely visit again if only for his excellent assistance.

title: Wonderful hotel with clean rooms and friendly staff
text: Brilliant location as everything was near by, bedrooms were clean, tidy and spacious. Staff was friendly & helpful, breakfast was great with a lot to choose from. I would definitely recommend this hotel.

title: Very Disappointed
text: Unfortunately I didn’t enjoy my stay at this hotel and feel the photographs and description are misleading. I specifically went for a hotel which had a 24 hour reception as I was travelling alone and knew I would feel more comfortable. I was disappointed when I realised that the reception is across the road in another hotel, as this is not stated in the description and though may seem a minor complaint, was quite inconvenient and took away from a main factor for me booking this hotel. When I arrived I was put in a single room in the ‘loft’ of the hotel. It was extremely small, with one little window and was very hot. I could also here a lot from the room next door, who were keen on playing music out loud. I requested a double room immediately, but one was not available at this time, but a gentleman kindly found a single room which was a little bigger and more comfortable, though still small. He was very helpful and iterated that if I needed anything someone would be at the desk 24 hours a day. The next morning I went and asked for a double room of which they said one would be available that I could pay extra for which I was happy to do. My trip was for business reasons and therefore I was out of the hotel for most of the day. I came back to get the key for the double room to be told that they had given the room to another customer, even after they had promised me this room that same morning. Not only that, the gentleman on reception at this time was extremely rude and made me feel uncomfortable. He spoke rather aggressively which I did not appreciate especially as I was a lone female traveller and did not know the area. On arrival the same gentleman had told me their card payment was down and that I should pay at another time- then when requesting the payment, tried to tell me it was at my fault for not paying at the time of the arrival! Though he did make sure to apologise at the end of my trip- most likely so I didn’t write this kind of review. It was agreed that if I left my bags in reception the next morning, there would be a double room held for me for definite. I made sure the next morning I was up early to take my bags to the ‘24 hour’ reception. The problem was that no one was at reception, I waiting around 10-15 minutes before I had to leave for a meeting and there was no sign of someone arriving anytime soon. Later on that day I got hold of reception via phone call, where they said if my bags were packed they would collect them and put them in the double room. So finally I was in a double room, though still small, it was better than the single. Unfortunately it was very noisy at night with people arguing and rushing past my door as it was by stairs on the ground floor. I found it very hard to sleep with the noise and the heat. Conveniently there is a Sainsbury’s across the road, of which I went to walk to one day- only to find police checking the building and then continued to check the other properties along the road. I felt very uneasy and it didn’t give the best impression. The rooms were tidy, very simple- improvements needed in general. In the second single room I stayed in, the bathroom ceiling was growing mould. Window handle broken in double bedroom- general things like this lacking. You also don’t get topped up with shampoo etc- once it’s gone you’ll get no more. No mirror, tv ok, very small wardrobe space in double and only hooks to hang clothes in the single. I actually couldn’t imagine two people having to stay in the double, as I felt cramped on my own. I didn’t have the breakfast, so I can’t comment on that. Overall if you just want a room then you may be happy with this- it’s a short walk to the hammersmith shopping centre and tube very close. Though, overall my experience was poor and I will most certainly not be returning. Also- If you stay here in the summer prepare to be extremely hot as there is no air-con, no fan and the rooms feel like small greenhouses.

title: Good price for the room and the area
text: The hotel has a great location if you want to stay in the Shepherd's Bush area. Also it is great that it includes breakfast, that it is not too elaborated, but includes things like scrambled and friend eggs and hash browns, cereal, toasts, juice... No express coffee though, only instant one. The basement breakfast room was cosy and nice, with a patio that looked lovely (although it was quite chilly in all the place). The room was compact but had all I need and with enough space for one: bedside table with plugs, tea and coffee, kettle, a fan, a desk, a chair, hair dryer, small fridge, bin, window (with no view) and a good sized flat screen TV. There's a supermarket opposite the hotel and the Central Line Station is just 10 minutes away, with many shops and restaurants around. On the negatives, some of the lights were not working. The toilet was loose and moved when you sat. There was a huge black humidity stain on the ceiling over the shower. Just had a big towel and none other. The toiletries bag was soaked with the shampoo, so had to throw away the cotton buds and rinse everything else. The sheets seemed clean, but had some stains of the kind that never go away. There was no lift and the stairs were quite narrow. Walls were quite thin and you could hear people coming and going from other rooms and the street (as my room was the one facing the door on the first floor). Better bring earplugs! A very annoying thing was discovering (when I arrived to the hotel under heavy rain) that the reception is on the Eurohotel next to it, and you need to check in there (also both hotels had breakfast in the Comfotel building, so it can be busy). Overall, I'd repeat for the same price, probably not for more. The place could be lovely with some more care and cleanliness, but it's not a bad hotel at all and looks newer than many in London.

title: Okay, not great
text: Stayed in the family room with my wife and three young children. The room was of borderline acceptable standard of cleanliness

title: Visit

title: Nice and clean

title: Excellent service and staff
text: Stayed with family for the weekend. Lovely clean rooms. Breakfast was excellent and staff at the reception is very friendly and helpful. Accommodated all our needs. Good value for money. Would highly recommend.

title: Not great but not bad
text: Myself and 2 friends stayed here as we were attending a convention in August at Olympia. When we arrived we were greeted with 2 small doubles which would not have slept 3 people easily considering we are a mix of very tall and curvy girls. I ended up sleeping on the floor on the scratchy blanket that was stored away and no spare pillows. Needless to say I was uncomfortable!! The room was also very stuffy, thankfully we had an electric fan to try and keep us cool through the night. We couldn’t open the window due to the room being located at the front of the building on a very noisy and busy main road. As for breakfast this was probably the ‘better’ part of the stay, the choice was alright ranging from pastries to eggs and toast. The only problem being that no matter how early or late you arrive for it... you will have trouble sitting anywhere hence why one of our party had to stand to eat. The lack of disabled access to and in the building is a downfall in this day and age and would not recommend to anyone with joint issues or problems with stairs as there are many!! Bit annoying also that you have to wonder across the road for any extra amenities or assistance. I feel that charging £280+ for a party of 3, when one didn’t even have a bed, is not central and is a converted terrace house was over the odds. Overall not entirely pleasant but not exactly the worst. 2/5 stars for these reasons alone.

title: It’s alright
text: Not the best place I’ve stayed not the worst. It’s way smaller than the pictures show. All you can hear all night is the doors of the other rooms opening and closing and for breakfast it’s almost a fight to the death for a table but it’s a really quick walk to the olympia which is what we where attracted to. I’d probably never stay here again considering it was £250 for 3 people to stay in a room built for 2 maximum

title: 很方便的地點，友善的服務人員
text: 旅館、房間和浴室都很乾淨，櫃檯實際是在隔壁的Euro Hotel，櫃檯的Mr. Badar 非常友善，有任何問題都能尋求幫助，經營旅館13年，Comfotel Prpl約開業3年，設備保持的很乾淨，感覺也很新。早餐很基本，且外面有個小院子坐起來很舒適。附近有Tesco superstore, Sainsbury's local，走路一會就到Shepherd's Bush地鐵和Westfield商場，商場也有很多品牌，少了觀光客人潮，相對市中心逛起來舒服許多，這個區域相對安靜，走路大約10分鐘或坐2站公車就可以到Hammersmith地鐵站前往Heathrow機場。

title: Had a great stay

title: 2nd visit, still great value for money!
text: Was in the area for a weekend conference and decided to stay again as my last visit was really good! Can’t compliment the location enough, instant access to central London and easy to get to and from Heathrow as well! I was happy with the service I received during my two night stay, although my interaction was limited due to being at the conference for most of the day. The staff were always polite and I think they’ve done some renovations since I was last there. There was plenty of hot water and the bed was comfy enough not to disturb my sleep - and I normally struggle with that sort of thing! If I had to be picky, Check in was a little delayed as there were other guests checking in and out at the same time so that is probably an area for improvement. Will definitely be staying again when I’m here in a few months time!

title: Ok budget hotel

title: Best place to spend holidays
text: The hotel is located conveniently within a few minutes walk to tube station, which made it easier for us to travel within London. There is also a bus stop right outside the hotel. There are a few convenience shops nearby that are open late, as well as a pizza takeout, restaurants and bars within walking distance. The room itself is nice, comfortable and clean and had space for our luggage as well as room to sit with a couple of chairs, desk and table. There is an iron for clothes and a hairdryer (which is what I look for in every hotel). The shower was powerful enough (unlike in some hotels), Breakfast was good with continental and hot foods to choose from. There is a pub in the hotel serving drinks and food which is very convenient. Overall, this was a very pleasant stay and we will come back again!

title: Great Location and Friendly staff
text: I stayed here for 3 nights in March with my family. Great location in London, near westfield and public transport. The staff are also very friendly and go out of their way to help. Highly recommend it and will stay again !!

title: Cozy for short stays.
text: The Hotel is in a good location as it is near from main bus stops, tube and shopping centre (all in a 10 minutes walk), parking wise if you go by car is to park in Westfield Shopping Centre as it is only 8£ for 24 hours while on street parking is 2.90£/hr, bare in mind though if you are planning to leave your car more than 48 hours at the shopping centre you need to leave some car details. Family room size are good as they have plenty of room to move but will help to have a bigger wardrobe if you are going to spend more than a night. Wi-fi does it job. Breakfast is really nice, cereals, yogurts, fruit, toasts, pastries, scrambled egg, beans, hash-browns and even fried-eggs are made on the spot. En-suite double room is a lot smaller than expected but as I have only stayed overnight that was not a problem for us, but expected a bit more. (Pictures taken to promote the rooms are really well made), bathrooms are small and there is no bath in it. Also there is no PWD access.

title: A decent budget hotel
text: We've just stopped here for one night for a 2 day break in London. We are a family of 5 so I always find accommodation difficult to find if we want to just have one room. Hotel Balkan was found on booking.com at a reasonable price including continental breakfast. We arrived late which wasn't an issue and had to check in at th hotel next door. We were given room 5 which had 2 double beds and one single which was perfect for us. I was actually expecting a fifth makeshift bed so was pleasantly surprised to find an actual full size bed. The room had recently been renovated and had a brand new bathroom... fantastic shower! Breakfast was sufficient. It's a small room to accommodate the amount of people at the hotel. We just managed to get a table and breakfast consisted of toast, eggs, beans, cheese and tomatoes. For what we paid and what we got it was perfectly adequate. I would return as the hotel has just changed hands and lots of upgrade work was obviously being done. The only niggles were the gap under the room door... it let in a lot of light from the hall during the night and when we went to check out we had to wait about 15 minutes because reception was shut (this was at 9.30am). No parking at the hotel but it's only a 10 min walk from Westfields shopping centre where you can park for 24 hours for £8.

title: Can't understand the excellent reviews?!
text: Good location close to both Shepard's Bush and Goldhawk Lane tube stations. However, the hotel itself is basically a converted house. Check-in is at the hotel next door and over the road as this hotel has no reception or anything. On my first morning I found there was no hairdryer in the room and tried to find a member of staff to ask if there was a hairdryer I could use, however I couldn't find a member of staff anywhere and there was no staff member on the reception type hatch at the neighbouring hotel. The staff at breakfast were friendly and polite however could not speak English, at breakfast on day 1 I asked if one container was hot water and staff couldn't answer. Breakfast on day 2 I asked if there was nutella (as there had been the previous day) and the staff member shrugged and conveyed she couldn't speak English. The food was decent, all bought from Tesco as Tesco branding on everything - crossaints, cake, toast, cheeses, yoghurts, hash browns, scrambled eggs. Weirdly also jars of fish paste. The room itself was reasonably clean although there were a few long hairs in the bed and a small hole in the duvet. The room was tiny, a 3/4 size bed pressed against the wall and barely any room to get dressed. Also the window had a large crack which made me worry about safety as the room was on the ground floor. Overall weird experience, would not return or recommend.

title: Clean, Cheap & Convenient

title: Great service and very comfortable beds
text: This hotel has a very welcoming receptionist who assisted a swift and an effortless check-in. The staff showed excellent customer service by adhering to our special request. My husband and I would definitely recommend this hotel to anybody who is looking for a modern place with a high level of comfort during a short city break. Will definitely come back.

title: Good value B&B in London
text: The room was clean, smart, warm and comfortable, with space for a desk and a chair to relax in. The shower room and WC was just as clean, well tiled, with reliable hot water. It looks as if the refurbishment mentioned in other reviews has worked well. One small fault was the lack of a soap dish or anywhere to put shower gel in the shower cubicle. There was lots of choice for breakfast - better than you would expect for a continental breakfast - though the coffee was instant and the croissants stale. For the price, in London, this hotel seems very good value.

title: Excellent Refurbishment
text: Staying again post-refurbishment I was very pleased by the new rooms. All amenities provided as remembered with a fresh, modern coat only adding to the experience. I would recommend this hotel to anyone wishing to stay in central or west London on business or holiday! The friendly staff-members remember your face and make you feel very welcome

title: Great place
text: Stayed 2 days with my husband. Hotel is only 20 mins from the airport and walking distance to Hammersmith and shepherd bush station. Staff was very friendly. Had a great time. Would definitely visit again!

title: Fab service, room, and location!!
text: Having stayed at Comfotel Prpl for 2 weeks I can honestly say I couldn't have been happier with my booking. The hotel is situated just minutes away from both Shepherd's Bush station and Shepherd's Bush Market station as well as a short walk away from Westfield!!.. the room was fab, newly decorated, clean, comfy bed and lovely ensuite. There was a choice of duvets if like me you're always cold!.. and ample towels, in room refreshments as well as a flat screen with various channels.. the breakfast bar was incredible.. tasteful decor and a great selection to choose from. The staff were friendly and very attentive, ensuring that I had access to the free wifi and always offered to help me with my luggage.. again the location is fab with loads of local shops and eateries, from Thai, Turkish, Indian and Italian literally on the doorstep and a Sainsbury's bang opposite!!!.. would def recommend and book again, suitable for any kind of trip, business or leisure and definitely safe for a family stay!!

title: Best place in London to stay

Rooms a little small if you have big luggage but we managed.

title: Ideal for SSE
text: Sadley will not Return to this Hotel again we Booked this September 2018 as we were seeing the Legends Tour which was well worth IT. just a 10 min walk. from the hotel. When booking the room we also Paid for Breakfast for two for the next morning. before we were allowed to be seated you have to give your room number which we did & was told that only One was booked for Breakfast so i went with the waitress to the Reception Desk & explained with have Paid for two breakfast , I was told i was incorrect & wrong i then said i will go to my room & get my booking details to prove that we paid for two Breakfast. my Partner was made to feel as we were trying to cheat the Hotel, out of a breakfast which i will add was not Pleasent anyway . we told that the hotel's system was right & we was wrong . Just be aware if you ever Book with Hotel. Phil M

title: Nice trip
text: Excellent service. Staff were very professional. Room was neat and clean. Breakfast was very good. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this hotel. Hotel is located in a very nice area. There are a lot of good restaurants in the area.

title: Building work and noise
text: This hotel is ideally placed for a visit to SSE arena...probably less than a 10 min walk. Hotel room was small but clean. What spoilt our stay, was building work right next to our room. The noise of the work and the fact that we had to keep our curtain closed for the duration of our 2 night stay, and that there was construction boarding placed right outside our window really spoilt it. The hotel has cheaper “ windowless” rooms available and I felt that we effectively got a “windowless” room, but not the cheaper price. We also would not have booked had we been aware that building work was happening right next to our room. No recognition for Reward member either.

title: Nice stay

title: Avoid it

title: Poor stay
text: The only positive about this hotel was the walking distance to Wembley Stadium. Our room was assigned twice meaning another guest walked in on us giving us quite a fright. How can a system allocate different guests to the same room? There were stains on the chairs. The telephone was broken and kept flashing intermittently. The milk provided curdled in our drinks. Despite asking for a high floor room, we were allocated floor one. The wallpaper was peeling off the walls. When asking where we could eat locally, a staff member directed us to KFC or Mcdonalds over the road despite there being a huge retail venue round the corner which we only discovered on our walk to Wembley Stadium. It may have been the timing of our stay (Ed Sheeran concert) but this hotel was so overpriced for what it was. I’m sorry but I wouldn’t recommend.

title: promised a lot but delivered very little
text: negatives - compared to travelodge - there is no snacks machine or drinks machine there was no biscuits - tea and coffee limited and not much variety breakfast is not that great for quality my key card did not work on second day and had to go down 3 times to get it fixed the staff were nice but had little experience hotel was not finished and will not for a while so hammering - sawing noises etc and people on roof - so little sleep if you wanted to lie in - noise while eating breakfast too for the price a travelodge would have been better and no discount for part refund for below average stay - not likely to stay here again 눇 positives - new and clean and nice decor and not far from wembley central tube station if travelling after 1.30 pm take N18 night bus - as the tube takes you at the weekend to far out the wembley stadium train station is much nearer - overground train from Euston is the fastest to wembley central station

title: Nice hotel,great location
text: We stayed here for one night for the football at Wembley. Very easy to get to, we got the tube to Wembley Park and it was about a 10 minute walk to the hotel. Staff on reception could be a bit more attentive. There was one member of staff who was not doing anyway and when she looked up and saw a few people waiting she asked the couple stood next to us if she could help,obviously not realising we were there first and had not been seen to. Perhaps a better queueing system? The room was nice, toiletries and beverages provided. Clean. Unfortunately (not the hotel's fault) we were rudely awaken twice by a loud drunk who had left his room and been locked out, shouting and swearing in the corridor at 5am. We called reception and security dealt with immediately. Check in and out was quick and easy, the only thing I would mention is that we booked through a 3rd party and were not informed that we needed to bring photo ID which the hotel required at check in. Would recommend this hotel to anyone staying in the area.

title: London nov 17
text: What an excellent hotel. Easy check-in and friendly staff. Rooms were an average size but it's decor was lovely. We had curtains etc themed on the f.a cup and wembley stadium( apparently all rooms are different) . The bed was very comfy and the air con was also easy to manage as i hate hot hotel rooms. Kettle tea/coffee making facilities were a must and i was not disappointed :) . Bathroom was a nice size as was the shower. Did not have breakfast there ( as we're weatherspoon hunters, and there's one close by) , so cannot comment on that , but im sure it was nice, There are plenty of high street shops about and it's about a 5-10 walk from wembley central tube. p.s we stayed at the 'moxy' in stratford for our second night.....they should come here and see how a hotel should be.

title: A convenient hotel
text: You can tell from your first moment in Best Western Wembley that the team is working together to give their guests a good experience. The staff was so helpful and did their best indeed to welcome me and make sure I had everything I asked for. The building is a little old, but the rooms were good and clean. The house keeping was good and active. The breakfast in the restaurant wasn't that good but it was ok. The location is great, very close to Wembley stadium and London Designers Outlet, and 2 mins walk to Wembley Central underground. I would definitely stay there again. Thanks to Stacy Ann and Paul. Keep it up.

title: Okay

title: Overnight business stay

Also builders are doing work on back exterior of hotel so had to keep the curtains drawn for privacy. Nearest tube station is not very close so had to take bus. Served the purpose.

title: Great value

title: Frustration
text: Not only does our room look onto some beautiful construction but the room is just frustrating. A smart TV where they have disabled everything smart about it... Light switches to the side of the bed that literally do nothing due to bad wiring in the bedside lamp and a wobbly loo roll holder with soap and shower gel dispensers that are millimetres from the bathroom counter so impossible to empty. The room just has had no thoughts. Would not visit again.

title: Just stopped in for a beer and and a pizza - excellent
text: While recently attending a major event in Wembley Stadium myself and my wife stopped into the Best Western Plus in Wembley just to have a beer and something to eat. The premises looked new, clean and inviting from the outside. Upon entering the lobby area it was extremely busy but we asked if it was ok just to have a drink and some food in the restaurant. The well dressed gentleman behind the reception desk said absolutely no problem and escorted myself and my wife to a table in the restaurant. Our waiter attended to us immediately as we ordered 2 beers and a freshly cooked pizza. The pizza oven is in open view and the chef makes the pizzas fresh when ordered. We had the 'Indiana' pizza. It was delicious, one of the best pizzas we ever tasted, definitely recommend it! The gentleman who brought us into the restaurant even found time to come over and asked if everything was satisfactory. We found out as we left the hotel that his name was Rajan and he was the general manager of the hotel. Although the lobby area and bar were very busy all the staff were friendly and talkative. So I would like to say thank you and well done to Rajan and his staff, we will definitely return and possibly even stay overnight on our next visit to Wembley.

title: Do Not Use - No way in the world does this merit a three or four star rating!
text: Firstly the rate I was quoted for my recent stay was not what they surreptitiously charged me. Albeit only an extra £7.90. I asked, but should have demanded on departure a copy of the invoice at which point I would have seen the difference in rate. Secondly despite raising an issue with the twin beds (the mattresses were too big for the bed frames leading to two very uncomfortable nights and my partner with a bad back) and being told by reception when first reported after our first night, NOTHING was done. The floor was covered in dust and fluff and the shower door didn’t close properly but no maintenance men available as it was the weekend. On reflection I should have spent more and gone to a better quality hotel.

title: Good value hotel close to Wembley
text: Booked this hotel for a concert at SSE Wembley. Nice and new hotel with clean and modern rooms. 7 min walk from SSE or the Stadium. Serves good pizza in the lobby and also has a bar. Very service minded staff! Good value for your money!

title: clean, comfy but terrible breakfast
text: Front desk were helpful when I was unable to get into my room. Room was lovely and clean if a little cramped. The huge let down was breakfast which was a very meagre affair of just bacon, eggs, beans, sausages and toast in terms of a hot buffet) and the quality was less than great. They also tried to charge me twice as I paid when i went in for breakfast and the same person tried to charge me at check out. also on booking I was told that the car park was operational, on arrival, it wasn't.

title: Concert Stay
text: Stayed one night here after a concert at Wembley! The location is about a 10min walk and easy to navigate! We stayed on floor -3 which had no windows - but actually it was fine! Room was spacious and clean and served a purpose! We also ate in the pizzeria in the hotel which was really nice and reasonably priced!!

title: Avoid at all costs
text: I was left feeling humiliated, out of pocket and almost without a room and I booked 3 months in advance! We arrived at 6.30 pm following a 3 hour car journey, and I was told at reception that they'd phoned me to say they were about to give away my room as rooms were in short supply that evening! I was then told I was given a basement room with no window despite paying extra at booking to avoid these basement rooms reviewers had warned about on Tripadvisor. The reception argued with me insisting that rooms with windows were going for £99 that evening and I hadn't paid that amount (I explained prices are cheaper in advance and showed an email receipt proving purchase of an above ground room). This was meant to be a romantic getaway for my partner's birthday treat (gig at Wembley) but we ended up in the disabled access room with a hand held shower and a noisy view of the hotel's air-conditioning units with 'black out' curtains which let in the light and a receptionist behaving as if she had done me a favour! I was also asked to pay an extra £30 damage deposit! I've booked the nearby Premier Inn for my next visit to Wembley Stadium.

title: Smartly furnished with sports-linked decor
text: Relatively recently refurbished and smart decor- silhouette picture of George Best in the room. Only criticism was the noisy High Road, although being a London-born but living in a village for the past 35 years, I wasn’t used to police sirens and noisy drunks throughout the night. Will take ear plugs next time!

title: Room was small and cold but ok
text: Arrived at this BW (Best western) after a late flight and when we got to our room it wasn't the warmest...It relies on the air conditioning to heat...Then when we opened the Bathroom door it was like opening a fridge....Christ it was freezing...What they should have done was at least leave the door open to have the temperature same as the room...even if it was a little warmer...Bed is nice and comfy but the room we where it was quite small...Lucky we didn't have much luggage with us. The area this BW is in is very very close to wembley stadium....and your never ever far from a food place as there is Dominos and KFC across the road with tons more fast food places down the road....Also there is a weatherspoon just down the road for a pint or two and a tesco express for little bits. If your there around when there is a match on at wembley stadium expect places to be alot busier around the area.This BW is 5 mins away from the Wembley central station which us very handy. I didn't bother with the breakfast here and just went to weatherspoons for breakfast as it would work out cheaper...The staff was lovely at the reception and always happy to serve.

title: Clean Hotel with everything you need.
text: We stayed here on a Friday night and had two rooms booked, the room was very clean and tidy and seemed brand new. The only downside was the fact we were not on the same floor as our friends. We decided to pay £10 extra to stay an hour longer and it was such a good decision. The shower was clean and they provided towels and toiletries. There wasn't a great deal of room but as we were only there for 1 night this suited us fine. Unfortunately didn't get to try the pizza downstairs but it did smell and look really good. definitely recommend if you are planning on visiting Wembley stadium or arena.

title: A Pleasant Surprise
text: Due to the trains not running in our favour and a lunchtime kick off we needed to find a hotel for one night to attend the North London Derby at Wembley stadium and we stumbled across this little gem. I booked a room with no windows to save some money and despite being a little apprehensive we need not have worried at all. The reception team at check in were excellent and although a £30 deposit is unusual we knew this was going to be asked for so it didn’t come as a surprise. We were shown to our room by a nice friendly gentleman which was for the best as it was down 3 floors but was an adventure in itself and the lighting art work that appeared on the walls to light the way was a really nice touch. The room itself was great, twin beds as requested as it was myself and my son staying there, really nice bed linen, tea/coffee facilities (sadly no biscuits) a great bathroom with a nice large shower and slow closing loo seat and plenty of towels and toiletries, funky decor all relating to sports and a huge smart TV. We arrived after 10pm so ventured out to get something to eat and there are an abundance of restaurants and takeaways literally outside the door. The beds were comfortable and it was probably one of the quietest hotels I have ever stayed in with only a couple doors being slammed in the early hours but no raised voices along corridors or people running up and down. The only downside with having a room with no windows is that you can’t tell when it’s morning so we had to check the time but it’s not a major problem. Check out at 11am suited us and when giving back the key the reception staff refund the £30 deposit onto the card originally used but did warn this depending on your bank could take up to 5 days, I don’t have any issues with deposits but when you’ve checked out and the room hasn’t been checked I don’t really know what it’s for. A nice touch was a basket of fresh red apples on the reception desk for you to help yourself too, makes a real change from a boiled sweet. Once again nice friendly staff on duty and despite being extremely busy with customers checking in and out they remained really efficient. I would highly recommend this hotel if you are attending an event at the stadium or arena as it’s only about a 10 minute walk away and if have time there are lots of shops close by as well as the London Designer Outlet area. We wouldn’t hesitate to book this hotel again if we have another early kick off or are attending another event nearby.

title: Dissapointing hotel
text: The hotel is excellently situated near Wembley stadium, perfect for an event there. We arrived and our room had not been cleaned. By the time we returned to the hotel it had been cleaned and they had cleaned away the wifi password we had been given by reception. I call ed reception 3 times to no avail the call just rang out. Once I had the wifi connection there was no internet connection. At £180 per night this is very disappointing.

title: Great staff, location
text: Great Staff and location. Twin room was a little small but decoration was good and very modern. Located on the high Street with everything you'll ever need close at hand. On booking it was unclear what type of breakfast was supplied and this ended up being continental. Staff didn't make us aware the we could update for £2 and only noticed later on the menu.

title: Worst Western
text: Checked in at 4pm to a room covered in plaster dust. A member of staff walked in and instead of apologising, giggled to her co-worker and walked out. Moved rooms rooms due to dust to a room where the curtains didn't cover the whole window. Someone came up at midnight to change the curtains. The doors didn't shut properly so they constantly beeped. We were woken up at 8am by builders on the roof/scaffolding outside the window (pictured). Thought we were in an earthquake, the buildings works were so loud. Complained about this but were told there was a warning on the booking website, was tiny in the fine print - the manager, Rajan, implied it was our fault and refused to offer a full refund. The kind lady behind the desk offered us a free breakfast but the works were so loud in the kitchen that this was off the cards too. Paid £265 for a terrible nights sleep, bad staff, an unfinished hotel, unacceptable rooms and not even in central London - on a Wednesday night. They eventually gave us a 25% refund. Worst £200 ever spent.

title: Loved every minute.
text: Thanks for everything. Services were really great, especially the serving at the restaurant. We did not have any problem in the 16 days we stayed there, everything was nice, the cleaning was also really great.

title: Perfect
text: Stayed here having been to Wembley for the Spurs v Swansea game. Everything from start to finish of our visit was perfect. The Hotel is in a perfect location for those visiting the Stadium or Arena and given what others in the area where changing for a nights stay, the price we paid was superb value for money. The room we had (with no window) was the perfect size, the bathroom esp the power shower was ideal. Both were super clean and tidy. Hotel staff were friendly and very helpful, and check in & out was super slick I would have no hesitations in booking here again 5 Stars

title: No hot water, broken sink-no apology, no money refund!
text: I had visit this 'hotel' beginning of January. My friend and I stay until late out in Wembley central. As we was really tired we had decided to oversleep there. We check in at 1am. In the morning we have realized there is no hot water to take shower and sink was broken as well so water couldn't run out. On the check out we reported problem.
