After long waiting of room investigation,they confirm what we said... Unfortunately, as they said, 'manager is not there and they can do nothing about it' but take our details and contact us. Almost full month after they are still ignoring me...

title: Stayed for 2 nights when seeing Ed Sheeran
text: Was really looking forward to staying at this hotel as looked really nice we paid £400 for 2 nights, when we arrived we checked in and went to our room which was like the box bedroom in my house the room was so small u couldn’t walk around the bed the bathroom was as small as my downstairs toilet the shower was behind the door so was a nightmare as cudnt fully shut the shower door otherwise the bathroom door would lock you in the shower, when finally chilling on the bed for 10 mins before going out I noticed a black Genital hair on the head board which physically made me sick, would never stay in this hotel again when arriving we was told we had to pay £20 a night to park our car and breakfast was not included in the total price of £400 what we paid..

title: Even Prisoners have windows
text: Stayed in the basement, no windows. Staff acceptable, clean, but No Window's in room???? and not that cheap. Probably not a flag ship Hotel, but what can you expect from a converted office block. No restaurant to speak of , not much of a bar. One nite only is cheap and cheerful especially when you had enough to drink and can't soak up the locality nor hear any birds AM.

title: so
text: Hospital visit from Cornwall, an overwhelming smell of Curry as we entered reception, car park was full! the bar had some sort of oil all over it and we had not even got to the room yet. When we got to the room it was in the basement and it was really cold, we worked out how to put the aircon unit on to warm the room up but it was late and we were tierd. The heater was to loud for us to sleep with, at 3am I was woken up by loud traffic and a freezing cold room! The remote control had that oily substance on it and also some sort of white sticky stuff on it. Really not happy plus a really poor night sleep never again!!!

title: Worst Hotel we have EVER stayed at !!!!!
text: Worst Hotel EVER !!! no parking and was directed to a pub car park over half a mile away. Booked a twin room and was given a double would not change it. Then insisted we had to pay a £30 deposit for the room even though the company had already paid in advance. Food served until 10.30pm but kitchen closed at 9.50pm when we tried to order !!! Dirty rooms, Terrible rude staff especially on reception. STAY AWAY, YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED

title: Nice and easy!
text: This hotel is out of the city of London but the tube station is only 350m from it. In about 35 minutes you are in the Oxford circus station. Very clean rooms, nice bathroom and hot water. The reception was friendly and helpful. Value for money!

title: Great staff, extremely good value and wonderfully clean rooms.
text: I cannot praise this hotel highly enough, despite checking in at after 10pm the staff were wonderfully helpful in assisting us to get parking on an ”Event Day”... don’t forget this is Wembley and just a stones throw from the stadium. Whilst the parking is very limited at the hotel Paul the manager was extraordinarily helpful in directing us to a car park just a street away from the hotel. The rooms are not gloriously luxurious but with a huge bed and well appointed bathroom they are more than adequate. Having traveled a great deal both on business and privately I cannot ever remember being so impressed at the cleanliness of a hotel. Paul and his team made our short stay very special and their attention to detail would be more appropriate in a hotel costing more than 5 times as much. Best Western, you should be very proud of this hotel, the management and the staff who work there. Thank you to all of you.

title: Very busy concert weekend
text: Booked pretty last minute as we were going to the Ed Sheeran concert at Wembley. Got a really good price via a booking site. Got there early checked in at a hectic reception(only due to amount of guests) was welcomed by a very friendly lady called ‘Tracey’ was really helpful. Only down fall was waiting for an iron, but then again everyone wanted them at the same time. We were in the new ‘annex’ I believe rooms weren’t the biggest but very clean and comfortable. Only down side I would say was parking, hotel only has a few spaces but again we should have booked ahead. Will definitely use again when going to Wembley. And for the management Tracey is a real asset to your company, you need to make sure she’s acknowledged .

title: Great looking hotel, well worth the price
text: This hotel was great, the staff were very attentive and accommodating. The room was extremely clean and each room is themed based on events at the Wembley stadium, which was great as me and my wife got a rock themed room which was perfect for us. I would have thought it was a 4 star hotel had I not known. And the heater above the bed was perfect at keeping the room a comfortable temperature especially with how cold it is recently. This hotel is ideally located as the stadium is just a short walk away and there are plenty of restaurants nearby. Would absolutely recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Wembley.

title: A quiet and comfortable night
text: A small double room with comfortable beds and all amenities required. The shower room was brand new with a large shower. The location of this hotel is a short walk from the underground and Wembley Stadium and Arena.

title: Good hotel.
text: We stayed one night. Hotel is new or recently renovated - rooms are light, airy and modern. Bathroom is good - good shower with good water pressure. Hairdryer is rubbish - old fashioned dryers stuck on the wall of the bathroom that are not effective. Good location - close to Wembley Central tube station and to Wembley Stadium which was important to us.

title: Best Western Wembly
text: Extremely impressed by how quiet the hotel was and the menu. The hotel is only recently opened so all the room facilities were of a modern standard. The option of express check in/out is really useful

title: Not the best experince
text: Upon arrival I was checked in swiftly but advised a £30 additional deposit was required. Upon entering my room the room was freezing cold, when taking a shower the water was cold and the shower door wouldn’t close properly. Other than that to be fair the room was clean and comfortable

title: Sooo comfy
text: I stayed here fir 2 niggts with my teen daughter. We attended X Factor final at SSE Arena 10 min walk away. This hotel is spotless and very modern. The beds are really comfortable. Ive had back probs forever and not one compliant did i have sleeping in this. Outside Hotel is packed with ships and eating places. Within 1 min walk in either direction. Is 3 pizza places. Kfc. Mcds. Nandos and more. If im ever back in London I will stay again. I had yo pay £30 deposit which was refunded on morning i left back to my bank card. So factor in this cost.

title: More than you would expect
text: Stayed here on Sunday night, due to attending the XFator that evening. And it is fair to say that this hotel is a hidden gem. Granted it’s not in the heart of Wembley itself, it really isn’t that far of a walk only taking us 10 minutes to get to the arena. Room was bright and spacious with far more facilities that we had anticipated. Plenty of lighting from both the natural light from the big windows and ample fixture lighting. The only small minor detail that let it down was the breakfast, as the hot selection I did find fairly cold but other than that our stay was very enjoyable. I will defiantly be booking this hotel again if I am to attend events in this area.

title: Nice hotel
text: Stayed for 3 nights! Great location,good size of room,very clean...however prior to my stay staff weren’t very helpful over the phone and thought it was very silly having a smart tv but no access to any of the apps .

title: Visit to best western best time ever!!
text: My time at this hotel was the best my wife booked this by suprise it was one of the best times of my life. The two gentlemen behind the reception were great and so welcoming. The stay there was great comfortable beds but shame that they never had any parking

title: Great stay for Wembley occasions
text: Great staff. Very helpful and professional. Rooms are clean, however bit of dust were found under my bed. Big screen tv and very good bathroom. Wembley is 5 mins of walk. How beautiful. Pint of beer for £5 served in plastic cups? Terrible for me. Breakfast (Full English Breakfast) for £5 and got cold beans and no beacon? Silly.

title: My one night stay
text: Last weekend I planned a last minute get away for the night with a friend we decided to stay at the best western in Wembley as it was local for us and good price the hotel was lovely nice rooms small but nice bathroom was good to and the night staff was very friendly to I would recommend this hotel as right on Wembley high close to the Wembley shopping outlet and Wembley stadium and very good links into central london if you want a short stay I would recommend this hotel to everyone :)

title: nice, clean and loverly staff
text: stayed here on a business trip, booked in advance a room with windows, rooms are not very big but clean and well equipped, the staff is nice and patient even with lot of groups (schoolkids and tourist), guy that makes the pizza's is very nice and gentle, takes time for a chat if not too busy

title: Lovely room
text: First visit here before a gig at Wembley, Loved our room , comfy bed , storage space and big bathroom. Tea and coffee facilities provided. Staff were friendly and hotel was close to the stadium , sse , and designer outlet. Will use this hotel again for sure.

title: One night stay while attending concert at SSE Wembley arena
text: The hotel was close to Tube and the Arena, the area is okay, the Hotel is very new and appears to have been built in a converted office block, some building work is currently on-going rooms were roomy and despite having no window was fine, they put a curtain up with a lighted London picture, room was clean and tidy, breakfast was included which was of good quality

title: Highly recommended
text: Stayed for 2 nights. Very clean throughout and a well kept hotel. Room size is ample for 2 people and not too cramped. Staff were very polite, professional with a smile. Short walk to the London designer Outlet in Wembley and the underground. Plenty of choice for breakfast. Would definitely stay there again.

title: Mixed feelings!
text: I have mixed feelings with this hotel. Poor service. After a long journey- our flight was delayed to London Gatwick by 2 hours, we got on the wrong train at Gatwick & had another 3 hour journey to the hotel from Gatwick. When we arrived tired, cold & hungry the receptionist was rude & obnoxious. She told us we need to give an additional £30 card deposit. I only had cash. I had to wait in the lobby to charge my phone, gain internet access, get in contact with a relative & get £30 transferred to my account! When all this was done & the deposit was paid, we got handed s room key and told to take the elevator to ground -1, now be careful, because theirs a second elevator down a dark corridor which you then have to take again to another -1 floor.- when we couldn't find the room because we were never explained about the dark corridor, second elevator & the other -1 floor, the receptionist sighed & showed us to this room, with no windows! The room itself was clean, decor nice, bed comfortable & great channels. for a room in the basement it was that I thought would be a horrible experience, was actually not a bad experience at all. The showers however could be a little warmer, along with the room temp. The location was OK, considering the price. 33 minutes on the tube to oxford circus. Nandos across the road- but I would have preferred to eat in the hotel, as it looked & smelled great (we came in late every evening). I ant comment on food as I never had breakfast, or lunch or dinner. I was never told dinning times by the receptionist. I really enjoyed the room & the hotel itself, however the staff made my experience to London a lot harder. a little smile or a nice greeting would have went along way. or even a little chat! I am going to London again in May & unfortunately I will be paying more money for a hotel in the city, as I prefer good customer service over room decor.

title: They saved the day
text: This hotel came to the rescue when another hotel let me down and it was a big concert night elo. If it wasn't for this hotel don't know where we would have slept this to me is a 5 star plus hotel in my eyes. Super customer service rooms were amazing clean and comfortable will definitely book again they couldn't do enough for me thanks again everything because to me u saved the day

title: good hotel if you are going to football game at wembley
text: This hotel is not close to downtown London so it will take you long time to go there, this hotel is good if you are going to football game at Wembley and that is the reason way i book that hotel. The staff at the night shift was not good, not much smile. and thee room whose good but it was not good that the window could not be opened

title: Never again!
text: The receptionist on the evening of October 28th was extremely unfriendly. He seemed to really hate his job. The hotel is very overpriced. Overall not a pleasant expierience. Would not recommend to anyone.

title: Best Night in London
text: This foot ball/sports themed room-decorated hotel is not too distant from Wembley Stadium however it is also linked to the city by excellent public transport links. It was clear that customer service is high on the hotels agenda.Ask for a room at the back if normal noise invasion is annoying to you as London awakes in the morning. This will be my first choice on my next London visit.

title: Price VS quality and Location
text: This is not a place or hotel or staycations or relaxation. It is the perfect, comfortable convenient place for a very reasonable price in London. Its very good for business traveller or people who wants to visit Wembley Stadium. The bed is comfortable and the bathroom has a decent shower. there are shops around around 5 ins to the nearest underground which is around 30mins to central London. This is also a good option for travellers on a budget like we were. P.S the front desk staff is nice but housekeeping didn't clean for the entire 3 days we stayed and the only time she offered to clean was our last night of stay.

title: Very Good Hotel
text: I stayed for 2 nights, Saturday & Sunday night

title: Some positives, some negatives...weigh it up
text: Firstly I must say that I am absolutely exhausted as I have never slept in such an uncomfortable bed. If you like firm beds, you know the kind, the ones where you feel like sleeping on solid floor might be more supportive, then the beds here will be right up your street. I am also tired due to being woken up early because they are still completing the building process (something I was not made aware of). They were sawing, drilling and hammering in the room next door to mine and by 1130am, I had had enough. This leads to the positives...I went downstairs to ask for a room transfer and they were more than happy to help with this (not that they had a leg to stand on as both myself and the member of staff were having to shout at each other in order to be heard over the workmen). They moved me to the top floor and to the opposite side to the work that was going on. It was also a room with two single beds so they offered to sort this as my convenience as I had explained I was working in my room, hence the complaint about the noise. The hotel is perfectly situated for access to the overground and underground services, and is a stones throw away from Wembley Stadium. There is also a wide range of eating and drinking establishments surrounding the hotel. The interior is sports themed and very modern. It is also a very clean hotel with friendly staff.

title: Very disappointing.
text: Unfortunately, the whole subterranean levels of this hotel reeked of cat urine. The unfortunate smell was really off putting, thankfully the smell was limited to the hallways or at the very least was not in my room. I was greeted by a friendly trainee on the front desk who's grasp on English wasn't fantastic, I did have to repeat myself a lot. I live in Newcastle but I speak with a southerners accent. It wasn't really that much of a hassle but it did mean checking in took a lot longer than expected. Their £30 holding charge on my credit card took over a week to be refunded, this for a company as big as Best Western is appalling. The hotel room although 2 floors under the ground was exactly what you pay for. No grumbles there. Clean, descent TV and Wifi. Location - descent in house restaurant - Descent Picture of Freddie Mercury on the wall in my bedroom. Nice touch!

title: Very basic
text: Hotel was very basic but did the job for one night. Excellent location for Wembley stadium am guessing that’s why it was expensive for the one night. Room was clean but flusher and tap was very lose. Staff was ok

title: Not value for money
text: The hotel is recently refurbished. But if you live close to the main road, it will be noisy. Breakfast is a continental breakfast, if you want a full English breakfast you have to pay extra. Parking is a problem as the hotel does not have sufficient spaces.

title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed here for two night's, it was lovely and clean. The room was small but perfect for what we needed and at a great price. The staff were friendly AND helpful. My only complaint would be that we couldn't open the window.

title: Wembley visit
text: Very good location and hotel. Very helpful staff. Only criticism was parking was charged at £20 per night, but website stated £10. The reception staff said it was because there was an event on. This should be clearly stated.

title: 1 night stay
text: Had an ok stay here did not like how we was underground was a bit strange. The air conditioning was annoying as it kept switching off and it was not on a timer. I would stay here again if I was passing.

title: Over priced and tiny
text: Booked at short notice due to attending concert at Wembley. Overpriced ( probably due to concert). Tiny room, basic but clean. Bed was comfortable and bedding was fresh and clean. Had only recently been refurbished and smelled 'new'. Construction going on, was not informed before I arrived but was told upon checking in! Although didn't hear anything during my stay. Was ok for one night but would not return.

title: Capital Summer Ball
text: Simplistically is the key here. It’s clean, warm and the staff are extremely helpful and friendly. The room was excellent as well as clean and modern, with a great view hahaha. The breakfast was fresh and plentiful as well as delicious, this hotel is ideal for a stop over for events at the stadium 👌🏻❤️

title: Lovely clean room and hotel, Pizza restaurant is fantastic
text: Lovely clean tidy hotel, room was spotless, only downside was freezing cold wood flooring! We had a meal at the in house Pizzeria it was so fresh and delicous, reasonably priced too. Plenty of choice for Breakfast also.

title: Best western hotel wembley
text: Very dissapointing, should have been a big king size double bed but was two singles pushed together......it was underground with no windows, just a fake window, which was not mentioned at timd of booking!!

title: Great location
text: This hotel is less than five minutes from Wembley Central Station and central london is easily accessible. The rooms were clean and the staff were very friendly. It was a scorching weekend when we stayed and thankfully the room came with aircon. Would stay again

title: Great hotel
text: Although our room was in the basement with no window this was a bonus as the hotel is on a busy High street. This meant it was quiet.There is a very clever lighted window in the room that makes it appear as if your room is in daylight in the morning The room was very clean, and modern as was the rest of the hotel. The staff were very helpful.

title: Would I stay there again? Not if I could help it!
text: I had to unexpectedly extend my stay in Wembley and the Holiday Inn, where I was staying, was full up. So were most of the other hotels I tried until I worked my way down to this one. The best thing you could say about it is that the wifi is very fast. But the hotel seems to have gone out of its way to make the worst of its possibilities. Take the room. The bed was pushed up about six inches from a pillar, meaning that to get round to that side of the bed was a tremendous squeeze. The pillar showed signs of scratches and chippings, presumably where people had tried to squeeze past. The armchair was located in a sort of alcove by the window behind the pillar and the TV was positioned on the the wall in such a way that it was partly obscured by the pillar. Why not hang it on a couple of feet nearer the other side of the wall? All of that nonsense could have been avoided. It almost feels as if they are going out of their way to make your stay unpleasant. Or take the bathroom. The towels were hung on a rail just above the toilet paper roll meaning that if you washed your hands and then went to dry them on the towel, you were liable to drip water over the toilet paper. Take the toilet paper holder itself: it appeared to be fitted upside down so that the roll was prone to slipping off. The shower had no ledge for soap, so that if you brought your own soap there was nowhere to put it in the shower (which was equipped with a shampoo dispenser). Why do those sort of things? Breakfast was horrific. There is a sign that says ‘please wait to be seated’, but no-one greets you and seats you. The breakfast room is quite small and the hotel seems to specialise in bus parties who all come down at the same time and use up all the tables. Then when they have finished, because the lobby is small, they hang around next to the breakfast room, or stay at their tables using their laptops. The breakfast room seems to be understaffed also. There is no hot breakfast buffet and you are not automatically asked if you want a hot breakfast. It seems that you have to find a member of staff and ask, a very strange system. When I checked in I was not greeted as a member of the Best Western rewards programme, which usually happens

title: Great hotel, lovely and modern/clean, great price!
text: Booked this as a last minute weekend away in London for two nights on booking.com and honestly can’t fault it at all. About £100 for 2 nights. Very close to the tube station with about a 20 min journey into the centre of London. The rooms are decorated in keeping with its close location to Wembley, very modern and super clean. Good amenities close by too so you don’t have to always travel into the centre of London for food etc. Highly recommended for a cheap weekend away.

title: An oasis of calm
text: We stayed here for 2 nights having travelled up from Devon for the ELO concert at Wembley Stadium. The hotel is very comfortable and has a friendly, calm atmosphere. The Management and staff were very approachable and gave excellent customer service. I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel for these reasons and for the fact that it is so near to the stadium.

title: Modern, small room
text: Room was clean but very small. Got a ground floor room next to a noisy busy road. Don't know why it says here on the main page that a buffet breakfast is included.....it isn't, its extra ……..quite a lot extra for a breakfast. Parking is non existent and ended up having to find someone who was letting there driveway for £25 a night a fair walk away from the hotel

title: Good and Bad Points
text: Let's start with the good points, close to Wembley Central Station which is great for access to the city, spacious and clean rooms and comfortable beds. Now the bad points... Pillows have left me with a crippling sore neck and shoulders (although I am disabled and maybe just don't suit my illness), the 'hair dryer' is a tube which blows as much hot air as my husband does when having a bad day, the shower is cold always, there is no plug socket next to a mirror for fixing hair etc and the heating system is confusing to use. I might stay again if these issues were fixed as it is easy to get to and good for disabled customers.

title: Recommended for leisure travellers
text: Excellent value for money (250 euros for 4 nights - no breakfast included), although it seems that i was just lucky and this was a promotional price and normal prices are not that cheap. Location was good, about 5 mins walk from Wembley Central underground station (Zone 4 - Bakerloo line + Overground to Euston railway station). Train to central London takes about 1/2 hour. The hotel is located in a safe, multi-ethnic neighborhood, with a wide range of restaurant and shopping options available Lack of a small fridge/minibar was essential, especially during the hot summer days of mid July. For an unknown reason, wifi simply didn't work in my room. I did't complain to the staff about that, as i returned to my room late every night and i did't have time to browse the internet, but that would be very disturbing for other customers. Rooms were very tight (no problem for a solo traveler like me, but it would be a problem for a two-person stay).

title: Best Western but not plus
text: Clean and tidy room Yes. Room to swing a cat in No. Small bathroom with shower door that wouldn't shut properly. Biggest problem is no parking repeat No Parking! Staff friendly. I didn't eat in the hotel cos if you don't like pizza you're snookered! I won't be using again the holiday inn around the corner will be my choice from now on.

title: Great short stay
text: Great friendly & helpful staff. Great room on the lower floor -4 very quiet. Good value for money would definitely recommend 👍Good breakfast. Very close to Wembley 10 minute walk. Lots of places to eat nearby.

title: A few problems but dealt with promptly and effciently
text: Stayed here for two nights, quick check I and lovely large room and bathroom, Tried to get reception but no one answered the phone. Next morning requested iron and ironing board but the receptionist was too busy !!.Breakfast was not upto the Best Weston normal quality. Second morning bumped into managers who dealt with problem with receptionist, very professional so in fact left with good impression of the hotel

title: GOOD OFFERING..
text: Stayed a few nights here while in London and it is quite refreshing having lodged in three other Wembley hotels. Relatively new, it is comparable to other BW hotels in Africa and USA. I came in at midnight straight from Heathrow airport having had flight delays. Despite prior booking, I was offered a ''Blind'' room at the basement, with blank-view windows! Quite tired the King bed was comfortable to sleep in. Bathroom details were tidy and aptly finished. However internet reception was nearly nil at this room and had to work at the reception on the laptop. Breakfast at 8am was rather too busy, with numerous students all over. I had to sit at the nearby Bar to eat quickly with a few others. BW Plus is appropriately located with accessible transport and eateries around.

title: Really Great Hotel
text: Hotel is in an ideal location. Close to Wembley Stadium, Fashion Outlet Shopping Centre and Tube. Parking is very limited you could get blocked in as not very well set out. All staff really friendly, went out of there way to help me and my partner on our visit to this hotel. Breakfast was lovely too, choice of full English or continental. Very reasonably priced. Rooms very well decorated and spacious. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend this hotel.

title: Stay Over
text: Checked in with no issues, pleasant reception staff. Room ready at 14.00 on time, but there was a facility to leave luggage with staff, before that time. Very close walking distance from the local over-underground station, situated on the same road. Room was modern art based, clean, tidy, comfortable bed, soft pillows. Good air conditioning. Shower, wc clean. Quiet good night's sleep. On booking the system was not clear that you needed to further telephone the hotel and pay via that. Not keen on the £30 security deposit. Good range of breakfasts on offer. I would stay again.

title: Perfect for one night
text: Stayed for one night after an event at Wembley and the hotel was perfect for that. We had a -3 level room which had no windows which was a little odd. Hotel seems very new so some little bits still need sorting. Was a little issue as they had 1 room booked for us but was soon sorted. Rooms are compact but perfect for 1 night. Would be back.

title: Our Stay
text: We really enjoyed our stay. The hotel is very well situated near an assortment of reaturants, we ate in the hotel due to the inclement weather.The pizzas were ok, unfortunately they said they were out of chicken for the pizzas but I did notice that the customers behind us had chicken even though the came after us.

title: Good clean hotel
text: Stayed at Best Western Plus in Wembley for 2 nights with my husband, chose this hotel as the price was so reasonable and it included free breakfast if booked through their own website. Literally 5 minute walk from Wembley Central tube, the reception check in was quick and easy, we did had to pay a £30 breakages deposit that we didn’t know about but this was refunded on check out. London Euston took us 21 minutes on the overground so commuting in and out of central London wasn’t a problem and this hotel was less than half of the price I was quoted for stays in central London which is why we booked it. The hotel itself was extremely clean and the room was lovely and bright decorated in a George Best theme, the room was a little bit on the small side though but ok for us on a 2 night stay. Breakfast was good with nice full english & tea/coffee and the service was excellent. Would I use this hotel again.....the answer is yes definitely!!

title: SSE arena trip
text: Stayed here for one night as a stopover for a concert at the SSE arena and the hotel served well for this purpose. It is ideally located for the stadium/arena and the hotel itself was decorated to a high standard, with immaculately clean rooms and public areas. This was slightly let down by the inanimate and in some cases, miserable staff working at the desk. Unfortunately we also asked for an ironing board and an iron

title: Stayed After Concert
text: After reading mixed reviews I'd have to say I was pleasantly surprised. Was worried I'd get a basement room but didn't. Lucky! The rooms are on the small side. But they're so clean and modern! There's toiletries in the rooms if you've forgotten anything Outside the hotel you're on a main road of shops and fast food - kfc nandos and pizza hut. Overall a pleasant stay and would come back

title: Sparkling clean, great beds and good value.
text: A great choice for those attending events at Wembley stadium or arena. We booked a king size room - lovely comfortable bed, very quiet considering location, very nice decor and very diligent cleaning staff. Would highly recommend!

title: Not a Plus
text: This hotel is ideal for Wembley and this and the aircon are the only plus points of the hotel. The hotel looks good on the outside. My room was in the depths of the cellar and there are three subterranean floors with no outlook on the outside. The room was tiny with no more than 20cm gap on one side of the bed. The only redeeming feature of the room was the air conditioning although the bed was comfortable and the room was clean. The English Breakfast was a joke with the bacon appearing to be weeks old (see the photo) and there were no tomatoes. The bread was left to dry out in the air so at least the toaster didn’t have to work so hard. The Breakfast gets 1/5. Staff were pleasant and had they not been the hotel would have got a 2 rating. Come on Best Western, you can do very much better than this. For a start provide a decent English Breakfast with some fresh tomatoes and keep the bread covered. I wouldn’t return.

title: Absolutely worth the money! Great stay!
text: This hotel is just 5 minutes walk away from Wembley central station, easy to find, it has really good and well equipped rooms. It's a maze though, you can get lost in the corridors :-)Bed was very comfortable, TV and A/C worked properly. I did not try the restaurant and never had breakfast, so can't say anything about that. The lady who checked me in - Noelia - was really friendly and helpful, and the rest of the team as well. I can recommend this venue for a stay when in London.

title: Quaint and Affordable Boutique Hotel
text: The Pilgrm is not only one of my favourite boutique like hotel in London but their cafe and lounge is one of my favourite places to visit and have a drink or a chat with friends when in Paddington area. Got a standard double room and It is on the smaller side but super comfy and well decorated and maintained with nice amenities. Bathroom whilst compact is also very well designed. Perfect for a single traveler or a non-fussy couple. Cafe area downstairs by reception/entrance is very cute and inviting. Perfect for drinking your morning tea/coffee as you watch people pass by. Lounge and bar upstairs is nicely designed and decorated. Spacious and inviting, it has a relaxed yet cool atmosphere perfect for a fancy cocktail or a casual meeting. This is where they also serve breakfast and food. I appreciate the hotel’s minimalist features and it’s focus on providing a great customer service. You won’t get anything above and beyond here service wise but you get personable and friendly faces.

title: Smallest hotel room I’ve ever seen. Very Nice staff
text: The Pilgrim is super convenient for access to Paddington/Heathrow express which is why I chose to stay just the one night. The entry foyer is nice and relaxed. Checked in on line. Very easy. I booked single room for 1 guest. Located in W wing. I don’t know what all the rooms look like but, mine W32 was very very small. About 4 square feet of standing area a bed that took up most of the space next to a window and radiator. Bathroom also was very small. It was a bit odd navigating the hallways but eventually I found the room. Don’t be afraid to ask at check in for assistance carrying your luggage to your room. It can be a bit confusing trying to climb some of the staircases as they are narrow and some winding. The room was super clean and attractive. The street is busy. It’s just that sort of area of London, very touristic and near Paddington. Bring silicone ear plugs if you expect to sleep. The bar area looked nice but I didn’t eat there or have coffee. There is a nice community pantry area to get tea in the morning .

title: Great design style hotel
text: Only stayed one night after going the theatre. We had a medium sized room on the 4th floor on the street side. Didn't notice any sounds from the street which was good. Only 2 small bad things were the small window on the left of the door which had no curtain and let loads of light in in the morning. And there was a constant sound of water running through pipes all night. Apart from that everything was great. Check in so easy. Cool little pantry with tea and coffee & water to go and find. Fab location and lovely late check out which we didn't mind. Comfy bed and nice products and stylish, clean & good sized bathroom! Would definitely stay again.

title: Small but (almost) perfectly formed
text: I needed a room for one night close to Paddington and happened to pick this one. Very new and freshly painted. Tiny room but nice touches. Sparling clean. Very comfortable bed. Efficient on-line check in and out. Very friendly staff. The window opened, and I even managed to turn off the radiator. However... there was a lot of noise from outside and some strong cooking smells. Luckily I had earplugs and slept well as a result. I found a little leaflet in the room with hotel information, but only on the morning I left. I was not made aware of the restaurant facilities on check-in, or other benefits. The little leaflet is fine, but would be much better handed over with the room key and with a bit of explanation from the reception staff. It would make all the difference. The Pantry on my floor (which was meant to supply tea and coffee) was empty. Maybe these are teething troubles as it seems very new. Minor issues aside, it's a great hotel and I would highly recommend it.

title: Convenient and modern
text: We needed a place to stay close to Paddington after flying in to Heathrow, and needed a place to do some work in the morning, and this place was perfect. We arrived at 8am and they let us straight in to the room! So we could drop our bags and change before our appointment. Food was great in the lounge, and we were able to set up with laptops and work there all morning. Stylish place. It is a little cramped and warren-like, but it is a 1 minute walk from paddington.

title: Short visit
text: Central base seconds from paddington station. Clean, tidy, toilet not much room took ages to refill cistern . Central base excellent but frosted window made husband feel enclosed. Very friendly staff. Would ask for front view next time

title: Excellent Location, Wonderful Food and Good Service
text: I stayed at this hotel and also ate at the breakfast, lounge and cafe on different occasions. It is one of my new favorites. I travel to London several times a year for work and this will now be added to my short list of preferred places. It is directly across from Paddington station which made it so convenient for me coming in from the Airport on the Heathrow Express. Also you can easily catch a bus or tube. The food was one of the most exceptional things about this property - even if you are not staying here you need to try their breakfast if you have time or are in the area. The avocado toast was fantastic! The room is small, but that is not important to me. The bed was comfortable, they had wonderful quality sheets and towels as well as good toiletries so I didn't necessarily have to have my own. They also provide complimentary water, as much as you need, which was wonderful as I was dehydrated getting off a 10+ hour flight. Wifi is also complimentary and was fast enough that I could get all my work done and also have Skype calls with no issues. There is no views out the windows and the room itself is nothing fancy, but there is a lot of charm in the building and I just loved the feel of it. Hopefully you'll give it a try!

title: Awesome Staff - Gem of a Hotel
text: Love this hotel! The location is perfect, literally across the street from Paddington Station/Heathrow Express. The decor is great, very stylish minimalist designed rooms. Rates are totally reasonable. But what really made my experience was the incredible staff. I caught a horrible cold. I was in bed with chills for hours. The staff brought me a kettle to the room and a portable heater to put next to my bed. They boiled fresh ginger, lemon and mint to help with my throat, and every time I was in the lobby or the restaurant everyone checked in on me to see how I was doing and ask if they could do anything for me. I love the restaurant. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, service is great. Breakfast and dinner were both delicious. Mozzarella and beet salad was awesome. The eggs are super fresh and the sugar free granola with yogurt is delicious. Rooms are super clean, bed is super comfy. Can't go wrong with this little gem of a hotel.

title: Great hotel in a great location
text: I stayed at The Pilgrm for one night and had a great experience. The staff were very attentive and we felt we were in good hands. We had a small bite to eat at the restaurant at night and the dishes we ordered were delicious (fresh ingredients and bursting with flavour). The wine was also great (Alex clearly knew a lot about his wines). The room had everything we needed. It is evident that every little detail has been extensively thought about (from the Ren soaps to the Marshall speakers). I would highly recommend this hotel if you are staying in London for a couple of nights!

title: Small but special
text: Rooms are very small but we are smallish people but all the important immenities were there - super clean, great shower, tea and coffee on each floor. It is two blocks from Padfinton Station. Perfect location for a quick visit.

title: Great customer service
text: I checked into The Pilgrm prior to an early morning flight out of Heathrow... on arrival, the gentleman who welcomed me, informed me of the times when breakfast was served and I responded that I'd be leaving before they started serving breakfast, so he said he'd see what he could do for me by way of a takeaway breakfast. As I checked in late (11pm) and the kitchen staff had already gone home, I wasn't expecting him to work miracles, but when I went to leave at 6:25 the next morning, a cup of tea, a freshly squeeze juice and two pastries were waiting for me in a paper bag - the perfect start to the day, eaten on the Heathrow Express! :)

title: Excellent
text: We come back from a perfect weekend at the Pilgrm Beautiful decoration, both at the lobby level, restaurant on the 1st floor, as our simple and chic room. REN welcome small gifts, a 10 pound credit for a cocktail, dessert or other ... Superb bed linen, towels and fantastic bath soap with the smell of rose. In addition to all these attentions, the staff and especially Suzana are very professional with a wonderful kindness. We have already booked the same room (on the 4th floor) for the month of September

title: Good crash pad
text: I booked this due to the price and website, I liked them style of the hotel and also it was very good value. The area isn’t the best however as it’s just across the road from Paddington tube station it is very convenient. When I arrived it felt like a guest house rather than a hotel. It had a “self service” feel to it as there is no check in desk or reception. Also the building is hard to navigate (not helped by room numbers not being on any doors) the building has been converted to a hotel rather than purpose built. However my room was very nice. I slept well as the bed was very comfortable, a great shower too and all was super sparkly clean. Due to size of room and lack of storage, desk area etc this is good for one to nights only unless you don’t mind having a room where all you need to do is sleep. Very nice design and good price so I would stay again and maybe next time I would try and find the restaurant and a place to have a coffee as that may help it feel more like a hotel than just a room in a corridor.

title: Perfect hidden gem
text: What a great stay! 30 seconds walk from Paddington station, the Pilgrm was everything we hoped to find for a hotel in London. Everything is quality over quantity. There’s everything you need and it’s of the highest quality. The mattress and bedding are probably the best I’ve ever slept on. The staff is super friendly! Lucy was a great and attentive host at the bar and the manager Sylvia was very welcoming! Also loved the breakfast (well needed after a few drinks the night before). The avocado on toast by chef Sarah is a must try! We will definitely be back next time we visit London.

title: Fabulous location - would definitely return
text: This boutique hotel was recommended by my Sister and it didn’t fail to disappoint. Minutes from Paddington Station it was superbly located. (We could not hear the trains or even see them from the hotel). It’s possible to check in and out on-line so hassle free. We stayed in the large room which wasn’t huge but very comfortable. The bed was large, with lovely linen and very comfortable. The room smelt lovely - I think it may have been the fragrance of the complimentary toiletries. The breakfast was wonderful - we had cooked breakfast which was very tasty - even included avocado - taken in a relaxing, informal lounge. Without exception all of the staff were lovely- nothing was too much trouble. The very kind receptionist even arranged for complimentary coffees after a long day out- coffee was delicious. Barista staff and Lounge staff all very helpful and friendly. Would definitely stay again. A quirky hotel, ideally situated (check out the nearby canal which leads to Little Venice and a 10 minute walk to Hyde Park), with very friendly staff. Thank you The Pilgrm from the Garlands

title: Cool Hotel
text: Nice rooms with lots of quirky but functional features - good location just off main road nr Pad Station but relatively quiet (for central London). No formal reception, so just find a friendly member of staff to check you in.

title: Excellent hotel!
text: My flight got cancelled and I needed a hotel close to the Heathrow Express, since all airport hotels were all fully booked. Booked it by chance, and I couldn't have picked a better hotel. The staff is extremely nice, the welcome has been so lovely that all the stress was forgotten immediately. The room (medium) was decorated with a lot of love for detail, the bed is very comfortable. Everything seems very new. I was able to work in the lounge the whole day (free wifi) and even had a great breakfast (highly recommend the poached eggs) and also dinner. Will definitely check their availablity for my next stay in London.

title: Convenient hotel with some drawbacks
text: On the plus side, this hotel is very thoughtfully designed and they have restored many great features of the buildings. Really appreciate the aesthetic and small boutique feel - the linens and towels were high quality and the bed was comfy. The lounge was a nice place to stop for a snack or drink and the main floor coffee bar was convenient. And you really can't beat the proximity to Heathrow and Paddington station. There were a few things, however, that were downsides at The Pilgrm. The elevator was broken during our stay, so we needed to take the stairs to the 4th floor, which was awkward with luggage. We also had an issue with our room keys both days and needed to have staff assist with the master key to open the room. The windows were not insulated well and there was significant noise from the street. We also noticed some design flaws, such as no power outlet in the bathroom and the only power outlets near the bed being located under a dark shelf, making it tricky to actually plug something in... Why not locate them on top of the bedside shelves? No way to make the room warmer or cooler - could be an issue in summer months. Would probably stay elsewhere next time in London since there are better options at a similar price point.

title: Quirky and very pleasant
text: Stayed here for three nights lately and found this hotel to be in a great location near Paddington station. Room was very small as we booked with Booking.com and we would have got a better room for same money if we had booked directly with hotel. Bed linen and towels in room really good quality. Breakfast is really good and has some good organic products. Wine list is well chosen and has all organic and biodynamic wines. Very good coffee shop on ground floor and also coffee stations on each level. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Will certainly stay here again but will book directly.

title: Postage stamp of a room and very noisy!
text: Common areas are lovely but bedroom was not great. The bad

title: Great location, cool design and great price
text: Stayed here for 5 nights with my partner for work. Location was super handy to tube station. The hotel itself is gorgeous, the attention to detail is superb and the building is charming. Breakfast was delicious and the breakfast staff were so friendly. Rooms were very cool, really nice design - they are on the small side, but we didn't spend enough time in the rooms to be bothered by this. Have already recommended this place to friends for their upcoming London trips.

title: On point. Marvellous hotel without the corporate drudge
text: If you want a stay in a hotel that delivers on style AND comfort, look no further. The room sizes are no secret. It is advertised on the site but if you want a good sized room, go large. The Lounge offers particularly tastey fare and a cocktail menu that focuses on quality ingredients and not the trimmings (perfect). Splendid location for access via Paddington station to the delights of old London town. Thank you for a stay that was delightfully now.

title: The Pilgrm a hidden Gem
text: Found the Pilgrm following a ‘Guardian’ review ...a hidden gem in a part of London we (and others) have yet to discover . Close to Paddington Station in an area that is coming alive ...looks like a coffee shop when you first enter (great coffee) then tardis like you discover great boutique style rooms, and a superb first floor restaurant bar area ..casual in ambience but great food with simple but lovingly prepared dishes Easy walking distance to Oxford Street or if it’s raining you can soon catch the bus. We came by car and used the ‘Just Park’ app finding a superb 24 hour parking slot in someone’s drive just 3 minutes from the Hotel Will use the ‘Pilgrm’ next time we need a night in London Town

title: Small and beautiful
text: I've stayed here twice in the last few months, and will certainly stay again! I stayed here first because the location is fantastic - about 30 seconds from Paddington Station. Everything here is fresh, new and beautiful, with a super hip vibe. The rooms are admittedly small and snug, the lounge is really the best place to hang with your laptop. The morning breakfasts are also fantastic - I love the avocado toast!

title: Great value for money, well-designed, convenient location
text: Staff were friendly and helpful and the rooms were clean, modern, comfortable and well decorated. The toiletries smelt fabulous (they even give you a little Ren kit with face cream and night cream) and you could tell that the towels and linens were good quality. The bed was really comfortable and we slept well every night. The hotel gives you refillable water bottles, which you can refill from the lounge area (they forgot to give us ours, but later when we went to the restaurant asking for water, they realised their mistake and gave us bottles immediately - so make sure you get yours when you check-in!). The hotel's location is great as well. While the hotel is not in the prettiest part of London, it is very close to Paddington tube station, which is on many lines, making it a convenient place to stay. A few things that could have been improved: There is still a bit of construction going on in one wing (the hotel isn't 100% finished yet), and so we were woken up by some drilling that started fairly early (9 am-ish). It would be good if this started after 10:30 am, just in case some guests want to have a lie-in. Also, the sink would benefit from having a towel holder attached to it or right next to it, as we had to keep the hand towel inside the bathroom (as sink was outside the bathroom). This was a bit annoying but not a big deal. Finally, during our first night, hot water was coming out of both of the sink nozzles. We didn't tell any of the staff about this but the issue seemed to have been resolved on its own by our second night. The property is fairly new, so we understand that there are always small teething issues at the start and I'm sure these will get resolved in some time. All in all, the issues we experienced were minor and we absolutely loved our stay here. It is great value for money, especially for a hotel located in central London! The rooms may be small but they have everything you need in them. We plan to stay here again when we're back in the city. P.S. They don't seem to respond to their emails, so perhaps try contacting them over the phone if you need to ask or request anything. I tried emailing them to ask for something for our next stay and it's been 10 days now and still nothing!!

title: Hip hotel in great location for Paddington & Heathrow Airport
text: Paddington has not been known for great hotels. The Pilgrm is a game changer - perfectly located next to the station for quick access to trains and Heathrow Airport. Loved the comfortable rooms, with a homely feel. The Lounge is a great place to relax, work or meet and offers simple, well priced and delicious dining & drinks. Great Workshop Coffee concession in The Lobby, Free Filtered Water and loved the Larder on each floor, with complimentary quality coffee/tea and books to borrow. Negatives are the noise in the street facing rooms. They do offer a sleep kit of ear plugs and an eye mask - but ultimately the Owners need to invest in secondary glazing. Maintenance was also patchy (the lift was not working during our visit and all Larder Fridges were out of order). The Reception Staff could also sharpen up, as are a little too laid back and not service orientated. It’s however well priced and perfect for that late flight arrival, or early getaway.

title: Overall - I'd Recommend!
text: We are just back from a weekend in London, staying in the Pilgrm. The hotel is really stylish, perhaps a little bit more style than function in places, but overall we really enjoyed our stay. The place has a lovely charm to it, as the original building itself is older but refurbed with really modern decor and facilities such as the delicious in house barista coffee, still and sparkling water on tap at reception and a nice lounge serving food and drinks. On our first night, we stayed in a room that had gorgeous original windows, but they weren't the best for blocking out the sounds of a busy London street. The next morning I spoke to a very helpful member of staff who arranged an alternative room without any hassle and had our key ready and waiting when we got in, she really was a pleasure to deal with. Our bags had already been delivered to our room. Our new room was perfect. The rooms are spotlessly clean, showers are great and beds are really comfy. Space is limited alright, but we spent 3 nights in a medium room and managed fine. London is a city to see, not to spend a huge amount of time in a hotel. Location wise it's about 60 seconds from Paddington station, or you can walk to lots of places in 30/40 mins - couldn't be better placed for a weekend of exploring or a short stay for business. Had we not had such lovely service with our room change, maybe I'd feel differently, but overall I'd be happy to recommend the Pilgrm.

title: Chic rooms but very noisy
text: We knew not to expect too much from this hotel because of their very reasonable rates (for London). However we were impressed with the clever design of the rooms, especially how they have fit in some thoughtful gadgets (like speakers, in wall usb plugs etc) given the tiny room sizes. We booked a medium room but it was still very very small. Only have just enough space to open 1 large suitcase. The major problem with the rooms is lack of sound proofing. In the mornings you can hear doors banging shut when your fellow guests are leaving their rooms (as early as 5/6am) or when house keeping is cleaning the rooms. Their house keeping staff seemed to have no consideration of the noises they produced when shutting and opening the bedroom doors. You can also hear/feel the trains coming in for some of their rooms (we stayed in both H and M wing). I would definitely recommend this hotel if you are on a budget and would like to stay in something hip and trendy. The hotel is still very new so go before their deco and facilities becomes worn and overused.

title: Desaster of stay...
text: London is known as friendly and helpful, not at this hotel. Staff is very young (some friendly, some not) and you can feel a mismanagement as everything is very chaotic and not really delighting. The check in was that we had to put in credit card details ourself and it took ages till we had our badge. The lift was not working and jackpot, we had an upgrade to a super tiny room where I was taking the luggage storer (the tiny thing you can put your luggage on) into the bathroom to store our beauty cases on there. The upgrade costs us 80£ a night on top, so in total I paid over 1000 £ for 5 nights which was not worth it at all! The bigger jackpot was, that we had to walk to the highest floor several times a day. Such an annoying part, especially when we left the hotel early in the morning and had to bring our luggage down 4 floors in a very old, english house. The only thing which worked very well, was the kitchen. Lovely chefs and nice breakfast, but the service was horrible. Again very young people without gastronomic experience. In our 14 m2 room (which was the biggest they have, kind of their suite) had one plug for english loading cables, not even USB but they helped out with adapters which was at least ok then. Overall the experience was poor and I would not recommend to stay there anymore. Please take a brief look also at the prices because the value was not worth the money!

title: Not perfect, but does the job
text: This hotel is rather unusual but really well located. The rooms have everything you need without having a lot - if that makes sense. I stayed for a week and the room was very comfortable, Wifi good & free, bathroom adequate - but not a lot more. For me though, this is all I really care about in a room - however it can get loud in this area at all hours of the night. There is no storage space, no air-conditioning (only heating and we had some unusually warm days in London). The Big Bus tour bus stops right at the door of the hotel which was a real bonus. The lift was not working for the duration of my stay which made things challenging with luggage, but I guess good for fitness. Buffet breakfast was very very simple but done the job. The hotel is not the easiest to locate and looks like a café, when you walk in there is no reception - only a few people working on stools and iPads. You are a walking distance from Paddington station and some great places to dine.

title: Good and bad
text: As most other reviewers have said, this hotel has good and bad features: Good - location almost next to Paddington Station, friendly staff, ever-so-clean rooms, towels and bed linen, comfy beds, excellent shower, tasty breakfasts (I enjoyed a superb avocado on toast with feta cheese and two poached eggs), definite overall feeling that you're staying somewhere that is a bit out of the ordinary and, dare I say it, trendy! Bad - small and dark rooms (I stayed in a medium room with space for a double bed and not much else), lack of storage space and no chair to sit in, tiny shelf in bathroom, electric sockets for recharging phones are hard to find (under the bedside shelves), impossible to control heating in one's room, no phone in the rooms (how do you contact reception?) or hotel information The (small) lift was also out of service for several hours on my second day. My room was on the third floor and I had only one small backpack but other guests may well have suffered as they negotiated the array of small corridors and flights of stairs. I (Pete) stayed here for only one night and had already booked to stay here again in the New Year but will think again after that visit about whether to re-book. One must always remember that one gets what one pays for in life, so if you want to get better than this, be prepared to pay more! I end with a tip - I was advised upon my arrival that breakfast was free but on checking out, I was informed that the fruit juice I had ordered would cost £3.99. I queried this and was told that a coffee or other hot beverage would have been free but the juices aren't. I was, however, not charged!

title: Great, affordable design oriented hotel
text: We stayed here for a night as we wanted to be close to paddington. Compared to the brand name American hotels (hilton) near Paddington It was almost half the price. We booked the king room since it was so cheap. Reminds me a bit of the Freehand hotel chain in the US. Great prices, amazing care put into the design (paint colors, stationary, lobby, bedding, bathroom) - which i love, and trying to push out of the old school hotel model. We enjoyed the stay, bed and room were very comfortable and clean. I found it to be pretty spacious compared to NYC and London hotels. I always bring my owns soaps and things so I appreciated that they don't give little bottles in each room - much more environmentally friendly! The cafe is really neat and there were lots of trendy people hanging out working and enjoying the bar. We were up on the 5th or 6th floor and there weren't double paned glass or covers over the old windows - we had to wake up super early to catch flight so didn't have a chance to find out if it was noisy in the morning. The hall echoed a bit as well, but not many people staying there while we were there so no issues. Would definitely go back! the pub across the street was really nice too - great scotch egg.

title: Hit and miss
text: Stayed here for one night ahead of a business meeting. I booked via Booking.com. Very interesting accommodation and plenty of pluses and minuses! On the downside: I booked a small room and small it was! That said it was (just) big enough to fit a double bed and the website did warn that it was modest. The room was cold when I arrived and I initially struggled to get heat. When it did come on I then found it hard to maintain a constant heat. It quickly became too hot! Liked the idea of free tea/coffee in the pantry but sadly the fridge was broken and there was no milk (was available from the bar) Was a bit confused with the amount of emails received before I arrived urging me to "check in" ahead of arrival. I did this but in the event there was a nice lady with laptop available to greet me. The main gripe was the noise from outside. My room (22) overlooked the square but the sash window didn't fit well and the noise (people and traffic) was very loud all night. To be fair the hotel supply a "sleep pack" consisting of earbuds and eye mask but this was only partially effective. On the plus side: Nice friendly welcome and a cold bottle of water on arrival Room although small was clean, well designed and well appointed Bathroom also small but immaculate with nice toiletries and towels. Suspect it was all brand new. Hotel had really friendly vibe - was well located next to Paddington and good value for London. Didn't eat or drink but there is a restaurant and coffee bar both with interesting menus. As long as my next room is quieter I'd definitely return. And next time I'd book direct as the rates are superior and appear to include breakfast.

title: Cute boutique hotel in a location you can't beat
text: The Pilgrm has an awesome location right next to Paddington station, minutes away from the Tube and Heathrow Express. Check-In/Check-Out was quick (faster if you do it online in advance) and staff was friendly. The interior has been tastefully refurbished in a cute boutique-y style. I appreciated the water sation on the groundfloor and the pantry on our floor (make your own tea, coffee etc.). Room was compact, but since it was a city trip we were only using to spend the night anyway (still, I'd go for the large double room). The bathroom was also nice and the shower was working well (not flooding the whole bathroom as is the case in so many hotels). The beds were comfy and eventhough our room was facing the street (London St., 2nd floor) I slept really well. Would definitely stay there again. Also excellent coffee in the coffee shop on the ground floor.

title: Affordable boutique hotel
text: Stayed here for two nights with my partner. Got to know the staff quickly, Aleni checked us in swiftly and explained the hotel was still being finished. This did not get in the way of our stay. Room size was as expected, went for large room and was spacious but lacked storage. Beautiful tiled bathroom and rainfall shower with nice soap and shower gel. Getting into London was easy, underground across the road, Baker loo line. Bus 36 on praed st takes you to Hyde park/Marble Arch in less than 5 minutes. Lounge was tasteful, lovely seats and nice atmosphere. For pre dinner drinks try the pilgrm cocktail with billitong as nibbles. Scrambled egg was made especially to order by very accommodating kitchen staff. Quite possibly the best in London! Only down side was the pub across the road who were chucking kegs out on the street at half 6 in the morning! We would definitely stay here again!

title: Maddening room design & overpriced
text: The common spaces at The Pilgrm are exactly the boutique hotel you'd expect, but the rooms are maddeningly designed. There's barely a surface to put anything on in either the bathroom (one narrow shelf) or the room itself (one foldable luggage rack). The "closet" are a few hangers on wall-mounted hooks, with the most functional one being hidden behind a mirror you can't move (so you have to contort yourself around the mirror in order to hang up anything). The Edison bulbs are pretty to look at but throw off hardly any light. And for all that, the room didn't feel any less generic than one of the big chain hotels. It's designed for instagram looks, not for actual people using the room. Super weird. The good: The staff was lovely and the building is really cool. All the common spaces are beautiful. The refillable water station was great. The bad: Beyond the baffling room design, it's just expensive. Breakfast wasn't included and was overpriced, and the room wasn't worth even the deal we got through a 3rd party. I wanted to love this place, but it was the most disappointing place we stayed.

title: Perfect Location - Lovely Hotel
text: The way you are greeted is very informal - it's warm, engaging and not done behind a stuffy big desk. In fact, you wouldn't know that the line of people sitting on small stools working on their Macs are staff..they are. Checking in online is a MUST - it saves so much time and its the way forward...why don't other hotels do this? After dropping my things off I made my way to the lounge for a well-deserved G&T. The Lounge is gorgeous, welcoming and warm. You feel at home straight away. If you're hungry I would suggest venturing out as the menu is very small - Paddington have a mountain of places to try. On my return to the Hotel, 130am, I was surprised to see the cleaner hoovering?! Who gets their cleaners to work at that time? I was questioned as to who I was, why was I in the Hotel and which room I was staying in...this was done quite aggressively. It annoyed me that I had to PROVE that I was actually a paying guest. You can't get far without a card which is coded. Breakfast was delicious - highly recommended. The Lounge was very busy so be prepared to not get served straight away. I would stay here again - there are a few things that need ironing out, but I guess that what's expected with a new boutique hotel.

title: Location location location!
text: My stay at the Pilgrim was phenomenal. I was in London for just over a week on business and this hotel met all of my needs. I cannot stress how perfect the location was for me- direct tube service to the hotel and access to all major lines within a 90 second walk from the hotel. The room was clean, warm and the bed super comfy! The staff working the lounge in the evening were very friendly! I would highly recommend. My only negative is that the shampoo/conditioners were never refilled for the whole stay, and travelling without my own has become a bit of a habit as these are usually restocked. Will definitely be back!

title: We absolutely love it!
text: On Monday evening we were enjoying Alladin Musical and after that we were staying at The pilgrm Hotel. Hotel is in great location, 2 minutes walk from the Paddington station. Our room was on the 3th level with easy access from the lift or from the staircase. Next to our room was small Pantry with the facilities like hot chocolate, filtered water, coffee and tea . A soon we came to our room I saw on the bedside table little card with greetings from The Pilgrm Team and personal touch like Ren toiletries. We really liked the decor of the room and also the size was good enough for two of us. Bed was extremely comfortable and spotless. In our room was everything what we really needed: hangers, hairdryer, nice magazines, marshal Bluetooth speaker. We absolutely loved the old fashion shower and sink with small soap on the rope -which is free of charge if wanted take it home. Shower was hot enough with the good pressure of water. In the morning we were eating delicious breakfast with very nice coffee. Restaurant team was professional and friendly. Lounge is spacious and super comfortable with nice sofas and chairs. We will back there definitely!

title: A gem of a place to stay in London!
text: I stayed at The Pilgrm for one night this weekend and it really was a lovely experience (I was a bit worried having read a few negative reviews - ignore them!) The staff team was incredibly friendly and helpful. The room was really delightful. (For London, I didn’t even think the room was small in the slightest!). I had a great night’s sleep in the fabulously comfortable bed. I loved the decor, in particular the shower room with the quirky and charming enamel sink etc. Others have mentioned no hanging space. For one (or even two) nights, I thought there was ample hanging space, and cleverly tucked out of sight behind a full length mirror. Perfect spot for an overnight in London. I’ll be back. Thank you to the staff (including the kind young man who helped me find my room) you are a credit to the hotel.

title: Perfect homey hotel
text: The hotel was a truly rare find. It's situated near the Paddington station and allows you to easily explore all the main attractions of the Central London. The medium sized room we had was spacious (compared to other things available across London) and really lovely decorated. It was very clean! The whole concept of the hotel is really great and gives you the feeling of being at home but also has the elegant vibe to it. The only small complaint we have is that there should be a small chair or a table in the bathroom because there is very little space to put your stuff. That being said, we highly recommend the hotel and will definitely stay here when back in London!

title: Stylish Boutique Hotel
text: The Pilgrm is a fantastic stylish hotel in great location. The Pilgrm is a hotel that does things differently and for me it works perfectly. The hotel has been lovingly restored to retain as many of the original features and as much character as possible. There is no fussy reception desk as the check-in has been streamlined so that you check-in before arrival and just pick your key up from the help staff from the laidback coffee shop in the entrance. The rooms have been very stylishly decorated and contain all the things that you need with none of the unnecessary extras. The bathroom has a unique contemporary style and everything that you require. The beds are really comfortable with the luxury bedding that you would expect. There are some nice touches like the bluetooth speaker that allows you to stream music in your room. The lounge has been beautifully decorated and was a lovely laidback place to have a drink. The service in the lounge as throughout the hotel was fantastic. The lounge is also where breakfast is served, and the cooked breakfast was first class - top quality ingredients cooked to perfection. The coffee is also excellent. The location of The Pilgrm makes it a great base to stay in London as it so close to Paddington station. There is lots to see and do in the local vicinity and lots of place close by to eat and drink if you decide not to travel further afield. A can personally recommend the Lebanese restaurant a couple of doors down which was great. I will look forward to returning to The Pilgrm next time I am in London.

title: Disappointing
text: The hotel building is lovely & has been refurbished beautifully . We arrived before noon & our room was ready which was great as I could freshen up after my train journey. The large room was very small indeed but it was only a 1 night stay so I wasn’t particularly bothered. Had a drink in the lounge which was buzzy & a nice space. Upon our return at after midnight the room was like an ice box as the trendy old school radiator wasn’t working despite being maxed up to 5 before our departure I went down to ask for help... incredibly surly blonde woman on night duty - what is your room number - 212 - no hmmfff can’t you remember what the initial is —- this is not the way to treat a guest who is being super polite . Happily she dispatched a very patient young man Lawrence to check that the radiator was not hot - he was a star btw if management are reading this & give a fig. Ended up with a plug in heater which was ugly. Finally after 45 mins settled in to a warming room.... The street noise levels are totally unacceptable . I was visiting London for fun not work and so a broken sleep wasn’t a deal breaker but woke up about 5 times in 7 hours. It’s not double glazed which is bizarre as the windows are new. I appreciate that this is a historic building but if installation of double glazed windows was impossible they should have sourced noise cancelling shutters or something to minimise the considerable street noise . I commented on the heating situation on check out & got comped a breakfast . Given we had lunch reservations I wasn’t really fussed about breakfast . I choose a continental breakfast. Went up to chose it & it was laughable... I have never seen such a meagre choice... one loaf of bread / some triangles of plastic cheese & some cakes that were tiny & possibly from Lidl. My overarching impression is that this place is all style & no substance. It was interesting to see a management response that began with ‘you can certainly stay again’ ... a hotel should want all visitors to return... it’s called repeat business but in order to engender loyalty the basics have to be adequate which is Not my experience of the Pilgrim Hotel Hope this is helpful to fellow travellers .

title: Great Location stylish accommodation
text: A great hotel with some real quirky touches from the record player in the coffee shop to the Pantry to make your own coffee and tea. I read the rooms were small so I booked the large double room which gave me a bit more space to move around in. Room looked like it had recently been refurbished, have since found out the hotel is only a year old although the building is very old, however the room was super clean and comfortable. Bed and bedding excellent, small compact bathroom with a larger shower and great shower power. No real shelf space in the bathroom, I was travelling alone so I could make do but for 2 people it would be tough as you can really only have one person in the bathroom at a time. Good quality fluffy towels and a nice shower gel provided in the shower area. The Marshall blue tooth speaker was a nice touch and great quality. There are no wardrobes only a small hanging space behind the mirror. It was enough for me as only stayed a few nights. There is a safe hidden under the bed that I only found on the last day so be sure to look there if you want to store personnel affects. I didn't use the restaurant so can't comment on the food but I can confirm that the sign out the front that say's "The best coffee around" is 100% accurate. Instead of having a kettle in the room each area has a Pantry stocked with 3 types of tea and coffee style bags with hot and cold water on tap. The fridge was broken but they had provided 2 types of milk in long life containers. The noise is an issue as the windows let in a lot of sound, I am surprised they are not double glazed. Maybe something they should look at updating. There is a sleep kit next to the bed that has ear plugs and a sleep mask but after all the walking I did during my stay I found I passed out every night and didn’t need to use them. There is no air conditioning just a fan in the room so not sure what the rooms would be like in summer. Lift is small only takes 4 people but never had a problem while staying there. Check in is a table and laptop which is always attended. Quick and efficient check in and check outs and always a smiling face to great you. Nothing was a problem and they are keen to help with any questions. My room was not ready as I arrived very early in the morning but I was given free coffee and guided to the rest rooms if I wanted to freshen up. The Pilgrm is super close to Paddington Express and underground stations. Not even 2 minutes’ walk. There are little convenience stores and restaurants in the same street plus the pub right next door so you don’t really have to go far to eat or buy essentials if you don’t need to. You can walk to Oxford street and be at Marble Arch in about 20 minutes or Notting Hill in about the same walk time. (I do walk fast so it may take others a little longer). All in all I enjoyed my stay at the Pilgrm and would definitely stay there again.

title: Great Hotel in an Awesome Location
text: Don't let the quaint little coffee shop throw you...it's part of the design and charm. When you walk in look for someone sitting at a cafe table along the left wall on a laptop as that is the "front desk clerk". The staff could not have been nicer, friendlier or more helpful. When we arrived our room was not quite ready so they offered us tea & coffee and a delicious muffin. The room itself (we were in a medium) was quite comfy for our short stay nd beautifully decorated. The location (1 minute walk to Paddington Station and the Heathrow Express, underground & trains to multiple major cities) was perfect. We would/will definitely stay there again.

title: Style over function
text: Yes, the website states that the rooms are small. So we got a "large" and it was still smaller than we expected. The size is not even the main problem, however, but the simple lack of enough storage or hanging space.
