text: I stayed 10 nights for personal reason with my friend. I really appreciated the space, the kitchen, the service and facilities. The place is clean. The staff is enjoying. The hotel is closed to the borough market and the london bridge. Very nice place to eat and to visit london.

title: Clean and beautiful hotel!
text: South Point Suites isn't the best when it comes to the location it is located a little outside London. Not way too far that you shouldn't book it because it is a beautiful hotel, the weather was not the best when we went but we did enjoy it and the hotel does have good breakfast in the morning. We definitely would book again!

title: Hidden Gem
text: I stayed at South Point on a business trip to London in November 2017. The upside was that is was within walking distance to work. In addition I had a room on the first floor away from the lifts and tucked in the corner which was great as it was quiet and peaceful meaning I got great sleep without much disturbance. The breakfast was OK but quite basic. That could improve. I used the gym and that was always empty which was good. The hotel also offers free laundry services which I plan on using before I travel on to my next destination. A nice little place and I will definitely stay here again.

title: value for money
text: The accommodation was very comfortable and clean and lots of attention to detail including a corkscrew...Staff very friendly and very helpful...Good value for money A pleasant stay will definitely stay again sometime this year ...

title: A very comfortable no-frills stay
text: This is the first time I stay here, although I've been staying on or close to Bermondsey street (great area for restaurants and independent boutiques) for the past 5+ years. These apartments went through a couple of identities and refurbs before ending in South Point. I must say that in spite of the minor negatives, I enjoyed my first stay very much. The booking process was prompt and efficient and the booking amendment was dealt with on the spot very efficiently. After staying there for 4 nights I came to meet a lot more enthusiastic and helpful staff than the one who checked me in. Although I was fairly familiar with the offerings of the place, it would be helpful if the reception staff would refresh your memory and takes you through the basic info quickly. My checking-in was literally done without even making eye-contact. No info about the check-out time, pantry, breakfast, swiping room key on the outdoor sensor when having a late night out, etc.. a Bad day, maybe? :-) I've booked a studio for 4 nights and stayed at #304. The studio was well-equipped and had all the necessary creature-comforts although I hardly stayed there. Would've liked some coffee sachets because the provisions were all esspresso pods. The bed, pillows, and linen were extremely comfortable. The negative aspect of the bedroom was its size and lack of natural light. Space was literally just enough to fit in a bed and two tiny nightstands. I would've liked to have a window or a completely open space but the layout was you have the living and kitchen area to the right of the entrance (with a window overlooking the building's side entrance - not much of a view if you're a view-freak) and the bedroom to the left, with the bathroom right in the middle in front of the main door. I was quite impressed with the amenities inside the bathroom and kitchen. Found all that I needed for my stay there and did not use either the breakfast in the pantry nor the gym. Housekeeping does not work weekends so they gave the studio a light touch-up clean the night before I left, which I found very convenient as opposed to a hotel where the banging doors of cleaners constantly disturb you. Putting the size of the space aside, the studio was sufficient for one person (though the bed was a double). I reckon that with two persons it would be cramped. Check-out was done by the same person who checked me in, and he was in a much better mood :-D So it all ended on a happy note! I spent my last 45 minutes waiting for my airport ride in the living room on the ground floor, and it had a very cozy feel to it. I would definitely stay there again, but maybe the next time I will try the 1 bedroom suite. My bill came to £599 for 4 nights. A no-fuss, friendly, contemporarily designed suites and premises that I will definitely visit again.

title: New, modern & comfortable
text: Love it! I booked a single night for a business trip and the hotel is really new, clean, and the rooms are great. 3 minute walk to Sainsbury to stock up and cook dinner in the mini-kitchen. Will definitely stay again. I only had one minor gripe and this is common to a lot of hotels - because the bed is near the front door and I had been allocated an accessible room there were quite a lot of LEDs shining at night so complete darkness was not possible. I usually bring electrical tape to hotels for this reason... :)

title: Excellent
text: The hotel is situated about a 10 mins walk from London bridge station in the Bermondsey area. There are plenty of bars and restaurants in the area. The hotel is clean and the rooms serve a studio flat with all the essentials you would need to cater for yourself. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming. The breakfast was delicious with hot and cold options. there were options for gluten free and diary free as well. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone travelling to london. To get into the city it is a matter of a 10 min walk to the tube.

title: South point Suites
text: Had a lovely relaxing stay on New Year’s Eve. Staff were polite and informative and the suite was clean. Breakfast had a wide variety of choices to suit everyone. Not much of a choice where the cooked food was concerned. Complementary hot drinks in reception throughout our stay.

title: Perfect place to rest your Head
text: Wife booked this place for her work trip as its close to her office. Stayed there with her. Pleasant staff, big rooms as far as London goes. Close to BoroughMarket, London Bridge, Tower Bridge. We would stay here again.

title: Fabulous apartments and lovely staff
text: As a group of three friends this was a brilliant option to avoid paying for separate sets of hotel rooms. A one bed apartment with a pull out bed in the lounge was a great solution. Modern, spotlessly clean and quietly tucked away yet close to trendy Bermondsey Street. Friendly, welcoming staff. It was a 12 minute walk to the nearest tube but that’s the only downside.

title: All you need for a comfortable stay near London Bridge
text: Fantastic facilities and a much better option than just a hotel room. Kitchen facilities give you more flexibility. Breakfast is an option if you don't want to make anything yourself. The staff were always friendly and helpful. Especially the breakfast host who I kept forgetting to give my room number too and the lady who checked me in :)

title: Strongly recommend !
text: We spent 3 nights with our 3 kids and had a fantastic time! Hotel is well located, in a quiet street but with many lovely restaurants and bakery. Walking distance from London Bridge and metro station. Room was big enough for the 5 of us. Small kitchen very handy when kids are too tired to eat out.Staff was very professional and welcoming. I would strongly recommend!

title: Let down by housekeeping & bad noise insulation
text: Its new and clean, so no issues there. The area is great and has good transport links and lots to do. Rooms are not as big as they make it look in the pictures. Probably one of the worst sleeps I’ve ever had in a hotel. The noise insulation in this hotel is terrible, you can literally hear every door open and slam on your floor as well as housekeeping screaming to come in to your room and clean, even though you have a DO NOT DISTURB SIGN on your door, the housekeeping also like to have their own converstions outside your rooms in the morning whether it be the on the walkie talkies or outside your room. We pretty much heard everyone on our floor coming in and out especially at 3am in the morning. We also asked specifically for a late checkout and all was agreed, as we had a late night and wanted some extra sleep, but obviously they didn’t take this into consideration and decided to give us a wake up call at 12pm to tell us to leave the room even though it was sorted the night before. Would have thought a new place would have thought about noise insulation, they haven’t. If you don’t want to have a decent nights sleep, this hotels for you! Definitely won’t be staying here again, wasn’t worth the money. Feels more like a overpriced YMCA in terms of service.

title: Great Place to Stay/
text: Great staff and very friendly place to stay. Had breakfast one day and was very happy wit the selection and price. Close to city events and excellent food, bars and coffee houses a close walk away. Uber is allowed in London and you can just hop on or off them easily. .

title: Magnificent Christmas
text: Cannot recommend this place highly enough - great facilities- loved our Christmas and appreciated our full kitchen. Beds lovely and comfortable, even the sofa bed, and the receptionists were fabulous (even minding the dog while we got coffee). Also afterwards they bent over backwards to track down some lost property successfully- thanks. Also, easy to walk to interesting and famous local landmarks and bars - very easy to be with your dog. Many thanks - we’ll be back.

title: Return visit- better than before
text: We stayed here a few years ago when it was Go Native. The change in ownership and their refurbishment has made a big improvement. You can tell that the furniture and fittings are new. The kitchen was well equipped but a more detailed manual for the combination oven would have been useful. The bed was large and comfortable although this did leave little room to walk around (bruised shins!)The corridors are unusual in that they are open to the air outside. It did mean they it was cold but we didn’t need to hang around!! The staff were very friendly. We didn’t have breakfast as we self catered but it was very popular amongst other guests even on 25th December. We will definitely visit again!

title: Wonderful state of the art apartments
text: New, modern and well equipped apartments. Only down point was the lack of storage space. If you want to stay more than couple of days you might have a problem. Besides that all was perfect. USB docking stations were available - great! Staff very helpful and professional.

title: It’s a must !!
text: Great stay, great location, great staff. Perfect for our stay in London and walking distance from London Bridge tube. The location of the apartment in Bermondsey street is perfect for sightseeing and more locally, good pubs and cafes. Definitely worth a stay.

title: Great spot closes to the Maltby markets
text: We liked this accommodation for a London break staff were friendly. Location is great close to the buses and trains. Plenty of options for eating out and several supermarkets near by. The gym was also really good

title: Good
text: Staff very nice. Check In easy.Nice Pantry.Good Laundry room and gym.Easy to find restaurant (turkist and china and italiano and india.Easy to fine supermarket. Easy to find bus.Near to Station.Near to bycycle rental

title: Great location
text: Nice room but isn’t a junior suite

title: A thoroughly good idea
text: I am staying here for business and it has been the best hotel experience I have ever had. The team are very attentive, the rooms are excellent and kept in a good condition, the magazines in the living area are always up-to-date and good quality, and the kitchen is well-stocked to allow me to cook proper meals which is the biggest benefit to me. Thanks a lot, South Point Suites team!

title: 10 points!
text: Stayed here with family (2 adults, 2 children and a baby) over the weekend. Very good location, approx 10-15 mins walk from London Bridge station. In a very trendy area as there are lots of boutique style bars, restaurants and cafes. Area seem safe with lots of light after dark. The hotel entrance is a bit hidden as it down a side alley. But there is a sign at high level on the main street indicating the hotel. We had no trouble finding it. The entrance is quite small but feels cosy and there is a desk as you enter and a coffee/breakfast area to the left. The check was very fast and the staff was very welcoming. We arrived slightly early and the room was ready. There is a lift to all floors which make it's easier with kids and luggage. The room itself was very nice and clean. They activated the sofa bed which was very cosy and the kids loved it. We also asked for a travel cot to be installed which the staff initially said would not fit but then said they will fit it in. We found there was plenty of space for all of us in the room and plenty of walking space. The room had the basics such as toilet, shower which were immaculate and also had kitchen sink, kettle, dishwasher, cooker, fridge which was a nice touch. Assume this for the longer staying guests at the hotel. We decided to pay for the breakfast as it was cheaper if we paid in advance. They offered free breaky for kids with a paying adult which we took. The breaky is limited but it has the basics such as toast, crossiants, cereals, teas, coffees etc. The beds were comfortable and we all slept fine. I did notice whilst sleeping in the kitchen area the clock on the oven is really bright as it lights up the kitchen area and could be a bit of a distraction when sleeping for some. There were 2 smart Tv's in which were very new and had lots of extras such as YouTube, Netflix, internet browsers. There was internet at the hotel which worked for us. Overall a very nice hotel and would definitely recommend it and would have it on our list of hotels to return to.

title: Weekend in central London
text: Had a really nice time. We took full advantage of all the cafe’s, wine bars & restauraunts. 5mjn from the station and in central london within 20 min from the hotel. Great food, great staff & great room! Thanks guys, see you on our next trip!

title: Amazing
text: Me and my partner stayed here for our anniversary, once we got to the reception we was welcomed by the staff and our room was very quickly arranged. Steeping into our room we was very pleased with the size, the amount of utensils given and the products there to use for our convenience. The room was spacious, clean and offered a lot of natural light. We both found the room cozy and warm, a home away from home. Every time we popped out or returned we was always welcomed back, the staff felt genuine and was always happy to help. For the same price as some basic hotels, south point suites offered so much more space and independance. 10/10 would recommend to others and would definitely come back and stay again.

title: Excellent Staff and Service
text: Stayed for 3 weeks as part of a business trip. The facilities were excellent and the individual suite was very well-equipped and comfortable. Having a TV both in the living area/kitchenette AND in front of the bed was a very nice touch. Both TVs had USB ports which allowed me to plug in my thumb drive to watch all the TV shows I had downloaded for my flight. Kitchenette was fully functional and, during those evenings where I just wanted to stay in, I was able to cook without any fuss. What really stood out for me was the excellent service provided by the staff. They were very friendly and helpful. They very kindly accepted parcels/letters on my behalf while I was at work and informed me when I could collect them from the reception. The staff also proactively checked the records and informed us that the breakfast was covered during our stay, even though my colleagues and I heard otherwise from our company. On my last day in the country I was in a rush and was unable to deliver a postcard to a friend who had asked for one. I asked a staff member to help me mail it when possible, and I can gratefully confirm that my friend did receive the postcard! There are some areas of improvement I would like to recommend: - The dryers in the laundry room were not very effective. Perhaps they needed some maintenance or were simply too worn out? I didn't have the time to report this to the reception but I'm sure this is something that can easily be solved, if it's not already been dealt with (since my trip was almost 3 months ago) - There were some days where I didn't have enough time to wash my dishes, and I appreciate the cleaning staff who washed them with the dishwasher for me. However, there were a few times when the dishes were not placed properly in the dishwasher, so the cleaning was not effective. My guess is that the cleaning staff might have been under a tight schedule and wasn't able to arrange the dishes appropriately. I just thought it would save resources if the dishes did not have to be cleaned twice. Nevertheless, these things did not detract from my overall wonderful and comfortable experience at South Point Suites. I would still recommend the place to a friend in a heartbeat!

title: Very convenient hotel
text: We enjoyed our stay very much. Kind personnel. A spacious, very well equiped room.Nice and tasteful decoration. The neighbourhood is young with lots of restaurants and cafes, and the London Bridge station is close by.

title: Best place to stay in London Bridge area
text: Excellent rooms, exceeds expectations in terms of facilities, large tv, really comfortable beds, spotlessly clean, gym (24 hours) plenty of water, towels and even fruit, pantry in case you forget the little things. Breakfast available if you want it, even some social events for business people. Best check-in services as the staff are so helpful, nothing is too much trouble, someone has got the training right as the service is consistently high. Housekeeping again excellent, everyday. I've stayed in many hotels in the area, including boutique style hotels but this is by far the best and very reasonable price, I would not stay anywhere else and would highly recommend to business people staying regularly as you can leave some luggage which is great for leaving the basics. Location is great, plenty of coffee shops, bars and restaurants but you don't hear any noise. Staying away from home every week can be hard, but South Point Suites have made it much easier by going the extra mile with both their facilities and service - thank you.

title: Wonderful place to stay
text: I cannot fault the hotel nor the customer service - both were superb and made for a very enjoyable visit to London. The hotel is very modern with a lovely relaxing reception area, I would highly recommend.

title: Great Stay - home from home
text: I stayed here and it was a great stay. Friendly, attentive staff from the beginning to end, without being intrusive. Suite was super comfy and had all I needed to feel part of a new neighbourhood rather than just a hotel guest. Breakfast in the morning was a full and varied selection plus grab n go to keep me topped up during the day. Look forward to staying again.

title: Enjoyable Stay
text: great location, great customer service and overall very happy with our stay. Would probably stay there again as good value for money and the location was fairly central and very close to London Bridge.

title: City trip
text: Perfect place to stay foe a city trip. Yes its not cheap but what is in London

title: Lovely hotel, staff friendly.
text: We booked the hotel on travelzoo for a introductory offer. 1 night stay breakfast included, late check out and arrival drink. The location of the hotel is perfect for east London travel just 2-3 min walk to Whitechapel station. The staff booked us in to our room early which was lovely as both my husband and I had a late night the night before. The staff on the desk are incredibly friendly and made us feel very welcome. Didn’t get the arrival drink promised as part of the package. Room on first floor view of garden roof which was nice. The rooms are very stylish and for one night the lack of storage was fine. The hotel has a few teething issues if I’m honest. The fire alarm light is incredibly bright and there is a motion sensor light which also is distracting when trying to sleep. The towel rail also fell off the wall when getting towel off. The sink wouldn’t drain very quickly. However these are minor problems which didn’t spoil our stay. The breakfast the next day was delicious again would say that there was a few teething problems in regards to staff. Lots of discussion going on very loudly about upsetting chef and my husbands breakfast came out missing 1x sausage, hash browns and toast. This was brought out after we spoke to someone. For the price we paid the hotel was great, the original features of the old mill are beautiful touches. I wouldn’t pay the prices for the breakfast if it wasn’t included in deal as breakfast would have came to £30+ for the two of us. I think once the hotel has been up and running a bit longer it will be perfect.

title: What'else?
text: I spent a wonderful weekend in London in a special hotel: nice and quiet room, helpful staff and complete and good breakfast. Special mention to a very kind Italian boy, member of the staff, Andrea, who made me feel at home suggesting me the best places to eat and have fun. I highly recommend staying in this hotel and I will definitely be back thanks to Andrea who left me his Business card for my future bookings. Wella, What'else? BOOK IT!

title: New hotel with funky rooms
text: Checked into this hotel one month after its opening, so my room was impeccable. Smart use of space, very modern. One thing missing though is a reading light for the bed. Not so nice to relax after a long work-day with the main lights on... I guess modern man is not to read any more, just watch TV or the computer? Friendly staff. Hotel restaurant wasn't bad, but you got little India around the corner with more exciting eateries so maybe skip on the hotel restaurant unless you're too tired to go out. Restaurant staff was a little new and inexperienced at the time. Choice of breakfast includes everything from full English to cereal bar. Very close to Whitechapel and about a 15 min walk to the train out to Excel

title: Pleasant and comfortable
text: Great staff who pay attention to their clients. Very professional. Always ready to help and see to your comfort. The room is modern, comfortable and sunny (large windows) but very little place to pack your things. The location is nearby an underground line. Good food. Breakfast : wide choice in the menu (traditional, vegetarian, sugar/salted proposal) and in addition a buffet. I recommand

title: Charming, trendy hotel in central London
text: Came for my girlfriends birthday, hotel staff upgraded our room as a birthday gift to her. This set the tone for all interaction with staff, so polite and helpful. Room was lovely, everything you need in a room and a particularly impressive bathroom with a walk in rainforest shower. Breakfast was included in the price of our stay and was amazing. Can’t go wrong with a full English!

title: Beautiful hotel
text: We booked one night in a standard double room, the cheapest we could find over Easter weekend! On our arrival we were given free drinks vouchers for the bar downstairs which was lovely! We were also pleasantly surprised to find out we had been upgraded to a superior room with and amazing terrace. The room was beautiful with a comfortable and clean bed, a lovely big bathroom (with jacuzzi bath), and a huge smart TV. The service was extremely friendly and professional- we would definitely stay here again.

title: Couldn’t have asked for more!
text: We stayed here last night and I can honestly say I was so so so happy. I booked the hotel as a birthday present for my fiancé alongside some concert tickets - which the reception staff very kindly printed off for me! The atmosphere in the hotel is so genuine and so lovely to just chill out in. We had a Warehouse X room and I have never slept so well in my entire life! The bed was amazing and we loved the decor - clearly a lot of thought has gone into making the history of the building and the vibe of the modern hotel merge together. It was just so relaxing and I couldn’t have asked for anything more. Emma - thank you for helping me find somewhere to park. Andrea - thank you for the upgrade. info@ - thank you for printing my tickets. Next time I promise I will just sit down and eat cereal, causing you no hassling! Just keep doing what you’re doing, it’s perfect.

title: Weekend away
text: Had a lovely experience at this hotel. About a year old everything still seemed new. Not your normal hotel kitted out with lots of furniture was very minimalist. Receptionist Eduard was our favourite will look forward staying there again.

title: Hipster but too hipster...
text: I was thrilled to be staying at New Road Hotel ahead of a gig at Village Underground. Online, the hotel appeared to be young, edgy and on-trend with the Shoreditech/Old Street/Brick Lane areas. Whilst the staff were extremely polite, and the lobby was a great space, my room unfortunately was somewhat a disappointment for the price paid. It was pretty much a bed, one dressing table with a built in cupboard, and an en-suite wet-room. The space was extremely small and the amenities were little to none... The room did not offer basic items you would expect in a hotel room ie kettle, iron etc. There was a communal coffee/tea machine outside for guests use on my floor (near the 'arcade' - quite cool I would addd) but to use an iron and ironing board, I had to visit another floor altogether! Maybe this is the future of hotels' cost saving strategies, but for the relatively steep price paid (on par with other popular London brands who offer in-room kettles, iron, slippers, mini toiletries) I don't believe this was worth it unfortunately. If I wanted just a room with a bed, I could have stayed at a Premier Inn or equivalent - it most likely would have been cheaper!

title: Contemporary stylish design and a service with a smile!
text: This brand new boutique hotel is located in East London but with Whitechapel tube station 3 min walking distance from the hotel all attractions are easily reachable. If you are into modern architecture City is few steps away. We stayed in pocket room which is the smallest type of rooms, however it had everything we needed - extra comfy large bed and great shower. Size of pocket room is actually a standard in many cities around the World such as London or New York. On each floor guests have complimentary coffee, tea and hot chocolate available at all times. As a travel agent I really appreciated service from all of the staff - everyone was working tirelessly to make sure all our queries are taken care of. In addition, all of the staff was enthusiastic and with genuine smiles at all times. Our room rate included breakfast which was served in a restaurant where Marco Pierre White is a chef. Breakfast was great, it was not buffet style so all the foods you order a la carte are freshly prepared for right for you. I would always choose this type of hotel over large hotel chains which, more or less can have more amenities, but are all generic and lack a character. Note that this is a modern property with modern design and some new ideas in the industry such as cereal café concept "Cereal Grind". We really enjoyed our stay and I will definitely recommend New Road Hotel to my clients.

title: Birthday treat
text: 60th birthday celebration treat in London. Fantastic welcome from the reception team. Excellent food, thanks to all the restaurant & kitchen staff and preview of house cocktail for the lady thanks Diego and Mauro🍸😘

title: Great place to stay
text: I stayed for a week for work, but would happily go back for pleasure. Fantastic room, hotel and the staff were first class. The hotel also has some other great features such as free pool, old school games and a quite room to work if you dont want to stay in your room, but have things to do. I have no problem with recommending this place.

title: Business Trip
text: I recently stayed at this hotel for a couple of nights whilst away on business and it stood out with its modern look and competitive pricing. There wasn’t many reviews to go on so my expectations weren’t clouded and all in all the Hotel served its purpose. I was welcomed by a lovely warm smile on reception and engaged into conversation with someone who generally seemed to want to hear what I wanted to say which made a nice change and set things off positively. Shortly after I made the short trip to the first floor where I was welcomed by a lovely clean and modern room. Space is always going to be an issue in London but the room was big enough for me and was well designed. The bed was lovely and large and the electric blinds super effective at keeping out the early morning sunshine. Upon waking the blinds being open filled the room with light. The hotel operates a more social policy with the social spaces and I know it’s not everyone’s personal preference. Personally I didn’t visit these areas but that’s because I was only there for two nights and was out most of the time. I ate in the restaurant the first night as I arrived late and enjoyed a nice, filling meal with quality meat that was fairly priced for the area. Overall this hotel met my needs perfectly and I would definitely look at staying again should I be in the area. Thanks for a pleasant stay.

title: A little disappointed
text: I came across this hotel online and as a fellow designer myself, I was impressed with the quirky design and thought would be the best place to book for my friend as her wedding gift. I emailed the staff informing them it was booked for a special occasion.The staff were kind with their reply and mentioned they will be leaving a little something in the room as a special welcome and asked for details of my friends name. My friend went to the Hotel in the morning to drop off her luggage before checkin time. During her visit she informmed me that she has seen an envalope with her name written on it at the Reception Desk. I informed her the staff mentioned they will be leaving something in the room so she would probaly see it when she checks in. Unfortunatily when we arrived at the hotel, there was nothing left in the room. However, I saw the in the way to our room, the room next door have left a half eaten cake outside their door step. The plate had "welcome" wittten on the plate with chocolate sauce! I went to reception to ask if there was anything left for my friend as a special welcome message and they informed me that nothing had been left :(! How disapointing.

title: Whacky note
text: An unusual approach to interior design and planning. Extremely friendly staff...Filippo in reception was a star..Extremely affable and helpful. A real asset! Rooms quite small but ergonomically designed. Quieter rooms out the back. Lovely place. Thank you.

title: Helpful staff, although I was downgraded when I asked for peace and quiet.
text: The staff were nice and helpful, the place is new and the rooms on the interior of the hotel are more quiet than those on the outside. My 'superior king room was located on the 2nd floor right above the busy road outside. It was quite noisy with traffic and people chatting until late. Although the room was quite spacious - the 'superior' aspect - the bed was not a king but two singles joined together. I asked for a quieter room and was offered a downgraded room (basic king room) the next day. As quiet was my priority I accepted the downgrade but was rather disappointed to be downgraded for the rate I paid.

title: Best hotel in London
text: I love the interior design of the hotel. There are all the essential equipments in the room and outside (library, gym, games) Best hotel for a couple but also for family time. If you want to visit East London, this is the place to stay !

title: Excellent stay!
text: The rooms are quite small but really well done out. Loved the social spaces and free hot drinks. Hotel is quirky with interesting detail and breakfast was fantastic! Bed was very comfy, some noise from road outside but didn't stop us sleeping well.

title: Great building, good rooms. Dreadful service.
text: Took a punt on this hotel on one of our regular trips to London as we like to try new places and the family room set up looked ideal for us and our teenage son. We read the reviews and there were some which pointed out their dislike of things like the vending machines for tea/coffee and so on, but we don’t mind that stuff. Positives first: Family room is great - two separate rooms of decent size. Really comfortable bed, super clean and funky enough to please a well travelled teenager. In Whitechapel, the hotel is in a really vibrant area, with easy access to Brick Lane and central London. Negatives: Hate to say it, but the service was really poor. Welcomed on arrival by a receptionist munching a chocolate bar. Not the most gracious of welcomes, but we can cope with that. We stayed for two nights, and on both nights arrived back reasonably late (around 10:30,10:45) hoping for a drink at the bar (attached to the Marco Pierre White Chophouse on site). On the first night we were just told the bar was closed. No questions, no attempts to help out. This was after standing at the bar being ignored by the bar tender for approximately five minutes (we were the only customers). On the second night, the same bar tender was cleaning while his colleague cashed up the tip, so we figured we were out of luck again. However this time we were invited to order from the “late night bar menu”. We ordered a beer and two diet cokes. The two soft drinks came in small bottles and were opened and offered to us without glasses. Both bottles were warm, and I asked for a couple of glasses and some ice, to be told there was no ice on offer! I declined both drinks and when it came to signingthe bill, was told we weren’t registered at our room. We crossed to reception, to register the fact that the bar service wasn’t terrific and really wasn't what we would expect for the price we paid. None of the three staff there seemed particularly concerned and only after pressing the issue was I assured that they would mention this to the restaurant manager. As we left for our room, we were chased to the lift by a receptionist who claimed we weren’t registered in our room. We had to return to reception to show our room keys before this could be confirmed. I know this all seems a bit picky, but this hotel is charged at a reasonably premium rate. The very least I would expect would be a warm welcome, and the feeling that the staff want to make your stay a decent one. This is not the vibe here at all. It can’t even be excused by the fact that the hotel is new any more. My advice - don’t be seduced by the funky interior. The service here is not good.

title: Overnight stay with friends
text: Overall we were very pleased with the Hotel. Quirky space in a original textile factory in East London. Comfortable rooms We only had the breakfast but was good but not outstanding. General service in the hotel is excellent.

title: Lovely place
text: I decided to go there with my girlfriend, we had a such good time. Everything was clean, stunning decorations and marvellous rain-shower. Expecially thanks to Mr Andrea, really kind and attentive to our requirements. They showed us several rooms since we are going to book directly with them and not agencies. we'll come back soon, thank you all!

title: Beyond expectations!!!
text: What can I say about this place? From the minute you walk in to the breakfast being served, the staff are nothing but helpful. The rooms are cosy, trendy and clean. The showers as a wet room is just so relaxing. Dinner in Mr whites Chop House was just sublime. The menu selection is exquisite without being pretentious. The steak was cooked to perfection. Speaking to the restaurant staff you can tell they know and understand the menu . The chef has the passion which translates on to the plate. Like I said simple food but done with passion. The breakfast selection and portions were just right. Overall could not have asked for a better stay. Next time will try a different floor as heard the top floor has jacuzzis as well as beautiful sites of East London from the terrace.

title: Cool place
text: The decoration is really cool, room wide enough and clean, located at 10 min walking of Liverpool Street and 2 min from Whitechapel subway station. Staff really friendly,delicious breakfast and cereal bar during the evenings! Nice place to come back if need to stay in the area again.

title: Great hotel
text: My husband and I had an overnight stay this weekend and thoroughly enjoyed it. The hotel is very ‘trendy’ in design and really makes the most of the original building features. Rooms are small, but perfect for a short stay. They are well equipped and finished to a high standard. The reception staff were all extremely courteous and friendly giving us a very warm welcome. We didn’t eat in Marco’s at night but breakfast was excellent. The immediate area isn’t great but within a few minutes walk your in Shoreditch and the City - so all in all a good location. I’d definitely recommend this hotel.

title: Noisy room, no sleep
text: They seem to have spent all their attention on design and had none left for the basics. My wife and I stayed in a Warehouse X room and the noise of the road, drunk idiots and car alarms was so loud that we barely slept. Then at around 3am a pipe started knocking in our room for a good 10 minutes with no explanation. If you're room price puts you not far off something like a Hilton or Marriott the least you should be offering is a quiet place to sleep but they totally missed the mark. We have twins under 1 so this hotel stay was supposed to be a treat night so we could actually get some sleep but it turns out we'd have slept better staying at home. We will never stay here again. When previous reviewers have said a similar thing the mgmt have said any London hotel will have this problem (rubbish in my experience) and basically put the blame on the guest saying they should've asked for a different room which is utterly ridiculous. They clearly know they have a problem and are unwilling to do anything about it

title: Saturday night stay
text: We paid under £100 for our stay, on arrival we got upgraded to a bigger room which was nice. Check in was good no issues, room was ready early. Room was clean and modern, had a comfortable nights sleep. Didn’t have breakfast include so we walked up-to brick lane, then Shoreditch. However we did have a burger from the restaurant that we took up-to our room. Nice hotel and would stay at it again if in white chapel

title: Cool, friendly new offering in Whitechapel
text: One of the least pretentious hotels I've ever had the pleasure of staying in. Reception staff are friendly, knowledgable and check you in with minimum fuss. Rooms vary in size, but even the smallest room is gorgeous. Rooms have everything you need, the beds are incredibly comfortable and the rooms are super clean. Each floor has a station for hot drinks, and on separate floors you can find a library, an ironing room, snack & social room and, on the roof, a space to work out (yoga mats and kettlebells). It's beautifully designed and feels really secure. The breakfasts are delicious - good veggie and healthy choices available. Really love it here.

title: I was treated like a friend
text: I can only recommend the New Road Hotel – the staff really care for their guests and you can tell they enjoy working there. This is not surprising since the hotel is just LOVELY! I especially liked the modernity of the building paired with the quality of an old, airy warehouse style building. This way, there were no musty carpets covered with room sprays, mould etc. that I have found sadly so often when staying in hotels in the UK. But even better: The furnishing was of high standard as well, which made it seem like a home immediately. Advice to anyone considering staying here: "Do it!" :)

title: Birthday treat with a hot tub
text: A special treat for my boyfriend's birthday, which i mentioned at booking and when we arrived there was a lovely chocolate cake and a bottle of Prosecco - lovely touch. Room is compact but perfect for 1 night. The star of the show is the hot tub! An added bonus would be if it was covered but we didn't mind the rain. We had a couple drinks in the bar which was nice and we ate in the restaurant. Food was really good and our waiter was really helpful with recommendation. Only one small thing no tea or coffee in the (most expensive) room, a bit of pain going to the landing when you've just got out of the hot tub! And the coffee which was available was pretty nasty. But we would go back for a special treat. Thanks

title: Excellent hotel. Brilliant for business or London break.
text: Fantastic hotel. Relaxed stay. Great staff. Great food. Clean and well equipped. Very close to tube station. Recommended for business or London short breaks. It was our Honeymoon and we had a brilliant time.

title: Birthday treat
text: This was a fantastic hotel which I really cannot recommend enough. Firstly the staff were so welcoming and were extremely kind to give us a upgrade as I was staying here for a birthday treat. The room was clean spacious and everything I expect from a hotel with a very comfortable bed. The location was great we managed to walk everywhere where we wanted to visit just a 5 minute walk to brick lane 10-15 minutes to Bishopsgate and Shoreditch. The facilities are great they have a library and a games room and lovely little little ironing and hot drinks station. Breakfast was amazing I had a delicious avocado and poached eggs on toast the breakfast and hotel was extremely reasonable in price. Having visited London many times and stayed in various hotels this was by far one of my favourites it reminds me of the Hoxton where I have also stayed but better value for money and much better service. I really really look forward to visiting here again soon, I have already recommended this to my friends who live in London and quite often have friends to come and visit Many thanks Xx

title: Great staff and delicious breakfast!
text: The staff were very friendly and upgraded us without asking. When we got in our room, we found a delicious brownie big enough to share and a lovely note welcoming us to the hotel. Breakfast the next morning was delicious - the full English breakfast was made to order and the beef sausage was very tasty! The room itself was roomy and fully modern as was the rain shower and wet room! Lovely stay and would definitely recommend for a lovely London stay!

title: Brilliant nights stay in a humongous bed
text: Stayed at new road hotel for business. Absolute bliss, 2x2metre bed is big enough for 4 grown men (not that you want 4 grown men in your bed) it is absolutely perfect. Topped it off with a brilliant morning shower and halal hot breakfast by Marco Pierre White

title: refreshingly simple and great value hotel
text: This was a refreshing change from other hotels of the same quality which can be stuffy and the service too formulated which allows little room to relax. the layout has been well thought out and finished with some careful consideration to mix the functional with modern design while retaining the welcoming warmth of high quality hotel. Everything works from the game room to the careful use of space in the rooms. these have a number of options which I am not not sure differs massively but enough to upgrade if given the opportunity. Wet rooms within the rooms we saw were also a good use of space. Double glazed windows throughout so I am not sure about the other reviews that have commented about the noise as it was very quiet. Electric blackout blinds on the windows which is a stroke of genius as very effective for those wanting to sleep in. bar is good which we had a burger and drinks in and the breakfast in the morning was great quality and just the right amount with a twist or two to make it stand out. we will definitely use the hotel again and no doubt others when more branches appear in the future.

title: Ultimate cool
text: The New Road Hotel is a hipster dream (in a good way). Everything you need, nothing you don't, and free coffee. The industrial look is really cool and it is walking distance from some great London landmarks without feeling too inner-city.

title: Not the value for the money
text: Well, we were staying in small pocket room as a couple. This was too small, apart from bed you only had 1 meter aisle to walk. It would be Ok for single traveller, but not for couples. Having such a small room with only glass separated bathroom makes it uncomfortable. Our window couldnt be closed securely, so hotel locked it and each time we wanted fresh air, we had to ask somebody from reception to come. Rooms and hotel toilets were missing toilet brushes. It sounds ridiculously, but imagine coming to public area toilets... or using one bathroom as couple. Hotel also isnt eco-friendly. It is cool that you have coffee/tea machine in the hallway. But each time you go for drink, you have to take new non-recyclable cup, you cant use same cup more often, tea/coffee is placed inside it and you pour only hot water inside. So if you want one more drink, you need to take one more paper cup, which is ridiculous when having tea etc. What I found the most inconvenient is the payment. Upon arrival my debit card was charged money for stay plus 50 GBP deposit. This is fine. However, when leaving, they - instead on returning 50 GBP deposit - charged my debit card ONCE AGAIN money for stay. And this first charge (money for staying plus deposit) is still being hold on my debit card even one week after departure!!! But we really appreciated the staff in hotel, which was helpfull. Also the design of the hotel is very unique and interesting. It was nice choice of hot meals for buffet, but apart from the hot served dish (6 options to choose from) there was really small choice of other food.

title: Lovely hotel if a bit kwerky
text: My major issue with this hotel and the Chophouse restaurant was that it didn’t cater for pork eaters I respect all religions and their beliefs but was unhappy to find bacon or pork sausages and black pudding not on the menu for breakfast as was no ribs or the like as in a run of the mill MPW restaurant

title: Great location in a new hotel
text: I stayed at the New Road Hotel in July. It's just a short walk away from the Tube station (Whitechapel) and is also accessible by bus. I got a friendly and professional welcome from staff at check-in and was soon in my room on the third floor. My room (a standard double) was compact but just right for my needs. The bed was very comfortable and, very important during the summer, the air conditioning was effective. Although there isn't a wardrobe you can hang some clothes from a short hanging rail to either side of the desk. There isn't a kettle in the room, although there is a coffee/ tea station at the end of each corridor but it doesn't offer hot water as an option so I couldn't have a herbal tea (I had brought some bags just in case). There is a restaurant / bar in the hotel so perhaps if I'd asked I could have had hot water in a mug - I didn't ask however. In the summer this isn't really a problem but in the colder months I would want to have a brew. I was in a room at the back of the hotel and it was very quiet so I slept really well. After a short walk to the Underground station a journey of nearly half an hour takes you right into the centre of London so the location is great. I was on my own but felt safe in the surrounding area. Good value for money for a London hotel - a great place to stay.

title: Stylish rooms and great staff
text: Staff at reception were really friendly and welcoming, and first impression of the hotel very positive. The decor is new and stylish, and on getting to the room I was really impressed (albeit, the in room facilities were quite basic). Unfortunately though, I had a terrible night sleep due to all the lights in the room. There were two on the air con unit, two for smoke/ fire alarms, and one green one (no idea what this was for). As the room was an open design, there was no getting away from them - it was like a disco going on all night! The room was clean in the main, but I did notice lots of dust and an empty water bottle and sugar sachets under the bed. Hotel was close to the tube station, and the restaurant downstairs looked to be nice (although I didnt eat there).

title: Cool, modern, friendly, central
text: The New Road Hotel is a gracefully converted textile factory in London's bustling Whitechapel district. Homage is paid to its industrial past in the polished concrete floors, open pipework and its textile- producing past is referenced in panels of patterned fabric which adorn the walls at each level....all very tasteful and considered. Bedrooms are ensuite, the wetroom separated from the bedroom by a glass wall and door. Our bed was very comfortable indeed. Air conditioning is a very welcome feature. Breakfast is a feast featuring a menu of hot options served from the kitchen, full English, avocado toast, veggie full English, granola pot, smoked salmon as well as the usual selection of juices, breads and pastries. My one recommendation would be to serve fresh pots of french press coffee directly to tables as the present system of coffee-dispensing flasks on the communal table seems less than satisfactory in terms of temperature and supply. All staff get full marks for efficiency and friendliness. Excellent place to stay, very convenient to Whitechapel tube. Thank you! We will be back.

title: Nice hotel
text: Enjoyed a 1 night stay Friday. Quirky hotel rooms not huge but big enough for a short stay and clean. Breakfast was good. Staff helpful and pleasant. Close to tube station and although area not the best in London, it didn't bother me as knew the area after years of working in the city.

title: Small but perfectly formed
text: The room was small (but was advertised as such - "small double") but perfectly formed - the bed/come sofa was very comfortable (it wasn't a sofa bed per say, rather a double bed with wrap around headboard) and the wetroom had the most wonderful shower )lots and lots of hot water at great pressure) The entire room layout was perfectly designed for a one/two night stay. The breakfast was a little expensive (book it in advance) but well worth it! The scrambled eggs were to die for! I'll certainly be back again!!

title: Amazing
text: The hotel asked the reason for my stay, I explained it was my boyfriends birthday

title: Great experience in an exciting part of the real London
text: Very nice new hotel, good location, nice spacy rooms. Receptioni desk is always willing to help and advise on what & how to explore. Brick Lane area is 5 minutes away, a must do. Nice lobby & bar. Because the hotel opened only three months ago not everything is perfect yet, but overall i would for sure recommand this hotel.

title: Stylish and cool
text: Great for a short visit in a unique part of town. Very modern and hip. If you are looking for somewhere great to stay, with exceptional staff and atmosphere for business and pleasure this is the right place. Loved the restaurant, Mr. Whites Chophouse!

title: Pleasant stay at peaceful hotel
text: I really enjoyed my stay here for one night last week. The check in experience set the tone for my one night with hotel manager/front of desk member Andrea being attentive and inquisitive to ensure we had an enjoyable stay. The hotel design itself is simple yet unique

title: Lovely hidden gem hotel
text: I stated one night for business here. Only a short work from my office near Liverpool Street. The hotel was very modern and had a good vibe with the busker live music set and cosy bar area. My room was very modern, a nice big bed and smart TV with wet room. Lively and quiet. I even borrowed the kettlebell from the rooftop yoga area to have an in room workout. I like the help yourself to coffee area on each floor. I will definitely stay again. Lots of local eateries or treat yourself to the Marco pierre restaurant (I will next time). Also the reception ladies were so lively and friendly, even offered me sweeties on checkout 😊

title: Great modern hotel with fantastic facilities
text: We stayed in one of their standard rooms and were really surprised about the incredible furnishings and facilities. Really comfortable king size bed, blackout blinds and rain shower. All the staff were really helpful and happy. Food was amazing and the cereal bar was a great addition to the delicious breakfast we had. Will definitely stay at this hotel again when we have another weekend in London. Highly recommended.

title: Birthday visit to london
text: Booked this hotel as it was in Whitechapel and we wanted to do the Jack the Ripper museum and tour. Could not fault the hotel. The staff were so friendly and nothing was too much trouble. I had asked a few questions before we went and they always emailed back within 10 minutes. The hotel is really clean. We loved the drinks stations and they have a lovely roof top yoga room. We ate in the restaurant and the food was exquisite and very well priced. It was my birthday and they even left a cake and a hand written card in my room. We had a fabulous weekend and would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Beaut new hotel in a fab location
text: Just got back from a nights stay at the New Road Hotel. From the start, the staff were so friendly and we chatted away. They even gave us a cheeky free room upgrade as it was my boyfriends birthday! The hotel is beautifully decorated and our room was lovely. The bed was massive and the shower was amazing. The only real down side was the water from the bathroom not draining so you got wet feet when ever you had to use the loo! The breakfast was really good too with a good choice and quality products. I used to live in Whitechapel and I love it! It's not the most luxurious area of London but it is bustling and full of life and really easy to get to central London (20 mins on tube). We will definitely be back to stay again I hope xxx

title: Peaceful
text: Really great hotel. Nice design, very friendly and helpful staff on reception. Room was very spacious and had some nice little details also free coffee/tea in the common areas on each floor, massive "ironing room" and a very peaceful library(picture). Nice places to hang out in reception to chat, work or get a drink. Definitely a good place to try and quite easy access to the Tube for central London and on to Gatwick airport.

title: Stop your fire doors slamming
text: Don't get me wrong this is a lovely clean modern & industial Hotel, with work rooms and yoga space upstairs great for hip traveller. Very good food at the Chop House......however and this is a big one if you don't want an early start....The constant banging of the self closing fire doors shook our room from about 7.30am every 10 mins or so.... Really not want you want after a night out!! ( you must fix this!! ) also not having tea or coffee in the room is a pain you have to leave the room to a google style working area to make you own coffee. Will not be back would rather pay double for a good nights sleep

title: Nice-looking hotel but lots of niggles
text: I agree with Nymphrose's review that the hotel is smart in a loft-style, but I'm glad we only paid £170 for two nights in a Warehouse room rather than the book price of £170 a night!! Positives were the supremely comfy bed and the nice shower cubicle/wet room. It was also very clean. Negatives were the sad 'communal' areas optimistically called 'snack stations', 'library' and 'games room'. Instant coffee in throwaway cups is not my idea of a 'snack, nor my idea of the service you expect in a smart hotel nor of my environmental hopes. The restaurant is for meat-eaters really, but there are plenty of other choices at Shoreditch, so that didn't matter. We were outraged by £6.20 for two cups of tea in the café, though, where a non-transparent service charge was added on. Overall, a good and comfortable stay at a good price, but I wouldn't pay full price here.

title: 1st visit
text: 1st visit and close to tobacco dock (i was attending a 3 day Bike show) . The area is not the most pleasing part of London but I walked a mile back to the hotel at 11pm and had no worries about that . The Hotel has a very nice vibe as you walk into reception. Very well decorated boutique style open plan looking into the bar and restaurant . Room 102 was not the biggest but was super clean and very trendy with large screen tv comfy bed and pillows , air conditioning and a wet room and more that adequate . Breakfast was very nice but I’m not sure about turkey bacon or the beef sausage. Coffee refill was offered every time my cup was empty and juices and cereal were available . I didn’t eat in the chop shop restaurant but heard good things about it from a couple of other guests. Not (for me ) so good points but MINOR , and not sure if anything could be done about it but after showering in the evenings the floor stays wet so any trip to the bathroom you are walking in cold water till showertime the next morning . The last thing and very minor ,not having tea/ coffee making facilities in the room means that if you want a morning coffee you have to get dressed to visit the tea/coffee machine or pack a dressing gown . To sum up my two night visit and the most important things for me on a short stay are friendly attentive staff ✅A lovely clean and comfortable room ✅ comfortable bed✅a nice shower✅and a good breakfast ✅ . I would definitely recommend the New Road Hotel Whitechapel . I thought is was good value and if in London anytime I would use it as a base . I will be back definitely next year if not before .

title: Ok
text: Pleasent enough stay, but on reflection not my thing. Would rather be able to make tea/coffee in my room than at a tea station. Likewise ironing. Don’t get me wrong the hotel was clean and the staff especially the reception team were very helpful As I said just not my thing.

title: Great!
text: 5 minutes walk from the tube, it’s very convenient, clean rooms with brand new bathrooms, the staff is nice and friendly. The price is really affordable compared to the quality of the facility. I will definitely come back later.

title: Great location and hotel
text: Great find in a central location. Tube a five minute work away. Newly refurbished, clean and sleek. Fresh and stylish room with a gorgeous rainfall shower. Good facilities, including the tea and coffee machines. Restaurant served lovely food and Selina was a great waitress- attentive, friendly and quick service. Bar wasn’t so great- had to wait 15 mins for a g and t. Only thing that led the lovely hotel down

title: Absolutely blown away!
text: From the minute we arrived, to the minute we left, we were amazed at what a wonderful, friendly and vibrant place this was! The staff were so helpful, the hotel was Modern, the food was very good and the bed was super comfy. I wish I could have stayed forever, I treated my boyfriend to this trip for his birthday and upon arrival there was a cake and a card in the room for no extra cost. I couldn’t fault this place if I tried. Also the bar is a good place to be at night and Whitechapel station is under 5 minutes walking. We will be returning!

title: Unique and welcoming stay in Central London
text: I stayed over night in this new hotel in the heart of London. Everyone was so warm and welcoming on arrival, the rooms were very high standards, with luxury bed, stunning bathroom, everything even better than online pictures. The hotel itself has a unique touch to it, that you notice from the moment you enter the building. The restaurant, the cocktail bar, the facilities including game room, library, etc all have real character, that made my stay extra special.

title: Amazing Stay
text: I recently stayed at this super cool hotel with my boyfriend at the weekend to explore more of East London, and time after time i got amazed by the hotel staff, they were helpful with finding activities ( like graffiti tour ), but also had the most incredible hospitality from management to house keeping , bar offered amazing service and cocktails, and restaurant was outstanding with Marco pierre white signature , and breakfast was yummy , please try the full english breakfast , superb x Without saying the deco and bed omg the most incredible and massive bed ever , love the style of old textile factory mixed with new building . Thanks for manager Joe who looked after us and always super friendly . Defiantly one of my new favourite London boutique hotel .

title: Awesome new hotel
text: We visited London for a long weekend and stayed in the New Road Hotel, I really enjoyed the experience, breakfast was great with small but surprisingly varied menu and a station to serve yourself bread, pastries juice and hot drinks and the room was small but very comfortable and had everything we needed. The window was lovely and big so was the bed and the bathroom very clean. My highlight however was the games room with an arcade machine and pool table and the library, both of which contained drinks machine with coffee tea and hot chocolate at no extra cost. I would definitely visit this hotel again!

title: Looks cooler than it is
text: The location so near the Royal London Hospital is a big problem, especially in any room on the front. Also, having a semi-transparent bathroom cube is an odd choice for even for couples travelling together. Breakfast is excellent, though.

title: Great little find!
text: I stayed one night here as part of a very fleeting business trip and enjoyed my short time in the hotel. I managed to bag a good deal through Travel Zoo and therefore a welcome drink and breakfast came as part of the price which was very reasonable for London. The welcome at reception on arrival feels very genuine and it was good to have a quick chat as I signed in with someone who seemed interested in what I was doing and why I was there. After settling into the room I took advantage of the welcome drink and the bar is a nice space which is not intimidating for lone travellers. There also seems to be an outside terrace but I didn't sit there. As a lone traveller, I loved the room which was plenty spacious enough for me - the bed is huge and as it has no headboard or foot board you can sleep in in whichever way you like! The blind didn't come all the way down (sorry New Road Hotel - I forgot to tell you on check out - room 112) The wet room didn't wet everything - I found it was best to have your shower and then put down the bath mat to save having to walk into a wet area after the shower when you returned to the bathroom for any reason. The bath mat didn't get too wet in the shower but mopped up the slight over spill afterwards. I was slightly disappointed to get hand wash and hand cream rather than shower gel/shampoo and conditioner but had to use the hand wash anyway to no detriment and it seems very good quality!! I didn't have time for dinner but did have tea and toast at breakfast which was fine. Checkout was painless and again really genuinely friendly. I can't really comment on the area except to say that this is the second time I have stayed in Whitechapel on my own, both times I came back by tube after 10.00 pm and felt perfectly safe walking back to the hotel. Worth a look and I would stay here again particularly if I got a good deal!

title: Perfect stay for a citytrip!
text: Such a beautiful and trendy place to stay! We stayed for two nights. Very pleasant arrival and welcome by Andrea and Emma. The ground floor and restaurant looked very cosy and designual, as well as the room. It was a fun detail that every floor had an “extra” such as a gameroom, iron-room or library. The room had a large smart tv and a rainfall shower. The location was perfect

title: Good hotel, disappointing breakfast, compromised location
text: Alright, so, this is a slightly harsh review and I'd ideally give 3.5 stars rather than 3... but I have my reasons. The first point is that this brand-spanking new hotel is definitely cool, clean and sharp. The styling is unique and deliberately minimal - but all you need is there. I have uploaded some photos of a King room. This isn't the smallest room they offer but there's not a lot of space in there. However, for a 1-2 night stay, that is OK. The wet-room bathroom is also small which means that everywhere gets (deliberately) wet in the bathroom - probably easier managed if not sharing. The location will not suit everyone. It probably won't even suit many... but you're (probably) an adult, so look at the map and make your own decision. But also look at street view - the area has a run-down feel and you're a 10-min walk away from the kind of typical London vibe you might expect. Finally, the restaurant. I didn't have dinner there, and I'm not sorry, based on my breakfast experience. First, despite two servers and only a handful of customers, service was really slow ... it took quite a while to put the order in.The guy beside me had to wait quite a while for the toast to come along with his cooked breakfast. I was on a breakfast-inclusive rate and don't actually know how much breakfast was included with that (just one dish of any type?, any sides included?, any smaller dish (porridge, yogurt/fruit) included?. This was not clear from the a la carte menu and was not proactively explained - though to be fair I should have asked. The shocker was, I received worst-ever pancakes. They were hard around the edges - I mean couldn't be cut or chewed. I am convinced that they were heated in a microwave (for too long). When I eventually caught the attention of a server she insisted that they were made freshly that day. I asked her to enquire of the chef whether they had been made earlier that day and reheated for me... but she didn't return with the answer. So, all in I'd have given the hotel a 4-5, but given the shockingly poor breakfast its a 3-4.

title: Unforgettable atmosphere
text: Me and my girlfriend stayed in the hotel for a night, the hotel is brand new and have the feeling of being in a mix of boutique and modern and vintage hotel. It is important to know that the hotel is short walk from Whitechapel Underground Station with fabulous connection around the city, for those on business trip Liverpool Street Underground Station is about 10/15m walk. Being guest in this hotel makes you feel special, the staff is really friendly and helpful. Right next to the entrance door is the cocktail bar with the best cocktails in town. We had a dinner in the restaurant where they offer a very good quality of beef among with range of good wines. We have been taken care of greatly and we are looking forward to stay there again. Thanks all for the great night.

title: Loved it
text: We stayed one night at the New Road Hotel on a Travelzoo deal in a Warehouse K room. The reception and bar staff were very friendly and helpful, and particularly efficient was the flame haired young female working on Sunday afternoon (apologies for not taking a note of your name). We loved the minimalist style of the hotel, I particularly liked the room not having a carpet, it smelt so fresh and clean on walking in. The history of how the hotel came about is interesting and gives it a personal touch. The only slight niggles I have are the bathroom and the breakfast service. It is impossible to have a shower without getting the whole bathroom floor soaked, which means having to use one of the towels to soak it up, and also the glass door - for me personally, I would have preferred the frosted effect to be down to the floor as I don't particularly like seeing my partner's feet and him seeing mine whilst sat on the toilet! There were two members of staff on breakfast service, separate from the bar staff making the pots of tea and coffee. The female member of staff seemed to be doing most of the work and seemed quite harassed, though she remained very polite. There were no hash browns on our breakfasts, we didn't complain as they're not our favourite, but I was aware of another guest having items missing from their breakfast, which was quickly rectified when pointed out. Maybe more staff at breakfast are required. We both found the skillet fiddly to eat from and would have preferred a simple plate! Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely return.

title: Style over substance
text: Whilst boutique hotel felt that was style over substance - playing to an alternative architecture vibe of industrial trendy. There was no shampoo or other toiletries that are common place in 4 star hotel - I mean no shampoo?? Nuts! No place to rest luggage. Rooms are cool with 1950 brick work and funky windows looking onto graffitti abandon buildings. But the bathroom is wet room so careful what you bring in during shower as its solely functional. Coffee is only available in 'snack room' and 'bijou' to say the least. No place to rest your phone or other items like a water bottle unless leave on top of headboard. Bed was very hard and comforter was for small single bed and therefore annoying. Its not a bad hotel but implementing basics rather than trying to be so "hip" would give it higher ratings. Staff were lovely and close to tube. Its a place to lay your head and if honest felt it was a step up from a hostel

title: Smart throughout
text: Couple of nights stay here and first impressions count, lovely decorated throughout from reception, bar, restaurant and rooms. Staff on reception where friendly and helpful. Room fine for two for a couple of nights we just had a standard room would upgrade if you where wanting to stay longer. Breakfast was delicious however service was slow not from the kitchen more from the waitress/waiter wasn’t overly busy but no sense of urgency and we waited ages for the coffee to be topped up and a long time for our order to be taken both days hence not given a 5 star, I would stay here again and would recommend, area isn’t great but don’t let that put you off we felt safe and fine station is close by to access every where.

title: Friends wedding
text: I visited this venue solo but for a friend's wedding (She also stayed at the hotel). I was visiting from Swansea. First impressions of the decor: Very luxurious. Lovely bar/restaurant area. Spacious room, comfy bed. Very little storage space. No wardrobes. Which may have been difficult if it had been for a long time.Quiet. Good location. 2 minutes from White Chapel tube. The only main concern for me was the customer service at breakfast. My first morning was particularly bad. Came up to the counter, could tell that the woman was busy, it was around 9am. She pointed me to a table and said she would be back, she didn't return. After a long while of helping myself to coffee and juice she still hadnt come back, so had to approach someone at the counter by the kitchen for help. I tried to make her aware that this was my first morning and didn't have a clue what I was meant to be doing, didnt even have a menu. The lady that I had spoken to previously didn't even apologise just slammed the pancakes down in front of me. Having said that the pancakes were lovely. I'm not sure if this was a particularly busy period they weren't used to (seems unlikely) a change over in staff (more possible, Seemed like there was a lot of young members of staff running round following orders, possibly from the kitchen without really taking note of the customers needs. A family at the table next to me did complain). The second morning was even worse (a Sunday) asked for a coffee twice before my friend actually got up went to the bar and got it for me. I think because she didn't want anyone to complain. Even so I have put 4 stars because the food was good. The reception staff were friendly. Ordered taxis when I needed. I did have one occasion in the bar when a staff member said to me that he was here if I needed anything which i found quite unusual from what i had generally experienced. And i did have a lovely weekend. I probably would avoid breakfast in future though.

title: Interesting little hotel
text: New boutique hotel with a hipster feel. The staff were very friendly and helpful with the few questions we had. Very close to the Whitechapel tube/subway station. A lot of street vendors right outside of the tube/subway as they are lined up for 5-6 blocks, I actually liked it as i felt like I was in a community. Anyway, not once did I not feel safe, but the area is kinda dirty and you know it's a lower income area... the hotel actual feels out of place, but again we ventured out at night and never felt unsafe. Also there were a lot of food options around which are mainly Indian places. Ok, almost forgot... only thing I think they fail at is the shower/bathroom area. I can't explain it any other way then saying the entire washroom is a shower stall... it is spacious enough, but because the corner with the shower doesn't have walls the entire bathroom floor gets wet. Is it a deal breaker, no... but just annoying that if you want to use the washroom after someone has taken a shower you need to go in barefoot or with shoes and dry off when you come out. Oh yeah, no ironing board or coffee machines in rooms, not a big deal at all for me, but i know it might bother some... instead they have the coffee in a little hangout area on each floor.

title: Top Top Top Hotel!!!
text: I've been there for a night with friends. The location is great, just few minutes walk from Whitechapel Station. The staff is amazing , friendly and absolutely professional. We ate at the restaurant Marco Pierre and the food was outstanding, best steak ever!!Definitely I'll go back!! Really Top Hotel!!

title: A very interesting place with great staff
text: I was provided this stay as I was on a course. As a single traveler it is always a bit daunting going into a hotel on your own, but the staff made me feel very at ease- they were all very helpful and friendly. The room was really interesting with a great en suite, a very comfortable bed and good pillows. Despite it being expensive it was a great stay and very enjoyable.

title: Call me a dinosaur....
text: ....but this hotel sacrifices practicality for style. We’d booked a Warehouse K room and the bed had headboards at right angles to each other round two sides, which meant that whoever slept on the inside would have to climb over their partner if they needed to use the bathroom during the night, and would feel claustrophobic squashed up against the plastic side. We went back down to reception and were told that all the Warehouse K rooms are like that so we ‘upgraded’ to a Warehouse T room – exactly the same size and style of room except that it had two single beds (which had very hard mattresses). The room was quite Spartan. There was very little hanging space and no other storage space for clothes, so we were relieved to only be staying for one night. The shower was good, but the bathroom was a wet room and, in the confined space, water went everywhere so, after showering, we had to use one of the towels to dry the floor in front of the toilet and basin or we would have been paddling. Breakfast, when it arrived, was excellent, but there were long delays and confusion and orders being delivered to the wrong tables. However, all the staff, in reception and in the restaurant and bar, were very helpful and friendly.

title: Brilliant!
text: Great surprise and much better than expected! Food is (obviously) brilliant and the rooms, location and staff are brilliant. Much, much better than expected

title: The best place ever
text: This was such a cute and nice hotel.the rooms are so unique. Perfect for traveling. There so warm and welcoming.so close to the trains and buses. So easy to get around. Shopping and restaurants right around the corner. I really did enjoy my stay. And the next time I am in London this is were I will stay again. If you need to get some where they will Google it for you map it out. And even tell you witch is the best route to take. Free coffe tea and hot chocolate. Best 4 floors I've seen. It's small but that was just fine for me small means cozy and comfortable. Loved there bed so nice and comfortable. This was beyond a dream come true. The employees are there to help really they are. They have a bar and restaurant cant beat that. And they had a DJ jamming on the ground floor. Thank you new road hotel. You changed my eyes of hotel forever.. if more hotels was like you than that would not make you guys unique. 10 out of 10 2 thumb up.i really do recamend this to any and every one.. I love you guys lol

title: 50th Birthday weekend
text: Our stay at this hotel was unexpected as we had been booked into another one just off of Brick Lane however due to maintenance issues they relocated us to this hotel. The hotel itself has been tastefully restored to reflect its past as a textile factory. We love all things old and restored with a bit of history attached. The staff we encountered could not have been more helpful. Everyone was so polite and welcoming. The room was funky, but there are a couple of design issues that could be doing with being looked at. The bathroom door made a very loud clicking/clunking noise upon closing, which meant we had to keep it open during the night because if one of us had got up to go to the loo in the night we would have woken the other when closing the door. This meant there was noise from the bathroom fan all night. I think the door is just screwed on too tightly. I heard it from other rooms too. The other thing is the smoke alarms or room sensor on the ceiling- there are two flashing red lights on these which go all the time. In the darkness of night, depending on which way you’re laying, this might be annoying! These are only small things, and I know the hotel is new so honest feedback will help get over these little teething issues. We loved the building, the staff, and the funky concept of the hotel and would recommend it to others as well as staying again ourselves!

title: Short Break whilst away on my birthday
text: Two night stay part work and part play as it was my birthday. On arrival on learning it was my birthday the staff arranged a handwritten card and a small birthday cake for my room which was a great touch. Check in was quick and easy and very happy with room. Not the largest but not a problem as we travelled light and don’t need to much room. But the entire hotel was spotless and well laid out clearly some thought gone into it. Food at the restaurant was superb as was the wine ten out of ten there. But what made it was the five star service from all members of a predominately young team who were polite friendly and genuinely interested in their guests. Would throughly recommend.

title: Trying hard but really not making the grade
text: The public rooms are modern and the food good but they fail on many fronts. Toilets smell Check in delayed Rooms small Meeting room leaking - continual drip Meeting room chairs uncomfortable Bar closed before 11 despite a group of 14 resident guests being in the bar.
