Notwithstanding the faintish rhythmic pulsing of the bass line (which I rather enjoyed!) was all I could hear from my first floor bedroom, so this was just about bearable and must have stopped around midnight. The room itself was a deluxe double - I was upgraded - was a decent size, clean and "funky!" The large mural of a donkey drinking a pint of beer covering one of the walls was an unexpected décor style I had not come across in a Novotel or Mecure Hotel before but then again this is Hackney and so it made me smile! The bathroom was supplied with a nice range of toiletries and the bedroom had some decent coffee and cafetiere for you to use which was a nice touch. I ventured downstairs for dinner - a simple selection of burgers, chicken and salad - but it looks like what they don't do in terms of range is made up in terms of quality. My burger with cheese and bacon was excellent - cooked medium rare - the onion rings obviously hand cut and crisply deep fried. The beer is also excellent, a good range of proper ales and ciders. Breakfast was just a good - proper poached eggs, crispy bacon and nice thickly cut bread for you to toast to your own specification and decent coffee. All in all a very nice evening and morning, good room, good food and beer, excellent music and a soothing bass line to drift you into sleep!

title: Very hot and cramped!
text: Very disappointed with our stay as this is supposedly a 4 star hotel. The room was tiny and very hot. The window only opened a bit so we were offered fans, the sound of the fans meant we could hardly hear the tv and they basically moved the warm air around. Hmmm. Most of the tv channels were scrambled and the room had no tea/coffee facilities. Breakfast is in a cafe around the corner!

title: Lovely quirky pub with lovely room
text: Great value, great food, great customer service and apart from no parking (we used just park.com) we had a lovely night here with our two girls in the family room. Breakfast was lovely - only moan we'd have is it was a little noisy and the room being at the very top was really warm!

title: A good night in Hackney
text: Easy walk from station. Good value, clean room, very comfy bed, helpful staff, friendly ambience if a bit noisy - but fair play it is a pub and I'm over 70! Great breakfast. Menu looked interesting but we were eating elsewhere.

title: Great staff, comfort, value and food.
text: I usually stay in fairly faceless, 'corporate' hotels, whilst always trying to seek out a good, local and reasonbly priced restaurant. Leaving it late to book, my options were very limited so a search of the area showed the Old Ship as an interesting option and I was very pleased I did as my stay was great, from start to finish. The street is extremely busy but the pub is hidden down an alleyway, so feels removed from the immediate hustle and bustle. A slight delay in checking in was forgotten with a welcoming free drink, giving me time to check out the menu of the small, restaurant, which is attached to the, equally cosy , bar area. The room was clean and comfortable, with a good strong shower and plenty of space (I was in a larger family room). This isnt a smart hotel, it's a pub, so your expectations need to be realistic eg it has a twisty staircase which some less able guests could find challenging. There are several things which seem to differentiate the Old Ship from its competitors though i.e. the staff - superb service throughout my stay, the rooms - clean and comfortable, the food - I had a seriously impressive steak and breakfast offers a good choice, and the price.....this has got to offer some of the best value, price to quality ratio, in the capital. I would recommend this pub as somewhere to stay if you're looking for a comfortable place to stay, with no pretensions, which offers great food and first class service. It's punching well above its weight.

title: you have all of hackney, why go here?
text: i have no beef with The Ship, i haven't been the victim of bad service, and i live meters away from it. But i just don't see why people would go here: the food is really weak, the beer is overpriced (£5.50 for an IPA: pay almost £2 less for the same in The Cock 50m down the road), and it's so so loud. I think i'm just a bit annoyed that I tried it out again. i do that every 6 months and i'm always disappointed. It's such a shame, it should be good, but it's a really poor pub in a borough full of great places.

title: Freiendly welcome, good food, comfortable room in ideal location
text: We booked a room here as we were going to a concert just round the corner. The parking that they recommended at the station was ideal (pay from 7:00 - 11PM). We received a friendly welcome. The room was comfortable. We ate in the bar that evening, great choice and our food was delicious. Full English cooked breakfast the following morning was nice too. We would stay here again. I particularly liked the fact that the tea & coffee making facilities in the room had old china cups and saucers (a quirky touch), a tea pot plus a cafetiere. It is not quiet here, but what do you expect, it is a pub in the centre of Hackney. We liked the atmosphere and it's location was why we chose it.

title: A fun weekend away for a couple over 50.
text: My husband and I had a lovely weekend. The location was great for the Hackney Half Marathon which we took part in. The bed was comfortable and we loved the china cups and saucers which we thought were a nice touch. There is also a good selection of toiletry items in the bathroom. We found the staff helpful and friendly. The food was delicious and I enjoyed my fish and chips and my husband said his steak was cooked just right. The crowd is young but we were made to feel welcome and took part in the Sunday Quiz Night and enjoyed the roast dinner. The breakfast is huge and we left full ready for our journey back to Cornwall. If you want something a bit different from the corporate hotels with plenty of charm, and you do not mind a more lively atmosphere in the evening then we would definitely recommend this unique hotel.

title: Fabulous place to stay. Highly recommended
text: I have just had the most enjoyable stay at The Old Ship Inn in Hackney. I received a warm welcome the moment I arrived. My room was just lovely. I love their style. The service I received was excellent. Everyone was friendly and went out of their way to help me. The food was just great and the whole thing was excellent value for money. What more could you ask for. I will definitely be staying there again and recommending it to my friends.

title: elegant mix of hipsters, loud music, average food and great atmosphere.
text: don't expect a quit and neat place. because there is a lot of energy flowing. un-orthodox surrounding, with crazy stuff on the wall. bartenders are nice, but could pay a little more personal attention.

title: Awful customer service
text: Nice place, interesting drinks, lovely decor but the worst customer service you could imagine. Having to wait 25 minutes to be served at the bar on a quiet evening?? When asked when I would be able to order a drink to be told rudely when they had served everyone else before us. SO RUDE. Wont be going back.

title: Friendly staff
text: I chose The Old Ship because it was fairly near a park in Shoreditch which staged a music festival in June. The only negative is that my single room was a little cramped. On the positive side, the staff were extremely helpful and friendly. I also got a free drink in the excellent bar when I arrived because my room wasn't quite ready. Obviously I stayed in Hackney before the recent disturbances and I wouldn't have then described it as "a bit dodgy". In fact I thought that London Fields was quite pleasant.

title: Good experience
text: First question was, is it safe in Hackney? Well, the area looked even quite nice. I was afraid to see a lot of 'burned down houses' but didn't see any.Hackney was just a short trip via tube and overground service from London st Pancras trainstation. (We took the Eurostar) Hotels are bloody expensive in London so we ended in this place because you get a little more for your money. And it is not too far from trendy shoreditch and just walking distance from Broadway street. (a hidden treasure). The room was ok, the bed wasn't that big and I was hoping for some cable channels though. (on one night we were extremely tired of walking and decided to go back to the hotel quite early). The bathroom was big enough and had even a bath (I'd expected just a shower). We were on the first floor and couldn't hear any noise from the restaurant below although we had people standing outside for quite some time. I was afraid of having to deal with binge drinking brits but nothing of that. Breakfast is served in the empire theatre cafe a short walk from the hotel. It wasn't really clear what we could have for breakfast and the beautiful German girl (way too much information huh

title: Great Business Trip!!
text: Booked 5 rooms for customers and colleagues for 3 days whilst working in Hackney. We all had a great time and really enjoyed our stay with you. It was great to come back to a warm welcome and a comfortable clean room after a hard days work . What good value for money this Hotel/BB is... Im so glad we found you !! My colleagues are already asking me when we can come and stay again . I will definitely book here again and will be revisiting very soon .

title: Nice quirky urban inn
text: My partner and I stayed here for one night in April, and enjoyed our stay. The staff were polite, helpful and charming and the facilities and decor of the rooms and the hotel itself were of a high standard. I would recommend this Inn.

title: Location unbeatable, lovely pub, room a bit rough around the edges
text: The Old Ship is probably the best place to stay in Hackney, and situated just off Mare Street, the location is perfect if you want to stay in what is undoubtedly the most interesting part of London. It's also a lovely pub, with a good selection of ales and a nice atmosphere. The room was good, not fantastic -- the furniture a bit scuffed, no hand soap at the sink (we just used the bath gel), the bed was OK. I would definitely stay here again, but I think the room could be better for the price we paid.

title: Handy for the Pru 100
text: Stayed for the weekend of the Prudential London 100 ride. Had a small top room which was difficult to get a large bike case up to,[old twisty staircase] and was quite stuffy. However, it was surprisingly quiet and a fan was provided [ no ac but it is UK!. It is not a modern purpose built hotel so these things add to rather than detract from the experience. Staff were friendly and accommodating as there were several cycle participants staying there. Food was OK - good burgers. I only had breakfast one of the three days due to early starts but it was ok and plentiful. Good location for Olympic park and the City airport is not too far, but a long way from Heathrow.

title: Great location, awesome burgers and nice atmosphere.
text: Stayed here for two nights with my friend and had an awesome time. The pub/hotel is in a great area, lots of cool bars and coffee shops. Close to shoreditch and central London. Had by far the best burgers ever on the monday (2 for 1) and tried some great craft beers and ales.Staff are all really cool and helpful, made some great suggestions about markets and places to go etc. We shared a double room, which was reasonably priced and included breakfast, which was a nice surprise! Will be back again soon im sure!

title: Good for a one night stand (sorry...stay!)
text: This place is fine if you are looking for a central place to stay in Hackney. The room was clean but small, but perfectly ok for the one night. The location is bang in the middle of the commercial centre so great for a short stroll around the various bars and eateries. The bar in the hotel is very cleverly decorated in a sort of shabby/chic style, which worked for me and the vast array of beers was impressive. Never ate here, so can't comment on the food.The staff were very pleasant and most helpful. A unique pub/ inn priced competitively and i would stay here again, for a short visit .

title: An Enjoyable Stay
text: Stayed for one night and it was a really lovely hotel, booked last minute the location is brilliant right by the train station. Would recommend the option of having dinner in the restaurant as well worth it. the food was very yummy and well presented & a complementary drink too. Did not wake up in time for breakfast, but im guessing it is good as the dinner was! Staff were welcoming,helpful and polite. Overall a very good place to stay had a relax stay, good value excellent staff and food and a comfortable night sleep! Having grounded coffee in the rooms instead of instant was a bonus!!

title: Friendly staff & a great breakfast!
text: Stayed here recently with our 2 children, had a family room which consisted of a double bed and a fold out sofa bed. The room was modern and clean, the floor boards did squeak, but other than that couldn't fault the room. The pub is really nicely done out, felt really friendly and the staff were great. Had an evening meal and then breakfast the following morning. The self-service cooked breakfast was one of the best I have had! We all enjoyed our stay and will stay there again. It is London, so you expect there to be some background noise, the only downside was one of the neighbours having a party at 6am, but at least the music was good!

title: A good one night stand
text: Found this a convenient place to stay in the location we wanted to be. Staff were friendly and we were offered a complementary beer on arrival. My single room was tiny indeed and the bathroom cramped but the bed was comfortable and linen good with nice fluffy towels and a bath robe. It was also very quiet. Bottle of water in room but no tea/coffee making facilities. Breakfast was good in the hotel with waiter service.

title: Very convenient and affordable with a unique edge & nice staff
text: This small hotel is a couple of minutes walk from Hackney Central amidst the hustle and bustle of East London street life. The bar is contemporary and simple and the open dining area is basic and functional. My single room (8) was pretty small but perfectly clean and well appointed for a one night stay. A really good breakfast was included in the price. Not the quietest place, so you may need ear-plugs and the public stairwell was rather grubby. Apart from that, I rather enjoyed my stay.

title: A venue with a Kraken twist
text: Recently relaunched with their new look I went along to the launch night and had a great time. A good looking venue with drawn murals that add charm to the venue and a good layout that works if you are just after a drink or food too. A nice outdoor area and good place to have a drink- particularly if you are rum fan... they seem to have a brand partnership with Kraken which was great news-the dark and stormys are obviously made lots and were excellent

title: Lovely urban Inn with great atmosphere
text: Lovely urban Inn - great location for town. Bar was lovely to have a drink in. Rooms are quite funky but our bathroom needed a little bit of tlc.The service was efficient and more communication would have been good but overall very friendly. Phoning them was difficult as I left a message when there was no answer and didnt get a call back.There was no parking available when the website said there was secure parking which was a shame (due to renovations). Breakfast was ok, not particularly creative or hot but ok. Someone is very particular about using tea leaves! The decoration in the bar is lovely and we spent a few hours having a drink before we went out in the evening which was lovely.

title: Nice Comfortable Stay
text: Had single room on the 5th December. Welcomed well on arrival and given a free drink from the bar which was nice. Room well presented, clean, tidy and functional. Nice modern bathroom and excellent Tea/Coffee facilities. Location was spot on down a quiet street. Breakfast very nice with full English, Cereal, Fruit and Yogurts available. The pub is also very nice for having a few beers before stepping out. Enjoyed my stay and thought this place offered very good value for money

title: Great location
text: I stayed 5 nights in this hotel.Room was small but clean. The staff was really friendly. Best thing in this hotel is great location if you want to explore the cool Hackney / Shoreditch area. There are lots of cool bars and restaurants near. The Old Ship restaurant was also good place to have a drink.

title: Business Trip
text: I don't normally write reviews on this site but I am very upset by the lack of response I have had from the Old Ship inn. When I arrived I was shown to my room, which was ok - nothing special but decent for the price and the location. It turned out that there was a pigeon coup in the wall next to my room, so from 3am onwards they were scratching and cooing. When I came home, I also noticed that they had overcharged me for my meal on the evening. I emailed them to explain regarding being overcharged and I also thought it best to mention the pigeon problem. The reply I got was not apologetic but abrupt, telling me they were undergoing a full refurbishment and that they will look into the problem during the work. Also that they will look into my overpayment for the evening meal. I have since emailed them 4 times and had no response with getting a refund back, I think the service is disgusting and I will definitely not be staying there again.

title: suprisingly really nice!
text: Stayed for 2 nights on business trip, room was very well appointed, very clean and had some really unexpected nice touches ie beautiful toiletries, fluffy towels and comfy bed. Friendly staff and great food.

title: Food in the Old Ship
text: Generally it is of a fairly good standard - I eat (or did) fairly often as it's very near to where I live, however - beware of the Sunday 'Roast' - I asked for a medium rare beef for a group of 4 and we were served boiled beef that was dark and rank (no attempt to 'roast' it had ever been made) - we asked for it be returned and it was - back to us!!! We ate all the potatoes and veg and when we complained about the 'beef' were told that as we had eaten the veg and potatoes that was a 'sign' we had enjoyed the meal (even though we had already returned it!) - no attempt was made to apologise or even be gracious. I haven't been back since and I was a regular!

title: Good location, above average stay but the room was cold
text: Returned to this hotel again, the room this time was spacious and pleasant. The only thing I would mention is that I didn't sleep well as the room was cold, there were no extra blankets provided and the heating was throwing out cold air, as well as being quite noisy. Oh and I found a long black hair in the shower, which wasn't pleasant (note to room attendant - always check this before leaving the room). The staff are friendly and the location is ideal, so it is above average . Shame you can't rate "Good" as that's what my rating would be on this occasion.

title: From Beginning to End/The Best! Its good to be the King!
text: From the time I entered into Club Quarters, the service we got was second to none. Matthew, recommended a room with a great view of Big Ben and arranged our large bags to be delivered to the room while we had a wonderful lunch around the corner. Matthew recommended a fantastic Indian Restaurant that served authentic Indian food and was sheik. The hotel restaurant was definitely worth the money and the people that served us were the best. The room had everything we needed, from free water bottles to umbrella's. We also asked to borrow an electrical conversion plug, not a problem what so ever. To finish the perfect stay, we had left some special cheeses in the Club Quarters refrigerator and forgot to take them with us. So I called from the airport to see what they could do. Well, they were quick to send me an email with instructions and suggestions on how to solve my dilemma. Like I said, the people at Club Quarters are trained professionals. They made our two night stay in England fit for a King and his son. John Giacomucci

title: Nice hotel, the breakfast not really living up to the hotel standard
text: The rooms and the location i great! The breakfast at the hotel is quite small and if you want bakon and eggs you have to order them seperatly, not really what we expected, bu there is alot of other places with in range of the hotel to eat breakfast.' (free wi-fi without password is also great) Thanks for a otherwise great stay !

title: Comftable stay
text: Spent one night here it's a perfect location for theatres plenty of restaurants and pubs in this area,excellent value for money Staff were friendly and helpful,we had a complimentary bottle of wine for our anniversary and most importantly a great nights sleep

title: Excellent, comfortable and spacious room
text: I had an excellent, comfortable and spacious room. The hotel is located just 2 minutes from Trafalgar Square and the room was extremely quiet. It had all the facilities one could wish for. I look to staying at Club Quarters soon.

title: Very unexpected
text: I booked a one night stay as I was arriving from Amsterdam, had dinner with my business partners in London, with a morning flight to Houston. We booked ClubQuarters as it was priced extremely well for a great location. (About $200). I had no real expectations. However, this seems to be a great hotel. The rooms are quite nice, very clean, with a decent sized bathroom. The only complaint was they began shutting the, very attractive, bar at 11:30pm. Since it is in the lobby the only way to "close it off" was to open the bifold doors of two wine cabinets and stick a spoon in the closing slats, to create a makeshift door. I know Americans seem to be the only ones who tip a great deal, but the inventive of making a lot in tips had me witness this same situation in the States. A hotel bar closes at midnight, but the bartenders are racking up as many drink orders as possible. When we got to the bar at 11:15pm you could tell they were trying to get people out. They mentioned they were closing "soon". There were two of us, and no matter how tried, we couldn't get more than one drink a piece from them. In the States, we probably would have had 3 each (didn't drink much at dinner), gotten a bill for $60 and left $80. When we went into the bar, there must have been 25 people there. Over the course of the next 30 minutes, the staff was able to "shoo away", at least 15 more people who tried to come in. They didn't say they wouldn't service them, just let them know it could only be a "quick one". With another "mindset" the bar would still be cleared by 12:15, the bar would have sold 100 more drinks, received $1000 more revenue (that's $365,000/year). In the States, those 100 drinks would probably lead to $200-250 in tips for the staff (I counted 5 people working). If those 5 people worked 5 nights per week, that would mean as much as $250 increase in pay. That's $10,000 per year, each, if they only worked 40 weeks per year. However, this has no more bearing on Club Quarters than any other bar I have been to in the UK or Europe. From a customer, the American way is far better. The best 10 hotels I have ever stayed out were, definitely, outside the USA. However, probably the top 100 bars I have ever been to, with service being the most important aspects, were ALL in the USA. I love traveling to Europe and the U.K. This is really my only general "beef" against their system!

title: Perfect Location and Fantastic Staff
text: We have just spent 2 wonderful nights at Club Quarters Trafalgar Square. The location is fantastic and its only a 2 minute walk to the Thames 1 way and Trafalgar Square the other. We were in London to celebrate a special birthday for my wife so I'd put balloons up and a banner in the room. When we got back later that afternoon there was a superb bouquet of flowers and a bottle of wine and card from the hotel staff. All of this must have been instigated by housekeeping. Fantastic stuff, wonderful hotel. Thank you

title: great hotel great location
text: i have stayed at this hotel twice now in the las 8 months & it is a really nice place, great locaation for trafalgar square, london eye, leicester square etc etc, i have no problem recommending this hotel its very affordable and very clean.

title: Location and a comfy bed
text: This is the third Club Quarters hotel I have stayed in, in as many months and I have to say that, for central London, the quality is good for the price and location. The check in procedure is efficient and friendly, the check out remarkably simple. The rooms are adequate for this part of town, a good hot shower and an excellent bed. I asked to be located on the quiet side, facing away from Northumberland Avenue, so that I could sleep with an open window.

title: Overnight stay at the hotel
text: Excellent location and a very plush and grand hotel. The staff members were very helpful and every request was met in a very pleasant and professional manner. The location of the room was excellent as you looked out over Trafalgar Square

title: Wonderful as usual
text: My usual selected hotel during my business stay in London. I had a wonderful and easy checkin and out with a great friendly staff. Also I had a parcel delivered to the hotel and it was missing first day but the reception had a guy in it and he was very helpful and kept apologizing until it was delivered to me. Room was great and everything was up to standards and wonderful

title: Mrs
text: My stay at Club Quarters Hotel was excellent. The staff members were professional, kind, and thoughtful, especially Matthew. I told him that I was in London to attend my grandmother's funeral, and he was able to check me in over the phone, because it was convenient for me to spend the night of April 10th at my aunt's home, and then officially check in on the evening of April 11th. I will definitely stay at this hotel again, and I love the location.

title: Great Business Location in London
text: Great Business Location, Ideal Underground Connections at Embankment or Charing Cross and in the middle of great dining and tourist sites. Quick walk to Covent Garden and Leicester Square and Piccadilly Circus

title: Dirty, worn out hotel
text: They gave me a dirty room with no natural light. Customer service was not effective in resolving the situation. The location is excellent but the rooms are old and dirty and in sore need of an upgrade.

title: Superb Stay
text: This was our 2nd cost to the hotel and from the moment we arrived to the minute we left were made to feel welcome. The location is perfect and the rooms were clean and warm on a cold London weekend and will return again soon.

title: Great location, ok hotel
text: Staff were very friendly and accommodating. The location right on Trafalgar can’t be beat. Was nice to have kitchenette when traveling with kids. Room felt worn and outdated. The breakfast buffet was very expensive and not good.

title: Wembley weekend stay over.
text: Perfectly positioned hotel right in the heart of London, I was able to disappear off to the soccer whilst my wife took herself around the capital for a while, the staff are very helpful if you require anything and prices were reasonable. You are close to all of the major places of note and it has loads of bars, theaters and restaurants all within very easy walking distance and the tube is right outside the hotel. The rooms are more than adequate and always very clean and modern, ten out of ten for this venue.

title: Great location
text: Our room was great. This is a wonderful location for walking the area. The free laundry really helped on a month long vacation. The buffet was excellent. The room had good wifi and lots of hot water in a nice shower was a plus.

title: Great Hotel Near A Lot of Attractions
text: We stayed for two nights at the Club Quarters Trafalgar Square hotel and enjoyed it very much. The staff were friendly. The hotel and rooms were clean. We had two rooms for our family. One room was a king suite with a sofa bed and it had a really nice kitchenette (fridge, sink, dinnerware, teapot, etc). Since the breakfast wasn't included we just went to the store at the corner and grabbed some cereal and milk and had a cheap breakfast. The location, like a lot of these reviews say, was great. So close to many of the attractions and if you need to you can take the transit system (buss or tube) very easy. We found it very easy to get around and the location was a good home base to be located at. It's not cheap but most hotels in this area are not and we figured the time and money we would have spent on transportation would have cost us just as much. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Excellent stay in a most convenient location
text: In the last 15 years I've been over 10 times in London both for business and pleasure. This is possibly the best hotel I've even been in. Comfortable, clean, silent and exceptionally located. Friendly staff and a spacious room (according to London standards).

title: Great position for exploring london
text: Good and central. Lobby fine building. Little tired in the rooms though. Could do with a spruce up and sort the heating out. Lovely staff . Great water fill up feature and ironing facilities. Right on Trafalgar door and a 2 min walk to nearest tube. Charing cross

title: Location location clean,friendly hotel
text: our 3rd visit to this hotel,the location is brilliant seconds away to Trafalga Square. Staff are very helpful,stayed in a family room which was very clean and plenty of room. It certainly gives you a London feel

title: Great Location, Reasonable Room, Free Internet, Good Value
text: Stayed here for a week for business, but did some sightseeing too. It is tough to find a reasonably-priced room of a decent size in central London, within a short walk from the National Gallery, Westminster Abbey and Parliament/Big Ben, the War Rooms, and so many other major locations. The Club Quarters at Trafalgar fits the bill. The rooms are of respectable size and decor, many or most have a mini fridge and kitchenette to allow you to save a few pounds on meals or late-night nibbles, and a modern bathroom that does the trick. There is free chilled water and bottles to carry it on each floor. Free high-speed internet in the room and free printing make this a real find for those doing business while here. The exercise room is well equipped (a couple of ellipticals, a couple of treadmills, weight machines) but quite compact. Nothing really fancy about the accommodations, though the lobby bar is a high-ceilinged affair with marble columns and drapes that is fun and impressive, albeit priced like any major city hotel bar would be. The food in the bar/restaurant is fine, not outstanding. Overall, I would say this is a fine value at a superb location, but don't expect opulence or extreme luxury.

title: Location excellent
text: Stayed for one night with my husband, but wish we could have stayed longer. Location was perfect for our requirements, had a river cruise booked and was just minutes away from the hotel. Room was extremely clean and comfortable and staff on reception so polite and helpful. Nothing was too much trouble. Was able to leave our suitcase when we checked out as we were going to do a bit more sightseeing before we headed home. Even gave us an umbrella to borrow as the weather was very wet. Fantasic location, right near to all the famous attractions. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Club Quarters at Trafalgar Square
text: We went here and had a wonderful experience. Our room overlooked the London Eye, Big Ben, Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, and Admiralty Arch. The hotel is incredibly centrally located and less than a 15 minute walk from any of the places mentioned above and Trafalgar Square is 100 yards away - yet Northumberland St. is quiet. Get a higher room - when you confirm your room 3-4 days in advance - ask for a rooom up high - it is worth it. We thought the King bedroom was certainly sufficiently sized - though the bathroom was a tad small - could be an issue if you are very large.

title: Business Trip
text: This property does just want it needs to - pleasant clean room, well serviced

title: Great Hotel !
text: We stayed there during a weekend. Its a great location close to the center. The rooms were clean and of a good size. The staff was very friendly. We could leave or luggage there when we checked out so we could go to town without carrying them with us. Our stay in the hotel was very pleasant.

title: Excellent facility
text: It is not a traditional hotel in my point of view, it is more of a business centre with excellent accommodation options, almost feeling like home and having all amenities you can think of at the best possible location.

title: Great base for the weekend!
text: I booked this hotel as a last minute overnight stay as I had Theatre tickets for the West End and this was the nearest hotel to the Theatre. Easy to find, short walk from Embankment Tube station, Northumberland Avenue is right opposite Trafalgar Square with everything that surrounds that area. The Hotel staff were very friendly and helpful and we were allocated our room straightaway. The room was clean, comfortable with everything you might want for an overnight stay. We returned to the hotel at approx. 11.30pm on the Saturday night and wanted to have a drink in the bar but it was shut, on mentioning this to the reception desk they arranged for a complimentary bottle of wine to be sent to our room, this was most unexpected but very welcome. We were able to leave our cases at the hotel all the next day even after check out and the staff were once again very accommodating. Lovely hotel, staff and surroundings.

title: Good location but....
text: My Wife and I stayed at the Club Quarter for 3 nights had found the location to be perfect. However there were a few issues with the hotel. The check-in area was odd that you stood in a tight hallway with a Reception person checking into a computer. We were given a room without air conditioning, but were not told they at check-in. We were moved to a smaller room in the wing that had air. This all should have been explained at check-in. Overall you could not get a better location, but the overall experience was frustrating. Sent from my iPhone

title: Excellent hotel!
text: Hotel has a great location--was there during a bank holiday 3 day weekend --zillions of people about, hotel is cean, safe, well appointed, and remarkably quiet. Staff could not be more helpful, room well appointed, very comfortable bed, modern bathroom. Public rooms stunning.

title: Great location. Such nice staff. Really nice room
text: Three of us stayed here this past weekend. It is a block from Charing Cross tube station and half a block from the Embankment (thank you to the trip advisor people who suggested taking the Piccadilly line to Hammersmith and then the local line to Embankment. So very easy with luggage from Heathrow) tube station. Right at Trafalgar Square and an easy and straight walk to Buckingham, St James, Westminster, theaters, etc. No map needed it is that easy. Since it is next to tube stations getting anywhere else is super great. We went to Windsor Castle for one day and since we were next to tube stations it was a breeze. Some have said the location was difficult to find because it is two hotels (The Grand and a Club Quarters) but we did not find this to be the case at all-really easy to find if you have the address. Shout out to Matthew at the front desk. He is great. He could not have tried harder to make sure our stay was comfortable and pain free. Helped with any request as well as made us feel very welcomed. Room for three was perfect. Queen bed and pull out single sofa bed. It was already made up when we arrived which was so nice. Coffee and tea for three with an electric kettle as well as milk (really nice as so many places do not provide milk) made our mornings stress free. Water bottles being able to be refilled by elevators is super when traveling. They even provide new, empty bottles should you need them. Nice touch. Great smelling bath products as well. Only big negative is no safe we could find. Not sure why that is as the hotel clearly caters to travelers and business people. If I were in London again, I would certainly stay here. Location is perfect, staff are terrific, and rooms were just fine or better.

title: Great location for London business trip
text: Perfect location for business trips around Westminster with good rooms. Nothing exceptional but for the price a good place to stay. I don't really understand an earlier review about sneaky extra charges - everything was clear to me. Would say £17 for breakfast is a bit steep. I went elsewhere

title: Great location, friendly staff
text: We stayed three nights at Club Quarters, just off Trafalgar Square. Nice, clean hotel with service-minded staff. The break-fast was seriously overpriced (GBP 15 / person) and we would have liked a fridge in our room. However, we made do with the ice machine just down the hall. The bed was really good with a firm mattress and the room was tidyed perfectly each day. We'd be happy to come back anytime.

title: very happy with selection
text: I only thing I was unhappy with happend only once. I wanted to end the night with a glass of wine. When I got to hotel there was a private booking in the hotel lounge abd I was denied entry. I wish they would not promote facilities that may or may not be available to guests.

title: Location
text: We stayed on a Saturday night 31May.room was on the 8th floor but had to walk along very long corridors before getting to our room.water dispenser was near the lift with no bottles in.had to ask for extra coffee tea sugar and milk ad not enough in room.room was a good size but needed to be cleaner under cupboards.but once again no sleep due to air con motor on roof to must noise and in the room.last thing KETTLE DIDN'T TURN OF SO BURT HAND. Location brilliant

title: Wonderful, Convenient Stay
text: I stayed at the Club Quarters for 3 nights and had a wonderful stay. The hotel is in a perfect location, just steps away from Trafalgar Square and within easy walking distance to many London icons. There are countless restaurants in the area also. The staff was extremely pleasant, professional, and and went the "extra mile" to be helpful. There were "guest lockers" on each floor where a person could grab extra tea/coffee, pillows and blankets, and even sewing kits.The room was very comfortable and had free WI-FI. Another bonus was that the hotel was so secure - you had to swipe your room key to get your floor. I would highly recommend staying at Club Quarters.

title: A great location, generally good but poor room service attention
text: We loved staying here because of its excellent location and general good quality. However when we arrived we were keen to have some tea with kettle provided but found that the kettle would not stay on when switched on. We phoned down for a replacement kettle and they told us that they would send one up. We waited for over an hour and then called down again, this time I decided to hold down the switch for a full four minutes to get the thing to boil! Another twenty minutes later it finally arrived. They also only provide two plastic thimblefuls of milk although later we discovered that you could help yourself to more down the corridor. Not much of an apology either, but everything else was fine.

title: Good
text: Very functional hotel. Small rooms which are common in London. Clean, good service. Nothing to complain about for the price. Concierge was helpful. Great location! You can walk anywhere from here. Am always pleased with Club Quarters.

title: Great location, but "OK" stay.
text: Great location (close to everything), but a lot of the rooms have no view (frosted windows so you can't even see outside). We stayed here 2 nights. On our first night we were given a room that had a foul smell (very strong musty/moldy) and we were congested all night. We asked to move for the next night so they upgraded us to a better room, which was much appreciated. Check-in took a long time because the card maker (keys) weren't working. We had to sit in the lobby for 25 minutes to wait for someone to fix it. The 5:00 happy hour with complimentary wine & treats was very nice. Overall, I would say it was an "ok" stay.

title: Amazing gem in the perfect location!
text: Stayed here for an extended work trip and was amazed by how nice the room was, as well as how gracious and helpful the staff were! The location is perfect for exploring Trafalgar Square and St. James Park, and just lovely on its own to relax in for the evenings. I can't wait to stay here again and would recommend it to anyone, for business or pleasure.

title: Fantastic location
text: Superb hotel close to many attractions and just off Trafalgar sq Hotel is very good and not too expensive Rooms are clean and spacious and you can even open a window for fresh air Need to watch which room they assign as you are very close to some of the busiest streets anywhere.

title: Great central base
text: Nice place, great location, clean quiet room. Good value, cheaper than travelodge in London but much better quality. Will stay here again.

title: Excellent Hotel & Location
text: Excellent hotel in first class location only yards from Trafalgar Square. Check in very efficient. Wifi best ever experienced in a hotel - a massive 74Mb in our room which was on the 8th floor, a long way from reception. If your into sports all Sky sports available on tv in room. Cold water supply and refill bottles on each floor is very welcome. If you only want a light breakfast at £20 per person this is a bit steep - Garfunkels is only 30 yards away and offers a full English from 5.95.

title: central hotel and a great night's sleep
text: just off Trafalgar Square, ideally located for everything we wanted to do in London for the weekend. We had a room at the back of the hotel which meant a limited view from the window but one of the best night's sleep ever, totally peaceful.

title: Not as it appears
text: After booking two rooms at this hotel on Saturday 20th February 2016, we arrived after a busy day and were asked to leave the seating in the bar area as we were not purchasing any drinks. There was nobody else in this area so we were not taking up seats. We eventually went to a seating area upstairs which is cold and sole less. Computers are there for people to work on, so hardly an area for being comfortable and relaxing. The hotel rooms are very basic and not worth the prices charged. The bathroom was small and although not dirty didn't seem very bright. The pillows are huge and extremely uncomfortable.

title: Excellent value
text: Brilliant location fabulous friendly staff everything within walking distance. We arrived early (7am ish) and were offered early access to our room for a small fee. So good to have a shower and freshen up. Exhausted on first night and bed so comfy. All round great stay!

title: Central located
text: I stay in this hotel quite often. The best thing about CQ us it's location..in the heart of Trafalgar Square, walking distance to the Mall, Buckingham Palace, St.James's Park and Green Park. Also close to Piccadilly Circuis and Leicester Square. Lovely walk to Embankement. I like morning walks alongside river Thames and on the bridges. Drinking water and bottles are provided on each floor, which is very helpful. The only thing I miss here is the breakfast. Menu us limited. However, options for breakfast are very close.

title: Def Worthy
text: We had such a wonderful experience when staying at this hotel. Perfect Location and superb staff and savvy front desk personnel and Carlos and Tadas, attendants who helped us. Thanks for everything...we will come back!

title: Super Location
text: This hotel enjoys a fantastic location if you want to explore the sights of London. It enjoys a central position permitting easy access to The Houses of Parliament, the London Eye, Trafalgar Square, Buckingham Palace and many more areas which are worth exploring. The staff are friendly,the rooms are clean and the prices competitive. A good choice all round.

title: Wonderful Weekend
text: Great Hotel location for Museums, Theatres, Restaurants and other major tourist attractions and places of interest. Excellent value for money and delightful staff that go out of their way to help you.

title: Great Locations - Good Service and Hotel.
text: Htis hotel is ideal for the weekend away in London - right in the center, this means you can walk everywhere and most of the central London highlights are within easy reach. Rooms were clean and tidy and staff very helpful.

title: Best Location and Friendly Staff
text: I was in london for 15 days with family. Stayed at another good hotel the 1st 10 days and then later here, as wanted to enjoy living in 2 different locations. I stayed in room 527 and the room was very big considering central London standards, and we also had a kid staying in our room on the sofa come bed. Very comfortable. very safe and perfect location for a tourist. Check in was quick. Check out was fast. The restaurant downstairs is reasonably priced. I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Brilliant!
text: Stayed for a weekend and adored this hotel! Hotel is very central - location us brilliant! Couldn't ask for more! Staff were very friendly and helpful. Hotel was beautiful and very clean! Very close to the west end and many other attractions! Close to very nice restaurants too.

title: ANOTHER GREAT STAY
text: Made another trip to London this weekend and again stayed at Club Quarters Trafalgar Square. The service here is always top class, cannot fault it. The staff are welcoming and extremely helpful. Rooms are clean and comfortable and their breakfasts are just so good. We always try to stay here every trip but sometimes miss out due to availability. Will try to book well in advance for any future trips.

title: A very nice stay
text: You just can't do better. Very nice property, great staff and great location. The restaurent was surprisnigly good and good value to boot. We stayed in the smallest room. It was small but really efficiently laid out. This is where I will stay when I come to London.

title: Business Trip
text: Stayed here with work - great location, within walking distance from Trafalgar Square, Buckingham Palace, Covent Garden, Soho and St. James' Park. Spacious room by city standards with some complimentary snacks and drinks. London price tag!

title: Good Value, Great Location
text: The hotel is totally fine. No frills - so don't expect top-notch service but don't expect a dump either, which this place certainly isn't. The rooms have little to no charm and are a bit tackily decorated (the curtains, duvet cover and headboard didn't match at all), but other than that - you'll get a decent bed, a solid shower and will be located steps away from the center of London including the West End Theatre District, The Thames, Big Ben/Parliament, Buckingham Palace, The Eye, Covent Garden, Mayfair and more. It's all about the location. You'll have a comfortable room for sure - just don't expect anything glamorous. Highly suggest for those on a budget and want a good room under $200 a night in a great area.

title: Excellent location and rooms
text: We wanted a room in a hotel near to Trafalgar Square as we were attending a function nearby. All we wanted to do was shower and sleep there and did not need anything fancy so we booked a Club room which was excellent for our needs. Everything was clean and comfortable and I will certainly return here when I need a room in this area. I used to live in London so don't need to see the sights but for tourists the location could not be better.

title: Great location and super staff
text: My husband and I stayed here on the 20th October because we had an event nearby,checking in was very simple and the staff were very friendly. The room was very clean and spacious,the tea tray could of done with more milk but that's the little down side and the only thing that I could find to pick fault with.

title: Excellent Location
text: Lovely hotel in a great location. Walking distance to many attractions. The rooms were a good size and very comfortable. We had a fridge and microwave in ours. A little on the expensive side but it is in central London so to be expected. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Excellent rooms, excellent staff!
text: I must have stayed at Club Quarters more than a dozen times now and have never had anything but a positive experience. The rooms are well-appointed and equipped, the staff are excellent - friendly, attentive and polite. The hotel is well located - literally a minute's walk from Trafalgar Square, with a number of good pubs and a range of decent restaurants and eateries nearby.

title: Good service
text: The reception staff were very helpful. They took the time to give us comprehensive information to enhance our visit. We needed an extra towel. It was delivered within minutes. Set breakfast was cooked to perfection. The best we've had for a long time. Will certainly book this hotel again. It is so well placed for Theatreland. Well done guys!

title: Perfect location - very friendly great for city weekends and business
text: Spent the weekend here recently and having stayed in many London hotels i was pleasantly surprised. The hotel was very clean, very friendly, and a trendy bar. The location is the best for the tourist, right next to Nelson and take a walk down to the Embankment to visit the amazing olde worlde pub in the cellers called Gordons wine bar - get there early as its hugely popular.

title: Nice place close to the city centre
text: A good place. Very comfortable room. Internet was iffy. In house free washing machine and dyer available. Staff helpful. Close to trains. Lounge on the ground floor is a good place to relax. Would I stay there again? Yes

title: Very happy with our selection of this hotel
text: Trying to find a room in London for three adults is not very easy. The choices are usually limited to finding a room with a sofa bed and then jumping over furniture (and one another) to move within the room. This hotel offers an incredible solution at a very reasonable price: The one room suite with kitchenette. Not only was the room nice and spacious, it was excellently lit. The sofa bed opened into a very nice double bed and our room - upon request- had a divider between the two beds for some privacy. The kitchenette was very well equipped with everything one needs to prepare a meal, a hot drink or a snack. The room itself was very clean and comfortable. I really loved the 5-6 books found in the room. The staff was extremely helpful and polite. As for the location: we were a minutes walk from Trafalgar Square and by strolling around for an hour, one could see Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, Big Ben and the Parliament, London Eye and so much more. A very strong recommendation!

title: Weekend Break
text: Superb stay. Clean and comfortable, all that we needed as just a place to rest our heads. Great location. Only slight annoyance was when a request for fresh milk for tea was met with a response "none available I'm afraid". Wouldn't stop us from staying again, we will just bring some fresh milk, rather than using the UHT option.

title: A lovely building in a fabulous location.
text: We booked this room as a last minute deal. It was advertised as a small double, but the room was more than adequate to meet our needs. The purified bottle water and ice machine, on each floor was used and appreciated. We would highly recommend a stay here.

title: Another nice stay at Club Quarters
text: I like this place. Good location, good staff, comfortable room. I'll stay here again.

title: ideal location
text: Stayed two nights over a weekend and overall had a great experience. The location is perfect. I was able to walk through much of "downtown"....from leichester square, to trafalgar, to westminster. if you're up for a hike, you can also walk to hyde park from there. The first night I ate at boyd's, which was delicious and moderately priced for a great piece of steak. The little perk of having distilled water stations was lovely on each floor. Staff were friendly, helpful. The room was small, and facing the back of the building without a view but had everything I needed (except a safe - never found one). The hotel is a little dated, so if you are picky about that, you'll notice. My only critique is that you could hear the people walking above you, with the floors creaking with every step. It only actually annoyed me for about 20 minutes but would make me consider not staying here again considering so many other options in London.

title: Great location, mediocre rooms, helpful and welcoming staff
text: I came for 4 days vacation with my wife + 2 days business. The room we first received was for disabled. Not very convenient and quite ugly. We asked for another room and received it after one night. Room was quite specious, simple and not very nicely designed, bathroom was really ugly, small and belongs to significantly cheaper hotel. What was really nice was the service and the great location in Trafalgar Square. Transportation is also excellent.

title: You will love this place!
text: As a regular visitor to London I generally use the usual hotel search sites to find a bargain in a good location. This time I hit upon the Club Quarters. OMG! It was brilliant . A great location, a fascinating old building steeped in history. The room was spotless with all you could possibly need and spacious . A nice big comfy queen size bed and no external noise ensured a great nights sleep. Friendly staff . All in all top draw. I will be going straight to this hotels site next time. No need to look elsewhere. All for £106 for the night.

title: Nice hotel-great location
text: My husband and I stayed at this hotel in June when we stopped in London en route to Wales. The hotel was very nice, the room spacious and the location excellent. We were able to walk to many major sites, ie. the London Eye, Trafalgar Square, Picadilly and the Mall and Buckingham Palace. It was also convenient to public transport. I would definitely stay here again.

title: More pros than cons
text: Brilliantly located, especially as we were in London for the Remembrance services at the Cenotaph. 5 minutes from Whitehall, Embankment tube, Trafalgar Square. Staff very pleasant. Club bedroom OK, bed really comfy & warm, could only access the window side of the bed by edging sideways along the wall. Bathroom, no bath just a large shower..pretty shabby though & the chrome facia of basin covered in finger prints from previous occupants. Doors to room really heavy, therefore close with a heavy thump, so throughout the night you knew when everyone was going to bed! Good (although pricey) place to stay for sightseeing etc if you just want a base & not somewhere to spend time

title: Excellent hotel, great location, amazing staff
text: I stayed over the weekend at Club Quarters Trafalgar Square in London. The hotel itself is very nice, though it has 4 stars in some ways it felt like a 5 stars, specially location wise and staff friendliness. Highlighting a Spanish girl there (Susana) who was very helpful with best spots to visit in London, away from the usual touristic places. Definitely highly recommended.

title: Terrible. Credit card rip off. Non functioning equipment. No staff.
text: Literally the first words on arrival were “I’m going to charge your credit card £20”. This for a prepaid room with no mini bar. When I refused we had 10 minutes unnecessary unpleasantness until the receptionist admitted it was illegal and unnecessary. So why the unnecessary nasty welcome?. If you get asked this Just Say No. then the TV would not switch off. No answer from the reception phone except an answer machine (at 9:50 PM). Why? Because there are no staff on duty. This hotel should be nice but it’s being run like a sleazy dump in a third world country that just wants to rip off gullible tourists. It’s not cheap. There a better hotels out there.

title: Two Words: Location and Service
text: The Club Quarter in Trafalgar Square is really in an ideal location. Walkable to Westminster, the London Eye, Leister, theaters, and Piccadilly Circus (among other neighborhoods), it is in the heart of it all. I stayed for three nights on business and could not have been happier with the location or the friendliness of the staff. An approximately 20 pound taxi ride from the Heathrow Express at Paddington Station, the hotel is located near several Tube stations (Charing Cross and Embankment) and in walking distances of dozens of restaurants, pubs, and shops. I arrived just before 10 am from an overnight flight and they had a room ready for me on the 6th floor. The elevators are keycard access to get to the floors and there is a lovely club lounge on the first floor with complimentary coffee, hot water, fruit, and snacks. My room was small, but very clean. It had no view (into an interior space), but I didn't care about that. It was also a connecting room, but I never heard anyone next door. The bathroom was clean and the shower had excellent water pressure. The hotel also had complimentary internet, which was a huge bonus! Overall, I would not hesitate to stay at the Club Quarters again. Its location and cleanliness give it top marks in my book.

title: No complaints
text: Stayed here last Friday and Saturday. Check in as previous visit very efficient. Given room on 8th floor. Decent sized room. Clean with small corner bathroom. View out of window towards big ben. As with previous review though, you can tell its more of a business hotel rather than leisure, as once again you tend to roll towards the middle of the bed

title: Fine hotel in fantastic location
text: Although I stayed at the CQ Trafalgar Square for business (attending a conference in the adjoining 8 Northumberland Ave venue) I would heartily recommend this hotel for tourists as it is in such a fantastic location for all that London has to offer. Amenities wise the hotel only scores an average - I expect more from a business hotel - but as I say for tourism where the hotel is just a base for exploring, it is an excellent option. My fifth floor room was spacious and clean.

title: Stay in London
text: Excellent location, which is my favorite thing about this hotel. Walking distance to everything and underground stations. We had one of the larger rooms. Pretty comfortable beds. Friendly staff. Very good value for the location and quality.

title: Great location and excellent staff
text: Staff willing to help, way beyond the obvious. They were all keen to give tourist information, offer support (e.g., lending a smartphone charger) and making our stay as confortable as possible. The location is great - just beside Trafalgar Square: you can walk easily to most tourist attractions. Rooms are a bit small but overall the compromise is very good.

title: very good hotel
text: The hotel was really well located right downtown in the centre of the city, almost no need to use any transport. only if you want to go to Kew gardens for example or to the O2. The hotel's service is very kind and nice, For example we needed an adapter so they gave us. The room was clean and all, but we stayed there for seven nights and they didn't changed the sheets of the bed, but when we ask them they replace them immediately.

title: Excellent Location
text: I've stayed at Club Quarters before (Washington DC) and knew more or less what I was getting into. The idea of the chain is quite nice, even for those that aren't business travelers. The excellent locations of the hotels (in general) are ideal for tourists as well. This facility is quite nice in the lobby, with a very trendy looking bar that is downstairs next to the lobby. Check in was quick, and we were able to get two rooms a few hours before check-in which was a plus. The rooms were decent, but not worth mentioning. The bathrooms were notably small, and the fact that there was a shower curtain instead of some kind of plexiglass door was slightly bothersome, but on the whole it was a good value. There's fresh water available in the hallway which is a nice touch and the WiFi is of a very decent speed. While there's no euro plug in the room, they have adapters available for free at the front desk. Overall, I would consider the Club Quarters again.

title: Excellent staff
text: I regularly stay at Club Quarters when working in London, the location is ideal and it is good value for central London. Today the housekeeping team, especially Carlos, have been particularly helpful. The team are always friendly and will go out of their way to make your stay the best possible. Great rewards points as well!

title: Excellent Place to Stay
text: Stayed at the Club Quarters Trafalgar Square April 10-13, 2015. I found it to be the perfect location for seeing a lot of major attractions as well as being very close to two Tube Stations. The staff were very friendly and accommodating. The room was neat and tidy and the bed and pillows were very comfortable. From our 9th floor room we had an amazing view of Big Ben, The London Eye and Buckingham Palace. The one thing that we did not do is eat breakfast there as I felt the price was a little high, but unless you go to a fast food joint, the price is pretty typical of most upscale London hotels. Although a little bit expensive, you definitely get what you pay for. I would recommend this hotel for anyone visiting London, as I will surely be staying here again on my next trip :-)

title: Very Quant
text: Excellent little place and very central to all London sites. The breakfast was very yummy indeed :) The room I chose was a little on the small side, but overall very satisified I shall return! Dr MG Smyth

title: Great Location - very Comfortable
text: Stayed for one night and already booked another. Club Quarters was an excellent hotel. This one has a bar and restaurant - but as usual you can order food in from local eateries. The room was spacious. It overlooked Northumberland but had very effective secondary double glazing which kept noise to a minimum. Check in and checkout was hassle free. Staff very friendly

title: Really comfortable and quiet
text: I booked a short trip at the Club Quarters in order to be closer to some of the surrounding areas like China Town, Soho, Covent Garden and Leicester Square (all of which are within a 15 minute walk of the hotel). I think this was a good hotel for what it offered in terms of being easy to check into, providing a comfy room, no-fuss receptionists and clean. The hotel room was probably a bit too small and lacked in-room basics such as a shaving kit, shower cap etc. However, free no-nonsense WiFi and being able to obtain complimentary purified water and ice from the corridor vending machine were nicer touches to the hotel. I would stay here again, probably if the price was the same or a bit lower.

title: Room was old creaky and dingy!!
text: Floor boards in our room were creaking. Room was very old. No concierge service to speak of in hotel. Good hotel to stay in if on business and will be staying a day or two. Otherwise, if you are holiday with family, avoid this hotel. The only redeeming value to this hotel was its location and that’s it.

title: Club Quarters Trafalgar Square
text: Very pleasant. Stayed in a standard room first and found it to be very comfortable, cleverly designed to use very inch of space. We're upgraded for our second visit--one more night at the end of our trip--and though also very nice, we found we preferred the smaller room.

title: Business Stay
text: I have been staying at this hotel every now and then for the last four years now for work and have stayed there for weeks at times. This is a fantastic location and the rooms are of decent size with facilities such as the Wi-Fi, water and coffee/tea available for no extra cost. Staff there have always made me feel welcome and like at home always with big smiles. Especially Joanna and Ophelie recently who were always there to help. Also, the Italian restaurant “Bianco” does great Pizza’s and really helpful with my random on-demand pasta requests!

title: Great stay
text: Friendly, helpful staff. Clean. Great location. 2nd stay here. Love it. I recommend staying here for a short or long stay. My first stay was a few days, this time was 10 days. Both were excellent and welcoming.

title: Another top stay at a Club Quarters
text: Our first time at Trafalgar Square but it won't be our last. We had a lovely and comfortable room and the people were smashing

title: Great location
text: Nice, helpful staff, clean. Our first room had been smoked in, we called & were immediately moved. Loved the location. It is near places to eat, museums and other attractions.. Staff was helpful and nice.

title: Brilliant Location.
text: This hotel could not be more central. It was clean, comfortable and my ninth floor corner room had a view down the Mall to Buckingham Palace.The staff were delightful and the reception areas and bar very grand. Very good value to be only yards from Trafalgar Square.

title: Convenient Location
text: I like the location of this hotel for my business trip as it is a short walk away from my office, and convenient to the Tube station, eateries, a Tesco Express, Trafalgar Square, the National Gallery, government buildings, River Thames, etc. Just walk a little bit more and you'll get to the theatres, Leicester Square, Piccadilly Circus, shops and restaurants. However, it gets noisy at night. For some reason, there was a lot of noise coming from outside my room window every night (music, people laughing/talking), and it would go on till quite late (but would end before midnight). But other than location, the hotel is average. The room is a good size for Europe, but it's a little old/tired. Very small wardrobe. The bathroom is functional, and the bathroom floor can get a little wet after a shower (not so pleasant) as there is only a shower curtain and the "kerb" separating the shower area is rather low. There is a kettle with free coffee and tea, but I could not find any stirrers/tea spoons in the 3 nights that I stayed. A good addition is the microwave oven in the room - very useful. Service was efficient/functional but not as friendly as the other hotels I've stayed in whenever I come to London. Not much of a warm welcome when I arrived nor a brief introduction about the hotel facilities - just here's your key (I had to ask where the lifts were to find my way to my room). It is great that the hotel provides drinking water with empty bottles and an ice machine centrally located on each floor. I will stay here again because I like the location, but it would be nice if the rooms are renovated in the near future, and I hope to encounter friendlier service the next time I'm there.

title: Good food excellent service perfect location
text: Brilliant service and food. Rooms are value for money. My room doesn't have any view, but they must have rooms with better view. internet speed is excellent!!! Breakfast is a bit overpriced, good quality.

title: Return to my favorite London hotel
text: Stayed here in 2014 and returned in 2015 because of the hotel amenities, location, and most importantly the staff. I had asked for some assistance in arranging some events during my first visit that the senior concierge took care of for me that could not have been accomplished without his help. When planning this trip, I reached out to him, and again the assistance was invaluable to helping arrange a great trip. My experience in interacting with all the staff has been excellent, but I have to give special accolades to Senior Concierge Daniel Laguarta.

title: Pub Quarters Hotel
text: We booked an overnight stay at this hotel in central London. We were given a warm welcome, excellent service from courteous and efficient reception staff and a room that fitted the bill which was very reasonable. And Wifi was included in the price and was fatter and faster than I have ever had in a London hotel.

title: 1st Time Visitor
text: Great hotel and excellent location. Many sites within walking distance. We walked to Buckingham Palace, the theater area, and many other sites. There were so many great restaurants local to the hotel.

title: Saved the day when i needed a place for someone to stay
text: I contacted John the owner and he let me know that he had a room and kept the room for my staff member as he was on the way to London at the time. he stayed at the hotel and said the owner John was a true gent, the rooms very good and the hotel would be a place he would be happy to go back to again.

title: So welcome & comfortable
text: Extremely clean, very friendly, helpful & efficient staff, lovely, airy, well-lit room...enjoyed my stay so much that I'm returning with my husband next month

title: Excellent Service in an Excellent Location
text: We traveled as three couples looking for a place to stay in London that was central to transportation and had a great reputation for service. We found both of these staying at The Lavender Guest House. John and Tony and staff couldn't have been more hospitable - going out of their way to answer every question and provide any service needed. The facilities were very clean, the rooms accommodating, and the garden setting pleasant and great for our gathering to eat and make the plans for our adventures. The close proximity of the London bus service and to the Clapham Junction for rail and access to the Underground really made getting around to the London sites and traveling to Scotland very easy.

title: Excellent place to stay
text: We stayed two nights and we shall certainly stay here again if it is not booked up. Our room was excellent, fresh, clean, spacious and well equipped. Owners are very friendly and helpful. As we were visiting family, we did not spend a lot of time in the hotel, but the pleasant garden and the food areas were useful options. Lots of good local places to eat. Breakfast at Jack's was especially good value with the Lavender discount!

title: Clean, Convenient Lodging
text: My wife and I stayed at this home for five nights. This guest house has average size rooms for the price however facilities are clean, breakfast choices excellent, and host John Houss and wife are friendly and attentive. This guest house also has a separate glassed-in porch area with garden view which contains a refrigerator, etc. This is available for relaxation or eating food brought in. The location, within 5-10 minutes walk of Clapham Junction Rail Station, is very convenient. We would definitely stay here again if travelling to London.

title: You won't need anything else!
text: If you are looking for a nice place to stay, very clean and cosy then go for it! I usually stay in 4/5 stars hotels, but this time I wanted to try something different so, after having read a couple of positive comments here on Tripadvisor, I booked a room, possibly, in the best guest house you'll ever find in London! The place is run by a greek family (John, Alice and their son Tony) who'll make you feel at home straight away:) Those people are amazing...and me and my mum miss them already! The rooms are spotless, spacious and very cosy. Breakfast and Wi-Fi internet connection are included, plus there is a beautiful backgarden where you can cook your food and relax! As I said, you won't need anything else:)

title: good location in quiet street in busy area
text: Very well maintained guest house in Clapham, within easy walking distance of rail and bus services. Room was well appointed and kept to a very high standard. We were slightly disappointed with the very limited breakfast menu - some fruit/yoghurt and something to go with scrambled eggs would make such a difference. A bonus was the access to a sheltered sunny garden along with a sitting room attached including a microwave for visitor use.- a good touch

title: Family visit over Holidays
text: We finally stayed at the Lavender Guest house when my daughters house got to crowded and are so glad we did. Tony and Lisa were so nice to us we felt like family. Clean and accommodating are cornerstones of this property not to mention it’s great location. We highly recommend and look forward to visiting in September. Cheers

title: Quite, clean, well maintained, friendly, affordable, accommodation.
text: Stayed for several nights while working in the area. Tony was excellent in providing help and information and arranging my daily car parking permit as I needed them. No breakfast or meals provided but there was a kitchen and two public eating areas for residents to use so no need to always eat out or have food smells in your bedroom if buying a take away. Car parking on the street always available I found and easy. Very comfortable safe feeling middle class area very close to shops restaurants and Clapham Junction station which is only 10 minutes to Waterloo central London. A very genuine find if you want a no frills affordable comfortable accommodation. Almost will certainly be staying again when the need arises.

title: Fantastic, fantastic, fantastic
text: My mum and aunty stayed here for 26 nights straight and not once did they have a problem. The room was lovely (much nicer then a hotel room), breakfast was amazing and service was brilliant. We would recommend this B&B to all our friends and family and will be using it again for sure. This is also a great location to the high street & train station. Thank you Lavender Guest House for making my families stay an enjoyable one.

title: Great place, lovely staff, good value
text: I was staying in Battersea for a couple of weeks work with a small marketing company. In which I needed to have a short commute to work and my stay to not be to expensive. Finding The Lavender Guest House on trip advisor with great reviews, it was in the perfect location and seemed to have a good reputation. After coming back from spain that morning I needed to be at work early that morning, very kindly letting me to leave my stuff in a bag holding area in which was then conveniently moved to my room when returned from work. Always great hospitality throughout my stay with them, John always made sure that everything was of top quality and value for my stay, working around my needs for my stay, making myself feel at home. Overall a top location with great staff and great value. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would highly recommend to anyone.

title: Excellent
text: This family run business is delightful. John, Tony, Lisa and Deb all work hard to ensure your stay is enjoyable. They are extremely helpful and friendly making you feel more than welcome. I thoroughly enjoyed my 10 nights there whilst visiting my daughter who is living in London.

title: Best hotel of the area so far.
text: Hide in a lovely and residential sweep in the heart of Clapham Junction you can find this small guest Hotel, the best hotel of the area so far. Impressive en-suite rooms and immaculate facilities. But the best is definetely its owner, John and his lovely family that run the business. Since the first moment we arrived, they make us feel like home. We spent a couple of weeks at Lavender House Hotel and John treated us as his own family.

title: This Hotel is Clean,Quiet & Cosy
text: We booked a twin room for our Surveyors who were working in the area they commented that it was a lovley hotel that was Clean,Quiet & Cosy. I personally found John to be very helpful when I was booking the rooms and he made the whole process very easy. SG

title: Excellent Place to Stay
text: A one night stay when visiting son. Dealing with Tony was excellent in obtaining a room and he was a pleasure to deal with. On arrival we were told we had been given a bigger room which was a delightful surprise. The property is wonderful, scrupulously clean with a lovely room you can sit in overlooking the garden where you can prepare and store food. The room itself was very good and comfortable. Recommend highly for anyone looking for a comfortable, reasonably priced place to stay in London 5 mins from Clapham station.

title: The lavender guest house
text: Lovely guest house and wonderful staff, would recommend it! There is a lovely garden area with a kitchen and refrigerator for the guests to use, we will be coming back here to stay on our next visit to London

title: Perfect!
text: We spent a few days at the Lavender Guest House last month and we will definitely go back there next time we go to London. It was simply perfect: - the location is ideal : very quite street but near Clapham's many restaurants/pubs/shops + more than enough train or bus connections to central London - the staff is extremely kind and welcoming, always ready to help with any inquiries (thank you Tony!) - the rooms are confortable, the beds are VERY confortable - the prices are more than reasonnable for London

title: The Lavender Guest House
text: A very clean and welcoming Guest House. Conveniently situated close to Clapham Junction and excellent value for money - good breakfast included. The owner was very attentive and helpful with any requests and our room was comfortable, spotless and quiet. We would recommend it.

title: Comfortable and convenient
text: We stayed 17 nights and it suited our purpose to perfection. The location was excellent. This is a family run business with the staff being friendly and very helpful. John, the owner, was also attentive. The full English breakfast every morning eventually became too much for my husband. Deborah was a ray of sunshine every morning when we went for breakfast and Lisa continued this when we saw her later each morning. Our room, although small and compact had everything we needed to feel at home for our duration. The conservatory was like a meeting place each night for all guests when we went there to use the facilities to have an in house evening meal and use the interent. We shall return next year when we visit family nearby.

title: Family-run hotel with charming host
text: Easy to reach, being just a five-minute walk from London's busiest railway station, bus stops and the Underground, there is only one place my wife and I shall be staying from now on. Breakfast is filling, the coffee livening, the toast comes whenever you need. The room was very tidy, the bed comfortable, and the washing facilities always properly cleaned. The toilet in our room was situated in a very surprising place! I won't spoil the surprise by telling you... If there is one criticism, it would be the separate hot and cold taps. Apart from that, there is nothing more to say except anyone wishing to be looked after by someone born to be a hotel owner, who takes great pride in making his guests feel at ease, here is where you should come.

title: at home in london
text: I stayed at the Lavender Guest House in Battersea for three weeks. I was traveling alone and did not know the area before. After a few days I started to feel at home.
