John, the manager, his staff and his son Tony are truly such great people, I appreciate their pleasing, very warm and professional manner. The Guest House is situated in a top quality location, very charming neighborhood and easy to travel to the center of London (by bus and by train). I stayed in different rooms and all of them had good wifi connection and were very tidy each day. I will go back there during my next stay in London! title: very good indeed!
text: I made enquiries and booked this place well ahead of my trip. John was very helpful via email and over the phone. I had to change plans last minute giving less than 48hrs notice but John was very understanding and re-arranged my booking for me and did not charge any penalties. I was greeted by Tony on arrival and was given a tour before I was shown to my room (room 6). Everything was as expected, no surprises, WIFI worked well, room was clean and comfortable. Toilet and bathroom, although shared (as indicated on their website), was clean and was available whenever I needed to use it so not an issue at all. Supermarket, shops, restaurants, buses and trains within a few minutes walk. In summary, very good for location and cost.

title: Excellent stay for my first time in London
text: Room clean albeit quite small, bed comfortable, friendly staff and a lovely hot cooked breakfast at a very reasonable price for London, and in a lovely quiet area - would definitely recommend and would definitely stay again.

title: A Home from Home
text: I have just returned from 3 nights at the Lavender Guest House. It was superb in every way - clean and comfortable rooms with a service which is second to none. A great find and I am looking forward to many return visits.

title: Great B & B
text: A fantastic find, the room was clean and comfortable, ensuite newly renovated, overall we were very comfortable. Family run business, they could not have been more helpful. Short walk to train station and the High St with many shops and ASDA close by. Plentiful breakfast but limited choices. Will certainly stay again. Carol & Peter, Australia

title: A home from home
text: My partner and I stay in The Lavender Guest House for a few nights most weeks. The accommodation is spotlessly clean, and Tony and his father couldn’t be more accommodating. The room is cleaned to a very high standard each day and the warm welcome Tony and his father provide makes you feel like you’re coming home to old friends rather than a hotel. The location is perfect being a 1 minute walk to restaurants and about 2 minutes to Clapham Junction. We are very happy we found such a nice place to stay whilst away from home with work. I would recommend to anyone!

title: CB
text: Good value for money, friendly,quiet wih good transport links - bus and train

title: Home in the heart of London
text: I am a regular visitor to the Lavender Guest House and have been coming here since 2010. I absolutely love the warmth and hospitality that I receive every time I visit. John and Tony are superb hosts and nothing is too much hassle. The guest house has more amenities than you would find in a normal budget hotel with a fully equipped (recently refitted) kitchen diner so you can eat dinner in comfort and not have to go out every night. The rooms are warm, cosy and quaint, most with new en-suites which is nice. This is not a 5* hotel (so don't compare it to one) but it is a 5* home from home and if you embrace the lavender you will love it as much as I do!

title: Clean and friendly, highly recommended
text: This is my first ever review on Trip Advisor. My nephew and I stayed 4 nights at the Lavender Guest House recently and we highly recommend it. From the moment we arrived Tony, the manager, made us feel at home. We stayed in rooms 6 and 7, both en suite singles at the top of the house. The rooms were plenty big enough for us, spotlessly clean and very comfortable. I didn't use the wi-fi however my nephew reported that it was strong and he was able to connect very quickly. Breakfast is not provided however there are two areas where guests can make their own

title: four day break to visit my new Grandson Mrs B Pugh
text: My sister and myself stayed at this lovely Guest house and would recommend it to family and freinds. We were made very welcome and were treated like one of the family the hospitality was the best I have ever recieved, whether it be a hotel or guest house there was no comparison the Gentleman who ran the Guest house Mr. John Housswas warm and very welcoming when we arrived and was very helpful if we needed directions. Tony Houss which is John's son was very helpful in finding out what time the train was for us to catch when we left and also for keeping our baggage in storage until we came back from vaying good bye to my daughter her partner and their new born son as it was past checking out time.

title: A lovely B&B
text: Very welcoming and a very pleasant stay. My room had a lovely en-suite and the service was excellent from both the owner and his team. I will definately be returning.

title: Friendly and clean
text: My daughter and stayed at the Lavender Guest House for 3 nights in May. The room was clean and had comfortable beds. Very nice to have the opportunity to make our own food in a clean and well equipped kitchen. Confortable bathroom. The host was very friendly and helpful. Clapham is a nice " town" only 20 minutes with train/tube to Oxford steet. In Clapham you will find many nice stores, restaurants and pubs. We will stay here next time we visit London , for sure.

title: Excellent place
text: The location is great: at Clapham Junction which has tons of shops and a 24h ASDA, also a quick train ride away from central London. My room is really clean and spotless. John, the owner, is a really welcoming host. Its a wonderful place to stay at in London.

title: The Greeks are succeeding worldwide
text: We had a great stay at the Lavender Guest House! Mr. John provided us with the most helpful advice for our daily trips to central London! He and his son kindly helped us with our luggage twice! We had a pleasant and friendly conversation with him and his lovely wife which we heard that takes care of the wonderful garden all by herself having "green hands" The service is excellent and the rooms are comfortable and spotlessly clean! The location is great! We had a great time , left with wonderful impressions and we are proud to see a Greek so successful abroad, proves that Xenius Zeus was greek!

title: Great stay in London
text: Thanks to the tripadvisor reviewers we booked our stay. From the beginning, Tony was a great help in planning our first visit to London. When we arrived at the hotel, Lisa was so warm and inviting. Our room was spacious and spotless. The hotel has a kitchen and dining area that is fully equipped. In addition, during our stay, John became a special friend and met all our needs. The hotel is near many fine restaurants and shopping and is very convenient to train station and bus stops. We highly recommend staying here.

title: Very accommodating and professional service, definitely recommend this B & B
text: Used this B & B for one of our employees for approximately 7 months who was working in the area, the feedback from our employee was that the B & B was very comfortable and staff extremely helpful, no complaints whatsoever. Room very comfortable and clean and easy access to central London.

title: Gentle
text: Nice, welcoming and gentle. Nice staff. Fine room, super service. Placed really good for central London visit. The overground services works out perfekt for London Victoria I'll be back - for sure. Lars Kjeldsen DK

title: Lovely B&B
text: My parents have just stayed here for 3 nights as we're having work done at our house. It's a perfect home from home, very clean, warm and with friendly staff. They stayed in room 4 which has a seating area which apparently made all the difference! I think this will now be their bedroom of choice when visiting us in London.

title: Fabulous 6 days
text: My husband and I stayed 6 days and nights here while visiting London. The owner and his son were most welcoming and made our stay wonderful. The room was very comfortable, the breakfast though simple, was delicious and the perfect start to our day. The breakfast cooks and servers were very friendly and accommodating. It was also located near our daughter's home and very convenient to bus routes all over the City. Other amenities included free wifi and tv. Both my husband and I have decided that the next time we come to London and need a place to stay near our daughter and her family's home, the Lavender Guest House is definitely where we will stay!

title: Like A Home From Home
text: From the moment we arrived at the Guesthouse, me and my Mother had fallen in love with the place. The welcome we received from Tony was so incredibly warm. Indeed, the reception from him over the entireity of our 3 night stay was fantastic. He chatted to us about what we were up to while we were down, spoke in such a friendly manner and made us both feel so at home. Likewise his sister who does the cleaning, she was equally as welcoming. The food was enjoyable. The room we had was stunning - truly worth the money (which, for inner London, is very good value!). Nice and spacious, and the en-suite bathroom was exquisite! And for inner London, the parking on the street is ample too! Would highly recommend the Lavender Guest House to ANYONE looking to stay in London! Cannot speak highly enough of it

title: Comfortable and warm
text: Really sweet hosts, thw ownder was very attentive at all times. Adorably cute environment, comfortable and clean rooms, and really well located. Includes good breakfast and wifi. Great value! Didnt expect it was going to be so good! Strongly recommend it and would easily return.

title: Very Good!
text: I stayed for 2 nights and I felt like I was at home. With a little kitchen for commom use in the garden, I could take some meals very comfortable, and breakfast was very good too. The owners were very nice, always ready for a chat. I'll be back.

title: 1st night experience in a London B&B
text: It was close to a 20 hours flight before we arrive at this B&B. Our arrival was greeted by Tony who was very helpful and accomodating. We soon settled in with his help and started exploring the surroundings that afternoon itself. Morning breakfast was simple but nice with friendly service. Great location and if we are visiting London again we will be staying over at this place.

title: Perfect
text: John is very attentive and helpful, as were the other members of the staff. This is a gem of a place to stay, clean, central with a garden and garden room you can use. Which is lovely to relax in. I would recommend Lavender Guest House to all my family and friends.

title: Excellent service, quality and location - Perfect for families
text: This was my second stay at the Lavender Guest House and I will most definitely return again in the future. I was there with with my mother and two daughters age 3 and 13. The service and attention to detail provided by our host John was second to none. The staff went out of their way to ensure that our room met the needs of our family - even providing Winnie the Pooh bedding for our daughter. The guest house and our room (Number 5) was impeccably clean and perfect for the needs of our family. This bathroom in this room only has a shower but there is a common bathroom available that has a tub should you need to bathe your children. The conservatory gardens were beautiful and a wonderful place for our children to run and play. We used the communal kitchen area for our dinners. This added to the homey feel of this guest house. The location of the Lavender Guest House is wonderful. There is a 24 hour Asda (Walmart Super Center) about 5 minutes away and the Clapham Junction train station is less than a 10 minute walk. This train station is one stop from the Gatwick airport and can take you to the main train stations of London very quickly. All of us loved our time at the Lavender Guest House and agree that this is the only place that we wish to stay at when we return to London.

title: Clean, tidy, very good basic accomodation and breakfast.
text: Excellent for the price, easy access to central London, short walk to under ground, lots of shops near by. Sink is in one wardrobe, toilet in the other (their cheapest room) so not suitable for anyone of big build or likes considerable privacy. But for us, it was just a girly weekend and out most of the time, so perfectly adequate. Bed comfy. Breakfast was also nicely done considering the cost of the rooms. They get booked up quickly and a long way in advance.....speaks for itself!.

title: Super clean and friendly host! Definitely will be back!
text: The place is really nice and clean. The host is friendly and made himself available for the whole stay. I recommend it to anyone who is looking for a cozy and lovely place where to stay. My family was very impressed by how the room was neat and tidy.

title: Lovely Guest House
text: Stayed at the Lavender Guest House for three nights in October as needed to be in Battersea area. We had read the reviews and were not disappointed. The owner is very attentive and could not be more helpful. We had a lovely en suite room that was clean, warm and comfortable and very relaxing in the evening and we had a lovely breakfast each morning. Good value, would definitely recommend and will use this guest house again when in the area. Could not fault it at all.

title: A Comfortable Shelter in the Middle of a Vibrant City
text: Like a comfortable shelter near the opportunity-rich and fast-paced heart of London, easily reachable thanks to the efficient train station in Clapham Junction, the Lavender Guest House has all the requisites to become the perfect accommodation for a lovely short holiday. The rooms are clean and bright, and their being a bit tiny increases the sense of coziness you can feel in this Bed&Breakfast, where everything is done with care from the arrival to the departure. Even if sometimes the service may result sightly intrusive and too friendly, it is polite and dedicated. In a nutshell, it is a very nice and recommended place where to stay and enjoy the vibrant city of London without being exactly in the center of its lively whirlpool of possibilities.

title: Location best feature
text: Well located with underground 5 min walk away & 1o mins to London Central. If you can put up with stairs & small rooms may suit however Budget Hotel would always be better proposition The staff were pleasant & run by a family over many years. Seemed popular

title: Great value in a nice neighborhood
text: We stayed for 6 nights at the Lavender Guest House. The price was very reasonable, and the walk to Clapham Junction Station is less than 5 minutes. There are many shops and restaurants within walking distance. There's a nice little enclosed patio/sunroom area where you can eat any take-away food you bring back. Dishes are provided for you. The owner, John, is very friendly. I was sick one day during our stay and had to stay back in the room. John brought me Ferraro Rocher candies and chocolate pudding in an effort to cheer me up. The breakfast is pretty mediocre, but we were able to overlook that, considering that the place was very clean and reasonably priced, and the staff was nice.

title: Comfortable and value for money
text: We stayed at Lavender Guest House while visiting London for family vacation. Room was comfortable, warm and very clean. Breakfast provided in a very cosy breakfast room was very tasty and healthy. Hotel is located less than 10 minutes walk from train station Clapham Junction. There are several restaurants and supermarket Asda in the nearby area. John, Alice and Nick are very friendly, gave us lots of information and we will remember their hospitality. George & Maria

title: Sparkling clean, well located, very small: good value for money!
text: My sister and I stayed in Room 3 for five nights: + good prices for London! ++ well located, 10min to Clapham Junction with trains into town every 4 min ++ quiet residential street, calm house (despite 8 guestrooms!) +++++ Amazingly clean with fresh towels every day and made up beds when you come back- fantastic!!! ++ ensuit bathroom is extremely well used space, but fantastic! Shower was the best!!! + Conservatory/Lounge in the garden is equipped with microwave and basics, a big "Asda" across the road. You can buy a good range of food there and have a cheap meal "at home" - double check the booking: our`s was forgotten...luckily the room was not taken, so we did not have trouble. Its a pity, you cannot contact them via mail. - cash payment only (even if told otherwise on the phone). So be prepared! -- tiny room (3). Only space to relax is lying on the bed. --- Sleeping quality was not the best as the bed was a little to small for 2: one has to sleep right next to the window, "underneath" the window curtain with a matrass slightly sloping down. Might be good for couples (only)... Also, there was only ONE blanket for both (wool and scratchy, with a linen sheet). No duvet, no nice bedcover stuff at all. - Very basic breakfast: you have to choose between scambled egg on toast OR beans on toast. ??? We didn`t understand ...and shared both. Packed up marmelade

title: Family Visit
text: TI stayed there for 5 nights. My stay was very pleasant in this very clean and well resourced small hotel. I had a good breakfast and comfortable sleep. It has a family feel and the owner goes out of his way to make sure you have everything you need. It is 'on the doorstep' for excellent travel links on both sides of London. I have already recommended it to friends who visit London and will stay there again.

title: Had a good time
text: We had a really nice trip, staying at The Lavender Guest House. The room and the hotel was perfectly clean and the decoration was lovely. The location is okay, not so far away from the city, deserved by bus and train (more expensive but only 5 minutes from Victoria and Waterloo station). A room equipped with a microwave, fridge is able for customers to eat. Supermarket can be found around the Hotel. The manager was really welcoming and accommodating, he allowed us to leave our luggages on the last day until 9pm and to eat in the room. The breakfast wasn't so generous though. It was a little expensive but this is London !

title: exellent
text: The hotel is exellent! I'm Japanese and the trip was alone,so I was unsasy. But the hotel's orner and staff were very kind, so my trip was so satisfying trip. Breakfast was nice, location was convenience and room was clean!! I'd love to stay there when I go to London!!

title: Hospitality Plus
text: Many Swedish friends ask us if we can recommend a place to stay in London. Now we have a ready made answer. The Lavender Guest House has good rooms, well equipped and it has that extra factor: personal service. The Manager, Tony Houss, puts Hospitality back into 'Hospitality Industry'. The perfect host. We would have found it useful to be able to pay by debit/credit card. That's the nearest I can come to anything even a little bit negative. Peter Fluck, Uppsala, Sweden Believe all these 5* comments! You will add your own later!

title: Gem of a guest house in london
text: My son & I stayed 3 nights for a mini break . The location is ideal for travelling by public transport being only 5 mins walk from Clapham Jct station. The host was very welcoming at our arrival. The rooms are clean & modern with double glazing, plus the advantage of a guest lounge which overlooks the garden. This is the best 3* B&B i have stayed in London & better than some Larger group hotels that I've visited. The only thing that I would improve is the variety of breakfast items offered. Otherwise a homely base for a visit to London. Definitly would stay again.

title: south london quality
text: without doubt it is the best hotel in south london. Small en suites are easily forgotten whilst eating the magnificent cooked breakfast in true British style. The rooms are extremely clean and the staff are more helpful than anywhere else in London. It is also most convenient for access to just about anywhere in London. Need to book well in advance as the very reasonable rate keeps them pretty busy.

title: Lovely time
text: The location was very convenient to all modes of public transportation, shopping and all manner of restaurants. Our rooms were spacious, exceptionally clean with comfortable beds. They were welcoming and helpful and provided an excellent service.

title: Perfect getaway in London
text: The Lavender Guest House was such a brilliant opportunity for me to stay in. John and his son Tony called me when I was back in Turkey to confirm booking and give directions of their property. Perfectly situated at the heart of London Borough of Battersea and close to the busiest train station of London, Clapham Junction. You can travel almost every in the UK from Clapham Jnc. This place is a family run business and the owners make sure you feel like you are home and safe. The rooms are always clean and equipped with what you would need during your stay. Although I travel to London 4-5 times a year, I never knew Battersea Rise is such a vibrant but local place. John and his son Tony let me leave my luggage at their place until I took the train to Gatwick Airport. Their lovely garden and conservatory is a great escape from the hustle and bustle of the city. If you do not want to waste your money eating outside, buy your own things and eat in the conservatory. I will definitely stay there next time I'm in London. Ms Turkey (Deniz)

title: Excellent.
text: Recently stayed here whilst exhibiting at Chelsea Flower Show - clean, comfortable, superb service, welcoming, quiet and value for money. Basically a very pleasant stay, will be looking to book for 2014.

title: Great Little Oasis in Clapham
text: We have just spent 3 nights at this lovely guesthouse in Clapham. It is clean, comfortable, good value for money. They have a lovely conservatory looking onto a private garden, staff are extremely helpful and nothing is too much trouble. I would highly recommend.

title: Short stay
text: John the manager was lovely, made us feel like an old friend visiting. Even posted my phone charger back when I forgot it :). Would definitely stay there again and thoroughly recommend. Room was clean and comfortable, great value :)

title: Perfect for our purposes
text: We felt very lucky to have found the Lavender Guest House. It was welcoming, clean, comfortable, quiet and perfectly located. The breakfast was adequate. We needed a base from which to do some sight-seeing and for visiting friends, and this suited our purpose perfectly. Close to the rail station and with several bus routes within minutes we couldn't go wrong. An assortment of good restaurtants and pubs nearby to suit all tastes. We will return, and would very much recommend it.

title: Great hospitality
text: At the frigid cusp of March / April 2013 I had the good fortune to be able to stay at the Lavender Guest House. The management and staff proved to be lovely, personable people, who were / are totally dedicated to the satisfaction and well-being of their guests. The room and bathroom were impeccable, comfortable and intelligently arranged, the tasty breakfast geared to the health of the partakers. For my purposes the location was ideal, and the immediate surroundings have a charm of their own. There is no doubt that if visit London again I will try to make reservations at the Lavender.

title: Good location, comfortable and value for money
text: Accommodation is basic but very clean and comfortable. Would recommend getting room with en-suite. Staff extremely friendly and helpful. Ten minutes walk to Clapham junction station and 5 mins walk to lots of local ameneties. Good nightlife in the area but you wouldn't notice it from the quiet street it is on. Would use again!

title: 5th visit - it must be good!
text: This is by far the best value for money if you are visiting London. The cleanliness is amazing - five visits and never found a speck of dust! This time I stayed in a little gem of a room with very cleverly designed cupboards giving all the essentials! Everything is done to help guests enjoy their stay and providing an area where you can enjoy your own drinks and food in such pleasant surroundings is a masterstroke. I will continue to stay here on frequent trips to London as both its proximity to Clapham Junction Station accessing the whole of London is a five minute work. Also parking is available by permit at £7 a day. Lots of good restuarants and bars especially along the Northcote Road and in a safe area. Really hard to find any fault here.

title: Lovely guest house and great location
text: We stayed at the Lavender Guest House for 8 days while visiting London. The guest house is located in a charming and safe neighbourhood a short distance from Clapham Junction train station -- 2 train stops from Waterloo and 3 to Victora Station. Very convenient to travelling in suburban south London and countryside, too. We stayed in 3 rooms 1, 2 and 4 and they were all immaculate. Room 4 was the best, and was a lovely, large, newly renovated suite with beautiful high ceilings and large windows overlooking the street and garden. If you can, stay in Room 4. The others were adequate, clean, and very quiet. The included breakfast was simple, but tasty. The conservatory was a nice touch, and you could eat your own meals here, if necessary.

title: Great place for London sightseeing
text: A large house converted into a small, cameral hotel with patio in the garden behinde the hotel. In the patio there are dishes, cuttlery, microwave and frige available for guests (we didn't use them because we were in the hotel only for the nights, all days spending sightseeing). Location: not far from city centre and well-communicated with bus stop just around the corner and Clapham Junction for train travels to Victoria Station from where tube is available. Travel by bus to Vaxhaull Station (tube) or Clapham North takes 10 and 15 mins respectively. Absolutly lovely old-english-style neighbourhood with many, many pubs, bars and restaurants to choose from, or just to have a long walk. ASDA 2 mins walk from the hotel. Rooms: very clean and pleasant. Not to small, but not to big as well. For me perfect size for couple spending time sightseeing rather than couch-potating. (We have had a room no. 5 with private shower in the corridor. Shower was as clean as room itself. There was a toilet and sink in the room. Service: very hospitable owner-manager sometimes overwhelming with his concern for guests. Breakfasts: choice of 4 a'la carte english-continental dishes, coffee, butter and jam. Not as big as I expected, but quite reasonable and tasty. For the price payed for four nights I could not dream of anything better especially so close to city centre, and if I come to visit London again I will choose the same place.

title: Perfect guest house
text: The lavender guest house was verry welcoming, clean, warm & frendly, a great nights sleep. Perfect host & a lovley breakfast service. Good prices, Would recommend to family and friends & would deffently stay agian.

title: Excellent short stay
text: Very friendly, spotlessly clean, convenient location. A really good find for us as this was perfectly placed for visiting family. John and his son, Tony are also lovely hosts. We had room 1, which didn't have a full ensuite but had its own separate shower upstairs and a spotlessly clean loo tucked in a cupboard in the room. It was fine for us, for one night and good value, but this particular bathroom arrangement might not suit everyone for a longer stay, and I think most other rooms had a full ensuite. We would definitely recommend this B and B and will try to stay there again. Lovely hosts, great location...very good.

title: Good food ,good value
text: Stayed there twice now. Very clean and warm during recent cold spell.Good choice of healthy food for breakfast.If you are visiting London it makes an ideal base it being near Clapham Junction,bus routes restaurants,bars etc.John is a very welcoming host and I think he offers excellent value for money

title: Just like home
text: We were very happy with our stay here. The hosts were exceptional and very accommodating. They answered all our questions, called taxis for us and gave us directions for around town. They even accomodated us when we arrived two hours before the check in time. Rooms are very clean and the breakfast was decent. They make you feel like you are at home. And as a first time visitor to London, the area is very convenient. 5 min walk to the train station and about a 5 min ride to to nearest tube station (Waterloo and Victoria). Def recommend.

title: Excellent place!
text: The guest house is located at a lovely little town, and the hosts were amazing. They went out of their way to make sure that our stay was enjoyable and gave excellent service. Clapham Junction also has many nearby restaurants, supermarkets and any stores that you might need. It is also close to the London city centre and is easy to get to. Highly recommended!

title: Warm welcome and pleasant stay
text: I stayed at the Lavender Guest House for a business weekend. I was pleasantly suprised by the level of cleanliness and comfort. The free wifi connection was a fantastic opportunity for me to stay connected.

title: The guest house where a traveller is welcomed and looked after.
text: The Lavender Guest House is always welcoming - arrived late in evening to find Mr Houss waiting for us. Our room, shower rooms etc all sparkling and great service from the staff - we had friends visit from Southampton and Mr Houss was able to provide a day parking permit for them - so much appreciated. Breakfast awaits each day and all questions answered too! We will be returning.

title: Good value and warm welcome
text: Finding affordable accommodation in London is more difficult than finding a needle in a haystack. When it is not only affordable (dearer than national prices but cheap for inner London), but clean, quiet, comfortable

title: Excellent
text: Our engineers have stayed in the hotel several times and don't have s bad word to say about them Definitely recommended. Clean hotel and excellent breakfast. The owner was very nice and helpful with bookings and information

title: A wonderful stay for an italian family.
text: We stayed at this hotel from August 6th to 11th. We have been pleasantly surprised by the warm and loving welcome of the Owner. The room was bright, spacious, comfortable and extremely clean. The Owner showed himself to be always available for any request, proving to be a gentleman of another era. The breakfast is typically British, but it is freshly prepared and served with great care and kindness. Excellent value for money for a city like London. A structure and wonderful people where we will definitely return.

title: Very friendly, very clean, we will be back!!
text: We arrived at the Lavender Guest House and were greeted by the very friendly and engaging manager John. We stayed in Room 8 which is on the top floor and had it's own ensuite shower and toilet. The room and facilities were very clean and serviceable and the staff were all lovely and very helpful. The location was ideal

title: Greek hospitality
text: Good facilities, clean room and fine assistance in a nice neighbourhood. Easy to reach via both tube and bus (87). Friendly people who were helpful to us. I slept well and enjoyed the stay. Good value for money.

title: A TERRIFIC STAY AND A GREAT HOST!
text: My husband and I have found The Lavender Guest House on Google map as we are looking for a B&B that is near the train station/subway for convenience for a 3 night stay. John and Tony Hooss have been great hosts to us during our stay. The rooms are clean, warm and comfortable and the home-made breakfast is terrific too! John (the owner of the house) have also been prompt to our requests. They even went to extra miles to help us get to know London better. Highly recommended for travellers who are seeking for a reasonably-priced accommodation and convenient location in London. Thank you John and Tony! Preston and Denise Singapore

title: Excellent value
text: My husband and I stayed for three nights in November and after reading the reviews on this site had high expectations. We were not disappointed. We had room 5 which has a toilet and basin but separate shower. The room was spotlessly clean and an adequate size.. The shower was up a few stairs but we had sole use so was not a problem. The breakfast was a bit limited but acceptable - would be much improved with better quality bread. The best feature was the location - just a few minutes walk from Clapham Junction station and many bus routes and yet the guest house is in a quiet residential street which felt safe at night. Overall we thought we had great value for money and will certainly stay again.

title: Enjoyable quick trip
text: I stayed for just a quick trip at the end of March. My room was compact and lovely and clean with a nice en-suite, and the owner Mr Houss was a very hospitable and entertaining character! I had a very enjoyable stay, and my parents who have stayed here before also rate the Lavender Guest House very highly. The rates were very reasonable for this area of the city and I will certainly use it again for any other trips to London in the future. Sarah.

title: Amazing hospitality, friendly and great price!!
text: My partner and myself stayed here for 2 nights, the moment we walked in it was like we were at home, John was there to greet us, he showed us around, asked how we were and was just generally interested. He helped us find our way around, the breakfast was lovely and adequate. We could not have asked for a better place to stay, we didn't want to come home. The rooms were very clean and I must say unique!! Overall I would give 10 out of 10 across the board. We will certainly be booking again!! Also close to shops, stations and bars! Thank you John for a lovely weekend!

title: Absolutely superb!
text: I'm normally a sceptic when it comes to staying out as I spot all the flaws. But might I say

title: Long term stay
text: I've been staying here during the week for nearly two years now. The Lavender Guest House is spotlessly clean, decorated to a high standard and is warm and cosy. The staff are extremely helpful. I would recommend this establishment without hesitation.

title: Absolutely Lovely
text: I spent a week at the Lavender Guest House and it was truly a home away from home. I cannot begin to say enough about the Houss family. They are very friendly, warm and caring. They take great pride in customer service and are even more proud of their Guest House. It is very clean and comfortable. The conservatory overlooking the gardens is a great place to enjoy a glass of wine... just sit back relax and enjoy the peacefulness. Every morning, I had a lovely hot breakfast. By the end of the week, I felt like part of the family and I hated to leave. Thank you for taking such good care of me. And Alice, I will make it to Portugal... I promise! Connie V.

title: Lovely
text: Lovely clean B& Breakfast in central London. Tony Houss (the Manager) was wonderful right from when I had problems making the booking and during my stay. He was alway smiling, friendly and willing to help with any problem or request. His staff are lovely and I would definitely stay again

title: Kris N. You won't want to Stay Anywhere Else
text: Our family recently stayed at the Lavender Guest House - We had booked three rooms for the six of us (all adults) for five nights. The location was very convenient to all modes of public transportation, shopping and all manner of restaurants. Our rooms were spacious, exceptionally clean with comfortable beds. We possibly had the best poached eggs ever - than you Beatrice. We certainly made use of the kitchen and garden area. Tony, John and his wife Alice were charming, helpful and very informative and great fun to talk to - their hospitalilty is outstanding. On our next trip to London we would not stay anywhere else but The Lavender Guest House and highly recommend it to anyone thinking of going to London. Thank you for a wonderful stay,

title: Convenient, friendly and good value.
text: They were accommodating and helpful when I booked. The owner has a very nice manner about him when we arrived and really helped us feel at home. the staff at breakfast were friendly and then the owner (john?) was kind enough to give me some cuttings of a plant i admired in the conservatory. We walked there easily from Clapham junction station and then were close enough to Clapham Common to have a walk there on sunday morning. The only gripe was that the shower and the toilet were a bit small.

title: Great Stay
text: We were down in London to visit our son. We stayed over the weekend. Tony could not have been more friendly or helpful, falling over himself to help. The room was excellent, clean and tidy with ample space. The breakfast was excellent, keeping the coffee topped up and the toast. I would not hesitate to go back.

title: "A Gem of a Place to Stay"
text: We recently stayed 3 nights in the Lavender Guest House which was spotless, cosy and comfortable. The breakfast room and food was immaculate and the staff were very hard working ensuring our stay was first class. The garden area and conservatory were absolutely delightful facilities to come back to after a tiring day. It is very convenient for access to main tourist sights. Trains, buses, shops and restaurants within a few minutes walk. Thank you to Toni for his caring and very helpful attitude and to Sonia for her pleasant, friendly and extremely efficient service. We are already booked to return.

title: A place worth staying
text: I stayed at the Lavender Guesthouse in Battersea for 3 nights in late August this year and I can highly recommend it as a very welcoming, clean and quiet place to stay. Most of the rooms have been renovated and have a brand new bathroom (including toilet). The Guest house is a stone's throw from Clapham junction where you have a great choice of shops and supermarkets as well as a good number of busses and trains going to the center of London. If you arrive from Gatwick airport it's only 30 min by train from Clapham junction. Tony and his are amazing hosts and very helpful with any concern. I will book this Guest House again for sure, when I'm back in London.

title: Home from home
text: I regularly stay at The Lavender Guest House when I am in London on my breaks from working as a live-in carer. The rooms are always clean and comfortable and the crisp cotton sheets a delight to sleep in! The family

title: Really clean, perfect area, lovely staff and great value
text: We stayed 3 nights, 2 room #5 , 1 room #1, really clean spotless! , nice rooms, bathrooms are clean, lovely staff and really helpful, well located as well, 5 minutes walk to clapham junction train station, a lot of shops around, also massive asda 24h, you can use the garden and facilities which help a lot. Thanks to john and his staff for being really nice and helpfull, place recomended for a couple or a familly.

title: Unbelievable value, and the friendliest staff
text: First time staying at Lavender, and I'll definitely be back. Start off with the knowledge you're paying £55 for a room in central London. That's cheaper than a travelodge, and this is cleaner, vastly friendlier, you get breakfast and you're a stone's throw from Clapham Junc. The breakfast is continental / scrambled eggs on toast etc. It's not a full fry up, but remember what you're paying.. A room with breakfast in London for under £60, you literally cannot go wrong. It's on a quiet residential street, and has double glazing so there's very little traffic noise overnight. Rooms have a kettle, tea & coffee, TV with freeview. Free wifi. The best thing by far was Tony the manager. Could not have gone further out of his way to make me feel at home. I had to stick around until about 1pm on day of check out - not a problem. There's a garden room, which I just sat in and was offered tea & coffee whilst I waited. Fantastic. Imagine that in a travelodge/easyhotel, I'd just be out on my ear without so much as a thank you. Decor: simple, clean, cream walls. Good, clean, new showers. No, it's not a boutique hotel with natty upholstered chairs & antlers on the walls - you're probably not going to stay here on your honeymoon night, but I don't think you can do any better for this price. Great, friendly, clean, quiet, free wifi, in-room tea & coffee, breakfast. Get involved. I'll definitely be staying again. Thanks Tony & staff.

title: Home from Home
text: I last stayed in the Lavender about a year ago, and going back felt like going home. It's clean, safe, comfy, close to Clapham Junction, close to bars and restaurants - basically perfect. John and his son are lovely hosts, and they accommodated everything my husband and I needed, then looked after me for the few days I stayed alone. I wouldn't stay anywhere else in London

title: Very convenient and great value
text: Lavender B&B is within the two zone transport area. Buses are at end of street and rail station 5 minute walk. We purchased a 7 day unlimited travel pass before leaving Sydney and this worked out very well as we initially stayed for 7 nights. The B&B is clean and the breakfast sets you up for the day. Wi-fi is available but not in every room but work is on the way to resolve this. Staff very obliging and allowed us a one night reservation on our return to London enroute to Brussels. We hope to return one day.

title: Luxury accommodation, lovely team!
text: We had a fantastic stay at 9 Hertford Street. It is a fabulous base for exploring local art galleries, shops, parks and theatres. The accommodation is very luxurious and the balcony was a fab bonus, especially as the weather was excellent for February!

title: A Second Home In London
text: My wife and I would like to extend our Thanks and appreciation to the Managers (Aude and Vladimir) and all the staff for the most professional hospitality we found during our stay in this service apartments. They made our stay so pleasant and smooth and made us only concentrating on my medical treatment,we felt really at home. We shall never think about staying at any other place when we are in London. Wishing you all the best and prosper.

title: Great for business or leisure!
text: Ideal location for the tube and buses at Green Park, and handy for a walk in the Park or for heading off to tour around the West End. The friendly team are welcoming and most helpful. On each stay, the apartments have been spotless, the beds comfortable and kitchens well-equipped - just the ticket for independent travellers who don't need 'hotel' services. A great place for visitors on business or for leisure !

title: Fantastic
text: Just stayed for one night. Booked through Booking.com and chose because it was close to the where my evening event was on park lane. Booking in was seamless and was even shown to my room by the lovely receptionist and told where everything was. Room / apartment was fantastic and was great in every regard. Had a massive bed, firm mattress, lots of storage and huge bedroom, the apartment comes with the bedroom, bathroom, dining area, kitchen, and huge living room. All in was great and I will definitely return in the future.

title: 9 Hartford Street - a soothing home in the heart of Mayfair
text: Back at 9 Hartford street, it was such a pleasure to be back in these familiar grounds once again, my third time here and I love it! As soon as you get in, a warm welcome and a feeling of calm and warmth is the first thing that grabs you. Huge flat, splotless, comfy bed and the staff could not be more helpful and efficient. Location is perfect, could go aywhere I wanted on foot and Hyde Park 2mns away is an amazing "garden" to have so nearby. Highly recommended.

title: Great Location and spacious
text: We stayed for almost a week in this property. The location is absolutely central and unbeatable. It was one of the longest we had stayed in a property. There were few areas which can be improved. The apartment air-condition was not working. We were told that it was getting repaired and could take many days. So in short it did not have one and the chance of it working in coming days seems difficult. We were given a portable air-condition which did the trick and worked well. The housekeeping in the apartment is good but not available for Saturday's and Sunday's. The towels are changed twice weekly. Both of this information we were not aware of while booking. There is also a slight dated look of closets and bathroom in the apartment but blends with the otherwise stylish interiors. The size of the apartment is massive with comfortable and tastefully done interiors in both living room and bedroom. The kitchen is adequate and well equipped. The ease of stay here was better than our previous london apartment stays. Very close to shepherd market with it's pubs and eateries and walking distance to most attractions. The key set gave easy access to the building and apartment. The response by reception incharge was quick and very helpful. Will surely stay here again.

title: Incredible place, incredible people. One of the best locations in London.
text: We have now stayed on two occasions for business and both times the experience has been exceptional. Mayfair truly is one of the best areas in London. 9 Hertford Street Private Residences and serviced apartments are right in the heart of Mayfair. The apartments and facilities are exceptional and the staff are very helpful and friendly. It really does feel like a home away from home and considering the location, the rates are very reasonable. I would choose 9 Hertford Street over any of the famous and overpriced hotels that are 5 mins walk from here.

title: So comfortable!
text: You don't expect to feel so at home in a hotel, but this is no ordinary hotel. We were really spoilt with a huge bed, great kitchen and a fabulously comfortable couch which was perfect after a long day pounding the pavement sightseeing. The apartments are so spacious, stylish and well appointed, the staff are wonderfully friendly, and the location is truly superb. It's an excellent base for exploring the West End, and a truly wonderful, super stylish home away from home. I can't wait to go back.

title: Week end break
text: Being a Cafe owner, we do not get much time for a break. Having booked for a much needed weekend break, we could not have been much happier. 9 Hertford was everything you would need for your break. The apartment served for all your needs. The staff are incredible and well versed, our lounge area was so comfortable and felt like home. We had the most amazing sleep, one could ever have. We felt so relaxed. The walk into oxford street takes in all thats wonderful of london. So close to all amenities, cafe's, bars and restaurants. We look forward to our next visit....

title: Spacious apartment.
text: The apartment was roomy with a separate, living, dining and kitchen area. The reception was hospitable and friendly. It is located in a quiet residential area, walking distance from the Shepherd Market and not far from Green Park Station. The furniture / carpet, seems a bit old although they are clean.

title: Great place to stay in Mayfair
text: Wonderful large rooms. Two options for coffee, Nespresso and plunger with Lavazza coffee- needed to buy more milk. Heated towel rails. Washer/dryer. Big rooms and comfortable chairs. Desk for work and WIFI. Blankets rather than duvet on bed make it easier to not be too hot. Nice shampoo. Parking space! this was perfect when friends joined us for dinner at a restaurant nearby. The staff person on the desk that evening couldn't have been more helpful to take the time to show our friend how to get to the garage. Great blackout curtains. The shower could have had more pressure and the bed was super hard. No AC for the summer months. The central heat didn't seem to work but there were space heaters that made the rooms cozy. Sadly allergies make it imperative that I have AC in the spring summer months to filter the pollen out. I would stay here always if these were fixed.

title: Great apartment! Whichever the reason of your trip to London, this is a perfect place to stay!
text: The apartment was spacious and very well equipped. It was perfect for relaxing during the evening, after a busy day in Central London. Great internet connection that allowed me to finish up some business, check up my email etc..in a dedicated desk that is part of a spacious living-room. In fact, all the other rooms (bathroom, kitchen, bedroom) were also spacious and very well equipped. One of the great things of this apartment is its location, in the heart of London, a couple of minutes from Green Park, yet away from noise and busy streets, what makes it the perfect location to stay when visiting London!!

title: Excellent stay
text: We stayed in a beautiful apartment on the 4th floor. We were greeted by James who was so helpful and attentive. Our room was ready for check in when we arrived with all the amenities we needed. The apartment was spacious and bright and beautifully decorated. Right in the heart of Mayfair next to Shepherds Market. You could spend the whole weekend there! Great power shower and right next to Green Park tube. I will be sure to come back and recommend as a luxurious home from home!

title: Even better the 2nd time round!
text: Second time we stayed here for a short break. Different apartment this time but just as great! The concierge was very friendly and helpful. The apartment was clean and spacious, with tv in living room as well as bedroom. Free wifi is of course a must these days and is included here with sky tv also. Big comfy bed and lots of storage space for your clothes if staying longer periods plus great selection of toiletries provided on arrival and every flat has hairdryer/iron etc and of course fully functioning kitchen with all the necessities to cook up a storm if you decide not to visit one of the many restaurants in close proximity.. Great central location in the historic Mayfair original market and so close to all the excellent museums, shopping areas, restaurants, bars and clubs in the area. Even though its centrally located its very quiet at night. This place has a lot of repeat customers and high quality clientele and i can understand why.. great service, great location and great flats.. what's not to like! I would definitely recommend as a great place for a short break or for repeat longer stays in London..

title: Superb!
text: This place was recommended by a colleague and they were spot on. The apartment was clean & spacious - perfect for relaxing after a busy day. On site Parking was an added bonus. I will definitely be back!

title: Great location, great team and so comfy apartments
text: We stayed there with my wife for a week-end. Our experience was great and I am definitely recommending this place to my friends. Location is spot on, you are close to Green Park station which takes you anywhere you like, you are next to Shepherd's market with great restaurant, atmosphere and pubs, so if you don't want to prepare your own breakkie you get a few options right at your doorstep. The apartment we had was on the first floor and leading to the street - it was not noisy at all - the bed was as big as it can get and very comfortable. I've stayed in services appartment for business many times, but these are different, they are big and the service is superbly executed by the friendly team at the reception. We only stayed for a week-end but really felt on holidays for a long time. Thank you!

title: Have stayed and always will stay here
text: Spent 8 nights here in this perfectly located Mayfair gem. Staff is super nice, and accommodations are very comfortable. Convenient to the bus, tube, or just walk where you want. Can't wait to return.

title: Excellent accommodation and service
text: I couldn't recommend this place enough! I booked a week end away from home for our wedding anniversary. The suite was very spacious, quiet, and the manager had left a card and small present to congratulate us. The bedroom was huge with a massive and super comfy bed...the living room was classy and enormous. There were two big tvs- one in the living room and one in the bedroom- the kitchen is well equipped and there is a lot of storage. But the best part is the service- the General Manager- whose name is Aude- was exceptionally helpful giving us plenty of tips for places to eat, visit, travel tips and was generally very smiley and welcoming. This is far better than any 5 star hotel- much more intimate. The staff really make you feel special and relaxed. We felt rejuvenated when we left and headed for a delicious breakfast only a stone's throw away in Shepherds market and then walked through Hyde Park to Selfridges...

title: Great location right in the heart of Mayfair
text: Location can't be beat. Nice apartments and helpful staff. Close to everything I needed to be close to. Was recommended by a U.K. based business associate and he was spot in. 1st stay here, won't be my last.

title: What a pleasure and in the heart of town !!
text: At 9 Hertford street you feel literally at home, with the added benefit of good and considerate service. The team are all lovely, and so helpful. We enjoyed our stay so much that we intend to be regulars

title: Very Nice Apt, Friendly Staff
text: We needed just one night for an early embassy appointment but I could have happily stayed longer as a self-catering base for touring London. Our apartment was very clean and nicely furnished. The kitchen had been updated and, though parts of our apartment felt a bit dated, the place had a very nice, upscale feel to it. For my needs, I was very appreciative to have use of the garage the entire day we checked out.

title: Comfort in a wonderful location.......
text: Girls weekend away, we chose an apartment over a hotel so we could spend more time together and these apartments were perfect. Well equipped kitchen, nice lounge area and a furnished balcony. Friendly staff and check in and out was slick. Location is brilliant in the heart of Mayfair and Shepherds Market area is great for a wander around, drinks and a bite to eat. Would definitely return.

title: Beautiful flat, fantastic location, very attentive staff
text: We stayed at 9 Hertford street over the Easter weekend and could not have hoped for a better place to be with our two-year old son. Not only was his cot ready when we arrived but we were greated with chocolates, fresh fruits and a lovely card written by the Manager. The flat was very spacious and bright, with a terrasse. We all felt at home straight away. The concierges were very helful and friendly. I was even provided with a laptop for an hour in order to catch up with some work! The building is elegant and located within minutes of Hide park, Green Park and Sheperd Market which makes it the perfect choice for a family break. Highly recommanded.

title: Fabulous
text: We booked for a couple of nights, but could have stayed a month. Large, well designed apartments in the heart of Mayfair, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of Piccadilly. Lovely cafes and bars to explore nearby. A real gem, if you want to get away from the hotel chains.

title: The Best.
text: We stayed 10 days at this home away from home. The location is ideal

title: Perfect in everyway, friendly, great location, everything you need
text: We stayed in the lovely 9 Hertford street with our family, two young girls. They loved it almost as much as we did. Such a great location, very friendly and knowledgeable staff and the flat has everything you could need in it. From the moment we arrived we were greeted in a friendly and personal way, shown to our apartment and all the kids many questions were answered with knowledge and humour! The flat has all the little bits and pieces one could ever need as well as a huge sky TV and very comfortable furnishings stylishly presented. The location is A1 and the staff's local suggestions helped this even further. It could not have been better, rooms are quiet, big and warm too, a truly relaxing city break was had by all.

title: Great location and amenities
text: We stayed in a one-bedroom apartment at 9 Hertford for 5 nights

title: Wonderful Wedding Haven! Perfection!!
text: I stayed at 9 Hertford Street the night before and for two nights after our wedding, and what a wonderful choice we made! Our apartment provided a spectacular haven for me as the bride to get ready in. Even with my mum, bridesmaids, hair, make up and our two photographers, the apartment felt opulent, warm and spacious. It was the perfect place to get ready in. Returning on our wedding night to the apartment was also a dream. The bedroom was stunning and unlike in a hotel room we were also able to relax in the living room and remember special moments the following day! For a wedding, I couldn't recommend this property strongly enough!!

title: Wonderful, like home with 4 star service.
text: Have been remiss as have meant to leave a review of this wonderful venue. Have stayed at these excellent apartments three times and each visit was wonderful. The apartments are spacious, clean, elegant and very well equipped. The staff is first rate and truly function as very capable concierge assistants, as one would expect at a prime hotel. The location Mayfair is very convenient and also very quiet as the street is centrally located but without bothersome or noisy traffic. Cannot find any fault and we have now made 9 Hertford St our go to place for lodging whilst in London. Highly recommended!

title: Perfect location
text: Our family of three (with a college age daughter) stayed at two different apartments over 9 days at 9 Hertford St recently. The best thing about the apartments is their location, on a quiet street in Mayfair. Within 5 minutes by foot you are at Hyde Park Corner or on Piccadilly. The little grocery store around the corner run by a nice Indian couple is open everyday from 8 to 11 which provides for your basic needs unless u intend to cook up a storm. The apartment is very spacious and well equipped. We tried both giving our laundry to the shop a few doors down the street (20 pounds for a full load of casual wear, same day return) and using the washing machine provided. Both worked well. Apartment 404 is much nicer than Apartment 302 which has problems with water pressure. Both have a good size balcony but it did not do much for us as it overlooked windows and rooftops plus it rained quite a bit. There were two minor complains that my wife had, one was the fact that the socket in the toilet is located at the roof above the mirror, not an easy reach if you want to charge anything. The other was the fact that although the staffs are very helpful, they are often away from the front desk doing various things for the guests. As a result you may have to play a bit of cat and mouse with them if you need anything. Other than that the place is great value for money, provided gym access, room service and immediate attention are not your top priority. They even offered to lend us a phone during our stay which we did not take up as it was easy to get a prepaid sim card.

title: Wonderful wonderful again.
text: Just wonderful, so nice to come back to 9 Hertford Street again. The staff are so friendly, helpful and welcoming. Rooms are spotless and peaceful. We had drinks on our own balcony then wander out for more drinks and dinner, so great to find so many restaurants a few minutes walk away. Though the hotel feels secretly tucked away in a tranquil spot the tube and London attractions are but a minutes stroll away. Could not have been better.

title: Luxury apartment fantastic location
text: A fantastic place to stay for business or pleasure. Easy to get to theatres and attractions and surrounded by great restaurants. The apartment was beautifully furnished and spacious

title: What a gem!
text: We stayed in a beautiful one bed apartment on the first floor. Elegantly decorated with the most comfortable bed. Fantastic location within walking distance of Green Park and Hyde Park and the market. Quiet at night but bustling in the day time. It really felt like home away from home. We got a taste of what living in Mayfair is all about. Lovely unexpected balcony at the back to enjoy in the morning and the kitchen is fully equipped for entertaining. Very comfortable large sofas in the big living room and a table that fits six. Great WiFi and plush towels. Wonderful service: I forgot something in the fridge and came back about 30 minutes after check out asking if I could retrieve it and before I knew it out host had run up and got it himself. Lovely experience, highly recommended!

title: New management doesn't care about guests, noisy, shabby.
text: While the location in Sheperds Market in Mayfair is great and having an apartment is terrific for longer stays, the front facing apartments are incredibly noisy from activity in the street and neighboring bars. There is also construction going on next door for the past two years and renovations in the hotel itself. Apparently you can't regulate the heat in the individual apartments, so to keep the noise out we had to keep the double paned windows shut. This meant the apartment was like a sauna. The staff had the carpets in our apartment cleaned while we were staying there and the smell was horrific. We were forced to move to a lower floor noisier apartment and treated like it was all our fault. Felt shabby.

title: Luxury Flat
text: This was my first trip to London where I stayed for any length of time so I was hoping that I made a good choice in rentals. I couldn't have been happier with 9 Hertford Street. The location is literally steps away from Shepard's Market, the Green Park tube and Buckingham Palace. The Tesco market is around the corner and we bought snacks and breakfast items there. This was so convenient as I was traveling with my son and we both had separate itineraries for our holiday. The flat we rented was on the fourth floor and was a one bedroom. We were upgraded (how great is that?!) to a room with a balcony off of the living area and bedroom. The flat was tastefully decorated with all of the conveniences of home. TV in living room and bedroom, free wifi, full kitchen with dishwasher, clothes washer, stove, and microwave. The apartment was cleaned and replenished every day except Saturday and Sunday. We were provided with robes, slippers, and beauty products. The coffee/tea service was filled each weekday. One evening during our stay, one of the other guests had pushed on the elevator door causing it to only go to the 3rd floor and we were on the fourth. Our host informed us that a service call had been made and the elevator was working again the next morning. I thought this showed attention to detail and was an example of how management was meeting the needs of their guests. The walls must be thick because I never heard any noise from the other flats, not even water running (as you sometimes hear in hotels.) Everything was just wonderful and I'm so glad that I found 9 Hertford Street. I had priced suites in hotels and Hertford Street was comparable so I feel that we got our money's worth in the flat. I can recommend 9 Hertford Street wholeheartedly and would stay there again.

title: Short but sweet
text: Stayed one night for a special anniversary weekend at 9 Hertford Street. Was not disappointed. Beautiful apartment, excellent location and friendly staff. Apartment was very clean, spacious, and best of all very quiet. The bed was huge and extremely comfortable. Great touch with the nespresso machine. Fast WiFi and sky tv. Even had a lift in the block so no problem if you have lots of luggage.. Little balcony in our flat that you could have a nice cup of coffee or even breakfast if the weather is good.. Location is amazing with shepherd market a few minutes away.. Lots of nice cafes and restaurants and some pubs as well.. All in all I would highly recommend, whether a short stay or long one.

title: Perfect
text: We were looking for a stay in London for our family. After talking to a least a dozen of hotels we found 9 Hertford Street. A very spacious, clean and well equiped apartment. This is 10 times more comfortable than any luxury hotel. Location is very central and still very quiet. Hope to come back soon!!!

title: Great location
text: Had a lovely stay with the kids over the Christmas break. Great location and well appointed apartments. The staff were all very helpful and made the stay memorable. Perfect for all that Mayfair and the area has to offer.

title: Nice and Lovely
text: Big and specious flat, lovely and comfortable with all amenities there. Nice and in the middle of all major London attractions and within walking distance from everything, very accessible with a porter service almost all day.

title: Another Great Stay
text: This is my third time at Hertford Street, its such a great place to stay, the apartments are always very clean, have everything you need with great sky package and really good WiFi connection. (Unlike other hotels I've stayed in) The Staff are great and always on hand to help you with any information you need on the local bars and restaurants. I can yet again really recommend 9 Hertford street.

title: Incredible Property, Spectacular Location
text: We stayed at this beautiful property last weekend and had a wonderful time. The property is perfectly decorated, extremely clean, the location is superb and the staff were efficient, friendly and most importantly very helpful. I would highly recommend this service.

title: Home away from home
text: A rather belated review but nonetheless this property never ceases to amaze! My wife and I use this property nearly every year when we visit London. Aude and Vladimir are most welcoming and professional. The central location in the 'hidden secret' that is Shepherd Market, with its village feel is ideal to explore what London has to offer.The apartments themselves are luxurious and provide the freedom that a hotel room can not! Our last stay was in December 2015 and we shall hopefully be back in March 2016...cant wait!

title: Fantastic location, gorgeous property
text: This may ramble a bit, so my apologies in advance. We found the property (3 bedroom) via TripAdvisor Holiday Lettings and booked using that route. This was the only source of any negative experience at all as the broker that represents Unit #3 on Holiday Lettings is completely different than the staff of the property (which is a different management group.) The booking company advertised one rate and then increased it significantly when we went to pay (despite a rather lengthy booking) and was less than easy to extract information from. The information they have posted on the listing isn't entirely complete (what they offer is accurate, but there is more to be said) and concerns were always deferred to the on-site management instead of providing solutions. That said, I would not hesitate to recommend the property - but by all means deal directly with the on-site management (AVA - as found on the property website) and not a third party. Now, on to the details. The property is stunning. The photos are accurate - no photography trickery involved. This much room in Mayfair is nearly unheard of, much less with the outdoor space that would be delightful during more temperate months. Two of the bedrooms have copious storage space while the third bedroom (with walk-in shower) has decent space. The amenities are of the highest caliber, but we were never provided additional hot beverage supplies beyond what was present at check-in. (I attribute this to the third party nature of our booking.) The on-site staff is as good as you'll find anywhere. Not much else can be said. I could write a paragraph full of flowery adjectives but in the end it boils down to excellent guest service. If you're considering a luxury Mayfair hotel the per-night pricing is comparable but the value for money is much greater if you would rather have more space and enjoy more of a home-away-from-home atmosphere. Again, book directly and I suspect you'll not experience the little glitches that we did and have an even better experience.

title: Definitely a "Home away from Home" - simply wonderful.
text: We have been fortunate to stay at 9 Hertford St Mayfair many times and each visit (our last in October 2015) has been a super experience with every comfort and convenience catered for. What makes it such a stand-out is the excellent care from Aude, Vladimir and the team who all go out of their way to ensure their guests are totally content. Each apartment is beautifully furnished and the location of the whole complex is ideal with restaurants, shopping etc all within easy walking distance. 9 Hertford Street is our favourite base whilst in London. Congratulations to all!

title: spacious but not convenient for a business traveller - and very cold! Dated bathroom.
text: Huge, light rooms but very cold - and just one polyester blanket (had to double over the bedspread as no spare bedding). Extra heater in bedroom made it bearable but muggy. Round pin sockets for bedside lights mean it was hard to use laptop in bed. Very noisy old Bush set-top box in the bedroom difficult to use and slow. Could be lovely for a family holiday as a base to explore from, but not convenient to work and sleep in while on business.

title: Perfect, elegant apartment in handy location
text: Beautifully maintained, comfy bed with all the mod cons you could need. Friendly helpful concierge. We also loved the recommend of Matsuri, which although not cheap, was beautiful food. Just a couple of minutes from Green park, we could also walk to the main shopping district easily and enjoyed the park for a morning stroll with a paper.

title: Best place
text: I went to this place several times. It has always been spot on. Great place, great location, great staff, great appartement, large room well equiped. Close to everything you need. You can walk to the center, the parks, restaurants. Will return with no doubt.

title: A delightful oasis in the perfect London location
text: Excellent apartment and perfect unobtrusive service in great spot for both business and leisure in central London. I was only there for one night as it was an overnight business trip and the hotels I usually book were full. I had never considered apartments before. This will be my usual first choice in future and I have also recommended it to my MD and other colleagues. Huge 1 bedroom apartment (402) with everything you might need for one night or significantly longer. If I was a tourist and had booked this apartment for a vacation I would have been equally delighted. The apartment has everything you might need including outside space, rarely found in central London. The pictures on the website do not do it justice - usually it is the other way round. I didn't want to leave.

title: Great service apartments
text: For the last 2 years, me and my boyfriend have been staying in 9 Hertford Street very often. The staff is very professional and friendly. The apartments are very big and clean. Compared to the hotels in central London, prices are lower. Highly recommended!

title: Fabulous apartments and staff
text: We have just returned home following a weekend in London and an overnight stay at 9 Hertford Street. I don't usually post reviews but wanted to write and congratulate them on a lovely group of apartments with a friendly feel. Everything was very clean, high quality and very spacious. The staff we met were very friendly, helpful and professional. I would very much recommend this as a location to stay when in Mayfair/central London. We were a group of 4 families staying in 4 apartments and they answered our every need. There is also a great coffee/breakfast/restaurant just 3 mins walk from the apartment which has wonderful food at great prices (called 'Caffe In').

title: elegant rooms
text: Amazing apartment in a very desirable part of London. The apartment had 1 big bedroom, very comfy twin beds as we had requested, two extra beds in the living room which did not interfere at all with the space in the living area. We had a champagne tea for our family in the afternoon and they happily provided extra champagne glasses and tea cups. Also after waiting a long time for a black cab one evening we asked for a cab number and were able to book taxi in advance to go to various venues and even booked them to do the Heathrow run for around £64 . Lots of toiletries provided, lots of white fluffy towels, plenty toilet rolls, electric heater in wardrobe in case we were chilly - thankfully didn't need it as weather was great. We had a large balcony but there seemed to be some kind of flood going on out there so we didn't use it. We had free good wifi It is literally 5 minutes from Green Park tube station. Buckingham Palace is about 7 or 8 minutes away We stayed 2 nights and I so wished we were able to stay longer Next time. It is certainly a place I will return to

title: Amazing
text: This was our second visit to Hertford street and they are simply the best. Amazing staff, really helpful and kind. Location is very central. They go out their way to make your stay comfortable and a happy one. Love this place

title: Value for Money
text: Everything was perfect. Our two nights in this lovely hotel was wonderful with the city view. The room was so spacious and facilities were very modern. Great location! Very attentive friendly and helpful staffs.

title: GREAT
text: This was the most perfect location for Buckingham Palace, Old English Pubs for lunch, dinner or a pint or two, Hyde Park, Green Park and for getting around london by foot or bus.

title: Smashing
text: Spent 2 nights in a beautiful 1 bedroom apartment. Location is great and the apartment was just refurbished with great style. I had a booking.com deal for a great price and really enjoyed my stay there. I would recommend the place to family travellers. only hiccup was that I was staying on the 4th floor and the elevator did not seem to work, but friendly staff offered to help with the luggage.

title: Excellent apartments and a great location
text: This is our second time staying here and enjoyed every moment the apartments are great the staff are all very friendly and very professional and cannot do enough to help and make us feel welcome. We also take our German shepherd dog who loves his holiday there and the dog is never an issue. We are starting to plan our next visit to here and to London Thanks to all the staff from Brian Ann and Bruno

title: Enjoyable stay
text: Apartments are very clean and location is great, within walking distance to the things that matter. Ample space in the apartments and all the basics are included. Reasonably priced. Will definitely recommend and stay there again on my next visit

title: Wonderful serviced apartment
text: This is a wonderful property in the heart of Mayfair. Central to the parks, the palace, shopping etc. The one bedroom/one bath apartment with living, dining and kitchen we had was just newly renovated so everything was new with every amenity you would want/need. There is a friendly staff available during the day and early evening should you need anything during the stay. First rate service and accommodations. Highly recommend.

title: very good but far from perfect
text: Great location. the reception team friendly and wellconing,good size of the living room, planty of storage space. well equipped kitchen. very comfort bed. our apartment on the first floor facing the street was noisy espcially during the weekend, dont be deceived by the look of the small street -it is a very busy one. bad noise insulation from neighboring appartments. TV in the living room is far too small for a room that large. no TV in bedroom. curtains do not block day light. the small safe can not accommodate even an I PAD

title: Great night stay at 9 Hertford Street!
text: My stay at 9 Hertford street was a very pleasant one, all of the resources were very clean and the apartment itself was very beautiful and well looked after. It was a very great location, which was close to everything, especially the theatre which I went to that evening. I arrived between locations very easily as it was in a convenient part of London. The bed was amazingly comfortable and big which allowed me to have an amazing and peaceful sleep. Even though 9 Hertford Street is very central, I couldn't hear the traffic outside which was a very nice element. I loved my stay at 9 Hertford Street, and would definitely stay again! Sara Vieira.

title: Home Away From Home
text: Great stay

title: Amazing
text: There is no better way to describe this place then to say they are amazing. The locations is spot on, the staff are so friendly and helpful, and the rooms are so homey. Really clean and comfortable rooms. When we left they were also just renovating the rooms, from what we saw its going to look great. Green park near by, tube station 5 min walk away, and lots of great resturants within walking distance. This is like a home away from home and great to get away from the hustle and bustle of London. We initially come here for a week but liked it so much we stayed for a few months. Would definitely recommend this place and we will be back here for sure.

title: It Gets Better
text: We stayed here back in 2013 and had a really wonderful time. The location, facilities and friendliness of the team here really make the welcome experience so wonderful. Unfortunately the apartment we had last time on the first floor was not available on this visit so we settled for the one bed on the 4th floor (has lift). Beautifully modern, large rooms with high ceilings - but with classical touches in style and design make this apartment. It appeared to be newly refurbished so it was an added joy to be able to enjoy it more. Great facilities, with fully equipped kitchen with all mod-cons, large screen TVs in bedroom and living room. Large off-set dining area (eat in, in Mayfair?!?) and free good-range wifi throughout (small, but important necessity). Bed was really (no..really, really) comfortable and lots of clothing storage space. Great bathroom space with a decent pressure shower. Warm cosy sofas with cushions to drown in! The star of course is the location - you cannot fault it. You're one minute's walk from Hyde Park underground

title: The best address in London
text: For a visitor this has to be the best address in London. Thanks to a warm welcome and our extravagantly comfortable suite we felt instantly at home. However this ‘home’ is at the centre of one of the most exclusive ‘villages’ in the world. We could walk easily to London’s theatreland, Michelin-starred restaurants, quaint pubs, art galleries, all our favourite shops or the healthy acres of Hyde Park. Back at ‘home’ we were treated to the great friendliness and knowledge of Aude and Vladimir who made our stay even more special – nothing was too much trouble. We can’t wait to come back!

title: A real jewel in Mayfair
