text: The team at 9 Hertford could not be more friendly or helpful, nothing is too much trouble and their advice was personal and helpful. I really recommend this place as you are made to feel like an individual. The flat was well equipped and well decorated yet homely too. The location is amazing, great places to eat and be entertained very locally. Well kept décor and smart staff, my time there could not have been better.

title: A LITTLE GEM
text: I stayed there for a romantic getaway- and it was the perfect choice- we found we could crumble onto the comfy sofas after our days out and about in central London- we could literally walk everywhere- hyde park, the royal academy, picadilly ,oxford street...the list goes on- there are lots of romanic restaurants within walking distance or just a short bus/tube ride away- cafes galore...and a luxurious bed awaits every night- the kitchen is perfectly equipped- the dining area is lovely and cosy- the bathroom immaculate- the service is warm and friendly...it's light years above any big hotel. Here you feel special and cared for- perfect for intimacy and privacy..

title: A large part of the pleasure of visiting London
text: We visit London to enjoy being there - walking most everywhere with the Tube as backup, enjoying restaurants, theater, pubs, museums, and emerging ourselves in the experience of being in London together. We always stay at 9 Hertford. We always find our flat to be lovely. It feels familiar, like home away from home, welcoming. And the location is central and a respite from busy London streets. We echo the other reviews of 9 Hertford: Hosts Vladimir and Aude are professionals who make our stay comfortable and predictable, so that we have energy and enthusiasm for adventures elsewhere. They each are the right blend of personable and efficient and we know that they will be available should there be need. Lourdes, who heads housekeeping, has been there many years and her cheery welcome makes us feel more like family than guests. And so here is the most important comment about 9 Hertford: we make reservations for our stay there before we make flight reservations. What more can we say?

title: Great Location Clean and Peaceful.
text: I traveled on business and enjoyed the quiet and spacious flat where I held a couple of meetings. The team was very charming and helpful. The concierge organized taxi transfer, theatre tickets and was very helpful. 5 minutes walk from Green Park tube station/ Hyde Park...

title: The oasis in Mayfair - Brian Dick
text: If you need to relax and still be close to everything that's good about London, then look no further than 9 Hertford Street. My wife and I have stayed in one of the beautiful, clean and modern apartments several times. The staff are more helpful and mannerly than most of the "big hotels". Nothing is too much trouble. The location of the apartments is close to tube stations and bus stops. No more than a stone's throw from Green Park, it is fantastic to take a walk in the sunshine in the morning or a leisurely stroll in the evening. Excellent restaurants are close at hand, as well as simple cafés and good pubs. All within walking distance! The apartments are well appointed, all with all the facilities that you would need for a short or long stay. Having stayed as a guest in some the grand hotels in the Capital, there is nothing to beat just relaxing in a lounge and enjoying a glass of wine or a snooze, whenever you fancy. Next time you are in London, give Hertford Street a try. You won't be disappointed.

title: Second visit
text: I have just returned from my second visit to 9 Hertford street, can't fault this place, such a great location, the staff are so helpful, I would really recommend this place to anyone wanting and comfortable stay in a great part of London.

title: Heaven in the heart of London
text: True

title: Good facilities, good staff, good value
text: High quality serviced apartments which make a wonderful base for visiting London. Location: If you know London you'll know straight away that this is a great location

title: A Personal Oasis
text: My family and I spent 10 days in London recently and stayed at 9 Hertford Street. The flat was simply outstanding in the Accomodations it offered and the staff went out of their way to make us feel comfortable. The manager Aude is a true professional par excellence. The location is extraordinary to visit all of the main parts of Central London. We will definitely return and recommend to our friends and family.

title: A quiet haven in the heart of London
text: We loved staying here. The apartments are clean and well appointed and you can't beat the location. The staff were friendly and attentive without being intrusive. We travelled with our 7 year old and having a park nearby was an added bonus. We will definitely be back.

title: Fantastic location
text: We spent 6 nights in a one bedroom apartment at 9 Hartford street in April and were pleasantly surprised by the size and high standard of accommodation. The apartment was beautifully furnished and provided everything we could wish for ( the basket in the kitchen with basic supplies eg tea,coffee,sugar,milk, biscuits, detergent and washing powder was fantastic) just enough to get you started and to even supply shampoo, conditioner and soap in the bathroom was an unexpected bonus. Having a washing machine meant we could do our laundry at a time that was convenient to us and without the added expense of paying a premium to have it done for us. We paid extra for a fold up bed (put up in the lounge room) for our adult daughter who stayed with us for a few days and still had plenty of room. The bed in the main bedroom was one of the most comfortable I have ever slept in away from home. The location is great very close to restaurants and bars, a supermarket. A 2 minute walk to catch a bus or 5 minutes to the local tube station, about a 15-20 walk to Oxford street. The staff are wonderful and ready to assist in any way you need directions, suggestions on shops,shows, sights, tours, they were polite and friendly without being pushy or intrusive. If we're back in London we would definitely stay there again. Highly recommend it for couples, families or a group of girlfriends, we always felt safe and secure in our surrounding.

title: Ann S. - "A very special place"
text: We were absolutely delighted with our experience at 9 Hertford Street and were sorry to leave, although we know we will be back at the earliest opportunity. The apartment was spacious, elegant and restful with an amazing lack of noise considering the very central location in an extremely busy city. We had our German Shepherd with us and he was treated, by the staff, as 'part of the family'. This gave us peace of mind when we left him in the apartment to go to a show or restaurant. The staff were simply lovely and nothing was too much trouble - warm and efficient but unobtrusive. The ambience of the reception area is warm and welcoming and the area is discrete but central. This place is a real treasure and we look forward to our next stay.

title: Family Friendly Oasis in Central London, maybe I should keep it to myself!
text: My third stay at this lovely hotel and I brought my two children this time. As ever staff were very helpful and everyone really enjoyed their stay. I wish I had brought my family on my previous visits. The location of the hotel near the huge parks of central London coupled with the very accommodating staff mean it really is a winner for families. The rooms are big and very well furnished. The kids also loved the comfortable and friendly lobby complete with very indulgent staff who made our stay special with great recommendations and smiles 24/7. A lovely and restful time.

title: An Absolute Gem
text: We recently relocated to London and stayed at 9 Hertford Street (with our 9 year old daughter and good-sized dog) while searching for permanent housing. And despite all of us being in a one-bedroom unit for 6 weeks, it was actually hard to leave. This place is really quite special. The rooms are very large, very comfortable, and (for London) a great deal. (Having a kitchen and washer is hugely helpful). The location is truly outstanding, in the heart of the charming and safe neighborhood of Mayfair, with parks, great restaurants, public transportation, etc. right outside the door. But the staff at 9 Hertford Street is what puts this place over the top. Everyone I dealt with here (Aude, Izzy, Lourdes, Vladimir, Suzanah, Marco) went above and beyond to make our stay better. You get a real sense that this is like a family, and they treat their customers as personal guests, not as profit centers. I'm definitely not the kind of guy who goes to B&Bs and makes friends with the hosts -- give me a nice impersonal luxury hotel experience anytime -- but at 9 Hertford, they've struck the ideal balance of being incredibly helpful and friendly, while totally respecting your privacy. From offering to walk our dog, babysit, print documents or provide great restaurant recommendations, they were always there when you needed them -- and never there when you didn't. And walking into that warm and cozy lobby at the end of the day really was like coming home. I can't recommend this place highly enough.

title: First Class service, amazing location and room is spacious
text: Stayed with our 2 boys, room was big and spacious and plenty of room for the children to have their own space! Close to the main shopping area in London, Oxford Street, Regent Street, Picadilly Circus, Fortnum and Masons, Liberty, Bond Street and the list goes on. Plenty of food choices around the area too, which is handy for foody like ourselves. If you like the old and new mix in the interior then this is the place for you. A must try!

title: A great place to stay
text: We recently stayed here for our wedding anniversary and had a wondeful time. The area is very special with many great places to eat and drink. Our classic apartment was large and very well equipped, but the main reason we will return is the staff. They were so helpful when we locked ourselves out of our apartment in the middle of the night. Can't recommend it enough and next time we'll try the Prestige apartment.

title: Great Location & Staff
text: I've stayed a second time in 9 Hertford Street and the service is as good as when I came last here about 2-3 years ago. I felt welcome once again and we enjoyed the discretion and quietness of the apartments. It's ideally located near Shepherd Market in Mayfair which gives you a quiet village feel close to busy Picadilly and Regent's Street. There are a few restaurant and bars options near the apartments. And you can easily walk to busier places in Central London. Location wise it's a big win. I'll definitely use this place again.

title: 5 star treatment
text: I have stayed in most of London's finest hotels and this is far better than the Dorchester or Savoy. The service is spot on, the rooms spacious and well appointed. We arrived late but that didnt phase the staff who where delightful and welcoming. I cant recommend this place highly enough We even left the smallest piece of lost property and were called by the GM, a very helpful and stylish French lady who's name escapes me and was told we had left something and she would keep it or post it on, thats 5 star service

title: Perfect London Base
text: I have stayed at 9 Hertford Street on at least six occasions over the last five years. The main reason that I return is the excellent personal service of Aud, Vladimir and their team plus the excellent location of the property. London is a big city with many precincts and the West End offers the theatre and access to beautiful parks and excellent shopping and dining experiences. 9 Hertford Street brings all these attractions into walking range and the London underground is easily accessible at Hyde Park Corner or Green Park station. The tariff is not cheap but a self contained spacious apartment is a much better proposition than a small often cramped hotel room. The staff will genuinely go out of their way to anticipate needs and to meet them. The accommodation is scrupulously clean and well serviced. Some of the common areas are a bit tired but none of this detracts from this wonderful, reliable home away from home in London. Highly recommended.

title: Perfect stay
text: We stayed 3 nights at 9 Hertford Street in one bed room apartment and it was really nice,clean apartment with fully equipped kitchen and we'll arranged TV room, near by you can find many restaurants and it is at walking distances from many attractions and Hyde Park. You may contact the propeirty direct for reservation and you will your stay.

title: A fantasic stay with family.
text: We really can't fault our stay at this place.. would highly recommend it, fanstasic staff the service was spot on, great location, just wished we could have stayed longer. We will definitely be returning to 9 hertford street. :)

title: A beautiful flat with wonderful service!
text: I just got back from London and we stayed at the flats. I was Amazed by the size and the amenities (I have small children so I had to make small meals). The location is amazing! Walkable to Hyde park and buckingham palace and lots if restaurants near shepards market. The staff is soo friendly and when above and beyond for us! I am so glad we picked this place, we absolutely loved it!!!!

title: Great Stay, Helpful Staff, and Great Value for Money
text: From the first moment I contacted the staff for special requests, they were extremely helpful and accommodated all my requests such as handling my baby equipment rental issues way before I arrived to London. They prepared everything for me in the apartment hassle free with no extra charges. The apartment we stayed in was decent, clean, and extremely spacious with a private terrace. What is also worth mentioning is that their kitchen is extremely well equipped. I mean you couldn't think of any kind of pan, pots, plates, cutlery, glasses that you wouldn't find. Their equipment is in very good shape (Microwave, dishwasher, washer, stove) The cleaning ladies were very kind and flexible with our timings. The cleaning of the room was spot on. I can't complain in this aspect. They also have skybox with all channels you can think of, along with normal satellite Tv and DVD. My parents also stayed in higher class room and it was with a higher price, but worth every single penny. They had 52" TV in the sitting room and bedroom. The furniture was also amazing. Before we leave, we also found a small card from the hotel's manager who has become a personal friend to us along with a very nice gift that left a nice impression on us. We really couldn't find a bad thing about that place, and we will be back. I've recommended to many of our family and friends, and some of them have already arranged future bookings.

title: Loved this accomodation and refreshing service
text: Stayed for a week and we were very pleased. Great kitchen, comfortable apartment, fast Wi-Fi, windows that open for fresh air, wonderful village feel in the back streets of Mayfair with lots of local shops. Narrow streets with cabs winding in and around the maze all the time and so easy to get transport. All the staff were so helpful and extremely polite and one of the only hotels in the UK throughout the last month who offered to deliver our luggage to our room. Loved the stay and would definitely stay again and recommend to others. Well done Hertford St and thank you.

title: Great London Accomodation
text: This is an excellent place to stay while visiting London. The staff are helpful, the cleaner is friendly and efficient. The rooms are tastefully furnished with comfortable lounge chairs. It is close to the underground and to buses as well as close enough to walk to attractions. there are numerous restaurants in the area to eat. The hotel will arrange for a driver to pick you up who is helpful and will wait when caught in the immigration hall of Heathrow.

title: If I could afford it I would stay here for half the year!
text: I loved this place. The first time I stayed here I rented an apartment at the back on the fourth floor and it was fantastic. It was spacious and well-appointed with the most comfortable bed and incredibly quiet at night. The location is great - the small streets around with little shops, cafes and pub create a lovely village atmosphere. Five minutes in the other direction, you are on Piccadilly with all its stylish razzamatazz, which I always enjoy anyway, so I reckon you have just about the best of all worlds in this spot. I sort of tripped over this place and they happened to have a free apartment so I just took it. I returned a few weeks later and stayed in an apartment at the front of the building which was also lovely but slightly less well-appointed. It was also a little noisy but the location makes up for this and the nightly rate at the front is a bit lower as well. The service is great and the reception lounge on the ground floor is warm and welcoming. The flowers were stunning. All in all I thought this place was fabulous value for money but go for a room at the back on a higher floor. Only one omission - no milk in the fridge. We tea-drinkers really need this after a long journey and a late arrival!!

title: our 3rd stay
text: Just returned for our 3rd stay. The location is terrific only 5 mins through Green Park to Buckingham Palace and less to the tube. The staff are helpful and friendly. The apartments are large with a seperate lounge, dining and kitchen area. The ability to do your own laundry while away is beneficial. We stayed in room 201 - a traditionally furnished room. Rooms are serviced every day except Sundays. It is also an added bonus they can arrange for Tony the taxi driver to pick you up from the airport and let you into you room what ever hour.

title: Quality care with a difference
text: I've enjoyed the comfort of 9 Hertford St over many visits and enjoyed the care from the Hertford St team. And that care is not just fixing for a shirt to be cleaned

title: GREAT
text: This is a home from home experience. Good central location and excellent facilities provided. The helpful, unobtrusive and obliging staff ensure that this accommodation provides everything anyone would wish for when you are away from home.

title: Home away from home
text: We have just returned from our second extended stay at this venue. Our three weeks spent there in May 2013 were ,as usual, fabulous. Aude and Vladimir are always extremely helpful, the location is ideal and the apatment has everything one would want to make you feel comfortable away from home. The apartments are serviced daily and the staff are flexible as to when you would like this done. Shepherd Market itself has a wealth of quirky restaurants and pubs. This is our preferred destination on our annual trips to the UK Chris and Sheri Robinson

title: great apartment
text: very nice apartments quite in the center of London. The attending staff were very knowledgeable. Excellent space although a bit pricey. A 10 minute walk from the tube station. Lot of restaurants around and a great coice of cuisine. Unfortunately no service in the apartments, although I must say I did not miss it. If one can afford this luxury, definitely recomended.

title: Lovely stay at 9 Hertford Street
text: My fourth stay here and I absolutely loved it, nothing beats the location nor the value for money and nice attentions + warm welcome of the staff! Looking forward to my next trip to what has now become my Mayfair home. Highly recommended once again. A "sans faute" as we say in French

title: I will definitely go back there again!
text: Clean, nice and spacious flat, friendly staff, excellent location, although I have to say the flat on the second floor which faces the street is a bit noisy. I will be happy to go back there again.

title: Great location
text: Had a fantastic stay, great location for all the shops in central london and the apartment was really massive. Only downside was that the person next door played their music really loud all the time and there was a bit of traffic noise - so just ask for an apartment to the back of the building and not on the second floor where that noisy person is apparently living.

title: Affordable luxury in Mayfair
text: These well priced, spacious, quiet and very comfortable apartments located in exclusive Mayfair are simply wonderful. My daughter and I stayed a week in a Deluxe apartment in November also taking advantage of the pick up service from the airport with their driver Tony who was a godsend after the flight from Sydney. We were able to check in to our apartment immediately upon arrival without incurring an extra cost. The manager Aude and her team were extremely pleasant and discreet. The property is located a short walk from Green Park underground and Buckingham Palace and the restaurants and eateries of Shepards Market are around the corner. The only inconvenience is that a couple of the cafes closeby don't take credit cards, so make sure you carry enough cash if having a morning coffee or picking up a very good quality takeaway meal to have in the apartment. We are already planning a return to London and wouldn't consider staying anywhere else.

title: Affordable Mayfair with great service
text: We often stay in London but always choose the hotel option but really wanted to get away from the impersonal feel of one so chose 9 Hertford Street after some friends recommended it. 9HS is fully serviced apartments within a stones throw of Hyde Park in the heart of Mayfair. We had the prestige apartment with the balcony and the rooms were clean, well appointed, comfortable and wonderfully luxurious. We arrived very early at about 8am and were made to feel extremely welcome from the onset. We were shown to our apartment - beautifully appointed, large dining room as you walk in

title: 40 Winks - As recommended by The Times Travel magazine - Please don't bother - or waste your money!
text: We should have known when it was Paypall or payment into bank account Only - but you know, sometimes, we all think that we are 'on to something special' and it did have a great review in the Sunday Times travel article. We arrived and were told "it's a shoe-free house!" they didn't tell you that on booking! The house is different, clean and quirkily-styled. Yes, probably looks good on photo-shoots, or the like - BUT staying there is something else! Basically, we tried to book 2 nights, but 40 winks could only accommodate us for 1. Thankfully!!! We were not told how to operate the water to fill the bath - there is no shower - we eventually found out that there are levers are in the cupboard above the sink. The bathroom comes with old cracked soap for you to use - these are the products in this 'boutique find!' We were given 1 bath towel for the 2 of us, which on the morning after our stay was removed before we could bathe!!!! WTF??? We thought that we were given the wrong keys because we could not lock the door to our bedroom - we were told by our host, "Oh no, we don't lock the bedrooms in the house" Well if it were somewhere else and you were not charging for the room then yes, but on this occasion and all others, probably... NO, that is not acceptable. Oh and there were no pillows just cushions, as part of the 'set'. We were informed that Breakfast was set up the night before and left out for us. We made an instant coffee and left before we could enjoy any more of it. Oh and as for the 40 winks - we didn't get any. The house is nice and is situated in a challenging part of town and is on a busy road. I was awoke at 0400 due to the traffic and street noise and didn't get back to sleep from then until we had the opportunity to leave. Please don't waste your money. The house takes a good picture and am sure is a great backdrop to Kasabian's next release - but based our our experiences, don't stay. We wanted to ensure that no one else has the same experience as we did. The story does not end badly. For £5 more per night we moved onto a very exclusive hotel with a pool on the roof, a great space and oh yes... a lock on the door, towels, products, bathrobes, pillows and it was quiet enough to sleep. And yes, we even stayed for breakfast.

title: Welcome in Wonderland
text: Staying at 40 Winks is definitely a unique experience, and a very good one. Stepping there is like entering a strange yet familiar world, magnificently created by David Carter. Conversing with my host was a wonderful moment, he really made me feel at home and I will never forget the extraordinary time I spent here.

title: A hidden bijou gem in the heart of London's East End
text: Not just for out of towners...so keen was I to spend the night at the famous 40 Winks, I planned a weekend in East London from my home in West London especially. It only has two bedrooms with every square inch carefully and beautifully thought of with pieces by some of the UK’s most fabulous artists, as put together by David Carter - a magician more than an interior designer! Walking through the house, the rooms change from day to night, a magical atmosphere throughout. David is the most attentive host and charming company. I hope to go back again soon.

title: 40 winks is simply wonderful

title: gr8 time at 40 Winks
text: What a gr8 time at 40 Winks. David Carter is a perfect host and the way his open up his home is magnificent. David’s recommendations of restaurants in east London is very good. We loved to come back when In London next time.

title: London's miracle!
text: Gorgeous and edgy, still at home…it’s a magic by the host, Mr. David Carter! The location is much convenient than expected. Very easy to access from Heathrow Airport, and a subway station is a few minutes walk away. I enjoyed the edgy but daily-life atmosphere of the East side of London, which is different from the very center of the city (though it's still very urban). The house, the rooms are sheer feast to one’s senses. The space is beautiful, exciting, yet clean, comfortable, and in fact, functionally superior. Especially, its beds. The bed cushions are EXELLENT…I heard they are used in Rolls-Royce or some luxury cars. It was a bliss to sleep on them. As like those consideration, Mr.Carter’s hospitality is a true virtue of this guesthouse. Once you contact, his e-mail reply is very quick and kind. While staying, his choice and advice for where to visit was never wrong, moreover, it was extremely interesting and impressive to have a conversation with him at breakfast or teatime (it occurred whenever he’s free! ) He’s both of a talented artist and a warm host…I think it’s kind of a miracle, too. I was terribly lucky to be able to spend first two nights in London in this hotel. I feel this experience was very “LONDON”…trad but avant-garde, elegant but human, smart, exciting but cozy. Staying at 40 Winks is the best way to meet the uniqueness of the city.

text: David Carter is an incredibly gracious and kind host. Most of all, I want to express my gratitude for his attention to detail when it came to my own personal needs. title: A feast for the senses - best stay ever!
text: Well, it's hard to know where to start, because 40 Winks is an experience like no other on so many levels. David has created something really special and magical - it's quite a full bodied experience! The love with which this abode has been created is so palpable - it just really goes so far beyond lots of pretty and cool things. David gives a very warm and friendly welcome and is very engaging and delightful, not to mention interesting and witty. I stayed for the Bedtime stories, which were very fabulous, and David was a total hoot - he really created a cosy, fun and slightly naughty atmosphere :-). I had the single room, which was lovely - the bed was super comfy with really great quality linens. The bathroom gets a special mention - it is so luxurious, and being a bath person I would have to say probably the best bath experience I've ever had. And I feel very blessed to have met David and got to experience his fabulous little corner of paradise. I will be back... title: Escaping reality
text: My partner and I spent just one night in this enchanting place and whilst I wish we could've stayed longer, the magic of David's home had a huge impact on us even after this short time. The house itself is beautiful, inspiring and enchanting, a feast for the senses. The room was bright, refreshing and very comfortable and the bathroom (bath) was pure indulgence! David was a true British gentleman, welcoming us into his home and sharing with us some of his exciting ideas to change the world. We left feeling invigorated and inspired, even though we were only 20 minutes from home! If you are passing through London or even if you live here and want to escape your reality for a bit, for a very reasonable price, I thoroughly recommend giving David a visit.

title: Amazing experience at 40 Winks

title: A unique and very special experience!
text: 40 Winks is a unique boutique hotel in the achingly-cool East end of London. The owner, David Carter is a world renowned interior designer and he has created an amazing hotel experience. He has carefully chosen beautiful items of furniture and decoration in every room of the house. Every item feels like it has been hand-picked for some special quality or beauty and you can spend hours just admiring the various reception rooms in the house. It is actually Mr Carter's personal residence, and he makes a most charming and friendly host who really goes out of his way to make your stay special. His local knowledge of the surrounding area is invaluable if you are not familiar with the charms of Shoreditch, Brick Lane and Spitalfields. It's still pretty valuable even if you are familiar with the area! as he will probably reveal a hidden gem of a restaurant, bar or store that you weren't aware of. Breakfast is served in the beautiful basement kitchen, which again has had the very special Carter touch applied. You could view the hotel as a place for special occasions, such as anniversaries or birthday treats, but if I'm honest, if I need to stay in London in the future, the first place I will look now, will always be 40 winks. However with only 2 rooms available and the fact that it is so well respected, I might not be able to stay as often as I would like! I do want to be clear that this hotel isn't for everyone. If you like the impersonal and ubiquitous experience of a recognisable hotel chain then, 40 Winks probably is not going to suit you. However if you want to escape the bland and the predictable, then do visit 40 Winks and experience a small adventure into the unique magical world that David Carter has conjured up in this amazing corner of East London.

title: A worldmof its own
text: We stayed at the 40winks for one night and have to say: it certainly has its own charme. It was our place to stay for our little escape for 48 hours from everyday live... Washing ones hair proved a challenge though, as there is no showerhead. But we managed. Althouh we booked only one room we could move freely within the whole house thus having the impression of it being all to ourselves for the night. Even though the doors are all unlocked our private sphere was respected at all times. Our host recommended some things to do in thea which were all good tips. Checkout was at 11 o clock, and we didn't have time to try out he breakfast. Checkout an hour later would have filled our stomachs and made the farewell a lot smoother. So if you are looking for a little special gem with its own charme, we can definately recommend the 40 winks.

title: bewitching retreat
text: We stayed at 40 winks last weekend and our visit allowed us to escape the London bubble into the inspiring world that David Carter had created. David is a warm host whose stories are as delightful and as enthralling as it is uncovering the treasures within his colourful home. A must visit for those looking for a unique London (and sensory) experience!

title: True London Experience
text: Some girls dream of Paris or Rome for their honeymoon... For me, it has always been London. My husband and I wanted to experience the REAL London and staying at 40 Winks provided us with that and so much more. It was a pleasure chatting with David in-length about how 40 Winks opens him up to new ideas, global perspectives, and inspires him to make the world a better, more beautiful place. We ribbed him about the "takeaway pizza" guests who complained in a previous review... and I saw how it wounded him. He's an earnest man, quintessentially British - perhaps his reserve can be mistaken for rudeness or snobbery, but we found him extraordinarily kind and accommodating. And honestly, I was offended at the idea that someone would want to stay in their room (as lovely as it is) - on their computers the entire time - when the city of London is just outside their door. It's a joke. That is NOT why you stay at a place like 40 Winks. Just the idea someone would COMPLAIN having to take a bath everyday while on holiday is appalling. Waking up from glorious sleep and stepping into the most beautiful bath tub I have ever seen just put me into this inexplicably calming state of mind. In my busy life, I very rarely have the time to enjoy a proper bath and luxuriate in my surroundings... 40 Winks allowed me to enjoy city life, which can be loud and gritty at times, and slip into another world when I retreated to my room and bath everyday. David introduced us to West End theatre, some of the most extraordinary gastronomic experiences we had in Europe, and great places like the Old Spitalfields market. His home is a revelation, inspiring me to take more risks in decorating our new home, incorporating antiques and collectibles with modern designs. Character and style. Some people have it - and others don't. I'd like to think my husband and I at least have an appreciation for it. But if you can't even appreciate the fact that David tries to provide his guests with a true London experience, don't stay here. Stay in a charmless hotel with all the wifi and shower stalls you need to stay holed up in your room the entire time you're in one of the greatest cities in the world. If this review seems scathing to the naysayers, it's only because we loved our experience so much. And because I am a fierce advocate for my friends - and that is exactly what David has become for us. We hope to be back in the next few years, if he will have us again. Thank you, David, for making our honeymoon so special. We will never forget our time at 40 Winks!

title: 'Alice in Wonderland' kind of stay in vibrant East London
text: Just a few minutes away from colorful Stepney Green tube station, you will find a tall black door with a small sign on the right that says '40 Winks'. You press the ring and will be welcomed by a man with a reserved smile and a big bowler hat. The noise of the steet behind you will distance as you enter the door, and you will find yourself in vacuumed tranquility after the door creaks once and then closes. The man who looks rather quiet and contemplating introduces himself as Mr. David Carter. The owner of 40 Winks himself. He leads you in and as your eyes get used to the 'candle lit' hallway, your journey begins to wonder about in a 300-year-old house eclectically decorated with tasteful flamboyance. David kindly offers some tea in the basement kitchen and we start talking and talking as if we knew each other from a long time. 40 Winks is not a hotel but a magical house that becomes your home while you stay. It appears quirky in details but in fact roots in great tradition and style with amazing personal hospitality. It is THE place if you want a 'made-to-order' kind of stay in London.

title: Felt like a princess
text: You are entering a different world when you walk in the door at 40 winks. I felt like Alice in Wonderland and was treated like a princess from the time I checked in to the hotel until I checked out. David Carter is a wonderful host. He has an unique style, a big knowledge of art and design and can show you places in London you'd never find on your own! He showed me a wonderful flea market with the most amazing treasures you can imagine! You will be inspired by his magical world and made my trip to London unique! It was like visiting an old friend. I recommend 40 Winks completely. And, can't wait to stay again!

David Carter is a perfect host, providing guests with a unique and beautiful home as well as lots of information on things worth discovering, be it markets, exhibitions, cafes, restaurants etc. I will definitely return.

title: It was a unique hotel experience we are bound to repeat!!!
text: This place is a great choice if you are looking for something out of the ordinary, a unique place with unique things, a great interior done with an impeccable taste...David was a wonderful host, always there to help, suggesting things to do and offering a cup of tea after your long trip or your London adventures... I loved the garden - I just could sit there for hours, and this place felt straight out of a fairy-tale to me...

title: Truly magical and will never be forgotten
text: I had discovered 40 Winks through social media and then happened to walk past it on the way to the cinema only living a short distance away. I was immediately intrigued and hoped to attend one of their Bedtime Story events. My boyfriend surprised me with a nights stay at 40 Winks back during August Bank Holiday weekend. Our stay was truly magical and will never be forgotten. It was above and beyond what I had imagined! As soon as we arrived on the Sunday afternoon David welcomed us and gave us a tour of the house. We then enjoyed a cup of tea and a chat with David who was so wonderful to sit and listen to. Once we had settled in we wondered around the rooms at our leisure admiring the amazing decor and furniture. We also sat in the peaceful garden and read our books for a while. It felt as though we were miles away from the hub and noise of East London. 40 Winks felt like a home from home and it still feels as though David is a friend who we could just pop in and have a cup of tea with. We had such a unique experience we then did book onto one of the Bedtime Stories which we're looking forward to in a couple of months time!

title: What an awesome little gem!
text: We were privileged enough to spend a night at this stunning house, and meet its awesome owner David. I couldn't recommend it highly enough. It is wonderfully unique and therefore memorable, the decor is stunning and inspiring, the bathroom, fabulous, and the bedroom marvellously calming

title: A stay in London, unlike any other
text: I stayed at 40 winks for a solo (& first time!) trip to London and it truly made the trip for me. The house itself is really as beautiful as it looks in the pictures- its a house that needs to not just be seen, but to be observed. I have such lovely memories of chatting with David over breakfast in the morning and he is a wonderful resource for food, shopping and non-touristy highlights in the city. The location was great for me, and although I had the time to explore other areas of London, I found it hard to leave the nearby shoreditch/bethnal green/whitechapel area. By the end, 40winks and the neighborhood felt like home to me, and I couldn't have asked for more from a first time trip to the city. Thank you David! - Ronita p.s. the beds are wonderfully comfortable, the bathtub is beautiful & expect to start reevaluating your life

title: Special
text: I've stayed here three times and it is now always where I stay when visiting London. It's difficult to put in words what makes the place special. As other people have mentioned, the interior design is aesthetically spectacular and stays with you. Also, David is a kind and welcoming host as well as a good conversationalist.

title: Completely original east London stay
text: If you're open-minded, bored with the traditional stale and tired hotel experience, 40 Winks is a great choice for staying in London. David welcomes you like a proper guest rather than 'a customer'. His home is fun and has tons of character. It felt like a (very special) home from home. It only works if you're adventurous and curious, rather than set in your ways of needing the familiar hotel format. Staying at 40 Winks is maximised if you want to explore Shoreditch (10 mins bus ride) and Hackney (15minutes bus ride, 15 minutes on overground or ten minutes in a cab) in particular, and get yourself organised to make the most of stuff in the area. It's a perfect bolthole for the area. Would highly recommend booking Tayyabs for a curry while you're there - short (and much needed) walk back.

title: A very different stay
text: I booked 40 winks because I wanted to stay somewhere that was different to your regular hotel. I most certainly got this. David was a wonderful host, and the house is amazing to experience. I knew from the start that I was not one of the regular kinds of guests that would turn up to 40 winks, and that I would also be going out of my comfort zone a fair bit in staying here, due to the sharing of the bathroom with a total stranger, and knowing there was only a bath, with no shower. I have given 4 stars as David was a lovely host, and we had lovely conversations, etc. The bedding, however, while comfy enough, and I'm sure, clean, was a bit worn, and stained. The mattress also did feel a bit old. (Please note that I did not mention this to David, who I'm sure would have been accommodating in the situation). This is really the only negative that I have no control over. The other parts were just me being out of my comfort zone, and I think, staying there maybe at the wrong point in time, when I really just needed my own space. Keep in mind that where you are staying is Davids house, in which I felt like a guest. I tend to enjoy making a space my own, and this is relatively impossible here. 40 Winks is definitely not somewhere you go where you will be pampered and live in the lap of luxury, but a place for something unique, quirky, filled with character and good conversation, if you desire it. If I could stay again, I would ensure I was there in a month other than August, when the legendary bedtime story nights are on. Otherwise, thank you for the chats, the cocktail and my stay at your wonderful house, David!

title: Sad to leave!
text: I heard about 40 Winks through the Lonely Planet guidebook to London. I was looking for a place in East London that wasn't a big hotel chain and had some personality. After a long day of travel from Madrid, it was so nice to arrive at 40 Winks, which is unlike any place I've stayed before. I had a good chat with David before going out to explore a bit. The accommodations are absolutely stellar. Everywhere you turn there are interesting, beautiful things to look at and admire. Each day I'd notice some new design in the detail of the wallpaper or the way a shadow would fall based on the shape of a lampshade. David was super helpful to recommend good spots around town (for example, Daunt books, which I could have spent all day in!) and I had such a great time talking to him about theatre, culture, politics and all sorts of things. I'm so sad I was only able to stay a couple of nights before flying home. I would love to stay here again in the future and would definitely recommend it to friends.

title: An enchanting evening
text: Staying at " 40 Winks" allows you to step out of the humdrum of everyday life and conventional hotel spaces. The calm atmosphere and warm welcome from David is akin to unplugging oneself! A good nights rest coupled with a lovely bath in gorgeous surroundings is a wonderful tonic. Thanks to David for his ingenuity to create this gem of a venue

title: An unconventional journey start from here
text: If you want an unconventional trip to discover East London, 40 Wink is one of the best choice. Not just because the unique and stylish room you stay, but also the host, David, can provide some nice travel tips according to your interest and share stories with you. We had little chat when I check in, and walked around Columbia Road Flower Market on Sunday morning. Even just stay for one night, you feel the place like your home, sweet, cozy and full of stories. Such an unforgettable stay. Plus, the place is quite convenience, close to Shoreditch. And the bed is so comfortable that you can sleep tight.

title: The 40WiNKS-slippers are really cool, like this wonderful hotel in general...
text: One of the first aspects David mentioned after our arrive at 40WiNKS was that we are invited to wear his house-slippers instead of our own shoes inside of the hotel - and if you study the condition of the floors and the rooms in general you know why: everything is almost perfect. This excentric and extraordinary hotel is very beautiful and clean. The interior design of the rooms is lovely and carefully designed by David. During our stay at the hotel we had the pleasure having teatime together with David - interesting and funny conversations about London, art and life in general are the consequence... Lara and I enjoyed our stay at this really remarkable hotel 40WiNKS very much and we are looking forward to be there again one day. Lara Herrmann and Matthias Hillecke, Stuttgart/Germany

title: Unique luxury close to the best parts of London.
text: Myself and my boyfriend recently stayed in 40 Winks for three nights as part of a week long trip to visit friends, family and enjoy London. We absolutely loved it. David is an absolute gem much like his house. He's full of great conversation and fantastic recommendations about food, design and the area in general. His house is beautiful, intriguing and a treasure trove for design lovers. The double room where we stayed was luxurious and the bed was one of the comfiest bed we've ever slept in. We left happy, relaxed and full of recommendations that we will be sharing with our friends. If you want to have a few days where you feel like you're spoiling yourself while also being able to step out on to the doorstep of all the interesting places that London has to offer, 40 Winks is the place.

title: Enchanting!
text: Wow! Our very brief stay with David at 40 Winks could not have been more magical. The space is unique, inviting, and has incredible energy. We only wished we could have stayed longer! David was very accommodating and the best host we could have asked for

title: Magical.
text: The charming Mr Carter has created an enchanting world that is not a hotel - it's an unmissable experience, a privilege and a pleasure to stay in his home. Those of us lucky enough to stay here will not leave unchanged.

title: A true dandy experience
text: A very special place run by a very special man. A true british dandy, David Carter will give you inspiration that will last you for a long time, even after your trip. The beautiful and quirky interior is both comforting and inspirational. If you are looking for something special this is your choice.

title: Magical and charming!
text: Although in the middle of a vibrant metropolis, the 40 winks let us plunge into a magical world for three nights. The charm of this little Bijou has left a lasting impression. David was an adorable host. We can recommend this gem to anyone who wants to experience London from a completely different side.

title: An amazing design experience
text: I stayed at 40 Winks with a colleague when visiting the Design Week in Clerkenwell and it was really an amazing experience. We are both architects and we really appreciated the interior and design of the accomodation, I can say it's the most unique one we've ever been, really full of details and unique objects. Spending some time here was like enjoying a trip in another time, a really unique experience. We really appreciated David kindness and hospitality, as well as the tidiness and cleaning of the place, that is not so common in London. Thanks!

title: Fabulous early 18th century town house
text: And an excellent host who made us feel very welcome. 40 Winks is located in Stepney Green, convenient for The City and central London. Would strongly recommend for the traveller who appreciates the unique.

title: A fantastical jewel box in London's East End
text: My partner and I started off our month long voyage with a too short stay at 40 Winks. Mr. David Carter greeted us with a delicious cup of tea and a lovely chat, followed by some amazing recommendations for the day. We started off at the Spitalfields Market where there was a dizzying array of antiques. It was enough to overcome the worst of jetlag... Every recommendation David made was well thought out and spot on. We ate at some divine restaurants that were only a tube stop or two away...Our favorite being the St. John's bread and wine in the East End. The "hotel" itself (it is much more than a hotel..) is a portal into a fantastically curated universe of boutique beauty and charm...and David is there to accompany you on your voyage...It is quiet, colorful and incredibly unique...We loved our room and especially the bathroom with its gorgeous tub...We enjoyed our time with David so much! He is a wonderful host, knows the area so well, and how to find the best of the best! Thank you so much, we will never forget it and will surely be back!

title: Feel at home in London
text: The house is a piece of art, the landlord a very polite and interesting man, very british. We had three very happy days in London and felt at home at 40winks. A true authentic experience. For people who have problems sleeping with noise from the street, the double room is quite noisy, well we get used to it after two nights and a bottle of red wine:-). Breakfast is: toast, jam, honey, tea or coffee and cereals with milk , and orange juice and good tips for the day and night out in London from the landlord. 3 min walking and you are at the tube station Stepney Green, very comfortable. If you are looking for something authentic and british and interesting, 40winks is a good idea for you to stay. We had a very good time at 40winks!

title: inspiring experience
text: we had a pleasant stay at the home from David. He is a elegant host, who gave a lot of helpful tips to explore the area of East London. The rooms were tastefully furnished - I especially love the bathroom! We really enjoyed our days at this wonderful location. Highy remommended!

title: amazing place
text: when i arrived i feel like alice in wonderland!..this place is magic and mystic..every items is amazing, the kitchen is stunning, the single room is very cosy and the bathroom so glamourous...and Mr Carter knows how to host..if you want an original and confortable place this is the best place in london..i have already recommanded to all my friends.

title: Inspiring, playful, uplifting!
text: Oh what an utterly fantastic stay! When you book a room at 40 Winks, you get much more than bed, bath (!), and breakfast. You get to explore the quirky and aesthetically impeccable decor of the whole house (got me thinking about how I might make my own living space cosier and more fun). You also get to meet David who must be the most stylish and creative host in the B&B business and engages you in deep conversations (gets you thinking about how you might a live a more meaningful life – though beware those who cringe at the thought of mild psychoanalysis). He’s so fortunate that this harmonious environment is his home! Last but not least, it's all great fun: I was quite amused by the playful details like the tulle pom-poms, the dog 'sculpture' wearing a sparkly tiara, or catching my breakfast crumbs with a Union Jack napkin.

title: Unique and other-worldly experience in our home town
text: I stayed at 40Winks the night before my wedding, and then on the wedding night with my new husband. We had wanted somewhere spectacular and beautiful to start the rest of our lives together and we were not disappointed. 40Winks makes you feel like Alice down the rabbit hole. Nothing quite makes sense, and yet it does. That David is a world renowned interior designer is apparent in every last fixture, fitting and objet d'art. Bring your camera - you will want it if only to capture a tiny piece of the magic. David was an extremely welcoming and understanding host considering the chaos of the wedding day preparations (hair, makeup, bridesmaids, parents, photographer) and provided an oasis of calm (and well needed cup of tea) when we returned to 40Winks after the nuptials. One caveat - if you are a light sleeper bring earplugs as the double room overlooks the main road and you are in East London so it is noisy. The bathroom was incredible - the absolute epitome of luxury. Thank you David and good luck in all you do.

title: Fantastic. Not to be missed.
text: We stayed at David Carter's jewel-like hotel for three nights in early October. David's house is all nondescript discretion on the outside, a Queen Anne row house on what at first seems to be a rather boring stretch of Mile End Road. But once you've knocked with the large brass lion knocker, a whole new reality opens up to you. As you pass through the nearly black entryway, you quickly realize you're about to enter a different world, if not a different century. David is an absolutely charming character: an internationally lauded interior designer, a hotelier, the creative force behind the fabulous "Bedtime Story Nights," which has been named one of the "14 most amazing things to do in the world" by the Sunday Times Travel Magazine, and he is charismatic and friendly as well. David welcomed us warmly and showed us to our room, a large, light-filled white space on the top floor of his charming house. Our entire stay there was a delight, and David was full of superb suggestions of what to do, such as visiting the Columbia Road Flower Market on Sunday, and an after theater dinner at Brasserie Zedel. David is concerned about his guests without being overbearing. He added a special something to our stay that a room at a chain hotel, no matter how chic or expensive, cannot provide. You must check out the photos of this gorgeous place to begin to understand its many, many charms. We can't wait to go back!

title: Staying in a magical world
text: Even if I’m writing my review quite some time after I stayed at David Carter’s magical place ‘’40winks’’ it doesn’t mean that the memories of my stay have faded. In fact the opposite… I stayed for 3 nights during August and as I was traveling alone I was looking for a different place to stay. I had such a good time at 40winks and it’s been a pleasure to meet David. He is super welcoming and a real gentleman. His tips for eating and going out are great. If you like the quirky and different and enjoy a good conversation this is definitely the place to stay when in London. It’s not like any other hotel I have stayed at. It’s kind of a home away from home and it will make you feel being a Londoner not a tourist. I don’t have to mention the super cool interior of the house. It was an amazing and inspiring experience and I’m very much looking forward to coming back.

title: The most personal and enchanting stay in London
text: We stayed at 40 Winks for three nights and had a wonderful and truly inspiring time! The house is amazing, everything ist perfectly appointed and Mr Carter is the most helpful and entertaining host ever. We really appreciated his recommendations for restaurants, sights and things to do, as well as the lively discussions over breakfast and afternoon tea. We can't wait to be back, not only to stay at 40 Winks but also to enjoy one of Mr Carters famous events.

title: All I was looking for
text: A stay at 40 Winks in London has been on my bucket list for the past few years. I travel a lot and spend a big chunk of my life in hotels so I always look for a special experience and something a little different. And 40 Winks is a unique find in deed and it exceeded my expectations when I recently spent a few days there. Loved the experience. As soon as you walk through the door from the busy street of East London you will be overwhelmed by tranquility and magic. The décor is a very successful combination of reconstruction of historical details with a twist of a fairy tale told by the host and the designer David. 40 Winks is highly recommended for anyone who is looking for a unique experience or would like to move back in time for a short break from the outside hectic world. Time stops here. And it feels good :) I really enjoyed meeting David who is a very interesting conversationalist and a wonderful host, and was also able to recommend many interesting places and events to visit. Thank you David. I am definitely coming back ! Ewelina

title: THE MOST BEAUTIFUL SMALL HOTEL IN THE WORLD
text: My husband and I stayed at the 40 winks in 2010 (I have since stayed a couple of times on my own when travelling on business at this jewel of a guesthouse). I found a link to the 40 winks when performing a search for a boutique hotel for a romantic stay in London. Holiday Inns and Sheratons are a dime a dozzen so when I do get to travel for leaisure I much prefer to stay at a place that has some character and some charm and a place that is an experience in itself. This boutique hotel is decorated and owned by Mr Carter a renowned interior designer, and the decor does not disappoint! My husband spoke to Mr carter on the phone and arranged a time for us to arrive and get a tour of the house and receive a set of keys for the front door. We were greeted by Mr Carter, we removed out shoes and were supplied with comfy slippers. The house comprises of 4 levels, downstairs is the kitchen area, at entrance level is the lounge, first floor is the "music room" and the green room and at the top level are the two guest rooms. We made ourselves right at home and enjoyed the beautifully decorated room (we stayed in the double, and I have since stayed in the single room) and the rest of the house (enjoying a cup of tea with Mr Carter the wonderful owner is an experience in itself!). Coming from Denmark having a bathtub is a rarity, and we made full use of the beautiful bathtub at the 40 winks (it fits two). The hotel is located in easy reach of the tube. Great recommendations are given on the hotel website and quite a few of my favorite places to eat and enjoy a cocktail while in London stem from the recommendations from the site. The hotel hosts events, and it is an experience if you are lucky enough to stay at the hotel when one of these events is happening (story telling nights, life drawing nights, pamper days for girls).

title: So refreshing!
text: My husband and I are Londoners, but fancied staying overnight somewhere special in our beloved capital. Some people thought we were a bit mad wanting to go to a hotel in Stepney Green, but this is a special experience wherever you happen to come from. We didn't just want a bland boutique experience, and 40 Winks provided everything in terms of otherworldliness and exquisite detail. We really enjoyed chatting with host David about art, life and everything in between, and couldn't stop staring at all the beautiful decor, ornaments and thoughtful touches about the house. I'm not going to list what things looked or felt like - go and see for yourself! And don't arrive expecting an identikit hotel experience - it's all about letting go of ordinary life, and going with the flow. Amazing.

title: GOSH!
text: After staying for 4 nights in the double room with a friend all I can say is gorgeous, gorgeous, GORGEOUS! I just want to join the other positive reviews, really nothing more to add, it's all said. About the fantastic interior, about the lovely host David, and about the great neighborhood area. And as a bonus we also bonded with the other guest staying at the single room. We had some nice chat, shopping and dining together. The only annoying thing is that my own place suddenly seemed so dull when I got back home......... But hey

title: Doesn't get better!!
text: What a fabulous privilege to ring in the New Year at Mr. Carter's oasis!! His gracious hospitality immediately puts one at ease as you enter through the rabbit hole into his delightful world of lavish meets whimsical decor. The beautiful bedrooms were private and cozy and the perfect place to de stress from a long flight or a London night out. Mr. Carter is the perfect host allowing as much privacy as you require. However, we were spellbound with his charm, sophistication and elegance and I think he was the one needing privacy by the end of our trip as we couldn't get enough of his delightful, entertaining tales. Thank you for your generosity of home and spirit David and we cannot wait to come visit again soon!!

title: Most Intriguing accomodation in London
text: I stayed at 40 Winks in May 2015. It is the most remarkable hotel I have stayed. The design is amazing and David and the lovely Maria were wonderful hosts. The place is not for everyone: if you want TV in your room, to wear your shoes indoors and the facilities of a standard hotel then this is not for you. If you are reading this review it is because you are interested in something a bit different. At 40 Winks ‘a bit different’ means something wonderful, intriguing or fascinating at every glance. The contrast between the austere eighteenth century architecture and David’s exuberant creativity give this a very special and elegantly provocative place to stay. I stayed in the back room which was very quiet and the gold bath a delight The house was generally very quiet and the kitchen is always an inviting place for tea and a chat if there is someone around The location is great:. 40 Winks is between two tube stations, (a short tube ride to Liverpool St). There are street markets nearby, cafes, an independent cinema and eighteenth century social housing in the form of Nelson era Almshouses. Shoreditch and Hoxton and all that that entails are close by. Perhaps you are thinking the décor is a little too feminine? E Pellicci, (Mile End Road) is nearby which serves the best Full English in London and 40 Winks is only a 5 minute walk from the Blind Beggar pub where the Krays shot George Cornell in 1966, so that should be plenty macho for you. I recommend 40 Winks unreservedly: the most intriguing accommodation in London

title: Christmas treat!
text: We treated ourselves to a stay at 40 Winks as a Christmas present and it was the perfect antidote to the stresses of the festive 'to do' list! The place is gorgeous, combining opulence with cosiness - wish I could move in permanently. David is a wonderful host and made us feel very welcome. The whole experience is like staying with a friend rather than an impersonal hotel. We hope to return!

title: THE journey into a journey...
text: I thought I already knew quite a bit about 40Winks, or at any rate a lot more than I usually do when I am going to stay in a hotel for the first time, because of the countless magazine and tourist's guides reports, photo features, interviews, reviews from this site and other sources I had read. Said all that, of course, it was nothing compared to what I effectively experienced! My expectations went overtaken and I am here to warn that 40Winks' guests are likely to develop permanent addiction to its "Great Beauty" atmosphere!! The fabulous house is the perfectly suggestive, dreamlike, evoking ambiance in which its unparalleled creator and owner sets the most pleasurable reception and hospitality you may relish. The ingredients are unique. Contrasts and blends expressed through artful use of colours and unusual pieces of furniture. The ornaments and their questioning shapes and symbolism. The playfulness in some end use of objects. The accuracy in the refurbishment of the historic building. The choice of giving a different power to each room, mastering the trick of the lights as in paintings, or as on the stage. Flawless and open for your joy and surprise..the top of the tree reveals itself seductively close to your fingertips! Not only the house. Of course, first and foremost comes David Carter. A dear friend in London. A genius. A charming interlocutor, able to entertain with class and humour, as well as being a fine conoisseur de la comédie humaine. I stayed 5 nights with a lady friend. We shared the superb double room, bright and spacious (rather odd in London) where the bed is a nest in which I had my most confortable rest. I've never met anything similar. The bathroom shines on its own, and it deserves time to savour the indulgence of the senses, echoing memories of "the Ballad of Kublai Khan"... Finally... I still miss the breakfast in David's kitchen!! A magic and super-positive power booster to begin the day with! Strongly recommended!

title: David´s wonderland in the east end of London
text: In June 2014 I spend three days at 40 Winks with David. Already when I booked a room, I expected to find a special place, but my expections were far exceeded. To dwell with David, is to enter as in a work of art an become acquainted with the artist. David is a very special Person, creativ, intelligent, warm an extraorinary polite. Upon my arrivel David was already waiting for me to welcome me an help me with my suitcase. When the door opened, I stepped - from the hurried Mile End Road - into another world. The house already exuded a magical atmosphere in the hallway. I felt like Alice in Wonderland! Each room in wich I looked, was even more beautiful than the room before. The decor of each room is tantamount to a composition. Many wounderful things like armchairs, mirrors, floor lamps, pillows, soft toys ... have been collected to settin up an artwork. You can feel how much love David has invested in the creation. But David loves not only beatiful things, he also likes to chat with his guests. He is a witty conversationalist an knows much about foreign people, antiques and politics. But he also knows all the cool locations for eating out in London and likes to give a recommendation. But best of all was the super comfortable bed, where I slepped wonderfull. In the golden bathroom I felt like a princess as well! I very much enjoyed my stay at 40 Winks with David and hope to come soon again. Christin from Germany

title: Charming
text: I stayed in a single room at it was great: amazing, cosy design felt like it was created to make you feel welcome. Being in the room is an experience of its own, it has a nice selection of books, soft calming light and incredibly comfortable bed - everything for an absolutely relaxing experience. The bathroom had a particular soft charming style and had a special atmosphere with its dim lights and decorations, so it was a pleasure of just spending time there with a book. The area is perfect for seeing London: very close to the tube station to Central London and also a good location for exploring East London. David was very helpful and ready to assist in any matters, includig recommendations for sightseeing, breakfast or just a friendly chat, and overall, has succeeded tremendously in creating a magical experience for the guests.

title: Little Details
text: Bounding to the door to greet me, and from there treating me like an old friend, David Carter and his unique accommodation are something to behold. If only I had more time to enjoy and properly unwind

title: Quirky & refreshing.
text: We went along to see Andrew Wilson being interviewed about the new Alexander McQueen book he wrote, Blood beneath the skin. The place is beautifully strange & the service is attentive & warming. Champers, tea & the most spectacularly delicious cakes were served with a welcoming smile. I will be back for another event & recommend the quirky curious ones of you out there do the same. X

title: Hat off to David!
text: I haven't stayed at 40 Winks, just made an enquiry about the tarrif, as I am looking for a special birthday treat for two very special friends. His reply was warm, informative and concerned to make sure that it would be suitable for them - given the details I provided him with. Thank you, thank you. No wonder you have such positive reviews, the photographs on the website are stunning and I am sure that the reality is even more wonderful... I am not sure whether my friends will be able to visit, but I wish David continuing sucess with his business.

title: exclusive and stylish ambience
text: I travel a lot and I usually go to 4 or 5 stars chain hotels that have all the same look. This hotel is the opposite with a unique ambience where every small detail is important and especially selected to be there. You feel good to be part of it. In addition, the elegant Mr. Carter is always available for chatting with a warm cup of tea or coffee

title: Fabulous stay
text: I had booked a room at 40Winks for my husband and I. We both fans of great interior design and David's B&B is just a gem. Each room is decorated with an eye for quality, beauty and style, without losing the homely touch. We also enjoyed the warm welcome at 40Winks. We loved everything it!

title: Experimenting poetry in all ways
text: 40 winks is one of the most unique places and experience I have had the pleasure to dive in, David is the most welcoming and charming host, and an perfect master of ceremony for his famous woderfull bedtime stories evenings. Go through the rooms and you will not be able to stop looking at all the beautifull and carefully chosen objects, sculptures, art, walls, carpets. Everything is a gift to your eyes and brings you in a very special out of time incredibly warm bubble, you wish you never had to leave. Thank you again David for letting me in your inspiring world.

title: Top hat and tales
text: I live in East London, but I went to 40 winks for a little holiday. I had arranged a surprise for my girlfriend, who only had the address of 40 winks, and no other information. I went earlier in the day to meet David and we talked so much I completely forgot time. David is a gentleman and he has created a wonderful place. David later greeted a rather surprised young lady at the door and was the perfect surprise host. He poured the champagne and provided a wonderful ice bucket in the shape of a top hat. It is a comfort and a joy to know that there are still people like David who delight in the exuberance of life. Its a special place I am looking forward to hearing more of his stories soon. Thanks again David, I take my hat off to you sir.

title: More than a hotel...
text: As a birthday treat to myself I decided to spend the night in a most extraordinary hotel and 40 Winks did not disappoint! Step through the front door and literally step into a fantasy world of opulence, glamour and charm. David is the perfect host and welcomes you into his world with a cup of tea and good conversation. I stayed in the single room (or should I say 'boudoir') with elegant antique furnishings and a luxurious bed. 40 Winks is so much more than a hotel - it is an experience that shouldn't be missed!

title: Just the ticket for pure theatrical escapism.
text: Somebody once said, they entered 40 Winks a banker and left as a poet. You may well question the authenticity of this statement, but I can guarantee that spending a night or two at David Carter's unique 300 year old home will leave you inspired in some way or another. I challenge you all to remain disaffected when the stoical owner casts his mesmerizing spell. We came to know of Mr Carter from within the pages of a colourful coffee-table book entitled 'I am Dandy - The Return of the Elegant Gentleman'. I can vouch that David qualifies Legendary status primarily based on his mantra that dressing formally enhances any occasion. He will personally welcome you into his unique secret world that is part Alice in Wonderland, part art gallery / museum beautifully brimming with carefully curated curiosities. As residents of the capital, I opted to take the missus out on a mystery two-nighter birthday weekend outing enabling us to leisurely explore the city and in order to avoid jet-lag altogether. And a delicious weekend it was too. We greatly relished a particularly surreal parting breakfast when our host reported progress on his latest interior-design project -a former Sausage factory, whilst his Italian Maid - a former Royal Opera House Ballerina - took on the ironing in authentic Edwardian maids dress. Thank you once again David for letting us dip our toes into your wonderfully creative universe.

title: Other world experience in East London -- just magical.
text: I only had one night in London and had read about 40 Winks -- I immediately knew I had to stay there. All I have to say is it wasn't long enough and I will have to go back soon to experience that whimsical, magical place. David is an amazing host and SO interesting. I learned a lot and slept under the watch of Lady Gaga.

title: A Fairytale in London
text: I stayed at 40 Winks this past weekend and it was such an incredible experience. The moment you step inside, you feel immersed in a fairytale-like atmosphere. Not only are all of the rooms decorated with the upmost elegance, but David Carter is truly a special host. His amazing energy and wonderful personality added so much to this experience. He showed me the coolest part of town, Shoreditch, and made me feel right at home. 40 Winks is the place to stay if you want an alternate experience from the big and busy hotel scene. You are so close to the tube stops and you can go anywhere your heart desires very easily. The bed was one of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in and the entire place was comfortable, remarkable, and purely dream-like. This is a tucked away, secret garden, stunning home, that you should feel lucky and wanting to see when in London. Thank you David!!!

title: Out of this world
text: My (now) husband and I were looking for a place to stay for a couple of nights before and after our wedding, which took place in a venue in East London. After weeks of combing through every hotel in the area, we came across 40 Winks almost by accident. I cannot describe our surprise and disbelief when we found this hidden gem in an area we thought we knew so well. From the moment we stepped inside, we knew there could not be a place more special to spend our wedding night. Behind the door of an (almost) ordinary-looking townhouse on a very ordinary street, there’s an entirely extra-ordinary world, full of magical quirkiness, romance and most beautiful detail. Thank you, Mr Carter for such fairy tale start and end to our wedding day. It could not have been more perfect. We hope to stay in touch! Kate & Karl

title: A most intriguing experience.
text: Staying at 40 winks is a most intriguing experience and something you will not forget. David Carter is clearly a highly talented designer and has created some fascinating spaces within his home which he is willing to share. David is most welcoming and one feels as though one is staying at a slightly eccentric (in a good way) country house within the East End of London. The bathroom is spectacular and relaxing and the rest of the house is interesting and quirky - I liked David's general enthusiasm and knowledge of the area. 40 Winks is a superbly upmarket and trendy bed and breakfast topped of with a most engaging host.

title: Mrs Kathy Keefe
text: What can I say that hasn't already been said about 40 Winks and its fabulous host David Carter! Well, for starter's...it's the most fabulous place I have ever had the pleasure of staying at. David is a splendid chap, who had plenty of time to welcome my husband and I into his home to spend a night in London for our Rubymoon anniversary. The house is situated close in proximity to Stepney Green underground station. This enabled us to reach the places we wanted to visit on our short visit to London. The house itself is quirky, with lots of imaginative design and you can see at a glance that it has been created with lots of love and style! The bathroom is adorable and very chic! The bedroom was very spacious, with lots of style and comfort! The most outstanding thing was how immaculate and pristine the entire house was kept. We will not hesitate to re-visit David and his beautiful stylish hotel, hopefully sometime soon.

title: Hidden Gem on the Mile End Road!
text: I booked both rooms at 40 Winks for one night, for my parents and myself, essentially so we had a place nearby to stay after my brother's wedding. My brother and sister in law were celebrating at the rather quirky Les Trois Garcons restaurant nearby and I felt that 40 Winks would keep these aesthetic themes running through the weekend and would make it even more memorable. Booking with David was so straightforward

title: A peculiar and highly individual place
text: This is a highly individual place close to a bus stop and two tube stations with good working wireless lan in your room. The welcome was a bit strange when you are asked if you are staying in the right place (especially after having payed in advance). The breakfast was basic continental and nothing to lift up your heart. Having a shared bathroom for the overnight price being charged does not really make it good value for money. But if you are out for the extraordinary this is the place to look for

title: A unique experience -
text: 40 winks is not your standard accommodation, so don't go if standard is what you are looking for. But definitely go if you are ready for a different, exciting and unique invitation to share this beautiful home. Remember, it is a home, and not a conventional hotel, and the experience is anything but conventional. The two rooms are beautifully designed, as is the whole house. The house is the venue for fashion photo shoots and other activities. I attended the Bedtime Story night -a fabulous fun evening and I was told in advance of what would be going on in the house during my stay. I loved it all - the querkiness of the atmosphere, the gorgeous room, the warm host. I felt at home and would definitely go back next time I am in London.

title: 40 winks the place to be in London
text: 40 winks, for David's house is a tale of a child, let go your imagination and your life prince become a reality. The house is decorated with great elegance, the home of David's wonderful, every detail is thought out. located in the trendy East London, London you live outside the crowd with all the benefits of a trendy neighborhood. I had the chance to live there for two weeks, I will never forget this wonderful experience!

title: Absolutely fabulous!
text: We had a great stay at 40 Winks last week. David is a lovely and charming host and the interior is amazing. The bed is super comfy and of course I had to try the fab bathtub! David offered us a cocktail before we went out for dinner and a lovely breakfast the day after. Definitely a place I would love to come back to!

title: Jmarsh
text: 40 winks is the most beautiful luxury boutique hotel ever. I have had the most enjoyable and memorable experience, something I will always treasure. Thank you 40 WINKS I sooo look forward to the pleasure of returning again.

title: Magical stay
text: My husband and I stayed for our wedding night. It was a wonderful place to relax before our wedding party and then spend our first night together as a married couple.
