David is a warm and friendly host. The only small point to note is that the bathroom has a bath not a shower, but this was not an issue for us at all. All in all, highly recommended - thank you!

title: Colourful, spiritual and theatrical
text: Well...wow! What an experience :-)...from start to finish great fun and will not be forgotten. 40 winks really is something special and to be experienced - be prepared to be welcomed by David. The double room was very comfortable, relaxing and spacious (though a little noisy with traffic). Good location for restaurants and markets and David has a lot of local knowledge to help if needed. Very close to tube. All in all - great fun! Go with an open mind... Happy adventures Paul and Kerry :-)

title: A wonderful stay with hospitable staff.
text: We vist Beaufort regularly to escape from the hustle and bustle of city life and the service has been exceptional every time. The rooms are warm and welcoming and the manager and staff are polite and cater to all our needs with a smile. I would rate Beaufort 10/10 for everything and would recommend this to anyone. Also, the afternoon cream tea is delicious!

title: Lovely hotel
text: I stayed here with my boyfriend recently and we will definitely be returning! On arrival at check in I was advised we have been upgraded to a junior suite which was a lovely surprise. We were told the cream tea is served between 3-5pm and I asked if it were possible to have it sooner as we have to leave at 3 for a show. They called the chef to check the scones were ready which they were and had it delivered to our room. The scones tasted heavenly and went down a treat. The room itself was so nice. Was perfectly sized and really beautifully decorated. The bed was so comfortable and the bathroom was lovely and stocked with Molton Brown goodies. The complimentary bar is a nice touch and the staff are just so friendly. I've seen comments complaining about the lift and having to use the stairs but that didn't bother us. The staff offered to take our bags up for us and to be honest, it's not too much of an effort to walk up and down stairs. We had a slight issue with my breakfast but the staff were very apologetic and took the cost of both plus all over room service charges off our bill and allowed us to check out later. Really didn't expect them to go above and beyond. You won't be disappointed if you book to stay here!

title: Nice with quite a few disappointments...
text: I booked the hotel as a special treat for my fiance's birthday. It cost £200 for one night, which is what it cost me the week before for 6 nights in an extremely good 4* in Milan. Positives: Lovely design, spotlessly clean, trendy. Ideal position in Knightsbridge, nice restaurants nearby etc. free drinks between 3-11 Negatives for a 4*: Very small room No coffee/tea facilities in room Awful view, despite requesting a nice view for the occasion No flowers in room as stated when booking 3 light bulbs were out in the ceiling - one being down some stairs to the bathroom which was dangerously dark (plus a screw sticking out of the flooring which hurt my foot) The quilt appeared to be a single in a double cover and didn't actually cover the double bed surface Curtains were stuck open and falling off where someone had tried to close them. So overall, not that great unfortunately.

title: Second visit
text: This was our second visit, and we got to the hotel to drop our bags off, around 4 hours before check in. However whilst we had a cup of tea we were told our room was actually ready and we had been upgraded which was a lovely surprise, especially as the break was for our wedding anniversary. The room was lovely, tastefully decorated and a good size. We had the complimentary cream tea in the afternoon, along with some champagne from the bar whilst listening to the jazz. I cannot fault this hotel, and will definitely be returning. It is a hidden gem, with brilliant staff and a great location.

title: We felt so welcome
text: Thanks to all the staff at the Beaufort who without fail were charming and helpful. A smaller hotel in a very convenient location worked out perfectly for my daughter and I. Stylish room (though too warm, need a thermostat as it bothered my green side to have radiator and AC on at the same time). The little extras like cream tea and courtesy bar all added to the sense that this was all about the guests. Funny isn't it, you'd think all hotel would think that way but in my experience it is a rare and special thing.

title: Lovely, clean, well located, hospitable and reasonably priced
text: I was looking for a reasonably priced hotel that was located fairly centrally as I only had one night in London. I was upgraded upon arrival and everything was very nice. The hotel staff were so friendly and helpful and organised my complimentary scones when I arrived even though it was past the regular time for high tea!

title: Short Break
text: Very nice friendly staff, we stayed in a junior suite which although was very nice required a spruce up on the detail. Tea & coffee facilities in the room would have been nice. Complimentary bar in the lounge area was a nice touch although we didn't use it.

title: Comfortable, good location and friendly.
text: This is a little gem of a hotel. Its excellent location on a quiet street near Knightsbridge and its very frendly and helpful staff made this hotel a great choice. We were travelling to South Africa and decided to spend a couple of nights in London. We had a double room on the lower level which was roomy, immaculately clean, and tastefully decorated. We would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel to other travellers, a great base in which to explore central London.

title: Boutique hotel in great location but go out for breakfast
text: I was allocated room 4 on the ground floor & it was very quiet clean & comfortable. It has been stylishly updated in last 5 or so years but really needs maintenance (scuffed paintwork, stains on lampshades & walls). The room was small but not cramped & while the mattress was a bit wobbly, I had great night's sleep. Lovely modern bathroom. Breakfast was dreadful: smallest blackened croissants, so go elsewhere.

title: Fabulous hotel
text: We stayed here for 2 nights in a Junior suite. The room was lovely with bay windows opening out onto a balcony, it was very spacious and comfortable, the Queen size bed was comfortable, the sofa bed not so comfortable which is to be expected from a sofa bed. Tea and coffee is brought to your room anytime at your request, also scones and cream between 3 and 5pm. There is also help yourself beverages including alcohol between 3 and 11pm. Located in a great area, very safe, pretty, quiet and close to everything. Harrods is a short walk away and not far from the underground, a great base for sightseeing while in London. The staff were courteous and efficient. Our needs were always fulfilled immediately and with a smile. The wifi was patchy, my device dropped out constantly, luckily I didn't need to use the wifi for business so it did not affect me too much. If I were back in London I would definitely stay here again, we found the hotel comfortable and of a high standard.

title: Lovely hotel in central London
text: Lovely central hotel nearby all the great shopping destinations :) Tea, and afternoon drinks are much appreciated after shopping up a storm ! Lovely, comfortable rooms . Great. personal service.

title: Lovely gem in Knightsbridge
text: This boutique hotel isn't cheap, but it is wonderful. The entire staff is charming, and they will do everything and anything to make your stay pleasant. Rooms are small, but immaculate. The location is just two blocks from Harrods, so it's very convenient.

title: Beautiful property in the heart of Knightsbridge
text: We recently spend 5 nights at this lovely little hotel on a quite street around the corner from Harrods. The staff were very helpful and friendly and we found the room and bathroom quite spacious by European standards. Some of our favourite things include: - free water and soft drinks throughout the day - free wireless internet - afternoon tea with homemade scones available in the afternoon We felt quite at home at this lovely boutique and we will definitely return on our next stay in London.

title: Love the Beaufort
text: We just returned from a family holiday in London. Our stay at the Beaufort was perfect. The staff was super. We had a suite for the 4 of us and it worked out really well. It is a great neighborhood, quiet, yet centrally located. Close to the tube, Harrods, Museums and Kensington Gardens.

title: Do Not Stay Here!
text: This is not a luxury boutique hotel. At best, it is a "bed and breakfast". The only good point is that it is in a good location in Knightsbridge and is close to museums and shopping. But once inside the hotel it becomes a massive disappointment. Uncaring staff, noisy rooms, thin walls, no security. You can hear EVERYTHING! You have to eat breakfast either in your room or in the lobby if you can call it that. Free bar is a mini fridge in the lobby. What a joke. There are many other choices - save your money and go somewhere else.

title: Feeling at home
text: If you enjoy small, cozy hotels then this is for you (not to be confused with small rooms). It is perfectly located, one block away from Harrods, in a quiet street. The staff was very helpful and proactive. I didn't give it 5 stars due to a minor incident, for which the staff responded very well and soon offered solutions. Great for couples! Rooms are ample and impeccable, made me feel as comfortable as home!

title: Luxurious Stay at the Beaufort Hotel
text: I stayed in the Beaufort for one glorious evening in London. I cannot recommend it more highly. The staff were incredibly welcoming immediately upon arrival. I felt totally taken care of. Once they settled us into our rooms, we were immediately served our complimentary cream tea. Such a nice touch--it was the perfect start to our London trip. So nice not to have to go out and find a tea place to enjoy the English essential. After tea, we went back to our rooms to relax. Amazingly comfy beds, nice tvs, and great bathroom. What more does a girl need before an evening night out? Oh she could use a glass of champagne of course from the complimentary bar! For a 21 year old, free alcohol is always a nice touch. For anyone who drinks actually so...the staff is more than happy to help you! They also provided little bar snacks like chips and olives. The front desk was so helpful in providing dinner recommendations and directions to the theater. The next morning, I took full advantage of the coffee service. Nothing better than having a steaming French press delivered straight to your room. Great way to start our morning in London. The Beaufort is in a great location. Really close to tons of cute restaurants, Hyde Park, shopping, and of course the London Institution of Harrrods. All in all no detail at the Beaufort goes unnoticed and it was a totally relaxing stay.

title: Worst hotel
text: We arrived at this hotel after a very long train journey,appearance of hotel not very welcoming,checked in to be told 7th floor,one person in tiny lift with bag ,needed an oxygen mask when we got to room,we booked a family suite room tiny! For £734.00 for one night it should have been a palace window smashed wallpaper hanging off horrible smell ,went to reception and complained partner very unhappy,got our money back and checked out ,managed to get into the Marriott hotel on Marble Arch lovely hotel for a third if the price!pure luxury!

title: Absolutely fabulous, as always!
text: This was my second stay at The Beaufort, and it's just as wonderful as it's always been. The rooms are comfortable and clean, the location is fantastic (steps away from Harrods and the Tube), and the service is amazing. The complimentary bar on top of the tea and scones are the perfect way to relax after a long day in London. The neighborhood is busy with Harrod's traffic, yet the hotel is located on a remarkably quiet street in the midst of it all. The staff is friendly and helpful, (especially Jesus! That man deserves a raise!) All in all, I think the Beaufort is the perfect place to stay in London and I will make it a point to come back to this hotel as often as possible. Thank you all again for a wonderful stay!

title: Gem of a Hotel in the heart of London
text: This gorgeous hotel, situated in a very quiet street, is a complete gem of a place. The staff are warm and welcoming. I stayed in one of the junior suites and it was so comfortable and spacious. It is so central, Harrods is a 4 minute walkaway! I loved staying here, female on my own, I felt safe and secure. I am looking forward to staying here again.

title: excellent service, staff are a credit to this little gem
text: we returned from our london trip yesterday, and have nothing but praise for this beautiful little place. we were both ill with the flu during our stay and the staff were so very kind and helpful. we will certainly be back. they have such excellent business relationships with surrounding restaurants and services our every need was catered for! even arranged an excellent limo/town car service to take us back to the station - we travelled in luxury and style for the same price as a london cab!

title: Very Good for the location
text: A very enjoyable one night stay in an unusual boutique hotel. The big asset of the hotel is its location in Knightsbridge with Harrods just a two-minute walk away. From the moment we arrived until we departed, the staff were all very friendly and helpful. The room was spacious (for London) and importantly, clean and well maintained. The bed was very comfy, air conditioning worked well and so we had a very good night's sleep. One of the bonuses is complimentary drinks until 11pm in the downstairs lounge...quite literally, like being in someone's front room/lounge. There was Champagne, lager, spirits, soft drinks and coffees. As the hotel is like a converted multi-story townhouse, it does feel quite small and the lift is like something from the 19th century. But that aside, the hotel is well worth a visit. We had a reduced rate from a third-party web-site, which made it better value. I do not think we would have stayed if we had to pay the full price though.

title: A welcoming, small hotel in Knightsbridge with cream tea and bar
text: I really enjoyed by one-night stay at The Beaufort. I got a very warm welcome when I arrived and was shown to my very comfortable room. The reception gave some helpful suggestions about where I might go for dinner. The hotel runs an open bar so on my return I poured myself a generous whisky and retired to my bedroom for a hot bath and then bed with a good book. The following morning for breakfast I had a delicious freshly made omelette delivered to my room at the time I'd specified. I managed to squeeze in some shopping into my schedule so I was relieved to be able to go back to the hotel in the afternoon for the complementary scones and tea..... the scones were so delicious that I even asked for the recipe. This is a small hotel with a very homely feel very close to Harrods. The staff are very helpful about checking out and finding parking spaces. Thoroughly recommended.

title: Just delightful
text: Have just spent three nights here - our third visit. As always, it's just a delight - a wonderful location, yet on a quiet street. It's so gentle! - cool design, charming and helpful staff, calm environment. The little complimentary extras (drinks, teas etc,) are simply a treat. I'll always stay here!

title: A wonderful retreat in the heart of the city!
text: The Beaufort provides a welcome respite after a busy day of sightseeing and shopping . The quiet, tree-lined street is just steps away from outstanding restaurants and shops, and provides easy access to many of London's major sights. We particularly enjoyed the open bar provided in the reception area, where we could relax, discuss the day's activities, and make plans for the evening. The entire staff is eager to ensure a wonderful stay in this little jewel of a hotel.

title: Little Gem of a Hotel
text: We stayed there only for one night, and was given a room on the fifth floor. I was very impressed with the layout of the room and the décor. We overlooked the main road/crescent, and was surprisingly impressed that the noise level was remarkable quiet. When we arrived the porter came straight to us to take our luggage to our room, and he then showed us where everything was and how it worked. There were bathrobes in the bathroom which was a nice touch, although we didn't use them. I have read that some of the rooms were quite small, but our wasn't, we had a large bed and small area accommodating a sofa. The check in was very quick and everything was explained to us on our arrival. Our deal included a complimentary cream tea. Tea, coffee and soft drinks were available free of charge 24 hours a day, and the hotel offered a complimentary bar between 3pm and 11pm, and a good selection of drinks to choose from. We ordered an 'Express Breakfast' and asked it to be delivered at 8.15, and sure enough bang on the dot it came. Nothing was too much trouble for the staff at this hotel and it was a little gem of a find. The only negative I would say is that the lounge and reception and bar area are all within the same area, so privacy is not so good. The hotel is situated two streets away from Harrods, about half way up a cul de sac, and surprisingly we slept with the window open and didn't hear any noise at all - very peaceful. Would I go back again - definitely.

title: Very enjoyable stay!!
text: My wife and I stayed here for one night while I was on business. It's a small hotel that looks like a grand mews house in a lovely quiet side-street location. The free overnight parking on the street right outside is a bonus. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful and our room on the ground floor at the front was very nice. The extensive free bar (from 3 pm to 11 pm) was a nice touch, as was the complimentary tea/coffee served to the lounge or room. We will definitely be returning!

title: The Beaufort is tops for price, location and warmhearted hospitality
text: We just returned from London and Paris...and our stay at the Beaufort in Knightsbridge was the most savvy booking we made. The staff was incredibly warm and hospitable--learning our names on day one and personally greeting us throughout our stay...offering a wonderful afternoon tea with clotted cream and freshly baked scones...stocking a complimentary bar with quite good sparkling wine and a plethora of mineral water...procuring last-minute theatre tickets to an in-demand West End musical...and making sure that our room was clean, comfortable and well-stocked with fresh towels and linens at all times. This is the level of service I typically find at a Four Seasons...and we found it at a fashionable London address at a fraction of Four Seasons prices. Yes, Harrod's is a few hundred steps away...but be sure and head in the other direction at some point during your stay--into South Kensington--for the truly memorable upscale boutiques and restaurants that reside within walking distance of the Beaufort. This place is a find--and a great value to be sure.

title: Amazing stay!
text: We were so happy with our stay here for 1 night just before Christmas. Staff were very helpful and happy. The room was lovely really big for a central London London hotel. We even had a balcony. Location is perfect for Knightsbridge, Kensington shopping and museums. The v&a is 10 min away and Harrods only 5! They have a free bar from 3pm. We read this on a review and thought there must be a catch, but honestly there is everything you can think of. And you help yourself. There's a seating area in reception which is quite nice for pre dinner drinks. And when we came back we were able to take drinks back to our room. This is a brilliant plus to staying here. We choose to have breakfast in bed, and it was lovely. Poached eggs were nicely cooked, toast, juice coffee etc lots of choice on menu and well executed. I can't thing of anything negative about this hotel. We will be recommending this hotel and will stay again soon. Brilliant.

title: Great little hotel
text: Travelling as a family, we booked a junior suite (295 pounds/night) with use of the sofa bed for our teenage daughter (extra charge 40 pounds). This was a perfect choice for a 2 night busy shopping&theatre weekend in London. We loved this hotel, but it's a very easy-going style of hotel. If you like the flashy luxury 5 star style, look somewhere else. Positives: I had requested a room on a higher floor, with view and away from the lift and this had been taken into account. Our room No 43 overlooked the Beaufort Gardens cul-de-sac and was situtated as far away from the lift as possible. The room was pretty small for a junior suite but OK by London standards. Very nicely decorated and with trendy cusions and nice darkwood modern furniture and a flat screen TV. The location is excellent, just 1 minute away from Harrods and the busy Brompton Road but removed from the noise and very quiet. We slept with the window open and didn't get disturbed at all by the traffic. The complimentary 'bar' (= help youfself fridge/cupboard in the lobby) is a nice touch instead of expensive in-room minibars and we enjoyed a glass of fresh white wine - which we brought up to our room - upon our return from a busy day. Reception staff was very friendly, smiling and efficient and helped with all our restaurant bookings, taxis etc. Negatives (although very minor): On our first night we came back from dinner to find the sofa bed was not prepared. After a call to reception, housekeeping arrived literally within 2 minutes to fix it - so no big deal. Housekeeping staff was very apologetic. The bathroom was a bit on the cramped side and could do with some refreshening (paint peeling of on corner of furniture). Also, there not very much cupboard space for 3 adults - enough for a short stay though. Breakfast is not included and added at 8.50/per person is just the very basic choice. Also the breakfast room is small. We opted for breakfast in one of the many coffee shops on Brompton Road - good choice, convenient and mcuh cheaper!

title: Great location but very small room
text: Despite the friendly staff and great location, I think this was the smallest hotel room of my life. There wasn’t even a bedside table - no room. They also resemble more a furnished apt than a hotel. There is no room for breakfast - you have to take it in your tiny small room. Not staying again. Ever.

title: A 3 STAR HOTELS AT 5 STAR PRICES
text: Having read so many positive reviews I was looking forward to my stay, albeit a short one. Having stayed at other Hotels in the immediate area I was aware of what a great location Beaufort Gardens offered. But what a letdown, from the moment the porter and myself tried to fit into a miniscule lift and then had to travel through a rabbit warren of narrow hallways and multiple doors before finally arriving at the room. This was not a room decorated in the manner of those represented on the website and definitely not worthy of a 5 star rating. However, the bathroom was large and light and bright. I pre-ordered a taxi for the following morning to Paddington Station but found a limousine had been ordered instead for a 5 minute journey. I HAVE STAYED AT MANY 5 STAR HOTELS IN LONDON AND THE BEAUFORT CERTAINLY SHOULD NOT BE CLASSIFIED AND PROMOTED IN THIS CATEGORY.

title: A huge thanks you to Izabella
text: Izabella rescued us yesterday. We had booked a junior suite through Lastminute.com and duly arrived only to be told that the hotel had informed Lastminute immediately that they were fully booked and our booking was void. Unfortunately, Lastminute had failed to tell us so we could make alternative arrangements. Izabella was so kind and lent us a room to change in for our party - very nice quiet rooms - tried to get hold of Lastminute and find us alternative accommodation close by and said we could leave our luggage. Will definitely stay here next time I need a good hotel in London but won't book through Lastminute. com!

title: Great Location, Good place
text: On a quiet cul de sac, just off the Brompton Road, two blocks down from Harrods. Great, if pricy, shopping is right in the area. If you are a runner and an Anglophile, one of the greatest runs anywhere is close by - Hyde Park & Kensington Gardens. Knightsbridge Tube stop (Picadilly line) is a couple of blocks away. Pret a Mange (great fresh/fast food chain) is a block away. The hotel is very clean and very nicely decorated, but small. Our room (a double) was very small, but nicely equipped - very comfortable queen size bed, A/C, cable TV, wireless, well lit. The bathroom was very clean and a good size. One thing to keep in mind. Many London hotels, including the Beaufort, do not include the 20% VAT in their posted rates on the website. In our case, this increased the cost from £230 per night to £276 per night.

title: Fantastic hotel
text: Stayed here over the weekend for one night and have nothing but great things to say about the hotel. The location of the hotel is exceptinal, and the service of the staff is unbeatable. I was also very shocked by value of the hotel especially for a hotel with a location as great as this. Will be returning

title: Great Find!
text: We've stayed in many London hotels, and the Beaufort is a hidden gem. Our room, although small (which we knew beforehand) was cozy, clean and had a bigger bathroom than many London hotels. The staff were very thorough on check-in, and very helpful during our stay. And who can fault the included drinks service, which enabled us to have water for our treks throughout the city and a nice glass of wine before bed? And the location is both quiet and convenient, a plus in busy London.

title: Amazing, convenient and so worth the price
text: This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. It is small and cozy, conveniently located near everything in London. The service was great. Free tea, scones and drinks in the lobby. The breakfast gets delivered to your room in the morning. The room was great size (considering most hotel rooms in London are relatively small). I would 100% stay here again and highly recommend it.

title: What an amazing boutique hotel
text: This place is tucked away in a quiet cul de sac 3 minutes walk from Harrods (and Knightsbridge Tube), 10 from Hyde Park Corner, 15 from Buckingham Palace, and 25 from Westminster Abbey (or Trafalgar Square). I know

title: This Hotel is like a cuddle
text: I've returned in this hotel for the 5th time for a brief business travel, and as for the previous experiences I got very comfortable. The hotel has small spaces (as typical of British houses) but very well-kept and clean . Also the rooms are small but comfortable. In particular I appreciated the comfort of the bed. Breakfast is excluded from the price and you can choose among three different typologie with different prices, and most important you can choose whatever you want. The breakfast can be served in the room or in the lounge, and I always prefer the lounge as I love sitting on the sofa, drinking coffee looking outside the big window with the sun coming in (when present

title: Great hide-away in the heart of Knightsbridge
text: Superb service and customer service with a home-like feel. WiFi could be better but other than that top marks for our favorite home away from home in London. Excellent staff. Cheers to our e Spanish girl :) Bob & Morgan

title: Everything you need, A Minutes walk from the hussle and bussle!
text: This spectacular hotel was a fantastic stay for us on the night we visited Gordan Ramsays Restaurant. The bed was extremely comfortable. We were impressed with the clean and spacious room and the comfy bathrobes. The afternoon tea and scones were delicious and the breakfast in the room was lovely too. Our only complaint was that the staff knocked the door before coming in, but did not wait for us to come to the door or to say to come in. I had to dash into the bathroom on these two occasions.

title: London Visit
text: Booked through IAPA and enjoyed our nights stay very much. Nice room - complimentary drinks, tea/scones and breakfast included. Our son was inlcuded in the complimentary drinks. Comfortable but small room with wi-fi and large bathroom. the staff were very efficient and pleasant.

title: Worn out
text: My wife and I sayed here just before Christmas. The hotel is superbly located in Knightsbridge close to Harrods, but that is where the good news ends. Sure, it looks marvellous on the web site but the hotel needs a serious upgrade. Rooms are TINY. Cleanliness average.

title: Fantastic stay for our anniversary
text: Beautiful hotel in great Knightsbridge location. Service was fantastic, as were the afternoon cream tea and room service breakfast. Suite was very smart, elegant and spacious with everything you could want for a romantic stay.

title: Not tiptop but certainly a pleasant stay
text: The pros of this hotel? Location, location. It's within walking distance of so much and convenient to tube. Great restaurants in the area on Brompton Rd. so we did not have to venture far in the evening to find food worth eating. The Beaufort's quiet location on a square off Brompton is delightful. We could keep the window open and sleep well. We had great big windows so lots of light. Very nice. The beds are very comfortable. We were put in a 5th floor perch which was fine with us. We were game to take the last flight on the stairs, since elevator ended on 4th floor. Elevator is very small but can accommodate 2 average adults, or 1 adult/1 suitcase. For the price however, there were a few glitches. We had no electricity in our bathroom one evening when it was "dressing for dinner" time. We waited over an hour for somebody to appear and fix the problem. Another time one bed side lamp did not work. Again, an electrical problem. Keep in mind there are no irons/ironing boards in the rooms, or at least in ours. We hung stuff in the bathroom during shower time to try to steam wrinkles out. These all were relatively minor annoyances, but for this price, should not happen. Generally, I felt the room had a lot of character. It was clean and quiet. The very small lobby was quite the evening scene of people enjoying cocktails together. My son visited for two nights and was put in a very depressing room in basement his first night. He looked out his window to see an extension ladder and other similar equipment stored. However, the staff was very quick to put him in a more pleasant room, his second night. Would we return? Strong maybe. This place has much more character than a fancy pants Ritz or other Big Hotel.

title: Fab hotel in a great location
text: Stayed overnight with my son. The hotel staff couldn't do enough for us so helpful and friendly. Breakfast served in the room at no extra charge for room service. Plenty of choice for breakfast. The room was very spacious and clean. Good value for money and a great position for sightseeing we will be back.

title: Like visiting a gracious friend's flat in London - amazing
text: We really enjoyed this hotel. It is on a lovely, tree lined, quiet street just off of Brompton Rd, around the corner from Harrods. Knightsbridge and South Kensington tube stations are within easy walking distance. You couldn't ask for a better location. Upon arrival, the staff made us a wonderful french pressed pot of coffee while we waited for our room. Our junior suite room was lovely and was spacious for a London hotel. The bathrooms are appointed with Grohe bath fixtures and marble tile. After spending a day out touring, it was nice to come home to a tray service of cream tea and the most delicious scones ever! They also have a nice feature - the residence bar - open from 3-11, you can just help yourself to any alcoholic drink. Soft drinks, water and juice are available anytime. We also really enjoyed the daily breakfast delivered promptly to our room. We also had daily access to a health club just down the street included in our package. We ended up only using it once though since we were so busy sightseeing and walking the city. The Beaufort staff was lovely and extremely helpful in recommending restaurants in the area. We had some amazing meals, all within a short walk of the hotel. (Brindisa, Racine and the Good Earth) When you are paying London hotel prices, it is nice not to be charged extra for every little thing.

title: Good location, warm reception and courteous staff. Helpful to a foreigner.
text: Very good location for Underground trains, museums and shopping(Harrods, etc.). Great restaurants are just short walks. Kensington Palace, the Victoria and Albert Museum and The Museum of Natural History are minutes away.

title: One of Londons best kept secrets.
text: Luxurious, decadent, contemporary and stylish. The hotel,provided us with classic English traditional,luxury and located right in the heart of Knightsbride. We enjoyed beautiful afternoon tea each day, wonderful staff who couldn't do enough for us, friendly, real and highly recommended staff that were just a pleasure to,talk to at any time of the day or night. They made our whole weekend extra special. I travel the world and stay in top hotels....this one is definitely in my top ten.

title: Fab location, charming little haven
text: Stayed for 2 nights for a Christmas shopping break. Totally recommend the place. Loved the room and enjoyed the free help yourself bar. Brilliant location and so quiet. Nice breakfast and high tea and can't wait to return.

title: Very nice hotel to stay at
text: Very nice location for this hotel. The reception girls were very friendly and professional. The room was a bit small, but very clean and nicely decorated. I really appreciated the fact we could put the heat on very easily (like at home) whereas it's not possible on most of other hotels which have the same temperature everywhere. I will definitely come back!

title: Always a lovely refuge from the bustle of London
text: I started staying at the Beaufort many moons ago when I would go to London to work. Fast-forward to 2016 and I returned with family and friends for a lovely respite at this charming hotel. The staff was very accommodating, the facilities tidy and charming, the afternoon tea always a treat (love that clotted cream) and the open bar a lovely touch when gathering with new and old friends in the living room/lobby. The Beaufort holds a special place in my memories and this visit, did not diminish those memories.

title: OK for a few nights in London
text: I stayed at The Beaufort for the nights of 4 and 5 October 2014. This was my second stay at the hotel after my stay in April 2012. The hotel seems to have ‘lost its edge’ since my previous stay. I did not feel the same sense of hospitality as my previous trip. I stayed in a room downstairs this time, whereas last time I was upstairs. Despite a note on their website when I booked the room mentioning that I was a previous guest, no effort was made to recognize this fact. The complimentary afternoon scones are a treat, as they always have been. That is a highlight of staying at the hotel. As is the relaxing area in the lobby and downstairs. I found the room comfortable though the bed itself was not great. The bathroom was fine. The hotel is nice and close to Harrod’s which is an added benefit. The Wi-Fi access is good and reasonably fast. All in all I would probably stay at this hotel again should I find myself in London.

title: Warm cozy stay
text: Had a short but really comfortable stay Rooms are well equipped. Warm for the cold outside which was really fantastic. Not large noisy breakfast room but a personal lounge or a choice to having breakfast in the main lobby which is Aldo very welcoming. But most of all it affordable. Thank you to the staff for s wonderful two days . It’s well located too did I forget that! 😂🙏🏾

title: Very good stay!
text: Hello, This boutique hotel is very charming and the staff is very welcoming. The hotel is located next to all the shopping places. It’s a walking distance to harrods and Harvey Nichols. To get to the rooms is like a labyrinth but it gets easier by the day. The area is very calm and you get good sleep. The rooms are very clean. It is great that they serve breakfast in bed since the do not have a dining room. I honestly think if you ever go to London book at The Beaufort. Enjoy your stay!

title: It's all about the room allocation!
text: Lovely little hotel ideally situated in Knightsbridge. Does everything it says in their blurb carried out with enthusiasm by caring staff. Lovely touches such as having a complimentary glass(es) of champagne (or whatever) in the lounge /reception before going out in the evening provides that extra special touch and makes for interesting conversation with fellow guests gathered. Unfortunately we stayed in Rm15 which reminded me of how a bedroom in an underground bunker would look but it was well appointed and on seeing a number of other rooms, no two the same, it seems we were unlucky with the allocation. No full english breakfast but lots of choice available nearby if you need that medicinal touch after a late night out! We will return assuming the pricing remains the same as it represents extremely good value.

title: Lovely place in fab location
text: My partner booked this hotel as a surprise for a romantic trip to London. It was expensive (£200) a night but worth it. We had booked a deluxe room through Secret Rooms and upon check in had been given a free upgrade to a junior suite. The room was big with a small sofa, plasma TV, comfy bed, and bathrobes. It was very nicely decorated. The best part for me was the afternoon tea which is free and served between 3pm and 5pm to your room, the scones were delicious! There is a free (help yourself) bar until 11pm with lots of choice including spirits, wine, champagne, beer and soft drinks. There are no tea or coffee facilities in the room but you can dial reception who will have a pot of fresh tea to your room within a minute or two - excellent service!! We had no problems with noise and the staff were very friendly. The only dissapointment was that continental breakfast was £14 per person, for the price we paid you would expect it to be included in the price. We chose to go for breakfast at Harrods instead!! We would definately stay there again.

title: Nothing too much trouble, a different style hotel, with class!
text: The Beaufort was a fantastic place to stay for our couple of days in London. The staff were excellent and absolutely nothing we asked was too much trouble - including leaving the bags there both days, getting gluten free cream tea, decaff drinks, use of an iron - we asked for all sorts! We were not made to feel a nuisance at all, it was so nice. There is no restaurant or tea making in the room, however, there is 24 hour reception and you can get beautifully presented drinks of choice brought to your room or a lounge at literally any time. We chose not to have the breakfast (went instead to Caffe Concerto across the road) but that was just personal choice. There is a self-service soft and alcoholic drinks bar for resident use and internet facilities. The bedroom was not huge but ample, there are seats, a coffee table, lovely bathroom, TV and the bed was extremely comfortable. The bedding had that luxurious feel and we slept well. The downstairs lounge has self-service coffee and I believe some office facilities. Good! Would definitely go again mainly down to the wonderful staff, the lovely decoration, general classy feel, the location and delicious gluten free scones!!

title: Working away again
text: Nice little boutique hotel friendly staff free drinks nice lounge and an overall good nights sleep in a cost central location right near harrods and the venue I was working would stay again really surprised at the price for such a prime location

title: Wonderful Hotel
text: We arrived at The Beaufort, at 9am on a Saturday morning, to a very warm welcome from the concierge. We checked in with the very friendly reception staff, left our luggage and went shopping for the day. The hotel is only five minutes walk from Harrods , Harvey Nichols,and Knightsbridge tube station. When we arrived back at the hotel, we found that our luggage had been put in our room, which to me was a nice touch. The complimentary cream tea, offered between 3 & 5 pm was enjoyed immensely by my wife and myself, as was the complimentary non alcoholic and alcoholic drinks, offered between 3 & 11pm, Champagne included. Our room was lovely, plenty of wardrobe space, wonderful bed, big bathroom and everything was spotless. In the basement, there is a computer room,( internet is free ) which also has a free drinks area, including Tea & Coffee. This is a wonderful friendly hotel, run by people that care.

title: A wonderful place like home
text: Rooms were comfortable and spacious for 3 of us. Great afternoon tea (Crème Tea) complimentary daily were awesome. Location was perfect and within walking distance to Harrods. Neighbourhood was lovely and safe.

title: Nice local, lacks attention to detail you would expect
text: Stayed at this hotel in late August for a holiday with my wife. Well presented modern looking room with good facilities. Location is perfect, near the Knightsbridge tube station, shops and restaurants. What disappointed me with this place is the lack of detail to service. The staffs are pleasant enough however they appear to hide away out the back. Things I would expect this hotel to do: - the downstairs lounge/business room was not cleaned regularly. Complementary drinks and nibbles are great: I just don't like eating chips, nuts and olives that have been left out for days on end. The tea and coffee facilities are POOR. The milk on one occasion had turned into a solid... especially disappointing when I was dying for a cuppa as the rooms do not have tea/coffee facilities in the rooms. This is unacceptable. There should be at least a wet bar for this offering with spot checks done for this area. The lock on our door was damaged and we had to SLAM the door at least 3 times to get it to lock... (the room above must have had the same problem as they slammed the door four times in a row at 4am, no doubt to catch a plane) Simple little things like this which can be rectified would make this Hotel a must to return... Not for me however.... I hope they lift their game....

title: NICE LITTLE HOTEL IN CONVENIENT LOCATION
text: We recently booked two rooms at this little hotel for 3 nights in London. We were happy that it had a great location very close to Harrod's. We were able to walk to many of the places we wanted to visit including the Victoria and Albert Museum. There is lots of shopping and many restaurants nearby. The hotel was on a dead end street so it was very quiet. The staff was very nice and the rooms were nicely furnished. We did find that the rooms were too small to unpack or access our suitcases easily. Guests are offered water or soft drinks at any time. There are too many doors which is confusing when looking for a room.

title: Great hotel in a perfect location
text: I had a great stay at the Beaufort Hotel even though it was brief. The hotel is located very near shops and restaurants which was perfect for me on business . The room was cozy, bed comfortable and staff were very helpful with all my needs. After a long day of meetings, the free complimentary bar was nice way to finish off the day. I recommend this hotel and will be back in the near future.

title: Super little hotel
text: Being an avid checker of reviews I was slightly hesitant to book this hotel, but given the rate and the location I decided to give it the benefit of the doubt. One of the previous reviews spoke negatively about Room 15 - imagine my surprise when that was the key handed to me on checking in!!! I had booked a single and was told that I'd been upgraded to a double. Well I found the room to be extremely pleasant

title: Loved The Beaufort
text: We stayed at The Beaufort the fourth week in June 2003. Overall, we had a very positive experience and would return again without question. The Beaufort is a jewel. Intimate and private. The property is very modern and clean. The rooms seemed sound proof even. Our ONLY disappointment was with the SIZE of our double room. It appeared to be like an American dayroom. Perhaps we Americans are used to large sleeping rooms

title: Still oozing quality
text: Please make sure you keep this to yourself and don't tell your friends !!! But this is in my opinion one of the best hotels in London.. I love it here quiet , personable and immaculate. Continental breakfast in bed and drinks in the lounge ... Just heaven. Looking forward to my next trip down in June .

title: Delightful, Cozy and Perfect for Business or Pleasure
text: My daughter and I had the pleasure of staying at the Beaufort Hotel for a short London holiday. We found the staff courteous, friendly and attentive. We enjoyed the daily cream tea provided with the room. Delicious and perfectly British. The room was very clean, well appointed and the bed was exceptionally comfortable. This was a lovely hotel away from the hustle and bustle of London but still in the middle of everything. A perfect spot for vacation or business travel.

title: One of the best 4* hotels in London
text: Stayed in the Beaufort whilst on business. Excellent room service and free bar. Very relaxed atmosphere. Hotel feels a little small although the rooms are of an average size. There is no restuarant so all meals are brought to you room. Feels very cosy and relaxed. I have stayed in around 10 4* hotels in central London and this was by far the best.

title: one night, very comfortable
text: would happily stay a lot longer, rooms small, but very nice and clean. great position, good reception, drinks available and part of cost of room nice and quiet, which is unusual for such a central location

title: Very nice, but not deluxe by any means
text: Recently stayed at this hotel - and as a boutique hotel I expected luxury, and spacious minimalism. I was also expecting somewhere quiet. I booked a deluxe room, which was no bigger than a standard Travelodge double, and had a small table and two rather plain armchairs plus the bed. This made it rather cramped when having tea in the room. There was no room service menu nor was any offered, although the website implies room service to be available. On our second night we returned at midnight, not having been advised the front door would be locked or how to gain access when it was, and had to knock loudly to get the night porter to let us in. On returning to the room, the tea tray was still there, the beds had not been turned down nor the room prepared. I would expect more from a hotel that claims to be offering a "deluxe" room. The bar/sitting area is small, if you had more than 10 people it would be full - hence we took drinks back to our room, although I found out later we could have taken them into a downstairs basement room. The complimentary drinks are nice but range of drinks offered is limited. The deluxe room was on the ground floor, but not quiet. It had air con units outside the main window which looked out onto a small yard with some plant pots and a sort of sculpture. The bathroom window looked out onto some kind of fire escape steps into a lower yard area and (we think) a communal toilet, as we heard flushing, water running and banging doors late into the night. On the plus side the reception staff were friendly and helpful, and the porter was very smiley and friendly. if you need to be close to Harrods, and you like sleek minimalistic wooden floored rooms, then this hotel may be for you. If you are looking for luxury, real comfort and all the extras a real deluxe experience offers, then maybe not.

title: Overpriced and disappointing
text: We stayed in room 8, a stones throw from reception, embarrasing when you opened the door to collect the breakfast tray and people in reception could see you. The room was tiny and definately over priced for the amount of space, but the bathrobes were a nice touch and the bed was comfy. The biggest problem was the paper thin walls, you could hear everything, ALL night, from the annoying cough of the night porter, the piano music in reception and then people leaving the hotel from early in the morning. I can't comment on the other rooms, but a complimentary bar doesn't make up for a night in the noisey room (as described by the receptionist when I complained). Don't stay in room 8 if you appreciate space and you haven't packed ear plugs!

title: Very enjoyable stay.
text: After an exhausting flight from Sydney I arrived at The Beaufort at about 7.30 am, hoping that someone would be there to let me in and also fully expecting to have to wait a few hours until check-in. I was delighted when the friendly receptionist offered me a free upgrade to a vacant room that I could use straight away. Complimentary coffee was sent to my room as I unpacked so I was able to relax whilst I enjoyed that, shower and then have a full day in London. The room was spotless and comfortable whilst being on the small side as is the same with every other hotel I've ever stayed at in London. In fact this would certainly been the equal of any others if not the best. A handy location in a quiet cul de sac and extremely friendly and helpful staff made this a very enjoyable stay.

title: Fantastic Value
text: In an overpriced London hotel market this one really stands out. Fabulous location

title: Loved the Cream Tea!
text: We enjoyed our weekend stay very much. The hotel location was very central for us, being just down the road from Harrods and just a few minutes taxi ride from the Royal Albert Hall where we were visiting that evening. The hotel staff were very welcoming and the checking in process was speedy. We arrived just after 3pm to be told that our cream tea would be brought to our room - what a treat and, together with a free residents bar downstairs, was included in the price of our stay. There is a lift, but beware if you are claustrophobic as it is tiny and there is only room for two people and no luggage, or for one person and luggage! However, it performed its function perfectly well so no complaints. Our double room on the third floor was compact but well furnished with modern decor and air conditioning and it had a lovely, spacious en suite bathroom, which was immaculately clean. Breakfast the next day was brought to our room - again no extra charge for this service - along with a Sunday paper so that we could have a relaxing morning. As we were only staying one night and had arranged to go out during the evening, we did not spend time downstairs in the guests' lounge, but this looked comfortable and inviting, so next time we stay at the hotel, which we plan to do this summer, we will make sure we make full use of this facility. Overall we both felt that the hotel offered good value for money and we fthought it was far more personal than a number of others at we have stayed in central London.

title: Perfect Location, Lovely Accommodation, Wonderful Stay
text: We booked to stay at the Beaufort Hotel for a birthday celebration and a night out in London. The Beaufort is clean and contemporary and finished with nice touches such as the complimentary afternoon tea. The scones were served warm to our room and were delicious. It is in a great location with Harrods and Harvey Nichols and the designer shops at your fingertips, great restaurants and amenities close by. We had a lovely dinner at Mon Peliano located directly across the road from the hotel and would recommend this to other visitors. I would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to all.

title: An Exceptional Boutique Hotel
text: My wife and I recently spent 5 nights here on a 25th Wedding Anniversary trip. Despite first visiting great hotels in Rome and Paris, I have to say The Beaufort, London was the highlight of our vacation. I just cannot say enough good things about this fantastic hotel to do it justice. I thank all the reviewers of this hotel on TripAdvisor for persuading us to choose this location. The rooms are tastefully decorated and kept spotlessly clean. The service was truly impeccable. The free daily cream scones and tea and the complimentary premium alcoholic drinks from 3pm to 11pm were a very thoughtful touch. This is the absolute best hotel and location for a luxurious vacation or stop-over in London. It feels like home. We look forward to returning soon.

title: Terribly over-rated hotel
text: The Beaufort has a few very positive things going for it. First and foremost is its location, two blocks from Harrod's on a lovely, quiet street without through traffic, close to many small (if undistinguished) restaurants and plenty of shopping, convenient for transportation. Second, its open bar service and free wifi is commendable. Third, they deliver an acceptable (but not outstanding) breakfast to you each morning more or less on time. In addition, the water pressure is good, there is plenty of hot water, and they provide nice toiletries. However, this is not a four star hotel. Contrary to what many reviews here have said, the staff is subpar and often wrong in their recommendations (e.g., about where to go, travel distances, and general knowledge of London) and some of the front desk staff do not speak English well and have difficulty with their computer skills. More alarmingly, the cleanliness level of the hotel is poor. As specific examples, the first evening here, I dropped a coin on the floor near the nighttable next to the bed and bending down to pick it up discovered a dirty men's sock that, judging from the mount of dust covering it, had been there for many days. Furthermore, one evening I found a 3 inch wide broken piece of china on the stairs. In addition, I noticed small bowls of potato chips and olvies that had been left in the computer room for three days without being cleaned or refilled. Recognizing that this is an old building, it should be noted that the bathtubs (which also serve as the shower) are the narrowest I have ever encountered in travels around the world. It would be difficult, if not impossible, for a heavy individual to bathe comfortably in this apparatus. The bathrooms themselves are cramped and there are no shower curtains -- only a half shower door, so that water is almost guaranteed to get on the bathroom floor while showering. In my four days at the hotel, I overheard quite a few clients complaining to the front desk about the size of the rooms they had been assigned, and was surprised that the staff did not seem especially helpful about dealing with these complaints. Several arrivals also found that the front desk couldn't locate their reservation information. On the other hand, I also met a few couples who have returned again and again to this hotel, so clearly some people like these accomodations. London hotels are certainly not famous for their spaciousness, but this is a cramped hotel with a rickety, tiny lift (elevator) where most guests simply walk up and down the stairs to their rooms. In my opinion, it is poor value for the cost, and I find it hard to understand how there can be so many rave reviews about this hotel, as my experience with the less than competent staff and the hotel's cleanliness was decidedly disappointing.

title: Nice location, friendly staff
text: We choose this hotel because it is located at a calm street just one block from Harrods. The staff was very friendly, although not experienced. It was a nice surprise the free mini bar and the home made cookies served with the free coffee. However, the lobby is very small and the hotel decoration is starting to need renovation. We stay in a nice junior suit with balcony and for the price we paid we were pleased and thus we recommend this hotel.

title: Small but lovely
text: Our first stay. Everything superb. A new favorite certainly. Location excellent, Underground 2 minutes walk . Very friendly reception and welcome. Afternoon tea included and brought promptly to our room very well presented. All soft drinks included. Freshly prepared and appetizing breakfast was served in our room. All for a good rate too.

title: Incredibly overpriced & far from a luxury or 5 star hotel!
text: I never write reviews but I felt incredibly ripped off by this hotel and wanted to warn others. The street its on is adorable, the lobby was nice enough, and the few staff members were well-meaning, but not well trained. Payment for the room was required in advance upon check-in

title: A beautiful hotel near Harrods
text: This hotel is a real gem! Very convenient location and the service is absolutley equivalent to rthat at a 5 star hotel. The staff is always willing to help, always smiling and always making you feel at home. The fact that you are served afternoon tea every day, refreshments from 5-11 PM without charge every day, is a gift that cannot be underestimated. The rooms are fresh and beautiful.there might be some slighter items that need repair but the overall impression leaves you with warmth and a great smile. We have been to London at least 20 times and this hotel is absolutely one of the very best- a dream!

title: Charming hotel, excellent service
text: Perfect location, spacious and well-equipped room, extremely efficient and very friendly staff. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay, would definitely recommend this hotel - can't wait for our next visit!

title: A special Hotel in London
text: It is my first time to discover the Beaufort hotel It is very clean excellent decoration of the lounge and rooms simple with a fine taste and perfect choice of colors.Excellent service and very warm staff. The open bar is a unique idea and welcoming pleasant feature. Thank you for the management, I enjoyed my stay.

title: Fabulous Location, Good Place
text: On a quiet cul de sac, just off the Brompton Road, two blocks down from Harrods. Great, if pricy shopping is right in the area. If you are a runner and an Anglophile, one of the greatest runs anywhere is close by - Hyde Park & Kensington Gardens. Knightsbridge Tube stop (Picadilly line) is a couple of blocks away. Pret a Mange (great fresh/fast food chain) is a block away. The hotel is very clean and very nicely decorated, but small. Our room (a double) was very small, but nicely equipped - very comfortable queen size bed, A/C, cable TV, wireless, well lit. The bathroom was very clean and a good size. The hotel is pricey (this is London), but you are in a terrific location.

title: Excellent location
text: Excellent location, great staff, excellent value for money. I f you are lookig for a casual and friendly atmosphere, that's the place to stay ! We'll be back for sure.

title: Excellent Hotel, really friendly and professional
text: Myself and my mum visit London every year and this time decided to stay at the Beaufort. The hotel is in a great position for getting around London easily. The staff at the hotel are really friendly and helpful and saw to our every request making our stay very enjoyable. The breakfast is lovely and the lady who runs around making and delivering the food is truely wonderful, if only there were more people like her in the world. We are looking forward to going back next year.

title: Terrific staff, charming boutique hotel, great location!
text: What more can you ask for. The staff truly went out of their way for us. Breakfast, drinks. All the amenities and none of the corporate attitude. Nice room. The location cannot be beat. Thanks for everything!

title: Atrocious stay with very poor service and substandard rooms/breakfast
text: We stayed at the Beaufort Hotel in July for 1 night and unexpectedly one of our family members was seriously injured just prior to our stay at the Hotel. We required a change of rooms to ground floor and 2 rooms beside each other to help the family member walk/dress, enter/exit their room. Unfortunately, the hotel staff could not accommodate our needs and this necessitated our moving hotels. We requested a refund of the remaining nights given the emergency situation and were refused. For the 1 night we stayed we had a basement room, which is not only very small (unsuitable for 2 people), loud (you can hear the people upstairs and in the 'business lounge', and there is no ventilation. We also had a junior suite, which was a lovely room but the breakfast we ordered with the room was awful. Cereal in a box, plastic pre-wrapped muffins, cold coffee, bruised bananas and it was delivered late. The staff at this hotel were not only unsympathetic to the injuries of our family member, but they berated this person and made them feel unworthy and very uncomfortable (they were crying in the lobby and the staff just said they couldn't help with anything). We ended up moving just down the street to the Beaufort House (different from the Beaufort Hotel) and had a fantastic stay!

title: Great Staff and service! Hotel a bit tired!
text: This is my second visit to this hotel. The first time, almost two years ago, I was really impressed with the service and the decor. This time around great service, with great staff, but, the hotel is looking a bit tired. Breakfast in the room, along with a daily paper of my choice was a lovely and appreciated option. Location is superb for shopping and access to the tube. The street cafe/bars, at the end of the street and over the main road, are great for observing the world in this part of London. They offer good food and drink at reasonable prices. Overall I really enjoyed my visit-5 days, but, probably next time, will look for a different hotel.

title: A true treasure in Knightsbridge
text: Location superb. Walked to all attractions. Great restaraunts nearby. Superb service and lovely suites. Thanks to all at The Beaufort.

title: Charming hotel with the best scones!
text: Bathroom and dressing area were quite large. Loved full size window that opened up. Our reservations included breakfast delivered to our room each morning. Always on time and nice selection of items. On a quiet street but half a block from Harrods and fun fashion boutiques.

title: Boutique hotel on quiet cul de sac
text: Recently we spent 6 nights in a small but comfortable room and enjoyed one breakfast and complimentary afternoon tea delivered to the room. We relaxed in the lounge in the evenings with out complimentary drinks and had excellent meals at Patar Thai Restaurant and Racine's. It was nice to get away from the hustle and bustle of Knightsbridge and escape to the welcoming atmosphere at the Beaufort. The staff was extremely helpful. I would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Small - but location is great !
text: The hotel is essentially a converted residence within Beaufort Gardens which is a cul de sac. Consequently it is in a quiet area althoiugh it's just a two minute walk from Knightsbridge , Harrods etc . So , when it comes to location - this is difficult to beat . The rooms are small - though the bathroom we had ( full bath ) was spacious. There's no breakfast room as such - so guests are encouraged to consume their breakfast either in their bedroom ( somewhat tight for two persons) or in the basement lounge. That having been said , the hotel seeks to compensate for this shortcoming by offering cream teas , drinks etc practically all the day round - and free of charge. The staff are excellent and immensely friendly and helpful . So , , in spite of it's smallish rooms - the overall experience was a most pleasant one and I would stay there again most willingly . Thank you !

title: A good location, nice service and quality
text: Definitively a good place to stay when visiting London for a break-away week end. Location is ideal for shopping and culture. Service is at par with the elegant design. Would definitively recommend and will stay there again. Fits single travellers or family, men or women (elegant shopping area).

title: Lovely boutique hotel in perfect location
text: My husband, 12-year-old son and I stayed at this hotel for 5 nights. We had a queen bed and a queen pull out sofa. It was very comfortable and we found the service absolutely excellent. Our breakfast was served on a tray in our room precisely at the time requested. The tea was lovely and we all enjoyed the homemade scones, butter and jam. The staff was friendly and helpful making theatre and restaurant reservations. The location is two blocks from Harrods, and two blocks from Hyde Park. Our son found the atmosphere welcoming and comfortable. I will stay here whenever I am in London if possible, from now on.

title: Dont get room 1
text: I stayed here for one night and I am not sure I would stay agin. The reception is looking a bit worn but the welcome was fine. I was shown to a duluxe room in basement...it was a big nicely furnished room although I would have preferred a carpeted floor. There was no working air conditioning so I had to leave window open ensuring I was awake from 5 when milk arrived. The staff started letting the kitchen door slam at 6 and the movies and internet didnt work to fill in the time until my breakfast arrived! Nice handy setting though but not worth the money especially if you had paid full rack rate

title: Fab. little hotel.
text: Just had a weekend at the Beaufort with my husband. You can't beat the location and the staff are superb...nothing is too much trouble. The self service bar is great and permanent tea/coffee...well what can you say? I was pleasantly surprised and would not hesitate to stay there again.

title: What a gem!
text: Booked 3 rooms for New Year's Eve celebrating our daughters 18th birthday in town. Lived up everything we've read on TA and more. Friendly staff, nothing was too much trouble. Afternoon tea in the lounge area with a glass of champagne was a real treat. We were able to leave our bags next morning while we went out for breakfast and sightseeing which was an added bonus. We'll book again for sure. One tip - they do have a small lift as over 5 floors and the status are very steep! If this is a problem speak to them before arrival for a ground or first floor room!

title: A super nice hotel in an excellent location staffed with great people!
text: My parents were in London for the weekend so I wanted to book them in a hotel that was strategically located without them having to navigate the tube or buses. After reading through dozens of reviews on tripadvisor, I finally narrowed it down to Beaufort Hotel in Knightsbridge and I can’t imagine a better choice for them- or for anyone else for that matter! First of all, the location is just fantastic. It’s just a skip away from Harrods and Sloane Street where all the cool shops are located, yet it’s a super quiet hotel as it’s on a quiet street that’s just a corner away from the usual city hustle and bustle! The hotel staff was excellent, very welcoming, very helpful, very friendly and super accommodating! Every staff they came in contact with, from the bellhop to the reception to chambermaids were all helpful, friendly and pleasant! My parents felt very welcomed indeed. Besides the great staff, the hotel has some nice touches for its guests. Hotel guests can have any much complimentary hot or cold drinks (soda, sparkling or still water) served to them at the lobby, the lounge at the basement or at their room, at any time of the day. In the afternoons until 11pm, there is even an open bar at the lobby or the lounge at the basement where guests can pour themselves or be served some wine, sparkling wine or even some stiffer drinks. In the afternoons, when guests come back to the hotel for a break, guests can request for tea and fresh scones to be served at their room (my parents really enjoyed the freshly baked scones with clotted cream)!! Breakfast is not included in the room rates, but guests who wish to have breakfast at the hotel can have whatever they wish sent to their rooms. They can either place their breakfast orders the night before or if they don’t mind waiting, they can place it on the morning of. It’s all very flexible. WIFI reception is good throughout the hotel, from the lobby, to the room, to the lounge in the basement. And one afternoon, when we had some friends who live in London come over for a visit with my parents at the hotel, the staff generously sent tea and scones down to the lounge for everyone. My parents were very appreciative of this. This is definitely a hotel we will stay at again!! We will highly recommend it to friends and family visiting London as well.

title: Something different!
text: What an amazingly looking hotel, both on the outside and on the inside. The hotel in itself is conveniently located 10 minutes or so from Notting Hill Gate, and if you are tired of them overpriced and not so personal hotels then this is something for you. Our room was well mantained and nothing to complain about when it comes to being clean as well. While I will stay at this hotel again, be aware that some of those working at the hotel is indolent at best. Whilst sitting down for breakfast the first day, being our first time there, noone told us that we could order extra food. The lady at the front desk just did not care that we were there.. So the next day we ordered breakfast to our room, which was delivered promptly. So while it would not hurt some of the staff paying a little bit more attention, it is still an extraordinary hotel and we are 100% coming back!

title: have my doubts
text: I think I must agree with earlier reviews, the hotel is well located in a very quiet street but way overpriced

title: A video about Portobello Hotel
text: I found the hotel to be perfect for my fiance and I. We lounged around and didn't do much, but it was magnificent. As business traveler, I like to see a place before I stay there. A friend of mine recommended this video so I figured I should pass it along. http://www.tripfilms.com/Travel_Video-v63118-London-Where_to_Stay_in_London_Portobello_Hotel-Video.html

title: Great experience
text: We stayed in the hotel for 5 nights, two weeks ago, and thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The position is central yet quiet and in a very decent area of Notting Hill. It is in easy walking distance of Portobello Road, the Bus and Tube station. The standard of the Hotel is really good, it is like being a guest in a private stately home. It is a small boutique hotel with personal care and attention. The reception is staffed by mature well presented ladies who go out of their way to assist guests with restaurant suggestions and booking, places of interest to visit, organising taxi's and transfers to the airport. They require special mention as they far exceed the norm and were very helpful and went out of their way to ensure our stay was enjoyable and comfortable. The reception is manned 24 hours a day by these ladies so one has a feeling a security and care when returning. The staff compliment is small and focused. I would recommend Portobello Hotel and will be a regular guest in future.

title: Gem of a hotel
text: We really enjoyed our stay at this hotel, beautiful building with period furniture and a lovely collection of ornate teaspoons. Warm welcome by the receptionist Diane who showed us around, particularly liked the honesty bar in the sitting room. Excellent WiFi. If you want any exercise just climb the stairs to the fourth floor, we stayed in room 45 lovely comfortable bed had a feather topper. Conteninental breakfast was good excellent pastries. Nice touch was coming back to our room in the evening and finding a warm flask of I think it was Ovaltine, lovely.

title: Visit to the Ginstitute
text: We picked the hotel as it is within walking distance of the distillery. It is certainly a curious place to stay, really lovely staff and a fantastic room but definitely quirky. Would recommend it for a couple, probably not for families though

title: Perfect location and lovely team
text: What a fabulous find in Notting Hill. A super friendly team, unique rooms full of character and history and a wonderful location. Highly recommended. Room 13 has the biggest bed in the world! It even has steps to it.

title: A little small (room, bathroom) but aside from that -- top quality !
text: I had some reservations about this hotel given previous reviewers comments about the service. Anyway, perhaps these reviews were duly noted, because I felt the service was top notch. I arrived late + hungry and the receptionist went out of her way to persuade a nearby restaurant to let me dine there. And, the service remained polite, prompt and attentive for the rest of my weekend stay. The breakfast is fine (they do the coffee well) and if you feel like a snack, I found the options on the hotel menu very satisfactory. Only complaint is that my single room was very small -- the bed took up most of the space. And getting in + out of the bathroom was not easy in the space provided. A small gripe though -- and I did not spend much time indoors with Notting Hill outside

title: so much character, its beautiful
text: I really cant believe all the things i've just read. I have already stayed at the portobello 3 times this year. My boyfriend and I love it so much we stay in a different room everytime we have a special occasion. First was the round bed room and it was so romantic, it made me blush as soon as I entered the room at the thought of what the night would bring. Second was the oriental room. The mirror above the bed really is something special, even if the sight of yourself first thing in the morning is a little scary. And thirdly was the japanese room. It was so beautiful. Having our own private patio was great as the weather was warm. the spa bath was amazing also. I admit that the rooms are a little on the small side, but you are staying in a hotel, not living in this room. It is romatic, beautiful, individual and a wonderful place to stay. I would recomend the portobello hotel to anyone.

title: Perfect getaway
text: I just stayed for four days in "the round bedroom" at the portobello hotel. I had a fantastic stay in this legendary room where once Johnny Depp and Kate Moss filled the bathtub with champagne and had a soak! Other former guests in this room include van morrison, audrey tautou, patti smith, richard curtis and alice cooper!! The staff is super friendly, and the whole experience feels like visiting someones well appointed home! The staff bought food and snacks for my stay at no extra cost, and considering how legendary the room is, the price is not off putting, around 300.£ pr night!! I will be returning, that is for sure!!!

title: Hip London hotel
text: This was the place to be in a certain era of my youth. But no Mick Jagger or champagne baths now. Very middle class place to stay. Mostly comfortable but don’t recommend the single rooms where I had to stay the first 2 nights. My more expensive and larger room was delightful and wonderfully quiet. Great location for Nottinghill and North Ken. Great restaurants in walking distance. Staff was wonderful and a great reason to stay there.

title: A Little Gem
text: Stayed w/e of 6/7th Oct 2018, brilliant location just off Portobello Road, we suffered no issues with road noise, room backed on to private gardens, we had room number 1 and it was fabulous. It had a great little outside area, beautiful little conservatory, super comfy bed, lovely bathroom space. The girls on the front desk were very welcoming, we dropped our bags off early and they were in our room when we returned. Very clean, well stocked mini bar and snacks (although these are quite pricey). We had dinner at a local tapas bar as there is no restaurant but it is such a diverse area that it was nice to head out to eat, great location for lots of bars and pubs. We arrived back quite late but there was someone at the desk. Definitely recommend our room and this hotel, it’s not cheap but what is in London anymore?!

title: Bad Service For The Money
text: the Portobello Hotel most definitely has a charm that many hotels would have difficulty matching. It certainly is unique in its furnishings, beautiful Kensington setting and celebrity guest list. We decided to book to spend the night there on a weekend break to London. I picked the Royal Four Poster room, room 13. This room costs £295 per night with continental breakfast. When booking the hotel i had lovely service over the telephone, but when we got there it was another story. We arrived at the hotel and there were other people already in the small reception area. We waited for around six minutes while 2 staff members ignored us...finally on checking in they dissmissivly (is that a word??) said "there's the lift or the stairs". No offer to help with our heavy bags up the stairs. The hotel is a little tatty around the edges but i feel it adds to its charm. We got to our room which was lovely with lovely views. The widescreen tv that was promised was positioned at the side of the bed so that it was almost impossible to view anyway!! With breakfast you can request to have it brought to the room free of charge. at around 8am the following morning i rang downstairs to request this....i swear i woke the guy up! he spoke very little english , grunted something said ok and put the phone down!! On leaving...we went to hand the keys in..the guy who looked like a student, sat behind the reception desk with his head down, blatantly aware that we were standing there, and that is where he stayed for five minutes , no "sorry ill be with you in 2 minutes" nothing. Customer Service is at an all time low in this place. I would NEVER go again, cos its such a damn waste of money!! yeh many celebs have stayed there and it is kind of intriguing thinking... "i wonder whos been in this room" but its not worth £295 and grunts from staff members!!!!
