title: good location for Tube but room a bit stuffy
text: checked in late as traveled after work, quick and easy in the room in a couple of mins. Room was very clean and well laid out, but very warm, AC unit showed temp as 26, turned it down to try to cool the room, but didn't appear to do much, luckily we could leave it on while out, so when we got back it was a little cooler, not a lot though, couldn't leave the window open as there is a bar/restaurant behind the hotel an lot of people were standing outside smoking / drinking talking.Breakfast is basic, but a fair choice, why are scramble eggs always sloppy in these places. second morning didnt have breakfast as had early plans, but looks like that was a good job as the breakfast area was rammed. Left bags with reception so we didn't have to drag them around. One very big positive was that we managed to leave something behind in the room but when we called housekeeping they had already put it in lost property so all good.

title: Christmas in London 😊
text: We arrived late in the evening, (Immigration took about 2 hours to get through) and we were tired and cold. Front desk immediately gave us our key. So in summary: Room : 4/5 Staff: 4/5 Location: 5/5 Breakfast: 4/5 All in all, had a blast for my first time in London.

title: Pretty Good- with a few buts
text: Overall I was impressed. Comfortable quiet hotel, reasonably priced for such a good central location, with attentive and friendly staff. Excellent breakfast. When the dining room was packed, staff worked hard to keep the food coming and the tables cleared as soon as anyone was finished. It was very clean. The free WiFi was a nice touch. The bedroom was fine, with choice of pillows and a lovely shower. The hotel is very well situated- close to shops, restaurants, bus stops and tube stations. Liverpool Street station is 15 minutes walk away Now my "buts"- 3 things went wrong whilst I was there, none of them serious, but together enough to stop me giving a 5* rating. 1) One day no new towels were provided. Luckily there was one left, so I managed OK 2) On my last day, the TV did not work 3) On my last day the lifts were out of order and I had to manhandle my suitcase down 3 floors. None of these were major problems and I would be happy to recommend the hotel to others

title: The hotel and the staff were phenomenal!
text: We arrived Friday 8/19/2016 in the morning. We were greeted with the most helpful front desk clerk. The next day we again had a fantastic front desk staff clerk who assisted us when my mother was under the weather . The evening staff again were fantastic guiding us with transportation information and anything else we needed. Breakfast was great . The rooms are clean and modern! We had a great time for such a short stay. The location is great ! The staff does it all! They are the jack of all trades! The staff was so friendly and really made our staff so comfortable. We are planning to book again !

title: Saturday night in London
text: We had two adjoining rooms on the top (5th) floor (530 & 532)

title: Place for a night
text: The hotel's location is good - a short walk from Old Street tube station, a longer walk to Liverpool Street which is much better connected, and masses of cheap eateries nearby. The hotel is sandwiched between two roads and is functional rather than beautiful. My room on the 5th floor had air conditioning, a very good shower and a large sofa. The bed was on the soft side but as I was alone this did not matter. The room was clean as were the other areas of the hotel. The lift was slow and I took to using the stairs which were as they should be, clear of any obstruction and well lit. Probably due to the attractions elsewhere, the bar and dining area were empty in the evening. I had an acceptable but slightly highly priced meal but the service was very slow. An added inconvenience was the inability to charge the meal to the room as I had not said that I wished to use my card for other the cost of the room. Breakfast was satisfactory. The reception staff that I spoke to did not have a full grasp of English, not a problem but, having never booked into a hotel which had a policy of limiting the use of a credit card, led to a misunderstanding. Security might be a problem as there was easy access to the stairs from one of the streets. Prices of hotels do change but at GBP299 for a bed and breakfast is presumably what the market will bear in Wimbledon fortnight. I have stayed in some Intercontinental hotels for this price. Overall, a good place for a night or two but, as they say, nothing to write h one about/

title: Great hotel for a reasonable (London) price
text: We were looking for a one night stay for several family members attending a wedding nearby. This was easily the cheapest hotel so we were not expecting great things but hoped it would be adequate. We were very pleasantly surprised at the quality of the hotel which seems to have been recently re-furbished. The rooms are of the standard chain type but very nicely fitted out with very smart bathrooms. The beds were very comfortable (all of our party agreed) and the staff were friendly. The breakfast was fairly limited and of the help yourself variety but plenty of it - no grumbles considering the price. All in all we, we were very impressed and would stay again. Tip - check out nearby car parks if you come by car. There is a multi story a few minutes away for £18 per day. Cheaper than the hotel spaces of which there are very few.

title: Clean, tidy, good location
text: The hotel is in a good location with excellent transport links to the city. I arrived at 9.30 a.m. and after a 90 minute wait was granted early check-in.The staff at reception were extremely helpful and welcoming, so were the cleaning crew. The lifts seemed a bit tired and quite noisy but worked just fine. I asked for a quiet room overlooking the courtyard at the back of the hotel. The rooms are spacious, clean, tidy and look pretty much the same as in their website. The TV channel selection is a little limited for a Holiday Inn hotel, but good enough for a short stay. The noise from the air conditioning was loud, but not loud enough to warrant the complimentary ear plugs they provide in the room. WiFi was fast and reliable. Overall a pleasant experience.

title: Clean and convenient hotel
text: This hotel is well located, clean and well-run. It's a chain, so it is not interesting or surprising but it gets the job done very well. Staff is nice, but it was a little hard to get help with maps, restaurant recommendations. Our wifi worked perfectly in the room. Breakfast had a lot of food, mostly of an adequate quality.

title: Rooms could be better cleaned.
text: 20 min walk from Liverpool street station, or easy access with bus 205. Friendly receptionist, breakfast is in peak hours chaotic but free. Room is OK, but needs some thorough cleaning: chocolate paper under the sofa bed, beer cup under the other indicates that cleaning is not the top. Bathroom is tiny, shower cabin is moldy. Bed is rather uncomfortable, mattresses are worn out (springs are creaky) .

title: brilliant staff - very friendly and helpful
text: Upon arrival we started to get irritated as we should have booked parking but weren't aware. Didn't know where on earth we were going to park but the staff re arranged things and made a parking spot for us (my husband is disabled). Staff were really helpful and friendly - yes, the air con isn't the best, but a staff member brought me a room fan to alleviate the issue. Breakfast was ok - not brilliant, but perfectly functional and again the very friendly staff made it so much better! The room was spotless and we had no issues whatsoever. Thank you to all the brilliant staff for their attention and time which made our stay what it was.

title: Good location and rooms
text: I only stayed here for one night which was on business. However I was really happy with the location and quality of rooms. It's about 10 minutes from Liverpool Street so perfect for what I needed, and in the evening it's on the doorstep of the bars/restaurants of Hoxton and Shoreditch so again, really hapy with that. The room is fairly basic but it looked brand new and very modern so again I had no complaints about this. The only downside was the hot breakfast, scrambled eggs and sausage, so not the full English breakfast many other hotels offer. If I was working in this part of town I'd definately stay here again though.

title: Appalling conference facilities
text: We've used this hotel previously to accommodate overseas staff, this time we booked a room and a meeting room for three days. The small meeting room at the hotel does not have useable internet (0.6 Download speed), we're an Internet business and have to go online during meetings. Apparently the meeting room is too far from the router for proper connectivity. They moved us to a bigger room that had better internet, unfortunately the only gents toilet was blocked and our overseas guest was presented with overflowing excrement. This was fixed. For the 3rd day our team had to commute to Kings Cross. Will never use again, it's actually put me off using Holiday Inn for events although other hotels in the group are excellent. This one is 'letting the brand down' The rooms maybe OK but the hotel has failed as a business hotel. To be avoided.

title: Good location
text: Stayed here for a week in July.The location is good which makes getting around easy.Tube is close by.Lots of places to eat around too.Room however is a little cramped espresso when you have to use the sofa bed.Breakfast was ordinary.No variety,same menu throughout the week.But is complimentary so it was ok:). Overall it was a good stay.Room and bathroom was clean .

title: shower needs more power
text: got a good rate on advance purchase , so value for money,but would not stay here again. Room clean and comfortable, but hot. Couldn't have window open as would have been too noisy, but table fan provided kept it comfortable, as it ran v. quietly so could leave on all night. Main problem was with shower. Initially had hardly any water flow, after struggling to have shower ,and then complaining, maintenance did improve it, but was still very poor. So much so that we negotiated a discount on checking out. Also, we were not made aware at time of booking that there would be building work taking place. On check in were told that work would not start until 10. a.m. but ate breakfast at 8. 15 to the sound of hammering. However, staff were all very pleasant and helpful.

title: Convenient
text: Booked this hotel as it was near to a work meeting I needed to be at the next morning and travelling down from Newcastle I needed a place near to the tube and Kings Cross also. Staff friendly, check in painless, rooms comfortable with furnishings if a bit small but main issue was ineffectual air con. It had one setting and the lowest temperature was 19 degrees not really ideal when it was sweltering outside and in. The breakfast was good and included. I guess ithe hotel cost is based on the centralness of location. The area Hoxton is certainly earthy (a couple of altercations were spotted in the short time we were here and police had to intervene) but interesting and there are a few Gastro pubs you can make use of in close proximity for food. Certainly if you can have a wander. The tube is like a 3-4 minute walk with luggage and two stops to Kings Cross Euston St Pancras etc Doubt I'll need it again but if I did I'd stay here another time

title: Underrated Gem
text: My family (2 adults and 2 teenage children) stayed in this hotel July 4th - 6th. We arrived a few hours early and were relieved to find a locked luggage room where we could leave our suitcases (each suitcase having its own 2 part tag - 1 part tied to the case, the other part given to us to match up when collecting the cases). The desk staff were very very helpful and made us feel very welcome. They politely answered all of our questions with ease. We left to visit a local restaurant and returned a few hours later when our room keys were ready. The rooms were very clean and the bed was comfortable with a choice of soft/hard pillows. The bathroom was spotless and the towels were in good shape. We went to reception and picked up an ironing board and also a spare shaving kit. They have things like combs and toothbruishes too if needed. The aircon was a little rattly but to be honest we didnt notice it after 5 minutes, and there were sets of ear plubs left on the bed side tables if needed. There was very little noise at night from residents and traffic. The breakfast was one of the best i have had at any hotel chain. It is a buffet style and is included in the room price. You have a great choice from cereal, fruit, cooked breakfast, continental etc etc. The only down side is that after 8:30-ish it gets very busy and you may have to wait for a table for a few minutes. The hotel is a 2 minute walk from old street tube station and also has a Sainsburys local across the street. Wifi in the rooms is a little slow, but i didn't go to London to sit in a room on the internet, it was fast enough to check emails and facebook though. I cannot praise this hotel enough. For the price i paid for 2 nights, i would have been content paying that for each night. I am looking forward to my next trip to london already, partly because i plan on booking into this hotel again.

title: Mr hasler
text: Great location nice and clean rooms staff very helpful .free breakfast was great rooms have all you need better than the Hilton we stayed in we just hoped on the train across the road in to london all I can say I will stay here again

title: Excellent Hotel!
text: My girlfriend and I have just recently returned from a one night stay at this hotel. We stayed there whilst attending the Coldplay gig at The Emirates Stadium. I booked this hotel as I needed somewhere relatively close to tube station and not too far away from the stadium. I have to say it fitted the job perfectly!! Old Street station is only a five minute walk away from the hotel which was ideal, and from there we were only a few stops away from the stadium. The hotel itself does not look anything special from outside, but once inside everything comes together. Very quickly and politely checked in, and soon off to our room. The room itself was a decent size with a two seater couch in it as well. This was very useful for putting stuff on, but could be used as a bed at a push. All the usual Holiday Inn Express bits and bobs including tea and coffee making facilities. Bathroom was stunning. Not a huge room but very clean, together with a beautiful shower. I have to say the whole room was immaculate and i can't praise it enough!! Breakfast in the morning was the usual HI Express affair..Plenty of hold and cold options, all very nice, together with lots of room meant that there wasn't a scrum for a table. We didn't have much contact with the staff as we were quite late back, but the front desk staff were very helpful and polite. I was very pleased with my choice of hotel, and I would certainly be more than happy to stay here again. Coldplay were amazing by the way, and what a fantastic stadium The Emirates is!! All in all a brilliant trip.

title: Great for an overnighter.
text: Got a very inexpensive deal on a room for Sunday night. Very competitive for a hotel in this location. Especially as the room (228) was much larger than I had anticipated at the price. Friendly reception staff, made to feel welcome straight away. I've got a Blue Badge and was told I could use their disabled space for no charge. Excellent. Went to a concert 2 minutes walk away and enjoyed a good nights sleep with a choice of pillows. Tea/coffee making stuff in the room. Bathroom perfectly fine. Breakfast reasonable with more friendly staff to help. Check out as friendly as our welcome. A bargain.

title: Good base for 1 or 2 nights
text: Very friendly staff. Room cleaned well each day and bathroom was spotless. Dreadful hairdryer was one of those where you have to hold the button in to keep it working - really tough for people with arthritic thumbs.Breakfasts very basic but plentiful and included in the room price which was a definite bonus. The bar is tiny and is in the main lobby - not very inviting. Not really a place to meet up with the party with which you're travelling. Lots of roadworks going on outside the hotel. A short walk to the trendy bars and restaurants. All in all a nice hotel in a good location but to catch a cab try to hail one outside - if you call from the hotel lobby dedicated phone line the prices seem to be higher!

title: Great location
text: I enjoyed my stay at the holiday inn express it is very central only 2 stops by tube from kings cross.When getting of the tube take the Shoreditch exit less than a five minute walk to the hotel.The bedroom was large and the bathroom was lovely very well maintained our room looked out to the main road but was very quiet.The hotel was very busy so breakfast was a bit chaotic but the staff did there best to ensure everyone was seated quickly I would definitely stay here again good value as the centre of London is very close by.

title: It's worth its value
text: We paid a very decent price, so we can't complain. Although I wasn't upset that the reception clerk told me that 'I looked like a one bed, with my friend' when I told her we needed 2 beds. The room was clean and pretty spacious for the price we paid. Near the old street underground so that was perfect. Also funny neighboorhood to have a drink (Hoxton Sq). Breakfast is pretty poor.

title: Perfect location
text: Easy access to central London but out of the way enough to avoid chaos! Right in the heart of shoreditch which is an amazing place full of vintage shops, markets, bars and food stalls. Hotel is modern and clean. The staff are really friendly and helpful and the breakfast that is included is great! Lots of choice and definitely fills you up. Would 100% recommend this hotel to anyone whether couples, friends, family or business.

title: Clean & friendly and not noisy
text: I stayed overnight during the end of January as I was attending a course in house. I arrived at 8.30am on the day of the course and reception could not have been more accommodating and professional. They had my room ready, despite the fact that it was a 2pm check in. I had rushed across London and travelled early, I was made to feel welcome and the receptionist was friendly and attentive, creating a great first impression. I found the room to be very clean and having read some reviews online wasn't surprised to see some earplugs provided - these were entirely unnecessary as the room and the hotel were not noisy as reported online. I had a room at the front, floor 2 next to the main road on a Saturday night in London and my sleep was not disturbed at all. I am not sure what noise levels previous guests had reported but I had both a peaceful and quality nights sleep. In addition the hotel provide a choice of 2 different pillows and tea/coffee making facilities in the room. The price was excellent for central London and the staff were both accommodating and informative about the local area. The breakfast which is included, was bountiful and went on quite late on the Sunday (just in case you feel like sleeping in). All in all this was a good hotel and value for money. If I had to make a suggestion, it would be nice to have a microwave facility or bar snack facility in the bar, as a woman travelling on her own, I did not want to walk out and dine alone in London on a Saturday evening and would have like the facility to purchase a light hot meal or warm one up in a microwave, but really this is not a big deal and I would recommend the Holiday Inn Express London City whole heartedly.

title: Much too expensive for the quality and service
text: I stayed here during a business trip. At the reception it already went wrong during check-in: the company would pay for the room, but they could not find the confirmation on this. The room itself is small and has nothing extra, like an iron or things like that. I informed the company to confirm again that the hotel should send the bill to the company, but when checking out, the reception informed me I needed to be. When I asked to check again, they still could not find anything about a comfirmation of a bill to my company. When I took out my phone to call the company again, suddenly the manager of the hotel came rushing out and confirmed that the bill was being paid for. Free wireless internet was not available and the breakfast was not that good. I think this is one of the worst business hotels I've ever been in.

title: Friendly staff, new rooms are perfect for short term stay
text: The new rooms are nice and clean, my room on the fourth floor was spacious. The only complaints would be the limited hot breakfast and the shower pressure was not great. My collegues showers were fine. Wi-fi was not free and cost £5.99 an hour or £13 for 24 hours.

title: Nice hotel
text: Go this room as was attending friends family event. Stayed for two nights and didn't try the bar or restaurant. Room was very tidy as was bathroom. However how they can charge the same amount of points as the kings cross hotel beats me as there was no gym or pool. Colour scheme of room was blue and lilac which I think they chose to relax you and aid with sleep. Bed was comfortable and ensuite only had a shower, however it was large and water was piping hot. Couple of pain retouched required in bathroom but nothing major. Couple of negative points. When asking for an iron and ironing board normally porter in hotel will bring it up. In this one the customer has to go and fetch it. If wanting a lie in pray that the cleaners don't clean the room next door. They batter the walls like there's no tomorrow. Area round about has lots of graffiti on buildings etc but it's the very impressive artistic type, even has a banksy across the road.

title: Best bathrooms in southeast
text: I know this title is silly, but i have been in four hotels in the last week, and the Holiday Inn at London City undoubtedly had the cleanest and more convenient bathroom. The shower made sense (no guessing how to turn it on), the tiles and grout were spotless, there was enough room to dry yourself without doing a yoga pose. Breakfast on a Sunday morning was a scrum, and much of the promised offerings were missing by the time I came down around nine o'clock. But the coffee was good (after I had emptied the coffee drip trip myself with the help of another guest) and there were plenty of seats. The staff are helpful and knowledgable, bed was lovely, check in uncomplicated

title: Overall pretty good
text: Myself and my husband stayed here for 3 nights. He was doing Ride London, and after some confusion over where we were allowed to store the bike overall we had a fairly comfortable stay. There are however a few niggles: 1) We were staying in room 509. The room had a very effective air conditioning system But when I woke up in the morning, my chest was hurting and my throat was very dry. You weren’t allowed to open the window for health and safety reasons but feeling ill every morning like this just ruined my mornings. 2: The bed was comfortable but very soft so if you get a bad back, this might not help! 3: breakfast- there is a breakfast buffet included in the price and there is a lot of choice however all the cereals are very sweet, and although they said you can ask for no added sugar muesli, at the times we went for breakfast, no one was around to ask. I also think they need to be a bit strict as there were some very greedy people, one bloke had a cooked breakfast, pot of porridge, 3 pieces of toast, 4 oranges, 3 crioissants, 4 bananas, a bowel of cereal, and yoghurt and berries JUST FOR HIMSELF! Fair enough you can go and help yourself but there should be a limit I think. A lot of people stay here.. and it’s completely selfish. For what we needed it was ok, but I have stayed in better places.

title: Great Location, clean rooms, and suitable breakfast
text: Stayed as a family with children 14 & 11 so we were a little tight even with the fold out coach but Europe in general is tough for family accommodations so thankful for a good clean place with good location. Staff was super accommodating and helpful with everything they could do. Tube within a couple of blocks, 10-15 good places to dine and/or drink within a 5 block radius.

title: Nice staff, good value and good location!
text: I have stayed in many holiday inns but was disappointed with this one. The bed was really uncomfortable and my two sons were in a sofa bed that dipped in the middle(when i say dipped they ended up on top of each other) and whenever they moved position the bed squeeked loudly. The air conditioning/heating was difficult to control and the room was roasting-we didn't sleep well at all. We went to go for a swim in the private gym, along the road, which is available to guests of the hotel at a reduced rate and asked the staff for more information-they couldn't give us any and even struggled to let us know where it was. When we got there, eventually, the prices had gone up and children were not allowed-even 2 boys to use the pool aged 13 and 14yrs-they have to be over 16yrs. We were gutted, this was one of the reasons we booked this hotel, for a relaxing swim after lots of sightseeing the evening before our 6hour train journey home to Dundee the next day. Breakfast was ok

title: Good Base for exploring
text: Nice friendly helpful staff, bit of scrum for breakfast so get in there as early as possible, the bed was massive and comfortable with a choice of pillows. Old street Tube is just a short walk away and you can be sightseeing in the heart of London within 20 minuets.

title: Excellent Location, Clean & Comfy
text: No complaints about this Holiday Inn. My room was clean and comfortable. I had one double bed and a couch in my room, nice amount of space. The room is new and functional. The best part of the hotel is the location, so close to Shoreditch for restaurants and pubs. Also, there's a grocery store right next door and the tube isn't far. Oh and it's nice to have breakfast included with the hotel :) Absolutely no complaints during my 3-night stay!

title: Great location
text: This hotel has a lot going for it. Great location, 2 stations from Kings Cross on the northern line and a very short walk from the underground to hotel. The area itself is quite busy with a few decent bars and shops. Our room was much bigger than i expected and was very clean and comfortable. My only negative points was that the air con isn't great (didnt really do much) and our room was quite noisy as it overlooked the main street which was always busy. I had heard that higher rooms were quieter but we weren't lucky in getting one (had requested it but understand these things are never guaranteed) Breakfast was good, plenty choice and vegetarian options available if you have time to wait. It does get quite busy so if you're in a rush get down before 9. Overall this hotel is pretty good value for money. I'd stay here again for the location alone...hopefully get a quieter room next time!

title: Great Area for Night Life
text: This area is very much for a younger crowd. Lots of small stores and great places to eat. Right beside the hotel I had an amazing chicken kebab. Also beside the hotel is a great Vietnamese restaurant. Loads of great bars and cool places to hangs out. Not really great for young kids and families

title: All just as described
text: We stayed here after a party locally, and it was just right for our needs. We don't know the area that well, but the hotel was easy to find (5 minutes from Old Street tube), clean and the rooms were comfortable. All was just fine for a one night stay. All was very clean, the bed was comfy and there was a good selection of pillows for if we were being particularly fussy. We asked for a quiet room away from the road, and got just that. We weren't disturbed by noise at all though if we were the hotel had provided earplugs, which was very thoughtful. Breakfast was good - when I asked about one item they had run out of, it was found for me with no drama at all. Given the cost of a hotel breakfast in London, the inclusion of a free breakfast was welcome, and the selection and quality were better than expected. It wasn't somewhere I'd want to stay for much longer - it was lacking in character and amenities over and above the basics - but for what we wanted, it was all pretty good.

title: very Good for a 3*
text: We really enjoyed our stay, the staff where very thoughtful and considerate of our needs. rooms clean and tidy. we had a shower in our room no bath wich didn't bother us as it was very clean. There is tea and coffe in the room, you could always ask for more. The only downfal was that there was too much noise on the street, we could hear it clearly although we where on the 5th floor the wondow could not stop the noise. apart Parking is not available you go by chance if your lucky you can get a space for £20.00 until 6pm the next day.

title: Surprisingly good stay - very helpful staff
text: I booked into this Holiday Inn Express at about 9pm the night before my stay, as I had a last minute meeting crop up. I wasn't expecting much as it was the only hotel available under £300 in zone 1 at such short notice - but I was pleasantly surprised. The hotel is a couple of minutes walk from Old Street tube (exit the underground via 'Subway 1' towards Old Street North) and is in a really up and coming part of the city, with so many great eateries nearby (try Red Dog Saloon, Meat Mission, Breakfast Club, either Vietnamese restaurant or the Korean take away - all great!) The hotel itself was very clean and seemingly newly decorated, staff were very friendly and helpful, and they have a left luggage service which is great, and a free breakfast - not great quality but free none the less! My room was on the 3rd floor and was quite large, with lots of handy facilities for a budget chain. The air conditioning works by putting your key in there wall, but it has a fault so it can be quite noisy at random times, it woke me up once at 3am but I popped in the complimentary earplugs next to the apology notice about the noise and I was back to sleep in a flash - it's testament to the hotel that they care enough to provide a professional explanation and earplugs. I wouldn't hesitate to stay again, even if it isn't my only choice next time!

title: Adequate for the price in London city
text: Rooms are nice and newly renovated. Bed (supposedly queen size) was very small, but I have stayed in other holiday inn express before, and it seems to be the norm that their double beds which are described as queen sized are a little smaller than the usual. The bed was very springy and too soft.....it was quite uncomfortable to be honest as you can feel the spring hurting your body as the bed 'sinks in'. Pillows were ok..... Staff in the hotel are ultra helpful and friendly. The free breakfast was simple and adequate. No free wifi (I thought holiday inn express provides 3 basic necessities: a good nights sleep, free wifi and free breakfast). Wifi is payable in this hotel. Even if you are a platinum priority club member, you are not given concessionary wifi access. No free drinks for platinum members too. Platinum members only get a 'discount' voucher for drinks purchased at the bar. Laugh out loud!! The hotel is conveniently located near a subway All in all a pleasant stay and will consider being back.

title: oh dear oh dear
text: When so many hoiday inn express are well run and well maintained, this one is very sad and tired. The general manager's name is missing from behind the reception desk and perhaps they are hiding from the guests? The rooms whilst clean are well worn. The hotel is certainly not value for money and at over £100 per night is not cheap. The reception staff are very rude and slow. Fortunately the rest of the staff are pleasant and seem hardworking. This is a business hotel and is well located not far from Liverpool street. This is not a tourist hotel and the location is not great if you are coming to London on holiday. It is certainly not the sort of area that you would like to walk around at night with your family though it does have a certain east end charm.
