Although the price was reasonable for "London" we were paying a lot and would expect better. For example the cleanliness and quality of the room was not up to scratch (toilet not cleaned and hairs found on the bedding) and the breakfast was below average. The bonus is that this is a central location, but if you are paying over £130 a night you would want better.

title: Adequate London Hotel
text: Stayed on a Saturday night. Room was small but that is typical for London hotel. Room was comfortable, good shower overall quite clean. Staff were very helpful. Breakfast was continental but quite a good choice we have certainly had worse. They have air con in the rooms which I guess for the summer is very good. It is a shame that like a lot of hotels they dont pay much attention to detail, one of the bedside lights didnt work, a few scuffs on the paint work and a shower head threatening to fall off. With a little bit of maintenance it could have been perfect. Room was expensive , however you paying to stay in central London and so it is what you would expect., at least our tarriff included breakfast.

title: Nice stay
text: Comfy and quiet in general, but I found sound insulation not good - if someone stays next door I kinda can hear activities going on in the next door, or when someone running in the corridor. Close to Euston Square Station and only 3 min walk away from Euston Station. Staff is friendly. Water temperature is constant. Shower gel and hand lotion are provided. Kettle is provided but the electric cord is short and I have to place the kettle on the floor to access the socket. Wifi is provided, but it requires Facebook/Twitter/Email login. I found wifi went off after a certain time and I needed to reconnect again.

title: You get what you pay for - but some niggles!
text: 2nd time I have stayed here on business, hotel chosen for location (good) and price (very good compared to some nearby). Rooms are small - indeed tiny if you choose a single room or if you are unlucky. I left feedback with the hotel last time I stayed and am dissapointed to see that the same issues remain. 1 - the TVs in the rooms are at 90 degrees to the head of the bed so you either need to watch with your head propped at 90 degrees and end up with a very sore neck or you have to rearrange such that you sleep at the foot of the bed. Why can't they just put the TV on a wall or where it can be seen? 2 - the free WiFi wasn't working at all. This is pretty essential when on a business trip so I was pretty hacked off. This wasn't mentioned when I checked in as I may have considered not staying. It was the same last time too, so don't be fooled by the "free WiFi" stated on their website. This wasn't even available in the public areas. 3 - there is no heating in the bathrooms, nothing, zilch..... accordingly the bathrooms are freezing. I had to leave the door open all night to allow some warmth from the room to go into the bathroom. This doubled the noise from the traffic outside. 4 - is the noise which I appreciate isn't the fault of the hotel. If you are a light sleeper I recommend that you ask for a room away from the main road at Euston Sq station side. The noise was deafening from cars and ambulance siren all night long. On the plus side, the hotel is clean and the staff are very nice. Breakfast was good, and despite my niggles is does represent good value if you accept that you get what you pay for.

title: Clean, efficient, great location
text: Basically what you would expect from a nice, non luxury hotel in London. Tiny but clean. Area is safe. Close to tube stations and Eurotrain (which we took to Paris). Walking distance from everything you want to see in central London.

title: Shocking - Worst hotel experience in London
text: The hotel is shocking, onr to avoid at all cost. If nosie is your thing then you are in luck. The traffic noise is relentless, rooms are dirty, small and inconjuicive for a good stay. Do yourself a favour check out and go to the premieer inn down the road - dont say you havent been warned.

title: Small room, good breakfast
text: We chose this hotel based on location and convenience. You expect to pay through the nose for London hotels...value for money is not a criteria you can usually apply to the inflated prices for everything in the capital. The hotel's location was excellent, the comopact room was well set out and clean and relatively well decorated...the bathroom ('room' being a euphemisim for cupboard) had all essentials and was clean...I was surprised at how enjoyable the continental breakfast actually was-the dining room was pleasant and well appointed-there was excellent coffee on tap, good juice and a generous selection of danish pastries, croissants, and white bread to be toasted...We werent disturbed by noise from traffic either-bonus!

title: Lovely hotel if you get it at the right price
text: Managed to get this hotel at way under the price quoted on their website for a weekend stay for two couples. Good location close to Euston tube station. Hotel is within walking distance of Madame Tussaurds and Regents Park. Rooms were compact but very clean and hotel staff were very friendly, especially bar staff who were kind enough to serve until we had had enough! (And also allowed us to order food into the hotel when the chef had finished for the night). Would definitely recommend this if you want a base to tour from and are comfortable travelling by tube. The hotel is a lot nicer (and cheaper) than some of the hotels based very central.

title: Small But Perfectly Formed
text: The Euston Square is not everyone's cup of tea. But it suits me fine. I am in London, working away from home each week. So my key needs are a clean and tidy room, free wifi, breakfast included (and not at stupid London prices of £18 to £25 per morning), a cupboard with enough coat hangers for my stay, warm water and closeness to my work and Euston Station and Regents Park for my daily run, This ticks all the boxes. It is a relatively cheap hotel - by London standards and does not presume to be anything more. The staff are friendly and helpful. Moreso than some more expensive and "pretend posh" hotels - play it up for the tourist, you know what I mean. As I have stayed there on a few occasions I am often upgraded in room size without asking. The rooms are quite small. As I say - not for everyone - but fine for me. I spend more time in the office than in the hotel bedroom, so it serves its purpose. Breakfast is simple. I only need some cereal, a fruit juice, yoghurt and tea and toast - so the continental style works for me. And there is a regular breakfast game to enjoy. In Scouts we have the Kim's Game. For those who don't know - this is where you place 20 or 30 small items on a tray, let the kids have 1 minute or so to learn them as best they can and then covering the tray you remove 1 or 2 items. And the kids have to spot what is missing. Breakfast at the Euston Square has its own Kim

title: Good location, Rooms small but functional.
text: We stayed at the hotel for 3 nights and found the accommodation clean and comfortable. The rooms are very small and the en-suite was minute. Having said this they were functional. Only thing that was missing was somewhere to hang a wet coat. The one drawback was the cooked breakfast. It consisted of 2 horrible grey sausages, streaky bacon, 2 fried eggs swimming in oil and a portion of beans. We had booked in advance for a cooked breakfast every morning but tried to cancel after the first and were told that it was not company policy to give refunds. Even so we did'nt try it again. On the positive side the continetal breakfast was very good. The location of the hotel was good with easy access to both Euston station and Euston Square underground and is within zone 1 for tickets.

title: Unsettled Night
text: Only stayed one night on a business trip , and thats all I could of taken . My rooms Aircon Fan inside the wall was going off ever 20-30 mins in the end at 10:45pm I had to move rooms due to the terrible noise . The room I was moved into had a broken phone , so I was unable to call reception and the Bed had seen more action than Iraq . It had spings broken all over it . Although the Staff were friendly enough no effort was made to compensate myself for having to move and then have a uncomfortable night.

title: Wont be staying again despite refurb. No kettle or desk and poor breakfast
text: I've been using this hotel infrequently for 20 years as a business traveller, mainly based on location, I never minded if it was a bit shabby as long as it was clean. I was there this week, and despite being in a nicely refurbished room, they have gone for style over substance. The staff are nice, I don't mind the room and bathroom being small, and I liked the little touches like the USB chargers and the Hypnos bed, but they have missed out on such basic essentials. There is NO kettle to make tea and coffee in the room - I paid £178 for a night and couldn't make a bedtime or morning cuppa? Also only a tiny fold down desk so couldn't do any work, not a single place other than the floor to hang a towel so they had to live on the floor, no loo roll holder or bathroom shelf apart from windowsill once once the blind was shut that also had to go on the floor! Ridiculous. More minor points are the website said there was a safe in the room but I couldn't find one, and it was a very poor breakfast too, nothing cooked and only fruit was an orange or an apple. Unless they bring back a kettle, a proper desk and towel hooks they have lost a loyal customer.

title: Good hotel for the price
text: Staff were friendly and helpful and allowed us to store our bags before and after check in. Room was fairly small and bathroom was super small but if you are travelling right in my opinion you aren't spending all your time here! Both were super clean and modern and air con made it more than comfortable. Breakfast was your standard continental offering, fairly good with a nice selection.

title: Not very impressed
text: Room was small and dingy (stains on the carpet, marks on the wall, beat up furniture). The air conditioner in the room was broken and it's a hot summer in London, so if I closed the window it got very stuffy. This was a problem because my room was on the ground floor facing the street, so opening the window let in quite a lot of noise. If I didn't have earplugs I don't think I would have been able to sleep. The staff was friendly. There was a Nespresso machine and a bottle of water in the room, which were a nice touch. The bathroom seemed recently renovated and was in much better shape than the rest of the room. With new carpeting, a fresh coat of paint, and working AC I think I would have given this hotel 3-4 stars, but as it stands I did not have a good experience.

title: Very disappointed with my stay.
text: I have to say I was very disappointed with my recent stay in this hotel. When offered the opportunity of an independent hotel via chain I decided to give this hotel a bash. On the plus side there was free wifi and a good selection of local complimentary newspapers available however from this initially positive impression things went down hill. I was allocated a very small room which I was accepting of until I went into the bathroom. On entering the bathroom there was a faecal smell and when I opened the toilet there were faeces belonging to the previous guest. Flushing the loo left skid marks and I didn't feel it was my role as a guest to clean this.There was blood on the door frame and the bedside lamp was not working as the low energy bulb inside was broken. Give the staff their due when I told them of my experience they promptly moved me to another room. I was in a rush to go to a meeting so left returning later in the evening. Unfortunately this room wasn't much better but at 9.30pm I couldn't face moving again. The mould in the shower cabinet was disgusting. The shower control was so damaged that it had corroded away. I was unable to adjust the temperature as a result. When I filled the sink to shave the water could not be drained as the plug was stuck and control lever broken. The toiletries in dispensers on the wall did not smell nice. A kind of musty orange smell. When I awoke in the morning I found that one of the pillowcases was ripped and there were stains on my duvet cover. There were no bedside lamps only extremely bright down lighters in the room which meant that I was in bed early and asleep as it was too bright to relax. At £150 for an overnight stay this was very poor value for money. Although there was triple glazing there was still noise from street which woke me at 2.50am. On departure the staff didn't bother to ask how my stay had been. I am sorry to say but I cannot recommend this hotel as there are similarly priced hotels in the vicinity which provide a more consistent and comfortable experience.

title: Small and Noisy
text: I had read that the hotel rooms were small and noisy but we still had high hopes that our room would be different. When we checked in I specifically asked for one of the quieter rooms due to the rather bad reviews I had read on this site. Where did they put us? It was a room directly above the underground tube entrance and next to an extremely busy road (24 hrs a day). The noise factor was worse than the fact that the room is so very small. No table or area to set your bags, purse, water bottles etc. Note: never but never stay in room 103. After 3 days we finally got a little smarter and requested a room on the other side of the hotel (room 119) that the windows faced a small street that ran alongside the hotel. Still noisy but not as bad. At least we got some sleep the last few nights we were there. Our room had air conditioning but we knew that not all rooms have air available. The unit DID shut off automatically as a previous poster noted. No complaints regarding staff. They responded quickly to our request for a room change, helped us book for a airport transfer service to pick us up when we departed and printed out our boarding passes.

title: One night
text: Friendly welcome upon arrival and helpful tips on where to eat. Room was clean but tiny no where to put my stuff .... bathroom lacked a shelf. Comfy bed and clean sheets and bathroom towels. Other than being cramped and my room outside the lift, it was fine.

title: Don't stay at this hotel!
text: A work colleague and I stayed at this hotel on Monday 19th April as we were hosting a meeting in London the following day with 150+ delegates arriving. I can honestly say this is the worst hotel I have possibly ever stayed in, certainly in London. My colleague had to change rooms three times as the swipe pass system that they had on each door was not working and so they were issuing everyone with a door key. The first two rooms my colleague was given the locks were not working properly and she could not get in the rooms and the third room she was given (which we were told, several times by the staff, was the biggest room in the hotel) she then had the embarrassing situation of another guest (male) being issued with the same key and walking in the room when she was in a state of undress. Also, we could not use the stairs as you needed a swipe card to access the stairs and the swipe system was not working. If that was not bad enough when we returned to the hotel at 9.30pm after having a meal we found that there were road works going on opposite the hotel which we were not told about when we first arrived. The road works were being done at night to minimise traffic congestion so we had a pneumatic drill being used until half past midnight and then more road works going on until 2.30am. The hotel did not have double glazing and so what with that and the sirens going by every half an hour we got about 3 hours sleep before a very important work meeting. I can appreciate that the workmen have to do their job but we were not informed of this by the hotel when we booked the rooms. Also, I would consider that the least they could do would be to issue people with earplugs considering the situation but when I asked for ear plugs I was told the hotel didn’t have any. The staff were rude, unhelpful and really didn’t seem bothered. Rooms were clean but very small even by London standards. The hotel was central being ten minutes walk from Regent’s Park and the breakfast was ok but I really would not want anyone to stay here. Our company have paid for the rooms and we are in the process of trying to get a refund for my colleague’s room but I would not want a member of the public to pay money to stay here. Breakfast was nice!

title: Hotel easy to go in central london
text: This hotel is perfectly located near the underground and near the Euston Tower. There are many attractions for travellers around here and in ten minute you can reach the British Library (wonderful), many other expositions and Oxford street too. The Hotel is cozy, with functional rooms, tiny bathroom but recently renovated with styled sink and mixer tap. The hotel is not comfortable for families, but it is really an easy solution to go to central London: in that case it seems perfect. Great staff that work with the best courtesy!

title: drilling sound all night long
text: apparently its the air con coming on un off it makes the sound of a hammer drill about every ten mins all the while day un night plus theres a main hospital directly over the road the street makes for a very un comfortable night .one street away theres much more quieter options

title: OK but thin walls
text: Booked in for course in London. Small room but clean and comfortable and very convenient for travel. The only problem being the paper thin walls (you could hear everything) so take earplugs if you are a light sleeper. The hotel restaurant is a good place to eat too.

title: Not good value
text: The two things that stand out about this hotel are: its way way way to expensive for what you actually get and the room is almost the smallest I have ever seen (def the smallest with a double bed though). Once you took into account the bed, the wardrobe, the tv cabinet i don't think there was a 1 square meter of actual carpet left bare. Even the elevator and corridors are tiny and claustrophobic. For the amount charged its absurd. having said that the place was well kept, clean and 'modern' looking. The breakfast was well cooked and the dinning area pleasant. The tv based internet was very cumbersome to use and they kept trying to overcharge me for its use. I you want a tiny, clean room that is overpriced, this is the place for you! You can get a room 80% bigger for about half price in many other locations, ok they will be a little more dated but believe me they are much better value.

title: Great Location but paper thin walls to rooms!
text: Euston Square Hotel is in a perfect location which made travelling around really easy. Free Internet and TV in the room, big wardrobe, kettle with tea and coffee provided and a hair dryer all included. Breakfast was good, cereals, croissants, toast etc... The hotel is clean, modern and friendly but the rooms are small with paper thin walls so prepare to listen to your neighbours TV at 2am. When I went the heating was constantly on to so if you get too hot, you have the option of opening the window to hear busy traffic (opposite a hospital so a lot of sirens) or use the air-conditioning which makes crazy noises and sounds as if its about to fall off the wall. Other than the few poor qualities, it is a fab hotel and I would probably go back again as the value for money is amazing considering how good the location is. (Euston Train/Tube Station - 1min walk, Warren Street Tube - outside the door) (Oxford street - about 20min walk) (Madame Tussauds - about 20min walk)

title: its OK, but Premier Inn is better value for money
text: Stayed at the hotel with work for one night - stayed in room 214 opposite the lift which I thought would be noisy. Rooms are very small and from what I remember weren't particularly cheap at about £145 B&B, thankfully work were paying. Location is good, however feel you could do better elsehwhere. Breakfast was continental and again OK. Overall it is sufficient for a one night stay but at this price point don't think you can beat a Premier Inn.

title: Budget hotel but not budget prices.
text: I stayed here twice recently on business, the accommodation being arranged my my firm. Not sure I would have been too happy paying for this myself as this is budget accommodation at non-budget prices, although maybe corporate prices aren't necessarily flexible. Anyway, it's in an ideal location for visiting central London as it's right above Euston Square Underground station and a couple of hundred yards from Euston mainline.You can walk into the West End easily. It's handy for anyone not planning to spend too much time in their room as both of the rooms I had were small (I think they all are) and the bathrooms tiny, with barely enough room to turn. The rooms are clean although on my first visit there was a big wet patch on the carpet where something must have just been mopped up and it hadn't dried out by the time I left. Owing to the room size this was annoying as I had to keep stepping over it. The corridors are also very narrow and it's clear they got their money's worth when refurbing this place. Breakfast is perfectly acceptable for continental but I would have expected cooked for the price. The breakfast room also serves as the bar in the evening but it was shut when I returned from work at 11.15pm, unlike the Ibis Hotel around the corner which charges similar (if not cheaper) prices, provides a cooked breakfast, bigger rooms, a proper bathroom and doesn't shut the bar early. However, my biggest issue was the morning of my second stay when I found there was no hot water for a shower or even to fill the sink. I had to boil the kettle for a wash! Upon highlighting this at reception I was advised it was probably because quite a few people were runnning hot water at that time. Really? At 8.00am it's a surprise that a number of guests needed hot water! I also realised I was not the only one judging by other guests at reception. Wake up Euston Square Hotel. This is 2012. Get it sorted! I shall be crossing this one off the company's list and ask to stay at the Ibis next time.

title: Location is brilliant
text: Location is the seller here, just outside Euston station, very handy. Rooms are small, but ok - service was OK. Would stay again.

title: Great location and clean and tidy rooms
text: Very well priced for the location, the rooms are clean and tidy and everything was fine. Staff are friendly and overall a pleasant stay. Being so close to station was great. Breakfast deal with the room is well worth it - try the full breakfast.

title: Superb location
text: This is a gem of a boutique hotel. Ideally located close to Euston tube and rail stations plus Kings Cross and St Pancras. The rooms are super modern, clean and comfortable. There is no problem, as I did, for checking in at 0100 in the morning. The reception staff are very helpful and don't keep you hanging around when al, you want to do is get to bed. I would highly recommend this hotel for location, value for money and comfort.

title: Hit and miss, this time a BIG miss
text: I booked this hotel for a colleague as it was close to St Pancras and they were travelling by Eurostar the next morning. I'd seen the reasonable reviews and the bad reviews about the hotel but thought it was worth a try as it's location was good for St Pancras. My colleague was due to stay for 2 nights but checked out after 1 night as the room was tiny, dirty, had no where to hang clothes, noisy, had no plug socket and there was a noise in or near the room that woke my colleague up every 15 minutes which does not bode well when you have to travel to Brussels first thing in the morning to deliver a presentation. The hotel refused the refund the second nights stay! Be careful!!!!

title: Handy for Euston Station if nothing better avaiable
text: Arrived at 9.00 pm after a gruelling 16 hour trip from Spain, full of flu. Desperate for a cup of tea, but no kettle in the room, and no facilities elsewhere in the hotel to get one either. Advised by reception to walk to Euston Station and buy one there! Room was tiny - barely room to get the cases in. Aircon didn't work so had to sleep with window open, and TV faced across the room, not towards the bed. Lift is tiny so often couldn't get in. Plus points? Bed was comfortable and shower was powerful.

title: Good choice
text: This hotel is good choice for those which wants hotel near Paddington Station. Cleaned, a cozy. Breakfast was good. For choice continental breakfast, or English breakfast for pay.Room, so just, not big, but not small. every day cleaning.

title: Squeezed
text: When I booked the room through the site, I saw the pictures of the rooms and I was aware that the rooms were not big

title: Safety not important?
text: We stayed at this hotel 3 nights in January. We got a mail from the hotel 5 days before our arrival where we were offered a possible upgrade for a reasonable price. We mailed back that we would like to use this opportunity. We asked about the upgrade when we arrived and the staff told thats not possible, hotel is fully booked.Our booking was via booking.com and with 48 hours cancellation policy, and we felt this was just a cheap way to hold our booking. But we found also some serious safety issues at this hotel. Our room was at the basement (room LG2)

title: great location, rest is average
text: we booked this hotel due to its distance to paddington station. It is a nice hotel but also has some flaws: nice but very small rooms, breakfast buffet being average (nothing missing), service was ok (not outstanding).

title: Great reasonable hotel Nr Paddington
text: A very good location close to Paddington offering compact comfortable rooms with all necessary amenities. The staff are very helpful and hotel offers a good breakfast, a very clean hotel ideally located for visiting London sights and close to the underground and bus services.

title: Good size hotel in London
text: We booked three club rooms for one night and the hotel is kindly to upgrade two of rooms to the executive twin. The pics are for the executive twins, but the club room is still considered an okay size in London The hotel itself is considered more modern in London, room size is bigger than most of the hotels in London. Location is good if you want to take the train from Paddington to Heathrow as it is only a five minutes walk. The room is good as I mentioned it is bigger than the usual room in London . It has everything , however the towels are not too clean and the carpets since a bit dirty. Maybe the housekeep should do a better job Will consider returning to this hotel if going back to London

title: Great value and location
text: This hotel is really nice, it’s a 6 minute walk from paddington and close to all the tubes. It was great value. The executive room was nice, apparently bigger than a standard room but actually wasn’t that big, so how small a standard room is I don’t know. The bathroom is tiny!! Bedroom was modern and bathroom new and fresh. Staff were very friendly. Breakfast was good and litany of choices from continental to English breakfast. There is a bar and they do evening meal deals (didn’t try this as ate out). Location is great, near lots of restaurants and bars. I would stay here again.

title: Great breakfast
text: This hotel just out of Paddington Station (100m walk) is not only a comfortable hotel but their breakfasts are amazing - offering a FULL English breakfast with everything included in the hotel room price.

title: DIRTY AND DISGUSTING FILTHY BEDS HAIR EVERYWHERE
text: was TIRED checked in after a LONG journey TIRED and HUNGRY was looking forward to getting to my bed after being greeted by a miserable receptionist was told my room was on 2nd floor so UP i WENT dragging my luggage only to confronted by a bed full of HAIR curls of hair ALL over the BED . i immediately went downstairs and complained only to be denied. i then convinced her to come upstairs and check the room. she saw the hairs all over the bed and i asked for my room to be changed. so we go to the 2nd room HAIR all over the bed again they looked like they hadnt been cleaned for a while. i asked for another room AGAIN dirty hair all over the bed. then a 3rd time i thought OK there were a hair here and there i was tired and just wanted to rest. i she leaves i GO to the bathroom and GUESS what i SPOT thats right hairs all over the bath. i had had enough it was middle of the night. i went back and and asked for a refund which they didnt GIVE. i had no money and nowhere to go. i had to SLEEP somewhere the other option was to sleep on the STREET. i then came with the idea of asking to at least CHANGE my BEDSHEET. which they accepted i then had to wait in the LOUNGE around 40 mins while they did that. finally i go up to the Bed completey TIRED it was LATE ready to sleep at least guess what MORE HAIR! but less than before i had no choice i used the covers to form a SHIELD and fell asleep. the next morning i was AWOKEN by a fire alarm i rushed OUT of my BED downstairs after being told by the STAFF. only to find it a false alarm!. so now my sleep has been DISTURBED. i get up to go to WORK a lot earlier than i needed to. i LEAVE very gladly. i return that same NIGHT. only to be LOCKED OUT!! it just was becoming a Nightmare . i then go downstairs to get my card checked to the miserable receptionist! i return to enter my room and the BEDSHEETS have been changed AGAIN!!! THE SAME DIRTY HAIRS RETURN. when you change beds the sheets are supposed to be clean not filthy and with hair. i return again downstairs and bring the manager out who DENIES changing them! i left my bed a mess and came back and its all sorted out. and he denies it. ALL in all avoid like the plague. unless you like dirty hotels. dont know hoe the are still running

title: Lovely Place - Great Location
text: We spent 2 nights at the Norfolk Towers in November, and really enjoyed it! It is a clean, comfortable, and quiet place to rest after long days of seeing the sights in London. The desk staff and concierge were very helpful. Value of price paid was very good. I would definitely stay here again!

title: Good
text: Nice and warm hotel, however, room is a bit small and bed as well. We booked the room witg breakfast, however, we suddenly discovered that the breakfast is limited to very specific type of food! So we paid extra to get the rest of it.

title: The Executive Room Mystery
text: I really can recommend this hotel, it is close to train and tube (Paddington) and several bus connections. Bus 36 goes straight to Victoria for connection to Gatwick Airport, if that's your aim. The staff was helpful, our room was clean and had all the facilities we needed, but it was rather small. I had booked a Club Room, and received an e-mail stating: Fancy an upgrade? The offer sounded nice, so I accepted, Then paid £40 extra for our 4 nights stay. But hence the mystery..... the "upgraded" room was just as small! We were shown another Club Room and understood that we had never been upgraded at all! We received a refund, but not any Executive room, so we stayed put. As long as you look out for this kind of "upgrade", the hotel is modern and nice, with walking distance to Hyde Park, shops and small restaurants. We had lunch and dinner in the hotel restaurant, which we enjoyed very much, and the included Continental Breakfast was all right.

title: Do not book a suite here!
text: As far as I can tell, the suites are all in the basement and ours absolutely reeked of sewage. The smell was so bad we had to sleep with the window open all night, in the middle of winter (there weren't any other hotels available in the area because it was New Years Eve). We talked to the manager the next morning and he didn't even apologize for the smell, let alone offer any form of compensation. We checked out early the next morning and stayed at the Hilton around the corner.

title: Lovely hotel
text: Lovely romantic break in london . Enjoyed breakfast. Lovely bed. Staff very friendly. Shower was excellent. Very close to train station. Very clean. Dont moan about wi fi.....you are on holidays. Only five mins from station

title: There is som many great hotels in London. This is just not one of them.
text: Some of the rooms are so incredible small that you can imagine it. It’s that bad that our bed was shorter then a normal 200cm bed, to save space. I know it sounds crazy but It’s true. I am 178cm and my feet was sticking out of the bed. The only elevator is extremely slow and can only carry 4 persons. There is a cellar and 5 floors. Often its already full when it stops on your floor. So expect to use a lot of time waiting to get up and down. If you choose to get the breakfast included, you get disappointed. Its only what they calls continental. And means that you only get to eat half of the buffet. No eggs, no bacon, no beans, no sausage ore any other hot food. A full English breakfast cost extra. Anyway. Don’t take it. you don’t miss anything. Well. The hotel is okay, if it was the last one free. But there are many hundreds of hotels nearby, so I can’t really give one good reason to pick this one.

title: Nice hotel but service needs to be improved ( a lot) !
text: The standard rooms are very small but well designed. You can find all the amenities that a four star hotel usually offers. Unfortunately the level of the service is the main problem here. Not recommended hotel.

title: Beyond expectation my trip
text: Short walk to Paddington station.I catch the Heathrow Express to tho hotel(airport-paddington)The bed was very comfortable

title: TURNED AWAY DESPITE CONFIRMED BOOKING
text: We arrived late to check in at hotel on 7DEC at 2345 to be told that there was no reservation for us i booked two rooms on 18 AUG for 7DEC, directly on the hotel system, had the email confirmation with me. There was no evidence of our reservation and no space at the hotel ... or in fact in London. We then spent an hour calling over 30 hotels to try and find a hotel and finally found one at 1.15AM in Victoria. We then had to pay travel costs to/from as the event we were attending the following day was local to the hotel! Their response to my complaint is poor and compensation is ongoing being offered (50% off next stay - Subject to availability)- shows a lack of care for the fact that they left us without anywhere to stay!!! The huge inconvenience they caused us to find somewhere to stay as well the extra expense it cost us!! Why would I want to go back???

title: Avoid. Tiny rooms, non-functional WiFi and false advertising!
text: The rooms are all way smaller than the pictures show. It’s good, sky photography. Also, the WiFi barely works. You get speeds of 0.2 Mbps in your room which is essentially unusable. The staff don’t really listen to concerns and just say there is nothing they can do until the general manager arrives in the morning. The rooms were dusty, and the tiny room problem can be showed by the example by the chair not pulling back from the table as the bed is in the way. Essentially making the table unusable. Very disappointing, especially as WiFi should be essential for a ‘business’ hotel. Also, they advertise a ‘media hub in the room.’ Don’t be fooled by this, it is freeview. Even within free view, there are limited channels as the tv is not connected to the internet. Avoid this hotel!

title: Lovely room
text: I had a two night business trip and stayed in one of the basement rooms which was amazing. Very spacious and good amenities. The reception team were pleasant and helpful. I ordered room service and they had run out of the Thai curry which was a shame but nonetheless the food was good, although I did have to ring down for the wine they missed. Good quality breakfast and only a short walk from the tube.

title: Newly renovated hotel
text: Nice surprise to stay at this clean and modern hotel in Paddington area. Quietest room I've stayed in for a while. Smallish room but all there, new, neat and tidy. Good breakfast. Would happily stay here again.

title: Something just not right.....
text: We arrived sat the 10th november and checked in.When we saw the room it was alot smaller than expected. When we asked about whether we had a club or an exective room we were greeted bluntly which no one would actually answer properly. On tues 6th november we got an email from ye asking us if we wanted to upgrade to an executiclve room and full breakfast for an extra £10 a night. We agreed immediatlely and corresponded via email. Conveniently the lovely slideshow of pictures on the reception desk which shows the different types of rooms and I can guarantee you most defiantly we do not have an executive room..as our room looks exactly like a club and not an executive room.when we questioned it a 2nd time they reassured us that it was an executive room.even when I questioned why level 1 and 2 both say executive rooms on the floor outside the lift they couldn't answer. Also the reason we upgraded was that we went from continental to full breakfast. When we went to breakfast the next morning the lady proceeded to tell us we still only had continental breakfast. I was quite upset. I went up to the desk again(this being the 3rd person we spoke to) and asked her straight out if room 410 was a club or an executive room. She said club room. Then I asked to speak to the manager and he then told us that it was in fact an executive room. So please may I ask ye to check with your staff to see if they in fact actually no the difference between a club and an executive room....because I really feel we are being cheated out of our upgrade and still being charged for it.we paid for our stay on check in assuming our upgrade was included in the price as I had received an email confirming the executive room...on questioning the manager about the room he proceeded to tell us that we still had the upgrade price despite paying for our stay in full on chwck in.we still have 2 nights left of our stay but we cant leave it go unsaid..also there is supposed to be complimetary water supplied daily and we asked for this on Saturday and 3 days later it still hasn't arrived.....

title: Like sleeping in a shoe box
text: So this hotel is clean and modern but the rooms are so small you can barely get one person in them let alone two. You have to have the toilet door open to use the lavatory and the bed is suitable for hobbits. If you are taller than 4ft and are of very slender build this place is great. Anything bigger than that forget it. Other thing to note is the bar shuts at 11pm even for residents. Staff are ok but are a little clueless on anything other then where the restaurant is. Also don’t book a cab through the reception either get an Uber or flag a black cab as it’s double the price!!! Overall very disappointing and won’t be staying here again.

title: Fantastic location
text: We stayed for three nights in a Club Double Room which was very compact but functional. Bar fridge was much appreciated as this is an absolute rarity in the UK. The option of having either air-con or open window was a plus. Staff were very professional and extremely helpful. Restaurant had great menu choices and all of the dishes we ordered were top quality. Prices of food and drink were very reasonable. Great continental breakfast which offered many options. Excellent location being only a three minute walk to Paddington Station which has much appreciated ramp access for passengers travelling with luggage. The only negative was there was only one lift which was frustrating at times.

title: Unbelievably small room at an expensive price!
text: An issue with online reservation forced us to stay at the hotel paying the price when booking directly with the property. The double room we were given doesn’t meet at all any standards of any 4 star hotel and can bearly accommodate 1 person. Access to bed, only by one side. Should you wish to get up, you need to wake up your partner! A triangular roof makes the ceiling fall into your face while lying on bed! Only one person can stand out of bed each time! As a result, only 1 bedside table can fit! Space between bed and a ‘cupboard’ counts to 40cm only! No space anywhere in the room to place your luggage! Shower at its base is approximately 90cm and triangular roof reaches 30 cm on top! You stand at 90cm space but your head is at 30cm when taking a shower! When using the toilet, there is no way to reach the toilet paper unless you stand up! In other words there is NO space to breath!!!!!! The 1st photo shows the distance between the bed and cupboard that is not enough for a person to stand in between. The 2nd is the toilet and shows what is mentioned above. The 3rd shows that due to the triangular roof, even a part of the bed had to be cut! The most inconvenient place we ever stayed at the highest price! (After pointing srrongly to the management that this should be sold as a single room, we were given a 50 pound refund)

title: One week in London
text: I have mixed feelings about this hotel- it has a great location near Paddington Station- so its quick and easy if you need to use the Underground or catch a train. Its near Hyde Park/Kensington Gardens which is great for a beautiful walk outside. And there are lots of restaurants in the Paddington area to chose from. We booked a Suite for a week long vacation and when we got there were told that our room was in the basement. Our room was indeed large but in a way that was not very pleasant. It was just a big space- bed in one corner, tv in another corner, sofa in another corner. We ended up moving furniture around so that it felt more like an actual living space. There was a strong musty smell through out the room and twice we saw bugs that looked like roaches. Also, make sure to double check your reservations- we booked directly from the Norfolk Towers Hotel websites and prepaid and they had multiple errors on our booking- length of stay and breakfast included was wrong. The manager who works the evening shift was very helpful and did fix these issues but definitely make sure to keep those email confirmations! All that being said, I don't think this hotel was terrible, it was just odd. I definitely would NOT book a suite- get a room above street level.

title: Horrible staff, toilet noises and very small rooms
text: This is the first negative review i write on Tripadvisor. The receptionists were rude and unhelpful when we requested early check-in as we arrived at 10 am and were very tired. The rooms are so small and the toilet doesn’t fit for one person, we were filled with bruises from the door hitting our knees and back. The worst part was sleeping at night when we were hearing the toilet flushes from all the neighboring rooms. The cherry on top was upon check-out when the receptionist asked us to pay 20 more pounds for breakfast because his colleague didn’t actually inform us that our breakfast doesn’t include eggs. Very disappointed 😔

title: Good hotel
text: Nice hotel, clean rooms, good beds and good service. We stayed a couple of nights here. Good cocktails in the bar. Breakfast was okay....you have to choose between cold buffet or pay for the warm one. For vegans the option is baked beans, mushrooms on toast (they had vegan butter), soy milk (ask for it) and fruit. Would stay there again. Good value and location.

title: Very bad hotel
text: We stayed in this hotel for 6 nights and we regret every second first we couldn't sleep is very noisy every thing that happened in the hall you can Gere clear in the room we have two rooms but they are both to small for England standard my daughter was always crying because the noise also the wifi is very bad it doesn't work a all a will never stay here even if is the last hotel in London and is free. please don't loose your money do not stay here

title: Worst night sleep ever!
text: Very noisy and couldn’t sleep from 5.45am-the banging and sliding of chairs upstairs from the Resturant. If your going to book here you must state before that you DO NOT WANT A BASEMENT ROOM! On arrival we thought we were lucky been given an upgrade to a lovey room downstairs. Later found out it’s rooms that no one wants and most people complain about. I should have read other reviews about chair noise on here but I didn’t look silly me. The staff had a chance to sort this out before they gave me the down stairs room but when we checked in they could not offer me another room because the manager wasn’t on. After complaining the next morning they still couldn’t do anything why? Manager wasn’t on! 🙄

title: Ripped OFF
text: SHAME ON THEM This hotel Norfolk Towers Paddington decided to take $271.00 fee when I cancelled with notice. They did this even though I pleaded with them not too. I makes me especially mad considering that they did not leave the room open but quickly rebooked. So they doubled their money at my expense. DO NOT STAY HERE. There are lots of great hotels with great customer service.

title: Pittoresk hotel in Paddington
text: Nice little hotel in centre of London. Friendly staff and nice and clean rooms. Good location in Paddington close to subway and lots of restaurants. 10 min walk from Hyde park and city centre. Fair prices

title: All you need
text: I managed to get a very good price on booking.com so that was a plus for a 4 star hotel. Adding to that, the staff was very nice and polite, the breakfast had a great qualilty and the rooms were also great. The location was a surprise too. Booking blindly this stay, I was lucky. There are restaurants, fast food shops, trains, coachs and the underground almost at the hotel's door!

title: Much better than expected
text: A wedding bought us up to London in August, the peak of the Tourist Season! We were pleased to get a hotel room for the Saturday night, but not sure what to expect at this place. We were blown away by the staff who coudn't do enough for us, the Room, which whilst small was adequate, the Wifi, which worked and ran at a proper speed, and the Breakfast, only Continental included in the price, but it was good, the coffee fresh and the available foods ample and tasty. Mind you the toaster needs replacing!. I shall use it again next time.

title: Fab Hotel!
text: Lovely hotel with friendly and helpful staff. Room was very nice and the bed was comfortable. Room had great facilities too. Loved being able to store our bags for the next day so we could get an extra day out of our trip without having to carry it around with us. Good location - close to the tube and Overground. Local area was quite quiet during the night too.

title: Fantastic find in London
text: We were so impressed with this hotel. I had booked a double room and on arrival we were upgraded to a suite. The reception staff were welcoming and efficient. The room was very large, the bed was enormous and extremely comfortable, the bathroom was fantastic with a large walk in shower(and tv in the shower!) The room was spotless and immaculate. We had a continental breakfast included and we were very impressed with the choice and quality of food. Would 100% recommend. Easy 5 minutes walk from Paddington station. Will definitely be going back again.

title: Exceptional
text: New refurbished spotless modern cosy rooms with all the facilities you should have in a 4 star hotel. Staff were nice and respectful and breakfast was tasty. The bathroom was a bit too small, and the 5 extra pounds for an english breakfast are not worth it.

title: Custo x benefício!
text: I ever been there during 3 nights. The place is good, nearly the padding station and very good tô locomotion. The breakfast is ok, basic, but you have everything that you need! If you wanna pay a bit more, you can enjoy the option plus complete, with English breakfast options. I didn't tried. The room are very small, but clean. For London, I never had big rooms, so Isn't a problem... The problem there, was the bed. My husband is 1,90m and needed to sleep with the feet out of the bed or in diagonal, so for me wasn't a nice sleep. Also the mattress was to soft, each movement disturbed a couple. I asked for change the room, they said that will see, but I didn't had answer. My brother in law and his wife was in the room nearly and said that was the same problem. So is not a bad place, just observe if you tail will be ok for the bed. They have a bar with good prices of bier and nice drinks.

title: Trip to London
text: This hotel has a very nice finish to it. The room and bathroom were all refurbished, lovely furnishings and comfy bed. Unfortunately the reason I have given a 3 out of 5 is because although the hotel is clearly 4 star standard, we felt the breakfast and breakfast service weren't. The maître d was very stern and unapproachable and there seemed to be no sort of system in place. We were allocated a table and it was given to another couple when we went to get our breakfast, the tea we ordered was also taken to the wrong table and we had to wait a while for it. We weren't too bothered about this really but the breakfast we got ourselves from the buffet was also very cold. We weren't asked if everything was ok when we finished so we let the reception staff know. The receptionist did promise us a hot breakfast the next day but unfortunately we didn't wake up in time for it after a late night which was our own fault. The choice at breakfast was very good. We were also surprised that as a 4 star hotel, there were no disposable toothbrushes or razors available in the room or from reception and we weren't able to get a packet of crisps late at night because the bar was closed. I assumed snacks would be available with a 24 hour reception. Despite these issues we would come back again as this is a lovely hotel in an ideal location. Hopefully the breakfast has improved when we visit again in the future.

title: Tiny rooms with all the comforts of home
text: When we got to our room I was a little surprised to find a staircase as soon as you opened the door. But to our surprise the room, though very tiny had everything you could want. Comfortable beds, nice shower, coffee maker, refrigerator, safe, hair dryer, very nice toiletries, and a desk. I asked for an extra towel and the were there in 2 minutes with four, two large and two small. The continental breakfast was pretty good and the service was excellent

title: Excellent staff. Good location
text: Stayed at Norfolk Towers Hotel for 3 nights bed & continental breakfast,plentiful choice.....full cooked breakfast available for an additional charge of £4.95 pp Booked a twin room..... Yes it's small but perfectly clean & adequate for a city hotel. Recently refurbished bathroom. Plentiful complimentary toiletries. Slight problem with the TV was attended to promptly & efficiently. Reception staff & waiting staff all very professional & attentive. Location ideal.....close to Hyde Park ,Paddington Station etc. Definitely recommend and would return in the future.

title: Not great
text: We weren't impressed. No decisions can be made, not even to use the phone when our room phone wasn't working, without "checking with the manager". We asked for an upgrade to accomodate an extra guest. They charged us £60 per night and put us downstairs. The sofa bed was so dreadful and we could hear every noise, footstep and chair scrape from above. We stayed 3 nights and then toured and came back for two nights we had slready pre booked. The second room was quieter, but the bathroom is so small you have to negotiate your way to sit on the loo with the door in the way. Also a tiny room. When I left the first time, I left a feedback form and said I was happy to talk to the manager, but when we returned, they never acknowledged the problems. Location is good, close to Paddington Station and breakfast is ok but expensive to have the English breakfast on top of a regular breakfast. I really didn't enjoy my experience here. I felt the staff were either poorly trained or the Manager didn't trust them. I spent lots of time waiting for the Managers response to trivial enquiries, and you could sense the high level of staff supervision so much it was uncomfortable.

title: Outstanding service in terrific location
text: I have used it twice during the day on stop overs while having meetings in central London first through a daily use site (by the hour) and then directly. The second time was at the last minute as my meeting time shifted and I needed a place refresh myself and leave my luggage so they gave a rate for 5 hours readily. The contrast to the hotel at Heathrow (Doubletree by Hilton) could not be more start both for service and the quality of the room. While the rooms are small they come with a full complement of amenities include a shaving mirror in the bathroom a full door for the shower (unlike the Doubletree Hilton which is a dump) excellent WiFi, coffee etc. The bed too was very comfortable with a full range of pillows. Strongly recommend whether for day or night use!

title: Great location, modern & friendly staff (tiny rooms!)
text: Great location, modern & friendly staff! The room was clean, modern and comfortable (lived up to the pictures online), but unfortunately very TINY! This was disappointing especially since it's not the most affordable in terms of price (when in the bathroom you can literally look in the mirror and see most of the bedroom). Lovely breakfast area with variety to choose from for breakfast. Staff were friendly and professional. The location is perfect, two minute walk from the central Paddington station.

title: Clean , Modern, Convenient, friendly and a tad small
text: My buddy and I were staying at the hotel before taking off to Scotland for a golf trip. I was searching for a clean and comfortable hotel room that was convenient to see the sights. I was not looking for any frills. First, the location is fantastic once you decide to use to the underground. There was usually at least one Underground employee to help figure out which train to take at Paddington. Was easily able to get to Covent Garden, Buckinham, London Tower using the underground. There were also a couple of great places for breakfast around the corner. The room was clean. The beds were reasonably comfortable, AC worked, and internet was decent (not perfect). While the room was modern, the bathroom was very small, I had to stand at a certain angle in the bathroom to be able to shut the door. Getting out of shower was a tad tough, was a big step down. I thought the staff was very friendly. Helped us figure out where to go. They arranged for a taxi for us to the train station the last day. I did not give 5 star rating because this was not a perfect property. However, if you are looking to stay in budget, have a clean and safe room with modern amenities while being within a 5 minute walk to one of the more central underground stations, this place was great.

title: Terrible hotel 2star service 2star rooms do not get robbed by them like they robbed us!
text: This hotel should be rated as a two star hotel nothing about it was good at all! Do not be fooled by thier photos! We arrived at our hotel and there was nobody to help us with our bags, we carried them from the car into the checkin area. We then checked in for our 12 night stay. We had a twin room. The elevator barely fit us both, when we walked in to our room we had no space for our luggage to even open! No closet space! So we went downstairs with our bags and told them we would like to check out and we understand that the first night we probably cant get back but the remaining 11 nights we should get refunded, i am sure this hotel can just re-sell the room and resell for more then we paid since we booked months in advance. They said NO, they said they will not refund us no questions asked they didn't even try to help. So we left and booked another hotel and checked into that one. So our room remains empty in that hotel for 12 nights!! I cannot believe a hotel would do this! We booked it on booking.com and they tried to help and could not do anything because the hotel refused to give back our money. So be careful booking or staying at this hotel they do not care about their customers you will not be happy they will rob you of your money just like they did us!!! What type of hotel would rather keep the room empty and keep a customers money instead of reselling the room?? How greedy! Just goes to show you how terrible their service is, how they do not care about their customers!! Stay away!

title: Loved our stay!
text: The hotel is located literally 2 minutes away from Earl's court tube station, in a very quiet and lovely area with plenty of food and drink options around. The staff were lovely and accomodating to our every need and although our rooms were in the basement, they were big enough and quite comfortable. Will definetly be staying there again!

title: Stay away from this hotel if you expect to feel relaxed and welcome while staying away from home
text: Just to say we have stayed in many hotels in London and have never had to complain before!! We arrived at this hotel a little early so was asked to go to the bar and wait a little while while our room was being prepared, bar tender could not even make cocktails, lol, when we got into our room it was the smallest room I have ever seen with stains on the carpet and a fridge that was warm, we requested an upgrade, which was sorted out for us with an extra cost of £180 more, young cleaning staff were very rude, some breakfast waitress were also rude, we decided just to make the best of our stay but one morning while having breakfast a manager came and sat on the table next to us and he proceeded to make a phone call, this call was to his sister and he was arranging his birthday celebrations that weekend, he spoke very loud and I’m sure the whole restraunt heard all his plans, during the call he swore a few times with the once saying to his sister “you have one job, just make sure I get f**ked” yes I know right, we almost fell off our seats, it made my wife very uncomfortable! Do not stay here if you want to feel relaxed and welcome when staying away from home

title: Expensive for what it is
text: Easy to find, good first impressions. No parking on or near site, had to walk 10 minutes from an expensive car park. The rooms were extremely small, although the beds were very comfortable. The bathroom was a good size with a fab shower. Continental breakfast included with a good variety. Wouldn't stay here again due to small rooms and the price paid.

title: Exceptional Visit
text: We stayed at this hotel for one night due to going to a show in London. From the moment we walked in, we were made to feel welcome by the smiley staff. Upon check in, we were informed that we had been given a free upgrade to one of the suites which was a lovely surprise. The room was magnificent wit ha comfortable queen size bed, a large seating area and a lovely modern bathroom with separate shower. There was even a TV in the bathroom! We had a wonderful nights sleep and in the morning we were treated to a very nice continental breakfast at no extra cost. The hotel with brilliantly located within a 5 minute walk of paddington station, which made travelling around London a breeze. This was an exceptional stay and we will certainly be returning.

title: Modern boutique hotel two blocks from Paddington Station
text: Stayed there for three nights on a solo visit to London. Rooms are small, but clean and well appointed. Staff were very friendly. Continental breakfast was good, with a variety of breads, cereal, fruit, yogurt, cold cuts and cheese. Great for easy access to the trains to Heathrow.

title: Good hotel in excellent location
text: We spent 2 nights here in a twin room. Yes the rooms are small but this is London. The location is great, just around the corner from Paddington station and a short walk to Hyde Park and Oxford Street. The beds were comfortable, rooms spotless, modern decor, friendly staff. Continental breakfast offered a good choice of fruit, cereal, yoghurt, pastries, bread, cheese and meat so we didn't bother to upgrade to the cooked breakfast. I'd definitely stay here again.

title: Good Hotel close to paddington
text: I stayed here for one night prior to a business meeting. It's a short walk from Paddington Station. Rooms are modern in style with decent showers (over the bath in the room I had). The bed was comfortable. Didn't try breakfast so can't comment, but there is a nice bar area off reception.

title: Good stay just next to Paddington station
text: Stayed for two nights on business trip, comfortable stay if arrive from Heatrhow. Breakfast was very tasty, room kind of small but this was not a problem, very clean, good quality tea and cattle in the room. Clean bathroom. Very helpful bell boy, navigate us on wifi and public transportation as we arrived. Bus 36 to Victoria via Park Lane stops just in couple hundreds meters and just in front of hotel on the way back. We used it a lot. I liked his stay.

title: An extremely good hotel.
text: Stayed here for two nights. The service was superb. Dinner and breakfast in the hotel were very good and excellent value for money. The cleanliness and comfort of the room were very good with the bed being exceptionally comfortable. The bathroom is very small and requires some choreography to maneuver around the space. I would certainly stay here again.

title: Lovely hotel
text: Amazing place! Really nice location and hotel overall. Stuff - all nice and helpfull. Rooms are clean and breakfast is delicious. I really enjoyed my stay in London. The bar is EXTRA nice! All the best :)

title: Great value for money
text: Great value for money. The location is great, just a few minutes walk from Paddington or from Hide Park. Executive Twin Room is spacious enough for two people, very clean, bathroom well equipped. Very nice service at reception desk and in the breakfast room. Included continental breakfast is a good joice of bread, fruits, cheese and meat, muesli, etc. I didn't need more. I certainly will return.

title: Great location but small rooms in Paddington
text: So, this hotel market itself as a modern boutique hotel with great location in central London. Although the hotel is modern and small (in many respects), I would not classify it as a through boutique hotel, both the amenities and service is not up the the standards of a through boutique hotel. However, my room was clean, the hotel serves a decent breakfast, and the location is great (3min walk from Paddington station and Heathrow Express). I travel quite a lot (business and pleasure) and I have never stayed in such a small room (not since student halls anyway), and as a traveler I think it would be useful if the hotel actually states the room size on the webpage (maybe they do but I did not book the room myself as it was business). Nevertheless, given the decent price for the room, £ 372 for three nights, and the location, I would recommend this hotel for solo travelers and possibly couples.

title: Small rooms but nice hotel
text: Location of the hotel is great if you leave the tube station the right way. It's about an 8 min walk. There are loads of shops and places to eat around the area. Hotel staff were friendly on check in and nothing was too much for them. Rooms were clean and small but they were fine for a quick stop might be a problem if you were staying for a few days. Fully stocked mini bar in room and room to put your own items to chill items. We did have a problem with noise in the night. There were kids staying in the room upstairs running around about 1 in the morning so went down to complain to the front desk who asked them to keep the noise down. 2 minutes later the noise resumed so we called down to the desk and they went up to see them and the noise levels dropped and we finally had a good sleep. The walls are very thin so if your a light sleeper ear plugs and sleeping tablets might be needed. Breakfast was included in our price you have to pay an extra £4.50 if you want the hot breakfast. Was a pleasant stay for the price and I would definitely return.

title: Lovely upgrade
text: Just had a lovely stay in London at the Norfolk Tower Hotel. We were there for a west end show and had a lovely room upgrade to LG2. There was an underground strike and we walked in the rain from Charring cross to Paddington an arrived dripping wet. Our room wasn't quite ready as we were a few minutes early so we sat in reception. We hoped to be offered a hot drink while we waited as we were soaked and it wasn't busy, but nothing, not even a towel. Overall a lovely stay and a nice English breakfast. Would stay again, as long as it was LG2. Thank you to everyone.

title: Nice hotel close to Paddington station
text: Hotel is nice, clean, modern and quiet. We had two rooms - one with double-bed was very small. We literally needed to take turn, when moving around in the room, and had difficulties to place the luggage into the room. The bathroom is very small, and hard to close the door once you're in. The other room with two separate beds was much bigger. Good beds and pillows, heating which was very much needed and worked well. The continental breakfast was ok, but every day the same. The full English breakfast for extra charge. The hotel has a bar and a restaurants, but we did not use those during our visit. Close to the Paddintong station makes a great location.

title: Fantastic stay
text: Lovely hotel , fabulous beds and a great rain shower . Good food . Only complaint is girl on reception called Janeth ,she has a Bad Attitude and is very rude .All the other staff members are lovely .We were also able to leave our bags all day , which was very helpful .

title: Great hotel good value for money
text: Great hotel and very close to Paddington station. Ideal location for a weekend in London. Will definitely stay again. Very nice room, staff very friendly and helpful. Great pub on the corner of the street. Very close to some nice restaurants too. Bed very comfortable. All in all a great place to stay.

title: Excellent!
text: Stayed one night as part of a business trip. It is a beautiful hotel close to Paddington station and the friendly smile of the staffs made me feel pretty comfortable, especially after a long day's work. The bar on the ground floor is atmospheric and both beer and food were great. The only problem is their lift, which is so small and slow and I had no chance to use it going down for checking out on the busy morning.

title: Very good location
text: The location is very good. Walkable distance to oxford street and Hyde park and next to Paddington station. The rooms are clean but rather small, but it is a very good choice for a lower budget in the center of the city. Most important, very good service, and restaurant is also good.

title: Norfolk has access to all transportation
text: The hotel has access to tube, train and bus. It is in the middle of an area full of services and walking distance to Hyde Park and Oxford St. It fits solo and family trips. The toilets have water hose which suits my culture and needs so much

title: Towering Above Others
text: Great location near Paddington Station and Edgware Road. Very nice entrance and modern hotel. Rooms can be small but well equipped. Nice bathroom but why are there no clear signs as to how to use the two showers and water temperature. Lots of guests wear glasses and it is difficult to read those silly signs in stainless steel when you do not have glasses on. Was every bathroom designer a person with 20/20 vision. LET US HAVE CLEAR SIGNS. Lots of helpful staff around especially at breakfast and at reception. Very nice for a few days.

title: Perfect Stay
text: Great location, 5 minute walk from Paddington, were able to drop our case off to be stored securely whilst we enjoyed our first day out. Upon our return later in the afternoon check in was quick and easy. Our room was immaculate with a bath in the en suite, perfect for a soak after a busy days walking. The beds were comfy and the room service very reasonable. Breakfast was excellent, continental was included but we upgraded to full English for only £4.95 each. The staff were all friendly and attentive and we would definitely visit again.

title: Excellent choice!
text: Good location, the room was tiny but comfortable, nice, quiet and clean. Tasty and fresh continental breakfast - ham and cheese, fruits, yoghurt, good coffee.... Breakfast restaurant was lovely with vice street view and comfortable chairs. Very frendly and nice service,. The elevator was extreamly slow :)

title: 2nd visit
text: I stayed here for 6 nights in April. This was my second visit to this hotel. This time I requested a twin room, and it was very small. The bathroom was so tiny I had to dry myself in the shower. The room had all the amenities necessary, and was cleaned every day, but the size of it meant we could not relax in the room at all. It was basically a room for sleeping and showering. Breakfast was included in the tariff and provided all that we needed. The biggest problem during this stay in Norfolk Towers was the lift. We were on the 5th floor, and on the morning we checked out the lift was not working. We toted our bags down 5 flights of stairs and when I mentioned it to reception, I was told I should have got someone to help me. Bit late by then! Norfolk Towers is in an ideal location for accessing Paddington Station which is why I chose it, but after my experience with the lift, I may think about a larger hotel next time.

title: Just what we needed
text: My girlfriend and I stayed for one night as part of an early-Valentines trip to the capital. We chose the place as it was one of the cheapest we found on booking.com and the reviews were ok. The hotel is about a 10 minute walk from Paddington, right by St Mary's hospital. The lobby is very bright and clean and the staff were welcoming. Our room was quite small, and would have been too small if we were staying for a week, but for one night it was perfect. The bathroom was again very small but the shower was a nice overhead. A continental breakfast was included, with an English available for an extra £4.95pp. There were plenty of staff on hand and I had coffee served very quickly. My only negative point was the lift, which was too small and too slow. In summary, the Norfolk did us proud for our one night stay and I would consider using it again.

title: Great Location, Nice and Clean
text: Wonderful location nearby Paddington Train and Tube station. Lot of restaurants in this area. My booking included continental breakfast, simple but you have everything you need. The room is not big but good enough to open two suitcases at the same time. Have daily housekeeping and it's clean. Only downside is the bed, it's too soft :(

title: Good location, but tiny
text: Bus 23 from Piccadily Circus stops right in front on the hotel and Paddington station is close, but not as close as I thought. There are nice cafes and restaurants around the hotel. Breakfast is good, especially the coffee, quick service, continental breakfast was included in the price. For English you had to pay extra. The staff is very friendly and the hotel and rooms are well maintained. There is only one elevator and it is slow and only fits 4 people or 3 with luggage or pram. The rooms, and especially the bathroom is very very small. No full size bath, and shower in the bath. Good airco. There is quite some noise from the traffic and crowd in the street, bit the original windows are covered by an extra set. This makes that it is almost impossible to get some fresh air unless you leave the extra window open. There is a panel in the room with several types of electricity outlets and usb which is excellent service that every hotel should have!

title: Brilliant hotel
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Excellent service. Ideal location. Room was very spacious. Stayed in one of the executive rooms. Breakfast decent. Only complaint is that the walls are quite thin and could hear people in the next room.

title: A winner in London
text: Stayed in the Paddington area for the first time in many years and was very pleasantly surprised at finding this gem. A clean modern room with very comfy large bed. An excellent restaurant and great staff. Paid £96 when similar hotels in the Euston area where I normally stay where wanting at least the usual stupid London prices around £180. Would highly recommend this hotel. It is two minutes walk from Paddington station. Will definitely book again

title: Great location
text: Had a quick trip to London , booked this just days before, we were not disappointed, staff very helpful , continental breakfast was good , we had deluxe suite worth few extra dollars , room was good size by London standards , bed very comfortable. 300m Paddington Station , Hyde Park, Kensington Palace etc . Lots of restaurants and pubs. Will stay here again .

title: Boutique hotel west London
text: Great location, close to Paddington Station. Easy access to airport as well. Very comfortable with the quieter rooms on the side. Free WiFi. Has restaurant and bar and offers breakfast as well - Reasonably priced. Recommend

title: A Touch of Class
text: Norfolk Towers Hotel has continued to be classy, neat and offers good value for money. Excellent WiFi services, very tasty meals at night and good breakfast in the early hours. Management should pay attention to training of front office staff. They are the face of the hotel and must therefore be trained in excellent service standards If Norfolk is to keep its clientele

title: Very nice
text: The hotel is new and modern in a calm area with underground and buses close by. Comfortable large single beds and large shower in bathroom. Breakfast is very good with a wide choice of food such as english breakfast or continental. You can leave your suitcase after checkout and no supplement is required. Highly recommended and will return

title: Small Hotel with Tiny Rooms
text: We chose this hotel for its proximity to Paddington Station which is about a 7 minute walk away. The staff is warm, welcoming and very helpful. A very good continental breakfast was included with our booking. We had a very early check out time so we were offered a box breakfast to take with us. While we declined the offer, we did appreacite the gesture. The room in which we stayed was quite small but had everything that we needed and considering that we barely spent any time in the room, it was fine. The are several restaurants, shops and money changers in the area. This hotel is good value for London.

title: Small hotel, excellent location.
text: I stayed in this hotel for 2 nights in October. We chose to stay here as it was only a 5 minute walk to the Tube and a 15 minute walk to Oxford Street. From checking in to checking out the staff were pleasant and accommodating. The hotel lobby is beautifully decorated, bright and modern. The room itself was quite small but that wasn’t an issue as we were only staying for a short time, most rooms in London are small anyway. The room was spotless and the bed was very comfortable, although even with the air con on the coolest setting and the window open it was uncomfortably stuffy. The breakfast was okay, the food was nothing special. I found it to be quite bland. Overall I’d say this hotel is more so suited for short trips, but we enjoyed our stay and its excellent location.

title: A Very Happy Experience
text: We received our stay at The Norfolk Towers Hotel as a present and what a wonderful gift it was. The hotel was very smart and clean and the staff were exceptionally friendly and welcoming in all areas of the hotel. We had a meal in the evening together with the breakfast next morning and the standard of food and presentation was really good. It was a stay we will never forget.

title: Great for Paddington and Heathrow!
text: Stayed here for a layover between Paddington Station and a flight from London Heathrow the following morning. A short brisk walk from Paddington - very convenient. Had a drink in the hotel bar - the hostess was very polite and friendly. The rooms weren't huge, but were well appointed (with good quality linens) and the en-suites were small but nicely decorated. Had a good night's sleep with no disturbances. The lift was a little slow - so don't leave it last minute to go downstairs! The breakfast was very nice, and the dining room comfortable. A quick walk to the Station and then the Heathrow Express in the morning... I was in the Lounge in Terminal 4 within an hour of leaving the hotel - quite impressive! Not my hotel of choice when in London (due to room size) but a great location for trains / planes!

title: Really disappointing
text: Spent £180 odd for a TINY twin room and a bathroom so small you could barely get in and close the door behind you! Arrived back at 11.30pm for a final drink to find the bar closed and no one prepared to serve the several residents hoping for a drink. I have never stayed in a hotel that wouldn't serve residents drinks at the end of an evening. The photos of the rooms are not realistic...much much smaller than shown and the noise through the paper thin walls is ridiculous. No breakfast included...thats another £11. Would I come back? No. Never.

title: ok - if you get a fair price
text: I was paiying some $145 during WTM, for that rate you can end up during high season in very bad hotels.... but this one was really ok. Good location (3min walk from Paddington), friendly check-in, clean room. Small, and basic, but it is central London. If you get a good rate - I would recommend.

title: Business meeting London
text: Stayed at the Norfolk Towers hotel in Londen for 2 nights. Hotel is a clean, small but luxuous hotel near a metro station and close to pubs and restaurants. Staff is very friendly and helpful. I booked a room including breakfast buffet which was good. Room was small but very convenient. Bathroom also small but nice and clean. I really can recommend this hotel for a business stay or weekend trip to London!

title: Ok
text: Lovely hotel Room was compact but practical Unfortunately the Bathroom could of been cleaner as we did find unsavoury items in the room Staff were attentive and helpful Clean hotel lobby And a complete breakfast for £10 Value for money But as my school report stated “Could try harder “ 😜

title: Pleasantly surprised
text: Normally we're based in Holborn for our last few visits down to London but as our main point of our trip was for stuff was in Hyde Park we had search around. Came across this hotel. Booked a family room which turned out to be a suite!! Result. Staff were all lovely and helpful..... nothing too much bother and done with a smile. Very welcoming. Room was spotless.... even a TV in the bathroom. The pull out bed that my daughter was in was a good size. Wife and I kept losing each other as our bed was huge lol. Sadly only stayed one night but will be back as it's a great location. Oh and for an extra few quid u can upgrade your breakfast..... well worth it and very tasty. And the staff at break were lovely too. Can't fault this one..... very very nice.

title: Close to Paddington station for trains to Heathrow
