title: Great Hotel,friendly staff
text: This is a lovely hotel,great location,friendly staff.Clean rooms and a nice breakfast.We paid £99 a night for a king room with free breakfast so was very happy with the price.There is a large fridge in the room as well as a safe. To find the hotel,catch a tube to Gluchester Rd,when you leave the tube station turn left past Waitrose and you can see the hotel further down that road.There are flags with the hotel name on visable.Its about a 3-4 minute walk. The Natural history and science museum,plus the V&V museum are within easy walking distance. For a short visit to London,this was an excellant choice.

title: More than I expected
text: Pleasantly surprised - every staff went out of their way to make you welcome and attend to every need or request. Would definitely recommend and go back again.

title: Lovely hotel
text: I thoroughly enjoyed my nights accommodation at the park international. I was pleasantly surprised at how clean, well presented and modern finish the room had. The showers and bathroom were spotless. The dinner in the restaurant was a lovely change. I highly recommend this hotel for business or pleasure. I can't wait to go back.

title: Excellent price-quality ratio
text: Excellent location, near by tube station (200 m). Our room was in 1st floor, still it was quiet. As a central London hotel the room was huge... good bed, air conditioning, warm, clean, good breakfast! Well equipped room: hair dryer, safe and good light in toalet to do the make-up!! The breakfast room was small but if you are in business trip and early up, no queue, if you are on vacation you are not in a hurry! Very friendly and helpful personel.

title: Great value for money!
text: We stayed here whilst attending a show at Olympia. We were very pleasantly surprised with the hotel. We had a lovely fourth floor room, not very big but absolutely fine for us. The reception staff were all great as were all the staff that we came across. Breakfast was lovely and super to see proper fresh fruit salad. We would definitely stay again! One downside, please, please get the goldfish at reception a much larger bowl, one of the reception staff told me they keep dying and I'm not surprised!

title: great location
text: The location of the hotel is really good. We always choose the area of Kensington, because it is quiet and well connected. The hotel staff is friendly and helpful. Breakfast could be improved. It is likely that I will return.

title: Short trip to London!
text: Me and wife planned to have a short trip to London and last time was for many years ago. We were lucky with weather too and all in all all a good trip. The hotel location was also very good, near to subway and short walking (15 min) to central locations in London. Our room was junior suite and we were satisfied with it. The hotel has also a good English breakfast too.

title: Exceeded expectations
text: This hotel looks like it has recently been redecorated and is stylishly laid out. The receptionstaff are welcoming , especially William on reception was most helpful and accommodated my request for a room with a bath. Breakfast was the only area which could improve for me as choice a bit limited. Very good location close to tube and restaurants

title: Great South Kensington location
text: My friend and I stayed in one of the small double rooms. Americans should be aware that their small rooms (as are the rooms in ALL European hotels) are VERY small. We were a bit overwhelmed by how small it was when we first arrived. However, after a nap we were able to organize everything so that we were able to comfortably stay in the room for 8 nights with easy access to our stuff. The bathroom is lovely and very roomy. The pillows are super comfortable, and the beds are not bad. Overall, between the fantastic staff, the cleanliness, and the FANTASTIC location, I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone!

title: FANTASTIC HOTEL
text: This hotel is fabulous, our family of three was upgraded on arrival to a room with two double beds. The room was spotless, and spacious although the bathroom a little small. Attention to detail is fantastic here, a problem with the card for the electricity was sorted in 10 minutes. My husband asked for a softer pillow and the receptionist took him to the stock room to choose his preferred one! Breakfast is lovely, everything you could ask for. Quality breakfast items, sausages are gorgeous! The bar is a welcome change by not ripping you off on prices. They have a happy house between 5 and 7. A pint of beer and a glass of wine was £5.50. Fantastic value for London. On the friday evening there was a very talented young pianist playing and singing which was a nice touch. This hotel was a refreshing change from all the big players i.e. Hilton, Holiday Inn. The location was great, three minute walk from the tube station. We will be going back - 5 Star.

title: Pleasant stay
text: We stayed 6 nights in a newly refurbished double room with ensuite. It was clean and very comfortable with shelves to unpack and store luggage. Ensuite was roomy with a great shower. Staff was friendly and helpful. Location was good for walking to museums and the Gloucester Rd tube station. This is a convenient tube station with access to 3 lines. Yes, the buffet breakfast ran a bit cold. Cold works for the canned fruit. Enough to choose from to make it work.

title: Good hotel, ideally situated
text: I have just spent Easter weekend at The Park International

title: Good hotel and a great location
text: Have stayed at this hotel many times and have always given it 4/5, but not this time.This time I got a room on the top floor and that meant a slanting roof. Still a good hotel at that price and will stay here again.. Some tips - Order through the website and get free wi-fi Good breakfast. Recommended. Near the tube Tesco, waitrose and sainsbury really close by.

title: Beautiful rooms Great Staff wonderful breakfast conveniet location.
text: This was the last hotel we stayed in our 2 week European visit. It was the best of all. The staff was so friendly and kind. The room and the bathroom were larger than any of the other hotels we were in. If we had stayed in this hotel first, we would have been disappointed in everything else. The room was beautifully decorated and looked newly renovated. It was close to the underground and buses. This will be My Hotel of choice when I visit again.

title: Not complaints at all!
text: Comfortable & modern rooms, good spread at breakfast, free wifi, good location. Very near Gloucester Road Tube Station along the Picadilly Line - except the Picadilly trains don't stop there due to upgrading til November! That is the only minus we have for this hotel and it aint the hotel's fault. Special mention goes out to the wonderful receptionist Filippa (from Portugal, hope we got your name right) - we appreciated every kind gesture you showed us! You were the icing on the cake to our 3 night stay.

title: Great Value excellent service.
text: We stayed for 2 nights, really good value hotel, great location for Harrods, Royal Albert Hall, Natural history and Victoria and Albert museums. Had an early meeting and left luggage at reception before checking in, which was not a problem.

title: Location, location, location!
text: Stayed here for 7 nights in April 2012. Very clean, free breakfast every morning with a decent selection of food items and friendly staff. You can walk from the hotel to Kensington Palace, the Victoria and Albert museum and the park. Two blocks away from the Gloucester Road tube station with access to the Picadilly, Circle and District lines which is everything you need to get around. There is a great indian restaurant across the street which I highly reccomend. Such fresh food! If you're going to be sightseeing this is the place for you. While the room is small, it does not matter if you'll be out sightseeing anyway. Would definitely stay there again! :)

title: Wonderful experience!
text: We just returned from London and had wonderful service, breakfast and rooms at this hotel. The staff was so kind and helpful with everything we needed! We will definitely return to this hotel if we go back to London!!!

title: A Mixed Bag
text: I booked a Superior room in this hotel on line after reviewing about 50 hotels in the Kensington area. Having lived in the UK and being familiar with UK hotels I was looking for something better in the mid range price. Check in around 2PM went fine and outwardly the room looked great. Large comfortable king size bed but very little space for 2 thin sized people to move around. (I would hate to see the size of their regular rooms!) On closer inspection, the bathroom sink was scarred with deep scratches (ideal for bacterior growth) and the bath tub stopper was broken. Minimal toiletries, worn towels and no hotel directory or TV instruction. Returned to the front desk to leave detailed written and verbal instructions for an impending call from my relatives from Australia who were staying nearby. We had planned a reunion dinner that night. At 4

title: Charming hotel, close to the the Natural History Museum and more...
text: I stayed at this hotel for two nights in December 2015. After initially booking a single room, I paid a little extra and upgraded to a double room and was glad that I did, as the room was very spacious and tastefully furnished. The staff on reception were pleasant throughout my stay and the breakfast service was very good. A perfect location to explore one of the finest areas of London!

title: best Hotel we ever had in London!!
text: nice and quiet room - very freindly staff - great sleep in good bed - great breakfast buffet - good location in the heart of London. We would always like to come back for our next stays! ...hopefully very soon :-)

title: Hard to beat location
text: I was reviewing another hotel and wanted to offer my comments from a stay two years ago. I would agree with most others that this is a great location. It's a very central spot with a tube station -- with links to virtually all of London's major attractions -- within a very short walk. The staff was friendly and helpful. I would say here again.

title: Great Experience!
text: The location of the hotel is the best part. Very close to the Underground and also bus transportation. Walking distance to Harrod's, Kensington Palace, and museums. Cute restaurants in the area also. The hotel was clean but basic. Still the breakfast (included) was good and the concierge answered our endless questions and were so helpful! I would definitely stay there again when visiting London!

title: Great hotel for the price you pay
text: For the price I paid I did not expect a 5 star hotel with all the trimmings but what I got was much more than what I expected. The room was small but good enough for 2 people. I stayed on the top floor and had a nice view of a little English street. Stayed here for 1 and a half weeks and the room was always very clean. A credit to the cleaning staff. Shower was a bit small (I don't know how an overweight person would fir comfortably in there) but generally clean. There was a small tv in the room which looked quite old but then again I didn't go on holidays to watch tv! Breakfast was included in the package and it was sufficient. A good supply of cereals, cakes, toast and fruits to keep you full well into lunchtime. The staff wew great and very helpful. They answered any questions quickly and without fuss. The greatest thing about this hotel though is LOCATION! A great location. Close to shops, supermarkets and mainly...Glouster Road Tube station. This station is connected to most of the main attractions around London. You can get from your hotel room to most major attractions within 20-30 mins if you know how to use the tube. And Hyde Park is not too far a walk either. I've had friends who've stayed in other london hotels for the same price and they have said that the room I had was far superior to any of the others they had stayed in. I highly recommend this hotel! I really enjoyed my stay here.

title: We would stay there again
text: Close location to public transportation underground & bus. Restaurants of all types and budgets within walking distance. Very well kept older hotel that was clean with updated bathroom. We had dinner at an Italian restaurant recommended to us that Princess Diana frequented. It was awesome! One of the highlights of that visit.

title: Great location/comfortable
text: Comfortable stay, nothing particularly incredible but nothing bad either. Internet worked well and was reliable. Rooms were clean, and 5 minute walk from the tube. One thing we liked was the availability of teas and a kettle in the room, as well as the sound insulation that made the place really quiet and comfortable. The staff were nice as well.

title: Good for the price and location
text: Room is not big but clean and comfortable. Centre in London and close to underground. Very easy to travel around London. Good for price. This is my third time stay in this hotel. They have now free wifi which is very expensive before and only free at lobby.

title: Overall Pleasant Stay
text: My first time visiting the UK and I was warned that the rooms are small so that wasn't too much of a surprised for me. I actually believe my room was updated so I was definitely comfortable. It had an old charm. The location was great being so close to the underground, nice restaurants and even tourist stops. So why am I only giving it a 3? There was a mouse in the lounge area. I've seen a mouse in a hotel before. Not saying they don't exist but it's just not experience. We didn't make a fuss about it but just seeing it made me a bit uneasy. I was also disappointed that American sports weren't available in our rooms (which is why we were in the lounge area). It would've been a nice perk!

title: Our London home from home
text: Our family has been staying at the Park International at least 3 times a year since 2005. We have always found the staff to be extremely helpful and friendly- especially the concierges and the breakfast staff. Now that the hotel has almost completed its extensive renovation programme, I can honestly say that it's still best value for money in London. We love the location (handy for tube, museums, Harrods and lovely Kensington) and the rooms are comfortable if not roomy. There are several hiccups with the new rooms (no bin iin the bathroom, no drawers in the room and nowhere to put your empty cases) but most can be remedied if you speak to the hotel staff. My family and I will definitely continue to stay in this cheery and excellent hotel

title: Great Hotel
text: Having just recently had a trip to London I found myself in a different area than that I would normally stay so decided to try The Park International and was really pleased I did. The hotel is in an excellent location for the Museums but a little bit too out of the way for some of the other attractions, however there is a tube station just around the corner. The staff were excellent, very friendly and helpful. The breakfast choice was very good and plenty of it! The room was very clean and very comfortable. I would definitely stay again and of course be happy to recommend to others.

title: Exactly what we wanted...and more!
text: I booked this hotel as it was definitely one of the cheapest in the area, and was expecting a basic, no-frills stay. The hotel is in a great location, only a few minutes walk from Gloucester Road tube station, with plenty of convenience stores and food outlets nearby. On check-in the staff were very friendly and told us that our room had been upgraded, which was excellent! The room was lovely, with a large bed and sofa and a big shower. It was extremely clean and beyond our expectations! Unfortunately, there was quite a lot of noise from the bar above us, but this didn't bother us too much. The breakfast was delicious with a good selection of hot and cold food. However, on an email I received from the booking company it said that if your booking did not include breakfast, there would be a 14.99 surcharge each. Luckily breakfast was included in our package as I do not think it was worth this price. Another downside is the wifi, I do think that this should be available free in all rooms for a 4* hotel. If in London again I would certainly stay in this hotel as the staff were brilliant, the bed comfy and the location made sightseeing very easy.

title: London on a budget! It can be done
text: Park International Hotel. Clean, Pleasant staff, Good service, Great Location - very close (4-5) min walk to the Gloucester Road Tube Stop. Stay here. Very easy to catch the Tube or the Cromwell bus line from the Park International... you are into the heart of the museum district of London in minutes or Piccadilly area with Fortnum and Mason (My favorite) or Harrods. Park International included Breakfast - a real breakfast! (Eggs, Sausage, Oatmeal, cereal, breads, fresh baked croissants, and baked beans of course!). With the family this is a bonus. Of course the WiFi in the lobby is free (slow but free) and the room WiFi is extra. Want to make the hotel fantastic offer free in-room WiFi, but pay for faster level of service. Special Kudo's to the front desk staff - We had a 4:30 am departure to catch a 7 AM flight and the staff had a sack lunch for us - Sandwich, box of OJ and a Croissant ready ... way before the breakfast restaurant opened. Thank you! My only gripe - the pub in the hotel is average at best and not as accommodating. We wanted to watch Six Nations Rugby Final Match, the empty bar had few patrons, and the bartender was not accommodating - he wanted to watch is local soccer team (Boo). We went to a Pub The Hereford Arms (Great food) around the corner to watch England win the championship match. I thought the British loved Rugby!

title: Good hotel with great location.
text: We checked in farely late but the front office staff was friendly and checking up on their nightaudit. We got to the room which was fine I requested a room on a higher floor which we got. We were celebrating my sisters upcoming birthday which I wrote before arr. But no surprise in the room :-) At breakfast they forgot us a couple of times, we ordered tea but nevet got it. The breakfast supervisor was very friendly but her staff seemed very stressed. But it was a lovely breakfast and always full of food. A shame we had to pay for wifi. The cleaning of the rooms were absolutly amazing ! I was a little bit disapointed with the Concierge. I am a Concierge myself and a good Concierge should never let the guests explain to much where they want to eat. We found help from others regarding this aswell for Clubbing! Overall a really good hotel with friendly staff. Very good cleaning and great location. We will come back soon !!

title: Amazing!!!
text: This hotel is a couple of minutes walk from the tube station and has loads of shops and places to eat within walking distance. Staff are friendly and see to your needs! The chairman’s suite is huge especially for London as are the other suites.

title: Nice clean hotel!
text: Staff is friendly and helpful, at breakfast severely short of staff, working too hard but always friendly. Management ought to be ashamed! I hope the staff is well paid.... Breakfast buffet was great with both healthy and unhealthy food of choice. Nice lobby. Room clean and nice with flat screen tv. Wifi too expensive. Great location, easy to get about by tube. Close to kensington gardens/hyde park. I would like to come stay again if there is a good offer on :)

title: Bargain hotel no frills
text: I stayed here with 3 colleagues on a 6 day business trip. The positives - great location, near two tube stations, (Gloucester Road and Earl's Court) decent restaurants and shopping, etc. The room was very small, clean, decent linens and towels, etc. The hair dryer was annoyingly not in the bathroom, but that is typical of Europe and the UK, but you had to press the on-button to keep it going the entire time. The bathroom was very small and the shower was a tube that you could stand in and just turn-around. Flat screen TV with limited channels but we were there on business and not to watch TV so it was ok. Now to the negatives: furniture in the lobby well worn and not terribly clean. The wi-fi was horribly expensive and you had limited data. It was free in the lobby and bar/restaurant but not without a password and access code that had to be updated hourly. The breakfast was passable - not great and the coffee was horrible. Even though breakfast was included in our deal after the 2nd day we all shuddered at the thought of it and went to Caffe Nero's. All in the all, the price was right, and because we had 3 of us for a week, with limited time in the room except to sleep, we put up with it. Would I say here again? No, there are other economical options for business travel that I would opt for first. If price is what drives your decision picking this hotel won't be a disappointment for you. If you are looking for something a little more upscale in terms of amenities and decor - go elsewhere.

title: Simply Wonderful!
text: I spent the weekend at this hotel with my family, age range 10 to 73 and we all loved it! The hotel itself is very convenient for the tube station, beautifully styled and lovely and clean. The staff were an absolute pleasure and made a real difference to our weekend. Breakfast was great - filled us up for the day and the bar has a really great atmosphere on a Saturday evening. Thanks for a fab weekend, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: All The Charm Of England
text: This was my first trip to England. I found the lodging at Park International to meet all my expectations of the charm of England. Staff were friendly and helpful. Location was great, close to tube abd shopping, and easy to reach from Heathrow. Definitely plan to stay here when I return next year.

title: All-round excellence at this splendid hotel!
text: We were lucky to get a special deal at this hotel less than a week before Christmas. Every aspect of our stay (for one night) was excellent: the booking-in, the accommodation, overall hotel facilities, the breakfast...everything. This is a hotel fully deserving of its four-star classification (why not five?).

title: A GOOD CHOICE WHEN IN LONDON
text: The Park International Hotel in the Kensington section of London was a reasonable hotel selection for our recent holiday stay in London. Somewhat undramatically sited on busy Cromwell Road near the Gloucester Road Tube station and south of Kensington Gardens, the hotel offered us good value for our money, and my friends and I agreed that we would stay there again if the opportunity arose. The staff were friendly and helpful, our daily breakfast was good, and our rooms were clean. Our rooms overlooked a side street away from Cromwell Road, so they were quiet. (I suspect a room overlooking Cromwell could be noisy.) It appears that the hotel may have recently undergone a significant refurbishment. There were some odd features. Internet access is free only in the lobby, and you must ask for a new password every hour. A single room is very small and can be difficult to maneuver in if you have much luggage. There are several steps up from the street below, so full handicap accessibility is doubtful. The on-site restaurant and bar are small, but they appeared to do a good business in the evenings. If you plan to use the Underground for your transportation around London (and the Gloucester Road station is on the Picadilly line from Heathrow Airport), I would recommend looking into the Park International Hotel.

title: Excellent choice for a few days in London.
text: It is located in a very good zone, nearby a tube station just two minute walk. Excellent service and clean rooms. there are also good restaurants and pubs nearby. In my next trip to London I would definietly consider again the Park.

title: Seven Day Stay at the Park
text: The Park International is a well located boutique hotel in South Kensington. It is predominantly used by tourists and air crew during their layovers. The hotel is made up of several Victorian era homes that have been joined together so that the layout of hall ways is interesting and the room sizes vary. We stayed in room 533 on the top floor under the eves. It was cozy and comfortable with a modern bathroom and a small porch(no great view). Housekeeping was professional, and we experienced limited noise from Cromwell Road. We visited during a London heat wave and as long as our room attendant left the "British" A/C on it was fine. Hint: Bring your own wash cloth if you need one. Evidently European hotels are starting to leave that item off their linen closet list. Breakfast was simple but plentiful and typically European with the cold cuts and selection of breads. Hot items were also available and I learned on the next to last day one could request eggs cooked ways other than scrambled. Plenty of dining and shops in the area and the Gloucester Road tube five minutes. The Park also had an in house restaurant which we didn't use but the menu looked interesting, and reasonable. The only reason I didn't give it 4 stars is because of the pay wi-fi. How much can it possibly cost to provide this amenity to guests in today's world. I would stay here again.

title: Our base of operations while in London
text: We had a very agreeable stay at the Park International. The staff was friendly and always willing to assist us with our travel around London. There were several restaurants near the hotel and the underground was a four block walk. The rooms typically small for a city hotel, but clean and well appointed. The morning breakfast was standard English fare that was well served. The bar was well stocked with pleasant servers. We will return to this hotel next time we are in London.

title: Location-wise is 10/10. 3
text: 3mins walk to Gloucester road station and 1 min walk to Ashburn Gardens bus stop which had night bus services. A big waitrose next to Gloucester road station and a 24/7 tesco express 5 mins away from the hotel. The room was a bit old. Four tea bags and 4 milk for tea were refilled every other day. They won't refill then even though we used up all the tea bags and milk in one day. And some tea bags were being teared!!! Furniture were a bit old but still fine for use. Our room located at the basement and it was spacious.

title: Very Nice
text: We enjoyed our stay at this hotel. We felt safe walking in the area. Our hotel was clean, staff friendly and amenities in the area included retaurants, pharmacy and grocery. would definitely stay there again!

title: Comfortable rooms and good location
text: It is only a 5mins walk to the Gloucester Road tube station on the Piccadilly and Circle Lines, so it is extra convenient. Many dining options in the area, as well as Waitrose and Tescos supermarkets. The rooms are of the right size, sleep was comfortable and wifi is fast enough. Would definitely stay here again on my next trip.

title: First class London Hotel
text: I have been staying at this hotel every week for nearly a year now. It's definitely one of the best hotels in London. Staff are helpful and friendly. Rooms are spacious - not your typical box room for London. Location is excellent - close to underground and nice restaurants and bars in Kensington. Only small complaint is lack of flexibility with room menu - well I have been here for a long time and would love the resdtaurant to be more flexible with food available in room. Apart from that no complaints

title: Excellent Hotel! Snotty Staff!
text: We booked a standard double room for two nights and I cannot fault the room! The hotel is in the perfect location with lots of restaurants and cafes around, and only a 3 minute walk to Gloucester Road station! The only problem was with the attitude of the staff - we did not feel welcomed and the staff we very abrupt!

title: One Night Stay
text: We stayed over at the Park International for one night as we went to the theatre. The hotel was clean and well presented although lacked the character of other hotels in similar locations. The room was fine but exceedingly small. If we had any more luggage it would have been a squeeze. Although saying all this the hotel is in a brilliant position with only a 5 minute walk to the nearest station and only down the road from all the big London museums so a perfect stop over if you’re not fussed on the size of your room. It was fine for a one night stay but I wouldn’t recommend an extended stay in the small room.

title: veru good hotel
text: booked through Groupon and was very impressed This hotel was a little dated however very clean and the service was excellent Breakfast was included and was excellent and just around the corner from tube overall very food vale for money

title: Very pleasant stay
text: My wife and I spent a week-end (Oct. 11-14, 2012) at this hotel. It was a very pleasant stay. The location was great. We took the underground from Heathrow to Gloucester road station (2 blocks from the hotel) and within an hour we were at the hotel. Every evening we visited the theater district. The trips were convenient by using the Piccadilly line from Gloucester road station. The hotel was newly renovated and the room was very clean and comfortable. The room was facing a back street and we couldn’t hear anything from the city noise. The breakfast was great with both warm and cold alternatives. The best was the friendly and service minded staff in the breakfast room as well as in the reception.

title: Brilliant location
text: We booked this hotel as it seemed farily near to the Royal Albert Hall where we were attending a concert. When we arrived we were a little surprised to see it was undergoing refurbishment and scaffolding all around it. however once inside everything was fine. The receptionist could have been a bit more pleasant and at least have smiled but in London or anywhere else it just depends who you happen it get as the reception staff change all the time. Our twin bedded room was quite small but everything was spotless and had everything for our use, it was in need of refurbishment and as this is taking place will be better next time. We found the area very nice with both supermarkets and restaurants all within walking distance. It took us about 10 minutes to walk to the Royal Albert Hall after getting directions from two charming gentlemen on reception. Breakfast was advertised as continental and was served in the newly renovated breakfast room. If this was continental I don't know what they would consider a full english. There was everything from bacon, sausage, eggs, mushrooms etc. as well as the normal cheese, ham, cakes etc. and all the restaurant staff were charming. I would certainly recommend this hotel to anyone who has to stay in this part of London and is on a medium budget as you can get to most places either on the bus or tube and it is a very interesting area to be in.

title: Good
text: Triple bed room is very small. If you are traveling with children with large luggages highly not recommend. upgrade to Junior suite is better. But well! If you ask for a wine glass in your room “a wine glass, not a glass of wine” 2.50 pound will be charged..... FYI 🙈

title: Served purpose well
text: Positives - price very reasonable - staff pleasant - close to tube station, 15 min walk to the Albert Hall - breakfast v nice - communal areas attractively decorated - clean Negatives - room and bathroom small - room way too hot - bed springs noisy every time I rolled over in bed - shower sprouted water out the side - complimentary bottle of water would have been appreciated

title: Lovely one night stay!
text: We booked a Junior Suite at this hotel online. The process was simple enough and we needed somewhere close to the Royal Albert Hall as we were going to watch a Kylie Christmas. Only a stone's throw away from Gloucester Road Underground Station, it's convenient to get to for travellers from Euston. We were greeted by Mira at reception who was really polite and friendly. We were given the Mews Suite on the 3rd floor and we certainly weren't disappointed! Beautiful, spacious, lovely furnishings and one of the most comfortable beds I've ever slept on. Lovely, semi-firm pillows made it even better as my pet peeve in hotels is a comfy bed with rubbish pillows. The bathroom was clean, Lee 'Occitane products and fantastic shower. I really couldn't ask for more.

title: Good quality in a most useful location.
text: We have stayed here twice as it combines good quality rooms in a very convenient place ,Gloucester Road underground just 100 metres away,at a reasonable cost. On our recent stay we had breakfast included and it was very good. The staff were all very helpful and friendly so we will return !

title: Nice location and an excellent breakfast
text: The hotel is situated very close to the underground which makes it perfect for a tourist visit to London. The rooms are nice and clean. The staff is very helpfull and professional. Our stay included breakfast and WifI whick were perfect.

title: Could do much better
text: We stayed 5 nights, on the 4th morning we were still dealing with room maintenance issues, after repeated meetings with duty and front of house managers. Our meeting with the general manager took us little further. Why is it so many hotels are reactive in dealing with these issues? Is it unreasonable to expect that the shower tray drains properly, that light fittings are properly fixed to the wall, that the bulbs work, that the television stations listed by the hotel are actually delivered? We were offered room changes to address the TV issue, once at 23.30 hrs. It transpired that the fault was hotel wide and duty managers either did not understand this or they were obfuscating. We were also told by a manager in heavily accented broken english that the problem was not theirs but that of a third party supplier, SO WHAT! And each day we had to keep asking what had been done because no one was communicating with us. The hotel has potential but needs to sort procedures, maintenance and communications. And please don't tell me I will not be able to speak to the general manager because he's too busy!

title: Exceptional experiences!
text: I stayed at the Park International London on the first and last legs of a 2 week solo UK trip in January 2006. I researched alot of hotels in London for this, my second trip to the UK, and I don't think I could have done much better than the Park International. I arrived at their lobby after a 10+ hour plane ride from San Francisco at about 11am UK time. The hotel couldn't have been easier to find, when you come out the Gloucester Rd tube stop (Piccadilly Line), turn left at the corner (where the pharmacy is) and go about a block and a half and there it is on your left, with all the flags hanging from the roof. I knew they wouldn't let me check in until 2pm so I was able to drop my bag with the friendly concierge, and went wandering the neighborhood until I could check in. There's tons to see around there-- I had a bite at the cafe across the street, checked my email at the internet cafe next to it, then walked to the Natural History museum. (about 2 blocks west of the hotel) When I was able to check in, I was more than pleased with my room. I had booked a king room with a fridge through an early booking promotion on the hotel's website for about 48GBP. (about $86USD) The bed was huge and comfy, the bathroom in good condition, the tv was large, and the room was quiet, facing the row of buildings behind the hotel. I stayed in that room (212) for 3 nights at the beginning of my trip, and was never too cold or too hot, always had something to watch on tv in the mornings and evenings, and was very quiet. The maid service was excellent, they replaced everything including soap, towels, and coffee tray items every day and never bothered me. The front desk was great, even delivered a note with a message a friend left for me under my door. The location is superb, I was able to walk to the Sainsburys (about 2 blocks east toward Earl's Court) and shop for groceries and drinks and save money on eating out by putting the stuff in the room's fridge. The tube was less than 5 minute's walk away, and there was plenty of fast food to choose from across from the tube station (KFC, Starbucks, Burger King) as well as small restaurants of every imaginable kind. I had such a good experience with the hotel on the first leg of my trip that it was a huge relief to be able to come back to it at the end of my trip. I even left Dublin Ireland a day earlier than expected and was able to get a room a day early back at the Park International with little fuss through Yahoo Travel, though I switched rooms after that add on night according to my original second leg of the trip reservation. So in all, I stayed in 3 rooms in all on my vacation in London. I had a great room for the single add on night (512?) facing Cromwell road on the top floor, great view! Then I was switched per my reservation to 207 (or 208?) in the back, for which I had to go up and down stairs in a back hallway. (not a big deal but kinda confusing) While in that room, on a Saturday evening, we had a fire alarm go off, and we had to evacuate. I was surprised how slow the guests moved to leave the building!! The staff was very good about getting us out though, and after the fire brigade checked out the hotel (false alarm), we were able to go back in. The rest of my stay was uneventful. The staff were nice at all times, and the breakfast buffet was good, too, though it was mainly toast, cereal, fruit cocktail, ham and cheese, pastries, and coffee. Through my booking online, it was included in the price. I will return to London again and again I am sure, and will absolutely stay at the Park International!!! It comes highly recommended by me.

title: Mixed Emotions
text: I stayed at the Park International twice. First time was in July 04, when I went to London to watch the Wimbledon Tournament. I had a twin room with a friend which was in the basement. As we didn`t spend too much time in the room, we were not really bothered, that the room was not quite luxurious. It was not bad and nothing special - but ok for two guys who wanted some fun days out in London. Second time I stayed there was in September 04, when I went there with my wife. We got a double room in the fifth floor and I couldn`t believe that this was the same hotel - the room was absolutely fantastic, it seemed to be new (at least new renovated), it was quite large, with a working fridge, kind of a flat screen tv and really clean and neat. I also made the experience, that the staff at the reception has a large variety of enthusiasm and customer care. Some are friendly and helpful, others don`t seem to care... I would probably stay there again if the price was right!

title: Excellent Breakfast
text: We stayed for one night. The hotel is conveniently located for museums and transport links. Room was comfortable and the breakfast was excellent. Staff were very friendly and helpful. the hotel is on a main Road but traffic noise for us *in a room at the back) was not a problem.

title: Great value and good atmosphere for a comfortable weekend break
text: We stayed here yesterday with some good friends of ours for a Saturday / Sunday London break seeing a show. It is very well-located, the staff are friendly and helpful, and the room - although on the small side - had pleasant decor, was spotlessly clean, with a very comfortable bed and a smart and spacious shower room. I regretted not bringing my sports clothes as the hotel has a gym. We were very impressed with the breakfast, included in the price, which included some cooked items, was in a very pleasant, airy setting, and provided newspapers to read. Great value and we are recommending it to our friends.

title: Fantastic hotel
text: I have stayed here over a dozen times, and return every time I need to overnight in London. Top staff, throughout the hotel, particularly on reception, bar and breakfast service. The hotel is smart throughout, and good value.

title: intruder in my room
text: On a recent trip to London with two friends we were surprised that the triple room didnt materialise, we were given a double with a safari bed, unsuitable for an adult. We complained, a suitable room was organised, the porter brought the key of the new room, no offer of help with luggage. That night we were surprised to hear a knock at 4 am, 5 minutes later a man came into the room! We were terrified. I rang the desk, they apologised, the following morning a 20% discount was offered. This hotel is of a very poor standard, no security whatsoever.I would not go back. Caution to single female travellers!!

title: Book with confidence,
text: Six of us spent three nights here whilst on a Christmas shopping trip, great location for access to the underground . Lovely atmosphere in the foyer and bar . General high standards of furnishings throughout,the rooms were immaculate. The staff were very pleasant and helpful at all times. The only slight criticism was shared by everyone else in our group was that the cooked food items for breakfast were Luke warm at best and poor in in terms of preparation and presentation. This would not prevent me from recommending this hotel very highly and I certainly would stay here again on my next visit to London.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: We've returned from spending 5 wonderful nights at this hotel. Sure, the room was small compared to US standards, but it was adequate. We had room at the entrance to store our luggage, then plenty of room to walk around the bed. The bathroom was very small. The breakfast was wonderful. They supplied assorted croissants and muffins, several cereals, toast, fruit, cheese, meat, tea and coffee. You do have to reserve on their site for it to be included, which is what we did. The staff was wonderful. We were greeted with friendly hellos everytime we entered the front door. The location was great. We were a short walk from the tube. We even managed a 30 minute walk to Picadilly Circus on Christmas Day. This was my second stay in London. LAst New Years, I stayed at the Holiday Inn-Docklands Excel. It was bigger and modern, but I'd pick this hotel over the Holiday Inn anyday.

title: Great hotel in a great location
text: I love this location, close to Gloucester Road tube station, because you can take the tube direct from Heathrow and walk to your hotel - quite a saving over a taxi right there. It is a lively area, close to museums, walking distance to the Albert Hall and to Hyde Park for down time, with good little restaurants and food shops. I have stayed in a number of the hotels in the area, and I think this one is one of the best values. The hotel itself is updated and feels clean and modern. Rooms and bathrooms are larger than usual in an old London hotel. Breakfast which was included had a really good selection. Staff were friendly and helpful. I did notice that room rates varied greatly so shop around.

title: Central location and a nice hotel
text: Me and my wife stayed her for the fourth time. The hotel have had several owners, but the last ones is the best. We stayed this time in a double room. The beds were to short for me and the room a bit small. But besides of that were everything fine. Free internet in the rooms were great! The breakfast had everything. The people in the reception were fantastic and always nice and helpfully. The bar was very nice and in a good atmosphere. The only negative thing was that the fire alarm went three times in a few hours!. Not very nice when you have gone to bed and have a room in fifth floor! We should have been told that it was a false alarm by the management! But I will come back to my London stay hotel!

title: Nice an central hotel
text: This was a good looking and comfortable hotel near by the tube "Gloucester".The area was nice to walk around with pubs and some nice restaurants. Our room was at the fifth floor and was small, cosy and clean, but a bit warm at night (or cold if we used the air condition). Breakfast was good, but we missed some alternative for Diary free and gluten free alternatives. The staff was helpful and polite.

title: My experience with Park International
text: Yes of course I would recommend this hotel to anyone. It is in a very good area. It is quiet, clean and comfortable. I wish I could stay much longer than one night. I really like it. Purpose of the trip was to be bring my daughter to an interview. I would come back again during summer holiday with the rest of my family members if they can afford it. It would be the ideal hotel when I will come back again to London in the future. Keep it up Thank you.

title: won't go back, been to better.
text: Picked this hotel for location as we have stayed in this area before, but the hotel we wanted was fully booked so we chose this one.The reception area and staff where the best part of the hotel. We where given our room on the 5th floor right above the front door of thehotel,which was ok we thought, but as the air con was rubbish and we where constantly boiling, if we wanted the window open for some air you couldn't sleep for traffic noise. Breakfast wasn't worth getting up for, as there wasn't even tables for everyone and they ran out of food the two mornings we did go down.Ww didn't go till about 9 and breakfast was served 7-10 and they still ran out and of clean cutlery. If the reakfast staff where any slower you would think they where dead as they had no expression what so ever. The room itself was clean but very basic. small bathroom and the shower pressure was crap, especially if you have long hair to wash as i do. N ot far from the tube which was ideal if you like to use it. The millenium glouster is much better and not much difference in price.

title: Would definitely stay again
text: My son and I shared a double room during a recent visit to England to see some of my relatives. The hotel was great. The building is in a renovated Georgian structure that fits in well with the neighborhood (as opposed to a hideous high rise Holiday Inn nearby!). The hotel is within short walking distance of several restaurants (many Middle Eastern and Italian ones), three supermarkets, and the Gloucester Road Underground Station. Many of London's greatest attractions were just a few station stops away, as were Paddington and VIctoria Stations. The lobby was elegant and welcoming, with several overstuffed chairs and sofas to relax on. The service was wonderful. My son and I arrived early for check in and were exhausted from jet lag. While our room was still not ready after some time, we were switched to another room that was ready! Thank you! For a "four star" hotel, our room looked somewhat austere ... two twin beds, a small desk with a hard chair, and another upholstered chair. But the beds were very comfortable

title: Not what you see online
text: I just discovered this site while searching for reviews of Italian hotels, and decided to write a review of the Park International. I must agree that the single room was tiny, and not what you expected after seeing the website. This hotel makes a big deal about it's Kensington address, which is convenient, but it does not live up to the upscale reputation the Kensington area has. The room was clean, and the public areas were decent as well. I also had the feeling, as others have mentioned, that they treated me a little less nicely because I had pre-paid through expedia. The front desk staff seemed to be mainly Russian or soemthing, and very very cold, as if a smile would have cracked their faces. All in all, it wasnt bad considering the location, if you won't spend a great deal of time in your room.

title: Extremely small room
text: Stayed at the Victoria Inn hotel for 4 nights in order to attend the WTM Front desk staff were nice, polite and helpful, the continental breakfast was ok and breakfast took is well decorated Rooms are in very good shape however the size of room I got made me feel like am in prison... Was not enough space for the clothes and seems like entire room including the shower was not more than 7 square meters Location is excellent walking distance from the Victoria train, tube and coach station Seems I'll be back next year, however will take double room for single use in order to feel comfortable

title: Victoria Inn on Belgrave Rd- okay for a quick trip.
text: A friend and I stayed at the Victoria Inn while we were visiting London Fashion Weekend in Feb. The hotel was in a pretty good location - we got the train straight from Heathrow airport to Victoria station (get the southern train, NOT the heathrow express, it costs twice as much!) and hotel was only a 10min walk max from station. Located in a very nice area, street was lovely and pretty quiet at night. Hotel was a bit of a disapointment if you are expecting any luxury! Run by what i think must have been a polish family- Room was very small, but this is to be expected of any hotel in the area. It seemed clean enough and we didn't get bothered with any noise at all. I had read a couple of other reviews that said the hotel was really hot & windows didnt open - however we had a fine temp in the room and window worked just fine! the little lift was very handy for getting luggage up and down. Bathroom was what can only be described as a pod- bit grimy round the edges but otherwise fine. Breakfast was a big let-down - although we were a bit hungover when we showed up for it! Give it a miss if your a bit paranoid! The breakfast room was a tiny windowless 1970's basement cupboard that smelled of old burnt toast. Stick to hot chocolate and a chewy croissant...! Didnt use the tube at nearby Pimlico as was really expensive. Got the bus straight to leicester Sq from bus stop across the road from hotel- really handy 24hr service & cheap too! Wouldn't go back as realised easyhotel was on the same street and looked a lot nicer - same price.

title: Weekend break
text: In terms of location, this hotel is great as its only a 5 minute walk from victoria station, and from here you can easily get to anywhere in the city. Checking in was efficient and friendly and it was great to have a luggage storage room too. The rooms were small, but exactly what you would need as you wouldnt be spending much time there. Everywhere was neat and clean. My only complaint was the location of our room, which was across from the breakfast restaurant and so it was very noisy from very early in the morning, if i were to stay here again, i would ask for a room on one of the top floors.

title: Small but clean B + B
text: Was booked into this establishment by a company while on a recent business trip to London. Had seen some of the previous reviews and was a little apprehensive. I'd have to say that while some comments are entirely accurate, the Victoria Inn is not trying to be something it isn't. Its website says it's a cheap, well situated, bed and breakfast and that pretty much nails it. I had a double room in the basement at the rear and, true, it was small for a double but the bedroom itself and small en-suite were spotlessly clean and it was quiet. WiFi is available but was quite expensive in my opinion. There is no air-con available. Breakfast was a similarly no frills affair. The breakfast room was also very small and filled up quite quickly in the morning. There was a choice of cereals, bread, croissants and, I think, tinned fruits. Tea and coffee were available from a machine, Again, everything was spotlessly clean. Staff were generally pleasant and polite. For me, not a bad experience overall but colleagues who were roomed at the front of the building complained of noise from the road and building renovations opposite.

title: Poor
text: Shocking hotel for business trip. Room so small you can barely get an ironing board and iron in, if they have one to give you. Room far too hot and when we told reception they said the air con is not working and left it at that without even an apology. Breakfast was shocking, cold egg, cold beans, no bacon or sausage. Would not recommend staying here.

title: Careless and insensitive
text: I had booked a room well in advance. The hotel cancelled my booking around the mid day on my day of travel and did not bother to call me. They apparently just sent an email at around 1:45 pm and expected that people would access emails throughout the day, esp when they are travelling and have busy schedule ahead !! If you had to cancel it for whatever reason, could you not show a courtesy of calling people? The receptionist told me that she cannot call everyone whose booking gets cancelled. So how many bookings do you cancel every day? And why?? I found the behaviour very rude, inappropriate, insensitive.

title: Rude awakening
text: I stayed here for one night with my partner in September, checking in was simple and straightforward at the desk. However, when we went down to our room in the evening the room smelt damp, whether this was because our window had been left open by the staff while we had been out we do not know. The worst part was in the morning when a maid came in to clean the room at 7am knocking but not waiting for an answer. As we weren't up yet she left but then for then stood outside our room talking loudly for a long time after. For a trip that includes a late night at the theatre this hotel is definitely not recommended.

title: Location Price Staff :))
text: Fantastic Hotel stayed 9 nights the location is excellent Victoria Station a 5 min Walk trains and Buses' any where u want to go in and around London the station has everything shops fantastic choice of eatery's very close so many nice Pubs for Dinner the Hotel staff ( Reception House keepers and Dining room staff ) were always friendly with a smile, serviced rooms every day very high standard,the size of rooms are small but very comfortable and clean,Kettle in room Tea and Coffee replenished every day the Breakfast menu has a good range of food a light breaky to start your day never ran out of any thing always topped up,,the price range for this hotel is amazing for London's reputation of being expensive Value for my money was exceptional 24/7 Reception is great felt safe and some one there if u need anything My stay at this Hotel was by far an excellent choice for Accommodation and surrounds of London.Would highly recommend this Hotel the location sits in a beautiful part of London stylish yet busy loved it :)))

title: Fantastic for the price!
text: I booked this hotel for 1 night as was going to Londons West End. I was pleasantly surprised when I got to the Victoria Inn, it's in a great location, within walking distance of both Victoria coach station/train station and a lot of the main attractions. The staff couldn't be more friendly, they were really pleasant and helpful. It was also really clean. I have stayed many times in London and stays here can be quite expensive so I feel that Victoria Inn is quite reasonably priced compared to others....especially for its location, a lot of the other hotels I looked at in the same area were a lot more expensive. Overall, really happy with my stay!

title: Well-located, reasonable and comfortable
text: We had a very pleasant stay at the Victoria Inn. We booked this hotel as a last minute thing online and it was the perfect place for a budget tourist trip to London. The hotel is located very close to Pimlico Underground which makes it very easy for travelling around London, no matter what time of day. Although our room was quite small, it was clean and very comfortable. Breakfast was nice in the morning, but the breakfast room is very small for the number of rooms the hotel has, so some guests did have to wait for their breakfast. Staff were friendly and helpful. We enjoyed our 1-night stay and would definitely return again for when we next have our tourist trip to London!

title: Good location
text: We choose this hotel for his location. Whitin walking distance from Victoria station from where you can go around and see everything you want. We arrived at the hotel around 1pm and were lucky because we could go to the room. The room is small but ok to stay a couple of nights. Both toilet and room are clean which is the most important. The breakfast place is also small and can be crowded. The food is simple but ok. The staff was nice.

title: Victoria Inn: Kind of Eh...
text: My friend and I stayed here while backpacking, and we thought it would be a great hotel in the midst of hostels...turned out our expectations were way too high. The location is great and the service is good, but there is no air conditioning and the walls are paper thin. We sweat all night and could hear our neighbors quite clearly. (And our room was right by the maid's room so we woke up every morning at 7:30 without fail when they started making breakfast and chatting....not too pleasant) They didn't give washcloths for some reason, and breakfast was nothing but cornflakes and toast. (no protein but small cheddar cheese slices to sustain you through the day.) It wasn't bad, but I wish that we had stayed somewhere else. ps. wifi is expensive and shoddy.

title: Victoria Inn was fine.
text: I have stayed at the Victoria Inn twice - Sept. 2004, May 2006. Each time I was with a different person. Yes, the rooms are small but we were out sightseeing most of the time. Considering the costs of hotels in London, this inn was a bargain!!!

title: Friendly
text: Had a great stay. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The location is excellent, with restaurants, supermarkets, shoppings, an underground and a train station all nearby. The size of the hotel is about average compared to all London hotels, not very big but the rooms are really comfortable The breakfast was basic, nevertheless it was very good. I definitely recommend it.

title: Good Value
text: A small and friendly hotel, in a very good location, the No.24 bus stops almost opposite and takes you up to the West-end and theatre land. Our room was clean and warm, the staff friendly and helpful. As other people have mentioned the breakfast room is very small for the amount of guests but if you are able to get a table the breakfast is good. We found it very good value for money and would certainly stay there again.

title: Don't book a single room!
text: Over the years I've stayed in many hotels in many countries but The Victoria Inn has to be the worst so far. The check in was fine and the receptionist was very pleasant and once in my room, to say I was surprised at the size is something of an understatement. I now know what a battery chicken feels like. If you wanted to, there wasn't enough room to put up an ironing board and walk round it such was the size of the room. I thought the bedroom was small until I went into the bathroom. Firstly there was no where to put my washbag other than on the toilet. It was impossible to sit on the toilet AND shut the door! The shower was fine (no bath) but the plug was missing from the tiny sink. I did mention that to reception and was told someone would sort it but nothing was done by the time I checked out the following morning. Obviously I can't speak for the other rooms but I won't be returning to find out.

title: not what I expected
text: The room definitely didn't look like the one shown on the hotel website. Generally I was disappointed because the hotel description on the hotel website was a bit different than reality. The building is quite old. Actually, everything in this hotel is old. The elevator is VERY old ... quite scary. What I didn't like was the place they serve breakfast. It was extremely small, there wasn't enough place for all the people, no matter what time would you come. So we had to wait for a free table. Plus it was really uncomfortable eating in such crowded place, making queue to a toaster ! There is no place you can leave your luggage (if you already check out), if you like you can tide it up to the radiator !Oh, and the bathroom was very small, I'm 1m77 and I could touch the roof with my head. The location is very good, especially if you plan to take a bus from the airport (all the buses go to Victoria Station which is very close to the hotel). The staff was nice and helpful. Our room was clean. It wasn't expensive, but I think a bit too expensive, considering the quality (but I guess London generally is expensive). It's a good choice if you go to London to visit a lot of places, and look for a hotel to sleep in only.

title: 3 *** hotel? ... Shame on you "Standard"
text: So that you won’t find a place to sit for breakfast in their limited morning breakfast serving time, The breakfast in simple words “very limited” it consist of exactly two juices, milk, stale cereals, croissants, coffee, bread and boiled eggs (oh yeah limited scrambled eggs go snatch for it).... Nothing more Period! Health and Safety issues, they don’t have any info mentioned inside the room or outside their mazy basement level for emergency. Even if they have its confusing trust me. Confused staff siting there keeps asking you the same irritating questions when you enter the so called hotel "Whats your room number?" or "Did you requested for a wake up call?" They felt disappointed when asked how to reach Airport with public transport, and not their commissioned based service for which they weren’t helpful at all, same goes for the Internet. Rooms have thin walls, with very few electric outlets. No lock in the toilet, so what if people staying are not couple and what about their privacy? Bottom line tiny rooms, cheap breakfast not even in the best central location doesn’t make it a standard budget hotel for what is has to offer. Before writing I have in mind that the manager is gonna go blah-blah below with criticism and that "Why you didn’t raise these issues while staying in the hotel?". Truth being told there is no need to raise anything when the hotel is out of standard!

title: Clean, Kind and Basic
text: This hotel was in a good location and offered a clean room, and kind service. Only a few blocks from Pimlico Station and about a 7 minute walk to Victoria Station, this hotel was perfect for the relaxed weekend we planned to explore the city and take in the theatre. The staff was very kind, welcoming us with a smile, offering information, and taking care of our blocked shower drain quickly and efficiently. Our rooms were clean, and the beds were comfortable. Breakfast was fine. Simple toast, cereal and eggs. It is next door to a youth hostel, but we did not hear any noise. (Maybe this was because we stayed there in the winter and people were not out on the terrace?) Overall, I would stay here again.

title: basic, could be better
text: Just come back from 1 nights stay with my daughter. We went to see wicked. Good show by the way........ The hotel is not near the tube station or theatre, it is a good walk away. We stayed on the 3rd floor and the room,you could tell it had been upgraded, Clean but really small. It was hot so had to leave window open, very busy street as there are many other hotels scattered around this area. Did not sleep well. I thought the baed was hard. The lift is old but fun to experience and the owners decided when to put the power on and off for this. We decided to pay the extra for the cooked breakfast but it was a let down so do not bother. If you like hot dog sausages you are ok. The staff were all friendly including the woman who was preparing breakfast. The breakfast room was small and there was stlll evidence of rebuirshment going on. There are no directions for visitors to the breakfast room and we came across a work man with his ladders.The carpets throughout needed a good clean and hoover.I was hoping through the night, that the fire alarm system was good enough as the device looked old on the ceiling and we were quite high up. The tea and coffee facilities were poor with dry milk sachets on offer in the room. Also, be careful if you use the hairdryer in the room as even though some rooms have been upgraded, the hairdryer still looks old and there was a sticker on it stating that it was last checked in the year 2000. Overall for 1 nights stay to see a show I would recommend it

title: Great Location
text: Stayed for a weekend break with my daughter - booked double room and given a triple. Reasonable size, clean, nice bathroom. Excellent location. Bus stop outside gives easy access to a major attractions. Short walk to Buckingham Palace. Breakfast room a little crowded but acceptable. Would stay again when in London - an oasis in a busy city.

title: Tiny, smelly rooms with even smaller bathrooms - you can find a better hotel!
text: The room we had was very small - a full size bed barely fit and the bathroom...what a joke! Imagine an airplane bathroom with a tiny shower. They keep your key when you leave - not sure why they insisted on this, but they did! You stand in a line for a breakfast that consists of toast and cereal in the smallest dining room I've ever seen! It was also very loud! The location was ideal, but there are tons of other options on the same road!
