title: Decent hotel, poor breakfast
text: Stayed for one night on business. The hotel is well located, 5 minutes walk from Pimlico tube station and about 10 minutes walk from Victoria. Staff at reception are nice and helpful. The rooms are clean and functional, and it's quiet enough. I had a pretty good sleep. Free wifi. It's pretty good value for London and I would've given 4/5 except the breakfast was pretty shoddy. There's very little to choose. From in the help-yourself basement breakfast room. It's lists as "continental" but you're really talking eggs, beans and toast. I realise it is termed a budget hotel but, if you're going to offer fruit salad, please do more than just open a tin. There are budget hotel chains who offer a much better breakfast at a similar price per night. Hopefully that's not too negative but I do think that a better breakfast offer would mean I would consider a repeat stay.

title: Hotel stay for leisure
text: We stayed for 2 nights for leisure. The staff were helpful during the day and the bed comfortable but that is the best I can say! The room was tiny, very hot, unfinished in the decor, (filler showing over the window for example) and really awful mould in the shower. The shower was so small you could barely move to wash or wash your hair. All of that aside, it was the noise from reception throughout the night that was unacceptable, we were right opposite reception, steer clear of room 14. Despite asking the staff at 12pm and again at 2pm, the chatter, singing, whistling, door slamming continued all night long. We had two very bad nights sleep and would not recommend this room to anyone. The breakfast room was very very hot, very busy and the food poor quality. The cost for two nights with breakfast was £306, a complete rip off! We have arrived home tired, grumpy and poor!

title: central, clean and friendly
text: Arriving to the hotel after un walk from Victoria Station, 20 minutes about, I finally arrive at the right place, because they are a lot of hotels along Belgrave Road, et several with rather the same names, and the numbering of the street is so funny that I had to ask two times to friendly people of the neighborhood. The hotel has been renoveted and the rooms are of a good size but not extra large!, friendly people at the reception how provide my a very quiet room on the garden. The breakfest is ok and its surely the best you could get so centrally.

title: Great hotel in London, they show how customer service should be!
text: This is a great hotel, offering fantastic value for money and the friendliest staff I have come across in London. I have stayed here a few times a week for a few months now, and have no need to seek other hotels in future when on business in London. The double rooms are clean and spacious, and larger than many of the "chain" hotels. Location is also great for Westminster/Victoria area, and plenty of good restaurants and bars within a few minutes walk. Highly recommended!

title: A nice stay with a few flaws - an honest review!
text: After scouring the internet to find a suitable hotel in the centre of London for a reasonable price we ended up booking the Victoria Inn. We paid above average prices I'm sure due to being London 2012 Olympics, therefore I think we were overcharged. We paid £140 per room per night, which is wayyy more than either of us would have liked to BUT it was probably one of the best ones available for the price. I think that their usual rates are probably good value for money, but considering the amount we paid, I don't think we had good value for money. We had a nice stay here and the lady who checked us in and out was lovely, very welcoming and accomodating, and let us check in 2 hours early which was great. The breakfast was very strange but adequate and enough to fill your boots for a busy day! The rooms were clean, but very small. The bathroom was also clean but very small. We were on the 3rd floor and our front door was directly next to the other rooms front door, so when they shut their door it ricocheted into ours and was very noisy. The rooms are small due to the period of the building, and the decor is quite cosy. The hotel itself is in a good location, just around the corner from Pimlico tube (which is much quieter than victoria) and about a 7/10 minute walk from Victoria. It is in a nice area, with a few bars and restaurants around, and a short walk from the Apollo Theatre. The only thing that bugged me with this hotel, is that we asked the receptionist in the afternoon to book us a taxi for 6.45pm so we could catch our show (as we had been walking around all day and were tired, had no idea where we were going and did NOT want to miss it) we were most disappointed that when we reached reception at 6.45pm, we were told that she didn't book us a taxi, and that we had to stand in the middle of the road and hail a cab. Subsequently we ended up walking, it wasn't far but the response we had when we booked the taxi was quite bad from the receptionist, and the distance is irrelevant, if we asked to book a taxi - we should of had one!! All in all, generally a nice stay here, I wouldn't want to stay again, but would as a last resort.

title: No complaints!
text: Belgrave Road is a great location and many of the houses there are hotels. Once they were homes for the well-to-do. In other words they were not built as hotels. Our room was not unlike a ferry cabin, and the "bathroom" was a plastic pod in the corner. But it was all clean and the bed was comfortable and at around £60 for a double room I don't think anyone should complain! The staff were efficient and friendly and when, two hours after we had checked out, we realised we had left all our Christmas shopping in the cupboard (the room was so small we kept falling over all the carrier bags!) we went back and they had it all waiting for us. Across the road in an identical building there is a Days Inn where a double room is twice the price. Even if the room is twice the size I would be happy to stay at the Victoria Inn again.

title: Nice Place!
text: I am frankly extremly suprised by how many bad reviews this place has gotten. I was not expecting much considering the price, but I was very pleasantly surprised. The location is fantastic, the rooms were cheerful and clean, and the staff were friendly. I would reccomend this place to anyone, and I'm someone who usually stays in fairly nice hotels. The bathrooms were small and very clean, although the shower was a bit finicky. The only thing I was really disapointed in was the breakfast. It was quite meagre, jusy three cerial choices and some toast and jam, but I shouldn't have expected more for the price. The beds were comfortable and there were small tea pots in the rooms which was really nice. There is also a computer you can pay a pound or two to use in the lobby. This place was really lovely overall. I noticed no smoke smell

title: Ok
text: This hotel is ok, not terrible and not great, it’s in a good location, about a five min walk to the nearest tube station (Pimlico). We stayed on the top floor and The room was tiny but in a cute way, small ceiling height and very compact but everything you need from a room, we stayed as a couple but were put in a triple room and I can’t imagine that being an enjoyable experience with three people in that room. Would complain we only had one pillow each with no spares anywhere. The shower was difficult at best it was either scolding hot with good pressure or Luke warm with hardly any pressure, I couldn’t find a happy medium. Breakfast isn’t great few croissants and buns and the coffee machine literally puts a mouth full of coffee into the cups, doesn’t even fill the mug half way- very strange. If you’re here for a holiday I’d go off and find a cafe to have breakfast in instead. The staff were polite. However upon checking out we came across the lady cleaning the rooms and she was dragging huge bags of linen and cleaning products in and out of the lift and up and down stairs, surely management could provide this poor lady with a trolley to put these on? She had about 10 bags. As we were on the top floor we found some steps going up to the roof of the hotel, not sure you’re allowed up here but we had a nosey anyway and would recommend the views were great- you could see the London eye etc

title: Cute single room
text: I stayed here for two nights and the room was exactly what I needed. It was small but had everything necessary, and everything was clean and up to date. It cost a little more than I would have liked to pay, but the price wasn't terrible. The staff were pleasant and the view from the back of the hotel was overlooking the small gardens of several buildings. I can't speak to the breakfast service as I did not use it.

title: good location
text: the hotel has a good location... I have especially chosen it to use Victoria Train Station to go Brighton area within my program... the building is so Victorian that have no elevators... nice and comfortable stay and the staff, especially Mr.SEREF, was so helping...

title: Sufficed my needs but wouldn’t stay again
text: Just returned from an overnight stop in London and stayed in a double room at the Victoria Inn at 65 -67 Belgrave Road. The hotel is well located, has quite a pleasant frontage but once inside it is like a rabbit warren with passages, doors and stairs everywhere. Signage was poor, trying to find the breakfast area was a case of following your nose! Once there it was very disappointing, no cooked breakfast only scrambled eggs, I do prefer a full English buffet style breakfast, even if there is an extra cost. The walls of the room I stayed in were very poorly soundproofed, I could hear every sound of the person in the next room(from 06:20 until he left around 07:30.) The bathroom was very tired and needed an urgent refresh. To use the toilet was almost impossible because of its closeness to the wall, door and toilet roll holder, also the toilet seat was loose. The en-suit door was very narrow and actually fouled with the radiator behind the door which stopped the door opening correctly, no good for anyone who is clostraphobic. However, there were plenty of clean towels, coffee, tea, in general the room was reasonably clean and I suppose £109 per night for a three star hotels is what it is. However, I have stayed in London on many occasions and can only compare with my past experiences, there are better hotels for the price. Apologies to the Victoria Inn but I did expect better.

title: Location and staff were the highlights
text: Small room, as expected this close to the centre of the city. However in a 7 night stay I returned 3 towels to reception because they were not white as they should have been. The facilities were very basic, the staff were very friendly and accomodated our early breakfast requirments (most days...) but I would not recommend a friend to stay here.. If you are desperate for this location, book here but don't pay a premium - limited number of electric sockets, 1 pillow per bed and my least favourite part was the towels which had not been cleaned properly/not checked before placing in our room. I'd love to complain about the lack of floor space and the musty smell coming from the drains, but from experice this is not unusual in this location and at this price. Shame, as the staff at the front desk were eager to please but just didn't have the facilities to make my stay 'enjoyable'.

title: Satisfied with location and cost
text: In a word - Great! It had what we needed at a price we were willing to pay. The hotel is in an ideal location (5 minute walk from Pimlico Underground station, and the #24 bus stops less than a block away on one side of the street, and right across from the hotel on the other) plus anyone in moderate health can walk to Westminster Abbey and the London Eye. The rooms are small - suitable for two without room to entertain friends - so we used the small front lobby for our party of six to meet. Breakfast is included - a machine that provides a variety of coffees and hot chocolate, three kinds of cold cereal, juices, milk, toast, rolls & croissants, and canned fruit. Plenty to get you through until you find a nice pub for lunch! The hotel is being renovated so some parts are finished while others are waiting. We stayed downstairs on the bottom/basement floor which had not been renovated but was still acceptable (this is no 5 star, but you're not paying that either!!) Besides - we were out touring from 9 am - 9 pm. The staff were terrific. On two occasions we left something valuable in the lobby and the breakfast room and within minutes they were looking for us to return the items. Plus they were friendly. The breakfast room is small with about 8 tables, but is only crowded on the weekends, the rest of the week was fine. We stayed for 5 days. Although parts of the hotel are still old and tired, we didn't get that grubby feeling. It will all depend on your needs - if you need space and fresh new furniture/carpet etc., this is not for you. If you need a clean room to lay your head in a good location at a decent price, I recommend the Victoria Inn.

title: Simple but okay
text: My husband and I stayed here for 3 nights whilst on holidays. Staff were pleasant and breakfast was basic but still okay (cereal,toast, scrambled eggs and baked beans).Get to breakfast at around 7am to miss out the rush at 8.30/9am. Rooms were very tiny but we spent most of our time exploring. There is no free wifi available but if you walk down to the steps at Victoria station you can pick up some signals there. Overall a simple place for a bed and breakfast.

title: If you want basic standard of cleanliness and customer service AVOID at all costs.
text: While the room, at a quick first glance, before leaving Again for an evening of sight seeing around the capital, was wonderful and very pleasant, upon our return was when we hit some issues. Firstly, when we arrived back at the hotel at approx midnight we found that our 4th floor room was very warm, to our delight we found an air con unit. Unfortunately this did not work, as we were unsure whether maybe we just couldn’t work it we phoned down to reception and the gentleman was more than happy to come up and help us to try and fix it. He tried to get it working with no luck, he even switched the fuse box off and on again to no avail, he apologised profusely for this and said he would report it and then left. Then upon pulling the duvet back we found 2 large brown stains in the middle of our bedding, and several smaller stains on the outside edge, by this point we just wanted to get into bed after a long day exploring London and did not want to call someone to complain! When checking out I mentioned this to the lady at reception who replied with a question as to why we didn’t complain last night and ask for it to be changed. As it was midnight the last thing we wanted was for someone to come in to our room and start changing bedding!! The lady made me feel as though it was OUR fault that the bedding was dirty! And it was OUR fault that we had not complained and asked for it to be changed at midnight! All of this in front of a packed reception of guests!! Whilst we appreciate that the price of the hotel is very reasonable, I feel that clean bedding is a basic need for any hotel, and then to be made to feel as though we were at fault is poor customer service I thought I would send an email to the hotel manager explaining the issues we had and ask for a part refund due to a hotel not meeting basic standards of cleanliness and he was just as rude as his reception staff Again blaming us that we hadn’t complained on the night and even then proceeded to tell me the stained bedding wasn’t a bed sheet it was the mattress protector so we didn’t even have a bed sheet!! If you expect a basic standard of cleanliness and customer service avoid at all costs.

title: No no no if it-s not your only choice
text: This hotel is really poor. The location is ok, near Victoria Station and Pimlico Station. The street is nice and safe also at late night. I even saw a wild fox in a garden nearby. But the hotel is extremely poor. This was the only hotel available in the area, so we booked, but...... ouch! I WOULD HAVE RUN AWAY THE SAME MOMENT I ENTERED MY ROOM, IF POSSIBLE. But everything in the area was fully booked. The lobby is just fine, would need a renovation. But for sure is the best spot of the hotel. I started trembling when i first saw the key to the room, that was RIDICOLOUS, a piece of grey plastic with the room number written on it with a black marker.... i tried hard not to laugh in desperation. They showed us the way to our triple room, and the room was incredibly small! The bathroom was very small and poor. No free soaps or whatelse....The carpet of the room was old and little dirty, the wardrobe was just fine but i didn-t even try to put my clothes into it and the curtains and the bedspread were quite dirty, even if my mom said they were clean but old stained... don-t know.... I am always worried about bedbugs and looking at that room i was even more worried because it was so cheap, but luckily there wasn-t.... I complained immediately to the reception saying that i was disappointed. Their web site was all but what i found once there, but they couldn-t help except showing me another room, that was on the low ground floor, and was cold and a little bit smelly. We preferred staying in the original one. The breakfast the day after was ridicolous, 4 slices of bread and some marmelades.... No bisquits, no chocolate, no yoghurt or fruit, and the drinks were also poor, and the worst... no space where to sit, as the room was incredibly small, and the hotel fully booked. The following mornings we went to have breakfast at Starbucks nearby. Finally i want to say that even if the staff was very friendly and available, the hotel was horrible. The worst i-ve ever stayed in my whole life. It would need a complete renovation and a change of management, because the location is nice and could be a great small hotel. But probably they just don-t care. They get the money anyway.... I must say that also all the other hotels nearby except Sidney Hotel, Corona Hotel, BW Victoria, Easyhotel seemed very poor, so probably Victoria Inn was just average.... but still!!! We payed 280 pounds for 3 pax for 3 nights. Not so much for London, you would say, but i can tell you that it was far too much for what the hotel deserves. I hope this review to be read by the hotel management... COME ON!! SPEND SOME MONEY TO MAKE THAT A PLACE THAT CAN BE CALLED HOTEL!!!!! This is my honest opinion. I-m always a small budget traveller and really adjustable person, but really.... i-ve never found a so poor hotel!! I-ve got no picture to attach.... but guys, trust me!!!

title: Very Happy
text: Not having been in London for over a year we were somewhat anxious having read some terrible reviews re various hotels. Booked the Victoria Inn because of its proximity to Whitehall - we were mixing business and pleasure. The reception staff were extremely helpful and our room was spotless and comfortable. Breakfast was more than adequate and the next time we are back we will not hesitate to stay here again.

title: made the reservation by mistake
text: I have made a reservation for 3 nights through Booking.com. Since I made the reservation through my mobile phone, I made the reservation by mistake for a January instead of February. I contacted them to ask for a cancellation free of charge since the reservation was prepaid. I have chosen this hotel according to the good reviews and I thought that they will consider refunding the money or using the already charged amount for the other booking. I wanted to book the same hotel, also for 3 nights but in February but the said that the hotel is already fully booked. I understand that is against the hotel policy, but I thought that they will help me to solve the problem.it was so not polite and unprofessional that they refused me immediately.

title: Clean and compact
text: Spent two nights here and as far as cleanliness and value it was fine. Rooms are small but no smaller than others in the capital and location is easily found. The hotel was very warm and the added Indian Summer of last week made it overly warm especially in the dining room in the basement. Breakfast itself a reasonable selection, very compact eating/self-serving area and the warm plates could be warmer especially for the beans. Main gripe were the early morning cleaners who had no qualms about talking rather loudly and leaving doors open at 8.30 am. After a long days travelling this was not appreciated, although this only happened on our first morning there.

title: Good Find in a Big City
text: Booked a good value stay through a booking site and found a gem. In an easy location not far from Victoria with easy access to the tube, it's a bright cheerful hotel. We booked a triple room for 3 adults and found it clean and comfortable. Continental breakfast was good - with a bonus of scrambled eggs. For what we wanted this hotel suited us just fine and we will use it again.

title: Member of staff refer to customers as "Scumbags"
text: My son was stranded in London without wallet or documents. I booked him a room at this hotel, paying for it by my credit card. The staff then made repeated demands for extra ID (both for myself and my son) before finally accepting the booking. The following morning, after debiting my card and my son leaving the hotel, I received an abusive mail from the hotel, which accused me of fraud (despite, as noted, my having paid by card in advance) and referred to me as "a scumbag". Overall, I can't really say I was impressed.

title: Here, there , everywhere in London.........
text: While traveling in and around London between Aug.8th through Aug.25th, I found my trip to be most enjoying......I traveled alone, and my final stay was at the Victoria Inn in London ... the hotel room was small, but it suited me , as I was traveling alone.........it was clean and the staff was friendly, helpful and courteous......... it suited my needs !!!

title: Would come back again!
text: Stayed for two nights and we wasn’t disappointed. Great price, 5 minutes walk to two tube stations, lots of places to eat and drink, walking distance to Buckingham Palace, and a really clean and friendly hotel. Would stay again!

title: Excellent
text: Very comfortable and clean room, very comfy bed and staff were very helpful. With a little bonus of free continental breakfast, the perfect location and close to the underground and other nearby anemities.

title: a last night in London
text: This was a very last minute booking, the hotel is nice and clean, the staff is friendly. The bed was very comfortable. The breakfast is a bit poor but for the price that I paid for the room it was a good one. It is not my first time in this hotel and probably not the last.

title: Very clean, friendly staff, good location
text: This hotel is spotlessly clean and after trying different ones in the Victoria/Pimlico area regularly over the past few weeks, this one is by far the best for the price. Professional and helpful reception staff, a lift (a rarity in cheaper hotels.) I paid £44 for a single room and it was small, but as expected for the price. At the back of the hotel, it was very quiet and overlooked houses/gardens - you could hear Big Ben chiming which was nice. The room was spotlessly clean and had a proper bathroom (shower not bath) which again seems a rarity in cheaper hotels where they have enclosed plastic toilet/shower spaces. Any hotels in this area, are in a great location - very close to tube/bus and walkable to most London landmarks. This hotel was very, very good value for money considering how well kept it was, how clean everything was and the professional staff. Breakfast was included but I didn't have any, so can't comment on that.

title: Good Value Hotel
text: Stayed one night on a business trip....the hotel is clean and tidy and the staff are very helpful....the single rooms are small but ok for one night.....booked via late rooms on a discounted room rate which made this very good value for central London......

title: Good and centrally situated hotel at a reasonable price
text: We stayed at the Victoria Inn for 3 nights. The rooms were small but cozy and clean, bedclothes and towels were changed daily. It seems that the bathroom has been renovated not a long time ago. Included in the price was the breakfast, nothing worldshaking but better than advertised with scrambled eggs, beans and sausages in addition to the expected (toast, butter, jam, coffee, tea and so on). The price may seem pretty steep at around 70£ per night but considering the location (Victoria and Pimlico station a stone's throw away and more or less the whole city centre in walking distance) it is unbeatable. And of course, you got the charming staff. All in all a very pleasant stay.

title: Good location
text: The hotel isn't top class but it doesn't sell itself as such. Well located on the Victoria line. Clean, tidy and friendly staff. Overall not too bad a place. If you're looking for a hotel which won't cost the earth then the Victoria Inn may just be the place for you

title: Very good for some days in London.
text: Friendly staff, super confortable bed and pillow, just 8 minutes away (walking distance) to Victoria Station. I would like to refer to Ana and Fouad that have assisted with the reservation and during our stay.

title: Excellent Hotel
text: We liked very much the hotel. It is close to the tube stations, the bedrooms are clean, the bathrooms have got hot baths and for us it is enough. We stayed 3 nights in a family room and we liked it very much. We recommend this hotel for the ones who want to explore the city of London. It is close to all the centre attractions. António, Marisa, Inês Serrano

title: Not Bad At All
text: Previously read reviews made me doubt the decision to book our 5 night stay here. Our contact with the hotel was always friendly and excellent. We were too early to check in but were allowed to leave our cases in the reception with a locked rope. When we finally checked in we found our room to be clean with a modern bathroom and more than adequate space for three of us. Room 34 is at the back of the hotel and quiet. You do hear other guests on the stairs and in their rooms but I didn't feel it was intrusive. The hotel is an easy short walk to Pimlico tube station. Breakfast is taken in the basement and the room is basic and functional. On offer is toast, cereals, bread rolls and croissants, cheese and plenty of juice and hot drinks. All perfectly fine. There may be a queue for seat but that is because everyone wants to eat at the same time, while queuing there will be guests taking ages chatting etc, the breakfast is fine but not worth relaxing over! We were too eager to start our day in London to linger.

title: So glad I booked this hotel
text: This was a last minute booking and I would have been happy with just a bed to sleep in. What I had was an immaculately clean well laid out single room. The room wasn't big but for one person I didn't need loads of room. The staff were friendly and so helpful. For the techies there are "Handys" to use when you are out and about.

title: Excellent value for money
text: Locality of the hotel was ideal for commuting, the modern decor and cosy beds added to the comfort of the room. Although the hotel was undergoing refurbishment, this did not cause any disturbance or distraction to me and my family. An excellent all-round break.

title: Thank you for the professional assistance
text: I had an exceptional case with an unexpected booking cancellation and must admit that Victoria Inn hotel management professionally helped me to sort the situation. I met the kind understanding and professional support from Mrs Hirji and her staff. I would recommend this hotel to my colleagues and clients in future!

title: Good location, good value, friendly
text: We stayed one night -- April 15. Clean, efficient setting and rooms -- friendly and helpful staff. Our room was typical by London standards (read: cozy), on the 4th floor, facing Belgrave Street, comfortable and quiet. Use Pimlico tube station if you're pulling or carrying luggage -- Victoria is much farther. Good selection of reasonably priced restaurants nearby, mostly Indian and Pub. We would definitely stay at the Victoria Inn again. Above average for location, hotel category and room price. Victoria web site offers special pricing.

title: Not the Best
text: This was my fourth trip to London and this was definitely not the best room I've had, even at the same price level. I'm used to small rooms, but the bathroom was akin to a Port-a-Potty. Some of the bathrooms in the photos on this site are nice compared to what I had. My bedroom window was held shut with a piece of rope

title: Fantastic Stay
text: Have stayed here twice and have also recommended it to family who have also stayed. My friends and I first stayed here when we were backpacking and trying to find work in the UK. The complementary breakfast in the morning was awesome as we were on a tight budget. The second time I stayed was just as good! Its a close walk to the Thames or down town London which was perfect as we had no vehicle. The rooms were comfortable and not over priced and the staff were also very friendly and helpful.

title: Would NOT recommend
text: It says it's a 3 star hotel, it is not, it's more like a glorified youth hostel, although I've stayed in better hostels. The shower was filthy, the staff were not helpful and in some cases down right rude. I would never go back there and would not recommend it to anyone looking for a 3 star hotel.

title: Perfect Love cation, great hotel, superb staff
text: A perfectly located hotel less than 5 minutes walk from Pimlico station, the hotel is an imposing terraced hotel, well renovated and modern in decor. The staff welcomed us into this hotel and went out of their way to help us with everything that we needed. The room was clean and bed very comfortable with complimentary toiletries and tea and coffee making facilities in each room. Our shower was piping hot and most welcome after travelling to the city. We had read negative reviews appertaining to the breakfast service however we had no problems when we ate at 9.30 am, a selection of fruit, cakes croissants breads cereals juices cheese and meats were a lovely way to start the day. We were attending an event on the Saturday and the hotel were most accomadaring in storing our luggage, providing a room later that afternoon to change in and storing our luggage again until we could collect it in the evening, nothing was too much trouble and we would certainly recommend this hotel to anyone, and would definitley stay here again. Thankyou

title: Nice and clean hotel
text: The hotel has a great location, close to every sights. You can get almost everywhere with the bus nr. 24 (to Trafalgar square, Westminster Abbey), and the underground is close (Victoria station). The staff is very nice and helpful. Our room was small, but tidy and was totally perfect for us.

title: Good location very clean
text: Good location perfect for an overnight stay, very clean and staff very helpful, free wifi which is always a bonus when travelling alone. Continental breakfast was very good and plentiful. Would highly recommend.

title: unpleasantly surprised
text: The room (#24) was very small

title: A great little hotel
text: It is always hard to find a good hotel at a good price in London, but the Victoria Inn meets all the basic requirements. A friendly efficient welcome, clean and functional room. And a great shower! And a simple but effective breakfast, though not the nicest coffee. I will use this hotel again.

title: Very quiet
text: Stayed here for 2 nights last week, clean and comfortable room. Staff very helpful, continental breakfast first day then continental breakfast and sausage and beans the next. Good for the price/location would stay again

title: Small but comfortable
text: I recently stayed 8 nights at the Victoria Inn Pimlico. The location suited me very well. The single room is very small, but at the end of the day all you need is a room to sleep and bathroom to use. The room was cleaned daily and the new hand held device for Internet and calls in every room will prove to be most popular I'm sure. All the staff I had interaction with were great and I found myself having conversations with a few of them over the week ( young man from Algeria couldn't have been more friendly and polite and young woman from Romania who was also very polite and helpful (sorry I don't know their names)). For me the price was good, location great and the facilities were fine. I had no complaints at all and would stay there again should the need arise. Small note to future visitors, on a nice day have breakfast outside on the patio, saves waiting for a table in the breakfast room.

title: Was absolutely fine
text: My husband and I stayed here for one night as we came to london to see a show. The hotel is quite modern and the rooms are basic, it's a good budget hotel in the whole. We had a few hiccups, the cleaning/front desk woman just walked in the room as my husband was getting changed, she had mistaken the room number she needed, but apologised, had she walked in a minute sooner she would have seen the full moon 😂 Also the shower walls weren't cleaned properly there were a few hairs on them. Breakfast was basic but you need to get there early, the room is quite small so I imagine it could be possible not to find a table to sit at when too many people go down at once. The bed was really comfortable but there's just one pillow and when I asked reception for extra they told me it wasn't possible so for someone like me who needs at least 2 could be a bit upsetting. They also have a mobile phone in the rooms that you can use for free for phone calls and internet, you can also take it out with you, so this is a great feature for someone outside the uk especially if in need of maps. Over all our stay was absolutely fine, but we aren't fussy people.

title: Enjoyable stay
text: Stayed at the Victoria Inn for two nights within the past week - was given one of the newly upgraded rooms. Although it is essentially a double room, we also had another single bed in the room for my adult son. Clean, bright room with lovely new decor and lovely bed. Breakfast lets the hotel down though - very very basic continental breakfast with limited seating and space. Thanks again ... we will return

title: Clean, convenient, worth a visit.
text: Excellent hotel great value for money and very clean. Close to Pimlico and 10 mins stroll (max) to Victoria. Breakfast basic - continental which is all whats needed and plenty of it. Rooms smallish, (well mine was but some may be bigger) , but adeqaute and would definately stay over again.

title: Clean, friendly
text: I stayed for 2 nights on business and it is all I needed -- a clean room (although very small), a tidy bathroom, breakfast and a good location close for the Tube. Excellent value for money. I had a cheap room on the top floor that was OK if you only wanted to sleep there -- if you want to stay home and watch TV the claustrophobia would get you.

title: Very clean, friendly and comfortable
text: Room was lovely and clean and had everything I required. Even soap / shower dispensers and hairdryer inc. It was also comfortable, modern decor and TV and quiet. Although not huge, it was entirely adequate for my requirements and staff were very helpful in directing me to somewhere to eat in the evening. Very handy for Pimlico tube and nearby meeting venues. Breakfast was continental but plentiful and good variety, including meat and cheeses. I didn't check to see if there was WiFi, as I had my own connection. All in all this was excellent value and more personable than a larger hotel. I will certainly return here if I need to be in this area.

title: Worst of all the hotels I have ever stayed abroad
text: Very very small hotel with only 28 small rooms in all, I guess. Its double bed room should be ideally a single bed room. I felt stuffy inside the room as ventilation was extremely poor. Non-smoking rooms smell cigarette. Attached toilet/bath is the smallest possible one. No toiletry, only liquid soap. You can hardly turn your body once you close the door of the bathing enclosure! The building is quite old too. Not well-maintained. Room is not very clean either. Stains are visible on bed sheets. I won't recommend it unless you are a lone traveler on shoe-string budget, who desperately wants to stay reasonably close to Victoria station for just one or two night's sleep only. Though some reviews talk about "good location", I don't think so. The hotel is at least 15 min walk from Victoria station (both coach station and rail/tube station). Pimlico tube station may be closer, I haven't tried it. I used to catch bus no. 24 from Victoria station to drop at Belgrave Rd stop and then walk 2 min. Free breakfast is a farce - only cereals, toasts, cheese, tea, coffee, butter, jam. You may get boiled egg and juice, if you are an early riser and can reach the basement (breakfast is served there) quickly enough before the supply runs out. During my stay, the tea/coffee machine was not working one morning. For me, the hotel is not even a good value for money. Now a few plus points at last. Free internet worked nicely for me. The speed was moderate. Hot and cold water available 24 hrs. Reception is okay. The old lady is not very welcoming, but the younger staff members are good. Concierge service is minimal. Locality is very good

title: Dont go there...
text: The rooms are small, grim and stink of stale smoke. Our room had a delightful damp patch on the wall which seemed to grow by the minute. The bed consisted of a saggy mattress, one measly pillow, and a dubious brown quilt that probably hadn't been washed since Queen Victoria was on the throne. The bathroom reminded me of a portaloo at a music festival, and the "complimentary toiletries" amounted to a caustic soap more commonly found in a public toilet. The continental breakfast was served in a windowless, stuffy holding cell in the basement, and amounted to some toast, chemical jam, and uninspiring cereal. I didn't even venture near the brown liquid that was pretending to be coffee. There are better hotels in London, I'm sure that there cant be many that are worse!

title: Value for money in a pretty good location.
text: The hotel is basic but clean and tidy. The staff are really friendly and helpful. The rooms are small but not too cramped. Brreakfast is a basic continental, however, the breakfast room is far too small - we took our food outside on the patio and it was very relaxing and a good way to start the day. title: Good value - everything we needed
text: Welcoming reception area and staff. Check in and out very easy. We were in 2 basement rooms opposite the restaurant but it did not disturb me. Double room fine for single occupancy - yes the rooms are small but very clean and comfortable. En suite very clean and brilliant shower. The hotel seemed newly refurbished. Restaurant a little cramped but adequate and continental breakfast was adequate. We only wanted somewhere to sleep after busy days and evenings and for the price it was perfect.

title: Pretty good
text: Really enjoyed our stay here. Recently refurbished to a modern design, the staff were very helpful in this smallish hotel. Good value for money and a great location. We were on the top floor: great view but room was certainly compact. Tip: get down for your continental breakfast EARLY. It's a small room and definitely a squeeze when it's busy. Marks off for limited breakfast but overall experience was good and would definitely stay here again.

title: A short walk from Pimlico Tube station
text: We found the reception staff very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Our room (15) had a double bed plus a single bed and had been freshly painted. The bathroom (shower) was modern and clean. All in all everything was fine, good value for money and perfectly adequate for our stay. We would stay again if we wanted to be in that area of London. Breakfast (cereals, rolls, croissants, jams, hard-boiled eggs, juices, tea and coffee) was good and is included in the room price. Internet is available on the computer in the reception area but is charged for. There is a locked left-luggage room behind the reception. Pimlico Tube station is just down the road and much less frenetic than Victoria (which is only one stop away). There are several restaurants in the area.

title: Clean and modern
text: Helpful staff, exact location I needed to get to meeting, unbelievably cheap price for this hotel with breakfast included and service provided, will book this hotel again instead of higher priced places as it is just as good and all that is needed

title: Not Impressed
text: Reception staff I found to be pleasant enough. The room was clean and reasonably sized. The bathroom was a plastic pre-formed unit, that was beginning to show its age. My main beef with this hotel was the Continental (with a small 'c')Breakfast and the Breakfast room in particular. The room was TOTALLY inadequate for the number of guests staying there. Chairs and tables were crammed in and by 08.15 hours there was a queue to get in there - a totally rediculous situation. If you were unlucky enough to sit with your back to the bar/counter, then you had people pushing past you all the time - dreadful. I only had one brief encounter with the catering staff and that was when we got into trouble for arriving at 07.55 hrs the first morning of our stay. The lady did not seem to be the happiest person in London !!! I would not wish to stay there again.

title: Worst Hotel Ever!!!
text: We stayed at the Victoria Inn while travelling on our honeymoon and unless you are completely desperate strongly recommend you find somewhere else to stay. The nightmare started when we booked in after 23 hours of travel to find we had been allocated a twin share room - despite being very specific in all correspondence about it being our honeymoon! We were informed there was nothing that could be done as no other rooms were available. The next day we were moved to the only available double room that was in the basement and was so small not enough room to open our suitcase and had no ventilation. On the third day we were moved yet again to room 6 which was (admittedly) a reasonable room. The manager of the hotel is the rudest person we have ever had to deal with for a customer service complaint and agree with your other reviewers that she should not be working in the customer service industry. When we complained about having been allocated a twin room she was very agressive, raised her voice at us and told us it was too bad and if we didn't like it we could get out of her hotel. We could not believe the size and standard of all the bathrooms (after having 3 different rooms we are able to comment on a variety of them)! The showers are so small you had to stand like a tin soldier once you were in, water was always covering the floor, and the toilets are very tightly squeezed in. The breakfast room was also the worst we have experienced. There was no ventiliation so it was really hot and stuffy and it was constantly overcrowded with nowhere to sit. The food was of a very average standard - basic toast, cereal and tinned fruit. On a positive note we found the cleaning staff really friendly and a couple of the front desk people also nice. The location of the hotel was quite central being a short walk to a couple underground stations. It was however very unusual that we were required to hand in our key at reception every time we left the hotel??? I am absolutely baffled as to how this hotel manages to keep it's star rating as it certainly does not compare in any way to any other hotel we have stayed in. The favourite part of our stay was definitely checking out! Do yourself a favour and find somewhere else to stay!!!!
