text: Stayed for 5 nights in June with my boyfriend and we could not have asked for a better location to do sight seeing in London! Although bathroom is small and room not so spacious, it was very cosy and had a good feel to it. It had all we needed. The area is also very quiet and we had a view from our window. It is walking distance to Euston metro, Kings Cross, Saint Pancras and Russel Square metro stations as well as the British Museum. The local area has many shops and cafes including a supermarket and general stores so everything was at our doorstep. Wifi was also very strong and fast. Would definitely return for another stay!

title: Return visist
text: We have stayed at Studios2Let about 4 times now. On our first visit we stayed in a large studio with a patio, but we subsequently booked the executive studio for the extra room and more shelf space. Everything is very clean. Cartwright Gardens is in a very convenient location, near two main tube/railway stations and there is a small shopping centre with two supermarkets a few minutes away. There is also a very good fish and chip shop, North Sea Fish, around the corner in Leigh Street. There are bus stops a couple of minutes away. The Bloomsbury area is full of academic institutions and lovely squares. The beds in the studios are very comfortable. The reception will replace towels, toilet paper etc. if asked.There is a free laundry, which is very convenient. You can buy the washing powder at the reception. There are plenty of electrical points for phones, computers etc. The kitchen is compact. It is hard to reach the sink in the corner, but you have all the utensils you need for making simple meals. The bathroom is also compact with a very small basin. A shelf for soap in the shower would be useful. One thing which we don't like in every room we have stayed in is the carpet, which curls up at all 4 edges and is a trip hazard. We have always had excellent service from the Reception team, and this time Elhadji stood out for his polite and efficient service. He always has a smile on his face and is an asset to the team. There is no lift, so if you have problems with stairs, it is better to ask for a ground floor apartment. We have stayed on different floors and had no problem with the lower ground floor. There was plenty of outside light and it isn't claustrophobic. If the budget permits, book one of the larger rooms. We always stay for more than a week and are very satisfied with this comfortable accommodation.

title: Excellent location with all you need for a short stay.
text: Stayed here with my wife for a pre Christmas break and was not disappointed. The location is in a nice area of London and so handy for all transport links including Kings Cross/St. Pancras . We used Russell Square underground station but mostly walked into the West End and visited the British Museum just around the corner. At the moment there are extensive works being carried out opposite the apartments but these did not spoil our stay. The Brunswick is a small shopping centre just a stones throw away where there is a Waitrose amongst a dozen or so other shops. There are plenty of eating/drinking establishments on the walk from the apartments to Russell Square Tube Station. The apartment we had was on the top floor and we were greeted by friendly staff a trait that continued during the stay. The apartment was small with a view of Cartwright Gardens and gave us everything we needed i.e. cooker, fridge, kettle with supply of tea/coffee etc. and a decent sized TV and comfortable bed. Wi Fi was free which is a bonus. If there was a negative and only a small one the windows did tend to be quite draughty. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Simple, Clean, Comfortable
text: We were only there two nights. We were looking for simple, clean, comfortable accomodation in Bloomsbury, and Studios2Let supplied all of that. We expect to be back for a longer stay. We liked the fully equipped kitchen and the efficient use of space. We were especially happy with the location: 6-8 minutes from King's Cross or Euston in one direction and Russell Square in the other, and facing a quiet green space. The staff were helpful with power adapters (we forgot ours) and local information. Free WIFI, of course.

title: Cartwright Gardens no
text: Great location. Nice place but a bit noisy. The sink was positioned weirdly and hard to use. The shower is extremely small so don't go if you are large. Quite noisy. The bed is not the best quality. It has a nice outside area to sit in, out the back.

title: Excellent rooms /no lift, but will certainly come again
text: I have just stayed here for 4 nights and it is perfect to my taste! The rooms are modern and clean with a fully equipped kitchen with everything in it to prepare your own food, bathroom with shower (+complimentary soaps etc) and the beds/matrasses are perfect ( I have a bad back!) The location is absolutely perfect near King's Cross Station and Cartwright Gardens is a fairly quiet street considering the busy Euston Rd nearby.(My windowview was on the crescent-side).Also several pubs/restaurants nearby and M&S Food on King's Cross to get your own groceries.Free WIFI in my room was a great advantage as well as the flatscreen TV. The room was a bit small ( to me it was not a problem) but there is enough cabinetspace to put all your belongings in.People at the servicedesk are very friendly and kept my suitcase free of charge in store when I arrived too early so I could start my shoppingday( and later carried it about 60 steps up to my room). So all in all, a good price for a great room on a very central location. I will come back again next time...

title: Compact affordable accommodation
text: These appartments are superb! Affordable, and in near reach of Euston. We really enjoyed staying here, and being able to organise food and visit attractions at our own pace and without expensive meals out. The flat was clean, compact, and fun. Very quiet and classy area. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable. Very efficient. All in all, to be highlt recommended.

title: Clean and comfortable room.
text: Our room was very clean, and had french doors that opened to the outside. The room itself is small, but you have everything you need. The location is quick and convenient to many dining spots. All the major attractions are just a short walk away.

title: Clean and convenient...would go back
text: My wife and I stayed for 3 nights in this hotel and found it clean and comfortable. We had a patio studio and found the room great. It was more compact than any room you find in North America but I would certainly choose this over some of the places I have stayed in the States. The room was designed with maximum utilization of space. There was a sink, microwave,fridge, a toaster,kettle, a small table and folding chairs all in our room and easily accessed without taking up any more space than required. The free internet was great all you have to do was plug the ethernet cable to your laptop. The bathroom was small but even for a heavy guy like me I did not feel like I was cramped. The decor was nice and the bed was very comfortable. We are not that demanding so all I required from the staff was to show me to my room. The area is also very good for transport and entertainment. The Kings Cross/St Pancras station and Russel Square station are very close by. There are pubs and a good shopping area ( Brunswick?) on the way to Russel Square station from the hotel. For 91 pounds a night during high season this place is a steal. All I wish is that they had a room for luggage storage. We wanted to store our luggage which was free but being that it was just left in the hallway made us feel that it was too unsafe.

title: Great location and price
text: This is the second time we have stayed at Cartwright gardens and although the building work currently taking place in the area is a pain the apartments and location are fantastic value for money. I would recommend the apartments to anyone but don't expect a lie in except on Sunday's. Jason and Tracey Birmingham, England.

title: Little Gem
text: Our weeklong stay in central London was made very easy owing to the great location of these apartments. Situated opposite a park in Camden (Bloomsbury to be precise) it is midway between Euston station and the two station complex of Kings Cross and St Pancras. It is only a 5 minute walk in either direction along Euston Road. A doddle with your pull along cases. The staff were excellent with immediate assistance on any matter or enquiry raised. We stayed at No. 27 which is the last in the line closest to Euston Rd. Now the apartment itself ... We opted for the budget apartment with its own ensuite. It had all that was required. Modern - with Stove, fridge, freezer, appliances etc. Plus a shared laundry in basement. But be aware that it is very, very small. It didn't worry us because we were there to see London and not sit in an apartment all day. But, if you want to bend down in the bathroom be warned. You WILL hit your head on the opposite wall. It is almost impossible to dress in there unless your name is Houdini. This is not a criticism of the apartment, just a 'heads up'. The only other point of note is that the light weight drapes allow light through and if the weather is fine you can sit in bed and read a book without turning on a light at 5 a.m. (summer when we were there). Not great for late risers. For all that we would not hesitate to use the apartments again.

title: Best place in Bloomsbury
text: The only place I want to stay in London - great location and extremely well-equipped and clean studio. It has everything from oven to deep freezer. The neighbourhood is very nice and everything is within walking distance.

title: nice location, clean comfortable
text: We stayed there in October 2013. The rooms are very clean and quiet. They are quite small, but that is expected for London. It is so close to Kings cross and Euston staions so very convenient for travelling on to Paris as it is so close to St Pancras train station. The locations is ideal for close restaurants, pubs, bars and shopping. There is a food supermarket just around the corner. Staff were very pleasant and I must repeat it is very quiet accomodation. There is a large lounge area and fee laundry.

title: Good, but don't get the basement
text: Great location, good value. Small, but good facilities and very well designed for such a compact space. Just ask for ground or first floor or above. In the basement you'll get a lot of overhead noise.

title: Compact and well priced, great location
text: Stayed with partner in a ground floor double apartment. Very compact, everything you could want, they really shoe-horn everything in. Ok for 1 really or just the 1 night. Has an internal bathroom with a broken extract fan which means it got very hot after a shower and never really cooled down. Ground floor meant a little noise from the streets - pedestrians rather than vehicles as its a quiet crescent street. Very convenient for Kings X / St.Pancras or Euston or Tottenham Court Road or Russell Square. Very friendly staff, very clean, felt almost new. Bed a little soft.

title: Great, affordable accomodations
text: Price was a key factor when looking for a place to stay in London, the next was location. The Studios2Let met both of our requirements. The apartment was small, but totally met our needs. We weren't in our room long enough for the small space to be of any concern. The apartment was VERY clean, and well equipped. Comfortable bed, TV/DVD player, kitchen with microwave, two burners, sink and dishes. Shower had great hot water pressure too. For it being a small space, we were still able to store two large suitcases as well. The location was PERFECT - just a 5 minute walk from St. Pancras station and Kings Cross - which connects you to the Eurostar and the Tube. Staff were very friends and helpful. I had forgotten to print off some pre-purchased tickets, and the office staff helped me by printing them off for me. I would highly recommend staying here again.

title: Stay somewhere else
text: Agoda offered an unnamed 4 star hotel close to Kings Cross. Boy,I was I totally misled as I was given a sewage-stinking room. Got another one instead, but ridiculously small. No room cleaning and needed to go to the front desk for toilet paper, soap and shampoo. The whole joint stinks of cigarettes. Shameful.

title: Great service and amenities but very, very tiny...
text: Based on the description of the "studio", I did not expect a huge place but was really baffled by the size of it. I was by myself and felt claustrophobic because there was so much is such a tight space. It is too bad because the bed was comfortable, the kitchen fully equipped, the bathroom functional, heating/air easy to adjust, everything very well thought out and all very clean and tidy. Staff at the reception desk were friendly and helpful, the street quiet and the neighborhood close to everything...Not sure if they have larger studios but if they do, get those as the place is very well kept!

title: Average place on a budget
text: This holel's pluses relate to location - Situated off Euston Rd - 10 minutes to Euston Station and a little more to St Pancreas. It does have a toaster/kettle/microwave/fridge/kitchen sink but no cook top or conventional oven Dishes are provided - bathroom is modern and clean = safe in room - quaint older homes 0n quiet street. Did store luggage pre check-in = staff were pleasant. Wi=fi very good Bed comfortable Negatives - Extremely small suite -= maybe2.5 metres by 4 metres - pictures were deceptive from what we experienced. =bed was quarter way across patio door pillows frequently dropped between bed and doorway -Housecleaning not done while room occupied. - but easy to engage additional towels etc. A little noisy at times - walls not too thick. Not sure I would book again - London is so pricey!!!

title: Very comfortable
text: Stayed at Studios2Let for a solo business trip. The reception staff were helpful but not over-friendly. My apartment was located several doors away from main reception, but the receptionist accompanied me to the door and showed me how to gain access with the electronic key

title: Great for a short break, but very compact accommodation !
text: These self catering apartments do give you much more freedom than a hotel. They are clean, modern, and well equipped for you to be able to use as a base to work or play in London. Also, they are in a good location to stock up on any provisions for your stay. Just be aware - they are not large apartments - and the bathrooms are not especially suitable for the larger lady or gentleman or anyone who gets a little claustrophobic ! If you are using the wifi on multiple devices make sure you ask for multiple access codes - codes are single use.

title: Comfortable, quiet and a great location
text: My wife and I recently stayed in a studio apartment for a week and thoroughly enjoyed it. Although compact, the modern, comfortable accommodation had everything we wanted including an oven and a fridge and freezer. However, the big attraction for us was the location. It was only a 10 minute walk to Russell Square tube station and just a further 10 minutes to the St Pancras transport hub. Self catering was easy with a short walk to a shopping centre containing a large supermarket. Bloomsbury's many restaurants and pubs are also just minutes away. To top it off, the staff are great - really helpful and full of suggestions on how to enjoy your stay.

title: Great location
text: We stayed 6 nights in a studio room with a patio. The room is not large however was clean and tidy and had kitchen facilities for cooking. The apartment complex has a number of self service washing machines and dryers available for use. The apartments are located within easy walking distance to supermarkets, cafes, St Pancreas train station and the British Museum. The only annoyances we experienced was the room we stayed in on the lower level had quite a bit of noise from the apartment/s above. Could hear people walking around and chairs being moved early morning and late evening each day. Also, the apartments are not serviced during a 6 night stay which is fine however, it would have been nice if management had provided additional fresh towels and toiletries in the room on arrival as I'm not sure many people enjoy having to use the same towel 6 days in a row!! Overall however we enjoyed out stay and would consider returning again in the future.

title: Clean, Convenient, No Frills
text: The space had everything that was advertised. We appreciated the kitchen, though the sink was oriented a bit awkwardly. We were on the ground floor, so no stairs to navigate. Bathrooms are tiny, my husband & I are both XL, but still fit with little trouble. The service was there if you asked for it, but this is not N. America, so they will not bend over backwards for you. I wouldn't hesitate to book here again as a seasoned traveller. The price and location outweigh any misgivings I would have regarding size/stairs/service.

title: Great location, extremely noisy
text: Pros: the hotel is in an awesome location next to shops, bars and restaurants for a twentysomething wanting to enjoy local London nightlife

title: Disappointing
text: On the plus side, the room (large studio?) was spotlessly clean

title: Compact, convenient self-contained apartments
text: Very compact, but convenient location. Good alternative if you can't afford the hotels nearby. Reasonable price for location. Clean, well equipped including complimentary toiletries, tea and coffee making facilities.Even toothbrushes, disposable razor and sewing kit. Bed was a bit soft and caused 'roll together' Not really ideal for more than one person. We had the standard double with balcony which is meant to be a bit bigger!Bathroom is very small, shelf above sink not good as you can't wash your face.Shower tiny, I'm 5'2 and could not crouch down. my husband is 6'7 so was a challenge for him.Noise travels so recommend ear-plugs if you're noise sensitive. Full studio style cooking facilities too.Pleasant reception staff and quick check-in at 2pm, Check-out 11am. 5 mins walk to British Library. Kings Cross and Euston about 8-10 mins walking. Overall impressed with facilities though for the price.

title: Just OK
text: Just about OK for the price. A very good location and the room adequately clean. Bathroom very small and double bed pushed up against the wall so only accessible from one side. The toilet seat was barely attached to the toilet and the batteries in the TV remote were dead, the remote control itself being very dirty. The water pressure in the tiny shower was poor.

title: Not bad
text: I stayed for 4 weeks during my recent work trip. The location is perfect, close to King's Cross/Russel Square/Euston Square tube station and Waitrose/Tesco nearby. It's located on a quiet lane but well lit at night.The studio unit is small, but okay for one person. The bathroom is really small and I had a feeling of claustrophobia, but this feeling resolved after a while. The kitchen is equipped with basic cooking tool. The washing facilities are old looking but functioning. During my stay, there were two huge travelling bag left inside the washing room. They looked as though they have been there for ages. On few occasions, some irresponsible tenant left their clothes in the drier, preventing other people to use. Price wise, I have to admit that the place is expensive.

title: Great value, comfortable stay
text: I enjoyed a very pleasant stay at this place with my mother. The check-in staff were extremely helpful and friendly and even helped us with our bags to our apartment. The apartment was small but big enough for two people to move around in. The kitchenette had the essentials for cooking small meals and the bathroom was small but clean. If you need more toiletries/toilet paper/paper towels, you have to go to the front desk to ask. There is a laundry room for everyone to use for free which was very handy. The location is about a 7 minute walk from the Brunswick square which has a supermarket, Starbucks and a few small stores which met all of our needs. The square is a few steps away from Russell square tube station. It is also just a few minutes walk from the St. Pancras train station (very walkable, don't bother taking a taxi). The only thing that could be improved is the mattress. It has clearly seen better days and is very saggy and you can feel the springs. If that could be improved then this place would get five stars!

title: Great Location and Apartment
text: Stayed in a ground floor Executive Studio in the main building for eight nights in May. Excellent setup for self contained stay with good facilities. If possible , recommend an Executive studio as I suspect anything smaller would feel fairly cramped. Small but adequate bathroom, serviceable kitchenette, comfortable bed and a sitting area with a small table and two tub chairs. Studio was well decorated and a view of rear garden through big picture windows helped make the room feel larger. Staff were always pleasant and helpful , although don't expect too much in the way of hotel type services as it isn't that type of accommodation. The real advantage of Studios2let is the location. The area immediately around Studios2let has a great feel about it with more than enough activity to make it interesting while still being relatively quiet and relaxed. It is very close to Russell St underground station on the Piccadilly Line ( cheapest, most direct way to get from Heathrow ) , the Kings Cross Overland Line ( and the main Kings Cross underground interchange) as well as St Pancras international for the Eurostar. getting to and from all the major tourist areas and attractions was a breeze using the Underground. Also only a few minutes walk to the British Library and the British Museum and maybe 20 minutes walk to Regents Park. There are also numerous pubs and restaurants as well as the Brunswick Shopping Centre all within 5 to 10 minutes walk. The Waitrose store at the Brunswick has everything you need ( including wine,beer etc) so you can self cater to whatever level you want. If you intend to stay in London more than three or four days and / or you enjoy the benefits of self contained accommodation, would certainly recommend Studios2let Cartwright Gardens as a good place to base yourself. We would definitely stay there again.

title: Loved this Hotel!!
text: We stayed in London just two nights, but this hotel was great and would be even better for a longer trip. The room is small, but very nice and updated and it has everything you need for your stay, including a mini kitchen and there are laundry facilities available to use. The cutest thing was the patio off of our room, and we really enjoyed running out to the bakery down the street, grabbing some croissants, coffee and some fresh fruit from the fruit stand and coming back and having a relaxing breakfast. The hotel is located in a great location, just 5 minutes or so to two different transit stations and a short walk from Soho. Really a great choice for a trip to London.

title: Beautiful Bloomsbury
text: These compact and complete studios are located in one of the nicest places in central London. Bloomsbury is located between Russell Square, KingsCross and Euston Station and has a lovely village feel. The rooms themselves are small but contain everything you need including kitchen, bathroom, tv, dining chairs and a small wardrobe. The property also has a lounge area and outdoor terrace out the back.

title: never book with priceline again!
text: in all fairness my issues with this hotel are not the hotels fault per say but I booked a room for my family to visit London when I confirmed on the day that all was fine I was told the hotel didn't have the facity for children to sleep but I could buy an airbed so I wasted half a day trying to do that, when we arrived we were offered no help with the steps (my wife is wheelchair bound and found the corridor was to narrow for a wheelchair so she had to manage while I collapsed the chair to get it in on viewing our room we quickly realised they left no bedding for our children and as the room was tiny (the smallest iv ever stayed in) my 2 children forced to share a single airbed under a table as no room for a second and the bed wasn't a double it was a 3/4 at best so nobody slept

title: compact but perfect
text: Compact, but the perfect place to stay for the weekend. The staff were helpful and polite, the apartment was spotlessly clean. We stayed here for the weekend and its a short walk to kings cross station / Although the bed was a bit small it was very comfortable. The building was very quiet. I would definitely stay here again

title: Good location and spacious studios
text: I enjoyed my stay there, in London hotel you always suffer from narrow space of hotel rooms therefore I have chosen mystudios2let. Also the location is very close to Euston station if you may have train trips through this station so this hotel will make you life easy

title: Great location but too many stairs
text: My wife and I stayed here the night before a Eurostar train first thing the next morning. The apartments were chosen due to the proximity to St Pancras International station. My wife is not a great walker having had a knee replaced and the onset of arthritis. Indeed the reception was easy to find on the ground floor of a sweeping terrace of town houses. Although we were early our room was ready and we were escorted back along Cartwright Gardens to number 27. We had been allocated room 15. This is at the top of the building, I was later to count 74 steps, without a lift. My wife struggled up and at one point I thought that was where we would be all day as I knew she would not want to do that too often. There are three apartments on this top floor and 15 is the central one. The apartment is bijou to say the least. The double bed dominates the room and set slightly at an angle to fit it in. That said, everything one would want for a self catering stay is there. There is no bath but a small shower, toilet and sink is within a separate small room. The toiletries provided are good. The room has a window overlooking a park and the window opens enabling guests to get air as the size of the room with two bodies in becomes quite hot. The bed was comfortable and clean. Next door to 27 is another hotel and next to that Mabel's Table pub, a little noisy but with a fair selection of ales. About 100 yards away is a Pret a Manger that opens at 06.30 so if one does not want to cook facilities are nearby. We did venture out and had a good roam around the west end taking in a show. The location is great for the stations and also getting about London. We would use it again but would phone in order to have a lower floor room. The price is fair for the area within which it is located.

title: Excellent location
text: I first stayed in these apartments about 4 years ago and had forgotten how good they are. Excellent location, great value for money and well maintained. My job changed and I didn’t visit London as regularly so now I’m back working here regularly and booked myself into a succession of not so great budget hotels. Then I remembered about Studios2Let, won’t book anywhere else now. Remember they are studio flats, if you are expecting an expansive bathroom then book elsewhere and the ones in North Gower Street are VERY small. However for the price and location I don’t think you can do better

title: Clean, Small Room in Decent Location
text: As others have said, the rooms are essentially a very small studio. There's a small kitchenette with a mini-fridge, sink, and dishes. There is also a small TV and free wifi in the room. The room and bathroom are very clean. And the location is walking distance to St. Pancras train station which makes it very convenient to get around. Now for the things you should keep in mind: The bathroom is small. Very small. I'm a tall and thin person, so it wasn't too bad. The shower is approximately 3'x3' in floor space. So, it was difficult to raise my arms or move around in the shower. Also, the water temperature would fluctuate on its own. There are no lifts / elevators. The stairway is steep and narrow. This will be a pain if you have large luggage. I was on the top floor, which means you go up an additional even narrower and steeper flight of steps. It feels like you are crawling up into an attic. Check-in begins in the early afternoon. You can leave your luggage there, but their office fills up quickly and bags are left in the hallway. They give you a number tag to claim your bag. But, they don't check it when you pick up your bag. They did not check my number tag nor other people that just came in and left with bags. I had to wait several minutes in the office for someone to bring my room key, so I noticed this happen quite a few times. Overall, this is a good hotel and decent value. Just be aware of the few nit picky things I mentioned and be sure you are ok with them before booking a room.

title: Really wonderful
text: The location is ideal. Just a 3-4 minute walk from Kings Cross / St Pancras and the neighborhood to the east and south of the studios is also great with lots of restaurants and shopping options that are off the beaten path. The studios themselves are very clean and accommodative and have everything you need, but, the only reason I give a Very Good rating and not Excellent is that the budget studios are difficult with two people staying in the room. The double bed is abutted against the wall. You have to disturb your partner to get to the bathroom during the night if you're the one sleeping against the wall. Otherwise, these are excellent accommodations. Simply get a larger studio and you'd have the perfect stay in Central London.

title: Good apartment!
text: We stayed at Studios2LetServiced Apartment - Cartwright Gardens for 2 nights in early October, 2014. Our room is located on the 4th floor of Building#35 Room #29. The hotel is well located just steps away from the King's Cross/St.Pancreas Station on a quiet residential street. The King's Cross station is a main hub for the subways/tube/metro and for trains as well. The neighborhood is very safe, we walked late at night and early in the morning, no problems. The room is small but very compact and functional. The room has a small kitchenette (includes Microwave, fridge, oven, stove top, kettle, dishware, utensils and sink) and a bar table for you to make quick-fix meals. The queen size bed is very comfortable. The bathroom is small but again, very function. The shower allows one person at a time. Everything in the room is spotless clean. There is no room services. This hotel meets all three of my standards for travel 1) Secure 2) clean 3) Convenient. You need an access fob to enter the building. The 24 hour concierge is one building away from yours (depending on which building you stay). The street is tucked away from the main street in a residential area in front of a garden, so it's quiet all day long. We booked the hotel 3 months in advance from the hotel website directly and paid about Cdn $170/night. Unless i find something better priced with the same quality, I would definitely come back again for this hotel.

title: Good base close to kings cross
text: The appartments are a really short walk away from kings cross, under 10mn. They are also less than 10mn from russle square tube station. There s also a nice shopping centre next to the tube with a waitrose, a tesco express and quite a few shops, cafés and restaurants. The standard rooms are the size you would expect in a hotel in London, with a very descent kitchen area. Very handy and well equipped. But obviously in your bedroom so better not cooking anything smelly! The windows are not double glazed and there's a clear draft but the heating is very good and, if anything, we were a bit too hot. The bathroom is minuscule but clean and warm, the main problem is storage... Nowhere to put ur beauty products. The bed is descent, the hotel quiet enough even without double glazing but the curtains useless which would be a problem in summer as I can imagine the room being very bright From 5am. The staff. Are friendly and helpful. Good value for money I think and convenient location

title: Excellent location
text: 2 nights thurs and friday. Glad we booked the large studio, just enough room to be comfortable. Bathroom very small but ok for 2 nights. Kitchen area probably would have been big enough to prepare a meal but lack of cooking utensils. 2 tumblers, wine glasses, mugs , plates and bowls but nothing else e.g. dish for oven , sieve , jug etc. Toaster and microwave but no microwave dishes. No cafeteria or coffee making utensils. All clean. Bed comfy, lovely view onto tennis courts. Although no traffic noise, noisy people in square late at night, sat night may have been worse. Area has lots coffee shops etc and only 5 mins walk to Russell sq tube, 8 mins to Euston. Would recommend and stay again.

title: Centrally located & reasonably pricd
text: I chose this as my place to stay in London this month because of previous positive reviews. It is close to St Pancras (Eurostar) and also to Russell Sq tube. It is walking distance to Trafalgar Square and Oxford Street. The neighbourhood is very interesting, and there are eateries and supermarkets nearby. I recommend "49" for coffee. My room (lower ground, garden) reminded me of a ship's cabin, everything you needed in a compact setting. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom clean and there was a kettle, fridge and good bed light. For a solo traveller it is quiet and safe. Service was friendly and efficient. The booking through Internet was good. So, I have no complaints except one. When I asked for a taxi to be called, it took a really long time (15 minutes plus) and then turned out to be clearly a 'friend' of the management. I was expecting a proper London cab, so made other arrangements. For those of us who when we ask for a "taxi" except to get one, not an Uber or friend driver, this was disconcerting to say the least. Management needs to be clearer in future. Other than this glitch, I would stay there again. For a city that has a wide range of options, this is a good one.

title: A Gread Weekend
text: A clean little room in which everything is available what you need. We were there from Fridays to Mondays. The garbage was unfortunately not picked up. Here, a garbage bin might need to be positioned in the house. We'll definitely be back at the next Good NFL game in London. But will use a better category to have more comfort.

title: Great city studio.
text: Good location near Euston Station in tranquil Crescent and close to shops and British Museum. Great facilities and service in clean studio which has everything you need to stay with option to cook. Restaurants and pubs are nearby.

title: Trip to Olympics-one night stay
text: Me and a friend stayed for one night to go to the closing ceremony of the Paralympics. The location was are first reason for staying and only being 5-10 minutes walking distance from Euston railway main line plus underground was great. we stayed in a large studio with private patio area overlooking studio2lets private garden area. Room had a cooker, fridge, freezer, table and 2 chairs,kettle, plates cups etc. The patio had a table and 2 chairs plus a variety of pot plants which made it homely, plus really enjoyed a glass of wine after a busy day in london.Having a nice garden to overlook was so relaxing. 10 out of 10 for cleanliness. Me and few friends are planning to stay there again when we go on a sight seeing tour of London.

title: value pack but be understanding
text: beautiful quiet location, close to 3 stations, including kings cross and the euro star. great eating very close by.very home like interior but spartan. can cook but facilities at the bare minimum. staff friendly and helpfulit would have been 100% if the beds were better quality. we stayed two separate weeks in two rooms and found the same identical comments. i admit it was nice to go back the second time after about 4 weeks and although it was a different room, the one directly above, it did seem like coming home.

title: Customer Service at its Best
text: I have stayed at Cartwright Gardens for several days each week over the past year, the experience has been second to none. From the friendly welcome to the cheery goodbye I have always been made to feel that my comfort was the teams' prime concern. The studio flats are equipped to a high standard and the communal facilities are excellent. Although I was working it is also an excellent base for theatre going, sight seeing, visiting museums and galleries - and even nipping over to Paris from St. Pancras which is 5 minutes walk away.

title: Ignore any bad reviews
text: Stayed here last night with friends and it was brilliant, rooms were lovely and clean and full of little freebies toothbrushes, toothpaste etc, staff were lovely aswell , cannot fault the place and will deffo stay again when im in london next

title: Comfort and value in London
text: We stayed in a Large Studio and it was absolutely perfect for our needs. Not really large, but certainly comfortable. Tiny but modern and clean bathroom. Cooking facilities and especially laundry facilities (free, in the basement) were extremely handy. Staff polite and helpful. Fantastic location, especially in relation to public transport. Would certainly return.

title: Small but beautifully formed
text: My Husband and I stayed for 5 days earlier this week. It was fairly near to Euston Station and so getting about was no problem( until the tube strike)The whole area was pleasant and a few moderately priced eateries near by. The apartment itself although quite small was well equipped and clean, we chose an apartment with patio , this was a waste of time as it was so small and never got the sun. The entrance was somewhat shabby and always loaded with suitcases, the reception staff were usually quite polite and helpful , some better than others, If you needed a change of towels the soiled ones had to be brought up to reception for replacement. These were not of a particularly good standard and not as sparkling white as I would have liked . Overall we enjoyed our stay, they served their purpose and were moderately priced.

title: Not for everyone
text: Rating safety issue 1.Rooms far two small for 2 people Very dangerous in a state of an emergency 2. shower would not meet safety standards with size and facilities 3Lack of storage space for travellers such as my wife and I . 4 I know we asked for a downstairs room but in all honesty upstairs or downstairs should nor matter 5 Cooking facilities (Stove etc poorly laid out in fact could be classed as dangerous 6 The property is in a good location 7However for disabled people it would not pass the test from an access point of view

title: Convenient stopover
text: We travelled down from Manchester at 4pm and were in our room at 6.30, then off out to see a band soon after. Simple checkin, one form to fill in then two doors down to our "front door" and down a set of stairs to our room. Everything we needed, though a smallish bed (pushed up against a wall one side) and annoyingly for me, no USB charger in the wall - I'd forgotten my plug - but a small bathroom with a shower and even cooking facilities - wow. Very quiet, excellent location, five minutes walk from Euston, 24 hour reception (we dropped out keys back off at 6am), perfect for a stopover, but just that - despite the cooking facilities, I wouldnt' really want to stay any longer. Not luxurious, just clean and tidy. For the price though, considering the location - "central" London - just what we needed.

title: Good location, but tiny.
text: We stayed for 5 nights last August and chose this property because we wanted a kitchenette to save some money. We also wanted to be close to the underground and St. Pancras because we were leaving London on the Eurostar. The unit was very clean and had air conditioning, which was great because it was very hot while we were there. The bathroom was very small and the sink in the kitchenette was difficult to use because of its position under the cupboard. The free internet was hard-wired, which didn't work with our iPad. The location was great for using the underground and we found a small shopping center nearby with a decent sized grocery store. We made breakfast using the microwave and had a few dinners there. You really couldn't have 2 people sit to eat, so it wasn't the best situation. We used the terrace one night, but most people out there were smoking, so it didn't work out for us. In fact there was noise under our window at night when people sat outside on the stairs to smoke and hang out. Overall it was good for the price, if you don't mind the tight accommodations.

title: Small well set up apartment.
text: All the bits and pieces you need to make a proper meal. An efficient use of the small space, but still enough room to handle two large suitcases. The side of the bed near the wall was not comfortable.

title: Great way to "live" in London!
text: I was staying in London for 2 weeks and I wanted a room with a kitchen. Studios2Let is a wonderful place to stay! It's centrally located in Bloomsbury and within short walking distance of major train stations, the tube, supermarkets, handy shops and restaurants. The staff was very kind and responsive to my needs. For those complaining about needing new towels or having their rooms cleaned, all you need to do is ask. They state clearly they clean once per week which for me was fine. The room I had was very clean and comfortable. Having a kitchen saves so much on eating out. The kitchen comes with a 4 burner cooker (stove) oven, microwave oven, small fridge, small freezer, hot-water kettle, toaster, dishes (even wine glasses), pots and pans and cooking utensils. There is great, fast and reliable wifi internet and wired internet available. A cable tv, safe and well-appointed bathroom. I stayed in one of their larger executive studios and it was perfect for one or two people. Having free laundry facilities was great too! I think Studios2Let was a good bargain for me and I couldn't have asked for anything better. I will be staying there again!

title: Location location location
text: A conveniently central hotel which offers cosy accommodation in central London. Ideal for work or leasure visits. Clean and warm, ideal after a tiring day out. Though the rooms are not particularly spacious they are not claustrophobic and make stay there comfortable and easy

title: Superb location, mediocre rooms.
text: The hotel is just 350m from Euston Underground station, and almost as close to Russel Square Underground station, which are both great hubs for getting around the city. Despite this, the neighborhood is very quiet. The staff are friendly, and the cleanliness of the rooms are ok. Me and my wife stayed in two rooms, as the first one was super small and felt claustrophobic. Luckily, the staff where helpful about upgrading me at a reasonable extra charge (80 BP for an entire week). I DO NOT recommend booking the smallest room (standard studio with terrace). The second room we got (standard studio apartment) was relatively well equipped, if we for example would have wanted to make breakfast.(A stove, cutlery, knives, glasses etc.) There was only a microwave in the small room, by the way. Beds were way to narrow, measuring around 1.40. For two people, that's not enough in my book. I think all the rooms have the same size beds, but I am not sure of this. Internet was not impressive, nor the TV. The bathroom was rather small, and there was nothing to set the soap/ shampoo on in either of the two showers (why?), plus both shower heads I tried had leaks. Shower was still comfortable, though. Ok for stays up to a maximum of five nights in my opinion, on account of the lacking feeling of spaciousness of the room(s). I know that from the looks of this review, I should have given a lower score, but the staff were pleasant and the neighborhood was awesome, so I stand by my three points out of five.

title: Great location, all you need
text: If you are sick of staying in hotels and want a bit more flexibility than having to eat out every night (but feel you are beyond a hostel), then this place might be for you. I chose a budget studio but it was still twice as large as some of the hotel rooms I have stayed in recently and much cheaper. The kitchen area was well set up with fridge, stove, microwave, toaster, crockery and cutlery and loads of storage. The bed was comfortable, there was a TV, free wifi, chair and table, air-conditioning, and a small but perfectly functional ensuite bathroom. It was all extremely clean. I liked the extra touches like a couple of pieces of fruit, shaving kit etc. I didn't use it but there was a laundry room for guests to use. If you have been travelling for awhile, then this place will let you have some normality in your life again, cooking for yourself and catching up on your laundry. It is located in a very picturesque row of terraces and only 5 minutes walk from Kings Cross/St Pancras and about double that from Russell Square. It was a real find and I can't fault it.

title: Great but don't take too many bags
text: These little studios are in a great location easy walking distance to several tube stations.They're also clean and in a nice area.They are very small though and if, like us, you end up on the top floor it's a bit of a pain to lug your bags up the narrow staircases and then have enough space to put them down.That though for us was the only real issue we had and its only really a problem on the day you arrive and the day between. Otherwise great

title: So pleased to have found this little gem!
text: Booked this as an alternative to hotel accommodation, and we were not disappointed! Yes, the rooms are small, but we were prepared for that and spent very little time there anyway. But when we were there, the accommodation was spotlessly clean, staff very pleasant and helpful, very convenient location, and great to have somewhere to prepare simple meals ( much cheaper than eating out all of the time!). Good quality fittings and linen, well equipped with all you need for short stay. No problem leaving luggage after checking out. Would definitely stay again, and will recommend to friends and family.

title: Great location, great unit for one
text: Recommended by my brother and sister in law and it was just perfect for me. Yes it's true the units are not very big, but suited a solo traveller perfectly. Great cooking facilities and very close to tube stations, supermarkets and pubs! I'm returning in July with my husband, it will be a squeeze with two of us there, but we only intend to sleep there on that visit (rather than cooking, etc in).

title: Amazing stay
text: The room was small but it had absolutely everything in it.. maybe a little stingy with the toilet paper rolls and they could have left some instruction on how to work the remote but I will definitely stay here again when i come back to London.

title: Studios2Let
text: Really good location, reasonably priced and with all you need for a comfortable stay in London. Check in and out was very straightforward and the room was very clean and generally well equipped. Would happily recommend to friends.

title: Great location, great apartments, overall good quality stay!
text: Stayed in Studios2Let for four nights whilst in London and was very happy with my stay! I would recommend for people travelling alone or with a friend/as part of a pair! I and my cousin stayed from the 25th of June for four nights. The location is amazing. You are a 10 minute walk away from the main Kings Cross St. Pancras station and the local underground station Russel Square is just down the street. On the five minute walk from the apartments to Russel Square station (down the street) you pass a few shops, a variety of bars and The Brunswick Shopping centre which is very handy to have all at your doorstep. There is construction going on across the street on a new building however it did not in any way effect our stay. Check in was quick, however I would suggest travelling light as there are no lifts and the stairs are steep. We were on the very top floor as we opted for a larger studio apartment for that little bit of extra space so the walk to the top was draining! The first couple of nights we had trouble with our TV though when we told reception they were happy to come to the apartment and help. There is also a very nice decking/garden area with two sitting spaces out the back which was nice to sit out on sunny days with a drink. There is also a lounge however we did not visit it. The outside of the apartment block is nice and makes for lovely pictures. The cleanliness of the apartment was great, however we did have a lot of trouble with one of our windows as it was very hard to get it up and down and we noticed ants at one point in the middle window frame (we stayed in apartment 33) however they weren't really much of a problem. Bathroom is quite small but it was expected, we didn't really mind. If staying for over a few days expect to have to ask for extra toilet roll, maybe more shampoo and to get rid of rubbish at the rubbish points outside. The shower is amazing, incredibly powerful and so relaxing even though it's small! Overall we very happy with our stay and would definitely stay again if we were to ever return to London! A great, quality location and good price for your money! No major complaints!

title: Weekend in London
text: This hotel is in a good location in an attractive building not far from Euston, Kings Cross and St Pancras stations We chose a room at the back of the hotel on an upper floor for a quiet position. There was little noise from outside but noise from the refridgerator in the kitchen area was disturbing. Also the curtains did not block out outside ambient lighting from security lighting which made sleeping more difficult. Other gripes were that the television did not work , the wi fi was poor and the shower room was useable but of bare minimum size. Also bear in mind that, although check out time is 11am, you will be unable to get back into your room after 10am as the electronic key is deactivated at this time.

title: Compact but comfortable
text: Cleverly designed to maximise a small space, my single room was well equipped, quiet and comfortable. A very neat kitchen area with microwave and conventional cooker. The shower was good, again small but had everything - except a shelf in the shower cubicle. Location is excellent, being close to museums, galleries , theatres and restaurants - yet so quiet that I was woken by bird song on Sunday morning. Would definitely stay here again especially if traveling by Eurostar from St Pancras which is just a few minutes' walk away.

title: Location is the saving grace
text: Quietly and conveniently located between Euston and King’s Cross, this was our 4th visit in the last 5 years (over 2 years since last time) and the place was very evidently worn and tired. Rooms meet all basic needs but the bed was old and saggy and sloped to one side, the blind was broken, shelf falling down and generally everywhere and everything was in need of refurbishing/replacing. It felt more like a hostel than a hotel.As always, staff were welcoming and friendly but this will have been our last stay.

title: What a find!
text: We stayed here over the bank holiday weekend. We chose it because its within 5 minutes walk of Euston station. We had a ground floor superior room, booked though hotels.com. It was just what we needed - clean, tidy, modern and close to so many amenities. We'd lots of fab places to eat, on the doorstep (try the Chinese along the road - turn right out of the front door. What a gem!) and were close to Euston, Kings Cross and Russell Square. Would definitely recommend this to all our friends and would stay again. Thank you.

title: Quiet location minutes from Euston Road - Excellent value for money
text: Great location within 5 minutes walk of Kings Cross / EuroStar or Euston stations. Rooms are a little small as other say but very well equipped and represent super value money for the locations. Lots of local restaurants, pubs & cafe's close by

title: Affordable place to stay in London
text: We stayed at the apartments for two nights in mid July. The room was nice and clean, it wasn't big but a reasonable size as we were just using this as a base and didn't spend too much time in the room. The woman who greeted us and walked us to our building told us a little about the place (nearest shops etc). This was the only contact we had with any staff so can't comment too much but she seemed perfectly friendly. Our room was on the top floor and there was quite a few stairs to climb to reach it, which might be an issue for some people. Also we stayed when the weather was really hot and found our room could get rather warm and uncomfortable. Location of the apartments is really good, we were able to walk everywhere we wanted i.e. London Zoo, West End. If you are looking for a more affordable base to explore the city then I would recommend.

title: Adorable studio
text: Coming from New York I am well aware of the space limitations. Instead of getting the basic I got the one above that, the superior. It was adorable and felt very cozy. I enjoyed the stay and the location was perfect for my boyfriend and I. It was steps away from the supermarket to pick up some groceries and close to bloomsbury. I recommend this studio under the condition that you understand the room space is quite limited, but overall a very good stay!

title: My mind of my travel
text: Studios are really clean, there is everything : TV, bed, bath, kitchen, toilet. Just a little bad point : the fosterling is a little bit cold. The hostel is placed very well in the center of London, so you have the underground around and many stores.

title: Location and Price
text: The location and price were right for our stay here. Our room was "efficient" (read that small) but served us well. It was very clean. The bed was the best we'd had in the UK. We would Russell Square Underground station to be the closest and most convenient. There is a short flight of stairs from the lower elevator level to the platform. We managed with our roll-aboard suitcases. The negative is that our room was in the "English Basement", half below street level. Our view was the trash cans, mops and brooms. It was reasonably quiet. Fortunately, the cleaning people didn't start work until 8:30am. We would stay here again.

title: Very small room in amazing location
text: I stayed in the studio with my mum, overall it was ok, but not amazing. I would stay there again but I am not going to rush back. The room had the most important things, it was clean, appliances worked and customer service was ok. The downsides *Shower was tiny, I am not overly big and I couldn't move in the shower *No lift, so carting bags up and down stairs *Couldn't leave window open or lock window *At night it was very noisy The location was amazing, so close to Kings Cross, shops, cafes and pubs, due to that reason, I would stay there again.

title: Small rooms, but very clean and convenient
text: I stayed here twice, a short time apart. First room was in the main building. Must be the smallest hotel room I've ever had! But it was very clean, recently renovated, with nice little courtyard area. OK for one person, although nowhere to put suitcase that wasn't in the way of a door or cupboard access. would have been hopeless for two people! Very friendly reception staff. Second room was a bit bigger, with a kitchenette area. Was not as recently renovated, and stairs are creaky and thinly carpeted, so you hear all your neighbours coming and going. Great location near tube and overground stations, with lots of coffee shops and restaurants nearby.

title: Ideal location
text: We stayed at Studios2let for a one night stay before catching the Eurostar. The location was excellent for this purpose as only a 5/10 min walk to the station. Having checked out the studio2let website and also Tripadvisor we were well aware of what to expect regarding the room sizes, but to be honest we were happy with the size of our room. No the bed isn't huge, but is a standard size double, and comfortable. The room was spotlessly clean. The shower, another area that I'd seen complaints about was also very useable, but I can see that if you're on the larger side of normal you may have a problem. We were on the top floor which was a bit of a pain, and I'd definitely advise anyone with mobility problems to ask for a room lower down. Luckily for us, the lovely young man who showed us to our room took my case from me and took it to our room. The down sides are definitely the stairs, the blinds at the windows are not sufficient to stop the light coming in, this morning by 5am. The kitchen sink isn't user friendly, being right in a corner, but we knew that before we booked. The stair carpets are showing signs of wear, but are safe. Would we stay here again? Well, more than likely.

title: I like my stay in Studios2Let
text: Lovely and comfort room I stayed. Kitchen was nice but if freezer would have been there, it was complete for me. I was so happy that there is an air conditioner and when I reached there it was kept very nice room temperature.

title: Hotel would have been better
text: My room was small, the bathroom even smaller and if you're overweight, you would not have fit into that shower. The place is expensive with very little that leaves you feeling like you've gotten value for money. The bed was VERY comfortable, I will say that. And the location quite ideal. The cancellation policy is tricky and will have you paying out of your you-know-where if you don't read it properly. And if you stay longer than 3 days or so, they charge you for cleaning your room. Yes. I read the terms and conditions upon check-in. And if you don't show up for your booking, they will absorb your deposit and charge you the same amount as a cancellation fee. It's truly ridiculous. You'll get better value for money at a hotel. The Pullman is literally around the corner from there. Book with them.

title: Holidays in London
text: We were a group of friends in London, we stayed in Study2let.Very nice apartments, clean, very quiet and very well located.The reception staff is not very nice, our level of English is not very good but they do not make any effort either.

title: Convenient studio apartment next to King's Crossing
text: Small studio apartment at Cartwright Gardens complex with kitchen in quiet location conveniently located 5 minutes to King's Crossing. Excellent access to London transportation (trains, underground). Our second stay and would return again when visiting London.

title: Short weekend in The Westend
text: Excellent accommodation for the weekend spent in the west end !.. Accommodation was adequate with excellent facilities and super location. Surprisingly quite for the location 4mins walk from Carring Cris’s

title: for the weekend
text: Right after a long day of sightseeing. The size of the study does not allow much to do other than sleeping and taking a shower. Anyway, I would not mind repeating if there were larger studies (I do not know). Quiet and well connected

title: Brilliant accommodation
text: These apartments are so clean, everything you need is there for you. Shower& toilet a bit small but are adequate, this is no big deal. The staff are very nice and have a smile for you. If you are in London these are great apartments and in a great location.

title: Exhorbitant price for tiny room
text: Fortunately we only stayed 1 night at Studios2let as a transit point between arriving in London and heading off to Edinburgh by train the following day. It was close to the station & clearly charged a premium price for that. The room itself was very modern and clean, but so tiny that we had to walk sideways to pass between the bed and the wall to get to the door. I cannot see how anyone could stay there for more than 1 night. Where would suitcases go? Yes, there was a kitchen area as part of the room but the overall space was so crowded, it would not be comfortable to use, let alone try to eat a meal. Never again.

title: Just such a lovely place to stay
text: Another very quick visit to this area of Bloomsbury to combine a catch up with our son and daughter plus a cookery course at the Good Housekeeping Institute. The Kimpton was formerly the Principal and has retained the same amazing selling point - the staff. Valter the door man is an absolute credit to the Kimpton. He remembers guests and his approach is friendly but not overbearing or pretentious with an element of humour that Is rare in many hotels of this standard. We were very fortunate to be upgraded and room 606 will not disappoint. It is spacious and allows you to get a real feel for a London apartment.....our daughters 2 bedroom London home is considerably smaller than the whole of 606! The hotel is beautiful and stylishy decorated but not stuffy at all. The bar staff in Fitzs bar are young and enthusiastic with a real knack for making you feel very comfortable.We are back again in mid March - testament to how lovely this place is. Whilst they do offer a super breakfast facility a trip to Tropea in the Russell Square Gardens is a must. If you don’t make breakfast then once spring is upon us just sit outside and watch the world go by.

title: Wonderful quirky character
text: Had a thoroughly enjoyable stay at The Kimpton Fitzroy for a full day business function, great food, drinks reception, dinner and overnight. Loved the decor, very unique and different from the run of the mill London hotel.

title: Splendid
text: Oh if only other hotels in the group had the same attitude as the Fitzroy. It was like a breath of fresh air staying here. Recognised and upgraded as a Spire Elite without the usual "all our executive rooms are booked" excuse. Fantastic room, clean, superbly comfortable bed and the most friendly staff who don't see every customer enquiry as an albatross round the neck! looking forward to our return.

title: Beautiful Hotel with great service
text: We stayed here for last leg of our trip and from check in to checkout the service was wonderful. Rooms were beautiful, clean and spacious. Near underground station and with ample bus routes around. Great location too!

title: Fantastic Hotel and Great Staff
text: We stayed at the hotel for 3 nights over the May bank holiday weekend to celebrate my 50th birthday and our eldest son finishing his university degree. Our experience throughout the stay was one of being made to feel very special, the staff in all areas of the hotel are very friendly and provide a very high quality service. Our particular thanks to Alex (Reception) and Ro (Concierge) for helping make our stay extra special and for arranging fantastic restaurant bookings. My wife and I stayed in a suite and our two sons stayed in a Deluxe double-double room, both rooms were of a very high standard, with very comfortable beds. We knew that we would be staying during the hotels soft launch period and not all areas of the hotel would be open, from the areas that are open we can see that the hotel has been beautifully renovated, the parts yet to open sound great, The Palm Court looks like it will be a great area to relax. The Principal hotel will for sure be one of London's top 5-Star hotels. Thank you again to all the staff for helping make our stay in London very special and we look forward to staying again in the future.

title: Dinner on our last night in London
text: We went for our last night dinner at Kimpton Fitzroy last Saturday 2nd February. We were impressed by the beauty of this hotel and one immediately feels at home. We were attended to as soon as we entered the restaurant and all was excellent, food, atmosphere and most of all the service. We would like to thank Adam for serving us so well and in a professional way. He was so caring and friendly. Thank you Adam and keep up the wonderful service. We will come again for sure if we happen to be in London. Well done.

title: Business trip
text: Service and staff are amazing - I have stayed at many hotels in London and this is the best . Location - close to great restaurants, fashion shops and near Oxford Street . Great areas to have a drink and then have dinner - really nice atmosphere to relax.

title: Decadence, Style and Service that makes you feel special...
text: I stayed here on my recent trip to the UK for work and loved the experience the team have created. Each area of the hotel had its on unique experience and the attention to detail was incredible. Used the gym every morning, really well equipped and helped me get over my jet lag. The service was slick and the rooms were spacious and extremely comfortable. The sound proof windows blocked out the early London buzz. Right across the road is Russell Square gardens so if you felt like a moment in the sun, you just had to cross the road. The Principle will be my go to from now on...

title: Out of this world
text: Booked a one night stay for my birthday in the Kimpton Fitzroy. The hotel itself is stunning, especially the public areas. We were greeted by Andrea on reception and were blown away by her wonderful service. She kindly upgraded us to a fabulous room, and I mean fabulous. There was even a personalised postcard in the room from Andrea wishing me a happy birthday. We dined in the main restaurant for breakfast the next day and the food was just as wonderful as the hotel. Overall a memorable stay and we will be back. Best S Cairns - 11th Dec

title: So bad we checked out early.
text: Very much an 'all hat and no cattle' experience. The hotel is wonderfully situated and the public spaces are gorgeous, which is why I've given it two stars, but it stops there. In particular, the front office staff deserve special mention, and for all the wrong reasons. If they were my staff, I'd be sending them off to hospitality re-education camp for an extended stay. Their unconscious bias is hampering their service recovery. This is an important issue and one that needs to be addressed ASAP. We were in London for a weekend at the end of a long holiday. We just wanted a place to sleep and, as we were two single women, we opted for a single room each. We foolishly assumed that the rooms would simply be a smaller version of a standard room - i.e. less floor area, smaller bed but everything else as advertised. Sadly, no

title: Great hotel with excellent staff
text: Had a great stay at the Principal. The hotel looks amazing, especially the public areas. The rooms were lovely and the shower was excellent, easy to use which i find is becoming a rarity in hotels these days. The staff are another highlight of the hotel, both friendly and helpful. Give that the hotel is having a 'soft-launch' and that there's still construction work going on I didn't notice any noise on my visit. Great hotel, great staff and I look forward to another visit soon.

title: Absolutely Amazing!
text: Had the pleasure of staying at this truly excellent hotel, every member of staff we encountered was excellent from check in to the bell boys! The level of service is impeccable and the hotel and the staff truly go out of their way to make your stay as memorable as possible. We were given the most amazing room, a junior suite which was out of this world so much so that we just didn’t want to leave! The standard of the accommodation was first class and my partner who travels extensively with work remarked that it was the nicest room that he had ever stayed in! The cleanliness of the room was excellent, the furniture and fittings in the room super luxurious. The extra touches like the complimentary tuck box made the stay extra memorable. We ate breakfast in Palm Court the staff were excellent and we were lucky enough to meet with the restaurant manager he was so informative and gave us the history of the hotel and treated us to a glass of champagne for our special occasion. All in all would stay here again in a heart beat! And would recommend to all who want an amazing hotel in a great location. Thank you Kinpton Fitzroy for an unforgettable stay We will be back!

title: Excellent on all fronts
text: Our first visit to this hotel - truly 5 stars. Amazing room and one of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept on! We were upgraded to a junior suite and it was superb. This is also the quietest room I’ve ever slept in in London with absolutely no noise from outside or inside a hotel despite a big function! Staff have all been friendly and so efficient. Breakfast in Neptune delicious with many healthier options - so nice to have a la Carter rather than eat too much at a buffet! Dinner at Neptune good but I ordered crayfish and not told it was DIY on the menu - a lot of effort for small reward! Main courses good. Tables for two a little close together so not v private. Overall a fantastic hotel and look forward to returning.

title: New hotel with a WOW factor
text: I took my wife to this beautiful hotel for a surprise anniversary weekend and from the time we walked in we were blown away by the stunning feel of the hotel. The doormen and reception staff are so friendly and yet very professional and made us feel very welcome. The interior of the hotel was so beautiful with marble pillars, stairs and walls. It was a real wow experience. Everything about our room was so tastefully done and even down to the little tuck box of goodies they give you made us love our room. We went to the bar, Fitz’s, which was probably the best bar I have been to in London. The service was great, the lighting and decor were beautiful and the cocktails were to die for. We had dinner in Neptune, a stunning restaurant. Dinner was delicious and so was the wine. It had a really cool vibe to it with great music and the staff seemed to be very happy. Next morning, we did a walk around the hotel and had a peep into Palm Court, a beautiful glass roofed atrium in the centre of the hotel which the staff told us is for Afternoon Tea service, It’s due to open in 2 weeks so we can’t wait to go back for that. All in all, a delightful experience. My wife was really happy and we both had a fab weekend. We will be back again very soon.

title: Outstanding!
text: Outstanding ! Fantastic building full of historical features! Great check in experience and friendly staff. We had a suite on the 5th floor nicely decorated and with a sense of details l have rarely seen in 5 stars hotels in Europe. Timeless yet modern decoration, huge bathroom and very comfortable mattress! Location is great : 15 mn walk from Euston station and 15 mn walk to Covent Garden!!Will comeback for sure! I found my home in London! Kudos to you guys!

title: Fantastic London Hotel
text: Stayed here over the new year for a couple of days, was welcomed by friendly concierge l and helped with luggage. We arrived early due to our flight and was checked in very quickly and efficiently. Our room was not ready which was fine, they stored our luggage and we started to explore London. The location is perfect located on Russell Square, 15 minute walk to Oxford Street and 2 minutes walk to Russel Square tube station. The hotel called us to say our room was ready which was fantastic. We arrived back to our luggage securely placed in our room and a lovely new year card and gift. The hotel has a lovely relaxed professional atmosphere, so warm and welcoming. The restaurant and bar facilities are excellent ranging from the palm court lounge area for drinks and light lunch/ dinner. The burrs bar and restaurant for club food. The Neptune’s restaurant for seafood and finally the Fitzs cocktail bar for some retro decor and a range of varied spirits and cocktails. The accommodation is immaculate and luxury accommodating all needs. All the staff are very friendly and helpful helping you with directions and knowledge of the hotel and area. A special thanks to “ Anna” who excelled in customer service and was always there to help. A special member of the team. Actually all staff from the doorman, concierge, reception, cocktail bar, palm court and housekeeping were all fantastic. We even met the hotel manager walking about and welcoming guests which lovely to see. Kimpton Fitzroy London - you have added two more regular guests to your fan club and we are going to tell everyone about you all. Again thank you for a special stay. Regards Euan & David

title: Amazing holidays in London
text: We couldn’t choose better hotel to stay during our holidays in London. All the staff made us feel like we were in our own home. Special thanks to Maria who have been really kind with all the family. For sure we will come back soon!

title: Just a dream of elegance and kindness!
text: I am totally in love with this hotel and can recommend it a 100%. We felt welcomed from the second we "entered" the first step of the hotels stairs (Including Walter and his very open and friendly appearance). The hotel (building) itself is very impressive and magnificent!The rooms are just a dream and very quiet.It's also located perfectly because small restaurants,supermarkets and the underground station are just a 2min walk away. The team is helpful with everything and very polite,no matter who you are.They don't make a difference between guests of "Expedia" or if you have booked directly. In other hotels one felt like a 2nd class but here it isn't the case. The hotel is decorated with so much love.Will definitely come back- with friends and family!Our stay was absolutely outstanding and we miss it already!Thank you so much for those fantastic days!

title: Weekend in London
text: We had a standard room on 2nd floor. The bed was fantastic, very comfortable and large. Shower/wet room was small - floor got fairly wet outside of shower. Not enough shelf space for toiletries (like most). Otherwise well equipped, though really ought to have proper coffee maker - basic tea and Nescafé instant. Good TV. Brilliant breakfasts - a la Carte - perhaps one of the very best in London. Staff were all really good, welcoming and very friendly. Interior of hotel is impressive, spacious and a great place to spend some time. Would definitely recommend.

title: Stunning hotel brilliant staff
text: Stayed for a joint birthday with my sister and our partners. The hotel is stunning in every way. Just 10 minutes walk from Euston and with the tube just around the corner the location was perfect. We were both given upgraded rooms on check in which was a nice touch for our birthdays. The rooms were truly gorgeous. We are at the buffet for breakfast which was fantastic although the tables are very close together. The bar is really something special in the evening although we struggled getting in it until later on after we had eaten. Will 100% be using this hotel as my go to place for future visits to London on either business or leisure.

title: Your search stops here. This is the one.
text: We stayed at The Principal last week for three nights. What a hotel - restored beautifully, such great detail and staffed with people who truly care for guests and clearly love their hotel. We took the Piccadilly line from Heathrow to Russell Sq, the hotel is minutes from the tube and a short 10 minutes walk to Covent Garden, Soho and the British Museum is across the square. Without exception all the staff were welcoming, genuine and professional - they love what they do and we felt so well cared for at every turn. Our room was perfect with the most comfortable bed and linens, a bright bathroom with a fantastic shower and the room had lots of guest friendly touches. And so quiet for a London hotel. We enjoyed great cocktails in Fitzs - what a classy bar with class service and had dinner on our last night in Neptune - decadent and delicious. A great hotel and one we will be returning to in October.

title: Not quite a first-class hotel, but well on its way to that status
text: There's a great deal to like at this hotel, a beautiful renovation of the old Russell Hotel. The staff is welcoming and professional, and clearly proud to show off the building, which has preserved many lovely architectural details. My room, which the hotel calls an Urban Double, was on the tight side for one person, and I think two guests would want to book in a different category. The room was nicely appointed, though like many small city hotel rooms, it had a bit too much furniture crammed in. Linens were of good quality. Nice touches included bottled water and a few snacks (popcorn and a chocolate bar) and a small refrigerator with a carton of milk for in-room coffee making. The casual restaurant, Burr & Co., seemed to be popular with people who work in the area as well as with hotel guests, and I could see why. The food was very good. I didn't have a meal at Neptune, the seafood restaurant, but it was the attractive site of a nightly wine hour for guests. My only surprise was that a hotel with so many positives lacked attention to some important details. One of those was small. When I looked out the window in my room, I saw that its rimmed ledge contained an empty plastic bottle and other debris -- nothing you had to look at all the time, but something I'd have thought would be cleaned up after the remodel. The bigger surprise was that anywhere from four to six large carts, containing linens (clean and used) and trash were left in the hallways throughout my stay.. I assumed the first day that they were there because room servicing was in progress, but they were still there at dinner time, after my return from the theatre that night, and very early the next morning, before room servicing began. As far as I could see, they remained there all day until late into the night. Not a huge deal, but not attractive, either, and something I've never seen even in hotels at lower price points. For this reason, I don't think I'd choose this hotel for a special-occasion stay, though I might do so for a general one.

title: Beautiful with exceptional service
text: I ended up rolling into The Principal at just gone midnight, exceptionally tired, bedraggled and angry as my previously booked hotel had mucked up the reservation and left me without a room for the night. From the second I arrived at reception I felt truly welcome and the staff reassured me and made an effort to sort a few issues with room booking very quickly (it’s tricky in most hotel systems to book in after midnight). This only took a couple of minutes and I was escorted to my room by a very nice and attentive staff member who checked I was ok before he left. The hotel itself has just been through a refit and as a result it is beautiful. My room was petit (probably the last room left in the hotel at that time) but it was very well appointed,felt comfortable and had some nice touches (and a big TV!). The bathroom and in particular the shower was exceptional. The placement of the hotel is excellent for covent garden which has lots of nice bars and restaurants on the doorstep and it is essentially next door to the Russell Square tube station entrance (one stop away from Kings Cross St Pancras).
