title: Not bad, interesting location
text: We stayed here one night when we went to London for a show. Got it on Hotwire for USD 100 and it was showing as a 4-star. This hotel is located in the financial district of London, which means it is very quiet on the weekends. Great for relaxing, bad it you want to shop or eat out close by. Room was usual British size (small) and featured a UK double bed. I kept waking up at night thinking my partner was going to roll out of the bed! There was a microwave and mini-fridge in the room, as well as a desk and small drawer stack. There was a decent sized closet but it was hard to get the door open as there was little clearance between the open door and the bed. Same situation with the bathroom door. Nice walk-in shower, just big enough for two. The sink tap in our room did not seem to have any cold water, but the shower was OK. Toiletries were decent, but we had to ask for more towels since there was only enough for one person in the room when we arrived. Bed linens were very usual- not a duvet. The hotel had breakfast and room service, as well as in-room internet but we did not use them. We would stay here again for another short visit but I think anything longer than a night or two would feel too cramped. I understand this is usually a corporate membership hotel so getting a room through normal sites is not always possible, but on weekends you can get in them on Hotwire.

title: Good sized room if a little dark
text: We stayed at this hotel after scouring reviews on this site for a reasonable quality, sensibly priced hotel in London and we were happy with our choice. The rooms were of a good size for London and comfortable, our only complaint being that the room was very dark, with the view from the window being of the building next door. There was no breakfast included in the price, but that wasn't too much of an issue. The hotel was a short walk from the nearest tube station making the rest of London easily accessible. I'd recommend this hotel for a short stay.

title: Great Location and Room!
text: I stayed at the hotel for about 02 nights. The location is great as it is very central and walking distance from some key tube stations such as Bank, Monument and Liverpool Street Stations. There is quite a bit of construction going on in the area which can be a bother for some only when walking to and from the hotel as otherwise, it does not cause any disturbance inside the hotel. The room fixtures were in very good condition and seemed well maintained. Room amenities were quite adequate, albeit missing a few small essentials such as bathroom slippers. Check-in and check-out was a breeze. The hotel's lobby is nicely designed and you get free coffee and tea along with work space. Also, there are free water bottles and water dispensers on each floor. The only issues I had during the stay was firstly, whenever the door of any of the rooms on my floor would close: the mechanism of the doors is such that if you do not hold them and shut them yourself, they close with a loud 'thud' which really disturbs your sleep. Secondly, the heating/cooling system in our room made a disturbing sound when we had it turned on which was also a bit of a nuisance. Now I am not sure if this is an issue with all the rooms or it was just our room. Apart from this, it was a great place to stay!

title: Great location and price.
text: My room was a bit small but overall very passAble. The location was awesome with the Cross Keyes pub next door and walking distance to Tower of London and the financial district. The main lobby was nice and had a wide selection of beverages and espresso during the week along with snacks at night. Overall a nice stay at a hotel that is quite average but has above average staff and location. I will note that the front desk was very helpful in making sure I got everything I needed, it was a nice add on to the service.

title: Great hotel for city center visit
text: The hotel is impeccable, rooms are very nice with loads of extras including excellent wifi, streaming possibilities to tv, well equipped bathroom and everything else you might need. One remark though: if you book a room, don't have breakfast included. Right next door is a great pub that serves excellent breakfast for less than half of what you pay in the hotel restaurant. Other than that no complaints. Easy access to tube (bank and monument) and busses. Location 3 mins off tower bridge so excellent location for walking to wherever you want to go. Staff is really helpful and friendly. Not the cheapest hotel but if you don't have to count pennies it is a real treat.

title: Everything great apart from the bed was quite hard
text: Location - Brilliant. Opposite Leadenhall Market and close to tubes Staff - Amazing and very helpful Facilities - Great Beds and Pillows - Not as comfortable as they should be Air Conditioning - Very welcome in the heat Cleanliness - Very good

title: Great experience
text: A wonderful place to stay in the heart of the city. Lots of great things to see and do. I would definitely stay there again without hesitation. I highly recommend the club quarters. Check it out the next time you're in London!

title: Business Trip
text: Room was lovely, very big and a separate bedroom. Breakfast was disappointing - very pricey - you could only order either the hot or the cold, you could not have both. I wanted Grapefruit juice and a Latte both of these were extra cost. Very central to the Business area and close by tube stations

title: Excellent facilities
text: Enjoyed stay, met all of our expectations (had booked 3 rooms) for our party. Friendly helpful staff, very clean pleasant surroundings. Loved the fact we could have hot beverages as we wished and also bottled water. Well placed for transport and other amenities. Would definitely choose to stay here again and recommend the hotel.

title: Stay in August
text: carpet and amenities look old and didn't get a luxury feel. Not sure whether I will recommend for family vacation. Gym is not properly equipped. Overall stay was good because of business travel. Don't feel to bring in family.

title: Great Hotel. Strange Bar
text: We stayed at Club Quarters a few weekends ago and we were really impressed by the hotel. Very classy, clean and the reception staff were lovely. We headed into town for dinner and when we came back we wanted to have s quick nightcap at the bar/restaurant with our family. When we entered the staff seemed confused that we wanted to have a drink and we were told many times we could NOT sit at any tables as only for eating. As my partner was at the bar I sat at a table in the far end of the restaurant to wait. I was immediately told to not sit there, why?! I wasnt in the way of them setting up for breakfast. A sweet younger girl at the bar suggested we sat on the bar stools but still didnt stop the strange looks from the other staff..... very weird! Other than the most unwelcoming bar I've ever been in, in a hotel the hotel was fabulous and we would stay again ..... but perhaps just to sleep!!

title: Amazing service
text: Amazing staff, arrived and got checked in and we had a problem with are room the staff resolved this straight away and went above and beyond to make us happy will stay here again very welcoming thank you to the guy on reception

title: Good Value
text: I stayed here over the weekend which means the area of the city is quieter than in the week. The hotel is in a good location 5 minute walk from Bank or Monument tube stops. Clean, efficient and decent size room for London. Totally meets your requirements for a short stop over in a busy city.

title: Great location for the city
text: Not your usual "full facilities" hotel but plenty here to please. Superb welcome at the Automated front desk. Comfortable room albeit a courtyard view, so to speak. Great TV... 50 inches plus. The fitness room is more than adequate for purpose consisting of 2 running machines, and 4 or 5 other cardio machines , plus free weights. I like the free water machines on each floor particularly at this time of year. And the foyer contains a free bar consisting of soft and warm drinks plus fruit and other healthy snacks. A very nice feature. Located right on the "Square Mile " with a range of bars, pubs and restaurants (including Leadenhall Market just across the road) within 5 minute walk, including 5 bars and pubs within 30 yards.

title: Great Job
text: This hotel did the job of an over night stay in the city very well. It is what it is - a room only - cheap deal for London. But pleasantly surprised at the room size, cleanliness, friendly faces throughout our stay and perfect location (for our needs). Nice touch with the free refillable water bottles. Great decor and good shower too!

title: OK staying
text: I have been to this hotel only once. The location is perfect if your destination is London City (everything is located nearby). Breakfast is poor but if you add the Argentinian menu, then it becomes interesting. Rooms are kind of old fashion, but if you need just a bed to sleep with free wi-fi, then you would be satisfied.

title: Mostly for business
text: I was with my wife for long weekend. The key point is the location. It's in the city central (business quarter) there is 3 subway lines close to the hotel. Super cleaness moder style but our room was small. Great Argentinian restaurant in the hotel. There is no staff the reception is very interesting. High prices.

title: Great location and nice room
text: The hotel staff did a great job resolving issues with my stay and I will not only stay at this hotel again, but will also recommend it to my work colleagues. The location is great and the free coffee snacks are a plus.

title: Reasonable size room, great location
text: The room was more like a studio apartment which provides almost everything we need. Size of the room is reasonable. Price is not cheap but given such a good location you cannot expect it to me much lower.

title: Great hotel
text: Paid for the club room and got upgraded for free on arrival, the room was clean, spacious and comfortable. Location was excellent and the free wifi was very good. Will definitely recommend. Didn't have to check out till 12 so we didn't have to rush. A very pleasant stay.

title: Basic hotel, high price, be careful of the deposit they ask you!
text: Visited this hotel in july with my wife for one night only. Nice reception with 2 employees working, fast check-in but got asked my card for 20£ deposit that i never got back even if the customer service told me to be patient (1 month and half is already passed!!!). Very old lifts, corridors and also rooms! Clean bathroom, comfy bed, tired furniture, dirty kettle, nice apple idock and nice tv! Good position.. Just 3 minutes walking from liverpool street station! In conclusion, a basic hotel perfect for a night stay or 2.. I just cant get over the 20£ they stole from me! Price is high anyway!

title: Excellent stay!
text: Great location, wonderful service, clean rooms, soft comfortable beds, Gauchos food was delicious, nice lobby, reservation and check in processes were smooth and efficient, lobby snack and drink supply was pleasant

title: Visiting London? CQ near Trafalgar Square is well located.
text: My wife and I spent 5 days here in February this year. The staff checked our bags in as we arrived too early to check in and we had the day to explore London. The rooms were very clean, good size and we found the staff to be friendly. Maybe at this time of year, London is quieter than normal but we found the room to be very quiet with not a lot of street noise audible. Location can't be beat as it is a 1 minute walk to the Thames pedestrian bridge, 2 min walk to a major tube stop, and just down the block from Trafalgar square. Lots of good restaurants, museums, and shows in this area all within walking distance. I would recommend this for couples and small families who want to explore London. Cheers!

title: Week in London
text: CQ Hotel, Gracechurch is well located, accessible from tube, by bus and everything important is in walking distance. Staff is friendly communicative and polite. Hotel is nice and tidy.Fittness room could be bit bigger and newer but its also ok.

title: Excellent service.
text: Stayed at this hotel July 12 to 14. RECEPTION staff were supportive and sympathetic in helping to locate tickets for the Michael Buble concert. The tickets should have been at the hotel on the Friday (July 12) . They arrived on the Saturday, a few hours before the concert. In the middle of a Mediterranean spell of weather, the room had fantastic air con and a very comfortable bed. The hotel is well placed for a few days in central London.

title: Well located and excellent value
text: My Wife and I stayed in this well located hotel because of its proximity to the DLR which brought us from London City Airport in 22 minutes. We loved the location. The room was very good although a bit small. We initially mistook the en-suite for a wardrobe! We could have done with two pillows each but everythong else was perfect. We had a superb lunch in Gauchos and would definitely stay here next time.

title: Great value and location
text: Great value in a great location with good hotel services. Easy access to stores, transportation. Very quick check in and check out process. Practical lobby. Room very spacious for London standard. Easy internal access in the hotel. Friendly staff.

title: Great hotel
text: Booked this hotel as a secret hotel and have not been disappointed. Arrived early on a saturday morning after travelling on the overnight train from Scotland. Asked to leave our luggage but were told we could get into our room as it was ready which was fab! Room is of decent size, bathroom very modern, everything very clean. I like the offer of an exercise machine brought to your room free of charge. Other hotel facilities appear very good. Didnt use the restauarant or room service but room service looks great - u can order any kind of food (from a list) and it is delivered from outside restaurants. This hotel is in a good location to visit the Tower of London & other attractions. Close to tube stations, however, be aware they often carry out maintenance at the weekend so some lines are closed. All in all I would definitely recommend this hotel and would stay again!

title: Fun Weekend
text: A very pleasant comforting stay. The reception staff were very accommodating and informative. The hotel was first and ideally situated for our purposes. I especially liked the internal door into the excellent Crosse Keys pub next door

title: Not the best hotel to stay in
text: Not the best hotel, that I have visited. The lobby and the service there is great. But beyond not good. From the room I had, I could hear everything from outside of the door into my room. They have a shared iron solution, which do not work. They were not to be found In the locker room, so ironing was not possible in a hotel that is In the business area of London. The Continental breakfast was a ok, but the service was poor. There were not to much focus on the customers which is bad. They spend their time on typing what every room had for breakfast-find another solution.

title: Excellent
text: great location - a few minutes walk from bank station, clean, friendly and helpful staff, a very relaxed atmosphere, perfect for business related trips or a city break, also had a lovely restaurant downstairs, Gaucho, which did breakfast

title: Super location, no fuzz and friendly staff
text: Spent a weekend in Oct 18, really nice and very well located hotel. Clean and well equipped room, cold purified water on floor, easy check in, very friendly staff and no fuzz, whatsoever. Able to check in before noon, and with small supermarket and alternative breakfast place within 50 metres, 400 m to Monument underground and Liverpool Street station and Underground maybe perhaps 700 m away, you have easy access to all of London, strongly recommended!

title: Perfectly located - great 2 night stay!
text: My partner and I stayed at this hotel for 2 nights in August for our birthdays. We had a great deal through ebookers with a promotional code as we used the ebookers iPhone app! The hotel is perfectly located

title: Excellent value,very clean and comfortable,helpful staff
text: I booked this hotel very last minute online after being given a free theatre ticket for last Friday night in London's West End.I didn't want to spend too much,but didn't want anywhere dubious,as I was meeting friends for the theatre but travelling back to ,and staying overnight at the hotel alone. I chose it from reviews on here (as I have in the past),and once again I was very pleased indeed with my experience. The hotel caters mainly for business guests Mon-Thurs,and as such is very modern and appointed with a myriad of technical and organisational facilities,and is smartly and tastefully furnished.There is a self check-in option on arrival,but i chose to deal with the two charming members of staff that were on duty during my stay,and found them very pleasant indeed. My single room was not overlarge,but perfectly adequate with double (and very comfy) bed,plenty of hanging space and dressing table/desk surfaces.The bathroom had a large shower (no bath),plenty of towels considering I was a single traveller,and everywhere was spotless. Monument tube station is less than 5 minutes away.The only negative,which has been mentioned in previous reviews so I was fully aware of it,is that on Saturdays/Sundays the area is a bit of a ghost town with all shops and restaurants closed.I could have requested breakfast delivered to my room,but chose to get the tube into 'town' to eat . Great value,excellent for a not too expensive break,and will definitely book again next time I'm off to London!

title: Great location in heart of London
text: This isn’t my first visit and again, club quarters met my needs very well. Great location for business meetings, a short walk from Bank tube station and loads of places to eat locally to suit all budgets. Service for breakfast was overly fussy and officious but this didn’t detract from what I wanted.Rooms comfortable with plenty of room to work, drinks readily available and swift & easy check in/out

title: We in London
text: We stay in this hotel last we. Very good position near Monument underground, clean and silent in the we. Free service of water coffee and tea. The family rooms are large with all optionals included. Wi fi service

title: Friday Night
text: The automated check-in process was made easier by the help of a member of staff. Hotel common areas are attractive but small. If you wish to participate in a "complimentary glass of wine" then this needs to be taken between 5pm and 6pm - not a minute later or you will be met by blank stares from the staff. I stayed in a suite which had the feel of a 1970s office with a bed in it - thanks to large brown wood room dividers and shelving and the two massive conference room style flat screen TVs. No quick shoe clean kit and the iron kept haemorrhaging water all over my shirt. Slept well though..

title: Second great stay. Perfect location.
text: Our room this time was larger as the hotel kindly upgraded us and we were also able to have our room well before check in time which was perfect. The rooms are very comfortable and the hotel is so quiet at night. There is free tea, coffee, water and cans of drinks along with snacks and fruit available in reception. All the staff we came across with very helpful and polite. We love the location of this hotel. We walked everywhere but Bank tube station is close by if you prefer to get the underground.

title: Pleasany
text: The staff were very polite and helpful, especially the restaurant staff. The accommodation is slightly dated, though still produced an extremely comfortable stay. The hotel is located very close to some important sites such as the Bank of England and the underground is only a few minutes away. I would recommend this hotel.

title: Not for me
text: As I say in the title this hotel is not for me. I booked two rooms for a Saturday night in town with the family. The hotel reception is so small that when we arrived we had to keep moving during our registration in order to let people in and out. The young man who checked us in was polite and in fact checked us in early, thank you. We were then told that we would actually be on two different floors, thank goodness for mobile phones. After registration we then had to dodge the pillars in order to reach the lifts, and went to our respective rooms. Although there were messages everywhere stating that some refurbishments were in progress, I did not expect wall paper hanging from walls, open wall linings and ripped, ragged carpets everywhere. Especially having paid full price for the rooms. Bedroom one, my bedroom, on the small side but did have a double bed with two bedside tables. Had to move the office chair so my partner could walk around the bed to reach bathroom etc. small but adequate bathroom, only one set of shower gel etc for a double room. When will these places learn there will be two people in the room. Bedroom two, my sister in laws room, was classed as a double and had a double bed, but could only get to one side of the bed. Again the bathroom was on the small side. No instructions were given for the heating and air con and this resulted in a very hot uncomfortable night in bed, having to open windows to breath. On checking out the hotel very kindly locked our cases away, as we had a later train to catch, but on return the room was opened and I was told "your cases are in there somewhere, you can find them". Good job I am honest because I think I could have walked out with any three cases. Would I recommend this hotel? NO

title: So la la
text: Stayed for two nights. The good things first: the coffee they offer in the lobby is really good and for free. Likewise wifi is free in your room. The room 618 was rather small and furnished in early 80's style. The bathroom looks pretty oldish and used. Everything seems clean (but a carpet in a hotel room always feels iiihhhh). The bed was very good, both mattress and cover. Had a window that could be opened to the backside.

title: Fab find in London
text: This hotel was in the business district quite on the weekends but you had two options for the underground bank or monument both close large room coffee machine down in foyer it had everything you need lovely staff we stayed at a few places much more expensive but this place was the best we will come back 😊

title: Business visit
text: Very good hotel, clean, neat and adequate amenities. I appreciate their innovation for recycled water bottles to refill from common filter. Staff is extremely polite and helpful. I would prefer to stay there next time.

title: A well located hotel with great staff
text: The hotel is only a 7 minute walk from Bank and Monument tube stations. It's also opposite Leadenhall Market which is a fun place to visit for food, drink and shopping. Please note the Market is closed at the weekend as are quite a lot of the surrounding restaurants. However as it was so easy to jump on the tube this wasn't a problem and the upside is that it also makes it a quiet location over the weekend. The staff were very friendly and helpful and we were touched that the General Manager introduced himself to us and told us more about the history of the building.

title: Very satisfied
text: The hotel and rooms are clean if a little small. The staff are polite and helpful and the location is great. I got a good deal for a 3 night stay and would definitely stay again for the same price and would recommend it just for the location.

title: It's a good business hotel, a bit worn down
text: Location: Conveniently in the City, close to where I work / the Tower of London. Staff: Friendly. Rooms: The hotel is a bit warm on the inside. The room actually has a window that can open (unique in London!) for fresh air. However, the room itself was a bit smelly, humid and dark. It was quite big for a London room, had free wifi and a proper bathroom. The bed was big and comfortable. Breakfast: No breakfast was served. However, during the day you can get snacks, coffee, cold water and various sodas from the lobby. Overall: Nice place for a night in the city, don't expect too much.

title: Overnight Stay
text: Great location for business district but also St Pauls and other tourist attractions. The rooms have everything you need and very clean. complimentary tea and coffee in the lounge area and bottled spring water on all the floors

title: Not the best, not the worst hotel...
text: Great location, nice perks (free bottled water, free variety of coffees and teas on the lounge and iPads to borrow...), but small and dark rooms, smelly bathrooms and dust everywhere. The cleaning has to be improved, I mean it.

title: Decent Place to be when away from Home
text: Neat & Clean Well lit room. They serve Snack in the evening along with cold drinks/coffee. Rooms are small in size, but overall fine for a single person stay. They clean the room almost daily base and are all good

title: Service and amenities are useless
text: The service at this hotel is just not good enough. As a lone female travelling all day on a Sunday for a business meeting on the Monday, I arrived at 5pm, really tired and just wanted to relax in my room with some room service. I was checked in, in 30 seconds. That should be good right? But it didn't feel good at all. They just didn't care. I was given no information on breakfast (not included in price) or the hotel amenities and I wasn't even offered a morning newspaper! The room was average but I actually felt like I was staying in a Travelodge for twice the price. Bearing in mind London City is dead on a Sunday evening and nothing is open, this hotel only offered a vending machine and a water machine which I had to find myself. And as for room service offered, its extortionate, with a steak sandwich being offered at £15 (fillet steak £40!) This hotel is cheap in every way other than the room service and the staff are uninformative and unhelpful. I'd recommend you book another 4 star in the City.

title: current refurbishments a put off
text: stayed here recently and not happy should have been told there were refurbishments going on before we booked the room, if i had known would not have booked it, the lift was a pain to use, staff were accommodating to an extent, but would not recommend at the moment to stay because the refurbishments were a disappoint them, so i can recommend you not to stay until the refurbishments etc, have been completed ,

title: Good Value, Great location.
text: The club quarters offers good value rooms right in the heart of the city. They are on the small side, and the hotel doesn't offer all of the "extras" but if your after a clean hotel, with comfortable beds, and friendly helpful staff look no further.

title: Excellent hotel in great City location
text: This hotel offers a very nice, spacious and well-designed room. Excellent workspace and lighting. The check-in and check-out procedure were among the fastest I've experienced, but not at the cost of friendliness or politeness. The location is close to the Tube and to the financial district. Good room rate at the weekend.

title: Great Locations but nothing much else
text: Club Quarters hotels in London have great locations but very little else to offer. I have stayed in them all. The rooms are small and shabby and the service is generally poor. The exception to this is Lincolns Inn Field which is a fairly new build with very pleasant staff. Their standard prices are very expensive for what is on offer.

title: A good place to stay un London
text: It's very comfortable. It' s placed near metro and bus stop. At night there isn't noise . We stayed in a suite for the family that is very specious The bed is very good , you can relax after a hard day walking.

title: Nothing good about this place, except the good location for business people
text: This is my second stay in this hotel and I have had the same negative image in both stays. The location is really good if you are on a business trip. However, nothing else is good! First of all, when you enter, the rooms do not give a clean image. They look as if they have been used for xxx billion times, they are old and do not look clean. I am not a very meticulous person, but if you were to examine the room/bed/bathroom in detail, you could see various problems/dirts and etc (for instance my bath was not very clean). The bathroom is also far away from being a good and a clean place. If you will stay in this hotel, know that you will be staying in small rooms and this won't be the most elegant/pleasant experience you will have.. Also, they air conditioner/heater does not work properly. And the kettle I had in my room contained rusty/muddy water in it, let alone using it, I could not even open it:)! Sometimes you may get good weekend rates, so they may be appealing, if you want sth. very average for a good price.

title: Nothing To Write Home About
text: I visited with my wife for our anniversary. It was a one night stay. The woman working the reception area could have been a bit friendlier, but she was not rude. The room was smaller than I had expected. We've stayed in similarly priced hotels in New York City that were almost twice as large. It was clean. I appreciated the novel, travel guide, and language aids available in the room. Overall, good idea for the brand, but could be better executed. Communication of services is also minimal. The gentleman who helped us retrieve our luggage at the end of our trip was very friendly and upbeat.

title: London stay
text: Great location, close to tube, and walking distance to some sights.Some shops and restaurants close at weekends.Clean room, adequate facilities.Coffee and snacks available in reception. Water available on room floors.Helpful staff

title: Club Quarters Hotel Gracechurch Street
text: Had a great stay: Room was clean, shower facilities etc were clean. Bed was comfortable, had a good nights sleep. Hotel is conveniently located close to all London nightlife but not in the thick of it. Room was very well equipped and maintained.

title: Terrible customer service
text: I made a booking for a 9 night stay and needed to get this amended due to a trip to be taken in the middle. I contacted the reservations desk by email direct and was advised promptly (and quite rudely) to cancel the booking and make two separate new bookings at a much higher rate given the passage of time. Given I have not even arrived at the hotel yet, and knowing this is the level of customer service I might expect, I have decided to avoid and stay elsewhere altogether.

title: Tiny rooms, friendly staff
text: I'm moving to another hotel because this place is WAY too small for me to stay in for three weeks. So to be clear I have a different perspective. The closet in this place is smaller than the tiny closet I had in my Tokyo hotel years ago, and smaller than any I have seen in Europe. The microwave and small fridge which make this a "suite" are shoved behind the desk next to the small loveseat. There is no tub, only a shower, and the bathroom itself is fairly small. Room service options are limited as are options to use your microwave given there isnt an abundance of grocers in the main City. Probably fine for a night but not for an extended stay. And not really a business hotel any more than Grange, or even Express by Holiday Inn. If price is much better, stay here, but check other hotels first as I would not recommend this place even for a day compared to others at which I have stayed (Andaz, Grance City, Grange Tower Bridge, Sheraton Park Lane, etc)

title: Decent Hotel
text: Its a decent hotel for short stay. The food is good. Staff is courteous and friendly, It is centrally located and near to Bank and Monument station which connects most of the areas. The only drawback is the shops nearby closes early and no store including restaurants are open after 7-8 pm.

title: Good value, convenient, well equipped.
text: An international chain offering quality facilities without frills for business travellers we came over a weekend because it was well sited and there was a good deal. A short walk from Bank and other tube stations. An easy stroll down past the Monument over the bridge to Southwark and the vast array of entertainments and pastimes of the south bank. Not far either from Whitechapel etc. Has the attached Goucho steak restaurant but there are other places to feed and water not far off. If you want the basics there is a wetherspoons next door. We shall use this place again.

title: Coco
text: Good location,famous leadenhall market transportation very convenient friendly staff clean room, free wifi coffee and snacks water dispensers in each floor was awesome, definitely coming back. From London

title: Good hotel
text: We stay there for a week end in London! The location is perfect 3 different metro stop near by the hotel (300 to 500 meters). The room was comfortable, clean and very well furnished (USB hub, everything you need for media connection , free wifi ) and you have complimentary water and coffee all day long witch is really a plus! If you fancy a diner or a cocktail you can go to the gaucho restaurant witch on the lower ground floor of the hotel! Cant say anything about the food as we didn't eat there but we tried the bar and it was really nice cocktails and the bartender was really good at his job and really friendly ! Kudo! I am working in hospitality for many years now and when something is good i really like to say it and this hotel is! Would recommend

title: Much lower standards than St Paul's
text: Disinterested reception staff upon arrival and later when I asked for information, dirty desk top in room, tired and depressing atmosphere. Management needs to pay this place and its staff some attention!

title: Vacation trip
text: Location was perfect for our visit. Easy walk to the things we wanted to see (tower bridge and nearby). The hop on hop off bus picks up near bridge. Takes you most anywhere a typical tourist wants to see

title: Mediocre but handy location
text: Stayed here for a night out with my wife. Didn't really use much of the hotel as had reservations in the city. The room at first glance is nice and modern. But the more you look around the more issues become noticeable. The bathroom is tiny. The only floor space is enough room for one person to stand. In fact there's more space in the shower. The shower curtain looked more at home in a cheap motorway hotel and the towels were tatty and worn. The rest of the room has all you would expect. The desk however was the issue. It's placed so close to the bed that the desk chair blocks you walking round to the other side of the bed. But there isn't much space in the room so there wasn't anywhere else to put it. During the night my wife would have to hop across the bottom of the bed in order to get to the toilet without tripping over the chair. Also the signs to and from the lift aren't the greatest and I had to double back a few times as I completely missed the signs. The above aside the room was everything you need. The location is great. But I've stayed elsewhere for the same or less price and had better quality room.

title: Great Staff, Top Location, Lovely Room
text: Awesome Location for Work and City Trip. The Hotel is located near to Monument or Bank Station so you can get to the most popular Places in London really fast. Room was clean, Showers were big. The Staff at the Check in desk was very friendly and courteous. We're looking forward to the next time.

title: Big room and comfy bed
text: Big room, comfy bed, great little kitchenette and powerful shower. Great transport links and close to local bars and restaurants. Great for a long and short stay and value for money in centre of London.

title: Love it !
text: I love every feature of this hotel, the lobby is nice , the room is lovely, reviewer said room is compact but i found out mine is spacious! (Not sure if they did upgrade and did not mention to me upon check in) Bed is super comfy, there is also a small pantry area which is nice. I love it they place a complimentary water dispenser on each floor. So sad that i only stayed for 1 night as need to catch flight to Stockholm but definitely will strongly consider this hotel again when revisit London. Cheers!

title: GRUBBY GRUBBY GRUBBY
text: Stayed for one night and NEVER again its a run down sub travel lodge I was moved FOUR times before I got a half decent room! even then it was worn grubby and not at all worth what they were charging AVOID IT !!

title: Last minute Overnight stay
text: Lovely to receive a complimentary glass of wine after arriving late from an unacceptable hotel. The was no breakfast offered but a few complimentary items we offered. The room was clean and comfortable Good location.

title: Not a bad place to stay
text: This hotel is very handy for the city of london as liverpool st station is down the road,nice quainte hotel,our room was very hot but the bed was massive and very comfortable which more than made up for the non view that we had,there is a witherspoons next door which served good food

title: one night stop over
text: Arrived at this hotel very late and managed to check-in the hotel restaurant closed before 10.30 which for London i thought was kind of strange, but the staff on reception directed me to a nearby eatery The room itself was very nice, looked modern with a sense of old style decor, the bed offered a very good nights sleep and felt refreshed in the morning.

title: Great option near Tower of London
text: Club Quarters provided everything we look for in a hotel room: good value, great service, clean, and close to attractions. Room was spacious and comfortable. Hotel is located near a business district, so there are plenty of shops and restuarants nearby and it's only a 10 min walk to Tower of London/London Bridge. Super close to 20 Fenchurch, Sky Gardens are not to be missed.

title: Good location, poor service
text: We stayed for one night at the hotel in June, it is in a good location for walking around London with the underground nearby. The hotel is located in the banking quarter so unfortunately the local shops are closed at the weekend though not far from restaurants and bars. Check in was poor with one person manning an online check in service and running between groups of people. It lacked the personal feel and welcome you usually get when checking in. Check out is the same, an online system, though quick and easy it's not the same as speaking with someone. We would use the hotel again.

title: Noisy, stains, squeaky floor...
text: I stayed in a small double, size was fine and decor is somewhat colourful and modern. Bathroom (shower only/no bath) is an adequate size and clean. There is a decent work desk and a proper adjustable desk chair. I was able to check in early but a lot of business travellers check out early so this is generally expected. It took ages to get through to hotel to confirm whether a room was available earlier than check in time, it also took ages to get a response to a call to front desk. The desk chair was stained as did one of the bath towels (stains on it) and the bedroom floor squeaked horribly, not so bad for me but felt for people in room below as it was difficult to avoid. The place was noisy with constant slamming of doors (soft close??) and there was a really loud humming noise near my room which required ear plugs to sleep through. Get the basics right! Receipt provided on check in was VAT exclusive so I had to waste time in the morning getting a VAT inclusive receipt. I would not seek to stay here again unless stuck..

title: Old and dull
text: Spent 2 nights in this hotel. The bedroom is quite dark and the furniture looks old. The bathroom is small, actually there is no bath, just a shower with a white plastic curtain. The room was clean but don not excpect too much for this price. Guess this is very convenaint for business men coming into the city. The city on weekend is a dead city, everything is shut, but it is quite conveniant to get to central london, apart from the fact the the connexion between Bank and Monument stations are closed, so you have to walk a bit more to get to bank station. The hotel is quite so you can rest but the TV is rubbish, big old TV without satellite aprt from CNN. There is no mini bar neither....

title: Very good hotel
text: Clean, large bed, quiet and large room. We will return two times in 2019. We are french and We don't want another hotel. Well placed in London for visits and shopping. Very discreet and quiet.Perfect hotel for us.

title: unfairly expensive
text: The rooms are very small and not very clean.. the breakfast is very poor, only tea, awfull coffee , some fruits jam.. the staff is not so nice and they couldn't give us clear information about many things and also the couldn't recommand us anything at all.. the small room was also noisy. I found the price of the room very very expensive, and also we had to pay for the electricity charger.

title: Good enough
text: Pretty basic budget hotel but the location is really good, 10 min from Victoria station and 5min from Pimlico station, The bus stop just outside, Nr 24 will take you to Tottenham, Leicester etc and it runs 24H. The hotel itself is pretty basic, the rooms are quite small,and the walls are thin. But the room was clean, beds comfy and the water hot so nothing to complain about really. The rooms were cleaned every day too. Reception staff were friendly and helped us, unfortunately there was no elevator at the time but I guess the exercise was good too. All in all a good place to stay for the money.

title: Cant complain, Perfect for a short stay.
text: I stayed here for a weekend and price were very reasonable comparing to other hotel in this area. the location was very convenient for a night out in central London and also for the sightseeing. you get the bus no 24 right across from the hotel which takes you to central London and Victoria underground was only 10 minutes walking distance. rooms were bit small but I guess that's standard size for central London but very clean. Breakfast was basic continental but you have an option to buy cocked English breakfast which wasn't to bad. Staffs were quiet helpful. Overall I had a wonderful stay at Huttons and will recommend.

title: A small hotel, with small rooms and a little overpriced
text: I stayed in this hotel towards the end of November 2007 with my partner. On booking I was looking for a budget hotel with 3 stars and a suitable location to get to the centre of London with ease. On reading the write up on the website I thought I had found th ideal place. However on arriving at the hotel I was a little dissapointed with what greeted me. The room was tiny. A double room with just enough room to walk around the edge of the bed. The ensuite bathroom was an obvious add on as this room looked to have been non-ensuite initially. The ensuite itself was tiny too. Very plasticy and prefab feeling to it. My partner likened it to being in a bathroom on a plane! The shower had barely enough room and the water was only luke warm and given it being the end of November, it wasnt the best shower I'd ever had. The breakfast was basic to say the least. Dried up sausages, passable scrambled egg, cold beans, and the coffee/tea machine had packed in not to mention the watered down "fresh" orange juice. All I can say on a positive note is that the hotel staff were friendly and the rooms were clean. Howver given the facilities offered and the standard of the rooms I am strugging to see how the hotel has achieved a 3-star rating. I had a glance at the tarrif at the main desk while I was checking in. I booked online and paid £60 per night and I am pleased I did, as to pay at the desk it was £100 per night. Now I am afraid for that much it encroaches into Premier Travel Inn territory, and my next visit to London will probably end with me staying in Premier Travel Inn to atleast guarantee the standard of accomodation I am accustomed to.

title: very basic accommodation, pretty clean, good location
text: dont expect much

title: London weekend
text: Spent a weekend here and found hotel very clean and comfortable. Continental breakfast with the option of a cooked breakfast for an extra £5. 20 min walk to Buckingham palace, but pimlico tube only 3 mins away. Well worth a visit.

title: Fantastic value for money, position hospitality
text: The hotel was great we could drop our bags off in a secure place before and after we checked in/out so didn't have to carry suitcases around London. The room was plenty big enough for the three of us 1 double 2 singles very clean through out. Breakfeast was continental but you could help yourself to plenty of what was on offer you pay £5 extra for a full English. The staff were all very helpful and polite. The hotel is a short walk from victoria train station. Well worth a visit very resonable price. Would stay again 10/10

title: Good location
text: I found the hotel to be very clean. The room was small but nice. The bathroom was tiny but clean. Breakfast was ok. The location was really good. We walked to Buckingham Palace and the London Eye. There is no AC. We had a room at the front of the hotel so it seemed a bit noisy at times, but then it was hot outside so our balcony door was open. There is a security door in the lobby, so only guests have access to hotel rooms. Victoria station is nearby, and there is a small shopping center inside for cheap eats and anything else you may need.

title: 10 out of 10
text: We were very impressed with Hutton's Hotel. Everybody was so friendly and helpful as soon as we arrived. The room had everything we needed and plenty of room for three people comfortably. We were also very impressed with the selection at breakfast .We would defiantly stay there again. Thank you Hutton's Hotel for a most enjoyable stay.

title: Rather ordinary
text: Tiny rooms, bathroom comparable size to that on a cruise ship and dirty bed linen. Average breakfast - full english aparently, but no bacon. Lift that only goes up, you have to walk down the stairs - no big deal but annoying when you have luggage to haul. Good location a short walk to either Victoria Station or Pimlico.

title: Good hotel
text: I found the hotel clean with friendly staff. I was comfortable and the hotel was value for money. I found the breakfast was value for money. The hotel is close to Victoria and Pimlico tube stations. The surroundings around the hotel was convenient with many eating out premises and shops providing quality and value for money this includes Pubs.

title: Lack of sleep
text: For the money this place was absolutely fine. However I had the misfortune to get a room in the basement where,unbeknownst to me, the breakfast facilities were. I was woken up at 2.45 in the morning by what sounded like someone preparing the breakfast room. This lasted for approximately 35 mins and as was going to be up at 6am i had difficulty getting back to sleep! Will make sure I'm upstairs next time!

title: Clean, budget bed for the night.
text: Good location on 24 bus route. This was really what influenced my decision to stay here. Walking distance 15 mins to Victoria station. Classic Belgravia terrace conversion. More or less, a very small room with a small double bed, a wardrobe, and an ensuite shower room. Although clean, it was too basic for me to be comfortable. Polite young man on desk did at least, provide me with a chair for the room, when I asked. Nowhere to 'put things down'. One bedside table, so a problem for things like my watch, glasses, water, phone, alarm clock, book, soap bag. Nowhere for towels. Laminate floors - very noisy clattering from floor above. This, plus persistent 'drip' noise all night, kept me awake. Small window to rear. No view to speak of. I think next time I would be better suited to a travelodge.

title: Would have been okay for 33% of what they charge
text: Nothing wrong with this hotel except the price. Why would anyone pay GBP 75 to 99(!) for this hotel when others are three times better for the same price? I'll be back when the tariff is GBP 30. But it's a beautiful street. And the breakfast was nice.

title: Small rooms, good place
text: Situated close to Victoria railway station, however quit silent place. Very small room, It was not possible fully open rest room door, bed didn't let do that... Breakfast very limited choise, however it was my first time in London so I couldn't compare if it is typical for London or not.

title: Great Budget Hotel
text: We just spent nine nights at Huttons Hotel in London. It is a budget hotel--small, clean rooms, small shower/bath facilities. The staff were friendly and helpful. Breakfast each morning was good, but not varied. The location was perfect: near Victoria Station and many small, ethnic restaurants. I recommend Huttons for students and others who want a non-fancy hotel.

title: NOT A GOOD STAY.
text: The room,bedding and bathroom were clean- and that was the only positive aspect to the hotel .The bedroom floor sloped and had laminate flooring .The bed was on rollers so it moved every time I turned over..The shower pressure was so weak only a teprid trickle came out of the shower head .The curtain covered less than half the window so I was woken early by daylight streaming into the room..Breakfast was inadequate and of poor quality. Never Again!

title: vicjan
text: Comfortable if staying overnight. Adequate sleeping space, could do with somewhere other than the bed to sit on. Really needs some hanging space for clothes. Other than that, Staff were polite, helpful and friendly. English breakfast was value for money. Location was brilliant and bus and trains were all within walking distance.

title: Theatre trip
text: The hotel was in a perfect location on a quiet street. I was a bit apprehensive of staying at this hotel after reading the bad reviews, but i had nothing to worry about. Room and bathroom were very clean , Room cleaned daily,nice clean bedding and towels on arrival. Helpful and pleasent staff (reception and dining room staff) It's just a 5 minute walk from victoria station and i would recommend getting the tour bus for sightseeing and getting around london. (bus stop at victoria station) they have a luggage room and safes to store luggage after checking out. I would certainly stay at this hotel again

title: Low Cost for Area
text: The Huttons Hotel is more economical than the majority of hotels in the area. Our room was small even by European standards. Unfortunately the noise level in the room was fairly high. The complimentary continental breakfast is just that—toast, coffee, beans and fruit juice. Full hot breakfasts are available at an additional cost. Overall the hotel has a great location and is reasonably priced with paralleled services and amenities.

title: More like a hostel
text: We booked this at the last minute and it served our needs but we probably wouldnt visit again. It was a tiny room which was too warm and no air con. In fact no mod cons at all really. Advertised as continental breakfast but more of a do it yourself toast bar. No bar or restaurant but close to both. This would be ideal for students or overnight visitors looking for no frills accommodation, although it wasnt a no frills price.

title: Great Hotel and Location
text: This is a great property. While by American standards a bit small, by European standards very adequate. We had a queen bed with a great mattress and pillows. Housekeeping was terrific and front desk accommodating. The breakfast included with our price is a continental breakfast of English muffins, toast, jam and cheese, and hot and cold cereal. For an extra £5 you can get a hot, made to order breakfast. Hotel is in a great part of town, 1.5 walking miles to the government buildings. We'd stay here again.

title: Excellent
text: Was here last month July 15, great hotel and hospitality, excellent access to local area. hope to be back soon. Hotel staff were really helpful and friendly. rooms very nice and clean, i hate to find a hotel that has dirty showers this was a great place. rated 110%

title: will stay here again
text: My family and i stayed here for a while and were quite satisfied. The rooms are clean, breakfast is good, the location is great only about 5 minutes walk to victoria station where u can go anywhere from. The price is not bad as well. There is a bus stop in front the hotel with is very convenient, and the staff is friendly. The only negative is as everyone said...the bathroom is very...small. But we would stay here again, the overall experience was great
