title: Decent
text: Great priced Hotel for the area, 2 minutes walk from the Pimlico Tube Station. The rooms are fine and the staff were friendly enough. There are a few excellent places to eat/drink nearby, most noteably "Cask" and "Goya" on my trip. Cask is a Real Ale pub with loads of different Ales on tap and even more bottled beers in the fridges, so many that they have a beer menu! Gets busy even midweek and they do food, I didn't try the food, burgers etc, but it looked excellent. Goya is a Tapas bar 2 minutes walk away, and the food and wine were terrific, can't wait until the next time I go to that area!

title: Weekend in London
text: I found the hotel to be very clean and the rooms as well. Although they are small in size they were comfortable enough not to make you feel cramped in. I found the staff to be helpful and cheerful. I would say my overall experience was much enjoyed. See you in the future

title: " A good position!!!"
text: The hotel has a good position: it is near the main city attractions and the Victoria station. It is made up of basic rooms but comfortable and clean. Staff were friendly. Breakfast adequate and with the option of a cooked breakfast.

title: clean hotel
text: We are happy with our stay at Huttons hotel, It was clean and we will come back here. Very friendly staff. We came directly from the Airport and this is our first hotel in London. We are satisfied and the place was very welcoming.

title: Great value considering location!
text: I booked this hotel through their website after researching most of the hotels in the area. The price was right for my one night stay, and its location close to both the Victoria Train and Bus station was enticing. It is also within walking distance of all the major sites I desired to see in my one day in London. I managed to use the hotel as a base, tour Westminster, Buckingham, Trafalgar square, Picadilly etc and still have a rest before heading out for dinner. Also, since my flight was way early...by an hour...they still let me check in much earlier then anticipated which allowed me to have a shower after my overseas flight, before heading out on the town. All in all, for the money, you cna't beat the location, and the staff is really friendly and accomodating.

title: nice clean rooms
text: Nice little hotel only a short walk from the train station. Rooms are comfortable and clean breakfast is reasonably priced. Its a little hot for my liking we had to sleep with the window open although the road noise wasnt to bad. All in all I would stay here again.

title: my opinion
text: Huttons hotel, i read the reviews and was scared , but my expreiance was different we booked a triple room it was on the ground floor,three single beds i speciffically askd for 3 adult beds as i didnt want to end up in a small bed for childern only , not enough power plugs for 3 ppl wanting to charge phones. complmentary tea and coffee

title: Avoid this Hotel at all costs
text: Terrible Business stay in this hotel on the night of 18th November 2015. We were told on check in that breakfast runs until 9.30 on weekdays. Myself and a colleague were attending an awards ceremony in London that night and had arranged to meet downstairs for breakfast at 9:10am. Upon arriving in the breakfast room, we sat down as no one was there to greet us and were then ignored for the next 10 minutes by the waitress attending to resetting tables. I then caught the waitress on her way past and asked if we could please have some breakfast. At this point we were spoken to in an appalling manner and told 'NO BREAKFAST FINISHED AT 9:15!''

title: Perfect location
text: Stayed with here with four other girl friends. Location was perfect to suit what we wanted to do - explore the sites of London. The hotel is conveniently located beside Victoria tube station and the Wicked West End theatre. The bus directly outside the hotel is also very convenient to bring you to quite close to all the main sites We stayed in the quadruple room which was clean and quite spacious. The only thing was that the room only had two sockets! Breakfast was lovely - cereal, toast, juice - just what we needed to start the day! Would definitely recommend this hotel due to its location and value for money.

title: Pleasantly suprised
text: We found the hotel to be very clean, bed was very comfortable Room is compact - En-suite is small but was clean, water hot Location - pleasantly surprised at ease of transport - 15 min walk to Victoria -tube/bus/London bus tour. Bus stop outside hotel goes to Westminster and Trafalgar Sq Overall we enjoyed our stay

title: Don't go
text: Not a very good breakfast , very little choice . No air conditioning . Long distances from attractions . Receptionist very rude. When I first booked , we made a mistake , I struggle to walk long distances, I tried to cancel seconds later because of the distance from the hotel to the centre and we were told no. The room is so small , it's more of a box room with a bed and no room around it . Awful

title: Good location
text: Located in a central area of the city, i found it very practical for its proximity to Victoria station, from which I could move by metro easily. The front desk staffwas very professional, discrete the chamber, as well as breakfast. Only problem with WiFi. No access from the room. I had to move, like several other guests, in the hotel lobby to use it.

title: great service at an affordable price
text: I made a reservation for a room for 4 persons just because their price was very reasonable and the location was great to just walk around London as It was my first trip to the area and i consider walking a better way to know the place. I arrived early so i dont expect to be checked in, the Associate was very polite and advised me to put all of our stuffs at a secured room and gave me a key to have access on it. Thus we were able to roam around immediately. When we came back the room was ready and i was surprised by its cleanliness, looks like it was newly renovated. For the price i was not expecting this. Thank you Huttons, we really had a nice time using your facility.

title: Don't eat just sleep!
text: Nice small rooms. The breakfast is really poor! Eat somewhere else. U get what u pay for! Cheap! Pretty good location close to bus stop and underground station. The door key is not reliable. We are not staying there again.

title: Clean but small. Not the best for business travelers.
text: This place has a good location and offers a decent value but it's really not the best for business travelers. The rooms are small with nowhere to work. Other than that, it's an okay option if you need to stay near Westminster or Victoria Station.

title: Lovely clean hotel, fab location
text: Stayed here for 4 nights in June 2018. We usually stay on Belgrave Road whenever we come to London but the cleanliness of the hotel where we normally stay has recently dipped significantly. Booked here in the hope that it would be clean if nothing else. We were not disappointed in the slightest, in fact of all the hotels we have stayed at on Belgrave Road (6 including here) this is by far the best. The hotel itself was very clean, bright and modern. The reception staff were pleasant, and although we did have to wait a couple of times for someone this was a matter of seconds rather than minutes. The lift is very slow, but it’s a very old building so it wasn’t too much of a problem. Our room (floor 4) while small (we already knew it would be) had everything we needed - a bed, kettle and a small TV. The bathroom was ample size and there was enough room to dry and get dressed without having to stand in the shower whilst doing so! The room was cleaned/tidied every day. The only negative for me would be the mattress, it sagged very badly on one side, which caused me some back pain on the first night, fortunately I was able to swop with my friend who can sleep anywhere! Breakfast was simple but filling enough. I particularly liked the porridge which I thought was lovely and creamy. Yes there are people who push and shove, and don’t understand queues or waiting, but that is no fault of the staff or the hotel. The location of the hotel is fab, 5-10 min walk to Victoria, and 5 min walk to Pimlico. Bus stop is directly opposite and takes you past Westminster, Trafalgar and down towards Oxford St. There is a luggage room which is locked where we were able to leave our bags on the last day, which is always a lovely extra. We will most definitely be staying here on our next trip to London.

title: Too many steps
text: We stayed in this hotel in June of 2018. It was a last minute booking. We had a room that accommodated 4 people to sleep, but only to sleep. There was barely any room to get around the beds otherwise. As you step into the suite there are 4-5 steps down into the room and then another step or two up into the bathroom. I don't really have an issue with steps, but getting a 28 inch piece of luggage (or 4 in our case) up and down the steps was very cumbersome. The front desk arranged a private taxi for us to the airport and we were told the flat rate cost of the trip, the driver charged us more, which is probably our fault, I'd just say beware.

title: Great price in a pricey town!
text: Small room & bathroom. friendly knowledgable staff. Great location near "22 bus" & Victoria station. The beds were a bit springy, but you get what you pay for. Breakfast was fantastic!!!

title: Vacation in London
text: Location great. Very safe. Easy to get around on tube. Can easily get there from gatwick. Was easy to connect to Eurostar for next part of trip. Breakfast was good with option to upgrade to full English.

title: Great stay at Huttons Hotel
text: Hi everyone! I have just come back from my family holidays in London where I stayed at Huttons Hotel for 5 days. I would highly recommend this hotel to everyone for many reasons. First of all, It is very well located as it is in the central of London, just 5 min from Pimlico Station and opposite to a bus stop where you can get bus number 24 and go all around the main places in London. However, you don't even need to take any transport to go to many places as everything is nearby and you can just have a walk as I did most of the times. We really enjoyed our stay at Huttons thank to the very hardworking and friendly staff who helped us find the best places to eat and visit while we were there. They didn't mind helping us any time. As a tourist, that is obviously a great help as it was our first time in this city. We had a really warming welcome. Also, my family and me loved the breakfast which they offer, due to the good variety and quality of food. About the size of the rooms, they were big enough for us, exactly the right size, not too big not too small. It was a great value for money! Plus you will find all the necessary things in the rooms such as hairdryer or fresh towels every day. In conclusion, we had a lovely stay at Huttons Hotel. Hotel has a very nice look and it is very clean I must say unlike others where I have been in different countries I have visited before. Warm Regards, Maria

title: Good Location
text: Stayed at this hotel at end of September for The Beach Boys concert at Wembley. The location was excellent for visiting a lot of the "sights" of London. 5 - 10 minute walk from Victoria Station. There is a bus stop across the road from the hotel (No. 24) that takes you past Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament and Big Ben, Horseguards Parade, Marble Arch, Scotland Yard, Trafalgar Square, Downing Street, Shaftesbury Avenue (for theatres) and goes all the way to Hampstead Heath. We also took this bus all the way to Camden Market ( a must visit). There seemed to be a standard price of £2.30 no matter how many stops you were going! Management and staff at the hotel were very pleasant and helpful. Room was a decent size (107) and clean. The breakfasts were fine and the optional cooked breakfasts were very good value for money. An ideal budget hotel in the centre of London. Would stay again.

title: good location
text: Our room was not small it was the smallest one we have ever stayed. Bot location is excellent. Near to Pimlico station, supermarkets and restaurants. For our baby they supplied crib. Breakfast was terrible. But if i visit london again i will stay this hotel without breakfast.

title: OK for 1 night if you get it at a very discount price
text: Had a twin room, budget room decor, bigger bathroom in a touring caravan. Luggage store fantastic. Breakfast poor. Handy location. Pleased we didnt pay full price!

title: Good hotel in great location
text: We had just the one night here recently - en route from JFK to home in Perth and needed one night in London. So chose this based on Trip Advisor reviews and because it was close to Victoria for the train to Gatwick. The hotel is good value, the room large by London standards and our room which faced the street with a window that opened was great! Only problem was a jet lagged neighbour either next door or upstairs who paced his or her room from 430am and the floorboards creaked! Despite this, recommended!

title: Does what it says on the tin
text: In London for a family weekend and booked a two bed and a three bed .Both were small but clean with basic amenities tea,coffee hair dryer etc,It's London so your not going to get a big room for that price. The room was warm and with the window open was noisy but that's not the hotels fault, my childrens room was in the back of the hotel and lovely and quiet(before anyone says anything about leaving kids in separate rooms they are 17,20 and 22) They staff were really friendly and helpful and as Victoria was a bit of a walk for me give detailed directions to pimlico underground a short distance away.We didn't sample breakfast as there were no tables available at 8.30 and we weren't that bothered anyway being a coffee only in the morning family.All in all not somewhere for a weeks stay but for a night or two ideal

title: Our holiday stay in London
text: My husband and I stayed for 10 days at the hotel. All staff were very helpful and friendly. The room was exceptionally clean. The hotel is in walking distant to Victoria. The continental breakfast was good and the staff provided good service.

title: Not as bad as some!
text: I am always anxious when checking into non-chain accomodations due some of the disasters we have experienced, especially in London, even after reading reviews, etc. There must be a happy medium between a dump and a too expensive place to stay. So I was pleasantly surprised with Huttons Hotel conveniently located in the Pimlico area of London. Yes, the rooms and bathroom are small, just one pillow per bed, and check out is an early 10:00 am. However

title: Great location
text: Had a lovely stay with friends for a weekend in London. The location is great, in Victoria, with a bus stop right across the street, and within a few blocks from two tube stations. The staff is friendly and efficient. Rooms are very comfortable.

title: I'm scared i've caught something!
text: What can i say, i was offered a room on the fourth floor, in the middle of the stairs... absolute terrible, mouldy net curtains, mini bed, shower so small it was unbelievable, bed was covered in red marks, im hoping it was pen and not blood. burn marks in the sheets and the bed side cabinet. dust all over the floor. I complained and got put in the basement in a double room. But it was a basement, and it was still very small. The Electrics were bodged and hanging off the wall, the lamp was terminated in a box that was just left free to move under the bed. The shower in this room was slightly bigger but still not big enough to stop your foot being i nthe shower when going to the toilet. please do not visit this hotel... the staff were friendly but were running a terrible hotel for someone who should have trading standards take a look. If i have came away from that hotel without a disease i will be happy... its still only been a few days though!

title: Small but adequate
text: Arrived and was pleasantly surprised very compact room but clean well decorated and nice bathroom. Adequate breakfast for a 3 star hotel, apart from very small and being on a main road so a little bit noisy nil complaints. Plenty of restaurants near by.

title: Nice staff, but the room was horrible.
text: I have stayed for 3 nights, the location was perfect for my needs with 10 minutes walk from Victoria Station. The reception Staff were really helpful and nice. However i was given a first floor room. The rooms are like a prison cell. There are too much noises from other rooms and doors... People pass in-front of your room you can even hear their breath. The corridors are just a meter wide. You can hear the lift going up and down every minute even during the night and it sounds like an old tractor. The toilet cubical is too small which includes a shower too. Its like a telephone boot. The Linen was clean and changed every morning ..... This cost me 160 for three nights which included breakfast. However the breakfast only consist of a toast with jam or with cheese (only) and butter, plus Tea or Coffe. They say that you will also have a telephone in the room however No rooms have telephone. The TV set is on analogue system and its very old. You will have only 5 channels. So if you happen to book this hotel, make sure you insert earmuffs if you wish to try to sleep. Not value for money i am afraid.

title: Great place
text: Stayed over the first bout of tube strikes and had a wonderful time, the Victoria line, close station, was still running as well so not as bad as it could of been.staff were great, had breakfast two mornings and was satisfied with the selection, service was great, very friendly faces which is especially good early in the morning. Reception desk was helpful and our room was always made up for us. Good tv and decor, good wifi and a kettle in the room. Nice bathroom to boot.had a wonderful time, would recommend.

title: absolutely brilliant and would most definitely return!
text: the hotel was fantastic! it was very clean and easy to find, the staff were really friendly and helpful and I could not fault the hotel. The breakfast was very filling and good value for money. I would definitely return!

title: Kind of cute
text: It was my first trip to London, and I went there mainly to see musicals in the West End. Not wanting to overcharge my credit card (you need money when you want to see shows), I booked a room at Huttons through Hotelopia. You have to know that the 10-minutes walk from Victoria can be hell if you're carrying loads of luggage and if it's a hot day (take a cab!). The street the hotel is on is quitte peculiar since it's only hotels for hundreds of meters, and they ALL look the same. Kind of funny. Huttons is not the best hotel in the area, but it sure was fine. Greeting staff seemed kind of shy/not too friendly, but very polite and helpful. My room was on the top floor (there actually IS a button for that floor in the elevator, just have to look for it), and I guess top floor rooms are among the cheapest, for you don't get much of a view (or a window, for instance). But I found that I could live with only a very small, non-openable windowlet high on the wall (you have to get on top of the bed to look outside). The room was generally clean, not really freshly rebuilt, but REALLY ok. Hairdryer as well as an electric kettle and complimentary coffee, tea and tinned milk are provided. My Hairdryer didn't work, but I had brought my own, and actually forgot to tell the staff about it. TV remote did not correspond to the tv set in my room, but that too didn't matter, as I told the person at the desk. The bathroom was INDEED tiny, pretty much a one-piece plastic cabin like you find in trailers (or Formule1 hotels in France, except here you have everything INSIDE the room). The hotel's pretty old I think, so I think it's normal that rooms don't look all shiny and brand new, bathroom door creaks and all. My room was cleaned daily for the 3 days I was there, with fresh towels (and a special mention to the maid who noticed I liked my many pillows and made my bed accordingly). Bring shampoo and showergel if you don't like multi-usage solution from a dispenser (but I've been to hotels where you don't even get a tiny bar of soap). Breakfast was nice. Quite typical, but nothing exceptionnal. Good coffee from a modern machine, eggs, sausages, bread, baken beans, orange juice... All your basic english-breakfast ingredients. I didn't see many staff members (I sometimes had the impression they were all locked up some place in the basement and only came out when people went out for the day - creepy impression), but all were polite (and SHY!). Elevator is EXTREMELY slow, and at breakfast time, better not need to urge back to your room bathroom, for people keep calling the elevator up and down. Location is GREAT. nearest tube station is pimlico, a 7 minutes walk for a slow walker like me, and you are only a 10-minutes tube-trip away from picadilly and theatreland. I can only advise this hotel if you're not too picky on comfort and all. I liked it, although I'm not the youth-hostel, backpacking type. It's cheap, clean, relatively cosy and greatly located. Some hotels around the world don't even match such basics.

title: Overnight stay
text: No storage for clothes/few hangers only: space between the twin beds for one person at a time: no plug in very small basin: care to be taken when leaning over basin as shelf overhung basin: chipped shower base.

title: Lovely reception, helpful stafff, disappointing room!
text: The rooms were small and cramped and looked like you had travelled back to the 80's, the bathrooms reminded me of an aeroplane toilet, unfriendly! The bathroom door didn't shut nor lock and i didn't enjoy seeing the dirty laundry chucked on the floor while coming out of the lift back to the hotel room. However, the staff were very friendly and helpful. They sorted out our complaints straight away! I probably would not stay here again on a leisure trip and pay a little bit extra for a lot more! Maybe if i was backpacking and short for cash, then i would stay here again.

title: Does what you should expect of its type and location.
text: This is a standard "railway station" type hotel in a row of similar hotels. The rooms are very small as are the bathrooms. I was staying only one night to attend an early morning meeting nearby and travelling alone so it didn't matter but two people with luggage would find it a squeeze. That said, my room, and I think the rest of the hotel, had recently been refurbished, so was immaculately clean and the shower room fittings looked brand new. On the other hand, some fittings which may have been there prior to the refurbishment were a little worn. The staff were reasonably pleasant and if I needed an hotel in the same location again for one night, I would use it. They should change the picture in the lift advertising the £5 breakfast. From the picture you might assume that a "full English" breakfast is on offer - it isn't. Breakfast is adequate but is toast, muffins, jam, cereals and fruit.

title: Very friendly and welcoming. Clean rooms/quirky pod like bathrooms..
text: Check in is at 12:00 which is handy for us as we are going to an afternoon show. Welcoming is warm and friendly as are all of of the staff, and very helpful. The rooms are basic but clean and bright with a super comfy bed. The bathroom is a pod like thing and is very small but also very quirky and quite funny.. I paid £200 for a double room for 1 night and 2 tickets to a theatre which I though was very reasonable. The hotel is closer to pimlico station although the instructions directed me from Victoria although there is only a couple of minutes in it either way. I would stay here again and recommend to friends and family who would like to stay in the area. There is some building work going on in the reception area right now but I expect it will be lovely when done. On the whole, great staff an great value for money. Thumbs up from us!

title: great location
text: We stayed there for 2 nights. We were really happy. Everything was nice but the receptionist didn't seem so friendly.. They didn't tell us any informations. I would expect that they will tell me such a basic information as where my room is..

title: Great Hotel And Friendly Staff
text: This was my second stay at Huttons and I will definitely stay here again on my next trip to London. The hotel kindly lets you store your luggage before and after check out, which is a great help arriving at 6.30 am on the bus from Glasgow. The room was spotless and I had the luxury of a king size bed. The pod style shower room is small, but I managed fine (and I am not a size 6, 4 foot beanpole). The breakfast was good and the breakfast room was very clean. I found out this trip that Pimlico underground is actually closer than Victoria. This hotel is very handy for anyone arriving at Victoria Station or Victoria Coach Station. All in all a very good hotel for the very reasonable room rates.

title: Good choice!
text: Nice hotel with best price,in the center of London close to Big Ben.Room is clean ,warm,receptionist is very polite and helpful,Belgrave is beautiful street,really love this place,restaurants,bars,metro,buses,supermarkets everything is so close ! The best choice and best price )

title: Half term treat
text: Booked on line for a 2 day trip with my eldest son. Very good price in fact I would say cheap for London so didn't expect to much. We tend to walk everywhere when we visit London and it was approx 90 minutes from Kings Cross. The street was nice and quiet and the rooms were basic but met our needs. Sink in the bathroom had a tendency to block and the breakfast was basic. Staff were friendly in general, the breakfast staff being the nicest. My only complaint would be other guests not being capable of closing doors without slamming them especially in the early hours of the morning! Overall close to an underground station and approx 10 minutes from Big Ben on the bus. If you are looking for a room on a budget I would recommend but not what I would call luxury in any shape or form.

title: We were pleasantly surprised
text: We were full of trepidation having read so many negative reviews but our stay at this hotel was overall a positive experience. We had a room at the back on the fourth floor. It was small but clean,newly fitted out and very warm. In fact,so warm we had to sleep with the window wide open. The shower worked well and the bed was comfortable. The breakfast was basic but adequate and the coffee was good. The staff in the breakfast room and reception were charming. I would recommend this hotel to anyone needing a short stay hotel near the centre of London. The area is pleasant and Victoria station is nearby. So is the river and Tate Britain. Our only problem was with noisy people in the room above late at night but earplugs sorted that out.

title: Reasonable Place to Stay in London
text: The negative: The mattresses were an "upgrade of an overnight Camp mattress", extremely lumpy and full of hard coils, pitched to the right. They really need to replace them, quickly!The positive: Good Location, very helpful staff, good English Breakfast. Huttons is in the process of remodeling their Hotel from October, 2017 thru January, 2018. We did not observe or experience any noise or construction staff, didn't even know they were remodeling had they not sent us an email informing us 2 weeks before our arrival. Very quiet for our 3 day stay. Book directly on their website, you'll get a better rate and it will include the FULL English Breakfast. Other websites just offer the Continental Breakfast. You'll need protein to keep you nourished during your explorations of London. Enjoy! 3rd NOTE: If you need a Taxi, have the Staff ORDER a Taxi the night before you need it. They will tell you how much it will cost and the Taxi arrives on time! Much easier than trying to flag down a taxi, which are pretty much non-existent.

title: Great Price, Great Location, Great Location
text: The staff was extremely helpful, especially the clerk who helped me find a taxi to Heathrow when my ride didn't show up. I stayed there on two different occasions and both of my rooms were quite "cozy", which didn't bother me because I was traveling alone. The location is fantastic, on a picturesque street within easy walking distance of the Pimlico and Victoria stations. There are several great restaurants close by as well as a couple handy convenience stores. If I were doing my recent trip all over, I would happily stay here again.

title: Great location, good price
text: Stayed here for a few days to visit the Chelsea Flower Show last week and was very impressed. The best thing about the hotel is it's location. The Show was only a 20 minute walk away as is the King's Road shopping district. Pimlico tube station is a 5 minute walk and Victoria station about 10 minutes. The area is very nice and we felt completely safe walking back to the hotel after midnight. It was also very quiet at night. The rooms are small and basic but are spotless and considering the location and the price, Hutton's is very good value. The photos above reflect well the actual size of the rooms (we stayed in twin rooms 503 and 505) It is central London afterall, so who spends their time sitting in the room?! Breakfast too is quite simple but was good. I would definitely stay again.

title: good location but small room, noisy music from reception
text: Good location in area we like, opposite bus stop so getting around so easy. Room very small but advantage of small balcony. Clean room nice bathroom. Breakfast a bit of a let down Staff quite miserable and had to complain to reception twice as we were in room 204 above reception area where music coming from there had a vibration from the bass line into our room.. It was nice to be able to leave luggage although no assistance offered to get them up the stairs.

title: Birthday + show
text: Booked this hotel as part of a show and hotel deal! ....... Fantastic The hotel is so close to everything you could want in London, we thought we were just going for a show but ended up been able to walk to Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, London Eye and one of the most beautiful parks! If you are looking for a night away to stay in your hotel room - this is not the place for you, it is basic, beds, tv, small wardrobe, small shower room, but great hotel as a base for everything you need, breakfast was simple but did the job! The beds are a little soft for my liking but that is down to preference than being something wrong! Will most defiantly be using this hotel again! Fab

title: Good location, good cleanness and good staff
text: The staff, the location and the cleanness are quite godd. Near of the victoria station and bus stop infront, also a few restaurants and a good pub are quite near. I will repeat if we come back to London.

title: Basic but good.
text: Room not over large but I was there to sleep not practice ballroom dancing. Comfortable bed, clean room, small but well appointed bathroom with a good shower. Close to Victoria Stn and lots of restaurants around Warwick Road. 24 bus from the front door takes you to Whitehall, Trafalgar Sq and Leicester Sq.

title: A overall good hotel
text: I stayed at the hotel for 2 nights with my friend in a twin room on the 3rd level. Overall our experience was good - adequate cooked breakfast (not a large amount of choice but enough) - the hotel was situated in a good area with a good bus route across the road. - we could store our luggage in a room before check in - beds were comfy - shower was good enough. - decor has been updated but not very modern. The not so good points (if I am been picky) - the room and bathroom were not very big - only one small lift for the whole hotel to share. - the breakfast room was not very big and there was ques for everyone to try to get their own food. - breakfast only served till 9.15am at the weekend.

title: Fine for overnight stay in London
text: I stayed in this part of London for business reasons and this was fine for an overnight stay. The room was small, and had a small toilet and shower cubicle, but it was clean and had all the amenities. Breakfast was basic and find - good coffee, toast, cheese, croissants, choice of two cereals or a cooked to order breakfast for a fiver. There was wifi and hot water for shower. The only negative was when I arrived the front desk wasn't staffed, which was a slight concern from a security perspective. Would stay there again if working in the area

title: ...booking.com victim
text: ...so, some time you have a good hotel in a good place but when you book the room you realy don't know what's waiting for you. I was on the populars web site for find a hotel, and 9 time on 10 was perfect. But this time, i book a room...on the street! I can't immagine how a manager can rent a room at ONE METER to the street. No store, so i have a street light all the night, noise, funny for the game me and my stepson we play: try to reconnaise the language the people speak! The hotel was clean and good, but not all the room at the groundflor. Forget the room to 101 to 107, if you book a room, ask a first floor...

title: Sep-14
text: Rooms are clean but very small. We had a twin room but in our opinion should have been a single. Could not leave window open as it opened out on to a balcony which had no security and anyone could have gained access to the room, therefore room was very stuffy. Very noisy at night with inconsiderate guests slamming doors. On a plus side it is handy for the undergroun, less than a five minute walk away.

title: Perfect for adventure
text: I stayed at Huttons hotel for a whole week between December, 2008 and January, 2009. I was travelling to London with three of my friends for a holiday. We were staying in a four-bed room. The hotel is quite small but cosy. the rooms are ok, nothing special, just all you need for those using the room just to sleep. the only drawback is the bathroom which is extreemly small...but you get used to it!!! the breakfast offered is good and fresh. we had no complains. it was just what we were searching for...something which is relatively cheap, at the centre of London and we were really lucky as the transport of the buses is quite near the hotel (the bus stop is right in front but only one bus passes). The staff is very friendly and they always try to help you out in every query one may have. I would recommend this hotel to those 17-18th year old guys who have a tight budget and want to experiance a crazy week in London!!!

title: Looks nicer outside than it is inside
text: We visited just to sleep one night and have a breakfast in the morning. Upon walking in it looked quite nice then when you get in the lift it starts looking cheap. Got into our room, bathroom didn't smell very nice and the shower was horrible. The bedroom was okay, small but I expected that. Some places in the room weren't very clean and I found a hair on the bed. Cheap coffee and tea which tasted horrible. Okay nights sleep it was quite hot but didn't want to open window because of noise. Went for breakfast in the morning and it was pretty horrible, I had continental and all I could really choose from was bread, crumpets and two cereals! My partner had a full English but there was barely anything on the plate.. I wouldn't return or recommend to anyone.

title: Would probably return
text: Nice staff, nice room albeit a little small, everything clean & fairly good location. The only criticism I have really is the 10am check out time, which I just felt was a lot earlier than other places I've stayed in. However it wasn't bad for a short overnight stay.

title: Good location but poor quality
text: We stayed for two nights and the first night was terrible, because of the really loud elevator (our room was just next to the elevator). So the next morning we asked a different room which they offered... The second room was significantly smaller and the entrance was from the staircase hall which meant that there was still lots of noise (they took note about the loud elevator and closed it for the night, so all traffic to upper floors went through the staircase hall). Since the hotel went through renovations, maybe they also took care of the loud elevator :) Otherwise the breakfast was alright and the location was good (a walk away from Victoria Station).

title: No recomendable
text: Small hotel, too small. Despite is clean. Bathrooms too small like a cabin of a vessel. Not room even in the shower. Too small rooms. If you travel in a couple and need a duble bed room, please don't accept room number 102. Is like cabin of "Marx" brother's film. Incredible. Continental breakfast is for only: toast, cheese orange juice, coffee or tea. That's all.

title: Perfect for what we wanted.
text: Stayed her for a night before I travelled to America. Perfect location, easy access to 2 tube stations and just around the corner from Victoria coach station. We were greeted with a warm welcome from the front desk. Rooms were nice and spacious and very clean. I didn't hear any outside noise from the room which is really rare for the central London. Would definitely use this hotel again and recommend to others. Also we got it for a great price compared to other hotels within the area.

title: Could be so much better.
text: Stayed one night with my husband to attend Olympics. Reception tiny with internet access (very dirty keyboard!). Room in basement clean, modern, nice ensuite, no hair dryer, no drawers, water in room 113 not for drinking. Breakfast room nice, food/choice dreadful, could make so much more of this and in my opinion a lost opportunity. The "garden" is a builders yard and I did not venture too far into it! Tips * a one night only hotel * eat breakfast out * take a hair drier * take bottled water (bottled water sold at reception) Overall ok if you can get a good room price. We paid OTT for Olympic period.

title: Clean, good location and enjoyable breakfast.
text: We stayed in a double room for two nights. It was small but perfect for what we needed as we didn't spend much time in the hotel. The bathroom was clean with modern fittings. I was impressed with the breakfast as you could help yourself to as much toast, cereal, croissants and drinks as you liked. When we visit London again we will stay at Huttons. Value for money and so close to Victoria.

title: Nice Stay Highly Recommended
text: Lovely clean hotel, not far from Victoria station. Very friendly, welcoming staff who cant do enough for you. We had a family room which was perfect for us. We would definitely recommend this hotel. Breakfast was ample, cereals,toast,croissants etc

title: Great base for exploring London
text: The location of the hotel is excellent for seeing central London, with Victoria and Pimlico tube stations each only a 10 minute walk away. It is in a nice quiet area, also with good bus routes (especially the night bus from Trafalgar Square). Hotel was clean and well looked after, and felt welcoming. Staff were friendly and helpful. Room was quite small, and the shower wasn't always particularly hot in the mornings, but these were only small issues.

title: Lopsided or what?
text: Room was ok although slanted and very uneven. As you walked around the room you either walked uphill or downhill depending on where you were going in the room. The whole hotel was like this though and made things dodgy on the stairs. Breakfast room reasonably clean and tidy but toaters slow and not enough of them. Asked for cooked breakfast when we arrived and told no problem but we are still waiting to get it. Didnt bother the rest of stay as didnt look that appetising anyway. Staff hardly spoke to us either in the breakfast room or at reception. Cris was friendly enough but didnt get a thank you for staying or goodbye as we checked out. No communication with anyone so hardly likely to stay again which is a pity as location is perfect for all our needs.

title: So clean!
text: I spent one night in this hotel because it was handy for the theatre we were going to. The thing that impressed me and my daughter the most was the cleanliness. It was spotless! It was in a lovely quiet area of London too.

title: Very good value
text: My family & I have been using Huttons Hotel now for many years for our annual trip to London for a concert. We have seen it develop into a very comfortable small hotel with regular refurbishments. It's now looking very smart & pleasant. The rooms are compact as city hotels usually are but they are well furnished with clean confortable beds, The breakfasts are very good. Extra is now charged for Full English which wasn't the case originally but there is still plenty on offer if you don't want to pay the extra.. We shall be there again in the next few weeks so I think that is recommendation enough

title: Fantastic staff and location
text: Went to see cricket at the Oval and this hotel was a good choice as I was on a budget. It is so close to so many things to see and do. The staff were polite and very helpful. The rooms are as you would expect for the price, however the coffee and tea was plentiful and the room was quiet, considering the location in the heart of London. A bargain.

title: A short stay in London
text: We just spent a night at Huttons and the location is perfect. Staff was friendly and very kind. We hadn't read that breakfast is served until 9.15. We arrived some minutes later. Notwithstanding the lady was nice and gave us all we needed. Room was clean. The only inconvenient was that the room is located in the basement just outside the main building. There is a porch roof and that night it has been rained uninterruptedly. Consequently the noise was just unbearable.

title: Great Location
text: I stayed at this hotel at the end of the London 2012 Olympics with my boyfriend. He had a ticket for the athletics and we decided to take in some sightseeing at the same time. The location was perfect for everything, very ner the city centre, bus stop just across the road and tube station down the rod. Pimlico has a very bohemian atmosphere - there were plenty of lovely eateries near by. The hotel was certainly very busy when we were there, the breakfast room was always full. A breakfast of bread, meats, cheeses or fruit was available as part of the package, or a cooked breakfast could be provided at additional cost. There were tea/ coffee fcilities in the room, the en-suite was small yet the shower cubicle was quite large - which was really nice. I found the room rather warm - having said that it was around 26 - 28 degrees in London at that time. Our room was cleaned every day - the room was small and there was no wardrobe - just a very high-up rail to hang your clothes up. We were well looked after during our stay - I am dairy sensitive and the hotel did provide me withsoya milk - which was very welcome!

title: One step up from Travelodge
text: Nice enough. Rooms pretty basic, everything nailed down, but okay. More hotel, less b&b. The bathroom sink was pretty funny. It's so small that I couldn't avoid getting the floor wet even though I tried. The breakfast was okay, only one egg and took a while. The breakfast room was vary busy and all hard surfaces so very loud. Staff was helpful and nice, thus the extra star. The wifi was very weak and spotty only one floor up.

title: Overnight stay after theatre
text: Visit to London to see Wicked at Apollo Victoria Theatre. Short walk to hotel meant didn't need to use tube. Comfortable room, good facilities, good breakfast. Would stay again if in the Pimlico area.

title: Great location, comfortable room, good price and service!
text: It was our first time staying at Huttons and we liked it very much. We usually choose accommodation close to Victoria station and so far, Huttons has been the best deal: great location (only 5min from station), comfortable room, the staff were nice, the price was the cheapest one I found for beginning of April and we even had the option of changing date or canceling. However, since we had no time, we didn't try the included breakfast. We highly recommend it.

title: Small rooms but CLEAN
text: You get what you pay for! Small but clean rooms. A small continental breakfast, not very much to choose from but enough. A short walk to nearest underground station. All staff we came in contact with where helpful and polite.

title: Poor hotel
text: Awful place, mould growing on the net curtain, old beds, leaking tap, would not recommend this place to anyone. we didn't even bother to eat breakfast there, I'v left the place with a rash on my face. ? If your going to stay here I recommend you take your own towels.

title: Nice Break
text: Very convenient for underground, good location. Hotel very clean, happy 😊 receptionist. Room adequate, but we returned just wanting to put our feet up after a exhausting evening only to find the television worked on one channel only. The rest stopped and started. This trivial thing ruined the them getting top marks. Along with poor wi-fi.

title: It's a disgraceful DUMP - go elsewhere
text: Only consider staying if you absolutely can't find anywhere else. It's very dirty, with broken fittings, dirty blankets in a heap on the closet floor, chewing gum ground into dirty carpet, and one bed in the room had a collapsed corner. Surprised they haven't been shut down for health reasons. Breakfast was basic but acceptable. Cannot imagine how they got a three-star rating!! We stayed only one night and then found a beautiful 4-star not far away for only a little extra money.

title: Hotel stay
text: This hotel is ideally placed for people needing the Victoria rail, metro and bus station for international and domestic locations. However the hotel is in a very old but attractive building and appears not to have been done up for years. The room was clean and tidy but had no air conditioning nor lift. We were on the third floor and had to climb six sets of stairs to reach our room. There was a continental breakfast included in the tariff. We thought the 145.00 pounds was expensive even for London.

title: A total nightmare, an internet trap
text: Don't ever consider staying with this hotel. We had very similar experiences to other travellers including: booking at the Hanover and then beign taken across the street, attic room with no space to move up 5 narrow flights, light fittings and towel rails hanging off walls, renovations in progress, 3 star claim, but slum presentation, rude and unhelpful staff, despicable, inedible breakfast served by stalinist robots, window which didnt shut, heating didnt work, hot water failed. We then checked out. I wish, I wish I had checked this site first. I booked through a 3rd party agent of considerable European repute and have taken it up with them to gain full refund. Will post again once we have result.

title: Shocking Hotel
text: Hotel was very hot- had no air conditioning and smelled like curry. The staff was friendly but the rooms were in terrible condition. The rooms are falsely advertised. There isn't nearly as much room as they show on the pictures in the gallery. The kettle was not clean, the window could only open by 2 cm and the hair dryer was faulty. title: Overnight
text: Did not realise we had to climb six flights of stairs to our room ( no lift ) thought we had paid fo a full English breakfast but there was only continental the room was acceptable with good bathroom facilities

title: satisfied
text: The hotel was very conveniently located for my purpose of stay. The staff were very friendly and acommodating.. In my original booking I did ask to have a room on the lower floor sinc there were no elevators. On my arrival I was put in a very small room with enough space for my suitcase and the bed, and a curtain between the shower/toilet and bedroom. However I did speak to the manager the next day and was moved to another room at one of their other hotel across the street. The Airways. Although the room was 1 level below the main level it was very clean and comfortable. The staffs there were also very friendly and helpful. the hotel suited my purpose for the convenience of getting around and lots of good eating places nearby. Like most othe guests, my only negative comment is the very small breakfst room. The breakfast was not great even for a continental one. However, it served the purpose of my having something to eat before heading out for the day. I, personally would stay there again as long as I do not have to go up or down more than 1 flight of stairs. For a city like London and the convenient location, it was worth the money. Zalina

title: For £115 I have stayed in much nicer hotels in London
text: Shower is an absolute joke, either scolding hot or freezing cold. We stayed in the basement so could hear people arriving back at the hotel throughout the night. Breakfast - toast is freezing cold sat out for you to help yourself to. Only upside is the fact you can leave your luggage in storage. Stayed in much nicer hotels with better breakfasts for a lower price .

title: beware of Hanover Hotel
text: I made reservations at the hanover hotel, st. georges st. london for december 3-6, 2004 little did i know that this was a bank holiday, upon arriving there i was told i did not have a reservation even though i had a confirmation # and email in hand, this was because they did not want to honor my internet rate of 59 pounds per night and wanted a walk in rate of 89 per night. we went to the hotel down the street, new england hotel and were given a room and great service, it seems hanover hotel has a reputation for pretending not to speak english, and leaving people without a room, i hope this is passed on to travelers.

title: A comfortably accomodation.
text: We stay in this hotel for about three days and his central position gets see several attractions. You can find, near the hotel, some metro stations and bus stops but needn't take public transport, infact in five or six minutes of walks you reach the Buckingham Palace. the district where is this hotel is extrmely quiet especially during the night. The breakfast supplied by the hotel is simple but very plenty. The room, that was at the first floor with the view of the road, was suitable for us that we had to stay a few days: the bathroom and the sheets always clean and a daily change of towels. The reception is available at all hours and is very gentle.

title: Good location, value for money
text: The hotel is in a good location, walking distance to victoria coach/underground and Pimlico tube as well as Sloane square, and lot of restaurants. The room was very nice, but with a view into an alleyway so absolutely no light into the room. The staff were friendly and helpful. Breakfast was ok, quite a small room so when it is busy it was quite crowded. Free wifi. We stayed on the ground floor, which was great. Cannot comment on the upper floors. For quite cheap, this hotel is a good place to stay in central London.

title: Good location, clean and comfortable
text: Stayed one night on Mon 13th April 2015 and chose it for location. Staff were very welcoming and although there is no lift they offered to carry our bags. Room was very clean and comfortable. Breakfast room was well managed and staff were friendly and quick to clear away and replenish the cereals/milk/toast etc. It was very helpful that when we checked out we were able to leave our luggage to collect later. Would be more than happy to stay there again.

title: Good value for London, if you know what you're getting
text: The staff of this hotel were friendly and helpful. The price was very affordable for London, and it was nice that they could accommodate 3 of us in one room. It is located in an old Georgian (early 1800's) neighborhood in easy walking distance from Victoria Station. Most of the old houses in this area are now hotels, and none have elevators. BE FOREWARNED. For our first of 2 visits, a staff-person carried our luggage up to the 4th floor for us, but for the second visit, no one was available to do this. The staff try hard, and the rooms have recently been repainted, but it is definitely a no-frills set-up. The mattresses were old and not comfortable, though they were clean. I would probably stay here again, just for the price, but it's better if you know what to expect.

title: Central and nice area
text: The location is very good, close to Victoria Station and bus number 24. The rooms are very tiny and leaves no room for luggage on the floor. Great with the free wifi and the cleaning was also good. However don't bother to have breakfast, it is awful, tiny and everyone is off with a bad and stressfull morning.

title: Excellent
text: Friendly helpful staff - we had an excellent stay! Room was clean - 2 beds - quiet. I can't say enough about the staff.

title: Good experience
text: This is a good hotel to visit London, if you are in hotel only for breakfast and sleeping. We stay for 5 nights, our room was clean, not too small, and pretty comfortable. The bathroom clean but a little tight. The staff very helpful and kind with us. There is no elevator and this can be umconfortable if your room is at the 3rd floor! It's very close to Victoria Station, 5 minutes by walking. It's a good compromise between cost and quality.

title: Wonderful Stay
text: We arrived at the Hanover Hotel and were asked if we would like to leave our luggage so great to have our hands free on our arrival and go to explore London. The room we had was just fine 3 of us shared and had a great shower en-suite. Breakfast was also included in our price it was a fresh buffet enough for everyone. The staff were really pleasant and helpful. We would certainly stay again on our next visit to London the trains and underground were less than a 3 minute walk away at Victoria. On our last day we were able to leave out luggage again the staff couldn't do enough for us. Thank you all kind regards Barbara Macdonald

title: London Trip
text: We stayed in a 3-bed-room for 4 nights. The bed was fine, unfortunately the double bed is definitely too small for two persons. The carpet on the floor wasn't that clean and tidy, we suppose that they didn't vacuum-cleaned it every day. The bathroom isn't that big, the shower wasn't clean, there were still hair on the wall of the guests, who used this room before! Behind the sink there was a lot of dust! The breakfast room is definitely too small for so many guests. There is a little choise. It had croissants and bread, slices of toast bread, which were cold, a machine where you can chose to drink coffee, tea or hot chocolate, orange juice, apple juice, water and milk, three different cereals. The stuff were friendly though and helpful.

title: Good location, not much more
text: This is a basic hotel near Victoria station, with a tiny tiny room on the fourth floor with no elevator and extremely tight staircase to get there. It was hot with a small fan, the breakfast is very very basic and barely decent.

title: Worst "hotel" ever
text: Please I beg you, DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY .I'm doing you a favor. I supposed to stay four nights but we only were one night (aug 06, 2018) in this nightmare. Overall the place looks dirty, stains in carpets, smells bad, no A/C, customer service is very poor (example: I ask for ice and after two hours they bring to me a little cup with ice only. The room that I had was in the center of the building with no air circulation (again no air conditioning). This room should be closed or used for deposit. I asked for a change of the room, but still was dirty. I paid CAD dollar $324 per night before travelling and because this nightmare I look for another hotel 100 mts away (Comfort Inn) which was extremely good, for a $308 per night with A/C and excellent customer service. I'm doing a very nice review of Comfort Inn which saved the vacation time in London. Don't go to Hanover.Yes was so terrible, that even I was willing to pay another hotel and I'm not rich. All the hotels around have air A/C. Waiting with travel agency to get my money back. I did not ask for a value hotel to the travel agency but that was a different problem, neither asked for a luxury one but this is totally crap.

title: Thanks to the staff that turned a bad into a good
text: We arrived from Alicante in the early morning hours and got to the hotel around 7.30 a.m. but we had booked the extra night to assure an early check in. Was hugely disappointed with our room located downstairs. So small you had to walk sideways to reach the bathroom but more so was not happy with the cleanliness or the room/bathroom/pillows. Our daughter was next door staying at the sister hotel Airways and while her room was small it was updated and in way better condition. Went back to Hanover and spoke with Animesh and expressed our disappointment at the general cleanliness - he was very receptive and said he would try and do all possible to move us but couldn't promise anything but said to pack up our things and they would move us if possible. I had just asked for a clean room and clean linens so we were surprised on our return to find that we were given an upgrade into a triple room which was huge in comparison and a view of the street of the hotel and right off from the reception area and our bags were in our room! Animesh turned a bad into wow!! On the Sunday we needed to have some documents printed for our onward flight early Monday morning and Harsh was very helpful and accommodating and arranged for our airport pick up at 6 a.m. The taxi arrived on time and it was a new taxi, driver in a suit and tie and he took us to Heathrow for GBP55 which we thought was a bargain. Hanover is in an ideal location and is budget friendly and if you just need a place to sleep this is it. I would make a suggestion that they just pay more attention to the cleanliness of the place and they will have very happy guests all round. Thanks to Animesh and Harsh - you certainly are a credit to the hotel.

title: Very cheap but its not the Ritz

title: Value for money

The hotel was in a good location around 7 mins walk from the Victoria rail/underground stations and 5 minutes to Victoria coach station. Overall a good stay and would visit the hotel again.

title: better than we expected

It had one window but there was a wall right in front of it, so it was kind of dark there. Staff people were nice to us at all times. Breakfast was not the best one ever. In fact, we didn't have too much to choose from. In my opinion this is what we didn't like much about the place.

title: Doesn’t deserve one star

title: Avoid at all cost
text: My friends and I have just returned from our stay in the Hanover 'Hotel', London. On our arrival at the Hanover just after midday we were unable to obtain an electronic pass key for our room door as it was broken and we were offered one manual key with a label attached 'emergency key'. This left us wondering what would happen in the event we were trapped in the room? However we went to the room to find that the en-suite facilities were no more than a prefabricated plastic unit (used in mobile homes) consisting of the tiniest shower imagineable, small washbasin and toilet. The chest of drawers had to be kept closed using a chair as the runners were broken and the second drawer unit the fronts were broken. Remaining optimistic and not wishing to let this dampen our weekend we decided to try and make the best of it. We returned later in the evening to what we can only describe as an 'icebox'. When checking out the gas central heating radiator we noted that it had been 'blanked' off, and as my husband is a heating engineer I recognised the heater was never likely to work, and to put the icing on the cake the toilet cistern was constantly running water. Knowing we would not be able to sleep I visited reception and explained the situation only to be greeted with tuts and huffs and was told to leave it ten minutes and the heating would come on. Explaining that I knew otherwise and that we could not listen to running water I asked if there was another room we could have. This request hit a brick wall, the receptionist called someone and proceeded to hold a conversation in their language with raised voices which I found intimidating and this lastest around three to four minutes. When he hung up the phone he 'ordered' me back to the room and said he would bring a heater and fix the toilet. Having just stood and experienced his phone call I felt I had to do what he said. Granted within five minutes he brought an oil filled heater (which popped like it was frying chips) however it did take the chill off the room and to resolve the running toilet he removed the cistern cover and showed us how we could manually adjust the ballcock to stop the water. Once we were ready for bed we pulled back the top covers of the two double beds only to find that one had a blanket on and the other had no more than a sheet. This is acceptable in the summer, not however at this time of year. I once again visited reception and explained only to be told there were no spare blankets? This I can accept if EVERY bed had one. We resolved the situation by putting the top cover from the bed with blanket onto the other bed. When switching off the main light and attempting to use the bedside light (no guesses needed) it was also broken. Morning arrived and showers were required, this proved to be a potential death trap. The taps were not marked hot and cold and the floor became a paddling pool. Once we overcame the ordeal and starting to 'crack' we agreed to speak to the manager after breakfast. We visited the dining room for breakfast to be met with chipped and cracked crockery, a kettle which boiled enough water to fill two cups at a time and cereal which was scooped out of the catering size cardboard box outers which were on the floor. We lasted all of ten minutes and returned to the room. Gathering our thoughts and agreeing that we all felt vulnerable given that when speaking to any of the staff they then proceeded to have conversation between one another in their language which is acceptable if you are abroad, however we expected (and it would have been manners) for them to speak in English. Better judgement prevailed and as we were afraid of the outcome we agreed that as we were only booked in for two nights we would be able to bear another night sleeping in the room however did not shower or have breakfast next morning. In conclusion we have left this establishment thinking the room was thrown together from remnants of other rooms and firmly believe health and safety are an issue. We have never encountered such poor service and down right rude and ignorant people. Please DO NOT even consider this hotel.

title: Perfect location
text: The Hotel is in a perfect location within a walking distance from Victoria Station. Nice and clean rooms. Stayed two nights. Don`t bother with a breakfast. It`s average hotel for good price. You get what you pay for:)

title: Very nice
text: If you're looking for prime location Hotel for decent price this is the place location is amazing the room clean stuff is super nice for what we paid it was definitely worth it definitely recommend this hotel to go with family very quiet nice neighborhood

title: Very pleasant experience :-)
text: I would highly recommend Hanover Hotel. Staff very friendly and accommodating. The hotel itself is very clean, tidy & well looked after. Vending machine with snacks. Reception open 24hours. It is also very central and close to the picturesque Grosvenor Street. The street that the hotel is located on is also very nice and in a secure and safe area. Breakfast is served 7.30-9.30am and has everything you would need. The ladies in the breakfast room are most helpful and work very hard to ensure that everyone is looked after. The water in the shower was hot - very important! Overall, a very pleasant stay and I will definitely be back if I need accommodation again in this part of London. Thank you 'Hanover Hotel'!

title: Awful!
text: Just got back from a stay at this hotel. The only thing good about it, is location. Otherwise: Just DON'T go there....! Rooms were filthy - bathroom worst. I had to remove a LOT of hair from the bathroom floor when we first got there, and the shower was so badly cleaned that our two girls refused to have a shower in there. The heater in our room didn't work, so room was freezing, in addition to poor ventilation. We were offered an additional heater to plug in, but the oven we were offered, was so filthy and greasy, that we didn't dare to use it. Ventilation in our room was so bad, that the walls in our room were constantly wet, and all our clothes were damp. After a first night - freezing in our beds, we were looking forward to breakfast. What a disappointment.... Nothing fresh: only cold toast, and plastic tasting croissants. You could choose between ham and cheese or jam - and that was it. Needless to say, we went elsewhere for breakfast. We travel a lot - and have been all over the world, and have lived in all kinds of hotels, but this was really one of the worst places we've ever stayed.

title: Comforatble stay
text: The hotel was very easy to find from London Victoria station, we walked and only took ten minutes. We had two double beds and a single which was more than adequate for myself, husband and ou ten year old daughter. Check in was easy, we were on the third floor and had a view of the London Eye and Big Ben. Breakfast was basic but good, we would stay again.

title: We wouldn't do this again
text: We were booked into this hotel for two separate one night stays in August 2008. The hotel was chosen primarily for its location in the Victoria area. When checking in for the first stay, we were immediately redirected to the Airways Hotel across the road. For the second stay, we were initially allocated a room at the Hanover. This room was on the lower ground floor (below street level), and was tiny. So tiny that it was impossible to use if you had luggage, as the double bed was the only place where luggage could be stored and opened. The bed itself looked to be well past its ‘due for replacement’ date. We asked if we could have a bigger room, and again found ourselves at the Airways. The Hanover generally has a run down appearance, and movement between floors is via narrow staircases. The staff are courteous while not particularly friendly, and helpful (room change request was handled well, and we were assisted with our luggage on the trip across the road). We’ve put a review of our stays in the Airways on Trip Advisor under that hotel.

title: London visit
text: For a small hotel I was pleased with the standard. The shower cubicle and the sink needed a more through cleaning round the shower head and taps

title: not bad for the price
text: four of us stayed in a quad room as attended a concert in london, the location was great, in walking distance from victoria station and also to hyde park where we were going. easy to check in, the room was pretty small for 4 people and this would be problem if staying longer than one night, but the beds were comfy, room was clean and it was quiet dispite being at the front, bathroom was small but had plenty of toilet roll and towels. Breakfast was basic toast and cerials but the coffee was very nice. They were waiting outside our room at checkout time so felt slightly rushed but staff were pleasent and called us a taxi when we were leaving. All in all for the price it is recommended, good location, clean room,quiet, breakfast included and staff were polite and helpfull. if staying longer than one or two nights would probably look to upgarde to a larger room in different hotel.

title: Terrible!
text: Everything from bad to worst, smelly room, dirty carpet, bad heating, fungus everywere, bath without towel or toilet paper support. The only thing ok was the breakfast, continental as they said, dont't expect too much either. Stay away from this hotel.

title: Small room, small bed, dingy bathroom
text: We was happy when we arrived at the hotel as it looked nice in the reception and from the outside. Our room was downstairs below ground floor and extremely small. It would of better suited a one person stay as there was no room to move about. The bed wasn't a double bed but a 4ft bed. The shower room was dull and dingy, the shower had mould in it and when the shower was used it kept going from either scolding or freezing. The toilet needed cleaning properly and the tap was loose on the sink. There was nothing in there to dry my hands on so I had to use my one towel what was left for a shower. The bed seemed comfortable at first, although small but it was very hard. And we was woken up as early as 7am by loud footsteps upstairs and what sounded like someone moving heavy furniture. We was informed on arrival that breakfast was between 7.30 and 9.30 but we skipped breakfast due to a late night and being woken up early in the morning. The staff were very polite and friendly but unfortunately our stay was a big disappointment.

title: Fab for the Price
text: I needed a cheap place to stay in London recently and stayed at the Hanover for 2 nights. For £33 per night this was a bargain. I was surpried to find that this included breakfast and wi-fi. Staff are friendly and the hotel is clean. Nice shower and OK beds. Breakfast was OK and as I was up at 7:30 there was no one else in there. If you want something of a higher standard then you have to pay more. I thought this was a bargain and not an inconvenient one in anyway. There are some downsides: I was on the top floor which meant climbing 7 flights of stairs. The walls are thin between rooms and I could hear next door's alarm going off. It's very close to Victoria Station too. All in all I will use this again whenever I need to be in London.

title: 3 stars hotel??? must be a joke!

I wonder who is gonna pay for that meal so horrible! croissants was hard as a rock, marmalade was expired and moldy, the coffee was dirty water, trays were sticky.... ten minutes to victoria station walking.... I almost forget, the hotel team was not friendly. so, 3 stars???

title: Small, clean but shabby, good for stopover
text: We stayed one night, prior to leaving for flight out of gatwick. The hotel is clean but shabby and needs a coat of paint and other cosmetic repairs. Our shower was slow to drain, with the cubicle roof partially exposed. There's no lift/elevator so if you have heavy bags or a pushchair it's a struggle. Breakfast is simple continental food and there is a good array of free magazines and newspapers in the reception. For us, it was adequate and close to Victoria station (5min walk) to catch the gatwick express.

title: Quick stop in London
text: The Hanover Hotel in Victoria was nice place to stay. The reception manger was always smiling and couldn’t be more helpful. Lots of good restaurants nearby, Tapas, Curry, Italian etc. The only thing that could be improved would be the breakfast. Suggest the hotel invests in a toaster in the breakfast room.

title: Worst Ever
text: This undoubtedly was the worst hotel I have experienced. I traveled a month in Europe on this trip. It was to be a 3 star hotel. The furniture looked as though it had survived World War I and whole hotel reeked of the smell of curry,. We ended up losing one nights rent since we had to flee the hotel and seek accomodations elsewhere. This hotel said it was near Buckingham Palace and that was a real stretch.

title: Better than I thought it would be
text: We stayed for one night and found that it was perfectly adequate for our needs. I really wish that when people write reviews, they take into account of how much they paid. This is a budget hotel and they do not pretend to be anything more. I have travelled all over the world, and I can assure you that I have stayed in rooms that were not up to this standard. The room was clean, had plenty of hot water, a television, hair drier, tea and coffee making facilities, a telephone, lovely towels etc. Okay, the window looked onto a back yard and the space from the end of the beds to the wall was very narrow, but hey, this is a very reasonably priced hotel in a good location. We were on the lower ground floor so the fact that there is no elevator was not really a problem. Do not expect luxury, and remember what you paid. I cannot comment on the breakfast because we had to leave before it started.

title: Pleasantly surprised!
text: Me and my sister (we're both under 20!) stayed for one night and found it was perfect for what we required.
