title: Only a great location
text: I must say I stayed for one night only. We needed a hotel in Central London, easy to access from Heathrow airport. I agree with all the bad reviews, but don´t forget that you are in London. You are supposed to sleep in a shoebox. We took the Heathrow Express from the airport, and the Paddington station is just 10 minutes walk from the hotel. Make sure you exit on Praed St, then turn right. The hotel entrance is just 5 blocks from there. How great is that? The down side is that the room is tiny and the breakfast poor. But I never expect a resort when I´m in London. Unfortunately, there is no safe in the room. I think that´s a must

title: Lovedit!!!!
text: We just returned from a ten day visit to London and stayed at the Brunel Hotel. It was wonderful. The staff was excellent, very helpful and welcoming. The room ( a triple with three single beds) was perfect. The hotel is centrally located and we found the neighborhood to be very nice. I really recommend it to London travelers.

title: VERY noisy room
text: Actually I should have stood at a different hotel of the Crystal series but they had to relocate me "because of maintenance problems". They arranged a taxi transfer to Brunel hotel where I was given a tiny room in the basement. I could hear the underground trains going by every 2-5 minutes so clearly as if a station was next to my room. The kettle turned on randomly (without water!) for some split-seconds, making loud clicking sounds. To make things worse the room was right opposite the breakfast room (~ 6-7 m from bed to breakfast table!) so starting from 7 am constant coming and going. This was definitely the worst stay I ever had. I recommend not accepting any rooms in the basement at all if you have to stay here. Breakfast was very basic, there are lots of restaurants really close that offer much more value for the money, not talking about the atmosphere of a window-less basement breakfast room.

title: good value for money ! cheap hotel in a central area not far away from london
text: paddigton is a very nice and well organized area just a few stations away from the center of london. the hotel is very close to the metro and bus station ! i went a trip with my friends so we didn't need something special.. a cheap hotel that meets our basic demands ! the hotel was clean and was next to the metro , nothing else.. everything was just basic ! we didn't expect something better if you take into account the amount of money we paid. ps. if you are searching for something a lot better but also much more expensive is hotel "indigo" also in paddigton. i went there with my girlfriend

title: At least it was pretty cheap...
text: I stayed in this hotel on the 28th of January 2009 with my wife because it is close to Paddington station, and it was the cheapest on offer. We were returning from Bangkok and had not slept for the best part of 28 hours. Imagine my delight when the chap manning reception left us waiting aimlessly in the foyer for 5 minutes while he finished his cigarette outside the front door, ignoring us and chatting to his mate. If it weren't for the fact I was only forking out 40 quid for the stay, I'd have left there and then. I don't need to be given a red carpet to walk on, but I do rather expect to be given priority over a cigarette when I'm checking in. What classy service

title: Dirty, noisy and old
text: Rooms are very small. Wall paper peeling off, Bath rooms simply disgusting! I sleep in hotels all over the world every week and I don't complain quickly but this was really terrible. WIll never stay in this hotel again. Accross the street there is a hotel named '27 Paddington': that is MUCH better.

title: Location makes it worth it
text: Small but clean. Hairdryer didn't work couldn't get a new one. Wake up calls missed! Elevator not to the 4th floor.breakfast area and staff was great. location was great near tube and good restaurants.

title: Value for money
text: This hotel has mixed reviews so I hesitated before booking it. The reviews are mostly correct in that the rooms are tiny, the bathroom not much bigger than a shoe box, no water pressure in the shower and the place feeling a little tired in places. However - it is clean, the staff are friendly, it's warm, breakfast perfectly OK, great location and it's cheap! So overall I think it offers good value for money.

title: I actually have great memories
text: My stay was in 1999, so wifi wasn't an issue. But this was my first trip abroad, and I have great memories of the Brunel. You always fondly remember your first

title: Nice place to stay
text: Stayed for a long weekend, hotel was lovely, rooms bit small but we didn't stay in them much, staff very helpful and friendly, very clean rooms, close to paddington station two min walk away and some lovely restaurants also close by.

title: Terrible,
text: Small rooms, very hot, dirty bathroom, mostly argumentative staff (although one man there was helpful), allocated us a double room but we asked for a twin (I even had the confirmation with me showing this). Didn't dare eat breakfast! Plenty of better hotels in the area.

title: Great staff and room just what you need
text: First time staying here and would book again if I were to return to London. Good Very friendly staff, lovely man on reception couldn't have been more kind and helpful in getting me a taxi to the station when the tubes where on strike, even waiting after his shift ended to ensure it came. Rooms where clean, comfy beds, good shower and telly. Great location Not so good Rooms weren't massive and neither where the bathrooms but they where fine for a few nights stay. Thanks, I'll be back and will recommend you to friends.

title: Toilet
text: Where do I start. Coming up the lift with more than 2 people and luggage is impossible if the lift works. Once opening the door to your room don't swing it to hard as it will bang into the bed. The bed was two singles kind of bolted together so you had to sleep on the outside edge or you just fell in the gap between the two singles. Unable to open wardrobe door fully as again this will bang into bed. Bathroom again very small when sitting on toilet you need to sit sideways as your legs wont fit under the basin if your any more than 5ft tall. Shower just be careful as turning inside the cubical normally involved bashing your arm or leg into something. Brushing teeth in basin is a mission as well as basin is so small and you bash head against the shelf above. And keep bathroom door shut as well as the smell from the drains is full on. As for the internet it worked for 2 nights out of 4 but very intermittent even when it was on. If you need to fill the kettle your need the shower as it wont fit in the basin. No fridge but luckily we were there in winter so we just used the window sill.

title: old.
text: Pretty old, expensive, and rooms too small, And the rooms are very dirty, old and extremely small. My wife and I couldn't even stay in the room, one in the bed and one on the luggage.e. The door is broken, even with the electronic key. the clima don't work, and the manual fan same.We can't by wtare or any beverage in the hotel, yoy must bay in the small store near the hotel, before came back to hote.only good the place near Paddington, Tanks God!!

title: Not worth the money
text: The double room was so tiny we had to store one backpack on top of the cupboard in order to be able to move - the other we placed under the desk. The cupboard could only be opened 20 cm. The carpet looked like something from World War II - very dirty. The window could not hold open - we had to put the only chair in the room in between the bars to hold it. The bathroom was ok, though, and the towels and sheets were clean. The breakfast was very good - order tea, not coffee, since the coffee was always cold.

title: Average Room for a reasonbale price
text: Booked through lateroom as I was staying in London for work and had stayed in the area at the Best Western Paddington Court the week previous. I was expecting a total hole after reading the reports on this site however after checking in and getting to my room I was pleasently suprised. The room was on the 3rd floor, it was light, airey, and there was enough space. The bathroom was small, however I paid £55 per night so I was not expecting a suite. You do get the tube vibrations up until about 11.30pm and from about 6am but its not something that kept me up. If your looking for budget accomodation in Bayswater its worth a look, the local eateries are also very good.

title: A total disappointment from check-in
text: I was very very disappointed with this hotel. While it is in an ideal location

title: Not 3 stars!
text: I ended up with this hotel as my three star priceline surprise. What a disappointment. The rooms were sweltering in November. We had to drag our bags up to the 4th floor. The toilet seat didn't fit the toilet and was flaking apart. The windows had mold and were broken. The one highlight of all was that the towels were clean. Not much use considering the shower had little to no pressure.

title: Good location, but there are problems
text: The Hotel is located in a very good place – near Underground Station, food shops around, not far from Hide Park. The Hotel is located in a lovely street and lovely building. Rooms: Rooms are clean, ok, beds ok, shower place is too small. The problems: 1. Room heating: it was freezing cold at night on the second floor. I asked to put on the heating, but service stuff said that heating is OFF at night and is Central Heating and they can do nothing with it. 2. Hot water in shower was not hot. It was not even warm. 3. I got sick after cold shower and sleeping in cold room. Each night I put on warm cloth and slept with warm cloth. Hotel stuff sent someone to fix the cold water in shower but it did not help. 4. Internet speed was really slow. 5. Breakfast is not reach, same every day. My small 7 old daughter was leaving dining room with red apple. She was "caught" by breakfast stuff and was asked to leave an apple because no food is allowed to be taken out of the dining room. She cried, so I bought her a chocolate. This is not a child friendly hotel Overall if I would recommend the hotel – only at hot summer month – July, August. Should be careful not to get sick

title: Ok for price, rude people don't pay for a full English
text: Fair price for London. Room was very hot but still pretty much what you expect for the price. I have to admit I wouldn't stay again though purely because of the women who ran breakfast. They were very rude, when my sister asked for a vegetarian they laughed and said she can remove the sausage and bacon ourselves. The breakfast was horrible we paid for full English but it was dry and neither of us are any of it. I wasn't impressed. Furthermore the owners could not understand English.

title: it was lovely
text: The hotel is really beautiful and i loved to stay there! The staff was really kind and give us good advice where should we go, what can we see in London. Helped us with everything. As I saw the people was helping each other (for example there was a really kind boy who was doing the portering and helping us with our huge luggages and then we met with him next day while he was doing receptionist jobs. He was helpful and really kind even when we arrived back late night!) The rooms was quite okay for this price I think it's absolutely normal in london. Especially I must mention the perfect and beautiful location of the hotel! It's just 10 minute walk from hydepark, Oxford street and many shops but still in a quite and nice street so we had a really calm sleep! I am definitely advising this nice hotel if you don't want to spend really much money for a weekend but you want a nice one! We have been many times in London and we always was looking for rooms around the same price like here and this is the first time where we met really helpful and kind staff and clean - clean rooms and just for the first look! I am definitely going to stay there when we travel to London again!

title: don't sleep there unless you like bed bugs
text: We stay in this hotel for ten days on September 2009 and it was horrible. They didn't change the sheets and they didn't clean the bathroom. We noticed red spots on our skin and we thought that was from mosquitoes bites and day after day the spots became biger and increased. My husbant is allergic to insect bites and finely we went to the hospital in Paddington and the doctor informed as that many people have visited the hospital for the same reason. BED BUG

title: Don't stay here
text: After 26 hours in transit from Australia, arriving and seeing the room in this hotel brought my daughter and I to tears... The beds sagged, non existent pillow, if you call a pillow case with a rag in it a pillow, and room was very dirty and seedy. My husband managed to squeeze into the bathroom to have a shower, shower head was broken off the wall. When we enquired if someone could fix it, told nobody was available . Asked if they had another room, we were told none were free. Husband went across the road to another hotel to check it out. We checked out of Shakespeare, and miraculously they had another room available. Checked it out was just as bad as the one we left. So, we went and stayed across the road..

title: Unfortunately, I will probably not come back here again
text: I originally booked the neighboring hotel, which is called "Dolphin Hotel". They told me that they were full and will give me a room in their "sister-hotel" next door. I never heard of such a thing, but it seems that life can be full of surprises. While in my room, I kept hearing a loud noise and couldn't figure out what it was. Was somebody listening to their TV really loud, or were they having a party? I went to the reception to ask. The receptionist (who spoke with a Spanish accent) came into my room, listened for a bit and figured out that it was the Tube ... . Supposedly, because the hotel is so close to the metro line, the entire area has problems with the noise. There were a lot of tourists in the hotel, I wasn't the only one attracted by the convenient price that included breakfast. I should note that there are a lot of prostitutes in the area. They tried to pick me up, but I didn't continue the conversation so long as to find out their prices. I did find out that they were from my country though :)) My rating is of "poor" and not of "terrible", only because the English Breakfast was ok , and the ladies who served it were friendly.

title: Shakespeare
text: Not a bad hotel, but the single star rating is because there was no hot water for a shower. Out of three nights there, there was only heated water on one occasion! Pretty poor for a London Hotel. Nice waffles though!

title: Location, location, location
text: Warm place let down by poor functionalities. Paddington station - both connect/Express and Underground (35 mins to Heathrow) is just 3 mins walking distance. Plenty of lovely restaurants around. But the rooms need better heating. Wifi is erratic and only stable in the reception. Also be cautioned, no lift means you will lug your bags up the floor

title: Very disappointed about my stay in this hotel
text: My partner and I stayed at this hotel in August 2014. We were offered one of two rooms. One was located on the 4th floor and there was no lift and we had heavy bags of luggage with us so we took the ground floor room. The hotel was not welcoming and comfortable. We were given a room that was poorly decorated and had a foul smell to it - no doubt coming from the plumbing in the ensuite. Every time an underground train passed there was rumbling and the windows shook. The floors felt as though the lino had been laid on top of a concrete floor which hadn't been swept before the flooring was laid so it was uncomfortable to walk on in bare feet. The decor was out dated. The breakfast room which was located in the lower ground floor wasn't very welcoming either. The good thing about this place was the location which was lovely as well as being close to transport and traditional pubs.

title: good location
text: The room we had was not air conditioned and it was hot. We had to open the window for air but then is was noisy from people outside. The beds were not that comfortable. The bathroom had a bad odor to it too. The staff was super nice, the breakfast was good and the location was good as it was short walk to Paddington station.

title: Was not impressed, you get what you pay for.
text: I was at this hotel several years ago in 1999. The rooms are incredibly small and so are the bathrooms. The bathrooms barely held 2 people at once. For the price and location it is decent at best but absolutely would not stay here again.The walls are paper thin and you can here everything that is going on in the room next to you, and in the hallways. We had a few problems there. When we got to our room, we had to change rooms because of the hot water not working. The room we were switched too had maybe 3 channels working on the TV. Our bed sheets were changed maybe once the whole week-my friend purposely made a lipstick mark on the bedsheets and the mark was still there several days later so they did not change the sheets. The staff (some ramdy greek guys) was helpful but I would spend more $$ next time ot stay in a nicer hotel. If you are cheap and don't care about really small, barely basic rooms, it miht work out for the thrifty traveler.

title: Skip it, there are cheaper and better.
text: The things going for this hotel are the breakfast, location, and lobby decor. Otherwise not a great choice. I found a bug on my pillow which is one thing I cannot tolerate! There is not lift in this hotel. So 48 steps later you will be at the second floor. if you have children, large luggage, a stroller, etc this is definitely NOT the hotel for you. The staff is not very knowledgeable and so arent able to give you a lot of assistance when going out. They will let you leave your bags and lock them up for you (at your own risk). I would stay here as a last resort.

title: Good price and quality
text: Hotell was nice and clean. A little small dining room, some of the people had to wait in the line to get to the breakfast table. Rooms are rather small, and for us, little bit too cold. But still, I would recommend the place.

title: Great Hotel and Excellent Staff
text: We stayed in this hotel for 2 nights and it was great. Location is excellent. Its in a quiet square in a nice area called Paddington. There are bus stops just around the corner to take you to Oxford street or Victoria station, and the underground as well, which is very handy. And its only 15min walk to Oxford street. Also, around the corner from the hotel is newsagents shop, gift shop, coffee shops, Burger King and other restaurants. Rooms are quite nice and clean, and you get a breakfast in the morning as well. Staff are very nice and polite, and help you in every way they can. I would really recommend this hotel to anyone who is travelling to London.

title: Treated like a nuisance
text: We spent 2 nights at this hotel with a small group of young people. The location is rather elegant, Paddington station just araound the corner. I was pleasantly surprised by the outward appearance but then was treated worse than I could imagine. The towels and sheets were dirty, other people's hairs could still be found on them. I had used one towel for the bathroom floor which I found neatly hung up on a rack in the evening. The hotel had lost our reservation so we had to wait for over an hour until they had their problems sorted out. The receptionist seemed helpless and inadequate and after finally finding rooms for us told us we would have to move again in the morning. In the morning I got a rude phonecall from the reception telling me to come down immediately, she needed to sort out the room problem...Breakfast was ok the first morning, however we had to leave early (7.30pm) the next morning and were only allowed into the breakfast rooms to help ourselves to some hot drinks and some plain biscuits. What a "wonderful" stay. Shakespeare sure would have found some words for it...

title: Should be better
text: After a long day we checked on here and I was pleasantly surprised to see work had booked somewhere nice, but it turned out that it was only the reception that's nice. Room was pretty grotty, as were the staircase up to the room. Bathroom was a bit mouldy too, with a pathetic shower. The only saving grace of this place is breakfast, it was great, with lots of variety.

title: Good location
text: I stayed here in September 2015 during my UK trip. We were here for three nights in a two bedroom. The two bedroom was converted from a living room, high ceiling, non-workable fireplace with a built in REALLY small 3 pieces bathroom. Whenever my travelling partner opens the bathroom door, the edge of the door would hit the corner of the bed. However, there was a fridge and kettle inside the room. The room had some troubles once in a while with the wireless internet, and the room stares out to the roof next door. The hotel is closed to the Paddington station - 5 mins walk and nearby restaurants and stores. The stores sell lower priced UK souvenirs compare to downtown stores but you're limited to a certain extent. There is a nearby park and the area is surrounded by hotels similar to Shakespeare Hotel. Beside the tube system, there are also buses nearby. The front desk people were nice and helpful. I didn't have troubles whenever I have questions or an inquiry if we could extend our hotel room by 1 hour longer. The breakfast - nothing fancy just your typical breakfast (eggs,toasts, waffles once in a while, cereal, juices, ham, cheese and etc). You have to go down early if you want a table and don't forget to bring your breakfast room card. Good place to stay if you're on a budget.

title: Our Paddington stay
text: The Shakespeare is in a handy location only a stone throw from the very busy Paddington Railway Station which makes it easy to get around to almost anywhere in London via the Tube or the other rail companies, of which there are many. The hotel itself is quite old with no lifts to help you get your luggage to the upper floors and the room that we were given was not as displayed in their online advertising. The continental breakfast provided as part of the room price was ok but you were made to pay for anything extra i.e. cooked bacon, sausage, tomato etc. The morning breakfast staff were very pleasant and efficient. Unfortunately we had to keep asking for toilet paper as the room staff seemed reluctant to leave a spare roll when it was required. Also, our room had a small balcony overlooking a nice park but you were not allowed to use the balconies as they were too dangerous. One big negative with the location of this hotel was that there was a Pub at the end of the road and every night the noise became louder and louder sometimes with people screaming and swearing until the early hours of the morning. We asked the desk clerk if they ever reported this to the police and they said they had on numerous occasions but the police did nothing. There was no Air Conditioning so we had to leave the doors to the balcony open to gain air flow. All in all, not too bad.

title: Great location
text: Really great location a stones throw from Paddington Station. Personnel were very friendly and helpful, both at reception and in the dining room. Rooms were comfortable. Stairs are steep if. You are concerned but understandable.

title: Value for money
text: Excellent location, wonderful service and an extraordinary breakfast make up for the tired rooms, lumpy bed and lack of lift. Definitely value for money. We would recommend for a family as we were travelling with 5.

title: Thank You Shakespeare Hotel
text: Back from 10 days in London and for the third consecutive year we stayed at Shakespeare Hotel in Paddington, which is a few metres away from the station. As always we were more than satisfied. Thank you Odysseas the professional receptionist for your service and guidance. You are the best. A big thanks goes to all the gentle staff. You are all fantastic.

title: Perfect for our London visit
text: We (4 adults, 2 rooms - each with 3 single beds) stayed at the Shakespeare Hotel in June 2018, during a severe heat wave. The fact that the rooms did not have air conditioning did not bother us at all, as we had rooms on high floors and were able to keep our windows open at night. The occasional train- or early birdsong noises honestly was not an issue and we appreciated the cool, fresh air. Yes, the building is old and chances are you would have to climb many stairs, as there are no elevators. The benefits - great, central location close to restaurants, Paddington Station, bus stops (also for the Hop-on-Hop-off buses), substantial breakfast and friendly service outweigh the negatives by far. I would definitely stay here again!

title: Horrible
text: Absolutely horrible. As soon as we got here they told us we had to wait for 2 hours to get into the room, only to have to carry my luggage up 4 flights of stairs since there is no elevator. I do not recommend this hotel to anyone, the room is small and the bathroom is even tinier. Not good.

title: Quad family room at first floor
text: We enjoyed our stay at the hotel, location is perfect near to bus, underground, Paddington train station, we were lucky to stay at quad room first floor, as there is no lift. Free wifi isn’t working all the time, breakfast is very good, delicious waffles, norfolk park is nice front view.

title: DISAPPOINTING! Dirty and Falling apart!
text: After looking at "mixed" reviews for this hotel we decided to go ahead and book. I was travelling with my husband and my two daughters (19 and 16) and we stayed for 5 nights from July 25-30th. Sometimes reviews can be very picky and fussy and we are most concerned with location and cleanliness so decided to give it a try. Unfortunately we happened to stay in July, the hottest summer since 1976. We had a "quad" room on the first floor which included 2 twin beds and 1 double bed. We noticed that the carpet was VERY dirty and the walls had many dirty areas on the wallpaper which was also tearing in several spots. The wooden trim in the room was coming off around the ceiling and the bathroom was the size of a very small closet. You could literally wash your hands in the sink while sitting on the toilet. The shower was barely big enough for one person and the shower door was accordion style so it folded in making it difficult to get into. Because of the heat the room never cooled off. There were large windows that went from floor to ceiling which we kept open when we were there during the day, but at night we didn't want to leave them open for safety reasons because they faced the street. They did manage to give us a small fan the second day which helped to at least move the air around while we slept. The beds were very poor and the mattresses in need of an update - hard on the sides and sagging in the middles. My husband had the English breakfast the first day, but it was very poor, and after staying in some B & B's prior to our London stop we definitely had something to compare. We stuck with the continental breakfast after that which was okay. The staff was very nice and we had no issues there at all and the location was good and just a 2 minute walk from Paddington Station. There was a lot of activity outside of the hotel and a small park in front where people would congregate and smoke so needless to say we inhaled a lot of second hand smoke having our windows open. All in all, I would say this hotel needs a facelift in a big way. They need to tear out the wallpaper and carpet and re-paint for sure. I would not stay there again in spite of it's location.

title: Perfect Location
text: I had a really nice stay here for 5 nights with my partner. It has a great location just one minute away paddington tube station and very close to the train station. Many nice restaurants around. Lovely clean hotel with extremely friendly staff. Odysseas at reception always helpful and always there to give you info about how to make the most of your visit in London. We will definitely come back

title: Don't ever come here
text: I stayed here for 1 night as a stop between flights and I have to say its the worst hotel I've ever stayed at (and I've stayed in some crappy places). When I first arrived I was told that my room was on the fourth floor and there were no lifts - which is fine! - but walking up the stairs was an experience in itself with the side of the stairs coming a part, dust everywhere and small gaps between the staircase and the next door (sometimes this was non-existant). When I got into the room, yes it was small but it appeared ok for what I paid for - nothing special - and had a faint mould smell which I discovered next in the bathroom. The ceiling of the bathroom was covered in mould that clearly no-ones bothered to address before, and with a broken shower head that (as I'm sure I'm not the only one out there) a satisfying shower after a long travel day was not actually achievable. The walls were better off being made of paper given the noise that came through - I am now on intimate terms with the guy staying next door and his partner's problems, the snorer who I'm pretty sure was staying further down the hall, the (what I'm assuming) was a group of german teenagers running up and down the hallway shouting and screaming all night and who may have even been the 'lets-pull-the-fire-alarm' culprit. Can't gove any commentry on the state of the breakfast meal: 1. I was just pretty keen to leave at that point, and 2. I wouldn't have been able to make it back up the stairs afterwards there were so many. All in all, if you value you're post-travelling shower, general comfort and cleanliness, then I suggest you look elsewhere.

title: Not too bad
text: Helpful staff. Conveniently located beside Paddington station. However, bed was terribly uncomfortable

title: exchange students experience
text: I stayed there 2 yeras ago while on a side trip for the exchange program and its was good for what we used it for. Its small and dingy and really kind of a crap hole in the wall but if your looking for a place that gives you an experience, stay there. We had a blast and the people who ran I though were very nice. We had breakfast every morning and then we went out to see the city. Its not bad. Not HIGH CLASS but not bad.

title: Very happy with my one night stay here.
text: My first impressions online of this hotel were good

title: very strategic location
text: Really very strategic location! reasonable price. close to bus stop ,train Station, convenient store, restaurants.. all within walking distance Although the room are small, but it's clean, and surround with quiet environment nice and simple breakfast, we really enjoy the breakfast.

title: Great location.... helpful staff..!!
text: It has an incredible location. 1/2 block from Peddington Station. Good places to eat at walking distance. The staff is very helpful

title: Excellent budget hotel
text: One of the nicest budget hotels I've stayed at in London. You can hear/feel the tube as you can in a lot of london but that's my only criticism really. Comfy bed. Small but not tiny room (had a double with single bed). Nice clean and fully functioning bathroom. Plenty of hanging space in a wardrobe. Nice view out to a typical london square and of course location brilliant for Paddington and access to the royal parks. Inclusive breakfast continental but worked for me as a veggy and did have scrambled egg which was really good. Even the machine coffee was nice. Great value overall. Would definitely book again.

title: Great place
text: Stayed for 2 nights

title: One night stay 30th May 2018
text: On arrival, I was greeted by three individuals whole just looked at me. Did not greet me at all. They were speaking in a foreign language up until I introduced myself. Two just stared and on abrupt man looked up my details, informed me of my room number, what floor it was on and the time of breakfast. All this without a single smile. My room was a very small triple on the fourth floor. On first impressions, the room was adequate, however closer inspection revealed that the room was very dusty, cracked mould tiles in the shower room and a large urine stain on the duvet. I am glad it was a one night stay. The rooms were hot and noisy as I could hear the water pipes running all night. This room was reasonably cheap, hence the fourth floor, however there is an excuse for filthy rooms and bad manners. There are however two redeeming features, the close location to the Station and a gentleman who was on reception in the morning who was very different and helpful. Offering to keep my travel case until the completion on my business in London which was very handy. When collecting my case at 6pm, the rude fellow had returned unfortunately.

title: I'll stay there again
text: Nice hotel at good place(bus line 159 and metro station two minutes walk). Hotel stuff are mostly non-english speakers so sometimes i can be hard to explain to them what do you need. Room was ok, clean and neat, but cold. Breakfast is excelent. So, if you want cheat but decent hotel for a short stay, i sincerely recommand this one. P.s. There is no free Wi-Fi and that's my biggest remark.

title: Incredible, especially for the price
text: A very nice hotel, located in a peaceful neighbourhood, a lot of cafés and restaurants nearby and a few general stores. A beautiful garden-park in front of the hotel. I required special assistance with some sensitive medicine I was carrying and the staff provided it even before the check in time. The staff was very polite at all times. My room was small, but with everything I needed, including a fridge and electricity sockets with a usb hub for charging a phone and a European plug adapter. The room was cleaned and tidied every day and i am very pleased with the quality of room maintenance. The breakfast was a little lacking in variety but was completely sufficient for the price. The hotel was incredible, the staff was extremely polite and helpful and the quality of service was high. Without hyperbolising the Shakespeare hotel was one of the highlights of my trip to London.

title: A hotel for sightseers
text: The rooms are small but enough for sleeping. The hotel was clean and it faced a nice park. It was close to many bus stops, underground station and restaurants as well. All the main and most famous places are easily reached from here, and you can also take long walks in the famous parks nearby.

title: Would be better named Hostel instead of Hotel ......
text: As a Hostel it would be reasonable, e.g. to clean the breakfast table by yourself and to have instant coffee for breakfast. In a Hotel I would expect a bit more. What is unacceptable: most fire exits are blocked!!! One exit corridor is used as luggage storage room. In the another they put the laundry and other things on a daily basis. This is Third World Standard and dangerous. Positive: Staff was friendly and helpful. I will definitely not go there again.

title: very good hotel, perfect location
text: I stayed at the Shakespeare for a second year in a row for 22 nights in February. From check in to check out, I never had any problems. Like last year I based myself at Paddington and did day trips out of London using BritRail. Nice hotel, literally a minute from Paddington station and heaps of food places, wonderful view of Norfolk Square, and to top it all, it snowed on my last day there. Will return again next year, thanks Shakespeare.

title: Helpful staff, great location, would stay again.
text: With just a few days in London, what matters most to a traveler is that problems are solved, staff are attentive and helpful, and needs are addressed. Your staff were all extremely helpful even when under pressure, happy to store our food in the fridge as our room didn't have one, the full continental breakfast was wonderful, and fresh milk was offered for our child when ours proved to be past its best. The only downside was the lack of a lift, but staff on hand when we checked in carried our bags for us. Just round the corner from Paddington with tube links and Heathrow Express when required. All in all a great place to stay for the money.

title: Very nice value
text: So I will start at the big pluses: location near Hyde park and public transport stations and amazing price with breakfast. I think this is one of the best value hotels in London. The bed was confortable and big enough for a couple. The room is nice and clean. The brakfast was not amazing, but it had the basics and we thought it was a nice meal. Recommended 100% for a 2/3 days stay in London. Also nice garden on front.

title: Brilliant location + room, excellent value for money!
text: Couldn't have picked a better hotel for our budget! The location was not only beautiful but so convenient!! The room was cute although the bathroom smelled a little. Bed was comfy, Internet was good and breakfast was great. Couldn't recommend this hotel more! We read reviews before our stay and were a little concerned but pleasantly surprised upon arrival so ignore the negative reviews and choose a hotel in an amazing location with a perfectly adequate room to rest your head in amongst a stay in the most wonderful city in the world!!

title: Interesting stay
text: The position of the hotel is fantastic. The staff are outstandingly helpful and friendly. Breakfast is fresh, filling & adequate. Good hot coffee. The rooms, being very clean, are varied in size which can make or break the hotel experience. We stayed 3 times in 10 days with a different room each time. 2 of the rooms were very small with one being the size of a small cupboard because we couldn't fit 2 large suitcases in the room at the same time. The 3rd room was large and airy and we could open the window. Overall we wouldn't stay here again but if you are happy with the experience of an upper class backpackers hotel, then this would be a good one. Very convenient to restaurants, cafes & pubs and so close to Paddington Station. And only about 10 mins walk to Hyde Park.

title: Liked This Hotel
text: I found this hotel cleaner, friendlier and more spruced up from other London hotels with this rating. The breakfast was a full English fryup with other options also available. The convenient location is simply the best with Paddington Station just around the corner and so many small ethic restaurants close by. The parkland is a decided perk. Have booked for next year.

title: It was much better than I expected
text: I found the hotel clean, efficient, and comfortable for an overnight stay conveniently close to Paddington Station.

title: Good service, budget hotel
text: I stayed here for one night. The location is great, it's just outside of Paddington station. The staff was pleasant and offered to move me upstairs to a bigger room, but with no elevator I chose to stay on the first floor. The room was small but functional. Toilet didn't flush, I called the front desk and they sent someone the next morning to fix it. Hot water was available. No carpet on the floors and dated wallpaper on the walls made the room feel a little old. But all in all, it was just a room to sleep in, offering a decent breakfast buffet, in a great location. Good budget hotel.

title: lousy as you can't even imagine
text: I normally stay in hostels and cheap places, so I'm ok with almost everything that comes on the way, but this hotel is like the worst place ever. All the staff was very unfriendly, even at breakfast time in the restaurant, waitresses kept looking at each other and laughing at guests. Bedsheets were dirty, not to talk about towels. We asked for them to be changed, we were told by the receptionist to leave them on the floor, I told the housekeeper to please change them, and when we came back, those towels were on the bed, nicely arranged, wet and dirty. When I went downstairs to complain, the receptionist was angry at me because I was making her work, and of course, I never got an apology. The receptionist only gave me two towels, not 4 (we were 4 people), we were told we would have the other 2 on the next morning, which didn't happen, I had to complain again, and when the new receptionist opened the fresh towels bag, one of them was ll dirty, I mean, how is that possible? I booked 4 nights and they made my reservation for just 3, I still don't know why. This trip was my mum's birthday present from my sister and I, so you can imagine how happy we were... Stay at the St David's hotel, which is next door and far better!!

title: Four nights at the Shakespeare Hotel
text: Good english breakfast every morning at the hotel, secured the first hours of "touristing" the streets of London. Only 3 minuted to Paddington station, and even shorter to the bus (at the corner). We will be back.

title: Awesome location, but very old and outdated
text: First of all, the location is really good. It's next to a underground station and in the center of London. Unfortunately, it's really old and too small. I was with my school class for 1 week in London, we had to sleep in the "basement". It was hard to sleep, because the underground was really loud. The service is friendly and helpful, but the hotel and the furniture are just too old. Pro -> Location,Service Contra -> Sleep Quality, Rooms, Cleanliness

title: Free Noise at the Shakespeare
text: It was certainly cheap and it was certainly nasty. Of course in this part of London you will find hundreds of this type of hotel and while you may say to yourself I am only sleeping there I am not living there - if you can -don't. The location is only around the corner from Paddington tube and national rail station to be sure and there are some great staff but at the end of the day you have the circle line benath you running 24/7 and the area itself is cheap and dodgy. It is some walk to anywhere of any consequence - Hyde Park is a good 15 mins through suburbia. The breakfast included in the tariff is enough to put you off your food for a week. The flat offered is at the bottom of the hotel and all the underground trains make for a background noise you can do without. There are cooking and washing facilities but neither work well and the "selfcatering"options are limited due to the lack of utensils, crockeryand cutlery, pots/pans and the fact that the stove top has an on again/off again relationship with the electric ignition switch. The grill works in a fashion but the oven is verschtikt. Save a bit more and stay somewhere in Kensington. You won't regret it.
