title: Awful
text: Terrible for a family of 5 including a 2 year old with luggage. We were on the 3rd floor with no lift which was a difficult task to reach our room. The bunk beds had mattresses which sat higher than the safety rails which deems the safety rails useless. The double bed was 2 singles pushed together which looked like they were made by the hotel handyman! I coukd go on but I'd be here all day, so all i will add is i won't be visiting again

title: Nice hotel
text: I had a single room, nice size clean. Great for the money I paid. Other hotels were double its price and proberly not even as good. Breakfast was ok the norm. They also had a pool table and games machine. I'd be happy to stay here again.

title: One Night Stay
text: Stayed at this hotel for one night on a visit to London with my adult son. We had single rooms B&B at a very reasonable rate and, although in separate parts of the hotel, they were both clean and comfortable with all the basics. The staff were very welcoming and friendly. Breakfast was plain but perfectly adequate to set you up for the morning. In addition to a comfortable reception area (with a pretty impressive original fireplace) there was a room with a pool table for younger guests which was a definite plus. This hotels location is excellent - looking out onto the very pleasant Norfolk Square yet conveniently close to Paddington Station, with many shops, eateries and transport links close by. Hyde Park is just 7 minutes walk away. I would happily recommend this hotel to family/friends, but if traveling with an elderly relative or lots of luggage you might be wise to request a ground floor/first floor room as the stairs (being original) are a little steep and narrow.

title: Nice and simple.
text: First of all let me start off saying this is a great hotel if you just need somewhere to put your head down. It is in a fantastic location (which can boast a minute or 2 walk from Paddington underground/ Train station.) As I stayed on my own in the hotel, I booked a single room

title: Good location
text: We needed a place to rest after a tiring day visiting London, a hot shower, a bed and a breakfast the next day. All of that we found in the Shakespeare hotel. The location of the hotel is wonderful,near Paddington station.Plenty of lovely restaurants around.But the rooms need heating and better cleaning.Hotel needs renovation,so if you are looking for luxury this is not hotel for you.But staff on reception is very friendly and very helpfull :)

title: DON'T DO IT!
text: Well let me start by saying if there is remotely a thought of staying at this hotel throw it out of your thoughts and never think about it again. By far the worst hotel I have every stayed at. I actually wouldn’t even call it a hotel, more like a hostel. We had a travel agent pick it on my family’s behalf and she based the choice on the location. I did find where it was situated that we could walk to most of the important things to see in London so I will give them credit for that. We attempted to make the best of it but it was a greater challenge than we were up for... Our room was on the top floor and of course no elevator in the building, which we did expect because of the age… but dragging 3 suitcases up 4 narrow flights of stairs was horrible and not ideal. We were already so tired from a full day of travelling and just wanted to rest, no matter what it had to get done but it would have been nice if one of the employees had offered to help. We got a room for 3 people and when we opened that door we found a SMALL room with 3 single beds and a bathroom. We had no room to store our luggage comfortably so bags were left on the ground to step over or around. Sleep quality was ridiculous. Each bed was on wheels so as soon as you hopped into bed you actually rolled down because the room was on a slant… and then of course there were the thin walls so you could hear the screaming arguments from the younger people down the hall. Stayed there for 3 nights and let’s just say I didn’t sleep much in that time. Rooms were not the cleanest. I saw a lady one day with a vacuum but I am more than certain that she never came into our room even before we checked in. Towels that were provided were never replaced and were the size meant for a small child. They also have you give a deposit for using the remote for the TV in the room which you do get back but I think that’s a little silly. They don’t have hairdryers in the room so again you have put a deposit down to borrow one but that’s only if you’re lucky and they actually have one for you to borrow. I asked each day I was there and even left a note for the staff that if they have a hair dryer returned to “please let me know “and I never ended up getting one. All around the hotel is not my first choice, not my second choice, not even my last… it’s completely off my radar. For the amount of money you spend to stay there, it isn’t worth it. Please do yourself a favour and book elsewhere.

title: Great Location, terrible stuff
text: We've ordered a family room almost 2 (two!) months ahead, to be sure , we also emailed the hotel and got assurance and confirmation to our reservation. As this hotel doesn't have lift and it has 4 (four) floors - we wanted to make sure we get a room in the first floor. When we got there, the receptionist informed us "they gave OUR room to another family..so sorry for you" and also added "we'll help you find another room in another hotel in the area .." . After we frightened them we'll take them to the court and make them out of business, they suddenly found two rooms for us.Apparently, good location is not worth such surprises , it's waste of money to pay for breakfast as you can eat better, rich and tasty breakfast for only 7 GBP just around the corner. So save your money and if you must stay near Paddington - choose the dolphin hotel - it's the same chain- but nicer rooms and nicer stuff.

title: Perfect For One Night
text: My partner and I stayed here for one night after seeing a show at the West End. We weren't expecting too much but were pleasantly surprised. Room was clean and simple. We were surprised by it being a large 5 bed room rather than the standard double we ordered, but this wasn't a problem. Bathroom was good too, small but enough for 2 people for a night or two. Breakfast was simple but good, toast, waffles, cereals, etc. The reason for the loss of a star is the stairs with no lift, as we were on the 3rd floor so climbing the many stairs was tiring. Of course we understand it's just the way the building layout is. It is a beautiful building and the staff were polite. Would definitely stay again. For the price it is very good.

title: would happily stay again with my family ...
text: I stayed at Shakespeare Hotel for one night - last Sunday ... terrible train journey from Devon ... aimed to arrive at 11.30 pm ... very late for me, but sadly a fatality on line meant all change at Reading .... slow train via Waterloo, which meant I arrived at 1.30 plus am, after a full days work ... excellent and helpful check in - Thank you ... secure, and helpful. Excellent 3 bed room ... and a mini bar ( ie a fridge if I needed it) - flat screen TV , very good en suite , copious supply of tea and coffee - great room --- Thank you .... just a shame I was so shattered I couldn't fully use room ... will I be back ? ---YES, and with my family. Thank you. A 'budget' hotel may be, but a very, very good one ...

title: Clean budget hotel ,with great staff and excellent customer services
text: I arrive at the Shakespeare Hotel without any confirm reservation and an incident took place where I was mug with my wallet stolen from me, it was around 03:00 am, at reception there was a night receptionist by the name of Ashvin, I explain to him what really happen to me, I had ask him if I could call my mother and ask her to pay for my accommodation over the phone, he told me that normally the hotel does not accept this procedure, but then was welling to help, I got my mum to call back the hotel and she gave all her details to pay for my accommodation, the receptionist went out of his way to help as a human being, I call this a great customer service that I did not expect . He gave me a very nice and clean single room with English breakfast included. I will definitely recommend this hotel to my friend and family who want a place to stay in London. Paul Everton Great Yarmouth

title: Lovely location but poor management
text: Location of this hotel is lovely as it is near the Paddington undergound and the Paddington Station. We had booked two rooms for three nights in late September. When we check-in, we were told that the rooms were at different buildings. We were shcoked as we booked the rooms in June but they could not arrange the two rooms even at the same building. The reason was that the hotel was very full. We asked for if they could re-arrange the rooms but the male staff refused and told us that we could contact by phone. when we insisted, he promised to arrange to change the room for the last night. So we had to take our heavy luggage to climb up the stairs at 3/F and the other room of our friend was at 2/F in other building. To be frank, I did not expect it was a three stars hotel but I was a little bit disappointed when we got in the room. there were three beds, a chair and a tiny table. we could not open our luggage on the floor as the room was so small. No A/C, we had to open window to have fresh air. Timber floor would crack when you step. more worst was the shower room. the door lock was broken therefore you could not lock the door. shower sprinkler was broken so water was leaking from the middle of handle and the connection joint of the water tape. it was very frustrated when you washed your hair. the water was so weak that you must take more than 10 minutes to washed out bubbles of shampoo. I lodged a complaint to the front desk in the morning next day and asked for maintenance for the sprinkler. the girl Keyla jotted down the case but not promise to complete the job as maintenance staff would not be on duty on Sunday. therefore, when we get back to the hotel in the night after a day out, the problem was not improved. So I had to got to the shower room at the lower floor to have my shower. You know what, the floor drain was stuck and I had to finish my shower in three minutes. I expected the situation would be better if we could change room in the last day. we confirm with the male staff at the front desk at next day morning if we could change the room. he confirmed the arrangement and agreed to move our packed luggage to the new room as the room was just the one next to our previous one. The room of my friend would not be changed. We were shcoked again when we back to the hotel in the night, the girl Keyla told us that our luggage was not packed so that they could not change our room. I told her that it was impossible for I had packed the luggage before I went out. We realized that they made the mistake as they want to move the luggage of our friend in another room. I was very very disappointed with the confusion. although I had my room changed but there was the same problem of the sprinkler. Overall speaking, breakfast was just OK but the attitute of the maid handle toast was bad. Impolite when we asked if waffle was ready. there is plenty of room for improvement of staff performance. Keyla and the other guy, likely is a supervisor at the front desk when we check-out were good. the guy asked us what happened and apology for the inconvence caused. In fact the facilities and service of this hotel was far from satisfactory. We moved to another hotel in Earl's Court and everything was alright. I do think this Shakespeare and Dolpin Hotel was just priced for its location.

title: Thank you Shakespeare hotel!
text: Very friendly and flexible! Cozy accommodation. All only best emotions! They always find you a solution and help you with planning the stay. I recommend highly this hotel to be your next choice. Bravo!

title: basic
text: we stayed here for 3 nights, the location is great about 2 mins walk from paddington station, we were greeted at reception by very friendly staff. we had a 2nd floor room, which was clean and tidy but basic, the ensuit is very tiny, which may be a problem if your on the larger side! The included continental breakfast was ok, you can pay extra for a full english but we werent that bothered, our biggest fault with the hotel was the lack of sound proofing yes you can hear the tubes( more vibration) but you get used to that( they cant help this),, but hearing everything from the other guest was annoying especially when they roll in at 04.45am perhaps a carpeted floor might of helped stop this, if they improved the sound proofing alot, we would stay again

title: Never again!
text: Only select this hotel if you like mould, noise, dirt everywhere and old, damaged furniture. The staff was extremely unfriendly - some did not even speak English. This is more a youth hostel than a hotel. The guests and the tube running just behind the hotel are extremely noisy, so do not expect silent nights. The bathroom was so tiny that you couldn't even close the door behind you when you were standing in front of the washbasin. The toilet and shower were also in a very poor state. In the kitchen they have a plate on the wall: "Customer says: my money pays your wages!" No further comment! I liked the situation though. Paddington is not a very nice quarter, but there are a lot of nice little shops and the tube station at only 3 minutes.

title: :/ Not the night I was hopping for
text: My girlfriend and me booked a night for a great weekend in London, but actually in this hostel, only the staff is kind. However they can't fix all the problems it as in this hostel. From the bed to the bathroom the hostel is old and bad maintained. Don't sleep there, the price is awfull compared to what you get. Actually I recomand not to sleep there even if it was half the price.

title: Decent price, decent reception, terrible stay.
text: Paying extra for internet was annoying, and a class of students were staying above me resulting in several calls to reception consecutive nights. Great location, around the corner from paddington ! Stairs are crazy steep. Would look at other hotels in the area (several)

title: Meh
text: The hallway was super dirty. Old carpet and the unique rails would be much nice if there wasn't layers of dust on them. Thankfully we had a bathroom in our room. Hearing people use the facilities and coming out of the water closest on the stairway was a bit uncomfortable. There is no lift so be prepared to carry your bag up many stairs. My 70yr mothers wasn't even offered help by the staff. Real fast was decent. Very friendly staff for breakfast. On our second night the night staff was very accommodating. He found us extra pillows and towels, as there weren't nearly enough in the room. Paddington is a nice area. There are lots of hotels around and pubs. Many of the pubs stop serving food at 9/10pm. Not worth staying in the area if you are looking for night life. Train station and underground station are very easy to navigate and lots of helpful staff there. I'll stay somewhere else on my next visit.

title: Good budget hotel
text: A good location in Paddington. Round the corner from Paddington tube station, plenty of places to eat and drink in the area and only a 5-10 minute walk to Hyde Park (we were there for a Green Day gig) Hotel were happy for us to leave bags until we could check in at 2pm. Staff were friendly. Had a room on reception level. Bed was comfortable, plenty of space. Bathroom on the small side, shower head you had to actually hold which wasn't ideal. You can hear noise from trains and feel vibrations (can't be helped due to proximity of stations nearby) Also had a smell of sewerage in the room when we came back in the evening, and there is no air con so it can get pretty warm! Although there were a few little niggles, they didn't ruin our stay. I would more than likely stay here again. Great for people on a budget or a quick stay in London.

title: Convenient location for Tube, train and other London sights
text: The hotel is convenient to Paddington Station, maybe a 7 minute walk (once I stopped going the wrong way), and is in a neighborhood of small hotels. Checking in was super easy, and I received my breakfast voucher at that time (which I either forgot about or didn't realize was included, either way - bonus). Then I realized there was no lift/elevator and I was on the second floor - which is really the third floor, and I had to haul my suitcase, which now seemed to weigh 100 pounds, up the narrow staircase. I was in a room on the right which was away from other rooms, which was nice. The room was tiny, but once I figured out how to maneuver and use the space, it was kind of cozy. There is actually a notice posted by the hotel that says you cannot bring anyone to your room

title: Keep looking!
text: I live locally, but for various reasons just needed a bed for one night. The place was awash with kids running riot, so much so that at 1am in the morning I had to ring down to reception to demand they did something about the shouting and slamming doors. Facilities otherwise couldn't be more basic. No hairdryer, shampoo or tea making facilities etc etc. Also very long climb to my attic room thanks to no lift. If the kids weren't enough to keep you awake, there was also the din from the tube trains which run just behind the hotel. Management must really do better for what is really just a two star dump.

title: Comfy Room!
text: Booked a Single Room at Dolphin Hotel actually but the room i preferred was not ready upon check-in. So the nice lady at the reception offered their sister hotel - Shakespeare which is just next door. So i walked to the Shakespeare Hotel, got a room (834) on the ground floor right behind the reception. The room was bigger than expected for a single room. Have separate toilet & standing shower, but bear in mind that the toilet & standing shower are at different side of the corner. It's not a big issue anyway. Very comfy bed, I had very good sleep during the nights. Hot shower some time to work so basically the first few minutes you just gotta shower in cold water until the hot shower actually works. For the light sleepers, you might not want this room as the staircase down to breakfast hall is just beside the room, so you will have "morning calls" every morning when the breakfast starts - staff preparing breakfast, guests going up & down for breakfast... Breakfast was ok, basic but OK. Location is really really good, just few minutes walking distance from the Paddington Station. There are restaurants, cafes, shops around the hotel. For those Big Bus fans, there is a bus stop right at the corner of the street.

title: Good place for few nights
text: It was really good stay for 2 nights at Shakespeare Hotel. While initially I've booked a room for 2 - later we needed our daughter to join us due to art exhibition in London and via few emails exchange with staff member Odysseas everything was sorted out in very professional way and triple room was ours. View from the second floor was really nice to old trees and street below wasn't noisy at all. For breakfasts I would only wish if hotel would have some fresh veggies in the menu. Location of hotel is really good to reach Paddington station and it's my advice to spend some time and walk towards Paddington basin, where both variety of food and some water attractions are available.

title: No Recommendation
text: I've been here for 5 days. The room was very tiny and our bathroom had mold in the shower and on the window. There's not really a "room service" only a person who fixes your bed and even sometimes looks at your luggage ( someone tried to crack our luggage code ). The room was even damaged ( chairs and bed ). The Staffs here is not polite at all, they rushed us out every single day at breakfast ( not even that much variation ). The only point in staying at this hotel is its location.

title: Disgusting hotel, unhelpful staff and false advertising
text: Please be warned, this is not how it looks on the web site. We stayed over for 1 night and had booked a double room but were given an awful room on the top floor with 3 tiny single beds. We went back to reception to be told we were 'lucky', as there was a double room free (number 843). On entering this room we were again very disappointed in the room. It was tiny with a small double bed pushed up against the wall. Decor was dated and the 'en suite' bathroom appeared to be in a cupboard with a gap in the door and no lock, the kettle was faulty causing a burn to my hand.....no apology given. Breakfast the next morning was equally disappointing. We booked for an English cooked breakfast but were given the wrong cards so were offered continental only. When we complained we were told sorry, there had been a mistake and would be able to have the cooked breakfast after all. But, instead of being asked what we would like, we were just presented with a fry up, all in, whether we liked the individual elements or not. Nobody in the group was able to finish their breakfast as it contained items they did not like. The second room in our group unfortunately developed a sewage like smell in the middle of the night which remained until morning (room 111). At no point were any apologies made by the staff and we were made to feel wrong for bringing up these issues. Needless to say we will not be returning to The Shakespeare Hotel.

title: Met or exceeded expectations
text: We chose the hotel because it was just a 5 minute walk away from Paddington rail/underground station and it was affordable. It was actually better than we expected (we'd stayed at another hotel in the same neighbourhood and would never stay *there* again). The check-in was easy and efficient (we arrived early and they let us leave our luggage while we walked about), the bed was comfortable, the bathroom tiny but clean and modern, the breakfast was more generous than we expected (scrambled eggs or boiled eggs, cold cuts, cheeses, waffles in addition to toast, cereal, etc.). The only drawback was that our ground-floor room was at the bottom of an airshaft and the folks above us stayed up late, talking, with the window open). But overall, this served our needs very well

title: you can not turn your but, but it was very nice
text: It was a nice low-budget hotel. The rooms were quite small. and the two-person bed was for midgets. the bathroom was very small too. but the positive thing: you could wipe your but with the shower curtain. so don't be surprised when it's a brown spotted curtain. but what can you expect for such a good price? Yes, there was a tv in the room, with one channel. The service of the german ladies was excelent. but every time we went to the reception they asked us if we were checking out. did we smell that bad? But overall we had a very nice stay

title: Should be SHUT DOWN
text: I have stayed in a lot of hotel's but this one was a disgrace. I will be writing a letter of complaint to the English Tourist Board . This Hotel should be down rated to a Youth Hostel instead of its current rating (Hotel). The rooms are disgusting, the beds were not made properly, no clean towels, no clean cups for Tea & Coffee. Even the television did not work, you can get better viewing in third world countries. Basic hygiene was ignored and should be reported. There are so many complaints regarding this hotel, I am so disappointed that it is still open. I am aware it is reviewed as a low budget hotel and the website photos look nice but after staying there the pictures on the web are nothing like the hotel at all, they should review this page and change there photos, but then they would not have any guest apart from drunks and certain types of people looking for a room for the night.t All the other hotels on Norfolk Square were much lower in price which would fit the accommodation. We did complain to the Manager, he told us that we could move to another room, but the rooms that he showed us were much worse. The service in this hotel is a total shambles, the best type of guest for this hotel is animals. I think even the animals in London Zoo have better accommodation.

title: Adequate and friendly
text: We needed an overnight stay for a theatre night in the capital. Not going to lie, we searched for the cheapest hotel in the central London area. And up popped the Dolphin Hotel near Paddington. No, I'm not reviewing the wrong hotel. The Dolphin is next door and they provided a room at the Shakespeare We didn't ask why... Room 123 was easy enough to find, was an adequate size and had twin beds. Pushed together, we had a nice size bed to share. I booked through a 3rd party website, so no blame to the hotel there... The hotel is set in Victorian era buildings and the older charms are still evident. The fireplace was a lovely focal point of the room. The ensuite was a later addition and was really nice - clean and modern. The room had a full-size fridge, drink-making kit and a wide screen TV. A little modernisation may be in order soon though, as the decor is a little dated and worn in places. The view from our balcony wasn't great, but we were only on the first floor and facing the rear of the property, so hey... Being one of the closest hotels to Paddington, We weren't surprised to hear a train or two gently rumbling nearby. Our sleep wasn't disturbed by them, but light sleepers should ask to be near the front of the building. Breakfast was included and this comes in the form of a self-service continental breakfast including ham, cheese, toast, fresh waffles (a lovely touch), fruit, yoghurt, boiled and scrambled eggs as well as toast, cereals, hot and cold drinks. Cooked breakfasts are available for an extra cost. Advice for the hotel: dairy and meats should be refrigerated while serving. The yogurt was not chilled and was a little unpleasant. Checkout was easy and quick and the staff are the credit to this hotel. Would we stay again? Yes... But keep an eye on the catering...

title: very kind
text: it was very great to stay in this hotel. people are kind and very helpful. the breakfast was good. it's great located. room are simply but just enough for us with tv and tea commodities. in one word : perfect!

title: stay at shakespeare hotel.
text: Good location, just a corner away from Paddington Station. Walking distance from Marble Arch and Oxford Street. As regards the room, a small disappointment was the lack of a small tube of shampoo, and the fact that used towels are not replaced on a daily basis. Breakfast was basic but ample. An overall pleasant stay. Highly recommended for the budget traveler.

title: Nice stay, cheap price
text: We spent 4 nights in this lovely hotel, 2 adults + 3 kids. Obviously spaces are tight but it is because the building is original Victorian age. The hotel is clean, receptionist very kind and breakfast is great. The hotel is located in a wonderful position with tube and bus a few steps from it. Don't miss Micky's fish&chisp just behind the corner, if you need a fast and easy dinner after having walked the whole day. I would definitively suggest Shakespeare Hotel for a reasonable price, comfortable stay.

title: Tiny Room, but cosy.
text: 1. Stayed from 7 Sep - 11 Sep 2016, in room 444 (last room at the top-most floor). 2. It was a single room with en-suite bathroom/toilet. 3. Room was very tiny and narrow, but had a small working fridge and flat screen tv, and a window. 4. There is no air-conditioning, but I requested for and was provided a table fan which worked fine. 5. Shower area is super small, but ok for someone who is not too large in size. 6. Body wash provided in a receptacle attached to the wall of the bath area. 7. Towels are provided (1 for bath, 1 for hand). 8. Bed mattress was a little bit springy. 9. One would need to be very economical with space, especially on placement of luggage bags. 10. Housekeeping was very efficient every day. Room was always clean. 11. English breakfast was provided (at no extra cost, for my package) at the dining room in the basement. Simple, but nice. 12. Free wifi in room was unpredictable, in terms of signal strength. 13. Would recommend that hotel management consider providing guests access to a microwave, to heat up food. 14. Had to climb steep stairs on daily basis to highest floor (4th floor). Not an issue for me. However, may be a challenge for the elderly, disabled or infirm. 15. Staff helped me bring my heavy luggage bag up and down from room during check in / check out. 16. Reception helped me book a taxi for my last day, with no issues. 17. Overall, staff are helpful, efficient and friendly.

title: Great Location, good place to clean up and get some sleep.
text: The hotel was walking distance from the Paddington Station, and right in front of the sussex gardens. Well, i made the booking through Dnata Travels which is a UAE based company and i got a good rate. This is a budget hotel i would say and is located right at the heat of Paddington, walking distance to restaurants, pubs and small grocery shops which came in handy during my 2 night stay at this hotel. The breakfast was average toast and butter with cheese slices and meat slices, just average. I was traveling with my mother so i requested a room in the ground floor and i was given a room in the basement. Had direct access to the main road from the room and the bathroom was not en suit so it was a bit of an issue. Overall this is a budget place to to spend a few days in the beautiful city. Keep in mind, they don't have air conditioning in the room.

title: Clean, comfortable and a great location close to Paddington Station
text: Hotel clean and comfortable with all requirements. Great staff, Excellent service and free wifi. We stayed at Shakespere for 10days. On our first night had a problem with our room and was settled in no time. Thanks to all the staff especially to Odysseas who was my very first contact from the day I did the booking till the very last day. I would surely go back to Shakespeare Hotel, and would highly recommend it.

title: OK hotel
text: Room was okay, good location, but breakfast is kind of chaotic and not that much to choose from. We were waiting for over half an hour on one of the days to get our breakfast served.

title: Value for money, maybe.
text: Positives first, clean, large room, mostly friendly staff. Breakfast OK but no more. It was possible to leave luggage before check-in and after check-out. Negatives. Got a room in the basement, and the nearby underground was noisy and the furniture rattled when the trains passed. Same for the floors above, did not try higher up. No elevator.

title: Location @ Paddington
text: Located at the heart of Paddington - 5 mins walk to Station and a lot of eateries and convenience stores all around. The breakfast was good, the hotel is clean and the staff are helpful - Mr. Konstantinos kept my request for a Ground Floor Room !

title: Cheap & Cheerful hostel hotel. Good value Great location.
text: Turn of the century row house converted into hotel. In an area of London with hundreds of small family owned B&B's the Shakepeare is a stand out for its cleanliness and modern upgrades. Chosen for location and price this tiny hotel did not disappoint. The room was small but had all amenities required-kettle, flat screen tv, comfortable bed, ensuite, ample towels and local brochures. The consierge will arrange taxi pick up and gives good directions. Paddington Station for trains, tube and Heathrow Express is a 2 minute walk away. Easy walk to Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. It can be noisy and would not necessarily recommend for families with young children but this is to be expected when booking hostel type accommodation in any city.

title: It was excellent!!!
text: me and a friend of mine werw in "Shakespeare hotel" for a week,The room was lovely, Clean bathroom, always have hot water,Breakfast excellent and rich! And service excellent! And most importantly the location was excellent! Thank you! nisso shalev and chen :)

title: Good location, nice hotel
text: Good location, good public transport in the vicinity, good pubs and shops in the vicinity, quiet area and rooms, nice, friendly, helpful staff, good breakfast, cleanliness, good price. There is nothing wrong with the hotel or staff!

title: No good at all
text: Dirty hotel, the cleaning services were no good at all. The bathroom (through the sewage) was constantly smelling terrible. Breakfast no good. Breakfast time only 7:15-9:15 (not suitable for vacation time). Too noisy. the floors from above along with the water tubes were making too much noise. Check-out at 10:40 (first time I experienced this). Internet only with charge (we new that before we chose the hotel). It was cheap but I WOULD NEVER RECOMMENDED IT, even to my enemies. We had chosen it because it is only 3 minutes walk from the Paddington Station.

title: Budget Hotel - But a nice experience
text: The rooms are a bit small and with no lifts - however, the breakfast was excellent and plentiful to keep everyone satisfied for the mornings. The staff were excellent. Both at the reception and at breakfast I found all the help that I needed and sometimes even went beyond what I expected. The hotel is situation just one corner away from Paddington underground station in a very quite area. Considering both the price and the location of the hotel I think that it is worth every sterling that I paid

title: Ruined my stay in London
text: Stayed for 3 nights before travelling north. Chosen because it was near Paddington Station and hotel was advertised as 2 star. Place was disgusting. Dirty and torn carpets. Bags of dirty laundry left in hallways. No lift, no offer to help with luggage. A group a overseas students caused havoc every night. Running up and down the stairs, in the street, shouting, screaming and slamming the fire doors until mid-night every night. Staff would do nothing about their behaviour when I complained. Tea room was overtaken by them watching sports on the TV. Other guests were told they couldn't go in to make tea or coffee. Only one towel was supplied for the whole 3 days. TV reception was terrible. Bed lamp was so strong previous guests had burnt the wooden bed head (fire hazard). Staff were unfriendly and didn't have any knowledge of area. Was booked in for another night before my return home. Was given another room, with bunk beds, where the shower drain would back up and overflow when used. Not 2 star. Not much more than a cheap backpackers accommodation. Travelled June 2008.

title: Great for budget stay !!!
text: Great place to stay on a budget. I was in London for a few days on a business trip. The rooms are small but very clean and the staff very friendly and helpful. Breakfast needs improvement (little sealed portions of butter, jam, nutela, would improve things) but the freshly made waffles are great. The 24h reception is very handy and the staff friendly. A special thanks to Odisea who helped me organize my limited free time after work so I could see the most of London. see you again in a few months hoping for a bigger room.

title: Fine for a basic room
text: Very close to Paddington and cheap which was the main reasons for choosing. Check-in was quick and luckily only on level 1. The room was basic but did the job. Loved all the plug outlets but wish it had free wifi. I was worried from reading other reviews but it was fine for one night. We opened up our balcony at night as it was very hot that day but we enjoyed the breeze. It was a bit loud on the street form some teens but not the hotel's fault. Would stay again if needing a short stay in that area.

title: Most important, CLEAN.
text: For value for money with budget accommodation the Shakespeare ticks all the right boxes. On arrival check in was quick and easy I got to my room on the fourth floor and it's a fair stair climb! I think it would be easier to climb Everest and that's the only reason for loosing a star. My room was small but very clean and comfortable with a piping hot clean shower and a bloody big flat screen TV. Breakfast was good with nothing over the top. Nice little hotel and will return!

title: Good value great staff
text: This hotel was just fine for the price. The sheets are clean. The shower is clean. The staff are incredibly hard-working and friendly. There is a pool table. The location is awesome. There's no elevator. Our family was there for two nights and it was sufficient. The walls are thin so you can hear the other guests easily.

title: Great location, great deal
text: I stayed here on the last night of my trip. I was flying out the next morning but didn't want to pay a ton of money to stay in the airport hotel. This place was perfect. It's literally right around the corner from the Paddington Station so getting to the airport was a breeze. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. I would stay here again.

title: Quiet and comfortable
text: Stayed here for one night with my sister in late November. We had booked a twin room in the Dolphin Hotel next door, but on arrival, were told that we were to be accommodated in the sister hotel, Shakespeare. Plastic bags piled near the entrance were not encouraging, but once inside we were warmly welcomed. Our room was on the ground floor - with a window that opened - and we had a double and a single bed, in a room, that judging from the fire 'map' on the wall, was one of the larger rooms. The room was clean and the beds, though firm, were comfortable. A little disappointed to find that only a powdered 'creamer' was offered with the usual tea/coffee sachets, but the guy on Reception was most obliging in giving me a small jug of real milk to make a decent cup of tea. The fridge in the room was a great bonus to keep the remainder of the milk till morning. Only a very short walk from the tube/train station, the hotel was in a relatively quiet area, and the rumble of the underground tube was easily ignored. Breakfast was adequate and the fact that we could leave our bags after checking out, was a great bonus. Delighted to have found a reasonably priced hotel in such a convenient location and circumstances allowing, would happily make a return visit.

title: Moved to another Hotel they owned.
text: I arrived at the hotel to find that they had moved me to another hotel they owned, on the other side of the road. They explained there were safety issues with the room but did not explain. So I moved to the Royal Eagle, which has its own problems.

title: Not worth it by a long shot!
text: I stayed in room 406 for 4 days in april.2012. This is a double room, with loads of problems. The floor is completely worn down. Holes in the floor after the bedpoles. The toilet had a broken lid, and the flusher didnt work. (I allso found my bogroll on the side of the toilet, since the holder was damaged.) The sink, and bathtub was clogged, and water bubbled up in the bathtub when I used the sink. After a quick shower, the tub used prox 4 hours to empty. Day 3 it clogged completely, and the manager had to use chemicals to fix it. The bedsheets lie on the floor when they clean your room, so expect to find gravel in your bed. Another issue is that this room has a door to the neighbour room. So you will hear EVERYTHING happening there. It's like sharing a room divided by a bedsheet. The door is made with a venting slot underneath so that air (sound, and smell) can pass through. The painted walls where full of moisture damage. This is a real healthissue! You can see the black fungi all over the wall. This allso occurring in the breakfast room. Here you find horrible moisture damaged walls, with black fungi litterally running down in streams from it. I regret not taking pictures to prove it, but this is just horrifying... Please send healthinspectors, and close this place... I am dead serious! You would probably be better off sleeping in the public toilet in Hyde Park! All the staff was smiling and happy, but that is not enough...

title: The worst hotel ever
text: I'm a seasoned traveler and always manage to find comfortable hotel through internet booking. When I first arrived at this hotel, I was so shocked, the room was so small, nothing like being shown on the internet, I could hardly walk in the room since there's only enough space to put our luggage. To make things worse, the sheet and the bathroom was dirty, I even get bug bites in the room. What I was so angry was, the male Indian receptionist was so rude to my family, the worse service ever!!!!!! The reason I stayed at the hotel was because others were fully booked, and I advise others not to stay at this hotel, because it sucks in every way.

title: Comfy rooms
text: Very close to Paddington station with a nice neighborhood. It was kind of small room but also very cozy. The rooms where clean and also a nice toilet. Friendly staff who recommended places not to miss when you are in London

title: Worst hotel I have ever stayed in.
text: Listen to all the other reviews ... i didn't and i regretted it. The rooms are coffin sized, the man at reception seemed to hate his job and when I voiced my complaint he just shrugged me off. The hotel is so noisy that I only managed about 2 hours of sleep, i was put next to the lift which never stops, you can hear the conversation of the next room as if they were in yours. The bed was dirty and the breakfast which I paid extra for was just cheese and ham on cold toast with a yoghurt. The breakfast table was dirty, a woman came and said that she was sorry the table was dirty, she walked away without taking any of the dirty plates that were there before we got to the table. The fact that this hotel can have the audacity to charge over £100 a night on some days is ridiculous for the standard that you receive. Stay at another hotel.

title: Ideal
text: Ideal location. I found the room basic and not more than i expected for a London 3 star. The staff were helpful and the rooms small but clean with better bathroom than expected. Short walk 200mts to Heathrow express station and buses,underground.

title: Don't take this hotel...please...
text: I was reading some reviews and I don't know why I didn't take the advise of others...really, I don't know :-( I don't know how to describe the hotel... Just, don't go... The room was so small that I had to go OVER my girlfriend in order to exit the bed...yes..believe... The double bed had ONLY one side out of the wall...so, each time I/she want to go out the bed, we had to jump over the other. The service...really bad. The people are not friendly and never, I say, NEVER they smile to us. The TV had only 3 chains and no remote control... no way to make understand the receptionist that they shoud check it... The electrical cables (and, believe, I know what I'm talking about) where without protections and were a danger for people. The breakfast machines for bread, coffee...etc, didn't work!!! Well, probably you are reading and thinking that I'm hard with them...but, just before going to the room, read the guest book in the left of the entrance...you will see some "nice" comments that people did before you. If you want to know more about, don't hesitate to contact me.. alfil1313@gmail.com Regards.

title: Slightly worse than a wet carboard box....
text: Positives: The location was good, not too far from public transport routes and easy to find. Food was not bad, not great but not bad. Bedding and towels were clean. The curtains were blackout curtains, great for hangovers. The lift was great if you wanted an up close and personal experience with the other occupants of the lift (very small) and half way up it made a sound like a mad axe man wanted to come in (we found this hilarious, hence it being a positive, however if you are of a nervous disposition I suggest the stairs!) Negatives: On arrival the hotel had no knowledge of the reservation what-so-ever, there was obviously a miscommunication between the booking agent and the hotel, hotelopia had the manager's email on file rather than the reception, however despite the manager having received the booking request this was not forwarded to the reception desk and therefore we were not on the system. Having asked the hotel staff to ring hotelopia to sort it out, they reluctantly obliged and eventually the confirmation was sent again to the reception, which immediately went into the junk folder! After another 10 minutes or so it was sorted and we were told we had been given the last room available. We were not expecting much... The room was ok, fairly basic and small however the first time we ran the tap an awful smell came up from the drains, the kind of smell that physically assaults all of your senses, this and the bathroom door did not close and had a half inch gap round the entire door, you can imagine what the room smelt like after half an hour. We sucked it up thanking our stars that we only had one night and knowing there were no other rooms available! The bed was fairly standard and tea and coffee making facilities were there, in short supply, but there. The shower decided it would be better to drench the entire bathroom rather than the occupant of the shower but that's ok because I like swimming. After a brilliant night out in London we came back to our underwater broom closet, thankfully we only had to spend roughly 6 hours sleeping in there (with gas masks donned) before breakfast and check out. When we left we thought we would just leave a few comments about the room, these obviously sank faster than the titanic and I don't expect they will do anything about it. There was barely any apology for the state of the room, nor the hassle we had to go through to get it in the first place, had we not asked them to sort it out, the hotel would have been happy to say 'jog on'! I think I might just avoid this hotel in the future as I can get the same experience renting a mouldy cardboard box, located on top of a drain, in a thunderstorm.

title: Worst Hotel
text: This is the worst hotel I have stayed in. The TV did not have any signal and I had to fix it myself as the person sitting at the counter had no clue how to tune the TV. There was no cold water in the taps and the water was too scalding hot to take a shower. They changed my room in the morning, but in the new room also the shower did not have any cold water. Hence I left the hotel without a shower at all. The breakfast is too plain. Not worth paying a penny for this, and I wouldn't stay there again even if they paid me to.

title: cheapoair sent me here
text: we saw the pics online and it sounded good. when we arrived they han not received our booking. so the indian guy at the counter charged us about 100 usd to hold a room. we paid on card, they said theyd not run it, they did immediately. when we looked at the room it had no air conditioning and it was rather warm. A tiny fan sat on a table. there were three amy cots in the middle of this really ugly room. they obviously had no mattress. my lady said NO WAY and we went to another without spending more than a minute in. this prince william hotel was a hotel we paid for and they stated that when they did get our money that theyd keep two days of it and refund the rest....yea, right. theres a sign posted right there in the office in front of the jerk that talked to us saying theyd only charge us for one day. DONT ever go there. We called Cheapoair and theyve not called us back, but i noticed this hotel no longer come up on the search engine on their we site. We ended up getting a normal hotel at the airport.

title: Great value for money
text: Great value for money. Hotel in the middle of being renovated so check in and breakfast in hotel across the road, but that was not a problem. Room was clean with newly refurbished ensuite. Bed comfortable and room relatively quiet. Excellent location close to Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. Would definitely stay again.

title: Very clean room
text: Were a bit concerned with the previous remarks, but when we arrived there we were pleasantly surprise to see a tidy reception and obviously newly fitted carpet. Very helpful staff, specially whislt arranging for theatre and sightseeing tickets. Very clean room, very bright and the laminated wooden flooring helps very much. We have stayed in similar hotels before with tiny and dirty bathroom but we have to say that the bathroom was fantastic, all tiled up!.Love the red high chairs in the breakfast room. For the price we paid we will diefinetly go back as it is in a prime location. Steve

title: Poor stay in a very average hotel!
text: From the moment we arrived in knew it wasn’t going to be an enjoyable stay. Although it was only a brief visit this hotel stil lacked the basics you would come to expect from any hotel. There was no warm greeting and being given my room seemed like it was a chore and the only time they spoke clearly was to tell me that breakfast wasn’t included in my stay. Our room was located in the basement. We got there via a lift which said it would hold 4 people. I would love to have seen this as two of us with rucksacks on just about squeezed in. The room was basic but clean but very small with barely any room to move around the bed, it would definitely be the average single room size in most hotels so be aware of this if allocated a basement room. The noise from the road was tolerable at night time although there is a draft from the window. The worst noise however came from the movement above which I believe was from reception where you can hear every movement even at 4am with the sound of suitcases being wheeled in and what sounded like furniture arranging as items were being dragged across the floor at 7am so make sure you don’t stay in this room (B3) if you treasure sleep. A good location is the only positive thing that can be said about this hotel with a 5 min walk to Paddington station and to Hyde Park. Overall a below par star which will not be repeated.

title: Flophouse close to Paddington Station
text: Odd little place with a small rumbling elevator, almost clean room, 1984 decor, and a hot shower with a trickle of cold water. The people working the front are nice and it's close to Paddington station & Hyde park. The internet is extra. Its cheap with no surprises.

title: Under construction, bathroom smelt
text: We visited London on a short new years eve break and stayed in this hotel. On our arrival we had to visit another hotel opposite to check in. The room was a good size and had tea/coffee facilities, the bathroom however stunk - I cant describe the smell just really strong. The downstairs part of the hotel was under construction but overall the staff we're friendly. I wouldnt stay again but hopefully the hotel would be better when everything's finished.

title: 'Hotel' from hell...
text: Staff are disgustingly rude and abusive...I had to call Paddington Police because the individual on duty last week was so rude because I basically asked if they had a larger room. He held my credit card and wouldnt return it-finally the Police rescued it for me. They are anti-american saying "get back to your ******* country". I was speachless. Didnt even stay one 1hr in that dump. My sister and I found a better deal and very pleasant hotel just around the corner. This is a very poorly run hotel. I aqll my years of travel I have never come accross such a bad welcome.

title: Reasonable value
text: Recently renovated in a minimalist style. Room was well cleaned but basic. Beds were comfy. The bathroom was nice and roomy but the drains were a bit smelly. Good location. Didn't try the breakfast but it looked ok.

title: Room 17
text: Stopped in room 17 , Small but had everything that is needed. No hair dryer but asked the gentleman at the reception and he produced one straight away. Small fan in the room to keep you cool . Very comfortable bed and the room was very clean . The staff was very polite and helpful. All in all a very nice place to stay .

title: Great depending on room
text: I found the Prince William to be exactly what I expected--snappy but simple rooms with a reasonably courteous staff and a basic continental, London-style breakfast. Good prices. The rooms were recently refurbished and the small bathrooms were gorgeous. Make sure to ask for a room that does not overlook the airshaft! While my first night was spent with a great street view, the next was a basement room with a nasty view of cigarette butts. The only advantage to that room was that the fairly good Indian restaurant was next door and they delivered my dinner free of charge. I am planning to stay again, on an upper floor.

title: Bad hotel
text: I stayed at the Prince William Hotel London from December 12th to 15th, 2005. My single room was more like a prison cell. Sheets were not changed. No hot water in the shower. I changed the room then. I've got hot water but the water pressure for taking a shower was awful. The heating didn't work in my new room, I was freezing. The young girl at the reception from eastern Europe was not friendly, no smile, no kind word. And so on ...Would I recommend this hotel, no!!!

title: Re-located !
text: Sent here after my original hotel had electrical problems....as it turned out not a problem. Very handy for Paddington, Hyde Park, shops, cafes etc. Room nice, clean, most amenities. The only negative was the size of the bathroom, or lack of size. I am under 11 stone and could just fit in. Basin so tiny you bang your head on the wall and when sat on loo your right leg rubs against the basin! Shower big enough though. Not double glazed or air- con but did have fan and I did not notice traffic noise during the night - but had a few drinks before hand. Just one socket!!

title: It makes the money!
text: Very nice 2* hotel, clean, kind staff, very very good location at 3-5 minutes from Paddington station and tube, in Central London. I recommend it for those who want to visit London due to its location. Also is very close of Kensington Gardens/Hyde Park. Maybe the rooms are too tiny but it is not a spa hotel. I highly appreciated the hotel staff.

title: We loved it!
text: Event though we read some bad comments we would like to go to this hotel. We found it great! Really cleaned and well furnished room, staff really kind and gentle. The breakfast was really good. We had no problem with anything. We would return there!

title: Not bad for price, but has issues.
text: We booked three nights. Just round the corner from Lancaster Gate tube which was really useful and also Hyde Park. Were given room on the top floor which was small but clean and well presented, the drain smelt a little tho but not worth making a fuss about. Staff were pleasant, breakfast good and we filled up for the day on it. Warm weather meant we slept with the window open and noise was no problem. However, woke up Wednesday morning to find no hot water. Walked out of room to discover two huge wet patches on corridor carpets. We had to notify staff of the issue, they didn't come to us. Were told an engineer would have it all fixed by the evening, which was fine. It's been newly renovated, I understand there might be a few problems. My issue was the fact when we came back to the hotel in the afternoon, to prepare to go out for the evening, we walked through a lobby, said good afternoon to staff that were in the lobby, waitied at the lift and no one bothered to inform us that the water issue had been fixed. A few words as we came back throught he lobby might have been nice, Not an awful stay at all really, but honestly we probably wouldn

title: Nice stay
text: We arrived a bit too early (check in is from 15.00) and the receptionist was kind enough to let us in the room earlier. There was an issue with the window in our basement room and so we were moved to the room on the top floor. The room was cozy and clean, plus a nice view to the rooftops of Paddigton. The bathroom had an issue with the lighting, the light would literally go out every 5 seconds (I counted) and you would have to move a lot for the light sensors to pick your movements up. It was really annoying while taking a shower. Shower was too far from light sensor and you had to shower in the dark or move around making everything wet. The hotel itself has plenty of tiny corridors and it can be confusing, but everything was clean and well maintained. Staff was very friendly. Breakfast limited, but good. Really good for a few days stay. Oh, and the location was just excellent, just as their Wifi connection. Would come back.

title: Avoid at all costs
text: Pig ignorant staff upon check in. I was also unable to re-enter the hotel for a while after midnight working late one evening until the receptionist regrettably decided to let me in. Roasting hot room with no air con, just a small fan and faulty electrics (took 15 mins for sockets to work after inserting room key) - one to avoid.

title: Adequate budget hotel in great location
text: The hotel was fine - not great, but adequate considering the price. The absolutel best thing about the hotel was the location. It's less than 5 minutes walk to Paddington Station, which will get you easily to most of the major tourist spots in London. It's also minutes from Hyde Park and close to many restaurants and a number of small grocery/convenience stores. The room was fairly small and the beds were not terribly comfortable but were fine for the few days we were there. The room was clean and the bathroom had been partially refinished (new tile, toilet and sink) and was small but clean. There was no air conditioning, and our room overlooked a busy street so it was a bit noisy at night. All of these things should be considered if you're planning to stay here. But for the low price, we could endure these things. The elevator was small but adequate (large enough for 2 people and 2 suitcases). Breakfast was in an incredibly hot, cramped room in the basement and consisted of cereal, toast coffee/tea and warm juice. We tried it once, but chose to get something at a nearby grocery store the other days. Again, if you're expecting a great breakfast for your money, this isn't the place for you. The staff were friendly and helpful and they happily stored our luggage in a locked room until our room was ready. We had prepaid the room, but they did ask for a 10 pound "deposit" which was put on our credit card as a hold. I had no problem with this and it was never actually taken off our card at the end of our trip. Overall, this was a very basic hotel - small, a bit dingy (needing some updating - particularly in the common areas) but the room was clean and adequate for the short period of time we spent there each day. However, if you expect any kind of luxury, this is not the hotel for you. If you're on a tight budget but looking for something more private than a hostel, I would recommend this hotel.

title: Absolute disastrous
text: We could only resist one night in this hotel, because the conditions were deplorable. Our room was in the basement without windows and ventilation, the humidity smell was terrible but the worst thing was the bed... the mattress seemed to have stones and having the springs jumped out made it impossible to rest these night. When we asked for a room change the treatment of the front desk was rude, arrogant and racist. Finally when we went back to the room, after a hard discussion, we saw a rat in the middle of the aisle. Get this hotel, Definitely it’s for sure the worst decision I have ever had!

title: Décevant à souhait
text: Well, the restaurant advertised on the website doesn't exist. The fuse goes off repeatedly in the room. Broken bits lie on the floor (we are staying with a toddler.... !), the shower is a joke, no space at all in the shower room, the door to the loo/shower room doesn't shut (not even a handle nevermind a lock). Honestly! And one bedside table for 3 people! One of the bedside lamp doesn't work, it's not even plugged. Rough towels, unfit for a toddler. And if only the receptionist spoke basic English.....

title: Beware of this place... The website is misleading
text: If you look at the website for this hotel it gives the impression that it has a restaurant. It does not. There is a small breakfast room where they do a continental breakfast, but the website gives a very misleading picture of the place.

title: Very nice location, very comfortable
text: Very good price, clean hotel and great service. This hotel is 3 min from the Paddington underground station. I strongly recommend as I was pleased with my stay. The room is clean and the staff is very helpful. Great place to stay for business or pleasure.

title: Terrible experience - robbed!
text: Sorry to say but I was a victim of theft at this hotel. A valuable item was stolen from my room. I found this hotel in a good location at a reasonable rate. On my first night, my room was beside the elevator and it was very noisy because the door banged and people would be coming and going at all hours. On my second night, my room was changed. The front desk clerk said my new room was not ready but my belongings would be moved while I was out for the day. When I returned home late last night, I was repacking and discovered that an item worth 500 USD was missing. I am absolutely positive I left it in the room. Yes, I know there are signs that say the hotel is 'not responsible for valuables left in the rooms' but I cannot carry everything with me all day. I didn't expect that this gave them license to steal. Super disappointed. When I asked to look through their lost and found items they said they didn't have any. I guess it's finders-keepers at the Prince William Hotel in London, UK.

title: It is worth the money
text: Advantages: Good public transport and cheap restaurants nearby, ready and kind staff, fairly clean, reasonable prize. Disadvantages: Ragged furniture and carpets, thin walls (you can hear your neighbour snoring), small rooms, only 6 TV channels (2 of them the same).

title: AVOID
text: This hotel was a huge disappointment, please don't waste your money on staying here.The room that we were allocated was tiny, filthy and cold (this may have been due to the MASSIVE HOLE in the window which was cover up by a plastic wallet).The furniture was broken and falling apart, the table in our room was being held together by a piece of sellotape! There was hair in the shower and sink and to top this off the hot water tap did not work.The conditions of this hotel were so appalling, hence we decided to stay elsewhere.

title: Budget traveller good
text: If you're in London, everything is expensive. So this hotel is a nice way to keep your budget low. Small rooms, but clean. Very friendly staff and helpful. A basic breakfast with a small variety in choice of food. But, clean, nice and a good way to start the day. It's close to Paddington station, so connections to the entire city at the doorstep ! Very good location. It's not a five star hotel, keep that in mind. But a clean room, a toilet and shower is all I need, and this hotel gives me what I need: the basics.

title: Good for location
text: This hotel is good for location, clean, warm athough very tiny. Reception helpful. I lived on 5th floor. The elevator is only to 4th floor. So, if you have havy luggage, be aware of that. Please remember that there is no hairdrayer in room, you have to ask it at the reception. Breakfast is very poor and all the same every day (bread, jam, cheese, cereals, coffe, tea, milk, juice). Be aware and don't drink juice, those whitch are left a little in a container!!!! It's poison, not juice. I felt immediately sick after havig a little sip! Brrr.... By the way, they still have a deposit of 10 pounds, as it's almost 10 days after checking-out.

title: Don't Go
text: We booked 2 double rooms, were allocated one on the 4th & one on the 5th floors & the lift was broken. (over 70 steps to the 4th, over 90 to the 5th). When we arrived, they required photo ID for all guests, we had only travelled from Wiltshire! Luckily we had driving licenses & various membership cards between the 4 of us, as the desk clerk was adamant we had to have! Both rooms were dirty, we had to ask for the very stained bed cover to be changed in one of the rooms. Both bathrooms had broken toilet seats, balanced in place. The walls were damp & stained. The beds were old, stained matresses & broken springs - not at all comfortable. No toiletries in the bathroom, except a postage stamp size piece of soap & half a toilet roll! No hair dryer either. The continental breakfast was a joke- in a small basement dining room with limited seating, breakfast was laid out in all four corners of the room - making it a bit of an obstacle course to get a slice of toast, coffee and a third of a slice of processed cheese, their idea of portion control! The towels were clean & the water hot. I would not recommend this place to anyone - it should be condemned!

title: Simply you get what you pay for!
text: I stayed at the Prince William a while ago! They're now under the renovation which is clearly posted on every website! You have to check in at the opposite hotel and breakfast which is free of charge is served at the same hotel. The room was spotless comfortable beds and amazing bathroom and toilet in the room plus a huge flat screen TV with coffee and tea facilities. Average room sizes for a hotel in central London. I see so many of travelers complain about simple stuff, checking is after 3pm then why do you think stuff is rude by telling you that rooms are not yet ready if you arrive before 3pm. so many horrible reviews I was so curious to see the reality of what's written here but surprisingly most of them were not true! There is no lift at the moment but a kind porter available to help you with your luggage. In general cheap and the location is the middle of London close to few stations and many buses available just minutes walk from where the hotel is based! Let's not forget the free WiFi available in the room without paying a penny for which isn't usual in most of the hotels in London. would definitely stay again and I strongly recommend it.

title: Going to this hotel must be a choise
text: Walking into this neighborhood I thought wow.....but arriving at the hotel was a disappointment. It looks old and rundown. The room was very small with just a bed and a tiny table, that's it. Although it was clean everything seemed held together by duct tape and nails. Smallest bathroom I ever saw, bumping your elbows while washing your hair. The breakfast area was literally falling apart, breakfast was toast, jam and a bit of cheese. The drinks were instant coffee and lemonade. The room was against the elevator shaft, lying in bed my head was half a meter away from it. I didn't sleep well with all the noise of the elevator, people talking and lugging suitcases. I won't go back there but if you can't be bothered with comfort and decent standards then this is a cheap location in a good area of London.

title: If you're claustrophobic, don't stay here!
text: My partner and I were spending a short break in London, and looked for a reasonably priced hotel which was at least clean and comfortable, as we really only needed a bed and shower. I had asked for a top floor room(no 55) and this is what we were provided with. The room itself was clean but tiny. The double bed was actually the width of the room so you had to climb over to open the window or get to other side of the bed! However there was a strange 'rubber' smell in the bathroom which got worse as the day went on. I eventually asked the receptionist if we could move and he offered me a basement room, which was larger but had no window! ( is this acceptable for Health & Safety?) which I refused

title: Great Location
text: Modest but adequate. Staff friendly & helpful. Breakfast O.K. considering average English prices. Easy walk to Paddington Station where you can take express train to Heathrow. Wonderful Indian restaurant directly across street.

title: very pleasant stay
text: Three nights November 16-19/04. Very courteous and professional staff. Was allowed to check in early as the room was ready - this was a bonus after a very long flight from Africa. Room was small, which is typically European, but very comfortable. Had a private bath and both the room and bath were extremely clean and well maintained. Breakfast was simple but adequate and hours were reasonable. Location was great - 5 minutes to Paddington underground. Enjoyed the 'old world' architecture of the hotel and thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Would definitely stay there again.

title: Awesome,very happy!
text: Worth the money. Went there with my family,best wifi ever-absolutely no problems,we had a great stay. Would definitely go there again,very friendly,understanding and helpful staff,very quiet and very clean. Nice view and next to the station.

title: Never go there - Mice in the room
text: I booked a one night stay at the hotel on the 24 th of August. I got there at 9 pm and was offered an upgrade to a double bedroom. The room was still too small. But it was fine as i just needed a one night stay before early morning flight to New York. As I got to my room and was getting ready to have a shower before i got to bed, i was terrified by a mouse running across my bare foot. I jumped on the bed and saw another one in the other corner of the room. I jumped to the reception and tbe receptionist was NOT surprised justifiying it by the fact that London city is full of mice!!! His only comment was that he would leave a message to his manager... I checked out immediately and ledt to another hotel near heathrow... Disgusting hotel and very unprofessional behavior at the front desk...

title: Great find!
text: I looked and looked, and waited and waited before deciding on a budget hotel in London. But I am glad I did. I got a twin room on the 5th floor. 501. Decent size, very clean with comfortable beds, new bathroom. A window. Great AC. No complains. Sure. You have to get off the elevator on the 4th floor and walk one flight up, but no big deal. They bring your bags up and bring them down also. The location was very good few minutes walk from Paddington Station and also few minutes walk to Lancaster Gate. Hyde Park is also around the corner. Bunch of restaurants around, but I will recommend Bizarro just down the street. Great food and service. Never try the hotel breakfast. In general very good experience. The 3 hotel attendants I dealt with were very nice and prefessionals. Will definetely stay here again.

title: Not what we expected!
text: Ok let's starts with the positives, the location was good few minutes for the tube and train station and good range of shops and restaurants. The reception staff was very helpful and polite but however it is less to be said about the breakfast staff were so miserable and blunt - I'm not sure if anyone wanna see miserable staff during breakfast! Lets face it's not a good start to a day! While we're on the subject of breakfast we paid extra £10 per person for a full English breakfast and we literary got a sausage, a bacon, an egg, baked beans (looked like it had been left on the side) and some tomatoes (tin tomatoes not fresh tomatoes)! The hotel from the outside looked ok but once you're inside everything looked like its was about to fall apart! To be honest the hotel could do with some paint! The room was was even more disappointing the bed feels like it will fall apart as soon as you turn and it squeek (I barely slept!).

title: Good Location but average experience
text: We booked the hotel primarily based on its location to Paddington as we arrived direct from Heathrow. We booked a family room and whilst not overspacious was adequate for 2 nights. It was a typical Londion Hotel with many small rooms and in the morning the corridors were awash with laundry bags which was annoying to say the least. A very small lift which was also an inconvenience at check-in/out as we had to make several trips with luggage. Good location but probably try other hotel in future

title: Nice hotel
text: Small and old, but a nice hotel when you just need a place to sleep. Staff was helpfull and friendly. Breakfast was boring, but ok. Elevator was small, but working. My children said the beds were good, my bag hurt, but just becauce the madras was to soft. We would stay there again.

title: Good deal
text: Stayed there cause of the great deal I got. Friendly staff, excellent location very convenient in terms of going around the city and night buses helps too. Room was ok but but he bathrooms was of a very good standard. Would definitely stay there again.

title: Cheap place in the center
text: Well, I can just say it is greatly located near the Paddington, which gives possibility to very efficient London tourism. On the other and, it is the hotel with the worst ever breakfast, just some toasts in non orking toasters with cheap marmelade. The room is so tiny, but surprisingly with new and fully renovated bathrooum, nevertheless with the problems with hot and cold water. And, byt the way the wall next to my bed was heating ...the bed was worse than ever imagined.Extremely helpfull staff is a big plus. Cheap hotel, in the center, for just few nights.

title: AWFUL!!! Do not waste your money!!
text: unclean, rude staff, very very old decor, floors uneven. We actually changed rooms becuase the first was soooo bad but the second was only slightly better, it was 1.30am so we gave up with arguing seeing as the staff were so rude and unhelpful. The bed was a put-u-up and the curtains had clearly never ever been washed. Disgusting. The dining room was in the basement - literally - and the suposed 'continental breakfast' was a pile of white bread and a toaster with a plate full of sweaty cheese. When we complained again in the morning we were told not to bother complaining

title: More dirty hostel than hotel!
text: I booked this hotel over the internet for me, my mother and aunt. From the second we arrived i knew it was a mistake!! From the tiny lobby, and odd reception not to mention the stale smell. I The staff were unfriendly to say the least, having poor english, hardly spoke a word just handed us our keys and pointed in the direction of the stairs leading down stairs to the basement. The lift if you can call it that, fits one plus suitcase and looked about 100 yrs old. When we got to our rooms the thought dungon sprang to mind as it was nothing more!! I cannot discribe the smell of urine it smelled as if something had died in there. The bathroom tiles, basin and bath were stained and cracked and not big enough to turn round in. The window was borded up and had bars on, the sheets and bed covers were a suspicious shade of yellow and the beds were lumpy! when we complained we were met by cold hostility as the girl shouted no smell no smell at us! she then agreed to give us other rooms on the second floor, but we soon found these were of a similar standard. I felt like i was going to cry it was so bad. We agreed there was no way we could stay in this disgraceful place. We went down to the lobby to tell the manager we wanted a refund, to find the full amount had already been taken from our card. The girl told us there was no manager for us to speek to through broken english. I said i found that hard to believe as it was 4 o'clock on a tuesday. she said we wouldn't get our money anyway!! I didn't care i would rather sleep on the street so left. We decided to check out other hotels near, and as a almost joke went into the hilton across the road to enquire the price. we were shocked to find the hilton charged only 8 pounds more!!!! With brakefast for three only £20 extra. Our stay in the Hilton was Amazing,a real treat, Clean, friendly staff nice food well worth the extra £28!! So my advise to you is avoid the flea pit prince william and go to the Hilton!!!! I cannot stress it enough!!!
