title: Terrible hotel that needs cleaning and renovation
text: Do not stay in this hotel even if you're on a tight budget. The rooms are very old, almost crumbling and dirty. There is no isolation, so you can hear everything happening in the corridors. On the first night we were put in a basement room that was next to an Indian restaurant. It was so old and dirty and the air was hot and stinky, but we couldn't even air it. When we changed rooms we were put on the third floor and the room was lighter, but was still very old and dirty and the shower hardly worked. This hotel is below acceptable standards even in comparisson with hostels. It needs major renovation and cleaning.

title: Great value
text: Provided that you don't pay the full rack rate and are able to get a good discount on the room price then this is really an excellent place to stay when in London. Situated near Hyde Park, many attractions are within a reasonable walking distance. My room was very quiet although I suspect that may not have been the case elsewhere in the hotel. Breakfast was basic but adequate. I would definitely stay there again.

title: HORRIBLE DO NOT COME HERE
text: Absolutely tiny for roughly $200 a night 1 small bed there was barley enough room for our luggage sour head didn't work, tv remote didn't work staff wouldn't do anything to get anything fixed. There was mold in the hallways. Staff is rude, there is no AC if you come in the summer your dead.

title: Not as bad as other reviews make out.
text: Stayed here for £80. Great location. Nice receptionist booked us in and was helpful. The room was a bed not much more. What else do you need in London? Breakfast was toast cereal juice coffee tea croissants and was ok. The only down side there was food on the walls the fitting were not great. Was good for a base but I don't think I would like to stay more than 1 night.

title: All in all ok.
text: It's good value for the price, One cannot expect more for the money. It was perfect for a 4 days trip! My room (#55) was ensuite, tiny, warm and as it seemed renovated. The matrace was horrible, room cleaning didn't take place. Breakfast was buffet and ok for british...

title: I liked it!
text: We had originally booked into another hotel down the road, but there was problems with the plumbing or something so they placed us into this one. Initially worried about the poor reviews the place has had on here, I was very happy in the end. The hotel has And still is having its major facelift revamp. Those older photos on here are irrelevant now. However, it is still having its revamp in some parts of the hotel, and the check-in desk is currently across the road at another hotel for now and the dinning room wasn't opened. The construction rubble outside the front wasn't the best of welcomes. But the staff are very nice. And our basement room was very nice and bed comfy. Continental breakie included, but this is in the dinning room of the aforementioned hotel across the road. Location very good, short walk to Paddington and lots of nice restaurants and bars near by. Nice area. We would go there again.

title: Disgraceful, appauling and horrid
text: Im so built up with disgust I dont know where to begin. Let me start by saying... I beg you, please dont stay here. I booked this hotel online obviously looking for something basic and reasonably cheap in the heart of London. It cost me 69 pounds at the time or roughly $150 AUD - I am aware that London is very expensive and was happy to pay that for what i thought would be basic but liveable however boy was i wrong!!! Please read below for my account: - On check in we were greated with an empty desk for almost 10 minutes - Once given our room we found it was down a staircase resembling a verticle drop and not wide enough to fit my back pack. You can imagine how dangerous this was and the difficulty to manage after a 20 hour flight let alone assisting my girlfriend with her luggage. - Once finally getting into our room I was pleased to find our room was situated under the staircase I had just gone flying down and next door to a public toilet for guests. - The room resembled a jail cell. Not wide enough to open luggage, a TV that could be watched with a magnifying glass, a bathroom that i had to suck in my stomach to fit into and a window that looked directly out to a beautiful brick wall. - The bed was the best part of this room - the mattress was designed in a semi circle. It was to short so my legs dangled, the pillow was as thick as an A4 piece of paper and through out the night my Girlfriend and I rolled into eachother in the middle of the bed as the semi circle/slant of the mattress took affect. One positive of this hotel was the breakfast. After waking to the magnificant view of the brick wall and the stench of urin from next door not to mention people crashing down the stairs above us. Breakfast provided a haven. Bread that couldnt be toasted because the toaster had no power. Cheese that was harder then the brick wall i woke up looking at and some spreads (actually make that a spread - jam) By half way through our stay we went out for breakfast - we couldnt bare to be in that hotel for a second longer. Finally as our flight out of London was at 4am i arrose at around 2 to go to reception to ask the man behind the desk if he could check for delays on my flight. He said he could not (but I saw him using internet on facebook and looking up websites). His reasoning was that guests could not use the internet so i then had to call the airline and sit on my mobile phone for 10 minutes. I give this hotel a -10/10. Prince William would not allow himself to be burried here. p.s when i booked they mentioned renovations had recently been completed as i walked in the sign on the wall was (we apologise for the decor renovations in progress - I have no doubt this sign still exists today.

title: not as bad as they say...
text: I seriously don't know why this place gets so much flack. I stayed at prince william for a weekend back in january 2011 n i found it very comfortable and convenient. We stayed in room G4 which was well stocked and the staff were helpful but pretty glum, its london and u shudn't expect any less. it may not b a 5 star hotel but its great value for money and the location is perfect, close to paddington tube station. don't let the reviews deter you, i would highly recommend this place as a good value-for-money hotel if your plannin on stain in town for a couple of days.

title: GOOD CLEAN & TIDY HOTEL
text: It's a great location for Paddington Station and I found it to be very clean & tidy. The breakfast was OK but breakfast room a bit dowdy ! I would recommend this as a one night hotel and I am sure that I'll stay again !

title: DO NOT GO THERE
text: I think this is the worst of the worst. Despite the fact that the rooms are ok (ridiculously small) nothing is ok. I m writing this review at 5am because it is simply impossible to sleep. The windows are useless and you feel like sleeping on the street you can even here the telephonic conversation of passer by ... Or for me as I m sleeping next the the elevator you have the " attention door closing ". You can also add the poor isolation that makes you feel like you are living with the person above head. I almost forgot that I almost got my hand cut off by the window that do not stay up. Let's talk about the breakfast. It is terrible, dry tasteless "croissant ". Oh I forgot the fact that you have to do the check in in an other hotel and eat in that other hotel. WHAT THE ...? Please I m begging you if you don't wanna end up with an enormous lack of sleep, don't go in there. Oh and it is expensive, of course.

title: Avoid - worst hotel experience ever
text: Described as budget, it isn't even that cheap. Location near Paddington is great but that is the only plus we could give this horrible place. Apart from the fact that they seemed to be more interested in renting by the hour than by the night, the management were less than helpful. Our room was so small we couldn't actually both stand up and have two average suitcases on the floor. Despite being advertised as a totally non smoking hotel, our room stank of smoke. On returning from dinner the first night after 24 hours flying from Australia we could not get into our room because of electronic door lock failure. The receptionist who had been on the phone to friends or family seemed disinterested, gave us another key, same result then said it must be the battery and she couldn't do anything. After an hour she finally tracked down a manual master key. Next morning still not fixed and barely an apology from the surly manager but at least it was fixed when we came back this afternoon. Horrible place, horrible attitude, just the pits. Suggest you spend your money somewhere more worthy of your hard earned dollars.

title: Excellent location, Hotel okay
text: I stayed here for one night. The hotel was standard and the room I stayed in was a double but small. The wardrobe space was just a rail with an overhead shelf so was very basic however at least it did have storage. Had kettle and tea/coffee which you'd expect - I can say I did like the glass cups added a continental feel. I ordered a takeaway from the local pizza place and they delivered to the hotel so this was handy as I didn't fancy going out for something to eat. I would stay again although basic I did not want any frills.

title: Disgraceful! Do not stay here!
text: Buyer beware! Please listen to the majority of reviews, which correctly describe the appalling standard of this "hotel". We booked this hotel to allow us to spend an extra couple of days in london. Upon checking in, we had to climb 8 flights of grubby stairs, to scour the maze of rooms, unaided to reach our cell. Unable to find floorspace once our small bags were in the room, we sought refuge on the very small, terribly uncomfortable and dirty trundle bed. Nothing in this room looks to have ever been washed or repaired, the curtains are broken, allowing neighbors to look straight in, the drains in the shower/ basin are blocked and we would be better off sleeping on the floor than the threadbare mattress, through which every spring protrudes. We found the general attitude of the staff unhelpful, after mentioning our mattress issue we were told to ask the morning after (our sleepless night). In the morning we were given the key to another "better" room, which hadn't been serviced, to discover the same problems. The location of this hotel is definitely NOT an excuse for the rates being this high. ANY hotel/ hostel/ under bridge accommodation will be vastly superior. If you can't get any accommodation in London for the weekend and this is your only option... Stay in Paris, or bring a bed, blankets, curtains, drain-o and bleach with you.

title: Bed Bugs in Room 36!
text: I am still itching and stinging from the bites that I recieved staying here, I have always tried to stay at the Prince William in the past and while small it was reasonable for the money, but this one took the cake, I complained to the front desk and was told they would take care of it, I was put back in the same room for the 2nd night, awoke at 2:45am with the blood sucking BUGS munching on me again. the next day I was moved but not after recieving over 80 bites! How disgusting to see critters running all over your bed. The Indian chap that moved me was surprised that I wasn't moved sooner, he was very nice and helpful, and actually the management there are very nice people, it's unfortunate this has happened, I will not take a chance again, you can...if you dare. They did give me a discount, but it was hardly worth the pain, which got worse, please be careful if you do chance it.

title: One night at the Prince William Hotel
text: The rooms were small but clean, though the taps and cistern could use some maintenance, It was ok for one night, but 90 pounds is pretty expensive for the service and ambiance this hotel has to offer.

title: Pretty grim hotel
text: We stayed in the Prince William for 1 night and that was a night too long!! The double room we stayed in was so small we couldn't both stand up in the room at the same time, the room was dirty, and the standard of bedlinen wasn't good. However the bathroom wasn't too bad and was clean at least. The room had an interconnecting door to the next room where you might as well have invited the guests next door in as you could hear them so well. Customer care and job satitsfaction seems lacking here by the receptionist and manager. There was no hot water at all and when we complained were sent upto another room which was 2 flights of stairs up where surprise surprise there was no hot water. We were informed that as this hotel is in an old house there can be problems with water pressure and only after a lengthy converstation with a sour manager about the basic requirements of hot water in a hotel did we get a small amount taken off the cost of the room. We didn't risk breakfast and would have to say it is the worst hotel we've ever stayed in.

title: dont go there
text: The lift wasnt working which meant we had to climb 3 flights of stairs to this tiny dirty bedroom where we couldnt even open our suitcases. We had to put them on the bed which I didnt want to, so I certainly wasnt going to sleep in it.We walked out and found another hotel.

title: Good location
text: Not bad, in process of renovation and had to change rooms. Rooms a bit on the small side and bathrooms small. Good price and sure service and facilities better once renovations complete. 5 minute walk to the underground so the whole of London is on your doorstop.

title: Bad
text: The receptionist when we arrived was so unfriendly and unpleasant that he must have trained in the Soviet Union. The basement room was tiny and underneath reception so a lot of thundering came the ceiling of the room. The corridor smelled and throughout our stay there were large bags of laundry everywhere, night and day. The bed, however, was comfortable and the shower efficient. I accept that our experience might not be representative, but I would not recommend anyone to stay in this hotel, and we shall certainly not stay again.

title: Good Hotel-Good Location
text: I stayed here for the weekend. Very clean and staff very helpful. The room was small, but I did not spend much time in the room. The bathroom was also small, very clean and the shower was very good. Would give a thumbs up here.

title: WORST HOTEL IVE EVER VISITED...
text: Before even arriving, my boyfriend who made the reservation (unfortunately without reading any reviews which all seem to say the same things) rang up the hotel and spoke to 'Mohammed'! Well how miserable he could be... before my boyfriend even had the answer to his questions, Mohammed - the supreme overlord of the front desk as named in previous reviews, slammed the phone down because he did not have the patience to explain what he was being asked. Further more, upon arrival we were greeted by a lovely young door man, who was smiley and polite, followed by a lovely receptionist called Simone. Behind our backs was 'Mohammed' who completely ignored our arrival, which in my opinion whenever arriving at a hotel having the intentions of spending hundreds of pounds to stay, should the guests be greeted by all staff. Instead, Mo was sat on the one seat there is in reception, glaring at his phone with no acknowledgment at all. From this point we new he was going to be no help. We were told where our room was, after a few difficulties checking in as the staff didn't speak too greater English, we opened the door and wanted to immediately leave. The bedrooms are nothing like what is shown online, they appear spacious, clean and maintained. We struggled as a couple to move about the room without brushing against one another. The smallest space is available to hang your clothes with about 4 hangers. The room wasn't equipped with a safe which I felt quite unsure about, having to leave valuables in the hotel room which all staff have access too, not being able to lock things away in. The bathroom... well you couldn't shut the door without it just scrapping the toilet seat. No room for two, when getting ready to go out on the morning/evening. Whilst I was having a shower, my boyfriend felt like he was having one too, as the shower head was broken and water was spraying out the top of the door, soaking the floor. All around the tiny space the room offers, the carpets were dirty and covered in crumbs, dust and pubes. Paint is peeling off the walls in several places. On arrival our door lock was broken, we reported this to Mohammed who said within an hour he would get maintenance to come and fix it, we went back downstairs to check on time, as we were waiting to go out for the afternoon, we Weren't expecting to have to wait in for maintenance to fix our door lock. Things like this should be checked before the room is booked out!! Anyway as we approached Mohammed for a time check, he hadn't even contacted maintenance and this was a good 25 mins later. The young doorman who greeted us actually offered to come up and fix it himself, which he managed to do. Our tv... health and safety hazard!!!!! The cable was exposing live metal and simply the tv wasn't working. The bed was very uncomfortable, with 2 single mattresses pushed together and a double sheet thrown over the top, creating a gap to fall between the two beds. 1 pillow each, rock hard! Throughout our stay of 3 nights, VERY OVERPRICED for what we had, we experienced a very awful stench of sewage!!! Coming from both the bathroom sink- unpleasant when brushing our teeth, and the hall way smelt too. Overall- I do not recommend this place in the slightest, it is dirty, smelly, and the hotel manager Mohammed was disgusting and very very rude. Good luck if you check in here. Makes me appreciate my own bed even more thinking there is always someone more worse off staying in room 30 of the Prince William hotel :)

title: Great hotel
text: I would defo stay here again. Room was good size, clean and always very warm. Staff were very friendly. Bathroom was brand new so was the floors in the room. Right next to everything you need.

title: The Worst Hotel in London
text: I booked a three day stay at this hotel because it seemed to be good value for money. I arrived late due to a train delay at 1930 hours. The receptionist said she was fully booked and that my online reservation was worthless because I should have arrived by 1600 hours or phoned ahead. The woman on reception was very rude and told me I would lose one days money on my credit card booking. I asked to see the manager

title: Easy and Simple
text: Location is good, just a 5 minute walk from the Tube Station. Room was small, but did the job for one night, nice and clean. Breakfast in the morning wasn't the best. Toast had been cooked and then left in the basket so was soggy and cold by the time you came to eat it.

title: Everything you need
text: This was exactly what we expected and what we needed. Location was great, short walk to Paddington station and Hyde Park. Compared to other prices in London, it was reasonable and affordable. We were in basement room which was good. Enough space, the bathroom was recently renovated and everything was cleaned every day. Staff stored out luggage when we arrived before the check in time which was a great help! However, they did make a joke that our booking had been cancelled which ordinarily I could have gone along with but not after being in transit for over 24 hours! We also smelt smoke coming from the hallway every morning. Coming from Australia where it is illegal to smoke inside hotel rooms, it was strange but our room did not smell. It was very clean.

title: Clean but noisy
text: Stayed here for 1 night on business and thankfully it was just 1 night as only got a few hours sleep. This was due to 1) the noise & 2) the heat of the room. The windows are single glazed so the noise from the street is unbearable! The heating was on full blast and took hours to cool down. You can't open the windows so the room was stiflingly hot Cheap price but I wouldn't stay again

title: Great location
text: Helpful staff, clean and modern but small rooms. Have stayed here during the different seasons and would not recommend it in the summer as there is a distinct lack of air con and if you leave windows open it is rather noisy! Prefer this to other better 'class' hotels in London- down to earth and good location.

title: prince william hotel
text: If you are looking for a nice cheap place to stay in paddington TRUST ME when i say this is not it very poor service ,breakfast is cold tea and toast ,broken toilet seats ,dirty sheets,doors that dont fit,hope this review helps many people. i certainly wont be staying here again.

title: Very Good Value For Money
text: I stay at this hotel regularly when travelling to London. It is within 5 minutes of Paddington station and is friendly, clean and efficient. The reception staff are always friendly (although there is a lady who is sometimes there and can't quite crack a smile!) the others are all 100%. Rooms vary from very small to quite decent, but they all are big enough to do the job! I have never had any difficulty in finding enough storage for my luggage and clothes etc. Everything is basic, 5 channel tv etc, but always clean and fresh. Bathrooms seem to have been recently rennovated and are all similar and clean with a supply of shampoo and soap. I have never had the breakfast (not much of an early bird!) but everyone seems content when leaving the breakfast room. In terms of value for money and location I believe you will not find better. I for one will keep returning.

title: Great Location
text: The Prince William Hotel is a handy little hotel, close to Paddington Rail Station and two Underground stops. The front desk staff are friendly and helpful and the rooms (at least the one I had) are clean. The hotel does have a few drawbacks... the rooms are small (not unusual for tourist hotels in London). I booked a single room, and the bed was about the dimensions of one that might be found in a monastic institution (narrow and uncomfortable). There is no air conditioning, and while I was there in October, the hotel was uncomfortably warm. If you have heavy luggage, make sure you don't have a room on the top floor, as the lift only goes to Level Four and one has to use the stair to reach Level Five. A continental breakfast is available on site, but you will find neighbourhood restaurants (and there are a lot of them) less costly for a better brekfast.

title: Nice Location
text: I stayed this hotel 10-14 September with my friends. Hotel was near the Paddington train station and city center. They cleaned our room everyday and staff was friendly. There was wifi problem in the hotel's room, we couldn't find wifi in the room. Hotel was noisy because of near the way.

title: Good, Cheap hotel...depending on the room
text: My wife and I stayed there for 4 nights. We booked through a 3rd party for ~100 Euro a night. The staff was friendly. The first room we got was B3 and it was directly below the lobby, on the street side, and our window opened to the access stairwell for the guests. It was very small with no AC (we went in early Oct, not needed). It was terrible, it was loud (both from the street noise [old windows with no insulation} and the lobby traffic directly overhead), smelled like cigarette smoke and only big enough for 2. We were there for 30 minutes and I was already trying to find a new hotel. We went up and asked to change and were told to try again the next morning as they were booked. The next day they moved us to the top floor and our trip drastically improved. The room was just as small but there was a little AC unit, a great view, and no one above us. PROS: a cozy hotel with an accommodating staff and in a great location for a reasonable price. CONS: BEWARE OF WHAT ROOM YOU GET. The downstairs rooms were awful and would have definitely ruined the trip had they not moved us.

title: Loved the Prince
text: We were a bit hesitant because of the reviews, but we took the chance because of the fantastic discount and the excellent location. We check in early in the morning, we were tired from our flight but surprisingly the receptionist was very hepful and got a room ready for us in 30 minutes. Very clean room specially with the wooden flooring it looks brighter, nicely tiled bathroom and vey well decorated breakfast room. Will stay there again. Fran.

title: Nope wouldn't use this place again.
text: This hotel for £70 B&B. Up 5 floors of stairs with a holdall and rucksack. Bed touching 2 walls, climb over the bed to get to the window. Clean and bright room, toilet light on a movement sensor, blinding in the middle of the night and can't switch it off. Breakfast was across the road, the room was full and badly laid out. Breakfast was continental - no hot food. We left and went up the road to Garfunkel's. Its cheap.

title: Honest review!
text: After reading all the 'never again' reviews, we decided to take our chances and book with this hotel. My partner and I aren't really fussy folk. We don't mind older places, bit run down so long as you can sleep, shower and the location is convenient. And this is kind of what this place offers (except I will say that the beds are probably the most uncomfortable beds I have ever experienced). The bed mattresses have no cushion in them whatsoever - you will feel the springs digging into your back. We had twin beds but my husband's bed was much better so maybe it's not every bed that is this bad. What I did though was put some spare blankets underneath to give myself a bit more cushion and that did the job. Slept much better after that. On the plus side...the location is pretty good to get to and from the main attractions. The hotel is near Hyde Park which offers a great running track if you want some exercise in the morning, which was just such a nice thing to do. There is also an elevator (albeit small and slow) but at least it's got one. And there is complimentary breakfast downstairs. Everything you need - toast with butter, jam, orange/apple juice, coffee, tea. And the hotel is run by many Indians who were quite friendly and helpful we thought. And there's also free high speed wireless internet you can use in the lobby if you have an ipad, laptop, which is fantastic cause the Hilton in Amsterdam charged 15 euros for like one hour! So I would recommend this hotel as it's got some good perks on the proviso that you are not that fussed about certain things.

title: Average hotel in a convenient spot
text: Average room in a very convenient part of London. Quick access to Paddington Station and Hyde Park. The room is pretty small, but it has the basics. We stayed on a street facing room, which was a little loud and the light came through the curtains. The breakfast was poor - not enough space and very limited selection.

title: 1 double bed 2 single mattress
text: Where do I begin Upon arrival we were given room 51 with 2 single beds and a paper width between them , also the smell of sweaty socks was a great welcome to the room. So once I complained about the single beds that were touching as I didn't fancy spooning my mate all night we were upgraded ( the porters words not mine ) to a family room with 1 single bed and a double bed that was made up of 2 SINGLE MATTRESSES seriously couldn't believe it , so again the shoes were on and down to reception I toddled to which I was greeted with shock and amazement at the fact I was complaining about 1 double base and 2 SINGLE MATTRESSES . Other than the issues above I found the hotel had be recently renovated and is clean and tidy.

title: Tourist Trip to London
text: Pluses: Excellent location (just two blocks from Paddington station and several blocks from Hydes Park), cleaning (given the size of the bedroom, I cannot figure out how the cleaning lady was able to perform her job greatly as she did) Minuses: the room was the smallest room I stayed in my life (The queen sized bed basically occupied the whole room. I am not sure if it was up to fire code for evacuations as there was barely the space to go around the bed). Same size issue with the bathroom as it was very difficult to close the door once inside the bathroom or use the sink to wash your face as it was too tiny (The shower was the only normally sized item in the whole room). Also, there is only one elevator and it is tiny. Many among the front desk staff barely spoke English. Last, the room does not have a AC unit, and ventilation from the court-facing window was insufficient for hot August evenings.

title: Best location
text: The hotel is located in one of the nicest areas of London. It is very close to Paddington station ( Zone 1). The rooms are small and not fancy at all.The lift was not working, and we had to carry our luggage to our rooms on the third floor! But if you are planning to stay in the city center and are looking for budget accommodation- this is a good option. The breakfast is so-so. There are many restaurants/ cafes close to the hotel.The restaurant serving Indian food- right opposite this hotel serves amazing Butter Chicken!

title: No frills cheap and cheerful hotel
text: Very basic hotel currently having upgrading done to the electric's . The decor and carpets are very tired . We stayed in a triple room and could hardly move , there was very little space . The plus was an ensuite . The hotel is a short walk from Hyde park , marble arch and oxford street . The breakfast was continental , good if you like pastries , I am coeliac and was unable to eat breakfast as they were unable to offer me anything gluten free . I asked for a yogurt and was offered boiled milk !! If you want a cheap hotel , no special dietary requirements then this is a place to stay as the reception staff are very helpful . I wouldn't stay there again though .

title: Do not recommend
text: Noisy, with children running around! Small bedroom, unconfortable bed and awfull luggage storage area.

title: Very good!!
text: Travelling with a 5 year old daughter and was a bit worried after reading the reviews here, but we were pleasently surprised after arriving to the hotel. Room was clean and bathroom was nice. Breakfast ok: toast, cheese, cereals, juice , coffee/tea. I would go to this hotel again with my children.

title: Room Smelled! Clogged Sink.
text: Room smelled awful and the amount of water it took to wash my hands took almost 45 minutes to drain. As soon as we opened the room door we noticed an absolutely foul smell! We called the front desk and were told there are no other rooms for us, but were offered an room spray, which also stunk. We were assured that house keeping would fix the sink and hopefully the smell too. Arrived back to the room, and it was just as bad as when we left. No resolve. We where booked for two smelly nights with our toothpaste swirling in dirty sink water for hours. Breakfast was offered in a bland basement room consisting of white and brown bread, assorted jellies and overly sweet and sticky rolls. We didn't bother eating it the second morning. Sorry we chose this hotel.

title: Not worth your money
text: We had booked this hotel for six nights. Big mistake. We asked a triple room which accommodates three adults. The room we got was tiny and hot with one small fan in the room. I asked for a bigger room the next day which they were able to change for us on the ground floor but still the rooms are very hot and the hotel DOES NOT HAVE AIR CONDITIONS SO IT CAN GET REALLY HOT IN THE ROOM. Location is good. Hotel staff very good. I would stay there maybe if they put air condition in their rooms or better ceiling fans. Over all for what they charge per night for the room it is not worth it. We would have checked out and gone to another hotel but last moment price for Hotels in London get very expensive.

title: Great hotel for the money
text: Stopped here this week turn out to be a good base a short walk to paddington and also lancaster gate tube stations. The hotel itself was good for the money paid nice clean and by the looks of it recently refurbished although a little small my room was for single occupancy so was fine. Breakfast was ok a simple continental selection did the job.

title: Still refurbishing, but fine for our needs
text: When I opened the front door I was in shock as the reception was taped off and the carpeting had been removed from the stairs. We were told to go to the hotel across the street to register for our room. We did so and I voiced my concern about the state of the entrance to the Prince William Hotel and was assured the guest rooms had just been renovated and all fittings were new with only the entrance to be completed. This proved to be true. The room was small and on the fourth floor, but everything was brand new and clean. The room faced the street but there was no noise on this quiet street and slept well. I booked a twin, but were given room 44 which has a double and a single bed. The staff was friendly and helpful. We needed a three-pin converter to charge our phones and were provided with one on the spot. Location is just three blocks from Paddington Station (Bakerloo Line). Basic continental breakfast was included at the hotel across the street. Fine for our needs.

title: Nice hotel but very small rooms
text: Visited this place last week. Very nice hotel. Small room though for three people. It said on the website that the rooms have the latest mod cons but there was no hair dryer in the room. The shower was amazing. More towels needed though in all rooms. It was very hot in London and we had to sleep with the window open and a fan provided by the hotel on all night. It would be nice if the hotel invested in air conditioning. Also our room window was right next to another room on the same floor. We unfortunately had to endure a couple arguing over their small upset child when trying to put him to bed. Did not stay for breakfast so I cannot review that unfortunately. Other than that the hotel is lovely and clean.

title: It´s becomes better and better
text: It was our 3rd overnight stay (2010/12/15) in this lovely Hotel near Hyde Park. The Rooms are small but excellent and freshly refurbished as well as the breakfast room. Staff is very careful & helpful.

title: No airconditioning: horrid time for 2 nights
text: It's astonishing /highly bizarre to have this kind of an experience from an established brand like novotel.....astonishing because customer service and experience should be at the top of the agenda for every service provider....when you are charging so much every night why wouldn't you invest a small amount in providing air conditioning/ invest in its maintenance....london gets hot around this time of the year....wld advise everyone to bear this fact in mind before choosing any hotel... my kids and I couldn't sleep because of this... appalling...

title: london style
text: this hotel location at west of london but easy to going anywhere... the food, staff was good

title: Very very tasty
text: Very good restaurant very good service tasty meal great chef great waiter the meal was great high class great few hours spent. We spent a whole evening drinks and meat and fish. We didn't have dessert we were full and happy after the meal.

title: "Executive" means little
text: Stayed here as I had business at the Olympia National convention center. Waited 20 minutes to check in, no one was infront of me, they just had no one upfront besides one person to check people in and she was busy chatting. When I got to my room it was ok, looks like they stopped half way through renovations. In the bathroom, there were two rolls of TP that had about three squares on each. Toilet didn't seem to work well anyways. I had booked WiFi for the extent of my stay - for Novotel that means you have to go see someone everyday (as calling proved useless) to get new login info - almost every hotel supplies WiFi to guests for FREE - Novotel seems to be stuck in 1998.

title: Appauling customer service
text: I recently stayed at the hotel for one night and upon check-in put my debit card down for security for the room. Upon check-out my company was paying for the room on their corporate card which meant my personal card shouldn't have been charged anything, Upon checking my bank account i noticed that £300 had came out of my personal account (the room cost £129 for the night). Obviously I rang up to complain and see why this had happened, expecting that they would notice their mistake and refund me. I first made contact over two weeks ago now and have not been refunded. Upon my first call with them, the front office staff couldn't deal with my query, so I had to send an email through. I was given an email address that was not managed any more which meant I didn't receive a reply despite emailing several times. This then meant that I had to call back again and explain the whole situation to a new employee, whilst I was getting frustrated over the phone I could hear the employee giggling (whether it was to me / to another employee is unacceptable). I have now escalated the issue through to the front office manager who has been "looking into the issue". This was over a week ago and still no resolution. They have now found out that my card has been charged for two other customers rooms accidentally by their system. Despite finally noticing their mistake, they have not offered me a refund / or any information on when this issue is going to be resolved. This situation is unacceptable and should have been rectified when they noticed that the system has charged two other customers rooms to my account. But no, they still want to "look into it further".

title: Business hotel
text: Stated here for a few nights whilst attending the Internet Retailing Conference. Excellent central location with easy access to central London or Heathrow. Not easy getting a taxi and be careful if you ask reception to book one as its more expensive. Just walk out to Hammersmith or Talgarth road. Generally a very good London hotel.

title: Nice hotel but glad I wasn't paying...
text: Upon walking into the lobby I was impressed by the seated areas and the bar, which all gave the impression that the hotel was modern and newly refurbished. Check in was lengthy for the people in front of me, however I was sorted within minutes. It must be noted all the staff I dealt with were fantastic. We had a room on the third floor overlooking the fly over which wasn't an issue. The room itself was quite small and as we were only staying for one night there was sufficient room for the luggage. Longer stays might have struggled a bit more. The bed was comfortable and it was quiet which was good. The only downside I had was that the shower leaked right on to the bathroom floor creating quite the mess. I don't expect this of a hotel that charges £275 a night - hence the title of the review. Overall I would stay here again as I do like the Novotel hotels (having stayed in New York and Paris) however I would not pay such high prices when I honestly could have found a maybe slightly lower standard with a much higher saving.

title: Nice hotel with amazing staff
text: We stayd in novotel west hotel for three nights with my husband and our 1year old son. The location is great, lots of restaurants and shops around and easy transportaion from metro and buss station. The rooms were modern and very cleen. Beds were comfortable. The staff was really friendly. We went to ask directions to nearest shop to buy diapers and ended up getting a pack of diapers from the reseption. Breakfest was really good, better than average! We ate a couple of times in the lobbybar and food was good. The waitreasses there were great especially with our kid. We will be coming back on our next stay in London 😊

title: Not great for the price
text: Although the room sizes are okay for London, they have not been maintained well. The carpet of the room I was staying in was stained and there were no toiletries provided until I reminding housekeeping. Furthermore, there was only one receptionist despite the long line for check in. Despite the complaints, the staff are very kind.

title: Family trip to London
text: Been to this Hotel a few times and as always the Hotel was spotless, the staff were always polite and efficient. The only reason we didn't give it 5 stars was because the fridge in our room wasn't working, nor was the the heating/ air con, we had no complimentary water in our room & the coffee machine was unplugged so we had to move the fridge to plug it in.

title: Short stay in London
text: Good clean modern hotel quiet location. We used it to meet family from overseas on short stop over as their tour company used this hotel close to Heathrow. Clean modern hotel, good size room. Close to Hammersmith centre, shopping, 10 minute walk from hotel's 1st floor reception, no need to use front entrance if using underground walk past Lo'real then turn right short cut signposted. Direct lines to Paddington, Euston, King's Cross, Victoria. Piccadilly and District line into central London for theatres. Breakfast buffet ok but a tad expensive for what was available at £17.50, we ate on last day to spend more time in saying goodbye. A short walk into town to Weatherspoons at £4.35 all day breakfast with tea an easy option with room only on booking.

title: not so good
text: Stayed for a work conference, good rooms for work functions, bedroom wise not so good. The bed was comfortable and large but there is little soundproofing - can hear all conversations down the corridor. Room was very clean, but bathroom shower poor - the main shower head was not functioning properly and it was just like shower with a hose. Breakfast was fine, lots of variety but coffee not so great.

title: Perfect hotel when attending a concert at the Apollo
text: I chose this hotel as it was the closest hotel I could find to the Hammersmith Apollo. It really is in a perfect location for the Apollo & the Hammersmith tube station (it's only a five minute walk away from both). This hotel was exactly as I would expect from Novotel. The staff were very efficient, helpful & pleasant & check in was quick. The rooms were of the standard that you would expect from a chain hotel. Very clean, & everything we needed for a short stay was there & everything worked as well! We found the bed a little on the hard side & it wasn't as comfortable for us as some other hotel beds of the same grade, but this is more down to personal taste of course. It really wasn't an issue though. The breakfast was very good with a varied selection of hot & cold food. I would definitely stay here again when attending a show at the Apollo (Kate Bush was amazing in concert by the way!).

title: very enjoyable hotel
text: spacious room. no bad surprises. good value for the price paid. would warmly recommended.

title: Excellent spot
text: Service was great , we arrived from Heathrow early AM , staff assisted us by giving us a room straight away , we had travelled for 24 hours and were exhausted . So this kindness and excellent service was very welcome . This hotel is central , a walk from Hammersmith tube , so a quick tube ride to all of London . It is very convenienant . We would stay here again .

title: Poor Reception
text: The Room was too hot and dingy. The check out was a nightmare. I was in a hurry to catch a train for an appointment. The receptionist could not understand that I had paid in advance for my accommodation in part by debit card and in part by Accor Hotel Gold Card points. A colleague had to give him a lengthy tutorial, delaying me and causing a very long queue to build up behind me.

title: Poor PR
text: I stayed at this hotel over 3 consecutive weekends (a total of 10 days) in June and I have been a past customer, but not anymore. After the first weekend I travelled out of London and requested that I leave my wife's hat box in storage until I returned the following weekend. I was told I could do so but it would cost 1 pound per day. I said this was unreasonable given that I was returning to stay at the hotel. My debate on this point was to no avail and further I was told I had to pay in advance. When I returned to stay the following weekend, I was told that the type of room I had booked was not available due to overbooking. After 3 more than 2 hours waiting around to get a room we got to bed at 2.00am. We had to pack and relocate to another room the next day. Whilst the reception staff were very helpful and apologetic it was clear that the hotel runs as a budget hotel and guests are just numbers. Could not close room blinds to full width of the window to block out morning light which in summer in London made for unacceptably early rises

title: Great food and elegant location
text: My family and I booked a table for dinner at the Novotel restaurant. The staff were very professional and friendly. The atmosphere of the restaurant is calm and relaxing. Ideal for conversations and catch ups with family. Even though our table was located in a central area, it was quiet. The food was spectacular. I have tried the best antipasti ever! In particular, I would recommend the bruschetta with guacamole and crab meat. Buonissimo! Me, as an Italian, I'd definetely include this restaurant as one of the top places in London where you can threat your family for an authentic Italian dinner.

title: Excellent Conference Facilities
text: Stayed here for a business meeting, conference facilities are extensive and well appointed. Rooms were well soundproofed and air conditioned. Food served for breaks was fresh and varied. Check in was simple and fast. Bar staff were friendly and talented. Outdoor space in the evening was really appreciated.

title: Central, nice and comfortable hotel
text: The hotel is located a short 5 minutes walk from Hammersmith tube station where you can get directly to/from Heathrow Airport with the Piccadilly Line. Also in walking distance is the cheap and popular Primark Hammersmith store and several bars and smaller restaurants. Check in/out could have been more efficient - had to wait for about 10 minutes at check in. The restaurant serves a delicious buffet both at breakfast and dinner. The rooms are clean and of good quality, with a comfortable bed, a desk and a sofa. You can connect your phone/MP3-device to the sound system in the room and get music in both the sleeping room and the bathroom. Very cool! Novotel Lodnon West is absolutely a recommendable hotel in the western part of London!

title: Well located
text: I stayed at Novotel on 1/4/15 with Cosmos group. I stayed the two previous night on my own twinshare. On the morning of 1/4 I went in to have breakfast as I had already prepaid bed & breakfast with Cosmos. I was greeted by a curt waitress with dark hair and an accent who tried to charge me again for the breakfast.She told me to sit down anyway and she would check. I had my breakfast assuming she would come back to me to say that everything was fine, however she did not. Not only do I think this was rude of the waitress but it reflects on the whole hotel. She was quick enough to assume i hadnt paid yet could even be bothered to admit to her being wrong or more importantly reassure the customer (me) that everything was good.Left me with a bad tast

title: Great Night
text: This hotel is a great location for Eventim Apollo,restaurants and bars in hamersmith.The hotel is very clean and staff very helpful,the Bed is very comfortable,the breakfast fantastic.There is a car park which is enclosed and safe and discounted for customers(just expect to pay London prices.The Drinks in the bar are pricey but this is a top hotel so expected.I stayed for one night as show at the Aventium but overall a great stay at the Hotel.

title: Good hotel, excellect location for public transport
text: A large Novotel. Check in was efficient and fast. The room was large and nicely furnished, quiet, and all equipment functioned well. Free in room wi-fi. The hotel is located next to both the Hammersmith bus terminal, and Hammersmith tube station, so perfect for connections to Heathrow airport or central London. Plenty of shops and restaurants in the vicinity. The price was very reasonable for such a good location.

title: A mediocre Novotel chain hotel
text: Novotel London West is located in Hammersmith area, very close to the tube station which takes you to London city for less than 25 minutes. A nice base for weekend stay. Wouldn't say the rate is cheaper than those hotels in London city as this hotel is very much likely to be used for conferences or business travelers alike. Rooms are pretty comfortable, a nice bed and large sofas, however the heater can be very stuffy. The breakfast is awesome, extensive selections and I love it. The lobby can get pretty crowded and I would say most of the I-macs in the lobby are unserviceable. The last time I tried to use it, only 3 out of 8 computers are usable. However, it is really hard to get the room service or housekeeping to pick up your call. It is most of the time left unanswered. It is very annoying. Even if they do pick up your call, they take forever to deliver the service. I am pretty pissed with this kind of room service. Management really needs to look into this pathetic issue. I believe there are other better hotels in the surroundings. But I wouldn't say this is the best hotel I've stayed in London but not the worst either.

title: A little Break
text: As this was are second stay at this hotel, we where very much looking forward to it, and we where not disappointed we where met with a very friendly check in and a nice room was selected for us. we where warned prior that there maybe some building work going on but this did not prevent us getting a good night sleep. Breakfast is a must and would definitely book this prior to arriving at the hotel.

title: Nice room, shame about the dog blanket and restaurant
text: Stayed here for one night with my daughter and grandaughter (aged 10) Room was nice, modern and clean. A personal welcome on the flat screen was a nice touch, as was the piped sound from TV through to the bathroom. The bed settee had been made up with clean sheets, but instead of a matching duvet, a grotty blanket had been used. The blanket was clean, but creased and pilled and it's navy blue colour certainly did not match the room decor. The message it gave was " it's only for a child so it doesn't matter". In fact my grandaughter is taller than her mum, so she slept in the double bed with me and my daughter had the settee with the "dog blanket". There was only one pillow on this bed too and it was wafer thin. There were a couple of functions going on at the hotel and on our return from the theatre at about 11pm the foyer area was full of drunks so we speedily went to the room and to bed, only to be kept awake by some booming "head banging" type music. The bass sounds actually made the room vibrate! We could hear the DJ between tracks, so the noise wasn't just coming from another room nearby. We were on the 4th floor! When we did eventually get to sleep I found the bed very comfortable and slept well. My daughter didn't get such a good sleep on the thin mattress of the "put-u-up". The curtains had black-out linings so we weren't disturbed by early morning light. We were looking forward to a good breakfast to set us up for a day of sightseeing. However, even though I could see some tables set up and ready, we were shown around the corner to an area where the vacated tables were still laden with dirty plates etc. There wasn't one clean and made up table. We were asked to sit at the least laden of the tables and a wet cloth was brought to wipe over it in front of us. A knife and fork and serviette was given to us, but we were not offered a cup of tea or coffee and had to ask for this after 5 minutes. The coffee was cold. We were not told about the buffets and so assumed that the buffet next to us was the only one. It was only when one of the staff said "this buffet's closing in 5 minutes so you'll have to use the main one" that we realised there was another one where you could also make your own toast. The food was lukewarm, the poached eggs looked like they'd been there for ages, the only saving grace was the fruit salad. And the un-cleared tables remained that way for the whole time we were there. There were staff evident but their priority wasn't to keep the place clean. I would rather be told when booking in to "sit wherever you like, there are 2 buffets to chose from" than be shown to an area of complete disarray and told nothing. In other words the girl showing guests to a table would be better utilised in keeping the tables cleared. My works canteen is cleaner and better run than this and the food there is certainly better. The hotel is convenient for the underground, although as it is in zone 2 it does cost more for the travelcard. If I was staying in London again I would chose somewhere more central.

title: London Visit
text: Good clean well serviced hotel, conveniently situated, (unfortunately with hard uncomfortable bed and evidence of cigarette smoke in a non smoking room).Breakfast( self service) is excellent. Otherwise recommended.

title: Great stay in September!!
text: We stayed with our toddler for 2 nights this weekend and had a very good experience. Check-in at 1.30pm was very quick and we found check-in staff very polite and courteous. Although requesting a room on a higher floor and not over looking the flyover via email a few days before, only one of these requests was met. We were on a higher floor but our room did overlook the flyover however the secondary glazing does a very good job and we hardly heard the road at all. The breakfast buffet had plenty of choice for everyone and we saw the staff working very hard to keep food and drink replenished. Breakfast was served between 6am -12pm which gives you plenty of flexibility of when to get up. All the staff were very friendly and were great with our toddler. The location of the hotel to the tube and bus station is only a few minutes walk and Hammersmith station is great for a number of different tube lines into central London

title: Good modern hotel
text: I was very happy with this Hotel, it is i an walking distance from the Olympia confrence center as well as the tube and bus stations and the small but convienent Kings Mall. My room was very nice, big bed ( got a double bed) with goof fluffy pilloves and double duvet, very spacious, clean and modern. It was a big hotel so there was sometimes a wait for elevaitors and on the first day, people had to wait for breakfast. The breakfast was a typical english breackfast and service was good. There is a small shop a the hotel, which came in good use for late check inns. I found the staff at the recption very polite and helpful. I would definetly recoment this hotel.

title: Handy place to stay in London
text: Spent 2 nights there post & pre tour. Very handy to the tube, eateries & others amenities. Half an hour ( when traffic good) to Heathrow. Room was a decent size. Clean & well serviced. Breakfast good, a great variety for all tastes.

title: Terrible
text: Never again. Fail to see what their 4 star rating is based on. Check in tried to fob us off with a small double room when I had specifically pre booked and pre paid for a superior with a sofa bed. Complained and got moved to the right room type. Rooms dismal. Reception and bar area look great but it ends there. Tatty carpets, dull decor, looks aged. Bed very comfy though! Room far too hot, even with the so called air con on full/cold. Room service was appalling! First night had dinner in room, left tray, plates etc outside for collection. Still there in the morning when we went out. Still there when we returned after 4pm... Disgusting. We wanted to relax after a very very tiring day, called room service twice but got no answer! Let it ring and ring. Gave up. To be honest glad we were forced to go out for dinner as the food delivered by room service the night before was not that good anyway. Got the order wrong due to staff not understanding English and not being patient enough to slow down and listen properly. Was so hungry and tired by this point we ate what we could. English was not the first language of any of the staff we encountered. The bar was mobbed and the one time we did try to go for a relaxing drink, bar man was rude and looked harassed. Language barrier again found myself having to repeat everything 3 times. Too few staff for the size of hotel. If you're looking for a relaxed break this is not the place to go! Chose it because of location and star rating. Location is great! Star rating is not justified in any way that we saw!

title: So poor Novotel
text: So firstly I didn’t try and check in until after 6pm. The staff were lovely but couldn’t allocate me a room so gave me a voucher for the bar. I asked for a gin and tonic and was told it was only for beer and wine! I got my room eventually and it’s hugely disappointing. I’ve paid over £200 for one night. Yes it’s london and yes it’s December but I expect a certain level of comfort. The room is tired, old and quite frankly nasty in places. If I wasn’t so tired or staying for more than one night I would be back in reception. Disappointing for a hotel chain I really like. Would not recommend and would not come back.

title: Short break
text: Nice hotel, reception area is nice with facilities to get online and print boarding passes etc. Executive rooms are good sized with large comfy beds. Breakfast was very good with plenty of variety. All in all a good value hotel, I would stay again.

title: If you need to be in Hammersmith, a good place to stay
text: Good clean business hotel close to Hammersmith tube. Clean rooms with a good desk to work at. Good choice and service in the 'Grill'. A bit out of London but perfect if you need to be in Hammersmith. Has the advantage of being outside the congestion charging zone.

title: Inner city hotel
text: Ideally located for travel around city centre. Executive room small, air-con not functioning adequately. Had to leave secondary glazing and windows ajar to get air into the room. Restaurant and bar nice.

title: Nice Breakfast
text: Great location. The tube station is just few minutes away. The breakfast is good. They serve almond milk as alternative.Staff were friendly and very attentive especially Gyurgitsa and Cornel. We enjoy the breakfast very much !

title: Car park rip-off
text: Got charged £91 for 25 hours in the car park when staying in the hotel. There was no mention of this on their website, and no signs saying what the parking cost. Frankly £91 for parking on overnight stay is robbery. Don't stay there.

title: Clean & Spacious
text: Clean & spacious hotel. Stayed here for 2 nights when I was attending a concert close a by. Would recommend for families and solo travelers alike. There is a lot of restaurants and bars in the area too so you don't have to travel far to get the London feeling.

title: Dirty room!
text: stayed in an executive room Novotel London West in Hammersmith on the 20th of September. I don't know if this email address is correct for the purpose but I would like to say how disappointed I was with our stay. The room was dirty, I found used dental floss by the bed, there were cobwebs on the ceiling and the carpet had more stains in it than I could count. There was only one dressing gown and slippers in the wardrobe, I called to reception and was told another would be sent up, it never arrived. I booked this hotel in the hope that we would have a special stay, I was taken by the promise of special service and exceptional rooms, I am sorry to say that my experience of both was poor in comparison with other budget hotels I have previously stayed in. I did voice my concern to the lady that checked out who thanked me for bringing it to her attention.... A sorry would have been nice.

title: Two weeks in Hammersmith at a hotel that under delivered and failed dismally to provide 4 star Novotel service
text: We were attracted by favourable online blogs about the hotel for families. However our 14 nights were seriously affected by:Heating issues in the first room during English winter, we were given, over 30 degrees and their answer was to give us a pedestal fan. Major fail.Next room was better, but outdated carpet and in desperate need of a renovation.Issues with door locks that stopped working as only programmed to 31 December, waited for over an hour to access our room.Buffet breakfast reminded me of the army, powdered eggs, rock solid fried eggs, slow water jog taps, extremely hot plates (burnt my finger on both hands one morning and attended by hotel first aid)Many staff could not speak English, so an issue for an English speaker like meNo Concierge desk at this property, just a porter, so no service or travel advice or assistance.Property catering for mostly European tour groups, not long stay families.After I complained several times I was provided some service, but when other staff or managers on duty It relapsed to poor service and a general lack of care or interest from staff.We had issues with room service, 2 menu items were inedible, the Thai green curry and American club sandwich. The hand burgers and pizzas were delicious on subsequent room service meals.Paid for late checkout and had issues getting the keys cut for the checkout afternoon. The reception staff refused on 3 occasions to recut the keys when I was desperate to go to my room and go to the toilet. I got upset with them and they called security to try and strong arm me. I apologised to the staff later but there was no need for them to deny my request to have my door cards extended as I had paid for a late checkout and produced my photo identification, which they could not find my late checkout confirmation in the system, so after I eventually got back to my room and could gain entry, I took down my booking confirmation with late checkout clearly printed on it, and I had prepaid all of it. There several other annoying issues during the stay, like staff entering our room when we were sleeping, no toilet paper, no water supplied on a few days, no laundry service, etc

title: Great hotel
text: Stayed here recently and had a good stay. The check in was easy and quick (which is really important to me), the room was nice and the food also great - they have just changed the restaurant so all newly done up. The hotel is close to Hammersmith underground (again important to me) which makes it easy to get to from elsewhere in London. Lower prices than a lot of central London hotels. Recommend people to stay here.

title: Excellent hotel
text: This hotel has everything a top hotel should have, pleasant helpful staff, large clean rooms, quiet, close to tube station (5 mins) with direct access to Kings Cross/St Pancras and the Eurostar, good restaurants close by and in the hotel. We stayed here for one night on 30/09/11 and would certainly stay here again, very good value for money.

title: Comfortable mid week stay
text: Great friendly, efficient staff, big room for London (we had a standard twin), comfortable bed and think it was pretty recently refurbished. Quite-ish, good glazing and we were next to the flyover. Pay TV overpriced and limited but truely amazing breakfast. Best I've had in any hotel. Actual hand prepped fruit, not out of a tin and lovely sausages. Breakfast was included in our rate but my other half thought it would actually be worth the extra cost if purchased separately. Would have no hesitation staying there again, especially as I am pretty sure it was full.

title: Good - Apart from Noise Issues
text: Stayed here for three nights whilst attending an interview and seeing a bit of the sites since we were here....35 minutes from Heathrow on the Tube, Excellent underground to the city centre with the Piccadilly line on your doorstep, 20 mins and you are there......A little hard to find (so if you need directions from Hammersmith Tube, out out of the station and look for the buses waiting outside, look straight across the road too Villagios Restaurant, cross the road, go down this road for approx. 200 yards, away from the underground, and you will see the sign on the other side of the road). Rooms are good, small and compact, TV not many channels, Shampoo/Soap, Iron & Ironing Board etc....only 4 coathangers so ok if your only staying one night...booked a twin and was not advised that this was a double bed and sofa bed, although the beds were comfortable and nice linen....The problem in this room 4059, was the noise issues, I did phone reception on the first night as I was woken by screaming/laughing girls and the Tv next door at around 12.30.....but they did not have another twin room to give us for that night neither could they change our room for the next night, they are a busy hotel, so this could have been true. Next night was TV till 12, then Singing at approx. 1am, and woken 6am with someone's alarm going off, for a full hour, they must have gone to breakfast and forgotten it was on, it went off eventually and then it was next doors/upstairs TV, we got up when you could hear everyone walking/talking outside your door, that's how bad the noise issue is... Last Night was a TV on until 1am, and then must of been an early start as the noise started 06.15, TV, children running/screaming up and down the corridor, topped off with a 30 minute love making session, sounded like it was coming from the side, above and below at the same time.....So its a nice hotel, but if you are a light sleeper (and I am not), the noise issue could be a big problem......I have bags under my eyes from 3 nights of less than 4 hours sleep a night.... Nice Hotel, Comfy Beds, Clean, Central.....But you need sound proofing in the bedrooms.....

title: Cheap but not luxurious
text: Stayed here 2 nights in May 05. The front enterance is very impressive, but is designed to welcome large coach parties, the main reception desk is one floor up in the lift. As previous reviewers have noted, very impressive foyer but once you get to your room you know you are in a novotel, well that's OK for me as a actually like Novotels, the rooms are large, light and clean although the overall design is beginning to look a little dated now. Breakfast the next morning was excellent with attentive service and a wide range of hot and cold choices. Only downside is that the nearest tube station is a 10 minute walk away and is inside a small shopping centre - can make things slightly confusing

title: Does the job…
text: Stayed for one night , location paramount as needed to be close to Barons Court area. Reception, Bar areas & facilities are modern and functional . Bedroom was small but clean. Not sure why we were given the room with disabled bathroom facilities ? Breakfast had plenty of choice with good seating areas. Staff friendly and attentive. Hotel seemed very busy but operated well. All in all does a good job for an overnight stay and seems in line with prices in London.

title: Good value for money
text: Firstly, I love Novotel hotels. They are always very clean with good quality furnishings and most of all comfortable. That said, this hotel is too hot!! The air on in the room simply couldn't cope with the sauna like heat through the hotel. The windows do open but the hotels position means that it's just too noisy to sleep with them open. As with all Novotel family rooms the sofa bed is two single beds which is brilliant and a contributing factor to us booking with this chain. The food in the restaurant was lovely, both for breakfast which is a massive buffet and the one late night dinner we had with friends. A buffet was also available at dinner for people with picky eating children, whilst a full a la carte is also available along with an extensive wine list. All in all it's a good hotel, just too hot!

title: Good hotel close to the tube
text: We stayed at Novotel as part of a bus tour of 8 countries of Europe starting in London, England. This hotel is more for business travellers but it is very close to the Hammersmith Station for the tube (subway). We took the tube and got off at Green Park and got on the hop on hop off double decker bus and were able to see all the landmarks like Buckingham Palace, the eye in the sky, Big Ben, Tower Bridge, Tower of London etc. The rooms were very clean and the staff friendly. There was free internet (4 computers) in the lobby. The included breakfast was excellent.

title: Hammersmith Business Hotel
text: The hotel property is conveniently located if you move around this part of the City. It was also an easy jaunt on the District tube line from Victoria Station. The best part of the hotel experience was the staff in general... so friendly and helpful, but in particular, Bettie and Jessica at the front desk, who were extremely friendly, helpful and warm... both from Italy and exude all those properties that has the whole world in love with Italy.

title: Great Hotel--Excellent Location!
text: My husband and I stayed 3 nights at the Novotel London West in Hammersmith. The hotel is located a short distance from the Underground station and we were able to take the tube from Heathrow to the hotel without incident. As the Underground is so close to the hotel there is no need to rent a car when in London as you can travel via the tube or bus to all major attractions, restaurants, West End, etc. I wasn't sure what to expect from such a large hotel, but this place far exceeded any expectation that I had! Our room was lovely and spacious with free wi-fi. We had a very comfortable queen size bed, adequate closet space, a pull-out sleeper couch, refrigerator, coffee maker, microwave and in-room safe. The bathroom was clean and good size as well. The breakfast buffet had plenty of choices and was always adequately stocked, considering how many people they were serving on the mornings that we were there. After spending the day touring the city, the hotel bar was a lovely place to sit, relax and reflect on all we saw that day--great drinks, good appetizers and the bartenders are top-notch--really putting on a show one evening while making drinks for us! As we did not have a rental car while in the City, we purchased the Oyster card for the Underground. This was a real time saver and one of the best things we did, as we took the tube or a bus whenever we needed to go somewhere. Highly recommend doing this!! When we return to London, we will definitely stay at the Novotel again. It really ticked all of the boxes for us! Great location, comfortable bed, good breakfast and a nice place to sit and have a drink or a pint after a long day of sight-seeing!

title: Just what we wanted to make our weekend special
text: Just what we were looking for. Decent size room, very clean and modern. Firm bed just as we like it. Lots of options for a better stay ie. internet, sky, breakfast in bed. Very quiet hotel with no distubances. Shame the breakfast was too expensive and it could have done with a few extra bed pillows but i,m sure if i asked they would have supplied me with them. Close to station also.

title: Fair enough
text: The location is not amazing, but the Thames is close enough to walk around. The view of my room was not the best you can dream of. Breakfeast is OK. I got the room with a good reduction, at full price there are many other places much better

title: Disappointed
text: Stayed here a year ago and had an excellent time and felt comfortable hence I returned. Now this trip was a disgrace and not recommendable. Staff is extremely rude and has a lot to learn of customer service. I am sorry but I will not be back. Lots of other hotels out there than provide accommodation for a much better price.

title: Great Hotel with a Convenient Location
text: I stayed at the Novotel for a conference. The hotel’s location is very convenient as it is near to the airport and to the underground and bus terminal in to the centre of London. The hotel itself has a variety of great rooms which makes it a prime choice for hosting conferences. The meals served at tbreakfast and the lunches/teas during the conferences were extremely good. Also the hotel receptionists were most helpful and kind. Where I feel the hotel has room for improvement is the amenities which come with the rooms. The quality and number of towels in the rooms need to be upgraded as well as providing a shower cap and other toiletries besides shower gel and shampoo would be geatly appreciated.

title: Great hotel
text: I stayed here recently whilst on business at the nearby Olympia expo centre, which is a 5-10 min walk up Hammersmith Rd.. It's not great to look at but once inside it's a very nice hotel, very big but still got a good feel to it.. The staff are great, breakfasts superb and its nearby for transport to other places in London and near lots of pubs, restaurants etc.. Also handy for Apollo and riverside paths for walks etc.

title: Awful customer service
text: The reception staff at your hotel are either completely incompentent or liers. Either way it’s not what I would expect from a 4* hotel. My family and I attended a wedding in the morning and receptionist the afternoon at your hotel today. In the morning we were told we would need to pay for the parkingt by the reception staff but when we asked the family who were holding the wedding they stated that the parking would be free and we could validate our tickets at reception as it is free given we are wedding guests. Are your staff trained to not tell people about this in the hope they would not find out and would end up paying for the parking? When we validated our parking ticket at around 4pm as we were leaving and were returning later in the evening for the reception. The reception staff, Diego, validated our parl8ng ticket and then informed us that as we were wedding guests we would be able to park in the car park for free when we returned as long as we left by midnight. When we returned at 7.30pm we had the choice of parking on street for free but as we had been informed of the free parking in the car park by the staff we decided to park in the car park. Upon leaving the reception at 11.30pm we went to validate our parking ticket to be informed by Ian (who wasn’t even wearing a badge), the night manager, that we would need to pay. He was very rude and refused to acknowledge the mistake by the staff who gave us the wrong information. He then stated ‘the longer you stand here the more you’ll have to pay’. We ended up having to pay £17.50 which works at more than £4 per hour! Had we not been given the wrong information by the hotel staff in the first place we would have parked outside. Seems they are trying to scam guests any way they can.

title: Basic hotel in convenient location
text: Room was decent sized and appeared clean however the room and corridors had a weird smell throughout our stay. The room is a little dated and in need of an upgrade. Very loud construction noise which woke us up every morning around 7am. The hotel is walking distance from Hammersmith station. Staff was friendly and helpful.

title: Jose, a really nice guy
text: I stayed in the hotel several times this summer, and everything was perfect, but I would like to stand out Jose's work. He is a receptionist, a very helpful, kind and smily guy, and so hard worker. I will come back.

title: Great stay
text: My wife and I loved our time at Novotel, one of the service ladies Gyurgitsa even remembered us from our last trip in September, she was friendly and very helpful. Great service fantastic staff. an overall pleasant stay! Thank you

title: mixed feelings
text: good public areas rooms need def an upgrade specially bathroom. new beddings is the plus of the room. good breakfast and friendly staff. not too far from hammersmith underground station is another advantage .

title: Good West London Business Hotel
text: Great stay at this hotel, all the usual amenities. Check in was a little odd as I was greeted by a member of staff with a tablet who then disappeared to check me in!! I also dined in the restaurant that evening and found the food a little overpriced. On reflection a good hotel but improvements needed on check in and I would eat out next time.

title: Good hotel, close to tube line for central london
text: This was an important weekend for us as we were entertaining a client and his wife in London, initially when we picked the Novotel London West we were a little concerned that it wasn't good enough to impress the client. However we were wrong to worry. It is a beautiful hotel, with modern comfortable rooms. I have no complaints about any aspect of our stay and I would definitely recommend it. We ate our evening meal in the hotel restaurant which was fine although a little over priced in my opinion. Breakfast the next morning was one of the best I've had in a hotel. Check in and out was easy with helpful staff dealing with all our requests. Parking is under the hotel and was over priced compared with hotels in the Russell square area of London, however in my opinion it was worth paying extra and being further out to get a much nicer hotel than those on Russell Square. Novotel run a points scheme for staying with them however we forgot to collect the points so have no idea if these are worth having.

title: Good Accommodation, Good Location
text: We stayed for one night to attend an event at the Apollo. Excellent location, easy to drive to, good on-site car parking and walking distance to Apollo. Lovely, well equipped room and helpful and pleasant staff.

title: 3 Stars
text: Room was small but adequate (they could do with updating the TVs though), large hotel with conference Centre right next door, staff were helpful, bed was like laying on a road, restaurant was dramatically over priced for average food so I chose local restaurants for dinner after the first night.

title: Big Busy Hotel, with Good Service
text: Recently had a two night stay at The Novotel London West whilst taking in the sights in London. The Hotel is a 5min walk to Hammersmith Tube station & the busy town center of Hammersmith where the usual suspect of shops and fast food places can be found. The hotel is massive, 9 floors and hundreds of bed rooms, we compared it to staying at Disney land its that big, but the surroundings are nice and modern, looks like a recent refurb of the whole hotel has been carried out, which extends to the bed rooms. We had a normal double with a sofa bed for our son, all good in hear. Breakfast is of the buffet type, where english, contenental & pancakes can be found. The only moan of the weekend was that the english breakfast bits were cold and the toaster was poor. We never ate in the hotel as the prices were sky high. Would stay again as the location, service, price & cleanleness of the hotel were spot on, just please keep the bacon warm next time.

title: Great locations,standard room except no clean tissue paper
text: Stayed in this htl very frequently and I really like the close location to the Hammersmith stn.Just 5 mins walk.And the area has plenty of shops,supermarkets,various styles restaurants,bars,pubs and some flea food markets every Thur/Fri. The htl is big enough for different functions.Especially those business events.Lobby is nice on both G/F and 1/F.
