title: Excellent hotel in a great all round location
text: My first time in a novotel and I wasn't disappointed. Arrived a little early and had to wait about half an hour for our room to be ready but plenty to see and do in the lobby area of the hotel including a small shop and bar. Hotel parking was ample and secure in an underground carpark underneath the hotel. Parking didn't cost much more than the multi storey around the corner in the shopping mall which wasn't secure and had a smashed up Lexus in it when I visited, So I was happy to pay the extra for the added security. The room itself was clean and a good size. Our room on the 7th floor had an amazing view towards the capital with the london eye on the horizon. The bathroom had modern fixtures and fitting and was of a high standard. The hotel is a 5 minute walk from both the hammersmith Apollo and the tube station so it was a great base for a long weekend in the capital while seeing a concert at the Apollo. Ordered room service and the food was excellent, didn't try the restaurant downstairs but can imagine it being of the same quality.

title: Novotel West, good business hotel but lacks charm
text: This is a solid chain hotel , fine rooms and has everything that you may expect in such a hotel. The access to the hotel is inconspicuous and you have to look for the indications on hammersmith road that lead you up to the stairs. The lobby is fine and open with a good possibility to sit and talk. The room is OK, as is the bathroom. On one of the mornings I had a cold shower which seems to occur more often. The breakfast buffet is fine , well stocked with ample selection. All in all OK, not exciting but good enough

title: The Best Afternoon Tea Ever
text: I purchased a voucher for 4 people and decided to treat my neighbours the husband is 88 and nearly blind war veteran and his wife as well as a friend aged 90 a volunteer at the local hospital. I do a lot of these teas and I am a bit blaze about them by now. We were escorted to our table and was offered our champagne and cold tap water with ice was served without being asked. We were handed a menu, as a rule it is all about what tea one wants, this one listed the sandwiches, the scones as well as the cakes. We were happy with he choice of sandwiches, as a rule they are finger sandwiches and come on the cake stand, these were open sandwiches and the fillings were very generous, prawns, smoked salmon, ham, cucumber and egg, they came on a separate long oval plate for each of us, my guests were very impressed and ate the lot as well as some of mine. The choice for scones were either plain, with raisons or chocolate, We got the scones 2 per person and cakes 5 per person on 2 stands and the clotted cream, strawberry jam with fresh strawberries inside as well as a chocolate spread always one for 2 people were served separately . Three of us had coffee and one had tea, we asked and got a second coffee each and the tea pot was freshened up. The food. was fresh, very tasty, the service was excellent, attentive, the ambiance was superb, in reception they had the most beautiful flower arrangement. I will definitely go there when I am entertaining fiends even to pay the full amount

title: Excellent
text: Stayed here at Christmas. Very stylish, and very clean which makes the difference. Excellent, shall return again in the future. Enjoyed myself, and the food service was fantastic. It certainly is far better than other Hotels within the same vicinity

title: Disappointing service
text: The room the hotel gave me smelled a lot of cigarette smoke, which is unacceptable considering that was a non-smoking room. I asked to change for another one. First the receptionist tried to sell me a higher category room, which I declined, and then they gave me a lower category room than the one I had been given. I complained again and they told me that there were no more rooms. Well, only if I wanted to pay for the higher category one. Very disappointing.

title: Great example of how a good hotel should be
text: Most friendly and helpful receptionist ever (trainee) so lovely and great impression of hotel. Besides good and clear contact with Isaac the assistant FOH manager, couldn't have been better. Fortunately everything about the hotel was exceptional. The room was clean, a lot of space, stylish and the most wonderful view I have ever seen. Jarkko made a lovely reservation for me and my parents (celebrating both of their birthdays) in the trader vic's restaurant, great atmosphere and chand and kamilla offered us excellent service and were extremely friendly and helpful. We were very pleased with our stay and although short and sweet this time. We hope to be back for a longer visit in the future. Keep up the good work! Thank you for everything!

title: Good service but need some management features
text: I stayed at 23rd Floor. My room was in good shape and unlike my previous stay this room was not too tired and all devices were working and functional. The room was provided me as King size but the bed was not king bed at all. Just twin beds poorly put together which was not too comfy. Club Lounge was excellent as usual. The only surprise I had was the housekeeping services at this floor. It looked to me all housekeeping staff of the floor was trainees their service was very basics. I have seen much better services staying in other floors.

title: Hilton Park Lane
text: I always enjoy my stay at this Hilton. The staff is very friendly starting from the time you are dropped off by the cab driver until the time you enter your room. Highly recommend this hotel to anyone. It may not be the ideal hotel for families, but great for business travelers. Regardless your purpose, it's a great place to stay.

title: Thank you
text: Had a great stay at this hotel.It was my friends 60th birthday and I had organised a few treats for her.I had emailed the hotel in advance and on check-in the lovely young man(sorry I didn't catch his name,he was wearing glasses)upgraded us to the 22nd floor and access to the exec lounge which included complimentary snacks and drinks.We were delighted and the view from the room was great.A lovely surprise as I know people pretend it is someone's birthday or anniversary etc when it isn't and it spoils things for the genuine travellers. Couldn't fault the hotel on anything it was extremely busy and coped brilliantly.Breakfast was very good .The concierge was helpful and all the doormen we encountered were very friendly.On Sunday morning the doorman that hailed us a cab asked if we had enjoyed our stay--as they say"it's the little things that mean a lot!!" Will definitely stay here again.

title: London Hilton Park Lane
text: Special occasion 1 night stay. Saturday night in January. The hotel is a short walk from the tube station. We had a choice of city or park view - we chose the city view which was very pretty at night - the room needs to be on a higher floor. Room was lovely with large comfortable bed. Wifi in the room. Normal minibar etc hairdryer but no complimentary toothpaste in bathroom but normal shampoo conditioner creams etc Quite a few restaurants a short walk from hotel. Hyde Park just over the road and most things on your doorstep. We had breakfast included (which has everything you can think of) as well as different types of breakfasts for people from outside the UK. Quite expensive breakfast if not included £26 per person. Staff very friendly and helpful and altogether a nice break. Would be much better in summer time with nicer weather

title: Excellent hotel
text: We loved our stay at Hilton on Park Lane. It was in a great location (right near Buckingham Palace & Hyde Park) and we had spectacular views over London and looking at the London Eye from our room. The closest tube station, Hyde Park Corner is also only a 5 minute walk. If you're flying into Heathrow, it's also very easy to get to the hotel (straight on the Picadilly line to Hyde Park corner).The staff were very friendly and helpful and the breakfast buffet was wonderful. Would absolutely return and highly recommend the property for anyone visiting London!

title: In need of a refurbishment
text: Visited the Hilton for 1 night during a break in London and was extremely underwhelmed by our experience. Unfortunately the room furnishing appeared tired and looked dated. The bathroom is inadequate for a hotel of this standard and seriously requires some re-tiling. Staff are quick and efficient and represent the hotel positively but I wouldn't necessarily rate them 10/10. Breakfast was as expected and reasonably appetising. Probably the best aspect of the hotel. Conveniently located near most touristic areas in London. Thankfully we redeemed points for our stay, would definitely not pay in excess of £300 for the room we were given. Really disappointed with the hotel. A refurbishment would be necessary in my opinion

title: Perfect Location in a Perfect City
text: We visited London to see a musical and a concert at Hyde Park. This hotel couldn’t have been better situated for both. The staff were all professional and clearly enjoyed their jobs. Our view of Hyde Park was stunning and the bars, restaurants and room service were all very good. Rooftop bar was the highlight.

title: Wonderful experience
text: Never has staying in a London Hotel been so luxurious. From check in to check out we found all staff to be delightful and courteous. Wew were early and were allowed to leave our luggage with concierge whilst we went out. When we cam back the lady at check in took us to the lift and waited with us till it arrived, we were upgraded from King Delux to King Executive and found ourselves on floor 25, room 2520, overlooking the city. This is by far the best side to be on. Even a bed turn down service. Breakfast was a joy. A great variety and freshness throughout. Tip, do not order a paper for the room, they are free when you get to breakfast. We were next to the lift shaft and could here the air rushing through it when in the bathroom, but not the bedroom. The Saturday evening we went to the Galvins bar, £32 for two rum and cokes??? Don't even get a seat and had to chase to be served, we were smartly dressed as well. Only stayed for one. We checked out at 11 and left our luggage with concierge again for more sightseeing. Very close to Hyde Park Corner Tube or a little walk to Green Park Tube, excellent location, excellent stay.

title: Always a great place to stay
text: Its a great location and get superior room if you can for the views and the extra space - its well worth the extra and Windows of the World on the top floor is a great location of an evening cocktail or meal. Better than the normal Hilton standard and needs updating in many areas but still not bad value (they do lots of deals) for central London. I have always found it a great place to stay.

title: Very helpful bar staff
text: Turned up unannounced in the bar in a group of 30 demanding champagne. Despite the fact that we had already drunk quite a bit they could not have been more helpful as we consumed a lot of fizz and caught up after 26 years of not having seen each other. They took a lot of money off us but in a v charming way.

title: Summer in London
text: This hotel is very nice, the staff are very very helpful and will take care of anything you need! Would recommend this hotel to everyone as it is in a good area and walking distance from hotspots! Hyde park and Harrods are walking distance, trader vics is under the hotel and all fancy restaurants are very close.

title: Go to the top floor
text: Superb restaurant Been several times had two Christmas parties there. Never been let down Never failed to provided excellent service Great food Great wines Great views over London Reasonably priced, do book in advance

title: Great Location
text: Hotel is in a geat Location with easy access to tube and some of the big London attractions, service was fine but nothing exceptional, decor is dated, soundproofing between rooms very poor- had an interconnecting door and you could listen to conversation next door, Food was ok but again nothing exceptional

title: Comments
text: I consider this hotel one of the best in London , only this time I get very old room ( 710). I am one of reguler client to your hotel , I have notes that few clients have the advantages of getting to Exective lounge , I hope I get that next time. I wish to have better room in my next visit to London.

title: High Quality, As Expected
text: Beautiful hotel with outstanding service and great location. We stayed here for a Valentine's day celebration and it was wonderful. The reason for the 4 instead of the 5 is that our room smelt of smoke, really quite badly. The room had a very small balcony which somebody had clearly been leaning out of to smoke and the room smelt badly of it. However, everything else was perfect - including the restaurant, but that's a separate review!

title: Mixed feeling
text: London Hilton Park lane is a beautiful hotel, no question about it, very good and prestigious location. Staff is helpfull and pleasant. 1 night business trip, standard room booked with smoking room request not guaranteed until checkin, at checking time I had to take upper room level to get smoking room, then added to price tag, exec lounge bfast just ok, tables not renewed no cuttlery, had to ask. Choice average, despite a very delicious smoothie of the day ( spinach kiwi) on healthy option Gluten free section available Room spacious and clean, few things damaged in the room ( cosmetics) Bed is very comfortable Overall I believe I could have stayed at Berkeley or Dorchester for same price, then disappointed .

title: Perfect location, view and ambiance
text: This is the fourth time we are staying in this hotel and we will be going back again. The location is very convenient for both sightseeing and shopping as well as for going out. if staying there ask fo a room with hydra park view and try to get one as high up as possible.

title: Chocolate Afternoon Tea was a real treat!
text: We enjoyed the Chocoholics Afternoon Tea here on Saturday (15/3/14) afternoon. The service was faultless, the afternoon tea was absolutely delicious and atmosphere was great. I brought this as a gift for my family and am so pleased they all enjoyed it. Special thanks to the lovely members of staff who swiftly sorted out some alternatives for my sister-in-law when we mentioned she has a nut allergy. They couldn't do enough to help. Also worth mentioning that if you can't finish all the afternoon tea treats you get a gorgeous little box to take you leftovers home in. Just brilliant!!!

title: superb
text: wonderfull place to stay in central london family and kids had a blast great restaurants worth every pound the staff was great rooms are with the best views of london 5mins by can to harrods and you can walk to oxford street

title: Fine but pricey
text: Attended an awards evening in the ballroom. Food and service fine. Table wine awful. Bar drinks shameless rip-off. No excuses, just fleecing the punters. Apart from the impressive set up in the ballroom, I was underwhelmed by the decor, lobby and bathrooms. Nothing like the standard I expected.

title: Great place
text: Great hotel, good location. Worth going in the Executive lounge, nice food and drinks. Excellent breakfast choices, lovely room on 25th floor. All staff very friendly and helpful. The gym equipment is good, the steam room and sauna were very old and dated, the sauna was only just warm. They were used around 11am ,so the sauna should have been hot. All other hotel facilities are to a very good standard, please update the sauna and steam room. I would certainly stay again.

title: Excellent
text: Great place to stay. In the pass use to be the Wilmington restaurant you close it !!!! You could keep it and when you have an even close it, but keep the Ellington restaurant open . And there was a Disco no more. Hotel is taking away the nice places

title: Expectedly a good hotel.
text: Nice, classy hotel, nice view, especially from the rooms in the executive floors. Nice, sound proof rooms, very good breakfast, and ideal place across the Hyde Park, beside the subway station, close to the Bond street, the Harrods etc. I enjoyed it!

title: Anticlimax
text: Galvin at Windows was amazing . Standard of rooms was not up to the standard that I would have expected from this sort of hotel.The cost of the rooms should have meant that everything was in full working order and clean and tidy.Not acceptable to find broken glass on the floor of the bathroom.

title: Mediocre at best
text: Stayed here last week at this '5-star' hotel. We have stayed at many 5-star hotels in Central London, and this hotel is not 5-star. Here is why: (1) The windows in the room were filty. Probably cleaned when Earth Wind and Fire were in charts. (2) Room servicing was spotty - had to track down staff to request extra tea sachets (3) The windows were drafty - literally blowing a gale, which made room freezing cold (4) Internet was spotty - had to go to business center to get decent reception (5) Fridge did not work - it was literally hot in there. (6) No answer when we called reception (7) Noisy - could hear our neighbours playing 'September' (8) Room was not serviced when we went out and returned at 5 pm. Had to ask to get fresh towels. (9) Furniture was worn out and nicked - (ok thats minor, Ed) Good thing: location, location, location. This hotel has probably been taken over by a hedge fund and they have to get their 10% before they sell it on to the next investors.

title: Outstanding
text: Stayed here for a special birthday celebration. There was nothing that really could be complained about - rooms was lovely and had everything you needed. The bed was extremely comfortable. Staying in an executive room meant we had access to the lounge which again was very good. The service was outstanding in there and you felt well looked after. This hotel has a fantastic reputation and by staying there you can see why. I would definitely stay there again and recommend it 100% to anyone.

title: Missed the fundamentals for a 5 star hotel
text: We stayed here for 2 nights at the end of a month long European vacation. This was our only 5 star indulgence on our otherwise 3 and 4 star accommodation during our tour. As such I expected a 5 star experience. The hotel initially appeared very impressive. It is in a great part of the city with quite a wow entrance and foyer. We were provided a room on the 12th floor with nice views of the city out towards the London Eye. We were told the room was an upgrade so that was nice but I am not really sure what a standard room looked like as ours was not huge. Maybe it was level or aspect we were given. On the positive the hotel room was very nicely appointed with some fancy gadgets like powered blinds and a cool night switch that illuminates a floor light and a led chain light on the floor in the bathroom. We had some room service and it was excellent. On the poor side upon initial entry the room stunk of cigarette smoke (non smoking floor) and house services quickly sent someone up with spray and he showed us how to open the window a few inches. The smell remained evident each time we reentered the room. The windows were very dirty which detracted from the wonderful view. On a Saturday morning the desk did not have any pounds sterling cash to exchange for our Euro. Not even a 50 Euro note. I found that unusual especially given that it was Saturday morning and the dodgy exchange rates the punter is normally touched up with here. No toilet brush and no replenished tea and coffee was another disappointment but none of these were game changers. I have saved my major grips with this hotel until last. We were advised that our room had a king sized bed and this is something I thought should be expected in a 5 star hotel. The room provided had 2 single beds that were made up as single beds and pushed together to form one bed. Sorry but this is ridiculous. Zip them or attached them in some way if you must but at least throw a set of king sized sheets over them so that we might enjoy a true couples king bed experience. To make matters worse the beds are on castors and easily push apart. Try sleeping around the join and see where you end up. This is just a cheap way of doubling the versatility of the room to call it a twin share or king room with a 10 second push of the beds. Finally the water temperature in the bath is not hot enough. I am well aware of regulations about water temperature settings but when you can try to run a hot bath and easily hold your hand under the tap before it even hits the bath you know it is going to only be a warm bath experience. If you cannot supply the fundamentals in a proper bed or decent hot bath you are never going to do better than 3 from 5 in this review.

title: Chocolate Afternoon Tea!
text: Wow, the afternoon tea was fabulous. Nothing was too much trouble. Asked to sit in the window...no problem moved us. Sandwiches were scrumptious and if you didnt like one of the selection you could substitute. Tea selection excellent..the orange blossom oolong was glorious! replenished scones and jams,chocolate spread and cream and very original cake selection, the theme based on the Rolling Stones delightful, although a little overwhelming. The champagne was very palatable. Our waiter, a french guy was very attentive yet unassuming...and the best of all ....a doggy bag!!!!

title: Good business hotel
text: Stayed 9 nights in May for business. Location is top notch in Mayfair and very accessible to hyde park corner tube as well as green park tube which is where I caught jubilee line daily to Canary Wharf. Hotel is a typical Hilton. Well kept, clean and comfortable bed. Deluxe room on 9th floor provided great city views. Also turn down service nightly with complimentary bottled water was a nice touch. Stopped in trader Vic's one night just to say I was there but the beer was pricey as anticipated. Concierge was always more than helpful with the few questions that I had as well. Free wifi got the job done for phone browsing, email, and other apps but would be costly for regular computer or if I wanted to use high speed for FaceTime. All in all a solid stay.

title: Vacation
text: After a trans Atlantic cruise from Tampa FL we spent 3 1/2 days in this extremely pleasant hotel. Everyone was most outgoing and were very helpful in answering .questions, etc. The room was on the 17 floor with a view of Hyde Park and the traffic circle. Had dinner the first night at Trader Vic's and the portions were more than adequate. Would stay at this hotel in the future.

title: Superb London stay.
text: The location and views of Hyde Park are magnificent. The top (28th) floor restaurant is pricey but superb. Booking an Executive level room gains you access to the Executive Lounge, with full English breakfast and evening cocktails and appetizers, all complimentary. All service personnel are polite and accomodating. Definitely recommended if you are going to London, either for business or pleasure.

title: The Best Views Of Any London Hotel I've Stayed In
text: Had the pleasure of having a birthday treat at the Hilton and stayed on the 27th floor The Views were the best of any London Hotel I've stayed In. The room was absolutely great not too cramped and everything you could need for an overnight stay. But The Bed!! it was like trying to sleep on a slab of concrete it was that hard! Very disappointing for such a lovely hotel. The 27th floor was great for the views but not very good for the noise from above bar until at least 1:30am

title: wonderful meal at the Hilton Podium
text: From start to finish a wonderful meal perfectly cooked and so tasty.the staff very attentive and friendly.Loved it !!! The restaurant was extremely comfortable and atmosphere extremely relaxed,no rushing at all.

title: Splendid Knightsbridge base
text: A long weekend break in London saw my wife and I stay at the Hilton on Park Lane for the first time. We are glad we did - it's a splendid hotel. Having booked via a website, upon arrival we chose to upgrade to an Executive Room on the 26th floor. This was very comfortable with pleasing decor and a view second to none. Throughout our stay the staff were charming and helpful

title: Afternoon tea party
text: An amazing English five o'clock tea party! We came for five o'clock tea party and enjoy it very much! A great experience and very tasty one ! The sandwiches was just great and very tasty! The English Arel gray tea was great. The cakes trade was amazingly!! The stuff is very welcoming and an excellent device !!

title: Gorgeous hotel, excellent service
text: I was really impressed by the hotel and the service and I was lucky to be upgraded. Room had everything I needed though had slight wear and tear in places. The shower thermostat was broken which is why I did not give 5/5.

title: Amazed
text: Everything was really amazing Top service Nice clean and neat rooms I loved staying there for my holiday with my friends we really felt we were a royal members there for there 5 stats service Xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

title: Bad Hotel The Hilton Park Lane
text: Bad Hotel, High Price, Bad rooms, bad beds, was bugs on the bed, bad staff and dont care about any complain, old bathrooms, when i ask them for water they said we dont have today , they told me early chick in and they let me wait more than 3 hours to give me room and this room was surprize to me its very very small

title: fabulous hotel in a great location
text: we had a great experience staying here for 3 nights in June 2015. All the staff we encountered were helpful and friendly and the breakfast was fabulous! Hotel is clean with big rooms and in a great spot - an easy walk to lots of places we wanted to go to. We would definitely stay here again.

title: Another very pleasant stay at one of Londons premier hotels
text: Stayed here for the night for my anniversary in May. Lovely rooms and superb service. We were also treated to a half bottle of champagne,fruit and cakes as a complementary gift to help celebrate our anniversary. Highly recommend this hotel.

title: Wonderful city view
text: We stayed at the park lane Hilton for a Saturday night . The room was ready early .it wasn't overly large and the carpet was quite dirty but the views of the city were amazing .very nice bathroom .good amenities . The room was very quiet We had cocktails in our all time favourite bar downstairs .Trader vics .we love it .

title: What an amazing hotel
text: Our stay was wonderful! Our room was on the 16th floor. The view over London is beautiful. Amazing staff!!! Breakfast was tasty and a big variety! If you are looking at a awesome central and good quality place... look no further that the Hilton on Park lane. Will definitely Go back!!!

title: Very enjoyable
text: We stayed for two nights while I was in London for business. We were in an executive room which was large, clean and very comfortable. We were really happy with it. The view from the 25th floor was fantastic! My wife had room service on both evenings and the food and service were excellent. The only reason the hotel doesn't get 5 stars is the executive lounge, as other reviews have said, is very tired and needs a good revamp! The food provided was really good though. The bar on 28th floor was lovely and it's a shame that the executive lounge doesn't mirror this.

title: Very nice hotel - Great Location
text: Very nice hotel - lots of modern ammenities. Located across the street from the Hyde Corner Underground station and next to several bus stops for convenient transportation. Very close to shopping district and Buckingham Palace. Food served at breakfast was good and the staff was very friendly. If you are a Hilton's Honors Gold or Diamond member, the lounge is very nice, but tends to be very crowded.

title: Lovely hotel in excellent location
text: I stayed here for three nights in London. Being a HH Gold member it is not my favourite hotel, but the location is second to none. Our room was not ready in arrival at 2pm but we were offered another and checked in very quickly. The room was immaculate, modern and spacious with an incredible view over Hyde Park. The only thing I did not like was not having a window to open in the room, but I understand this is standard in lots of places and the air conditioning was more than adequate. I also used the Spa facilities for a massage and although quite expensive, was possibly the most relaxing hour of my life and definitely the best massage I've ever had! Staff were friendly and approachable always, and we took delight in walking to Oxford Street (10 minutes), Soho (20 minutes) and Piccadilly Circus (15 minutes). The only disappointment was after returning from a night out at dinner at the theatre the hotel did not have a bar open past midnight that I could have enjoyed a drink with my partner. I was offered a drink to be send to my room with a tray charge but I declined. I would recommend this Hotel highly.

title: Disappointing ..........
text: Great location but that was it. Check in slow, check out amazingly slow. Room large and comfortable enough but not very clean. Breakfast was OK but not really 5 star status and was crazy expensive. I will certainly not be back as there are many better alternatives.

title: Not so towering as we thought
text: My boyfriend booked to stay at The Hilton as part as my 18th birthday present. We both arrived and the check in was alright, Allen went through what we needed to know and we proceeded to our room. He mentioned to us he had upgraded us to a deluxe room which we thought was great. We then got to our room.. The view was lovely however we dread to think what size our room before would've been. We've been to many hotels and experience fantastic welcoming fruit, water, bubbles and many more however there was nothing in the room... Luckily we did bring our own bubbles along!!!!! Feeling a bit deflated. We did find some Merlot, Pringles, relief pack (plasters etc) and salted nuts which we assumed was compliment as no one had told us nor no sign was there to say included with Minibar etc. Over night stay was nice, big enough bed for us both. However, when we woke up we had a bill for 4 items on the minibar. We looked in the menu pricing once we had to phone reception for a menu price and realised the 'so called, complimentary, unlabelled nor explained' items which we did munch on we're chargeable. I would not want to stay here again as I felt as that I was being conned and had to pay out for every little thing. Not what I expected and can find other hotels around London for the same price.

title: Justifies the hype
text: Excellent location. Great view of Hyde Park. Parking was a challenge, very tight labyrinth of kerbs and pillars all bearing the scars of careless drivers. Room was spacious with a huge bed. Bathroom a little tired and in need of modernisation. Replace the bath with a walk in shower ? Clever lift system avoided frustrating delays. Breakfast was varied with some interesting juices and a omelette station, although we had to wait 10 minutes to be seated.

title: Ver good business hotel
text: This hotel is a very good choice for a business visit to London. The location is outstanding for the West End and the business district (City) is an easy journey by London Underground. Rooms are spacious and very comfortable. The restaurant ('Podium') and the less formal basement bar and restaurant ('Trader Vic's') are welcoming. Unfortunately the hotel internet/WiFi facilities are slow and unreliable - I had to get the resident technician to reconnect my WiFi every day when it failed and terminated the service. Several of the other members of my workshop group also had reason to complain. Hotel staff acknowledged that their WiFi system is not particularly good. Once this is rectified the Hilton On Park Lane will be a great choice.

title: Great Service
text: My wife and I stayed at the Hilton for our 2nd anniversary, and i had arranged some flowers and advised the hotel during the booking process. Upon arrival at the room the flower was delivered within minutes of check-in and a little while later a complimentary bottle of bubbly, fruit platter and anniversary card was delivered!! What a lovely surpise :) But really, we had reason for call room service/reception twice - once because things got messed up with the room (smoking instead of non-smoking) and again for some toothpaste - and the staff couldn't do enough to make out stay as relaxing as possible. One quible - i prefer more pillows on the bed as i need back support, but a small one. We at a Windows on the 28th floor - see seperate review, but equally the service was top end and we thorougly enjoyed our stay!!

title: Pleasant Stay, Minor Niggles
text: Stayed here for two nights in November with my Partner as part of our anniversary celebrations. Nice and attentive staff on the front door, ready to help with luggage and any assistance. Check-in was fast, although I was not welcomed as a HHonors Silver member, but no drama. The gent on reception was friendly enough. We stayed on the 15th floor in a King Deluxe Room. Spacious with great views overlooking the city skyscrapers. Bed was comfortable and fresh linen provided. Housekeeping could have been more attentive with the cleaning of the room, top of wardrobe caked it dust and strange stains on the bottom of the bath tub. Also, the hot water wasn't hot, but couldn't be bothered too have a room swap or cause a drama about it. Strange design of the bath, with the shower screen only covering half the bath and it cannot be moved, so when trying to turn bath on or empty plug, it's an assault course. Breakfast was nice, great selection of hot food. Although, I'd recommend the chef try the chicken sausages...they could be better! Everything else was perfect with the food offering. Good Job. Within two hours of checking in, two members of staff entered our room without giving us chance to answer the door, this was not a nice surprise! I asked them to come back, and give us more time to answer... But can I thank you for the kind gesture we received to our room after checking in,for our anniversary. (Fruit bowl, water and lemon tart) Would stay again.

title: London Hilton on Park Lane
text: The hotel was chosen because of its location. The staff were friendly and very helpful from the minute I checked in to the moment I checked out. It's an excellent hotel and good value for money but found bar prices a bit high.

title: Great location...below par service
text: Well, I stayed at this hotel for almost 4 weeks...so, I would say that I had an opportunity to experience the hotel in a fairly non-typical manner. First off, the positives...the hotel has a great location and the room size was good for Central London (we were in a King Deluxe room, which is what we had booked). The view from the room (16th floor) was nice. The bathroom was okay...the shower is placed inside the bathtub which is standard for some of the older hotels, although I prefer a walk-in shower to a bath tub in a hotel. The area where the hotel is really below average (even poor) is its service levels and attention to detail. While it is understandable that a hotel which is as large as this would not offer you super-personalized service, you would think that it would value a long-stay guest staying for 4 weeks. Well, in my experience, it was really impersonal without any warmth whatsoever. The breakfast at the hotel is average and the service poor. On many days, you have to wait 5-10 minutes just to get in as the queues are so long and the hotel does not seem to be able to fix it and service during breakfast on most days was bad (since they seem to be understaffed). One of the hostesses at the coffee shop (where breakfast is served) was quite nice but there was another one who was downright rude. To make matters worse, the hotel charged my credit card without my consent and despite specific instructions/ request from my side and even though they had enough authorization on the card to cover them in case of any issues...they kept making mistakes on the billing and hounding me as if I was going to run away...again, the hotel was fully protected as they had authorization on the card. I stayed in the same room over 4 weeks and the housekeeping was quite patchy...some days, it was good and on others it was quite poor. The concierge made a big deal out of storing our empty suitcases in the cloak room...we wanted 3 suitcases to be stored away to make space in the room...again, not what you would expect from a 5 star hotel with a long stay guest. Overall, I would not recommend this hotel if you are paying the full rate advertised on the website...if you have a good corporate rate, it would be okay since the hotel does have an unbeatable location and decent sized rooms, but don't expect any high service standards!

title: Chocolate Afternoon Tea.
text: This was bought for me as a gift. We arrived to be greeted by very friendly courteous staff who proved to be very helpful during our stay. Our waiters explained the procedure for the afternoon, and the order in which our food would arrive. We started with an individual plate of five delicious sandwiches, egg and cress, salmon and horseradish, ham and sundried tomato, and prawn cocktail. This was followed by a three tiered stand of beautiful cakes all containing chocolate, and displayed on chocolate plates. These were complimented by a choice of loose leaf teas, we had a jasmine, a rosy fig and a decaf afternoon tea, again all hot and delicious. Throughout the afternoon the staff came to ask if we were ok and if we wanted more. At no time did we feel rushed, and left with our uneaten food boxed to take home. I would certainly recommend this venue for any kind of meal as the lunches also looked delicious.

title: Great hotel wonderful stay
text: We have stayed in this hotel many times. The location cannot be better. I am a permanent Diamond HHonors card holder so I get automatic upgrades. This time was a two night stay and the upgrade was too a Park Lane Suite it was super in all ways the room, the staff. the cleaning were all excellent as usual. Even without the upgrades I would recommend this hotel to anyone

title: An Awkward Check-In
text: The room was booked in my husband's name. I have a different surname. I was first to arrive so went to check in. I handed over my photo ID and explained to the receptionist that it was booked in his name. She couldn't find the booking. I got my husband on the phone to extract a booking number and gave it to her. Even so, she claimed not to have found the booking. "Would it be booked with your husband's middle name?" I thought she asked. "No," I responded. It seemed nigh impossible she couldn't find anything under his name nor the booking number (both weren't showing up she said). So I handed over the phone to him so I was no longer the go between and she asked him what his middle name was. He told her. All of the sudden the booking was "found". It was just a bit weird and awkward

title: Daylight Robbery
text: Yes it's a nice place, and yes it's London But come on - charity fundraising dinner £279 + vat per head before starting Small bottle of beer - £7 Bottle of basic Pinot Grigio - £44 Shocking profiteering

title: Great Location and service
text: This is our 6th time staying in London and the 1st at the Park Lane Hilton. The location is great for a central London location and the service we received was excellent. We paid a bit more for this hotel than we had originally planned, however, it was well worth it!

title: Central and stylish. Good bar at the top
text: Stayed here for an event and it is large. Room were clean but moderate sized and expensive. Location central. Bar at the top floor was very nice but again expensive! Overall as expected for central London hilton

title: Lovely room let down by public areas
text: This was a special event and we stayed because we wanted to enjoy our meal in Galvins and not have to travel home afterwards. Our meal was lovely and our room really nice and the views from our room were spectacular. What spoilt the experience were the public areas. The bar by Galvins was packed and very noisy as well as being very expensive. The reception area was constantly extremely busy and packed with people. These were all forgivable but the Breakfast was the real letdown. It was akin to eating in a staff canteen that children were also allowed into. The variety of food was very good and the service wasn't bad but the place was absolutely packed with families with young children who were all allowed to do what they wanted. They stuck fingers into dishes of food and picked up food and put it back into the dishes using their hands. There was food all over the floors and the whole place was messy. Their parents paid no attention but did manage to get in everyone's way and acted as though only they had the right to be there. We would go back to Galvins but would never consider staying in this hotel again as it has clearly been taken over by a particular group of people and their families.

title: Fabulous setting and close to everthing
text: My husband surprised me with tickets to an open air concert in Hyde Park to see Carol King and Don Henley, so we decided to make a weekend of it and stay in London, We chose the Hilton Park Lane as it is literally opposite Hyde Park and minutes away from shopping on Oxford Street or strolling down Piccadilly. There are bus stops really close for sightseeing and also the underground station. On arrival at the hotel we were greeted by a really friendly doorman and then a very cheery chap on the front desk. We had a twin room on the 8th floor. The view was okay and we could see a bit of the park. Obviously it wasn't huge as we were in Central London. There were tea and coffee making facilities, together with robes, hairdryer, etc. The bathroom was very well equipped with lots of toiletries and towels. After the concert we called into Trader Vics in the Hilton. They serve light hot snacks, which include ribs, chicken skewers, etc. They are not large plates of food - so a few is good. They also serve lots of different cocktails. Considering where we were, the price was good. The staff were really friendly again. The only negative was the beds were a bit hard and the room a bit worn but maybe that's just me. Overall, we had a great stay and I would recommend this hotel. PS. The concert was fantastic and we are already planning our next trip back.

title: Amazing weekend
text: My Children and I stayed at the Hilton Park Lane this weekend and we cannot speak highly enough of our stay there, The location is of course second to none for London. The staff are what stand out for me, no request was too much trouble from arranging cars/travel to room service ( which was always prompt and thats not easy!) We had the use of the Lounge which was far and away more than you could ever need , the food was superb and I'll never forget my daughters face when she saw gold leaf on cake @ Afternoon tea! Great stay at a wonderful Hotel

title: Yummy food!
text: We had a lovely meal at The Hilton Park Lane in the Podium restaurant. Food was very yummy and the staff were friendly. We booked over the telephone and they had our table ready for us when we arrived. Fantastic food and service!

title: Disappointing, far from 5 star experience
text: I stayed at the hotel Tues 7th Oct. I don't really understand how this hotel has a 5 star rating, I would say is more of an average 4 stars. On arrival there is no one to assist with luggage or doors. The general feeling when entering is that it

title: Perfect example of hospitality
text: The Park Lane, flagship of Hilton in UK. What else is there to say... Having stayed in different Hiltons in London before I decided to book a room for me and my girlfriend for our anniversary. From the very first moment I was greeted by Christian in reception who checked me in and made me aware of a complimentary upgrade to an executive room which was, to say the least, impressive. The views were so very worth it... Room service for dinner was quick and delicious, whilst the housekeeping porter was as well quick to deliver extra shampoo and dental kits. From the very beginning we were treated by name and felt very properly taken care of. Raffaella in F&B made sure our breakfast experience was top notch. As well special mention should be granted to Ishita and Isaac in reception, who made their most to retrieve my phone back once I lost it in a silly way inside the room after check out. Trully an experience to remember. Thank you.

title: Needs a face lift especially the rooms
text: Being a Hilton member was disappointed in the rooms.The need a upgrade.The toilets didn't flush properly & having to pay for wi-fi was disappointing as we have stayed in other big name hotels & small ones where we get free wi-fi.Hotel is close to Harrods & Oxford Street so it was handy walking distance.Our room over looked Hyde Park.The staff were very helpful with our needs.

title: Hilton Hotel Park Lane
text: The Hilton Park Lane is situated in an excellent area near to Hyde Park and Piccadilly. Service is very good with a very pleasant and friendly atmosphere. The staff are very attentive and are very helpful in all areas. The banquet was delicious and well served.

title: Not impressed, stayed in executive level room. Nice Lobby and bars but room nothing special
text: Best thing about this hotel is Trader Vics, I just love it down there, it reminds me of being in Hawaii and they do a fantastic Pina Colada, it is usually quiet mid week earlier on so nice and relaxing too. The hotel has a gorgeous lobby and bar, and I love Windows too but the rooms are not fabulous and the lounge access isn't worth the extra money. Hilton's vary so much all over the world, the best Hilton I ever saw was the Doubletree in Kusadasi! Exquisite! If only all Hiltons looked like that wow!

title: Elegant & Exquisite
text: Great place and people to stay with. Loved the Cleanliness and cooperative staff. The property has been well kept. The breakfast was great but might need a change in menu from time to time. Overall a very peaceful experience.

title: Night away
text: We thought we would treat ourselves to a night away. Looked at several hotels. Booked a deluxe king size room. Arrived at check in, staff very polite and helpful. On check in, staff said he would get us as high as possible with an upgrade to our room . We were given a room on the 27th floor. Originally booked between 12/17 th floor. The room was OK. Very compact. All the extra things you would expect. Bathroom very small, dark and dingy . Overall finish of decor poor. Lovely view of city. If this was a upgrade, not sure what our original room was like. Breakfast very over priced not sure how you can justify £26 for a full English.

title: Best hotel I've ever stayed at
text: This is by far the best hotel I've ever stayed at. The staff were warm and welcoming, the room was huge with a fantastic view over London, the room service was fantastic and quick and the food was brilliant. Every time I see the hotel now I want to go back and stay. I would highly recommend staying if you can afford it.

title: Perfection again
text: As a Hilton diamond member we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the London Hilton on Park Lane. We received upgrade and complimentary breakfast. The room was wonderful - spacious and well maintained. All the staff were extremely helpful and friendly. I would like to say a big 'thank you' to Natalie (Guest Services) and Abdel (Front line) who were exceptional. The executive lounge was spacious and offers quality items (coffee, snacks, etc). The breakfast in the restaurant has more to offer/selections, but Executive Lounge is also nice & quiet. The hotel is not cheap but the customer service makes the price more than worth it. The location was perfect. The hotel is located in walking distance of many top attractions in London. Overall, the hotel is perfect in every aspect. Definitely among the best hotels we have stayed with. We remain loyal to Hilton because of experiences like this. We have stayed in the hotel many times, and we will definitely return soon.

title: Chocoholics afternoon tea
text: Had a wonderful afternoon tea. Staff were very attentive and the food was delicious. When the food arrived it didn't look to be enough, how wrong we were. Plenty for us both and if we couldn't have managed it all a beautiful box was provided to take the rest home.

title: Industry Luncheon
text: Attended an Annual function in November. Over 1200 guests. Organisation was very good, food served promptly and of a consistently high quality across all courses. Dropped a point as one of my guests asked for tea and nothing arrived, despite numerous requests, but the bill for the wine on the table arrived promptly!

title: Nice, could be so much better!
text: Having stayed at a number of DoubleTree and Hilton hotels, we payed for a night at this hotel using HHonors points to treat ourselves. I’m starting to wonder whether it was the right decision. Check-in was swift and friendly and was advised that we had reserved a smoking room, being non smokers we asked to change and the lovely lady at the desk obliged. We were put in a conjoining room that was separated by two doors, this wasn’t a problem until 6:30am the following morning, when someone’s phone alarm kept going off every 15 minutes until 8:00am. If you’re going to have conjoining rooms, they need to be well insulated! Bath robes and slippers are a nice touch in the room, but little things like the TV remote control not working and the loose shower head makes this hotel fall below the usual Hilton standard we’ve come to expect. In terms of service, this hotel would be a four but the overall stay means I can’t give it more than a three. With a few simple tweaks, this could change.

title: Love the Property BUT Not a Fan of their Room Service
text: I try to always stay at the Hilton London at Park Lane when i go to London for business. The accommodations are usually the best and what I expect from a Hilton. However, I must say - now a second time here with an incident with their Room Service. Made an order and got it 45 minutes later. The onion soup was hot and very good. However, the pizza in a box was the coldest I have ever had. I called immediately and had them take it away. They offered to bring a "hotter" one....well after I wanted it by now. I then mentioned this to the front desk, with a dismay that this was my dinner. Only to get a "well they took it off the bill". While that was expected, I am still very hungry and now have to redress and go out for a meal. ARGGGGGGG.

title: Great stay
text: Very impressed with this hotel. I had stayed at many brands of hotels in London throughout time, and was very impressed with this hotel. We had a room on a high floor, and the view of Hyde Park was superb. The front desk clerks were all pleasant. The size of the rooms were huge compared to London standards. This hotel can be summed up as a perfect place to stay in one of the nicest locations in London, Mayfair.

title: Very nice stay
text: We stayed here after going to the theatre and had booked the Mayfair suite in advance. Very nice hotel, great welcome at check in & room very nice. Sadly the sofa was clearly rather old, sunken and so uncomfortable we couldn't sit on it. The only other irritating point is that, due to the position of the room, we could clearly hear the lifts going up and down until about midnight. It wasn't necessarily a huge issue but, had I have been advised that lift noise was likely, I wouldn't have paid for that particular suite. The room was clean, nicely decorated and laid out with a spacious bathroom and plenty of toiletries. The best part of the room was the view over London, absolutely stunning! Staff were very helpful & polite, we decided to use the executive lounge at breakfast and were very impressed with this. Would definitely book again, but probably an executive room rather than the suite.

title: Comfortable stay with a great view
text: This hotel is perfectly located with easy access to many attractions of London. Staff was very helpful all stay long. Small problems and additional requests were successfully handled by them. I stayed in one of the top floors with an unbelievable city view. Waking up to a wonderful London view was a great start to a day. I was totally satisfied with the cleanliness of the room and room service during my stay. Information desk also guided me very well whenever it was needed. When I returned to my home country, I realized that my mp3 player is still at the hotel. After exchanging some e-mails with the hotel security, mp3 player is sent to me without any problems. Special thanks to the head of security, Sir Ian Blake:)

title: Spectacular views from the Park Lane Suite
text: Recently stayed at the Park lane on a Friday night. As a Hilton Gold member we were treated by the reception desk to a complimentary upgrade to the Park lane Suite which is as grand as it sounds and really started the weekend off with a bang! But it was more than this that really set the mood. The staff are really helpful and polite and cannot do enough for you. Couple this with really superb facilities set in such a pefect location in London and you have the makings of a memorable stay.

title: Great room, great views and great location
text: My partner and I stayed at the Hilton Park Lane a couple of weeks ago to get us into the Christmas Spirit. We had an amazing time. The room was clean and spacious and we had an amazing view overlooking the Hyde Park Winter Wonderland. We were unable to check in early but the check in was extremely efficient and we were able to leave our luggage so that it was ready in our room on our return. Room service responded to our requests extremely quickly. All of the staff were extremely friendly, professional and helpful. The only critique I could give is that the breakfast room isn't large enough to serve all of the guests which meant large queues built up into the hotel lobby. The staff however, clearly did their best to deal with this and were regularly ensuring that all guests could have drinks while they wait. It's definitely the small things like this that make a difference when problems do arise as it shows that customers aren't forgotten in a queue.

title: Podium restaurant
text: We went to this restaurant on a living social voucher. The meal and food we're excellent as was the inclusive bottle of wine. Particular mention goes to Rebekka who was a superb waitress as I had to change some of the dining requests due to dietary requirements. They also accommodated a change of table without any fuss. This is totally unlike the Savoy hotel (Kaspers seafood bar) where the waiter, sommelier and manager were awful - three bottles of wine were off - it took them 20 minutes to concur to this - no consolation drink or apology was offered and they got the order wrong twice and also served cold chips to my husband which were not brought again until he had finished the meal - it was not even busy. Full marks to the Hilton park Lane and Rebekka!!!

title: Great Stay!
text: We visited London in November 2014, The hotel is in a great location, close to many attractions, good restaurants, and easy access to the Tube. The hotel is modern, clean, and the staff was very accommodating. As much as I like the hotel, I did not find it to be a true 5 star hotel, that being said, I would not hesitate to return. We had been out all day touring and decided to grab a quick bite at the Hotel Restaurant, Trader Vics--the food and service were excellent!

title: Attention, Hilton employees - THIS is how it should be done.....
text: The last few times I have stayed in Hilton Hotels I have received service and accommodation that has ranged from Excellent (Tower of London), through various levels of boring or just not very good, down to one of the worst hotel experiences of my life. It's fair to say that the Hilton group were no longer flavour of the month for me when travelling, and I have got to the stage where I would rather book in to a cheap, but invariably better, hotel whenever I had an alternative. Due to some unforgivable problems I had endured at a UK located Hilton, I received the opportunity to pay a visit to the London Hilton on Park Lane, and was able to arrange it so that it fell a couple of days after my wife's birthday, and shortly after a milestone wedding anniversary. The staff at the hotel were aware that we were coming in to town to celebrate, and undoubtably were aware of the previous issues, and someone had decided to pull out all the stops! A friendly, efficient and extremely speedy check in was followed up with the much welcomed news that we were to be billeted in a super room way up on the 23rd floor, overlooking the gardens of Buckingham Palace. The duty manager, a lovely lady named Emma, took the time to greet us personally, and escorted us up to our room. Executive lounge admission was also produced, and Emma ensured that we had everything we could possible need for our stay. That afternoon was spent out in London, followed my a meal and a show, and we did not return to our room until very late in the evening. However, after a quick shower and change, it was down to Trader Vic's - the newly refurbished bar situated in the basement of the hotel. Again, the service was first class and so, so friendly. A pleasant hour or two was spent downing cocktails, before retiring to our room for the night. The bed had previously been turned down, and a tray of fruit and pastries had been left out for us. The huge and comfortable bed assured us of a good nights sleep. Or at least it did until the Middle Eastern occupants of the adjoining room decided to argue, shout and debate the woes of the world - at 3.30 am. After half an hour or so, it was quite apparent that they were all set for an all night session, so a quick call to reception was needed. The response was first rate. Within a couple of minutes I heard a tap on the door of their room, followed a brief muted conversation, and then silence reigned. I don't know just what security said or did, but the effect was immediate! A first class job! Breakfast in the morning was everything you would hope for at a top hotel, and checking out was just as easy and pleasant as checking in. Once again Emma was present to ensure that we had enjoyed our stay, and to see us off. The overall service received at this establishment was a shining example of how hotels should be run. It doesn't matter if you are there as a guest of the management, or whether the hotel charges £50 or £850 for a room - the basics are the same,- treat the guests in the way that you would wish to be treated yourself. A little time, a nice smile, some genuine concern for their comfort - it all costs nothing. The management of the Park Lane Hilton can be justifiably proud of their establishment. Not just because it is a super luxury hotel with wonderful facilities, but because of the quite excellent staff that they have working for them. The Hilton Group should cause all of their staff from all of their other establishments to sit up and take heed of the correct way to do things. They should take a leaf out of this hotel's book, because unless they up their game, it won't be too long before there aren't too many Hilton's left. The Hilton Park Lane will remain though - because it is the epitome of good service. And there is something else as well. Yes it's a bloody expensive hotel. But if you can manage it - go there. You won't be disappointed. Treat yourself, and in turn let the staff there treat you right. Thank you Emma, and thank you to everyone who works so hard to make sure that all of your guests have such a warm and comfortable stay. I

title: Best location in pretty London
text: Other reviews say this hotel is getting old which is true but still it's definitely an amazing place to be when in London. Common areas are well taken care of. The roof top bar is awesome! Rooms are spacious and well equipped. I had a view towards the Hyde Park which was very nice. Breakfast was very expensive though. I simply went to Pret-a-Manger (5min walk) and had some fruit, yogurt, coffee and a croissant for 1/3 of the price! Another good place to ear nearby is Prezzo, right behind the hotel - delicious pizza, pasta and atmosphere (me and my mother went there 4x in a week!). There is a bus stop conveniently located right in front of the hotel which can take you pretty much everywhere in London. Would definitely go back!

title: Does what it says on the tin
text: Managed to secure a nice room for £98 using hilton honours points (well worth joining if you travel regularly). Great location, nice staff. Just the job really😊only a 10 minute walk to either Kinghtsbridge or Bond street.

title: Chocolate delight!
text: Recently my daughter and I booked a chocolate afternoon tea, with champagne, through Groupon. We were seated in the Podium restaurant, the staff were very friendly and explained the menu and range of teas on offer. The sandwiches were of the open variety, a reasonable selection (although I had requested not to have egg, as unable to eat it, but was given this anyway. I'm sure it was an oversight and just left it) The 3 tier cake stand was the outstanding feature of the tea, delicious scones, jam and fresh clotted cream. The cake selection was truly amazing, the top tier being served upon a slab of white chocolate. We left feeling very full. A chocolate lover's dream!

title: HIGH FLOOR XXXXX
text: We stayed here to attend a concert across the road. The hotel is expensive but you know you are getting the Hilton service and they go out of there way for you. We stayed in a very high up floor suite overlooking the Park and Palace. Our maid was very funny. Really nice 5 star with a lovely bar on the top floor.

title: Internet does not work properly at this hotel
text: In this hotel internet connections do not work properly. It is either there is no connection or it is disconnected in every 5 minutes and also it is very slow. I do not understand why the hotel management can not solve this problem. This is a long time problem at this hotel. Using 3G is expensive for a foreigner plus it is very slow in the UK. I wish I could receive a reply from the hotel management thal they have upgrated their systems so that I can maka a reservation in this hotel next time I am in London.

title: Overnight Stay
text: A nice hotel, but to be honest I thought being on Park Lane we would be staying at a Hilton Flagship Hotel. The hotel was clean & comfortable, the room we were in, I expected to be larger, but that aside, the bed was very comfortable & the amneties in the room 1st class.

title: I'm coming back
text: This is a great hotel. The location is awesome--who can't like the Mayfair area?--and the staff were great. My wife and I usually rent a flat when we're in London and don't have a whole lot of experience w/ business class hotels in London, but this was a great place to stay.

title: Not what it should be
text: So, stayed in many hotels around the world. What is missing from this hotel is the eye for the details that are important. In this day and age, when you stay in a suite (The Park Lane Suite in my case on this visit), potentially there could be 3 or 4 people in the suite, for the sake of argument lets then say two. So, what hotel in this day and age limits a room of this status to 2 mobile devices for the internet connection? And then cannot come up with a solution around it? Really...? The room was clean, the servicing of it was fine. Check in was efficient, check out we shall see...This hotel just does not shine like many others do in London. I stayed because the guest relations manager invited me to after a below average experience during the summer at this hotel. It is not a bad hotelm it just is not good enough...

title: location and breakfast good!
text: I mean Hilton is really not great these days are they. But this hilton is one of the best, the bar on the top floor is amazing and great views over the whole of london. you can eat there too and i know its michelin star but I personally have never dined there yet! But galvin at windows do best frozen daiquiris around! breakfast is really nice and unreal pastries! other than that location good for mayfair and oxford street just a short stroll away! but room nothing to write home about just normal hilton inoffensive rooms!

title: Not the usual Hilton quality
text: My husband and I stayed here for 4 nights and have stayed at various Hilton hotels throughout the world. Firstly, the reception staff were unfriendly and gave us the wrong room. I pointed this out and we were changed to the correct executive level room with no apology.The room quality was average with a frankly perplexing glass sliding bathroom door that does not stay closed and is unable to be locked. We paid for an executive level room and it was not the standard we've come to expect from the Hilton brand. Although the room was a good size and had a nice view, the bed was saggy and the pillows flat as pancakes. There was no heated towel rail which I would expect from the executive level and the bathroom was dark and very cold. The makeup mirror was broken. We were continually woken during the night by guests slamming doors so the hotel obviously has a design fault which it has failed to remedy. We will not stay again, there is much better value to be had from other hotels in this area and if the Hilton brand can't be bothered to upkeep their hotels in line with customer expectations then we will give our money to someone else and continue to write poor reviews on line.

title: Top class base for London visit
text: It's a Hilton on Park Lane so you know that it's going to be good. Ideal location for sightseeing or shopping. Friendly staff who are very helpful. Breakfast is excellent. If you are going to the capital for a short stay, push the boat out and treat yourself to a room here.

title: Perfect
text: Just back from this wonderful hotel with my wife its in a perfect location near to everything very handy for top attractions the palace is just 10 minutes walk as well as oxford street marble arch and about 25mins walk to big ben.Its also very conivent for hard rock which is minutes away and if you go through back of hotel you could be in bond street in 15 mins its great not any need for taxis if you feel up to it.It was a special coccasion for us thats why we picked here booked 3 months in advance got a wonderful upgrade from allen as nice person just enough chat and friendly manor we were on the 20th floor which had great views of city and it was smoking room which was a nice option.Room had everything you would want and a nice size for inner city hotel only small concern was nice from people coming out of lifts on saturday at 3am but it was saturday night and maybe they had one to many and the light coming through under room door was making it hard to sleep so I just threw a towel down to stop it.It was only 10 minutes in taxi from victoria which was great.The team in hotel were very courteous and smiled alot which made me feel at home in such a big city.I want to thank the team for making our first trip to london a trip to remember and dont forget to go to the 28th floor in the night and have a glass or two of wine and take in the views a real treat.Only one complaint that the price for internet is crazy I just had to say it other from that flawless top marks a warm thank you to the doormen which in my opinion made a big difference to us just answering questions on london and letting us where to go and not to go which was very kind on them.PS The hop on hop off bus tour is just across from hotel and brings you back there when its over.

title: Good, clean accommodation
text: We stayed in the London Town hotel from 10th to 12th November. The room was basic but very clean and an amazing shower! breakfast was fine for continental. It was a very good location for the tube into London centre too. Overall a good experience.
