text: Very clean nice hotel 2 min walk frOm Olympia. Breakfast was good, though no full English option. Bed a bit hard but ok for a night. Room G3 was next to reception so there was a bit of noise early evening whilst guests checking in but no disturbance in night. Definitely worth a visit, nice pubs nearby too

title: Hmmmmmm
text: Booked this room for a one night stay to go to a show. It was just about ok. Greeted by 2 ladies on reception, neither one chose to say hello. We were told out room number and directed to the top of the 1st flight of stairs. To say the room was small really is an understatement. I think even the most elaborate of estate agents wouldn't have the nerve to describe this as more than a small single. Two people cannot move around the room at one time, one person has to shimmy down the bed to get out. The bathroom is no bigger that an aeroplane toilet with a shower connected. The shower door only opened a third of the way. The only real positive was that it was spotlessly clean. Transport links to the city are a little lengthy. It isn't on a main route which was a bit tedious late at night. Breakfast was continental and ok. I have to say I wouldn't stay again.

title: Very small room but handy for Olympia
text: The hotel was very clean and the beds were comfortable but the room was tiny and I was glad I did not have a dress to hang up in the wardrobe as it was barely tall enough for a jacket and I had to hang my coat on the back of the bathroom door. Breakfast was adequate although the croissants didn't taste as if they were fresh that day. The hotel was very hot and humid for the cool London weather we experienced during our stay and the air conditioning wasn't working. I also found my usual bugbear of hotels as there was no mirror within reach of a socket and so you couldn't use straighteners, although the hotel did lend me an extension lead so that I could use mine in the bathroom (fortunately I didn't get an electric shock), also the light in the bathroom was very poor for applying makeup. This was difficult as we were exhibiting at a business exhibition at Olympia and obviously appearance is very important in these circumstances. Only one pillow wase supplied per bed and it took three hours and two calls to reception to get more. The towels were very small and inadequate if you wanted to wrap one around your wet hair while you dried yourself on another. Why do hotels ignore the needs of female travellers so often? The hotel is on a quiet street just accross the railway track from London Olympia and it was just a couple of minutes to cross the bridge at the station to reach the entrance for the grand hall. The noise from trains wasn't too loud as it is a quiet line. I would use this hotel again if we were at Olympia in future, although there are cheaper hotels of the same quality in West London we didn't want the hassle of travelling before and after the show and for the post show reception.

title: Excellent value.
text: We booked at the last minute to stay here for a weekend in London. We were a little nervous and unsure what to expect as the hotel is described by some websites as a "budget" hotel, so we were concerned we would find dirty rooms etc - but I have to say we were pleasantly surprised. The reception area and lift are small but functional, and the room itself was clean, modern, well equipped (with an ironing board, writing desk, TV) and modern clean bathroom. To a certain extent you do pay for what you get, so the lack of a window in the room (there was only a very tiny window behind the bed) was something we would have preferred to avoid, and the rooms didn't seem to be sound-proofed as we could hear people walking around in the rooms around us... however these are just picky criticisms and in general, for the price, this was a very good option and next time we're in the area we will probably book again.

title: London experience
text: I found this hotel very welcoming and ideal for staying and visiting London with a young child. Until I found out that the nearest station Kensington Olympia was an overground station and that tickets could be used from the underground system it had meant a lot of walking. This could be made clear in information given

title: Fantastic Value, Clean Rooms, friendly Staff
text: I was attending/working the Ideal Home Christmas Exhibition at Olympic the hotel was five minutes away so convenient after a long day working. The cooked breakfast was average and didn't help it was cold but the continental breakfast made up for it. I would recommend this hotel despite being woken up with water flooding through my ceiling where another guest had left the shower door open.

title: Not that bad but expected more
text: Stayed at this hotel for 1 night. The location was very close to the train station. But I arrived at Paddington, and there is no service from Earls court to Olympia on the weekday, only on the weekends. But easy via the overground. The hotel was easy to find, located on a quiet street. The hotel lobby was clean. The receptionist wasnt the most receptive but the football was on when I checked in..... when I arrrived there was no acknowledgement by the receptionist. I checked in and payment was taken. My room was on the third floor but I wasnt told there was a lift and I wasnt I told where the breakfast room was. Very poor service. I came back down to borrow an Iron and the receptionist was hesitant to go get it........but the footie was on........... I went out for dinner and the iron was ready when I returned, its only then he told me I could use the lift. The room was clean and the AC worked. The room was small and with its slopping roof it felt even smaller. But I was travelling alone so It was ok. The receptionist told me that he didnt have an ironing board but there was no way one could fit in the room. There was a fridge and complimentary tea and coffee. The was also free Wifi which worked fine. The room was very clean and so was the bathroom. The bathroom was nicely done, nice tiles and good hot powerful shower, complimentary toiletries. The bed was comfortable and I slept well. The breakfast was in a nice modern breakfast room. The breakfast was continental and plentiful. The staff were very helpful and they replaced the breakfast items very quickly. There are shops close by tesco etc...there is a pub over the road and a few restaurants. I ate at the indian Miran Masala and the food was nice. I payed £119 for one night as a double....this room should be sold as a single due to its size. I could only image what the single room looks like. I stayed in room 305, which is at the top of the stairs, its great as no noise from above etc. But if I was staying with my partner I wouldnt want to stay in 305. I give this hotel 3.5 out of 5 as its above average.

title: Very nice
text: This hotel is the perfect place to stay short term. Close to the Olympia overground station and the Olympia Conference Center. The bed was very comfortable, not sagging or soft like most hotels. Nor did my room have a musty smell unlike a big name hotel around the corner that my friend was staying in. The staff was extremely helpful. I would stay here again if there was an event at Olympia again

title: Very comfy beds, awesome location for Olympia
text: Stayed here when visiting a 2-day event at the London Olympia. Great service at reception, nice clean and modern rooms and a huge comfy double bed with air con. I was actually amazed just how close it is to the olympia. Literally a 5 min walk and a single right turn. Would definitely stay there again. I didn't eat breakfast there, but it was great value at just shy of £8. You'd easily spend that at a local cafe or patisserie. Complimentary tea, coffee, water and biscuits in the room too which is a nice touch considering the value.

title: Location Good
text: Stayed 3 nights based on location of nearby conference Helpful staff, early check in, provided adaptor, arranged taxis etc Free WiFi in room / plenty of heating and hot water with generous shower. Actual room was miniscule! and difficult to move around with bags and 2 people. Access to only one side of bed squeezed against 2 walls which is tricky enough when staying as a couple! - fridge in wardrobe. Room (1?) located under the stairs on the ground floor,avoid this room unless you are deaf. Everyone using the stairs can be heard day and night.

title: Great Hotel for the price. Right next to Olympia.
text: One night stay whilst visiting Apollo Theater. Hotel is right next to Olympia. The room was clean and tidy and found for only £59, for a double room not bad for London. The en suite bathroom was refurbished to a high standard. No single occupancy surcharge. The room had a safe,a fridge, tea and coffee making and guest slippers. Bed linen, towels etc all freshly laundered. Friendly staff on reception. Ok it is not like a holiday inn or upmarket hotel, it is a converted large terraced house but as a place to stay for a night I could not fault it. Breakfast was provided in a pleasant basement room for £6.90 again not bad for London. A very adequate breakfast was provided. Fruit juices, fruit, variety of cereals, toast maker, choice of continental style or cooked breakfast. Bacon, sausage, beans, tomato and pieces of omelette, tea and coffee. Again with friendly staff. Only draw back to watch for is its apparent proximity to tube station which is Kensington (Olympia) this station is a restricted service only open at weekends and when some events are on at Olympia. The hotel is a 15 minute walk from Hammersmith.

title: Suberb
text: Excellent location for the Olympia stadium at Kesington..like a 4 min walk. Rooms small but immaculate and clean. Breakfast also very good. Would highly recommend. Went to westend in the evening and it was really easy to get there.

title: Good for the money
text: My partner and I stayed for 1 night before an event at Olympia (can't get much closer !) We checked in all smoothly, make sure you take ID they take a copy. Lift to 2nd floor. Room, compact but adequate complete with own air con unit although ours room 202 made some funny noises after a while so had to turn off and on again. Didn't go for brekkie but believe it's continental . Would I stay here again? Yes, if you book direct and use code Mstay you get 15% off. Ten minute walk to Bill Wymans sticky fingers (separate review to follow). And South Kensington high st.

title: Clean newly refurbished
text: Small rooms that fits a small doublebed or single. Avoid room 203 because of an uninsulated door connecting to the next room which meant that you could hear every sound from your neighbors. Nice bathroom though tiny. Very friendly staff both in the basement breafast room ( again tiny) and in the reception.

title: Is decor or bed more important.....
text: Just had 2 nights in a beautiful, tastefully decorated hotel in heart of London. Convienient for Olympia shows. Room was VERY cramped, but space is premium price I know. Room designed more towards a business man I guess, as no shelf in front of lovely shower room mirror for ladies bits 'n' pieces. Head & foot of bed touched a wall at each end. Had to climb on bed, then foot on windowsil to reach dangerous wide opened window on 2nd floor that had no restriction bars. The bed, pillow & duvet were that of a nil star hotel I am sad to say, & really let the whole place down. Pillows so flat & hard, no way could they be 'pumped' up & no pillow protector & have come away with a sore throat ?!? Not sure what rest of rooms were like, but chatting to lady over breakfast (excellent) her bed etc were exactly the same. No chair. Very hot room but not from heating as nothing on, not even the HOT towel rail. Air con - no instructions. I was a woman alone & felt safe walking to end of road, turn right over the bridge & pub with good food on the left - but I always keep a lookout knowing if anyone walking close no matter where in the wolrd I am.

title: Great hotel perfect for Olympia events
text: Great room, fantastic breakfast. Location directly opposite Kensington train station, two minute walk from Olympia. Receptionist not to friendly but try to be helpful on other hand all other staff lovely. Had a really great stay, going back next year hopefully if vacant

title: Small rooms but very clean, great location!
text: I stayed here for just the one night as I needed somewhere last minute, the price was pretty good for last minute so booked it over the phone. I was in a single room although had a double bed, the room was pretty small but very well equipped! Came complete with kettle, tea & coffee making facilities, even got biscuits! Really comfy bed, although i will say the bedroom was a little cold as I think the heating is controlled by the main desk? I could have called them but as it was the one night I didn't bother, opposite to that the bathroom was boiling!! The room itself was spotless, especially the bathroom, something i always check and really cant fault it. I would definetely book again if i could get a decent price, ideal for Olympia. Didn't have breakfast so cant comment on that, also didn't have much contact with the desk staff but they seemed nice enough.

title: Small rooms, convenient location, clean
text: Had to wait 20 mins to check in as no one on reception. Then it took another 20 mins to get through check in process - very unsatisfactory - have never had to wait that long to get into a hotel room. We had to show photo id (we are UK residents! - new one on me, never had to in UK before). Staff ok, not overly helpful or friendly, just ok. G01 was noisy (noises from reception) and my colleague got no sleep the first night, his room was changed the second night but no compensation was offered. My room was a Small double, floor space so tight should have been a single - 2 people would find it very difficult to share, one would need to stay on the bed whilst the other got dressed. OK for one person. Breakfast was disappointing - cheap food, particularly the bread. Over heated - my air con was set at 27 degrees and the radiator on full when I arrived. What a waste. Room was clean and well equipped. The hotel is off the main roads so a good quiet street but conveniently located. We booked 6 rooms over 2 nights - hotel wouldn't negotiate on price and didn't seem overly keen for our business - another reason we will not be returning.

title: Lovely location but not great facilities
text: We only booked for one night as needed to be in the area. Room was ok, not big but didn't matter as we did not stay for too long. When we went back to our room to sleep we realised there is no heating and we had no way of watching TV as probably the aerial was not working. We did call the receptionist who was very happy to come up and have a look. She plugged the electric heater and tried to understand the issue with the TV. The heater was cold until the next morning that we checked out and she couldn't fix the TV. The breakfast was ok. Probably won't stay there again.

title: A missed opportunity
text: Although this hotel was too new to have been reviewed, I decided to risk it on the basis that it would be at least clean and in good condition, as it was. Reception staff were generally helpful and friendly, and it is in a convenient location very near to Olympia. But there was little else to recommend it. The room I had was described as a "small double", but while it was just about tolerable for one person, it would have been impossible for two. There was literally just enough room for a small double bed, and with two people one would have had to crawl over the other to get to the toilet. There was no wardrobe or anywhere to put clothes, just a few hooks to hang up coats

title: great location, noisey rooms
text: Stayed here recently for an event at Olympia. Chosen for location and cost. The hotel itself is set over several floors and the rooms are squeezed in to make the use of space. I had room 103, which shared a small hallway with three other rooms. My room had an interconnecting door with another room, which meant every noise and word could be heard from the adjoining room - no good if you are trying to get to sleep and your neighbour is clearly skype-ing home. Also, the window doesn't shut fully - so street noise permeates in. In all - it was worth trying this hotel, but be aware that it is a little noisey (in my experience). Also, breakfast is only continental - so no good if you are looking for a traditional English fry up. If you want that, just pop along to the Hand and Flower opposite Olympia.

title: Shame - could have been better with very little effort
text: room 302 on the third floor was small, bright, airy and in the main clean. But the service from Receptionist to breakfast waitress cold and unfriendly. Loads and loads of tea/coffee but only 2 milk sachets. I asked for more but none came. Breakfast was adequate - just be prepared to ask rather than be offered! All in all, as long as you don't good service the hotel is good enough for a reasonably cheap overnight stay.

title: Compact
text: The room was clean but a bit on the small side for two people, but luckily just for one night. Shower was good and hairdryer powerful. Kettle lead not long enough to stretch to the socket. Continental breakfast was fresh and plentiful.

title: Atrocious customer service
text: Hotel made an error in booking dates for my business stay and then insisted this was non-refundable and non-transferrable. Initially they accepted that the error was theirs but then when trying to change the booking changed their mind about accepting any financial responsibility and rather than transferring the payment were insisting on full payment for the new booking (which if course is fine) and no refund for the erroneous booking!

title: Lovely stay
text: One of the cheapest places to stay in this area, just 1 minute walk from overground station, tasty breakfast, nice staff. I can recommend this hotel. The only thing one could find disturbing is that you can hear the noises from the whole building in your room.

title: Good quality hotel in a west London location
text: I was in a business trip to London and the occupancy rates were high so I looked a little further west towards Olympia for the Russell Court. It is a mid terrace London hotel which has been relatively recently refurbished. The room I was shown to was on the ground floor and looked as if it had been converted from free space. If was long and narrow but nevertheless comprised a double bed, a well appointed shower room and it had enough space. The bed is comfortable and sheets crisp and white. A swan sculpture was created from the towels which was a first. I could not get the TV to work on arrival and was eventually assisted by the receptionist who clearly thought I was incompetent. Fiddling with the power lead solved the problem. Silly me. The staff were not the happiest looking but they were efficient and helpful and quickly organised a taxi for me. Breakfast was good enough without being memorable.

title: Perfect siting for Olympia
text: This is a very small hotel where I stayed for two nights. The rooms are very compact, but the shower is good and the whole place is extremely clean. The major advantage is that it is so close to Olympia, literally 2 minutes walk. On a cold, snowy February day, I was so grateful for that! Breakfast is functional but was a welcome addition, and perfectly acceptable. Maybe a few more smiles from staff would be a nice touch, but overall, it really suited the purpose of our visit.

title: Glad I lost my money
text: After looking for places to stay on late rooms for a weekend. I came across this hotel so thought I'd give it a go. I'm staying for a family event so called the hotel so check to see if we have to be back by a certain time or we will just get a key. Not great customer service but managed to be told we would get a key so could come back whenever. Perfect. I went to book the hotel and as the payment was going through somewhere along the line the date had changed. Literally have no idea what happened as I had been looking at places and 100% know I had the correct dates in. It had then defaulted back to the current date. Anyway called late rooms who couldn't of been more helpful and tried to call the hotel. The advisor from late rooms came back and said there wasn't anything the hotel would do as they had processed the payment.....myself and laterooms had a laugh at that as I noticed the error and called them straight away so the call between late rooms and the hotel would of been minutes after the booking. I got the feeling from the late rooms advisor the staff member at the hotel wasn't the most helpful. But she said for me maybe to give it a go and call them myself especially as I had called asking about whether there was a time we had to be back by literally 10mins before. So I did......worst mistake. The staff member I spoke to was rude and literally had no people skills at all. Now I fully understand that the error had nothing to do with them but to be then spoken so badly and not willing to help in the slightest I was just shocked by as I was very upset and frustrated about this. I was then told if I wanted a room for the correct date I would then be charged an extra 10% on the room rate for the correct date. As the date had defaulted back to the current date I explained the room would be empty as I wouldn't be there to which the advisor sounded like a robot and just kept saying 'I can't cancel the room I can't cancel the room!' I just thought as I'm a good person I would let them know that the room would be empty incase they wanted to get someone else in. Shouldn't of been so nice I suppose. So sorry i can't comment on anything to do with the hotel but I'm glad I lost that money and didn't have to stay there and would never consider staying there or ever recommend it to anyone. The staff clearly have had no training and no people skills. I didn't expect a lot as I appreciate the error wasn't there fault but not even explaining the reason and just being shouted at and told nothing could be done wasn't helpful. Especially given I had called them 10mins prior to the booking and said the date I would be arriving.

title: Great Location and price for London Olympia
text: The Single Room I had was decent size, Clean and modern facilities and the staff were very friendly and helpful. It is right next to the train station and the fact that it has air conditioning was perfect. Not the biggest room but more had adequate for one person, couple might find it a little tight but they do have bigger rooms if you have the option. Would use again no problem for visit to the Exhibition Hall.

title: Tiny tiny at a steep price
text: Positive: nice staff, lift,clean 24 hrs reception.nice bathroom.our room (205) was bright and overlooking the road. Negative: double bed was placed in tha corner of 8 sqm room. One the left side along the wall nowhere to step- on the right side there were exactly 12 cm to place a foot. Hard and short bed. Not a room to stay in though you could ( luckily we had others things to do)- lay in the bed with your feet on the outside and stare at a midget-tv fixed 2 m up on the wall. We had to have the window wide open to have two people sleeping with sufficient oxygen. The breakfast room was overcrowded and people who came late had to wait. We paid about 150 pounds for something which was worth half of that.

title: Pleasant
text: This hotel was such a pleasure to enter... Staff are warm and welcoming (especially after leaving Holland court hotel which is the next street) We were very impressed by the cleanliness and friendliness of staff Thank you for a wonderful experience Close to the Olympia (walking distance) If you are exhibiting etc Also very close to the buss and underground Thank you

title: Good for short weekend stay
text: The hotel is next to Olimpia train station, nice neighborhood, tube station West Kensigton is also 5 minutes walk. Staff is nice and friendly, breakfast is good. The rooms are very small and wifi is not very fast. I would recommend this hotel for 1-2 days stay in London.

title: Perfect for Olympia!
text: I've just had a couple of nights stay at this hotel whilst exhibiting at Olympia. As with any hotel there are pluses and minuses. The location is great for Olympia, only 5 minute walk and very close to Olympia overground. It's also just off Kensington high street where you can find some great places to eat. The hotel itself is small but I found everything functional and in some ways better than some of the bigger chains that I frequently stay in. The main points for me are that the hotel is clean, the bathroom was very well presented with plenty of complimentary toiletries but very small as was the bedroom but there is very little noise as the windows are good. There is tea and coffee making facilities in the room and no shortage of tea or coffee sachets. The room I stayed in however needs a re-paint as its looking shabby. The breakfast is continental but there is a very good selection of fruit, yoghurts, bread, croissants, cereal, eggs, cold meats, cheese and fruit juices so you won't leave hungry. I'd definitely use this hotel again.

title: Do not stay here
text: The rooms are not good enough. Stains on bedding.decoration poor and a place trying to be quality but just is not.I have stayed in cheaper hotels that were better quality. The TV only shows bbc 1 and 2. The rest just de- pixelate so no joy there either.

title: In, out, no room to shake it all about.
text: This hotel was booked for me by work. Usually we stay at the nearby Hilton, however budget cuts meant a more 'affordable' option for us while we attended an Expo nearby. So having looked online at the reviews and felt some trepidation at my upcoming stay, I prepared myself and went to check in. Reception is tiny. The Receptionist sits inside a small cupboard within reception and deals with your check in quickly and efficiently. Wifi info and other details such as breakfast etc is given on a printed sheet of paper, and your room key is just plain white with the number written on it in felt tip marker pen. I believe the phrase is 'no-frills'? I was just grateful that the girl in front got given the ground floor room which was the front room of this converted old house, a sidestep away from the reception area. Her door to her room was just inside the main door but before reception, so I don't know how safe I would have felt staying in there? I would probably decline that room if you're travelling alone and security is an issue? I was given Room 303 and accessed it via a very small yet modern elevator. The door was open when I arrived which unnerved me slightly. The room itself was very small and had an even smaller ensuite bathroom. Initially I found only one power socket near the teeny slither of a desk where the kettle was. Luckily for me I travel with an extension cable, as the kettle cord wasn't long enough to reach the power socket without suspending the kettle upside down, as it was situated half way up the wall (see photo). Regarding the tea and coffee facilities, they were basic like the room. I didn't even get any spoons the first night and had to use a pen to stir my tea The room itself was far too hot and the heating couldn't be adjusted using the aircon system for some reason so I had to have the teeny window open at all times to cool off. The bathroom was modern yet tiny and there was no shelf to store anything so it had to go under the sink. The sink was one of those space saver mini ones. It wasn't big enough to get the kettle in to fill it so I had to use the mug to pour water from the tap into the kettle. Also, being such a small sink, there was no way of switching on the tap without soaking yourself from the spray. This meant you and the floor (and all your stuff you had to put on the floor because of no shelf unit) was soaked every time you washed your hands. However the shower itself was nice. Decent water pressure. The walls are paper thin in this hotel. On the first night the guy in the room to my right had a terrible cold and I heard him blowing his nose a lot. The girl in the room to the left of me had a very long mobile phone conversation that I would have been able to tell you in detail about had I spoken her language. She then took ages trying to plug something in, as it was scratch scratch scratch against my wall. At one point I was going to knock and offer to help her. Thank GOODNESS a couple in love weren't in the next room!!!!! The wardrobe was super small but there was a long mirror on the wall. The TV was tiny and wall mounted. I found another power socket near the bed. Talking of the bed, each day I was greeted by towel animals (swans in a heart in this case). A vain attempt to give a little romance to this room, although I definitely wouldn't be in the mood for romance if I was with someone in this hotel! Breakfast was basic in a small basement room, a little like a canteen. I would suggest you go to Costa which is attached to The Hilton around the corner. This is a basic yet clean hotel. Good for business or leisure travellers who don't usually stay anywhere higher than a 2 star hotel and don't care what it's like as long as there's a bed. It does the job, if the job is having somewhere to sleep before you move on. Clean, small, functional. If you don't expect much, you'll be fine.

title: Would stay here again!
text: Room was small but had everything we needed, double bed, tv, en-suite, and free wi-fi. The fridge and safe were unexpected bonuses, as were the slippers, although we didn't use them they were a nice additional touch. The En-suite was lovely, bright and spotless with beautifully clean white towels, mini toiletries, heated towel rail and hair-dryer. The bed was a little on the firm side but it did have crisp white linen and duvet cover. The dining room was much nicer in reality than on the photo, and the breakfast (continental) was fine...we just had toast with butter/jam. Again this area of the hotel was very clean. Reception was 24 hour and there as a small lift for those unable to manage the stairs. We stayed here for 2 nights to attend an event at the Olympia and so the hotel was close to the rail station and the venue!.

title: Small but excellent value, and great service.
text: A very warm welcome from the man on reception, and a hand with my bags too. Small room, but clean and modern with some thoughtful touches. Loads of tea and coffee, and a fridge full of milk - better than the usual pathetic rations you usually get in hotels. All in all, a nice stay in a reasonably priced, clean, friendly hotel.

title: JUST THE BASICS
text: First of all, have to say the facility is clean. My room was very clean and that was important. In fact, my room on the ground floor was enormous with about 12 foot ceilings! There was a large cold draft coming from the windows by the bed, however that made it uncomfortable. No pictures or decorations to speak of, its rather spartan. Couldn't use the phone in the room, was told thats not allowed and having no cell service, made it a bit difficult. The staff is a little indifferent but I think thats a cultural thing. I think its really overpriced for what you get but its incredibly convenient for anyone going to a conference at the Olympia Center. Its literally 2 short blocks walk. Shower and bath looked new plus there was a towel warmer.

title: Cute, clean and cosy!
text: Stayed here with my partner to be near family. This place is in a lovely location and has a real London feel. Room was small as is everything in London but very comfortable (clean, great bed, quiet and AC) we stayed on the 37degree day! Breakfast is fresh and staff are nice.

title: Very good semi-budget hotel
text: We stayed at the Russell Court for London Film & Comic Convention and having used a lot of local hotels for similar events, had our reservations about quality. However, we were very pleasantly surprised! Reception was manned by friendly and helpful staff who helped manage our extremely heavy and bulky cases up the outside stairs without being asked, and check-in was simple and quick. There is a small lift, only really big enough for one plus case, but welcome indeed! As for the room (number 203 in our case) I really can't fault it. Plenty of space, clean, tidy with a bijou but well maintained bathroom with a great shower and toiletries provided. Facilities included tea and coffee making facilities, hairdryer, plasma TV, safe, mini-fridge, with ironing board/iron available from reception There were 3 plugs dotted around the room (one oddly halfway up the wall!) and free WiFi which was excellent. Great air conditioning, which was welcome given we stayed on a very hot summer weekend. Have docked one star for the bed which, while not uncomfortable, was quite firm. We slept well with very little noise as we were located at the back of the hotel. Breakfast is continental, with meats, boiled eggs, cheeses, toast and croissants - the staff will gladly make tea and coffee to order and were pleasant and friendly. Checkout was quick, and best of all, given the amount of costumes and luggage we had, they kindly offered to store our cases until the convention closed at six, for no extra charge. In short, a good hotel that comes highly recommended for access to Olympia and rail links.

title: Not that good location
text: We have stayed there for 3 days. It is a good and silent area. Breakfast was good. Hotel is renewed but the rooms are so small, staff is not that welcoming and hotel is far from the underground. Eventhough kensington olympia station is close to the hotel because of there is only direct train at the weekends, on weekdays you should change 3 trains to get london and they are not frequent.

title: Good Value near the Olympia
text: Booked this with short lead time...given that there was an event in the Olympia and I needed to be nearby. All other Hotels in the area were booked out...so getting a reservation in a small hotel so close to the Olympia...made me sceptical. I needn't have worried...Check in was painless and straight forward, my room was a decent size but it was clean, bed was comfortable, air con worked well and all in its a pleasant place. If your on business or attending an event in the Olympia...this is a great option, particularly if your your travelling alone. The nearby Hotels that weren't full were charging almost twice the price. A colleague was staying in the Hilton nearby and showed me a picture of the room...what I got for half the price in the Russell Court was far superior. Breakfast was OK...very basic continental breakfast but staff were friendly and the coffee was nice so I got what I needed and was on my way. I would easily recommend to travellers to the area...its not a romantic getaway style place, but perfect for a business traveller that wants good WiFi, good location, good value and a clean, comfortable room.

title: Great budget hotel
text: Excellent room at the back of reception. Quiet location, large room, comfortable double bed, plenty of tea and coffee supplied and super continental breakfast. Good WiFi connection. Friendly staff. Only downside is that there isn't a secure location for baggage storage for leaving your suitcase on the day you are leaving.

title: Suitable for Olympia Events, Extra Small Room
text: I've stayed in Russell Court hotel in order to attend an event in Olympia Grand. the hotel is around 5 minutes walk from Olympia, the Rooms are clean and breakfast is basic but ok. I have stayed in single room, the room was really small, however, it serves the purpose of the stay.the room has an air conditioner and it works fine. and the receptionists were very helpful whenever I requested any help. Some useful tips: 1. the "Over ground" is two minutes walking from the hotel, if you are going to an event as in my case, and looking for a nice place for shopping and dining. you can use the over ground for one station, and go to Westfield shopping center which is very nice mall with most of famous brands, and nice dining restaurants. 2. you can move to different places in London starting with Kingston bus station on the main street. 3. You can top up your oyster card either from the overground station or from the gift shop of Hilton hotel just around the corner.

title: Great Place to stay
text: This hotel is in Central London and it is very closely located to the Underground, Overground and the buses. We stayed in a double bed. It was enough for us and our baby. A bit small though but it was comfy and cozy. Our room was cleaned everyday, despite the fact that staying with baby creates more mess in a small room. The had very courteous staff. Their wait staff for the breakfast time was very polite. The receptionists were also very nice. Specially Julia, who was the best of all. She was very courteous, helpful and polite.

title: Good for events in Olympia
text: Very nice location in Kensington, quiet and safe. Olympia exhibition center is 3 min walk, right across the railroad. Keep in mind that there is a footbridge nearby. Room was clean, staff - polite. Breakfasts were frugal, but their presence is a plus.

title: excellent for that money
text: Considering the rates in London, this was a best deal for my 3-day trip to London! the breakfast was included in the room rate, the room was very clean and I enjoyed my stay. the rooms are very small but if you need a larger room, pay more somewhere else :). it was comfortable enough for 2 people and had good quality linen and the towels were soft and smooth..looks like it has been recently renovated. they have expensive faucets and the bathroom was well maintained. the only thing I would suggest them is to put more hangers for the towels in the bathroom and more hangers in the closet. it does not cost much but it would be more comfortable. it is close to the bus station that takes you to the center, maybe 10 minutes drive...it is close to walk to the kennsington park...

title: Very disappointing breakfast fayre. Thin quilt.
text: Our room was clean and presentable but the bedding consisted of a thin fibre filled quilt and there were no extra blankets in the wardrobe. Consequently, we were not very warm in bed and had no control over the room's heating. Our ground floor room was right next to the little reception area - separated only by a thin plasterboard wall so there was some unwelcome noise. There were only two pillows on the bed. Breakfast was basic. For £103 a night I would have expected fried or scrambled eggs, bacon, sausages etc but all we got was cold meat, processed cheese slices and boiled eggs that were already cold. The croissants had not been warmed up and the apples on the counter were not fresh - their skins rippling like an old person's hands. To get a second cup of coffee I had to make a special request of the two foreign ladies "working" behind the counter. The hotel's description of a "buffet style" breakfast should be clarified. The word "cheapskate" should come in handy. Russell Road is quite affluent and pretty quiet and that should make for a good night's sleep but because of the thin quilt, I only managed about four hours and then had to get up to go for a Sunday morning walk. As I say, the hotel was clean and some money had clearly been spent on refurbishment and maintenance but for the reasons cited above I would be reluctant to stay here again.

title: Well it was...different.
text: Stayed in October for a conference at Olympia, it really is very handy location wise. A station is a 2 minute walk away for getting into the city centre etc. After reading reviews we requested we be given a decently sized room as I suffer from claustrophobia. No complaints on room size at all. Nice big bed, comfy, too. Clean and well decorated. Breakfast decent. VERY efficient housekeeping, so efficient in fact that every day they insisted on putting our clothes back into our suitcases, including the ones that needed washing...a little odd, but hey, the room was spotless. Now the negatives. There were only 2 pillows, both rock hard. On asking the receptionist for 2 more we were informed there were none spare as the hotel was full! The lift was a death trap and we only braved it once in spite of the five flights of stairs every time we went back to or left the room, not that it mattered as it broke down the first night and wasn't repaired until when we left 4 days later. The bathroom was TINY. The sink splashed water everywhere if you put the tap at more than a dribble. The shower was interesting to get into, one almost had to open the bathroom door itself in order to manage it. As people have said, it opens against the sink and you have to be pretty slim to get in the cubicle. BRILLIANT air-con, BTW, cooled the room down in about a minute. The fridge was a bit strange, given that it was actually hot inside and not, as by tradition most fridges are, cold inside. Sleeping was difficult a lot of the time, we could hear the people in the next room having extremely noisy sex in the shower. Most mornings the builders in the house next door starting drilling into the wall at 7.30am so even when we got to sleep we never got to have a lie-in. It's tricky giving a rating, really. Bed was good, room nice, location great, housekeeping insanely efficient (on leaving we were told we had to take the lift rather than go down the stairs as the extremely zealous Polish cleaning lady got most irritated at the idea of having to stop hoovering the top stair for a second) I'd give it a two and a half, but I can't do halves so...yes...it was definitely different!

title: convenient for kensington and chelsea
text: In the heart of kensington and chelsea and close to olympia

title: The best in town for the price
text: Dont expect the best and you will be fine here, its clean, friendly and most importantly quite!! Some rooms are small and some are spacious with good facilities and condiments! We always stay here when working in london and have never been dissapointed if only all budget hotels were this good!

title: Great location and good value for money.
text: The location to Olympia event Centre a major attraction for me. It's proximity to train station a distinction. Located in a serene neighborhood with easy access to shops and restaurants. The wardrobe size not attractive at all. Excellent staff. The breakfast menu was always the same each morning. All said I enjoyed the neatness of the room.

title: Great location for Olympia
text: If you're going to an event at Olympia and you don't want to spend lots of money on what is at the end of the day somewhere to sleep and shower then this is ideal. I booked a double room which was plenty big enough, it was clean the bed was comfortable and the shower was good - what more do you need? Staff that I came into contact with were friendly and courteous. Breakfast is basic (nice coffee) but as it was included, I've got no complaints.

title: Good value for money
text: The room was nice and tidy, location is excellent and the neighbourhood is very quiet and fancy. There are many good pubs nearby and it is well connected to the center of London. Since the room and the closet is small, maybe it is not suitable for longer stays but for me it was great (5 nights).

title: What a sweet little hotel!
text: I loved staying at this hotel and Kenssington for several reasons: 1.) The concierge and the other people who work there were very kind and friendly and helpful. 2) my room was impeccably clean spacious tidy and they wrote the towels in the shapes of swans. 3)The hotel is walking distance to the train station and to the Olympia venue. After having stayed at many places in this area that was so nice I truly appreciated this one. I highly recommend this hotel for couples, business people, and families

title: Modern and well located
text: The room was compact but clean and modern with everything you need for an overnight stay ie hairdryer complimentry toiletries, kettle tea coffee and small fridge. We had the room next to reception which proved to be rather noisy, the breakfast was adequate continental style again nice clean modern dining room. The staff were polite but not very friendly, which was fine for a one night stay but might have been a bit off putting if staying longer. Location was very good.

title: On the small side but overall pleasant experience
text: Someone called this a budget hotel, I suppose for London maybe it is, but at $120 per night I consider it full price. The location is good, just off High Street in Kensington, close to bus stop, about 15 minute walk to High Street Kensington tube station. Plenty of shopping close by. The room was nice, somewhat small, bed was comfortable but no bedside table, no clothes storage except for closet to hang items. This is somewhat due to the space available. Bathroom and shower are nice, wash basin is small. On the plus side, everything is clean and refreshed daily. The breakfast that is included is good, with plenty of options. The young ladies keep it well supplied and make coffee to order. The front desk staff was nice and helpful. The Wi-Fi in the room worked well.

title: Nice clean modern
text: Stayed for 1 night in a triple room it was very clean and spacious although beds are a bit hard .breakfast was nice continental ,it's in a great location for Olympia but too far out for main London shopping.staff were friendly and helpful.

title: Very decent
text: Stayed here whilst attending a conference. Small, but very decent and clean rooms. Quiet at night, and close to Olympia station. The stairwell is, as other reviews indicate, a number of short flights of stairs, which might be inconvenient if you are carrying a lot of luggage. The breakfast room is in the basement, and offers a decent selection, if not quite the most attractive location. I do have to recommend the cleanliness - the hotel was spotless throughout. The rooms at night might be a bit on the warm side, but that might just be personal preference.

title: Close to Olympia & that's it!
text: Stayed for a trade show & this 'hotel' is the other side of the railway line at Olympia station, very close. Not cheap at £83 a night. My room was on the top floor (2nd floor) but layout of staircase meant 8 small flights, no fun with a heavy suitcase as my 3 day stay the lift was out of order, not impressed! Double bed filled the room, I've never seen such a small bathroom. You couldn't spend an evening in the bedroom that small, nowhere to sit. Continental breakfast in basement, now 9 flights down & back up again! Small breakfast room but adequate offering to start the day, cereal, boiled eggs, yoghurt, ham, cheese, toast, coffee. I will say however everywhere throughout is very clean. It is convenient for the station & Olympia exhibition centre.

title: recommend any time, lovely hotel friendly, helpful staff
text: we loved this hotel, the room was a double and excellent for what we needed, the staff were very friendly and helpful at all times, will def be back to this hotel on our next visit, easy commute to everywhere, breakfast was lovely, would highly recomend. many thanks russell court hotel

title: Way better than I expected
text: I have been travelling to London on business for the last 5 years, and I find it terribly expensive to get anything decent, plus I have a New Zealand dollar exchange rate that makes anything in the UK doubly expensive. Imagine my delight then at finding this place. My five star rating is based on its value for money. The hotel is in very good condition...new carpet in the halls, stairs and rooms, modern tiling and fittings in the bathroom, and a good continental breakfast. The rooms aren't big...in fact quite small but I've stayed in similar sized places in the same area that cost more and were in worse condition. Yes the bathroom is tiny and if I were obese I would find it difficult to use, but again it's larger and in better condition than many I've experienced at a higher price. I had a single room and yet two people could have used the bathroom at the same time. This looks like a family run business and I will be back here in a month, this time with my wife, who is more fussy than me about where we sleep. I will definitely be happy for both of us to stay here. Access is very good...Olympia overground station is across the road. If you're coming from Paddington take the Tube to West Brompton and then catch the overground to Olympia. There's a Costas just around the corner -30 seconds walk maybe. The Westfield shopping mall is 10 minutes walk north. Lots of good eating places there. This hotel is a lucky find for me.

title: Clean, but not a good nights rest
text: The hotel is ideally located for Olympia, we stayed for a conference for 2 nights. The hotel room is well presented, the rooms are quite small, but there's been a lot of work put into them. However, the bathroom has very poor ventilation so constantly smells stale. The rooms are very hot, and the windows only open a small amount. We turned the air con on, but as it had been left stagnent over the winter months and not actively serviced, we got quite ill from the units. The bed was also quite uncomfortable, and the pillows were really not good quality, it was like sleeping with a folded towel. It's a shame, there's good effort gone in, but the last 10% is the real important bits which have been missed.

title: Cost and Location is the only good things...
text: Just a warning, I slept almost nothing the 1 night I stayed here and that tainted my whole experience. I stayed here one night to do some business in London, I arrived at about 22:00 in the evening and left the next morning. So literally just a bed and breakfast. The room (and the hotel in general) was REALLY warm and there was just no way I could figure out that time of the night to get my room to cool down. There is a air con control, but clearly the system was shut down (it is autumn after all...), the window will only open with about a 1 cm gap. It was just one very long night spent in equatorial temperatures with none of the pleasant drinks or beaches. My Lip Ice melted !! The only memorable thing about breakfast was the fact that they managed to open a window in the breakfast area. Cold boiled egg, not that fresh croissant... The room was really small. I stayed in a single room and I've had bathrooms double the size in reasonable hotels, but I don't actually have a major problem with that, there is the cost benefit. I do have a problem with the fact they've crammed in so much in the minuscule room (I assume to tick the relevant list to get the stars) that I can't use the desk (for example). Didn't try the internet, so can't comment on that. The bathroom. Nice shower, good water pressure and no problem with warm water. No toilet roll holder (?!?!?!) toiler paper is found on the handle of the toiler brush..... Careful when you open the basin tap, water sprays all over your front. I get the impression that none of the managers or owners have ever stayed in one of these rooms.

title: Good location, poor service
text: For the shows in the Olympia Center this is a perfect location. Unfortunately the service is very poor! I forgot my electric toothbrush, e-mailled them, they have found it, but refuse to send it to me, even on my own costs! Besides that the wifi connectiion is very slow and with a lot of hick ups.

title: Great stay
text: Like many of the other reviews state, rooms at the Russell Court are indeed small, however they are stocked with everything you could possibly need and the room is incredibly clean. The bed was a double and was very, very comfortable, there was a safe, a mini fridge, a kettle for tea or coffee in the morning and a large flat screen TV. The continental breakfast is really good and the staff was on hand to refill anything that was running low. Staff at the front desk were very helpful upon check in. The only minor irritant was we asked them to call us a cab when we checked out and when the cab arrived it was un-metered and the driver only took cash. That said, the location could not have been more convenient. It's only about two blocks to the Kensington/Olympia Tube station and just a block off of Kensington/Hammersmith road, which is lined with many restaurants, banks, cafes, etc. Well valued hotel.

title: Okay for a short stay
text: I stayed here due to its close proximity to London Olympia (less than 5 minute walk). The hotel is small, but is clean and tidy. I was on the third floor, so was happy to see the hotel had a lift to save me lugging my case up all the steps! I had a single room, and though it had everything I needed, including tea/coffee making facilities, it was extremely cramped and the room was incredible hot. The walls between the rooms are extremely thin as I could hear conversations between other guests. The breakfast was fine, and items were continuously replenished. It's a good hotel for the price, but I would look elsewhere next time.

title: Okay for a night
text: Stayed here due to close proximity to London Olympia & found the location extremely convenient for the conference centre (2 minute walk). Hotel itself is okay, clean rooms, good shower & nice touch to have shower gels etc provided, tea/coffee making facilities also very useful. Downside is that the walls between the rooms must be extremely thin as I could clearly hear conversations between guests staying in a room upstairs & I was very aware of the person in the room next door. I also found the room & hotel itself to be extremely hot. Continental breakfast is good though & staff in breakfast room were very polite. All in all this isn't a bad hotel given the costs elsewhere in London & it served its purpose for a night.

title: OK for an overnight stay without paying a fortune.
text: Stayed here just for one night before the Royal Park half marathon. Quite a convenient location for the west end of London. The room was small although clean and tidy. The decoration could have been better, looked like a lot of jobs were half finished, especially the wi-fi boxes hanging off the walls. The rooms were well heated and there was plenty of hot water, this is a budget hotel but if you are looking to rest your head in central London without paying a fortune then I would recommend it. Breakfast was included in the price

title: Still great value for money
text: This has been my fourth stay here in three years. Since last time the hotel has had a cosmetic lift, with new carpet, fittings in the bathrooms, and a tasteful paint job. All this is a nice touch but really, it was a good place to stay even before that. Yes, the rooms are tiny, but there are many providers in central London offering the same thing but with reduced service and so reduced value for money. I like this place. The breakfast staff are attentive and while the food is the same each time, it is consistently good. The lift always works and is helpful when moving heavy bags up or down stairs. The rooms and bathrooms are always clean and there is always someone manning the reception desk. The rooms are well heated, or in warmer weather can be ventilated. The location is very convenient for me. It's off the Main Street so there's reduced traffic noise, Olympia centre and the overground stop is in the next block, Shepherds Bush, Hyde Park, and Hammersmith are all about 15 minutes easy walk away. Get over the smaller room size and you will have an enjoyable stay

title: PLEASANT STAY
text: A very pleasant stay. Staff was friendly and helpful. Room cleans and tidy although a little on the small side. I would most certainly stay there again and also recommend it to others. The hotel was in a ideal location for my visit to Earls Court and my inward and onward travel to and from London. It is easily accessible to the West End and the City.

title: Good Value London Hotel
text: Stayed here for one night in late September 2014. Booked a single room which actually had a double bed. The room was fine for one person and was very clean and well presented. Furnishings and bedding were to a high standard and everything worked perfectly in the modern bathroom, which was a bit cramped but well thought out to maximise space. There was a safe and fridge and adequate storage space in the bathroom. Tea & coffee facilities were provided, and there was a phone in the room. A simple breakfast is provided including cereals, meats, cheeses, toast, breads & pastries and good coffee is freshly made to order by the efficient and attentive young lady who keeps the breakfast room to a high standard and organises more toast or coffee top ups etc. Location wise the hotel is close to Olympia and is served by a number of buses that will take you to central London via Kensington. Kensington High Street is just a short stroll away and there are numerous restaurants nearby. All in all I was very satisfied with this hotel which offers rooms at realistic prices and I will return when I next need to visit London.

title: Good Clean Hotel
text: I booked a room for one night for one person. The hotel room was a little on the small side although there was a double bed in the room (not easily accessible for two people and very low to the ground which would not be suitable for anyone with back issues!) plus the bathroom was 'cosy' but it was generally clean and suitable as a room for sleeping in. The continental breakfast was good.

title: will visit again, highly recommend !
text: stayed for a weekend. quiet area with good transport links. friendly staff, the young man at reception was extremely welcoming and went out of his way to help us on several ocassions . 10 out of 10 will visit again!

title: London visit
text: Great hotel, clean comfortable we had triple basement room plenty of space, shower perfect.Shame public loo right next to door (who is it for?) Two ladies at breakfast attentive and polite, thank you. Nearest tube High St Kensignton as went in week but only 15 min walk. Already looked at other Magic accommodation for next time in London. Oh yea the beds were perfect too.

title: London Trip
text: Nice & tidy very clean within walking distance to some great restaurants & just around the corner to the tube. For breakfast we went to the little cafe between the tube station & the hotel is was great full english £6

title: great !!!
text: very clean very comfortable....loved it !!!! the receptionist was so sweet and helpful !!! location was great !! the place was clean comfortable and just great.. it was very safe !!!!.i just had an issue opening the window hahaha..

title: Easy access to all attractions
text: This hotel has beautiful decor, incredible marble staircases , spacious rooms and polite professional staff. I found the location so perfect to access all the sights, museums, and theatre. The tube station is right next to the hotel on the direct line for national history and science museums, also for Harrods. The bus stop is just outside the hotel, Kings Cross main line station, Oxford Street, Regent Street, are a pleasant walk away. We ate in the bar it was lovely and a reasonable price, however there are several cafes and restaurants within walking distance.Overall we got great value for our money and we will stay there again.

title: Nice Hotel. Great Location
text: Russell Court is perfectly located for Olympia and the London Overground. Nice small hotel with very nice staff. I was in room 104 which was well appointed and plenty big enough. Clean, tidy with a good effective shower. The fridge in the wardrobe was a nice touch. Free WiFi was great and connected first time every time. Continental breakfast was included in a clean bright dining room with pleasant attentive staff. Good selection for breakfast but a better standard of ham and cheese instead of the plastic stuff served would have greatly improved it. My stay was for four nights and when in a hotel for that long it is nice to unpack and put clothes etc away to get rid of creases and make them easy to select. By this I mean, put them in drawers. The wardrobe was ok for jackets etc but there was nowhere to put anything else and I had to live out of my suitcase for four nights. Hate that. There was plenty of space in the room for a set of drawers which would have made a great difference. The Russell Court is not alone in lacking storage space and this is one of my pet hates. So, my niggles were pretty minor and I would certainly stay there again.

title: good location for olympia
text: nice and tidy had twin room quite spacouse and i was pleasenty surprised at night hardley and traffic noise even the lightest sleepers would have no ploblems here!!!!!!!!!!! My room had rearly soft beds.Bathroom yes small but ok except lots of tile are cracked must have had problems.I didi not stop for breakfast as it started at 7.30am why do places not start early

title: Clean and friendly hotel
text: This hotel was very convenient to both Earl's Court and just a 5 minute walk to Olympia. Hotel room and en suite was very clean but a little small for a double and single bed, breakfast was continental and staff were very pleasant. Would stay there again.

title: Excellent
text: Great atmosphere in hotel lobby. The hotel has a beautiful view of the park across the road. Spotless clean room. The bathrooms are class with a hanging power shower from the ceiling. Staff very Friendly.superb location. 30 seconds from tube. Def staying again. A bit pricey is the only fault.

title: great value for money
text: Picked this hotel due to location near olympia, pleasantly surprised with the cleanliness and how updated the hotel was overall. Room and bathroom a bit small but fine for a night or 2. bathroom was fab! team were also very pleasant. great location and great value for money for a london location, will be back here if ever in the area again!

title: Short Stay
text: We stayed here because of its proximity to Olympia as we were here to see our daughter perform, we stayed for just one night. The room and hotel was lovely and clean, one of the receptionists rather miserable but the other one very nice. The double room was uncomfortably small and unbearably hot, we turned all the radiators off as soon as we arrived. The shower was excellent for the room but again the bathroom small. We knew the breakfast was continental but we were very disappointed with it. The milk for the cereals warm and the toast & croissants cold. The location for Olympia was excellent. Although saying all this I did have an excellent nights sleep!

title: Short Stay
text: I stayed here due to its location to Olympia as I was visiting for a 2 day exhibition. Hotel was very clean, with helpful staff. I had a single room which was very nice but a bit small and found it too hot, so turned off the heating. Shower room was very nice but a bit of a squeeze to get out of the shower as the door only opened as far as the sink allowed. Breakfast was continental but good choice and served by friendly staff. I would recommend the hotel and would stay again if visiting that area of London

title: stayed 1 night to visit Christmas fayre at Olympia
text: We stayed in the basement triple room and cannot fault it. I must say reading the reviews I was a little apprehensive. Yes there was building work taking place in the reception area but this did not distrupt our stay at all. We were all extremely pleased with the size, standard, cleanliness and comfort of the room. It did not feel crowded at all and there were three adults in the room and the bathroom was spotlessly clean large and big enough to allow getting ready together to go without arguing, something which has taken place in other hotels in the past as they are usually not big enough to swing a cat around in. There was everything you could need in the room. Full tea/coffee facilities, fridge, safe table and chairs, wardrobe etc. Beds extremely comfy. The breakfast room is lovely and clean and a typical continental breakfast, nicely presented, freshly cooked and plentiful. Full marks. The staff were very nice, and approachable and provided iron/board when requested no problem. We were able to leave luggage while we went out on the last day no problem. It is fantastic proximity to Olympia, only a few minutes walk away. My only critisism has nothing to do with the hotel at all, but with the tube at Olympia. We booked this hotel for it's close proximity to Olympia and the tube. However we did not realise that the tube to Olympia is run on a restricted timetable. 15-23 minute in between tubes. Not a big deal if you are not restricted by time but as we were not aware of this and were running to a schedule we ended up walking from Earls court. With cases, this seemed a very long way. Getting into the city centre at night and back again was a problem around theatre times. We got a taxi back from Earls Court for eight pounds. A taxi from the hotel to Euston train station late on the Thursday night cost twenty pounds. So if you are not in a rush just allow your self an extra 3/4 hour to comfortably get to/from centre from Olympia, by tube. So apart from the difficulty with the tube I am pleased to say we would all highly recommend this hotel.

title: Superb stay and location
text: Morgan Hotel is very bijoux. Clean, modern decor, great breakfast with well organised and very accomodating staff. Price good too! Went down for two days on a course off Drury Lane. Loved being so close (walking distance) to Covent Garden, Oxford St, Leicester Square etc. Would recommend this hotel very highly. The only drawback was a tiny shower - but this is central London!!

title: Friendly Family- Run
text: We stayed at the Morgan for a week in March 2006. We loved it.The location is excellent. British Museum ,pubs, restaurants, shopping etc. Bloomsbury is a safe area with easy access to transport and cabs. Warning for old fossils like us -- no elevator. I have bad knees so David put us on the ground floor(room 201). That was confirmed by email in advance and they came through with flying colors. If you really have a problem pick a hotel with a lift. I was able to navigate the 11 steps down to the breakfast room every morning no problem. Running up to the fourth floor would have been impossible for me. The breakfast was outstanding and all this talk about the cholesterol is bunk. There was yogurt, fresh fruit, toast , juices, dry cereals and David even offers Porridge (oatmeal). Yes there was the "full English" egg/bangers/ bacon heart attack platter too (it was a treat- once). Our room was spotlessly clean and the breakfast room and food was too. The family runs the place (brothers David and John alternate months managing) and John's son helps out with everything. A very nice family atmosphere. Is it the Savoy? Nope! But if you want a nice clean family run place in a great location - This is it! We will stay here again. David kind of summed it up ."We try hard". They do, and it makes for a very pleasant stay. Rating : Excellent!

title: Great Location. Excellent Value.
text: We scoured the internet to find a reasonably priced hotel in London for a 2 night break. The Morgan seemed almost too good to be true, but we were pleasantly surprised to find it was exactly as described. Clean and comfortable, nice breakfast, superb location, pleasant and friendly staff, and a great price. We could find no fault, and cannot think of anything to improve this great little hotel. We will definitely stay here again.

title: a great little hotel
text: The Morgan Hotel (24 Bloomsbury) is a gem. It's a small hotel located around the corner from the British Museum. It is convenient to the tube (Tottenham Court Road), to an AMEX office, a large cyber cafe, a market, a newsagent, Oxford Street shopping, various eating establishments, and within walking distance to the West End. The hotel's rooms are small, but each room has ensuite facilities and is very clean. Every morning you get a "sturdy" breakfast to help you get a great start to your day. I recommend this hotel highly. I've stayed here in 1995, 1997, 2000 and will stay again this fall. As a single female traveler, I feel safe here. One important thing about the hotel: I prefer staying in the main hotel, not in the annex.

title: fine - nothing special
text: Decent enough 3 star hotel. It's more a guesthouse, to be honest - a hotel squeezed into a large terraced house. There's no lobby or bar. Perfect Location for central London though. 2 small-ish gripes stopped me from giving this more stars - I was in a room near the front door and therefore was wakened at 0530 by people heading out to the airport. Traffic noise was NOT a problem. Secondly the coffee in the morning was foul. At least there's plenty of coffee shops nearby. I'll be returning to the same area in a while, but I think I'll give the Jury's hotel down the road a try - similar price for a proper hotel.

title: Good hotel
text: Nice hotel, could do with updating, a very pleasant stay though and perfectly adequate for ourselves, breakfast was good, staff very friendly. Close proximity to everywhere possible as we walked from Euston station to it and all around London for the few days we were there.

title: Good place to stay
text: Stayed at the Morgan from May 11 through the 19 for nine nights. Was in Room 243 in the annex - on the 2nd floor (3rd in North America) - no lift, but still young enough to lug the suitcase up the stairs. The apartment was huge, really. Had a bedroom, living room, tiny kitchen, washroom with toilet and sink and another bathroom with tub, shower, and sink. Water pressure in the shower was pretty weak, but ok for a guy with hardly any hair. Women washing long hair would have some trouble. Not sure if this is because of being on that floor or if it is common throughout. Bed was ok (two singles attached together), had a bit of a dip in the middle. The unit was clean, had some old charm to it, had enough storage space (including a large safe). John was very friendly and helpful, though I missed the breakfast everyday (7-9) - too early for me on vacation :) Agree with a previous poster - the rooms need a do not disturb sign. Not sure if the common computer in the main part of the hotel is linked to a printer or not. I would stay again, though I like to stay in different parts of town on further visits.

title: met expectations
text: Very pleased with my stay at this small hotel. Only criticism was smallish breakfast compared to other places I stayed but it was adequate and good quality. Excellent location, friendly service especially the lady in the kitchen. Good size room and bathroom for this type of accommodation.

title: Excellent Location
text: We found this hotel by looking up the location, there was no availability on their website or on any hotel discount websites but when I phoned them they gave us a room. We paid on arrival and changed our room from a triple to a double the day before our trip without any charges. The hotel is located at the end of Oxford Street and less than 5 mins walk from Tottenham Court tube station which is on the Central line. We partied and shopped all weekend and didn't need a taxi once the hotel is so central. Soho is less than 10 mins walk away and Camden town is a quick tube ride. Our room was on the ground floor so there was a bit of noise with people ringing the doorbell to get in but other than that it was perfect - clean with plenty of storage space. We didn't get up on time for breakfast on any of the mornings so can not comment on the food! The staff were friendly and helpful but due to the great location we didn't really need their help with directions etc. The location felt safe and secure and seemed to be in a nice area of London.

title: Great Again!
text: We visited London in August and stayed again at the Morgan. Just can say once again super value for a super location and great service - we'll be back! Chris & Erich

title: Lovely hotel , you can almost roll out of bed and in to the British Museum
text: I have stayed here twice and met many people in the dining room who have been there upwards of 20 times. Small, fabulous location , close to great book stores , London Review ofBooks,Persephones, and so many more , ideal for West End theatre ,a fabulous stamp and paper shop, lovely afternoon tea spots, UCL visits , numerous buses stop at the door, walk to great shopping, Piccadilly Square, Covent Garden market and so much more .... friendly helpful staff , was family owned for many many years , actually hAve two buildings with apartments and smaller rooms , wonderful breakfast included and very reasonably priced given all that you get location and lodging wise

title: perfect location, fine accommodations
text: Bloomsbury's the best! In London for just a few days with two family members. Our three-bed "English basement" room in the annex was just fine for our needs. A plus was the newly refurbished bathroom: great shower, gleaming tiles. Not great to have to walk up the road to the breakfast room in the drizzle, but all in all the accommodations were fine. Breakfast average. Very friendly, humorous innkeepers. Two tube stops within a short walk

title: Pleasant surprise! Would definitely recommend!
text: Judging from the Morgan's simple website, I wasn't expecting very much, and I thought it would be more of a B&B type arrangement. We were pleasantly surprised by our experience in person: our spacious garden level room (with outdoor patio) was clean, and the newly remodeled bathroom (esp. the shower) was fantastic. The whole setup is more like an apartment than an inn or hotel. The service was friendly, attentive, and professional. Breakfast was very good. WiFi was free. The location was what attracted us, but it's just one aspect of the overall package that has made this my top choice for my next London visit. We later stayed at a so-so hotel (Kensington Gardens) for less money--oh how I wished we'd booked that night back at the Morgan instead...!
