title: Excellent Value/A Real Find
text: Our family booked 2 rooms at the Rushmore for 10 days over Christmas 2003. I used trip advisor to make my decision to rent. It was truly an excellent find for London lodging. Our rooms were spacious with roomy bathrooms (great water pressure and temperature) and coffee/tea in room. Mind you, this is not a fancy boutique hotel but it offers so many advantages I think you will be hard pressed to find better London accomodation for anywhere near the money. The staircase is narrow and there are no elevators. However we had one attic room (4th floor) and it was definitely worth the climb. We enjoyed a large room and bath with one double and two twin beds - all comfortable and no smoking! Our older sons had two twin beds and bath on the second floor. The staff is friendly and accomodating. We very much enjoyed our stay over Christmas. The basement breakfast room is lovely and although the breakfast bar selection is small, it is healthful and offers tea, coffee, toast, jam, muesli cereal, yogurt, fruit salad, cheese, crackers,sliced meat and during Christmas the traditional mince tarts. While modest, we found it far more preferable to the more common selection of pastries, eggs or sausages. The location was excellent as well. Only half a small block from Earl's Court tube stop and a happy selection of well priced restaurants on Earl's Court Road. The Rushmore is between both a Tesco and a Sainsbury (supermarkets) - both large, open late and in easy walking/bus distance. Communication with the hotel was efficient (Teresa) and reliable. We all felt the Rushmore was a 10 out of 10 Hotel and would love to return.

title: Rooms and Value
text: London is synnomnous with being expensive but Rushmore is rather the contrary. For one night we stayed in 2 rooms and the next night in a nice family room. Prices are good but you have to walk for 1 hour to Oxford Street.

title: Second visit in hotel
text: Positives - wifi in room , very good staff, very good location near underground . And hotel is located on a street where there are shops , restaurants,coffe shops, english pubs , Mc donald , KFC etc .... Negatives- very small room , Previously ( first visit in january 2016) , we have larger room , Breakfast is very very very simple ( cammembert cheese, cheese, dietary salami, boiled egg, toast , baguette which you had to slice piece of it , cookie , mussli,)

title: Cheap hotel, poor staff and clients
text: I had a multiple night stay with my girlfriend earlier in April at Rushmore hotel. Positive points : - 3 mn far from Earl's court tube stop - close to couple of restaurants, M&S food and Sainsbury - early booking can lead to 60/70 GBP for a double bedroom, so not expensive Negative points: - rooms are smaller than advertized on website, older as well - hotel is clearly understaffed which has obvious involvements such as dirty/dusty rooms and poor level of service - breakfast is more than disappointing : don't expect continental buffet here, only 8 tables, one toaster you have to fight for the access of, no french viennoiserie, lack of fresh food - no bacon, no scrambled eggs... - you are asked for a a full payment before stepping in so you can not see rooms first and can not cancel your stay after one night which IMO is a clear indicator of average dissatisfaction or earlier experiences... - no lift so if you have 50 kg of luggage or did not book rooms on 1st floor forget it - clostrophobic ? Stay away from bathroom as you won't be able to use shower or closets - hotel is crowded with low quality clients e.g. german students groups or young province british girls : more noise comes from other rooms than street or courtyard - luggage room is also a staff room and used for laundry storage, I was scared to let my stuff there...

title: Friendly, well located, comfortable stay
text: Visited Hotel Rushmore expecting just a basic hotel, but this is so much more. Greeted by a friendly face, who couldn't do enough for us. Early breakfast no problem, helpful advice, no problem! En-suite bathrooms were clean ...with plenty of room (be aware of a small step into the bathroom - as if you are tired this may surprise you). We would definitely use Hotel Rushmore again.

title: Clean, comfortable and convenient
text: I've just left the hotel after a one night stay. The hotel is very easy to find

title: Return Visit to the Rushmore
text: I returned to the Rushmore again after a 8 month break and really my view has not changed , its still one of the better hotels in Earls Court. Good value, I got an ensuite room with Continental Breakfast for les than £50, which in London in August was very good. Room Ok for one night , the shower seemed even smaller than the last room I stayed in, the best way to describe the shower size - As an average sized British male, its like getting into an upright coffin, perhaps some of the owners of the hotel who are not exactly small should try them!! The shower aside it great hotel for a few nights in London , staff are pleasant, the room is clean the Breakfast is good quality with good choice , so would stay again but need to go on a diet.

title: Very well situated!
text: Very close to Earls Court underground and close to many shops, pubs and restaurants. The rooms are small, but thats standard in London. The bed in room 22 was not to recommend (far to hard for lightweigthers). Breakfast was OK. I recommend this most for its location!

title: Weekend Break
text: Hotel is ideally situated in Earls Court for shops, bars, restaurants and tube station, room was very clean and serviced daily, staff were very friendly and helpful. Only negative is there is no cooked breakfast but the continental on offer was good.

title: A lifesaver
text: The Rushmore and it's outstanding staff were lifesavers on our recent trip London. Our group was stranded in the country without a hotel due to Eurostar failing to maintain service through bad weather. We stayed in a total of 4 rooms at The Rushmore (2 quads and 2 singles) and on the one night that they couldn't take us in, they helped us find another nearby hotel with availability. Their complimentary breakfast was good, the rooms were small but comfortable and interestingly decorated, and the location was very central. The hotel is very near the Earls Court Underground stop and you can get most places without a single transfer. My only complaints are that noise does travel a bit inside the hotel, some of the showers can be a bit small, and they could certainly benefit from an elevator (dragging our luggage to the top floor was miserable) but for a reasonably priced hotel, you definitely get your moneys worth. We will be staying there again.

title: Great place to stay
text: This hotel is located near the Earl's Court tube station, 2 minute walk. Lot of restaurants and pubs nearby. Hotel itself is on a quiet street. Service was really friendly, I stayed in a single room, which was really small, but that's no exception in London. So Clean, Good bed, and convenient to have tea and coffee making facilities in the room. Will I stay again? Absolutely yes, because of location and friendly staff.

title: Good base for a short city break
text: This hotel has no lift - fair enough, it is an old property - but neither was there any offer of help at check-in when it came to getting our bags up the stairs. My husband and I are mobile but getting on a bit in years so would have appreciated some assistance - in fact, a couple of other guests saw we were struggling and gave us a hand, which was very kind of them. Our room was small for a double and the en-suite fittings worn. The toilet could have done with some bleach. The bed was comfortable and the (included) breakfast OK. The proximity of Earls Court tube is a plus and the main reason we chose to stay at this hotel. The lady on reception our second day was helpful in organising an early morning wake-up call and cab to take us to the mainline station. I wish there was a 'good' rating on the overall Trip Advisor scale but the experience and the price we paid for it was more 'average to good' than 'good to very good', hence my overall assessment.

title: Weekend in London
text: Excellent location, just off earls court rd & 1 min from tube station so very accessible to all parts of central London Stayed in twin room which was very nice though bit tight on space. Room on 3rd floor, with no lift and steep stairs. Self-service breakfast (cereal, toast etc) was fine but only one type of fruit available. Free Wi-Fi also available Fire alarm went off around 6.30am one morning, but seemed to be ignored by everyone. Paid £187 for twin room for fri & sat night. Expensive for what you get but suppose the location is a big factor in this

title: A Trip to Remember
text: Rushmore Hotel, the London weather, the parks and London as such made this ''a trip to remember''. Excellent, wonderful, beautiful, out of the world, great, magnificent and any other nice adjective would be apt to describe it. What an enjoyable trip courtsey Hotel Rushmore. They are simply the best. One reviewed hotels online and then went and saw almost 20 odd hotels in the vicinity of 1 mile of Rushmore but Rushmore stood heads and shoulders above the rest, both in terms of tariff cost and quality of service. Tremendous. Location wise absolutely great. Right next to Earls Court Tube Station and a stone throw distance away from all your market requirements you can think of. Free Breakfast too too good. Rooms tip top. Wi Fi too good. You name it and its there. We stayed for good 18 days in Rushmore from 04 May to 21 May 2015. And today one can say with great satisfaction and happiness that they were the best 18 days of holidays we have ever spent. The owner, the reception staff, the serving staff and the room attendants were simply the best. Hospitality at its best. Feels like home. Would recommend Rushmore hands down. Just close your eyes and head for Rushmore. And take my word you will not be disappointed. Our gratitudes to Rushmore - Deepak Mehta

title: Great location, good value
text: The rooms may not be the biggest we've slept in but what does it matter if the location is perfect (close to Earl's Court station, a lot of good restaurants in the vicinity), the staff is frindly and the breakfast is great? Good value!

title: Handy good value friendly hotel.
text: The title says it all.... Very conveniently placed near the tube station and loads of places to eat and supermarkets, pubs etc. Room was very spacious, clean and comfortable. Breakfast included which was a bonus. Staff very friendly especially Theresa who was very helpful and enthusiastic.

title: friendly, clean and convenient!
text: My daughter and I stayed here for 2 nights in July 2015. 2 mins from Earls Court tube so convenient for most city attractions. The staff here are great and very helpful! For a budget hotel I can't fault it! Breakfast perfectly adequate, fresh fruit, cereals, cheeses, toast etc. Only downside is no lift. We had a large case (daughter exhibiting at art show) and had a twin room on 3rd floor however the receptionist summoned 2 chaps to carry it up for us! Would definitively stay here again!

title: AWESOME location!!!!
text: We had a wonderful stay at the Hotel Rushmore! I can't say enough about the wonderful staff...so friendly and helpful!! The location is absolutely perfect

title: Good price and exellent service
text: Stayed third time in this hotel 16-18Nov. Staff is very friendly and helpful, reasonable price. The room was just wonderful and beds so comfortable, that we slept like babys. The breakfast kept us going until afternoon! Location is only a few steps away from Earls Court metrostation. We can definitely recommend this hotel.

title: Great location, small room.
text: Stayed at the Rushmore for four days. I used the hotel as a base for sightseeing on my own so simply needed somewhere to sleep. The room was small but very clean and quite well maintained. The bathroom was no more than a closet and if you dropped the soap in the shower, it was difficult to pick it up ( I am only 164 cms so am not a large person). Breakfast was also basic. Cereals, toast, yoghurt, some cake. Juice and tea, coffee to drink. It is very close to the tube and has a great variety of restaurants within easy walking distance. Staff were friendly and helpful. Would stay there again if I was in the same circumstances.

title: Avoid - only good point is location
text: Take care if you are thinking of booking here. 4 floors, no lift, steep narrow stairs, with breakfast room another flight of stairs down. Very poor ventilation in room - small desk fan provided. Small room with bed against wall, old T.V. at bottom of bed, small writing desk against other wall. T.V. remote not working, light bulb blown. Not enough storage room. Shower in room was approx 2' x 2'6" - couldn't turn around in the shower. Reception had difficulty understanding English. Paid to have our laundry done while we were out for the day @ GBP8.95 which is dearer than the commercial laundry opposite the end of the street. Came back at 5.00pm and couldn't find our laundry - eventually tracked down drying on airing racks in the breakfast room, and we then had to put in dryer as it was still wet.. Front desk couldn't understand why we were upset. Totally unprofessional operation. Only good things about this hotel are its location on Picadilly line from Heathrow, and good continental breakfast

title: Very enjoyable
text: This weekend I went to the Rushmore Hotel in London. Not only was the exterior very pretty, the location was also ideal! 200 meters to the closest subway and still in zone 1, so our ticket of the tube was still valid! Rooms are small, but super clean and a nice and comfortable bed! Breakfast was very tastefull and a wide variaty of choices! Stongly recommended when visiting London!

title: Great location, cozy room
text: We stayed at this hotel only for one night, but it was a pleasant experience. The location is excellent, just steps away from a tube station. Nice, quiet neighborhood with all convenience. The room was small, but clean and comfortable. The staff was very friendly and accommodating with all our last minute request. Free WiFi was a good plus. The room we stayed had a tiny balcony which would have been great if it were summer. I'd definitely go back there for a longer stay.

title: Nice Hotel at Earl's Court Station
text: Hotel Rushmore is located right around the corner of Earl's Court Station. Its a typical London terrace house. So its a little tight. But the double room we had was still big enough and more importantly it was spotless clean. Breakfast buffet was good, although I missed the typical British bacon, beans & Eggs. It was extended continental with bread, cheese, cereal, boiled eggs, juice, coffee and tea.

title: If you enjoy small spaces and an old styled room, then this place is for you!
text: I was shocked, to say the least, when I opened the door to my so called "refurbished room". It was incredibly old school, with wooden window shutters and an old wooden four poster bed. It was also a very narrow room, which looked nothing like it did on the website. The bathroom was also tiny. You could not move in the shower, it was that small. The TV did not work, as the aerial was broken. I do not understand why this was not fixed prior to us arriving, as it was snapped and left hanging. We asked to have this fixed, but this did not happen. However, the rooms were clean and the staff were very friendly. The location is also excellent, only a few minutes from the Earls Court tube station, and within walking distance to some of the most gorgeous pubs you have ever seen! If you choose to stay here, I'd only recommend it for a few nights, as being in a narrow space might get frustrating after a while.

title: A BEAUTIFUL PLACE TO STAY AT
text: Very nice little hotel in Earl's Court near the center of London. The tube station is only 2 minutes away and that was great for us. The main road is full of restaurants and pubs that do great food and it is not too expensive(that's only if you want to eat near the hotel). On the Tube you are only about 3 to 4 Stations away from the main City Center stations. The Hotel lies in an old Georgien house,the road is full of these Houses and all the roads nearby are all the same,it's just beautiful! The owners and staff were very nice to us and looked after us very well. Our room was quite small but very cosy,the only negative point was that the shower was quite small but it was clean. The second negativ point was the breakfast,not much choice,not very nice and no English Breakfast!! We do recommend the Hotel for people who don't want to spend all their money on the hotel booking :)

title: Shabby but not in a chic way.
text: This hotel is not cheap, i paid £100 for one night and that was after pushing for a discount due to the rates available on the website not being what they quoted me. The location is great and staff were fairly helpful but thats as positive as i'm going to be. I kept my clothes packed as there was no way i would have put them in the warderobe or drawers. They looked grubby and stained. I also wasn't confident about the floor being clean so kept my shoes on. When i pulled the bedpsread back there was just a scruffy, old pink blanket and a sheet. I had to turn the heating up high to keep warm at night and didn't like the blanket touching me as it felt awful. The bed was almost completely solid, made my joints hurt. The bathroom was clean but the shower tiny, i am by no means large but struggled to get washed without jabbing elbows into walls or catching feet on the edge of the shower. Breakfast was disappointing, just toast and cereal. By the melon rinds left on the breakfast bar i presume there was some fruit before we got downstairs, clearly 8.30 is too late to get hold of anything other than stale white bread despite the breakfast service only being open for half an hour. Just disappointing really. The decor is bizarre and shabby but not in a charming way. Watch out for the prices they quote.

title: Disappointing
text: When checking in, receptionist proudly told us we were allocated a room with a balcony. This was on the first floor, so good start, but then downhill from there. Room very small and narrow: bed against the wall - no space for bedside tables. Decor in urgent need of work - paint peeling off, scuff marks on walls and giving overall impression of being dirty. Bathroom even worse: very narrow shower and no bath, which we were expecting after having looked at the photos on various websites. Doubt whether this was really a double room since only one set of towels was provided and because the size of everything. Breakfast of very average standard and not all items on their menu were provided. Also breakfast room not big enough to accommodate 22 rooms. When we were there one couple came in and had to wait outside till a table cam available. WiFi very temperamental and not as advertised and expected. Why call this a hotel? We've been to better B&Bs.

title: Very close to the station
text: Arrived early evening and although it states check in is 2pm this wasn't a problem. I was helped with my bags and when I got into my room there was a kettle for a nice cup of tea. There was also a balcony which was great. I asked for a glass of water and the staff kindly gave me a bottle. The room was very hot but with the balcony door open this wasn't a problem. Breakfast was basic and continental. I would have liked a full English before a big day but not a problem. Thank you :)

title: Great Value in January
text: I have stayed in many hotel in this area over the years , many making me feel not be particularly proud of our capital as the perception given to foreign visitors was not good, but NOT the Rushmore Hotel. This is the best I have stayed in in Earls Court, it general well maintained there are worn carpets but the ensuite rooms are OK. There are some comments on Trip advisor about the small rooms , for me my room was OK, yes the bathroom was small and any well covered (large ) people would struggle in and out the shower. The Breakfast room is very nice and breakfast was OK based on previous experiences elsewhere . the Wi-Fi is free but a bit slow.

title: Good hotel, good staff, good location overal.....AMAZING
text: The hotel at first impressions was nothing special but as soon as we were greeted and felt really welcome my impressions changed. The room was very clean and tidy. Although the shower cubicle was fairly small the bathroom was clean and towels were fresh. Wifi was ok most of the time and breakfast was fairly standard. The location is amazing as rthe tube is 2 minutes away with restaurants and shops being at the door step. Check-out was at 11am but we requested to check out at 12pm and leave our luggage in the hotel till 4pm (as our coach was this time) and the staff were more than happy to accommodate all of this.

title: Dont stay in the attic room!
text: We were a family of 6 ( with children)travelling to London on vacation. We had to split our family up into 2 rooms due to lack of accommodation in 1 room. We had hoped the rooms would at least be in close proximity to each other. One was in the basement, and one was in the attic !( 96 stairs separating the 2 rooms) The basement room was beautiful, nicely decorated and clean. The attic room was terrible! There was mold growing in the tiles in the shower, the shower ceiling was slanted so you hit your head on the moldy tiles, ( and every where else in the room the ceiling was very slanted) , the bathroom smelled of urine, the shower had no pressureadn worked in spurts, there were no windows to look out (just sky lights), it was a fire trap as far as I was concerned, it was brutal dragging all of our luggage up those stairs ( no help and no elevator). The room was cold and we couldnt get the heater to work. The tv didnt work in either room and the kettle had electrical tape on it in the basement room causing it to be tempermental. There was soap scum on both seashell soapdishes in both rooms. There was a pay for use computer but they did not have a printer to print our boarding passes for our return flight home so we had to go out to an internet cafe. The breakfast room was nice, breakfast was good and the staff were friendly. We would stay there again in the basement room, but would not reccommend ANYONE stay in that attic! And no, there was no discount for that attic room either! Both rooms were the same price! It neeeded a good updating and a good cleaning! (There was a pamphlet left under the bed from a previous guest!) The hotel lobby staff were friendly, the small main lobby is cute, the conservatory and breakfast were nice. Just dont stay in the attic!

title: Excellent value for money, great location
text: Stayed here for 2 nights, the hotel is very easy to find. We were given a large room facing the rear of the property on the 2nd floor, the room was very clean as was the ensuite (which was even fitted with a bath) Our room was very quiet. There were two routers to ensure good wifi to the room. Literally a minute to Earl's Court tube station and high street. All the staff at the reception were very polite and friendly. A good selection of continental buffet breakfast, which was constantly being refreshed. Was nice to see proper orange juice rather than the watered down stuff you find at much more expensive hotels. Would highly recommend this value for money hotel !

title: Absolutely Fabulous!
text: The Hotel was easy to get to from the airport. most important part of the deal. The staff was very friendly and helpful in their directions and answering questions regarding the neighborhood. Loved the convenience - close to the Metro, Buses and neighborhood had many places to eat at & drink at. Rooms were always clean and comfortable. Bad thing - the stairs - but that was its only fault. I would definitely head back to the Rushmore just because I enjoyed all. Definitely for people who are not high maintenance (need the comforts of elevators) and need a lot of space but I loved it. You would love it if you are a traveler at heart.
