title: Friendly service, fantastic location
text: This hotel is beautiful on the inside and crisp and clean on the inside! The staff was super friendly and the bed so comfortable! The location is fantastic on the Piccadily line, so could go straight from airport to hotel on one train! Just a few min walk from hotel to station. Plenty of supermarkets and places to eat, ATMs just minutes away from hotel. Only downside is the hotel doesn't have stairs so lugging your heavy suitcase up many flights of stairs is the tiniest of challenges in this otherwise perfect London hotel experience.

title: Great location
text: This hotel it located a few minutes from the Earl's Court tube station making this very convenient. There is no lift so that is disappointing when they only have rooms available on the 3rd and 4th floors. The breakfast is traditional continental with very fresh foods available. The lobby was spotless clean which made for a warm welcome. The bathroom was very clean and the bed extremely comfortable. Definitely a great value for the prime location in London.

title: A fine, friendly, convenient, reasonably priced B&B hotel that's and easy walk from the Earls Court Underground.
text: This is a family-owned hotel that makes the guest feel like family.

title: Good
text: Everything was great except the noise from the street. Shared Bathroom and toilet, except the room on the top floor. Friendly staff when they are at the guest house. Clean room, hot water, only the noise from the street isn't good.

title: Clean, good showers but very noisy and couldn't have my breakfast.
text: Single room too hot and extremely noisy from the lorries that start going by at 5am. Paid extra for breakfast but after waiting 15mins at reception to find out where to go, there were no staff about and so had to leave. On a positive note, rooms very clean and showers hot and powerful.

title: Not good
text: We stayed here for 2 nights last weekend. We checked in at the sister hotel which was a short walk down the road. We stayed in room 4 which was a spacious and clean room. Friday night was an absolute nightmare! From 2am-6am the noise from the other guests was horrendous! We didn’t feel safe at all, especially with there being no reception. We had no sleep at all. They were laughing, shouting and banging around for most of the night. Our whole room smelt of cannabis, it was a joke! The next morning we went to the reception at the other hotel and complained. The guy on reception was very pleasant and apologised and said it wouldn’t happen again. Saturday was much better, no noise in the hotel but the noise from the traffic is unreal. It’s like sleeping on the hard shoulder of a motorway! As we were getting ready to leave on Sunday morning the lady staying below us knocked on the door and told us to be quiet. I couldn’t believe it! We weren’t doing anything apart from getting ready to leave. The floorboards are so creaky and noisy. Obviously she can’t have stayed the night before and heard the noise we had to put up with! The TV in the room is the smallest TV I’ve ever seen! The bed is the equivalent to a mattress on the floor as it’s so low down. The guest house is in a good location but that’s about it. The staff were also very nice but I’m sorry I wouldn’t recommend it and we certainly won’t be staying again. We paid £225 for 2 nights, I’d rather stay in a Travelodge!

title: Perfect!
text: I booked the room suited for 4 persons for a week. There was a daily room service that was very helpful since we were 4 in the same room and there was a bus stop right in front of the guest house. We found it perfect to go visit London everyday. Everyone was really nice and I really enjoyed my trip thanks to the Guest House. I would definitely recommend it to anyone that wants a safe and easy trip.

title: It's worse than it looks like
text: I was supposed to stay at this place that they call hotel but for me it looks like an old wherehouse, but when I saw it from outside and no reception and the place is not safe as well specially for families, pay little extra but never go to this place at least for your safety. And the people who are supposed to give you the key are very far away and that's extremely difficult if you have luggage.

title: Nice stay at Clapham Guest House
text: The room was very clean, modern and quite large, very good value for money. I would recommend this hotel. I did however have to go to another hotel about a km down the road to pick up keys for some reason but i'm sure this was just a blip.

title: 6 days in London
text: Clapham Guest House and Chelsea Guest House are the same reception. Following that possession of a key to get in for Clapham Guest House have to go 10min from no 372 (the Chelsea Guest House) to 685. Easy. The Clapham Guest House location is perfect. You have the closest metro station, buses and stationary bicycles point. This hotel is good enough for the travellers who need some place to sleep somewhere without pretending for something else. It has a common bath on the first floor and a small bed inside the room with TV on the wall. There are very small wardrobe and teapot with a cup for tea. There are all that is necessary to spend your time in London for some days - not more. There are food stores around, street is connected with the center of the town by bus, you need 15 min to come to Westminster Abbey for instance. It locates in a townhouse what seems a little bit exotic. Bed comfortable and clean, bathroom clean and good. It was conveniently located for me on this visit to London. Nice, neat, comfortable, convenient and spacious room at a very good price! For people who need night toilet is difficult to come to the bathroom because you have to go down 2 floors every time. Otherwise, for those with good legs who sleep unconverted, it is OK.

title: GREAT LOACTION
text: CLAPHAM is a great place to stay, close alot of nice bars and cafe's. The house was nice with an old touch, I will be back here for sure. The staff were friendly and made things easy for our 1 week stay.

title: Not too bad
text: Stayed here in room 1. It's basic but clean, noisy because of the road...£89 for two isn't bad for London. 10 mins from the tube if you're Mo Farrah...took us 20....but lots of good bars close by.overall it's ok.

title: Enjoyable Stay
text: The young lady on reception was great. Very helpful and explained very patiently how to get into inner London. Excellent value for money and I would echo it's not the quietest place due to the main road. Great location nr to Clapham Common and transport into London. Would definitely visit again.

title: Perfect for Brixton Academy trip
text: I was going to a gig at Brixton Academy and this was a great location and cheap. It included free wi-fi and a kettle, and the bed was comfortable. My only negative is that there was a busy road outside (Wandsworth Road), so bring earplugs if that affects you.

title: Anything is well, expect location
text: very good. the room is so clean. And the toliet is also clean. But the room is a little noise. And the receiption is better closer to the room to collect the key. The price is cheap. The important is that the transfer is very convince to go to the centre of the London. I like this hotel.

title: clean basic but pricey
text: We stayed at the clapham guest for a night recently and was disappointed with the room because we expected more for the price we paid.The reviews on the guest house looked good and as we had a housewarming party to attend close by we booked more on a location basis, we arrived at the hotel and were greeted by a pleasant girl that showed us the ropes (free wifi a plus) but only to discover we had not ensuite bathroom shower or even toilet was a bit of a let down room was basic as expected with a small tv placed above the bed and coffee tea making facilities available had a nights sleep i cant rate because i was drunk when got back. Could be cheaper but then again its the london factor i suppose.

title: Horribly Small but clean
text: Clapham guest house does not have a reception on it's own, but you first have to walk to another guest house 5-10 minutes away. I had bad luck and got a room on the third floor and had to caryy my bulky and heavy suitcase up there. when I entered the room and got my suitcase in the room was already full. It smelled a bit like cigarette smoke but it was possible to open a window, also it faced to the street. I shared a bathroom with the other rooms, but I must admit that this was not a problem the bathroom and the appartment have both been in a good condition and have been perfectly cleaned.

title: Great Place to Stay
text: There is no sign, but the street address is clearly shown so it wasn't too hard to find. It is a bit far from the train if you have a lot of baggage (about a 10 minute walk) but the very nice man at reception told us where the closest bus stop is which is much more manageable (although we just used the trains as we knew them better). Very clean room and bathroom--the room is small but if you are expecting a large room in London you will have to pay much more. It was plenty comfortable, and we never even saw another guest so it was nice and quiet. Our window opened right to the road which I was fine with but I guess if you are an incredibly light sleeper you may not like the noise from the road. Overall this is a great place to stay, after reading reviews of other hotels it seems like there are a lot of small dirty places to stay outside of London so I was very excited to arrive and see how comfortable and clean this place was. Definitely would recommend staying here.

title: Clean and comfortable but with issues
text: I was taken by the high standard of decor and cleanliness and its great proximity to rail and tube stations. However, some things just don't work for me: someone smoking hash

title: Great value for money
text: I was looking for a cheap hotel in the Clapham area, and I wasn't disappointed. It was basic, clean and comfortable. Although the bathroom facilities were shared, they were spotlessly clean and modern

title: Great value for money!
text: I wasn't expecting much because the price was so good! But turns out we had a big room, the bathrooms were super clean and looked newly renovated, and the staff were very friendly. We stayed there when it was very hot and they offered us a fan without us even asking. Very impressed! I would stay again and I would recommend to my friends and family!

title: Walk the walk
text: Reception 2 bus stops away, odd. Long way to the loo from the top floor. However clean and comfortable. Rooms on the front very noisy, easy to get too on the 87 bus, Lavender Hill a couple of miles down the road lovely area with a good range of shops. Bus shop almost right outside.

title: Kept clean
text: They try to keep it clean, neat and tidy. It felt like home after a couple of nights. The best is to have a back room away from the street traffic. The stairs are a killer, so keep your luggage to a minimum weight. We had to go up six sets to get to our room, so be warned.

title: Pleasantly surpirsed
text: We booked to stay at the Clapham Guest House whilst in London for a wedding. We rang up the morning of the wedding to ask if we could leave our bags with reception as check-in was at the same time as the beginning of the wedding - we were immediately assured they would prepare our room early so we could check in and get ready there. Our room was large and very clean, the bed was big and comfortable. The bathroom was almost the same size as the room and the shower was huge. The staff were friendly and very helpful. Given the price we paid for the night, we were very pleasantly surprised. We would definitely stay here again and recommend to friends.

title: Nice room on a budget
text: My husband and I stayed at the Clapham Guest House for 12 nights. We had room 5, which had its own bathroom. The room and bathroom were small, but cozy. There is a nice big shower in the bathroom. Overall, we are satisfied with our stay and would come back any time. Yes, you have to check in at a different place, but the people there were always very helpful. Also, you can hear EVERYTHING that goes on in the corridor as if you were there yourself, but people were respectful during our stay. The bed was comfortable and there were extra pillows to get some extra pillow height because these were a little flat in my opinion. Only downside, the spreadsheet was not big enough to be well tucked in under the mattress, so I woke up a few times during my stay with the spreadsheet all bundled up under me. Also, the Wifi wasn't super strong in our room. Sometimes, we had to sit a the foot of the bed to get better signal, but it is free. As for location, there is bus right in front of the guest house that gets you to Vauxhall station in about 15 minutes (there was construction while we where there on the bus route, so some days it took a bit more time) and that same bus brings you to Westminster and Big Ben in about 30 minutes. We took it everyday instead of walking the 15-20 minutes walk to the Clapham Common Station. I would say that we got to everything we wanted to see in about 30 minutes to 1 hour, which is reasonable to me.

title: Excellent value
text: Stayed there before Christmas, the place was clean, well priced and comfortable. very highly recomend. The service was excellent, the people servicing the place were very very nice. please note that you can get cheaper offers by booking online or calling them than by booking online.

title: Would not stay here again.
text: This was our first trip to London. We arrived on a cold wet evening and there was no one to let us in. My husband had to try to find his way to their other hotel to get a key while I shivered outside waiting with our bags. It was unseasonably cold during our entire visit. While there were two beds in the room they only had one blanket and no way to turn up the heat. We both slept in clothes under our flannel pajamas. There was no insulation between floors so every step taken by the people on the floor above us was amplified by the wooden floors. While this was a budget hotel I really did expect at least blankets and heat.

title: budget accommodation
text: The guest house provides adequate accommodation for travellers who are seeking sleeping facilities without hotel facilities. The room was clean and the modern bathroom was equipped with a good sized walk-in shower. Tea/coffee supplies were replenished daily. Reception staff were friendly and pleasant and gave information and maps regarding transport facilites, etc But, oh dear, the bedside lamp was in a very sorry state - tattered and frayed. To replace the lamp would only need minimal expense and would look so much better.

title: Perfect!
text: Great Hotel with great service! I stayed in a single room and it couldn't have been a better stay. Very clean and friendly cleaners. Great location as well if you are going to be around south London for your stay. Only great things to say about this hotel.

title: 2 hours sletp if lucky
text: The room was clean . Thats is the only good commemt terrible beds high noise level the tv too small apnd to far from bed to see its prob ok for site worker but not a lady or children would not stay again ever

title: A pleasant stay
text: Kevin, we found to be the perfect host. He went out of his way to make us feel comfortable and assisted us with local advice on more than one occasion. A suggestion for the unit we occupied, a second bedside table and lamp and in addition a small table and 2 fold up chairs. Having said that the accommodation was comfortable and clean and a very user friendly bathroom!Also very convenient as close to bus stops and shops. Bruce & Viv

title: Good intentions, bad execution
text: My experience with Clapham Guest House unfortunately wasn't great. I've booked a room because it was close to the Clapham Junction station. After booking I got a mail that I had to pick-up the keys at another location, further away from the station. This was a bummer. Upon arriving at the location, there initially was no one present and the phone was not answered. After a few minutes a employee came from a restaurant next door. He was very helpful, showed me the way back to the Clapham Guest House and explained how to check-out. I'll summon up my positives and negatives: + Bathroom is very spacious, modern and clean + Staff is helpful + Free WiFi + Bus stop in front of the building - Picking up keys at another location and telling about that AFTER booking - The guest house is very noisy. I could almost literally hear conversations in the room above mine - The bed was 'end of life' and so was the matras - The room had stains on the floor and wasn't well cleaned

title: Squeaky floors, complete nightmare
text: Squeaky floors made our stay an absolute nightmare. We could here all the visitors on the first floor walking around and that all night long and early in the morning. It's not the guests' fault so I couldn't even complain but resulted in only getting a few hours of sleep for the entire 3 days. There must be a minimum conditions that such 'guest houses' are obliged to fulfil. I really hope someone will do an inspection on this. Simply unacceptable! In our "suite" there was no window and no natural light came through. There is no reception which makes any questions or complaints a mission impossible. For a quarter of the price we've paid we could have gone to a hostel where we could even get some more sleep. Just incredible... Complete rip off.

title: One time adventure.
text: The room was clean and daily fresh towels. The television was to small en hang to high. Three nights on a row very loud television noises from the room underneath the whole night!!!. After complaining this was solved but shows that there is no one responsable for the wel beeing of the quests after nine o clock in the evening.

title: Awesome, clean, straightforward and good location
text: Near everything. Clean room. Nice bed. Good staff. Great time. Will come again. I liked the experience. Did not hear any noise. They had flat screen TV. And the bubbly staff was willing to hold my luggage while I did sightseeing.

title: Did the job
text: Room was clean and tidy. Bed was comfortable and small but nice bathroom and very good shower. Only stayed one night but ideal to visit daughter and local area. Is near main road so some traffic noise.

title: Very Good !!!!
text: We were very happy to find a very clean room and our own clean new bathroom ( family Room upstairs Nr.8) .We had nice and friendly contact befor our trip with cecilia. She was so helpful !!! A little table in front of the couch would be helpful for breakfast ..*g*..but we helped us we the suitceases. We would book again !!!

title: Arrival in UK
text: Extremely noisy, but ear plugs were provided and at least there was double glazing.Noise from room upstairs was constant at night, then from around 4.00am in morning. Think they were doing exercises. No soundproofing between floors. Bathroom ceiling was black with mould.

title: Horrible. Not Recommended
text: Spending one night here, having originally booked in Chelsea Guest House just down the road. Unfortunately, the room was booked for us and we arrived quite late on Christmas night so moving to another hotel is not really viable. The business is known as Chelsea and Clapham Guest Houses. The room (6) we were given in Clapham Guest House is awful. The room is dirty with some bubble gum stains on the floor. The bed is dirty with stains, black spots and body hairs left in the sheets so we are sleeping on top of the bed in our street clothes for warmth. The room includes a bed, a small kettle with a few milk and tea sachets and a small cupboard to hang clothes in. The TV hangs from the cove at the top of one wall and it's impossible to comfortably watch it from the bed at all. The bathroom is two floors down

title: Damp
text: I stayed in the Clapham Guest House for two nights but although the room was clean it did have an issue of damp and it was not pleasant experience to sleep in, I think they need to look at better ventilation for the bathroom. I would not return to this hotel.

title: great guest house
text: trip to london with my daughters , and will definately stay again. staff friendly and great for travel advice as we were trying to get to the O2 . with tube problems they found us another route and we were there in 25 mins using the overhead railway. towels changed everyday, tea and coffee supplies in abundance for when we got back from hectic days in London. Bus outside was brilliant , straight into parliament square and Clapham common tube was only a 10min walk away. only negative comment was the road noice outside , but as we were there during a great sunny spell , we had to keep the windows open to stay cool overnight .

title: Clapham Guest House Review
text: Was extremely pleased with the room, very clean, comfy beds, tea and coffee and excellent ensuite shower room complete with shampoo, conditioner and hand soap. Had to walk 5-10 minutes up the road to collect keys from reception. Receptionists were very helpful and gave us all the information we required for buses and tubes. Bus stopped right outside the guest house. Tube station a five minute walk up the road. Rooms were lovely and warm and was surprised to find our room was cleaned after our first night. I didn't expect this. Showers are amazing. Well worth the money, would return again if we were to stay in London again. Would definitely recommend.

title: Very tidy and quite place
text: Easy check in and check out and easy access to city center. Friendly and very helpful personnel. Best price for such accommodation in London. Discounted price when booking directly to hotel. Traffic is not too crowded and easy to get public transport

title: london is perfect - chapham guesthouse will I not come back to
text: London - fantastic - magnificient. Our guestroom was clean - both the living and the bathroom but I do have one experience that lead to number three on the scale two times during our period we were awaked up at 1 o clock in night due to noise from guests upstairs. so sorry i want tro return to london, but i have to choose another guesthouse sincere knut ekroll 5531 haugesund norway

title: Excellent!
text: I stayed for 5 nights at the Clapham Guest House in the single room at the beginning of September 2012. The room was very clean as well as modern and had everything that I needed! Even though the window was facing the main road, I had no problems sleeping , as the noise was minimal! The bathrooms were the best ever! I lived in London for 20 years, so I know water pressure is always a problem , but not at the guest house. A very powerful shower and a very modern and clean bathroom, brilliant! I did not mind sharing! The connections via bus ect are perfect! Outside the house the bus stop to get you to Trafalgar Square within 30 minutes, perfect, as I love buses in London! Even the night bus stops outside! To top it all off, Kevin the manager is wonderful. Helpful, friendly and always there to help! I can only recommend staying there!!!

title: amazing
text: Great location great staff. Clean room. All ok. The bus stop is near clapham guest House bus 87 toward Westminster and Trafalgar Square and 452 toward Chelsea. Reception 24 h always available on everyone request.

title: no lamp
text: The room was good, spacious and with good beds and a nice bathroom. The house as such appear ed rather run down however . From the outside it looked very tacky, with teared blinds. The room was also quite noisy in the sense that it is a lot of traffic outside and whenever people moved upstairs it sounded like they were coming trough the ceiling

title: Lovely spacious room
text: Perfect location for my stay, because I had a wedding just a short way up the road. A lovely spacious room, which was nicely renovated and new bathroom fittings with a fantastic large shower. Would definitely recommend for a short stay when you need to be in this area of town.

title: A Second Home
text: I work in the area every week, so have been staying at the Clapham Guest House. It is a clean, spacious, comfortable place to stay. The Manager is friendly, attentive, helpful and really courteous. Great customer service and extremely good prices. Will continue to stay at CGH, and am glad I found it via TripAdvisor. Z, Shafi.

title: Basic but clean and good value
text: Very good value for money. Bathroom clean and room tidy with the exception of a few hairs. Only downside was that it was very very noisy and you could hear everything going on in next door and stair ways. Otherwise very good and would stay again.

title: Clean but quite noisy guest house
text: We've spent here 10 nights. Pros - Room number 2 was very clean with modern spacious bathroom. Bed was comfortable. wardrobe was big enough. Bus stops are near the guest house. 10 mins walk is McDonald which we used for breakfast. Cons - minimum storage space, 2 little bedsides and 1 little table for tea/coffee. You could hear everything above you. Every night we've heard squeaking. During 1 night somebody in room number 1 which is next this room had a party with loud music. This night was the worst! This guest house is very good but noisy!

title: Good Value for Money
text: we were down visiting friends & family, so just needed a bed for the night, for £75 i was pleasantly surprised how good it was & clean and comfortable. Good Location in Clapham, even though it was on a main road it was quiet and easy to park down a side road.

title: Great place to stay
text: Was impressed with how big the room and ensuite was and it was very clean as well. Really enjoyed staying here. The only downside was the noise (we had a lower ground room and could hear everything from the upstairs room) but not much you can do about that really. Didn't bother us because we were only there one night and out clubbing ourselves. So all in all I would def recommend this place.

title: Pretty rough
text: Could hear all movements upstairs, bathroom wad good however bedroom was rather ordinary, bed too low and not very comfy, could of done with a chair in the room. Did not realise how far out I was from Waterloo.

title: Good Price, could easily be better
text: Good price, most things are new. Some things could be better. 1) We arrived at 1 and realized nobody is there, not before 3pm. on the website it said Reception Hours from 1pm onwards. I expected someone to be there, would be better to state it clearly on the website (not in the small print) because these hours are not conventional. 2) The double room had no window. Only with open toilet /bathroom we had a bit of light since there was an opal glass door (locked) On request the woman told us the key is missing, a guest lost it. (how about: making a new one?! we were ground floor, would like to see the garden, go outside, have light in the room. in the toilet is another indirect window in the ceiling, to high up to open. A stick to open was missig as well. No fresh air? She brought as a little ledder (we found the stick she has not found the next day hidden under the bed). 3) the room we had (nr. 2) is noisy, next to the reception, very loud, no isolation, every day they renovated in the room above, very loud. Upstairs is better, my friend had a room there and was happy. 4) Rubbish plastic bags in front of the house (how about some nicer entry? Or a second bin? all in all, good price, close to public transport, but could easily be a bit better with not much effort, just a little more care. Double Room means for me two beds not a big single 140cm bed.

title: Pretty bad, but not terrible
text: Was a pretty average stay. Found out only the morning of our flight that the reception was about a 700m up the road. Normally this isn't an issue, but when you've got heavy bags it was pretty annoying. Our bed was broken, you could hear every step that was taken in the house whether the person was above or below you. The people upstairs were smoking and drinking until 4am on the Saturday morning. Bathrooms were clean though. Overall, pretty disappointing stay and was very happy to be checking out by the end.

title: Nice rooms poor service
text: When we arrived at the room the was no one on reception just a note by the door informing us to go to a sister Hotel reception (about a mile away). When we arrived at the sister hotel there was no one at that reception desk either with another message saying they had gone to the hotel we had just come from and would be back in 20 mins. 30 minutes later they arrived back. So it took us over an hour to check in. The rooms where clean and comfortable but the TV was mounted next to the ceiling. the only way you could watch it is by standing on the opposite side of the room you could not watch it from the bed or chair. There is no on suite facilities however there are couple of bathrooms and toilets and they were very clean and modern.

title: Highly recommended
text: Stay was short (1 night only) and just needed a quiet and nice place in the area to spend the night. The room size was good, ensuite bathroom with shower, tea and coffee and kettle in the room, good storage space, and good size TV screen. Area was quiet, and bed was comfortable. Price was very good and checking in and out the easiest possible. No complaint. Highly recommended.

title: Good value for money
text: The location is near 87 bus stop, so you can reach easily to any London's attraction. At arrival the room was not so clean (-), but they have changed towels every day (+). They have offered tea/coffee and cookies every day (++). Friendly staff. Because of the location (the room position was near the street), the noise was sometimes disturbing (-). Also, there is a poor isolation between the rooms, especially if you have neighbors which are awake during the night. A big plus for hot showers at any time. Overall it is worth to spend money here, if the noise is not bothering you.

title: Very tight
text: It's in third floor with very tight stairs. I don't recommend it and the staff refused to change the room even with extra charges. No room service available. No changes of mattresses. No phone in the room. Very tight bathroom and hardly can take shower on it. Not recommend it for enemy and how I can recommend it for friends.

title: Nice place
text: Nice family room in attic. It is close to bus stop and thus easy access to downtown London - perfect for us a family of 4. But cheaper to buy breakfast in a local restauarant than through vocher at hotel....

title: Accomodation for "Lets Rock London"
text: Perfect location and lovely sized room, with lots of ventilation. Bathroom is a little small but as only stayed one night, cant complain. Cleaner was really friendly and helpfull. I would definitely book this again.

title: Adequet
text: This hotel was very adequate for the purpose of our stay. Me and my friend simply needed a bed for the night as we were attending an event. You have to check in at one place and then walk a short distance to the guest house (and it really is a short distance) bus services are great. It's also right next to the station. The first house itself was very clean. There are communal bathrooms and toilets but plenty of them and not once did we see the other guests that were staying. My only complaint was the noise levels of the area. There were car horns and sirens at 6 in the morning. Bare in mind I was hungover and not used to the area so it seemed louder to me. Also the floors were extremely creeky making it sounds as though a whale was above us or something. Over all I would definitely come here again. Thank you.

title: Stevie wonder concert
text: My partner and I stayed here last weekend as we attended the calling festival at clapham common. The room was very clean and spacious. The staff were nice and it had good transport links. Would go back. Didn't like the shared toilet though...

title: Don't judge a book by its cover
text: From the outside, it looks shocking - however inside and in the rooms it is clean, comfortable and adequate. It's cheap and basic but does the job nicely. Wifi is so so but does work, I would stay here again.

title: Value for money!
text: The room was very clean and immaculate, staff were really helpful and location was great, there is a bus stop directly outside taking you into Central London within 15 mins. Next time we are in the area we will be booking again, would highly recommend staying here!

title: Friendly Staff! Brilliant Accommodation For The Price!
text: Stayed at Clapham guest house with a family member and friend to attend a near by gig. Struggled to look for the building at first due to the main reception and hotel being separate for our room. If you get stuck looking for the building, there's probably a chance you need to head down the road, the main reception is located not far from McDonalds. The staff are friendly, and the cleanliness of the hotel is spectacular especially for a low budget. There's a chance we'd/I'd show up again! Thank you for your pleasant service. :)

title: Good location, friendly, clean & comfortable
text: Stayed at CGH for the SW 4 festival. The location was spot on. Lots of bars, cafés nice locations to visit. Receptionist was very helpful & friendly. The room was small but very comfortable and clean...with all the basic condiments. Recommend to friends & Family. .

title: Cheap
text: Clean and modern bathroom and communal areas. Room needed airing as cleaning products strong smelling but Noisy road with window open. Bedding needs more regular replacement, clean but lumpy mattress!

title: It was ok, just ok
text: When i saw it, i was a bit scared. The building of the hotel is old and the zone doesnt look nice . My room was ok although i couldnt recommend to you. If you pay a bit more of money ,you could find a nice hotel in a secure zone.

title: Very Hot
text: I have stayed a couple of times at Clapham Guest House , but most of the time at parent hotel Chelsea Guest House, unfortunatley on both occasions wasnt really happy, first time no hot water, did mention this but it was very sorry will are getting it fixed response, and this weekend very big room, however no windows and it got very very hot so had the worse nights sleep ( it wasnt an overly warm day either)

title: Need to be up-front about reception being over a quarter of a mile from the Guest House.
text: Whilst I have no complaints about the Guest House itself - it is basic but clean I would recommend that it is made clear BEFORE booking that the reception is in another building over a quarter of a mile from Clapham Guest House. The walk, on a dry evening, was not particularly difficult for me but could cause problems for others. It is not acceptable to make this fact known by sending an email only after booking. It should also be made clear that, unlike some guest houses with shared bathrooms, there is no wash basin the the bedroom.

title: DONT
text: on the morning of my travel i got an email to state there was no reception, but have to walk around 5 minutes to pick up key.on my visit the family room was the attic 4 flights up, not good for family,property needs upgraded, no wifi working,shower NO hot water toilet basin in need of repair.on returning the key to pick up area, i told staff of my position, but sorry about that was not good enough no refund or discount, i wont return, sorry

title: Great value for the price
text: In my view this is very similar to a Travelodge but a lot less expensive. The shower was good, the bed was firm (which is the way I like it), and the location is good for Clapham and Battersea. It ticks all the boxes for a basic room for a night or 2.

title: Clean room, too much noise.
text: Good experience in this guest house. Helpful reception, clean room. Position a little bit confused. 10 min far to metro Clapham common. The only negative exception was too much noise during the day and the night.

title: Excellent stay!
text: We stayed at Clapham Guest House for the South West Four Festival (We stayed on the saturday night) Our room was spotless and had a very luxurious en-suite. Kevin the manager was brilliant and made us feel very welcome. He has an extensive knowledge of London and we felt that nothing was too much touble for him. Thank you for a very pleasant stay. We have already booked for next years South West Four!

title: clean, simple, no fuss
text: Great value for money. Clean room, decent shower, excellent location (5 mins away from garage, fast food, general amenities, bus stops and overground connection to the underground) and a simple, no fuss experience was had. People at check-in desk were polite, friendly and very helpful. If you're an all round good egg and not a snob you'll need nothing more when visiting London.

title: Mis-leading
text: I walked past the Clapgam Guest house twice. It has no sign. It is a plain white door. The Chelsea Guest house is along the road. You have to check in there first. I stayed in room 1in the Clapham Guest house. The traffic keeps you awake. You hear every footstep from the room above. The single bed was clean and comfortable. I am staying tonight in the one along the road The Chelsea Guest House.

title: Comfortable, clean hotel, bit noisy though
text: Went to pick up our keys from the other building, which was a short walk away. The guy at the desk was very friendly, check in was quick and straightforward. The map with directions to the other hotel, and to the Brixton Academy, was useful. Had a bit of trouble finding it at first because a delivery van for next door had parked diagonally across the drive and obscured everything, there was no sign but the house number is clearly displayed. The room itself was very clean. Layout was a bit unusual, no windows in the room itself, but lots of light if you opened the door connecting the large ensuite bathroom, with a side door (which didn't open) and a big skylight window (which let in a very welcome breeze). The lighting was very good in both rooms. Overall the room was great, the only downside was that being an old building, every time someone walked about upstairs or dropped anything you could really hear it. Next door neighbours were really noisy, think they were quite drunk from mid afternoon onwards, presumably making the most of the nice weather. The location was good, both hotels were close to Wandsworth Road overground station, and fairly close to Brixton, which was useful for us as we came for a gig at the Brixton Academy. If you're coming from outside London to see a band there, I would recommend a daily travel card as it allows you to travel back and forward, and saves getting a cab. A couple of minor points of feedback: when we first entered the room it smelt a bit musty, opening the skylight window for a while sorted this, luckily the weather was nice enough to do this, perhaps it needs more regular airing? And the mirror is quite far from the nearest plug socket, I have quite a long cable on my straighteners, but still only just reached. I would definitely consider staying here again for a similar trip.

title: Very noisy
text: This is the noisiest accommodation I have ever stayed in. Our ensuite room is one of several that looks straight out onto the Wandsworth Road, an all night bus route and next to traffic lights from which the roar of accelerating motor bikes and cars was very loud. I know Wandsworth Road well but since no other comments on Tripadvisor mentioned noise, I thought the hotel had found the secret to making the rooms quiet . I was wrong. We had planned to be in London for another day but had to cut our trip short because we were too tired to do anything

title: good reasonably priced base.
text: Decent size room, good decor, easy to get to different ares for a night out! Bathroom was huge, only slight downside is there was no window in the room (expect the bathroom).Keys are picked up from hotel down the road.

title: Room 3
text: Really good and really clean. I recommand it ! Good price for the room. Just be careful don't sid down on the floor, there are fleas in the carpet, my friend has bite because she was sit, me not. Great value for money!

title: Good location but noisy
text: The Guest house has a good location in the lovely area of Clapham. 5-10 min walk to the Underground, Bus stop in front of the house. Restaurants/pubs very close. Nice park! Price is not high but room are noisy. You hear people walking above you or in the corridor. Room was quite small. Reception (5 min walk) is not in the guest house. People at the reception were very kind and advice you for any trip/public transport etc.

title: Clapham Guest House
text: Good points - cheap for London - clean - nicer shower - two beds in room - clarity of directions, check in check out Could do better: - tv didn't work - in room 1, the ceiling made an awful noise - not good when there's a herd of elephants on the loose at 4am upstairs!

title: London 2016
text: good cleaning in reference to english standards, a lot of noise early in the morning from the rooms on the upper floors and stairs. Good position to reach the city center and well served by buses even at night

title: Good for the money
text: I wanted a one bedroom room that was cheap and fairly central. This definitely fitted the bill. You are not going to get luxury or indeed en suite but if you are looking for a place to stay that is cheap and cheerful then this is it. It's close to the Overground station at Wandsworth Road, which is a big plus (though Clapham Common is the closest underground, about ten minutes away). The collection of keys from another hotel is a bit weird and the noise from the traffic will annoy light sleepers, but it is still good and I would stay there again if I was on my own.

title: Basic but noisy
text: Good location for us. Rates ok. Rooms small,clean,functional and basic. Couldn't get 3 rooms next to each other. Not all ensuite. Noisy guests during the night coming in late and shouting etc. No night reception here so no way of complaining.

title: Functional
text: We wanted a clean room to lay our heads over a busy weekend. Met the bill admirably. Shower room was excellent and the staff very helpful. 10 minute walk to Clapham for a choice of cafes and restaurants. A little distant from the underground stations so make sure you have luggage with wheels!

title: No luck this time
text: We were not happy with the overall impression. Our room had no window and this is a very big no go specially if this was advertised differently. after asking we did get a new room with a window but only 2 days later. also on our first night we had very noisy neighbours that made the night very difficult (loud music and singing!). the walls are thin and you will hear everything happening in the room next to you and above you. we had 2 bad nights and 1 ok night most likely not repeating

title: unbelievably noisy
text: Guesthouse was a good half hour walk from underground' had to pick keys up from different property and let ourselves in. It was 11pm at night when we arrived - room ok, lovely bathroom. I was not prepared for the horrendous constant noise. we couldn't hear the tv. It was non stop traffic, buses, sirens, Got to sleep at 2am but woken at 5am by people upstairs walking around, floorboards creaking every step they made. It was a shame as facilities good for budget stay but they need to invest in noise reduction.

title: Well located
text: It is very well located. You have the underground, the overground and a bus stop very close. And also if you want, you can walk til downtown, something about 3.5 miles. The room and the bathroom were very clean, and the bed was great!

title: Room not safe during my stay. Street at night not great for female solo travellers.
text: I had a ground floor room, and the bathroom which connected to it had a back door made of glass facing the toilet. I checked the door and the lock was broken. If you pushed or pulled the door it moved - it looked as though someone had tried to force the door. I didn't feel safe in the room at all. When I called reception they reassured me that the back garden was secure and the owner lived around the back. If I wanted to change rooms I would have to walk back to the sister hotel to collect a key- but it was dark at that time. The room was very noisy - although I couldn't hear traffic you could clearly hear the front door banging open and shut and all the footsteps upstairs and up and down the stairs. It was quite loud. At the front - next door to the hotel there was a dumped disused sofa - so not a good welcome. Otherwise, the room was clean and warmed up well with the radiator. The shower was good.

title: The Good, the Bad, and the HOT!
text: Upon arriving at Clapham Guest House late Sunday morning, July 14th, my husband I were initially confused about whether or not we were at the correct address! The lack of sign or any indication that we were at a guest house left me a bit panicky as the taxi drove away – but alas we had arrived. We immediately realized that the doors were locked and a sign was in place saying that Clapham reception was closed, without an indication of when they would re-open. A phone number was listed for the guest house’s sister hotel but since we do not have a cell phone that operates in the UK this was of no use to us. After buzzing for quite some time, a housekeeper answered the door. She didn’t say anything but beckoned us inside and disappeared to the back of the house. A young woman, clearly having been awakened from bed and still in her nightgown, greeted us. She was kind and helpful and took time to show us maps of London and the tube system and give us transportation advice. We were in room #2, an interior room on the ground floor, which my husband and I would affectionately come to know as “the sweatbox.” The room was spacious and clean with an enormous private bathroom and very nice shower. However, there were no windows and the one door that opened to the outside and may have provided some relief from the stifling temperatures, was locked. Undeterred, we dropped off our baggage and headed to Central London for the day. That night we arrived back at the hotel near midnight and found the room to be unbearably hot. All we needed for some relief was fan and a key to the elusive outside door. Unfortunately, reception at the guest house closed at 10:00 pm and no one answered the bright red “24 hour” courtesy phone which purportedly connected with Chelsea Guest House down the road. We barely slept at all. The next day we were up and out before reception opened. When we returned they had again closed. I called on the red “24 hour” reception line and this time someone answered! I asked for a fan and was told someone would get back to me shortly. A few minutes later the young woman who had checked us in came by and said that they were out of fans but that we could have a key to the veranda door. However, she sternly mentioned that we were not permitted to venture out on the patio. Without explanation – she then left. Some sort of state secret must have been out on that patio to necessitate such a warning! The next day, while in London, we purchased a very small, very expensive and largely ineffective fan from a department store. That night my husband called the “24 hour” reception line at the Chelsea and had what could only be described as a very bizarre conversation. He enquired about the possibility of obtaining a fan to which he was directed to the Clapham’s reception office. He explained that we had tried that already but no one was responding to repeated knocks though it was within operational hours and the door was slightly ajar. After this was explained to the individual at Chelsea, and a fan once again requested, the Chelsea receptionist stated “that since your reception is closed I am not going to answer that question.” My husband again explained that the reception office was indeed open and that no one was responding. He was told that someone would be with us shortly. A short time later a man popped out and apologized that there was still no fan (night 3). He assured us that we would receive one the next night after the people who had “it” checked out. Nights 4 and 5 we gratefully were able to sleep in relative comfort after having received the fan. I understand that a heat wave in London is not the fault of this establishment. However, in a city where central AC is not routine, I believe that the guest house should have a fan for every room – especially interior rooms without windows or ready access to the outside. Other minor complaints: • Very thin walls – you could hear every movement from neighboring rooms and the people above. • Total lack of storage space in the room or bathroom. There are NO shelves besides one tiny one above the sink. We literally had to balance our toiletry bags on the furnace and put our stuff on the floors. • The tea pot had old water in it when we arrived. The bottom was scaly and full of scum. Decided not to have tea at Clapham after that! • Receptions hours are totally inconvenient for busy tourists as we generally left before they opened and returned after they closed. • The “24 hour” reception phone was of limited use because they didn’t always answer and when they did they were rude 50% of the time. Overall – we don’t recommend Clapham Guest House. It was disappointing though has potential as it is located in a very active and interesting neighborhood with easy access to Central London.

title: Eccentric, atmospheric, good
text: If you have difficulty walking, be aware you actually check in @ sister hotel 10 mins walk up the same road. It isn't in Clapham. There's a phone direct to reception (up the road) by the room. Staff friendly, helpful, efficient. Room 2 fine for late night arrival & early leaving but has no natural light except frosted glass door in bathroom (facing toilet and shower). Could hear all footsteps from several other rooms & another guest surprised me by saying he could hear me watching Fawlty Towers on my laptop. Overall Clapham Guest Hse is an eccentric hotel experience but more memorable & lively than most hotel stays and was fine for me

title: Very good guest house near Clapham
text: Very good guest house just a short walk away from the centre of Clapham. down side traffic was a little noisy as it is situated on the main Wandsworth Road, and its a little walk to pick the keys up. Upside clean and tidy, good size shower and its got good pressure.

title: Good clean, basic accomodation in good area
text: Room very clean and tidy. Staff helpful we enjoyed our stay here. Approx 10min walk to Clapham Common station on the northern line. Shops/restaurants nearby. Bathroom very modern and wifi worked well

title: A bit expansive but really quality and clear place!
text: I have been in Landon for one day and I have chosen Clapham Guest House because it is close to Clapham Junction station in order to take a train for airport. Actually it is not really close but it is okkei, at the end I departed from Victoria eheh! The reception is lokated in another way, not too far from the room, if you need of them you can also call by a telephone. The room is great, simple and cozy and important really clear, as bathrooms are. As I wrote in the title, I found the price a bit expansive in respect to what they offers as guest house, so no breakfast no bathroom in the room... finally, to go in the centre of London there is a 87 bus next to to the house! Thank you!

title: Stayed a night
text: Stayed a night .Staff extremely nice and polite. Room cleaned. Common area cleaned. Quite surprised by the service considering how cheap a night was. Public transport nearby including buses taking you straight to the center and an overground train.

title: New Year Holiday Stay
text: We stayed there over the New Years period We book in 10months advance and the prices where very high for what we received. We booked believing it would be a little better than it was. When we arrived at the reception which is a ten minute walk away. The people where friendly and helpful. But ideally you want one person to be at the guest house and one to walk to other place to save dragging bags up and down the road. The room was clean and tidy. All furniture are ikea furniture but one lamp was ideal. The bed was very low down like a futon level. Sockets for charging a phone etc is behind the head board which wasn't practical esp since it looks like the room has been recently refurbed. We had en suite which was great. It was very large and well thought out. Our only complaint which needs to be taken on board was the noise of other guests. The doors are paper thin and walls too. We could hear everyone come in and out. And we could hear everyone walking around above us (carpets have no underlay) easy to fix the creaking but you can hear every conversation every foot step and if really lucky very position of the karma sultra by the couple above! Tube station is only ten min away with nice restaurants bars and a lovely cinema just round the corner. Price - over rated clean - clean tidy and practical Location - great transport links to Clapham tube station

title: everything you need for a stop over
text: Just what we needed a bed tv and coffee for a night stay over in London. Everthing was nice and clean. Well prosented and maintained. Not far from Clapham Common which was a nice walk and town, great places to eat and underground was easily accessible.

title: As expected for the prcie
text: The experience was fine- arrived late on the Thursday evening- the receptionist at the chelsea guesthouse was very friendly when we collected our keys. Only a short walk to the Clapham Guest house. Handy to pass the texaco/co-op on the way to buy water as no kitchen facilitiess in guesthouse. Guesthouse was ROASTING- radiators on full blast and as you climbed the stairs, got even hotter. Turned off every radiator we could find- unnecessary on a mild march weekend. Room was basic- pillows very thin. Blind hanging off and broken/ripped.. not difficult to replace and surprised the establishment were happy to accept this poor standard. En-Suite was lovely-best thing about the room with good shower. Courtesy telephone on ground floor for 24hour call to Chelsea Guesthouse, answered our question regarding iron and ironing board, again very polite. Room also provided travel hairdryer but as mirror was not near plug, unable to see yourself when drying hair- frustrating. Nearby towards clapham common- lots of nice pubs/cafe places as opposed to wandsworth road which seems quite dilapidated.

title: Good place to stay the night
text: I have arrived at this guest house late after midnight. Excellent check-in service done quickly and efficiently by a friendly lady receptionist. The room is simple but very clean and tidy. Bathroom and shower were very clean. Very good value for money and I will definitely go there again.

title: overnight in clapham
text: stayed one night in the Clapham guest house, although was fantastic value for money,there were some down sides too. no one at the guest house to check you in so you have to walk about 5 minutes to another address to get checked in,we arrived quite late at night and although the receptionist was lovely, it was slightly inconvenient to do this. The bed was extremely uncomfy, low and flat with a big bump on the left hand side! Pillows very flat and uncomfy. Tv was so high up on the wall to the left of the bed, so difficult to watch. There is apparently a "breakfast deal" for £5 you can obtain a full English breakfast at a nearby café, but you have to purchase a token from reception. If the receptionist had told us the night before we would have done so, but we were not walking back to the other checking in house to do so! Room was very noisy, bot from occupants of other rooms , in their rooms or walking in the corridors to the bathroom, and outside traffic. On the plus side, for the money it is good value, well kept and extremely clean, complete with toiletries and ample tea/ coffee, also close to the tube statiin and a short walk to town centre.

title: A typical "I just need a bed to sleep in"-hotel
text: This hotel's location is so fantastic that it almost makes up for the lack of hot water in the shower. But just almost. We had one and a half short showers before the hot water was out, and then we were without for the rest of the weekend. We slept fairly well in our top floor ensuite room. The beds were comfortable, but the room held quite a high temperature. There was a big fan installed in the room, and that helped a bit, but as we were here in March and the fan ran non-stop, I think it can get quite damp in these rooms during summer. We were staying on the top floor (fourth, I believe), and it's not an easy task to maneuver large suitcases down the tiny staircase. You get one key when you check in, and you have to leave this in the reception when you go out, and then ring a door bell when you return. This was not a problem for us. Anyway, I think I might stay there again. You get what you pay for, and even though it's not a great hotel facility-wise, its location is superb and the prices friendly.

title: Last minute cheap deal, pleasantly surprised.
text: Stayed here for one night on my own after having to stay in London for a night longer than planned. I searched long and hard for a hotel that was cheap and looked ok that had semi decent reviews, didn’t want to spend loads as it was unplanned and it was just me. Stumbled across this place and glad I did! I had a room with shared shower room and toilet, not something I’d usually go for but in all honesty it wasn’t a problem at all. Tv worked, there was a kettle and hair dryer, bed was comfortable and the decor was nice enough. Everything was clean and check in was smooth. Had a really good night sleep with no noise disturbance. I’d definitely recommend this hotel, if you are looking for a posh get away in London there are better places, but they’ll cost you £200+ extra a night. For the price as hotels in London go this was an absolute bargain!

title: Small but central
text: Have just returned from a four night stay in this Inn with my son. Room was small but clean and any small issues we had were resolved immediately. Only gripe I would have is that our room was on the top floor and it doesn't say on the site that there is no lift!! My Fitbit loved it though as I climbed so many flights of stairs daily!! When we booked in great emphasis was made about the no smoking( we don't smoke) but on returning to our room on day two definite smell of smoke particularly in bathroom. I think was coming through extractor fan from other rooms. We did report and the guy on the desk held his head in his heads and said we are always telling people not to smoke!!!

title: Great In Value and location
text: I stayed there for 4 nights on March.eventhough the room was a bit small, but its ok. the hotel is in very good location and near to all the amenities, easy to find halal restaurant nearby for muslim..hotel location has very good access to all the attraction. Enjoy my stay there

title: Great Accommodation
text: Would stay at this place again. Excellent location, great restaurants in the area. We had a shared toilet, but our own shower and hand basin. In the week we stayed there I never saw anyone else going to the toilets, so just trotted down in my nightie. The managers were very helpful and the breakfast was fine. Very good value for money.

title: Good location, difficult to sleep
text: Good points, very well located, clean, hot water,fairly cheap(£70), nice staff. Nice Pub within 10 meteres. Bad points, the room could not be any smaller, the shower/basin/ toilet was a cubicle in the corner of the room.Very small. We had difficulty sleeping due to noise from other rooms in the hotel. Single glazing sash windows did nothing to dull the street noise. We stayed for 3 nights and did not get a good sleep at all. Summary I would spend a bit more to get a better nights sleep. But if you are on a tight budget ? Please note, I did not ask for a quiet room, this may help.

title: Great location - below average service
text: The location is undeniably fantastic. My partner and I wanted to be in the middle of things - that is exactly what we got! 5 mins to marble arch / tube. 5 mins to oxford road. I cannot fault it. It's the other things that made our stay a little bit lack lustre - 1. We weren't allowed to hold I to our key. We had to return our key to the desk every time we left the building, which is slightly unsettling. However, the thing that makes it very unsettling is that every night we came in and said our room number... They would hand us the key without a second thought. Only once did we get asked our names. 2. The room had been smoked in - we are non smokers and the room stank of cigarettes. I asked the gentleman at the desk if we could move and got a "I will see what I can do" - nothing came from it. 3. Location of the room - we were situated next to the toilet. I paid £220 to not sleep and to listen to people slam the door, three nights in a row. Now saying all this - I would stay there again simply on the basis of location. However, if you want a relaxing, sleep-filled stay, I would not recommend this hotel.

title: Friendly people, but...???
text: I had read mixed reviews on another site, but my booking was last minute and it was very hard to find places around Marble Arch at an acceptable rate. So I decided to take the venture, it was for two nights anyway and I would be there to sleep only. The people have done their best, this is not against them. In fact, when I left my things there before I could check in they were quite helpful. But I never will stay there again and will recommend it to no-one. The room was advertized as an en-suite. I know that this is a definition matter, but the room was no more than 3 meters by 3 meters, the bed filled almost all of it, the old fridge on the ground fills the rest. You have to almost crawl over the bed and the fridge to hang up your clothes. The room was in the basement. It had a window... the top half of the window looked on the inner court, which is about 1 by 1 meter. There are other rooms looking onto it but still it looks like a view inside a chimney, and I am afraid that in case of a fire the inner court will perform exactly that function. Maybe the place has been approved by the fire prevention authorities, I can't say it hasn't, but then either there is something wrong with the rules, or the supervision, or with the way they give the guests at least a basic feeling of safety. I have seriously considered to go somewhere else, the reason why I did not was only that I was too tired, and I guessed why would something happen today and not yesterday or the day before. Lousy way to deal with my self-safety, I know, but I guess I am not the only one. Maybe my concerns were not that strange too: one of the lamps above my bed was a ball-shaped with holes in it, with carefully hidden the one side of it that had already melted and deformed. And in the morning an alarm rang that was definitely not the wake-up bell, but nobody seemed to bother. They advertize with a remote control color satellite TV, well a very funny one: the remote control is attached with a wire to a shelf above the bed, hardly useable when laying in bed and you have to move out to switch the TV off manually anyway. The satellite reception, I don't know why but even the BBC reception was like it came from the other side of the world, and all together no more than 12 channels and maybe 1 or 2 AV channels. I read on one site that there is "indirect airco". Well that is the funniest description for an electric fan, standing on the ground against the bed (no idea where or how to put it when you want to use it...) and it is fixed against the wall with a chain, apparently in the fear that guests would take it with them (they will have a hard time to even get it out through the room door!). This room (that's why it was more expensive) has its own "bathroom". A sink, a toilet and the smallest shower cell that I have ever seen crammed into approx. 1.20 meters by 1.20 meters. The shower area is about 3 cm deeper than the rest of the floor, but when taking a shower you need all the extra towels to avoid the whole bathroom and eventually the room getting flooded because the floor is not horizontal. After I arrived I went to the toilet and closed the door but did not lock it, yet I found myself trapped and was afraid to push it way to hard until I could open it again. This place is called a bed & breakfast. Again, also the word breakfast is a matter of definition, but to be honest, my association with a breakfast in England is certainly not to have a little basket placed on the ground outside the room, the mice probably had aten part of that basket, and under the plastic foil there were: a mini-pack of the cheapest of the cheapest orange juice(???), a dito small pack of UHT milk, a little box of cereal, a plastic wrapped croissant (which must have been at least two days old) and a small plastic cup of yoghurt, you know, one that they break off from a tray of six. I did not expect much, but this??? I want to end this review in a positive mood: one very nice feature that I wish other hotels would do is a standard electricity plug adapter in the room. Another positive (and I would say: great) plus for this place is its location. But why, why, why, if you have a property with this potential, in such a nice place, why can't you make something decent out of this? The GBP 65 pound a night that I paid now (but admittedly it included the spectacular breakfast) is grossly overpaid. The management should better refurbish the whole place, reduce the number of rooms by 50%, make a real B&B out of it, that means a real breakfast that you can eat in a real breakfast room etc. and then maybe you can also charge a decent price. But he way it is now, is a low price which is still far, far too much for this place. I am really sorry people, I liked your friendliness, but I honestly feel like this. Only being friendly doesn't make your place a nice accommodation yet.

title: Nice bed and breakfast
text: Spent 4 nights at Marble Arch Inn with my daughter 25.-29. March. We wanted a double room, not expensive, and close to Oxford Street and Hyde Park - and that's what we got. The room was small (as expected), but was clean and nice. The staff was friendly, and we will not hesitate staying there next time we go to London.

title: I will return!
text: The Marble Arch Inn is a little hotel in a wonderful position in London: it's a few minutes of walk by Marble Arch tube station and Hyde Park. I booked this hotel on its website paying in advance but with a discount. Our room was a double room with WC, it was very small but we stayed there 10 nights without feeling smothered. They cleaned the room everyday and changed linens twice a week. Breakfast is included in the price: each evening they give you a basket with yogurt, milk, orange juice, cornflakes, croissant which you can put in the fridge in the room. There is also a coffee/tea maker with tea, coffee and sugar. The staff was very kind and on hand, they give you every kind of information you need. Only one demerit: no soundproofing so you can hear everything, on fridays and saturdays nights above all .

title: Marble Arch Inn
text: Friendly service. If you want a large room then this is not the place to stay. Having said that the room was very clean and fresh towels were provided every day. Location was fantastic. We were close to every place we wanted to visit. There was no disturbance from the traffic in the room we were in and we slept well on both nights in a comfortable bed. Would return again but next time we would book ensuite.

title: Super location, old fashioned victorian building
text: I've stayed at Marble Arch Inn two nights, from 11 to 13th November, and it was a good experience overall. I arrived at the hotel at 10:30 am, after my 06:20 flight from Bologna, Italy, expecting not to be checked in until 13, as listed on the website. Instead, they checked me in at 10:30, and I was so tired for the travel that this definitely made my day. The room was small, really really small, but super clean and since I used it only to sleep it worked perfectly. The staff at the reception desk was amazingly helpful, kind, available for wake up calls, street directions and so on... Price is fair, you get an extraordinary position and a clean room. I had shared bathroom, which is not a problem if you're a bit of adventurous like I am. Overall, very good!

title: Perfect place to stay during weekend trip!
text: Me and my mom went to London for 4 nights and stayed at Marble Arch Inn and really felt like we got alot for our money (260 pound for the room 4 nights) Be aware that the room is VERY small, but we just needed a place near Oxford street with a nice bed and that's exactly what we got! I really liked this hotel! Nice staff and a GREAT location!! Small room but had everything we needed -coffee, zink, dubblebed, towels and a drawer. 2 min walk to Marble Arch / Oxford street ! Milou

title: It was nice, and very friendly
text: Thanks for all our trip was very good and in the hotel everyone were friendly and when help needed, we recieved it , thanks a lot

title: did not provide a warm and friendly hospitality
text: I booked a room in advance and paid £70 for a single room with breakfast. When I tried to check in I was told there was a problem and they had moved me to another nearby hotel. I was taken outside and pointed in the general direction. No-one escorted me to the alternative hotel

title: Terrible stay, almost no sleep for four nights...
text: Stayed at this place four nights in July. It was terrible! Got a room at the third floor, no lifts, no air-condition only a fan on the wall. Was much hotter in the tiny little room than outside. And the beds was the worst I have ever tried. Very hard and uncomfortable. So very little sleep these nights. The receptionist was not very helpful looked like they did not want to be there. Will not be returning. And though I check the news on the TV, but I didn't know they where making that small TVs anymore, why choose a small TV when recently upgraded? The only upside are that it is central, but I'm shure there are better central hotels...

title: Hotel or B&B!!!!
text: This is by far the worst B&B (not a hotel) I have stayed. Poor staff (who do not seem a bit interested in customer service or indeed smiling). Breakfast is a joke and very poor. I would not recommend it to anyone.

title: Great location, but a 2 star hotel
text: The Marble Arch Inn is ideally located and cheaply priced. If your looking to stay at a convenient location in London on a budget, this is the place to stay. It's only a couple of minutes walk from Hyde Park and Oxford Street, and a short taxi ride away from the West End. That's why I am giving this 2 star hotel 3/5. Do bear in mind though, this is a 2 star hotel. Many rooms have shared toilet and shower rooms, and our room (which was on the ground floor) smelt very damp. The room was clean though. We only stayed for two nights and the room was turned over on the second day. The rooms have tea and coffee making facilities as well. The staff are very helpful, and will gladly book a taxi for you.

title: Suitable for a Weekend visit, or overnight stay
text: First impressions were good. The desk staff were very helpful, then we went down to the room in the basement. As other people have mentioned, the room was small but it was only to sleep in. The shower/toilet room was amazingly small with the cistern loose on the wall. The window faced another and the room was unusually hot, their was a fan. Tea & coffee making facilities, fan and hair drier (4 sockets were very useful). Located within easy walking distance to the tube and a Mcdonalds for fast food and some nice coffee shops and restaurants. WiFi would not work.

title: Great location
text: Very well located hotel. Minutes away from Marble Arch & Oxford Street. Ideal for shopping trips as it's only a few minutes away and one may offload bags and return to the shops for more shopping. Decor is quite ppor but hotel was very clean, spotless showers. Small rooms. We had a room on ground floor, I would never stay at ground floor again if I had to re visit. Night receptionist is hopeless. He watches TV in the reception area with very loud volume all night long and knows nothing about online bookings, keeps saying that he can't help with train bookings or attraction bookings but the lady working during the day is very helpful. Our room was just whitewashed when we arrived so, for the first day/night, it smelled of fresh paint. But on the whole, it's agood budget hotel.

title: Not a enjoyable experience!
text: Spent one night here and would definitely not want to spend anymore time here. I know you get what you pay and I wasn't expecting anything amazing but I wouldn't even call it good enough to be a 2* hotel. The room was small, cramp, claustrophobic and basic. The bed was hard and uncomfortable. The receptionist was rude, miserable and looked like they did not want to be their. Will not be returning.

title: Horrible
text: Stayed at the Marble Arch for 1 night had booked in for 2. I understand that paying 70 pounds a night you dont expect alot, but there should be a small standard. Staff are unfirendly and sour. Room that I stayed in was the pits-was in the basement, had a window that opened onto a tiny cement square that was filled with bird poo and cigarette butts. Rooms were not clean nor were sheets. Bathroom was a complete disaster and was always covered in water from the toilet I suspected. Did not want to use the bathroom it was so bad, bed was pushed up against the heating system-great fire hazard!! Breakfast room was under construction, so breakfast was shoved at you in a bowl at your arrival. Could not wait to get out of there. Never again.

title: Nice, pretty much as advertised
text: Small rooms, shower & toilet but all big enough for their purpose. The place was clean. Staff friendly, location great. The beds were comfortable and clean, fridge was handy and breakfast was sufficient. A bit above my budget at 39pound a night, but I would stay there again if I could get a good rate.
