The rooms are incredible posh and well-maintained the staff and service is unbeatable. The hotel is also located on a dead-end street so it is extremely quiet with no traffic on the street.

title: We absolutely loved this hotel!
text: We just returned from a four night stay at the St. James. We were just thrilled with the outstanding service and accommodations. From the time they picked us up at the airport to the time we checked out they could not do enough to make our stay enjoyable. The staff was friendly and helpful. The rooms seemed really new with great features like flat screen TV's, wireless internet and beautiful decor. We definitely felt like we got our money's worth by staying at the St. James. Highly recommended for anyone traveling to London.

title: Simply stunning
text: Great location. Great service. Nice suite. And most comfortable beds/pillows! Will most definitely be back when next in the UK.

title: Superb Hotel and staff but a small improvement needed
text: We stayed at St James's a few years ago and enjoyed the experience. This time it was our 33rd wedding aniversary over the weekend of 2nd and 3rd September. As I had business in London the day before I booked an extra night having booked a Junior Suite through SLH I went direct as they didnt have any capacity. The staff were very helpful and although I arrived early on the 1st I could sit in the lounge and read the papers. They upgraded us from a Junior Suite to a Delux Suite as we were there 3 nights and it was very nice. No complaints about the room itself though there were a couple of minor issues. First issue is that nearly all top hotels do not provide tea and coffee making facilities in the room. This is a serious ommision for the British traveller and seems odd as Premier Inn and Travelodge do! My lady wife was arriving later and I asked for a kettle, some tea and milk to be put in the room for her arrival as I had some business to attend to. No problem - except only one cup (two people in the room should have given a clue). The following day, after we had gone out for the day the room had been done but the cups had been taken away and no milk had been left. We rang and got the cups but were charged £5 for a jug of milk - not sure that is acceptable (afterwards we bought a small bottle from the M&S food shop nearby). Its a small improvement but this should be standard in all UK based hotels especially the top level ones. the 2nd issue, which wasnt the hotels fault is that our room (403) overlooked the entrance to the Royal OverSeas League building - they had a wedding on the Saturday night but the bottle bank is right underneath the bedroom window and from 12:30 to 02:00 they filled the bank 5 times! Not the hotels fault but guests need to be warned. All that said, we enjoyed the stay and the staff were very friendly and helpful throughout and I would recommend this to friends - just make sure you put tea making facilities in the room!!

title: Another great stay
text: Another short, but great stay at this hotel. We really enjoy the location of this hotel and the fine service they provide. Close to Green Park and Piccadilly St. Very comfy beds with great AC in the room(very hot during our stay). Our visit was too short, we hope to come back soon.

title: A suite stay
text: The staff is outstanding-- warm, friendly and helpful. The location is perfect- walking distance to theaters, shops and sights. On previous visits suffered the lovely but tiny rooms, so this time opted for a comfortable suite. Worth the extra cost.

title: So British
text: This is such a great hotel! Staring with the front door man, he was amazing, such a character!!! We stayed in a great family room on the ground floor. 2 double rooms, 2 bathrooms, family lounge area and room for a roll away bed. The beds are huge and comfortable. The shower/bath was a little tricky to use, some days it was tricky getting hot water. A tv in the bathroom, if only i knew how it worked!! High tea the afternoon we arrived was a treat, yummy cakes and sandwiches. Lucia makes amazing cocktails, our family loved her! The staff are very friendly, at the end of each day they always wanted to know what we got up to. The hotel is very close to Piccadilly and Green Park tube station, a very quick taxi ride to Oxford Street. A very quiet location, in a dead end street so there is no street traffic! I heard the top floor suites have great views, maybe next time for me?

title: Best
text: The best combination the price-quality-location The hotel is situated in the center, close to Piccadilly, the Royal Palace, Harrods, Selfridges, Hyde Park. All within walking distance. The hotel is newly repaired. Good Breakfast and service. We arrived early check-in, tired, wishing urgently to go into the shower, the hotel Manager helped us settle into the room early, although the hotel was fully booked

title: Perfect location and luxurious
text: Picked this for jos 50th birthday special treat, great reception lovely welcome, got full tour of the room. Deluxe room, reasonable size, huge bed, luxurious bedding and good facilities. No iron but pressing ng service available if required. 10 minutes walk to her majesty theatre for phantom and same for mint leaf, close to the Ritz and the kings man tailors. Bar staff And concierge we’re fabulous.

title: Great location, wonderful service, and an amazing nights sleep
text: The hotel is a 5 minute walk from piccadilly circus and right near all the best shops, but it's location on a side street made it possible to sleep soundly. The staff is polite and very helpful, and the beds are absolutely divine. Overall a wonderful stay, the only downside is the light that shines through the vents above the room doorway is annoying when you're trying to sleep.

title: Good location
text: Nice enough hotel, with friendly staff. Room was quiet although our view was the hotel entrance! Aircon and bed comfortable. Wifi was unbearably slow and unusable. Had free gym access but the gym was a 10 minute walk away. Didn't eat here, but overall a comfortable stay in central London.

title: Wonderfully Speechless!
text: Now for me, that is hard to say! Not many places can take my words away but THIS place takes the cake. This was the final hotel stay on our month tour of England/France and it was purely and simply THE BEST! From the plush room to the locations to the concierge that REALLY can get you anything you want (I needed tickets for the next night to Les Mis and he delivered) including recommending a local indian restaurant that the true Londoners go to (blew my sons mind as hes a picky eater)... I cannot wait to come back to this hotel again!

title: Good location
text: We stayed here for 4 nights. Breakfast was included and had a variety of cereal, breads, cheeses,ham,coffee etc. The room was on the small side. There was only room for one suitcase, we used the chair for the other one, it was too uncomfortable to sit on and needs replacing. The bed also needs replacing but was adequate however the sheets did not fit the bed properly and slipped down. The bathroom was small however if there were more hooks to hang things it would help. The stairs are narrow and not good if you have any problems with knees or mobility and made lugging suitcases up quite difficult. The staff were pleasant and courteous and the location was good, that is why I gave a better rating.

title: Disappointment
text: I choose this hotel becouse it was well located near Victoria Station. Officialy it has 4 *. However in our rooms located in the lowest level of basement had windows which cannot be opened , the air conditioning didn't work. No way to take breath! It was a horrible night. Breakfast was very poor. In breakfast room was only 7 tables so we had to wait 1/2 hour to have a seat! I don't recommend this hotel

title: Great hotel
text: We were very impressed with our stay here. The hotel is close to a lot of things. The room is a bit small but very comfortable. It was hot while we were there so we enjoyed the AC. Good variety for breakfast

title: Highend Hostel?
text: I have no idea why this location would have such high ratings. Now, understand, you are traveling and in London, so prices will be high and expectations should be low. I selected this hotel because of the location. We needed to be close to the tour we were on (Golden Tour) and the train station. This fit that bill. Within walking distance from both the tour location and Victoria station, is about the only thing the hotel had going for it (besides the staff). Upon arrival, we soon realized there were no elevators and having traveled for 10 days, we had some baggage to lug. There was a gentlemen present to help with the luggage, but once we go to the room, we soon realized there was not enough space for the three of us and our bags! The pictures shared by others are factual, but do not present that what you see is all there is. The internet was sketchy and inconsistent, the bed and pillows were nothing to write about and I could barely get into the shower A N D close the door. It is not a horrible place, it was clean and all the facilities functioned, but do not think you are walking into something more than a hostel.

title: Average, but great location
text: Stayed April 2014 for 2 nights on business. Room was OK, though bed a bit soft and lumpy for my liking. Breakfast simple but OK, though the reception area where it was served was small and a bit crowded. This is a great part of town and a lovely street. But there are better hotels in the same street in my view!

title: Excellent
text: Well located hotel with easy access to transport. 5 minutes from from Victoria rail and underground and Victoria Coach station. The reception staff were very efficient, polite and welcoming. A free room upgrade was also given. A rarity nowadays was a porter to take your luggage to your room. Nice touch and very welcome. The room was a good size, very clean with great facilities. Free bottled water and also a free non alcoholic mini bar of canned drinks. Tea and coffee and biscuits were available in room. The bathroom was spacious, immaculately clean and well appointed. The bed was very comfortable and the room serviced daily. We didn't use the free breakfast provided. A great choice for a stay in London at a great price, but the icing on the cake were the great staff. Many thanks to you all.

title: A little disappointing
text: At first glance we thought this hotel was lovely, however after we returned from our evening and had a proper look we realised all the problems. The bed head had questionable marks all over it...I don't even want to think what it was! Marks on the walls. Mark in the bath tub. The bed had a big dip in it along on edge, like it was broken. No towel rail in the bathroom and a terrible noise from the generator most of the night. The breakfast was a little poor and a bit limited. However there was a few good points about the hotel, the location is brilliant only a few minutes walk from Victoria station and the soap, razor, tooth brush etc in the bathroom, were nicely packaged.

title: Great place!
text: Lovely place to stay. Nice showers, breakfast that made you full, great location. Most of the staff was very friendly to us. The WiFi was horrible in the rooms, but we managed to get it to work in the reception.

title: Sensational Location, very good service, nice hotel
text: We stayed in the Park Avenue Belgravia after a short cruise with Cunard's Queen Elizabeth and found it very nice, clean and a good value for money. The hotel is located 3 minutes walk from the Victoria station bus terminal and only about 7-10minutes from Victoria train station. The hotel looks like a typical local town house and you have the feeling of entering a friend's house when getting there the first time. Staff at reception was friendly and were going above and beyond our expectations. As all rooms are located on different levels you have to be careful and advise at time of booking if you have any issues with climbing stairs. The rooms are rather small in comparison with other hotel rooms in Continental Europe but for London they okay in size. Rooms are very nice and stylish with a very comfortable bed, flatscreen and a small but very stylish bathroom as well. Breakfast was good and was included in the room rate. But best is and I know that I am repeating myself: the location. Not only that Victoria train and bus station are within a short walking distance you are also just minutes away from theatres, shops and restaurants. And even Buckingham Palace can be reached within a short and nice short walk. We will definitely return when we are in London the next time.

title: Exception and helpful service!
text: We were really grateful for the service shown by the team at Astors Belgravia, they were super accommodating and went above and beyond. We had a problem come up in our trip and they were very helpful in offering us a deal!

title: Friendly, clean and enjoyable
text: Very clean room and hotel, friendly professional staff, excellent facilities in the room, breakfast was adequate, perfect quiet location for visiting London. I would visit this hotel

title: Good Value Hotel for London
text: Recently spent two nights at this hotel near Victoria Station. Hotel was clean and comfortable and breakfast was adequate. No elevator and narrow stairs. For its location and price it is not a bad choice. Walking distance to Buckingham Palace.

title: Staying at Astors Belgrsavia
text: I stayed 4 nights at Astors Belgravia. The hotel is very clean, breakfast is good, although one and the same everyday. People working at the reception and breakfast area are very kind. Ladies cleaning the rooms a doing great job! There are 2 things which I didn't like - there is no lift at the property and the stairs are too narrow and when you leave your suitcases at the storage room after checking off, they charge you 2 GBP per case /although the hotel is not cheap at all/. Its a shame! I travel a lot and never happened to me before anywhere in the world!

title: Tired looking B&B
text: This place didn't live up to the website description. It isn't a hotel but a B&B. I paid extra for a Club room bit it was still very tired looking. The water didn't drain from the shower tray, the shower caddy was hanging off the wall, the curtains were dirty and, oddly, the cold water ran hot!! You can hear every creak in the staircase and the room above. The desk seat was so worn that you couldn't sit in it. Traffic noise is an issue Breakfast is average. Location is good though Won't be coming back

title: Its OK and had a nice weekend
text: This is a budget hotel and so one should not expect to receive 5* accommodation. We had a room on the ground floor that quite suited our needs for a two day stay. Yes, when on the first morning we heard them getting breakfast ready and rustling around, we had places to go so it never mattered. Location wise if you travel by Bus or Train it is a great location and anything else depends what you expect to receive. Room was tired but comfortable, staff were welcoming, all the rest is make it what you need for your own trip if it suits? It suited us and speak to other people at breakfast for unless you need a 'full English everything is there'.

title: Astors Hotel
text: I really liked staying in Astors Hotel, everyone was really nice, it was verry clean, great breakfast and close to Victoria station wich was also great. The only two thing that me and my friend yhought were not as great, are the beds and you can hear everything from the hallway. Wich is not really wierd in these kind of buildings. But if your a light sleeper it can be A bit difficult to get some sleep sometimes.

title: Overall good location
text: Overall good location to go and visit London, I didn't have time to be in the hotel, just to sleep and have breakfast. They could improve on the breakfast by having an options on gluten free, the bed was to soft for my liking.

title: Very close to Victoria Station
text: We were in and out of London through Victoria Station so we needed a close hotel to dump the bags (in) and leave the bags (out). We had 40 minutes to get back from Royal Albert Hall, collect our bags and get the train. This was the ticket

title: great value, great location
text: We stayed here having booked the 3 star sister hotel Victoria Inn for £84 inc breakfast but then were transfered to this sister hotel. I usally book 5 star wherever I stay in the world but due to a change in circumstances I couldn't justify the cost & so took the plunge after checking trip advisor. I never experienced the Victoria Inn but I was extremely impressed by this hotel. It was very clean, the staff were friendly, particularly the lady who helps with breakfast & yes the rooms are small but perfectly adequate for what they are designed for. I felt I got fabulous value for money & I wouldnt hesitate staying here again, I will be recommending this lovely boutique hotel as a great affordable higher end budget place to stay. Rather here anyday than a chain budget hotels. And great location, the wine bar across the road is just wonderful too.

title: Fantastic price for location
text: Took the National Express to London Victoria coach station, walked around the corner and found the Astors Hotel, Belgravia. and Wow were we please with it, we certainly were, great location for both Victoria coach and Victoria train stations. Our room was clean and comfortable and the breakfast was "user" friendly. TKY

title: London in June
text: Nice hotel on a quiet street, close to Victoria station. Clean rooms and you didn’t notice any noice from other customers. If you like to walk it is the perfect location, easy to grab a bus if you’re getting tired.

title: Comfortable with a good location
text: Very friendly and helpful staff, without exception! Very good rooms and a good breakfast buffet. It's location which is very close to Victoria coach station, train station and underground was a real bonus as I needed to use the coach terminal as well as inter city trains. The only downside was the very poor internet access.

title: Enough
text: Single room enough for a short stay in London. Staff is polite , 4 blocks from Victoria station, breakfast is small but OK, WiFi works even in the basement rooms, Reserved through Booking.com at a good rate, will return next year, it's enough to stay the night, and it's easy to walk around for restaurants & bars and transportation. Single rooms in the basement are difficult since stairs are too narrow, not recommended for handicapped, but there are other rooms

title: Service was the Best
text: Our room was a tad small for western standards, However their shower and bathroom were terrific! breakfast had a variety of healthy choices, loved the cereal, yoghurt danishes and bread cheese and ham selection and their Cafe Laite in the mornings were fantastic. We had a front room with windows that opened which was nice. The reception folks were terrific in helping me access computer and printers for my boarding pass. Nice hotel in a very central location to victoria station and restaurants

title: A one night stay in London
text: My sister, brother in law,brother myself and my partner stayed in the hotel for one night as we were meeting our cousins from Montreal who were staying in London for a few days. The hotel was very close to Victoria coach station as we travelled by the mega bus this was very convenient, it is also not far from Buckingham palace restaurants and other attractions. On arrival we were greeted by the receptionist by have you got photo identification to my partner as it was his name the booking was made. When he said he didn't have anything other than his bank card to show his identity she was not happy for us to book in, bare in mind we had paid in full three weeks earlier and this had not been mentioned whilst booking, I showed my driving license which clearly had my photograph on it but as we are not married and don't have the same surname this was not good enough this went on for a little while until I lost my cool and said what you saying we cannot stay here and I have wasted my money. She then changed all together and gave us our room numbers so cannot understand the fuss In the first place maybe it's because we booked through another site not direct. Otherwise the hotel was clean if you have problems with mobility this hotel is not for you as there are stairs to most rooms which are very tight and steep and there are no lifts on site rooms are compact. The stay was ok but we were put off by what happened when we checked in.

title: Great Location
text: This hotel is so close to everything. Handy to Victoria Coach station, around the corner from car hire firms, Avis, Hertz etc. Close to Buckingham Palace and other tourist attractions, and the metro to get about easily in London. Rooms are clean, beds are good, shower was hot and strong, good continental breakfast, no noise at night from either inside or outside the hotel. Staff extremely friendly and helpful. Great stay once again.

title: Pretty good
text: Overall a pleasant stay Pros - Excellent location, close to Victoria Coach/Rail/Underground, Hyde Park, and all the posh stuff - Very nice shower room - Comfortable bed - Staff are good Cons - Door can't be bolted from inside - Windows don't lock shut - Breakfast a little disappointing - mostly tinned and packaged food - Internet hardly ever worked

title: Wife's birthday
text: Booked this hotel because it's great location,only a 10 min walk to apollo theatre, stayed the one night only but staff where very friendly and helpful, would definitely book again, comfortable bed and a great selection of biscuits.

title: Nice stay very close to Victoria Station
text: Very good location close to Victoria station which makes it very convenient to visit London. Nice rooms, clean and well furnished. The reception is very friendly and helpful. Quiet area. Only the breakfast is a bit short of expectations.

title: Great location
text: We loved this hotel! The location is perfect- close to the tube and train station and walking distance to Buckingham Palace! The rooms are small, but they have everything you need and ours was very clean. FYI.. no elevator! The hotel staff are very nice and accommodating and breakfast in the morning is sufficient. I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Great Service, good location
text: The Hotel staff was very friendly and helpful. They helped us with everything we needed. The Suite was big enough for us (3 Persons). Air-conditioner was a bit smelly but apart from that all was good.

title: Average hotel, good location
text: A 20 minute check in wait followed by a visit to our basement level room next to a loud lift and some sort of unit outside the window. The shower head was just below shoulder height, and the shower screen was about 18 inches wide meaning water went all over the bathroom. On the plus side, very comfy bed and in s great location. 5 minute walk to Victoria station.

title: Excellent stay
text: Great location. Close to Victoria, Knightsbridge, Oxford Circus. Excellent rooms and bathroom facilities. Beds and showers are especially good. Very clean hotel. Staff are very welcoming and helpful. Will definitely stay here again.

title: A clean & tidy hotel with lovely staff close to Victoria train & coach stations
text: A clean hotel near to both Victoria train and coach stations offering fairly priced accommodation and a fresh continental breakfast in the morning. The staff are all happy to help and really welcoming. Worth staying here if in the area.

title: Overnight stay
text: Stayed here for 1 night with my teenage daughter for a show at the Victoria theatre. Fantastic location and very friendly staff. Only negative was the room was very small. This wouldn’t put me off booking again though.

title: Nice hotel
text: Excellent location, just few minutes from Victoria station. Tiny rooms, but very clean. Helpful and friendly service, very good continental breakfast. If and when we go back to London, we'll be going to stay in this hotel.

title: Visit to London
text: On arrival the lady at reception checked our booking details and identification and promptly booked us in. We were then made aware of the breakfast times, after this she called a porter who showed us to our room and carried our cases, this seemed to be the normal routine, possibly because there is no lift. Once in the room, which was spotlessly clean, we found the facilities were adequate for our needs.

title: Great Hotel with Friendly Welcoming Staff
text: We stayed in the hotel this weekend for Last Night of the Proms in Hyde Park and we were very pleased with our stay overall. The staff were very friendly and welcoming from the minute we set foot inside. As we arrived early (11am) our rooms were not ready, which we weren't expecting anyway as check in was after 2pm, and they kindly labelled up and kept our bags for us. The rooms were small, but we have come to expect that staying in London. That said the room was decorated in a very modern and tasteful style, the bathroom particularly was very nice. It was extremely clean and tidy. I would flag up though that the stairs are narrow and steep, it wasn't particularly an issue for us, but if you have any difficulty walking or doing stairs I would suggest avoiding this hotel as there did not appear to be a lift. The attendant from reception did help us with our bags and carried some of them up to the room and showed us personally to our room which was a lovely touch. Breakfast in the morning did not have a huge choice, but what they did have was fine and tasted good. It was a little cramped for space at breakfast, a couple more people and they would have had a queue... but we didn't mind and staff again where very friendly wishing everyone a good day as they left. Location was great, 5 minute walk from Victoria Station. Lots of lovely cafes to choose from close by. It was about 10/15minute walk to Hyde Park which is what we needed for the proms. We would say that it did feel more of a posh B&B set up rather than a hotel due to the small size. Overall great stay and would be happy to stay there again.

title: Decent Little Place
text: After reading the other reviews to set our expectations, my husband & I decided to book 3 nights for late May. The location is great! Easy walking distance to Victoria Station, Buckingham Palace, etc & the price, considering the exchange rate, was not too bad. Upon arrival, we were greeted by Marco, the friendly owner, who showed us to our room on the main floor/street level at the front of the house, I think it was number 11 (and gave us some sight-seeing advice). Double bed, small TV, plenty of closet space, TINY bathroom which served its purpose, but would have been helpful to have a little shelf in there for our toiletries. The carpets were a little worn, but everything was relatively clean and in working order. We've been in Europe before and knew the room would be small which honestly, is fine since we didn't spend much time there! The breakfast was good - cereal, packaged baked goods, fresh fruit, coffee/tea/juice - plenty to get you on your way. Marco was readily available every morning to answer questions & offer suggestions for sight-seeing & transportation. Overall, a great place - just be realistic with your expectations.

title: Nice location, room a bit small
text: Nice location, room a bit small. Close to public transport, Service and breakfast very well, enough choices . Only the room was a bit small for 2 persons: 10m2, the bed was also a bit small for 2 persons and too soft, very small bathroom.

title: small room
text: hotel is in a very good place nea Victoria station and Buckingham Palace. Our room for 3 persons was really too small !!!!! Breakfast could be batter ! Room well cleaned .Hotel has 3 entances and this is not really very confortable.

title: Very good
text: This is an excellent little hotel in the heart of Belgravia. Great service and brilliant restaurant called Sicily recommendation.. near good coffee shops and easy to get to and from. Great stay thank you!I loved my stay thank you guys !

title: Birthday treat
text: We stayed at Park Avenue Belgravia for one night on Friday 14th June. My husband had booked it as a surprise stay as we had a theatre trip booked for that evening. It is in a very clean and safe area. We were shown to our room by a member of staff after checking in. Our room was in the basement and was pretty small although the decoration was just as looks in the pictures. As ours was a short visit the size of the room wasnt too much of an issue. I found the bed comfortable (i'm 5ft 3in) my husband didn't (he's 6ft) and his feet hung over the end. Breakfast was fine and was what we expected for a continental. Whilst there we had to ask for a different remote for the tv as ours didn't work, bedside lamps did not work and toilet seat was not fixed to toilet, we did report this to the male receptionist on way out who i must say was very polite.

title: 5 days in London with my 10 yr son
text: Perfect location, clean rooms with friendly staff. A bit with paperwalls so noices in the hall way is very obvious. Breakfast is mainly based on bread, so if you are a non bread/non cereal person it is a bit limited. But all in all a very good experience.

title: OK Hotel, nothing to write home about
text: Stayed here on a business visit to London where I needed to be in the Victoria area. This hotel has a great location. The staff are good. I was given a disabled room on the ground floor. The room was small, but clean and comfortable. The on suite good also, although the shower was somewhat tucked into a corner when there was loads of room to have more sensibly located. In London you expect some outside noise, especially in a converted house as this was. What you do not expect is inconsiderate night staff making an ungodly noise in their filing cupboard outside of my room at 4.00am!!!! Just remember, you are selling sleep!!!

title: Never book one room for 3 people
text: Pros: 1. Location! 2. Location! 3. Location! Yes, that's all the pros I could find in this hotel. Cons: 1. Extremely small room for 3 people, but charged quite much extra for the third person. We booked through hotel.ca which listed that either a room with a double bed + sofa bed or 3 single bed room is available... So we chose the 3 single bed option. When we got to the hotel, we were told that there was no such room in the hotel. Basically, the sofa bed was right outside the washroom and placed really close to the double bed. We could hardly walk to the double bed and the washroom door could only be half opened for us to slip in. 2. No lift. We had to lug our 2 suitcases up and down 3 flights of stairs. Not fun. 3. Extremely basic hotel with no free wifi, low ceiling (I'd say about 7 ft ceiling), and need some update (washroom, carpet etc) for sure. All in all, it's a ok choice if you just plan to shower and sleep there. Never book one room for 3 people at this hotel though. If I'd known the room configuration ahead of time, I would definitely not book it for such a price!

title: Nice for two!
text: Perfect location, nice area. Only 5-10 minuts from Victoria. Friendly staff, very clean Hotel:)The breakfast is what it is, Continental but okay, missed scrambled eggs though. Great value for what you paid!

title: Good for short stays but not long stays
text: The staffs were generally all friendly and helpful, except for the female receptionist. She has a perpetually black face on all the time, no thank you, no please. And I wonder why she still kept her job if she was unhappy. The room has air-conditioning, but it doesnt work in cooling the room. I had asked for a fan, but the (same grumpy) female receptionist told me she can only give it to me next morning? Why would I need a fan in the morning on my check-out day? Moreover I was living on the highest level, so the room was really warm. The hotel should have anticipated this well enough and prepared enough fans to distribute, especially to those living on the high levels. The location of the hotel wasn't exactly near to Victoria tube, at least 10 mins walk. The housekeeping is slow. I had requested for housekeeping on my second day. I came back to my room at 2.30pm, nothing was done. Overall, the hotel is good for short stays of 1-3 nights, but if you are looking to stay longer, I suggest to look elsewhere.

title: Clean, friendly and great location.
text: I stayed here for two nights on a business trip and was very pleased. The hotel is located 5 min walk from Victoria station and is ideal for short breaks. The rooms are well furnished, clean however like most London rooms on the small side. The hotel serves a basics breakfast offering mainly cold food however there are scrambled eggs and beans. The staff are very friendly and there is also a luggage storage room so you don't have to carry bags around once you have checked out. Overall a very good hotel which is ideal for short breaks or business trips.

title: Stay was so so
text: We booked this facility cos it was centrally located. And yes it was. But the rooms are very small and little cramped for family stay. The breakfast had only cold breakfast and nothing hot except coffee and tea. Most of the staff was cordial which was a good thing.

title: Very Basic Hotel
text: My daughter and myself went to London, for a business trip. Being Wimbledon all rooms seemed to have been taken. The prices had rocketed so for one night it was £173 pounds. MostHotels did not provide Breakfast so it was it was nice to have some basic food. On arrival we were late. The Hotel did not serve food We then had to go up six flights of stairs, They had no lift.. The receptionist was Indian, I think that the Hotel was run by Indians. Not what We expected. The room was small but clean. The curtains did not close and the light shone through all night. The bath room was small. But clean. I have stayed in worse Hotels. If you are desperate for a room in London, go for it. Otherwise go on trip adviser and read peoples re views.

title: Best value for money
text: On our trip to the UK, we planned a week in London and then a couple of nights in Edinburgh and then one last night in London before flying home to Manila. We booked Park Avenue Belgravia even if there weren't any reviews yet at the time because it was the best price for the area that we wanted. A few minutes walk from Victoria underground and coach stations. We took an express room to save on money. It was below ground and very small and you can hardly move inside the shower, but it was clean, had everything we needed and we got free wifi in our room! Breakfast also comes with the room. Only continental but still better than nothing. When we came back in early November for our last night in London, they took forever checking us in. We waited over an hour. But when we finally got our room, they gave us a large one for the price of an express. It made it much easier for us to pack for the long trip home, but the free wifi from the lobby didn't reach our room this time. But still, very reasonable and the staff was friendly, and if we ever go back, we would definitely stay here again.

title: average breakfast but good location
text: breakfast was just average, the room we stayed was on the 1st floor which was not sound proof, you can hear the cutlery from the canteen. location is good just 5-10 minutes walk from Victoria station and hyde park, staff are friendly.

title: Comfortable
text: Nice little hotel just nearby Victoria station. Easy to come and go to the airport Gatwick. Breakfast was delightfully light, although we would like to have fresh vegetables like tomatoes and cucumber

title: Very good
text: Be aware there is no lift, but staff will help with baggage. Room was compact but comfortable. Clean towels, soap and shampoo every day. No problem with noise at nighttime, but could hear the aircraft approaching the airport from about 4.30 in the morning.

title: Nice hotel, good location
text: Hotel was nice and clean, compared to room price it was was very good. Breakfast was quite modest, no warm dishes or green topping to bread, but anyway you can have full stomach. Location is great. The area is is quiet even you can walk to Victoria station in couple of minutes.

title: Great value of price
text: Hotelroom was quite small and ceiling low, we stayed there 3nights (3 of us). The breakfast was good surprise, im picky and i had my stomach full. Fruits, cornflakes, toast, coffeemachine etc. There is no elevator in the hotel and the stairs is really narrow (had a bit problem carrying the suitcase to the top floor, but friendly staff helped us). The location is great, only quick walk to the victoria metro/train station.

title: Great Budget Hotel
text: Great hotel for their location. We spent 480euros for 4 nights as a young couple. The position is great, you're in the middle on the zone 1, right next Victoria Station. Our room was located downstairs, which was very tiny and noisy. The bed was really confy, but we ended up being awoken every morning for the noise upstairs made by people who where having an early breakfast. Probably room upstairs are better, anyway for what we payed the place was perfect, very clean and with breakfast included, which was a bit limited in choice but better than nothing. I would definetely reccomend this hotel if you want your privacy (aka private bathroom) not spending too much!

title: Great location and value
text: Great location surrounded by a vast amount of patisseries and close to Victoria train station! This central hotel is a fantastic base for any couple who want to experience all of London and not stay in the hotel the whole time. The breakfast is substantial and there is enough variety to please everyone.

title: We came from the deserts of Namibia to a London Hotel with No Water
text: The location and the staff were friendly. But the water to our room was cut off and whilst we were told it was getting fixed we left at 11am the next day without having been able to have a shower or flush the toilet. It would have been nice if they could have made a plan as it was our last night in the UK from Namibia and the price was very high for us. Even in Namibia our hotels have water.

title: Great location, poor breakfast
text: The location is great! The tube and bus station is just around the corner. There is a small shopping mall, grocery store and lots of places to eat nearby. Neighbourhood is very nice and quiet and you can spot luxury cars easily.On the downside, breakfast was terrible. There is quite a little where to choose from. There is nothing hot served, like scrambled eggs. Coffee machine made awful Coffee and there is no fresh Coffee served.Cleaning every day is a nice thing though the cleaning should be done much better. Our rooms curtains and bed sheets were dirty and stained and they stayed that way the whole holiday. By the looks of the stains, those fabrics have seen quite a many quests.

title: A gem
text: Very nice place to stay. Walking distance from the Tube and to Victoria Station. Let us leave our luggage while we went sight seeing. Can walk to major sights but might be long for some. Room was neat and clean with roll away bed set up when we arrived. Room is small by American standards but location and friendly neighborhood made up for it.

title: comfortable stay in a good location
text: Excellent location, walking distance to Victoria Station(10 mins), pleasant and quiet area of the city and easy to access all other areas of city. The staff were always very friendly and helpful. For London, in comparison to other hotels which we considered, this accomodation was very good value for money. The breakfast was simple but a well organised continental breakfast. The rooms were decorated to a high standard but one of our two bedrooms was slightly small on size, which I'm aware is normal for many London Hotels. Would recommend this hotel to family and friends.

title: Great location.
text: Very nice small hotel in a great location. Very friendly staff, all non British. Nice clean room facing the street but very quiet. Good buffet continental breakfast in a lovely bright lounge. Location perfect for Chelsea Flower Show. Lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Very safe area at all times of the day. Highly recommended.

title: The best hotel and location in London
text: Really nice hotel, centrally located (near Victoria) and in a beautiful area of London. The rooms are renovated, confortable and clean. The breakfast is simple but good quality. The staff is friendly. There is no lift but they helped us with the luggage so no problem. I will go back!

title: Great Location but poor WIFI
text: We stayed at Park Avenue, Belgravia for 7 nights in early August. We got the room at a good rate which is definitely not the norm for this part of town. I think all the hotels dropped their prices significantly after the Olympics began as they realised the expected vacancy rates were not coming to fruition. After our flight arrived from Australia in the early morning, we attempted to check in early however the room was not available. We were however give some face towels and a toilet with basin to freshen up before leaving our bags and departing for the day. The best thing about this hotel is the location and it's proximity to Victoria rail, tube and bus stations. It is also 10 mins walking distance to Buckingham Palace and The Mall. Breakfast was nice, however after a few days straight it does tend to get a little boring. The WIFI was horrible, we were on the second floor and it was in and out for the whole week which made it extremely frustrating to use. All in all it was a nice hotel in a great location.

title: Suffocated in a Room with no Ventilation
text: Before my check-in for a 10-night stay, the front-desk manager asked if I had any problems with one of their basement rooms that had an air conditioner that was not working well. I said for the September climate, it would not be a major problem. During my first night, I had a terrible time because the outside temperature was close to 30 degrees and if I open the window, the noise would be unbearable. The next morning, I asked the front-desk manager for a different room as I was staying for a long time. The East Indian Manager refused because I agreed with that room earlier. I said, there is a major difference between an AC what was not working well and not working at all. Finally, with a major concession, she finally agreed to switch a room for me. While the hotel facility is good, but their staff is poor. Not only they always providing wrong information on most frequent questions such as normal cab fare to the Victoria Railway Station. The staff believe the less you ask the better because they simply don't want to be troubled. They probably never care. While the hotel owner invested a lot on its facilities, yet its staff are doing the utmost to destroy its image. The bedside lights do not work and I suppose their staff never bordered to find out.

title: Harry Potters room
text: Stayed last night in the smallest room in a cellar under the stairs, I felt like Harry Potter. The staff on reception had no idea suggesting I had no booking but had evidence from booking.com.After 15 minutes they decided to check me in and would not transfer my room. Very expensive, no bar only continental breakfast.

title: Great value
text: I was pleasantly surprised as I had paid a last minute rate which was very reasonable for London. I arrived with a large suitcase because I was travelling to Gatwick the following morning and was in London for a party the night I stayed. The receptionist kindly gave me a ground floor room so I didn't have to carry my case upstairs. The bed was very comfortable and I managed to get a table for breakfast. Yes, the dining area is congested but breakfast was continuously stocked and had a good choice. The carpet in my room could do with being replaced but it would certainly not put me off using this charming hotel again. Value for money - don't expect 5 star when paying such a reasonable tarif. Staff charming and helpful and a great location.

title: Haig
text: Can not fault this hotel, fantastic location, staff very helpful, continental breakfast was adequate for our needs. Rooms were clean and daily maid service straightened room and provided clean towels. I had read previous reviews and did not experience anything that I could say was poor. I will certainly stay here again and will be booking again next year. Really enjoyed our stay.

title: Not wonderful but good
text: The location is really good, as it is 5 minutes from Victoria Station and 2 minutes from Victoria Coach Station ( good if you do not have time and you have to travel to/form airports). The hotel itself is not bad but spending 139€ you may expect a bit more. The rooms are small but overall clean. The breakfast is served in a open room which is nice! not bad, but not special.

title: Three nights
text: Great location, only five minutes walk from the Victoria Station. Very friendly and helpful staff. Hotel itself was small but cozy. Surprisingly our room was rather large. Breakfast was ok, but the breakfast room was really small. I couldn't spot an elevator, that wasn't a problem for us, but nice to know for everyone. Very good value for money, and I would definitely go there again.

title: Fine small Hotel in nice neighborhood
text: Rooms were very small but otherwise ok. Breakfast very basic and service below average. Location good with many transport options and even descent walking distance to many attractions. Perfect location if you travel via Gatwick airport.

title: In Love u Park Avenue Belgravia
text: This hotel is vy nice although the room that i stayed in is suitable my a couple with children. The toilet is very very clean and new and in a look modern.I love the toilet,room,bed very much. Anyway if u carry alot of luggage please request the hotel/reception early for a better room level because the staircase in quite narrow and small. However, the reception/the staff of this hotel is very kind. The staff help me to carry my luggage although i have only one luggage and no tips they require and just a helping hand. I really very pleasant to stay in this hotel and this is my last day in London and back to my country,Malaysia. I only stay here for a night only(139 pound) and i should book the same hotel when i arrived to London but I accidentally book a wrong hotel(79 pound) the day i arrived (very disappointed).

title: Very close to Victoria but very noisy
text: This hotel is a converted town house, it's really small. The reception area is very cosy, the staff are friendly but it does feel being in someone's house. My room was very small, but perfectly clean. The location is great for Victoria and Belgravia. My biggest problem was the noise. The walls and doors are paper thin. Every guest that came into the hotel would wake me up with the echoing footsteps and crashing doors. This was on top of the sound from my neighbouring rooms, I could hear every flush, TV programme and snoring sleeper. I chose this hotel as I had a super early start in Victoria. I slept the day feeling shattered after the constant disturbance.

title: Worth a visit, great location.
text: This hotel was exactly what I was looking for: Comfortable modern room with good facilities (However not sure how long they will last, buy cheap buy twice). Breakfast excellent and staff were extremely helpful and efficient. One small negative point I personally would have preferred that they spoke English whilst conducting their duties around the hotel. Will definitely use again and recommend.

title: Underground
text: Breakfast very poor, bathroom not clean, trash outside the window, room in a cellar! Good and friendly service in the reception. Belgravia Astors has a very central location, a lot of bars and restaurants. There is also one of the best bakery‘s of the world!

title: Amazing Hotel
text: The hotel was very easy to find and had such friendly staff. The rooms were very clean and spacious and nicely decorated, it was also very quiet at night which we were grateful for. The breakfast was lovely and couldn't be faulted, such good value for money. Enjoyed it very much.

title: Greit location - value for money
text: Great location near Victoria station. Nice hotel with small but nice rooms. Breakfast could be better. Walking distance for shopping and many attractions. Good wifi. Pubs and restaurants in the neighborhood.

title: Good location. Cold rooms though
text: Really good quiet location. My room was really cold and only had a really thin quilt. Staff really helpful and friendly. Breakfast room was full both mornings. Lucky enough we was just up the stairs and took breakfast back to the room.

title: Smoking Room
text: I know this is England and there's smoking ban but not in this room I had - some persons had been smoking and felt like no effort had been made to de-fumigate the room - it was disgusting - I couldn't sleep even with the windows wide open. Avoid this hotel. It is very poor value for money.

title: Ideal location in beautiful Belgravia
text: My wife and I have just returned from two nights at this hotel in room 311 on top floor. Our case was brought up as the stairs are steep. Ideal place to base yourself in a fashionable area close to lovely cafes, bistros and restaurants. Very good value. We booked the most basic grade room and it was perfectly adequate, clean and big enough. Victoria Station, Knightsbridge, etc all a walk away. We would recommend this hotel and stay again. It is a real bargain.

title: Short stay
text: Very central location. Hotel clean . Small room up 5 flights of stairs . No lift. Bed comfortable . Very basic continental breakfast. Strangely didn't appear to be a kitchen and breakfast dishes were washed in a recess off the dining room which was slightly off putting. We would return as it was convenient for our purposes. Staff at reception were pleasant and helpful.

title: Boutique Excellence
text: Stayed at this hotel for 2 nights. The place is charming, clean and ideally situated being close to many of London's attractions, such as Buckingham Palace. It is also adjacent to Victoria Station and the Underground. Breakfast, which is included in the price provided sufficient variety to satisfy my wife and I. The room, whilst modest, was spotless and provided everything needed, reverse cycle air-conditioning, safe, colour TV and WIFI. The staff were wonderful, friendly and more than willing to answer any questions and provide advice and directions. Will stay here again when visiting London

title: Good location
text: Good location, in the proximity of Victoria station. Very quiet and comfortable. Breakfast was also a bit above of what we'd expected. Friendly and helpful staff. Don't bring too big suitcases, though. The staircases are narrow - typical for small hotels in London :)

title: First time in london
text: Super comfy bed. Great area. Lots of stairs. No microwave and coffee in room was instant so wasn't good. Staff was very friendly. Toilet seat not comfortable. Breakfast was slim pickings. Need guide for tv

title: A great littkle boutique style property close to transportation.
text: A cozy, tidy hotel near to the train, tube and restaurants. Many types of entertainment and history within a healthy walking area. Staff were always friendly & helpful. (Not there is no elevator here, but staff will assist with bags to your suite.

title: great location, but too expensive
text: James House Hotel was located on a very quiet safe street just a few minutes walk from Victoria station. It is within easy walking distance to Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, and many other attractions. The hotel owner was away during our stay, but the interim manager was very welcoming, friendly and extremely helpful. (He made phone calls to the airport to track down my missing luggage while we were out sightseeing all day.) Our room was very small, but charming. the beds were clean and comfortable. The room could use a good cleaning however, as the pipes along the wall were coated thickly with dust. and we found bits of food under the bed. Bathroom was tiny but clean. breakfast was very basic and unappealing.. just cornflakes, cruiscants in plastic wrap, tangerines, juice and coffee. though London is an expensive city, I thought the room rates were high for the accommodations, with only continental breakfast provided. There were many other hotels on this street, and I would recommend checking rates at a few others to see if you can get a better rate. The location couldn't be better.

title: Will not book here again!
text: I booked a room here for a colleague who informed me that the room was small, dirty, the tv didn't work properly, the heating was not working and there were some lights that didn't turn off. When she complained to reception regarding the heating and tv they did come up to the room but managed to turn the heating up full rather than a sensible temperature. They also managed to turn the tv on, but made her feel a bit stupid for asking in the first place. This was actually quite expensive for what we got, there are much better hotels than this in the area. I will not book this hotel again!

title: Very nice for the money
text: Stayed for 1 night in August in a small double room (302) Room is very small but furnished to a high standard, bed is comfy and air-con was great. Usual facilities, tea/coffee/water/biscuits. Bathroom obviously small but shower was great. Nice location, close to Victoria Station but very quiet as on residential street, slept very well indeed. Reception staff were pleasant and helpful. Breakfast is poor, small selection of meat and cheese, cereals and toast, tea/coffee/juice, yoghurts. Pastries were stale. Cooked breakfast would have been appreciated. Will definitely stay again.

title: Great value
text: Very nice hotel. Great location for Victoria bus station and plenty of restaurants and cafes just round the corner. The room was snug but very comfortable with all the amenities you'd expect. The bathroom was very nice indeed and the air-con was a god-send in the intense heat while we were there.

title: Perfect London Lodging
text: This hotel is very close to Victoria Coach Station but in a quiet and elegant Belgravia street. The area is truly charming. The accommodation is immaculate and tasteful. The air conditioning and Wifi were excellent and made it a very comfortable stay. The staff were all friendly and very helpful. The facility of being able to leave your luggage with them before check in and after check out was priceless. Will definitely be staying here again.

title: It's like being at home but in London
text: Hotel with very good location, near Victoria station. Very quiet and beautiful neighborhood. The staff very friendly and attentive. They stored our bags at reception. Very comfortable beds and very clean room.

title: Comfortable hotel in a great location, lacks the finess if a 4 start
text: Great location if you don't want to get the tube everywhere. 30 mins walk from the museums, 40 from the London Eye. Room was a good size for a double but with the third bed was quite restricting, however, when in London, the room is purely for sleeping as there is too much to see and do to spend time in the hotel.. Some reviews mention the narrow staircases. They are! No problem with small bags of luggage but I can see why people would struggle with larger suitcases. The staff are polite when spoken to, but don't go out of their way to be friendly. Breakfast is adequate, however, the tables are in the reception area (not an ideal place) and only seats approx 16 people at a time (the hotel has 20 rooms - you do the maths), we never had to wait too long for a table though. Breakfast was never a relaxed affair though, with battling the small space, getting to food and drink, and often things had run out and we had to ask (despite staff circulating most of the time). I feel this is probably a 3 star rather than 4.

title: Smelled like liquor
text: The staff were all nice and the breakfast was delicious. But after booking just in January we were placed in the basement in a room that smelled like liquor was wasted all over the carpet. A very Comfy bed!

title: Good value for money.
text: We had a club room priced at £149, which was in the basement. Although a club room is one of the best rooms, it was still rather small. However for the price, very comfortable bed, and lovely shower. We had no noise problems whatsoever. The continental breakfast was rather basic. The hotel is in an excellent location not far from Victoria station. There is a good pub round the corner, Travellers Rest. There is no lift, and stairs quite steep, so not a hotel for the less mobile.

title: Reasonably priced rooms, in a good location.
text: Astors Belgravia offer decent sized rooms and bathrooms (in relation to the price) along with a few simple breakfast options that should do the trick. The staff at the hotel were very nice and I would stay here again. The location is really handy, especially to Victoria Station. If you are using the Gatwick Express or coach services, you won't be disappointed.

title: Simple and nice
text: The best and most kinds staff ever. But small rooms. But to be London this was great. Area very nice and close to Victoria station for travelers from Gatwick. The breakfast is boring but staff helpful to toast your bread. It ain't their fault that the food in England is so bad.

title: Bad bed
text: The hotel was ok , the area was great for transport, I booked a room with 2 beds , they gave me a room with one bed and a che's lounge sofa, they called it a sleeper sofa, it was not, only a child could fit on it and it had no mattress , most uncomfortable bed ever

title: Perfect base for London break
text: We booked a last minute 3 night break in London for a honeymoon, but wanted to keep costs down due to the obvious explosive costs of the wedding! Let me start with the travel. We were quoted over £200 for the two of us by train and National Express from Cornwall to London. When I inquired about MegaBus we found it was less than £20 per person return to London Victoria Coach Station. And this is where this hotel frst caught my attention. It is only about 2 minutes walk from the coach station door. Having paid when booking for a double room, I was aware and a little concerned the rooms were small, however we intended to either be out and about or in bed, so we did not see this as too much of an issue. We were first showed to Room 206 - which unfortunately was a twin room! When I mentioned this to the receptionist and in fact we were on honeymoon she told us she would get another couple moved from their room and we were to sit tight for ten minutes. As it turned out, we were then allocated Room 208 on the top floor, a perfect double room. Yes the room was small but it had air conditioning and an en-suite. The en-suite has a small square shower, barely big enough for a man like me to turn round in, but it served a purpose. If they utilised the room properly they could install a much bigger shower cubilcle which would have been far more comfortable. But anyway, it did not spoil our visit. The bed was soft, but exceptionally clean and quite sturdy! Not much of a view but we did not expect one. We never tried the breakfast room - there are plenty of places to get breakfast close by. We did make plenty of cups of tea though, and had no issues whatsoever obtaining more tea bags or milk. The staff were lovely - friendly and willing to help, and certainly did their part to make our little honeymoon memorable. If you do stay here I suggest you definitely try the Peggy Porschen Cup Cake Cafe opposite - expensive (£12 for two cup cakes and two lattes) but they were the best cup cakes - apart form those made by my wife! Well worth it to try them and sit outside watching the world go by for half an hour. Top hotel, great value and thoroughly recommended. And only ten minutes stroll from Victoria Tube Station, and five minutes from a pick up for the standard open top London tour bus.

title: Pleasant Surprise
text: Having read the reviews I had severe anxiety about visiting this place, but this was totally unfounded. When we arrived, we were immediately upgraded to a larger room which was more like a suite then a double bedroom! For the price we paid you will struggle to find accommodation as good as this in East London, (we paid £194). I think the reviews reflect old management and older rooms which are still in the process of being updated that some guests have stayed in. However, food for thought for management is that: The rooms don't appear to be sound proofed, this could be looked into. Not all the plug sockets worked which is just me being fussy as I like to have my phone next to my bed But most importantly, your reception staff don't pick up the phone when people call and when they do, I just got "hello" and a very monotone and unhelpful conversation. Either hire new staff who care about first impressions or offer some training to them as they're not helping with resolving initial concerns. When we arrived everyone was lovely so this I'm sure could be easily resolved? Would have scored higher if initial contact was better, shame! But all in all give these guys a chance, great location for the money and the horror stories don't seem true.

title: Fine for us
text: This apartment was just fine. Friendly staff and good size rooms with simple furniture. Place was clean we has no complaints except a late checkout but because we checked in very late they waive off the charges which was nice of reception. We didn't encounter any terrifying comments heard from other reviews so we continued our pleasant stay thank you for the welcome millennium apartments.

title: Comfortable but small
text: Overall nice, clean apartment near the centre. However, it was rather small for four people and a few minor maintenance issues. For the price though and a three night stay, it was very pleasant. Doesn’t deserve such negative reviews.

title: perfect central location
text: This is a tricky one because the location is great but please ignore the photos on the website as they are not a true representation of the apartments. It was clean tidy and the staff were amazing. The first room they offered us was shocking. Very hostel like, tasteless and ugly. Then we got offered a top floor room which was much better, modern bathroom and kitchen with a tiny attic space fitting a bed. Pretty cool little flat and we had no problems. Still if your looking for a high end city escape or a romantic getaway I wouldn't recommend this place, best suited for teenagers looking just for a place to sleep and wash after heading out to the amazing bars/cafes.

title: Pictures are not representative
text: Room was nothing like in the pictures, bed very basic. no proper wardrobe, small hanging space. the neighbouring street is noisy with bin lorries visiting through the night to clear rubbish from the restaurants. also the doors in the block are very stiff meaning you will be awoken whenever someone gets back to their apartment.

title: Do yourself a favor and book somewhere else
text: I booked a studio apartment in this "hotel". The stay was a complete disaster and we had to cut it short. Firstly, the studio room is not apt for two people and should not be allowed to be booked as such. The layout of the room is terrible, with no space between the bed and the wall, no nighttable to put anything, a strange chair in the small dividing space between teh kitchenette and the bed. There were no sheets on the bed, only a duvet, limited amount of towels, insufficient for one person. More importantly, the place is a construction site with dust everywhere, buildings pacing up and down the corridor at 8am and the low quality construction materials used for the place mean that walls are paper thin and the window is not double glazed which makes it impossible to sleep with the noise outside. When we told them we would cut our stay from 5 days to 3 days, we were not offered a refund or anything, other than the next stay would be free. They mentioned a 15 day cancellation policy which is ludicrous, especially as we were cancelling given our bad experience once we saw it. Advertising is misleading and the size of the studio do not match that shown on booking websites and their own website does not load the pictures... Anyways, terrible experience so do yourself a favor and book somewhere else.

title: ok for younger people.NOT Seniors
text: ...a little disappointing...we had to climb two flights of steps ( no lifts) with heavy luggage. Not a good thing for seniors. This is really small and the bathroom was a bit worrisome to get in and out of the shower...if anyone is the slightest bit overweight they would never get in. You have to step about a foot....try getting out through a space of 3 ft. ( if that) when your wet.....no safety bar to grab....really a dangerous set up. The kitchen was functional but forget doing laundry in a hurry. The washer does fine but it's a combo washer / dryer. In order for your clothes to dry you must run the dryer on 'Cupboard Dry' ....and that takes approx. 2 hours. The clothing came out so wrinkled we couldn't even iron them out. The eating area has three chairs and one for lounging. Bedrooms up in a loft...one must climb over beams. Fine for young folks but I wouldn't stay here again.

title: Brilliant stay
text: I stayed here with my friend and two teenage daughters. We had a very comfortable stay and can complain about nothing. Area was fine and even though the closest underground station was closed for work the next one was only a short walk away. Room was spacious and clean with a full sized kitchen. Would definitely stay again!

title: Photos of the property flatter it
text: I had reserved a double room for this trip, since the single one looked really cramped on the photos. They kindly upgraded me for free to something bigger, and then discovered they were redecorating it, so upgraded me again to their family room. Interesting. There's no way I would stay here with a family. The bed upstairs was over an obstacle course of beams and low ceilings which I can only think in an emergency would lead to someone falling down the staircase. As it was, the downstairs of the family appartment would have been big enough for two, just, but the bathroom is tiny. Really tiny. The pictures make the decor look more classy than it realy is. The tiling is somewhat linoleum. They mean well, but you don't get the feeling the people that run this are experienced hoteliers. The check-in desk is the kind of high counter that prevents the receptionist from being attacked - the kind of thing you'd see in a 70's american movie in places that rented by the hour. This may have been the previous use of these premises. I would certainly updated this space if I owned these appartments. Defintely the smallest appartment room I've ever stayed in. Smaller than most hotel rooms, actually, except it had asmall, but reasonably appointed kitchen, even though the fridge was free standing with the microwave propped up on top of it. I chose this hotel originally for its closeness to Liverpool St and my onward trip to Cambridge the next day, and hadn't realised that the area around it was so full of great restaurants and bars. The area makes a good destination, I'd say.

title: Best Location and great value
text: We stayed here with friends to celebrate my Boyfriend's birthday - it is the perfect location if you're looking to spend time in East London. We were close to everything we wanted - great local restaurants, good pubs, amazing clubs and shops! The underground is close by and this made it easy for us to get around and see greater london as well. Apartment is very clean and secure and it was great to have cooking facilities. Whilst it's not the most amazing or luxurious stay this was really great value and well worth it for the location.

title: Not quite as it seems
text: Don't look at the photographs and believe your room will look like that. Location good as 5 mins away from Old Street underground station. On entering there is a sewer manhole beneath the entrance mat and boy can you smell that it is there. The reception staff are quite abrupt, they will ask to photocopy your id and credit card, don't let them as this is stored together then you are open to someone using your card no as they will also have your address! I was offered an upgrade for a cash supplement which I took them up on as the small room is really small, I waited in reception for a receipt as I believe they don't normally give one from reading other reviews. The apartment was ok, comfortable bed, adequate kitchen with a fridge with ice compartment, microwave, washing machine, kettle and toaster, tea, coffee and milk was also supplied. Shower needs a bit of a clean but overall the apartment was clean. Television with freesat though not all channels were available. I was in the room (8b) above the main entrance so it was really noisy with the door slamming every time anyone came in or left which was in the early hours of the morning. There's a great little indian café next door that does some great food you can take back to your room, rice and 2 currys only £3 but tasted really good, I couldn't eat it all! I won't be returning to this apartment.

title: Not as advertised!
text: The Appartment looks nothing like the pictures. It was an incredibly small, oddly decorated room. The noise levels in the place were atrocious. Hotel workmen sawing and sanding at 7am and hotel staff in and out of rooms (assuming for cleaning) at 7am onwards letting doors SLAM. I may aswell have brought earplugs. Unfortunately not what we expected whatsoever and the images and description (4 star???) is completely false.

title: Worst apartment ever!!
text: The apartment was supposed to b suitable for four people. However, it was a small room with 4 beds in the same room. More like a bed sit. Very disappointing. To top it off they took a further 150 pounds out of my account. Not happy and will not stay there again.

title: Good location and nice appartment
text: Nice and very clean appartment, well located and with good public transport. Expensive extra charge for leaving luggage for a few hours last day. There is not a very good table/chairs for a family lunch.

title: Good Value
text: Staff are very friendly and room well equipped. The hotel is located in a very convenient location with lots of pubs, cafes and restaurants. It was a bit noisy at night due to proximity of restaurants and pubs but it dies down quickly and the windows are double glazed.

title: Good price for value
text: The service are good, the room is nice, very comfortable bed and bathroom. The kitchen have everything that we need to take a breakfast, but I think is not good to cooking there. The neighborhood is good but a little noisy at nights, but there are many restaurants to get a meal.

title: Family holiday
text: The apartments are perfect location for visiting many attractions, they are however smaller than I thought and basically just fit for sleeping in,there is a small kitchen which is handy but not suitable for having a meal. Clean and cleaning staff lovely Too many stairs with suitcases and pretty expensive,

title: Great location but certainly not executive apartments.
text: The "executive apartment" was extremely small and the bedroom area only just squeezed a bed in. The photos on the website were very misleading and certainly showed different apartments, if not a completely different building. The location was great but the rooms were pretty terrible.

title: Landmark Apts.
text: Very nice accommodations--clean and comfortable for our family. Two things to be aware of: lots of stairs and compact rooms. We would stay again if we were to return to London. Thanks for a nice stay!

title: Right Place!
text: I have to come into the city every couple of weeks due to work and they always book a hotel that im not satisfied with so i dicided to book myself this once and spot on found a small apartment hotel with a resturant on the ground floor. The great feel for me was the full kitchen and fridge! I always want. Didnt have to dine for my 3 night stay, i happily went food shopping all walking distance to the apart hotel and saved myself from dinning on my own. Immaculate clean and thats all i want. Will tell my office to book this next time.

title: Fab Place
text: The apartments were fabulous from the time i checked in at the reception, pleasant staff and very friendly. I booked a studio room but my daughter living in the area of shordeditch wanted to stay with us, as we had come from a long distance. So they kindly offered us a family apartment for a good price. good stay. Will stay here again.

title: Not disabled friendly.
text: This hotel has so many stairs without a lift and the staff did nothing to assist us at all despite having a disabled guest. There is nothing on easy to book or the hotels website warning of this which I find very frustrating! Rooms were tiny, incorrect number of beds on arrival, facilities were terrible and in one room the second double was put in the most claustrophobic corner under the eaves which was awful! Be warned.... The photos do not represent the true place.

title: Small, complete and very clean
text: A very small apartment. Everything was available, even an iron and board. It was very quiet and very clean. Rivington Street East End is a pleasant area with a lot of small restaurants, very close to Liverpoolstreetstation.

title: Decent!
text: Us lot was looking for Hoxton Sq Shoreditch zone to have a weekend away and meet friends. This was ideal for us. We arrived in the afternoon and dropped our bags and went out for the day. When we returned we realised what a decent place this was. Our apartment was based on 2 floors with a breakfast table kitchen and double beds! what more did we need. They looked newly refurbished with massive windows overlooking the front of the building, so plenty of natural light. We requested another iron/board and they gave it to us straight away. Knowing that i am abit of a fuss pot i actually didnt have any complains except a late check out which they said was fine even though we paid a small amount. Glad we booked here and only place i will book when im in the area again.

title: Funky Place!
text: Incredible staff. Arrived in the afternoon after a long travel. The Location was in the heart of Shoreditch and the apartments was very modern looking with all the facilities needed. The wifi and daily cleaning was a bonus. We always find it hard to find something decent in this area but as this place was recommended by friends, I would gladly tell more people. They have a restaurant on the ground floor , and we all had breakfast which was delicious, a little pricy but def worth it. appreciate the welcoming and look forward to come back.

title: Not As Advertised
text: Me and my partner stayed at Landmark Apartments for a weekend trip to London. Check in was easy after we'd found reception

title: Too many stairs
text: We had made a booking for a studio apartment before leaving on our trip. On arrival at Rivington Appts we were told that our booking was not available and we were given a family appt but we would have to move when our booked appt became available. It was a nuisance for us to have to pack up and move during our stay.When we had moved appts we found there wasn't a frying pan. When we asked at reception for a frying pan, it was promised but was not delivered to our room. We found the young man at reception when we arrived to be most helpful. As we had booked this accommodation over the internet we weren't aware of all the stairs that we would have to negotiate,through both the building as well as in the apt we were moved to.

title: Do not stay here, pictures aren't what you get!
text: During our three night stay each night was noisy and it wasn't even the weekend... On arrival reception took forever to let us inside the building to even check in, as soon as we opened the doors in the apartment we were disappointed, were promised a queen bed, and we got a double! Not only was the bed small but it had very old sheets and quilt cover whilst also being very thin and not warm! Was a weird green light on during the night in the rooms roof, making the room bright at night! Wifi was horrible, slow and hard to connect to, always dropping out and at times unable to even connect to on your list of available wifi on your device. Only good thing about it was it was secure, in shoreditch and close to the old street underground station allowing easy access in and around London. We won't be staying again

title: Good, but Expensive for what it is
text: Not a bad place, but much smaller than it seemed in the pictures. For the pricepoint, it is a bit much too -- there is no 24x7 reception (and the building/rooms really feel like an apartment building, not like a 150-pound+ per night hotel.) Location is great, however. And lots of cool places nearby. I probably wouldn't stay again unless it was <100 a night, just because it is a lot for what it is. Sonya, one of the receptionists, is amazing. Helped an incredible amount, considering the limited amenities of the hotel. Including arranging for non-down pillows to be bought for me, and getting my shirts dry-cleaned and picked up.

title: Perfect Location
text: Hotel location is really excellent with easy access to several interesting places either commercial or for tourism.Wonderful to be able to leave luggage prior to checking in if arriving early and on checking out to be able to leave luggage until the end of the day.Stylish, modern and decent size room, the bed was really very comfortable and very well decorated and really functional. Friendly and helpful staff, nice and clean rooms. I would happily stay there again.

title: Recent trip to London
text: I would certainly recomment this hotel to others and I will more than likely come and stay at the hotel again in the not too distant future. It's in a great location and has all the amenities required.

title: Had a very pleasant stay
text: Met our needs perfectly, friendly staff, plenty of restaurants and amenity shops nearby, clean, good housekeeping, very close to tube and also bus transport facilities, free 24 hr wifi access was a treat, the only thing noisy was the water tank in the kitchen, every time someone used the toilet sink or shower it made a rattle noise, but we got used to it after a while

title: business
text: good. i stayed for 2 nights. good rooms and good service. the rooms were clean and i stay well without any problem. i cannot say anything about the morning break-fast, because i haven,t do it. if i will return to london i will fix surely again this nice apartment.

title: Do not stay here! Also known as 'Rivington Apartments'
text: This place false advertises. The room I had looked nothing like in the photo. Tiny, crammed and with an ancient heating/fan system, that did not heat the room but made a whole lot of noise. The "kids" who run reception know nothing about customer service. No one had a solution to room 2A being so cold when 2 degrees outside!
