The windows are not double glazed and there is a draft that lingers due to gaps in the front door. I stayed one night had another 2 to go, of course they would not refund my money. I left and found a room at the Hoxton Hotel just around the corner and if I say a thousand times better... That would be an understatement. Landmark are just a bunch of crappy rooms in a dodgy building with incapable staff and no service. The entrance and then strange narrow staircases going up to "reception" had me wondering where the hell am I staying. Not a good start and not a good ending!

title: Excellent apartments
text: Excellent service from the friendly staff. Rooms are clean, have everything you would need and it is very well positioned near Old street and Liverpool street. Would use the location again and would recommend it to anyone else.

title: Good service- Simple hotel/apartments
text: A little noisy at night (there are a lot of clubs in the area) but overall a good apartment if you want a decent place to stay close to the City. If you're travelling for business or just finding your feet in London I'd recommend this place if you need to be walking distance to the City.

title: Landmark Hotel Rivington Street
text: Reasonably priced apartment hotel near Old Street tube. Recently renovated. Clean and well equipped : fridge, washing machine, toiletries, coffee and milk, no tea bags. Felt friendly and safe. Would use again.

title: Miss leading pictures and information online.
text: I was in town for my birthday and going out in the Shoreditch area. I needed a place to stay. I usually book a hotel when i am out in Shoreditch but i came across this 'apartment' online. Thought it would be perfect for three girls getting ready to head out. The pictures showed a spacious apartment with a separate lounge and kitchen area. Instead it was as big as my current lounge, it had a large double bed with a single bed at the foot of the bed. The single bed slept half in the kitchen and half next to the double bed. There was not much space for three girls to walk around or get ready. It was a very tight squeeze! When we spoke to the man at reception about how miss leading the pictures are online, he didn't seem too bothered. He did however show us another room which was even smaller. By the time we had checked in it was far too late to book somewhere else.Thank god we were heading out for most of the night and back drunk enough to knock out. Other people staying in the building would let anyone into the building, without knowing if they are staying there or not. We had a key fob and probably used it once. The Location was the only good thing. As the club was in walking distance. I would definitely not call it an apartment. Next time i will stick to booking hotels i know. The hotel i usually book is of a well known chain it is usually the same price and can sometimes get it cheaper. I would only recommend this place as a last resort. Remember to expect too much to avoid disappointment.

title: it was okay
text: my sister and i stayed here for 8 days. the place is tiny! the bathroom is tiny the kitchen the bedroom was really small dont be fooled by pictures. but the wifi was good lol location is alright the closest station doesnt take you to the central lines but its still okay.

title: The smallest place in the world
text: The studio apartment is not made for human beings but for Lilliputians. The bathroom is the smallest I have ever seen

title: Nice except the noise isolation
text: Impossible to sleep I could hear the neighboµr the next rented flat like if they were in the same room. And the toilet were very noisy the pump. nice decoration but if it is impossible to sleep it doesnt worth it!!

title: Would've been a lot better...
text: Booked several people in, and the hassle and inconsistency coming via email and then on the phone was astonishing. Overall it's a good location but the admin seemed heavy and I felt like I was being 'taken for a ride'...

title: Do not stay here under any circumstances!!!!!
text: As I am writing this I am currently in the process of suing the apartments for unauthorised debits to my account and misrepresentation of copy on their web-site. We stayed here some 4 weeks ago for two nights as we had organised a large fundraising night for cancer research and wanted to stay near the venue. We arrived later than expected due to traffic and had been told by friends staying at the apartment that they had been turned away even though they had a confirmed booking due to essential maintenance work. We had booked a family room and an executive room. Upon arrival, we realised that both my parents who are registered as disabled would not be able to stay as the apartments have no lifts and huge staircases. We were shown to our "family room" which meant climbing a very tall spiral staircase to find a room in the eaves with a lumpy mattress and a second bed under the eaves that you had to climb into backwards. There was a small shower room and worst of all only a sky light measuring 1 foot by 2 feet with no way to reach this to open or close it. It was in effect like being in an underground bunker. We are still trying to get back the money that we have been overcharged and even with email proof they are still refusing to refund us. Please also be careful as we had a total of 5 friends stay here on the night of our fundraising event and NONE of the rooms matched the size or style of those shown on the web-site. I normally read trip advisor before booking anywhere but made the mistake of not doing this. I am sure that the good reviews come from those that manage to get the rooms shown on the website but to me you are better staying in Fraser Apartments as they are great and you get what you see in the pictures. The management have the Customer Service skills of cockroaches. Be warned!

title: Good option in East London
text: Decided to stay in a different part of London on a recent trip. I had a first floor Executive Studio, the kitchen was very well equipt, air-con/heat and heated floors in bathroon all worked perfectly. Internet access was solid all trip. Interesting location with lots of things going on - overall I liked this property. Management was courtesy, but they need to provide a welcome book with location information, restaurant guide, stuff like that. Otherwise, your on your own - which isn't all that bad. Only a 5-7 minute walk from Old Street Tube Station.

title: ''Superb stay, friendly, clean, central, will stay again''
text: Excellent location for those quick trips in and around london and very easy to find, staff were very friendly and facilities at this hotel made my short stay extremely welcoming. Highly recommend this establishment, and will certainly be visiting again in the near future. Thanks for a fantastic stay!!!

title: The worst experiance ever in London
text: Never trust the phrase “ non-refundable deal “ following the term “Executive Deluxe apartment” This is very suspicious! What does the term “ executive deluxe apartment” mean anyway? Unfortunately, there is no standard definition and it is totally dependent on the owner’s preference ! We were looking for a one bedroom serviced apartment in London to stay for 16 days and according to the description on the Easytobook website, we booked at the Rivington Apartments. It was strange that the description did not clearly state what type of room/apartment this was, however, it suggested that the property was likely to be a 1 bedroom apartment. Just to make sure, we emailed them to ask about more details, but never got a reply! We were running out of time and had to book a reasonable priced apartment very soon. On arrival, we became worried once we saw the narrow entrance and even narrower stairs! The stairs were approximately 65 cm wide ! There was no lift, by the way. The building was highly compact with rooms as all what appeared walking through was its narrow stairs. We thought, that’s not a big deal as long as the room is ok. However, the room was NOT ok ! The 1 bedroom apartment turned out to be just a room (not technically an apartment!). We were extremely upset that we were mislead by the fancy description and most of all the words

title: Slept like a baby
text: I have chosen this apartment because of the location because of work but I was won over by the services , i have stayed in many apartments but Rivington was one of the best experience I have had , I would definitely come back definitely would recommend it to my friends family and work colleagues the staff were very welcoming and helpful big smiles , the room was very clean tidy and very comfortable I put my bags down straightaway and had a little nap There was no noises or any types of disturbance at all I slept like a baby Rivington is excellent value for money worth every penny , if work or any other reasons requires me to come back to the same area I would definitely be staying in Rivington

title: Definitely recommended!
text: Stayed here for 3 nights during a business conference in London, amazing location, great value and superb facilities, to top it off the staff were extremely knowledgable about the area and directed me to the great bars and restaurants closeby! I will most definitely be booking a room here again when I'm back in January.

title: Excellent Home Away From Home
text: Staff was friendly and helpful. My room was a bit hot due to the floor heating in the bathroom but the saw to it right away. My only gripe was that there was a homeless man sleeping in a hallway when left early in the day.

title: We were having a business trip in London. And the staying in Rivington apartment has changed my good impression of Londo
text: The service and the reception people are not gentle! They never keep their word. That was the most awful experience in London. Once you paid the money, they will never treat you as a customer. The preception people in Rivingston Apartment never solve problems, they just know how to shirk responsibility and shift the blame onto others . I have written a letter of compliant to easybook.com and hope they can have a satisfactory answer for me. I wrote complaint letter to their Manager， for twice， No one answered.

title: Fantastic apartments
text: Fantastic apartment, very modern new and stylish. Great hospitable staff who were very friendly and welcoming. The location is very funky and trendy with close proximity to Brick Lane trendy cool bars. Overall 10/10 great place to stay.

title: The luxury of Kitch
text: The entrance was obscure and a friend visiting tthought I was staying in a brothel ..lHe smell in the entrance was parculiar. In any case they tried to give the appartment a luxurious feeling but with a taky taste and hence the pictures look great but when you get there you do not feel comfortable. The reception service you felt similar to the way they treat people at NY Kennedy airport ,, not precisely welcoming . the apartment room was OK and I did like the fact of having space., although having said that the entire interior spacing was bizar and nothing worked. out, the bathroom was probably 1square meter and the floo r heat ing was so hot that tit resembled a sauna + on bare feet was impossible to stand on the foloor

title: Disaster in London
text: We actually did not get the chance to experience the apartments. The first day we were relocated due to a "plumbing" problem to Stratford city (7km away/ London zone 3) because they could not find anything else.... We asked to still see the apartment, but they didnt have the keys... The new hotel we got, was not even aware about the rebooking. They booked it by internet under a false adress. Worse they had already charged our credit card and we had to pay again for the night we spent there... we are still waiting to be refunded. We tried to call, but no one answered anymore. After 2 days complaining & several phone calls, they finally got us something similar in London. We are still trying to get to the bottom of this story.

title: best place in the area
text: I stayed at many hotels of the area and I think this one is really good given that it is a full apartment, not just a hotel room and comes with a small kitchen. The price is not too high for the area. For 124 I had a nice, very clean studio apartment with a small kitchen, flat screen TV and free wireless internet and of course impeccable service. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Highly recommended.

title: Didn't look like that on the website
text: Although in an ideal location for our needs, clean, warm and generally good value for money, I found the website very misleading - the apartment was much smaller than lead to believe. As a group of 3 we were expecting an additional bed, but upon arrival were told all they could do was provide a mattress. On returning back to the room at 12.30am, no mattress had been put in the room and when reception were informed, they initially just gave us bedding! However the situation was remedied within 10 minutes. Would stay again only if Travelodge was booked up.

title: An odd little place
text: ***Note: This place also goes by the name of Langham Apartments. The Rivington name may have been created because of the many negative reviews for Langham Apartments.*** First some advice: If you are a tourist visiting London, this is not the place for you. Old Street is a down at the heels neighborhood in east London and it is far from most typical tourist attractions. If you are doing business in the City of London, however, this place is both convenient and inexpensive. You'd do well to check in on the early side (and call in advance to ensure that there will be someone there to greet you because the reception is not always staffed). The building itself is a bit of a rabbit warren that is under construction...a bit of dust present, though my room was spotless. I stayed in the "studio flat". The flat is furnished to a pretty high standard, with top quality bathroom fixtures and lots of marble/granite on the walls and floor. The bed was extremely comfortable. The room is exceptionally tiny, however and suitable for no more than one person. The bathroom is practically non-existent...the toilet takes up all the floor space, and the sink is too small to shave in. You'll want to shower, shave and dry off inside the (very nicely appointed by the way) shower stall. My first floor (second floor for Americans) flat was very noisy: Street noise was noticable throughout the night and starting around 11pm a disco beat started...sounds like there was a nearby disco, or even one in the basement. The disco continued till two or three AM. So in summary, OK for a single person for one night if you are doing business nearby and can sleep through ambient noise. Completely unsuitable for tourists and light sleepers.

title: Photos are untrue-noisy-didnt have my reservation/had to move rooms.
text: Disappointing to say the least- I do not suggest this hotel at all and the finishings are of poor quality/taste. Stay at a regular hotel and just eat out cheap. Its not an executive stay hotel at all even with the new renos happening/left a bad taste in my mouth. Reception is not actually a reception and you have to talk on the phone to someone else regarding your rooms/bill/etc.

title: For those looking for quality
text: I stayed at this hotel for 4 nights as I visited London for business purposes. The location is very good, a couple of minutes from Old Street station and a walking distance to Liverpool street. The prices in this area are very high and I got an amazing deal with these apartments. The building is very well maintained and the apartment was spotless. I stayed in an Executive room for 120 per night. This is a good place for those searching for quality for a relatively cheap price. Highly recommended.

title: Imressive
text: This is a really nice aparthotel. I stayed in a studio apartment for one week and liked everything about the hotel, the service and the staff. The studio apartment had a nice, comfortable king size bed, plenty of daylight, a small kitchenette, a lovely clean shower room with hot and strong shower. The location is almost perfect, there are a lot of bars and restaurants nearby in the area and on the street where the hotel is located. The underground station is just minutes away from the hotel. The cleaning service is provided and is included in the room rate. I did love the place and will come back here. Recommended for those searching for quality.

title: Perfect long term stay
text: I have been staying at this hotel for 3 weeks already and I am checking out today and will surely come back here. Everything was great, the hotel was very clean and my apartment was always sparkling. The maid service here is perfect. The bed is huge and comfortable and is perfect for the good sleep. There are plenty of bars in the area, but the windows are double glazing and the insulation is good so the noise outside never bothers you. There is also plenty of light in the apartment, it is bright and airy. Overall, I cannot fault the hotel at anything. Highly recommended.

title: Sleepless Night
text: Would not stay here again. Very noisy at night. No sound insulation from street below. Was allocated a different room for each night. Expensive for a self catering apartment.

title: Do not stay here
text: I am incredibly disappointed, angry, and upset about my stay here. I splashed out for my husbands birthday and booked an executive one bedroom apartment. I really stretched my budget for this as it was his sole present and wanted to have a little luxury. I booked a large, light, one bedroom apartment and I checked into a tiny, dark studio, with no apology. I booked this through Wimdu, and have received a full refund from them, however I have just checked my bank statement and the apartments have charged me, for two nights in a studio, ironically. This is illegal as I booked through Wimdu, and they should not have charged me a single penny.

title: Never book it. Cancel it ASAP if you have a booking. Book it, if you wish to stay with mice.
text: Never book this hotel. If you have a reservation, cancel it asap. The aisles and stairs are too narrow, it looks illegal building. You may be offered a room with closed windows. In aisles and even in rooms, it is dusty everywhere since the staff (receptionist?) are creating new rooms. In the kitchen, when you open the door of the lower cupboard, you can directly see the brick-wall of the building. The ground floor of the building is a restaurant. You can see creatures such as mice there. They put pesticide in the kitchen. Even if you cannot find any hotels in the same price range, DO NOT BOOK THIS. There are many cheaper hotels much better than here in more convenient places. Travelodge or Premire In should be far better than this. I have never had an experience worse than this. I recommend to book this if you like small creatures.

title: Ignore the Internet pictures - This place is basic
text: Booked and paid for an "Executive" room but the room given was at best basic. Akin to sleeping in a 70's kitchen. There was no wardrobe, just a rail under a 4ft hight shelf that was filled with an ironing board. I booked 4 nights but only stayed for one, that's how bad it is.

We did not lika this hotel, it said it was a four star apartment hotel but we belive that is not true. Considering the rooms how it looked and so on it was not a four star stay. Also the heater broke in our room and water started pouring out and all they wounderd was if we wanted to take a shower.. After a while we got a new room but just for the night so they could fix it then we had to move back to our old room.

title: Not at all what the pictures show
text: I checked in at the apartments for a one night stay before moving on to family and friends in central London. I picked this place based on location and price. Upon arrival I was told that there was plumbing problems with my room and that I'd have to pay an extra £20 to be able to stay there. Knowing I had no where else to stay at last minute I begrudgingly paid the extra to receive a very dark and basic room. I was not impressed by the quality of the apartments and do not feel they give value for money.

title: Worst start of vaccation.
text: We booked a room and paid it all in advance. We also send the hotel a e-mail that we would be arriving late. When we arrived we got to pay a "arriving late" fee of 50 pound because they said that we had not informed them. We argued but they said they don't have a computer so we had to pay. We was tired and angry.

title: Great Second Stay!
text: This is my second time staying at the Rivington apartments as I am always travelling to London for work. This time I thought I should write a review as i enjoyed both of my 3 night stays very much. I booked an executive room both times as I am very tall and the queensize bed was most suited to myself. The rooms were very clean and the furniture was in new looking condition. The free wi-fi was very efficient too. Upon check-in, the reception staff were very friendly and answered all my questions. I will definately stay here in the future as these apartments are perfect for short buisness stay.

title: Boyfriends Birthday
text: Good location and close to all bars and clubs in shoreditch which was ideal for me and my boyfriend as we are in our early 20's. Although the bed was extremely comfortable do expect noise when cargo (nearby club) kicks out at 3am. Very convenient and room was adequate for two night stay as we spent alot of the time out. Would be ideal for longer stay also as kitchenette was fully equipped for all cooking which was great.I do think the charge of £20 for checking in after 7pm on a friday night was unneccessary as 8pm is not late to have the reception occupied and it was not mentioned at all on the website prior to booking.

title: Our Stay
text: We loved everything about the Rivington except how loud it was from the music coming from the kitchen of the restaurant below and when the bars let out at night. The air con could have been a little cooler as well. Otherwise, I loved the place and would highly recommend it.

title: surprisingly poor review
text: cleanliness: was surprised one day to find the towels instead of being changed were re-folded and hung back on the rack. and the piece of towelling that they had on the floor in front of the toilet was folded up and on the shelf with my toiletries one afternoon when i got back. and another day the room was filled with the smell of roast - most likely from the restaurant below - despite never having cooked in there and all the windows being closed. location: it is in a very cool location with lots of restaurants and bars. the drunks wandering home at night is the only downside. rooms: the rooms were good though the TV remote would not work from the bed and the floors were extremely cold and the heating for them did not work service: quite good on check in and check out, but nothing special (i.e. no tour of the room and explanation of the facilities) value: like everything in london, quite expensive but considering the location and the setup of the apartment, reasonable in the end sleep quality: the bed was quite comfortable, though the pillows were very small and flat overall: i liked the apartment and wanted to give this a good review but 'average' is what it deserves for the price paid and the little things that occurred that could be improved. would stay there again despite those however (better the devil you know maybe...)

title: Wonderful staying
text: I found this accomodation very valuable for the price: I stayed there during the Olympics, quite close to the venues, and paid less than 100 £ per night for a wonderful studio deluxe apartment! Very spacious (rare to find in London), well furnished, all the necessary kitchenware provided, and quite clean: the only problem I experienced were hair on the linens on my arrival, but I asked for a change and the receptionist was very polite in apologizing and making change them and the duvet cover, too. In spite of this fault, they clean the room every day. If you needed, as me, for a checkin after 11pm, you'd have to pay an extra 40 £ for the receptionist's night shift.

title: Bad reputation, perfect stay!
text: Me and my boyfriend originally booked to stay 1 night at the mount apartments in London, after booking and THEN readin all the reviews we started to panic, on the day of my check in I received a phone call to say we would have to move to Rivington apartments due to our room being unavailable - as said in a lot of other bad reviews this then got us even more worried that this was all a scam. Anyway we took the risk after hours of debating whether to book another hotel or cancel our reservation and turned up at Rivington apartments expecting to be faced with a number of problems .... How were we wrong! The reception was tiny but the building was modern and clean and smelt lovely, we were taken to our room by a young girl and our apartment was huge, all modern, big flat screen tv, the most comfiest bed I have slept in and we had a perfectly sized bathroom which was incredibly clean and a full size kitchen equipt with a fridge, washing machine, dishwasher and all of the cutlery you would need. It was perfect we couldn't believe there wasn't some sort of catch and after reading the countless number of bad reviews we were convinced something was waiting to happen, but we checked out in the morning with no fuss nothing, our stay had been everything we had wanted and more!! So for anyone reading all of these bad reviews, ignore them and give it a chance, it was a perfect place to stay, maybe not in the best of areas but the tube station was just a couple of minutes walk. I would DEFINATELY stay here again without a doubt!

title: Small but perfect - no complaints!
text: Great location and a small but perfect apartment. The staff were friendly and very helpful, the hotel was clean and comfortable, overall an excellent experience. I booked a studio apartment and after reading the reviews about the size I was quite worried but when I was showed the apartment it was perfect, I will admit it was quite small but it was what I expected as a true studio apartment, and the apartment looks the same to the pictures they display as the studio on their website. Everything that is listed on their website that will be in the room was there and was in perfect condition, everything looked brand new. The best part of my stay was the bed, it was so comfortable and I slept like a log, which was especially good as I was on a business trip. The free Wi-Fi was a great extra and very useful as usually when I go on business trips there are always problems with the internet. The tube at Old Street was located a 5 minute walk away however a taxi from london kings cross cost less than £10.00. The area around the hotel was also very modern and had lots of restaurants and local food stores. Overall, I was very impressed with the Rivington apartments and I will definitely stay here again on my next leisure or business trip. Thanks.

title: Time in Shoreditch
text: Here for a 5 day business trip to London and turned out Rivington Apts was the perfect place to stay. Good location in Shoreditch near lots of my meetings and coffee shops and pubs. Clean rooms, nice amenities, and strong wifi.

title: Treated like royalty!
text: This is the first time I've written a review on tripadvisor but wanted to share our experience because we were so delighted with the place. Me and my boyfriend just wanted to go on a short trip to London and decided to go for an apartment as we prefer our own food. From the moment we arrived we were treat like royalty. The staff go above and beyond to make your stay exceptional and are extremely polite and helpful. The apartment itself was of a very high standard, and was very spacious, every object in the room was spotless, I could not think of one thing that was bad. Stay here, you will not be disappointed, despite what others have written! I have never been so sad to leave a place like this and I will definitely stay here again when I come down to London again.

title: Rotten to the Core
text: It all started when they booked another couple in in our apartment, so we had to find another place to stay the first night. The receptionist was very little helpfull and when we asked for the refund of the hotel we had to cover the first night she instead booked us in the excecutive apartments because the other rooms were very small and should not be used for a room for 2. The apartments look good, own kitchen etc. Except for the broken bed, everything was nice until we went to bed. The windows on apartment 8A and maby 8b and 9A are so litte loundproof that you can hear the people having conversations down on the street. Even 2 storys up you can still hear excatly what they are talking about. It does not help that there is a firestation 100m down the street or that there is a party each night that last to ca 02.30 in the morning 20m from the hotel. So far this is the 2nd to worst hotel i've ever been to. If sleep is not for you i would reccomend it

title: best hotel in london
text: the best hotel I ever stayed in London, very clean, new furnature, all the equipments is there, spacious rooms, very excellent service, very nice reception people, very helpfull, close to all amenities, very near to the underground station (Old street station), very very safe area, the best night clubs are steps away(all for profissional people). I like it soooo much.

title: Brilliant Hotel, Excellent Value
text: great location, friendly staff, would definately book again.

title: Nicer than expected
text: Stayed here for a few nights with my sister and had a very lovely time. On arrival, we found The room we booked (studio) was not exactly suitable for us and the receptionist was very helpful in moving us to another with no fuss. The rooms are lovely, very well furnished and comfortable with clean linen and towels. There is a restaurant on the ground floor which serves amazing typical british food and lots of other convenient places to eat, drink or party nearby. For the amount we paid, i was very surprised to have received such service and quality. I would definitely reccommend this hotel to friends and family. We had a lovely time and were sad to leave.

title: NICE TRIP
text: I am satisfied with this place, very clean and comfortable rooms and polite and attentive staff. Rachel was really helpful. Thank you for the good stay.

title: Worst service ever!
text: Booked the Rivington Apartment Hotel several weeks prior to my business trip. Upon arrival I called the reception to notify them that I would check-in a bit later. Surprisingly, the receptionist told me, that they have some technical difficulties and they would not be able to provide me with a room that is actually pre-paid. Obviously it is impossible to find a room in London on the same day of arrival!! Unacceptable.

title: Pleasant Hotel
text: I came to London for two days. My company booked for me. I normally stay in hotel but to my surprise this was a lovely small studio apartment with a kitchen. I was checked in very quickly and the staff is very polite. I was provided with extra towels with no fuss. Room was clean and cheerful and loved my stay. I normally eat very light breakfast. I went to the Irvington bar downstairs and had my continental breakfast which was nice. I can definitely recommend this apartment hotel and will come back again. I am surprises about others who are complaining about services? Maybe now the staff is changed and the hotel has relished customer service is important.

title: Great Stay - Family Trip
text: I have had great time staying in the Rivington Hotel with my Wife and Two Children. I came from UAE for one week holiday break.... Staff were very polite and helpfull - we are leaving today and we will be be back in two months. I have no hesitation to recommend this Hotel for family stay..

title: “Good value and central location”
text: I stayed in a 'Executive' room for seven nights at the beginning of March. Room was clean, comfortable and came with free WiFi. The staff were lovely, always ready to help with any enquiries. The room was a reasonable size although nothing special. There was a fridge, a microwave, three sets of cutlery and crockery, and a sink. That was enough to make a decent breakfast. The room was very quiet, clean and comfortable. The staff were young, friendly and, generally, efficient. The prices is also very competitive. I wouldn't hesitate in recommending this hotel for business or pleasure. Big thumbs up from me! I would have no hesitation in staying here again. It is very good value indeed. Thanks

title: Pleasant stay
text: I stayed at this hotel from mid March to the end of April for 42 days and I can recommend it for a long stay like this. The booking process is very easy, you get e-mail confirmation straight away (I booked through the hotel's own web site. Check in procedure takes only 5 minutes. Throughout the whole duration of my stay the service provided by the personnel was close to perfect. The staff was very nice, helpful and attentive to details. I stayed at an Executive Apartment which has its own en suite bathroom and kitchen, small dining area and a settee to watch TV. The apartment has been newly refurbished to a high standard. I liked the style chosen by the designer very much. It is decorated with marble which makes the apartment luxurious and very clean. Daily cleaning service was provided free of cost. There was a washing machine in the room. Air Conditioner was also provided. Wide windows allowed penetration of lot of light in the apartment. Kitchen had everything one needs for long stay - kettle, toaster, electric hob, complementary tea and coffee, fridge and freezer, cutlery, saucepans, pans. There was no wall clock at the apartment and I asked the reception if they could provide one. They arranged for one literally in one hour. Extra towels were provided and were changed daily. Bed linen was changed once every week but if you request you can get it changed more often. The building itself is very attractive, built of brick and seemed to me to be very old. The location of the building is perfect. It is 4 minutes walk to Old Street underground station and walking distance to Liverpool street station. There are lots of bars and restaurants in the area and there is a famous Rivington Bar and Grill on the ground floor of the building. I owe much to my wonderful stay at London to these apartments and I surely recommend it to all visitors, business visitors, like me and holiday purposes.

title: JUST DON’T DO IT!
text: If you are thinking of reserving this, or Mount Apartments by the way, just don’t do it! Making a long story short, we ended up with no room in London, no assistance from the management and had to sleep on an airport hotel after 3 hours of searching for a room, and came back home the next day, 4 days earlier than we were supposed to. At arrival, no room was available due to water leaking/infiltrations issues - which, from other opinions on the internet that we should have seen previously from reserving the place, seems to be awkwardly frequent. After visiting the alternative proposed – Mount Apartments, which was obviously much further way from London Centre, apart from the fact that we did not enjoyed the neighborhood, or the distance to the subway – we tried to call Rivington Apartments for two hours to discuss other alternatives, but no one answered the phone. When we came back to Rivington Apartments, the receptionist was there with a paper in his hand that we had to believe was the refund of our money, and no one from the management to talk to – reception was closed and despite our insistence, no one was available in person or telephone. No help given - “now you are on your own” - together with a strange huge occupancy of rooms in London that night, gave us a 3 hour period whilst we thought we would not have a place to sleep that night. Our vacations were ruined, we left London the next day (we were supposed to stay there for 5 nights), with extra travel and accommodations expenses that we are still trying to get back. So please, don’t make the same mistake we did and do not reserve Rivington Apartments or Mount Apartments – without longer details, but in Mount Apartments we were also deceived and from what we understand the landlord is the same for both places.

title: Wonderful place to Stay
text: We stayed one week at Rivington Apartments in Feb 2012. This hotel is very special , Beautiful decor in our room, excellent service from everybody from the concierge to the room service. The food was excellent, the decor unforgettable. Everybody made us feel good. Perfectly located. We will choose this hotel again for sure and will remember the truly warm hospitality. You won't regret your stay.

title: Happy stay
text: It's my last day in London. I came here from Lithuania for work reasons and stayed in Rivington apartments for 62 days, my stay was very pleasant. The staff was very polite and helpful. My apartments was cleaned every day. I wasnt charged any extra from first till last day of the staying. I was able to take towels, soap or anything else i needed free of cost. had great time and i will ask my company to book this hotel again for my next visit.

title: Avoid!
text: I did not stay in this hotel but wanted to warn other guests. I booked my room 2 months in advance and the day before I was due to stay there, I received an email from Venere, saying that my reservation had been cancelled. I did not receive any contact from the apartment until after I had telephoned venere to complain. On contacting the apartments, they had flooded. They were unable to provide alternative accommodation at this notice and suggested I try a hotel in Stratford or waterloo. Very very unimpressed with the poor service and lack of help to make me an alternative reservation.

title: Dissapointed, not to be recomended
text: This is a strange place. Arrived at 12.30 pm. Room was not ready which was not a problem for us. We asked the reception if they could take care of our cases. "Yes they could" she replied but she would need to charge us 20 GBP per case "for insurance reasons". After I pointed out that this was very unusual she relented and only charged us 15 GBP for both cases. When we returned to the appartments at 6.00 pm another receptionist apologized that the room we had booked was very small but "he could offer us an executive room at a higher rate". We declined but the truth was that our room really was tiny. Actually bed and room was ok, at least clean and furnishings were new. Soundproofing inside the appartments and outside is non exsistant. Expect people to howl scream and shout outside your room and on the street on all nights including Sunday. Also loud techno music will go on until early mornings. We were here on a weekend trip so it was ok for us but expect no service or trimmings. After we checked in we didnt see any staff again at all.

title: Very good
text: I have read other reports and although I do not usually write reviews felt that I should do one for this place. I had no idea about the reviews on Tripadvisor before I made the booking and I was shocked when I read a couple of them after my stay. My experience was really positive for this place and cannot explain the negative experience of some of the travellers. I booked a studio apartment and as my flight was arriving late, after check in time, I contacted the hotel reception to inform them about my late arrival. They said somebody would specially come to the building to check me in and that I should not worry. I arrived by midnight and indeed I was warmly greeted by a receptionist. As I was very tired after a transatlantic flight, the receptionist quickly led me to the studio room. The room was tiny but the first thing that you would notice was its exceptional cleanliness and comfort. It had a large double bed, a tiny but very well equipped kitchen, a tiny but exceptionally clean and modern bathroom, a 26 inch flat screen TV which was just the right size for the room. I was told that in case I wanted a more spacious room I could get an upgrade to an Executive apartment the price of which was 135 pounds, but as they had it available that night they would give me a discount and I could stay there for as little as 85 pounds. As I was a single and only needed an apartment for myself, I said that I would stay in a studio room. I spent 1 week at the apartment and literally fell in love with the place. Good service was provided although the reception was not manned 24 hours. However they have a 24 hours contact number. I called as I needed extra towels in the room at around midnight and they sent somebody with fresh towels to my apartment. Then, in the evening The only question I had after my experience + after reading some of the negative reviews, particularly comments regarding the size of a studio apartment was: Why do they expect a palace when they book a studio room which the booking confirmation says is 15-20 square meters and when they book in a perfect location for 54-60 pounds. My impression was that this apartment was much more than I paid for and that nowhere in London I could get an apartment or service of the same standard for the price I paid. Recommended for those who do not expect a palace and are content with a clean and a comfortable room of a reasonable size, perfect service and a good location!

title: Excellent facilities and location
text: I had to book accommodation in London at very short notice (about 3 hours before arrival) so booked here simply because it was very good value and the location was perfect for my needs – as I was attending a conference on the City Road – and in spite of some of the bad reviews on here. I was a bit worried when I saw how small reception was but was very pleasantly surprised when I was placed in room 2 which turned out to be a very nicely sized apartment. The sleeping area had big double bed and two arm chairs and plenty of storage space. Satellite TV, DVD player iron and ironing board all provided, plus real coat hangers in the wardrobe. The room was decorated to a high standard and very clean. There was a door through to the dining area, which had a table and four chairs and a sofa. The kitchen was well equipped with 4 hob cooker, washing machine, dishwasher, fridge freezer etc. The units all looked new and in good condition. The bathroom was small, just a shower, sink and toilet but again was nicely decorated. The service from the receptionist was also friendly and professional all in all I had a very pleasant stay. The value for money I got was incredible for central London, I think I may have been upgraded on the deal I got due to a better room being available but it is always gratifying when a hotel does that rather than leave better rooms unoccupied. I would definitely go back if working that part of London in the future

title: Cheap but tiny
text: I had booked an Executive Deluxe Apartment and what I got was a cupboard for £100! The photographs on the website bore no resemblance to the actual room. The TV remote didn't work but as the room was so tiny I could change channels without having to move very far!! It was also very noisy, both from the outside and when people came in late at night resulting in not a lot of sleep. Convenient for where I was working and a good local restaurant on the corner but not a place I will be going back to in a hurry.

title: Where did they take the photos?
text: My room had been given to somebody else when I arrived, so was told if I wanted to stay I would need to pay more for an executive suite. I was then shown to a shoe box sized room. Yes there are flat screen TVs, but they are the size of a laptop screen. Yes there are kitchen facilities, but the only place you can sit is on the bed or the toilet. I agree with other reviews about the poor soundproofing, both from the noise outside and the TV from other rooms. They have cheap deals for a reason and I am suprised there are people saying they would go back. Very, very poor.

title: Don't stay here.
text: Dreadful hotel. First off, the hotel is right next to a night-club, which plays pounding music into the small hours (2 AM). There is no double-glazing or any soundproofing, so there's nothing for it but to stay awake. The staff are inept-for some reason, despite my having a reservation, it took them 20-minutes to check me in. Not what you want after a transatlantic flight. There is also no lift-you have to haul your bags up a few (not long, but inconvenient enough) staircases to make it up to reception. There is also no staff there in the evenings. The place was clean and near my office. That's all I can say that is good. Everything else, especially the pounding music all night long, was a nightmare.

title: Great location, well set up and well looked after
text: This small set of apartments is well looked after and very convenient to Old Street tube station, with Charlie Wright's music venue just around the corner and the delicious Breakfast Club very nearby too. Not that there's a great need for eateries nearby - the executive apartment's kitchen is extremely well appointed, right down to a spice rack (only thing missing for the Irish traveller was a potato peeler and a corkscrew!). Surprisingly quiet given the central location, just the sound of the building's airconditioning til roadworks started in the morning. Nice friendly staff. We were kindly upgraded due to maintenance work going on in the studio we had booked.

title: Reasonable Price - Reasonable Room
text: I booked to stay at this hotel via, hotels.com and got what seemed to be a good price. So good in fact that I booked a further 3 stays - one for 6 nights. After confirming (and paying in advance - non refundable) for the various trips I then decided to check Trip Advisor and was a bit gutted to see some of the negative reviews. I arrived at the hotel last night wondering what on earth the place was going to be like. I have to say, that I think I got decent value for money. The reviews that say the place isn't finsihed yet are probably accurate. I've seen a few workmen about the place and various bits of building materials in corridors waiting to be fitted. - but all the workers have been polite (and not noisy or early starters) and the materials are stacked neatly out of the way. We were upgraded to an execuitve room without charge (and without having to ask) by the really friendly receptionist. The room is of a decent size and standard for what we paid - and it is clean, furnished wiith OK stuff and I really don't have a problem. I'm a pretty fussy traveller and wouldn't hesitate to complain - but I can honestly say I feel I got good value for money at this place. My room was ready on time, it was clean, comfortable and I had a good nights sleep. I didn't pay a fortune and my experience was OK. I'm hoping that my 6 day stay next week will be just as good. I'll post again afterwards to update this review.

title: If this was the last hotel available in London, book a room in Essex.
text: We have had a truly awful time with this hotel. We booked in on the Thursday to stay three nights in a studio apartment which the website had described very nicely, upon arrival we where offered an upgrade to the deluxe family suite for only £30 extra per night, an offer we where very happy to accept. When we arrived at the room we had to wait for the builders to finish fixing something before we could get settled, the furniture in the suite was assembled awfully and builders continued right outside our door late into the evening. Early the next morning we received a knock at the door from who I assume was a general manager informing us that they needed to attach a number to our door, loud drilling ensued. The absolute worst of our Rivington experience came on Saturday morning when, once again, the general manager (he never introduced himself) woke us up at 9.30am informing us that due to a leak (which we have seen no sign of) we would have to move out of our suite and into a studio room like we had originally booked, all he could offer for this inconvenience was £30 back for the nights upgraded. We where told to be out by 11am. When we arrived at recieption with all of our luggage we where informed that the other room was 'not quite ready' so the storage cupboard was the best they could offer us for our bags, we arranged to come back to the hotel that evening to receive the full upgrade amount (£90) and an adequate room- what we arrived back to was £30 and a room that the builders where still building- half tiled, wet paint, no fitted kitchen, no wardrobe, no 4star accommodation. The staff where farcicle, unable to offer us anything at all, let alone s refund. We where told a manager was on there way and would arrive by 9pm (12 hours after we had to leave the suite) by 9.30pm no one had arrived and the same man we had been talking to all night handed me his mobile and had me speak to his supervisor who could offer absolutely nothing. All we could do was email the management on Monday and REQUEST that they CONSIDER giving us a partial refund as a full refund was completely out of the question. We have yet to hear anything back from them, no one has even uttered the word sorry let alone offer any compensation for our wasted weekend or the fact we had to pay for another hotel at 11pm on a Saturday night. This may not happen to every customer but we met a few people outside reception unhappy with the hotel or who had not even had their room reserved for them! If you do go ahead and book a suite here (you'd have to be insane) watch out for- •the terrible stair case. • the reception music is awful R&B played off of the receptionists laptop • the rickety furniture • there is no DVD/CD player • the shower is filthy • there where no fresh towels provided • underfloor heating in the bathroom WILL burn your bare feet • the builders are hard working, they start early and finish late • the building materials are stored in your corridor • you need to lock your door using your key, there is no thumb lock on the inside • people may walk into your room, there is no signage, so it's not always there fault. Again, lock your door! • no house keeping was offered If this is the only hotel available to you then please consider buying a tent and pitching up on Bethnal Green.

title: The worst customer service experience I have ever received, and they still owe me money!
text: Long story short, we were kicked out of our hotel due to 'plumbing issues', which it now seems very apparent is a scam, and offered nothing in the way of a viable alternative, a refund, or even an apology. It ruined our trip. DO NOT stay here!

title: Boutique feeling hotel but with none of the attitude
text: Stayed there over Xmas and had a great visit. The location can't be beat if you want to roam around Buckingham Palace or Big Ben in less than 10 minutes. The hotel feels like a boutique hotel even though run by Hilton and yet none of the staff had attitude and our kids felt welcomed. The rooms were very nice and actually spacious for London. Comfortable beds, nice linens and great small touches such as a Nescafe in the room and bottled water for free. I would highly recommend.

title: Amazing service
text: From the moment we checked into this hotel we could not have been happier, the rooms are quite spacious compared to other places we have stayed in London, and they were bright, fresh modern and clean and we found it to be a great central location.Staff went out of their way to make us feel very comfortable, taking the time to show us the restaurant, bar gym location, asking if we needed wake up calls, quickly organising our bags to the room, and very aware that we had just travelled 24 hours and wanted to get showered and changed, little details makes a stay here very special. Grant front of house was in particular was very helpful, will most definitely be staying here next time in London.

title: Fabulous location
text: a stunning hotel in a super location for the West End shopping and local attractions. Have stayed in many Hilton properties and thesis on of the best. A warm welcome when dropping bag en route to ROH, and again when we returned later that evening, lovely corner room very elegant over looking the street. A lovely buffet breakfast supplemented with some made to order dishes wonderful location, wonderful staff will b sure to visit in the future

title: Almost great
text: We stayed here for a couple of nights prior to lunch on the Orient Express. This is a good hotel, clean and efficient. The rooms are of a high specification and the pillows are incredible. Breakfast has a good selection and plenty of choice. Two minor irritations as to why i marked this hotel down are 1. Poor design in the shower (room 357) Your bathroom will get flooded and then you will end up mopping the floor unnecessarily because the wet room does not work as it should. 2. Two different tables for breakfast and both unstable. i do not expect wobbly tables in a hotel of this calibre Apart from this we enjoyed our stay and had a good nights sleep on both occasions.

title: The Best of the Best!
text: What an amazing experience at The Conrad! Every staff member we encountered was professional and cordial - from the front desk to the concierge to the breakfast staff and the bartenders in the lounge. The rooms are luxurious and inviting with every amenity. If you plan on days filled with sightseeing this is the place to stay since they have a phenomenal breakfast that will start your day right. And if that's not enough the Saint James station is right across the street! The perfect place to stay.

title: WONDERFUL
text: We were greeted by very attentive staff that were cheerful and very accomodating. We were escorted to our room and shown how all electronics functioned. We'd like to give a special shout out to the concierge named Max. He gave us straight forward info on everything we asked of him and he could not have been more accomodating. The hotel is smack dab in the middle of major sites, i.e. Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, Parliament, the Eye, River Thames cruises, etc. The underground trains called the Tube was literally right out the front door. Great take out is the Pret which is right around the corner and concentrates on whole fresh foods, salads, wraps, sandwiches and killer soups all at very inexpensive prices. Room service was prompt and efficient as was maid service. We can't say enough about how polite and cheery every member of the staff was. Whoever runs this hotel gets a 5 star rating from us. Keep up the good work. Room was spacious and sparkling clean as was the bathroom with seperate shower and bath. And the shower head! It was a huge rainstorm! There are speakers from the tv in the bath so you don't miss a thing. We will definitely stay here again. We stayed 8 days.

title: Excellent Stay
text: The hotel is newer and everything was very neat and tidy. All staff members were extremely nice. The coffee was the best we had during our trip. I know this seems trivial but very helpful with jet lag. The breakfast was excellent along with more superb service. I would definitely stay here again. The only negative aspect was the pillows. I have found this to be the experience at the majority of Hilton properties.

title: Lovely hotel, a few rather odd issues
text: My husband and I stayed here recently and while this is a well located lovely hotel with - I think - generally good to excellent service, we experienced too many little issues to give a full five stars. The hotel itself while small is very nice and very clean and our room was quite nice (though there was no view). It has a small lobby with a nice lounge next to it. We only stayed two nights, so it was not a lengthy stay. We have stayed at several Conrad properties, including the Conrad Koh Samui, the Conrad Singapore, and others, and have always been overwhelmed by their loveliness and excellence. This made the contrast with London's Conrad St. James a bit poignent. On our one full day in the hotel, our room was not made up until just before 4pm. We returned to the room around 3 and I was shocked that it had not been touched. I assume this was a temporary issue - but we only have the one data point. I had been offered a newspaper and clearly stated I wanted one, but one was never delivered. I found that a curious lapse as well in a hotel that prides itself on service. Finally, on our last day our room keys stopped working. Unfortunately, this was not resolved on the first try, but required multiple up and down trips to get a working key. With regard to food: we only ate breakfasts in the hotel. The staff at breakfast was nice and efficient, and I had been anticipating Conrad's usual over-the-top buffet breakfasts. Breakfast here is certainly nice but does not rise to the level of other Conrad properties

title: First class hotel in a great location
text: Amazing service, especially from Terry-Louise who was simply amazing. Great, friendly hotel in a good location with very professional staff. The place to stay in central London. Terry-Louise greeted us at reception and kindly gave a tour of the room and property, she went out of her way to ensure we had the perfect one-night weekend stay in London. This would be the perfect hotel for business or pleasure.

title: Excellent Hotel in London
text: There are many positives about this hotel. The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, the location is wonderful and overall the hotel is luxurious. Negatives to note are that the rooms are on the small size even by London standards and the rooms don't have views. I was staying for work so those factors were less of a consideration. Overall, a good choice to stay.

title: Luxurious treat
text: Stayed here for 1 night as part of a theatre and hotel deal with Show & Stay. This hotel is now the Conrad St James, and we had excellent service. We arrived just after midday expecting to have to leave our bags with the concierge but were checked in immediately and given an upgrade too. The room was spacious and immaculate, with walk in shower, separate bath, Nespresso machine and capsules, large TV. Bed was very comfortable, and the room was very quiet. Breakfast was very good, if we hadn't had the cooked breakfast as part of our deal, then we would have been extremely happy with the continental buffet on offer which had a great selection of cooked meats, cheeses, fresh bread and pastries, Bircher muesli, granola, cereal, smoked salmon, fresh and dried fruit, smoothies and yoghurt, etc. Very pleased with this hotel as we had chosen this as a treat for our anniversary, and would highly recommend.

title: Fabulous, Amazing Hotel!!
text: My husband and I recently stayed at this wonderful hotel. Location is perfect. It is across from the Underground - within walking distance to Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace and shopping on Victoria Street. The staff was probably the best staff we have ever encountered in all our travels, particularly Andy, one of the Concierges - incredibly friendly and helpful. Rooms were lovely and immaculate. Refreshments appeared magically each day. Views from the room were fair, but we took into consideration, we were in the city. Also had a lovely restaurant and bar. I will recommend this hotel to family and friends! Great stay.

title: My New Go To Accommodation In London
text: From having the front door opened for you upon arrival to the stylish elegance of the interior design, from jaw dropping pieces of art all over the hotel to reception staff who truly care if you have a great time, you know staying at The Conrad St. James will be a memorable experience. I have now named this hotel as my new home when in London. My experience was exceptional and each and every member of staff I encountered treated me very well. I can 100% recommend this hotel, ideal location (right opposite the entrance to the tube) friendly, caring staff, superbly appointed, well maintained stylish rooms, lovely food, well presented quality breakfast and to top it off an executive club that feels like a fine gentleman's club! Go visit The Conrad, tell them I sent you, You'll love it!

title: Superior service, beautiful atmosphere, amazing food!
text: This hotel is just perfect and exceeded all expectations. For a medium sized hotel, it manages to deliver an intimate feel and a perfect ambience. I just could not fault the service, at afternoon tea or in the restaurant. A special thanks to Weronika who looked after us during dinner and at breakfast, the service was great and she was an absolute pleasure. We will definitely be returning!

title: Fabulous
text: A great experience in a five stars hotel. Impeccable personal service. An excellent location to enjoy the city. Close to major parks and several notable monuments to visit. Also, a good communication with public transport.

title: Return visit
text: We stayed here in November 2015, and returned during a conference. George, the engaging young man at the front desk remembered us immediately before we checked in and welcomed us warmly. Beth set us up with a lovely large upgraded room, and we were able to enjoy breakfast in the Executive Room while we waited for our room to be prepared (early morning flight arrival). Benjamin from the south of France gave us excellent friendly and professional service every morning in the Executive Lounge. Great location between Buckingham Palace and Big Ben. Young Michael was great server at Blue Boar downstairs (we liked the Sunday Roast).

title: Wahoowa
text: We recently completed a 3 day stay at the property. It started off a bit bumpy due to an error on behalf of Hilton.com, but was identified by the reservations department, addressed with apologies and upgrades. Francesca, in reservations, was great and should kindly be identified as such. Also, Alessandro at check in is phenomenal. Property, location, and attention to detail was fantastic. Thanks for a great stay and your efforts.

title: Lovely hotel. Great bar!
text: I stayed here with a friend in July 2016. The hotel is in a convenient location, on a quiet road, right opposite St James's Park tube station. It's also walking distance from lots of sights such as Buckingham Palace and Westminster. From the minute we arrived the service was fantastic. Our deluxe twin room was spacious with a huge bathroom (separate bath and shower). Lots of little touches in the room such as bottles of water on the bedside tables, slippers and mats next to the bed and a great range of toiletries. The beds were extremely comfortable! Breakfast was delicious with a good selection of hot and cold food. The staff at the hotel were very professional and helpful. I would not hesitate to stay here again.

title: A great find!
text: My wife and I stayed here for two nights on her first trip outside the US. The hotel was everything one would expect from the Conrad name. What sets this place even higher is the concierge John White and his staff. The attention to detail and knowledge of the area made the beginning of our European adventure truly memorable. We are looking forward to our next stay at this hotel!

title: Luxury Hotel
text: The Conrad is a luxury hotel with very friendly staff. The location is perfect - close walking distance to the major tourist attractions and across the road from St James Park underground station. There are also a large number of good pubs and restaurants within close walking distance. The staff are very helpful in answering questions re best restaurants, train travel etc. Highly recommended.

title: Enjoyable stay
text: We had a very enjoyable stay at the Conrad London St. James hotel earlier this month. The beds were comfortable, and the bathrooms were huge, with a shelf by the window big enough to hold lots of essentials. We enjoyed the Executive Lounge for quick breakfasts and snacks. All the staff members were professional and pleasant, but special kudos to concierges Tom, Andy, and Ardit, who, with patience and good humor, answered all our questions, both before our stay and during it, greatly enhancing our visit with their guidance and recommendations.

title: Amazing hotel in the city centry
text: Perfect service - everything well organized for business events. Extraordinary food and amazing breakfast. We have hosted a event for 80 people there and the feedback was overwhelming. Great location.

title: Great experience
text: I loved the place it was great experience my family enjoyed it so much. I advice people to go visit and enjoy. It's very close walking to Big Ben watch and just across the Underground station so please visit and enjoy

title: Good location, etc
text: So this place was really nice. The room was beautifully appointed, and the bathroom was huge considering the rest of the room was small. It was right across the street from the St. James underground, and about a 5-10 minute walk to Buckminster, and Westminster Abbey/ Big Ben. And the front desk staff were very friendly and helpful. The hotel was nicely decorated. Major downsides for me: 1) The scent they used to clean and decorate. It smelled like really strong cheap men's cologne which gave me a migraine virtually the whole time I was there. 2) It seems like the cleaning supervisor maybe takes the tips of the cleaning staff. Why do I say that? We left the tip on the last day on the desk, and as we were leaving, the supervisor (she was wearing a nicer suit/ hotel uniform as opposed to the cleaners' uniforms we'd seen), went in. My husband forgot something in the room, so he ran back up less than 2 minutes later. The tip was gone. I know this unfair practice happens all over the place, but I was unpleasantly surprised to see it happen at an upscale London hotel. 3) Be prepared for the hotel to hold at least a full-night's fee on your card as insurance (ours is still pending on our card, waiting for the charge to drop). 4) The shower door doesn't lock the water in (the indentation for the water to stay inside the shower stall is less than 1/4 inch), so it was a bit stressful to take as quick a shower as possible so as not to make a huge watery mess on the floor. 5) The room had several lights that wouldn't shut off at night which kept on waking me up- a lime green light which I think was part of the fire alarm system, the alarm clock which was really bright, and the TV wall watch which would randomly blink. I unplugged the alarm clock but the other two light distractions were glaringly there and woke me up every night.

title: Iffy start but hotel redeemed itself. A lovely stay all in all.
text: Good central location for everything. Pretty safe as only a few footsteps from Scotland Yard!! Didn't use the tube but the station is a stones throw away. Not a 'grande dame' type hotel (like Sofitel building or Ritz) but I actually preferred it to the Sofitel of which I normally opt for. Better room, nicer staff, less touristy, just as modern and sumptuous inside. Stayed late December 2014 for three days (actually added to my booked 2 night stay whilst there because it was so pleasant). Hotel was beautifully decorated for Christmas. Did have a hiccup on check in which I subsequently forgave them for - a very tall lady checked us in but my prior written request for an upper floor quietly situated room got ignored. She explained that all other rooms of my chosen category were taken and she allocated us a lower floor room that looked over the side street where there was a pub

title: Family stay at Conrad London St.James
text: Great location and great hotel! Close to everything and easy to get around. Right next to the train station and bus service. Hotel is very clean and has a great Executive Lounge, staff is very attentive. Irina in Executive Lounge was amazing and very attentive to our kids. Concierge is very knowledgeable and provided us with very useful information. Rooms are very clean. Will stay here again.

title: Lovely part of London, great service
text: My husband and I stayed for a night at the Intercontinental Westminster in December to celebrate my birthday after booking it last minute through Secret Escapes with a great discount. The hotel is located right next to St James Park tube station, and is just around the corner from Westminster Abbey. It's in a beautiful area of London. We had a Superior room, which was a good size, and it had a separate bath tub and shower. The view from the room wasn't great, maybe it's because we were on the 2nd floor at the back of the building. The bed was exceptionally comfortable, the temperature in the room was great and easy to change quickly. The staff were all very friendly, and room service was quick. The hotel seems to have more of a business feel to it rather than a touristy feel. I would recommend this hotel if you can get a good deal, the location is great, it's very clean and comfortable. A very enjoyable stay.

title: Perfect start to a perfect vacation. LOCATION BABY!!!
text: Loved the Conrad!! From the staff to our AMAZING clean, well stocked and serviced rooms to the private bfast and afternoon treats, the Conrad is THE place to stay. Literally a 2 minute walk to major attractions (Westminster, Big Ben) and a short walk to T Square, Pic Circus, B Palace and the parks! You can't go wrong! The room service was fab as well. The Blue Boar bar was a fun place to either start or end your night (or both for us:) and the staff there were all so friendly and remembered us and our orders after only a day! Well managed for sure. Would definitely recommend staying here, book it!!

title: I will not, I repeat, I will not stay anywhere else if I ever come back to London.
text: We arrived at 7:30 am after a long overnight train from Scotland and were greeted with open arms. We never imagined that they would have a room available, but luckily we were shown right to a room and the room was splendid! It the perfect size with a huge bathroom including a separate tub along with a stand up shower. Every part of the room was opulent and comfy and served as a great home base for our week in London. Since we are Hilton Honors members we had access to the Executive Lounge and it became the highlight of the Hotel. We ate breakfast in the Lounge each day before sightseeing until about 4 pm, came back for afternoon tea (including sandwiches and pastries), freshened up, and then went back to the Lounge at 5:30 for drinks and finger food before heading out for our evening plans. There were several days that we didn’t even have to eat dinner afterwards as the food was so good in the Lounge. The Lounge was also a good spot to meet other travelers and compare itineraries. The staff at the hotel were also top-notch. Everyone went out of their way to ensure we had a wonderful stay. When we booked the hotel, we mentioned that we would be celebrating our birthdays and anniversary during our stay. The staff provided us with a tray of pastries and fruit one night and also decorated our room and bathroom in rose petals. This was completely unexpected and such a nice touch. I can not stress enough how convenient the location. Yes, it is across the street from the St James’ Park tube station where you can hop on the Circle & District tube line, but it is also a short walk to the bus stop and within walking distance to many attractions. We spent a great deal of time researching all of the London Hilton properties while planning our trip and are so pleased with our choice. Book it!

title: Top Hotel
text: Pros: Excellent service in all areas from check in to check out. Very quick check in. Ultra fast internet. Extremely comfortable bed. Location. Close to a lot of tourist attractions. St. James station right across the street. Cons: Can't think of any.

title: Excellent hotel
text: This hotel is conveniently located with walking distance to Buckingham Palace, london eye, big Ben, and Westminster. It is also across the street from a major tube station. The hotel staff is extremely professional. I highly recommend this hotel.

title: Amazing Property
text: This was a birthday stay with my wife and we have both stayed here before and love this hotel. The location is great and st james tube just over the road, doormen always welcoming and the front desk staff are great. Rooms are super modern and clean and always get a great nights sleep here. I cant recall the room type. Did see the duplex suite they have and its on my wish list. The lounge is great both for evening happy hour and also breakfast in the morning although some items are chargeable now which I dont think should happen in a lounge, this may have changed again I dont know. Always wanted to try the sunday roast in the blue boar and it was lovely and worth the wait. Great service too. I would recommend this hotel as a place to stay, a place for afternoon tea which they do sometimes themed or even a place for dinner or after work drinks. The Conrad St James is my go to place when in the area. Look forward to my next stay whenever that might be. 5 out of 5 from us.

title: Modern new IC in the heart of London
text: I love this IC property! During our 6 nights stay in the UK capital, we enjoyed our room and hotel. Overall, it was great oasis, +33 outside and beautifully chilly inside. Great location. Great staff. Great room. The only issue is a lack of breakfast spots in the area.

title: Quick vacation in London
text: Hotel location is great. Walking distance to Big Ben, London eye... Hotel itself is really well maintained. Our suite was large, comfortable and clean. Breakfast had a nice selection from the buffet. Quiet and relaxing unlike so many loud and rushed breakfasts I have experienced in the past.

title: What a wonderful week!!!
text: My daughter and I decided to treat ourselves to London for our birthdays. One of the best decisions we made was the Conrad St. James hotel! Talk about location. Just a hop, skip and a jump from Westminster, Parliament, and Buckingham Palace. Our room was gorgeous and spacious, but the staff the highlight! Aden?, in guest services, Julia in the bar, and Dave the doorman in his purple coat and top hat were among our favorites. The Executive lounge was great and housekeeping was amazing. I would give the hotel 5 stars. Our ONLY complaint was that our morning coffee pods were not replenished routinely. Otherwise, a flawless stay. Thank you, CSJ!!!!

title: Serenity Despite tube strikes, floods and general chaos
text: Close to the London underground. Great Location. Arrived at 4am due to flights and had bought an extra night accommodation in anticipation of this. Of course the concierge at 4 in the morning had no idea and thought our booking was cancelled despite giving them formal notice. Our Bedroom was give a twin share rather than a double. Difficult as my wife is pregnant. After that initial hurdle we were shown to the rooms. The rooms were spacious and modern. The TV was inbuilt into the wall with a large glass frame. The Showers a little strange as they only closed inwards meaning you'd had to be stuck in the corner just to enter the shower. Room service was acceptable but prices were a little hight. Great Beds to sleep in and very detailed clean the following day. The staff (except for the lady checking us in at 4am) were all very keen to help.

title: Continues to be excellent in all aspects of services
text: So it's a year since my last review and I really do stay a lot at this hotel and I wanted to refresh my comments and rate the facility. I would guess I have stayed @ The Conrad - St James’s Park about 12-14 times over the last year. The hotel went through a lot of management changes about a year or so ago and they have continue to grow and deliver and I have to say they really do go beyond to make sure your stay is the most comfortable in every way. Previously I know a lot have mentioned that the concierge staff can be in your face but I have to say this really has scaled back a lot - they are available to help in anyway but they are not pushy in anyway whatsoever. The front desk service is excellent - yes I know it's easy for me to say because I stay a lot but they do go above and beyond for all guests. While everywhere needs constant updating the hotel continually are working on refresh programs they really do have exceptional rooms and I have stayed in a lot of them. Don’t think twice about it - just stay here.

title: Oksana from Kyiv, Ukraine
text: I very much enjoyed my stay at this hotel. Would definitelly choose it for my future visits as well as recommend it to my friends. The location is perfect, the service was excellent and the interior - luxurious. The bed was extremelly comfortable and I truly look forward to staying at this hotel next time I am in London.

title: Quiet London weekend location
text: Westminster may not be the place you first think about when looking for a hotel in London but the Conrad has good walking access to many of the top sight seeing areas. Located on a quiet street ( weekend) it literally is opposite a tube station if you want to move further around the city. The hotel has been recently refurbished to a Conrad and feels very fresh. The rooms are very comfortable with an excellent bed and great bathroom. We didn't eat in the hotel so I cant comment on the food or service. Top marks to for their very helpful concierge who I am sure will increasingly become an important feature in this hotel.

title: Second to None!
text: My daughter and I took at trip to London and Paris. Stayed at the Conrad the last night before before our flight back to the States. We only stayed one night but I wish we had stayed there the entire time while in London. I have rarely experienced the customer service I did while at the Conrad. Fruit in our room as welcome. Room service was like fine dining at a restaurant. Room itself was well furnished, clean and spacious. I stayed at the Waldorf the first part of my London stay and although the Waldorf was nice, it does not compare to Conrad. If you are torn between the two, Conrad all the way.

title: Wonderful location and great service!
text: We stayed here for a mother/daughter trip to London. Location is fantastic. Near all of the sites and the underground, very safe and calm neighborhood. Service was wonderful from the first greeting at the door to checkout. We had dinner in the restaurant one night. Good was adequate and again the service was great. Tea one afternoon was fabulous. Can't think of a better place to stay in London!

title: Perfect honeymoon hotel!
text: First, the hotel is gorgeous! Second, the moment we walked in we were greeted by just about everyone! The guest relations man was just wonderful. Room was beautiful and clean and gave hat perfect London feel with all the needed amenities and more!

title: Supereb stay
text: From the moment you step out of the Taxi you are welcomed warmly by the door staff. They offer to take your Bags straight away and are so polite. Check in was fairly seamless when they located our booking. Staff offered to take the bags to the room, we declined however they did show us to the lifts, The room was stunning and the bathroom was lovely. Couldn't fault at all.
