Breakfast was good but could have been slightly better organised. We weren't explained what we were able to have or not. The bar was nice and the atmosphere was just right. All the staff that we came across were lovely and friendly and I would definitely be going back.

title: Fantastic Night
text: I was in town for business and had an extra night to spend in the city. Using my Hilton points I decided to stay at this property. From the time I checked in to the unfortunate time I had to checkout I had a wonderful time. At check-in I was greeted by a very warm and welcoming front desk agent (who's name escapes me at the moment, but she was French from France), she saw that I was from Quebec and we started to speak French, it was a pleasure. She was very charming and professional and was able to give me a great rundown of the hotel and the amenities that it offered. I was given an upgrade and had access to the executive lounge which served breakfast in the morning, snack during the day (I believe, I was out for the day so I would not know), and at night they had hors d'oeuvres. Service in the lounge was very nice and it was a quiet place as well. There are many options at breakfast, enough to please anyone. The concierge was able to recommend a good restaurant within walking distance of the hotel, which was called M (it is a steakhouse). The hotel is wonderfully located within walking distance of all the major attractions that London has to offer. I tube stop can be found just across the way. Shopping is also only a shart walk away (15 minutes or so). The room I had was fantastic. Tall vaulted ceiling with a large washroom with bath and walk-in shower. I even received a beautiful fruit platter. I included some photos in my review. Very clean and a wonderful night's rest on that bed. The turndown service is a very nice touch. My stay at the Conrad was short, but when I return it will surely be back to the Conrad.

title: A lovely experience once again!
text: Stayed for 4 nights in Dec 2017 and highly commend the Manager and front desk staff Yusri for making my check in experience a wonderful one even though I arrived around 11am (4 hours ahead of the usual check in time). She ensured I got my room almost immediately and when I complained about the entrance to the first Suite, the Manager also took the time to show me around a couple of Suites to make sure I got one I was happy with. The executive lounge staff too were very very nice. The only down side I experienced was a couple of staff at the blue boar restaurant downstairs when I went for breakfast there once whose customer service wasn’t that great. But overall a lovely stay. This is my second stay at The Conrad St James and I’ll definitely stay again.

title: Great luxury stay!
text: Truly luxury stay for 5 nights (left day after Prince George of Cambridge was born!). This is just next to St James's Park tube station, easy to walk around, or via Underground to most historical sites in London. The hotel is relatively new, built within the historical Queen Anne's Chamber. Even better that we had an upgraded room due to Ambassador status.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: We recently stayed at this hotel and were delighted with the standard and service and would highly recommend it. The rooms were very nice, modern and clean. The breakfast staff couldn't do enough for us and the buffet was good. In a great location. If I have one gripe it would be that we tried to obtain a special rate for our guesses from the front desk before as we were their for a family function and booked more that 20 rooms, with about 67 nights, but found it cheaper on the internet! Check the internet first!

title: Brief but brilliant
text: I decided to surprise my wife with a night at the Conrad St James last Saturday as a prelude to our stay at the Conrad Algarve (2nd visit) in late March. We had room 645 - 1 bedroom suite with lounge access. Through the Conrad app I contacted the concierge and asked for a bottle of champagne in the room for us which I fully expected to pay for. This was provided as well as some chocolate strawberries free of charge! Brilliant. The room was cavernous and very comfortable. The room service was prompt and courteous. All of the staff were incredibly polite and helpful. This seems to be one of the Conrad's qualities. Shame it was only for the one night - wish I could afford to stay longer! Can't wait to visit the Tokyo one next year! You won't be disappointed.

title: MR
text: Thank you to all the friendly and professional staff of the Conrad Hotel to make our short stay very special. Thank you to the chef for the special treat. Breakfast delicious and well presented. We will come back. Regards Mourad & Grazia

title: Fantastic location, service and executive lounge!
text: Our week at the Conrad St. James was wonderful, assisted by surprisingly excellent weather for March (our daughter thinks London is a sun destination). The service was first rate, and the executive suite was perfect for a family of three. The staff brought in a real bed (not a rollaway, or sofa bed) which our daughter loved though it did delay her from getting up bright and early (too cosy). We had checked out the lounge option, and the person on the Conrad hotel line told us it was so good that we would not need to eat anywhere else. We were skeptical, but she was right with great breakfast, tea and appetizers and drinks later in the day

title: Great hotel, great location.
text: I stayed in this hotel for business on its second week of opening. Amazing modern hotel, with spacious rooms and lovely bathrooms. Very well equipped room with Nespresso Machine and Kettle for hot drinks. I was in the executive room with access to the club lounge, which was very well laid out and equipped as well. Nice variety of snacks and food all day and breakfast was very well selected. Staff is also very attentive, despite some issues which I think had to do with the soft opening. The gym was not yet open. TE hotel location is outstanding a 2min walking distance from Big Ben and e House of Parliament. Also St. James Train station is literally on the other side of the street, very continent. Recommended for business and family.

title: westminster Winner
text: tucked away near Westminster Abbey and opposite a tube station makes this an ideal location for sightseeing as we found for the New Year's Day parade. As Hilton Gold Honours customers we were upgraded to a delightful room. Hotel facility changes had to be made as it was the 31st of December but sitting and eating in the lounge was a pleasure. We had asked the concierge for the nearest mobile phone shop and were delighted when he helped us cure the phone problems without needing to leave the hotel. The staff were helpful and welcoming and the breakfast was delicious. We will return.

title: Very good hotel in great location
text: My husband and I stayed at the Conrad St James as a birthday treat and we thoroughly enjoyed it. We arrived at midday and were able to access our room straight away. I had taken the option to upgrade on booking and we had a very nice executive suite and access to the executive lounge. The room, although not huge was luxurious and very comfortable. Everything was clean and we had very nice Molton Brown toiletries to use. The executive lounge was brilliant for a pre dinner drink and the staff even put strictly on the TV for me! Bed was very comfortable and room was quiet apart from a slight rumble from the tube below. Breakfast in the executive lounge was well cooked and relaxing. Hotel is very well situated for walking to Westminster, Covent Garden and the West End and although we were not doing a tourist thing it would be a great base for exploring.

title: A good stay
text: Stayed at the Conrad london as normal!when I'm in london,good stay clean, hospitable and the makings of a great hotel. Wonderful staff and a big thank you to micheala and her team for a wonderful and memorable stay, and not to the chef responsible for ruining my dinner arrangements.

title: Not worthy of your 5 stars!!!!
text: Booked to stay here through last minute.com and it was a top secret hotel, although didn't see what the secret was after a disappointing stay. Started with confusion on arrival about the room type we had. A member of staff was dealing with the issue and kindly explained it wasn't there fault and they couldn't help any further. That's fine my husband got on the phone to last minute to try and resolve the issue and the staff were gossiping and giggling whilst looking over at us! Very childish and unprofessional. I am heavily pregnant and not once was we offered a seat in the lounge to get a drink whilst we were sorting this fiasco out. My husband went back to speak with the staff member and another lady intervened who was dam right rude in her tone of voice to him and I was appalled. She spoke to him like he was thick when he fully understood what had previously been explained to him. We eventually got the manager out concerning the issue who was very apologetic and helpful. He sorted the problem out as best he could although this cost us an extra £72! The manager had us sent some complimentary chocolates which was nice. Our room was very nice. The bathroom certainly had the wow factor and the tv in the wall was a snazzy idea. Our bed was really uncomfortable unfortunately and the pillows were way too soft so had to keep folding them up which was a pain. Room had a nice Bose sound system in which could be played in the bathroom also which was great. A few niggles were, outside noise, no shaving foam, no hotel information pack, no pool, glass doors in bathroom were a hazard as husband trapped his fingers in them, leak under sink. I also must note that there was no floor to ceiling mirror which was odd. 1 mirror was there and it was in the bathroom. There was no plug socket in there for hair straighteners and no plug within reachable distance out the bathroom so where exactly should you do your hair? Very strange. It was silly things really that built up to be a big deal as it started badly and was one thing after another. The following day we decided to take tea in the bar so was seated and started to look at the menu. There were 4 staff members on, chatting may I add and we still hadn't been served 20 mins later. Then a female staff member dropped and smashed a glass and said for f** k sake rather loudly which I've never seen before in a 5*. We had reached boiling point so swiftly left and went to our room. The staff on the door entrance were nothing but polite and helpful the whole duration of our stay. Maids were all lovely and professional. The room service was very fast, faster than the bar anyway. So overall was disappointing for what we paid and I have had much better in London than this in a 4*. Real shame. I think the front desk staff need retraining in how to speak with customers in difficult situations and maybe be a bit more helpful like supplying a drink whilst waiting etc. It's not something that would typically happen every day so allowances should be made really. Believe me if these things had of been done this review would be very different.

title: Three nights away
text: My husband and I stayed at the Conrad hotel In an executive room for 3 days, as we had also stayed in the Conrad suites hotel in Bali last November/December & it was absolutely amazing. So we we stayed in the Conrad in London. We wasn't disappointed it was just as amazing. You can use the executive lounge if you stay in these rooms. You get afternoon tea daily at 3pm-5.30, & it's gorgeous. A delicious selection of finger sandwiches & cakes. Then from 5.30 until late 7.30 it's cocktails. This is all in with the price of the executive room. The staff are all highly trained & so helpful. The hotel is beautiful & it's situated central to everything, with a tube station straight across the road. The breakfast is also delicious, with a fantastic choice of anything you want really. We will be visiting again shortly.

title: Beautiful hotel, fantastic location
text: Conrad London St. James is a beautiful hotel with lovely rooms. Conveniently located next to one of Scotland Yard's offices (making it a relatively safe place), a tube stop is across the street, and Westminster Abbey is a few blocks away. Wonderful service and very pleasant. Would highly recommend.

title: Amazing London
text: Absolutely fabulous hotel. In the heart of Central London and walking distance from the Westminster Abbey,London Eye, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace. Easy navigation as its close to St.James station and Westminster Abbey. The rooms are very nice, amazing ambience, great breakfast offering. The support staff and hotel team is very well mannered ,helpful and kind. The hotel is high end hotel and if you are looking for a budget travel, this may not be the right place, but if you are looking for some lifestyle, a bit of luxury feel and some English culture, you should enjoy this.

title: Almost there, but not quite
text: Stayed here for three nights following a transatlantic cruise. We were booked with a senior rate. We wanted to extend for one additional night and they wanted over 250 pounds more for that night. That's about $400 additional over our existing rate. They would not bend on that either. So, off we go and we get to tell our story to the world. The restocking of towels and coffee pods was always incomplete and we had to call reception for these. The hotel is nice and in walking distance to many attractions. My original review was going to be five stars stating that we got what we paid for, but unfortunately they didn't live up to our expectations. And because of this we will not stay here again. The competition is too stiff and there are just so many other hotels to choose from.

title: amazing hotel
text: This is the best Hilton that I have ever stayed in and it puts other Hilton to shame! The service was excellent and the breakfast was amazing quality. All the staff couldn't do enough for you and made the stay more enjoyable and special.

title: Snails pace.
text: Came here for afternoon tea on a Saturday. Arrived at 16:40 seated and ordered by 16:50 then waited for 25 minutes for sandwiches and scones! Tea and cakes arrived another 20 minutes after the sandwiches were finished! The offer was unlimited champagne ! Well we got two glasses!!!! Not that we wanted bottles of the stuff but glasses were left empty for ages before any more was offered. Overall a managerial failing not the waiting staff who tried their best in the face of overwhelming patrons.

title: Wonderful Hotel!!!
text: My daughter and I stayed at this hotel the end of September 2018. It is in a wonderful location, walking distance to Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, London Eye, Big Ben, etc. Wonderful customer service, clean rooms and property. The executive lounge is wonderful as well. Upon arriving our room was not ready so we went to the executive lounge for breakfast. I guess I was tired due to the long trip from USA. I had a couple of cups of coffee and began feeling unwell. Turns out I had caffeine jitters!! The young men in the lounge, took great care of me and fixed me a cup of camomile tea along with lots of water! The one young man, I wish I could remember his name, was just so kind! I finally began feeling better and was able to enjoy the rest of our 8 day stay. We really enjoyed our time here in London and particularly in this wonderful hotel!!

title: Wonderful location
text: So easy to get around. We used the underground and went everywhere or walked. Big Ben was right there as were most of the "big" venues. We took the tube to Notting hill and then walked back, past Buckingham palace. The room was very nice, as diamond members, we were upgraded and the executive lounge was perfect for us. We went downstairs to the Big Boar for breakfast. Very pretentious wait staff, food blah. The food and amenities in the lounge met our needs. The staff in the lounge, particularly a young Australian woman Beth was the most helpful. She made sure we knew exactly where to find our spots, had to find the blue door from the movie Notting hill, etc. We had one meal at the ACE cafe and it was wonderful, though $20 for fish and chips is a little pricey. London in general was very expensive. I wanted to go to the tower of London and see the town jewels, however, the admission was $60/person...No way, so I bought the book, plus it was very crowded. You can get the general feel by walking around and across the Tower Bridge. The theater was charming. We saw Phantom of the Opera, every bit as good as Broadway in New York and the actress playing Christine, Celunde Schoenmaker was superb, great voice and great personality. WOW. Warning, we took the hotel limo to the airport which cost $150 dollars, but because of the traffic, it took 1.5 hours to get to Heathrow, a cab would have broken the bank.

title: Fourth Annual Visit ... Still Heaven
text: I have reviewed this hotel before, but we just returned from our annual one week stay, so I thought I should provide an update. And demonstrate that we continue to put our money where my mouth is! We spend a week each year going to theater in London, and I admit I have been tempted to "stray", and occasionally will click on a hotel closer to the West End. (this is about a mile away, and is an easy tube ride, or actually a very nice walk.) However, I never get farther than that, because once you have encountered perfection, why tamper with it? The bottom line here is that it is the absolute best night's sleep anywhere. Somehow, they have soundproofed the rooms into complete silence, and the beds and bedding are the most comfortable anywhere. As soon as I get home each year, I can't wait to return!

title: Hotel with modern service, situated in royal center of London
text: I stayed in a King Grand Deluxe Room, the size of the room and closet were comfortably large. The marble washroom was very large. I had room service dinner for the first night, and used laundry service several times during my 5-night stay, and I was very satisfied with all of them. The breakfast buffet offered all necessary choices for English breakfast. The location is very good, and I don't think it requires me to list the tourism attractions nearby for readers of this website. The hotel is facing the tube station (St. James's Park) and that makes my daytime-outing travel extremely convenient. The hotel is situated in an area with few pedestrians after dawn, but it is quite safe. My room did not have a good view, and it was just other gray office buildings

title: Not as good as I'd hoped
text: Booked through Lastminute. Check in is 3pm, but I arrived 2:15. OK to be asked if I would wait in the bar area, but no one took the effort to come find me when the room was ready. TV didn't work or respond to remote. That was fixed when I was out for the day. Main revolving door failed while I was there. Wifi speed was v poor and having paid a lot for the room I felt it was cheeky to be asked to pay for quicker speed. Hotel well placed for Westminster.

title: Smooth and stylish
text: This is a very smooth and stylish hotel indeed, from the check in to the concierge it is done very well indeed. The rooms are very comfortable with really nice bathrooms and a super comfy bed with just the right amount of bounce. Location is excellent to walk in Westminster and explore London.

title: Excellent location
text: I stayed at this hotel about a year ago, and for some reason forgot to add my review. The hotel is situated in an excellent yet quiet location. Its just behind Buckingham palace, and literary a 12 seconds walk to the St James Park tube station. This is not only important for accessibility but on rainy days you cross the street and your good to go without getting drenched. The breakfast in the morning was really good. I have had more lavish breakfasts in Dubai and Asia, but what is on offer is more than enough to satisfy all tastes. Rooms were nice, relatively modern an dupto what you would expect from a Conrad. I do recall that there was an issue with the shower as water was escaping out due to how they are setup. The hotel needs to look into this issue. Otherwise all in all, I was very comfortable with the rroms I would recommend the fish & chips in the hotels pub. There is also a pub around the corner from the entrance to the hotel, the drinks are fine there but the food is so/so. The heating was not working in my room, but maintenance was quick to fix it. The problem the was so dirty it was clogged. I was surprised at that since this is usually a standard maintenance that should be cleaned periodically. This not only prevents proper functioning but also reduces chance of allergies and viruses circulating the rooms from previous guests. Overall Im was happy with my 3 night stay and would look to stay here again.

title: Only the best!
text: The room, the bathroom, the bed, everything was amazing! The bathroom was heaven with a waterfall shower. Beautifully done. It was a wonderful hotel. The room is decorated beautifully and is very comfortable.

title: Every time it hasn't disappointed
text: This was the 4th time my wife and I have stayed here, and we continue to really be impressed by the Intercontinental Westminster. The team are diverse, friendly and professional. As many reviewers have commented the location is just superb. A little bit of street noise and the vibration from the Tube stations are very small negatives, so if you are a very light sleeper perhaps this may be an issue, but where in Central London can be completely quiet? What we like the most about this hotel is that it's not too large , not too small. It has space and style and so we feel a little bit special as soon as we walk in the door. We will keep coming back.

title: Fantastic position, lovely staff
text: Many people reviewing this hotel seem to be regulars. We are infrequent visitors to London and picked this hotel on the positive reviews and its fabulous position. We are not UK residents and London prices are quite expensive for us, but the Conrad seemed good value for the level of quality. We were not disappointed. We travel for pleasure a fair amount and like to be quite independent in our transfers. We caught the train from Heathrow, changing at Hammersmith, and we were in the hotel in about an hour from the airport. And all for £6! The only steps were leaving St James station (no lift) and then the hotel was just over the road. We're tourists, so we were delighted to be so close to St James Park, Westminster Abbey, etc. We walked everywhere, to the galleries and museums, along the Thames (criss-crossing the bridges), Piccadilly Circus, a West End musical and much more. We only had 4 days in London, but the great position of the hotel allowed us to make the most of our stay. As to the hotel, the king bed room was comfortable and well appointed, the complimentary Nespresso machine was appreciated. The breakfasts were very well done (although I do prefer something with a bit more Asian influence). However, I think it is the staff that makes this place. They were unfailingly friendly, helpful and efficient and it seemed very genuine and spontaneous. We would definitely recommend this hotel to overseas visitors to London.

title: Our favorite hotel in London
text: This is a wonderful boutique hotel, centrally located between Westminster and Buckingham Palace. The rooms are very comfortable and, the Executive Lounge is wonderful. The staff makes you feel welcome during your entire stay. My husband and I travel to London once or twice a year and always stay here.

title: Conrad London St James
text: A very comfortable stay in a well appointed hotel with friendly staff. Nice bar too.Situated, despite it's proximity to Parliament Square, in a relatively quiet area. Would be great if there was a pool.

title: Great Hotel
text: This is a lovely completely renovated hotel which is clean, modern and very central to all of the tourist attractions. The property has a friendly staff, and the breakfast is good. Beds are comfortable and it is very quiet.

title: Incredible Hotel
text: I stayed here for two nights and wish I stayed for a lot longer. The Conrad brand is strong all around the world, and London is no exception. This hotel excels in customer service, and that was evident the duration of my stay here. The rooms at this hotel really impressed me. Bed was comfortable, bathroom was huge, and had a Bose bluetooth speaker in the ceiling--so that was pretty awesome. Views from the room aren't that impressive, but no big deal. Water pressure in the shower, which is how I gauge any hotel, was solid. Turndown service was a nice touch as well. Breakfast in the morning was A+. Overall, very satisfied, especially with Hilton HHonors recognition at the property. Location is a good area and the tube is directly across the street so getting around is pretty effortless. Tons of stuff to do within immediate walking distance, too. Would absolutely stay here again, and recommend this hotel for anyone. Top notch all around.

title: An incredibly disappointing Conrad in London.
text: We spent 3 nights at the hotel at the beginning of December. The hotel is very centrally located, next to the St. James underground station – a 10 minutes walk from Buckingham palace and a 15 minutes walk from Westminster. We checked in at 14:30 and despite checking in also online, our chosen room (525) was not ready, so we were assigned a Deluxe room – room 503. The reception is located in a lovely lobby. Despite being Honors Diamond member and other rooms being available, no upgrade was offered. Our room was rather small with no view (nor privacy) at all – it was facing an office building some 5 meters away. That meant that our curtains needed to be constantly closed, to avoid the people in the nearby office to see us. The room included twin beds (stuck together with no gap between them), a big TV (with only a few channels) mounted into a mirror wall, a minibar, a safe, a desk with a chair and a small armchair. There was also a Nespresso machine. The level of cleanliness in the room was not satisfactory (and definitely not up to Conrad standards). We did not receive any welcome gift (as honors Diamond members), no Conrad duck/bear and there was no information in the room regarding the services of the hotel. The bathroom included a tub, sink, shower and WC. The shower was constantly leaking and was not fixed, despite repeated requests. The towels have clearly seen better days and were anything but luxurious. The bathroom amenities were a new good series from Aromatherapy. The hotel features a small gym at the –1 level (no showers). Unfortunately, the hotel does not feature a swimming pool, nor a spa. As Honors Diamond members, our rate included breakfast at the Blue Boar restaurant. The breakfast was very average, at best (I've written a separate review about it). The Executive lounge is located on the first floor was beautifully decorated for Christmas. The lounge is open from the early morning until 22:00 and serves soft and hot drinks throughout the day. We haven't tried the breakfast at the lounge, as we've had it at the restaurant. The afternoon tea spread was absolutely fantastic with scones, jam, butter, sandwiches and desserts. The dinner at the executive lounge is abysmal. It consists of a tiny tasting menu, some cheese, cold cuts, bread and alcohol. It was almost embarrassing to leave the lounge feeling hungry. The place was packed evening after evening and the waiters were doing a very lousy job at clearing the tables. Service at the lounge was below average, in general, too. To add insult to injury, little children are allowed to the lounge and they sure made a lot of noise during dinner. This was absolutely a 3-star experience, and definitely not something we expected from a Conrad. Bottom line – despite its amazing location in London, the hotel was truly underwhelming in several aspects and was not in par with other Conrad hotels, especially given its very high rates.

title: Great location, great hotel
text: Booked last minute with my husband to stay in the city after a drinks evening. Great staff helped out with booking issues (Last Minute.com can be a bit slow in confirming). The room and facilities were excellent. Just a little warning that the complimentary coffees etc are in the in the same tray as the non complimentary items! Very comfortable room, very quiet for a central London location - literally across the road from St James Tube station.

title: Excellent location and accommodations. Impeccable service
text: We stayed on the 2nd floor near the Executive lounge. The room was modern and sleek with every amenity to be expected. The Executive lounge and full breakfast are included if you are Hilton Diamond. Both the lounge and restaurant are excellent with a variety of choices and outstanding service. The hotel is ideally located in Westminster about 3 minutes walk to Westminster Abbey and Parliament.

title: Tiny, dirty, and rude
text: I'm a Hilton Honors member and was excited to cash in rewards certificates at this property. However, it is far from 5 stars. The only saving grace is that it is in a fantastic location. The room was super tiny. I could barely navigate around the bed. I don't know if only my room was such a weird shape and so small, but it was terrible. Upon checking in I noticed that the carpet in my room was completely torn. It had curled up from the wall. It was also filthy with large dark stains on it. I complained and they did nothing. The 2nd day they claimed that they cleaned it, but it was obvious they didn't. Also the phone in the bathroom would not stop making weird noises. I finally had to disconnect it. Avoid this hotel at all costs.

title: Absolutely Superb
text: Allow me to say first that I can be somewhat difficult to please. While I am fair in my reviews, it can be difficult to get me to "rave" about a property. Our stay here was nearly perfect, and I can easily say that we will return here in the future. I made a prepay booking approximately three to four weeks before our trip. About a week later, the price dropped. Usually, I would let it go, but I thought that given the circumstances I would request a refund. I was offered the difference (about $150 over three nights) or an executive room upgrade. I opted for the upgrade as Gold members are not offered executive lounge access as a guarantee and that was important to me. This was the first pleasant surprise. We also received a few e-mails prior to our arrival asking what the hotel could do to make our stay better or to arrange transportation. We didn't necessarily need anything, but I really appreciated the attention. Upon arrival, our room was not quite ready though it was only noon. We were personally ushered to the executive lounge where we could refresh and leave our bags while we went out. By the time we had returned from tea, our room on the sixth floor (top floor) was available with luggage already arrived. This time, we were escorted to the elevator and given some more details. The check-in staff were amazing. The doorman was also very welcoming and pleasant to deal with. He was great at ushering our ubers in and out. The executive lounge staff could use some slight improvement - perhaps taking a more proactive approach to asking if we required any additional items. Otherwise, the lounge is a great oasis when it isn't too busy. There are canapes, drinks, refreshments, comfortable seating and a shower if needed. The room itself is large by London standards, but still slightly small in other places. There was a king bed, a desk and a lounge chair. The bathroom was a good size with both a shower and a one person, deep tub. We used the Conrad Concierge app to request some additional items which were promptly sent. Housekeeping did an excellent job, replacing the towels and sheets each morning. She also kept the bar stocked and sent our shoes off to be shined. Turndown service was also great. Room service and the attendant were also excellent on one night we opted for that rather than going downstairs to the restaurant. Given that, we unfortunately did not get the opportunity to use the restaurant. Breakfast each morning in the lounge was adequate, though could use some additional options. We were given the choice of a continental breakfast in the restaurant, in the room (for a 4pound premium) or the lounge. The lounge featured one meat and eggs each day, several breads and treats, and the typical beverages. The location of the property is very nice. Directly across the street from a tube stop, easy walking distance to Westminster/the river. A 10-15 minute Uber ride will get you to the shopping on Oxford, the park/Dorchester area, and Paddington. You're looking more like 20-30 minutes by car from Kings Cross. Overall the stay was most excellent. I could hardly find any items to complain about. We have a great option when we return to London. As a side note, I am a bit stingy when it comes to room rate - anytime I pay in excess of $300 per night I have extremely high standards to be met. I was NOT disappointed and felt like it was a good value.

title: just perfect!
text: My teenage daughter and I stayed here over the Christmas break last week. The hotel is wonderful in every way. The room was beautiful, comfortable, and the bathroom was fantastic. My 16 year old daughter was very impressed (not an easy thing). The attention to detail is much appreciated, from the complimentary Nespresso machine to the iphone dock and usb charging stations. The location is ideal, the staff was marvelous. Doorman Grant in particular was so very helpful and seemed genuinely interested in advising and helping us. I wholeheartedly recommend the Conrad London St. James, and will definitely stay here again if we return to London.

title: Excellent
text: I would like to recommend this hotel to everybody..Rooms are nice and comfortable. People are so friendly and try so hard to make your stay convenient. There are sportfacilities. The restaurant looks good and the food is fantastic. For every purse you can have a good meal.

title: Top quality hotel in a prime location
text: We picked up a good value deal on another website. Upon arrival our room wasn't ready so we were upgraded to a junior suite. Overall hotel and rooms are of a very good standard. Showers in particular were very good :)

title: Good Hotel and Location
text: The Cons: 1- I called the hotel 2 times on two different occasions to confirm our arrival and make some request. The hotel failed to notify me, even though I am a Hilton Honors member with gold status, either on the two occasions I called the hotel, or by email or text, that this area of the city will host a bicycle race and that all limousine and taxi access to the hotel will not be possible. As a result, myself and my family had to be dropped at a subway station with 5 pieces of large luggage to take the subway to a station near the hotel. We had to carry our luggage up and down the stations and walk the streets to the hotel. This is really unacceptable and the hotel should have informed their arriving guests of this event and offer them options. 2- The Junior suite we stayed in was very small in comparison to other junior suites in other properties I previously stayed in when in London. 3- On our first night, a trailer was dropping merchandise on the street our room is overlooking. The driver kept the engine on and it was extremely loud and we were unable to sleep. I called the front desk and they acknowledged the issue and said that they cannot do anything about it and it will take some time. Pros

title: Perfection
text: The location of this hotel is perfect (located next to St. James Park). The rooms are beautiful stocked with top notch amenities. The hotel also has an Exec lounge which offers drinks and afternoon hors d'oeuvres. The breaksfast was fantastic offering a full array of goodies including menu items. Overall the stay was great and notably the service by Rosamarie at the front desk. She was very pleasant and very welcoming upon our arrival. She happened to notice I fell in love with the candies on the table. To our surprise she had a special bag sent to the room with a note attached welcoming us. Now that is First Class!

title: A haven in central london
text: The hotel is very incredibly well situated to acess central london, whilst maintaining a quiet haven inside. The team were unfailling helpful but not intrusive. As a single traveller this mix is rare often i am offered poor seats in restaurants and slow services. I would recommend to both to all travellers

title: Awesome stay!
text: We stayed here for 3 nights and all I can say is that my family and I were extremely happy with the Conrad! It’s pricey but well worth it! Very convenient as it’s across the street from the tube and a block from Westminster Abbey. Food at the Blue Boar was great and hotel staff were accommodating.

title: 5* in design, 5* in hospitality
text: A perfect destination and location for a weekend staycation for us and visiting friends. Great first impression and sense of arrival as you step off the street into the fresh scented, smart,calm lobby with a humoured Westminster theme, which is followed on and highlighted throughout the hotel . Smart, professional staff guided us through the seamless checkin process and advised us that our guests had arrived and were waiting for us in the lounge. Our rooms were beautifully designed to create a spacious feel with sitting area, well stocked minibar and Nespresso machine. A clever swivel panel incorporating a TV defined the innovative living zones and a sliding panel door to the spacious bathing zone.. with bath and separate power/rain shower complemented with Molton Brown amenities... a lot of thought has gone into this. Breakfast was offered in the Blue Boar restaurant by way of a generous Continental Style buffet and an a la carte menu featuring a variety freshly cooked breakfast choices. Tables are set with crisp white linen and attentive staff are on hand to look after you. All the staff were delightful and helpful and really supported the Intercontinental brand and went out of their way ensure customer loyalty.

title: Great hotel and service for a family trip with young child
text: We chose the Conrad for a special experience on our weekend in London to celebrate a landmark birthday and bring our young son to the capital for the first time. The hotel and rooms are exactly what you would expect from a Conrad hotel - exceptional quality and detail throughout. The lounge is a particularly good one with a great range of food and srinks throughout the day - much better than the Hilton Park Lane and Waldorf in our opinion. I must particularly thank the hotel and guest relations manager Robert, for the wonderful welcome provided to our under-two year old. A few generous extras appeared in the room during the stay and 'London Bear' made an instant impression. This is particularly appreciated on hotel visits for pleasure with the family rather than the more routine bunsiness trip. Thank you. 10 out of 10 service and a wholly enjoyable visit.

title: A special night for our 6th Anniversary
text: We had a Virgin Gift Experience voucher for a luxury 1 night stay at The Conrad Hotel. We decided to stay here for our 6th Anniversary. The hotel was lovely & our room was lovely (not very big but that’s London hotels I guess) the bath was really big & so relaxing. The bed & bedding was so comfortable & we both had such a great nights sleep. We had breakfast included in our package which was good & they had everything you could want for breakfast. There was a wait for a table as it was so busy but apart from that everything was perfect.

title: HOLIDAY
text: Having stayed at the Conrad St James' previously, this was our first choice. On this occasion it was a special visit to include my wife's birthday. Upon arrival we were both made most welcome and Paul at the reception desk was especially helpful. Our room was top class and to our surprise there was a wonderful welcome birthday gift for my wife. We visited the restaurant in the hotel for an evening meal and were delighted with some fabulous wine advice and tasting from Carlos. The location is excellent too with St James tube station just across the road. All in all an excellent value hotel with wonderfully attentive customer service.

title: Premium outstanding and exceptional hotel experience near to New Scotland Yard !
text: Knowing very well this amazing location just before it opened about three years ago with another famous hotel chain's name, I would like to especially dedicate this wonderful dream experience to Rosamaria and also to the Man who did it really make happen as a dream, would like to name Mr Luis Aguayo, Assistant Front Office Manager. He was Head of the entire Conrad London St. James Hotel during my 2 days' stay and it has been a real Honor to meet him especially during the check-in period. Muchíssimas gracias otra vez Sr. Aguayo, tanto amable y directamente dedicado al escucha del cliente.

title: Overall good but for a 5 star hotel they missed the little things
text: Used points for this stay and was upgraded which was very nice. The executive lounge was really nice and the staff in there was amazing. However this being a 5 star hotel there were minor things that bothered me. Our room had a dirty robe and some other dirty things in the bathroom. Housekeeping consistently didn't fully clean our room and would leave used glasses and half eaten food after coming. Our mini bar was never restocked without calling and the last night they didn't restocked it even after speaking with the front desk in person and calling again

title: Perfect location, attentive staff, great rooms!
text: We loved this London hotel! It is located across from the St. James Tube entrance, which made access to everything so easy. The staff were very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. Our room was pleasantly spacious. We enjoyed their breakfast buffet daily - it was just easier for us overall. There's a good convenience store just inside the Tube station for quick and healthy snacks. I would recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to London.

title: A great new addition
text: The Conrad is a great new addition to Hilton's portfolio in Central London. It has a touch of quality and luxury and its position in the Victoria/St James'/Westminster area is perfect for business and attractions alike. The welcome on arrival by the concierge and reception staff was very professional and friendly, it gives that feeling of being wanted and appreciated. My deluxe king room was fresh and spotlessly clean with quality amenities. The bed was very comfortable very much in keeping with the Hilton group's standard. The executive lounge was quiet on the night I was there but the offerings at evening canapes/drinks was OK. Breakfast in the lounge was excellent, using quality ingredients and served by staff eager to please. Definately to be recommended.

title: Top of their Game
text: Such a beautiful 5 🌟 hotel in a quieter part of busy London. The elegance is low key & I was embraced by the serenity of the reception which was beautifully presented with exotic fresh cut flowers. Staff were elegantly turned out & provided what I considered next to butler style service. I also had afternoon tea. This is the BEST venue for a high end afternoon tea experience . Scone with lemon curd, clotted cream & fruit jam. YUMMY !!! Can't wait to go back. Such great Value for money too. Thank you for all those that looked after me.

title: Intercontinental Westminster
text: Probably the best hotel we have stayed in

title: Great location
text: This hotel is my favourite due to its great location. Walking distance from the parliament and short tube ride to the city. Very nice property, comfortable room. The restaurant is worth visiting - I had a working breakfast there. Very nice space with good quality food.

title: Prect way to end my trip
text: This hotel was great. Now this is the Hilton experience I expect when I travel. The Hotel is in a great location just a few blocks from Westminster Abbey, Big Ben. Walking distance to almost everyone around. The Hotel is modern, and you can get the AC below 21 degrees Celsius. The staff is great, the hotels clean, breakfast is good, and if your Hilton Diamond they have the free Happy hour from 5-7 free beer, wine, and sparking wine. I'd stay here again in heart beat.

title: Best Kept Secret in London
text: The Marlyn Lodge is the perfect venue if you have business in the London insurance market or if you want a convenient location for a family vacation. It is a 10-minute walk from the Lloyd's Building and just a 5-minute walk from offices on Fenchurch Street. The Tower, Tower Bridge and St. Kathryn's Docks are less than five minutes away. And the West End is about 15 minutes away by Tube via Tower Hill Station. While it is not luxurious, the rooms are very comfortable and well appointed. Also, a grocery store and health club are located in the same building. The business is family owned and operated, and you interact with real people when you have a request. The value is excellent. The cost is about half of other serviced apartments in the area. I have stayed at the Marlyn Lodge since 1994 on both business and family vacations and recommend it highly.

title: Very nice
text: It was my second time in Marlyn Lodge with my daughter and we enjoyed it as the first time! We had full of place, the furnishing is very modern and nice ( with great pictures of London and flowers) and Portsoken Street is very well situated in London to visit the city, and with two food stores within 100 meters. We will come back again!

title: The Collins Explore London!
text: The location of this property was ideal for us, as it was close to the Tower Hill underground, which enabled us to travel effortlessly to the many attractions we wanted to see- Tower of London, Tower Bridge, The Globe, the South Bank, etc. The area is quiet with minimal street noise, and it is both safe & secure. Within walking distance are several small eateries that are far from the madding crowd! Except for some deferred maintenance in the apartment, it was a very comfortable place to set up headquarters for 5 nights.

title: Great value!
text: very nice place for the price. separate kitchen was nice to have and store a few beverages/snacks, washer/dryer came in handy so that I didn't have to pack dirty clothes and do laundry once I got home. clean and spacious little apartment.

title: I wish this was as it was listed
text: We went on a family vacation with 11 people, and booked three rooms. Two of the rooms had a horrible smell. Within the first 20 minutes, our daughter accidentally locked herself in the bathroom, and they had to call in a tradesmen to dismantle the doorframe to free her. There were tears. The kitchen was downright dirty, as was the bathroom. The sheets were soft and the pillows were nice. That's about it. The location was ok, down an alley. None of the families in our party would stay here again.

title: False Advertising
text: I booked Marlyn Lodge expressly because one of the top features listed on Booking.com was a fitness center. This is false advertising because there is no fitness center at all. Apparently there used to be the option to buy passes to a gym nearby but now even that is not the case. The bed has not been made nor the bins emptied each day. This also differs from the posted services. In addition, the apartment was very dusty, the exhaust fan in the bathroom doesn’t work, there are stains on the carpet and the leather furniture has numerous scratches. It’s all just a little out-dated (everything is beige and brown) and shabby. I am here for business and objections that might seem minor on a pleasure trip are a nuisance for business travel. The location is convenient but that’s about all Marlyn Lodge has to recommend it in the City of London, where there are numerous other serviced apartment options. Lastly, they don’t answer their phone or return messages, which is very unprofessional.

title: Great location and facilities
text: We stayed at Marlyn Lodge for 9 days in March. We prefer apartments to hotels, and certainly some apartments are better than others, but this one was tops! The location as good, easy walking distance to the Tower of London and Tower Bridge, and also easy access to three Tube stations. Grocery shops just around the corner (Tesco Express and Sainsbury's) and Aldgate High Street not far away. The apartment was very comfortable, had everything we needed (including a washing machine and very efficient shower) and squeaky clean, with tops-ups of towels (and toilet paper!) every week day. Coming from Australia, it was excellent to be able to use a credit card for online payment (rather than mess around with bank cheques which we've had to do with some properties in the past) and having a lift, rather than stairs, a great help with luggage. We'd definitely stay here again.

title: Super Nice
text: Extremely pleased with our stay at Marlyn Lodge. Great location, tasteful decor, security, and close to Tube and DLR stops. Easy walking distance to shopping, museums, parks, and great pubs and eateries. Close to Tower Hill, Tower Bridge, And many more tourist attractions. We highly recommend Matlyn Lodge.

title: Brilliant for locating and price
text: A spacious studio apartment in a fabulous location, could walk to many places of interest. TowerHill tube was only a few minutes walk away and there are others close by. Tesco is at the front of the building, it's well equipped for every day pantry needs etc., found it so useful. Would recommend these apartments to family and friends and would gladly stay again. .

title: London Experience
text: This was my first experience with AirB&B and I could not believe our luck. My daughter and I spent 6 days in London and having a flat to come back to was awesome. The flat was located in Tower Hill are so it was very convenient for waking, near 2tubes and the train station. Lots of restaurants and a small grocery around the corner. The flat was very clean. We had twin beds, a sitting room and a kitchen with all necessaries, even a washing machine. We got fresh towels every weekday. Wifi was free. Security was top notch. Should I return to London I hope this flat is available. Thank you for such a great experience!

title: Perfect family holidays
text: Everything was perfect. Andrew and his team are so helpful and always prompt to reply to your requests. Also Jorge (the concierge) was such a nice person and very helpful. The apartment was exactly as we expected, with a nice kitchen with all necessary and working equipment. Wi-fi signal: 5 stars. The location is perfect. Thank you so much! For sure in a future visit to London Marlyn Lodge will be in our top preference!

title: Great alternative to hotel.
text: Stayed for five nights with my wife and two adult children. Plenty of room, and although the one bathroom isn't huge, it's adequate. Getting the key and entry into the building was simple and I received easy instructions to get in the security gate. I'm not a London expert, but liked the location. Walking distance to two tube stations and the Tower of London, there's a small grocery store around the corner and, of course, a Starbucks down the street. Plenty of towels were provided. The bedroom has a good a/c, but we couldn't figure out the one in the living room, as the screen on the thermostat was not working correctly. Luckily, it has a ceiling fan and it was cool at night.

title: Revisit to Marlyn Lodge London
text: This is our 4th visit to this well located, well equipped and well maintained, serviced apartment. It is almost like a home far from home for us. Like anything, the quality of a home depends on the people who runs it. In this instant, it is difficult to fault the team, anchored by manager Andrew and owner Catherine. Both are hands-on. If one looks for a quiet and quality stay in London, it is damn hard to find a better address than Marlyn Lodge.

title: Excellent location & space for four
text: We were in flat 206. The location of the building was fantastic for our 5 days in London. A 5-minute walk to the Tower of London/Tower Bridge and less than that to the Tube station and train station. Tower Hill was the closest tube station. We had four people in our room, and the space was more than accommodating for us all - not your typical expectation of European accommodations. We intend to recommend Marlyn Lodge to friends that will also be traveling to London in the next few months. Private location where access was VERY secure and we felt extremely safe in the building and the area. There are plenty of eateries and things nearby, including a Tesco for some light groceries to have in the flat. Great experience and would happily return.

title: Great Location, But Beware Of The Washing Machine!
text: We stayed 10 days in Room 201, so we got very familiar with this place. It is very conveniently located within walking distance of the Tower of London and its tube stop. A Tesco Express is literally right around the corner. With a small built-in kitchen, you can have some meals in, which really helps stay within budget on a trip. Having said that, there are good reasons why Marlyn Lodge is relatively cheap. Be prepared to leave your window open to cool off at night

title: Easy check in, perfect location
text: We stayed for 5 nights - 3 teens and one adult in a room with bed and pull out. The room is simple but clean

title: Great affordable apartments
text: I normally stay here when I am on business in London as they are clean and are great value for money, the apartments are very spacious and are more than just an hotel room, I would recommend these to anyone visiting London

title: Quality accommodation for the City business traveller or London tourist
text: I have been staying at Marlyn Lodge for nearly 10 years on a regular basis, and will never stay in a hotel in the City of London again! The location, facilities and value for money make this the ideal base for my business trips to meet my clients.

title: Perfect location and price!
text: This property is value for money in what I would regard as a brilliant location. On one side, if you are here for business, you are on the door step of the old financial district, near the tube station and the pub! If you are here for leisure, then this is the base you want to be as it's close to two of the main attractions (Bridge and Tower) and the rest of the city is easily explored via tube / uber / cab / foot. The rooms are clean, the kitchen VERY useful (Tesco Express is less than 50 metres away!) and the bathroom is in perfect order. Stay here! Your wallet and mind will thank you for it.

title: Friendly place to stay VERY near to the Tube, bus and train!
text: Really helpfull when we asked about WIFI or softening the sofabed and responding time was superb, thanks Andrew! Close to the city, felt safe and friendly. All the facilities are there: kitchen, shower and sleepwise.

title: Super flats in nice area!
text: Very nice and well eguipped flats. Very comfortable beds and even the sofa bed is enough for 2 big swedes! The flats is in a very nice part of London close to Tower Bridge and both bus and underground just around the corner! Perfect if you arrive or leave from Stansted or Gatwick and go by train to/from the airports. There are good food store in the same house open from 7-23 and a nice pub with very reasonable prices food and beer just across the road! The self service check in was very simple to use and perfect if you dnt exactly knew the time for arrival!

title: Stay
text: The block has parking and a day time concierge. It is perfectly located for transport at Tower hill and Aldgate tube stations and the DLR. perfect for Tower Bridge, the Tower, St Catherine's Dock and walking along the river in any direction. Some good pubs but a lot is closed on a Sunday as this is the City not the West End etc. Not many shops in the vacuity but tube rides will get you anywhere you want. It is in the congestion zone area. Several flats are owned, other are rented out for single or multiple nights. The whole block is very warm!! And sits on top of a Tesco and gym.

title: nice location in the heart of london city
text: a few minutes to all locations in london city. A nice appartment, wunderfull kitchen. Safe and clean. we will stay again in Marlyn Lodge netx year. Underground, shops and other helpfull things near by - excellent

title: Great location in the City of London
text: Good value for money apartments with excellent access to the tube, local tesco store, and restaurants and pubs. The apartment is good-sized, clean, and includes a well-equipped kitchen and fast internet access.

title: Back again!
text: I have been renting here since the 1990s, perfect location and amenities. Convenient to the City for business visits but also near numerous public transportation sites for travel around the rest of London and indeed Britain.

title: Great location, great value. Utilitarian place.
text: The Marlyn Lodge is exactly as they advertise. The location is a very short walk to the Tower Bridge, the Tower of London, and to several mass transit stops (Tower Hill and Aldgate are the closest) which makes it very convenient to the rest of London. For the 5 nights we stayed, we very much enjoyed taking walks to the attractions and restaurants along the Thames nearby. The Hoop and Grapes near the Aldgate Station is a great pub worth walking to. The Marlyn Lodge facilities themselves are clean, yet utilitarian and somewhat dated. Self check in was easy and basic linens were replaced during the week. Overall, a good value for those looking to save some money yet not expecting typical hotel amenities or updated decor. We were happy with our selection to stay here. Would we stay at the Marlyn Lodge if lucky enough to visit London again? I think we would consider other options, but no regrets for our first visit to London.

title: Review
text: Excellent location. Pub across street and grocery around the corner. Close to Tower Bridge and Tube. Walking distance to almost everything. We would recommend asking for apartment on back side. Street side a little noisy. Price for London is very good. Older building but clean. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend Marlyn Lodge

title: good location, could use deep cleaning, updating and plumbing check
text: We stayed in unit 508 with a family of 4- 2 adults and 2 kids. The unit needs updating, and on our visit was not clean on arrival. There were clean sheets on the bed and clean towels. The towels in the bathroom were plentiful and of good quality. The sheets were not great. The sofa bed was terribly uncomfortable and small

title: Steen S
text: We were staying here as a Family with 2 children , it as a very nice and clean Apartment , with all you need to make your own food douring the day. It is very central in London , near seightseeing and transport.

title: Very good
text: The location of the apartment is excellent, close to a metro station (Tower Hill) and a Tesco. 5 min walk from London Tower and Spitalfields. Very clean and comfortable. The service is excellent. We will repeat our stay La situacion del apartamento es excelente, cerca de una parada de metro y un Ttesco. Muy límpio y cómodo. La atencion es inmejorable. Puedes ir andando a London Tower y Spitalfields, estan a 10 min Repetiremos nuestra estancia

title: Location was awesome
text: Close to many tube stations and also within walking distance to many famous sites. We couldn't fault the location. The studio accommodation exceeded our expectations. A fairly new, small but adequate separate kitchen was very handy. It included a washer/dryer combo which was great. The only complaint was that there was no washing powder supplied which meant we had to buy a full box for just a couple of loads. The bathroom was roomy with a bath/shower combo. The bedroom/living area was quite large with a lounge and dining table. The bed was a little soft I thought, but I do prefer a firm mattress for my back.The decor is a little dated but other than a slightly dirty kitchen floor the unit was quite clean overall. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to my friends.

title: Marilyn Lodge
text: Our stay at Marilyn Lodge was very nice. We found our apartment (407) clean, spacious, and comfortable. The location was so very good-- a five minute walk to the Underground station Aldgate. The neighborhood was safe with a Tesco next door and a fabulous Indian food restaurant (The Empress) nearby.There is a washing machine, but no dryer. We would definitely stay here again.

title: Excellent, central accommodation
text: I was looking for somewhere to stay close to Tower Bridge for a trip that was two thirds business and one third pleasure and found Marlyn Lodge via an online travel search engine. Having previously paid over £200 a night in another hotel for a room so tiny that I could put my arms out and touch all four walls without moving, I wasn't optimistic what I'd get for a more central location for much less money. I was very pleasantly surprised to find that I had a large apartment with a large living room, perfectly sized kitchen, large bedroom and good sized bathroom. Everything I needed was there, with a large tv in the living room with Sky, and a smaller one in the bedroom. It turned out to be a perfect base for my trip and was less than a five minute walk to my business location, overlooking Tower Bridge. They provided an excellent folder full of information, which proved to be useful in looking for places to get food. It's also thirty seconds away from a Tesco Express which is handy. The only downside is that, being in the square mile, most food places are closed in the evenings at the weekend. However that isn't the fault of the apartment. But there are Tesco and Sainsburys within very short distance.

title: Fantastic place to stay for a family
text: What can I say....excellent communication....last minute booking..very accommodating to needs. Parking an issue..however great if travelling by public transport. Great amenities close by and great for travelling as a family for that home from home feel. Would highly recommend.

title: Good location.
text: We spent two weeks at this place in Flat 107. Washer/dryer is helpful . The kitchen units are a little dated but is clean and has all appliances you need. Decoration stale and partial damage. Ex: Safe box didn't fixed on wall. Sofa bed is caved in. Didn't weekday daily changed and replenished all linen and towels and toiletries. I would recommend to other travelers if these problems have improved.

title: it was ok, but not that nice like in the pictures
text: The apartment is very small, old and needed of a renovation. The kitchen is 30 Years old like by Grandma, no wash dishes, toaster was one part broken, bath too small, door didn´t open completely...no room in half, has no light switcher, you pull an a rope?!?! , Toilet calcified. But Bedding was very clean, the bed very comfortable and cozy and if the cleaning woman came(if...), you got every day fresh towels. Check in very easy, became good Information per E- Mail . If they renovate , I think I will come back.

title: Nice apartment
text: We staid at apartment for 5 days in February. It is near of Tower of London, very well communicate with the city by the tube and bus, the Liverpool Station is at 10 minutes walking, you have a Tesco in the same block and the price is cheaper respect another options, so it's highly recommendable. We were 5 people and although it's a bit narrow for so many people and the mattress of the sofá and the extrabed very very thin, it's sufficiently comfortable for a short stay.

title: Highly recommended
text: We enjoyed our stay very much. The apartment is nice and spacious and also in a very good location with good acces to the center of the city. The Tower of London is almost literally around the corner with many other known places not far behind. The only thing I would change are the pillows on the bed, which were too hard for me.

title: Average staying
text: The location is very good, although the appartment might be better. Cleaning must be improved and the communication with the owner was very hard. We did several phone calls to the owner without no replies, neither at the weekend or week days, only we got response thru email.

title: Half term exploring London
text: Well appointed apartment-with all the mod cons you need. We stayed for 5 nights at Marlyn Lodge. While husband worked in London we enjoyed the sights! Within three minutes walk from tube and Tower of London

title: Amazing location, great apartment and quiet, safe area
text: The apartment is great for 4 people. The location is really amazing, you can walk anywhere. 5 minutes away from the underground. The concierge is a portuguese guy, very nice and helpful. The building is very quiet. Even though we only had online contact, Andrew made the check-in really easy and carefree. The internet connection is very good. I recommend it! You won't be disappointed.

title: Excellent find in London!
text: This flat was a great find. The location is in a business district near the tower of London. It is close to a metro station and has a Tesco on the first floor. We stayed in a studio flat and it was great. The kitchen was clean and well stocked with basic utensils. The bathroom was clean and there was free wifi available. All in all this was a great find and more economical than staying in a hotel.

title: Very nice
text: Very good located, clean. Plenty of restourants and small market one minute walk. The tube is about two minutes walk. The kitchen is fully functional. there is an air-conditioning in the room. Highly recommended

title: Great Stay! Would visit again!
text: Very organized and detailed procedures sent prior to arrival. Our unit wasn't available at 14:00 as expected. We had to wait another hour or so. Not the end of the world. Jorge was kind enough to store our luggage and bring it up to the apartment when it was ready. Older building, but well maintained. Liked the secure entrance. Elevator was fast and always available. We thought that the apartment was very affordable considering how spacious it was. The bed, couches, dining area, and kitchen were great. The A/C unit in the bedroom worked really well, but the one in the living area didn't seem to work at all. We eventually gave up on it and opened the windows there, but got quite a bit of street noise as a result. The bathroom was spacious and nice, but had some mold in the shower on the tiles and on the ceiling. The shower curtain also smelled of mildew. Maria (housekeeping) was very pleasant and came to pick up the garbage and recycling on the weekdays, as well as change out towels if desired. The kitchen had everything we needed, but the dishes weren't cleaned very well by the last renter. We just made sure to wash everything before we used it. Nice to be close to the Tower of London and Tower Bridge, but many of the restaurants nearby aren't open in the evenings or on the weekends since the area is primarily a financial district/office area. Not a big deal

title: Comfort of Home in London
text: Marlyn Lodge is my first choice for accommodation in London for business or holiday. A spacious and comfortable apartment for less than one can book a hotel, the lodge is secure and is perfectly located near Tower Bridge and equal distance between two tube stops -- Tower Hill and Aldgate. Over the years, the management has been courteous and gone the extra mile in accommodating my booking dates. Having a full kitchen and grocery shops near by means that when you get tired of eating out you can have a meal or two in the comfort of your own apartment. Lovely owners and a lovely place to stay.

title: perfect location
text: a good price / quality balance good location near all the main interesting points, quiet silent, easy check in and check out kitchen forniture a little old but clean and well equipped (except for paper towels and tablecloths) clean and new sheets

title: Miss you already, Marlyn Lodge and London!!!!
text: This trip was for the occasion of my daughter's birthday and to realize my lifelong dream of visiting London and environs. We booked with Marlyn Lodge after reading page after page of glowing reviews both on TA and Booking.com, and couldn't be happier with our choice. This serviced apartment is situated in an unassuming and charming little brick building on Portsoken Street, a small lane right between two main arteries (Minories and Mansell) of Whitechapel. The location can't be beat, especially for the price point. There is a Tesco Express literally next door (though the "Express" part means this is NOT a fully-stocked grocery store, so don't expect to be able to buy all the ingredients to prepare a gourmet dinner, but it was serviceable enough to keep us in basics like milk, bread and cheese). The apartment is located within a very short walking distance of several bus and tube stations (most notably Aldgate, Aldgate East and Tower Hill tube stops) and its proximity to Minories and Mansell meant that we had no trouble at all hailing one of the city's convenient, clean and disabled-friendly black taxis whenever we needed one. (Please note that almost all the iconic, red, double-decker buses are also handicapped-accessible

title: Excellent value
text: Our family had a nice stay at Marlyn Lodge. The location was excellent, with easy access to the circle and district lines of the underground, 2 grocery stores, and tower bridge area attractions. The one bedroom flat was exactly as presented online. It was quite spacious and the kitchen well stocked with all a family of 4 would require. The bed was very comfortable and the street was quiet and safe. We checked in early and the directions for self check-in were easy to follow. We appreciated that the management waived the late checkout fee. I particularly liked the straight forward method of booking. You knew exactly what you were being charged ahead of time, and had various options for the level of housekeeping. The communication via email was excellent, which was important to me coming such a long distance and never having stayed in a nontraditional type of lodging. Overall, an excellent value and great alternative to a hotel, especially if you are traveling with a family!

title: Convenient Location for work stay
text: A good place to stay in terms of proximity to work area, local tesco convenience, tube stations and eateries nearby. Only downsight is availability of food in the evenings or weekends unless you don't mind cooking. The apartment itself is clean and fully equipped with basic necessities. Being a light sleeper, I am sensitive to noise outside, if one is not then this place is perfect, considering everything else is good. I will definitely consider returning to this place for a personal holiday.

title: Home away from home!
text: Marlyn Lodge is perfectly located in the heart of London within walking distance of the tube station. Very welcoming, comfortable, clean environment. My father and I enjoyed our stay immensely over the holidays! We would recommend to anyone and everyone looking for the perfect accommodation in the big city!

title: Disappointing and nothing like the photos
text: Our initial reaction on seeing the apartment was total disappointment as it certainly was not a representation of the photos. It was dirty, the walls were badly scuffed and scratched, the toilet seat was broken so that every time you went to sit down it moved considerably so that you slipped. There was a brush for washing dishes that had food stuck to it and had never been rinsed. The washing machine didn't work properly and certainly didn't dry the clothes........four hours and they were still wet and it also leaked. There were positives which were the apartments proximity to a number of tube statiions, having Tesco and Sainsburys near by as well as some eateries. It was also very handy to visit Tower Bridge, the Tower of London and was walking distance to many others attractions. The other plus was the bed was comfortable and there was plenty of hot water with a good shower. A good facelift is despartely required.

title: Marlyn Lodge Apartment 101
text: The Marlyn Lodge is ideally situated : 5 minutes walk from Aldgate station and Aldgate East Station, and 10 minutes walk to Tower Bridge and The Tower of London ! Spectacular ! You can also get an Indian dinner on Brick Lane (15 minutes) and visit Whitegate Galery (7 minutes!). There is a small Tesco supermarket right on the corner, which is very convenient. The flat is clean but the photographs on the website make it appear a lot bigger and trendier... Don't expect a separate bedroom, when the description says "1 bedroom" it means "one room" in reality... There is a separate kitchen (fully equipped and spotlessly clean) but the bed stands right next to the dinning table and the couch ! For unknown reason (hot water tank for the whole floor next to the bed stead??) the room in incredibly warm even when the weather is rainy and cool outside in the summer. What makes the situation worse is that the old AC is very noisy and quite useless... To finish, the lamps next to the bed work only intermittently (if at all!!) due to a failing electricity system. Eventually the apartment is situated on the first floor and can be quite noisy (trafic and busses). On the whole the apartment is clean and comfortable and remains affordable for London (a city where you can find horrible places for the same price or just a little less) We had a great stay in London but we were a little disappointed by the apartment at first. However the location is so great and convenient that we forgot all about this ! You should go there but just don't expect to find what's on the photographs !

title: Great location
text: My wife and teenage son stayed for a week at the Marlyn Lodge. It is a great location near Tower Bridge and within an easy walk to a couple of Tube stops. There is a Tesco around the corner and was a short walk to numerous pubs. It is a cost effective alternative to a hotel. The kitchen was stocked with all the cups, glasses, plates we needed. The wifi worked well and the beds were comfortable. As for issues - the bathroom smelled, likely due to the constant dampness. There was a fan that didn't seem to do anything and the only way to ventilate was to prop open the door. They also missed supplying us new towels one of the weekdays (supposed to be daily fresh towels during weekdays). Having never stayed in a flat in London, I don't have anything to compare it to, but I imagine you could do much worse at that price point.

title: Perfect for London!
text: Marlyn Lodge was super convenient for our 5 day stay in London. It 'did what it said on the box': everything worked, things were where they said it would be, apartment was convenient and spacious. Nearest bus stop is literally outside the building, nearest tube station is about 7 mins walk. Lots of options for eating out close by. All in all, very useful place to know for London, I'd definitely stay here again! P.S. no need to sign up for the cleaning service- not much use :)

title: Comfortable and Good Location
text: I stayed here for 3 nights because I had business meetings near Tower Hill. This was a very spacious and cozy apartment with a nice view of the Gerkin tower. It was relaxing to have a kitchen, living room, large bedroom with king bed, and nice bathroom. Though a little bit run down with fading carpet and peeling paint in some places, overall it was fine. It is also a much better price than London Hotels, and much more comfortable. There are also many pubs and restaurants within walking distance, and a grocery store just around the corner. The Tower Hill metro stop is only a 5 minute walk. WOuld stay again.

title: Second visit
text: We were very satisfied with our accommodation on our first trip. This accommodation left something to be desired. There was no heating in the bedroom, and the heating in the living room was as programmed between 16 and 18 degrees. It was cold that week and we froze. The bathroom needed upgrading. The shower leaked all over the floor. Jorge did replace the tube, but it shouldn't have been in that condition when we arrived. The toilet never stopped running after flushing. My husband had to keep lifting the lid up and wriggling the tubes inside.

title: Perfect location and very quiet.
text: We were 3 people 4 nights. The apartment is in a privileged location, close to the subway, the financial area and its modern buildings and the Tower of London. It is very quiet, and the service is good. It will be necessary to improve the cleanliness of the bathroom, the kitchen, and the cabinets of facilities, but it is acceptable. Good WiFi and good T.V connection. Nice. Check in very organized. Recommendable

title: Great apartment in central London! Walking distance to lots of London sights!
text: We stayed at Marlyn Lodge for 2 weeks while we explored London. Upon arrival it was exactly according to the instructions, so very easy to get in to. It was spacious, clean and tidy. Bed was comfy and we had everything we needed. Kitchen was great, everything was in working order. The room was checked every week day to change towels, toiletries, kitchen items and clearing of rubbish. I could not fault the service. Close to the Underground, Tower of London, London Bridge, Shard etc all within walking distance. The only fault is there was no personal service...:( It would have been nice to see someone and put a face to the Lodge.

title: Amazing location for a trip to London.
text: The location was perfect ... Just steps away from Tower of London and easy access to the tube & other transportation. excellent pubs in the neighbourhood, easy access to Tesco for necessities. Room was perfect - all the amenities kitchen, lounge, dining room, washer, dryer, dish washer etc. well stocked for a home away from home. Highly recommended. Will stay there again and recommend to friends. Well worth it!

title: Just what I expected
text: I gave this property 5 stars because it was exactly what I expected and what was described. It's not a "5 Star" property, but based on previous reviews, it was what I expected. You get what you pay for. The communication was prompt, the location safe and the price was perfect. I would recommend this property for families wanting to get away from the crowds of West London, that's near two Tube stops and that doesn't want to spend a lot. The location is also walking distance from Brick Lane which is full of Indian restaurants.

title: Very good venue and value for money
text: We had a very nice stay and enjoyed the location s lot. The lodge is close to many attractions and to public transport. As a family, we wished we had a slightly bigger room and an extra toilet. A dishwashwe was also desirable. The service was also good and friendly. There was some noise with the traffic down the road, but overall it is a good place to stay.

title: Very comfortable and convenient
text: We stayed at Marlyn Lodge while looking for somewhere to rent long term.
