The apartment is so convenient for Knightsbridge and central London in general. The easy access to local shops for provisions and restaurants is brilliant as well as great transport links. Love this place and will definitely be back. Thank you Beaufort House.

title: Wonderful!
text: What a charming place to stay whilst in London! 3 friends and myself decided to go to London for a weekend and instead of booking 3 small rooms in a hotel we decided to try an apartment. Not only was this much more economical but so much more relaxing, spacious and fun. Each double room came with an en-suite bathroom therefore we had total privacy. I recommend an apartment at Beaufort House to everyone. The past reviews on trip advisor also made us decide. Their whole team was so wonderful and friendly. I have already booked to go back next month....

title: Stay in London
text: We always stay at Beaufort house as the location is very convenient to us. Next to Harrods and all the shops on Knightsbridge ansd Sloane Street. Quite a number of nice and trendy restaurants in the area. Always ask for apts on the upper floors

title: Fabulous accommodation . The
text: Fabulous London Piedaterre. Bringing the comforts from Home into a london overnight stay. Such wonderful comfy beds, lounge and kitchen, it was beautifully decorated, thoughtful additions

title: Excellent comfortable private convenience
text: The appartments are very well fitted out and the rooms comfortable. The staff are just superb and inobstrusive. I stay reasonably regualry and have never sought or found fault. The location is easy with plenty of good local restuarants, especially Italian.

title: Like our home
text: Stayed for 2 nights, we were welcome, our baggage was taken care of, the place is wonderful, the rooms are big, we had also access to gym, pool and spa which is 400 meter walking. the only issue is that no valet parking available. They have guided me to the nearest parking.

title: Great Location, Gym & Pool access
text: Stayed for 2 nights at the 2 bedroom apartment, 24 hours reception available, daily housekeeping, gym access 400 meters from the hotel, swimming pool, sauna, steam is available. The only think is that no valet parking available. It's the first building after Harrods, the location is wonderful. Thanks to all the staff who were more than helpful to guide me to the nearest parking.

title: Lovely Place
text: I stayed in a superior one bedroom apartment on the 1st floor. The location is not hard to find as it is in the knightsbridge area and just next to the famous Harrods stores. Lots of convenient stores are near by, the tube station "Knightsbridge" is also around the corner just 5 min walk. Back to the apartment, the living room style is tasteful and somehow classic, it has a large flat tv with many channels including premium. The Kitchen is full of all you need appliances plus a thoughtful basket containing cereals, jam, honey, and assorted teas, also there are orange juice, milk, water, butter, and toast. The bed was nice as well as the bathroom. However, the best part was the friendly staff where they made my experience amazing. Well Done.

title: Never stay anywhere else!
text: We stayed in a one-bedroom apartment for 6 nights and it was perfect. The apartment is large and well-appointed. The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful. I visit London every year and this is my go to place.

title: A Wonderful Place to Stay
text: We stayed at this hotel for 8 nights over the Christmas period. We absolutely loved it. We had a 2 bedroom apartment which was just perfect for our family of 2 adults and 2 children. The apartment had absolutely everything you could need including a washer/dryer, very well equipped kitchen and 3 televisions. The location is brilliant. Around the corner from lots of stores including Harrods, loads of restaurants and food stores. Plus Hyde Park and a number of museums are within a 10 minute walk. What really made this place extra special was the very friendly and extremely staff. They were all so lovely. We will definitely stay here again when we return to London.

title: Great location 🇬🇧👍🏻
text: This was the 3rd time to stay at Beaufort house 45- 47 🇬🇧it's a perfect choice for us as a central location for relaxing & shopping 🇬🇧it's 3-4 minutes walk to Harrods☕️🌂💄👠👝👢👓...The rooms are small but very clean . The 3 bedrooms apartment was good for my family . Free Wifi & free complimentary fresh milk + toast+ tea+coffee+meneral water 👏🏻🇬🇧❤The reception is open for 24 hours 🇬🇧🌹The staff are friendly and helpful 👏🏻Thank you Khadija & Kate for a wonderful stay 🌂🌹see you again 🇬🇧❤

title: Love the place
text: I love the place is really nice and comfortable and very near from Harrods and Hyde Park, I will definitely recommend it to my family and my friends because the staff they are friendly and I feel I am at home.

title: 4 night stay in beaufort house
text: I selected the beaufort house as its serviced apartment. Very convenient for family. Decent size but the TV room looked over used and can be arranged nicer and cleaner Must to say that this place has one of the best hospitality reciptionist and administrator v friendly and helpful , i had a complain about sofa as not clean. They had shampoo them and send apology letter V strict in terms of allowing to stay after check out time Not like other hotels may be as they have limited room not sure I can stay again if with family not solo

title: Overall
text: Self Service Apartments. Good option if you are a family with kids. Very good location to Central london & shopping district of KNIGHTSBRIDGE. Very london posh area. Expensive location. Clean & quiet. Close to Harrodsburg & Harvey Nichols & Sloanes Street. Very conservative style hotel.

title: The only place to stay in London
text: Stayed here for a second time in Dec 2015. Absolutely superb in every way. The apartments are extremely well equipped, very clean and luxurious. The staff are friendly, helpful and professional - they really made an effort to interact with our 11 year old, which made him feel so special. The location of the apartments is second to none. Harrods is a few minutes walk away and all the major museums (Natural History, Science and V&A) are a short stroll away. Lots of lovely restaurants within walking distance, and if you choose to spend an evening at the apartment you have the choice of fab takeaway food from Harrods or M&S I honestly can't imagine staying anywhere else when visiting London! Great for couples and families alike. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend the Beaufort, and we'll definitely be back (soon, I hope!)

title: Outstanding staff with top quality customer service
text: Me and my family stayed with the kids and we had a great time staying at BEAUFORT HOUSE. The staff were just Fab. I made our reservation over the phones and the person who answered was very poliet and helpful. They discribed the apartments to me in detail and suggested which type I should book to accommodate the whole family. When we arrived and booked in they took us to our apartment which was great and spacious. All through our stay the staff were so helpful will making dinner reservations and theatre bookings for us. We went on a tour to Oxford as well which they arranged for us. House keeping were great as well they serviced our apartment every day and the cleaning was fantastic. We would come back a gain and again to stay at Beaufort house as we had a great time with then and would suggust any one to go and try them out. I am already planning my friends hen night stay there with the girls. A rare gem in the heart of London.

title: Second time here
text: This place has 24 apartments. I book the normal 3 bed room and once the executive three bed room. Both of them are really nice worth every pound a very clean place and very helpful staff. title: Complete Package !
text: Security first and foremost. 24 hour receptionist monitoring. Luxurious atmosphere, friendly & professional staff, family oriented. I had a great stay and will certainly visit again. Lower ground floor with patio is excellent for clusterphobics & nature lovers !

title: Thanksgiving week in London
text: This was our first time to stay at Beaufort House. My wife, two daughters and myself checked in for the week of Thanksgiving. The front desk staff is amazing. They got us checked in and the 3 bedroom apartment was amazing. It had 3 full bedrooms, 2 and 1 half baths, large kitchen, full dining room and large living area. It was truly like being in a small home. The staff helped with all transportation, visits to sights, and any wish was handled quickly. Kate at the front desk was a godsend and always had a smile on her face, as did her colleagues. We went to Paris for a few nights and will be heading back to Beaufort House for one final evening prior to returning to the states. I can't wait to get back to our home away from home at Beaufort House. You can't beat the location and cleanliness as well as the elegance. There is no other place to stay in London.

title: What had gone wrong
text: Apartments were lovely, position was great, but the last time we stayed there staff were rude and so unhelpful we moved out mid booking. What has happened to this lovely place? Would not stay ther again.

title: Beware - hotel keeps money when booking process fails!
text: I booked a stay of 1 night on the 20th November for my wife and daughter to spend a day Christmas shopping in London. During the booking process the screen went blank for around 30 seconds and I thought that their system had crashed, however the screen came back and I entered my credit card details and booked the room. This was at around 10.20 in the evening on the 10th October - the following morning I was surprised to receive a voicemail left just before midnight from Beaufort House querying whether I would be arriving that day! I immediately called them and apparently their system had booked the accommodation for the night of the 10th November -the day I made the booking! I explained the problem but they informed me that they would be keeping my money (£309.61). I sent an email explaining exactly what happened with their system and that there was no way I could have genuinely wanted a room for the same day - especially as the reservation was made at 10.20pm with a baby cot and arrival at 2.00pm! They still refused to move the booking to the correct date and have kept my money whilst obviously incurring no cost. I have now made an alternative booking with another hotel for our stay and I am trying to recover my money from the credit card company - who were surprised that their merchant had behaved in this way. Beware....

title: It always feels like home!
text: I agree with all the reviews about the location and cleanliness, but most importantly are the staff working there. They are the reason I come back every year for almost 10 years. Thank you Mr.Juan G the general manager and all his team for everything. You all deserve the best employees of all years.

title: Fabulous apartments. We'll definitely be back
text: Stayed at the Beaufort House with my wife on the 25th June. The apartment was beautiful and very nicely presented with lots of nice touches. Considering where this is located (just around the corner from Harrods), it is also quite good value considering its excellent quality. We'll definitely be staying here again.

title: Excellent, everytime!
text: The first time I stayed at Beaufort House was with my children in the summer of 2006 for two weeks and since then I have returned to this spectacularly situated, beautifully maintained property many times. Over and above the property itself are the excellent and ever helpful staff, lead by the manager who is a perfect gentleman, make staying here something to look forward to everytime!

title: Family holiday
text: We rented a four bedroom apartment for a two week stay in London. The location in Knightsbridge is ideal with Harrods two block away. M&S, Waitrose and Sansbury all have small grocery shops less than a block away. The staff are very friendly, helpful and efficient. The unit has a very nice kitchen stocked with the basics.

title: Exceptional, stylish and relaxed.
text: After spending time at some of the well known boutique and grand hotels in London, finally a place with everything one needs with significant more space but without the hotel formalities. Exceptional finishes, warm, friendly and efficient staff aswell as a perfect position. Difficult to consider alternatives after staying here.

title: Perfect, as usual
text: We arrived on dec 25th and leaved on jan 1st and the crew was the kindest you can imagine, the apartment was clean, warm and comfortable for 5 people, including 1 child. We were on the 7th floor, so we can see the sky. Many thanks to them and a very happy new year !

title: A very homey apt. style hotel
text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Beaufort House. We stayed for 3 nights in the 3-bedrooms, 3-bathrooms (two of them en-suite) upper floor apartment. The apartment is clean and well maintained. It has a spacious living room with separate dining room. The apt style unit has AC in each bedroom (no AC in the dining, living and kitchen) but you can keep you bedroom door open to have the cool air into the living area. We were very comfortable in the living area even when it was warm and humid in London. When we checked-in, the staff had the kitchen well stocked with basic foods such as cereal, bread, milk etc. They are very friendly and helpful. The added bonus is that the place is in a very good location in the Knightsbridge area-- close to the shopping/dining establishment (one block from Harrods), and just around the corner to Marc Spencer grocery store, very convenient! but yet it is pretty quiet being located on a cul-de sac/looping street just off the main thoroughfare,. The gym is off-site within a short walking distance (local gym) Our family (of five) stayed in St Regis in Piccadilly last time we were in London but we prefer this set-up at Beaufort House (much more space for our family). We really would recommend this place. For sure, we will stay at this place again for our next visit to London.

title: Another Outstanding Stay
text: This was our second stay at Beaufort House and it was just as good, if not better than our previous visit. We spent 10 nights in a 3 bedroom superior apartment which had two balconies facing the back lane of the hotel (one off each of the major bedrooms). This place is almost perfect. It feels like you are living in your own home in the middle of London but with the benefits of a hotel. The staff are outstanding in every way, friendly, considerate and always happy to help whenever necessary. The apartment was gorgeous when we visited two years ago and it was still in the same condition upon our second stay. Everything is kept beautifully clean and tidy plus the upgraded balconies and the installation of TV's to each of the bedrooms were lovely additions. The only change we would suggest was that the breakfast basket be refilled free of charge for those staying longer than a week but other than that you can't find a better place!

title: Perfect for my family
text: Beaufort House was recommended by a friend who had also previously stayed and was perfect for my family. With an apartment, my family of six were all able to stay together and was like staying our in our house with all the comforts of home. Who would of known that this little gem was so centrally located in Knightsbridge and the staff were so friendly, taking care of our every need. Thank you Beaufort House, I will be telling all my friends!

title: Our home in London
text: We spent 8 nights at the Beaufort House in May in a one bedroom apartment. From check-in beginning with Kanie and the other staff members to the housekeepers and the manager Mr. Garcia, everyone was welcoming, polite, professional and helpful. Our apartment on the lower level was very quiet, nicely furnished and well equipped with everything we could want including its own wifi modem which is a plus in my book. Beaufort House is ideally located with convenience stores around the corner if you want to pick up some snacks or breakfast items. A block away is Harrod's where we found the Food Halls a daily temptation. Numerous restaurants are within walking distance and the tube stop is just outside Harrod's. The V+A and Natural History Museums are also about a 10 minute walk. All in all, we had a great time and would have no hesitation booking Beaufort House again for a future trip.

title: Just Perfect
text: We spent a week at the Beaufort House in May

title: Home in London
text: This is my choice in London whenever they have availability. Well managed, great and helpful staff, clean, convenient and well priced. Location is also great. Room and apartment size are good.Tip: book early.

title: Wonderful stay in Knightsbridge
text: My husband and I stayed here for a week in October 2011. It was better than I had expected and the service from the moment we arrived was over the top. We were met outside as soon as our taxi stopped and they knew it was us as they were expecting us. It was lovely to be so welcomed. Every time we asked the staff anything they were exceedingly helpful and happy to make bookings and find information for us. We were upgraded too which made our stay even nicer. We have already passed on the name to our friends as I could confidently know that they will also experience a fantatsic visit. We certainly hope to return.

title: Great Location
text: Great location in the heart of Knightsbridge and has good facilities

title: So it's true!
text: My, oh my! So are all those 5* reviews are spot on after all. We enjoyed a long 4-day London weekend at Beaufort House - a family event, 5 adults and 2 children. We stayed in the 3-bedroom Executive Suite. We had an amazing time. The apartment was absolutely perfect - beautifully and tastefully furnished and very spacious for us all and the kids. Topped off by a lovely balcony made-to-measure for the sunniest of spring weekends! Comfy very quiet bedrooms and lovely bathrooms with a range of toiletries provided. The breakfast box full of goodies was much appreciated. Fantastically efficient maid service included also. As others have said the location of Beaufort House is so convenient. 5 minutes to Knightsbridge Tube (the only problem is stopping yourself popping into Harrods en-route!), 10 minutes to the Brompton Rd Museums, and to Hyde Park. Many pubs and restaurants nearby, plus M&S Food, Waitrose and Sainsburys. So, all this PLUS the most helpful, friendly and courteous reception staff possible who made us feel so much at home that at the end of our stay we really felt Beaufort House was our home! Big, big thanks then to Juan Garcia and all his staff. We would have no qualms whatsoever about returning to our London "home" - and would love to do just that in the not too distant future.

title: Refurbishment looks fantastic!

They have not only made the interior design stunning but they've added air conditioning, plasma tv's, ipod connectors and my personal favourite..LARGE WALK IN SHOWERS!!! Good job Beaufort House...you've done great!

title: Wonderful location and Fantasic apartment style room
text: I'm using my wife's account to write this tripadvisor review. I took my dad to Japan, with a stop over in London for his 65th birthday. Knowing that London hotels can be very small and expensive, I wanted to look for an option where my father and I could share a larger space. He snores and my thought was that I could sleep on the sofa bed in the living room if the snoring got out of hand (I booked an executive 1-bedroom apartment). Fortunately, when we checked in, the sweet woman at the desk upgraded us. We ended up staying in a lovely 3 bedroom apartment with more than enough space. The beds, bathrooms and living areas were all newly updated and very comfortable. The small, but much appreciated touches, such as, providing milk, cereal, coffee, tea, and OJ in your kitchen were an added bonus. The location was equally as wonderful--we walked to the Thames, Buckingham Palace, churchill war rooms, John Winnants old residence, Westminster Abby and through a few parks. We didn't go into Harrods, but for any shopper out there, you are literally a block from Harrods. To make the quick trip even more perfect, the weather was unseasonably warm and dry! I'll definitely stay here again--they run a top notch operation! Best, P. Carter

title: Most friendly place in London
text: These apartments are in a fantastic location and are wonderfully appointed and beautifully clean. All of the staff are friendly and helpful and go out of their way to make your stay as enjoyable as possible. We never want to stay anywhere else when in London!

title: Beaufort House
text: We spent a week staying in Beaufort House this year. We found the apartment spacious for a family of 5 only 2 streets away from Harrods and the Knightsbridge Tube station. The staff were extremely friendly and efficient, only too willing to help. The cleanliness throughout the building was always kept to a high standard. There are plenty of food outlets and pubs close by so it makes a great place to have as your base in London. For me the one item I found symbolised the attention to detail was the "welcome Basket" we found in our apartment on arrival. It contained enough essentials that you did not have to hurry down to the supermarket to buy breakfast cereal and milk. I can honestly recommend this establishment for a comfortable stay with all the mod cons

title: Wonderful

Only one other apartment on the floor so it was very quiet. The apartment itself was spotless with furnishings that matched those shown on the website. Kitchen was very large and well equipped. The building is only one block from Harrods, a Sainsbury and a M&S Simply food -- so it was very easy to pick up whatever we needed and since the kitchen and dining area were so nice, we actually ate in twice. LInens of very good qualty and comfortable beds. The area is packed with small restaurants

title: Fabulous

The apartment looks exactly as in the pictures provided. Everything you could need was there including breakfast / tea / coffee supplies sufficient for one or possibly two days. Perfectly clean and everything in full working order. The location is also perfect. We will definitely stay again.

title: London home
text: This is our third time at Beaufort house and yet again another perfect stay. Just off the main Brompton Road which means you are fantastically located, but away from the noise and bustle. Plenty of places to eat out nearby and also to buy food if you wish to cook ( Marks and Spencer's, Waitrose and Sainsburys all but minutes away) The location couldn't be better - a couple of minutes you are outside Harrods and about 5 minutes form Knightsbridge tube, also only a walk away from Hyde park (10 mins) and 20 min walk from the Albert hall. The staff are incredibly helpful and polite. Wouldn't hesitate to stay again next time we come down to London

title: Home away from home

Great location, 2 minutes from Harrods,3 minutes to the Underground and 4 minutes from Harvey Nicks! Really friendly and helpful staff. I can't think of anything wrong about this place, it really is a great find! If you're currently thinking twice about it, stop, book your rooms!

title: Location! Location! Location!!!

Otherwise a wonderful place to stay in London a block from Harrods.

You can walk to the Victoria and Albert Museum and the Natural History Museum - definitely worth a visit and like many London museums free!!! We would definitely stay here again next time we are in London.

title: Holiday

Would definitely recommend staying here if you have children want that bit if extra room for them and have a nice kitchen to prepare food for them with a supermarket at your door step.

title: Still my home

title: A great place in the heart of London

The location is great and easy to commute to and from. Most impressive are the staff, who are very friendly and helpful. Only Downside is that the airconditioning units seem to be dated? and are quite noisy. Otherwise highly recommended.

title: Excellent location & wonderful hotel.
text: The staff was very nice to us during the stay. Our rooms were spacious & the bathrooms were lovely. The location to walk to so many things & the Underground was fantastic. Also the meals we had in the hotel were excellent. Would definitely recommend to friends!

title: Just exellent service
text: 1. Great service and excellent location 2.. Very convenient overnight meter parking just outside the hotel which is rare in london area 3. Upkeeping is excellent 4. utensils in apartment and cooking equipment all very well kept and maintained

TThe bedrooms were small but very nicely furnished. The kitchen had absolutely everything. The staff asked us if we wanted them to get anything in. As we were arriving around 2.30 in the afternoon and wanted to make the most of our day, we asked them to get lunch things in, which they did to the letter. We made a cooked breakfast each morning (though there are several nice places around where you could go if you could not be bothered). It is steps from Harrods, the tube station, the Natural history museum. The staff could not have been more helpful, making all kinds of booking for us for show, plays etc, offereing to drop things up to our apartment, coming to show us how to use the VCR, etc. Especially Kannie, though they were all very nice. The independence that hte apartment gave us was fantastic, much better than a hotel, though works out about the same price. I would come back again and really recommend it for larger groups of people visiting london. Use the staff and save yourself time and frustration to make your bookings!

title: Best location

title: Great experience
text: I have stayed at the four bedroom apartment .It is a good choice for a family vacation excellent location in Knightsbridge close to bus ,tube and taxi station.Refurbished nicely and well maintained compared to other apartments in London.Twenty four hours reception and good security ,the staff were friendly and helpful.

title: A wonderful place to stay, in a fabulous area!
text: I have stayed at Beaufort several times over the years. Thoroughly enjoyed the property - super clean, friendly and each time I returned it felt like coming home. I love the location - close to the tube and all the best shopping that London has to offer!

title: Superb Apartment, a real luxury home from home
text: We've stayed here before and it remains a lovely place to stay in a superb location in London. The apartments are wonderful, the facilities are great, the staff superbly attentive and nothing is too much trouble. It feels like a total home from home. We'd certainly continue to recommend this lovely accommodation.

title: If I could give The Beaufort House 6 stars, I would!
text: My husband and I stayed for a week at this charming, extremely clean and best located apartment style hotel in the Knightsbridge area. The accommodations were superb! Whatever you were looking for, the apartment had it. We stayed in a spacious, 1 bedroom suite approximately 700 sq ft. enough for a couple or small family of 3 or 4. Bed was very comfortable with ensuite air conditioning, ironing board/iron, vacuum, ample closet space, dresser, safe and flat screen 19-22" tv are in the bedroom. The living room consisted of couch (do not know if opens to sleeper sofa?) and matching chair, separate air conditioning unit and 32-40" flat screen tv with local and international channels. There was also convenient and free wifi in the apartment. The dining room area seated 6 and full service for 6, placemats, all utensils, dishes, pots, pans, everything you would need to serve and cook a meal. Kitchen had separate small freezer, mid size refrigerator, oven/microwave, coffee maker, hot water dispenser, toaster, dishwasher and all the dish and dishwasher soap, linen towels to get you started. A lovely welcome basket of snacks, breads, cereals, milk, water and juice in the refrigerator was waiting for us upon arrival. The comfort bathroom was small but efficient and included a bidet, towel warmer and luxurious Molten Brown accessories. Hidden within the cabinet area upon entry, was a dual washer and dryer 2 in 1 combination unit

title: Great for short or long stays
text: We are very happy that friends recommended this full service apartment/hotel for our nine day stay in in London during September 2012. Our one bedroom unit included a dining room, living room with work table in an alcove at the end, kitchen and two bathrooms. We were on the bottom floor and had a large garden seating area accessible either from the living room or kitchen. The kitchen was fully furnished with everything we needed including a combined washer/dryer. Having the kitchen made breakfast easy. We purchased breakfast and snack items at the M&S around the corner and the Sainsbury across Brompton Road. Our daughter lives south of London used the kitchen to cook six of us a wonderful salmon dinner one night, and the maids cleaned up after us! I found that I needed to keep the front and back windows open at night to cool the unit to my favorite sleeping temperature. Also housekeeping provided a memory foam mattress top that made my wife’s nights more comfortable. The location is a couple of minutes from the Knightsbridge tube station and Harrods. Parks and Buckingham palace are just short walks away. The front desk staff could not have been more friendly and helpful. We found all their recommendations to be excellent, wether for coffee, a great local wine shop, or restaurants.

title: As always.....it is like coming back home
text: We'll never stop praising enough The Beaufort ! this is our 4th stay here in the last year and we love to come ! everytime we come things get better since the staff knows us and they are so nice and helpful. The apartments are great, modern, clean, spotless and the location can't be better. This is our home in London...hate to leave and can't wait to be back in some weeks...

title: Amazing Trip.
text: My husband and I went to London to spend some quality time together after a long time of hard work, and we had the best time! Beaufort House is an amazing place for any type of trip, the apartments are all fully equiped for every need, the size of the apartments are just right and the welcome basket was lovely for our breakfast, and not forget about how nice and helpfull the staff was, they are a 24hrs service and everyone was amazingly friendly and helped us in everything we wanted. After searching a long time for places to stay in London we luckly found Beaufort House. And I will recommend Beaufort House to all my friends and definately will come back. Thank you Beaufort House for our lovely stay and congratulations to all staff, 100% Fabulous.

title: A home in Knightsbridge
text: Juan and his staff have made this a real haven. Great location, excellent amenities all mean something, but without the people it is meaningless! Deserves all the awards and accolades it has received.

title: Fantastic place to stay in London
text: We stayed here for 2 weeks over the Olympic period. We stayed in a 3 bedroom apartment for a family of 5. It was the perfect location to base ourselves for an extended stay in London. The apartment set up was ideal, not huge but big for London. Just like a 5 star hotel but with more room. Serviced everyday, free Wifi, good size living area with separate dining room. The location is fantastic - literally 2 minutes to Harrods and the Knightsbridge tube, 10 mins to Sloane Square. There is an M&S food shop and a Sainsburys very near by to buy supermarket essentials. There was also a basic start up kit waiting for us, together with a lovely bunch of flowers. I would definitely stay here again, particularly if traveling with kids.

title: Elegant home away from home
text: I have stayed here for business on over a half-dozen occasions. I prefer self-catered apartments and this is the best one I have found in central London. The rooms are clean and well decorated. Free wireless is easily accessible. The young front desk staff are extremely friendly. Housekeeping is efficient and also cordial. Food shopping is convenient as a Sainsbury's is across the street and Harrod's food court is a block away. The reception area is a bit worn, but charming. I highly recommend the place to people looking for an elegant home away from home in London.

title: This is what I call home
text: I have been staying here for years now, wonderful staff super nice and friendly! they make you feel like your are home! very nice and spacious apartments and great location. I really recommend this place.

title: Fabulous London Accommodation
text: We stayed at Beaufort House for 6 nights in April 2012 in a 3 bedroom executive apartment (after receiving an upgrade upon arrival from the standard 3 Bedroom). After a 13 hour flight from Singapore, Beaufort House and its staff were an oasis. The staff are outstanding. Friendly, courteous, nothing is too much trouble and they genuinely seemed to enjoy chatting to us as well as our children when given the opportunity. The apartments are lovely and fully outfitted with everything you could need. The kids were satisfied with the satellite tv after a day of site seeing and the washer dryer was a welcome addition. The breakfast basket provided upon arrival was fabulous and was enough to last us at least the first few days of our stay. Any other provisions were easily accessible at the M&S around the corner. The location is wonderful. You literally walk around the corner and run smack bang into Harrods and it is on the blue line for the Big Bus Tour which is another bonus. Even though you are in a busy area, the hotel itself is quiet and beautifully maintained. During our stay, the hotel was fully booked and whilst on the odd occasion the neighbours were a bit noisy, all in all the hotel is quiet and peaceful. If you are staying in London and looking for apartment style accommodation, you will not beat Beaufort House.

title: Great Place to Stay!
text: We arrived on a typically cold, damp London morning at about 7 am. We were greeted cheerfully and informed that we had been upgraded to a three bedroom apartment. Our luggage was dealt with quickly and we were shown up to our apartment. What a surprise. The apartments were quite lovely, having recently been renovated and redecorated. The bedrooms were roomy and very pleasant, all with individually controlled air con and heating. The bedrooms all get mornng sunshine, which was very pleasant and made the rooms seem very light and airy. The bathrooms (2) were new and very plush, with lots of fresh towels and toiletries. The living spaces were very generous and comfortable, comprising a spacious living room and a separate dining room. The kitchen had every mod con and a washing machine (they also have a laundry service if you cant be bothered doing your own ) These apartments are situated literally around the corner from Harrods, off Brompton Road, yet the street is quiet. Shops and restaurants are on your doorstep. As we were travelling with our two children (11 and 14), it is often easier to have an apartment than a hotel room each and Beaufort house was certainly ideal and more reasonably priced than deluxe hotels. The service was excellent, right down to the welcome basket of breakfast items for our arrival. (They will also do your grocery shopping for you're too lazy to slip around the corner to Marks &Spencers or across the road to Harrods 102.) The apartment was lovely - there were simply no bad points. If you are looking for a deluxe alternative to a hotel, Beaufort House is an excellent choice in central London. Will definitely stay here again when we return.

title: Wonderful base for London trip
text: I spent 10 nights at Beaufort House in May 2007. I cannot say enough good things about the experience. The apartment was large and comfortable with all the amenities described in the advertising readily available. It was serviced every day and kept in impecable condition by the excellent staff. The office staff was very freindly and efficient. They all knew me by the second day and were helpful in many ways. The location is terrific, just a block's walk to Harrods and the Knightsbridge tube station. There are also many bus lines on the main road as well. It is also just a fair walk to Hyde Park or the V&A. My one note to US travelers is that the washer/dryer is a single machine and is slow compared to the ones I am used to. It can take a couple hours to do a single load of clothes. So don't leave all your laundry to your last night.

title: A Home away from Home
text: We have just returned from lovely stay at Beaufort House and could not have been more pleased with our experience. We traveled from America with two children (ages 4 and 7) and all of us felt welcomed. Having a flat for a few days made our trip much more enjoyable for our family. The location was easy to navigate with simple access to cabs, the tube and bus routes, not to mention restaurants and groceries. The staff was kind and helpful and having the basic groceries already in place in our kitchen was a nice touch. Despite Trip Advisor's putting this in the "Bed and Breakfast" category, this is really a luxury hotel that simply doesn't have actual room service or a conference room. But with its amazing location (the street really is quiet despite being right off Brompton Road), you won't miss a thing. Loved it and hope to be back.

title: Lovely Stay
text: The hotel is extremely neat and clean and very well positioned. Rooms are a little small but ok by London standards. The service and staff are excellent and make ones stay a pleasure. Only negative side being their 10am checkout but other than that I would recommend this hotel to anybody.

title: Fantastic Location, Great Service, Beautiful Apartment! A+
text: Having lived and worked in London, I believe there is no better area to stay in than Knightsbridge. Beaufort House is in a perfect spot--on a quiet, tree-lined block just off of Brompton Road. For ease in getting around the city, you are a few blocks from the Piccadilly Line / Knightsbridge Tube stop. Hyde Park, Science and Natural History Museums and fantastic shopping (Harrod's is a block away) are only steps away. And, in case you wanted fabulous take-away instead of eating out-- Sainsbury's, Marks and Spencer's are within a block. Service at Beaufort House is outstanding. Our two bedroom was spotless when we arrived and throughout our stay. The housekeeping staff really ran a tight ship. They started us off with a basket of cereals, teas, coffee, bread, butter, milk, orange juice and such so that we wouldn't starve when we first arrived from NY. The apartment was well-stocked with everything you would need to actually live there (laundry, fab kitchen, great beds etc). And, Richard and his team at the front desk were attentive and very helpful! Our apartment had the look and feel of a Four Seasons Hotel -- modern yet warm and charming. We were looking for a high-end (5-star) hotel but needed the extra room since we were traveling with children. This was a perfect fit! Enjoy London with the kids. Beaufort House makes it easy to do so!

title: Perfect in Every Way
text: It isn't every day that one is invited to dine at Buckingham Palace so the choice of a worthy accommodation was imperative. Beaufort House was perfect in every way - location, value, cleanliness and a charming and helpful staff. Four friends - a couple and two singles shared a three bedroom accommodation for a week. The value was fantastic coming in at 156 pounds per person per night. Given that we had three bedrooms and three baths in addition to an ample sitting room and separate dining room and a fully kitted out kitchen, I cannot think of a better value in London. The apartment was serviced daily and was spotless throughout our stay. A wonderful place to settle in and call home while in London.

title: The best in London!!!!!
text: The is no better place to stay in London!!!!!! Classy furniture, impecable cleanliness, fabulous location!!!! Front desk team extremilly efficient, they all about Lonndon!!!!! I just Loved it!!!!!! Stay here!!!!!!!

title: Immaculate, Central, Perfect!
text: We were only down for one night with the kids and Beaufort House is a perfect place to stay. Within metres of Harrods and a short walk to museums, South Ken, Sloane Street etc. The apartment was well appointed with more than enough space for what we needed. I'll tell you the one thing that made Beaufort House - the guys working there - I can't describe the welcome and the service provided. It was exceptional and appreciated.

title: Still a London Gem
text: I have now stayed at Beaufort House, at various times of the year, on six occasions. The refurbishments are now complete and feature a modern, muted palette. Other than the excellent location (culture/shopping/transport) the staff at Beaufort House the real plus. They are unfailingly welcoming and pleasant and nothing is too much trouble. The fact I keep seeing the same faces over the years, and am now on first name terms with some, is testament that the Beaufort must be a pleasant place to work too. And happy staff make for happy guests in my experience. If your budget allows I recommend a stay here without hesitation

title: Getting very tired
text: We booked a 2 night stay at Beaufort House as the reviews looked great and the extra space of an apartment was ideal for our purposes (much cheaper than a suite for 2 nights at a good 4/5 star hotel). Whilst the location cannot be faulted and the staff are as helpful and friendly as everyone says - the accommodation itself is disappointing. Apartment 12 was our "superior 1 bed apartment" but it was not as described on the hotel's website - it did not have an ensuite bathroom and additional guest cloakroom - just 1 bathroom off the hall which was very small with a mixer tap acting as the over bath shower. The bath itself was also very small - as were the hotel towels- not a luxury bathroom by anyone's standard. The lounge was big enough with 2 settees and a small dining table in the room - but it had 1 small window (about 4 feet above floor level) which let in very little light and resulted in a dark and dingy looking room. The bedroom was similarly dark and overlooked the air conditioning units for the whole house - unattractive and noisy! This was doubly annoying since our very stuffy apartment did not have air conditioning itself but opening the windows meant that we had all of the noise but none of the comfort of everyone else's aircon. There is a programme of refurbishment underway - they are doing 2 apartments at a time on a programme that is due for completion in summer 2009 - I'd wait until then before booking!

title: A true gem
text: We stayed at the Beaufort House Apartments in October 2001 with our 7 year old son as we often find hotels difficult when you have children and chose to try an apartment instead this time. What a wonderful place to stay!! From the moment we arrived, we were made to feel very special. The front of house staff are exceptional and so very friendly and knowledgeable. Our little boy was delighted that the lady who checked us in remembered his name, and called him by his name every time she saw him! A small thing to do, but it meant an awful lot. Our apartment was superb - very, very clean, beautifully decorated, very well equiped and so quiet considering the building's proximity to a busy road. The location is great too - only a short stroll to the tube station, lots of shops and restaurants nearby and within walking distance of the big museums. We can't wait to come back! Our little boy refers to the apartment as 'the lovely place in London'! We can't imagine staying anywhere else now. If you are looking for an apartment in London we can't recommend Beaufort House enough. It's superb - a true gem! We're looking forward to a return visit as soon as possible.

title: Fantastic!
text: After a week at the beaufort house in a 3 bedroom appartment, i would definitely recommend it! Clean appartment, very nice decoration, and fantastic location without the noise! The actual bedrooms are a bit small but for us it was just a small detail.

title: Another lovely meal
text: Thank you to The Victoria for another great evening of great food, lovely ambiance and good service. I frequently eat here - it's the perfect place to take a parent or catch up with good friends over a glass of wine - and am never disappointed. My staple is to pick two starters and the mini pudding - the perfect size packed full of interesting and thoughtful flavours. The bar are also very accommodating of my small dog who happily sleeps under the table in the bar. These things all combine to make this one of my favourite local restaurants.

title: 1st Class hotel with 1st Class service
text: There is a small car park at the back of the pub for around 10 cars. Upon entering the beautiful pub we were greeted with the beautiful smell of woodsmoke coming from the fire as well as a warm welcome from the staff - who were very helpful and friendly, from table service to arranging taxis for us-. The pub itself is a very old building and it is also very clear that a lot of money has been put into the sympathetic refit. The en-suite rooms are separate from the pub which we found to be very clean, comfortable and quiet with a little fridge at the bottom of the stairs filled with fresh milk and water. The food is quite something, The burger I had from the bar in the evening was fantastic, it towered over the plate with handcut chips as a side, the meat was melt in the mouth and very well cooked - a very sumptuous meal indeed. Breakfast is a large selection of homemade breads and pastries, meats, cheeses, yogurts, cereals, honey etc and of a high quality. A cooked breakfast is an additional option which I will try on my next visit, a wonderful place to stay in Richmond and about a 5 min taxi run to the local train station which takes you into central London. In Summary the Good points Friendly and helpful staff The food - of high quality The Room - a very good nights sleep was had Surroundings - very cosy and welcoming There are really no bad points in my opinion

title: Sublime dining experience
text: There a great pubs and there are great restaurants - but what if you combined the two? What do you think the result might look like? My wife and I discovered just that, culinary paradise in a relaxed, informal and convivial atmosphere, when we recently visited The Victoria, a gastro pub within spitting distance of Richmond Park owned and run by the renowned chef Paul Merrett. In fact to call The Victoria a gastro pub would be far too simplistic

title: Friendly, good quality food and a nice room.
text: We stayed here whilst attending a wedding in nearby Syon park, the room was clean and well presented. The food and service during our stay was excellent, highly recommended. We stayed in a spacious double room with a great shower most comfortable.

title: Stayed 2 nights and had lunch
text: Excellent hosting by the staff accommodating to our every request with two very small children. Good breakfast. Delicious food generally. Good quality coffee machine in the room and nice touch of triple chocolate cookies. Rooms are ok, clean and neat but a bit tired, hooks falling off walls, door stop broken, bed link not fitted well. Just small maintenance issues. Good wine list and nicely made mixed drinks. We’ll be back for sure if we need to stay close to my family but not with them.

title: Rather disappointing
text: Came here for a birthday meal, after previous experiences had been rather good. While the atmosphere was nice enough, and the starters were great, the chicken burger recieved (after 45 mins wait) came out of the kitchen stone cold, and even when returned after making a complaint and it being 'reheated,' the chicken was still only luke warm and the rest of the burger remained cold. We had heard another customer in the pub at the time complaining of a cold burger so we knew we weren't alone... clearly some issues in the kitchen that night! The Onglet Steak was mostly good - with the rosti being particularly good, and so were the fish and chips apart from the rather small portions in general relative to the prices. While the servers tried to be apologetic, we were still automatically charged the full 12.5% service along with no mention of compensation for the burger - the overall experience therefore with the fairly small portions of food, seeming lack of care over the burger and very long wait created quite a disappointing experience this time around, especially for a birthday dinner!

title: Lovely atmosphere and child friendly
text: We had a great pre-Xmas lunch here at the weekend. We had a fairly big group with two young children and a baby and the staff were very accommodating. The food was great and the pub had a great bustling atmosphere. We will definitely return when in the area.

title: Twickenham Rugby visit
text: Recently stayed here for a visit to Twickenham Stadium, the location and free parking is great with only a £13 uber to the stadium. The pub is clean, cosy and serves great food- far higher standard than traditional “pub food”. The breakfast is also nice and complimentary and the staff are friendly and efficient. The rooms are small but also clean and cosy. Only improvements would be the coffee/ tea machines in the rooms and an ability to turn the heating down in the room!

title: Overpriced
text: Recently had a meal at the Victoria in East Sheen. The restaurant is in The Victoria pub, hidden away in the back streets of East Sheen. There is free parking behind the pub, which is very useful if you are driving into the City. The restaurant is fairly rambling, set behind a bar clearly used by locals and their dogs, who indifferently made no attempt to let anyone pass, despite being politely asked. The menu was nouveau pub, including deserts served in marmalade jars. Service was brisk and efficient, but impersonal, with little eye contact. Food was OK, but expensive for what it was. I had a steak, which consisted of a 4"" diameter very fatty ribby eye, steak quite well cooked accompanied by a bowl of floury chunky chips, a bowl of indifferent salad and a large bowl of bearnaise sauce. At just under £20 this was poor value. Overall, not greatly impressed.

title: Food lovely, rooms need improving to make it 4 star.
text: The food was really good, we couldnt fault our 3 course meal. The staff were also great. The down side were the rooms. The beds were really old and uncomfortable. The bathroom smelt of dam. It really needed up grading to be a 4 star hotel.

title: Good
text: I’d give 3 and a half if I could - this is definitely one of the better pubs I’ve been to in this area. The food on the most part was great - the fish was extremely fresh and the people who had the lamb said it was very tender. I also really enjoyed my apple crumble dessert. If you don’t eat meat however the menu is very limited - only one fish option and one veggie option on the mains - and nothing at all for vegans. We also found it strange that the roasts were served without gravy - making them very dry. When we asked about this some was brought out - but only a tiny jug - barely enough for one person let alone two. Service was a little hit and miss - two of the main courses came out long after the others - and one dessert was forgotten altogether (they did however bring it out quickly once we’d let them know - and removed it from the bill straightaway). A few issues need to be ironed out but overall this is a good place to visit - I’ll certainly be back.

title: wedding reception
text: Our daughter and partners wedding reception was held at The Victoria on Saturday 8th September. The service was excellent, Leah and her staff did everything to make the day run smoothly. Most of the guests commentated on the excellent food and the pub has such a lovely atmosphere it felt just as my daughter and her partner wanted it to - a party to celebrate their marriage. Several of us stayed in the rooms for the night which was great and the breakfast next morning was lovely, compliments to the chef and all the kitchen staff. I must admit I was a little dubious when my daughter said they were having their reception in a pub but The Victoria is quite a lot more than a regular pub and i'm so glad they chose that venue and would recommend it to anyone..So a big thank you to Leah and all her staff we will be back soon for a meal.

title: Lovely lunch
text: Well presented and very enjoyable food. Pleasant interior and patio garden. There is a very good priced set lunch available which is amazing value. Friendly and efficient staff. Look forward to returning.

title: Easy access to East Sheen & Richmond Park
text: My husband and I spent 3 nights in April at The Victoria principally because my brother's house is walking distance from it. The pub reminded me of a country watering hole, where locals appeared with their dogs to chat and drink a cup of coffee or a beer -- an English sort of "Cheers", where everybody knows your name. The staff was very friendly. Breakfast was delicious -- greek yogurt, fruit, freshly baked bread and pastries, cereal, cappuccino, and I had some very good mussels for lunch one day. The accomodations on the other hand were not comparable. Yes, the bed was comfortable and the room clean, but it was otherwise lacking for the price. Neither My 6'2" husband nor I was able to comfortably shower

title: Fabulous!
text: Venue. Food. Service - all fab-u-lous. I'd booked Sunday lunch for 12 ladies - a baby shower lunch. Due to traffic some of us were very late, but staff were accommodating and made sure we never felt rushed and even managed to switch tables around so that we wouldnt have to be thrown off our table. The food was simply divine too. (The table actually went quiet for a a good 15 mins.) Am definitely plannng on going back to devour the rest of the menu....

title: A very good place to stay
text: Booked this hotel because easy to get to Wimbledon for the tennis & was not disappointed.Quiet location .Very friendly staff and excellent room. Busy at times and a little chaotic in the bar. Wonderful area at the rear for sitting & eating outside. Enjoyed all the food. Would stay again.

title: Food disappointing, service amiss and unschooled
text: In spite of the lovely back garden setting on a summer's evening, we were ignored upon arrival, and we waited ages to be served our drinks and to be asked for our food order when finally seated (though there were many staff, most were very young and seemed to ignore the patrons rather than make eye contact). Our waitress informed us that a lot of the staff were "in training" that evening. I heard more than one glass item get dropped from a tray. The food was OK but nothing remarkable, and drinks prices were over the top (since when is a large glass of wine £12?). Our waitress sneered when we ordered burgers from the "classic" menu, ostensibly not from the pricier specials section (we did order starters!). Didn't appreciate a guy installing lights in the back garden plied with free pints from the bar while we were trying to enjoy our supper. As others have mentioned, adding on the 12.5% service charge on top of already more central London prices was the icing on the cake. I won't be back anytime soon. With decent service and more reasonable pricing this could be so much better.

title: An oasis
text: We have just returned from a stay at the Victoria. From the start it was absolutely stunning. The staff are very friendly and helpful. We were able to park our car on site. The garden at the back is an oasis of flowers and calm. It was so welcoming for dogs children and all ages. Beautiful The food is sublime. All home made fresh ingredients. The room was perfect. They kindly put prosecco in the room as it was a special occasion. Clean ,fresh and modern. Coffee machine , water in the room. Really comfy and cosy. On returning to the Victoria after our evening out. It was a pleasure to sit back in the garden with the lovely lights on and enjoy a glass of wine. Continental breakfast in the morning was fresh ,well presented and delicious. Will definitely recommend this hotel to everyone. Thank you for a very enjoyable stay.

title: Over-Priced Average Food
text: Went out with colleagues for lunch. Not impressed by the quality, portions or price. Paid £17 supposedly for hake (or was it cod?) wrapped in ham and a puddle of tired risotto. Price then supplemented by a "service" charge of 12.5%

title: Great hospitality with gourmet dining
text: On a business trip in London, and knowing the Richmond area well I chose to stay at "The Victoria" for the week . This is a first class establishment owned and managed by professionals who clearly understand, and practice the art of delivering exceptional cuisine, with service and style. The hotel, and gastropub has great ambience, and much care and attention has been placed on all the key factors that turn a "stay" into "an occasion". The hotel takes full advantage of a superb tucked away location, with parking, that allows for relative peace, and quiet, and has been fitted out for comfort, and enjoyment for those wanting a decent pint, superb food, and a good night's sleep. It is also a sincere pleasure to engage with staff, who are obviously very motivated, and take considerable pride in what they do. It is easy to see that both Mr Paul Merrett, Chef proprietor and his business partner, restauranteur Mr Greg Bellamy, work very hard to achieve this excellent standard, and I compliment their effort which is visibly apparent to a guest used to staying at numerous hotels worldwide. The bedroom was immaculately presented, and kept this way throughout my stay by the housekeeping staff. The room was well thought out, with working space at the desk, and all the usual amenities required for day to day use, including a good shower with instant hot water in the mornings. With Wi Fi in the lounge/snug area one can work conveniently prior to or after breakfast, lunch or dinner in a very relaxing setting. This is a wonderful venue for entertaining either on business, or socially, and a very welcome change from some of the typical chains. I would like to congratulate all of the team at "The Victoria" and look forward to a repeat stay in the near future.

title: Service a shambles
text: Popped in for drinks & nibbles with 4 girlfriends on a Thursday night to find the Vic really busy with drinker and diners. Not sure why the restaurant space wasn’t being used given that the was so busy. Service was chaotic. There were plenty of staff but service really was a shambles. One member of staff couldn’t understand English well so everything needed to be explained 3 times and then came back wrong anyway. Drinks that weren’t ordered were brought, ordered drinks forgotten, food orders mixed up..... and these were the mistakes of the entire team, not just the one guy with poor English. Bizarrely they seemed keen on table service for drinks but why start this if you can’t cope? We ended up with empty glasses for half the night and had to wave down staff for additional drinks. We’d have been happy to go to the bar! Why not put an an extra pair of hand behind the bar so guests don’t go thirsty? Really hope this place sorts itself out. Staff all seem new so hopefully things will improve. Such a shame management don’t pay any attention to customer comments or these reviews. We’re locals so knew many of the other diners and drinkers.... every one of them us the same experience. Thankfully for the Vic it became funny so a good night was still had by all.

title: Bad Breakfast
text: The Victoria advertises breakfast and yet they seemed a little disappointed to receive guests at 9.30am. Diners share the 'lounge' with staff doing paperwork and having discussions about the day's business. My egg whites were runny and inedible. When questioning why the eggs were still on my bill as "I didn't eat them", the rude and very aggressive David stated "I think you ate them - that's why". Won't be back.

title: Did a small birthday party here
text: Excellent communication, quality snack food as well as presentation and a very friendly welcome. Was very busy on a Friday evenng but we were well served. We didn't stay here in the B&B but simply reserved an area for our party.

title: Boxing Day Challenges
text: Helpful staff, reasonable food, which is an achievement on Boxing Day, but a certain amount of chaos as a result of the restaurant being absolutely packed. Given its a bit of a desert area for food, definitely worth visiting. Equally, benefit of the doubt on what it would be like on a normal day. Good fish, light touch risotto, and pleasant lamb. Interestingly, everyone added salt, so suggest that the kitchen may be overly careful.

title: Shocking
text: This was our 3rd trip to The Victoria, the first two both very good. Unfortunately this was a total shambles. We arrived for a midday booking and didn’t eat till 2pm after they had lost our first order and we had asked 3 times when are food was going to arrive before they admitted the mistake. Even before that the order was a mess when asking whether the bean chilli was vegetarian the waitress had no idea. We also made drinks orders that never appeared - we asked for 1 pint of kronenburg 3 times and gave up in the end. I would say that the manager was very apologetic and did not charge us for the meal so that was appreciated but I’m not sure if that’s enough for us to go back after such a poor service.

title: Tremendous wedding Breakfast
text: Had lunch (wedding breakfast) at this gastropub (their description) with 40 + others. The pub is welcoming and modern-looking and we dined in the conservatory to the side of the main building. The food was excellent. For starter we had a prawn salad asian style, which while it would not have been a first choice for me was tasty and well balanced. The main course was a very tender steak served with potatoes and baby carrots. all was well seasoned and well cooked

title: How hard can good food be?
text: It's my local and I've never had a "great" meal here other than BBQ in the garden, in fact I've never had a good meal. Had a friends leaving dinner here last night and as usual the food was so sub-standard I'm amazed anyone goes. I think it's been taken over as there's loads of refurbishment going on which is nice but there is no excuse for bad food. 4 of us had steaks and the cut was awful, full of sinew and tough as old boots. They took two off the bill but yet again the Victoria disappoints. The manager didn't seem very bothered. The Plough, whilst not as pretty, serves very good food. And if they made a mistake they'd go the extra mile to ensure we were happy. We're local, we're regulars, we're the life blood of these places so come on guys make a bit of an effort!

title: Very Enjoyable Stay
text: I spent two nights at this inn and found it to be comfortable. My room and ensuite were clean and nicely decorated. Although there was a coffee machine in the room I would have preferred a kettle because I'm a tea drinker and have fixed ideas on how to make a good cuppa. You need boiling water and machines never get the water to a high enough temperature. Enough of the OCD! The breakfast was adequate with very nice bread but I was expecting more choice in the meat and cheese department as I'm not at all interested in cereal or fruit (yes, I know, unhealthy!! but that's my taste). On the first morning there was apple and orange juice but, alas, on the second morning this was overlooked. Yes, I could have asked but hey it wasn't the end of the world. I could also have upgraded to a full English breakfast for £8.50 (if I remember correctly) and I may do so during a future visit. I came to London to visit my five grandchildren and one newly born great grandson and wanted somewhere nice and peaceful to come back to with a parking space and this I did have. I would definitely return and would be absolutely overjoyed if my above comments were taken into account. Next time I intend to try out the restaurant as the group chef director is Paul Merrett. The staff were nice and friendly

title: Very Warm Welcome
text: We received a very warm welcome at the Victoria. The bar staff were friendly and very efficient. We were shown to our rooms immediately on arrival. The room was spacious and clean.The bed was very confortable wit crisp cotton sheets. The ensuite shower was compact but functional. Plenty of hot water. Breakfast was in the bar, the buffet breakfast was very good and the coffee fresh and piping hot. We sat in the bar after we had unpacked and had a complimentory coffee, a nice touch. We did not dine in the resturant this time but will certainly give it a try when we stay next time.

title: A Little calm place in London
text: We had a two night stay here while visiting family in East Sheen. The rooms are tastefully decorated and there are some nice touches - there's a fridge downstairs in the accommodation area where you can help yourself to a complimentary bottle of still or sparkling water, also a tray to brew your own tea or coffee. This meant fresh milk rather than horrid little plastic tubs! Breakfast is served in the conservatory - plentiful newspapers. Tea, coffee & fresh juice are served, otherwise it's help yourself. Nothing exciting, but fine. We had an evening meal for the family one night. We thought it was a touch expensive (London prices!) and that the choice for our veggie daughter was limited (Only one main course, which she could have made any day) The kitchen were asked if there was anything else they could do, but no they couldn't. That's a bit disappointing & we pointed it out to the staff, who accepted the feedback well and said they'd take it on board. This is, after all, a gastropub with rooms rather than an hotel. We liked the ambience and overall, we'd stay again
