text: When looking on the website to book we didn't expect much but it was fairly cheap & near where we needed to be so we just went for it. Just as we were boarding the plane to London we received a phone call saying we had been re-located to their property in earl's court due to a problem with the rooms. We flat out refused as the reason we were were visiting London was for an event near Paddington & they then changed their story & said there was only twin rooms available. Now having read these reviews & seen some pics of the double rooms I am glad this happened as our twin room was very spacious compared to the doubles! When we arrived the man on reception demanded credit card details even though we had already paid & refused to tell us why they needed them. Pros: great location, fairly cheap, nice area Cons: walls are paper thin (woken frequently through the night by toilet flushes, noisy children), kettle but no tea bags, coffee or sugar. no washing up liquid or anyway to do dishes.

title: be very very careful
text: While it looks and sounds great on the web, these are not apartment but very small rooms....if your a bloke of any size you wont be able to even sit on the toilet with out adopting a bent man act. The worst room is outside and under the road in a World War II bomb shelter....which may sound exciting but its not....full of mould, and no room to move.....its also to far into the city!

title: Wouldn't recommend it
text: The building is well located in Paddington. We arrived from Australia at 8am, tired and wanting to leave our bags until we could check in. We had booked through Central London Apartments and our information said 'reception' would be open from 8am to 10pm 7 days. At 10:30 am there was still no sign of anyone to open reception and the house keeping staff were trying to deal with 12 cross people lined up in the very narrow hallway. Apparently the reception hours are somewhat flexible. (Unlike the Eastern European receptionist - if there is an expression that means the opposite of "nothing was too much trouble" it applies to her.) The rooms are very small but there was a sink, microwave and fridge. A tea towel and a smidge of washing up detergent would be universally provided in Australia but apparently not at Dylan. There was no soap holder in the shower and no toilet roll holder and it was the smallest bathroom I have ever been in in 25 years of travelling. The price included internet access which we were counting on - on the 5th floor we had no signal at all

title: Very Pleasent stay in Dylan Paddington
text: we had a lovely stay in Dylan Paddington appartments. Tiny, but clean and comfortably rooms and very kind and helpful people at the reception. I really recommend this place and will come back for sure :-)

title: Do not stay here
text: DO NOT STAY HERE. We were sent here from their partner hotel as our room had a leak (apparantly) - no warning before we got there. We didn't know until we'd paid for a our room that there was actually no room for us and we were being put in one of the staffs rooms who was away for the weekend - sheets covering his belongins and a put me up bed as we'd booked for 3. Complete with porn stash in bedside table!! Manager was just rude when we complained and acted like he was doing us a favour!

title: You get less than what you pay for here
text: London is expensive, that's just the way it is, so I bore this in mind when I booked to stay here. I have pretty low standards, so I wasn't expecting much. Anyone else booking should bear in mind that this is cheap by London standards, and adjust their expectations accordingly. However, I wasn't expecting it to be quite as bad as it was. The bathroom was so small that I had to sit sideways on the toilet. The room was so small that there wasn't even enough space to do my usual yoga practice (which doesn't require a lot of space). Housekeeping was a bare minimum - they threw some clean towels on the bed, but didn't even bother to make the bed, or to wash up the dishes in the sink. When I checked out I asked about leaving my bag there for the day, and was told there would be a £10 charge. I have never heard of such a thing! There are plenty of other hotels in this price range near Paddington Station, so I will pick another when I have to stay overnight in London (or go with Air BnB).

title: Poor service, poor rooms
text: Good location near Paddington Heathrow Express, but the room were tiny, we were unable to turn off the radiator, hardly any hot water in the shower, leakage through the ceiling in the bathroom (strange liquid was landing on toilet - in the actual bedroom there was marks in the ceiling telling that there has been a leakage, lousy windows not able to stay up nor keep the wind out! We also had a double room (thought I think I booked a twin rooms), but a doulbe is fine and I can share the bed with my friend but PREFER A SEPARATE BLANKET/QUILT - but when asking they said it was only one per room!!!!!! They did not have a spare!!! And you also have to 5% extra in order to pay with credit card.

title: Agree - don't stay here!
text: We ignored the general feedback here and booked a night at the Dylan Hotel, to our cost! We were put in room 41. We have stayed in all sorts of hotels, many basic and small (we’re not into 4*), but not like this. It was sold as a double but it would be small even for a single room – you would only fit in it if you were a slim single person with very small piece of hand luggage. When I asked was there anything that would actually fit two bodies and luggage, I was shown another room that was even worse, very slightly bigger but in the lower ground with absolutely no natural light. So we stayed in Rm 41. Never again. The double bed was pushed against the wall and there was barely room then to walk between the bed and the other wall, against which clothes were also supposed to hang! The ¾ size door to the miniscule bathroom couldn’t open all the way because the bed was in the way. The ‘kitchenette’ is a sink-sized bench in the corner with mini fridge underneath, It has 2 hotplates on the side of a very tiny sink and a toaster, but there is absolutely no room to actually do anything with it. There are no teabags, no bedside tables, no reading lights, no hairdryer, no air conditioning, and you have to pay a deposit for the remote controls for the TV (though aren’t told this on check in). The website we went to said it had wi-fi but the coverage didn’t reach our room

title: 4 nights in london
text: Stayed 4 nights at apts.We stayed in basement apt, room was small but adequate, place was clean, good water pressure /temp in shower and clean towels everyday.The apt had everything you would need to make quick meals, but there were so many small family run cafes/restaurants in the immediate area at brilliant prices that we didn't need to use the cooking equip. Hyde park is just round the corner and metro/bus links a 4 min walk. All in all, if you want a cheap, clean place to stay with good links to rest of city then this is it.

title: Avoid!!!
text: Appalling customer service... I wish I never booked this hotel! Any reputable agency - online of offline should think twice before doing business with Dylan house (London). Hopefully sooner or later they will realize and stop dealing with them. The only reason I booked 2 nights at this hotel via www.bookings.com was close proximity to where I needed to be in London last weekend of October for my NLP seminar. I was called from the hotel only 3 days before arrival date to be informed that they had some maintenance work going on and no rooms were available. Nobody bothered to apologize for inconvenience. I had to find another hotel nearby. A month later while checking my credit card statement I realized that Dylan House still charged me £77 - one nights fee. When I phoned to inquire about the charge, both - bookings.com and Dylan House replied, that this was a cancellation fee for no show.... Please, be aware and try to avoid this hotel at all cost!

title: Small but Okay with Good location
text: Stayed for 3 nights, the first two in a triple room cause that's all they had left, which really should just be a double room, but they've just shoved a 3rd bed into it. Checked out but had to stay a 3rd night due to flights rearrangements and ended up in an actual double room on the top floor which was TINY!. The room was clean enough, but should be cleaner. Mould in the bathroom tile grout which I hate and the shower head itself needed a scrub. But a good location, lots of cheap food places around and keep an eye out for the convenience store around the corner that has internet for 1 Pound an hour. Bargain!

title: A jewel in central London for £70 a night!!
text: Firstly I was drawn in by the lavish website and the pictures of a suave and contemporary decor apartment, I booked with out hesitation! Then afterwards I wanted to see a few more pictures so I ran a search on Google and SLAP! I was met by some awful Tripadvisor reviews!! I was very nervous to say the least. However my booking was made and I did not have time to look elsewhere so I sent a email off to the Dylan voicing my concerns which were met with a prompt and timely reply fuelling my confidence! I continued with my booking. On arrival I was shown into the office and was in a awful hurry to meet work colleagues and was checked in swiftly and with zero problems. I was issued a key and given directions to my room. No problem there!! I opened the door expecting to see a dive as per the reviews however I was cock-a-hoop to discover that the room was delightfully adequate and tastefully designed, clean and well equipped for the single or duo traveller(s). I left the room after trying out the bed to which I found extremely comfy and walked 100yrds to the next street where I found a stylish street full of trendy cafes and a really nice pub called The Mitre. I could not believe that I had grabbed such a great deal. £70 for a quaint, stylish and primly located bed for the night. A stones throw from the pub and I was at Marble Arch chowing down on some very fine food and wine at the Island Grill restaurant. Not only will I give this hidden jewel 10/10 I will also recommend it to anyone going to the city on a short stay! Well done Dylan Paddington! I have tried to book 4 rooms for my brothers 40th next month but they are full! And I am not surprised......

title: Poor quality 'apartment', very disappointing.
text: We were allocated Room 41 which was has not yet been refurbished. It was classed as an 'apartment' but was such a tiny room that you couldn't fully open the shower room door because the bed was in the way. The double bed was in fact a 4" bed and although we asked for extra pillows, a glass and bowl - none of it materialised. The bedding was clean but the walls of the room were grubby and the curtains were about 12inches too short. We absolutely wouldn't stay here again.

title: MY OPINION
text: I was rather disappointed since I expected more comfort and from the picture on the site the appartment hotel looks smarter than it is actually.Moreover,on the day of our arrival,nobody was expecting us to welcome us so we had to wait at the door for half an hour at least.I consider that to be unacceptable all the more that THE PRICE IS NOT SO CHEAP AND THE PLACE IS LOCATED IN A RESIDENTIAL AREA.

title: WORST STAY EVER - THE PLACE IS A DISGRACE
text: Truly the most dreadful and disgusting accommodation stay I have ever endured. How this company can charge what they do and advertise these apartments as they do is beyond me. I stay in hotels and serviced apartment a lot for both work leisure so have stayed in a complete mix off properties but this stay was the worst ever. The room was the most uninviting and in the poorest condition I have ever seen for paid accommodation. It was basically a bed sit with the most basic and unhygienic facilities imaginable. The bed sheets still contained hairs from goodness know whoever else! The head board was covered in stains and the bed was rickety and very uncomfortable. The kitchenette was complete in practical and the small fridge was so badly frozen over there was no cold refrigeration if you put anything inside it. The worst thing for me was the smell of the room which was initially making me feel nauseated. There was a raw sewage smell coming from the bathroom so did not use it choosing to go to the hotel across the road to use the WC and I showered once I checked out. The staff were extremely unhelpful and unfriendly and I would never stay again even if it was free. I would rather sleep in a train station before I'd stay in one of there rooms which left me feeling itchy and unclean. I appreciate this is budget accommodation but please think wisely about spending you money at this place as it truly is a disgrace and I can't find anything positive to say which is a shame as I like to be as fair as possible with my reviews but I can on this occasion as I had such a terrible night.

title: Don t stay here. Sewage stink in basement.
text: Don t stay here. Sewage stink in basement. I got very sick which ruined our time in Singapore probably from ecoil from bad drains. After all London is a very old city and the drains are equally old. Extremely small apartment. False advertising. Australians expect basic cleanliness which on the surface seemed ok but DO NOT STAY HERE

title: Short stay
text: I booked this place because of price and location, and after reading the reviews I was a little concerned as to what I would encounter!.. However I'm glad I still continued to stay, yes it could do with a little modification but it was clean, hot water and facilities to make drinks the bed was comfortable and the staff were friendly and polite. I would definitely recommend if on a budget, location and travel links are fantastic and will defiantly consider staying again. This was basic accommodation at a great price, but completely functional for a short stay were you just need somewhere to sleep.

title: Great Budget Hotel
text: For a budget hotel, dylan house is a modern and accommodating offering that provided what i needed, a small hideaway not to far from the centre of london and with all the basic amenities that were of a particularly good standard. I had booked a studio double room with ensuite for me and a friend for a 2 night break. When we got into the room it was a typical compact studio room that was clean and fresh, with the ensuite and kitchenette of a high standard of cleanliness. The ensuite was cosy but not to small to feel claustatphobic. The kitchenette was useful for us, as we wanted to keep our food costs down. The storage facilities, clean cutlery and nicely sized fridge , on top of the plasma tv was all a bonus, as was the added storage space which was plenty for 2 nights. We were on the top floor, which suited us perfectly. The couple of stairs up was worth the quietness that the top floor offered us. I was also aware that some studio rooms can get stuffy but the fan unit provided was a great asset to stop this. I would say that while the rooms were clean and of a good standard, we did have a problem with our DVD player, which would not work. I went down to the main office and the man was very obliging in sending someone up. However, whilst the man did his best to solve the problem it was plain to see that he had no more knowledge than i did. He did promise a new dvd player would be brought up but this promise was broken. This was the only bad aspect of the service. On every other occasion the office maintained a friendly atmosphere with service always being offered with a smile. Overall i was impressed by the standard available on my basic budget and would book to stay at Dylan's house again. I would however be mindful that Dylan house is best for those after a short break of 3-4 days and i would advice those, especially people looking for a compact studio room to a center and of a good standard to choose Dylan's house.

title: You get what you pay for
text: My boyfriend and I stayed at Dylan Apartments for 2 nights in January. We were put in Room 51 - an apartment on the 4th floor, no lift and very windy, small stairwells to walk up - not ideal when you have luggage! The window was open when we got into the room so it was freezing and loud. We couldn't work out how to use the heaters so spent the 2 days either boiling hot or freezing. In the evening I got a phone call telling me that I would be charged if I didn't check in by 10pm, despite having checked in at 2pm! Apparently the person we checked in with had not updated the system... The first morning we had no hot water, rang the reception to tell them & they said they would have a look to see if there was a problem with the boiler. 30mins later and we still had no more information. Eventually the boiler was fixed and we had hot water again! The kitchen utensils that were supplied were vary sparse, and no sort of washing up facilities were provided apart from a sink with no plug... Not even a towel to dry the dishes with. The bathroom was basic, but it stank and the rooms were either very close together or the walls were an inch thick, we could hear everything that was happening throughout the place! Despite the apartments flaws, it is in a very good location. Kensington Gardens are a 5 minute walk away, as is Paddington Station and Lancaster Gate tube station. It only takes about 20mins to get into central London on the tube, which is handy. There are a few shops, restaurants and cafes in the surrounding area which are useful for a short stay. According to the website there was free wifi in the apartments, but we weren't given any information upon arrival. Once we had asked about the wi-fi the receptionist reluctantly gave us the information we needed. I still have no idea if there actually was wi-fi in the apartments because none of the hubs listed in the information came up on our phones. Extra data was purchase because we needed Maps to travel around London! The saying "You get what you pay for" really does apply here, it's fine for a short stay if you are trying to stay in London cheaply. The transport links are great, but the apartments are not.

title: Absolute disgrace!!
text: If i was offered to stay in this place for free i wouldnt stay there!! Oh my god it was an absolute disgrace! It was filthy cramped and just a sheer let down at least for the price i paid anyway. Their website pictures shows luxury apartments and its no where near the standard they claim!! These pics will show you what ul get if u stay there!!

title: Do not touch this place with a barge pole!
text: We had basement room it was terrible, all windows overlooked by balconies on either side, bathroom window could not be closed and toilet window was overlooked and had plain glass! - had to cover it with a plastic bag!! There were pigeons nesting in area outside 'kitchen' area with all the mess that they make. The sink leaked on the floor. It was noisy as the reception was above and someone was sleeping in there during the week! No wardrobe. walls were dirty and marked. Bed was broken with spring poking through!

title: room 11 basement
text: My Husband and myself booked Dylan apartments for our 2 day trip to London. we were given the basement apartment which I am convinced was for single occupancy. (hotel picture shows only 1 towel).There was no wardrobe so we had to live out of our cases. The shower curtain was old and black at the bottom from age (£10- 15 for a new one!) The fridge did not work so had to throw our bacon etc away we bought on the way to hotel. only 1 very flat pillow each and when I asked the night manager for 2 extra she told me she didn't know where the spare ones were kept?! The view from the window was a dirty wall and bin bags. There was a locked internal door in the room that led to another room which sounded like it was an office from 7.30 in the morning! My only positive is the cleaner does her best with the old tired room

title: Great for the price
text: I am sorry to have put my reviews late .. My husband and i visited Dylan on January 2014 We have choose Dylan as we are on a strict budget.. It does worry me a lot on reading the reviews which I had previously.. however with the budget constraints that we had we are left with no choice but to book with Dylan We were there for 7 days.. to began with bad reviews first followed by the good. 1. Bathroom agree with other reviewers. It's rather small however for my husband and I we can make do with it 2. WiFi are rather useless.. We actually paid for it but the connections didn't work most of the time when in our room. We are located underground Btw. . 3. No views from the window :) our view is actually the steps to the first level however its being locked and seal. but I don't choose the hotel to have a view! So we are ok as well.. 4. I kind of agree with other reviewers.. the walls are thin! We can actually hear what our neighbour is watching on TV! Oh I think the cupboard was the only separation between our room and the next door neighbour.. I didn't really look on that thou.. Good points 1. Clean and tidy.. but of course it is not really well maintain but that's not the point.. our trip to London is to SHOP till we are drop not to sleep! Get my point? Lol 2. Utensils and the small fridge are clean 4. Towels are changed daily.. Ok that's about it.. I hope this helps.. like I mention if you are looking for a strict budget like we were and not bother much about the maintanence of the studio than this is the one for you!

title: Poor hotel, good location
text: We had to pay in advance, but we get no receipt. In the beginning the heeting system was out of order, so the room was very hot. We tried to switch off the radiator, but anything happend. Staff was incapable to help. So we had to sleep window open the first night. On the second day the problem was repaired. Soundproofing between room and corridor was poor. Bed squeeked noisy. Assortment of utensil in the kitchenette was modest, for example pans haven't lids and there was no brush for dishes. The best point was location so near Paddington station Our opinion is the hotel is not worth three stars.

title: tiny, dirty and cc card is not safe
text: 7 flights of stairs to a room so small that my small bag only fitted in the tiny toilet. On arrival they insisted i write my card details on a piece of scrap paper that was left on the open desk for all to see even though i had paid, he left the office door open and anyone could see them. Shower means burn/freeze/burn/freeze and a fun game to play. I could not get a receipt when i left as the staff don't turn up until after 9am, instead there is an emergency number on the office door but don't bother calling it as no-one answers. After many many calls the promised receipt is still not with me. I work in London 10 months a year so i am experienced. on the upside it was very quiet (no traffic all night)

title: Vial
text: walls wear covered in dirt and stains, the bed sheets were unwashed and smelt, kitchen was not usable, mould in the top corners of the room. Even the toilet roll itself was dirty and stained. The photos were absolute lies. Stayed until I could book another hotel and then left.

title: Stayed long enough to book somewhere else, then left!
text: Such a lovely building in a great location, but wow, this place really is bad. Checked in to room 13, on the ground floor... Scuffs on the walls, really bad décor, from the toilet you can see into the room over the way, as there is no frosting on the window, there was a bra outside our window on the roof of the basement, basically its a budget bedsit, but at £85 it wasn't really that budget! We complained and after being told that we had the best room (!) we were shown a superior room, literally on the top floor which meant climbing A LOT of stairs, which had slightly better décor, but the curtains were 2 inches too short for the windows and basically it was still awful. The staff member was quite abrupt and told us that its not a Hilton, which we knew... I went onto Hotels.com and managed to book another hotel in Bank for £40 more at very short notice... This place needs a major refurbishment, or to cut its prices massively - I understand that you get what you pay for, but this was far from that! The website makes this place look a lot better than it is - avoid it and please book somewhere else.

title: Not recommended
text: Small rooms poorly equiped. Both bedroom and bathroom was dirty, we had to wear shooes all the time. Terrible smell in bathroom, like toilets in old pubs or night clubs. Did not use the shower as is was too dirty. Unstable internet connection. Nice neighborhood. Overall not recommended

title: Only stayed for as long as it took to book somewhere else
text: Totally disgusted and £400 down the drain and wasted. Entrance to hotel carpet and walls worn and filthy before you even get to the rooms.Reception half painted room with rubbish scattered about. No facilities for disabled,I find walking difficult and they had put me in a basement room down some steep stairs.Room was filthy,shower room just as bad. Upstairs the double room was equally dirty,with the shower head blocked up and unhygienic. One person working there who hadn't a clue how to contact the owner to complain. Unsafe emergency procedure as were told to go outside if there's a fire or whatever and ring for help. Free wi if waste of time as it didn't work unless you went up to the office. Will be asking for money back and will contact tourist board to complain.

title: Basic and Budget
text: Stayed there for business purposes so wasn't proposing to stay inn the room much -a very good job as it turned out as the room smelled of damp coming from the showroom/toilet. Great location and for a one or two night perfectly adequate. The stairs are very steep and totally unsuitable for anyone who has difficulty with stairs. I had to ask the receptionist separately for the wifi codes bearing in mind the stairs I had to go down to see him to to get them. Would have been better customer service to be given them as I checked in. Given that this is set as as self catering apartment oddly they didn't provide any means to wash up any dishes and classes used.I left the dirty dishes in the sink first morning and they were still there in the evening so clearly they mean for the guests to wash their own crockery etc without providing any means to do so. Which means of course that the dishes etc can only have a cursory rinsing by guests and put back in the cupboard.

title: Very dis-satisfied customer!
text: The one positive comment for this accommodation is that the location was great. We were in walking distance of the transport links and Hyde Park and the local area was very picturesque. Sadly the accommodation itself was not as appealing. Our room (or the dungeon) as we called it was on the lower level of the building and very dark - definitely not worth the £220 we had paid for it. We were staying in Room 3. Although we had requested a double room we were greeted by two single beds and there were no extra pillows in the room so we had one very lifeless pillow each. The heat in the room was also unbearable and as there were no air conditioning facilities our only option was to open the one window we had in the room, which lead into a small enclosed outdoor space (used for storing rubbish and broken furniture - not very scenic) providing little or no fresh air. This area also appeared to be the main source of building pipework, so every time somebody flushed a toilet ran a tap or had a shower we heard it and there was a constant sound of trickling water. There was also a problem with the drains as the smell of sewage was continuous from the moment we arrived. It was awful and combined with the heat made staying in the room for long periods of time unbearable. This wasn't just an issue with our room but throughout the building as you could smell it everywhere - other guests also commented on this as we were checking out. Our friends were staying in Room 13 and the smell was even worse in their room. The walls were practically paper thin - you could literally hear everything. This combined with the single bed and uncomfortable pillow made for a very restless night’s sleep! Our attempt to drown out the noise was also unsuccessful as the TV in the room had no reception. After further investigation we found that the aerial had been removed from the power point and we had to re-connect it behind the heavy to move cabinet to get a signal. The remote control was also useless as the only button that worked was the channel 9 button - which was tuned into channel 3!?! Finally we were asked to pay upon arrival which was fine, however I was not happy having to write my payment details in full on the booking form, as they had already been provided when the booking was made several weeks earlier. This is not common practice with other companies and is not a very secure method of retaining customer details. We will not be staying in this accommodation again and would not recommend to anyone looking for a decent night’s sleep.

title: Overpriced for facility
text: Friendly reception service and location Very kind to accomodate for keeping the bag after checkout as our train was late Very small room, beds not comfortable as well. No provision of coffee/tea ,though kettle was provided. So to summarise i assume the price was high for the facility provided.

title: Great location friendly staff nice stay
text: The location was perfect!the hotel is close to metro lines and bus station..the staff is very friendly!the room was ok, clean with all the amenities written..they change our towels every day and they clean our room..I think is a value for money hotel!

title: Great location but not so great inside!
text: I stayed here only for 2 nights - the first night was better than the first because there was no one else in the rooms around me. The walls here a paper thin - someone opening a can of soda sounded like he was next to me! I chose to stay here because I needed a place with a fridge/kitchenette. No problems there! The fridge, microwave, electric kettle - all good. Even the bathroom, clearly recently remodeled was in good shape - certainly small but fine. If you're particularly tall or larger, though....maybe not the best. The bed was firm and clearly old - I could feel every spring and support in the mattress. My neck will be reminding me all week. The TV is odd - the remote works for the tiny box but you have to turn it on manually....and stand right in front of it to get the remote to work. Annoying but not horrid, The wireless is horrid! Kicks off, takes forever to connect, looses it....you name it. Also, FYI - you need to bring all washing things for dishes - soap, towels etc. There are pots, plates, utensils but make sure to stop around the corner. Distance to Paddington station is ideal - a few blocks down and easy to get to. All in all I'd say if its a quick trip and you really need the kitchen (like me) this is fine but if I had to stay any longer I'd sleep n the floor with ear plugs.

title: Not too bad
text: I actually enjoyed my stay at Dylan House. I arrived late after taking longer than I expected to get from Heathrow Airport. When I tried paying for the room for 6 nights the receptionist discovered that my Credit card had insufficient funds so she happily accepted cash for one night and said I could pay the rest the next day, and that paying cash would be better for me because they have to charge 5% on Credit card payments. The room was very small, as was the bathroom, but, in my opinion, so what. I was in London to see the sights not spend all day in my room. The walls were thin and I could hear people walking around upstairs and in the hallway, but again, so what. It's a small boutique hotel, not a Hilton or a Best Western. The location was extremely handy to everything - close to Paddington Tube Station and many great restaurants and mini-marts. The staff were very helpful, and when, after coming home from a long day seeing the sights and discovering I had accidentally booked my room for 5 nights instead of 6, the guy in reception told me that they had a room available at their other hotel at Earl's Court and that I could stay there as I had paid for 6 nights. He was very apologetic, even though it was entirely my fault. I would recommend this hotel if: a) You don't expect luxury b) Budget is an issue c) You only need a place to sleep after sight seeing all day

title: Clean, comfortable and excellent service
text: Having been a frequent traveller to many areas of the country, I am incredibly familiar with how deceptive pictures and "reviews" can be. It was with a bit of desperation (last minute work delay) that I had to stay overnight in London and on a tight budget I booked the Dylan Apartments in Paddington. The room cost me slightly over £50, so I was very wary of what kind of room and experience I would be 'enjoying' but I was pleasantly surprised. The room was large and clean. It had a gas cooker, kettle, iron, ironing board. The bathroom was small, but ingeniously designed so that it had a shower, toilet and sink in an area where you probably couldn't swing a cat. Very clever. And not at all uncomfortable or claustrophobic. The walls were on the thin side as I could hear the occupants in the other room, but by around 9pm they had quietened down and I was left with a pretty quiet room. The staff on reception were excellent and friendly. The only downside was the room was a bit cold. Not TOO cold but just cold. But given that it was -2 degrees outside, I think many hotels would have struggled to be warm. My advice is, if you own a little fan heater (the £5 ones you can get from any electrical shop/amazon) you would be able to make the room toasty and pleasant. I plan to use Dylan Apartments Paddington again but I may bring my little heater with me.

title: Terrible. Never again...
text: I wish I had read the reviews BEFORE booking as I had to walk out. Absolutely disgusting. Stay well clear. The room was tiny, walls were dirty. I was actually worried about catching something. I have stayed in apartments throughout Europe and this was easily the worst. Avoid at all costs.

title: Very basic, but clean and had everything you needed!
text: We booked into the Paddington apartments for two nights to attend a friends wedding. We were on a budget and they were the cheapest we could find. We were quite nervous after having read the reviews on TripAdvisor but thought we wouldn't be spending much time there so it will be okay. When we arrived we were told we were in the basement, scared stiff we made our way down. When we arrived at the room we were pleasantly surprised. It was clean with fridge, hob, utensils and TV. It was small and a bit rough around the edges but certainly no unusual smells to report or anything untoward! We were in room five and I would say you get what you pay for and I found it great value for money! You cant expect the ritz on a budget.

title: The worst accommodation ever! Stay as far away as you can.
text: Terrible terrible terrible place. Save your money and stay as far away as you can from this place. Reasons why: - Terrible location. Not close to anything of any interest. - Tiny rooms. Only suitable for dwarf children who dont bring any luggage. - Smoky rooms as doors and windows dont fit snug in the frames.My partner who suffers from asthma was up all night as he couldnt breathe!! - Dusty bedding. No duvets provided. Only layers upon layers of old dusty blankets. - Noisy as there is no double glazed windows. - Staff unhelpful. Handyman went to get batteries for the TV remote and didnt return. - Bathroom only suitable if you are ok with keeping the door open- The handle was actually falling off of our bathroom door! I have emailed and called repeatedly for the past month and no-body from customer service has called me back. The Paddington branch phone line has been down for the past few weeks too so I am unable to give them my feedback directly. I am considering getting my solicitor involved as my stay was nothing like what was described on their website. If you dont have much money to spend, please take my advice and book a B&B or sleep on a park bench- as anything is far better than this place! You can even sleep on my garage floor because atleast the door keeps the noise, light and smoke out.

title: Horrendous.... avoid!!!
text: We stayed at the Dylan Apartments on a business trip for 3 nights.... 3 nights too many. Upon arrival the entrance and hallway appear to be quite nice, do not let this deceive you. We were in room 5, it was the dungeon. It was a tiny room in the basement. I could deal with the fact that the room was small as it is London after all but everything that comes with it.... I simply can't deal with..... *it smelled of faeces!!!!! * no windows and a skylight that was cracked. * no ventilation. *the bathroom sink leaked. *the TV remote was broken *One ring of the hob was broken *the toilet flush regularly became stuck and didn't stop running. *the bed creaked every time you moved. It was also uncomfortable with pillows that resembled the roadside kerb. Dirty looking duvet cover. * the walls/ceilings had damp stains *the shower was so small i had to use the toilet seat to put my toiletries on as the space was too small to bend down to pick them up. *broken tile on bathroom floor that had broken to a sharp point and was sticking up. *the walls are very thin so you hear every little noise from other rooms. * night storage heater in room that looked like it had been there since the place was built! *there was a mouse trap in the basement hallway under the radiator. Sure sign of problems. All in all, I'm just reiterating what everyone else is saying. I've stayed in some places before but this is up there with the worst. When you feel you need to go home and disinfect your belongings after staying there there's something not quite right. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!

title: nice rooms, pity about the noise
text: when we arrived we were allowed to check in early, great after having a night flight into london. went to pay and was told that there would be a 5per cent surcharge for using a debit card which was not uk register - we are from scotland and have a scottish bank account!!!! so we paid cash. room was small but all we needed for a 1 night stay. spotless rooms, and the maid came by and asked if everything was ok. we asked for a couple of extra towels which was promptly got for us. perfect place to stay for hyde park (our destination for proms in the park) and a 10 min walk from paddington train station. however the beds creaked evrytime you moved and you could hear every little noise in the building, which didnt help when the other guests were making such a noise until 4am!! they were banging doors so hard that the window in my room shook! it even sounded like someone had a washing machine on at midnight!! for £100 a night i would expect some soundproofing between the rooms. very disappointed.

title: I wouldn't bother
text: I guess if it looks too good to be true then it probably is! Nothing like the photo's, tatty, poor facilities and the bed has to be the most uncomfortable I have ever slept in, virtually no sleep all week. This was the deciding factor me I actually had it booked for the following 2 weeks as well but quickly cancelled them. With a comfy bed it would be tolerable but there are similar properties with much better facilities. The plus point is the location, quiet area, minutes from Paddington Station. Certainly didn't feel unsafe as others have said and I did have a good wifi connection but I know I was lucky as I met other guests on the stairs trying to get one.

title: Dylan Apartments
text: Request a low floor if party has walking problems, easy to find, a good location. Lots of local shops and places to eat in area, shops stay open to around 8pm in area so evening shopping is easy if you arrive later.

title: Ever wondered how it feels living in prison?
text: Checked in at this smart-looking place and was given a basement bedroom. No windows. No ventilation. Plus, there's an AWFUL sewer smell from the bathroom - it must be ongoing because there's an automatic airfreshner installed. Not even worth half the price I paid… and no, the place was NOT cheap! Travellers, BEWARE!

title: Value for Money
text: Thanks a lot to Dylan house because when i booked a studio with them i was scared after reading the reviews,but when i reached there and stayed for 42 days i found it amazing.The staff was very helpful and caring,the room standards are excellent.Actually i must say it was worth what i paid for to stay.Special thanks goes to Mr.Rajat who surprised me on my birthday by putting a nice bottle of champagne and a heart shaped cake in my room when i was away,and as soon as i opened my room it was decorated with flowers and ribbons.My wife was so happy and this is what i expected from my tour that i wanted to make my wife happy,I will prefer to come here again and again.

title: Absolutely VILE!
text: I know alot of people think when reading these feedback reviews and go ahead and book it, but seriously! .. DO NOT! This place is an absolute dive. My girlfriend treated me by taking me to London for the weekend and booked this hotel, I have never been in shock before I saw this room! It was joke to call this place a 'Hotel' We stayed in room 12. The rooms are no bigger than a rabbits hutch, the bathroom you cant swing a cat in, the bathroom is an old wardrobe 'Converted' in to what ants would call a bathroom. 1) The door to our apartment came off in my hand! .. held in with one screw. 2) Bathroom towels are thread bare. 3) TV was hanging off the wall/bracket .. No sound of the TV and mostly foreign channels. 4) Kitchen, don't get me started on the kitchen, it was less than a metre in diameter. 5) Fake plug sockets? .. Where you have to give ' Your overall rating ' .. if I could give 0.5, I would.

title: bad experience
text: The Dylan Paddington advertised studio apartments. Upon arrival we found this to be more like a youth hostel. The bed was so small, I had to sleep on the floor the first night so my wife could sleep on the narrow bed. When we informed the manager the room was inadequate for our needs and we had to leave, he refused to provide any kind of refund thus in effect charging us $643.00 for one night's stay. Citi Bank would not intervene saying it was a foreign country. Stay if you are a single student, but don't do business with these people if you want a comfortable lodging and value your pocketbook.

title: Had to leave as it was so bad and forfeit full payment
text: I booked an executive apartment and paid it up front so that on the last two nights of our stay in England we would spoil ourselves a little. What an absolute shock we had, which began with the pleasant receptionist telling us to keep the shower door closed so it would not set off the smoke detector. I wondered about this comment until we opened the door to the apartment and found a tiny room with the only ventilation being windows (that did not lock in the bathroom,,,)there was no sash to even snib it closed. No curtains or privacy in the shower room at all, and at ground level we did not feel this to be right. The so called kitchenette was opposite shower room and toilet. Was tiny and with no exhaust fan any cooking would have set off smoke detector. Shower basin was in need of replacement. See my photos, bed was rock hard. Heater looked unsafe to use, it looked like someone had used it as an entry from the window into the room. Really really disappointing and nothing like the executive photos from the site. To top this all off, we went out for dinner and when we returned the toom smelt of poo, yes poo. When we spoke to the male staff member he said it was not their fault, as the council must have cleaned the drains, the only offer he made was a can of air freshener and to open the ground floor windows. He did not apologise and said there no other rooms available and expected us to sleep in this stinking room all night. Apart from thr safet, there were cigarette butts being flicked outside from rooms above and so we would have had the added smell of that if we left the windows open. We could not stand this as it made us feel ill, so we were lucky to find anothet hotel thanks to booking.com assistance and left. We have lost $500 australia with this hotel, no refund from them has been offered at all, despite booking.com asking them after seeing our photos and report. Do not use this place unless you are desperate.

title: fine room in budget hotel
text: We stayed at the Dylan Hotel for 3 nights/4 days and found it perfect for a short citytrip. It's located near Hydepark, just a five minutes walk from the Lancaster Gate (underground) station, in a quiet neighbourhood with several restaurants, a pub and supermarkets around the corner. Our room (13) was small but big enough for 2 people. We were out sightseeing all day anyway so we just wanted a private place to have breakfast and a good nights sleep. The room was very clean and we got new towels daily. Even the bedlinnen was changed. We had a good bed and a nice warm shower with free shampoo, soap and showercaps. We made our own coffee and toast each morning. The little kitchen was perfect for a short citytrip. The staff was friendly and helpful. Maybe the hotel is a little noisy at times but then again

title: Don't believe everything you read
text: I booked the Dylan Apartments last minute for a business trip. I needed somewhere close to Paddington and options were limited. The pictures looked ok, but the reviews had left me nervous to say the least. I had some email contact with Gina before my arrival, who had been extremely helpful. So I arrived at the Dylan Apartments around 7pm on the Tuesday evening, a little over 24 hours after I had booked. The location is perfect - a short 5 minute walk from Paddington Station and on a quiet street. The hallway as you go in is pretty ornate and impeccably clean, I was starting to feel more at ease. I was handed the keys to my home for the night by the lovely ladies in the reception room who were very friendly and explained everything that I would need to know. I got into my room and I have to say, I was pleasantly surprised. It wasn't the hugest room in the world, but at the end of the day, I just wanted somewhere to get my head down so I wasn't too bothered - plus with the beautiful high ceilings, it did not feel cramped in the slightest. The décor was a little dated, but my god, was the room clean!! I am one of these people that likes to have their phone on charge in grabbing distance overnight, so I had to pull the bed out to get to the socket. There wasn't even a speck of dust behind there! It was lovely to have the kitchenette and the option to cook for yourself and the tv was a great size. The shower cupboard (as I have named it) was very tight on space and I would suggest maybe a shelving rack in the shower as it was difficult to find homes for shower gel, shampoo etc, but this was the only downside. The bed was extremely comfortable, with great pillows. There was some noise from neighbouring rooms (not excessive) and the fire alarm went off around 11.45, but there is not a lot they can do about that - it's not something I considered to be honest. All in all, a very good experience and I would happily stay here again.

title: Avoid the basement
text: Terrible sewage smell in basement -denied by the management - but we noted an air freshener had been provided in the room. Unsatisfactoty TV reception in the basement. A shame as we were looking forward to UK TV. Twin room OK in size - adequate kitchen - no plugs or washing up liquid.( basics surely!!) Location excellent. Just don't accept a room in the basement.

title: Terrible coffee, lovely porridge
text: The cappuccino was of poor quality, although the Illy sign would think otherwise. The oats porridge was on the other hand delicious and a good bang for your bucks

title: Ripoff
text: we came there after reception hours, just after 22 h at night, and the receptionist charged us 50 pounds extra in cash for 'late check in'. He claimed they don't have 24 hours reception anymore - while that was advertised on their website! I felt I was conned. He even said that he would charge 100 pounds if we would arrive after midnight. Obviously I would not recommend anyone to go to this place. Bu apart from this, the 'hotel' itself is nothing more than a basic youth hostel: very noisy, no warm water, terrible mattresses, dirty and smelly.

title: Comfotable *** Hotel
text: There is not much to explain. Dylan Apartmets Paddington is a resonable choice at all. Starting from the Reception all employees are very polite and helpfull. Quite and relaxing rooms..very clean bath room and good English breakfast. My wife and me had a good time in this *** Hotel.

title: Trying to be positive....
text: This is a very disappointing place. They are well located and in a quiet street but they mess up on everything else. Room 42 had no hot water, no TV and a heater so hot that I still could not touch it the following morning. Add to that the itching we both got as soon as we settled into bed, dirty walls and funny smell it's difficult to see why you would want to stay. It's the first time I've walked away from a hotel (and the money!) but my health comes first.

title: Why oh why didn't I read the reviews first, before booking !!
text: Thank god I only stayed one night! The negatives : Crack in the window - creaky bed - radiator behind bed was on full blast - black hairs on the sheets ( I'm blonde)- no hot water - the smallest shower in the world😩 we had to walk up 3 flights of stairs to the room - no lift Thin walls The positives .... There's a great western hotel across the road ?

title: Good Location but very small room
text: The hotel is in a good location but the small was very very small. Just the bed and you can not move more. Cleanliness was good. Recepction is not open during night, so if you arrive along the night is a problem

title: Good and Bad
text: Just come back from a 3 night stay at Dylan apartments and I was left not overly impressed but not disgusted. Check in is strictly 2pm but if you do arrive early you can leave your bags in reception, as we did. We were upgraded to a larger room on the ground floor which was nice and the extra room to store things and get sorted round in was good. The down side was the noise (I don't know whether this is the same on every floor), we could hear every noise from the apartment next door and the main entrance door is not on a stopper so makes a very loud bang whenever anyone comes in or goes out, which was all hours. The window did not lock and being on the main road at ground floor level obviously didn't leave us feeling very secure. We got a great deal on Booking.com and if we could get the same price I would go again (around £246 for the 2 of us for 3 nights). The room was a little shabby around the edges and the apartment as a whole could use a little TLC. Staff were helpful enough when we needed them and new towels were provided everyday. Kitchen and bathroom were sufficient for what we needed however if you are of a bigger build you may struggle with the shower and there was nowhere to put your toiletries once in the shower so I had to leave them on the toilet if I wasn't washing my hair (small things make a big difference). If you want a cheap place to stay in a good location and don't mind noise etc then you will be fine staying here.

title: Too little room on te fifth floor without lift
text: The room was too little without desk and chairs. Its was on the fith floor without lift and very hard to climb. The wifi was not OK and very expensive. It was raining in the room. But the room was near the station and it was very practical. From France.

title: On the fence with this one
text: Just had a 3 night stay in one of their "Studio Apartments". Let me tell you in my opinion what the pros and cons of this accommdation were: Pros Really good location, ideal for acessing the underground and bus services. The accommodation is on a nice quiet road. "Apartment" was nice and clean. Staff appeared nice. Window in the room opened really wide so was nice and airy. The bathroom was nice and had a decent shower, once you waited for the water to heat up. Someone came in each day and made the bed up and changed the towels if they needed changing. It is possible to access the roof in this accommodation and the view is amazing, you're up higher than most of the chimneys around you so its really a stunning view. Cons The term "Studio Apartment" is used in the very loosest term. We were in apt 52. The room is not big enought to swing a cat, mind you, thinking about it, dont even bring your mouse because you wouldnt be able to swing that either. Absolutely tiny. Its supposed to have a double bed but in reality its not much bigger than a decent sized single bed. A word of warning, if you are having a shower make sure you shut the bathroom door otherwise the fire alarm goes off, which happened to us. Not sure what would have happened if we had tried to cook something in the kitchen......... Now the biggest con of these apartments is the stairs, dear god they are unreal. The first two flights are not bad but the other million flights up to the apartment are all twisty and turney, different depths and quite steep with no handrail on a lot of them which makes it extremely difficult getting up and down carrying cases. In fairness i am definitley not the fittest person on the planet by any stretch of the imagination but even Mo Farah would have difficulty negotiating these stairs. The lock on the outside of the door was falling off and it took ages to work out how to actually lock the door. Be aware that you need to use the key to lock the doors they do not lock automatically when you shut the door. You have to turn the key to lock the door then turn it back as if you are opening the door but stop just before the lock turns and take the key out. They also only provide 1 pillow person so might be an idea to ask for a second one on arrival because believe me you wont want to trawl up and down the stairs any more than you have to. They do provide an ironing board and iron in the room but the ironing board is about 2ft long and you have to put it on the bed to iron but its better than nothing. The paintwork in the commune areas is dirty and worn and could do with freshing up. I do think that these apartments are overpriced for the accommodation you get, but the location is really good. Would I use this accommodaton again - yes I would provided that we could request an apartment on a lower floor.

title: Super clean, well-located
text: I found the room super clean and the double studio was a good size for just me. It was great to have a kitchenette and that saved me a lot of money not having to eat out all the time. There is a Tesco Metro supermarket about 5 minutes walk away and a very efficient launderette/service wash about 1 block away. The staff was very helpful, friendly, and responsive, especially Claudia the cleaner and Robert the maintenance person. It's right in the center of London, about 5 blocks from Paddington railway and tube station. The internet was ok (not really high speed) at mid-day or late at night. Otherwise it was very, very slow or pretty much non-existent. (I had to pay 65 pounds for 12 nights internet!) If you are charging for internet it had better be fast and reliable. The hotel advertises that it has satellite tv. Yes they do, but the satellite channels are only viewable if you can speak Spanish, Polish or Russian. The only English channels are what's available via antenna, BBC1, BBC2, BBC4 and ITV1. No Sky channels or anything else. The mattress was comfortable but a bit too firm for me. There was a very small, very flimsy folding chair to sit on, otherwise it was the bed or the floor. Overall, the room was very clean, no frills, well-located and good value for what you get. But for the slow, unreliable internet, I would stay there again.

title: Extreme Caution
text: I recommend extreme caution if considering Dylan House as a place to stay. It can take weeks to get an email response and they have just dropped a booking of mine, even through the request was made weeks ago, just 2 days before international travel. They are very unprofessional and I suggest going elsewhere if professionalism and responsiveness are important to you. Dont get left out in the cold - go elsewhere!

title: Good for the price
text: I was a bit worried after reading all the bad reviews on here but booked it for a hen weekend as it was so reasonable. I booked four standard rooms. For a few night's stay they were just fine. A little small and tired but clean and had everything we needed. If you want a big room as for room 2 - it's big! This is a good value hotel for where it is. Just a few mins walk from Paddington and next to some great places to eat. The Mitre pub is great. The staff are friendly and accomodating. For the tiny price we paid it was just fine!

title: OK but wont be back unless without kids
text: Strategically situated but the rooms are far too small...my son who is 1.95mts/6ft 4" had his feet sticking out of the bed and to use the toilet was a real trial. Clean & very close to station/tube.

title: Nice hotel but bad service
text: Quiet good location but the service and staff not all of them are really poor and they lack some hospitality. The first time i try this hotel and wanted to become a regular client but it is not worth it. I left something in my room and when I came back to ask about it at night, one guy staying at the reception told me that he can't do anything with an attitude while playing on his mobile. I really felt like I'm not in a hotel. However, I appreciate the lady with blond hair at the reception and the Executive Housekeeper, they are really helpful and very friendly.

title: Really enjoyable stay
text: We stayed 3 nights for a sightseeing trip with children! We were a bit dubious at first after reading some of the negative reviews about this hotel but was really pleasantly surprised! My advise is dont listen to the reviews and make your own mind up. The staff on reception were lovely, really helpful and friendly. We stayed in a triple room 2adults 1child room 419. The room was spotlessly clean, comfortable beds, tv etc... Nice and cosy and just what we were after. The en suite is compact but again, very clean, lots of fresh towels and served its purpose! The location is excellent, Paddington Underground is a 2minute walk away taking you wherever you need to go in London. The Big Bus Tour stop is right outside the hotel and There are lots of shops bars and resturaunts right on the doorstep. There is a tourist information service in the hotel, the guy was really helpful told us everything we needed to know and we bought discounted tickets for some London attractions from him saving us approx £35! There was no hard sell or anything like that. If your looking for somewhere clean, comfortable and reasonably priced then we could not fault this place and would definately return. A great time was had by all.

title: Decent enough
text: Hotel was clean, welcoming and in a great location. Shame the breakfast was a waste of £5. Had I known it was a poor continental breakfast I wouldnt have bothered. Would stay again though, staff were helpful too.

title: Good location, acceptabel standard
text: Situated only a few hundred yards from Paddington station, the hotel is easy to reach, if you come from Heathrow. The rooms are small, but OK and the breakfast included in the price is more like a survival kit. Close to Hyde Park. Pleasant staff. Altogether: In London this is not bad.

title: Only The Location Worths
text: Tiny 3bd room, noisy, no refrigerator, No free wifi - just 15 mins! Big advantage that the hotel is conveniently located within easy walking distance of Paddington Station is close to the hyde park, and there are many restaurants in the neighbourhood.

title: Excellent place and location.
text: Excellent hotel for a very reasonable price. We had a great room, free WIFI, excellent breakfast, all services were excellent, no complain at all. The Location is next to Paddington station, very useful.

title: A TERRIBLE hotel experience. Ruined our trip!
text: The worst experience of my life. Our first night at the hotel was quite an eye opener not just the noise but other matters! We had to stay in the reception area until the hotel manager came in. We found cockroaches in our shower room, the night manager offered us another room, above the room we just vacated, we declined the offer. Whilst we were sitting in reception, we noticed two women (who came in off the street) using the toilet often and chatting with the night manager. Incidently, on one of their visits to the hotel, one of them went upstairs with a man. The reception toilet was used by the same woman when she came back down about half an hour later. We had no choice but to use the toilet a good while after, this is when we found a plastic wrapper in the sink. We informed the night manager, when she next came in, he told her to get out, it was obvious, going by her expression, it was for our benefit. The hotel obviously allows non paying guests of all varieties! The cleaner quickly cleaned this up before the manager came in. When speaking with the manager in the morning, the cockroach part was quickly dismissed, even though photographic proof was provided. The CCTV can prove the rest, he seemed to take heed of his other non paying guests!! Please beware! The one star is so I can alert people. If cockroaches and people can come in off the street without any health and safety measures in place for the hotel guests, then do you really want to stay here. I feel I need to end this with something positive. Ideal location when in another hotel in this area. London is also a fantastic place!!!

title: Tight-arses
text: It was the middle of winter and we asked several times for our heater to be checked because we had no warmth. Each time the reply was the same "the timer is set to turn on at 4pm" at 4:30 there was no heat, rang reception again "it's set for 5:30" 5:30 and no heat, told again "heater is set for 6 pm". At 7.30 we were told "8pm" at 8:30 I rang again and had the concierge turn up and plug-in a gas heater saying that the "boiler was broken and the plumber is on the way to fix it". Absolute bollucks! They refuse to switch on heaters and give the room adequate toiletry supplies. Penny saving Serbs run the joint to the most cost effective way and do not go out of their way to meet your needs! Our room was also on a slant with dirty old cupboards and a pokey bathroom that could barely let you sit on the loo with the door closed! Go elsewhere!

title: Avoid booking this hotel
text: Booked a prepaid rate at the beginning of March, when I phoned hotel to inquire why payment hadn't been taken the receptionist was very rude and said the price was incorrect and I would have to cancel and rebook, so I spoke to booking.com who said they would sort it out. It's taken 4 weeks for them to tell me that I would indeed have to rebook at 3 times the price of what my confirmation said and that I would have to accept this offer immediately or the booking would be cancelled. Unprofessional hotel and staff, this all would be understandable if the hotel would have contacted me immediately.

title: BAD HOTEL
text: This is the one of very bad hotel ever I stay.... rooms are very- small, toilet also too small you can’t move your body.... no service in the room.... room is not cleaning …….. Very stupid and rude staffs working... poor breakfast facilities.... they are just concern with the money without customer satisfaction and service. Truly it’s very bad to the city like LONDON to have such a hotel……..

title: Good location, very small rooms!
text: We paid £160 for 2 nights which is pretty good for a central London hotel as you could probably expect to pay this per night, however...this hotel is cheaper because it is CHEAP all repairs and furnishings are done on the cheap and it shows really! The rooms are basic and extremly small I stubbed my toes on the bed everytime I moved there is literally about half a metre between the bed and the walls or window so not alot of space to get dressed, the bathroom is by far the smallest and again the floor was slightly raised and no cover so more stubbed toes, the cover for the sink pipes wasnt fixed and so everytime you sat on the toilet it moved and theres no storage to put toiletries etc. there isnt any air conditioning or a fan however it wasn't too hot, there was a window but to be honest it's so noisy you could'nt possibly sleep with it open (you can still here the noise when the window is closed). All in all this is a good base for a day or two in London the beds are comfy, it has a tv and a kettle with fresh towels for £80 per night!

title: as close to a bargin as you get in london
text: Let me start this review by saying after traveling to london a couple of times that there are no deals in hotels. I found this to be a close as I was able to find. Each room has a wc and they are clean. the rooms are fine but on the smallish size which I think is std for london by US stadard. There is a nice breakfast included which can be upgraded to a large for a fair price. The location is great near hyde park and a few tube stops. THis is my first choice for a central london hotel but just remeber that there is not a lot to choose from in this area and price class

title: More con's than pro's
text: Positive: - Good location. Close to Paddington station. - Friendly staff. Negative: - Very small room and bathroom. May work for single traveler or a couple, but with kid I would not recommend. - Bed was extremly uncomfortable and bedframe very unstable. Bed made loud noises as soon as you moved in it. - Unbearingly warm rooms (even in September) making it hard to sleep well. - Baby cots needs to be checked over and replaced, we got two broken ones. - Broken phones. We would not consider this hotel again if we went back to London.

title: Convenient,clean, and would return
text: The biggest mishap was when we arrived to be told our apartment was not available and were would be given a triple room newly renovated to make up for the double booking with breakfast included. We were in shock as we were set on a kitchen to prepare my gluten free meals for four days without having to be worried about eating out. We tried to be nice but they could not seem to understand why I wanted a kitchen. However what do you do? We have learnt o try and turn a negative issue around to a positive one!!!! The room was smallish but we could use the single bed to place our suitcases on which was great. Bathroom excellent with plenty of hot water. Bed a little hard but much better than too soft! No safe but the reception looked after our needs there. Luggage room worried me. They give the key to you to place your suitcases in there. I could have easily walked out with any bodies belongings. The hotel keeps saying they are not responsible but what happened to duty of care!!! The same in the rooms no responsibility if anything is lost. I would definitely stay again but CONFIRM my apartment the day before. Value for money in London.

title: WORST SERVICE EVER!!
text: NO customer service AT ALL!!! We made a honest mistake and needed to change our booking dates.. they would not even let us do that even though we called immediately after we made the booking!!!!! Then they charged us the full amount with no consideration at all. It is peak season in July, It wouldn't be long before our cancellation was filled again! We travel a lot, know a lot of people in the travel industry and would NEVER EVER recommend this hotel to anyone!

title: An average B&B hotel
text: I stayed in this hotel for 5 days and 4 nights last summer (between 4th and 10th June. Pros. Great location for sur. I had a room overlooking the backyard, so it was a good quiet room. The room was clean, yet a bit smelly, room service was there everyday. I stayed in a double-room, so the room size was just fine. Good English breakfast. Has an elevator!. Has a standard US power outlet, in case you forgot your adapter. Becoming stuff Cons. No air conditioning, it was too hot in summer,. Small bathroom. Uncomfortable bed.

title: Ideal location - Good Service.
text: I have stayed at this hotel on a number of occasions. It is idealy situated just a short walk from Paddington Station. The rooms are spotlessly clean and comfortable, but the shower room very small. The staff are extremely polite and helpful. Dont be put off by some of the poor reviews about the hotel. If you are paying a short (tourist) visit, many of the sights and attractions are within walking distance, and the underground and mainline stations are on the doorstep. If i had any adverse comment it would be about the cooked breakfast - not very warm and a bit leathery.

title: Would stay again
text: Good Service, good breakfast, good location near restaurants, internet cafes, laundromat and central to Paddington Stn. Reception staff very helpful too.

title: Great Location
text: Stayed at the Westpoint for two nights , one before our trip to Paris & one after . Great location to the tube & walking distance to Oxford St & Hyde Park . We have two children & we were all able to stay in one room along with two big suitcases & backpacks. Room & Bathroom were clean & staff very friendly & helpful. Continental breakfast was included & very nice , cereal , toast ( you can get extra if you want ) ham & cheese etc... One good point was the baggage holding facility , they give you a key to put any suitcases etc..in the locked room for as long as you want , this comess in handy if you checkout & want to see some London sights before departing the city Overall , very good value for Money ...
