title: Also known as the Abbey Court Hotel - not great!
text: We stayed here during visiting an event at Hyde Park as the location is ideal. It is about a 10 minute walk to Hyde Park - but this is the only positive..... After turning up in our room I pretty much wanted to leave...the only thing keeping me there was that the rest of my family were also staying for this specific event... So here are all the negatives: -We had one towel for two people...... we ended up letting ourselves into the store cupboard (which was left open) and got some more towels for ourselves -10.30am check out.... this is early... -The Bathroom door didn't shut (luckily I was with my husband but still not ideal) -No shampoo or toiletries - for London this is unusual - There was a draft from the window - this would be freezing in winter - Small travel kettle in room - this didn’t make one cup of tea.... -Plastic cups for water - no glasses? -The toilet didn't flush - The Angle of the tv meant you couldn’t watch it from the bed - in a hotel I really don’t see the point of having a tv if you have to stand next to it to watch it? - Creaky floorboards in the room - couldn’t go to the loo in the night without waking up my other half. The hotel in general was not cheap - it was on the cheaper side for London - so in one aspect you get what you pay for - although in all honesty I don’t think we got what we paid for - we got less! The hotel reception looks lovely when you walk in - don’t be deceived!!

title: Nice foyer but....
text: This hotel has spent a lot of money on the foyer but the rooms are dated and run down. It was clean, quiet and adequate for 1 night but little things really let it down

title: Decent budget hotel in convenient location
text: We weren't expecting luxury at the Westpoint's relatively low rates in an expensive city, but we were pleased with the Westpoint. The location, a block from Paddington Train Station and Underground and near Hyde Park, is its biggest plus. Rooms are tiny - no room for large suitcases! - but spotlessly clean and are adequate for travellers who don't plan to spend much time at the hotel.

title: Great place.
text: I booked this hotel quickly when I came to London to see Guys & Dolls and didn't know what to expect! What a nice surprise! A completely charming hotel with a friendly staff, cozy comfortable rooms and a brilliant location close to Paddington station, I can’t wait to stay here again when I return to London in December. The staff was kind the rooms were neat and clean but on the small side, and the beds were comfortable and the breakfast was tasty. The location was also close to many nice restaurants. I’d recommend it.

title: Close to everything...
text: Stayed for 3 nights at the hotel. Waling distance from Paddington Station and Heathrow Express. The stand out feature was the staff in the breakfast room. Very friendly and helpful and provided excellent service. 4 sharing a room so not much room to move but was adequate. Terrible smell in the bathroom which we should have complained about but just didn

title: Excellent value
text: Very reasonably priced and literally two minutes walk to the north of Hyde Park with the able bodied within walking distance of Notting Hill one way and the West End the other. Hot breakfast doesn't have endless choices but hey, what more do you need than eggs, bacon, cereals and fruit? Very friendly staff - Spanish man on the desk was very helpful - and ideal if you're staying a night or two and somewhere clean, warm etc

title: Great location, great price
text: We booked this hotel for a girly weekend and didn't realise it was the same weekend as the London Marathon - we still got a great rate! In the grand surrounds of the beautiful houses (and multiple hotels) in Sussex Gardens, the Westpoint is a mere 2-3 minute walk from Paddington Station. Perfect if travelling in from Heathrow, but equally fine to get the tube from any other part. The foyer is a bit tired looking, with very grandiose statues gracing a lounge area - the lift is very small and does take some time to reach each floor (especially at check-out time). The rooms however, have been very tastefully updated in a modern style with very cool blue uplighting above the wardrobe space. As with all London hotels (in my experience) space is not something you expect - and such is the case with the Westpoint. However, as 3 women sharing a triple room - we had no complaints as we really only were there to sleep and shower. The bathroom was compact with a shower that, for the most part, was fine - it did lose pressure quite a bit in the mornings. Both the bedroom and bathroom were immaculately clean. The check-in staff (which were all that we integrated with) were absolutely wonderful. They couldn't be more helpful with our very late check-in due to a delayed flight and equally during the course of our 3-night stay. We opted not to have breakfast in the hotel - although there is that option. The free wifi has problems - you need to get a new username/password each day (which is fine) but it very often didn't work and was completely unreliable. This really could be improved. This is a fantastic location to stay in being so close to Paddington Tube Station, a very comfortable (and quiet!) location with lots of interesting cafes and restaurants nearby if you don't want to venture further. I'd highly recommend this for friends/solo/business trips and will definitely try to return.

title: Perfect location
text: The staff were friendly, welcoming and efficient. Triple room although clean was small and cramped. Buffet style breakfast was adequate, but get there early or be prepared to queue to be seated! Perfect location as Paddington station is within 5 minutes walking distance. An ideal base if, like us, you set out immediately after breakfast and don't return until late evening.....the room was too small.....claustrophobia would set in if you had to spend any length of time in it!! Overall an enjoyable experience and we would be happy to return.

title: Terrible!
text: This hotel is outdated and everything is of low quality. The room (double room) couldn't be more tiny. And the bathroom was even smaller and looked cheap and dirty. Couldn t have the breakfast as it was worse than in an airplane. I payes 84 and 120 £ for two nights. Don t go there! Avoid!

title: Unsure what every-bodies problems are
text: Although the initial sign in at reception was a little slow. The hotel room that was a reasonable sized for central London on the first floor. The bed was very comfortable and shower/toilet was fine. Excellent location next to Hyde Park. On my experience I would recommend and would rate highly.

title: Best Location and Nice Hotel
text: The hotel is located at superb location, Oxford street was just 15 minutes walk from hotel, so we did lots of shopping. The room was bit small and wifi was very expensive. and the staff was very friendly and coporative. The hotel has information desk inside the hotel which was very very helpful and the information guy was very friendly and helped us a lot and arranged us theatre tickets in the last minute.

title: Recommended ONLY for location.
text: The hotel is situated pretty near Paddington station, probably a 5-10mins walk. Apart from that, the rooms are small, very old and not well maintained. Our toilet's shower head was faulty so the entire toilet will get wet after one takes a shower. The mattress is so old that you can literally feel the springs. Not to forget, the walls are so thin you can hear your neighbour's conversation. Service wasn't that great after all. If you need to stow your luggage, bear in mind that it's self-service (reception give you the key and you stow your own luggage with whatever space you can find at the luggage room). The reception won't even guide you to the luggage room. Not recommended especially when there's other hotels located near the station.

title: Absolutely awful experience. No customer service.
text: I booked because they advertised free WiFi. For a real amount you have to pay... if it even works. The WiFi on our floor was found to be switched off so we had to try to connect from a further port. Trying to resolve this issue, they were rude and obnoxious, saying it was not their problem and failed to fix the problem. Each day and night we complained and they still failed to fix the problem. They did ring the service provider who said the port was switched off, but turning it on did not help. On the last day they said, you needed to stay and wait for the provider to come out so they could access a device. One of 5 of ours that did not manage to connect to the internet. They advertised incorrectly and failed to provide the service that we paid for and did nothing to help it except be rude and unwilling to help. The breakfast was also like plastic. Do not stay here. There is plenty of other hotels nearby if you are looking for the location.

title: Wouldn't recommend
text: We stayed in Room 7, and unfortunately it wasn't at all as shown on the website. The room was small, stuffy, smelt awful and the carpet was quite dirty, I was coughing none-stop every time I was in the room. The bathroom was small but fine, however there was a problem with the door which kept getting jammed. Also there was no running hot water on the second day which meant we had freezing cold showers. When checking out from the hotel my partner did mention the above, to which the receptionist didn't even apologise for the inconvenience, or offer any refund. I use to live in London so know it can be an expensive city, but really expected much more for £126 for one night!

title: comfortable, convenient and good value
text: We stayed two nights in July 2004. Calls itself a hotel but is really a large guest house. Very convenient for Paddington station (less than five mins walk). Room and public areas were very clean. Room was nice & bed was comfortable. TV and phone in room but no tea/coffee facilities. Bathroom was quite small and some larger guests might find getting on the loo a tight squeeze! The choice offered in the Continental Breakfast was lmited (Corn Flakes, rolls, cheese & Ham, Jam) but there was plenty there. Don't bother upgrading the breakfast to 'full english' which consisted of 1 sausage, 1 bacon, 1 egg and beans - not worth it at £3. Car parking (Open to the street but with barrer controlled access) is offered for £10 per day extra which is a cheap way to park in London. All-in-all it was worth what we paid (£64 per night for two people) and, yes, I would stay there again.

title: Great location,Helpfull and friendly service
text: Close by Paddington Station, was very handy to catch trains to Manchester, Bath and Windsor Castle. We often started our day with a stroll through Hyde Park ending up in Oxford Street. Room was good size with comfortable beds and nice bathroom. Only dislike was the heating was turned up too high and was not readily adjustable. Front desk service was warm and helpful. A special mention to Sala who made our stay more enjoyable with his warm conversations and assisting us with any questions re getting around London. Breaklfast staff were also warm and friendly.We stayed 16 nights and have nothing but fond and pleasant memories of our stay.

title: So Unfairly Treated and Bad Customer Service
text: UNFAIR REFUSAL OF REFUND - TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE: I accidently booked to stay at this hotel in Sept approx 8 weeks, and within 46 minutes of booking this hotel I found out from my husband that we could not get confirmed seats to London for our children to fly with us. So we are now NOT going to london and contacted the hotel to refund our money and they have REFUSED. I have provided 8 weeks of notification and I only have just made the booking. How rude and inconsiderate is this hotel. I am now not able to get flights to London for my children and I have to pay for hotel accomadation that I wont be using. I cannot believe how inconsiderate and unfair this hotel has been. Please REFUND my money, it's not an unreasonable request !! Please respond and do the right thing.

title: Terrible service.
text: My wife and I booked online--a single room--showed up at 1am and were told that a single room was for one person and if we both wanted to stay we would have to rent another room! After much arguing we were offered a room for almost double the price i had prepaid.

title: GOOD LOCATION, EASY TO FIND, NO BACON AT BREAKFAST!!
text: Very impressive foyer, but then when you go into the little hallways and stairs the carpets are threadbare in places! The room was small but ample, we had a triple with a double and a single. The bathroom was small but clean and well decorated, maybe not for "THE LARGER PERSON" The dining room was clean and impressive only to be let down by the quality of the food! The cooked breakfast was scrambled egg with beans and cheap sausages (NO BACON!) there were also cold meats and cheese. and toast and jam. Maybe this is what people want as many of the other guests were from all over the world . THIS HOTEL IS VERY EASY TO FIND, 2MINS WALK FROM PADDINGTON STATION AND BUSES,YOU CAN BE IN THE CENTRE OF THE TOURIST AREAS IN ABOUT AN HOURS STEADY STROLL THROUGH HYDE PARK TO BUCKINGHAM PALACE THEN DOWN THE MALL TO BIG BEN! OR JUMP ON THE TUBE AND ITS 15/20 MINS. APART FROM THE BREAKFAST THIS HOTEL DID THE JOB! CHEAP AND CLEAN.

title: Great location- room a little small but location location
text: Nice lobby- we were in a triple room which was one double bed and one single.. not much room but did have a bathroom with a shower (small) but didn't have to share. Room was hot so they gave us a fan and we managed quite fine.. they also have an elevator which is great vs a lot of hotels in London. Breakfast good - but busy. Best part of hotel was location at Paddington Station - you can go anywhere from this stop... Price reasonable $110 pounds per night.. but then again where is it cheap in London.

title: Best stay ever!
text: This hotel and it's staff were 100%. 20 of us stayed here and We were all made feel very welcome. Location was perfect too. The rooms are basic,ideal because We weren't there to relax. I would recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: 'Ordinary'
text: As one enters this hotel it is quite impressive. If a little more of this cost had been spent on the rooms it would have paid off. Compared with the Premier Inn in which we stayed the previous night in Luton this was most disappointing, yet another four star that just does not come up to scratch. Poor nights sleep and I didn't bother eating breakfast as my wife who as a result of an earlier start had waited for the dining room to open at 7.30 only to find once again an unacceptable breakfast, texted to say don't bother, so I didn't. Lost revenue for the hotel, How hard is it to provide an acceptable meal in the morning? come on, get your act together! Malcolm S Stott 5/10

title: Consistent customer comfort and service in ideal convenient London location
text: The West Point Hotel has efficient facilities and friendly attentive staff . It is busy throughout the year reflecting customer satisfaction and returns . Breakfast Dining Room and hot quality breakfast buffet with unlimited quantity is excellent ,setting one up for a day visiting the London attractions . Easy with all London public transport systems on the door step . Bayswater , hyde park , Marble Arch , and Edgware Road are pleasant walks with all the restaurants and shops one could wish . In the evening the West Point's Bar and Restaurant are outstanding . On a Sunday morning a warm welcome is waiting at St James's Sussex Gardens , the beautiful Parish Church of Paddington . I have stayed in many hotels in London and rate this hotel as the best located , excellent value for money and value it highly .

title: Comfortable and affordable
text: My family and I stayed for 4 nights at the hotel. Although the room for the four of us was small it was comfortable and breakfast was included. The location is sensational because it is no more than a 5 minute walk from the Paddington tube and train station. Such a great location. The staff are pleasant and helpfull and a pleasure to deal with. We loved it.

title: loved it!
text: I 1st visited London in 2001, ever since i go back every year and each time i stay at the westpoint hotel. I just spent 9 nights there and as usual i was very satisfied with the place. This year the staff was even nicer than the previous years, i was very impressed to see how kind and helpful they ALL were, especially of the brazilian staff at the reception. For the price and the location i couldn't ask for a better place to stay. Maybe the bathroom are a bit small, but to be honest i didn't have much problems with it anyway. The breakfast was good enough for my tastes, i always got enough food to not feel hungry till noon.In the room we had tea and coffee making facilities, which was a great thing to have! I will keep on chosing this hotel for my future trips to London.

title: Stay away from this hotel
text: This is one of the worst hotels I've stayed in in my life. The day after we arrived, they commenced a full renovation of the room next door to us. That meant that we were breathing in fumes of wet paint and toxic-smelling paint stripping chemicals. We requested to change our room and they informed us that they were fully booked but could give us a "un-renovated room". Since the fumes in our current room were out of control we decided to switch to the "un-renovated room". Turns out that there was something wrong with the plumbing in this new room (which they didn't inform us of in advance). The second night in the new room, the pipes starting smelling like an open sewer. Not only that but the carpets and bed linens had a nasty smell. Even though we had a booking for a full week we decided to leave the hotel 2 nights and move to another hotel next door. The breakfast was also absolutely awful. There was a big platter of baloney (or spam? not sure?) and some greasy croissants among other things. In short, stay away from this hotel.

title: Brilliant loction
text: Minutes away from Paddington station.very clean and the rooms although not huge are very adequate.friendly staff.would definitely stay there again and recommend it to anyone going to Chelsea Flower Show as we were.

title: Unfriendly but reasonable value
text: My wife and I and our grandson stayed for 4 nights. The room was tiny but clean and adequate to sleep in. House service was good. Reception/concierge was unfriendly, unhelpful and did not give a stuff as they clearly don't need repeat business. The area is good with quite a few eating establishments. The tube and railway station are a block away and, if you don't mind a walk, a stroll into Oxford street across Hyde Park is quite pleasant.

title: Save your money
text: Despite being in a great location, this has to be one of the worst hotels I have ever stayed in (including ones in remote Zambia and Ethiopia). The rooms are absolutely tiny, the bathrooms even smaller, and the staff is completely indifferent to their guests. If you are there in summer then the rooms double as saunas! The hotel breakfast is appaling - if you are lucky enough to get scrabbled eggs then you can expect it to come with shells as well! What makes this hotel particularly bad is that there are plenty of alternative hotels to choose from right next door. Based on casual observation, I would say that the Stylotel and Hotel Indigo are far superior alternatives despite being the same price. So avoid West Point at all costs.

title: The Pits
text: I stayed at this 'hotel' for two nights with my partner and will never return to this hotel even if i was paid to stay there. I travel all over the world with my job and have stayed in mostly 3 star hotels but this hotel is by far the worst. The room was very small and dated that no amount of cleaning would make it welcoming, the toilet was very small and the toilet door when closed was very difficult to open and when flushed the toilet kept running, the shower base was sealed with duck tape and the water had no pressure even though we were on the first floor! The tv had no remote control. The continental breakfast consisted of cornflakes, apple juice, cold toast and tea or coffee. The cooked breakfast was just as bad and tasteless. The Hotel staff were less than helpfull and even though we handed our key into reception before 9am when we returned to the hotel at 1530hrs to get ready for our evening event our room was not madeup. BE WARNED AVOID THIS HOTEL AT ALL COSTS!
