We paid for a twin room 69 pounds (in total for two persons). By the way, if you don't pay in cash, an extra 3,5% of the amount will be charged. We had a room on the first floor. Pros: - Perfect location just 10 min walk from St. Pancras/Kings X Stations and 20 min walk from Euston Station. Cons: - Noise - you hear absolutely everything from the neighbor rooms and from the street. - Old furniture and old beds. My opinion - if you need just a place to stay before your train from the mentioned three stations and are not going to stay in the hotel for a long time, it's okay. Otherwise, you have more interesting choices in the area!!

title: Functional and good location
text: Is typical of hotels in the area, functional pleasant staff, theres free wifi, towels bed and a shower The rooms are clean if as you woukd expect at this level and in london, they are small However the room was quiet so a good cheap place if you need to be in this area

title: About as good as you'll get for a budget hotel in London
text: The best thing about this hotel is that it's about a 5 minute walk from King's Cross and St. Pancras Station - crucial if you're taking the subway/tube around London or the train to/from London. The rooms are pretty small, but decent and pretty clean. The only real beef my mother and I had with this hotel was the plumbing - the toilet did not flush very well and no matter how many times we asked someone to fix it, it never got fixed properly. The breakfast here was decent, considering it was included. Overall the place was nice for the price when compared to other hotels that were MUCH more expensive. I do not think I would go back, but it was a good hotel for tourists and not bad if all you really intend on doing is sleeping here.

title: the worst 'hotel' I have ever had the misfortune to stay in
text: To start with the (only) positives: the Arriva was somewhere handy (for King's Cross / Euston) to lay our heads overnight, was reasonably clean, and was unfazed by our late arrival (after midnight). That said, it was a Fawlty-Towers-type experience (without the humour) which I do not wish to repeat. I had emphasised in the booking that it was conditional on there being a functioning lift as stairs would be a problem to us, and asked that if there was no functioning lift the management contact us. No contact received other than a confirmation of the booking - and when we arrived we found we were in a basement room (down stairs). On enquiring about the lift we were told, offhandedly, that it was 'out of order'. No apology. When I said that this posed a problem I was told 'Oh, it's only one or two stairs - maybe three'. Actually, it was more than 20! The (male) receptionist did not offer to carry our heavy luggage down said stairs and initially stared at me when I requested help with it. Fortunately I can be assertive when required and eventually he did help. On arrival in our room we found that the advertised tea-making facilities consisted of cups and saucers but no kettle! The man on reception was unapologetic about this omission but agreed to 'see whether he could find us one', and brought it to our room half an hour later. By that time we had discovered the unbelievably uncomfortable mattresses, which appeared to have no padding between the springs and the fabric cover. Fortunately it was a hot night so we could lie on top of the duvets, which insulated us slightly from the springs. On trying to turn the light off we discovered the next problem, which was that it continued to flash on and off for the next half hour - but by this time we had realised that if we asked for anything to be done about it we would be likely to be up for a lot longer, waiting for something to be done, so we closed our eyes and tried to ignore it. In the morning, after an extremely uncomfortable night, we were foolish enough to go to breakfast: cornflakes, milk, white toast (they said they didn't have any brown, despite my having asked for that on the booking too), jam, and tea or coffee, served in a dingy, windowless basement room. When the 'waitress' said they had no brown bread to toast I asked whether anyone had read my booking request, and she unapologetically said 'no'. To be fair, the reception man did (on being asked) help us back up the stairs with our luggage. None of the staff seemed to have the slightest notion of customer care, hospitality, looking after people or even basic courtesy, and I was truly embarrassed that the many overseas visitors there would have this as part of their experience of Britain. If you had a category for 'attitude' I would rate that as 'terrible' too. Thare must be better places than this for the money!!!

title: Only one night, thankfully!
text: When we arrived the staff were polite but with limited English. Room was fairly cramped and sparcely furnished. Tea & coffee making facilities were on a plastic tray on top of a fridge at the bottom of my bed with no plug socket nearby. Bathroom was small and mouldy grout in the shower cubicle. Water did not clear during shower, hence standing in a puddle in the shower tray! Noisy street outside and floorboards above meaning we woke sooner than we wanted after a late night. Arrived for breakfast at 8.55 and there was nowhere to sit. Limited food availability and food supplies not replenished frequently enough due to lack of staff. Sat with stranger due to lack of available tables. 2 Cereals - one empty. Bread slices to toast, white or brown. Saw yogurts briefly which disappeared quickly & not replaced. Don't pay for the breakfast if not included. Hotel price was a rip off - only positives were comfy beds & central location.

title: Wow
text: Booked last minute as was tired from journey, Expected more for price, but guess its just where its based, rooms need touching up with some fresh paint, mirror wasnt clean didnt use shower as was abit grim, also no spare pillows so didn't really have a comfy night :( the male receptionist was polite tho :)

title: Excellent Priced Budget Hotel
text: My friend and I stayed at this Hotel while on a recent trip to London. We have stayed in another 3 Hotels in that area in previous years, however we both felt the Arriva Hotel was by far the best value for money. We received a very warm welcome from the staff on Reception and they were exceptionally friendly and professional. The fact that the Hotel has a lift is fantastic as the other ones we stayed at in the area didn't. The layout of the room is very good and the furniture is adequate. The bathroom we had was also very good especially the shower. Continental breakfast can be ordered and paid for at reception and we found this to be extremely good value. All in all we found this to be a very good priced budget hotel. With less than a 10 minute walk to Kings Cross/St. Pancras we found this to be in an ideal location. Would thoroughly recommend this establishment and will certainly visit again.

title: Better than expected budget hotel
text: For £54 / night including breakfast in London (after a previous bad experience at another hotel), we where not holding much hope. As it was for just an overnight stay, we where prepared to "rough it" and put up. The hotel is in walking distance from King's Cross station. We arrived around 1.30pm (check in was from 2pm) reception was pleasant stating that our room wasn't probably ready but gave us the room key and said we could leave our holdall in it. The room was waiting to be cleaned. On inspection the bedside cabinets, where dusty. As the cleaner was in a room a few doors down, we showed her the dust and she said that she would sort it. We left the hotel to do what we had planned. On our return the room was made up (clean bedding, towels) and dust removed. Breakfast (continental) is in the basement 7.30 - 9.30. It is not a big room. We went down at 8.45 and got the last table. Breakfast was fine. Overall for £54 the hotel served it's purpose. We did not use the shower but there was hot water in the sink tap.

title: Ghastly
text: £100 bought a small room, dirty windows, no ventilation, worse than awful "continental" breakfast, disinterested reception, ludicrously small shower room, nowhere to store clothes. Possibly the worst hotel I've ever stayed in - and I've been in some bad ones!

title: Value for money
text: Booked this hotel as it was near Kings Cross and was best value for money in the local area. The staff are very polite and helpful, not a bad hotel considering the price. Only downfall is the very bad Internet connection. Only managed to connect to the Internet for 7minutes and continually get cut off. The hotel room is cosy, modern tv, comfortable bed, the shower needs to improve as the water drips out rather than shower out. Apart from that I would say it's not bad. Kings Cross area especially near the station tends to be noisy so considering the other hotels in the local area I have stayed in, the room I stayed in managed to keep the noise now.

title: Clean quiet room
text: Booked this hotel for a weekend get away room 32 is on the ground floor at the back of the hotel it was quiet, clean and the bathroom was modern its very close to kings cross and the underground and the night bus no 91 coming back from soho dropped us quite close to the hotel. Would definitely stay here again

title: Disaster hotel for high price
text: My rate: 0 / 5 This was the worst hotel ever. I believe that London can offer much more for the same budget, but obviusly we picked one of the worst :( - noisy, noisy, noisy - basement rooms - dirty covers (quilts) - uncomfortably bed - poor breakfast I would not recommend to stay here.

title: nice location
text: Hotel room very small and very basic. Location was good. Breakfast very poor but overall cheap and cheerful and great location.If you are looking for a cheap hotel with easy access you could do worse.

title: Great price-great rooms
text: My wife and I were stuck in Kings Cross London on the 4th Jan 2015. On searching the internet I came across the Arriva Hotel 55 Swinton Rd WC1X 9NT. At first I could not believe the price-£40 for a double room in the centre of London . I took a chance and booked the room. On arrival we were very pleasantly surprised..The hotel reception was bright and spotless. On being allocated a room we found the same standard applied to the room. Alright it was basic with a double bed,kettle and tea bags. flat screen t.v. and ensuite bathroom. But for £40 what do you want. This hotel is ideal to use as a base for any trip to London. My wife and I certainly in tend to use the hotel again next time we are in London

title: Excellent value hotel.
text: The small double room was clean and fresh and the shower was excellent. There were tea/coffee making facilities, a smashing hair dryer, two good sized mirrors, enough clothes storage space, an extra work surface with stool and loads of electrical sockets. Staff very helpful.

title: Health & Safety nightmare
text: We arrived, was allocated our room and left immediately. The room was sparse, dirty amd full of flies. The manager refused a refund and was rude and abusive. Disgusting and reported to the environmental health team.

title: Nice Surpise!
text: Booked this hotel via the internet as good location to St Pancras and not having seen it was not expecting much for the price BUT what a lovely surprise! On arrival we were greeted by a friendly gentleman who offered us the choice of two twin bedded rooms (one on the ground floor or one in basement) but were advised the basement would be quieter so chose that option. The room was small but adequate and extremely cosy (also had a fridge!) The bed linen was beautifully clean and smelt lovely. The staff were extremely helpful and informative and made myself and daughter feel most welcome. As a well travelled lady I feel the negative reviews regarding this hotel are totally unfair - you get what you pay for and this hotel totally exceeded expectations. We will certainly be paying a return visit. Ps another advantage - luggage is allowed to be left (with a small charge) after checkout and picked up when convenient - beats the queue and exorbitant cost at St Pancras!

title: Arriva
text: Cheap but shabby. Ask for a quiet room at the back or you will stay awake all night. Breakfast poor but bathroom good and clean room, if tiny. Spend a few pounds more for a room only deal elsewhere and eat at a cheap cafe.

title: Decent Holdover
text: My wife and I booked this hotel for the night as we had tickets for the Eurostar the next day. Cheap and cheerful

title: This place rocked!
text: For an econo hotel, this placed totally rocked! It was conveniently located and our room was neat. Our bathroom was clean with a full size tub and a shower with good water pressure. Our room was a little small, but our friends had a room much larger, so I guess the size varies from room to room. There was also a full set of dishes, a mini-fridge, and extra sink in the bedroom area. Breakfast was pretty much cereal (they even have Coco Pebbles), white toast, coffee/tea. The staff was very pleasant. Overall, I had a great experience at this hotel, and I would definitely stay there again.

title: Not good
text: It depends on what you need/want really, very hand location and I guess quite cheap for London but it's all very much run down, twin rooms have very small single beds, but in fairness I didn't have any problems while staying here and what I saw of the staff no issue there either. You get what you pay for.

title: Avoid if at all possible
text: I left my booking until late this trip, and the usual hotels I use in London were fully booked. I left a colleague to book 'something' for us, and he picked the Arriva Hotel in Kings Cross. Lesson learnt there. The staff at the hotel are very pleasant, no issues there but I was not impressed with the cleanliness of rooms, which were basic to say the least. The worst issue was the central heating which was constantly on, with no facility 'in room' to switch it off. The room was like a sauna, and the only way to cool the room was to open the window. Which leads to the next issue....noise from the traffic. Even with secondary glazing the noise was bad, but I had to have the window open to cool the room. This made it almost impossible to sleep, even with ear plugs. I asked for an ironing board to iron some shirts, and the guy produced something that I thought was a child's toy. I had to kneel on the floor and balance the tiny ironing board on a stool, as the pull out legs did not support the board. In the bathroom was a toilet brush, which was just leaning against the wall i.e. not in a brush holder. Not nice. Breakfast was weird....let's just leave it at that. Won't be staying again. For a budget hotel it is not a budget price.

title: Stag do
text: Well booked this hotel for its closeness to kings cross and underground station so ease to get anywhere in London. It was my son in law to be stag do was very central, rooms were basic but ok only slept for one night breakfast was good plenty to eat but get voucher when checking in

title: location location
text: Staff were very friendly and helpful, super location only minutes from resturants, bars , starbucks and Kingcross station which brings you into Picaddily in minutes..also St Pancreas eurostar station was 6/7 minute walk away which was handy as we went to France straight after...ok down side...room was very basic. I do like to swing a cat 😐. Shower was small and 2 people sharing this size room can be a bit clostraphobic at times. that said it was clean and cheap so it gets my vote if your on a budget.

title: not happy
text: I would like to highlight the booking policies of this hotel, I booked a room checking in Monday 24th march for three days through Booking.com, I had to cancel the booking because of personal reasons and asked Booking.com to let me know what refund I would be receiving, Booking.com got back to me to say that the booking was non-refundable as the payment was taken on the day of the booking, the payment was taken 2 days later not on the day, I asked Booking.com if they could re-instate the booking as they had taken the money, I was told that there where no rooms available, this hotel has in effect taken two lots of money for one room, I knew that I would have to pay an administration fee but I did not think that I would receive no money back at all. I phoned Booking.com yesterday several times to try to either get some of my money back or to rebook the room and was told that there were no managers available, I was told this several times yesterday and was told again this morning, it is very unprofessional to have no managers at tall on sight. Just beware everyone.

title: Good value but no hot water at "peak" times...
text: Stayed for 6 nights at the beginning of December. Location was excellent, fifteen minute walk from Euston with lots of shops and restaurants nearby. Room was small, but comfortable. A little noisy as our room faced the front of the hotel. Breakfast was limited but pleasant and overall, the hotel is good value for money. I found staff friendly but there is a major issue with the hot water running out at certain times, mostly in the morning when most are getting up for breakfast. If you shower at night or after 11am, there wasn't much of a problem.

title: Visiting Kensington Palace to see the Late Princess Diana's dresses
text: The location became insignificant when we entered the room, thank goodness it was for just 1 night. all aspects needed a good clean and by now should anyone have tried to close the curtains as I did they will have virtually shredded away .The stay deteriorated the continental breakfast was not available although I asked for containers to be filled up nothing happened so it was toast and jam!!!! being served in a small cramped room in the basement .

title: A basic average hotel
text: An overall good experience at this hotel for what I initially expected (reading other reviews etc.) The location is very good (next to King's Cross St. Pancras station,) and safe I would safe since it's close to a major train station and the room was quite small but clean. It's a good choice if you are traveling solo and are out of the hotel during the day. It's not a very good value for money experience though. I know London hotels are extremely expensive, but paying 115 pounds per night for this hotel is way too much. It is just an average hotel after all so they need to lower their prices a little bit. What I also found disturbing was that you had to pay for wi-fi.

title: Good budget hotel with great location
text: I booked a twin room at this hotel for 2 nights for a short trip. The staff were very friendly and helpful and the place was clean and bright. Our room was situated on the first floor, at the back of the hotel. There was a lift as well as stairs. After reading some reviews about noise from traffic outside I put in a request with the hotel for a quiet room - and that it was, other than perhaps the odd sounds of walking from guests above us on the next floor. The room wasn't as cramped as many reviews have said on here - perhaps it differs from room to room. We had 2 twin beds, with good colour tv - which worked well with plenty of channels. We also had a fridgefreezer, tea and coffee making facilities with kettle, and hairdryer. and a small open closet for hanging clothing. The bathroom was very clean and we were given new soaps/shampoo and conditioner as well as fresh towels twice during our stay by housekeeping. There was always hot water from the shower and all in all we were quite happy with our stay. In terms of the breakfast provided, I cannot comment on that as we didn't try it - we decided to go out to cafe's in the morning for our breakfast. The room we had did get very very hot even with the sache windows being wide open all day and all night - so I would recommend you bring something like a handheld fan as the heat can feel quite suffocating. I realised that this may have been because our room was right above the laundry room. Another thing was that although you leave your keys at reception each time you go out, when you collect them they don't ask you for ID which I found a little unnerving. Otherwise those are the only downsides. Everything else was very positive. Bear in mind the hotel is a budget hotel and that is what it is, it was very clean, but simple and good for a couple of nights away. I would recommend it and would probably stay here again if it was for 1 or 2 nights. As the room was very hot, I would take a small fan with me next time.

title: If you are desparate
text: I stayed here on business persuaded by the reviews that said it was clean. Put it this way, you wouldn't go to the bathroom in bare feet. The fitting haven't been replaced for 20 years, every part of it is deeply shabby and the roomis so small I can almost touch both walls at the same time. Horrid.

title: Grubby hotel and poor facilities
text: We needed somewhere local to Kings Cross station so I chose this hotel as it was a good location. However, the room was tiny, there was no shelf space for storing bathroom essentials so everything had to go in the wardrobe. I tried to refill a kettle but the sink wasn't big enough to fit the kettle so I thought I would refill a bottle of water. That wouldn't fit either. I had to use a small glass to do the job. There was a coating of dust on the 'refreshment' tray. Overall not the best experience.

title: Arriva Hotel and Kings Cross
text: Just came back from a trip to London. (Oct21, ) and had an enjoyable time. However, the basic costs were very high when compared to a major city in the states. We stayed at the Arriva Hotel at Kings Cross. I have stayed there before and the costs are very reasonable for London. The hotel is very basic but is very clean. Ask for a first floor, backside room for a more quiet experience. There are fridges in each room as well as a sink. All rooms are ensuite. Kings Cross is a major transportation terminal for the tube and trains. A great location. I would recommend the Arriva Hotel if you are interested in keeping costs down. Continental breakfast is offered. Many restraurants in the area. Easy links to all airports. Remember a dollar equals about 1/2 pound.

title: Cheap and cheerful - no complaints
text: Stayed for 2 night for a business trip. Great location close to kings cross. Reception staff friendly. Room basic, but very clean. Bed comfy with clean mattress protector on, bathroom spotless with clean new towels. shower gel and shampoo provided and replaced on second day. breakfast only £3.50 for cereal, juice, toast, ham and cheese - so no complaints there. Co-op close by. Nothing flas, but definatley adequate, and greeted with a smile by staff - always a bonus!

title: Everything you need!
text: My friend and I were originally looking at hostel dorms but found a last minute deal for Arriva on a twin room that would cost us not much more. The location was great as I needed to be near Kings Cross. On arrival we were greeted by a lovely man who promptly checked us into our room. He was also very helpful in booking our bus tour the next day. The room was a comfortable size and the cleanliness of both the room and en suite was of a high standard. There was a hairdryer, kettle and tea & coffee provided. The complimentary shampoo was a bonus as I'd forgotten to pack some :) I would happily stay here again and recommend it to others.

title: The worst!
text: This is a disgrace. I expect budget accommodation for a fair price but I do not expect a carpet that smells, and I mean one that you can smell standing up - not sniffing the floor! Pubic hair in every corner of the bathroom and in the shower. Mould and crumbling skirting boards. And for a small room, a sizeable area was taken up with a full size metal kitchen sink....that isn't even working, and a disgusting old refrigerator. On the upside, we were disturbed at 9:30 by a knock on the door and a man shouting MAINTENANCE who came in and started checking all the electrical appliances. Apparently they all work ok...but couldn't you do those checks when the guest is out ???? I could keep going on but to keep it far briefer than it should be. Save your money, and do not stay at this germ infected dump. Even the carpet in the common areas is dirty and unhealthy. A disgrace. Horrible.

title: Clean and functional
text: Cheaper than many hotels in the area, and you get what you pay for. Our room was clean but small and being on the ground floor at the front, it was very noisy on a warm evening when we needed the windows open. et is actually fairly busy.

title: Very noisy, not worth the price
text: We stayed in this hotel for 2 nights. Both nights were extremely noisy and uncomfortable. Not only we heard people watching tv, showering or whatsoever

title: cheap & Tacky....
text: I knew this hotel is only a 2* and i was only staying there for 1 night. the outside looked alright but when you get into the rooms you think twice, should i be staying here!!!! the fridge made sooo much noise, the tv had really bad signal and might as well been in the roof! the bathroom was clean but the shower was rubbish. threre was sticky marks on the sides in the room. over all not that clean. the man on the front desk was helpfull, it is somewhere cheap and close to kings cross station that is the only good thing i can say about this hotel

title: Business
text: Small clean central no frills and cheap.what more do you want when you just need to sleep? Couldn't fault it except the shower in room 86 was less than efficient! Didn't stay for breakfast. Gent on reception couldn't have been more polite or helpful!

title: Go to Travelodge instead!
text: Let me list the notable things about our room: 1. Steps down into the room - we didn't know about this, there was no warning and the receptionist said nothing, so my friend promptly fell down them onto the floor, narrowly missing the wardrobe which was straight ahead. Fortunately she didn't injure herself. 2. Kettle was too small to fit into the sink to fill, had to fill with cups provided. 3. Smoke alarm was fixed, but covered in polythene like it was brand new. 4. Drafty door in the corner disguised as a window with bed pushed up against it, the head board leaning free against the door. 5. Hotel on main road, our room was on that side. Traffic picked up around 5am and was quite niosy. 6.Breakfast room smells strange, no windows and staff were not talkative, food was basic cornflakes, toast, plastic ham and cheese, no fry ups or pastries. Although the location in excellent and the reception was gleaming, the rooms...well...I think it depends which room you get! First off most - if not all the rooms are below street level. My friend and I checked in, and our room was at the very back of the hotel. As soon as my friend unlocked the door, she took a step into the room and promptly fell down three steps which the receptionist had not warned us about, NOR was there a warning on the door about steps down into the room. She could have hit her head quite badly on the wardrobe or fell badly onto her bags, but fortunately she didn't. I turned the light on and saw the room. Yes, it was a large room (we booked a twin), and yes it was clean. The wardrobe could have been put against the disguised door in the corner, eliminating the draft. Breakfast was basic with just cornflakes or bran flakes, orange or apple juice, toast and the continental option comprised of plastic ham and cheese. No fry ups or pastries here! The room had a strange smell, the staff untalkative, and no windows either. Would not stay here or recommend - go to travelodge instead!!

title: One of the best BnB's we've stayed at!
text: We stayed for 2 nights here over the weekend. The rooms were clean, newly decorated with lots of extra little touches that made our stay homely and welcome. We had an en-suite bathroom and the room was plenty big enough for the two of us and our 10 month old son. We had friends stay in another room with their 2 children also. It was handy to walk to the station to catch the train into London which the children loved and lovely to leave the hustle and bustle of the day and come back to the peace and quiet of the guest house. Breda and Tony were superb hosts and made us feel very welcome, and we enjoyed the breakfasts, especially the fresh fruits & pastries and brewed coffee. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this Guest House.

title: Read review
text: I booked this B&B on November, 26 2012 for three nights. One double and one single and sent a deposit. All was OK at that point. On June 18, 2013 I received an email from Breda after two email attempts telling me that the reservation had been miss handled and they did not have a single for me on the third night and they were going to move us to another B&B for the third night. On July 18, 2013 I received an email that all was good again and we were secure for the three nights as scheduled. On August 21, 2013 another email that we were indeed going to have to move to an alternate B&B. So we were OK, then not OK, then OK, then not OK. We arrived at the alternate B&B to find that Breda told them that we would all share our ensuite bathroom. This was of course not possible and Breda was aware that we didn't want to share accommodations. This is the first time I have given anyone a poor review. But if you should decide to stay here make sure you have alternate plans. Maybe stay in downtown London. The Metro costs about $6.00 each way and takes 45 minutes. So for $200.00 night and no hassle you could stay at the Staybridge Suites or similar. The B&B it's self was clean, well appointed, and a fine light breakfast.

title: Outstanding and beautiful stay
text: I would totally recomend this place without hesitation. It is a beautifully kept guest house, faultlessly clean, comfortable and warm, with free wifi, great included breakfast, set in a quiet and peaceful tree filled lane location, yet a nice and easy walk to the tube station and within half an hour of kings cross and central london. Incredible value for London, Breda and her team couldnt have been more weloming, friendly, kind, and helpful, and at the same time utterly professional hosts. Thank you !

title: Beautiful
text: Both me and my partner arrived here for one nights stay so we could visit family in the area... upon arrival the lady that greeted us was very warm and welcoming and very helpful... she showed us to our room which was located on the top floor... and I’ve got to say the room was immaculate... beautiful bed, beautiful furniture.. lovely bathroom.. you can tell this family look after their guest house and their guest... we would most definitely come here again and stay for longer next time. Thank you for the best nights sleep we’ve had in ages

title: Best place to stay if going to London.
text: What can I say that has not been said before...Its a thumbs up from us 👍🏻 The guest house is warm and cosy spotlessly clean a lovely home. Our room was on the top floor with lovely views, and the bed was very comfortable indeed. For breakfast there was plenty of choice in a lovely room, as are all the rooms in the house. Breda and her staff cannot do enough for you, they truly want you to be happy....and we were. Under 10 minutes walking to Southgate station onto the Piccadilly line very convenient. We stayed here for 4 nights and found a great Lebanese Restaurant just by the station called Warda. Also the guest house has gated parking which really suited us. Many thanks for making our stay a good one.

title: Exceptional Accommodations
text: Trip Advisory was spot on with the reviews on this place. We spent three nights here with our friends and were thrilled with the accommodations. The staff was friendly and very accommodating. they gave excellent directions on finding our way around London. The breakfast included fresh fruit, lovely bread, cheeses, yogurt, juices, coffee and tea. Very quiet and peaceful and a 10 minute walk to the tube. You will not be disappointed!

title: Short break
text: Brilliant location to visit the city, few minutes walk to underground piccadilly line. Beautiful house and lovely owner, couldn t have been more welcoming. No english breakfast but cooked eggs, fruit, muffins etc

title: Excellent accommodation with parking
text: Breda & her staff were very welcoming. Breda was very efficient in responding to our queries. She has gated car parking which was suited us. It is 10 mins walk from the guest house to the tube station. The rooms are very comfortable & well-equipped & the breakfast was VERY good. You can help yourself to fruit & cereals & Breda provided a choice of eggs, toast & excellent coffee. We could not have asked for more!

title: Deservedly 5* One of the best...
text: Delightful people who own and run this guest house... Friendly, helpful and patient! Quiet area

title: Quiet and comfort in London
text: A most comfortable house for a stay in London - extremely quiet, and set in a pleasant location. There is generous, secure parking, and a good night's sleep was following by a lavish breakfast in a lovely, light room. Many thanks to our charming host.

title: EXCELLECT B & B
text: We booked another B & B in London for 4 nights, unfortunately the reservation was messed up and we had to spend 2 of the nights here - wish it would have been all 4. Other place was good, but The Oaks is fantastic. Owner and her help are VERY personable. Breakfast is made to order, many options. Rooms are clean and quiet. Close to the Underground. After the 2 nights the owner ferried us to the other B & B. One of the best B & B's we have ever stayed!

title: Fantastic B&B
text: My wife and I stayed here last night after going to a gig at Ally Pally. The accommodation is fantastic, very clean, has plenty of toiletries and tea and coffee facilities along with lots of milk for a change. It’s in a great location and Breda and her staff are very kind and helpful. If we go to Ally Pally again we will definitely be staying here

title: Quiet, comfy, convenient, friendly with lucious breakfast !
text: Loved my stay at The Oaks Guest House, which is conviently situated just a few minutes walk from Southgate tube station, with plenty of amenities within walking distance. The Oaks is located in a cul-de-sac in a quiet and safe area, and the property has security gates, too. Most friendly welcome from the owner. I had a room on the second floor with a large window and no other houses in sight. A very comfy bed with equally comfy pillows. En-suite shower and toilet, all spotlessly clean. Breakfast was a feast without limits and huge choice of cereals. The service at breakfast was so efficient and friendly. I could have had more than the cereal, toast, fruit juice, tea, delicious poached eggs, but frankly this was just perfect for me! Visiting from France I'd forgotten my 13 amp adaptor, but one was quickly found for me and it was no problem to charge my telephone over breakfast. I will definitely return when I next visit the area, especially for the friendliness, the quietness, the comfort, and that feast in the morning! Perfect for the traveller or for a holiday. Pubs and restaurants within walking distance, and this particular area still has fields surrounding it!

title: Great place to stay
text: The room was clean, comfortable and fully equipped with toiletries, hair dryer, tea, coffee and biscuits. Excellent breakfast. Breda, the host, was great and welcoming. She answered all my questions, help me with directions and booking a taxi to the airport, gave some tips and was sincerely worried with my well being. I would definitely stay at The Oaks Guest House again! And I strongly recommend it to anyone who wishes to stay away from the London downtown bustle.

title: Forever grateful
text: My visit was a challenging one as I fell ill and had many unnecessary obstacles, but thank you to Breda, Eliff, Lorraine for their hospitality beyond the call of duty, thank you for going the extra mile...thank you for bringing my breakfast to my room and washing my clothes, many thanks for the times when you’d go out of your way to assist in whatever way you could! You’re all highly appreciated!

title: Fantastic!!!
text: The warm welcome, spotlessly clean rooms, fab breakfast and great location make this a fantastic place to stay - only 10 minute walk to the tube and you are then whizzed into central London - what’s not to like xxx

title: Perfect Place
text: The rooms are spotless and clean, plenty of towels, soap, shampoo and sundries. Breda the land lady could not do enough for us, explanations on the tube, things to see. Very quiet and welcoming place just 3 minuets from the Southgate underground station. Will go back and enjoy the hospitality again.

title: Simply outstanding
text: My husband, my grandson and myself stayed here for 2 nights. Breda, our hostess, was so welcoming and hospitable. Nothing was too much trouble. Our grandson is only 2 yrs of age and Breda was most accommodating of this. We loved the breakfast and our room was so comfortable. Would we recommend this guest house - YES WE WOULD! Will we be staying again? YES WE WILL! We normally stay in Highbury but not any more. This place is close to the tube. More comfortable than some hotels we have stayed in and certainly a lot more friendly. Thank you Breda!

title: Very pleasant stay
text: We just returned from a 9 night stay and I have to say it was a very nice and pleasant stay and 100% recommend it. Very clean, nice breakfasts cozy atmosphere and nice owners. Continental breakfast. Bright bedrooms with TV and en suite bathrooms. Great option with online 5 minutes walk to Southgate Tube Station. Would definitely come back.

title: Beautiful home with lovely staff. The epitome of an English home!
text: If you have the opportunity to stay at this lovely home, take it! What a lovely home, great breakfast service and food. Very nice rooms and quiet location. It is a short walk from the tube station into London. The park like setting is such a nice change from the busy London streets and yet, they are so close. Lots of little shops and restaurants within walking distance as well. No need for a car. Wish I could have stayed longer.

title: Top Class!
text: I had the pleasure of staying at The Oaks guesthouse this summer with my husband and young son in a lovely family room on the top floor of the house with wonderful views. Breda & Tony were perfect hosts and really could not do enough for us all. The house itself was modern yet warm and cosy & spotlessly clean.This place really does deserve it's 5 star reviews, particularly for the standard of accomodation and fantastic management & staff. The property is well located for travelling into town, only 5 mins to the local underground and a pleasant 20-30 min tube ride into town. We have already recommended it to our friends and are planning another visit in the new year, our son did not want to leave! Thanks for a wonderful stay.

title: Best place to stay if you make a trip to London
text: A lovely place to stay and come back after a busy day visiting London City. Clean, quiet, and with a very polite staff that makes you feel at home. It's only a ten minute walk to Southgate underground station and just thirty minutes away from Piccadilly Circus. Will come back again asap. Don't look for anywhere else when traveling to London.

title: vacation
text: The owner and staff are wonderful, accommodating and always with a smile. My wife and I were very impressed with how the room + bathroom + breakfast area was organized and nicely renovated. We would definitely return here.

title: Home away from home
text: This guest house is lovely. We have stayed here many times in the past two years and every time is wonderful. Comfy beds, tastefully appointed rooms, always clean and fresh. The hostess, Breda is a warm and gracious host and the staff are delightful. Easy walking distance to the Southgate tube station on the Piccadilly line. The Oaks is a home away from home for me when I visit London.

title: A home away from home...
text: A wonderful stay in every detail at the Oaks Guest House. Breda and Tony are perfect hosts. Rooms were clean and large. The bed was so comfortable and the sheets smelled of lavender. Breakfast was delicious and location was outstanding: 5 min walk from the Piccadilly line station of Southgate, in a quiet and green area, away from the chaos of the city center. We will definitely come back! Cristiano and Sara

title: A little Gem in London
text: The only B&B I’d stay in London, this is the best of British hospitality. Breda is always delightful, warm & welcoming. She never ceases to amaze me with her kindness and generosity. I’ve been coming to stay at the Oaks for a number of years every time I go down to London. It feels like coming home every time. The room is always modern, tastefully appointed and spotless clean. The breakfast is fresh, generous and fine quality. I’d recommend it to anyone and it won’t disappoont.

title: Perfect Guest House The Oaks
text: Friends and I have stayed a weekend in The Oaks. We were in London for the Olympic Games and the Holland Heineken House. We had beautiful rooms and bathrooms (looks like a five star hotel room). The guest house is a few yards from the Southgate tube station on the Piccadilly line. Perfect located in a quiet blind alley. The people of the guest house were very warm and welcoming. We had a very wonderful time in The Oaks. I would recommend The Oaks to everyone who wants to stay in London. Thanks for everything.

title: Couldn't have been better
text: Our 1st stay in Breda's beautiful B&B and it really couldn't have been better. Breda made us feel very welcome. They list the breakfast as Continental but it was super super generous with loads of toast, pastries, cereal, gorgeous fruit salad, a choice of 4 fruit juices plus eggs cooked any way you like. A short walk from the Tube station, lots of parking and we were fine to leave our car there after the check-out time which really helped. The room & en-suite were absolutely immaculate and had everything we needed including slippers & a hairdryer. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend. It's really peaceful in the bedroom too, you could only hear the birds in the trees. Wonderful. Thank you very much!

title: A Gem
text: Stumbled across this GEM when trying to find somewhere near Alexandra Palace. We have tended to go for anonymous hotel chain brands this made a wonderful change and we will return whenever going to London! All the positive reviews are totally accurate - we couldn’t have been made to feel more at home. Quiet location- secure parking- clean - comfortable - great breakfast- a lovely hostess and team.

title: A gem of a place
text: This was our second stay at The Oaks for a 2 night trip to London and it didn't disappoint. The location is fantastic being just a 5 to 10 minute walk from Southgate tube station (Piccadilly line). Our room was spacious, clean and beautifully furnished and decorated. The welcome from Lorraine was lovely (Breda was away) and nothing was too much trouble. The secure car parking is an added bonus. We will always stay here whenever we go to London and I can't recommend it highly enough.

title: Perfect stay
text: Perfect Guest house for a London stay. Location great. 4-5min walk from Southgate Underground and Piccadilly line takes you straight into heart of London. Out first stay at the Oaks and the hospitality was so warming and welcoming. The entire guest house is immaculately clean and our twin room had a large bath/shower room and nicely decorated. Breakfast and service were fantastic, I really cannot say a bad word and the owners should be proud of their accomplishment. Will definitely go back again when next stayibg in London and cannot reccomend enough.

title: Excellent B and B!
text: We stayed at the Oaks Guest House for five nights, and it was the nicest place (of the six) where we stayed on our vacation. The room and bath were spacious and immaculately clean. The entire house is beautifully modernized. Breda was kind and considerate and went beyond the call of duty to make our stay pleasant. The breakfast was delicious, with a large variety of choices

title: Comfortable and welcoming
text: My wife and i stayed here for one night while visiting friends nearby. Our room was spacious and comfortable with an en suite shower room. Breda was very welcoming and helpful. Although breakfast is listed as continental we were also offered eggs and ham. In fact the spread of excellent quality food can only be described as copious. The immediate area is very quiet yet an easy walk from Southgate underground station.

title: Four night stay to visit children.
text: Our third stay at the oaks as our son and daughter in law have a flat in Southgate plus our daughter and boyfriend rent in Winchmore Hill. Therefore the Oaks is so perfect for us. So peaceful and delightful B and B. 5 mins from tube and easy journey to central London. This stay we occupied the Studio apartment, really spacious with kitchen etc and large bedroom upstairs. Washing machine,fridge, tumble dryer all to use. Breda so friendly and helpful and offering excellent breakfast choice. Everywhere is clean with all toiletries provided etc. Again, would totally recommend and should be staying again just before Christmas.

title: One of the best
text: My husband and I have stayed at quite a few guest houses in our time and The Oaks has to be one of the best. If we had stayed at one of the best hotels, we could not have asked for more. The friendliness and service of the staff, particularly Lorraine, were next to none and the cleanliness was superb. Our every need was catered for from tea and coffee making facilities to toiletries, free Wi-fi and the most peaceful and loveliest of locations. The Oaks is at the end of a cul-de-sac and considering we were in London and a busy location, we could have been in the country.

title: Quiet, good value, great friendly place for accessing London via the Underground
text: My wife and I stayed 14 nights in their apartment unit. If you don't need a big hotel environment, this is a great alternative. Very quiet location from 9:30 PM to 9:30 AM in spite of being next to a school with a play field. Short walk to Southgate Underground Station makes access to London, trains, etc. very easy. Lots of fine restaurants within walking distance. Very friendly, welcoming owners and staff made breakfast the equivalent of a champagne event.

title: Wonderful relaxing stay
text: The oaks guest house is truly exceptional! Only five miles outside of London, a stress free tube ride straight into the main tourist area, leave your car securely behind locked gates. Comfortable clean rooms, joyful breakfast, eggs cooked freshly to your liking by the lovely Lorraine, Breda is a wonderful host making us most welcome in her beautiful home. Guidance given where to eat, we can recommend the Angus steak house! Thank you so much we will surely be back! Janet and mike.

title: Beautiful hideaway with exceptional hosts
text: My wife and I stayed here recently and was amazed at the beautifully presented guest house. Arriving at a very late hour to gates being opened automatically seemed like somethong out of the rich and famous "who lives in a house like this". We were going to a festival around 10 mins away and required something close by but never imagined such a treat existed. Its definitely not a place where groups of guys are looking for a lads night out but more for a peaceful place to rest and jave as a base camp to visit on a weekend away. Breakfast is continental so ask for amazing omelettes and you eill not be disappointed. My special thanks goes to Breda who made our stay ever so welcoming and apologies for our lateness o ce again as we arrived in the early morning when ideally we should jave been there by 11pm at the latest.

title: A real pleasure
text: The rooms are pretty, clean and well maintained. Breda, the proprietor, could not be more helpful and charming. We did not have breakfast but there is coffee, tea, sugar and a kettle in the room. Very much recommended!

title: Wonderful overnight stay
text: We were staying one night prior to going to a wedding in Surrey the following day, we were travelling from Leeds and decided to take the opportunity to go to the Theatre in London. I couldn't recommend The Oaks highly enough, our room was fabulous, plenty of tea, coffee and fresh milk and a fridge to keep it in (unheard of in any other B&B I've ever stayed in!). There was also a microwave for our use. Breda and her team were so warm and welcoming and it was so quiet. The Tube station was a 5 minute walk away and only a half hour journey into Covent Garden. It was a real treat to stay and we will definitely going back.

title: Warm welcome and spotless room
text: Stayed one night whilst visiting friends locally. Excellent location - near tube and yet in a lovely quiet lane. Room had everything you need - small but cosy. Made to feel very welcome by Breda and a good breakfast the next day which included a perfectly boiled egg! Will certainly look to stay again in the future when in that area.

title: Excellent - with nearby tube station for easy access to Central London
text: We arrived quite early and were greeted warmly and showed to our room. The room was just what we needed with ensuite , substantial tea and coffee facilities with plenty of room. Breakfast again was lovely and everyone really friendly. The area seemed very safe and very quiet. Everything just had a really good feel about it we would definitely return

title: Absolutely wonderful!
text: We are a family from Hong Kong, and we were planning on staying in a hotel in London for our holiday, until we saw how much we could save by staying at a B&B. But, to our surprise, everything about The Oaks Guesthouse met and surpassed our expectations, and we could not have asked for more. The owner, Breda, was incredibly accommodating, even at very short notice, and there was a genuinely welcoming and comforting ambiance to the guesthouse. The accommodation itself was superb, with excellently maintained facilities that were spotless and wonderfully furnished rooms. We were served a continental breakfast every morning which were most wonderful. Breda even suggested to us places to go to and where to eat- which by the way, the guesthouse is just a stone throw away from the Southgate town centre, bustling with wonderful restaurants tailored to every taste and the Southgate tube station, which when the tube is running, is very convenient. Overall, in juxtaposition to our initial thoughts, staying at The Oaks Guesthouse was the best choice for accommodation due to the remarkably accommodating owners, excellent rooms and divine breakfast.

title: Great Stay
text: Spent 5 nights at the Oaks and enjoyed our time there. Breda made us feel welcome. The room and ensuite were both spacious and very comfortable. Breakfasts were great with as much food as we could eat. Close to underground train which made it easy to get around. Really appreciated our time there.

title: Sight seeing and rock concert
text: This guest house was excellent. Very warm and friendly upon arrival and throughout our weekend stay. The owners and staff were very helpful and accomodating. 2 minute walk to the town centre where there was access to buses and the underground direct to London in under 30 minutes. Will definitely stay here again whenever we visit London.

title: Excellent B&B
text: We have visited London a number of times and found our recent stay at The Oaks to be among the very best. As others have reported, Breda and Tony are excellent hosts and their rooms are bright, modern, comfortable and spotless. The house is at the end of a quiet street, an easy walk from the Southgate tube station.

title: Brilliant location
text: Excellent facilities, secure parking, within a few minutes walk to Southgate tube station. Breda was very welcoming, friendly and helpful and made our stay really enjoyable. We will certainly stay again when we are next visiting London.

title: Very, very nice
text: My wife and I stayed here for two nights in the middle of November. Our hostess, Breda, could not have been better. Very warm, welcoming and absolutely went way out of her way to help us. A first rate experience in every which way. The Southgate neighborhood (where The Oaks is located) is outside the central London area, but the nearby underground station made getting around to the places that we wished to visit quite convenient. My highest ratings for this lovely BnB.

title: Superb
text: Spent two days at The Oaks and loved it! I was a lone female business traveller so really appreciated feeling safe and the well appointed room and luxurious toiletries, mineral water and hot chocolate and biscuits. It's a beautiful place and only 5 mins from the tube. Continental breakfast is super as is Breda's welcome and hospitality. Highly recommended.

title: Excellent stay!
text: Really nice accomodation, excellent value for money, spotlessly clean, would thoroughly recommend! A 10 minute walk away from a fantastic choice of restaurants! Our host was excellent, extremely friendly and accommodating, the place was immaculate! Mike, Bristol

title: Brilliant Lodging
text: We have always stayed in the Southgate area when we visit London because it is close to the Tube and also has a varied selection of shopping and dining options nearby. This was our very first stay at the Oaks because our normal B&B had closed unexpectedly and the Oaks was recommended. Wow! We will definitely make the Oaks our home away from home from now on (provided it is available). Everything was perfect - from the comfortable and clean room to the hallway microwave and frig to the amazing breakfasts to the exceptional customer service

title: Wonderful Stay
text: We stayed for seven nights at the Oakes. Brenda and Tony were wonderful hosts. The room was spacious and clean. My husband, son, and myself were all in one room with plenty of space to spare. The breakfast was delicious and Brenda was so attentive to our needs. When we checked out I felt like we were saying goodbye to family! You cannot go wrong staying at this B&B! It is only a six minute walk to the Piccadilly Line and we walked it every day -- a pleasant few blocks of quiet neighborhoods. I would not hesitate to stay here again and again!

title: Good place for feeling at home
text: Stayed there on a business trip. The location is quiet, clean and well maintained. The atmosphere of the house and the attitude of the people are very enjoyable. For sightseeing in London a bit far out, but if you are looking for a place around Southgate the best call.

title: Perfect place to stay when visiting London
text: I chose this B&B because of the reviews here on tripadvisor.com and on its site. It's beautiful! I went there with my son (who's a 3 year and a half old boy) and my husband, for 8 nights (from August 11 to August 19), and we had a great stay. The owners are warm and welcoming, and we found in Esra - a lady who works there to help them - a very nice surprise. She made our breakfast times so lovely, and we really felt like she cared for us. The rooms are really nice, they look lovely and are spacious and comfortable, all was clean and functional. We slept just fine, there were also books you could borrow, a nice tv with a dvd player, and free wifi, which was very important for us to work with at night. Its location was also great, so near to the Southgate Underground station on the Piccadilly line which leads you straight to the city centre. And the neighbourhood was lovely, there were many shops, restaurants, and supermarkets (also a big Asda one, which was open 24 hrs a day), and nice parks nearby. I would no doubt recommend this B&B to anyone choosing to visit the beautiful London, I miss it already. Thank you, Tony, Breda and Esra, we had a really great time with you, and we'll definitely book a room of yours when we happen to come to London again. Elena, Luigi & Nemo

title: Super comfy stay for a weary traveler
text: I stayed at The Oaks in Sept (2013) and it was outstanding! I had been traveling all day (plane, bus, subway), and was exhausted when I got off at the tube station with my luggage. It was a short, convenient walk to The Oaks, and I nearly cried with relief when I saw the guest house and then my room. It was very inviting. My room (and bathroom) was spotless, and the bedding was super clean and fresh. Cleanliness is VERY important to me, and this exceeded my expectations. I was so happy to be able to relax in a comfortable room. The neighborhood is very quiet and residential, which was also nice. After resting for a bit, it was easy to walk to the restaurants near the tube station for dinner. I had a wonderful night's sleep. Breakfast the next morning was tasty and filling. There was plenty of delicious food to eat, and I really enjoyed talking to Breda. I would definitely stay there again, and I highly recommend it to anyone.

title: Happy and comfortable stay at The Oaks Guest House
text: I am delighted to have found this very comfortable guest house located in the beautiful leavy suburb of Southgate in North London. My room was spotless and beautifully decorated, and the patrons, Tony & Breda were very warm and welcoming. The guest house is only minutes from Southgate tube station on the piccadilly line, which takes you into central london in under half an hour. I would not hesitate to reccomend this accomodation for it's location, comfort and excellent value for money.

title: Overnight stay
text: My husband and I had spent 10 days in Cambridge where he was a speaker for the Wilberforce Academy at Sidney Sussex college. The accommodations were nice, but we ended up with twin beds and dorm mattresses. We chose The Oaks to spend a Saturday night because it was close to the church where my husband was speaking in Southgate the next morning. What an incredible surprise!! The accommodations were amazing...spacious and comfortable. The owner, Tony, even carried my large suitcase up to the third floor room. The breakfast was superb. Everyone was friendly and helpful. Our only regret is that we didn't stay one more night! We will be sure to stay here again if we are in the area. Thank you, Tony!

title: Wonderful place to stay
text: A clean, quiet and pleasant place to stay in a great location! Breakfast was lovely, lots of choice and the rooms were spacious. Very reasonably priced too. The hospitality was nice, the people that run the place were friendly and I would definitely stay here again. I really liked how the local tube station got us into Central London in 20 minutes!

title: Excellent stay
text: This is the 2nd time my husband and I stay in The Oaks and we have been very pleased with our last stay. We stayed for 15 days in December and we have been very pleased. Breda is always trying to help and she is a wonderful hostess. The rooms are nice and comfortable. We would definitely go back. There are a few suggestions we would make though : - more hangers in the wardrobe - no towel heater in the bathroom (as stated in the website) and in the winter months it is very importante. - the heat is turned off in the afternoons so when we stayed in the afternoons it got very cold Besides that...perfect ! Will be back soon.

title: Lovely Rooms at Oaks Guest House
text: I stayed twice at The Oaks Guest House in July. Breda who operates The Oaks, is very kind and hospitable, and the rooms are tasteful and comfortable. The first room was a large room with a shower, and the second was a smaller room overlooking the back garden. The second room had a bath tub which is very welcome after a day of travelling and sightseeing. Everything at The Oaks was immaculately clean and well maintained, and the location is very quiet. The Oaks is about a 15 minute walk from the Southgate underground station on the Picadilly Line. Southgate is only a few stops from Kings Cross and St. Pancras International Train Station. Also, if you are going to the airport, you stay on the Picadilly Line which will take you to Heathrow. From Southgate to Terminal 2 is about a hour and 40 minutes. There is a library only a few minutes' walk from The Oaks and there are numerous restaurants just across from Southgate station. There are also grocery stores close to the station along with other shops. If you are taking the underground or a bus, remember to buy an Oyster card at the station or have a credit card with direct pay as you cannot pay for buses or the underground with cash in London. Walking from Southgate to The Oaks, you take the main road and turn right onto Blaagdens Lane, follow it several blocks to the end and turn left. It is a very short walk to the Oaks along a quiet lane but the lane is not that well lit at night. The Oaks has a fence and gate and Breda will give you a password for the keypad. You can have breakfast, but I had other arrangements so did not try it. There is ample parking inside the fence but I did not need it as I wasn't driving. I had two lovely stays at The Oaks and I would highly recommend it.

title: Lovely Gem
text: Excellent service, Friend and very helpful Staff, room, bathroom were very clean. In general it is very clean place, Quality of service make you feel like home, Great breakfast, was fully and very tasty. I recommend this hotel to everyone. Glenn

title: Top end B&B
text: We tried to book this accommodation on a previous occasion when we visited the area but it was full This time we were lucky some 6 weeks ahead. The property is well positioned for the Tube and bus routes as well as having gated parking. Our bedroom was on the second floor and had an attractive and comfortable sleigh bed as well as a settee, ample hanging and drawer space and a desk. Tea and coffee making facilities with fresh milk available in a fridge in the hallway. The shower room was wet room style with spotless modern sanitary ware. The whole accommodation has an air of quality. Breakfast was served in a bright airy room. Coffee was tasty and plentiful. Usual selection of fresh fruits and juices plus cereals. Hot course consisted of eggs anyway but surprisingly no bacon or sausages. Selection of croissants as well as toast. Thoroughly recommended. Breeda and her staff were friendly and helpful.

title: 4 Night Stay
text: Excellent guest house with modern facilities, & very good breakfast with plenty of choice. Quiet location & close to Southgate tube. Breda is a friendly host & will cater for any needs or requests throughout your stay. Free secure parking a bonus. Would recommend.

title: A little gem
text: Stayed here for 1 night whilst in the area on business. From the booking to the moment I left I could not fault it! Breda was so welcoming. The room lovely and fresh, bed very comfortable, bedsheets smelled fresh and clean, the bathroom ample size and breakfast was delicious. I'll be back when next in the area! Don't hesitate to book this little gem of a b&b!

title: Excellent accommodation - clean, friendly and quiet
text: My parents, my partner and I had two excellent nights at The Oaks Guest House. The rooms were quiet, clean and comfortable (hardwood floors and tasteful furnishings), the breakfast was delicious (fresh fruit salad, toast and scrambled eggs) and the welcome from the owner, Breda, was warm and friendly. Breda kindly accommodated for a gluten-free diet without any fuss, providing special cereal and bread. All in all, excellent value for top-class accommodation. We would definitely stay again.

title: Quiet Neighborhood, Wonderful Hosts, Yummy Breakfast
text: We enjoyed our stay at the Oaks. Breda and Tony were able to accomodate us for the one night as we decided to fly into London a day early and our other B&B was not available for the first night. The Oaks is at the end of a Cul De Sac which made it very quiet. The room was very clean and roomy enough with its own bathroom, the breakfast was very good, a lot to choose from and I wish I had been able to eat the other crumpet Breda made for us but I was so full from breakfast. They were very helpful and friendly hosts. The trip from the airport to me was quite long but once you started your day into the City riding the tube did not take too long depending where you were getting off and it was a short walk from their house to the tube station.

title: Excellent !!!
text: My wife and I stayed in Room 3 from 3/11/15 to 5/11/15 inc. The hostess, Breda, was extremely pleasant and helpful. The Guest House is situated behind an electric gate, which was very reassuring. The room, and all the public areas, were very clean indeed. Our room was great, with a large bathroom. Everything worked perfectly. Breakfast was extremely varied and plentiful. Southgate tube and bus stations were only a few minutes away, very useful. Overall, highly recommended.

title: Perfect tranquil retreat after the hustle and bustle of central London. Would highly recommend.
text: I have just returned from a two night stay with my 12yr old daughter. We felt very safe and at home in this luxury guest house and would recommend to families, couples or solo travellers who prefer peace and tranquility. It is the perfect retreat after the hustle and bustle of London all day. The house is situated at the end of a cul de sac and enjoys peaceful surroundings. I had read previous reviews and so knew the house was situated at the end of a lane that was poorly lit at night and so when it was late, we simply got a black cab (there are loads outside Southgate station), and it only cost about £3.50. The walk to the station is literally 2 to 3 minutes though. The twin room we stayed in was

title: First Class Accommodation
text: We just returned from a 4 night stay at the Oaks Guest House and we would highly recommend it to anyone visiting London. It is located in a quiet neighbourhood and just a 5 minute walk from Southgate Station on the Piccadilly Line which will take you to the centre of London. The Picadilly Line is also a direct route to Heathrow. There are numerous restaurants in the area and also several supermarkets. It is a lovely B & B, the rooms are quite spacious and tastefully decorated and spotlessly clean. Excellent breakfasts consisting of an ample selection of cereals, fruit juices, breads, teas and coffee, yoghurts, croissants and fresh fruit. Breda and Esra were so friendly and pleasant we quite enjoyed our morning chats with them, we felt like part of the family. Thank you to Tony, Breda and Esra for making our stay so enjoyable.

title: Simply Brilliant
text: I became aware of this wonderful B & B from a quaint book on London I stumbled across. The Oaks Guest House is an amazing place to stay, run by an equally amazing lady, Breda. Words can't express the warm greeting and kindness of our hostess as well as the comfortable rooms and outstanding breakfast. A close walk to the tube which takes you right to the city centre and amazing London sites. Also a close walk to the local shops, markets and various places to dine. The rooms are spacious and very well kept. I highly recommend this lovely B & B and look forward to staying there again on my next trip. Absolutely recommended.

title: Memory Lane
text: Stayed here at the beginning of a 2 month UK trip and ended up cancelling the "posh" hotel in South Ken at the end of the trip so that we could stay here again before flying back. The tube is so easy and quicker than ever. Remember to get a visitor Oyster card BEFORE you go

title: Spotless and Accommodating!
text: What a wonderful surprise this guesthouse was. Everywhere is immaculate, requested a very early breakfast - came down to find a lovely assortment of food. Would definitely recommend this guesthouse to everyone.

title: Good quality and friendly
text: Excellent guest house. Nicely decorated and very clean. My wife and I were visiting friends and family in Central and North London and found it really convenient and easy to get to from the motorway. Bus and tube connections are within walking distance but the guest house is in a quiet cul de sac. Certainly quieter than we expected at night from a London guest house. Very good value for money compared to other places we have stayed, and we will almost certainly go back. Continental breakfast was fine for us as we were eating out a lot. We stayed December and 'all in all' had an enjoyable few nights stay.

title: THE OAKS IS JUST TREE-MENDOUS
text: We've just stayed a night at the Oaks and it was outstanding. We were so well looked after by a lovely local lady called Lorraine. She couldn't do enough for us and fussed over us as well as other delighted guests at breakfast. And she was so funny and entertaining - as well as being warm and friendly - that she should be on the stage! We had a very pleasant room, secure parking was perfect and we were within just a few minutes' walk of a host of superb restaurants. And we were just a few hundred yards from the Tube station, catching the train all the way down to Baron's Court for the Davis Cup tennis tie against France at Queen's - brilliant! The Oaks Guest House is tip-top - it is simply your gateway to the whole of London.

title: Fantastic long-term stay
text: I cannot recommend The Oaks highly enough. I rarely get on TripAdvisor to review hotels but there are a few instances such as with this experience that the owner, Breda, and her team really deserve recognition for such amazing work. I travel internationally nearly every month for work and I can really say that Breda and her team could give a master class in hospitality. I spent 10 nights at the Oaks and each day's hospitality was genuinely as perfect as the next. Breda was extremely patient, warm, kind, and professional from the initial emails about my reservations to my very late check-in, to a change on my reservation, to my diet requests (more on that in a moment), to my various needs during my stay (such as early breakfast). She and her team are perfectly accommodating without being overbearing. Returning to the diet requests, Breda accommodated my vegan diet without any fuss - I had a huge, delicious breakfast every morning. Each day, I looked forward to this breakfast. Part of this wonderful hospitality are the wonderfully/beautifully kept rooms. I stayed in two different rooms during my stay due to my particular reservation needs. Both rooms were spotlessly clean and refreshed perfectly each day. The room with twin beds is very spacious and has a gorgeous tub. The double room I stayed in was also perfectly spacious and also had a nice tub. The rooms and the entire B&B smell and look beautiful. The linens smell amazing! The bed is very comfortable and the internet works great, as does the TV. It is five-star care. The grounds are so quiet - but you are just a (very safe) 10 minute walk from the Tube station (Southgate on the Piccadilly). Extremely convenient. I really enjoyed spending time in my room on the long evenings with the breeze coming in the room. Extremely peaceful. Sincere thank you to Breda, Lorraine, and the rest of the team for their superb care during my time there. I hope I can come back not too long from now and that I can recommend others in the meantime.

title: Great accomodation
text: Stayed 5 days using the Oaks as a base to go to the O2 and visit the London sites. We were not disappointed at the standard of accommodation, service and food was without any hesitation the best B&B we have ever used. The tube into London was within easy reach and never waited more than 2 minutes for a train. I would like to thank Breda for a great stay and look forward to returning in future.

title: Great in every way
text: We stayed at the Oaks after a 24 hour flight from Austratia. We were greeted with a smile and got into our room early. The room was fantastic and the bathroom was not only great but particularly spacious. The breakfast was as funny as a circus, in the nicest way possible, we didn't stop laughing for 2 days. Very handy to the tube and the owner drove us there after checking out as we had a lot of luggage. We then moved into town for a few days before continuing our travels . With the benefit of hindsight we should have gone in and out by tube

title: a short visit of my girlfriend on weekend
text: is a very nice, quiet location with very nice people (Mrs Brenda thank you again for hospitality), close to the tube station - thing which is very handle for downtown visit. breakfast is great, prepared on demand by mrs Brenda.

title: excellent value
text: We stayed as a couple for two nights, visting a nearby friend. The b&b is in an attractive and very well located property. We found everything to be very clean and well maintained. Although a cooked full English breakfast is not provided, it must be said that the continental breakfast that is, leaves nothing to be desired. The landlady is quiet friendly and charming. The Oaks is excellent!

title: Perfect location for trips to central London or M25 environs
text: Found initially by chance when looking for accommodation with parking close to tube for C London visits. Turned out to be run by a former work colleague, so even more perfect, lots of catch-up and chat! Almost like being at home! Secure parking, 5 mins walk to Southgate tube (30 mins to C London) plenty of eateries close by (safe and walkable, even by a single lady in the dark evenings) and a comfortable, even luxurious stay with lots of little touches (tissues, face cloth, plenty of toiletries, alarm clock, tea, coffee, water, comfy chairs) and many options for a good breakfast. (Even crumpets, gorgeous!). Lovely bathroom, pampered beautifully. And peaceful, only woken by a rather noisy dawn chorus! You would never believe you were minutes from a very busy high street. I stayed on both my outward and return journeys and it was a home from home!

title: Top class accomodation at very reasonable prices!
text: I take time out to write a review on this wonderful Guest House we've discovered in north London on the picadilly line into central London, which will from now on be our home away from home when in London. I am careful not to use the term B&B when I describe the place because it is so much more than a bed & breakfast! Lovely location, short walk &felt safe walking back from tube at night! Arriving early in London we were able to drop off our luggage and shown our room, keys were handed over & useful information given, also able to leave bags on day of departure to be picked up in pm as we had an evening flight, these extra touches make travel so much easier The bottled water was very much appreciated when we returned at night along with selection of goodies! There was also a fridge , sink, mini kitchen really, outside our room ideal i'm sure for families with young kids. Beds so comfortable, tv & free wifi brilliant! Breakfasts in the mornings were so enjoyable with Esra her friendliness , kindness & eagerness to please we so much appreciated ! Tony & Breda deserve top class ratings based on our experience!

title: Delightful, quiet neighborhood stay
text: My sister and I stayed in this lovely home for four days while sightseeing in London. My travel agent thought it was a bit far from the city, but we loved being in a quiet neighborhood where we could sleep with the windows open and awaken to birds singing. It took us just minutes to walk from the Southgate Underground Station to the Oaks. We appreciated the help from Breta and her family printing off maps, making arrangements for shows, and generally guiding us to various other sights. Our room was comfortable and the bathroom spacious, with morning light streaming in. We loved the fruit and various cereals for breakfast and especially the french press coffee. We had excellent accommodations but more than that we enjoyed our visit with the family.

title: Practically perfect in every way!
text: What a stunning place! Definitely not your average guest house! We booked 2 rooms for 2 nights. We had a double and a twin for our 2 teenage children. Both rooms were beautifully decorated, spotlessly clean and very comfortable. Our room had an ensuite shower room and the twin room had a huge luxury bathroom with a corner bath. Service was very warm, friendly and efficient. We were made to feel very welcome. Lovely breakfast too! Highly recommended. We are hoping to stay again in the future.

title: Fantastic, friendly, we'll be back soon!
text: We travelled to London stayed five nights at the Oaks recently, when our baby daughter needed a string of appointments at Great Ormond Street Hospital, and our choice of hotel couldn't have been more perfect. First of all, the hotel itself is just gorgeous. Although it's only a few minutes walk from Southgate station (with a direct run on the underground into the heart of London in around half an hour), it's at the end of a leafy cul-de-sac and faces a park, making it incredibly peaceful and giving lovely green views from the windows. The hotel has a gated car park which was an unexpected and wonderful surprise, as it meant we didn't have to worry about our car, the length of our stay. Breda and Tony gave us a gorgeous room up on the 2nd floor, which was nicely private but also had a mini kitchen outside on the landing - a fridge, microwave and sink that we could use, a dream come true for parents travelling with a young baby! The room was luxurious and spacious, and had a lovely table at the window which my partner was able to use for his work, along with the hotel's wifi. Our bathroom was very designer, with a lovely big walk-through shower. Fab! The bed was big and comfortable, in short it all felt very high quality and luxurious. Breakfasts were great as well. Breda and her team were such friendly hosts, and we really enjoyed chatting to them as we tucked into the superb spread, including the best fruit salads I've had in years. I haven't eaten so much fruit in a long time! They were all so lovely with our daughter too, and couldn't have been more helpful and attentive to all of our needs, providing a high chair and other bits and bobs that we needed, and really helping us through quite a stressful time by providing a real home from home, and lots of care and support for us all, as well as advice and general chats! The area is great, with restaurants a short walk away, and one night we had a takeaway delivered to the front door, after Breda provided a range of menus. It felt like a very safe walk to and from the hotel at night as well, which was very welcome. To summarise, we can't commend this hotel enough - my partner has already returned once for a business trip and we'll be back as a family whenever we have to return to the hospital. The Oaks is a great find - I'd recommend it to anyone!

title: Great hospitality
text: We will remember hosts for their generosity in giving us a ride to the train station with all of our baggage so early in the morning to make flight at Heathrow. A very comfortable and clean room with a great view from the third floor. Also, appreciated a delicious, early breakfast in order to get on the road.

title: Wonderful wonderful stay
text: My daughter, grandson and myself all living in the USA stayed at the Oaks for one night while traveling around England visiting family.
