We are British having lived in the USA for 18 years and my husband and I travel to the U.K. at least twice a year. I have to honestly say that in all this time, this is definitely one of the best guest houses/hotels that I have stayed in. The owner (We only met the wife) was extremely hospitable and the customer service at the guest house went way beyond any expectations we had. The breakfast offerings were absolutely superb. The room and bathroom was so clean and excellently furnished that even my two year old grandson commented on how comfortable his bed was. We actually made this reservation at the last moment as we were totally let down on our reservation with a hotel chain close to the Oaks venue, where we had a confirmation number but unfortunately no reservation

title: Excellent for the London tourist
text: Stayed at the oak guest house for 9 nights to do London as a tourist. Excellent, clean and very friendly. 5 mins walk from the underground station, 30 mins into centre of London. Southgate has plenty of shops, pubs and places to eat so quiet nights away from the centre are not a problem. Recommend the cherry tree pub and Italian restaurant in old Southgate 10 mins walk from the oak guest house.

title: Little Gem
text: Recently spent 2 nights at The Oaks with my wife, easily reached from the M1 or A1 roads or Kings Cross Station. The accommodation was everything we wanted, clean, very comfortable bed, quite, and a very adequate breakfast, the fruit salad that Breda prepares every morning is amazing, a plentiful supply of cereals, toast, croissants, cheeses & meat, eggs (no cooked breakfast) 5/10 minutes walk to Southgate tube station on the Piccadilly line and 30mins later arrive in central London. Can also recommend Miss Saigon and Les Miserables and the Thames Clipper to the Cutty Sark at Greenwich

title: Great Place to Stay
text: My husband and I stayed at this B&B with two other couples last May. The rooms were clean, the owners were kind, helpful and accommodating. We stayed for 4 days and enjoyed the quiet lane and the private atmosphere. It's proximity to the Southgate tube station was ideal. We will gladly stay there again next time we are in London.

title: Football trip in london.
text: Last weekend me and my partner booked a night in the oaks as part of a trip to the Emirates stadium. We chose the oaks as it was very close to southgate tube station on the piccadilly line. We were very pleased with the choice of b&b. The oaks guest house is in a fantastic location very close to the restuarants of southgate and 2-3 min walk to tube and bus station, down a very peacefull and quiet cul de sac. Its a beautiful, very clean and tidy house with all the facilities you could ask for in a room. Breda the owner is a lovely lady who went out of her way to help us.providing maps of the local area with directions to said tube station and restuarants. All in all we had a very good nights rest and a large breakfast with huge choice of foods.we both very much enjoyed ourselves. We Would highly recommend. Would i stay again? Yes and will be staying again. Next time ive got tickets to the football my first call will be to book a room at the oaks guest house.

title: Wonderful stay
text: My daughter and I recently stayed at The Oaks Guest House in June and it was by far one of the nicest places we stayed at. Our room was huge, comfortable and so clean. Bathroom was a nice size too. Our hosts went above and beyond in making us feel welcome and even gave us tips on how to get to places. Their home is very close to the London metro with a short walk from the stop. It was great to explore London by day and come home to a quiet home in a very quiet neighborhood and listen to the birds. A perfect ending to a busy day. Breakfast was great, you can't go wrong with a good cup of coffee, fresh fruit and croissants! Our hosts Breda and Tony were so nice, we really did not want to leave. On our next trip back we will stay longer.

title: great B&B
text: I stayed here with my elderly parents for 5 nights in June. We loved it! It was very clean and Breda was a fantastic host! It's at the end of a quiet street and very peaceful. We found it a nice place to come at the end of the day to relax away from the bustle of downtown London. Pros: *Breda and her family do a great job running the place and are super helpful and friendly. We were leaving early in the morning, before breakfast was normally served, but Breda still had breakfast for us and even drove us to the tube station with our luggage because she had a few minutes before breakfast started. So nice! *breakfasts were very good--Breda had a cheese basket that I was totally obsessed with and the coffee was good *quiet neighborhood *the bed was very comfortable *lots of storage space (drawers, wardrobe) in bathroom *large tiled bathroom *house itself was very nice Cons: *None, really. We were very pleased. Random Things, including Location and Tube Stuff: *If you aren't familiar with London, I think it's helpful to know a little bit about the logistics of this location. It is definitely NOT city center but it IS on the tube line so it's still central London, I believe--London is just THAT BIG. If you want a location where you can walk outside and see Big Ben, this isn't it. We basically had a choice between staying right downtown in a small, questionable hotel or staying further out in a place that was nice and that we were confident in, so we chose here and were very happy with it. The advantage of it is that it feels like it's in a town--it's definitely in a neighborhood--so it's calm and quiet, which we like. There are a number of restaurants around and a grocery store near the tube station. So it's all about what your priorities are. To give you some general idea, it's about a 10 minute walk to the tube station. Southgate is almost at the end of the Picadilly line--about 27 minutes to Kings Cross (fyi, sometimes the Picadilly Line ends at Arnos Grove, the stop before Southgate, so you have to get out and switch trains there to get to Southgate. Normally you just make sure you get on a Picadilly train that goes all the way to the end, but on a few longer trips they switched the endpoint midline so that's just an fyi). We allowed about 45 minutes to most places in the city center by the time you switch lines. It was about an hour and a half from Heathrow but except for the switch at Arnos Grove it was direct and super super easy. From Gatwick we went to King's Cross and Picadilly Line then caught a train to Gatwick--it took about 2 hours to do all of that but I think the train was having some major issues that day--I think it's normally a lot shorter but do allow time just in case). *The family room can house 3, but one is on a sofa bed. I think it's probably best for two adults and a child rather than 3 adults. We knew this was the case going in, so it was fine--just an fyi. Breda said that at some point they were hoping to have a room with three single beds, so if that's available that might be the way to go if you have 3 adults. Overall we wholeheartedly recommend this B&B!

title: 5 night stay near London
text: My family of four shared two rooms while visiting London. Our rooms were clean and lovely and the breakfasts were great. Loved the ladies at breakfast - especially Lorraine (sp?)! It was convenient to the Underground for our visits into the city, but away from the hustle and bustle which I liked. Wi-Fi in our room was great. The only thing, which I realize was a bit out of their control, was some construction that was being done on the place. Overall, it didn't make a huge impact on our stay. Another plus...they let me do a load of laundry for which I CAN'T THANK YOU ENOUGH!!! Would definitely stay there again.

title: Great place to stay in London
text: We stayed for almost ten nights at Oaks. It is in such a lovely part of London, away from the busy center of town. It is very easy to begin to think of it as home. Breda and Tony are such simple and generous people, that you don't need to worry about anything. We wanted to know if there was a laundromat nearby and there wasn't one but Breda let us use her washing machine which was so generous of her. Oaks is in a lovely quiet neighbourhood and also placed very close to the underground station called Southgate which is on the Picadilly line. So getting around is absolutely no problem.There are many places to eat very close to the underground station. Even if you get back late, you have a pretty good choice of cuisines. There is a microwave and basic dishes and spoons right outside the room which proves very helpful if you just want to have a snack and beer. The only downside is that the regular cleaning of the room is a little slipshod. We will certainly stay there everytime we go back.

title: Excellent
text: What a wonderful guest house. With a very friendly reception by our hostess Breda. The rooms are large and well fitted out. A short 5 minute walk will take you to Southgate underground station and 37 minutes later you are in Central London. So it is convenient if you are planing weekend in London. There are plenty of restaurants in the area also within a comfortable 10 minute walk. There is a large secure car park as well. All in all this is a wonderful place to stay.

title: A Terrific Place to Stay in London
text: Short version: My wife and I stayed 7 nights in late May and we thought The Oaks was terrific! Long version: The Oaks Guesthouse is quiet and comfortable. The owner-operators are a married couple, Breda and Tony

title: Excellent stay
text: This was not our 1st time in The Oaks and wont be our last either. This time we stayed for 22 nights and we have been more than happy with our stay. Comfortable and clean room. Delicious breakfast every morning with a wide selection of breads, eggs, etc...but most importantly Breda & Tony are such good hosts, always willing to help with a smile....lovely stay. It is a 5 minute walk to the Southgate Tube Station so very convenient for visits to Central London. A great place to stay and I highly recommend it.

title: So convienent
text: It is so close to Southgate tube station, which is on the Piccadilly line which goes straight into Central London. The Guest House is extremely comfortable with plenty of parking. So easy to reach from the M25. Leave the car and use the Tube. I heartily recommend it.

title: A lovely find
text: My birthday present from daughter was an overnight stay in London. To travel by train is unaffordable so we decided to look for accommodation with easy access from the motorways and parking. The Oaks fitted that bill and more besides. What marks this place out is the quality of decor, furniture and bedding alongside the cleanliness. It is luxury standard. We only left yesterday and already today I have recommended it to someone at work! The breakfast is lovely too, just perfect. We'll be back!

title: What a Shambles
text: Stayed here for two nights - the first time at a Holiday Inn Group Hotel - and the last. Nowhere in their advertising does it state that the rooms only have showers in the bathrooms - we prefer a full bathroom. We were given a "better" room at the back of the hotel - Glad I was not in a "worse" one. Very small with hardly any storage space but the bed was quite comfortable. Breakfast on the first morning was of a reasonable quality but the food was lukewarm and cold plates did not help this. We went down for breakfast at 8.45pm and there was no hot food left and we were told that they had run out!!! There was no bread or croissants either. The staff were very good and pleasant and very apologetic - we left the hotel very disgruntled and hungry. I complained to their head office and was given 5000 points then 2000 points as they obviously thought that I would stay in one of their hotels again. The points would not even cover a cup of coffee!! I was told that being as the breakfast was complimentary we had received value for money - I think not! Their attitude was that they were doing me a favour in allowing us to stay there - we have stayed in better Travelodges which can be very good value and at least they have a bath in their bathrooms. Very poor customer care from "above". Very surprised at their attitude as running out of food is completely unacceptable in any hotel.

title: Nice and clean
text: Had a relaxing stay here. Staff were very good and the room I was in was a good size and clean. Can get a little noisy at night as it is on a main road but all in all it was a good stay. Must say that the food in the restaurant was very cheap and very good. Would stay again

title: Excellent quality hotel in a great location for London
text: I'm a business traveller who works in central London. I've been struggling to find a reasonably priced, clean and high standard hotel within easy travel distance to the city centre until now. The room was furnished to a high standard, it was very clean, very quiet and the staff were very helpful. I didn't have any food on this occasion although breakfast was included in the rate. At £82,50 a night, I will be back next time I'm in London for sure.

title: Wonderful stay
text: I stayed there for a night and I had a wonderful time. The toom was clean, had wifi. Unfortunately the breakfast wasn't that brilliant. The selection could've been better considering where it is located.

title: Nice quiet
text: The hotel is quite good and the breakfast more than adequate 4 stars definitely. Only think don't like is exhorbitant car parking charge of 20 per day nicely located sound. proof .big plus as we other budget hotels can be noisy

title: Not great!
text: We must have ended up in an un-refurbished room as it was extremely tired and doesn't match some of the new flashy photographs on their website. There were a number of dirty areas and scuff marks all over the room. Parts of the shower were missing, but still functional. You aren't far from Stratford station and the shopping centre. It's easy to get to central London from here too. There's a handy Tesco express just down the road a little. We constantly smelled cigarette smoke in our bathroom. We mentioned this in the morning, received an apology but no more. We really did find it most unpleasant! It was good enough for a bed for a night but not longer.

title: Excellent stsy
text: Stayed at the holiday inn for 3 nights and couldn't fault it. Its only a short walk to Westfield Stratford shopping centre and the tube stop is also at Westfield. Only 15 mins into central London by tube. Room was clean and comfortable with tea and coffee provided. The bathroom looked new and the shower was nice and powerful. Breakfast was fine too. I would definitely stay here again

title: Very impressed for a short business stay
text: I stayed at this hotel for 2 nights and can definitely recommend. Location is on high street Stratford and about 7-10min walk from Stratford underground. On check a nice touch, due to being a priority member, received a free alcholic drink or extra points. Chose the free drink :-) . Wifi is free throughout - other hotels take note ! Rooms are very clean, feel fresh, functional with tea and coffee, flat screen TV, bathroom with shower. Restauant area is fine with really good food for snacks and evening meals served quickly. Breakfast is relatively limited for each offering, but suffucuent - toast, pastries, hot food, fruit, fruit joices and hot drinks. Safes available and vending machine with travel items and food/drink.Staff are very friendly and very professional. Only down side was the fact it was London Fasion week and the rate for every hotel had doubled so I had to pay c£200+ per night for this hotel which was double the normal rate, but in line with every other hotel that week.

title: Trip to London
text: We've (family with 2 kids in two rooms, one to the street, one to the back yard) visited London for the first time and used HIE by friends recommendation - well done, they didn't lied !!!!! Hotel is very nice, clean & proper, , staff is always friendly and very helpful for all purposes, rooms are spaciousness, breakfast with various choices, hot/cold, fresh fruits (!!!!) - absolutely o.k.

title: Very good accommodations
text: Hi I love unashamed three star accommodations So cleaver this hotel - super service, great rooms and comfy beds, nice breakfast And, close to the Olympic Village, Transport nodes and Stratford Centre I so enjoyed my four day stay Well done and thanks!

title: Recommended for a short stay in london
text: Close to many London attractions. The staff were fantastic, friendly and superbly helpful. All areas were clean and the room was clean and very comfortable. Breakfast was good quality and continually replenished. EVERY member of staff I dealt with, made it a pleasure to stay here.

title: Excellent service and character
text: Great location for the Olympics, stayed there for 4 nights and am more than happy to recommend. Breakfast was full English, very nice even though I am not fan of english breakfast. Staff were first class, willing to go the extra mile. A shout out to Joel at front desk who moved us to a better room when we complained about our bathroom. The room was very nice and clean, but A/C can be a bit loud. Mind that this location is 20 minutes away from Oxford Circus by tube. Westfield shopping centre is around the corner, with both high-street shops and lots of eateries.

title: For a basic hotel remarkably good
text: Stayed one night for business with my only complaint being that it’s a bit of a walk to the Tube...10/15 minutes. Despite that it’s clean and the staff are well trained and friendly. A good breakfast spread and efficient and friendly service. Not too expensive either.

title: Ottimo qualità/prezzo
text: good position (5/10 minutes on foot to the underground station, 20 minutes by underground to arrive in London downtown). Very clean, very good breakfast. Room space sufficient for a short holiday. Helpful and kind staff. A terrible bed, mattress too soft!

title: Perfectly suited for us
text: We stayed here for 4 days as a start for a 5 week holiday taking in Europe. The Hotel is within 5-10 minutes walk of the Underground and provided us with a great opportunity to get some 'impromptu' exercise. We did have nice weather though so I wonder whether this would be handy if it was freezing or raining! The rooms were comfortable although they do not provide a mini fridge. This was initially a problem as I require weekly medication that MUST be refrigerated. Reception staff were brilliant - explained the medication issue which was then promptly stored in the bar fridge until we left. Teh downstairs breakfast area/dining was fabulous and having a couple of kids with us made it easy to eat then get them to bed at a reasonable time. All the staff were great - very friendly and nothing was an issue. Managed to get checked in earlier than the usual check in time which was handy given we arrived at Heathrow at 6 am after flying from Australia. There weren't too many convenience stores around to purchase snacks for when relaxing in the room but I gather this will change given it is the perfect location to stay for the upcoming Olympics.

title: Poor
text: The air conditioner is centrally operated. This means that an overheated room in winter cannot be cooled down as all settings are set to "hot". Do not book if you find overheated rooms unbearable. Staff ok Location noisy and prone to police sirens.

title: Perfect location for Westfield
text: My mum and I stayed at this hotel for a recent shopping trip. It is within walking distance of the shopping centre (about 10 minutes) and it clean, spacious and good value for money.

title: awful beds
text: I stayed for 2 weeks while on business trip in London. It s clean. But - the beds were the worst I have ever slept on. The matrac was so soft that actually, when I sat in the middle of the bed, both ends went up. I dont suffer from the back pain but these two weeks were the hell for me as I had a terrible back pain. Once I got back home - all went away. The breakfast. The choice is: the cheddar, the youghurt, the scramled egg, the jam and the fruits. After a week I started buying myself my own breakfast as I was that bored of these. I would appreciate at least a little bit of a ham for a change! Tbh, it was not the only Holiday Inn I ve stayed in but this one was the only one dissapointing.

title: Nice Location
text: Been there numerous time for business trip. one of the best location when travelling to London. Located right beside the huge mall with lots of eatery. And just next to Stratford station which is convenient. Pricing is reasonable also compare to Central London.

title: Good and affordable hotel
text: A good and affordable hotel close to Stratford station, home field of West Ham and Westfield shoppingcenter. Breakfast wasn't lile at a more expensive hotel, but acceptable. Rooms were clean. No complaints.

title: Parking
text: Spent one night here as we had got tickets to see a show, hence the hotel was booked and paid for by someone else. As i checked in i needed to pay 20 POUND for the parking onsite. I was informed that as i was paying for the parking with a different card than the one that paid for the room that the other card would be refunded and my card charged for the room. Now, i work in a top class hotel and have never heard anything like it. How hard is it to just charge me the 20 POUND for parking and leave the booking as it should be ( a present). I had to get the person who paid for the room on the phone to sort it out. The hotel itself was really good and the bed was very comfy. Breakfast was as expected. As a whole the hotel was good, just the person on the front desk being awkward.

title: Would stay again
text: I stayed here over the weekend for a shopping trip. It is within 10 min walk to Westfield Shopping Centre & Stratford Station. Staff were so helpful as my friend forgot to actually make us a booking. They charged us reasonable rates that you would expect to pay. Rooms were clean and spacious, the hairdryer did not work and the reception staff got me another one with no fuss at all. Very accommodating hotel with pleasant and professional staff - esp Bartosz who joked with us and went out of his way to help us. I would stay here again - no problem at all!! Breakfast was basic but nice - esp for being free.

title: Excellent all rounder
text: I never write reviews but was so impressed with this hotel I thought I would make the effort! We had a queen room which was a perfect size and in excellent clean condition with nice decor. Staff were lovely, food delicious. Only about a 10 min tube ride to Liverpool street and the tube station is right next to hotel. Can't praise it enough, will definitely come back. We got a dab deal too, only £94 for room and breakfast.

title: Decent stay great staff
text: Stayed here for a 2 night weekend family stay. Arrived around 1pm and the reception staff were very polite and helpful during check in. Room was on the 2nd floor and seemed a bit smaller than ones we have stayed in before in HI Expresses. Bed was very comfortable and the shower was nicely powerful. Breakfast was the usual fare but was very busy and I think the layout made it a bit chaotic. Had a late drink in the bar each night and was ok. Free wifi was included. 2 minute walk to the DLR and about 10 minutes to Westfield. Not a lot in the immediate area but good place for staying if exploring East London. Staff were excellent throughout the stay (including the under pressure breakfast staff) and made us feel very welcome. Might want to review the layout at breakfast to make it run a bit smoother but other than that great.

title: Good business hotel
text: Return every year when attending WTM. Good value for money hotel. Would recommand this when you are attending a fair at the Excel. Friendly staff and good value for money. Rooms are ok. Bathroom need an update.

title: Faultless
text: We were warmly received by Vanessa at the Reception. Stayed in one of the new rooms on the 6th floor. I enjoyed every bit of my stay. The room was more than standard. Shining bathroom. Sparkling clean with a massive television, safe, tea and coffee making facilities, safe, iron and ironing board, hairdryer. I was super comfortable. The breakfast was excellent. Nothing to fault. Various options full english, cereal, hot drinks. This is included in the room rate. It was too good i had both 😁 If you are stuck for time, there is the option to grab and go. Service was faultless. There is the dinner option as well but i didnt try it. Its a 7 minutes walk from stratford station which is super convenient. Theres is a Tesco express 5 minutes walk from the left of the hotel. Currently, there is some refurbishment going on but I am definitely coming back and referring Holiday Inn Express to the world.

title: Great Location for the Olympic Park
text: Great location if you're attending any functions at or near the Olympic Park, Great room sized, nice shower, tea & coffee available in the room. Probably the first hotel that I've stayed at that actually has plenty of easily accessible sockets including next to the bed. Great value for money. Only downside, could do with more variety for breakfast, and a quicker turn-around than 15 minutes to deep-fry some sausages. We stayed in a family room, so we got a queen bed and a sofa that opened info another bed, it did the job for 1 night. Would stay again if going to the Olympic Park

title: Long Weekend
text: We spent three nights at the hotel and would definitely stay again. The hotel is in a convenient location with good facilities. Breakfast was included in the price and offers a buffet style of hot and cold food. Our room was spacious, clean and comfortable. Staff were friendly and efficient. Looking forward to going back in the future as it is a good base for exploring London close to bus and rail links.

title: Very nice hotel
text: Stayed 2 nights and found the hotel very clean and the staff were very pleasant and helpful its about a 15 min walk to westfield shopping centre,taxis are easily booked and cost about £5 to westfield the room was very spacious and it was a joy to stay here.

title: Clean, tidy and does the job
text: Location wise was ok - a short walk to the Stratford high St (DLR), probably a 15 min walk to the Westgate centre and Stratford's main tube station. Rooms were clean though and had everything you needed. Staff seemed a little over-keen (took about 15 minutes to check in, mainly because the staff wanted to tell us a million things - including when our wing was built etc... - 90% of which we didn't care about). But breakfast was included (and was pretty reasonable quality) so that was a definite plus. The only thing which really harmed our experience was a fire alarm at around 6am (on the weekend), which we couldn't get back to sleep after. The Management did pop a note under the door apologising for the disturbance but would have been nice for them to have done a bit more (maybe a free drink, discount off the next stay etc...). Other than that was pretty good if not amazing.

title: BEST VALUE HOTEL IN LONDON!!
text: Stayed 2 nights in this hotel & would recommend it highly! We arrived in the UK early in the morning at 9am & arrivied to Stratford by bus (National Express) & was dropped off at the Westfield Shopping Centre .. hotel was 5 min walk away, went to drop our bags off & the lovely lady on reception told us we could check in as our room was ready & we could have complimentary breakfast that morning aswell! .. after travelling all night, we were delighted! Room was lovely, standard but for the price we payed.. best value yet! Bed was comfortable, don't know why people are so picky like a review below saying the beds are too soft.. i had a great nights sleep & didn't fall in the middle! haha! Breakfast in the morning was fab.. great choice from cereal, fruit, croissants, buns, full english breakkie incl tea/coffee & juice. All staff are so friendly & helpful.. great credit to the hotel! The metro/train station was right beside the shopping center so again just a mere 5 min walk.. around 8 stops to get to oxford street so bout half hour.. perfect location & hotel overall... will be back very soon :)

title: One night business stop-over
text: This hotel is pretty new so you can expect a clean and attractive hotel at a reasonable cost. I had food at the hotel as there wasn't much local. The food wasn't bad - typical bar menu

title: Disappointed
text: Stayed at the holiday inn Stratford last time which was fab and would recommend to anyone but to our disappointment we got there and were told we'd booked the holiday inn express in Stratford !!!! You need to make this clearer having 2 hotels in the same area ! So we had to drag our luggage 10 mins away to basically a horrible drab part of town and small pokey room . To say I was miffed was an understatement 😡 My poor boyfriend had booked it and thought it was the same one we stayed last time . There's no mirror over the desk/ dressing table to do your makeup which was bizzarre and the breakfast was carnage and the worst I've ever had so we ended up just taking a croissant upto our room the second day . View from room was awful and only one plug socket on one side of the bed ! Won't be staying there again .

title: Value for money
text: I had to chose this hotel due to last minute business travel. Like other express hotel this hotel has no frills but fulfills your basic needs. This Hotel is close to Stratford station and Westfield shopping center which is 15 minutes walk. My only disappointment was with the breakfast which had same fixed menu on all days which made mornings very monotonous. I guess they can do so more options with b/f menu. Right for those looking for economical accommodation, there is not much for families and children to do.

title: Uncomfortable bed
text: Decent stay. However the bed is very firm and the too small (I am used to a king). Also the room very hot and air con didn't work/make any difference. Breakfast was ok. Decent selection of hot food. However, went to get more food and not only had our nearly full cups of coffee and juice been cleared away but someone else sat where we were!!

title: Probably the best ever value for money Hotel ever in the world
text: like new ..well run ..good bedrooms.. great showers ..after a knackering day working for the Olympics this is what you need...i stay a lot in these Hotels and this was good . Breakfast was ok not great however

title: Below average facilities
text: I stayed here for 2 days in October, 2018. The room was good, but lacked basic facilities. One of the receptionist was rude and wouldn't answer clearly to anything I asked him. He would give a blunt reply to anything that we ask. And for water I had to go down to reception and drink. Breakfast was above average. But everyday, the menu was same. There was no change to the breakfast menu. If we are staying there for a longer time, breakfast would be a concern.

title: Had a great stay
text: 2 nights, double bed, 5th floor, £180. I stayed here for the weekend with my partner. Upon arrival I was informed that we'd booked a twin room instead of a double, a lady at reception offered to and switched us to a double room which was nice. Breakfast was plentiful and tasty. Serve yourself buffet with sausages, bacon, scrambled egg, toast, beans, fruit, cereal etc. Very nice and good to fill up on before a day exploring. Great location, was quiet and only a short walk from the bus/train/tube stations and very close to the shopping centre also. Very happy with our stay and would reccommend it.

title: Rooms ok but overpriced terrible food
text: Stayed a week room ok but very stuffy. Staff friendly enough but very expensive. Ate dinner one night not impressed at all and we both had terrible upset stomachs following day. Worst part was breakfast, in a word shocking dry hard scrambled eggs tough fatty bacon cold beans. Certainly not recommended whidh I'd gone to premier inn

title: Good hotel in good location
text: My wife and I got a last-minute deal on this hotel that was around £40 cheaper than the standard rate - not bad!!! A decent location not far from both Stratford station and Stratford High Street Docklands Light Railway station, we were warmly received by the staff. They were helpful in advising us of somewhere to eat given we arrived late and the restaurant was closed. The room itself was fine - spacious, usual tea and coffee making facilities and a clean, reasonable sized bathroom. The only downside was the bed mattress felt like a glorified quilt and was spongy-soft - not so good. Breakfast the following morning was good - a varied choice to cater for all tastes! Whilst the food wasn't 'top-end', given it was included in the price it was fine. The Olympic Park was a short stroll away - alas parts of it are being flattened given the games are now over - as is the vast Westfield Shopping Centre for all shopaholics! Would definitely stay again - a good option if you don't fancy the rip-roaring racket of London but want to be in striking distance!

title: Have yet to be disappointed
text: I've stayed with friends 3 times in the past year and would highly recommend it. Excellent value for money, friendly staff and the breakfast is reasonable. Most importantly, the room facilities are looked after well and my sleeps were completely uninterrupted. I forgot to bring toothpaste but the staff were happy to give us some. Also, there was no iron in the room but there was an ironing room on the floor above so it wasn't a massive issue. Some of the other guests could have had a lesson in manners when at the breakfast buffet but that's no fault of the hotel.

title: A nice hotel near Olympic Park
text: We were trying to keep the cost of visiting London down so, we picked a hotel in east London. The rooms were clean and efficient(no frills). The breakfast had something for everyone and the staff was very helpful to us! I'd stay here again!

title: Good for what it is
text: If you want a reasonably priced room in this area of London, this is not bad at all. The rooms are fairly spacious and the hotel is well maintained. The bathroom only has a shower and an all purpose soap/shampoo/body wash dispenser. But the towels are large and thick! I've had a lot worse in smarter more expensive places. Breakfast is ok but you eat it in a canteen atmosphere, some of us had to virtually sit in reception. If you need to be here on business this is fine and only 6-7 minutes walk from the Westfield centre with restaurants and shopping

title: Great stay
text: Stayed here with my son who is living in London, close to Stratford tube station and Westfield, few mins walk. Hotel room clean and everything we needed, breakfast was lovely, so much choice and was able to check out later than required without a problem, will def stay again.

title: Weekend visit, great location
text: I had to visit London to go see a friend in Hospital. Another friend found me this hotel which as it turns out was an excellent location for my weekend requirements. The bus to the hospital stopped right across the road. The staff were lovely, very friendly and helped with directions. There was a Gala Bingo just 5 minutes walk away for evening entertainment.

title: I've been to better
text: It took forever to book in as they had lost our reservation, despite giving confirmation details to them. There is parking available but at a cost of £12. The bedroom was ok. Comfortable bed and basic facilities available. The bathroom was a let down. There was no bath and it was rigged up for disabled customers, which posed a problem. There was a very sensitive emergency cord hanging in the middle of the shower which, when knocked, alarms reception. If you accidently knock this, expect many calls from the reception desk! Overall, I was disappointed with what we got for the money...

title: over-priced even for the city....
text: The website suggest great things...I was there on business the room was cramped and very noisy with mould on the shower ceiling......There were also horrid smells from the kitchen, more like a burger wagon than hotel. Food was average but definitely not value for money, on a positive note they did let me watch The Great British Bake Off in the bar! Not as close to the Olympic park as advertised either....

title: Great Hotel
text: I was visiting our offices in the vacinity of London Liverpool Street Station, and needed somewhere out of the city (so cheap),but still close enough. 15 mins walk from tube/national rail station, good service when I got there and even a view of the olympic park (from the second floor, through the adjacent tower blocks. Would definately recomend this hi.express.

title: Sleepless Night Hotel, a more accurate name
text: The service is average with a nice and committed staff. Breakfast limited, food quite average, fairly good size room but not very confortable but above all, NOISY, Very very NOISY. The price, as expected in London is quite high but the value for money is a rip-off. I won´t ever come back !!!!

title: Great location, hotel and staff
text: Stayed here for 2 night on a weekend with family. This hotel is ideally located (10 mins walk) from the Westfield Shopping Centre and Stratford railway station and underground. We flew into Stansted and the National Express bus (£14 return and takes 50 mins) drops you off outside Westfield. The hotel itself is all you would expect from Holiday Inn - good clean rooms, a more than adequate breakfast with ample choice and extremely friendly and efficient staff. Excellent value for money and would most definitley use again on our next visit.

title: A clean, modern hotel within easy reach of Stratford
text: The Holiday Inn Express, Stratford was built in time for the London 2012 Olympics, so still has a clean, tidy appearance. My friend, visiting from the USA, and I booked a twin bed room and were lucky enough to be placed on the 5th floor at the back, looking onto the Olympic Stadium. TIP: On check in try and ask for a 'rear room' as these look onto the park (slightly obscured by a building) and then cuts down on the traffic noise from Stratford High Street. The breakfast was a typical continental/full English buffet, included in the price. However on the Sunday morning the staff were a bit lapse in ensuring there was enough cutlery and one of the two toasters didn't work. Otherwise, a very nice hotel. Only picked it as it was cheap but I'm glad I did!

title: Friendly staff
text: A very warm welcome from friendly polite receptionist,explaining procedure and direction to room, she went out of her way to lend us her umbrella when pouring down with rain. Rooms were suitable for us, beds comfy, bed linen and towels all nice and clean. All facilities in bedroom and bathroom were fine.Breakfast was very good, a wide selection to choose from. Very near to station and underground. Within walking distance to Westfield shopping centre. The only fault I would say was noise from main road, but were not too bothered by this. Overall a pleasant and enjoyable stay. Will definitely stay again.

title: Impressed
text: Come here for a training course which was located in the hotel, everything is clean and tidy, with the staff consistently buzzing around cleaning up after guests, food is great the asparagus soup was amazing, the only problem I had was to decide whether I sleep on the firm pillow or the soft? The hotel is located a couple of minutes walk away from the Olympic Park.

title: Well connected Holiday Inn Express for Olympic Park and London
text: Stayed at the Holiday Inn Express, Stratford for a 3 night business / leisure trip in October 2013. The hotel is conveniently located just a five minute walk from Stratford Station (train, underground, DLR and bus depot), and particularly well connected to Central London by the Central Line Underground. Upon arrival the staff were very friendly and welcoming and the check-in process was efficient. The request for a rear facing quiet room was also met. The room was spacious, clean and well serviced. The beds were comfortable, with nice duvets, fluffy pillows and afforded a great night's sleep. There was also a double sofa bed in the room. The bathroom was also very clean and spacious and we had a room with a very effective shower. Shower gel, shampoo and hand soap are available in dispensers. Tea and coffee making facilities were in the room and a nice coffee lounge was available near the lifts on our floor, offering further supplies of tea and coffee and a comfortable place to sit. The breakfast was fairly standard and comprehensive, with a small supply of hot items (scrambled eggs, sausages and baked beans), cereals, bread, rolls and toast, cheese, sliced meats, fruit and yoghurt. More than enough to set one up for a busy morning in London! Would I return or recommend this hotel to my family and friends? Yes, highly likely!

title: Average Holiday Inn Express
text: From the outside this looks like a fairly new hotel, but clearly it cannot be. I busily adjusted my stylish aircon/cum heating system only to discover that it responds zilch to my temp settings. Result: a pretty hot room during an unusually warm period in October. They have wifi included in the room rate, it's one of the reasons why I tend to book hotels in their chain. This place has a bizarre system that doesn't recognize your smartphone/pc etc, so you need to re-login all the time. Mightily annoying. The breakfast is included in the room rate, too. It's basic, but it does the trick. Given the rate I paid during my stay, I thought I paid way too much for what this establishment is. I ended up in a room with two small single beds. Terrible. They had soap spenders in the bathroom that basically disintegrated when you looked at them. The most pointless contraption I have ever seen. Location wise, well, I wanted to stay close to Stratford station for reasons to do with my travels. You can't beat this place, except perhaps for the better (and even more expensive at this time of the year) Holiday Inn at the Stratford Westfield shopping centre. Unlike others I experienced zero noise issues, likely to do with the fact that my room was at the back of the property. No complaints here. I suspect, for what you're being charged here, you should be able to get a better deal, given their room rates, elsewhere in London.

title: Best chef and sraff
text: If you want a service par excellence, with 5 star chef, then this is it... Yes for real - Syfur is service personified, can you believe this man made me one of the best vegetable curries ever, he did off menue and with skill, dedication and attention that I've not had staying in central London. Give it a go, be clear about your expectations (talk to the team) and you will not be disappointed.

title: Pity it's so far out
text: IHG member. Spending a weekend in London found this IHG hotel by far the best price and fully inclusive of breakfast and free wifi. From booking in, through drinks at the bar, and checking out... what friendly and informative staff. A most comfortable spacious rooom (626). I cannot fault this hotel, probably the best Express Inn I have stayed in.....I wonder if people realise they are franchised. The only downside is that although well served by tube and bus it is almost an hour to central London.

title: Good value for money
text: Good value for money. I stayed here for the Fleetwood Mac concert. It is a little walk about 5-10 minutes from the Westfield Shopping Mall. Please don't get this hotel confused by the other Holiday Inn which is located at the Westfield Shopping Mall. Very close to the O2 arena about 10 minute taxi ride which will cost you £20 each way. But honestly if you're going to the O2 use the underground as you'll get stuck in typical London traffic and it's much cheaper. The room was a good size and a variety of choice for breakfast

title: As Expected
text: It was a Holiday Inn on a major high street. Everything was just as expected - breakfast was better than expected. Staff were great. Great location for Westfield and tube for O2. Will definitely be back.

title: Gut for business travellers
text: The most important thing for business travellers: I had great fast wifi the whole day long in my room. You have to pay something if you transfer too much data, but the price is acceptable. The room had a nice working desk at the window and otherwise was really nice with a TV with HDMI and USB slots. The only thing I didn't appreciate so much was that the water faucet only gives you a few rays of water, maybe good for nature, but not so good if you have a limited amount of time to wash. The breakfast was standard good, not bad and not extraordinary. It was, despite being at a road, very quiet with a thickly carpeted floor, so I slept very well on the comfy bed. It is about 15 min. walk from the huge Stratford shopping centre and you should not mix it up with the Holiday Inn that is inside this shopping centre. I didn't mind the walk though, there are a lot of nice, also upper class restaurants in the shopping centre and the walk back to the HI Express was a welcome one. There is also a tube station at the Stratford shopping centre and Canary Wharf, or business city, is very close, both by tube or taxi. I can highly recommend it for any business traveller who has business in Canary Wharf

title: Good place to stay
text: We stayed for several nights in April 2013 and are glad we did. Got a great rate by booking online a few months in advance. The rooms are a bit small with the sofa bed for our 11 year old daughter, but that is a minor issue as the room was great value and kids stay free. Breakfast was good, and it's only a 10 minute walk from Westfield Stratford/Stratford tube station (there's also a bus stop about 50m up the road and plenty of buses to Stratford as well). Only 15-20 minutes into London central areas by tube. Would happily reurn.

title: Ask for a room at the back of the hotel
text: never had any problems staying at the holiday inn express. They always give you a good sized room and bath room and really helpful staff. We were very lucky that we had a room at the back of the hotel so didn't hear any traffic, we all had good night sleeps. I think they should offer you more for hot food at breakfast, but I know this is a country wide thing, and that they need to say the same for all of their hotels. Car park at the back is really secure if a bit expensive and on a first come basis. Overall really happy with Holiday inn

title: Great for o2, fantastic value for money
text: Was very pleased with the hotel itself which was very nice and the location which was very close to Westfield and stratford shopping centres, the underground and DLR. The rooms were very nice and similar style to premier inn. We had a decent view of a school so not noisy due to staying at weekend. Noticed the hotel provided ear plugs if the room was too noisy though. Along with free essentials like toothpaste if you forgot.The breakfast was very good too, and free! Fresh fruit, yoghurt, cereals, sausage, bacon, scrambled eggs, beans, toast, croissants and muffins. As well as fruit juices three different kinds, a coffee machine with all different coffees and tea. We stayed there to go to concert at O2 arena which on the jubilee line at stratford underground (10 mins walk) took around 8 mins once you arrived was right outside the back of the station (3 stops away). I recommend an Oyster card and using the underground it's the easiest way to get about to most attractions using the jubilee line. Our room 413 was very good.

title: Recommended: Good value for money!
text: + most important: clean + very friendly and helpful staff + big room + 5-10min walking to the next tube station (Stratford) with many connections + good breakfast buffet included (nothing special but full English breakfast: beans, sausages, scrambled egg,

title: Great Hotel for the Price, Friendly service
text: It's the staff at this hotel that make it outstanding. Very helpful and extremely friendly. If they didn't have the answer to a question, they got it for you. The rooms are quite small compared to American hotel rooms, but then again, that's usual in England. Breakfast was good and enough to get you through well into the day. Locations is a little out of the way, and not in the greatest of neighborhoods, but we felt safe walking there at night. The subway was just a couple of blocks away and there is a good shopping center just outside it. The bus will take you right in front of the hotel I recommend this hotel for a fairly inexpensive and very welcoming stay.

title: Very good for what it is
text: This is a basic hotel with modest facilities, but very good for its type. I wanted a comfortable but inexpensive London hotel for a one night business trip. Central London was stupidly expensive in early summer, so I took a chance on this one. The hotel was very clean and comfortable and the restaurant for dinner and breakfast was fine, not gourmet, but fine. The location is within easy walking distance of the Westfield shopping Centre and the Olympic Park, so great for those, otherwise it's not great. But it's also walking distance of Stratford Station and that offers pretty good access into London, avoid the rush hour unless you don't mind pretending to be a sardine. Overall, this is a very good hotel for the price they charge and I have to say the staff were really working hard at being attentive and giving good service, so a special mention for them.

title: Decent Enough
text: Recently stayed at this hotel while attending an event at the Excel. It's well placed for this as it's an easy run down the DLR to the Excel and isn't as expensive as some of the hotels in the immediate vicinity of the exhibition centre. I enter London through Kings Cross station and it was a pretty straight forward tube journey from here to Stratford (one change if I recall correctly). The staff I dealt with were pleasant, the room was fine and the bathroom clean which are the main things I look for. I didn't eat here but on arriving back at the hotel after they had stopped serving food they seemed happy to help other guests arrange takeaway meals. The only thing I mark the hotel down on is the breakfast, it's nice to see it included in the price (so many of these hotels charge extra for it) but it was horrid. Scrambled eggs weren't nice, beans cold and sausages indifferent. Still, I didn't visit for the food so was still fairly happy with my stay.

title: Very disappointed
text: Incredibly unhelpful staff. I am a company secretary for a very loyal client of Holiday Inn. We called the Hotel in Stratford as the Hotel had incorrectly accepted a parcel for the hotel down the road despite having no guest staying there under that name. Then after calling twice and speaking to a male with a very strong French accent who did not understand what i was saying i was also put on hold and disconnected.When i did get through they refused to deliver said parcel down the road to the correct hotel. I believe this to be a shocking experience and most certainly will ensure we do not use this basic hotel in future. Big mistake from your rude and amateur staff.

title: Easy access to London Stratford Westfield
text: Good value comfortable accommodation near to stratford facilities of Westfield and travel connections. Friendly check-in. Small breakfast and bar areas with light breakfast option available and included in room rate.

title: Noisy on road side
text: I stayed at this hotel for the Ride London - Surrey cyclosportive. Recognising that this will have been the first time that the hotel was full of cyclists and bikes the did a great job. Opening up for breakfast at 5am was very much appreciated. I thought the food was fine and there was plenty of it. But, the noise in our room from the road was relentless. It's a main road into London and was busy all night. I didn't get much sleep. Get a room on the other side of the hotel unless you are a really heavy sleeper. I have to say that the staff were super friendly and helpful - much appreciated. As this looks set to be an annual event they do need to think about bike storage. We kept ours in our room and that was great (as everyone else seemed to be). But if they had been wet the hotel would have ended up with a few oil stains here and there however careful people tried to be. Maybe provide super size bin liners to cover rear wheel and drivetrain and insist people use them? In summary - fine for the price. Take your ear defenders!

title: One of the friendly hotels, I have stayed ten nights for businesses and leisure.
text: I have stayed here for the first time. The staff was very warm, welcoming and friendly, good value for money, excellent customer service friendly staff good food rooms clean and comfortable, location 5 minutes from Stratford underground and DLR, you also have the Westfields shopping center next to the station. In fact, we were informed that if we become a member of the hotel we may have some discount for the next time stay at any Holiday Inn in London. I would have no hesitation in staying in this Hotel again.

title: good night's sleep
text: I stayed one night only in this hotel as I was on a flying visit to London. The room was fine and the bathroom adequate (shower only no bath). The bed was extremely comfortable and a nice touch was the pillows labelled soft and hard. The hotel was quiet. Breakfast was a help-yourself-buffet but there was most of the things you would expect.

title: Convenient location, great breakfast
text: This budget hotel is located close to the Olympic Park but provides easy transport links to central London. The main tube station is a 10 minute walk from the hotel and from here almost anywhere in central London is not much more than a 20 minute journey away. We arrived almost two hours before the published check-in time but as our room was ready the reception staff were very happy to let us have immediate access. The room has plenty of room for two with a compact shower room. The buffet breakfast was a lot better than I was expecting with a good range of hot and cold items all the items I tried were excellent. I will definitely stay here again when in London.

title: Hotel, Close to Westfield Stratford Mall
text: A Hotel, which is Close to Westfield Stratford Mall, just a walking distance. Complimentary Breakfast is great. Service is nice. Rooms are clean. Quite affordable. Another best thing its close to stratford tube station.

title: Wonderful Stay but Failed at the Last
text: I booked this hotel having previously stayed at the nearby pricier Holiday Inn. There was no real difference between the two (except the location and here the breakfast was included). The room was clean and comfortable and the staff helpful and friendly. I had an accessible room and once accidentally pulled one of the alarm cords. I received an immediate call to see if all was well. The breakfast was excellent with plenty of choice. My stay was for four nights with earliest check in 2 pm, latest check out 11 am. Pretty standard. I assume that like me most people plan their travel arrangements round these times. It was a little disconcerting therefore when there was a knock on the door at 10.15 a..m. yesterday, my day of departure, and I opened the door to find not the cleaner but a member of the office staff saying the cleaner wanted to come in to change the room. She went away when I pointed out I had till 11 a.m. to vacate, agreeing that yes, that was another 45 minutes. I packed and left as quickly as possible feeling that I had been pushed out. This gave a very poor impression and spoiled what had till then been a very pleasant stay.

title: We like it
text: We stayed at this hotel for 4 days. The hotel is next door to the Olympic Village, which will be open to the public at the end of July 2013. The rooms are nice and clean and have air-condition. The staff is most helpful and nice. We enjoyed the free buffet breakfast. As for the wifi connection – because I am a priority club member we had connection to the internet free of charge. The hotel is about 10 minutes walk from Stratford tube station (central, Jubilee and DLR lines), Stratford International railway station and the Westfield Shopping Centre, were you can find almost everything including several buffet restaurants serving all kinds of food. Next to the hotel there are bus stations to the city. Be ready to spend about 30-45 minutes on the bus, but the road and the sights are interesting. Of course if one takes the tube it is faster, but keep in mind to skip the tube at rush hours.

title: Great rooms
text: Holiday Inn Express is always good for value for money - with breakfast and internet always included in a pretty reasonable price. This hotel is no exception. The location is reasonable - about 10 minutes walk from Stratford tube station and the fantastic new Westfield shopping centre that is right by the station. The hotel is fairly new and the rooms are excellent - clean and comfortable. The breakfast is pretty decent for one that has been included in the price and I would have rated this hotel as Very Good except for the completely inadequate restaurant in which the breakfast is located. The buffet is set up in a really tiny room at the end of a small restaurant. There are not enough seats so you often have to wait to sit down and once you have, you have to struggle through the rest of the people trying to get into the tiny room at the end of the restaurant where the buffet is located. I have stayed at this hotel a number of times and the situation has always been the same. Today I ended up deciding the free breakfast was not worth it and went out to get breakfast elsewhere. If they would fix the breakfast situation, the hotel would be truly outstanding value for money.

title: Good Base For The Excel
text: I stayed her for 2 nights starting October 19th, as I was going to a convention at the Excel. Because we were running late for our appointment the reception staff let us throw our cases in the lockup and said that they would sort our room keys out when we got back. Which they did, no problem. Our room was very nice and clean, with white bedding, choice of pillows and with large towels. Good hot shower too and toiletries supplied free of charge from reception if you should forget to bring anything. Not much room to put any clothes away, but I don't suppose guests stay long enough for that anyway. Our mistake was not asking for a room away from the High Street. The noise of traffic and emergency services was all through the night. To be expected I'm sure on a busy London street. The free breakfast was to be praised. I'v stayed at hotels with free"breakfast" but none as good as this. The bacon, eggs and sausage were good, choice of cereals, fruit, lovely fresh bread and croissants, top name yoghurts, and a first class coffee machine. The orange juice in the machine was a bit tasteless, but the rest of the breakfast made up for that. We didn't eat in the hotel at night so can't comment on their meals. We did try to order coffees at the bar one evening but the staff kept talking together and wandering off so we gave up. Reception staff though were very nice and helpful. We were about an 8 minute walk to the train station for our train to the Excel. They were working on the line so had to transfer to a bus at Canning Town. But no problem. Overall, yes, I would stay here again if in the area. And would book again through Laterooms as we got a deal.

title: Great stay for quick trip
text: I stayed here while my sister was moving to London to attend Queen Mary University. The hotel lobby and rooms were nicely designed, not old fashioned. The room was clean, spacious, and really all your needs were available. However the WIFI was slow when it did connect. The breakfast buffet was really good! The location was perfect for us as it is a 10 minute walk to Westfield Stratford City (great shopping mall), Stratford station (for underground tube,DLR, and trains) and the bus stop is right in front of the hotel. This made getting around the city was quite easy. The only thing I wish the hotel and or website would have provided was options from Gatwick Airport and not just from London City Airport.

title: Good stay
text: Great location 8 minutes walk from Stratford station, good size room clean with tea and coffee maker. Full breakfast included excellent range, can't complain about anything really, good stay. Free phone calls to local national and mobiles from the room which was an added bonus and access to an ironing room fab!!

title: Location is key
text: Look, first of all this is a Holiday Inn Express, it's not a five star stay, bear this in mind when booking. I have looked at some of the other reviews, I cannot comment on the competence of the staff in general beyond checking in and checking out, this they achieved with no problem. I found the room to be quite comfortable, I was concerened about the room being at the front and overlooking Stratford High Street, I shouldn't have as the noise level was not a problem at all. The bed was comfy enough for an undisturbed sleep. I didn't spend a whole heap of time in the room beyond sleeping, but I would have been happy enough to. Breakfast was, well Express style breakfast - scrambled eggs, suasages, beans, a variety of pastries and croissants, cereals, fruit, yoghurt. Let's face it, for an included in the price breakfast it did the trick. But the overwhelming advantage of this hotel is it's location. Putting ther Olympic statdiium to one side for the moment

title: Exceptionally good experience
text: Stayed in this hotel during February, my booking was approx 12 days but on 4th day hotel water lines chocked & hotel staff shifted us to Stay bridge suites West field a 5 star hotel without any additional charges for all remaining days. During our stay at Holiday inn express we found staff very cooperative. Rooms at Holiday inn express were quite big even much more bigger than few Holiday inn in London. Hotel is only 400 meters away from underground. Cleanness was up to satisfactory mark. Bus stop just next & opposite to hotel. Must stay next time in this hotel. Breakfast was average & sleep quality was also ok.

title: Happy weekend
text: Two night stay was memorable. So comfortable and excellent staff. Nothing was too much trouble and so pleasant and helpful. Hotel was conveniently placed for the Olympic Park and Aquatic Centre as well as the large Stratford Shopping centre with numerous restaurants and designer shops.

title: Silver medal for effort
text: Make sure you book as early as possible to get a decent price, as being in London in summertime is a challenge pricewise. This hotel is well situated, not very far from the Olympic Village, Westfields Shopping Centre, and the O2.Good connections from Stratford, DLR, BR, and the Underground. All is clean and bright, friendly staff, decent breakfast, although it does get quite busy in the morning. The room is fine, but we did have to be moved due to a power failure in the room. Its a bit noisy with all the comings and goings, but a pair of earplugs should suffice. So why go to the City and West End and pay twice as much, this feller will do the bizzo.

title: Clean, spacious, basic room
text: Well sitated just off A12 so handy for North Circular. I had a good deal @£86 for a twin room with breakfast - but offset somewhat by the £20 parking charge. Room was clean, modern and spacious with comfortable bed and good sized en-suite. No wardrobe or staorage drwaers so OK for a night or two but not longer. Breakfast room was extrememy crowded and food was quite diverse in range but not great quality - though perhaps I was unlucky in getting the stuff that had been out a while. Reception was quick and efficient and staff were friendly, polite and professional.

title: Good size room and nice breakfast
text: Spent a night here on a recent trip and was amazed with the size of the room, it could actually accomodate family of four. Breakfast spread was pretty decent too. Wifi worked well throughout the stay. Short stroll to Stratford Centre malls and transport connections. Overall it was better than I expected.

title: Great hotel, lousy breakfast
text: We stayed at this hotel for one night over the Whitsun Bank Holiday Weekend. It is quite a long ride by tube out of central London and a good 10-15mins hike from Stratford station when you have luggage and kids in tow, but the price is very competitive when compared with somewhere closer to central London. The hotel itself is very nice - all new, so very clean and welcoming. Our family room was also clean and adequately equipped, with a choice of firm/soft pillows. Reception staff were helpful and allowed us to leave our luggage there several hours before check-in. The breakfast was something else altogether. The buffet area is cramped when busy. Whilst waiting, supplies of trays, coffee cups and bread all ran out and took a long time to be replenished. There was no bacon at all and they were serving sausages instead which also ran out. I was told there would be more in 5 mins so I waited, then I was told they'd be another 5 mins. Eventually they were brought to our table, but the sausages were so awful, my dogs would've turned their noses up at them.

title: Good Budget Hotel
text: I booked this hotel on Expedia for 9/10 November at £158 for the Wednesday night and £88 for the Thursday night which averaged out to £120 per night. I called to confirm our reservation for a 'smoking room with two twin beds' the night before we arrived and was assured that everything was in order. We checked in at approximately 1:00pm the following day and were told that our 'non-smoking room with one double bed' wouldn't be available until 2:00pm. Obviously the system broke down but the gentleman behind the counter was very helpful and quickly sorted things out for us. We were in room #609 on the top floor which provided a view of the unremarkable east London landscape. The room was small but clean and contained a television, a desk area with a chair, and a kettle with coffee and tea. We found the beds comfortable and each came with two pillows tagged with 'firm' and 'soft' although we couldn't tell the difference. The bathroom was spotless but there are no amenities. The soap and shampoo are one in the same and dispersed from a wall mounted unit in the shower. The towels were a nice size but disappointingly thin. There was no mini-bar or in-room safe, although there are safe deposit boxes in the lobby - there may be a fee attached to use them, we didn't bother. The Expedia website lists 'Wireless Internet Access' as one of the hotel's room amenities but there's a £15 per day charge for that and we passed. The computer in the lobby, if used for less than 10 minutes per day, is free... but longer than that and the £15 charge is applied to your bill. The hotel provides breakfast from 6:30 - 9:30 which is comprised of scrambled eggs, sausage and beans, (it's a British thing), along with the typical assortment of cold items: cereals, breads, fruit. The sausage was extremely poor quality but everything else was quite nice and the hot chocolate from the machine dispenser was surprisingly good. The Stratford International Rail Station offers both the Central and Jubilee tube lines for getting into the city center and the station is roughly a ten minute walk from the hotel. The new Stratford High Street station for the Docklands Light Railway is much closer and very convenient if using City Airport. We knew we were signing up to a budget hotel and we had a pleasant stay here

title: Pillows like paving slabs!
text: When I got to my room there was a customer satisfaction questionnaire on my pillow. Unfortunately, it had already been filled out by the previous guest! I read with disappointment that the kettle didn't work which was bad news as after a long journey I was gasping for a cup of tea! Anyway, the kettle did actually work if you applied pressure to the plug (loose connection!). Good value, new, clean, nice continental breakfast. Nice property but my night's sleep spoiled by the pillows which were thin and hard.

title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed here for an early valentine's and were very happy with the hotel itself. Didn't eat here and although a free breakfast was included which is great, it was really too early to go to as we were there to relax and sleep in, would have been nice to be served til 11 at least. Only complaint was that the Fire alarm went off about 3 times on our first morning there which was awful and not the best way to be woken up. But thankfully it seemed to be a fault and we weren't actually evacuated which would have been even worse! (Although obviously not if it were to be an actual fire) location is not the best if you don't drive and can't walk far, buy there is a shop over the road for snacks which was handy.

title: Excellent Stay at decent price
text: Had travelled to london for one week sand stayed at this place for one week. The hotel is pretty good and staff are very friendly and ambience is good. Rooms are clean and well maintained. Complimentary breakfast has good spread Walking distance from Stratford High street station

title: Clean & tidy
text: Wife and I stayed there for weekend in London. Hotel clean and tidy. Very quiet inside despite busy main road outside. Parking is a bit of an issue, but then I suppose this is the London way ........!

title: Comfortable Rooms, Good Food
text: Bit more an adventure getting to the hotel from London on trains but was a comfortable, more affordable experience. Rooms are comfortable with the amenities you would expect.The front desk staff was friendly and helpful. They have a dinner service which had a nice variety of food and is served in the great room at a reasonable rate. £46 for 2 sirloin steak dinner with adult drinks and a kid's chicken nuggets dinner. Breakfast is included with room and offers a variety of food to get you started. If you are staying near Stratford I would recommend!

title: Value for money!
text: Stayed for a week - on business trip 1. close proximity to London Tube station (Stratford Station) 2. Complementary breakfast was part of my package. Though breakfast did not carry a wide variety, it was certainly value for money! 3. Staff was very courteous and helpful during my stay 4. Rooms are not very spacious but fit the purpose of a short business trip * Stayed from 3rd Oct-2016 (for 1 week)

title: Comfortable and Clean
text: I stayed here just for 1 night on business. The hotel is located on the high street, about 10 minutes walk from Westfield Shopping Centre and a stones throw away from Olympic park. Although located on a busy road, I wasn't disturbed at all by traffic although I kept my room window closed. The air conditioning in the room worked brilliantly. The room was spotlessly clean, although a little dated, and the bed was extremely comfortable. Although no iron in the room, there was an ironing room on the same floor located by the lifts if required. The bathroom, although spotless, was showing signs of age and again was a little shabby - damaged tiles and chips on the basin surround, also there was only a shower and I prefer a bath, but that's my personal preference. I didn't sample the breakfast here as service doesn't start until 6.30 and I had to be at a meeting before then, but the helpful receptionist did say that if required, the kitchen crew would be happy to provide cold options. I did eat dinner in the restaurant and this is where my confusion began....... Firstly the "restaurant" consisted of chairs and tables in the main foyer of the hotel. Food is ordered at the bar and you are then issued with a table number which you place on your table. The choice was limited and I naively assumed that, as the website describes the restaurant as "award winning", the limited choice would be superbly cooked and well presented. How wrong I was. I chose "Posh Fish & Chips" described as served with a crab cake, minted mushy peas and tartar sauce. What arrived looked about as appetising as the inner sole of my trainers. I assume the chef had "Gone to Iceland". I think the only thing on my plate that could be described as fresh would be the slice of lemon garnishing it. The batter coating on both the fish and fish cake was dark brown and like biting into cardboard. The fish cake left an unpleasant aftertaste but the fish was surprisingly succulent. The chips were also good but not sure where the mint was in the minted mushy peas. None of the waitresses asked if everything was ok with my meal (to be fair, it wasn't just me, no one else was asked either). On the plus side, WiFi was free and was speedy in all areas of the hotel. There is a car park adjacent to the hotel for customers only, but a word of warning - it's fairly small and is on a first come first served basis. On the whole this hotel was good for my business needs, but I wouldn't choose to eat here again. It's location is great for shopping and as a base for exploring London futher as it has good transport links.

title: Not your typical Holiday Inn Express
text: As we approached the hotel the neighborhood seemed a bit rough but we found it was nothing to worry about. The hotel had a restaurant with a limited menu. The food was good and reasonably priced. We enjoyed a beer at the small bar and were pleased with prices and service. The room was clean, quiet and comfortable but more than expected. Wireless Internet access is provided and fairly reliable. We enjoyed the breakfast included in the rate and found the croissants especially good. We found the local shopping mall with a great selection of dining options just a short 10 minute walk away. Too bad we foulnd the mall at closing time. The Stratford train/bus staion was at the entrance to the mall Overall we enjoyed the experience and will return next time we are in the area.

title: Weekend shopping
text: Room on the 6th floor was large, clean and standard equipment but a bit cold. Heating was set at 24 but room was a maximum of 21. Breakfast was good. The hotel is a short walk from Stratford station and great shopping center.

title: Lovely and central
text: We stayed here recently for a night away. It is a beautiful and clean hotel. Staff were helpful and kind. The location of the hotel is perfect. Close to the shops and tube station. Price was reasonable and rooms were nice. Brilliant location to Stratfield Shopping Centre and Olympic Park. Breakfast was pretty weak but it was free! Would recommend if price was right.

title: Good Stay
text: We stayed in the holiday inn express whilst it was being renervated last year. Our room was modern. During our 2 night stay we got locked out of our room due to a fault in the new door. All hotel staff were very accommodating and we were well looked after. Including being given complimentry drinks and a nights stay for free! Breakfast was very busy and basic. Quite a way out but easily accessible by tube. All in all a good hotel and an affordable price in london!

title: Our overnight stay.
text: Clean comfortable room, very friendly and accommodating staff, nothing was too much trouble. Great location too and very reasonable rate for the area. Free breakfast but alas we missed it (too much of a good night) ! Would definitely recommend and stay again.

title: What a location!
text: Loved our experience at the Chamberlain Hotel, and much of that has to do with the location and the restaurant/pub in the main lobby. We wanted to stay at a place that felt like a true British hotel, and Chamberlain fit the bill. What we didn't expect was how wonderful the location was even though it was a little outside of the hub-bub of areas like Picadilly. The hotel is within very easy walking distance of the Tower of London and is basically equidistant from two tube lines, which makes traveling to other parts of London very easy. The pub at the hotel was great--a perfect place to grab a pint before our after a night out, and there are some other great pubs within walking distance as well. The room was small, but for the price, we couldn't complain. The staff was always willing to answer our questions and provide us recommendations. We'd definitely recommend this place to friends and stay here again.

title: Completely Missed the Point
text: Stayed here 1 night and that was enough I did have further nights booked but cant take a risk - the rooms were spacious - TV and services ok - albeit too complex and took you took many clicks just to watch the news - Wifi was poor and didnt exist in my room (307) the room also smelled of smoke - it was clean and tidy - the bar and staff were ok but the bar is expensive for a Fullers pub. I stay in the city a lot and this hotel just came up so thought lets give it a shot - schoolboy error - the shower did not work it was a dribble of water - this is dreadful we are in 2014 and no hot water - I complained as I left and all they said was we will look at it - no good enough - its no good looking at it after I have left - wont be staying again - wont be recommending and will be complaining - very poor show in a very competitive market - reception need some training as well.

title: Recommended
text: Recommended. Good hotel in convenient location, close to Aldgate and Tower Hill underground stations. Friendly staff and comfortable rooms. Handy bar and restaurant area. Excellent dinner and tasty breakfast.

title: Nice hotel, great location
text: We were looking for an affordable hotel close to London attractions but still accessable to Heathrow airport ... we found it in the Chamberlain Hotel! Just around the corner from the underground, very close to Tower of London. We took the Original Bus Tour, which stopped right at the Tower of London - very easy and convenient. Rooms were comfortable, well supplied and very clean. Good size too, compared to many London hotels. I would stay here again, and would definitely recommend it!

title: Great location
text: If you don't want to be in the very center of the madding crowds this hotel is perfect. Great value for money and so easy to get in the tube or walk to some Lovely local Places not teeming with tourists

title: Chamberlain Hotel For City Breaks
text: Stayed the in the Chamberlain last week for 4 nights and could not fault it. Staff were great, food was gorgous and the rooms were more very clean and comfertable. The hotel is 5min walk to the left to tower bridge were all the hop on tours start from (choice of 3) and 2min walk to the left from the underground subway station. As its in the business area there is no loud music or much traffic to annoy you though there is a number restraunts and bars few doors up. Breakfast was simple sausage, bacon, hashbrown, egg, tomoto, black pudding, and beans though there was ceral and other stuff. We ordered room service when we were there and 15min it was at our door piping hot and lovely home made burgers and chips and club sandwichs and they didnt cost the earth for room serivce.
