title: London's Best Kept Secret!
text: I stayed here for two nights whilst attending a training course in London. I booked it through Expedia for the very reasonable rate of £125 per night. The hotel is situated in a quiet side street just off Queensway, in the leafy Bayswater area of London. It takes around 5 minutes to walk from Bayswater underground, or about 10 minutes from Queensway station. Queensway is lined with shops and restaurants, every fast food chain imaginable as well as Sainsburys and Tesco stores, restaurants offering cuisine from around the world and more souvenir shops than you can shake a stick at. All this is only a couple of minutes from the hotel, making it very well positioned. Checkin was a pleasant experience, with very helpful staff. My room was a Triple Executive Studio, room 415 situated on the 4th floor. On entering the room I wondered if I’d got the wrong room. I walked into a very large room, with a settee, dining table and chairs, and then a king sized bed and the bathroom. There is a fully fitted kitchen including fridge, microwave, toaster, kettle and all cutlery and crockery. There are even wine glasses, bottle openers and a full set of knives. There is a widescreen LCD TV and DVD player, the TV offering a full lineup of Freeview and full package of SKY channels. Plenty of storage for all of your clothes, and two windows offering a view of the street and square down below. The room was far larger than any other room I’ve stayed in London, very spacious and I certainly wouldn’t object to spending a longer period of time here. The room is very swish, including the bathroom which has a beautiful, high pressured shower. The hotel seems to be popular with tourists rather than business travellers, and unfortunately on my second night the evening was spent listening to Russian children running up and down the corridor. Although my experience was extremely positive, with no complaints anywhere, it should be noted that some rooms are in the basement (the cheaper rooms I believe). I would not want to stay down there. Also, it should be noted that the hotel offers an incentive for people to write “genuine reviews on TripAdvisor”, as per the attached photograph. (please note I did not choose to take advantage of this offer as I don’t believe in it). Note to the management – you do not need to do this! The hotel is amazing and you don’t need to incentivise people to write good reviews, they will come naturally! All in all I was very impressed with this hotel, and I will certainly be looking to stay here again in the future, particularly if it is for a longer stay. Having all the facilities of home in a large, comfortable room, is very handy. And the location cannot be beat.

title: False advertising
text: What a horrible hotel. Really hot no air conditioning, long hot corridors to get to your room and numerous doors and steps to be negotiated Rooms very poorly load out. Nothing for washing up dishes. Front desk people were rude. Wouldn't check anyone in before 2.30 but the next day when we got back from sightseeing they were checking people in early. Seems to depend on their mood. Windows can only be open a limited amount. We have done substantial international travel and this would be the worst hotel I have ever stayed in. Definitely not what was advertised and certainly not value for money.

title: Family of Four Adults
text: My family of four stayed at Grand Plaza for 10 days for the usualy vacation in London. When we first got their, it was a bit too early for check in. We arrived with eight baggage, there was man ready to take our bags to the baggage room. My family went out to eat at one of the many restaurants nearby. We went back to Grand Plaza and were able to check in an hour early. We got our room on the third floor which was right next to the elevator which was no problem for us going down such a narrow hall past our room. The sofa bed was set up and everything. The room was a decent size for this American family, but having to get used to a bathroom with no shower curtain was something we just had to deal with. Until the first night. The fire alarm kept going off about every two hours when we slept. But after that night...it only went off once for the rest of the nights we stayed. Anyway, most of the staff was helpful, especially this one man, he spoke in my family's native toungue and he was really helpful with a lot of our touring around London. The maid service was really good at keeping our room clean. The laundry service was nice enough to fold our clothes before we got them back. The kitchen was really helpful because my family loves to cook and we saved a lot of money for not eating out every night for dinner. The location of the Grand Plaza is a BIG plus and that's why I give it 5/5. You'll just have to see it when you get there. Just a tip on when you leave/enter the room. I'm not sure if it's for all rooms, but I had to always make sure the front door of the room was completely closed all the way. It wouldn't close all the way if you let it close by itself, you had to give it a little pull or push when you close it. My family and I enjoyed my stay at the Grand Plaza Serviced Apartments.

title: A great hotel in a great neighborhood
text: Before coming to Grand Plaza I was a bit apprehensive because of user reviews on Tripadvisor about rooms that didn't look anything like the photos on their website and confusing hallways. I encountered no such problems. The room was very nice, just as it appears on the website photos. Having stayed in several European hotels, I was pleasantly surprised to find that this room was, by far, the largest I've ever stayed in, with ample closet space. But the best thing about Grand Plaza is the employees. Every one I encountered was friendly and accommodating. When I was having a particularly bad morning, Mohamed the desk clerk was particularly helpful in retrieving and printing an important email for me. The hotel provides one free load of laundry for guests and a complimentary fruit basket in return for user reviews on Tripadvisor and other websites. This demonstrates the level that Grand Plaza cares about its guests. The neighborhood is convenient with lots of shops, restaurants and two Underground stations nearby. The only negatives were a slow lift (this seems to be common in European hotels) and the couch was not comfortable. And try not to get a room facing the street, which is quiet by day, but very noisy for about an hour each night at around 23:00 caused by loud, noisy carts being loaded onto a truck right in front of the hotel by loud, noisy people. These are the only things preventing me from giving a five star review. All in all, this is one great place to stay and I highly recommend it.

title: this place is a joke-do NOT stay here!
text: Really-I could not believe how misrepresentative the web decriptions and photos of this place are. The apartment (that we had paid large amounts of money for) which we were given on arrival was on a noisy thoroughfare, dark and dingy. Most of these 'apartments' seem nothing like the spacious, light ones seen on website. On complaining the (admittedly helpful) manager showed us several other apartments. None however match descriptions. Even the 'family' apartments did not have a separate living area as I was led to expect. So whoever was unlucky enough to sleep in this room was woken if anyone wished to get a drink etc or get up earlier. The whole point for many people (as us) in having an apartment is to have extra space-in fact there was less than if we'd had two hotel rooms! The 'second bed' is a sofa bed-very uncomfortable. The carpets and chairs filthy and walls marked and scuffed. Not at all what we had paid for-in fact wouldn't expect this if paid alot less. Only good point is location. DO NOT BOTHER WITH THIS PLACE. We were informed that you'd get better rooms/deals if booked direct with the place rather than via expedia etc-surely this should not be the case-NO EXCUSES PLEASE. Bell boys lovely however

title: Would definitely use again
text: I went to these apartments with my mother and sister. We would all use them again although smaller than I expected and the third bed was a bed settee(not very comfy) All staff were friendly and polite and willing to assist with anything you ask for.

title: Great!
text: Stayed March 10 - 17, 2012 and it was exactly what we needed...a small apartment (we had two rooms - one with a bathroom and one with the kitchenette area). It was very clean, and the staff was courteous and helpful. The location of the hotel is spot on. It's about 5 blocks away from the Circle and District lines so you have easy access to central London, and it's one tube stop away from Paddington Station and the Heathrow Express train. Whiteleys mall is about 3 blocks away, which means you can easily pick up anything you need at Marks & Spencer. I would definitely recommend. The area is quiet, but busy, and you get a real sense of London. If you're in the area, try Prince Alfred's pub...the food is pretty good and they have music on Thursday and Sunday. Best thing is that it's not Taylor Walker so it's a bit different.

title: Best in Bayswater!!!
text: - It is my 3rd time staying at Grand Plaza Hotel for my business trip. I keep on coming back here due to its strategic location. - Walking distance to Hyde Park where I get to see the famous Swan Lake, just to wind down from meetings. - Approximately 10 h

title: Split level 1 bedroom apartment
text: Stayed for a family holiday. The front desk lady Oana was very pleasant and professional. We had the one bedroom apartment on the 2nd Floor with kitchenette. The location is ideal ans apartment very clean and value for money. Although the room is a bit small, it is satisfactory for the city of London. Internet is also excellent. Will definitely consider staying again if the same standard is maintained.

title: Not grand nor are they apartments
text: We stayed in this place over the summer. We had asked for a one bedroom which turned out to be a room with a closet in the middle dividing the room in half. They converted the sofa into a twin bed. Both double and twin beds were so uncomfortable we didn't sleep well the 4 night we stayed. No air conditioning. Carpet is dirty. Kitchen Favilities are limited to a tiny 1.5 meter counter. This was not worth the 300 pounds they charged me for!! I didn't even have any room to open up my luggage. I will never stay here again.

title: nothing special, but a good location
text: The Grand Plaza Apartments. Things got off to a rocky start, we had booked a 2-bedroom apartment. The one allocated to us was in the basement, room LG 22, first impressions, not too bad. the tea towel and dishwashing sponge were missing, but so what, means they have to clean up after us. There is a manhole in the middle of the lounge, sharp screws and rough edges, told reception and they quickly provided a rug to cover this. Then the fun started, sounded like a herd of elephants above us, after an hour or so of this racket I went to reception to find out what was above us, the lady there said there was nobody above us, but by 9pm I had enough, again I went to reception as by then I had worked out that we were directly below the kitchen. Requested a room change but apparently only the manager can authorise this and he was off duty, by this time I was getting somewhat irate. This racket went on until well past 11pm and started again at 0545hrs the next morning. Next morning spoke to the manager and he agreed to a room shift, packet up and left the bags in the room for them to sort out. Came back later in the day and found we had been allocated a room on the 4th floor, this was quiet and comfortable, but not without its faults, floor tiles in kitchen area loose and cracked, some genius of a plumber connected the hot and cold water in the bathroom sink back to front. The room we first got should be assigned as a storeroom. The rest of the hotel is quirky, multiple stairs, slopes but typical of old London properties. Certainly no good for anyone with mobility problems. This is not a 4-star property, maybe 2.5 stars. Malaysian owned and maintenance does not seem to be a priority. Windows do not close properly, paint and furnishings tired. In conclusion, I think the rooms are hit and miss, you may get a good one or it could be a horror show. Would I return - NO

title: Disappointment plus!
text: Very strange place with unusual & highly inconvenient 'rabbit warren' floor plan. Our long flight from australia was met by uneven flooring, confusing corridors & what seemed like 100 fire doors through which we had to drag our luggage with the exception of one lift. Our rooms were on an obvious lean so bad that I actually fell out of bed the first night! Low quality furnishings & VERY misleading website. We were expecting much more for the price & from it's website information & images. 'Spacious' & 'luxury' as quoted was very far from it. Not impressed!! Lucky for the hotel, our stay was given some positives with close proximity to a metro station & lovely parks. The apartment was clean but boxy & cheap looking. Would never stay here again.

title: Comfy but have stayed in better
text: We booked this to be with friends that came over from Nz. On arriving in Victoria train station we caught a cab to the hotel. It was quiet a way out but near to tubes to get to where we wanted to be. The area was leafy and quiet. On booking in we were told that we had to pay a deposit of £200 just in case we were told we were to have wild parties and trash the room!!! ( we are 70 and 60!!! ) this is along with having our card number?? Reduced to £100 when we asked why! We left our luggage in the store as we arrived before the room was done. On getting back we were told our room number and time of breakfast which was extra, not being told that you could pay extra again and have a hot breakfast. The room was large and the beds comfy. In the morning , 8.10 there was a knock on the door. A chamber maid asked what time we would be leaving the room. We said it would be after breakfast. 11 o'clock is the time you have to vacate the room according to the large info book left on the table?? !! We got back from breakfast. And packed and again left our luggage in the store. The hotel is about 8 min from the tube and taxis we found sporadic in price ranging from £11 to £30 to get to Say Covent gardens. Twice we were taken around the houses by black cab drivers!!! Bad!! Walking was nice but far. We found the Hotel catered for Asians and middle eastern clients mostly. It was quiet and clean and comfy but we have stayed in better.

title: Decent room for the money
text: We stayed in a quad studio. Our two boys slept on the second bed which was not comfortable at all. Upon arrival the sheet set on the main bed had been ripped and had hole which made me think the bed sheet wasn't changed because why would you replace a sheet with something that is torn. The room is decent. The bathroom had a pungent smell. At check in we were told we were staying in the new building but the room is a bit dated and work so I wonder what the older building looks like. The staff was nice enough. No one has stepped out as being super friendly. Overall it's a decent place to stay just think it needs a good cleaning and bit more attention to detail.

title: A surprise in Bayswater.
text: We've stayed in a few dud hotels around Notting Hill and Paddington in our time, so this time we booked an apartment. We were pleasantly surprised by the size on the room for this location in London. The bed was comfortable, the room was warm, the facilities were clean and the internet was super fast! The kitchen had a cutlery and dishes for 4 people. We shopped at the local Sainsbury and Waittrose stores for food to save on meal costs and to eat the way we wanted to. As a bonus a Handy phone was supplied which enabled free calls to Australia and a few other locations. The laundrette service was also a bonus. Each load was only £6 and every second load was free! The apartment was close to Bayswater tube and a Boris bike station was around the corner. We used both frequently. If you need to stay in this part of the world and want more than a compact hotel then this is a great option. We were impressed for the price, particularly when booking online. We have already booked our next stay.

title: Pricey for the quality that you get. Needs a revamp.
text: Pros: Good location: 10 mins walk to the nearest tube station. Abundant of restaurants just down the road. Pleasant and nice concierge staff. Cons: Room looked old and worn-out. Room felt like it had not been vacuumed on a daily basis. Dusty. Carpet/ furnishings in room definitely needed a revamp. Stained walls in hotel hallways. Thin walls. Foldable beds were uncomfortable. Noisy - though we stayed during the peak season. ONE tiny lift - could only fit 3 pax max with luggage. Pricey. We were given a one bedroom, one bathroom apartment with a living room that fitted 2 double size foldable beds plus its dining table/ chairs and a mini kitchen. I am not sure how they thought that 6 adults could stay adequately in a very crammed space with only one small bathroom to share? Having said that, if the charging rate was equal to the quality and standard of the room, I wouldn't be complaining - you pay for what you get. However, in this instance I felt that we had been over charged for what we stayed in. Grand Plaza definitely needs a major revamp! I strongly urge that if you are looking at staying in London for a week or more, to consider renting an apartment. There are plenty within the central region that are much cheaper and far better standards than what Grand Plaza had to offer.

title: John
text: Well equipped and clean apartment, conveniently placed location. Staff very friendly, helpful and courteous. Good value for money. Very satisfied.

title: Great place to stay in great location for Carnival!
text: My friends and I booked here again for the second time for this years Notting Hill Carnival. Great location for the carnival, close by but not so close that you get any noise from there. Right near all the shops too. Staff are really helpful and friendly, especially the man who takes the luggage. We got a large apartment on the ground floor out through reception at the back of the place, and it was really spacious with a setee, double bed set up in lounge area, kitchen dining area, large bathroom and a really large double bedroom. It was clean and great for us. Only little problem was some noisy students above us banging around but told reception and they sorted it. The 4 of us had loads of room and this was a much bigger room than one we had last time, although that was a good size too, We'll stay again next year. Good value for money too.

title: Rude Chamber Maid
text: Easy check-in. Reception staff was friendly. Laundry staff and bellman was friendly. Our room was located on the first floor towards the end and was rather inconvenient because of steps leading towards the room. Room was smelly. Kitchen was in living room and was NOT a closed kitchen. Sofa bed was also located in the same area and was not great. There was an extremely big silver smelly bin in the kitchen - we had it removed. Bathroom was a good size. Master bedroom was not bad although there was "nothing to see" through the window except a four square wall where the bottom was dirtied with cigarette butts. On our last day, chamber maid was unfriendly and knocked twice on the door like a mad person and asked us to check out and leave just so she can clean the room. Chamber maid was not informed of our late check out and she was also very rude. Location of the hotel was excellent. Located a few minutes walk away from Whiteleys Shopping Centre and Bayswater Tube Station. Easy access for transport and food along Bayswater.

title: 100% Satisfied!!
text: I've stayed at this hotel a few times now and I absolutely love it!! Easy to get to, outside of congestion charge, plenty of parking, close to central, amazing apartments and I enjoy my stay everytime. A happy bunny :)

title: Pleasant place to stay
text: This great location offers attentive service and clean spacious rooms. The hotel is within walking distance to the Bayswater and Queenswater stations. Good colour choices, lighting, and comfortable amenities. Looking forward to staying here again.

title: Terrible
text: We stayed here for one night after arriving on the plane from Australia and were really disappointed. Our apartment if you can call it that was more like a care home, the furniture was awful, the lift didnt go to our floor so we had to carry big suitcases up several flights of stairs and our bedroom was so small that there wasnt even enough room for a gap either side of the bed. I have stayed in youth hostels that have been nicer. I was very puzzled by some of the good reviews so after looking at their photos I dont think all the rooms were as bad as ours, its just a lottery when you book. From the photos on the sight what we got was nothing like the rooms in the pictures. Perhaps we spent the night in their broom cupboard by mistake!!

title: Good location and budget friendly
text: The best thing about this property is the location. There are 2 subway stations (Queensway and Bayswater) just 3-4 mins away. Area has loads of restaurants and also couple of supermarkets, so convenient esp for families. Hotel itself is also ok, although I found the rooms too small. I had 2 rooms that sleeps 4 and 6 persons, and whilst they managed to squeeze in the beds, it meant that there was very little room left. Rooms also only had a toilet located in the main bedroom, which was inconvenient and one of the rooms (220) had heat emanating from somewhere and was warm. Kitchenette was adequate with usual amenities but fridge had no ice maker and there was no dishwasher. Front desk efficient with calls for cabs and enquiries. Hotel provided towels and toiletries. Downside was that a package I sent to hotel with rail tickets was missing or did not arrive. Nott sure if it was postal service or hotel's fault but if you are thinking of sending items to hotel, do check in advance that it has arrived.

title: Not impressed
text: I have recently stayed here 2 nights, not impressed if I am honest. I thought the reception staff was rather rude. Location was great for what we needed but the room needed I felt was very basic and in the bathroom it could have done with a good clean under the sink etc. The neighbours we had were also very noisy, they must have lived in the apartment block and from 7am in the morning the kids were running up and down the stairs and slamming doors. Not the hotel's fault I know but not good when you have booked a nice weekend away and you get woken up.

title: Good place to stay for families
text: This is a genuine and unsolicited review. Apparently they have been having problems with bogus negative reviews. They do offer a free fruit basket for anyone writing a good review but as I am now in Berlin I can't take advantage of this. We stayed as a family of four with two boys ages 9 and 14. The room was clean and well presented. The staff were all unfailingly helpful and courteous. It is situated in Bayswater which is very multicultural, especially for Middle Eastern cultures. The underground is situated only about 5 minutes wslk away. Although we had a front facing room it was very quiet with no noise problems. They offer breakfast but we didn't eat there as for a third of the price you could get a great breakfast for the Art Cafe about 3 minutes walk away. We would happily stay again here if we wanted to be in this part of town.

title: Modern, & Excellent value for money!
text: On arrival we were upgraded to to a 2 bedroom suite for free, this is the 2nd time we have came back here, lovely safe area, immaculate modern apartments, free wifi is very handy, plenty mirrors for ladies... 4 which is perfect as we can all get ready at the same time!, spacious, warm bathroom, fresh clean towels & sheets/bedding, handy vending machines for drinks and crisps/chocolate at pleasantly surprising and reasonable prices!, in all honesty theres no problems and if i was really fussy id say the little milks hadn't been filled up and the bedroom light switch needs repairing but all in all excellent value for money, Ill definitely be coming back with my family 2 flat screen tv's in seperate rooms with lots of digital channels & dvd player, hairdryer, ironing board....nothings missing! I won't bother booking hotel rooms in London as an apartment is much better, especially for families. Thanks:-)

title: Excellent stay for families.
text: Pros: -excellent location near bayswater and queensway tube stations 5mins walk. -apartment is cleaned everyday. -full cooking utensils. -modern interior -great for families Cons: -had to carry luggage ourselves to the room (We were 3 families with 2 infants and 7 huge luggages) -corridor to the room is narrow for luggage and ours were at the far end of the hotel. -rooms were small (ours were 3bedroom apartment) -no lock on the bedroom doors (lack of privacy) -a/c doesnt work though they were standing fan provided. -no mirror in the bedroom Overall it is a good hotel apartment for those who travels with family if you don't mind some minor lack of service, you will enjoy your stay.

title: SERVICED APARTMENTS IN LONDON
text: Ever wondered why so many people are choosing to stay at serviced apartments in London and around the world ? Well, it’s easy to see the huge benefits and savings one can make by switching from Hotel rooms to Serviced Apartments. They have more space, self-catering facilities, cheaper in room rates, flexibility in stay and are overall more convenient for Families or Groups. My family recently visited London for 3 weeks and stayed at the Grand Plaza Serviced Apartments in Bayswater. With excellent connections to the West End and loads of shops and restaurants close by, they had an absolutely fantastic time enjoying the area as well as the Apartment. They were able to cook when they did not feel like eating out and my father, who is a diabetic patient, was able to keep a check on what he ate. Having booked a Quad Executive Suite, they spread themselves out and enjoyed the comfort of extra living space and storage with air-conditioning. They also benefited from the free broadband access and the onsite free laundrette saving loads of money. A successful trip and as well as a comfortable one. They can’t wait to come back. We booked our stay through www.check-in-london.com

title: Convenient Location
text: Employees are very friendly. Rooms are a little small for the price, but our room was clean. Location is not bad with the bayswater underground a few minutes walk away. Lots of restaurants and groceries are nearby as well.

title: Not as advertised online - disappointing
text: We booked this apartment 10 months before as it seemed good value for money and a self-catered apartment. We were charged approximately AUD $1550 for 4 nights (2 bedrooms). When we arrived we were escorted to our room which was in the basement! The rooms were tiny, dark and damp. There was mould growing on the external walls and pavement. There were minimal utensils provided and a tiny kitchen. The bedside lamps were not pluggged in because there were no powerpoints for them to be plugged into. The "air conditioning" was a simple electric fan. The only item I would classify as luxurious would be the towel warmers, which were handy particularly on a cold night. The height of the ceiling was barely 6 feet and there was no room in which to store the luggages due to the basement location. It looked as though a room had been developed with the leftover space under the fire emergency staircase. We were located right near the staff cleaning quarters and laundry room. Outside the hotel was a huge rubbish bin overflowing with garbage bags which remained for approx. 3 days. Not a pretty sight (or smell) for tourists. Although the exterior looks very nice, the room we stayed in was appauling. We complained twice about the room, particularly given there was a carpeted sewer manhole in the room as well as a sealed lift engine room door with a hazardous sign on it! Only once we complained to the manager (twice), were we upgraded to a room on the ground floor, which was of a higher standard. I was even asked to write a letter to the management explaining why I had complained because the manager advised me that he would otherwise get in trouble with his boss for having upgrading us. I wouldn't think that customers should be trying to bail out staff and be inconvenienced particularly when they are dissatisfied to begin with - very unprofessional. Lastly, all staff were unable to speak english at a satisfactory level as their understanding of english seemed very basic. This made it challenging at times to communicate with them. Never again would I contemplate staying in these apartments as I felt we did not get what we thought we had paid for. Very disappointing, particularly given that I had my father with me on this trip as this was meant to be a gift holiday to him.

title: Nice apartment close to the center of Londom
text: We can recoment the Grand Plaza Apartments. Nice and clean and very easy to go to f.e. picadelly cirkus and other attractions. Close to the undergrund. We are traveling with 2 kids on 7 and 11 years. No problem... Nice to have the extra bedroom. We did not use the restaurant, so we dont know how t is. The only thing bad we have to say is that the room is really hot. So we can't stay in the room during the day.

title: Apartment Gem!!!....cheaper than most hotels!!!
text: Apartments are approx 5-10min walk from Bayswater tube. On arrival we were upgraded to a family room free of charge. Overall impressions are really good. We paid approx £80 per night which for the standard was cheaper than most hotels even the typical budget ones like premier inn, ibis etc. Plus you have full cooking facilities for making food all day if you want too. We would fully recommend the apartments and Will be def staying again:-) So the apartment details..... The living room has: a sofa, dining table, tv, full kitchen and a guest double bed. The kitchen includes fridge, dishwasher inc dishwasher tablets,cooker,microwave, toaster, and washing up liquid. The bedroom.....really nice. Decor really modern. In the room is a double bed, 3door wardrobe, chest of draws, bedside tables and tv. Bathroom is immaculate with bath and power shower.Toilet and sink.

title: Excellent location and fantastic VFM place...don't think just book
text: Loved it for the location....good rooms...great choice of over 20 restaurants for breakfast, lunch and dinner to eat just 5 minutes away...great rooms....lovely staff...just the perfect place to stay with family....

title: A pleasant experience
text: I enjoyed a lot from the Grand Plaza. Their is defiantly more good than bad. I particularly enjoyed how accessible the staff are and how much they help me get around such a big city. The rooms are well furnished and feel comfortable. Some things i did not enjoy was the placment of the fan making it hard to get in and out of the room and the lobby doesnt really have anything special. Although overall i would recommend this hotel t any family in the future.

title: Good location
text: The Grand Plaza is a great hotel, situated in a lovely location, near Hyde Park,the apartment is clean.

title: Nice Place
text: We stayed 4 days here with 2 kids in Family Room. They provided 2 rooms in 1 Family suit. It has all kitchen facilities including microwaves to utensils etc. Very clean & hygienic. Location is good enough with lot of different restaurant and Tube very nearby to hotel.

title: London Serviced Apartments
text: We stayed with our 3 children aged 13, 10 and 9 this last week of october. Everybody knows that London is not easy when one looks for a nice, reasonable priced accommodation. Having said that, we chose the Grand Plaza serviced apartments mainly for its location and price. We had been already a few times in London and wanted to explore this time a new area to stay. Grand Plaza Serviced Apartments are in the Bayswater/Notting Hill area, very close to Hyde Park (walking distance to the north part) and a 5 mins walk to the Queensway tube station. It has good and varied bus/underground options to get everywhere. The apartment itself (we booked the one bedroom apt that fits 6) was ok, basic furniture, new appliances, quite spacious bathroom. The serviced part, referring to the cleaning of the unit, is done daily, not in detail but at least the beds are made and the towels changed (you get plenty of them). A good thing is that we got one laundry service included for the 5 nights and since we could not pick it up during pick up hours, they left it in the reception ready for us. Wifi works very well which is not always the case in other hotels/apartments. I would recommend this hotel to people looking for a decent place to stay in London with a party of 4 or more, and with a medium budget (which will still be high in London!).

title: Good location, but it is too warm inside the room
text: Location is good, the room is just average, the bed is not firm enought...another big dispointment is no air condition in the room, when the temperature in London is high, it gets so so hot in the room...

title: reality not as nice as appearance
text: we were put in the basement and when we complained we were told in london it's normal. the staff did not seem to understand that being in a basement is not nice and we had to insist to convince them to give us attention. The hotel does not seem to be managed at the level you would expect from a big and well located hotel like that. the basement rooms should just not be allocated!!! and the staff should be more accomodating and especially more customer oriented.

title: Something you will not regret about
text: Very well located, near places to eat, supermarkets, the underground. Beautiful building, just a few steps from Kensington Palace and its gardens. The staff is very friendly, the installations are new and the rooms are big and confortables. Great place to stay with your family if you are taking a break in the nice city of London. If I would have to come back to London I would choose the Grand Plaza Hotel.

title: Very good.
text: Stayed here for 7 nights from 18.06.2016 to 25.06.2016 in their double executive studio no G-11. Since I was travelling with my wife and son of 2 years who likes to roam about, i requested them to give us slightly bigger rooms so that he could play with his toys in the room itself which they told would be subject to availability. I guess they have different size of double executive studio rooms from 15 sq. mt to 28 sq mt. I guess its better to inform them about your requirements prior to your arrival so that you are not disappointed. Our room was just the first room from the reception on the right hand side on the way to the breakfast hall. It was of decent size not really 28 sq. mt. but not too small either. The room was neat, clean, tidy as it should have been in any 4 starer. The bath room was also big, clean with a bath tub. Our room had 1 queen size bed and 1 makeshift queen size bed just next to the dinning table. Both the beds were enough for all 3 of us to sleep comfortably alebit separately. It dosent have an a/c so if you are travelling in summers and the forecast is hot then you better tell them for an air cooler as the windows open just about 4 inches. The room had an attached kitchenette with an microwave, cooking range, electronic kettle, cutlery etc etc. The location of the hotel is amazing just 4-5 mins walk to bayswater underground station, 6-7 min walk to the queensway underground station & bus stop for bus no 94 which goes to the picadilly circus and 7-8 mins walk to the hyde park gardens. There are 3-4 supermarkets like tesco, sainsburry, spar etc etc at a distance of 3-4 mins. Whitleys mall is about 2 mins walking distance. There are many restaurants serving, Indian, Italian, Chinese, Thai food, burger king, mc donalds, sheesha parlours, Pret a manger, etc. etc. at a distance of 3-4 mins walk. The staff at the hotel is very courteous, friendly, polite and helpful. Its a huge hotel and has many types of rooms suitable to singles, couples & families. i would defenetely recommend this hotel to everyone.

title: Great location, but very disappointing
text: Extremely disappointed with our 7 night stay at Grand Plaza. In such a great location as close to transport, shops and in a lovely area. Portobello markets, underground and Whiteleys so close. Was attracted to hotel by website photos but room was nothing like advertised. Carpet stains, dirty and smelly, staircase rail falling off wall, windows had gaps so we froze in our room during March and heater wasn't adequate at all. Booked a room for 3 adults and trundle was so uncomfortable for 3rd adult, they had a backache and couldn't sleep properly for days. Hotel couldn't even locate a plug for the sink for us to wash our dishes!! Spoke to reception and as they were 'fully booked' advised there was nothing they could do and couldn't move us. Flight was at 10pm on last day which I'd previously advised them I needed a late checkout days earlier, which last minute I was told they couldn't accommodate. After discussions they were very unhelpful and upsetting. I persevered as I had a 14 hour flight ahead of us and they relocated us to another room and charged me 200 POUNDS for 4 hours. I was so disheartened, upset and tired by this stage that I didn't argue and paid. I felt totally ripped off, they left a very bad impression and I would NOT recommend staying at this hotel. On a last note, reception staff were extremely rude. I reminded them about my complaints regarding the room on the last day while I was discussing the late checkout and they rudely said 'well you should have told us about your issues with the room at the beginning and we could have done something about it'. Excuse me? I told them on the first day and was told it was booked out.

title: Great location.
text: Good sized one bedroom apartment, room for plenty guests. Lovely lighting. Fridge is an optimum temperature. I enjoy the microwave being disguised as a cooker too, nice touch. Great Boris Bike access. we like the parks. thanks! Could do with a coffee table.

title: Thank you Mr. Akhtar .. Gem of Grand Plaza
text: Stayed at the Grand Plaza Serviced apartment and ABSOLUTELY LOVED the hotel and our room was so spacious, clean and good decor. Mr. Akhtar Ayub was so very helpful and attentive always that all guests would queue to talk to him. A GEM that made all his guests stay memorable. Thank you Mr Akhtar.

title: Our 2nd stay here and will be coming back again!
text: We were here from 29th May till 8th June 2014 for the One Direction concert, trip to the Harry Porter Studio and the Friendly Worldcup Football match between England and Peru. On the day that we arrived at the apartment, we felt totally at home as it was really clean and cosy. Eventhough our room was on the 3rd floor with no lift, (room was situated at the back facing the café, where you the exit through the door at the garden) we felt perfectly fine going up and down the stairs. The porter was helpful and kind in assisting us with the baggage and the cleaning ladies came to our room every day to clean and change the towels. Location was great, just a walking distance to many shops, tube stations and parks. Will definitely come back again next year!

title: Terrible experience, ruined our holiday
text: This has to be one of the worst places we have stayed at ever, I have listed below the specific faults but suffice to say that this is over-priced and far from value for money. As you will see from my other reviews during same trip, I am not a moaner by nature but this apartment block almost ruined a very special family break in London. You arrive to a fantastic entrance and impressive foyer but then the story goes from bad to worse. You descend (in our case) to a lower level & then further to what looks like the catacombs in Rome, to eventually find a basement flat which will test anyone's patience & sense of humour. We were sold at an expensive rate a luxury apartment that would easily accommodate a family of 5, first warning was an email to state that our requested 3 bed 2 bath unit was un-available & we could only have a 2 bed 2 bath unit. After repeated phone calls we eventually were assured that the unit could accommodate 5 people. On arrival we realised that this was a total fabrication and the unit that was available was too small & smelled terrible. We complained to the reception but found that the only other unit WAS EVEN smaller. We tolerated the unit for 3 nights as we had no choice but spent every possible minute out of it. I have detailed below the specific issues but feel totally RIPPED OFF by this company who sold us a sub-standard break at exhoribent prices. Their website gave the impression of luxury & space but the reality was cramped, low ceiling, smelly rooms, with broken equipment & filthy conditions. Tap in bathroom broken and tiles cracked None of extractor fans work Sofa bed in lounge – won’t stay flat, hard to sleep in, wouldn’t accommodate 2 adults Filthy below sofa bed and mechanism broken Twin bedroom – strong smell of damp Apartment so small – how could it be large enough for 6? Could barely fit 4 round dining table Total misrepresentation from website which shows large and airy rooms En-suite in shower room – filthy frame – never been cleaned Mattress in double bed – very uncomfortable – can feel every spring Noise from floor above prevents you from sleeping later than the people above you – hear every chair scrape etc Cover for ‘man hole’ in entrance barely covered by rug – safety hazard How can this ceiling height be acceptable?

title: Another excellent stay
text: This is my third stay at the Grand Plaza and again I am pleased with the accommodation. The apartments are a good size, all three I have stayed in have had enough room for two double beds. Apartments are clean and have the basics in terms of cutlery and crockery. Some of the carpets are a bit tatty but the rooms are pleasant. Free Wifi as well - good speed and I currently can select from 9 different access points so it doesn't matter where my room is. It is about 10 minutes walk from 2 tube stations which give you access to 3 different tube lines. 5 minutes walk from Queensway which has a big selection of restaurants, take-aways and supermarkets. There's also a good pub round the corner which does good food and beer. I have been staying in London hotels for over 20 years and, for the money, this place is hard to beat.

title: Very good it is clean and there is a A good breakfast.
text: It is a nice hotel there is plenty of room for 6 peole. It is very central you can even get a free fruit basket.it is a friendly place to stay there is a shopping centre near by. I would very much recommend it to everyone so please stop come it's you get free wifi.

title: Good hotel, and good location
text: We stayed at the Grand Plaza appartments, London. We had the studio appartment, which is smaller than expected but catered for our needs. it was clean, quiet and in the heart of london with some basic self catering amenities. There was plenty of hot water for baths, not always available in abudance at London hotels. Ideal for families. Iron and hairdryer provided with an ironing board and good comfy beds. Highly recommended.

title: Excellent rooms, service, staff, location, ambience
text: Beautiful suite divided into three rooms with a convenient kitchenette and TV's in living room and bedroom. Staff were very helpful and on duty 24/7. Outstanding location near bus routes and Tube stations as well as great restaurants and shops all within a short walk. Very upscale neighborhood. Look forward to staying here next time we are in London. Could not have asked for more!

title: Disgusting and gutted
text: Was really looking forward to a weekend away last weekend but my 2 year girl got rushed into hospital on the Friday morning! Rang the apartments to explain what had happened and why we didn’t arrive as planned and was told we would still be billed the full amount for the weekend…

title: Great location
text: Stayed here for 4 nights. Lifts slow, hallways long and narrow. We had a two bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment which was large for London but dining area quite small. We payed a large price for the apartment. Staff were helpful and beds were comfortable. Long wait trying to book into room but a lot of people arrived at same time we did and staff coped very well with a lot of demands. Location great which was a bonus.

title: Excellent location but a bit costly for size of room
text: I booked on the advice of my sis in law who stayed in the hotel in Oct 2012. The location is excellent with easy access to food and tube stations. It in such a nice part of town. But the quad room I was given was a bit small and crammed for 4 persons though 2 of them were children. Though the hotel did provide a portable aircon unit, the fact that its summer and the room can get quite stuffy and hot. I would still consider staying here but only if I got a bargained price on booking and only stay during the colder days.

title: Good location & Services
text: Great location,walking distance to shopping mall and restaurants. The room is clean and comfortable. We stayed for two nights. The first night was very noisy because of the delivery. We were able to switch to a very quiet room for the second day. The help desk people were very nice and helpful.

title: Holiday
text: Absolutely a fabulous stay at the grand plaza apartments. Extremely courteous and helpful staff. Will stay here again and highly recommend it . Spacious and well connected. A rare combination in central London.A big thanks from the Swani family...

title: Great location, some nice rooms, generally OK staff
text: Stayed in this hotel 3 times in a space of 2 weeks for business trip. First room was on the first floor, and I really enjoyed this room. Decor feels a little cheap, but it was still a lovely room. Second time I came, we got a basement room - not so nice. Third time was on the second floor. Generally all had similar decor, though some rooms are nicer than others. Staff were generally nice, though one or two could be a bit more friendlier. Food was great! I loved the breakfast. You get a full on continental breakfast, or you could go Malaysian. Absolutely tasty food. And Halal too! Location is great. Just a short walk from Hyde Park, Kensington Gardens, and Bayswater. Food all around, plenty of places to go. Just get an Oyster Card and hop on the tube or bus. All in all, I loved my stay here. Would definitely recommend it.

title: Not bad value
text: despite some of the mixed reviews the GPSA served us well for a family of 5. However note the apartment rooms are not huge and the bed arrangements were a bit makeshift but we got by. No airconditioning can be a concern. Bit mad at reception, they need a bigger front office. Location great with tube stations nearby. Staff all young but friendly.

title: Avoid if you have a pram
text: Would not recommend for families as the rooms are not pram friendly. Staff are mostly unhelpful and rude. Overall appartments are ok value but would never stay again.

title: Better than average but not 4 star
text: Stayed in room 101 which was a 2 bedroom apartment from 16/2/2013 to 18/2/2013. Good size apartment overall with enough room for my wife, myself and my 3 young children. To be fair we do struggle to find suitable accommodation due to our enormous family of 5. Anything over a family of four seems to be a no no in the hospitality trade so I was hoping that the Grand Plaza would be the solution. I would put us in the bracket of liking the good things in life but like to get a good deal, but not unreasonably. I did feel on arrival that the staff were not particularly friendly or accommodating and when asked if our room was available at 2.10pm they said no, check-in should be 2.30pm. I did however ask if I could check in to save time ready for the cleaning to be finished and suddenly all was finished, what a coincidence. However on arrival we were pleased with the size of the room and all was modern and clean. However I would add that the apartment was a little tired with paintwork, especially in bathrooms being worn and shower areas showing signs of a leak, the kitchen doors were also battered and worn. The main problem for us was the noise from the road and above us, secondary glazing would be the obvious choice. The beds were comfortable as were the pillows. Overall a good stay but by no means a 4star property.

title: Great value, well located.
text: A well located apartment, maybe slightly out of the heart of London, but, 3 stops on the tube or a 30ish minute walk and you're in Oxford Circus. Two tube lines are both less than 10 minutes walk away, and the Bayswater area is great. The apartments are in a lovely quiet area, but just a few minutes walk and you're in the heart of lively Bayswater. The apartment we stayed in was spacious for the price and well equipped. A very minor point would be that some of the decor is starting to look in need of a spruce up, but everything was clean and generally well presented. The reception staff were all very pleasant and helpful, free wifi was appreciated, though it slowed to a crawl in the evening. We loved having the freedom to eat out at any one of dozens of cafes nearby - every nation is represented - or pop into the local Sainsburys to grab some things to cook up in the kitchen. There's also a very nice shopping mall with a cinema just a few minutes walk away.

title: Home away from home
text: Relaxing valentines celebration with our good friends.quad room is superb and comfortable bed. closest tube is 5 minute walk in bayswater.helpful staff and accommodating.we are staying in room 120 and we definitely be coming back again. Ideal for group travellers and or family .

title: Loved this hotel
text: We found this hotel as a last minute deal for only 75 pounds/night and found it a great value for money. It was by far the most spacious hotel we've stayed in London. It was clean, comfortable, just 15-20 minutes walk to/from Paddington Station and we could open our suitcases and walk around!!! There's a little kitchenette/fridge, etc. if you wanted to have some meals at home. The bathroom was spacious and modern. The staff was perfectly friendly and helpful. Breakfast was average, but about what I expected.

title: Not as expected
text: Apartments are tiny with little room to move about, not what we had thought from the photos. Also very dirty, rubbish behind the sofa etc. Tiny windows in our room with very little light. The only good thing is the wi-fi!

title: Big disappointment
text: We stayed here over New Years for 5 nights in a 3-bed apartment. The apartment is Tiny. The kitchen and living space is not adequate for 5 people and the bedrooms small as well. This was an expensive apartment that was not worth the money and would be the worst placed we have stayed in London. The service at reception was poor - the room was not ready on time, and when we did get the keys we were not directed to the apartment and had to look for it ourselves. The reception staff did not speak adequate English and could not understand us very well. The complex seems to cater for Malaysians only. Wifi did not work at all during the 5 nights and the staff were not interested in helping. During check-out, there was no assistance with luggage despite requesting the day before. The location is good and close to 2 tube stations with good access to Central London.

title: Review of Grand Plaza Service Apts in Princes Square
text: Me my wife and my sister in law planned to visit London after our company trip in Munich. We booked direct from the Grand Plaza. Must have looked at hundred of places online but somehow the Grand Plaza stood out with brilliant reviews. From day one we dealt with Isabel and she was very helpful and response was almost immediate. She gave us a great rate for a Triple Studio. Checking in was a breeze and we were in our apt 10 minutes later. The apt was very clean and looked brand new. It was well equipped with all the comforts of home. The bathroom was fully stocked with toiletries and ample towels and the kitchen had all the utensils and equipment to cook simple meals. The TV was clear and reception was excellent. The DVD was a nice touch! Even though it was end of March London was freezing like the rest of Europe but the apt was well heated with hot showers which never ran out of hot water. House cleaning was of a very high standard and the staff was polite and helpful. The Guest information book was also very helpful equivalent to those found in 5 star hotels. Location was brilliant and Queensway & Bayswater tube stations were literally a 5 minutes walk away. We travelled mainly by bus which was a cheap and convenient way of traveling with bus stations only 5 minutes away on Bayswater road. The neighborhood was very pleasant. Quiet and safe even late at night. I have always stayed in 5 star hotels when I travel with my company. Grand Plaza apts are very good value for money. There was very little which we could find fault with in the apartment. Though it was a bit small but all the other plus points about the apt really we could not complain. I will DEFINATELY recommend the apts to anyone looking for a place to stay in London. I have stayed in another hotel in the same area and it is nowhere near the standards of the Grand Plaza. I will DEFINATELY stay at the Grand Plaza again the next time I am in London. Thanks to all the staff at the Grand Plaza for such a pleasant stay. See you all soon Raymond/Malaysian

title: Fast, Pleasant & Comfortable
text: From the quick & friendly check-in to the immaculate room & facilities, I just love staying here when I get a chance. My room on the ground floor had lots of space & was very comfortable. Unfortunately I wasn't staying in for the evening so after dropping my stuff off I was straight back out until late. Another thing was the ample supply of toiletries including shampoo & shower gel. At other hotels I find I have to request more. Overall a fantastic stay & service. Would definitely recommend Grand Plaza Apartments to others looking to stay in London.

title: Great for families
text: We stayed at the Grand Plaza. We had five adults, two teenagers, two eleven year old, a nine year old and three little ones in toe. We stayed in the family apartments and had an excellent stay. We had an excellent stay. Plenty of room for the little ones to run around and for the older children to chill out. Kitchen and dining area in room great for breakfast and lunch as tesco is just around the corner. Location is excellent, staff were very friendly, extremely welcoming and helpful!!!! Would recommend for families

title: Very Hot!
text: We booked a double executive apartment and it was much much smaller than what I was expecting. I found this to be very expensive but was told this was like everywhere in London. The location was great but our taxi driver could not find the apartment and keep driving us around, she then told us she did not expect traveller or credit card and we did not have enough pound and had to use euros - we were overcharged. Our apartment felt like a sauna, it was split into 3 rooms and only one room had a cooling system but wasn't very effective. We tried to stay out of the apartment as much as we could as the temperature was lovely outside but nauseating inside. The lift is very small, hot and takes a long time, we used the stairs where we could. Staff were friendly.

title: Good location
text: Good location to explore London, clean, helpfull friendly staff, close to all good eating place. Transport link is very good for tube and bus. Nothing hill gate is just a stroll away. Free wifi which is brilliant! This is our 3rd stay here, will definetly stay here again in the future.

title: Great location and very clean place
text: The Grand Plaza Service Apartments is at very convenience location. It is just around the corner from two tube stations

title: Very good value for money in central london, highly recommended
text: I have been in london for ten times. It might not be the best hotel in the city, but with the money you paid and the quality they offered, i will say its a really great deal. Clean, spacious (London standard), kitchen with two bathrooms, helpful staff, free wifi, vy reasonable car booking to airport......etc, what else can you ask for in central london? I will definitely recommend this hotel, especially for people travel in group.

title: Very good accommodation in an excellent location.
text: My mother and I stayed for four nights upon arriving in London on our first trip. We found the Grand Plaza was easy to find and very convenient to two tube stations, giving us easy access to all of the sights of London, as well as Kensington gardens being only a couple of minutes' walk away. The apartment was cosy and warm during the cold patch we encountered and the beds were really comfortable. It was clean and well serviced each day. We would definitely recommend it to anyone wanting to stay in the Bayswater area.

title: Everything you need
text: My friend and I stayed for 7 nights in a comfortable 1 bedroom apartment. The location is terrific with 2 tube stations very close on 2 different lines, a bustling High-street a block away with every type of shop available and great pubs for cheap meals. The rooms were spacious with a pullout double bed in the main room and double bed in the bedroom. Bathroom had a great shower and heated towel rail. Your first basket of washing was free and the Wifi had a strong signal throughout the building with easy login. Iron and board, hair dryer and toiletries provided, with daily servicing provided of the apartment. Rooms were very quiet, especially the back bedroom. We were very impressed with the price, facilities and location. Would certainly return next time I'm in London!

title: Very Friend Staff but...
text: I really enjoyed my stay at Grange Lodge Hotel. My friend and I landed in London to meet up with a tour group the next day. We only stayed one night but the staff was more than accommodating. They didn't have a room available because we arrived early so we toured around the area. There are shops and restaurants about 10 minute walk away from the hotel. There's also a train station stop about 15 minutes away. They ended up giving us a bigger room because it was cleaned sooner and we were so grateful. The ladies were magnificent, even providing us bread and jams and milk for breakfast even though we left two hours before breakfast hours began. Such sweet staff. Only downfall was that the rooms weren't in the best repair. The tv in our room didn't work, the floor wasn't even and the shower head was angled weird so you had to press yourself against the wall to have water run on you. It was removable luckily but a hassle nonetheless. The area was safe and people were nice so I would definitely recommend staying here if it's within your budget.

title: Comfortable and lovely accomodation
text: The "Grange Lodge Hotel" gave me a warm welcome. The place is very comfortable and located in a very quiet area. There is a good breakfast and a nice lounge where it is possible to relax while reading a book. The staff of the hotel is very kind and helpful. Finally, I recommend to meet the lovely cat.

title: Second home!
text: Back again and still great. Comfy room, lovely breakfast, friendly staff and super location. Always a pleasure to stay here as the staff make us feel so welcome. Sorry to have missed you Jill, hope you had a great holiday - but your team looked after us perfectly. We will, of course, be back!!!

title: On night in Ealing
text: An old work colleague reunion was held in Ealing and some of us decided to stay here after reading Tripadvisor. It was very clean, comfortable, friendly plus good breakfast, price and location. I would recommend it.

title: Lovely stay
text: I really like this place. Fantastic to be upgraded to double ensuite although would never expect this each time. Friendly staff Exceptionsl value to have breakfast included in the price Relaxing stay Will definitely come again.

title: Cheap and cheerfull!
text: Booked Grange Lodge for a long weekend to take in some museums and a show, stayed for two nights. Our room was on the ground floor, right next to the dining room where breakfast was served. The receptionist who greeted us was very friendly and helpful and check in was a breeze. The room was clean, warm and airy with hot drinks making facilities and plenty of everything. Free wi-fi is provided with a good strong signal. TV provided was small, but a modern flatscreen with freeview (and HDMI great if you have a laptop with DVD!) Breakfast was adequate and plentiful, plenty of cereals, juice and coffee along with a full english breakfast which was well cooked and with eggs 4 different ways! Access to Ealing Broadway is a brisk 10 minute walk with plenty of bars, bistros and restaurants in Ealing town centre. City Centre about 25 mins by tube. One of the few guest houses I have found where you can park your car. Other guests were a bit noisy in the morning which was the only downside of having a room so close to the dining room, but this is only a small thing. Overall, Grange Lodge (although not a hotel) is great value for money and I would happily stay again.

title: What a wonderful experience!
text: We wanted a place to stay that was not far from Central London and not far from Oxford. This lovely place was just right for us. The room was comfortable, clean and spacious. It had great windows. The walk to the Tube/Railway Station was only about 8-10 minutes and an easy walk. Breakfast was delicious. It was also a very quiet street. We would stay again! In fact, we are staying here in a week on our return to London before we fly home to California.

title: budget friendly
text: Stayed here for 2 nights recently - it is a 10 minute walk from Ealing Broadway station, and our room had an ensuite, along with fan, blankets and a heater and ample storage space. Our bed was very comfortable. Breakfast had cereal and fruit/yoghurt options and you could choose different items to make up a cooked breakfast. Really budget friendly (we paid under £65 for two for one night for a double room ensuite) and the staff were very personable.

title: Brilliant
text: Just stayed here for two nights to visit family in London. Including walk to underground, takes about an hr to kings cross and about 35mins to central London. Nice rooms, very friendly staff and lovely freshly cooked breakfast. Very reasonably priced too. Would definitely use again.

title: Home from home
text: Think we've said it all about this Hotel. Seventh time of visiting, still great. Comfy room, , tasty breakfast, fab location and very pleasant staff. Seem to find ourselves here every year. Long may it continue!

title: Only one real problem
text: I've stayed here many times, so it must be generally good, but this year breakfast is a bit of a lottery. A new member of staff is the worst I've ever encountered anywhere in the world - she'll she'll actively ignore you for up to 20 minutes before asking 'what do you want then?'. Apparently when she's working meals can only be prepared sequentially which is strange because at home I can make up to six similar breakfasts at once. Even then, at least one item is burned and at least one is cold or undercooked. Basically, if you see this woman serving in the morning get up and leave.

title: Excellent value in quiet location.
text: Stayed for one night in April while attending football at Wembley stadium. Very friendly service with no fuss,Breakfast very good.Nice quiet location and close proximity to buses and underground. Will stay here again

title: Very advisable
text: Ok: it is true. GL Hotel is not the Hilton. But it a very confortable place, with a great staff, and -we are speaking about London- offers a very good value for your money (a powerful breakfast is included in the price). The distance... Well: You must know where Ealing is. Certainly, it is not the downtown. But the hotel is very good linked by tube and bus with the main areas. By tube, you have two or three stops, of red, blue and green lines, ten minutes away on foot. And the train spents twenty more minutes to, for example, Westminster. I recomend to take the tube in Ealing Broadway station. The rooms. We had two times in GLHotel, and were in two double rooms, with private bath. Both of them, had an extra bed. The rooms are very ample and spacious, and we noted an extreme cleaness ever. It is true the bath is not very large, but I think that it is enough, attending its purpose. The towels were changed daily, and no problem with the hot water. Wi-Fi connection worked fine, too. In the morning, you can choose two kind of breakfast (English and continental). We prefered the English: eggs (fried or scrambled), tomate, beans, the sausage, the bacon and something like compact freies, that I had never seen, but I loved it. Of course, toast, butter, juice, jam... The breakfast is served in a confortable room, for two pleasant and very patient waitresses: thanks a lot. Well: I liked very much GLHotel. It exceeded our expectations, we save money and we did not miss anything. Of course, it is a B&B, and you choose your travel style. I choosed this, and I am very satisfied.

title: Small affordable B&B
text: (+) Grand Lodge B&B is good for those, who want to stay close to Heathrow airport. It is 15 minutes by subway and 15 minutes walk from South Ealing station to the property. B&B is located in a pretty good neighborhood of Ealing district. Ealing broadway is 10 minutes walk from the hotel. However, it takes 45-50 minutes to get to the center and it is a drawback. B&B is small, maybe 5-6 rooms. We stayed in room 4. The room is compact but has a double bed and sofa inside. Full English breakfast is excellent for those, who like heavy ingestion in the morning: eggs (cooked as you like), sausage, bacon, potatoes, tomatoes, beans, toasts. Cereals with milk, orange juice and coffee are also available. (-) Room 4 and most probably all other rooms are small and are not suitable for families with kids. There is no lift for disable people. Wi fi signal is often very bad. No AC, only a fan but in London it does not actually matter because it never gets too hot. Fruits are not fresh at the breakfast.

title: cheap place to stay
text: My daughter and I recently returned to the Grange lodge, this is the third time we have stayed. Ok lets be perfectly honest, "the Hilton this is not", if you want 5stars then don’t go here. If you are still reading, then good on you, this is a cheap place to get your head down after a long hard day. it is "no frills accommodation" but the service is great, and the staff are there for YOU, believe me when I say that the staff are some of the friendliest people I have come across in hotels. They really cant do enough for you. The rooms are clean enough, and come with clean towels every day. Although the rooms are quite small, they are big enough to be comfortable. Breakfast is good too. full english and cereals are on offer. prices are cheap and great value. This is not a 5 star hotel, but it doent pretend to be one. Its cheap, clean and affordable. I will return again and again, many thanks to the wonderful staff

title: Great B & B in a cute part of London
text: If you're looking for a decent B & B type hotel in London then this place deserves your attention. Close to exit 2 on the M4, an easy drive from there to the property where there is off street parking. Ealing Broadway underground is a 10 - 15 minute walk away and there are plenty of shops locally to get all those essential things like take-out coffee and sandwiches. Walpole park is 5 minutes away where you can sit and watch London pass you by. The place is clean and well run, with a good breakfast and for London standards a helpful and friendly staff. There is free Wi-fi too. Well worth considering, we'd go back there for sure.

title: Great Location
text: I had a single room which was of a good size, it was clean and comfortable with shared bathroom facilities. It is situated in a quit street and although under the flight path, I didn't notice any noise despite the window being open. The location was great only a 10 minute walk from Ealing Broadway rail and Tube station. It was also handy for the local pubs and cafes etc and the local shopping centre.

title: Just Perfect!
text: This was our sixth visit to this hotel - wouldn't stay anywhere else. From booking online to check in and checkout, smooth, efficient and very friendly. We had our favourite room, spotlessly clean, wi-fi, nice breakfast, attentive staff and in a fab location. Can't ask for more than that - even the weather was fantastic! Thanks to Jill and her team and we can't wait to go back.

title: Full English breakfast on far west end of London, within walking distance of Underground
text: We stayed in a small room on the top floor. We were told the room would be small, and it was, but it was fine because we weren't going to spend much time in the room besides sleeping. The room had its own bathroom and shower, a closet to hang clothes, and a desk with a small TV on it. The TV didn't get great reception and there was no fan or air conditioning for the heat in July but it was fine because we opened up the sky light and the bathroom window to let air circulate in. The room rates were a bargain, especially since you get a full English breakfast. The Underground was about 5 blocks away, so within walking distance. There was a bus stop 1 block away if someone wanted to ride the bus to the Underground. There was free WiFi available too. The staff was very friendly and willing to help with any questions about the hotel or London we had. It was a nice value and was on the outskirts of London so it did take time to get to the tourist attractions. Not a bad value, just be willing to jump on the Underground a wait a bit to get to the sites. It's worth it though if you get a nice breakfast!

title: Lovely, peaceful and great service !
text: The room, the bathrooms was very clean, everything was great ! Breakfast very lovely ! I will come back ! Definitely ! The service on the morning was really good ! Very peaceful place and quiet! Very recommend !

title: Conveniently situated B & B
text: We spend one night with our dog at The Grange it was a cosy enough room with a very small en suite bathroom. The bed was cosy and clean but unfortunately the window would only open with slat bits in it at the top one side and we were amazingly hot even though we had turned the radiator off/down. Luckily enough there was a fan in the wardrobe so we could calm and cool the dog down, he has a bad heart and was getting himself into a terrible state! Our bedroom was at the back of the house so was quite quiet we liked watching the squirrel and birds out of the window in the morning. Our bedroom door was very warped so could do with replacing. It was basic but upto London standards good we had a single and a double bed in our room. Breakfast was good, yoghurt, cereal, a bowl of fruit, cooked breakfast, toast, tea or coffee. It set us up for the day. We had only came to visit Kew Gardens to see the orchids and left our dog with a sitter from DogBuddy. The lady who greeted us was very friendly and gave us info on the bus - they only accept contactless card and oyster card by the way NO cash. The cats Boots is lovely and I so wanted to take him home in my handbag!

title: Lovely stay!!
text: I had a wonderful two nights at the Grange Lodge. I check-in a little early, but the staff was very nice and animated she told me to come back in a hour, my room should be ready by then and it was! There was a definitely that laundry mat smell (very welcoming by the way) and I rather is smell fresh and clean than stuffy and gross. I had one of the rooms on the ground floor that is right next to the dining room. My room was average size, the bathroom is literally right outside. The breakfast selection was great. the staff was lively and helpful. Internet access was free and high speed. The location of the place is pretty nice. The Ealing Broadway station is about 10mins walk. There are tons of places you can go grab some food. a little mall is around the way walking to the tube station. As a single women in their 20s, I felt very safe walking back from the station at night. I would definitely stay at the Grange Lodge again!

title: At home
text: We had a very nice stay. Delicious breakfast. Very close to the Underground Station Ealing Broadway connecting to London. You can easily walk to the restaurants or to Ealing Broadway Shopping Centre where you can find anything you need. Clean and quiet. Staff very familiar, kind and polite.

title: Brilliant location
text: We stayed here for 3 nights in November. The location is perfect for going into London every day we strolled the 10 minutes to Ealing Broadway underground station. Here you can get central line right across London and the district line. Perfect just make sure to get an oyster card, easy to get on line and set up. The welcome at the hotel could not have been warmer Lee is a treasure nothing is too much trouble. We had a triple room even though we were just a couple. The room was perfectly adequate if a bit dated. The room was also very clean and the beds were comfortable. The TV is a bit tiny but we never switched it on, too tired after a days sightseeing and a meal in Ealing. The en-suit was a bit small but the shower was good plenty of hot water. All in all good value and as I say perfect location. Breakfast is fine you can have the full English after fruit or cereal or both, or you can make up a breakfast from the items available. Endless toast and coffee. The location in a quiet leafy street is just that quiet but easy to get to the town for a meal or shopping.

title: Cheap alternative
text: Needing to stay over following a gig, I stayed at the hotel on the night before the London stage of the Tour de France was to take place, hence with the influx of visitors all the usual cheap accommodation options in the capital were unavailable forcing me to a B and B in Ealing. It is at least close to the Tube. The Grange’s best asset is the girl who seems to run it – I can only assume this was the same person others have referred to. She was bright and cheery on signing in, and also when she took care of breakfast duties next morning. As for the accommodation, the word tired sums it up. I don’t imagine the place has been decorated in decades. It was not dirty and everything seemed to be working. It was also a quiet house. I had one of the en suite rooms but the communal facilities for anyone on a tighter budget looked adequate. Breakfast was equally jaded, but edible. It was served on a cold plate which is a negative feature for me. To sum up, this is ok @ £45 for one night, but Travelodge @ £26 for early bookers (no breakfast) represents rather better value.

title: Great location and hotel
text: Stayed at this fantastic new hotel for two nights. It's part of the Grange boutique hotels. It's been newly refurbished and upgraded because you can still smell the paint. Small reception hall and narrow hallways but the room we were given was huge with all comforts: plasma TV, hi tech shower, king bed, slippers, free newspapers and magazines and butter cookies. The view from the room was awesome. The staff is very friendly and helpful., The continental buffet breakfast very yummy with a wide selection of food. I am definitely going back next month. Highly recommended
