title: Budget hotel well placed for city
text: As my husband is disabled it was a bonus to find somewhere with free parking just outside. However, it's not suitable for a wheelchair as there are steps up to the front door. Very friendly reception who helped with luggage. We used the ground floor accessible bedroom which was very clean, though the ensuite was a little too small for comfort. We were served an excellent breakfast in the room next to ours.No frills but convenient and welcoming.

title: A great place to stay
text: The check-in process was very friendly and helpful including a quick check to make sure I had parked at the hotel (free parking), rather on the road outside. The room was very clean and well equipped with a kettle, TV and a fan which was very useful on a warm evening. The bathroom was clean and toiletries were provided. I only stayed for the one night and the following morning breakfast was excellent, again delivered with a smile and excellent service.

title: good value
text: Good value for a money, a furniture is a bit old but rooms are very clean. Very quite neiberhood at night. Staff was very helpful.

title: Little Gem we found in Ealing Broadway
text: We were looking for a place to lay our head that we could drive to and then park the car free and use the underground to travel to the city where hotel prices are really high so you can only afford to stay one night. Well we arrived early and only rang the bell to say we were parked on their driveway and we will go and eat if told where to go as we were in a residential street. The lady said no worries your room is ready so lets get you checked in and then I'll give you a map showing where the town is from here about a 10 minute walk away ok. Yes the room was not ultra modern and the 19" LCD TV is something I have not seen in a long time. But for the price I paid which includes a full English cooked breakfast and free parking I for one didn't mind the look of the room. The bed was very comfortable and hot water was always there when wanted. The room was also clean. We tried to do this in another hotel in Action town and there was no mattress protector and we were woken up throughout the night by younger guests returning from night clubs. So the grange lodge hotel for us will do nicely. The breakfast was both plentiful but they also give you a choice of different ways they will cook your fried breakfast the way the eggs are cooked and items can be left off. There are cereals juices and yogurts to start with, and toast, butter and jams then a choice of tea or coffee. Everything you are offered in a higher graded hotel but will leave you much poorer after paying the bill when you leave. We will leave you to read the reviews and make your own mind up if to stay here, as we all do. But let me assure you all, we will be booking again on our next London show weekend trip ourselves. John & Sue Eastbourne UK

title: The best hotel
text: I stayed at this hotel as I had an audition at the west London university and it was only a short walk. The decision to stay at this hotel was one of the best decisions I've made. The staff were so friendly and would do anything to help. They even gave us some local takeaway menus when we were wanting to order food on the night. We were able to check in early as we informed them our coach was arriving early and they even offered to keep our bags whilst we attended our audition. It's located in a lovely area with Ealing Common not too far and with good tube links into London centre. The breakfast was lovely with a variety offered although we opted not to have the full English it was made to order which I thought was lovely. I am hoping to go back to London and when I do I wouldn't stay anywhere else because the atmosphere was simply wonderful.

title: VALUE FOR MONEY
text: An accurate rating would be 'good'. Above average purely based on the very reasonable price whereas the facilities would be classed as 'average'. The rooms are a little tired and basic but were adequate, warm and clean. The staff were hugely helpful - particularly as we had an issue in vacating until late the following afternoon. With precious little else on offer in the area we were relieved to find this one such good value for money. Free car parking is also a major asset in an area where parking is so difficult.

title: Great for value!
text: Me and my boyfriend paid £65 for one night to stay here with breakfast. The room and hotel itself is very basic but for the price we paid and the amount of time we actually spent in the hotel it was definitely worth bit! The surrounding area is very pleasant, with plenty of pubs and shops nearby, the tube station is only a ten minute walk away which is ideal for a short weekend away! The staff were friendly and helpful, they allowed me to keep my bags at the hotel even when I had checked out so that I didn't have to carry them around with me when sightseeing. Thankyou for such a lovely weekend!!

title: great B&B in a great location
text: Lovely B&B at a reasonable price. The room was very comfortable, the staff very friendly and the breakfast was really tasty. The location was excellent too, if you don't mind spending time on the Underground. I do think that the bathroom could do with a bit of updating, and the sink in the room was very slow to drain too, but these could be overlooked by the positives.

title: THIS MUST BE THE BEST VALUE IN LONDON
text: I have stayed at the Grange Lodge on 5 occasions ranging from one to three weeks in the past 11 years and have never been disappointed . The staff have always been a delight , friendly and helpful. The rooms can be compact but always clean and very comfortable , perfectly acceptable . Located in a quiet street and just 10 minutes walk from three tube stations and one railway line , every type of restaurant and pubs galore , what else would you require and at a price that is very affordable . This is a great place to stay , hopefully I will return again in the near future

title: Lovely Place
text: Great Place, Very Nice Friendly Staff, Lovely Food. All in all a great stay. Thank you very much. Lovely House cat! And Some great artwork on the walls. I would go back there again without hesitation.

title: Excelent place to stay
text: it was a very enjoyable trip with excelent accomodation. the location is easy to get to by car and has one site parking which is a bonus for a london hotel, with the tube station just a short walk away. the young lady working in the hotel was very friendly and helpful, and patient with out 100's of questions about where to go and how to get places. the room its self was very well looked after and clean as well as decorated to a pleasant standard. The beds were so comfortable that we struggle to get up in the morning, this meant we didn't get to experiance breakfast but will certainly be returning to have another attempt at breakfast!

title: Convenient hotel with free parking & friendly staff & cat
text: Stayed here for one night to attend concert in central London. Room small, but adequate. Staff very friendly & attentive & adorable resident cat. Free parking a great bonus. Free wifi much appreciated. Breakfast ample & tasty. Hotel in need of some maintenance, but fine for a short stay.

title: Convenience is worth it!
text: The last time we stayed in the Grange Lodge, there was a fair bit of mould in our en suite. We noted it in our trip advisor review. We decided to give it another try, as the location was so great. The community of South Ealing is charming. This time, we had a great room, no mould at all. The breakfast is quick and hot, and so yummy. They have a resident cat and it is adorable. We'd highly recommend staying here. It's an easy walk from the Underground to the hotel.

title: Small but comfortable
text: I've stayed at this hotel for one night. The room was small and smelled like old house but it was clean and a bed was comfortable. A breakfast was good and very nice, friendly cat was walking around :). I will stay there next time.

title: Great Staff, Affordable, Not Very Nice Accommodations
text: We spent a week here recently as we visited the city of London. The hotel is located about .85 miles from the Ealing Broadway Train Station which is a very convenient stop to get to the sites of the city. The hotel staff (particularly the week day staff) are extremely nice and helpful. The breakfast is adequate but the service for breakfast on the weekends is not as diligent and good as the weekday woman provides. The rooms are, how shall I put it, minimal. There are twin beds that are not uncomfortable but not very nice. The lodge is more of a B&B as the building has the feel of a large home. It is not dirty but not completely clean. I would say that it is probably just because it is an older building that things don't seem quite as clean as they could. Very small bathrooms even in the rooms that have them en suite. You can save a few pounds if you choose to share a bathroom. No thanks. Overall, if you are trying to save money this room with breakfast is a decent price and the staff is outstanding. I just warn you not to expect a real lodge or hotel feel to your experience.

title: Great value, easy access to London & free parking
text: We used this hotel for a night before visiting London. They let us leave the car with them whilst we were in London, which was a great....there is a "multistory" down the road which would have been £10 for the day. The hotel was a good standard for what we paid, and cooked breakfast was ok. The staff were friendly and helpful. Either Ealing Broadway (includes rail to paddington), or Ealing Common (underground) are a short walk away. There are a good few pubs/restaurants locally, which is useful. I was told that there are some rooms that are not on the main websites (Hotels.com/Booking.com etc), but these can be booked direct…..we got a small double en-suite which was cheaper than Booking.com. Would definitely use again if wanting to go to London. They also have a sister hotel - Abbey Lodge just around the corner.

title: Ready to move on...
text: We've stayed twice at the Grange. This time there was no mold in the bathroom!! The rooms are comfortable but not fancy. The breakfast is good and the staff will do lots to make your stay more comfortable.

title: Close to Heathrow, free parking
text: We always spend the first night here after our long haul flight from California. You can park your rental car and get a tube into Central London. This is a good value for money B&B. Not luxurious by any means but clean, friendly and the full English breakfast is very good. Ideal first night stop in the UK if you are landing at Heathrow.

title: GREAT location and price!
text: Good location, not far from the train station. Tipical english house with local design. Full english breakfast, clean and well lighted room, affordable. Friendly and accomodating staff. Value for money hotel.

title: London excursion.
text: Good value B and B. Clean/tidy room with free wi -fi, (clear reception) Nice breakfasts, friendly, attentive staff. Would have been a 5 out of 5 if not for cobwebs in some of the communal areas. Free parking in the grounds of Grange Lodge, located just in front of the building. This is done on a first come first serve basis. Very close to the infamous Ealing studios. Close to a large, friendly pub and close to Ealing Tube Station and numerous amenities. Grange Lodge Hotel is situated in a great location.

title: Clean, inexpensive B&B in West London
text: I booked the Grange Lodge for one night when working in London. The room was clean with tv, free wifi, comfy bed but rather dated decor and there had definitely been a smoker in the room recently. Shower was small and clean Fine for the odd night. I'd definitely come back.

title: close to Ealing Broadway.
text: Plain and simple B&B with friendly staff and good local amenities. Breakfast was very nice. It was a 10 minute easy walk from Ealing Broadway tube ( and even closer to a bus stop. Nice quiet street but lots of restaurants and shops within easy reach.

title: Good value for money
text: Location is a half-hour tube ride from the city centre, but the upside of this is a quieter night's sleep than you're likely to get in a central London hotel. For some reason it's very difficult to find budget hotels in London that do a decent cooked breakfast, but Grange Lodge is a welcome exception - ample and plenty of choice. (Note: I'm virtually certain that the review below by John W is about a different hotel, as the information about breakfasts is wrong and there was no pub across the road from Grange Lodge.)

title: We liked it
text: My boyfriend and I spent a night here last weekend. The room was large and comfortable, but when we arrived the heater was off and it was very very cold and it took very long time, after I switched it on, to warm the room up. The toilet could be better but it was clean. We enjoyed the good breakfast the morning after. (We loved the furry cat)

title: Very good for the price
text: A very pleasant and quiet location. Very impressed with the price of this hotel... I've stayed in more expensive hotels in London that weren't nearly so good. I had a single room with a shared bathroom which was fine. Breakfast was just right ( except for the cold baked beans!) with a view into the little garden. Good wifi connection too. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Lacks a few important touches
text: This Hotel has so much potential but they lack in some minor details that would make it special. The Breakfast is Continental unless you wish to order something hot, this will cost extra, which is fine because that was how the room was advertised and we had no issues on the quality and selection offered. What was disappointing and a little out of place in a Hotel of this class was Butter and Flora in little plastic pots when a ramekin of Butter would have probably cost less. Also a colleague ordered a Cappuchino which incurred an extra charge which seemed rather harsh. The final negative was whilst registering at reception they insisted on payment in full., as we were staying for two nights with a dozen other Friends and Family and wanted to use the Bar facilities this seemed rather commercially foolish, so we all de-camped to the Yorkshire Grey Pub across the road where we were all made extremely welcome

title: Good, clean B&B close to Ealing Broadway
text: I stayed here for 3 nights at the end of July and it was just what I wanted. A reasonable price for a single en-suite (although they gave me a double) close to shops, restaurants and the tube. Good choice for breakfast and I loved the full English. Wifi worked very well in Room 15 as there was a extra router located nearby. Staff were very friendly and I would definitely stay here again when in London.

title: Super
text: We stayed the first night of our honeymoon in London. The place is funky, weird, cool, and clean. We liked it, and the breakfast was good. We have no complaints...it is Spartan

title: More a Guest House than Hotel
text: Stayed here recently for a night, Nice reception on arrival, single ensuite room was on the 2nd floor. Decor of hotel a bit dated and overall could do with a big make over but then prices would be considerably higher. Quiet location and a short walk to common and tube. Nice to have waitress breakfast as hoetls i have stayed in at this price range in London is Buffet. Also free off road parking if you are early. Would stay agin.

title: Feel like home!
text: A super staff and the greatest full breakfast on earth! but the walls are very thin and you do hear things your neighbours do. So it´s a great place to be , but please take a pair of Quies with you and it Will be perfect. I loved this place , I'm sure you'll enjoy too!

title: Haven Revisited
text: I stayed at Grange Lodge Hotel about the same time one year ago. It was so welcoming , friendly, clean and comfy. I returned yesterday after a second visit and it was lovely. The French windows were open from the dining room / lounge and the garden looked beautiful in the sunshine. It all felt so calm and peaceful and I was so glad to be there. The lady who met me on arrival was lovely - gave me a great welcome.

title: The Terminator returns!
text: Back in 2012, when I first reviewed this place, I said I'd be back. I have returned in fact several times (which in itself speaks volumes) but this is the first review I've made since then. I still occupy the same small front single room as then, which is still perfectly adequate for my needs. Nobody should doubt that the GLH is as old-fashioned and unmodernised as they come, but that is exactly one of the reasons I like it! I doubt any of the furniture or fittings is post 1970, the gloss paint includes probably half a dozen layers, but the place is clean, comfortable (snug is a good word for it), quiet and with friendly staff. If you want modern chrome and smoked glass with power shower and trouser press, go fish. I slept well as I always do here - the situation is very quiet residential. My breakfast was good, though they STILL haven't cottoned on to my point of two years ago which is that it needs to be HOT rather than just warm. So I've reluctantly had to lose them a star. They have, however, reinstated the do-it-yourself toasters which I love, since I can get HOT (nb!) toast ad lib. It's also good to watch other guests nervously approaching the machines as if they were unexploded bombs. The range of comestibles (ahem) for breakfast is broad. They do you well. And my "waitress" was a charming friendly lass (from Oz?), quite unlike the old grump I'd had previously and who was the only reason I ever had cause to complain about the hotel. I paid, I think, around £40. I still believe that excellent value. So the Terminator will return again. (It doesn't apply to me who use train and tube to do The Smoke, but there is a very large private parking area out front).

title: good hotel at affordableprice
text: I spent a night in that hotel which is clean , friendly and relatively cheap. they had good break fast .on the other hand it needa sign at the street entrance and good wifi . the staff are so friendly.

title: Nice little budget hotel
text: I stayed there with a friend (each in our own separate rooms) for 5 nights. My room was small but an adequate size. Very good lighting: overhead light switch by the door, a lamp by the bed and another light over the bed with a string. Very nice for reading in bed! There was a small desk, a chair, television, tea kettle, and sink in the room. Not ensuite but I only ever had to wait once to use a toilet (and I just went downstairs and used the one there.) The tea kettle in the room looked a bit questionable so I always went down the one flight of stairs to use the one in the lounge. The lounge itself was nice: couches, chairs, lots of tourist pamphlets, another tv. There is also a microwave and toaster available for guests to use. There were always tea bags available including an assortment of herbal teas. The staff was very nice and accommodating. When I complained of being cold in my room, one of them brought me a heater to use for the remainder of my stay. They offered laundry service for a small fee, which was extremely helpful (and they even used unscented laundry detergent as we requested!) The hotel is about a 10 minute walk to Ealing Broadway, perhaps slightly longer to Ealing Common. Plenty of shops near Ealing Broadway including a Sainsbury's inside the mall, useful if you want a cheap meal to microwave back at the hotel. Wifi was a bit intermittent, and anyone severely allergic to cats needs to know there is a neighborhood cat who spends quite a bit of time inside this hotel. Very friendly cat, and it didn't bother me (I have a mild allergy to cats) but just be aware. There's no lift at this hotel but as far as I know the most stairs you could possibly have to cope with would be two flights. Let the staff know ahead of time if you have trouble climbing stairs. My traveling companion did exactly that, and she was given a room on the ground floor. I was fine being up one flight. I was happy with this hotel--quite a bit less expensive than central London but an easy trip into town. And it was very quiet: no street noise at all.

title: Hold the Mold!
text: We loved the location of The Grange Lodge B and B. It's a lovely quiet area, it felt very much at home. The ladies that we saw running the hotel, were friendly and knowledgeable. The room was small but perfectly adequate to sleep in. We stayed in one of the only rooms with an ensuite. The ensuite had a mold issue and by the time we left, I was sick. For the price of the nightly stay, it was mostly worth it--the ceiling needed a good washing and the peeling drywall with the mold behind should be removed.

title: Generally very good.
text: Good location only 10 minutes walk from Ealing Broadway tube and from there regular tube service into central London in about twenty mins. First impressions were decor and furniture is a bit dated but it was clean and the bed was very comfy with good quality mattress and bedding. En suite was small and clean and the shower was good but a little noisy. No problems with the hot water. The walls are quite thin and we heard several guests returning late, not that they were kn any way noisy just doors being opened and shut.Breakfast was ok with a selection of cereals , yoghurts and fresh fruit , apples and oranges. However only one choice of juice , orange, which ran out as did the yoghurts but no-one noticed. The cooked option was fine but not fantastic as other reviewers have stated. There was a cat allowed to roam free in the dining area which was a lovely cat but jumping up on my seat whilst I was having breakfast is not really acceptable and I could see it causing problems for some diners if they are not at ease with cats. Also found the woman serving breakfast not very friendly. All in all good value for what we paid and would recommend as long as you're standards aren't too high with the decor side of things.

title: Good location, comfy bed, free parking and great breakfast
text: Enjoyed our stay here was good for one night. Ten min walk to the train, comfy cosy doona/bed and really tasty breakfast. Wifi wasn't very good and hotel a little dated however for the price it's a bargain, plus free parking and friendly staff!

title: disappointed
text: I stayed here with a friend after reading great reviews. It is located about a 10 minute walk from the tube, which was great although the area was very quiet and lonely at night. The price was reasonable but what a dark, dingy and dated place. The room was cold so I used one of the extra blankets which had seen better days. The bathroom was in need of a refit, the sealant was peeling away from the shower tray and mould grew on the grouting. At breakfast we were served by a grumpy woman who could not even make eye contact. We had the full English breakfast and asked for the poached eggs. My friends arrived with a nice runny yolk but unfortunately the white was just as runny. I called the woman over and immediately she appeared to be on the defensive and said " whats wrong with it?" She did replace it with a new one and I did not even mention to her that I had a fried egg on my plate when I had asked for poached,she may have thrown us out! I think that this place is used by contractors as I heard alarms going off early in the morning and mens voices/doors banging. The cat was the friendliest in the house!

title: SO much better than what I expected and great breakfast!
text: I booked the hotel as I have a small cocker spanil hence I need to go in a dog friendly place. I discovered instead it to be a fantastic place: friendly staff, clean reception and rooms plus an amazing breakfast served with plenty of goodies! Rooms are nice and spacious (I had one with en suite toilet, some rooms are cheaper and with shared bathrooms) Will definitely go there soon again!

title: Nice hotel in a residential area
text: We really liked this place. Its in a residential area about 3-4 blocks from the Ealing-Broadway station. The rooms are nice and clean and the staff was pleasant, and cooked what we wanted for breakfast. It seemed very Old Europe. Between the underground station and the hotel there are many shops and restaurants.

title: Affordable and clean hotel, a bit far from the tube
text: The hotel was clean, located in a quiet, residential area. There is air traffic above, but the hotel is sound-proof. The staff was generally nice and they cook breakfast to order. I had a room with no bathroom but had no problem with the shared bathroom, possibly because there were not many people in the hotel. The main downside is that it takes at least 10 mins to go from the metro station to the hotel. Also, the closest train station is quite far from downtown London (zone 3), you need 20 mins to reach the museums area (Victoria and Albert etc) and much more to get to Westminster etc. Overall, given the price, the hotel is an excellent value.

title: Good location, simple, and cosy.
text: Stayed there 6 nights, short walk away from the underground rail. Lots of cafe and places to eat around. Staff were friendly. The room was spacious and clean. Breakfast was nice every day. All round lovely b & b.

title: Simple but perfect
text: We stayed a couple of nights in the grange lodge and had no complaints throughout our stay. With off street parking, and quiet surroundings, and wide choice available to eat in the morning - this hotel went above and beyond the specification of a bed and breakfast. Incredible value for money, extremely comfortable rooms and welcoming staff made this hotel highly desirable for both me and my family. Would highly recommend this hotel to both individuals and families alike :)

title: Comfortable and pleasant - just what was needed.
text: My husband and I went for our 5 year anniversary. Neither one of us had ever been overseas so we had no idea what to expect as far as what the norm was. To sum it up, we really enjoyed our stay. Here are some points to be made: 1) We stayed for 7 nights and got a discounted rate - 350 BP - very affordable

title: Good for the price
text: An odd place but it was cheap and convenient, so gave it a try. Free off street parking determined my choice. It's is fine, no frills, clean enough, no issues. The shared bathroom wasn't a problem as I think only one other room shared it. Yes, the decor is old, tired, 60's, a bit shabby and a total makeover would be good BUT it is not depressing, things work, bed linen of quality and very, very crisp and clean. I'd use it again, in need.

title: Cozy, close, quaint and worth every penny!
text: I just returned home after a week in London. But I felt very much "at home" at the Grange Lodge Hotel while in London! We booked our stay weeks in advance which was not only comforting, but very efficient and trouble-free. The staff was accommodating and the room was quaint and clean. The full English Breakfast gives new meaning to "bed-and-breakfast"! But most enjoyable was the fact that the hotel is only 15-minutes by The Tube (subway) from the heartbeat of central London. The area was near the University of London West so it had a vibrant neighborhood of eclectic restaurants and shopping areas--for young and old alike. Families strolled the streets at night and early-risers were greeted by birds and joggers. I highly recommend this facility to anyone traveling around London. Come once--and you'll come back "home" again and again......

title: Good spot in London!
text: My friend and I stayed here in October for 6 nights and thoroughly enjoyed it. The room was comfortable, quite reasonably priced for London too! Despite being a tube ride from the centre of the city (~20 minutes) it is a pleasant place to stay, with a few pubs and restaurants around, as well as the Ealing Common. The free Wi-Fi was welcome, and the complimentary breakfast was excellent too. Tea & coffee facilities were also available in the rooms. All the employees there were very pleasant as well. Would certainly recommend if you don't mind being away from the chaos of central London!

title: Still My Go-To Place in London
text: Have stayed at the Grange Lodge Hotel any number of times since early 2010, with my most recent stay being during Easter, 2013. I always book a single with shared bath. Never any issues using the shared bathroom which is actually separated into two separate rooms, one room with toilet and another room for shower/bathtub. Hotel staff is great and always helpful, a real plus is the cooked-to-order breakfast every morning! Ealing may seem a bit far from central London but it's only a twelve-minute ride on National Rail to Ealing Broadway and about double that amount of time on the Central, District and Piccadilly lines of the London Underground (the last from South Ealing Station). Any number of nice eateries and shopping nearby the hotel.

title: Poor accommodation - not to be recommended
text: My husband and I stayed here for two nights, 22nd and 23rd March 2013. The good points were the on site parking and the cooked breakfast, and that it was cheap. However the room (room 4) was very poor. Poor decor and furnishings which would not appear to have been updated since the 1970's. One curtain was hanging off the curtain rail in places. In addition, grubby walls, paper starting to peel from the ceiling, bed linen that was very old, stained, and the top sheet had a hole in it. The pillowcases were crumpled and unironed, and covering exceedingly old pillows. The room was not very clean. The ensuite was as tiny as possible and again very dated with bubbling lino where it would seem water has seeped underneath. The tiles were not all the same size round the basin and had not been sealed into the basin, and the tiny washbasin was dirty with broken plug chain. This establishment markets itself as a hotel but I would suggest it is a very poor B&B. Overall, not to be recommended unless you are desperate.

title: Great pied-a-terre!
text: This is a super little b & b with several parking spaces. The double en suites are spacious and offer free Wi-Fi, TV and tea & coffee making facilities. The breakfast is freshly cooked, and there is also toast, cereal, fruit juice and tea/coffee. There is a small lounge with TV and a selection of books. This hotel also provides a microwave and crockery/cutlery so you can bring food back with you: (there is also an outdoor covered smoking area). Ealing centre is a few minutes stroll away, has all the High Street stores plus plenty of eateries, bars and clubs. Ealing Broadway Station is approx. 10 minutes walk and from here you can be in Central London in less than half an hour. If you are looking for 4 or 5 star accommodation, this is not for you, but the hotel is clean, smoothly run and in a great location. We have stayed here five times and will be back next year! A trip to Southall is a must. Ten minute bus ride from Ealing (bus nos. 207, 427 and 607). The array of fruit and veg is unbelievable, and great shops selling magnificent saris, jewellery, shoes and handbags, and much much more! A great atmosphere, especially on a Sunday (after 12 noon) well worth a visit.

title: Great place to stay
text: My third stay at the Grange ( Usualy 2/3 weeks ea ) was as usual a most pleasant experiance . The staff are very helpful and kind , the rooms are compac t , but are clean and comfortable with a good shower and a kettle for that late night cuppa . The Grange is in a nice area and quiet , a few minutes from the tube and a good selection of resturants.The breakfasts keep me going until dinner . I look forward to another visit inm 2012 Andy New Zealand

title: Good value, but not the best
text: We were looking for a budget hotel near our daughter who is living in Ealing. It was difficult to find something reasonable in Ealing, that wasn't too expensive. We chose the Grange Lodge Hotel, and it was ok. Not fantastic. We had a room on the second floor, and while the room was tastefully furnished and comfortable, with a lovely aspect to the backyard, Our requirements are basic, decent sleep, decent shower, and good food. The bed was comfortable, (although the walls are a little thing), and the breakfast was good. Cooked fresh, eggs anyway you liked them. I had poached eggs both mornings, and they were well cooked. Coffee wasn't the best. The shower though, was a problem. If you showered in the morning (which we did on both mornings), the water was cold. It was as if the boiler or whatever was not big enough to handle the hot water requirement. The Sunday night I had a shower, and the water was lovely and hot. I also didn't feel as well looked after here. The previous weekend we had stayed in another hotel and felt really welcomed and looked after. There is no-one at reception when you come and go here, and because of that it made less of an impression. But as far as the basics go, it's reasonable value for money (so long as they get the water situation fixed).

title: You get what you pay for
text: Easy to find and a short way off the main roads, this hotel immediately gives the impression of having had hard use and has a 'care worn' look to it. Our room key took several tries to make it work and once inside we were presented with a wealth of fresh air due to the missing glass louvre panel in the top window. Closer inspection revealed the missing piece on the flat roof outside and it looked as if someone had tried to reach it by digging the rotten wood out of the bottom of the window frame, leaving a hole in the frame over a foot long and deep enough to take the entire first joint of my index finger. The bedside shelves were loose and liable to jettison anything put upon them until I had been around with a Swiss Army knife tightening the few screws up, making them just about secure enough for their purpose. The 'en suite' was little more than a cupboard the width of a shower tray - inside was the shower with a curtain that didn't reach the floor, a hand basin (suitable named because it would hold barely more than a handful of water) and a toilet which flushed noisily and took ages to fill. I found it impossible to use the basin with the door shut

title: Excellent hotel
text: Very nice hotel £98 for 2 Nights in London a good place about 25 minutes from London City centre but lots of stuff to do on Ealing for those who don't want to go into the town centre for restaurants or night clubs

title: Like visiting a friend in outer London :-)
text: Lovely "bed and breakfast like" small "good value" hotel in a quiet residential neighborhood 10 min walk to shopping, green areas and tube/busses. Good safe family like atmosphere with other costumers and staff. Enjoy the hazzle of London city and recooperate in Ealing. Take a double-decker bus (no 65) from Ealing to the nearby beautiful Kew Gardens and Richmond (by the Thames river and meadow walkways). And visit the bohamian Notting Hill and classy Kensington High Street in one strike by short tuberide to Nottinghill Gate. If you are not just a city-lover - you can not beat the location of this hotel.

title: buisness trip
text: stayed at the grange lodge hotel on 31st october.situated in a good position for central london just off the north circular and plenty of pubs and take aways within easy walking distance.I was greeted on arrival by Anna who was polite ,efficient and went out of her way to assist me with some faxes i needed to get back to my office.I cannot speak highley enough of Anna who is a credit to her employers she went the extra mile to ensure I was a happy customer.The breakfast was excellent with plenty of choice.Would def stay here again.

title: Fantastic value for money in great location
text: My husband and I along with our 7 month old baby stayed for 1 night, although at time of booking the only available room was a small double, Jill at the hotel was so helpful and made sure we would have everything we needed on arrival inorder to make our stay as comfortable as possible, down to making sure the room would be ready for me to feed our baby in when we got there around lunchtime. The room was all ready with a cot and bedding all set up, the room was clean and actually not as small as I was expecting which was great! Perfect for our needs. We were able to store our buggy downstairs in the lounge rather than lugging it up the stairs and a highchair was put out for our use. Breakfast was great and the staff really friendly, on site parking was also a bonus. Ive never found it easy to find reasonable decent accommodation in London but will most definitely keep the details for this hotel as a fab find and great value for money, for the next time we venture up to the big smoke from Devon! Many thanks Jill

title: Great Hotel
text: This is a little gem of a hotel in Ealing. The hotel is about a 10 minute walk from the Ealing Broadway train and tube stop. Heathrow Connect Stops here and is a short 20 min ride. One note is that if you are arriving or leaving on a Sunday the trains only run once an hour. Ealing offers a lot of restaurant options. My favorite was the Haven Arms Pub, a short walk north of the station. The rooms are decent size and clean. Its a little bit on the older side, but well maintained. I stayed in a room with a shared bath. There is sink in the room which is handy. I had no problem with the shared bathroom. The breakfast is the typical English breakfast with toast, eggs, tomato, hash brown, bacon, and sausage. The staff will cook the egg any way you want. There is also yogurt, cereal, and fruit. The staff is great. They are friendly and take care of anything you need. Overall it was great place to stay and I definitely would stay here again when I am back in London.

title: Good Location - Fair Accomodations
text: The Grange Lodge is a short 15 minute walk from the Ealing Broadway or Ealing Common Stations, 2 lines that are easily accessible from Heathrow Airport. If you arrive between 10am and 8pm, you may want to select Ealing Common Station, as Ealing Broadway Features a route of Restaurants and Shopping and can be quite busy if you are toting luggage. The hotel is on a residential block, and you may find yourself thinking you are on the wrong path until suddenly there it is. We arrived at the Hotel early, due to an overnight flight - they do not accomodate early check in, so we found a nearby Starbucks to drink coffee and use the free internet to pass the time. As mentioned in other reviews, the staircases are narrow, but this did not pose a problem for us, as we had packed light for the trip. The room was of a good size for a European room and the beds were comfortable. The room was clean, and a TV with many channels was provided as well as a coffee maker. The bathroom was tiny, but functional. I myself had to step out of the bathroom after using, as I found maneuvering in there resulted in bashed elbows and knees. Breakfast was average. They prepare eggs, sausage/bacon, hash brown, tomatoes, beans, and toast to order. The food tasted ok, it wasn't great and it wasn't bad - for breakfast it served the purpose. There was also cereal, yogurt and fresh fruit provided. We did not leave the lodge hungry before venturing out. The neighborhood is nice, and seems safe. We were able to find restaurants within a 5 to 15 minute walk, and there is a shopping center 10 minutes walk away that can suit many needs. Wireless internet at the hotel was great, it had enough bandwidth where we could use Skype and IP phone applications to keep in touch with home. There is a neighborhood cat that waits by the doors, not sure if she is owned by the hotel or a neighbor. We didn't let her in, but we did give her attention. She is very lovable and friendly, and a nice addition for those of us pet lovers who pine for our animals at home. We'll definitely consider the grange for a future London trip. Though an old hotel, it was clean and functional, and had enough in the neighborhood to keep us busy, as well as stations nearby to get us anywhere in London.

title: Nice for the Price & Loved the Breakfast Lady
text: Stayed 3 nights in this little hotel....located in a residential neighborhood, but close to the tube and Ealing shops and eats....We paid $780 for 2 rooms for 3 nights....2 family rooms that would sleep 3 in each...the British breakfast, which is included was excellent as you had eggs, bacon, sausage, beans, toast and tea...also had juice and cereal. The Breakfast lady was wonderful....all of the staff were very helpful. Nothing fancy but the hotel was clean and we had no problems. The only thing is the showers are not very good....no pressure, but a bath is available across the hall if you can't get the shower to work for you. It is more like a B&B so don't expect a regular hotel stay. Free Parking as we had a rental car. Overall it was a great stay!
