title: Great value for money
text: Great value for money. Basic but free wifi, decent breakfast and 25 mins to London on the tube. Would stay again.

title: Good hotel in outer London
text: This is a nice little hotel in a residential neighborhood in the suburb of Ealing. Since it was made by combining several row houses, it has an eccentric layout and the rooms have shared toilets and bathrooms. However, my room did have its own sink. I stayed there because I had a friend living in the neighborhood, but this could make a low priced base for touring the city. It only cost me 33 GBP per night and was only a 7 minute walk from the Ealing Tube Station. The place is staffed 24/7 with a live in manager who took care of everything--fixing breakfast to cleaning rooms. She was very helpful and friendly. If you are willing to travel on the Tube each day, this may make a nice, quiet place to stay for your visit in London.

title: Not bad but definitely NOT great
text: Aside from price, which was good considering what it costs to stay in a hotel in London, the Grange Lodge was not a fabulous stay for us. Amber greeted us on our first day and she was super nice. When we got to our room, it wasn't exactly how the pictures portray it to be...it's quite budget, but not a problem. The problem was the cat urine smell of our bathroom. It was awful. There was mould on the shower tiles, the fan was quite loud and the toilet ran forever (we were in Room #10). I was happy to have our own bathroom but there was a definite price to pay for that. After our first night, we seriously contemplated going elsewhere. The next morning at breakfast, which was your standard English fare, we were greeted by a very unfriendly, surly woman. I don't know what her name was but she didn't even say "good morning"

title: Couldn't ask for more for the price!
text: After reading the range of reviews on Trip Advisor, my mother (78 yrs. old) and I (43 yrs. old.) decided that Grange Lodge Hotel sounded like a good choice for the money, and it was. We didn't expect frills, and we didn't get them, but we DID get a warm welcome, a clean room with comfortable beds, attached bathroom which was small, but clean, and a hearty breakfast to start each day. I was a bit frightened of the woman serving breakfast after reading the other reviews, but she was pleasant enough, and far from rude. The B & B was on a very quiet residential street, but a short walk (2-3 blocks) from great restaurants and shops. The Underground (subway) that will take you to London is about a mile walk from the B&B, but it was a walk filled with the sights and sounds of Ealing, so it didn't seem like a mile until we were coming home from a long day in London and were tired. What was nice was staying in a quiet neighborhood after spending a long day in the busy city. I would definitely stay here again! If you're looking for an inexpensive place to stay while visiting London, you've found it at the Grange Lodge Hotel!

title: Reasonable place
text: I stayed here for almost a week. The location is good-less than 10 minutes from the tube station, from where you can get to the main attractions in less than 30 minutes. The lounge area is cosy, there are lots of books and the WiFi connection is great (does not work in the room!). The bed in my single ensuite room was unbelievably uncomfortable-I could feel every single spring in my back. The rooms are thinner than paper. One night I was kept up all night by someone snoring in the room next door-this should not be heard through a wall! I was not particularly impressed by the breakfast. You choose your own cereal, but they are individually packaged which is incredibly environmentally unfriendly. Then you order what cooked food you would like to eat. I think a serve-yourself buffet works much better. I kept getting only 1/2 a tomato despite asking several times for a couple (in the hope I would get one whole one!). The eggs were sometimes cold, the tea not very good quality-and the orange juice was also really quite gross. The staff were mostly pretty friendly and helpful, but I found it odd that my bed was made only approximately every second night. The hotel is well priced, I must admit. If you are after just a place to sleep, and are on a budget, then this is as good a place as any.

title: A reasonable place to stay but needs some care and attention
text: We stayed at the Grange Lodge for 6 nights and found it to be Ok, though with a bit more effort it could be a lot better. We feel that the hotel is reasonable for the price that we paid - approx 60GBP per night. The room was smallish and the bathroom tiny. The decor throughout the hotel was a bit dated and we felt that there was a lack of care to much of it. For example, the shower had a shelf that was too high and not fixed on properly so that it leant down at an angle and was useless to put anything on. It would be very easy to fix minor things like these but no-one had bothered. The room was furnished with 2 very faded chairs and a table. It also had a small chest of drawers which would have been very useful however it was placed such that the drawers could not be opened. Another example of lack of care abut the room. Breakfast was quite good. A selection of cereals plus a cooked breakfast of Bacon, eggs, sausage, beans, tomato and hash browns. The location is also quite good. It is within a very short walk to shops and cafes - though we arrived 2 days after the London riots and some were still closed. Ealing Broadway station is less than 10 mins walk away and will take you in to central London in about 30 minutes. Overall, it is not a bad place to stay for the price however it could be a lot better with some care and attention.

title: Nice area, OK hotel
text: I can agree with all the other reviews written here. Grange Lodge Hotel is a B&B rather than a hotel.It is two large houses converted into one. Amber is very friendly and served breakfast on the Sunday making breakfast a far more pleasent experience. ( yes the other lady is a bit grumpy.) The room was clean and adequate for our stay but as it is a converted house there was a lot of noise from the guests on the floor above late at night. Every step sounded like they were clog dancing. The street the hotel is situated on is very quiet and residential and felt very safe. What I saw of Ealing seemed very pleasent and I would visit again but would consider staying elsewhere. Also I would stay nearer central London.

title: Very friendly staff, excellent location, great price
text: I was visiting London from the US and decided to stay at Grange Lodge mainly for the close proximity to Heathrow. I arrived at around 8am on a Sunday, and even though check-in isn't until 11 the staff was very welcoming. They let me sit in the lounge and use the wifi until my room was ready and even offered coffee or tea. When somebody extends a courtesy like that it shows that their customers are always priority number one. You won't get that kind of warmth at any of the major corporate hotel chains. The building itself is very quaint and cozy, located on a quiet street in Ealing. Ealing has everything you need, including walking distance to the tube and trains. The room I stayed in was a little small, but it was more than enough considering I was traveling solo and just need a place close to Heathrow to crash for a few nights. Breakfast was excellent. Wide variety of everything, and the service is as prompt as can be. Unlike another corporate hotel I stayed at for a night, the wifi at Grange Lodge is free and the signal is excellent. I'm really happy I decided to stay here. Any other time I go to London in the future, this is where I'll be staying.

title: Home away from Home
text: It's offers a homely ambience, with a cosy room & bed and my room overlooking the backyard garden with soft breeze and plenty of greenery. The Lodge provides a good full breakfast with a variety of cereal, toast, ham and bacon, eggs, baked beans, hash potato, fruits, coffee/tea. It is a refreshing change from busy London hotels or noisy hostels. There are limited rooms, so it is quite peaceful and quiet. The Lodge is about 10 minutes walk from Ealing Broadway train stationary and Ealing shopping area (includes Mark & Spencer). Travelling to London is about 30 minutes.

title: Great for visiting London
text: I stayed at the Grange Lodge Hotel for four nights in April 2012 during a trip to the UK to visit prospective universities.The Grange Lodge had good breakfasts, good beds, good wifi, and good bathrooms. The key determinant in my decision to stay at the Grange Lodge was price. There are many London hotels that charge as much in one night as the Grange Lodge charges for four. On a student budget, the downtown London prices are not reasonable. Yet, by using the Grange, I was able to visit all of the fantastic graduate programs of interest in London, as well as the British Museum, the National Gallery, St. Paul's, and Big Ben. From the Grange Lodge I was easily able to walk up to the Ealing Broadway train station (bought an 'Oyster' transit card in advance). There were frequent underground trains into the core of London--I was never waiting more than ten minutes. On average it took me about half an hour to get from the Grange Lodge to the downtown universities (UCL, LSE, Birkbeck, and KCL). If you might have similar interests, don't be thrown off by the location of the Grange. It is clearly out of the downtown core in terms of location, but the price cannot be beat. I got off to a great start each day, well-rested, well-fed, and into downtown London on time. Thanks again to the staff!

title: Excellent value!
text: For the price, you cannot beat this hotel! As mentioned before, it's more of a big B & B, but for 50 GBP per night for the two of us, it was excellent value. The breakfast was very good, although somewhat inconsistent. Some days there were tons of baked beans, some days about 5, only once did we have tomato, and often the orange juice had run out and we had a bit of a wait for replacement. But you know what? If you want the Ritz, go pay for it. The room was large, immaculately clean, looking out to the tiny garden. The shower situation has been sorted with 'boosters' installed to give a really good hammering (although they make a heck of a noise when operating). There was a lovely comfortable lounge to sit in next to the breakfast room, although we never used it as we were out all day. Very close to the station and on the central line, so it wasn't a schlepp to and from the city centre. My only complaint would be the receptionist, Natalie, who blew hot and cold the whole week we were there. Although I had notified them of our arrival time, late Sunday afternoon, her whole attitude when we arrived was one of us having disturbed her Sunday afternoon. She's an ex South African, but didn't raise a glimmer of a smile when I remarked on the South African cricket shirt she was wearing. When I asked where she came from and how long she had been there she reacted as if I was delving into her deepest darkest history. Looked very shocked at breakfast when I asked if we could have our morning coffee after we had eaten (gets cold if it is served before, and we like to drink it after). Then she'd be quite reasonable (I would never class her as very friendly) and warn me about the bus strike on for the day, which I appreciated. She was also very unhappy when I paid at the end of the week, and she asked for the 5 GBP for the load of washing she had done for us in cash. When I said I had spent all my pounds as we were on our way to Switzerland, she was very unhappy. She took the payment on my card, but it left a nasty taste in my mouth. I also felt her attitude towards non English speakers wasn't good, she got quite frustrated when she battled to communicate with them at breakfast time (she does all the cooking, and very well too, I have to give her that). However, we were not there for Natalie, and I would very much recommend this place for an incredibly reasonable place to stay. Don't let her get to you, you have very little to do with her anyway, and enjoy the convenience, cleanliness and comfort of this super place.

title: Good place, budget rooms
text: Last year in June I stayed for a long weekend in London again. Didnt like to pay lot of money in the CBD like the other trips. I figured out that place between CBD and Heathrow. Budget rooms, you get what you need and good English Breakfast. Its a 10 Minute walk to train station to get into London. Ealing Broadway is a peacefully place and many good restaurants on the Main Street. No need to have dinner in London itself. I had a single room with sharing bathroom & toilet. If you are all day away and just need your bed and the breakfast its a perfect place.

title: decent place for the price
text: I've stayed at the Grange four times over several years and it is a predictable place. Good full breakfast, clean if dated rooms, good showers, and quiet surroundings. The internet is free and worked well for me. Don't expect luxury but if you just need a simple place top rest in pricey London, (and don't mind a twenty minute train ride to Paddington), then this is a good choice. I like it partly because it is close to good Indian restaurants.

title: Wonderful experience, true England in one small hotel!
text: The value you get for price in this hotel is really great. This hotel is very cosy, the building itself is charming, true English style. The rooms are rather spacious, the in-room shower may be a bit small, but if you are a tiny person, it's gonna be ok. As far as I noticed, the shower rooms in the corridor are more roomy. The interior of the rooms is just fine to meet the demands of the traveller: bed, armchair, table, wardrobe. There are cups and small teakettle in the room, as well as tea and coffee. The TV has about 5 channels, just ok for getting recent news. The breakfast is very good, it is basically full English breakfast - corn flakes, eggs, ham, sausage, beans, tea/coffe, juice. The staff is very helpful and friendly, especially Sarah, who really is a service-oriented person. The area where the hotel is located, Ealing, is quiet, but at the same time there are several nice shops, restaurants and pubs around. It is really close to the tube Ealling Broadway station, which is on the Central line, so you can rather quickly approach the center of the city. It's about 10 minutes walk from the hotel to the tube station.

title: Great Hotel
text: Situated in Shepherd Bush (London), this small hotel was our booked venue for 6 nights. We were greeted by the front office and also gave us a choice of 2 rooms to choose from. We were granted the room before the Checkin time.Having been in London for a number of times, I was surprises with the size for the room (for 3) as normally the size would be half of what we were allocates. The room had a capacity of 4 people (we were 3). It was very clean and the room was cleaned on a daily basis. Good continental breakfast was served until 10am and we also had free wifi. The staff (maids, front office, breakfast) were all very friendly. The prices was also reasonable considering that werl were there during holiday season. I highly recommend.

title: Small room and poor breakfast
text: This hotel is a big house of many small rooms. The reception is friendly and provides free Wi-Fi. Our room had a tiny but nice bathroom with a lovely big mirror and a power shower. The toilet was rather cramped in the bathroom. The carpet wasn't very clean but the room wasn't the worst I have ever stayed in. The breakfast was a poor version of a continental (I was in Rome recently and know what a good continental looks like). I was offered some toast and after a while some croissants and tea. I felt we were not looked after the way some other tables were and this was unacceptable. I had to ask for tea and they didn't do Earl Grey. They also had some hard boiled eggs and gave our table some cheese. There was no cold meats offered. I paid £85 for a night in the week - The best thing I can say about the Grantly Hotel is that its location for the Shepherd

title: Don`t expect too much
text: I booked the rooms in the hotel`s website. It left an impression of a large hotel, as it had the booking system in their www, and after booking i received a message to my email...When we arrived there, it turned out that their "booking system" is a notebook:) We had two rooms - Double and Quadraple. Double room was the size of a closet, bathroom was so small that only slim people can use it. Quadraple room was large enough for three people, also the toilet was a little bit larger. Furniture was old, but it is ok if you don`t expect fancy design. Breakfast wasn`t self-service. Instead there are two ladies that bring you tea/coffee, toast, boiled eggs, etc...It is time consuming if there are many people in breakfast room. Food choice wasn`t too large. Location of the hotel is very good, unless you want to live in the very centre of London. A few minute walk to metro station. There are possibilities to eat outside, also cinema, and a nice pizzeria right next to the hotel (when we stayed there, it had a good deal for take-away pizzas). We tried to pay by card (website said that it is possible to pay with credit/debit cards), we tried two cards, but it didn`t work out. So we had to pay in cash. All in all, if your priority is not a fancy hotel, you can stay there. But next time i will definitely search for another hotel.

title: Perfect location
text: + Perfect location, good breakfast, newly renovated bathroom. - Old dirty bedding, old damaged furniture

title: Never again
text: Horrible hotel with sombien staff. Dirty low class hotel that don` deserve one star at all. Never had an worse experiens in my traveling life. Toielett was in pieces and the hoower stood in the midle of the room when we etered the room. It was dirty and the towels + bedlinnen had stains.

title: Great hotel for a short visit
text: We spent 2 nights in this hotel for a concert at the Hammersmith Apollo, and the hotel was just perfect for this - only a 20 minute walk from the venue and other nice locations. The beds were wonderful and the rooms were cleaned daily. Kind staff and good service. The only thing we thought was a bit troublesome was the bathroom light, which worked via a sensor. The light went on and off quite often if we didn't move enough, which meant we had to flail our arms a lot if we didn't want to brush our teeth in the dark! Apart from that, lovely place to stay.

title: Horrible!
text: The staff was unhelpful and the rooms were dirty, bedsheets were stained. When my friends had been in their room for about one hour the owner told them that they had to leave room in 2 minutes, they got another room but there was no explanation. Breakfast was bad.

title: Grantly Hotel is great value!!
text: I needed a single room in Shepherds Bush London for just one night. Knowing the prices of hotels (and indeed things in general) in London I was startled to see that the Grantly Hotel charges only £35 for a single room including breakfast. I almost discounted staying there as I figured something that cheap couldnt be any good. How wrong I was! The hotel is great! The reception area was spotless, bright and smelled of nice polish. The owner was friendly and helpful. I found my room to be superb value for my needs! The room was very clean, it had an ensuite bathroom with a great hot shower, remote control TV with teletext, comfy bed with crisp white sheets......ideal! I didnt stay for the breakfast as I had a long journey home and wanted to miss the traffic, but I'm sure it would have been fine if the rest of the hotel was anything to go by. I would recommend the Grantly Hotel to anyone, and will certainly be staying there again myself. £35 must be bargain of the decade!!!!!!

title: Great weekend
text: We spend there a weekend, from Friday to Monday, and it was great! Everything was awesome! Staff, location, price, breakfast, room was cleaned every day, new towels every day. Underground station Sheperds bush nearby, 2 fare zone. 10 minutes to Oxford street....:) New furniture, new bathroom...:) Very comfortable beds.

title: Away for weekend.
text: Had to get a few tubes from our station to shepherd's Bush but not too far to walk from tube to hotel.2stops away from Notting hill.where we went to portebello market.hotel as cheaper than in the city as it was school holidays and more expensive.staff very good.room ok.couldnt turn heating down and as hot.double bed was against the wall so couldn't get in and out easily to toilet in night .would have to crawl over partner!so partner slept in single bed in the room and I took the double!!!!!breakfast was really nice .staff also.manager too.ok for one night

title: Perfect location for Shepard’s bush empire
text: Stayed for one night and chosen purely for location. Check in was easy and there is free WiFi Room was basic and a little tired. Breakfast in morning was in a different building and was a continental offering. If you want something basic just to rest your head then this is a good little place for the money

title: Great location but quite old and not that clean
text: This hotel is perfect for going to a concert at the Empire, just across the street! The staff at reception was very helpful and nice. They seem to be there 24h but at night they are sleeping, so you won't find anyone at the desk. My room had a decent size, en-suite (the bathroom looked newer than the rest. Took me a while to realise that the light in it was automatic, so you can't switch it off and the ventilation fan is kind of noisy. The bed was comfy but quite small. There was a TV, a kettle, a small cup and a glass. Also a fan and a heater (that smelled a bit like burnt). Plugs near the bed. A mirror, a desk, a table and a shelf completed the tired furniture. The day after they saved my suitcase very nicely and put a sticker with my room number on it. However, when I picked it up I did it myself from a room and I could have taken any suitcase there. You have breakfast included but have to go to a building next to this. The breakfast room is downstairs. It's a basic breakfast, but they give you fresh toasts, coffee/tea, juices, cheese… They also offered croissants and buns but wasn't too hungry. On the negatives: My room was a basement one, so not much light, no view and a bit of a damp smell. Very narrow basin in the toilet. The cleanliness wasn't great in general, there was quite a lot of dust around and the kettle was old and a bit rusty. The hair dryer looked quite dirty. Inside my wardrobe there were a lot of things, including old dusty telephones and other stuff that was stored in there. Didn't use it because of that. Overall a nice place, but needs some deeper cleaning and refurbishing for being really good.For the price, it could be at least a bit better.

title: Terrible
text: Checked in 930pm the air con wasnt switched on in the room. It was 28 degrees! I played with the box in the room said it was controlled by master box. I called the manger he was messing around with it for a further 20mins even tho i told him you cant control it in the room. He called another guy who messed around another 15mins on the computer. At whivh point i had the leave the room i was so hot. They set it the temp i wated it and i waited another 10-5 mins withe door open for it to cool. By 1045 i was ready for bed the room was still on 26 so i tequested a room change. The manager told me just to wait for the room to cool, it was late i had been on a 5hr train journey so i demanded a room change. At which point they started acting extremely put out and was quite rude to me. The new room was a more tolerant temp but was very unclean! The windows were sash style and single glazed which ment it sounded like the main road was in the room! I had no sleep whatso ever and couldnt wait to leave. Breakfast however was very pleasant.

title: the staff here - just aint botherd !
text: i stay regular at the grantly hotel and i really dont know why i keep going back. well i do, i only stay there because of the location , which is exellent. the place had had a makeover , which has improved the place. the main problem here is the general attitude of the place and staff. i ill try to list the problems - there are loads lol 1. tiny cramped rooms 2. general hygene 3. pathetic breakast - 2 girls serve what they call "continental breakfast" which if your lucky you might get a boiled egg. 4. the staff here work on a basis that youll only stay once , so they aint botherd if you enjoy your stay or not. in conclusion , you pay your money and take your chances. i do stay there, but only because i need that location, if i didnt , id never stay here

title: Great value for money
text: I´ve been staying at the Grantly hotel for 6-7 times. It´s a small hotel, very small rooms and not the kind of place you want to show your wife. Then again, if you´re on your own, or going on a trip with your mates, it´s perfect. Cheap nights, clean rooms. I mean, why pay the GBP 100 plus for a room you´re staying in for the night only? These rooms will set you back for GBP 60 per person. Located in the Shepherds Bush Green, you´ll have two options for subway transport, very easy access from Heathrow via underground, or Heathrow Express to Paddington, then the Hammersmith and City line to Shepherds Bush. When in Shepherds Bush, eating out is cheaper than in the town centre. You´ll also have short and easy access to on of the largest shopping malls in Europe, Westfield.

title: The room was filthy
text: The coffee table and the table where the Kettle and cups were place was absolutely thick with dust, you could draw a picture with your finger. The carpet was also dirty and not hoovered. There was no way could I stay in that room.

title: Good place in a strategical position
text: The hotel is situated in Shepherd's Bush Green: so it is just a short walk away from the tube station

title: Good hotel at reasonable price in London
text: There are several key advantages for this hotel: location is great with easy access to metro and buses. We liked the surrounding as well - a great mixture of popular area with a nice/big mall nearby and excellent restaurants very close to the hotel. The staff was nice and helpful. The room itself was a big small but I have to say big as per London standard. We were located in the newly refurbished building so it looked all pretty good. One of the big plus as well is the parking which is extremely practical (need to pay extra but fully worth it) But, we had issues in the first day with the cleaning of the room - it was not done properly when we arrived and on the second day (we stayed for 5 days) but feedback was given to the manager and it was then sorted. The isolation of the rooms is let say not the best but not too bad neither. The breakfast is correct with toast, boiled eggs, croissant, cereals so good enough for us. I would go back again for the location

title: Friendly staff
text: I chose this place due to only a 10min walk to the tube and bus station. You can catch a bus to close to the Natural History and Science Museums. (Great option when some of the tube lines are closed for works.) Also directly to Big Ben (although it’s undergoing major renovations and is covered in scaffolding). I had a room (42) slightly below ground level and above the breakfast room, only bother to me was the noise of emergency vehicle’s sirens going past in the night. It needs some minor maintenance (leaking kitchen sink sap and very loose toilet seat). Also found the staff to be friendly and helpful. Breakfast was good - boiled egg, toast, croissants, juices, tea/coffee, cereals. (There is a M&S Simply at the BP servo nearby for fruit and snacks.)

title: Great location but good service
text: We were at this hotel for 3 nights with our two kids. The location was excellent. 5 minits walk from the subway and so many shops with different types of foods. Several convenience stores to buy water, fruits, snacks and beer. It’s less than 5 minits walk to the Westfield mall which had quite a few sit down restaurants, food court and many shops. The neighbourhood felt safe till it’s dark. After it got dark there were people hanging out with alcohol in the park so I would avoid walking in the park after dark. The hotel had two sections. One section was newly renovated with nice floors and air condition and the other section was being renovated. We were given a room in the section where some rooms were being renovated. The carpet was full of dust and there was no air conditioning. After a long day of walking in the heat we had to walk into a room that felt like a sauna. The fan didn’t help much and it was in our way all the time because the room was small and with luggage the fan was a nuisance. At 8.30 am or even earlier the construction workers started nailing the wall next room which was so annoying. The room was facing the back with nothing. Toilet was fairly clean and the rooms were arranged and new towels kept daily. The breakfast was ok with bread, eggs, cheese and tea. Nothing out of the ordinary. The woman at the breakfast place was very nice and made us feel welcome. The sign in was easy. The staff was friendly and nice. I would definitely stay here again but I will make sure I get a room in the newly renovated section.

title: Just what I was looking for
text: Like a number of other reviewers I was looking for a reasonably priced room for one night as close as possible to the Shepherds Bush Empire. The Grantly couldn't be more convenient! It's only 200 yards away. I booked a single room and I was very impressed with it. It was quite small but it had everything I needed, including a spotless en-suite shower room. Breakfast was quite basic but it was served in a bright, cheerful manner by friendly staff. When I go up London again I wouldn't hesitate to book a room here again. All in all I had a great time.

title: Grantely Hotel - BEWARE!
text: My husband and I stayed there last weekend and paid £75+. The place is a dump. From the outside it looks quite nice however when we got to our room we were seriously disappointed. The room was so dirty. Dirt or and other substances on the walls, the carpet had not been hoovered in what looked like months. The bathrooms were growing mould in the tub and on the walls, the furnniture was beaten down and broken, and the mattress on the bed had springs popping up all over. If we hadn't arrived so late in to the evening (after 9:30 PM) we wouldn't have stayed there and looked for another hotel. There is a Hilton down the road that we are staying at next month for £89.

title: Grantly Hotel
text: I stayed here for 30 days. The room was clean, in fact they changed the sheets/towels etc everyday. I had a single room with an en suite. The room was on the small size but why would I spend more time in the room then I needed to? when I had the whole of London to explore. A continental breakfast is supplied everyday, consisting of juice/tea/coffee, toast with spreads/cheese and boiled eggs, which was adequate for me. There is a 24 hour receptionist. Only issue I had was because my room was at the top of the building the free WiFi didn't reach me. Two tube stations nearby and plenty of restaurants/shopping, Westfield is just a five minute walk. Definitely stay here again.

title: bad hotel, bad area, bad staff
text: a lot of weird people around...definitely not for families...very old hotel, impolite staff /night the money is not all, so pay an extra 10 note and get something, more decent. coz, in the night you could really risk it all

title: Beast from the East forced us here
text: The pipes at home froze over so we were without hot water or even a working toilet or shower... so we chose to come here for one night and we were put up in what appeared to be a completely new set of rooms, completely refurbished and rather cosy. It isn't the ritz, but they had everything you might need and at a very good price for a last moment reservation. Receptionist friendly, and breakfast was good too.

title: Excellent budget hotel with onsite parking available
text: Booked just the one night here to visit family in the area. We booked a double room and a single room. We arrived early and as the double room was ready, the reception staff allowed us to check in and use it to put all our luggage in until we could also check into the single room. Both rooms were in the adjoining building and had been newly refurbished. The double was a good size with plenty of tea and coffee, comfortable bed and it was very quiet as it was at the back of the hotel. The single was a great sized room and even had a small kitchen at one end with fridge etc. The only small complaint was that maybe the bed could have had a better standard of mattress. Breakfast was taken in the main ‘Grantly Hotel’ in a conservatory at the back, and was an adequate continental breakfast, with fruit juice, tea/coffee, croissants, cereal, toast/jams, cheese, and boiled eggs if requested. I think it could benefit from some fresh fruit and yogurt being available. This part of the hotel could do with being refurbished but on talking to staff that is due to start quite soon. Excellent location and parking was available at the hotel for a reasonable fee, plus we were able to leave the car there the next day, again for a fee but much better than having to move it on checking out. I would definitely recommend this hotel as its decently priced in a good location and near to the tube, plenty of restaurants and bars, Shepherds Bush Market, Westfield Shopping centre and the O2 Empire.

title: Clean and homey
text: I loved this lovely clean hotel.I spent six nights there and staff were helpful.it was abit difficult locating the hotel cos its said shepherds bush green instead of the hotel is located opposite the green park in shepherds bush.The hotel needs to be described better.Breakfast was good but same thing everyday(toast,tea or coffee,juice,cereal and orange juice).Toilet was abit cramped though like a match box.Finally,I would recommend this hotel any day and I would stay here again.For single use,take room 23 or 31(attic room,though).Thank you grantly hotel.

title: General view
text: We have found the hotel nice and tidy and professionally managed. It is well situated and reachable by various means and tubes . I particularly liked the surrounding area with different restaurants and pubs, while my wife was very happy with the Westtfield shopping complex which is of walking distance from the hotel.

title: Poor
text: Will start with a positive, according to my husband it was cheap. Also it was handy for both the bus and underground. There were lots of steps both inside the hotel (no lift) and outside, the latter being slippery when wet. In the first room we had, the double bed was pushed against the wall, but anticipating that, our friend, who had made the booking, had booked us a triple room. Our shower only gushed scalding water, very dangerous, and could not be adjusted. The only toiletry provided was liquid soap in a wall mounted dispenser. Also as you entered the bathroom the light and fan went on, but the fan went on and on long after you had exited the bathroom, very disturbing especially in the middle of the night. The fittings were rusty. We were allocated a new room because of the broken shower. The bathroom had extensive black mould in the shower and there was smell.The walls did not reach the ceiling so the smell pervaded the bedroom and of course the fan noise was even more evident. The nozzle of the hairdryer was sellotaped on and the bin had not been emptied since the previous guests.The casing of the fridge was cracked.The windows were filthy. There was siren noise from emergency vehicles even at the back of the property. Breakfast! Individual boxes of cereal, toast, fruit juice,croissants if you asked for them and tea or coffee. Cooked breakfast? Yes hard boiled eggs, that was it. No bacon, sausages, scrambled/fried/poached eggs/beans/tomatoes/mushrooms etc.On our second morning we asked for mixed toast, but were told it was brown only, they had run out of white bread! I would not recommend this hotel and I would not stay here again.

title: Cheap, Clean, Good Location, Plus Good Breakfast
text: This has now been our second stay at the Grantly. We have stayed here twice due to the location in Shepards Bush as it is close to the tube, Westfield, Hammersmith/ Thames River, Nottinghill, markets, etc. Nice centralised location to get to and from London and to & from Heathrow airport. The rooms are pretty standard, nothing special which makes it a good price, also another thing we like about staying here is the breakfast. When you are travelling it is good to fill you up as much as you can with a good breakfast and there is plenty on offer at the Grantly such as cereal, toast, and a boiled egg. and of course coffee. we have had 2 different rooms which have been clean and meet our needs as we were pretty much just their to sleep. On the down side it can be a little noisy in Shepherds Bush at night but this didnt bother us. We would definately stay here again.

title: Good Location for 02 Shepherds Bush Empire
text: Upside...Nice hotel, Clean and tidy. It's very near the venue. Five minutes walk from the tube station. good price @ £55 per night, very helpful staff. Downside... bathrooms extremely tiny and the constant screaming of sirens throughout the night. that said the pros far outweigh the cons. would use the hotel again

title: Great hotel to choose
text: I've stayed in this hotel a few years back and was really happy with it, so when I was planning a trip to London with my friends this year, where we'd stay was a no brainer :) Rooms (we had room for 3 people) might be small for some, but I didn't think something bigger was needed, since we were there to explore the London, not the hotel room. Our room was cleaned everyday, we had a mini fridge, TV and a fan in the room as well. Bathroom a bit smaller, but nothing you can't handle. We were offered room no. 3 and 16. In 3 we spent the first night and the rest of our stay we were in room 16, since we chose to agree to switch the rooms. The staff kindly moved our luggage, so we didn't have to worry about it. In room no. 3 we had wifi connection, but in room no. 16 we didn't. The problem was solved immediately when we asked the staff about it and were given passwords to a different wifi :) The staff is very friendly and always helpful. As for us, we enjoyed out breakfasts - cereals, toasts, croissant, boiled egg, butter, cheeses, marmalades, nutella, tea, coffee, orange juice or just water. Hotel is just across the street from O2 Shepherd's Bush Empire.There is also a lovely park, Westfield shopping centre and the Shepherd's Bush underground station are just 5 min walk from the hotel. Also I'd recommend the Italian place right next to the hotel :) Next time, I go to London, I'll definitely choose Grantly Hotel again.

title: Enjoyed my stay
text: Stayed at this hotel for 6 nights and had a really good experience. The single room is small (not tiny) but clean and with all the amenities/facilities. The single bed and pillow were comfy. The property does not have lift so be aware if you have lots of luggage. Perhaps email/phone ahead to arrange a room on the lower floor. The location is excellent. A quick stroke you reach Tube station in less than 10 mins and then 10 mins Tube ride to the city centre. Loads of places to eat and supermarkets in the neighbourhood. If you prefer a bit of shopping, the Westfield shopping mall is just around the corner and open till late (10pm week nights). The staff are friendly and helpful. Check in was fast and efficient. Breakfast is simple but plentiful. Love the ladies working in the brekky room. They were always attentive and friendly. Just be aware the brekky room isn't huge so on the weekend you might need to wait a little. In summary, love the location, love the brekky and happy with the staff and the room/facilities. Will definitely recommend.

title: Great location , value for money
text: Recently stayed at The Grantly over night with my friend and our daughters, as the girls wanted a shopping trip to Westfield, well situated easy access to underground. We stayed in the recently renovated building belonging to the hotel, the room wa a duplex room, and we all loved the feel of it Very well decorated and lovely finish, friendly service and would definitely recommend.

title: grotty little room
text: stayed for one night, that was one too many, reception deceptively clean and tidy. room was grubby, light bulbs not working, unable to open drawers, shower head was filthy and kept falling off, light above sink broken, toilet roll holder hanging off wall, paid cash on arrival, despite booking on line receptionist only had my first name as booking reference, breakfast not too bad, but conservatory where it was served was grubby, dusty chairs and floor. will not be returning. also my bag was kept in an unsecured room opposite reception which was full of junk having been told it would be taken to my room, it was there several hours later on my return

title: "Does what it says on the tin"
text: Booked in due to the volcanic dust and cancelled flights, our daughter lives nearby but no space at her home/flat. We stayed 17-19 Apr 2010. We booked a double room but when they saw how much luggage we had gave us a triple room (No. 6) They only charged for the double at the end, which we found very good. There is no charge for paying by debit card. Breakfast is included and as described bt Ly36 - see review 8/8/2010 - its a bit unusal the way its done in the conservatory - but saying that it is served quickly and everything is freshly made tea/coffee/toast etc. The staff were friendly and helpful. Clean and good value. The location is excellent for the station(s) and there are a couple of award winning restaurants within a few minutes walk (Patio - 5 Goldhawk Road and Tatra on the corner of Pennard Road and 24 Goldhawk Rd - both Polish.) We found the food in Vesbar at 15- 19 Goldhawke Road very good and their coffee is good - reasonable prices. The Westfield shopping centre is within a few minutes and a "must visit" even if you hate shopping centres - its outstanding.

title: Fantastic quality, cheap, clean and modern!
text: Excellent hotel! My husband and I literally came here after we missed the last train home to see if they had any rooms. By chance they had a single room left. Even though there were 2 of us, we took it knowing we would otherwise had been stranded. Hotel owner was incredibly friendly and very sympathetic to our predicament. The single room we had was very small but it was modern, comfortable and warm. Everything was clean, and had all you could possibly ask for in a decent hotel. We were surprised when we checked out that breakfast was incuded so we went for it! Breakfast was very substantial and good quality. For £50 a night for us both with breakfast, this was a bargain! Highly recommend it and who knows, if we got stranded again, this will be the first place I would head to if we're in West London!

title: Annual holiday
text: I come to London every summer, and this is our 3rd year in this hotel. They're perfectly good. It's exactly 3 mins walk from the underground station, and 5 mins walk for the super market (tesco express). The owner knows very well about the hospitality. The breakfast is very good quality. The stuff is very friendly. They have a small livings room. The room is very clean. And the price is very reasonable. I surely recommend this hotel if you're coming to London:)

title: Just OK -- not safe for children
text: I booked this hotel because it was the cheapest hotel near central London with ensuite bathrooms that didn't have horrible reviews. Although it wasn't a horrible place to stay, the rooms were worse than expected, and I probably would have preferred a hotel with nicer rooms but shared bathrooms. Advantages: 1. Close to Tube station, train, and bus -- you are not in Central London but it isn't an extremely long ride 2. Although there was some bar/club activity in the neighborhood, it seemed reasonably safe at night Disadvantages: 1. Room is not safe for children -- fiberglass insulation and rodent bait/poison are within reach of guests. 2. Musty and bad smelling room. Dingy furnishings. 3. Extremely low ceilings in bathroom -- I understand that London hotels are often cramped, but I should be able to sit on the toilet without hitting my head!

title: Lovely hotel idealy placed for shops and atractions
text: I travelled with my wife and two children to London to watch the final of the womens cricket. We needed somewhere not to dear that included breakfast. The Grantly did this and more the room was at the back of the Hotel away from the road the beds where comfortable the bathroom was lovely .The breakfast was a continental breakfast with many choices. I would stay here again and would recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: decent hotel
text: room spotless.. good nights sleep bed very comfortable... the breakfast let it down ...boiled egg and toast were both cold and breakfast room staff not the friendliest ..other than that hotel was fine pI picked it because of location to an event I was attending and it was ideal for that :)

title: Lots of stairs
text: Brilliant for if you're attending an event at the Shepherd's Bush Empire due to the close proximity. Check in was simple even if the guy behind the desk looked like he'd been sucking on lemons. Bedrooms were functional. No extra pillows provided so we used towels to prop ourselves up. Bathrooms were very clean but the metal fixtures were rusty. No complimentary toiletries. Lots and lots of stairs. 41 from reception to our room. 51 if we went down the extra flight to get to the breakfast room. Breakfast room was too small to accommodate for the number of rooms in the hotel. We got turned away once and had to return later. Ladies serving breakfast were very pleasant and efficient. Pleased to see Nutella and little blocks of cheese available instead of just preserves.

title: If you value your life -- do not stay here!
text: Booked for one night - Room 23 !!! Did not stay, place has filthy walls, discusting bathroom and something had died in the fridge and stunk the whole room out. Was totally overpriced and I would not let my dog sleep here. Shame because location is spot on.

title: 3 night break
text: mid 50s couple stayed at the grantly hotel for 3 nights from 23/09/14.we arrived early @11:30 thought we would be dropping our bags and checking in later but we were told to take a seat and they would check room availability. we were in our room before 12 much appreciated.stayed in a double room spotlessly clean . there was a compact but modern toilet /shower. a remote control fan a fridge. however the bed was against a wall accessible from one side only . we were up three flights of stairs (no lift). the breakfast was ok. the only cooked part seemed to be a boiled egg but there were freshly baked croissants. the location is ideal two shopping centres and tube station 5 mins walk. found staff helpful and friendly. overall good budget accommodation

title: compact
text: when we arrived told not to use bannister as painted not much use if you needed help to get upstairs, room small bathroom really small had to stand in shower to shave would be impossible wash face in sink due to its size bedroom not very clean and bed hard against wall, kettle was sited on peddle bin, had to leave building at rear for breakfast to conservatory in yard, location good for shepards bush green empire but would not stay more than one night here

title: Stayed last week.
text: We had tickets to Melanie C at the empire. Location perfect! Just across the street. The circus was in town. Plenty to do, see eat and drink. Price great for London. Hotel clean but basic. Bed was quite comfortable if not a little firm but we had no complaints as slept really well. Bathroom tiny! I think if you were of the larger frame you would struggle in room 30. Clean and well equipped with tea/coffee, TV and some bathroom toiletries. Rooms basic and simple but adequate. Breakfast was good. Simple set up. In conservatory in basement which was lovely on a sunny morning. Continental options only but boiled eggs offered which was a nice touch Just right for breakfast :) will definitely look at staying again should we ever want to go to another gig. Thank you.

title: Great hotel for gigs!
text: We were going to a gig at The Empire and chose this hotel for it's location. We could not have been more pleased. Just a 2 minute walk across the green and you're there. We booked a twin room and were nicely surprised to find the large room had a double + single. The room was very clean, plenty of tea/coffee/sugars etc. The continental breakfast was sufficient .. no frills but very nice. I'd definately recommend this hotel for a stay in London.

title: Good for overnight stay and great location
text: I was there for business trip and stayed three nights. I was in room just for sleeping and that was satisfactory. For London, and considering location, price was quite good. Pros: Location is superb. Two different Tube stations, each less than five minutes walking distance. Westfield shopping center nearby and lot of small restaurants, shops, market, etc...Safe and convenient. Although there is no English traditional breakfast, it is quite satisfying (once you accept that is like you having breakfast in staff's private kitchen). Room was cleaned every day and fresh towels provided. Bed was quite comfortable, bathroom small but functional. Chose this hotel only for location and do not expect luxury. Cons: Room (single) is really small. I think that I've never been in smaller single room. It for sure can be cleaner. Windows could not open and window's glass was non-transparent (probable due to unattractive view), so I had feeling that I was trapped in box. I have to pay 2% more because I used credit card, and it was explained that credit card machine take 2% and that they can not help that. Of course that machine takes 2%, it is card company commission that everybody have to pay, but sellers, not customers. Price for all stay is supposed to be paid at check in. For airplane travelers (who travel light and with liquid restriction), do not count on more than little soap.

title: Great value
text: I was pleasantly surprised by the Grantly Hotel, less than 20 min walk to the event I was attending at Olympia at a much more competitive rate than those closer to the venue. The staff were friendly and helpful upon arrival with my room available earlier than I had requested. A decent sized room for London, a comfortable bed, good wifi and a surprisingly quiet room given how close it is to busy roads. Great value, I'll certainly be looking to book here again if I'm working in the vicinity.

title: No Key
text: walking into the hotel, it seemed quite nice, the staff seemed friendly and it looked clean, then we were told that our room key was lost but to go on down (as our room was in the basement). the room itself (room 25), was sufficent, clean bedding, and towels. the bathroom was the size of a shower cubicle but all worked fine. as we had to leave our room to go the bbc studios, we were left with no option than to leave our bags in the room where only the manager had a key, and the patio door was left open. when we arrived back at the hotel not only had the not found the key but the whole lock had been removed so instead of goin straight to bed after a long day we were forced to sit around and wait whilst a man fixed the lock untill 1am. we had no discount and were ignored by the new receptionist. bad experience but if your in a tight jam and need a cheap place to stay, then its okay, should be cheaper though for what they r offering.
