title: Perfect for What We Wanted
text: My husband and I went there for an anniversary break sans kids! From the outset, when I called to ask something, the lady I spoke to was extremely helpful. As I told her it was for our anniversary, she explained that the hotel was not at all fancy and was I sure that I wanted that for an anniversary stay. Well that honesty and integrity had me hooked! I basically said that at long as the room was clean and had an en suite and the breakfast was good, that was all we needed - we didn't intend to be in there very long anyway. The room was spotless - the white sheets nearly hurt your eyes they were so clean. It was small but Travel Lodge standards and I understand it wasn't the smallest, but we were prepared so in actual fact were pleasantly surprised. The en suite was spotless too, with beautiful white towels. The bed was very comfortable, and the TV, hairdryer and kettle all worked! The breakfast was a buffet full English, which was refilled continuously. The staff are so friendly and cheerful not matter what time of the day or night. I was unlucky enough to have a tummy bug on the last night/morning and they were happy to let me stay in the room for longer than usual leaving time until it settled down. As has been said it is right in the middle of where you want to be for theatre land. It was a ten minute walk from Warhorse and 5 from We Will Rock You. Matilda is at the end of the road and Jersey Boys not much further! There are loads of restaurants in the same road, Italian, French, Hotel Chocolat....... honestly, you'll never starve!! It really reminded us of staying in Paris! We had a double en suite with Breakfast for £105 a night. (At the back of the hotel for a quiet nights sleep). We have also found out they have an annex which has some family rooms for, at the time of writing this, £155 per night B&B. If you want to be 'where it's all that' and can go for an small, character hotel with lovely helpful staff - then this is the place for you.

title: Disgusted!
text: I only stopped at this hotel for one night and am glad it was only was only one night. I must say this is the worst place ive ever stopped. The bedroom was tiny. It was a hot night and the heaters were left on all night so i was sweating all night and could not sleep. All you can hear through the night is banging from the poeple upstairs. And the kettle took about half hour to boil. In the morning for breakfast we looked at every ketcup on all the tables and they were more than 3 years out of date. I would not recommend this place to anyone. For the same price i would stop in Regent Palace in Picadilly Cirsus (travelstay) it was a much better hotel.

title: Needs fixing
text: 2 star hotel. Water pressure was bad, no air condition (ceiling fan avilable but made a lot of noise, however helped to keep the room tolerable). Our parents room did not have a phone, got a shock from the night stand lamp and the toilet did not flush. Extremely noisy drunk guests (1 night). Our friends room did not have a ceiling fan. There were small flies in the bathroom. However, it was not the worst hotel I've been at. It was clean and the locations was excellent, breakfast and Wi-if is included and the breakfast was good (English breakfast). The staff was also extremely helpful and friendly. Its a noisy place, so ask for a room on the top floors so you won't here everyone using the stairs at night.

title: Last minute overnight stay
text: The location is excellent and the staff friendly. This is a clean functional budget hotel. If you want a bed in central London this is good, but if you are seeking home comforts this is not the place. The house breakfast is as good as most decent hotels but without frills. Good luck to the owners who are trying to provide a decent service

title: Fantastic location
text: This little hotel is a real gem. The staff is most friendly and welcoming. The location was superb for all that we wanted to see and do in London. If you want to travel, bus and tube are nearby. It's not a complaint on our part but I must point out that there is no lift and the stairwell is narrow. I will definitely recommend and hope to return.

title: Original toilet arrangement
text: The toilet was separated from the room by .. nothing! Not even a curtain. So as in a prison cell, you make your business in the same room where you sleep, drink coffee and watch tv. The room was also very small. I stayed at number nine. It was on the third floor without lift. It seemed clean.The staff was nice, I didn't try the breakfast. I slept well. On the plus side, it is fantastically central in the Covent Garden district, a few steps from everything.

title: Great Location
text: If you want to be close to Covent Garden and don't want to pay an arm and a leg this is a great place to stay. However, the rooms and bathroom are very small. The staircase leading up to the rooms is very narrow so you wouldn't want to have a large case as there's not a lot of space to haul it up the stairs and there's no lift. The carpet on the narrow staircase was a little loose in places and even without a suitcase was a little tricky. The people are lovely and the rooms are spotless. It was quite basic but there were tea and coffee making facilities. Breakfast was in the cellar and was small and packed. It was a British breakfast of beans, sausage, bacon, egg, toast. Not as bad as I thought it was going to be having read the reviews. It was hot in the room and we needed the windows open but that meant it was quite noisy at night. If you were staying when its cooler this wouldn't be such a problem as the windows had good sound proofing. For a short stay in the centre of London this was perfect for me although I wouldn't stay here if I had large luggage or needed a bit more space.

title: Recommended. If you are aware and chose wisely.
text: This a very useful reference hotel... if you really know what you will get. The hotel does not have any bells and whistles... it does not have any "turkeys" either. And all reviews must have in consideration the cost/benefit ratio. Location could not be better, right in the heart of Covent Garden, where all the action goes: theatres, pubs, restaurants and all the Soho life nearby. Plenty of underground stations around. Piccadilly Line direct to Heathrow Airport. Price does not get any better in any hotel 5 kilometers around. We paid 140 UK pounds per night on a triple room (more about that later) including breakfast. Staff is friendly, kind and willing to help, where necessary. Room care is addequate, bed grooming, full towel change and WC cleaning everyday. Now, what you should be aware about: Hotel is in a narrow building with 4 floors (we stayed in 3rd), there is no elevator (lift) and the stairs are narrow. Bringing in the suitcases may be a chore (I was offered help but declined), bringing them out is the same, but this is work to be done only once on arrival and once on departure. However, if you have mobility issues, be aware. Rooms have the bare essentials, however clean, cozy and quite new. But rooms are not spacious. When me & my wife reserved, there was only a triple room available but we reserved anyway, because the price & location were right. This triple room (#11 on 3rd floor) was exactly right for us, with a nice double bed plus a single bed where we could spread our things and open our suitcases. If we were on a double (or if we were 3) the suitcases should have to stay open in the floor. The WC was ok, small but addequate, good shower, lavatory and toilet. Be aware that economy hotels in London have usually *very bad* WC's (or they have shower but no toilet, or no WC at all). What else ? A clothes keeper big enough with lots of hangers & 4 drawers, two bedside drawers, small TV, hairdrier & mirror, coffee/tea kettle with cumplimentary coffee, tea & cookies every day. The hotel stays in a very quiet street but cornering with a busy avenue. Londoners are noisy (and frequently unpolite and rude), you may be bothered with noises at night, like buses and lorries passing by, some sirens and even obnoxious people honking at 4am !! Not to mention the "night birds" speaking or singing loud as they pass by. Bring in your earplugs. And your eye covers (curtains are thin and don't block daylight). We were lucky, neighbour hosts were quiet (this is always a question of luck). Big central heating, switched on when necessary (temperature was very comfortable). No AC, big fan in ceiling (maybe useful in summer, but London is never hot anyway). Breakfast is the typical English breakfast, not our preference but quite addequate and substancial anyway. All in all, and with the correct pondering of pro's and con's, this is a very interesting choice for an hotel, that we may easily use again next time.

title: Excellent location - friendly staff
text: We have stayed here before and would choose to come again because the location is so good, meaning you can walk to many places. Yes, it is noisy but beds are comfortable. Staff very friendly and helpful. Breakfast not for us as only typical English breakfast - no fresh fruit or pastries, nor herbal tea - but not really problem as so many places nearby where you could get something to eat. Maybe it would be possible to book on a room only basis rather than bed and breakfast?

title: Short stay in London
text: When we arrived at the hotel the service was very prompt and were in our rooms in a matter of minutes. The room was nice and clean with a large separate bathroom. The room was below street level but was quiet. The bathroom was clean and had shampoo and shower gel provided in large containers. The bed was comfortable and the room had a small fridge with tea/coffee facilities, 2 hair dryers and a TV. Enjoyed our stay and the location is perfect for clampham common. The hotel was not expensive and was ideal for our stay.

title: Nice cheap hotel
text: The hotel was clean and the beds were comfortable but DO NOT BOOK IF YOU ARE DISABLED. My partner is disabled and we requested a ground floor room, unfortunately the only disabled room they had was unavailable and my partner had to struggle up 2 flights of stairs. As we were only staying one night we just put up with it but it did mean we couldn't leave the room until we were leaving. Good hotel if you if you want somewhere cheap and near the tube station.

title: Noisiest hotel ever!
text: Stayed here for one night. Rude service at reception and would not let us check in before 2pm. Rooms were clean, however if you choose this hotel then you should bring earplugs. It is located on a very busy street with non-stop traffic into the am, including trucks. Couple this with the London Underground which ratttles the building every 10 minutes. Seriously avoid this hotel. Terrible. Worst hotel I stayed in during a two visit to the UK.

title: Nice hotel in Clapham
text: We stayed there for one night as we were going to a concert in Brixton which is only about half an hour away from the hotel. Clapham South underground station and Clapham commons only a minute walk away. The receptionist who checked us in, Alex I believe, was very friendly and helpful with direction and where to eat as they do not serve breakfast. There’s a very good cafe across the road ( the Commons Room). Our room ( number 2 ) was situated downstairs in what must have been the basement, not much to see out of the window but we were only staying there to have somewhere to sleep in London. The room itself was very spacious, clean and tidy. Tea and coffee facilities are on offer with biscuits. The bed was comfortable, a bit small but good enough. The Tv wasn’t tuned in so we could only watch the news on the BBC iPlayer. The bathroom is on the large size as well which is a rare occurrence in London hotels for the rate we paid. We planned to do the Clapham commons parkrun, and found that it is only a five minute walk from the hotel which was perfect! A nice hotel to stay in.

title: Brilliant Local Hotel
text: We were visiting London to catch up wth family who live in Clapham and booked into this local hotel. The rooms were spotless, as were the reception and all other areas of the hotel. Although they do not serve breakfast,there are so many eateries locally that this is not a problem. We arrived very late due to delays in our flights so we called the hotel to advise. Alex very kindly left us the key and instructions to let ourselves into the hotel. Checking out was just as easy, we will definitely be booking in again the next time we visit London

title: Excellent stay ...
text: We stayed in The Gateway Hotel for 2 nights

title: Hotel met my needs, nothing special.
text: I wanted a hotel close to the Royal International Air Tattoo. Normal price for this hotel is £80 per night. Because of the local air show, I paid £320 for two nights! For that money I expected more. It’s ok, for £80 a night I would have been happy. The staff are helpful and very nice and accommodated dietary needs with no complaints. Breakfast was very good. Bar good and prices ok. Bed comfortable room clean. Coffee facilities available although on our second day the room was cleaned but the biscuits were not replenished.....£320!! I would have expected them to be replenished. Good location but noisy due to main road, but I can live with that. Would I stay again? At £80 a night for sure. £160 a night inflated for local demand, not a chance!

title: Bargain stay for London.
text: Bargain stay at 216 pounds for three nights. Our basement room was spotlessly clean and comfortable, and probably the best place to be in a heatwave - although there was a fan, we didn't need it. Ear plugs are provided by the hotel - definitely necessary, since the road outside is busy, and the Northern line of the Underground runs under the hotel. Hotel parking was much appreciated, and easy to use. The bathroom was clean, but somewhat rickety. The shower splashed most of the room, since although there was a shower curtain, there was no barrier at floor level. The grey plastic drainage pipe from the washbasin ran for about a metre along the bottom of the wall next to the shower before leaving the room.

title: Excellent Stay!
text: Stayed in a lovely double room, clean, spacious, even had a fridge and a much appreciated fan! Immaculate white sheets and towels. Really lovely helpful staff, gent on reception could not have been better. Perfect location, safe and secure. Will definitely be back!

title: Great location + clean room
text: I was looking for a cheap hotel in London for one night. Although some reviews found in the Internet were negative I decided to book this hotel. I enjoyed my stay. All was great. The most important that it was close to the Tube station and the room and bathroom were clean. Good location and value for London. The hotel is 10 min walk from the Tube

title: Good value
text: Good value stay. Reception open restricted hours - then separate access for some of the rooms. Comfortable clean double room - small double pushed up against wall. Earplugs provided - was that a sign? Some train noise in mornings and I was woken by the elephant waking in the room above me (high ceiings! :-)) at 0530 but guess that was bad luck. Very convenient for Clapham South tube and an M&S food and Sainsbury's local a few paces away. For what it was though - did the job and would visit again

title: excellent location
text: The concierge was more than helpful and let us choose our room due a family staying above one of the rooms and no view with the other. We were not there for the view, so the room we choose opened up on to an opposite wall which did not bother us at all. The room was basic but perfectly equipped for a quick over night stay for a party in Clapham and also with the hotel being situated close to Clapham south tube, many bars and restaurants and supermarkets, I could not recommend this place enough!!

title: A Brilliant Hotel
text: I chose this hotel when I had family members admitted to St Georges Hospital to save us having to make the daily commit up and down. To be honest, I did not have high expectations for the hotel, as the price was extremely reasonable and they also have parking available which was my main criteria. When we turned up at 8.40 at night I was extremely pleased to be greeted when our car pulled in by Alex with a huge smile and a very cheery hello, he proceeded to helped us unload our bags and carried them up to our room. The room (a twin) was spacious with an on suite, tea & coffee facilities a fridge, TV with Freeview and plenty of storage. The decor was very nice and appeared to be new, even the carpets. The beds were very comfortable and we both sleep very well in spite of our difficult personal circumstances which was a real bonus. There was a M&S, Sainsbury’s Burger King, 2 cafés’, a newsagents and other shops right on the door step. For us it really was a little oasis in a very hectic week. Thank you again guys, especially Alex, you really did brighten up our week 

title: Excellent value
text: Stayed here recently - had to book very quickly when where I was due to be staying in Balham had no running water for 3 days! Alex on reception very helpful and friendly. The room was very clean and comfortable and it was tremendous value for one night.

title: No frills hotel- great value for money
text: My stay at this hotel far exceeded my expectations. At just £75 a night, this was extremely good value for money. A comfortable bed, very clean room and bathroom, good shower, TV, tea, coffee and a fridge. Loads of places to buy food and drink within two minutes walk - a wine shop right across the road! Very friendly staff. Lovely and warm on a cold winter night. I felt very safe here and will return. The only negative that I can give is that it is based on a busy road so it is noisy during the day, but it was certainly quiet enough to sleep overnight - and the hotel provides earplugs anyway.

title: Fantastic
text: I usually book chain hotels, in City, but I came across this one and thought I’d take a chance. I’m so glad we did!! Right from prior to booking, to when we left, the staff were brilliant. I’d arranged to leave my car there, at a cost of £5. Bargain! Parked up at 12.30, and was taken to room straightaway, by the very pleasant man on reception, who was really friendly and helpful. We were in Room 17, so first room at top of stairs. Yes, Room is basic, but it has everything you need, and was clean. You won’t get luxury, but it’s £75, so didn’t expect it. There are tea/coffee facilities and biscuits, along with a fridge. Yes it is on a main road, but we genuinely didn’t hear much noise, and slept really well. Great location!! Clapham South Tube Station is literally just up the road, so we were in Central London in no time. There’s shops close by if you need to get things for room. The best thing was fact they were more than happy for us to leave car there today, so we could go back into London. Really really helpful. We have already booked to come back!!

title: Ideal
text: This was our second visit to this hotel and it was even better than the first. We had a small but perfect double room, beautifully clean and comfortable. The staff on reception was very helpful. There is no lounge and a continental breakfast is not included but can be booked. The tube is a hop, skip and a jump away and bus' stop outside. Clapham Common is on the doorstep as are any number of bars/restaurants. Having reading some bad reviews I wonder if they got the wrong hotel?

title: Sleepless in Balham
text: Stayed two nights here recently as it was convenient for a family visit. It is close to shops, cafes and restaurants and the underground. Very friendly receptionist and we were allowed to leave luggage in our room though we were very early in arriving. At £80 per night for a twin this was not cheap. This did not include breakfast as they were 'short staffed.' We were asked to pay on arrival as reception was not always staffed: in fact, after check in we saw no staff at all though the room was serviced. We were shown a side door which we were asked to use for entry and exit and just dropped keys in a box on departure. The room was serviceable but the chair was worn, the carpet had a hole in it and the wash basin was cracked. The hotel is close to Balham Hill which is a very busy road so were kept awake by traffic noise, frequwnr sirens and loud voices in the street. On these grounds we would not reuse.

title: Poor service
text: When we arrived to check in we rang the desk bell & waited 10 mins & no one showed up so we had to phone the Hotel to get someone to serve us (answer phone message stated the the receptionist was busy!! no they weren't, there wasn't anyone there). We were shown to our room that was cramped, but clean apart from the net curtains that were filthy. The shower hose was leaking so badly it was almost impossible to rinse yourself properly. Noisy fellow guests woke us up at 6.00am on Sunday morning with their TV blaring out then banging doors shut. Room vibrates every time a Tube Train goes through (apparently the hotel is above the underground line). Hotel is situated on a very busy main road so you get a lot of traffic noise all night long. I would not recommend this Hotel to anyone. Pay a little bit more & go somewhere else. You can't put a price on a good nights sleep

title: Highly recommended and Will Be Returning
text: This was an overnight stay for the Wimbledon Championship. We phoned a few days before to ask if we could check in earlier and the really nice Gentleman said he would do his best. We arrived extra early and as promised,they did their very best as we were able to have our spotless room straight away. 2 minutes walk from Clapham South Tube,brilliant! Everything you could ask for in the room, including ear plugs. Yes,bit of a busy road but didn't disturb us and we live come from a very rural setting. Easy access to everywhere , tea/coffee in room. Helpful directions fron reception Gentleman. So kind. Will definitely recommend and will be returning. Good price too for the location.

title: Short Stay - Staff lovely
text: We stayed here on on Wednesday the 12th to Friday 14th & had a great stay - hugely due to the welcoming, friendly & helpful staff! We have never been to London before & asked a few questions how to get to certain places & the man on reception (so sorry, didn't get his name but I believe he was Portuguese) was so, so, so helpful. He even outlined a map for us & as we were going to Wimbledon the next day printed off different ways to travel. So very helpful! Thank you! Links to London were fab as the underground station Clapham South is a minute walk away!

title: GREAT HOTEL IN LONDON
text: More than happy to find this comfortable by all means hotel in such an expensive city. As soon as you get off the Clapham South tube (first zone) you are almost at your destination in 2 minutes. Very tidy rooms with daily clean up (including Sundays), super friendly and very supportive staff. Two main supermarket chains - M&S and Sainsbury's are at the next door. Greatly enjoyed all 12 days stay in Gateway! The hotel is the best in London for the price you pay!!!

title: London to Brighton overnight stay
text: Brilliant hotel with very friendly staff. Location is perfect for London to Brighton, 2 minutes walk from Clapham South tube and Clapham Common. Very close to many restaurants and shops, including M&S, Sainsbury's, & Burger King to name but a few. Tv, fridge and kettle in the room & free wifi. Will definitely stay here again

title: A pleasant stay
text: A lovely little hotel. The receptionist was very friendly and the room was a standard double with a wetroom style en-suite. But for only £75 it was a bargain especially as amenities such as tea/biscuits, towels and radical showergel were provided for less than the cost of a travelodge. It's only 2min from clapham south underground or 5min from balham station. The underground does pass under the hotel however it is not loud and didn't prevent me from sleeping soundly.

title: Greate location
text: Close to subway, park and good restaurants. Also a small food market close. If you come by car, be sure you reserve a parking space. No breakfast available in the hotel, but right across the street plenty options. Recommended to use the ear plugs if you mind the subway noise.

title: Comfortable Value Hotel
text: My boyfriend and I had a two night stay in this hotel. We arrived before check-in from an early morning flight and the hotel was able to generously accommodate our early check-in (thank you so much!). This also caused us to get a room upgrade (double thumbs up!)! The front desk man went above and beyond showing us to our room, helping us with our bags, and making sure we were comfortable. I'm sorry we probably didn't properly thank him since we were in zombie mode from the traveling. The room was comfortable with all of the expected amenities in any nice hotel. The only downsides were the inconsistent wifi and weak shower. We loved that it was just outside of the tourist area in the city center (but still a short, convenient commute to the city center) and we were able to get a true local feel. However, it was a bit loud at night, I still slept fine without the provided earplugs. I would definitely recommend - you can't beat the price!

title: A Great Choice for a London Based Vacation on a Modest Budget
text: We stayed for one week in Room 15, an upstairs unit with 2 single beds. One can often acquire the best rate by booking with the Hotel directly on their website. We were greeted by Gavin, a very nice man who went out of his way to welcome us and show us around the property. In fact, I never saw a staff member the entire time without a smile on their face. They are truly a great team. This property was well maintained and looks just as it does in the online photos, with no surprises. The surrounding neighborhood was mostly residential, but it had plenty of stores and restaurants on the main road in front of the hotel. The Clapham South Tube station (Northern Line) is only 2 blocks away and will link you with the entire London Transit system. Several bus lines are also available and stop nearby. With a Visitor Oyster Card, you can travel anywhere you want to go in London safely and quickly. The room itself was very clean, and despite being a tad bit small, it had everything that we needed, including a closet and several dresser drawers for storage. The bathroom appeared to be a recent renovation and was in great condition. It was more than sufficient in cleanliness and function. The shower had good water pressure and ample hot water was available every time we used it. The single beds were mattresses on wooden frame and they were quite comfortable. The room also had a coffee maker, small refrigerator, cable TV (with lots of channels), and good strong WIFi that worked perfectly the entire stay. Room service cleaned our room and changed out towels daily while we aere out and about, and they did a great job our entire stay. If you are interested in cheap eats, I took a city bus to McDonalds in Clapham Common every morning for a cheap L4 ($5) breakfast. In the evening, Dominos Pizza and a local chain called Nando's are within easy walking distance in the other direction from the hotel. Simply put, this is a great little location away from all the hustle and bustle of Central London, but close enough to Tube into tourist land within 30 minutes or so. As a bonus, South Wimbledon Mall and many good restaurants are also very close in the other direction away from central London. As for safety, the area seemed very good to me. There are lots of school kids in the area riding buses to school each morning, and working class people are living their normal lives, pushing baby strollers, exercising, and shopping. We felt safe and secure in the area, but the hotel also has key card entry to the hallway and to your room to add to your sense of security. The biggest danger in the area seemed to be walking in front of an oncoming bicyclist on the roadway. They are everywhere on the local London roads, and they are fast and silent. Look both ways! As others have stated previously, the only real negative to this property is the noise. The rooms with two single beds all face the front of the hotel and road noise at night from sirens and such is (unfortunately) pretty bad. Saturday nights were the worst, as a small convenience store is just across the street. The ear plugs provided by the staff help a lot with this issue, and I was able to sleep well while using them. But we did have one night where the earplugs were mistakenly taken from our room and not replaced (Saturday Night). This turned out to be a terrible night of sirens and other noises that I would not want to repeat. One other negative for some people is that the rooms have only a table-top fan, and no air conditioning. This is usually no big deal in London, but if it is exceptionally hot outside, this could become very uncomfortable during the day. In summary, I consider this to be a great place to stay on a moderate budget, if you can handle the street noise and lack of air conditioning. I would certainly stay here again if I return to London, as the noise was not a problem for me when ear plugs were available. The staff were super in every way, and the property was always clean and well maintained.

title: Friendly, good value hotel
text: I stayed here booking 2 rooms with family and the welcome we received from the Brazilian duty member of staff was fantastic. He was extremely helpful and friendly, printing out a route map for us and giving us information on public transport. The rooms were extremely clean and while they are not the most modern, it looked like they had been recently redecorated and provided everything we needed. There are excellent transport links around and many places to eat and drink. The only downside was the traffic noise in the rooms facing the main road (there were ear plugs on the bedside cabinet!). Luckily we had sampled the excellent late night hospitality of the Avalon pub next door and I slept like a log!

title: Lovely
text: Really nice room, friendly staff, lovely and clean the pub next door was really nice too! Only annoying thing was that trip adviser had it listed in hotels close to Electric Brixton, it said it was 1.1 miles away but when I arrived it was actually 2.4 miles away

title: A New Year getaway at The Gateway
text: We went to see family in London for New Year and stayed for 4 nights at The Gateway Hotel. It was only 5 minutes walk from Clapham South Tube Station. It is also a pleasant walk along from Clapham Common Tube Station too. Our room, number 17, in the newer extension, was modern, clean and comfortable and the staff were polite and friendly. Breakfast wasn't available during our stay, but we took a 10 minute walk down to Wetherspoon's Moon under Water at Balham for breakfast. There are also several cafes there and it has convenient tube and train stations too.

title: Weekend away
text: Great room, friendly staff, brilliant location and excellent price. Premier Inn standard but half the price. Just remember to bring your own travel iron as they don't have any. Room came with tea/coffee point, hair dryer, mini fridge and flat screen tv.

title: Great experience, wonderful value
text: Small, profesionally run hotel conveniently close to tube lines. Impressive cleanliness and service, and very comfortable nights' sleep Wanted to extend my stay, but they were fully booked. I'll return. Downsides: potential to be a little noisy (though this never affected me) and the bathroom was small though sufficient. If this concerns you then book a hotel higher up the price ladder.

title: Onenighter
text: Hotel was further from Clapham Junction than I expected (walking) but had a friendly reception on arrival. Room is basic and clean with comfortable beds. Good bathroom. Tea making Plus a fridge. Be warned the traffic is quite loud and if you are not used to it - take earplugs with you.

title: Decent for the money
text: Simple,basic, comfortable, clean. Not a luxury place by any means but a nice place for a very decent price. Clean rooms. Shows broken and no one around to tell. No breakfast but a decent cafe across the road (the common room). Good location next to Clapham South tube. Noisy as next to a busy road but used ear plugs and no problem.

title: Friendly place
text: We stayed here as we were attending a concert on the common. We were met with a very friendly and helpful receptionist, our room was very clean and tidy, upon first impression was a bit on the small side however considering the reasonable cost it is more than adequate. Would certainly stay again if we are local.

title: Better than expected
text: Just got back from seeing madness on the common,stayed one night..lovely little hotel.prompt and friendly service at reception..room was clean /bright,had everything we may need including tea/coffee making facilities..clean towels,fan and tv..can't fault it..I will recommend it too anyone and I would def stay again

title: Excellent location for events on the Common
text: Speedy check in and out process. Perfect location for events held on the Common. Secure and comfortbale rooms with adequate facilities. Walking distance to shops, bars and cash points as well as the nearest underground station.

title: Ideal!
text: Well run hotel in an ideal location, two minutes walk from the tube station and Clapham Common. It was a great base for my travels around London. Clean and comfortable rooms with all the facilities you'd need. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Plenty of choice nearby for cafés, shops and bars. I wish they provided breakfast but everything else was spot on.

title: Good value for money
text: Not so quiet area but great locale for London. Excellent public transport at door. Clean rooms and good value for money.

title: Thoughtful friendly service
text: I arrived late and I was greeted warmly, given a choice of the available rooms, and felt very well taken care of. The room was clean and well supplied with biscuits, ear plugs and free wifi. Great hotel and very reasonable. It is close to the tube and their is a lovely cafe opposite for breakfast.

title: Theatre trip
text: Nice reasonably priced place. Not high end but comfortable and clean and situated in quite pretty grounds too. Felt safe and the staff made us feel welcome. This place could not make visiting the city any easier for getting around London if it tried. We were a 2 minute walk away from Clapham South tube station and we had no problem with noise from the station keeping us awake at night. If you do stay here, be sure to go to The Common Room for breakfast. The food is lushness on a plate with locally sourced produce. The gentleman on the hotels front desk recommended the place and you know if there are builders in a cafe, it's a good sign for a proper meal.

title: Good location and value
text: Stayed here last week as it was close to a wedding I attended. Good practical single room with bay window, therefore a bit noisy, and reasonably sized bathroom. The traffic noise could have been overcome by the earplugs provided, though I did not need them. Coffee, tea and biscuits provided in room and good hairdryer. Friendly front desk staff and electronic security code to enter the building. Location is excellent, right on bus route 155 to Elephant and Castle and 150 metres from Clapham South tube station. I did not have breakfast there but sampled local restaurants and coffee shops, of which there are several.

title: Perfect for short stay! Very friendly & helpful staff.
text: Stayed here at the weekend with my son as we were going to the Rugby at Twickenham and I have another son who live 10 mins from the Hotel. The room (17) was a twin. It had TV, Ensuite Shower/toilet and 2X 3 foot single beds. The room was clean (as was the Shower etc). Not the most comfortable beds, but fine for a night or two. Our room was at the front of the hotel and there was some road noise (the hotel put ear plugs on the bedside table - but really think they are not needed!) The staff are very friendly and helpful. There is some parking, but I would suggest you book rather than take a chance (4 spaces?). We will book again for our next time at the Rugby.

title: Good location
text: Good location, clean and tidy hotel and best ever welcome by the guy on reception. Very warm, friendly and funny, you are a star sir 👍👍. The rooms on the front do get some traffic noise, so may be better to avoid if possible.

title: Excellent customer service, location and quality. Will stay again.
text: Positioned conveniently just outside of the underground makes it very easy to get to using the Northern Line. I went here with my gf and had no problems finding the place or needing to make any sort of rail adjustments to get to. It's situated perfectly away from the noise of central. Greeted at the door and the customer service was excellent. He was such a lovely and friendly chap! Asked about us, told us a bit about himself to ease any tension and then helped us with all our questions and gave us a plentiful amount of information to help us get around London. It paid off as his directions for us to get home in the early hours really helped us dodge closed stations. We were even given an umbrella in case of rain! The hotel room was a twin room and had everything we needed for one night stay. Two comfortable beds, thick pillows, plenty of towels. Sizeable TV, free wifi and a clean bathroom with a faultless shower. A kettle and some teabags for a good ol' cuppa. Slept very well and it was very clean. We didn't eat at the hotel so I cannot review the quality of the food. On checking out, we were also given some complimentary 2016 diary planners of good quality. Thank you. My complaints is that

title: Last minute cancellation by the hotel left my colleague without anywhere to stay
text: I called the hotel to make a last-minute booking, clearly stating it was for my colleague. The guy on reception was really helpful and even agreed for reception to stay open later for check-in. My booking confirmation came through which I then forwarded to my colleague. This is where the excellent customer services ended. My colleague was called at 9pm to ask if he had a van (why wasn't this question asked at point on booking?), when he confirmed that he had got a van he was then told that they didn't accept workmen or vans and that his booking was going to be cancelled. I don't understand how they couldn't have accommodated my colleague, even if the van had been left off site. To cancel the booking at such short notice and leave someone in London without a bed for the night is unacceptable.

title: Convenient inexpensive hotel ideal for much of London
text: Needed a hotel that was both close to my son's home in Clapham and central London for the Royal Jubilee festivities and would not break the bank, either. Gateway proved to be excellent: two minutes walk from Clapham South Tube with quick access to Central London

title: Bedbugs Nightmare
text: Worst experience ever! Disgusting! Woke up at 3.30am with bedbugs biting me and crawling all over the bed. Killed many, leaving blood stains on the sheet. Nobody in reception till 8.30am, when I told manager what happened and showed him the dead bugs and blood on the sheets, he didn't apologize, would't refund my money, just treated me as if somehow it was MY fault. He even said " You've been complaining since you arrived." I suppose he was referring to the room key and tv that didn't work, the heat that wasn't on...I finally recvd a sort of apology by phone and a refund cheque from him because after he called the pest control he found out that I was not making the whole thing up. I had an allergic reaction to the dozens of bites all over my body and face that lasted for 3 weeks, in fact while writing this, I still have scars from the bites.

title: Just great!
text: Great hotel! Great service! Not expensive and great value for money. Stay here instead of some of the other local hotels!

title: Stay here if you like dirty rooms and dead mice!
text: We stayed here with another couple in the middle of July 2011 for 2 nights. Our friends were in Room 9 (1st floor) and we were in Room 2. Room 9 was on the front of the main building and quite bright but noisy because of the busy road outside. Room 2 was down some narrow stairs in the basement. The smell was the first thing we noticed, a sort of musty, mouldy old ash-tray smell – I realise it’s an old building but this smell was not right. The guy who showed us to the room left us at the bottom of the stairs outside the room, handed us the key and left. When we entered the room the smell got worse, the room itself was dark, dank and dirty. The bathroom and toilet were old, dilapidated and frighteningly filthy, the toilet seat was broken and hanging half off. The shower was an ancient “over the bath” type with a grimy head which gave out a trickle of water directly over the taps so water sprayed everywhere. The bedroom was no better, the walls were mouldy and this was badly hidden by a coat of white paint. There were thick and dusty cobwebs in every corner and on the light fittings. Then there was the very nice welcome gift of a dead mouse in the middle of the carpet. We went back to reception to request a room change and were told that there were no other rooms available that night but we could change on the 2nd night, but they would, very kindly, remove the mouse! When we pointed out that this was not acceptable the guy called his manager, we were then offered the choice of a) having the room for free or b) they would call another hotel and get us in there for 1 night. As there were no vacancies anywhere else and we were staying with another couple we decided to stick with what we had. We were told that the room was due for refurbishment and that the building was old. I have no idea how this justifies the poor cleanliness of the room – it costs nothing to clean something properly especially when you are asking someone for £75 a night for the privilege of staying there! In all the staff did not seem that bothered or surprised by what we were reporting. We went out relatively early and spent the rest of the evening in the bar/ restaurant, The Avalon, next door, which I would thoroughly recommend! The nights sleep was not very good at all as the fridge in the room made a lot of noise and kept us awake as did the thought of more mice creeping about the room! The next day we went out early and returned late to avoid spending any more time in the room, we found that all our things had been moved to Room 6 even though we had not asked them to do this. Room 6 was a vast improvement on Room 2 it was small but brighter and with a shower cubicle. However our room did have a Power cut because we put the extractor fan on for the shower. The room was still not the cleanest but was better than before. The room was also at the front of the hotel near the main road which was very noisy with lots of buses stopping outside. Don’t get me wrong I didn’t expect peace and tranquillity this close to central London but the windows seemed to keep none of the noise out. One thing this hotel has going for it was the location, 5 mins from Clapham South tube station and Clapham Common with lots of local shops and places to eat. This place is worse than Fawlty Towers, at least that was probably cleaner! For a hotel in the country’s capital you expect better standards, I can’t imagine what impression this must give to tourists staying here visiting London. Safe to say we will never ever stay here again and will not be recommending it to friends and family. Negatives: Dirty, noise, dead mouse Positives: Location

title: Clean, convenient, comfy, cheap, convivial
text: A great place to stay! Other reviews have complained about noise - we heard none to disturb us. Clean: clean room, big enough, good housekeeping. Convenient: 250 yards from the tube, passing M&S food on the way

title: Family Trip to London
text: Upon calling the hotel I was greeted by a very friendly lady named Denah. I was traveling with my husband and we were bringing my Mom and sister with us from the states. She was extremely helpful with the directions on how to get to the hotel. It turns out it's a straight shot on the Northern tube line from Euston Station, and less than a 5 min walk from 2 different tube lines. On arrival we were personally shown to our room and were very surprised at how large the rooms were! I was expecting to be in a sardine can but the rooms were a great size! The rooms were very clean and the bed was firm but easy to sleep on. My husband and I took the room by the road as my sister is a light sleeper. We were provided ear plugs, but only my husband used his because the people in the room above us liked to walk around a lot in the early morning and the floor squeaked. Only complaint would be the very low water pressure in the shower, however it did get nice and hot so I'm not overly upset about that. We had a great time! I would definitely stay there again and will most likely book there again if our travels ever land us in London again.

title: NIce Small Hotel
text: My wife and I stayed in this hotel and we found it excellent value and convenient to all amenities. There was some noise from traffic and the tube but it was not a major problem though it is possible that in other parts of the hotel it was. The room though small was very clean and the tea making facilities was a bonus. It is very close to Clapham South Tube.

title: Great value for money
text: We stayed last night after attending SW4 Festival on Clapham Common. This hotel was perfect! Inexpensive, ideal location with tube station right on the doorstep, really clean and a great welcome. Highly recommended and will most certainly book again for next year.

title: Friendly and cosy
text: After a lot of searching for a hotel in London I came across this. It was the nicest looking one in my price bracket, so I booked it, very local to a tube station, upon arrival was greeted by a very friendly Brazilian man, who was just so welcoming and friendly and made us feel completely relaxed at home, he apologised for not being able to put us in a bigger room, which wasn't a problem at all but it was still kind of him to be considerate, they provided ear plugs as it was right on a main road. I personally didn't use the ear plugs as I didn't find it that loud but again, very considerate of them. Great nights sleep, would visit again. Very happy with the hotel.

title: Small, simple and clean
text: My friend and I stayed here for about a week and a half while on holiday. The room we booked was small but nice and clean. We had a window facing the street so at night the traffic was noisy. The staff were very friendly and helpful as necessary. The location is very close to an underground station so going into the centre of London where most tourist attractions are was fairly manageable. There is a restaurant/ pub just next door which was nice for a last minute meal and drink. The temperature in our room was very up and down. On warm days it was very hot and on rainy days it cooled down significantly.

title: Small, friendly and perfectly located
text: This small, friendly hotel was a brilliant find. We were attending a wedding in Central London, so South Clapham tube being 5 minutes away was a bonus, as is the car parking, which is reasonable at a fiver a night. The staff are young and helpful, the ensuite rooms are clean, comfortable and big enough for us. earplugs were provided, but even on a Saturday night there was almost no road noise. The hotel is as far away from the huge corporate competitors as you could imagine. I have no hesitation in recommending it. If you stay over a weekend and are a lover of real asian food, the small cafe opposite the tube station has Pakistani home favourites like Haleem and Nehari, for farcically low prices. Don't expect tablecloths, just corking North Indian food.

title: great value for money
text: Hot day so we had to have window open onto noisy street with pub beer garden close by. However, we didn't have any problems sleeping. Very clean and very friendly staff. Excellent location - close to tube, shops and restaurants.

title: Amazing, even for 1 week + stay Solo
text: For a young, solo trip for over a week, this was more than I could ask for! Stayed in the Superior Double Ensuite room (very lucky): -GREAT location, right next to a very modern pub, shops, restaurants, cafe, M&S, Tube stations, bus stations, you name it! -Receptionist & service in general is very friendly -Very high sense of privacy -Quite Quiet (next to road) -Amazing clean, modern, comfortable facilities (bathroom is my favorite) -Extremely safe location in the middle of Clapham.

title: Nice hotel, great receptionist!
text: We were running from a close hotel and found The Gateway Hotel. The young lady at the reception, Anna, was absolutely lovely and helped us so much! Sadly, we could only stay one night, as the hotel was fully booked. We would have loved to stay longer. Our room was big, neat and tidy

title: Mrs
text: Superb. Very helpful and friendly staff (Alexander on main reception was amazingly welcoming). Very well presented room, clean and well equipped. We stayed as a couple with our 2 year old son whilst visiting friends in the local area. We will DEFINITELY be using The Gateway again.

title: simple 2 star hotel
text: Modest hotel. It was clean and well kept with the features to be expected of an economy establishment. Reception closed at 9 and the heating was not on in my small room. Furnishings all very modest and functional. The staff recommended the "Common Room" eatery nearby for breakfast rather than their pre-packed offering. Good advice.

title: Not even worth the cheap price
text: We booked a double room for this hotel two months before staying. At no stage up until arrival did we have any clue this would not be the case. On arriving we were given the key to a twin room, when we questioned this we were told it was all they had, and gave no apology for not giving us what we booked. Things got worse when we got to the room. It was freezing, there was no heating apart from a little portable electric heater, which hadn't been turned on in advance, and had little effect on the room when it did. Added to this was the noise - good double/triple1-glazing might have helped keep the noise from the busy (24hours a day) road and rail line out, but this wasn't there. Neither was any net curtaining, so unless we closed the curtains and pitched the room into gloom we were on display to the world. Reception could offer nothing to help so we left.

title: Brilliant vaule for money and wonderful staff
text: only had one night but was very surprised at value for money. the staff where very helpful and rooms very good standard and very close to tube station still within zone 2 so only 10 min from centre of London. will be staying again.

title: Great value
text: Stayed 4 nites while in London and only a short walk from metro stop with easy access to the city. Rooms were fair size with free Wi-Fi that worked well and staff very helpful and friendly. Would stay here again when in London.

title: Gem in a London
text: We stayed here for one night to go to a gig at Brixton The staff were very helpful as when we arrived we only had some Electric not all was working so my husband went to mention it it was sorted out within the hour ! Rooms little on small side but that's expected in London lacked a mirror in the room maybe a plastic corner shelf in shower traffic noise a issue for rooms on the front ..but ear plugs are provided ! Tube station 2 minute walk away so in a great location ! We would go back 😃

title: Broken window, No services
text: Checking into the hotel went well. It is a short walk from a metro stop and easy to find. The problems began when I came back in the evening. One of the windows was broken and stuck open. Tried calling the desk and the emergency number and no response. Spent the night in a cold room with very loud traffic sounds. Stayed to check out of the hotel and the person running the front desk came in 20 minutes late. I spoke to him about the window and he said simply that there were no windows broken. Asked if he could hold the luggage so that i could come back later and not have to carry it around. He said he was only staying at the desk for an hour or two and then was leaving. The hours for the hotel clearly stated that the office was supposed to be open for the day. Multiple problems with no source of contact. The best thing was the price.

title: Great location & hotel staff fab
text: Stayed here for a gig at O2 Brixton. Easy to find, immaculately clean room & despite being on main road no traffic noise at all. Price ok for London. Access to Clapham South tube station is easy, 2 minute walk away along with a few places for breakfast as not included. Safe area & would stay again. Didn't use car park as very tight & forgot to book but not a prob as on street parking in adjacent road. What made our stay exceptional was the customer service provided by the staff - especially Alex!! Really helpful & friendly and even ran after us to give us extra information about transport options back in case we decided to stay out late after the gig. What a lovely guy!

title: it was fine
text: stayed while over for daughters graduation-room was grand. did not see many staff but was out and about all day. not as noisy as i expected from reviews although my room ws at back. i would go back-good value for clapham.

title: Good hotel, served it's purpose
text: I availed of this hotel for just one night. The stay was pleasant. The rooms were a little small but clean. The situation of the hotel was perfect, just a short distance to Clapham Common tube station, and a short distance to the Common. The interior was homely however, it was well equipped with all the necessities and served it's purpose for this short stay. I would consider staying here again for events organised on the Common.

title: Convenient for events on the Common
text: Had a trouble free one night stay here for SW4 festival. A 2 minute walk from Clapham South station and a stones throw from the Common, booked late and still got a reasonable price (for London) so we were quite content with what we got. Got the feeling that it was a family/couple run sort of place as the staff we encountered were very casual in their dress and attitude. The guy who answered the door at reception upon our arrival did so in shorts and flip flops. The girl who was at reception when we were checking out was exceptionally helpful. I was trying in vein to book airport transportation for later in the day on my phone, I explained this to her and she invited me to pop behind the desk and use the hotel computer to sort it out. This was a lovely touch and ended up saving me €20 so I was delighted with the service.

title: Nice Hotel
text: We stayed in this hotel for 2 nights at end of Nov beginning of dec 07. The rooms were small but it was very clean and we could not complain. the gentleman at the front desk was extremely helpful and it was in the perfect location for us. The tube was a 2 min walk from the hotel and everything was accessible from here. We had a pleasant stay there and would have no hesitation recommending it to anyone staying in London. We previously stayed at 2 other hotels in London that left a lot to be desired. The rooms in the Gateway were well kept and reasonably priced.

title: Good value and very good location
text: Had a pleasant one night stay whilst flat hunting with fiancee. The staff were very friendly and helpful and were there if we needed them. Room was comfortable and quiet. Location is superb for transport as well as getting out for a meal.

title: Great place
text: Nice place to stay, rooms clean and trendy, ensuites really well designed. Super quiet fridge in the room was a nice touch. Nice friendly staff ! Internet handy for planning, paying congestion charge in advance and my case parking ticket ! over zealous parking wardens, Tooting !

title: Lovely hotel, warm welcome
text: I've stayed at the Gateway Hotel Clapham for 1 night. It's just a few minutes walk from Clapham South station. I tried this hotel as I didn't fancy going back to a grotty budget chain hotel I'd stayed at before. The Gateway is lovely, it's very clean and comfortable and the staff made me feel very welcome. My double room had an ensuite bathroom, TV, and wifi. It doesn't have a restaurant but there are plenty of cafés nearby. There is some traffic noise but the bed was comfortable and I slept very well.. I'd definitely recommend the Gateway & will come back again

title: Pleasant stay
text: Stayed here for three nights recently with my mother as it was close to my son's flat. Nice garden to front of hotel. Our room and communal areas were well kept and clean. There was traffic noise but we still slept well. Plenty of shops, cafes and restaurants nearby and close to the tube and bus stop. Staff were very friendly and helpful which we appreciated, a smile and a chat makes a big difference. We enjoyed our stay and wouldn't hesitate to return.

title: Warm Friendly Welcome
text: We stayed for one night as my husband was entering the London to Brighton Bike Ride & this Hotel. was walking distance from the starting point. We arrived at 14:45 & parked our car on site as we had already pre-booked a space which i would advise. We where greeted by a very bubbly guy who made us feel very welcome. Due to the bike ride he had laid out a plastic sheet in the sitting room so guests with bikes could bring their bikes in for safety & also work on them if needed. We booked a double with ensuite which was in the front of the main building, the room was a bit small but for one night it was ok. If we had been staying longer we would have felt a bit claustrophobic. The double bed was a bit small with only room for one bedside table which was at an angle . I myself felt this room was fine as a single , the room was very clean with a nice shower in the ensuite. You are given ear plugs as the noise from the constant traffic would keep you awake . All in all we would stay again but ask for a larger room away from the front . A good hairdryer, fan, iron & ironing board in the room which we were impressed with .

title: great value and friendly
text: I stayed here for one night before the London to Brighton bike ride. The staff (Alex in particular) were brilliant and very helpful. Everything was spotless and the room was very comfortable and well equipped. I was really chuffed to find 4 pillows rather than the standard 2. I've stayed in some more expensive hotels over the years but this was one of the cleanest I've ever seen. Bike storage was available and was well organised and secure. Balham Hill can be noisy at night but the windows do a reasonable job....the complimentary earplugs were a nice touch. Tea and coffee making facilities were plentiful and even had a good selection of biscuits. Can also recommend 'Pizzaria on the Park' which is a lovely restaurant 5 mins walk away past the tube station. Overall, brilliant and would definitely stay there again.

title: Great value-for-money and service - home away from home!
text: We were so impressed by this hotel. The staff were just lovely - from the moment we arrived, they were available to show us around, were friendly and helpful and made us feel really at home. They provided a baby cot for my daughter and made sure we were comfortable. I love feeling at home without feeling "invaded" and the Gateway were able to balance this perfectly. They made us feel welcome. The room was lovely - with gorgeous bay windows and a cute little garden. The room was clean and light/sunny and we had excellent TV and wifi coverage. The bed was comfortable and had tea/coffee/biscuits in the room. The hotel is extremely close to all amenities, including the tube station, shops, restaurants and a large park which was lovely for our daughter to play. I really recommend the Gateway - it is so great value for money and has such great service. Our only regret was leaving to go home!

title: Very pleasant hotel
text: Very clean, pleasant hotel. Helpful, charming staff, especially Alex, guy at the reception, and Anna - they gave me all the detailed hints and information about places I was about to visit and even gave me the travel guide. The room was spacious, always cleaned thoroughly and some cakes and tea were left every day. Close to the tube (2-3 minutes). Although the street was busy the noise was not too oppressive if I closed the window at night. To summarize - a very good quality for a decent prize.

title: Not Flash But Good For The Cash
text: Staid here for three nights a couple of weeks ago. Great location just 5 minutes walk from the subway that then gives you access to all main areas. Nice restaurants, cafés and bars close by. When arriving we were greeted by Alex. A flamboyant, lovely, friendly Brazillian guy who made us welcome before showing us to our room. The room was pretty basic but clean and comfortable. Despite double glazing a busy road is close by and it can be noisy. The owners recognise this by supplying ear plugs. That may seem silly to some but worked for us. Good value, friendly, well positioned hotel

title: Great value for money
text: My partner and I travel a lot for business and I was a little unsure of what we would get for our money. However we were really pleased with the warm welcome, secure parking and clean facilities. The room was more than adequate with a large shower, comfortable bed and tea making facilities. The hotel arranged taxis for us to and from our night out. Whilst ear plugs were provided, we found we didn't need them, although the slight rumbling from the tube trains did amuse us 'country bumpkins'! Great value for money when compared to London hotels. Clean and comfortable rooms. A warm welcome from incredibly polite, helpful staff. I would recommend this hotel.

title: Much much better than expected!
text: Having had the standard terrible London hotel experiences in the past, I wasn't expecting much from the Gateway, but it was well located and well priced so I figured it was worth a shot. To my surprise, it turned out to be a great small hotel - lovely staff, nice clean room - no complaints at all. You do get some road noise in the rooms - but it's London, this is to be expected - earplugs are supplied :)

title: lovely hotel with lovely staff
text: We visited last week, and although our room was quite small, it was spotlessly clean and perfectly adequate, but I must mention that the receptionists were lovely, on arrival the Brazilian gentleman was lovely and very helpful, but a special mention to Danah who went out of her way to help us with bus routes during the very inconvenient tube strike, over all a lovely two night stay, and I would defiantly use this hotel again

title: Average, affordable, OK.
text: Contrary to a previous review, you do not need to bring earplugs

title: Great/Quiet stay close to central London.
text: We enjoyed a very pleasant stay at the Gateway hotel. Room very clean and quite and a really lovely area 2 minutes walk to the subway for central london. Great food stops chinese food and Burger king just acroos the street for a nights snack. Staff were friendly and very helpul

title: Very kind people!
text: Exceptional people- the hotel is run by a wonderful family and everyone working there was absolutely delightful beyond belief. Completely wowed by their kindness. Great location for a 'living in London' experience...rather than tourist chaos. Close to everything you need including transportation.

title: Worth the money
text: Stayed here 2 nights while visiting our daughter in Clapham. Booked a twin room which was definitely value for money, the beds were very comfortable and pillows soft. Good clean basic room with tea/coffee facilities and biscuits. Perfectly good en-suite with decent shower. Nice powerful hairdryer provided as well as iron and ironing board. Although our room was next to the busy road and bus stop, noise levels were low and we had no problem opening the window for some air. Will certainly use this hotel again in future.

title: Small friendly hotel
text: The Gateway is situated on the busy A24 on Balham Hill, London. It is within easy walking distance of the Northern Line tube station, Balham Station and the town of Balham itself. Do not expect any frills but do expect a very warm welcome. The hotel has two parts, the older original property and an added new extension. We were accomodated in the older side. The room and bathroom was clean and of a reasonable size. There are tea/coffee facilities and a television. Room 6 was facing the road and did suffer from some road noise, however the hotel provides earplugs - I slept soundly in the comfortable bed. Car parking is very limited so you need to book a space in advance. Entry is by way of a large metal gate, I suggest you telephone ahead when you are near the hotel and ask them to open the gate as there is no parking nearby and access is difficult due to the busy road. I recommend this clean friendly hotel for people who require easy access to London and do not wish to pay the extortionate prices charged by more up-market hotels in the area.

title: Good Value and Close to Tubes
text: Booked last minute after another hotel decided to double book us! Very friendly on the phone and booked the car parking space also. Room was spacious and clean with good power shower. A little noise from the road but hello you are in London!! They did also provide free ear plugs but they were not needed. 3 minute walk from Clapham South Tube - Zone 2. Opposit garage and Burger King with free cashpoint and plenty of shops within 3 seconds walking distance. Very limited free parking so call early to book a space. Perfect for a cheap night in London :)

title: Not bad!
text: Nice little hotel in a very busy area of south London. Clean room but very small. Upstairs rooms are hard to get to. Next to a busy street and bus stop. Lots of noise and could not open the windows. Staff was great. Very friendly and helpful. Close to underground but not much else going on. Good restaurant next door.

title: Excellent
text: All the staff we met were brilliant right from booking with the fantastic Alex including the other fabulous reception staff they were so kind and helpful and courteous excellent service I'll definitely return, five star gold service thank you

title: Outstanding customer service
text: Whenever my Mum comes to visit she stays here as we don't have room in our flat. Recently, she has had to stay for a long period. The staff here, particularly Deana are outstanding. So helpful and accommodating, ensuring my Mum's stay is comfortable. The hotel is on a main road, so it's not the quietest of places to lay your head, but they do what they don't try and hide that fact (not that they can!) and they provide ear plugs, which is a great touch. The rooms are super clean and comfortable and the value for money at a London hotel is just fantastic.

title: Decent little hotel
text: Stayed 1 night as we went to a gig at the Windmill in Brixton, 5-10 mins away in a taxi. Standard twin room which was clean and tidy. All staff were very friendly and helpful. Reasonable price and onsite parking for extra £5. Would stay again and would recommend.

title: "Well located and very considerate staff"
text: Stayed here a number of times over 6 weeks as a base for UK and further European travel. A small hotel very conveniently located a short walk from Clapham South Underground. Excellent and very considerate staff did agreat job. On a busy road, however this is just part of the city buzz and the plus is a number of shops, cafes and small supermarkets nearby. The rooms were clean with good facilities and the hotel felt safe. As in many places the WIFi was of variable quality in different rooms, more reliable in the reception area.

title: amanda
text: great location stayed here for two nights in October , very freindly near the clapham south underground located near shops, i enjoyed my stay here it was very reasonable especially for London would highly reccomend . On a busy road but london is busy great location would definatly stay here again many thanks for a great stay at a lovely freindly hotel.

title: Excellent stay and location
text: Stayed in this hotel as a couple for five nights in mid-June. We didn't really know what to expect before arrival because of some reviews on this website, but our stay was really flawless. On arriving at the hotel we paid the balance on our account before being offered help with our cases and shown to our room. The public areas of the hotel were very tidy, nicely decorated and felt very fresh. Our room wasn't massive but a good size with it had two large bay windows so lots of light. The room was next to the road which I thought might stop me from sleeping but I had no problems and earplugs were provided if you need them. Daily service was excellent, the maid never failed to turn up and the one time she arrived when we were in the room she was very polite and said she would come back later, no problem. Clean towels every day, tea and coffee facilities replenished, beds made and bathroom cleaned. There was a mini-fridge in the room which was very handy for keeping milk as there are no breakfast facilities in the hotel, though several times we went out for a breakfast to cafés. The hotel is also very close to Clapham South tube station and lots of bus links on the road. There are lots of amenities in the area but Clapham town centre which was about a 15 minute walk away or two minutes in the tube (Clapham Common) had some lovely cafés and coffee shops. Overall a lovely stay in this hotel and would recommend to anyone.

title: Bit damp!
text: We booked two rooms in August 2012. They were cheap (well, for London) so expectations were not high. My parents hated their room as it smelt musty and the full up dehumidifyer only confirmed their suspicions that the building suffers badly from damp. They also moaned about noise from the street and rumbling from the underground, plus the hardness of the bed. However, my parents are habitual moaners, so I am sure they let it bother them more than it should. We found our room ok. We didn't think it was excessively noisy (it is London afterall). However, the carpet was badly stained, the showerhead was filthy and encrusted with mould and general ickyness, and the chest of drawers contained rubbish and a dirty pair of shorts from a previous occupant! Nice. If the rooms were given a thorough clean, I would consider staying here again but think I will pay a bit more for a clean room next time and stay elsewhere!

title: An excellent budget option ...
text: A group of us (two couples) stayed here recently. For London the rooms were a good size and clean. The staff were also helpful. It is about 200m from the tube (northern line) for sightseeing and close to Clapham High St for nights out. For anyone who doesn't want to pay extortionate prices in the city centre I would definately recommend this hotel!

title: What a nice hotel
text: OK so what I mean is relative to the price so for the price I paid it was excellent. The room had plenty of tea, coffee, biscuits and kettle etc. was very clean and so were the bed clothes. There was no cooked breakfast or dinner but it is right next to a great eatery ' Avalon'. The most important needs were more than met even ear plugs in case you are a light sleeper ( a nice thought). For the price it is better than expected and as we were doing the London - Brighton bike ride it was only 400 meters from the start.

title: Great Spot
text: Stayed last night for first time after Emerites match . Checked in 10:40 pm and helped by lovely friendly man behind bar . Shown to spotless room , then back down to nice local bar with a welcoming atmosphere . Shower strong and hot on morning . Absolutely no complaints . Good value and will try and get room here in future when next in area . Pleased I found this place through Agoda !

title: Will definitely stay again!
text: Trolled through lists of hotels and then B & B's in London, looking for one which wasn't too expensive but at the same time clean and comfortable. The New Inn certainly ticked the boxes. It's situated in a very nice, quiet area. Our host was very friendly and helpful, our room clean and comfortable and the Thai meal in the evening to die for. Also as other people have commented once in the bedroom no noise could be heard from the pub below. We would definitely stay here again on any future trips to London.

title: Cosy and charming
text: Very cosy and tucked away in a great neighborhood – about 10 mins from the St Johns Wood tube station. Although the rooms are over the pub, it's still very quiet. There are lots of locked doors between the guests and the outside, so I felt very safe. The hostess is very good at what she does – she even fetched my visiting friend, who was being drenched in a rainstorm on her way from the tube station. I liked this place quite a bit and would love to stay there again.

title: Good value for money and very nice people!
text: My husband and I visited The New Inn in February 2011. We were absolutely smitten with this accomodation as it is clean, cosy and friendly. We wouldn't think about booking somewhere else when in London: it is in a very stylish neigbourhood nearby St. John Wood station. Jan, the owner is a true professional who took very well care of us. After a day of hardcore shopping and sightseeing, it was such a delight to have a drink (or two) at the pub that is also part of the inn. Had a wonderful Thai meal over there as well. The staff is helpful and friendly and we highly recommend this place

title: Nice B&B with a Thai twist!
text: My wife and I stayed here for a night on a very hot June weekend with friends. We were welcomed by a very friendly lady who showed us to our rooms, she gave us a quick tour and showed us how to get into our rooms when the pub closed. She then left us to it. The room had a portable TV hanging on the wall with freeview channels, tea/coffee and biscuits were also provided. The Bathroom was clean and of a good standard. The only critisism we had was that our room was very hot and stuffy, there was a cooling contraption but it didn't really cool the room - it just moved the hot air around. We didn't have breakfast, but we did have lunch after checking in, a selection of dishes from the pub'sThai menu - it was fantastic, very fresh and very tasty. The highlight of our stay. The B&B is about 10 minutes walk from the nearest tube station. We were back late, the pub had closed, we had no problems getting into our room. I would stay here again without hesitation - I just hope the weather's a little cooler.

title: A surprise hidden in St Johns Wood
text: We recently visited The New inn to see and listen to the talents of blues singer Sean Taylor. Nick the owner is a very congenial host,and his staff are most attentive.He has taken this establishment over and changed it, from a beer slopping corner local,and given it a slight continental feel.You can watch tv in one part,you can dine in another or as we did,enjoy a bottle of wine nibbling on cheese and olives whilst listening to live music. Unfortunately it was rather empty.So atmosphere was lacking slighty. They deserve to do better,give it a try,live music every Tuesday,and other special nights too. They also have rooms above ,a few paying guests drifted into the bar and seemed happy enough. So if you are ever in St Johns Wood and Fed up with the normal Gastro pub,and seek an alternatve,especially on a tuesday night when Sean Taylor performs,you will not ,i hope be dissapointed.

title: Loved the New Inn
text: The rooms was very clean and comfortable. The pub downstairs with the locals was very cozy. To relexe in the pub after a busy day with shopping and beeing tourists in London was very nice. We loved our stay and will definitely stay her again next time we come to London. All was perfect.
