You also have all two power sockets to plug in all your devices.there are two mirrors one in the bathroom and one in the room too.I strongly recommend it if you search for a low price and also be in the city center in a couple of minutes(zone 1 means low travel cost)

title: Nice place gréât staff
text: We stayed 3 nights. Good location cheap price basic rooms buy Coran.gave us Windows rooms very polite staff.receptionist MANZOOR very helpful .always smile we Will return n station nearby. London is beautiful.saw good places very nice

title: Graduation Ceremony London
text: Staff is very friends. Specially Saad is a very nice receptionist, great guy. He welcome us with a nice smile. Helped us for our quries. Basic but Clean room. Great Location near Old Street Station. Definitely will come back soon

title: A REALLY GOOD, WELL RUN, HONEST, BRILLIANT HOTEL
text: Booking online a breeze- a good start. Beautiful building, very well maintained, very helpful staff, great, good sized room for price and location. Huge bathroom and all very clean and tidy. I will definitely use this hotel again and will recommend it to friends and family. Downsides, the walls of the room had a number of black marks from ignorant peoples luggage, this needed freshening up- about 2 hours work really. As in many, including some of the best hotels I have experienced, the shower is a bit of a compromise, flow was very gentle, took time to hit temperature and the controls a bit difficult work out. All worked out right in the end and a great experience in my view.

title: Very Acceptable
text: Stayed in this hotel for one night in February. Found it pleasant. After staying in the other Easy Hotels in London I was was pleasantly surprised by this standard. The room was large, and although no window, it didn't feel dark as the lighting was more than ample. The bathroom is small but it's what you expect. More than enough floor space which is good. The heating wasn't brilliant but it was ample. Despite what another reviewer says, the road isn't heard from all rooms. I couldn't hear a thing other than the neighbours down the corridor. However the mobile signal is non existent which is a problem. All in all I would return.

title: Much better than expected
text: I booked 10 nights in a standard twin room for myself and my 10 year old son in July, and since I booked several months in advance it cost just under £400 for the stay. As the holiday approached I started having major concerns about the size of the room and the temperature inside – I didn’t know at the time I booked that we would be having a heatwave this summer! I needn’t have worried… the room had plenty of space for our luggage, it was pleasantly cool at all times, the bathroom pod was cute (and very well-ventilated – which meant that it wasn’t a problem that the shower, sink and toilet were so close together as everything dried quickly) and we barely noticed that there was no window. We knew in advance that we’d have to go out for breakfast so although inconvenient, I can’t really complain about that. We had a slight problem with a water leak one day (apparently from pipework which ran under one of the beds) but this was dealt with efficiently by the very helpful and friendly staff. Altogether we were extremely happy with this budget hotel and wouldn’t hesitate to go back again.

title: Small room and bad hotel
text: Room is extremely small. Bathroom / toilet small, basically no toiletry. Not any extra except a very very bare room. And price was not that cheap. I would not recommend any of my friends and relatives to stay in the Easy Hotel chain.

title: 4 days, 3 nights in London
text: Good location. Clean room. Quiet. But poorly equipped. We were two persons with only one set of towels. Basin in the bathroom was very tiny and couldn’t even wash hands properly. There was not even a chair or a small table to put a bottle of water on. We had to place the bottle on the floor. Wall foldable chairs would help in such tiny space. All our stuff were on the floor. Central AC, not such a good idea. No window...if you want one, ask for upgrade but this will cost more. Room cleaning...yes this costs extra too. But anyhow...because of this we spent more time walking around the city!

title: Fast check in and convenient location
text: Good price, very Fast checkin and perfect location. Close to all transport and amenities. Totally recommended if you plan to stay a few days in London. Amjad from reception was super helpful! Thank you!

title: Friendly staff and clean place
text: Nice and clean place. Close to central london. Good place to move around london in no time. Lot of shopping malls and tourist places around here. Staff are super friendly too. Really welcoming and smiley. Check in check out process was super quick. Overall nice stay

title: Bare minimum
text: I love the concept of the bare minimum but this place does nothing to make the bare minimum feel like a bargain. I saw three rooms. On my first stay it took about 45 minutes to book in, the first room I was given had a light that would not turn off. The second room I was given had a window and I was not allowed to stay there, the third room I was given was OK. The place looks like someone rented an old storage unit on the cheap and there some beds in it. There are chunks missing from some of the woodwork and the corridors are gross. The rooms are OK and what you'd expect for the price. As advertised, they were bare. The only thing I really needed was a little shelf for my glasses. The only place to put them was on the floor. The cubicle bathroom was OK if you don't mind having your feet in the shower tray when you use the toilet. The fuse box thingy above the door was astonishingly noisy. I expected basic, what I got was a shade below basic. Youth Hostels have better value.

title: This hotel should be closed, do not book a room.
text: This hotel should be shut. They are having obvious major problems. We were greeted by buckets collecting water in reception. Which became obvious in the morning that it was waste water and maybe even sewage, it was much worse in the morning, the floor was soaking and the buckets increased. We were on the first floor and our shower didn't drain at all, so it flooded the bathroom almost immediately. Also the thermostat on the shower wouldn't adjust the temperature so it was dangerously hot. Our room was freezing with no way of adjusting the temperature. Our colleagues that were with us for work in 2 further rooms, said their rooms were unbelievably hot and they couldn't sleep, windows couldn't be opened so the room was unventilated and unbearable so they couldn't sleep. When we went outside for a smoke on several occasions, we saw at least 2 prostitutes entering the building late at night as there wasn't anyone on reception. Their minder waited in a car outside. The whole place is very tired and shabby looking, the rooms resemble barracks with scary scratch marks down the walls. We knew there was basic facilities but this is a fairly new build and it has aged very badly. This hotel should be closed to sort its problems out, which there are many.

title: Excellent Staff. But accommodation standard matches the price
text: The staff there were very accommodating. They were available 24/7 and even at 3am didn't hesitate to help me work the vending machine! I in particular would like to thank Manzoor Ahmed for keeping my wallet safe for me when I thought that I had lost it. I came back to the hotel after I had checked out and he had kept it in a secure place in the hope that I would come back and look for it. He was very helpful and even didn't accept my £50 reward when he handed it back to me. I am so so grateful of him and for that reason I really rate my stay 5 stars As mentioned, the staff were very kind and helpful. However I have little to say about the accommodation because for £30/ night. I really didn't expect much more. It was merely a place to rest my head for a few hours.

title: Great location & cheap...perfect for people on a budget.
text: I've stayed here on two separate occasions. It is conveniently located 5 minutes walk from Old Street underground station. Last time I stayed it was in March and they only seemed half occupied. Many reviews do harp on about the compact size of these rooms and I agree the single rooms are tiny. However for very little extra you can get a good sized room if you opt in for a twin and you can push the twin beds together to make a double (I have also stayed here with my wife which has adequate space for two). It is certainly worth the effort, the bathroom is also bigger than the single en-suite, so definitely go for this option if you can afford to do so! Something else to consider is that you must be prepared, namely the air conditioning is a little noisy and ear plugs may be worthwhile if you are a light sleeper like me. Other than that, it is clean, beds are comfy, has someone at reception 24hrs (secure) and boasts many amenities outside i.e. convenience stores, restaurants, tube station all within short walking distance. Overall it's not bad in my opinion, not bad at all.

title: Frozen or boiling room.
text: We stay only 2 nights in a room without windows. The staff was pleasant and the be was quite comfortable. The location was quite good!! The room had a air conditioner super cold and they only can switch if off so it was so warm. They weren't able to regulate the temperature. The bathroom was small and the floor was the same for the shower, if I had known that I would had take flip-flops! The cleansing was not included on the price and the room was not especially clean..!! We were a little bit disappointed with our stay.

title: Noisy room
text: shower curtain smelt drain smelt Room was located next to a generator which meant there was a terribly loud vibrating noise all night! Was not worth the money I paid for, but needed a place to sleep for the night.

title: Just right for one night
text: Wanted some where to stay one night after the London 2012 Paralympic Games so was looking for a clean, cheap hotel which was in easy reach of a tube station, and this was it. We had two rooms which were bigger than I expected. They were clean, with nice towels, and bedding. If you have a room with a window you may end up facing the pavement which as my friend found out was unfortunately noisy from the traffic! I had an inside room (no window) which some people might find odd, but hey you will be a sleep anyway! There is no tea/coffee making in the rooms but there are a number of food places right on the same street. As one reviewer has said there is a small cafe opposite the hotel which do good breakfast with many choices for a good price. I did have a query after I booked and used the easyhotel web site to ask my question, as you can't phone. and as yet (6 days after booking and staying there) I have not had a response even though the web site suggest they will respond in two days Having said that, if you want a place just to sleep this is a good place to stay. I would certainly use an easyhotel again

title: Budget hotels could be done better
text: While I understand that this is a budget hotel and I have no problem with the room size there could be a few small additions to make ones stay easier. The addition of a mirror outside the bathroom near a power outlet would help people get ready as there isn't/can't be an outlet in the bathroom. If the window alcove had a shelf in it that would allow for better luggage storage. Some sort of shelves for night tables as there is nothing and more than 2 wall hooks. Aside from that be forewarned that the 1st day I paid for WiFi and was asked and given 4 codes for our 4 devices. At that time the pleasant front desk person told me that I would have to come down the next day as the codes expire every day (24hrs.). The next evening I asked a different front desk person for new codes as I was instructed. This rude employee told was unaware of my purchase and told me that as I already received 4 codes I received 1 more than I should have gotten. Be aware that it is apparently £10 for 3 days on 1 device. You are not paying for WiFi for the room but rather the device. Overall easyHotel a room to sleep and not much more which I am okay with. Given what I mentioned above along with the damaged hallway with a strong chemical smell I would not recommend this hotel.

title: Good for a small trip
text: The rooms are small and have no windows, but for a small trip it's good. The room has private bathroom, also small. The location is good - 10 minutes away from 2 different underground stations (Old street and Barbican). The are supermarkets and bar/restaurants near the hotel.

title: Stay at easyHotel Old
text: My husband stayed in the hotel for 4 days. Although the room was a bit small he was very positive about great service and support from the hotel staff. Especially Mr. Saad//manager of the hotel was very helpful. My husband's any request was met and he always heard 'no problem' from him asking for even small things. This happens very rare this days. We can fully recommend this hotel!

title: Avoid at all costs
text: This hotel was disgusting. The reception area and desk was old with chipped desks and weird smells coming from the receptionist's office. The hallways were dirty, grubby. There were no cupboards in the room, no air-conditioning I could adjust. The blinds were not working and let the light through on the sides.

title: Good simple stay
text: Stayed there for 4 nights and room was simple yet satisfactory. Staff was very helpful and always ready to answer my questions/request. Location is the main plus point since it is walking distance to lancaster gate and paddington station.

title: A bed hotel
text: This is a small hotel good if you want to spend one night only to be close to Paddington train station only 0.4 mile away and very close to Hyde park . The room small but clean the price are average for bed only

title: What a dump!
text: We stayed here Saturday having been to the Proms in Hyde Park. The room was adjacent to the reception kiosk. You heard everything going on in the entrance hall. The room was furnished with what looked like a house clearance sale! The fact that we stayed there really was a bad call. We had booked 3 rooms some 3 months earlier only to receive s cancellation notice the day before. After much persistence by my other half we managed to recover 2 rooms. With hind sight. We should have accepted the cancellation. They would have done us s favour!! Best visitor they could have would be Hotel inspector! To be avoided.

title: Expensive to sleep and shower in filth.
text: The bathroom was absolutely filthy. The rooms above must flow into our apartments system all you heard was running water. The sofa bed was a fake leather type and although a sheet was supplied it wasnt big enough to tuck in and all I could think of was how many different bottoms had sat on it! Any other places I have stayed with a sofa bed have the proper pull out ones with mattress protectors and are much more comfy. In the bedroom the room was long and thin meaning no bedside table just enough room for a stand up lamp. And about 1 ft to get into bed from the one side. The wardrobe was tall and an IKEA type. We opened the doors and the whole thing tipped forward so dangerous. Upon investigation there was a radiator behind and the wardrobe was not attached to the wall accident waiting to happen. The bathroom was tiny with mouldy dirty grouting. There was dirt and dust everywhere in the bathroom filthy. The bathroom door didn't shut properly because the hinge at the top was coming off. The kitchette area there was mould and damp on base of door. Bare wood on end of worktop, chipped crockery, fridge that didn't stay cold and a wall cupboard just about ready to fall apart. The corridor door right outside my room had the door closer at the top removed and was closed by one of the old fashioned chains in the door frame meaning it slammed ever time someone walked through. Out of the 6 electric sockets in lounge 2 worked, 2 didn't and one was covered with duck tape. The 2 that worked had one of the old fashioned type triple adapters plugged in for fridge, TV, kettle, toaster and microwave! Think that if you turned them all you would have had a electrical fire I didn't try it. It did make charging 3 phones a nightmare. The only good thing was the location. The staff didn't care about the state of the room it was a case of stay or not your choice I'm not the owner I just work here. The owner should be ashamed. The building is beautiful and with a little investment the room could be worth £460 I paid for 3 nights but not as it is.

title: DISGRACEFUL SERVICE and UNRELIABLE
text: This is the first bad review I have ever written and I do not do this lightly however I would not like anyone else to be in the predicament I found myself in ! I booked 3 these apartments 6 months ago for myself and my friends to attend Proms in Hyde park via Booking.com. At 8am the day prior to travelling I received an email saying my credit card was invalid (not true see later in the story ! ) However I immediately rang the apartments directly to assure them we were still attending and I would sort out the problem. The lady I spoke to was not only unhelpful but very rude. I immediately updated my card details on booking.com and received an email to say they were fine. I again rang the apartments to inform them and again talked to the same incredibly rude lady who said she hadn't received anything yet. I told her we were still coming we needed the rooms and that we had train tickets and prom tickets booked and paid for . 5 minutes later I received an email cancelling all 3 rooms ! I rang again and the lady said it was nothing to do with her, this wasn't true as as I was informed by bookings .com that she had cancelled the rooms. I rang her back and she said all the rooms had now been re booked ( this was within half an hour of the original email ! ). After much arguing I then managed to rebook 2 rooms (with the same card she had said was invalid !!!) However we were a room short , eventually she offered to put a mattress on the floor of one of the rooms and it would be an extra £40 ! I was desperate so I agreed. There was no apology in fact I think she thought they were doing me a favour ! Quite disgraceful, So yes, the place is cheap but if you book in advance don't expect to have a room when you get there, they may have sold it to someone else ! the lady I spoke to was clearly not the owner , but whoever the owner is you need to address this problem immediately.

title: Nice apartment, Pefect Location but lack of facilities
text: This apartment was perfect location for traveling, the apartment itself was more like a bedsit but habitable and cosey. The owner took forever to check us in and seemed very at leisure taking his time. He was not present when we arrived and had gone to the shop. The only downside really was the fact there was a microwave in the room, for cooking but it did not work. it was simply being used for decoration. Called the reception lady who had said to me 'Ohh the microwaves dont work in any of the rooms thats just the way it it'. Well i asked her ' whats the point in having them in the room if they do not work'? she said she didnt know. We have paid for this apartment and the microwave did not even work.

title: Lovely big room but needs some attention to detail!
text: We had a lovely big room on the second floor with a good size bed, private bathroom and useful kitchenette. We were greeted by a lovely man who was very friendly. We were more than happy with our room but (some constructive criticism!) some attention to detail is needed to improve. Towel holder was broken, no plug in the bathroom sink and the shower head didn’t fit the fittings... these were minor things to us but still feel they could be dealt with to improve this already lovely room! Will definitely be hoping to stay again!

title: Great location. Basic accommodation in need of attention.
text: A great location, opposite Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens and a very short walk from Lancaster Gate tube station. Sadly the accommodation is somewhat down-at-heel.The kitchenette facilities, especially the fridge, were very useful but in need of a refurb. Both taps were loose and awkward to use. However, the bed was comfortable and the bedding clean and the WiFi was very good. It was a very hot weekend. I would have appreciated a fan but none was available.

title: WARNING! Lack of ventilation and High temperature
text: Some rooms in this hotel don’t comply with the minimum conditions of ventilation, insufficient windows and wall isolation required to be occupied. The temperature exceed 35c degrees at night time without air conditioning or enough windows. Rooms are dirty and have narrow stairways without lift to access them. These issues have been reported to Westminster City Council and are being surveyed and investigated. Refrain from staying there.

title: Budget apartments in great location
text: I have read recent reviews on this place and have to say i disagree with most. It is budget but i found our apartment to be clean and modern with the facilities you need. The bed was comfortable although the wooden base had sharp corners!! The location is great for events at Hyde park and Paddington station. The staff were friendly and helpful. My only criticism was that in this heat a decent fan would be beneficial as the one we had was too weak. We slept with the windows open which meant the noise of central London at all hours. I have stayed in a lot lot worse at greater cost.

title: Disappointing stay
text: The hotel is ideally placed just a minute away from Hyde Park and Lancaster Gate metro station. And compared to other hotels of the same category rather economic. But here is where good things finish. I had booked a 25m2 room but what I was finally given hardly exceedes 14m2. Although guests should leave at 11.00 and new comers check in at 14.00 so as for the rooms to be cleaned, mine was completely filthy. The toilet was tiny and dirty and I had to clean some parts to be able to use it. The matress is awful. Dust under the bed made sure that no one had ever thought of passing the vacuum cleaner. Carpets in the hotel's corridors were also dirty and old. In the morning when more guests take a shower, water in the cabine stopped flowing. Don't ever make the mistake to stay here. It is worth paying a bit mote for another hotel.

title: Dirty and miserable place
text: At once after arriving our two sons got allergic reactions: red eyes, itching red spots on skin. The room was really dirty. Part of our family had to move to another hotel. We tried to negotiate to get back at least part of the money with no success. The sofa was hairy and uncleaned, some of the chairs were so dirty that one could not sit on them, there were dampness damage on the floor near the bathroom. One sheet had big spot of old blood - really disgusting. The room was noisy because of the traffic.

title: Budget
text: Business overnight. Functional room with kettle and coffee etc. Clean and functional and value for money. Tv worked and shower and sink worked. Would stay again. Good location for the event I was attending.

title: Worst experience ever!!
text: This place is rated as a 3star but to be honest i would give a rating in the negatives if It were possible. When one is out traveling on leisure, oone expects conditions a little bit better than home especially if one has paid a reasonable amount for the place. Now, where should i start? The dust on the bedboard that hasn’t been wiped away for ages, the bad condition of the floors such that one can hear the people checked in in rooms upstairs walking, the non sound proof rooms “ i especially hate it when it was stated on the selvreview that rooms are soundproof “. I had an apartment facing the traffic and all that traffic came right into the room, plus that the management thought it was smart to cut a bit of space from the apartment and make it the reception!! Problem is there is no sound proofing so i could hear whatever they were doing in their reception! Not that they were doing anything bad, but guests appreciate the feeling of privacy( if I can hear what you are doing, it goes without saying that you can hear me too). And lastly the bathroom, my goodness,this was like a 2qm bathroom that smelled really bad when I locked the little door completely, I discovered quickly that it was not wise to lock the door to the bathroom. I liked the medicineskap like drawer that was the representation of a mirror in the bathroom 😊 you had to be taller than me though to be able to see yourself in that. On the positive note there was free wifi and good entertainment on a decently sized flatscreen tv. Ohh and by the way, make sure you check if the kitchen wear is really washed before you use it, mine was probably rinsed after the last customer, and there stood a used glass with a teabag in it when I entered the room for the first time. I guess that’s what tipped me off about checking if everything was actually washed. Shame on you guys who are the managers of these apartments.

title: APPALLING DO NOT STAY. MANAGER NEEDS TO BE FIRED
text: Photos are pretty much self explanatory. The pictures are all taken of room 15 as explained by the receptionist. No other room looks like the one displayed. Awful service from the manager who told us that we broke the fire alarm after I told them it was illegal to have a broken one escpecially on the top floor of an old damp building. Manager hang up on me after we demanded a refund and then disconnected the phone so I couldn't ring back. Manager should be fired as she is never there and clearly is unaware and cannot be bothered to fix her apartments and make it a safe building. Be stupid to pay money to come here and we shall not be returning. Just because an apartment is in Hyde Park does not mean they can be disgusting and unkept.

title: Priced low for a reason, not suitable if you don't like stairs!
text: Location was good, very close to underground etc. When we arrived, we checked in very quickly at the small front desk and were given our room key. We were allocated a room on the top floor, little did I know that there was no lift. The stairs seemed endless and the stairway was very difficult to climb. Certainly not possible for anyone who struggles with stairs! The communal area was very run down. There is glass missing in the windows and the area is not kept clean. The actual room was different to the photos advertised. It was well equipped but tired. I was really pleased to have a fridge but we soon realised that it didn't work. The small kitchen area was very dusty and had a smoke alarm directly above the toaster. This was set off when we used it in the morning. My husband wafted a towel under it to stop it but this filled the room with dust. Was disgusting. On the plus side, the bed was clean and pillows were comfortable. A good sized wardrobe was in the room. Sadly no bath but there was a walk in shower. Bathroom area appeared clean. A real mixed bag as there were issues with the lighting and TV was poor but we both slept well. Definately is tired and requires improvement but it's reasonably priced for its location. It suited us just fine as we only required a bed for the night, weren't there very long but took me quite a whole to recover from the staircases!

title: You get what you pay for
text: The staff on reception were extremely helpful and friendly. The apartment was a fair size and had the basic amenities included (microwave etc.). Location was perfect for Hyde Park and Paddington Station. The flight of stairs was long, with no elevator/lift facility. There were a few cracks in the walls and windows on the stairways too. Our apartment had a strange smell coming from the sink whenever it was turned on too.

title: Very very basic
text: Somewhere cheap to rest your head. We wouldn’t use the shower as it didn’t look nice. Couldn’t lock the bathroom door. Very very noisy from street The photos are old on booking site as flat was tired. BUT: Clean linen Great location- parallel behind Lancaster Gate tube. Easy check in and check out. Cheap place to rest your head!!

title: Excellent place to stay. Woke up to the sound of horses being saddled up
text: nice little apartment. Close to Paddington and hyde Park. Pubs and restaurants around the corner. Apartment is situation next the the hyde par stables, so you can actaully here horses with the windows open. Would definitely stay again

title: Weekend
text: Close to Hyde park and under ground station ,not a bad price !Quality of the space ..low medium!small rooms with small bathrooms,the windows are old cose that we can ear everything outside and so feel the cold thru the window gap!

title: Economical place to stay next to Underground and Kensington Gardens
text: Basic older style accommodation with large rooms, kettle and fridge. Old but working laundry machine on premises was a good surprise. Only problem was any form of compensation for reducing our four day prepaid booking to three days after arrival.

title: Disappointing and actually dirty!
text: We had a basement room which may have explained, but is no excuse, for the damp everywhere. The lounge area was huge with a galley kitchen but frankly every everything in the kitchen looked old and well used. The bed in the main bedroom was comfortable with decent quality sheets and pillow which was the only saving grace. The bedroom furniture was very old. The bathroom was the biggest problem and was not good at all....all the window blinds had mould embedded in the material and the cabinet under the sink was frankly a health hazard. The general cleanliness of the room was not up to much either and we only had hand towels....no bath towels available. The location is great, staff friendly and the rooms on upper floors may be better but we did hear that 'we had the best room' so I doubt it!!! We basically dumped our bags, went out, came in late, slept and headed straight out in the morning, sorry, I wouldn't go back!

title: Appalling 'Management'!
text: We booked into Assaha as we were attending Green Day in Hyde Park. Upon returning we found the bathroom flooded and water pouring through the light fitting! The only solution we were offered were 3 towels to mop up the floor. The manager has REFUSED to speak to us and over a month later we are still awaiting even an apology.

title: Good room on a central location
text: This is a place we highly recommend if you want to have a good place to stay for a nice price. We spent one night at the hotel, and our apartment had a good size. A bedroom, a livingroom with a kitchen and an excellent bathroom. The bathroom was one of the best we have ever had in London, and we have been to many hotels in all scale of price range. The sofa was not confortable, but worked for one night. The bed was good. It is very near the Tube and Hyde Park and also very close to Paddington station.

title: Will not be back
text: My partner and I stayed here for 2 nights. In my confirmation email it said check in was at 14.00, I also phoned a day before to confirm check in time and was told 14.00. However when we arrived at 14.30 we were told that our room wouldn't be ready for another hour and half!! The lady I'm reception wasn't very helpful at all. It really messed up our plans for the day as we had plans at 3.30. When we eventually got to room 18 on the top floor (ALOT OF STAIRS) our key card didn't work so we had to go back down and got it fixed quick enough. We were greeted by the smell of sewage! It was very strong. The room was very very warm due to the hot weather, however we did have a fan in the bedroom. The room itself was much smaller than we anticipated, as we were told it was the 'deluxe' apartment. The sofa was worn with lots of stains. Make up marks and dirt on the bedroom and living room walls, which I easily could wipe off (clearly the cleaners couldn't be bothered)!! The microwave was half broken and very hard to open and it was also very dirty inside, there was a small cooker but no cooking pots or pans. Only 1 dirty fork and a few knives, the plates had hairs and grease left on them. The bathroom light kept switching off after a few minutes so I had to shower in the dark. It is slightly modern but badly needs the walls cleaned or pained. We had a fire escape exit with an empty bottle of whiskey and cigarette butts everywhere. When we were leaving the same receptionist from the start didn't ask how our stay was. On the positive not, it was in a very good location, the television had a good range of channels and it looks nice from the outside. It was not worth £193 for 2 nights. Will not be back!

title: Horrific stay
text: We booked ourselves here for a one night stay as we were attending the killers gig down the road in Hyde park. I think its safe to say the only thing good about this place was the location. We had arrived early so our room wasn't ready, however the lady on reception said that there was another room which was ready that we could have instead. We said that was fine as we just wanted to drop our bags off and enjoy the rest of the day. We ended up with a room which was actually in the cellar. And outside our room door was where they appeared to sort all the laundry. We got into our room and at first glance we thought the room was minimal but okay for somewhere to crash. Once we got back my partner sat on the bed to find half the bed was collapsed. No one was available to speak to so we just had to make do. The mattress was quite possibly the most shocking thing i have ever slept on. I think the floor would have been more comfortable, and we was only given one tiny pillow each. The room was far to hot with very little ventilation ( probably because we were in the cellar) the bathroom wasn't very clean and for the price it was just far too basic. The constant noise in the building is terrible.you could hear banging from above us all night, things been dragged along the floor and general voices. I was still trying to get myself to sleep at 4.30 in the morning. I finally managed to nod off and around 6.30/7am the cleaners were sat on the steps outside our room laughing with each other and SMOKING! Constantly banging every door around us throwing what i can only assume to be bags of laundry outside our bedroom door. It got to the point where my other half was so angry he got out of bed and had to actually shout at them to shut them up. They soon stopped talking but for another 2 hours they continued to bang doors and make our stay missersble. We got to the point where we thought it would Be nicer to go sit in the train station and wait for our afternoon train than stay in this so called "apartment" any longer. Do not be fooled by the name "apartment" like we was. This is a small tacky minimal hotel with disrespectful noisy staff with minimal facilities. Definitely wasn't worth the price and will not be staying her again. Think next time we would rather find the nearest hostel. Very unhappy and very disappointed and will be speaking to the head of this establishment to make our complaint known.

title: Overnight stay
text: Friendly and helpful staff. The room was clean and tidy with all needed for a stay. A coat of paint would not go a miss. But overall it was ideal for my needs and . I would definitely use again for a short stay.

title: A-OK Assaha
text: I give it 4 Green Circles, as overall it is good value for money. Stayed a single night. Double room was very good value. Whilst the hotel is a little tired, it is excellent value (less than £60) and a great location. No Breakfast - but there is a fridge, kettle, microwave and toaster in the room. Shower - ok. Decent wi-fi. A few minutes walk from Hyde Park which is bonus and near a tube station and Boris Bike docking station.

title: Well-located...but that's about it
text: It's an easy walk from Paddington station (about 5 mins) and right next to the park. The main room was clean but the bathroom was dirty and tiny (and the shower cubicle was literally falling apart). I wasn't sure about security either

title: Don't go there !!!
text: This is the most terrible place I have ever been !!! The rooms are dirty, there is hair everywhere!!! The bathroom .... OMG, the bathroom is the most dirty place in the world !!! I asked to change my room and they gave me even worse room. There is no reason to visit this place!!! Never again here...

title: Could be better
text: 👍🏻 Good location in the center. Even the closest underground station is far (Lancaster gate was closed) there are plenty of buses. Low price. Large room. All furnished. 👎🏻 Service could be more friendly and smiling. It is a bit noisy. Place was not very clean. Shower and the bathroom were not very well organized and convenient to use. Insecure windows which let the air and noise coming in. There is no lock room to let your luggages. I had to let them near to the stairs, and even there is a camera, it is not very safe. If you have a tiny budget and you have planed to stay only few nights it could be a good deal. Otherwise you could find something better.

title: Avoid this place.
text: Arrived after 4pm, my room was ready. kust realised that the closest underground station is closed to I had to walk for 15 minutes. as they always sais they are close to Lancester station (close till july 17). Room was kinda clean but really old and low maintained. dirty sink at the small kitchen. the tap at the bathroom sink was broken, shower frame is totally rusted. woke up every day as the sunrises since there are no real shades or curtains in the room. noisy area, no double glazed windows. every step on the floor above me was well heard as the floors so thin and creaky. service? no one even thought about asking me after check in if I liked the room? if all is fine? or should I need anything. PAY A BIT MORE AND STAY IN NICER PLACES.

title: Too noisy, creaking floorboards and dragging noises from above us at all hours of the day.
text: We stayed in downstairs basement apartment no 1. The stairs leading down to basement are not too safe as carpet is frayed and has come away from stairs on top step. The reception was above us and there was room 4 behind reception. The blinds were always closed in this room. There was noise coming from there both day and night. Someone kept moving around. We could hear as the floorboards were extremely loud and creaky. Also there was a lot of dragging noises. I didn't complain as I was a bit worried to, as I wondered why there was so much dragging, even during the night. It was quite creepy. Our apartment was not as I'd hoped. The apartment was not the same as the one shown in the picture when I was booking it. It was disappointing. Also the carpet was dirty. There were bars up the window so if there was a fire in the basement area you would not be able to get out of apartment 1. Overall, we have paid less before at other hotels with breakfast included. This apartment was self catering and the only cooking appliances was a toaster and a microwave. We will definitely not be staying here again. Overpriced for what you expect receive.

title: TERRIBLE!!! DO NOT STAY HERE!!!!!!
text: This is the worst in History experience of Staying in hotel (apart hotel) in my life. First of all: 1. The room we got has nothing common with the pictures provided. 2. It is dirty 3. fridge is broken and makes terrible noise (there is no option to switch it off. 4. Every 20 mins we hear the alarm (i guess it is some door alarm, nevertheless it is 3 am and it impossible to sleep. 5. you can literally hear everything around, drunk neighbors who can't fall asleep as well, but enjoy their night by getting drunk and laughing. 6. as a result we have just booked another place and plan to relocate tomorrow (already today as it is 3 am of a new day) Please give this place the worst possible rate from us. I would like to get some compensation as it turned out to be a complete waste of time and money, We are in London only for 4 business days and we have very serious meetings planned for each of these days and I have no ideas who we are to work tomorrow after sleepless night.

title: Better not have high hopes...
text: 👍Biggest advantage is the location cause it's 2 minutes from the bus station, the metro station "Lancaster Gate" *(although it'll be out of service till June or July 2017!)* and 5 minutes from "Paddington". Luckily There were clean towels and trash bags every day. 👎The building is old so be prepared... cause there is NO ELEVATOR! The reception was kind but indifferent. There was NO HOT WATER. There was no central heating.

title: Good location, clean but spartan accommodation
text: The best thing to be said about this 'hotel' is that it is very well located, a stone's throw from Lancaster Gate tube and Hyde Park. It is clean and safe but basic. The room was very small and the cooking facilities poor. There were no pots or pans and just two plates and cups and no utensils. There was no table at which to eat (or seating of any form in the room), so beyond breakfast one would be hard pushed to feed oneself here. The room I was in was located on the very top floor, this required climbing 84 steps of ascent up four flights of very narrow stairs with a suitcase, as there is no lift. So this hotel is not in anyway suitable for the less able bodied. The room was also very hot, even though it was only 20oC outside. In sunnier weather and with two people in the room it would be pretty uncomfortable I imagine. I was undecided between two and three stars (2.5 would be perfect) but as I got a very good price and the location is convenient I opted for three.

title: Good position
text: I think the apartments are in great position, close to hyde park and few minutes from Lancaster Gate station which is very convenient. I booked an apartment for 4 but when we arrived they didn't even open the sofa bed. It's definitely too small for 4 people and too expensive for what we got, but it's London so I guess you pay for the position. I wouldn't say it was that bad but me and my friends got a room on the fourth floor.. and there's no lift so it was very difficult for us to carry all our luggage to the room. Overall it was good for one night, but I wouldn't stay there for more than 1 or 2 nights.

title: Don't Bother
text: I stayed here with my boyfriend

title: great room & nice staff
text: the location is excellent, super close to paddignton and even closer to lancaster gate! the rooms are larger than typical single rooms in london and much cheaper too! great bed! the staff were really helpful & friendly (I arrived really early but they still found a room where I could quickly wash up and leave my luggage) overall just very easy!

title: London trip
text: Did what it says on the can, cheap but cheerful, right by the tube and the West end. A great spot I would use again. Across the road from Hyde Park. The room was decent for a weekend break tad noisy as there was road works but not the hotels fault great pub round the corner with lovely food

title: Not fit for a dog
text: Stayed in the basement it was disgusting food underneath the table when we got there looked like it hadn't been clean floor was filthy it was damp and stunk of damp mould by the bed chest of draws and bathroom door looked like there had been a leak ,had a leak in the ceiling was going all in the plug sockets they didn't seem to concern just gave us some towels never had cooking felicity like it stated the manger was meant to meet us to discuss the problems but did not both worse we've ever stayed in Mouse or rat trap under sink view was terrible damp on ceiling could go on forever

title: Do not consider staying here
text: Stayed here for a weekend with friends for a girls shopping christmas trip . On arrival we paid our fee of £667 for a 4 bed and a 3 bed appartment and were allocated our apartments. Four of us were staying in the basememt and 3 in another apartment on the first floor. On entering the basement down steep stairs with dangerously ripped and dirty carpet and stairwell we came to our apartment number 3. On opening the door the smell of damp hit us and immediatly we had regrets. There were visible damp patches on the ceiling and walls of the lounge area and dirty chairs and the floor looked filthy. In the bedroom next to the bed was mould and the smell of damp was horrendous. Next to the bedroom was the bathroom the door was falling apart and the mould and dirt was unbelieveable. Mould growing on the blinds and a window that would not shut. The paint was falling off the ceiling and when i opened the cabinet the shelf was damp ridden amd falling apart. The shower door had a 3inch gap init so the floor got soaked which was so dangerous. We found paint falling off every where and damp patches too. Under the sofa cushions it looked as if it had never been hoovered and there was chips and lettuce under the coffee table from the previous visitors and a mouse trap sat on the shelf in the cupboard next to a pan. There was no cooking facilities as stated online the stove had been taken out and boarded up due to health and safety as informed by the receptionist . The windows had bars and we were not informed of the fire exit but we think it was a door leading to a ladder that didnt even reach to a safe area. We complained at reception and asked to speak to a manager. We were told he was unavailable and given an email address to contact him . We emailed our complaints and asked him to contact asap . That night there were men moving old beds and broken furniture by our window till gone 11 at night. We were woken early in the morning by the so called cleaners. The last straw was when water began to pour through the ceiling and on to the sockets. All of us had breathing problems and tight chests during the stay and three ended up with sickness. We were told on several occassions the manager would phone which he never did and he had promised to meet us on the sunday morning and again he did not show up . This place is not fit for humans to stay in as agreed by the receptionist and other guests complaining at the same time. How health and safety and inspectors can allow this place to trade in England and be advertised on official booking sites is beyond me .This should be closed immediatley i wouldnt stay there again if i was paid too. I am still trying to make contact with mohammed the manager and will fight for a refund we will be reporting this place to the relevant authorities as in this day and age people should not get away with this.

title: Not very clean room 18
text: Booked here for a one night Dirty and pubic hairs I think i was lucky and got a room that has been updated. But not very well A door to the roof in the bedroom has dirty marks running down it , and i am not keep to sleep in a bed with other peoples pubic hairs. When i checked out the lady was not interested.

title: Cheap price but not enough facilities
text: The hotel staffs were friendly and the rooms are tidy and clean, they do have mini studio flat set in their rooms which includes cooking facilities, fridge , microwave and etc. But the hotel haven't got elevator..so we have to go all the way to 4th floor by stair case. Not recommendable for old people, pregnant unless if they get a room in ground floor.resturants are near by this hotel and u can easily access to public transports.

title: Terrible - don't stay here.
text: These apartments are in a great location. Other than that there is nothing good to say. We had a room in the basement and it stank of damp and stale smoke. The hob had been ripped out and the hole covered with a bit of board. The floor looked like it had never been cleaned. The bathroom was horrid and the bottoms of the bathroom door and bedroom furniture looked like they had been in a flood. Peeling and bubbled paint on the walls, and mould on some of the window blinds which did not all open. The worst, most depressing and dingiest place we have ever stayed - had paid for two nights but only stayed one, could not bear being there any longer.

title: Horrible
text: Stayed there in February with my boyfriend and sister. When we arrived we were put into a room in the basement. Not that it was a problem, it was the fact that it was next to a janitors closet that was never closed. Looked like rat's could sleep there. When we looked out the window, I could only describe what looked like a skip there, old, stained mattresses thrown there. When we first arrived to the room, the smell was unbearable but did not want to open the window overlooking being afraid of what would have climbed in. The bathroom walls were covered in damp. We went up to reception and after explanation all the above, asked to change room. The receptionist, after much hesitation obliged and we were put in a room in the top floor. The new room was much nicer, however, still had a few problems. The sheets were covered in hair and there was an alcove in the bedroom where a dirty sheet looked like it had been there for months! Only upside to the hotel was the area it was situated it, near small shops and an underground. Would not stay there again!

title: Brilliant value for money and very handy location
text: I could not believe what good value this place was. I booked a studio which was perfectly adequate for one person. It had a double bed - very comfy - with clean linen. It was ensuite, with a toilet, shower and basin. It also had a fridge, sink, 2 ring cooker and a kettle with tea & coffee provided. It is in a very centyral location right by Hyde Park and 2 minutes walk from the Tube station. I marked this as 'average' - only because the communal areas - e.g. the carpet were a bit scruffy. BUT, for a budget place to stay this exceeded my expectations and I would definitely stay again. The staff on reception were very friendly and welcoming. If all you want from a hotel is a place to sleep and wash that is clean and comfortable then I recommend this venue.

title: A great base to head of round london
text: Handy for the subway straight here, rooms fair but a little tierd . Large rooms with fridge, toaster, microwave, hob and sink. In the room table and chairs sofa, coffee table cupboard, draws, fan mirror and double bed

title: Awful dirty and terrible
text: i stayed here in July for my birthday. Location wise its fantastic but apart from that it was crap! The room i booked and got was two different things! I was expecting an apartment with a sofa, a kitchenette functioning water which clearly i didnt get! The water so hot we could have a shower, the shower was also full of mold and dark. The bathroom was filthy clearly had some sort of repair done to it cause it looked a state! There was dirt on the walls the tv didnt work properly. The fire blanket was not in the pack. There was no microwave no plugs in the whole place. In the description says there was hair dryer and iron in the room there wasnt! There was no tea/coffee making facilities either in the room either. The towels what was in the room was also dirty. I told the staff they did nothing it was awful. It basically ruined my whole weekend. I asked for a refund or some sort of reduction on the price and was told no cause i apparently stolen things what wasnt in the room. Dont stay there cause it will be just be a waste of money for no reason.

title: Disgusting
text: booked through booking.com and expected tv,fridge,kitchenette,microwave,however the room we was offered was 2 buildings away and had NONE of these. The receptionist was clearly scared while on the phone to owner who to their credit gave us a refund there and then (the owners excuse for our room not having the facilities we expected was "i have more than one hotel,you was placed in a different one!"..making no sense what so ever) . Even if the room did have what we expected the whole building inside and out looked like it hadnt been decorated since queen victoria reigned.. Having stayed in many hotels in the Paddington area of London and understanding the whole "you get what you pay for" when it comes to London hotels, i can honestly say that i would have preferred a night shelter

title: Comfortable Stay
text: We had a very Pleasant two night stay at these apartments, the staff were friendly and the room had everything we needed and was clean. The location was brilliant as it was very close to Paddington station. Thank you

title: Just awful.
text: Not what we booked. Receptionist the least welcoming and slowest receptionist I've ever encountered. Building run down and shabby. Furniture and decor slap dash and mismatched. A beetle in our bed and one in the shower. It was clean enough but definitely not worth the money we paid. The location was what we booked it for as we were at a concert in Hyde Park. We got up and left for a lovely walk in the park in the morning so as to be in the room as little time as possible. They should be embarrassed to charge this amount of money for these rooms.

title: Not Executive
text: My parents always taught me if you can't say anything good don't say anything at all............................ I suppose if I did have to write a review I would say that the location for Lancaster Gate is great, our room was cleanish but oh so run down (very). Everything was broken. I have stayed at cheaper and better. Staff were friendly

title: One night stop over
text: Ideal location if you don't expect a pub to serve past 11.20pm! Room was generally clean, bit pokey. If you're of a larger frame I'd bring shin pads with you. Lovely full English at a good price just around the corner.

title: Good location, nice room
text: The location is great, very close to the tube station and Hyde Park. The room was clean and had heating (it was quite cold in London when I stayed here). Bathroom is modern. You do have anything you need in the room. The only downside is that even though it says apartment, it was a single small room, basically you were sleeping in the kitchenette. And they don't have any lifts, I found a tourist that could barely catch her breath while trying to go up...

title: An embarrassment to London
text: We stayed here after a concert last weekend. The room was basic but ok considering its location. When we got the key for a room, it was missing a sofa bed .. I mentioned it and was assured by the time we returned there would be a third bed. When we returned still no bed so my friend slept on the floor with just a coat. Whilst I appreciate things happen- what shocked me most is the £18 refund gives for a room costing £128 and clearly for 2 people and not 3. Not much more to say really.

title: Would've been great if it didn't stink of wee
text: The room was small but fine. Location great, a little noisy but that's to be expected. I would have been really happy apart from two big problems. 1) The bathroom smelled so bad I couldn't use it. I brushed my teeth using the tiny basin and couldn't bring myself to step into the shower. 2) I was on the top floor and there was no lift. I have a foot injury so it took me a long time to get to the top!

title: Assaha Hyde Park Apartments
text: This hotel advertised as Assaha Hyde Park Apartments on Booking.com, but this same place. After seeing some other reviews on here, I sent a message requesting that we not be put too high up as would find the stairs difficult (I have recently cracked a couple of ribs, so carrying case up stairs not very comfortable), and that the room could have a heavy curtain, as we can't sleep otherwise. First room we were offered was on top floor in the attic, 4 floors up! The blind was translucent, no chance of keeping light out, and the room was unbearably hot, even with the window open. I called reception where the extremely friendly young woman said she could move us down one floor to an empty room, and did so. At least now on 3rd floor - still a long way up, but not too bad, and much cooler room. Still blind was translucent however,Luckily we had both packed sleep masks, as the light from street lighting all night would have kept us awake. Also you should take ear-plugs as even with the windows (not double-glazed) closed the street noise is loud all night long. We found the room to be clean, everything functional, though all very basic and cheap. There was a microwave, kettle and toaster but no hob, but some nice cafes quite near to have breakfast so not a problem. We were very near Hyde Park, which was what we wanted, fine location close to Paddington and Lancaster Gate. The staff were very helpful. Overall, the place was very over-priced -but I guess that is true of much of London.

title: Horrible room
text: Stayed here 4th-5th june, on the downstairs apartments, receptionist was nice and welcoming but room was horrendious, pizza left over in the microwave from people before us, tissues and junk from them to, room cleanyness let it down to much!! Under the bed had dust, dirty ear buds, work gloves & female towel wrappers. Had no sleep at all as we cud hear was the people above us, their tele them moving around and also the room was light as anythicng, curtains wud off been idle!! My partner complained as we cud hear everything at half 5 this morning, man on desk said no other rooms yet the lady this morning said she could off moved us! Other than dirty room the 2 women receptionist was lovely! Also the wi fi was playing up so we couldnt use this!

title: Great value for the location and a family of 4.
text: This is a basic one bedroom apartment, in need of a bit of updating. But it was clean in a great location. The bed and sofabed were great. The bathroom was a bit squashed and the light is on a sensor near the door, not the most convenient.The windows are old sash windows so it is noisy at night. BUT... its a great location with seperate bedrooms for 4 people at £99 for the night, what more can you expect for the price. We would happily stay again and would recommend.

title: 1:50 AM and didn't close an eye yet
text: The location is good, but then ... We're located somewhere at the last floor. The place is small but initially appeared decent for the price. The kitchen is decent, the toilet as well. The sofa is full of stains and the bed sheets not 100% immaculate. The light at the shower is controlled by a sensor which oddly stopped detecting my presence and turned the light off from time to time. I find this amusing and I can live with all the rest considering the price, but men... a terrible sulfate smell comes in bursts and is fullll. So full that you cannot get rid of it with 10 air freshers. One room is completely compromised and now we all 4 moved in the sofa-bed from the kitchen living area which is about 3x4 square meters (the room, not the sofa :) ). I did complaint about the smell and the gentleman downstairs said this is surprising. Although I doubt they didn't know about it, I pushed myself to believe it. I didn't read any review before ... NOW I get it. Just opened a bottle of wine with the hope that I fell asleep before the kids wake up. They didn't seem to be bothered. ... aa and the noise in the bedroom is terrible. The window will not close and there ia a awkward door in the bedroom that seems to go nowhere. Is closed but you can see the sky through the edges. So the traffic noise is all over.

title: Decent and central
text: Decent but not worth the price. Then again, accommodation is generally expensive in London! Unlikely to return. Breakfast acceptable and quite good location- wise. Fairly central to lots of good places. Great cafes close by and close to transport links.

title: OK for one night
text: Room looks nothing like the pictures on website, I requested ground floor but had the room on the fourth floor and there was no lift. Although most of the room was clean, in the room was a door (it was locked and I have no idea where it leads) that had mold on it, and there was a terrible smell in the bedroom. There was an air freshener in the sitting area but it didn't help. I had a short hot shower in the morning, and then when my daughter went to have one half an hour later there was no hot water, Like I said it was mainly clean and ok for one night, but I wouldn't choose to stay here again. It wouldn't of been worth the full price, luckily I booked with laterooms and had a cheap deal.

title: UNBELIEVABLY BAD.
text: My nan, sister, mum and I booked to stay here via booking.com where it looked really nice on the photos they displayed on their website. However, after a long 4 hours of travelling we arrived late to this "grot hole." We had half an hour to get to our show in Victoria so we just dumped our stuff there and left. When we woke up in the morning, we were cold, and STILL tired where my nan had been up all night because of the traffic, people above us and banging doors. (she's elderly) and my sister who suffers from severe asthma had really suffered because of the DAMP on the walls. Not only was it DAMP but we were in the basement where our windows were restricted with metal bars and dirty Windows. The shower didn't ever get hot so we couldn't use it and the floor had an ant infestation which we later on found in the corner of the floor near where I SLEPT. We had no cups or glasses and no towels. We decided to address the issue and speak to staff where they offered us a room change. THE ROOM they changed us into was DISGUSTING, and smelt of poo. (slightly odd?) and then she took half an hour to find another room which also had damp all over the walls. We then had to spend out £199 on another hotel and leave for the next night. WE WONT EVER RETURN AND HOPE THAT NOBODY HAS TO GO THROUGH WHAT WE DID. Fortunately we paid £260 for the 2 nights and our being reimbursed £105 of that.

title: Very bad place to stay in... AVOID!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: Very bad place to stay in for any purpose. Room is dirty and we found dirty underwear and soaks in the shelf. Electricity was cut in room and had to wait 4 hours. Dirty kitchen and very hot room and uncomfortable beds. They try to lie all the time about the facilities available in room such as iron. When i complain they offer to give me smaller room than i booked. I decided to leave the hotel and find another hotel. AVOID!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! it's not cheap for the bad things you will find in the room. The Staff behavior is so bad and aggressive and not responsible.

title: Awful and failed to repsond to complaints
text: Difficult to know where to start really. We stayed on the night of 21st October, paying £93.50 plus £20 for car parking. One of the reasons we chose this hotel was because it boasted a car park. In reality, the car park was in an atrocious condition. In order to access it via a shabby makeshift gate, I had to call on the help of a builder working on the adjacent property, who had locked it just as we arrived. He spoke no English at all and this took some time but when we eventually managed to get in, the only remaining space in the car park was like a quagmire. Our shoes and luggage got covered in mud as a consequence. When I needed to return to collect something from my car later in the evening, the car park key could not be found so I had to go out and back in again via the staff exit, down slippery wooden steps which were unlit, as was the entire car park. For some inexplicable reason, the car park excess fee had to be paid in cash and card payment was not allowed for this 'extra'. The bed was the hardest thing I have ever slept on, or tried to sleep on. It was the single most uncomfortable mattress I have encountered and we slept very little on it. There was no mattress protector, only a very poor quality thin sheet over this ironing board of a surface. The net curtains were filthy. In the bathroom, there were water stains in the shower, the shower tray was badly chipped and poorly filled, the shower head and hose were wrapped around the taps, the bracket being completely missing from the wall, the grouting was stained and mouldy, the soap dispenser above the sink was broken leaving an unfilled hole in the wall, the grouting around the various surfaces was very poorly completed, leaving holes and uneven edges. There was no remote control for the TV and none available at reception. When I went to reception about these issues, the member of staff on duty seemed new, and was struggling with several complaints from other customers. It soon became clear that there were no other rooms and so the opportunity to move was not available. The fire alarm sounded just after 5.30 am, disturbing the remnants of the little sleep I had managed to get. Soon afterwards the building site next door started up and I gave up trying to get back to sleep at all. When I raised my concerns the following morning, there was no hint of an apology, just a request to put my complaint in writing to an e-mail address. I have done that three times and had not even an acknowledgment.

title: Ok, but I wouldn't stay again
text: First off, it was clean, and the staff was friendly. But, the room was really small, and had a sink and two burner "kitchen" taking up space. They would have done better to get rid of that since it took up space and wouldn't satisfy anyone who was really looking for a kitchen in their room. The walls and the desk chair were a bit time worn, and the elevator was often reluctant to open its doors. If I had been visiting as a tourist, I would have been unhappy with the location. As it was, for a night before heading to Heathrow, it was fine. I paid 88 pounds. Supposedly that was half-off. No bad, but at 160 I would have felt ripped off.

title: Good location, lots of stairs.
text: This place is in a really good location! Really close to Hype Park + a couple of different tube stations. We were on the 5th floor and there is no lift. It was 86 steps up which isn't fun with a 20kg suitcase but it did help to burn off all of the pub meals we were eating! Because we were on the top floor the shower ceiling was so low that we couldn't even stand up so ask for a lower level if you're any taller than 5"! There was a tiny kitchenette which was enough for us to store our cereal and milk or make some toast. It's poorly signed from the outside so make sure you know the exact address because they did have the street number on display. They did let us check in around 9:00am though which was really handy after 36 hours of travel from Australia and which we were very happy to be able to do.

title: Basic and noisy but good value for money
text: We had the basement apartment during the Olympics at very reasonable price. Overall the rooms were large enough however not as clean as we would normally expect. The location of the hotel next to Hyde Park and Lancaster Gate is perfect, the staff friendly. Overall we would use it again as a budget place but not for business.

title: Never again!!!
text: This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. I was given room 12 which was filthy, the window didn't close, the bathroom was so small you couldn't even turn around and the whole experience was horrific. I did not stay in the room which I had paid for, luckily my friend was staying locally so I shared a hotel room with her. The hotel may be cheap and in a good location but I wouldn't advise anyone to stay there, even rats wouldn't stay in the room.

title: Great value!clean!
text: Stayed in room 14,overlooking,the Horse stables!yes real horses! Amazing,a kitchen,en-suite bathroom,super clean!£60 a night! Big problem,intercom does not work!spent one wasted hour,finding wifi,to find phone number,to go and stand at the door,and phone reception,they could put a notice up, saying this! Great location ,but hard to find, Come out of underground,turn right,then next right,walk up to,where there are two sets of traffic lights,cross the busy road,and its the 5 row of houses,in front of you,its badly signed! Come out of the building,turn left,on the corner,a small shop,turn up the street,and the next street,on your left,behind the apartments,are stables!great fun to see!

title: If you want the Ritz, go book at the Ritz
text: Quite honestly the reviews about this place are a little unfair. This 'hotel' just off Hyde Park (Lancaster Gate tube station is literally a stone's throw away) is NOT listed as a ***** or a **** and not even a *** You get what you pay for and £60 in the heart of London gets you the Hyde SO. Room was clean, the kitchenette dated, bathroom clean, sheets clean and the bed comfortable. What it lacked in palatial amenities it made up for in its location. Superb bars, delis and restaurant all around and within easy walking distance. It provided me with a place to kick back and relax after a busy day at the LBF @ Olympia. If I could have afforded the Ritz I would have booked the Ritz. I couldn't so I didn't. I got what I paid for and I'm not going to whine that it wasn't as well appointed as a true ***** Cheap and cheerful, and during my stay, thankfully devoid of moaners and whingers. 👍👍

title: Location isn't everything!
text: As a family of 4 we stayed here right before Christmas. Yes it is ideally situated near to Lancaster Gate Tube and winter wonderland at Hyde Park, but there ends the positives. I am not a fussy person but these apartments are not great. There was only hot water coming out of the tap in the kitchenette area,and I do mean hot, so had to buy bottled water to make a cuppa safely. The fire blanket was zip strapped shut so absolutely no use in a fire. The shower light was on a timer and went off on each of us while using bathroom. The shower screen was useless and using shower resulted in covering the whole of the bathroom floor with water. Windows need replacing as you WILL be kept awake from outside noise, was as if we had window open all night. Finally the duvets were stained and dirty and could hear everything going on in next apartment.

title: Awful
text: I stayed here with my partner and 7 year old near Christmas this year. I had to call from the tube station and the lady sounded as if she had never took a call in her life. She directed me left... Which after a long walk I asked a tube staff and he replied 'no u go right.... And if I ws u I wud think bout finding another hotel' immediately I was concerned. Got there n told her she gave the wrong directions n she didn't even apologise just looked plain hopeless. She then directed us up FOUR flights of stairs to our room. I get to my 'executive suit' and it's basically an attic. With a double bed. I called her (not doing those stairs again) and asked to sort a bed out. A camp bed came n wen my daughter sat on it it began to fold. Fuming but couldn't face that silly hopeless woman again. Other than hearing n feeling every gust of wind(due to being on the roof) we survived but learnt location isn't everything.

title: Avoid
text: I'll start with the positives, because to be fair, there were a couple, but definitely not enough to warrant a good review. Staff was helpful, location was perfect, towels were clean and fresh everyday. The first room we stayed in was completely disgusting. Stains on the wall, black mold in the shower, wardrobe looking like it was going to fall over, tiles broken in the bathroom, curtain rod falling down, among other things. I called the place I booked the place through and they told me to talk to the front desk. I did and they switched me to a slightly less disgusting, but still not what I would consider clean room. Another big thing, wifi was spotty at best and had to burn through a LOT of international data figuring things out. Photos are very misleading on the site. More like a frat house. Very dingy and dirty. This is a one or two star at best. If this is your special trip that you've been saving for to go to London, PLEASE look elsewhere.

title: the website is very misleading avoid to avoid any disappointments
text: I was lead to believe I was paying for a executive room that sleeps 2 adults 1 child the room I was given number 10 was nothing like the rooms advertised on the website my room was grotty the skirting boards were filthy the doors were black the decor was dated not contemporary like the website had described the crockery and cutlery and fridge was dirty the toilet bowl and shower was dirty the bed was uncomfortable the only good thing was the location . I feel I was overcharged for the room I had actually been given not what had been advertised on the website I had been informed by late rooms that it was as saga that put the website together not them so a call to the trading standards I have spoken to the receptionist via phone her reaction I do not see what your problem is this has promptede to take this further they could not have offered me an alternative because the rooms were full . They have taken my money they are not bothered anyone reading reviews avoid booking there I will not return I will not use late rooms again to book any hotel

title: Good start to our trip - Assaha Hyde Park Apartments
text: My husband and I started our UK trip at the Assaha Hyde Park Apartment building and it was a pretty good place for us. We stayed for 5 nights and had a ground floor room. My husband has a lot of food intolerances so I picked this place for its kitchen facilities. The stove top didn't work so the owners had put in a hot plate for us to use which worked but cooked everything very slowly. The fridge was also very handy to have and saved us a lot of money. We found staff helpful and enjoyed the use of the pamphlet stand in the foyer. The bathroom was handy and we appreciated the bed being made each day while we were out. It wasn't perfect (there was a reasonable amount of street noise, the bathroom had a few bugs in it and the bed springs made noises as they moved) but it was a great location and with the price we paid we could not expect any more.

title: not a pleasant stay
text: Should have written this before. This place was advertised as a nice place but unfortunately it was a very bad place to stay. It has a great location but it has the pleasantness of a medieval lodging. I should have complained at the time but I guess we were tired of our journey and just wanted to relax. First off they didn't say anywhere there was no lift in the place. We had to climb four flights of stairs to the attic part of the hotel. It was supposed to be a whole studio apartment but it was just tiny. For the price we paid for two nights. It wasn't worth it. That was not all, the light in the bathroom had a mind of it's own. Every time you went in, the light decided to turn off after a few seconds. I worked out you had to turn it on, once let it turn off, then turn it on again, straight away and it would work longer. I lost sleep over this stupid light. I could hardly relax then to top it off my partner really hurt himself as he walked into the door as the light went off randomly again whilst he was coming out of the bathroom. I should of complained, or read some of the reviews before we stayed and paid [first day!] as they all seem to be negative as I read them today. My advice is, do not stay here, despite the location, it was not a great place to be. There are far better places to stay at a better price I am sure

title: Excellent location and very helpful staff
text: I stayed here for weekend I really can't put in to words the experience we had at the hotel it was fabulous the staff were so polite and explained every thing nothing was too much trouble they ordered taxis and gave advise of local amenities and attractions both my girlfriend and I thoroughly enjoyed the stay from start to finish and would definitely stay here again and recommend to any one wanting to book To be honest there really wasn't any thing to dislike about the hotel or the staff excellent experience all around.

title: Enjoyable Stay - Boiling Hot Room!
text: Location was fantastic, close to hyde park, and a lot of local attractions such as museums, it was also very close to the underground station. Staff were friendly enough. Our room was on the top floor, which involved a lot of stairs, but we didn't really mind this as we were pleased with our room. It had everything in it that we needed, fridge, kettle, and all the other basics. Bathroom and kitchen were clean enough, although the bathroom was a little on the small side. The only real downside was the heat, but it was during the summer heatwave, the room could have done with some air con or a fan. Other than that I was very pleased with my stay, and would probably stay again.

title: Not an apartment!
text: Stayed overnight to attend a concert in Hyde Park 5th July. Booked due to close proximity to the park and reasonable price for London. No name outside of 'apartments' so could prove difficult to find unless street number noted prior to arrival. Check in desk is simply a small cupboard with a chair and chip and pin machine! Quite slow, but understandable as was quite busy due to other Hyde Park attendees all arriving together. Entrance hall quite shabby, definitely not inviting. I admit I had read reviews on here but my daughter had already confirmed our booking and we couldn't cancel due incurring full charge. I didn't in anyway expect 5* and decided to arrive with an open mind. PLEASE READ AND NOTE THE REVIEWS PRIOR TO BOOKING! Unfortunately the majority of them are true. We had room 11 and it could not be called an apartment by any stretch of the imagination. Our room was approx 12x12ft and consisted of a 3/4 bed along the right hand wall, to the left was a wardrobe, next to this a sink with a two ring hob set into the work surface, underneath was a fridge. in the corner was a tiny, dark bathroom. The room was not filthy, however neither was it clean. Very outdated, shabby, hair in both shower and fridge!!!! Nowhere to sit except the bed.Blind did not work, no curtains, sash window very difficult to open. it was very warm in there,however, a fan was already provided. On the plus side the bed linen was clean, as were the provided towels. Bed throw at bottom of bed old and didn't look clean. For a few more £ I know we could have booked a much better deal in a far superior hotel. We paid £119, which some would state is cheap for London, but this 'apartment' is a bedsit!!! Very noisy overnight due to traffic, constant traffic begins early hours. Not sure what/who were above us but continuous banging and moving about. Maybe a room for domestic staff or other staff??? Really annoying. I wouldn't have thought it were other guests packing or preparing to leave as began approx 06.00am and it lasted for over 4 hours!!!! Couldn't wait to leave. Please do believe the reviews, the negative ones are accurate. Will not be staying again.

title: ok for a couple of nights but wouldnt like to self cater there
text: went to see Ozzy so excellent location. For appartement read bedroom with kitchenette. No seating for relaxing or eating so had to sit on bed for both. We were in room 21 so had 83 steps to climb. As its in the roof space effectively all ceiling is angled. I'm 5"4 and could not stand up straight in the shower, which is set up with door so you flood the bathroom which for a very soggy step out onto the bathmat an wet marble tiled floor. Would not go back for anything longer than an over nighter.
