text: The first thing I noticed upon entering my room was how atrociously small it was!! Don't be fooled by the posh exterior of this building! Also I was appalled to notice that the duvet and pillow did not have covers on them - they were simply placed on the bed for us to do ourselves!! The bed sheet only just about fit the mattress also. Aside from this, the room and ensuite was of a clean standard. We booked a room with English breakfast. The food was absolutely nasty - the bacon was undercooked and the sausages simply unedible! However, the eggs were cooked nicely and I ate this with the toast. Also one of the drinks machine provided lukewarm orange juice and apple juice, luckily the other machine was slightly more chilled! Overall, for the money I paid for this hotel, it was average, and I chose it based on the location which was the positive. Would not recommend however, could probably get a room that's better value for money!

title: Safety Concerns
text: Horrible is an understatement. There are safety concerns. Someone actually go through the stuff I had left on my bed. I also overheard that other guests had lost their items and the counter staff simply ignored the guests when they complained. The area itself is a non-white district, plus some of the guests staying there gave off a weird vibes that doesn't feel like the usual backpackers. Cleanliness is also an issue. My hair actually itches after two nights at the hostel. Zero customer service as well when you request assistance from the counter. Appearance of the hostel looks OK but it is very deceiving.

title: Great hostel on the South Bank
text: We stayed 5 nights with "Borough Budget Rooms", partnered with Rest Up London and housed in the same building. We found the room and facilities to be very clean, the front desk was friendly and accommodating, and although it is quite far from everything, the bus is literally at the front door (and Elephant and Castle tube 5 minutes away). We walked to Borough Market and Tower Bridge no problem. The accommodations are very simple, and there is not much atmosphere, but as we only needed a clean and comfortable place to sleep, it was perfect for our needs, and very reasonable priced. I found the bed to be comfortable enough. We took a private room with ensuite bathroom so I cannot attest to the communal washrooms / showers, and we didn't take the breakfast so I can't comment there either, but if you are looking for clean, simple, and value accommodation on the South Bank, I would not hesitate to stay here again.

title: Great stay
text: My friends and I really Enjoyed our time here. Stayed in a 4 share dorm. The dorm and other facilities were very clean. Was a little busy due to the fact that the schools were visiting, so if you're looking for a party hostel - not the place for you. Was quiet easy for public transport too with a bus stop out the front. All staff were very helpful especially Alex who went out of his way to make me a great espresso and give me some extra trip advice! Thanks again!!

title: For Students
text: Well to be honest it was a shock when i realise that they are working mainly for huge groups of students. its more like a dormitory. well open to everybody as well. Lockers were the most expensive thing. you pay 2 pounds for locker but just for one use so imagine you forget something you have to pay another 2 pounds. aprt from that it was a bed to stay ....

title: Place to stay in london
text: Young people or persons If you are looking for short stay place in the heart of london almost That's clean Value for money That's busy buzzy vibrant lots going on This hostel is in place 5 minutes from tube station Frequent buses outside This is the place I have seen the facilities excellent

title: Good
text: I liked very much this place, the common areas are great! The rooms are ok, the beds make noise when you move. The toilets and showers are together and they're make and female mixed.

title: The worst of the experiences
text: I made my reservation online and my selection was to share with 4 people and private bathroom, it turns out that in this hostel there is no option of private bath, on the other hand the receptionists extremely rude, in the time that I was there, a lady of about 50 years old was in my room and Then a gentleman with two children and as I read it is for people no older than 30 years ... I made my payment in advance and payable in advance there is no refund ... Dirty rooms, I ordered a coffee and was told they did not have time to do it.

title: My Worst Hostel Experience
text: The toilets on my floor were clogged for my entire stay and the staff didn't seem to be bothered by the fact. Wifi was only available in the lobby and was terribly spotty. Rooms meant for 4 people were the size of walk-in closets. Oh, and the lounge on my floor was shut for most of my stay. I usually stay in hostels when I travel and this was hands down the worst experience I've had.

title: Bare minimum
text: Good price, the staff is friendly, and a welcoming lounge area with cool decorations That's all you get. The rooms are empty. Uncomfortable beds, stained white sheets, creaking bunks, loud drunks heard through these paper thin walls. They charge for every little thing, just like everywhere else in london.

title: rest up London
text: the rooms were basic but fine. The staff were really helpful and friendly. But the toilets and shower rooms were awful- cleaned with only water which just made it muddy. The showers and loos were never cleaned whilst we were there. resulting in faeces etc being in the loo and bins regularly. For the price we could have got a cleaner apartment between us! The placement of the hostel was very handy for seeing London though.

title: Good location
text: We stayed with 2 friends 3 nights, and was a good deal. Buses close and subway too (10min walk). Breakfast was nice. Room was okay, and facilities too, It is a good place to stay, you even have a night bus for your crazy nights in London (Camden!!). Good place, I will do it again

title: Your Average Hostel...Adequate at Best
text: Stayed here with 3 friends on a weekend trip to London. We had a 4 person private room with a shared bathroom. Thank goodness I was with 3 people I knew in the tiny room, because the room was so unimaginably small that staying in there with strangers would have been very awkward for moving around. Bathrooms were disgusting. I would not take a shower in there for fear of coming out grosser than I went in. On the upside though, the rooms were very clean and the beds were very comfortable! Everyone at the front desk was great help too! As far as location goes, it was a nice walk to the closest tube station (Elephant and Castle)...luckily we had nice weather. The neighborhood also seemed a bit "iffy" at night

title: AWESOME!
text: Nice place, really near to the city centre, kind & helpful staff. It is open 24h so there is no problem with coming back from the party. Rooms and bathrooms are clean. Very close to the bus stop and underground.

title: Highly recommended Hostel
text: After solo backpacking for the last 4 months and visiting 21 countries the team at Rest Up hostel were the most friendliest and helpful that I have come across!!! Consisting of Sam, Taty, Leah and Morgan they made my stay very enjoyable and helped me a lot with the paperwork I required to set up bank accounts and look for employment and gave me a lot of useful information about London. They went above and beyond their job description to help me out which I couldn't be more thankful for. Rest up hostel itself is in a perfectly central location being close to bus stops and train lines, it has a great atmosphere and vibe with 2 large hang out areas which are perfect for just chilling or organising your life if you have just moved to London like myself. For the price it is a steal and I would highly recommend Rest Up hostel to anybody that is looking for somewhere to stay in London. Thanks again Sam, Taty, Leah and Morgan :)

title: Great service for awesome value!!!
text: My stay in Rest-Up was quite brilliant actually and has resulted in me going back everytime I have business in central London.The location is perfect, very close to Elephant & Castle tube station and a bus stop right outside the building!The staff are always very friendly,helpful and it is refreshing to get exceptional service especially for the little price they ask for per night.Breakfast (full English) is generously presented portionwise and the food offered on the menu throughout the day is always fresh,affordable and neatly presented. Wi-fi is in the reception area and dining area only but I was able to access it from the 1st floor room I was in too probably above the reception:)The hostel is clean and has lots of loo/shower areas located on all floors and they have a beautiful balcony sitting area up on one of the floors to watch a gorgeous London sunset skyline.Absolutely amazing hostel to relax after a busy day and I am still going back for more as the service is consistent

title: Great hotel with friendly staff & good facilities
text: Friendly helpful staff, comfortable room, great pool & sauna. Delicious breakfast with wide variety to cater for all tastes. Good location close to Southwark tube station. Only disappointment was evening meal in restaurant on Friday night- it was overpriced, burger was greasy with nasty aftertaste & bill included unnecessary service charge. Despite this would recommend & would stay there again.

title: Excellent
text: Great hotel, nice modern rooms. Good location, 5 minutes walk to the tube. Very friendly staff. My family enjoyed this stay. Nice detail with the frosted window in the bathroom. I would certainly recommend this hotel.

title: Fabulous
text: Only stayed for one night but had a great time. Good location, lots of places to grab a drink or a bite to eat nearby. Very close to lots of London attractions on the south side of the river. Breakfast was good, a bit pricey if it's not part of your room rate. If the hotel is busy then I would get to breakfast early as there was quite a long queue of late risers.

title: Very comfortable and efficient.
text: The reception staff were excellent and gave an immediate good (and true) impression. My superior room was cleverly designed in contemporary style. It was well lit and furnished and a pleasure to be in. The room was spacious. The bed was very comfortable and clean and the bedside lighting was perfect for reading in bed. The A/C control worked well and I was able to achieve the comfortable temperature I wanted. The buffet breakfast was very good with plenty of choice and I was well looked after by the “breakfast team”. The location is much better than it might perhaps seem for the City, just a short walk over the Thames and great for the South Bank and also the St Pauls area. The staff are doing an excellent job. I stayed on business and will definitely stay again and recommend the hotel.

title: Modern, clean and well located
text: This is a great, new hotel. Not the cheapest in town, but some really cool features like under-water music in the pool, iPads on the breakfast tables, free wifi, and excellent breakfast. These people really know how to run a hotel. Highly recommended, unless you want that cozy mum&dad B&B feel.

title: good place to stay
text: We stayed here in November for a long weekend. It was easy to find only 15 mins walk from Waterloo tube station. Check in was a little slow but not to bad. The staff were all very pleasant and helpful. Our room was on the 7 floor, it was very clean and it was also quiet which was good especially at night time for a good night's sleep. We ate in the restaurant which was nice the choice of food was quite good. The restaurant was busy in a morning and we had to wait a few minutes for a table, but the choice was very varied. On the whole very good we would stay there again, a good base for touring around London.

title: Yes. I knew They could - på norsk nederst
text: In Norwegian at the bottom På Norsk nederst Last time we were at Novotel Blackfriars we had much problems and gave them 2. This time (always give another chance). It was a success. We stayed in an Excecutive room with balcony. We had two days with a lovely sun in the morning at the balcony with coffee. In March! :) The rooms are modern, ironing equipment, safe, good place, a little sofa and Nespresso maschine. There are gym that is good, small, but everything you need. Good breakfast and Nice staff. Front desk staff is very friendly, polite, recognise you fast. A great staff. And they do try to fix whatever It should be. Do recommended the hotel. Also very close, to two tube stations, and 20 minutes walk to Covent Garden, 35-40 to Buckingham. Dette hotellet har alt du trenger på rommet. Nå bodde vi på de rommene som har balkong, og det er veldig behagelig å nyte morgenkaffen i sola, i 12 etasje i det som er i ferd med å bli et veldig moderne og fresht område. 200 meter til to t banestasjoner, men du kan fort gå via Covent Garden til Buckingham eller Oxford street. Vi brukte ca 20 minutter til Covent Garden. Veldig nært er det kiosk, Boots og flere restauranter. De har en god frokost, med godt brød. Mye godt til kaffen og. Du får kaffen i kammer til bordet som er praktisk. Veldig hyggelig resepsjon. Spør og de prøver sitt beste for å hjelpe deg. Anbefaler hotellet :)

title: Still new, and a find
text: I have stayed here twice, once on business and once for pleasure, on each occasion for two nights. The location is excellent for both business and pleasure. Although south of the river, a short walk takes you to Fleet Street, the Strand, Covent Garden and beyond in one direction or Ludgate Hill and St Paul's in the other. The hotel is still relatively new so that taxi drivers do not always know where it is-be very clear about the directions so that you do not go to the wrong hotel. Reception was very professional. I had a luxury room on both occasions, with a balcony and a view of the Shard. Worth it, especially at weekend when the rates are cheaper. The room and bathroom were excellent. Breakfast was the standard Novotel breakfast bit arranged in a breakfast area with some innovative seating arrangements. Overall this would be one of my top choices for a London stay-very clean, modern, relatively quiet and with very smart and professional staff. I hope it stays as spotless as it is at the moment-if so you should not be disappointed.

title: Family not business
text: I stayed at this hotel for a business trip. The hotel has a nice contempary feel with good facilities and is immaculately clean. Unfortunately I had a very disruptive nights sleep due to people running up and down the corridor and a smoke alarm going off. Whilst this is not the fault of the hotel I would have expected an acknowledgement at least from the reception staff when reporting these issues. The breakfast had a good selection of continental offerings

title: Great hotel, well located
text: Very nice place and very nice staff. I also greatly appreciated the restaurant Jamboree. I had a very good salad and the day after a burger . The atmosphere is relaxing and design is really cosy and classy

title: Great hotel for business or pleasure
text: Checking in is relatively smooth. The bar is located to the right hand side of it. For a London hotel bar it is averagely priced. The rooms are modern and clean. Always go for the room on the higher floors to get a better chance of a decent view. Its a bonus in London having the pool and sauna which is located in the basement. Makes it almost worthwhile in itself. It is so much better than the IBIS next door. The only downside was the breakfast was average at best. Still its either here or the H10 when I'm in London. As for dining in, Why? You're in London. Eat out :-)

title: Familie visit to London
text: This Hotel is an other typical Novotel style. The lobby are open space where you will meet very friendly personal who easily check you in. Kids can play on a table pc while waiting. The rooms are very nice and are a fairly/ large to for two parents and two kids. Bathroom are a fun space and open. Tv, bar and coffee are okay as well. Our view was poor. Looking down into some cooling towers. But there was no noise from them. A big plus for this hotel is the pool area. Clean, big, hot and pool depth are only app 1200 mm all over. Sauna are around 60 dgr C, so everyone can stay in there. We managed only to have breakfast there during our stay but it was perfect. Plenty to choose to eat. Personal was again friendly and funny. You are in the middle of London but you can not hear or feel it, quite hotel. Recommend this for family stay.

title: Comfortable stay in London
text: We decided to have short stay in London sightseeing, and found this hotel with good location, just 1 mintute walk to metro station. The room was clean and tidy, the pillow and bracket comfortable! Breakfast was alright and allow to take upto 11:00am which was good for late wake up travelers.

title: We loved this hotel
text: Stayed here for two nights with my daughters (9 and 13). They loved that you could push a button and have either clear walls or opaque walls in the shower! The beds were comfy and the bathroom clean and very modern. We had a nice view of the street, on the third floor. And the pool! The pool is one of the main reasons I chose this hotel. It was very nice, just about the perfect temperature. Breakfast was great, a buffet with just about anything you could want. The hotel is within easy walking distance from many tourist sites like the Tate Modern, Millennium Bridge, and St. Paul's Cathedral. Southwark tube station and a Tesco are also close by. I would recommend this hotel and would stay here again.

title: Christmas emergency stay
text: We stayed at the Novotel from Christmas Eve to Boxing Day as a last minute stay with our two kids (8 & 10). They were absolutely brilliant. Kids received presents on arrival, hotel was decorated, Christmas Eve buffet was delicious, staff were great, swimming pool was a treat for the kids We were in a room with a queen size bed and two camp beds. Cozy but fine Couldn't believe we could get such a nice room, booked the day before 24/12, at an excellent price Especially good was the breakfast buffet - loads of choice, great food and open until 11 Highly recommend this Novotel

title: Nice modern hotel close to Borough Market and the City
text: Novotel is located just off the Blackfriars Bridge on the South side of Thames. It is very close to Southwark tube station. It is within walking distance from Tate Modern, London Bridge and Borough Market. Our room was small spacious, airy and modern. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom looked quite new. We did not eat hotel breakfast, but made our own using the room water boiler and fridge and the nearby Tesco supermarket for supplies. There is a nice bar in the lobby.

title: Great Moment !
text: A very good location next to Waterloo Station, 10 minutes far from the London Eye, Sea Life, Westminster Bridge etc... Very confortable and spacious room (we were 2 adults and 1 kid). The restaurant is quite good, prices are reasonable and you can find a large variety of flavours. One of the best moment is the breakfast time. First you will have a lot of choice with the food but the best come with the team which is just full of kindness and attention. A special dedication to Alinia and Chamo from our son Gabriel and us. Thank you for all. We'll see you next time. Have a warm Christmas.

title: Remarkable hotel
text: High standard room, good services and excellent location close to jubilee line. The restaurant offers delicious dinner. The hotel is close to the Tate and other points of interest like the Millennium bridge

title: Great location, 1st class hotel!
text: Awesome! From check in to check out wall to wall excellent hospitality from all sectors. The room was in a quiet location as per our request along with an amazing view. The food served at dinner and breakfast was 1st class. The pool was amazing as was the sauna and well equip gym. Our Anniversary was marked with a welcome drink and a lovely card, balloons and petals on the bed, just so much thought to make our day so special! Reception and restaurant staff so attentive and friendly. The only place to stay on our next visit to London. Thanks guys!!

title: One night in July 18
text: Extremely smart hotel. My sleep was incredible. The room is just with the necessary accessories you need to rest and being resourced for the morning. The tube is not so far and you can catch all location in London easily.

title: Good stay
text: I was on a two dab business trip to London. Arrived early morning and lucky me they got me a room.quite new hotels, chic and funky . Receptionist a young man from north Sfrica I can't recall his name was very nice to me and professional. I shall return.

title: Happiness
text: 3 nights in June when the weather was hot, air conditioning quiet and efficient, room large, clean and well appointed, good location 2 minutes walk to tube. What really set this hotel apart was the staff, we had need to do some business whilst staying the girls athe front desk were brilliant, nothing was too much trouble in helping us getting some documents scanned and emailed, while they don't have a dedicated business centre, it was the best service I have experienced, so thank you. My only complaint is the room did not get serviced till 3.30pm, which in my opinion is a too late.

title: Great location, Clean rooms, courteous staff
text: Stayed here for two nights over Valentines weekend. I am a Londoner and I live about 3 miles from the hotel and wanted to take the family to a different environment for a break. This is actually a good central spot on the South side of London. about 10-15 minutes walk north to the South Bank to where the OXO tower, the National Theatre, Restaurants and more are located. Walk south as you exit the hotel and you can find Pret, Costa Coffee, South Bank Tube Station which is around 2-3 minutes away, Nandos, and a few small Café. The Hotel itself has a fresh clean ultra modern look and the rooms are decent size. If you have children, you won't get any higher than the 5th Floor so no great views of London but rather the side of other buildings. Clean Bathroom/Shower facilities and clean towels supplied as one would expect. Great little pool that my family enjoyed. The restaurant in the Hotel is expensive £16.50 for a unplanned full breakfast. just over £12 if you pay in advance. My Tip would be to walk along Union Street about 5 minutes south and check out a few of the cafes there. I got a full English for £5! I also think that the room rate was a little on the expensive side for what you get (or don't get) however if the price is competitive when searching, then I would stay again.

title: Great stay with family
text: Traveled to London with two little chilrden. Our family enjoyed the hotel very much. Very clean, great service, great breakfast and good location, The service of stroller for kids was life saving and free of charge.

title: Good and convenient overnight stay
text: I stayed here for one night whilst en-route to a venue outside London the next day. It was important for me to have a hotel close to Waterloo Station for my early morning travels. This hotel's easy and quick access to the tube was the big driver, and I found it perfect for what I wanted. The staff were very welcoming and efficient in both check-in and checkout. Whilst the breakfast in this hotel is quite good, the dinner restaurant, which includes a bar, is not something i could write home about. For dinner, I would suggest any of the restaurants close by some of which are along the River Thames. For a business traveller in London for more than two nights, not sure I would recommend especially if relaxation space and unwinding is important. This hotel has all the basic elements but none of the frills that sometimes you need on a long business trip.

title: great stay
text: Have stayed here on quite a few occassions now and found the staff pleasant and friendly, rooms are a good size, clean and well maintained. breakfast and restaurant facilities are worth recommending. leasurely stroll to Southward tube station is great for travelling around.

title: Executive room Novotel Hotel
text: Tendy hotel. Great location for the South bank and only 20 min walk from Covent garden. Amazing views from 12th floor executive room with fab room service! Lovely pool and sauna but didn't have time to use.

title: Great Short Stay
text: We stayed here for a few nights on our trip to London. The service was nice and friendly. The breakfast was nice and they do take away packs of breakfast which is very nice. The rooms were clean and reasonably sized. The area is okay, close to a Tube Station. We did walk to the Tower of London in about 30 mins of slow moving.

title: Amazing but......
text: The room,location and staff are amazing! The location is near all the main parts of london. The staff are realy friendly and welcoming. But my only problems were that the beds werent comfortable so you couldt enjoy london because you were always realy tired!

title: Great Family Stay!
text: We had a fantastic stay at the Novotel Blackfriars. The staff were very friendly and helpful. They were always immediately offering to help us find a taxi, print tickets or look for information. The pool was nice and the room was spacious for a downtown hotel. The area was lovely and safe - just a few blocks from the river, a block away from a Tesco market, across from three coffee shops, a pub plus it had the restaurant downstairs and it was easily walkable to the Southwark tube station and the city area. The staff provided us with a pack n play for our daughter to sleep in and the room was nicely made up each day and coffee replenished. Having the fridge was great as we picked up snacks from the Borough market (also walkable).We did not hear other guests during our stay on the 7th floor at all. The only note I would express is that the hot tub is part of the pool, so the hot tub is not really hot (I note this because we were hoping to have one for my husband's back at the end of each day. He enjoyed the pool but the heated tub is what we were hoping for). Otherwise, our stay really was perfect. Thank you to all the staff for a lovely trip.

title: Nice room, good breakfast, pretty good location
text: I stayed here for a couple of nights and I was impressed by the room. Very comfortable, very clean. The people working in the hotel are very friendly and helpful. The breakfast was also pretty good. The only think that bothered me was the free wifi. This was so slow that it was not even fast enough for reasonable browsing. I know that faster internet was available for 10 pounds er 24 hours, I felt that for the price of the hotel proper internet should be provided.

title: Well located comfortable hotel in London
text: It is not the first time at this hotel. I stayed for a few days last year and decided to stay there again this January. I stayed for 11 nights and had a good opportunity to check the services and premises of the hotel. I stayed at an executive room and it is very comfortable with most of the amenities you should find at this type of accommodation. The bathroom has a good power shower to relax at the end of the day. I would just suggest a pair of slippers and a bathrobe would be good. The staff is nice and helpful. The staff at breakfast is really welcoming and friendly. The staff at the bar should follow this example, they are ok, but at times not that friendly. At the reception most of them are really nice and friendly, although I have experienced one problem from one member of the staff which was sorted it out well by the manager on duty. Congratulations for the manager. The swimming pool is really relaxing including a warm spa pool. Overall, I recommend this hotel. I am pretty sure when back to London I will stay there again.

title: Very Disappointed.
text: This hotel is well located and the staff are really friendly and the check in process was smooth, quick and a relaxed process. They explained well the hotel facilities and provided maps for London. However as I had booked and paid for a room for three adults, I was very disappointed with the size of the single bed in our room along with our double bed. It was totally unsuitable and not at all fit for purpose. We were grandparents travelling with our sixteen year old grandson, who is a six foot tall big lad and I expected a sofa bed arrangement similar to the Premier Inn. The tiny camp bed was just a joke and would only be suitable for children up to a maximum of ten years of age. Please see my photos if you think I'm being over critical. I did ask for a change but they said they only could find a room where two of these camp beds would be pushed together but that they had no topper to make it a comfortable bed. We had paid an extra 16 pound on the room rate to be upgraded to a view of the shard and this new room would not provide that. We made do where we were but he did not have a good night sleep with his feet dangling off the end and in a bed too narrow to move about in. Totally ridiculous and unsuitable. We did not dine in the hotel restaurant after having drinks in the evening ahead of heading out, we found the dining room to be sparse, uncomfortable and more of a canteen or bar vibe. In our opinion this restaurant is just too stripped down and minimalist to offer any comfort or ambiance. We tried again in the morning but we just couldn't face the very long line of people queuing up for breakfast in a narrow confined corridor. So we ate out in London. I have stayed in Novotel Hotels before and this one did not match my previous satisfactory experiences.

title: Impressed
text: Novotel are almost universally good hotels. We were rather impressed by this one, equipped with automated check-in and -out and featuring a cool electric translucent bathroom window. Comfortable and well-served as ever, this Novotel made our trip to Waterloo very easy.

title: Stay in London
text: Excellent rooms, clean and comfortable Service was slow when we had a meal in the restaurant is the only negative point Location excellent and easy to find Breakfast good Enjoyed pool Staff helpful on arrival

title: Pleasantly suprised
text: Rooms and hotel very modern and quite stylish. Rather bizarre glass panel to the bathroom which mists up at the press of the button, otherwise it is clear. Great if you want to watch your significant other showering, but also gives a fine view from the bedroom to the toilet!!! The pool and sauna/steam combo called a Saunarium was a delight, with enormous video projections giving the impression of swimming underwater with the fishes. Once underwater the chill-out music could be heard, giving a rather surreal swimming experience. Not what we expected for a Novotel and for the price, and we will certainly look to book again, particularly as the hotel is so well situated.

title: fantastic stay
text: Great staff, very friendly and helpful, this made our stay. Lovely hotel, yummy breakfast. Very nice swimming pool and nice clean room. Wonderful stay with return. Bus outside took us straight to Liverpool Street. Tube station one minute walk away.

title: Sad disapointment
text: I stayed recently in what I thought was a REALLY nice room.. service was excelent.. UNTIL it was time to sleep. There is a partially frosted glass wall which connects the bathroom to the rest of the room and is right next to the bed. It is simply not enough to protect from light pouring out of the bathroom and straight on the bed.. which wakes up the occupant every time the light is turned on.

title: Great for a London family break
text: We stayed here from 29/03/18 to 01/04/18. Stayed in a superior family room. Room was very comfortable the rain shower was great and plenty of room. Lots of great facilities and the swimming pool was fantastic. We had our 5 year old with us and it was his first trip on a plane and for all of us the first time travelling to London. The hotel was perfect for us as we were close to two tube stations and good bus routes. The staff made us all welcome but the staff in the breakfast area each morning were above and beyond They greeted us all but especially or son and gave him a sticker and a stuffed toy each morning. Really nice people and the breakfast options were amazing even having vegetarian options on without having to ask. Lunch and dinner menus were great too and any request was never too much or a problem. Particular attention to be paid to manager in the breakfast area. Really helpful even brought over a child seat for a young girls doll to sit and eat breakfast with her doll. Never have we seen such helpful staff. Will be back to this hotel. Thank you so much Pete Hutchinson and family.

title: Great Hotel in a great location !!!!
text: This hotel is new and very modern with very large rooms and and bathrooms. Also the facilities are excellent for everybody including kids. An amazing pool with sauna and gym etc. although not huge it does everything you need. One big problem with the pool is the temperature. Wow it's the coldest pool we have ever been in. Everybody in the pool when we were in was complaining about the temperature. That said its worth going in just to see the giant live fish tank screen that's projected onto one side of the pools wall. Our daughter loved it even for the 10 minutes we could suffer the temperature for. Breakfast was amazing again everything you needed and more. The staff in the restaurant were excellent. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it.

title: It's fine, it's a typical Novotel
text: It was fine. It's not badly located being right next to Southwark station (and a short walk to Waterloo). The rooms are average, we were in an Executive suite and it's nothing to shout about - the balcony was nice to have but the rest of the room was typical Novotel. Breakfast was the usual Novotel bunfight - there are many more interesting places a short walk away.

title: I can't thank the staff enough
text: I treated my mum to her first trip to London for her 50th birthday and when the staff learned it was her birthday they brought up a brownie cake with our breakfast and put balloons in our room and even put up the banners I brought with me, all free of charge. I honestly can't praise the staff enough they were all so friendly, funny and made you feel special and I overheard one of them at the bar say something like "Make every customer feel special, treat everyone as you'd like to be treated yourself" and they really did, me and my mum were shocked it's not a 5 star hotel, it should be. The hotel itself is really nice, the bar had a nice atmosphere to it and they all know how to make a nice martini and lemon (even though one of them thought I had bad taste in drinks he was very funny and was the one that brought my mum another birthday cake during breakfast!). The room was pretty cool still not over the mist bathroom wall that can be transparent or give you your privacy, I thought it was pretty neat. I wanted to take the mattress and pillow home with me, they're so comfortable! Great shower and bathroom in general, plenty of towels on hand. I loved the gym and pool and I was surprised that I got both completely to myself one night, really relaxing environment. On check out day we went down for the breakfast buffet- again, I can't fault it at all there was so much choice it's a good job they had a gym because I couldn't stop eating it was that good! Was sad to leave, mum misses it as well and wants to go back already! I'll recommend this hotel for friends staying in London and will definitely stay here again next time I'm in London. Thank you to all the staff at Novotel Blackfriars, you really helped make my mums birthday memorable, you all do a great job, keep it up and take care. -Shelby Madden :)

title: Unique, high-tec hotel. This is the future of Novotel brand
text: Dear readers, You really need to experience this product. This is one of the best hotels i have ever stayed from the design and space solution perspective. You can only compliment-i should not say anything anymore. Try it! If u do not do it u would miss a lot! This is the right future for Novotel brand.

title: Overnight for a concert.
text: We have stayed here a few times and must again comment how good this hotel is. Fantastic location, lovely rooms and service. We arrived late in the evening from our concert and were greeted at the bar by Charlie. She was so pleasant and helpful. Even arranged a lovely Pizza for us. We hope to return again soon.

title: Novotel Great Experience
text: Just back from a two day stay at Novotel Blackfriars. The hotel is obviously fairly new and our room was most comfortable and well sound proofed . The hotel is in great location adjacent to attractions such as the South Bank, Tate Modern Museum and a lovely riverside walk to the London Eye and Houses of Parliament. However, the best feature was the attentive staff in Reception who were very pleasant and most helpful despite attending to multiple check-ins which they took in their stride! Well done for recognising that customer service is key. We'll be back.

title: Great Location
text: Excellent, Modern, Clean, Tidy, Smart. Hard to fault. Lovely room. Fantastic looking pool. Amusing comment from Jane P about the bathroom door. I DID look twice. Great location. Easy walk to Borough Market. ( Worth a visit) Tube nearby. Good breakfast , maybe a trifle expensive but very good nonetheless. Thumbs up from me.

title: It's ok, but anonymous place
text: Pros and cons: - it's a few steps from Southwark station, so it's easy to get there and use public transport - the building is been renovated, so the rooms are new - it's clean (for British standards....) Cons: too much informal at the reception desk for a 4 star hotel, the staff is not really interested in your stay, they didn't even ask how it was. It seems they're too toung and not even trained for that job. That area of the city is totally anonymous. I would not come back there. Just a little bit more of attention to your guests and I'd gave you another star.

title: Good but could be better
text: The hotel is in the perfect location close to the tube and blackfriars bridge. The room was very nice but the shower was not as I expected,with no mats for the floor the room got quite wet.Could of done with more tea/coffee and milk. Bar was very good,bar staff excellent,cocktails were amazing.The hotel was good but we expected a little more for a 4 star Novotel.

title: Excellent staff, stylish rooms
text: Stayed 3 nights at the Novotel Blackfriars on a special offer through the Accor Hotels membership programme and enjoyed it very much. Location is handy for transports (bus, tube) and some attractions (oxo tower, London eye, st.Paul) are in walking distance, the area is nice and lively, with many restaurants, pubs and the wonderful Southbank Walk just down the road. The staff is extremely welcoming and attentive, they even lent us a Uk adapter since we had forgotten ours! We didn't try breakfast nor the swimming pool because it was crowded with children playing and making noise. Rooms are elegant and comfy, we particularly appreciated the decor and lights arrangement. We had a beautiful view of the Shard and the skyline. The only downside was the carpet, it looked dirty and worn, the rest of the room was impeccable though, especially the bathroom, spacious and with a big see through glass separating the shower from the room (obviously, a button would make the glass opaque). All in all, it was a superb experience, would not hesitate to go back!

title: Fantastic Stay
text: I have been staying in London once a month on business for the last 6 months, normally at the Ibis next door. However after visiting the bar in the Novotel, the welcome i got from the staff there was second to none, and made me make my last bookiing in Jan at the Novotel. A special mention should go to Allyson who provided lots of local recommendations and along with her other colleagues always made me feel very welcomed.

title: Modern clean and confortable business hotel
text: Modern rooms, very clean, everything works, USB charger, free wifi - everything you need from a business hotel

title: I was stuck and the lovely gentlemen helped me.
text: I was visiting family from abroad that was staying In the and I completely lost track of time. Missed my last train all my phones were dead. And the gentleman on the front desk kindly assisted me to find a cab that was a reasonable price for the journey I was about to make. I wasn’t actually staying there so I can only imagine if I was top service. I’ve just got home this very moment and I had to make sure I left a fantastic review. X

title: Great room, not so good food
text: Modern hotel, good security, the room was large and pleasant, good shower and related facilities. Overall a nice place to stay and reasonably conveniently sited close to City areas and tube station. The one down side was the restaurant. In the evening I was assailed by a nightclub style singer whose microphone was set on far too high a volume - simply could not hear myself think, let alone have a conversation. Furthermore, the dinner had a restricted menu, being heavily dependent on burgers. Also had breakfast - pretty standard buffet style, so soggy bacon, fried eggs, baked beans, toast, etc. All acceptable, but nothing special. I did not use the pool or gym, so cannot comment on those.

title: Keeps Getting Better and Better!
text: I recently had two separate stays over the course of a week at this Novotel London Blackfriars at the end of May and they were absolutely fantastic. On both occasions I was upgraded to the Executive Level thanks to my Accor Gold status and on the first occasion my room was actually ready at 8:20am as I arrived early as a result of an early international flight. Both rooms provided commanding views of the Shard and everything else in the vicinity. This time around, I took advantage of their excellent facilities on floor -1 that being the heated indoor pool as well as the gym. Both were excellent. Breakfast was to a very high standard as usual in the Jamboree Restaurant and never disappointed. The eggs, sausages, pastries, beans etc all very well prepared with attentive service. Prior to arrival I emailed to enquire about having two packages delivered and kept for me two days prior to arrival and this was no problem for the Novotel Team. The location is fantastic at 46 Blackfriars Road. Just two minutes from the South Underground station on the Jubilee line. The good thing about that station is that you can get from the platforms to the road level without having to use the stairs as there is elevator access. Tesco Express is around the corner from Southwark and there is also a Sainsbury’s Local a bit further up the road. This is absolutely my place to stay in London when on business and I shall definitely be back again. Thank you Novotel London Blackfriars!

title: Style over substance
text: This hotel looks amazing from it’s website. Lots of pictures showing a bright, vibrant hotel with good facilities. However the reality falls far short of the sales pitch. Rooms. Very basic in appointments. Nothing better than you would find in a much cheaper chain. Plug sockets that were badly fitted, not allowing you to plug in chargers etc. Not a particularly comfortable bed, with a thin cheap duvet. An utterly ridiculous feature glass wall between the bedroom and the bathroom. This meant that if you needed to use the toilet in the night you had to either bathe the bedroom in light or fumble around in the dark. Fancy light up mirror makes an annoying high pitched whistle every time it is turned on. Facilities. The swimming pool area was very dark and dingy. The jacuzzi was cold, but not as cold as the sauna. Who has ever heard of a sauna that is actually COLDER inside than out? The restaurant was overpriced, as was room service - £16 if you wanted an omelet in your room! Staff Ranged from disinterested to outright rude. Housekeeping didn’t come to clean / make up the room until 5.30pm. When they were told this wasn’t convenient and asked if they could come back later I do not expect to be told no! When they did eventually make up the room, they didn’t refresh the tea/coffee/milk or even fold the towels. This hotel charges a lot of money per night. I managed to get it on a last minute deal and feel vastly overcharged. I dread to think how disappointed anyone who pays full price would feel. Nowhere near good enough and terrible value for money

title: central london with toddler
text: A great modern high tech hotel in a very good location - we walked to Tate Modern, St Pauls, Convent Garden & Trafalgar Square. Loved the well thought out rooms (everything designed / fitted), we had the single sofa bed made up but still felt a spacious room. The glass view into the bathroom (made opaque at the touch of a button) was a fun novelty feature too. Breakfast was good as expected, but perhaps not exceptional. No cooked to order options seemed to be available. Liked the ipads onthe table for kids. Service was very good throughout the stay, we got late check out at 5pm Sunday for no extra charge. However the most amazing feature of this hotel is the swimming pool with video projection wall, plus the lovely sauna. We had the place to ourselves and it was bliss.

title: Fantastic
text: We arrived at 10.45am was told they had upgraded us to a better room as it was my birthday and checked us in straight away with no hassle. We also got robes and slippers included and i got a birthday card and balloons in my room on arrival. which was lovely. the staff we really helpful and also kept our luggage for the day until we left london to head back home. We had food delivered to our room from the onsite restaurant no complaints there either was lovely. We used the pool facilities was a bit crowded as small but managed an hour in there. The location is quite far out from the attractions we wanted to see but there is a tube station right on the corner of the street and could jump in a cab outside the hotel. We were on a busy main road at the front of the hotel but heard no noise and had a view of the shard from our room.Overall was a great stay and would recommend and would return.

title: Novotel Blackfriars
text: We were lucky to be upgraded to the executive room. Room was wonderful with a balcony overlooking the Shard. Very clean and even pillows were comfortable. The whole experience was spoilt with the farce for breakfast. Had to queue for a long time to go in. Table hadn't been cleared

title: Great Hotel
text: This hotel was amazing with a very friendly and helpful staff. Parking was a bit of a nuisance but can be found a short trip away near Waterloo Station. The quality of the food was exceptional and the facilities great. Highly recommended.

title: Excellent hotel
text: Have recently returned from a wonderful weekend stay. The hotel is located in a great location, very close to Southwark underground which made it really easy to get around. On arrival we were met by a warm and friendly member of staff who made us feel very welcome. I’ve stayed in a lot of hotels in London but I have to say this was the best night sleep I’ve had out of them all. The rooms were spotless and quiet and had everything we needed. I will definitely be returning!

title: Poor Standard Room with bad smoke smell
text: Very poor standard rooms, my room smelt so bad and had to request another room. Despite requesting an early check in after long flight, had to wait until 2:30 for room and once I opened the room door was hit by the smell of stale cigaret smoke. No manager was available to change room until much later. ( staff did try their best & arranged another room, saying that the smell was the carpet) Not recommend the hotel or group - very poor

title: Great Property!
text: This was a clean, convenient, well-served property. It is 1/2 block away from the underground (take the Southwark exit) which can easily take you anywhere around town. Easy trip from the airport. The staff was so friendly and professional. Rooms were clean, and the sofa made a big enough bed for our 6'7

title: Excellent room with a balcony
text: As I had meetings near St Pauls Cathedral, Novotel Blackfriars was a comfortable walk away. I found the location of the Hotel excellent as it was a comfortable walk away from both Blackfriars Station and Southwark Station. Check in was painless and I was allocated my executive room on the 11th floor. These rooms were excellent as they were the only rooms with a balcony. The view from the balcony towards the Shard was an added bonus. The room itself was spacious and had all the necessary amenities for a business traveller. There was a restaurant on the ground floor called Jamboree and the service at the bar was friendly and fast. All in all a great Hotel and I have already booked a room for my next visit to London

title: Family short break
text: We took our 14year old grandson to London for a couple of nights. We had a packed programme of theatre and museums, including madam tussauds. We chose the Blackfriars Novotel because it had a pool. It is within a few minutes walk of Southwark tube station. This was great for madam tussauds as there is a direct line to Baker Street . We used the swimming pool every day, and managed this in spite of a closure for cleaning on Friday afternoon. If you plan to use it may be worth asking in advance if there is a closure for any reason. Waterloo is only about 10 minutes walk away and you pass many restaurants and small shops on the way. There was a small frig in the room which was handy, as we had provided our own breakfast for the first day. The second day as we had more time we had breakfast in the hotel. We found that rather pricey and not as good as other Accor hotels we have stayed in. We had to clear our own table for breakfast and we would advise that rather than standing in the queue till they get round to finding you a table. Reception were helpful if we asked for advice but not always quick to answer the phone from the room. A brief phone call to a local number was charged as 50p which seems exorbitant by any standards Oh and the pool is quite cool which is probably why it is quite pleasant if you want to swim. There is a spa pool but it is the same temperature as the main pool so not one to linger in. However, on balance we had a comfortable, convenient stay and one has to say, good value for London.

title: 3 per room. Just what we needed
text: We chose this hotel because it was the best priced for 3 people per room. Room was clean and fresh and had everything we needed including iron/board, hair dryer and toiletries. Bed was very comfortable. We had a fantastic view of The Shard which was an added bonus. The room did not include breakfast however it did include use of the pool and sauna. However, there is only one shower in the pool area which is ridiculous. Also, no steam room. The bar was pretty cheap considering it was a 4 star hotel in London. Location is a 2 minute walk from Southwark underground. It cost us £13 in a taxi from Soho in the early hours which I thought was reasonable for London. Overall the hotel was a very good. However I feel that breakfast should be included or at least no more than £10. £20 is asking far too much when your room has cost you £250 for one night.

title: Southwark location is great
text: Lovely welcome, nice room is a bit small. The glass bathroom panel is fun but annoying at night when people get up to use the bathroom and switch on the light. Curtains weren't great so quite light at night. Nice breakfast but slow service with the hot drinks. Small but nice pool, big sauna. Great location! Will come again for sure.

title: Super cool bathroom window
text: My son loved the bathroom window which went from tinted to clear with the touch of a button. The staff was super positive and my son got a birthday present in our room. Beautiful view towards «the Shard.» We’ll be back. Runar, Conny & Tobias.

title: Wonderful stay!
text: We were so happy we chose this location of London! The hotel is located a few blocks south of the Thames. It is close to a few Underground stops that offer different lines so you can really be in a different part of London quickly. This side of the Thames is on the quieter side with a lovely walkway along the river that offers an art museum, lots of shops and eateries. The hotel itself is fine - small lobby but they are renovating the bar area which should add nicely to the space. The room was fine - nice size for London I think with plenty of space for things and a sofa. The bathroom was nice - very modern. Some people have commented on the lack of a door but perhaps didn't realize there are doors that fold in towards the bathroom from the hallway. There is also a glass divider between the shower stall and the bed area which with a click of a button located in the shower can be clear or foggy so you don't see thru. Good selection of tv channels. The breakfast buffet was good. It was pretty much the same as we were offered in Leeds City Center Novotel but a bit better as the hot food was being prepared right where you got the food so it was fresher. It was also a lot busier as this hotel is larger. We had the front desk arrange a car for us to get to Heathrow for a 6:30 am pickup. The car was there early, fast check out too. Overall I would recommend this hotel and would stay here again. Join the accor club for discounts.

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Super brand new hotel in a superb location. Excellent friendly service from the minute we checked in. Our room was large enough for 3 adults with a super shower. The tube was extremely handy and we whizzed around London easily. We had dinner and breakfast and enjoyed both. We will definately use this hotel again.

title: Perfect choice for London sightseeing
text: We had the pleasure of staying here again or two nights on our recent London trip. We had a Shard view room which was fabulous, especially in the evening to see it all lit up. The room was spacious enough for three, and super comfortable and quiet. The staff are welcoming and helpful, the bar area is much more upbeat than the normal hotel bars, great for a family, and we even enjoyed a swim in the pool, which was lovely. But it's the location of the hotel that makes it so perfect, you can walk to so many attractions and it is only a short taxi ride from St. Pancras. We walked to The Shard, St Pauls, Westminster Abbey, Southbank, Tate modern , Big Ben to name just a few. Also, there are great restaurants nearby, especially down The Cut. Heartily recommend this hotel.

title: A nice surprise visit...
text: On quite short notice I had to do a buisness tirip to London. When arriving to my initially booked hotel, there was a mistake in the booking and there I was with no hotel in the middle of Fashionweek... I then ended up in Novotel London Blackfriars a little bit out of my normal pricerange but you get what you pay for in London. The hotel was really very nice, I got a suite eventhough I only booked a Executive room. The suite was very nice, clean, fresh with a large bedroom and a very comfortable bed. The bathroom was very well equipped. The only thing I can see as negative was a quite lenghty check-in process, but that might be because of a short notice booking done on Booking.com which hadn't arrived at the hotelsystem when we arrived in person... I could really think to stay here again

title: Great Location for a Tourist Base!
text: Stayed here with Friends and my God Children who were in London en route from Chicago to Rome. Great location to do all the tourist visits, walking distance to London Eye, Big Ben -Houses of Parliament, Tower Of London & London Bridge to name but a few. However tube station is very close if you don't want to be that energetic! Staff were very friendly and helpful. Facilities were excellent - swimming pool and gym.

title: Perfect location
text: The front desk staff was very friendly - they would who do anything to help you out. Hotel room was great - comfortable bed, with with the electric privacy glass for the en-suite. Perfect location - close to the Underground, South Bank, London Eye, etc.

title: Good location and friendly staff
text: Located right on Blackfriars road, the hotel is very convenient: just two blocks from the Thames riverwalk, one block from at tube station, and the buses stop a half block away. Around the corner are many restaurants. The first thing we noticed was how friendly and helpful the staff was. Both front desk and dining room staff were pleasant and accommodating at all times. The breakfast was very complete, offering a traditional English hot breakfast, and most any other item you might want. It's an added charge, so be sure to check the rate so as not to be surprised. The rooms have been updated and are very comfortable. The hotel faces on Blackfriars Road, which can be quite busy, although at night there is not much noise. Ask for a room NOT facing Blackfriars road for a little more quiet.

title: Novotel London Blackfriars
text: Was upgraded to Suite Room. Basically, the room size is bigger however the bed comfort level might not up to expectation. Also need to fill up a declaration for prior to use the swimming pool. Very near to Southwark Station. Breakfast varieties consider not bad.

title: Birthday trip
text: I would like to thank all the staff from the receptionist down to the restaurant staff and housekeeping staff for making our one night stay so memorable and special. We decided to go to London and chose Novotel as previously stayed in Novotel Paddington and had a grand time. We arrived around 10 am and luckily our room was available so we were allowed to check in earlier. We left the hotel as we were going to London Zoo and when on arrival back to the room my daughter was so delighted to see a birthday card and balloons in the bed! She was beaming with delight and she felt really special. Not to mention the complimentary drinks from the restaurant. The room is well laid out. The bed is so comfortable to sleep in. We asked for extra pillows and was sent to our room immediately. The following morning we had breakfast and my daughter had another surprise birthday brownies. My daughter decided to write a thank you note to all the staff as we leave the hotel today. I have been to many hotels and I have to commend the excellent customer service of this hotel. You have a brilliant team and doing an extra mile to cater your customer goes a long long way. Thank you very much! From room 710 - JP

title: So close to being very good...
text: This is a very new hotel and it shows. The whole hotel is fresh and modern and, importantly, clean. The problem is that there are quite a few small, annoying glitches that are spoiling what could be a decent hotel. The free WiFi is stupidly slow to the point of being almost unusable. I can, of course, upgrade for £10 per day, but in a hotel costing £175/night I expect WiFi that works. The lockers in the pool/gym don't have any working locks. The spa pool is in the corner of the main swimming pool, so it's cold for a spa pool and cannot be warmer. The bar on the first night couldn't charge drinks to my room due to 'upgrades' and I didn't have enough cash on me. The second night they'd run out of some of the draught beers. The bathrooms are good, but you can clearly hear everything from the bathroom immediately above yours. I'm not sure if this review is going to get the same 'cookie cutter' response as seen on the Novotel website, but there's not a lot they need to do to sort most of these minor glitches out... Decent wifi would be a good start!

title: Amazing stay
text: What an amazing stay as alway Jaqui you are the best hotel manager and a credit to the hotel chain , my parents had an amazing time and loved the room and hospitality . As always the staff are exceptional and I look forward to staying in the future. This is deffinelty a great place and location with a warm welcome from arrival to departure.

title: Mixed feelings
text: As too often in London, this hotel appears to be understaffed. As a result, the service cannot be properly delivered, no matter how good willing they are. This stay was a reflection of this statement. I wrote ahead of my arrival to let them know at what time I would check in and the kind of room I would prefer (I am a Platinum member). While they acknowledge receipt of my mail, they gave me something at the opposite of my wishes as a large bed room was not yet available (it was 5pm!). I had to change in another room for my dinner! My room was ready actually just before I left... The morning after, breakfast was OK, but the checkout took too long. Now it is 4 chips to reward all the efforts of the staff, the swimming pool and for the great location of this hotel.

title: Birthday treat
text: Had the most amazing time, the reception staff were welcoming and very helpful. We had an Executive suite with a fabulous view of St Pauls and the Shard and a lovely balcony to sit out on, although it was raining on our visit. The room was lovely and staff had put a birthday card and balloons in the room without even being asked to do this, also complimentary 2 glasses of prosceco in the bar which was a lovely touch. The food in the Jamboree restaurant was brilliant and cocktails (2 for 1 between 4pm and 7pm) amazing. The live music was great too. Breakfast was lovely with great selection. The pool was fab and was lovely and clean. We definitely want to visit again and think I may organise a girlie weekend away here.

title: Above average Novotel
text: I come here for meetings or a quick bite. It is friendly, has a good eating area and the staff provide good service. Fairly typical Novotel but this is one of the better ones. Good location and if you need somewhere in the area use this

title: Nice and clean like any Novotel
text: When looking for a good and reasonably priced hotel in London, Novotel must be considered. We landed on Novotel Blackfriars because of the location and the pool for the kids :-) Good breakfast and close to the tube.

title: Third visit - almost cannot fault it!
text: Gushing a bit but genuinely, when we arrived for our third stay, there was a sense of coming home! Rooms are lovely, location is central, pool is wonderful , breakfast was outstandingly delicious (could we have a machine that fills the cups a bit more to save so many return trips?) and the chocolate chip cookie in the evening -lush!. But what really makes this place are the staff - Chamo remembered us from previous stays, made the effort to find out my son’s name to say hello agin which made him feel like a rockstar! Little gifts, kind words, smiles, nothing too much trouble - all the staff are great. Problem with the supplier meant best lagers were off which was a tiny disappointment and meant we returned to our room instead of a drink in the bar. But love it here, can’t wait to return in June!

title: Good Hotel, Close To Centre of London
text: Good hotel, stayed here on business and decided that due to the location, price and amenities I would come back with the family for our tour of London. Typical chain hotel but a step up from Ibis, Premier Inn, and Travelodge (in fact a couple of steps up). The hotel offered everything that the family needed, comfortable (air conditioned) clean rooms, good breakfast buffet (continental and full english), bar, iPads and XBOX 360 for the kids to play on in the lobby area. In the basement was a decent looking gym with treadmills, bikes, weights etc... Next to that was a great little pool with built in Jacuzzi and Saunarium (steam room come sauna), never seen one before but it was great. A nice addition was a projection of fish swimming in coral onto the back wall, which gave the whole place a nice calming feel. Free lockers and towels were provided in the changing rooms. Outside the hotel is a short walk to Southwark tube station on the Jubilee line, or 5 minutes walk in the other direction was the south bank of the Thames, with views to St Paul's etc..... Taking the Jubilee walk to the west (left as you face the Thames), leads you past the ITV studios and on to the London Eye and County Hall with great views of Parliament and Big Ben. I would estimate that the wakl along the river bank to the London eye would take 20 to 30 minutes depending on your pace. All in all I would recommend this hotel for people on business in the centre of London, and for families going to explore. 2 adults and 2 children sharing a room should budget around £275/night which includes breakfast.

title: Great Trip
text: My stay went smoothly, the bedroom was great, very clean with a large bed, soft mattress, no noises what so ever. Everybody was very nice and treated me and my family very well. The breakfast was also very good and substantial. The interior pool was available, but I didn’t went for a swim The location is great, with the tube one minute walk away, near to the Tate Modern, Shakespeare’s Globe, you can see St Pauls Cathedral just across the river, 10 minutes’ walk across the Blackfriars bridge. In summary it was a great experience to be repeated.

title: London Royal Visit.
text: Arrived in London after a long flight from Bangkok via Helsinki after a flight delay of one hour. After an hour car rider from Heather Airport via the city traffic we arrived at the Novotel Blackfriars. The hotel is well located to the underground stations and within easy reach of nearby restaurants and shops. Also bus stop close to the hotel and taxi service opposite hotel.

title: Great Position - Great Staff
text: We have just got back from 2 nights Friday 5th and Saturday 6th May. The hotel is a great position for tube travel and approx 10-15 miuntes from Big Ben and all major attractions, simply head down the road to the river and turn left for some stunning views as you walk. The hotel itself is very modern and the staff were great, the rooms quite large and for us which is always a must is great air conditioning which it had. We used the pool and jacuzzi and there were also very clean and top standard. The breakfast is very nice and had a good selection (The coffee was amazing also, i am a big coffee fan) We would use this hotel again i think, the price was at the higher end compared to some we have stayed in before but we did not mind simply due to the nice position of the hotel. The only downfall we had was the room service, on the Friday night we got in quite late and decided room service would be good, the prices were very high for the standard, the food was cold and my daughter could not eat the pizza as it was simply dreadful to taste, i spoke to another guest and he said his was good but did not order what we did, maybe we should of complained but it was late and TBH i could not be bothered. Other than that which i dont think is a regular occurance i would give this hotel a solid 4/5.

title: Excellent stay, ideal location
text: The room was clean and more than enough for 2 adults and 2 children. The staff was nice, friendly and very professional. Breakfast buffet was more than decent. It’s family friendly with a swimming pool where kids can enjoy after a long day

title: Amazing coffee time -)
text: I have been here few times. It's on my way to my appointment whenever i am in London for a meeting. The service is good (polite staffs) Erika made excellent coffees and tasting. And also chamo one more time with this unique customer service.

title: A few disappointment when coming in the room
text: I came in the room and found a stain on the toilet, the towel was dirty, there was water on the shower floor and I almost slipped, be careful with the shower floor. Also, there was only one sheet left on the note pad. Staff was friendly and helpful. Very close to the tube.

title: Friendly staff nice facilities
text: Stayed in this hotel for a short overnight stay was welcome warmly and meet iuliana and florie that were very friendly and helpful, jacuzzi in the swimming pool and sauna is what I came for! Relaxing moment guaranteed! Had diner at the restaurant and was very good nice atmosphere overall. I can only recommend this hotel!

title: Great value for money.
text: 4 days, 3 nights stay. Very good location close to main touristic points. Very good service, always willing to help and support. Very well thought rooms with perfect beds for recovering after walking days. Breakfast is simply outstanding, with lots of choices of highest quality and enormous quantity. restaurant also good and not expensive for London standards. Definitively recommended, We will repeat if coming back to London.

title: Disappointing breakfast
text: The room was actually well done, with a rather good feel, nice view and well thought through equipment. Nothing fancy, but doing it well. Breakfast is not nice: crowded, coffee and other food of low or average quality... Pool is small and unfriendly.

title: Great location!
text: Like other reviewers tell you

title: An excellent experience from start to finish
text: My wife and I booked this hotel as a treat for her thirtieth birthday. The woman at reception was very welcoming and asked about our stay. When we explained it was for a 30th, the member of staff upgraded our room. The room was superb, clean, spacious with good facilities. When we returned after some sightseeing there were birthday balloons and a birthday card on the bed! The staff also provided two glasses of sparkling wine. I went for a swim in the morning and the pool was very clean and well equipped, although perhaps slightly small for serious swimmers. I was impressed by the whole experience.

title: Perfect Stay/modern deco and friendly staff
text: Perfect City Stay, cycles and underground directly or 100m away from the hotel/rooms in modern deco and the young international staff is very friendly. Buffet breakfast with a wide range of food. We absolutely recommend the Novotel Blackfriars.

title: A great hotel
text: The location is ideal, near the Bankside area and close to the metro. The view from our room was really scenic. The room was neat, well equipped and clean. The bed was quite small, But that was the only negative thing. Breakfast very nice, with lots of fruit and nice warm dishes. Especially the mushroom and sunny side eggs.

title: Good location and brand new hotel
text: It happened that I stayed here on the very first night of opening so not a typical stay. There were lots of very helpful staff on hand and the room was clean (new!), the bed was very comfortable and all the general areas of the hotel were impressive. This is a good location for South Bank, with easy access to city and main line stations. Several bus routes run from right outside the hotel. Highly recommended and good value for money.

title: Novotel Blackfriars
text: We stayed as a family of four (2 adults, 2 children aged 8 and 11) in one large room with four very comfortable beds. Lots of room, very well appointed, including tea-making equipments. Excellent TV. One slight gripe - the transparent wall between bedroom and bathroom means that the toilet is exposed to view, which not everyone appreciated. This is an excellent hotel, comfortable, bright, clean, welcoming, efficient, very nice staff. The swimming pool is a big plus. Location could hardly be better - just a few yards from Southwark Tube Station on the Jubilee line means that the West End can be reached very quickly. Also ideal for visiting Greenwich, Cutty Sark etc. Excellent restaurant and fabulous breakfast buffet. By booking online in advance we also got a very good rate. Altogether a five-star experience in every respect. We shall certainly go again. The best hotel I have stayed in in London.

title: Best Experience
text: everything was great. great location , i like the pool gym. the hotel is very close to london underground tube lines. very good communication, staff were very friendly, epeceially reception staff. i will come back

title: Just perfect
text: Me and my sister were visiting Notting Hill area when we passed by The Laslett Hotel. We popped in for a quick coffee break and we were impressed by the attention of details of this lovely Hotel. Breakfast buffet was stunning and we decide to stop for breakfast. We sat outside on the terrace and we had some fresh fruit with yogurt and poached eggs with avocado toast. Quality of the food was great, staff looked after us in a really friendly and professional way especially Alessio who shared with us a bit more information about the Hotel and Notting hill area. We definitely recommend this place and we'll be back soon.

title: WHAT A GREAT HOTEL!
text: I have been in many hotels in my life and all over the world. But this one is definately one of my favorites. Everthing was perfect to me: hospitality, service, food, drinks, interior, the room, the bed, the staff and the location. 100% sure that I will come back. Highly recommended.

title: Beautiful boutique hotel in great location
text: We had an amazing two night stay for my girlfriend's birthday. We loved the hotel reception, the staff, the house cocktails and the amazing bathroom! Of course, the room was pretty special too - definately recommend paying the extra for the suite and also request a room with a free standing bath.

title: Wedding anniversary
text: Fabulous hotel, location and staff. Would definitely recommend and book again! Short walk to Portabello Road and Kensington gardens easy walk too! 2 minutes from Notting Hill Gate tube. The extras offered for purchase are pricey so don’t be tempted unless you have deep pockets. The room had everything I would expect from a hotel of its class and did not disappoint. The hotel even provided a complimentary bottle of bubbles for our 25th celebration!

title: OKAY no tea facilities in room disappointing
text: It was OKAY, however stayed in Hilton Hotels with much better facilities for half the price. No tea/ coffee making facilities in the room which was very disappointing. Beautiful bathroom and extremely comfy bed but actual room quite underwhelming. Lots of noise from people in and out of rooms nearby and can hear conversations from other rooms. We had a nice stay but definitely would stay again

title: A pleasant alternative!
text: Excellent and quiet location. We stayed with our 3-year old daughter in a Master Double Bedroom and there was enough space for all of us. The ammenities of the minibar were great as well. There's a reason they call it a Big Bar there, because of the total amount of things they can fit in an enitre cupboard! The Reception staff were always friendly and gave us some very good recommendations about places to visit around there. I would definitely recommend this small independent property as a solid alternative to big chains, simply because it has so much character and it fits perfectly in the area of Notting Hill.

title: Perfect hotel, great location, very friendly staff
text: This small and elegant hotel is located in the beautiful Notting Hill neighborhood, perfectly situated in a quiet street very close to the tube station"Notting Hill Gate". The staff was extremely welcoming, very friendly and helpful, we could not have picked a better place to stay in London for our 5-days trip. This is also an ideal hotel if you are travelling with kids. Our room was very spacious and elegantly decorated with great art and the breakfast was amazing. Thank you very much for making our stay memorable, we will definitely be back! Esther & Sophie Sardagna

title: Beautiful hotel!
text: Stunning hotel! We had a double room which had a walk in shower (no bath, only the suite has a bath for fellow bath lovers) but the shower is spectacular, huge beautiful towels and the bed is massive! One of the best nights sleeps for a while, if only I could have stayed all day! Breakfast is either continental or cooked which I this is either £22 or £25, it is well worth the money and the coffee is sublime! Enjoy! You won’t regret a stay here.

title: A best location for the best London has to offer
text: A wonderful " home from home " Hotel with great staff and a collection of wonderful touches all aimed and welcoming you better and serving you better in a Natural way . The location is the most privileged in London without doubt . You are 100m from Palace Gardens and if they are prepared to spend millions for their location then any price asked to stay in Laslett is cheap .

title: Wonderful place!
text: The room was excellent, everything was even a bit better than we expected. Really clean, functional, well stocked and also with large windows and a nice view. The staff was really helpful, friendly and flexible. Thanks to everyone! For example, we had some special requests with the checkin/checkout times and even though fully booked they managed to arrange some flexibility for us. In general, this place is an excellent choice (And we will come again

title: Top notch & very friendly
text: We arrived later in the day but were welcomed by incredibly friendly staff. A nice room with good space and very nice bathroom. (Superb shower) The usual mini bar and amenities, even had straightening tongs. Prime location in Notting Hill which makes it very convenient for central London and easy access to all transport, The restaurant has room for improvement in the food department but the bar service and cocktails are really good, and made up for the short fallings of the food offering. I liked the lounge area as it had great attention to detail. I really liked all the artwork in the guests areas and bedroom, in all a great spot and would recommend this lovely London boutique hotel to anyone.

title: Couldn’t be happier with my stay!
text: We stumbled upon this beautiful boutique hotel and booked two nights as walk-ins. I am still in awe of how attentive, hospitable, and accommodating the staff was here. William especially went out of his way to make our stay so special. He created us craft cocktails based on a few things we told him we liked and he created an unbelievable drink for us to enjoy in the beautiful library room. The rooms were new and clean and we had a beautiful street facing view. I was also surprised by how good the food was here as well. I already have recommended the Laslett to many friends and plan on coming back. Thank you again William for making things so special!!! 10/10 recommend the Laslett. Amazing value!

title: Perfect stylish boutique hotel in Notting Hill
text: Recently stopped in London for 4 days on the way home from India and had a marvelous time at The Laslett - three large townhouses renovated into one very charming, hip, hotel with a small charming dining room, a library for drinks and small get togethers, and a fantastic breakfast! The location was perfect, literally steps away from the tube station, Kensington Park, and all the charming shops and restaurants and pubs one could want. The rooms were spotless and super comfortable and the bathroom was great. The staff was wonderful, especially Emily at the front desk who gave us the full tour upon arrival and made a point of saying hello and catching up each time we saw here as we came and went from the hotel. Can't wait to go back!
