title: Weekend in London
text: Stayed here for two nights on a mini-break to London and wanted to stay in Notting Hill. The hotel is in a good location right next to the tube station and is an ideal base for a weekend visit. We stayed in a master double and the room was of a good size with all brand new fittings. would definitely recommend this hotel for anyone looking to stay in Notting Hill

title: A beautiful hotel with lovely staff
text: I chose the Laslett for its location, though I didn't know what the hotel would be like. It is probably the nicest hotel I've ever stayed in. Everything about it - the public spaces, the room, the facilities, the breakfast, the friendly, thoughtful staff - was first class. So much attention has been paid to details, and that continues to be the case. Whatever your age and nationality, I think you would be comfortable here, and made welcome. The room was at the front of the hotel but, even then, and in such a great location, it was quiet and restful. I haven't anything negative to say about it - only praise.

title: Eight Nights At The Laslett
text: Because of our extended stay we were pleased with our large, third floor room. It wasn't the room I had requested but is was well appointed, the bed was extremely comfortable and being at the very top of the building, was quiet and filled with light. The bathroom was lovely and the little spare room a great place for suitcases and shopping. The Laslett is a very 'on trend' hotel but they didn't seem to mind having two, quite ordinary middle aged guests staying with them. We are regular travelers to the UK and have never stayed in the Notting Hill area before. There were lots of nice walks to be had in Kensington Park and through the beautiful local streets. We managed to walk to Oxford Street and to Soho quite easily. There were a few glitches ( no wake up call on our last day and of course no tea facilities in the room) but the hotel was a beautiful place to stay, the staff were friendly and obliging and after eight days it felt like home!

title: A great boutique hotel in beautiful Notting Hill
text: Very clean , we stayed in the master suit , spacious and great taste. The staff is friendly , the atmosphere in this hotel is vert pleasant and cool. The location is absolutely beautiful and central. Literally 3 mins walk from Notting Hill Gate tube station. Also, great food available with healthy choices. I totally recommend this hip, comfy, warm and neat hotel in London.

title: Very average
text: Last month we stayed with my boyfriend at the Laslett. After check in it turned out that we will have very very very (!!!) small and very very very dark room in basement (yes!! basement!). After two nights, fullfiled with terrible noises from upstairs, and our complaints, we've been moved to other room. Room, next to the stairs, which was even more noisy!!! After that we've been offered complimentary breakfast, which was cold and tasted like prepared previous day or frozen. We are very sad and dissappointed, because it suppose to be our anniversary trip to beautiful place... plus no coffee/tea facilities (unless you order and pay over L3)

title: simple, warm and welcoming
text: Laslett is simple, warm and welcoming. The room was decor was simple black and white as is the reception. The whole hotel is on the ground floor. The breakfast is served with much warmth and care which was not found in other European cities. I was impressed to see young boys and girls running the business independently. The only discomfort was we had to wait for the rooms to ready beyond the check-in time. But for it, a simple, warm welcoming Laslett!

title: Design without Substance
text: We were very pleased to see that a new, much needed hotel had opened in Notting Hill. Even better it was positioned as luxury in many trusted travel sources. The location is ideal, close to the tube, cafes and the crazy scene found in NH but the hotel is tucked away within Pembridge Gardens and remains rather quiet and unobtrusive. The outside of hotel makes it look fun, with a lovely terrace where guests (and others) can take a drink and enjoy some downtime. The lobby is designed with a small eating area on one side and a bar/lounging area on the other. Both these spaces rest adjacent to a long "bar" which includes the front desk, and an actual bar where a breakfast buffet is served each morning. Our room looked very good upon arrival- large, very clean, king bed, separate dressing area with desk/vanity on one side and a bathroom with large shower on the other. However, once the front desk clerk left me to actually stay and use the room all the delight of the superficial design began to strip away. The room was very noisy being located next to a fire door and on the lower (yes, lower) ground floor. Though it was not street noise, it was guest and staff noise that startled me both day and night-also the smell of food from kitchens or some type of service space. Next, the bathroom was verging on the ridiculous. The super small sink- about the size of a medium salad bowl, and I do not exaggerate, came up to my thighs. I was not quite sure what anyone was thinking, or not thinking, to place such an absurd and useless sink in a hotel. There was no space for toiletry bags or any products let alone to really use this tiny object with any grace or elegance. The shower was not separated by anything but an L-shaped curtain that kept the water around you and worked relatively well. However, the bathmat was placed inside this area which I managed to drench immediately, and there was only tepid warm water- despite best efforts we could not get it hot....which was very annoying. Also much to my dismay, we received a knock on the door by housekeeping at 10am....really? In this day and age, can there be a little more sensitivity to guests in a room on a Sunday morning-figure out a way to train staff to be more aware. The staff was nice but never really looked at you. We left the hotel several times and were barely acknowledged. In the morning during breakfast it was even more of the same. Inconsistent, understaffed and you felt like the staff thought they were doing you a favor when serving you. There was nothing gracious, friendly or warm in any interaction (though front desk staff upon check in was very nice). I would describe it as a certain distance that seemed to be kept between staff and guest. It is understandable if you are staying a a truly groovy hotel with a scene- maybe in Miami at the Delano or Setai, but here? Not expected, not appreciated and not worth it. I did complain to the front desk and requested a room on a different floor. The hotel was full and they could not accommodate a change. I was offered a complimentary breakfast. Upon check out, I told the staff that we had no hot water and housekeeping knocked on the door to our annoyance. Her response was to apologize and asked if I received the complimentary breakfast....kind of clueless response. Hot water is a pretty basic requirement in any hotel, but it was not acknowledged as such-- as I said this distance between staff and guest was fascinating. Overall, if staying at The Laslett set expectations. You have almost no choice in Notting Hill or Bayswater for a decent hotel. Defining the hotel as "luxury" may be a relative term when comparing to other hotels in the immediate area but is truly an exaggeration for the initiated. Despite wanting to love this hotel and return again and again, I say with much sadness that I would never return nor recommend.

title: Great Stay A+
text: We have been travelling to London for the past 13 years on business and this is one of the nicest hotels we have stayed in. Stylish rooms and one of the comfiest beds I have ever slept in. Staff couldn't have been more helpful. Great central location. Will definitely return.

title: Best place to stay in London
text: I love this boutique hotel ! It is very charming & beautifully designed. It is contemporary & at the same time you can feel the soul of Notting Hill.The balance is perfect. The rooms are very comfortable, with enough space to feel like at home, and to work if needed. I love their bathrooms as well, especially the shower ! I travel to London twice a month. To be honest, I tried other places, sometimes even twice as expensive, but I am always disappointed compared to The Laslett. It is very close to the center, quite fast to get there by cab through bus lanes actually. You can easily find a cab. It is also 1 minute away from the tube, which is very convenient if you need to go east fast. I've been there alone, with my boss, with my husband, and also with a friend. All of them loved the Laslett.

title: Charming Notting Hill Hotel
text: This hotel was one of the best I’ve ever stayed in! Perfectly placed in Notting Hill and steps away from Notting Hill Gate tube station. Everything was wonderful, from the customer service to the room and to the hotel restaurant... If we ever come back to London we will make sure that we stay here! Highly recommend!

title: Not for business travellers
text: As a business traveller, the hotel misses the mark. I was left with the feeling that there was new management, and that cost-cutting is taking place. There's no concierge to help you secure reservations at high-demand restaurants or shows. It doesn't provide tea and coffee in the rooms unless you ask for it. It's cancelled premium news services such as CNN yet these still appear as channels on the TV, and are listed as being available in the in-room information pack. Housekeeping is slack - dirty glasses and cups were left behind every day and none of the glassware in the bar was replaced during my three-night stay. The airconditioning is really noisy when it works, and appears to be set to stop working during the night so the rooms get really stuffy. Staff are friendly but don't seem to now what's going on. For example, those on the front desk in the morning didn't know CNN is not longer on offer, and didn't communicate that they had learned of that while I was out, yet when I raised the issue a second time in the evening I was immediately advised.

title: Birthday / hospital trip.
text: We enjoyed our stay. Nothing was to much of a problem. Room was lovely. Bed super comfy. REN bath products. Comfy stay .. We had lunch ... Only slight windge .. it was expensive for what we had . Fish pie and a toasted sandwich .. two glasses of wine . The fish pie was nice . But small and there was no garnish.. Rose wine was delicious .. In the evening we had cocktails and before check out we enjoyed a great breakfast . Staff were lovely and friendly . Perfectly placed a very short walk from the tube.

title: Great central Location
text: We stayed here for my daughters 21st Birthday and had a lovely time. The staff were very friendly and efficient on the front desk on our arrival and throughout our stay. The rooms were very comfortable - we had three rooms all of which were super clean and comfortable particularly the beds. It is located in a great central location with Notting Hill tube station very close by although the hotel is nice and quiet at night which is good. As it was my daughters birthday they gave her some lovely chocolates and a handy bag which was a lovely touch. If I am being picky the bar / breakfast area lets it down a little. We had drinks before we went out to dinner which were ok - one of our party had a cider which was not to his liking - perhaps a little too artisan - and they insisted on masses of ice in the drinks - Also breakfast took a while and was brought out at different times for each person so some of us had finished breakfast before the others got theirs - Having said that overall this is a lovely new boutique hotel in a great location which I would stay at again. Thank you

title: Great little hotel!
text: Nice new hotel with great staff and service. Everything is new and clean. It is very close to the subway station, which will get you to most of the sights in London . Also there are a lot of cafes and restuarants just a few steps away, if you want something else other than what the cafe in the hotel offers.

title: What a hotel
text: This is definitely a hotel to visit. Everything was perfect - from the check in procedure to the interior design. Great staff, great vibe, extremely comfortable and homely hotel in the heart of leafy Notting Hill. What more could I ask for? The Laslett and team, you get a 10/10 from us!

title: Amazing experience
text: Had a fab stay at The Laslett - our room was airy and stylish, loved the setup with the 'big bar' and got to make use of the cocktail shaker provided! Lots of cute touches too like being able to order stockings from the room service menu. The staff were delightful and willing to go the extra mile, especially when we asked for tea in the room and were brought a whole tray with tea, coffee and a kettle at no extra charge. Food and cocktails were also great - highly recommend the baked barley risotto! The Laslett is definitely our new go-to bolthole for when we stay in London.

title: Nice hotel, location ... but noisy night
text: The location of the hotel is very good and this hotel seems attractive ... certainly in rooms upstairs. It is not normal to have so much noise problem with this level of hotel. The sound insulation is not enough and the rooms in the basement are really poorly soundproof .. at this price it is not eligible and no discount was offered.

title: Excellent service. Beautifully appointed modern rooms.
text: We received excellent service upon checking and throughout our 24 hour stay. The room is well designed with amazing linens and mattress, great body products, and well designed and spacious modern room. Great location, and wonderful food assortments. Great staff. Had a lovely vibe. Only negative was whomever I spoke to when making a reservation was extremely rude. Maybe a tad overpriced as well. The place is super clean and refreshing.

title: Perfect hotel in London
text: Brand new hotel with great design. The breakfast was perfect. The staff very friendly and helpfull. Really great value. Super location: Very near Hyde Park and Dianas playground for kids. Short busride to Portabello Road. We will come back!

title: Wonderful staff and a wonderful stay for my parents.
text: My parents stayed here before Christmas for four nights. There was the possibility that the stay was going to start off stressfully because there had been a booking goof on agoda.com. Too complicated to go into on review but suffice to say that The Laslett took care of it after being on the phone with Agoda.com for a while. The hotel staff are fabulous and could not have been more accommodating. They gave us all lovely coffees while we waited for a resolution. After that was taken care of, they showed us to our parents' room. Faced the street with tall windows (floor to ceiling), a comfortable bed with a lovely bathroom and plenty of storage and a little seating area. Breakfast was included in the rate. It included the wonderful coffee and a continental buffet. The spread was simple but very good. We joined them in the morning (family lives in neighborhood). The hotel staff were very welcoming and my niece enjoyed their pancakes every day. Overall, would highly recommend. The location is great for exploring Notting Hill and the tube station is right around the corner.

title: Modern boutique hotel
text: The location in Notting Hill is superbe and the area although very beautiful is not known for upscale hotels. I booked a double room for single use and way given a basement room which I found unacceptable. The staff is very kind and friendly and they immediately found a solution and moved me into a room on the 3rd floor small but nice. The breakfast is pleasant , so is the breakfast room and the lounge. It is a modern approach, no real restaurant, no real bar, it is all in one with the reception.I was there before Christmas and I found the room rate a bit over the top for what the hotel offers (around 330,-- EUR) but this may have been the busy London pre-christmas season. In all I will come back !

title: A stylish luxury boutique hotel
text: The room we booked was spacious and clean. Everything was of high quality, especially the bathroom. Beautiful tiles! New and expensive looking shower interiors. The location is very convenient. It's right next to the underground station. The staff were very helpful and accommodating to our requests. Helped with luggage, restaurant recommendations, and even arranged a taxi for taking us to the airport. Highly recommend this hotel, especially to families who need extra space. Breakfast buffet could have more variety.

title: Lovely London Hotel
text: What a lovely London hotel! Amazing design in every detail. Clean rooms with everything what we needed. Great staff, really helpful and always there to make our stay memorable. We loved food, drinks and all atmosphere of this hotel. We just had a lovely relaxing time:) We will be back!

title: Great time
text: Wonderful, cozy hotel with the stylish rooms and restaurant. Rooms are very nicely designed, especially those with the big bath tub. Vito was very nice and helpful whenever we had any questions. Id stay here on my next visit.

title: almost perfect!
text: we agree with many comments previously written in reviews about this place and an absolute bargain price we paid comparatively. Everything was really very good short of no coffee maker (nespresso or similar) in room and the prohibitive cost of single malts

title: Beautiful boutique hotel
text: Stayed here with my husband for my birthday,Could not fault our stay, beautiful boutique hotel, great friendly and helpful staff, fantastic customer service and all in a great location. Will certainly be returning to this hotel.

title: Great location, room & staff
text: Glad we booked this beautiful hotel near the Notting Hill Gate tube station. Was very convenient for tube, and also walking to numerous Notting Hill breakfast & dinner restaurants. Staff stored our bags until our room was ready, and we were given a very spacious room on the third floor, with a great view of the street. Bathroom was large and shower worked very well. Had plenty of storage & comfy bed. We asked for dinner recommendations and received three great dinner restaurant tips from the helpful desk staff.

title: Movin' on up
text: On a return visit to the Laslett, we were disappointed being assigned basement rooms (we had 2 rooms booked), and no options was available for a change as hotel was full, but a change to upstairs was arranged for the following 2 nights, which made all the difference. Upstairs (first floor) we found a wall of windows with view of the pretty street, and it changed our mood considerably. Not sure why the basement rate is the same as upstairs, although supposedly, according to the front desk, some people prefer it. It actually cost us a lot more than the later upstairs, due to it being a certain busier night of the week. In the future, we would be 100% sure to specify no basement when booking. Otherwise, we enjoyed the superb location, funky lobby and room decor, cool vibe, well stocked bar, good breakfast, and the lovely cheerful and accommodating staff.

title: Great Boutique in a Great Location
text: I have to preface this by saying I don't usually like British or European hotels. My experiences have often resulted in cramped confines, with few amenities, and lacking attentive service. Not the case here. Even though we had a basement room (they have a nicer term, which escapes me), it was a great space. Very quiet, which helps when adapting to time zones, and recently renovated. The shower was a little snug for the 6ft types, but some of the better plumbing I've experienced in Britania. The staff are fantastic. Michelle managed to get us a table at the Savoy for afternoon tea, with just a day's notice. The bar staff make great drinks, and everyone (including housekeeping and maintenance staff) are always cheery and helpful. Apart from the great hotel experience, this is steps from Notting Hill Gate station, and you can get anywhere worth going to in 20-30 minutes on the tube. There is a cool record store a couple of blocks away, and you have Portobello Road just below. You can walk to Kensington Gardens & Palace, or right to the V&A. Next time we come to London, we'll probably come straight here. Beat the Hell out of Mayfair.

title: Lovely stay
text: I booked the laslett as it's close to where my friend lives in Notting Hill. The hotel is really nice. It's a small, boutique type place with a very clean, minimalist design that is still elegant and classy. It's in an excellent location, literally two steps from the tube stop and a five or ten minute walk to Portobello road. Checking in was a breeze and the double room I booked was great. The bed was HUGE and so there was less floor space to use, so if two people were there with suitcases, they might have found it tight, but since I was alone, it was fine. It was also very quiet which I liked. The bathroom was great with a big shower and lots of space. The room and hotel were spotless. I was very impressed. The Wi-Fi was easy to use and strong. I usually ate out but the final night I decided to order in. I got the Mac and cheese and it was AMAZING. made me wish I'd order in before. Checkout was easy again and I was sent off with a smile and complimentary latte. All in all, I couldn't have been more pleased with my stay and will definitely book again!

title: Great location and helpful staff
text: The Laslett is a few strides away from a metro station and in a lively yet peaceful area of London. There are plenty of cafes in close proximity (Paul's, EAT and Pret A Manger) and nice restaurants, which is a big plus because the coffees and breakfast at The Laslett, although lovely, are pricey. Some rooms are better than others here, I would avoid a basement room... However the staff are extremely helpful and keen to please, we moved rooms with no fuss. Bathrooms are modern, nice high pressure shower, great decor and attitude to the place. Feels very local and hip, with lots of interesting books to read on offer. The management is very obliging, free adaptor hire, umbrella hire, hospitality trays etc.

title: Lovely, memorable stay
text: This hotel was chosen after a search on tripadvisor and internet. I was happy to find out that it was to my satisfaction. Rooms were really great and clean. The location of the hotel is just perfect!! close to museums and parks and notting hill, not to mention shopping. The price was a bit too much for me although it is worth it's money.

title: A special place
text: My husband & I stayed here for only one night as part of a bigger trip. Upon arrival, we were greeted immediately by Valerie. She was so warm and really made us feel welcome. I had mentioned we were on a big trip celebrating our 25th wedding anniversary. She checked us in and brought us up to a large beautiful room. She told us she upgraded us because it was our anniversary! We had a little sitting room in addition to the main room. The windows are wide so the room is bright. Bathroom is updated and the entire room/hotel is very clean. As we were settling in, we had a knock on the door...it was Valerie with a bottle of champagne and two glasses! So incredibly thoughtful!! We were going to meet my cousin for dinner that night, and she arranged a taxi to pick us up upon our request. After dinner, we came back to the hotel and sat at the little bar for a bit. We really enjoyed our time there with William & Ariana. We both slept well that night. Our bed was very comfortable, so important! The next morning we enjoyed a delicious breakfast and after we were done, we had a taxi waiting to take us to the airport thanks to Valerie who called the day before to arrange one for us. (our request) We were sad to go! I will absolutely stay here again when we return some day.

title: Lovely in all the best ways
text: The Laslett had me at "hello." And, it only got better from there. There are certain needs for me when I stay at a hotel: warm staff who seem to really enjoy their work, a clean room, a good cup of coffee in the morning, and a convenient location. The Laslett has all of these and so much more. In fact, I can't say enough about the staff. They make the Laslett hum with an elegant, hip vibe that flows along with the hotel building itself -- a seriously cool mix of craftsman meets art studio. My wife and I happened to stay in two different rooms during our visit, and both were meticulously clean (frankly, my biggest issue). We first stayed in a room in the lower floor, and although it didn't have any view, it was quiet, nicely sized, and had an amazing walk in shower. We also stayed in a room on the second floor (which you can access by stairs or elevator). This room (which looks like the Trip Advisor picture) was larger and had floor to ceiling doors that allowed us to have coffee while watching and listening to the neighborhood bustle about. This room was also quiet, and had a clean, well designed bathroom with a very large tub/shower (a nice stool sits next to the tub for guests who need to give the kids a bath!). Back on the ground floor, in addition to the front desk, there are a couple of really lovely rooms where you can nosh or meet with a client if you're in town for work. But, if you feel like hanging in your room, you'll have options: a minibar that is well stocked with all sorts of nibbles and drinks, or room service! The Laslett has a well-crafted menu, and although my wife and I didn't need any special diet, my guess is that the Laslett will accommodate restrictions if at all possible. Finally location. I'm not sure you could find a better spot. My wife and I caught the tube every day from the entrance at the end of our block, and the neighborhood is filled with awesome pubs, great restaurants of all types, and shopping. And, Hyde Park is three blocks away! I can't imagine having a better place to stay!

title: Nice Hotel in Notting Hill
text: We stayed for 1 night for our 10 year anniversary on 18th July. We were given the ‘Archie Room’. The room was very nice, the bathroom was gorgeous. The bed was comfortable. We could hear running water from rooms above us and people walking up and down the stairs, but for 1 night this was not an issue. We had dinner at the hotel – you get 20% off food and drink as a guest. We booked breakfast in our room rate, the lady behind the counter was in a very bad mood, having an argument with someone over the phone for all guests to hear. When we left we said thank you to her, but she did not even acknowledge us. The rest of the staff were very friendly and helpful though.

title: Tasteful and perfectly located!
text: When we entered the room we were in complete awe with the design, the artwork, and the penguin classics above the bed was definitely a nice touch. We noticed there wasn’t a kettle in the room, so we asked the staff and they offered to bring us one with coffee and tea which we really appreciated! Thanks! Later in the evening we had dinner in the restaurant and the food was divine! Great selection of cocktails and Marius, our waiter was so entertaining! :D We will definitely stay again!

title: Visit to London
text: What a pleasure to visit such a well appointed hotel, such attention to detail is rare. I find it difficult to find fault. The rooms are extremely comfortable in that I felt completely at ease. There was everything I needed. I ate in one night and was very satisfied with the cuisine. Totally recommend staying here.

title: Great stay at The Laslett
text: What a great place to stay! Great hospitality and ideal location - highly recommended. Modern apartment with some very personal touches, all new and tastefully decorated, professional reception and really good breakfasts. Be sure to enjoy a cocktail outside on the verandah.

title: A wonderful new hotel!!
text: What a wonderful new hotel... Great staff, helpful, kind and always there to help and make your stay memorable. Design is classic modern, full of light and a beautiful collection of artworks that give the place a true sense of personal touch. Location is best - steps from the park and the center of Notting Hill. We will be back!

title: Good location and facilities, service to be improved
text: It s quite astonishing how a 5 star rated hotel can get away with not offering either a free bottle of water nor tea/coffee making facilities in the room. You don't come across that very often nowadays. I also can hardly remember the last time I spent 55 minutes in the breakfast room in order to complete my breakfast. Bad coincidence? I doubt that really, what I think this hotel needs is some hardcore manager who irons out all whereabouts as this place has its DNA and all the right ingredients to become a topper. Great location, eye for detail when it comes to interior/ architecture, cleanliness and helpful staff. So take it up a notch.

title: A hotel that doesn't feel like a hotel
text: The Laslett is perfectly suited to people who like hotels with a genuine homely feeling. Situated in the heart of Notting Hill, you get a wonderful neighbourhood atmosphere, whilst still being close to everything in Central London (the hotel is also right next to the Underground Station). Being a collection of houses, you instantly get a less commercial atmosphere on arrival. The staff are friendly, relaxed and attentive. Rooms are beautifully chic, comfortable and have nice touches such as a full size bottle minibar and Neals Yard Bathroom Amenities (also full size - which is a nice touch). There in no In Room Tea/Coffee, which would be addressed, as you would expect this from a quality hotel. There is however 24 hour room service and I enjoyed a lovely home made cake with my tea. There is a wonderful collection of books throughout the hotel and the living rooms are the perfect place for a cocktail before heading out to the many restaurants in the area (the hotel also has a restaurant, but I did not experience it).

title: A real gem
text: This is just what Notting Hill Gate needed - a discreet boutique hotel, right on its doorstep. Great location (quiet street just off the main drag). Well-designed rooms with careful attention to detail (great beds with superb pillows!

title: Family wedding
text: We booked four rooms here for my daughters wedding near by. Everything was excellent and the staff were just wonderful. Friendly, happy and attentive.! Nothing was too much trouble. Great hotel in a great location

title: Superlative
text: Superlative in every sense. I have visited London many times, but this is the first time I have felt relaxed in London. That is partly due to the location in Notting Hill, and largely due to the hotel itself. It is a hotel that does not feel like a big chain hotel ... it is charming, stylish, elegant and thoroughly enjoyable. Beautiful rooms adorned with interesting art works, and very stylishly presented. The staff are warm and friendly too. My only 'gripes' or suggestions are very minor: I did not enjoy music being played in the breakfast room during breakfast

title: A true treasure
text: SUPER-GREAT location. Underground station located in the corner the hotel's quite and pleasant street . A very gentle, yet keen and friendly staff served us with warm smile and real care. Breakfast is perfect. simple, elegant and not expensive. Room service dish ordered at night, was a real delight. The room was beautiful (We loved the combination of modern and homey design) and p-e-r-f-e-c-t-l-y cleaned, a lot of light from outside (not just on the sunny days we surprisingly had). Next time in London will be at the Laslett for sure!

title: Good hotel with some niggles
text: Stayed for one night in a double room (not the 'spare double' which is the cheapest). Hotel location is excellent, literally a few steps from Notting Hill Gate tube station and a short walk from many pubs & restaurants as well as Portobello Road. The hotel is smart and characterful, and all the staff we dealt with were very pleasant and helpful. The room was fresh and modern, with a very comfortable bed & nice products in the bathroom. It was actually much larger than I was expecting, but I was a little shocked when I realised that it was in the basement! We were taken to the room via the lift so didn't immediately notice as the blind was down. It's one thing not having a great view, but another to be actually subterranean! A couple of other gripes about the room: - Despite its size there were very few surfaces to put anything. The hotel makes a great deal about its 'big bar' which is basically a large mini bar with mini bar prices, I would rather have had more shelves for our clothes rather than end up with half our stuff on the floor - I really think that basic hospitality should include drinking water, the bottles of water in the 'big bar' were quite expensive (I think £5), most hotels of this standard provide complimentary bottled or filtered water - There were no tea & coffee making facilities in the room I would happily stay again, but would be pickier about the room. If we hadn't already unpacked or were staying longer I would have asked to be moved.

title: Beautiful, Modern, Artsy
text: This is a beautiful, sleek hotel. We stayed for just a couple of days, but found it very comfortable and we really liked the decor and theme. It was a good location for walking to the Portobello Market as well. Our only two real knocks were that the air conditioning seemed to struggle to keep up with the unusually hot temperatures London was having at the time. And the shower was pretty tight. Still, a good value for the money. We enjoyed our stay.

title: a nice kind of trendy hotel
text: nice hotel, close to Notting Hill gate tube station, friendly staff, nice breakfast room with good quality food selection, rooms comfortable, not a very big hotel, more boutique like I suppose, would stay here again

title: Excellent hotel - would stay again
text: We stayed with our teenage girls. The staff is friendly and helpful, and the neighborhood location is great. Only about 100 feet from a tube stop. We really enjoyed the food, wine, and coffee and various times during the day. And, the rooms were really comfortable. Of note is the well designed bathroom, which had a shelf running the length of two walls. It was very easy to set our toiletries without being crowded or making a mess. We would recommend this to anyone.

title: Home-away-from-home <3
text: The Laslett has really become my home-away-from-home during my work trips to London. It is a great alternative to your typical 'business hotel'. The rooms are really airy, clean and with great decor. All the little touches are there to make you feel welcome and comfy :) Also, The Laslett offers great customer service! Not to mention the location, of course :) You've got the Notting Hill Gate tube station just round the corner, the lovely Gate cinema is a 1-minute walk away and all the lovely cafes, boutiques and the market that Notting Hill has to offer are within (short) walking distance. Highly recommended!

title: Like a smart flat stay in London
text: Clean, newer hotel in traditional London frame. Great location. Staff excellent, I could not ask for more hospitality. All the privacy & courtesy of a hotel without sacrificing the feel of London. The rooms walls are a bit thin but really I slept fine after long days out in town.

title: Very good overall but a variable experience
text: We stayed at the hotel twice in July and it was as if we had two quite different experiences. For the first stay, which in my opinion was very expensive, we had a small basement room and the door rattled with each person walking past, quite often making us jump. It was also quite cramped, and the view was of building walls and plumbing. On the second occasion, ironically less costly, our room was more comfortable and spacious and looked out on to the main street. We also found the staff friendlier and more helpful during this stay, whereas during the initial stay they seemed overall rather nonchalant. I was surprised by the variations. The location is excellent, the general appearance appealing, but there remains a strong role for a warm welcome whatever the pitch of the hotel.

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: Stayed one night in September. What a great little hotel. Bright, clean, modern.. it felt different from many of the other hotels I've stayed in. Staff couldn't do enough to help. Room was large and immaculate. Will definitely return.

title: Eclectic
text: Great small hotel in excellent location - would definitely stay again. Wonderful furnished rooms, eclectic mix of modern comfort in true British style. It's worth paying a little more for a room on the first or second floor as our room was on the lower ground floor with limited natural light.

title: Neighborhood location
text: Quiet location in Nottingham Hill. Near subway and lots of services. Quiet bar with limited but adequate menu with good prices. Good service. Brand new property. Modern and sleek design. Fair value for pricey city.

title: beautiful space, great service
text: Staying at The Laslett nothing but a pure pleasure. Over the years i stayed at many different London hotels, but can't think of another place that so well combines the modern English chic with comfort, warmth and great service. Not to mention the breakfast. 11 out of 10!

title: Not fair
text: On my arrival day they have given me a room at the -1 ( basement ) which has the windows at the roofside after my complains they have offered me another room at the 3rd floor.The room at the 3rd floor was also smelling from the bathroom which has not been solved although reception informed.Still ca not understand how English helath & safety commision let them to use this room as a guest room ...

title: Sharp practice on bookings
text: We recently booked accommodation, via Mr & Mrs Smith booking, at the Laslett for later this month, as part of our trip to the UK from Australia, and we were looking forward to staying there. Unfortunately, we have been forced to change our plans and cancel the booking, nearly four weeks in advance of our planned stay. We had paid 100% of the accommodation coast as a deposit and we acknowledge that the booking terms specified that this deposit was not refundable. Accordingly, we acknowledge that the Laslett is within its rights to have refused any refund - but, with no costs incurred and nearly four weeks notice, we think that any fair-minded hotel with its interests in revenue balanced by its interest in the needs of guests would have, without prejudice to their rights, agreed to some refund. A classic case of legal rights being a poor justification for sharp practice. I suppose, if this is how they treat people, we are less likely to have enjoyed our stay than we had hoped to be. I would advise people to avoid this hotel.

title: Lovely aesthetics and fantastic location
text: New, still evolving. I've now stayed here for multiple days on three occasions, in March, June, July. A very appealing small hotel, combining sophistication and a fresh, casual atmosphere, in an optimal setting. Furnished with care, from the old Penguin paperbacks in the room to the Neals Yard toiletries, the terrific art on the walls, and the wonderful beds and bedding. And the superb reading lights that flank the beds! Rooms do vary in size within the category, so ask questions

title: Be warned - misleading website and really average service - 3 star hotel at best
text: I stayed at the Laslett in a Master double room for a couple of nights in early May. For the price paid I have to say it was one of the most disappointing hotels I have stayed in. Firstly, the website is completely misleading. Most of the master double rooms are in the basement (you get in a lift and go to floor -1) and have absolutely no view and very very limited natural light. There is no mention of this on the website which I think is deliberately misleading. The corridor in the basement that leads to the rooms also stinks on cigarette smoke (I suspect that people who stay down there can't be bothered getting the list up to the ground floor and smoke in the corridor). When I mentioned this to the reception staff they said they knew about the bad smell and they were "sorry". It amazed me that they were aware of the issue but hadn't seemed to do anything to rectify it. After I asked to be moved to a room with some natural light the new room looked directly at a brick wall and I still couldn't see the sky no matter how much I put my face against the window. At 390£ a night I expected a LOT more. The service is also really really average. I'm not sure if it's deliberate - in that they are trying to create a really laid back feel - but there was no one to assist with luggage from the street to the reception, no one assisting with recommendations and no real warmth from any of the staff. I felt like I was a bit of an inconvenience to the staff, rather than a guest they wanted to welcome. There were a number of other issues with the stay - the housekeeping service always tried to come early in the morning when I was in the room and On the last day tried to come 3 separate times just before the check out at 11am. I was trying to take some business calls and it made me feel so rushed and that if I stayed a moment after 11am they would come charging through the door and demanding that I leave. On the plus side, the rooms (if you're not in the basement) have high ceilings and are roomy for London, as is the bathroom. The decoration in the room is gorgeous but has come at the cost of being functional - there is absolutely nowhere to put your suitcase except on the floor or on the bed - which is just such stupid design for a hotel room where everyone has a suitcase. The location is the best thing about this hotel - it is 1min from the tube and without walking distance to everything that Notting hill has to offer. On the whole I would recommend staying somewhere else - for about the same money the Hari in Belgravia is miles better than this hotel.

title: A New Gem!
text: My partner and I booked this hotel for Valentine's but unfortunately I developed my semi-annual cold, genuinely, I wasn't faking a headache.

title: Looks really lovely but ...
text: This recently refurbished and rebranded hotel is, at first glance, delightful - and there is a lot to recommend it. The staff are delightful, helpful and friendly, everyone smiles and really does seem to want you to enjoy your stay. The location is excellent and the place is fresh and clean. So it makes pointing out all the things that were really annoying seem almost mean, but annoying they really are. I leave it to others to decide whether they would find these things equally annoying. The rooms are small. Okay this is London after all, so what do you expect? Well the Laslett claims to have five stars, so I expected something at least a little bigger, or at least better appointed. Very nice decor but the arrangement of the room is such that you cannot see the window from the bed, which I hate. The bed was only so-so (could be firmer) and there are only those dreadful hotel pillows that you need to pile four high because as soon as you put your head on them you are lying completely flat again. Really annoying. The bedside tables are so small that I had to put the phone on the floor to out a plug in the socket at the back of the table. Annoying and inconvenient. The heater in my room was on when I arrived and I turned it off, and could not get it to ever come on again (but really didnt need to - see below). There is nowhere to put a suitcase and nothing to put one on. Floor or nothing. Annoying and inconvenient. If you open the wardrobe door you can't get past to take something from it because of the proximity of the desk, so you have to walk past the wardrobe door first and then open it, then close it again to walk back to the bed. If you are packing or unpacking this gets old fast. You have to keep logging into the wifi (which is pretty slow) and each time you have to provide the passcode, your email address and your name. Annoying and inconvenient. The wardrobe isn't full height so hanging a dress or a full length coat is not possible. Annoying and inconvenient, and like most hotels, clearly designed for male guests. There is an ice bucket (seriously?) but no kettle or tea and coffee making gear. Annoying and inconvenient. There is no bar soap, only really unpleasant smelly shower gel. Annoying and inconvenient. Though the hotel is only 8 months old, one of the taps in the bathroom was really loose, the tooth mugs were rusty, and the toilet flush was dodgy to say the least. Kept sticking. Also it is designed in a way that makes it impossible to use by anyone with long fingernails - I had to press it with my knuckles. Annoying, inconvenient. and painful. In the bathroom there are no shelves, so nowhere to put things other than on the narrow margins of the basin. Annoying and inconvenient. The rooms are noisy

title: Not yet 'Luxurious'
text: Billed as 'luxurious' this hotel while attractive, with friendly staff has a way to go. Interiors are fashionably grey with touches of black and white. Rooms are of a decent size. Beds are comfortable. Art work is quirky and general feel is 'minimalist' and utilitarian. Bathrooms are attractive but shower heads are too close to shower doors and products, while good quality, are not consistently replaced and are restricted to basics. Room service menu is minimal and breakfast is adequate but choices are again limited. Staff are young, multi-cultural and helpful. Location is excellent.

title: Pleasant Enough...but, a mixed bag
text: We booked two rooms for two nights. PLUS: We really liked the location, and boutique vibe of The Laslett. The rooms were clean, small and comfortable-it feels much like a W Hotel- (I've stayed in many W Hotels, but also in many of the world's top hotels (grand and boutique)-- and I do appreciate both the difference and price point, and what you should reasonably expect in each case). We liked the architecture and provence of the hotel...being more in a neighborhood was really appealing to us. We also knew that the Laslett wasn't going to be "posh"

title: Excellent!
text: Very nice place to stay - felt very comforable. Wonderful room. Great service, especially at the reception - thanks. Silent. Very close to the Underground makes it easy to discover the city. Kensington Park and Portobello Road just around the corner. And a few minutes walk to parking and the "Champion Pub".

title: Great Location
text: The Hotel is well located and beautiful from the outside and with a lovely lobby and bar area and with polite and welcoming staff. Our master double room was in the basement and smelt strongly of new carpet. I was not a fan of the rather dismal interior design and the incredibly poor lighting - without direct light over either the bathroom or desk mirror making it difficult to apply make up especially as this was a basement room with little natural light. The bathroom had a massive wet room style shower and then the loo, the sink (which was about the size and depth of a dinner plate and basically useless) and towel rail stuffed along one wall. Also there was nowhere to put our toiletry bags except on the floor which is not ideal in a wet room. Maybe other rooms in the hotel are better designed but I feel there was a lot of function left out of the design of our room. Soho House it is not.

title: Nice boutique hotel
text: Belated review for our 4 nights’ stay in late October 2017. Very nice boutique hotel, a short walk from Notting Hill metro station, and a pleasant stroll to Portobello Market. Love the stylish decor and furnishings of our Master Bedroom Suite as well as the retro bathroom. Different faces at the reception every time we went in and out, all were warm and friendly.

title: Great weekend stay
text: Location of this hotel is fantastic, easy access to Tube and surrounding areas. We stayed in a master bedroom double and this was a good size with a well stocked mini bar. All staff were polite and helpful. Breakfast menu for us however was a little limited. This was full of great healthy options, muesli and berries, granola, etc. but whilst on holiday it would be nice to be able to indulge in a bit of bacon perhaps!

title: A modern trendy friendly boutique hotell
text: Great location close to Notting Hill underground station yet in a very quiet residential area. Nice room and bathroom but unfortunately no floor heating in the bathroom. Very friendly staff. Good breakfast but limited choice.

title: Lovely room
text: The hotel is just around the corner from Notting Hill Station, so it's a great location if going by Tube. Short walk to Hyde Park and Kensington Palace. Our room was spacious, clean and bright. The large bed was very comfortable. A fully stocked drinks cupboard was available to us as well. The bathroom was very modern and gorgeous. Shower and tub were perfect. Drinks at the bar were a bit expensive. £14 for an Old Fashioned with Rye is a bit steep. It also seems that, even if you're down in the bar/restaurant area, and you charge the bill to your room you will receive a "service charge". We had several of those added to our final bill. We were not made aware that such charges would be applied. Overall, it is a very nice hotel and we would happily return.

title: nice boutique hotel with a hidden secret
text: stayed at the laslett for a couple of nights and were not amused to find ourself in a room in the basement. i checked my reservation and there was no hint regarding bunkers... they gave us a room on the 1st floor the next day, but still, that's not really the hinest/transparency i expect from a place of that pricetag. otherwise the laslett is really nice, small but nicely decorated and furnished rooms, a good breakfast (extra) and helpful staff. the location is perfect, just a 1 minute walk frim notting hill gate station, but really quiet. good place - just make sure your not in the cellar...

title: Beautiful hotel great location!
text: We stayed at the Laslett for the first time. It is right next to the notting Hill tube station so it is terribly convenient. The rooms are modern, with muted grey and beiges. It is beautifully designed. The rooms on the front of the hotel are bright. The suites have floor to ceiling windows. The breakfast is ample and you have a wide choice of fresh fruit, cereals, croissant, juices -- and eggs dishes. They even have avocado toast. We walked to Holland Park and everywhere as it is so well located. Service is wonderful.

title: Poor Service...
text: Spread across 5 Victorian mansions, The Laslett is less than 1 minute from Notting Hill Gate Underground Station, The Gate , Portobello Road Market, dozens of restaurants and boutiques and Holland Park are all within 15 minutes’ walk. Rooms are charming, convertible bed and table, Bathrooms feature subway tiles, Belgravia fittings, full-size Neal’s Yard toiletries and black-and-white-tiled floors. The room has floor to ceiling windows, full of light, & the windows can be open slightly for a fresh air! The Henderson Bar, named after a musician from early Notting Hill Carnival days, menu is very limited & over priced to compare with other restaurants in London. Spaces are intimate you have little choice to seat! In the bar, library or lobby. ******* However I will not suggest for more than a night or two, definitely not for a long stay as I did! I wasn’t happy with the service at all, but being extremely busy I didn’t have time to change my hotel! Unlike my experience with other hotels in London Staff didn’t put much effort to make it better. I think most of the staffs are part time as during my 14 days stay they kept changing! I should say all of them were nice, but with no authority to take decisions! ***On second night of my stay I fund the room very cold & I asked for extra blanket, which to my surprise they said they don’t have extra blanket! This was resolved on day 3rd or 4th when the person in charge of maintenance was at the reception & he arranged for a extra duvet & small heater in my room! (Thank to him!) *** When I asked for extra hangers, they provided 2 extra and again they said they don’t have more! *** In the advertising the room was with coffee machines, in my room I had nothing & when I asked they said it’s for higher categories of room, even-though I payed not the least price! They promised to provide the tea tray! It took 2 days to get it & almost every days to chase them to replace it after housekeepers removes it. *** The first weekend my room was not done until 1pm and when I asked I was told hotel is full & they are busy! That did happened few other times during my stay. *** They didn’t change the bedsheets during my stay, I didn’t noticed if other-ways, as I could notice the dust from my wool blanket which I was using! After a week I asked the lady who was doing my room, she said only after checkout they change the bedsheets or if Guests asked the reception and they inform the housekeeping! Many other small things, such as shoe cleaning products! When you chose a luxury hotel you don’t carry your shoe cleaning tools with you!! Overall as I mentioned it wasn’t a pleasant experience...

title: Very nice boutique hotel
text: We stayed here one night while traveling back home through London from Italy. The rooms are very stylishly done and modern. The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was nice. The location is good for a walk to grab something to eat (lots of choices) and it is a short cab ride to Piccadilly to get the Heathrow Express. While we did not take advantage of them the hotel has a small bar, library and dining room. We would certainly consider staying here again the next time we are in London. It is a Small Luxury Hotel member.

title: Chic and quiet boutique hotel.
text: I had a very nice stay at this hotel. The location is excellent - a quiet street in Nottinghill, steps from the Tube station. The hotel staff was pleasant. Rooms were a good size with comfortable beds, modern, chic design and comfortable beds with nice linens. It is a smaller boutique hotel, so there aren't the amenities of a bigger hotel (i.e. full restaurant, gym etc.), but if you are looking for an easy, clean, comfortable hotel in Nottinghill I would definitely recommend it.

title: Excellent. Boutique and Funky whilst practical and comfortable!
text: The Laslett. What a find! Located in Notting Hill and just a few steps from Notting Hill Gate tube station this newly refurbished and converted row of townhouses is simply 'Excellent' As you walk through the the door you get an instant hit of the boutique and funky decor and atmosphere. There is art, literature and music all over! The rooms are large, clean, crisp and are very well equipped. The beds are large and comfy. Well stocked mini bar and books... The bathrooms are traditional with modern and good quality accessories. We needed a taxi and had no cash on hand but reception used there service and added to our room bill. Good breakfast! The hotel is simply high end quality but comfortable and not pretentious. Great service! I wish the owners and staff success and will return!

title: Lovely hotel in Notting Hill
text: Really nice little hotel in a great location near Notting Hill Gate. Strikes the right balance of cool with efficiency. Really enjoyed our stay and will definitely return. Handy location for Notting hill but also v close to tube so easy to get into centre of town . Would def recommend

title: So quaint and so lovely!
text: Located on a quiet street in Notting Hill, The Laslett is both trendy and chic. With comfortable rooms and excellent service, I was beyond pleased with our stay. The rooms are spacious and the King size bed is quite accommodating. I enjoyed the spaciousness of the bathroom with a beautiful bathtub. The wifi, television and well-equipped plugs allow for an easy stay in London. I highly recommend this hotel!

title: Tasteful hotel
text: We stayed at this hotel to celebrate a birthday. We were greeted with a smile on arrival and offered complimentary drinks as it was a special occasion. The nicest thing about this hotel is the decor. It is very tastefully done with lovely artwork in all areas. It has a real classy feel about it. Our room was lovely with very nice bathroom and toiletries. The only disappointment was the breakfast. The staff on duty were truly miserable, with no welcome and it was all rather chaotic. There was no clarity over how to order food, etc. It's a small dining area and the food buffet area is in the middle of a corridor which is not ideal. Items were forgotten that we ordered and when we reminded the team, it was met with a surly look. All in all this ruined a very nice stay. We gave the feedback on checking out to be told that the staff member was not feeling well. In this case they should not have been serving customers. The price per night at this hotel is high end and we feel the mixed service does not match the price tag. It's a new hotel and only open for approx 1 year so perhaps over time the service levels will improve. It has the potential to be great.

title: DESIGN & SERVICE GOALS
text: We loved staying at the Laslett!!! The staff was more than friendly, helping with everything and it really felt like staying at a good friends place. We didn‘t expect such a friendly and personal service in london since it‘s such a big city. The location is amazing aswell, in a beautiful street only 5 minutes walk from Portobello Market. The design of the hotel is EVERYTHING. So tasteful and creative, i absolutely loved every little corner!!!! The breakfast was too good to be true aswell, best coffee, fresh berries, delicous croissants, could‘t ask for more. This place is our new go to hotel in london, we‘ll always come back!!! Thank you very much!

title: Great base for a weekend in London
text: Great location - close to Notting Hill Gate underground station. Victorian townhouses tastefully modernised into an interesting boutique hotel. Bedroom extremely comfortable. Good breakfasts. Found all staff welcoming, friendly, knowledgeable and helpful.

title: Shopping Trip to London
text: Just a Dream!!! Everything Perfect!! Gorgeous breakfast, large confortable room, great design in the whole Hotel.... and a lovely service!!! In the middle of Notting Hill everything is close by!! We will definetly come back!

title: Fabulous boutique hotel
text: Stayed at The Laslett Hotel in Notting Hill for 4 days. Excellent customer service in all respects. Concierge, breakfasts, personal service and beautiful accommodations. Exceptionally friendly and helpful staff! Appreciation to Sergio and Zoltan!

title: Lovely stay and will book again.
text: The Laslett is truly a lovely boutique hotel. The location is perfect in terms of proximity to Paddington (and of course Notting Hill) but where the hotel really shines is in terms of splendid staff, fantastic food and cocktails, ambiance, and small but perfectly formed (and decorated) rooms. If you're not into the corporate, faceless identikit hotels - but want something with heart and character you can't go wrong booking this hotel.

title: Loved it...will return!
text: 3 nights in a double room, most enjoyable! Nottinghill area, apart from the main road, has a lovely village feel. Great restaurants nearby, plus the parks and beautiful shops. It felt much more peaceful than our usual London expierence, but still had the London buzz we both love. Very helpful staff...set us up on Uber which was great, lots of good books, very boutique hotel atmosphere. Only thing missing, for me, tea and coffe making in the room, but everything else made up for it.

title: An amazing stay due to your amazing staff!!
text: I travel quite frequently due to work and have stayed in many hotels but haven't experienced such great customer service as at The Laslett. Your receptionist Kamelia was really helpful, friendly and your waitress Giulia was very welcoming and always had a smile on her face. Both Giulia and Kamelia made me feel at home again as London was my hometown. Due to their customer service i will definitely stay again. They are a real asset to your team. From Izu Ani- Room 35

title: Just Great!
text: My wife and I did really like everything about this hotel, cosy modern comfy in a very good area, friendly staffs, special thanks to Camelia! Though it gives you a real feeling of 5* but still in our experience nothing beats Hotel 41!

title: DO NOT BOOK THESE APARTMENTS
text: We booked three nights in an "Executive Apartment" based on the website pictures at Landmark Apartments London 6 weeks in advance. When we arrived we were shown a very small, dark, narrow apartment which in no way resembled the pictures on the website. There was literally not enough floor space to put our bags down anywhere without having to step over them (and we only had 3 carry-on size bags!). It was impossible to climb up the small steep stairs with our bags without turning sideways and when we reached the tiny attic and stepped over a floor beam to reach the bed, you had to bend over double to reach a sofa crammed against the bottom of the bed to avoid banging your head on the low ceiling (I am 5ft, 3" tall..). We asked for an Executive Apartment as advertised on their website and were told they were fully booked. We informed them we could not accept the substandard apartment they had shownus. We were told to send an email request and we would be refunded within 48 hours of the receipt of the email - we sent the email within 3 hours. The money we paid for this place was equivalent to a four star hotel (we know this because that's where we ended up after leaving Landmark Apartments). What we were shown was absolutely appalling for the money. That was at the end of May - after many phone calls by us and Hotels.com through which we made our booking, the people at this establishment have made claims that we walked out without saying anything, that we were told there would be no refund, they have hung up on us and Hotels.com, they have promised action and done nothing. On closer perusal of reviews of their establishment, it appears that most of the good reports are by reviewers who have submitted only one review. I have drawn my own conclusions from that. At this date, we are filing a claim in the County Court to recover the large sum of money owed and my strong advice to anyone reading reviews on this property is to look carefully at the credibility of the reviewer - take note of those contributors who review regularly - you will find that the majority of trustworthy reviewers are telling you the same thing - this is a dodgy establishment and unless you like gambling with your holiday money, book anywhere else.

title: Dirty
text: I stayed in this hotel on business trip. The place has not been cleaned properly. There were the accumulations of dust on the floor and this is not the first thing you would like to notice when you come to a place.

title: Booking cancelled 2 days before - Do not book here!!!
text: Booked and paid for a double room back in November via Hotels.com for a two day stay for the weekend to watch the foo fighters (who were amazing btw ) when 2 days before the stay we were advised by email that the room has been cancelled due to problems with the boiler(the same problem that has been going on for months as reviews show that other people's bookings were cancelled due to this in March !!!) .. Do you know how hard it is to book affordable accommodation in London within 2 days .. thankfully with no help from hotel.com or the landmark apartments we managed to acquire some very avg accomodtion and the weekend was saved . WE currently have not received a refund and no real confirmation of when or if it will arrive I am now contacting the omnisman to seek compensation and to ensure they stop accepting bookings on all websites .. We have also checked that it seems landmark apartments are now millennium apartments charging over £200 a room a night (hence why our room was cancelled .... allegedly)

title: Cancelled my booking at Checkin!
text: Literally got a text at 2:00PM on the day I was supposed to checkin! Flew in from Paris and had no place to stay! Horrible! They have no assistance in trying to find me a new property. Thank goodness I was able to find a great place in Kings Cross a few hours later while my family and I sat in a bistro with our luggage.

title: Great location, nice and clean!
text: We stayed here since Friday with our grandkid, checking out today. We had family room. The room was lovely, clean, modern and had everything we needed, the bed was comfortable. Great location, close to tube and lots of little shops and pubs. It was so lovely and welcoming, from the minute we arrived to the minute we left. The staff have been very friendly and helpful and always had a smile! Would absolutely book here again. Thanks you for a lovely stay!

title: incredible bad bog. they charged me for keeping my luggage 20 GBP
text: not recommended for business travelers. When arriving at the hotel, it was not yet time to check in, I asked them to keep the luggage because I had to go do some visits. they only agreed to keep my luggage upon payment of GBP 20. DO NOT RECOMMEND ANYONE, NEVER AGAIN will visit this bog. Room very small and not confortable. do not expect any service.

title: Suited us perfectly!
text: Used these apartments to stay at for a company event and was not disappointed! I came with 2 other groups, one of 7 and one of 4 so split across 4 family rooms, 1 double and 1 executive double. The hotel is in a great location easy to get to from London Waterloo and a short taxi from St. Paul's. We had dinner at the restaurant below which was excellent, they had a really good offer for a burger and wine or beer for £10 but also had things like crab and grills available too. The hotel rooms are a really clever use of space, using attic type spaces as a second floor, granted one of the family rooms we couldn't work out how you could get safely to one of the beds but the rest were perfect if you like cosy spaces. The beds were extremely comfortable and all the rooms were clean and well presented. Lots of TVs in all the rooms, if your after a hairdryer if your not in an executive or a deluxe family take your own as the travel ones in those rooms are rubbish. Also the aircon in the executive room made so much noise it had to be turned off but other than that it was fine. Lots of food places and some good bars around the area (not open on a Sunday night though)! All in all I would definitely use these apartments again as were amazing value for money especially travelling in a big group that would usually cost a fortune at a normal London hotel.

title: They cancelled booking last minute
text: Didnt get chance to stay as they cancelled our booking last minute due to fitting boiler and redecorating area around it, this was done by text didnt have decency to call me. Due to stay 22.23 june 18. Told us to contact expedia to re book accommodation elsewhere we booked through hotels.com. still not had refund. When originally booked they took payment twice and I never got my refund back for 3 months and I had to claim this back through my bank. Sent emails text and called and no reply. Spoke to someone and they said they would call me back still nothing. They may get back to me now i have put this on here.

title: If the room was slightly bigger and the Wi-fi was a bit quicker, it would be the most ideal place to stay in London!
text: This hotel had very good customer service straight away, very easy to find and there was no problems pre-entering room. I was given room 1B which was the nearest one to reception. In terms of space, if I wanted to get changed I'd be in the kitchen. The double bed takes up the whole room which just enough space for the door to open and close. It is definitely a room for one person! If my girlfriend came along, i'd have claustrophobia and I don't have even have problems suffering that. Location very very good - couldn't get any better. Very close to a tube stations as well as bars, restaurants and local amenities within walking distances. Would come again if I was by myself and on business - if on leisure or with someone else, I'd have to get a bigger room or look elsewhere. All in all - more positive than negative!

title: Bad management
text: Look at the previous reviews this place is run by some ridiculous people! Our party of 4 arrived at 6pm for our room, we had even informed them we would be arriving 4-5 hours AFTER check in time. The receptionist informed us our room wasnt ready (which is ridiculous because we had already arrived so late after check in, and we had also informed them what time we were arriving) and offered us 2x double rooms, or a deluxe room for 4 for which we would have to pay additional for. We didnt want the 2x dbl rooms because we had booked to be together and the sleeping arrangements werent right. The receptionist tried to make out that the dbl bedrooms were way better than what we had booked and bigger aswell, and that they would be doing us a favour by giving us 2x dbls. I rejected this, so she took us to a deluxe room for 4 of us together which we would have to pay more for, or wait another hour for our room. At this point I was like what the hell because we had already told them when we were arriving and our room should be ready, and that they had the cheek to tell us to pay more for us to get a room together. Even worse if we wanted to wait we had to leave and come back because they dont have anywhere for us to wait, not even in one of the spare rooms. This was a stupid situation and I wasnt giving in to these silly suggestions and was adamant we either got our room or give us the deluxe room (which wasnt that deluxe anyways) without paying extra as it is their fault that it was like this. The receptionist was stuck and saw I wasnt giving in and went away made a call and gave us a different room for us which was similar to the one we booked anyways so in the end they did have our room but were trying to get us to take these empty dbls beds. So all of that for nothing. IF you end up going here dont give in to this from them as it seems to have happened before to previous guests. The room was good, clean. Space wasnt great but had what we needed. It was noisy though and I woke up a few time from that. to summaries- dont listen to them if they want to move you to a different room theyre talking nonsense. Management is ridiculous.

title: Great location and nice room
text: Our room wasn't big but it was enough for two persons. A great kitchen with everything you need and new equipment.The service was good and the location was good as well, east London has a lot to offer in food, shopping and culture.

title: Was a decent size and very nice staff.
text: Don’t know about all the negative reviews. My room was perfect and my daughter was even able to sleep comfortably upstairs. The kitchen was small but functional and met our needs. Because the pubs are so close it was noisy at night until 1am, however it is no fault of the hotels. Really close to the Underground. Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Showing upstairs bed and Kitchen.

title: Scam! Now called Millennium Apartments
text: We booked rooms here for our stay in January 2018. We arrived to check in for our stay in June 2018 and were told that the business had been sold and we should have already been refunded our money and notified by email. We have never received an email and never received a refund. Standing at their check in counter I even checked my card statements online and no refund was ever issued. Their solution was to charge us again for our rooms, and suggest we report the January charge as a fraudulent charge. We declined and paid a fortune to stay at a name brand hotel elsewhere in the city. I’ve traveled extensively in Central America and have never ran into something like this!

title: Dont see the problem!
text: Well after reading the other reviews its safe i was terrified about staying here.... Couple of days trip away with my Mum, Auntie and Granny who i knew would not be impressed if all these reviews were the case. However we arrived slightly early and for a £10 charge got checked into the room as it was ready. With baited breath we headed up the stairs, which is quite a thin, steep staircase. The guy at reception showed us around the room and we took a sigh of relief... although it was quirky, it was clean and had all the facilities we needed. Shower gel and shampoo provided along with clean towels and all the things we needed in the kitchen, which was basically mugs for the morning and wine glasses for the evening. For all the time we spent in the apartment as were always out and about, it was exactly what we needed. High table with four chairs to chill and talk around in the late evenings and then off to bed, which i need need to climb over the beams to get to my bed, which i more found funny than anything else but probably not ideal for an older crowd. Upstairs there were three beds and air conditioning which we did use. The street noise you could hear but when the clock struck one it went peaceful very quickly. So many places to eat and drink right at your doorstep and a two minute walk from the underground. Was ideal for us and exactly what we needed. Would 100% go back and stay again.

title: Lovely rooms and fabulous service
text: I booked a room at this hotel for our trip to London. I booked a family apartment via Expedia for 7 nights. We wanted something in Shoreditch and Landmark Apartment seemed to be the best deal in the area. Well, I have made a great choice. Our trip to London was wonderful indeed. There is lots to do in this fashionable area of London and the hotel was simply great. We had a generously sized room with a full kitchen and comfy beds. The service there is very good. We have experience no problems at all at check in or check out or during the stay. Whenever we needed something we would simply ask the lovely reception staff there who were always ready to help. I am thankful to the staff for the service delivered and would love to stay at this hotel again.

title: Basics missing
text: Stayed one night visiting London Studio apartment it was tiny! Just about fitted the bed in. Some basic things were not there such as bathroom soap! (If you are staying for one night you don't expect to buy hand soap!) other things included no tea towels and also more annoying no toaster there was a grill pan but no handle for the pan! For £125 I expected just a little more, Sham as location is good by other than I would probably go for the Holliday express just around the corner!

title: Terrible Experience With Staff. Don't Book!
text: I can barely begin to explain how annoyed I am with this, apparently "four star hotel." I got a phone call on the morning of the day I was supposed to be staying at this hotel and was told my booking was cancelled. Apparently there was an issue with the boiler, but the more questions I asked about it, the more angry the person on the phone seemed to get with me! They apparently booked us a new room in a different hotel, but when we looked it up, not only did it look really seedy and disappointing, it was over an hour away from Landmark Apartments! I called the reception to discuss this, but was told that I would get a call back in ten minutes. I didn't. I got some texts from the number that called me, so I texted back asking them to find us a hotel in the area. They replied: "Ok, as we tried out best to help you, and you didn't accept it, you can arrange your accommodation by yourself." I found this incredibly rude and annoying. The number claimed to be the manager of the hotel, which is frankly disgusting. I tried to call the reception again but didn't get through until 18:30 that evening! Obviously, mistakes happen, accidents happen and sometimes you can't accommodate as many guests as you thought. But that doesn't excuse the rudeness of the apparent "manager" and the lack of response from the hotel. Luckily we were able to find a last minute hotel in the area, but if we didn't we would have had nowhere to stay. Since I booked with this hotel they should have helped us find alternative accommodation. I'm a little glad we didn't stay in this hotel if this is the way the staff behaves! I don't know who gave them "four stars" but it's clearly a lie. Avoid at all costs.

title: I booked with pleasure!
text: after seeing the strange reviews I still decided to book here as my work dinner event was round the corner. actually found this place decent, most importantly clean and friend staff who explained me much about the area. after all this place is based in the central part of London which isn't green grass scenery but lots of entertaining bars, restaurant, so a mice on the street wouldn't be a surprise to me, as long as its not sleeping in my bed. its a shame to get false reviews from such a building and modern designed house who keep it clean as much as possible. Im a man of my own and believe reviews are not always the best way unless you trust you instincts. anyhow I enjoyed my stay and would be coming back to you with great joy in the near future.

title: Linda
text: Stayed here for 2 nights while visiting London. Easily accessible by tube. Very clean, very comfy beds. All facilities excellent & loved the fact we could do our own thing & not be tied to breakfast meal times. Would definitely stay again, very reasonable prices.

title: Rooms don't look like the pictures. Avoid.
text: You definitely get what you pay for here. The rate may be cheap but this was one of the strangest hotels I've stayed in. The pictures from their web site make the rooms look really good but they are a step up from a dorm room. I arrived at 8am and they told me the room was ready but if I wanted to check in I would have to pay an extra fee which wasn't cheap. I've never had that happen to me at a hotel before. The hallways are entirely tiles and there was always garbage bags just outside the hotel entrance. Spend a little bit extra and stay somewhere else.

title: What a dump
text: It was actually quite funny when I told my friends there were mouse traps in my room. Then I thought, Jesus, really. What a dump, the room was smelly, the lighting was terrible. Will never stay again!

title: Awful, do not book here!!!
text: Please don't book here, what you see on their website is a room just to entice people into booking at Landmark Apartments. DON'T BE FOOLED! I travelled with friends to London for 2 days. We had booked an executive room and we were given a family room whose "living room" was the size of a one seat sofa. The "bedroom" looked like a child's attic with two normal beds and one fold-out bed. Completely different from what is advertised and a complete rip off. Appalling customer service as well. To finish things off, on the day of check out we asked if we could leave our bags in reception for a couple of hours. The receptionist said we would have to pay 20 pounds to leave them. Suffice to say we didn't leave our bags and left Landmark in a very bad mood.

title: Would definitely stay again
text: We had a family 30th in London and stayed here for just 1 night.
