When we arrived we was shocked by the size of reception (like a shoebox), the young lady who checked us in was prepared for guests arriving. Very polite and friendly, checked in very quickly, took us to our room and showed us everything we needed to know and left us to settle in. The room was small but big enough for a couple. The kitchen was in full working order and the shower was decent. (May struggle for room in the shower if you are bigger than a uk woman’s size 16). We arrived back to our room at approx midnight and was awoken around 2am by people leaving bars and restaurants on this street as it’s a very lively street over a weekend. Also woken at 6am by bin lorries collecting the bars and restaurant bins. These are 2 things the hotel cannot change. Spittle field market is approx 15 minute walk from here too and definitely worth a visit. Would recommend staying here. Gave a 5 star but the cleanliness could have been better and there is cracks in tiles etc but we were comfortable.

title: business&pleasure
text: As well as having my business dinner meeting at the Rivington Bar and grill these beautifully decorated apartments was located above the famous restaurant. We checked in after our dinner around 9pm and a polite lady at the reception checked us in quite swiftly to our room. The most important part for us was the cleanliness and big large windows that we can open for fresh air. Even though we had no view to anything spectacular , we understand we are located in shoreditch one of the most trendiest part of London where it is in a new business hub of London silicon valley. good stay!

title: Weekend blast in Shoreditch!
text: I stayed for 3 nights in Landmark Apartments. V.clean , bright and spacious. I came with a group of friends to have a long weekend stay. It was worth our while as we had a full kitchen and Salisbury super store was just 30 seconds away from the building. The staff were lovely and very helpful. Lots of bar clubs and restaurants all walking distance. The bar& restaurant on the ground floor serve nice breakfast. We noticed that 123 cab service was right next door which was much cheaper that a black taxi! good value for money, look forward to stay here again for the future.

title: In the heart of Hoxton
text: I stayed here for about 6 weeks, I always stayed in an executive room, they have everything that you could want a dinning area, a kitchenette fully equipped even down to a washing machine, washing up liquid provided all cutlery pots pans cups glasses plates etc, the beds are mostly king or queen sized and very comfortable, the bathroom usually have a large shower cubicle towels provided also shampoo & shower gel provided. Very good value for money, some of the rooms are noisier than others especially those on Rivington Street. situated in Shorditch a couple of minuets walk from Old Street Tube Station a few hundred yards from Hoxton Square everything on the door step.

title: Good price in the heart of the city...
text: Very close to all the bars and Restaurants of Shoreditch and to Old St tube station. We had the Executive apartment for four nights and loved it. It's not big but the full kitchen with washing machine was very handy. The young girls on reception were always helpful and had a nice smile. Wifi works well too! I would definitely stay here again.

title: Good location, comfortable rooms, good price.
text: Landmark Apartments' location is very good. It is close to underground station and there are lots of small charming streets nearby. We were tourists and had a really good stay at Landmark. There are lots of nice restaurants very close to the hotel, nice clubs and bars as well. The personnel working there are helpful. Rooms are very clean and comfortable for the price we paid. We would happily come back to Landmark again when we come to London.

title: Great for a group of mates!
text: Four mates on a short break in London, requirements were simple, a place to shower & sleep. Needless to say our requirements were exceeded, plenty of amenities, spotlessly clean and attentive staff (they even gave us a courtesy call to confirm all was well as we were slightly late for our estimated check in time due to traffic)

title: Best Luxury Apartment Hotel In London
text: Nice, clean, Quiet, spacious room, the kitchen is fully equipped, perfect location and the staff are friendly and helpful.The apartment was perfect in every way. The hotel is located near the famous place London Bridge, Tower of London and St. Paul's Cathedral. I am really impressed by this hotel. I will come back again.

title: Nearly a land mark
text: Good value and good location. Room was a decent size and simply furnished. Not as plush as the websites photos - but served its purpose. En suite and shower were good. In the heart of Shoreditch with lots of pubs and restaurants nearby.

title: Fantastic stay at Landmark....
text: A lovely hotel with lots of character. The staff is very friendly and provide excellent service. Our first trip to the hotel and but not the last one. We stayed in superior room. The room was cosy and very comfortable.I will definitely recommend to my friends and family.

title: Ok apart from flaws
text: Found that I couldn't get the AC to work, but reception shuts at 9pm so tough luck. One of the windows was stuck wide open so I got fresh air but all the street noise. Then discovered door lock broken so couldn't lock the door while I slept. Again if it's after 9pm tough luck. Apartment fine otherwise but a shame you're on your own after 9pm. Bring a small wrench, be prepared.

title: Lovely staff and the location wonderful
text: Comfortable apartment and the staff is brillant. Room was spacious and well laid out.Very clean and tidy room with every thing you would need for a stay and would definitely stay again. A good location and very good for exploring..

title: Very plesanty suprised
text: Room very comfortable and modern. Bathroom had just a shower but was very clean and tidy. I choose this hotel because its close to the Liverpool St. Station where I had to get a very early train. While its not a bad walk from the hotel to the train station, in the early AM you will ned the taxi. Internet worked very well. Plenty of free coffee and tea in the room and nice and big kitchen to have breakfast before leaving.

title: Lots of issues, good location
text: I liked the idea of booking this apartment, I got a good deal. Was close to the tube station and local shops like sainsburys and co-op, also a subway round the corner. On arrival I was told we needed i.d none of my booking emails has said this, so after 5 minutes with receptionists that didn't fully understand what I was saying I was told I had to pay for my room again and get a refund on my initial booking, reluctantly I agreed and paid and asked for my refund to be told that couldn't be done now but the manager would be in in the morning. We was shown to our room, the pictures look great our room wasn't that great to be honest. You could only just walk past the bed to get to the kitchen, only space for one person to sit and eat food, massive half inch + gaps under front door so was very noisy. Bathroom was tiny knees pretty much touched wall, and shower was very high, I struggled to step up into it. Good points - toiletries and kitchen stuff I.e. Wash up liquid provided, great to have a DVD player, quick check out, good pressure and heat in the shower, good location. The next morning the manager still wasn't in and continued to row about getting money back - was then promised an email that I never received, did finally get my refund but they have ignored all my emails. I think if we didn't have all the issues it would have been a much more enjoyable stay, would just love the door to be sorted to block out some noise. I think it would be ideal for a single traveller on work or tourists who will only be there of an evening.

title: what a great find!
text: What a great find. Frequently stay over in London and usually rely on lastminute to find me a hotel but this time it took me to the Landmark Apartments just off Great Eastern Street. Exactly what we wanted: fantastic value for a Friday night

title: Poor apartment, great location
text: I stayed in this apartment with my friends. The hotel is in a great location- near old st station, near bars and shops but the apartment itself is very basic and poor. The room is a decent size but the mattress is so old, we had such uncomfortable sleep, the floors are so creaky with floor boards loose and dangerous. The walls are so thin, you can hear the people in the other room so clearly. And it’s so noisy from outside. To make everything worse, horrible smell from the drains. Would not recommend this apartment if you are looking for comfortable and quiet sleep.

title: Weekend away
text: Staying for two night at the landmark apartments was okay. We thought we would get a room as pictured but it was small and no seating area. Kitchen was not suitable for cooking as small so eating out is a must. Tv only had a couple of channels but the WiFi was fast. The area is great for bars and restaurants and close to the city. Interesting sewage smell outside the room. We could hear the water flushing from other apartments while in bed but the bed was comfortable and pillows great. Staff friendly but we didn’t need them. Overall typical London apartment and not expensive but probably would not come again and won’t be recommending unless on a business trip or working.

title: Great Hotel in a great location
text: We stayed in a cosy room by choice. Granted its "cosy". The bathroom is great with a stand - alone shower which i prefer anyway . There was plenty of room here. There`s a safe tea/ coffee making facilities, full length mirror in the wardrobe space. A huge telly with all the usual stations is also a bonus. Being a cosy room, we didn`t have breakfast in the hotel but did eat in the restaurant one night. The food here was great, great cocktails and great desserts. I`d highly recommend eating there. We didn`t have a drink in the bar either but it look like a nice spot. The hotel is in a great location with loads of good restaurants and breakfast spots to choose from both Barbican and Farringdon tube stations are a short walk away in either direction from the Hotel. We loved our stay here and would definitely stay again.

title: Very noisy, but nice staff.
text: Have stayed here twice so far, both times in an executive room (was upgraded for two nights to a family room, which has two beds in). Firstly the good stuff - nice team here, polite and friendly. Prices are reasonable given that you get a kitchen, living room and as I'm staying here on business it means I could save money by eating in. Location was great for me. The bad side: it's very noisy here. Single glazing means you get a lot of noise from the street. The first time I stayed here the kitchen window wouldn't close properly. The second time I stayed here the room I was in had almost constant music coming from either downstairs or next door - this went on late in to the night, and a door (not sure if part of the property or not) would slam every ten to fifteen minutes and the apartment would shake. This isn't a place to stay if you want a good nights sleep or to relax

title: Mixed but the truth is!
text: Me and my now fiancé :) have stayed here in the past before and honestly never come across anything bad except not enough towels in the room but you tell reception staff on time and they deliver your request immediately with any extra cost. Not only to mention the Bed the finish of kitchen and cleanliness is absolutely up to standard and it’s a pleasure to stay in the heart of Shoreditch! To us it’s clear that to find such an apartment with this size in this area is not possible but everyone has their own opinions. Mix reviews like this is ludicrous! Anyway we look forward to our next visit again when we are officially married we will book a nice restaurant in the area and stay again. Thank u also to the friendly staff who made us feel homely.

title: avoid like the plaque
text: advertised as a apartment there were four of us I expected this to be bigger no sleep noisy people coming back from clubs, people outside shouting booked as double beds with two singles my other son ended up with a camp bed false advertising as it stated in our print out two single beds pipe going threw where my sons were sleeping the pics you see on there website are very misleading due to the fact that these pics are apartments that they don't advertise on website only rented out to longer term clients and these ones are bigger rude receptionist not nice people at all having to go threw booking agent to get money back shut reception at eight never got told about there emergency number which was stuck on another wall outside how the hell can you see that if your not told in the first place I would not recommend anyone stay here terrible place

title: Very small and very noisy
text: I book apartments for business trips as they generally have more space and the kitchen is useful to save eating out every night. The first "executive" apartment I was shown brought on an attack of claustrophobia. The receptionist cheerfully moved me but apart from windows (not present in the first) it was little better. There was no drawer space for clothes and only a half height open hanging rail, next to the fridge and three feet from the cooker. Cooking would have meant smelly clothes for business meetings. The noise from outside went on longer into the night/morning than I would have expected but I did expect it. What I did not expect was to have to turn off not only the air conditioning at night, but also the boiler and the fridge, to have any chance of sleep. The shower room was tiny but did, unlike the main room, have plenty of storage. It's a great area for bars and restaurants (just as well) but I'll give these apartments a miss next time.

title: Great amenities and staff, location ideal for the night enthusiasts
text: In an up and coming part of the east end, lots of local eateries and bars close by (it can be noisy at night). We were there to see the sights of London, so it was convenient to the Old Street underground stop (5 minute walk). The apartment was small, it's Europe, but had wonderful staff that checked us in late, carried our bags, and overall incredibly helpful.

title: Fantastic & value for money.
text: The Rooms & bathrooms were very good. It's surely value for money. The staff was very professional. I am surely going back again as this was my 1st great experience & I visit London regularly . The Resteraunt on the ground floor is very nice & delicious . I liked Chunky Fish & Chips . I stayed for a short time & they upgraded me which was very nice of them . I promised them that I shall be back & will surely do that . I can compare the Apartments to High End Apartments in Mayfair where I pay double the amount .

title: Terrible service and overbooked hotel
text: Booked a room on this apartment hotel due to the good location. When we wanted to check in the front desk personell asked us to wait for 4 hours and said the room had to be cleaned first. Ok, a hazzle but no big problem. After waiting for almost a whole day they eventually canceled our reservation due to a problem with the room. The exact same story as described under. I assume they overbooked the hotel and thats the real "problem" with the room. Stay away from this unproffesional place and your stay in London will start with no problem!

title: Awful Apartments - Fake photos - scam
text: My partner and I had chosen this apt for a night away in London. The apartment was dirty with stains on the floor, it looked like an old persons care home. The photos on the internet are not a true reflection of the place. We decided it wasnt for us, so we had the expense of booking another room which we got cheaper and was clean and modern. The receptionist offered a full refund, however couldnt complete it on the day as it wqs the head offices job! I have sent 3 emails to the head office as i was told to, to get my refund, but heard nothing. Im calling the number provided on a day to day basis only, the person who answers the landline number says you need to call the office, which is a mobile telephone, with which the mailbox is full. So no joy. Reading the other reviews on here about peoples same experience doesnt surprise me. I advise to stay clear, and dont get ripped off

title: Amazing stay
text: Nice hospitality, by the staff, the apartment was fantastic. I always stay in Landmark Apartments, when I travel to London for business. Close to the tube and my office which is great. They have always been able to accommodate my early chekin.

title: My Favourite Location!
text: This is not the first time I have been in this area, in fact the reason why we do end up staying here is because this area has so much entertainment with lots of bars and restaurants. Cool classy people with good sense of dressing. These apartments are well equipped with a full kitchen and big windows. big firm beds and nice size for the value. Just remember to book on time as they seem to be full all the time. Will be back again in the near future.

title: Surprised by negative reviews
text: Double bed with clean bedding. Iron and ironing board, hair dryer. Hanging space and drawers for clothes. Table with two chairs. TV and DVD player with remotes. Kitchenette - fridge, hob, microwave, cutlery and crockery. Clean shower room. Clean towels. Reception staff were fine. OK, a small space - not much room by the sink for washing up, but I managed. I was not disturbed by noise from the street.

title: Room with a mouse
text: My family and I stayed at this hotel for 8 nights (summer 2017). The room was dirty when we got there as if the checkout cleaning of the previous tenant had not been done: food bites in the kitchen sink, hair in the shower, etc. The pictures on the website were taken years ago. The rooms do not look this way anymore. The service from the desk clerk was awful. When informed that we had a mouse in our room, he said he knew!!! But he did not believe that the mouse had come in underneath the main door as he said it had to come in through the kitchen pipes, as it usually does.... we asked for mice traps. They said they had installed one in the kitchen while we were gone for the day but the one we saw was dusty and had been there for a while. We were lied to a few times. We asked for extra room cleaning and they said it had been done when it hadn't. We had to take the clerk to our room to show him. He gave us a phone number saying this is how we could reach the manager but it was in fact the number of the hotel. Nobody ever answered this number when we tried. Awful place. Would not recommend it at all. Walls are paper thin. The reception opening hours vary from one day to the next...can't trust you get any service. The safe was broken in our room. The shower stunk because of piping. Major lack of maintenance.

title: Horror Hotel - Stay Away
text: This is a scam to put it mildly. I paid for late check in and was assured my guests would be able to get in when they arrive late from the airport. They called the hotel's 24 hour phone line repeatedly and there was no answer. When they arrived there was no answer at the reception and nobody there to let them in. They were stuck in the street overnight. When I enquired about this and asked for a refund I encountered hostility (e.g. manager named Sonya and other top management who I spoke with) and to date my payment has not been refunded. This hotel is operated by a strange and unprofessional group of people and I would never try to use it again - to say the least!

title: Too loud to sleep
text: The straff was friendly but the room was a bit filthy and very small. It was also very loud outside at night so it was never a silent moment, which is a problem when you are trying to sleep. At least it was near the tube!

title: Extreme air freshener
text: Brilliant location. Someone else has described the area as "grubby chic" which is spot on. The room was fine, clean and equipped as you would expect although not very spacious. It was noisy during the night - not the hotel's fault - just something to be aware of in this part of town. My big problem was the overwhelming use of air fresheners.

title: Beautiful Hotel
text: I stayed with my family in this hotel. All the facilities are excellent. There were beautiful art work on the walls which makes the room very nice. Kitchen was comfortable. We had breakfast every day before going for the trip around London. The staff is very polite and helpful. I hired the car from the hotel for the day with driver for just £65 a day. I will definitely come back to this hotel when I visit again for holidays.

title: Don't believe the photos
text: Stayed for one night in a studio and a family room. I expected the studio to be tiny. Our family apartment for 4 was a joke - we squeezed in to a 'sitting area' which was a wooden bar affixed to the wall with 4 plastic chairs. There was a solitary armchair, and only two mugs. The bathroom was smaller than many cupboards and there was a dangerous 2 foot drop as you got out of the shower. The fit out is cheap and tatty and the overwhelming smell of air freshener which is pumped through the air con makes it either hard to breath ( and I expect possibly harmful) or hot and stuffy. It was worrying - what is it masking? We only had one night and luckily on used the apartment as a place to sleep, they are cheap but you get what you pay for. Book a hotel instead!

title: Terrible experience!
text: I would give -100 rating if I could. It was a disaster since the beginning as I had a booking with Mounts Apartments and was told that they had a leak in the room yesterday and the repair took longer than expected bla bla bla. I asked them why I had not been informed through phone or email in the morning and the staff went silent. The whole explanation on leak, etc seemed to be very well rehearsed and I was, then, asked to go to Landmark Apartments which they had booked me into. On arrival, I found out the studio room they (Landmark) had was very small, just enough space for one person and I had another friend with me. I was offered an upgrade to executive room at an "extra" cost. At this point, the negotiation was actually between me and the same guy who run Mounts Apartments and somehow had the power to influence the Landmark staff decision. He claimed that he was only there to ensure his guests from Mounts were well taken care of but the ease which he knocked down the "extra" cost from £15 to £10 bothered me. I took their offer for upgrade and stayed for 3 nights. On the final day, a different staff knocked on my door and said that I was late for check-out and liable to pay £30/hour charge (?!) which I was not informed when checking in. She claimed she had consulted with her supervisor and agreed to just charge £15. The staff was really rude when I asked why I wasn't told about this earlier, to which she remarked, "I am not going to argue on £15 with you and if you don't want to pay, leave". It is not about the amount of money that I have to pay but their principle of doing business. I'll definitely not going back to stay with them again. I booked my stay with Agoda and I was charged a £20 admin fee/night on top of the £55/night rate they already charging for the stay. I could have stayed in a decent hotel like Holiday Inn for that price.

title: Nothing like the website or Expedia suggests
text: Very disappointed with quality of these apartments and nothing like photos. Virtually no reception or staff on site and despite requests a month ago still waiting for receipt for stay. Apartment charged an extra £10 for checking in 30 mins before agreed check in time. TV didn't work but no staff around to resolve. If you literally need a bed for a few hours - it is just about fine, but nothing more.

title: Great location
text: I stayed in one of the single apartments for just one night. The apartment was nice, like a dorm room, basic, clean with a decent kitchenette and bathroom. The staff were friendly on arrival and helpful. The location is great, 5 minutes from hoxton and shoreditch with all their bars and restaurants. The street below is a little loud at 4 am but perhaps that was my bad luck and partly to be expected given the location. Would suit a couple staying a little while in London given the price and cooking facilities.

title: Worst accommodation ever!
text: I cannot simply put into words how disgusting this apartment is. Filthy, and not cleaned by any standards. We had to ask for replacement sheets as the bed linen had hair and chunks of skin on it, underneath I was disgusted by the stained and rancid mattresses which they have not bothered to place a protector on. The bath mat was filthy in which we hadn't touched. And the toilet had not been cleaned. See photos attached. Disgusting accommodation by every account. I've stayed in backpackers better than this!

title: fantastic stay
text: This trip with the family was wonderful. We called them for a taxi from the airport and they was kind to send us with a welcome board on arrival. Booked 2 family apartments and it was exactly what we expected. Nice and clean, mordern look with newly refurbished toilets. Our room was next door to each other which was perfect. Bed linen spotless and good large windows for good breeze. The area was interesting and unique to what we normally stay in. very close to the town centre and easy access to busses and trains. thank you for a pleasent stay and we all look forward to coming back.

title: Nice City break
text: Nice hotel in a good location for what we wanted. Furniture is good but could be better but room very clean. A lot of night life around the hotel. Bar and restaurants open on a Sunday and the bar next door open on even Sunday great. So even on Sunday plenty of places to have a drink. But overall very good experience with the hotel. Good staff.

title: £10 per bag to store luggage for the day
text: That's got to be a 1st!! Stayed last weekend. The apartment was clean, tidy and the beds were comfortable. The lay out was totally bizarre! We had no living space at all (mainly beds, stairs, a decent galley kitchen just nowhere to sit and the tv in the most random place). We wanted an area to have a social drink and chat while we got ready. As we were 4 girls on a weekend away. There were 4 beds in the a loft space with steep steps to get up there (dangerous in the middle of the night) but not nearly as dangerous as the 8 inch high ceiling beams that we had to climb over in order to get to the beds which were just squashed up in a mezzanine loft space without any thought for design or layout. Just cram the beds in style. Location for market, bars and nightlife absolutely fantastic. Checkout was 11am on the dot! The least impressive thing about the entire experience was that they charged £10 to store 'each' bag for the day while we went round London. In all of my years travelling this is a first and I must admit I thought it was daylight robbery given how much we had paid to rent the apartment for the evening. I would not recommend this place neither would I stay there again. Do yourself a favor and shop around a bit more. There are good reviews in here so we must have got a duff room. Just check before booking. I hope this is useful? I wish I had known before I went.

title: Just not right!
text: We booked through hotels.com and the pictures looked really impressive, together with the price per night at above 200 pounds on average, one would think this is a nice place! Nothing about that impression was correct!! Its small and tiny rooms, hardly any room to even place the bags, loud at night times, not even a proper window in the room that could be opened- curtains were broken. The standard seems off in London anyway but this was a poor experience.

title: Can't describe my satisfaction with my stay !
text: Worth every penny we have paid. Stayed here for a weekend with my friends. Customer service was exceptional, from the time of check in by check out.our towels were chanced daily.cleaninigness was spot on.definately will be staying again !!!!

title: Fabulous place
text: This hotel was a great discovery for us. We found and booked it via Agoda and it turned out to be a perfect choice. Our beautiful room was cleaned daily by a very polite and professional maid, we were well looked after by the reception staff as well. The quality of the room in comparison with the price we paid for it was high and of course the area is superb with best bars and restaurants in the city. I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel in the light of all of the above.

title: fantastic stay
text: We arrived pretty late but there was someone waiting for us at the reception for our late check in. We booked a family apartment, just as it was advertised, with its own kitchen and single beds as we requested. The place is clean with maid service included everyday. The wifi was free which was great as the kids use the internet continuously. The area was fantastic with loads to explore and many restaurants in the area. We asked at the reception for extra linen and hairdryers and it was left in our room quite promptly. excellent service and friendly staff. We have more family visiting for the near future and will be back very soon to the same place.

title: Compact apartment, good location
text: Stayed here recently whilst attending a business event at the Barbican a short walk away. Room was very compact and pics were a little misleading but not a real issue. Staff were fairly helpful and friendly - tend to stick to the check in times rigidly even though there was a room available when I arrived. I could have had it but required £20 surcharge - not best practice in my experience It was fine for my needs and would maybe consider using again.

title: Great place
text: Great place to stay. The apartment is well located in a nice area "Shoreditch", daily cleaning service and well equipped. Easy access to everything. Close to a metro station and and bus stops. Excellent restaurants, cafes, pubs and clubs in the area. Managment staff was always available and very professional. I strongly recomend this place to stay and I will return to without any hesitation.

title: Best night life in city centre of London!
text: We booked this hotel apartment purely to Relax and go to the recommended bars in the area seen on Times Out Magazine. Our importance was to have decent size rooms, immaculately clean and good bedding which was all delivered on arrival. We arrived pretty late and was warned before hand that the reception would not be open all night for the check in and a late check in fee would accour - but as thoughtful and accommodating the staff was we did not pay and had a swift check in. Really enjoyed every bit of our stay and this hotel deserves a thumbs up.

title: A good idea, not very well executed
text: First thing to say is that if you cannot manage steps, this is not the place for you. I had to change my room because the shower was really dirty - I will spare you the details! It is noisy as well - garbage collection at 0300! So not my first choice for my next night in London

title: Ideal Location - That's something.
text: We stayed here for 6 nights in April/ May. Room was smaller than expected, but that's ok. After 2 weeks travelling around France, we looked forward to having a washing machine - but there was no drier. So off to Tesco to buy some string and then room turned into a laundry with clothes everywhere trying to dry. Bed was low, but comfortable enough, not great for older people (or those with sore knees). WiFi was also sporadic. The windows did open though, which was nice to get fresh air in the room. But the location was great.

title: Small odd shaped room in poor decorative order
text: Stayed for four nights and would not recommend it. The room was hideous but the kitchen area, up a few stairs was new. Three random plates and a few mismatched glasses. Bathroom small but adequate. Small double bed with cheap bedding and extremely soft mattress. Net curtains with view of walls covered In very noisy aircon units and extractor fans so a constant humming in the room. No bedside lights, told this would be fixed ~ next week~. 30 p!us spotlights in ceiling and had to get out of bed to turn lights off! Walls in sleeping area tiled and artexed, a bit disconcerting. Right in the heart of shoreditch so really good location .

title: great for the price
text: in the heart of shoreditch, ( which is much more interesting than soho these days) handy for the city and old street, good position, basic, clean hotel, ( funny smell in the lobby) a good deal, i would stay here again, very good postion. the safe didn't work, which was no big deal

title: Good Trip
text: Myself and my wife love the City live enjoyment and love entertaining friends and family in London so we decided to choose Shoreditch as part of our weekend stay. Surprisingly found a decent apartment hotel in the heart of London where we invited friends to reunite in these wonderful apartments. v. polite friendly staff and cleaners on site at your service. We booked the family suite with comfy queen size bed and had another dbl bed upstairs which was great and ideal for us for friends to stay. They don't serve breakfast but the kitchen was fully equipped and Sainsbury 30sec walk away for food shopping. v convenient place.

title: Hours of waiting
text: We came over for one night only. We showed up at checkin-time, but was asked to come back one hour later because the room was not ready. After one hour we got the same message. And the same happend two hours later. Finaly they admitted that it was not cleaning we waited for, but a short circuits-problem. Now hours was wasted waiting for the room, and we had to move to a completly different district. When entering this "hotel" we had to climb 2-3 floors, in really narrow aisles, to the worlds smallest Front Desk. We could only be one person at the time inside. What made me annoyed, was the fact that they could not be honest with the customer right away.

title: Nice and relaxed stay at Landmark!
text: Just enjoyed a lively stay at Landmark, Rivington Street. Arrived about 11am and greeted by friendly staff on reception. They offered an upgrade to us and we could check in straight away for a small extra fee. Apartment was lovely, huge and with all the usual amenities, bed was comfy. We used this as a base as had booked to visit several attractions and shows. Ot was an enjoyable stay and would definitely stay at this hotel again in the future. :)

title: Avoid at all costs
text: DO NOT BOOK this hotel. We booked and paid for the 'executive apartment' five months prior to our stay. When we arrived to check in we were told that there was a problem with the electricity and that we could stay in another apartment about 15 minutes drive away. We explained that we had booked this apartment because our daughter lived close by. They asked us to go away and they would try to sort it out. We wasted our whole afternoon waiting and ended up with a tiny room that was nothing like the advertised picture. It had no windows and was very stuffy. The bed was against a wall and we had to climb over each other to get in. The sheets weren't clean and we had 25cm gap to walk into kitchen. They even had the audacity to charge 20 pounds to mind bags for a few hours on last day. They lied about everything- very underhanded and deceitful dealings with staff.

title: Welcoming, clean and spacious apartment
text: The staff were very friendly and helpful. The room was cleaned well although there was some wear and tear seen. The room was spacious and the kitchen and bathroom within the room was of a generous size. I was pleased to have a washing machine within my kitchen after i had completed a sports event and could clean clothes easily. Nice airconditioning and heating system nd comfortable double matress. Easy to access on public transport and bike. Free WiFi and bathroom cosmetics. I would recommend this accommodation.

title: Superb.
text: We as a family visit London a few times a year to come into the busy fun part of central London. This time we dicided to stay in the shoreditch area rather than our usual. These apartments had a modern twist about them with a warm feeling. Lots of cleaners from the looks of it so it was nice to know they are maintaining the building. The apartment we stayed in had a fresh cleaniness smell to it and the beds was comfy to sleep in. We enjoyed the breakfast on the ground floor, enterance was seprate but that didnt bother us. We prefered resturants/bars and found many in the area all walking distance from the apartments. We was offered a deal and got a reasonable rate, we would definatley consider coming back in the near future. suberb! good stay.

title: Lovely Valentines Trip
text: Came with my boyfriend for valentines, good little hotel on a side street, which was quite noisy but we enjoyed being so close to so many lovely restaurants and not a far journey to Brick Lane. Old st tube is a few minute walk. Room was quite small but was ok, we weren't in the room much. It was cleaned every day which was nice too.

title: Compact and clean
text: I was very dubious about having booked this after reading various reviews but it was OK. The room was small and a larger framed person than myself might struggle. The only way to open or close the curtains was to stand on the bed. The microwave, oven and kettle all worked fine I struggled with the TV but the staff were helpful. There were tiny pots of milk but no tea or coffee - I left a big jar for the next occupants. The bed was softer than I would have liked but the shower worked fine and I didn't get burned by any pipes. It was a little noisy but hey it is in central London. The whole place was very clean and the hallway did smell strongly of air freshener but so what. The aircon worked well Would I stay here again ? Maybe, but I think I'd prefer a Premier Inn One strange thing, all the female staff were stunningly beautiful, made me feel somewhat lacking

title: Great location, good emanities, snug!
text: This accommodation is in a great location, with lots of good places to eat, shop and drink nearby in Shoreditch and Hoxton, and just 10 minutes walk from Old Street Station. Two friends and I had booked a 3 bed apartment which was very compact. It's a good thing that we are good friends and easy going, as it was a tight squeeze for the 3 of us - it would have been more suitable for a couple rather than 3 friends. Overall, it was small but clean, everything we needed was provided, and as it was in such a great area, I would definitely book here again.

title: Does not worth the price.
text: I spent 10 nights here. Based on my experience, I think it does not worth the price. The room is spacious and comfortable for 2, I like their bed, and the reception is really nice and willing to help, but that's all. I once took the towel out and found hair inside. The washing machine wasn't working at all till the end of my stay, in spite of my twice complaints. The reception said that they could do the laundry for me and I accepted it. However, 2 pieces of my clothes shrunk, I don't understand why a hotel would have made this kind of mistake.

title: Terrible management.
text: When we stayed here the bathroom door was wonky and fell off and we were unable to use the bathroom all night. Was late so there was no one to help and no reply to email when complained about this. We couldn't use the toilet or shower for 12 hours, and there was no apology from staff when we told them about this. When I have payed 150 pounds for a family apartment I am gobsmacked that they aren't able to offer anything for this. You can't sell an apartment with facilities that people can't use!!!! Do not recommend this place at all!!!! Totally rude money grabbing owners.

title: Wouldn't go again unless massive improvements happened!!
text: So the start of my experience began when we discovered we would have to lug a huge suitcase up two flights of stairs because there weren't any lift facilities. This to me was poor as surely they would anticipate people to arrive with a lot of luggage they don't want to cart upstairs. The actual apartment was nice enough and have to say the bed was insanely comfortable. However the air conditioning was terrible so you could either sit in a sauna or have the windows open and hear EVERYTHING outside. I also woke up with a very dodgy throat and blocked nose I'm assuming due to that. Went to enjoy a bottle of wine on Sunday night and alas, no corkscrew to open it! Isn't this a staple for an apartment kitchen to provide? The only thing I can really rate is the bed. The shower also went cold after a few minutes which is not what I want in my life.

title: Horribel!
text: Problems started at the arrival, couldn't check in if I didn't have the same credit card that the apartment was paid with, after a long telephone call with my travel agency I was finally allowed to see my apartment. It was a tiny room that could give anyone a claustrophobic feeling, the window was to small to use as an escape rout in case of a fire, the bathroom was very small and colder than the outside temperature, warm water was only available 10 minutes in the morning, it was dirty under the bed, and I found garbage from the last customer.

title: horrible hotel
text: This hotel is so bad, nothing worked. No hot water in the morning, no service, nobody at the reception, no one was answering the phone when I called to tell them that we did not have any hot water and it was freezing outside. Next day: we had to open the water tap from the sink to be able to get boiling hot water in the shower, we could not adjust it. Room not that clean, very small en crappy.

title: Misleading pictures, just a glorified cupboard
text: The only good thing about the place was the friendly receptionists. The pictures just be Photoshop as there is no way you could take the pictures unless you stand the other side of the street! We stayed in the family apartment which was a joke. It was no bigger than a cupboard. The top 'bunk' was dangerous to climb up to, and you had to crawl into bed as no headroom. Ridiculous small bathroom, closed in and claustrophobic. Ended up with many bruises from a one night stay from constantly banging into things. For 200 a night it was a joke.

title: Not Great
text: Stayed here for 3 nights in a family room. Very small room, walked up the small stairs to next level and found a black metal bar going all the way across, have no idea why it is there and the fact it was black made it very hard to see, surely needs to be painted a brighter colour. Had a shower the first morning and the shower door fell off in my wife's hands, thank god we hadn't taken any kids with us, as that could of caused very serious injury. We did inform reception and we came back the door had been removed, only to return next day fixed. Could only get the four main channels on the TV. Milk was off that was left in the fridge for us and curdled as soon as we put in the cup of tea. They have a water pump to help drain all waste water away (including toilet waste), this is situated behind the headboard of the bed and found there to be some bad smells on occasion. Good area to stay, lots of bars, restaurants and clubs, close to Old Street Tube Station.

title: Nice friendly staff and clean room
text: Me and my partner stayed here on valentines day for 2 nights, the room we stayed in was nice and clean and had everything we needed, a bed a tv with freesat, a fridge and a nice bathroom. We arrived early on the saturday around 11 and they allowed us to check all our details in and leave our luggage at the hotel and come back later for our key, which we didn't mind as we wanted to go shopping in Oxford street anyway. When we arrived back to our apartment the lady showed us into our room and asked us if there was anything we didn't like which there wasn't and she showed us the wifi password and local shops that aren't far away. On the Sunday we unfortunately had to stay in our room all day due to falling very poorly, my partner told the staff to leave our room and that it didn't need housekeeping and they left us all day but knocked again at 4pm to see if we needed anything. Overall I would stay here again staff we're nice and the room was clean, although it was a little noisey at night but it's london you'll expect that anywhere.

title: Nice Choice.
text: Me and my partner wanted a night out in London Town and decided to pick the shoreditch area, as we hear so much about it on Time Out' magazine for London and online search. We was pleased to say that the accommodation was just fine, swift check in clean tidy rooms and nice queen size beds with extra linen and bedding we requested for at no cost. Staff can. The night life was absolutley incredible, lots of happy people good vibe and not expensive as we thought. We will for sure make a trip back one day again. We thank all the staff for making us feel comfortable.

title: Excellent stay
text: Stayed here with 3 other girls for my birthday night out in London. The apartment was clean, smelt amazing and the beds were comfy- when we eventually got in!! It's very central and easy access to the tubes and taxi services. The staff were great. Cant say a bad word about the apartments. Yes, it's noisy but that's what you expect in central London!

title: Great price, great location, comfy getup
text: 27yr old lover of all things city here. I've been to London a few times now and I've gotta say, this is probably my favourite hotel in terms of price, location and quality. My first shout out has to go to the receptionists at the front desk- great service from these girls. There was a misunderstanding with my reservation and although it wasn't their fault, they did everything they could to organize my stay as best as possible. They were super nice, and helped me however I could, including arranging taxis and printing off maps when I asked. The room was clean and comfortable, and bonus-the remote controls actually worked! The wifi isn't stellar but hey, you're in Shoreditch, there's like 100 cool little coffee shops within a 2 mile radius. The location can't be beat-you are directly in the hustle and bustle of hipster central. Great restaurants, bars, pubs, cafes, markets, and one-off shops everywhere you look. However, along with all this East End glory comes the young, hip, 20 something year old crowd, and they aren't exactly the quietest bunch after a few too many beers. So ya, you might here some street noise later on in the night, but that's not the hotel's fault, and in my opinion, a small price to pay in exchange for this affordable hotel just a quick stumble home from a great London night out.

title: Nice stay!
text: Rooms are fantastica, we arrived very early in the morning and the receptionist are very friendly they prepared our room and gave to us straight away! Comfortable beds and good space. Nice area and lots to do, we went to the river Thames, easy access to central London and all the best tourist areas. We request for extra towels and hair dryers and they had no problem. Wifi with good connection. The Resturant downstairs have very nice fish seafood and burgers and many more around. We all was very happy with stay - many thanks.

title: Nice surprise
text: After reading previous reviews I was a bit apprehensive, but I have to say I would stay again anytime. Was given a nice apartment , very clean, no smell in our apartment at all,just a clean smell. Had a decent well equipped kitchen , nice. At broom and amenities and clean beds so I was very very happy. Had a spiral staircase leading to the room which was novel. There were four of us in the room and it was ample for space. Very good location too. Check in was fine and was showed to the room and asked if it was ok which was nice . Downstairs by the entry door, there was a smell of drains but that did not bother us as our room was the main thing and this was not constant anyway. Tube is 5 mins away, sainsburys is also 2 mins walk and there are bars and restaurants in the street . A cab from Euston was reasonable also and there are plenty in the area when needed. Will be staying again.

title: Totally misrepresentative fish-eye pics. Unsafe accomodation
text: I'll start with the positive: the kitchen was welll equiped with an oven, microwave, fridge freezer and washing machine, I think the staff are trying their best and it was three minutes from the venue I was visiting. And now for the not so good. The pictures on the website are in no way a reflection of what greeted me when I opened the door to the "family apartment" after I hauled my bag up three flights of tiled stairs. Advertised as accomodating four people, it was lucky two friends dropped out of our weekend. What greeted me was an Escher-style hamster cage with a double bed downstairs and a sleeping platform at the top of a dangerous set of stairs. I had to bend over to get into the room as the ceiling narrowed, then at the top of the stairs was a trip hazard formed by the eves. How this has passed fire regs, I don't know. (In fact, we were so scared, we both rehearsed how we'd get out in the event of a fire.) The "mezannine" is no way family-friendly as a small child could have rolled through the gaps in the ballistrade. It's a shame it's not safe for kids because only a child could have stood up straight in the room. I actually put the mattress on the floor because I was terrified I could startle in the night and get a concussion from the tiled, sloped ceiling. The rest of the room is a comedy of errors including the bathroom cabinet so high up I couldn't see myself (I'm 5ft 8). The bed linen and towels were clean but the decor very tired and random. We had three barstools, two dining room chairs and a armchair in our small room. Plus a bar and two fixed tables. The welcome pack stated in no uncertain terms that 'Early Departures would result in the full night's accomodation being charged." Usually in hotels there might be a fee for late departure, but clearly other guests have fled early, and Landmark are taking no chances. Their welcome pack stated if any damage was found 'in the future' my credit card would be charged. How far in the future? There was the endless list of other fines, including £65 if I blocked the loo. The notice above the toilet said the Saniflow system had a one inch pipe, and only loo roll could be put down the pan. Fair enough, but why fine a guest for the inadequacies of the plumbing? And why provided thick, quilted loo roll to entrap me? The list of fines make me feel like I am going to suddenly face a list of deductions weeks from now. I left the hotel having taken pictures of everthing: the dangerous carpentry, the interior of the now-empty fridge, even the loo to prove we hadn't left it blocked. And there's so much more (the street noise, the other guests voices carrying between rooms, the dust, the orange mould in the shower), but I hope this gives you the gist. There might be a room in Landmark that looks like the pictures, but it wasn't ours.

title: OK hotel, mostly
text: When we arrived, the door was locked and we couldn't figure out how to get in - note, there is a small reception intercom to the left of the door :) Our check in was a breeze and the staff were very helpful. The room we had was a standard european size (small but serviceable) and the king size bed was super comfortable. The main problem was that our hot water stopped working twice (it was fixed both times but the second time no one bothered to let us know it was working) and then our last night the hydro went out to some rooms of the hotel (we were told it was a problem at the street and nothing could be done) and we had no lights/outlets (except an emergency light that stayed on all night making sleep next to impossible), no hot water and couldn't flush the toilet which soured our stay quite a bit. Other than the water and hydro issues it was an ok stay in a nice neighbourhood.

title: Great Area and affordable apartments
text: These apartments are located in the heart of shoreditch surrounded by bars, a couple of clubs and restaurants which was great for my friend and I who came down for the weekend to London. Our room was small but suitable for the price I paid and everything was provided in the apartment and the bed was comfy and room was clean.

title: Weekend in London with friends
text: Well. This is a little gem in the middle of London. Unfortunately, its an Armed Forces members only club and invited guests (lucky for us!). The outside appearance is very unlike the inside, which is like being greeted into the Officer's mess in a military establishment from yesteryear! A very agreeable reception area, bar and restaurant and as the old adage says, that "great armies march on their stomachs".... the food was every bit an inch of that ..... We stayed in a double room, which if you're looking for 4* and above then you'd be disappointed but as I am ex-police and my horizons are slightly lower I thought this was very good accommodation for the cost, in a bang on location! Our friends were ensconced in a three bed flat in a different part of the building. It was spacious and so well equipped a family could happily live in it!!! Good views outside and internal cleanliness was outstanding! Food was very good and I understand the bar prices were fair compared to London generally. Looking forward to them re-opening membership to Police Officers!

title: Perfect location
text: Stayed one Saturday night, two mins walk from Waterloo station. Short walk to the London eye and covent garden. The room was spotless with great views over London. Staff were very helpful throughout the hotel. We enjoyed the evening meal and cooked breakfast both were lovely. Great value drinks in the bar and coffee shop. We could even leave our case after checkout until our train home instead of dragging it around.

title: Low cost, High Quality - a real haven
text: I stayed here for two nights this week. My first night coincided with Armistice Day so the atmosphere was poignantly relevant. The Club has a very strong military and Britsh feel and atmosphere ( as you may expect). It manages somehow to maintain this atmosphere alongside one of a warm and genuine welcome. I really felt at home and feeling peaceful and relaxed despite being in the midst of the Capital's bustle. I had a single en-suite room which I found adequate in size and unexpectedly well designed and appointed with every key need catered for. Double socket by the bed for charging phones, light in the dressing table area, sockets for the provided hairdryer and any straighteners or such. The walk in wet room was spotlessly clean and bright and also had a light up mirror with shaver socket etc. The free wifi was good quality and pretty fast for hotel wifi. Dining was a pleasure, great food and excellent service. I travel a lot with work and the breakfast was I think the best I have seen. I can't speak highly enough of this amazing establishment.

title: Fantastic location and hotel
text: I stayed overnight in a single room on the evening of Saturday 23rd April. The hotel is in an incredibly central location with rail stations literally across the road. Within a 5 minute walk your on the Thames. The room was incredibly clean and well presented. I had a shared bathroom of which there were ladies and gents. The ladies was spotless and did not see anyone else use it whilst I was there. The only reason I haven't gave this hotel a full 5 stars was the noise. The walls are quite thin and heating appears to be quite noisy. I was staying the night prior to the London marathon so I needed my sleep! I ate in the hotel restaurant which was very cheap for good tasty food which was in a lovely setting with great service. I will be back without a doubt

title: First visit and sadly - not by choice- the last!
text: During my 32 year service with the British Fire Service, I never knew the UJC existed! Now in retirement, I recently stayed with a group of friends. We had a really good stay and the hotel staff made us very welcome. The public rooms are exceptional, very comfortable and an ideal place to catch up with old friends. The rooms are perfectly adequate with all mod cons - and are very clean indeed. The food and drink are both well priced for London. The location is excellent for public transport links and attractions. My only regret was that I hadn't been aware of the hotel before as, I would certainly have been pleased to stay there. Some of the group had already made plans to stay next year however, and sadly, this is not to be. The hotel has now changed it's membership rules and retired Fire Service personnel are no longer eligible to stay. I feel as though I have found and lost a little gem - all in the space of a fortnight!

title: Unexpectedly superb
text: My past experience of military type establishments, holiday places etc. did not prepare me for the amazing experience that is the Union Jack Club. Everything from the security, reception, staff friendliness and professionalism, the bar and restaurant, cleanliness of the whole place including the room and bathroom, was first class. It was the first time I've stayed there but certainly not the last. Thank you Union Jack Club, see you soon.

title: What's Not to Like?
text: First time we have stayed at Union Jack Club. The rooms are very clean. The location is superb for Waterloo, Covent Garden- theatres etc. Drinks are reasonably priced and breakfast hearty. Will use it as a base for all future trips to London Thanks to staff.

title: 24hrs in London
text: Stayed here with wife for day/evening trip to London, perfectly situated (outside Waterloo St) and walking distance for main sites, accommodation was spot on, we stayed on 20th floor (great sights) clean, well furnished (double en-suite) and breakfast really good. As an ex servicemen has been many years since I visited similar venues and was great to take in the rich HM forces history throughout this venue and remind me of great times and proud to have served. Definitely recommended!

title: UNITED
text: Booked for 20! Stag do, after I messed the bookings around for months before hand, chopping and changing names, they really squared it all away. Great decor, great staff, single man rooms with shared facilities was like being back in the block, loved it. Cheap drinks, especially the coffee shop just inside the door. Located right outside Waterloo so easy access to all transport networks, direct dial for a cab. Left luggage storage, can't fault this, many thanks all.

title: Love this place!
text: A brilliant hotel for serving and former members of Her Majesty's armed forces! Such good value, the rooms are comfortable and clean and I love staying here. Really, really close to Waterloo station, and when in London, we never stay anywhere else.

title: Slightly disappointed
text: We have stayed here on many occasions and have been thoroughly impressed. However, our meal in the restaurant was dire! My partner had to send his main course back for being overcooked and my medium-rare steak was positively ruined! Having complained, his Calf's Liver came back raw and my steak was still hugely over-cooked. All the waiters/waitresses seemed unimpressed/uninterested in working there! Shabby in my opinion bearing in mind the meal cost us £88.00 for two! I think they might need to change their butcher! My steak was definitely frozen! Poor service UJC - better standards in the restaurant, methinks! ☹️

title: Still a great place
text: I have used the UJ club on numerous occasions, the staff are very helpful and welcoming. The accommodation is of a good standard and the location is fantastic. The only downside is the noise from the railway, but nothing ear plugs won't solve

title: Wonderful stay
text: Having stayed at the club before when on courses for a Military Charity, I thought it about time I joined in my own right. By joining as a member you get certain privileges and cheaper room tariffs. I had to attend London for a meeting so I brought my wife and went to see a show the following evening. We booked a double room with en-suite and found it extremely comfortable. However the hotel does have "cheap" rooms with no TV and shared facilities. If you are just using this hotel as somewhere to crash for the night and you are used to this sort of accommodation (This is a hotel for serving and retired Forces Personnel) then this sort of room is ideal and cheap. If you are a Civi who somehow managed to get a room here and booked one of these cheap rooms then dont complain on here about the hotel being basic. You get what you pay for. If you are a Civi on a course and your company booked you into one of these rooms, then don't write scathing reports about the hotel. Take it up with the company that put you in there and paid as little as possible. As far as I am concerned I received 5* treatment from all the staff and if you walk out of the restaurant at breakfast still hungry, you only have yourself to blame. A wonderful short stay and from now on I will use this as my base in UK

title: I Love This Place
text: A haven in the hustle and bustle of Central London. The rooms are always clean, well furnished and equipped. The staff are always friendly (although the bar staff can be a bit rushed), always clean and tidy. Great for an ex military person.

title: High value for your money
text: Well priced hotel. I have stayed here 3 times over the past 2 years. Located across the street from Waterloo Station, 10 min walk from London Eye and Big Ben etc. Secured parking in the basement. Quick internet. Main floor restaurant is excellent. Great breakfast and fantastic dinner menu at reasonable prices. Rooms are small for North American standards but they are clean and comfortable. Laundry machines available downstairs for a small fee and the bar area is also well priced. Service was quick and fast with great front door security. For downtown London the price, value and location ius absolutely fantastic! Highly recommend.

title: Get what you pay for, however!
text: I understand it's probably the cheapest way to stay in central, however it's still a hotel and you expect a reasonable hotel service. On arrival I was greeted by security and instantly asked and I quote 'what are you here for' I hadn't even stepped one foot through the door. The concierge was rude dismissive and had a lax attitude to help me. I had parking booked where we then waited for over 15minutes to be given a parking space. The place itself is nice and you can't complain for what you pay for. At breakfast the staff were rude dismissive, they didn't seat us down and was told, again I quote 'help yourself' with a wave of the arm. I had to ask for more food to be brought out and tea and coffee after being told they would ask for tea and coffee once seated. Just to add salt to the wound on leaving the security is supposed to open the car park gate for you to leave however after a terrible explanation we had to do it. All in all good facilities, terrible unhelpful rude staff!

title: Perfect!
text: You really can't get better value in central London. Basic bedroom facilities but perfectly comfortable, good value food and drinks- the scrambled eggs are heavenly! Amazing location opposite Waterloo. Why would you stay anywhere else!

title: Comfortable stay
text: Nice feel to the place. Room very comfortable. Breakfast was lovely and drinks and bar food very reasonably priced. Ok service, bar staff good. Door staff weren’t so good for a first time stayer, we weren’t sure what to do or where to go and we must have looked a little lost but they didn’t point us to reception etc.

title: Best Breakfast in London!
text: Stayed with family for a weekend in one of the flats. The flat has 3 double bedrooms (2 double and 1 room with 2 single beds), two bathrooms (only one has a bath/shower) living/dining, fully equipped kitchen and great views of London! Staff were friendly and helpful and the breakfast was great value and very good. £8.50 for eat as much as you like buffet. Only problem was, the noisy location which meant none of us slept very well. It was a hot night so kept the windows open but the noise of the trains (up to 1am then starts again about 6) and sirens, people shouting etc. was quite disturbing. There was one fan available which helped in one bedroom. But as hot nights in London are few and far between I don't think this is a huge problem. Otherwise a good stay, very good value if you are a member, great location.

title: fantastic club
text: been staying there for many years, always clean,warm welcome from very attentative staff. bar and resturant prices excellent. mainly ex-service fellow guests but like a 5 star hotel. all you can eat breakfast buffet style. rooms clean and warm in winter and toilets, showers and toilets spotless, best place to stay and handy for all sightseeing, just behind the london eye. took my wife there last september and she loved it.i cant wait to go again this september and november

title: Excellent place to stay
text: Stayed here after being out of the RAF for thirty years but what a great place to stay. My wife and I had a fantastic time here even although it was only for two nights. If you are exforces or serving member of the armed forces this is the place to stay in London. Will definitely be back.

title: Wonderful hotel
text: I've stayed a few times now but this week was the best. We had one if the flats that sleeps 6 and it had everything that we needed, and more besides. Staff friendly and helpful from security to reception to restaurant to housekeeping. Restaurant offer a small but delicious menu and the atmosphere in the bar can sometimes be rowdy but always good humoured. Right next to Waterloo so very convenient for everywhere.

title: Great location, value for money and atmosphere!
text: My husband and I have stayed here several times over the past years, but I have never reviewed it. Based on our most recent experience, it remains a hotel of excellent value and with a lovely, friendly atmosphere. The location is outstanding for the rail network and Tubes plus for many central London attractions just a walk away. The nice part of staying here for us is that we often bump into old friends and colleagues here.

title: Newly refurbished rooms are fabulous value
text: I use the Union Jack Club several times per year for business and stay in a single en suite room. This was the first occasion I had been in a newly refurbished room with new furniture, new bed, new tv and new en suite shower room. Great value for money by any measure.

title: Great club
text: Excellent facilities in London & am glad I am able to use it. Always clean & immaculate, good bar, restaurant & breakfast. Have only had single basic or single en-suite rooms but always very good. Opposite Waterloo station or 15 min walk to central London.

title: Great place to stay
text: Ideally located, spotlessly clean, great facilities, comfortable rooms, friendly staff, cheap (for London) bar with good, well kept, ale and excellent value for money! If you qualify to stay you'd be foolish not to! I can't recommend this place highly enough!

title: Ideal for ex services
text: This is my favourite place to stay in London. I am so lucky to be a member and suggest that all ex service personnel stay here if visiting the capital. The excellent breakfast the comfort of the rooms the location close to central London and the cost make London affordable to all.

title: Location and room views
text: You feel looked after from the moment you arrive, the staff are very friendly. The room and all the public areas were very clean. It is great value for money.Being located next to Waterloo tube station, its a great base yourself when visiting London.

title: Ex Forces Club / Hotel
text: Absolutely perfect for Ex HM Forces ... feels like your back in the mess, and for the price of accomodation you absolutely cannot get better for Central London The rooms are spotless, very clean and have all that you need, depending on your budget, even the single rooms with shared bathroom facilities are perfect for London. The only small complaint if it can be called that is some of the single rooms dont have a TV ... which is a shame as the remaining facilities, club staff, security, restuarant and bar staff are all first class, very polite and deliver excellent customer service. You do have to be Ex HM Forces and become a member to enjoy the benefits however the membership fee for the savings you get for central london are well worth the cost. Top Tip !!!! book as far in advance as you can as its extremely difficult to get rooms due to its popularity, cost and location.

title: Great location
text: I last stayed here with a couple of mates from the RAF in 1978 and was less than impressed, however 35 years is a long time and the UJC is simply the place to stay if you are ex or serving HM forces and are in town for a couple of days. Excellent service, a secure environment and value for money. We ate dinner here instead of going out and while never going to win any Michellin stars the food was solidly good. Breakfast was self service but very good value and an excellent choice. We will be visiting again

title: an oasis
text: you know when your in town its busy ,hot ,pushy , noisy ,loud ,costly ,wet ,windy ,dry ,and all the rest !! but as soon as you walk into the jack you can just relax take off your shoes ,rewind have a break refresh and then back out there. its always a pleasure to go there.good service ,food ,drink ,price .and the staff have always got a smile for you.no1 on my list

title: Love this place
text: Stayed here for a course in London and have stayed quite a few times over the years . Breakfast is amazing. Rooms are clean and modern. Lots of towels and plenty of tea / coffee in the room. Great location outside warerloo . Very safe location for female travelling alone

title: Great Position, got the Lot!
text: This is open to ex military & police and their families from anywhere. It is basically accommodation for UK Non Commissioned Officers and families. There is a great military feel and ambiance with VC winners, plaques and military paintings tastefully presented. It is ideally situated in Waterloo for seeing everything London has to offer. It is a five minute walk to the London Eye, Big Ben, Thames and the Red hop-on hop-off Buses. They have a great bar and restaurant with ample seating and the food is good, breakfast, lunch & dinner. The staff are friendly, obliging & helpful. It would be advisable to book in advance via the internet as proof of service is required. My wife and I stayed there with our daughter, her husband and six month old baby, we were accommodated in a two bedroom flat with fully functional kitchen, loungeroom and two bathrooms. Not 5 star but outstanding with a view and everything you need....fabulous! We flew in from Australia arriving at 6am and our biggest quandary was how to get from Heathrow to Waterloo!!! We looked everywhere on the net to answer this very question to no avail!! Well here it is....if anybody has a better way, please let me know.........'Transfer from all Heathrow Terminals to Paddington on the Express Train. Then get a cab!'..........That's it! This is the quickest and most economical way, trust me! If you are eligible to stay at the Union Jack Club......don't miss it!

title: Great visit
text: Lovely comfortable room, with great views. A very safe, comfortable venue, near to Waterloo Station and underground. Evening meal was excellent, as was breakfast. Very Central location for meetings in London. Staff very helpful.

title: Veterans best place to be when visiting London
text: We are in London for Business have to register as member before booking. The restaurant is of a high standard staff are very friendly security is taken seriously on site. Most shows and activities walking distance Club has a Gym nearby you can use. Lots of space with leather chairs to relax after a days work or business. Rooms are well appointed with different rates can have shared rooms or en suit with TV ect beds very comfortable. Now We have used the club we will be back. Recommend The Union Jack Club.

title: Rude staffs and stinky room
text: I booked a single room for a night. When I checked in and entered the room, i found fresh vomit stain at one corner and the room was stinking and it was absolutely horrible. Next morning when I checked out, a female receptionist was terribly rude.

title: Excellent breakfast
text: Was visiting London early morning to attend a function at the Royal hospital Chelsea. We could not find anywhere to have decent breakfast. Walked in to the Union Jack Club on the off chance we could have breakfast there (you have to be a member or serving in the forces) We were allowed in and shown a table straight away, staff were lovely, tea and coffee plentiful, breakfast was in hot trays usual things toast, bacon egg sausage black puffing toast etc, plus fresh fruit, cereal, yogurts. All very hot and plentiful. Breakfast was lovely All for £8.50 per person, fab price for the centre of London. We will be back thank you breakfast was fab and it really set us up for the day.

title: Lovely central specalist hotel
text: This is not the first time we have stayed at this hotel,no complaints from us,room lovely all on-suite,so central right opposite Waterloo Station,staff friendly and helpful,great bar,we ate in the restaurant lovely fish and chips we do recommend ....Lovely hotel..

title: Love coming here
text: We have been here quite a few times over the past six years. Cannot complain as everyone is so friendly and helpful. Al the double room and suites as really cozy and spacious and comfortable and very clean and has been updated to a more modern style these days. The restaurant food and bar food is usually very good indeed and quite a lot to choose from. They do provide special offers throughout the Christmas season as well as in the summer time. Check for offers from time to time. Looking forward to coming back some day soon.

title: London Visit
text: Never having stayed here before we bit the bullet and booked an overnight stay. What a great experience, good rooms reasonable prices and all you can eat buffet breakfast for just over £8, can't be bad for London. Comfy rooms and friendly staff make you very welcome. I will definitely get my membership next year.

title: Regular Visitor
text: I stay at the UJC around 3 or 4 times a year, I am EX Army and find it a relaxing place to stay. Very good accommodation, rooms always clean and well made up. Good rates and cannot find anything bad to say about the facility.

title: Bargain Price - very hard to beat!
text: I've stayed in the UJC a few times now in both single rooms (with ensuite) and doubles. For the price the hotel cannot be beaten! The rooms are clean, and although some aspects (eg. Thin mattresses / basic ensuite) aren't quite up to usual 'hotel standards' they are far better than you'd expect for the money. Great food (fab breakfast for £8) and polite staff. The security staff could be more friendly but that's a minor negative. I will return (on many occasions)

title: Lovely stay but there is something that could definitely be improved on
text: My wife and I were back at the Union Jack for a few days as we enjoyed ourselves so much earlier in the Summer when we used it as a family meet up when visiting the Somme. Obviously the location is perfect for visiting London and the value exceptional. Once again we couldn't fault our room, the friendly reception staff when checking in, the bar is super and we enjoyed the food at dinner but I was disappointed with the restaurant staff at breakfast each day. With the occasional exception we found them sullen and difficult to engage with. Trying to attract attention get a coffee top up was no easy matter unless you fetched it yourself and I actually found myself apologising to one young lady as it seemed such an effort for her to fetch a cup when my wife didn't have one. I have worked in hospitality for much of my life and a smile and friendly attitude make all the difference to the atmosphere of any establishment. The restaurant staff appear completely different with "regulars" or people they know but you have to be nice (and attentive) to all your guests. The lady who was working at the coffee bar in reception on Friday morning (11th November) however, could not have been more friendly or helpful and my wife commented that some of the other restaurant staff could learn a lot from her! I hope to take my family to the club in the New Year, I am proud to have served my country and to have this facility but I hope the restaurant staff can be cheerful and hospitable on my next visit, it doesn't take much to smile and be alert in case someone needs something. Other aspects of the club are superb however so please don't don't spoil the ship for a ha'p'orth of tar.

title: High Standards throughout
text: The facilities at the club are first class, excellent menu for both lunch and dinner at reasonable prices, and serves possibly the best English breakfast in town. The main bar offers fresh all day informal meals, snacks and sandwiches also the beer is very reasonably priced the cheapest pint in London! Our room was spacious, clean and had a good view of north of the river, you also get Wi-Fi at no extra cost! Looking forward to our next visit soon.

title: Perfect base for a family London weekend
text: I have stayed here previously, but not for almost seven years. There was a slightly anxious wait as the date of our stay was approaching, as there had been severe flooding the week before due to heavy downpours in London, which resulted in the hotel having to close due to water damage to electricity and heating services. Luckily, the Club pulled out all the stops and installed emergency heating equipment. As far as we were concerned, this was seamlessly done as we saw no signs of any damage, nor any services unavailable with the exception of car parking (for which we were pointed to a nearby secure car park). We were in a family room, where we had a nice bathroom and a separate bedroom with bunk beds, which our son loved. There were also separate TVs in each bedroom. We didn't use the dining facilities during this visit, as the options were more aimed at adults and older children and we were out and exploring London all day anyway. To add the icing on the cake, we realised on returning home that we had left our son's teddies in the room. My wife emailed the hotel to ask if they had been found, and we immediately received an email offering to post them to us straight away! I would recommend this to anyone who is eligible for club membership.

title: Great stay!
text: I recently stayed for four nights with my son and two friends from Germany. A really great stay. The club has transformed since I first used it while serving in 1976 or thereabouts. Nice restaurant and a nice bar with good prices for London. The bar food is pretty good too. Good location...literally out of the door and turn left down the tube.
