Loads of buses in the area, the IMAX just a short walk...admittedly it can get noisy in that district...but on the 19th floor it recedes a bit�The reception staff are really quite pleasant, nice manner. Speaking of the single rooms, both myself and my son were perfectly happy. And the friends found the double room perfectly adequate. But as a member who has stayed on numerous occasions with no complaints, I can say that in my opinion you won't get anywhere in London for the same money that matches it for location etc. The club is clean and comfortable...It's not a five star hotel...but you could pay a lot more for a place that is nowhere near the standard of the UJC.

title: Fantastic value for money
text: The Union Jack club is a military club for members of the UK and other military forces. I am an ex member of the Australian Defence Force and easily organised accommodation for 9 of us. Excellent location right opposite the Waterloo Station. We had a three bedroom flat with cooking and laundry facilities. The staff were excellent - helping to print off emails, giving directions etc. The restaurant was very reasonable in prices (about half of outside restaurants) and the bar prices were very reasonable. Great place to stay for any Military, ex military family or person in London.

title: A Peaceful Retreat
text: Central and quite literally across the road from Waterloo station but you would never know you were in the centre of London as the peace hits you as you walk through the door. Lovely room with en suite, toiletries supplied, comfortable bed, tea and coffee selection and multi-channel TV. Restaurant (which we never used but should have!) bar and also a luggage room which we found useful to make the most of London on check-in and check-out days. Would definitely stay again and highly recommend.

title: Comfortable rooms and good good
text: I work for the RBL and we use the UJC regularly for overnight accommodation and meetings. Rooms vary from very small singled with shared bathroom to very comfortable double rooms with modern en-suite. Good buffet breakfast. Not as basic as a Travelodge type and not as luxurious as a four star chain hotel.

title: Reunion
text: Stayed here with a group of guys on our annual reunion, we opted for a 3 bedroom apartment on a self catering basis. As usual the room was fantastically clean, spacious with great views of the city. The staff here at The Union Jack Club are absolutely fantastic, always showing great respect for their guest. For those eligible to stay here you cannot ask for a better more safe and secure property in London. Every little detail catered for from a well equipped laundry room offering steam irons etc which having travelled far with shirts in a small case it’s great to be able to freshen them up. Fabulous location and establishment and I look forward to next year.

title: ATTENTION
text: Well that worked. Now I have your attention I will tell you a little of my experiences in the Union Jack Club. I have stayed in this club quite a few times with and without family but this is the first review that I have written. That is because this is not an hotel as such and I do wonder if Trip Advisor reviews are really appropriate for a club? However I have started, so I'll finish as they say. I first became a member in the mid 1960's when I stayed in the original Victorian building. The present building was built on the same site in the mid 1970's. The ethos though was still the same back in the 1960's as it is now. So to reiterate, this is a Club not an hotel, so in my opinion any issues that you may have should be addressed 'in house' and not on Trip Advisor. The Club is run as a charity and not a commercial enterprise. It has always been reliant on legacies, donations and gifts etc. Something to think about. I stayed in the Club recently with my wife for three nights. The first thing that struck me was the security. There is strictly controlled entry and this is very reassuring in today’s environment. It is particularly so for ladies staying here alone. One feels very safe here and our thanks must go to the vigilant doormen who control entry to the Club. The reception area is as imposing as a 4/5 star hotel. Checking in and getting the key took only moments. The staff at reception were efficient and friendly and nothing is too much trouble for them. There is a corner 'coffee shop', which is a relatively new and welcome addition to the reception area. The double room that we had was quiet and well-appointed. The bathroom had obviously been updated and was immaculate. The bed was very comfortable and my wife particularly liked the soft pillows! Room cleaning took place each day whilst we were out and everything was spic and span when we returned. The room had all the things you would expect to find in an hotel including an iron and board, hair dryer, kettle with tea-making tray, a small fridge, a flat-screen TV, telephone and shampoos in the bathroom. Another plus is that there is free Wi-Fi and that worked well in our room and not just in the reception area. We ate in the recently refurbished restaurant which was very nice for breakfast and dinner. Breakfast was excellent with a buffet range of hot and cold dishes. This is self-service but with the hot beverages brought to the table. The dinner menu has a good choice and on occasions there is an additional menu for particular events i.e. St. Patricks day. The food was well-prepared and wholesome and the service excellent. It should be mentioned that the prices are very, very reasonable for the location. The bar has plenty of comfortable seating and a good range of drinks, also at very reasonable prices. Bar food is also available and the service here is also excellent. So to summarize, this is a really nice place to stay and in a great location. If you do come here then take time to look in the reception area where there is information about how and when the Club came into being.

title: Jackpot for price location and quality
text: Stayed as a guest for a function, very impressed. The staff were incredible, the whole place had a relaxing feel and the meals were incredibly good value for money. Rooms spotless and very comfortable.

title: Great Stay
text: If you're looking for value for money you'll find it here. Rooms are a good size, with everything you need. Everywhere is spotlessly clean and well kept. Restaurant is pleasant - we only took breakfast, but it was well cooked, and offered a wide variety of foods. Service was excellent, and at £8 you would not get better value. The evening menu looked good, and if we had more time we would have given it a try. The bar area is comfortable, and serves snacks. The location is ideal - next to Waterloo, 5 minutes walk from Southbank and the London Eye. The staff are very friendly and efficient - we will definitely stay here on our next visit, ouldn't fault it.

title: Excellent value
text: the whole place is excellent value. Very reasonable. the restaurant is good food at great prices. Location is central, although waterloo can be noisy with police sirens etc, and there isnt a great deal around the hotel , but its only a 20 min walk to westminster Service is mixed, but mostly good. Very few english staff sadly. This club is for members only - its an ex forces club. So a good atmosphere and not too busy

title: Great Hotel, Excellent Location.
text: Excellent service very friendly and helpful staff, room was superb great value for money. The location of the hotel is, within walking distance from most of the theatre's, just walk across Waterloo Bridge, Waterloo Station is next door so you can get the Tube to anywhere in London. I had a great stay and would do so again. If there are any ex serving members of the British Forces who are reading this and who like visiting London, but have not joined this club, you should do so.

title: I really wanted to give it a 5, but the shared facilities let it down.
text: I've stayed at the UJC many times and have always been very happy with the rooms and service. Many aspects of my recent stay were very good too

title: Best value for money if you are ex Armed Forces or still serving.
text: I had a single room, very comfortable. Tea and coffee making facilities. Plenty of power points. A superb ‘wet room’ type shower . Hairdryer . Free WiFi. A full English breakfast , self service style for under £10! And 5 minutes walk from Waterloo station. Very friendly and helpful staff too. All in all, a really great place to stay.

title: Leisure
text: Yet another fantastic stay at the Union Jack club where we were looked after by the dedicated staff who could not have been more helpful. Brilliant room and the breakfasts were as usual excellent. Thank you for a great stay👍👍😀

title: Outstanding
text: The service here is outstanding, cant fault the stay I had, both the rooms and food were excellent and the staff were friendly and helpful. I have stayed here several times and each has been a good experience.

title: Where the inlaws gather.
text: On several occasions we had rendezvoused with our daughters in-laws at the UJ when we are in London from New York. We always have a delightful time in the lounge or at dinner in the dining room. It is perfectly located near Waterloo Station. What a gem for veterans and their families and friends.

title: British At It's Best
text: Visited here for lunch yesterday for Father's Day and had an absolutely excellent experience. The bar is clean and cosy and the restaurant formal, comfortable and elegant. I will start by saying service was exceptional throughout, friendly and well timed. I started with Prawn Cocktail, fresh and light. I opted for Roast Turkey while the rest of my party of 8 chose Roast Beef. My sister, who is also a keen 'foodie' described the Beef as 'the best she has ever had'. The Turkey (which as everyone knows is renowned for being a drier meat) was cooked succulently and perfectly. Perhaps the best homemade Beef Dripping Yorkshire Puddings I had ever tried. Chocolate Soufflé was for dessert, I had no words to describe how good it was, light, fluffy and sweet. I will definitely return here and would certainly recommend to all.

title: It's in central London, not the countryside
text: People complaining about noise??? Good grief, this hotel is situated close to the centre of one of the biggest most densely populated cities in the world next to one of the busiest train stations in the country, HELLO!!! You are going to experience some noise people. This hotel is perfectly situated for people wishing to visit all central London has to offer. Brilliant beds, very good restaurant with very reasonably priced food. Friendly staff, good security and left luggage service. I would recommend this hotel to anybody looking for the ideal Hotel for a stay in the Capital, however if the noise of a city concerns you, then stay in the countryside.

title: Excellent stay
text: Can't fault it. The room had recently been refurbished and was spacious and fairly quiet given the location so close to Waterloo. We used the baggage room before check in and after check out. A little gem in London. Highly recommended.

title: Great location!
text: Wonderfully located close to Waterloo train station, this is a fantastic base form which to explore the nation's capital, shop, drink, dine or what ever else it is that you will be doin in London. The rooms are a prefectly reasonable size given that this is London and that space comes at a premium. The facilities are excellent whilst the staff are always genuinely helpful. You also have a choice of wheter you wish to have en-suie or shared WC/bathroom facilities and the rooms are priced accordingly. Of course I will be using the club again!

title: good weekend
text: 10 of us had a weekend away and the club is opposite waterloo station, so easy to get to. for the centre of london it is excellent value. had slight trouble finding my room, as the signs are not very clear, maybe that was the only down fall. food is excellent and worth the money, breakfast is buffet style, dinner served at your table, as we never had lunch i cannot comment on it. rooms are quite small and basic, but, at the end of the day you only want a bed, shower, basin and toilet and it had all of those ! if you want posh, try the waldorf, if you want value try UJC

title: Love this place
text: Have stayed here many times and just spent another one night stay. Convenient for the railway and for walking into central London. Clean rooms, good service, great food. Nice to have laundry facilities on site. Pity there is not a spa or gym area but I know they have an affiliation with a local service. Good value for money and always my first choice for accommodation in the city.

title: First class Central London Hotel
text: Close convenient and more importantly value for money. This Hotel is an excellent oasis for serving and retired servicemen. I have been staying here for nearly twenty years and the place has constantly improved and upgraded. this has to be the best value for money hotel in Central London!

title: ideally placed, excellent staff, excellent service
text: I stayed overnight at this forces favourite and was very impressed, it is kept clean and tidy and the staff are excellent, helpful, friendly and very welcoming. It is ideally placed within 5 mins walk from Waterloo underground. My room was a single and it was ideal, comfy bed, modern shower and good facilities, TV kettle etc. The bar was going through a revamp so was a little cramped but the prices are very competitive and again you get the same quality service. Breakfast was also top class with choices of traditional English or continental. Good for couples, on your own or with family and the prices are good given the locality.

title: Business trip
text: We were staying in the Union Jack Club whilst in London for Business. It is ideally situated next to Waterloo Station, so only a short walk with your suitcase. I found all staff to be welcoming and keen to assist with any enquiries. The rooms are fresh and clean, a little warm but with the windows and the portable fan, I managed to keep cool at night. There is a rooftop bar across from the room that I was in on the 8th floor, so you can hear people talking , followed by the noise of glass bottles being emptied in to bins, it’s in a city, so expect some noise. The food was tasty and reasonably priced. They have a luggage store which is great to store your suitcase on the last day of training once you’ve checked out.

title: Fantastic location
text: Always use the Union Jack Club when in London. Great price, club bar cheaper than the pubs and excellent club facilities. Me and my colleagues have regular meet ups here and spend a few nights catching up. I also stay here with my son when visiting London. Usually book the single shared facilities rooms which are excellent value especially at the weekend. £30 per night for central London. To beat that price would involve a cardboard box and a doorway! Have to mention the buffet breakfast. For a little over £8 you get an all you can eat cooked breakfast. Great choice of all the usual full English breakfast items as well as a choice of continental if preferred. Staff are helpful and friendly and there is controlled access on the door 24 hours for security.

title: Excellent Restaurant
text: Three of us went to the Club and had a delightful drink in the bar area before an excellent lunch in the restaurant. Made very welcome and service was first class. All prices very reasonable - we started with potted shrimps, prawn cocktail, etc followed by pork belly, rib eye steak and Club burger. All well cooked with a variety of vegetables and washed down with good house wine or Spitfire real ale. Highly recommended if you have the opportunity to gain entry to this Club.

title: Good budget
text: Go there. Very central and handy for all transport links so you are all set to explore this great city. Rooms are everything from basic up but it is somewhere to hang a couple of shirts to see you through the week. I love it especially where it is. The food is pretty top notch hit it has to feed former servicemen so it has to be!

title: I go there 10 to 20 times a year and it is a haven in Central London
text: The club is for forces and ex forces up to the rank of Sergeant Major. On the ground floor is a large reception, ample seating area and a coffee counter where their espresso machine is bigger than I have ever seem in Costa or Starbucks. Up half a dozen or so steps is a computer room, cloakroom, toilets and a large open veranda with we jokingly call "the smoking room". There are stairs down to the basement/garage which also houses a games room - bar billiards and table tennis, and a his and hers changing rooms where you can hire a locker and change for an evening out before getting the last train home. This is free. Going down a passage way you come to our fantatastic "silver service" restaurant, with an excellent menu which is changed quarterly. The standard of cooking will match any Pall Mall club. Outside the restaurant, before we go into the bar is a dedicated section for holders of the Victoria Cross. The bar is huge, and although, alas, there is no draugh beer, they have a good selection of all types of drinks. Through the bar on the other side, is a library. The first floor is reserved for offices but the 2nd, through to the 25th floor contains numerous rooms, single, single de luxe, Doubles with bath, suites, and there are four flats. The flats have three double bedrooms with basins, a toilet and bathroom, a shower and basin room, a toilet and basin, a huge lounge with a table to seat six, three two seat sofas, and a huge well stocked kitchen, complete with washing machine, ovens and microwave. There are conference rooms available for hire, scattered throughout the building, from a huge one in the basement, to several on the ground floor, to two or three on floor 24 which have magnificent views. And, of course, members are willing to talk to us as we all have one thing in common. David Cameron hates us.

title: First visit to the Union Jack Club
text: Great location. Friendly staff, fantastic value for money. Fast service and good prices at the bar. The bedroom was clean with a good view out of the window from the 11th floor. This was my first visit to the UJC, and I'm looking forward to returning again soon.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Superb location, right outside Waterloo station, and friendly staff. Restaurant and bar very reasonable prices and good quality. Rooms a little basic, but excellent value. Would definitely stay again.

title: Great Value, Comfortable & Convienient
text: We just returned from a 2 week stay with the Union Jack club. We traveled with our kids to London and were happy when we found that this location offered bunk beds in their family room -- my 12 & 14 year old strongly dislike sharing a pull out or double. We were grateful to be considered Temporary Honorary Members and the price, while not drop dead cheap was very reasonable. The location was incredibly convenient with Waterloo station less than 3 minutes walk. There were also shops and pubs and restaurants close by. We could walk to the London eye easily and there was a street food festival in the neighborhood on several evenings that provided affordable & yummy food options. The hotel is very traditional (you actually get a real key!) and the crowd was mostly British and on the whole a bit "older" but no one seemed bothered by my kids. The bar was festive and lively at all hours and the pints were affordable. There was a game room downstairs that could have been slightly better appointed but my kids enjoyed it nonetheless. We only ate in the restaurant twice our dinner was nice but the breakfast was just OK -- both were very reasonably priced. We also had tea which was served in the bar but good overall. The room was small and the area with the bunk beds isn't much more than a closet -- but it served our purpose well. It was clean and quiet -- our room faced a pub and the evenings were noisy if the window was open but we didn't mind that. The staff were friendly and helpful. I'd easily recommend a stay here if you qualify.

title: Great place
text: Visited the Union Jack Club (Waterloo) a few times now over the past couple of months and have enjoyed my stay there. Chatting to serving and ex-forces personnel as it's a friendly place. Rooms are always spotless and comfortable and the food is more than adequate

title: Best ever
text: Brilliant can't fault it cheap and right in the heart of London.had a family room for 4 nights .clean ,comfy ,quite and a lovely buffet style breakfast .the family room cost £170 a night and full English buffet £8.50,continental buffet £6.50.didnt try the evening meals but they were very reasonable.cant recommend highly enough.thanks

title: Great place to stay in London
text: Always stay here. Staff are lovely,always polite. Excellent service. Rooms spacious and comfortable. Showers good.no complaints. Really good central location . We always stay at UJ club when in town. It’s a club for serving members and ex forces, ate in the restaurant during our stay. Food was fab, really enjoyed first class service. Can not fault the place.

title: Superb value in central London
text: Stayed there for the first time last night. Although a Tuesday night, the bar and restaurant appeared very busy. Only had a drink at the bar, so cannot comment on the food, but the accommodation, for the cost, was superb value. Spotlessly clean and tidy. Will certainly be back.

title: Excellent hotel, great location, reasonable price.
text: Stayed the UJC for the first time in July 2013. I found this to be a very good hotel with everything one might expect in a far more expensive establishment. Our double room was a reasonable size with en suite facilities. All the usual bits were provided in the bathroom/toilet. In the room tea and coffee making requisites were provided, as was a hair dryer. The location could hardly have been better. Literally 50 yards from the front entrance to Waterloo Station, making both surface and underground lines immediately available. I did not use any of the buses but needless to say there was an almost continuous stream of them passing by outside the station. Westminster Abbey, House of Commons, Whitehall, the Palace and Trafalgar Square are within walking distance of almost everyone. We paid £95 per night for a double room with en suite, which is the members price. If you are ex service personnel it is well worth getting membership as the temporary membership price is £122 per night. Even if you stay only one night, you save money. Why wouldn't one join if you qualify. The lifts were sufficiently fast and there was never too long to wait for their arrival. Check in was fast and friendly. The restaurant was first class. The menu is a little limited but big enough to satisfy most ex servicemen and their ladies. Prices in the restaurant are very reasonable for the excellent quality food served. Breakfast @£8 a head is as good as anything you get in London, its an eat all you want format, which certainly suited me. Bar prices are as might now expect, very hard to beat anywhere in London. Or anywhere else in Britain come to that. Faults......I could only find one. We stayed during a spell of very hot weather in July with temperature reaching 33 degrees C. Although the public areas are air conned, the rooms are not. Our room was very warm, opening the two windows did help (a lot) but it did mean having the window open during the night. Being on the 13th floor, security was not a problem but the noise was. Emergency vehicle sirens were frequent as was the din made by "revellers" (drunks) With windows closed the noise ceased to be an issue. For "normal" British weather non of this is a problem. You will be hard pressed to find a hotel of this quality, at this price anywhere else in London.

title: A Pleasure to Stay Here. A Pleasant Experience
text: WOW WOW & THRICE WOW!!! We were booked in for a long weekend stay as a guest of one of our sons. What a great place to stay. The Club is open to ALL Serving Members of HM Forces with thier families bing allowed to use the facilities as guests THe establishment is very wheelchair accesible with a lift at the enterance at ground level and another inside to gain access to the Bar, Restaurant & Lifts to the rooms. The staff are very helpful and have to operate the internal lift which can cause a slight delay if they are busy elswhere and you're in a hurry. Check in is easy ans we were soon in our room on the 17th floor !!!! Now you might think why put a wheelchair dependant person that high up? If there's an emergency and the lifts are off they're in trouble. Panic yee not for in your room is full instructions of what to do should the Hotel need evacuating. Our room was superb, big, light airy with ample supplies of tea,coffee and everything else , not the usual 4 milks and scant tea-bags and such. The Wetroom was massive as big as my l kitchen diner at home A folding shower perch, a low-level sink & mirror + a normal height one and a welcoming raised height toilet, which made it all the more special for myself. After a great nights rest we were up early for the Queens Birthday Parade. Breakfast buffet style was amazing, Full English, Continental, Cereal, Toast Fresh Fruit, Dried Fruit & Nuts, Crossiants, Warm Danish Pastries and bottonless Tea/Coffee. If you want poached /boiled eggs just ask. We were only booked in for B&B but we could book a table in the Restaurant which we did for Saturday Evening. The food is 5* a three course meal inc Rib-Eye Steak with wine & Beer less than £50. I can reccommend the steak whilst my wife recommends the Bream Royale. After a theatre visit we decided on a nightcap in the bar which has very resonable prices a pint & half £3.65, bar meals eg Ham, Egg & Chips ect ect. We cannot fault the venue or the staff and are already contem-plating our next visit. If every hotel was up to this standard ..................................... PS Top Tip.....invest in some ear-plugs you may need them if your room is in the front facing Waterloo East Station

title: Cannot ask for better!
text: Been staying at the union jack club since 1994 and have to say that for location, service, rooms and food you would be hard pushed to find anywhere better in London. The breakfast is just heavenly, the bar meals superb. Last trip we stayed in one of the flats for four nights and my brother in law had to return home to work for one of the days, as my dad had his ID that is needed for you to enter the club the staff were good enough to arrange for him to enter without issue on his return. If you can stay at this establishment you'll be hard pushed to find better!

title: Oasis
text: Brilliant for Regular and Retired members of HM Forces, and now due to spiralling costs, for other organisations. A Club, and this should be remembered, and NOT a Pub. Needs a dress code and, more attention, to Members Language, in The Bar!

title: Family outing
text: Used before but never eat there until now. Good reasonable priced food, good well stocked bar with a selection of ales at local out of London prices. Staff could not have been more helpful, could not have enjoyed my stay more wish it had been for longer.

title: Why didnt I try this place sooner?
text: This place is an amazing oasis of calm and value in the middle of London which is neither. I cannot believe the room rates, simply unbeatable value. As far as the restaurant is concerned, it's absolutely outstanding. Three adults and a bottle of £16 wine had mains and dessert for £43 so without wine three of us are for £9 each in central London.

title: Excellent Value and Service
text: We stayed at this hotel as we were coming to the capital to celebrate a special birthday for my sister. It is in a perfect location for any sightseeing in the capital. The service of the staff both in the bar and restaurant was fantastic. The hotel is well maintained and very clean. Great value for money. We will

title: Another fantastic stay.
text: Stopped here for the Ride London and 1 extra night. Food and service excellent. Staff very very helpful and friendly. Wouldn't stop any where else in London. Facilities are great and well maintained. Clientele is always good, if you know what I mean too. Close to railway and tube too.

title: Good location Good value
text: My wife and I stay here for three nights in mid May. It was the first time I'd been back to the UJ since staying here in the mid 60s. I was here to attend a training course and the organisation that booked the accommodation allowed me to pay for a move to a double room from the single originally booked. In the event we were given a family room. I have to say I was pleasantly surprised with the changes to the Club. It's big! 23 floors and if all the rooms were as comfortable as ours then the UJ is definitely a place to consider when staying in London. It is just across the road from Waterloo station. The attractions of the South Bank are short walk away. The Old Vic is just down the road, the IMAX cinema is also nearby. Our room had twin beds and bunk beds in a separate room. Loads of coffee/tea and milk, likewise shampoo and show gel. Every thing very clean and well laid out. Good sized bathroom and the shower worked just fine. We ate there only on the first night. A pre booked fixed menu which was perfectly fine. We didn't take breakfast there but other members of my course did and said it was pretty good. We were on the 5th floor overlooking a bus depot but peer round to the left and you get a good view of the Shard. More impressive at night I have to say. Staff amiable and helpful. There's a little coffee stall just inside the main entrance serving early till late and good value. You can leave your luggage in the UJ after you check out if you need to, it will cost you a pound if you're not a member. All in all a comfortable stay and worth considering membership for the discounted room rate alone. Recommended.

title: A Well Oiled Machine
text: There is nothing to dislike about The Union Jack Club. Everything WORKS here. The light switches, the expelair in the en-suite, the Wi-Fi is fast and the serving staff are well trained, the rooms are kept spotless, the meals are well cooked and even ones fellow residents are like minded souls with similar values. It's in the heart of the city, near major sources of communication and transport and importantly, in these days of questionable sanctuary, the security is good. For serving personnel and those who have served, it is a gem in ones social life. I love the place.

title: Good nights sleep
text: Stayed for one night and was very comfy, possibly the most comfy hotel bed I have encountered. Room was surprisingly quiet despite being in a busy area. Alas, when we booked we hadn't realised we had a room without en suite facilities (thought perhaps only youth hostels were bathroomless these days!) We managed admirably and to be honest had we been 'caught short' in the middle of the night there was a hand basin which would have afforded a chap relief and the bin did have a liner so not all was lost for me either. That said we found the nearby bathroom absolutely fine, not shared the gents before but no signage to a ladies bathroom so apologies to those who may have been interrupted mid-flow by me in my M & S finest. Like I always say, we're all the same apart from our dangly parts being sited slightly differently!! Breakfast is a wonder to behold and set us up for the day.

title: Superb
text: Brilliant location, amazing facilities. Have stayed twice now and not been disappointed on either stay. Rooms are spotless! Food prices are reasonable and also the food is great quality. Helpful, friendly staff. The military history displayed in the hallway is very poignant and moving.

title: Great hotel and great value for money
text: This hotel is lovely . Very clean and great value for money , it's very clean and the staff are helpful . It's in a great location and near to Lots of of the great spots in London such as the west end, the Thames etc and close to the tube station. The cooked English breakfast was really nice . I will sure be going back here .

title: Home from Home
text: Booked this for my niece and I and used the standard room instead of the en-suite ones. Rooms are just as good and towels are provided so no need to take your own. The bathrooms were just across the way so not too much trouble. I used the bar this visit which I hadn't done before and it was lovely. Comfy chairs with lots of friendly people and attentive bar staff. The baggage room is very useful, we left our bags as we couldn't take to the concert and just picked them up on our way home. Make sure when you exit Waterloo tube from the main concourse you follow signs for Sandel St, otherwise it is a very long walk round.

title: More than just an hotel
text: As a hotel this place , or should I say , the 2 rooms we had are just basic . The first room a double was comfy , bathroom with bath. The second room a twin with a wet room bathroom. This bath room did not match the very basic mixed matched green carpet tiled room. The staff make this place. Very much yes ma'am no ma'am but that is to be expected . A great base for london .The food served here , well it is a good price but 2 steaks asked for rare and both served well done and they did not understand why I was not happy.

title: The flat
text: We stayed at the Union Jack Club 14/15 May , in one of the flats , a very well kept secret , when we tried to book two double rooms in Nov , we were told that there were none , but helpful staff put us on to the flat , a brilliant move. With three bedrooms you can sleep up to 6 , and a fully fitted kitchen ( including a washing machine ) , and a comfortable lounge , all at a very reasonable £200 per night.. The food a breakfast and dinner were well up to top restaurant standards. All in all an excellent experiance.

title: Excellent accommodation and service
text: Stayed at the UJC last week with my son to see a West End show. The room was very clean and comfortable. The accommodation is available to ex-military and members of associated organisations.. They boast about the best breakfast in London, and I agree with that! Prices in the restaurant and the bar are very competitive - ( superb all you can eat breakfast for £8).

title: As always, first class
text: Why stay anywhere else in London? Great staff, lovely food and a pleasant ambience. It feels like home, warm and comfortable. Parking in Addington Street a 5 minute walk away and only £20 for 24 hours (this is value in London).

title: Very impressed
text: Had my first night stay last night and am happy to say that all was good and I am just sad that I didn’t hear of this place years ago. Excellent value for money, staff friendly and polite and everywhere was very clean.

title: Very Nice
text: Stayed just for one night,the place was lovely very clean.The staff were very efficient and friendly. We had just the basic rooms but they were spotless, the views from the room were amazing. All the prices were very reasonable for central London.

title: Disappointed
text: I booked this apartment for my husbands birthday so did not mind paying 400 pounds per night as we were expecting to have a wonderful 2 day stay. We arrived a little early but they would not allow us into the room until 3pm as is in their policy however we have travelled extensively and have never had to wait until the checking in time right down to the last second. We had a lovely meal out and returned to the apartment. During the night we could hear loud music and thought it was coming from outside as it was very hot in the apartment so we had the window open. After being woken up several times during the night I asked my husband to close the window as I could not sleep. Having closed the window we could still hear the loud music and realised it was coming from the apartment next door. At 5am I went and spoke to the night security person who stated that I had complained about the noise a few nights ago. I proceeded to inform him we only checked in that day so it must have been another person complaining. They did ask the people to turn off the music but there was still loud talking and women screeching. I will be speaking to the manager today as we cannot put up with another poor nights sleep. I would not stay here again or recommend it to anyone else

title: all what you need in one place "CEVAL"
text: cheval, excelence, feel like home, really miss it as am back home, definately will repeat the visit. highly recommend it, best location in london, very quite, very easy access, all you need is near you.

title: A Perfect Week in London with our Family!
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our week in London, in particular our stay at Cheval Thorney Court. Upon arrival we were greeted by the friendly concierge team, and lucky for us, despite our early arrival our room was ready. Martin took such care to give us the "lay of the land", sharing with us highlights of the neighbourhood, explaining the bus and tube system and offering suggestions of where to eat with our children. The room is spacious, impeccably clean, and there are no words to describe the view! Every morning we enjoyed our breakfast while overlooking Kensington Palace and the park. Having a fully operational kitchen proved to be a treat - with Whole Foods (and several other shops) a short walk away, and numerous markets a tube ride away we could prepare complete breakfasts and several dinners in the comfort of the apartment after full days of site-seeing and exploring the city. Each day the staff was keen to offer suggestions and check-in to ensure that we were comfortable and enjoying our stay. This was our first trip with our children to Europe and it was a success in large part due to the accommodation. Thank you to the staff at the Cheval Thorney Court! We hope to return soon!

title: Exquisite weekend with friends - highly recommended!
text: Very comfortable and elegant apartment with plenty of space and view of Hyde Park. The location is perfect for family or night out. The team was very carrying and friendly. Unforgettable stay we will definitely come back.

title: Lovely Place & Location, but Service could be better.
text: We stayed there from the 16th of April to the 27th of April, which coincided with the long Easter weekend. The Place is very popular with the Qataris and other Arabs, due to the high standards of privacy and premium location. As I have already said the location was Prime. Couldn't ask for better. 5 min walk from High Street Kensington, 90% of the good shops are there as well as Whole Foods, M&S & Tesco. Kensington Park is right opposite which is lovely to stroll in and spend a couple of hours relaxing in. Royal Albert hall is about 2 min. away too which is very convenient for concert goers. The building was very good but not very modern. I didn't really explore the other facilities(Gym, Pool) so I can really comment. Apartments were spacious and well decorated. Very Comfortable. The bedrooms were very plush too and the only thing that could be better was the lighting in the bedrooms, which was very dim (Typically English). The bathrooms were large and spacious as well but could have been a bit more modern. The Kitchen was small but well laid out and all the necessary things were there. They were kind enough to leave a welcome hamper with essentials as well as a possible shopping list. Nice touch. The only thing I didn't like was, firstly, the contract mentioned that housekeeping/room service would be done twice a week. What they didn't mention was that on weekends (Friday, Saturday, & Sundays) there is no service. We arrived on a Wednesday and since the room was made up the day we arrived the scheduled service was due in 3 days i.e. Saturday. Being the long weekend they didn't have any housekeeping staff in house and Sunday and Monday being public holidays there was no service so we went almost a week without housekeeping. No sheets towels were provided which was quite disappointing. They came in on Tuesday and made up the rooms but in 11 days that we were there they cleaned our apartment ONCE! SHOCKING! Considering that you pay GBP1000+ a day its REALLY SHOCKING. Other than that they tried to charge us for a water stain on the dining table, which was later reversed. Just be careful to lookout for all the damage in the apartment when u arrive so that u can point it out to them so that they don't charge u later.

title: Happy Saturday In Kensington
text: Fantastic views of Kensington Gardens from our 9th floor apartment. The kids took full advantage of the super spacious rooms to play an endless game of hide and seek. Convenient for High Street Kensington shops and restaurants and a short walk to all your favourite museums.

title: Cheval Thorney Court Kensington
text: Cannot give enough praise for this Apartment. It was well serviced and the following Concierges couldn't have been anymore helpful or friendly.....Andros Sander Martin & Sam. The Apartment was in a great location Kensington Highly recommend

title: Apartment with a View of Hydepark
text: we booked an apartment on the 10th Floor. great view of Hyde park. Cheval Thorney Court had installed new walk-in rain showers which are excellent, the water pressure is amazing, concierge team (sp. Balwant, Arnold) made our stay memorable one. thank you for the lovely welcome hamper. I love the new bed side radios. overall great stay.

title: Spectacular apartment, outstanding location and superb service
text: Spacious and beautifully furnished luxury apartment, fabulous view, comfortable bed, fully equipped kitchen, complete with a generous welcome pack. Easy walking distance to Hyde park, museums, restaurants, Knightsbridge and West end. Martin and Alex were incredibly helpful and accommodating. We loved our stay so much that we extended for two additional nights!

title: PERFECT
text: Everything was perfect staff, location, rooms, food, cleanliness the welcome pack draw my attention, they provided juice, coffees and many more Everything was just amazing and fabulous I definitely recommend this hotel to anyone

title: Excellent stay!
text: Stayed with family and we really enjoined the space and luxury. Apartment was immaculately clean and everything in perfect working order. Beautiful little touches and gifts made out stay extra special. The concierge are very welcoming and made our family feel at ease as soon as we arrived. I am very picky when it comes to mattress and bedding quality, but this was my best sleep away from home. Just perfect! We will be back. Thank you.

title: Great stay Fantastic apartment size and view
text: Stayed with family, loved the apartment with the welcome pack with lots off goodies including juice coffee croissants and more. The location is perfect everything on your doorstep,Palace gate with coffee shops places to eat and get a few essentials from local shops. Kensington High st to the left off us with evrything there, park across the road. a big thank you to all the excellent staff who made our stay special. will be back.

title: Home from home and more.
text: Helpful and attentive staff. Apartment was huge, elegant and well placed. Definitely worth a 2nd trip and more! Very quiet and a welcomed end of day retreat, away from all the hustle and bustle of London.

title: Fantastic experience in a perfectly cleaned 3 bedroom apartment!
text: I was staying with friends in a 3 bedroom apartment to celebrate birthday. Although it was horrible and rainy outside, the warm welcome I received from the evening male receptionist made me forget about the miserable weather straight away. After entering the apartment I was astound by the size of it, beautifully decorated throughout and my favorite was the large living area with plenty off windows to oversee Hyde park which I only could admire the next day. This was definitely perfect choice for all of us to gather and celebrate. The condition of furniture and fittings was as it was brand new, there was no sign of wear and tear and you could tell the housekeeping and maintenance team is taking pride in looking after the property. The cleanliness was fantastic, everything had its own place and much care was taken in how the apartment was presented. I could not see any scuff marks on walls or skirting boards which is always a weak point in other properties. Beautiful little touches in the kitchen,rooms and bathrooms made it more special. We had fantastic time as a group and will definitely return again in the future. I hope the music was not too loud and didn't disturb other customers.

title: London holiday
text: Great apartment and friendly staff. The security was excellent. we certainly appreciated that there was staff there all the time when our children came home late at night. The apartment building is in a great location

title: Wonderful. Treated like royalty.
text: One of the most amazing places we have ever been. If you want to feel like royalty at least for a day you need to try Cheval Thorney Court Apartments. We would like to express our appreciation to the whole team who went out of their way to make our stay as excellent as possible. Talking about going the extra mile for offering the best guest experience. We were completely woowwwed. Thank you for the lovely surprise in offering gifts to our daughter. Very clean apartments with brilliant amenities. The friendliest staff we have ever encountered. Wish we would have booked a longer stay and will be back as soon as we can.

title: Cheval - the wonderful serviced apartment experience!
text: You know something is right when you don't want to leave the comfort of the apartment to go and do what you're in a place to do and this was exactly the case during a recent stay in Cheval Thorney Court. Having been lucky enough to stay in Cheval Three Quays and Cheval Knightsbridge on previous occasions you come to learn that the apartments have their own unique character but one thing you can be assured of is that you will without doubt always have a wonderful experience. The comfortable surroundings, the most comfortable beds and pillows, to the big fluffy towels and a wonderful shower. From a delightful welcome pack to the delicious chocolates, from the just beautiful aroma from the diffusers which we loved both in the apartment (fab Jo Malone!) and in the reception areas, to the warm welcome from the Cheval Residences team whether it be maintenance to front desk you can always be guaranteed a friendly hello! The location is great, nearby undergrounds, a great view of Hyde Park even in the winter months, the penthouse was just beyond comfortable, spacious and wonderfully equipped. Great WiFi speed and service which is essential when travelling for business. A lovely outside terrace which would be amazing in summer, the apartment was just wonderful! Thank you team for another wonderful Cheval stay!

title: Great place to be when visiting london
text: Great place to stay for families. The appartment looked exactly as photo at the web, big rooms and graet amnetieis to use, stuff very helpfull, we wormly reccomand it. A little bit far from metro but there are many busses near the hotel and you can go to most of attraction by foot (few km for many places to visit)

title: Fantastic apartment near Royal Albert Hall
text: We were seeking a hotel near the Royal Albert Hall and discovered Thorney Court Apartments. We booked a one bedroom apartment for two nights and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The Apartment was very large and comprised one large bedroom, a large and nicely appointed bathroom, a wonderful living come dining room, a separate bathroom plus a kitchen with all appliances. There was a nice welcome pack including milk, bread, butter, conserve and cereal. Every room was decorated to a high standard and was spotlessly clean. We had views across Kensington Gardens. It was lovely an quiet, yet a 5 minute walk to local restaurants, shops and supermarkets. Parking is available at extra cost and the valet parking service was friendly and efficient. We would definitely return to the apartments in preference to staying in a hotel. It was lovely staying in a superbly appointed apartment with so much living space. I would add the service and staff were very friendly and efficient.

title: Great Place @ the Right Time!
text: We rented a two bedroom flat at Cheval Thorney Court at the last minute because I was in a auto accident near Stonehenge. After 5-days in the Salisbury district Hospital, the doctors would not clear me to fly back to America (our home) for an additional 10-days. We were referred to this property by friends and could not be happier. The flat was luxurious and overlooked Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. The modern kitchen made my our stay great as we ate in the kitchen many times. Our two 20-years old children came and stayed with us for the week of Thanksgiving at the flat. The staff was fabulous and looked after every detail. The daily maid service was excellent as well. This is a great property and wholeheartedly recommend staying here to anyone.

title: Luxury stay in London
text: We stayed at Cheval Thorney Court for 2 nights in a 3 bedroom apartment. The apartment was very spacious and beautifully decorated with all the amenities you could need. The location is amazing, located in the heart of Kensington and opposite Hyde Park. The concierge and housekeeping were excellent, very friendly and helpful. We did not want to leave and we are looking forward to another stay.

title: Wonderful stay !!!
text: My friends and I had an amazing stay at Cheval Thorney Court. Great views and location. The apartment was spotless.The apartment was superb and the staff was so attentive as was my birthday and they surprised me with a cake and balloons.

title: Excellent quality and service
text: The Cheval Thorney apartments were excellent. Quality, cleanliness and size were all excellent. Staff sevice was first class. Cheval Thorney will be our first choice in London for future visits. Happy to recommend to anyone.

title: TOP CLASS STAY
text: We booked and stayed at Cheval Thorney Court for four days . We booked a three bedroom as we were welcoming friends from Perth Australia , it was their first time in London and celebrating a birthday . The apartment was absolutely fantastic , very big and very well appointed , on arrival in the apartment was a welcome pack with tasty treats , and they surprised us with birthday treats , beautiful flowers , a cake and even champagne , we felt very special , what a fantastic thought , we had a great time exploring London and Thorney court is perfect as its so near hyde park , across the road which we enjoyed morning walks , the staff are professional and friendly and i can t recommend Cheval Thorney Court enough , everything was so perfect we just did nt want to leave , a special mention to the head Front of house Craig who welcomed us on arrival , and the flawless team , highly recommended

title: Classical style with excellent locaton
text: I lived two weeks in this amazing classical style hotel. When living there you just feel like at home with wide living room with wide veriaty of TV channells including all Arab chanells. Th locatin is amazing in front of the Hyde Park and very close walking distance from the one of the most important High street in London where you find all what you needs like resturants, Cofee shops and Supermarket. The only issue which is very importsnt is that the price is very high and not easily to be cosidered again. I spent long period with them and tried to get discount considering my long stay without any cooperation. The staffs are very friendly and very cooperative and they have a sense of humer. The staff treat you like a friend and really nice people. If you are not a fan for old classical building then this hotel does not fit you. Also remmember that the locationis on front of the Hyde Park so you may hear alot of noise from the streat.

title: Perfect venue for a special occasion
text: I've booked a 3 bedroom apartment for a special occasion which was a great choice as the apartment was extremely spacious and perfect for our friends' get together after 15 years. It was raining all weekend so we ended up spending a lot of time in the apartment and catching up on the last few years. We had ordered groceries for our day of arrival which arrived slightly before us and they had already been neatly put into the fridge. The apartment was spotlessly clean and had all the amenities which we required and more. The service from the whole team was impeccable. We had the best time and can't wait to be back in the future. Special thanks to Irene and Andras who made the experience extra special.

title: Best place to stay in London
text: We absolutely loved our stay here is was amazing the rooms were clean, beautifully decorated with decor, staff was friendly, it was located very convienantly, it was amazing. I cannot day enough about how much we enjoyed our stay.

title: Lovely stay
text: Opposite Kensington palace, wonderful location, market nearby. We stayed here for 14 days and absolutely loves the apartment. Spacious living area , fully functional kitchen, en suite bedrooms. And the housekeeping did a very good job everyday. The apartment this size does tend to get messy but the housekeeping staff spent almost two hours cleaning everyday.

title: Fantastic Service, High Quality Apartment, Stunning Views!
text: We had an incredible stay here at Cheval Thorney Court, the team were amazing! As it was for a special birthday occasion, the team surprised us with a bottle of Prosecco and gifts on arrival. The apartment was spectacular, we had a great view over Hyde Park and also South Kensington! All creating an amazing experience! I could not recommend more!!

title: Exceptional!
text: Can't recommend Cheval Thorney Court enough! Amazing team at the front desk at our beg and call! The house manager welcomed us and upgraded us to the penthouse 2 bedroom suite with stunning views of Kensington Palance and Kensington Gardens and the Royal Albert Hall. The flat was immaculate and spotless clean. TV and internet connectivity were flawless. You can't beat the location, at walking distance to Kensignton Gardens/Hyde Park (it's just opposite), the South Kensington museum district (Natural History Museum, Science Museum, V&A Museum) and the Royal Albert Hall. And if you decide to eat in or have friends over for dinner at the spacious dining area, High Street Kensigton is around the corner with Wholefoods and M&S Foodhall at your disposal for any of the meal ingredients you'd ever want. Also, our daughter couldn't have enough of the flat as the very spacious living and dining area gave her ample space to run around. If only our weekend stay could last longer as it felt that we could stay there forever! Would defiantly stay again.

title: What a great team!
text: Family visit to Albert Hall to see Circ de Soleil . Two bed room flat for the weekend . Everything you would need .. We overlooked The Park .. Martin and Alex were on the front desk. Great personal welcoming ,, friendly and well informed. Made us feel at home. Just walked to the show and walked back afterwards .. breakfast just down the road then lunch at the Builders arms the following day...fantastic position and great place for a London visit ..we will definitely stay here again in Cheval Thorney Court. Thank you team

title: Fantastic Surprise
text: I am so sad that we could not have stayed longer at the Cheval Thorney. We knew we were getting a larger space with a family of 4, but what a fantastic surprise! The apartment was huge and so lavishly appointed. Martin and Sam, the best possible employees, saw to our every need. The kids needed adapters- poof! Instantly they arrived. We were shown to our apartment, and given a fabulous array of goodies to make each morning for breakfast. The location of the apartment was perfect for our visit. Centrally located near Kensington palace, this spot had a wonderful selection of restaurants and shops. The tour bus was outside our front door! Again, we were sad to leave. I will absolutely return one day.

title: Great way to visit London!
text: The Cheval Thorney Court offers guests a place in London that feels like home, but better. Great service, the concierge staff were always attentive and helpful. The rooms were large, particularly for central London. The beds were very comfortable.

title: Beautiful apartment in London
text: We had a truly exceptional stay at cheval Thorney Court from the time we arrived until our departure. We stayed in a 3 bedroom apartment and the size was incredible. With regards to service, all the staff was very helpful If you are looking for a 5 star apartment, cheval Thorne Court is the place to go for. We will definitely return.

title: Fantastic
text: We stayed here for 16 days over the rugby world cup and found it to be just fantastic. We were 2 couples and the two on suites were just perfect. There was also a 3rd powder room which was convenient for guests. The large kitchen with table and chairs was also appreciated along with the large lounge. Leonado, our cleaner did a fantastic job, which was also really appreciated. We found the location to be perfect with shops, pubs and restaurants to be close by. It was a toss up as to which tube to get (Gloucester Rd, of High St Kensington) as they were both about 10 minutes walk away. Taxis also run past the entrance at regular intervals. The hop on hop off London tour buses left from right out the front. All in all a fantastic stay and we would diffidently stay here again. Rex Julian Perth Australia

title: One of the best places in London
text: There's nothing that I can complain of. Everything meets my expectation. The room is spacious. It's better than some of 4-5 stars hotels I have stayed before. You'll get what you see from the photo. It's worth your money.

title: Just Perfect!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: The hotel is amazing, well decorated, clean and very well located. The staff? what to say? They are extremely polite and dedicated. We stayed in a wonderful two bedroom apartment. Upon arrival, after they had given us an upgrade, there was a birthday cake waiting for us, as they found out it was our daughter's birthday. We'll be back for sure. A 5 star hotel!!!!!!!!

title: Excellent Customer Service
text: I have stayed at multiple Cheval properties over the past few years and my favourite is Thorney Court. I have stayed both as a business traveller and on holidays with my family. On my latest trip the service was excellent as always. The location is great and the apartment sizes and finish are first class. On my previous trip my daughter required a doctor at 2am for an ear infection and the night manager arranged for a doctor to come to the apartment who promptly arrived within an hour. I highly recommend this property.

title: Like a second home
text: Just like your own home. Staff are very helpful and nothing is too much trouble for them. Maybe looking a little tired but extremely clean and very well stocked. Welcome amenities were great. Would highly recommend to anyone who doesn't want a hotel.

title: Not just accommodation, an experience.
text: I stayed here with my mother in law and husband as a belated birthday treat for my mother in law. As soon as we arrived, as if by magic, staff appeared and our bags were taken to our room and we were swept on to a tour of our accommodation. The apartment? Evoked a gasp from my m.i.l. It was beautiful! Truly grand living. 3 bedrooms, three bathrooms, two balconies, wonderful living room with sweeping bay window, grand dining room, guest loo, fully equipped kitchen complete with nespresso machine and fabulous Miele appliances and all immaculately clean. Add to that bvgari toiletries, a beautiful welcome basket with great quality snacks, cereals and bread, birthday cake, balloons, champagne and Jo Malone gifts and to say we were wowed would truly be an understatement. During our stay, the staff at Thorney Court made us feel so welcome, nothing was too much trouble, they asked about our plans and were always happy to chat. The apartments are close to High Street Kensington with all that has to offer, the Albert Hall and to Kensington Palace and those beautiful gardens and park. This was an utterly faultless stay. If you are looking not just for accommodation but a truly fabulous experience, this is for you. Try it. You will never want to go home!

title: One Month Stay at Cheval Thorney Court
text: Everything was great however i think housekeeping should be done everyday and not on the week days. `other than than my stay was really lovely. All staff are very friendly and useful. I recommend stay at Chavel Throney Court

title: PERFECT LOCATION
text: Great apartment to enjoy London as a family with an ideal central location close to Kensington Park, the tube, Royal Albert Hall, etc. Large bedrooms with ensures for all and a front desk with truly excellent friendly and helpful concierges. Not inexpensive but our 3 Brm. suite with lovely living and dining room compared favourably with the 3 hotel rooms we would have needed.

title: Great Property and Wonderful location!
text: From the moment we checked in to the time when we left, the experience at Cheval Thorney Court was a relaxed and wonderful one. Helpful concierges, large airy apartments and the fantastic location made the visit to London a memorable one!

title: Thorney Court London
text: I would definitely recommend this place to friends, and I would stay there again in the future. Great location. The kitchen was stocked with water, milk, tea, coffee, washing detergent, and other basic needs. Wi-Fi was fast. Felt like home.

title: Highly recommend!
text: It was our first trip to London and we were completely satisfied with everything the apartment had to offer from the moment we arrived to the end of our holiday! Would definitely recommend the apartment to friends and family and hopefully we will one day return !

title: Magnificent Apartments
text: Well, I thought I had stayed in some really nice places in London over the years and I have, but Thorney Court just blew them all out of the water! My husband and I recently stayed for 1 week in a 1 bedroom apartment here and I honestly don't know if we could stay anywhere else when we come to London in future. The flats are gorgeously decorated with antiques, there is even air conditioning which works very well at cooling, the housekeeping staff do a fantastic job at keeping things really clean and I am a clean freak so that is very important to me. The staff are extremely friendly and go out of their way to make your stay comfortable and memorable. Did I mention that the flats are LARGE, which is not always the case in London. We were fortunate enough to be placed in a flat overlooking Hyde Park and Kensington High Street so it was fun looking out at all the life going on....from the nice little balcony! While this place will not meet everyone's budget, if you can make the jump to stay here, it is entirely worth the money. The location is perfect and I felt very safe here. In all honestly I can not find one fault with this place and that has never happened before in any place I have stayed. Two weeks after arriving back home in the States, I am still thinking of my stay here and wishing I were back NOW!

title: Vacation of a lifetime
text: I stumbled across this apartment while looking for hotel rooms for our vacation. One of the requirements was that it had to be close to Royal Albert Hall. Well, it IS that, and so much more! So much to see and do just a short distance in all directions. The apartments are huge, beautifully furnished, and imacculate. Beds are extremely comfortable and even the pillows were perfect! The views overlook Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. So cool!!! The staff was always quick to answer any questions, recommended some amazing pubs and places to shop. They took great care of us! Already planning our next visit across the pond, and we will be staying here again!

title: Beautiful apartments & great service
text: These apartments are absolutely stunning & the service was excellent, you are well looked after. I will be staying here again. The apartments directly overlook Hyde park & the rooms come with a coffee machine

title: Superb
text: This is absolutely lovely apartment, perfect location, very safe area around, the main benefit - the apartment really looks like on photos! Very large and comfortable kitchen, fully equipped. A lot of shops nearby

title: A RETURN VISIT - HOPE TO VISIT AGAIN SOON !
text: We have stayed at several Cheval residences and at this location previously. We returned this time to celebrate a family birthday and we were exceedingly well looked after - a particular thank you to Irene who made sure our stay was everything we could have hoped for. The location is perfect, the apartments are excellent and the service too is first class. Highly recommended.

title: Julaidan
text: This was my third time in Cheval Thorny Court and every time it was good experince. One of my favorit choices they have it all, good lcation, the staff are freindly, and comfortable good space appartments. The services are good always trying to make my stay as comfortable as possibale. Very good overall expereince.

title: Excellent stay
text: Spacious, clean, friendly and safe. Excellent choice for short and long stays. I usually stay in hotels nearby. I believe that if you are a family with kids, this will be a perfect location. the property well kept and the staff are so friendly.

title: Wonderful London Apt for families
text: We had an absolutely wonderful stay at CTC with our 4 children. The apartments are very spacious. The location of CTC could not be better! We were able to walk to museums and great restaurants, Whole Foods is right near by, Kensington Gardens are right across the street and the tube station is very close. We really loved everything about our stay. The concierge staff was very welcoming and friendly, making us feel at home. They were very attentive to our children, bringing them cold drinks after our long trip when we arrived. They were also very helpful when it came to navigating the city. We really were sad to leave CTC at the end of our vacation and hope to return!

title: Great appartment but sharp practce re deposit taken at the start of the stay
text: The apartment we had was fantastic and just as advertised - but this great experience was spoiled by the fact that I was told that it would take 5 to 6 days before my deposit of £150 per day (£750 in total) would be credited back to me, This means that my £750 deposit will have been with the company for c 14 days by the time it is returned to me. I understand the need for a deposit but there must be a way to check the apartment on our check out day and to sort out any issues there and then. Our great holiday in the apartment was marred by this financial practice re the deposit

title: Perfection
text: From the moment we stepped into the foyer our stay was absolute perfection. I've stayed in Cheval Three Quays previously so guessed Thorney Court would be good too ... and indeed it is. 4C is a vast, luxurious, immaculately presented 2-bedroom apartment with every mod-con to hand. We couldn't have been happier and wished we could have stayed longer.

title: Well done
text: It was our pleasure to stay at cheval Thorney court. It was our first time to stay in your nice appartment. Great place nice staff helpful. We wish to stay with you in our next vacation to London. Thank you once again :).

title: Great apartment
text: Recommend to all families who visit London . Just take the bus (9,10) and you are in the middle of Oxford Street. The Kengiston Garden just next to you . Starbucks Cafe a minute walk. 24 Open Grocery just nearby.

title: Wow
text: We decided to spend a couple of days in London and were struggling to find a room at a realistic price when I came across this Hotel. Well its not really a Hotel its more like serviced apartments that are generally used for people staying a few weeks or more. We booked a 1 room apartment online and when we arrived found that we had been allocated a 3 bedroom apartment. It was huge, 2,200 sq ft. The apartment had everything you could want including, a separate kitchen, large living room, large bedrooms. Everything was a very high standard. The location is excellent. Its near Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, Harrods and you can walk into The West End should you want to. If you are travelling and want a room for a regular hotel price but with more space, this would be a good option. Next time I bring the whole family to London I will be checking availability at this Hotel.

title: Grand residences in great location but terrible check in experience.
text: The location of these grand old residences is just in front of Kensington Gardens and Palace and offers great views over the Park and London. Easy access to the Park and many of the main tourist attractions. The serviced apartments are grand and huge but feel a little dated and in need of an upgrade though would appeal more to those liking old style 'English Country Home' furnishings. For my part, I had a terrible check in experience as a result of the hotel systems not updating a booking through an agent correctly and being kept for over an hour at 1am after a 24 hour journey. I was asked to pay over a thousand pounds on my credit card to check in for a booking that had already been paid for. The hotel of course blamed the agent and I was left on the middle, tired and angry while they tried to sort it out. Eventually it was sorted out the following morning but was a terrible start to what should have been a stay in a lovely place. The hotel is hidden away in a small alley off of Palace Gate and is certainly a little Oasis in London for those wanting to experience London and then escape. My rating is based on my total experience.

title: Best alternative for a family
text: European travel is difficult with children, and we had all 5 with us this trip. Hotels were quoting 3-4 rooms, with luxury hotels over several thousand dollars per night. Cheval offered the best value

title: Weekend with friends
text: This is luxury in London that is affordable. Beautiful rooms, bathrooms that work and the most comfortable beds ensure that you can just enjoy your stay without having to complain about anything at all!

title: stress free weekend

title: great place to stay

TV's in bedroom, wifi, plenty of space and even a fab garden area over looking kensington palace. We stayed in the 2 bed luxury and was very pleased with our choice. Great price for a london apartment in comparison to what you get (in terms of space) with 2 joining bedrooms in a hotel. Place was spotless and well maintained, staff were very helpful and friendly. Plenty of towels and bathrobes (although you do need children ones). My only disappointment was the cooking aroma in the apartment coming from (I think) other apartments. We stayed for 2 nights and I think any longer would have been hard for me to bear. Other than this a real 5* lux accommodation.

title: Smiths and Currys
text: Dear Sir, i have my wife to thanks for making this excellent booking. One of the best apartments we have ever stayed in. Beautifully appointed, excellent amenities and wonderful location next Hyde Park. Plenty of help available form the Concierge guys and so much more comfortable and adaptable than a hotel. We always stay in hotels when we come to town, but from now on its an apartment for us! Beds so comfortable, a little traffic noise but no trouble sleeping, if anything the apartment was too warm! One minor complaint, very minor, bigger coffee cups please. Thanks for a great weekend.

title: Best apartment in London

title: Very friendly and helpful staff. Martin was so helpful.

title: Relaxing holiday
text: If you want a good and relaxing holiday you should stay at the Cheval Thorney Court. Best service, top quality. And it's close to the lovely park so you can really get time to just have a rest from the busy life for a while.

title: Excellent
text: Very nice and spacious 3 bedroom apartment.Though I wish they had walk in showers instead of bath tubs . Hope they renovate that. The washing machine does not fully dries . I wish they add a dryer as well. Other than that it's a beautiful property, good location .Kids loved the park was so close. Nice staff.Well equipped kitchen. Wifi needs improvement. Nice concierge crevices.

title: Nice place to stay
text: I loved the place except for the non working air conditioning on the second room that made it very hot and a manual air conditioning had to be put in the bedroom and made a hell of a noise and had to leave the window open all night because of the exhaust.

title: Stay at Cheval Thorney, Kensington.

title: unsatisfied

title: Superb

title: Great Trip

For a family traveling from overseas, there should be a better selection of welcome supplies. Some of the other Cheval properties are better with their welcome packages. However, it is a wonderful property compared to the other Cheval residences in London.

title: Exellent Experience
text: High quality, well-located hotel with good staff and good amenities. Room was clean and spacious. Great access to Hyde Park. Decent access to Underground. Only drawback was street noise on Friday and Saturday nights.

title: Perfect place in the perfect spot

title: our stay at Cheval

text: I've never thought I would find such home feeling apartment in London. Definitely the best apartment I have stayed in London. The quality of service is phenomenal as it is more than what anyone can expect

title: Comfortable hotel
text: Nice and comfortable stay with cheval thorney court. Nice views over kensington garden. Halal restaurants closed by and the shopping stores in high street of kensington are just few steps far. Amazing staying.

title: Superb in every way imagineable
text: This is luxury at its best and not too unaffordable. We saved for this holiday and we were not disappointed. Our welcome was warm and gracious and fun. Our rooms superb. Day to day service fantastic. location out of this world. This it the hotel the rest of the world needs to set its standards by.

title: Great Experiance
text: I really enjoyed staying at Cheval Thorny Court, everything was perfect except I was disappointment that two rooms not having AC, where the concierge offered us with portable AC but was not available instead they provided us with a fan :)))

title: Luxury
text: Regular guest, best place to be when you are in London with family. Rooms are very spacious very clean and very safe for children you cannot hear any noise from other appartment or in the reception area

title: Very good apartment for family holiday
text: Very clean, (especially the towels and the bed linens), very comfortable apartment with good design and decorations, high standard maid service, good location with private parking, perfect place for family holiday.

title: eric claptons night
text: great place near the location i wanted to be, friendly staff, let me check in an hour earlier. The rooms where big well presented, clean, warm and nice deco. I would highly recommend this apartment to everyone i know, nice places to eat and drink too

title: London Stay
text: Great overall experience as usual at Cheval Residences. Keep up the good work and this is our home away from home in London. We will continue to frequent the residences as long as we need to be in London.

title: Luxury, comfort and location
text: Furniture and design of the apartment is great. But the TV should kept away from kids. It can be on the wall or on cupboard. There was housekeeping during the weekend. The telephone was not working. Wifi not available is not available in all rooms + the speed was low.

title: Wonderful stay
text: We had a five night stay to celebrate our 41st Wedding Anniversary at Thorney Court. The location is amazing, with a view over Hyde Park. Ten minutes from either tube station, tour bus and normal buses stop outside. A very friendly check in, with helpful conscierges especially Martin who was always cheery. The apartment was huge with good quality furnishings and facilities, and it really did look like on the website, which is often not the case. We never saw our housekeeper as we had very full days out, but the standard of housekeeping was excellent. The bed was huge and the sheets with changes every other day were really silky and without a crease, which made for a comfortable night. We were woken early a few times with sirens, and really strange, horses hooves!! We did see a large number of horses in the park but wonder where they are stabled! Everything you would need is available with a welcome starter pack with bread, butter, water, fruit etc. we were also given a card and champagne for our anniversary and upgraded to the largest two bedroom apartment with the best view. We had a great but tiring time in London and it was much nicer relaxing in a comfortable apartment with gowns and slippers on comfy sofas, than a hotel room. Lots of museums, parks, shops, pubs and restaurants nearby, I would definetly recommend and love to return to try one of the other Cheval residences next time I visit London.

title: Top place to stay in london
text: I stayed here several times. I stayed before at other places but this is the best one. Reservation with Irene was very convenient,helpful and quick. The concierge staff and receptionists were very polite and friendly. The were always ready to help any time and in a proffisonal manner. Thr apartment was very spacious ,clean and well furnished. The security was excellent and we felt very secure living at Cheval. I strongly recommend staying at Cheval Thorney Court and I rate it top No 1 among Cheval residences.

title: Perfect with kids
text: Travelled with our 3 year old. Plenty of space for her and us, within walking distance of museums. Apartments are just gorgeous, and concierge very helpful! Will definitely use again. Lots of lovely little touches. Our daughter loved her little dressing gown and slippers.

title: The best accomodation I have ever been
text: I have wtitten on previous Page) : everything is amazing! Thank you for complimentary upgrade for our family. Fantastic Atmosphere, now in London only with you! Whole Foods (healthy options) is just two steps from CR - it is very important for me!

title: Perfection!
text: From the moment the sliding glass doors brought our group of four into the well appointed lobby we were treated like Royalty. The manager, Craig, couldn't have been any more accommodating or charming. Our request for an upper floor with a view was unable to be met, but we were treated to an upgrade and a slightly earlier check-in. Our "home away from home" met and exceeded all of our expectations. Beautifully decorated, incredibly clean and beyond spacious. The location was also spot on with the Hop on Hop off bus tour stopping right in front of the hotel, Hyde park across the street, Kensington Palace, this, all within a delightful neighborhood full of wonderful little spots to dine. The staff, in particular Sam with his welcoming smile, were all beyond friendly and most professional.
