While it states that housekeeping was only provided on week days, we had these services over the weekend, which really made for a nice stay. It was with full regret that we checked out, but right until the final goodbye the professional, over-the-top service continued as Craig helped wheel the luggage up to the waiting taxi.

title: Like no where else
text: This is my one and only place to stay when traveling to London, you can't find such luxury and fancy residence to stay in , plus the beautiful stuff who become like my family , very helpful always smiling, they never ever disappointed me in all my visits to London , I can't remember how many times i stayed there cause this is the only place i like to stay in when visiting London

title: Weekend Visit
text: WOWWWWWWWWWWWWW - what service - the staff were so kind and caring - we were attending a wedding and the rooms were ready in super fast time. The room was spotless - air conditioning was a god send. The bed was amazing, bathroom, towels, everything 5*. The garden was lovely to sit in and the breakfast excellent. Would highly recommend.

title: gig stopover
text: Really enjoyed our stay here albeit short, staff and facilities excellent, room fantastic, the bar area is really clean and the toilets very clean and no expense spared in the décor would definitely stay here again if in the area. We were looked after as soon as we arrived, and the free parking is a bonus, especially in London

title: Excellent staff with exceptional customer service
text: We stayed here for a couple of nights whilst visting family nearby. From the second we walked in the door the staff could not be more helpful, from carrying our bags to our room and explaining it to us, to getting us fresh milk for our morning tea, nothing was too much trouble. Our room was spacious and clean, and although the hotel is beside a very busy road, the double glazed windows do block most of the noise. Breakfast was very good with a large choice to meet all needs. We did not eat in but wish we had as the food and atmosphere appeared excellent. Overall an excellent stay.

title: Shocking customer service
text: We had some issues shortly after we booked into our room. Staff were not willing to listen or to help us in any way so we were unable to stay here. I had to book into another hotel. I tried to speak to the manager over the telephone but couldn't get through until 2 days after our stay I spoke to a member of staff who was very rude. I finally got to speak to the manager who was very dismissive. The only positive is we got to spend a night at the Crowne Plaza and our stay was perfect.

title: Perfect stay with friendly staff
text: Stayed here for 1 night in room 2. Nicely decorated with great touches like robes and very importantly a Nespresso machine. staff super friendly which can be rare in London. Breakfast was the highlight of our stay. Warm service. Both full English and eggs Benedict were delicious. Throughout our stay we felt very well looked after. Wouldn't hesitate to stay again!

title: Brilliant team
text: 2nd visit The whole team from housekeeping to front of house, went above and beyond to ensure we had a comfortable stay in difficult circumstances for us,nothing was too much trouble All round excellence as standard. All good wishes for 2019 and your continued deserved success

title: Lovely all day spot!
text: I love this place! Perfect to the last detail! Thanks to Jemma & Matt ! Delicious , well- cocked all day menu for all different tastes! Good drinks and amazing cocktails by George ! Really friendly staff that make you feel really welcome! Such a cozy bar area! Lovely room really modern but classy as well! Lovely lovely place with lovely staff that works so hard to keep everyone pleased !

title: Top pub!!!
text: Great place to stay in an up and coming location with great accessibility to the city. Food was great. 🍺 was great!! Couldn’t recommend more and the Sunday roasts are also to die for!! Five stars all round

title: Great hotel
text: We were at a wedding around the corner and stayed at the Tulse Hill hotel for one night. Really couldn't fault it. We arrived early to a warm welcome. It's a pub / restaurant downstairs. Nice interior design, good coffee and a yummy breakfast, which was included (We had eggs Benedict and a full brekkie). The room was great, again nice interior and touches... even a feather pillow! I would definitely recommend

title: Wedding anniversary treat
text: Great hotel with lovely staff. We stayed here after having a day out in the city, it’s really easy to get to via train, the staff were brilliant, very welcoming and really looked after us. The room was superb, a lovely comfy bed and everything we needed to have a great stay. We had dinner and breakfast here too and the food was amazing! Would definitely recommend!

title: Excellent
text: Stayed for one night on business. Hotel was lovely - room was so welcoming, clean and comfortable with lovely extra touches in the room - went for a lovely meal in the restaurant. The staff were so lovely and attentive. Breakfast was excellent too. Will definitely stay again.

title: Perfect place to stay
text: We stayed here for the night for a family wedding. The staff were very welcoming and friendly. The room was spotless and beautifully decorated. The breakfast in the morning was amazing. It was really easy to get into central London from the nearby train station. I really couldn't fault this place, I wished we could have stayed for longer!

title: Just Amazing - Service and Food. Well Done!
text: I had to leave a review as my friend and I went for Sunday lunch yesterday (Mothers Day) and first of all managed to get a walk in table which was shocking as the customer service, food and wine was just AMAZING! I was so shocked at the lengths the staff went to to ensure we had a nice time. Really is something special - well done to the guys that bought it and refurbed it as it looks amazing and was just a wonderful experience. Will be going back again and again and again! The only negative thing is that more and more people will begin to realise how fab this place is and I won't be able to get a table soon!

title: Sunday lunch
text: Really nice atmosphere and very pleasant staff. Lunch was good and plentiful but gravy was a bit thin for us. All the accompanying sides were given in a sharing bowl. We had a sharing chicken platter which was really tasty although you were left to carve your own with a very sharp knife. Will definitely be returning.

title: Very comfortable
text: Stayed two nights here in the heatwave and was delighted to find excellent air conditioning in the room. The rooms are very stylish with excellent bathrooms

title: Grwat hotel
text: Great hotel. Friendly staff who looked after us well. Rooms were very nice and the a.c. worked great as it was 35 degrees outside. Close to the train station which was handy Highly recommended, wish we had longer there

title: Awful Service
text: What can I say but I will not eat here again, which is a shame as the food was good (when it eventually came). I booked a birthday lunch for four and the afternoon started well. Whilst waiting for others to arrive the staff were friendly but for some unknown reason this changed when my guests arrived. It took twenty minutes for anyone to approach and ask if we wanted drinks then almost another twenty minutes to ask if we wanted to order our food (before you ask it was not that busy). Waiting for over an hour for food when everyone around you is being served, even when they arrive after you, is very frustrating. No one came to offer us any further drinks or ask if the food was okay. At one point I wondered if we had somehow contracted the plague. It took a long time to clear away our plates and again we weren't asked if we wanted anything else. In the end we put our coats on to indicate that we were ready to go as no one approached us again so we couldn't ask for the bill. After a further fifteen minutes someone eventually came over and asked if we wanted the bill.....really. I hope the service does improve because I normally do like to support local places but there are much better and friendlier options nearby and they always make you feel welcome.

title: One night stay.
text: Stayed here for one night in July which happened to be the night England played Columbia in the world cup. I was very surprised at the standard of the room. It was modern very clean and had everything I required. The staff were very friendly and keen to assist in any way. The food was excellent and so was the service. As you would imagine on that night the place was full to the max and still the staff were very attentive and jolly. The atmosphere was bussing and fantastic. I would definitely recommend this place to stay and I certainly will be returning in the near future.

title: Excellent service, amazing stay!
text: Stayed at Tulse Hill Hotel while visiting London for a few nights. Service and accomodation were exceptional. Staff were extremely friendly, making us feel incredibly welcome. The bedrooms were clean, bright and modern! After a great nights sleep on a huge bed we were treated to an amazing breakfast with a large selection of delicious menu options all made with super fresh ingredients! We will definitely stay on our next visit to London! Thanks team!!

title: The Good and not so Good!
text: I would have marked Tulse Hill down as excellent, however one issue prevented this which I will mention later. This was our second stay at Tulse Hill having travelled from Derby, it's got a lovely atmosphere about it and a cracking little restaurant. Ideally placed to visit the near by borough's of Herne Hill, Brixton and Dulwhich, also a 15 minute train ride from London City. The train station is no more than a 10 minute walk with very regular trains. We stayed in room 6 which is not for the faint hearted, it's situated at the top of the hotel and up a couple of flights of stairs, the second being steep. The room itself was immaculate, excellent bathroom with all the trimmings including bathrobes but no bath. The bed was huge and very comfortable, the TV was adequate. One small complaint about the room would be the noise from the traffic. Moving onto why it didn't receive an excellent rating, SERVICE CHARGE. Apologies to the Management if this charge is highlighted on their website or menus as I didn't and can't see where it was. I do not agree with adding a service charge especially when it's a table for two, a group booking I can accept as long as it's been highlighted. How a service charge can be automatically applied to both food and drink along with the level of service you receive is very presumptuous. We had decided to dine on this visit, the menu was limited, however we both decided to go for the Sunday Roast Whole Chicken to share @ £38.00, this included a large Yorkshire Pudding, Roast Potatoes, Carrots and Greens with small boat of Gravy. Now here is a reason why I don't agree with adding an automatic service charge, the Chef rang the bell and placed our dinners under a hot light, the waitresses on the evening were aware the dinners were sat there, rather than bring them over they walked passed them, one went over to take an order from a table that had come in after us and the other was milling around not doing much. We sat there and waited watching the dinners for around 6 minutes before the dinners were acknowledged. When served they wasn't the hottest of dinners and we waited further for our sauces to arrive which we had asked for when first taking our order. A word of warning for all fellow TripAdvisor Reviewers who plant to eat here, either order your drinks from the bar beforehand or ask if they are going put the service charge on all drinks, this can work out expensive. Based on our dinners being sat under an hot light instead of immediately being served, we asked for the service charge to be removed in the morning. This was accepted and an apology was given. I would still highly recommend staying at the Hotel.

title: Excellent
text: We heard through the grapevine that the Tulse Hill Tavern had re-opened after a refurbishment and decided to go for a meal with friends who were visiting for the weekend. We have lived around the corner and never been before. In a nutshell, we all thought it was wonderful. The food was excellent. Three of us had the whole mackerel, which was beautifully cooked and couldn't be faulted. The vegetables come as a side dish, so we ordered the buttered cabbage and the purple sprouting broccoli which were also delicious and perfectly cooked. The handout (not out of a giant bag) chips were superb. The wine list was extensive and our beer drinker enjoyed the Greene King IPA.... The staff are lovely and attentive but not overly so and they are keen to make a great success of this new venture. We left feeling warmed and happy and excited that we have a lovely new local within 2 minutes walk from our home. GO there.

title: Exceeded my expectations
text: What a great find. Located on the South Circular I thought it would be noisy but well located. Room 5 was large, had a huge king sized bed, great pillows, AC and importantly great double glazing. No noise, great sleep. A large clean modern bathroom with a rain shower and hand held, good pressure,nice toiletries. Good quality tea, coffee, water and biscuits. The pub downstairs had some great beers and a nice outside area. We didn’t eat as there are plenty of great places in Brixton, but the food looked good. Try it, you’ll like it.

title: Perfect for the price
text: Booked this hotel last minute to attend a festival in Brockwell Park. We arrived early at 12pm and check in wasn't until 2pm, however the staff accommodated us and managed to turn the room round for us at 12:30pm so we were able to check in and get to the festival on time :) The rooms were spacious, modern and clean with the COMFIEST bed i've ever slept in! Then bathroom was lovely and clean and the shower was great. Perfect location just a 5 minute walk from the tube station with links into Tower Bridge, we couldn't of asked for better! The rooms are noisy with the traffic outside, that's the only issue we had, however after a few wines we slept perfectly well. As we were out late at the festival and checking out on Monday morning the hotel staff said we could have a later check out free of charge. Brilliant service and i'd definitely return, thanks so much :)

title: Great overnight stay
text: Stayed whilst on a training course this week and couldn’t have been happier with my hotel choice. Staff are welcoming, efficient and friendly. Room rate was very reasonable and I don’t think I could have gotten better quality for this price. I felt completely comfortable on my own in both the gorgeous hotel room (which had a very comfy big bed) and the pub itself. The beer garden is very peaceful, and I like the eating area outside that didn’t allow smoking. Evening meal was great, and breakfast in the morning was fabulous. Boiled eggs and soldiers! Highly recommended. Thank you all.

title: Loving our new local
text: Very excited for this to open on my doorstep! I haven't stayed here, but enjoyed a beautiful lunch before Christmas. We shared lots of different starters which were all amazing, and the steak was to die for. They've put a lot into the renovation and it is a beautiful place with great atmosphere and friendly service. The only reason I haven't given it a 5 is due to a severely overcooked burger on another visit. Hopefully it was just a blip..

title: Beautiful bolthole
text: We enjoyed a beautiful meal and diverse wine selection at this super pub/hotel. Hosted by incredibly attentive staff we felt warmly welcomed on arrival to our room and in the restaurant. Highly recommend a trip or day out to Tulse Hill!

title: Great value
text: Stayed for 1 night while visiting family. Our room (7) was on the top floor looking out across the busy Tulse Hill junction. The double (triple?) glazing kept the vast majority of traffic noise out, so we weren't disturbed at all during the night. Room spotless, very comfortable bed, great shower. Good breakfast selection. The value - £105 B&B midweek - excellent, as was the real ale. Highly recommended

title: Sorry to burst the bubble......
text: Having seen it being refurbished two of us went in for a bar meal a couple of weeks ago - truly excellent. Three of us went yesterday evening. Burgers were seriously overcooked - nearly cremated, very salty, otherwise unseasoned - the cheese was a partially unmelted slice of "prefab" cheddar. Very disappointing for a £12 burger. The ribs were fantastic. We'll give it another go because everybody has a bad day but £50 for two dodgy burgers and some ribs - albeit with a drink is a very full price.

title: Great food but one member of staff today was incredibly rude...
text: I have lived in Tulse Hill for 10 years and am really pleased with the renovation and have visited many times to eat. It isn't cheap but the quality of the food is worth it and ther service usually very good. Today i was told by the barmaid that the restaurant was"fully booked" even though it was empty. She then said i could choose a table in the bar that wasn't already booked - even though no one turned up for the booked tables while we were there. She didn't show us to a table and as i walked away she literally shouted across the room "excuse me" holding the menu out. Her attitude stank from the get-go. When i bought and paid for the food she was rude, tapped the card machine repeatedly saying "take your card" and didnt thank me. My son's order was wrong and had to go back. The manager changed it and he was polite. When i went to the bar to get a drink she made a point of looking daggers at me. Ridiculous. The other barmaid told me i couldnt use my card unless i spent a minimum of £10 even though i'd just spent over £30 on food. She said she would do it "this once" not acknowledging the fact ''d just paid for a meal. Its a shame that one bad attitude and rudeness has changed my opinion of the place.

title: Great venue
text: Stayed here to celebrate daughters birthday in March 2015. Excellent meal in the restaurant with attentive service despite being fully booked. Lovely room and wide choice for breakfast. Thank you and will be back soon. Sue and Steve.

title: A Reliable and Relaxed Small Hotel
text: I first stayed at the Tulse Hill Hotel, for one night, in March this year. I reached it by train to Tulse Hill station, which is five minutes walk from the hotel. At first sight that day, the dark Victorian pub, on an enormous road junction of the South Circular Road, caused my heart to sink. But on that occasion, as on this, my welcome was relaxed and informal, and the interior of the hotel completely belied its exterior. If you want hotel with a smart reception desk and lifts, this isn't the place for you. You walk in to the (very acceptable) bar area, and 'reception' is a tiny office. But the formalities of reception are blissfully short, and you will be shown to your room. There is access to hotel rooms aside from the access for those who use the bar and restaurant, which is useful late at night. Although I have never driven to this hotel, there is good car parking. The rooms have very recently been refurbished and are in characteristic modern boutique style. Everything is spotlessly clean, and the beds are comfortable. There is complimentary still mineral water, an alarmingly sophisticated coffee maker, and facility to make tea. The rooms are double-glazed, and when the blinds are drawn the endless traffic not far away is not too obtrusive. They have recently installed air conditioning units in rooms. These make the rooms deliciously cool, without the need to open the windows and thus admit traffic noise. The units are quite noisy. You can switch them off. I am a light sleeper, but I have slept well on both my visits to Tulse Hill Hotel. Breakfast is in the restaurant, which is a high-ceilinged room off the bar, with doors onto a very large, walled patio garden. So you can eat breakfast outside in summer. Breakfast is served to you and not a buffet. There are choices of different types of breakfast. I have enjoyed my breakfast on both of my visits. If you don't know London, I should perhaps say to you that the part of Tulse Hill where the hotel is located is not either the most fashionable and beautiful part of London, or the most impoverished part of London. It's quite safe to walk the streets, but you may want to drive, walk, or catch a train to other neighbourhoods nearby if you want slightly more upmarket shops and restaurants. The proximity of the hotel to the South Circular makes it ideal for travellers needing a stopover. But if you are a London tourist, there are train services nearby which will have you in Central London in a short time. I think the Tulse Hill Hotel is well run, relaxed, clean, friendly, and comfortable.

title: Great welcome, excellent hospitality
text: Cannot fault the friendly young team at Tulse Hill. Nothing seemed too much trouble for Belinda, Hannah, Sean and colleagues. Bedroom was beautifully furnished, super-comfy bed, lovely bathroom. Breakfast menu superb. Excellent value, at £135 for a twin room per night. We'll definitely be back.

title: Brilliant addition to the area
text: For those of us who knew what this place was before, it is an amazing transformation! The interior is really fresh and welcoming - still has the pub feel but really modern. The food is fantastic - on all the occasions we've been and in the summer the outside area is great. I do hope it continue to be popular, so that it can be successful as this place really is a great addition to the local area.

title: Value for Money
text: From the minute we arrived for a 3 night stay we could not fault the service, room or food. Becca especially went way beyond need be to help us sort a birthday cake we were having delivered to the hotel. The room was scrupulously clean, they had even supplied an air condition unit due to very hot weather. The breakfast was to die for,especially home made granola, yoghurt and honey. Without exception the staff were extremely pleasant and helpful and nothing was too much bother and delivered with a smile. Can't wait to return.

title: South London Gem...
text: A daughter's nearby wedding was the reason behind our 3 night stay at this excellent gem of a hotel in south London. We stayed in a family room at the front of the hotel which given the hotel's location on a main crossroad meant there was some traffic noise. However, as other reviewers have already noted the high standard, comfort and cleanliness of the rooms

title: Best pub in south london
text: I adore this pub. With magnificent feasts, magical beers and attractive staff, the THT is an absolute gem. Can't recommend the place enough. The cuttle fish and beef cheek croquettes blew my mind. My wife and I come here often and are satisfied every visit. 6 stars

title: Wonderful Surprise!!
text: Finding this little gem of a traditional English Inn was a stroke of amazing good fortune. We wanted to be outside of London, closer to friends who are SW of the city. The recently renovated rooms and bathrooms are so comfortable and beautifully appointed: Krups/Nespresso coffee service, rain shower stall showers, comfy king beds. The pub itself serves great food and drink, with gourmet breakfast included in our room price. The staff are all over the top friendly and helpful. We hope to return on our next visit.

title: Lovely evening meal
text: Visited the hotel for a birthday celebration meal. Served by Renata, who was polite, helpful and very attentive. The food was lovely and the staff made us feel very relaxed. We definitely plan on visiting again

title: Inspired Renovation
text: This early Victorian tavern has been sensitively and imaginatively restored. The result is a spacious bar/restaurant, accompanied by nine bedrooms. Our room was comfortable, well-appointed and carefully insulated from traffic noise. It is a busy location, of course, but this did not intrude, and we appreciated the proximity of public transport, especially the railway station. Guests arriving by car have access to dedicated parking slots, a bonus anywhere in London. We had the opportunity to sample both breakast, and lunch (with guests), and can commend the quality of food being served here. Every member of staff we encountered was attentive, helpful and competent. This new venture deserves to succeed, and, judging by the number of customers we saw that weekend, it will.

title: Great all you can drink brunch
text: Had a very nice brunch. Choice of English breakfast, eggs royale / benedict / florentine, etc. Had 2 hours of drinks which were interchangeable. Our waiter Mario was excellent, always topping up our drinks and severing us after at the bar. Great place for a party.

title: Ripper of a Roast
text: My girlfriend and I went for Sunday lunch and it was outstanding. We had the Roast Beef and the Roast chicken and were outstanding. Delicious, good quality meat as well as solid portions. The wine menu was very good and not outrageously priced which is always a bonus.

title: Good location
text: Nicely revamped Pub/Hotel 3 years ago. Really friendly service and beautifully appointed spotless ensuite bedrooms with comfy bed! Breakfast cooked to order and from what we saw of the dinner food, it would be worth staying in for. Great atmosphere and certainly no need for the background thumping music which unfortunately did take a little from our stay as on all 3 nights we had to ask for it to be turned down or turned off after midnight. We will, however, return.

title: Lovely meal
text: Had a great meal consisting of very well balanced starters and perfectly cooked steaks for mains. Add in perfect service, super attentive staff in the restaurant and behind the bar and you can't fail to have a great time here. Would love to spend a night in the hotel.

title: Sunday lunch
text: The restaurant at the Tulse Hill hotel serves hearty food. The portion sizes are huge, just check out their Yorkshire puddings, massive! I have eaten there before in the summer where they have their hog roast and bbq station in the garden. The food was amazing! It's always really busy, so you really need to book. This time, when we went today I was quite disappointed. We choose exactly the same dish as it was so delicious the last time, but it didn't live up to my previous outing at all. The crackling was fantastic but the pork belly was tough and not enjoyable. My mum couldn't even cut through it I had to do it for her. To be fair though, when the waitress came to clear our plates and saw we left the meat but ate all the vegetables, she asked if we enjoyed the meal. I said no it was disappointingly tough. So she gave us our desserts for Free! So whilst I'd give them 10 out of 10 for goodwill, in trying to rectify the situation, I have rated it as average. The meal was far from memorable this time, it was completely packed with young couples with babies, who were allowed to crawl all over the floor in a very busy restaurant! I'm sure there's a safety issue there, but no one else was complaining, and it was ever so noisy in there it was hard to have a conversation. The bill worked out to approximately £30 per head for 2 courses with one glass of wine each. I haven't written the place off. But I might leave it till summer to go back and see if the Al fresco dining is better.

title: Good Food, attentive staff
text: Great experience, because there was 11 of us we had our own private room, the food was very good, everyone really enjoyed their meal, the chicken pie looked delicious, i had fish and chips, the fish was huge could not finish it all, and i really enjoyed the apple pie for dessert, great cocktails, the staff where attentive and friendly they really did look after us and great price too, will definitely be back

title: Celebration Night Out
text: My wife an I stayed at the Tulse Hill Hotel as part of a birthday celebration and show in London. So we opted for a superior room and we weren't disappointed. The room was very clean with good amenities such as a Nespresso coffee machine, iPod docking station and a Dyson fan. The bed was comfortable and the shower was excellent. What was also commendable was the food. Evening meals and breakfast were all excellent. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout at at breakfast in particular nothing was too much trouble. The only negatives were that the room was rather warm and the ventilation options were limited in terms of how far you could open the window, hence the fan was a life-saver and London prices!

title: An amazing private dining room with top notch staff
text: We spent a glorious Saturday afternoon and evening in the Newsroom, the private dining room at the Tulse hill hotel, celebrating a friend's baby shower. We were 11 guests and one toddler and were treated to a wonderful afternoon in beautiful surroundings. I booked the newsroom about 6 weeks before the event. The staff were excellent in the lead up with putting on a bespoke menu for us (afternoon tea), answering all my questions about the room and set up for the day. We were lucky that there were no other bookings in the Newsroom that day so we had it from 1.30pm until late. We were able to decorate the room and it looked great. The food was absolutely delicious and so much of it! The staff were an absolute delight and couldn't do enough for us. We had such a fantastic afternoon and can't thank the Tulse Hill Hotel enough for making us feel so welcome. Can't rate this place highly enough and there really is no other private dining room like this in the area.

title: Awesome food - Amazing service
text: We went to the THH just for a meal and some drinks with friends to celebrate our upcoming marriage (we live local so didn't stay). The food is brilliant, the drinks great (the espresso martinis were bang on) and our waiter Toby was an absolute rockstar. Nothing was too much for him, he was so accommodating and lovely and everytime he came over to our table he has us in stitches. We loved him and will be back! Thanks Toby :)

title: This is a review of the bar/ restaurant. Great food and cocktails at a reasonable price
text: This place has been done up recently apparently. I'm new to the area and have been a few times for drinks and food. Nice beer garden out the back and nice relaxed atmosphere. The food is very good and the bar staff knowledgable about the drinks and very friendly. They seem to have a good use of seasonal produce.

title: Fantastic
text: I stayed here from the 14th for 3 days It's located on a busy crossroads but once inside it's quiet and the bar/ restaurant area and especially the beer garden are amazing The food and drinks at breakfast and dinner are superb and the staff especially Jess are amazing The bedrooms were also brilliant and I would definitely stay here again and thoroughly recommend Thank you Michael

title: Great base to visit London
text: The hotel staff were very helpful, the room was spacious and accommodating for 2 adults and a baby, it was clean and very tidy offering tea, coffee and air conditions The bathroom was modern and fully equipped with a shower and bath The price was very reasonable and the food was delicious It is on a main busy road so expect some noise from the traffic below if you have a front facing room I would definitely stay here again

title: Wonderful.
text: We stayed here as we had to deliver some stuff to my brother who lives locally. The hotel is outstanding. We had booked a superior room which was upgraded to what is one of the finest hotel rooms I have ever seen. Huge bed. Maximum comfort. Wonderful wonderful bathroom. Fabulous cosmetics. The food is beyond reproach and the atmosphere friendly, lively and yet, for a busy junction, near silent in the rooms. A superb wee hotel which is really handy for central London

title: Lovely, fab hotel
text: We were really impressed with the Tulse Hill Hotel. The pub and restaurant has a cosy warm atmosphere when you walk in. The staff were welcoming and couldn't do enough for us, booking taxis, etc. Rooms are clean and beautifully decorated with facilities and final touches well thought though

title: Re visit
text: This was the second or third time that we had visited the hotel. As always good reception upon arrival. Getting to the rooms is a struggle as no lift! On this occasion we had to take the superior room as all the other rooms were reserved. Our expectations were raised as on previous visits the rooms had been exceptionally appointed. You can imagine our disappointment when we discovered a number of problems in the bathroom not least the temperature of the hot water tap from the handsink which was both instantainious and hazardous. Other fittings were falling off the wall and the shower/ bath was not draining properly. Breakfast was as usual exceptional with great service.Reported the problems to staff the following morning who assured us that they would make repairs. We do hope so as was our favourite short stay hotel.

title: Great addition to the area
text: My friend and I had a three course meal. Brilliant new local restaurant. Interesting menu, beautiful interior and outside space. This is a fantastic new addition to the local are so please support it.

title: Really impressed Tulse Hill Hotel
text: Just completed a 3 night stay . Very impressed with this hotel. Warm frendly welcome easy check in slight climb to room but lovely very clean room and big comfortable bed. Coffee and tea making facilities. Spotless bathroom with very good amenities -wonderful shower. Breakfast each morning was excellent and good selection. All staff were lovely and soooo helpful. Never written a review before but this Hotel and it's staff really deserve a few minutes praise. Will definitely recommend and use again. Thank you.

title: Lovely pub, great cocktails, tasty food.
text: Great for tasty cocktails: the Bellini is my favourite. There is a decent outdoor area at the back if the weather is good. There is some traffic noise from the adjacent south civility but not enough to spoil your enjoyment! Food is good too although some dishes seem a tad overpriced compared to other places in the area.

title: Great evening
text: Spent a lovely evening with two friends at the tulse hill hotel. Toby was our waiter and he was just brilliant so attentive and very funny! We shared the cote de bouef which was huge for two people but we managed it! Great wine and amazing chocolate orange espresso martinis! Thanks tulse hill hotel and Toby- I will definitely be back!

title: Fab roast, lovely staff, great way to spend a Sunday afternoon
text: I had heard this place did a great roast and I wasn't disappointed when I popped in yesterday afternoon. I rang late morning and was lucky enough to get a table for 2, and if you want to visit I would advise booking ahead as well, as it was nicely busy. Great service from the staff, in particular Toby, who was very attentive and couldn't do enough for us, and the food was DELISH. We shared a roasted Ham Hock and thoroughly enjoyed it. Will definitely be back - thank you for a lovely afternoon A+++++

title: Busy gastropub that nevertheless serves decent food
text: I am always a bit suspicious of gastropubs, especially those that price their dishes with no currency signs, such as 11.5, instead of £11.50, or who serve food on wood or slate. These clues signify: pretentious! However, this one was perfectly acceptable. It's situated at a very busy place, right on the South Circular, but that wasn't a problem in itself. As other reviewers have mentioned, it can get quite noisy, not from the traffic but from the other customers. But that's not unique to here

title: Lovely weekend
text: We stayed at this hotel for 3 days and were very pleasantly surprised. The hotel is a pub with several delightful rooms. Our room was on the third floor and it was a lovely We had a 5 foot bed and tea and coffee making facilities, a beautifully clean bathroom and excellent air conditioner. The pub was extremely well stocked and the food was well cooked and presented. The waitresses were all very attentive and friendly in fact superb, The manager could not do enough to help. Thank to everyone. A very excellent weekend!

title: Yes! What a wonderful place!
text: Welcome to the neighborhood! We couldn't be happier. Matt and Gemma have done an amazing job - the food is amazing and the decor is gorgeous. A warm inviting atmosphere and great food. Well done to all involved and we are so happy to have the THH.

title: Very nice concept, but so noisy...
text: I spent one night and the Tulse Hill is a very nice concept. Small room but very clean. You even have a Nespresso in your room. Very well decorated. Very nice staff. At ground floor, Pub, Restaurant and outdoor tables. The area where it is located is quite old and nothing to do around. However my rate is 2 because you guys didn't take care of well being of your customer against the noise from the street. It is not serious to not have acoustically insulated your rooms (at least the number 4) with good quality window. I should claim you my money back as I couldn't sleep from very noisy carrefour your hotel is located. I cannot imagine how so nice people like you are, didn't managed this. I am very disappointed!

title: Would recommend
text: Great value for money.The room and communal areas were decorated nicely and were very clean.The bed was comfortable but a bit small. Breakfast was very good with a lot of choice. It also benifited with a secure car park around the back.

title: Tulse Hill Hotel offers fantasic rooms, service, and food.
text: Earlier this month, I traveled to London for a wedding and stayed at the Tulse Hill Hotel in Tulse Hill. I have stayed in more than a few hotels in London in the past and this was by far one of the best experiences I have ever had there. The staff were friendly, accommodating, and took genuine care in their customers. Whether it was in the gorgeous restaurant or in the garden patio, food service was spectacular. The food - the food was superb! Even if you were not staying there, I would recommend the restaurant here. Every meal we had there was positively delicious and the breakfast included with our stay was truly wonderful. So many options and every one of them was delicious. The refurbished rooms in the hotel were clean, bright, and a great size with large comfy beds and large en suite bathrooms. Between the service, cleanliness, food, and genuine care the staff at this hotel clearly have in what they do there, I would not hesitate to recommend this hotel, and I look forward to staying there again on my next trip across the pond. Truly top notch!

title: Service so good I had my 40th and surprise engagement here
text: I will review this in the correct location, i.e the restaurant and not the hotel as others have incorrectly done, so please see there for my review. However I can say we have recommended several friends and family to stay here and they have all been really pleased with it - comfy rooms, surprisingly quiet considering it's location and a great breakfast! Very close to station which in turn is 20 mins into Central London.

title: Sunday lunch
text: visited on Sunday 11th June, sat outside in the lovely back garden. Great food, playing really cool music too which had a nice 'chill out Ibiza vibe' and lovely service from Jess who really looked after us. this is a great jewel in south London :)

title: Fun place
text: Amazing local pub, went there with some friends and we had great time, good drinks, delicious food, and we had an amazing service from a very friendly waitress called Renata, she was super helpful and smiling, we all love her tattoo. Cool place to have fun with the friends...

title: Don't judge by outwood appearance
text: We were attending a wedding of an old friend in West Dulwich. When the bride told us she had booked a room for us above a pub on Norwood road on a Saturday night we were apprehensive. Our apprehension seemed justified as we entered the popular and noisy pub at 10.30 pm. However, once we had opened the door marked "hotel rooms" the change in atmosphere was dramatic. With a warm welcome we were shown into a remarkably large room, with a sofa, and a truly marvellous well-equipped bathroom, with free bath robes. Despite the situation we had a quiet and peaceful night in a very wide bed. Breakfast next morning was cooked to order very quickly and was delicious. There were plenty of attentive staff. We would welcome the chance to stay there again. A luxury boutique hotel hides above a popular pub.

title: Ok but expensive
text: Very smart, busy and interesting menu. Is expensive but it didn't quite work for me. Burger was ok but would rather it was served on a plate rather than wood as difficult to eat without making a mess. Family eat here quite a lot so it must be doing something right

title: Amazing local!
text: I moved to Tulse Hill in July and have since be here several times. The staff are excellent, I am also in the industry and their product knowledge and enthusiasm makes you feel very welcome and at home. The food is always awesome, I even had a vegetarian quinoa chilli as it sounded so good (I am not a veggie!) and it delivered. Just wanted to say thank you and you have a fab team, you should be proud!

title: Great Find
text: Arrived in the secure carpark, the gates are locked at midnight which was reassuring. We were welcomed into bar area to check in, which was quick and easy, my partner and I along with my parents were on the 2nd floor, The rooms were beautifully decorated and furnished, lovely and clean with a fab view. The hotel has been recently renovated so everything felt new and shiny. We didn't eat dinner here but the food looked very good the staff behind the bar were very friendly. Definitely recommend the breakfast. We would have no hesitation staying here again or recommending this hotel.

title: Great room, great food
text: I switched last minute to the Tulse hill hotel, and I'm glad I did. The rooms are fitted out to a high standard, with everything you would need for an overnight stay. The food was fabulous, and well priced. Had steak Mondays, steak, chips and a glass of red wine all for £15. Breakfast provided a good choice of food, all cooked fresh. Would definitely stay again.

title: Tulse hill hotel
text: We stayed 3 nights in this newley refurbished hotel. Hotel very nice tastefully done the breakfast was amazing included in the price.The staff are well trained and so friendly,there's a pub underneath the accomadation but you don't hear any noise.. We ate in the restaurant one night food and ambiance good. Good links to get into London by train to Tower Bridge. My gripes we had come off a long haul flight and had a lot of luggage we had to climb so many stairs had been put on top floor,we are in our sixtys.In there defense we chose the cheapest rate hence the stairs . Last thing our window looked over the main street so all the double deckers and apartements across the road could look in couldn't close the blind as the room would have been in darkness in the daytime .I would stay again yes indeed.

title: Anniversary Break
text: What a great place to stay. Comfortable rooms and bed, well equipped bathroom with fantastic shower. The restaurant did top notch food very well presented by very friendly staff, who clearly know how to look after their customers. A 2 minute walk to the train station and then just 15 minutes to London Bridge. Tulse Hill Hotel is a handy place to stay, far enough from the city to be away from the bustle but close enough to be convenient. And if you drive there (like us) there is secure free parking. Not many places boast that these days!!

title: Monday Night Steak Supper
text: This was my first trip this place for diner, and it certainly will not be the last. What a find! The staff were very attentive (Chris) and lovely. They seemed to genuinely care that I was having a nice meal. Speaking of, my steak (with wine for £15) was perfectly cooked and yummy. Great value. Great night, I will be back. I live one stop away on the train so didn't have a room, but going from the decoration and service we got in the restaurant, it must be a safe bet to say it would be a good place to stay. To the staff, thank you!

title: Great Stay at Tulse Hill
text: Had a very good stay - 3 nights - in the best bed ever. Very comfortable - had a very good nights sleep. Attention to detail was very good linen, pillows, towels all high quality. Bath and shower spot on, plenty of hot water and lovely shower gel and shampoo. I liked the style of the hotel - clean, comfortable and welcoming - I was on my own and felt quite happy. Added bonus was the 'pub' with fab food, speciality gins and friendly staff. Will be staying again. Connections into London very good and Brixton down the road. Thanks to Rebecca for being so helpful .

title: Evening Dinner
text: We were lucky to have friends who really like the place and we all went for dinner during the Christmas holiday. What a great place! Wonderful food, really nice staff and the ambience is relaxing. I say great food as we all had something different from the steak to the aubergine cannelloni and we were all very happy. We all had starters and the ham hock croquettes were delicious. Their prices are very reasonable. Definitly hoping to return on our next trip to the UK. 5 stars!!!

title: Bringing the West to Norwood
text: Jemma and her team are delivering delicious, no nonsense food, superbly sourced and beautifully prepared. Couple this with show-stopping service, terrific ambiance and excellent value for money it's a winner.

title: Very good Sunday lunch
text: We went for Sunday lunch and the food was very good. We all had the roast beef which was cooked perfectly. For the price it would have been good to get an extra (thin) slice of beef. But that is my only criticism, apart from that it was perfect. I then has the sticky toffee pudding, which was very very good. Light sponge with lots of rich sauce and a scoop of vanilla ice cream. £147 for 4 people: 3 1/2 mains, 2 bottles of wine and 2 desserts. Highly recomended, will return in the new year.

title: Excellent overnight stay
text: We stayed at the Tulse Hill Hotel for one night in room 5. The room was well appointed and very comfortable with a large comfortable bed and a roomy en-suite. There was some emergency vehicle noise at night but this is to be expected in such an urban location. Note it is 20 steps up the stairs to the first floor rooms as there is no lift but plenty of help! Breakfast and Dinner were excellent and the staff were all very friendly and helpful. If you need to stay in the area we would certainly recommend it.

title: Lovely Friendly Hotel
text: Stayed with a friends here en route to a birthday party. Rooms were lovely. Very clean with amenities you would expect. Fresh towels and even a complementary dressing gown each. Bed was really comfy though after having a late night I wish I had longer in it! Check out is at 10.30am but breakfast is served until 11. Would make more sense to have checkout later - this was the only downside. The breakfast was lovely. The eggs Florentine were gorgeous. Staff let us store our bags in the office and leave the car on site after checkout whilst we all went out to walk off our breakfasts which was accommodating. All in all staff were very friendly and helpful. The bar/restaurant area entertained a mix of ages from elderly to babes in pushchairs in a relaxed atmosphere. Could have stayed in the bar all night if we didn't have a party to go to.

title: Stunning hotel and lovely staff
text: Stayed while visiting the area and can't recommend it enough. What an amazing room, huge bed, great coffee machine and fab shower. Jemma and Matthew, the management team, are absolute stars. So hospitable and just all round good eggs.

title: Last minute stay - highly recommended
text: Arrived at 2245 on a sunday having not pre-booked (hotel mix up). Initially had nothing spare as being refurbished, but they then found a room which had already been refurbed - ran down the road to get me to tell me they had a room after all - don't get that everywhere! £90 including bed and breakfast and 20 mins to central london, Super comfy bed incredibly quiet (despite being on main road) warm decor and furnishings - very peaceful can do attitude of duty manager (even at the late hour on an Sunday) Very well connected (main line into Victoria) as well a host of bus routes If I had need I'd stay again for sure.

title: A really enjoyable stay
text: Just returned from a weekend stay in the Tulse Hill Hotel attending our sons wedding. This is a great little hotel with excellent food, rooms and car parking! We were on the top floor so it's a bit of a climb with suitcases up narrow stairs. We were,however, offered help but didn't need it. Our room was at the front and overlooked a busy main road with constant traffic noise, so take ear plugs just in case! Our room had been recently refurbished and was just great, the only downside was the lighting was not great giving my wife problems with makeup and hair preparation. The staff were very friendly and customer service was exceptional. We have no problem in recommending this hotel.

title: Comfy pub-hotel with great rooms and food
text: What can I say, great people, great food, nice rooms. Only a bit noisy from the music from the pub and the crossroads. But I enjoyed my stay very much. I felt very welcome here. Steak Monday is highly recommended.

title: Good Hotel, Restaurant Menu, and Service was Great!
text: Having a Sunday lunch engagement with Mother can sometimes be problematic and expensive a visit to the New Tulse Hill Hotel on a beautiful sunny day was incredibly enjoyable, great service, good menu and a good choice of wine, the venue certainly gets my vote, we will return!

title: Favourite place to eat and drink in London
text: Perfect for a few drinks on a Sunday afternoon, a mid week supper or a special occasion. They have a delicious selection of lagers and ales on tap, a quality wine list and the staff are friendly and knowledgeable. This place really gets it right.

title: Beautiful
text: Visited with my boyfriend for a dinner and drinks and had a wonderful experience. It was so nice to come inside from the cold, the place immediately is warm and inviting, love the lighting and wooden bar and decor - it looks beautiful. The staff are friendly and helpful, without being overbearing, and had great tips on what to eat. Amazing food, best roast potatoes I have ever had! Thanks very much, sure we'll be back again and again.

title: A superb little hotel
text: A two night stay for a wedding up the road and we had a fantastic time. Although right on a crossroads, the rooms were very peaceful and comfortable. On the first evening the restaurant was fully booked but the staff squeezed us in (four of us). The meal was excellent and the staff very knowledgeable about the wine list. Breakfasts were lovely with a good choice. However, the best thing about the hotel was the staff. Gemma and the rest of the team made us feel like long lost friends every time we ventured downstairs. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone staying in the area.

title: Great restaurant
text: Disclaimer: I live nearby and have not seen the hotel rooms. But lunch on a Friday afternoon was truly excellent. Even more so as we ate it sitting in what was, until the recent total refurb, a sorry cavern of a deserted bar in a traditional pub that had been in a slow decline since the 70s. Decent wine at sensible prices, too.

title: Lovely gastro pub
text: This is a great location for a lovely meal in the restaurant area, drinks with friends or both. Good food, good service and there's a lovely garden area too - perfect for the summer. It's a favourite.

title: Overpriced
text: We took a family room, which was very nice, don't get me wrong, but very warm and VERY noisy. Essentially it's a pub with rooms. We could hear music booming all night, so it wasn't great for us. We paid £150, which should have been £90-110 given the area and facilities. Most of the staff were helpful and friendly, minus one who seemed to be away with the fairies and incapable of going that extra mile. To the point we had to buy our own milk - we found that so odd as there's a shop across the road and it would cost around 50p to make a customer happy! I wasn't given an itemised bill, just told the extras, which I paid. The Friday night waitresses were lovely and gave excellent service, the pub is great - but sadly the rooms are just too expensive for what they are.

title: Staff great, Parking, room clean but small?
text: Booked through booking.com a superior room. We arrived early and staff more than helpful hence the review. Note no 24 h concierge so need to check in before 10-11pm or you are locked out. Paid through booking.com for superior room, reflecting now on the room (1) if that was superior the photos on booking.com are misleading. Bed ok but tight, bathroom up to date and air-con (very important ) as you can't sleep with the window open (noise). Shower good and nespresso etc. Breakfast good and again staff great. Accessible location and parking so fair value in that respect.

title: My perfect present!
text: This is a wonderful place to spend a weekend - it was my birthday weekend, but any weekend would do. The room was really spacious & the bed was sheer luxury, especially after a great meal in the restaurant & a fair number of exceptional cocktails! Large & carefully planned en suite - choice of shower heads for those who don't want wet hair. Even the complimentary toiletries were special, Orla Kiely I'll have you know. And don't get me started on the coffee machine! Best of all though was Jemma, Matt & the Tulse Hill Hotel team. Such kind & courteous service and a fantastically warm welcome. As for the breakfast, well my recommendation is you go to stay there and find out for yourselves - you won't be disappointed. Thank you for my best birthday weekend ever guys, I will definitely be back!

title: A perfect addition to the neighbourhood
text: I have only great things to say about this place. It looks great, it has been very thoughtfully refurbed with a nod to the past in using some reclaimed materials but right up to date with a modern feel. The food is fabulous - that doesnt seem to be enough to say but there is a spanish influence which is great and all bread is baked in the kitchen and is delicious. On Saturday night myself and 10 friends christened the "newsroom" which is the private dining room and we had a great time. We shared several of the big boards and everything was perfectly cooked. Gemma and Matt have done a great job in making sure that the THH has had a great start, long may it continue. Thank you.

title: Three day visit
text: We stayed at the Tulse Hill Hotel for three night the room was very clean and the staff very friendly we had breakfast on the three mornings and it was lovely lots of choices we would definitely stay there again they have a beer garden at the back of the hotel and even though it's on the junction of a major road traffic noises are very little. Bed room spacious comfortable bed and pillows, bathroom clean and a good size

title: Absolutely Brilliant meal with a fantastic host
text: We went for dinner on a very busy Saturday night without booking.After being greeted we took a seat in the bar and waited no more than 10 minutes for a table.The staff were very attentive and lovely.Together we covered all three courses and they were delicious. I cant say enough how much we enjoyed our time in the restaurant and we really impressed with the selection of cocktails on offer. I would say for the area the price was quite high but you get what you pay for and it was very much worth it.

title: Hidden Gem
text: This is a great place to stay. Friendly staff, cool furnishings, quality food and drink and comfy rooms. We wanted to stay out of the city centre and away from the over priced hotels with dated facilities. The Tulse Hill offered us everything we wanted from a hotel, we even stayed in the bar rather than venturing back to the city!! The staff were very friendly and extremely helpful. Food was amazing and I had the best pint of Heineken I've had for a long time. The room itself was nice and cosy, not too big, the best was so comfy and bathroom was modern. The room had all modern facilities and even had a docking station, which was great as we didn't switch the tv on once!! I will definitely be recommending the hotel and will not hesitate to stay again

title: Best Sunday roast outside of mums kitchen!
text: We live across the road and could not be happier about the refurbishment. All the staff are knowledgeable and very friendly. The food is unbelievably good and the venue itself is beautiful and comfortable. Well done everyone involved. We has our family Sunday lunch there yesterday and it was the best we've ever had!

title: Great weekend stay
text: We stayed here for 2 nights and we were apprehensive due to reviews we had seen. On arrival the hotel was clean and modern and reception staff were very friendly. We arrived before check in time but were able to leave our bags there. We were given room 303 in the main hotel. Room was clean and had everything you needed. A handy phone, shower, toiletries and a hairdryer. Also included a fridge (which didn’t work well) and a hairdryer. Plenty of wardrobe space for 2 days. Bed was comfy but a little small, bathroom also small but I think is usual for most London hotels. Walls are paper thin and someone on our floor was very loud, banging around and screaming and shouting at 4am which woke us up. Take earplugs! Breakfast was fine, hot breakfast and continental available. Baker Street station is a 5 minute walk away from the hotel. When we checked out, we were able to leave our bags again and collected them later on in the evening. Overall, this was a good hotel, in a great location and I would stay here again.

title: Miniature
text: First the good things. The hotel is located in a road only five minutes level walk from Baker Street tube, so quite convenient. The area is safe and civilised, with quite a few food shops and restaurants open in the evening. The young receptionist was enthusiastic, though I had to ask her to repeat some of what she said, so rapidly did she speak. I was in the annex across the road - I knew about the annex from previous reviews so it was no surprise

title: Business stay
text: Staff was friendly and efficient. Rooms are equipped with everything you need. The only downside was that the temperature in the lounge and the room was too high. Definitely too warm to sleep comfortably.

title: Gerard
text: Very good location for this hotel, all refurbished , small room but good bed and shower. Even if we had to cross the road to get to the annex. They kept our luggage until the evening so we could enjoy the city until our evening departure. The staff could be a little more smiling and friendly.

title: Very good all round
text: Stayed here for 3 nights at the beginning of December.All the staff were friendly and the rooms,although on the small side had everything you needed.they were cleaned to a high standard daily.It is situated a 5 minute walk from Baker st tube which gets you to the majority of the main tourist sites.I would recommend this hotel to anybody.I thought £10 for breakfast was a bit steep and didn't have it.There are plenty of places nearby included a reasonably priced cafe around the corner.

title: Lovely hotel great location
text: Stayed here mid week great location less than 5 min walk from Baker Street station, room is small but has everything you need, fridge microwave etc, lovely rain shower and lots of little extras in the room, breakfast was lovely plenty of fresh fruit,breads and hot food. Would stay here again and would recommend it to my friends if there were heading to London

title: Ok
text: One night stay. Small basement room very clean well furnished good bathroom everything functional. No lift was not a problem for me as I had little luggage. Dark. Across the road from reception. Would give four stars except for the strange layout.

title: Nice hotel
text: We stayed here for one night as going to a concert at Wembley.For location it was fantastic.Not even 5 minute walk to the tube which went straight to Wembley or Oxford Circus and close to regent park too.The hotel was very clean and comfortable.There was no heating or electric when we arrived but the staff sorted it very quickly thankfully.we paid for a deluxe room which wasn’t particularly big but for London prices was happy enough and would stay again.

title: Friendly hotel but way over priced-though is central London.
text: Friendly helpful staff, rooms well furnished but small and don't be fooled by upgrade, three of us were upgraded for a hotel of only 15 rooms! Room small and no natural light but comfy all the same. Breakfast ok and location good. As on company expenses no isue but would not pay price if my own cash.

title: Good little hotel
text: Not too expensive for London. 5 minute walk from baker street tube station. Rooms are small but you should expect that for the money you're paying. Rooms are clean, comes with a flat screen tv, fridge and microwave. Breakfast was fine. No frills. Nice staff. If your looking for something inexpensive but still good then this is the place.

title: Clean , Good Service
text: Booked a club room for a one night stay . The room was across the road ( though I knew beforehand that some rooms were and a decent size for a London hotel . The room was also clean and tidy so no complaints . Breakfast at £7 was fine but as some other reviewers have said the option to have say an egg as you wanted (rather than just scrambled) would be nice .However this is but a small point. Staff were pleasant and efficient . Overall a very pleasant stay .

title: Average stay, suitable for solo short trips
text: The only good thing I would highlight about this hotel is the location, since I stayed here while having some work on Baker St itself. It is very close to Baker st tube station and walking distance to Edgeware road/Paddington. Ambience: The place however, is not as pleasing as it look in pictures, as they are situated in old buildings. There are no elevators, so if you get a room on the higher floors, make sure you are ok to climb up steep stairs. However, they do offer porter service if you have luggage. Rooms: The rooms have very limited space, and more than one person in it would make you claustrophobic. The washrooms are good. Bedding quality is average. Would recommend only for short business trips where you are not planning to spend time in your rooms much.

title: Incredible!
text: Most beautiful hotel I have ever stayed in. Great service and amazing room. It had a very personal feel to it and the room was the perfect size and type for my boyfriend and I. Will definitely be staying here the next time my boyfriend and I visit London!

title: Great Location
text: Small hotel with small but clean and effective rooms and service. Rooms are small however have very comfortable beds, well heated rooms, and great shower and everything available one can expect. Location is superb with walking distance from baker street tube station, restaurants, bus stop, marylebone station, regent park and much more London has to offer. Staff is very helpful and goes out of the way to help, basic breakfast is included and is a bonus and overall value is great for London standards.

title: Clean and quiet
text: I stayed here, in a twin room with my daughter. As a lot of hotels, the twin beds were pushed together with little room to push them apart but this wasn't too much of an issue. The hotel itself was easy to find, just minutes walk from the tube station and shops. It's in one of the old Edwardian style houses and because we were fairly early, got a room at the top. There is no lift so not ideal for you if you are unfit or have small children. It wasn't an issue for us until the key didn't work and I had to run up and down the three flights a few times! My fault though, I forgot those card keys shouldn't be in a bag near a mobile phone! The shower/toilet was lovely and had a small array of toiletries. On arrival, we found that if you booked breakfast there and then, you got a discount. The choice of breakfast was pretty good for £7 and made life much easier than taking a walk to buy something though the room had both a fridge and a microwave. The only issue with the fridge was that it didn't work while you were out (the key card puts the electric on) and it didn't chill my bottle of wine too well either. Reading this back, it sounds as though I'm being negative but actually, this was a very pleasant clean hotel, lovely, polite staff and an excellent location. The road itself is one way and has a fair amount of traffic however you could not hear this in the room. In fact, I think I had the best nights sleep in a hotel ever here! You also didn't get disturbance from the other guests, possibly because there were only a few rooms on each floor. Regents park is a short walk away and I took advantage of this in the evening, going for an evening stroll. There is also a Tesco Express 2 minutes away and many cafe's another minute or so towards Baker Street tube station. It felt a very safe area and I'd be happy to stay here again.

title: Spontaneous trip
text: We stayed here for 2 nights for a short get away before we got married, i asked the hotel if they could put a bottle of champagne and some chocolates for a small charge which was fine, but they asked me to fill out a form which they sent via e mail but didn't have a chance to fill out the form as i work 6 days a week and planning a wedding doesn't leave much free time so i asked if they could just bill it with out the form and they said no - when arriving at the hotel it was nice and very clean, the next day we left the hotel to go out and explore London about 10am and came back about 11pm we find that the cleaners have been in to clean our room but left the door open so any one could walk in for 12 hours lucky nothing was taken. they have friendly staff and comfy beds would come back there again and would recommend it

title: Great quality, well thought out
text: Well thought out for international travellers. Room includes handy travel companion which doubles up as a mobile phone. Rooms are well fitted and easy to relax in. Good area. The hotel does not a lift, but the staff helps with moving luggage so it's not a problem.

title: A bit Pricey
text: The hotel was very nice, a bit on the expensive side for what it was, but again being in central London you are paying for the location. It would be very harsh to call it average. As stated in another review, it is annoying that the hotel is on two sides of the room, especially if you are located on the opposite side. Would stay again, but not if I had to pay £135 again. You can definitely find better

title: Nice room a little small
text: Nice decor friendly staff but very noisy. We were in room 22 which was on the ground floor and seemed to have a generator running outside all night The surging and turning on and off made sleep impossible . The apologies from staff do not make up for a bad nights sleep. Shame as I'm in London for work on a weekly basis and other than that the hotel was comfortable and well located

title: Close to Regents Open Air Theatre for a Birthday weekend 'On the Town' !!
text: Heading to London for a birthday weekend to see a performance of 'On The Town' at the Regents Park Open Air Theatre, I booked this hotel for one night because it looked near to the venue on the map. Unfortunately we got a bit lost on the way there eventually finding Regents Park to walk through, but after the show, on the way back to the hotel, the park is closed so had to go with the crowds via the main road in the dark and got even more lost. Eventually we flagged down a taxi to take us back. I will know next time. The show was amazing so all was forgotten when we got back to the hotel. The hotel is in a fairly quiet street of lovely old terraced houses. The staff were very polite and helpful. Our room was not in the main hotel building but in another building across the road in the basement. It was a fairly large twin room with a good sized shower room, fridge with complimentary water and tea/coffee facilities. It was clean and well decorated. We discovered that the phone did not work which we did report but this was not fixed. It was clean and comfortable for us for the night. Deluxe twin room for £180 for one night 27/28 May 2017.

title: Average stay
text: I booked this hotel for a one night stop over before having an operation the next day at the nearby princess grace. On arrival to reception there were 2 ladies that looked like hotel cleaners sat around in reception laughing and talking loudly in a foreign language which wasn't the best reception for a guest to walk into. They just stared at me without as much as a hello. Club Room was ok but bed wasn't very comfortable and there was an annoying green led light that stayed on through the night. I had to turn the fridge off as it was quite loud. Location wise it's very good but I don't think I would stay there again.

title: When is a King really a King?
text: Be warned - the King size bed they advertise on their website is not what you expect of a King Size bed and what you get at almost every other hotel in the world that says King size. Theirs is a British King size which measures 152 cm x 198 cm. Would help if actual dimensions were added to the website since clearly, there are multiple interpretations to “King size”! The phone in the room does not work so one must use the mobiles provided... except, we’re in the basement and reception is really bad. Very frustrating!

title: Check in very disappointed
text: Upon arrival, we were a little early, 45 mins, told to go away and come back in 45 min time, after doing so we came back and there made to wait like school children until our room was ready, customer service was very unfriendly, won’t be staying there again.

title: "Excellent little hotel"
text: Stayed here 24-26 October and was very pleased with the hotel. Located 5 mins from Baker Street underground and a brisk 15 min walk from Oxford St, it is ideally located to tour London. The staff are very pleasant and helpful. We lost our sightseeing tickets for the bus and they kindly printed them off from our email for us. Room was a little small but it's London and it was perfectly adequate for both of us. Bathroom was lovely with large shower with constant hot water. Room was impeccable, bed very comfortable and as for the little green light that I've read people on Tripadvisor complain about, it in no way interrupted my sleep. All in all, we had a lovely weekend in London and when we decide to visit again this is the hotel I'll be booking.

title: Fantastic hotel in an excellent location
text: I spent 4 nights at the Park Avenue Baker Street. The location is excellent: 5 minutes walking-distance from Baker Street Station and Regent’s Park. There are plenty of restaurants in the area, a Costa at the corner and some pubs. The room is clean, nicely furnished with modern furnitures and big enough for 1 traveller, it is quiet even if my room was facing the street and the bed was very comfortable. The en-suite bathroom was larger than the standard in London which I truly appreciated. I slept as good as at home! The only small thing that bothered me during my stay was the carpeted floor, in my opinion, it’s not the most hygienic floor to have in a hotel… So I avoided walking barefoot in the room which is a shame considering you had spent the whole day walking in London. But as I said, this is a very small thing in comparison to my excellent stay! The staff was friendly and helpful. As I was flying late, I could leave my luggage at the hotel free of charge. The WIFI was excellent too. I did not take breakfast so I have no comments about it. I highly recommend this hotel which is good value for money.

title: Very pleasant, did not meet the standards of the price tag
text: I booked into this hotel after reserving it whilst travelling to London, I didn't have high hopes as it was a rushed last minute booking, I managed to get it at a heavily reduced rate of £119 and was surprised at the cleanliness and attention to detail, the staff were very happy to accommodate your needs, even helping me out with razors after mine broke and left me with a half shaved face, the advertised £399 a night rate however would be extremely steep. I stayed in a room on the first floor right at the front and due to the busy nature of the road outside it was loud so maybe request a room nearer the top and at the back if you're intending to stay here! Beds were comfortable but not outstanding Would stay again if given a room at the back of the hotel, did not try the restaurant however

title: Just splendid!
text: Yet another stay at London and I went for the assured choice of park avenue baker street, as I had stayed here previously too. It was another flawless stay and was truly glad to see further improvements within the service and quality from last time.. Credit to the management and team alike and look forward to staying with you guys again around the new year. ADIOS.

title: Park Avenue Hotel
text: We stayed in this Hotel, as we came to watch 'Little Shop Of Horrors' in Regents Park open air theatre. Location was perfect. It was litturally a 5 min walk from hotel to the venue. Lovely indian restaurant nearby 'Cinnamon spice'. The room a little bit hot, but otherwise fine. Took the tube from Heathrow and got off at Hyde Park Corner, and walked for 40 minutes to get to hotel. Next time I would take a taxi, because of suitcases. (This information, I would have loved to have had, before the trip)Thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

title: Lovely hotel. Amazing breakfast.
text: The hotel is lovely. Returning again next month for business trip. Great location, amenities, breakfast, value for money and clean. Couldn't criticise anything. Marked low on sleep quality coz I woke up during the night.

title: An OK hotel.
text: I was speaking at a conference, so the organisers organised this room for us based on quality and price, so we cannot comment on the price or value for money. The main hotel is on one side of the room, but there is an annexe on the other side fo the road. On arrival, the staff were very friendly and organised for a member to show us to our room across the road

title: Clean and compact.
text: We read the reviews on Trip advisor before booking so we knew what to expect. The rooms are well decorated and furnished with a super shower room. We were there for three days and our room was cleaned to a high standard every day although the sheets were not changed. A good selection of shampoo and gels were provided along with biscuits coffee and tea. There was a microwave and fridge in the room and a large screen TV.We were allocated a club double which was on the second floor overlooking the road but the traffic noise did not bother us. The room was compact to the point that we had to put the suitcase stand on top of the wardrobe and only one of us at a time could get around the bed.This did not bother us as the location was perfect for our needs.The reception staff were friendly as was the cleaner.

title: A poor recommendation by Secret Escapes.
text: My wife and I booked an overnight stay on the recommendation of Secret Escapes. What a mistake! Neither the hotel or Secret Escapes warned us about an annex and it being across the road. This road is a 24 hour bus and taxi route and it wasn't that easy to cross. It was drizzling with rain and there no hotel umbrellas so we got soaked. Further we were not warned that there were no lifts and that the stairs were quite steep. I found them difficult to climb. Our room was small, tired, and not that clean. The shower door seal was coming off and there were unpleasant stains around the soap basket and shower tray. This is meant to be a no smoking hotel and yet we found two cigarette packets wedged between the wall and the bedhead on the far side of the bed. Obviously the room had not been thoroughly cleaned. The decor in our room, the stairway and hall were all 'down at heel' and needed refreshing. Breakfast was underwhelming. There was only one waitress who did her best but it took her nearly ten minutes to clear a table for us to use. We were greeted with one piece of cheese and one piece of ham on the cold plate, virtually no hot food in the heated trays, and a poor selection of fresh fruit. The coffee was bordering on the undrinkable. I cannot recommend this hotel and we will certainly never stay here again. I would question Secret Escapes decision to feature this hotel. The most concerning thing was that when we returned to our annex at 03:00 a.m. we found all the fire doors on every floor still wedged open. So much for the safety notice!

title: Good service, small rooms
text: We booked this last minute and had a room on the 2nd floor across the road. It is as expected, a small hotel built from the original buildings in a good location. The staff were very helpful, carrying luggage (no lifts), bringing us things we asked for and fast check in and check out. The room was too small really for 2 adults and 1 child but was very clean, good temperature and a good location near to Baker Street and Marylebone stations. We had a good stay here.

title: Lovely hotel
text: We had a lovely welcome when we arrived at hotel, we stayed in the hotels annex across the road, we had a porter take our bags for us which was lovely, our room was spotlessly clean & the bed was very comfortable. Would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Not for me, Thanks
text: This hotel is very clean with modern furnishing in rooms and bathrooms, good wifi everywhere and a central location next to the Baker Street line. But its divided into two buildings one across the street where I stayed on the top floor with six flights of steps and no lift. There is only a tiny reception and a breakfast room. I had to cross the road for breakfast ( self service ) and I opted for the cooked breakfast was not edible as it was cold and the coffee was like tar.

title: Park Avenue
text: Stayed for one night recently and would stay again if needs be. Room clean and tidy, bed comfortable, large wall mounted tv in room. Tea/Coffee making facilities in room. Whilst hotel is on a very busy road, we were not disturbed at all.

title: Small cramped room, tatty and tired
text: Seemed ok from pictures and description on booking.com but the first room i was shown to was in the annexe across the street was in a damp smelling basement with an air conditioning unit right outside the window. I went straight back to reception to ask to be moved. The next room was in the annexe again but second floor. Tiny room, small bathroom, worn carpet. The pillows are very thin and lumpy. Shame that the hotel has not had a tidy up as the location is fantastic for baker st and regents park.
