Will not be staying again i am afraid, even though the room was less than £100 a night i now know why! Do some maintenance and clean the common parts at least, please!

title: Good value
text: Overall very good value for the location and I was happy with the service. The check in and out was smooth and efficient and while the rooms are very small they have all the necessary amenities that one requires for a short stay.

title: Dry hotel with tiny rooms
text: It is not in Park Avenue New York. It is not even in Baker Street London but in Gloucester Place which is famous as being a major bus route and west end exit to the M1 and the North but generally a good location close to Marylebone and Baker Street stations. The rooms are small - sleep only type. The in room coffee making facilities are not replenished during your stay. There is no room service and no alcohol available. The mini bar is empty. The breakfast is expensive for what it is. The windows do not open more than a couple of inches. There is aircon. There are good electronics and free wifi. The rooms are recently refurbished. Rooms at the front are double glazed (and need to be!).

title: Great hotel
text: Lovely hotel friendly staff and good location. Rooms high standard enjoyed the minerals tea coffee and water supplied free of charge and also toiletries. Would stay again. Showers a good size and powerful, as was air con which we enjoyed as it was so warm. Receptionist was very helpful and pleasant to deal with.

title: Very nice hotel
text: The hotel is really very nice. Modern and clean rooms, small bathroom (but quite normal for the London standards) free wifi. I can't express an opinion on the breakfast cause i did not have it, but i was told that it is brought to the room in a small box as there is no breakfast room. Great position, just a 5 minute walk both to the Baker Street tube station and to Marylebone train station. I definitely recommend it

title: Amazing bathroom floor
text: After a long journey from the north to south this was a good place to stay central and quiet. My husband had booked a single instead of a double so we had to pay the difference which was fine because they had rooms available but the rooms where the same size and really the beds wernt much bigger in the room we got. Break fast was lovely and the food area was clean. Underfloor heating in the bathroom was amazing. Air conditioning was great. Fridge was faulty but that's a minor problem. Stay was great and great location.

title: More than average but not very good
text: I would rate this hotel 3 and a half. It is a good place to stay in London but just needs that little bit more to be rated very good. I stayed here with my family for a week. With W1 post code, location is optimum! The rooms are small and neat with a very compact bathroom with all the basic amenities but very nice towels. The shower has two options - one overhead and one wall unit and they both boast wonderful pressure. I did not enjoy using the soap and shower gel as the quality seemed very poor

title: One to keep you fit
text: Pleasant enough hotel - in good location. Rooms well fitted out and modern inside, bathroom very well fitted out. My room was in the annex over the road from the reception which was fine although twice when I went out in the evening the front door was ajar not closed. I was on the third floor - and there is no lift in the annex. Air con struggling to make any impression during the current heatwave. No secondary exit from the top floor of the annex and it looked like you had to use a ladder from the 2nd.

title: Great stay
text: Had read the reviews and didn't expect much from Breakfast, however putting the tinned mushrooms and coffee aside it was lovely and very tasty. Beautiful room and great service. Would definitely come back

title: Yet another pleasant stay, my preferred hotel when in London
text: Have now stayed at this hotel more than 10 times whenever I am in London for work. Hotel and rooms are modern, and the location a few minutes walking distance to Baker Street tube station and Marylebone National Rail station is ideal for me. Staff are also polite and helpful. No complaints. Overall I think it's a great value hotel when staying in central London, and I will be back once again next month for work.

title: Great value stay!
text: I stayed at Park Avenue Hotel as I was at a conference nearby. Excellent service, including help with my luggage and the offer of a free smartphone with information about London - would have used this if I'd have stayed longer. Room was clean and comfortable with an excellent shower and TV - I was in the main hotel. It's very close to Baker Street, so a good base if you're exploring London Zoo and Madame Tussaurd's. Highly recommended.

title: Beware!! This hotel could take your money!
text: We were really looking forward to our stay in London but unfortunately my husband fell extremely ill and we had to reschedule. We politely explained if we could rearrange for another night and they declined immediately with no offer to help or accommodate another night at another mutually convenient time. Beware before you book.

title: don't book this hotel
text: I stayed with my partner and we had payed for a club room as we wanted a nicer room than the standard. We arrived at the hotel and our room was in the basement next to the restaurant. We got back from the theatre at 23.00 and could not sleep due to the noise from above and doors slamming in the basement. i was then woken at 5 by slamming doors and what sounded like a washing machine shaking everything! I had to call reception to complain. We then woke up again due to someone hoovering outside the room at 8 in the morning and to finish off we had to have a cold shower in the morning. When checking out the receptionist informed us the boiler was broken. Not impressed at all.

title: Location is great, free wifi a bonus - the room was small
text: I stayed for 4 nights in this hotel for business and while the room was small (well about normal for London, small for anywhere else), it was clean, it had free Wi-Fi, the bed was comfortable and the place was close to Baker Street Station making it very easy to get around and there are quite a few eating places within a short walk. There are 2 areas to this hotel on opposite sides of the street from each other. I was on the other side of the street from the reception. I asked for a quiet room when i booked and I was put at the back of the hotel and I did not hear a sound the whole time I was there. The shower was hot and had pressure and the tea and coffee making facilities were very welcome. There is no lift so if you have issue with stairs this may not be the place for you, but there is a person to help you take your bags too and from the room when required. There are other hotels of a similar standard and size room around so I’m not sure if I would stay here again, but it was close to my conference venue, the price was reasonable and my stay was comfortable.

title: Stay at Park Avenue Baker Street
text: The location of the hotel is ideal. 10 minutes walking and you are in the center of London.The rooms are very clean and comfortable. The sleep quality is excellent. The service is excellent. and the average of quality and price is good.

title: excellent hotel came to our rescue
text: This lovely hotel was our salvation after we had made a terrible mistake. Having booked into a dreadful hotel, we were desperate to find somewhere nice and the Park Avenue Baker Street came to our rescue. They had a room available, and it was so comfortable and pleasant, we cannot recommend it too highly. The porter was extremely helpful, the bed was very comfy, good television, quality bathroom, spotlessly clean, good standard of buffet-style breakfast, don't know about wifi as i didn't have a computer with me, in a superb location just a few minutes walk from Baker Street and Marylebone tube stations, and about 15 minutes stroll to Marble Arch. It's reasonably priced as well - this is an excellent little hotel.

title: Stylish boutique hotel in the city
text: We went on a shopping trip to London. It's perfectly located - tube is in walking distance, the street is quiet. The hotel is set up in two houses opposite of each other. We stayed in the house on the other side of the street where the reception is situated. The rooms are typically British small, but for London rather big - the design is very tasteful and modern. The hotel is very clean and the staff is friendly. The perfect hotel for a weekend trip to London.

title: Better than expected
text: Great reception, friendly and welcoming. Lovely room - basement but good AC and a window. Lighter than I was expecting. Comfy spotless room and bathroom. Shower great. One of best nights sleeps in London. Virtually no noise from the road - maybe as it was basement but will def be back and with a request for a basement room.

title: Couldn't asked for a better hotel!
text: Me and my partner stopped at this hotel last weekend. For the money we paid we couldn't of asked for better service. The staff were friendly and allowed us to leave our luggage in reception before we could check in and after we checked out. The room we had was very modern and spotless not a spot of dust or dirt there. Breakfast had plenty of choice and was hot and fresh. I would most defiantly stop here again and highly recommend it. Location was a five min walk to Baker Street and Baker Street tube station.

title: Disappointing, nothing compared to the pictures!!
text: We stayed here for my birthday in November. The hotel is split into 2, either side of a main road. The rooms are no where near as big as they seam on the pictures. When we stayed there, they had a power cut, and we have paid nearly £11 each for breakfast, we tried to explain just give us the money and we will go elsewhere, but they were all foreign and no one understood us! Was really, upset.

title: Uninspiring.
text: Arrived 20 mins before check-in and was advised that the room would be available at 1400. Left bags and went for some lunch. Hotel in great central location. Upon returning at 1500 the receptionist started our check -in but then decided to deal with a woman who interrupted us to take her bags, pretty obvious we were not important enough. Was told our room was actually located in their adjacent building from the main reception on the opposite side of the road (I wasn't aware there was another building that we may have been sent to and this is not mentioned on their website). We arrived to the room (3 x flights and no lift) to discover the window wide open, the window you couldn't see out of because it was so dirty and probably wouldn't want to as all it looked out onto was the roofs of the other buildings. The room itself was tiny (we booked a 'deluxe double' room) with no bath unfortunately and the inside door handle came off in my hand! The bed was a double, so not big enough for me without my legs poking out the end and in places very lumpy, not sure if this was the springs? For what we paid the location was great, but I'd be interested in seeing what a standard double room looks like, if this is the deluxe offering?

title: Not up to 'Secret Escapes' standard
text: We stayed here for one night as part of a short break away, I had booked through Secret Escapes believing them to always offer a certain standard of hotel..... the hotel itself is actually based across two sides of a street, if you are on one side then you have to cross over the road in the morning for your breakfast - no heading to breakfast in your PJ's! Reception staff were friendly and a staff member escorted us across the street to our room. The room was small but had the amenities you would except, it was rather tired and worn though, as were the communal areas, halls, staircases which were actually quite grubby. Breakfast was a disappointment, very poor hot selection, just scraps left over, and no real attempt at service. Won't stay here again. Location is ok, a short walk from Baker Street station

title: Nice stay in the centre of the city
text: I stayed in this hotel in a single room for a couple of night , the staff is helpful and very nice , my room was very spatious and in the building facing the main part of the hotel . The only problem is the mattress a little old and too soft . I would definitely recommend it to other travellers though .

title: Okay...
text: It's not in a bad area, restaurants and coffee shop near by with good public transport links. Rooms were modern. I don't think the staff were the most helpful people in the world. I also requested an early check in & didn't get it, even though we gave more than a weeks notice. I didn't feel comfortable leaving our bags in the lobby whilst we had to leave because we didn't get our early check in. No lift, not a hotel suitable for people who need wheelchair access.

title: Small but okay
text: Stopped here for 1 night in business. Staff were lovely and friendly on check in and that was easy. Crossed the road to my room, shown by one of the team. Then got into the room. The room was on the small size but for one night not going to complain, the throw on the bed was a little dirty but overall cleanliness was good. Then we come to the bathroom, in a word small! As a slight larger person getting in and out of the shower was an event! I certainly wouldn't call this a delux double room. Breakfast was good and plenty of it. Overall a good hotel but not great for the price!

title: small fiendly a breath of fresh air.
text: A one night ., we were given a ground floor room equipped for the disabled. Only two small niggles although the room and en suite were spotless there was no plug for the wash hand basin, and no shelf in the bathroom for spongebags. Very good breakfast in the basement restaurant such a pleasant change from the big chain hotels.

title: shame about the breakfast service as all other parts were excellent
text: Shame about the breakfast service as all other parts were excellent, location, cleanliness and room quality were all good. Breakfast service was really poor, help yourself to cutlery and table settings as the poor girl was run off her feet. Hot food tins empty and other guests stole tables before announcing room numbers etc. No system and very little control. We finally got our cutlery and cup to have a cup of tea 20 mins later, so after we had a pleasant walk around the corner through Regent Park and were ideally located for tube, Madamme Taussards and all other attractions. Get your table first before queuing to give room number to be seated if you stay as all the non Brits do.

title: Average
text: The hotel is split over two sides of the road and we stayed away from the main part of the hotel. It's close to Baker Street underground - 5 minute walk. You use the key card for the front door and the room. The room itself was very small - you can't move without walking into the desk or the wardrobe or something! It's clean and tidy, however. The shower is a reasonable size and quite powerful. The breakfast wasn't great. It was cold and they were running out of food and drink quicker than they could refill it. There were plenty of options - English breakfast, cereals, pastries, yogurts, etc. It's fine, very average and nothing amazing stands out even though it's a 4* hotel!

title: Clean comfortable Hotel
text: My wife and I stayed in this hotel with a couple of friends who were in another room. Overall the stay was comfortable, clean and in a decent location close to a tube station. The fact that the reception was on the opposite side of the road to the actual hotel I thought was bizarre but it may not be unheard of. The price for a nights stay in London was good so can't complain at that. I believe my friends didn't rate the buffet style breakfast that highly. Overall though a good stay.

title: Relaxing, comfortable and convenient hotel
text: Clean rooms with microwave oven and fridge. The room is not so large

title: Does the job and great location
text: Very comfortable bed and a small but nice room. Floorboards creaked though, there's next to no soundproofing and the lack of lift doesn't really help much - this wasn't mentioned in the listing. If I'm honest, it needs some work if this is to match up to the pricing.

title: Nice hotel, great location
text: The location of the hotel is marvellous within short walking distance of Baker Street tube station from where major tubes lines have their stop. Personnel friendly. Our room was ok, spacious enough and really clean, beds good and with nice tasteful decoration. Beautiful clean bathroom with a rain shower and nice toiletries available. Wifi worked great (though no password required in the extension ... safe?). There were coffee and tea facilities and cookies on the house (new every day). For a hotel in this part of London with this service level, the pricing is ok. Not all rooms are "with a view" as ours was in the basement of the hotel's extension, away from the main building and reception desk. No view in London does not annoy me as there are other things to do in London than looking out of the hotel room window but I felt somewhat unsafe being in a building without any hotel personnel present (main building opposite of the busy road), specifically as the rooms are quite noisy and neighbours started their own little party at 3:37 a.m. above our heads and had the fire alarm go off due to extensive showering (we were told later). The windows could not be opened with makes it somewhat claustrofobic, given the fact that the view was only a wall on 2 meter distance. How we would get out of there in case of a fire remains unclear as the road to our room was all narrow stairs. All not the end of the world and it would not be a reason for not visiting this hotel again. Really annoying however was the green light in the ceiling which could not be switched off as we were told it is for safety reasons but which lit up the entire room in green at night. I know at least one person who would immediately leave and take another hotel for that reason.

title: A little gem in a desirable suburb..
text: Simply an exceptional stay! Couldn't find any flaws in any aspect. Staff were really helpful and couldn't commend their assistance enough considering my circumstances. I was reluctant initially on few elements, reading reviews from other esteemed travellers, and as much as i respect everyone's opinion and evaluation of their experience and how it can differ from others. I do believe us travellers are quick to pass our judgement based on small niggles which could be constructive but at the same time quite harsh and detrimental to the hard work most of the businesses genuinely put on the daily basis. Consideration of the above situation forced me to start posting reviews myself too. I was allocated a room across the other side of the building in the lower ground floor while my colleague was in the main building. Surprisingly we both liked my room better, as all the interior of the rooms are identical so it was no pain crossing a road, in fact it was more spacious being in the lower ground. The room was equipped with everything I could possibly need during my week long stay and every time I requested the front desk for any additional items, it was arranged for. The breakfast had both English and continental range. Always replenished and hot, contrary to some reviews I read. So no issues on that front too. All and all a great place to stay while in London, particularly if you want to be close by to pretty much everything London has to offer. Recommended and would definitely stay again.

title: Good small hotel for business stay in Baker Street location
text: Stayed for 2 nights for business in December. Decently refurbished. Hotel room was very clean and comfortable. Bathroom was good too. Had to walk up stairs to room which can be quite a work out if not fit! So if you need a lift to go up - not the place for you. However, very convenient, friendly and helpful staff. Good wifi...

title: Great hotel
text: We stayed at the Park Avenue Baker Street hotel for a night whilst visiting London. The room was very nice and really modern with large tv and monsoon shower! Only 5 mins walk from Baker Street tube and we also walked to London zoo in about 20 mins. Would definitely recommend.

title: Clean and well priced
text: This hotel was at the lower end of my price range but at less than a hundred quid in London for a one night flying visit it was perfectly adequate and good value for money. On arrival we were welcomed by very friendly staff and immediately upgraded. The room was on the small side but was modern and fresh. Although the bathroom lacked a bath, which to be honest I'd never have used it was spotlessly clean. My only criticism would be the constant humming of the empty mini bar fridge. If I were staying longer I'd have unplugged it.

title: Hard to be positive
text: The staff really tries their best to help. They understand the shortcomings. The staff brought me a fan, when I asked for it. The problems I had here was: - The room was on the 3rd floor. No elevators. This is a small inconvenience. - They have a stool in the room. No chair. - A really small desk that is 25% occupied by their phone and some device. So really small pace to do any work - Air-conditioning was iffy. Needed a fan Would not recommend for business.

title: A very convenient place
text: If you look for a luxury hotel with lobby bar, spa and 3 stars restaurant, this is not a place for But if you are interested in comfortable, central, clean and well equipped room in reasonable price, try the park Avenue

title: Feedback
text: It's good to be there as we knew many things and can access the tourist spots with in the range. Had a good time with best locality and climatic conditions which made the place more lovable. Keep doing the things great and really looking forward to visit again.

title: Excellent
text: A great hotel for a lovely weekend in London, it's in a central location, we had a nice surprise of a breakfast box in the morning, A hair dryer was in the room. Tea, coffee making and microwave in room too.

title: A nice place to stay!
text: I found the hotel via a price comparison site so didn't realise how easy it was to travel from Baker St (just round the corner from the hotel) to the National Gallery and over to Oxford Street. It was a comfortable place to stay (I had a single room) with a big shower and my own fridge and microwave artfully concealed in one side of the wardrobe!

title: More than acceptable, but needs a little attention
text: Over all this hotel is fine, I have no complaints about my stay, but offer a few comments. Finding the hotel: this was easy with Google maps, plenty of parking around if you're driving, but nice and close to Marylebone and Baker street tubes if not. Reception: a good job at 10.30 at night, although a little confused about whether I never to pay or not. Helpful with menus for local takeaways, no other choice. Room: My room, in common with others was in the'extension' located the other side of the road. For families, i would suggest you ask for a room in the main block. Overall a good room, compact, but not cramped, clean, quiet (especially given the busy road she front), meeting my requirements. It would benefit from a little updating generally, touch up the paint, fix broken fittings, give the shower a deep clean. The TV had ports for all connections which was good to see and full freeview channel listings. Wi-Fi: excellent service Food: my takeaway order was complicated by reception insisting I go through them, meaning I then had to go to reception ( across the other side of the road) meet the driver and cash the firm to give payments details... An unnecessary hassle late at night, but at least I could get food. Breakfast was perfectly adequate, all usual options available. A friendly face first thing was welcome! Check out was easy and quick. Would I go back? Yes, but I'd eat before getting there at one of the many restaurants on the route...

title: Cancellation guarantee turns out to be false
text: I made a group booking through Booking.com of almost 5000 GBP with a cancellation/modification guarantee up to a date. The hotel sent me a special contract because of the size of the booking, with an earlier cancellation/modification date. Before this date, I shortened the booking for one of the rooms from 5 to 3 days. It then turned our that the hotel raised the price of the 3 days to a total equal to the original 5 days. When I complained, they said it was an automatic adaptation made by the booking system and they could not do anything about it. They claimed I made a new booking while all that I did was cancel two out of the five days in the booking made and guaranteed to be adaptable. What a despicable attitude towards any client, let alone one with a large volume booking. In addition I had to ask three times for a correct invoice because it kept being incorrect. They had to send it by email because the reception could not access the system. They also did not keep their promise of offering all the rooms on lower floors because there is no elevator. Together with the disappointing quality of the rooms and the breakfast, it turned out to be a very bad experience so I advise everyone to stay away - many better offers in the area.

title: Roger L
text: A very comfortable, sensibly-priced hotel, conveniently situated on the edge of London's West End. A compact room, it's true, but very well appointed and with all in-room amenities. I would certainly stay here again and would recommend it to friends and family.

title: Nice, and convenient location
text: A great location, very close to Baker Street underground. Nice, clean room (if a little compact), and friendly professional staff. Air conditioning and decent WiFi add to the package :) The room was also quiet even though it was on a main road.

title: Nice rooms in Marylebone
text: Meetings in Marylbone Road, so obvious to choose Hotel in neighbourhood. Found Park Avenue Baker Street, which is a Hotel and not a B&B as stated here on TA. Anyways, it is a renovated London town home hotel, as I new the in my school trip days - situated in several house scattered over the street. Only difference old decor replaced buy smart posh designer lamps, wallpaper and mirrors. Anyways all is the same as back the. Breakfast bland and uninteresting. Windows hadn't seen Widex in month, so somethings can't be solved by decorators. Nice sleep though. Good bed. Upgraded (very tiny) bathroom, so that very good.

title: A practical and clean B&B in a great location
text: I was a little concerned about my planned and pre paid stay here having read some of the reveiws, particularly regarding the single occupancy club rooms which are not in the main building. I contacted the hotel and was upgraded to a double room in the main building for a small increase in cost, staff were very helpful and professional. The hotel is really a B&B there are no public rooms or a bar.... So it depends what you are looking for... it is neat tidy clean quiet and safe and in an excellent location. Linen towels toiletries tv and breakfast were all excellent. All in all a comfortable and practical place to stay and very conveniently located to Baker street tube.

title: All good - as always in the past
text: Good and fast service at check in and check out, good room in the separate building opposite site of reception and no complains about noise from the street, evening his time my room did face the street. Did not have breakfast so cannot comment on this service. Will definitely return and this spot is good value for money for business purpose

title: No lift!!!!
text: What a disappointment, the last time I was on holidays in Barcelona the hotel was amazing. Am back in London paying £105 for a hotel and can't get even a lift to the 3rd floor. The rooms are really small and we payed for big double room. The bed is comfortable tho.

title: Small but Comfotable
text: Stayed on first floor in main building,some rooms across street.Hotel is very convieniently placed less than five minutes walk from Baker Street tube station and Regent's Park.No lift but staff carry cases upstairs.Room small but modern,clean and well eqipped including a microwave,safe, tea,coffee and a free bottle of water.Small empty fridge also in room.Bathroom with shower also modern and clean.Breakfast was included in the price of £152 per night,but unfortunately hot food was not available until later due to problems with gas??{perhaps chef was late? }Fair selection of cold food on offer.Reception staff pleasant and helpful.Would stay here again.

title: Small but clean and quied
text: Pros

title: Efficient, easy, professional.
text: This place is ideal if you need to stay over after a long meeting or an award ceremony. The facilities are spotless and the staff extremely polite and efficient. My room was quiet, comfortable and i had everything i needed. Yes it's an ideal stopover hotel on business. I loved the way a cleaner was already mopping reception and polishing when checking out and the staff really were 1st class. Just a note to the Hotel exec team though: probably have a big re-think about breakfast offering - I would have turned and walked away were it not for one lonely member of staff anxious to please - i felt a bit embarrassed and sorry for her so had a solitary cup of tea (horrid) and a banana (fine). You've got a good space in the basement - there's a wonderful opportunity for a good coffee machine - some quality sourdough and jams/honey and maybe some eggs to order? Inject some passion into it. Happy to re-visit and chat ideas for free. As it stands, the breakfast experience is Britian 1980 - make it London 2016. I cannot stress enough how professional and competent the staff are. This is a perfectly good hotel and I'll happily stay again. Oh yeah - the wifi was excellent too!

title: Amazing boutique hotel
text: I've been welcomed by friendly staff, ready to help and very professional. My room was located on the extension building, and it was standard big and very clean. It made me feel like a home away from home with plush pillow, standing shower, hair dryer, complimentary toiletries, Flat screen TV with satellite channels, Tea/Coffee maker, microwave, refrigerator, air conditioning, wi-fi, complimentary smartphone and in-room safe. I received excellent customer service, made my experience in London amazing.

title: Great location
text: Check in and out was great. Room was small but OK for me. The bed was too soft. I didn't like that I was woken by the night Porter at 01.49am to say that there was buzzing coming from room even though there wasnt. He said he couldn't hear anything. It too me ages to go back asleep and I was up early. Not happy.

title: Don't stay here especially if you're American
text: This is a review for the Park Avenue Baker Street Hotel. I was recently traveling abroad and my overall experience was horrendous at this hotel. Bottom line don't stay here. I know this is Europe, but rooms are super tiny. Look much bigger in the website photos. Not all of the outlets worked in my room. Power went in and out during the day. Which was extremely annoying since this controls the air temperature. Being on vacation and in a foreign country I wanted to keep my valuables in a safe, when arriving to the room the safe was not working. Repeatedly asked hotel mgmt to have this serviced and it took them 36 hours to address the issue. When addressing the issues with the manager he was nice and tried to address the issue but just seemed overwhelmed. The only pros for this hotel is the location which is 5 min walking distance to Baker st tube location. For the cost and hassle staying here I would advise another hotel within the area at a better cost.

title: 3rd Stay
text: It was my 3rd time in this hotel. Always recommend for business trips or short stays but faced a couple of issues this time. Booked for 4 nights and had to extend stay for another 3 nights. first 4 were perfect. other 3 nights had to change the room twice which isn't convenient but as they mentioned they were fully booked. Anyhow, it made me experience different rooms. Bed comfy if it was a single big bed, twin rooms not recommended (small and stuck next to each other), never take a room more than the 2st floor where its tiring to go up and down the stairs. Love the interiors, Staff are really friendly. Even the restaurant staff was more than friendly and generous to the little one. Wifi is fine. Location is great. But had a visit to London after a month and didn't book because think prices are increasing there massively. Anyways, would recommend if you book a big bed and not more than the 1st floor

title: Excellent Location and Hotel.
text: I stayed here with my daughter for a weekend away to take in a few sights and see a show. Going into Marylebone we wanted a hotel close by. This was ideal. 5 minutes stroll away. Making the underground very accessible. We only saw the staff on reception but they were friendly and polite. The hotel is spotlessly clean as was our bedroom. Refreshments in the room where included in the price. The bathroom floor, well what can I say about that. Being someone who is always cold this was a dream for me. Under floor heating so warm it burnt your feet. We both loved it.

title: Good for a one night stopover
text: We arrived quite late for our stop over. We checked in at reception and had to be taken across the road to our room but not a big deal. When we got into the room it was quite small but ok and cleanish. The bathroom was well equipted and had lovely toiletries but the shower cubicle was not the cleanest Plenty of canned drinks and water which were complimentary which is a nice touch also View was very poor just a brick wall

title: Excellent location for work
text: 2 mins walk from Baker Street , really handy for getting around London - Hotel is in a lovely building , my room was across the road from reception , very clean , bigger than expected . Complimentary soft drinks in room plus tea/coffee - only drawback was inconsistency of WIFI , coverage was variable and ddoesn't seem to remember users from day to day

title: Terrible customer service and unbearable noise - avoid at all costs!
text: I payed full price for the room on the hotels website, when I arrived I asked for a quiet room. I was told the hotel was quiet this evening and that I could get a quiet room with a bath.I was taken over the road to the second part of the hotel on the other side of the street. I stayed in room 822 in the hotels basement and the room was adequate for the price. However, a little after 9pm I started to hear an unbearable noise! It sounded like a washing machine on full spin cycle above my bed! I called the reception who said that they did not have a laundry room above me, but the noise I could hear was the heating system, the receptionist knew the room was next to the main heating system. After my partner and I tried to ignore the noise and get some rest, I rang reception again. Despite being unable to sleep through the noise ( it was gone midnight by then) we were told that there was nothing that they could do and what did we expect! The noise continued until 4am when I eventually got to sleep. In the morning the receptionist said that no manager was in today, leaving me with no way to formally complain in person to resolve my complaint. I was appalled at the arrogance of the night porter's comments and the lack of understanding towards a paying customer in the morning. Please avoid at all costs as I wouldn't want you to have the same experience we did.

title: Great Value
text: We had an early appointment just south of Baker St so wanted somewhere to stay locally the night before. After searching several alternatives in the area we were drawn by the significantly cheaper price offered compared to the competition. After reading several reviews on trip advisor the main comments appeared to centre around, room size, emergency lighting, no lift and accommodation sited away from the main building. Yes the rooms are small but adequate for purpose after all this is London. There is a green glow from the emergency lighting over the room door but this was not annoying and did not prove to be an issue with us. Our room was 303 on the 3rd floor and yes it is only accessible by stairs but we are both in our 60's and this did not bother us, as our case was carried up to our room on checking in. We were fortunately located in the main building so cannot comment on the remote accommodation nor the breakfast as we checked out quite early the following morning. Overall we were very pleased with both the reception service and the room which was modern and well equipped. If it was not for a couple of small points we would give the Park Avenue an excellent rating. Firstly the toilet bowl had not been cleaned thoroughly and flushed. One of the cups was chipped on the top edge. The hair dryer plug was in two pieces and dangerous as it appeared that the retaining screw had been over tightened and sheared. We pointed this out to reception upon checking out so this should have been dealt with by now. Overall everything is well looked after but maybe either the maid or a member of the management team just need to check over simple items such as these to make the experience perfect. We would certainly recommend the accommodation and would definitely book here again when the need arises.

title: Great location, nice rooms
text: Location is great, just between 2 tube stations , a lot of good restaurants in the area, a lot of buss to everywhere in London. Room was clean, large and with complementary breakfast- which was a nice surprise for us

title: Friendly staff but tiny rooms
text: Stayed one night and found staff to be friendly and accommodating. However, this is very much a glorified B&B with a small reception area. Clean rooms and comfy bed but booked a superior room and it was tiny so a little disappointing. I had a ground floor room which was reasonably quiet.

title: Cosy and good value
text: I stayed for 4 nights recently in a single room and whilst it was absolutely tiny (as most bargain single rooms in London are!) the hotel was excellent and I'll definitely stay again. Breakfast was included and was very nice, and the ladies serving it were very friendly. Location wise it is across the road from Finsbury Park and a 3-5 minute walk from Finsbury Park tube station. There's a late night bakery down the street that does amazing bagels and several shops/pubs nearby for anything you need. My only small disappointments were the pillows and the room wasn't as clean as it could have been but even so I'd recommend it.

title: Location good
text: Stayed for one nite in February, had a single room , very basic , but clean , could do with a better pillow or maybe even just a second one , the bathroom was quite a tight fit and I don't think a larger person would be comfortable at all there , saying that- it suited me just fine as I was attending a match at the Emirates Stadium,it's probably a 15/20 mins stroll to the stadium and only a 3/4 mine walk to the underground station Finsbury park.The break was good,a selection of cereals, yogurts also a full English given. I will stay here again

title: Good clean stop over
text: Stayed for 1 night booked an hour before arriving as our journey was delayed so we needed a stop over rather than travel to friends in West London. First impressions were good, very clean with warm welcome. Our room was a twin with the most efficient use of space I have ever seen! The bathroom was modern and spotless and again creatively designed to fit into a small space. Yes if you were in the room a lot it would seem claustrophobic, but as a stop over it was fine. Personally I prefer clean rooms and location over large rooms when not wanting to spend for luxury. Great location for Finsbury Park Station, easy walking distance and the reception arranged a taxi to Alexandra Palace for £12. Breakfast was ok. The croissants were very cheap and doughy. The full breakfast was what you'd expect at a cheaper establishment, but we've had similar in higher priced places! There was plenty to choose from but a menu listing cooked options would help. Would recommend if you are looking for good transport links and clean modern accommodation.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: We stayed here for a family wedding, and having paid just £55 including breakfast for a double room we were pleasantly surprised by the quality of everything! Prior to our arrival we requested a cot and a parking space which were both available (although no dropped kerb so beware if youre car is particularly low) The reception staff were friendly and welcoming and the rooms were ready for a midday check in perfect for the wedding at 2pm. The rooms were clean and modern with everything you needed ours had two double beds and enough room for the cot, and we had a nice shower room. We were on the third floor so no problem with noise although a lift would have been great for the buggy and all baby kit! The breakfast was great, although no high chair available but this wasn't too much of a problem. Overall and for the price paid hotel highly recommended.

title: Good hotel
text: We have spent 6 nights there (2 adults and 2 children in the same room). Price is reasonable comparing to other places. Underground and bus station is very close, you can reach Heathrow airport easily event at night (when no underground service). Room was clean, breakfast was good (can choose if you like English breakfast or continental breakfast). Staff was helpful. Walls are thin so you can hear other people and the street is also busy (I slept with earplugs so I was not bothered at all). I can recommend this hotel.

title: Modern and affordable ..
text: Came here on a Business trip and stayed here for 2 nights. Very affordable and would go further and say it was like getting a 4* hotel for the price of a 2*. The kind and polite staff had reserved me a space for my car as London is usually a nightmare for Parking. Anyways the rooms were very spacious and modern. Had a very nice relaxing night sleep. And would definitely recommend for any type of visit if your near by. Very polite and needs understanding staff.

title: Lovely little hotel
text: We stayed for one night in November (2 adults and 2 children) We requested a double & two single beds, which we got. We were in room 27 which was perfect for us. There was still some floor space for the kids to play - quite rare in budget London hotels. The location is very convenient for access to central London and cheaper than other hotels. The hotel was clean and smelled lovely! The staff were welcoming and friendly. Our room wasn’t ready and we wanted to head straight out. When we returned, our bags were in our room. A lovely touch. The breakfast was good however you need to be really clear what you want. The ladies didn’t seem to understand ‘full english’ and were only bringing eggs out for everyone until another guest explained to them what they meant. Overall, a great little find that I would definitely return to when staying over in London again.

title: Very good for the price
text: I stayed here for four night this past weekend and was very pleasantly surprised. I stayed in a single room in the basement. Not thd biggest or rooms, but a very comfy bed, great shower-I have long hair so this is very important- and an ok breakfast. The staff are excellent-they sourced a fan for me on what has been a hideously hot weekend, were very friendly and helpful with all requests, couldn't ask for more. One star lost because there was a problem with the wifi for all four nights I was there that resisted all attempts to fix it. But I'd highly recommend this hotel if you're looking for a clean, comfortable place to sleep with good transport links.

title: Great little place close to the tube
text: We stopped for a night for a concert at Alexandra palace. Close buy is the bus and tube and Finsbury Park is opposite. This is a cracking little hotel with everything you need for a night stop. A good breakfast downstairs but the veggie option is limited. The hotel Isn't noisy it is the inconsiderate guests that make noise not that I heard a thing after a night watching The Prodigy. Thanks for a great little stop.

title: Atrocious!
text: This hotel is terrible! If you’re after any kind of peace & quiet from the hustle and bustle outside stay elsewhere, the walls are that thin you can hear the people in the next room turning over in their bed, you can hear them turn the tap on in their bathroom. If you’re after some kind of comfort while you sleep, stay elsewhere. The mattresses are either that old or cheap that you can feel the springs on your body. The bathroom is that small you struggle to sit on the loo! I’m not a large person either (32” waist) I asked for an iron and ironing board and got given a full size iron but the board wasn’t much bigger than the iron. It was impossible to use! I had to end up ironing my shirt on a towel on the chair that was in the room. The breakfast is served so late that chances are you won’t be able to have it! They tell you it’s from 0730 however it’s not actually set up and ready until 0740 which meant I was late for my first appointment. You’re not allowed ANY visitors to the room you are paying for! The whole place needs a major revamp to bring it into the 21st century. The decor is dilapidated, scruffy and aged.

title: Lovely Hotel for an overnight stay
text: We stayed here for one night following a night out at the Alexandra Palace, the hotel is situated on the main road, a few minutes walk from lots of shops, bars and cafes, it is a 5 minute walk max from the tube/ train. The atmosphere within the hotel was lovely and welcoming and check in was quick and easy. Payment was required on arrival. We were directed to our rooms, the corridors of the hotel were cold but the rooms were warm. We stayed in a twin room which was more than adequate, there was a small shower room/ toilet, a small wardrobe and a small desk. There were tea/ coffee making facilities in the room too. The room was clean, modern and comfortable. Slept really well, and the hotel was quiet. Breakfast was good and varied (full enlist, cereals, meats etc) check out again nice, quick and easy. Would definitely stay here again if visiting London. Thank you for a lovely stay :-)

title: Good for the price
text: This was very conveniently located for the tube and opposite the very pleasant Finsbury Park. The single ensuite room was small but spotlessly clean and comfortable. I was at the back of the hotel and it was very quiet. It was very cheap and value for money for London.

title: Fine hotel in Finsbury
text: We visited the hotel in connection with a visit to Emirates Stadium and it was perfect located within walking distance of stadium. Not the best location for shopping and restaurants however close to Underground station and easy to get to other areas of London. Friendly staff, clean rooms and OK breakfast. Only disadvantages I can come up with is that there are no elevator (we stayed at top floor) and that you occasionally had to wait for a table in the breakfast restaurant.

title: Great find and easy accessible!
text: I needed a last minute hotel booking for a work function that was happening in Mayfair that wasn’t going to cost me an arm and a leg and I’m glad I found Queen’s. Short walk from the station so travelling to and fro from there was easy, check-in again was easy and very helpful, as mentioned to me before going up to the room about no hairdryers in the room so saved me a trip of going upstairs to come back down to pick one up. Free WiFi so another plus. The room itself was quite small, but wasn’t expecting anything different and it was clean and fully functional so again no complaints. My view from my window of Finsbury Park itself was also a nice touch. I would definitely stay here again if needed.

title: Ideal for finsbury park events
text: Stayed here for a concert held at Finsbury Park. Rooms are small but it was ideal for a resting place after the concert. Bathroom was also small but very clean. There was no bar at this hotel but right next door there is a cafe bar as aprt of another hotel which had a small beer garden. Tube from London Victoria is approx 15 minutes to Finsbury park station and the hotel is about a 5 minute walk up the road from the station. Breakfast was average sausage/bacon/egg tea and coffee. In summary - if you have an event at Finsbury Park then this is great, wouldn't want to spend more than a couple of nights though due tio no bar etc

title: Lovely small hotel
text: The hotel was lovely and clean the reception staff were great helping with taxis and sorting out the tv in our room. The room was functional but very small you could not turn in the bathroom for the price we were very suprised. I would recommend the breakfast which set us up for the day

title: Great service, location, breakfast & staff. A little more effort on maintanence would go a long way.
text: I stayed here with my girlfriend Mid may of this year. The hotel looked good from outside. The reception & general décor was also of a good standard. We were greeted by a friendly receptionist who explained everything we needed to know & was very helpful (gave us umbrellas on our way to dinner). Our room was clean & tidy however, there were a few little things wrong. Firstly our kettle leaked form the base right near to the power cable which, was a little unsettling. We reported it & the friendly man at reception changed it for us straight away. Secondly, the toile seat was broken & slid around when we tried to sit on it. Thirdly, which was actually quite dangerous, our TV fell off the wall! Luckily we were laid on the bed watching it. Had either of us been sat at the table underneath it, we would have been hurt. Again, the guy at reception was very apologetic & helpful (although not his fault). I had a look at the fixings & clearly the wrong ones had been used. The wall was plaster board but the fixings were for brick. We went out to dinner & when we returned we had a note of apology, some wine & chocolates. The gesture was very nice & appreciated. Our stay included breakfast & it was lovely, all freshly prepared & served with a smile. Overall this place is a great little find. Clearly they have the right recipe for success, with great staff. But, with a little more attention to detail & maintenance this place could be a real gem!

title: A Good Find
text: Was visiting North London to see a band and booked this online. After reading some other reviews I wasn't expecting much, what a surprise. Pleasant and easy check in, room was clean, well equipped (if a little compact) Missed the breakfast as was late up but it smelled nice. If you need a lift and can't manage stairs then go to the Ritz, I have paid more for a much smaller room in West End ! Handy for Finsbury Park tube and some nice local shop, pubs and eataries too. Great Value

title: Very good value.
text: Stayed here as I was visiting my daughter who lives nearby but lives in a small flat. Very convenient for me as five minutes from tube. Checked in at nearly midnight but not a problem. Single room small but perfectly good for one night. Comfortable bed & spotless. Quiet too. Cooked breakfast reasonable with also a selection of meat, cheese & cereals etc. Extra coffee & toast. Could have been a bit more organised e.g. replenishing buffet etc. Very friendly young lady on reception when I checked out. Very chatty & genuinely concerned that I had a good stay. Not perfect but pretty decent for £70.

title: Mixed feelings
text: We stayed at the hotel for a night My brother booked this for us thinking that we will be getting something worth for 65 quid in Finsbury Park I'm highly claustrophobic, really struggling with small places. However, we booked a twin room thinking, of course, it will have to be a good size double instead we were given a very narrow single room with a bathroom attached. I have to say that the room was clean in general with a quite modern touch to it but considering my health condition was a real struggle for me to stay there, not being able to sleep all night. Although my poor brother did everything he could contacting Expedia trying to find a solution to our situation but we were literally just passed around customer service for two hours without any results. Shame on them. Hotel receptionist Milkos was very kind and comfortable but unfortunately, he had no power on doing anything about it and there was no manager around or anywhere to be reached to solve the issues. Everyone seemed to not care. Really disappointed about this as everything else was decent in general with a great breakfast as well. My advice to the management (Lana) is to try to be more engageable if they want anyone to come back and their small business to thrive. As far as we are concerned we will never be back there for the lack of professionalism and indifference we were treated as well as customer service. Again from higher management who did not bother to move one finger in order for my complaint to be dealt with accordingly considering my health situation. Very unhappy !!!!

title: A mixed stay
text: We stayed here for one night for my partners 40th. I did mention it was but there wasn't anything done to to make it extra special which was a shame. The hotel is clean and welcoming. Not long after getting into the room (which was nice) I put the TV on and slightly adjusted the angle of it. It didn't look particularly secure but I was careful. Five minutes after sitting on the bed to watch it then whole thing fell off the wall. Luckily no one was hurt and the TV didn't smash. I popped down to reception and the member of staff came up straight, away, cleared the room and was very apologetic. We were a bit shocked but it could have been worse. Came home at the end of the night and found an apology note, a bottle of wine and a box of chocolates which was a good. They definitely need to work on their maintenance as the kettle had needed a PAT test since March 17 as well. When the TV fell off I did ask them to change it which they did. The breakfast was pretty nice and quick. Not sure if I'd stay again...

title: Not Great
text: I stay in hotels semi-regularly for my work, and this was one of the more poor I have stayed in. The hotel seems clean at first but after spending some time there it became clear that it was not. The hotel was very strongly scented by a plug in which was very over powering. The room was invaded by small insects on the windowsill. The television was not tuned in and a security lock on the ability to tune it in myself, and there was some sticky black substance on the blinds. The beds were hard and the single pillow provided was flat and had a crease in the middle where it had spent time folded in half. There was no cleaning of the room at any point during my stay, some one came in to top up the coffee/tea but no-one made the bed, or cleaned the bathroom/replaced towels. The staff were not accommodating to our request to take breakfast a little earlier due to work commitments. The need to hand your key in every time you leave feels somewhat limiting, though I can understand that this is necessary for security. It is in a convenient location, near to several shops and food outlets, as well as Finsbury Park underground. Overall, my stay at this hotel was not a comfortable one, and I couldn’t give any more than 2 stars for my experience.

title: Good value in an excellent location
text: Having recently spent several nights at the Queens Hotel, I can recommend it as value for money. Exceptionally clean throughout, it also smells very hygienic, with the communal areas very well carpeted, painted and lit. Reception staff clean and polish in communal areas at quiet times.The overall impression is of a calm and dignified place, with helpful ,polite and unobtrusive staff, who represent a vast array of countries.The three reception staff I encountered were Georgian, Hungarian and Maltese,with the kitchen/breakfast staff eastern european. The cooked breakfast was good,and cooked and presented to the same standard every day. On the first day I asked for extra toast, thereafter it was given to me from the start, by the friendly servers. The room was clean and well lit, the water in the sink and in the showers down the corridor always piping hot, and the bedding changed every day, with fresh towels and little soap, as was the drinks making facilities.The furniture was basic and the light lacked a shade, but this was known about anyway, no plug on the sink, but one wasn't necessary for my purposes as I waash and shave, etc., with running water.The room was warm , but a convector heater was supplied in the wardrobe for addtional heat, which was never necessary, and the other guests were quiet and there were never any noise issues. It would be hard to imagine a better locationfor a guest house in this price bracket, opposite the green lung of Finsbury Park, less than a minute from bus stops, shops ,petrol stations and cashpoints, and two minutes from mainline and underground trains, post office, supermarkets, restaurants, etc. Great care is taken by the management to supplement the green theme, with a welcoming array of planters, tubs and hanging baskets, and with pot plants in evidence inside too. Looking forward to staying there again !

title: Neat and Tidy Hotel
text: My wife and I stayed here for four nights and were suitably impressed by the cleanliness and pleasantness of the hotel. It was also a nice touch for the owner to give us a bottle of Merlot on arrival. Our room, whilst not huge, was fine with windows that opened for fresh air, which is always a bonus. The breakfast was also good and the service very quick and efficient as were the staff who manned reception. The only drawback was the lack of quality restaurants in the area. Would we go back? Yes, we would.

title: Perfectly fine accommodation at a good price
text: We stayed at this hotel for the recent darts world championship at ally pally and for us, (there were 8 of us) it was good value and hassle free, very close to Finsbury park tube station. The check in was fine, breakfast nice enough and the rooms looked like they'd been recently refurbished, yes they were small but what do you expect for the money? Would stay here or next door at the penbury no problem

title: Totally okay in its price class!
text: Stayed here for one night. Room was okay. Bathroom, TV, WiFi, Breakfast, and limited parking space available. Rooms are small, if you are looking for a lot of comfort than this is not the place for you. Street rooms are little loud. Request a backroom if you are easily awoken at night. Underground train is 5-8 minutes away from the hotel. 7 stops away from the Main Victoria Train Station. Near Hotel, there are many Restaurants in the neighborhood, and also few Pubs. Variety of grocery stores are also close by. Breakfast is your regular English Breakfast, coffee, tea, etc. Staff was very friendly, and helpful. If you are staying here over the weekend, the streets might be very crowded at night. Like I said few Pubs/Clubs are close by. Emirates Stadium home of FC Arsenal is like 15min away, walking distance. Overall, everything went as I expected. If I ever find myself in London I will consider staying here again. Keep up the good work.

title: Stayed for Local Music Event
text: After missing out on getting a room in the same hotel as my friends, Queens Hotel was my next closest option. I may of only spent a maximum of 8 hours in the actual hotel but it did everything in which I needed it too do(Shower, get ready and sleep). Based only several hundred yards up from Finsbury Park tube its in good location as well as been close to local supermarkets and takeaways. Small rooms but for one person Im not complaining. I had breakfast in the morning and whereas everything was fine for myself i did notice that there was one table that were having problems as the kitchen never seemed to get a message about specific dietary requirements and Queens kitchen staff didn't seem to have a solution to the problem, that been said i didn't stay long enough to see the outcome. There was however a good choice of added extra's such as cereal, brioche and hams to go alongside the full english breakfast (Nice touch). Staff were also very friendly and were helpful when i was in a rush so they placed my bags in my room for me. In all a perfectly fine hotel, beds certainly werent the comfiest but they did the job and the price seemed slightly steep but i suppose due to the time of booking i would have struggled to find anywhere else as cheap.

title: Nica and well located
text: Even though it felt a little bit small (single room in the basement), overall it was very acceptable. The staff was friendly, breakfast was good including a full English breakfast. People in the hotel were a little bit noisy, but I still managed to sleep well. The shower and bathroom were very clean and the location was pretty good. About 10min walk from Manor House Metro station.

title: Fit for Lilliputians only!!
text: Once upon a time there was a hotel. It was called the Queen's Hotel. It was a special hotel. Because it was named after the Queen! And the hotel had a tiny, tiny room. With a tiny, tiny sink....that didn't work. And tiny, tiny beds. Even the ironing board was tiny, so tiny in fact that it didn't even seem to exist. It was a magic ironing board! The shower was BIG but the water pressure was...yes, you've guessed it, tiny, tiny! And the woman on the desk was tiny too, and very grumpy! So much so that resolved never in fact to go back to the hotel, ever ever again. I don't know about living happily ever after BUT I will be going to the Travelodge next time. The End

title: A little gem of a hotel
text: A few minutes walk from Finsbury Park tube/overground/rail station, this place is great. I am staying here for business reasons and the staff are lovely, the rooms clean and comfortable, the shower is great and a good selection at breakfast. Bit of noise from other guests but a brilliant combination of quality and value.

title: very nice and friendly
text: the hotel is very nice. the stuff is just GREAT! lovely friendly caring people, a massive THANKS to all of them! it was all very clean and cosy and warm! the surrounding area is not a very good one, but if you are only stayng a few days to visit London, it would be very ok to stay here. i will personally stay at this hotel again next time i visit London :)

title: Great customer service comfort only ok. Should be 2.5 star hotel
text: Staff is super nice, breakfast is great, clean for most part but room is only okay. No A/c, water is not really going down on shower and sink drain, bed is cheap quality, can hear noise from upstairs and hallway. The bed has springs and you can actually feel it when laying down. Wifi is regular speed (19 mbps p sec). House rule is to leave key up front at all times. Seems to be an okay neighborhood, few bums on the block

title: Arsenal Away Day
text: A couple of times a year a group of my Arsenal Friends and myself try to get a weekend in to catch up with each other and to take in an Arsenal home game, as we travel from various parts of the country we normally stay over and I must say we have fallen on a little gem of a hotel ideal situated for us, especially as Arsenal Fans but even if your not it's an ideally situated hotel to base yourself! It's literally five minutes walk from the tube, the Queens Hotel is very welcoming and accommodating, it's very clean and well presented, warm and comfortable and perfect for a stop over in London , we have used the hotel on a couple of occasions and it is now always our first choice option, it's ideal for us as a group as they have "quad" rooms which will sleep 4 people and it's very economical when you share the price between 3 or 4 plus you get a full English breakfast in with the cost! They also have free wife in the hotel which is very handy when away from home! We will definitely be using the hotel in the future and would definitely recommend the hotel!! Ps please don't think it's full of rowdy football fans because it's not we are all family people and business people and respectful of our environment and to be honest the only time you know there are other people in the hotel is when you go down for breakfast in the mornings !!

title: Great for one night stay
text: Booked the hotel for one a night stay. The staff are friendly and helpful and serves an okay breakfast. Room was clean and not too stuffy. If I was in the area again, I would definite consider staying here again. A little expensive for what you get, but I guess that's London for you!

title: Stayed with my son for one night so we could watch his team arsenal play. Excellent choice of hotel. Receptionist was so helpful
text: Hotel is excellent. I travelled down from Scotland so my son could see arsenal play. Staff are very nice and I must mention the receptionist who was so helpful. Found my son an I phone charger which made a huge difference to our trip as his French girlfriend was chatting on facebook when battery died! Rooms are really clean and tidy and seem to be very new. Breakfast was lovely and staff very polite and helpful. I also spoke with a wee Italian chap who offered to get me a coffee. Nice conversation and it was clear he was the owner. Very friendly which epitomises the hotel. Don't worry about staying here. It's a fine hotel, well run and will be just what you need.

title: Very good reasonably priced hotel
text: Booked direct with the Queens to get a better deal as we stayed for 3 nights. Location- within 5 mins of Underground station, and, on the way, there are numerous eateries and pastry shops etc to stock up. Hotel was very clean, reception friendly, ideal for somewhere to stay at reasonable cost and very convenient.

title: Ok Stay
text: Stayed here for one night in May after concert at the Emirates Stadium. Very good location as only 15-20 mins walk to the Emirates and only 5 mins from Finsbury Park tube. We had a quad room which was small (not unexpected in London) but clean and comfortable. Breakfast was basic but ok. All in all it met our needs, which was somewhere to sleep after a gig.

title: Convenient and good value
text: Spent a couple of nights here - found a good price online and it was just what I wanted. Two Tube stops from Kings Cross station and a few minutes walk from the Tube. The single room was small but had everything I needed and a view over Finsbury Park. English breakfast was included. Staff friendly and everything worked.

title: Small but fine
text: Just back from a weekend at the Queen's. It is small, but I found the beds comfy. For a budget hotel you can't complain. Breakfast is average but satisfactory. To be honest, we didn't spend much time there as we were out all day. The only issue we had was every time someone in the room above us had a shower there was a terrible dripping noise, which wasn't a problem when you were awake, but after midnight=awful. The bathroom fan went on for at least half an hour after switching the light off, but we did find a switch high on the bedroom wall to switch it off altogether. If you just want the hotel as somewhere to sleep it's fine.

title: Great location for Ally Pally Gig
text: Stayed here whilst attending a concert at Alexandra Palace. Ideal location as the train/tube station is a 5 minute walk away, so easy to get to and from the venue. Hotel nice and modern clean and has standard hotel facilities. Price included full English breakfast, which was probably the same cost as a Travelodge or Premier inn, so well worth it IMHO.

title: Ok
text: Hotel immaculate. My single room was tiny but perfectly formed. Had everything I needed for a 2 night stay. Unfortunately, refurb money was not spent on sound proofing. Two nights poor sleep due to the noise. I'm not exaggerating when I say I could hear next doors mobile vibrate on silent, the light switch being turned on and off, the television and the hairdryer being used. Won't go back - which is a shame as its got a lot going for it.

title: Stayed 3 weeks did not have any issue
text: Stayed 3 weeks. Staff was great. Ladies who served the breakfast were very helpful and polite. Simple and clean rooms. Loved Christmas decorations and lighting. Rooms are not very big but not tiny either. We found a Turkish restaurant just two Street away loved the food. Two masques near by (4mins and 7mins walk). Finsbury park just opposite, Western wedding party wear shops walking distance plus station about 4mins walk. Recommended!

title: My London go-to
text: I've always rang through, so can tend to negotiate a better price on the rooms when I stay. (which already puts them on a good footing with me) I always come away with a very good price for staying in London. Every time I stay in a double room. Positives: Price Comfortable Double Bed Good sized TV Reliable Wi-Fi Excellent cold breakfast options Very helpful staff Rooms are cleaned daily Negatives: Rooms to the front can be quite noisy Only two parking spaces (although I've never had an issue) Cooked breakfast can be hit and miss Some of the rooms are starting to show excessive use Overall, if you're wanting to stay in London and this is your price point, then its a very good hotel. If you're trying to save money by staying here and still expecting £100 per night quality, then you're a bit silly.

title: Disappointing
text: The facade of the building is encouraging - it presents well as a boutique hotel and overall the building is in good order and decoration. And its a relatively cheap hotel but compared to say travel lodge or premier inn which can pitch in at similar rates, the rooms are teeny-tiny and the separating walls paper thin. Noisy guests in the corridors didn't help with the quality of sleep - these issues can happen with any hotel but staff intervention to keep noise down would have been nice. These minor issues I'd forgive but my big disappointment was in the breakfast room. Customer service was unacceptably poor - the staff ignored not just me but other hungry guests while they attended to tables in a somewhat lackadaisical manner. I ended up clearing a table myself so I could have breakfast before I needed to leave for my meeting. A family of four had waited so long they also requisitioned a table that had not yet been cleared but had lain empty for over five minutes, others waited at the door, watching the empty tables being passed over while staff faffed. We have a tea room and our staff are taught to acknowledge customers, clear tables quickly and ensure customers feel attended to even if it will be a few minutes for food to arrive. Leaving people ignored at the door is not acceptable. Waiting staff struggled to work in the medium of English so a bilingual maitre'd with good command of English and more experience of waiting would help bridge the customer service gap. I've used other budget hotels in London, this one is ok and has the potential to offer good value, but waiting staff need sorting out as they've let the team down on this occassion.

title: Good value hotel
text: The rooms are small but you expect that in London. This hotel is very good value. It was a great location for us as we were visiting family in North London. It is clean and quite comfortable. There is a full English breakfast included also. The free wi-fi was useful too. We were just here for one night. The staff were very pleasant also.

title: A nice hotel but with a few negatives
text: A nice small hotel in the Finsbury Park area of London (in zone 2), very close to the tube station and several other amenities such as a Tesco Express, Subway and small newsagent-type shops. The room was immaculate and so was the bathroom, clearly recently refurbished. I paid around £60 for the night for a single room but prices do often rise higher than this. The room was small but ample for a one night stay and sole traveller. It also had reliable Wi-Fi and freeview TV. There were a couple of negatives though. The bathroom loo seat wasn’t screwed on properly, the bathroom vanity light and shaver plugs did not work – maybe these are after-affects of the recent refurbishment. The sink is also tiny and it is near impossible to have a wash in this sink without soaking the entire bathroom! It would also have been nice to have more than one towel in the bathroom and more than one small pillow on the bed (there were no extras in the wardrobe), these should really come as standard in all hotels and usually do. Aside from the above, my main negative is that the walls are incredibly thin and it is possible to hear your neighbour on the phone, watching tv, flushing the loo and even their bathroom fan. It is no exaggeration to say that I could hear my neighbour snoring very clearly in the room next door – the walls are obviously paper thin and not really suitable for overnight accommodation. This is not ideal and is the only reason I wouldn’t rush back. Breakfast is included in the room rate and consists of full English and/or continental and was OK. Staff are friendly. I would recommend to sole travellers if you can get a good price (and a quiet room). Maybe request extra towels, pillows and some earplugs to to make your stay more comfortable!

title: Good choice
text: Hotel is in a good location for the Emirates stadium, the rooms are comfortable very clean and tidy, the staff are helpful and there was good selection for breakfast. Finsbury park station is 5 minutes away, and there are plenty of local shops.

title: One night stay
text: Very clean and tidy, all facilities very good. Breakfast was lovely. Staff were all very helpful and polite. Beds could have been a little more comfy but for a one night/short break it was perfect. There are a lot of stairs in the property which is not made clear at time of booking but was not an issue for myself.

title: nice staff
text: stayed here two nights during august, we had a double room and a triple room. both rooms were lovely and clean, beds were nice and comfortable. all the staff we met were polite, smiling and helpful . breakfast was lovely both mornings with plenty of choices . the location of the hotel was good with ease of access to trains, underground, buses and taxis. we will stay here again no problem !

title: Fantastic find - handly placed for transport
text: I stayed here for 3 nights whilst down in London on business - great hotel. 2 mins walk from Finsbury Park tube station, so very accessible to London centre. I was in a single room, and whilst quite small, it was spotless, with a very smart (again small!) but clean ensuite shower and toilet. Adequate storage for a single traveller, room also has a desk and tea/coffee facilities, small fan and modern TV..All staff I dealt with were excellent and reception is manned 24 hours. Only two small negatives - the bed only had one small pillow - two or the option of 2 would be good, and the position of the TV meant you couldn't fully see it when lying on the bed (as it was round a corner). All in all though great hotel - also very quiet ( I was in room 4 near the back) - and I paid £176 for 3 nights B&B so great value!

title: Good value for money
text: Good little hotel, I used this for a recent weekend break and found it perfect for my needs. Comfy beds and very friendly staff, also a choice of breakfasts in the morning. An ideal place to stay if you're on a budget. I had no bother with noise as I was in a basement room. The hotel is ideally placed for the tube which is a couple of minutes' walk away, and is also on a main (24-hour) bus route, there is also a good choice of buses from the bus interchange at the tube station. A good range of local shops is nearby and Finsbury Park itself is over the road. I came away feeling that I'd made the right choice and will return again. And for any Scots reading this review there is a 24-hour filling station next door which sells Highland Spring mineral water and Irn Bru!

title: Second stay - less positive experience
text: I got home from a 3 night stay at the Queen's hotel today (end of August). Two years ago I stayed there for one night and my review of this experience is on Tripadvisor as well. Turns out, this is a good hotel for a one night stay, in cooler weather. This longer stay, in near heat-wave weather, revealed some flaws that weren't a problem the last time. The rooms really are tiny. For one night, it's not a problem. If you're staying longer, the space becomes an issue. For one, you need to bring more stuff, so getting rid of them semi-neatly is a big issue. And second, the lack of space and constant bumping into things becomes annoying. If the weather is hot, it becomes so incredibly hot and stuffy in the rooms. They do provide you with a small fan. We had to leave it on all night to get some sleep. Since we also had to sleep with the window open, because of the heat, the noise became a problem as well. Street noise is acceptable, really didn't bother us. But since everyone had their window open, and the rooms are packed in so close together, we could constantly hear TVs in other rooms. Our room didn't get cleaned after the first night. It appears they forgot. The reception staff was helpful and got us clean towels and cleared out the bin. But, yeah, mentionable oversight. And the shower. Man, the shower. Rain shower. Some people might enjoy this but I at least want the option of having a hand held shower head. The water pressure was laughable. The temperature gauge makes no sense whatsoever, and early the final morning, the water would not heat up. Despite that list I'm rating it average and not poor, because this is still a clean, friendly, good value hotel in a great location, and breakfast was as lovely as the last time. I just no longer recommend it for a stay longer than a night.

title: Let Down
text: If you don't mind a cramped room and are in no hurry for breakfast then this is the place for you. We stayed in a double room that was just about big enough to get the bed in. The shower in the ensuite was tiny and very temperamental and definitely not what you would call powerful. As for breakfast well we waited 20 minutes for anyone to even acknowledge us and then only because we asked if we were going to be served, then when we did finally order the food was totally wrong and had to be sent back and the toast was made up of every crust left over from that mornings service there was not a single slice of bread! Would love to have been able to discuss the problems we had when we checked out but there was no one on reception so we just left. Good location for public transport into the city but that was about all the good points we could find.

title: Noisy and smallest double room ever.
text: The rooms at the first floor at the front of this hotel are noisy and tiny. The Seven Sisters Road is constantly busy and the "double" bed is forced under the window with your head next to the window. Even with earplugs and windows closed the traffic is noisy. The room was described as a double room, at best it was a large single with a double bed crammed in .
