No fans in the heat, 1 double socket so far away from the bed making it a pain for phone alarm etc. Was also a little disturbed by the request to photocopy my driving licence ... The room had been pre paid by our agency and I had shown positive ID . Letting someone take a copy of personally identifiable data seemed unreasonable. I would never stay here again I'm afraid .

title: Enjoyable Stay
text: We stayed back in October for a few nights whilst doing touristy things in London and found this accommodation to be exactly what we needed. The staff were friendly and helpful and the room was clean and had everything we needed. The bathroom was on the small side but was fine for how long we were there, we didn't want to pay too much money as the hotel was just a base for us as we were out all day. The hotel is on the high street but our room was quiet at night and the tube station is just 2 minutes flat walk so pretty good location. The breakfast room was quite busy each day so we often had to squeeze onto tables wherever possible so I would recommend getting up a bit earlier if you plan to have breakfast which is worth having.

title: Affordable, comfortable and very friendly
text: We recently stayed in a room, which we asked for a double and two single beds, of which we didn't get but did get a bottle of wine, which was brilliant! The rooms we stayed in were clean, comfortable and the bathroom was spacious, compared to other reviews on here, I expected smaller, especially for the size of the building and what London bathrooms are usually like. We also had the pleasure of meeting the boss of the building (at least we think it was?) who was very friendly and gave us some chocolates, which was very kind of him. Would definitely stay here again in future!

title: Good location. Clean rooms. Friendly staff. Good breakfast.
text: Booked a triple room for a week at the end of Sep 2013. Very good location, very close to Finsbury Park tube station . Small but always clean rooms. Very friendly and helpful staff. Quiet hotel since we were at the back side. You don't ask anything more if you travel for sightseeing since you spend most of the time out of the hotel. Among the first choices for future stay.

title: Fab B&B would definitely recommend
text: I've stayed here twice now and can't think of anything bad to say about the hotel!! Clean,tidy,good location and most of all the staff are lovely and friendly which I find is rare here in this part of town! I have to say how impressed I was with Tima in the breakfast area, such a hard worker and always lovely and friendly to the guests and nothing is too much trouble for her-definitely the best staff member here by far-keep up the good work Tima as guests appreciate a friendly greeting !! Will be returning again very soon with my family for a short break x

title: Horrible
text: I'm writing this review from the very uncomfortable bed in room 11. I usually stay at the Best Western London Highbury just up the road but they were fully booked. I felt the need to post a review straight away. Please see fotos below of the room as soon as I checked in. First of all, as soon As I walked into the room the smell of dirty carpet was very prominent. Not even vacuum cleaned. Then I noticed the beds weren't made nicely. Just sheets thrown on the bed and no effort whatsoever to make them like you would expect in a hotel. People are just arriving in their room and I can hear them like as if they are in my room. The shower room is extremely small and the shower doesn't work properly. Took ages to warm up. There aren't any hand towels. I'm just hoping I can manage to sleep tonight. Will never stay here again!

title: Stayed one night, it was clean and comfortable with helpful staff.
text: Single room number 2 was small but beautifully clean and surprisingly quiet. I asked for an extra pillow and it arrived within 10 minutes really pleasant and helpful staff. The breakfast was wonderful a full English and a wide variety of meats, cheeses, yoghurts, cereals, rolls, pastries and scones plus fruit juice and fresh fruit

title: This is what gives English hotels a bad reputation
text: Room so small it would be hard to swing a hamster in, let alone a cat. Bathroom I actually had to enter sideways as it was so small. Breakfast was awful with terrible service. It arrived with stone-cold baked beans and hard fried eggs. The only phrase the waitress seemed to have in her vocabulary was "one moment" which I heard her say in irritation at least 20 times in 5 minutes to various guests. I saw three couples get up and leave rather than waiting for their breakfast. The room I had was at the front of the building. A word to management: install triple glazing on the windows and some soundproofing on the walls between rooms or just go dormitory style which is extremely close to what is is now. I could hear the traffic like the windows were wide open all through the night and I also heard snoring from 3 different rooms! Oh, and I almost forgot to mention the two guys who came home at 2:00pm in the morning and treated everyone on that floor of the hotel to some drunken singing before engaging in some amorous activities which they also shared with everyone due to the cheap plasterboard walls thrown up between bedrooms to maximize the number of accommodations and therefore, the income. Overpriced and to be avoided! A youth hostel would be an upgrade. How on earth does anyone give a hotel like this even an average rating is beyond me.

title: Adequate but lower statndard than expected
text: We stayed in the family room. There was no lobby so we had to either be in the room or out of the hotel. Although it was clean, the stair carpet looked as if it had never been cleaned. The bathroom was too small to dress in and the breakfast was average. I thought that for the cost we could have expected better. Nonetheless, the location was good, opposite a park and easy access to bus and tube. While Wi-Fi was free it was not always available.

title: Surprisingly nice near Finsbury Park Train Station
text: After looking on various booking websites for a Hotel near Finsbury Park for two nights away on business I stumbled across The Queens. Rooms are clean, my bathroom (Shower) was compact and it served it's purpose as place to lay my head. Soundproofing between the corridors and the rooms could be improved as I could hear people coming back in the early hours, which did affect my sleeping. Full English was sufficient, although I had wished the yoghurts (which were stacked on a table) to be colder. All in all

title: Not too bad..
text: Firstly let me say that the staff here are great. Attentive, professional and friendly. The location is great. Several minutes walk to the railway station and to bars, restaurants and shops. The rooms are very small, and the room I was originally given had the view of a wall right in front of the window (see photo attached), this wouldn't be an issue for one night but for four.. No way! I requested a change of room and was moved without question. However the rooms are clean and tidy. The bathrooms are tiny, and the shower cubical is cramped. The breakfast is good, the toast needs toasting a little bit more (note to managers!), as its texture is little more than stale bread. Be warned that if the hotel is full, you'll need to wait to get a table when one comes free. All in all, this place is not too bad for the city centre and if you're in a budget.

title: Very friendly service and good breakfast
text: Very friendly service, luggage room available when you arrive early or leave late. Very good continental and full english breakfast. Bathroom very small, but it's London, room space was ok, we had a 4 bed room. Good location close to Finsbury Park tube and railway station.

title: One night stay
text: Excellent hotel. Friendly and helpful staff. Clean rooms and nice building. Close to tube station. Felt safe in this area at night with my 3 year old. The breakfast was good for the value . The hotel allowed us to leave our bags after checkout to allow us to visit the city before leaving.

title: Excellent value
text: We are three females who stayed overnight in London. It was my first time visiting the city but not for my sister and our friend. We were in town to see plays. We were surprised by the friendly staff who went out of their way to assist us with everything imaginable from directions, cabs to helping us with a broken suitcase. It wasn't just one person

title: Claustrophobic? Its not for you.
text: Stayed here in a triple room on Sat.11th of Nov. for a concert in Alexandria Palace with my 2 friends. Double bed and a single bed with a bathroom the size of one half of a double wardrobe in width. We are all of slim build so our elbows against each side wall of the bathroom didn't impact us to much. Their is no bar in this hotel so take a left as you come out of the hotel and within 2 mins you will arrive at the Seven Sisters pub. A lively spacious pub with good comfort grub for a hungry traveller. After the gig was over we couldn't get a cab so we walked about 4 klms until we found a well lit area with a closed restaurant and a crossroads with the name of the road. Still having no joy hailing cabs as they were all full we contacted the hotel. Having told the male receptionist that we were guests staying at the hotel and we didnt know how far away from the hotel we were and we couldn't get a cab. He refused to send a cab despite explaining to him that we were not from England and lost even though he recognised the location description. This conversation lasted 5 mins and then another wait ensued until he gave us a cab company number that didn't answer. Every hotel I have ever stayed in always offer that service bar this one. 40 mins later we got back to the hotel. The rooms of the hotel are paper thin and you could clearly here conversations and people walking about on the floors overhead. Breakfast was basic but warm. Not a good experience.

title: Very small
text: Stayed here with a friend to go to a work conference for 2 nights. These rooms are very small, we had a room each and both were the same, the beds are practically near the door. The bathrooms are unbelievably tiny you couldn't swing a cat in them. Couldn't see a hairdryer anywhere but you do get tea and coffee/soap/showergel. The breakfast is nice usual full English with choice of cereals/orange juice. The hotel however is clean. If you are claustrophobic this hotel is not for you. The main thing is the size of the rooms.. the pictures are deceiving.

title: Lovely boutique hotel
text: I live around the corner and I looked around the area for a good quality hotel on a reasonable budget for my mother to stay (the space in my flat is very limited) I was able to look inside of their rooms and get an idea of what to expect for my mother....she is of limited mobility so they were more than happy to cater to her needs. For tourist not just Arsenal fans I would recommend this hotel as you can grab the tube/rail/bus into the city centre as well as get a feel of "us" locals.

title: Awesome hotel
text: Lovely hotel - room very nice and, well laid out and facilities ideal. Hotel staff great couldn't be more helpful! Highly recommended. 5 mins walk from Finsbury Park tube station so ideal for Victoria line straight into central London attractions

title: Clean, cosy, simple and very decent for the price.
text: Paid £55 a night for a double en suite room incl breakfast. Room was very clean, modern and indeed very well heated (important considering it was literally 0 degrees outside). Got given a ground floor room, closest one to reception to be exact, which was quite unfortunate due to a bit of noise and quite a considerable amount of door banging around and about outside our room. The room was a bit cramped, however I wasn't exactly expecting a spectacular 5* experience at this price. The bed wasn't extremely comfortable either which was somewhat unfortunate. Close to some fantastic authentic restaurants and very close to lots of different means of public transport. Also pretty close to central London (15 mins by tube - 30 mins by bus approximately). Hotel keeper was very friendly Greek guy, gave us a couple of freebies for no apparent reason on our day of departure which was really sweet.

title: Not too bad but wouldn't stay again.
text: First things first: I am an open-minded traveler. I obviously prefer to stay in nice hotels, but I understand the need to stay in a cheap hotel so that you at least have a bed in the city. This trip was based on the latter, and we stayed for two nights. The street in front of the hotel is busy, and therefore sort of noisy, especially on the weekend. Another traveler gave a tip to ask for a room in the back if you want quiet, which is probably a good idea. You can also hear everything going on around you within the hotel

title: Queen's Hotel London England
text: This was a very nice hotel in a nice area, it was a short walk to the underground which connected us to all of London we wanted to visit. The room was small as was the bathroom but was comfortable, clean and updated so we did not mind. The staff was helpful, kind and friendly and breakfast was lovely. If you do not mind the stairs I would suggest the top floor to avoid noise from above which was the only issue we had but otherwise a very nice stay and would be happy to stay here again.

title: Lovely little hotel.
text: Stayed here for one night whilst attending a gig at Alexandra Palace. Lovely clean and welcoming hotel, quite basic but satisfactory for our needs. The staff were really friendly and helpful, bed and bathroom clean and comfortable, breakfast in the morning good, what more could you want.

title: Football-trip on my own.
text: Went to se a football-match at the Emirates Stadium December 2015, and stayed here for 3 nights. The hotell was nice, but I got a room facing Seven Sisters Road. The traffic-noise was so loud that I couldn't even sleep with ear-plugs! Located a 5 minute-walk from tube-station Finsbury Park (and a 15-minute-walk from the Emirates Stadium). Friendly staff, clean rooms, good breakfast if you're OK with English breakfast. Not very much to choose from when it comes to spreads/cold cuts though. Mainly jams and ham/salami and one type of cheese. For me the deal-breaker was the location of my room. If it wasn't for this I would rate this hotel much higher.

title: Well located clean hotel.
text: We needed a hotel close to Finsbury park for the Arctic monkeys concert and you don't get much closer than this. We arrived a little after check in time which is 12 o'Clock and our room was ready for us with the receptionist being fast and friendly. The room was clean and bright if not a little small but you expect that in London. There's a large LCD TV on the wall and tea and coffee making facilities although the plastic spoons weren't the best idea. The wardrobe only had three hangers in but we were only there for one night so that didn't bother us. The beds were fine apart from the valance sheet had bleach stains on it and there were brown cushions on top of the pillows that had seen better days. The bathroom was fine with a good shower although small it did the job and it was clean. Breakfast is served between 7.30 and 9.30 which was great for us but may be early if you want a lie in. the food was nice but I did feel as though the portions were small it felt like a children's breakfast. At checkout time it was just a case of handing the keys back and the receptionist saying thanks I thought she could have asked about our stay considering we paid £135 for one night. The location is great for the tube into central London and we had a great weekend.

title: Excellent all round.
text: This hotel is a hidden gem. I stayed for 2 nights and requested a quiet room instead of a street view. Very quiet indeed. Room was spotless, bathroom was spotless, staff were friendly, never came across anyone grumpy. Magda on reception is lovely , MIchael too, and all the other staff Who i didn't get to know by name. Breakfast service was excellent and the choice is great. I loved their cosy little reception. Overall very happy with my stay. Would stay again.

title: Nice hotel near Finsbury Park
text: You can walk from Finsbury Park underground station but cross the street.It is nice and comfortable.The family room of 4 is a bit small same as restroom.The bedding is fine.Breakfast is quite limit in choice,but you can choose English breakfast with sausage,ham and egg.For cleaning staff ,I saw her place new towels on the floor as they do not have trolley as the walkway is narrow. Stair is very narrow,I arrived in the morning and have to carry luggage to store in dinning room at basement.

title: Broken bed!
text: Booked this hotel quite late having seen good reviews on tripadviser. On arrival reception was small but smart, young lady on reception was very helpful but asked for photo ID which I had not been notified would be required (room was paid for in advance). I was given room 8 on the ground floor just behind reception. This is the smallest double room I have ever seen and certainly nothing like the photographs. Although small the room was clean let down by a rusty radiator. On sitting on the bed I discovered the bed base was actually broken so the mattress had no support. On reporting this to reception the nice young lady (having inspected it) was very apologetic but told me they were fully booked, had no other rooms and would be unable to replace the broken bed! I have just received a call from nice reception lady to tell me they may now be able to replace the bed. Bed was replaced with more apologies, unfortunately just due to the size of the room I wouldn't book again.

title: Nice hotel, but room far too small
text: This is a very pleasant hotel, with good service and pretty good breakfast. The location, directly opposite Finsbury Park and a short stroll from Finsbury Park station, is pretty good - especially if you want a break from central London or want to kick a ball around the park. There are local shops and take-aways. The hotel is clean and reasonably modern. But our main issue was that our room (room one) was VERY small. The en-suite bathroom was equally poky, with no wash-basin to speak of. The shower was also unsatisfactory. Considering the room price we paid, despite this being London and the hotel and staff being pleasant, I still feel it was not good value. Maybe for a lower price, or staying in a bigger room, things would have been different.

title: Queens Hotel. - a second home.....
text: We stayed 11 nights in this pleasant hotel.Everything was clean and tidy. Breakfast was plentiful. We had tea and coffee available to make in our room AND biscuits! This was highly appreciated after a long days shopping! Location is excellent, five minutes by train to central London. Bus stop and tube station, two minutes from the hotel. Shops and restaurants available nearby. The staff on reception and at breakfast were always helpful and polite and made us feel at home. A neat compact hotel...We will certainly come again.Thank you!

title: Location
text: Stayed here in February 2015 with my boyfriend as we were going to an Arsenal match. The area is ideal and was only maybe a 10-15 minute walk to the stadium (Was great not having to get the tube after the match as it usually takes ages because of the crowds). Finsbury tube station is only a 2 minute walk and there are many pubs, cafes and restaurants in the area. The hotel itself was nice. Friendly staff who let us check in even though we arrived very early. The room was small which we expected but it was fine as we didn't intend on spending time in there. The only complaint was that one side of the mattress had collapsed so was uncomfortable to sleep in. Also it was very noisy in the mornings as the walls are very thing. I would stay here again if we had a different room as the location was ideal.

title: Compact and bijou
text: We were visiting the Redbull Soapbox and wanted a hotel quite close to Alexandra Palace. The hotels that were closer were full so I had to make a wider search of hotels that were close enough to a tube station. I found the Queens Hotel in Finisbury Park, it has good reviews, its minutes away from a railway/tube station, its ideal. Staying here meant we had a choice either travel by train or the tube to our event. I enquired by email whether there was any room and an email was sent back very quickly to say there wasn't a double but one twin room left. As it was only for one night, a twin didnt matter. I emailed to say I wanted it and had another quick reply to say the room would be held for me until I rang up to pay. Which I did next day. It was quick and easy and had a confirmation email within 10 minutes. We arrived at the station and it was so easy finding the hotel, we were there within minutes. The Hotel from the outside looked really clean, we were impressed. We were greeted by a lovely young lady who handed me a form to fill in and explained about the 24 hr reception and the breakfast next morning. She showed us where our room was, It was room 20 which were up 2 flights of stairs. The door was quite stiff to open because of the door closer. The first sight of the room was pleasant but very small. It was really a room for a single but it didnt matter because we were only there for a single night. As long as the bed and bathroom are clean, its ok with us. The bathroom was tiny, its not a criticism, It was very clean and you don't spend a great deal of time in there. We changed and went for a walk. As soon as we walked out of reception, the receptionist called us back to say we need to leave our key there. No trouble. When we came back, we asked for our key and the receptionist made sure we were the people who were in that room that night. We walked towards the station and turned left onto Blackstock Road to find a place to eat later on that night. We found a couple of restaurants on Tripadvisor and wanted to take a look at them and perhaps book a table. We walked down about half a mile and started to flag as it was very hot, we saw The Arsenal Tavern and decided to call in for a cold beer. The staff were really pleasant and enjoyed our time there. When we came out, we walked a bit further to find Il Guscio that has really good reviews and it looked nice on the outside, the menu looks good, so we went into book a table. After our meal, we came back and the room was really hot because we had closed the window, one because of security and the other because of the pigeons that were hanging about outside. We had to turn the fan on and opened the window, by then the pigeons were asleep and not making any noise. The beds were really comfortable and slept part of the night but it was really hot in there. The fan was a god send. We woke early in the morning and went down for breakfast. We had a cooked breakfast which consisted of sausage, bacon, egg, beans and tomato. We could have tea or coffee and there was a good selection of yoghurts, cheeses, meats and cereals and fruit juices. Our breakfast didnt take long to come. The lady brought us plenty of toast, she was very nice. The breakfast room was full, nothing was too much trouble for the waitress. We checked out and walked to the station to go to Alexandra Palace. We wouldnt hesitate to recommend this hotel. Its very clean and the breakfast is lovely and everyone is so friendly.

title: amandas 30th
text: had a fab stay at this hotel staff very friendly breakfast great only downside rooms are a bit on the small side .it was my daughters 30th birthday so we were out all the time anyway.it was near tube station into central London in no time.due to my mobility I asked for a ground floor room it was no bother for the staff to give us a ground floor .when we came back our luggage had been moved to our new room.that was great service .we got very wet on the Friday evening but radiators were on so that was good as we were able to dry off our jackets don't know if I would stay again though would prefer central London.if you had children with you there was a big park across from the hotel.

title: More like a b&b
text: My daughter and I booked a night at this hotel as we were on a budget and just needed a stop over. Feels more like a B&B in that it is just a large house - on the end of a terrace. Check in was fine. We were in a twin room at the top - no lift and a normal "house like" staircase - we were fine with our little cases, but would be hard going if you had a big case. Room was tiny. No mattress protectors on beds, mattresses were tired. I ended up putting a blanket under my sheet for comfort! One pillow each and when I asked reception for a second, they said there weren't any! bathroom tiny, but clean and functional

title: Nothing too little trouble
text: Stayed here Saturday 25th April as my friend was running London Marathon and we had come down from Yorkshire to cheer her on. Party of 3 adults 2 kids. Originally booked United Lodge Hotel but was moved due a power cut (even though lights were on?) it was a nicer hotel but from the off we were treated like we were a pest. I asked how much the room cost being as the other hotel had paid for it due to our move and was told she wasn't allowed to tell us! She did though after gentle persuasion. We asked a room service menu and was told there is no room service. We asked if they could warm a pasty up for one of the kids and was told no. Hotel ok but area really rough ventured out once and that was enough!! Won't be staying around there again!

title: Don't let the location put you off.
text: I know the Finsbury area from when I lived in London and like the park and variety of shops. Near the station and bus interchange. Hotel staff was friendly, room clean and a good breakfast in the morning.

title: for the price it was OK
text: Our room was warm (which was good due to the snow outside) clean and comfortable. There was a really good choice for breakfast which made the price value for money. Down side, the lack of sound proofing between floors. My partner slept fine but I was woken up by people upstairs, not that they were making a lot of noise, just moving and walking about which kept me awake. My tip if you book direct with the hotel ask to me on the top floor. But if you are a heavy sleeper then you won't have any problem.

title: Friendly, welcoming hotel.
text: Walking distance from Finsbury Park tube station and night bus stops for visits to Camden, this hotel is ideal for a social visit to London. We stayed in a ground floor room at the back, and found it to be very quiet. The rooms are all carpeted, which helps with noise reduction. The room was small but very well appointed and spacious enough for two adults. The en-suite bathroom again was small, but spotlessly clean and modern and with a powerful shower. Breakfast was included in our booking, and included a good fry up as well as cereal, pastries, yoghurts and fruits. We were even asked if we'd like more toast

title: Easily accessible base for city traveller
text: Hotel is nicely situated only 5mins walk from Finsbury Park station. Stansted Airport trains stop at Tottenham Hale, which is only one tube station away from FP station, so it's only an hour travel. Buses run frequently to city centre, and it takes about one hour to walk peacefully to Camden Town. Area is fine, feels quite safe and the hotel has 24hr reception which is a safety issue too. Two ok pubs near, some geocery stores and ATMs, a post office and little fast food joints right down the street. The hotel itself is little, cleanish and cosy. Our room was at top floor so a lot of stairs, I would ask if they had family rooms downstairs if I was travelling with younger children or people with lower ability to walk. Our room was nice and quiet, facing back garden. No traffic noise at any time, which was nice as Seven sisters road seemed to be busy at all times. The room was spacious enough, as we were just sleeping and showering there. There was a complimentary kettle tray with instant coffee and tea, though we had to get our tea bags and coffee sachets downstairs after our first night. Our bathroom was big and clean. Toilet paper was quite poor quality and shower drain was a bit blocked - some people would've complained about it but we didn't care about it so much as we still could shower. Bathroom floor was really cold, and it got wet which was not nice as there were no extra towels or any equipment to dry it a bit. They served either continental or English breakfast every morning, but you actually had to choose which one you want and with English brekkie you weren't supposed to have anything but drinks from the continental buffet. A few rashers of bacon, a fried egg with runny yolk and a lot of cheap beans in tomato sauce is not a very nice English breakfast as I expected to get some mushrooms and tomatoes. Maybe there was some options, however we weren't asked anything. The continental breakfast was croissants (not crispy), rolls (small), brioche, lukewarm yoghurts, salami, ham and cheese. Two kinds of juice, coffee and tea, selection of marmelade and butter. Both breakfast options included toast, which was nice. Overall experience was ok, as we didn't want anything else but a place to shower, sleep and have some breakfast before running about the city. Location is good, staff is generally friendly and helpful. Would return to Queens Hotel if I was on vacation with my friends with plans to be out and about like we were this time.

title: Fab for the price!
text: Stayed here with my husband & daughter as we're seeing a concert at Finsbury Park. Interns of location from tube station and finsbury Park itself, it was tremendous. I agree with other reviewers that the rooms were small, we had 3 beds in ours so could just get around the beds but we couldn't fault the cleanliness. The bathroom was small but adequate & again spotless and as we were only stepping in there for 1 night it did the job. The breakfast was better than expected in my opinion. A choice of meats, cheese, cereal, fruit juice & a full English with toast & marmalade/jam. I asked for poached eggs on toast, no problem. The staff were friendly, efficient & attentive without being overbearing. A great balance. If we were coming to finsbury park again, I would absolutely look to book this hotel.

title: Excellent service , fantastic breakfast ,very clean hotel.good location .
text: We stayed at the queens hotel for 5nights . All staff is extremely friendly. The hotel is very , very clean everyday we had a fantastic breakfast with excellent service by girls from Poland, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Ukraine. At the reception Anna and Michal Was very helpful .!! Owners were very generous and nice! We definitely recommend this hotel .Queen Hotel 324 Seven Sister Road London UK ,and the price is right .

title: customer accused of arrogance
text: The location is fine, easily accessible to Finsbury Park station. The rooms are fine for the price, though small. The rooms on the road are externally noisy, constantly in spite of double glazing, and internally noisy because of the door closers on all doors and VERY thin walls - you can hear everything. Not suitable for light sleepers. My room had a faulty door handle (inside) on the bathroom, which did get fixed within 24 hrs of being reported. Then a fault developed on the internal door lock device - without which the room was not secure. I asked for help with this before going to sleep and then also asked for attention to the remote control or new batteries. The gentleman on duty rounded on me and said I was arrogant and uncivil and if I wanted 5 star service I should go somewhere else and pay 5 star prices. Customer service eh? But he couldn't fix the lock and subsequently agreed to a room change which proved satisfactory. Other staff on reception were very helpful.

title: Clean, Value for money
text: My wife and i stayed here last night and were pleasantly suprised. Although our double room was a tad on the small side it was very clean and the ensuite was compact, clean and nicely decorated. Breakfast was nice enough, full english with tea or coffee. You can also help yoursefl to juices and rolls, croissants. Only down sides were, the dining room could be bigger. There was not enough tables for the guests staying so there may be a small wait if your a bit late getting to the dining room. Other one was the doors are noisy when they close. From inside your own room other guests doors are pretty loud through the walls. On the whole though we would stay here again, it is literally 5 minutes walk to finsbury tube so you can be in the west end within 20 minutes. £63 for a double room in march wasnt bad, with the breakfast it made it worth the money.

title: Bargain London hotel !
text: We have just returned from a 2 night last minute stay at the queens hotel and overall the hotel was very very clean, modern and provided us with free parking upon booking with them over the phone ! The hotel is opposite finsbury park and less than a 5 minute walk from the nearest underground and railway station which was great for us as it was 15 mins to the centre of London by tube ! We stayed in 2 rooms during our stay as the hotel was quite busy but we didn't mind as we got a discount for doing this ! Our first room was number 8 it was a double room which was quite small and compact but very clean and comfortable ! It was next to the main hotel corridor so it was a bit noisy in the mornings but not to bad ! Our 2nd room was a triple room number 11 which was much larger than a double but still had a compact but clean bathroom ! In both rooms tea and coffee making facilities were available with biscuits as well as a flat screen tv ! This room was very very noisy please pack ear plugs ! Noise from the next rooms could be heard as well as constant walking around, slamming doors and floorboards above creaking ! I didn't have a good nights sleep at all in this room ! Maybe some courtesy signs about guests and noise wouldn't go amiss ! Also the double bed in room 11 needs changing ASAP it's poor quality and you can feel the springs as soon as you sit on it ! We didn't have this problem in room 8 though the mattress was fine ! Breakfast in the morning is good, great service from the ladies in there ! You can choose from continental or full English. Tea, coffee and juices available and toast with a selection of jams on arrival. You can't moan at the breakfast that is included in the price you pay to stay at this hotel ! The breakfast room is light airy and welcoming. Great hotel if your on a budget ! I would stay here again but I would pack earplugs as I am a light sleeper ! Fantastic cleaning standards and customer service just invest in new pillows and a mattress for room 11 !

title: overnight theatre stay
text: Four of us stayed for 1night in the hotel in a family room, the accommodation is basic but having said that it was very well kept and very clean, the beds were very clean and comfortable,the room and bathroom also very clean along with the towels. Breakfast good and staff very friendly. Only down side is the hotel doesn't have a lift which could be an issue for some. Would definitely stay here again for weekend. Tube station very close. Area not brilliant ,but we knew that from reading other reviews. Good budget hotel.

title: Good location
text: Hotel is in a good location. Very short walk to the tube, huge park across, lots of supermarkets and fast food nearby. The hotel itself is clean. With the usual tiny European hotel rooms. The complementary breakfast is satisfying and those serving are very efficient. I am giving an average review because I feel security is not so good. A companion's bag almost got stolen by a man in a suit pretending to be a guest during breakfast. When he saw me looking at him, he pretended to help pick it up (when it was hanging on the seat back and was not at all on the floor). This man hastily left minutes after without taking his breakfast.

title: Good experience for good money!
text: We spent our last week in this hotel and we can confirm that is a very good place to stay for one or more nights. The hotel is connected to the metro and the bus so is really easy reach the city centre. You can choose from continental or English breakfast and the staff meet all your needs. The room was small but very clean and the staff is really nice. We are happy to suggest this hotel!

title: Useless
text: 1 - Be aware that you have to be 25 to stay here!!! It says in the small print riiiiiight at the bottom of your confirmation email. Otherwise, they’ll ask you to spend an additional £50 (non-refundable) to “overlook” those who are under 25. (Baring in mind, there’s a jungle gym complex outside for children, however children aren’t allowed to stay here???? We were told “they don’t use the jungle gym to advertise for younger kids to stay”.) 2 - We booked through booking.com which doesn’t specify the age restrictions and the excuse we had on the phone was that it basically isn’t their problem. 3 - Additionally, there is no reception desk to contact if you have an issue. 4 - You have to send the security deposit before you go so that they will send you your code to enter your room. 5 - We stayed outside the room for an hour trying to sort this issue out. We were sent an email at 3:58am, which is the date we were coming, saying they wanted the £50 and another £350. To complete the brill experience, I am absolutely horrified about the way my family members were spoken to over the phone. A couple who was WILLING to pay the amount required, were also given attitude and told by the person on the phone, that she would talk to her manager and call back. This was after they’d waited an hour and a half. They were also told that they weren’t going to be given the code to their room because they were “rude” and the girl (who was speaking politely) couldn’t speak to the manager because he was “busy”. We got in eventually, but disgusted which has put a downer on our experience.

title: awful service
text: Keys to balcony door locks not provided, access to apartment open for public access (2 rooms) . Called on two occasions to complain and ask for keys and both times were told that were high up so “you’re safe”. On the first night we called we were told that keys should have been provided and that they would be provided in the morning as it was too late to find keys. On the second day we called we were told that the apartments aren’t advertised with balcony access so if we opened the doors we were in breach and that subsequently keys didn’t need to be provided for this reason. Again the point was made by a (rude) agent that “you’re on level 5” you’ll be safe. How can keys not be provided for external doors which would have access to the apartment. Utterly ridiculous and an awful stay!

title: Big mistake
text: I had stayed in Apple Apartments a couple of times and was always impressed by them. This however was not an Apple Apartment it was an Excel 02 apartment and it was rubbish. I feel completely conned. When I arrived at the apartment I tried to contact someone to cancel but I had stupidly booked through Tripadvisor who then put me through Agoda which meant that the people at Excel had a buffer to stop me taking any action. This meant I was stuck with the place for two nights. It is a mile from the Tube in any direction. If you get a cab the traffic in the area is usually backed up due to the Blackwall Tunnel. I had booked for 2 people but there was only 1 towel 1 set of bath products 1 wine glass etc. The bed was adequate at best but not really big enough. The TV had an indoor ariel which meant the reception was very poor. The freezer could not be closed as it had been left open and had iced up. There were crumbs on the kitchen worktop and most of the dishes were still in the dishwasher. The apartment is listed as "luxury" but it is merely functional. This is obviously a firm which is just out to make money and has no interest in providing a service. This was a big mistake which I will never make again.

title: Very nice 👌🏻
text: 2 friends and myself stayed here for one night on 20th July. Location is close to North Greenwich tube and bus station. We got a taxi from the tube after a long day of walking as it was listed as a 20 minute walk but with hindsight we could’ve travelled on the 188 bus route as it stops opposite the apartment entrance. We booked the 3 double bedroom apartment for £180. The apartment was perfect for our needs, to have a few beers and a place to chill. Check in procedure was easy, didn’t experience any of the negative customer service as has previously been mentioned on here. Yes the rules are quite strict and the outside of the apartment is monitored by CCTV but this is somebody’s property so rightly so. We paid a £250 bond (use a credit card and not a debit card like us as it takes a couple of days for the pre auth to be released) and it was clear that previous tennant’s had caused some minimal damage which is a shame. I have rated it as 4/5 as their inevitable fine could’ve been used to reinvest in the room and bring it back up to a perfect standard. Just a minor gripe though as everything about the apartment met our expectations. If we havd any future group trips to London we’ll be booking these apartments again

title: Not a bad place. Lack of Customer Service though.
text: We booked this apartment a couple of months ago as we where attending a concert at the O2 Arena about 10 mins away. The day prior to staying I was emailed instructions on how to enter the apartment. Very simple. However upon entry we discovered that the keys left on the table, one key was snapped. I rang up to report this incase they took the £250 deposit even though the snapped key was nothing to do with us. I rung up and customer service didnt really seem bothered on my report of the broken key. I checked my credit card statement a few days after and it was showing the £250 deposit was still pending. However this has all been cleared now. So keep an eye out on that. Other than that, the flat was clean, great location, roomy and the balcony was a great place to chill. Very reasonably priced considering the location within London aswell. Would probably stay here again if I needed to attend the O2 Arena.

title: Warm, Clean, Fresh - good for groups
text: A group of 5 of us recently stayed here on a visit to London. The cost per person averaged out at around £35 per night (which for London we thought was a very good price). The apartment was fresh, clean, modern and warm - we could not fault. If we are ever in London again (as a group) we would use this place.

title: Fab-u-lous accomodation
text: My wife and I booked one of the apartments because they were close to the O2 and for the excellent reviews. We were not disappointed. Check in was easy and we were then shown up to the apartment by one of the lovely staff. We had been upgraded to a two bedroom apartment overlooking the river. The apartment is new and was spotlessly clean. There were two bathrooms, one with a bath with shower over it and one with a shower cubicle. They were well kitted. The bedrooms had plenty of room and storage. The bed was comfortable. There was a sitting area with a small kitchen and dining area. All amenities were there such as microwave, cooker, fridge freezer, toaster etc. the apartment was very comfortable. It is well located within 5 minutes walk of Greenwich with restaurants shops and pubs, and the Cutty Sark. In Greenwich is the tube station and the river bus pier. The O2 was just 10 minutes by taxi

title: They cancelled less than 24 hours before check-in due...
text: We booked an apartment for 4 people as we were going to a concert at the O2. The day before we were due to travel I got an e-mail from them saying they were preparing for our arrival and asking for the names of all guests. Less than 4 hours later - which was less than 24 hours before we were due to check in - I got an e-mail from Booking.com saying we could no longer be accommodated because of 'maintenance work'. I phoned them to ask which e-mail was correct and they confirmed that within the space of a few hours, the accommodation had gone from 'being prepared' for us to arrive, to being totally unavailable and the nearest accommodation they could offer was at the other side of Greenwich, which would've added another 30 minutes onto our walk. Not even an apology. WE'D BOOKED THIS 7 MONTHS IN ADVANCE. Disgusting treatment.

title: We expected more after staying at Ealing
text: I was due to staying at The Ealing Apple Apartments from the Monday to Thursday, we have stayed there before. I was staying there on business. However, the Saturday before my arrival, I received an email from Apple informing me that they had been trying to contact me as they needed to cancel my booking at Ealing!! This is the booking that was made about 6 months in advance. They said the good news was that they could book me into a 2 bedroom luxury Apartment at Greenwich. It was no where near the venue that I was going to my conference on, but due to short notice I accepted it. This is my review of the place: SMELL - Despite the windows being open in both bedrooms, there was an awful smell from them, it smelt of Spices, such as Cardamons and Tumeric. I did not sleep very well the first night due to the smell, you can not have the window open as it is right on the high road and so noisy traffic. We had to buy some candles and leave them burning to try and eliminate the smell. During the day whilst out, the windows were left open. CUTLERY - There were no forks and just a few knifes and spoons (See photo). CROCKERY - We had 3 plates, no bowls or side plates (see photo). COOKING UTENSILS - These were non existent, well there was a pasta server! Two saucepans and a frying pan. We were actually self catering so it was a challenge with no wooden spoons, mixing bowls or cooking utensils. There is no Toaster and you cant use the microwave as there are no suitable dishes to put anything in., Dishwasher, you cant use this either as there is not enough crockery or glasses etc as you need to wash them each time as there are not enough (see pictures) TABLE IN KITCHEN AREA - This was small, round and glass, you could not use it though as it wobbles!! TAP IN KITCHEN - This leaked when it turned on, it leaked water out the side which meant you got wet operating it. LIGHT SWITCHES - Some of the knobs on the dimer switches were missing (see photos) TV - There was no guide on this, you can excuse this, but there was no back on the remote control and so the batteries kept fall out (see pictures) LUXURY TOILETRIES - These are advertised, but you dont get any, not even a bar of soap such that you would get in a Travel Lodge - in fact, you hardly get any toilet roll, we ran out and had to buy our own. CLEANLINESS - Th walls are scuffed in many places, the shower in the en-suite was disgusting at the plug hole, we had to pull the TV stand as the battery from the remote dropped out (due to battery falling out) and when we did we found some rubbish/bow (see photo). We could not use the drawers in the bedroom as they were filthy, there was hair and dirt behind the chest of draws and behind the bed in the main bedroom (See Photos) Its about the attention to detail, it could be a nice place as the furniture and quality of the fixtures and fittings were okay.

title: Outstanding!
text: Fantastic apartments, great sleeping arrangements and wonderful views to the Thames, night staff went above and beyond their duty to arrange parking for us. A short Walk to Greenwich University, Museums such as the Cutty Sark, the Maritime Museum, Greenwich meridian line and great restaurants!

title: Accommodation for concert at O2
text: Whilst these apartments are spacious inside with a balcony and quite well kitted out be aware that they are about a mile (20-25 mins) from the nearest tube station - North Greenwich at the O2. We had a couple of problems which were quicky sorted but were annoying as it wasn't cheap to stay - bins full of rubbish from previous person, dishwasher not unloaded. The shower tray obviously blocked as it filled up with water and drained very slowly. One advantage is that you can walk from the O2 however note that buses aren't that frequent (422 and 180). Traffic up Blackwall Lane was very bad getting to the O2 - we had to wait over half an hour for a bus to get there so leave plenty of time. The area seemed ok - high street just up the road with supermarkets and restaurants. Walkable to Greenwich and the Maritime museum.

title: Amazing Apple Apartments
text: We have just had a weekend at Apple Apartments and it was amazing. The location, facilities, quality and service could not have been better. The apartment 'made' our weekend. The views from our balcony were breathtaking. There was parking available at a very fair rate. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Waitrose on hand for all of your shopping needs and the centre of Greenwich with shops, pubs, restaurants, attractions, DLR, overland rail link into Central London a very short walk away. I would recommend these apartments without reservation.

title: Fantastic Value for Money & great place
text: I booked this apartment, for the convenience of going to a gig at the O2, and we were not disappointed. The place was easy enough to find, and very close to the amenities and attractions of Greenwich. The host was very friendly and accommodating, and also helped us with bus and taxi information for the O2 (in the end we walked to and from the gig, as it only took around 25 minutes), but the bus stop was right opposite the apartment. The accommodation itself was of a very high standard, and had all of the facilities of any modern home - microwave, dishwasher, washing machine, & fridge freezer. You also get free Wi-Fi. They also provide some basics such as tea, coffee, sugar & washing up liquid. The place was kept clean and well maintained. We booked a Standard Apartment at a cost of £90 for the whole place - but that gave us 2 double bedrooms, a large bathroom, then an open plan kitchen with dining room and living room. If you are considering staying in the area, then I would definitely recommend this accommodation. We will be back!

title: Top quality Apartmenst
text: We stayed here for 2 nights with my daughter and grandchildren we had a one bedroom aprtment with a bed settee which was fine for the two children.The apartment had all the amenities and an added bonus was the small playground for the children downstairs.It was ideal for transport facilities with a bus stop right outside which took you straight in to Greenwich where you could catch the Clippers to central London or the train. We got a bargain for 2 nights but I would certainly reccomend staying here at the normal price!

title: Great
text: Stayed here for my birthday. I stayed in the penthouse apartment. As it's a new build was quite hard to direct the taxi driver, as the street name does not work. However just get directions to the Waitrose in Greenwich and the apartments are right behind there! The apartment was really nice with a big balcony a view of the River Thames and the city (so pretty). Only downfall is I think it's quite far from central London, but if I was going to O2 I would book here definitely!

title: 'Children can't stay in these apartments without an adult'
text: Ok, so having travelled 3 hours on a train to arrive in these apartments, which the train wasn't cheap at all along with the apartment we finally arrived at 'Apple Apartments'. Having been in a rush to get to a festival which we missed majority off we got told we couldn't stay in these apartments as we needed an 'adult'. Ok so I'm a sales negotiator in the second largest city in the country... I sell apartments, I sell houses, I sell commercial business properties, I sell my mortgage brokers and solicitors. To be told I can not stay for one night in an apartment which I had already paid for. With booking.com sending all of my details to Apple apartments. Surely they could of possibly knew the whole party's ages, or at least confirmed this with us. After looking over the terms and conditions very closely after the arrival having already knew I had to put a £250 deposit down which surely shows I am capable to pay all costs if there was any damage to the apartment. The very last line under 'other information' it stated you have to be over 21. I understand my misunderstanding with not seeing this, but to be told we needed a responsible adult completely baffles me! I have my own bills that I pay and I'm probably a lot more responsible than many 21+ year olds. The attitude from the staff was completely unprofessional, with my background working in a major hotel in the middle of Birmingham I think the service delivered from your staff was completely embarrassing. Yes I got offered a refund and I took it. But that's not what I wanted because I've probably wasted more money not being able to turn up to a festival to then fork out on even more money to find another apartment which really was probably 10x better than Apple apartments with a view of London Bridge and the rest of London. I suppose that was one positive of our whole journey! But no. I definitely wouldn't recommend this apartment. Not because I never got the room but the disgraceful comments from staff, and the terrible service that was given. The staff did not even look presentable in near to their loungewear... With gigantic swirls of eye liner around one of their eyes. Being told I wasn't an adult coming from people who possibly looked and acted younger than myself and my peers I thought was completely embarrassing to your company itself, and having managed a business previously I would not stand for this and action would be taken drastically, as I wouldn't expect such degrading comments to people who were happy enough to choose the apartments anyway. Very unimpressed...

title: No Surprises, just want you want from a holiday let !
text: Apple Apartments near Greenwich is an easy going apartment block which is a mix of residential and rental apartments. Booking was easy enough and because we did the early bird we got 2 apartments for 6 people which compared favourably against even the cheapest of hotels (premier inn et al). Ok the room is a little out of town but if you are spending all day sightseeing then a short journey on the bus or tube is really no bother at all. Location for the 02 Arena though is excellent a short bus ride or about a 20 min walk and you are there. Communication was excellent email details, arrival instructions etc all very clear. On arrival we called the number and moments later an Apple Apartment rep appeared. He should us to our 2 rooms, explained entry exit rules, showed us round and explained how the Windows worked. We had 2 rooms for 6 adults, a 2 bed duplex, master ensure plus a family bathroom and then a toilet downstairs servicing an open plan lounge, diner and kitchen. This room was on the ground floor and benefitted from a small garden enabling us to open a large door to let in some welcome fresh air as it was a warm day. The second room was on the top floor (5th floor) which benefitted from a walkable balcony, not a balcony to sit on. But as the balcony was half of the building so providing great views of local London. This was particularly nice of an evenings when London was lit up. For those interested this was room 44 a 1 bed room and one I'd ask for if available. Both of the apartments were as advertised, they were clean and fresh. Couple of small things and this is not a full on criticism, it is true of many rental apartments all over the world yes you have a fully functioning kitchen but the utensils provided are "just" enough, it has pots and pans plates and cups but just enough, so be prepared do do some washing up, but it is the homely extras that are missing, no measuring jug, or tongs for cooking with, a microwave was provided but nothing to use to hook in microwave, Tupperware containers would have been useful. Often it is the small things that frustrate. I think you get the idea. All in all though these are great rooms, we ate out for all meals bar breakfast where we wanted to cook a full English to set us up for the day, which we accomplished, it just took a bit of thinking through to get the job done. In terms of planning a useful tip is to take advantage of a supermarket food delivery, we had a Tesco shop delivered just after we arrived so didn't have to bring food with us. There is a coop about a qtr of a mile up the road so food is available but who wants waste time shopping when you are on holiday ! We will definitely stay here again and by staying here we saw a part of London we had never seen before Greenwich, a nice little market located very close to the cutty sark. A nice way to start your day, note we caught a water taxi to central London from the cutty sark pier saving time on the bus/tube network.

title: Spot on
text: We arrived about an hour early but this wasn't a problem as the apartment was ready, got to say this place is excellent. Very clean and well presented in a modern setting. We were visiting the Excel centre which we walked down to the emirates cable cars which only cost £2 to cross. Would definitely use this again is staying anywhere near again.

title: Great Apartment!
text: Stayed at the apartments last month for a couple of nights. Really nice modern apartments, with great views and plenty of space. Everything was great, beds were so comfortable and shower was awesome! We didn't really use the kitchen but it was well equipped! Its just a 5min walk from the nearest tube stop - Cutty Sark - it took us about 30-40mins on the tube to get into central London eg. Marble Arch! There is also a bus stop close by, but we didn't use any buses. There is a lovely supermarket in the apartment complex also: Waitrose. On arrival it was hard to locate the apartments, there was only one sign at the entrance to the apartment complex, the rest you had to figure out for yourself! Some more signs and directions would of been very helpful - lucky there were construction workers around for us to ask!(Maybe providing guests with a small map on their confirmation sheet would be a good idea?!) Once you get to the apartment building the apple office is apartment 7 - I cant remember the name of the building, but it was on the far left of the complex behind the supermarket! Staff were helpful, and friendly and we were able to check in early - a big plus!! Loved our stay here, only wish we had more time to spend there and in the surrounding area of Greenwich. I Would recommend the apartments and would definitely stay there again!

title: Beautiful Place
text: I liked everything in this place. We stayed in the two bedroons apartment, beautifully decorated, spacious, clear and comfortable. There is a very good supermarket within the condo, and other options just a few minutes walk. The neighborhood is very pleasant, and the apartment is just some blocks away from restaurants, bars, pubs, drugstores, beautiful parks, the pedestrian tunnel under the Thames, museums and a subway station. The reception was warm, and the charming, wonderful Maria made whatever was possible to make our stay even better. I don't only aprove it, I highly recommend Apple Greenwich Apartments for those who don't want to be in the middle of the tourists mob and prefer, like us, a quiet and pleasant place to feel what is like to be in "real" London.

title: excellent
text: Booked with Apple again as we had a fantastic stay at the Greenwich Village appartments. Booked this one to be closer to the O2, we wasn't disappointed. Excellent facilities, clean and modern. Smooth arrival and completion of paperwork. Fantastic location, you can walk to Greenwich or the O2 area but the apartment has a great bus service right outside the door. Would highly recommended staying there.

title: Turned away with nowhere to go!!!
text: Upon arrival, we could not get in as no one was there to greet us or open the door which had a code, and were made to wait 25 minutes outside with bags. I had called emergency number who told me the incorrect code, and informed me he would be with us in 5 minutes but still waiting on him arriving! We were told that we would have to pay an extra £250 on top of the £140 we had already paid, which was not included in the small print etc to which the 'hostess' agreed, it was not provided in the small print. Unwillingly, we agreed to pay after questioning said hostess and her 'boss' on the phone while they continued to speak to each other in Spanish etc, leaving us in the dark about what was going on. We were argumentative in agreeing to pay this as it was not agreed before booking. We then went on to attempt to pay the £250 deposit on two different occasions on two different cards which had surprisingly 'declined' both of them yet both having more than enough money in each account to accommodate the price required. We then suggested transferring the money into the booking persons account to have it taken out that way, but was declined by the hostess. After all the stress, we were then told that we would not be allowed to stay there as we had alcohol with us, and were told we were not permitted to drink on the premises. So, 4 people, traveled from Scotland with nowhere to go, and out of pocket thanks to the complete incompetence of their staff and booking system, which resulted in more expense being paid due to having to find somewhere else to stay at such short notice, which then also resulted in us being late to an event we had arranged to go to. We were told we would be fully refunded, with nothing to be seen as of yet. Would happily recommend nobody says here if you're under the age of 30 as they clearly don't allow people to have a good time. Such a shame as were looking forward to this weekend and this had completely ruined it for us.

title: Really lovely apartment
text: We stayed at the Apple apartments because they were convenient for the O2. We were not disappointed. Clean, warm and comfortable with a well fitted kitchen and a balcony. It was great value too with a good deal for a Sunday night. I don't think we could have done better. The only quibble I have is that 4 of us stayed but only 3 mugs, 3 knives, 2 complimentary bottles of water, 3 apples etc.

title: Excellent location for a visit to London
text: We booked 2 nights for my 40th birthday party with the familiy. The kids were excited about the view of London. The appartement was spacious. The service was excellent. A Waitrose around the corner instead of a bar/restaurant.

title: Fabulous apartments
text: We stayed here as we we were going to the ATP finals at the O2. This was the Blackwall street apartments. It was only a 20 min walk from the venue and lots of bars, restaurants and shops close by. The apartments themselves were amazing. So clean, fresh and had were of a great standard. We will defo be returning!

title: Great location, great price.
text: I booked this apartment for my son and his wife when they went to the O2 arena to see U2. I was a bit unsure as I have never booked an apartment for 1 night before in London but as I could not get a hotel room anywhere near the O2 for a decent price I decided to look at these apartments as an option. It was easy to book via booking.com. Communication and information was great from booking through to arrival. My son was extremely pleased with the location and cleanliness of the apartment. It had a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and lounge area, all quite spacious (sorry but for some reason I am unable to upload the photo of the lovely lounge area.) He was also pretty impressed with the view. He said the staff were friendly, helpful and checking in was pretty straightforward except that as I had paid for the apartment as a gift, he had to produce photographic evidence of me which he had not taken with him. This was soon remedied as he rang me, I then took a photo of my driving licence to send to the staff. It could have been a bit of a pain though if he couldn't get hold of me. To be fair, I think I recall that I should have given him the evidence so it was my fault. He also needed my debit card as I had paid for the apartment, I had remembered to give him this. So if you are paying as a gift for someone else then remember to give these 2 items to your friend/relative before they go. All in all these apartments are a great alternative if you are visiting this area of London and are not bothered about having your meals cooked for you. There are ample shops and cafes around to go and purchase whatever you need. He also said he used the Uber car/taxi service which was brilliant if you don't want to walk around late at night.

title: Nice apartment and convenient location
text: I stayed in these apartments for one night for a concert at the O2. They are clean and tidy and suitably furnished with everything you need. Very convenient for the O2 (20 mins walk or 5 min taxi). Much better value for money than hotels in the local area! Only downside was the checking in and out process (we didn't see anyone there for the whole stay!)

title: Excellent - look for Admirals Tower
text: Couldn't fault a 2 night stay - competitive with local hotels for much better facilities & siting. Others refer to lack of signage & info on website which does make it difficult to find, so may be helpful to know their reception is Room 8 in Admiral's Tower.right at the end of Dowells Street. Car access from Norway Street and entrance to Waitrose car park. But once you're in there's everything you need, all in good order & clean as a whistle.

title: O2 Wear The Rose Concert Stay!
text: Myself and some friends went to London to go to the O2 and these apartments were cheaper than staying in any of the hotels for 2 rooms. Not knowing what to expect when we got there we were utterly amazed at how fabulous it was! The place was spotless with beautiful modern furniture and appliances, was literally perfect and so much more than we were anticipating! The beds were so comfortable, better than mine at home! Within walking distance of the O2 it was ideal. The only draw back for some may be parking as there is very little in the area, we were fortunate enough to grab a space on the road by the nearby school as it was kicking out time when we arrived but would advise researching other parking arrangements in the area in case that was full. Would definitely recommend and we will be using from now on for all our London road trips!

title: Great river view
text: One word Fantastic. .....lovely apartment. .....nice furnishing.......very clean.......good value for money.......good location close to Waite rose supermarket. ......very helpful staff. Ideal for underground station and river tours, museum's restaurants local market, shops coffee bars.

title: brilliant
text: Stayed at these apartments for the first time this week and will definitely go back , clean comfortable and convenient . We were visiting the Maritime Museum and Cutty Sark so it couldn't have been better , also we like to travel on the river when we are in London so happy to stay out in Greenwich.

title: Mrs
text: 2 night stay in a 2 bedroom apartment in Greenwich . Was clean spacious and well located for shops attractions , restaurants and transport. Free wi fi a bit intermittent . Would recommend for business or pleasure. A few more glasses and cafetiere would have been welcomed.

title: GREAT LOCATION AND IMPRESSIVE QUALITY
text: Just a few minutes from the centre of historic Greenwich, with nice views over the Thames and Deptford Creek, this proved to be an excellent choice for a weekend stay. All very modern, clean and comfortable, with good security and a thorough, helpful welcome from the rep, Eva. Top tips: don't forget your photo ID! Only two sets of towels included in the basic proce, with extras at £5 pp - so take your own if you want to save on costs. Undergorund parking is £15 per day, but worth it for peace of mind and convenience. Highly recommended - you could easily pay almost as much for a very average hotel room.

title: fabulous apartment
text: We stayed here for 3 nights, the apartments are not far from cutty sark tube station, we chose this location because we were going to the o2, we normally stay up west when staying in London, I would definitely stay here again, the apartment was very spacious and clean with all you need for self catering accommodation.

title: Could be fabulous
text: This place could be fabulous if only..... it was clean! A bit unfair perhaps as the apartment we stayed in was mostly clean. However, the admittedly fab balcony was filthy, covered in cigarette ash. The laminate floor was clean in the parts you could see but under the furniture was a different story, a mix of food crumbs and hair and fluff. the WiFi worked! It didn't when we were there. we had somewhere to sit! We had a six bed apartment with only a small dining table and only four dining chairs. the kids could sleep! I had to pull the circuit breaker on the ventilation system as the kids couldn't sleep though the noise it made. the kitchen was properly equipped! Ok. We were only there for three nights but basic items (dish cloth, cleaning materials, bin bags, colander, serving spoons etc.) wwould have been useful. The crockery didn't match, non of it! The tumblers needed washing before we could use them as the kids complained that they smelled of beer - they did! Having said the above we did have a really great time. We were in London for the Marathon so the location was spot on, couldn't have been better. Close to Greewich and associated transport links so a good base from which to visit most of London. Waitrose store next door for essential supplies. The views from the balcony - once it was cleaned - were absolutely spectacular. The staff were friendly and the check in, whilst quirky, was pretty efficient. Special mention to Alex the Concierge who is a star - Thanks Alex! Parking was very convenient and good value and seemed secure. Apartment was spacious, modern, warm, furniture was comfortable if a little mismatched. All in all pretty good but not for you if you are expecting very high standards. I suppose that you get what you pay for! Could be fabulous with just a little more attention to the detail.

title: Nice apartment but service lacking
text: I stayed in a two-bedroom apartment which was nicely decorated and had everything in it that you could need. The reason I rate my stay as 'poor' is for the following: 1. The email you receive before arrival is very brusk and verging on rude. I understand they may have had trouble-makers staying in the past, but it would still be nice to feel welcome. The email also insists that all guests have their ID so it can be checked when you arrive but only one ended up being looked at, which seemed odd. 2. We booked a river-view room but only looked out a little offshoot of the Thames, certainly not the main river like other reviewers have had. This was very disappointing and we were basically looking at some brown sludge and then the main road into Greenwich. 3. The lady that met us to check us in was very pleasant but there was some confusion with the booking in their system. She thought we were staying for 1 night when I had confirmation that it was for 2 nights. This was sorted but didn't leave us feeling very confident about their organisational abilities. 4. No information was given to us about check out and none was in the info book in the apartment. We therefore had to email to find this out. It would be helpful if this was outlined clearly. 5. Check out involved you just leaving the key in the apartment so you can't lock the door. This doesn't feel very secure and if anything had gone missing or got broken, I'm sure we'd have had to foot the bill. 6. When finding out about the check-out details, we confirmed we'd leave at 11am. Despite this we received a knock at the door at about 10:40 from a cleaner who was ready and waiting with all their cleaning products. 7. Originally we had only going to be a party of 2 but we then changed this to a party if 3. Despite this being confirmed, there were still only 2 bath towels.

title: Definitley worth considering for a stay in London
text: Stayed for a couple of nights during the Easter school holidays and very impressed. Hadn't expected a balcony or separate bathroom as I thought that was only for the higher priced rooms but pleasantly surprised. Lovely views of the river, especially at night. A little trouble finding the right building but if you head for Admirals Tower North and go to flat 8 you will find the office to check in. Have already recommended to friends.

title: London weekend
text: NIGEL H We went to london to see a show, found this place on booking .com Great View , Very Clean apartment, close to the DLR and Canary Wharf Stations, five minutes walk from the Cutty Sark and the Museums, the market is excellent, what can I say Fabulous!

title: Fantastic weekend away with friends
text: A group of 6 of us rented a penthouse apartment for the weekend. The views along the Thames from the balcony were simple stunning. The apartment was spotless and well maintained, the decor modern and comfortable. It was kitted out with all the amenities you could want, TV, WIFi, etc. The beds were very comfortable and the bathrooms stocked with toiletries etc.There is a Waitrose 2 mins walk away which was very useful to stock the well supplied kitchen. Greenwich itself has lots of restaurants and bars and the Cutty Sark was just a 5 minute level walk away. One of our party has limited mobility but because of the location of the apartments there was easy access to the DLR stations and on into Central London .

title: Loved it!
text: I'm local to Greenwich and this is in a great spot, 5 mins walk to the river, Cutty Sark and Greenwich town. Clean and modern, attentive staff and well equipped kitchen. Spotless and lovely bathroom. Water in the fridge on arrival as well as starter sachets of hot choc, tea and coffee plus washing up liquid. It would be helpful to have salt and pepper and maybe sugar as I begrudge buying large containers for a 3 night stay. Plenty of pots and pans, cutlery and dining ware. View on to courtyard was fine, no building noise when we stayed but builders where in the courtyard. All good. Beaming sun through the large windows and the balcony was a nice addition. Smooth closing fixtures in the apartment so no banging around from other rooms. Comfortable bed and lounge. Sooo much better than a hotel room. Loved it and I want to return!

title: Sublime
text: Spacious, incredibly furbished and boasting phenomenal views( The picturesque Canary Wharf, central London and the O2 Centre) I truly cannot contemplate a more heavenly haven . Ideal for travellers interested in live music, entertainment and sport and beautifully situated.

title: good. Don't think would stay again.
text: Stayed here for one night on Tuesday. The apartment itself was nice and clean which is good and the bottle of wine we got free was good touch. The parking is a nightmare you have to faff about with a key fob and going back and forth, i think it took us around 45 minutes to get sorted with the car, you have to go collect your key then go park the car. We was also advised to leave the key on the table in apartment which strikes me as odd as this means we could not lock the door on our exit? it also meant we had to go get the car get out of car park then go back upstairs just to leave the key. We also had to find alternative parking the second day as they don't allow extra time. The receptionist did offer to let us stay a bit longer but as we was going to be all day in the city we wasn't able to do this. Also the lady who checked us in was adamant we didn't have the correct credit card with us despite it being clear it was one digit out and perhaps them who wrote it down wrong (turns out we was right) The apartment itself was great and no problems, however I don't think we would stay here again as there needs to be some sort of organisation skills put into order and for the money you pay you would think it would be a bit better.

title: Got the "wow" when we walked through the door
text: A excellent apartment right on the river. Our apartment was clean and well furbished. The view across the river to Canary Wharf offered a fabulous backdrop. At night the area was quiet so sleeping was easy. All members of the family fully approved. Access to the city was easy by river bus. We will stay again.

title: Excellent - great apartment, very good location
text: These apartments are in great location. Short walk to centre of Greenwich & DLR. Waitrose virtually next door, so not far to carry shopping. Very good standard with well equipped kitchen. Great views of the city & river. Friendly, helpful, staff. Would definitely recommend & would stay again.

title: Beautiful 😁
text: Another visit to the apple apartments, and again a beautiful apartment, very clean and well equipiped. Check In has changed from previous visit a little mixed up but resolved quickly.. We booked for a party of 3 this time so had a very much smaller apartment so was a little dissapointed with the size and unfortunately a little disappointed with no view at all. Also no DVD player but could call reception to ask for one, we were only there for 2 nights so didn't bother. Also we had to make up a bed in the lounge which was a bit of A hassle :( The apartments have a fully and beautifully equipped kitchen (nicer than my own) very happy :) I will book again but will ensure we get the river view apartment which was amazing and also my daughter smokes and had to keep going downstairs which was not very nice... All in all had a very relaxed and Beautiful time spent with my 2 Daughters... Roll on the nta awards and another visit to the lovely Apple apartments 😄

title: Penthouse perfection!
text: The penthouse was spacious and we were a family of 4. Plenty of space with a wrap around terrace. Only issue was check in they are not there 24/7 ensure you have the phone number to call when you are 10-20 minutes away. No early check ins accommodated. There is a waitrose a few steps away and that was extremely convenient. Cleaning is only every few days unless you pay extra. Very modern apartment and I would stay there again in a heartbeat!

title: Conveniently located with a good view of the London skyline
text: First the bad things about the place: Though conveniently located 5 minutes from the Cutty Sark DLR station, this place took me a while to find because there are no signs that bear the name of the apartments anywhere! Calling the reception up does not help either because they were less than polite with their direction-giving! But the apartments themselves were clean, spacious and offered a brilliant night view of the London skyline across the Thames. Also if you are on a trip to show someone the city with a limited bugdet, this place is very conveniently located and reaching central London does not take too long either by ferry or the DLR. There is construction work going on currently and the noise can get annoying especially if you are a morning person. But overall a good comfortable place to stay for a short trip!

title: Luxury and location
