text: Spent one night in fabulous modern apartment in outstanding location right on the riverside at Greenwich. Not only are the facilities great but the office management and staff, Maria and Bearnice could not have been more friendly and helpful. My wife and I are looking forward to our return visit for 5 nights later this week.

title: A perfect place for a weekend break
text: We took our daughter and friends for the weekend in London, this was the perfect base. The apartment was clean and modern, all you could need was supplied, and there is a waitrose downstairs! so everything was very simple for us to do. 5 mins walk from the cutty sark, tube and the Thames clippers for easy transport into the city peaceful and great views. service was efficient and helpful. I would recommend staying here for a perfect London visit

title: Hidden ( really hidden) gem
text: We are a family of 4 adults and stayed in a 1 bedroom apartment in December. The hardest thing about this place is finding it, directions on the website are terrible. I suggest once you get of the metro, ask where the Waitrose supermarket is & go there, the apartment blocks (there are many off them in the complex) are right behind. Ring the contact number on your booking advice and a young lady will come down and meet you in front of the complex, behind Waitrose. If you arrive late or like us don't have a mobile phone, there is a complex management office just next to Waitrose supermarket ( they are not associated with Apple), but ask nicely and they will make the phone call for you. If you need a taxi for an early departure also ask them to book for you, because no one can find this place. As per other reviewers, don't expect too much service once in the apartment, contact is by email and requests are sometimes filled promptly and sometimes not. One tip, make sure you get plenty of toilet paper from them. The apartment itself is great, a little tight for 4 , but OK. Very clean and modern, with cooking facilities and utensils. You probably won't get a view of the Thames, but that's OK. The price was good compared to hotels and the location & travel time into London was surprisingly quicker than we expected (15 minutes) & quite frankly it does not matter where you stay in London it will take you 15 minutes to get to your destination. Buy yourself a metro day pass for 8 pound & go where ever you like. So long as you are well prepared and don't get too concerned about the customer service you will love this place. By the way don't rely on google directions to find thus place, it too has trouble, just ask someone in a shop near the metro station for directions to the Waitrose supermarket, don't worry you will find the apartment.

title: Good place to visit London
text: We had an apartment with a great view on the Thames and the city. The (free) wifi was not that good, but the apartment was spacious and clean. The kitchen was quite complete. Greenwich itself is quiet and already has some interesting venues to visit (our kids loved the Cuty Sark), but you can also visit London via the subway or even better via the Boat bus nearby. It only takes a half hour to get to Piccadilly Circus.

title: Great value for a group of friends
text: Just spent a weekend in lovely Greenwich to attend a friends Birthday party.As there was 5 of us we booked a 2 bedroom apartment

title: Property lovely, service average
text: We (retired couple) have stayed here a few times, taking advantage of various special offers which make price very competitive with local budget hotels - but here you get lovely apartment, always (we've found) in good condition. The service is 'odd' as it's based in another apartment, so you phone & staff meet you to see you into your apartment. I think the 'deal' is that they've an interest in various apartments in at least 2 blocks in the area. Their arrival information is not always clear - others have commented on parking - the best is to use the Waitrose park, free for 2 hrs for a £5 spend - until you've checked in. And the changing local roadworks also make it difficult to find your way in. They need to send an up to date access map. Excellent location for seeing all that Greenwich has to offer (a lot) and for access to City, with West End access best by 'clipper' which ride gives excellent chance to see London from the river rather than from the inside of a train.

title: wonderful apartment
text: the apartment was spacious and comfortable. The wi-fi wasn't really accessible for the iPad and iPhone, though. The apartment situates in a really convenient place with Waitrose supermarket and the train station nearby. Good views outside as it overlooks the Thames. It is of walking distance to the pier, where we could walk there to take a boat to the city. Lots of shops around where we could shop to our hearts' delight. Overall a great experience.

title: Pay for the view
text: The difference between double room and luxurious penthouse apartment is the view and the price. We had waited more than 30min to check in. Very difficult to find the parking space. The staff lied to as that they was busy on the phone when dere was clearly no one on the phones. Overall I will visit again but never book more than simple apartment coz there is no difference in luxurious just in price

title: Terrible customer service
text: To whom it may concern, We had an apartment booked in your Greenwich apartments for the weekend of 22/11/2014. Having driven up from Bath, when we got into London at 12pm, we rang your Greenwich office to confirm where we could park. The lady on the phone said she didn't know and she would have to ring us back. Ten minutes later, we received a phone from a gentleman called Jamone saying you had no details of our booking. As you can imagine, we weren't impressed with this as we had booked a show in the west end to see that night and booked Winter Wonderland in Hyde Park on the Sunday. We made the booking through booking.com and had the confirmation email. Jamone then said that it your company to blame, and would do all he could to get us an apartment, and he would give us a call. We then waited around London until 2pm to receive the phone call, but it never came. We decided to wait a bit longer, so 3pm came and still no phone call. At this point, we were disgraced at the customer service on your end. I decided then to give your office another phone call to see if we had an apartment or not to which Jamone answered the phone, and response was 'We have found you an apartment, sorry I forgot to ring you back'. As you can imagine, our first impressions of your company aren't great at this point. Thinking everything was sorted, we made our way to the apartments. We tried to ring through for someone to meet us with a key, but it kept going to voicemail, to which we left 5 voicemails with no reply. We tried other options on the automated service to which everyone's response was 'you need to ring the Greenwich office'. Myself, my partner, who's name the apartment was booked under, his mother, who had just recently come out of hospital, and our 6 year old niece, was stood on the road outside the apartments, in the pouring rain for over an hour trying to get through to someone. We missed our show, to which we paid over £200 for tickets, which was our niece's birthday present. We were finally greeted by a lady who was very apologetic but that didn't make our for the ordeal it had been so far. We couldn't fault the apartment, it's just a shame the whole weekend was ruined by your company's poor customer service and lack on communication skills. I don't usually write complaint emails, but this sort of service has put me of using your services again. .

title: Lovely Stay, Ideal for the O2
text: These apartments are situated ideally if you are visiting the O2, you can get the 188 bus from the top of the road directly to the O2. We took the boat from the London eye to Greenwich and walked to the apartments, which was a 5 minute was which was convenient. The apartments themselves are lovely and modern, we booked a 'deluxe' apartment and had 2 bedrooms, 1 with en suite and another larger bathroom. Balcony overlooked the river which was also a nice touch. On check in the apartments like to take a photo copy of the card which you paid with and identification. Following booking we called the apartments to confirm our booking as we has booked through agoda, which was confirmed. On arrival, it was explained to us that as we booked through agoda who take the payment from your card and then pay apple apartments through there own means, we would need to pay a £250 deposit which was be refunded to us on checkout. We did not have this amount on the cards we had taken with us. This was quickly resolved and we did not have to pay this deposit and there was no further problems. Therefore it may be better to book directly rather than through an agent. This was a problem apple apartments obviously have ongoing. Overall a very lovely place to stay, convenient for a number of activities in Greenwich along with easy access to central London. Will be returning but booking directly!

title: Great aparments with bad service
text: The aparments was very modern and stylish, situated by the Thames in a calm area of Greenwich. 10min walk to the underground and the ferry. They call it serviced apartments but it is not. If you want cleaning or new towels you have to pay extra. We had an apartment for 4 persons but the kitchen was not equipped for 4. There is no reception so if you want to talk to any staff you have to call on a mobile, and the same when you check in. The only time we saw any staff was to get the keys and when they knocked on the door to remind us about checking out time! Apart from that the aparment was really nice with great view but they would definetely benefit from beeing more service minded.

title: Great alternative to overpriced hotels
text: The Apple apartments are exactly right if you want an unpretentious and straightforward home from home - at the highest level. Two double bedrooms - ideal for family or business outing to the city with friendly and simple arrangement. 10 min walk to DLR or main line trains.

title: Apple Apartments Greenwich
text: Beautiful Apartments next to the river in greenwich, quiet immaculately presented with every mod con. If on business or pleasure a great place to stay easy into Central London with Greenwich on you doorstep I will choos this always outstanding

title: WOW! what a beautiful view
text: Just returned from a one night stay at the apple apartments in Greenwich, London with my husband, 18yr old daughter and 12 yr old son. Booked it for my daughter's 18th birthday so wanted something special. Was not disappointed. The apartment was very modern, clean and spacious. Had everything we needed and more with dishwasher, washing machine and full kitchen. We were on 11th floor and the view form our balcony across the Thames was spectacular. The apartment was very spacious and light with huge windows to enable you to see the amazing views. Would thoroughly recommend them and would have loved to stay longer. Thank you.

title: Great location for easy access to London
text: We stayed in the luxury penthouse apartment, which to be warned, is on the second floor and not the top floor. This did not detract from the view over the river which was just fabulous. The apartment staff were very helpful and friendly, however, a frosty reception from the young lady who works on the reception desk for the actual apartment block, not nice. The apartment lived up to its billing, and we loved it. Travel to and from London is very easy on DLR and a 20 minute ride away to the city, with the apartments a 5 minutes walk away from the station, just ask for or head towards Waitrose, which is in the complex. Will deffinately return for another weekend trip.

title: modern design perfect location
text: Very spacious apartments overlooking the Thames. Stunning view, clean and new, we had 2 bathrooms, big balcony, washing machine, microwave and a dish washer. Friendly staff. Everything was fantastic. Greenwich is a very interesting area with lots of museums, shops and restaurants. Don't forget to visit Greenwich market! There are so many talented artists salling their art and unique crafts.

title: Great for family
text: Need ed accomodation for 6 of us and trying to get the right hotel room combination and availabbility was not easy and then found the 3 bed Apple Apartment. Looked too good to be true but it was good. Ok allow around 1 hour to London Centre but very pleasant experience on DLR and very close to Station. As with others slightly weary of reception procedure (like meeting you outside in your car) but it worked and all went well. Staff very helpfull and aprtment very spacious and as described. Was apartment 36 on second floor of Beacon Point with great views over Thames. We arrived at 1000 at night and left by 1000 next morning but everything we needed was these including tea, coffee and milk. Waitrose about 3 min walk. Beds very comfortable and apartment clean (outside of windows could do with a clean). Doors in master bed and loung/dinner open onto balcony (little technique with handle to do so which staff will show, so do ask before they go). Parking excellent in undergound car park.

title: Strongly Recommend
text: I was staying here by myself for one night on business. I booked a one-bedroom apartment which was even better than what I was expecting. Very clean and well decorated throughout. Staff also pleasant. There's also a Waitrose a minutes walk away and numerous restaurants 5 mins walk away. The sacrifice of being slightly outside of central London is definitely worth it, better value and better quality rooms. Would more than happily stay here again.

title: ideal for London visit
text: Have stayed in London a few times but in hotels. This time we thought we would try an apartment. Travelling from north of Oxford, all links are really easy to Greenwich. We found the same issue as a lot of reviewers have, that is the exact location of the reception. Head for the big silver building at the end of the development. The woman on reception at Apple Apartments explained that the postcode has not been sorted as yet explaining why directions will send you to Greenwich Park. I did Google beforehand so knew where we should be. Arrived early and would have used the baggage storage as we had things to do but fortunately the apartment was ready for us. Cleaners had just finished. Clean and spacious one bedroom apartment. Very spacious! Easy walk to Curry Sark DLR. We ate out most of the time but there is full kitchen facilities. A Waitrose store is within the development and holds a reasonable amount of gluten free products. Plenty of pubs and restaurants locally too. Will be using again when we want to stay for a few nights stay in town.

title: Great City Trip
text: The Apple Apartments Greenwich are a fantastic place for a London getaway. The apartments are on Dowells Street behind the new Waitrose, it took us a moment to find them as there are new buildings going up in that area so some parts of the streets are closed off. The apartments are all new, the guy on reception buzzes the office and someone comes down to organise check in. We stayed in the building opposite to reception on the third floor. This building has a mixture of residents and visitors renting apartments. The apartment was finished to a high standard, extremely clean, spacious and comfortable with everything from television, hair dryer, iron, washer/dryer, dishwasher, fridge, tea, coffee, sugar, salt, pepper, water etc to be honest it felt like being at home. There is a Waitrose on the other side of the building which is open most nights until 10. The DLR train is a 4 minute walk away in the centre of Greenwich. Car parking is underground in a secured area of the Waitrose car park at £15 per day this is organised at the Management Office, there are a few short term parking spaces in front of the check-in building to leave the car in when checking in. We would definitely go back.

title: Excellent
text: Absolutely perfect for a family. We had an apartment with 3 bedrooms and a view to the river. Rooms were clean and very well equipped - it was like a second home. We wanted to stay longer... There's a well stocked supermarket in the next building so we used the kitchen for all breakfasts and dinners. We definitely will stay there again when we go to London next time. I have one message to the management, though

title: Apartment over Hotel
text: When our family of four recently visited London, we decided to look for an apartment. The main reason was that most of the well-located hotels in our price range had small rooms and would not allow more than two persons in each room. We also thought that me could experience the city better. Positives: The building was almost new. The units were bright and spacious and were available in two bedroom/two bathroom configurations. The outward-facing walls of the master bedroom and living rooms were all glass. Our unit had great views of the Thames River and the London skyline. There was a balcony off of the living area. A receptionist was on duty during the day and a key was required for after-hours entry. The management company has an office on the first floor (floor zero) that is staffed around the clock. Our unit featured a unique under the sink clothes washer and dryer in one. (I would suggest asking for a demo, since the guest manual is very inadequate and that machine has more buttons and dials than a Mercury space capsule.) A large grocery store is located adjacent to the apartment property. It is a short walk to Greenwich where there is a good variety of shops and eating establishments. Living among the locals for a week was a privilege! Negatives: There will be at least an hour's taxi ride from Heathrow Airport. If you are traveling during rush hours, it can be much more. (Get a flat-rate taxi to avoid unpleasant surprises.) There is no air conditioning in the rooms, but this seems to be typical and we were comfortable during our stay. The windows and both doors are a bit tricky and different than anything that I have ever seen. (Get a demo.) The public transportation is easily accessed from the apartments, but figuring it out is not so easy. We preferred the water taxis because they were took us to most places that we needed to go. The busses, subways and trains are more difficult. Also, they can be crowded. Be prepared for lots of walking and standing in line. All things considered, we were very happy with our apartment experience, but before we return, i am going to see if there is a "London Transit for Dummies" book available!

title: Good value for money
text: I was very impressed by this place everything you need for self catering and lovely views over the Thames. Further than I thought from Central London but not far from the O2. It's not the easiest place to find but all you have to do is ask. It's right behind waitrose. Wifi never worked for my whole stay even though I asked to get it fixed on the first night. Not a really big problem for me and everything else made up for it including the price. Just thought I'd mention it. Overall 8 out of 10

title: Luxury Riverside Apartment
text: Just stayed at Apple Apartments Greenwich again and it was as good as ever. Check in was very friendly and professional. Another balcony riverside apartment with fabulous views over to Canary Wharf and all the facilities including the all-important free Wi-Fi you could possible want. The beds are exceptionally comfortable and everyone got a great sleep. The croissants from Waitrose next door make an excellent quick breakfast along with the free tea and coffee in the kitchen on arrival. The underground car park is great - especially as it rained really heavy one afternoon. Saved us getting soaked! Will definitely be back when in the area. Well done everyone!

title: "short stay for O2 visit"
text: Ideal if you are going to the O2 for a concert as the bus stop is just around the corner and there is a very regular bus service to North Greenwich - Tube station is just around the corner if you prefer to travel this way? . Although other reviews have stated difficult to find we did find the place straight away,using the two addresses the apartments give you when you book,also take note of emergency number they provide. We only booked a one bed apartment for the night but found the facilities very good and with Waitrose right next door this was ideal for our short stay! Linen was all nice and clean and additional bedding was provided to make up sofa bed. Thought for the price we paid for a family of 4 staying in Central London good value for money and would definitely consider going back for a further stay. Couldn't get the wi-fi to work which wasn't a problem for us but could cause problems if business traveller.

title: Inability to resolve problems
text: We’d booked Apple Apartments Greenwich understanding that this is not a full-service hotel. However what we did not expect was that ‘Apple Apartments’ apparently does not own the apartments, but is a ‘middle man’ who acts on behalf of the actual owners of the various apartments to ‘lease’ the apartments out to us the customers! This is according to the manager, and we only found this out during our stay when we had to bring up several issues. The apartment we stayed in was in a separate block from the reception, and there is no phone line to reception. This resulted in many trips taking the lift and walking to reception in another block whenever we had queries or problems with the apartment. Unfortunately we did have problems: 1) We had booked for 3 persons, but there was no extra bed in the apartment and only 2 sets of towels. I had to walk back to reception to get the 3rd set of towels and to find out that the 3rd person was to sleep on the sofa which pulled out into a bed (no demo given, left to figure this out myself). Sofa bed is too big for the space when pulled out, so I just slept on the sofa as is. 2) Only one set of keys and security fob per apartment – when I had to separate from the rest of my family to run errands, I was supposed to buzz the apartment intercom for them to let me in. Reception apparently does not have a ‘master’ key/fob (how does housekeeping get in then?) And to top things off, our intercom was not working! 3) Intercom was spoilt, repairman did not turn up at the scheduled time. 4) Electric kettle short-circuited the apartment! Reception was unable to provide a working replacement kettle. 5) Fan was obviously dirty, when I showed it to Beatriz at reception she asked where is the dirt??? 6) No toilet roll holder, told by Beatriz that the apartment ‘is like that’?! 7) No safe in the apartment. 8) Wifi worked better than I’d expected from previous reviews, but still occasionally spotty. Had to sit in entranceway to get consistent reception. 9) Awoken by construction noise at 8am one morning, wasn’t warned by reception, but by then we were too tired to complain and were going to check out anyway. When things are going smoothly, the staff do smile at you. I had a reasonably nice experience with Maria. However when things start going wrong, the unfortunate response of the staff was to explain to us why problems could NOT be fixed, rather than provide solutions. Hence I got the explanation of Apple Apartments as a sort of middle man, who has to go through the owner/landlord before problems could be fixed. I was really taken aback by this as I had not seen this information on their website or other booking sites. Worst of all, there were no apologies given for the shortcomings and inconveniences. In fact some of my concerns were denied by Beatriz whose response was usually to the line of ‘no this is not a problem’ and ‘the apartment comes like that’. We were expected to accept the situation or have to look for another place to stay at short notice. Please note that Apple Apartments would have charged your credit card hours before you’re due to check-in at 2pm, leaving you with no option to pay by cash, and incurring credit card charges even if they were to give us a refund.

title: Lovely weekend break
text: Stayed here last weekend whilst visiting family and friends in the area. As I am familiar with area, locating the apartments were rather easy. On arrival at the office we were greeted by two very friendly and helpful ladies who did all the necessary check in procedures. Be warned they do take a photocopy of the card that you made the booking with which made me very uncomfortable for obvious reasons. The apartment itself was superb. Exceptionally clean and very modern and equipped with a fab kitchen. We had booked a two bedroom apartment which had views of the Thames and Canary Wharf. One negative thing about the apartment block is that it doesn't have air con and the apartment can be really hot and stuffy when the sun shines on the building.......to purchase a flat in this block of the same standard costs between £700k to £900k and believe me for that kind of money you would want air con !!!! Also I felt that the parking charge for the apartments were very excessive at £15 per night. Word of warning your car gets covered in dust in the underground parking area !!!! Not great when you are wearing clean clothes and brush against the car !!! Would we stay again?- Mmm probably but no way during the summer months as it would be a sweat box !!!!

title: TALL SHIPS EXPERIENCE
text: My Wife and I spent 4 days at these appartments,and it was FABULOUS , We came for the Fantastic Tall Ships Festival,and we could not have picked a better location. We were right by The Famous Cutty Sark and the Appartment overlooked the Thames. The Appartment was superb,and had everything we needed for our stay.It was spacious,and very clean and with every uttility in the kitchen.We were also able to Park up our car for the whole stay for £15 a day. The Staff are very friendly and helpful,and we will certainly look at the other London Apple Appartments for further stays in a London. Excellent Seasoned Travellers

title: Only good things to say!!
text: Just got back from a weekend break & had to say how much we enjoyed staying at Apple Apartments! We had read on here that they were tricky to find so asked at the management office who happily gave us .The girls in the booking in office were really helpful & let us check in early as our apartment was ready. We had a 2 bed roomed apartment with a fabulous view of the river! Very impressed with the fact there was a bathroom & ensuite( great for us plus 17 year old daughter!) lovely spacious apartment with absolutely everything you needed from cutlery,crockery,toiletries....they had thought of everything!! Yes you have to travel to get into London but we soon got used to the journey which took us about 25 mins via DLR then the underground from Bank station.Will definitely use these apartments again....fabulous!

title: Room with a view
text: Just back from a great 3 night break in a 1 bed apartment (4-7th Sept 2014 )with Appleapartments Greenwich while the Tall Ships Festival was on. Very efficient staff on site, nothing too much trouble and Reception advised us she had moved us to a room with a better view of the river (most 1 bed apratments are at the rear of the building). We had an oblique view of the river and you could just see the tops of the Cutty Sark rigging. best thing was the first morning when we woke up a massive cruise liner had berthed through the night so that was a very TALL ship! Everything you could want in the apartment (apart from any form of saucepan) just like a good quality hotel, everything very clean. I imagine they would have found a saucepan if I had asked but I managed with the microwave. Great location too and nice riverside gardens and small play areas for residents. So handy for Cutty Sark Greenwich Station too. Really good Indian restaurant in that vicinity called Mogul. Highly recommended.

title: Great short break in Greenwich
text: We stayed as a family-two adults and three teenage children. The apartments were spotlessly clean and in a great location. The staff were really helpful. The only criticsm we would have is that there was only one small sofa and one easy chair so with five of us , there wasn't enough comfy seating for the evening. Other than this small point, everything else was great. I would thourougly recommend staying here if you are a family as it offers great value for money.

title: Fantastic accommodation for a family
text: We stayed as a family of 5 in one of the apartments for 4 days. It was an unforgettable experience. The apartment was well-designed and equipped with all the appliances we needed. The service was helpful and friendly. The building is situated within a few-minute walk to DLR station and 2 minutes from Waitrose supermarket. If we have another chance to come to London, we will definitely choose Apple Serviced Apartments in Greenwich.

title: Very convenient for city trip London
text: We stayed at this apartment for a city trip to London. The apartment is located outside the busy areas of London but the highlights of London can easily be reached by public transport. The water taxi on the Thames is a very nice alternative to reach London. The apartments are very clean and spacious. The only problem was that it was very warm in the apartment.

title: Brand spanking new
text: Top spec lovely and new. We had 2 apartments one with great Thames view and 1 with no view. Near the water taxi to Central London. Nice staff. Near by supermarket. I went in a mini bus that would go in the underground parking but the complex staff happy to help. A lot of accommodation for prime and new position. Don't expect a hotel it's a apartment

title: Nice Apartment in Greenwich
text: Stayed here two nights last weekend. The apartment was very spacious, with good kitchen and bathroom. Close to DLR and Greenwich town centre. Friendly staff. There is a Waitrose on site which is very handy. Very quiet area. Worth visiting the cosmopolitan market in Greenwich. Would stay here again.

title: Stay Anywhere else!!!!
text: The apartment is 45 minutes to London. The wifi never worked and the boat took an hour to Big Ben. The management was extremely not professional and when we mentioned how far it was they agreed. If you are out of country be aware there is no 24 hour front desk unless you have an international phone to call a number. I can't write enough how much we did not like this place. They clearly don't care about the human experience of being on vacation.

title: GREAT PLACE BUT VERY HOT IN SUMMER
text: very nice location, close to DLR, River Bus ,Buses,Waitrose and lovely Cafes. We really enjoyed our stay here, there is some construction work going on but not enough to spoil our stay. The apartment had great views over london although this does mean the setting sun heats up the living room and the bedrooms so we had to get a fan to keep the temperature down even at night. I would definitely stay here again but not in summer time i would stay here again in winter

title: Excellent family apartment
text: We booked 2 nights to show our 1 & 3 year olds the sights of London. Very surprised by the size of the apartment, lovely big space. Arrived for check-in and asked to wait 40 mins as it wasn't ready, probably my fault as I hadn't emailed our arrival time, but a park on site and quick trip to Waitrose for essentials soon passed the time. Went back and they couldn't contact house-keeping so we were given another apartment, I think we were upgraded to a river view! We were very impressed. Unfortunately our children were both ill in the night (1 day in nursery and they caught a bug, typical!). Asked at reception in the morning and new bedding was provided for a much more enjoyable 2nd night. Thank goodness they also provided washing tablets for the washing machine - hopefully the neighbours were already awake at 6am! Travel cot and high chair provided were great too. The trip into London to the sights by DLR/Underground was a bit of a drag so used the Thames Clipper, much more enjoyable and still walking distance to the apartment. Use Greenwich Cutty Sark stop on DLR, We didn't think this had been communicated well on directions supplied.

title: Great place
text: We booked into this hotel as we were going to a conference at the O2 arena and we had 2 small children. We were upgraded at no cost, there is a good Tesco (Supermarket) in the Apartment Block. Public Transport via the River, Train and Bus were all really close, our 2 year old could walk to them all. I will say though it is difficult to find as the postal code is new to older GPS's, it is the last building in the block that the GPS directs you too, and the road goes all the way round into the apartment blocks.

title: Don't let the swanky photos fool you
text: We arrived after a four hour car journey with three adult children and having booked a three bed apartment months in advance to be shown into a two bed and told there weren't any three beds. We were offered another one bed apartment four floors away and told we could move into a three bed the next day. We weren't happy as we were only staying three nights and wanted to settle in from the start which was the whole point of booking an apartment. We eventually got them to refund the money which they'd taken from us before we even arrived and we managed to find a brilliant hotel nearby. The description of fruit and tea/ coffee being left for you as a welcoming touch was actually three apples to share between five of us and the usual sachets you get everywhere. The staff dealing with us thought it was all a bit of a joke and tried to suggest we were getting more for our money than we'd booked. One final point - they need to clean the windows sometimes. Awful experience.

title: Excellent value and very convenient
text: We've used these apartments on a couple of occasions and always been very pleased with them. They are located just a few minutes from the centre of Greenwich so you have good access to the Tube, buses, the ferry to North Greenwich and the Emirates Cable car that runs over to the Excel centre. Greenwich village has a wide variety of restaurants, a big indoor market and of course a variety of local landmarks. The apartments are clean, quiet, well furnished and for anyone wanting to eat in they have a mini kitchen. Beneath the apartments is a Waitrose supermarket that opens long hours so buying and preparing meals is an easy option. There is secure onsite parking at reasonable daily rates if you want to ditch the car and travel round by public transport you can.

title: Perfect location Great views
text: Great location, close the DLR, River Bus and Buses. We really enjoyed our stay here, there is some construction work going on but not enough to spoil our stay. The apartment had great views back over london although this does mean the setting sun heats up the living area and we had to get a fan to keep the temp down. I would definitely stay here again and have recommended it to family and friends.

title: Perfect customer service
text: Jermaine is the best customer service manager I encountered so far! Quick and attention to details. As travelling with 2 babies can be very demanding, Jermaine is very proactive in providing solutions. I am very looking forward to staying in this apartment!

title: Excellent location - great river views
text: Excellent location, close to Greenwich DLR, river taxi and British Rail. Greenwich village and market worth a visit, beautiful park. Apartment spacious, clean, modern with good facilities. Ask for a river view, which is spectacular. BUT, construction work outside of apartment block noisy during the week (it begins at half seven and goes on until six in the evening - lots of banging and drilling). No instruction booklets in the apartment on how to use the cooker and microwave and staff not bothered. Said they would send someone and after numbers calls and an hour later the lady said there was no one who could help. The problems was never sorted out throughout our stay.

title: Needs maintenance
text: We stayed at these apartments as we've stayed their before and loved them. However I feel that the consent are not keeping up with the maintenance and nave no one on hand to repair things as they go wrong. For example the dishwasher, one of the runners kept falling off when pulling the drawer out. The plug was missing in the bath- not at all good with a 5 year old and 3 days walking around london even though we reported this on the first day and promised it would be sorted. The sofa had a burn in it. The coffee table had rings on it. The staff where hopeless when it came to repairs. Parking also extortionate £15 a day! Will have to reconsider where I stay next time!!

title: Amazing way to top off our stay!!
text: We came up to Greenwich to see Robbie Williams at the o2 and we decided to stay at the Apple Apartments! Best decision ever! There was 6 of us and we stayed in a 2 bedroom apartment that was stunning and so spacious for us all! The apartment was spotless and beautiful and has a huge balcony overlooking the Thames, you can even see the o2! Location was great, perfect for a visit to the o2 as we got the river taxi straight there and back after. The only thing I can fault is that it was a little confusing with the location of the parking getting in the car park, we figured it out in the end and it would not stop us staying again as although it was tricky it was great that we had parking - maybe just ask for better directions than we did! Overall the staff were lovely and it really made our trip special staying here!! Will definitely be back!

title: Super clean and good value
text: We are a family of two adults and three kids under 12 that enjoyed two nights in apple apartment. The apartment was very clean, close to the cutty sark tube which meant 20 min to London. We used the river cruise S well. and shopping. Staff was very pleasant and the balcony with view of the Thames was great! Better value than staying in London! Free wifi made kids happy after a long day of sight seeing. Kitchen was good, just needs oven mitts. Would come back.

title: Awesome stay with friends
text: Apartments were clean and fit for purpose. Excellent view of the Thames from the balcony. We were upgraded to a bigger apartment. Accommodated an early check-in at 10am as room was available. All the gubbins one would need for a weekend stay were supplied. A Waitrose 200 yards round the corner to stock up on any foods/ drinks required. There is, however, no sign post at the door so apartments are not obvious. The postcode doesn't find it either. The apartment was exactly what we needed. Greenwich is a great place in London to catch a few sights and spend time with friends without being caught in the madness of the centre of London. The only fault really to note regarding the apartment is lack of signage. Since we stayed on a very hot weekend, air conditioning would have been a benefit. Balcony doors to living room and master bedroom were invaluable. All in all I would recommend this apartment.

title: Great location, clean apartment but it needs some maintenance
text: There may be a challenge finding the office as the postcode does not work on google maps. I thought I knew which building we were staying in, but once we had registered (copies of ID for everyone staying) we were walked to another building to find our apartment The apartment is very clean and well equipped, including tea, coffee, fairy liquid - even dishwasher and laundry tablets. We were situated very close to a Waitrose, with plenty of small playgrounds dotted around for my 4 and 1 yr old to enjoy. We were only a few minutes away from the centre of Greenwich - which was very handy. My main gripe was that we were staying at the height of summer and there is no air-conditioning and insufficient ventilation - especially as the door to the balcony was broken. We also had problems with the bathroom door not locking or some of the bedroom doors would not shut - this meant they kept banging when the windows were left open. We did report the balcony door but no one has been by to fix the problems. It really feels like more care is needed to maintain these apartments - I don't think I will be using the again.

title: Excellent London base
text: I've been staying here for two or three nights a week now for about 3 months. I've never found a fault with the apartments (pretty much brand new with all the gubbins you'd need) or my booking or the check in process. Always very friendly and helpful. A quiet location with a Waitrose on site which makes self catering that bit easier. Greenwich is a beautiful part of London and you're very close to the DLR station as well. Highly recommended.

title: Excellent apartment with beautiful views along the Thames.
text: We booked a 2 bedroomed apartment & upon arrival found we had been given a 3 bedroomed 2 bathroomed modern apartment with all the modern appliances & furniture that appeals to people who love city waterfront living. It was well presented, clean & uncluttered. It had a very spacious feeling to it. Our only regret was that we were only there for 1 night. We will definately be back & would highly recommend the apartments. I would say the only very slight negative is that it's a 30 to 40 min dlr & tube ride from the centre. On the plus side to that is that it's nice & peaceful. Doesn't feel like being in the city.

title: Worth every penny
text: Just got back from a 2 day stay here and I can't speak more highly about it. If you are travelling as a family don't waste time with hotels stay here. Only a 5 minute walk from Greenwich and all the travel links into London you could want. My only issues would being new it can be a bit hard to find,also there is still building work going on so if your a light sleeper a 8 o'clock wake up call might be a bit annoying, but as we were on the 12th floor it wasn't a problem.

title: Perfect place to be in.....close enough to central london
text: The apartment is a short walk from cutty sark DLR station. We had bags and so we took a cab. Thankfully the cabbie knew the place as there was no signage. We had of course been sent a detailed map by them and it should have been ok. The 2 bedroom apartment was beautiful with a balcony overlooking the Thames. Impeccable, comfortable, convenient, fully equipped with washer cum dryer, dishwasher, freezer, refrigerator, iron, toiletries and detergents. Towels were replaced after 2 days. 24 hour support from the office. Waitrose grocery store was a minute away. Lots of restaurants, cafés, ice cream places,and the beautiful greenwich market were all at walking distance. Not to forget the royal observatory and the maritime museum and gardens. It took about 40 mins to reach central london. We chose this place as we had come to spend time with friends who live in blackheath....but I would choose it once again even if we come to spend time in central london.

title: 2nd Worst Hotel I have ever stayed in, World Traveller.
text: We were travelling with young adults who wanted to go cheap. Boy did THEY even regret this pick! Room for 5 was 2 doubles and a single crammed into one room. Not even room for our back packs on the floor. Toilet stunk like urine. We were having trouble with the flush handle, took the plastic cover off and found that the insides were being held together with scotch tape! Asked Manager to come fix it. We came back later...more scotch tape was the solution! Box springs were on the floor and were filthy. The bed covers barely covered the bed so box springs were showing. Our "Breakfast" was packaged junk food and a carton of orange juice! The homeless guy that lived outside on a bench was happy to get our breakfasts. Thankfully we only had to stay there 3 nights! The old homeless guy was the nicest thing about the place. The Manager and his wife seemed to be sitting around, talking on the stairs every time we came in. When we took a bus the driver cringed when we mentioned where we were staying. Said he would not stay in that area.

title: False Advertising
text: Booked this hotel by mistake thinking we had booked a different hotel of the same name. The pictures on Booking.com made it seem like a really fancy 3* hotel, only when we arrived did we realise this was far from the case and it was actually a 1* hotel! There was a lot of discrepancies with what the hotel actual was, some websites say this place is a hostel and others class it as a hotel. The location is okay, close to the tube and train station but its difficult to get around seeing as it only serves the Bakerloo line and its not near any tourist attractions. The hotel was so close to the tube station every 4 minutes the building would shake, this didn't affect sleep though so it was okay. When we arrived check in was a little slow considering they were doing it the old fashioned way by handwriting in a book. The staff seemed friendly. It was a little alarming knowing there was no staff on the premises after 11pm when there was regularly people fighting outside, and that the only key on the key ring served the front door and the room. There was no lifts, which is expected in London and not paying for a big fancy hotel chain

title: very cramped
text: stayed one night very small room in need of cleaning tv in room just about worked the door to the shower and toilet was battered and the sign saying toilet was on the inside on checking in it was demanded i produce an identity card had to point out in the UK we don't have to carry such things

title: Good value and great location
text: We wanted somewhere to stay during the Olympics that was good value. If all you need is a place to sleep and have a shower then this is ideal. The location is very good (2 mins to Paddington, 10 mins walk to Hyde Park) and there are plenty supermarkets, pubs, take aways and restaurants in the vicinity. We stayed in room 8 (first floor overlooking Norfolk Square) and it did the job. It was fairly clean, had a small table and chairs, little tv, big mirror, hairdyer, tea and coffee making facilities and a fridge! The bathroom was tiny but it didn't matter for one night. We were able to leave our luggage there before we checked in and after we checked out. The staff were friendly. This is certainly a budget option but if you just need a bed for the night then this place is good.

title: horrid
text: horrible staff that couldn't speak English,,, breakfast was a joke no dining room they brought it too you, couldn't eat frozen bread rolls,,,, room was so small and you couldn't see out the window, tube ran underneath the room so felt all the vibration,,,,, heating only worked when it felt like it.... wouldn't go back ever

title: Terrible place
text: The hotel was ideally situated But however, there was thick dust on picture rail,window sill, and skirting. The curtain was ripped and filthy. The furniture was so old and decrepit. No wardrobe, just a hanging rack. Bathroom was so neglected, crack in sink with no plug, shower drain outlet was also cracked and stained. Electrical wires just clipped to wall. London Underground trains rumbled under the building and very poor internet connection. Booked two nights but left after the first night. The breakfast went straight into the bin ( yuk) Only stayed the first night due to no other vacancies in other hotels nearby.

title: okay room
text: Room was small however it was clean. room was stuffy.. we hardly managed to open old window.. all we saw was wall of another building so close.. i wouldnot recommend for claustrophobic.. reception guy was very nice but our room was connected to reception.. we could hear everything likewise he could hear everything.. no privacy.. big bed abd good mattress but tiny bathroom even for a small girl like me however the guy was really friendly and helpful.. it got hit amd miss hotel

title: Terrible experience at St George Hotel, Paddington
text: I've booked a twin-room for 5 days from 13-Nov to 17-Nov and a double bed room on 18-Nov at St George Hotel through the website hotellondon.com. I've prepaid the 10% deposit and booking charges by my credit card. When we arrived to the hotel, the hotel manager gave us a 3-beds private room at Tony's House Hotel for the initial five days. At this hotel, the toilet facilities are fine and the room service is satisfactory. The reception assistant was nice and helpful. However, on the fifth day night, the reception assistant requested us to move out from the room for the reason that the room has been booked by others. He told us we've placed the original booking at St George Hotel and not at Tony's House Hotel. At our request, he phoned the hotel manager in charge but he said the manager wasn't there right now. ( At that time, we've known that the hotel manager's name is George through his telephone conversation). He told us St George Hotel was over-booked and he promised to give us a reply on the next day. On Saturday, when we asked the reception assistant about the room arranagement, he told us to ask the hotel manager directly. So we got to St George Hotel and the hotel manager promised to give a double bed room for us and told us to return to the hotel at around 2:00pm to get the room. When we came back to St George Hotel, a girl at the reception led us to the Continental Hotel, which is next to St George Hotel. After we put our luggages to the room, we've found that the toilet facilities are in very bad condition and the drain doesn't work well. At the same time, we knew from the pricelist of the Continental Hotel that the double bed room only cost at 45 pounds whereas we've originally booked a room at the rate of 58 pounds. We were thoroughly dissatified with such an arrangement and went back to St Geroge Hotel in sought of a reasonable explanation from the hotel manager. We finally reached the hotel manager George. We spoke to him that we'd want to get a double room at St George Hotel. He said that we were lucky enough to get a room already as the hotel room supply at London was very tight right now and many people came in for a vacation during weekend. When we asked him whether he could give us a refund for the differences of room rates, he refused and said we could either accept the arrangement or go. We've disputed about the changing of hotel room for nearly ten minutes' time but the hotel manager repeatedly declined our request. He said we were tough and were like Jewish who calculate on trivial matters in a despise manner. Finally, he promised to refund us five pounds. We had no choice but can only go back to the Continental Hotel as we've already paid the hotel rental. We both felt very disgusted about the hotel manager's attitude and manner. We felt we were being insulted by his words and deceived for trusting him. We originally had a pleasant journey at London but was completely spoiled by this terrible experience. We hope that the tourists, especially girls, should pay attention and beware of this and carefully pick a hotel in the future.

title: Budget base
text: Visiting london for a 2 day business trip. Wanted a reasonable valued hotel. Was a 3* when booked month or so ago. Seems now lost and is 1*. Made mistake of going into hotel next door. Nice place. Turned up early. Deff not ready for us.let us leave our bags. Guy in reception ( broom cupboard) seemed stressed. Said come back after 4pm. Got here after trade show. Stunk of marijuana. Had room 9.on 1st floor. 2 double 1 single bed. Large room. Bathroom updated. Nice black tiles. Room VERY dated. But fixtures all new. Good coffee facilities. This is important for us. Had mini fridge & hairdryer. Even a fan & safe. But double door balcony let in the cool air i like. Deffo needs better decoration & bedding. Has FIRM mattress. Hubby loves, i hate. Clean towells & bedding. Sachets of soap & showergel no shampoo. Deffo a 1* but have stayed in far worse hotels. The area has everything you need. Many shops, resturants, cafe. I recomm the burgers grom olivers steakhouse, just around the corner. Paid £79 via booking.com. Wouldnt stay here again. Will be more aware of reading reviews and would stay in hotels on same st instead. But got what paid for. Just need to see what bteakfast is supplied in morn to our room lol.

title: Great family room, great location
text: Booked here as most places booked up. More like a hostel than a hotel but reception man when we arrived was friendly enough. We had booked a quad room and to our dismay way on top floor!! So about 5 flights of stairs and 2 if which are very steep and narrow! Not ideal when carrying bags, suitcases etc! Be warned. The room itself is nice we stayed in 21. Small double beds and a single. Bathroom is modern fitted out but pokey. Needs shelves or somewhere for your wash bags and things. Sink is tiny for washing and the Tao is fitted poorly so water pours out down the side and on floor. Shower ok but not power or even electric so not what you want but you get by. Nowhere to hang towels in there or your clothes etc. Just a base so we have coped for 3 nights but any longer would be a no no. Fire alarm went off on 1st night about 5am sending us in a real panic but someone in one of the rooms was somehow cooking toast!!?? Could smell it when I was inspecting to evacuate. No communication from room to reception. Breakfast is delivered to the room on a tray. Basic 2 white rolls each, a yoghurt, an apple juice and a croissant. Packets of butter and jam too. You are provided with plenty of tea and coffee sachets plus sugar and uht milk sachets too. So that’s not bad. There is a small fridge which we used for milk and bits. Found ourselves getting a bigger breakfast/brunch elsewhere. Overall it’s ok here, cheap etc good base for travelling around, big bus tours stop is just across Norfolk Square. Nice area.

title: London Vacation
text: I stayed with my family in St George hotel in London for 5 days. It was a really bad experience The hotel is far from being a 3 star hotel. Everything was really bad . Hotel is old , rooms are dirty. Breakfast ,I can hardly call it breakfast,is totally unacceptable. The pictures of the hotel can cause you to think that it's the right place to stay in your vacation in London,but I suggest you to run away.

title: Not Fancy but a handy place to stay
text: Three of us stayed at this hotel for a week. The location is excellent 2 minutes walk from the station, bus stop 2 doors away, easy access to taxis and a plethora of restaurants and a couple of pubs all within 100 metres. The room was small, the bathroom was tiny but it was clean and the bedding was clean, there was a fridge, tea making facilities and a hair drier. There were also plenty of power points!!! This was a huge plus as two of us have medical equipment needing to be plugged in. The staff were very friendly and helpful and we had a chat to them almost every time we came in or out. Our room was cleaned every day. We werent looking for a fancy hotel.. just somewhere to sleep as we had a full program every day .. this hotel suited us. Yes, its basic but for the price it worked well for three of us sharing. There is no lift and most rooms are upstairs.. these hotels are in older buildings so dont expect all mod cons. The breakfast was super basic but we werent too bothered about that. We enjoyed our stay here and would stay again.

title: Not good value for money!
text: Need make over, not cleaned every day... We had to even ask for clean towels... Next time I will go a little bit outside of the city center close to the Tube and I find better value for money place....

title: Overpriced - wouldn’t return
text: Group of 5 girls stayed here while we went to a concert taking place at Olympic Park. Fantastic location 2 minute walk from Paddington tube station, lots of shops pubs also surrounding the hotel. We booked a family room to sleep 5 adults, priced at £190 we thought this was very steep. The room was clean but so cramped, 2 girls had to get ready in the corridor! The receptionist guy was friendly and pleasant and so were the other staff! The guy brought breakfast to our room the following morning which was juice, crossaints etc. Overall I wouldn’t stay here again and you could get a lot more for your money! Even though the hotel was clean it resembles faulty towers and definitely needs some decor updating!

title: You only get what you pay for!
text: Not a bad hotel for a one night stay. The bed wasn't that comfortable, the pillows were really heavy and hard. The carpet wasn't very clean at all, neither was the hotel by the looks of it. We were on the top floor which was a real maul getting our bags upto there. Our room was really small and pokey, the only bonus was you could shower and use the toilet at the same time!! haha :D The breakfast came at 8 in the morning on a little white tray outside of the door, we took one look at it and went to McDonalds. Everything was pre-packaged so therefore not fresh. My advice is that for one night if you can stand it then go for it, but if you are staying in Lodnon for more than one night then pay that little bit extra and have some luxury and comfort!

title: Excellent location , excellent staff , good value
text: This hotel is small clean with basic facilities Wi fi was good It’s a budget hotel and prices are much cheaper than neighbouring hotels Breakfast is not worth availing of its delivered to your room .I found an excellent cafe 2 minutes from hotel LA TAZZA Praed st (out of hotel turn left left again and left at pub on corner of Praed st )which has excellent all day freshly prepared full English breakfast for £ 5 to 6 Having used St GEORGE on a number of visits I found walking to Marble Arch took 12 t 15 mins Excellent late night bus no 23 from PICADILLY via MARBLE ARCH brings you directly to hotel Better value than some neighbouring hotels.

title: Like a hostel
text: An affordable hotel in the comfort of the hostel. Storey without lift. Good location to explore - you can walk, or use the nearby metro. Around a lot of pubs. Room equipped with std. We had a bathroom (a bit claustrophobic). Breakfast very modest and cold. The room has a kettle, mugs, coffee, tea, fridge and tv. Generally if you only sleep there and you have no requirements, it's ok.

title: Ok, but couldn’t sleep
text: We stayed here for one night end of jan 2018. At first glance everything seemed ok room had everything we needed and was small but we had no plans to stay in the room so it was fine for our needs. Breakfast was fine and for the price I thought it was great they provided anything to eat at all. This hotel is fine for a cheap short break. My only reason for a low score is we just couldn’t sleep which to me is the main reason for booking any hotel, you want and need a comfortable stay and we didn’t get that. We stayed in room 4, the bed was small. I am not convinced it was a double bed maybe a 3/4. Me and my partner couldn’t move in bed and so couldn’t sleep at all. You can hear the tube underneath also although that didn’t bother me too much. I would suggest that this room be changed to a single as that way there would be more bedroom space and guests would sleep well which makes all the difference.

title: Too expensive and uncomfortable
text: We have stayed at this hotel, the room was soo small and the breakfast was just few things without a restaurant they were leaving the tray in front of the door. the hotel is good for one night stand but for family and long stay I wouldnt recommend. the price is so high for this service.

title: NEEDS SHUTTING DOWN
text: What a vile hotel! If you can even call it that! Tiny little broom cupboard which was called reception, receptionist was pleasant enough though. A huge amount of stairs to climb to room 20. On first quick glance it didn't look too bad, but boy were we wrong. There was a huge piece of wallpaper on the ceiling peeling off, wallpaper was peeling off the walls in numerous places, the radiator was only hot on one side & underneath a window that didn't shut! There was mould covering the 'bathroom' ceiling & a 2 inch gap under the main door (which we had to cover with a towel to try & retain some heat). If you don't mind noise, then you're fine here as there's a constant drilling sound all night, we we first thought could have been from the underground, but 5 storys up?? Breakfast was a joke. The 'continental breakfast included' comprised of a bread roll, a chocolate filled pre packed croissant, a yoghurt & a 29p strawberry juice carton. Needless to say this was left complete on the tray as we left. Had we been able to book somewhere else at last minute, we'd have been gone from here! This is the worst 'hotel' I have ever been in. DO NOT BOOK

title: Not that bad like people say
text: I stayed in a single room for two days, which is clean, quite small and a bit hot in the evening, but I think that is ok as it was cool in the midnight. You can have everything you needed, such as, tv, sink, hairdryer, kettle, wifi in room. The toilet is next to my room. You will not hear the toilet flushing. Just could hear some voices of people walk in & out, but will not feel so noise. The location is quite convenience. just 5 mins walk to paddington train station and around 2 to 3 mins walk to Paddington tube station. There are some restaurants nearby, The staffs are nice and considerate. As I took the early fight at 7:45am, the staffs prepared the breakfast for me in the pervious day. The hotel is safe. The main door will always be locked, so you have to use a special key to go inside. I think it is quite reasonable for a single room in paddington.

title: It's cheap
text: The room I was in had a new bathroom. The tap didn't work properly and the shower head wouldn't stay in place but it was clean and spacious. The guy at reception was pleasant enough. I could've had breakfast for no extra charge but a continental breakfast is worthless as far as I'm concerned. If you wanted to sleep before midnight you wouldn't have been able to because of the train noise. It was really cheap, so I can't really argue. If I'd paid £100 I wouldn't have been happy, but i didn't.

title: old and dusty
text: I only stayed here one night. The front desk is so small that i had no place to sign in that book, so i had to put it against the wall :)) The room was even smaller. If I wanted to go to the bathroom, my boyfriend had to climb in bed. We had breakfast in bed, becuase there was no other place to do it.

title: VERY GOOD BUDGET PRICE!
text: Was not expecting much to be honest. Decor and furnishings are quite basic and I was expecting the worse when I arrived. Have to say i was pleasantly surprised. Hotel is in a great location. The room allocated to me (as a single traveller) was a treble room so I had plenty of room. It had clean bedding and towels. It was en-suite with free wi-fi and the middle aged guy at the desk was very friendly, helpful and informative. All in all for £35 this was great value. I dont think I will be taking the wife here anytime soon but as a single traveller who really just wants an affordable room with hot water and a comfortble clean bed then this is a good place to consider staying at.

title: Old but friendly place
text: Very old and used hotel. Decor is something from the eigthteenth century, just without the charm. Rooms clean, but stairs and surrounding area dirty. But a very friendly guy sitting in the reception, always ready with a smile, and let me an adoptor for my trip, since my own had stayed in Denmark. Breakfast comes from a tray, but never mind that, if you dont like it, there is plenty of other chances of food just outside the hotel doors.

title: Stuffy and dusty
text: I was here 6 nights with my boyfriend. This place really isn't very good, thou we didn't expect no luxury for that price. We arrived on sunday and our room wasn't ready yet. That's okay, but it was really weird that hotel staff called one customer "total idiot" etc because he was still in the room sleeping.. Just weird? Anyway, we went to eat and when came back, we got our room. Our room was in the upper floor. There's no lift and the stairs are steep and soooo tiring :D The room was small, stuffy and dusty. Shower was small and there is a lot of back mould in the bathrooms seiling!! And it was a total lottery- sometimes you get warm water, sometimes not. Cleaning is poor. Our room had only one mug(dirty one) and no hand towel. I asked clean mugs and the towel, so next day we had two mugs (but both still dirty!!). We had the towel also, but cleaner didn't give us more shower gel or toilet paper AT ONCE!!! So we bought our own :D Unbelievable. I also pointed out that our room was very dusty, but she didn't do anything about it. I think she only made the bed (and maybe vacuumed?) Location is ok, Paddington metro station is near and also busses come very near the hotel. There's couple of good indian restaurants near and you can get good breakfast in Java U or Pappiland Coffee for example. So there's no need to eat hotel's own breakfast, that's not very satisfying.... :D Wi-fi worked good!

title: Did the job
text: As one would expect of a hotel in Paddington the hotel was small and between a number of other hotels. What we didn't expect was the dated interior. It looked like a 12 year old painted the banisters and the window frames. We were downstairs in room 2 where you almost have to roll the suitcase down the stairs as they are so narrow. The rooms were not put together very well and the furnature was dated. The room included breakfast which again did the job. It was a tray with 6 bread rolls, 3 yogurts 3 juices and some butter and jam. The rooms were not serviced well and we had to complain which didn't really help. As we were downstairs it seemed we were right above the tube line as the room rumbled from 4 am to 11pm every 4 min. Other than that we really just lay our heads there after long exploratory days in and around London.

title: To expensive for what they offer
text: Very Small bathroom. Not even a child, can move in that bathroom. Poor breakfast. Better going on supermarket. Old place. Old bed, old door, old table. From money earned, they can renovate this place a bit. Is in Paddington!! For this price a night they can do more....

title: Not a hotel, Bed to put your head down!
text: Great location but that is it. All you have access to is a small really old fashioned bedroom. Nothing else, even your breakfast ( Bread rolls, jam, a cake and carton of orange juice) is bought to your room as there is no where else in the house that you can access. Its bascially what i would call a Back Packers place, nothing wrong with that if thats what you want, however, please dont expect anything else. The staff were pleasant enough and as we were only there for 1 night no big deal. Just letting you know what to expect!

title: Worst hotel ever
text: This was the worst hotel me and my partner have ever stayed in. It cost £79.00 for bed and breakfast. Please keep in mind the breakfast was an orange juice each,flap jack and a cob. Room was tiny and bathroom dirty. Would never stay here again!!

title: Great value for London
text: Nothing wrong with this place had a 3 bed room.Very close to Paddington station. Good value for london.Simple place only stayed one night which it was perfect for.

title: value for money
text: 70 pounds/night for a 5 persons room inc. breakfast is a very reasonable price for a hotel especially in London. Just about 3 mins walking distance to Paddington Tube Sta. Definately will stay in this hotel again...

title: Great little B&B - a must stay
text: A great little find in Paddington around the corner from the tube station. Yes, small however very comfortable, great value for money and Peter from front office very very helpful. Easy access to everything in London with tube to Heathrow airport, tube to all other main tube stations, hop on and hop off bus around the corner, best Chinese restaurant, great pub on corner, clean safe and variety of restaurants. My room was small on the 3rd floor and Peter took my luggage. Clean towels daily, tea and coffee replenished daily and hot water in my ensuite. Great price and Great Find - tku Peter.

title: Pay the extra
text: Room was tiny, property is gloomy and drank...took a chance and it didn't pay off. At the very most, this would work if you were on your own and needed somewhere to crash for a few hours. Don't take your partners. Good location though, so shop around for better places

title: Priceless for Location
text: Hotel really small and tiny, no left so quite a treck when your on the 3rd floor. Owner was really pleasant to say he didnt speak fluent english. Shower really tiny, but i found the bed was comfy, we didnt use the kettle, drinks or tv. KFC, Subway round the corner, but the location is just priceless. We only stayed one night and would definetly recommend it to others.

title: A lovely hotel that worths.
text: I would not be a tourist if I not start with the excellent location of this hotel- just 3 minutes from the tube, the Paddington station( the train that heads Windsor as well) and Hyde Park- Bayswater is a great district with a lot of cheap restaurants( in comparison to such in the centre) and different cousine to be tasted, so have it mind. My sister and I were accommodated in Room 11, which failed to ensure us enough free space. However, the staff was more than helpful and they even took our 27kg. weighting luggage to the room and gave us the so important power plug for UK sockets. Besides, an electric kettle was provided, as well as a handful of tea bags, instant coffee, sugar packets and nondiary creamers. I do not hesitate to recommend this hotel to everybody, who is not so capricious and would not mind staying in a small room for several days, as the easy access to the city centre do counts.

title: Only stay if you like the smell of mould and dust
text: Don't be deceived by the internet photos! The place is a dump. When you enter, be prepared for the smell of cigarette smoke from the concierge and his mates smoking in the hallway chatting. Walk up the stairs to your room to the smell of mould and dust, filthy curtains and a bathroom that is like stepping into a caravan - moulded fibreglass insert. Breakfast is delivered to your room (there is no common area except the hallway entrance) - a glass of orange concentrate, two slices of cold toast, individual packets of sweet biscuits and a container of some sort of dairy concoction with chocolate sprinkles and caramel - Yuck! There is a television and kettle in the room - but we didn't want to use the kettle at all. The carpet throughout was filty and there was rubbish under the bed which indicated it had not been cleaned for many years. The heating was so hot that we needed to keep the window open all night in the middle of January. The locks on the door were flimsy to say the least and there was exposed wiring running along the walls and ceiling. The one saving grace was that the sheets were clean and we got some clean towels. London is expensive - but you can do much better than this by simply walking down the street to some of the other hotels in the street and bargaining on the price. They offer hot (real) breakfasts and are clean and safe - for the same price.

title: Poor poor hotel
text: Stayed couple of nights in a small room in the basement, with little of natural light coming from a window looking to a dead space (like tiny tiny indoor yard). The room was too old, the bathroom was too old as well as everything in the room and therefore there was an strange smell in the enviroment. You can hear and feel the underground as it pases under the hotel vibrating. I dont rate it as terrible only for the staff which is kind and helpfull and for the location which EXCELLENT. You are in 10 mins with underground or bus in the city center and the stations for both are 2 mins from the hotel. Moreover the neighborhood is safe with some options for dining as well as fast food.

title: Small beds, be careful if you ask for a double room
text: I guess you can get much much better at the same price. Small bedrooms, small beds, no facilities at all. Don't take breakfast: go out and have a proper one. The one you get from them is so sad and miserable. Recommended for short stays and for solo or couples (thin ones). Check for something else at the same lovely square, really! The location is excellent and the neighborhood is lovely.

title: Good budget hotel
text: Location: Good location and easy connectivity from all places to Paddington. Wi Fi: Hotel policy says Wi Fi in public areas but we stayed on ground floor near to reception area and had good connectivity in our room. Breakfast: Basic breakfast served in room including breads, butter, jam, juice and yoghurt. Staff: Staff is helpful and friendly. Esp Peter who was there all the time has been really nice person. Room Amenities: Basic room having beds and private bathroom. It had electric kettle and fridge provided. Room was neat and clean and we had no issues.

title: Bargain price so can't complain !
text: Booked at last minute and got an ensuite room on a Wednesday night for £35 so in that respect a real bargain. First impressions not great - pretty shabby entrance and slightly neglected feel - pretty common for many lower priced hotels in London. Personable chap on reception. I was given a room on top floor which meant a long climb on a rickety staircase - was'nt a massive problem as far as I was concerned but clearly would not have been ideal for families or the elderly. First impressions of room were not too good - the double bed took up most of the room so I'm please I did'nt have too much luggage. Bedding nice and clean, plenty of clean towells and good supply of soaps and shampoo etc. Mattress not comfortable and probably should have been put in the skip in 2005. Room clean but in need of some tlc - shower cradle was broken so had to hold shower head whilst showering. Bolts on sliding glass shower door rusted and not easy to open. Plug in sink was all rusty and looked terrible. No breakfast room in hotel - however a continental breakfast tray was delivered to my door at 8am - a roll, butter, jam, cartons of orange juice, yoghurt, biscuits etc - tasted fresh and all pretty good really. Overall, for £35 I felt I had got a bit of a bargain. Whether I would have thought the same way if I had paid say £70 or £80 is a different matter. In summary - would look to stay again provided the price was right.

title: Not the best... not the worst
text: The beds were stiff, and cheaply made. Many soft spots in the flooring. Bathroom was clean, appeared to have been recently updated. There were plenty of electrical outlets, something that you don't see too often in the UK. Don't rely on the breakfast, decent for a grab'n go circumstances (bread rolls and juice boxes). Staff seemed friendly upon check in

title: Easy hotel and central
text: We stayed for one night in a 5 person room. Size was good, beds comfy, bathroom modern and clean. Great location and cheap cafe around the corner for breakfast. Paid £30 each which for London central is good! Would stay again. Only thing was room was a little warm even with a fan!

title: okay
text: -you get what you are paying for.. -great location -nice staffs -they served breakfast to your room every morning -suitable for backpackers -no elevator, you need to carry your luggage up the stairs. its a hassle if you are bringing huge luggage

title: Not a 4 Star hotel
text: This hotel is NOT a 4 star hotel as promoted on Hotels.com, Expedia.com and Orbitz.com. We've been to Europe in the past and knew the rooms were smaller than rooms in the US so we were prepared. However, we were not prepared for cramming three twin beds into a 1 bed room. There was no room for luggage, the floor squeeked with every step, and we we could hear EVERYTHING outside the door. The bathroom was old, cracked and not the cleanest. The directions state that this hotel is only 300 meters from the Baker Street Metro. It was a good mile from the Metro. This place was not worth the money. We stayed at the Hilton Metrople on our return trip and what a pleasant surprise. It was cheaper, newer and the service was just awesome. Would not stay at the St. George ever again, nor would be recommend it to anyone.

title: Scary
text: Lobby actually really just a hallway, which had signs advising that it was illegal to smoke smelled of cigarettes. When we arrived the staff argued with one another. The hotel has shared bathrooms which were disappointingly unclean. The window in our room was broken (cracked), and the chairs were torn. Sheets did not fit the beds and the lock on the door was loose. Breakfast was continental and not English and delivered to room. If I was a 20 years old and traveling with friends I wouldn't have minded it all because the location is great. However that is not the case. On the plus side, the manager was pleasant and helpful and did watch our bags.
