title: Not good
text: Not sure who have been writing these reviews but I have stayed in some awful hotels in my life but this one is not good. We were staying in London on a theatre trip but to be honest I didn't want to go back and stay here. The room (no 11) was suppose to be a double but there was not enough room for both of us to stand up. More like a single room with a double bed squeezed in. The bed was right next to the radiator so very warm. The bed was broken. The sheets seemed clean but the duvet over the sheets had a couple of stains on. The carpet was clean and the to had lots of channels. I have stayed in some bad hotels in my time and I know you get what you pay for but this was the pits. There are several hotels in Norfolk place and as you look down the road you can tell St Georges as it is the one that is in dire need of refurbishment and a really good deep clean.

title: A great deal in London
text: After booking with only two weeks before our stay. We received a good deal. The staff are welcoming and friendly. The room was clean and comfortable bedding there was also a hairdryer. Good coffee and tea making facilities. Ideally located to Paddington and Central London. Would definitely recommend and stay here again.

title: I wish I could give this hotel a better mark
text: But sadly I cant! On the positive side - Good location, nice green space directly opposite the hotel, friendly helpful staff, lots of fruit teas and coffee, clean and tidy room. On the negative - Tiny bathroom (you could sit on the loo and have a shower at the same time), lots of noise from the underground trains even on the first floor (avoid the basement rooms as they must be REALLY noisy), the "nice" room given me at the front of the hotel had received a budget make-over recently and the new curtains were thin and white - meaning that light from outside lamps and street lights streamed in all night!, dangerous looking electric junction box behind door (Room 8) To be honest whilst cheap it wasn't THAT cheap (£68 per night) and I've stayed at better for less.

title: In need of a good clean
text: Stayed for one night in Sep 2012. £55 for a single room. Not a bad price for London. Room was tiny but that didn't bother me. What did bother me was the filthy shower. Breakfast was served at 8am whether u want it or not and was a tray of stuff I wouldn't consider to be breakfast items, biscuits etc. Not a bad place to stay for one night if u are on a budget but very basic. Staff were nice tho especially the Polish girl at reception

title: Not to bad.
text: I would stay here again but it's really budget stuff. Rooms outdated and old but running hot water some what clean with tv and tea coffee making facilities. Breakfast to the room and was ok. Reception is in a broom cupboard and man with computer looks out at you its like a scene from a thriller film. Friendly guy all the same.

title: Great value
text: Great value for money, we stayed 1 night to go to a show. It had everything we needed. A comfy bed and a shower. Also breakfast was included in the price. It's not the most glamorous of hotels but it does the job for a little break at a low cost. I will

title: As expected
text: A nice friendly welcome, the room was ensuite, clean and tidy, a fridge and hairdryer were in room, the bed had fresh linen and was very comfortable, parking was available outside of the hotel on street pay meters roomparkingoutside the hotel on pay meters

title: Great value super location
text: I paid £49 for a double room. Popped in at 10am to leave my bag there for the day and a cheerful Polish lady allowed me to check in early. The hotel is dated and tired but clean. You have everything you need..or at least I did. Fridge hairdryer and kettle. Masses of free tea and coffee. A basic continental breakfast was served on my room. Set on a leafy square among other hotels popular with tour groups. 5 mins from Paddington and Hyde Park. Cheerful friendly staff and great value.

title: Good budget hotel in a fantastic location.
text: Easy to find as it's just 5 minutes from Paddington station. Hotel reception is a tiny desk as you enter the premises, on your right. Room itself was very small but had everything I needed and was generally clean. Although, there was a stain on the mattress as you can see in the photos and the room was very noisy from the trains passing every few minutes. All in all though, good budget hotel. Breakfast was delivered to the room and was a variety of packaged food like croissants, yoghurt and juices.

title: Clean friendly hotel but...
text: We spent three nights here. On arrival found reception to be in a very small room like broom cupboard. We had asked for low floor as we had 4 heavy suitcases but were told we were on 4th floor no lift and no help. They offered an alternative in the basement which was a very small room if one person standing up the other gad to either be in the toilet or on the bed. We adked if ither room was any bigfer and thry advised smaller.....we took the basement one but for the first time in my life i suffered claustrophobic feelings. The bed was between two walls so as you slept you faced walls......however it was in a good arwa to be able to walk around centeal london marble arch etc. Would i go again....no

title: almost all you have read is true !
text: Yes, for me almost all you have read is true, I wouldn't think of taking the shoes off and stay in bare feet.... or even to move much during the night, the sheets were smaller than the horrible dirty mattress and it was better not to move ! The shared bathroom, terrible and the many floors of stairs were an adventure! I also have to say, I saw no animals there (didn't want to look either), the clerk and helper were really nice and polite, Continental breakfast was fine and enough and it helped a lot to have so much to do and see in London that at the end it was easier to arrive very tired and stay in the hotel just to sleep. The location is beautiful but I dont think I would go there again even when I really think I got what I paid for.

title: Needs a major uplift or pulling down to start afresh
text: Our room was booked as a double en -suite, when we arrived and stepped over the threshold alarm bells rang .....the receptionist was housed in what can only be described as a broom cupboard...tiny dimly lit cubby hole....not a good start. We were given the keys to room 15 and so climbed three flights of stairs to reach it. We opened the door and were amazed at how small the room was and it was just like a sauna....the so called double bed fitted from wall to wall and was pushed up to the window which meant we had to climb over each other to get in it. We also had an ensuite...a tiny corner shower cubicle and a non thermostatic shower valve " not sure if these are legal any more " and a tiny corner wash basin which you could only use by straddling over the WC which was also fitted at an angle, when using the WC our knees touched the wall...different ! When in the en-suite,unless you were stood in the shower cubicle there wasn't room to stand with the door closed.Overall the decor in the room although clean was at best shabby. Tea making facilities provided though the ingredients were the low cost budget variety.Breakfast

title: Great location, poor quality !
text: The location of this hotel is spot on in paddington It is a 5 minute walk from the tube station where you can go access and go anywhere in London. But the quality of the hotel and rooms is very poor, the rooms are tiny and it's very old fashioned, I wouldn't stay here again.

title: Satisfied
text: The location was great and safe Building is a little bit old but somehow nice one there were shops nearby, hope on hop off bus stop was at the end of the street.Tube was7 minute walk(Edware road) wi-fi was ok The receptionist named Peter was very helpful

title: nasty place!
text: everything stated by others about this hotel at norfok-square, Paddington explains the hotel as it is. we have been there for four days in june 2007 - just DIRTY and NASTY! The price (30-40 EUR) per person is absolutely not worth for what you get.

title: Good - Pleasant stay
text: Overall, St. George is quite good. Good location, good wifi, clean, good tea and coffee, helpful staffs and friendly. One thing about the breakfast is that, it would be much better if the hotel could change some items , not the same everyday. The ground floor room can fit only 3 beds, not 4 beds. The upper floor has more light and airy. However, we enjoyed our stay at St. George hotel.

title: Comfortable enough
text: This is not the best hotel I have stayed, but it was great value for money. Close to Paddington station and a quiet corner of Norfolk square. Our first floor room faced the park in front, and it was a good view. Lots of good restaurants nearby and the St Mary's Hospital bus stop is one minute away. We took the family room, which was a medium sized room filled with 4 beds. So there was hardly room for anything else, even for the bags. Tiny bath room, with bad plumbing. The shower door was broken and hanging on one hinge. But it was all clean . I have to say that the common bathrooms on first and second landings were modern and much better. Well, the lack of space was nicely compensated by the abundance of tea/ coffee/ hot chocolate / toiletries they kept, good wifi and also by the friendly , cool service. They serve breakfast in room ( obviously there is no dining room), which is a large tray of packed stuff like croissants, fruits etc and some breads. This was a good enough breakfast, for the money they charged. All in all , not bad. I have to add that this is located on a row of several hotels, many of which looked better but for all the five days we stayed, this was the only one which had the 'No Vacancies' board.

title: Good - pleasant stay
text: The hotel is in good location, easy to find. Overall is clean, good wifi, friendly staffs and helpful. Breakfast here is all sources of packed, which is ok and more convenient for us. But as we stayed here for 8 nights, it would be better if the hotel could change for something else for some days. We love our stay at St. George hotel.

title: Nice stay, helpful staff, great location and reasonable price.
text: Only a short walk from the Paddington station. Great restaurants in the surrounding neighborhood. We had the ground level room, which was large but filled with three single beds. Small bathroom with a tiny shower but everything worked great. The staff was very friendly. We were able to check-in early and they held our luggage after we checked out as we went on a tour before we left London. A cute breakfast was brought to our room each morning. We got a few cereal bars, small juice boxes, and small pastries. Nice way to start the day.

title: Okay budget hotel close to the underground / train station Paddington
text: The hotel is located close to Paddington station, just few minutes walk away. It is situated in a calm square and as my room faced the square there was no issue with noise during the nights. It is also a shortish walk away from Hyde Park and Oxford street. There is no lift and the stairs are usual old english narrow stairs so if you have a lot of luggage be aware of this. My room was on the fourth floor, it was clean enough (my standard is quite high and I would have preferred it cleaner, but nothing grose). The room itself was small, but okay for few nights alone. The bed was a double and took most of the space with a small table, kettle and tv. The adjoining bathroom was small also, but not so small that you could not move, however getting to the bathroom was a bit tricky as the door opened out into the room and the space between table and chair and the door was non-existent. The room and hotel itself would need a facelift as it is showing clear marks of wear and tear, but then again you are not checking into a five star hotel. The reception was friendly and polite, both people I met, a older man and a younger woman, both happy to help when needed. The breakfast, which was included in the price (75 pounds for two nights), was not anything special. It was brought to your room at the time you requested and was composed of can fruit, processed cereal bars and croissants, few bread rolls with butter, jam, nutella and cheese. Coffee, tea and hot chocolate bags were already provided in the room non-stop. It kept hunger abay until lunch and that is the point. I would recommend the hotel for those looking for a budget hotel in London and understanding that they get what they pay for. Basic accommodation that is fairly priced.

title: Noisy & needs a bit of TLC
text: Hotel is in a great location, 5 mins walk from Paddington station. Unfortunately, because it's so close, if you get a basement floor (we had room 2), you will hear the tube go through every ~5 minutes. Obviously nothing they can do about it, just a warning as it will disrupt your sleep - the tube runs from about 5.30am-midnight. The room itself was clean, however needed a bit of work - the shower floor was cracked, as were some of the floor tiles, the sealant was peeling, and the shower head attachment was broken so it wouldn't stay up, making washing a bit tricky. Also the bathroom itself was really small, and the toilet area was, shall we say, a little cramped. However, we could see they were doing a lot of work - paint pots and wood all over the place, so I would assume it's in the process of a bit of a sparkle. It was also surprisingly warm at the end of January (we slept without duvet's due to the heat), so is probably extremely hot in summer. Service was however good. Simple check in/check out, and breakfast arrived dead on specified time of 8am, and the room was clean & tidy. Can't fault them for that. Also of note is that we got it at a discount rate on laterooms of £47 per night. Even with London prices, simply because of the noise, not sure if it's worth more than that. Unfortunately, sorry to say, it's not something that can be fixed.

title: Grotty and in need of a duster!!!!
text: We stayed here for one night! The room we were given was on the top floor which was like climbing a mountain the stairs are so steep and the staircase was covered in dust, so they changed our room straight way it was room 5 this was right next door to the reception this was a tiny cupboard with a computer and a booking book, the lobby ( this is the hallway into the hotel and rooms ) was tiny and diry. The room was falling to bits ply wood furniture that looked like it could fall down. Mould on the shower curtain, stains on the duvet cover dust everywhere and the windows do not shut. Then the breakfast that you get at 8 am regardless weather you want it at that time, this includes muffins, aqua water, and a pastry, some crackers. Please be warned do not stay here if it can be avoided !! Oh yes and the tube runs directly under the hotel and rock the floors.

title: If you just want a bed and base to sight see from then it is okay.
text: My boyfriend and I stayed 3 nights at a cost of £200.00 .. The undergound is 5 mins walk away and lots of restaurants and shops all around, so great location. Room was tiny, a bit like,' Harry Potters cupboard under the stairs' and quite shabby, though we did have a tv and fridge and tea & kettle. Toilet & shower were clean. No wardrobe just hang clothes on rail from ceiling. Did get bitten by some insect, so be warned. If you are used to roughing it and know you won't spend much time there you may be ok. All in all quite grotty but bearable.

title: Cramped, but cute!
text: My boyfriend and I stayed in room 3, on the lowest floor. Upon checking in, we found the guy at the desk to be super friendly, allowing us to leave our bags, since we had arrived a little too early and the room wasn't quite ready for us. There was no judgement whatsoever on the fact that we are a same sex couple. The room itself was very small, but cozy, clean and tidy. We had a particular chuckle at the fact that the number of lights was seriously disproportionate to the size of the room - one of which had three switches that needed to be flicked in the correct order to work properly (which was great fun! It reminded me of the original Resident Evil game). The hotel as a whole was well maintained. I've noticed a lot of the reviews complaining that it is dingy and untidy, but it's an old Georgian building, not a fancy modern hotel... And for £55 a night, what are you expecting, the Ritz? I'd say you get what you pay for, but for London, you actually get more. Breakfast is delivered to your door, which is a nice touch. When I returned to the desk to obtain the WiFi password, the gentleman was on the phone (no problem there, I know how tedious these jobs can be, especially midweek), but the moment I walked in, he immediately stopped his conversation and dealt with my request. I really admire that. Overall, very satisfied. It could have been a lot worse. The reviews had worried me slightly, but I imagine that a lot of the poorer comments here are from snooty snobs who just want to complain.

title: Completelly satisfied
text: We stayed there for 3 nights. Our room was very big and comfortable, the room itself and the bathroom were both very clean. The breakfast (served on demand at 8, 8.30 or 9 o'clock) was decent for the price paid. The location of the hotel is perfect very close to Paddigton station and to Hyde Park. The young people managing the hotel were very helpful (they even gave us a power adaptor for charging our phones) and nice. There is though no elevator and the stairs are narrow. There wass also very strong free wifi all over the hotel and therefore in the rooms!The price was completely reasonable for London! We would definately choose it again!

title: Had a fab time.
text: When I booked this hotel I was a little concerned as it cost less than £200 for 2 people for 3 nights. However on arrival we were made very welcome. The place is dated but had everything we needed. Bed was clean and comfortable the room was cosy and warm and everything we needed including tea and coffee in abundance, hairdryer even a fan for if the room got too hot. Shower room was small but had everything in there we needed. Breakfast was continental brought to the room and had a selection of fresh rolls cheese and jams fruit juice and fruit all in all for the cost We could not have asked for more and would definitely stay here again.

title: Almost walked away
text: Looks lovely from outside. When you enter, reception is a cubby nook. No lift. We were given room on ground floor right next to office. Room was fitted with 2 small double beds with just enough room to walk around beds. Bathroom was like a cramped plastic cupboard you'd find in a old caravan. Very high ceiling with no windows. Very thin wall could hear conversations from reception, which meant we were concious & resorted to whispering. Underground train noise wasn't a major issue but can be heard. Very dated. Having said that it was clean & near paddington station for our 1 night stay. We opted not to stay for breakfast but was told they deliver it to rooms only (no dining room).

title: Small room but great value
text: I booked a single room for together four nights. Number 7, right on the first floor. It was very small. 1.5 meter by 3 meter. But it had everything in it. Bed, closet, two small cabinets, fridge, sink, television, electric heater and a hair dryer. I suspected to have trouble sleeping because of the noise in the hallway. Also that the toilet was right next to my room worried me but I didn't hear a thing actually. The shared toilet and bathroom were clean and nice. It was like a hostel but more private. Also Paddington station was around the corner, which was very convenient. The staff is also very relaxed and helpfull. If you're on a budget and just in London for a few nights by yourself it's perfect. Just don't expect a luxurious hotel.

title: Not that bad
text: Ok so if you are after somewhere nice don't stay here! I stayed in a single basic room. The room was small but I was only after a cheap bed for the night. The room was cleanish, not spotless but probably no more dust than on some of my shelves at home. The toilet was next to my room, again sink and toilet clean but the floor could do with a good with some proper cleaning. The shower on the next floor up on the other hand wasn't so clean! The room had TV, wi-fi, a kettle and fridge. The location 5mins from Paddington is ideal. I paid £34 for a single room so basically you get what you pay for and I was expecting worse for that price in central London. I wouldn't stay here if you intend to spend much time at the hotel but if you want a cheap bed for a night or two and are not too fussy it does the job. Breakfast was brought on a tray to the room. I'd read the reviews so I knew what to expect. Again you get what you pay for!

title: nice personal, good bed, poor breakfast, a little noisy
text: 1.Personal was nice 2.Location is brilliant 3.Cleanless is great 4.My room was on -1 floor, near Paddington station, I did not pay much attention to the sound sometimes from trains, especially at night, but person with insomnia, it could be real disturbance 5.breakfast was poor

title: Good location, backpackers 'hotel'
text: I stayed for one night and expected a basic hotel as all we wanted was a place to sleep. We were given a room on the ground floor with a view into what seemed to be the utility closet. Tube could be felt and heard quite loudly at night and in turn will keep you awake. Breakfast was a tray consisting of a carton of orange juice a stale breadroll and a packaged danish which was handed in the door in the morning (the door knob could be reached from the bed as the room was so small). You are paying for location and nothing else.

title: Location
text: Great location right near tube ,big red bus , restaurants , bars and shops . Staff was always friendly and willing to help , room was clean, bed was very comfy . Would stay there again . Bathroom could be a bit cramped for a larger person .

title: Quite shabby
text: We had a five bed room. The room was ok for up to three beds. There were no room for the luggage, no wardrobe. We had to put our bags under the table. A small bathroom with a bad shower. Breakfast was served in the room, since there was no Lobby or restaurant. The carpets were old and needed to be replaced. The staff was friendly though. Not worth the price! You'd better choose a hostel.

title: This hotel should be closed down!
text: The hotel is terrible,its very old,dirty and disgusting.Rooms are awful.We arrived late with our 2 year old,I booked double room with en suite and a cot for the baby.The room was so small,like the size of a normal bathroom,we couldn't fit a cot in so the baby slept on the floor.It was so old and dirty.Next day we were moved to a room with 2 double beds.In this room we found RODENT CATCHER under the bed with mice poo on the floor.Curtains were black from dirt.It was just awful.I will never return here,we are not picky travellers and we usually book low budget hotels but this was just terrible.Only nice thing about it was the lady that checks people in and brings breakfast.

title: Adequate
text: Close to Paddington Station and bus transportation. Located in Norfolk Sq with pleasant gardens. Staff helpful and pleasant. Good breakfast service. No elevato, 80 steps to top floor!!! Overall, good value

title: London Horror Tour
text: A dump. This should be included in the London Horror tour. I have no words to describe how bad this was. Admitedly, we didn't see any living sentient beings apart from the colonies of fungus and plants growing under the beds, but the smell of dust and decay was enough to discourage any mammal from going inside. It didn't discourage us though, as we slept for 4 nights in this madhouse. The beds were not that bad, but the bathrooms... Oh god, the bathrooms, I still have nightmares about the state of the bathrooms. And i'm talking about the ones "on suite". The communitary ones are the paradigm of filth and decay, without any running water. The staff is lazy, it took us days to get them to bring us a couple of cups, to stop having to drink our coffee from the kettle, and we had to fetch some toilet paper ourselves before they thought of giving us some. There were holes in the walls and ceiling, filled with old newspapers, and holes in the bathroom ceiling, filled with old reeking towels. The horror, the horror of it, Oh God. Please stay away from this, run and never look back.

title: Good location
text: This hotel on good location, 5 minutes walk to Paddington train station. Easy to travel in london by tube and go to other city by national rail service. The room is small as normal budget room. No lift. No comments for other services.

title: Disappoint in Abundance
text: So I arrived on a Saturday morning, to be greeted by a grotty, worn reception. The receptionist was more occupied with texting than with checking in guests, and between sending snapchats and talking with his colleagues, I got my keys. Up 84 stairs to room number 18 I went, and was greeted by this smell. An indescribable odour of stake takeway mixed with taxi driver sweat and febreeze. "I'll just pop into the shower and freshen up" I thought, as I picked up a clean, albeit rough towel off the bed. Well! Let me tell you, the shower was not dissimilar to being very lightly spat on from a great height. Water pressure didn't enter the equation, nor did temperature. Ice cold, like a mass produced beer. As a gentleman of 5' 11", I found the beds to be horizontally challenging, as my feet dangled above the mottled carpet, while enjoying stunning views of the yellowing, stained patchwork I called a ceiling. Checkout wasn't a thing. Keys were handed in, I was vaguely acknowledged as a human being and I left, with a rather unfair dent in my wallet. Wholly unimpressed.

title: nice little hotel
text: Is not terrible like people say, rooms are little, shower is very good and you have hot water all day, if you want new bed linen and towels you can ask for . We was on 3rd floor but that is good for form :) ... you can`t ask more for this price, but make sure you get more than you pay if you look price of other hotels. In any case you go to the London to enjoy in the city, not to spending your time in hotel.

title: Nice Hotel!
text: Me and my boyfriend stayed here on a city break to London. We arrived in at about 12 o'clock which was earlier than our set check in time. The woman behind the desk was lovely, and allowed us to check in early, giving us our room keys and WiFi code right away. We were given room 3 on the lower ground, the stairs were a little steep but they weren't annoying. Our room was fine, I was expecting a lot worse after reading some of the reviews on here. The room was clean and the bathroom looked brand new. We were given a kettle, two cups and a television. All of which worked perfectly. The only problem we had the room was that the bed was slightly uncomfortable, and quite hard to lie on, but it was only a minor problem. You could also hear the trains rattling the room, but again it never really annoyed us as we were only in the room to sleep. The breakfast was nothing special. Two plain baps and jam, some yogurts and a couple of fruit pots, breakfast elsewhere would be better. And to quote the receptionist whom helped me get into the hotel in the first place, after a few seconds of confusion... "OPEN DOOR NOW!"

title: Even helpful staff can't make up for this unsanitary hotel
text: Having read the reviews I was expecting a below standard hotel but this hotel is quite extraordinary. I am shocked that it is allowed to operate as not piece of electrical equipment had a current PAT certificate, there were wires all over the place and it was beyond dirty. The first room we were shown was a large single bed stuck into a nook so that 3 sides were against walls, I said that my husband and I could not fit in the bed. In fairness to the staff we were moved immediately to a quad room. The hotel is really noisy there were children running up and down the stairs until after 3 o-clock in the morning and then at 6.30 the tubes start up again and everything in the room shakes (this is obviously not the hotels fault). The duvet consisted of what appeared to be roofing insulation and eve then it was only about 2 foot long so that your feet were cold. I am not even going to bother to talk about the breakfast. I would have to be in dire straits to stay in this establishment again. I would never take a child there as the wiring and electrics are death traps.

title: Not to be considered.
text: I recently stayed at St George Hotel on Norfolk Square, and I wouldn't recommend anyone to consider staying there. 1) Rooms are dusty and dirty. All you need to do is check under the bed searching for a lost item and you will discover a decade-old accumulation of dust and dirt. 2) Breakfast is institutional and industrialised. Juice is fake, muffin is old, nothing amusing or interesting. 3) The place is not well-ventilated, so you`re constantly smelling wet rugs...

title: One night stay
text: Was a bit wary after reading some of the other reviews but stayed in a small single and it was fine. It was a walk up and the tv didn’t really work, but the wifi was strong and the bed was clean with fresh linens on a seemingly new mattress. The bathroom smelled faintly of bleach and didn’t have hot water the afternoon I checked in, but it was fixed by the evening. They deliver a tray of packaged goods at @8am to be consumed with the tea and coffee that can be made in-room. This is explained when you check-in. Check-in/out itself was quick. All staff were professional and some of the cleaning guys were quite friendly and genial. Location was really convenient for Paddington station. For the price paid, no complaints.

title: Two out of five but still a valid option for a short stay
text: Only two out of five because of the cleanliness, maintenance, service, and quality of sleep. The poor maintenance, quality of furniture and the general cleanliness takes quite a bit of the appeal away from this Victorian building, not only the communal area, but also the rooms themselves. As said in many others reviews, there aren’t any lifts in the hotel so if you’re given a room on the last floor (as in my case) you’ll be testing your strength while walking up those steep steps dragging your luggage behind you. After that, you may feel like Rocky Balboa at the top of those stairs. The room was just OK. No wardrobe, but enough hangers to keep clothes in a specific corner. The mattresses were thick and very good. Little and old TV. Bathroom with regular shower and basic amenities, more light would have been appreciated. Quality of sleep. We heard a continuous humming from the very moment we went to bed that must have come from an air-con or similar. It was annoying in the beginning but in the end it didn’t take a long time for us to fall asleep. Of course, that’s because we don’t have many problems falling sleep, it might not be your case. Breakfast. It consisted of a good selection of bread with butter and jams, biscuits, fruit, yoghurt, juice (mmyeah, not high-quality, let’s say) enough not to be able to finish it all. The down side was that we had to have it in the room after they had left the trays on the floor at the door at 8am. At least we were told they would do that when we checked in. We prepared the hot beverages with the kettle provided. At this point you’ll probably be wondering why this hotel is still a valid option. Well, they offer bargain rooms, and staying in an en-suite room at a central hotel in London (just across the way from St. Pancras station and near Marble Arch/Oxford street) for £40 is something to be seriously considered.

title: A dump!
text: This hotel was last cleaned in 1974! If you have no other place to stay in London and this is the only place availale, then I would suggest you sleep in Trafalger Square or under Westminister Bridge. I was not able to check-in until 5pm as my room was not cleaned. After gaining access to my room, I noticed that not a lot of effort was taken to clean the room. I stayed there for 5 night (I had pre-paid so unfortunately I could not escape early). My room was not cleaned and towels were not changed for the duration of my stay. The room smelt like and ashtray - I had to buy air-freshner to try and get the stench out. Breakfast (if you could call it that) was supposed to be delivered at 7:30am. On the first morning it did not arrive until 8:30am on the second day it arrived at 9am and then for the remainder of my stay, it didn't arrive at all (this was actually a blessing). Luckily I found some bleach in the hallway on my second day - so I cleaned my bathroom - only the second clean since 1974. There was a tv in the room, but no reception. Please, do yourself a favour and don't stay here.

title: Horrible!!!!!! Stay away!!!
text: There are not enough words in the English language to explain how horrible this hotel was. The pictures on the web site are of a hotel, but certainly not St.Georges. We arrived at noon. We had booked a double-Room with a bath-room. First impression: Filthy. Both the "hotel" and the manager. The manager took us into his "office", a dark little hole in the wall, with two beds in the middle of the room, dirty dishes from a week ago on the table. We went up to our room, which had not been cleaned. EVER!!! The so-called double bed hardly had enough room for two people. No bath-room, that was down the hall. Stay away from this place. We found another hotel, which cost us 20£ more, but was clean and had a bathroom.

title: As expected after reading previous reviews...
text: We chose this hotel for the location, and went in to it knowing there was no elevator. The walk-up wasn't so bad if you take it by itself, but after a day being out and about in the city, trudging up the narrow Victorian stairs was not fun. The staff was friendly and accommodating, but the room was tiny. Don't get me wrong, we knew it would be small when we booked the room, but my hubby and I had to take turns getting dressed in the "vestibule" because it was the only place in the room with any space. You could barely stand between the bed and the counter top that held the TV and electric water heater. Breakfast was delivered to our door every morning (thank God for not having to go up and down any stairs for food!), but was all pre-packaged. Chocolate chip muffins, "orange juice", and a few other things that at least was enough to take the edge off before wandering out to a coffee shop. Overall, the St. George was okay. Nothing spectacular, but nothing I would necessarily recommend to my friends. I wouldn't warn them AWAY, but I'm not sure I would encourage a stay either.

title: Good price and position, forget all the rest
text: The few good things: really good price for London and quite central, well served zone. Really unclean, stained bed linen, found some food belonging to previous guests in a drawer. Really, really hot, we had to spend the night with wide open windows. No lift and really narrow and steep stairs. A camping toilet box, made in plastic, mounted inside of the room. Breakfast = they knock at your door and lay a tray of low quality food on dirty moquette just outside of the room.

title: Great location, a lot of potential, but somewhat poor execution
text: I must start by pointing out that the location is excellent : 150 m from the Paddington Station, in a quiet neighborhood, next to a Central Line tube stop. The room was really tiny : barely enough free space to put my suitcase into. But it was clean and perfectly fit for the purpose of getting some sleep before an early departure. Great value for the money ! Don't expect to get any extras through : there was a tea and coffee selection inside the room, but nothing to stir them with. So barely useful. The disappointments were that there was no lift and the staircase was really narrow, thus presenting significant difficulties to people traveling with heavy luggage. And there was no hot water in the shower when I was about to leave for my 5am train.

title: The room was what I expected
text: The room was small, but it was the cheapest room in the hotel. Clean and tidy is all I expect when I pay that much. Hotel wasn't noisy at all. Had breakfast at Paddington Station which is only round the corner.

title: Cheap, tiny rooms, awful breakfast
text: We stayed here for a couple of nights in March as it was close to Hyde Park and easy to get around. Value for money as it was cheap but the room was very cramped however it was clean enough. Breakfast was sugary packaged food. Would probably not stay here again

title: πολύ καλο!!!!
text: answering to the previous reviews, i think that you get much more regarding the money you pay. i've been there twice. the receptionist was very polite and helpful. it was clean and quite. very good location and of course very cheap. so dont be mean people, you get what you pay for!

title: Going Back Next Year
text: The Room We Stayed Stayed In Wasn't as back as a lot of these reviews are making out. We stayed in room 21 which had 3 single beds & 1 double, Which was perfect for us as most the Big Chains (Premier inn, Travel Inn & Holiday inn) wouldn't allow more than 3 people in one room. This hotel is in the perfect location for getting round london. We walked from the hotel to the london eye in about an hour with loads of stopping for tourist attractions along the way (Buckingham Palace, Parliament, and a few cathedrals). And It Was easy to Catch a cab from the hotel, most the time from the front door. And Most places We Took A Cab Too Cost Around Or Under £10. The Room Wasn't bad, Wasn't 5 start luxury but as we'd read the reviews before we came we knew what standard to expect. I'd taken air freshener with me but didn't really need to use it, just the bathroom smelt strongly of bleach, which was in a way quite comforting. The furniture was mostly broken but it didn't affect us as we didn't really spend a lot of time in the room. The Breakfast Was Well presented Although Non of it was to are taste, A Very continental Breakfast, To European For us. But Wasn't a big deal As there was plenty to eat elsewhere. The Gentleman At the front desk was lovely, as even though we didn't really speak to him much was probably the reason we all liked the hotel so much, he let us keep our bags in the hotel after we checked out as we weren't getting the train home for several hours. He was sat in his reception 24 hours a day. When We Left & Came Even If It was a ridiculous time in the morning. We were on the top floor & We did Have to carry our bags up a million flights of stair ( Though Some Guy help me with mine) but i was good exercise & We all laughed at how unfit. As i didn't see any other room i can only give you our experience, i might not stay there as a family or couple but as a traveler or like us 18/19 year old girls (Or Boys) it was good enough for what we needed it for.

title: Not the place I would stay again
text: The hotel wasn't hard to find... But it was not much for the price that we payed for... We booked double room and when we arrived the man at the reception desk wasn't expecting us. Then we got a room for four people but we paid the price for a double room. The room was small even for two of us. There was a TV in the room, but with only a few programs. The room anyway wasn't much at all. The bathroom (if I can named it like that) was just made all of plastic from one piece. The stairs was really bad...And the thing that I remember the most is the smell of the whole hotel. I didn't like it at all... Anyway the rooms were celan, the breakfast was served in the room. NOthing fancy just few pieces of bread, marmelade, butter and yoghurt.. I wouldn't like to know where they are making the breakfast... If I'm going to London some other time, I wold sleep somwhere else.. Definitly...

title: Tonys mustache 5 reeten
text: For the price we paid, this is a well worth place. Yes it's small, it's no 5 star breakfast but if you are looking for that you need to go elsewhere and pay a lot more. With other words. You get your money's worth here. Also Tony has a great 'stache.

title: Awful
text: Booked into this hotel whilst working in London doing full days heavy construction. On arrival asked what time breakfast was served... only to be told 7am to meet my needs as a worker was too early, therefore breakfast was offered in the form of a packet of biscuits given to me in my room before bed!. Not impressed, on further inspection room was dirty, small and not cared for. TV was above my head over the pillow end of the bed, not much thought given there then!. Paid cancellation fee of £79 to get out and find somewhare clean and comfortable...ouch. Do not stay here, dirty, tired, minimum effort... I would say trying to max profit over consideration over care of guests. YUK

title: Not that bad!
text: After reading the sole post on this hotel, I figured I'd better add my 2-pence worth. Me, my wife, and two grown children stayed at Tonys during July 2004. It was not great, but it was adequate. We had a quad at the front on the first floor, overlooking the square, with a new, modular bathroom. No odors or similar problems in our room. We were there for 3 nights, and yes - sheets were not changed. Like many budget hotels in London, it is old, but we found it to be clean. Sorry to hear about the rats

title: good value for money
text: stayed at Tonys house hotel for one night, Hotel is located 1 minute walk from paddington tube station, all local ammenities close by - shops pubs, fast food etc. we phoned to check in early and the man on reception said this was ok so checked in at 11am. Hotel was fine, we stayed in the quad room which had 1 double bed and 2 single beds, small shower/toilet, tv and tea making facilities. only paid £72 which we think was very cheap for london and after all we only used the hotel to sleep there. there was an annoying water dripping noise, which could be heard all night and everytime you turned over the beds sounded like they were going to break however, overall this place was fine for a night or 2 and would definitely stay there again.

title: Stay away
text: Similar to everyone else's reviews... Gross prepackaged breakfast. Nice location. The worst thing was the shower. Either freezing cold or scalding hot. Pretty grungy and scummy bathroom and bedroom. 15 yr old tv didn't even work. Not worth the savings. Pay a little more and go to another hotel. We stayed in hostels all over Ireland and the UK. This was the worst.

title: Shocking place
text: What an awful place to stay, just dont do it, dont book you will be sorry!! everything nasty said about this place is true!! There is no reception just a guy sitting in a cupboard! Dont do it! dont book! dont book!

title: Poor Hotel
text: Would definately not recommend this place to stay. Definately not a hotel. Was taken to a second hotel 5 mins away! by reception person from this hotel. Room had 3 beds clean sheets, clean bathroom and clean towels, That was it ! Carpet was dirty, no furniture nowhere to put anything,asked for a hairdryer it was unsafe. Underground could be heard all night. BIG mistake don't go here.

title: For the price I've paid...
text: Well, I wasn't thinking about to make a review about it but then I saw a lot of people saying horrible things about this place, so here's a brake down: - The location is incredibly great, 2 mins walk from Paddington station and near a lot of places to eat and 10 mins walk from the Hyde Park

title: Where to begin.....
text: My husband and I were moved here after originally booking the metro hotel. We were told there was a problem with our room and were moved. very annoying and customer service was non existent. The room was small and the carpets were dirty. The drain in the shower was blocked, and when we explained the problem to staff we were told he was to busy. I feel we were completely ripped off and the manager wasn't interested in the slightest. Paddington is a lovely place and a great location but do your self a favour do not book this place!!!

title: embarrasing
text: This hotel was grubby, rooms very small. Breakfast was cereal bars and other pre-packed food, on a tray! Please check beds!!! The so called bathroom was a combined unit at the end of the beds. The 24hr reception was non existent, there was a note stuck on door saying it was his birthday.

title: this is by far one of the worst, "hotels"
text: this is by far the smelliest dirtiest, hotels in London! do NOT, book a room here! the rooms have rats, and the sheets are never changed

title: Good budget hotel.
text: five flights of stairs to the third floor, our fault , should have checked if they had a lift.. the guy who booked us in carried our cases for us. It was Very budget ! But the beds were comfortable and clean, And we had a Fridge 😀 breakfast was delivered to your room , a selection of goodies in a basket outside the door. .

title: Visited for the Royal Wedding
text: Originally booked small single room. Reviews werent great as bathroom on different level so paid for ensuited room which was on 4th floor. Nothing to write home about very small room. Tight fit. Every inch was tight including the bathroom. Would only recommend one person as 2 people would be on top of each other. However. It served my need as I was a solo traveller. It was very clean. And house keep was very neat tidy and attentative to detail. Delivered breakfast was ample and plentiful. Location location close to everthing. So. I have to rate this as very good as it ticked all the boxes in terms of price and location. Staff on desk friendly enough. Stairs were a work out but hey. The view from the window and nice balmy nights to leave open..made up for it... thanks Tonys House..

title: NOT RECOMMENDED
text: We arrived late and staff woke up to let us in.. rate was different, more expensive than what we had booked. ( Not due to exchange but the actual rate in pounds) . We stayed on the 1st floor, luggage did not fit through the door as the door to the room was below average size. The room was ridiculously small, no place to put luggage. We had to place the luggage on the bed and sleep with it as there was barely any floor space.. There is a closet but you could not access it due to a smalll table which held kettle, coffee and tea items. One single bed nuzzled between 2 walls right under the window which even closed had an awful draft. Double bed sheets were stained and dirty. Bed spread dirty.. Bathroom is a good size, but a large stain on the floor which looked like blood. Toilet did not flush properly and took a good 10 min or so to fill the bowl. Pressure was decent in the shower, but shower base did not look like he had been cleaned. Breakfast, fake croissants, cookies, yogurt and one piece of fresh bread with cheese delivered to your room.. Too small, smelly, bedding gross.. the only positive thing is the location 2 min walk from Paddington.

title: Stay away from basement
text: Beware of loud noise and trembling in the rooms in the basement because of metro. Not suitable for sleeping. Other rooms not clean bedding and shower smells musty of the fungi. The hotel has no breakfast room. Breakfast is served in the room.

title: Lovely budget hotel
text: Just stayed at this hotel for 1 night on sat the 15 th sept, stayed in the quad room at 94 pounds a night with breakfast,staff could not do enough for us and I would stay there again. Rooms are small but has all you need a fridge kettle,tea coffe, hair dryer, shower gel etc. beds where clean and overall a lovely stay for a great price. Really close to padding ton station.

title: Básico
text: Basic ammenities, no elevator (our room was on the 4th floor) - good internet. No hair conditioner, just shampoo. Good location, close to the metro station. Very small rooms, very little light in the bathroom, which by the way, smelled of cigaretes. Someone was smoking there.

title: Faulty Towers
text: Thank God it was just an over night Stay we as Grandparents took our four grandchildren and our Two daughters and husbands to Winter wonderland for the weekend looked for a Hotel near to the event and Tony’s House Came up the location was about a twenty minute walk to Hyde Park not two bad but Hotel well defiantly a 2 star, room was like a broom cupboard awful furniture uncomfortable bed much to small for a double room ,shower room if you were bigger than a size 14 no chance, breakfast was bought to your room in a small basket everything was value orange juice yogurt and dry bread rolls such a shame as not a bad area and the two staff were pleasant enough. no lift three floors very dated very noisy doors slamming . Summing up will look else where next time .but I surpose you get what you pay for .

title: Tony's House Hotel
text: Tony's House Hotel, is a very good value for money hotel, Tony the manager/host/owner is a very pleasant guy who does his best to make your stay enjoyable. The location of the hotel is excellent, the breakfasts are served room service style which is a big plus. I would certainly stay there again.

title: Good stay!
text: The location is good if you want to go to the airport easily, just 15 minutes with airport express. The underground station is near but it will take you a while to the tourist attractions. Restaurants open till late around the corners. I stayed in a single room, simple furniture but with everything I need. I had to go downstairs to use toilet, but there is a shower & washbasin in my room. The room is clean and cozy. Bed is very comfortable. Anyway it's great value for money!

title: Quick stay
text: Had a quick stay over. Bloody lovely staff, bed was comfy, tv worked and shower was hot in the morning.... oh and there was decent coffee. What more could you want! Didn’t experience the breakfast but I’m sure it’s great! Will definitely stay again! James x

title: Weird place
text: Nobody inside when you arrive, no reception, poor maintenance and expired yogurts in your breakfast. Location was good. Small rooms and minibars have no food inside, not even plugged in. Price was ok but I did not expect such this bad experience I had.

title: Brilliant kids loved it
text: What can I say it's perfect location, tube is just round the corner, canal with places to eat and drink 5mins walk. The hotel was clean a little tight for 2 adult and 3 little kids and a bit out dated but what can you ask for for the price, we all got a bed each. the staff was very friendly and didn't seem to mind my 3 loud boys, plus the breakfast to your room was a big hit with the kids they loved it. I had a problem with hairdryer but sorted out straight away lol x the only big thing that was wrong in our room was we had the shower that had a little leak every time we took a shower but it didn't spoil our trip at all. It's great value for money and we will deffo be going again

title: Is it a hotel or mice trap???
text: My toilet in Athens is bigger than the room we had stay for 5 nights.And i don't live in Buckingham palace!!! The rooms were so small that we had to move our buggages in order to leave the room! The breakfast was tragic...A disc full of plastic food! The best thing about the hotel was its location.Perfect to discover London.Nothing more!

title: One Word Disgusting.
text: Myself and 3 of my friends headed to london for 2 nights we had booked this hotel 2 weeks before. We were all really excited photos of the hotel looked good and the location looked lovely . We arrived here at around 1pm to our shock went in to check in and there was a man sitting in the reception drinking a can of guiness (we were disgusted) we went on to fully check in and he told us that there was a mistake with our booking and they had to move us the next day to their sister hotel, to be honest we wernt quite happy about that but we agreed on it on top of all that the man was very sleezy and not at all professional. Because we had already paid for the hotel we checked in anyway, got our keys and we went to our room, the room was up the top story, we are all fairly small girls and could barely fit up the stairtcase it was that small. when we got to the room we were just horrified it was horrible. Our bed sheets were dirty the room smell was just disgusting, our ensuite was a joke you could barely stand inside the door and close the door after you.. there was no sucure lock on the door. Over all the room was horrible and not what we had seen in pictures. We are all 21 and we did not feel safe in this accommadation at all. We got our bags and got out of there as quick as we could. we were lucky enough to find a lovely hotel and a reliable hotel just one street up 'Days Inn' non expensive and to be honest it was a 'hotel' unlike Tony's. i would highly recommend people not to go to this hotel it is horrible and in my opinion not a safe.

title: Great friendly hotel
text: Our room was tidy and breakfast in the room was included. Staff were very keen to help and went out if their way to advise us on transport and places of interest. Location is fantastic - it's 1 minute to Paddington station. Located in a green square. We had a kettle, TV, hairdryer and an ironing board in the room and the Wi-Fi was fast.

title: holiday in a shoe box
text: When we arrived the reception was in a broom cupboard, under the stairs and that set the rest up. Every inch of space is set to make money. The room was tiny small custom bed small wardrobe and a full size fridge. The shower sink and toilet completed our room, the sink being so small you could not fill the kettle. Our first night was disrupted by other very noisy guests and in the morning same again. The continental breakfast was akin to a childs lunch. Disruption the second night again every noise is greatly amplified. Almost forgot the train noise. We had a few issues which we raised with the duty manager, he quickly rectified what he could great effort. Overall cleanliness does not appear to be a priority. Cheap accomodation and no frills

title: Look somewhere else
text: Tiny room. Stained mattress. Dirty. Continental breakfast advertised! It was more like a kids snack pack. As there wasn't even room for a a chair it was difficult to eat even if you wanted too. If can afford something better, don't book this one. Location isn't too bad.

title: Good value for money
text: I've been here a few times. It's certainly not as bad as people seem to suggest. The rooms aren't the greatest, i.e. they are fairly run down. But the staff are friendly and helpful, and the location is excellent. Would stay again.

title: Budget budget - very budget hotel
text: Very small hotel with very small rooms. No lift even for the 5th floor - very narrow stair case Room not available at the stipulated time due to delay in cleaning Suffocating room - No air flow - very hot inside with outside temperatures of around 18C. Very good location though, lots of restaurants close by and Paddington station is 2min walk Free wifi is of very poor signal strength - very rarely got connected

title: Never book there
text: I am an owner of a hotel in Paris and I usually do not say bad things about my fellas but if you get a chance, book elsewhere. DO NOT BOOK THERE : We booked a double room online. What happened is that on the day we got there, the staff told us all the rooms were sold out so they took us to another nearby hotel called 'Metro Hotel'. The double ensuite hotel room we booked for 90 euros per night turned out to be an awful single room in which the hotel added an extra single bed to make it a twin room (the bed was not even against a wall... was just sitting in the middle of the room). The mattresses were as old as my grandma and we could almost hit the ground when we sat on them. The room was all dusty... If you do not want to spend a whole day trying to find another hotel in London? NEVER BOOK THERE IN THE FIRST PLACE

title: Could be worse.....but could be better!
text: We stayed here for 2 nights towards the end of August 2011. From the outside the hotel looks very good, however, once through the front door you realise that the place is in desperate need of a makeover. We had a family room with 1 double and 3 single beds. The beds were very thin and the double was about the size of an average single bed. Behind 2 of the beds we found vermin boxes with poison in, and worryingly one where the poison had disappeared. However, the beds were comfy and all the bed linen and towels were clean. Breakfast was delivered to outside the room at the time we asked for it. Breakfast is basically a tray of cartons of fruit juice, yoghurts, croissants, bred rolls, cheese and preserves. All in all breakfast was ok. The location of the hotel is excellent as it is only a 1 minute walk from Paddington tube and rail station which are on Praed Street which had plenty of places to eat. Overall an average stay but you get what you pay for and considering the location this was very cheap. On a final note we only saw the owner twice, on both occasions he was stood out the front on the steps drinking from a can of special brew!

title: Do not bother.
text: Booked 2 double rooms via last minute. My friend changed one of the doubles to a twin and was given the ok. Arrived and all we wanted to do was check in,get ready and go off out to a gig we have come up for.The bloke looked on his puter for a while,then asked for payment,rudely. Then told us the rooms were "next door",yup,up around the corner. Then got told there was only one double there.I just found him rude. He went off to phone his manager in Greece,was gone for ages. My friend went to sort out as I was getting very angry. Long and short,the other hotel did have our rooms but chap on the desk gave it away,which I think is all lies. We were then give a family room" a few doors up.Which was a ground floor room filled with 5 single beds and a tiny loo with a shower,no towels. We were in a rush to go the gig so had no choice but to take it. We changed our train tickets the next day so we get home early as we did not want to stay here longer than needed. This was a great shame,as the hotels are in a great spot. I just found the whole set up as dodgy and a rip off,I found the man from Tony`s rude. My friend on the other hand thought he was helpfull and a good chap. I get the feeling they hope people are from abroad and so can just fob them off. Oh and I have been feeling itchy but it could just be all in my mind but would not be surprised at all. I do read reviews on here and try to make up my own mind as people can be fussy. I so agree on this,do not bother.

title: Excellent budget stay
text: Opted to stay here en route to Gatwick as wanted a budget hotel that was clean and value for money. Located 2min from Paddington station in Norfolk Square which is full of hotels Tonys House Hotel gave us just that. We paid £64 for one night with breakfast - which was a selection of yoghurt, bread, cheese, juice and brioche served to our room in a basket. We had teas and coffee makos get facilities plus a fridge in the room so could enjoy a leisurely breakfast before heading out. The room was small and contained a shower. Wardrobe, TV and double bed. Toilets were shared and outside on the lower level. They were well stocked and clean. We were 3 levels up - a lot of stairs and no lift but it was no problem for us. The decor was clean and tidy and the staff who checked us in and served breakfast was very friendly. Situated next to Paddington you can hear the rumbling of the trains but it's not an intrusive noise. There are many bars and restaurants nearby and we ate at Dickens Tavern - a Greene King pub professed to be the longest in London! If you can't handle basic budget hotel facilities, walking up a lot of stairs, shared toilets and are a light sleeper, then Tony's House may not be for you. If however -like us- this doesn't bother you then give Tony's a try. We will be going back for sure.

title: Horrible..Disgusted ...live from the room!!
text: so basically what happened is we checked in at 9pm just went up to the room and at first glance everything seems ok , we went out for a meal and when we came back to settle in the room we just noticed that behind the bed there was a box of mouse killer ( see images) that was already very suspicious for us so we just moved the bed to check what else was behind . There was a huge amount of rat dropping all over, tissues, white stains on the sheets(only god know what it is ) We went to complain and the receptionist, informed us that it is a hotel policy to have the rat poisoning in the room ( never heard of that before!!)..When we asked for the money back, the owner only wanted to give us a refund for 2 night instead of 3 !! We did not expect a 5 star hotel with the money we paid..but this utterly disgusting and not safe! Tony himself, the owner of the hotel, was very rude and did not really care of our complaint and he did not even wanted to speak to us on the phone!! For your own safety do not come to this hotel!!They ruined our holiday!! and we have to stay here for 1 night as now it is 2am!! ...Pray for us.. (16/3/13)

title: very nice hotal, Excellent central location
text: small and cozy hotel, Fair price. Very kindly attitude, A light breakfast Served in the room. Excellent central location. Close to Paddington rail station, Oxford, Hyde Park. Nearby streets are full with restaurants, cafes and bars

title: absolutely awful
text: Cold rolls , cheese spread, jammy doggers yougurt not really a breakfast. on e teabag, kettle didnt work. Springs digging in .Door broke n and not put right as promised. our room was 5 wasnt ready when we got there at 15.30 so offered 2 seperate but no toilet in ours, but they soon had someone else to fill our room. The lad who was there in the morning was half asleep and not helpfull at all, didnt even apologise for any of our pro blems.Never again

title: Great
text: For 3 adults and 2 children the family room was alittle cosy but it was nice we were out all day so only needed somewhere to rest. Very clean. Great location. Staff freindly and helpful. Breakfast to your room. What more could you ask for.

title: Take my word Nightmare !
text: This place as got to be the worse hotel iv ever witnessed in my life ! We had two family rooms which were based in the basement we might as well stayed in the tube station , the noise of the underground was a joke plus are other family room had all the rubbish from the hotel outside there window . The hotel alone was dirty , couldn't tell you when it had last been cleaned . We had no hot water at all in one of are rooms , plus the smell coming from the bathroom was that bad i wouldn't use the shower on my children had to wash them down with cold water . The breakfast they gave us in the morning was all out of date . This place should be shut down . People who can comment on this place and say its lovely are lying .

title: Great place with great value. Will definitely stay here next time in London!
text: I really don't understand the people leaving bad reviews on this hotel, because you get what you pay for and in this case you got way more. We were five girls living in a incredibly small room with five beds squeezed togheter. But who cares? We were in London to se the city, not spend time in the hotel room. We paid £24 each per night which is as cheap as it gets. This hotel gives incredibly value for the money. I have paid a lot more for hotels not nearly as good as this one. The staff was really friendly and helpful, the room and bathroom was clean and neat and the location could not have been any better. It was a 1 minute walk to Paddington station and a 15 minute walk to Oxford Street. They cleaned the room every day, the wifi was good, you had all the facilities you could possibly need plus in the room you had a fridge, kettle and coffee, tea and hot chocolate. They delivered the breakfast to the room in the morning at a time that you chose yourself. The breakfast contained juice, yogurt, bread, croissants, cake and more. All of us was really happy with the hotel and will definitely stay here again next time in London.

title: Wouldn't stay here again
text: I stayed here with my partner for one night in October 2011 whilst going to a concert at the O2. I paid £80 for the room. The square the hotel is on is very nice but we were very disappointed with the hotel. Our room was very very small, the bathroom was in the middle of the room. The bed was terrible. The sheets didn't fit the bed and the pillows felt as if they were stuffed with socks. The breakfast was pretty poor, consisted of muffins, biscuits and bread rolls in wrappers. I wouldn't recommend this hotel. Only good thing is the location. I stayed here because it was cheap and I booked at the last minute but I will not be revisiting this hotel.

title: Real value for money
text: Very comfortable room for a family of five. Just where can you get this sort of value in this location for a large family? Excellent! A continental breakfast brought to your room at the time you wanted. All the toiletries you need, plus a safe, hairdryer, iron and board and a fan in the room. People who write bad reviews need to pay a couple of hundred quid extra and be realistic if you think this bad value! Thanks Tony's House - we had a great stay.

title: The lovely disgusting place
text: Tony's a lovely magic place, we booked 2 rooms and we had a great time! Top moments were the following ones! "Hello Mr Tony, where's placed our room? - It's the one close to my counter, it's door to door, you will have the best wifi coverage inside the hostel! (he really was our neightbour, he slept on the floor indeed) "Excuseme mr Tony, there's no hot water (we awake him at two o'clock in the morning) - Then there's no hot water "But Mr.Tony, we need to have a shower! - It's ok, try using the cold water tap instead of the hot one (it seemed to be some kind of scramble for newcomers) What kind of breakfast will we have mr Tony? Surprise, it's a nice continental breakfast! (actually, next morning we found a stray on the floor and some dort stole the few things that were slighly eatable) We strongly recommend Tony's to the ones who loves the Phantom Manor or want to have a great time!

title: Unratable
text: Disgusted with our booking. Checked out 5 minutes after checking in. Dark, smelly, dirty. Couldn't even open our luggage. Noted packaged breakfasts were left outside several doors. Had to find accommodation elsewhere as room was also up 5 flights of stairs.

title: Great value for money
text: Hi everyone! If you are looking for a cheap place to stay this would be the best one. First of all, the location is perfect! 2 mins from paddington station. The service is very good. The rooms are small but very clean which is rare for super cheap bnb hotels. Breakfast is delivered to the door and is rather more for a sweet tooth but the amount of food is huge which is a great for people like me. I would definitely come back myself and recommend to a friend who is looking for cheap accommodation options :) good luck!

title: What an absolute s**thole
text: Stayed here few weeks back and can honestly say it is the worst place I have ever stayed in, on arrival we were apologised to for the high price £179 for a twin room, I can only assume this was because they knew the room was no where near worth that! We stayed in number 6 right next to the reception and once you open the door the damp mouldy smell hits you, the carpets were covered in iron burns, thick dust, hairs and other bits of mess. The wallpaper was hanging off the walls, I wouldn't even shower in the ensuit bathroom, just didn't want to touch anything in there. The only reason we stayed was because our work commitments went over by a day and this was the only place available, proceeded to go out and get pissed to try and get the thought of having to stay there out of our heads, even contemplated sleeping in the van!

title: British summer time
text: Me and 2 friends stayed here for the weekend on British summer time, on arrival I was told there had been a leak in the triple room we had booked. We was given the option to have a single and double room which we agreed was fine. When we checked in we went to the single room to leave our bags as the double room was not ready. We stayed on 3A, this room was a disgrace, it was unclean and not suitable. Yes there was a bed to sleep in but it was such a small room you could hardly move, there were tea stains on the furniture and the plug sockets were hanging off the wall. Not where I would have liked to sleep. When we went to the double room it was a lot better however was under the understanding that there would be a bathroom in the room, there was only a shower and a sink. Toilets were shared with the whole hotel. Not to mention the heat, it was unbearable and the window in the single room had to be propped open with a remote and the double room no air could get in, made me feel sick. We were also told we could have breakfast in the one room and our friend could join us, they did not provide breakfast for all 3 just the 2 of us and when we explained the situation about the leak, the person on reception had no idea, therefore ringing alarm bells that they had lied and there was no leak they had cocked up! Fuming isn't the word. Due to inconvenience, on arrival we were told we would get a discount on check out, however due to messages not being passed on this was not the case... Definately advise people not to stay here!!!

title: Budget hotel
text: It's exactly what you pay for, budget Hotel, but was perfect for what we wanted. A central Hotel, close to underground, tea coffee facilities, fridge. It was small, but if your out all day how much room do you need? Breakfast was an added bonus, tray left outside our room, juice, yoghurt, croissants, mini cheese, jam, cereal bars. Would definitely book this hotel again. Staff were lovely, we had a problem with our dates, and we rang and it was sorted without any fuss. Thank you!

title: we will come back for shure
text: we had a lovely stay, and the place is just perfect. thanks a lot for the service very efficient and kind.

title: Family visit to London 2 adults 3 children (16,11,7)
text: Location - FABULOUS. literally 2 mins walking from getting off the train (Paddington St) to the hotel. The whole street is basically hotel after hotel, with Tony's house sitting half way down. Not the most aesthetically looking hotel but we didn't book it for that. Price. Location and value for money were our priorities and Tony's House delivered on all 3. Our room (1) was downstairs 3 x double beds with space between them, unlike other hotels I've stopped in. Modern looking room with all the basic facilities. The underground runs adjacent to the hotel, which means you can hear the trains past

title: poor quality
text: when i first saw the hotel i thought it seems nice, but as soon as i entered the main entrance , the standerds was not very high ,however putting that aside we reseaved poor customer service through out our experiance in the hotelthere was no smile or eye contact no hello or good bye or anythink , the room was extremly small the bed was way to small to be a double , then when we were due to leave we find rat poision on the floor near the window ,dont be fooled by the nice pictures , we was exetreamly shocked off the standerds, would never ever recommend this hotel.

title: Just right, price reflects what you get
text: Me and my friends stayed for the weekend for a hen weekend, the location was fantastic with everything u need close by! The room was standard but had everything you needed, they guy in reception was more than helpful and everything was mostly clean and up to good standards. We didn't realise we got a continental style breakfast delivered to the room in the morning. Basic but no complaints! Would definitely recommend to anyone who understands that you get what u pay for!

title: Good location, but there are certain shortcomings
text: The location is a good one (close to Paddington Station and to Central London), the price looks correct and the facilities are adequate. The breakfast is served only in the room and it contains too many sweet things and lacking any meat and it contains only one piece of processed cheese (in conditions that is promoted as a continental breakfast). The room was extremely small, but the bed was confortable. Another downside is that while the sink and the shower are in the room, the toilet was located a level downstairs.

title: A SHAME !!!
text: beds and dirty room, bathroom very small, wc on the inside ! not close the door so small ! cover beds very dirty, dirty carpet, dirty sheets, no key to lock the door, one day they forgot to close my room ! with my luggage (I'm French). One day not hot water in the morning and nobody to get informations ! A horrible breakfast ! disgusting products...I didn't have confidence, I was afraid I blocked my door ! Tiny television and failed ! work in the next room, the smell of paint and a lot of noises ! what deception ! it's a shame you had to pay before taking the room !

title: Horrific
text: Absolutely terrible room, old, small and dingy. To make matters worse the window is next to the bed and it has an awful draft. Not to mention there is no toilet in the room (it's downstairs) and the shower, which isn't in the room either, has a moist towel on the floor and it has no lock. Definitely should be avoided.

title: Ok for overnight stopover
text: The hotel has a great location, being a couple of minutes from Paddington. As we only wanted the room for somewhere to sleep, it was quite adequate. We were able to leave our bags on arrival (as we arrived too early to check in) and go out for the day, which was great. The staff were really friendly. The sheeets and towels were clean and the continental breakfast brought to your room was fine. Unfortunately we were at the back of the hotel, so didn't have a view, but at the front of the hotel is a lovely little park to sit in. We bought lovely fish and chips from Mickeys around the corner and ate them in the park.

title: Disappointment
text: We were staying at room for five persons which is too small for that many people,also a bathroom was a size of the small closet, and the room was not very clean also the sheets on the bed seem not very well washed.Also we have waited more than its needed for the owner to give us a room key. On the other hand, positive thing was a good breakfast and kind staff.

title: An Ok Place
text: Only had 1 night stay here as had an early flight out of London. Perfect location for the Heathrow express train at paddington. Beautiful neighborhood and fantastic tree and park lined street. Room we had was on the very top floor and had to climb 5 flights of stairs, (the last flight feeling like a ladder into an attic). the stairs did not bother us as we are quite fit, but maybe a hassle if you are less mobile. room was very small, but comfortable bed. I'd probably remove the small round coffee table as it is useless. :) staff were quite helpful.

title: The location is the selling point.
text: It was a pleasant stay overall. We knew it was the location that mattered. Just a few metres away was the Paddington Station. It didn't really matter that the room was small nor that it was not as clean as we wanted it to be. What was important to us was it's location. The staff was friendly and the hotel adequate for our needs. Important fact: No elevator. So if climbing and navigating through several steep stairs is going to be a problem for you, pick the rooms on the ground floor.

title: Not great
text: Only positive was the shower room which looked recently modernised. Peeling wallpaper and mould in the bedrooms. Bed which had a musty smell. Public areas need decorating and have to say the most inedible breakfast ever,threw most in the bin after one bite.Won't be back.

title: Decent place for a night's rest with very good location
text: The best part of this hotel is the location. Paddington Station is only about 2 mins walk and there is a beautiful garden right in front of the hotel, very suitable for those seeking relaxation. Very convenient with all kinda shops selling food, souvenirs and almost anything that you might need situated around the area. Paid £66 for a room for 3 with private bathroom and it was well worth the money. The room is small and old but clean and decent for people who only needs a place to sleep. The room comes with a small TV, tea/coffee making facilities, 1 single bed, 1 double bed and cupboard. Bathroom is clean and looks new but the water heater might not work at times. The windows are unsecured and may be dangerous for those with kids. It might also be quite tough for people with large luggages as the staircase is narrow and the room may be on the 2nd or 3rd floor. Breakfast is nothing fancy, very simple but enough to fill the tummy. It will be sent to the room between 8-9am but since I was to check out the next morning at 7.30, they offered to send some food over at night which I find was very nice of them. This hotel is perfect for those who wants to stay in town on a budget and only need a place to sleep for the night with very basic ammenities.

title: Hyde Park Zoo
text: If your an animal lover then this is the hotel for you!! If your lucky enough you will wake up with mice roaming about your room which is nice for a bit of company on them cold winter months. The bathroom was so big that we had to open the door in it if you wanted to turn around to get into the shower. They conveniently made 1 out of 2 beds in the room which was also a nice touch. We particularly enjoyed on the Sunday morning when the random man walked into our room and then banged the door closed, this meant there was no need to set an alarm as he woke all of us up in a warm homely fashion. To top the beautiful experience off when we sat down in the room to enjoy a cup of english tea when we noticed a gorgeous brown scum floating at the top of the cup, this was nice as it gave off a gorgeous beige magnolia colour to the tea. Being a group of girls away for the weekend of course we all over packed and had too many clothes with us, but not to worry, as when you stay in the beautiful Tonys House Hotel they dont like to turn on the heat in your bedroom so we got to wear all of our clothes at once, amazing!!!

title: Ok for a short stay
text: I was pretty anxious after reading those 2 posts. Eventually, the staff was friendly and the hotel is extremely well located: great bus service, nice view on the park. However, i found it difficult to determine whether the hotel was dirty or just old. My advice: prepare some flip flops for the shower. The sheets seemed clean though. The bed wasn't great and the walls shook everytime the subway went by... Overall, a cheap place good enough for a few days.

title: Definitely stay again!
text: Me & my partner are in our early 20s and we both loved it here! The location was brilliant

title: do not be fooled by the photos!!
