title: thankyou we really enjoyed our stay.
text: we were in a group of 8 family members who stayed for just one Saturday night, last weekend. We were really impressed with the size & quality of the rooms. Yes there is building work being done at the hotel but this didn't affect us at all. Our room was an inner one overlooking the inner court and was very quiet. There was a lovely walk along the Thames upto tower bridge. Thank you.

title: Beautiful
text: Lovely hotel, staff were all very friendly, rooms were well decorated (although our curtain was broke!) very modern, had a few drinks in the bar which had beautiful views and not badly priced! Great location within walking distance to Big Ben! Would return

title: lovely London weekend
text: We stayed at this hotel for 1 night for a weekend away, the hotels entrance is impressive We asked for a room with a view of the river and we weren't disappointed, the view was amazing as for the room it was large, clean and very comfortable. This hotel is a short distance from the centre of everything but a 10 minute stroll and you're at Westminster Bridge. I would definitely stay here again, as compared to other places we have stayed this hotel was well priced.

title: Could have scored higher
text: Stayed 2 nights ago, looks wise internally, its excellent, clean and modern. But then it just lets itself down. Deadbolt on door did not match up with the hole in the door frame, therefore could not securely lock the room at night. I did mention this to the girl on reception, who just was not interested (which made me write this review). Room was cold, tried to use the thermosat, put it up to 30 and still cold. My colleague in a different room on the floor below has the same issue. View was of the train track, as i arrived after 9pm, and left at 8am next morning this didn't bother me, but if staying for a longer period would not have liked. Buffet breakfast was good, but the veggie sausage repeated on me most of the day.

title: Great location
text: Great hotel very welcoming with excellent facilities. Close to transport links to city and beyond. Very comfortable bed and powerful and refreshing shower. Awesome multimedia system smart tv with high speed WiFi

title: Not catering for 4 occupants, poor service, drains smell and no compensation
text: I stayed in a suite with a family of 4 on the 4th floor. The sofa bed was very uncomfortable with springs. We rang to housekeeping on the evening for another quilt to cover the springs and some more pillows as the sofa bed was given only 1 pillow. We were told the hotel was full and no more bedding available - unbelievable. The drains in the bathroom have a smell coming from them The room even though we pre booked for 4 people was really set up for 2 with not enough towels (had ring for more towels) not enough soap and shampoos etc. On check out I informed receptionist that I was disappointed where standard customer practise was to pacify me at that point and no discount or compensation was offered which I find disappointing

title: Four star luxury!
text: I bought my fiance some tickets to see a comedy gig at the Leicester Square theatre, so to avoid having to rush for the last train home, I booked us a night at the Park Plaze Riverside hotel. I got a great deal via Hotels.com of £87 - this didn't include breakfast, but as soon as we walked into the hotel lobby I was assured that we had got a bargain! We needed to check out before 7am the next day anyway, so the breakfast wasn't really an issue for us anyway. The hotel lobby is really impressive - it's modern yet grand, and the hotel staff are superb. We arrived slightly too early to check into our room, but we left our luggage with the concierge, who was really polite and helpful, gave us a map and pointed out some nearby places of interest. After a walk around the locality and some lunch, we moved into our room on the 3rd floor. We had a room at the side of the hotel, so our view wasn't the best - a building site directly in front with a side view of the river, but the room itself was spacious, spotlessly clean and very comfortable indeed. Free Wifi in hotels like this is always a plus!

title: Not what was expected
text: Has been a difficult one to review this and I have given it 3 in my rating. Will start with the good things. Hotel was lovely, rooms were excellent, everything you expect from a Park Plaza. Bed was huge, excellent and very large TV, remote control everything from lights to curtains, have to say that for the rooms alone I would happily return to a Park Plaza. Now for my issues and whilst I raised these with the hotel and had these resolved, I feel that I have to note them. Arrived early and room wasn’t ready, not an issue, left luggage and headed into London to re-visit some of our favourite places. Returned to the hotel in the evening and was allocated a room on the 14th floor with what looked to be a great view, the issue with the room was that somebody else had already checked in, suitcase and handbag left in the room, would hate to think what the occupants would have thought had they been in the room. Headed back down to the lobby to raise my concern received an apology and a new room, 13th floor and again with a nice view, we had booked an executive room. Issue with this room was no sofa bed and there were three of us. By this time I was a little exasperated, rang reception who sent a staff member up, given a new room on the opposite side of the corridor, lovely huge bed, sofa (not yet converted) and a shocking view, by his point daughter was tired so we took the room, was advised the sofa would be made up shortly. No sofa made up by time we were heading out for the evening but thought nothing of it as there was still time, however when we returned at about 11.30 still not made up this then led to a 30 minute wait for the bed to be made up. Good nights sleep, beds so comfy. Headed down for breakfast in the morning, tried to order some poached eggs waitress didn’t seem to know what these were and whilst trying to explain these to her she began to pour hot coffee down my arm and t-shirt... not a great start to the day. As I say this was all resolved as I raised my issue with the reception manager Lawrence, he was very helpful and listened to my concerns and issues and assured me that he would address these with the relevant departments and I have to say he seemed sincere and I feel that he will speak to the relevant people, he has also compensated me with some Radisson points so I left happier then I would have been. I haven’t written this review to put anyone off this hotel as it was brilliant just a few glitches that can happen anywhere, please do go here and enjoy your stay, I am certain that if I return I would have none of these issues again.

title: Reception
text: The check in process was farcical.Had to queue 3 times to finally get room cards. Check in is supposed to be 2pm, room was not ready until 3.10pm. We frequently stay in Park Plaza hotels, this one was not in the same league as the Park Plaza Westminster Bridge. When staying there we are always informed about the £50 over charge, however the person who eventually checked us in failed to mention this.

title: Great Hotel, Great Staff, Great Coffee
text: Well appointed room, stylish hotel, great service. Staff were helpful, friendly and accommodating. The location is fantastically situated to be near enough to public transport when you need to move around London(Vauxhall is a 10 minute walk) but far enough away to encourage you to walk along the river to Westminster and the Eye etc when you feel like being a tourist...and the espresso in the bar was brilliant. Will definitely use it again

title: Lovely from the moment I set foot out of the taxi!!
text: We had an absolutely lovely time at this hotel. Dean, the hotel porter, was extremely friendly and welcoming. He took our bag out of the car and asked me if we had had a nice holiday. He then handed the bag over to another member of staff but walked us to reception. Once we have freshened up and changed we planned to go out for dinner. As it was around 9.30 by this point we asked Dean where was quick and easy but nice to eat. He recommended 'The Rose' which was just a two minute walk down the road. We had an absolutely lovely meal which was extremely well priced. When we returned back to the hotel we asked him for directions for the plans we had made for the following day. He informed us which tickets we needed to buy, what line to get on and how long it would take. He was an absolutely lovely member of staff! Another porter brought our case up to the room. He showed us around the room and explained how everything worked. He asked if there was anything else we needed or wanted. Another member of staff that was lovely and faultless. The rooms were very well sized and modern. They had an en suit bathroom which had a very reasonably sized bath and a lovely shower cubical. The room was cleaned everyday to an impeccable standard. In my opinion there was only one really minor fault to this hotel and it was one of the bar staff. I queried the price of a cocktail (as there was two mojitos on the menu) the bar staff snapped back at me. Admittedly I did order the wrong cocktail, but I was perfectly happy to pay the more expensive price. At the time of ordering I did not realise that there were two cocktails. I just felt he was fairly snappy with his reply. However excluding this blip he was polite and helped me choosing drinks, explaining what was in them all. I would recommended this hotel to anyone. The staff were all very friendly and the hotel was situated in a perfect location. The view was breath taking especially at night.

title: Beautiful hotel, poor expirience
text: Hotel is very modern and has a great wow factor, but... housekeeping us very poor. Dirty carpets in the corridor, in the drawer in my room I have found dirty socks and pants after previous guests. Smell in the bathroom was awful - it was coming out from the pipes each time someone flashed the water in the toilet above - and I was loving on the first floor... when I opened up the shower door I couldn't breath - smell was so bad. Very noisy room as well, I could hear all noises from the kitchen.

title: First Class Hotel
text: Change of location from the city hotel we use but what an amazing choice. Fantastic views of the Thames from our floor to ceiling view, spotless throughout and a first class service during our stay. It’s a quieter area, about 7-8 minutes walk to the tube Vauxhall, or about 10-15minutes the other way along the river to the London eye. The restaurant and bar was top notch with high quality food and service along with cabaret through the evening. Very relaxed but worth the expense. Whilst we love the “busy” London, it has made me rethink about the quality, space and luxury you get for your money from a short ride from the city. Definitely go back to this hotel and would recommend to anyone to benefit from an alternative choice of location. Nice clean safe area with a few bars and a deli that serves Portuguese tarts!! Amazing

title: Great location and good value for money
text: A friend of mine and I stayed at Park Plaza for three nights. We got a good deal and the location is great for exploring the city. The rooms are modern and clean and the service staff is very friendly.

title: Even when it's bad, it's excellent....
text: I am a pretty loyal customer of Radisson as I am part of their loyalty programme and stay in numerous hotels for work. In my experience the staff at Park Plaza London Riverbank are consistently exceptional. However, on my most recent visit with my whole family I was let down by the fact the room was not cleaned and beds not made, a little bit of rubbish was left in the room and tea not replenished etc. etc. I asked the cleaning manager to correct this when we went out and she unfortunately seemed to forget. Similarly, the busy reception also seemed to have their message lost when I requested it be done while I was out for dinner, This was highly unusual and I did feel that the staff were genuinely regretful when I spoke to them. i eventually spoke with Salem at guest services in the evening and he was superb, he made me feel immediately extremely valued as a guest and was both apologetic, friendly and generous. I can't thank him enough as I had both my 5 and 3 year old with me at the time and it wasn't easy. I have been staying at the Park Plaza London Riverbank for several years on and off for business and more recently with my young family for special trips to London. Approx 2 years ago I brought my young son on his first trip to London. For each family stay so far, I made a couple of special requests for my sons which the hotel over delivered on. They have actually helped make our stays 'extra memorable' and for that I cannot thank them enough.

title: just can't get away from the train tracks
text: would avoid this hotel like anything ! we stayed in one of the 410.00 suites and it really wasn't worth the money . we arrived a t 2pm for a12pm check in and was told the suite wasn't available yet ..we didn't get it until 4pm . when we did get in the room was dirty ..on one of the office chairs there was stains on the seat and there was empty drink bottles from the previous occupants . even though we were on the 10th floor the noise from the trains was just awful ..how can you possibly sleep when the trains are passing every minute .i would rather stay at an 80.00 a night premier inn .

title: Excellent Service
text: Had a great stay, we booked a standard 'superior', room got there and they said we had a free upgrade. We were taken to a special reception area and checked in to a luxury suite, and wow was it Luxury, Living area with kitchen and large flat TV, All very clean and tidy. Very posh bathroom with walk in shower all Marble and Glass. Bed very comfy. Probably only get a free upgrade like that once in a lifetime but it was well worth the experience. Have stayed there before in a standard room, and it was very good too, but not quite the same Breakfast was excellent too. Will stay there again, there always hope we will get another upgrade I supose.

title: Disappointing stay, dirty carpets and furniture, too expensive for what it offers
text: We used to stay in this hotel (several times) but it was a couple of years ago, the hotel was newer, the food was better and the staff were friendlier and much more helpful. Now we found very dirty carpets in our rooms and in the corridor, very dirty sofas and armchairs, smelly pillows, old furniture, broken wardrobe, cleaning up was not done properly at all, the minibar was not replenished on the second day, porters did not care, did not help us with our siutcases when we arrived, even though they could see we had problems with it. The food was ok but in the past it was much better, the staff (especially in the bar) were unobservant. We liked the new bathroom and the view of our room, which was stunning. The location is very convinient (close to London Eye and opposite The houses of Parliament). The reception staff were helpful and willing but the whole stay was terrible and they took a lot of money, we will never come back again.

title: Great hotel
text: A very nice hotel. Relatively cheap compared to other luxury hotels in London, but still with fantastic large rooms, comfy beds and great bathrooms. The hotel is also in a great locations, only a 10 or 15 minute walk along the Thames (very beautiful) to some of the big tourist attractions within the city. Also near transport terminals. Well worth the money!

title: Great hotel
text: Hotel has several restaurants close to all major tourist spots and very close to a metro shop. Would definitely stay again. The room has very spacious for London's standards and a good value for the money.

title: Nice hotel and good location.
text: It was only after booking I realised this was a four star hotel. I was just looking for somewhere well location and clean and I found it. The four star was kind of wasted on us as we didn't use any of the facilities, spa, gym etc. We didn't have breakfast at the hotel as having seen the menu in our room it was very expensive. The check in process was easy, we arrived around 1.40pm and check in opens from 2pm but advised our room was ready. I was also given a rewards card but this was poorly explained by the person checking us in so I don't know what it actually is. She mentioned something about free water and card in room said if don't have housekeeping for two days will get bonus points added but again none of this was mentioned. So I now have a card and no idea what to do with it. We had twin beds which were nice and big and comfy. Everything in the room is controlled by electronic control including AC, lights, closing/opening curtains which was good and a controller on each side of the beds. The room was a good size and clean. The view was of other rooms but we didn't pay extra for a view as only in the hotel at night to sleep so didn't see the point. The downside in room is that the fridge is also a mini bar and you are charged if move something. This meant we weren't able to keep our water in the fridge. I feel a hotel of this calibre should have a seperate fridge for clients unless the assumption is if staying there you will use the mini bar. There are ice machines on each floor so I guess you could use this in the wine bucket in the room if wish to but felt this was too much hassle especially when we were only in the hotel during the night and out exploring during the day. The hotel is less than 10 minute walk to Vauxhall tube and train station. There are a couple of pubs, shops on the route and a petrol station. As leaving the hotel on the right hand side there is a grocery store and the London Eye is a 15 minute walk away so well located. There are places to eat by the tube station. We didn't need to have any interactions with staff other than check in/check out and using luggage room on our last day but all the staff were pleasant. On ocassions were door man at the front he always said good morning and wished me a pleasant day which was nice :-) On check in I was asked to leave £100 for any in room charges, I don't recall this being mentioned when I booked but I was able to provide a credit card. We didn't have any in room charges and on check out asked if this would be refunded and advised it would. Only left yesterday so will wait a few days to see if refunded. There was no charge for using the luggage room. Overall this was a nice hotel if not a little too fancy for me. The staff were nice and it was well located.

title: My stay in Park Plaza Riverbank
text: I received an upgrade of the room without asking The receiptionist was very kind and professional and available to provide any kind of informati and suggestion. I look forward to visit again this hotel where I also enjoyed a very good breakfast, just on the river of the Thames

title: By far the worst hotel ever!
text: This is my basic expectation from a hotel: A clean and quite room where I can recharge my batteries during my sleep so I can explore the city I’m staying at. What I got was: A clean room but only one out of three good night sleep. Reasons why? 1, I had an impeccable nice view from the window but unfortunately I was also facing a construction site. Drilling and hammering it’s not a pleasant wake up call. 2, After the first night the cleaning lady removed my private anti-dust-mite sheet even though I wrote a note “please do not make my bed” on an already made bed. I’ve got a severe allergy to mites. Without it equals asthma and eczema during my sleep. Hence the one out of three good night’s sleep. I was surprised that no one at the hotel knew about this allergy considering what business they are in. They surely tried “their best” to help me during the two following nights but since they didn’t know what the allergy implies consequently their help was kind of useless. In addition to this I also had to spend time and energy to argue with them every morning and evening about how important that sheet is for me. I required to get compensated for the sheet (and the sheet only, not for the two destroyed nights) and for that I had to speak with FOUR different managers whereas the last one required me, at the very last moment before I left the hotel to cath my flight, to write a handwritten statement about the matter even though I’ve already solved the issue in the morning with the third manager AND I was already late to my flight. But they gave me “the benefit of the doubt” (quote from the 3rd manager), since the cleaning lady claimed she didn’t touch my bed, and reimbursed the money for the sheet. Thanks a lot!

title: Romantic days in London
text: Fantastic!!! The great surprise during the our stay in London! Recomend! It's so near The Londo Eye and Big Ben. Great view of Tames River. Thanks for The hospitality !!!!!! Recomended for the families with childrens

title: Excellent but a bit dated room
text: Nice Room, excellent views, friendly and prompt staff. Breakfasts we good value if booked upon arrival. Some emergency services sirens from headquarters nearby occasionally became annoying , but im a light sleeper.

title: Falls short of potential
text: The location was fine, as was the final response to the complaint that I had to make. I reported two faults - 1) blocked bathroom sink that was taking 10 minutes to drain and 2) edge of the curtains was hanging off, so sunlight able to come in during early morning. The drain problem was very unpleasant and unhygienic with previous guests' hairs etc washing out. (I won't go into any more detail!) Neither fault was fixed between 9.30am and 10pm while we were out. I had to speak to reception again the following morning. They initially offered a £6 discount then when I laughed they offered this plus a breakfast in the lounge. In the end the resolution was okay, but what a shame it had to come to that. Other minor irritations - two out of four lifts not working, waiter quite snooty and didn't bother to mention that steak comes without potatoes or ANY sides - spoil what should be a very good hotel.

title: Good location
text: This is a very modern hotel, very spacious, separate shower and tub, the staff were very helpful, mailed my postcards for me, within walking distance to the London Eye, pubs, convenience store. I had emailed them prior to my stay about early check in and they did accommodate us. The breakfast was very good, lots of choices.

title: Great views from River view rooms.
text: Nice hotel, great room on the 10th floor with spectacular river views. Beds are quity comfy for memory foam, would be intrigued to know what make. The main bar closed quite early for some reason, but thats not such a bad thing the next morning. One significant issue is there was no thermostatic control stop for the shower , so easy to turn the morning shower into a scalding trip into hell's fire and brimstone. I suppose it once worked but it needs replacing before someone is injured.

title: Brilliant service
text: Stayed for 3 nights between xmas and new year, ideally situated with fantastic quality service. Had evening meal once and 2 breakfasts which were all fantastic. Will definitely be returning. Thanks to all the staff.

title: West end weekend
text: My husband, my daughter and I stayed one night at this great hotel in the heart of London. A stones throw from the Tower of London and transport readily available to everywhere else. Tube is very close. Bus top just at the top of the road. The hotel was very clean and pleasant. Our room was lovely and large. We booked the family meal deal with breakfast. Superb food and excellent value. The staff were great. All in all we had a great weekend. Would recommend highly to anyone visiting London xx

title: Excellent value, great location
text: I was stating in central London with friends for a weekend as we were there to see a show. The hotel is very easy to find, particularly from Monument station. The hotel was clean and the beds comfortable. The staff were friendly and helpful. We arrived early and were able to leave our bags while we went out to do some touristy things. We did the same the following day when we wanted to leave earlier than check out. We went out for breakfast rather than stayed in, but two of our other party had the hotel breakfast as they were there with their 14 month old son. There are also plenty of vending machines if you’re a little peckish. The only down side of this hotel was the hairdryer... it was a bit pathetic. I have thin hair so it doesn’t matter. If you’ve got thick hair, bring your own!

title: Great hotel and location
text: From friendly reception staff to a great location, we were surprised at how good this premier inn in. Our family room was a great size and very clean. The bed was super comfy and we thought the breakfast was excellent

title: Great Family room
text: We stayed for 3 nights, fantastic room, lovely and quiet, plenty of space for a family of 4. Restaurant service was great and the kids meals were well put together. We had a minor issue with our meal deals on the booking as the cost was doubled for each night because there were 4 of us, but we only wanted 2 meal deals as there were 2 adults an 2 children, with no facility to pre buy children's meals, which took a while to ascertain when we were being asked for more money on arrival, knowing we had already pre-paid.

title: Location ok, clean, tidy, and spacious
text: Location It is about 5 minutes walk from Monument station, Monument and London bridge. Tower Bridge is about 10 minutes walk from here. I was on business trip and picking this hotel due to it is close to the office. If you're looking for eateries, this location might not be your best choice as this is office area, a lot of the shop is cater to office hour and take-away. Weekend even worse, a lot of them either not open or just open on Saturday (close earlier than weekday) [Apart from Subway and McDonalds]. Hotel & Room The hotel provide step-free access. The room is clean, tidy, and spacious. The bed is comfortable. Aircond is available. There's no safe box in the room. Hair dryer is provided and located below the mirror. Double room comes with double bed, desk, and a couch. The TV is big and has lots of channels, but they've lock the volume, you can only turn it on until level 15 then it won't get any louder than this (a good measure to prevent guest turning on the TV too loud and disturb other guest). The toilet is clean and spacious too, with a bath tub and all-in-one cleaning gel (two of them, one next to the bath tub and another one next to the basin). The ventilation in the bathroom is a bit slow though, after a bath, it took quite awhile to clear out the steam. There're two WiFi network available, one free and the other not. As you would have expect, the free WiFi is slow and it is really slow (less than 100kbps). The paid WiFi is slightly better (test it using Speedtest.net, it shows about 3Mbps). But the quality of the paid WiFi isn't guaranteed, I've experienced both fast and slow connection on this network, it gets worse during the night (probably due to lots of other guest is using it as well?). There're central switch to turn off all the light at both side of the bed (apart from the table lamp and light at the mirror near the door, that one has to be switched off from there). The floor is carpeted, which feels good if you stay there during winter. My room comes with breakfast, it taste ok. If you plan to have dinner there, remember to book the seat in advanced as the restaurant seat is limited. Overall the room and food is good. Service The check-in and check-out is quick. Room is cleaned everyday. The staff always greet and smile to you. I made some order from Amazon and get it delivered to the hotel, they help keep it and hand it over to me when I'm back to the hotel and collect from the reception. There's one package, they put it into my room straight away. The staff at the restaurant is always friendly and with a smile on their face, it is good to see that each morning when having breakfast before heading to work.

title: Wife's Birthday
text: First time at a Premier Inn and was not let down!! Great room, really good food and very friendly staff. Would definitely stay here again. Ideal location for everything that we wanted to do so it was a good base to use.

title: Check tubes open. Limited food area
text: Lovely rooms as per Lenny Henry. Tube station shut as weekend so got taxis everywhere was quicker. Restaurant got very busy and slow.DO BOOK A TABLE IN EVENING. Limited eateries nearby at weekends as business area.

title: Great Location, usual Premier Inn rooms and value
text: The one thing with Premier Inn - you know what you will get. A comfortable and clean room, bed with standardised bathroom layout. Reasonably priced accommodation in Central London. Now, this isn't the best Premier Inn I've stayed at but this is pretty good. The tube station is 3 minutes walk (Monument) and the interchange to Bank is easy, so good connection’s for wherever you want to go in central London is easy. The Tower of London is 7 minutes walk and the Thames is 3 minutes walk. Would certainly recommend.

title: Excellent location, wonderful staff.
text: I'm writing this on behalf of my partner and her daughter who had a "Girly" weekend in London for the daughters 40th. They were delighted with all aspects of the hotel and particularly the conduct of the staff at this location. Arriving early they were able to leave their luggage securely while they went on the first of their adventures. On return they were shown to a upgraded room on the 7th floor simply because they had mentioned in conversation with the check in desk girls that it was a birthday weekend. They found the location pleasantly quiet, only 10 minutes walk from Liverpool Street Station, with excellent tube and bus connections to central London, Theatreland, the Petticoat Lane/Bishopgates area and the South Bank. There was very little traffic noise and pleasant breakfast and bar facilities. The staff could not have been more helpful. Nothing was too much trouble and the one night they had an evening meal at the hotel the lights went dim and the staff appeared with a "Birthday Cake" complete with candle and sang "Happy Birthday". The food was basic but adequate, well prepared and served with courtesy and a smile. Big thanks to the staff for their part in making the weekend a memorable one.

title: Lifesaver
text: Second stay at this hotel and this time it was an absolute lifesaver. By the time we reached here we had been awake for 26 hours and had just got off the virgin red eye from New York.......needless to say we were shattered. We were 2 hours early for check in but they let us have a room and waived the early check in fee......we must have looked as bad as we felt. Great place, great sleep and excellent position

title: Clean, comfortable, well located
text: This hotel was very clean throughout and very comfortable. The mattress was excellent. We heard no noise or disturbances from our room. Reception staff were friendly and helpful. The location is excellent - a thirty second walk from the river, and two minutes to Monument station. We enjoyed our stay and would happily stay here again.

title: Weekend with th grandchildren
text: Recently stayed 2 nights, 4 of us in a family room. No problems at all, room excellent, very friendly and helpful staff. Breakfast both mornings was excellent and kids eat free. Took advantage of the happy hour at the bar and the dinner/breakfast meal deal, both great value. Would definetely stay here again.

title: Away from the hustle and bustle...
text: Third Premier Inn stay this year, and yet again one things stands out...the staff. I don't know how, but on the main they seem to employ or teach a very customer orientated experiance. It doesn't matter what time of the day you engage with staff, they are always friendly and informative and in this hotel several members excelled. It amazes me as some people put it on for reward, but when in a wage only environment, ie not waiting staff working for tips, staff like I say were so polite. The room itself was fresh and clean, not the biggest P/Inn, but definitely the quietest. we've stayed in. The easiest tube we found was Monument, and it was an easy walk. We exited at the actual Monument itself, turned left up the hill, then immediately right, past Tesco on right, Walkie Talkie sky scraper on left, and I think 4th turn on your right. We enjoyed the £10.50 all you can eat buffet breakfast, which has some new bakery items on it for the price increase, but still excellent value, with unlimited Costa machine coffee and kids U16 eat free as advertised.,but chose to eat out in the evening. Would definitely use this Premier Inn again

title: Great location and calm!
text: We stayed over the weekend and surprised how quiet and calm it was in the hotel and surrounding area. The staff at hotel were friendly and helpful. Our room was very clean and the bed extremely comfortable. We didn't use public transport and walked along the river to Westminster and across the bridge to South bank etc. There are quite a few tube stations in the area. A much more relaxed stay than in previous locations in London.

title: Excellent
text: The location was brilliant, right next to the underground and plenty of restaurants to eat if you didn't want to eat at the hotel. The staff were friendly and pointed us in the right direction when we weren't sure.

title: Weekend London Visit
text: Good location and usual Premier quality. We had paid 6 months previously so achieved a good rate. Were disappointed having booked and paid that early, plus checked in on line our group were split over as many floors, and rooms not available until usual time. Housekeeping in the corridors were not to the usual quality and that was reported to the front desk. If breakfast is not booked previously payment is taken prior to seating which I found a bit irritating! But overall these minor issues did not detract from a usual Premier quality.

title: Amazing
text: What a lovely clean bright hotel we had a family room great size tea and coffee. Didnt need to bring hair dryer as they have them in the room shower and hair gel, very much home fromm home. The staff were a amzing always there to help and the breakfast is a must, Happy Days :)

title: What you pay for, and a bit more
text: I stayed as a solo business traveller for 5 nights. For business in The City, it is in a spectacular location. The lobby is large, clean and bright. I was not permitted to check in until 2:00 pm because not one room in the hotel was available. I did not buy it, but whatever. The rooms are small but adequate. The beds are doubles, not queens. For couples it would be a challenge. There was no phone in the room, which I found interesting. I was provided 2 bath towels and the only bath amenity is soap in dispensers in the shower and next to the sink. I was not crazy about that. The shower and toilet pressure were fine. There is a bar, and it is just fine. Full selection, fairly priced, and open late. My biggest problem is with housekeeping. They did not clean my room at all one day, and on another it was not cleaned until late in the day. It's a guess but I would say that the lack of diligent housekeeping is why they do not check people in until 2:00. The place has free wi fi, but it is pretty slow. You can upgrade to faster internet for a fee. This place is not luxury. The furniture is cheap particleboard garbage that is already showing wear. But this place is $100 per night less than any place near this location. I would bring my own bath stuff next time, but if I again was traveling alone on business, I'd probably stay again to save the quid. The savings can buy many pints!

title: I second the previous review, Jesus an excellent employee
text: We stayed on 29 December for one night, a family of 2 adults & 2 children. Check in was excellent and very slick, staff were polite and always smiling and could not do enough for you. The room was large and very clean, we were on the 7th floor. Jesus was always there to help, on reception, at dinner & breakfast. There was a delay with our table for dinner, so Jesus arranged for us to have a complimentary platter which was delicious. With problems in the kitchen, there was also a delay with our food, but Jesus kept us informed and worked so hard to please everyone. It seemed he was there day & night. It was a lovely hotel, one we would visit again thanks to Jesus. An excellent employee, all hotels should have one!

title: Great hotel and location for families
text: Great central location - situated in a quiet and pleasant part of of the city. Hotel was clean and the staff were all friendly and helpful. Hotel is around 5 minutes walk from the tube station and very close to Sky Gardens also.

title: 4 nights on business
text: An excellent stay. The hotel is in a great location for anyone working in the city or wanting to stay close to the Tower. Really quiet and the rooms are definitely larger than normal. Staff were friendly and apart from getting stuck behind a massive queue of people checking in, I couldn't fault it.

title: Clean, great location, comfortable
text: This hotel is exactly what I have come to expect from Premier Inn. It was clean, comfortable and had friendly staff. It is well located and is a short walk from Monument Tube Station. It was an average London hotel price so decent value.

title: Blown away by the service
text: Generally we wouldn't choose to stay in a Premier Inn - there are always quirky, boutique, friendly hotels and B&Bs out there which are often better value. However, for business, location and therefore convenience, the new Premier Inn at Monument ticked the boxes. This is a new hotel and it shows. The decor is fresh, clean and quite fun. The sound is deadened in the corridors and rooms, so it really has been the quietest room I have experienced in London. The bed was high and very comfortable. But you would hope for all of this anyway. What made this stay exceptional was the customer service. It is a very long time since I have received such attentive, helpful service in a chain hotel. I expect it in independents but alas, service is erratic in budget to mid priced hotels. When I arrived the guys in reception were brilliant and the following morning a change of staff but no depletion of excellent attitude. The manager allowed me to stay longer in my room to complete some work - without having to pay for a second full night. I have no idea if other Premier Inns are now like this - certainly my last experience in Kings Cross wasn't - but that was some time ago. Keep it up - whatever customer service training you are implementing it works - we will now stay for a City weekend not just business.

title: Very convenient and brand new Hotel in the City
text: Very comfortable and quiet hotel tucked away in the heart of the city. Most comfortable beds and pillows etc. and stonking breakfast! Staff very helpful and location very handy to Monument Tube Station.

title: Enjoyed Our Stay
text: My two teenage daughters and I recently stayed at the Premier Inn London (Bank Tower) for four days.This hotel was well located and within walking distance to the Tower of London and London Bridge, as well as walking distance to the Underground and buses. The reception staff were all very friendly and helpful. Our "family" room was perfect for the three of us. Not only was the room very clean, but the bed was extremely comfortable. My younger daughter slept on the sofa bed, and she commented that for a sofa bed, it was quite comfortable. We had breakfast twice during our stay. While I am not accustomed to paying for breakfast in most North American hotels, their breakfast is worth it if you compare to other restaurants in London, and the food offered was good. We also ate dinner there and found the service was very slow and the food average. However, the restaurant was busy that night and it looked like they were understaffed. The "free" 30 minute wifi was not working during most of our stay. Again, most hotels offer unlimited free wifi. Not sure why PI doesn't? It was inconvenient to try and find a cafe everyday where we could get wifi service. Overall, we enjoyed our stay at the PI London Bank Tower, but feel the lack of reliable unlimited free wifi was an inconvenience for guests and this is an area they need to improve upon.

title: Decent place in the heart of London
text: I have stayed here for both work and leisure. On weekends it is very quiet in this part of London, few residents, offices all shut, most restaurants shut too, but the pubs are open. On weekdays it is in the centre of the action, lots of bars, restaurants, a stone's throw from The Tower, Tower Bridge, Leadenhall Market, a few metres from The Monument. Tower Pier is 5 minutes walk and one can catch a river bus to Greenwich or Westminster etc. The rooms are standard Premier Inn, your know what you will get, breakfast is good as usual in this chain. The bed was big and comfy, the price during the week is just within my company's cap, which is difficult to achieve in this part of London, on the weekend, our room was only £75 a night, an absolute bargain!

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Excellent hotel, rooms are very clean in excellent location only two minutes walking from the train station Monument and 5 minutes from Bank Station. The receptionist are very helpfully and are willing to explain to you.

title: Great place to stay
text: Few minutes walk to nearest underground station. 5 minute walk to the tower bridge. Restaurants nearby. Hotel clean. Staff very helpful. Child's bed was a proper bed not a fold up/pull out bed which was good.

title: Fabulous for families
text: We were party of 15 including children.Fantastic service. Front of house staff wonderful..Close to tube to central London. Advice. Check in is 2pm. Rooms are allocated on ad hoc basis of availability. If as we did, you need interconnecting rooms, do not use automated check in service. Mention to staff and they will sort out. Also kids eat breakfast for free. Highly recommend. Lady on desk came out to steps to take group picture of us at midnight! Wish I could post..

title: Lovely Staff
text: Stayed here for two nights over the weekend and had a very enjoyable stay. Staff were very polite and friendly at breakfast. One evening my auntie wasn't feeling very well and a member of staff got her a drink and came back later on to check if she was feeling any better. Nothing was wrong with our stay and would stay again.

title: Good location
text: Good value compared to other hotels in the locality, pleasant staff, good breakfast, excellent bed & shower, quiet location yet central. Everything is spanking new as this hotel opened only a couple of weeks ago. Close to Tower of London, Tower Bridge, London Bridge, only 15 minutes walk to St.Paul's Cathedral. Apart from a substantial breakfast I didn't dine at this hotel but I can recommend a very good Indian restaurant just below the hotel (downhill from the hotel entrance, turn right and it's only a few metres on your right)

title: Family room, good price, good location
text: We are a family of four from Canada and had a great experience at this hotel. The room had a double bed and two twins for the kids, which is actually better than two doubles/queens as the kids had their own beds! The room was spotless and very quiet. We paid for the full breakfast each day, which was good value but we maybe could have just had the continental a couple of mornings. The hotel is a short walk to the Tower of London and to the modern architecture of The City (Leadenhall Market and the Lloyd's Building are worth a look. We didn't go to the top of the Sky Garden, but that is also close by.) Tesco Express nearby is a good place to pick up picnic lunches, but to respect the busy workers from The City who also grab lunch there, perhaps shop before lunch time. The kids also loved riding the No.15 bus to Trafalgar Square, which we did every day, passing by St. Paul's Cathedral on the way. We also took a day trip to Brighton, with the train leaving from London Bridge station, about a 10 minute walk over the Thames.

title: Super family friendly hotel
text: Stopped here for 2 nights a group of 2 adults and 3 kids in 2 rooms, the staff especially Julian could not do enough, the family room was very spacious bigger than some I have previously stopped in in London would stay again with no hesitation

title: Business Meeting in London Central Business district
text: I stayed at the Premier Inn Bank (Tower) Hotel for one night on business. A very convenient, quiet, clean budget hotel in the middle of Londons business district with easy access to the river Thames, Tower of London, City bars, restaurants and other attractions.

title: Great Central Location
text: Great central location, 5 minute walk from London and Tower Bridge. Stayed here for a total of 3 nights over a weekend (check-in Friday, check-out Monday). Room was a decent size, a little bit of a tight squeeze between the desk and the bottom of the bed. Air conditioning in the room as well as a fan in my room (there wasn't one in my friends room, but that may be due to his room being bigger). The only thing that was a bit of a disappointment was the view. My room, and my friends room, looked into a block of offices. I would imagine the side that faces towards the river would be slightly better, but still masked by other buildings. Staff were friendly enough.

title: Weekend stay with family
text: Good location, close to Monument Underground station. Good rooms, clean, helpful staff members. A various breakfast. Could have a better spare bed, but had help to soften it with more covers. A bit stuffy air in the room, airconditioning could be a bit better. And would be nice with a small fridge. But in the whole a good stay, good value for the price!

title: Excellent Premier Inn
text: Stayed here a couple of times in November on business. Asked for a high floor room on each visit and was put on the 6th floor on a couple of occasions and the 7th floor on a recent visit. Hotel rooms were clean, comfortable and quiet. Food in the restaurant was very nice and would go as far to say it's one of the best premier Inns I've stayed in. Breakfast was typical Premier Inn with an all you can eat buffet. Staff were very polite and obliging.

title: Fabulous
text: Fab hotel, excellent breakfast, clean and friendly and prosecco £12 a bottle, what more could a girl want. Stayed at this hotel for a coup,Es weekend and we were not disappointed, recently stayed at a more exoensive hotel and the food and staff were far better here at this hotel

title: Grim and extortionate
text: The room was tired and old with marked, scuffed and jaded decoration. There was a stale, unclean odour that remained even with the air conditioning turned on and a soiled smell in the bed. The air conditioning turned itself off completely after a short while meaning it had to be continually reset. The windows could not be opened, however the room was on the 1st level overlooking a gloomy enclosed courtyard of loading bays filled with rubbish bins, cars and work people coming and going. Noise started at around 5:am with things being shifted and banged about. The window overlooking this area was filthy, adding to the depressing outlook, but the curtains had to be kept shut anyway as it was opposite offices which looked directly into the room. The bed was nothing like the advertising promised - hard and worn out with no give at all, in fact painful to sleep on. The double bed was made up of 2 single mattresses which meant there was a hard ridge down the middle and sleep for the 2 nights was very uncomfortable. One of the worst beds I have ever tried to sleep on. The bathroom fittings looked clean but the room smelt stale and used with brown and orange stains around the bottom of the shower and shower curtains. The shower was feeble though the water was hot enough. The check in process was marred when our booking could not be found and then both mine and my colleague's credit cards were declined by a fault in the system, meaning we had to be checked in by the reception staff which was awkward in front of a queue of other guests. We had booked 2 rooms for 2 nights and the experience in the other room was not much better. At £200.00 per night each, the rooms are scandalously overpriced and the hotel experience was completely misrepresented by the advertising. My 'overall thoughts' are Grim and Extortionate. To add insult to injury I expect that no action will be taken as a result of my feedback.

title: Great location and new facilities
text: Great location and a new hotel. A few downsides - the room is hot and airconditioning kept switching off. Very slow wifi which kept logging out. On the plus side the rooms are well apportioned and the breaksfast is good but it is a really greatl ocation for working in the City and connection to the tube network.

title: Historical location in London
text: I stayed here for 4 nights. every night I would walk over London bridge along the embankment past HMS Belfast and back over Tower bridge past the Tower of London. drop into the hung drawn and quartered for a drink and then back. This hotel is very central for old London, pudding lane where the Great fire started is in a short walking distance as is the monument to the fire. Walking at night I used to see a fox coming out of one of the many church yards. The tower of London is a a very short walk. I liked this hotel mainly for the location, I read many books on the Plague and the Great fire so to walk the roads and lanes mentioned was quite a buzz.

title: Central, clean, helpful staff
text: Great location, 3 minutes walk from Monument tube station. Very nice family room with two individual single beds for the kids and corner window looking up towards the 'cheese grater' building. Spotless bathroom. Really helpful staff, made sure everyone in our party was on the same floor and were great with the kids. Lovely breakfast, great fry and everything else from flat jacks to fresh fruit salad.

title: Fantastic value for money and location.
text: We stayed for one night, as we wanted to be close to the Tower of London. The location is great for this, as it was only a few minutes walk. It's also close to Monument station and Bank station is a little bit further. It's a fairly new hotel, so everything is pristine. Exactly what you expect from Premier Inn. Nice room, lovely comfy beds, very friendly and helpful staff, great breakfast and they even have a Ben and Jerry's vending machine in the lobby! We arrived early and our room wasn't ready, but bag storage was no problem and no extra charge. The amount we paid was pretty unbelievable in terms of what we got. We even had a view of the top of the walkie-talkie building from our room.

title: A city gem
text: We stayed here for a long weekend in August with our children aged 12 and 10 . This hotel is in a great position for most of London's land marks and others that are a bit further away it has good transport links you will be able to access ! Staff at this premier inn go over and above to help and with children that can make or break your stay ! Lovely clean room with air con and a great little restaurant below this hotel is fabulous for any family break .

title: overnight stay with friends
text: Very clean ,and friendly helpful staff very comfortable stay , would stay again It is very close to Fenchurch street station and very well located for a lot of things to do in london , they call a black cab which arrives very quickly

title: Lovely hotel
text: We was staying here when we was going the the world athletes champions at the queen Elizabeth Olympic park. Hotel was easy to find from the tube and only 4 min walk to. Was busy around the area as it was a Friday afternoon and people was finishing work but that was the only time it was as it was quite most of the weekend which was a very nice change for center of london. We turned up to the hotel to be greated buy a very friendly gentleman at the desk. We did try and book in online when coming over on the train but we couldn't so did try on the computer screen there and still no lucky but he was very helpful and friendly.. Room was nice and very clean and modern with always a very comfortable bed. We stayed for two nights and on the 2nd day we went downstairs to the bar to have a drink and just waste a bit of time before getting are train home. There was no one at there bar but was a buzzer. Pressed the buzzer but no come came. After 5 mins I popped up stairs to see where the staff was and ask the same man from 2 days before where the bar staff was. He said I will comedown myself and serve you. Was very nice of him and yet again was very friendly and helpful. Which I got him name as his customer survives was top class. We will be booking this place again when we come back to london in the future.

title: Optimal rate quality vs price
text: I suggest this hotel for value and cleanliness, breakfast is good. It is a perfect choice for families. I was there with two kids for one weeks. Personnel is quite nice, quality of sleep is excellent.

title: Nice hotel
text: It was the first time that we stayed in premier inn, good experience The hotel is not in the hyper center of London. You need to take the tube/bus to go to the city center to see the major monuments/museums, but the stops are in 3 min walk. The staff was very friendly and helpful. There is a possibility to leave the luggage for free at the reception desk.

title: Coming home
text: From the check-in until we four days later catched our bags on our way to Heathrow, we felt very welcome! The friendly staff made us all feel like home. We´re coming from Sweden, where you almost have to apologize when you want service at a hotel.

title: 5 Star!
text: We had a wonderful experience at this premier inn. I normally don't do less than 4 star in London, otherwise you are basically sleeping in a cupboard but I booked this at the last minute and thought it would be OK for one night. We were thrilled. the room was the biggest we have slept in in London and accommodated all four of us easily. The room was spotlessly clean, it looked very freshly decorated. It was also one of the coolest rooms I have every slept in! (why are hotels always so hot???!) but i could easily control the temperature when we needed a warm up. We ate down stairs in the Thyme restaurant and the meal was fantastic, great steak and chips and good child size portions, four of us ate a two course meal for £40 inc drinks, that would be good value anywhere but it is amazing in London. The breakfast next day was fantastic too, really good choice and lovely atmosphere - I normally find breakfast in hotels a bit stilted, everyone looking bleary eyed and a bit uncomfortable but with music playing and genuine happy staff it was a great meal. The food was great too. My only small niggle was that the car parking is not on site, you need to drive for about 5 minutes to get to it and then it's a five minute walk back but now that we know where it is we will come again! Thank you to all the staff. (oh and a top tip - go up the Walkie Talkie (20 Fenchurch St) just around the corner, it is free to go to the top and the views are amazing).

title: Good location, family friendly and good value!
text: You know what you’re getting with a premier inn and this is same, breakfast was busy and little cramped but it was half term so maybe that’s to be expected? Overall a good stay and would use again if available at good price.

title: Great Value - Lovely Staff
text: I've just returned from a girls weekend away staying at this hotel and thought it was great value. Good location, comfortable beds (with the second bed a "proper" one - albeit a single - which was a welcome surprise), fresh, clean, quiet, and just lovely staff - all at a very reasonable price. I'd definitely stay here again.

title: Great location, very clean and helpful staff
text: Great size family room for 2 adults & 2 children. Issue with one of the childrens bed. Breakfast area, staff and food quality really nice to get started for the day. Would have been 5 circle rating if not for the broken bed issue. All the thought through features you expect with Premier in, thank you. Close to Tower of London for bus tours or start of your London adventure. East side of most London attractions. Can walk along the vic embankment or over the bridge to the south bank. Museums, St Pauls cathedral and public transport links to get to all the main sites. Reasonable price for London.

title: Excellent stay
text: Great location, walking distance to the tube, Tower Bridge and Tower of London. Lovely breakfast that keeps you going around London and helpful and friendly staff. Wish we could open the window for some fresh air.

title: Grea Central Hotel
text: A very good, reasonably priced hotel right by the Tower of London. Nice staff and good accommodation make this an ideal location for business or leisure trips and stays, I would thoroughly recommend it

title: Does the job
text: New, decent value for the location

title: Good but could be better
text: Nice friendly staff but there are better located premier inns in London I thought I had booked Tower Hill but was disappointed when we arrived and we had booked this one! Our room was so close to an office block you could see people sitting at their desks and even what they were drinking! Not the best of views! Staff were lovely, breakfast was good. Just location and room view that let it down.

title: Above and beyond...A+
text: Excellent hotel in a superb location, ideal for our young family's trip to London. Very helpful and friendly staff. Close to shops and underground. Rooms were very clean, large enough for our three kids and us. The hotel realised it was my daughter's birthday and the manager surprised her with a lovely card and large box of Chocolates and few packs of goodies left in our room... She was delighted. It was very thoughtful and went above and beyond our expectations.

title: Very good
text: We spent great time at premier Inn during Christmas holidays. The room was very clean and comfortable and staff was fantastic. I would particularly thank Antonio for his kindness and availability. See you soon !!

title: Hotel break in London
text: Excellent base for sight seeing around London . Next to Tower of London , near to Shard and Monument . Easy to get to the tube to get around . Clean . Good , helpful staff . Would recommend . Breakfasts good and plenty of choice .

title: Disappointing
text: Had really high hopes for our long weekend in London at this Premier Inn after reading so many positive reviews. Unfortunately, we had a really bad experience here. Our room was extremely warm (with no way to significantly moderate the temperature) and there was loud noise every time someone in another room used the taps or the shower (apparently this was a known problem). Moreover, the sound proofing from the outside noise (we had a room close by the main road) was very poor. Thus, although the beds were comfortable, we really did not enjoy a good night's sleep during our stay. On top of this, we experienced some language barriers with the staff which made communication of these issues difficult. The only positive outcome of our experience was that, in light of the problems with the room, Premier Inn provided us with a full refund. This is a good company policy, but we would rather have had a nice weekend in the first place!

title: Weekend away with friends
text: Great location only a short walk from the Tower of London, Tower Bridge and St Katharine Dock. Friendly, efficient staff. Near to good bus links to get to key parts of London. We prefer the bus to the Tube as you get to see sights along the route although it takes more advance planning than using the Tube. Clean, comfortable rooms. Restaurant has a varied,tasty menu. Would recommend the evening meal and breakfast deal.

title: Always a great experience
text: I like Premier Inn, but this is something more. The staff make such a difference. I've stayed here numerous times and the people, from reception to bar to cleaners have the very best attitude and make my stay Thank you

title: London tower
text: Ideal place to stay if doing a river cruise or London Tower nice easy walk Hotel very clean and comfy, bar did a happy hour which in London is a good thing Bed was lovely and the room was quite. ideal for our needs

title: Superb Location for visiting London
text: Great location and convenient for Monument tube station (3 mins walk), approx 4 mins walk to main street with many cafes, pubs etc on it. Room was excellent in all aspects and the hotel is quiet generally inside and out, no problems with the family sleeping. Good size family room located on top floor and view to match.

title: Annoying
text: So arrived and needed an iron to iron a shirt for work tomorrow. Had to collect an iron from reception then go to the first floor to a room at the end to collect an ironing board, no cover on the board, then back to the lift up to the 4th floor where my room is, all this while carrying a suitcase and briefcase. Why dont they just put them in the room?? Pillow cases are dirty so take the ones down from the wardrobe and they are dirty too! Not a great experience premier inn thanks !

title: As advertised
text: As the advert promised -a great nights sleep - which is what you want no matter whether it's business or pleasure that keeps you from home. The experience was positive from easy booking to a good night's sleep. The central location was a real bonus for activities in Central London.

title: Lacking the human touch.
text: We stayed as a family at the beginning of November for a short break in London. The hotel is conveniently located near The Tower of London. Check in is an automated screen which is very impersonal and lacked the human touch. Our room was on the 7th floor and was everything we have come to expect of a Premier Inn - Comfortable bed, clean and spacious. We had a fantastic night's sleep and didn't hear any noise at all. Breakfast was a little disappointing. It was very busy and the cereal and juices are at one end of the restaurant and the cooked food, toast and coffee is at the other. All is a buffet service, however when you are travelling with children it is not convenient to make several trips to either end of the restaurant. Coffee and toast is all self served from a machine and it just lacked that human element again...

title: Good room but disappointing breakfast
text: Good, clean room and modern. Wasn't a bad size. Good central London location so not bad for the money. For the breakfast at £10.50 I expected the quality to be a bit better but it was disappointing. The sausages were inedible and amongst the worst I've ever had anywhere. The coffee was also bitter. I regretted paying for the breakfast and should have instead found a local café and had breakfast there instead.

title: Nice hotel
text: Very close to the tube station as well as being very close to the south Bank so good location indeed. What was very nice is that they had drinks for guests checking in which was a very nice touch when you arrive.

title: No faults, no problems.
text: Was here many times through work and each time the room was always spotless and cleaned everyday. Staff were pleasant and chatty when checking in and out, and there was never any real noise to disturb sleep during the weeks I stayed! You do have to pay for the Wifi, but to be fair for a tenner for the week it's not really much to grumble about. Can't comment on prices as I never paid but can imagine they are reasonable for the location.

title: Comfortable room, shame about breakfast
text: I have stayed here a few times. Staff are fine and the room a decent size and standard. This time the hotel was very busy and breakfast was chaotic due to lack of space - crazy layout and organisation. I couldn't be bothered trying to get all I wanted! This really needs improving for when the hotel is so busy. The cooked food was hardly warm. One coffee machine which is daft! Come on Premier Inn - I know you can do better.

title: Rooms ok but shocking resturant experience
text: stayed for 2 nights whilst running the London marathon. Booked in for a meal in resturant at 8pm on Saturday, by 9:05 we still had not been served,then when some of the meals arrived (they came in 2 lots ) they were appalling and I would have been ashamed to serve it. My husband refused to eat his cold lasagne and my pre race pasta was a disaster!!! Sunday breakfast equally bad, no plates,no bacon,poor food. Second stay at this hotel, first experience was better but not great. Spoke to staff who said that they couldn't help as the resturant was nothing to do with them. Won't stay again.

title: Excellent as usual
text: What can I say - easy to book and subsequently amend dates online. Room great, includes all you need with a comfortable bed and very efficient bathroom I am a Premier Inn fan so always look for a suitable room with them first - never been disappointed over a large number of stays . Given overall quality I very much doubt they need to pay on on their Good Night Guarantee!

title: restaurant
text: I have stayed here before and experience good service. However this week they seemed unable to cope and service was extremely poor in the restaurant for both dinner and breakfast. The queue was so large at breakfast I had to skip eating before going to a business meeting! I hope they can improve.

title: Good location but needs more staff
text: The hotel itself is located with easy access from Bank and Monument tube stations and situated near to the river so is also good for visiting tourist attractions. The rooms are clean, comfortable with working facilities (not always the case with hotels I've used!). Free wi-fi too. The price was also reasonable for Central London. The hotel loses marks for lack of staff on reception. Upon arrival, the automated check in would not accept payment - it wasn't just me, as there were several other people experiencing this problem too. I was kept waiting for nearly 20 minutes until someone appeared and then a further delay occurred until they had resolved checking in issues for other guests. These delays did make me late for a business meeting and caused inconvenience. I wouldn't blame the member of staff on reception as they were doing their best - there just wasn't enough staff on duty.

title: Good nights!
text: We stayed at the hotel only for sleep, but the beds were really comfortables and the was no noise in the room. The hotel is clean and cool. With free wi-fi and cheaper breakfast it would be perfect. I really recommend it if you want to have a cheap holidays in the centre of the city.

title: Perfect Location & fantastic staff
text: Perfect location right in the heart of the city and a short walk to all the main attractions, London Bridge, Tower of London etc. Spotlessly clean and comfortable and very quiet. Air conditioning was a bonus and very welcome in very hot London, tea and coffee in room and an area in reception to restock your room when needed plus water and juices - The staff are a credit to Premier and the hotel, all multi-national, very friendly, helpful polite considerate and hardworking, very very pleasant caring staff and nothing was an issue or problem. Bar was a bit slow one of the evenings but guy serving was also helping out in the restaurant in between checking people in upstairs, very much a team effort! Great, breakfast, fabulous, clean and efficient, food was constantly replenished and areas constantly cleaned and tables cleared, no rush, no fuss and the choice and quality was vast, something for everyone. We ate in the restaurant downstairs on one of the evenings (there for 2), good menu, something for everyone and very reasonable. This is my second stay in London in a Premier inn and would certainly love to go back and will recommend this one, we stayed over the bridge a few years ago and it was a bit manic and breakfast was a bit more of a scrum but was Christmas and very busy. Really is a gem of a hotel in such a big city. Check out is 12 lunchtime, unfortunately we got back late due to a river cruise and our key cards expired at 12 but not an issue, cleaning staff were already at our rooms cleaning round our stuff, we apologised, packed quickly and all was good, we even left our cases for the rest of the day in their luggage room and they happily printed off attraction tickets that we had booked on the day - well done to all, great stay, we will be back, thanks for being such a great bunch of people!!I I shall leave this review here and with the premier Inn directly - for info, we were a group of 11, 4 very comfortable family rooms!

title: Business Stay in Central London
text: Well located hotel close to London Tower and City. Good value and has all you need as a business traveler. Efficient online check in and out. Good breakfast. Very comfortable rooms. Nice restaurants close by.

title: Excellent
text: My only mild complaint is that the plates for the cooked breakfast were tepid. In all other respects an excellent, great value, clean, hotel: central (a half hour to ExCel on the DLR via Monument-Bank station, 5 mins walk away). Staff uber-helpful. Really couldn't fault it for a quality bargain hotel: this chain has comfort-with-utility down to an art.

title: Fantastic 5-night half-term stay!
text: Cannot rate this hotel highly enough! Location, service, cleanliness and food all top notch. Was especially delighted with my birthday breakfast cake-complete with singing staff-and flowers left in my room when they discovered I was staying there on my birthday! Would not hesitate to recommend this to anyone travelling to London. Blessed with good weather we easily walked (with an 8-year-old) to the London Eye then used the hop-on, hop-off buses (Big Bus-fab!) from Tower Hill to get further afield (i.e. Madame Tussaud's) whilst enjoying the sights. The free boat trip that came with the tour took us from Tower Hill to Westminster another day as well so with some planning you can get around easily!

title: Fab hotel for London city break
text: The hotel is in a great location for a city break. We had monument tube station a 2 min walk away and we could walk to and from lovely restaurants, shops and tourist sites within 15 mins. Great when traveling with children, and felt like a safe area. The breakfast was really good as hotel breakfasts go, all you could eat for 10.00 and the children ate for free. The family room was great with a double bed a single bed and 1 camp bed. Room was very clean. Would highly recommend this hotel and its amazing friendly helpful staff.

title: Fantastic
text: Very nice room. Front desk have been exceptionally helpful and have met every request I have had. Very well located and easy to get to. I will most definitely recommend this hotel to my friends and will be back for sure. Thank you premier inn!!!

title: High Standard Premier Inn
text: Just had 3 nights here over the Bank holiday. The hotel is very clean and the bedroom is comfortable. We had a triple room as our 11 year old grandson was with us. The extra smaller bed did not cause any problems so the room size was adequate for the three of us. Good tub/shower combination in the bathroom but as with all Premier Inn 's there is no solid soap, only the gel type in containers on the wall, something that I am not a fan off. Another small issue was that the maid seemed to store the contents of the two waste bins from our room in clear bags by the side of the wall just inside our room ! The room has a good sized flatt screen tv mounted on the wall with very good reception. The room looked out onto the City with views of the new high rise buildings alongside much older medieval churches. There are a few places to eat and drink near by as you are only minutes away from the Tower of London in one direction and the City of London in the other, there is also a good supermarket close by for stocking up on supplies. Breakfast was good but the dining area is not the biggest so with the hotel being busy this did cause long queues at times. All staff we talked to were polite. Checked in at 2pm hassle free with the help of a friendly guy on reception. The free Wifi was a added bonus. The hotel is very close to both Tower Hill and Monument tube stations. I would have no problems in recommending this hotel or returning myself.

title: Great nights sleep in a central location
text: We stayed here on a recent trip to London and had one of the best nights sleep. The staff were super friendly and helpful and helped us use the new automated check-in system. Great location if you want to go sightseeing with just a quick walk across the bridge to the Southbank. The only downside was that we struggled to book our room with a Canadian credit card and ended up having to borrow a friends British one. It could have been us but after 5 failed attempts they almost lost our booking.

title: great,quiet, central hotel very close to the Tower of London
text: We (2 adult and 1 child) had a great stay.Close to District line underground (Monument) and very close to the tower of london en tower bridgeSpacious room and very quiet.Nice restaurants close by (Blacklock, Burger & lobster)

title: Great for all the family
text: We recently stayed for a long weekend at this hotel. Couldn't fault it. Location was great, near to the Tower of London and Tower Bridge and we went for walks in the evening over to the south bank where there was a lovely Xmas market. Two tube stations are about 5 mins away so travel about London was easy. We booked the breakfast and dinner special offer and were very pleased with the selection and quality of the food. The staff were all extremely happy and helpful. Overall extremely pleased with our stay and would recommend this hotel.

title: Nice stay
text: Good service, nice and modern hotel with all the facilities. Good value for money for London. Near underground and bus in a quiet zone of London. We had a very spacious family room but the shower made a strange noise whenever we used it.

title: Only 30 minutes free Internet sucks!
text: Pros: No noise at all in the room

title: great hotel in london
text: For a family four this was a super hotel for a short break over the Easter weekend. Location is super for Tower of London & Monument underground station very close. The staff are really pleasant and helpful, breakfast took a while but everyone wants to eat at 8.30 - 9.00am, that's not the hotels fault, a little patience is all that's needed.

title: Great little place to crash for the night!
text: Good value for money especially when we include the breakfast :)Had a good night sleep with the whole family during the pre-Christmas trip to London.Rooms doesn't have intercom which can be an improvement area for a 5* service.

title: Not bad for budget
text: Firstly as someone who stays in these type of hotels a lot for work I always think Premier Inn beats Travelodge and this hotel is a good example of that. Friendly staff, clean, comfortable bed, nice bar and restaurant... Ok its not got much character but with what they've got to work wit they do the best they can. The only thing that let it down was my shower made an ungodly noise when it was on - really loud and it was a bit much first thing in the morning. Shame because it looked like a brand new shower but there is definitely a problem with it. Great location for getting out and about in London.

title: A great city break hotel
text: We knew Premier Inns are usually very good but the staff at this hotel made our stay even better. From the check in through to check out nothing was too much trouble. One of our party had limited mobility so the reception staff ensured they had a ground floor room. The staff at breakfast were excellent as was the breakfast itself. Particular mention needs to be made of Julian on reception. He was so attentive making sure everything was perfect. It was as if this hotel was his own and he went that extra mile to make our stay special. The location is excellent for the Tower, London Bridge and if you cross the bridge The Shard. If you like walking then go along the south bank from London Bridge to Westminster and beyond. Tube or taxi maybe needed for theatres etc. limited number of restaurants nearby but we managed to find a couple to avoid travelling. Overall a great stay.

title: Perfect for a London tour!
text: I stayed at this hotel 2 nights and I can confirm all the good reviews. The most important this to me, when I travel, is a good rest and night and I found this hotel very quite and perfect for this feature. It's in The City, walking distance from tower hill and tower bridge. Well located for tube (monument, bank and tower hill), cycle hiring (just behind) and restaurants, but also to visit the East London/City. I don't want to forget to mention the extremely helpful and kind staff. I think I'll definitely take in consideration Premier Inn for future stays. Thanks

title: Great stay
text: We stayed here for 5 nights. We were very pleased with our stay. Room was small, but I'm use to American size hotels and bed. Shower was a deep tub, had to hold on to something to get in and out. Close to tube. Overall a great stay.

title: Good but a little impersonal
text: We stayed 7 nights. Good location on a quiet wee street, close to the Tower of London and Monument Underground station (from which you can get to a lot of the key attractions without changing lines). Relatively new building, good furniture & fixtures and a comfy bed. Breakfast was good, however it was a bit odd that there wasn't an option for only a continental breakfast like at other Premier Inns, which is usually only 2/3 the cost. The big let down was the staff were rather impersonal. Even after a week of in and out and booking & eating breakfast, no-one seemed to recognise us, except for Rosie.

title: Great base for family weekend in London.
text: Very clean and close to the underground. Perfect as a base for weekend away. Very quiet at night. Breakfast was good, as in all premier inn’s. Staff were very helpful both on reception and in the restaurant.

title: Not great
text: I stayed herein January 2018. The location of the hotel is very good. Net to Monument underground station. The room I had was good in size but a bit old fashioned. I thought cleaning was not very thorough and they forgot to give new towels so I was left without. One night I had a drink in the bar and no beer on draft could be served.

title: Really good location next to the river
text: Clean room Clean bathroom Room quite big - i think 3 people would fit i.e. Couple with kid as in my room 524 there was additional bed/no sheets on it There was a kettle tea etc Friendly staff Quiet room Area felt safe You can walk and explore area to Tower bridge its a couple of minutes walk free wifi is good enough to use skype/viber/facetime voice (didnt check the video) and for 6 GBP you can get paid faster Internet connection There was no fridge/mini bar No iron in the room but you can ask for it at reception

title: Holiday
