text: Hotel was very clean and great hospitality. The staff and the director were very kind and helpful. The location of hotel is very good, close to many restaurant and 5 minutes from the greatest shopping mall of Europe_Westfield. I had a memorable experience out there..

title: Ideal location!
text: We stayed for one night as were goingvto a concert at Shepard’s Bush Empire. Couldn’t be any more ideal as was just across the road and so near to Westfield shopping centre. Roger was friendly and welcoming and the room and bathroom very clean. We will definitely return!

title: Fabulous Hotel
text: I have stayed at Her Majestys Hotel on many occasions

title: Outstanding
text: Superb location for accessing Shepherds Bush and for us exhibiting at Olympia. Nice welcome very friendly owner. Our room was immaculately clean and well presented. Beds comfy also. I will be rebooking for next year shortly.

title: Lovely room.
text: We stayed here over the bank holiday weekend. The room was clean and comfortable. Luckily we read about the cash only policy on the way over. The area is nice and near to the underground. Plus the Olympia event we went to was only about 10 mins walk. I would stay again, but I will book directly next time rather than use booking.com

title: Quadruple room
text: First things first they no longer serve breakfast, and only accept cash payments. Neither of which is clear if you book through booking.com Once this was explained everything was good, beds comfy pillows comfy (which never happens for me I am v picky with pillows lol) great location

title: A Wonderful Weekend In London
text: Well what can I say? Fantastic Hotel with just the nicest of staff. Breaky was yummy

title: WORST customer service BY OWNER himself
text: this man took one look at my family and his treatment was unacceptable. we had this place reserved for 3 weeks came by bus and train with infant and toddler in tow in the pouring rain. He wanted my 3 month old niece to stay in a room with a bed to herself, we explained that the baby could roll off the bed therefore she stay on a bed with the mother and he very rudely dismissed us and advised we go somewhere else saying "good luck" because everywhere else was booked. the Hotel next door was actually quite nice and updated. completely apart from this racist jerk

title: IF I COULD PUT NO STARS I WOULD .
text: This Hotel was simply the worst of the worst. MANAGMENT WAS An A-HOLE AND VERY RUDE. we booked A triple room for my family. 2 ADULTS AND 2 KIDS. and when we got there he told us our 10MONTH OLD wasn't allowed to sleep on the bed with mom and dad. that she needed her own bed. RIDICULOUS. On top of everything it was pouring rain and cold and wouldn't even let us stay inside as we searched for another hotel. Because we didn't want our 2 kids out in the rain. His words were "not my problem" .we left and booked another room right next door at the GRANTLY HOTEL. (WHICH WAS 100% BETTER THAN HER MAJESTY) IF YOURE LOOKING FOR A COMFORTABLE STAY WITH A family FRIENDLY AND NICE STAFF ALSO FOR A LOW PRICE. GRANTLY HOTEL IS IT!

title: Immaculately clean - great price!
text: I stayed here for 5 nights whilst exhibiting at Olympia. Lovely hotel, Clean, Continental breakfast provided. Free internet.Very safe, Great host and kind. Will definitely stay again. Great find. Very cheap for London.

title: Perfect location and perfect service
text: This hotel was just what we needed, not even five minutes to Westfields or the underground central line, the rooms were spotless and the service was incredible throughout - they couldn’t have been more helpful or made us feel more welcome, would recommend and will be staying again!

title: Excellent service
text: Her Majesty Hotel was fantastic, excellent service and friendly. Was easy to find and close to the London Underground , easy access to the city. The room was clean and tidy, comfortable bed and modern shower facilities. The owner was so helpful and kind. I would highly recommend staying whilst in London.

title: EXCELLENT SERVICE ON MY SECOND VISIT
text: I really enjoyed my stay at the hotel with excellent service from staff ,felt homely and would strongly recommend to stay at this hotel as its close to all facilities mosque,halalfood,shopping centres and much more....Looking forward for staying again . Mir Mujahed Ali Jeddah- Saudi Arabia

title: Amazing hotel
text: Her majesty hotel is the best I have ever stopped in in london. The cleanest room and the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in. I would recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a great stay whilst in the capital. The owner was so helpful and very kind to my son altogether a perfect stay.

title: Sightseeing visit
text: We visited from New Zealand and included two nights at London as part of our itinerary. The hotel was fairly easy to find, though Tomtom wasn't entirely accurate. The hotel has its own off street parking which is very convenient. It was a squeeze to park up but you need to appreciate parking is a premium in this area. A very warm and friendly welcome by the proprietor. The room was ideal for our needs, we chose a room at the rear as this would be quieter. The rooms are very clean with modern shower facilities. The London Underground just a short walk. Westfield shopping mall is just a short walk with a huge array of clothing outlets. There is a good selection of restaurants and eateries at Westfield. This hotel has very personal service which you would not find at the larger hotels. We would definitely stay again and would highly recommend.

title: Excellent find
text: Stayed 1 night, to attend concert at the O2 in Shepherds Bush, which is a 5min walk away. Although the outside of the building needs a little TLC, we received a friendly welcome from the owner, Mr Roger. Our double room was large, well-furnished, comfortable and most importantly, spotlessly clean. Good quality sheets. Modern ensuite, good power shower. Tea/coffee making facilities and tv in room. Phone, hairdryer. Breakfast perfectly adequate for advertised continental breakfast, staff very helpful and everyone friendly and pleasant. Nothing too much trouble. Hotel is quiet itself, but of course, being on a main London road, if windows are open there is traffic noise. No air/con, but I wouldn't expect that in a B&B. Price was excellent at £85, cash, no cards accepted. Plenty of decent restaurants/cafes/pubs nearby. We would certainly come here again.

title: Excellent Find
text: I called this hotel very much last minute on New Year's Eve to book a room for my wife and I. We were off to a nearby NYE party and decided against booking an Uber back home to Ascot. All the surrounding hotels were predictably booked and those that weren't were quoting figures in hundreds of ponds for one night. I got through to the hotel manager/owner (not sure which) who was charming and did a great job of assuring me that he didn't want any undesirables in his hotel. Which was actually quite reassuring. Suffice to say our room was extremely comfortable, everything worked, the shower room was lovely and the whole thing spotless. We didn't stay for breakfast although judging by the majority of comments earlier I suspect that would have been good too. Rojay seems to be very "hands on" and clearly loves his hotel - he worked at the Dorchester for many years so obviously knows a thing or two about the business. This is not an expensive hotel and for what is offered represents excellent, above and beyond value. I work in the city and occasionally need a stay over hotel so I am looking forward to returning soon!

title: I would recommend this hotel.
text: I stayed here for four nights. The location of the hotel is convenient, close to the underground and bus station. The rooms are nice and very clean .The staff is friendly and helpfull. I would recommend this hotel.

title: Great value and excellent location for stay in London!
text: I booked my stay here with housband because of the large number of positive reviews on TripAdvisor.com, and it lived up to its reputation. The location is excellent, about an 3 minute walk from the Shepherd Bush tube station and 4 minute from Westfield shoping centre. Near the Her Majesty Hotel are several good and reasonably priced restaurants of different cuisines. The bed was comfortable, and everything was very clean. Tea and coffe in the room. There is a television with a decent selection of channels, and the Wi-Fi. The continental breakfast has a standard but plentiful selection. Staff are very friendly and helpful. There is no place for disappointment here! Would visit again. Highly recommended!

title: Rude and Insulting
text: The booking process wasn't easy, and confirmation email was slow. We chose the hotel for it's close proximity to Shepherd's Bush Empire, where we went to see a concert, the hotel is only 100 yards from the venue. On arrival, they took our money, and then told my partner and I that had we not booked, we would not have been offered a room because of the way we were dressed. What were we wearing? Jeans, jacket and converse trainers... typical post grad student attire (and if you're wondering, no we don't have tatoos or facial piercings). I have stayed at one of the Hilton hotels, wearing the same thing to travel in, with no problems. We were told that it would scare people, and this was a family hotel. We were told REPEATEDLY at check-in that we were not allowed to smoke in the room or let other people stay, which we found extremely patronising. The room was clean, and there was no mould in the bathroom. However, the bed was narrow and the room and shower was cold during the day, the heating and hot water didn't come on until early evening. I've travelled a lot and stayed at a range of hotels around the globe, everything from the beach shack to the 5* spa resort. I've never been so insulted or patonised. If you're a young couple, I would definitely go somewhere else!

title: it was a wonderful stay at HMH. feel at home all throughout
text: i enjoyed my stays at Her Majesty Hotel all throughout. It is a quite, decent and central place stay in shepherd bush. very strategic and close to the underground train station and westfield shopping center amongst others. The management of the Hotel are so friendly above all matured.

title: Small, clean, cheap. Great value.
text: Stayed here in July 2005 in a single room for approximately US$60 per night. Very small room, but also very clean. Bathroom was the tiniest bathroom I've ever seen, but again, very very clean, which was more important to me than space. Owner takes pride in his establishment and it shows. Breakfast is a simple but tasty (and free) affair -- croissants, cereal, coffee/tea. Easily accessible via the tube in an offbeat, non-toursity neighborhood. Very safe, front door to the hotel is locked at night (guests are given a key). I was given a hair dryer upon request. Warning, you do have to pay for your whole stay up front. If you don't care about the size of your room and don't mind the short commute into central London, but want someplace inexpensive, clean, and safe, I highly recommend this establishment. Perfect for single travelers (I was a young woman traveling alone). I would absolutely go back.

title: Our Favourite London Hotel
text: If you want to stay at a hotel with a friendly atmosphere and get good value for your money, this is the hotel to book. The rooms are spacious and also very nice and clean. The manager and staff are always friendly and helpful, and both new and regular guests fell welcome. The hotel is located only a 3 minute walk from Sheperd's Bush underground station, and Westpoint shopping centre is just around the corner, so it's easy access to everything.

title: Lovely visit
text: Such a lovely visit of three nights! We stayed here nine years ago and everything was as good as it was then. Room was impressively clean, and breakfast nice (including toasts, croissants, cereals, jam, butter, juice and coffee or tea). There is a selection of good restaurants nearby and location is excellent - about a 5 minute walk from Shepherd's Bush tube station. In other words: Her Majesty Hotel is highly recommended!

title: An amazing experience.
text: I had come down to London to pay my son a visit and chose to stay at this hotel. I was there for about a week , they provide a nice continental breakfast , amazing staff , the service and hospitality is just spectacular. Made me feel like I'm staying at home with my family members. It's situated at a very nice location, making it easy to travel and explore London. Would definitely recommend this hotel to everyone. And would love to check in anytime I'm in London.

title: Lovely hotel for sightseeing in London
text: Spacious family room that was ideal for our family of 5. The beds we comfortable and the room had a clean and up-to-date en-suite bathroom. There was a nice selection of breakfast foods available. All staff were extremely friendly and helpful. The local amenities were excellent with a wide range of shops, restaurants and takeaways very close by, and with only a 5 minute walk to 2 different tube stations it is well placed to explore the whole of the London area.

title: Charming, but with some drawbacks
text: We booked this hotel based upon the positive reviews here on TripAdvisor and the fact that most London area hotels are much more expensive. Overall, we feel the pros outweighed the cons, though not for everyone in our group. There were 8 of us staying in 3 rooms. My husband and I had a small double room, with an in-room bath (no tub, just a small shower that never lost its supply of hot water!). Our bed was VERY comfortable. No complaints there. Our room faced the very busy street along the Shepherd's Bush park area, so we had to choose between a stuffy room with no a/c or fan and extremely loud street noise. A fan would have made a huge difference. Our daughters and their friend shared a triple room, but the maid pulled out a trundle bed and the 4 were accomodated very well. The beds in this room were also very comfortable. Noise didn't seem to be much of an issue for them, as they didn't face the street. My mother and brother shared a room with two beds. It was a larger room with an in-room bath (no tub, but a shower, toilet, sink). They were also facing the street, so the same noise dilemma that we faced. But the real problem for them was the poor quality of the mattresses on the two beds in their room. Very, very bad and it resulted in terrible nights' sleep. When they spoke to the owner/manager, he just said there were no other mattresses (though there were available rooms and he didn't arrange a switch). It really detracted from their stay and made it more difficult to enjoy the day's sightseeing, after such a bad sleep. This is a lot like a bed and breakfast, just with 16 rooms. Not in the best area of town, though the subway is close by. The employees were extremely friendly, extremely helpful. And the hotel was exceptionally clean. So for us, the pros outweighed the cons, though I think my mother might not agree because of the mattress problem.

title: good value for money
text: The hotel is rather a small b&b suitable for families. The rooms are ensuite and clean. Its location is perfect(transport to centre of London is easy and quick) with 2 undergound stations and 1 railway+ overground and a lot of buses. If you are a fusy eater, there are lot of restaurant to choose from nearby and a very big shopping centre. We had continental breakfast like jam, butter, toast etc which for us was fine. Also we had a lot of advise from the staff(they were very kind and helpfull) about travelling, London attractions and anything else we wanted to know. They make you feel like you are at home. If we would ever come back to London, we would choose this place again.

title: Never disappoints
text: I always enjoy my stay here. Clean rooms, lovely breakfast and the people working there, as well as Mr Rogers, are always so nice and welcoming. This hotel is about a 5 minute walk from Shepherd's Bush tube station (red line) in less than 15 minutes you're in Oxford Circus. If you prefer the scenic route, I'd recommend taking a bus. It takes longer but so worth to be at the top of a double decker! Already planning my next stay! Thanks so much!

title: Excellent friendly welcoming place to stay
text: We booked 2 rooms in December, one for my friend and her 2 children. Another for my husband and I. Both were well equip, very clean and lovely views of the green outside. The shower was nice and powerful and I particularly like having tea and coffee facilities which were replenished daily. The breakfast is continental, nicely presented. You help yourself to a wide range of cereal and fresh fruit while tea, coffee, toast and croissants are done fresh to order. Fantastic location for the tube for central London, we also visited Lego land (45min drive) and Westfield Shopping centre is a short walk away. We also went while the fun fair was outside on the green, a highlight for the kids and big kids. A nice Italian restaurant just 2 doors away too. We were well looked after and will definitely be back.

title: Terribly rude!
text: I had booked a room with this hotel for September. My husband is critically ill and I had to cancel this reservation. I did not receive any confirmation of the cancellation and finally called this morning to make sure that they had gotten it. When I did book this room in July I had written to change the arrival time without a problem. The man answering said he had no time for people like me that book a room and then cancel. They are much too busy, said that they had sent a reply and said bye and hung up. Needless to say, if we do get the chance to go to London I will not book here. What kind of a business would treat someone like that at such a terrible time in their lives?

title: Fabulous friendly hotel.
text: Spent 4 lovely nights here end of October. Manager & staff very friendly, helpful and provided much needed local tips on good restaurants. Free WiFi, lovely continental breakfast, room cleaned to a high standard every day...well worth a stay here. Shepherd's Bush has lots of bars & good eating places ...Her Majesty's Hotel is central to everything including 3 tube stations and a 5 min walk takes you to Westfield Shopping Centre.

title: Pleasant
text: Quite a pleasant place 2 stay. The rooms were clean with the usual amenities. Breakfast although not a cooked English one was good with a choice of fruit juice ,cereal and toast or croissants with tea or coffee and fresh fruit. Perfectly situated if you are going to an event in the 02 empire. Lots of traffic outside but room was quiet!! Staff were pleasant although we were asked 3 times in 1 day what time we were checking out. Handy for train / tube / bus. I would stay there again.

title: very friendly!
text: used the hotel on recommendation from a friend. Basic business class accomodation but very well priced for a one night stay. Close to the subway,so i made it to my meeting in central london in 15 mins.

title: An absolute disgrace for breakfast
text: I paid £ 90.00 and the best they could offer their ( guest ) for breakfast was toast!!!!. Two old glasses of orange juice with a napkin placed over them on a table in the corner!!!!!. It's just a complete rip off and wished I had paid a bit extra and stayed at a hotel that actually looks after its guests. What a joke and am off to McDonald's now!

title: all you'll ever need
text: Excellent hotel,great position overlooking shepherds bush green.Very clean,nicely decorated.Busy area but good double glazing.Plenty of continental breakfast,you won,t go hungry.Friendly and helpful staff.Good choice for anyone going to empire gig or shopping,and further entertainment in london town.

title: cut-price hotel with cut-price value
text: I had a "luxury" single room - offering a TV and coffee-making facilities. Room was small, but clean and adequate, ditto bathroom. Breakfast was minimal in a small breakfast room. However room was very quiet, inspite of facing a busy road. Some warnings: 1) no visitors allowed in rooms, apparently a safety rather than a moral regulation. This is a nuisance if you want to meet someone, since there is little public space. In fact the manager kindly made an exception for my daughter. 2) no lift, which can be a nuisance if you're handicapped of have heavy luggage. 3) credit cards not accepted. I chose this hotel because it was close to my daughter's student flat, and communication by bus or Underground is very good. I wouldn't choose it as a holiday experience.

title: Can't fault the price!
text: A small private hotel - really a BB. Good location a few minutes walk to 2 tube stations and close to the Westfield. Very friendly and helpful manager and staff. The single room was tiny (think cabin or student room) but it was clean and the ensuite bathroom had a decent shower and was spotless. The room was very quiet- at the back of the building with no road noise. Only the bed let it down - a single bed with a very uncomfortable divan base. Absolutley a bargin for London though, so highly recommended if you're on a budget.

title: Lovely! Great location.
text: My daughter and I stayed for one night, Friday 5th Sept as we went to a show at nearby O2 empire Shepherds Bush. Very close to the venue, close to underground station. Room spotlessly clean, bathroom very clean and modern. Staff very friendly and helpful, I'd read a lot about the owner and was looking forward to meeting him, but no sign. The girls more than made up for it though. The breakfast was lovely, very tasty, very plentiful and the lovely girl asked if we wanted more. We are both highly delighted, and would not hesitate to recommend to others, and will use it again. Thank you.

title: great location and value
text: What we liked: the kindness of the employees

title: Solid value, very clean.
text: I booked a single, the smallest accommodation. Not much room, but for £55/night I got my money's worth. Every day my bathroom was cleaned (could smell the bleach) and new towels were provided. A suggestion for those not familiar with B&Bs- bring your own wash clothes, big bar soap and shampoo. Breakfast was continental and plentiful. The staff was very customer focused and worked on practicing their English when possible. Two girls from Poland and one from the Czech Republic. A warning for Americans that can't live w/o Air Conditioning. In a hot summer, this place is not for you. If you can tolerate warm evenings, then gives this place a go. Cheers.

title: Gold Coaster loved HM
text: Highly recommend Her Majesty. Manager and staff so helpful. Had front room but double glazing kept noise to minimum. Bathroom v modern and overall room v clean and comfortable. Excellent value for money. Close to shops & transport.

title: Good Solid accommodation for great value
text: This B&B offers everything you need when visiting London. I booked 3 rooms for my 5 family members for 3 nights in June/July. The double rooms were surprisingly spacious for a budget hotel in London with a warm and inviting decor. It had comfortable beds, and a good size bathroom, TV, phone, small sitting area and closets, tea and coffee in the rooms which were replenished daily. Wifi for free and the continental breakfast contained toast, cereals, coffee, orange juice and fruit. We were on the first floor overlooking a small park. I enjoyed waking up and drinking my coffee watching the world go by. Some guests in previous posts said they had issues about noise, we did not once the windows were closed and we slept comfortably. The owner was always present and friendly and strove to make our stay comfortable. One could see that he ensured that the standards were maintained. Our issue with the TV channels was quickly resolved and he arranged for a taxi to take us to LGW at a very good rate. The location was great, about 5 minutes to Shepherd Bush metro and bus stations and the large Westfield Shopping Center and numerous eating places nearby. I would certainly stay there again.

title: Not luxurious but lovable, clean,and convenient.
text: My wife and I stayed five days here and enjoyed ourselves immensely. The rooms are average-sized by London standards, adequately furnished, have renovated baths, and most importantly are very clean. If you are bothered by noise, ask for a room at the back. We overlooked the street out front, which was rather noisy with traffic, but neither of us is bothered by noise. We found the breakfast plentiful with a variety of cereal, fruit, croissants,and toast. The hotel is located just across from Shepherd's Bush, a safe if not posh, area of London. There are ample and good restaurants within walking distance, a tube stop on the Central line a block away, and the Overground railroad across from the tube stop. We found we could be into central London in fifteen minutes. Perhaps the best feature of Her Majesty is the owner/manager, Roger, who was once a Valet du Chambre at a luxurious London hotel that had such guests as Richard Burton and Onassis. Roger is helpful, kind, and attentive. After the first night, he moved us to a larger room when it became available by chance. All in all, we felt at home, and the price is quite reasonable for always pricey London There is no lift, but the staff took our bags up and offered to take them down when we left.

title: Great little B&B.
text: I've spent a few days at Her Majesty Hotel and found it to be a great B&B. It has friendly staff and for me most importantly is that the room with bathroom was very clean and I had no problems staying there, not like some other places I've been unfortunate enough to end up in... After that breakfast was ok for me, I just need coffee :) I think one of the other reviews on here is in error as there is no cooked breakfast, however there's enough cereals, fruit, toast etc... there to keep you going. I only needed access to west london so it was ideal, however there are 2 tube/metro lines and I managed to get to Oxford Street in central London in 15mins once. It's located in quite a busy area but there's a nice little park in front of the hotel which adds to the atmosphere of the area. One thing that was good for me was that there are a number of shops nearby open 24hrs, so you can get pretty much what you may need when you want. All in all it was cheap and ideal for me.

title: Nice and convenient
text: We were going to see a concert at the Shepherds Bush Empire, and didn't fancy the long trek home after the show. We therefore looked up hotels nearby and saw that Her Majesty Hotel had good reviews. The hotel was small, compact and friendly. It was fairly basic, but gave us all that we needed - comfortable beds, spotlessly clean and right on the doorstep of The Empire, and the underground to get to work the next morning. At £85 it was very good value for such a location, and we were very glad to be able to simply cross the road and climb into bed once the show had finished. They don't take cards, so make sure you have cash to pay for the room.

title: Very nice hotel!
text: This was our second time at Her Majesty Hotel from May 1st - May 5th. The hotel owner is a very kind man from Mauritsius, who is taking good care of his guests. We enjoyed staying at this hotel, and we will definitely come back again to this beautiful and lovely hotel with a cozy atmosphere.

title: Fantastic!
text: Just got back from a 3 night stay at this fab little place which is in such a good location! Rooms and all communal areas are really clean, breakfast was great each morning - tea, coffee, fruit juice, cereal, croissants, fresh fruit and toast what more do you need? Tea and coffee making facilites in the rooms and a TV. Staff all really friendly, especially the manager I didn't catch his name but what a nice chap. Reasonably priced and has everything you need, would definitely stay again!

title: Exceptional hospitality
text: We had booked a room at a different hotel but they booked us as single. We scrambled on a Saturday late in the day to find another room. Not only did we find Her Majesty Hotel the owner Roger greeted us allowed us some special accommodations but went above and beyond to help plan our activities and much more. Our room was very clean, quiet and I felt we had special security and assistance that we would not have had elsewhere. If I come back to London I will make a special trip to visit Roger.

title: OK but not great
text: After reading all the great reviews at TripAdvisor, we chose to stay in this B&B Hotel while in London earlier this month. However, I find it difficult to understand what is so great about this place. Ok, the rooms are very clean and there is no mold, but the traffic noise is awful, the bed is narrow and short, there is not always hot water, and it is difficult to shower in the extremely small bathroom (with a funky shower). There is some hammering going on sometimes starting at 4 o'clock in the morning. You also constantly need to explain yourself (i.e., where have you been, did you buy something, etc.). The breakfast is not good at all, there is nothing warm or even yoghurt or pastry. It seems to me that they serve as little as they can, to still be able to call it breakfast. Also, the hotel is very far from the city center. Yes, there are two metro lines nearby, but last trains go around midnight and you certainly don't want to travel this far with a taxi cab. This basically means, that you will not have time to have dinner of drinks after a night in theathre. Also, you will spend a lot of time sitting (or standing) in the trains during your holiday. It is not practical to just stop by at your hotel room during the day (each return trip taking almost an hour), but rather you have to stay on the move the whole day. Although I would not recommend this hotel, there are no serious problems either. However, it can be difficult to make a reservation here, as the staff does not reply to E-mails very well. It felt a bit risky to go without a reply to a confirmation E-mail!

title: Great Place!
text: Traveling with another girls for 2 weeks in January 2014. Room is newly refurbished very pretty and clean. Shower room small but very clean and fresh towel daily. Continental breakfast was satisfied. The small hotel was clean , very quiet and peacefull witch is very important as I need my sleep at night. Easy transport, 2 stop by underground to madame Tussauds, 1 stop to Notting Hill Gate and the Royal Borough of Kensington. The girls and manager working at the hotel was polite and helpfull. I DEFINITELY RECOMEND THIS PLACE

title: The Best Bed&Breakfast in London
text: For student days I worked in this hotel . After a few years I returned to London with husband and two-year daughter on business matters . It is the best place you can choose for bisnes , family trip or honeymoon , not only because of the attractive room rates . The hotel has a very good location on Shepherd Bush Green . Very close is located in Westfield shopping center , two underground station and many buses to central London (20 minutes). In front of the hotel there is a park . There are also many shops and restaurants. The hotel is very clean , well maintained and safe . The rooms have new beds , new televisions, new bathrooms . The hotel has a very good heating and hot water . The rooms are thoroughly cleaned every day . The room has a kettle , tea and coffee. Breakfast is continental - toast, croissants , coffee, tea , milk, cheese , butter , cereal , jam, marmalade , honey , juice and fruit. The breakfast is sufficient. The hotel has a warm atmosphere . The staff are very friendly and helpful. We would certainly recommend this place and would definitely go back there again .

title: Fantastic
text: I spent a great time at this excellent hotel. All the staffs are very polite and with a good knowledge about the fire department rules. I found the hotel completely clean, the breakfast with fresh food and the most important, a good price. I am a 100% sure next time in London I will “live” at HER MAJESTY HOTEL! Trust me, it is not a hotel it is like your own house.

title: Quiet and restful
text: I would recommend Her Majesty Hotel. Here is a list of the amenities. Breakfast - filling. Each table got a basket with each person getting 2 toasts and a large croissant, plus orange and apple juice, coffee and tea, cereal, fruit, cheese, and jams, jellies, and Nutella. Bathroom - very good water pressure and hot water did not run out. Beds - clean and comfortable. Room - when the window was shut, I heard no noise at all from the outside, even though there is a busy street outside. View - a lovely view of Shepherd's Bush park from the side of the hotel out room was on. Close to: Shepherd's Bush Market, tube stop, a GIANT mall, a park, a library, bicycle rental, cafes and lots of fabric stores on the 2-block walk to the tube. Staff - very friendly and made us a cup of tea when we came in exhausted from traveling all night from the US. The owner greeted us every time we came in. Cost - I knew it was reasonable (about $135 a night USD) but after I saw the prices for everything else in London, I feel it was an even better deal. There was wi-fi that worked fine (some earlier reviews for this hotel said there wasn't any) and a hair dryer, TV, and tea setup in the room. There is parking available in the front. Possible drawbacks: There is no elevator, but I found that most of London is not very friendly to to those who may have mobility issues. Once we came to breakfast the very minute it ended and the girl didn't offer us anything at all, so we had to get breakfast down the street at Liz Cafe. I think she should have made an effort even thought it is true we should have gone down even 10 minutes earlier. Payment must be in cash once you arrive, so be prepared. On balance, I would stay here again with no qualms.

title: My favourite
text: Loved staying here. The staff is incredibly helpful and friendly. Nice, comfortable beds, clean room and bathroom, nice view and great location. To be honest, I prefer to stay here than the big hotels around the corner.

title: Cosy hotel
text: We had an excellent 4 days stay in this hotel. Rooms are very clean, single one is small others are bigger. Good breakfast, modern bathroom, and above all very helpfull manager. Few stops with the central line to the center. We will definitely come back.

title: Def stay again!
text: Whilest working at the BBC on Wood Lane for a few weeks at a time i wanted to find a hotel that was in walking distance as well as clean, friendly, resonably prices and had a home from home feel to it. i certainly found this here! I would definately recommend to both business people and tourists as the hotel is only a few minutes walk from a tube station on the central line. lindsey from leeds

title: Comfortable & Safe Hotel.
text: Enjoyed a comfortable 4 nights stay (8 to 12 June) at this hotel which is in a great location. The rooms (one single and one single deluxe) were clean and comfortable. The en-suite bathrooms are compact but modern and functional. The continental breakfast was of a good quality - consisted of fruit juices, packaged cereals, warm croissants, toast (Warburton bread), jam/marmalade/honey/butter spreads, fruit, tea and coffee. The manager (owner) was courteous, friendly and helpful - as were the staff. Some reviewers mention that the manager insists on no visitors to the rooms. The manager's explanation for this is to ensure the safety and well being of the hotel's guests and their possessions - I find this policy to be reassuring. The location is ideal for travelling across London - the following stations are within 2 minutes walk of the hotel: Shepherds Bus underground and overground railway station, Shepherds Bush Market overground Station and Goldhawk Road underground station. Westfield Shopping Centre (5 minutes walk) and Hammersmith shops (10 minutes walk) are close to the hotel. Nearby there are plenty of pubs and restaurants which serve a variety of lunches and evening meals. I will be returning to this hotel on my next visit to London.

title: Above average for budget, but it's still budget....
text: The Good Location (near the TUBE), neighborhood (cheap food shopping, international fare, big malls), the price, breakfast. The Bad Staff cannot indicate directions around hotel, limited English language speaking, non-social, micromanages guest, not particularly polite, nosy and controlling. Room is quite modest, and showers are too small within the room. Two pieces of soap, but no shampoo. Does not permit guests to the room under any circumstance. Average noise pollution.

title: Nice little hotel
text: Stayed there for a few days in April. Service at the hotel was great, the rooms were very clean and all have en-suite bathrooms. Very reasonable rates and about 2 minutes walk from Shepherds Bush station. The bed wasn't the most comfortable but it did the job! I'll most likely stay here for a return trip.

title: Location and service
text: The hotel have good location to the underground and its close to Westfield shopping center. Only 10 minutes to Oxford street with the underground. It is 10 minutes walk to Primark and a nice shopping street in Hammersmith. We really like the manager, he is nice and helpful. Nice clean room!

title: Excellent service and a secure place to stay
text: Her Majesty´s Hotel is a central located hotel in the West of London. Opposite the hotel is Shephards green. Three tube stations, Westfield shopping Center and al lot of small good international restaurants and small take aways. A very good choice if you stay for a business trip in London. The service is excellent and the hotel team is always taking care for you, to stay at a secure place. Tiny rooms with always renewed and refurbrished interior gives a warm atmosphere. Clean and new towels everyday I really enjoyed the four nights. Thank you

title: Wonderful stay
text: My family and I stayed in the hotel for 3 days.The hotel location is very good close to the underground- pleasant environment - big shopping center around. The rooms were very clean and well maintained and the manager is a very kind and helpful person.

title: A great pleasant stay
text: When we arrived, the owner was very kind and helpful. The room was above average, with a flat screen tv, ultra comfortable double bed, lovely view over the park, large enough for both suitcases and a clean up-to-date bathroom with a wonderful powerful shower! Breakfast was nice, with a selection of cereal, fruit, toasted bread which was lovely, and pastries. Coffee, tea, orange juice, milk or multifruit juice were available. All in all, this breakfast was filling and varied. The rooms and the hotel were always clean, the staff friendly and the area is close to the centre. Along the same road is the bus-stop and the underground station, which is only a few stops away from the sites and shopping area. The area is well catered with shops and there is a shopping mall close by. All in all, the hotel was great, friendly, clean and comfortable. It was a very enjoyable stay and hopefully we will visit Her Majesty hotel again in the near future!!! This hotel is very recommended to all...

title: Convenient location
text: I stayed in this hotel for 4 days with my 2 friends. The hotel room is nice. It's near to the metro station and we can find many grocery stores nearby. However, the service is only average. The receptionist was not very willing to answer our questions when we asked for direction for sightseeings.

title: A Home away from Home!!
text: My husband and 22 year old daughter spent 6 wonderful days at Her Majesty Hotel. They were in London to setup my daughter's studio apartment for graduate school. The rooms were clean and serviced everyday. The breakfast was deliciious and they even made a plate to bring up to the room for my daughter every day as she slept past the time breakfast was served. My husband and daughter were coming and going all day as they were busy buying essentials for my daughter's apartment and each time they entered they were greeted and offered assitance in anything they needed. The owner even offered to drive them to my daugher's aparment instead of calling a cab so they could bring all their purchases to her new aparment. They could not have felt more at home and want everyone to know about this wonderful hotel. We plan on staying there when we visit my daughter in the spring.

title: Horrible hotel
text: Stayed at hotel for one night the chap on reception is not helpful and just goes on about no guests in room no smoking no this no that , you can not relax at this hotel stay else where , this is not worth staying at

title: Great days in London
text: Visiting London during The Olympic Games, 3 days in august , I stayed at Her Majesty Hotel. I met a very friendly staff and when I had a problem with my suitcase (lock was broken) Holger (the owner) drowe me in his car to a store, where they could open my suitcase... :-) So a very good first impression! - Rooms are functionable and clean. All with bath and some with a small kitchen. The hotel is quiet and cozy and close to the tube (Shephaerd Bush) and for my purpose, a central place and easy to get to center of London. Close to Hyde Park, Shepherd Bush Market, Westfield Shopping Center, BBC... So, a small hotel with a good and friendly atmosphere, which I can recommend any time and I will be back there next time I visit London... :-)

title: No internet and no phone in the rooms
text: Good room, but with a really small toilette. The employees were always in a bad mood and to complete the terrible experience, there is no internet (wireless nor wired) and no way to call external numbers from the room, that's why I do not recommend this hotel.

title: Terrible
text: A low quality hotel. What a horrible, noisy, pokey room from the start. The written hotel room policy says "no visitors after 11 pm" but I was physically stopped taking my son to my room (to fetch a map) at 10pm. Despite constant argument that the written hotel policy (displayed in the rooms) prevented visitors only after 11pm, management totally refused to be reasonable and wouldnt let my son into the hotel to visit my room, for which I had paid £110!!! It was absolutely dispicable behaviour on behalf of the hotel manager, who, when questioned about the no guest policy said "I don't want homosexuals, prostitutes or drunks in here." Lovely guy!! Because of this I ended up having to take my business elsewhere. Would he give me a refund on the unused night? You guessed it!!

title: Nice place, well situated
text: We spent 2 nights at "Her Majesty Hotel". The hotel is really well situated, and the neighborhood is nice ! The room was a little bit small, but very clean ! As London is a really expensive city, this hotel was perfect for the price.

title: Well-run hotel
text: I stayed here with a friend for four nights. The hotel is very clean and welcoming, and the bedroom was of a good standard, including the shower room which looked very modern. Breakfast is fruit juice, cereals, tea or coffee, croissant and toast, and was included in the price. Beds were comfortable. Our room was at the front, which was a bit noisy from traffic when window was open (only), but then you do get a very open view of the trees on the green. This hotel is well run, and definitely worth considering.

title: A great find
text: My brother and I stayed at Her Majesty hotel for 8 nights in May 2012. We had a downstairs room in the back with a double and single bed. The room was very quiet, reasonably large, and nicely decorated. The bathroom with shower was very small but functional. Fresh towels and iinens were provided every day. The beds were comfortable. Above all, everything about the room and hotel was extremely CLEAN. Breakfast was just fine, with a selection of cold cereals and fruit. As soon as we came down for breakfast each morning we were offered coffee or tea and after the second day when our preferences were known it was automatically brought to us. Freshly made toast and warm croissaints were brought to us right after we sat down each day and there was a good selection of jams and jellies. Throughout our stay we were made to feel very welcome. We felt the price of lodging was very reasonable for the quality received. We also really liked the Shepherd's Bush neighborhood as a place to stay, It has very close walking access to 3 different Tube stations so anywhere in London was very easy to get to. There were a good selection of pubs nearby and a wide variety of small restaurants serving about any type of cuisine you could think of. There is a very nice modern upscale shopping mall (Westfield) about 2 blocks away. We especially liked the fact that Shepherd's Bush is a real Londoners' area so the people you encounter on the Tube and in the pubs and restaurants are locals not tourists -- and people were friendly and helpful. The neighborhood is very ethnically diverse, which we enjoyed. Her Majesty hotel worked out extremely well for our vacation stay and I would definitely stay there again.

title: best value- hospitaliy-safety
text: We have just returned from London. Our travel in London was fabulous. The hotel was cool, in a beautiful place, in front of it was a park. Good neighborhood, not very far away from the center of London. The tranportation was terrific and we could take any transport we liked in front of the hotel. The room was quiet and we felt safe their. The room was very clean everyday there was someone there to clean the room and the toilet although it wasn't very big was very clean with hot water everytime. The shower was very clean and the door was sealed.There was no fridge, or air contition but we have no problem with that because the weather although it was 28th of May it was like our January. Too cold for us!!! Mr. Roger the manager, I suppose, was very gentle and very helpful. It was always there for us. We had great time with him. The breakfast, wasn't very big but you could have a simple and healthy breakfast, corn flakes- milk, bread and butter/marmelade, tea, fruits. There isn't any lift but only stairs. We could not expect something different because the building is too old and charming, and I think that when it was built there were no lifts. There are only 3 floors. Near the hotel about 2 minutes away, In Goldhawk Road, there is a pretty polish restaurant, very clean and cheap. It is called Patio Restaurant. Don't forget to go. We taste many different cousines in London. We didn't like the British food was very heavy for us. We went to an amazing restaurant called Gaucho [--] 25 Swallow Street, near Piccadilly underground. It has an argentining cousine, not cheap. We ate many different plates, and desserts, and 2 glass of wine and the account for 2 persons was 100 pounds.Don

title: Not a *5, but perfect in other ways.
text: Hotels in London don't come a lot cheaper than they do at Her Majesty. And if they do, they're tiny and often lacking in basic amenities (like hot water) at best--or absolutely decrepit at worst. Actually, the same can be said of many much more expensive hotels as well. Thus, I was shocked at the cleanliness and size of the rooms at Her Majesty. No one ever pretended it was 5 star quality, but the owner strives hard to make sure that what you do get is spotless and comfortable. I'm not sure there's a better bargain in town honestly. The only negative, IMO, is the location. Shepard's Bush Green is fine, but it is a little bit outside of many of the areas that us non-Londoners want to frequent when we come to stay in the city. However, it does have easy access to the tube (2 stations within 2 or 3 blocks--Shepard's Bush on the central line and Shepard's Bush Market on the Circle & Hammersmith and City lines... all zone 2), so central London isn't more than about 15 minutes away. Overall, if you're looking for a cheap, no frills London getaway that is immaculately clean with lots of comfort for value, this is a great option.

title: Very clean, great service, comfortable bed - just what we needed!
text: Her Majesty Hotel was a perfect choice for what me and my fiance were looking for this past weekend. We currently live in Norwich, and we just wanted a weekend away in London. Her Majesty was VERY clean, and the room was VERY comfortable and quite spacious considering it is London. We slept very well on the bed, and we had plenty of hot water everyday. It was quiet, and the service was wonderful. The owner is very friendly and he goes out of his way to help you and talk to you. The prices are VERY affordable for London as well. The only possible downside is the fact that it is not located in central London. Having said that, the location is not necessarily bad by any means... it is very close to the Shepherd's Bush tube station, so you have easy access to central London if that's what you are looking for. It is also only two tube stops away from the wonderful Notting Hill area which I personally could spend days exploring! So the location is really a matter of what you are looking for and what your needs are. If you are a big family looking to have a holiday in central London and see all the sights, then you might find it inconvenient to stay in this area. All in all, we had a great experience and it was just what we needed. We would definitely stay there again!

title: Great For London Business Too!
text: Stayed for the BETT Exhibition at Olympia for 4 nights and was very happy. Very Clean, Comfortable, Homely rooms! Roger is a really nice and 'honest' owner after he realised I had overpayed! Waste of money staying at the Travelodge and PremierInn when you have this so close to Shephards Bush Station.

title: A different way to visit London
text: The hotel is simple but very confortable and quiet. People are really nice. It's not in the center but near and it's very well connected. Around the hotel are plenty of restaurants and shops. We spent a very good week there. Rosa & Xabier

title: Clean and well located!!!!
text: I have been to London and stayed at Her Majesty Hotel. I was happy with my choice because the hotel is clean and the staff are friendly. It is well located, close to the tube station, so easy to get to the centre. It is also close to Westfield which is good for shopping. Ideal for a short break in London. Ana from Brazil

title: That night Roger saved us...
text: It was a saturday night and we could not find a room, finally we ended up at the her majesty hotel where we were greeted and welcomed by Roger, an authentic gentleman. He provided us a great customer service, the room we stayed were warm, comfortable, clean, tidy. The location is perfect, very closed to the underground Sherpherd's Bush, restaurant and supermarket are close too. I really invite anyone to not miss the opportunity of such a excellent quality-price service. The last day he even printed out a map for us to get home quickly. Thanks Roger. Chris and Valentina

title: P-e-r-f-e-c-t-i-on!
text: Love the staff and the manager! Nice and clean, superb location, friendly staff. What more to aks for? Great value – highly recommended!!! We will defenitely come back. Pål & Margrethe

title: Great hotel
text: My partner and I stayed at Her Majesty for three nights recently. We've stayed in quite a lot of hotels over an eight month period travelling Europe and Her Majesty was the best in terms of cleanliness, location, breakfast and service. Our room was cleaned every day and Rogee went out of his way to be helpful in all aspects of our stay. I've heard so many horror stories of some London hotels, but Her Majesty was a delight and relatively inexpensive. I would without a doubt recommend this hotel to other travellers.

text: i love this hotel. the room was a good size, very quiet as we had one of the top back rooms. i would imagine the rooms facing sheperds room green would be quite noisy. very close to the underground, cinema and shopping facilities. breakfast was tea/coffee and toast with cereal. no cooked breakfast but it was not an issue with me.

title: the manager was a jerk
text: We were talked down to on several occasions by this manager either because of our age or the way we looked, but he was so rude I didn't feel like a customer, and I'd NEVER stay at this place again or recommend it. TERRIBLE.

title: A lovely surprise
text: We've stayed at Her Majesty Hotel last july. We are a family of four and stayed in one room. Although I have read the previous reviews we only really know when we get there and Her Majesty Hotel was a great surprise, the room was good, clean, the breakfast was good and the staff was really nice. They all were very polite and the manager was always making an effort to help us in whatever we needed. Althought the hotel is not in the central area it is not far from it. We totally recomend this hotel to anyone who wants to be in a good, clean and friendly hotel and wants to save their money to spend in attractions, museums etc.

title: EXCELLENT PLACE TO STAY
text: we are steam which had the business departure to london and we stopped in this charming hotel. And we don't pity our choice at all. A very nice older manager and his assistant greeted us. All the time he guarded so that we have everything what we need. Room was perfect for us. New, comfortable beds, spacious and cleanness for which heavily in it knead. Bathrooms equipped with new showers, towels exchanged every day . Cleanness, cleanness and one more time cleanness. Breakfast was contynentalne, nice service and tasty. We value the help all the time Rogee offered which to us for ourselves. THANK FOR ALL OUR STAY definitely we will choose this hotel one more time...

title: Horrible staff
text: The staff at this hotel are incredibly rude. I had to cancel a booking of three nights, for someone who was coming to visit, and they were horrible about it. Given I had already paid 45£ for a deposit (in cash, as they don’t accept card payments), which is the cost of a single room per night, I assumed they would at least let me use the room for one night, for someone else but they refused. According to them the minimum stay is three nights, something they hadn’t mentioned when I booked. On top of it, they were incredibly rude on the phone. I would suggest you go somewhere else, if you have the choice.

title: lovely stay!
text: It was a lovely stay in this hotel!! maybe the room was just a little bit small, with classic english moquette covered the floor, but everything was everyday cleaned, the bathroom was recently refurbished and the welcoming staff so helpful with us, especially the manager! And last but not least, don't forget the price, very cheap! Definitely recommended! Luca from Italy

title: Great Value and Classy
text: This was a great place to stay. My mother and I were traveling together, and we found it had good value, service, etc. There were no problems, and the proprietor was a very gracious and kind fellow. Being in Shepherd's Bush, it is not right in the center of London, but for those who might need to do laundry or find a grocery store, I've found that a place a few minutes outside the center of a city is best. It is quite close to the Tube.

title: Nice and clean rooms, friendly and helpful staff
text: Once again we have enjoyed our stay at Her Majesty hotel. The hotel was as always nice and clean, and we all (group of 12) find both manager and staff as both friendly and helpful. This is where we stay when we want good value for our money and a safe and comfortable atmosphere for both adults, teenagers and younger children. Easy access to Oxford street on Central line without having to change to different lines and also Westpoint shopping centre a 3 minutes walk from the hotel is also a bonus. We were sorry to read review of guest from Riaydh who complaints about unfriendly staff and poor facilitie - needless to say that we couldn't disagree more! The youngest boy in our group had an unwelcome meeting with a lamp post and the manager immediately offered to take us to the hospital. Every day he offered the children small treats and spoke to them in a friendly manner, and he was also very nice towards the older children and us adults. Christina, member of staff, stayed behind when her long work day was due, just to help us with museum bookings. We had a pleasant stay and will definetely come back, hopefully soon ....

title: Silent, clean rooms, good location, excellent breakfast.
text: I've found very kind staff, careful to customer needs. Room is always kept clean. Hotel is silent and quite, desturbing people never accepted, so it's ideal for people who wants to relax in hotel and then spend day visiting London. Good connected to center, near Sheperd's Bush underground and overground.

title: 5 beautiful nights
text: Rooms are quite small but very clean and comfortable. Very good breakfast and friendly people. Recommended!

title: Fantastic Hotel
text: We had a wonderful stay (2 nights) at Her Majesty Hotel. The room with bathroom was lovely, clean and comfortable. Breakfast was ok (cereals, tea/coffee, toast, croissant, jam, chess, juice, butter). Grazyna welcomed us on arrival and we were shown our rooms, she was an excellent host. Room was cleaned every day. Very , very clean hotel. Close to the tube. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

title: Very comfortable stay
text: I have just returned from a trip to London with my daughter for a two night stay at Her Majesty Hotel. The hotel is in a great location, close to the tube station, shops etc and has a very nice little park in front of it. We had a large room downstairs at the back of the property with a double bed, single bed, small kitchen and en suite shower room. There were patio doors leading out to a table and chairs. The hotel is very clean and very comfortable. The staff were very pleasant and friendly. We enjoyed the breakfast (they make a very good pot of tea). We would definitely stay there again.

title: Perfect location, very cozy, friendly and very helpful staff!
text: I and a friend of mine decided to visit London in late august for a week. We went there to see some musicals, visit tourist attractions and just enjoy the city. I have been there before but loved it and needed to come back. Going to the hotel was a great idea. It was refereed to me by a friend from Spain who also visits the city occasionally. I was glad to see that it is 3 minutes away from the tube and the bus stop. In front of the small cozy hotel there is a park and a large shopping centre nearby. Very close to Notting hill and Kensington. When we arrived I had issues with my baggage and the owner immediately helped me along with one of the girls working there. The whole stay was great. Breakfast was great, the rooms nice and clean. I am definitely staying there again when I go back to London.

title: Great little hotel, good value, personal service
text: Great service from the owner & very flexible . We really enjoyed our tourist stay.

title: Excellent value for money
text: I have recently returned from a visit to London and stayed at Her Majesty's Hotel for a second time. The hotel is extremely well situated and the transport links are excellent. I have stayed at several different hotels in London over the past 15 years and have found that Her Majesty's accommodation to be of a high standard and the continental breakfast superior to many of the other hotels. I respect the owner's rules as these are necessary to create a safe environment for his guests. I can thus thoroughly recommend Her Majesty's and believe it to be excellent value for money. Thank you for your hospitality Rogee. Joanna

title: Good place to stay
text: Three of us stayed at Her Majesty Hotel at the end of August and were generally happy with our choice. For the price (79 pounds/night for a triple room) I think it would be hard to find a better place to stay. Some details: Room: We stayed in the triple room on the second floor in the back of the hotel. While the room is not large by American standards it was of adequate size. The sheets were clean, pillows could be better but worked for us, the twin bed was of a normal size, not small. Rooms was cleaned well and beds made daily. The bathroom was small and the shower cabin is tight so if you are a large person it may be uncomfortable. The only issue we had with the bathroom was bad ventilation - towels would not dry up, rainy weather outside did not help either. I made sure the room was in the back when reserving the room as I knew the hotel is on a busy street. We kept windows slightly open and had no problem with the noise (only heard occasional ambulances) but I imagine the noise would be an issue in rooms facing the street. Location: The hotel is not in a central part of London, but it is not too far from the center. I would disagree with one of the reviewers that is it very far. It is only two stops west of Notting Hill Gate on a Central line, so with one transfer max you get anywhere in Central London within half an hour. Being in the west part of town it is also not too far from the Hearthrow airport (30 min drive). The area of Shepherds Bush is OK, not exactly pretty but felt safe walking around. There are plenty of inexpensive eating options from fast food to many small restaurants (polish, italian, thai, indian, moroccan, irish pub, etc.). There is also a little mall nearby with a supermarket and bunch of other stores. Breakfast was OK, not a lot of variety so it may get boring if you stay for many days. There are a few choices of cereal, bread, croissants (supermarket quality), butter, cream cheese, jams, milk, orange juice, tea, coffee, apples and bananas. The tables are setup nicely (tablecloth, flowers, etc.) and a kind lady brings you tea/coffee and toasts a bread for you. Can't complain here. The manager is an indian (I think) guy who was very pleasant and helpful with any of our requests. We felt that he cared about keeping his guests satisfied. I had no issues making a reservation, I called hotel directly, emailed request details and received confirmation email right away. One inconvenience was that the payment had to be made in cash on arrival so I had to exchange currency in US (not a good exchange rate). Not a big deal, but something to keep in mind. I would recommend this hotel to any budget conscious traveler who needs a clean, convenient place to spend the night while visiting London.

title: Disappointing!!
text: NOISE NOISE and more NOISE! Slamming doors, construction, and a rude host made Her Majesty Hotel a big disappointment. Upon arrival the owner took a good 15 mins to track down as we waited on the front stoop. Then that morning as we prepared to catch up on some sleep we were awakened at 6 am by slamming doors. The cleaning people in the room above up were some of the noisiest people I have ever heard in a hotel. Its only good quality was the cleanliness. I would never stay over again!!

title: Lovely Basic Hotel
text: My family and I stayed here for 4 nights all in and I have to say it was perfectly located and sufficient for us based on what our trip was for. The rooms are small but clean and comfortable. Bathrooms are exceptional, lovely shower and modern. TV was very good with multiple channels and WIFI is acceptable. Mini Fridge in the room also. The breakfast area is quaint and lovely - to anyone who moans about this, you are staying in a basic 3 star guesthouse and only paying £5 for all you can eat. If you take up issue with this then stay in a 5 star hotel. It is expensive enough to stay here but you are paying for the location. Within walking distance of almost everything. There are plenty of restaurants/cafes nearby if people bother to look. (I highly recommend Le Pain Quotidien Café 3 minute walk away). I would definitely stay here again for what you get. Word of notice to guests - book with booking.com or another 3rd party provider. Much quicker and easier.

title: Convenient to Regent's Park and Euston Road transit.
text: Nicely remodeled with modern lift and rooms fitted out for guests with electronic devices. The bathroom was a delight, with excellent shower. My single was a bit cramped for space. Several Underground stations and two National Rail stations are within walking distance.

title: Horrific experience!
text: I thought I would give this hotel 5 stars just so it can go to the top of the listing and others would not waste money staying there. In practice, it doesn’t merit one star. I stayed on 5 March, the check in wasn’t great - was advised that my company hadn’t booked breakfast and so I would have to pay £5. There was another lady at the same time who was forced to pay the full amount as the hotel receptionist claimed that her company hadn’t paid for her accommodation. I paid £5 for breakfast (foolishly!) only to be told the following morning (when requesting a receipt) that there was a new member of staff on and they shouldn’t have charged me. Told I would be refunded within half an hour - two days on, I’m still waiting! The room I was allocated was incredibly small and in the basement (they call it lower ground). There was no light in the room, the bed was squashed in between two walls and it was generally dingy. I requested another room but was advised that the only two left were larger rooms (only a cupboard would be smaller than the one I had) and so I had to stay where I was. The room was noisy at night, early in the morning there were staff outside the tiny window putting rubbish in what looked like a cellar part of the hotel and when the cleaners came in and the breakfast started it got even noisier in the basement. Entry to bedrooms is by a plastic key card, however, the hotel prints the room number on each key, so if you do go please look after your key as this could be a serious security risk if lost! The area allocated for the dining room for breakfast was small, cramped and over crowded. There was only about seven tables - some guests ended up sharing and I saw 5 people come in and simply leave as there was no space to sit down. The choice at breakfast was dire! They offer a basic cooked breakfast - I ordered an omelette and it arrived with half a non cooked tomato - it was the flattest, greasiest omelette I have ever seen! I asked for decaffeinated coffee, a herbal tea and a yoghurt but they didn’t have any of those items. All they had in terms of a healthy options was a large bowl of tinned fruit salad! The only positive about the hotel is that the bathroom (albeit small) was clean and the shower good - guests are allocated one small hand towel though which proved insufficient. This hotel claims that there are many resturants close by - in fact, there are two Greek resturants and two Indian resturants at the end of the road so don’t be fooled. I would never go back and would certainly not recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: Good hotel despite booking mix up
text: The hotel is well located a short walk from Baker Street and in a quietish area. I'd booked online but when I arrived late (around midnight), I found that they'd been an error and someone else checked in against my booking. It took 20mins to eventually check in which was a pain but the night receptionist did resolve. My room was on the lower ground floor which is never ideal. But the room was a pretty good size for the price (I paid £98) in London and it was clean as well as being well equipped. I didn't visit much else of the hotel except reception and my room as I arrived late and left early due to business commitments.

title: Great location - basic room
text: The room is quite small ( I was with my son in a double bedroom, my father was in another single room - really small....). Room was clean and the bed was comfortable, nice hot water in the shower. Breakfast was the same every day - and was ok ( nothing fancy ) - eggs & bacon. If you are like us - mainly came to be outside the hotel, and you use the hotel for mainly sleeping - it's a great location with a good price ( compare to other option around in the main area)

title: Great location at a great price
text: Just a few minute walk from the Baker Street tube station and Madame Tussards, this hotel offers a clean room, functional room on a quiet side street. The wifi was very good, but the chair at the desk in the room was so low that it was difficult to work at the desk. The room was rather cold, but as the heating system was centrally controlled, I could not change the temperature. The sink in the bathroom can only be used to wash your hands. The walls were also rather thin do you heard every time someone walked by in the hallway. Fortunately this was not that often. The rooms were small, but the location and price are great. Not perfect, but a great value. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Rough start - turned out ok in the end
text: When we arrived at the hotel there was a problem with the payment prosessed by Hotels.com. They room was supposed to be prepaid but the hotel couldn't trace the payment. We ended up paying for the room fora second time and will contact Hotels.com regarding the missing 333 £. Anyways.. The first night we didn't get the triple room we were supposed to have due to difficulties for the family staying there before us. We were given two rooms for the first night - one single and one double. These rooms were SMALL. The double bed in the double room was also very small, most likely about 140 cm.. The second night we got a triple room with three single beds. This room was much better and bigger and gave us some space. Otherwise the hotel is clean and the beds are very comfy. We asked the reception to order a taxi in advance for 05:30 in the morning as we had to catch a flight. The receptinist forgot and the taxi never arrived as requested. Luckily the other receptionist managed to get us a taxi with in three minutes. The hotel's location is great. If it hadn't been for the problems regarding the payment and taxi we most likely would've been quite satisfied.

title: Great location, clean, comfortable
text: Small, clean tidy room. The hotel is well serviced, breakfast is plentiful (although it is the same every day). Location is very convenient, great neighborhood close to shops and restaurants. It's not fancy but it worked for us

title: Goid Location - But - a big but!!
text: This small hotel is well located. Close to Oxford street and the Baker street underground is only minutes away. Breakfast is average with no special effort made to make it more appealing. The real disappointment is that the WiFi that was promised fails to work. Have been here two days and have yet been able to enjoy reliable WiFi service... Hotel reception gives no answers and only confirms there is a problem and promises to fix it. So far - problem has not been resolved. Very annoying as there was a promise of "free WiFi". This is a three star hotel and is not cheap - costs more than $170 a night... You would expect for them to put an effort into solving basic issues like this but seems like they don't care. When you call reception they mumble a few words about an engineer coming and they promise to call my room when fixed - they have not called back nor apologized .... The room itself (single room) is of minimal size. The sink is the smallest I ever encountered and not useable for laundry. Channel line up on their TV is basic with no news channel, sports, HBO etc. It should be expected for the cost of the room to provide more options. Toiletries - minimal as well. Location is important but is not the only criteria - I can't recommend it based on the amenities only chose it if the location is your main criteria. I assume there are better choices in this neighborhood.

title: Good and very handy for Princess Grace Hospital, Tussauds, Marylebone Station....
text: I needed to get to the Princess Grace early on several days and it is on the very same street a very short walk down the road. It is also a few blocks from Marylebone and convenient for Tussauds. The rooms were clean and reasonably quiet, the staff helpful. They take Apply Pay which was very useful given that I had left my credit card at home! I was on my own and the room was plenty big enough.

title: Clean, good location
text: As as single traveler (older female) it is usually very expensive to find decent accommodation for a reasonable price and this place was no exception. The price included breakfast - cereal and/or eggs. The location is very good as it is only a short walk to the Baker Street tube station. Regent's Park is nearby and I love spending time there. One morning it was raining, the desk clerk offered me his umbrella with the stipulation that I have it back by the end of his shift. That was very kind of him. I used it to walk to the store and buy an umbrella and then walked back to return his to him.

title: Overpriced and under serviced
text: Let's start with the size of the room: a twin room that has 2 beds that can be joined to form a double. But as twins they are so close anyway that you might as well have them as a double anyway as the room is soooo small. Bathroom not much to write about except that the light didn't work and we were told it was being fixed. Two weeks later and it still wasn't sorted despite constant reminders. Cleaning staff kept forgetting to clean the room - again had to keep reminding the front of house people to do it. Breakfast was fast service but not massive portions. Toast was cold, coffee had been sitting on a heating element so was well-stewed and not very pleasant. These small terrace-style hotels are really starting to show their age and cannot complete for price and service with the larger chains. We only chose this one for its proximity and availability and really would not recommend it at all. Windows are single-glazed sash ones so get lots of noise from street and main roads very close by. The walls, ceilings and floors are not particularly well insulated either so you get loads of noise from your neighbours.

title: Clean, Comfortable and Convenient
text: The room was small but we managed. We were three adults in one room and were given a room with three single beds (rather narrow). There is someone on the front door 24 hours which I liked. Great neighborhood. No complaints.

title: Clean and quiet boutique hotel in Marylebone
text: This is a modern and quiet boutique hotel of about 25 rooms in Marylebone. It is a 2 minutes' walk from the Baker Street underground station, Madame Tussauds, Regent's Park, a supermarket, and a selection of excellent restaurants. We booked a 3 beds room on a high floor. This is what we got. All floors can be reached by elevator. The room was supposed to be 19 square meters in size, but was no more than only about 14-15 meters. While being rather smallish, the room is air conditioned, has a modern bathroom, plenty of storage space, desk and chairs, small fridge, percolator, and free Wi-fi (that worked quite well even on the top floor). The room came with breakfast, that was quite reasonable in European standards and includes toast, eggs, bacon, sausage, juice, selection of cereals, fruit salad, and coffee. Our overall rating of the hotel is 4/5, primarily due to the smallish room and due to the medium value for money (3/5 or 3.5/5). The price tag of $260/Night might be reasonable for London, but for that price we would have expected to get more.

title: Comfortable bed, air conditioning, breakfast
text: Room was small but typical for this type hotel. Nicely kept up and clean. Beautiful tile in bath, but - the one negative - the tiniest sink I have ever seen! Glass shelf above it makes it impossible to splash water in your face. Others said there was no meat with breakfast - this is no longer true. they offered eggs, beans, mushrooms, tomatoes, bacon, and sausage. Also options of yogurt, cereals, and canned fruit. Wheat toast was super. The room had air conditioning and there is a lift serving all floors. Free wifi, TV, small refrig and safe.

title: Pleasantly surprised
text: After reading a few less than positive reviews my husband and I were a little apprehensive as our stay approached. Having been asked our anticipated time of arrival, and advising the hotel we planned to arrive shortly after 1.00p.m., it was disappointing to be told at 1.15 p.m. that the room was not ready. The man on reception gave no apology and we were not made to feel at all welcome. However that was the total extent of our poor experience. The room on the lower ground floor at the back was very clean with lots of storage space and a comfortable bed. The air conditioning was the best I have ever encountered in a hotel - easy to use and very responsive. This was crucial to us getting a good night’s sleep as we couldn’t open any windows and it was very, very hot. Breakfast was good, basic cereals, yoghurt and fruit but very prompt service by the friendly and efficient staff and the cooked food was good. No meat but that was not a problem for us. Good quality bread for the toast, plenty of it and lots of butter. The room was nicely serviced while we were out before our second night there. Good external door security, 24 hour reception (very polite and friendly staff apart from our first encounter). Room safe. Would be happy to visit again.

title: Excellent location
text: Hotel is a B&B conveniently located with bars,restaurants and tube stations close. No frills but clean and seemingly recently refurbished. Breakfast was served promptly and very enjoyable. Would not hesitate to stay again

title: Close to transport links
text: Stayed in a quadruple room for one night, to see a show. The hotel is far from the west end but just over the road from baker street tube and Madam Tussauds. The hotel is clean and the beds are comfortable. The only issue we had is that we didn’t have a plug for the bath which was quickly rectified. The air con/heating system is centrally controlled so cannot be operated without a password which was annoying as the rooms get red hot. The rooms have enough plug sockets close to each bed, and there is a hairdryer, mini fridge and tea/coffee facilities. The breakfast was nice, made fresh to order, but no meat options. All in all i wouldn’t mind staying here again but i would rather be closer to the West End/covent garden.

title: London stopover
text: One night stay, clean and comfortable. 50/50 chance, rooms at the back will all be quiet, those at the front maybe some road noise. Breakfast is vegetarian, fine for the money. Location very good for central London. At this price point, there are far worse out there.

title: Pretty poor
text: My wife and I stayed on a Saturday night and found the whole experience pretty underwhelming. We checked in at around 12:00 , which was a bonus. I asked about the breakfast in house and was rather dismayed to hear they do not serve meat. When I stay in a hotel I do enjoy a full English breakfast and if this information was on the booking site, I wouldn't have booked here. The room was nicely decorated and tiny (it's London, what did I expect). The bathroom smelt of mildew though. The sound proofing in the hotel is basically non existent and we had the pleasure of hearing someone vomiting at 03:30 in the morning. It sounded like it was outside in the corridor, so we called reception. The night receptionist answered the phone after a couple of rings and sounded like he was still asleep.
