We told him what had happened and he asked us to go out side and check the corridor?!? I do believe that is his job. Upon check out the receptionist did not even ask how our stay was. I wouldn't recommend and wouldn't stay again

title: mixed feelings
text: I have mixed feelings about this hotel. I had specifically asked for a bath when I booked, and was given a single room with a shower. When I objected, the receptionist kindly substituted my room for a double one, at no extra charge since all single rooms apparently have only a shower. My main complaint was the breakfast and its early closing time - 9.30am on weekdays and 9am on Sunday. I overslept the first day, and missed my breakfast. The last day, I left early at 4.45am and asked whether I could have a packed snack. The only offer was for a small pack of cereals. This has happened to me in other hotels and I was many times give a packed sandwich or some other form of fresh snack. Also, since I was on my own, I emphasised for a wake up call at 3.45am. Thank God I decided not to sleep, for my wake up call came at 4.30am. Other than that, the room was clean, and breakfast was good, although a larger portion would have been great.

title: Very well located
text: A townhouse in a quiet street between Baker Street Tube station and Marylebone High Street, this hotel has been tastefully converted and remodelled throughout. Comfortable en-suite rooms with everything you could require for a stay over in London was topped off by a first class breakfast of cereal, juice, excellent coffee, and a fried breakfast of eggs, tomatoes, mushrooms, beans etc., all part of the price.

title: Location, location, location
text: Wherever you come from, this place is easy to reach. It is in the proximity of of Baker street and Regent's park subway station, meaning that you have subways to every place in London and that you can easily catch busses leaving to Oxford or Cambridge (from Baker street). Madame Tussaud's museum, Sherlock's house, a bunch of restaurants and of course the Regent's park are couple of blocks away, making the place ideal for everything. The room is extremely small, you can barely fit yourself and your luggage, but it is clean and well maintained. The reception and the stairway look a bit dodgy, but it is all cool - receptionsts are friendly and everything is clean. Internet and breakfast? I did not pay much attention to it. Internet was somewhat stable. I ate the breakfast and then hurried to The Regent's park. The location!

title: Value for money
text: Modest, but good quality for such rate per night. Room was tiny like in most mini hotels on the center of London. Though a bed quite big and comfortable. Linen clean and good. No mini bar, no adaptor for European plugs, no hair dryer, no iron in the room. Good breakfast. 5 min from Baker street underground station. 10 min walk to Selfridges.

title: A really nice hotel
text: We stayed here for 2 nights, the 1st room they gave us was really small & the bed was not a double. I rang down & they immediately gave us a very nice bigger room, my sister who was with us had a single room which was more than adequate they were both very clean and nicely furnished. The staff were great & very helpful. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Great value for money in an expensive part of London
text: The Baker Street/Marlyebone area of London is very vibrant with lots of independent shops, cafes, restaurants. Also Madame Tussauds and the Planetarium are very close by. The downside being that most of the hotels in the area are pretty expensive (usually £2-300/night). I booked a few weeks in advance and only paid £115 for a (small!) double room. I stayed here for a University reunion event and for the money it was great. My room was in the basement and pretty small but had a window (with a view of an outside staircase), was very clean, well presented and even included a fridge (which looked like it had seen better days but was cold-ish) and a safe. It was fine for one person, two would have been a bit of a squash (although there were two chairs). The bed was comfortable and a good balance between firm and soft. There was a small LCD TV mounted to the wall and plenty of power sockets. No bath but the shower worked well. It has clearly been refurbished fairly recently to a good standard (better than a TravelInn). I was very warmly greeted on arrival and on departure. The only real issue I had was around some noise and a bit too much light in the morning (blackout curtains not fully covering the window). You could hear people outside up and down the stair case and also in the other rooms. Not awful and perhaps the rooms on higher floors would be better. I didn't try the breakfast but a friend who was also staying said it was "okay" but nothing special. Wi-Fi is free but I didn't try this either so can't comment on reliability or speed. In summary then if you want somewhere in this area on a budget I'd recommend it, it was very good value for money, has friendly service and is very well kept.

title: Pleasantly surprised
text: A last minute business trip and the place usually stay was booked up. Very pleased with the Regency Parkside, great location and the facilities are good. Nice room with a huge bed, a very clean and modern bathroom. Breakfast was mediocre, had scrambled eggs on toast, eggs were over cooked. I'll definitely stay here again.

title: Really nice!
text: I went there a couple of times. The hotel is cozy and nice, but what really made the difference for me was the staff! They remembered me and were really welcoming, next time I'll be in the city I will definitely stay there!

title: Would stay again
text: Single room was very small, but clean, with a comfortable small double bed and stocked with a fridge, safe, flat screen tv, wardrobe, desk, hairdryer, ensuite shower and wc. Seemed recently updated. Continental breakfast was good - cereal, yogurt, canned fruit salad, and choice of vegetarian cooked items, i.e. eggs, toast, mushrooms, tomato. No muffins/ croissants etc. No leisure facilities within hotel. Handy location to Baker Street tube station, Madam Tussauds and Regents park. About 10min walk to Harley street, Hallum Conference centre, BBC, Oxford street. Lots of shops and cafes within minute or two along Marylebone high street etc. As a safe, clean place to stay, in a great location, I would definitely book again.

title: Average comfort but clean and well-located London-style hotel
text: This hotel offers the basic what a hotel should offer. The room is small and full. High table, low seat so not ideal for working. I wouldn't know why there are four pillows laying on the bed, because that was also not large. But it's clean and you have a beautiful, modern bathroom. They start very early in the morning with vacuuming and cleaning so better ask for a room a bit away from the ground floor. There are also rooms in the basement and as the rooms can get warm and crampy a window is nice. Good breakfast with a wide variety of hot dishes to order. Take the time as it can be busy. The hotel is close to Baker Street (tube station) which is ideal for some of the tourist activities. It is however located in a quiet, nice street with shops and a few bars nearby. The hotel itself is also well soundproof. So you have a good night's sleep in a clean but small room. A good hotel but not ideal for a long business trip.

title: Best Place in London
text: (1) It was Clean. (2) It was very Clean. (3) It was very very clean. The area is beautiful. The hotel is beautiful. The best place I have ever stayed in London. The guy at reception in day time is a gentleman. So polite, so helpful and very generous. I fall in love with him :-). The breakfast was lovely. The girls at the breakfast are very polite and with smiling faces. The room was big and veryyyyy comfortable. I would definitely recommend this place, and send all my friends and family to stay in this hotel whenever they are in London.

title: Clean and Comfortable
text: The first thing that strikes you is how clean the rooms are. The hotel was recently refurbished so everything looks and smells new. Staff are friendly and very helpful. I stay here regularly, chosen initially for its excellent location and secondly for its excellent value. I have forward booked all my stays to make sure I can always get booked in as would not want to try anywhere else.

title: Only one wheelchair accessible room, no communication to say it's unavailable even though I'd booked it
text: I booked this as part of a gift for my daughters 21st birthday present, I requested a wheelchair accessible room in the 'special request' box on booking.com, I en phoned the hotel 3 weeks prior to confirm this and was told that I did have an accessible room, I then paid for the room, when my daughter arrived she was told that she did not have an accessible room and was then asked to pay fo the room again!!!! She was given a room that she could get into in her chair but had to leave the door open if she used the bathroom!!!! Totally appalling treatment!!!!

title: Excellent location
text: When traveling, you want to want to be close to attractions and restaurants. I can say this hotel covers both. You are right around the corner from Baker Street, and the Baker Street train station. You can catch the Big Bus on Baker Street which is a hop on hop off bus across from Madam Tussauds. This is a good way to see all of London. They offer a 1 or 2 day option. You will need 2 days. Madam Tussauds London is a block away. There are several restaurants within walking distance. The staff is very friendly and you can buy most attraction tickets from the hotel. The rooms are clean, small, think mouse house, but that's normal for the city of London. The linen and towels were questionable. They have a restaurant in the hotel but we did not eat there. Cab ride from the Paddington station to hotel was £7. Take Heathrow express from airport to Paddington station. Or transfer at Paddington station to Baker Street station and walk 2 blocks.

title: Great location - Overpriced
text: We thought we would try something different and settled on an independent. The hotel is very well situated for Madame Tussaurds, Baker Street tube station and Regents Park. Only a short walk to several places to eat and drink. The room was a fair sized family room for 3 people. It was a disabled room so had a nice big bathroom with walk in shower. The decor was very plain and no pictures or homely touches made it a bit stark. There was a fridge and a safe which would be useful for overseas visitors and people staying longer. The double bed was not very comfortable and was very obviously 2 singles put together with a ridge, and not very easy to access if you were sleeping on the right. The reception staff were very friendly and helpful and check in was nice and straight forward and we were able to leave our bags for a short time after checkout. On check in my husband was given a wifi code but when we came to use it later that night we couldn't get it to work, so gave up on the wifi Breakfast was a big disappointment we were advised that it would be a continental which to me is a collection of pastries, cereals, fruits etc. In fact there was very average choice of cereal only 1 choice of juice, a bowl of fruit saladand not a pasty or croissant in sight. We were instead offered a vegetarian English breakfast, eggs, beans, tomatoes, and mushroom. Not what I would call a continental breakfast. The dining room was small and poky and we were sat at 2 separate tables! This is not really acceptable on a family weekend. We tried to order extra toast as neither my daughter or I eat most of what was on offer but couldn't get the attention of the waitress and ended up leaving without it. We expect to pay more for hotels in London but did not feel this stay represented good value.

title: Value in London
text: The Regency Parkside is the perfect place to drop bags and spend a night. The single rooms may be small, but that are impeccably clean. The wifi is good, and the room price reasonable. The best part is the staff - among the most friendly I have come across in London. The hotel is reasonably no frills, but that simply means you are not paying for things you probably don't need. It's in a great location, near Barker St, and perfect if you are travelling to or from Marylebone railway station.

title: Nice clean hotel in a lovely area of london
text: Stayed here with two colleagues (3 separate rooms!) for a business trip from Cornwall. Friendly staff in a very clean hotel in a nice respectable part of town close to Madame Tousauds, Baker Street (for the Sherlock Holmes museum) and Regents Park. Nice rooms with double beds and updated bathrooms. Breakfast was vegetarian and partly buffet style. Good price for a London hotel. Will stay here again when back in london

title: Clean and simple and good value
text: If you just need a simple hotel in a great part of London this is an excellent choice - the hotel is pretty basic with no guest facilities but beautifully clean, with very pleasant staff. My room had everything i needed, modern bathroom, good wifi and comfortable bed. As it is in such a good area adjacent to Marylebone Lane there are plenty of excellent restaurants, cafes and pubs within walking distance so the fact the hotels had no guest services didn't matter. I didn't have breakfast as I was in London for a breakfast meeting but I had a look at the breakfast room and it reflected the rest of the hotel simple and clean. I will definitely use it again if I need to be in that part of London as it represented great value - I booked a double room as my experience of single rooms in London has not been good, generally cupboard-like and the small amount extra was worth it. I heard a small amount of noise from neighbouring rooms but nothing too annoying. Overall I was pleasantly surprised.

title: Great stay
text: Stayed there for a week with my hubby. Lovely cozy place. Great location as its very close to baker street station where u can take an underground metro or a bus. Very close to Regents Park also to Madame tussaud. Super friendly and helpful staff. The only annoying thing no variety in breakfast everyday cereals and eggs fried or boiled.

title: Overnight stay
text: I travelled to London for two days only and stayed in this hotel overnight. The room was very small but quiet and comfortable. Very good WiFi, I used this for video call. I had all I needed just for one night.

title: Just perfect!
text: Our family of five really enjoyed our stay. Close proximity to tube and Oxford Street was great. Very, very friendly staff and very, very clean. Breakfast did the job and the ladies in the kitchen really do their best. We'll be back :-)

title: Great location.
text: Overall this is a lovely hotel. Very clean and staff for the most part were friendly Was disappointed not to have a full English breakfast available. Instead the had a continental breakfast with eggs cooked how you wanted Diversity training may be beneficial for some breakfast staff who seemed very surprised to hear that two men had been sharing the same room and had the check several times that we didn't occupy a second room

title: Great value for money
text: I spent here just a couple of nights on a business trip. The hotel is clean and the staff is friendly. Despite of the decoration of the room that is neither traditional nor modern

title: Worth It
text: It was a good experience staying in Regency Hotel Parkside. The rooms are clean, well-equipped. The breakfast is good. The best thing is that the WiFi is fast and reliable and you don't have to pay anything for it(Free). The staff is friendly and helpful. I asked for the taxi to be reserved, by the time I was in Reception the taxi was waiting for me at the door. I normally come to London every month for a business trip, and I think this is the best place to have a peaceful stay. 100% recommended.

title: Quick and Comfortable
text: We only stayed the one night.The toilet refilling was quite loud even with the door closed and other guests could be heard- though this didn't really bother us as we were tired might not be the best for light sleepers-but we slept very well. Only hot food available at breakfast is eggs which didn't suit us personally but still great value, toast and a continental breakfast is offered. HOWEVER this hotel is in a great location for Madame Tussauds but also for the underground to get around London (Baker Street). The room is extremely clean as well as the bathroom and the bed is very comfortable. TV with Freeview and fridge in room. Staff at reception very friendly and helpful. Also good security as you have to use your key card to get past reception. Only one key card given on arrival though. All in all a very good hotel at a reasonable price in London

title: Excellent hotel and great value for money in good location
text: Very friendly staff and an exceptionally clean and quiet room. Breakfast was really good, too. And there is a lift, plus free wifi and plenty of power points in the room (the main things I always look for).

title: short stay in central london
text: Regency Hotel Parkside is just a few meters away from the Bakerstreet Underground station. The reception of the staff was very friendly. I had a single room, which is small (obviously) but clean. Breakfast was good, although there was not a lot to choose from. I will return to this hotel

title: Great hotel
text: Stayed here for a night as a birthday treat. .Nice clean hotel .Quiet .Staff very friendly.Great location.Handy for tube , and local attractions..Breakfast great Good variety. Freshly cooked.Good price for the west end .Would recommend.Good size room,bath and shower.Tea and coffee facilitiesin room .Fridge and safe in room.Wouls highly reccomend this hotel.

title: Spectacular surprise
text: This hotel turned out to be a spectacular surprise. My wife and I booked this hotel after reading the reviews. We were concerned with some of the earlier reviews but decided to take a leap of faith knowing that if we weren't happy we could move on to another hotel. On our arrival out initial concern was that the hotel charged for all nights up front. This practice was a first time experience for us both and having stayed in other hotels during August in Europe this year that did not do that we were some what shocked at first

title: Clean and convenient
text: Nice hotel, clean, good location. Friendly staff. On street parking available. Breakfast is ok, rooms are fine with tea tray. Internet is reasonable. Would stay again if in London.. Taxi to west end theatre cost less than ten pounds and took 15 minutes.

title: The best hotel in a strategic position for people love running
text: From Stansted airport about 1h and 20 minutes to arrive in this hotel, in 25 Nottingham Place W1. Train to Liverpool street and tube to Baker Street. The hotel is very nice and staff friendly. Around hotel, what you need is available in Marylebone and Baker Street. Regent's Park is the best place to run. Squirrels will do it with you. Running talking, from this hotel, in 25/35 minutes you are in Oxford street and Piccadilly. About hotel, rooms clean and sufficient space (considering same standard London hotel). In a few words, I really suggest this hotel.

title: Ticked our boxes!
text: We were after a warm friendly welcome, a spotless clean room and bathroom, in a gorgeous London Street, close to the tube, with breakfast included and free wifi at a reasonable price. I don't ever think we ask for much, but it is sometimes difficult to find... Well done to Regency Hotel Parkside, we enjoyed staying with you! The rooms were not massive, the toiletries not wow-we these look lovely, the breakfast was nice and adequate not fabulous, there are no extras like laundry bag, shoe shining etc but if you want real flash then you pay more and go somewhere else. We would have no hesitation in recommending to our family and friends. A lovely area, we walked to Oxford street and the staff were great

title: Lovely Place to Stay !!!
text: Lovely Hotel, Beautiful Area, Nice and attentive Staff. Had knowledge of all surroundings and sightseeing. Room was very clean and tidy. Also specious for 2 people. Had a shinning bathroom with lots of towels. Highly recommended and would love to stay here again in near future.

title: Poor hotel for price- avoid
text: We booked 2 weeks ago and were there 2 nights at the weekend. The cost on booking.com at £297 included breakfast but none was on confirmation which was odd. The room was clean but decor was very neutral and no pictures on wall and basic and room and bathroom was very tight. The door was almost touching the toilet and the toilet seat was moving. We were on ground floor just behind reception and limited light came in from light well at rear of building. The air con was centrally controlled and room was very warm. Breakfast was in basement and was poor vegetarian but we were not told that when we booked and paid extra £7.50 for a rubber omelette . The hotel is in a good central location but I would never book here again as better to go with a chain or research a proper independent with a track record. I think this had been bought recently and despite it being clean it was a let down in various ways.

title: Tiny Rooms, Awful Climate Control, Lousy Breakfast
text: Let me start with the positives. The rooms are clean. The staff is friendly and helpful. The location is excellent. Now for the negatives. The rooms are tiny. Really tiny. If someone is sitting at the desk they block the passage past the bed so that you cannot get by. Basically you are talking about a room that is as long as a bed, plus a narrow aisle, plus a small desk. The climate controls are basically nonexistent. If you dislike the current room temperature you have to call the front desk to get it changed. All you can do is turn the system on and off. You cannot even control whether you have the AC or heat on. The lighting controls leave a lot to be desired too. Like many hotels you have to insert your key into a box before the lights will go on. Unlike many hotels when you pull your key out the outlets shut off as well. Yes, your laptop or tablet will not charge while you are out. As many other have mentioned the breakfast is awful. While we were there you could get coffee, cold cereal, canned fruit and eggs if you wanted. That was it. Even bowls for the cereal were not always available. The day before we left guests were using cups to hold their cereal and milk.

title: Fantastic stay.
text: Brilliant hotel. We stayed here in the quadruple room, fantastic room very spacious and very comfortable beds. Sparkling clean bathroom.Great facilities, including a fridge(which we expected to be noisy but was silent). Excellent value for money, lovely staff who were very friendly and helpful. We will definitely come and stay again and would recommend to friends.

title: Below the average
text: If you want to go cheap in London this is what you get: old fashioned lobby and rooms, very basic services, small rooms. Poor breakfast, no fresh juice or fruit, just canned fruit salad and cheap juice The staff is gentle and available to support you.

title: Nice hotel in beautiful street
text: This hotel was very comfortable and very clean. The location was quite good! The price was just perfect! A few metres to buses and Baker street underground station. The Regency park is very nice place for relax! Breakfast was very fresh and tasty. I will go there again!

title: Great value, great location, very clean and good sized family room.
text: The hotel is located on a quiet street surrounded by several embassies in a location that feels very safe. It is a short walk (less than 5 minutes) from Madame Tussaud's & Baker St. tube station. The gentleman on reception was very friendly on arrival. Check-in was very fast and the family room was perfectly sized for us (2 double beds, 1 single). Beds were very comfortable. The room was spotlessly clean. There were plenty of towels & toiletries and a good hot shower. Breakfast the next morning was nothing special, but certainly adequate. There was a buffet of breakfast cereals, yoghurts, juices, tea and coffee. Toast and eggs were available cooked to order. Overall, I thought it was excellent value for a central London family stay and I would definitely stay there again.

title: Superb Location.
text: First Impressions. Great location and absolutely spotless! I mean this room 211 was, without a doubt the cleanest room that I have stayed in for many years. The room was a little on the small side but this was no problem. Although the bed was in the corner so my partner was up against the wall but it was warm and comfy. My problem was simply that at 03:00 on Saturday morning, as we were asleep, somebody entered our room !!!!!!!!!!! I let them know (in no uncertain terms) that they had the wrong room and they left, pretty quickly. This certainly upset my partner as she was worried that anybody could enter our room at any time. Our Key card was not a secure way of locking the door and maybe they had the same code for each and every room. This certainly upset our feelings about this hotel and I do have to state that if it wasn't for this I would have praised them. The breakfast was good enough and the staff very friendly, The Location is perfect, 5 minutes to Madame Thussauds and a couple of minutes more to Baker Street Underground. Just a shame about the uninvited guest.

title: An OK hotel in a good area.
text: The hotel is a small one located in Marylebone, 300 m from the Baker St underground and Madame Tussauds in a nice area. There are a lot of restaurants and cafées within 500 metres from the hotel, located on and around Marylebone High St. The hotel breakfast is not so good. You can get one omelett, a hard, dry toast with jam but nothing else to put on it, and a cup of coffee or tea. The breakfast closes early (in my opinion), 9.30 everyday except sunday. The rooms are very small, you can not have one opened bag anywhere in the room. The room is clean and the bathroom is fresh and clean and OK in size. The beds are quite hard. The windows are thin and expect some noise from the road outside (which is not a big road but there is a bigger 150 m away). Internet is included and works excellent! Overall, the hotel is OK for the price and area.

title: Very clean, good price!
text: As in many budget hotels in London, the room are small. But this one has a good shower (!), very clean, the reception is very friendly and helpful. They really treat you like with respect in a friendly way. We had few problems in parcels delivery (arrived after I left back home) and the guys helped sending it by going to the post office for me! Can you believe it? They are really nice. It is well located, close to Baker Street Station. And has good restaurants and places to have breakfast, just 2 blocks from the entrance.

title: What a find
text: Right next to Baker Street station, modern, clean, friendly staff. great breakfast, although vegetarian, their sister hotel does a full English next door. There is a lift and the quality street on the reception are a nice touch.

title: Clean, modern and affordable with friendly staff
text: I was in London recently for a business trip and stayed here. It was a very affordable option in a great location. The rooms were small but comfortable and modern. The staff was very friendly. I would recommend staying here if you're looking for a reasonably priced option in London.

title: Modern, functional in london center, avoid Low Ground rooms
text: Recently renovated. Modern and functional. Was just in trouble with air conditioning that is centrally controlled. no way to have your own settings. So it was definitively too warm for me in the Low Ground and too cold for my friends in upper levels.

title: Ideal for leisure or business
text: As I was attending a conference in London I wanted a hotel near the conference venue and found this hotel on the conference website. I read the reviews and booked on line which was easy. The hotel is situated in a quieter side road and within easy walking distance of Baker Street tube station. The staff were friendly and ŵelcoming. I got room 211 which is not large but provides all the amenities you could need and was clean and comfortable. It faces the road and you can open the window a couple of inches but the room has hot/cool air conditioning. The bathroom had a shower over the bath. When I arrived the fan in the bathroom was making a squeaking noise and fearing this would keep me awake I advised reception and someone came straight away and fixed it. There is free wifi and you have to ask at reception to get a password. I was pleasantly surprised to find that breakfast was in fact included in my room rate of £135 as it appeared when I booked that it was a room only rate. Breakfast is served downstairs in a separate dining room. There are two TVs on the wall in this room. You help yourself to hot drinks, orange juice, tinned fruit, yoghurt and cereal. There is then a menu where you can order toast, eggs done 4 ways or baked beans and tomatoes. Overall a good stay and I would be happy to recommend.

title: Good Experience
text: We stay here for 7 nights. Tight quarters for 3 people, but we didn't mind as we were out all day. Breakfast was basic but filling. Very friendly staff. Great location with many attractions nearby. If you like walking, you can walk to Hyde Park and Buckingham Palace (15 min walk). Close to the Baker Street tube station and busses. I would recommend, but no more than 2 to a room.

title: Excellent location
text: We have just stayed at The Regency Parkside for the BBC Proms in Hyde Park. This hotel is literally 1 minute walk from Madame Tausauds and 2 mins walk from Baker Street tube. Off the main road it is very quiet, hotel is exceptionally clean. Facilities were good as was breakfast in the morning. Staff were very pleasant at all times.

title: Great Location
text: Great location for central London as close to Baker Street and Oxford Circus. Quiet road for London so good uninterrupted sleep. I stayed one night only. Excellent breakfast, hot food cooked to order, but no sausage or bacon. Rooms are standard size for London (small) - glad I was single in double room. Bathrooms modern and clean. On arrival I had no spoon on my tea tray, but went downstairs to breakfast room and found one down there (told reception that I had helped myself). It was a shame that the hotel is split level, but does have a good working lift. Will definitely use this hotel again.

title: Great value for money
text: The hotel is situated a short walk from Baker Street Underground station and Madame Tussauds is even closer. Shopping at Oxford Street is just a 10-minute-walk down the street and just outside the door you'll find plenty of cosy restaurants, pubs and shops that are not just the regular high street names. A was upgraded from a single room to a small double and luckily I stayed alone in this room which was small indeed but equipped with desk, comfy chair, fridge and kettle to make coffee or tea. Free wifi which worked all the time. Bathroom was extremely clean and first impression was it had been made just for me! Only minus was the breakfast. You get served at the table and can choose from scrambled eggs, omelette etc which is nice. Some bacon with this and added cheese instead of just marmalade and the minus would be gone. Would I stay here again? Definitely!

title: Great little hotel for the budget conscious in SO expensive London
text: Bit of a delay in getting checked in, but my friends and I had no complaints after that. Rooms were clean, beds comfortable, the a/c worked, and the breakfast, though limited in items offered, was cooked to order and cheerfully presented. Location is marvelous as it's on a quiet side street but close to the Baker St. tube station in one direction, and great shops and restaurants in the other. Oh, and there's a small fridge in the room and hair dryer as well. We were all pleased with this place and wouldn't hesitate in recommending it to others.

title: Clean & comfy
text: Surprisingly clean and comfortable place as of central London. Small rooms (even the 3 pax family variant), but with good beds (esp. the king), fresh carpets with no sign of wearing. Most probably recently renewed property. Really impressive - super-clean and new bathroom with excellent equipment. Lift from the lower ground to the top floor so no problems with heavy bags. Very nice service at the breakfast (included in room price) even if the choice is limited and no fresh veggies are available. Still, you get eggs in all formats, cereals, milk, coffee, orange juice and toasts. WiFi fast, but easily breaking communication. Reasonable pricing considering we have stayed during the long May weekend. Good transportation options because of the vicinity of the Baker Street underground station. Bottom line - very strong 3 star hotel. No luxuries, but reliable package.

title: Basic, clean, but expensive!
text: Very basic for the cost, but very clean and the staff were very polite. I am sure if we had looked harder we could have found somewhere much cheaper with a double bed and a bigger bathroom. But on the upside we found that the Marylebone Summer Fair was on that weekend and we were right in the middle of it so a bonus for our Sunday! One thing, be sure you don't travel on Gay Pride Parade Saturday, the traffic is a appalling and the cost of getting anywhere in a taxi is not good, we were sure we paid more that we should have.

title: Location is key
text: I stayed here with my partner for 8 nights. Following a late and frustrating arrival, where we had to pay immediately for almost the entire length of our stay, we were given a tiny room with a 1.3 metre bed. Fortunately, after a couple of nights, we were able to move to a larger room (with a slightly larger bed). The rooms and bathrooms were both clean and modern. Wifi is included. However, for the price, I believe we could have done better where toiletries are concerned. Sachets of shampoo/conditioner/soap do not really cut it. The breakfast was okay, though unimaginative. Service was fine. They do not serve meat for breakfast, but I don't understand why they can't provide cheese, or fish or fresh fruit - the everpresent tinned fruit salad was unappealing to say the least. This is not a cheap hotel. Its location is excellent, and there is no shortage of good restaurants nearby - but I believe it could provide so much more.

title: Ticked a lot of boxes
text: This hotel has been modernised to a very high standard. The staff are very efficient and helpful. The breakfast was in between full English and continental with the range of juices, cereals etc a bit limited as was the hot food element but the service and cooking were excellent. We stayed in a twin room and it was very compact. We had to squeeze past one another to get around but everything was extremely clean and the beds were very comfortable. The location is very handy for the tube and the price is very competitive for central London.

title: A pleasant stay
text: My family visited London three days ago and decided to book this hotel. We got a triple room. The room is spacious enough and the beds are so comfortable. The TV has loads of channels and the washroom is clean. Breakfast is delicious. Friendly staff. Overall, excellent quality.

title: Weekend Break
text: I had this hotel booked as part of a birthday present weekend to London with my boyfriend. We stayed here for 1 night and upon arrival I was very happy. The staff were so helpful, and let us check in 2 hours early which was great. Room was spacious and clean, the bathroom was great and shower was even better. Breakfast was OK, get a choice of how you would like your eggs (fried, poached, scrambled or omelette), and then choice of toast, cereal and juices. I would return to this hotel

title: Short break away
text: Hotel very clean. Staff on reception very helpful . Bedroom compact always plenty of hot water, shelf over washbasin too low my husband always knocking his head. Dining room pleasant choice limited no bacon on menu. Table not cleared as you finished cereal bowl & plate after cooked meal left while you had your toast. Food hot when served.

title: Visiting London for a few days.
text: Great location in London. Around the corner from Madam Tussauds and the famous Baker Street, home of Sherlock Holmes. The hotel is very modern and clean. We stayed in the middle of November, and it was freezing cold outside, but the room was nice and warm. I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting London, particularly for a few days. Marylebone is just down the road, with its abundance of restaurants and pubs.

title: Friendly staff and centrally located.
text: Very centrally located to the transport in London. Lovely quiet, clean hotel with very friendly and helpful staff members. Not very large room but not tiny either. Has all the usual wants and is very clean, tidy and modern. Free wifi in the room is great. Very short walk to some fantastic eateries, pubs, attractions, convenience stores and cash machines.

title: Convenient
text: Clean and comfortable. A little gem in the city. Highly recommend this hotel.ideally located and excellent value for money. Ladies travelling in London can feel safe here, quiet location.able to accommodate parties of three to five who wish to share room & costs.breakfast included and hot & cold options available all included!

title: Bacon Free Zone!
text: This is a medium priced hotel for central London and is quite well placed for the main attractions. Its an attractive building and has had a fairly modern make-over inside. Our room was a bit cramped but had adequate facilities. There was no view from the window. The room arrangement leaves a lot to be desired

title: Decent stay nothing special
text: I had here for 2 nights on business. Overall it's a decent stay. I booked last minute and wanted to stay in Central London. There wasn't much available that was in my budget so I went with the Regency. The location is good as it's very central and close to Baker St and Marylebone High St so a lot of restaurant options around and it's close to the tube. When I checked in the guy the front desk was friendly and helpful. My room was on the small side but clean. The bathroom was basic and not many toiletries were offered. Don't expect to find luxury here. It was quiet at night so got a good sleep. Breakfast is offered but I didn't partake. All in all a decent safe stay in the center of the city to put your head down. A bit too expensive for what it is though.

title: great location, accessibility problems
text: Pros: close to Marylebone station, Baker street tube, within walking distance to Oxford street high shopping. Fantastic in terms of transportation and shopping. Eateries all around. Breakfast cereal and water - some pleasant ladies brought over menu that you can order hot breakfast off on. Mushroom omelette and croissant worked for me. Cons: there are half-floors that the lift cannot get to. No ironing board not for business travel. Big downside the shampoo and soap comes in a small tear-off pouch. Was expecting new ones for next day but NO! Nothing. That's taking cost down a bit too far. At the very least make this known to customers so that they can be prepared for life without shampoo (or go out and buy some prior to stepping into the shower)!

title: Quiet, decent hotel
text: Nice hotel in a quiet and somewhat boring area of Marylebone. Rooms a bit on the small side, but this is London. The bed was comfortable, the room very clean and the shower was . Even the breakfast was ok.

title: Stay only if you have to
text: This review misses the "terrible" rating with a very small margin. The only good thing about this hotel is its location. Other than that, everything will easily get the terrible mark! Front staff very rude, room itself dirty, small and like a prison cell. Horrible Wi-Fi too. And you have to pay a very expensive price for this carp service ... I will never stay in this hotel again.

title: Noisy but clean
text: 4 nights at this hotel at the end of November. Had asked for a quiet room since I'm a light sleeper. Got a room in the basement. Right next to the pipes rattling away at all times of course as other guests used bathrooms and showers. Room tiny but clean, bathrooms fairly new and fresh. Nice breakfast. Friendly staff. At 159£ a night not really value for money.

title: Excellent Hotel
text: Situated in the heart of Marylebone, we were pleased to have such a comfortable, clean and warm hotel. The nearest tube station is around the corner at Baker Street. We had a queen bed in a small room, but, it was so comfortable I even missed breakfast after my first night! The room was spotless, and the hotel looked as though it had gone through a complete refurbishment. The bathroom was immaculate and the usual free wi-fi, small safe and flat screen TV are provided. It was near the end of November when we stayed and the weather was cold and wet. Inside, it was cozy and warm. I have no faults with this hotel, the room, the staff and the breakfast. I would recommend it to anyone wishing to stay in this part of London. While the roads are fairly quiet outside, I suspect some people won't be too happy with the traffic, but hey, this is central London, not the middle of the countryside. About 150 yards down the road is Marylebone High Street with its myriad of shops, restaurants and pubs. All in all a great little hotel in a great location with friendly, helpful staff.

title: Worth money with decent location
text: Stayed one night in this hotel. Location is a bit far away from activities. If you start walking south(-east) through Marylebone, Mayfair and Soho areas in 25 min you end up Piccadilly Circus, which is full of shopping, eating and amusement possibilities. While walking you will see all the brand stores you can possibly think of. Hotel itself is very clean, free wifi and breakfast work well and rooms are big enough. If you like to sleep a bit longer, ask for a room that is not at the end of hallway, otherwise other will wake you up while leaving the hotel.

title: Really Good Hotel
text: I was staying at the hotel in the 1st week of November, its a really nice & very clean hotel. Centrally located & close to the subway station. Breakfast was not too elaborate but was decent & fresh. The staff is friendly & quite helpful. Will surely stay in this hotel again.

title: Fantastic value for money
text: Stayed one night with my sister as somewhere to rest following laser eye surgery at the nearby London Vision Clinic. Location was great, short walk to harley st, oxford at and Euston. The beds were so comfy! Which was exactly what I needed following surgery! Large comfortable and well decorated room with a large ensuite with very clean and modern suite! Tea and coffee facilities and a large flat screen tv made our stay top notch. The breakfast was lovely too with cereals and fresh coffee plus cooked eggs,beans,tomatoes and mushrooms and toast as your hot choice. All very good quality and service was quick and friendly. I couldn't recommend this hotel more, fab location, lovely rooms, comfy bed and filling brekfast! I'll stay here again for sure! Thankyou so much regency parkside!

title: Great location and cleen
text: Stayed here for three nights with a friend, and it was ok. The people working in the reseption was helpful and friendly, the room was cleen and we got new towels every day. Very small room, and there was no extra floor beside the bed to open the suitcase on. The room as also a little cold, and it was not possible to turn any heat on. The breakfast was ok. You could choose between different eggs, bread and cereal but that is about it. I don't think I saw the staff in the breakfast restaurant smiling once. The hotel has a very good location. 10-15min walk to Oxford street and 5min to Baker street underground. It is also in a quiet area, and we did no hear a sound from the street.

title: Great hotel!!
text: We were here for one night and loved it. Staff are friendly, it's clean and really nice set up, plus it's close to Baker at train station. Good location. Would definitely go back if we visit London again. Breakfast was simple but good. Well done guys :)

title: Good value for London and good location
text: We have been at this hotel for 4 nights (2 rooms) during our last visit at London. The location is very good since its only 3 min walk to Madam Tussaue and less than 5 minutes to Baker street station which is a major one with few different lines. The staff are great and helpful. The rooms are small - very small. in the double bed room our bed from one side was near the wall, no space at all! The room itself was clean with nice bed but hardly 2 people can move in it. The breakfast room is very small also, only few tables. Breakfast choice is the same every day, limited choice but fresh and pretty tasty.

title: Good clean hotel in great location, great value
text: Newly done out, this is a really nice little place so close to Regents Park. I was in a "single" room which only cost £125 which is not at all bad for London. However, the only thing I would say is that the twin room I ended up in had REALLY small single beds - not even the "normal" sized single. If you are a bit of a wriggler you might end up on the floor - or at least the duvet (which is equally tiny) might! The shower room is also pretty small with the teeniest sink I have ever tried to clean my teeth in! But apart from that, it was super clean, fresh, all new.

title: Little gem!
text: Stayed at Regency Parkside for one night to attend meeting in Marleybone. I chose it as it was 5 minutes walk to Baker Street and 25 minutes from Euston station. I was Really pleased with hotel. It's been recently refurbished. My room was on the ground floor and I felt as though I was the first person to stay in it , it was immaculate and everything brand new. Key card entry. The bedding was pristine and the carpets spotless. I was impressed to find that I had a large mounted TV, fridge , hair dryer, kettle and air conditioning. There was even free wifi in the room.The bed was extremely comfy . I had a wonderful nights sleep. Breakfast was better than expected in the basement breakfast room. It consisted of self serve cereal and I was offered toast and eggs, , cooked to my choice , to order. I was able to leave a bag to pick up later. If I had to make a criticism it would be that there was a generator outside my bedroom window . However it didn't prevent me from sleeping. I would definitely recommend and would stay again.

title: Great location and wonderful staff
text: Only a few minutes walk from the tube station passing Madam Tussar and Sherlock Statue. Compact and cozy room. Front desk staff is ready to help at any time. Only regret is breakfast choice is very limited.

title: Good hotel in central london
text: Nice small hotet. Small and clean with 24 hrs reception. The staff was very helpfull and courteous. The location was peacefull and is located in a very safe neighbourhood. Very centrally located. Breakfast was freshly cooked and good. The rooms are small and do not have any view but overall a good find in the heart of the city. Remmended for stay in central London.

title: Better than expected
text: Nice small hotel, which looks like it has been refurbished fairly recently. Room was clean and comfortable, although a bit cramped as there was an extra single bed in it. Staff were friendly. Breakfast was fairly basic but we expected that from previous reviews. The cooked bit was freshly cooked to order and was better quality than most buffet breakfasts in more expensive hotels although limited in choice. Good location for Regents Park Open Air Theatre.

title: Decent for £165/night
text: Nice hotel at 10 minutes from st pancras station in a fairly quiet neighborhood. The room was nice and clean, I slept well on the bed and the staff was friendly. I got room 213 and the only downside was the view from the window, basically looking at a wall. All things considered I would recommend this hotel.

title: Not to be recommended
text: This was the first time I used this so-called 3-star rated hotel. Who provided this rating? Looking back I was fortunate that it was only for one night. The receptionist was friendly and there were no issues checking in. Had a double room on the 5th floor. The room was hot and had little ventilation. The bedroom furniture was outdated and the dsressing table had a big burn mark. The matrass on the double bed was awful. When you sit or lie on it you can feel the springs. The loo seat was broken and the plug in the handwash basin could not be closed and opened. The light fixture above the mirror was old and didn't give much light. The next morning I realised the shower didn't work. There was too little water pressure to get the water through the shower head. The breakfast was very poor. Few types of cereal, few white buns and a jug of orange juice on the buffet counter. Ordered a full English. The sausage was terrible, the bacon was of poor quality (more fat then meat) and the coffeee was too strong and tasted awful. Total lack of imagination when it comes to providing a breakfast. The bill for one night came to a whopping £ 135, an absolute rip off for what was offered.

title: A Night Out In Town
text: A nice clean place to stay, staff were very helpful and provided great service. Breakfast was good and filling. The only downside of my visit was that it was a very hot day and night, the room was very hot, even with the window open. I did think of going down to reception to see if any fans were available but it was too hot to move :(

title: Excellent location
text: We booked here for a night in March and were very pleasantly surprised. It is excellently situated being only 2 minutes from Paddington station and there are a lot of places to eat very near by. We were in a triple room (3 single beds), it was a good size and had a kettle along with everything you would need to make a tea or coffee. The bathroom was compact with a small bath and over bath shower, again all you needed in a bathroom. The breakfast was tasty and hot, the staff were very friendly. If we were staying in this part of London again we wouldn't hesitate to book here.

title: Lovely hotel, friendly staff, and well located!
text: My Mum and I stayed here on 28th February. A lovely hotel and really friendly staff. So well located, only a two minute walk from Paddington Station, and many buses to many places in central London. A lovely cooked breakfast, very comfy beds, and a great nights sleep. A very reasonable price too! and a quiet location. We're hoping to come back again in the summer, and also for the Christmas lights. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Chrysos Hotel. Thanks for a lovely stay in London.

title: Dont do it!
text: The only good thing here is the location. The reception staff are doing a favor that they are answering your questions. NO WIFI in the rooms and they are not doing anything to solve it. NOT RECOMMENDED!

title: Convenient location closed to Paddington Train station and Marylebone station
text: Traditional English local Hotel. Staff is nice and efficient. Clean and tidy relatively to others hotel closed to train station. Different varieties of food are nearby such western and Asian restaurants, takeaway shop and fast food shop. The price of food is reasonable. It suits for economy traveller.

title: Jewel of London!
text: Stayed here for three nights. It's clean with a perfect location and surprisingly quiet, which makes a change from some hotels I've stayed in this area. Staff are friendly and rooms are basic & well decorated. It's a nice little hotel and would recommend it for sure!

title: Good Value, Great Location - Would stay again!
text: We stayed here for 5 nights, and found reception very helpful when checking in, although our room wasn't ready when we arrived we could leave our bags in the lobby. Not a secure luggage room but it was safe enough to not worry us. The room was quite small but that is what we were expecting, and as a place to sleep it was fine. We were right next to the elevator on the 3rd floor, and initially I was unhappy with the room as the elevator was very loud when opening and closing, and I thought it might keep me awake at night. However I ended up having no troubles sleeping. The english breakfast was very nice, and the continental selection what you would expect, cereal, toast, juice. The wireless internet did not work in our room, it sometimes worked in our friend's room as they were on the 2nd floor, so we had to go to the lobby to use the internet there. It was free, and whilst it would cut out every so often was still quite acceptable. Located right near Paddington Station, in a pleasant looking square I found the location couldn't have been better considering the price range. Would definately reccommend to others and stay here again.

title: Clean and friendly, needs a makeover though!
text: My wife and I have just spent 2 nights at the Chrysos which was a little disappointing. Whilst the hotel was generally very clean,all the staff very friendly and the hotel in an excellent location, we thought it was not good value for what we paid. Our room (No 34) was very small for a twin, should have been a single really! The bathroom is tiny,I am not large (11 stone) and found washing in the sink a problem. I guess a larger person would have to keep the bathroom door open to manoeuvre around it! There were many faults, sink plug would not work (2 calls for the maintenance guy) T.V. reception awful (new cable fitted) radiator control fell off (re-fitted by me) free WI-Fi unavailable from 3rd floor upwards (confirmed by other guests) and to top it off the reading lamp failed on our second night. Looks as if they have carried out some refurbishing, new beds,bedding, curtains and bathroom fittings but have not redecorated which spoils the overall appearance. I would recommend this hotel though as I guess not everyone has had a bad experience and given that there were some very good points to the hotel. To be honest if my wife was not in St Mary's Hospital having a heart operation I would have kicked up more of a fuss.

title: Good Location/Very Basic
text: The hotel is located very close to Paddington Station - which is a great location. The hotel is very small and rooms are very tight! If you just want somewhere to sleep and shower only it will do for the price. I wouldn’t really call it a breakfast but in a pinch it will do. Cleanliness was very moderate so don’t expect more. Staff was very friendly and helpful.

title: My worst experience
text: I stayed at this hotel in August durring my short bussines trip in London. I would say the days were awfull not because the rain that killed me but because this so called three stars hotel. Except the location, everything was dissapointing. Starting with the guy from Reception( a beardman extremely bored), the room( extremly old and dirty), then the bathroom(insalubrious with hairs on the floor) and the breakfast(very poor with lousy service- some hungarian ladies taking loud and to much for a service person) The word - dissapointing

title: Exellent staff
text: Exellent staff! Very helpful and profecionals! They make the difference. Next Year i'll be Back to stay with you guys! Thank you for everything continue like this and you Will have loyal new guests! I'll suggest your hotel to my friends!

title: basic accommodations, very tidy, and good value
text: This hotel provides basic accommodations, is very tidy, and was a great price. The neighborhood is very convenient to Paddington station and walking distance to Hyde Park. The staff was helpful too. If you're looking for the Ritz, this ain't it, but it's a clean and basic hotel with a good price.

title: Very Good Value
text: I stayed here for a week in July with my husband and teenage son in a triple room. I had expected the room to be extremely small but while it was smaller than North American standards, we had ample room and did not feel confined. The room was immaculate and always kept clean by housekeeping staff. It was a hot week in London when we were there so we appreciated that the window could open and we left it ajar all the while we were there as the hotel does not have air conditioning. Our only complaint was that the bathroom was far too hot - we asked to have the heat turned off but that only happened once and then it was on again - think it was the towel bar. The breakfast is adequate and enough to get you started. Location is excellent and like others have said, just a few minutes from the Paddington Station which is also convenient for the Heathrow express. Good grocery marts in the Paddington station which we used frequently to buy water and fruit. Hotel and location was very quiet as well. Front desk was also very helpful. If you take any of the Premier Tours, the pick up is at the Hilton right beside Paddington Station and this was great for us, since we took 2 of the tours out of the city. Would definitely recommend this hotel and would stay there again.

title: Brilliant hotel, excellent location
text: I was very, very pleased by my 4 nights stay in this beautiful hotel. Don't understand why rate is so low. It was unexpectedly very nice hotel. Spacious (by London standards) room and bathroom, spotless clean, big and comfortable bed. Very quiet undisturbed rest. Had no problem with water pressure or temperature (on ground foor), morden units and mixture taps, shower over bath. Tea & coffee facilities in the room. Hair drier was supplied immediately on request. Polite and helpful staff. Breakfast: continental unlimited with reasonable choice of cereals, juice, milk, a pot of coffee or tea on demand, plenty of toasts freshly made. English breakfast served on demand in a matter of minutes, hot and fresh. Very eficient and smiling staff! Absolutely everything you need for a good start of the day! Well, Wi-Fi is quite slow but ok for browsing. Overall, after reading some reviews, was surprised with a quality hotel in a busy London area for a reasonable prise considering location (booked a BA deal). Many thanks for my lovely stay!

title: A good option for a good value stay - good breakfast too
text: I've stayed here for a few nights a week over the space of a fortnight. This is a good option if you want a comfy budget hotel, friendly staff, free wifi, and a decent breakfast - all within a 2 minute walk of Paddington station. Week 1 I was in a single room on floor 5 - which was tiny, but clean, and quiet. Week 2 I was in a double room on the 4th floor - this was bigger, had tea and coffee making facilities, and was much comfier. Plus points here : the rooms are clean, tidily appointed and furnished, and have double glazing, so exterior noise is greatly reduced considering Paddington station is around the corner. There are also a small number of rooms on each floor, so noise is reduced as you don't have so many people banging doors etc. I stayed in another hotel in Norfolk Square before this one - this one however is far, far better. The breakfast is small, but there's no supplement for having a cooked English breakfast, and there is plenty to eat with toast and cereal too. The breakfast room is a decent size, too. Wifi is free - it didn't work on the 5th floor, but worked fine on the 4th floor and in the lobby. I would (and have) stayed here again.

title: great location but thats all you get,
text: i booked a different hotel through a company however i was informed my booking had to be changed and was placed at the chrysos hotel, i found it to be in a great location just metres from paddington station, but that was the only great thing, service was fine room was clean but very small no wifi in rooms but was lucky enough to find a neighbours signal on one of my nights on this trip i was a single traveler and was given a single bed in a box room the tv and hospitality tray were located above my head so viewing was poor and to use the kettle involved reaching up over the bed over my head then to boil it either on the floor or on the bed as no other surface, there was no room to store my case so was constantly squeezing past it the toilet and shower room was 1m x 1m but functional altho the shower was very poor , the easy hotel paddington is within sight of this hotel and the rooms there are bigger and its cheaper and as a young single traveler would of suited me better, i didnt use the breakfast facilities so cannot comment

title: Centrally located, well priced
text: Well priced, functional and well located overlooking a Square (which means a garden) in Paddington, London. Extreme value for money and would not hesistate to recommend to anyone who wants Central London at a reasonable price. 10 mins away from Oxford Street. A smiley and friendly receptionist - makes all the difference to an extra *.

title: Linda R - Fantastic Stay at Chrysos Hotel
text: I stayed at this hotel with my two sisters for three nights, it was an absolute pleasure, the staff were so helpful and really interactive with us, the reception is 24 hours and always staffed with a good humoured receptionist, the information given back to us as we threw question after question, was fully answered and more importantly followed with better information than what we had and moneysaving too. The room was a triple, comfortable, clean, tea making facilities, hot water for showers, room was cleaned and towels replaced every day, great TV with lots of channels including Radio and music channels, there is even sound proofing slides on the windows so no noise from the street, breakfast was really good as was the dining staff. This hotel was recommended to me by the agent I booked through for the location, which was so perfect for us close to everywhere we wanted to visit, this is the perfect location as everything is on your doorstop (even a McDonalds) Thank you for making our stay in London memorable, (for the right reasons)..

title: Best Service ever had in London
text: I stayed at the Hotel last month and I would like to say that was the best time I had in London . The service is perfect and the Greek Receptionist Nikolas ( the guy with the beard ) is the most professional receptionist I have ever seen. He is always smiling to the clients and the information he gives is always spot on And just to answer to the traveller bellow who said about how he dressed I don't think that you can find a lot of receptionists in London dressed everyday in Hugo Boss and Armani ( probably something you forgot to mention in your bitter review bellow mome m ( btw you can crawl back into your miserable hole now) The rooms are good but need refreshing and the wifi is a problem that I am sure they will solve eventually A big thank you to Nikolas for his service and I hope we will see him again soon .

title: Large rooms, don't order Continental breakfast
text: Arrived early at the hotel. Check in time is usually 2pm but room was ready at 1:30pm which was good. They also let you leave your bags at the reception area if you want to walk around before check in time. Bags just lie there in common area relatively unattended so don't leave any important stuff or valuables. The room is big for London. It has a desk, wardrobe, bathtub and coffee & tea. There's no hair dryer so plan ahead if you need one. Also no A/C which would have been appreciated since it was very hot during my stay, but having the window open all day helped cool down the room. Wi-Fi is not good but works to at least get some directions and book attractions. Connection is very slow and intermittent. There are two underground stations that you can use to easily get to the city center. Breakfast is a joke. They still don't know the definition of Continental breakfast so they just leave you there with toast and butter. No meat, no eggs, just plain toast and butter. English breakfast is not that good either. As other reviews said it's served cold, the one egg you get looks like plastic, and taste is not good overall. You're better off going to a supermarket nearby and getting a sandwich with soda. Won't cost you more than 5 pounds and it will be much better than what they give you here. I'd rather have the hotel tell me there's no breakfast included than having to sit there eating toast and butter. I mean just google Continental breakfast people! I have had nothing to eat this morning because of course when they explained that my breakfast was going to be just toast and coffee it was already too late for them to give me English breakfast. The so called kitchen was already closed. Great recipe for a hungry angry tourist, they get that right. Overall the place is passable. Just try to avoid inconveniences and get your breakfast elsewhere. My review is heavily influenced by my hunger right now.

title: good enough
text: The location is perfect if you're arriving in Paddington late at night. Exit the station, turn right, walk by Burger King and you're pretty much there. There are plenty of places to eat nearby and it's located close to many sightseeing spots. The rooms are old but the hotel is quite nice. It was quite chilly so I appreciated the heater next to the bed. The shower was strong. The bed was...a bed. That's it. It was enough. Breakfast was good, No complaints really. It was okay for a night but I wouldn't have spent a week there.

title: Quite a good find
text: Nice hotel which offers a comfortable room at a decent price. Booked a single room and got a twin. Plenty of space in the room which was quite clean. Good powerful shower. Only downsides were the extractor fan in the bathroom which was noise and ineffective and the TV attached to the wall was too small to watch while in bed. Breakfast was okay and served very politely by the staff.

title: Good for me
text: The Chrysos, stayed nine nights in late September The hotel is cheap (for London) and as always you get what you pay for The room and bathroom were small but functional, but tired and could do with a lick of paint, the water was hot and plentiful, the bed just OK, the breakfast was passable for 3-4 days then got boring, some fruit salad would have been nice, I (personally) do not wish to eat eggs and toast for nine days The staff were helpful and the hotel was close to most places I wanted and Paddington has lots of eating diversity The hotel was good for me but other people might be disappointed at first sight, it is a bit of a "rabbit" warren and as before some rooms are small with single bed, if you book a single room probably that is what you will get and it might not suit someone who wishes to stay more than a couple of days

title: Bad
text: Very bad service. Very small rooms. Towels are torn up. Uncomfortable beds and pillows. Water was very hot I burnt my skin and they could care less. Receptionist is very bad, inattentive and rude. Only advantage is that the hotel is close to Paddington Station. NOT RECOMMENDED AT ALL!!!!

title: Freindly Staff - Good location
text: A great small size hotel in a nice location in Norfolk Plaza. Rooms are a bit old with carpets, however, it's a 3* budget hotel. Breakfast is average but location and staff friendliness gives it some points!

title: Bed Bugs...refused refund!
text: 2 hours after checking in we found a bed bug in our room, which we discreetly took to show the manager and said we would have to find another hotel and asked for a refund. He assured us we had to get our refund back in Canada thru our travel agent via the booking agent, but it would be "no problem". He admitted bed bugs were a problem in the whole area. Upon return, we found he had wrote an email to the booking agent blatantly lying and we were unable to get a refund. These are very unethical people! Do not stay here!

title: Surprise Find
text: I had an overnight in London before a flight to America the next day at London Heathrow. Ever - ambitious, I made some plans to dine with family friends that evening and needed to be able to get to Kings Cross easily, and of course back to LHR the next day. I chose this hotel for proximity to Paddington Station (both the Tube a d Heathrow express), and really just wanted a clean room, shower, and a bit of breakfast the next morning. The room was pretty basic, but it was clean and quiet. I did hear a neighbor cough a bit, which makes me wonder if being there on. Friday or Saturday night (opposed to Sunday) would have been less peaceful. The hotel is located on a square that faces a common area, and can be easy to overlook if not paying attention. As I mentioned before, the room was pretty basic, but what I appreciated most was the extreme friendliness and courtesy of the staff--both at check in and at breakfast. I got my rest and the price was definitely right. I would stay again under when the need arises.

title: Do not stay.
text: First of all, this is NOT a 3 star hotel far from it, superior modern rooms is a joke. My room was so old the telephone was stained yellow, severe mould in the shower cubilce, despite the website saying a bath. Carpets dusty with fluff on it. "Full" English breakfast consists of 1 sausage, 1 bacon, 1 egg and a spoon full of beans - all nice and cold. Reception area is nice and definetly had money to "Spruce" it up, though everything is very outdated - do not be misled by the website like I was, the area is not the best though only a short walk to main hyde park / oxford street. My advice - dont waste your money on this, stay somewhere else. Had a great weekend in London,though hotel nearly ruined it!!

title: Dont stay here if you want a shower!!
text: The Chrysos Hotel is very conveniently situated for Paddington Station. It is a 3 star hotel. My only complaint (but quite an important one!!) is that the shower in the en-suite bathroom was totally inadequate - it was just a very small dribble of water

title: Nice and clean
text: If you are looking for a nice, basic and clean room then Chrysos is what you looking for. 2 minutes walk from paddington station!

title: Perfect location!
text: This is the ideal hotel if you need something just to put your bags down and sleep at night. It has a fantastic location, right in the heart of Paddington night life and the Paddington train station is a short 2 minute walk from the hotel. If I ever stay in London again, I will be returning! The service is great, the staff are very friendly and the breakfasts are delicious. I couldn't recommend this enough, its great!!! Thank you for helping to make our trip so perfect.

title: Never going back
text: I stayed at the Chrysos last year while on a London trip with my boyfriend, and the experience was awful. The room was tiny, but my biggest issue was the staff who absolutely rude. We went down to have breakfast and in the middle of our meal we were promptly told that breakfast time was over and we needed to leave. One of the waitresses literally yanked the coffee cup out of my boyfriend's hand and insisted that she needed to clear away the table as breakfast time was over. I was completely shocked and horrified. I have never seen such poor customer service in my life. I was terribly disappointed and I would NOT recommend this "hotel" to anyone.

title: Child friendly hotel in excellent location
text: We stayed ay the hotel for a weekend in a family room. The room wasn't huge but there was plenty of space for 3 of us. It was spotlessly clean and the staff were all pleasant and helpful. It is 5mins walk from Paddington Station and just round the corner from The big bus tour route where you can pick up tour bus to Hyde Park and all round London sights. Hyde Park and Oxford St are a 15-20min level walk away. Paddington mainline and tube stations are 5mins walk away. There are lots of cafes,restaurants and takeaways just around the corner but the hotel is in a quiet square with a small park in front. We chose to have continental breakfast but full english was available. I particularly liked that the 11 yr old child with us was made so welcome by everyone,especially the front of house staff.

title: London Stay
text: We were booked into this hotel for 10 nights and it was certainly very convenient for the tube and mainline station. Also plenty of restaurants and cafes at the end of the square. The bathroom had no ventilation and was musty. It would have been nice to get a new soap while we were there. The room was clean and adequate as we didn't spend a lot of time there. Breakfast so so and the kitchen would benefit from a new toaster. found the staff at reception very obliging. there was a lift. Strange to have to request a hair dryer from reception rather than one in the room. I borrowed an iron but no ironing board so ironed on the bed.

title: Tricky hotel that would be happy to rip you off whenever they have chance
text: This is a cheap hotel, but we were charged by 135Ponds per night because we booked at Hotels.com and the rate we browsed was 70ponds per night , but it end up shows 135Ponds per night on order confirmation printout at Hotels.com. We did not check carefully when we print out the order confirmation and when we argued to front desk when we checked in, they gave us a lot of reasons why the rate was 135Ponds and they even refuse to cancel for the 2nd night that was written for free cancellation. They asked us to argue with Hotels.com and we did but hotels.com said we should check the order confirmation by ourselves and we explained to them that should be your system problem and we trusted your system now we got suffer and ask Hotels.com to argue with the hotel about the rate, Hotels.com simply said they are not allowed to do it. So we suffered to pay for the high rate at low season in a cheap hotel and it turns out this hotel run by Greek people , perhaps a family and they said the same thing over and over again that they charge what order confirmation said because hotels.com will charge them 15% commission. No matter how many times we explain that the rate we saw when we booked was only 70Ponds per night, they just don't care. THe next morning, we mentioned this to another man in front desk, he finally told us that this is not the first argument, there were some cases before when people booked at Expedia or Hotels.com and did not check carefully on order confirmation and they just charge the amount, obviously that's the culture of this hotel which is cheap and low quality hotel and they found the sneaky way to charge higher rate and they don't care if the customers will be back. We went complain about Hotels.com system and the service people seem to blame on us did not check the order confirmation carefully , so we should be the one to suck the loss. We will never use Hotels.com nor Expedia again and if anyone is using those website just be careful there is such mistake on their system and they don't care!! and this tricky hotel seem to have good cooperation with Hotels.com or Expedia in this way!!

title: poor review....
text: advantages: excellent location next to Paddington station, friendly and kind personel both at reception and breakfast disadvantages: everything else... I'am very sorry to write this but it costs a lot of money without offers not even the basics.....

title: Excellent location and good value for money
text: We had a very pleasant stay in this hotel, situated in a leafy square not far from Hyde Park and close to numerous eating places. Staff were very pleasant and friendly. Our room wasn't large but was clean and comfortable and the en-suite was modern (recently refurbished?) The breakfast was perfectly acceptable, not a great choice but what was offered was nice and well-cooked. The hotel was incredibly quiet both inside and out. I was amazed to go down for breakfast to find the room full of guests as I had thought that the place must be nearly empty as there had been so little noise. Location was ideal, close to the places we wanted to be. Would recommend and would use again as absolutely fine and reasonably priced.

title: One praise for available location one for reception
text: The location which is really close to Paddington station and there are plenty of restaurant around with good quality. However, I guess you would not like to check in the room without central heating in this early spring and without a hair drier unless when you realised and then lent from reception, especially when you found the hair drier is almost like an antique with dirt and stain. Furthermore, you'll spend twice of time to take a bath because the shower is not well enough.

title: hot and no wireless working
text: It was hot in the room and no wireless working. Bed was not comfortable. Paid lots for very little.You could only use the wireless if you were main floor where the router is located. No kleenex in the rooms. The elevator is quite old.

title: Too expensive for its level. Even in London.
text: The only positive aspect of this hotel is the location. Staff at the reception was unpleasant. Room carpet was a crap. Staff at brekfast was kind and helpful even if the choice for breakfast was poor. It's definetly too expensive for its level and the man at the reception should learn to deal with clients in a professional manner: he has been very unpleasant.

title: Lovely staff, great location close to Paddington Underground
text: The reception staff were very friendly and helpful. As check in isn't until 2pm we were able to drop our bags at the hotel early in the morning and go sightseeing for the day and check in later that evening. The hotel is very close to Paddington Underground Station and was a perfect spot to stay while visiting the city. The room was lovely and warm which was great as we had spent all day wandering the sights of London in the cold and were delighted to get back to a warm comfortable room. The WiFi connection in our room worked perfectly. We were very happy with the hotel for the price we paid. The only thing we thought could be improved was the cooked breakfast. It wasn't great and could be improved. We just had cereal and toast on the second morning rather than get the cooked breakfast again. If I was visiting London again I would stay here again.

title: Adequate
text: We chose this hotel for convenience to Paddington for the Heathrow Express. For that purpose, it got the job done, and its proximity to Hyde Park was a plus as well. Setting on Norfolk Square is lovely. The property itself is just okay. Building is nice on the outside, but not updated or well maintained on the inside. Rooms not quite shabby, but outdated, with plenty of scuffs and scratches. Uncomfortable beds. Breakfast not very good. I think the location is the only reason they are able to get away with the price. Poor value. (We probably paid a premium for a stay just before the new year.) Overall, I was disappointed. Very glad we stayed elsewhere for most of our trip.

title: Cute Boutique hotel
text: Stayed here 2 nights. Cute, quaint. Bed was great. I had had hip surgery 8 weeks prior and getting into the tub was very tricky. People pleasant and helpful. Breakfast was wonderful-typical English breakfast. Bus to tour was around the corner. Paddington Station a 5 min walk. Very convenient. I would stay again.

title: Excellent service - Chrysos Hotel
