A mini heater, as well as radiator kept the room warm. Tiny but impressive en-suite shower. Huge shower head! Nextdoor, a few steps away, the pub area which is handy if you just want pizza/nibbles/drink.

title: Clean and comfortable
text: Don’t judge a book from its cover I’m told, and on arrival my heart sank at the surrounding flats that surrounded the place. A lovely polish lady checked us in and gave us a detailed walk around showing us the kitchen the bathrooms then our rooms. I had an en-suite room which I was more than happy with. The bed was super comfy and the bathroom was modern, clean with plenty of amenities. The room also comes with a mini fridge which is really useful. Plenty of sockets in the room and USB charge sockets too. The room was lovely and warm and on arrival all the carpets had just been shampooed too. There is a bus stop right outside, use the buses they’re great and you see more rather than the underground. Parking is available on the front at a charge, the other parking spaces close by are for the residents. I didn’t get breakfast, I’m not sure if you have to book this or not.

title: Hour glass hotel
text: Enjoyed our stay would defiantly come back staff very helpful and clean rooms at a good price also in a good location as not far from central London also close to good food places would recommend accommodation for everyone

title: That is what talking about:)
text: The rooms are very nice and clean. Me and my girlfriend stayed in freshly decorated en suite double room on the ground floor. We have been upgrated for en suite free of charge, which was great. Sebastian, the manager did our loundry after long travel across Europe without taking even a penny, that is what i am talking about! Loved It! Definatelly will ne back.

title: Familiar Spirit
text: As we searched a Hotel with a Pub in the near, we found a Pub with a Hotel. We felt very comfortable and welcome. It‘ s a cute Hotel. The Bus Station is directly by the hotel. You can take the bus route no. 42 or 343 to drive in the City or to the Station Elephant & Castle. When I get back to London I‘ll check in at the Hour Glass Hotel.

title: Disappointed
text: Didn't get the value for my money,got to the hotel and even locating the reception was a problem. There was a bar with people all around drunk. After a long wait we were finally ushered into our room and to my surprise i was given a twin bed when i had booked for a double bed. When i questioned the receptionist they were so busy so that's what i get after paying the full amount for the room. I don't think i would use them again.

title: Avarage place for low cost
text: We spent a weekend there and it was not bad. The price was very good, taking into consideration our tight budget and prices in other places in London. The room was small but nice, beds could be more comfortable, but I slept on worse. The neighborhood looks kind of scary, but we had walked there few times very late and nothing bad happened. The hotel is in walking distance of several bus lines, with good connection to metro (Elephant & Castle station). Also shops are around and a local pub downstairs. The manager was from our country, so we had no problems with the staff- they were nice and friendly to us- told us a lot about the neighborhood, buses, metro, things in London, etc. The bad point is one share bathroom for few rooms, what can be annoying, but it was clean. Corridors and stairs and very narrow, the whole place is located in small, 2 level house. Generally it was OK for students or young couple like us, but older travelers probably expect more of a hotel.

title: Would go again!
text: We have friends who we have not seen for quite a while, and suggested a leisurely lunch. "The Hour Glass", they said. I'd heard of it, but was not sure it would be up to it. However.... Pleasantly surprised. Decent menu. Friendly efficient service. Plenty of parking. And my steak was good!

title: awesome hotel
text: One of the best hotels in London in its price category. Clean, large room. Excellent service, always responsive and pleasant staff. Great food and location of the hotel is quite acceptable. I'm not the first time was in London, I would say exactly the price of its best hotel I've ever seen. Thank you!

title: Perfect place for my holiday
text: I booked this hotel mainly for its location.It is very close to the centre,one straight bus and in 15 min you are at London Eye,Westminster Palace.The room was very nice and very clean,bathroom was quite big and modern furbished.There is a fully equipped kitchen available,which I find it quite handy as London is expensive and you can not eat every day in the city..Overall,my staying was simply perfect, I had everything I needed:nice, comfy bed,big room,quality shower,wifi,tea/coffee replenished daily,nice personnel,seb and Dan were more than helpful...I would recommend this hotel to everyone!

title: A nice find
text: The only thing that wasn't so great about this hotel was the location because it isn't near a tube station or bus stops so a bit of pre-visit route planning was needed. However - the hotel itself was excellent value for money, the staff were great, the room and bathroom were clean and cosy. It even had a little fridge in the room which was really handy. What more can you want from a London hotel on a budget on a busy weekend before Christmas? We were very pleased with it.

title: Very friendly pleasant place to be
text: On arrival at the hotel we was greated by Daniela who was very friendly and helpfull, and made us feel very welcome. The room is very good value for money. The bar has a friendly welcoming atmosphere. overall i enjoyed my stay.

title: Epic place
text: Good value pub and rooms, plus self catering kitchen and laundry as well and a fridge in our room, saved us loads of money!!! Very very nice staff and people, amazing service especially from Caroline, Kiesa and razvan, we will definitely be coming back here when we are working in the area, can't believe I'm in central London!!! Super duper ten out of ten service and a lot of fun in the evening :)

title: Great service
text: Me and my partner stayed here for New Year’s Eve and what made it for us was the polish gentleman running the hotel and pub. Lovely guy great customer service can’t complain about anything. Thank you for having us.

title: Terrible night sleep
text: Room was tatty, tired and too hot. My husband and I had to leave the room during the early hours as we couldn't turn the heating down the breakfast was poor quality, I spoke to the manager who said we should have turned down the radiator? We tried??? The bed was literally on the red hot radiator

title: Comfortable, very clean and quiet
text: The room and bathroom were very clean, beds and towels washed, changed daily. The bed was very fluffy and comfortable. Perfect for those who want to spend little time in the hotel, just to sleep and take a shower. The room had an electric jug to heat water and make some tea or coffee. Quiet area, with bus stop in front of the hotel. Buses stop every 6 minutes for various zones. Close to Elephant and Castle, several restaurants, very nice pub, subway and train. No one bothered us, it was very pleasant. Certainly I will return for next time!! Love it :)

title: Great place for the price
text: I stayed here three nights and i must say that this is a nice and clean hotel if you are on a budget. It has an ample and clean kitchen with everything you need, the washing machine and drier was a plus for me. My room was kept clean with the bedding and towels changed and the beds were comfortable. Tea and coffee were excellent. We tried the pizzas in the pub and they were tasty. Very short bus ride to the underground station. If i were to visit london again I would stay here.

title: Great value for money, clean, friendly, a good place to stay.
text: I stayed here from 14th-27th April, sharing a twin room with a pal. I was very impressed

title: Pleased
text: We just stayed in the hotel only 1 night. We booked a room for three with shared facilities. However, when we arrived, Daniella warmly welcomed us and proposed us to have a private bathroom instead, free of charge. We were really pleased by this special attention especially as the room was very comfy. I recommend this hotel to anyone who wants a great value for money accommodation. Alex

title: Interest experience
text: We booked a room with a bath room, so had to climb up 4 floors as these rooms are at the top of the establishment. The hotel is sort of a bread and breakfast and sort of not. The hotel sits above a pub so it is very much like old facilities used to be. But this means if you arrive early, before the pub is open you have to bang on the locked door to get the cleaning person to answer. The place was clean, the beds were comfortable, the closet space was minuscule, the Wi-Fi was sporadic and for one of us didn't work. The amount of food they delivered each evening was abundant and reasonably good. Coffee and tea were excellent. Room contains a large flat screen tv, small refrigerator, tea, coffee, sweeteners and cream. For those interested they can cook and eat in the roomy kitchen, which besides all the usual accouterments has washers and dryers for laundry. A walk to the nearest tube station, but more than doable. Bus around the corner makes it possible to have a short bus ride to central London.

title: Better than Expected
text: The Hour Glass hotel pleasantly surprised me. It is a decent hotel if you are looking for a place to stay on a budget. The location is not the best (it isn't that easy to find) but is is only a couple minutes walk from Tesco on Old Kent road where you can find many connivence stores and cheap restaurants. The hotel also had a couple bathrooms with showers on most floors which was very convenient along with a small kitchen area with a washer and dryer. Overall, despite its shabby appearance it provided me with a decent stay.

title: We were pleased
text: I think it's enough good hotel. Not far from a centre, clean and the price of a room is normal. I would stay there the second time again. My friends would stay there also. Thanks.

title: Awful - avoid this place
text: When we arrived, we were checked into the wrong room - a room without a bathroom, which we had paid extra for. We had to point this out, as they didn't realize this themselves. When we got into our new room (with a bathroom), it was stiflingly hot, as if the heating had been on full for a week, and a very strong, weird unpleasant smell, which didn't disappear in the four days we stayed at the hotel, no matter how much we opened the windows to air out. When we wanted to shower in our en-suite bathroom (which was the same temperature as outdoors - and we were there in January, so it was absolutely freezing), we turned the water temperature all the way up to get the hot water running. Once it became hot (very hot), the temperature would not fall when we tried to turn it down! So we had to use the shared bathroom in the hall, despite paying for a private one. One of the two towels in our room was not clean and smelled like mould/vomit and had to be changed before we could shower. All in all, an awful experience. We were glad to get home after just four days here.

title: Andy cuff
text: Always friendly pub with all sports channels and cheap beer for London! Friendly staff👍always stay here when working in Covent Garden.plenty of places close by for food,Tesco etc plus loads of restaurants a short walk away and they also do hone made pizzas

title: Awful!
text: Awful! We had booked and paid a room by internet and got a confirmation. However, when we arrived we were stuffed into a cab and brought somewere else (an inn further away). The cab driver told us that it happens all the time. The hourglass overbooks its rooms on purpose and you end up staying somewhere else (where there is no tube station around!). Nice doing business with you.

title: Excellent
text: Really gd hospitality superb service clean rooms would recommend anyone to use this hotel for value for money not far from main town easy to find good location will alway use this hotel when working in the area

title: Paul , Sheffield
text: cheaper, friendly clean hotel, staff really helpful, big thanks to Dan for looking after us ! will use again when working in the area.

title: Loved it
text: Outstanding place with brilliant service with a smile and knowledge. Fully equipped kitchen and proper london pub with good atmosphere, cheap beverage , sky sports and tasty pizza does it all. Recommend it big time and I'll be back, promise Seb :).

title: Great place
text: Very local, above a pub (but it closes around 10pm so no noise issue). The staff is great, it is nice (old english style), and clean. Lots of take away options near by. You do have to catch a bus from Elephant and castle but it is only a 10mim ride, and well worth it. Would definitely recommand.

title: overcharge.
text: Well, I am currently on hold while someone finds out for me how the Hour Glass came to charge me for using a room I cancelled a MONTH before the check in date. Thanks a million guys. Cause I really am rich enough to sustain an unexpected 100euro withdrawal from my bank account.

title: Nice place!
text: I stayed for 1 night but the hotel is really nice. My room was big and clean, wi-fi was working fine, tea and coffee available in the room, nice pub downstairs! I enjoyed my staying and Daniela was very attentive,nice hard working girl, who knows how to do her job! Well done guys, i'll be back for sure!

title: More working man's pub.
text: It advertises itself as a pub and B&B but having visited the pub I would say it's not the most plush place to visit and it is in the middle of the Aylesbury Estate but have busses pass regularly which is convenient and the decor is more old school pub than a smart establishment. Seems to attract more the poor man alcoholic than the sociable crowd. If your looking to find friendship with a decent crowd I would say find a different pub.

title: Back again
text: I stayed here about 2months ago and now I booked again the same hotel. The rooms are nice and cleaning is spot on, wi-if is pretty fast, well they keep up with the same standards! But the reason I booked the same hotel is because I felt welcome, and that is Daniella's merit, her smile could make everyone the day,lovely girl she is!

title: Would recommend
text: Before arriving at the hotel she rang to let us know what the checking in time was (brilliant customer service) very easy to find. Very polite staff friendly atmosphere. Room and shower brilliant and clean. Everything is told to you when you arrive. Very helpful if you dont know where you are going will direct you. Beds are very comfortable. Good bar makes you feel very welcome. Would recommend to anyone.

title: Quiet and clean - brilliant shower!
text: Stayed for two nights in a twin room with a friend as we wanted to stay in London to do some sightseeing. The weekend that we stayed all the buses were redirected which meant that we ended up in quite an unnerving area late at night, but on our last day the buses started running properly again and the bus stop (where the bus will take you to Elephant & Castle station) was directly outside the hotel and would have been perfect! Room had a fridge, sink, and kettle. Continental breakfast was brought to the room the night before (which seemed a bit strange) but was actually okay - bread, jam, nutella, butter, cereal, milk, orange juice, crackers, cheese. We were on the second floor so used the shower on the second floor which was a brilliant shower! Kitchen on first floor was clean but no bowls to eat cereal out of so had to use a mug! Can't fault cleanliness and staff were reasonably friendly.

title: Great hotel
text: Very good and helpful staff. Clean rooms. Not far from bus station. Best price-quality ratio in London. Dark drapes in case you want to sleep in the sunny morning. There is a big kitchen with two microwaves, toaster, washing and dryer machines. Also TV, electric kettle and fridge in the room. The window is very big, a long battery under it and additionaly a separate little electric battery.

title: pretty awful
text: I wouldn't go as far as some people in dissing this place. It's a cheap, not-particularly-well-run place in a not-so-nice part of town, but it's not that bad! the people were quite nice and the beer was cold. I won't be back though!

title: A good budget choice
text: It was exactly as described, except for the sheets and linen that was probably not changed after previous guests had left. Staff (Christopher) was extremely helpful and nice. I didn't feel very safe walking around at night, since the hotel is located in Southwark, one of London's' ghettos, but it's quite near to E&C tube stop and a non-stop bus stops right behind the corner. Taking the price into account it's probably one of better choices for non-demanding visitors

title: Budget hotel
text: Not the best of areas and the walk to the tube station is nearer 30 mins. Hotel is clean, has things you need but nothing more. Some parts are a little worn down. Bathroom is shared, and not very spacious. Fine for a few nights on a budget but not for a longer stay!

title: Great!
text: Very nice place to stay for few days in London. Comfortable rooms, kind staff and good price. I recommend Hour Glass Hotel. A bus stop is very close to hotel, so a trip to the center of London takes only 15 minutes. If I go to London next time, I will book room there for sure.

title: A bit out of the way
text: Despite reading the reviews and noting the location and bus stops beforehand, this was a bit too off-centre for the price. I don't mind a walk, but it had been raining persistently and Waterloo Station is about two miles away, so bus and Tube were necessary. What spoilt it for me was the bunk bed and no chair/desk - I was in a single room with shared toilets, and there was no internet connection despite having a wifi connection and trying the code a few times. Good points were the warm welcome and a quiet nights sleep. My room overlooked the outside smoking area so the window was firmly closed, I was given a room fan which was really nice as it provided "fresh air" to help me sleep.

title: Be warned
text: Not a fan of leaving negative reviews, but in this case...I only gave 1 star because you have to mark something. Absolutely everything about this 'hotel' was abhorrent, from the TERRIBLE communication to the place itself. Chosen for its proximity to the O2, was a big mistake. The neighborhood area has armed guards patrolling on foot(first clue) our taxi driver sternly warned us about taking our safely seriously while here. Our room was on the 3rd floor with NO window, just a small opening on the roof. Yes we knew it was budget, but they should say revolting budget. There is a difference between simple, clean and affordable and then the hourglass. We did not unpack, stayed the one night (we paid for 4) and left early the next morning. This 'hotel' (the lobby is actually a filthy bar) was one of the worst places we've ever stayed.

title: Awesome!!
text: I really liked this place. The room was basic but very clean,which was the most important. The Internet connection was pretty strong and free of charge :) The hotel is very close to the centre, there is a 24h bus just outside the hotel,so if you come back late you don't have to worry about the transport! The pub is ok, you can have a decent drink with reasonable price and the people are nice. Staff is attentive,especially Danielle,who gave me good tips and helped me whenever I needed something. In one word, awesome,I really liked!

title: Great hotel for the vallue
text: We experienced a very helpful and friendly staff at the hotel. The hotel doesn't look like much from the outside but the overall experience were very good and cozy. The rooms were clean and nice. The shared bathroom worked very well during our stay, the bathrooms were in good condition. The location were no problem, there is about an hour of walking to Big Ben and London eye, and 15 minuts from Elephant and Chastle, which is the nearest metrostation. This may be a to long distance for some. The area were very quiet and we werent desturbed during the night.

title: Trust me it exists!!! and the workers are VERY NICE
text: For some reason cabbies have NO IDEA where this place is. So be prepared with a full zipcode. Also if you are just arriving, know the bus routes(get off at the Alsace stop) or even better have your Uber app ready to go!!! Apparently London is HUGE on Uber and cabs dont frequent south of the river. Two girls on a budget and we were very thankful for this handy hotel! I felt secure that no one could just walk in. There were a million shared bathrooms. If you dont like one, check out the others! each one is unique and quite a few of them look brand new!! The bed was super comfy! and the drink prices downstairs werent too shabby!! Clean, cheap, shared bathrooms, and a shared kitchen! You get your own mini fridge in the room along with a sink, tv, and folding closet. Dont pay too much mind of people telling you 'about the area', seriously? guess what? you are living where real londoners live! nothing crazy that i could tell from the WEEK i stayed there.

title: Suitable for heavy sleepers..
text: I will write this review with my personal honesty. The staff were great, rooms were okay nothing special but they are cheap rooms, kitchen was nice, bathrooms were okay. HOWEVER: Good luck getting any sleep. It literally sounds like I am sleeping at a construction site. I heard metal being tossed around at 1:30AM into a garage nearby, I had a bunch of loud mouth teenagers next door and can hear everything they do, door slamming, talking the lot. The room above me floor was creeky as sin, every time they stepped on it and walked around (at 3 A.M?) you would hear it, it is not a quiet creek either. It's not the most appealing neighbourhood and the residents have very little respect in terms of noise. It's the kind of neighbourhood where you really would not want to leave your car. That being said to get to the point: If you're using other means of transport to stay here, then it's okay. If you don't mind a bit of noise and are a heavy sleeper then that's okay. The hotel itself is OK to stay in, however the location and other people just let it down. If people had more respect for others then I'd be happy with the stay...

title: Peaceful and serene place
text: Awesome stay there! The staffs are excellent and always with a smiling face! The staffs are very helpful too. The place are clean and there is a bar for the guests to hangout ! Easy accessible to transport like taxi, bus and underground train! What more can I ask for. The hotel rates are reasonable. Was given full used of the kitchen, washing machine, dryer and microwave ! The hotel amnities are there! Have a park and super marks just minutes walk away!

title: Not bad
text: I am slightly bemused by some of the negative reviews here

title: The rooms are not like in those pictures when you book room on their website
text: The condition of cleaning is terrible, dust and mess everywhere on the floor under beds and behind their moving waredrobe. Audibility is too high..you can hear any discution from all sides and floors. That's unaccaptable!! The only thing which saved us is TV volume on max. One big + is their new kitchen..even there are just 4 chairs and one table for eating!! The whole not cheap service is on 1 from 10!! Staff needs to be more professional to offer any of these services to any customer!! If you have option to go somewhere else, so go there!! P.S. on there ground floor is pub, so if you want to mess up your nise clothes into the halfdry beer cirlces and splashes,so come here because reception is right there where people drink beer and too loudy watch the football!! Good luck everyone..but no in this student accomodation!!!

title: Nice staff, great facilities
text: I stayed here with a friend for three nights in August 2015. It was a great experience although my first impression of the area and pub were a bit negative. You get a great value compared to other places in London and it is only 1,5 miles from London Eye. The rooms, shared bathroom and kitchen were very clean. Great for people on a budget!

title: Best place ever stayed in London as a contractor
text: Staff friendly and helpful, room was comfortable clean and modern, welcoming bar, sky sports all you could ask for as a contractor out of town, so impressed would stay with my family for a london weekend away good transport links to Central London, lovely kitchen area to prepare and cook meals and eat with your family

title: Like home!
text: Thank you Kaz and Daniel to do the very welcome to my friends from Italy.. Very confortable, service, amazing! They make us feel like at home. Clean, tidy, warm. Near to everywhere practically, The bus just in front to the hotel, 15 minutes from everywhere.

title: vile.
text: This "hotel" was vile! it had one shared bathroom at the end of the hall, that we had to share with who ever else may have been staying at the time. Rat poison behind the fridge, when we got there we were informed that they under inspection for the rat problem and to try and not ope the window because they climb in. The location of the pub itself was horrific! i didn't feel safe to walk back after dark, the area buildings and people were like something out of kidulthood or harry brown. upon arrival we were asked to sit in the cold while they put sink cleaner down the drains, although we could have sat i the pub below,, i didn't like the look of the people and didn't feel particularly safe. however the people were lovely and sheets were clean, and they were very welcoming and nice.

title: Perfect for City Trips :)
text: We (four girls, 17 years old) have been to London in June 2015 for three nights. Our bedroom for four people was small but clean, really comfy and very practical because we had our own fridge, water boiler and microwave. The bathroom was clean, too, but unfortunately the douche was too small to shower without getting a lot of water in your face... However, there was a big, comfortable bathroom with a shower in a bathtub next to our room (it was a bathroom for the whole floor but it wasn´t taken basically all the time). The hotel kitchen for guests was also very practical (you could cook there and use the oven)

title: Budget hotel don't expect the ritz
text: The landlord was a very nice guy and funny with it.didnt get to chat with the land lady much ,but she was very pleasant when I did. Yes,the surrounding area is a bit daunting,but was very quite,day and night.we walked 3 miles through the middle of it at around 1am back from a gig in Brixton and didn't feel uneasy once. If your looking for a cheap hotel,then don't expect the ritz,it isn't. Bed was very comfortable and clean,great shower,the room was a little small,but it did was fine I'll be staying again next month for my next gig

title: Clean and friendly
text: Yes this is a budget stay hotel and in the middle of a massive council estate BUT the staff and management are very friendly and accommodating, transport links are right on the door step and local amenities easily accessible. We visited the area to enjoy a concert in Brixton which was a 45 minute walk away from the hotel we encountered no problems at all the estate was really quiet no dodgy looking characters or gangs as other people describe and we walked through the estate at 6pm and back again at 11pm ... All in all very quiet location and would definitely stay again ... Thank you for the great hospitality

title: Here's to an amazing experience
text: Absolutely amazing service. Very accommodating, friendly and absolutely a breath of fresh air when it comes to customer service. I would recommend it 100 times over! I was welcomed and I felt comfortable from the moment that I stepped foot in my room and the staff were very attentive at all times in making sure that my stay was enjoyable. Which it absolutely was. I can't sing their tune enough.

title: welcome to the getto
text: run by foreigners an located in the middle of a council estate....was only stopping two nights ended up staying over two weeks....woodnt negotiate on price for alonger stay......'famous last words..lets see what the internet says' charging me full amount every time......some good people in the pub below....dean the taxi driver...sound mate.....oh an be carefull of useing your card there as they want to charge you a pound a time for that privilege too........all in all i wood have rather sleept in a skip

title: Highly recommended
text: Friendly staff. Nice location as it is quite near to the central of London. Bus 343 can bring you to the elephant and castle station where you can go anywhere you want. Besides that, although the room is quite small, it is clean and tidy :)

title: Main manager called Sebastian and his kind attitude are superb! Like home, really)
text: It is warm, clean, really friendly! Not that central, districkt is not that beautifull, but there are a lot of busses to the centre (including Victoria Station) and a straight bus to Elephant and Castle tube station from Gatwick airport. Reasonable price! Thanks a lot, your attention and humor were so needed in these rainy days in London.

title: Nice and tidy
text: I can recommend this hotel! We where met by very polite staff and a friendly atmosphere :) it's a perfect place for one on a budget. The rooms where clean and cosy, the bathroom was small but practical.

title: Super nice place
text: nice place , room was clean and all seem to be perfect , is the place where i will go back for sure next time and i will not regret it ,people there did everything to make me have a pleasant stay . All i can say in few words is that Hour Glass Hotel will be the first on my list when i will be in london next time .

title: Best place ever
text: Very nice and confibul place Nice staff hew can talk and communicate this is the best place that I found in around in London people look at this place you won't regret I really like the staff respect to manager Sebastian, Natalia, Daniel. very good staff. Hour Glass is value for money

title: Back again
text: This place is awesome, I cannot fault this estblishment on nothing. The staff Sebastian, Daniela and Christopher are doing everything to make everyone's stay as pleasable as possible, very attentive, that you can see they know what hospitality job is all about. Tray their pizza, it is lovely.

title: It's NOT an Hotel.
text: My parents stayed in the "hotel" for 4 nights and I regret having booked it for them. The room was clean,but not to be considered as a double,as it was advertised(it only had a double bed,but the space was really limited. The wardrobe was a joke(a foldable one,probably from IKEA), the heating worked only a few hours during the day, thinking that people could get away with the electrical one provided, and I had to lend an extra blanket to my parents because they didn't have one at the reception,which is not even open until 12pm or 1pm. I had to wait five minutes before someone could come to show us around while we were waiting in the middle of the pub sorrounded by drunk customers and gamblers on slot machines.Yeah, ok it's a pub, but being Towels were changed after two days,replaced with brand new ones,still with price tags on(so I assume they haven't been washed before). Location is not even that great. Ok it's zone 1 but the area looks rough and it takes 20 minutes walk to get to the nearest station (or 10 minutes by bus) and then other 15 minutes to get to Oxford Circus, and in the night up to 50 minutes by bus from central.

title: Some problems, but could not be more friendly!
text: I spent just one night at the Hour Glass Hotel, with my fiancée. The staff was very, very sympathetic - but unfortunately I forgot the name of the girl (I am really sorry for this...). Our hostess offered an electrical plug adapter, presented us the whole place - and the breakfast was superb. We did run into some trouble - we had no wifi and our private shower seemed to have no hot water. I tried to use it very early, so there was no one to call about it. But we could use the common shower of the floor - so, it was not a desperate situation. I would go there again!

title: What an awesome experience!
text: This was an amazing experience and if I go back to London, I am staying there. There is a pub below the hotel, which consists of good times and even better people! Thanks for a wonderful time and can't wait to come back.

title: Excellent Friendly and Spotless!!
text: Arrived later on the Sunday for a week at London Tower offices. Reception in adjoining bar (only comment!). Checked in by Daniel (Inter Milan fan) and was extremely friendly. Room was twin bunk room with shared toilets / showers. Room was spotless!! and had everything I needed including fridge. Showers and Toilets were immaculate!!! The shared kitchen is also fantastic and brand-new. It was 30min walking distance to the office - easy-peasy. I will happily stay there again and planning trips over the next few weeks. Also enjoyed a beer with the friendly locals - was John's 80th birthday!

title: Nice hotel but area terrible
text: The hotel itself was nice. The room was comfortable. Had flatscreen TV, DVD player, kettle with tea and coffee, ensuite bathroom etc. If they could pick this hotel up and drop it somewhere else it would be great. The area its in severely lets it down. Its literally in the middle of the slummiest council estate I've ever witnessed. We were out till about 7.30pm and even then we didnt feel safe walking around the streets then. Gangs of hoodies stinking of drugs on every corner and badly lit alleyways with dubious characters standing in them. Definately wouldnt want to stay there alone.

title: Good for the price
text: The staff is very helpful and the rooms are clean. The bathrooms have been recently refurbished and the kitchen is dreamland. Transportation is OK, with a bus line in front that will take you to E&Castle in 10 min. It may be a bit noisy during the day. The area is residential, with a High Street w/ big Tesco on a 10 minute walk. The building's got a pub below, but is not noisy.

title: Fantastic stay
text: It is very difficult to find a budget place with some quality in London. This hotel ticks all the boxes, it is pretty central with easy access to the heart of London. The staff is very helpful, nice, professional and very attentive. The manager - Seb will go an extra mile to provide really good service. Would definitely come back.

title: Excellent
text: Having read some good reviews on the Tripadvisor, I called up late (0030 hrs)to check if the room was available. Lucky me, the staff was very polite and provided me ensuite room with no extra price. Small size room with all the essentials fitted and good value for money. I had a peaceful sleep and felt comfortable and safe during my stay. Highly recommended!!

title: Low budget, good quality accommodation
text: This is budget accommodation which is great value for money for London. The rooms are adequate and the beds were clean and comfortable. The area seems a little daunting at first but is okay, you just need to keep yourself safe like in any major city. My only criticism is the bathrooms could have been kept cleaner and a few bits of maintenance would make a great improvement.

title: Would't stay here again
text: Chose this place for the price but when we got there and got into the pub and the reception, we had to wait for a long time to be helped and once someone came to help she look trough papers for a really long time and went back and forth. When she showed us our room she was kind enough though. As a Swede I am not fond of the thick carpets, but that's the way it is I guess... Few toilets, but it never became a problem. If people were chatting in the corridors we could hear them loud and clear in our room. Free wifi is nice, but I would't say it's fast. Bus to underground right outside, but from the hotel it takes a long time to get into the city center.

title: Not great!
text: Really friendly people and decent shower room but shower was either hot or, hot and wi fi in room didn't work. Room was decent size and relatively clean if you didn't look too closely. Bedding clean but stained as were pillows. It's a cheap place to stay at close to amenities but not a nice area to stay in, noise was no problem though. A definite no for romance! Shared kitchen etc. nice. Wouldn't want to stay again.

title: perfect accommodation and just right on the budget!
text: clean rooms.. friendly and considerate staff.. and although there are no ensuite.. the bathroom and toilet are clean. if you need an immediate accomodation that's near central london.. and you're tight on the budget.. i definitely recommend this hotel.

title: Marvellous!!
text: My partner and I stayed at The Hour Glass last evening and had a wonderful time. Sebastian was very accommodating and took great care of us. The food from the bar was delicious as were the drinks. We sat out on the patio all evening and made friends with the locals who were all lovely people. We look forward to our next stay!

title: great little pub
text: if you go to london and want a cheap clean hotel then visit the hour glass sebastian made our stay great as did staff and a few locals we met my son loved it wish you the sucsess you deserve in future cant wait to come back thanks to you all dave n little connor

title: Don't be put off by location
text: Set on a fairly quiet road in Walworth 1mile from Elephant and castle and on the 343 bus route , this small hotel was excellent value for money but at a price! The rooms were just about big enough for the beds and the bathrooms were just about big enough for the toilet and shower. Clean but slightly dated bedding and new carpets which were too thick for the doors ! Breakfast was available but not offered? We had a triple and a double room the double ex In the triple was only accessible from one side ? Rooms were on ground floor so outside drinkers would be heard as it's a locals pub but not overly busy. It's on the edge of a couple of housing estates with graffiti covering the garages close by. You can park on street for free after 6 and weekends which was a bonus!

title: Sweet Jesus- what a mare
text: Located in a scene from crimewatch, Bedlam would have been preferable. Words cannot express the Dickensian squalor and' penny a pint gin'-orientated grimness that haunts this place. To get there you have to run the gauntlet of some of the deprived areas the UK has. Communal loos and bathroom add nothing to the charm. On the plus side, the beer is cheap and the broadband fast. If that's what floats your boat, go for it.

title: Fantastic Location & Value for a 'Low Budget 1 star Hotel'
text: I stayed here for one night with my mum as a 'cheap' option for visiting Chelsea Flower Show and seeing Mama Mia. After reading some of the reviews giving this place a very poor rating I was nervous - but we only needed a good bedroom for 1 night (£56 on Booking.com). I upgraded our room to an ensuite for only £10 well worth doing (as I'm pregnant and my mum is getting on a little saved us a walk along a corridor in the middle of the night). We were given a downstairs family room with a double and single and it was absolutely perfect. The shower and toilet room were very nice, clean and everything you need. Tea/Coffee making facilities and a little fridge of our own. plus TV (although maybe the batteries in the remote needing changing). Beds were comfy and although close to a main road the noise wasn't bad especially much later (no noise - and this is London!) there was absolutely no noise at all from the Hotel bar. We travelled on the tube to the Elephant and Castle then 343 bus (from Platform R outside the station - every 6 mins) which takes no more than 5 mins drops you directly outside (opposite side of the road) to the Hotel. It was super easy! Yes the surrounding area looks a 'little bit shabby' but if you want a hotel in a lovely smart area pay £100 +++. It is a busy tube and bus route so there are lots of people around which is nice - You are in the centre of London and paying very little to rest your head for the night and wash and shower in good facilities - I have stayed in 2 star hotels which haven't been as nice or accommodating. We ate in a fantastic little Brasserie (4/5 mins walk in between Kennington/Elephant and Castle Tube station called Brasserie Toulouse Latrec which was a great, ambient little French Restaurant (with Live music and a very affordable menu) before getting our bus again from outside the Elephant and Castle back to the Hotel around 10.30pm without any issue or problem. Please don't be put off by the unkind reviews, this is a Budget, 1 star Hotel and that is reflected in what you are paying. The location and links into the city are fantastic for a days site seeing. The hotel staff are very friendly and accommodating - lots of info and leaflets and maps given.

title: Way better than expected!
text: We booked our stay at the Hour Glass Hotel because they had the best prices by far! We came expecting to have to have a shred bathroom but when we arrived Daniella gave us a free upgrade to a private room with our own bathroom. The bathroom was great - travertine floors and travertine shower! The room was clean and totally adequate for our needs. The hotel is pretty close to downtown and easy to get to. the price was great. Would definitely stay here again! William from Camas

title: Bargain accomodation in London
text: I recently stayed here on a two night trip to London. The hotel is located south of Elephant and Castle and so is quite a walk from the Thames and other attractions north of the Thames such as convent garden etc. we were here primarily on a budget work trip for a conference which was fairly nearby. While we agree that the area is a bit earthy, it is perfectly safe to walk about during the day, care must be talking if a lone female traveller out at night. The room we booked was ensuite, clean and comfortable. There was a tv and fridge and there are communal cooking facilities. All in all for £66 for a double room in London it was a good buy. Not luxury accomodation, but safe, clean and the staff were friendly. We would stay here again.

title: cheap and very cheerful
text: My wife, mother and I stayed here in May 2014 when my wofe and I were in London on business. The rate is very competative considering its location. The rooms were clean, slightly small and of a good standard. There is a pub on the bottom floor which is also cheap and serves decent drinks. The distinguishing feature of this hotel, however, is the positive experience with the owners. They were super friendly and very helpful arranging taxis for my mother, who is not particularly accustomed to london. They went over and above the call of duty for her and we were grateful. I would recommend for a budget stay nearish to central london.

title: Wicked hotel love it
text: Where to begin Place is awsome very reasonably priced for the quality of rooms they offer free fast wi fi Fully equipped kitchen Outstanding showers Free toiletries Always helpfull staff with their leader manager seb Would come back and recommend to everyone

title: Holiday
text: Peaceful place and like it because it is near my friend house. The hotel is clean and quiet and the management staffs are very helpful. Is about 10 minutes walk to the bus stop and to a bus ride to elephant castle about 5 minute to the tube

title: Clean, Tidy, Lovely staff
text: Me and my friend stayed for two nights the weekend just gone. The Receptionist Lady was brilliant! Her name was Daniella and made us feel so comfortable as it was our first experience in London! We were upgraded to a Double and Single room with our own bathroom and it was lovely. Definaitly booking again for the end of June!!!!

title: Its like being in a 3rd world country.
text: 15 people on 1 floor sharing 1 bathroom. U do the math! It's horrendous. I wouldn't recommend this to the council, who search for places for the homeless. Plus the area surrounding the pub is like the Bronx in the 80's. I expect my vehicle to be tagged, but even this area is too rough for banksy!

title: Budget Hotel
text: Like everyone says, it's a budget hotel so don't expect too much and you won't be disappointed. We actually like the Elephant and Castle neighbourhood, it wasn't very touristy and obviously you've got a lot of cheap eats nearby. It was a bit further of a walk from the tube than we thought originally, probably closer to 20 minutes than the 10 we read about on bookit.com (where we booked the room). The immediate neighbourhood of the Hour Glass is pretty seedy, but the rooms were clean enough, the bathroom probably could have used a good scrubbing, but considering the cost of most hotels in London I don't think you can complain too hard considering the cost.

title: Dirty, falling apart, terrible area, awful staff, i could go on
text: i booked this place through booking.com and was horrified when i got to this establishment. it is totally advertised wrong and i cancelled my reservation and was charged the full amount. Everyone stay well clear of this place. we got a lovely place called stanley house on the belgrave road and had a lovely view of the london eye from our room.

title: Cheap and well connected
text: I found this hotel to be quiet, clean, and very well situated for access to Borough, London Bridge and Brixton - for the price. For the price I paid, sharing a bathroom is hardly an imposition, and I found the premises to be very clean given how many people were using them. Many reviewers have also taken issue with the location of the hotel. My feeling on this is simple: if you want the London of the movies, stay in Notting Hill and be prepared to pay for it. There is a bus stop right opposite the hotel with a night bus service, and therefore no reason to walk around late at night if this bothers you. I saw no evidence of "feral gangs" or any need to jump straight in a taxi. You are far more likely to be pickpocketed on Oxford Street than attacked on a hundred metres of busy, well-lit street in a multicultural part of Southwark.

title: thanks
text: Thank you so much to Sabestian and Daniela... We had a fabulous time in your lovely city, If it wasn't for you both we would be lost in such a big city.. Your kindness and excellent hospitality will never be forgotten and we will recommend your loveky hotel to everyone we know.

title: Coolio
text: To be honest you do not many plases like that anymore, the atmosfere and approach from the staff, i have to admit they are very attentive, always happy to help giving you the best advice aver to get to the places, especially SEB :)

title: Unexpensive place to rest during trip in London
text: If you want an unexpensive place to rest during the visit to London, this is the perfect place. Located near the Elephant & Castle Underground, the best way to get to the hotel is to catch the 343 bus and you'll be in front of the Hour Glass. The service is excelent, very pleasant and (Sebastien has) always ready to help. Don't expect any big luxury but after running the city you need a place to rest and this was perfect due to location and cost. Sergio

title: How many glasses are there in an hour?
text: We enjoyed pretty much everything during our stay at this hotel. Everything was excellent, starting from the ultra-comfortable bed and ending on the flat-screen TV that hang on the wall of our room. This is indeed quite an interesting place to be, especially when you've got a beautiful old-style English pub just downstairs. Plus wonderful service, good standard for a cheap price, and location makes it a marvellous place to stay.

title: Super!
text: Very nice rooms! The cool atmosphere and the tasty chow. I recommend Hour Glass Hotel very much. We could calmly rest after a heavy working day. Additionally, the nice service, the clean bathroom and comfortable beds.

title: Great place to stay excellent staff friendly atmosphere
text: I have stayed at the hour glass while working in London and I have to say that it's like a home from home the staff are always friendly and helpful nothing is ever too much trouble , thanks Sebastian and company. The rooms themselves are clean and well furnished if you don't want to eat out you can get food in the bar or you have the use of the hotel kitchen. To conclude I highly recommend this hotel and I am fairly sure you will be hard pushed to find somewhere to stay that is as much value for money as the Hour Glass!!!

title: excellent one:-)
text: Thank u for all, best staff...very attentive..I will come back here in second holiday promise, to be honest the price its ok, not very far from the centre and its so good..unexpectable..sebastian and mariana thanks a lot for all

title: So kind
text: The "Hour Glass" is a great place to stay. The people who work there are so kind and actually they welcame us at 7 o'clock in the morning. I stayed only one day but it was enought time to get personal opinion. You know, London is a big city and you can easily get lost but they helped us how to get to the airport. The room we stayed was clean and big enought. We have own bathroom. There is a TV in the room and a comfortable bed. Also you have an internet connection in the room, which was very important for me because in that way I was cheking the some very imporant things. The hotel is so quiet and nice, they have a little bar restaurant where you can go for dinner or just to have a drink. Also the hotel has a good location. In my personal opinion it is a great place for couples. It is not expensive. Actually. you pay less and get more.There are so many buses which you can get and just go when ever you want. Thank you so much for making this day so good and for helping. You are so kind people that I If I visit again London I will stay there, for sure.

title: Great hotel with superb service
text: A wonderful hotel. Beautifully clean. Excellent check in. Lovely room - we asked to move because it had been a smoking room previously. This was dealt with with politeness, courtesy and genuinely brilliant customer service. We were moved to another super room. Buffet breakfast was excellent. Staff were friendly. Location excellent etc. I genuinely can't think of a negative to say hence the 5 rating

title: Great place
text: I booked this for myself and my 8year old daughter after attending a concert at the O2, the taxi ride was quick, the check in was quick and efficient, we had been upgraded to a executive room, the room was lovely, bed was big, plenty of pillows and really comfortable, the bathroom was lovely and it was all clean. We had breakfast in the executive lounge with great views of the city, the choice was great, cooked food, lovely breads, fruit, choice of juice or other soft drinks, cereals and pastries, yogurt, binoculars to see the view, check out was easy, and tube was 2mins walk, would definitely return, great service and comfort.

title: AGAIN AND AGAIN
text: I was over in London for a weekend and decided to stay in this hotel as a result of a previous experience. Firstly hats off to the staff. As a H Gold member i was up graded to an executive room with access to the lounge. I see now why the bar closes at 21.00 it is a very different type of customer as the girls in the lounge had to put with dogs abuse on two of the nights that I was there. For some of the staff English was their 2nd language yet they must have known that they were been slagged off. yet they were very professional. I can't recommend this hotel strongly enough, very close to city airport yet only 25 mins to westminter station

title: Good Hotel - convenient. Friendly staff
text: The hotel is very close to Canary Wharf business district. The rooms are spacious and modern. The bar and restaurant are very good and friendly. The hotel even offer a running club leaving the hotel at 6:45 weekdays mornings. There is both a bar menu for bar snacks and a full restaurant menu.

title: Such a convenient location
text: Our first time at this hotel, but I hope not the last. Larger than average bedroom - loved the complimentary chocolates and mineral water - that was beautifully quiet, great bathroom that actually had a bath rather than just a shower

title: Great customer service - All expectations exceeded.
text: I booked this hotel for my one year anniversary and the experience exceeded all of my expectations. I would like to personally thank the Guest Relations Manager - Isfarhan Camball (Izzy) who made our day so special and run like clockwork. I had a number of very specific requirements and these were followed to perfection by Izzy. He was very helpful and welcoming and is truly an asset to the Hilton Group. Our room was modern , clean and had a great view. Thank you for the experience we will definitely book again.

title: Perfect Hotel
text: My second stay in 3 months. Great hotel located less than 5 minutes from the Jubilee Tube station and some good restaurants. Hotel is very clean and the rooms are spacious. Both the Executive Lounge and the Fitness center are two of the best I've been to at any Hilton property. The staff is awesome and will promptly take care of any issue you may encounter (Thanks Alessia!!). The breakfast buffet is very filling and has a good selection of hot & cold items. Can't wait to return.

title: A Mixed Bag
text: I stayed 2 nights in January. My first impressions on the first day were of a hotel that overall had very high standards. The staff were very friendly, helpful and the hotel was extremely clean. The ambient temperature in every location was perfect, whether it be in the room, corridor, foyer or breakfast dining. The hotel room was very quiet the first night, the bed was a amazing, very comfortable. However, the second nights stay was spoiled by people in the room next to me. I was out in London all day from 11am to 10pm visiting galleries and museums and when I got back I just wanted to go to bed and sleep. Next door it sounded like they were having a bit of a party and enjoying themselves much at the expense of other hotel guests. They were going in and out of the room at what seemed like every 10 -15 minutes and letting the door slam shut, laughing loudly and playing music. I did give them the benefit of the doubt, thinking the noise would stop and they would go to bed. This did not happen and went on until I phoned the front desk at 2am and was told the hotel would speak to them. Thinking the noise would now end, I tried to get some sleep. Sadly, the noise continued and I phoned the desk again at 3.30am and was once again told they would check it out. The noise continued until I gave up and phoned the desk again at 4.10am and asked for a room change. I was then moved to an alternative room at 4.30am and eventually got to sleep around 5am. This was obviously not a very nice experience and it was compounded by the night desk manager's over sight at not dealing with the problem in the first instance when first reported at 2am. Needless to say, i was shattered afterwards for a good few days. In the morning when checking out I complained about what had happened to the Front of House Manager who was very apologetic. The outcome of this spoiled nights stay, is that I received a complimentary nights stay to be arranged when suitable to use in the future. This was the correct action and the only action by the Hotel and in fairness to the Hotel, they did show consummate professionalism when dealing with the incident the morning after. It is obviously with regret, that it was not dealt with properly the night before. So my stay was a mixed bag, the first day and night was amazing and I was highly impressed by this Hilton, but sadly it was spoiled by the extremely rude, selfish and ignorant behavior of the people in the room next door. I will be returning to stay at the Canary Wharf Hilton in April, as I do believe this was a one off incident and the Hotel have re-compensated me for the inconvenience caused. p.s. if you are staying at the Hotel I would recommend a visit to the London Docklands Museum in Canary Wharf. It took me a full 3 hours to look around it and the entrance is free.

title: Theatre trip
text: We always stay at a Hilton Hotel, whether we're going on holiday or like this stay, a trip to the west end....As always everything at the Hilton at Canary Wharf was just so... from the minute you arrive, till the moment you depart...perfection....the location was perfect..the staff at the hotel most helpful and friendly...wonderful breakfast...super clean rooms..what more could you ask for...

title: Stay at Canary Wharf
text: Nice stay here. Get a room on other side from dlr for a very quiet stay. Convenient location to get into central london as South Quay dlr is directly next to it and Canary Wharf tube station is 3 minutes by foot.

title: Another very pleasant stay
text: We stayed in room 1317 -a huge executive room on the 13th floor with good views of the area. Check in was very efficient and all the information required was provided courteously. We really enjoyed the breakfast and found all the items tasted fresh and at the right temperature. Hanimcan served us with plenty of hot coffee and was an absolute joy. We really can't fault this hotel for the location and service it provides.

title: Hilton Canary Wharf stay
text: We stayed at the Hilton Canary Wharf for 2 nights as we were attending a concert at the O2 arena. We were very happy with the hotel, great location, very clean and excellent, friendly staff. I'll definitely stay here again

title: Amazing customer service from guest relations team
text: My experience at the Hilton hotel in Canary Wharf was amazing. Firstly I would like to thank the guest relations manager Aaron for making our stay enjoyabl and unforgettable. It was my partners birthday and Aaron and his team made it super special for him. The room was located on their top floor with a beautiful view. The hotel arranged balloons, cake and a lovely bottle of bubbly on our arrival. I am extremely impressed with the level of customer service I was provided from the beginning to end of our stay. I would definitely stay again!! This is definitely one of the best hotels in Canary Wharf! The service was excellent! I can’t fault anything!

title: Four point five points
text: This is our favourite hotel in London due to the simple fact - the rooms are big, well sound-proofed, the beds are comfortable and the peaceful sleep is guaranteed. We`ve stayed here before and we`ll stay here in the future, however we do notice changes that appear through years. First disappointment was breakfast - no more smoked salmon available and the fruit selection was scarce (what happened to pineapple or oranges?). They weren`t serving freshly squeezed orange juice anymore. Cutting budget and hoping guests would not notice? Secondly, they appear to offer free Wi-Fi now to HH members, but this still has room for improvement. I could use mine after I brought my laptop to the reception, but my wife has just given up on connecting. Staff at the reception was really very helpful (e.g. I could not use the printer in the business centre, so one suggested to e-mail the document to his address and he printed it at the reception). Very good hotel, but could do even better.

title: Lovely modern Hilton Hotel
text: We stayed in this hotel for one night only on a special deal that included dinner, bed and breakfast. I must say that at weekends this is excellent value for money. The rooms was very spacious 21 square metres, nice, clean, modern, discreetly luxurious, it had a safe, Internet access, climate control, ironing board and iron, bath robes, Crabtree Evelyn Toiltetries, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, body lotion, soap. If one needed anything extra all it took was a simple phone call to housekeeping. There is a well equip fitness centre on side. The dinner menu was really nice and of very high quality, customer service very friendly. Breakfast was of high quality, they serve one orange juice, and tea/coffee (any type one requires, decaf expresso, regular expreso, regular coffee, a selection of speciality teas, the rest is self service, on the extras side they have kippers, haddock and poached eggs. A fantastic fresh fruit selection including passion fruit, kiwi, pineapple,mango among others. A delicious bread selection there were several types of speciality breads. Cold meats, smoked trout, smoked salmon and smoked mackerel, olives. Anything one could possibly want. The executive lounge looked very nice, it is on the 14th floor with nice views of Canary Wharf and the docks. The only minor problem was lukewarm water in the shower.

title: Fantastic staff and stay
text: I booked this hotel as I was taking my husband into London for his 50th birthday weekend. I had mentioned this on the booking and the manager (Izzy) arranged balloons, champagne and cake at no extra cost. All staff were very friendly and wished my husband happy birthday whenever they saw us. They also allowed us to check in at 12.15pm instead of 3pm and the room spotless and ready.

title: Four days, close to CW, pleasant stay
text: Stayed for 4 nights. The hotel is clean and up to date. The A/C works well to the US standard. Housekeeping was prompt and thorough. Exec lounge was nice, but the offerings were not the greatest. Overall, good though. Was a quick walk around the side of the hotel, over a footbridge to Canary Wharf. Only 10 minutes all the way to the opposite end of for me.

title: Untrained front desk staff
text: We arrived and was given the wrong rooms.We had booked 2 rooms , junior suite and normal double room so that we could have adjoining rooms.The allocates rooms was normal executive rooms and one had a very strong smell of cigarettes.After we complained , we were given a room in a different floor , was told hotel is almost full.One if the sinks was blocked but was fixed after they were informed.The second issue is to do with delivery .We had been expecting a parcel and were informed the front desk to expect it .The concierge was NOT informed of this and went on to reject the parcel!! Overall , Hilton canary wharf did not meet expectations.I felt they did not communicate with each other.I don’t think I have stayed in a similar rated hotel where so many things has gone wrong.The reception and concierge were friendly enough , but I think they have not been trained adequately

title: Birthday celebration
text: My girlfriend invited me and all my girls, including my mom, for an extended weekend in London to celebrate my 50'th birthday. We had a suite and a separate room and all was excellent. Hand crafted cake, champagne and balloons welcomed us on arrival. The staff where all very kind and made our trip perfect - so a big thank you to all of them. Highly recommended.

title: Good value in London
text: We chose this hotel because they had a very good weekend package and because we had never stayed in Canary Wharf. The first room we got was on a smoking floor and though it was a non smoking room you could still smell tobacco. When asked the reception if we could change they immediately gave us a new room on another floor. The room was very spacious by London standards, quiet and clean. The breakfast was also very good.

title: Afternoon Tea
text: We booked a Wowcher for afternoon tea and could not wish for a better experience. the view was amazing, food was delicious and service was top quality. thank you so much for making our day so special. it's the best afternoon tea I have ever had.

title: Excellent for a long weekend break
text: With one of us having used this hotel for business previously we decided to use it again for a long weekend (Saturday to Monday) and as a base for shopping in central London and to see the American Football game at Twickenham. We did have a slight doubt that we were away from the centre of London but with excellent transport available by way of the DLR and/or Tube we found we were only a 20 minute train ride from Bond Street/Green Park. All in all the hotel was great - large room even though it was a standard double and very quiet despite being on the second floor and close to the street. Very clean and comfortable and the staff were great too. We had been allocated an adjoining room which we don't like and didn't need. This was rectified immediately at reception. The concierge was also very helpful looking after our luggage as we arrived early and left late. Value for money was good and one is close to shops and restaurants within Canary Wharf. We will visit again as a base for London shopping/sightseeing etc.

title: Lovely hotel-DO NOT DRIVE THERE
text: This hotel is lovely, it’s in a great location 5 minutes away from Canary Wharf station. The rooms are clean and quite large in comparison to other standard rooms and the concierge is very helpful. Breakfast options are varied and very tasty and the staff are quite friendly. The only issue with this hotel is the amount of parking, so there’s 24 spaces for 282 rooms! On the website it just says ‘limited’ so you have no way of knowing how many there are before you arrive. We drove about an hour and a half to get there just to be told all the spaces were full and to park in several other car parks nearby(these are around 10-15minute walks away) it was pouring with rain and if you don’t know the area well the 15minute walk turns into half an hour because footpaths are closed etc. When are eventually arrived at the hotel the staff seemed unsympathetic and just said “That’s the problem when you have such a lot of rooms an not enough spaces for everyone”- thank you for pointing out the obvious. I feel that it would be better if when you booked the room you could prebook parking and then if there were no spaces available you would be able to see and then decide whether to travel by alternative means or not. Basically in a nut shell it’s a lovely hotel but do not drive there!

title: Breakfast is Super!
text: It was a great breakfast in this hotel. There are many meals and my favorite one is homemade muffin. It's so delicious!. Also, room is cleaned and modern atmosphere. Location is 5 min walk from Canary Wharf St. It is convenient for going Central London.

title: Consistently great
text: Professional check -in. Very efficient and polite staff. Had stayed here alone on a business trip a few months previously, so this time brought my spouse for a combination business and leisure trip, and I had built his hopes up in a big way about the breakfast. We were not disappointed- first class selection, quality and freshness along with a pot of fresh coffee replaced every time you need it. Rooms- great. A/C great. Am planning a return again soon. Canary wharf is a great base for sight-seeing in London. Only cons- gym small.
