title: Great business hotel
text: Very good location, close to DLR and other tubes to centre of London. Friendly staff, modern and clean rooms which are bigger compared to other hotels I have stayed in London. Light is a bit pure in the bathroom and what I do not really like are the carpets in the rooms. Breakfast was good - although it took a long time to get a simple omelette cooked. Early check-in and free wi-fi was also a plus. Unfortunately I have heard the DLR noise which kept me awoke for a while.

title: Weekend stay
text: This hotel which is just a couple of minutes walk from the tube station and a five minute walk to the Thames having easy access to the Thames Clippers service it is located in the centre of Canary Wraft and is a great location with shopping mall within a couple of minutes walk and central London is only 20/30 minutes on the underground . We stayed in an executive room which gave us access to the lounge and free wifi,the staff in the lounge were very friendly the breakfast was a little basic but enough to start the day,the afternoon tea was very good. Our room was ok nothing fancy,very small bathroom only issue was arriving back late afternoon and our room had not been cleaned and we were planning on showering and heading back out to Covent gardens for a show.We spoke to reception and they sent housekeeping up we had tea and coffee in the lounge and when we went back in an hour it was all done however I would of expected the room to have been serviced by 4 o clock. Overall this is a lovely hotel all the members of staff we came into contact with where friendly and helpful and we will certainly stay here again on our next visit to London.

title: Great Night at the Hilton!
text: We stayed here on a friday night, we had concert tickets for the o2 and the previous reviews showed that this hotel is a great choice as its only 1 tube stop away. We got our room for a great price of £66, prior to our arrival as I had booked through a 3rd party company I emailed the hotel to confirm the booking as this was also for our 5th anniversary. We arrived earlier than check in times and the hotel did a pre check in for us, offered to ring us when our room was ready and took our bags so we wouldnt have to carry them around with us. When we arrived back at the hotel later that afternoon we discovered that we had been upgraded to the executive floors and had full access to the executive lounge, which includes breakfast, afternoon tea and light evening buffet!! Considering we had paid for a double room only this was fantastic news! The executive lounge was fab and had all you could want and more! The rooms on the executive floors are large and ours had some good views across the city, floors 12 -14 are purely executive floors so there arent many rooms on each floor and I don't recall hearing people coming and going so the walls are obviously well sound proofed! Great rooms, large, with large bathrooms including a bath and shower cubicle with complimentary toiletries of a good quality. We had rose petals left on our bed which was a nice touch and around 5'o'clock a staff member arrived with a plate of cake/fruit with compliments of the chef and a card from the manager welcoming us and congratulating us on our anniversary! We went to the concert arrived back at the hotel around midnight, on returning to our room the bed had been turned down and chocolates left! This hotel had thought of everything and for the bargain price we paid we were delighted! We would recommend this hotel and would definately return.

title: Great Stay
text: Just back from a 4 day break in London. This hotel is excellent from check in right through to check out. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Breakfast was super great selection and good range of healthy options. Special thanks to Hanimacan who served us each morning very pleasant young lady and very attentive. Hotel well located to all forms of transport. Would definitely recommend Hilton

title: Does not live up the Hilton name
text: Were to begin, my wife and I arrived for a weekend that was a mix of business and pleasure. We where surprised to find a double bed in our rooms as other Hiltons we have stayed in all had king beds. Then the phone reception was sporadic and non existent at times and I missed several business calls, I don't know if it is this hotel or the area but for a business district area, it is certainly not at all sufficient. My wife went to turn on the lights and that tripped the electricity supply off for 15 minutes, when it went back on there was two lights still off and this was not rectified during our stay. The hotel staff were mediocre and did not know where certain restaurants where located in the area. After putting a drinks bill On the room on the second night there was a whole drama and two calls regarding this as the front of house staff member had said that they did not need to swipe my card (which I thought was very bizarre at the time). I had to go down and sort this out and this was very frustrating. I asked for Manager on two occasions but was told he was otherwise engaged. Bottom line, I wish we stayed in a different hotel as there is much nicer hotels in the area. Also this stay has made me want to avoid recommending to colleagues and staying in Hiltons in the future.

title: Wedding Package
text: Booked the Wedding package for pre-honeymoon stay. Very nice modern hotel with a fantastic restaurant and really great views of the modernity of Canary Wharf.... If you like that sort of thing. Lovely staff, great service and close to all the amenities of Canary Wharf... Shopping Centre, City Airport

title: Lovely hotel and great location
text: A really lovely, clean, friendly and welcoming hotel. Excellent location for getting into London with restaurants and amenities near by. Goor value for money and efficient service from staff. Would stay here again and highly recommend it.

title: Great stay, great support during our event.
text: Spent a week during our event and couldn’t be more pleased with the staff and accommodations. Quick room service and well-appointed executive lounge. Looking forward to returning next year. Thank you!

title: Lovely staff and a lovely hotel
text: Myself and my boyfriend stayed here for one night to celebrate our two year anniversary and the staff made our stay so special. We were surprised by a complimentary bottle of champagne and two slices of chocolate cake, along with rose petals and balloons on our bed. The room was so lovely and modern and the bed was very very comfortable. The next morning we had ordered room service breakfast to be delivered at 9am and it was so delicious. I cannot thank Izzy enough for making it a weekend to remember and for doing all these special things for us

title: Excellent Stay in Canary Wharf
text: The Hilton in Canary Wharf is an excellent hotel for business travelers working in the Canary Wharf area. It is clean, convenient and a good value. The hotel has an restaurant, although I did not utilize it during this stay. I recommend the Hilton and will be back in one week.

title: 3 nights stay 👍🏼
text: Stayed at the Hilton for 3 nights Friday to Monday great location as was going to the o2 arena for 3 nights, helpful friendly staff good room always nice and clean every day good selection for breakfast every morning , will definitely say hear again and would not hesitate to recommend this hotel to friends .

title: Outstanding service and facilities at Hilton Canary a Wharf Hotel
text: Gorgeous room and terrific service. Friendly and professional. Food in restaurant was excellent. Checking and out smooth and efficient. Easy to get to, a lot easier than I expected, as it is near Tube stop on Jubilee line. Nice views from higher floors.

title: Comfortable beds, comfortable rooms, but go outside for network
text: We booked this hotel as we were visiting the O2 and it is one hop along the jubilee line from it. We made the mistake of taking the DLR from canary warf to south quay, but it is just as fast to walk across the bridge. The shopping mall across the bridge has everything, although easy to get lost as it is a bit soulless! The hotel is modern and clean, check-in was fast and the room was large and comfortable with a good aircon / heating and a very comfortable bed, which is something we haven't had often in London. Room sound insulation is great, in the corridor the next room were very loud but couldn't hear them in the room, and you didn't hear the DLR which goes past the hotel. Breakfast was also of a good standard. Food in the hotel is very expensive, as were the costa (in name, not in taste) drinks in the evening, best to go to the little mall round the corner if you want something to eat. The only criticism I could make was that you don't get wifi in the room, you have to pay extra for that or be in their frequent travelers club. This seems a bit of a throwback to when this was normal a decade ago, but we haven't stayed in a hotel without free wifi since the mid 2000s, even the hotels that cost a fraction of this, and although the area has very good 4G, the insulation seems to prevent that coming into the room. Seems a shame where no other expense appears has been spared to cheap out on such that I would consider normal in a hotel, and mar the whole experience. Hopefully at some point they will correct this, but for now, if having internet access is something you need, be prepared to budget more than your room cost for this. However, outside has good network, the shopping mall next to it has free wifi as do all the cafes (even macdonalds has free wifi, I just looked!).

title: Top Canary
text: After a disaster occurred to my other arranged plans Hilton Canary Wharf came to my rescue in IMPECCABLE STYLE. The Empathy to my situation, and to the fact I had 2 children to accommodate as well seemed not to shake their professionalism as I turned up Very Late, In A London Downpour on a Friday Night. Fed, Watered and Relaxed all thanks to AMAZING STAFF. HILTON CW YOU SAVED MY WEEKEND.!!

title: Valentine's Weekend 2015
text: My boyfriend surprised me with a lovely weekend stay at Hilton - Canary Wharf and I have to say it was amazing! We have stayed at the Hilton Hotel in Dartford before, which was great but the service at the Canary Wharf branch was 100%. Firstly, I believe he was given a free upgrade to an executive room as he was a member of a Hilton gym. With this we were given a great room on the top floor and access to the executive lounge. Cannot fault the room at all! Exactly what you would expect from Hilton hotels, clean, fresh and very practical. We visited the executive lounge on Valentine's day and the service we received was excellent! Luckily, it was not too busy in the lounge so we easily found a comfy table to sit at and have our complimentary afternoon tea. We were then approached by a member of staff who offered us a free raffle ticket, obviously we accepted and won a free bottle of wine and 2 DVDs. It are these little touches that make hotel stays memorable!! Another added factor was that as we placed a "do not disturb" sign on our door we were given a call at around 2pm and asked what time we wanted our room cleaned! They offered to come anytime up till 9pm!! Usually when we miss the room service times at other hotels we have to ask the reception for fresh towels and are not offered any cleaning after 2pm. All of the staff were very nice and friendly, greeted us every time we returned into the hotel and the staff in the executive lounge were professional and very approachable. The only criticism I would have was in terms of parking, we circled around the hotel area a number of times trying to find the parking facilities as they we not easy to locate. However, a quick phone call to the reception and they directed us. I believe there are very limited number of spaces available. Luckily we arrived just in time to grab the last one - I wouldn't know what we would have done if we didn't get the last space so make sure you plan for this. (I do understand the hotel is based in Central London so parking is already a bit of an issue) Overall... Great stay with Hilton once again! Would love to come back and stay again!! (The ice machines on every floor is a great touch)

title: Marathon weekend stay
text: We booked the Hilton at Canary Wharf due to its location for the London Marathon and as a bi-point to celebrate a birthday. We were not disappointed in any way. From the moment we checked in we were met with pleasantries and a professional service. Our rooms were split between delux and executives, both were to an excellent standard with remarkable views over the wharf. With the executive rooms you get lounge access, throughout the day you can have peace and quite as well as be served with sumptuous cakes, canopies and a tipple to wash it away. If you are in a delux room you can pay an extra £30 per head to enter the lounge, used well it would be value for money. Upon arrival to the lounge I mentioned it was my fathers 70th and could they do anything for me, they upgraded his access for free to celebrate the event. Extremely generous of them. Later that evening my father rang me to tell me that they had decorated his room, gave him a bottle of prosecco and made him a cake.The following morning they also made another cake and the restaurant staff sang happy birthday! To summarise a super hotel, modern, very well kept, great location and to top it off a very human and compassionate service on an extremely busy weekend. We will definitely be returning for the service alone. A credit to the Hilton Brand, with applause to the staff and the general managers ,particularly Isfarham Camball. Great stuff.

title: Excellent Customer Care Well Appointed Room
text: Had an excellent stay at the Hilton Canary Wharf. A very smooth check in, great customer care and attention. It was a Sunday and i needed to grab an email and even though i wasn't an executive customer they let me use a computer for 5 mins in the executive lounge. Nice room, well appointed, good selection of extras from bathroom extras to mineral water etc. Nice views overlooking canary wharf. Great breakfast, fantastic selection - pretty much everything you could think of to eat for breakfast was there.

title: Absolutely fantastic!
text: We recently stayed in Hilton Canary Wharf for an extended birthday weekend. What a great surprise it was to find out on the check in that they not only noticed my note about this special occasion but as well upgraded us to executive level with all the amenities included. Canary Wharf Hilton is a modern business hotel located just in the middle of the business district only 5 mins walk from metro,DLR stop,shops and bars. We stayed in an executive room on the top 13th floor. The room was spacious with contemporary decor and great views. The bed was spacious and mazing to sleep on and the bathroom was just stunning with both bath tub and shower and the highest standard sanitary. Entire room was spotlessly clean, included all necessary mods and cons and even complimentary bottles of water. We enjoyed as well the services of the executive lounge with it's complimentary drinks and snacks, internet facilities, ambient atmosphere and stunning views on the river Thames and London city. What is absolutely necessary to mention is the level and quality of the service we received from entire staff of the hotel. Started at the check-in, continued on breakfast (which is great buffet style with huge choice)with restaurant staff, concierge ..basically whoever we came in contact with was extremely helpful, professional, knowledgeable and polite. Some extraordinary service we received from Pei Ling at the executive lounge desk who wasn't only welcoming and provided answer on each of our question but as well promptly helped us with our duplicate reservation issue. Summa summarum Hilton Canary Wharf Hotel was so far the best hotel we stayed in with ultimately most professional service of the highest quality. I just hope they will keep their standard and would be delighted to return again and recommend it to everybody.

title: Fantastic !
text: This review title may be brief but that one word describes our stay perfectly and there is no point saying more when one word will do ! The company my husband worked for at the time were celebrating 40 years in business and by way of a celebration they decided to take all staff and their partners to London for a weekend. They employed many staff so one hotel couldn't accommodate all so they were split across a few hotels. We were lucky enough to stay at the Hilton Canary Wharf. We made our own way to the hotel rather than using the coach put on by the company and upon arriving at the hotel the realisation of how big this was to organise became very apparent. There were people everywhere both seated and standing awaiting their allocation of room for the weekend ahead. We were told that our rooms could be checked into at 3 pm onwards and that is why we were all there. We were being picked up at 5:30 pm for the evenings activities namely a gala dinner at the O2. This was a massive task for the hotel getting all the rooms cleaned and ready for all of us. However, by 4:30 pm my husband and I were still waiting and so were a few other guests. Naturally we were unhappy and we were getting anxious about having time to change from our casual attire into our evening wear! The hotel worked very hard to get rooms sorted providing us with complimentary drinks by way of an apology. Thankfully we were in our rooms before 5:00 pm and had enough time for a quick, although not ideal, change of clothing and freshen up. The room was lovely clean and fresh with a great view of Canary Wharf. Breakfast was great with plenty of choice of both hot and cold food. A mixture of table service and as much as you can eat buffet. The hotel is very close to a DLR station only about a 5 minute walk away, so access to the city centre and surrounding tourist spots within London is very easy. There is a small selection of shops and bars nearby should you wish to have a drink away from the hotel. Amazing stay and service delivered by the hotel despite the numbers they were dealing with. Very impressed and we are looking to return to this hotel for this reason very soon.

title: Excellent hotel
text: We booked this hotel as we were going to a concert at the O2, it is conveniently located for both Canary Wharf Underground station and South Quay DLR. The staff were attentive and efficient, they really couldn't do enough for us. We were upgraded from the double room we had booked to a Junior Suite at no extra cost, which was a nice surprise on arrival. The room itself was spotless, very well set up, the bathroom was lovely, and the bed extremely comfortable. I especially liked the little extra touches, when we returned from the concert, our bed had been turned down and slippers laid out for us. Our rate included breakfast, which was also excellent. Plenty of choice, and very good quality. A highly recommended hotel, we will be returning if we need to stay in London again.

title: Excellent the second time around
text: I spent a weekend here with my dad in a twin executive room, and again was very impressed with the overall experience. The room was large and well appointed, and had a great view up the Thames towards the city

title: Birthday Trip to London
text: Just arrived back from a one night stay in London for my boyfriend's 26th birthday. I had included the fact that the stay was for a special occasion in my booking but was overwhelmed with the kind gestures we discovered upon arrival. The staff were so friendly and upon entering the room saw that they had decorated the room with birthday balloons as well as there being chocolate cake, champagne and a birthday card. The room itself was perfectly clean and had a lovely view from the window over Canary Wharf. Our stay couldn't have been any better and we will definitely be back when we visit London again!

title: Value for money hotel in great location
text: Slighlty out of town but a clean and comfortable hotel within easy reach of London attractions. Hotel is accessable by a small ferry boat from the hotels quay Ferry connects to CANARY Wharf so easy access by Jublie line into central london Hotel rooms are clean and stocked with Tea coffe and biscuits. Hotel is clean and staff welcolming , and provided ferry timetables and tickets on request Nice hotel for a London city break

title: Night manager poor service
text: Firstly the hotel itself is lovely, the room we had was the executive room on the twelve floor, everything you need in this room. Beds really comfortable, had a lovely nights sleep once I got the room!! Barman friendly and helpful. Breakfast the following morning help yourself buffet was really nice. Now for the downfall of this hotel was the night manger on duty, we went to check in around midnight I handed the booking form in and explained the names were changed and that I had rang the hotel to confirm the name change, then he went to say he needed the card it was booked with, I explained that I hadn't got that card as I am not that person and had paid the people for the room, then to be told that there was no record of the name change and I would not be able to have that pre-booked room. Even though the room was all paid for and we would be able to stay there but not in that room, we would have to pay for another room. He said the only way I could have that room was for the lady to ring up and confirm that she had sold the room to me, I couldn't get through to the lady. I offered to show him all the messages on my phone with the conversation between us, he wasn't interested in looking and carried on repeating the hotel policy with pre-booked rooms. I then said do you think they are going to turn up and he said yes maybe. At this point I had to walk away and get some fresh air. We decided we had to bite the bullet and pay for another room. I got my husband to sort it out. Then the night manger said as I was saying I will charge your card and refund the other peoples card and will charge you the same rate and then you will be able to get the money back. Now if this was said in the beginning there would of been no problem as we would of seen that they need our credit card details incase any damage etc. However he acted as it was all about the names. So we checked in and paid on card, checked into the room and turned the tv on and it said welcome to the other lady's name? Check out next day. The receptionist who served us was about to go over all the same thing as previous night and then went on to tell us that the other lady would not be refunded and about the policy again until another receptionist stepped in and said she had been refunded who did actually know what she was talking about. but when looked at the invoice it was for over 50% more!! ( Also would like to add all paperwork that we had afterwards was STILL in other ladys name) . The receptionist then went to get the morning manager, who was brilliant, shame we didn't get him in the first place. Sorted everything out, which I am grateful to him for. It seems that the staff have lack of communication with each other, which leads to the downfall of the hotel.

title: perfect stay and service
text: this hotel deserves all its stars. the room and the bathroom, the hotel atmosphere itself, the service and the breakfast, everything was perfect for me. DLR station is 5 min away. some smaller store (tesco, prest, subway) also next to DLR station. hotel is providing a small gym. the executive lounge is very we equiped. was great to stay with you

title: Nice enough hotel
text: This is a nice enough hotel although nothing special. Our room was clean and spacious but I was a little let down by the bed which, although reasonably comfortable, seemed too small for the room and lacked any sort of decoration in that it had no throws of pillows etc. The bathroom was clean, modern and adequate for our purposes. This hotel certainly offers good value for money but I think it's back to the Marriot for us on our next visit to Canary Wharf.

title: Excellent rooms and food
text: Highly recommended. The best breakfast by far compared to other European cities. The chef will prepare eggs in front of you in the manner you desire. Wide choice of English and continental food. Large rooms, tea and kettle of course, ice machine in the corridor. Staff is not English, but you'll have no problem understanding them. Tube is nearby. It took us about 25 minutes to reach the city centre.

title: Hilton Canary Wharf Excellent Value,
text: The Hotel was easy to find and the amenities were excellent, the junior suite was very spacious and clean with a great view over the city. Some might find it a little far out of the city but with the DLR and Jubilee line so close access to the city is very easy, I have no problems in recommending this hotel.

title: Could this replace our usual London hotel option?!
text: When we need to stay overnight in the big smoke, we usually stay at the Hilton Bankside for it’s location, parking and all round service that we always receive when we stay This is the first time we stayed at the Canary Wharf Hilton (it’s not a part of London we typically pass by) and it was for an event near the O2 Yes, it takes longer to get to (it’s on the other side of the city for a start) and yes the surrounding area is akin to a ghost town on weekends But..... It’s a great hotel Staff are friendly and helpful - from front desk through to housekeeping The pre-visit email is a nice touch and the Guest Relations team were superb The room has all that you need The digital key, via the App, is a nice touch The parking is great and reasonable in price The proximity to the DLR station makes getting around straight forward Breakfast choice was more than I expected Executive Lounge is clearly popular....and for a great reason Only thing missing was a pool Would we stay again? Most definitely

title: Fantastic Executive Lounge but some areas need sorting
text: I stayed here for 3 nights one weekend in early December. I chose digital check in and chose my room on the 14th floor, I made sure to change the credit card in the system since the first had expired. I arrived at the hotel to see that they could not deliver the digital key since I needed to stop by reception. I joined the queue and 20 minutes later got to the front to be told that they could not send the key since they needed a credit card. I presented the one that I had made sure was in the system. Totally un- necessary and a total waste of time. They obviously don’t know how to use the digital key technology here since the key never did arrive, on a previous stay it never arrived either. The room was fabulous and large and I immediately hung the card outside the door asking for no cleaning in return for 1000 Honors points. More about this later. The Exec Lounge was superb and the food offering is fantastic. The Saturday evening was completely spoiled by two families who brought their children who were running around and not keeping them under control. The staff just let it happen whilst the parents ignored the children and got drunk on the free alcohol. I would have expected them to have at least been told to control their children or more ideally asked to leave!! Sunday evening was much more pleasant since no screaming children. The staff were excellent on the Sunday. The final issue occurred when after checking out I never received the 1000 points for no room cleaning and to date I’m still waiting. Mind you this seems to be an issue across all the Hilton properties who have lovely cards saying points will be awarded on check out and then never arrive. Very annoying, frustrating and all a total lie!

title: Great experience
text: Excellent staff and accommodation. Good transport links to all parts of London. Nice calm and relaxed atmosphere and the staff make you feel at home. Overall a wonderful experience and certainly one of the better hotels we have stayed in.

title: Will stay here again
text: We booked a family room, it was very spacious and came with a king size double and two singles for the children which made a pleasant change from the usual double for the kids. Very clean throughout and well stocked on towels and toiletries. The breakfast was really good, lots of choice including healthy options. Staff were very friendly and attentive. We would definitely stay here again.

title: Superb!
text: We booked three rooms at this facility during our stay in London and were really happy with the overall service, rooms, and the cleanliness of the rooms. The breakfast and the access to the executive lounge was the icing on the cake!

title: Absolutely brilliant
text: This was our third stay here and it retains its extremely high standards. We had an Executive room, allowing us access to the Executive Lounge, which is excellent. Perfect service every time and highly recommended. My only adverse comment would be the £20 car park charge. However,all cars are securely parked underground, with gate access controlled by the front desk staff.

title: Nice room
text: The executive rooms are nice and spacious with access to the lounge. Breakfast is good and plenty of choice. The hotel is well located near bars and restaurants and a tube station. If you are at the O2 this is a good place to stay. The only down side is the parking as it's very limited and I had to find alternative parking.

title: Customer Service is second to none
text: I had a fabulous room but was under the executive lounge and all i could hear was footsteps so the next day I asked to be moved and i was. The staff really go out of their way to help your stay be an enjoyable and stress free. I would stay here over and over without hesitation!

title: Good quality hotel with excellent, friendly staff
text: We stayed here for just a couple of nights because we were attending a concert at the O2 Arena. The hotel itself has everything you would expect from a good quality Hilton - clean and extensive public areas, a decent executive lounge and good quality bedrooms and bathrooms. However, what made our stay really enjoyable was the friendliness and efficiency of the staff that we dealt with

title: Relaxing place
text: We stayed at the Hilton on an organised trip it was such a lovely place the area was so calm and I felt really safe there , the tube and river taxi were so easy to get to and get into London ,there was an under ground shopping centre which was beautifully set up with Christmas decorations . The hotel was the best we have ever stayed in ,The manager Isfahan Camball met us at the door and was so approachable and because it was our 25th wedding anniversary he had a bottle of wine and strawberries sent to our room .The staff were amazing at there jobs nothing was too much trouble, polite and nice people . I will return to the Hilton again as I loved the whole experience .

title: Highly Recommended hotel for the O2
text: The reviews for this hotel are all correct in their rating, my wife stayed in a another Hilton the week before which was a 5 star in central London and was pleasantly surprised that this hotel was so good. Easy transport links to central London and the O2, which is why we chose this hotel, close to shops and restaurants in Canary Wharf you can't go wrong booking this hotel. Only negative thing was the breakfast buffet style, the bacon is ROCK HARD, but as so much is being cooked there's no choice really, and the rolling toasting machine I had to double pass my bread through it to get it to go brown, it felt like Russian roulette would brown or would it burst in to flames on the second pass. The room we had was a large but the bathroom was small which is how they made the room so big, nice and quiet and clean, you couldn't hear the DLR outside which made our night's sleep after our day at the O2 very nice to end on.

title: Weekend in london
text: Very friendly Staff, even the cleaners. Breakfast was awesome. A great selection to choose from. Only a few minutes walk from the tube station, which is then only 10 mins tube journey to waterloo station (near london eye) . Just wish they had air con in the rooms.

title: Ideal location - Brilliant staff
text: Stayed at the Hilton Canary Wharf on a weekend break and was very impressed. Great hotel, ideally located for both DLR and Jubilee line. Our room was modern and clean . Breakfast was lovely with plenty of choice and ample staff on duty to cater for guests on a busy Sunday. All staff that we came into contact with were very helpful and courteous. Will definitley return for another stay.

title: Very modern and comfortable
text: I stayed on a weekend, so it was very quiet. Very pleasant and efficient check in. Room size is a bit larger than some UK Hiltons. The exec lounge was very nice. Wide variety of snacks, typical wine, beer, and a few liquors. I would definitely stay again, and take in more of the neighborhood sites.

title: Business traveler
text: Location- The hotel is strategically located in the center of the Canary Wharf business district, this makes it very convenient to both the business offices and hosting after hours events. Room / Accommodations- What you you expect from a Hilton. The rooms are clean, nicely appointed and large, free WiFi and a nice work area. It’s important to call out they are equipped with both USB and a US power outlet. The bathrooms are clean, well appointed and nothing remarkable notable. The room was equipped with an iron and hairdryer, no coffee machine or mini bar (which is a positive for me) Staff- the staff is outstanding and attentive almost to a fault! I definitely didn’t mind the extra attention. Restaurant/bar- Daily breakfast included was a great option. The staff extremely attentive and the food outstanding for a breakfast buffet. The bar was quiet most nights, a nice place to grab a final drink of the night and have conversations with co-workers. Overall a great option for a business stay. The hotel was higher priced but similarly priced to other top quality hotels in the area.

title: Overall is good
text: Overall is good despite of the fact that there were some minor cleanising problem with the bath tub. I ended up did not use the bath tub other than standing in it to shower. Nevertheless, nice room and friendly staffs. Breakfast was average, typical english breakfast. Would recommend to stay!!

title: Gets Better and Better
text: I preface this review by stating I am a regular visitor to this Hotel and over the years have found it gets better and better as my wife and I use it as our base when visiting London. Our most recent visit was to celebrate our Wedding Anniversary and being aware of this the Hotel Management ensured our stay was memorable. Special thanks must go to Andre Gameiro, the new Executive Lounge Manager who had made plans before our arrival. My wife and I were touched by the welcome surprise in our room and we felt really valued customers of the Hotel. All the staff are friendly and welcoming, particularly the Concierge team and those in the Executive Lounge. Although the Hotel is always busy at weekends, the staff always keep their composure, just as you would expect for such a good hotel. A welcome addition to the Executive Lounge is some cool background music. It remains our favoured Hilton Hotel in London - quite apart for the recognition they give to regular guests - the accessibility of the nearby Jubilee Line on the London Underground makes getting to either Central London or the Stratford shopping Centre very easy at the weekend. We look forward to continuing to visit this Hotel

title: Great London Hotel - perfect for the 02
text: Loved this hotel, great room, best breakfast ever, super easy to get to (2 mins walk from South Quay DLR station) and v.easy to get to the 02 (5 mins walk to Canary Wharf tube, 1 stop on jubilee line). Staff were also fab - especially Izzy.

title: Good Hotel
text: Hi, We stayed on a fantastic half price rate of £60 including breakfast for a Friday night - we were also able to secure the same room rate for the Saturday night. Our first room was on the 14th floor (top floor of the hotel) which is also the executive floor (my husband is a gold card holder) and we were pleasantly surprised to be 'upgraded' given the half price room rate we paid. If you are coming on the DLR the best stop to get off at is South Quay you can see the hotel from the station although Canary Wharf station is literally a 5 minute walk from the hotel. Our room was very clean and modern with a great view however once tucked up in bed we soon heard the sound of the DLR trains which do run frequently! I hate to think of the noise on the lower floors we asked the next morning if we could move rooms which was done without fuss and the second room was much quieter. As a tip I would recommend asking for a 'odd' numbered room which faced away from the DLR station (our first room was 1414). All the staff were very pleasant and helpful and the executive lounge offered a good selection of snacks and drinks. Breakfast was good with a huge selection and once again very attentive waiting staff. We would return in a flash (especially with the half price room rates!) and would not hestiate to recommend this hotel to our friends and family.

title: Great location
text: I stayed here for one night for work. The lobby and bar are welcoming and the rooms are a really good size. I can't comment on what breakfast was like as I left before I had it. The rooms had lovely bathrooms, plenty of wardrobe space and a complimentary safe. Hairdryer was of a good standard. The room was huge but the bed was a standard queen which looked really small in a large room, but that's just me being picky! Really comfy chair in the room for chilling out and a good size desk for anyone that was away on business. The bed was really comfy and I had an amazing nights sleep. Although the hotel is huge, you couldn't hear anyone from any other rooms or the hallway so once you were in the room it was really peaceful. If you want to use the car park there, there are only about 25 spaces so get there early. I parked at about 8am and it was empty but at 3pm when I went back to the car park it was completely full. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others.

title: Convenient location for O2
text: Friendly,helpful staff. Comfortable rooms and good facilities. Food and beverages are expensive and reasonable food can be had just round the corner. As a Hilton Honours member I am still not convinced you get the best deal on price. Good location for the O2.

title: And again...... Amazing service at an amazing hotel
text: I tend to visit London between 1 - 3 times a year and I always get drawn to this hotel (no matter what the price) due to not only the amazing location and room but the service is just amazing. From staff on the reception to house keeping. Both Guest Service Managers, Niraad and Tomasz were great and made our celebration even special. The location of the hotel is great with great views and only 3-4mins walk to Canary Wharf tube station. Will definitely be booking this hotel again for my next London trip.

title: Excellent Hilton
text: Awesome service, great location, family friendly. Employees expedited all our requests and were very friendly. Location has easy access to transportation of every kind whether it's Uber, Taxi, railway. etc. Will definitely stay here again on our next trip to London.

title: Exceptional hospitality
text: We stayed at this hotel for my partner Tom's birthday and I can honestly say that the service we received was outstanding. Izzy went out of his way to make our stay excellent. Our room was upgraded when we arrived and the luxurious birthday treat put in our room was a lovely touch. If you're after excellent customer service at a high quality hotel then we would wholeheartedly recommend this one. Thanks to Izzy and the team we certainly felt that this was our best hotel experience in London. We'll be returning very soon!

title: Comfortable, but nothing special
text: We stayed for almost a week in this hotel & there's not much to complain about, but nothing much to talk about either. In order to be absolutely fair i'll just list out the pros & cons: Positives: - Great location if you want to be near Canary Wharf, just a short walk cross the Thames will get you there - hotel is run efficiently & the rooms are clean & practical - Beds are comfortable & bathrooms are adequately equipped - they have a good parking space if you are doing a self drive Cons - There is minimal human interaction, in the week that we were there I barely saw any staff (might be good for business travellers), however, having stayed in similar (or better) class hotel in Canary Wharf itself, I have seen how an efficiently run hotel can also be extremely warm & friendly without being intrusive! This hotel is positively cold & i am not talking about the heating! - not very child friendly (this could be corporate policy as they primarily cater to business clients), but I felt that my little one was totally ignored here. Even simple request for a cup of milk in the morning was treated with a lot of confusion we didnt try the restaurant as there are some great options nearby in Jubilee place. So if you are going there on business & will be using the hotel only for a good nights rest - then by all means stay here! but if you expect a little bit more from a 5 star, there are better options in Canary Wharf

title: Not very attractive from outside, but.......
text: ...once inside everything is as it should be. Reception staff were unusually friendly (isn't it sad that I should find that unusual - surely that is their whole raison d'être?). Public areas are very modern, smart and clean. Rooms are standard, but ok. Location is good, with the businesses, bars, restaurants and shops of Canary Wharf just a few minutes away via a footbridge over a waterway.

title: Our Trip to London
text: We stayed at this hotel last year and found it excellent, and when this visit was organised we were happy to hear that we were going back to The Hilton at Canary Wharf and once again we were not disappointed with our stay. The room was ready for us although we arrived early and we found it spotlessly clean and tidy and very spacious and this time to my delight we had a bath which was ,having walked miles around London a nice treat. The location of the Hotel is ideal with the tube station just over the bridge and a straight run through to the city centre. Once again I would recommend this hotel and hope to go back next year.

title: Outstanding Customer Service with a Personal Touch
text: Q: Me - "Would you like to go to London for your Birthday?" A: Wayne - "Only if we can stay at the Hilton Canary Wharf!!" The only place we will stay in London! Why? 1. The personal service is exceptional and so very rare for a busy, city hotel that's part of a multinational chain. 2. The breakfast is wonderful: a major factor drawing us back again and again!! There's loads of choice, it's fresh, clean, constantly topped up, great quality food served by attentive, charming staff. 3. Outstanding and exceptional customer service. The staff genuinely care about you and your stay and are very engaging. 4. No matter which type of room you book, from Standard to an Exec Suite (we've had them all!), you receive the same treatment from staff and superb customer service. We know through experience that this does not happen at other 4 and 5 star London hotels! 5. The Executive Lounge is wonderful and has a great view over London. Lots of menus / choice / specials and the food variety and quality has really improved, even since our last stay over Xmas last year. 6. On other trips to this hotel we have eaten dinner in the restaurant and we highly recommend the food - environment, ambience, service, food are all perfect. The Pick Chardonnay is wonderful too! We want to thank the staff for looking after us this weekend, for making us so welcome and really making our stay brilliant! Our 'Super Star Staff' are: Alessia, Mr Kostas, Ravi, Matthew, Raphael, Chat, Issy and the breakfast / restaurant staff.

title: Beware the DLR!
text: I booked the Hilton as part of a birthday weekend seeing The Eagles at the O2. They were brilliant! The hotel is very convenient for the O2 being one stop on the DLR from South Quay to Canary Wharf, then one stop on the Jubilee line to North Greenwich. We upgraded to a Junior Suite with Executive Lounge check in and access. Check in was fine even though is only one chair at the check in. At weekends it is mostly couples so who gets the seat? The junior suite was on the 12th floor with far reaching views to the south. The best views are from the other wing to the west and you can see the Eye and most of central London. The west wing is also away from the DLR tracks and so will be much less noisy. Even though we were on the 12th floor we could hear the sound of the trains every 3 or 4 minutes - virtually right through the night! We had afternoon tea in the lounge but because we had to leave the hotel at 6 pm we could not take advantage of the open bar and hot snacks. A real waste of money. Suggest they open this at 5 pm to give weekend guests the chance of a pre show drink and snack. Breakfast in the lounge was good. Plenty of choice and nice and quiet. We would stay here again if visiting the O2 but it is hopeless for central London.

title: A night with the girls
text: We stayed for one night only but it was amazing I will definitely come back. There were 6 of us I booked two rooms at team member rate and did not expect a suite so that was a plus it was big and enough space. The bathroom was amazing I couldn't decide whether to use the shower or bath and yet again so spacious and extremely clean. Breakfast was really good, variety of food, very tasty and good service from the host. Last but not least the check in was my favourite part very fast outstanding customer service from Stephanie and another (which I didn't get his name) overall it was amazing and nice touch felt special.

title: Great location to visit the O2 for a gig!
text: Fed up with arduous journeys back to Berkshire everytime we see a gig at the O2, I decided to stay over somewhere convenient after seeing Snow Patrol last weekend. This hotel is perfect for that. One stop only on the Jubilee line. Canary Wharf tube station is only 3-4 minutes walk. we drove there and used the hotels secure underground carpark, very convenient. The hotel struck me as unlike many city centre hotels. It is large and uncramped. It never seemed too busy and there were always plenty of attentive and polite staff on hand to help straightaway. The room was a very generous size especially for city centre and very well equiped. Steer clear of the mini bar though the prices are extortionate! The food at breakfast is buffet style and all tastes well catered for. I have no idea why I haven't thought to do this before. We had a fantastic time both at the O2 and the hotel with no travelling stress. I bet we were back in the hotel bar after the gig while some were still queuing to exit the O2! Will definitely do this again and this Hilton hotel is a real gem in the docklands. Brilliant!

title: Massively convenient
text: Picked the Hilton at Canary Wharf for a weekend in London. I am so glad we did as the Hotel room was all that one would expect from the Hilton. The full English breakfast was a great way to start the day and all the staff we met were very helpful. The location and accessibility to the Jubilee line was fantastic. It made getting into the city and back in the evening an absolute breeze. Would stay there again.

title: My New Fave London Haunt!
text: All I can say is WOW! I have had the pleasure of staying in a selection of 4 and 5 star hotels in London over the past year and the Hilton Canary Wharf is by far my favourite. I booked a Junior Suite via the hotel website and I must say the room was amazing. It is huge with the most comfortable bed I have slept in for ages. I sampled room service twice. Once in the evening and also breakfast. Both were very tasty, well presented and very quick to arrive. My only minor quibble was that the water in the shower and bath ( they are seperate btw) did not get as warm as I would like. I did leave feedback to this affect on checkout and I got a nice phone call from the manager on my return to speak to me about it. Finally the location is fab. Right beside South Quays DLR stop and 5 mins walk from Canary Wharf tube stop. Fab place

title: Highly recommend this hotel!!
text: Although we didn't spend much time here as it was just an overnight stay to celebrate our friends 50th, the welcoming reception we had was amazing. We were delighted with our room. In the morning for breakfast, every member of staff couldn't do enough for us, very attentive. On checkout, once again really pleasant staff. Good location. Would highly recommend this hotel

title: usual high standard
text: Lovely Hotel right beside the Docklands Light Railway station , South Quay.Very handy for travel via subway and DLR. A few shops near by , but this is mainly the business side of town. Hotel was what you would expect from Hilton-Warm welcome,clean,comfortable room.Mega breakfast as always,which sets you up for the day.

title: Cocktails and sharing platter
text: Myself and my wife visited on a weekday afternoon using a Groupon voucher. Cocktails were lovely and the sharing platter was one of the best I've ever had. Staff were friendly and helpful, only drawback is there's no view from the bar.

title: Excellent stay
text: A fantastic hotel near to canary wharf underground and DLR. Less than 30 mins into central london. Great staff, and fab breakfasts for all the family. Quiet comfy rooms. Good restaurants in mall nearby. Thank you for a first class trip.

title: Great hotel – wonderful location!
text: We stayed here in April over Easter and had a fabulous time. The hotel is a little tricky to find whenever you come out of Canary Wharf tube station, but once located very peaceful and quiet. We had the opportunity to upgrade to the club lounge for £20 extra a night, which we availed off. It was great value, offering breakfast and afternoon tea - there were also beer and wine available in the lounge in the evening. The hotel room was compact, but nicely decorated so it didn’t feel cramped. The bathroom was very spacious, including a large walk in shower and outsized bath/tub. Overall the hotel was very clean, all staff members encountered were very polite and courteous. I definitely recommend this hotel – 5 stars! We got an excellent deal on this hotel, £70 a night for two – I recommend keeping an eye on the Hilton website as they do offer generous discounts on this location.

title: Good and Bad
text: Overall the stay was brilliant, however the service of certain members of staff was outrageous and very rude. Especially the morning breakfast staff, taking us to our table did not offer us any hot beverages on the first day but on the second day did, this is inconsistent service. Also, we were not greeted with a warm welcome which wasn't the best for being the first thing in the morning. Also, the room service was not efficient, I tried ringing all lines for some extra toiletries and a new hair dryer (that just suddenly stopped working after 20 seconds of blowdrying) and no lines were picking up. Once someone did pick up they were extremely rude and I asked them for little favours but seemed like I needed a leg and an arm from them which I did not very appreciate 1 hour into staying at the hotel. Very warm welcome when I checked in and felt like I was valued as a guest and waitress/waiter service was very good with polite manners. However sometimes clearing my plate wasn't as quick as I hoped for but I understood that breakfast catering can be quite hectic. Efficient housekeeping as our room was cleaned after our breakfast which was quite thoughtful. Thank you for your hosting and will most likely stay at Hilton again.

title: Excellent
text: Superb rooms very clean, the speaker I'm the bathroom was a nice addition. Staff were very helpful and polite, would definitely recommend staying here. Breakfast was fantastic with lots of variety, above and beyond what your expect from a hotel breakfast.

title: Fabulous hotel but poor service
text: The room was wonderful and spacious but I would expect so as I paid a lot of money for our stay. What let it down was the service at the bar, we waited for 35 minutes for 2 Irish coffees!!, and to top it off its cost £21, overpriced and cold coffee is not a pleasant combination. For the rest of the weekend we went out for our coffees.

title: Very good stay in Hilton Canary Wharf
text: We spent a very confortable stay in Hilton Canary Wharf in October 2014 and strongly recommend this Hotel. The location is ideal for business visit to the main financial place in London, and Jubilee tube station is 2 min walk from the hotel which allows quick journey to London city and touristic places.

title: A good business hotel but not for vacations
text: Stayed out here for a change. Its a very business oriented hotel which you would expect being in the middle of the financial district on the Isle of Dogs. The rooms therefor are your typical business hotel rooms - plain and simple. However, some great shopping near by in the mall and some good restaurants and bars near by. Als I would not that its a 10 minute walk to the TUBE station but from there only 10 minutes to Westminster so not as far out the way as some might think

title: Excellent stay
text: Lovely hotel, very convenient and helpful staff. Canary wharf is an excellent place to stay in london. Lovely surroundings, business friendly environment and plenty of good eating out places. Overall my stay was very relaxing and comfortable.

title: The best
text: The hotel is located near Canary Wharf business center, so it's a wonderful place to stay if you go to the business trip. It takes about 5-10 minutes to walk to the shopping center and restaraunts. The restaraunt located at the ground floor is excellent. Breakfasts are manifold and tasty. The best about this hotel is staff. Staff is not only friendly but really helpful. They can assist you in organizing your evening knowing everything about nearby bars, pubs and restaraunts. Pity that a hotel rooms have no wi-fi, but wi-fi can be acessed at the lobby. Everything else about rooms is ok - rooms are clean and nice. Of course this hotel might not be the best option if you come as a tourist but it fits perfectly if you come for a business.

title: Great again
text: Stayed here for the third time to celebrate my wife's birthday. We had a one night package which included dinner. We were upgraded to an executive room which was a very nice gesture (although the receptionist did not point out that we could not use the executive lounge which was slightly embarrassing when we did try an do so and were told that we couldn't because the hotel had upgraded us foc). Another nice gesture was two slices of birthday cake delivered to the room - very thoughtful. Dinner was good although there was some confusion as to what we were entitled to under our package which took some time to sort out before we could order. Love the breakfast - such a huge choice. Staff are friendly and helpful. This Hilton represents by far the best value for money in London as it is usually considerably cheaper than all the others. We love the area and transport links to central London are excellent. Will come a fourth time.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Stayed for one night as visiting a friend in London. Called in advance and they explained about the parking at the hotel. First come first serve basis and charged at £20 per 24hours. Check in was swift and easy, Isabel was very pleasant. The room was larger than I was anticipating and comfortable for 2 people. The bathroom was well appointed with a shower and bath. Like the feature of having the TV sound being played in the bathroom. Only used the bar for a drink in the evening and Aaron was pleasant and efficient. Was expecting an element of noise with it being in London and located next to the DLR line but there was nothing. Location for restaurants and bars is excellent and the various transportation available - London City Airport is only 20 minutes away. All in all a lovely stay and have been specifically requested to book this one again. Thank you.

title: Excellent Value
text: Fabulous small hotel. Rooms aren't huge but that wasn't expected in an older building like this. Shower pressure is amazing and so is the service. Mike at the front desk is the best and Jan puts forth an amazing Continental breakfast each day. I can't say enough about how much I like this place. Parking is limited, so plan accordingly. But don't miss this place. Very reasonably priced and very much a more homey and intimate experience than a large hotel. I stayed 2 days but would have loved to stay longer. A+

title: NICE CLEAN HOTEL
text: nice quaint hotel. Very friendly staff. Room was kept clean and the bathroom was very clean. Got a room facing the back, it is pleasantly quiet. A few underground stations close to the hotel make it a very accessible. i would definitely stay here again.

title: Birthday weekend
text: A massive thanks to Michael and his team for making our stay at the hotel, a very pleasant one. The room was lovely. Clean, Warm and tidy. Modern. Light and airy! a 2 minute walk from North Ealing underground station. The Breakfast was lovely. Hot, freshly cooked and plentiful. Michael took the time to make us feel very welcome and his team couldn't do enough to make us feel special. I recommend this hotel very highly. It has a Japanese restaurant inside as well with a pretty good menu. Averagely priced. I can only hope that Michael and his team are there when we visit again hopefully very soon. Go try it out. It's worth it! You get out what you put in! 5*! Thank you Michael

title: Boutique Gem!
text: We stayed here for location to a dinner dance we were attending a mile away, so I can't comment on the distance/time into central London, but We were very happy with our stay. Modern boutique decoration, Crabtree and Evelyn toiletries, complimentary drinks in room, Krupps pod style coffee machine. The room is 'compact', if you want something 'spacey' maybe not for you, but didn't bother us at all. I chose a garden room as I knew it was on a busy road and we were on the second floor. Alex on reception couldn't have been more helpful or polite. I would definately choose to stay here if I was in the area, could see the tube station from our window. Great quality and value, comparing it to other choices in the area.

title: Overnight stay
text: Last minute booking, what drew me towards this place was the free parking - disappointed that it only fitted 6 cars that were crammed in. Took me an hour to find a parking space on the street then I worried about my car security. The hotel itself is spotless, the rooms large and modern. No creamer for the coffee so I had a black one and hit Mcdonalds for breakfast. The Japanese Resturant is excellent, a little pricey but the food was top nosh,, first time having sushi as a full meal and I can honestly say I was blown away. For the cost if the room £100+ I would have expected breakfast to be included, the receptionist seemed proud to tell me there was free tap water - cheers for that :-) I was assured that it was a quiet room, apart from the constant traffic noise which could be heard all night then guests checking out from 6am onwards it would have been. Still I suppose if I'd have been staying there for two nights I would have slept better out of sheer exhaustion. All in all a lovely hotel would highly recommend but next time I will make sure that.... A) there's creamer available before I strip naked. B) I find a parking space well in advance. C) Bring ear plugs Brilliant facilities by the way, shower , bed, fresh and clean ... Super job and congrats. I will stay again but perhaps when there is a better deal on - ever considered NHS discount ?

title: Loved the apartment in the back
text: I stayed there with my son in the apartment in the back of the main hotel. It was perfect for us and very nice especially the garden view. Close to North Ealing metro station and there are shops not too far away. The best part was when we were leaving I asked if I could use the computer to look up train tickets. They said yes and then a man in the bar started helping me with tips for traveling around Europe and even got on his own laptop to look up fares for trains and hotels at the same time I was looking n their computer. He turned out later to be the hotel's owner! He was super nice! He gave us some good advice that a local would know and even said that if I ran into trouble to call the hotel. Not only was the room great, but they could not have been nicer! I will go back !

title: Family overnight stay
text: An excellent hotel and good location for our visit to Ealing Cricket Club, where my daughter was holding her 40th birthday party. Our room was rather ‘compact’ but was well appointed. My daughter and her husband had a much bigger room that even accommodated two baby travel cots! The continental breakfast was extremely good and my husband was sufficiently impressed, that he didn’t need his usual ‘must have’ of the optional cooked breakfast. The staff were friendly and very helpful. Will definitely return if we need to stay in the area.

title: Minimalist but great quality
text: We are a young couple and stayed for two nights for a concert. The desk staff were very helpful and courteous, telling us the best places in London for the things we wanted. A little disorganised, they hadn't noted down the amended length of stay that I rang up about and also hadn't noticed our mini-bar purchases! This was quickly and politely rectified. The room we stayed in was small as other reviewers have noted, yet the decor was new and the bedding clean and comfortable. There's a nespresso machine with free refills and a spotless bathroom. Some beautiful butterfly art completed the room and in all it felt very cosy and romantic. Breakfast was similarly minimalist with a small selection of pastries, cereals and toast and jam. Yet again here everything was high quality, the bread was soft and fresh and the pastries nicer than any other hotel we've stayed in. Would highly recommend for a great value stay.

title: Smoky hotel is not designed for comfort
text: I have to stay that I am very disappointed with the hotel, I expected so much from the reviews and it just did not deliver. When we checked in we were placed in room 3, which was tiny, stank of smoke, had the light fitting with live wires hanging off from the ceiling and 3 lights were out. The room had no natural daylight and overlooked a wall. When i informed reception the receptionist proceeded to try and fix it by placing his hand inside with the live wires. Eventually he gave up and moved us to the disabled room at the front of the hotel which was noisy from the traffic and reception but better then the box room. Again the room was missing the attention to detail, no conditioner or body lotion, no iron or ironing, only 1 pillow each no spares, the kettle did not work, no place to hang wet towels, the sink was to close to the toilet, no manual for the hotel. Breakfast was nice but would be better with the option of a cooked breakfast. This hotel has a lot of problem mainly the smell of cigarette smoke that a new hotel should not. it is pleasing to the idea but is not built for comfort.

title: "Amazing Value for London"
text: Having visited London numerous times this hotel is by far the best value for money my husband and I have ever experienced. While the rooms are small by American/Australian standards we found them to be reasonable by English/European standards. The hotel has been freshly renovated and was spotlessly clean in both our room and the common areas. The bed and linens were of good quality. A welcome addition was the modern well planned bathroom, good toiletries and the flat screen TV certainly did not go astray. The location is close to a tube station and a reasonable distance to Heathrow by tube. We found the staff to be friendly and courteous. Due to changes with our flight we had to cancel our last nights stay and the hotel did not hesitate to refund us in full for this unused night which was fantastic. There are also alot of eating options in the local neighborhood. We will definately return to this hotel on our next trip to London.

title: Fantastic Service, Brilliant Room, Value for Money
text: Staff were very kind and extremely helpful. I arrived very late at 4:30am and they happily checked me in then and helped me with a few items I had to bring in. The room was lovely, very comfortable and very clean. The Nespresso Machine with complimentary pods was also a plus! Would definitely recommend this place and I'd stay here again.

title: Nice hotel and staff, but specify room if you're fussy about noise!
text: The two bedrooms we saw nicely decorated. Unfortunately our room was on the ground floor, immediately off reception at the front of the hotel so there was a lot of noise from the traffic, people coming in and out of the front door and walking outside our room on the wooden flooring. The bed was really comfortable though! The restaurant/breakfast area is very nice, overlooking a lovely garden at the rear. Would stay again but definately request a specific room!

title: Amazing long weekend
text: My husband booked this as a present as I'd wanted to visit London. The staff was really helpful and friendly and we had a nice bottle of prosecco and a note from the manager in our room. We will be returning to this hotel, all of the staff are excellent, the breakfast, bar, restaurants, location, and rooms are wonderful.

title: Superb Stay
text: We stayed in the studio at the back of the hotel garden and it was just wonderful! Really private and does not feel like you are in a hotel or even London at all. We had a lovely stay and got to make our own breakfast in the kitchentte within our room. The restaurant is also amazing, the best sushi I have had in a while. We will definitely be back.

title: A little gem
text: So pleased we found this little gem. Easy to find (from M4) Limited parking at front but a couple of minutes walk from North Ealing underground station where parking is only £4,50 a day. Also on street parking around hotel with few restrictions. Nice Italian restaurant next to station and Greystoke pub which is very much a local but serves perfectly decent food at very reasonable prices. There is also a Japanese restaurant at the hotel which we didn't try this time but will certainly use next time we stay. The hotel is beautifully appointed, clean and contemporary. Room was quite small but perfectly well equipped and very comfortable. Continental breakfast well presented and plenty of choice. Hot food not needed. Absolutely couldn't fault the service. The staff were very friendly and happy to help. Benjamin and another young man (whose name we didn't get) on reception were a pleasure to meet. Staff at breakfast were also very pleasant, friendly and obliging. Nothing bad we can say about Hotel55. We will definitely stay again.

title: Funky Boutique Hotel
text: Booked this hotel for a business trip as location was close to meeting. Price was reasonable, particularly for London. Most surprised at the high quality of the place. It was a cold day and the staff had really warmed the room up in preparation. Beautiful décor and furnishings throughout the hotel including corridors. Added bonus of an in-house Japanese restaurant. All staff helpful too. My colleague that stayed was also suitably impressed.

title: Great service
text: Has a one night stay with friends on a business visit. The hotel is beautifully maintained, marrying the old with the new. Gorgeous old stained glass windows in the hallway. The receptionist was a star-couldn’t do enough for us & very informative. Went above & beyond. Our first floor room was spotless & well appointed, overlooking the front car parking area which leads onto the main road. Unfortunately, the road is a busy one & we were disturbed by overnight traffic but the receptionist was very apologetic & discounted our bill for which we were grateful. This wouldn’t deter me from returning. I would ask for a quiet room when making any future booking

title: Very small room
text: Seems to have gone downhill a bit since my last visit a few years ago. Room was VERY small (room 6) and looked a bit shabby (scuffed paint, pictures on wall grubby). Bathroom was cramped. The check in was efficient and the team at the hotel were very pleasant and polite.

title: Very welcoming
text: Arrived to watch Ealing cricket which is 2 minutes round the corner. We stayed at this hotel last year, we had an upgrade to a suite which was really lovely, staff very friendly. We will be back. Little gem.

title: Fantastic value and amazingly stylish
text: I stayed at the hotel for 2 nights on business. Great staff, excellent rooms, Philip Stark eat your heart out!!. The owners have done an excellent job at making the hotel staying experience more than just a cheap room. This is a 5 star experience for 3 star prices. Will come again.
