text: My wife and I needed a inexpensive place to spend 1-night in London close to the Paddington Station where we were going to catch the train to Heathrow Airport the next morning. This hotel was perfect. Only a short 5-minute walk from the Station and in a safe neighborhood. I could not believe that I could find a hotel for the cost I paid for the Mandalay Picton House. Now, don't expect fine accommodations, just functional. Our room was #12 and it was up three flights of narrow stairs. The room was very small but it did have a ensuite bathroom. Good place for the price.

title: Wonderful tennis at the Albert Hall
text: When in London, I always stay at the Mandalay, I am always made to feel very welcome by Dwight, Gary and all the staff. The bedrooms are clean and comfortable, with plenty of coffee and tea on tap! The breakfast is served nice and early, leaving you to enjoy the whole day. The location of the Hotel is very quiet and I always enjoy a good nights sleep. There are great transport links, I caught a bus to Kensington and then on to the Albert Hall to watch the Masters Tennis. The tube station and mainline railway station are just around the corner.

title: Cosy and comfy place to stay
text: Nice and comfy place to stay. Near to all the main attractions. Owners are nice and breakfast provided was like home made. Good quality and variety😌. Rooms are small but good according to the price of the room.

title: Basic
text: Close to Paddington station. Tired, basic hotel that 'did the job'. En-suite was a cupboard that flooded. Only 2 plug points in the room...both in one corner. Breakfast...cereal, toast, fatty bacon and eggs swimming in grease...and mixed veg!!

title: Does the job
text: Basic hotel. Great location and for what you pay, in London, it is fine. Whole place could do with a lick of paint to freshen up. Breakfast poor, toast, cereal and greasy bacon, eggs etc but there are breakfast places nearby which we went to on the 2nd day. 'En-suite' clearly just scrapes through guidelines, caravan shower room more spacious but good shower pressure. Only 2 sockets in room. Staff friendly. Great place for a night or 2 if you want to be near the sights of the capital. 5 min walk to Paddington.

title: Basic
text: Location is at 5min walk of Paddington station and 10min to Kensington Gardens. Very basic and old fashioned inside the hotel and rooms. Bed and shower were clean but old. Very small shower and bathroom. Breakfast was also very basic but good. Very friendly staff!

title: Ideal for Paddington Station
text: We stayed for one night - the room was a small double on the lower ground floor with an en-suite shower and toilet

title: Friendly manager
text: It wasn't my ideal stay, it had dated rooms with bars at the window and I hate net curtains but overall, the room was clean, the bed comfy and the staff friendly and helpful. The breakfast was not the greatest either but you have a choice of things to start your day.

title: Good service but bad room
text: We stayed 4 nights at Picton. You feel very welcome here. However the family room that we got was not great. The double bed was very small - too small for two people. And the beds are quite hard. The bathroom was in bad shape. Good location close to Paddington and Hyde Park and very friendly hosts makes up for a lot of that. And a good price. However we will probably choose another place next time.

title: Great Value
text: We stayed three nights at the Mandalay Picton House Hotel from 14-16 September 2011, after reading the positive reviews on the Trip Advisor website. Hotels are not an important part of our travel ethos, so long as they are relatively clean and we have an en suite. Travel is about being active, not lounging around a resort hotel, so we tend toward value and location rather than luxury. In this way, the Mandalay Picton Hotel fits the bill. The rooms are small, but we found the bathroom comical in its teeny tininess. You could sit on the toilet and take a shower - all at the same time! Breakfast was interesting, especially if you like cut-up hot dogs with your morning meal (optional, of course!). However, the staff are really friendly and helpful. In fact, we had some difficulty finding the hotel, and a hotel staff member rescued us from our geographical confusion by personally leading us to our destination. It's only for the customer service that I score it 4/5, without that crucial element it would barely score a 3/5.

title: Wow! What a wonderful, service-oriented place to stay!
text: The location is great, just around the block from Paddington Station. Our en suite family room was quiet, immaculately clean, with adequate space and comfortable beds--all at an unbelievable value. Breakfast was quite good and plentiful with extensive choices available. All of the above would rate Mandalay Picton House 5 stars, but there's more! I cannot even begin to heap enough accolades on the Ally family who run this place. They are what really set it apart from the rest. We stayed at 4 different Guest Houses/B&B's in Scotland and England on our recent visit to the UK, all of which were more than adequate. None came even close to the friendly service that we received at Mandalay Picton. Gary, Dwight, and the rest of the Ally family, greeted us warmly, treated us as old friends, and went out of their way to insure that our London stay with them was stress-free, and enjoyable. Great place, great hosts, highly recommended--you won't be disappointed! While you're there, have dinner at the family restaurant--Mandalay

title: A Place To Rest Your Head...
text: As the title says, if you are after a cheap (by London's standards) place to rest your head for the night then this place will do the job. If however you are after a little bit more for your money then I suggest paying a bit more and going else where. I needed last minute accommodation for 1 night after I was bought concert tickets as a present. The Mandalay was one of the few convenient options still available that I could afford being a student at that time and it served its purpose in providing that. Although I booked the Mandalay Picton knowing it wouldn't be the best accommodation in the world I have to say that after staying there I am a little surprised it has received as much high praise as it has. Great location, easy to get to. The building itself is dated and did not smell fresh. Breakfast was okay but nothing to write home about. The "en-suite" was tiny and more like a cupboard. Whilst I was expecting this to be the case and just made do, my friend (who is 5"7' and small in build) was not happy that he had to shower with his "bottom touching the wall" (lol). My main criticism of this place is the lack of regard for the safety of our belongings. Usually when I have arrived earlier than the "check in" time for any hotel, bnb etc. the staff have always allowed us to leave our luggage in a safe place with our names on it so we are free to go out and check in later. When we asked to leave our luggage at the Mandalay we were told to just leave our bags by the staircase (which lead to all the rooms) and collect them later...When I highlighted issues such as: a) our luggage was out of main sight and anyone staying at the Mandalay could in theory go through our bags b) staff hadn't put our names/ room numbers on the luggage and therefore how could they be certain we were claiming the right bags as our own when we returned (and likewise for any other guest claiming bags) The lady I spoke to looked at me blankly and didn't seem to understand what my concerns were. She then got on the phone to her boss (I presume) and we had to explain the problem again...eventually they agreed to let us leave our bags in the little office/ reception room behind the desk...personally I don't see why it was so difficult for her to grasp the issue here nor why she couldn't have let us leave our bags in the office in the first place without having to phone someone else. Also, (as someone else has already mentioned) there is a policy with the room keys in that when you go out you are expected to leave your room key in a pot at the front desk and collect it again later when you return, so there is always potential for something to go missing. I've rated it one star mainly because of the security issues I had and having to debate this with the member of staff I spoke to. That being said if this doesn't bother you and you are after somewhere to stay in London, which is affordable and nothing special then give it a go. I personally will not stay here again or recommend it to friends/ family.

title: Value for money!
text: I came to London for a weekend of sightseeing with my daughter who is 6. The hotel is in a great location. It was a few minutes walk from the bus stop (we were on Big Bus Tours). It was also a quick walk to Paddington Station. I didn't want to spend a fortune and didn't want to have to stay far out either. With this hotel you get what you pay for. You pay a very reasonable price to stay very close to the centre of London. The room was small but clean. It was warm and cosy. It's not fancy in the slightest but very good value for money. The management are helpful and friendly. On the way out my daughter said 'mum I like it here'. She was happy so I was happy. If you literally just need a place to sleep it's fine here. We didn't have the breakfast in the morning so can't comment on what it was like.

title: An interesting experience
text: The positive side is the friendliness and helpfulness of the owners/staff, who were lovely and full of good intentions, which made up for the lack in other areas. When I arrived my case was carried up the stairs to the third floor for me and the remote control for the tv which didn't work was quickly replaced - although the replacement didn't work as it should have but was ok. There was a very limited choice of tv stations and reception wasn't great. I had chosen a third floor room over a basement one when booking but wondered after climbing from the breakfast room in the basement to my room each morning whether I had made the right decision! But good for fitness! I was in a back room, which had constant drone day and night from the extractors from the kitchens below. There were a few niggles in the room which could be so easily sorted and would make it so much better, but for the price one shouldn't expect a mansion! There was a buffet breakfast with an interesting selection, but the Nice biscuits seemed a bit out of place! An extra cereal to choose from would have been better. It was nice that the owner chatted to guests over breakfast. Gives the personal touch. The en suite was very small - I could have washed while sitting on the loo! But it was adequate. There was nowhere to put a towel, so had to leave that on the bed while washing etc. There was a small bar of soap provided but that was all. That presumably had been used by the previous occupant as it was unwrapped and was stuck to the sink! I would stay here again because of the friendliness of the owners/staff and the location is great - easy access to both Paddington station and Hyde Park.

title: Heart warming stay
text: This was our first time in London and we were traveling with a young child of 17 months. Mandalay Picton House Hotel is a family run business and they were very friendly from the first e-mail. They arranged for a taxi to pick us up from airport and they were generous enough to let us occupy our room before scheduled time without any extra charges as they could see that we were traveling with a young child. They did everything to make our stay comfortable and pleasant. We found the hotel very cozy and safe. The rooms are small but comfortable and they are serviced everyday. During our stay we felt at home and were surprised to see the hospitality of this family in London. We appreciate their care, support and love during our stay and we hope to see them soon again.

title: Excellent value & location, friendly staff - highly recommended!
text: I stayed at Mandalay Picton House for a couple of days when I was attending a conference in London. The hotel is perfectly located - 5 mins from the Paddington Station, easy to commute to any part of central London if you need, The Hyde Park is just a short walk away. The staff is professional and very friendly, rooms were taken care of everyday. In the morning I could enjoy an ample breakfast so I can't think of what else a business traveller may need. In my opinion it is fantastic value for money and I plan to stay at Mandalay whenever visiting London again.

title: This is a wonderful little hotel
text: The Mandalay Picton House Hotel is a small, family run hotel in the heart of London catering for the budget conscious international tourist. Many of those that stay at the hotel are however people like myself, professionals and tradesmen who regularly need to stay in London on business. At the Mandalay we are assured of a warm welcome, a good nights sleep, and we leave for work in the morning having been fed a great breakfast. Because of this we return again and again. The hotel is managed by people of integrity who we can trust will take care of us. This is a no thrills hotel, but it still provides the comforts needed to give many of us a home away from home.

title: You get what you pay for in London
text: On arrival we were shown to our room. To say it was small is an understatement. The bed was so small we were touching as we lay on it. There was a blanket for warmth but this did not reach the bottom of the bed! The bathroom was so small that when you were sat on the loo and leaned forward your head hit the door! The shower was so close that you were also nearly in it whilst sat on the loo. This too was so small that when you moved the curtain stuck to you like glue. The room was very clean in fairness but that was the only redeeming feature. Breakfast was another let down no one told us how things work and there was cereal,curry, scrambled egg and beans on the menu. Hotel is very close to Paddington Station and very cheap for London which should have told us something!!

title: You get what you pay for, I suppose.
text: It was £75 per night for our twin room which was fine. It's a bit annoying that you can't get in the front door without calling a member of staff (although the staff were lovely). The room was an okay size with a three quarter bed and a single bed. The bedspreads had lots of worrying, crunchy (yes, crunchy) stains on. The en-suite was incredibly small...impossible to sit on the toilet without one foot in the shower. The shower also covered the entire bathroom in water when used. We were unsure about cleanliness so we didn't try breakfast. The room also needed more plug sockets. Decent location, though.

title: Blah
text: Perfect location ..nearby shops and restaurants. 5 minute walk to the underground and the express train to the airport. Staff was absolutely wonderful, very knowledgeable about tourist things to see and do. On the other hand..tiny rooms.. mold in the bathroom which made the smell unbearable. The shower curtain was also covered in mold and desperately needed to be replaced.

title: Warm welcome, lovely staff, clean rooms.
text: On looking for hotels in this area,(Sussex Gardens area) where I had stayed before we did have difficulty finding the accomodation, this was due to the London marathon, the football at Wembley and also the kids holidays. I must admit I did overlook this hotel, and on booking it I was a little sceptical until I saw the reviews, now on visting this hotel, I would definately stay here again. The hotel is run by a very friendly family, the staff cannot do enough for you, they are warm, welcoming, friendly and their knowledge of the area is great and they really are helpful in letting you get the best out of your visit. The rooms are very basic and have a TV with tea & coffee making facilities in them, although a little dated they are very clean. Bedding is clean and towels are too and changed daily. Breakfast is cereal and english breakfast, (although no bacon) they use continental meats. We still enjoyed our stay. The rooms we had were double rooms and on arrival were offered rooms with either a double bed or seperate beds which we accepted, the rooms were small in size, but not too bad and as we only slept and showered in them, as we were out most of the day. They were clean and worth every penny. The next time I visit London ....Yes I will stay and book this hotel. Dwight, Gary and all the family are great people.

title: This hotel is great value for money
text: I visit London three or four times a year. I always stay at the Mandalay Picton House Hotel. It is clean, comfortable, has a great breakfast and is very friendly.

title: Excellent value, great location and service
text: This is lovely small budget hotel where quests are always warmly welcomed! Rooms are clean and quiet and there is free tea and coffee. The staff is absolutely lovely and they are happy to provide you advice and tips on your London visit if you need. Location is perfect just few minutes walk from Paddington station. There is good underground and bus services around London (and when tube is out of service, many busses from Paddington goes nearly everywhere). I have stayed here three times since 2010 and going again in April.

title: Good location for the price.
text: Family run hotel with great service, but needs some updating. The staff lives on site, so there is someone to let you in 24/7. Rooms are very small, but that doesn't seem unusual for London. There is no lift, so be able to haul your luggage at least 2 flights of stairs. Also, the wifi only works in the lobby. It is very quick, but still inconvenient not having it in the room. Could easily install a repeater and solve this problem.

title: A Good Family Run Hotel
text: I was very happy with our stay. We dropped off our bags as we arrived early, before our room was ready. The room was more spacious than I thought with a good size toilet and shower. The hotel is a nice family run hotel who were friendly throughout even when waking them up in the night. As the family lives in the hotel, I had to stop myself from singing along to nursery rhymes at Breakfast - but I like the family feel. Breakfast has its good points, fresh toast for each table, however not liking eggs myself I was disappointed by there being no sausage and the quality of the bacon. My rating is based on the fact it is a 2 Star Hotel and a slightly better breakfast and the fact you don't get a key for the front door meaning you have to wake the staff when getting in from a night out (which I feel guilty about). Location is great, short walk from Hyde Park, Paddington and Marble Arch.

title: The Worst Hotel Experience Ever
text: Had a horrible experience here. I've stayed in some bad motels road tripping across the United States, but this place was by far the shadiest. I could go on and on and go into the details about how horrible the room is (and the airplane size bathroom), but you guys get the idea. It is so overpriced for what it is. The hosts kind of screwed me over (another long story I won't get into), they have a very deceiving policy, and they were very rude. Just don't go there, please.

title: Great budget B&B
text: We had a twin room for 5 days, facing the back yard. Very quiet, even with the window open during the night. Clean room, small but OK bathroom-cabinet. Warm breakfast which was good (compared to other London budget hotels/B&B's), but I missed the bacon! Less than 5 min walk from Paddington Underground, also quite close to Lancaster Gate underground station Friendly and helpful staff/owners. Wouldn't hesitate to book in again.

title: The definition of hospitality
text: Staying Mandalay Picton House Hotel gives a whole new meaning to the word "hospitality". From the moment you walk in the door you feel very welcome and taken care of. I have travelled quite a lot, and i must say I have rearly experienced better service. At least not to the same tariff as at the Mandalay. The staff is extremely friendly and helps you with almost everything! The rooms are quite small, but when you are in London you don't want to spend your time in a hotel room, you want to see the city!! Thank you for a very plesant stay!

title: deceiving "policy"
text: This place charges their fare hours later you cancel it , bad manners and more.. DONT go there, there are plenty of Hotels around better and wont charge you anything for cancelling nor when booking them , something that his Hotel should learn, apart from treating guests well It stinks

title: Simple lodging with warm and helpful hosts.
text: As it is with all other hotels in Central London, the room is typically small but it's equipped with the basic necessities such as cable TV, a heater (since we were there in winter), a sink and beds which were made everyday. They also provide a change of towels and soap daily. Coffee and tea sachets along with a electric kettle are included in the room. A halal continental breakfast is also included and it was a reasonable one for the room price we paid. In terms of accessibility, Mandalay Picton House is located at Sussex Gardens which is within a 5 minute walk to bus stops (which can take you to tourists attractions like Notting Hill and Kings' Cross Station) and Paddington Station (which also has a direct train to and fro Heathrow airport). A 10-15 minute walk also takes you to Marble Arch, Hyde Park and Oxford Street. A family-run hotel, the owner and his family are truly friendly folks who are always more than happy to help you with anything you need. I had an enjoyable stay during the 10 days that I was here with my mother in the winter of 2014 and I would stay here again.

title: Good location, delightful hosts
text: This small hotel is very reasonable, clean, and located within a few minutes' walk of several tube stations, Paddington station, Hyde Park, and Oxford Street for shoppers. But, what really made our stay was the wonderful helpfulness and friendliness of the owners. Gary, his son, and his brother Dwight went out of their way to be helpful with sight-seeing and travel arrangements and we shared many interesting conversations with them. We also loved eating at their Mandalay restaurant which has delicious Burmese food and is clearly a local favorite. Highly recommended! During different parts of our stay we had two different rooms. The one at the front was more airy, but very small and traffic was noisy. The one at the back was larger and quiet. Both rooms had their "quirks," but were clean with comfortable beds and met our needs just fine. Bottom line: We would definitely stay here again if we returned to London--with a big thank you to our hosts for all they did to make us feel like friends.

title: Budget B&B, good location, nice owners but very small and dated
text: The owners here are warm, genuine, friendly people and the B&B is very well located and cheap (for London). But you get what you pay for and the rooms are small and very dated, tiny tv's, some nylon bedding, and miniscule shower 'rooms' which include a shower, sink, and toilet in some kind of cupboard that you step into and can't move around in. Breakfast is pretty poor. Would rather pay a little more per head and stay somewhere less dated, with far more room and a half decent brekky.

title: You only get what you pay for.........
text: Location Location excellent. The bed linen was clean.... This is the only good thing I could say about the b&b. The place stank of curry and spices and was very off putting. The room was tiny and very run down as was the whole of the b&b. I could sit on the loo, brush my teeth and take a shower all at the same time. That is how small the bathroom was. Having said all that. It was only £75 for a night... Next time I will pay an extra few pounds and stay in a place that is not quite so run down and dated.

title: nicest host, clean, good breakfast and good value
text: Felt right at home with Dwight and all his obliging family. They took great care of me during the ash cloud mess (had to stay for 4 extra days) and provided good clean confort for a great price. They even waited up with me as I got a very early start for my boat trip home! Thanks to all the Picton family. Mary (Portugal)

title: Lovely welcome, perfect location
text: The welcome couldn't have been friendlier, the owners are genuinely interested in their guests and can't do enough to help. Our triple room was small, but quite adequate and clean. For the location and the welcome you'll not find better value in central London.

title: Great value, excellent service, good location
text: I selected this bed and breakfast because the very good recommendations it got, and can just say that this bed and breakfast has - in my opinion - great value and excellent service. We had a room for two with en-suite facilities. The other bed was very large, the other what I would call standard single bed, we were easily able to sleep in the wider bed. The bathroom was very clean and looked somehow newer than the rest of the room. I am personally not a fan of fitted carpets, in my opinion they make every room look shabby, but it was clean. The owner was very friendly and the breakfast was good for the price. I did not expect to get new towels every day but the room was well cleaned every day. So, I can just recommend this bed and breakfast for everyone who wants to stay in good location surrounded by friendly athmosphere and do not pay much for it.

title: Excellence in the Eye of the Beholder
text: London is a big crazy city with a million or more beds in wide price ranges, but the Mandalay Picton House is one in a million when it comes to warm welcome and genuine personality. There are few 'creature comforts' beyond clean towels and a bar of soap, the staircase is narrow and you won't want to bring your boss there for a drink after your high-profile business meeting...there is no bar... but Gary will greet you like a returning cousin on your first visit, has cold bottled water in a cooler, will give you a fan on a warm, still afternoon. He will take calls from your friends and deliver the message the moment you walk in. Dwight will recommend the best Indian restaurant, the best afternoon walking tour, and other family members will prepare a breakfast of delicious fresh eggs with crisp toast and give you a cheery "Good Morning" in a variety of languages, including Norwegian and Burmese. Do not mistake professional politeness for their genuine good will...this, along with a clean and comfortable bed, an excellent shower...in such close proximity to Paddinton Station...makes the Mandalay Picton stand at the top of those million beds.

title: Charming!
text: My friend and I stayed in a twin room for three nights. The room was incredibly small, but we were only there to sleep- so we didn't mind at all. Dwight and his family were SO friendly and accommodating. Breakfast was small but very nice. If I ever return to London, I wouldn't hesitate to stay here.

title: fantastic
text: excellent to say the least .... comfortable, clean and cozy, the owners and staff or family .... fantastic with several services that you will not find anywhere: microwave, column refrigerant (ie cold water free) and much more wi fi free and also the price conpetitif .... I think one of the best in London! alex and family italian

title: Perfect Location and Amazing Owners!
text: The place is located near Hyde Park, around 5 minutes from Paddington Station/Tube which has express trains to LHR. The location is the the greatest selling point of this B&B. You can walk through Hyde park into the city center. It is a long walk but London is best explored by foot anyway. It is also worth mentioning that the hotel is situated within one of the most upscale areas of London, so it is very safe. The hotel itself is quite old with old carpeting but it is a budget accommodation. The bed (2 mattresses stacked together) is really comfortable and heating works great. The room will be cleaned daily with fresh sheets and towels. There is no elevator but its quite common in older UK buildings. If you decide to stay in a single room, you will have to share your bathroom with guests living on the same floor, but this was not a problem for me as the facilities are kept clean and most people leave very early to explore the city. There will never be a line up to use the toilet. The staff are extremely nice. I had an interview at Oxford, so I wanted to stay 4 days exploring the city and the owner was extremely supportive and nice to me. In fact, I never met such kind individual in my entire life. Email them and they will assist you the best they can. I was really touched by their warmth and care and recommend the place without any reservations. I checked a lot of B&bs and within the price range this is the best accommodation you can find in central location. The actual room is not very impressive and could be cleaner, but the fantastic location and the great great owner make up for all shortcomings the place may have. For the price, there is no better place. Book with confidence!

title: It's okay if you're desperate
text: the owner is very friendly and chatty and gives you a warm welcome, although the other woman at reception was extremely cold and did not reply to questions, which made me a bit uncomfortable. the room is just awful: really small, smelly and outdated, no duvet, just a blanket which had clearly not been washed in a while, with suspicious stains on it. bed was too uncomfortable to sleep. noise is quite bad as the walls are very thin and there's no lift, so people were pacing up and down the stairs all night. bathroom: impossible to use. tiny, cracked toilet seat and dirty shower mat with black stains. breakfast: cold toast, undrinkable coffee, and a hot buffet which looks greasy and unappealing to say the least. I was with 2 friends so we got it very cheap and enjoyed the great location and helpfulness of the owner. however I would not go back as there are plenty of other B&Bs on that street and I'm happy to pay an extra £20 for a decent room. only go if you're desperate for a room!

title: Great location and very friendly and helpful staff
text: The perfect location for a weekend with friends in London. The Sussex Garden area feels safe and the hotel is very close to Paddington station (2 minute walk) which makes it easy to get around. Oxford Street is also in walking distance from the hotel (10-15 minutes). The rooms are clean and the prices are very affordable. This is a family run hotel, and the Ally family always gives you a warm welcome. They are very friendly and helpful. I will definitely go back! Thank you for a great stay!

title: Excellent Hotel for my first London Visit
text: Hotel location was great, only couple of blocks from Paddington underground station, and close to Hyde park which was amazing. Staff were super friendly and helpful and they were happy to provide information for tourists. rooms were decent and clean with all of the amenities that you need to have a convenient stay. Overall, great hotel for low budget travelers and highly recommanded.

title: Close to Paddington and Hyde Park
text: We booked here to be close to the World Championship triathlon in Hyde Park and our friends visiting from Berkshire via Paddington. The hotel is cosy and clean and the staff incredibly helpful, friendly and generous. We slept well in a good bed, in a quiet location and were very happy with our stay. Dwight is a very friendly generous host.

title: Great Location, more like 3.5 Stars
text: My husband and I stayed 4 nights here. The location is excellent, and the rooms appear clean, however our shower smelled like mildew the instant we turned on the water. The double bed also appeared to be using a twin bed as the frame, which was a bit strange. The breakfast was adequate, although we ended up eating a lot of toast. If you're willing to be relatively cramped (but it's London, so no surprise there) and not have the absolute best of amenities, then this hotel is a good deal. However, if you're looking for plush and modern accommodations, this is probably not your hotel.

title: Great, as usual
text: Second time here and all O.K. The staff is welcoming, friendly and nice. The room was spotless, the breakfast more tan enough. The toilet is tiny, but clean and even with hairdryer. Perfect location in central London. Great Price.

title: We love Mandalay Picton House Hotel
text: We have just returned from mandalay picton house hotel. We stay there for 3 weeks. The hotel is normal budget hotel but i love the service and off course the staff. Such a lovely experience with them. Me, my hubby and my two kids love them so much especially nanny, nana, gary, dwight and farzana. They are like my second family there and their hotel like my second home. The breakfast is lovely. My son azim, 5 years old love the "telur goreng"( fried egg). Every morning dwight will accompay us and start telling story to the kids. It's such a lovely moment and my kids miss that so much. I think we managed to visit most of the places in london with dwight help. He always give me easy insturuction where to go and take buses. The location of this hotel is really good and easy acces by public transport. I am sure i will return back to this hotel next time. To dwight, gary and family we miss you guys so much and hope to see you again. Take care and please contact me if you happen to come to kuala lumpur, malaysia. LOVE, AZAM,ERA,AZIM,AZIF.

title: Going back next time!
text: I and a friend were here in July 2013 for four nights. There are at least three things that are great about this hotel: 1. It is located centrally with a walking distance from Paddington subway and Train Station that can take you directly to Heathrow airport, and Oxford Street, if you come from Gatwick you can take the subway directly to Paddington from Victoria Stations who connects with the Gatwick Express and Southern line. 2. When I was there I met guest who returns every time they are in London-(3) but not only because the price is one of the best in the same area of many hotels. This B&B is run by the Norwegian, English and Burmese speaking Ally family since 1994 after living several years in Oslo, Norway (They might even know some more languages that I did not ask for) as my mother tongue is Norwegian I did all my communication in Norwegian with them without any problems at all. I will definitely recommend this hotel if you are Scandinavian speaking and do not feel comfortable with your English or if just want a “laid back” chat after a long day with “tourist” English in London. They even had an adaptor that connected with my Norwegian telephone charger that I had forgotten at home, and they have maps and information pamphlets for free. The double room we got was cosy, very clean, had tee-and coffee making facilities and TV. Even in the summer you can choose between the regular sheets and a fluffier sheet to cover yourself with at night, which is great for me who tends to freeze even in the summer (most hotels I have gone to do not provide fluffy sheets in the summer). The breakfast was nice and plenty. They also got Wi -Fi Dwight and his Wife Farzana did everything to meet our needs, it really shows that they are dedicated to their business and they go far to make you feel at home so I will guarantee you will feel very welcomed here, and if there is something you are missing do not be afraid to ask them! We met Dwight’s brother Gary at their Burmese restaurant only a stone’s throw away from the hotel, the brothers run the Hotel and Restaurant together, so do not get surprised if you find them in the hotel and restaurant at the same day (The restaurant had a range of vegetarian dishes to choose from, so this is a vegetarian and vegans heaven). Next time I am in London I will not hesitate to book a room at Mandalay again, and I have already recommended it to several friends as I do not they will not get disappointed.

title: Nice place, great location
text: We stayed with them a few days before going on a cruise. Small, clean rooms, but not as small as Paris. Tiny bathrooms. Owner's worked hard to make sure everything was OK. Nice people also. Breakfast was acceptable. But just a short walk to Paddington Train/Tube station! Everything you would ever need (market, pharmacy, laundry, etc.) all in the area.

title: Excellent value for money
text: Can't recommend this B&B enough. The hosts were pleasant and very helpful. Rooms are small but adequate and for London- very spacious. Very centrally located.

title: Fantastic value in the heart of London with a warm welcome from this family run business. Home from home
text: On arrival we greeted with warmth which remained throughout our stay. The rooms are clean & all is provided in terms of tea/coffee etc, breakfast is more then adequate. I stayed here on many occasions & when in Central London would always like to come to this well run family orientated business which has become a home from home.

title: Best Value in London, England
text: Excellent location from Paddington Station. We arrived from Paris and made to feel at home immediately. Gary and Dwight were wonderful hosts, meeting all our needs and assisting us in any way possible. The accommodations were perfect, clean and efficient. They accommodated us especially well on our last day, allowing us to keep our luggage in the main foyer, which permitted us to tour for the rest of the day until our taxi arrived later in the evening. Gary arranged for the taxi too which took us to our hotel near the Gatwick Airport. We felt safe, welcomed, and greatly appreciated their care and concern...a special gift when travelling in a foreign country. We will tell all our Canadian friends to consider this hotel in the future.

title: Great hospitality, great location, rooms leave something to be desired
text: We chose to stay at Mandalay Picton House because it was one of very few budget options in central London and at a great location. From the very first email from one of the owners, Gary, we could tell that we were going to meet wonderfully kind and considerate hosts, and we weren't disappointed. Both brothers are extremely talkative and knowledgeable persons with unbelievably retentive memories, typical of good listeners. They will memorize everything you tell them of yourselves. Never in our travels have we come across hosts who were truly interested to find out something about us personally and about our culture. So thank you once again, Gary and Dwight, for many an interesting talk! On a different note, having read the positive reviews of Mandalay here, we were led to expect a certain standard of cleanliness in our room, which sadly wasn't the case, and this is actually the only real complaint we had. The carpeting on the floor looked as if it hadn't been vacuumed in a long while, and although the room was cleaned on a daily basis, the fact remained that the floor was dirty. The bed linen, however, was clean and changed regularly, and so was the bathroom. The room was small but comfy enough for the two of us, with even an extra bed. It looked in need of some serious renovating, though, as its whole aspect was a bit run-down, but we didn't mind since we spent most of our time outside. The bathroom was also very small, which meant there was no way to keep it dry once one of us took a shower. This didn't pose much of a problem, though, once we got used to it. The water in the shower was nice and warm. The window to the street was very difficult to open/close, and even when closed, it didn't seal shut, but as it was pretty warm outside this didn't represent an issue. Breakfast was quite ample and certainly very filling, with enough options to choose from. Coffee is pretty good. The staff are very courteous and you can ask them for anything. There is also the added bonus of having Dwight present at breakfast every day, chatting everyone up and ready to have interesting discussions. The location of the hotel is fantastic, with Paddington train station and two tube stations nearby, as well as regularly serviced bus stops on the same street. Oxford Street can be reached on foot. The Paddington/Bayswater area is quite touristy but nevertheless very pleasant and safe, with plenty of restaurants, pubs and 24-hour shops, and Hyde Park virtually around the corner. We would recommend this hotel for its prices and location as well as the above-and-beyond hospitality of its owners, just don't allow yourself to expect too much in the way of cleanliness and general appearance.

title: Very Satisfied
text: My parents,sister and I have stayed twice at Mandalay Picton. In fact, we are leaving only tomorrow for Europe. We are a family from Canada and Bangladesh. We have the same family room (four beds and private shower/wc). The room is large and clean. Breakfast is ample,suitable for both vegetarian and non vegetarian. The hotel is centrally located

title: Very Friendly, central and clean!
text: My girlfriend and her younger cusin stayed at this hotel for 4 nights. Its very central (aprox. 3 min from Paddington subway station), clean and it has a very kind staff! It is also very cheap! Will come back in November!

title: Probably the best value in London!
text: My mum and I stayed at this B&B for one night. Please find detailed info below: Price: We paid £65 for a twin en-suite room (with breakfast). If you want something cheaper, you will have to settle for bed bugs, bad neighbourhood, bad service, communal showers and no breakfast. This is definitely an amazing value (probably the best) in London. Location: Very conveniently located about 5-10 minutes (on foot) from Paddington underground station. The neighbourhood was very quiet and nice. Cleanliness: Everything was very clean except for the floor (could have used a vacuum cleaner) but to be fair it does get dirty anyway if you don’t take off your shoes in the room. Room: We stayed at room No. 5 which is the first room on the ground floor. In this room we had a TV, tea and coffee making facilities (inc. kettle, 2 mugs, 2 glasses, sugar, etc), a large drawer and wardrobe, 2 single beds (quite comfy), a telephone, hairdryer (seemed a bit outdated so used own), mirrors, washbasin, toilet, shower. 1 towel and 1 bar of soap each and toilet paper was also provided. In the wardrobe we found hangers and extra blankets. We could have used a towel hanger and a window that opens (heating was on max, could not turn it down, could not open window either but we did not ask for help as we only stayed for one night). Sleep quality: The room was very hot (details in above paragraph) so that kept us up, also there is an alley way right next to this room so it was a bit noisy (not too much though). Also, I swear I could hear the underground trains below us – but maybe it was just my imagination. Service: From the first point of contact (phoning to check availability, get info on accommodation), we were welcomed as valued customers. On arrival and departure we could leave our bags, which was very handy for us. Overall: Clean, close to station, close to city centre, cheap, average crime rate in area (like in most of London, trivia: Westminster’s the highest), value for money, excellent customer service and high ratings (which proved to be truthful). Check! I would say this guesthouse is definitely great. After doing an extensive research (as I am a travel and tourism student) based on factors like location, price, nearest amenities and ratings on here

title: Genuine and Friendly Owners
text: Well done to Dwight and his family for making this place welcoming and warm to guests. He speaks Norwegians too - having lived there and trained as a Chef for over 15 years. The BB is kept clean and neat - please don't expect 5 stars Hotel rating or Michelin stars breakfast menu. Highly Recommended - for the cost, location, sincere owners. I will stay again.

title: Great location, friendly staff
text: Wonderfully located hotel with very friendly, helpful staff. Rooms were tiny (bathrooms even tinier), as to be expected in London, but very clean. Breakfast was rather weak - everything was prepared in advance and selection was limited. Located on a quiet street within a short walk of Paddington Station - perfect!

title: good location,quiet rooms and friendly staff!
text: Good location, just a couple of minutes from paddington tube station. the area is quiet for being in such a central location. rooms a bit dated,but clean and comfy. bathroom is good. Did not really like the breakfast, but there are lots of places in the area to choose from. small tv and only a few working channels. Our beds was made every morning. we could not hear our nabours wich we really liked! i would stay here again! All the staff we met were lovely!

title: Maybe we were just unlucky
text: We stayed here in a quin room in August 2011. We received a very warm welcome but our room was not what we expected after reading the reviews on Trip Advisor. It was on the ground floor with steps leading to the pavement outside. The room was tiny with NO space between the beds and the bathroom was filled with mould (even the toilet paper and tiny bar of soap had mould on it) and the toilet seat was broken and obviously had been for a long time. The breakfast was interesting - custard creams and very oily eggs. We wouldn't stay here again and are of to London this weekend staying in our usual B&B which may cost £20 more a night but is well worth the extra money for the comfort it provides.

title: Friendly
text: The hotel staff are very friendly, they welcomed us with open arms. Have chit chat with them asking about our stay and trip. The hotel was cleaned everyday. Have a good times staying in this hotel.

title: Clearly too popular for its own good
text: We had booked a room in advance and the email correspondence was faultlessly polite and friendly, so we were horribly dismayed when we arrived at the hotel to be turned away! While we were checking in, my companion requested if we could just have a look at the room. The proprietor seemed to take offense at the request, saying that if we did not actually want the room, then we should not have booked it, and furthermore there were many people on the "waiting list" who would gladly take it if we didn't. We were shocked at his reply, since we had not intended to offend, and it is a standard question that is commonly asked. We then said ok, we would take the room, but he turned us away and said it was no longer available! Clearly they are so popular that they can afford to pick and choose their customers. If they did indeed have so many people on the waiting list, then he should not have a problem if we saw the room and, on the off-chance, did not want it -- unlikely, since we had just come off a 17hr flight and wanted to rest. If you happen to book with them and experience the same treatment, don't fret. We were a little worried at first that we couldn't find accommodation as it was about 7pm, but the area is chock full of B&Bs, you'd be spoiled for choice. We found another place in the end, which turned out to 1) be nearer the tube station, 2) have wifi internet, and 3) have the friendliest and most helpful service staff we have met so far. I guess the unpleasant experience turned out to be a blessing in disguise afterall.

title: Definately the best hotel we've visited.
text: Family of 4, stayed for 4 nights. The most friendly and hostile staff we have met. They welcomed us with a smile and were very helpful to find information about places to see, timetables for evening song, booked transportation etc. The room were better than expected at this low price, clean and tidy. They also run a great budget restaurant a little walk away, which we absolutely recommend.

title: My Dad's 70th Birthday was even more special because of the Mandalay owners!
text: My Dad and I traveled from Canada to London for his 70th Birthday. My Dad has never been to London and I knew he would feel uneasy being away from home, so when I read the reviews about the Mandalay, I thought it would be the perfect place for us to stay. Just as I thought, Dwight and his family made my Dad feel like the hotel was a home away from home. Their conversation, breakfast, sightseeing advice and accommodations made our mornings and evenings there quite delightful. The hotel is a great buy for the price you pay. The beds are clean and the rooms well maintained. The washroom was small, but at least we had private use of it. One morning, we woke to the sound of the Queen's horses clip clopping by! I highly recommend this hotel if you want to feel at home in London. Thanks Mandalay!! J Lee

title: Cheap, clean, kind Mandalay Picton
text: We were at mandalay Picton House in June. We were 7 girls, a gropue of friends in 2 rooms ( a triple room and a room for 4 people). They were small, but no too much. Rooms and bathrooms were very, very clean and towels were changed daily. Gary and his family were very hepful with us: we arrived really late the first day and there was not any problem

title: Very good value and safe
text: Great location, great staff, very reasonable rates (plus a reduction for only having 3 in a quad room). Rooms are clean and serviceable. Only one complaint, the fire alarm went off at 6.50 am!! Finally, although it's adequate and surprising that its included considering the low rates, I would recommend going out for breakfast!!

title: THE hotel!!!
text: I and my 9 year old son have had the pleasure to visit this hotel five times since may 2011. Allways the stay has been relaxing, and with perfect, but respecful services. It is situated just between to underground stations, closest is Paddington st. The personal is very service minded, and allways in a good mood. The rooms are just somewhere to sleep. But it is allways clean, and fresh. In the end, I have to meantion the calm and quite moment och breakfast. People from Sweden, Norway and elsewhere who share their experiencies from yesterday, and perhaps what will happen today. I will say.. go there!!! You will not be disappointed! Väl mött på Picton Mandalay hotel

title: Real value for money
text: if you are looking for luxury, don't go here. But if you want a safe and very cheap place to stay, go! The hotel is small and the opposite of fancy, but the owners are extremely helpful and nice. The room I had was very small but also very clean, which is not always true of London hotels. The bathroom was tiny and not very comfortable, but again - clean. The full English breakfast was included in the room price. This hotel is perfect is you are in London to stay out - and not in. It is real value for money, and the location only two minutes walk from Paddington is perfect, especially if you are flying in and out from Heathrow.

title: Lovely hotel
text: The owners are wonderful & friendly. Rooms as standard hotels in that area. Bathroom very small - but clean & it worked.

title: Return Customer
text: The Ally family makes this hotel one of the best places to stay in London. My experience this time was no different then my visit 2 years ago and is the reason my friend and I returned. The personal care this entire family takes to make sure you have an enjoyable stay in London makes you feel like you are staying with good friends. The beds are quite comfortable and compared to other hotels I have stayed in in London the rooms (this visit and last) are a nice size. My friend and I have plans to return to London in September of 2012 and will definately stay at the Mandalay.

title: great hosts
text: we stayed there a group of six people in two triple rooms.the rooms were quite small (especially the bathroom) and not very beautiful decorated.we had a very rich breakfast every morning but the dinng room was small and we had to get up after 20 minutes for other guests to sit.overall the hotel was clean.the big advantage of this b&b is its owners.they are helpful,always smiley and funny.

title: Awesome Location with the warmest welcome in London!
text: This cozy little B&B is right in the heart of London, just a 5-6 minutes walk from one of the biggest train and tube stations-Paddington Station. What this means is that you are close to most of the attractions in London with minimum line changes and low travelling time. Also, the Heathrow Express runs through Paddington (I think it starts there) making it really convenient. And all this is before you get there! I loooved being greeted by name as soon as we walked in by the ever enthusiastic Gary (with whom I'd corresponded during booking). It was such a refreshing change from the usual impersonal check-in experience at a hotel. It was our first time at a B&B and we were definitely charmed. The sheer effort and care than has been put into every aspect of this place by the brother duo of Gary and Dwight shows and was much appreciated by us. The rooms aren't too big, but then this is London. And at this price and location, there really isn't anything to complain. We're definitely staying here whenever we are in London again!

title: Perfect location, old fashioned customer service, clean facilities
text: Utilised trip advisor to find this hotel in a very central yet peaceful area only 2 min from Paddington tube station and 10 - 15 min walk to Oxford Street. Cannot fault service always very warm and genuinely caring. Good breakfast, fresh towels daily. For the price the facilities are excellent, would recommend!

title: Very welcoming staff
text: We work around London all the time and have stayed in some dumps, it was very nice to find a good clean hotel and will always stay here in future. Room big shower good and a good breakfast to start the day.

title: Fantastic Hospitality
text: We stayed at this hotel during the Queen's Diamond Jubilee. We arrived as strangers and left as friends. Dwight the owner is an absolute star. He made our stay very comfortable, nothing was too much trouble. The reception area is so pretty, security is good, the front door is always locked and we were able to leave our luggage after check out which was a huge bonus for us. The hotel is just like Upstairs Downstairs television programme, full of charm and atmosphere. We have already booked our next stay at this hotel and highly recommend it to anyone visiting London. It is very rare these days to receive such hospitality from this family owned and run hotel. We will never stay anywhere else in London again.

title: Excellent stay
text: The Mandalay Picton House is an excellent place to stay. the house is perfectly situated for getting around with everything I need.ed just a very short walk away. the staff were extermely friendly and very helpful. Everyone said hello etc whenever they saw us. The rooms are clean and comfortable. The price includes breakfast.Keep up the good work and thank Youy for a wonderful stay.

title: Treated like family ... What a wonderful place to stay.
text: The Mandalay Picton House was an excellent place to stay. It is very close to Paddington Station. This family own and run hotel treated me like family. They always helped with directions and suggestions for getting around London. I started each day with a wonderful and hearty breakfast and good conversation. The accommodations are modest but very safe, clean and comfortable. A great location for catching tours, trains, buses, and shuttles. I cannot begin to express how kool it was to stay at such a friendly place on my first visit to London. What a wonderful experience!

title: Excellent stay
text: The Mandalay Picton House Hotel was an excellent stay. Without a doubt the hotels most attractive trait is the wonderful service provided by the Ally family. From booking the room until checking out they were able to go beyond our expectations in satisfying our needs for a great value hotel in a convenient location. Paddington Station is a three minute walk and will get you anywhere you need go within the city. The continental breakfast was delightful to wake-up to in the morning and was everything needed before a big day of touring. Although I am 100% satisfied with my stay, I should state that if you are looking for a luxury Hotel the Picton House may not fully cater to your needs. The rooms are somewhat small but do include comfy beds, fresh towels that are replaced every day, and a television with many channels. I highly recommend this hotel as it will sure to improve your experience in such an amazing city. Tim Adams

title: Nice hotel with very friendly staff
text: I`ve chosen this hotel on the basis of reviews found here and I must say that it was really a good choice. Good location, very clean room, good breakfast (eggs, beans, muschrooms, cereals, toasts, bananas,...) and above all very friendly owners. Both brothers were really nice - we felt like at home and we were sad when we were leaving. We enjoyed our stay in Mandalay Picton House very much. I can also recommend the restaurant Mandalay in Edgware road (same owners) - the food was excellent.

title: Great value
text: Value for money, great hospitality, good location, wonderful people, it's the Mandalay Picton. For those expecting 5-stars anything, look elsewhere. If it's a good British B&B, you can't go wrong with the Mandalay. Given time, try their restaurant, a 15-minutes walk from the hotel. I spent five good nights and was made to feel at home. They gave good advice on the places I should go to and made sure I was safe. They were patient to open the door each time I needed to take a puff. This also meant that strangers can't enter the permises without a good reason. While they don't have a safe in the room, there is coffee, tea and snacks in the room. There is a small fee for wifi, 2-3 pounds per day, and they're working to improve the connections in the rooms. To summarise, the management have been around the world so they know how important accommodation is to travellers.

title: Friendly and helpful
text: I have been staying there on and off for about a year with work and I find the staff very friendly and helpful. The location is ideal and I will recommend it to anyone coming to London for business or pleasure.

title: Friendly, helpful staff. Convenient location.
text: I booked this hotel due to its location and the reviews on this website. My husband and I were very pleased. It was a great value for the price. The staff was very friendly and helpful and offered excellent recommendations and thorough directions. The room was en suite and was very neat, clean, and quiet. We were allowed to leave our bags after check-out so that we could explore London before taking an evening train from Paddington Station.

title: Excellent quality-price ratio
text: I booked this hotel purely due to positive feedback here in TA. Booking was easy by prompt email correspondence and a nice surprise was that no deposit was asked. Room was more spacious than I expected although bathroom was very tiny. Double bed wasn't the biggest I've slept on but ok for two nights. Buffet type breakfast was more than adequate. I highly recommend this for a few night trip, quality-price ratio is excellent!

title: So friendly..! Clean..!
text: It is also a genuine place . The owners Gary and Dwight are wonderful people, friendly, affable and genuine! Clean rooms, convinient location ! Makes you feel at home ! Highly recommended !! Don't miss the amazing cosy Burmese restaurent on Edgware road!

title: Great base to see the sights! Clean, safe and friendly!
text: If you are looking for a great location, reasonable rate, a good night's sleep, safe neighbourhood, spotless room and fantastic staff, this is the place! The hotel is a few blocks from Paddington Station which is on the direct Heathrow Connect and Heathrow Express rail lines from the airport. We received a very warm welcome from our host, Gary who, along with his brother Dwight, was extremely helpful in recommending restaurants and sights and helping with transportation information. They always had time for a chat. The room was small and had a tiny ensuite bathroom but everything was very clean and the beds were comfortable. It met all our needs as we personally spend our time seeing the sights, not in the room. Our room faced the front street which was not overly busy with traffic and quiet at night. We walked to many local pubs/restaurants and Hyde Park (well worth seeing). The Paddington Underground station is on three tube lines and convenient to everywhere. The breakfast (included) was adequate and included eggs, cheese and bananas as well as the usual continental fare. The Mandalay Picton House is great value -- way above other hotels in the same block charging 20+ pounds more for dirty, unmaintained premises and grumpy staff!

title: Comfortable and valuable stay at the heart of London
text: Although I have few visits to London, I have been a regular customer at Picton House hotel since the past seven years. I believe Picton house provides clean, fast, and remarkable customer service. People are friendly, extremely helpful and organized. I really find it as the affordable price with comfortable and valuable stay at the heart of London. For each of my new visits, Manadalay was my choice for stay and proved to be always maintaining and developing the customer experience.

title: Swinging a cat in the room
text: The room was so small you could not of swung a cat in it. The room numbers are shown on small signs that are hard to read. The actual room on the last door to gain access to it did not include that room number. The room was tiny, it was cold due to the constantly running air conditioning. The bed was so soft it was terrible. The space to get to the bed was so small it was beyond belief. The bathroom although small was very clean and modern, but the shower did not have and markings to show the temperature of the water.

title: Won't stay again.
text: We booked a double room thinking that it had two beds. When we arrived, the room was unbelievably small, the double bed took up all the space, there was no table, chair or lamp because there was no room to fit them in. The window was broken and wouldn't open, the Wi-Fi cost an extra 4 pounds a day. We requested another room as this one was impossible for 2 people to stay in for 5 nights. We had to pay an extra 180 pounds for another room and got the cold shoulder from the staff for the rest of our stay.

title: Room 411
text: Not an easy room to get to & the space between the bed & door is too narrow chipped cup in room attention to detail is all important. Hotel has a lift & breakfast buffet at additional cost buffet should be for paying guests & not for staff to help themselves while guests are around.

title: never again, that's sure!
text: I stayed at Euro lodge Clapham for four nights. I had to re-clean the room (double) by myself immediately because it was too dirty for my standard, and very dusty. There was also a sock behind the wardrobe and it was covered by dust. The kitchenette was not clean, even if it worked and it was useful

title: clean and pretty
text: very pretty staff and clean room and bathroom. perfect location: 2 mnutes walk from the tube station, in front of the park. And Clapahm is a very nice district: clean and calm but with brilliant life, restaurants pubs etc. one significant fault: double bed looks like a single one...

title: Good last minute room
text: I booked the room last minute, was clean tidy and well equipped. 24-hour reception is handy. Only thing that through me is there is another hotel by the same owners next door! They do offer a breakfast for £5, although I didn't go for it.

title: Poor hotel, good location
text: Don't book here if you are planning on spending time in your hotel. Our room was tiny, you couldn't open the window so it was very hot, people were drilling outside our bedroom at 10am on a Saturday morning, our room key stopped working a couple of times so had to get help from reception, shower was sort of blocked, poor quality bed, no wifi in the rooms only in common areas. One positive is the location. It is very close to the lively bars, restaurants and cafe's etc in Clapham and very close to Clapham South tube station. Convenient if you are looking for a cheap bed for a night or 2.

title: Clapham South Belvedere Hotel
text: Chose this hotel,as it was the nearest to Brixton O2 Academy. A good half an hour walk to Brixton high street. The hotel room was clean,but very compact. The double bed,took up the majority of the floor space,leaving only a tiny walking space,around the outside of the bed. For a double room,I would of expected a bit more floor space. It was ok for the price of the room,but wouldn’t stay here again,as it was just too cramped. Probably more suited to a lone traveler.

title: not good
text: The room was smelly, dirty, with no air con, the windows were just beside a garbage bin, also very humid and dark. Bathroom dirty and stained. The impression i have according to what i saw. it is that this place is like a motel, where people go there to have fun for a while. So my advice is please do not waste your time and money in this place.

title: Steep Stairs & Upfront Payment
text: At check-in, we're asked to pay the full amount in cash upfront, usually a sure-sign of TROUBLES ahead. We're assigned to a room 4-floors high. After dragging up 2 luggages, totalling 30kg, up the steep stairs, we found the room uncleaned. Went down to the front desk to ask why, ... we're assigned another room after some time haggling. We had to drag the luggages down. And repeated the whole process of climbing the steep stairs with 30kg luggages again, to a newly assigned room. The Front Desk staffs were neither encouraging nor helpful throughout the process. And we felt like troublesome guests, rather than irrate guests requesting for what we've paid for. It was definitely not a good first-time customer impression for a customer.

title: Good choice, they can better
text: Good choice, value for money, but they can better. Very clean, every day cleanness the room and change linen and towels (they give only bath towels not face-towels). Even small rooms but very warm and clean. 24h reception. There is not a closet but a small place to hang clothes.They charge for wi-fi.

title: What an "upgrade"!
text: Booked this hotel twice: - The first time: Upon arrival, we were told that our room has been flooded and we have been "upgraded" to a 3 star hotel "nearby". They called a taxi to send us to the hotel, which was located in a remote area (with NO underground service, only overground - you can imagine how "nearby" it is) - which totally ruined our traveling plan the next day. What is even more ridiculously is that our "upgraded" room was a room with 2 single beds with a BUNK BED - what kind of upgrade is this?!!!?? We did not pay hotel price to sleep on bunk beds!! Also, the room was tiny with hardly any room to walk let alone open our luggages to take our belongings out

title: Nothing to complain about
text: I used this lodge for a rest stop after my top deck tour and it was exactly what I needed good bed when the window was closed the room was quite and with a decent sized TV and a good selection of TV channels I was entertained while I was in my room. Very pleased with this lodge

title: Filthy hotel
text: We stayed for one night in this hotel. It was absolutely filthy: the room was tiny and covered with mould. Additionally the room was situated next to the breakfast room and so was extremely noisy. The only advantage is the location: it's near to a tube station, so you can get away from the place as quickly as possible.

title: We could have died..
text: When my boyfriend and I arrived for check in at 3pm we were greeted by what was to be our first bad encounter with Euro Lodge. As the hotel was overbooked there was a large queue gathered in reception and a huge delay ensued as each customer was convinced by an unprofessional staff team, to move to a hotel a half an hours drive away. We refused and 45 mins later sent to room 103...... It was small, outdated, badly decorated (paint chipped, no drain in the shower etc..), and had terrible lighting as the view outside the window was a concrete wall (see pictures). Settling in we noticed a large crack in the ceiling and were shocked to find there was dust falling through it onto the bed. Later that evening we were concerned & asked to be moved, however we were refused. The next day when we arrived back to the hotel we were shocked and appalled to learn that the roof had collapsed !.... All our stuff had been moved to another 'upgraded' room and we were not impressed when we seen that everything had been tampered with (clothes had been taken from bags and laid out, or transferred into other bags) Also some small items were missing such as shaving cream. Various items of clothing were destroyed in dust and the staff did not offer to pay for dry cleaning. The following day my boyfriend complained twice and demanded a refund, after constant hassling we finally spoke to a manager who agreed to give our money back, however he did not specify when and now one week on there is no sign of the cheque.... Other complaints: slow internet, bag holding area was a room with a glass door and no lock, no water stocked at reception, no signal, staff very difficult to communicate with.

title: HORRIBLE!
text: Only come here if you want: extremely small, dirty rooms, broken toilet, no hot water to shower with, noise, fire alarm ringing caused by smoking people in the middle of the night, terrible breakfast, only bread and butter, and marmelade, the heaters are on 24 hr and cannot be turned off! There are no proper sanitary provisions, water pressure is not more than drops..... If there is a top 10 worst hotels ever, this is a top three listing! I bet. It is an old hotel, it should be demolished 99 years ago. STAY AWAY from this hotel and do not believe ANY positive feed back!

title: Average, basic, dated, nothing special
text: The hotel itself is located on a main road about a 15 minute walk from Clapham Common Underground Station. there are no directions on the road so make sure to find out exactly where it is as you will be walking aimlessly up and down the road, which in our case, we were. First impressions are the hotel is old, the facilities are dated, worn and in bad need of refurbishment. It was clean but again I couldn't seem to look passed the outdated decor of the room and entire hotel.

title: Low expectations, pleasantly surprised
text: I stayed for a week at the hotel in Feb/Mar of last year and I went in with my eyes wide open. I'd read the reviews and was expecting the absolute worse. My friend and I didn't have a lot of cash to spend and since we were there to see the sights, not to spend all day at the hotel, we went for a cheaper hotel that was pretty close to the main tourist areas. And I must say that the hotel was not at all like I had expected from reading the reviews. The staff was really nice and tried to help in whatever they could. The room we stayed in was kind of small but everything was clean and well appointed and it was on the top floor in the back of the building, so we had some nice views of the neighborhood. The shower/tub was a hassle trying to get it to where the water wasn’t boiling or frozen, and unfortunately we had some rather noisy neighbors, but other than that I have no complaints about the Euro Lodge Clapham. Sure, it had a few things that are lacking if you’re only used to American hotels, but it was a really nice surprise and I’d stay there again if I went back.

title: I love this hotel
text: I really liked my stay in this hotel. I actually dontd get negative reviews about it. Everything in the room was super clean, towels, blankets. No moquette on the floor. In the room there is a little tabel with a kettle and every morning you find tea bags and sugar. Okay, the room is small, but what the hell do you have to do inside a hotel room in London? You always stay outside so for sleeping is perfect. I also enjoyed the quite neighborhood :)

title: Location, location, location
text: Guess what - great location but that's about it. Bus stop is outside and tube 100m away. Also good bars around. We had a lovely meal at the Avalon. However the electrics were weird. Ours turned off when we put the card in and we had to sleep with 2 lights on all night. There was also no signal on the TV. The bathroom was clean and new although the shower pressure was a bit ropey. The breakfast choice is limited - cereals, toast, juice and tea/coffee. The reception staff were friendly but the 2 women in charge of toast and cutlery rationing were clearly not very happy in their work.

title: Do not Book!!!!
text: Booked this "lodge" for an overnight stay in London for a friends birthday. Booked it through Booking.com and it was star rated. I have just arrived and I am gutted that I didn't cross check this venue with Tripadvisor. It is horrible!!! Way over-priced. I don't care how expensive london is. I can see now (my own error for not checking) that check in is not till 3pm which is not great for an overnight stay but I should have double checked. I have taken pics of reception area and I haven't access to the bedrooms yet but I am dreading it! Will post pics when I do check in. I agree London is expensive to stay in but €100 for a substandard hostel!!! Crazy!! I have stayed in plenty of hostels before and they were much much better quality that this place..Ugghh..Do not stay here, pay the extra €20 and get a better option elsewhere or seriously booked into a hostel- if it's only for one night do not give your good money to these rip off merchants..The few staff that I have encountered have been disinterested and there is no sense of warmth or welcome..God, I hope I'm drunk enough later to force myself into their sheets. and judging by the other reviews here I can hardly wait for breakfast.

title: Will be back again!
text: My second visit and returning in September. Family members live in Clapham so very convenient. Reception staff friendly and helpful. Happy with sunny bedroom & ensuite overlooking street and Clapham Common. My room was next door which was perfectly ok. Traffic noise not a problem at night either as I wear earplugs when away. I was lucky to get a double bed for single use which was very comfortable. Breakfast minimal, but fills a gap, coudln't expect much for price I paid. 5 mins walk to Clapham South tube for Northern Line and 2 mins to Tesco. Plenty of restaurants nearby. Internet cafe is past the tube station on left. Opens 8.30 am I think. Internet in reception but there can be a queue to use it. Don't expect luxury, if you want luxury you need to pay for it. If you want a clean bedroom & bathroom and somewhere to sleep this is just perfect, for me anyway! There seems to be many different types of rooms, good as I had and not so good judging by some of the reviews I have read. However, I do think some people expect 5 star facilities for 2 star prices and they need to take into account how much they paid and think twice before giving their awful reviews.

title: You Definitely Get What You Pay For And Some EXTRAS.
text: Not good to start at the reception and on a chair was a bag of canabis which didn't seem to faze the receptionist. Got to room and all I can say a shoe box is bigger lying flat out my head is on one wall and my feet on the window. Simply terrible place.

title: Only 3 rating because of location!
text: Well the beds and pillows were fabulously comfortable. Room 333 although small was adequate and clean. Looked fairly recently decorated but let down badly in other areas. The hotel is undergoing major reburbisment lets hope they get to the public areas soon...in dire need. Room 333 is right at the top of the building...no lift...phew! TG we are fairly fit pensioners. At least there wasn't much noise up there...apart from cooing pigeons. No hairdryer in the room is most unusual...and a pain! Forget the complimentary shampoo and soap...put a hairdryer in!! Quite disgusting in this day and age to charge £4 for wifi! Maid service was very good for the 1 day it was needed. We only stayed 2 nights, we would stay there again because of the location but there would be a few relevant requests! Come on Euro Lodge get your act together! I know £77 per night is cheap in London but COME ON you need more good reviews!

title: Wimbledon trip.
text: My husband and I have just returned from staying at this hotel for 4nights . We had Wimbledon tickets and theatre tickets so planned a mini London break . When we arrived we were given a room on the ground floor with no outside window just a small one that opened up into a corridor . The room felt like a sauna so we asked to move . We were given a room on the third floor with velux windows . The room was an attic with almost all of the ceiling sloping and with a double bed in there was no room to walk around and my husband who is 6 foot kept banging his head! There was no wardrobe , just a tatty small cupboard so nowhere to put anything . The bed was pushed against the wall so I was forever hitting my head if I moved ! We had to move one at a time in the room and the shower room door didn't open properly as the bed was in the way ! There was no shower curtain so water went everywhere and one didn't appear until the last day despite asking repeatedly. The water pressure was low but the worst thing was you couldn't control the water temperature it was either cold or too hot to use . We kept reporting it but it was not resolved . The mirror was on the back of the ensuite door and as you couldn't open the door properly trying to dry my hair was difficult . We had continental breakfast for two days but couldn't face it for the last two days of our stay. It's the worst continental breakfast I've ever had ! There was limited selection and the bread and scones were not fresh. We didn't try the cooked breakfast so can't comment on that . The decoration in the corridors is tatty and the carpets are threadbare in parts with holes in them so a health hazard . The one plus point of this hotel which is now called The Belvedere is its location. The nearest tube station is Clapham South and the hotel is only a five minute walk away .

title: It's good value for money
text: London hotels at pretty dire at the bottom end. This was better than many. Lots of things you could complain about. However it is very Clean. Freshly painted. Rooms are tiny. However on the value equation for London this is good and worth considering.

title: Average
text: Cheap stay, you get what you pay, but it's clean and perfect for visiting London. We stayed in hotel for 5 nights and we only slept in (we were visiting London during the days). Our room was on the top of hotel so we had to take steps every time which is not a problem unless you're bringing a lot of luggage (steps are really old, small and very narrow, so be careful :). Rooms are small, with own bathroom and they are clean which is the most important for me. Hotel provides you a breakfast but we didn't take it. Overall, this hotel is not the hotel you want to spend your holiday in, but if you're going to visit the London than it's great. Underground station is 2min walk from hotel and it takes you to central London in 10 - 15min!
