Underground station name is Clapham Sout (if anyone wants to check on the map), and it has very good connection to any sights of London!! (you are where you want to be in max. 30min). The area of hotel is quiet, but there are some bars open in the night, Burger King and supermarket are nearby.

title: Much better than expected
text: The Euro Lodge Hotel is quite cheap, but you certainly get value for money. The rooms are very small, and the bathroom is just poky, but everything is clean and the beds are excellent, if a bit narrow. There is no airco, so the temperature can run high, especially when there is a heat wave. The Wifi works very well, but it costs you 4 £ for 24 hours. It can be uses on 3 devices. If you need an adapter to plug in your tablet or smartphone, you can buy one for 5 £ at the reception. Breakfast costs only 5 £, and the buffet is not ample but sufficient. A full English breakfast with sausages and the like costs 7.5 £. The staff is friendly and helpful. Clapham South metro station is only 200 meters away and in a short time you are in the centre of London. Some snack bars and restaurants and only one pub close to the hotel. A good place to stay for just a few days if you don't need much luxury.

title: Is what it is - sometimes less!
text: Mixed stay: Our room, couple, fine. Ok size for one or 2 nights and a nice bed. It’s noisy as London so bring ear plugs. For 75 for 2 people in a decent location like this - reasonable. Didn’t try the breakfast. Be aware it’s a busy noisy hotel and perhaps a ‘hostel’ feel. Receptionist pretty useless on check in. Not great English. Given wrong key to room. My Sisters room. Single bed swingle room. An absolute joke. The room is without doubt the smallest hotel room or indeed bedroom I’ve ever seen. She had to sleep with her bag (small) ON HER BED. No room on the floor. This room surely isn’t legal. The door doesn’t even open fully and a quick escape in an emergency would be difficult. For £62 a complete joke. We’ve tried to find a contact e mail to make a complaint but so far can’t. Have used the hotel and will again as it’s not terrible for the money. But be aware of the room!

title: Journey of London
text: Beautiful things to see in London famous monuments, Like Westminister and Big Ben, London Tower and Tower Bridge, Buckingam Palace ans the changing of the guards, museums free like National History, British Museum, Tate Modern, but too covent garden, borough market and all the parks of London

title: Excellent value for money
text: A late decision to go to london meant that the room was only booked 2 days before arriving and looking for a room of 4 we thought this would be a major problem especially in terms of cost. However a room for 4 people on 4 single beds only resulted in costing £32 each, the beds were comfortable and the shower was excellent and with it being around the croner from where we were heading out it turned out to be an excellent location

title: You get what you pay for!
text: Cheap and cheerful and that is what this hotel is. Well located close to the underground with very helpful staff, the rooms unfortunately are a bit grim. However, for the price paid (47) it was acceptable. Clean but shabby. Well located for restaurants and bars - a great little Italian close to the hotel is well worth a visit.

title: If your looking for a budget hotel with instant underground access, THIS IS IT!
text: The hotel is located just 2 minutes walking distance from the Clapham South station and about 5-7 minutes walking distance from the Clapham Common Station. There are plenty of eating options near the hotel and the location was so convenient. You won't have to go finding the hotel in the nights. The rooms are quite small and the washroom was even smaller. Thats the only bad thing about the hotel, The washroom was so small I could hardly stand and turn, but it was clean to be fair even the rooms were clean. It was very comfortable and for the price you pay it is very very good. Breakfast is very basic,Nothing much just toast with butter and some jam, tea coffee and cereal. Then again, its what you get for the price of the hotel. Wifi is not great in the rooms or it hardly works in the rooms. You have to come to the lobby. There is a TV in the room which helps and some good channels on it as well. The reception staff are quite helpful, The lady even helped me get a cab to the Euston Station at a very reasonable price. Overall the hotel is very good and worth every penny. Better options are obviously more costly,

title: Claustrophobic no windows bug infested hotel
text: DO NOT GO TO THIS HOTEL! Reception staff are very rude and unhelpful. We were given a tiny room with NO WINDOWS TO THE OUTSIDE. The room only just fit a double bed. As soon as we entered the room there were two huge spiders on the bed which I have a phobia about. I also suffer from mild claustrophobia and was distraught at the lack of space and oxygen. The only window provided was facing the corridor and if the curtains were open people passing by would have been able to look in. The corridor smelt mouldy and damp and we were clearly given the worst room in the hotel. To make matters worse a fire alarm went off at 9am in the morning continuously which awoke my partner and I, and when my partner got up to find out what the problem was it was just some steam which had set the alarm off. We paid 75 pounds for a claustrophobic room with no fresh air and bugs inside it. DO NOT GO TO THIS HOTEL IT'S A SCAM!

title: Problem with the heating
text: This hotel is very simply, but functionaly eqiuped. It´s location is also very good. I was very surprised of the cleaness of the room, is was absolutely perfect. The towels very changed every day (I didn´t expect the towels!!). Breakfast was very simple - only toasts with butter and jam or cornflakes. But the problem was the heating - when we came, it wasn´t working, after 3 phone calls to the recpetion someone came!! There is no possibility to change the temperature, it must be done by the employee of the hotel, so we had to call him almost every day, terrible!! The worst thing was the noisy ang lights from the street, I couldn´t sleep!! It is a good hotel near the Clapham South Tube Station for a very good price, but if you can, choose the room with the windows to the other side :-)

title: Very basic and more like a hostel for students
text: Normally stay in central London when we visit for a trip to the theatre but having just returned from an expensive holiday, we chose this budget hotel. Our room was in the attic and absolutely minute. The en-suite was so tiny that it was difficult to dry yourself after having a shower. Lots of back packers staying so breakfast was something to be endured rather than enjoyed. Very basic room with all kinds of odd furniture in it. Very noisy and after helping yourself to Weetabix or cornflakes, you then queued up for your piece of toast. Nothing else on offer. The return tube fare from here was £14.60 so I don't think that we saved very much by being so far out of the city. Not somewhere I would recommend.

title: Nice location
text: Good value for little money. Considering that British hotels are not as good as European hotels, I would still rate the experience at this place okay. The hotel was clean, though somewhat shabby

title: Cheap and grubby but hopefully being updated
text: Myself and 2 friends booked a triple room to attend a hen party in June 2012. I arrived late at night and was told to leave my bag at reception and look at the room in order to ensure it was ok. It wasn't but given that we had no other option, we stayed. Rather than a triple room, it was one single room and one double. I had hoped to enjoy a relaxing evening watching tv, however, I was informed that none of the tvs in the hotel worked! The rooms had mismatched furniture and, although not dirty, seemed grubby. The hotel was in general very run down. Breakfast and the shower were ok. The hotel was in the process of being renovated/painted when we stayed, and this was badly needed. During the day time, the floors were covered in painting sheets, and the flooring beside our room was being taken up and the area had not been cordoned off, which was dangerous. The rate was cheap £150 for 3 people for 2 nights although I still consider it to be excessive, considering the states of the hotel. On a positive note, I slept well in the bed, although it was small and the hotel is a short walk from the tube station.

title: Affordable and comfortable
text: I have stayed a couple of times at this lodge and I can say that the rooms were always clean and tidy. It's surrounded by a couple of decent pubs and cafes and not that far from central London. I would highly recommend this place if you're looking for an affordable and family friendly place to stay in London.

title: Awful customer service
text: Upon walking in and greeting the man at the desk he put his hand up to gesture he was busy and for us not to talk. Shockingly rude. We where then made to pay £10 extra to check into room early, although we where told prior to arrival it was 2pm check in not 3. We where also told there was a car park, but on arrival there was a space that could only fit 2 cars at a push that was being used for building works, so I was lied to on the day before, The man showed no remorse and not even an apology.

title: Great Location but could do better.
text: This is the second time we have stayed at this hotel, both in order to complete the moonwalk that starts on Clapham common.Location wise it is great, Clapham common is on the doorstep and the Northern line into the city is 100 yards away. 20 minutes will get you into the heart of London. You can book into the hotel until 3am, the rooms are clean and have been updated since our last visit,the staff are friendly,and the cost is really reasonable. It doesn't pretend to be a 4 star hotel and the price reflects this, if you want a great location with local bars and restaurants and the lovely common across the road it's perfect. Be prepared for small rooms and don't take a cat,because you wont be able to swing it, but we will be booking next year for another moonwalk nice and early because the rooms go quickly.

title: Average
text: Stayed here for one night, decent enough however I wouldn’t recommend for a long stay. There was some inconsistencies in the rooms, one room didn’t have a lock for the bathroom for example. The shower head couldn’t stand up properly for some reason which made showering a chore. However, it’s in a good location, the staff were nice and it did just fine for us.

title: Get what you pay for, remember you are near central London!
text: We were a group riding in the London to Brighton bike ride and was looking for something essentially cheap and cheerful but could drop the cheerful if required, we did not drop it in this case. I would say we got a result with this hotel, the bike ride starts from opposite the hotel on Clapham Common so great location. The staff on arrival were very friendly and helpful. We were looking at keeping the bikes in the room with us which reception was unsure of but ok'd quite quickly. We did not do this in the end as there is a rear yard which is quite secure with a blanked of steel gate and pedastrian gate with lock. We could keep the bikes undercover here like others had also done. The rooms were clean and had been decorated recently and also had there own shower room which we were not sure they would have. Dont be fooled the room we stayed in was not the largest but perfectly adequate for what we needed over one night. We did not have the breakfast as was out early the next morning. I would suggest the rooms are good for one to two nights stay, at a push possibly three. Remember this is only somewhere to put your head down do not expect anymore and you will not be dissapointed. Staff were very helpful and professional.

title: Humidity and heating
text: The heating does not work and the room smells humidity so be careful and you have to pay for the wifi... the breakfast was good and the location too but , some rooms are not so confortable but the staff tried to hepl us .

title: Completely Average
text: My boyfriend and I stayed after a gig in Brixton. The room was tiny, so much that you couldn't fully open the bathroom door or walk around the bed. The room and bathroom were clean but paint was gone in places, holes in the floor and screws missing. Fine for a one night extremely quick stay, wouldn't recommend for any longer than that.

title: Worst sleep ever
text: We booked a double room for one night as the location is very handy. I do not expect luxury for the price in london, a small clean double room with walls thicker than a postage stamp would be adequate. However, a double room does not mean a double bed at the Euro Lodge it apparently means a small queen size bed which for my boyfriend and I means a very uncomfortable sleep as we are both quite tall. The room seemed clean enough. Our 'double' room provided 1 towel and 1 cup for tea/coffee and a bedside lamp that didn't work. If I book a double room I expect a double bed (even 2 singles together would be ok) I did not expect a queen size bed in a room that feels like a curtain has been drawn between you and the people sleeping next door. Our room was exceptionally noisy especially from around 5.30am onwards so I would advise that if your not the type of person who can sleep through a passing freight train then pack good quality ear plugs and if your sharing the queen size 'double' be sure to practice your sleeping in a coffin position to ensure a few hours kip. The worst part of the experience was the fan from the room next door which was left on throughout the night, the walls are PAPER THIN, getting into bed we could clearly make out what they were watching on the tv next door and then the constant vibration/loud hum of the fan on ALL night kept me awake. It was far more intrusive than the traffic outside which I did expect in a location like this. Very, very relieved this was a one night only stay!! The 3pm check in is also quite an awkward time, we sat in the park for a few hours and put 2 of our largest bags behind the desk at £2 a bag. I also think the fact you are unable to make any adjustments to your booking or seek any refund even weeks in advance is very very poor. I am not a fussy customer I have travelled all over the world and sadly I can honestly say this is definitely the most uncomfortable stay i've had in the UK. When I approached the reception staff about the problems I was met with complete disinterest, flatly told that it was standard whilst they literally looked away from me and out the window clearly not interested in continuing the conversation or offering any solutions. I would never EVER stay here again. Just because London is an expensive city does not mean that consumers should just accept what they are given if it is not to a certain standard. I suspect the hotel owner keeps his/her distance from the place whilst making a tidy profit but leaves, I can only assume, very low paid staff to 'handle' constant complaints by way of fobbing off and offering weak apologies without a sniff of a refund or discount in sight!!

title: Brilliant value for money
text: I was originally booked in the Euro Hotel Clapham which is next door. Upon arrival, I was told that my booking for me and my friend had been made at their sister hotel instead. Had to wait til 3pm to check in, slow to check in, but went smoothly. We were then shown to our rooms which was actually outside the reception, turn right into a street and into what seems to have formally been a block of flats and our rooms were there - bit strange. The rooms were very basic, but clean. TVs have not been changed to Freeview yet and they are still relying on the analogue signal. The hotel is on the main Clapham Road, so it can be quite noisy in the room. Tesco, Sainsburys and various take aways are close by. Clapham South underground station is about 3-4 minute walk. Breakfast is in the main building - again basic - cereal, toast, tea and coffee - but for £44 a night, you can't really complain! Another friend of mine checked in on the second night and his room was in the main building - it was like a suite compared to my room, so if you want a bit more 'luxury' it might be worth asking to be put in the main building instead of the outer building. Overall - if you are looking for a no frills hotel that is clean and good value for money, stay here!

title: Avoid at all costs!!
text: We booked this hotel in February for our young daughter who was travelling alone to stay for 4 nights. We chose this hotel because of the reasonable price and the location. We weren't expecting luxury by any stretch of the imagination, what we were expecting was it to be clean. When she arrived the first evening, her room was in an annexe and was absolutely filthy, hairs everywhere etc. She asked if any other rooms were available to be told there weren't. She had no choice but to stay there that evening. She slept in her coat on top of the bed due to the terrible condition of the room. She also did not feel safe as the main door to the annexe was left open all night. She checked out at 7.30 the following morning after being informed again that no other rooms were available. She was informed that they would have to charge her for 2 nights accomodation. As we had already paid for 4 nights we have been trying to get a refund for the further 2 nights ever since. Despite sending letters, several emails and telephone conversations with the management where a refund was promised, it has not materialised. It made it a very expensive stay as we had to quickly find her alternative accomodation at very short notice. Please do not book this hotel if you expect a basic level of cleanliness and customer service, it could turn out to be very expensive if our daughter's experience is anything to go by.

title: Horrific people.
text: After 30 hours on a plane we arrived at faulty towers, the home of bad customer service and an staff with an angry attitude. Not to go in to too much detail, the staff were incompetent and unbelievably rude. They did nothing to help us in our attempt to check in early. Although the room was clean and the location of the hotel was great. Please do not stay there.

title: Dont go !!!
text: Went to this Hotel this week never again Place looks ok from outside Inside needs a complete face lift very rundown , work done in rooms DIY !!!! Mould in shower , noise from pump feeding taps or flush of toilets !!! Room very small ,bed right next to radiator Pay abit extra in future and go to Travelodge

title: Smelly
text: Staff wasn't helpfully at all, when I booked the room I asked if for car parking they told me yes that's fine then when I got there no car park available so then it cost me 20 pound to park some where else, room was dirty and smelly couldn't stop itching couldn't wait to leave hotel next day

title: Dirty. Rude. Noisy.
text: Staff are rude. During check in they talked amongst themselves in a different language and acted like we were intruding on their social time. Room was filthy and tiny. Disgusting actually. There was so much noise in the morning we left by 8.30am as there was no point in staying in such a tiny, dirty room with so much noise. We complained on check out and the receptionist shrugged her shoulders and said it was beyond her control. Totally awful. Don’t waste your money. It looks cheap but it’s not worth the horror!

title: Value for money!
text: Will be staying again in June, family living in Clapham so very convenient. No bells or whistles, just a place to sleep. Was lucky I got a double bed in my room and bathroom and shower were clean and perfectly adequate. What more could you want!? Asked for room at back and got one so it was nice and quiet. However, at 4am someone started walking around their bedroom on floor above in high heels for over an hour it seemed, and could not get back to sleep.......not the hotel's fault of course. Missed breakfast as it finishes at 9.30am but got sandwich in Tesco down the street, so not a problem. Prefer to get value and a reasonably priced clean room rather than pay for luxury and spend the difference on a nice meal, plenty of restaurants around! Receptionists very helpful and friendly.

title: Great hotel and price
text: Good location and room it was a single room and was comfortable and the staff very helpful and professional. Cheap price too I would go again, the view is excellent of Clapham Common, near some good restaurants and placing of transport connections.

title: Very good location at a very good price !
text: The hotel's location is very good, nearby Clapham South station (zone 2), 20 minutes from the center or St Pancras. The room was clean, small but it was enough if you just stay at the hotel to sleep. Breakfast was simple (toast, butter, jelly, coffee, tea, apple or orange juice) but it was enough to start the day (they said 10am but at 9.30am they start closing). We arrived at 9am but we have been able to leave our luggage in a luggage room (locked and surveillance camera), on the day of our departure we also have been able to leave our luggage in the morning and come back later, as our train was at 20pm. The neighbourhood is nice, very nice pizzeria nearby the hotel, and Clapham Common just across the road. I would recommend the hotel to anyone looking for a cheap stay with a good location, and the service was also very good.

title: Old hotel in need of renovation but clean & good location
text: I wasn't expecting anything fancy when we came to stay here as I read the reviews 1st, all I wanted was a clean place to crash after a hard day sightseeing and that's what it accomplished. Its true that the hotel could use a good paint job inside and a bit of renovation. The rooms are small, and some of the bathrooms are smaller than others 'some being super small', but it wasn't dirty. The beds were comfortable and we slept ok, better than I have in some 'higher end Hotels' The Breakfast was simple but it did its job, ill not sing songs about it or be inspired to write an opera The location was very good, a tube station just up the road and from there is was a 10 min ride anywhere So in Conclusion

title: has potential
text: Nice hotel, nice location and perfect transport facilities (underground, bus). The hotel has a beautifull yard in front, well maintained. The hotel is also nice architecture and pleasant interior. Only the rooms are too small for modern travellers

title: Awful hotel, never again
text: The most uncomfortable bed I have EVER tried to sleep in, disgraceful plus when I went to get something done guess what, no one around. But that's not all, after returning to my room having been out all day I found my door actually physically open, yes actually ajar!! I have no idea how my laptop and other stuff was still in there. Appalling place.

title: Don't expect too much.
text: Room: I got a single room. As small as a prison cell. Good enough to sleep and shower. The length of the room is long enough to fit a single bed. The stand-in shower is big enough for you to fit you inside with your arms crossed. No central heating. Food: The basics. Bread and butter, Creal, Tea/Coffee/Milk/Juice, Plain flapjacks... You need to pay for the Cheese. Wifi: Only has free Wifi in the common area (Hotel lobby and Canteen) Proximity: Tesco nearby and within 5mins walk from the Tube. 30mins journey to city centre via tube. 45mins to 1 hour train ride from airport with transfers during lunch time. Overall: This is the cheapest hotel you can find nearest to the city especially when it comes with the convenience of having your own bathroom.

title: Muy buena elección y recomendable
text: Room without closet Beds something uncomfortable, the springs are noticeable room with enough space for a room where you can spend the night and verte clean the hotel staff was very correct, pleasant and at all times happy to help and make us feel at home. We will definitely return in case of returning to London

title: Basic, no frills accommodation at a fair price when not at peak nights.
text: Basic, no frills accommodation at a fair price when not at peak nights. Would be nice if heating in rooms had a thermostate so can control temperature. Room was boiling with only open window to vary temperature. Also the tv reception is awful and very annoying

title: Nice hotel, good breakfast, just noisy having a room in front of the hotel, ground floor
text: Friendly staff, enjoy the hotel except this time stayed in room 911 bottom floor, on main road side. It was very noisy. Very central and right by the underground. It is very close to all amnesties. Has a 24 hour friendly reception

title: If your room starts with L it means LEAVE!
text: The hotel is very dirty all over, the room (number L13) we were given was miserable, shower head was broken, there was a terrible and unbearable smell coming from the toilet, and when we notified the staff we were told to open the window (which wasn't helpful at all). The tv signal was very poor and no mobile network either. The free wifi didn't reach our room and it worked very poorly even at the reception. There was mould all over the bathroom (check the pictures). We asked to change room, but as I had already taken a shower, we were told "you can't change rooms since you've already used the facilities". We were given a different room the next morning, which was much better, it felt like a different place, much cleaner but the bed wasn't a double, it was more like a slightly larger than average single bed (check pictures). The thing that annoys me the most is that they advertise their room on websites such as laterooms.com and booking.com where it makes you believe you're saving 70% off the normal price while it is very clear as soon as you step in that it is just a cheap, dirty hotel.

title: Single traveller
text: I's good value for money!!! + location (located between two subway stations (2 Zone - 11 min and 3 Zone 2 min) & 30 min to train station) + service (they have microwave & fridge) + price per night - it's great - service (NOT bad, but they didn't make documents for TAX FREE) - breakfast (2 toasts, tea, cornflakes, jam, butter, juice, milk - that's all ) - too thin walls (you heard everything in nearby room) - cleaning once a week

title: Lost property
text: Me and my girlfriend have just stopped at the hotel and found many things wrong firstly our radiator was broke and couldnt turn the heat down so was like sleeping in a sauna and we had to prop the window open ourselves to try cool the window down. Also the shower had a leak at the top and seemed to only do rather hot water, in the room we had 2 lights 1 either side of the bed which didnt even have any bulbs in. We was out the room most the time in london and when we got back twice our key wouldnt work and had to go reception just to get it fixed and then finally when coming to leave the place we packed all of our things to notice 1 of our bags was missing with a gift for my little sister we got from winter wonderland we looked everywhere but could not find it when we checked out we informed them at the desk to a responce ahh the cleaners may have thrown it away we can take your number if we find it. We had no apology and neer offered to pay us for how much the gift was but then charged us 6 pound to leave our bags their for 3 hours while we waited for our coach so overall we wasnt happy with how it all went.

title: Claustrophobia
text: My colleague and I laughed when we swung open the door to the first room. There wasn't much room to swing it, mind you. Both our rooms were boxes, which included dubious, indelible stains. Not one for complaining (I swear!) but I'd only consider this hotel if you get rooms for very cheap.Having stayed in a similarly priced place in a similar London location, Euro Lodge was far inferior in terms of comfort. The staff and cleaners were fine (despite the inconsistency of complimentary bathroom sachets) but this claustrophobic hotel is too poor to recommend. At least you have the lovely Clapham Common to escape to, as you'd want to spend as little time as possible in the room itself. Also, paying an additional £4 for WiFi each day is a joke in this day and age.

title: Good Hotel
text: My wife and myself stayed here for a gig at the Academy in Brixton. The hotel is 5 minutes walk from Clapham South tube station. The hotel was very clean and very reasonably priced especially for London. Check in was easy and the staff were very polite. The room was very clean though a tad on the same side but as we didnt spend much time there it wasn't a problem. I would recommend this hotel as it's close to public transport and reasonably priced.

title: Simply Give this hotel a miss if you know what is good for you.
text: Our flight landed on time, we were both exhausted from our long flight, loss of sleep overnight, upon our arrival at the hotel about 1130 am, we were not allowed to check in even though the room was ready but to come back at 1500 pm, what are we going to do for the next 3 and a half hours in busy London? A well thumb down! We had to forked out extra on the tube fares to get somewhere just to while away our time. We were both fed up at this point. A supposedly double room we booked had only one light in it, and one in the toilet and hardly enough room to swing a cat. There is no wardrobe not even a sign of coat hanger we had to make do with placing our clothes on the luggage. The underground runs directly under the hotel and you can hear it so clearly at regular intervals. There are so many partitioned doors along the hallway and can easily create a major health hazard if a fire breaks out, there is no chance anyone would get out of the building alive! Dont expect anything grand for breakfast either, only bread and coffee available. If you are a meat lover then book elsewhere. Not again will I recommend this hotel to anyone, it is a right tip, for an extra 20 pounds a night get somewhere to stay like the Thistle or Best Western, you wil get a better sleep and be in a better mood for your morning after.

title: ok
text: all you need for a cheap stay in london. a bed and a shower. zone 2 on the northern line. i'll mention that at 9:30 sharp they start clearing the breakfast. at 9:31 you cant find anything anymore. i think its rude and unprofessional.

title: Brilliant value for money...!
text: All the reviews on here are wrong. If you're looking for a cheap place to stay this place is excellent. We paid £49 for a triple room for a night & can't fault it. It's not luxury, but go pay real London hotel prices if that's what you expect. The night staff are lovely & even shared their take-away with us. The breakfast is ideal, nothing special but also very good for the price. The location is amazing, about 3 minutes from Clapham South. Would definitely return!

title: Would have been happy if I was backpacking in Senegal and paying £3/ night!!
text: Queued for ages to check in in the heat. Shown to tiny twin room out the back across the service courtyard with laundry, bins to what looked like the staff quarters! TINY room- carpet all rucked up. Lime green walls. Mouldy walls. MAJOR and prob but when I told girl on checkout she just said "oh". No shower curtain and shower didn't drain properly so ended up sliding around in shower tray (dangerous)- shower head broken anyway do not so much shower as torrent of water. No window in room!!! So hot and stuffy. Lots things broken or needing TLC. Hair in bed. Loo room poky and musty. Towels graying. Breakfast- not worth bothering!! Check in staff friendly though. And handy to tube stn.

title: Good location - Small rooms - Noisy - Awful Breakfast
text: An excellent location about three minutes walk from Clapham South Underground (Northern Line) Rooms small - and a bit shabby (although bed and bathroom clean) Right by a major road junction - So lots of noise (bring ear plugs) Dont do the Breakfast - £3.50 for Continental ... Machine Coffee, Powder made (dilute) Juice and two slices of toast - RIP OFF !! (Costa Coffee is up the road !)

title: Good value for money
text: Good value budget hotel – would use again. Convenient to underground station & bus route. Helpful staff on Reception & in breakfast area. Problem with bedside light on arrival, but immediately rectified by staff. Hairdryer didn't work, but immediately replaced with one that did work. Excellent shower. Good facilities & breakfast better than we expected – self-service buffet of cereals, toast, cold & hot drinks. Disturbed nights' sleep because of pedestrian traffic past our room with associated loud conversations in the early hours of the morning.

title: Good for a short stay 👍🏻
text: Stayed here for 1 night whilst me and my girlfriend spent a couple of days in London A friendly welcome, and a nice clean room just the right size for the two of us. Good shower 🚿 and TV 📺 made the room perfect for what we needed and at an affordable price compared to London hotels! Do not be out off by the negative reviews 😎

title: Average
text: Exterior wonderful. On arrival not very pleasant welcome. Rude to honest. We had the "Deluxe" room. Oh well! Stayed here as going to the Rock festival. I wouldn't stay again. The deeper you go in the place the worse it gets. No bar, one coffee sachet and two tea bags. Poor show really. The bed was clean and comfortable. So grateful for that.

title: Tiny Rooms,
text: Cost £45 pounds for a night so i cannot complain about the price or location but i think everything else with regards to the room was terrible. Room was tiny it could only fit a Double bed and a small table. We had to run the water for 10 minute before we got any hot water. Vending machine took my money. Staff barely spoke english. I though i had miss placed something and the receptionist was just rude when i inquired about it. There was allot of fungus in the bath room. I could have accepted all the above but the bed, it was one of the worst night sleep i had, it was as though i was sleep on a wooden plank, and all the springs in the matters were poking me.

title: Unacceptable
text: We booked in to have a rest before we travel out of London. We usually book there and never had problems before. But this time we were shocked when someone knocked on our door twice before trying to open it even we said "hang on". Me and partner were lying half naked in bed as the room had only 1 fan and no air conditioning. We were really angry at that point. I opened the door to find a gentleman (I believe to be the manager ) asking me to come in with some builders to check the bathroom. Unacceptable! We only checked in around 13:30, the hotel should have organised this better and the gentleman did not even apologised for trying to open our door. We never had any issues with the lodge before its appalling how our privacy was about to be breached by someone. It's totally unacceptable and I hope the management from The Euro Lodge Clapham will get back to me to compensate for this issue Asap before I decide to take any further action. Thank you.

title: Staff didn't know what they were doing
text: The place was so poorly managed that it was ridiculous! The receptionist first took us to the wrong room, which was in a very dodgy looking alley behind the hotel and we had to get help from a maid to find the right room since the room numbers made no sense at all. They didn't keep track on who was staying in which room and it was waaaay to easy to get a key to a room without even giving your name! The breakfast included white toast, cereal and instant coffee, nothing to cheer about. The staff was just very confused about everything and didn't seem to know what they were doing. To be fair, the rooms seemed clean and we slept well, apart from the noise coming from the hallway, ever heard of sound isolation?? We heard that our friends staying in other rooms had problems with the rooms and showers not working. So if possible, choose another hotel.

title: terror...go away fast....horror hotel
text: the hotel of horror...never again... owfull... dirty.. breakfast just 2 pieces of bread without cheese or bacon jambon .hot water named coffee.. experience very very bad...go away now
subratings_json: {"business service (e.g., internet access)": 1.0, "cleanliness": 1.0, "value": 1.0, "service": 1.0, "location": 1.0, "rooms": 1.0, "check in / front desk": 1.0}

title: Not bad and quite cheap
text: Stayed for one night with a friend. Paid £69 which isn't bad in Clapham. Continental bfast £3.50 and Full English £5.00. Room very basic, clean. Friendly staff. Tesco 5min walking, tube nearby. If you looking for cheap hotel and you're not fussy this hotel will be good for you.

title: Very grotty
text: Grim. Carpets hadn't been vacuumed in years, stains on the ceiling, just very, very unpleasant.

title: good value for the money
text: I stayed here 6 nights with my boyfriend. When we got to our room first night, we realized that there is water leaking from the ceiling, so we were moved to another room by a very kind and helpful receptionist. This room looked rather worse, smaller and with bathroom shared with another room. But this was OK, since in the other room was no one. In the morning we were told that they will try to fix the leakage and move us to our original room, which we liked. This room is located in the top floor, which is quite inconvinient when you have to carry your suitcases, but we managed it. There was nice and clean bathroom, TV, dressing table and 3 mirrors. The bed was allright, but squeaky. The linen looked new and clean. Its close proximity to underground station is very convenient, as is the nearby Tesco and Sainsbury´s (open 7-23) and other shops. The staff were all very helpful and nice. The breakfast - you can serve yourself with toasts (with marmalade and/or butter), several kinds of cereals, milk, orange juice, tea, coffee. I think it´s good value for the money you pay.

title: Egads!!!!!!
text: Recently stayed at the Euro Lodge in Clapham Commons. A lovely little town, but the same cannot be said for the lodge. My companion, (responsible for the arrangements) met me at the lodge and we checked in only to find out that they had given us the topmost room, 4th floor no lift, and we each had a heavy bag. The room had a kitchen, sleeping area consisting of 3 twin beds, and a bathroom. There was no hot water for baths, the television did not work, which, according to the staff, service was not hooked up yet (right!), nor did we have phone service, although the room did have a telephone. The carpet was old and in the worst shape, sticky and smelled as did the room itself. The linens (and I am being kind describing them as such) were thin and old as were the mattresses. Although we asked for a better room, they offered us a room separate from the lodge, out the back next to a condo parking area, which we chose to pass on. I tried to convince my companion that we should try to find better accommodations, but she risked losing her money, since the room had been paid for prior to our arrival. It is clear that any money made has not been re-invested in the upkeep and maintenance of this lodge. And I haven't even mentioned the "staff.''

title: TINY ROOMS
text: This location is EVERYTHING! However, the rooms are absolutely tiny. Double bed was somewhat comfy, but there wasn't room to walk around the bed, or room for a chair or anything. The door to the bathroom had difficulty opening because there wasn't enough space. If you literally just want to crash into a bed and that's it - then this place is perfect. Also, unfortunately the internet wasn't working for the entirety of my stay.

title: Awful
text: We booked our room a while ago and requested a nice room as it was for my 21st birthday, however I feel we were given one of the worst! It was big enough for a double bed to fit with barely any room to move around, our only window faced a road so we could hear the traffic all night, there was a door in the room that looked as if it went to the roof letting lots of light in and was stuffed with tissue to stop the draft, there was mould growing in one of the corners of the ceiling and the bathroom again was tiny with no bath. Will definitely never be going there again, worst part of the weekend. We were room 241.

title: Great value for money
text: We went up for a Friend's leaving do, which was in Tooting (under 10mins on the tube). Great location on Clapham Common & lots of bars and restaurants close. Our rooms slept 3 each and were really warm cosy. The rooms were really clean and to be honest after reading a few reviews, which all slated the hotel by the way, I was pleasantly surprised. We really enjoyed our stay, it was perfect for what we wanted.

title: Hotel very cheap and nice place.
text: I like this hotel because is very cheap, my room was very clean and confortable and the staff were very kind but they didn't speak spanish :( The breakfast was good and complete, (coffee, tea, cereals, toasts..) The place was very beautiful had a park very big in front, pubs, shops, fast food (pizza, chinese food...). I don't understand like the people talk so bad about this hotel, I stayed 4 days and everything was perfect. The only thing that I didn't like was the far away that I were to the city center but the subway stop was near. Finally, I will repeat in this hotel.

title: Great location and very comfortable.
text: We stayed here when sightseeing in London. Great value for money. The lodge is close to all amenities and the Underground. The common is just across the road too. Rooms are comfortable and safe, we had two triple rooms. There is seating outside and inside which allowed us to bring our own fish and chips back. Check out was 11am which was a bonus as it is usual 10am. We didn't have breakfast but it was offered to us for £7. We grabbed breakfast from Tesco/Sainsburys, just 5 minutes up the road. We will stay here again.

title: Good budget lodgings
text: I have been at the Eurolodge for almost 2 weeks and it has served me well. I have been in a single room, which is admittedly small, but ensuite and has a large flat screen TV. The room was on the top floor (there are no lifts!) so nice and quiet. There are no bar/restaurant facilities if that is important to you, but very close to lots of decent bars and restaurants. I'm heading back there in a few days, so that is a good endorsement!

title: Poor customer service
text: 2 of us booked 1 night at Euro Lodge because we had a gig at Brixton Academy. Upon arrival the outside looked well presented and quite nice. However, the same couldn't be said on the inside. We walked in to find a woman talking away on the phone and an awfully grumpy, straight faced man finish serving somebody before he just wandered off. That left a queue of us waiting to be checked in by one woman who then answered the phone and ignored us for about 10 minutes. After finally hanging up we were in the process of checking in and she asked me had 'somebody has already checked in under this name', like I'd know anything about that anyway. Then she picked up the phone when it rang and ignored us for another few minutes. You couldn't make it up. As we both stood speechless she eventually shuffled some paper work around and eventually gave us a key to our room. Not sure what went on there! Anyway we went upstairs to quickly throw our bags down as we were heading off out again. First impressions the room was tiny, the tv wouldn't work unless you bought a remote, the bed was basic but comfortable enough. Though it was a slight relief after reading some of the review on here about the awful rooms, so we were lucky. You couldn't open the bathroom door fully because the bed was in the way. If you were quite overweight you'd struggle squeezing through the tiny gap. Our shower was also bust because it stayed at 1 temperature which unfortunately extremely hot. The sound proofing on the walls was awful but luckily it wasn't that bad regarding noisy guests. We didn't even want to bother with breakfast. Overall, for the price you can't really argue. The staff were rude, miserable and obviously hated what they do.

title: Great value. Great stay.
text: Was a great stay. Location is very good to get around. Be sure to check out the park and food offered there. The best was what looked to be a temporary caravan with tent but it is permanent and great!

title: Worst ever
text: We arrive in London late in evening and going to the hotel reception there were a guy who told us that the hotel was overbooked and closed us the door at face with no excuse.When i asked for explanations he told me that that he couldnt do anything about that.After two hours staying in the Reception and trying to find somewhere to stay one of the receptionist find us a room in Anerley too far away so we take it in order not to sleep outside.something is realy wrong with that hotel because there were a lot of people that night there with the same probem.I would never come back there.

title: dirty and internet almost never working
text: Dirty room and bath room Internet never be working in room . Aslo most of time it's not workign for internet even in the reception room

title: Really really really bad staff
text: I travel a lot and I never been in a hotel where the staff was so rude. The rooms are claustrophobic,we had problems with toilet and sink, wifi is not free as they say, it s possible to use it only in the entrance. The customer service is really poor. The staff is really really really rude.

title: Bed bugs
text: This place is riddled with bed bugs that ate me alive whilst I was staying here for a business trip ended up getting confirmation via email confirming my above situation from the receptionist saying saying my room was covered in them and ended up getting my hotel room rate back so do yourselves a favour and don't go there

title: BED BUGS! STAY AWAY!
text: I have stayed in many hotels around the world and never before have I had such and awful experience. We stayed for 3 nights and my partner and I came back home with bed bug bites. This place needs to be closed and give damages to people for getting back to normal!!!

title: euro lodge clapham
text: Quality hotel. Very good value for money. Very impressed with the irnately folded towel on the bed. Very artistic. Great facilities. Very luxurious hotel for the price. The staff was very helpful and friendly.

title: IT was Oke
text: Prise/quality was Oke Breakfast not expensive. Good food for only 5 £. One day we odered englisch breakfast: than you pay 2,5 £ more. The room neads a upgrade, but was clean. The bathroom was a bit small. We missed a lamp to read in bed.

title: A mixed journey
text: During our journey, we have found a weird personal. We have to pay directly and we cannot decide the day but they had the credit card number for any problem . Then, after our last night, we have been pressed to leave the room at 11.03am and threatened with a charge while we were leaving the room. Finally, we found a serious lack of smile and welcome sense. The other things we want to point are the wifi. It is really expensive just for this time. And we have been awacked by workers just in front of our window at 8am.,

title: Nice little room, OK place
text: I was a bit worried about staying here as I had read some awful reviews about it however I enjoyed my stay. It was really close to Clapham South tube (although I went the wrong way to begin with so had a long walk). Right near a huge tesco as well. My room was really nice. I arrived about 45 minutes before check in and the lovely man on reception let me check in early. He was really friendly. A nice lady took me too my room as well to help me find it. My room was a outside room and you had to walk past the building work going on but once in the room it was lovely. It was really small but cosy. The bed was so comfy aswell. Room was clean and the bathroom was nice. It was very small though. The toilet flush often made a noise for a while after being flushed but it wasn't too bad. I would stay here again.

title: The strand appartments London
text: Great location in central London. Really close to Covent garden and many different shops and places to get food. The appartments are really close to the theatres so if your going to London for that then I recommend them. The rooms are really spacious and the beds and kitchenette are lovely. The appartments aren’t to pricey but it’s worth it for the great location. Despite not having any good views, as it is a inner city building, it is in a good spot and close to major tourist landmarks in London. The rooms are really simple but effective and the bathroom is heated with is great for London in the winter. Can’t wait to come back on my next visit to London. Highly recommend!

title: Beautiful apartments
text: Stunning apartments close to all amenities and Covent Garden. Very clean and high tech. Superb views from Windows. Good places to eat nearby. Staff very helpful and looked after our bags next morning while we went shopping.

title: Apple apartments strand like a rotten apple tossed in a bin
text: I have nothing good to say about our booking for this apartment . We arrived litter in bags and in bins,dirty bed, dirty towels in bathroom, dirty kitchen, toilet and sink. We managed to get our money back however we lost most of our Friday evening sorting it out and for sometime thought we were going to be without accommodation. Thankfully we had booked through booking.com and they stepped in to help us and found alternate accommodation in a hotel close by. If I could give this place a minus score I would and would not recommend it to anyone. It is in effect a private apartment and not part of a group of apartments in this property and no one onsite that represents Apple despite what it says in the not helpful folder in the accommodation. We were on hold for over twenty minutes on two occasions before we got through to someone and then had to chase them to get anywhere when we then went to booking.com. This was a special weekend for my wife’s birthday which clearly started with a very stressful situation

title: Exercise care when booking this apartment
text: I will start with the good bits. Great location, reception staff (although not from Apple Apartments) were fantastic and the room was Okay albeit with too much technology. Now to the problem parts. The published inclusions and service were all but non existent. We had received an email from Apple three days before we were due to check in and asked when we would be arriving and the names of the people staying in the apartment. When we arrived the reception staff (remember they do not work for Apple) gave the apartment number and advised us to go straight there. We found the apartment which was not locked and found the key on the table. No instructions, no welcome in fact no contact at all. We tried the “emergency” number provided and it just rang off. Tried a gain and same result. Rang the corporate number mentioned in the earlier email with the operator saying that what we experienced on entering the apartment was normal!!!!! We read what little information there was in the booklet in the room and it referred to the representative in apartment 8. No such apartment in the building. The promised toiletries and towels comprised of a small container of body wash, equally small shampoo, a tiny bar of soap, a roll of toilet paper, two hand towels and two average sized bath towels. This was supposed to last us for 5 days - are they kidding!!!!! In the kitchen there was a dishwasher but no dishwasher detergent. Also no dish cloth or tea towel. Overall cleanliness was poor especially the kitchen and bathroom. Could not improve the state of cleanliness as there was no broom of any kind. Two small rubbish containers were provided however these soon filled up and we resorted to shopping bags. Unfortunately we had no way of disposing of the accumulated rubbish so we had to leave it there. When we booked the apartment through Hotels.com it clearly listed that there was luggage storage available, which was important to us as we had a late flight out of London. We soon found out that luggage storage was not available even though the listing on Hotels.com still had that facility listed as being available. We rang the corporate number again and advised them of our problem and the operator said she would try and arrange a late check out for us. She promised to ring us back the next day but we had to chase them up and fortunately we were able to extend our checkout by 3 hours. It was a help but not the same flexibility as having a luggage storage option. Overall what should have been an enjoyable hassle free stay in London was marred but the total lack of service from Apple Apartments and the poor state of the apartment. For the price of the apartment we expected much much more and we don’t believe we are being unreasonable. We could have stayed in a 4 star hotel close to the Strand for the same price including breakfast for two. Our best advice is to avoid booking any apartment from Apple Apartments.

title: Modern
text: Great location stayed in a one bedroom and had discount using apple membership . Clean room and great shower. Bed was soft like a cloud. Parking clearly over priced for 5 nights but in saying that i knew my car was safe and it is tje city... The gentlemen at the front desk were so helpful kind and freindly. Had all the facilities including kitchenette. Its a clever set up and design. Just couldnt get bathroom tv to work but wasn't a necessity. Great stay.

title: Great location in small modern and quiet apartments
text: The location on The Strand is great for tourists. It is a 5 minute walk to Covent Garden, a 2-15 minute walk to various West End Theaters, a 5 minute walk to the Royal Opera House and a less than 20 minute walk to St Paul's Cathedral, the British Museum, Leicester Square, etc. There is a Tesco Express for basic groceries as well as a Boots Pharmacy both a 2 minute walk from the front door. The apartments are also incredibly quiet with little traffic noise. The 24 hour concierge staffed front desk is a real bonus and the staff is very friendly and helpful. The4 apartments are also very modern with all the necessary kitchen appliances. On the negative side the 1 bedroom apartment is quite small particularly the bedroom and the bed itself. The lighting and electric system are very difficult to figure out. To save you some time here is a quick guide. Once you make sure all the lighting is on at the main IPAD control, each room has its own keypad to turn the lights on and off. To turn on all the ceiling lights in a given room press the top button on both the left and right rows. To turn off the ceiling lights in each rom press the bottom button on both the left and right rows. An exception is the keypad near the front door. Pressing the bottom buttons on the left and right rows turns off all the ceiling lights in the apartment so only press the bottom left row button to turn off the ceiling lights in the front hall. None of the buttons are marked and this system is not intuitive. Operation of the combined microwave oven is anything but intuitive. Either check the brochure or have a concierge come up and demonstrate how the kitchen appliances work. Due to the convenience of the location and the benefits of having a kitchen I would return to the Strand Apartments.

title: Beware
text: Apple Apartments Ltd, who were trading as Apple Apartments went into voluntary liquidation in June 2016. I have been in contact with Bailey Ahmad Limited (the appointed liquidators) on behalf of a friend who paid for an apartment which Apple Apartments cancelled at the last minute.

title: Never again
text: Had an absolutely horrendous time with a late cancellation to the room and the subsequent dealings with the management trying to get a refund. Everything looked rosy right up until the last minute then was treated with an absolute lack of compassion or respect .. NEVER AGAIN!

title: London stopover
text: Where do I start Tiny apartment no room to even open a suitcase. 1 door Key so very inconvenient if 2 or more are staying. Reception:concierge say they are nothing to do with Apple apartments so will offer no service other than pressing button to open main door. Worst no mattress protector on the terrible mattress. I heave never experienced a poorer quality mattress. Unable to open bedroom cupboards as no space. We booked several months in advance. We confirmed bookings in the days prior to arriving. Booked extra fold up bed for 2 families and bigger apartments but when we arrived no bed, no linen, no towels. Promised bed and linen and spare keys would be provided following contact with service department but bed did not arrive and no extra linen for one apartment. No spare keys ever arrived. No call back from service provider. What about the towels. I have had bigger hand towels than the bath towels provided. Coffee machine was full of used pods and old coffee dregs Good points Location very convenient for Covent Garden Aircon works well. My advice. Much better value can be found elsewhere.

title: Just perfect in every way.
text: Upon arrival, you are greeted with a huge and a beautiful reception/concierge space. Check in is with the concierge staff, which were Nour and Albertino. Lovely guys! After I had arrived in my allocated apartment, I was truly overwhelmed by the super futuristic living

title: Weekend in london
text: Great apartments on the strand 2 bedrooms 2 bathrooms all mod cons easy access to the tubes and some theatres with plenty of shops not far from Covent Garden plenty of eating places only problem we checked out at 10 are train was at 5 but they couldn't store are bags so had to pay to leave them at another hotel

title: Trendy apartment - very high tech
text: Would have given this apartment 5* if it wasn't for the high tech gadgets for working lights etc. Only stayed one night so didn't bother asking how to get the tv on in the shower and couldn't switch off the some lights in the lounge area. My husband found the bed too soft for him but it was fine for me. If you like ultra modern fixtures and fittings then you will love it. It was pretty spacious compared to other places we have stayed in London. There's a proper hairdryer in the wardrobe plus iron and ironing board. In the kitchen there's washer/dryer, dishwasher, small oven and large fridge freezer. They are all top makes (miele/smeg) and there's also a Nespresso machine but couldn't find any coffee pods for it. It's home from home basically so you can enjoy your stay and self cater if you wish. Good location too for theatres. The reception staff were very nice and helpful too. It was very clean as well.

title: Honeymoon
text: My wife and I stayed at Apple Apartments, The Strand during half term holidays. The room was fantastic, in particular the air conditioning, which was a god send! The bathroom was lovely and the t.v in the shower was a very nice extra. The room was very clean and there was plenty of room to move around. The reception staff were very friendly and extremely helpful and we are planning our next stay as we speak.

title: Perfect for a short break with the family
text: Because of the central location as well as the modern and spacious apartments, this offer is recommended for a short holiday with family or friends. The price is not cheap, but for the performance absolutely corresponding.

title: The best hotel apartment in London
text: we stayed at the apartment for 5 nights and we can only describe the hotel in one word - perfect! we took 2 bedroom apartment and the bedrooms were big with space. in each bedroom we had huge closet to store our clothes. At the apartment we had washing machine, fully equipped kitchen (with the best electric refrigerator, indication gas, oven, microwave - all of that is Miele company). At the bathrooms we had heated floor, beautiful and comfortable). At the living room we had flat TV. The thing that helped us the most was a mobile phone they gave us which included internet, Google maps and an option to make international calls - all free and with no charge. really amazing and very helpful. The concierge was amazing and helped us with every question we had. The apartment is close to every spot in London - we had a lot of bus lines to every corner in the city and we didn't need to take taxi at all (very close to Trafalgar square, Starbucks is just 1 minute walk and so do Tesco). Honestly, we had a great time and this is without a doubt the best hotel in London. we will come back!

title: Electronics Degree Needed!
text: We were a party of 4 adults and small child visiting London for the Marathon which one of our party did. We found the premises situated in Old Marconi Building on The Strand no signage. Arrived early and the reception staff were great and took our luggage so we could explore....and register for the event. On our return our bags had been taken up to our 6th Floor 2 bedroom suite. The apartment was not as big as expected but was clean and reasonable excepting dated Lounger which was somewhat stained and a very basic flat screen tv. As other reviewers describe everything is controlled by a wall mounted pad heating lighting media etc which is rather complicated one of our party is a heating engineer and even he struggled . We had to leave the second bathroom lights and heating on as we couldn't figure how to turn it off! The place is very quite and is double/ triple glazed....the second bedroom had no windows. On the Sunday morning we attempted to use the toaster but this kept tripping the electrics so we gave up. There then became a big issue as we attempted to watch the marathon start on TV! all the main channels were not available a call to the staff was made and it transpired the whole buildings tv was out except the Freeview minor channels not much good to us on our big day watching our daughter start etc. This remained so until we left on the Monday. The tv was very basic and with all the technology one would expect a smart tv so we could have least watched on bbc iPlayer At over £700 for 2 nights these issues should not be expected! On a plus its very central close to all the main sites in London.

title: Great Place to Stay!
text: The apartment was fantastic! Great room, and it was peacefully quiet even though our view was of the main road of the Strand. A short walk from the station and underground

title: Apple Apartments: London--The Strand
text: Robertino, the portatiere, was über friendly. Outstanding value and great accommodations in posh London Town. High tech options were frustrating. Next time we'll bring a personal IT spak-ilist. Clean, smart and sexy. Will book again.

title: Four friends and a concert
text: We needed something where 2 couples could stay without paying the inflated 5* prices of hotels Came across the Apple Apartments via a referral- having never stayed in a serviced apartment I was a little anxious as we like our comfort We were not to be disappointed From the booking experience to the warm welcome to the smartly appointed apartment - can't fault anything Would def recommend to anyone wanting home from home comfort while in London Easy, convenient, clean, comfortable, modern, wifi, complimentary tea and coffee, it had it all We will be back

title: Amazing !!!
text: A really impressive apartment !! it was very clean and exactly as it is shown in their photos !!! The location is great for everything! The staff was very friendly and helpful and the apartment had daily clean and amenities that we where not expecting!! We will definitely revisit it and i definitely recommend it to everyone!!

title: Nice replacement
text: We had originally booked another location with apple, but they moved us to this location 10 minutes before arrival due to critical maintenance. They solved this in a swift and professional way. Nice, High-tec, modern and quite stylish apartments with a central location. 24 hour manned reception – excellent service from those guys. Just forget to learn the high tech stuff, like light switches etc ,,, it would ruin your holiday, and you need to spend an extra 2 days just to turn on the TV in the shower.... and yes there is a TV in the shower.

title: Great Location - for the tech savvy
text: We've stayed as a family (2 adults, grown daughter) for 4 nights. The place is amazing - very nicely appointed. Although very centrally located it was totally quiet, no outside noises whatsoever. The staff at reception was helpful and fun. The downside: everything in the apartment is centrally controlled by an old and slow touch screen. So forget about just switching on the lights in your bedroom - we needed to study a multipage manual first before coming to grips with the electronics.

title: Perfect to live the London life
text: After two weeks in Europe, we landed in London ready for New Year's Eve. We chose the Apple Apartments because of their central location, quality fit out and ease of travel to and from Heathrow. We were not disappointed. The apartment was warm, comfortable and quiet. The fully equipped kitchen was great, we even cooked up a meal with some quality ingredients from Harrods. The apartments are a short walk from Covent Gardens tube station and there is a Tesco Supermarket about 200m from the front door. Great spot.

title: Perfect location
text: We rented a one bedroom apartment for one night at very reasonable cost for this area. I received email confirmation of my booking a couple of days before our visit, and arrived slightly early which wasn't a problem. The apartment was spacious, clean and quiet where we were located. Have to agree with other reviewers that the tech was very flaky and I was glad that we didn't feel the need to take advantage of it. Did manage to get tv in shower working though! The heating worked fine too. Downsides....no normal tea bags on offer, only herbal so take your own. Tech box kept in wardrobe in bedroom so slight hum could be heard but better than some air con units we have experienced. Was asked in email to confirm name of other guest and offer of reserving car parking space which I did. Had no response from Apple apartments so had to find our own parking at considerably more cost than they were offering. There didn't appear to be anywhere to securely store left luggage which I think is why they don't offer it on website but we certainly saw some behind the reception desk so wouldn't think it would be a problem if you were happy to leave it there. Compared to other apartments we have rented in London this came out very favourably indeed and after our first experience we wouldn't hesitate to return.

title: Cancelled three days before arrival
text: I cannot rate the apartments facilities although it seems that they are pretty good. However I can rate as very bad the management function. I made a reservation some months ago through Booking.com. I tried to contact them several times during the last week to confirm the reservation but they did not responded back to any of my emails. And today (3 days before arrival) I received an email with the cancellation without any further explanation. What is more, today it was the last day for cancellation in Booking.com without penalty. I contacted them and explained they are doing remodeling in some rooms so that was the reason. I still do not understand why they do realize three days before my arrival that they had to cancel my reservation. Unfortunately I already read several cases similar to mine so it seems that it is an standard way of working of this company. Definitely not recommended unless you are used to gambling.

title: Excellent value and location
text: Quiet, sleek, serbiced modern apartment in a great area on the Strand. Close to the river, Trafalgar square, Soho, Leicester square. I can't imagine a better spot for a first time visitor interested in seeing the primary sights. First rate amenities including a complimentary smart phone with wifi, talk and text and maps. 2 large TVs, fireplace, view, efficient kitchen.

title: Not what it seems
text: Oven doesn't work, it's never been used. Purchased some nibbles for evening snacks that needed cooking and had to leave them. Don't be fooled into thinking it's a self catering apartment cause it's not, won't be staying again will spend my £210 a night somewhere else

title: Peaceful yet central!
text: We have been staying here for the last three nights. The room is great. It's clean, bright and modern. It's also very quiet at night and we have all had great night sleeps! No sound of the bustling traffic even when we are right on the strand. The location is great and the receptionist have been so warming and welcoming. The only thing I would say that it is maybe slightly too confusing with all the technology available. I am the tech wizard of my family so I was able to adapt fine but as for my mum and sister they were very confused with all the buttons and screens. Apart from this, I would highly recommend this place to stay.

title: 4 day London visit
text: My new husband and I wanted to spend 4 days in London to enjoy theatre, museum trips etc. We stayed at Apple Apartments in the Strand and it was a great choice. We arrived at 11am and left our bags with the charming and helpful concierges (check in us 2pm). Head office do need to get this bit right because before we booked we checked we could leave luggage before 2pm and were told we could. When the paperwork came through it said there was no facility to leave luggage! We telephoned and told this was a mistake and we could leave luggage. However when final e mail arrived to reconfirm our visit it once again said no luggage could be left. Another phone call and we were told we could. It was all fine on the day but had given us some concerns. Once we checked in we were very pleased. Apartment very smart and immaculately clean. Also very quiet. The triple glazing really works. A great choice for those wanting a perfect location for theatreland.

title: technology blunders abound
text: Generally speaking, technology is supposed to make life easier, right? Not the case in this room

title: Wonderful Apartment
text: Fantastic two bedroom apartment right in the centre of London. Extremely well soundproofed and the facilities were amazing. Even included a tv in the shower! There were tea and coffee making facilities provided and good quality toiletries. The furniture, finishes and linen were of a very high quality.

title: Good place to stay with minor flaw
text: Friendly reception staff and a really good room. The ac and light system for the room is just over complicated. In-room ammenities were great, fully supplied kitchen. Minus for the fact that the room just had one key, travelling with family and heading off to work at day needed key coordination.

title: Immaculate, modern and friendly
text: Traveled with friends and comfortably fit in a family apartment. The amenities are modern and apartment comes equipped with all items necessary. The bed was extremely comfortable, but the living room sofa could use a better mattress. The thoughtful touches of water, chocolates on the bed, teas, coffee, and toiletries were a pleasant surprise. The apartment is centrally located near the tube and numerous bus lines. The concierge made all the difference in guiding us through London. They gave us directions, recommendations, made us feel welcome, and had all had a fantastic disposition. The assistance of Abdul, David and Nour were remarkable . Apple apartments is lucky to have such wonderful staff. Absolutely would return to London and only stay at Apple apartments.

title: Strongly recommend that you avoid this place!! (It is also known as Marconi House).
text: In April we booked an apartment here for our trip to London in June through booking.com and paid in full. One week before we were due to arrive we received an e mail from the apartments stating they had overbooked and the apartment was no longer available, they offered to move us or refund our money. The apartment and location they offered to move us to was inferior to what we had booked and paid for in full so we chose to take the refund.Well what a joke that was we spent hours and hours trying to contact them by phone and e mail for over 4 weeks only to be fobbed off and ignored, so in desperation we contacted booking.com who were OK to start with but every time we had contact with them it was a different person so no real continuity. Three months later after exhausting all options we decided to contact the CEO of booking.com to lodge a formal complaint, no response for 2 weeks so e mailed again then finally things started to happen and we received our money back from booking.com who now have to invoice this property to try and get the funds reimbursed to them. This was not a small amount of money that we were owed either!! So I do not recommend this place and would say be very very careful or you may be left in the position we were. This was a stress we did not need, we had to find alternative accommodation one week before flying to London from Australia and this was not an easy task and then the further stress of 3 months of trying to get our refund.

title: Overnight , mid-week stay.
text: After a shaky start, i.e. our reservation was lost on their system despite booking direct and having an email confirmation ( get your act together Head Office you are letting the side down ! ) we were finally shown to our room by the very friendly and helpful reception staff. And what an excellent room it was. Compact but kitted out with every thing you would need to set up base camp in the Capitol, including dishwasher, iron, cooker, washing machine !!! And all of the highest quality although best to take an eight year old with you to sort out the high-tech lighting, tv and sound system. All in all and excellent experience. Great location for the West End, City and South Bank. Would definitely use them again.

title: Anniversary visit to The Shard
text: Room was in a very easy to get to location and was a nice apartment. Everything we needed. Until the evening. Was a very hot day and we had been to the Shard for dinner. No air con in the room just a ceiling fan which didn't work. Phoned services who were not at all helpful told us to look for the fuse switch in the kitchen. There wasn't one where they told us it would be. Opened all the windows, There is a takeaway at the back of the property and the noise from it was appalling. Until at least 2.30am. Talking, bottles being dumped and the food extractors going off every few minutes. Also the smell of cooking oil was quite overpowering, then shop alarms started going off. Never again!

title: Superb!
text: I booked these apartments on the basis that it was closer to work. I have absolutely no regrets and would happily stay again! In fact I am Trying to but it's seeming difficult to book again as evidently they are very popular. Concierge are quiet and charming! I wouldn't hesitate recommending anyone to book!

title: Shame the people let the room down
text: The booking service for these apartments kind of ruined these for me. I booked them for a work conference and chose them on location. I was booking two apartments and felt they were the best option. The day before travel I had only received entry details for one room so I called to check. Found out that there had been a mistake and they had overbooked so the second room was in a different location. The only thing they could do was move both of us if we wanted to stay together. When we found the apartments which aren't really marked, my colleague was given a larger room, nice for her but not great for me! I felt that with the mistake both of us should have been upgraded. The apartment was nice however, but it was a hot day and the tech in the room wasn't working. Had to ask security to put the air con on as it was really hot. didn't work so had to go back and ask them again - turns out my room wasn't activated as occupied. None of the smart system worked at all so TV etc was pointless, as was the manuals! So although the apartment itself was nice, the overall experience,lack of acknowledgment from the company for being rubbish and the really long walk in the morning I would not book with these people again.

title: Excellent location and nicely appointed apartment.
text: Wow - amazing place. We could not stay in our usual apartment, so decided to book one night at Apple Apartments The Strand. Booking was very easy, and on arrival the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Our room was on the 4th floor overlooking The Strand. Due to the fact the windows were triple glazed there was no road noise at all. The apartment was extremely well equipped with a hob, oven, dishwasher, washing machine, television (there was even a tv in the shower)!, complimentary tea and coffee (only herbal teas though and not normal tea bags), biscuits, apples and bottled water were also provided - in fact everything you needed to make for a pleasant stay. There were gadgets (if a little confusing) to control the lighting, air conditioning, docking station, but this made it a funky apartment. Exceptionally clean and immaculate - we would certainly stay here again as the price was excellent for the location (Covent Garden is very close by).

title: Excellent location
text: We were travelling as a family of four, and this apartment solution gave us an opportunity to be together in one space, instead of taking two hotel rooms. The Strand has a 24h front desk, which made us feel safe. The apartment had two bedrooms, two nice bathrooms, and a open kitchen/living room. The apartment was not big, but it's large enough, quite efficient plan. Everything was as it was supposed to be, clean and quiet at night. We were on the sixth floor, but I don't think it matters that much. Best of all, the location is perfect for culture, shopping, whatever you want to do. All in all can recommend this apartment.

title: A great alternative to a hotel room
text: We stayed for a weekend of theatre and dining and were really impressed. There was a bit of a mix-up when we checked in, but no drama. The lovely Robertino on reception even organised breakfast boxes for us both to apologise, which was a really nice and unexpected gesture. The apartment was spotless and superb. Overlooking Somerset House (the Courtauld Gallery is brilliant) the location couldn't have been better. We had tickets for Funny Girl, which was at the Savoy Theatre - less than a 10 minute walk. Staying in an apartment was a revelation. There was a great little kitchen, and having a fridge also meant that we could buy and chill a bottle of white wine from the Tesco down the road and enjoy listening to music rather than paying loads in a bar. I loved the fact that the apartment really did feel like home from home. So much more room and comfort than a hotel. For the quality it was also much better value than a hotel in the same area of London. We'll definitely stay here next time we have a weekend in London.

title: Great trip to London staying at Apple Apartments The Strand
text: Took a short overnight trip with my husband to London. We stayed in Apple Apartments The Strand. Self serviced luxury apartments in a great location. Apartment was amazing!
