Clean, well maintained and the staff could not have been more helpful and polite! They are within waking distance to some of the major London attractions. We walked round Leicester Square, Soho and Covent Garden. They are also handy to the underground tube service. London is amazing we are already planning our next visit and will definitely be staying in Apple Apartments again! Would highly recommend 😀

title: Avoid!!! - Cancelled our advance paid Booking! Terrible!!!
text: Very disappointed after paying 2 months in advance - that we had notification one week prior to our stay from Booking.com to say our booking was not available anymore!!!! After being promised a refund within a couple of days - it actually took us 2 weeks to get a refund (which actually came from Booking.com in the end). I have read other reviews saying that this has happened to them also!!!!! So I would advise anyone considering this hotel to avoid it like the plague!! - as it is very difficult to find another hotel at short notice - and we were actually back for over a week before we got our refund (so had to pay for our new hotel without receiving the refund back). So avoid, avoid, avoid!!!

title: I paid a month in advance and they cancelled my reservation!
text: I booked on priceline.com and got a confirmation that said Agoda.com was the booking partner. I pre-paid a month in advance, a non-refundable, no-cancellation room. While in the middle of my trip to Europe, a few days before check-in I got an email stating they were overbooked and canceling my reservation! I was offered a replacement room or a refund. I asked for both and took the room out of desperation because all of the rates had gone way up and I could not find anything reasonable. They broke a written contract on priceline's website which says the reservation cannot be MODIFIED or AMENDED. Well I have contacted bothe priceline and Agoda and neither are willing to offer a refund for their mistake and incovenience. They are all just passing the buck. BEWARE when using any of these vendors!

title: Would definitely re-book, only a few minor flaws
text: Location: Fantastic location, within walking distance of all main attractions on the north side of the river. Ideal for those going to see a show or wanting a central location. Check-in: Only took minutes, concierge carried luggage up the few steps to reception (unless they have a ramp, this location is not wheelchair friendly, i would advise contacting beforehand, just to double check) Staff all very friendly and helpful throughout the stay. Apartment: Very bright and cool upon arrival (was a hot day and air con was welcomed!) - iPad style control for air-conditioning, music and lighting, although also lighting panels for each room with dimming settings. iPad wasn't very reactive and the option for Sky TV/Internet Radio said there was an error and was therefore unable to do this - not too much of a problem as didn't really go to London to watch TV. TV in shower was a nice touch, good double shower and plenty of hot water. Underfloor heating in bathroom. Good size towels. Complimentary Nespresso coffee pod upon arrival, with easy to use machine. Complimentary Bvlgari shower gels/shampoo/conditioner. Also complimentary shower cap, cotton buds and make up remover wipes. Reception happy to look after your luggage after check-out, which is always handy as a lot of serviced apartments do not have a luggage concierge. Minor Flaws - Could not get the induction hob to work on the last day?! Not sure if it was the pan, but the previous pan that had worked was in the dishwasher so couldn't be sure. Also no regular spatula, so no eggy bread for the Mrs on her birthday lol. No robes as advertised in the Delux Apartment - would have been a nice touch. All very small things, didn't trouble us too much and i'm sure they would have provided us with a spatula, had we asked! Would definitely re-book again, for sure, thanks for a lovely time!

title: Fabulous!
text: Great location and the check in was really easy and quick! We arrived 2 hours early to our check in time but our room was ready and we were given the key! The location is one of the key advantages as it is in walking distance to many places! The apartment was clean, great view and comfortable bed and pillows! Tea, coffee, hot chocolate was on offer! The shower was incredible especially with the built in tv! I would defiantly stay here again however next time would like to try the duplex!

title: Perfect location, high quality....
text: We rented two apartments (1x one bed & 1x two bed) for a Saturday night with family. On arrival the reception team were very helpful, rooms were small (as you would expect) but very well appointed, clean and quiet. I would recommend a stay here for business or family - value is pretty good considering the location and the quality of the apartments. The only issue we have was the integrated audio system turned itself on with some kind of very loud interference at 6.30am which scared my young children and got us all up and out of bed much earlier than planned. We managed to turn it off after about 5 mins of working out how to on the slightly over complicated control panel. If you stay here make sure all audio for all rooms is muted and you will not have the same problem.

title: Quiet & Comfortable City Location
text: I chose Apple Apartments due to the close proximity of the theatre my wife and I were visiting. The apartment building is a few minutes walk from the tube station along The Strand and whilst this was ok, it seemed we running the gauntlet of beggars and homeless people on the approach, but that's increasingly common in many cities now and is no reflection on Apple Apartments. The reception area is very large and is staffed 24/7 by polite staff who made check-in a breeze. It took about a minute which was nice. Checking out was easier - just handed over the key. Our apartment on the third floor was very nicely arranged and appeared to be well looked after and clean. The lighting was a bit of challenge - all controlled by finger pads or a central control pad in the hallway, which to be honest, was a real over-kill for the size of the apartment. Last time I experienced a computerised system like this was in a huge house in Sydney, not a one-bed apartment. Having mastered the lighting and air-con, we quickly settled down and made ourselves at home. The kitchen included a dishwasher, over, microwave and fridge, though we only used the fridge briefly to store fresh milk. A selection of tea, coffee, hot chocolate, biscuits and apples were provided, along with fresh flowers in the lounge. There was a TV in the lounge and the window was well-insulated with double-glazed secondary glazing, in addition to the already double-glazed windows. This ensured that there was no street noise whatsoever. Only a single police siren in the morning was noticeable. The bedroom wasn't so much a room but a partitioned space off the hallway. The glass sliding partition was situated right at the end of the bed, making it a little claustrophobic, but leaving it open made it acceptable. Plenty of storage by way of fitted wardrobes was provided, along with bed side cabinets. The bathroom included a TV in the shower, though no matter what I tried, I couldn't get it to work as it was not programmed. It was a bit gimmicky in any event. Clarins branded toiletries were included and perhaps I should have used the shower gel instead of the hotel-sized soap in the shower, because there was no soap dish provided. This meant that after dropping it in the shower tray, it was extremely difficult to pick up again when wet. Sleep quality was excellent. The bed was extremely comfortable with great pillows and this, in my opinion, is the most important aspect of staying away. The lounge had a comfortable sofa and a dining table with chairs. The free Wi-Fi was a bonus and was reliable throughout our stay. All in all, this was a better experience than any of the hotels I've stayed in and a serviced apartment is now my preferred choice for London stays.

title: Just Perfect...
text: The apartments are just fantastic - this will be our first choice for all future stays in this part of London. The staff greeting us on arrival were very helpful and friendly. Our apartment was spotless and everything had been catered for. The funky iPad system for the lights, heating, TV, (including the one in the walk in shower) radio was just great. We had a one bedroom apartment on the third floor overlooking Somerset House. The apartment has everything you could possibly need from the fabulous toiletries in the bathroom which are replenished daily to the welcome tray, there is a fridge / freezer, dishwasher and even a washing machine if you need it!!! We stayed for two nights and there was absolutely nothing to fault. Thank you..

title: Location
text: These apartments are well equipped, very comfortable and clean. The toiletries provided are top quality, Clairns products. It is very well situated for theatre goers and shoppers alike. It is opposite Sommerset House, which is worth a visit. Would most definitely recommend staying here.

title: Great Stay
text: Myself and husband enjoyed our stay in the spotlessly clean well equipped modern spacious apartment. Situated in a great location right next to Convent Garden. The staff were extremely polite and friendly. Both myself and husband had a great stay and a lovely nights sleep. We would defiantly return back soon.

title: Nice, clean and polite staff
text: Loved this place. The staff were very polite and helpful. The room was cozy, clean and had everything I needed. The only minor negative thing is the door lock jammed on our last day and lost good 5 min to try to unlock it. There are quite a few stairs to climb, but you get used to it. I didn't mind the excersize. Very quite room for London. Couldn't hear either neighbour, nor any car noise. Great location!

title: Festive ,functional and fabulous
text: Central London in Winter is one of the worlds most magical sights . Nestled in the heart of Covent Garden surrounded by the glimmer of lights residing in exquisite luxury and comfort - Apple Apartments The Strand are simply the perfect place to stay . Prime position boasting outstanding views , perfect for business in the city , seeing the sights , shows or for shopping . The concierge are the most helpful and charming I have ever been aquainted with . The building is secure and the rooms relaxing and wonderfully equipped . There is even a plasma screen television in the bathroom ! I cannot imagine ever staying in another hotel after sampling Apples incredible range of gorgeous appartments .

title: Convenient,cosy and cheaper than a hotel
text: Stayed for one night and loved the convenient location-the apartments are part of the ME Hotel. Quite small but full of gadgets ( tele in the shower!) and the kitchen although tiny had everything you would need if you wanted to self cater- I didn't. Bed was extremely comfortable as was the sofa. The place even had a washer/dryer. I usually opt for 4/5star hotels but like previous reviewers am a little fed up with paying over the odds so decided to try other options in future. I will definitely stay here again

title: Great location for cosy apartment!
text: Had a lovely one night stay in these apartments with my boyfriend. Although the apartment is like one long corridor with the bedroom only big enough for the bed with bedside table either side, its all you need for a short stay. The kitchen area was small but came complete with everything you needed, although the lack of attention to detail was disappointing

title: Great location
text: Stayed for 1 night recently with my boyfriend. we usually opt for 5* hotels but we are a bit sick of paying £300+ for a nights stay when we often don't spend much time in our room. After checking out the reviews I thought we'd give apple apartments a bash, was a great find they are! I will be staying here every time I visit London from now on as the location is fab and great value for money. Rooms are very modern with great facilities, lovely walk in shower and it even had a TV ( which we didn't use). Technology in the room is great although we didn't use it all. A short walk from temple and 5 mins walk from Covent garden, so there are plenty of restaurants to chose from for breakfast, lunch and dinner and getting about on the tube is easy. We had a room with a view of the strand but it wasn't noisy at all, in fact it felt very quiet. Lovely Clarins toiletry's, Nespresso and bottles of complimentary water - better than most of our recent expensive hotel stays! The whole thing was easy. Thank you Apple apartments.

title: Much better value than a hotel
text: I was very pleased by style and smartness of the reception area and the apartment, and certainly much better value than staying in a hotel of the same standard. I didn't use it, but there was even an option for room service from the neighbouring hotel - nice touch.

title: Nice but expensive
text: Apartment is Ok, spacious and clean. Location is handy, next to Trafalgar square, shops and restaurants. However, gets very crowded on rush hours and using a taxi is not that recommended. There is no staff onsite to help, need to phone for all requirements. Sofa bed was terrible for me, my son son enjoined. If travelling with young children avoid to rent the 2 floors flat as the the stairs are very tipped. Also, on the second there is only the room and a bathroom, no place for childrens basically. All properies have a touchscreen control panel to adjust loghtning, room temperature and access to the sound system.

title: Brilliantly located and well appointed apartment
text: This was the first time that we'd stayed in anything other than a hotel in London and given the price, it was worth it for the comfort of having your own living area and separate bedroom as opposed to everything being in the one space as it is in a normal hotel room. The hi-tech lighting and air conditioning took a bit of working out but we got it sorted along with the sound system and TV. In the end we ate out on both nights but had we decided to coo for ourselves, the kitchen was extremely well equipped and had everything we could have asked for. The bathroom was nice with a big double shower and the bed was wonderfully comfortable!. Situated opposite Somerset House the location itself was perfect being central to everywhere (Covent Garden only a 3 minute walk away) but the double glazing was superb so you barely heard a thing from outside . Secure parking is available at £30 a night which isn't too bad for central London and the staff were all incredibly polite and helpful

title: Long stay with the kids
text: Stayed for 10 days , Big bathroom , amazing kitchen with facilities and free Wifi ,but to my surprise that was it !!! 1. Apartment was extremely small (not as the pictures shown on site Booking.com) 2. Curtain was broken from beginning, even after i have reported it they didn't bother to fix it 3. No safety Box available at all ( Apt 404 ) 4. Bed was small ( 150 cm ) and the mattress was unbearable to sleep 5. Kitchen Hub does not work ( smell stays after cooking ) 6. Cleaning was a disaster , they come every 4 days to change the covers and that it. they don't even tidy up the bed , just lay down the new covers on the bed and that's it. no dust removing , and not even cleaning the WC 7. WC had a large dark stain on the seat , when i reported it , they simply ignored it. 8. No telephone in the apartment to call reception or any other room !!!! 9. late night shift reception cannot be bothered to leave the seat or talk to them !!! Unprofessional 10. Home automation was nice but frustrating to a level were you really don't need it at all I was disgusted with their level of hygiene on the apartments , as if they don't care . requested a new apartment and was replied that they were fully booked. Location is amazing near Covent Garden but that's it. As per my experience , i will not stay there again unless you don't care about how they dress the cleaning part of the apartment . My regards to Anwar and Roberto from the reception for their excellent customer relationship and efforts done .

title: avoid
text: Despite having paid for apartment in full several weeks before. We got an email less than 24 hours prior to travel to notify us that they could no longer honour our booking! Unacceptable having already booked train & theatre tickets we had a frantic time trying to get something else suitable at short notice. On a positive note they did refund our money promptly.

title: Decent stay
text: Was here for a week as part of a euro trip. We got a one bedroom duplex which was well later out and pretty. The location was very convenient and it had the basics right. Only downside was for the amount I paid for I expected to get more space and more facilities a hotel room at that price would be. Will recommend but personally think I could get a bit better service apartments elsewhere.

title: 5* apartments, only place we'll stay in London from now on.
text: I don't know where to start, we arrived and were greeted with the friendliest pair of concierge staff you've ever met. One came down and met us in the car park to bring our luggage up. I told him he didn't need too but was completely insistent on taking it, with the hugest smile on his face. We had arrived an hour and a half early, but only kept us 5 minutes before having it ready for us, spotlessly clean. The apartment was spacious but cosy, it was filled with the highest technology(even a TV in the waterfall shower) 😮 they had every thing you would need in there, along with complimentary miniatures of just about everything. The staff were continuously helpful throughout our whole stay, and I couldn't recommend it enough. Secure car park and safe area, as well as being quiet, you didn't feel like you were in the centre of London. What I would add is that we had ALL this having paid for the cheapest room, as everything else was fully booked. I wouldn't hesitate to book.

title: great location and very well appointed
text: Just back from two nights in a one-bed apartment. Ideal location - central for everything

title: False information
text: We stayed at the apartments. We under stood and paid for a week for a two bedroom. It turned out to be a bedroom in a loft overlooking a very small pull out couch. The entrance way is lovely to the bldg. but the apt was small and cramped. When we complained the told us there was nothing we could do and if we wanted to move we would lose the full week's rent. So my message is - it is fine for a couple. But that is it and the manager does not believe in the honor system.

title: Great location, lovely apartment!
text: Located at the strand, Apple apartments is wonderfully accessible to many of the tourist attractions. When you turn to the right, it is a 5 minutes walk to Covent Garden and if you head further down, it is a 10 minutes walk to National Gallery. When you head to the left, it is a 20 minutes walk to St Paul's Cathedral. At the opposite side, there is the small but impressive Courtauld Gallery within Somerset House. As you head further south, you will reach River Thames and South Bank in less than 10 minutes. Other than it's fabulous location, the compact apartment is beautifully decorated. It is also fully equipped with a kitchen, necessary utensils and even a washing machine. Housekeeping is done on a daily basis. It has a very pleasant stay because of the friendly staff as well as the housekeeping team. Would like to especially thank Plamen who had been enormously friendly and helpful! Will definitely recommend our friends to this place! :)

title: Lovely modern accommodation
text: Stayed here with family. An apartment was much handier than a hotel with young kids. Apartment was modern and spotless. Reception staff were really helpful and pleasant. Location was great for getting around different parts of London. Apartment had everything we needed for our stay. Apartment was quite small but same as most places in London! Would highly recommend.

title: Great location but some issues
text: The location was fantastic, nearby Covent Garden with many restaurants nearby. I would recommend going to ME Hotel's rooftop bar next door as well if staying at the Marconi House. We stayed in the one-bedroom apartment with a sofa bed in the living room, if you're going to use the sofa bed take note that it's not the most comfortable but it is adequate. The only major issue was that on our last night our apartment's electrical circuit was out so the appliances, AC, WiFi and electrical sockets were not working. There was nothing they could do about it and all other apartments were full, but it was a good thing it was our last night there and the lights were still working.

title: PLUS POINT PERFECT LOCATION, BAD POINT BEDS TOO SOFT
text: The location of these apartments are perfect. Taxis galore, tour buses round the corner in Aldwych and 5 minutes walk from Covent Garden and majority of theatres. Apartment was perfectly adequate and provided enough plates, etc. We didn't cook here only had breakfasts. There was air conditioning but given we were in London in the heatwave didn't seem to make any difference to the heat in the room. We had an apartment on 6th floor overlooking the rear of the property so no noise from The Strand but did get woken up at 7am every day by the dustbin men. The beds were much too soft and if you have back problems then trying to climb into the VERY DEEP bath in the ensuite room is out the question. I had to give up and use the other bathroom which had a walk in shower. We had a two bedroom apartment and the layout of the master bedroom in relation to the sofa was very poor ended up with bruises on my shins as bed was on a fixed base and there was about a foot between rear of sofa and sliding glass door to master bedroom (photos attached). Just bad layout of the furniture.

title: Informed at 11am on day of check in that apartment uninhabitable with no satisfactory resolution. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!
text: My stay "... was less than perfect..."! I didn't get to stay due to a 'supposed' PROBLEM with the toilet that UNBELIEVABLY couldn't be fixed by an emergency plumber, PLEASE, NO PERSON IN THEIR RIGHT MIND WOULD BELIEVE THIS STORY! We were only informed of the problem at 11.05am while on route to the apartment. The stress caused to me and my family was huge and the resolution of moving us to the ME hotel was less than satisfactory. It meant we were in the correct location (not impressed with an offer of an apartment at Hyde Park or near the Monument) but the move to a one bedroomed hotel room with a put me up bed in the living space and sharing one bathroom and toilet was not what I wanted from accommodation. This was not what I wanted as I was staying with my partner and her mother was to have her own room in the apartment. So, no I won't be recommending you to anyone nor will I be staying with you again. My guess is they had a better booking for more than one night and they just made this up to get rid of me. (supposed to be staying 3rd June for one night)

title: Great location
text: We stayed here instead of a hotel as we wanted 2 rooms close together but an apartment with 2 bedrooms was ideal. The Apple apartments are luxurious and extremely close to theatre land. There was even a TV in the bathroom above the bath! The lights are all controlled by panels on the wall with the climate control also. There is a fridge freezer and oven. All items needed are there, just provide your food. The receptionists are extremely friendly despite another review which said otherwise. Cant recommend highly enough.

title: My little girl felt like a princess
text: This is certainly a five star property the room was big airy and light all mod cons with an ipad to operate lights heating and tv. The bathroom was stunning with an inbuilt tv and to top it off miniature clarins products and a fluffy robe and slippers. The concierge was very helpful, he printed us a map when we asked for directions. Nothing was too much trouble he was so very polite and even hailed taxis for us and brought us up extra tea and sugar on or request. I will definitely be back to visit this beautiful apartment it made my weekend. please bear in mind there are residents That live in the marconi building so bear this in mind and be respectful during your stay.Thank you Hayley.

title: wonderful comfortable high spec
text: Stayed one night ,so comfortable all high spec the staff in reception were brilliant , right in the heart of theatre land.we were even given chocolates for being winners in an award ceremony at the savoy. will certainly stay there again,

title: Great central London place
text: Easy to book and find. Place is really central, few mins walk to Covent Garden and theatre land. Very modern, clean, comfortable rooms. We had a 1 bed, which had everything you could need in the kitchen, as well as pull down comfortable sofa bed for my 12 year old. She was celebrating her birthday and staff did a special gift waiting in the room for her, which she was thrilled to bits. Extra special, personal detail, like a hotel, but freedom and space to eat/drink in the lounge. Very reasonable rates for London and family. ME hotel just on corner, so you are looked after like a hotel, with bars/resturants close by, but without the cost. Will be booking again soon for our next trip. thks to all team for their effort.

title: Golden Delicious !
text: You couldn't possibly imagine a more wonderful location to stay in whilst visiting London than the Strand. The luxury apartments are a stones throw from the glorious Covent Garden & Leicester Square which boast fabulous attractions such as Somerset House, the Royal Opera House, the spectacular St Pauls cathedral , Chinatown and a marvellous selection of theatres and eateries. The magnificent Marconi House which has previously been awarded London’s best large development contains absolutely everything one requires for a superb stay in London. A fully equipped kitchen if you wish you dine in, plasma screen TV , exquisite bedrooms , brilliant storage , a state of the art bathroom , climate control and the privacy of its own discreet entrance with a helpful 24 hour concierge. Housekeeping is daily. The 5 star ME hotel (Awarded Hotel Of The Year) is just one door down is home to the best Italian in the City- Cucina Asellina . Then pop up to the 10th floor Radio Rooftop Bar for glittering views of London Eye, Trafalgar Square, London Bridge, Covent Garden, St. Paul’s Cathedral until 2am. Apples portfolio of prime location properties is extensive. They also accommodate in Kensington, Hyde Park, Greenwich, The Docklands, Belfast , Aberdeen and East London and are constantly expanding. Looking for something extra with Star quality? Don't hesitate to book today.

title: Luxury, comfort and convenient
text: My husband , 6 year old granddaughter and myself stayed in a two bedroomed apartment .... The place is perfect ... Beds so comfortable .. We had a fab weekend . Once checked in and dropped off our bags we just walked a stone throw away to the theatre to see the amazing lion king ... Fab shopping area as only walking distance to great stores .. Indian , thai and pizza restaurants literally across the road ... We loved this luxury comfortable apartment and highly recommend it . A perfect weekend had by all 😃😃😃

title: A great choice
text: We stayed here from December 20th through to the morning of the 26th. The apartment was perfect for our purpose, having a separate lounge/kitchen area in addition to the bedroom,was ideal. I particularly appreciated that the room was warm, with great under floor heating in the bathroom, and the kitchen was well equipped. The location was great for walks into Leicester Square, Covent Garden, Chinatown and St James Park. I would have no hesitation in visiting again.

title: Lovely Stay
text: We were looking for somewhere nice to stay in London for my wife's (special) birthday when I chanced upon the Apple website. Having out our dates in it transpired that Black Friday had been extended so we booked a 1 bed family apartment online with 30% off. I subsequently had cause to ring the booking line on two occasions, one to arrange car parking and one to confirm that there was a sofa bed in the apartment as our daughter was going to stay for a night. On both. occasions the people who took calls were very friendly and helpful and on the second call it transpired that we had been upgraded to a two bed apartment. Bingo! On arrival the reception guys were very helpful and showed us where to park and then got a trolley for our luggage. They were always friendly and welcoming when we went in and out and very helpful with any queries. The apartment itself was lovely and was all we could have asked for. Very tastefully fitted out and very comfortable. The only slight niggle was The electronic control system for lights, hearing, audio, TV etc, which wasn't great....touch screens not as responsive as they might be and not everything functioned correctly. It wasn't too difficult to work out how it should work and the glitches were not something that bothered me. Perhaps it is all about expectations but I didn't actually expect it to work properly and it didn't! A minor issue and it didn't detract from our stay at all. The location is fantastic with Covent Garden close by and two tube stations within a five or ten minute stroll. Overall a fantastic few days in superb accommodation in a great location. What's not to like?!

title: Bad start!!! But Happy..
text: Ok - so I booked this 1 bedroom apartment 2 weeks ago We are here in London to see a West End Show so the location was perfect Nice couple of gentlemen on reception and we arrived to check in our room at 3:30pm We were allocated room 610 and when we entered the room it had not been cleaned!!! Shock/ horror I phoned Apple Apartments to complain and right enough, 2 cleaners turned up half hour later full of apologies and a bottle of Prosecco telling us of the mix up as they were told to clean the apartment - not expecting new arrivals but continued guests The girls cleaned while we were here - and were very sorry for the mixup and did a lovely job I would of given this apartment 5* but because of this they will get only 4* The apartment is clean!! Modern and very comfortable and in a great location I won't let this bother me.. That the apartment wasn't ready- as once it was done it's lovely I will stay again

title: Excellent location
text: I stay in London for business regularly and could not fault this apartment. Firstly the location is perfect for central London. The apartment is cosy and very clean. The bathroom is very spacious and the Clarins hospitality gifts are a lovely addition. The reception staff are very friendly and efficient. I would highly recommend this apartment.

title: Perfect location
text: The hotel, staff and rooms were of excellent quality, reasonably priced for location, no bad points as such only thing I could offer constructive criticism about would be a tv in the bedroom rather than the living room would have been far cosier and the front of the hotel didn't have anywhere to dispose of cigarette butts but other than that we had a fantastic stay :-)

title: Affordable luxury in the heart of town
text: I visit London twice a year for a long weekend since many years, and I've tried many accommodations in various parts of town. The Apple Strand apartments are probably the most luxurious and best equipped accommodation I've stayed at and has the best location of all, yet the price I paid is not much different from what I paid in the past for a good quality hotel room or apartments with fewer amenities and less attractive locations. A special mention deserves the air-conditioning, which was very quiet, with a subtle airflow, yet very effective. The bathroom was also very nice, with a shower over a bathtub. Lighting is subtle and, unlike a previous reviewer mentioned i found it easy to control and adjust. Free wifi and tablet provided. Minor drawbacks were the smallish bedroom and the limited supply of plates, cups and cutlery, which makes it necessary to either wash dishes by hand or have the dishwasher run nearly empty. Also the mattress of the sofa bed was not brilliant, but passable. The baby cot on the other hand was well equipped with an additional mattress on top of the standard one. For my future stays in London, the Apple Strand apartments will be my first choice, but I'm somehow afraid that I was lucky with the rate I got this time.

title: Good Location
text: I wanted somewhere that was handy for the theatres and getting back quickly after the show as I have a 7 year old. Also, getting to the London Eye the next day was easy on foot. The apartment was clean and ideal for our stay. The Clarins toiletries were a nice touch. I wasn't fussed about the technology but I dare say this made the apartment more expensive to stay in. I probably would stay there again.

title: Good location
text: Bit of a weird experience here with many pluses and a few bad points. Good points- Great location with the Strand being a perfect place to stay in central London. No matter what direction you walk in you will fun things to do. The apartment is beautiful and enjoyed the apartment hugely. The TV in the shower was a nice touch. Self service apartment s but there is a Tescos metro right over the road. Bad point- After an hour of arriving i heard a loud "pop" in my room and instantly smelt smoke. I could not find the problem so went downstairs to the gentlemen in reception. They had the football playing and the Italian man that helped me looked like i had just spat in his food when i asked him for help. He told me that it is not his job to be helping with the apartments. That may have been the case i told him but the fact i could smell smoke should have been enough to trigger his interest. When we had a better look around the bedroom we found a bulb had blew and smashed the lens too. Of course it was right above the bed. Although the man had a good clean around i still cut myself in the night on glass that was not found earlier. Because he told me the service of the apartment was nothing to do with him it put me in the position of not knowing who i should talk to. To be honest i enjoyed the rest of the stay that much that by the time i left it was not a huge deal to me anyway.

title: Don't let the mod cons fool you
text: There is a lot that is great about these apartments, but then again... As one earlier reviewer suggested it would be extremely helpful if a staff member could show you to the apartment and explain how it works. A/c is running and the apartment is stuffy - can't work out how to change it - at night it is hot, but noise from street is too loud to keep window open. The double glazed window works spectacularly - very quiet! The bed "room" is novel: a queen size bed and 2 bedside tables fill the space - the cupboard where the shelves are cannot be accessed as the door cannot open as the bedside table is wedged in: useless, ended up putting the bedside table in the cupboard - what sort of designer can't figure that sliding doors in limited space actually are really functional? The bed itself is very soft - yuk. And it wasn't made properly as it can't be moved to tuck the sheet in on the top end, so ends up scrunchy every night. Blame the designer again for that. Took a while to sort out the shower: you can have water raining down on you or squirting on your midsection - I think that might be an "English" thing. Design fault in locating the hand shower - no room to attach it to the wall, when there is a pointless tv in the way. WI-FI - finally found the password - would have been so much more helpful to be given it at reception - there is no phone n apartment to contact reception if they are needed, take a trip in the lift. The oven buzzer went off every minute for 20 minutes at 3.00pm - still can't figure out how to turn it off. The apartment is all glitz , glamour and location and that is what you are paying for: 300 pounds per night is not cheap and I would expect more sense and service for that money. Yes and there is no way to let room service know that you don't need them

title: Hi end serviced apartments
text: I have stayed here twice now. The first time I was impressed with how hi end the apartment was. The bathroom is sharp lined modern with Clarins products as standard !! A telly in the shower but do not expect a bath. The bed and linen was comfortable with a slightly strange arrangement of sliding glass doors to separate the bed from the hall. The lounge area and kitchenette is well stocked with a microwave an electric hob fridge and freeze. The home entertainment equipment will impress fully integrated music system hard wired and the ability to stream films. The sizes I have found of these do vary and some are bigger apartments than others. The weekend rate I had was very good far meter than a hotel room with if you were down for a long weekend more options. There is service from the attached ME hotel with the ability to order food until 10:30 and drink. Location for theatre land etc is amazing. Check rates as I had a more expensive midweek stay these last fee days but with multiple events on in town this week was still cheaper than a hotel.

title: Great Location
text: We stayed in these apartments for 2 nights. Great location for sightseeing in London as well as attending London shows. Apartment has all mod cons & was clean & light. Very comfortable stay & will stay there again

title: Lovely Hotel!
text: Stayed here with my boyfriend, was a lovely hotel, Very clean, modern and quite. Staff were attentive to our needs, and were there 24 hours so someone was always there if we needed them. Very close to the pubs bars and restaurants so not far to walk. Expensive but worth it.

title: Ideal for Short Trip
text: I've stayed for one night only and booked a one bedroom apartment. I have to say that it was a very clean luxury apartment. The control panel on the wall worked quite perfectly, apart from turning on the TV but that it's just the minimum. It's a good location, comfortable bed, nice shower and kitchen. It's like having your on pad in the city without spending too much money. Although, I don't think that it would be ideal if you are planning to visit London and stay for over one week. Perfect for shorty trips. I would definitely book it again.

title: Lacking of size and service
text: "We did not get what we paid for" The main reason we choose this stay was the size of the aparments. We booked an aparment 55 sqm in size. When we got there the aparment was only 30 sgm in size. Acordning to other information, we had got an "Studio" (smaller in size) than the aparment we had booked and paid for. When trying to solve this with the staaf at Apple Aparments we where offered and larger apparment to an higher cost??? Talking to the staaf at Apple Aparments was, to say the least, rather confusing. The woman that answered had to talk to the manager for every question we had. I would really recommend, if you plan to stay here, get the apparment size in writing or stay somewhere else. I realy regrett staying here instead of at an other place. Do not like beeing fooled

title: Disappointed, customer service lacking
text: I emailed this to the apartments yesterday morning, no response so here's the review. Would be extremely helpful if reception guided to the apartments and talked through the basics ie lights/appliances and where things are - when in London for just one night extremely frustrating having to read through manuals just to switch on lights and work the tv. iPod Dock did not work. No tea towels. 4 sachets of coffee, 2 packets of biscuits - I cup each and it's all over! I'm not sure they realised 4 friends were staying? Air climate would not work it was hot in the apartment, those few minutes of customer service would have made enormous difference. The "fruit bowl"was 2 apples on a plate (again 4 sharing?), "fresh flowers" - 3 tulips, the fact that it's mentioned in the details would indicate that it would be a little more than 2 apples and 3 tulips. Would have been helpful if reception had given wifi code when checking in, assumption was that this would be in the apartment, when reception visited this was given on a scrap of paper - this surprises me when everything else is "high tech" that this was not in the apartment, would also have been helpful if reception had pointed out that there was a fob on the keyring to use to come into the building. I found it extremely irritating and rude that house keeping knocked at 10am to see when we were leaving. I decided to spend more than what I would usually a this was a special birthday treat, and have a touch of luxury - I was left a little underwhelmed and disappointed.

title: Apple apartments, Strand
text: We stayed in the Stratford's sister apartments in the Strand. The apartment was clean, modern, quiet (with excellent double glazing) and excellent service. Minor quibbles were that there was no way of signalling that we didn't need room service (because no "do not disturb" door hanger was provided) and that the central controls for the air con, TV, and MP3 player were too complicated and didn't always work. The kitchen was adequate, and the white goods supplied good quality. Being in the Strand meant the location was excellent. We'd definitely stay again.

title: Your very own private lavish apartment without paying a fortune!
text: Did you ever wish you could stay in the heart of London in your own private apartment without paying a fortune? No rental contracts, no estate agents, free from the shackles of contractual commitment? All the modern cons and the luxurious feel? Well, Apple Apartment at the Strand is the perfect place. The location is right across Somerset House, and a 10 minute stroll from Trafalgar square. Covent Garden throwing distance from the apartment, what more could you ask for?The building has a beautiful Grade II listed facade, on entering the building you don’t feel you are at a hotel nor an office, but more like a lobby area for a residential accommodation. The building’s name is Marconi and it used to house the BBC’s first radio broadcast. The reception staff are very friendly and professional. The apartment itself is finished to a high standard. The bathroom has a clever technological trick up its sleeve – a TV in the shower! The bathroom supplements are Clarins products, which is fantastic. The corridor leads you past the bedroom, which has an impressive sliding sheet of glass, giving that extra va va voom factor. The bed is so comfortable and ample cushions for any cushion enthusiast. There is an iron, iron board and hairdryer in the cupboard. No safe though. Moving along the corridor you have the open plan kitchenette and lounge area, all finished with a high standard and 40 inch TV, with a nexus tablet on the table if needed. The kitchen itself, has a brand new oven, new high tech fridge and all the cutlery one would expect in a self catering apartment. The whole apartment was very clean and made you feel right at home. Only let down, was the central electronic mechanism, which controlled the surround sound, comfort cooling etc that did not work. Also in the room you have a menu card from the adjoining 5 star ME London hotel restaurant STK. So those who want pure indulgence can opt for a superb meal from them. In short: This luxurious apartment / sort of hotel is perfectly located centrally within walking distance to most main attractions. Its clean, spacious, lavish and the front of house staff are very friendly and for the price its one of the best. Getting there: Trafalgar Square Tube station or Temple Tube station. Top tip: Book an apartment facing a London attraction. Give a miss: Nothing really. Suggestion: If you need a coffee with some lovely Italian pastries, head out right from the main building, turn on your first right, cross the road you will see Fratelli coffee shop, great coffees!

title: location location location !!!
text: The apartments are situated virtually opposite the Lyceum Theatre. Covent Garden is literally a few minutes walk and there are plenty of restaurants / pubs right on your door step. We booked the 2 bed apartment (2 adults and 2 children) for two nights. Our first impressions were 'this is smaller than we thought it would be' but soon got used to the layout. The 2nd bedroom is small but the main bedroom was fine with a very big ensuite with all mod cons. With a little more thought - the layout of these apartments could have been soooo much better. The furniture / kitchen is top quality and everything worked fine. Apartment was very clean although the maid service after the 1st night was limited (forgot bedroom 2 completely). Saying this, we would definitely stay again and the apartments are excellent value for money.

title: First class serviced apartment in prime location
text: I stayed here on business in February 2014. The building itself is very secure. You need to be buzzed in by the receptionist and then you are given a pass which allows you to come and go from the building as you please. The receptionist is very helpful and offered to organise theatre tickets or restaurant reservations. The building had the feel of being discreet and pretty exclusive. I had booked a one bed apartment. The apartment was extremely well kitted out. There was a long hallway leading to a lounge / galley kitchen area. The lounge had a nice flat screen TV with free view stations, a comfortable couch and a small dining table. The kitchen was very well laid out and had quality fridge, hob, microwave and washer / dryer (Miele appliances in the main). It had everything I needed. As a nice touch there were some fresh flowers, bottled water and apples in the room on my arrival. There are some nice restaurants in the area. There was a menu in the room which offered a selection from these restaurants which could be organised via reception. A comfortable bedroom led off the hallway. This was partitioned from the hallway by large sliding glass panels. The bathroom was modern and finished to a high standard. All lights were operated via a tablet. One surprising feature of the apartments is how quiet they are. I couldn't believe that I had found somewhere so calm in the centre of London. The location was great. The theatre district is on the doorstep and Covent Garden and the British Museum are a short walk away. Holborn Tube Station was about a 5 minute walk away and so I had no trouble getting to my meeting in City of London. I will definitely return next time I need a base in central London.

title: Luxurious apartment
text: We stayed at a one-bedroom apartment. The place was luxurious. It was equipped with full air-conditioning, washing machine and dryer (and its detergent), heated towel rack, oven, kitchen hob and hood, kitchen utensils, dishwasher and refrigerator. It even have waterproof tv monitor in its main bathroom. There is a Tesco shop nearby and you can buy almost everything there. From the apartment, moving around was easy. You can get London bus to Oxford Street (10 min journey), you can go to the embankment area (just in front of the apartment), 30 min. walking time to the Big Ben, Trafalgar Square, Victoria Embankment park etc. It is quite a problem to get to the apartment via cab. Our cab driver did not know the exact location hence we were going around to look for the apartment. What suppose to be a GBP15 trip from Paddington area, costs us GBP28 instead.You have to mention Aldwych to your cab driver. From 5 pots provided for cooking purpose, only one can be used at the kitchen hob, as the hob required magnetized bottomed pot. We ended up using only one pot to cook a 3 course meal.

title: Excellent
text: Excepting the iphone dock that did not work. The rest was perfect. Nothing to say. The location, comfort, cleanliness, sleep quality, ....etc... I recommend it for family weekends as professional travel

title: Review of the STRAND apple apartments.
text: We stayed at the sister apartments on the Strand. Initially very hard to find, called the number on my confirmation email and expected to get reception but got some woman in a general call centre somewhere else. She was still very helpful and we got there in the end. Defo more of a residential feel than hotel-esk but can't complain because it was all lovely! Slightly confusing following a booking specified for 3 adult guests and arrived at a one bed apartment with no sofa bed, pictures on the booking page specifically under the 3 guest section show pictures for a huge 2 bed duplex apartment which is not what we turned up at! The apartment is beautifully furnished and would be perfect for a couple, I was staying with my mum and 78 year old grandmother who I had brought on a trip to the west end as an Xmas present and obviously would not have expected them to sleep on the floor!! Some transparency and clarity when booking would be beneficial for future guests, I rechecked the booking.com advertised page incase it was me being dozy (not unheard of!) but it wasn't, this is not very clear at all. Still, location is ideal for the WestEnd, the one bed we did have was comfortable and the apartment itself is lovely. Few lights out in the bathroom which made getting ready abit of a struggle with not much lighting. I would stay here again with my partner for sure, but if I could do this trip again, I wouldn't be staying with apple apartments, £250 is abit steep for a night on the floor!

title: The Strand, Depends on the rate you pay. Don't expect soul
text: I stayed at Apple Apartments on The Strand for one night. I paid £250, which is now becoming just about as cheap as you can get for quality in London. The value was, I guess OK, no more. It has no soul. On entering you are met with a bank style lobby and two guys who are more like security than reception. The apartment was clean and comfortable but bare. There was no way to contact reception, to tell them that the iPad type controller was not working - so music, air con etc not controllable. The location is good if you want to be in the Aldwych/theatre/ opera house area, which I did. Wouldn't be so good for shopping in Oxford a Street or West End. I felt I was living in a flat with strangers rather than a nice hotel. I would only go back if I could get same rate or lower, which looks unlikely on most booking sites. It just didn't feel like a very welcoming type of place.

title: Fabulous Boutique Hotel
text: This is in a great location in Hammersmith - near to exhibition halls, restaurants and bars. The hotel is above a classy bar / restaurant and the room is decorated tastefully. Everybody in the hotel was very friendly. I didn't eat, however the breakfast looked very tasty and was being freshly prepared.

title: Great friendly pub hotel
text: Stayed here with family in February for a weekend break. Staff were very friendly and the rooms were very spacious and clean. There were a great selection of beers in the pub to chose from and the food in the bar was nice too. Would highly recommend a stay here when visiting London.

title: Our stay
text: Perfect!! The restaurant and bar were great and our stay was amazing . Everyone who worked at the hotel and restaurant were great. The food was amazing. Thank you so much for the great stay. We are going to be back!

title: Great Stay...
text: Have just returned from a two night stay, originally booked last August as I was attending Walker Stalker London at Olympia, the description said it was 0.2 miles from the venue and it couldn't be closer which was perfect after a long day spent at the event! When we arrived Friday night the bar was noisy and I was a bit apprehensive about noise levels but I have to say the room was very quiet. It was clean, modern and quiet. I had breakfast both mornings which was great and also dinner last night which was also very nice. If the convention is back next year I'd definitely stay again!

title: A memorable weekend
text: My husband and I stayed here for two nights and celebrated my son's wedding in the function room. Firstly, our bedroom was clean and comfortable (where did you get those lovely pillows?) and the bathroom was brightly lit. I was so pleased to see a coffee machine, with plenty of coffee provided. Breakfast was excellent and the choice varied. The staff were all so helpful, Pat ensured my son's wedding party was hassle free, all the staff were friendly and, although we kept them busy, always smiling. I don't hesitate in recommending the Hand and Flower for accommodation and functions. Thank you all for making this a special weekend for our family.

title: A quality of stay of 2 halfs
text: I visited this hotel in February. The good points were the politeness of the staff, the breakfast and the cleanliness of the room. The poor points include the road noise is heavy and even with the curtains closed to some would be intrusive secondly the basin had one of those push down pugs that didn't work so the basin didn't hold the water plus the majority of the holes in the shower head was blocked by hard water scale so shower quality was poor

title: Great place with loads of character and all mod cons.
text: I was a little bit wary about the potential noise in a room over a pub on a busy road next to a station but other reviews reassured me & they were right - I had a great night's sleep even with the window open. Very helpful staff, an espresso machine in the room (bonus!) and a decent breakfast. The only slight gripe is that I kept the curtains closed most of the time as my room (The Sully) was a bit of a goldfish bowl. I chose the Hand & Flower because it's just a short walk from the Hammersmith Apollo & looked more interesting than chain hotels in the area. I'd definitely stay again.

title: a great stay
text: The hotel was the perfect location, the staff were helpful and friendly, great room (nice and quiet), and was lovely breakfast (happily surprised. will stay again next time we come to London.. and it was a great price too

title: Handy place with good quality accommodation at fair prices.
text: I've stayed here several times when on business in West London. Always found a friendly welcome and good clean rooms. Bar gets busy in the evenings but the rooms are quite quiet. The Hand and Flower is on my go to list.

title: Disappointing Food and Service
text: I took a friend who was travelling in London to this pub for lunch thinking its menu looks very appealing at the door, hoping it will become my local favorite too. There were only two tables including ours in the dining area. Not once any of the staff ask if we needed more drinks nor if ht e food was okay. Service was appalling - no smile nor appreciation. You need to pay for bread. Food was totally lack of seasoning and overcooked. I know I will not be coming back, and will warn all my friends not to bother.

title: A 1 night business stay
text: This was sold as some sort of luxury room but it was reallt nothing of the sort. It was okayish but he room was a bit tired and shabby. It also faced out onto the main road so there was a lot of traffic noise. They forgot to provide shampoo and shower gell and I had to go downstairs to ask for it. The staff though were friendly and helpful.

title: A great option for West London
text: We were very happy with our stay at the Hand & Flower. On arrival we were pleased to see our room was spacious and well appointed, with a modern bathroom. Although it didn't have air conditioning it did have a nice full sized standing fan which we made good use of given it was the middle of summer. The manager was very friendly and gave us some helpful tips. The highlight was breakfast on Sunday morning, probably the best hotel breakfast I have ever had. I had the Hand & Flower full English, and my wife had the regular full breakfast. Very tasty. The hotel is in a good location, especially if you are staying on the weekend when the Kensington Olympia station is open. It's only a five minute walk, tops. You're also only a 15 minute walk from the massive Westfield shopping complex at Shepherd's Bush.

title: An original stay in London
text: I use to stay in London for business and after some standard fully of stars accommodation I decided to move to the hand and flowers. I have known them because I had a very nice and British dinner, but after I got that as hotel as well was really fine. There is more than all you need to have a nice comfortable stay in London. The rooms are well furnished, all the staff are really nice and they all their best to let you fell as t home. I love this place and I am looking forward to stay there again. Thanks!

title: Perfect location
text: Staff were very friendly and helpful Room over the road was noisy but this isn't unexpected for central London. Only 3 hooks in room on which to hang clothes - no wardrobe or drawers. I was staying 9 nights and had formal clothes for business, so had to use doors and curtain rails as wardrobes. Standard of cleanliness was high.

title: REALLY NICE STAY
text: We choose this Hotel for a week holiday. The room and service was really nice. Very comfy bed. Nespresso coffe Machine in the room was a plus. We found it was a bit far from underground stations ( as Kensington Olympia did not have any trains, we should use Baron´Court 10min walk or West Kensington 15min walk). Hotel really clean and very well isolated from pub downstairs.

title: Everything we wanted
text: We stayed at this lovely little pub whilst visiting the Olympia Christmas Horse Show and it was just perfect, not just for its location but also for the great atmosphere in the pub area, lovely rooms and food of a very high standard. Nothing was too much trouble for the staff and I'd definitely recommend the Hand and Flower and will stay there again if in that part of London.

title: Quaint Hotel With Friendly Staff
text: Everything at The Hand and Flower was wonderful. They let me check in several hours early as I arrived to London in the morning, which allowed me to freshen up and spend the day unburdened by luggage. It really made my whole day. The room was lovely, warm, and clean, and all the staff I interacted with were delightful. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Unbearable without air conditioning in July
text: I really wanted to like this small inn above a pub, but as we stayed in late July and with no air and very little airflow it was completely unbearable. The weather was low 80's F / high 20's C which was apparently unusually warm. It did cool off at night, but this only helped a little as the rooms have no way to air out. We really should have left, but hotels were very full when we visited and we needed a 'family room' that slept 4. The last night was the worst and we slept with bags of ice next to us to get through. The staff was very helpful otherwise and the food in the pub was excellent. The rooms are quiet, and the pub is family friendly. The location is ok but not great. The area felt safe and we walked at night as a family. There is a movie theater and restaurants within walking distance. The pub is located a half block from the Kensington Olympia tube station but this station is not on the line that goes to the main tourist sites (Buckingham Palace/Big Ben/Tower of London). You have to transfer, which can take longer at some times of day then taking the 10-15 min walk to Kensington High St . Station which has more direct access. The tubes also have no air and a 20-30 min ride to the sites gets uncomfortable quickly. Most places we went were on the district line between South Kensington and Westminster. When arriving we took the tube from Heathrow to Earls Court and made 2 small transfers to get to Olympia. The full trip took over an hour. The inn is a bit worn down with badly stained carpet but the bathrooms were in a good shape and the paint fairly fresh. We stayed in 2 different rooms. The beds were quite comfortable. The shower in one had good pressure and temp, but in the other was poor. Staff is helpful with requests - you need to ask for irons, hair dryer, more soap etc. The 1st room was in the front of the building and we had to open the window due to heat which subjected us to a flashing neon sign all night.

title: Great room, location & pub
text: Visited for 2 nights. Room immaculately clean. Bed very large & comfortable. Great little touches like a free beer, snacks & proper coffee machine in the room. Location is opposite Olympia & central London is fairly quick. Food is pub plus downstairs, fresh & well prepared. Menu particularly good if you like Vegan or Healthy dishes. Recommended.

title: Simply Brilliant!
text: From the friendly arrival to the stress free check out this trip was a pleasure from start to finish. We had breakfast and a couple of evening meals in the pub, all smashing, beans could be hotter! Room was as warm as the welcome, however there was an air con unit, as much ice as we needed and opening windows. Comfy, clean large bed, great housekeeping and a quirky room with character, tiny bathroom but very clean and a nice powerful shower. Free wifi and a tv positioned to watch from the bed comfortably. Ideal for Olympia and on the train station for travelling. Not sure about parking as we taxied in from Heathrow. Don't want to write this as I want to keep the place to myself!!! Well done Lee and all crew, we are not fans of coming to London and you more than made up for this. 10/10

title: Great London Pub/Hotel
text: Stayed overnight for the London Edge show at Olympia. The room was very good, nice bed, clean spacious bathroom and good facilities. The pub is excellent with fantastic food! Including one of the best English Breakfasts I've ever had. Even the black pudding was spot on and that's coming from a Lancashire lad! The staff were extremely friendly and efficient and I would recommend to anybody. No lift though so no good for anybody with difficulties on stairs. Overall 10 on 10 from me.

title: Perfect for Olympia but a little noisy
text: Stayed in "Sully", which was a lovely big room with comfy bed and good bathroom. Noisy overnight for someone used to sleeping in the country, but the short stroll across to Olympia was a big plus. Great eggs benedict for breakfast.

title: 2 night stay
text: The stay at this venue was excellent - the room was clean and comfortable and the staff were very helpful - the only drawback was no lift so the venue is unsuitable for elderly or disabled - I would definitely stay here again

title: Nice pub/hotel, poor, poor staff
text: Staff are totally disinterested, especially when these are the people responsible for greeting and closing a guest's stay. Food is very poor (breakfast). Rooms are nice. It's an old hotel next to a railway line, but it's cosy and clean.

title: Hand & Flower
text: We regularly use this hotel when staying in London and thoroughly enjoy it. Spacious rooms, comfy beds and a lively bar. Conveniently situated close to Olympia and with good bus and train routes. They have recently improved the breakfast service. staff are very pleasant and helpful.

title: Superb quality food
text: When we ordered we thought prices were expensive. But we ordered one between two and the server was excellent and split the single order between us - separate plates and cutlery. We each had more than adequate,excellent meal and will look forward to returning. Well done.Can't recommend highly enough.

title: Nice room poor cleanliness
text: Room was nice and modern, confy beds and nice tea and coffee facilities. No lift so not very good with babies. Toilet was dirty, and there was a bug walking in the bathroom. We move the twin beds to put them together and there was rubbish under the beds.

title: Fantastic location, lovely room and attentive staff!
text: My room was clean, comfortable and just what I needed, but the best part was the amazing breakfast in the morning! Would definitely recommend staying here and will look to stay again next time I'm in the area. :)

title: Absolutely great stay
text: Clean room, tea/coffee facilities in the room, comfortable beds and great breakfast. And very friendly staff!City centre is very close: Hyde Park is thirty minutes by foot or fifteen by bus. Bus station Kensington Park is situated just near the entrance of the hotel.The only problem could be that there is no lift, only stairs as it is not a modern building.

title: Clean, convenient and professional
text: Perfect location for Olympia, staff very friendly and helpful. The breakfast is always very good, although as I was on business, I didn't have time to indulge on this trip. Room clean and cleaners very good. Would have been convenient to have a small fridge in the room to keep some fresh milk, juices etc.

title: Great location, room dated and noisy traffic can be heard in room
text: stayed for one night as visiting the olympia - great location for this but room was dated and the traffic from the busy road meant I didnt get a peaceful nights sleep. The radiator didnt warm up the room either. The ipod dock / speaker was for 1st / 2nd generation so not very useful.

title: Ideal family room
text: We had the pleasure of staying here for a few nights with our two girls, age 6 and 11. I had read all the past reviews and despite some 'odd' past negative reviews we were still happy to book here. Unlike others we found the nearby station always to be open (our stay was Tuesday to Thursday) with a little help from a 'Tube station ' app we easily made our way around the many sights of London. Yes, there are lots of stairs to get to the room, but in the context of a London trip where one spends a lot of time up and down the stairs of the Underground, they really weren't an issue. Breakfast was lovely, with the chef quite happy to make my daughter's fried egg face with bacon smile each morning. The staff were happy to deal with all requests that we made. They do not keep the hairdryers in the rooms because people were stealing them!! but happily produce one on request. The room had a heater which could be controlled by the occupier so the room was warm to out taste. There were plenty of power points to use to charge various items and even a Play Station for the children. All in all this room was ideal for families and an ideal base for sight seeing in London.

title: Good location and Average room
text: Really nice to be near the Olympia for biz, room is good but I hate carpets and thick curtains Toilet chair was shaking, I paid 140 pound and they did not accept that I paid through the website, need to check when I am back if I did not pay more or twice, never had this before. The pub down stairs is nice, you can drink and go to bed, there are also some Indian and Persian restaurants down stairs , will try them tomorrow

title: One night stay in London
text: Warm welcome, a couple of hours early but able to leave luggage. "Peacock" room was large, clean and comfortable with a kitchen / dining area but warm to say the least. The large state of the art fan only rubbed salt in the wound by informing us that the room was 33 degrees! Breakfast was perfect, great choice and fresh. Manager was friendly and gave us tips of where to go for brief walk before catching our coach home. Would happily stay again now we know how close it is to tube / railway stations. Altogether a traditional pub with great accommodation.

title: Friendly and cosy
text: The Hand and Flower staff are really friendly, the room was spacey, homely and clean. The breakfast was impeccable, high quality, well cooked and filling. The location is great and the pub was buzzing with people in the evening - without disturbing the calm of the room. A very nice small hotel, indeed.

title: Great location and value
text: Great nights at the Hand and Flower in London. Easy to get to the tube and on busy bus route. Room was spacious and clean. Everything was excellent! Everyone was friendly and helpful in the pub downstairs from check in to chatting and recommendations to check out, and holding our luggage before and after. We did not eat at the pub, but the menu looked good.

title: Duncan Baker-Brown
text: I had a wonderful stay. My room was delightful with an amazing view in three directions. The food, both supper and breakfast, was excellent, and the service was excellent as well. All s taff were charming and the building was beautiful.

title: Lovely place to stay
text: Very welcoming and friendly. I was travelling solo but felt very at home and at ease. There was a good selection of food on menus both in the evening and at breakfast. The location for me was excellent as I was visiting Olympia.

title: Birthday celebration.
text: Everything was so good. We liked it all and will very much like to return. The staff were all very helpful. We also visited the restaurant once and liked it very much. We*ll rekommend the hotel to our friends.

title: Lovely little hotel
text: This hotel was situated right opposite Olympia which was ideal for us as we were attending an event there. We thought the road would be an issue but it didn't appear to be. Staff were very welcoming and polite.

title: Pleasant stay and such friendly staff.
text: Chose this hotel as we were heading to Olympia exhibition centre. Didn't realise how perfect the hotel was - right opposite to the enterance and the train station. Dinner and breakfast was lovely. The staff were so helpful. Would definitely recommend and will definitely be back.

title: Unfortunatley the Sunday Roast was not on, but still had a good meal.
text: Really wanted a Sunday roast before leaving England, but unfortunately there was an ordering mishap, so it wasn't on. Instead we ordered from the menu and the food was great. Loved the chirizo and chicken pie that came with a pint of beer, and the beer battered fish and chips was also solid. Service was really friendly and apologetic that there was no roast on.

title: NICE STAY
text: Good location for Olympia and for general transport links such as buses and tube . The room was lovely and spacious with an huge bed and an interesting coffee machine ? Overall a very nice experience !

title: A disappointing stay
text: My husband and I had looked forward to staying in one of Fullers hotels,we were very disappointed. We arrived to find the hotel reception was in fact the end of the public bar - not very satisfactory when credit cards are being used . Worse was to come, two steep sets of stairs to climb, carrying our luggage. Our room was pleasant,but the traffic noise continued throughout the night making sleep difficult. The bathroom was the smallest we had ever seen, we are not large people, had we been we would have been unable to get in or out of the room! On a positive note, the included continental breakfast was very good indeed. The hotel is very near to Olympia, but certainly not worth £125 per night for what are, in effect, rooms above a pub.

title: Great room and location
text: We stayed here for one night for business and found the hotel very enjoyable. The room (we stayed in "Marmaduke", which has a double bed and is on the top floor) was great. A comfy bed, beautiful bathroom with a bath, coffee&tea facilities and basically everything you could wish for in a room. The rest of the hotel is also great, although we were a bit disappointed with the cafe/restaurant, which - although it looks wonderful - closes at 23:00 at a Thursday night and doesn't serve any food after 22:00. Fortunately for latecomers like us, there are some other dining options nearby which serve until midnight. Continental breakfast is included in the price and comprises of toast, butter, jam, sweet rolls, some apples, orange/apple juice and coffee/tea. At extra cost it is possible to order English breakfast, eggs Benedict, etc. Besides from porridge with honey there was no vegetarian option. We were pleasantly surprised when we found out we did not have to pay extra for the eggs and bacon we had ordered besides our continental breakfast. The hotel was perfectly located for us, but the fact that it's right next to a train station (Kensington Olympia) is a bit misleading as we found that almost no trains passed through there and were forced to take the tube anyway. No problem of course, as it's only a 10 minute walk to the nearest station, but something to consider before booking. The hotel does not have any European plugs available for its guests.

title: Weekend break
text: This is the second time we have stayed here for a short city break. The location is ideal for all sightseeing, really close to all public transport routes. We had the same room for both visits. Breakfast is served in the bar area, a varied selection on the menu, the full English breakfast was very good .Very friendly and efficient staff. I'm not one for leaving reviews usually, however the customer service I have experienced this visit has gone above has beyond. I realised when I returned home that I had left something behind. Not a very important item but mattered to me. I emailed them and got a very quick response from Nikola letting me know the item had been found and would be returned to me by post. I offered to pay the postage but was told it wouldn't be necessary. In this day and age when we're all so ready to complain, it is just as, if not more important to commend too. I will definitely return here for my next visit.

title: Another enjoyable stay
text: Decided, with my friend we would take our hubby's here as we enjoyed our stay so much last time she and I went. Rooms as usual up to expectations, very clean etc. Food, altho' choice limited as unusually busy for New year's eve, eve. both fish and chips and veggie burger good as was the beer.Staff very friendly. Would recommend this pub even (as we did) walked the 6+ miles to get there from Victoria, via a few sites!! Can be done with changes on tube or buses etc as it is a little way out. Was advised, after paying £135 per room, it sometimes goes down by half. worth checking the prices throughout the year.

title: Great Stay Ideal for Olympia
text: Stayed at the Hand and Flower last week as I needed to be at the Olympia Exhibition center early morning the next day. Me and a colleague stayed in one of the 'luxury' twin rooms as the hotel was fully booked so we decided to share. The hotel is located above a very very busy and noisy (but nice) pub - the pub closes at 11pm though so sleep wasn't a problem. Check in was quick and easy and our bags were carried up to our room for us. I was so surprised by the standard of the room! I thought for the price we paid, it wouldnt be that great but we were wrong. Would rather stay here when I am in London from now on as rooms are much nicer than a Premier Inn or Hilton. Little bit quirky and nice home furnishings made the room very pleasant to stop in. The pub/hotel is located on a very busy main road but the super thick curtain in the room muffled the noise from outside. The beds were very comfortable and extra pillows and throws were provided. All your usual tea and coffee facilities were available in the room and the bathroom was high quality fixtures and large soft towels. Breakfast the next morning was fantastic, served quickly and all cooked really nicely. All the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. Location for the exhibition centre is excellent - literally over the road! We paid £135 for 1 nights B&B for 2 of us, which considering the location is a bargain! Will be booking again soon.

title: A real find!
text: We stayed for one night and found the H&F comfortable and convenient. We came into Paddington Station and had tickets for the Albert Hall - both of which were only a short bus journey away, and of course it's 10-15 mins away from lovely Kensington High St and handy for all the South Kensington museums. We arrived early, left our bags and enjoyed some tea and coffee on the house. It was raining and we were offered the loan of umbrellas for whilst we were out and about. Both gestures were really appreciated. We stayed in 'Feathers' - a lovely deluxe double room in a quiet spot at the top and back of the pub. There were a few flights of stairs to go up (3?) but it was worth it - and we only had overnight bags. The bed was supremely comfortable, there was a windows we could open, TV, free wifi, a good shower and all the complimentary bit and bobs provided. On check out the next morning, after a delicious cooked breakfast,I remarked that a small mirror in the room would be useful (there was a large one on the back of the bathroom door) and both staff agreed enthusiastically and said they would be onto it. Altogether this is exactly the sort of place we love to stay in. A million miles away from bland hotel chains and, if you don't get back too late, there's a drink or two to be had in the bar just downstairs from your room!

title: Great stay...
text: Nice room, great bed, lovely staff, great location for Olympia. Busy bar downstairs with great atmosphere but as I was on top floor, wasn't affected by the noise in the bar. Good pub grub available in the bar.

title: Great London stopover
text: Upon entering the H&F main bar was buzzing, the staff were friendly and the room was tidy. We stayed in the Feather room, which could do with a coat of paint but was very comfortable. The H&F was very reasonable at £120 per night including breakfast which was very tasty and generous with seemingly unlimited coffee. All in all I would strongly recommend!

title: Slow service. Don't come if you want an efficient experience.
text: It took them over half an hour to serve our meals... when we folled up they just kept saying it was on thr way. People that arrived after us were served and finished their meals before ours were even served. When they arrived, they were luke warm and the rib eyes were hard as leather. Don't come here if you want a good pub experience.

title: How Hot
text: When I checked in at 5pm I was in a hurry and whilst I was aware the room was very warm I did assume that it would cool down in the evening. When I returned at 12.30am the room was even hotter. There are no telephones in the rooms so as the pub downstairs was closed I had no idea how to get hold of a member of staff nor was I even aware if there was one on duty. The only window in the room was a full height window opening out onto a flat roof, this was also the fire escape. The room was so hot that I had no choice but to sleep with this open all night. Not great as a woman on your own in London ! Obviously I hardly slept, there was no water in the room so at about 3am I went to rinse my hands to try to cool down. The bathroom water is obviously tank fed and it wasnt just warm is was terribly hot and I ran it for several minutes and it was still warm. The room was lovely and a bottle of water and a fan would have made the visit bearable.

title: A pub for the wealthy
text: This watering-hole is almost opposite Olympia. It has quirky decor and a wide variety of seating that will suit every size of buttock. The beer is expensive as is the food, but if you don't mind paying extra you will always find space in here to watch your favourite sport on tv. PS I didn't know this was a hotel, it looks just like a pub to me....

title: Great place for a drink
