text: My London office is not far from here and I normally stay at the Hilton over the road. This Fuller's pub has a great selection of beers on tap and reasonably priced (for London) tasty food. On a summers evening the footpath will be choked with happy drinkers enjoying the sunshine. This is on my must visit list whenever I work in London.

title: Lovely weekend break
text: I have just spent two nights at this super pub whilst visiting London for a friend's wedding. The staff were great, friendly and helpful. The room was clean and the bed was very comfortable. the TV worked. The Wifi was quick and always available throughout the building. We had a very tasty breakfast, well cooked and plenty of it. Many thanks to all at the Hand and Flower! Super location - close to Olympia Overline and a short walk from Hammersmith station and the river.

title: Just the job
text: Good location in London, especially for Olympia. With a combination of traditional and contemporary features and atmosphere it is a great place from with to explore London, and also enjoy the best beer in the world - Fuller's London Pride. Breakfast was impressive and pleasant, with the cooked breakfast specially prepared for each guest. The Hand & Flower is just good all round and relatively economic (for London). Travel is from the nearest overground station (Kensington Olympia), pretty good for embarking on explorations of the capital

title: Comfortable eclectic lodging across from Olympia
text: I attended a conference at Olympia and found the Hand and Flower extraordinarily convenient. Unlike other lobbies, this is a full service pub - so meeting colleagues could not have been more pleasant! The interior has a unique charm, with 19th century portraits, high ceilings and individually decorated rooms.

title: Great location
text: Was going to Olympia for good food show so this hotel is perfect location. Stayed here for the past 3 years and will be back again. Rooms are very clean and the staff are always friendly. Very busy pub but it does close at 11pm so you still get a good nights sleep.

title: Great cosy place to eat & stay
text: Booked for Walker Stalker Weekend excellent location, friendly service, great atmosphere with lovely food choices. Would recommend. Would stay here again, ideal for weekend stay, central & comfortable.

title: Leisure and Olympia Show
text: Was looking for somewhere close to Olympia and The Hand and Flower is literally opposite it was pricey for a pub but then this is London. When arrived we had a warm welcome they had our booking to hand and were quickly shown to our room "The Siddons" which was a twin room. The room was very spacious with 2 large box sash windows looking out to the view of Olympia. The beds were very comfortable but the 2 pillows were pretty useless. The room was very warm even though the outside temperature was not exceeding 20oC during the day. There is an air cooler provided in the room but wasnt working correctly on closer inspection the next morning you could see that it probably had never been cleaned or topped up with water once done it was now giving cooler air.(surely this should be checked daily by staff if they are providing them). The overal cleanliness was very good but detail was missed the sink plug was disgusting, on the subject of the bathroom it should have been a good size but someone decided to put a shower bath in the room which made using the toilet not quite impossible or at least not the easiest. The sink stuck out a lot also so it was difficult to get changed in the bathroom after a shower (impossible to be able to put socks on anyway). The room was noisey at night but then it is on a main road, fairly sure the windows were single glazed. The breakfast was ok but nothing special, perhaps a little choice of cereals and croissants wouldnt be to much to ask. The pub itself was great, it was nice to sit downstairs and have a pint of Fullers when you get served. The second evening one of the staff had to ask someone to serve us about 4 times before he finally did. So beds comfortable, very noisey from traffic at night and the bathroom is designed badly. However I did fail to mention there was a coffee machine in the room which was a nice touch and the staircase was stunning but sadly more needs to be done with bathroom and windows.

title: Lovely accomodation
text: We stayed here from 19th - 22nd Feb whilst exhibiting at Olympia. The location was PERFECT! We stayed in the Siddon's room and it was rather noisy due to external traffic but was a lovely room and with the best coffee machine! The food was good too although I asked for a fish Finger Sandwich twice and it was unavailable twice! The breakfast is FABULOUS! The staff were great and were super helpful. I would stay here again on business but also for pleasure too!

title: Wonderful staff,great stay.
text: We have just returned from a one night stay at The Hand and Flower Hotel.We were greeted by Craig,who was very helpful and carried our luggage right to the top floor.We had the family room,which has very comfortable,clean beds.Breakfast was excellent,eggs benedict to die for!.Overall,a wonderful stay,and we will be back.Cheers Craig and the friendly bar staff.

title: Great location and Clean room
text: A small hotel very close to the Olympia hall. The rooms are above the pub and are large and clean. The staff is very friendly. Please note that rooms facing the street suffer from the traffic noise even at night.

title: Quaint and Characterful.
text: From the moment we arrived to checking out the staff were great. This pub is full of charm and gives you the personal touch you don’t always feel in large hotels. This is obviously a popular place because it gets quite busy with a good atmosphere. Breakfast excellent. Would definitely stay again. The only negative would be 20 min walk from nearest underground station.

title: Great location, service, rooms and breakfast, but bring earplugs
text: The location is perfect if you are attending Olympia. The room was very nice, very clean and decorated to a high standard. The breakfast, which was included, was also excellent. I had a well prepared English breakfast which was generous in size and flavour. Now onto some negatives. You need to check in at the down stairs bar. The pub was showing the World Cup so it took over 20 minutes to reach the bar and a further 10 minutes to get the attention of a staff member. The staff were very helpful however, and despite being incredibly busy, offered to take my bags up to the room. Next negative - the noise. No noise came from the bar despite the football, but the noise from the main street was unbelievable. Lorries and motorbikes screaming up and down the road until I finally got to sleep at 0400. I would certainly stay there again for the breakfast alone, but I would bring earplugs. On a final note, I really want to reinforce that the staff were welcoming, friendly and efficient considering how busy the bar can be.

title: Nice Hotel on top of pub
text: Very pretty typical hotel near to Chelsea district. Miss a 24/7 reception so is recommended to arrive in open time. Staff did a good work to solve our problem with baggages anyway, I'd like to come back in this inn.

title: Quiet and out of the way.
text: Overall we had a pleasant stay. All the staff at the pub were very nice and attentive. The location of the hotel was a little farther than we would have liked from the typical tourist attractions, but it was quiet and easy to get to. More information about access to management would have been helpful.

title: Busy well run pub/hotel
text: Called in for lunch whilst on business locally after trying a very poor establishment nearby. Busy with a mix of clientele, many of whom had been attending an exhibition across the road at Olympia. Despite the numbers staff were friendly and keep things moving, food and drink pretty good and by London standards reasonably priced. Well worth a visit.

title: large rooms!
text: Stayed here due to working in the area in early June, surprisingly got a double room for £80 via laterooms. There is no parking on site but you can park for free after 8 om on the nearby side street. On arrival check in was a bit slow due to the bar being busy and a young lady member of staff whom was not familiar with checking customers in, however she was pleasant and explained everything clearly. The bedroom was on the second floor, it was huge and fitted out to a high standard including coffee machine, the en suite was lovely and the shower had decent pressure. Breakfast was continental ( they charge for full English ) but there is a nice selection of yogurt, cereals and fruit. Would definitely stay again

title: Excellent stay
text: Stayed for Olympia thought the staff and service were very good breakfast was the best we have had Bed was very good and room clean but we were on the top floor there were 62 steps !! Keeps you fit anyway

title: Great place , great food !
text: We stayed here for a trade show at Olympia and was a perfect find .Room was airy and clean with character with all mod cons .The pub was a lovely pub , friendly with good food and the breakfast was very yummy .The area felt lovely not too busy and just a short walk from all the shops on Kensington High Street.Would definitely stay again .

title: I liked the Hand and Flower
text: The Hand and Flower had very friendly and warm staff, the food was very nice. The wine list was good. I stayed in the, what I think was the Peacock, the luxury Studio @ £155.00. the room (a Studio) was well equipment, I liked the fact that had a Nespresso coffee machine, and a jar of coffee capsules, not just one or two. A wine fridge , fridge etc. It was a very comfortable room / bed. What does needs attention is the peeling paint in the bathroom above the bath/shower. And the shower nozzle needs the heavy scale removing. I would definable stay here again.

title: Late night drinks
text: I find this very disappointing that I am not able to have the choice of which type of Pepis I can have as my mixer..... They only has Pepsi Max on the tap, no bottles of Pepsi I do not like Pepsi Max I like to drink Disserno and full fat Pepsi

title: Superb stay with excellent service
text: We had an excellent stay at the hotel. The staff were friendly and helpful, going above and beyond to make us feel comfortable there. The hotel is also conveniently located, with restaurants, amenities (shops, pharmacy etc.) and underground travel close by. The rooms themselves are spacious and we found the bed to be very comfortable. Our only quibble was that the shower temperature was tepid at best but this wasn't particularly an issue. The inclusive breakfast includes continental and cooked options, which was definitely a highlight of our stay. Superb value for money and we will certainly be returning for our next trip down to London!

title: An excellent place to stay.
text: We stayed in the family room and were very impressed with the room. The staff were all very nice and extremely helpful. Breakfast was cooked to order and set us up for a day of sightseeing. Getting into central London is easy, making this a superb place to stay. We will definitely be staying again.

title: Pub with rooms
text: Booked in with the wife to attend the beer festival and this is the closest accommodation to the venue. The room was clean with a comfortable bed and a reasonable size bathroom. The staff were very helpful and check in was quick even though the pub was busy. Access to the rooms is via a separate entrance, so you don't need to go through the pub. One grumble about the entrance was it was constantly blocked by drinkers standing in the doorway or sitting on the step. People did move out of the way with no fuss, but it may disconcerting for some. The bouncer for the pub did try and keep the entrance clear. The room was very warm (26 degrees), but the windows only open a couple of inches (probably to stop people falling out). There was a remote controlled fan (nice gadget) that helped keep us cool while sleeping. Noise is not too bad considering it is over the pub on a main road. The pub noise was not intrusive, so the traffic noise could be the challenge for any light sleepers (not me). The main downside in the room was the lack of storage space. There is no wardrobe just three hooks for coats with two coat hangars and no cupboards or bedside drawers. We were travelling light, so it was not a major issue, but if you intend to stay for a week or more be warned space is a premium. Breakfast was very good with freshly cooked eggs, good quality ingredients e.g. Herby sausages, thick hash brown and crispy bacon. They were out of black pudding in this occasion, so may be next time. Overall we enjoyed our stay and will use the pub again.

title: Conventions
text: Great room, friendly staff - 3rd time here and won't be last. Breakfast is great - lots of stairs though so not for the unfit. Great location and convenient for Olympia and Earl's Court. Good selection of beers on tap.

title: Great location for London Olympia
text: Just over the road from London Olympia so ideal for a quick drink before entering, although the drinks are not to badly priced the food was a little expensive for what you got, although it was very nice I did feel that £9.00 for a chicken and bacon baguette with the only side dish of coleslaw was pricey. Staff are friendly and there is plenty of seating

title: A wonderful inn and pub!
text: Comfortable and quiet bedrooms, with in room tea and heated towel racks! The pub is also outstanding- wide varieties on tap and fresh local foods. Full breakfast menu as well. It's a little outside the city in a more suburban feeling neighborhood, but there are also great restaurants and public transportation close by.

title: Excellent well run pub and hotel
text: We loved this pub. It's in an excellent location ideally suited for those visiting Olympia. We stayed overnight and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The pub itself is very pleasant inside and serves excellent beer and food. The staff are very friendly and are a credit to the place. Our room was nice and very well appointed. Breakfast was included and was the best breakfast we've had in a long time - no buffet style here - a full English breakfast cooked to order! Special shout to Seamus the Head Chef - a very nice guy.

title: Fantastic location, friendly staff and excellent beer choice!
text: We stayed here for the Great British Beer Festival and we were amazed by this gem! Literally feet from Olympia, this lovely hotel/bar could not have made our stay any better. The staff were all lovely and made our stay most enjoyable. We fancied a night cap after we'd been to the GBBF and obviously lots of other people had the same idea so the bar area was incredibly busy with it being 11pm and after the GBBF but the staff were incredible

title: Nice pub but rooms not for business people
text: Great location for Olympia and good for a 1 night stay but not if you are exhibiting/working as no desk, no wardrobe or drawers for clothes and also extremely hot in room even with windows open. The pub is nice and you can't hear noise from rooms. However there is a function room just below our room and on the Saturday night loud music went on until past midnight which was annoying as we had to be up early Sunday morning for the exhibition.

title: nice for once
text: Charming hotel without elevators. Room has charm but is insanely hot with warm weather (occupied luxury suite on third floor). The lack of decent air conditioning (they provided an extra fan but this isn't enough) is a little disappointment. there is a small kitchen with microwave, toaster and coffee/tea but no fridge. the bathroom is small, your knees touch the bath while seated on toilet. clean but the mold in the ceiling corners is visible, a problem due to insufficient ventilation. the bath has a rain shower and separate hand shower operated by different water taps. the lower one to fill the bath is very difficult to regulate. didn't used breakfast because it was pricey. fast free wifi that requests daily login for a once experience is not that bad, but I won't be returning if I would be attending another event at Olympia. Too priced for the comfort you get.

title: Friendly pub/hotel with lovely rooms and great staff
text: We stayed here after booking a meal at a local Italian. We watched the fa cup final in this friendly pub and really enjoyed it. The staff are so very friendly and made us feel very welcome. The room (pendragon) was lovely with very nice decor and a huge bathroom. The breakfast was well cooked and the waiting staff were most helpful. Would highly recommend this as a place to stay.

title: The Hand and Flower is very cozy
text: My lovely check in lady hauled my heavy suitcase up many nights of stairs for me. I thought that was above and beyond. I loved the coffee and tea set up in my room, the huge towels, really comfortable bed and the truly luxurious bath tub. After long winter walks the thought of that bath got me up the stairs. I liked the closeness to public transportation and it was walking distance from the Design Museum, Kensington High St., Hyde and Kensington parks and some of the museums.

title: Perfect for mid priced business and leisure...
text: I agree with all the positive things previous reviewers have said. Good cooked-to-order breakfast and friendly staff in particular. Will visit again particularly as it is so close to the exhibition centres. Only down (very minor). Never worked out how to put the bath taps on in the Lovatt Room (it shouldn't be that difficult should it?) and no mirror outside the bathroom, which makes it difficult to do hair with electric appliance, and make-up (steamed up) ... but both things are easily put right, and would make the place even better. Thank you for a lovely comfortable peaceful stay...

title: Excellent
text: attended an event at the convention centre, excellent location for it. Warm welcome every day by the staff who were friendly and helpful. Breakfast was absolutely delicious and the hotel rooms were well presented, clean and well maintained. Would definitely return.

title: Lovely Quirky Friendly Hotel and Pub
text: On arrival we were greeted by the very friendly manageress who checked us in quickly despite the pub heaving. Long walk to the top of the building however was eased by quirky Victorian Decor. Room was a suite (Peacock) and was lovely and cosy although because of the old sash windows noise from outside was noticeable. A compromise for originality. Smart TV, Coffee Machine, Wine Storage, Kettle, Toaster, Microwave all in the kitchen. Bath room nice, toilet dripped a little. Went down for dinner which was lovely, and wine, cost around £49 with drinks including starter and main for two people. Breakfast, which was included also lovely - cold buffet, and Hot Meal. We had a english breakfast and kitchen was accomodating to us. Would definitely stay again!!

title: Brilliant
text: lovely place to stay comfy bed and the service was top notch and the breakfast was really nice ! the bathroom was a nice size and the hotel was across the road to were I wanted to go I recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: Suited us
text: I had luckily won a Fuller’s overnight and meal voucher in an auction at a Wooden Spoon rugby charity event. We chose to use the stay at the Hand and Flower because it was very close to the Hammersmith Apollo (we saw Greg Davies). The meal was pretty good and the comp wine went down well. We ambled down to the Apollo in about 15minutes and returned the same way for a late nightcap in the bar. Our room was more of a suite (kitchenette, dining area and bedroom) and although not modern was warm welcoming and had nice touches. Breakfast was pretty good too with a good menu selection of posh eggs as you like them.

title: Characterful Inn
text: A pleasant easy place to rest , extremely comfy bed , lovely period property in a good location . Efficient staff made our stay hassle free , nice nespresso coffee machine in room and adequate breakfast choice

title: Excellent stay
text: Good value hotel close to Kensington Hugh Street. Bus stop over the road takes you into Central London or there is an Overground station at Olympia. Nice cosy room and staff were helpful and friendly.

title: Handy Hand and Flowers
text: Stylish comfortable room. Touching distance from Olympia so perfect location for attending Babyshow. A few more 'normal' tea bags in the room would have been nice but would definitely use again for visit to Olympia.

title: Not as good as our previous stays
text: Not as you have previous had, fell below what we would expect from Fullers, somewhat disappointing. The staff that were working did well but way to under staffed which resulted in poor service. Such a shame as previous experiences have been excellent

title: What a lovely surprise
text: Due to the inability to walk very far and as I had to go to the Beauty Show at Olympia I decided to book into The Hand and Flower, so that the distance I had to travel was minimum. I was very disappointed when I found out that there was no lift. I need not have worried as we were greeted by a very friendly and jovial Craig, who was like a breath of fresh air, picked up all our bags and carried them up all the stairs to our room that was very clean and fresh.. Large enough to accommodate us for our stay and with 2 very comfy chairs a descant writing table and a fantastic bed that gave both me and my wife the best sleep for a long time. Craig whenever we saw him was always cheerful and ensuring we were ok. and even gave us his phone number in case we needed him out of hours and insisted we phone him prior to our departure so that we didn't have to carry our own bags downstairs. The food was good and wholesome, hot and fast. Well done Craig and his team and thanks for a lovely stay.

title: Good Time At The Hand
text: Great service with special mention to Andie Allan for sending us our left belongings. The room was as described and pretty much what we expected. Nice free bottle of beer left for us in too. Decent coffee machine in room.Room was clean and comfortable. We booked for the hotel's position next to Olympia and it's literally right on the doorstep. Real nice bar with good beers and food and a good atmosphere. Our party was two adults and one 14 yr old and we would definitely stay again. Thank you Hand & Flower. Nigel and Maria.

title: Olympia
text: Ideally placed opposite Olympia for the Beer Festival. Good service and excellent breakfast. On top floor with no lift, but at least that meant it was quiet with excellent views! Missing bulbs from the lamps were annoying but otherwise comfortable .

title: Really good pub
text: I visited this pub with a group of business acquaintances on a Thursday lunchtime in October 2016. The pub is close to Olympia, which is the only reason I'd be in the area. Be warned that tubes to Olympia are few and far between - the Overground is your best bet in the week, failing which a taxi. The pub itself is very well presented - beautifully maintained and with an interesting history. My group was sat upstairs. There is a bar up there and the staff manning it were helpful and friendly. My only complaint was that whilst this is a Fullers pub, there was no Honeydew on tap. Perhaps they keep it downstairs. Shame as it is the nicest beer in the world. I had fish and chips for lunch, which were excellent. Meaty fish and crispy batter. Decent chips. The others all went for the burger, which they enjoyed. The menu could have perhaps been slightly more exciting but I suppose one can't cater for all tastes. A variety of pies and some scampi wouldn't have gone amiss though. Overall, this was a lovely pub. It seemed full of suits rather than regulars, but there was a property convention taking place next door. Highly recommended.

title: Great location
text: This was my second stay at Hand and Flower, and I confirm my positive opinion. Friendly staff, good food, comfortable bed. Great location , tube station on the high street is at ten minutes walking, buses stop by the hotel. I will come back.

title: Will stay again, Don't let reviews fool you.
text: If I had read the reviews before i booked our stay here, I would have probably booked somewhere else, spending more money. After reading the reviews I regretted booking this place, and worried the whole time that it was going to ruin our weekend stay in London. I rang the hotel the day before to confirm my booking, which to me is common sense. Some reviews said that their appartment was not available, which could be down to any number of reasons, so always confirm with the hotel on the phone beforehand. The location. A 2 minute walk to the nearest underground station, Kilburn Park, is perfect for anyone wishing to get out and about round London. the area itself is exactly what i would have expected of a central London location. People complaining saying that they didn't feel safe...Where are you from? What do you expect? It's London! There is a Tesco express next door, shops, restaurants, pubs and coffee shops all within a couple minutes walk. Noise. As i have pointed out before this is central London, one of the busiest cities in the world, if you want peace and quiet, go to the countryside. The noise from the pub next door and the main street is minimal. Our hotel room faced Kilburn High Road, the train station only a short distance away, and we didn't even notice it was there. The Hotel. The staff working in the hotel were very friendly, helpful and polite. A 24 hour reception is always a plus. The room itself was clean. The bed was clean, the kitchen and utensils were clean and the bathroom was spotless. There were stains on the carpet, the sofa was old and the bed wasn't the best, but all in all we were very happy. I don't understand how people can let that 'ruin' there stay. What do you expect from an apartment that sees hundreds of people each year moving though it. There is free wifi and a 36 inch TV with freeview, which is nice. All in all, a very good place to stay. Considering most places this central in London cost £150+ a night to stay, this was considerably less and well worth every penny. I will stay here agin in the future, and I 100% recommend So Quartier to anyone wishing to stay in London.

title: DONT BOOK THIS!
text: We booked online basedon their description of being four star and nice looking photos. We were fooled! We arrived and were greeted by a drunk in the lobby who was another guest at the hotel. We checked in, and were sent to an awful room with an old foam mattress, cigarette burns in carpet, it was suffocatingly hot and no a/c. They offered us other rooms (the drunk followed us around the floor but we were told that he was a paying guest and they couldn't do anything about it.) We went from room to room, and it was gross & creepy! Only the bathrooms were nice, which would have been okay if we could sleep in the bathroom! We were told they would keep our full booking amount even if we left. I had a child and my mother with me & it just wasn't safe or clean, so we determined to take our lumps and leave. They advertise this as four star, it's barely a one. Please post it to save others the same misfortune.

title: 3.9.18 - 6.9.18 Clare Court Flat 122
text: This unit is a 2 bedder with 1 bathroom located along Judd St & Tavistock junction. The location is superb. Within 5 minutes walk to nearby Brunswick Centre. There are also a few 24 hours provision shops that sell basic necessities at a higher price. There are also restaurants around. The bldg was built in 1976. The unit is installed with laminated wooden boards. We would say the unit provides minimum essentials of what you need. The 2-in-1 washer cum dryer is gd. Fridge is a stand alone 2 doors fridge. There is a small microwave above the fridge. Please note that there are very few wall sockets especially in the bedroom. Both table lamps in the master bedroom looks like Ikea, but both could not work or no socket around for you to plug into. Only in living room, there are multiple extension chords connected, but we are concern if there would be electrical power loading that might lead to fire. The blanket in master bedroom is like super single size. 2 avg size adults sharing the Queen bed would hv their feet exposed & covered up to chest level only. The bathroom is super tiny. There is barely space for 1 person to stand outside the bath tub. When you take shower, you observe the ventilation fan vents & you would observe that it is filled with thick piles of dust as if it has never been cleaned/vacuumed for ages! Most cabinets or drawers are flimsy particle boards from Ikea & looked old. In fact, the shoe racks facing main door if scattered with electrical items like bulbs, extension chords that not sure if it is working. The cabinet for jackets at the foyer is filled with used paint barrels, brushes, etc. More a store with junks & not usable. There is a porter at the apt’s lobby during 8am to 8pm. They are friendly. The notice board actually displayed a notice by the building mgr that short stay like airBnb or Booking.com is not allowed by the building mgmt & the authority.

title: Good place to stay and a good hotel alternative
text: Turn right at corner like when you come out of the Tesco supermarket, go down the little street and less than approx. 50 meters you will see a small reception with a 24/24 desk service. The reception desk keeper asked us to help us to take up our luggage and show us the apartment which we considered as not necessary. The apartment is clean, recent and well equipped. The only thing I would recommend is to becareful with kids as the windows open very low, approx. 1 meter from the floor.

title: Go Native
text: The hotel is located within the High Street close to local pubs, gym at the basement, cafe's and nearby Supermarkets. As a self catering hotel, the rooms are well presented with very friendly staff. The price is reasonable for the location.

title: Disappointing!!!!
text: We had booked to stay there but when we arrived they told us that we were being moved to another hotel and they our room was not available. We did not want to stay elsewhere as we had booked that location for a reason. We asked to see the manager but he wouldn't see us and kept us waiting for 20mins before authorising the poor receptionist to give us a refund! He avoided facing us and we never even got an apology! We were treated so badly, I would not recommend this place to anyone

title: ****Maida Vale Aparthotel avoid at all costs****
text: ****Maida Vale Aparthotel avoid at all costs**** I've travelled to a lot of different places and stayed in many different hotels. I've flown to locations all across the world but have never experienced such a shabby hotel. I've stayed in a £12 a night hotel in Thailand with lines of ants in the bed, and I've felt cleaner than I did in this hotel. It was so shabby and worn that I couldn't even bring myself to eat in the apartment. Firstly, the pictures that they have on Bookings.com shows a new and modern apartment with one bedroom, a kitchen/dining area, bathroom and seating. I felt so unclean in that apartment I didn't even attempt to sit on the sofa. The bathroom was abysmal, small and not very well laid out. The first time I took a shower and tried to close the shower curtain, the shower rail fell down. It was one of those cheap ones which were held in place by being pressured to the wall. This was not a £100 a night hotel. I wouldn't have paid them £10 a night. This brings me on to the stuffiness of the apartment. I stayed on one of the hottest nights of the year. There was no air-con and only one fan. I had to use that in the bedroom as it was so hot. There were windows, but they opened onto the main street which was extremely noisy. There were these massive 1980's looking radiators dotted around the apartment which were an eyesore. This place was more suited to newly released prisoners who need somewhere to stay before joining the rest of society. It's a crime that booking.com has allowed such a shabby place to be advertised on their website. *The only thing this place had going for it is the location and the customer service skills from the people on the front desk. The service was good, and they were accommodating. I did explain to them whilst checking out how awful the hotel was, but I couldn't fault their service. * In this place the owners have cut all manner of corners to try and save costs. From the decor to the quality of the furniture. Even the kitchen towels screamed cheapness. Staying in this place was like a bad dream. ****AVOID, AVOID, AVOID**** THE PICTURES DON'T SHOW HOW BAD IT IS. Until the owners actually spend money on fixing the issues here, I wouldn't advise anyone to stay here.

title: Barely livable made worse by poor management. Avoid!
text: Booked 4 apartments in the middle of the one of London's worst heatwaves. Could not control the heating in 2 of the apartments and had to turn it off at the fuseboxes. A third (Room 211, a 2 bedroom) apartment only had enough hot water for 2 occupants in a day - the other 2 occupants had to shower in one of our other apartments every day. We complained about this the day we arrived, but the problem was NEVER FIXED throughout our stay (7 nights). The desk manager simply said he had put a ticket through to get it fixed but it never was, and he got quite irate when we asked him about it daily as we came back from our sightseeing. The apartments were old and tired

title: Absolutely avoidable !
text: This place is a complete no! We booked a month and a half in advance. The day manager is grumpy n unwelcoming ...the night Mangaer is a sweet talker but in the end nothing happened ...we booked 2 one bedroom apartment FX ...avoid Lcd 402 it’s like a hostel dump ! We should have read the reviews and avoided the place ! Pathetic experience ! Waste of money with no help !

title: Cozy & clean. Recommend to stay!
text: We stayed there for 16days for a business trip. I brought my family along. The apartment is equiped with all you need. So we cooked breakfast and dinner there. Such a wonderful place to be. Tesco is just next door and we got halak chicken there and loads of halal restaurants and butcher near by. Sainsbury, iceland, M&S, market, 1pound shop, aldi etc... just a walk away. Busses and all train stations are just mins away. The hotel is wonderful but just that we had water heater problem that water became ice cold after 3 bath.. coz the unit is for 4pax. The water will be cold all thru the day till the next morning. Same thing all over again. However the hotel was running full. One more thing.. housekeeping is only once a week so our unit was only cleaned once for the 16days stay. No broom or mop in the room too. The rest of it was perfectly great! Also agreed that the reception lady is not that helpful. The male receptions are so much helpful and friendly. However its so much better the Best Western Maitrise Hotel around the corner with Rude Reception staff. Even after giving feedback the GM replied to favour the staff so.. they will never be better. I would opt for Maida Vale Apthotel anytime... I would recommend ppl to stay here. Its so convinient.

title: Excellent choice to stay in London
text: Awesome choice. Great space for 3. It has a small but very nice kitchen, so, if you want to save some good £, come here, stay, go out, buy your goods and cook without spending a lot. It's very clean, and the Underground station is just a block away. Several grocery and good shops are all around.

title: Very roomy, convenient location,poor maintenance
text: First impression is one of spaciousness as you open the door into another corridoor with 3 doors coming off it....large,modern bathroom, bedroom and living area. bedroom....bed was terrible,heater didnt work,window didnt cloose,venetians broken. living room....nice size,also 4 burner hotplaate,large fridge, undersink washing machine,microwave etc,lots of cupboards,tv,cable etc. broken edging on floor tiles,venetians broken,couch badly worn. if only these people would spent just a few pounds on this place in maintenance, it could be fabulous

title: Perfect holiday home
text: Stayed here for almost a week. Got best deal from Agoda. This place is strategically located in central london, 2mins walk to Kilburn High Road Station and 5mins walk to Kilburn Park and there are many bus stops that are link to many places in London. Upon arrival, the staff was very friendly and very professional and helpful. Once I entered the apartment, I was so happy because it is very clean and spacious. There was an elevator too which makes life easier especially when you have big luggages . ( some service apartments in London do not have elevator, so Im glad this place has) . Tesco is just 1min walk and there was nearby starbucks too. There is a balcony in my apartment and really like that. I will definately stay here again . Its value for money . Its better than staying at the hotel

title: Not What you think stay away
text: This could be a very nice hotel. After a day at work you could relax in a 2 bedroom apartment have a drink and watch some telly. Sadly not the case The furniture in the apartment is disgusting and feels like a cold apartment. The TV channels are poor no sport channels the bedrooms have no tv.s.Imagine you can not relax in bed and watch TV. THERE ARE way better hotels . This place currently is a dump. More like a classy hostel. Fix it up get a loan and it would be a sellout

title: Excellent choice to stay in London
text: I'm at the hotel right now and everything has been perfect. The zone is very safe, the Tube is a block away. We have more than 5 grocery stores around, pubs, restaurants, banks, etc. I read a lot of reviews. All the negative are a lie. The aparthotel is great. We have free Wi-fi, a washing machine, 2 bedrooms, kitchenette, a living room and I'm sure next time we'll stay here. I came with my family, and it's a great choice.

title: Mixed views
text: When entering the room you were met with a stale smoke smell, although it is a non smoking room we were on the first floor with windows opening on to a flat roof which resembled a old ash tray. Then the tv would not work, we pointed this out to which some one was up to sort it out straight away. We were only staying the one night so put up with what was there,if we were staying longer we would have complained. No toilet paper ,both blinds were bent and broken, quite a dangerous edging strip between kitchen flooring and carpet my daughter caught her foot on it twice.Bathroom was very nice clean and modern there was a small chip in bath but no plug and couldn't get shower to work. Kitchen was large but lacked in equipment again no plug for sink no drying up cloth,only three glasses for 4 people. Carpets worn and stained whole please could do with a overhaul. Not somewhere I would recommend .

title: Not nice
text: Had an awful stay. Lots of noise from overground station which kept us awake. We asked for a travel cot for our baby but this didn't happen, staff didn't help. Rooms aren't cleaned often. Very basic rooms with very little furniture. No parking outside, you have to park quite far away or pay expensive parking fees. Not worth the money

title: Can't say I'd recommend
text: I booked an apartment for myself and 5 friends (deluxe superior or something) however upon arrival we was told there was a problem with this room so we were given two smaller apartments instead, not a problem as we all still had a bed to sleep in but I'd seen this same issue mentioned on here before so I was half expecting it. We didn't have any hot water in one of the rooms however the other room did, so good job we had 2 rooms as otherwise this would've been a nightmare. The staff are ok but I certainly wouldn't say approachable, I was paying for the room(s) on arrival however was told the PDQ wasn't working so the gentleman had to phone a colleague to take the payment, didn't particularly appreciate my card details being read out with other guests in the reception area. It isn't the worst hotel in the world by any means, it's decor is modern and I slept comfortably which is the important thing. Location is great being only 3/4 stops away from Paddington, plenty of shops and food outlets nearby.

title: Warning worst ever DO NOT stay
text: I don't normally post bad reviews I like to post positive but In all my years traveled staying in various places .. tents , caravans , hostels to 5* luxury our New Year's break was ruined with this appalling excuse for contemporary deluxe apartments.. we changed rooms 3 times so it's not as though it was a one off disgusting room 1st room was dirty filthy no sofa bed just a old rotten base and a stinky mattress Floor peeling away door frames filthy. Water coming up from the sink Changed rooms to a marginally cleaner room Went out for food came back for some sleep made cup of tea .. only thing in the fully equipped kitchen was a masher and chopping board !!!! Decided to go to bed ... sat on the bed and it collapsed 😡😡 looked under bed to see and all slates were broken (previously) and worse still filthy floor full of hair dust and just scum Moved again at 1am to one of the deluxe apartments beds were ok but again no equipment or cuttelry in kitchen Shower screen broken , sofa disgusting had to put a sheet on it to sit down And worse was the whole place smells of cigarettes the duvet pillows everything everywhere Apparently the manager wasn't happy with us ! Really ? I want a full refund 😡

title: It's OK but can be so much better
text: This review is based on a one night stay. The apartment is on the busy Kilburn High Road, above a Tesco Express store. We booked a parking via JustPark but there is local parking available. The apartment is very easy to find and there is plenty of transport option. Kilburn High underground is 5 minutes walk away. This is a busy high street and there is plenty of option of restaurants and local shops. The staff on arrival was excellent. As we had arrived before our room was available, we were able to store our belongings in a secured room until we returned back later on. We booked a Superior Room apartment for 4 people. This apartment hotel must have been built as a regular living space for families. The apartment we had was very big. Two large bedrooms, a living room with a full kitchenette complete with fridge, microwave and oven. A hallway and a large bathroom with bath and shower. Overall the place was large and spacious. The building itself is quite nice but the downfall is the furnishing. It's old, broken and in desperate need of a refurb. We hoped the beds where clean as we dared not look under the bedsheets. The bedding was clean and the general apartment was clean as well. Even though there is a kitchenette, there was only basic cooking utensils, plates and mugs and absolutely no cutlery. Not a problem for us as we did not intend to cook there. This hotel can be really great if the owners upgraded the furnishing. Interiors are old and much in need of a upgrade. Special thanks to Muhammad who was able to sort out our room problem immediately.

title: Dumbstruck
text: Just a quick note to express my utter surprise that people are still booking into this terribly managed dump! It needs a management change and a month of maintenance to make it come close to being a comfortable place to stay. Avoid this place at all costs.

title: Ideal
text: We had an amazing apartment. Very spacious. Convenient to tube station. Shame they don't supply tea coffee etc.

title: Terrible experience.
text: Me and my girlfriend stayed here for our anniversary trip to London. Upon arrival I was told that I hadn't paid for our stay there... after showing booking numbers... bank transfers and after he called somebody, this was finally resolved after 15 minutes of waiting around.. I noticed i am not the only one to have suffered this, as it seems they tried the same thing to somebody else who left a review as well as somebody who checked in during out stay.... We then went to the room at first glance it looked fairly nice. After delving deeper into the apartment we started to notice cracks in the sink, broken blinds and stained bed covers. That's just the start of it. After going out for something to eat, and a stroll around London, we came back to notice our key card wasn't working. After going to reception they were able to fix it for me. This happened every single day... it was a big inconvenience which wasn't needed. The bed was missing screws, I wouldn't have known this if it wasn't for the mattress suddenly dipping when I got into bed, a serious hazard! so I spent quite a bit of time trying to fix the poorly built bed... I'd say the only good thing about this hotel is the fact the underground is only a 2 minute walk away... apart from that the location isn't the best, not a lot round the area. Apart from a Tesco below and a Starbucks. It's safe to say I will not be returning. We had an amazing time nonetheless, the whole place is a Hazard. I'd advise anyone to stay away, it's not worth the hassle or the money.

title: Worst hotel experience
text: My wife and I booked this apartment for a weekend at a Hyde park concert. The TA reviews at the time seemed good and the website portrayed the apartments as clean and basic. Well first of all we had to wait 3 hours for our room to be ready. We missed our restaurant reservation due to this and we were not happy but all the time reassured by the friendly staff that our room would be ready shortly. At no time was there an offer to look after our luggage. Secondly the apartment was awful. The Windows to the outside were damaged and couldn't close. One was hanging by a broken hinge and was a danger to us. On consulting the staff there was no other rooms available and I spent time calling other hotels to see if we could move. There was limited availability so had to stay there the night. We'd originally booked for two nights but I felt we could not stay there in those conditions so elected to leave. Never to return! But not before I spoke with staff and they asked me to contact the booking team with any complaints. I've since complained twice about our ordeal and I've had no response and no refund. This place is not fit for humans.

title: WORST EXPERIENCE!!
text: Through Booking.com we booked 1 "luxury" room for 6 girls all coming away for my birthday, upon arrival we were told our room wasn't ready for us to check in so we left our luggage and headed out for a couple of hours, when we arrived back we were shocked and disgusted with what was coming next! A different receptionist was on and rudley told us we could not have the room we had booked and had paid extra money for and that we had to have 2 separate down graded smaller rooms which was ridiculous as we weren't informed this earlier and had specifically paid for a bigger room to all be together! The receptionist showed no interest at our upset and LAUGHED in our faces!! Customer service in this place is disgusting, we then phoned the manager only to be told he "dosent care and it's not his problem"!! After a long hour we finally had no choice to take the two small down graded rooms and to be separated! Whilst this was happening there was also a group of 3 men who had booked a room who were turned away onto the streets with their suitcases because there was "no rooms available" I could only imagine how they were feeling, they had PAID for a room and were turned away with no remorse from the rude receptionist! Along with all the broken things listed in other reviews there was also a centerpede in our bathroom!! Avoid this apartment at all costs!!! FALSE ADVERTISING- not given the room paid for and definitely not 4 star, the photos provided are misleading!!

title: much better than we thought
text: We made the reservation on internet and once we reached there we found the place much better and much bigger than we thought.We were problably the first users of the studio, since many things were still packed, and a very nice girl would come every day to change the towels and do the cleaning. As for the receptionist she's a really friendly and helpful girl, and she tried to satisfy all of our demands

title: We found it to be good value!
text: The first receptionist was very helpful and friendly.. The room was a good size, and had all we needed, as long as we didn't need to cook with any pans!! No big deal. The size of the room for the price we paid was good value. Kilburn Park Road Tube Station a VERY leisurely ten minute walk to the apartment. Our only negative was the fact that we reported our bedroom window (Room 303) was unable to be opened. We were there for four days and this was never addressed. As there is no Air Con, it was humid and uncomfortable...and this was October!!

title: Great place to stay!
text: My wife and I stayed here for 3 nights and we loved it. The location is excellent. There is a tesco on the ground floor of the building, Sainsbury, Iceland and M & S food are just 5 minutes walk away. The underground is just 3 minutes walk from the hotel and the west end is about 10 to 15 minutes bus ride. The apartments are well equiped and the staff are always ready to help especially Dana at reception. I will certainly return!

title: Collard Dublin
text: This is the bed we had to sleep in. Window broke. Lid of salad box left in cutlery drawer. Lock on front door broke. Wires hanging down from telly. Photos of mattresses. Will be looking for my money back.

title: Needs Updating
text: Booked this apartment based on it being 4 star and the pics booking a VIP one bed apartment. The rooms were no better than a Travel Lodge as the decor remineded me of a time when i could only afford 3 star, the room was dimly lit probably to hide the shabby carpet. The plugs were too far from the mirror to do your your hair if a hair dryer was available and the lamp did not work in the badly lit bedroom. We were booked for 5 nights and not once were our towels changed. The sheets had holes in the them and the shower was a trickle. Even though it said they provided an iron and hair dryer none of these were available not that we cared for the hair dryer but we arrived at about 10pm and my husband needed to iron a shirt for the next day, we called down to the desk and were told it would be sent up in 20 mins, 40 mins later nothing we called again and they said they were trying to locate one. In the end we fell asleep waiting and eventually one arrived at 7am the next day. Everyday a man came round during the day and shouted through your door that he was here to collect the rubbish!!! The only good thing was the polite lady that worked on the reception during the day.

title: So London Apartments in Hmmersmith! Super
text: Loved this Apartment,located in Hammersmith, with two nearby train stations to choose from, Hammersmith & City Line, or Piccadilly Line. It was really clean, neat and spacious, with double bed, tv, ensuite bathroom and plenty of closet space. We had our own little kitchen with hot plates,fridge,microwave and sink supplied with fairy liquid! They had a pot,pan and cutlery with plates,mugs & glasses. We really enjoyed our stay. I would always recommend this excellent apartment. You will not be dissapointed, just look at the photos!:)

title: BED BUGS FROM HELL
text: Me and my 2 colleagues, after a long, hard day at work checked into what seemed to be , from the reception, a lovely, warm, clean and welcoming establishment. After checking in, we went up to Apartment 411, upon entering, we noticed that the smoke alarm in the kitchen was not working nor up to the relevant regulation standards. When opening the cupboards, we found love cables hanging from the boiler, easy access to children should they stay there. But, we had just finished work and were willing to let this go. So, after something to eat and a couple of sherberts, we all settled into bed. My colleague was then awoken at 2am, writhing in pain. He turned the light on only to find a swarm of bed bugs crawling over the sheets. He quickly alerted the other two of us in the apartment and we were horrified to turn out mattresses and discover them everywhere. Immediately in the morning, we decided to get the heck out of dodge. When we went downstairs and showed the receptionist a video he just laughed and said "oh, another one". He couldn't care any less. Eventually though we did get a refund. No apology, no offer of compensation. We have had to have all of our clothes cleaned and My colleague spent a day in A&E because of the pain he was in from being bitten - all this has been at cost. This hotel is shocking, anybody staying there be warned, you're not alone. The whole place needs shutting down and fumigating. The staff just do not care, at all! Shocking service and shockingly accommodation.

title: Never again
text: It was bad before I even got to the room. The room had been pre booked and paid for already, when I got to the front desk they couldn't find a booking and once they did they said the system says it has not been paid for and while is was trying to sort out the room there was a guy sleeping and snoring right behind me which he was there all day snoring. Got to the room and just as bad as the service. See pics, damage everywhere and other reviews said the same thing but I thought I would just see how we go but it is all true. Do not ever stay here

title: Terrible stay, staff unresponsive, dirty apartments.
text: When our team arrived, the booking had been messed up, meaning we had too few beds. The rooms smelled bad, were dirty, had awfully stained mattresses, the fridges were switched off, there were not enough sets of cutlery/crockery for the number of guests, and only two small pans with which to self-cater. One of our team was ignored twice when politely asking a member of staff to address the filthy mattress issue. The 'daily clean' of the room involved spraying air freshener and emptying the bins. Other tenants were incredibly noisy in the night, which we can appreciate is not the fault of the hotel, but this was overall a terrible stay, one we will NOT be repeating.

title: Very good...but with a few annoying niggles.
text: Booked a "deluxe" one bedroomed apartment for a 4 day trip to the capital. The flexibility of being able to cook a meal or two ourselves or relax with a bottle of wine in the lounge area meant we could cut down on expenditure and allow both ourselves and our 10 year old daughter a little privacy. We weren't disappointed although there were one or two annoying niggles. The niggles : the cooker didn't work properly (we tried to heat a pan of water to cook some pasta but the hob wouldn't get hot enough. We even tried to boil water using the kettle but it wouldn't work)

title: Great Apartment!
text: So London was great! Spacious room, bathrooms, and living area. Very convenient having a kitchen and grocery stores around the corner. 2 minutes from Kilburn Park tube station, the only way to travel. Be aware that the hotel is located of the main street. There is a small off shoot of Kilburn High Road and that is were the hotel entrance is.

title: Terrible Experience
text: The only good point for So Quartier is the location. Besides that everything else was a nightmarish experience for me and my family. title: Awful service - awful rooms - no air con - NOT HAPPY
text: Arrived today at our perfectly located apartments to be advised that our apartments were no longer habitable!! We then got shipped to another apartment 30 minutes away from where we were meant to be! As a result, it took us an hour, 3 trains on a very hot day with a party of 10 to get to Wembley. We had booked 2 rooms for our party of 10. Upon arrival at our relocated apartment we were then split into 4 different rooms. Considering we have 5 children with us , this was entirely inappropriate for our family. Last but not least the apartments or ridiculously hot and the air con doesn't work. Really disappointed. Would not recommend!!!!!

title: Great Location, friendly staff and spacious rooms.
text: We have stayed a few times over the last 2 years. Love the fact the Tesco is right below the apartments. Its very convenient for local shops such as Primark, Argos, Sainbury's Aldi and for McDonalds, KFC etc. Its right by the train station (one or 2 stops from Euston) and lots of bus stops within a 1-2 minute walk, We often strolled to Little Venice from here and Paddington 20-30 min walk. Rooms are spacious, bins emptied everyday and towels a few times a week. It does get very warm in Summer. There are fans though.

title: Bug Bites. Not a bargain.
text: During the stay, we encountered a number of problems, the most serious being that my three year old daughter received a large number of bug bites on her face, hands, feet, and waist area while she slept in the sofa bed toward the end of our stay. While we got the staff to inspect the room and *eventually* change out the sofa bed mattress my daughter had been sleeping on, they did not move us to a clean room. After the incidents, I could not sleep because we risked injury from everyone falling asleep. Kept lights on to keep bugs away. Additionally, we experienced the following problems which negatively impacted our stay: 1. The hotel elevator was not functional for the first six days of our stay (before the bedbug incidents). Our room was four levels above ground floor. Staff repeatedly kept telling us it would be fixed "today". 2. The apartments are supposed to be serviced every three days. This did not happen. We had to repeatedly ask for service and consequently the apartments was not serviced as many times as should have been for the length of our stay. The correct amount of towels was never provided. 3. Room had a freezer, but could not get ice trays. Staff repeatedly said for days they would provide some until finally admitting they don't provide them. 4. The interior of the hotel became quite noisy at times. It often sounded as if a herd of elephants was coming through the hallways. Could easily be heard in rear bedroom. 5. Shower hot water does not last long! Not enough for two showers in a row without waiting for it to heat back up. Staff is very shady. Some were friendly, but many staff members will say and promise anything to just get you to go away and stop bothering them. Then if you complain afterwards, they deny there was any problem. Needless to say, I would not recommend anyone stay here. While there are no tourist attractions within reasonable walking distance, only redeeming quality of this place is that it is very close to Underground, Overground, and bus stops. But this is true of many London establishments.

title: Beautiful and spacious apartments
text: Personally I enjoyed my stay in So Quartier. The apartment we had was very spacious and cosy with a big living room and comfy beds. We felt like home away fron home. The staff is very friendly and helpful.

title: surpassed expectations, great experience
text: Our reservation at the grand tourist hotel was cancelled when it had to close without warning the day before our trip. Bit of late night googling and found a one bed apartment for 4 people, similar money as not so grand tourist hotel. Arrived well before check in time as soaked an carrying heavy bags. This was no problem greeted by friendly young guy who gave us key and sent us up. Were greeted with a warm and immaculately clean two double room apartment (free upgrade !) yes the main carpet was looking a bit tired and stained but all else was very good. Location is really convenient for central london and contrary to other reviews the staff were really helpful. Young polish girl on counter was very sweet, more than happy to lend me her bottle opener at 10pm and give directions advice etc where needed. a nice experience and the first time i have had a good experience with accomodation in london. My only concern was the aparrent lack of other people staying and i wonder if these will not end up as homes if so quiet

title: So Sienna Kilburn
text: We actually booked for the So Sienna apartments in Hammersmith for 3 people. When we arrived the apartment was only large enough for 2 with no cooking facilities. Got moved to Kilburn which was larger. No pots & pans or kettle, fridge didn't work and smelt horrible and beds were terrible. Was very expensive for what we got, disappointing.

title: Think very carefully before booking here
text: We just had a 4 night stay at So Quartier - it states Maida Vale, it's actually Kilburn. I normally try to stick to positive reviews but this place has so much wrong- almost all small things that could easily be fixed. We were originally 'upgraded' to whatever they call the apartment above standard. The plus points are that the bedding, towels and bathroom were all clean and fresh. The downsides however include all of the points raised in previous reviews - unbelievably noisy if you are given an apartment at the front, even with windows closed the traffic, revving motorbikes and sirens continue all through the night. Surprisingly a pre used dish sponge (seriously- they cost 10p each, surely hygiene should say new one for each stay) no plug, no kitchen towel (so can't dry dishes) the kitchen itself was ok- and there was a decent sized fridge. Unfortunately the fridge had been switched off and left with the door closed - and so when we worked out how to put it back on it smelt really bad. The furniture in the living room was in very poor condition, a glass dining table with bent legs and a sofa bed which was neither a sofa or usable as a bed as the legs collapsed. It was incredibly uncomfortable to sit on as the springs were almost through the fabric. (I thought maybe I could lie on it instead of sitting as the back half didn't have springs coming through but it just folded in on itself) The bedroom was tiny, had to walk sideways to get into the bed, no bedside tables and an extremely soft mattress. The next morning I asked if there was any chance of a different room away from the front and with a sofa that could be used - the very friendly guy at the front desk promised he was going to help me out and that he would come to the room in an hour- 2 hours later I went back to find he had forgotten me, and could t offer anything g other than a smaller room also on the front. I asked again the next day as after 2 sleepless nights we were ready to just give up and find different accommodation - this time I was shown another room, then told it was £25 more per night if I wanted to move. Desperation led me to pay the extra, although I did get it reduced slightly. The new apartment was on the side of the building, the trains were frequent but nowhere near as bad as the traffic noises. Apparently this was now a luxury apartment !!! The sofa was useable, the kitchen was grotty. Bathroom fine (still no plugs and shower fitting a little broken but useable) Bedroom much better - at least in size, but the mattress was too big for the frame so the bed was already sinking before we got in it. The staff were all friendly and the bedding was clean, otherwise this review would be one star. I can't think of a single reason to use these apartments- even if the price was lower I wouldn't go back.

title: Careful wheelchair users: Incompetent service - Incompetent manager
text: I booked an apartment for 3 people, and I made clear during the reservation process that we required disabled facilities. We got a DIRTY apartment for 2, without disabled facilities, and with a broken window (there is a night club downstairs). The whole building was fully booked, so we weren't allowed to change apartment. Overall - very bad experience, and even worse, they don't reply emails, so forget about claiming money back afterwards.

title: Relaxed, Friendly and Good Value
text: Stayed at So Quartier for 3 nights in a 2 bedroomed apartment. Easy to find. Very warm welcome on arrival. Check-in was fast and efficient. Reception staff and night staff were very friendly, especially the General Manager on check-in who was very welcoming and friendly, and the female member of staff (think she was Polish) showed us to the apartment and she was also very friendly, helpful and pleasant. The apartment was large, lovely bathroom, clean and spacious. Excellent value for £170.00 a night with laterooms. All amenities were provided ie. Television, DVD player, fully equipped kitchen with microwave, en suite bathroom and lounge area. Furnishings were fine and modern mainly IKEA. Bins emptied daily and bathroom cleaned and serviced. Kilburn area was fine just 2mins walk from the Overground Kilburn High Road Station, and just 5mins walk to Kilburn Park Underground on the Bakerloo Line to Central London and the West End in 15mins. Tesco Express underneath the apartment block had an excellent selection of food, snacks, meals, drinks, wines and beers. All local shops on Kilburn High Street were within walking distance. Given the price and space of the apartment I would recommend staying here opposed to extortionate prices in Central London and the West End. Apartment 112 was very quiet towards the back of the block, just some noise from passing trains, but nothing to complain about. Thank you for a nice stay.

title: A trip for an operation made in to 48 hours of hell!!
text: Firstly the booking was a no.deposit booking. No money was to be paid upfront. This. Was stated on the booking policies. However the full amount was taken from my account a day or 2 later with no consent from me!!!! The card details were for reservation purposes only so they in effect took money illegally. We found in their website closer to the date the rooms for a quarter of the price as shown in photos. We could have cancelled the booking and rebooted directly however this wasn't possible as the full amount had already been taken. Then on arrival it was like walking in to a sauna when we walked in to the apartment. We opened the windows but when we went to bed realised that the main window was broken and had a bolt to close it but this meant you couldn't leave it ajar it swung completely open (once almost hitting me.on the head when I was sat on the sofa) so we had to.close it completely when.we went to bed. The bedroom blinds had no pull to close them.it just had to be done by hand which didn't close them Completely. It was so oppressive (and I'm. Usually a very cold person that welcomes heat!!) It was impossible to fall asleep. Then the screaming, shouting and music started from right outside. Then the banging and slamming somewhere inside.the hotel. The main part of all this to mention is that the reason we were here is I had an operation the next morning and had to be up at 6 AM. It was now 2 AM and we went downstairs and demanded to be moved rooms as I had an operation in a matter of hours and I needed some sleep. We were moved rooms and got in to bed about 3 AM to realise the new room was practically on top of the train line with freight trains (which are obviously very loud) every half hour. So i finally got 2 hours of broken sleep before I had.to get up again. To go in to.surgery!!!!!! Also In the new room the TV didn't work. Only one channel half worked. My partner was told someone would fix it when he was.collecting me.from the hospital so it was OK for when I got back. It wasn't. No one had fixed it or. Even said anything about it. We were booked again for another night for me to.get some rest before going home but it had become apparent that this was not going to happen. So i came.out of hospital, went back.to the apartments, and packed to go straight home on 2 trains. When Down stairs checking out I was telling a female member of staff rather irate (not surprisingly in 2 hours sleep, a general.anaesthetic just hours before and in pain from.surgery) that I wanted a note on the system that someone was to email me asap as I wanted a full refund and an apology- only to see a male member of staff named Chadi Selka smirking at me. Obviously he found this very amusing and so when I got angry apparantly I was the rude one!!!!!!! I am absolutely DISGUSTED!!!! apparantly.taking money illegally wasn't enough and it was necessary to make my trip an absolute misery even though the reason for the trip was that I'm. Unwell!!!! I also have a health conditions. That is hugely affected by sleep and stress and so I most certainly didn't need this right before surgery!!!! The fact that right after an operation I came home on public transport rather than staying the second night says alot!! And the fact that staff seemingly found that funny is disgusting!!!!!!

title: Good value, but...
text: Good things: 1) very clean 2) lovely bathroom 3) very nice size apartment, spacious and such 4) nice reception at check in 5) free wi-fi 6) amazing public transport 7) Starbucks and Tescos just outside Bad things: 1) No TV in bedroom (a basic chill requirement for most) 2) Mattress in bedroom and sofa fold out very poor quality and not very comfortable Conclusion: Decently priced and would use again if needed something cheap and cheerful - but wouldnt recommend for a romantic weekend (where sleep and luxury was key) or more than a few nights stay (owing to mattress lack of quality)

title: Horrendous. Memorable for all the wrong reasons.
text: I will put it blunt. Website stated hairdryer in every room... 2 hairdryers in whole hotel. There was a queue of women waiting with wet hair and the receptionist tried to give £5 to one of the customers and said "There's a shop around the corner go buy one" We had to wait 45minutes to leave our room because they didn't have a key for our room. They stated on-site parking... Not on site... no where near. Shower didn't work. 5 out of 6 of the staff where ill mannered and rude. The manager is completely disrespectful. Worst stay in London I have ever experienced. So much so we left London 6 hours early. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

title: An absolute SCAM!
text: The SO Quartier is an absolute SCAM! I booked my refundable reservation through their website 2 months in advance. After reading some questionable reviews online, I decided to cancel the reservation the next day. I sent their reservations an email and after Sylivia tried to convince me to reconsider but she did cancel the reservation. A month later, they bill my credit card for the full reservation amount and refuse to issue a refund! This has been absolutely unbelievable! STAY AWAY! I now have to rely on American Express to correct the FRAUD on The SO's part.

title: Long stay
text: I always stay at the So Quartier whenever i visit London. Location is excellent with good shopping and restaurants around. Staff is very pleasant and helpful, worth mentioning name of Juan who was extremely nice and cooperative. Underground and Overground stations are within 5 min walk. Rooms are big and simple. All kitchen amenities are available. House keeping staff cleans rooms daily and a full service on every 4rth day. I will stay there again when i visit London again!!

title: Fantastic spot for business travellers
text: I had the chance to book this property, very comfy, 2 minutes walk from the tube stations. Super positive point as well is that you have supermarkets and shops, as well as restaurants all around, which is very helpful when i finished late. Finally, not easy in London to find a place for heaters are great, and it was very warm in my apartment when back on the evening, and i really felt home. Thank you so very much !

title: The location of the hotel makes everything easy
text: We used the So Quartier hotel when going to a gig at Hyde Park and we found it to be a fantastic place to stay. As we were arriving at Lunchtime on Saturday, heading straight to the gig and then back home early on the Sunday morning time was of the essance so the fact that the hotel was only 15 minutes off the M1 was ideal, couple with that there's a great place to get lunch (The Westbury pub next door), a Tesco's to stock up on booze, a couple of coffee shops for breakfast on Sundayand even a cracking kebab shop all count in its favour. Aside from the local area complimeting the hotel we found it be very clean, modern and the appartments were much bigger than we expected and fit out/decorated to a high standard. We'd definately use them again and will recomend.

title: Awful place!!!!!! 4 star?? Is that a joke?????
text: If this apartment is graded a 4*...then I am the Queen!! This is the worst place I have ever stayed in my life. I booked this accommodation based upon the grading. It very clearly states that it is Four Star accommodation. However, on arriving last weekend with my husband & 2 small children, we were bitterly disappointed. The apartments are situated next to a nightclub/bar and in our room there was a very noisy boiler/generator, which kept firing up and off at 11pm at night. The noise was so awful that we complained, the staff were very dismissive & fairly unhelpful. After explaining that there were no other rooms available, we decided to drive the 2 hour journey back to Bournemouth at 11.30pm. Needless to say, we were all devastated that our weekend had come to a very disappointing end. We have complained & received a ridiculous refund. We feel totally let down & mislead. I would like to warn anyone wanting to book this apartment based on the 4* grading......DON'T!!!!!!!!!! It's more like a 2 star at very best. The whole place was exceptionally shabby!!

title: Beware of the big bad manager
text: If you like roughing it, this is the place for you, that is if you like to pay very expensive to go rough. The first look is chic and modern but after the ladies in the reception are done with you, even a scrubby hostel would do just fine. We were greeted by a Russian or Polish girl, well greet is not the correct word. There were some things that were not clear so we tried to ask, but the girl did not know a thing, so another lady approached us and she was so rude and bad-tempered I almost swallowed my tongue, to my shock I found out that the Iranian lady is the manager. We sheltered from her wrath and went for the room. The room was so dirty and the carpet was badly stained, the property not even one year old deserved a makeover. The Monday afternoon, after a hard day touring through London, we retired too the apartments and found a different atmosphere. We were properly greeted by a young South African man

title: Bad LUXURY apartment
text: It's on London 2 just in front of N9ne night bus stop. Very next to 2 tube stations. The LUXURY apartments was actually for 3 persons and the unlucky one has to sleep on a very uncomfortable and dirty sofa. When we asked for an extra bed they charged us of 25£ each night. There weren't sufficient furniture at all. They have us only one toilet paper roll for 4 people for 4 nights. We asked for the sheets. I think it's better to choose for a different location!

title: Worst hotel
text: Bad services, bad room The hotel charge us from the deposit for smoking inside the building for 100 pound. The sofa bed in the room was broke and the water in the room not running. Bad experience in UK.

title: Very good option
text: stayed for 5 nights at this aparthotel in North West London, very close to Kilburn park station and plenty of Bus options to central london, there are multiple food options near by and the tesco round the corner is of a great help for breakfast stuff. I found the hotel staff helpful and accomodating, the appartment was clean, good heating system, the only negative point is that housekeeping do not clean the rooms and provide clean towels every day, you have to use your towels for 3 days which not great, other than that, this is a good option for families. hotel also offers free wifi connection for multiple devices.

title: fab apartments
text: My party of 4 stayed in a 2 bed apartment as a birthday trip to see a gig at Wembley. In terms of location the site is great- tube on your doorstep and only 6 stops to Wembley, bus outside takes you to Marble Arch. The apartment was huge- 2 good sized double bedrooms, an open plan lounge/kitchen/diner and ample sized bathroom. The room was immaculate with great dressing such as the cushions on the bed. The conceirge were helpful and attentive without being intrusive. Great value for money, would definitely stay again.
