title: Disgruntled guests
text: Me and my partner had booked 3 nights to stay at the Church Street hotel to attend a concert. On our last evening, we spent most of our time in the hotel and decided to help ourselves to the 'honesty bar' for a beverage and make note of what we had taken so we would be charged. The lady who was working the night shift at the reception was accompanied by another lady who I can only assume was a friend of hers. As we were attempting to make a martini at the bar, the friend entered the room made herself a beverage and sat directly opposite us and did not take her eyes of us for one second. We had finished our drinks and made our way back to our room feeling untrustworthy and greatly offended. As we were sat in our room feeling restless and paranoid, we had decided to go back to the bar a few minutes later to find that hawkeye was no longer there and was back at reception laughing with her friend (receptionist). We can only imagine that we were not trusted because we are young guests. We are now back in our room, we are feeling very angry and wanting to leave at a late hour. We are very very happy to be leaving Church Street Hotel tomorrow morning. Absolutely disgusting!!

title: Great hotel - unusual and interesting
text: Found this on LastMinute when at a conference - great and original hotel in South London. Rooms are clean, reasonable size and full of character. Bathroom has nice tiles and a good shower! A bar of chocolate and a pot of hot sauce is a step up from the usual chocolate on the pillow. Also a lounge with good coffee and an honesty bar that is very well stocked as well as a large selection of DVDs for the player in your room. Thoroughly recommend the hotel, though getting there can be a bit of a pain as its not on a tube line.

title: Average rooms, lovely staff
text: They have done a really nice job decorating parts of the hotel, but some areas leave something to be desired. The coffee area and my bedroom room were very nice and definitely updated recently, but the carpeting, wallpaper, and layout of the rest of place were kind of crazy. My room (23) was cute, but small - tight for two people. There were L'Occitane products in the sink in the room, which were much appreciated, but I was not a fan of the shared toilet and shower down the hall. The staff was lovely and very helpful. This is a good place if you are going to be in Camberwell since there aren't a lot of options for hotels nearby, but it takes awhile to get to the center of London.

title: Luxury with a twist
text: This place is great! We stayed for 3 nights including valentine's and had a great time. The hotel is a little off the beaten track but on lots of bus and night bus routes which were simple to use (get an Oyster card) and ran frequently. It took about 40 mins into the central area but as I have always previously stayed near a tube stop it was actually nice to see where the hotel was positioned and to see the surrounding area. Camberwell may not be everyone's cup of tea but we had no problems. It's a little run down and very definitely in a city and a bit rough around the edges but if you are used to cities its fine, lots of places to eat, good transport and didn't feel unsafe at all. Its also very busy which helps. The hotel itself is unusually decorated with lots of mexican icons and pictures and our room was bright orange with a beautifully tiled bathroom. It was nice to have a change from the usual beige rooms. The room wasn't huge (standard double) with no wardrobe but there was a clever use of space - with a hanging shelf with coat hangers for clothes and bedside table. We had a dvd player with free dvds to hire from reception - with a great and unusual selection. Breakfast was delicious and very laid back - which was nice but slow if you were in a hurry to get somewhere - also had a bit of a problem knowing what to do - would have been good to have a note on the table. Basically some of it is self serve and some is table service but this isn't quite clear! Breakfast room doubled as a lounge with an honour bar with reasonable prices - similar to what you'd pay in a pub. It was nice to be trusted to write down what you had in the little book. The hotel was very peaceful and our room felt like we were staying somewhere really quiet! Beds were super comfy and the nice toiletries, little touches like the sauce and rose for valentines were the icing on the cake. Thank you so much for such a lovely stay - will def. return! PS they have just opened a tapas restaurant which looked nice although not really my cup of tea. Didn't eat here but looked nice. We had a lovely indian meal at Safa across the road whcih seemed popular with locals. PPS - few reports here about "dodgy area and sirens continuously" as I said it didn't seem dodgy to me and the sirens are common in London generally and especially round here as you're so close to a major A & E department so don't worry too much!

title: A real treat
text: To be honest even with the reviews I wasn't expecting much in Camberwell but this was lovely. The room was just the right size for two girls who needed a nice safe room to sleep in after a concert. The beds were really really comfortable. And the free tea, coffee and hot chocolate was superb quality. Would definitely definitely go back to this tastefully decorated and relatively cheap for London hotel.

title: Average
text: An average hotel. Clean rooms. Comfortable bed. Small but decent bathroom. Good bus links into city centre. Not an awful lot of choice at breakfast time but what was there was pleasant enough. Front door is locked but on occasion, if reception staff are busy, you will be left waiting to be let in which given the hotel is on a busy main road, is a little frustrating. At times the reception staff were a little rude and not as friendly as one would expect from a hotel, however, it was noted that they were so incredibly busy. Would probably stay again if I got a good deal.

title: Always happy here
text: When I'm in London on business I always stay here if I can. It has charm, warmth and personality. It has a great tapas bar downstairs. There's always a good book or two by the bed (Rochester's Poems and Crime & Punishment this time - didn't have time to read the latter). The shower's good, the bed is comfy, the organic breakfast is delicious, and the rest of the clientele are invariably personable and interesting.

title: Loved this hotel!
text: Cool hotel, really well decorated and the room was lovely. Lots of patterned tiles and great attention to detail, the place was spotless too. The toiletries were posh, the free chocolate a lovely touch, and the hot sauce came (the oddest hotel freebie ever) was sizzling. The honesty bar was a lovely spot to sit for drinks

title: An unexpected pleasure
text: Our daughter booked us in here as it was close to her flat. We were pleasantly surprised as to the warm welcome by the staff and the quality of the establishment. A good sized room with ensuite, comfortable bed and little tokens of chocolate and a small jar of home maid spice. The breakfast area was beautifully set up and the continental breakfast excellent. All in all highly recommended.

title: Highly Recommended
text: I have stayed at the Church St Hotel for 3 weeks whilst on business in London. What a pleasure it has been. Jose and his staff are so pleasant and helpful it was a pleasure to be there. You have the loveley cleaning ladies that change your towels and make your bed daily, always with a smile and a chat.The lady that does breakfast which is always so fresh and plentiful and nothing is to much trouble for her. David the receptionist always with a smile and ever helpful. I would say that its probably the cleanest and friendliest hotel i have stayed in in my 55 years.I have more buisness in London soon and you can rest assure the Church St Hotel will be my first choice.

title: Lovely stay
text: What a characterful hotel - it's like entering a different world from the busy street in Camberwell where it's situated. I was upgraded from a superior room to a deluxe room 6 which was as quiet as possible. The bed was super comfy, the l'occitaine bath products much appreciated and free treats of hot sauce, organic chocolate and bottled water were an added treat. The staff were helpful and friendly. We ate in the hotel restaurant downstairs which was delicious. The whole hotel has a Mexican/Spanish feel and the food reflected that. Very fresh tapassy type dishes. We invited friends to join us and although they lived in Camberwell never knew the restaurant existed. They like me will definitely return if possible.

title: What a great find!
text: Stayed for one night, close to a kings college hospital. Quirky hotel, very clean. Honesty bar with complementary tea & coffee was great! Breakfast was great value. I would definitely stay again if in the area. Buses to central London are convenient.

title: A cell
text: I have stayed in the Church Street Hotel before and found it interesting and quirky but last night changed my mind altogether. My £155 deluxe bedroom was like a prison cell with a small window opening onto a wall with a vent. The window was so high it required a chair to reach it and there was absolutely no light in the morning. I asked if I could change my room but was told by a very surly member of staff that this was the only room left and besides most people liked it because it was quiet. Yes it was without noise but it was also without air, light or any feeling of comfort. If you decide to stay at the Church Street Hotel then my advice is to ask if your room comes with a proper window because if you don't you will live to regret it.

title: Stylish hotel in South London
text: We stayed here as a family prior to our daughter getting married. The rooms were lovely, and all different which was good to see. We stayed in the triple room which had a beautifully designed bathroom with great bath and shower. Staff were very helpful and welcoming and the breakfast was first rate and excellent value.

title: Charming
text: I used to live in Camberwell and I had always been curious about the Church Street Hotel. It was even better - warmer, sweeter, more comfortable - than I could have hoped. We stayed in a single room on the top floor and it was spacious and so warm and inviting. I would happily have moved in! The hotel is filled with little touches - chocolates, coffee, DVDs to borrow, fast wifi, a common room to sit on the couch and read the paper. The tapas restaurant downstairs is also absolutely delicious - and very veg/vegan friendly in addition to all of the Spanish meats and seafoods.

title: An oasis of fun
text: This hotel is an unusual oasis of fun tucked away in South London. There is no lift and the stairs are narrow so it would not be ideal for guests with limited mobility. I checked in late in the evening which meant that I missed out on many of the best features. I did not get to the bar or restaurant, didn't manage a drink in the guests lounge, had no time to watch a DVD from the extensive library (there is a TV with DVD player in the room). The rooms are clean, beds comfortable and the staff friendly and efficient. If you want to crash & dash like I did this hotel has everything you need but it is worth taking a bit of time to absorb the décor and the film set atmosphere. Many hotels have free wifi but this is the only one I've been to that has free chilli sauce. I fully expect to be back here soon for a more leisurely sequel.

title: One night stay - would come back
text: We needed to have a one night stay close to family in Camberwell. We were impressed. A really reasonable value independent unique hotel. We had our car and for £5.00 for 24 hours you can park 5 min walk away. Really helpful, warm staff. As other people have commented rooms are quite small but for one night it was fine even I think for 2-3 nights. Lovely touches in the room 2 small bars of chocolate made locally, water in glass bottles (not plastic -great). Very clean, white soft towels, great toiletries. Lovely tiled bathroom, shower a reasonable size but not particuarly powerful. A guest lounge where you can make your'e own beverages and even cocktails. We didnt make use of this as we were going out that evening. Very good diverse range of dvds. The hotel was not very busy during our stay, so dont know about noise levels, but we both slept well. Loved the organic juice at breakfast time and very good coffee and pastries. We weren't hungry enough to have the cold meats/cheeses or the cooked things (which are done to order. If we needed to stay in the SE5 part of London would come here again.

title: Perfect for one
text: This was my first time to London. I was only there for 2 nights but it was perfect. I was quite excited to find a spanish inspired hotel. However it felt like a bed and breakfast, which made it cozy and quaint. The hotel was a few steps from bus lines. The neighborhood was safe. The attached tapas restaurant made it easy to have dinner and breakfast in the morning. The staff was extremely helpful. I would definitely recommend it.

title: Lovely,friendly place to stay.
text: I stayed in this hotel with my partner when we were staying in London to see the New Year in 2012. Very friendly and relaxed atmosphere. The room was well decorated and furnished in a Cuban/Spanish theme. The bed was comfortable,a spacious,well lit private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Could'nt ask for a nicer place to stay. Limitless tea/coffee at anytime for you to help yourself, a 24 hour self serve open bar( pour your drink and write details in the book,the cost is charged to your bill) and a wall full of dvds to borrow if you are struggling to get to sleep. There is a restaurant next door which is ideal if you don't wish to travel far to eat. Buses and rail withn 5 minutes walk away. The Curch Street Hotel is excellent value for money..

title: Perfect night away
text: The staff were wonderful, friendly and very helpful our room was absolutely lovely and the decor of the entire building was beautiful! The lounge had an honesty bar and a large DVD collection, free to use, my boyfriend a recently graduated Film & TV student was over the moon with the collection! The breakfast was lovely and had vegan options which was great! The location was also great, lots of pubs, little green grocer type shops and we ate at Wuli Wuli Chinese Takeaway which was excellent! We were visiting as I was collecting research from the natural history museum and the distance to the main hub of London wasn't too far but took a while in the traffic - we should have perhaps caught a tube or bus rather than taking an Uber!

title: Perfect in every aspect
text: The Church Street is exactly how a hotel should be. My partner and I travel constantly with work, and this has to be one of our favourite places ever. Every detail has been well taken care of. Complimentary bottled water, quality tea, grounded coffee, organic chocolate, even a specially made chilli sauce from the owner. A lovely little bar/lounge is run by an honesty system. Beautifully equipped and with absolutely gorgeous decor. Free hire of huge DVD selection, wonderful, helpful staff. Comfortable bed, extremely clean and homely. We couldn't have asked for anything more. A really lovely stay, thank you!!!

title: Unique find in London
text: I recently stayed overnight at the Church Street Hotel, not really sure what to expect I was pleasantly surprised. The rooms are very spacious and the beds are very comfy. The bathroom was decorated with beautiful hand painted tiles and there was a great honesty bar located downstairs with a good range of DVDs which you could take back to your room. Very enjoyable stay!

title: Great New Year
text: Me and my partner decided to spend a couple of nights in London for the new year and after discovering this hotel it was a no brainer where we wanted to stay! We both love things a bit quirky and different so the Mexican theme really appealed to us and didn't disappoint. When we first arrived we were a little apprehensive about the area but we had no problems and at night there was minimal noise even on new years eve. The bus stop is literally 30seconds away from the hotel and the bus journal to oval was 10min max and from there we managed to get around and do a lot of sight seeing. The greeting when we checked in was friendly and the rest of the staff were the same with the girl doing breakfast being particularly helpful and chatty. We stayed in the Deluxe room and overall we were very happy with our stay, the room was lovely and clean, the breakfast was to die for and the staff were helpful and unlike all the other hotels we had looked at they didn't double the price of the room on the 31st because it was new years eve! hopefully we'll get a chance to return in the future :)

title: Camberwell Delight
text: We arrived at the Church Street Hotel with a sense of trepidation and excitement at what we might find. My extremely attractive companion and I were not familiar with Camberwell as an area, so the occasion had a “mission” feel to it. We were greeted and looked after by the extremely hospitable Jose (one of the owners.) This immediately put us at ease. The room itself had fabulous décor and loads of fascinating details (kitsch religious artefacts, cigar boxes containing complementary chilli sauce and chocolate.) The bed was stylish and superbly comfortable – a winner. The bathroom interior was a treat – tiled with an almost Moroccan feel. The colours in both rooms were warm and calming. We were told that we could help ourselves to anything in the bar and just put it on an honesty tab – which we both felt was a great touch. We left the next day, feeling really happy about our choice of hotel and having the sensation that we’d actually been spirited away somewhere special.

title: Very very small
text: Didn't expect a hotel room to be so small. Had to walk sideways to get past the TV and edge of wrought iron bed. Same thing to get into the bathroom. TV wouldn't work. Phoned reception about this, they said they would come up but didn't. Bathroom was recently refurbished. Nice toiletries, L'Ocataine. Our room on 2nd floor. Very narrow steep staircase and dam difficult to get heavy suitcases up there. Once in room, no space to put suitcases except on floor which took up valuable space in the room. The hotel has a dining, lounge area with a bar which is self service and based on an honesty system. Nice pastries are available there in the morning, purchased on honesty system. Helpful staff. Building is an old Georgian villa, refurbished to South Americian decor throughout. Breakfast available

title: Nice boutique hotel.
text: I chose the Church St Hotel because it had good reviews and because I was born and grew up in Camberwell! OK, the Camberwell I remember has long gone but at least the hotel was an oasis. Lots of nice touches - the honesty bar, good (cheap!) continental breakfast, chocolates in the room etc and a hot shower and comfortable bed. It's a shame that the Restaurant has closed as by all accounts it was very good. My only grouch was that you have to ring to gain access (this IS Camberwell after all!) and if there's no-one at reception you can end up waiting a while in the lobby. No real big deal though. I'll be staying here again in a few weeks time :-)

title: Lovely place to stay
text: We stayed for a saturday night to attend a party nearby. The hotel was very quirky, clean and staff were very helpful. Short walk to train station. Room was not too small for London, clean with some small little touches such as bottles of water and chocolate. Bathroom very colourful and had great toiletries. We were on the same floor as the lounge where there was complimentary coffee/tea and papers to read as well as vast range of DVDs to borrow if wanted. We had the continental breakfast which was good with artisan bread . Would stay again and recommend.

title: Small but beautifully formed!
text: Very unique hotel but all add to the stay. Rooms clean and very uniquely dressed. Staff very friendly. Great breakfast again with some nice different twists the normal hotel breakfast. Hotel with the right attitude! Nice touch's with the hotel such as the honesty bar, DVD collection in the bar.

title: Perfect for KCL
text: Nice hotel, perfect location if you are visiting the KCL Denmark hill campus. Nice common area with wifi and tea/coffee. A lot of stairs though, so request a room on low floors if you dont want to go up stairs. Lots of buses into central london close by

title: Nice little hotel
text: Loved the decor and staff at this hotel, breakfast yummy, rooms finished really nicely. Bit noisy if you're in a room facing onto Camberwell Church Street despite sound proofing. Steep staircase without a lift but but otherwise a great place to stay.

title: Fab quirky little place
text: Hi - booked last minute 2 night stay whilst I had 3 days of day treatment at Kings College Hospital (5 mins walk away)(but too far for me to commute) Quirky, immaculately clean, a real find here in Denmark Hill/Camberwell. I had single room with shared bathroom. All I could get last minute. Was dreading the shared bit..but at least I had my own sink. All went well. Sweet attic room, up 5 short flights stairs and facing the main road, but again, I don't expect peace in South London and guessed the singleton rooms would be in the eves. 4' wide bed, beautiful linen and towels and L'Occutaine toiletries. Organic chocs and chilli sauce (!) Honesty bar and free organic tea coffee etc, all beautifully neat and clean in The Communion Bar (!) Wacky South American Religious themed..just made me smile. So whilst I hope never to need to use this hotel again for a hospital stay, if I had to, I'd re book in an instance.

title: Gem of a hotel!
text: I booked this hotel as me and a friend were having a weekend shopping and gigging in London. I chose it because it looked like it had a Hispanic theme and was quite cheap (for London). When we arrived- we were already excited. The tiny foyer was beautiful, and we were greeted warmly. We received a brief tour of the facilities at the hotel and to our room. The room, though compact, had everything we needed - although not en suite, but we knew this prior to booking. L'Occitane toiletries and Green and Blacks Chocolate Bars already had us grinning ear to ear, a lovely touch. Throughout our stay we did get lost through the maze of stairs and hallways, but we got the hang of it by the end! The honesty bar was always fully stocked, with lots of goodies to choose from, and a great choice in teas, coffees and hot chocolates. Do not miss the breakfast downstairs, it is to die for. The area isn't the greatest, if you're planning on seeing to much of London (it's a bit of a pain getting about) but there are plenty of bars and places to eat if you're feeling lazy :)

title: The worst stay
text: When I first checked in, the receptionist made a mistake and made me pay twice the whole price of the stay which I did not get the refund added to my balance yet because it is an international transaction, no breakfast, no kettle or tea in the room only in the communion room, the TV did not work properly. The toiletries were not replaced until I had to ask for it The underground is not near. At the check out I forgot the cash deposit of 20 pounds and nobody reminded me to take it. In short the worst stay.

title: Hidden gem.
text: We were going to Brixton Academy for a gig and needed a local (ish) hotel so we didn't have far to walk afterwards. We travelled down by train and got the tube. My partner was very worried as we walked through the local area from the tube station about what quality of hotel we would find ourselves in but she had a very nice surprise! The rooms were spotless, airy and light and the breakfasts were out of this world. It was good to stay in such a unique hotel and certainly beats Travel Tavern. A nice touch was the 'honesty box' for the bar, which means you can get yourself a drink from the bar at any time and leave a note to say what you had. We foolishly left a pair of boots behind in the room. I asked the hotel if they would post them on and charge my credit card for the postage. They did it straight away and free of charge. We were there for three nights and took full advantage of the local pubs, which are excellent.

title: A special tret in a seriously overpriced city
text: I stayed here while visiting some friends in London. They were staying at the Hilton and said that, of course, it is nice there but they had to pay extra for absolutely everything. Well, at the church street hotel, you have wifi, a beautifully decorated room, free organic chocolate, hot sauce, bottled water, and an incredible and healthy breakfast. For the price and the convenient location, this cannot be beat. It was a pleasure to take the bus to get around for a change. I always knew where I was instead of walking out of a stuffy, dank tube station and feeling totally lost.

title: Cosy Retreat
text: I needed somewhere really close to Kings College Hospital as my husband had to stay in hospital for a few days, I searched so many web sites looking for something as close and clean as possible. I liked the look of the Church Street Hotels website and went for it. Well Im so glad I did, being a very nervous 55 year old woman on my own not used to London and not knowing where anything is. The moment I got to the Hotel I felt safe. My room was lovely, so cosy and clean the bed was big and very comfortable flat screen T.V and DVD. I was told I could help my self to any films I,d like to watch. The toiletries were delightful as was the complimentary chocolate. The staff were great very helpful and friendly, and breakfast delicious. I would definitely recommend this Hotel. Also this Hotel is a 10 minute walk along the main road to Kings College Hospital.

title: Very comfortable and welcoming.
text: Stayed here last night and although I never usually review hotels I stay in for business I wanted to express how lovely it is here. The staff are pleasant and the room is comfortable and well equipped. Breakfast is a little unusual but lovely. I will certainly remember this hotel when I am working in the area again.

title: Amazing find!
text: I came across this hotel after being let down on an airbnb place and I am so glad I was!! Cannot say enough nice things, room was gorgeous, large, light, bed was so comfy, bathroom was stunning. Little extras like the sauce and chocolate made it more personal. We just loved our stay and were almost tempted to see if the room was free for a second night! Really couldn't fault it! Honesty bar was well stocked and very much appreciated! Apologies to anyone who had to see me in there looking slightly worse for wear on the Saturday morning after we were out dancing until the small hours, wasn't expecting anyone to be there when I rocked up with crazy hair! :-) All in all, the hotel made a great weekend fabulous. Definitely be back!

title: Clean and Helpful
text: Bit quirky but the bedroom was clean, the bathroom was small but functional, plenty of toiletries provided and hairdryer. The room also had air con which was great in this muggy weather. Helpful reception staff and for the money it is really good value as far as London is concerned. Would stay there again

title: A quirky number!
text: Stayed here because it was convenient to visit our daughter, who lives in Camberwell. We were very pleasantly surprised by both the hotel and Camberwell itself. Our room was clean and comfortable and we liked the quirky decor. However it was very easy to get lost in the hotel as there were numerous stair cases a little corridors! We liked the honesty bar although it was expensive. Really good continental breakfast. All the staff we came across were friendly and helpful.

title: A piece of Mexico in London
text: My wife and I stayed at this hotel for three nights and we found very attractive. The staff is courteous and the breakfast is wonderful. They offer night drinks at the breakfast area and the guests can help themselves and just write down the consumption, they say that "in guest we trust". Very friend attitude of then. The decor is absolutely Mexican, but with good taste. They offer, as courtesy, two chocolate bars, a small hot pepper chutney, along with the good quality bathroom complements. Although the location is not the most charming one in London, there is plenty of buses that can take you anywhere in town. You can find restaurants on the neighborhood but I strongly recommend the hotel restaurant, Angels & Gypsies, that you can ask the front desk to make reservations.

title: Dissapointing and upsetting
text: What was meant to be a special (birthday) weekend turned into a very stressful and upsetting experience. After making the booking we were told we will get a nice quiet room when in fact there were loud noises all night, we hardly slept at all. There were constant footsteps, banging and all sorts of other noises coming through.and it really spoilt my birthday experience as it left us super tired, grumpy and upset. I also ensured that my dietary requirements where specified twice both there will be appropriate food for us to have as I paid the extra amount of £10 for breakfast (I am vegan and my partner is vegetarian). The facts stated on their website are no longer correct and there was hardly anything to eat for me (apart from dry toast and jam/marmite). If they would've told me before I wouldn't have bothered and made other breakfast arrangements. The guy on reception receptionist didn’t seem to understand our level of frustration and genuine and rather reasonable distress considering the circumstances and didn’t apologise once. In fact he made the situation more stressful for us as we felt attacked and his reaction can only be described as defensive and slightly aggressive also. We weren’t offered a refund or any sort of compensation for the room booking mistakes at all. It is not unreasonable to expect the room booked and pictured on your website to also be the room that you get offered on arrival and the facts that you were given on the phone or website (see vegetarian and vegan breakfast options) to be true as well. Neither of this was the case and we had a very distressing time at Church Street Hotel, which kind of affected us throughout the day. Our special stay in London wasn’t so special after all but rather upsetting in the end. This was a very unpleasant experience with no acceptable or satisfying outcome (i.e. compromising on the price/a refund or any other sort of compensation) and I wouldn't recommend staying there unless you bring proper earplugs and a magnifying glass.

title: Like a mini holiday
text: We stayed one night after one of us had day surgery at Kings College Hospital. It was absolutely lovely, quiet and comfortable room, fabulous decor and fittings. We loved the lounge area with the unlimited tea and coffee. Evening meal at the attached Tapas restaurant was excellent and the breakfasts also

title: Would have given 4.5 out of 5 if I could..
text: As the title says, I would have given it nearly top marks if I could - as there was one slight niggle - but overall and excellent place to stay.. The one slight downer - well I booked 2 rooms, one for my daughters and one for my wife and myself. Thought that for a treat I would book a lightly "better" room for me and the wife -so paid a little extra for this. However - when we go in the rooms - I couldn't tell the difference. They were both as nice as each other. Apparently (so I later discovered) - the only difference was that we had a king sized bed, rather than a double.. Not much of an "upgrade" if you ask me - but there you go. As for the hotel - loved it - staff were excellent - very helpful and friendly - breakfast was really nice - and the rooms were spotless and nicely turned out. Oh - 1 other thing - its quite a walk to the nearest tube station - either walk to Denmark Hill overland rail - or get a 36/436 bus to Oval tube station....

title: Wonderful stay
text: A nice friendly hotel, wonderful clean rooms and helpful staff. The breakfasts classed as "continental" were ample for us. Cereals, toasts, danish pastries, fresh orange/fruit juice, all delicious and made even more pleasant by the staff who were so obliging. Would definitely recommend.

title: Would have deserved a better rating but just couldn't sleep...
text: Stayed as a family of five.Hotel is a great 3/4 star boutique hotel in Camberwell.Quite a way from central London.I loved the Mexican theme and honestly they are great staff starting with Ali. The rooms feel like new and the housekeeping is great.Very clean.Good amenities and excellent linen.Beware there is No lift and staircases are narrow.Ali will help you get the luggage upstairs. These are my issues:The open bar remains open the whole night.My wife couldn't sleep until 3 am due to the rowdy drunk guests.They should really lock it after mid-night.We were given compensation and they opened the cellar to avoid people disturbing guests during the following evenings.Very thoughtful but damage done. On the third night one guest(drunk I guess) sent of the fire alarm at 2 am!!!! Forget the worry but again NO sleep.Ofcourse it was not the hotels fault but still... I spent one night in room 34...(?) No air-con so had to keep the window open.Ofcourse an open widow on Church Street is not a good idea due to the traffic,music and general emergency services rushing through. Again the hotel is not responsible but basically I love a good nights sleep and hotel did not deliver. I know they can't change the location but when they reserve a big loud group the should avoid having other guests. Would have loved to rate very - good but it just missed the mark.

title: Great, great, great
text: The staff of this hotel is very amazing - it's probably one of its best features. They are all personable, friendly and kind. The room itself is lovely - it's tastefully decorated, even being quite small. The thing I dislike a lot about it is that the door closes after you, so if you forget the key to go to the toilet, you are locked out. Aside from that small disadvantage, the rest is great. I primarily had a beef with hotels that had shared bathrooms, but it's not that big of a deal here, quite on the contrary: the bathroom is bigger than a regular ensuite bathroom and shared with few rooms (two more, in my case). So grand, I guess I don't have an issue anymore. They had this very lovely handwritten note, with chocolate and bottled water on the side, telling me to have a lovely stay - thanks, I did!

title: Home from home
text: We frequently stay at this gem of a hotel in South London when visiting our son & family. It is a charming & very welcoming small hotel. If you wish for huge bedrooms with awe inspiring views & need a lift to upper floors read no further. However in other respects it is a great base for seeing London with easily accessed transport & great local cafes, bars & restaurants. The ensuite bathrooms are quite unique with amazing tiling & the best fluffiest biggest white bathtowels of any hotel. The decor throughout is South America with electic artwork. There is an honesty bar ( extremely well stocked ) where tea /coffee / ice is freely available. This lounge is really comfortable ( you can bring in a take away & enjoy here ) Also DVDs to hire , board games. Breakfast is continental with wide choice of cereals, juice, yoghurt, speck, cheese, eggs & fresh bread where the toaster has a ' knack ' to it. Danish pastries too & copious good coffee /tea. Check out this beautiful hotel

title: Gorgeous Hotel with great in-room facilities
text: Me and my girlfriend stayed for one night at the Hotel. We didn't arrive till around 9pm, so we didn't take in any of the other facilities available at the hotel. The room was gorgeous, terrific design and entirely 5 star! The bathroom was exceptional, with a fantastic shower. All air con and lighting could be controlled via the tv remote. When we woke in the morning we could take in the view, which to one side was fantastic, overlooking The Thames. The only downside comes if you look over the other side of the road at the builder's merchants. Breakfast was fantastic, which we ordered to the room for a small extra charge. The location of the Hotel isn't ideal, but it isn't as bad as other reviews make out. We got a taxi to the Hotel in the evening, but when we checked out we decided to walk to Clapham Junction station as it was a lovely day. It took us about 15minutes and was very easy to find. I can't agree with the reviews that the location takes away anything from this Hotel, and I do believe they offer a free bookable shuttle service to Clapham Junction anyway. Overall a fantastic stay at a very fashionable and trendy hotel

title: How fun! Funky Ambience!!
text: This is not normally the type of place we end up in, but we had a good stay! Arrived late in the night

title: Best kept secret revealed
text: The only complain possible with regard to this place is that God apparently allocates the good taste so unevenly. Almost all of it went to people who can create places like this and who manage to keep it breathing the same spirit. A tiny bit fell to our lot so that we would be able to appreciate the beauty of such places. "Bags of idiosyncrasy" already mentioned on the website. Incredible value for money. Great people, great breakfast, complimentary hot drinks and DVD collection, great comfort. No fuss and no nonsense. We spent there few weeks when first came to the city and after a year in London - our wedding day with few guests placed here next to us. Great food for a picnic from Angels&Gypsies ordered just the night before was prepared and packed with great care and along with genuine smiles from all the staff around and surprise-surprise on the bed upon arrival - all made our (wedding) day! I would also address possible doubts. Camberwell?...With an oyster card this Camberwell's treasure would be a perfect gateway to the diverse capital of all good stuff on Earth where they truly appreciate variety (besides, that's why the prices are so reasonable). The district is not Shoreditch, beardymen, but the there are direct buses. Afraid of beggars around after dark? Like anywhere in London. Actually, bless them, probably they solely keep the "beardyness" of the hotel at bearable level. For someone really concerned with the lack of soundproof walls in the hotel - nothing to worry about, really...or was that you who began liking his grandmother much less because you have to speak louder from time to time? It's a living thing! (this gorgeous place)

title: Great little hotel
text: My husband and I stayed here for a night while in London to see a gig at the Brixton Academy, and were very impressed with the place. It's not the best located for the tube (Oval is 20 min walk away) but buses run from outside into central London very frequently. We got a complimentary upgrade on check in to an en-suite room (beware - the £90 deal is for a room with a shared bathroom which I'd have never booked if I'd have realised). The room was compact but spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated. The complimentary breakfast is gorgeous and the staff very friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again

title: An excellent place to stay.
text: We were at Go Native Monument for one week, it was an excellent experience. The apartment was very clean, its appliances were so useful to cook and feel like home. The staff were so helpful. We would definitely stay at the apartment again. Well located and highest standards. We definetely will stay here again.

title: Excellent hotel
text: Brilliant, comfortable, roomy, clean, staff really friendly and helpful, well connected for tourist with underground and train station. Would totally stay here again and have already recommended to friends. I will definitely go back

title: Hidden Gem
text: When I'm on the road I like to feel as though I'm the very first person to ever set foot in the place where I'm staying. With this apartment I got that feeling the moment I walked in the door. It was nicely lit, had double aspect windows, the smoothest wooden floor and very comfortable furniture. The queen size bed was superb with plenty of pillows - I slept very well as a result. There was a small kitchen in the living room which was very handy - I've long since outgrown the "thrill" of eating alone in restaurants and would rather just cook at home. Most important of all, the place was clean to the point of being immaculate. The washing machine was another useful feature. I'm not a fan of communal laundry rooms and having a machine just for me is ideal. Location-wise, the unassuming entrance is in a discreet pedestrian street close to Monument tube station, and the pubs and restaurants of London Bridge are a short walk away across the River Thames. Couldn't be better!

title: What a Lovely place!!!
text: I spent Easter with my boyfriend in this lovely hotel. The apartments are new, fully furnished, clean and the staff was just lovely. A special thanks to Michael for be so kind and professional. These apartments are in a great location (really close to the station) and walking distance to London's mayor attraction, I would recommend it either for business and pleasure trips.

title: Brilliant Hotel
text: Wow this hotel is absolutely fantastic. Rooms are spacious and modern but more importantly the Staff are absolutely fantastic, especially the young lady from Portugal. I stayed in this hotel whilst on business in October and subsequently stayed at the Club Quarters Gracechurch Hotel in January which was horrific which prompted this review as I really enjoyed my stay here so strongly recommend this hotel for its friendly staff as well as great accommodation and position.

title: Great place to stay in the city
text: I stayed 6 nights for work. The office is the walkie talkie building so super convenient, just across the street! Check in was fine, although they didn't let me have early check in, they did allow me to use the bathroom to freshen up so I didnt feel so bad after a 13 hour flight. The studio was lovely, just like the photos. My only comment is that the housekeeping only comes every 7 days, so I was left with a pile of rubbish that wasn't disposed of and had to keep asking reception for additional coffee/milk/toiletries as it wasn't restocked. Finally, check out was smooth and even allowed me an extra hour to check out. However, when I asked what the main road was to order an uber, the receptionist was clueless and kept saying Lovat Lane - surely a car cannot drive down a cobbled lane. I managed to figure it out in the end so it was fine. All in all, a great location, close to my office, tube stops, food options and bridge, and a lovely apartment, with a few minor niggles, for a reasonable price, that made the week in London very enjoyable. I will definitely stay again!

title: Wooow, just wow
text: This is the perfect place to stay when you are in London. If I could make this my own apartment I would. Just loved it. Close to just everything worth seeing. Bed was like, never want to leave. Everything you need is in the room, even a walking buddy phone 😂 just so happy to have experienced the native monument hotel. Service was 5 star to

title: Great apartment in central location.
text: I found this apartment when looking for somewhere to stay for the night when I attended an awards ceremony at Drapers Hall which is only 10-15 mins walk from here. It's down a cobbled side street off the main road and only 5 mins walk from the Great Fire of London monument which it is named after. It is also opposite the Walrus and Carpenter pub & really close to the river and Tower Bridge. Check in was relatively simple and our room was on the 3rd floor. It's not the room I expected - I thought I had booked the premium apartment but it seems I was given the premium studio so the photos are quite misleading. I was hoping for a sofa and a bit more room so I think the photos need to match the apartments better on the e mail confirmation. I must add that I wanted to check in a bit earlier than normal due to attending an early function and communication was excellent in regards to this although it couldn't be confirmed until on the day but I was really happy with the communication from Georgina. This has raised the rating to very good otherwise it would have been average because one of the major problems I had was with the state of the apartment floor. I hung my long black evening dress in the cupboard and when I put it on my partner commented on the fact I seemed to have lots of white fluff on the bottom of my dress... when I looked it appeared that my dress had picked up lots and lots of dust... when we looked in the cupboard and elsewhere next to the bed and table there was loads of dust, clumps of it! It's a hard wood floor so I wouldn't have thought it would be that difficult to clean the dust but it actually looks like it was swept to the side of the bed! This was so disappointing as I ended up having to pick all the dust clumps off my dress and even then I couldn't remove them all! The apartment would have been just right if it hadn't been for the dirty floor! :(

title: Hard to fault
text: I stayed here for one night as I had meetings nearby. Great location just off Eastcheap. Friendly, efficient check-in. Nice, modern and spacious room. Little kitchenette. Boozer (lively) right next door. Bodeans for decent BBQ short walk away. Loads of places to eat and drink nearby. If you need to be in this part of the City I would absolutely consider this place. The one over the river at Bankside is great too. And I am staying at Native Hyde Park this coming week.. they must be doing something right..

title: Excellent Accommodation
text: My top floor apartment was fantastic, extremely comfortable and with everything I required including lovely toiletries and large, fluffy bath towels. Unlike a lot of hotels these days where you are left to find your own room, I was shown up to the apartment by a very friendly and professional member of the Go Native team who made sure I was totally familiar with the workings of everything. I was concerned that the location would be a bit out of the way, but it was perfect, I had no idea how central it actually is. I feel like I have found a second home in London!

title: Easy check-in, upgraded, pleasant experience
text: First of all the location is very easy to get to, about one block from Monument Square in London. It was also just one or two doors down from a pub right on the corner which made it easy for us to get food and drinks. Upon the unit to be upgraded with brand-new appliances, a beautiful bathroom and kitchen and had everything we needed. The staff was courteous and friendly and helped us with all the directions we need it for trains and restaurants. I will definitely come back here again.

title: Deserves 5 stars
text: I stayed over Christmas so it was fairly quiet in the area, but even so the heavy windows and thick curtains really helped to reduce the traffic noise from the main road. This is definitely one of the best London apartments that I've stayed in. The room was spacious, modern and well laid out with a separate bathroom and kitchen area and with a full (not just microwave) kitchen. I would have definitely felt comfortable staying a little longer. The staff were really helpful and courteous and I saw them eagerly helping different tourists with directions and tips. The location is great it may seem out of the way for central London, but by walking along the river you can get to Westminster in 20-30 minutes.

title: Comfy, cosy and right at the heart of the city
text: I stayed here for 2 nights and had an incredibly enjoyable stay. I've stayed in a few "Serviced Apartments" before, but I can safely say that this was the best one yet. The staff were friendly, courteous and professional and the room itself was of the highest standard, with easy-to-access WiFi (a must for a person like myself), a kitchen area that has exactly what one would need for a short stay and a very comfortable bed. I would definitely recommend the room I had to anyone wanting to come into the city for business, as it has some of the best transport links of any serviced apartment I have used, and also for couples wanting to have a mini-break.

title: Great location and modern apartment
text: We stayed there last week in room 507, 2 BR 2 BA, and it was great! A/C works great, plenty of hot water. The washer/dryer combo washes great but, as is always the case with these units, takes over two hours to dry your clothes to 'distinctly damp' so we quickly gave up on that and used the large, sturdy drying rack provided. The dishwasher as well seemed to leave dishes dirtier than they began so we just washed by hand. The terrace is a lot smaller ! than it appears in pictures, maybe 5 feet by 6, but was still so nice to sit out there with a cup of tea! Despite being inside the city it was quiet, and being right next to the Monument (and the Monument's tube station) was very convenient for tourists to explain to people where they needed to go. There are two grocery stores nearby and a very easy walk to the Tower of London.

title: Wonderful hotel, great location and the best staff and amenities provided
text: This property is fantastic first and foremost due to the amazing team that work there, they are so friendly, accommodating and professional. The room was absolutely beautifully appointed and had the most generous amenities of any of the serviced apartments we have stayed at anywhere. The hotel is very centrally located in the Financial district only a few minutes walk to the Tower of London and the London Bridge. A short two minute walk to the tube for easy access to all other parts of London and close to pubs, restaurants and a Tesco. Unable to fully express just how much we enjoyed our stay. The 23 hour reception service is also wonderful as you know there is always someone there to help you if required.

title: Enjoyable stay & good value proposition
text: I’d recently spent three nights at the Native Monument serviced apartments. This is the first time that I stayed in a hotel in the city (previous trips were all at hotels in the West End) so it’s quite exciting for me for a change of scenery. Native Monument is located very close to the Monument tube station (District and Circle lines). The circle line can be confusing if you are a first time visitor to London so look out for the train display information at the platform. I had a one bedroom apartment on the first floor, which looks out to the busy Lower Thames Street. It’s a busy road during the day and noisy. The unit was clean, well equipped, the bed was comfortable, wifi worked well. The bathroom was a bit tight. The glass cabinet above the sink can be a danger if you lean forward when brushing your teeth. I had to remind myself not to lean forward to avoid knocking on the glass corner of the cabinet. The washing machine worked well but the wash cycle took two hours. The Native Monument’s location turned out well for me - quite close to London Bridge and a easy walk to Tower Bridge. Overall, it was a comfortable stay and of good value.

title: Good location for business
text: Reason for staying at native monument was because its near to my office. The bed was too small for two ppl and I doubt it will fit a tall person. You need your key to open the facilities door in your room where the washing machine was. No one has informed us nor any signage which I think these are things that’s need to be improved. The hotel is located right next to a pub so prepared noise from 5pm onwards. Fortunately we had fell asleep after a long day but probably you need to reconsider if this will cause an issue.

title: Weekend away
text: These apartments are excellent, they have everything you could want. They are fully equipped, spacious and clean in an excellent location 5 minutes from the tube. The staff are friendly and helpful, would definitely go back, many thanks.

title: Cosy appt for fair price
text: I came to this hotel occasionally, because the other hote (where I usually stay in London) was already booked... But finally it was a nice discovering: hotel is modern & comfortable :-) Much better than I expected. Actually I feel me home :-) I will be glad to come back.

title: Live like a Londoner
text: Very spacious two bedroom apartment with the comforts of home. Two TV’s, two baths, and a balcony with a view. Simple washing machine for small loads which case in handy. Staff was very helpful and enjoyed staying here with family as opposed to our regular hotel.

title: Hidden Gem
text: Great place. A bit difficult to find, but once you've seen the apartment, you will be very pleasantly surprised. It's an apartment, so don't expect restaurant facilities or breakfast. But there are plenty of shops nearby. Also a very good Italian Restaurant in the same street, just 50 meters up. The apartment itself is brand new (2 months). Very stylish interior design. Enough space, very clean, bathroom very good. Has a dish washer as well as washing maschine. I can really recommend. Tube is just around the corner (monument). Tower bridge is a 15 minute walk.

title: Ideal
text: The apartment-residence is new and very clean. All is special and the staff too is very kind and professional. The placement is fantastic because it's close at Tower of London in the city of London. So the placement is good for workers and tourists. The Monument underground station is very close. I hope go back in this recidence. Remember that the housekeeping is one a week, but that's isn't a problem for me

title: Amazing stay
text: I only stayed over for 1 night in the 1 bed apartment but it is amazing! Cheaper than many hotels here so you can not go wrong! Gorgeous and modern with absoutely everything! From washing wachine to baking trays and tea bags/milk/coffee. It is very spacious and has large drop windows too. You also get a free Smart phone to use during the stay with access to internet and calling UK/EU for FREE! Great touch.Check-in and service was very quick and easy with friendly service. Location is amazing in Financial District with many bars/clubs/eateries on your doorstep. Lovat Lane is very sweet and quirky with old brick floor. My only complain is that half way through the night, I woke with my body in pain as the bed was so hard! I laid on my side and could feel the hardness of the bed pushing on my body so much it was hurting! If I was staying more than 1 night this probably would have been an issue!! Will stay with Go Native again for sure.

title: GREAT Apartment - only 1 complaint!
text: I stayed at the Go Native Monument for 5 nights & absolutely LOVED it! My only complaint is that like everyone else said, the beds are SUPER hard which is weird considering how lovely everything else was! I'm a troubled sleeper in beds that are not my own so I usually travel with my own memory foam topper so I can get a decent night's sleep. But even with my 2 inch high quality memory foam topper from my bed at home, I still woke up with a sore back, neck & shoulders & felt exhausted from tossing & turning all night trying to get comfortable. Aside from that, the apartment was in a FANTASTIC location - a grocery store was just a 7 min walk away which was great because the apartment had a small kitchen that was fully stocked. Right outside the apartment there are several nice pubs to grab a drink, and just a 4 min walk away is a tube station that connects very easily to all the other lines. The apartment was very clean, the staff was very friendly & accommodating, the towels & sheets were of good quality, there was a washer/dryer in the apartment as well as a dishwasher, and the decor was beautiful & stylish! I'm coming back to London again this year and I would definitely book here again UNDER ONE CONDITION: they invest in some new beds that aren't so hard! Seriously, these beds are a real deal breaker!

title: wonderful apartment!!
text: The apartment is in Monument and it is very useful area to sight seen. There are many amenity like washing machine , dish washer ,as well microwave. Also the every staff is smiling and very friendly. Of course they have hospitality. Almost apartment are no staff and you should go to another building to chek-in. But this apartment staff are staying from 8:00 to 20:00. So if you got something trouble, you can ask the staff. If you search somewhere go to hotel, you should book the apartment.

title: Awful - Very loud traffic noise, cheap furniture, no room servicing
text: One of the biggest disappointments in a long time. These 'apartments' photograph very well but in reality are nothing like the presentation. Main issue is the building is right next to one of the busiest highways in London and there is constant very loud traffic noise at all times of day and night. The owners have put secondary internal glazing in a couple of bedrooms which helps a lot but not in all apartments and not in the living rooms. Result is constant background traffic noise which is sometimes so loud it feels like a truck is outside your window (even on the 5th floor). Other issues, the furniture is good looking but very cheap and uncomfortable. The sofa has very thin cheap foam and is very small, so not comfortable to relax at end of days work. BEd is also very cheap spring mattress. Firm but can feel all springs so get plenty of dead arms in the night. The kitchenette is minute. The building also only provides room cleaning once a week, so you have to wash your own towels, and take your own trash to the basement. Only Pros: Shower water pressure is very good Staff are very helpful and try their best but they are saddled with an awful building. I stay in London every six weeks and this is the worst place i've stayed in years. Avoid.

title: Livin' in "The City"
text: I had researched this hotel-apartment on TripAdvisor before booking and it exceeded its excellent reviews. The rooms were very spacious, bed comfortable in our view, and the living room/kitchen were exceptionally large and well-equipped, especially the roomy fridge. I have been to London many many times, stayed in lots of hotels, but had not before spent time in the east end, or "City". Go Native Monument is indeed steps away from Monument tube station which connects you to the whole city. Nice pub across the street. although deserted on weekends. Great launching pad for people doing business in the City, or visiting Tower of London, Borough Market, St. Paul's, etc. We were very pleased.

title: Love this place
text: the check in was problematic. their card machine wasn't working and they insisted the issue was with my card. despite trying 3-4 different cards. the other staff members were a little more accommodating but one in particular was very rude. he then said it's my cards that have a problem and to prove it hell charge one pound on his card. that didn't work either. so eventually they established their machine had a problem. anyway after a while it was back up. the location is great as are the rooms. apart from the check in. love the accommodation. will definitely come again. it's perfect!

title: Perfect place to stay
text: Who needs a “hotel” when you can stay in a really nice high spec apartment for less. There are dozens of nearby eateries so that breakfast or other meals are on tap. Great location and close enough to Monument tube station to be able to walk with a wheelie suitcase. Very friendly staff and would highly recommend

title: Beautiful apartment!
text: I really like the one bedroom that I stayed in, it was beautiful, clean with great kitchen. The bed sheets were brilliant, I couldn't wait to go to sleep! Also the location is within a cobbled stone road with friendly reception. The quality is as good as any 5 star hotel in London, great value. Will recommend to everyone needing a secure stay in London.

title: Well situated, lovely accomodation - exceptional value
text: We had a fantastic couple of days stay in London in our Go Native apartment at Monument. I had been looking for some alternative accommodation to the usual hotels we at stay in London and I came across Go Native, they looked interesting and a bit different so I thought we should give it a try. When we arrived at the address we were pleasantly surprised to find such a wonderful building set within a picturesque cobbled street, we were then greeted by the lovely reception staff and they checked us in very efficiently. Our room was well laid out, warm and comfortable with lovely furnishings which gave the room a sophisticated 'boutique esq' feel which was perfect! The kitchenette was a brilliant feature that drew me to the accommodation, it was well equipped but we could have done with a small amount of basic larder ingredients including salt, pepper and oil to make full use of the facility without having to purchase a whole bottle of oil for example. The room was fitted with great climate A/C which was easy to use. The bathroom was fresh and light with a great selection of The White Company complimentary toiletries. The shower was excellent however the bath was on the small side which was not ideal but on the whole we had an excellent, highly recommended experience which exceeded the standard of a hotel in a similar price range.

title: Refreshing change
text: London hotels can be notoriously expensive and often the rooms are tiny. With Wimbledon tennis approaching its end the hotel prices rocketed. Go Native was a refreshing find. There is no restaurant or bar here - you have a kitchen in your room and more places to eat and drink within a stones throw than you could manage. The room was big - sofa, chairs.....the bathroom I loved. Huge shower. It is a 5 minute walk from Monument Underground station. No negatives from me. Would stay again in a heartbeat (and probably will).

title: Can not recommend highly enough, great location and apartment!!!
text: We had been travelling through Europe for three weeks and were having our last week in London, last time we were her we did not get enough time to see all we wanted to see, and experience London in a way the locals do. This apartment was magnificent, close to the business or financial district or close to tower bridge and Tower of London, Monument underground is a mere 2 min walk, and there is a Tesco just round the corner for the things you might need. The apartment we had was on the third floor, we booked a premium one bedroom and were pleasantly surprised, the best things were the space, the fact it was well stocked with what you would need before you get to the shops, central heating and cooling just like we have at home, it was quiet and very functional. They provided dishwashing tablets, washing powder tablets, dishwashing liquid, tea, coffee, sugar, UHT milk enough for a few days. The washing machine /dryer was great especially when you have travelled for a time and other hotels charge a small fortune to wash clothing. A few things which irked us were, the small double bed with a mattress as hard as a rock (saying that, we find it hard to sleep in hotel beds at the best of times) shower over bath, not my favourite thing to have to deal with at my age, but we were happy to concede that it seems to be a favourite of hotels these days. The staff were more than helpful and pleasant, I had emailed asking if we could have an early check in and they said they would do their best but could not promise, happy with that and they did in fact have our room ready early as we had asked. I would have no hesitation staying at any of the Go Native apartments while traveling, I wish they had them in more locations.

title: Good access London Tower and Bridge
text: We just had a lovely four day stay in one of the apartments. Well appointed with cooking and laundry facilitates. Very historic part of the City of London close to where the great London fire started. There are lots of places to eat close by and the Tower, London bridge and Markets are within walking distance. The staff were welcoming and helpful with advice. It is worth noting this is not near the West End or Houses of Parliament which required a trip by taxi or the underground.

title: Excellent All Round
text: We were placed in these Appartments as we were attending a conference at a local business centre. Outstanding quality rightly listed on each review: kitchen, fridge with milk, dish washer, washer/drier. I travel widely, these are amongst the best equipped and best quality facilities I have ever stayed in. Location is fantastic for the City - I don't think I will stay in a hotel again! Good value and great staff, easy stay, great service and product.

title: I Highly recommend!!!
text: We stayed there the first week of August and had a great time!! The apartment was awesome, with everything we needed and more. Perfecly located, very close to Monument Station where we could go almost everywhere.The staff is very correct and helpful. The bed was perfect for us and the place very clean and quiet. I would come back!!!

title: Better than you might expect
text: Let me start by saying this was a last minute thing, booked on a comparison website at the last minute about 8pm the night of the stay. I booked because there was a massive discount and I just needed a room. That said, the service was good, the communication was excellent, and the room itself was a small 1br apartment with a proper kitchenette including actual pots, pans, cutlery etc. You could actually use it. Quite impressive. Now clearly someone had done that, because the room stank of curry, not just someone had eaten curry but rather they'd lovingly slaved away for hours cooking to the point where it was just ingrained in the fibres of the flooring. Two days and three showers later I think I can still smell it on me. Also, it was ground floor, street level, with frosted windows across the lane from the pub next door where let me assure you there is plenty of activity standing in the lane leaning on my windows drinking and smoking until quite late. Undoubtedly this was the last and worst room they had, and they were dumping it on the internet. But id give them another shot. Somewhere higher, away from the pub, which doesn't ooze curry, is probably a pretty good deal if you're a road warrior who likes to actually buy weetabix for breakfast and sit on a proper sofa and watch TV in the evening. I've ranked it on the basis that it is actually pretty good and has huge potential if you don't get the curry room outside the pub...

title: Hard beds and noisy but close to everything
text: This apartment block is very close to the tube and Tower of London. Beds are very hard and only doubles. Our room was very noisy from the pub next door and all night road noise. Bathroom very small, couldn't shut the door without getting nearly into the shower or if sitting on the toilet. Kitchen fine and lounge area good. Wifi good. Staff were excellent very helpful and obliging. Tescos, sainsbury and M&S within 5 minutes. Just ask when booking for a back unit and in the quietest part.

title: Great big room, hard bed
text: We had a great stay at go native monument. The room was huge, great kitchen with all the books so you know how to used the microwave oven if need be, great location near monument and bank tube stations, walking distance to the London bridge, borough markets, the shard etc. There is a note to say that they only service the rooms once a week, we were only there for 3 nights so that was fine by us. My main issues were the bed and the shower. My husband loved that the bed was like sleeping on a plank of wood. I did not. The shower was also a bit hit snd miss. Sometimes it was ok, other times it would continually go from boiling hot to freezing cold. The instructions in the booklet were for a different shower. We also had dishwasher tablets but no dishwasher...

title: Wonderful
text: Visited recently ,stayed in studio Second visit.From start to finish amazing.Wonderfully placed ,5 minutes from Tower of London and monument station Clean and modern decor and a beautiful rainfall shower.There is even a washing machine !!!! Staff friendly and helpful ,always a smile Definitely for placement,value and comfort one of the loveliest places to stay in london

title: Well appointed
text: Arrived early but able to store luggage. A really well appointed apartment- small but with everything needed. The washer/dryer and detergent was a nice touch. Pub noise early one morning of our stsy (beer barrels) frustrating, but ok. Superb location to Monument station, a great breakfast spot within a two minute walk and a pub on the corner. Chemist and supermarket very close. An easy walk to grab a hop on / off tourist bus too. Recommended.

title: Great! Just one little thing..
text: Everything and everyone was great. The price, location, layout, furniture, amenities all lovely. Both the staff I dealt with were really nice and helpful. Except... the bed was uncomfortable and the comforter and pillows could have been fluffier/nicer. Maybe just my room? If same in all rooms then I'd recommend an upgrade. I'll definitely consider coming back.

title: Good value
text: Nice flat, nicely decorated, very clean and well equipped. Location is very central and convenient, yet aways from the chaos. Painless and friendly check in and check out. Ground floor flat was a bit too dark, buy this was already expected, no surprise there. The "only" downside was the bed: I normally like firm beds, but this one was a bit too hard for me. Plus, it was too small for 2 and too short for anyone taller than 1:75m.

title: Nice apartment near borough market
text: I wanted to provide a bit more than what others have already said about this apartment. It's near monument station which means it's not in heart of shopping area. However this is a good location if you don't want to be in the middle of chaos. This is near London bridge (2 mins walk) and the famous borough market is a mere 6 mins walk away! Which mean you can easily have a nice brunch after a good morning walk! They have now gotten someone to man the Recep except from 6 to 8am. Pretty good value all in all.

title: Excellent location. Wonderful apartment
text: Stayed in a studio apartment for 2 nights. Only one tube line from Euston which was great considering we were dragging cases and then 2 min walk from Monument tube station. Apartment was spotless, well equipped and perfectly located for Tower of London. There is a Tesco express & a Sainsburys close by plus an array of other shops just 2 blocks back. Staff were so friendly with a warm welcome morning & night. Definitely stay again as it gave us so much more freedom than a hotel.

title: Why stay in a hotel?
text: What a find and like John D's review I am torn about reviewing too but ultimately I think the property and staff deserve it.! Great location if working in the financial district, or would prefer to be out of the west end. The apartments and studios are extremely well appointed with excellent facilities for cooking if you so choose but also their are many restaurants right in the neighbourhood if you prefer. The big 2 positives for me though are that firstly their is a reception desk (with very attentive and friendly staff) from 8am to 8pm, which certainly not all serviced apartments have. Secondly and crucially for me, they are sound proofed and as a quitter as they can be given they are in one of the busiest cities in the world. I have stayed in many serviced apartments and believe you me its crazy the number that aren't.

title: Have a back up
text: Make sure you have a back up as they canceled our stay the day before for "unforeseen circumstances". Been to the go native tower Hill, which was a disaster in terms of organisation and flat conditions.. .

title: Great stay
text: We stayed at Go Native Monument for 4 nights. We arrived late at 9pm and the reception was closed. However, they gave us check in instructions in advance. The process was smooth. The location of the apartment was very nice. Within 5 mins walk to tube. And nearby was tower bridge and london bridge. Everything was great. Highly recommend.

title: In the heart of City of London
text: The location was hard to beat. Very close to the subway (District line - easy change to Piccadilly line, and then on to the airport), to the bus stop (famous bus No 15 is running there, too). It is in the heart of the City and thus close to all its attractions! The kitchenette was well equipped. Only a dishwasher was missing (there was a washing machine, which we would happily swap for dishwasher), as well as kitchen towel and no table cloth. The apartment was very clean, too. I should also mention easy process for the self check-in and I had got a very detailed description per e-mail. And, unlike in many small hotels, the late check-in is free. On the negative side, we were given a room on the ground floor, although we had been asking for a room at the upper floors. There was no daylight and worse, no possibility to open the windows! We think the hotels should (and booking sites must require them so) explicitly state on their webpage the fact that the windows cannot be opened. Then, bathroom is designed in a way that makes the whole floor wet when taking the shower. The lights there are too dim.

title: Great find!
text: Excellent apartment in a good area - Our rooms had views of The Shard. Staff very friendly, helpful and efficient. Room very modern and well equipped. Can't fault it. Would use Go Native again and have already recommended to a friend.

title: Excellent quality/value, spacious, and nice place to stay in London. Much better than a regular hotel
text: Go Native Monument is not a standard hotel. In my opinion it's a much better option if you're visiting London. We stayed at a very nice, spacious studio apartment with a small but very well equipped kitchenette, a tiny but comfortable living room and a well-sized bathroom. They don't clean the room everyday, and there's no receptionist or personnel overnight - as opposed to what they'd do/have in a hotel. However, the price and the quality is a million times better than what you can get for the same price at a standard London hotel. The location is not central but it's excellent nonetheless: it's a relatively quiet area, 5min walk from the tube station, 10min from the Borough market (where you can have an excellent breakfast), very close to the Tate Modern, St Paul, The Barbican, all the good restaurants in Clerkenwell and the 'cool' London east: Spitalfields, Brick Lane, Hackney etc. It might not be the most convenient location if you're using Heathrow Airport but an excellent option if you're travelling via Gatwick (London Bridge Station is super close). There were just a couple of not-so-good things: - the bed is a bit small - my partner is 1.87m and he didn't fit well - and the bed linens were not soft at all - they were rather rough. - There were only toiletries for one person (we asked for an extra set, however, and they gave us more without any problems) Apart from this everything was perfect and we very much enjoyed our weekend in London. OH! the tea bags provided are EXCELLENT!

title: Good location
text: Hotel is in the middle of Monument and Bank underground. Very convenience for taking underground. Just need 15 minutes to Tower of London. So that we go twice. haha~ Kitchen delights the apartment, you can get all appliance you need. AND they are alll new and clean! Remember to buy oil and salt before cooking. They are not included~ Btw, Washing power is included. Lucky that live on the 5/F, Quiet at night, we have good sleep. Service is just so so. With a reasonable price, we do not have much expectation. It will be nice if more plastic bags for rubbish bins. We only got 4 while there are 3 rubbish bins in apartment and we stay for 6 days. Staff gave us a huge black plastic bag. That might not related to service as that’s all she can gave.

title: Perfect home base while in London
text: When looking for a place to stay on our first trip to London, we explored many options. Traditional hotels were expensive, AirBnB locations just didn't feel like the right option for this trip and then we stumbled upon Go Native Monument. The price was extremely reasonable for our 10 day stay. The location is in more of a business district, so you have to jump on a bus or use the Subway system to get to most locations, however both options are within a couple blocks and take only a few minutes to access. Upon our arrival we were greeted by the extremely friendly staff and given a room on the 2nd floor. The room was the perfect size for us, had a full kitchen and washer & dryer. After our first night, we realized that the street noise from the nearby pub was quite an issue and the staff were very nice in relocating us to a different, slightly smaller room on a different floor (We paid through Expedia & and ended up paying a bit more for the smaller room). This made all the difference and the rest of our stay was comfortable and quiet. You don't get daily maid service, but this was not an issue for us (you get it once a week). All beds at this location are doubles and were too small for us to both sleep really comfortably as we are used to queen or king size beds. There are 2 grocery stores withing walking distance and you can save some money by stocking your fridge and cooking a few meals in the room. Prices at both were very reasonable. Kitchens have everything you need and more including a dishwasher. You are within walking distance of Tower of London, Tower Bridge & The Monument to the great fire (climb the 311 spiral steps for some amazing views) Check out was fast and easy and we would stay at any of their locations if in London again.

title: No one was at the front desk! No service, surprisingly bad service apartment. 最悪のサービスと呑気なカスタマーサポート。
text: Go Nativeのチェーン。立地は良いが、オフィス街なので日曜日夜は周辺のレストランも店も開いていないので要注意。 １ベッドルームの部屋は、こじんまりとしているが快適。キッチンには食器や紅茶も揃っており調理はしやすい。洗濯乾燥機も便利。シーツは変えてくれないし、清掃も無し。自分でゴミ出しの必要もある。 問題は基本的な対応。午後８時半までしかフロントに人がいないということで、７時半に到着。 数人のゲストがフロントの前にたむろしていたが、従業員の姿は皆無。そのうち皆さん諦めて誰もいなくなった。が、さて困った。カスタマーサポートに電話してみたら、部屋のカギを用意してあるはずだから事務所に入って金庫を開けろという。フロントの人間は不在だが飲みかけのコーヒーに、点けっぱなしのラジオがデスクの上に放置。嫌な気持ちで暗証番号を聞いて開けてみたが中は空っぽ。サポートの外国人風のオバサンとああでもない、こうでもないと３０分以上電話で話しながら事務所の中を探す。 そのうちファックス・マシーンの裏側に封筒が二つ落ちているのを見つける。ひとつに自分の名前を発見！ 中にカギも入っている。ポーランド系と思しきカスタマーセンターのオバサンは、Good job!と電話の向こうで笑っている。どっと疲れる体験だった。余談だが、ロストバゲッジのスーツケースが真夜中の二時半に届いた。 フロントには誰もいないので携帯電話に連絡があり、建物の入り口を開けろと言う。 延着したスーツケースは破損で真っ二つに割れていた。英国のサービスは落ちるとこまで落ちたのか。

title: Ideal location, modern apartments with everything you need!
text: Go Native monument is brilliant! We visited in Sept 2016, and used it as a base for exploring. The monument and it's tube station are both literally around the corner. Tower of London is a 5-10 min walk. Staff all very friendly, they even printed a money-off voucher for me :) Rooms have everything you need, even a pint of milk which was a nice touch, and a great range of complimentary teas :D Free wifi too. We would 100% stay again.

title: Pleasantly Surprised!
