text: This was a great studio apartment. Fresh, clean & modern with a touch of class, the layout makes the most of this space. The bathroom was spotless & the kitchen area has everything you need. Location great for my office on Lovat Lane & Monument station.

title: Great modern studio
text: I was very impressed by our accommodation, which was spacious, clean and modern. The bed was very comfortable, and the shower room was great, with no issues regarding water temperature or pressure. In fact, it all felt quite luxurious. The kitchen area was clean and up to date, with everything you could need for cooking for yourself, if you wanted to. Tea, coffee and a small amount of milk were provided. There was a washing machine and ironing equipment, if you are staying for a while. The receptionist was very friendly and helpful. Great transport links are close by, and plenty of restaurants and supermarkets. Lovat Lane is pedestrianised, but it is literally a stone's throw from the Underground station. It is the first time we have stayed in a serviced apartment, and we would definitely stay there again. I would have given 5 stars if it hadn't been so noisy at night (firstly from the pub over the lane, and secondly from inebriated people shouting outside at 5am) on both nights we were there. If you are a light sleeper like me you might prefer to stay elsewhere.

title: Apartments booked to hold parties!!!
text: I also originally booked Tower Bridge (because I stayed there before), but was moved to Monument because of over booking, which seems to happen a lot if you read the reviews. But that was the least of our worries!! Checked in ok, pleasant staff but was informed there is no staff between 8.00pm - 8.00am, which became a SERIOUS problem on the second night. At around 10.30pm the Fire Alarm went off, (remember this building is NOT serviced at this time of day) most people in the building evacuated, except the people on in the first floor apartment where the PARTY was being held. The party guests, who I can assure you weren't staying there, were continuously going in and out of the building to get food and drink. This went on for over 30mins with the alarm still going. The emergency number given for you to ring in an emergency was a joke. We phoned it and the female who answered said she " was aware of the problem" and was trying to give us, and the two previous guests that had phoned, a code to switch the Alarm OFF!!! At no stage did anyone attend to check why it had gone off. The Fire Brigade hadn't arrived but she was prepared to give us a code so we could turn it OFF!!. Not once did she ask if the building was evacuated, which led us to believe it must be a regular occurrence or why would she give out a code. The fire brigade were appalled when they found out and said they would be an investigation. Now on to the PARTY!!!! While we were waiting outside at least another 16 people turned up for the party, which was already taking place. Listening to the conversations was how we know it's been used before and that they weren't guests staying at the apartment. After an hour or so we were let back into the building. That's when the PARTY really got going with music blaring (they obviously brought their own:sound system because its not part of the apartment) until 4.00am. We were on the fourth floor and could still hear it, our friends were next door on the first floor and didn't sleep all night, (which is surprising because the smell of cannabis was so strong). This happened because the building is not serviced 24 hours. The lift was full of vomit the next morning when we checked out so had to carry our luggage down the stairs. We couldn't complain to staff because we left at 6.00am and they don't start till 8.00. This is a real shame because the apartment was lovely and very clean, but because it's not serviced there is nothing to stop this happening again. This is the second time a party!! that has been reported on this site. I will never stay here again. If you get moved from another London Go native to Monument don't accept it.

title: Everything you need
text: These apartments are spacious and have everything you could need including quality appliances. Location is not great but your only about 4 mins from the underground. My complaint to the management was that the bed was tiny and very uncomfortable which was a shame because they had spared no expense elsewhere in the room, we asked for a room with larger bed, but were told all rooms are the same. There is a hotel next door which has very early deliveries and you are woken by the rolling of kegs but I guess this would depend on where your room is situated. We booked our room and paid in advance in January. Then in May they moved us from London bridge location to tower hill. When we arrived at Heathrow on check in day we received an email (luckily I had wifi) and were told we are now staying at Monument location. Not good enough when my booking was non refundable and paid 6 months in advance.

title: Good place to stay.
text: For a few days in London a good place to stay in the middle of the city. Apartment is fully serviced and in good reach of Monument Underground. Shop at Tesco Metro. The best coffee in the neighbourhood was served at Pret a Manger. It can be noisy sometimes so sleep with airconditioning!

title: Just like a home...
text: The place was cosy like a home and is near The Monument Station. For me, it beats staying in some 5 star hotel. You might be surprised but the most important for me was the washing machine-cum-dryer. This allowed me to bring lesser clothes all the way from Singapore on a 8 night stay. Well, lighter luggage for me then. The downside of it was that it is a ghost town at night! And to comment it as downside... it really depends. The upside of being a ghost town at night means you can sleep in peace as well. Staff are pretty helpful with directions too.

title: What a surprise to find such a great hotel/apartment in city center London.
text: In addition to a great location close to the tube,restaurants,shopping and attractions all within a few minutes walk, we also had a kitchen with a fridge, oven,convection oven, washer and dryer. It was clean and the staff was helpful. It did not have a breakfast option or restaurant on site but we were able to shop and prepare some meals in the apartment. We really felt we were apart of the London experience. we walked across the London Bridge,saw the Tower of London, Monument Square. We would stay there again on our next trip to London.

title: Perfect location, amazing staff and great space
text: Stayed in Go Native Monument for a week on my most recent trip to London - a city notorious for small hotel rooms at an exorbitant price but this place is amazing! I stayed in a studio apartment on the ground floor, it had a well kitted out kitchen, had a small living area (sofa, TV), plus a table big enough for laptop, papers and my tea! The staff were so helpful and friendly throughout. WiFi excellent which is also important and the room incredibly quiet. In addition, the tube is not far from the apartments (2 small streets i.e. 2 min walk). It's also very easy to get to places after work (Borough just across London Bridge), Leadenhall Market (would recommend The Butchers for something to eat) by foot. So really a great find and I shall be staying here again

title: Disappointing stay in an apartment that could be perfect
text: The apartments are very new, clean and in a very handy location if you need to be in the City of London. The check in was very poor having just flown into London on a long flight the we were hold after much tapping on the computer that they could not find our booking and suggested we had booked the wrong day. We gave them the confirmation and were told they would try and accommodate us. After a long wait we were shown to our room. Exhausted, we decided to go to bed to discover that the light sensors next to our bed (in the kitchen area) automatically come on every time we moved. We talked to reception about it and were told there was nothing they could do to fix it …so there went any real sleep for 2 nights. It was such a shame as the bed it's self was perfect and the room was a good stylish space in a fantastic location. I really hope that Go Native are able to sort out these issues as it could penitentially be the perfect place to satay.

title: Excellent location, great value for money
text: We travel regularly and believe this apartment is the best value for money. Our premier one bedroom was new, modern with a washing machine and a dishwasher. It's perfect if you are staying in the city of London for more than a couple of nights. The staff are also lovely - they even bought a high-chair for our baby which we really appreciated.

title: Excellent, but don't tell everyone!
text: I'm torn between writing a review and keeping this place a secret so I can secure a room. Exceptional customer service in accommodation that is fresh clean and modern in an excellent location for working in the City.

title: Marvellous room
text: Spent a great night in a beautiful, quiet and clean room. I was especially impressed by the luxurious feeling. I didn't want to leave! The personnel was also friendly and professional. Great value for money.

title: great apartment Let down by awful wifi
text: I travel a lot on Business and these flats are some of the nicest i have stayed in. Many apartments market themselves as "luxury" apartments but the decor is run down in shabby in most. These are freshly decorated, in a great state of repair an very modern. The rooms are spacious and the front desk staff are very friendly. having stayed here for 2 seperate weeks however i cant return as the internet is simply unusable, i am away from family and need it to be able to work and contact them. i did see if i could get it fixed but to no avail. Cheval the owning company did try to assist so no complaints there. i just tried to submit this review and the page timed out.. how apt Anyone staying on leisure who doesnt need to be able to work, stay here you wont be dissapointed.

title: Perfection
text: My boyfriend and I stayed in a studio apartment for two nights. The staff member who checked us in was friendly and professional. The apartment was spotless and the kitchen was well equipped with all the essentials aswell as thoughtful extras like a pint of milk in the fridge and ice in the freezer.There was a small leak in the apartment which caused a slow drip from the ceiling but this didn't affect our stay in any way as it was very small and only in one corner, we informed a staff member who dealt with it very professionally. The apartment was a great size especially for a studio, it felt like a home away from home. The location was brilliant, a short stroll from monument station, it's possible to walk from Liverpool Street station aswell but just be prepared that it takes about 15-20mins at a good pace. London bridge is very close by, there's also a tesco around the corner which is very handy and a marks and spencers about 10 mins on foot. Check out was a breeze, again the friendly nature and professionalism of the staff was excellent. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay with Go Native and would happily stay here again.

title: The perfect hideaway
text: My only concern is sharing my secret hiding place in central London. I have stayed here almost every week for the last few months. The location is a little out of the centre, but all the better for that. The Go Native team are always extremely friendly and welcoming and the apartments are wonderful. Now please don't book it - I want to be able to get in next time I'm in London!

title: London City Stay in Spacious Studio
text: This location is in the business district, so a stay is suitable for work purposes, but there are no eateries nearby after hours, or available on weekends. Our studio was spacious and beautifully furnished with lounge and dining facilities and a small kitchenette. The bathroom was huge - but poorly designed with no thought to placement of toiletries beside the hand basin and nowhere to place the soap in the shower! The helpful staff managed problems ASAP, however, there are no staff onsite 24 hours. No views from our room unfortunately - it was basement level and looking onto a laneway.

title: Great alternative to hotel
text: Stylish & brilliantly designed apartments. We stayed in a premium studio & were very impressed indeed. Offers the perfect solution for both business & pleasure with lots of cafes, shops & restaurants nearby. In the City but an excellent location for the underground, walking along the Thames, Tower of London, the Shard. If I was being very picky I would suggest more detailed instructions on the unusual door lock would be useful - we arrived after reception had closed & whilst getting into the building & retrieving the key fob from the safe was straightforward, we struggled to work out how to get into the apartment. Also the double glazed windows are not particularly great at minimising the noise from outside. Never-the-less, I would be delighted to go back & wouldn't hesitate in recommending to others. The experience has really made me question why I would use a London hotel again.

title: Fantastic place to stay...
text: Amazing place. Very high quality and super clean. Great value. So nice to stay in an apartment rather than a hotel. Staff were just so helpful and couldn't do enough for us. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend anyone travelling to London to have the experience Go Native Monument experience.

title: Very classy apartments!
text: Really enjoyed my stay here, while I was in London for a week on business. Excellent location, easy to walk to public transport. I ran along the River Thames for my morning exercise - great views. The apartment has really tasteful furnishings and was very well equipped. The only slight downside was the noise from a city pub close-by, but that quietened down by 9pm so no sleep lost. Highly recommend this place to stay.

title: Best Place to Stay in
text: I am very late in writing review for this amazing apartment we stayed in, in the month of june 2015 but then I thought better late then never. We have stayed in this apartment with my family which includes my infant daughter. What an experience I had. It's just amazing. Departmental store is 2 mins walk, bus stop again 2 mins walk, tube station 2 mins walk, if somebody wants Indian restaurant who serves delicious food is just one min away. Excellent staff with a beautiful smile on their face and an attitude of help at any point of time. When we reached that apartment it was almost 6:30--7 in evening and when I peeped from the door, there was nobody inside. Then I called on their number (which was written on the name plate outside) and very conveniently I was directed by the Lady on the phone how to enter in the apartment. I must say it was an extremely easy check-in and check-out, no hassles. We were so lucky that apartment which was given to us had a balcony and what a view from there. The apartment is fully furnished, if you are there u will feel like u r living in your own house. I will seriously recommend this place to stay in. By staying in this apartment one can save lot of money in comparison to a hotel and the same money can be utilised for your other expenses.

title: Ideal
text: Great new accommodation (nov 2014), really helpfull front desk, Tesco round the corner , a great Nicholsons pub across the road and a good city location. Ideal for a business traveller. I recommend highly. Just shop for the right date when prices are sensible.

title: Great Location, Great Stay
text: Stayed here for a couple nights with some friends in the 2 bed apartment. We had a balcony which was a nice touch and the location was fab. Decor was really nice and to my taste a very spacious and up to date room. Thank you for a pleasant stay hope to stay with go native again in the near future

title: Will go back
text: A very fantastic four nights, everything that we wanted from our stay in London. Our only problem was that the bathroom light over the shower kept flashing, is was reported to reception but it was a weekend and nothing could be done until Monday. It was 'fixed' but then it was worse as the bathroom lights then also went out whilst you were taking a shower, so you ended up in the dark. Yes, they have been re- furbished but there are certain everyday items that are missing, nowhere to put soap etc in the shower. Other issues being the dishwasher when we first used it tipped forward out of its cabinet and we had no phone in the apartment, when mentioned to reception they said so you are one of the missing phones but never got one. They did offer to move us to another apartment but were full on the weekend, further offer to move us but only to a smaller apartment. All that said we would definitely go again

title: Your home in London
text: Great sized rooms with everything you want and need for an extended stay. The kitchen was particularly helpful over the weekend as most restaurants/cafes were not open (it is in the business district after all). A very busy pub is just across the lane way but we hardly noticed at all, even with staying on the ground floor. The hotel is in a great location in regards to public transport (only a 3 minute walk to Monument tube station and 10 min walk to Bank or London Bridge tube stations). Borough Markets, Tower Bridge, Tower of London and St Paul's Cathedral are all within walking distance. We did, however, have a lot of trouble using our wifi. We were told this was because we were on the ground floor so I'm not sure how it is in the rest of the building.

title: "Fabulous surrounding for a short break"
text: I stayed in these newly opened apartments on a week night with a small group of friends. The facilities within the apartments were fantastic, the decor was beautiful and the staff were friendly and helpful on arrival and departure. An excellent location for both work and social events. I would highly recommend this venue and will be booking to stay again on my next trip to London.

title: A Lovely Surprise
text: I had not planned a visit to London, England this month, however, it is always a pleasure to travel South to see my daughters. I prefer to take the train. It is a relaxing way to travel and takes me right into the centre of the city. So, I like to stay in a hotel that is central, that way each of my daughters can spend time with me coming from different parts of the city. I found the suites at Go Native Monument in a very central location. It was a lovely surprise. The building is very close to the Monument underground station and near the main East Cheap thoroughfare. The only disadvantage is that, Lovat Lane, where Go Native Monument is situated, is a pedestrian street. It is quiet, but a taxi cannot pick you up from outside the premises. It will pick you up on East Cheap at the top of the lane. I had rented a a studio apartment. it was spotlessly clean and is equipped with full kitchen facilities (including a washing machine)! Complimentary tea, coffee, sugar milk and cleaning materials are provided. The bathroom had a lovely, large shower. Toiletries, including a dental kit, are supplied. The towels are large and fluffy and warmed by the heated towel rail. The bed in the apartment is comfortable and the sitting are small but functional. There is also a dining area with a tale and chairs. This is suitable for working or eating at. Free wi-fi is available. The staff at Go Native Monument are charming and helpful. The situation of the accommodation is perfect and the apartments are very competitively priced for the space and facilities offered. However, although reception is only manned 8am to 8pm, I would highly recommend Go Native Monument and would certainly use their apartments again.

title: Affordable luxury in a great location!
text: I love visiting London & it can be a drag getting the last train home when wanting to enjoy the night life! My stay in these apartments exceeded my expectations. I was especially impressed with the attention to detail of the furnishings which made the experience feel homely & comfortable. The apartment was clean, spacious & in an excellent location. Next time I will definatley stay for more than one night!

title: Heart of London
text: This apartment is up there! I stayed there in the month of June and, I have to say, it was by far one of the best places I've stayed in London! The view was spectacular! The comfort of the room and amenities were superb. The area was easy to get around in, and we were right next to plenty of restaurants and pubs that fit in with the area. If you are looking for a place during any time of the year, this is it!

title: Outstanding
text: From the moment we walked through the door we were made welcome, we went to London to chill and this place hit the spot, very quiet which added to the sleepy lay ins but close enough to everything for a cheeky snifter, bank station is only a 5 minute stroll and this station feeds everywhere you need to reach by tube, we would definitely book this place again in an heartbeat. Thank you go native team 👍

title: Couldn't recommend it more highly
text: We were really happy with the location of the hotel which is only a short walk (3 mins) from Monument / Bank tube station and 10 mins from London Bridge and Borough Market. However when we got to the room we couldn't believe how nice it was. Not a thing I would have changed about the décor and the kitchen is really well equipped. We spent three nights there so cooked one night with all the nice ingredients bough from Borough Market. The customer service was also very good. The only thing I would have changed was the shower room, when on holiday I personally like a bath, so was a little disappointed (but not surprised) not the have a bath. We were in a ground flood 'accessible' apartment which meant it was really spacious, however we over looked the little alley way at the front and there was building work going on in the building opposite. Not anything the hotel could do but meant we didn't get any lie ins. Highly recommend to all.

title: Exactly what we needed
text: Our family of three had a one-bedroom apartment for two nights. This is a great base for exploring London, as it's only a couple of blocks from a Tube stop. Not much going on in this neighborhood on weekends (even the pub across the street is closed Sundays), but there's a grocery store not far and plenty of things to do elsewhere in the city. The building is a smaller one, up a few cobblestone paces of an alley from the main road. The apartment was well-appointed and in great condition. The small kitchen had everything we could require in a neat, tiny configuration -- including a dishwasher. The upside of being in a neighborhood that's dormant on weekends was a very quiet sleep, despite being on a lower floor. Very nice.

title: Great place to stay
text: I found this apartment very close to the main attractions, it was nice to be close to London Bridge and not to far from tower of London and London Tower Bridge Monument station is right by the Monument. (Monument to the Great Fire of London ) which made it easy to get around London. We stayed in a one bedroom apartment which was comfortable, if you are staying for an extended period I would recommend that you get the room cleaned during your stay, I found we had to buy toilet paper which they didn't replenish. Yet they had cleaning products which was great. There is a Tescos near by, if you want a better quality store there is Waitrose on King Williams St. Overall I would recommend the self contained apartment, it's modern and clean. If you arrive after 8pm and haven't received an email a week before departure with password codes for door and safe, I would recommend phoning before you travel.

title: Excellent apartment in central London.
text: This apartment is fantastic! The room is massive, you get a bedroom a kitchen and a bathroom. All super new and modern. Good furnishings and comfortable bedding. The location is perfect a 2 min walk from monument station. It's in a quiet lane way and we stayed here on a Saturday night and didn't hear any street noise at all - level 2. The apartment comes fully stocked with a washer/dryer, full kitchen and dishwasher. They provided shampoo, dishwasher tablets, washing powder and cleaning sponges etc paper towel. They also provided tea coffee sugar and milk - which a lot of apartments don't provide. The window opens up for fresh air but the air con works fine. We cooked 2 dinners here and had no issue. There is a Tesco around the corner to buy everything you need. The only thing I would say is that the dishwasher is super small and in a tiny cupboard which makes it a bit hard to use. The wifi works fine and it was stable - but not as fast as other hotels only around 6mbit. But fine for Skype and planning :-) Seriously a great place to stay - if you sign up to their membership - free - through the gonative website you can get cheaper prices generally.

title: I LOVE LONDON
text: This was my First trip to London and my friend and i were there For London Tech week! What a cool reason to go to Europe And London For the First TIME! The Views From the Balcony were really amazing. There are bikes that can be rented all around this place and thats what we did just hopped on bikes and went out into the city. I know its kind of a funny thing to be impressed by but ONE thing that I was really impressed by was how modern everything in this place was. Kind of made me feel like i was in a futuristic place. Ill have to come back to London and stay here with my Lady Friend who I know would be impressed! Thank you so much!

title: Best Experience Ever!
text: We were tired from the 12 hour flight to London and the hotel receptionist was so friendly and polite when she checked us in. Our check in was very easy and fast. The first day we realised our phone chargers did were not compatible with the hotel outlets. We called the front desk and they let us borrow a outlet converter which allowed us to charge our phones, tablets, laptops, etc. The hotel is completely updated and furnished. Each hotel room has a kitchen(ette), refrigerator, dish washer, utensils, plates, coffee maker, toaster, living area, dinning area, washer/dryer, bedroom and restroom. There is not parking garage or parking spaces but there is plenty of transportation options. The hotel is centrally located and there is a grocery store just around the corner where you can buy food for late night hour snacks. Go Native Monument was great, I would go there again and recommend it to everyone. Did I mention free wifi?

title: Great find!
text: My husband booked this instead of a hotel, just for a change. It's a real gem, just near the Tower of London, which we walked to in just a few minutes. The apartment was immaculately clean, with everything you could want provided. Thoughtful touch was fresh milk in the fridge. Tescos Express store just nearby, so it's easy to make yourself at home. Receptionist polite and very friendly. Would definitely stay again.

title: Fantastic
text: Great place studio apartment. Very happy. Reception staff namely Katie and Sylvia plus others in our 3 day stay have been fantastic. Only complain is that lighting is poor as is most hotels. Close to Monument underground. Everything appears to be newish and fresh.

title: Outstanding Staff Great Apartment
text: I would agree with the positive reviews of the facility but wanted to write about the helpfulness and great attitude of the front desk staff. We were greeted by Silvia and Jazmin . They answered all our questions and Silvia showed us to our studio apartment. She refused a tip. The next night I had a medical emergency (cut finger requiring stitches). Jazmin helped in getting us to a hospital. This was very comforting in a strange city. The next morning, Jazmin had to come to the apartment to repair the washer/dryer, which she accomplished with smile and no complaints. If ever in London again, I would not hesitate in booking the Go Native Monument not just for the apartment but for a caring and helpful staff.

title: The perfect pied a terre
text: From the moment we were greeted by a charming young lady on reception, to the moment we checked out, our stay here was fantastic. The studio room we stayed in was first class, fully kitted out with everything one could require for a self-catered stay. All appliances and fixtures were of good quality, no scrimping on costs here! The location was excellent, with great links via the underground and even walking to the West End. Highly recommended!

title: Great place to stay!
text: We stayed here for two nights when visiting London. The apartment is great - it has everything you need and is very stylish. The bed seemed a bit hard when I first got in, but I have to say that I actually had a great nights sleep. The staff were very friendly and the location was ideal - less than 5 mins walk from Monument tube station. Would stay here again on our next trip. I had only two small niggles - 1. There was free wi-fi in the room, but it kept dropping off. We tried different devices, so it did seem to be the wi-fi. 2. I tried to call the reception before we arrived to make sure it would be OK to leave our bags, but I couldn't get through. I left a voice message that wasn't returned and was given wrong phone numbers to contact the reception on. However, when we arrived, the staff at Monument were very friendly and there was no issue leaving our bags before we could check-in.

title: Great Apartment, Great Location
text: We were originally meant to be staying at the Go Native London Bridge apartments but were moved here due to unforeseen circumstances which was a happy accident. These apartments are located very close to Monument tube station which made getting around easy and there is a Tesco Local just around the corner for supplies (G&T and crisps in our case!). The apartment, while small, was well furnished, comfortable and quiet - ideal! Good value through Booking.com as well. Would certainly recommend to people wanting a little more space than a regular hotel room and would use again next time we're in London.

title: Great Value
text: For London this offers amazing value, the room has every thing you need for a few days stay. It was exactly as pictured on the website. It was also stocked with milk tea coffee and sugar on arrival which was a nice touch. The light inside the door is on a timer so it keeps switching on and off, you have no control to leave it on and the wi-fi in the room was not great. However over all you could not ask for more comfort especially for london. Hope it remains at good value!!!

title: The best place to stay in London!
text: Loved staying at this apartment. It is 1 minute walk away from Monument station, 3 minutes walk to Bank station. The apartment was very new and modern. There is a supermarket about 2 minutes away. The wifi was free. It has kitchen and brand new washing machine. They even provide washing powder. I've been to London a few times, but this place tops every hotel I have been to. Loved staying here and will definitely come back to stay there on my next trip to London. Katie at the reception was so kind and helpful all the time and organized taxi ride to Heathrow.

title: Great location and rooms, nearly five star
text: As another reviewer has said, unusually for apartments I was shown to the room by very friendly and helpful staff. I had a corner apartment which looked out over Old Billingsgate and towards the Shard. I was only staying for one night but the apartment would be mostly comfortable for several nights. But there was a flaw. The apartments are new and the window to the bedroom had been poorly fitted leaving a small gap. The fact that it let in a slight draught was a lesser problem than that it let in noise from the road outside which is in use 24 hours. So sleep was poor. I pointed it out and am confident it would be fixed but the lack of sleep negated my attempt to avoid a very early start for an early meeting.

title: Great apartment... but...
text: I recently stayed at the Go Native Monument Apartments for two nights (19 December – 21 December). When we checked in we were really pleased with the apartment which was just as described and the great service received from the reception staff. We had a great nights sleep on the first night and were looking forward to the rest of our stay. However, our second night was a different story. At around 3am on Sunday morning we were woken up by loud music from one of the neighbouring apartments. This continued for two hours until 5am at which time a large group gathered outside the door of our apartment in the corridor. They were shouting loudly to each other for around 30 minutes as well as knocking on our door and ringing our doorbell several times. As there is no manned reception in the night and only a telephone number to ring in emergencies I raised this with reception when checking out who informed me they had experienced problems with the group who were a ‘late booking’. They assured me they were going to investigate. I didn't hear anything further and received no response to my email containing these comments when asked for feedback by Go Native. Overall, the apartment and location are fantastic but our experience on this occasion was poor.

title: Lovely Hotel in a Great Location
text: Lovely hotel within a very central location, Lobby and bar area quite stunning and a lovely spot to while away a few hours before dinner! The Bar staff do need to work a little harder at adding up the drinks bill though as we had to send ours back twice, having been overcharged! A little disappointed that the room "extras" were a bit hit and miss! Our friends were provided with wine and a food hamper in their room - lovely touch - but why one room and not the other I wonder? The hotel were aware, in advance, that both couples were celebrating special occasions... Very helpful reception staff ensured our group had rooms on the same floor. Rooms were of adequate size and very clean with every thing we needed for an enjoyable stay. A nice touch was the ice dispenser on the landing, along with filtered drinking water and bottles.

title: Excellent location but don't expect any food service after the theatre
text: We stayed here for one night as it was so convenient to the theatre district. A good hotel with helpful checkin staff and a small but nicely appointed room. However when we returned from the theatre we were surprised to find that although the very impressive lounge bar was open, they were no longer serving any food. We asked for nuts or pretzels but a very snooty waiter said nothing was available. 11pm on a Friday night is not exactly late. If we'd known we'd certainly have gone elsewhere for an after theatre drink.

title: Perfect hotel, best location and clean rooms, helpful staff.
text: I chose this hotel from its reviews on tripadvisor and expedia. We were not disappointed! Our double room was on the second floor with a view of trafalgar square. Room was clean, had internet service, minibar, private bath and cable tv. A few steps aways were several cheap eats and a minimart to pick up snacks and stuff. Plan on going back in 2011 and we will be staying here again. Great Value and friendly staff. When I got sick they arranged for a travel physician to come to my room for an exam ( a little ackward but worth it to get meds).

title: Nice by miserly
text: Check-in not smooth as it was to be all by computer and self-service but it would not work so done by reception. Quick easy checking in would be super. We would go back as location is super. Room clean and like new. Very nice. Breakfast pricy. Only two tea bags in room. TV not easily viewable from bed. Remote well used as all print worn off. TV great if not difficult to view. Room quiet and bedding great. Water down the hall but all one wants. It is very near elevator and your fill the bottles yourself. On leaving receipt for room not available which is a concern. Just a copy of the bill would be a wonderful addition by reception would not provide. This no final room bill needs to be changed and now.

title: Great Luxury hotel with affordable rates
text: Clean room, very well equipped. Location perfect, just 100m from Trafalgar Square. Excellent breakfast, I would definitely recommend! At very close proximity good restaurants, Tube station and loads of tourist attractions to see.

title: Recomendations
text: Disappointed about the bar facilities but apart from that everything was fine. Hotel very central and we would recommend it . We would certainly like to stay there in the future .If there are any package deals for West End shows or any other events in London we would like to be kept informed.

title: Very helpful and good service
text: Front desk guy Adam was very helpful to our family with kids. Helped with our enormous luggage with kids. Gave us a room with microwave and fridge at no extra cost considering we had baby food. It was perfect location.

title: Very Nice/Great Location
text: I stayed here for 5 nights last week. I got a great deal on Orbitz so it was worth changing from my normal spot. The hotel is easy to get to from LHR on the tube to Leicester Sq and walk or switch to Northern Line - either way works. I had a single room which was actually a double bed. The room was more spacious than I expected (based on normal London rooms). It was modern with nice furniture and a flat panel TV (which got about 20 channels). The bathroom was decent size with a shower only. Housekeeping seemed good. I never heard my neighbors (which is important especially when I sleep late occasionally). A friend visited the room and also commented on how nice it was. overall, if I got anotehr great deal - I would stay here again.

title: Clean, respectable, nice bar
text: Great location - probably the best thing about this hotel. Decent place - our room was clean and there's an area to work on the first floor. Nothing particularly special, but decent place in an excellent location.

title: “Perfect Stay hotel "
text: Friendly staff helped me with the electronic check in. Room was a nice size (especially for London) we had no trouble with outdoor noise, air conditioning was quiet too. very clean and modernly decorated. A staff member came to check that everything was ok and asked whether we needed anything too which was nice.

title: Lovely hotel
text: The hotel was lovely and had an excellent location. The staff was welcoming and helpfull, especially Florina at the Boyd's Bar. The room was spacious and clean. The breakfast was good and the water refilled in hallway. I hope to stay there again.

title: Not so Grand
text: This place is ok but unfortunately not great as one was led to believe by the web site, the air con unit sounded like an aircraft taking off and the room although ok was a bit tired and more of an apartment than an executive room like we ordered, the last thing i wanted to find was a microwave/ plates knives forks and a kitchen sink, we wont be going back. It completely spoiled what should have been a great birthday treat.

title: Great location
text: Lovely hotel in a great location close to Trafalgar Square and two tube stations close by. Nice size and clean rooms. Would stay here again when I next visit London. Staff were very helpful and had a free glass of wine on arrival.

title: Weekend break
text: Friendly and welcoming staff. Beautiful hotel ideally situated for theatres, restaurants and sightseeing. Well appointed room and en suite. We came to celebrate our anniversary and arrived to find a welcome pack including a bottle of wine. Will definitely return.

title: Great Hotel, real high class experience for great value prices!!
text: Booked this hotel for the location and reputed business-class experience offered at reasonable prices for London. Location Fanstastic location at no.8 northumberland Avenue just off of Trafalgar Square(nearest tube station is Charing Cross). Rooms & Facilities Fantastic finish and size with excellent services(free internet with wireless keyboard, flat screen TV, range of gadget connections, network cable, mp3 etc). Bed was very comfy and the bathroom was excellently finished with a real high-end feel to it. There was a complimentary chilled water dispenser in the corridor with a fresh plastic bottle per customer (meant we could take water with us every day we were out in London) and complimentary ice-bucket and ice-dispenser also available. Staff Never had much dealing with them apart from when we checked in/out but they were very efficient(we arrived 30mins earlier than the 3pm check-in and there was no hassle in allocating us a room). Maybe them being pitched at the business market means that the perform a functional type person service rather than a more touristy approach to clients? Breakfast One tip that I read before going was that as told by the hotel, their continental breakfast was £9.95pp, but we were already armed with the knowledge that if you don't mind eating in a chain pub that there was a Wetherspoons less than 2mins walk away from the hotel. Recommend If you don't need a person service and want an excellent hotel to stay in with an amazing location then I'd strongly recommend a visit to them, and I will definitely return to stay with them next time we are in London

title: So disappointing
text: We were really looking forward to staying at The Grand for 2 nights for my birthday, but left feeling deflated. The location is excellent, however, our room was somewhat lacking. It was a very cold weekend, the room was not heated when we arrived and it took us a day to find the heating controls on the side of the bed (heating system seems to be behind the headboard - and it is noisy!!). The bed was just a double and we rolled into the middle, only 1 pillow provided per person so we had to ask for more. No green tea provided. No underfloor heating in the bathroom and no heated towel rail. Only 1 hand towel between us. The staff were excellent but I expect so much more from a hotel of this standard.

title: No huge problems, but not overly impressed
text: I booked through an online discount site, and was happy to have a 4-star hotel for the price I got. It doesn't feel like a four star hotel though. I got to my room jet lagged and thirsty. there's no fridge in the room so I went to get ice. The bag in the ice bucket had been used as a garbage by the previous visitors, and had not been cleaned. The room is nice, somewhat small by my standards. In the morning I went downstairs to look for some food. I saw that there was a buffet of croissants, danishes and fruit set out, so I thought rather than pay for something, I'd just grab some of that. They asked for my room number halfway through, and I told them. At the end they brought be a bill for 12 pounds! That's about $20 for a few croissants and some fruit. They said they're not affiliated with the hotel at all, despite the fact that they're in the lobby, and on the bill you just write your room number.

title: great location
text: My husband and I stayed here for one night with a couple of friends. The location was great right in the heart of everything. We had a room on the 9th floor with views to the London Eye, Big Ben, Buck House and Whitehall. The room was very nice but cold, the heating controls didn't seem to work properly. There was a flat screen telly, internet point for your laptop, a microwave and a fridge. The bathroom was small but perfectly adequate with a good shower. Our friends had a room on the 4th floor with a very large bed but no microwave or fridge and no view. We stayed in the part called club quarters, from what we could make out the grand part isn't ready yet. We ate breakfast at Garfunkels next door as we weren't prepared topay ~£26 for it at the hotel. The only downside to this hotel is that it doesn't have a bar. As most of the bars nearby close at 11.30, this was quite frustrating as we would have liked a coupleof drinks after leaving the theatre. All in all a very nice hotel in a great location which we would use again.

title: Excellent location
text: Booked this hotel for the one night on a last minute occasion and was very pleased. Its a lovely looking place from the outside and also when you walk in, very grand. This place is an ideal walking distance from pretty much all the tourist destinations so you will never be out of things to see or do. Check in and check out were both easy with all the staff being very friendly. The room was very clean and a good double size. It had all you could need within the room plus the little extras should you require them were in a guest cupboard which was located next to a water dispenser, brilliant idea! The only thing which would of been nice to have is some biscuits........they would of gone down nice with my tea :) otherwise I would definitely recommend this place and may even be back one day.

title: Great hotel at the centre of London's tourist spots
text: Our first time in this hotel and a great experience. Only booked it due to its close proximity to the theatre and the National Portrait Gallery visits we had planned, but we were so impressed we'll use it as our base for further weekend breaks in the capital, which we tend to take every few months throughout the year. Fabulous room with dual aspect facing out over the entrance to this imposing building.( same odd, pre-fab bathroom mentioned by previous reviewer, but pristine clean and excellent shower facility) Expected to hear noise from the busy streets below but didn't. Good promotional rate secured via Booking.Com which made the stay excellent value for money for the facilities on offer - including HD TV, Wi Fi etc, free bottles of chilled water and ice machine on the corridors and large internet/chill out lounge on the mezzanine floor. Chose to eat out at two of our regular favourite restaurants - Pierre Victoire brasserie in Soho and Melanie Italian trattoria off Charing Cross Road - both very reasonably priced and within 15 minutes walk from the hotel, so cannot comment on the hotel's food offering. Agree with previous reviewer's comments about the breakfast being too expensive - so we went to a lovely French patisserie just two doors down oj Northumberland Avenue and enjoyed a great value Continental breakfast for half the price.But we did enjoy the odd nightcap back at the hotel's stylish cocktail bar. Nice staff and particular mention goes to Ophelie who checked us in and out with a wide smile and great - nothing's too much trouble - type service. It is certainly worth looking out for weekend 'deals' at this hotel because, just by paying a little more than average 4 star rates, you get a good trade up and take away a great visitor experience. Would recommend it highly!

title: Perfectly located,recently refurbished
text: This hotel is perfectly located just off Trafalgar Square. It's as grand inside as it is on the outside. It had very recently been refurbished and we could still smell the paint! (but not a put-off whatsoever). I booked through booking.com, and thought it was excellent value. Our room was spacious, light and airy, with a lovely big bed. I would recommend this hotel to anyone, with its convenient location and perfect rooms, you can't go wrong.

title: Good Location, Beatuiful Reception & Bar Area
text: I stayed here with my husband and we had a lovely time. The hotel really lives up to its name! The reception is very grand and vintage themed, and the bar area is very cosy and relaxing. The room was comfortable, clean and a good size, we would stay there again. The location is good, we were close to the underground and in a good area to walk around. We will be staying there again next year.

title: Excellent Hotel!
text: We booked this hotel afetr deciding to take our Daughter to London for a few days over Half Term as it was well located and very reasonably priced. The hotel is very comfortable, very clean and we had no issues with noise at any point. We didnt eat at the hotel, however there are many cafes and restaurants nearby to eat. All in All I would certianly recommend this hotel and will be staying again when we go back.

title: yes, but...
text: I went for a 2nd time in 'The Grand at Trafalgar Square' because I was very happy of the first stay there. this time I travelled with persons who'd never been in London before and the location of the hotel is just perfect for a 'first-timer', it is very easy to go by walk to the main points of interest in London! the hotel is decorated in a nice way and is very pleasant. however, some minus points: -the breakfast which, compared to last year, has decreased and was really not worth of a 4* hotel. One can have a same kind of breakfast even in the low-cost chain hotels on the border of high-way (at least in France). - no safe in the room - bar closes at midnight on Saturday evening.. Also, for a 4* hotel, one would expect for a more personalised reception service, the automatic check-in/out machines remind too much the modern airports where you all the communication between people has been withdrawn.

title: Brilliant Place to Stay!
text: We were very impressed with the cleanliness of the Hotel, every thing you need is available, you could just go to the Locker in the corridor for more Tea/Coffee/Milk if you needed it, Irons & Ironing boards were there too. I needed extra pillows & they weren't in the locker, I rang reception & they were delivered to our room within 10mins. Loved the Iced water available at all times. Look forward to staying there again when there is a Guest Lounge for after Theatre Drinks. We were on the 7th floor at the back, but we had nice views & only very slight traffic noise. The staff are all very friendly & polite. The fact that you don't have to check out until 12noon was wonderful too. Excellent!!!!! Thank you.

title: Great location
text: The best thing about this hotel at the moment is its location - just off Trafalgar Square, within walking distance of most of what you would want to do in London. Easy to find - tube to Charing Cross, then just cross the road. It's a large grand Victorian building, recently opened as a hotel, they're in the process of doing it up. Which makes it a bit impersonal and lacking in atmosphere at the moment. There's no restaurant just now (they do have an arrangement with the Commonwealth Institute across the road, which we didn't try). We had breakfast at Garfunkels next door

title: Another fabulous stay
text: The staff, location and rooms are the reasons I come back every year and will continue to come back in the future. Everything is spotless and the rooms are comfortable and perfect for a business trip.

title: Grand Escape
text: Room was comfortable and well equipped. Breakfast was expensive and fried eggs were inedible. Replacement eggs were also inedible. I could not even break the yolks. Excellent location for South Bank, West End and China Town.

title: Great location, pick your room
text: RECOMMENDED. One of the best London locations, literally feet from Trafalgar Sq, easy access from Embankment Tube station, hotel is on a relatively quiet street, though rooms facing the street will have street noise. Rooms sizes vary, this is an older restored property. I changed initial room, one facing street had strange bedroom with bath built into room and then enclosed. But bedding & lighting comfortable. I generally stay at St. Paul CQ as think that it is more comfortable (hence I don't give this 5*). But for location this CQ Trafalgar Sq is a super choice.

title: Excellent
text: Stayed here with family for a couple of days sightseeing. We had a large room with a huge bed overlooking Northumberland Avenue, very grand and comfortable. Only fault with the room was their was no mini-bar. Bar area not very comfortable though and it closed quite early. Location is fantastic and I would certainly stay there again.

title: Lovely hotel perfect location
text: Stayed here as a family in December. Room 213. A beautiful room, really big with 1 queen bed and a sofa bed made up off the kids. Lovely kitchen with coffee maker, microwave, fridge and rings. Utensils also available. Also had an iron and ironing board in the room, also hair dryer and an umbrella. Massive room with a lovely view of Trafalgar Square. We did check in at 11.30am and our room was ready, perfect. Was quite noisy at night with the fridge buzzing, traffic and you can here the underground. But saying that I would stay here again as the location is perfect. So close to all the main attractions. Didn't use the restaurant or bar but it looked very grand and the prices were very reasonable. A very grand hotel and would recommend to anyone. The staff are also very friendly at reception and they were happy for us to leave our luggage there for the day when we checked out.

title: Great hotel and cocktails!
text: Stayed here with my partner to celebrate his birthday and loved every minute of it. Fantastic location - great for if you're seeing a west end show! Friendly and professional staff who know their stuff (especially when it comes to making cocktails - one of the best espresso martini's we have ever tried!). Room's fairly small but very comfortable and quiet considering the location. All round great stay and would highly recommend.

title: Perfect Location !
text: Hotel right in the heart of London. We were able to walk to all the main tourist attractions which was a huge plus for us. If taking a cab from Heathrow beware tho as it can be pricey. Over 100 US dollars one way. We were so jet lagged that it was the easiest option at the time. Lots of eating options right next to hotel as well.

title: Reasonable stay and great location
text: Hotel is right beside Trafalgar square and within 10 mins walk from Chinatown and major shopping streets. The Ghost bus tour is also right in front of the hotel main entrance. My stay was reasonable but heater was not hot enough and it was winter time...when i first went in, one of the towel was dirty and it was not changed throughout my one week stay. Safe was faulty and cannot be used. Dental kits and slippers has to be collected at the front desk if needed and they do not send it up to your room. However, the price paid for the hotel commensurate with the overall stay.

title: Fabulous stay
text: Really great stay here. Location is very central. Very friendly and helpful staff. Room was clean and quiet despite being moments away from the London hustle and bustle. Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone travelling to London, my husband and I have already booked our next stay!!!

title: Highly recommend.
text: The staff is very nice and helpful. room was clean, quiet and spacius. Location is the main advantage of the hotel. Few steps away from most important London atractions, subway and restaurants. Highly recommend

title: Very nice place to stay. Easy access.
text: Very nice place to stay. Friendly people. Easy access to the tube and lots of attractions within walking distance. We took our 7 year old and we had a blast. Nice place for kids to stay. Easy access to the train station.

title: Conference and Long-Weekend
text: I was due in London for a conference on a Thursday, so my wife and I made a long weekend of it. The Grand at Trafalgar Square is reasonably priced and compared favourably with similar hotels in the area. It is ideally located, being in walking distance of the Convent Garden, Leicester Sq, and Soho areas, the main shopping streets, Theatreland. and The City. The hotel is a mix of traditional London, 70s chic and 21st century technology, offering a fast check-in check-out service at terminals in the foyer, and free Wi-Fi throughout. The staff were all friendly, polite and efficient, and we experienced no problems at all during our stay. The room was a reasonable size and well laid out, with a comfortable bed, air-conditioning, TV kettle etc. There was also a microwave and small fridge, though we didn't use these. The foyer leads into the bar and restaurant area which all have marble walls throughout in a sort of art-deco style. The furnishings are generally a modern take on a 1970's theme that really kinda works, with comfortable settees and chairs in the bar area alongside rather natty coloured plastic bar-stools and restaurant chairs. The food in the restaurant was excellent and reasonably priced (for London!). There is an extensive wine list with choices from decent, affordable wines to ridiculously extravagant ones. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at The Grand and I would not hesitate to recommend it.

title: Family of 5 perfect location with big rooms and kitchen and great A/C
text: 2 adults and 3 teenagers had adjoining double room and double with extra double bed. Had kitchen with fridge. Really tall ceilings. Great air conditioning. Best of our European vacation. Right off of Trafalgar Square. 10 minute walk over the bridge to London Eye and London Dungeon. Free chilled water down the hall. Great Internet. Good front desk but no doorman or bell hop. Front desk helpful but also encourages use of free business center on 2nd floor. Total for both rooms was 400 Pounds per night which seemed like good deal for central London. Would gladly stay here again.

title: Great Location Not so Great Rooms
text: Pros- 1. Great location. The best part about the hotel is its location. 20 m from trafalgar square ,5 min walk from leicester Square, 5 min from london Eye..... 2. There is a tesco just round the corner...long lines though. 3. Lots of food options all around , garfunkles right next door. Cons- Room sizes are small . I had taken the premier room with a kitchenette but the room was not that spacious. The Bathrooms could definitely do with some renovation.

title: Location is Prime!
text: The location is the best part of this hotel! You can't go wrong staying here for your trip to London. We did have some initial problems--we had to change rooms twice, HOWEVER, the staff could NOT have been more accomodating, (First room too noisy, second room had NO AC, third was PERFECT), they were very helpful and kind in our requests. Once we got past that in the first 24 hours, we had an excellent time. Check in/Check out a breeze, water near elevators is excellent, and although the elevator access was a bit tricky at times, not a showstopper. Highly recomend for all!

title: Fantastic hotel and convenient for all activities.
text: We stayed at The Grand at Trafalgar for 4 nights. We're 2 adults and 2 children (7,14). It was @ £15 from St. Pancras to the hotel in a taxi we boarded outside the station. Our room was serviced everyday and had lovely comfortable bedding and sufficient amenities. There was a complimentary hamper in the room which included a bottle of fine red wine. There is a purified water cooler and ice machine for the hot days on all floors. The hotel has a complimentary laundrette which is very handy. Buckingham Palace is 15 mins walk. Trafalgar Square is like just there. Embankment and Charing cross is less than 5 min walk. You can walk on the Jubilee bridge and reach London Eye in less than 10 mins. The walk through the Whitehall garden takes you to Big Ben in 10 mins. There is a Tesco express at the corner of the street. Tesco metro is about 10 min walk. There is no ramp to bring your luggage into the hotel so you'll have to carry the few steps. It wasn't an issue for us. Overall it was a comfortable stay and we'd recommend to anyone who's want a semi-apartment style hotel in the middle of city which is convenient for all activities.

title: Close to the key attractions
text: My wife and I just returned from a one week stay at The Grand at Trafalgar Square. The location is fantastic with easy access to the Underground, bus and train stations. The hotel staff was very friendly and helpful. Will definitely use again if we return to London.

title: I cant wait to return!!
text: When I was planning my first trip to London the most important things to me were that the hotel was clean, comfortable, and in a good location, and this hotel more then delivered! The price was amazing for the location, you are merely a 1 minute walk from Charing Cross Station to get pretty much anywhere you would want in London. When you walk out of the front doors you can see Nelsons Column in Trafalgar Square, and all the activity down there, it really is a top notch location. Check in was easy and quick, and while I will say that the reviews about not really seeing a lot of staff or it being like a standard check in at a hotel is true, but it didn't impede the check in or out, and never had a need for anything else from them so it didn't bother me at all. We stayed on the 8th floor and I was impressed by the size of the room. I was imagining that it would me very small, but it was comfortable and very tidy. Would have been nice to have a tub or a bigger shower, but overall you will be pleased with the room accommodations that they offer. The only “complaint” I would have would be that no matter how low the cool setting on the air conditioner was the room seemed to stay very warm. Luckily it was spring like weather when we were there and simply leaving the window solved that problem. As a hotel manager I feel I have more expectations then most, and they have been more then met! I cannot wait to return to London and stay again at this property. Do not hesitate to have a great London experience and stay here.

title: fantastic
text: great hotel, great location. down side no fridge in the room. Staff very helpful and friendly.

title: Great stay for a great price
text: The grand at trafalgar is an excellent hotel. With friendly staff, a great price and an ideal location, this hotel is a must stay when visiting London. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for comfort at an affordable price.

title: Great location
text: This hotel is situated in an incredible location, just steps from Trafalgar Square. The lobby was beautiful, and the room was clean (albeit a bit small). Plenty of good food and transit connections nearby.

title: Make me a member!
text: This hotel is in a wonderful location for sightseeing. It is just steps from Trafalgar Square and within walking distance of Big Ben, Parliament, Westminster Abbey and Buckingham Palace. We also walked to Leicester Square and Soho, although, we like to walk. Our room was very nicely decorated. While it was a little on the small side, it certainly was adequate and didn't feel cramped. We booked through Orbitz and got a great rate. The free water machine in the hallway is a very nice plus! There is a chi-chi Italian restaurant in the hotel, but we didn't eat there. There is a Garfunkel's a minute away and they have good breakfast. Tesco Express on the corner also has pastries and donuts if you are into grab and go. The Charing Cross tube station is closest. There is a PC with a printer on the 2nd floor that you can use, which is very handy for printing boarding passes. Inserting your key card in the elevator to make it work can be a little tricky, but I had more luck than my husband! Really, it's not a big deal and in my opinion is worth it from a security standpoint. I would absolutely stay here again without hesitation!

title: Great room great location - recommended
text: This is the second time we stayed at The Grand at Trafalgar. The hotel is perfected located to the West End for shows and for walks along the Thames and not far away from the South Bank. The hotel has a lovely entrance and a beautiful bar. We loved our room which was on the 6th floor and had a view of Northumberland Avenue and we heard little to no traffic noise. The Sherlock Holmes pub is directly across the road and you are minutes away for the National Gallery and the National Portrait Gallery. Covent Garden is 5 to 10 minutes away. Room was large spacious and airy. Larger than average for a hotel of this standard. We will definitely be returning in the future,

title: Not So Grand
text: Although the location at the edge of Trafalgar Square is terrific, the once Grand has been sliced up by Executive Quarters into cube-like rooms with only the barest necessities (no microwave, refrigerator, etc.). In the tiniest bathroom on record (where the toilet didn't flush properly), there's lots of hot water but no bathtub, which at the end of a day of trekking is a necessity for this senior traveler. Furthermore, unlike other hotels in the same price range (for example, the Tavistock at Russell Square), breakfast is not included - thereby adding to the tab

title: Nice hotel, great location, very poor attitude
text: Location wins for this hotel.....very poor service and bad attitude from staff. Perhaps they don't need to try due to tourist footfall they benefit from. Hope the tourists to the UK do not experience this and think this is the norm!

title: Great location, good services
text: I got there early and I checked in. Since it was like 8am, they understandbly did not have a room ready for me. They took my luggage, gave me the possibility to go change myself, and took my luggage. I then got the room, which was big, clean and clean washroom. I had a problem with the safe, I called the reception and the problem was solved in two minutes. Great hotel. I would def. come back.

title: Perfect emplacement for tourism
text: Kind and helpful staff, clean rooms, drinking water available on each floor. Expensive breakfast, so we went to the tearoom next door which was perfect. Near to the National Gallery, the theatres and next door to Trafalgar Square

title: close to Trafalgar square
text: great location not far from subway station. and trafulgar square which is easy to walk around.room is clean and not too tiny. abit confusing to walk to a room from elevator. but all ok good bar good breakfast nice and clean and great location staff are friendly and helpful

title: Fantastic location
text: We stopped overnight to see all the key sights of London. What a fantastic location this Hotel is in. As soon as you step outside you can see Trafalgar Square and the Tube Stations just a 5 minute walk. The Hotel Staff are very professional and helpful and nothing was too much trouble. The room was clean and comfortable. I reported an issue with the TV and within 4 minutes we had a Staff member sorting it. We would definately recommend The Grand due to the location and the service we received during out stay.

title: Very small room
text: Unfortunately, our room was tiny for a double room, and with the added view of industrial pipes and a wall very close to our window, it was fairly claustrophobic. Staff were friendly and the proximity to London tourist attractions was good.

title: Great weekend
text: Stayed here in February, arrived early, there was a room available for an early check in but we didn't feel like paying the £40 that was being looked for! However we were allowed to leave our bags & off out we headed! Room was clean, staff friendly & I was allowed to print off boarding passes behind the desk when the guest printers weren't working! Couldn't have had a better location, we were able to walk everywhere! Would definitely return & stay again!

title: Excellent location & very comfortable hotel
text: After reading many excellent reviews our expectations were high & we were relieved when they were met in every way. Stayed for 3 nights & were a matter of yards from Trafalgar Square so couldn't be more conveniently located for transport links (bus, tube & water ferry all within 5 mins walk) as well as numerous shopping, entertainment & eating options. Super speedy check in, a comfortable room with all the required amenities including an umbrella & hair dryer with a long enough lead to use AND reach the mirror! Basic tea & coffee making, This hotel is specifically equipped for business use rather than tourist & the room had a fridge & microwave but you won't find things like a mini-bar. If you want to spend a lot of time within the hotel then this is probably not perfect but there is now a bar & restaurant (although we didn't even bother to look at them - too much else to do & look at!) Everything was clean through-out the hotel. Staff were helpful - we asked for an extra pillow which had been placed in our room by the time we returned to the hotel later that evening.

title: Brilliant!
text: A 5 star hotel with attentive and friendly staff. The hotel boasts two nice restaurants, a large business center/atrium, lovely lobby in a historic building (I believe it was the former Department of Defence building). One could not ask for a more central and convenient location for sightseeing. Across, the street there is a great pub as well.

title: Uber good experience with family
text: We had 4 enjoying nights in a spacious room with fab sofabed for our 14 yo son, clean bathroom, location's fab, walking distance to train station, trafalgar sq, national gallery & shopping area eg. Covent Garden.. Staff are friendly & helpful.. And the most important thing is FOOD! No worries! They have Deliverance Room Service..we tried the indian food & it's fantastic! So tasty & good price.. Would be perfect if they up-dating their furniture with more brighter furniture so it will be more fun to stay!

title: The Grand at Trafalgar Square
text: I don't have one bad thing to say about this hotel. The location was perfect (you could pretty much walk to many of the sights, museums, famous areas etc.), staff warm and accommodating and what I like the best was the simplicity of getting in and out of the room. It's small enough to where you could run up to your room, grab something and be back outside within 2 minutes. Rooms were very nice, clean and the bed was very comfortable. Loved the downstairs bar and restaurant. I would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend it to my friends.

title: Great location, pleasant room.
text: Stayed at this hotel for three nights. The room was very pleasant and modern with a good TV system and basic Internet access. On the downside, little information was provided about facilities either within the room or in the hotel generally. On check-in, staff appeared surly and again, unwilling to divulge basic information. I wasn't, for example, told that I had to run the card through a reader in order to operate the lift! Having said all that, the room was really comfortable and pretty spacious

title: Great location!
text: Myself and a friend booked a stay at The Grand so we could catch up in London and relax. We booked a superior room with Kitchenette, which we wanted as a twin room. Check-in was quick, but there was some confusion over the room set up as they thought we wanted to share a bed. It took some explaining that we didn't actually want to share a bed but wanted the sofa bed also made into a bed, but it was rectified and someone came and pulled out the sofa bed ready (it was, worryingly, already made up inside the sofa, which made me wonder if it was in fact clean?). It did appear to be clean, if a little crumpled, but would have preferred it freshly made up. The room was a reasonable size but the bathroom was absolutely tiny. The kitchenette was small, but useful. No view - only of a large tube and a brick wall just feet from the window, so the room had no real natural light - not really a problem when you are only using the room as somewhere to sleep, but I wouldn't want this if I was here for more than one night. It felt very oppressive. The location of this hotel is fantastic. A few minutes walk to Charing Cross, the West End, Theatres, National Gallery and of course Trafalgar Square. From this hotel you can get to anywhere in London quickly and easily. We had an enjoyable evening in the Bar, Boyds London, which serves fabulous cocktails and British Tapas. We had both and the food was really quite good. The prices are very reasonable for London and we enjoyed a good number of cocktails, including an "experimental" cocktail by the Bartender, which was delicious. The atmosphere in the bar was quiet and it was easy to talk to one another. They had the Rugby on in the corner, but well away from the main bar and on mute, which suited us. We didn't have breakfast as it wasn't included in our rate. The staff were very good - polite and efficient. Overall its a great London hotel, with a really good bar and a very calm ambience, superb location with good service. Would stay here again, but wouldn't want to stay in an inward facing room! Would have been 5 stars it it hadn't been for that.

title: Very good for families -highly recommend
text: We just returned from a 2 night stay over the May Bank Holiday weekend and were very happy with our experience. We lived in London for several years but had never quite cracked it in terms of finding a place to stay when coming back as tourists with 2 young children. Now I think we have. The location is fabulous, a half block from Trafalgar Square and across the Millenium Bridge from the South Bank and London Eye. The renovation of the hotel seems to be complete. We had a lovely room which, although billed as a one bedroom suite ,was actually just a very large single room with a comfortable king size bed and a large sofa bed which fit our 2 children. I had read a review indicating that you had to be careful to make sure that they gave you a big enough room for a family of four so I called the hotel reservations centre a few days before we arrived to confirm that the room would be big enough. If you need a family room, I would advise doing the same. We also had a kitchenette which consisted of a microwave, refrigerator (new, with the plastic wrapping still on the inside) and a sink. The hotel provides a complete set of dishes and silverware and pots and pans. We found this invaluable for bringing food back from the nearby Marks and Spencer Simply Food and heating it up ourselves. When you travel with small children you really need to have kitchen facilities. The room was quite spacious, even with the king size bed and sofa bed. The bathroom was a separate room, no bath, only shower but quite large and obviously new. Our rate did not include breakfast but with the kitchenette, it was quite easy to have our own breakfast in the room, and much more convenient with kids too. I had read the reviews indicating that the staff was unfriendly but we found everyone very helpful and any requests for service (ie to fix a light or bring up additional plates) was dealt with quickly. Also liked the fact that there was good security, key card needed in the elevator and the fact that they called to the room to confirm that they could give out a key to my husband who arrived after we did. The price was the same that we had paid for smaller rooms much less centrally located. We did request a room in the back of the hotel, off the street. It had no view but it was quiet and we weren't in the room long enough to have a view really matter. The location of the hotel leads me to doubt that there would really be any special view (ie it does not front onto Trafalgar Square but rather a road off the Square with only a view of the street, so who really cares?). All in all, a great place for families and others too. I would definitely stay here again.
