title: Excellent service
text: I've used Club Quarters before and never been disappointed but as The Grand is such a large hotel in a very busy area I was a little anxious as to whether or not it would suit my requirements. However, I was not disappointed. I had to be up at 3am so requested a quiet room. That was exactly what I got and my stay was excellent.

title: Great Hotel - Great Value - Great Location
text: I have been to London many times and I am happy I discovered The Grand. The room was very comfortable housing my wife and daughter. The kitchenette was convenient and allowed us to enjoy a couple of homemade breakfasts in our room. The location is smack dab in the centre of London close to all tourist attractions and 3 tube stations (Charring Cross, Embankment and 10 minutes from Westminster). Big Ben, Covent Gardens, Theatre District, The London Eye, The National Gallery are all minutes (walking) from this hotel. The staff was very helpful and very pleasant. The free laundromat on the 3rd floor was great as it allowed us to wash our laundry in the comfort of the hotel. I understand this hotel is 6 months old and has the feel of old English charm with all the amenities of a modern hotel. Our cabby mentioned that the hotel used to be an old Ministry of Defense building and the foyer has been completely restored. There are many restaurants and English pubs in the surrounding area. Hats off to Club Quarters for doing a great job restoring this hotel. We'll be back!

title: Tasteful hotel with lovely staff in a very convenient location in central London.
text: A very grand hotel, lots of marble, tasteful furnishings, understated style. Well maintained, everything worked. Surprisingly quiet room (2nd floor). Lovely helpful staff. Great location for theatres, shops and restaurants.

title: Great Iocation, better TV, beds and pillows are needed.
text: Great location better TV, beds and pillows are needed. Please put small refrigerators in the room overall we had a great time and recommend the Grand we would stay there again. The location is perfect no need to rent a car.

title: A fantastic hotel but......
text: This has a fantastic location with easy access to the tubes and walking distance into the city. the hotel its self is amazing to look at but I felt that the rooms although whey were fantastic didn't seem to go with what the hotel as all about. But like I say the hotel was amazing. no complaints we were well looked after and I cant fault it.

title: Good service, perfect location
text: We only stayed one night in the Grand, which is acutally the same hotel as the Club Quarters. The location is unbeatable, right next to Trafalgar Square, staff is very professional. Somebody came into our room at 8 in the morning and when I reported this the guest relation manager looked after us so well and provided a voucher for a complimentary upgrade for our next stay. They provide free water on the corridors and if you need extra milk or coffe sachtes that's available on the corridor as well from a wardrobe:) We booked a small double room and even that was big enough for 2 people. Everything was great about this place.

title: Wake up to the sound of Big Ben and experience 007 views!
text: My husband and I stayed here for 1 night as we were in town to see Charlie and the Chocolate factory at the Drury Lane Theatre. This is the first time I've stayed in a hotel in central London as we usually stay further out to save money. My review is based on the rate we paid (£135 which I think is a pretty good deal). First impressions were great, lovely foyer, very grand looking, the man who helped us check in was polite and helpful. The location is fab. Right next to Trafalgar square, 5-10 mins from Covent Garden, 2 mins from Charing Cross Tube station. Looking out of our room we could see Big Ben, the top of Buckingham Palace and to my husbands delight we could see where James Bond stands on the roof at the end of Skyfall - very cool! I thought it was really nice to wake up on Sunday and hear Big Ben chiming gently in the background. The room was quite compact but perfect for a couple just overnight, it was clean, modern looking with a kettle and tea making facilities, flatscreen TV, CD player alarm clock, temperature controls. The bathroom was nice, again compact but a person of normal size doesn't need much more room than that. There were no 'frills' and it was a very generic looking room so if you're after something fancy and luxurious you'd be disappointed here but it met all our requirements. Down the hallway there is a water machine where you can fill up bottles of filtered water and each floor has a little store cupboard where you can stock up on extra shower gel, tea bags, UHT milk etc which I really liked. When we got back from our show at about 10pm I was concerned about getting to sleep as the road was very noisy but thankfully our room which was to the back of the building was quiet and the windows seemed to eliminate a lot of the noise. After a nice nights sleep I went to find breakfast outside the hotel (we didn't have breakfast at the hotel as the continental was around £14 and we're not big eaters first thing) - 2 mins round the corner is a Tesco, Pret and Mcdonalds all open early - I bought a pint of milk for 45p and made my husband tea and coffee in the room which saved us money! We didn't eat at the hotel during our stay but the restaurant Boyds looked to have some good set menu deals. Overall we both enjoyed our stay, even though we're from the UK it was quite a thrill waking up and being in the midst of so many iconic buildings and so lovely to go out and get breakfast before the crowds turn up and seeing Trafalgar Square empty and peaceful!I would definitely stay here again if I could get a similar rate, I wouldn't want to pay anymore than we did though as we only use hotels as a 'base' and spend most of our time sightseeing. If you're looking for luxurious or quirky rooms then you might want to try elsewhere as the rooms are very business orientated which was fine for us as we were just after a modern clean and central base!

title: Be careful about your room rate
text: When I checked in, I was quoted a room rate significantly above the web rate. When I produced the confirmation e-mail, the original rate was honoured, but as I checked out other guests were querying their rates - so it wasn't an isolated problem. Good room, if perhaps a bit small for two and some obvious fittings missing - fridge, safe. Good walk-in power shower - at least by UK standards. Hotel amenities are a bit basic - although the fitness room is good. I passed on the £9 continental breakfast - there are some great cafés nearby. One concern - while I was there there was a power cut, and the staff didn't sem able to cope. Obviously staff are kept to minimum to keep overheads low, but I wonder how they would cope in a real emergency. That said, if you can get a rate around £ 100 it's good value in a central location.

title: Great Weekend Value---Fantastic Location
text: Fantastic! 2 blocks from the Thames. 1/2 block from the national gallery and Trafalgar square. Clean rooms, comfortable bed, AND FREE LAUNDRY. Yes, FREE LAUNDRY. title: Great Stay for summer
text: The Grand was very convenient for our visit to London. We stayed in the summer and they have AC which was a huge plus. Staff was very accommodating! Andreas at the front desk went out of his way to ensure we had a great visit. Thanks and hope to visit again soon!

title: Lovely spot in a great locaiton
text: My husband and I stayed this past weekend and, in spite of a crazy busy city with the London marathon, we felt that the hotel was a perfect spot to be in the midst of the action and to escape for a breather when we needed a few minutes of peace and quiet. Very helpful and efficient staff, nice sized room with a great view.

title: HUGE brownie points!
text: I had acquired tickets to a West End show as a Christmas present for my mother and stepfather, and wanted them staying somewhere central, to avoid them having to drive back late at night, or pay for taxis to a hotel in a non central location. Club Quarters was recommended to me by a business colleague, who said that it was the only place that he would stay when in London, both for location, and for their apparently faultless service. My mother is rather particular about what she likes, so I did some research first, just to double check it's credentials. I needn't have worried. Both Mum and Stepdad absolutely raved about it! Obviously they were lucky to have the Christmas tree in Trafalgar Square visible from their window, which they said only added to an already magical stay. They were apparently warmly received by 'the most charming American girl', who apparently went out of her way to show them to their rooms, give them directions, and offered to store their luggage the next day, when Mum decided shopping was on the cards! They said the room was comfortable, quiet, Stepdad was happy to be able to watch sports on the large television the next day, and the bed met Mum's high standards too! They dined in the in house restaurant, which they said was lovely, and when they returned later after the theatre said that again they were again greeted warmly, and asked how their evening had gone. Mum was so thrilled that she wanted to write a review herself, but as she hasn't managed to get to grips with email yet, I have been entrusted to do so on her behalf! She apparently wants a repeat stay for her birthday in June. Thanks Club Quarters, would certainly recommend, and might even treat myself to a night there, when I next have a late one in town.

title: Wonderful location at reasonable price
text: I was lucky to get a good weekend price for a double room overlooking Trafalgar Square and Nelson's Column! It was a combined shopping, party and theatre weekend so I did not have to walk far. The room was big, clean. A bit cold (think green policy) at first but warmer after turning up the heating... though the fan was rather loud. The bathroom was clean (shower only). Free access to the internet and the printer (lobby). I ate out so I have no idea what quality of food they serve. Breakfast was not included in the price. Fast check-in and check-ou using a machine. You just slide you credit card and that is it! Great! The staff was helpful!

title: Excellent location
text: We stayed here on 30th Jan for 1 night as was watching a performance at the Harold Pinter theatre. The location is excellent and would definitely recommend this hotel. Check in was smooth and easy and the first impressions on arrival was lovely. We stayed in a standard room and this was more than adequate for our needs. A very comfy bed and great shower. There was a closet outside of the room where you could help yourself to the iron and board and top up on more milk if required. The only one thing that I found strange was the two interruptions once in our room. Fair enough the first one was to check we had settled in OK, but about two hours later there was another knock at the door, before we even had chance to open the door and ask who was there, the person was already letting themselves in and found my husband in his birthday suit (having just showered) not sure who was more embarrassed. We did forget to put the privacy sign on the door but even so, I wouldn't expect someone just to knock and open the door within 2 seconds of knocking! Apart from that small grievance we enjoyed our stay at the grand and would definitely be back again.

title: Very Nice location
text: The Location was perfect! Close to everything and bustrips nearby. friendly staff, beautiful lobby and hotel. BUT no breakfast included, very Dusty room(not clean), bad pillows and the aircondition did not work, so it was very cold in the room!

title: Great placed hotel with nice rooms
text: Great location next to various sights, great restaurants and transport connections (both underground and trains). The rooms are also comfortable with fairly good space and a nice hotel bar. Reasonably quite hotelroom despite being next to a major road.

title: Great find
text: This hotel is great value for money. We had a wonderful stay and couldn't have been in a better position. If you can get a room on the top floor at the back you will have views of Big Ben and Buckingham Palace. There is a Garfunkles just up the road with the normal plastic meals, but if you fancy something more traditional go to the Sherlock Holmes which is almost opposite the hotel. Great Treacle pudding !

title: Shower curtain terror
text: Foyer is spectacular, wish the rest of the hotel was the same... our bags were stashed in one of the meeting areas whilst our room was getting ready, but don’t expect the staff to help you. The reception is in a hallway to the side of the lobby in a tiny hallway so space is frustratingly limited . Our room was old. Tacky old not classy old. The mattresses need to be replaced & the room a freshen up. We asked for 2 double beds, one ended up being a sofa - not impressed. The bathroom has the mould stains & curtains you are terrified to accidentally brush. Location is good, but I would stay in one of the numerous other hotels around with better value for money.

title: Great location, but...
text: I chose this hotel because its location was in central London within a short walking distance to major tourist attractions. This is basically what you're paying for, not furnishings of the room. From the pictures I saw, the rooms looked like they had tasteful-looking bedding with large windows and good views of the city. NOT the case with our room. When we first headed to our room on the 9th floor (909), we got the impression that we were being hidden away from other guests (this was infuriating and the main reason why I will not be recommending this hotel to others). Our room was tucked away at the end of the hallway in the corner. We opened the door and saw what looked like a purple zebra-print duvet cover (so hilariously ugly). Our windows were tiny and up high. It was like we were in a basement room. The view out of our two small windows was of a wall with barbed wire on top. The toiletries were disappointing. I was expecting conditioner and shampoo separately, but instead got "conditioning shampoo" which is just shampoo. There's nothing "conditioning" about it. With the liquid restrictions placed on travelers, it's nice to not have to worry about packing shampoo and conditioner thinking your hotel will provide it. So when your hotel doesn't provide both, as with this hotel, it's very upsetting, knowing they're cutting corners and your hair will suffer for it. Everything in the room was clean, no complaints there. The room was definitely large enough. I appreciated the coat hooks next to the door and the full curtain in the shower. The side table outlets and desk outlets were easily accessible to charge our devices. There was plenty of counter space in the bathroom. The last thing I will mention is that because the hotel is located next to Trafalgar Square, you can hear a lot of city noises, especially ambulance sirens, which sound frequently. Luckily, they don't go late into the night. Given the whole experience, I will not be recommending this hotel to others.

title: Pleasantly surprised
text: I booked a one night stay through a last minute company, so was not quite sure what to expect. The central location could not be better, the staff were very helpful and I was very pleased at the room size. There was 3 of us in one room and the pull out bed was a double. The only downside was that we had the noise of the extractor fan and outlets outside our window all night, although I didn't mind as we had made a last minute discount booking and I doubt the traffic noise on the other side would have been any better! Would definitely recommend this hotel for its location and comfort.

title: Loved this hotel!
text: Excellent arrival. The room had a wonderful writing desk with a view of historic London. I was in London for pleasure but had to work both days from my room. The staff was very good, and the hotel has a very British Library, business center. Fabulous! Coffee, snacks, fruit, etc.. It was a pleasure to use this quiet retreat. I was 100% satisfied with my stay. I enjoyed one spectaular breakfast in the hotel. One evening I wanted to open a bottle of wine and the bar tender did it for me. I will return to this lovely retreat.

title: Spectacular, spectacular!
text: I absolutely love this hotel and cannot wait to stay there again next year. I stayed in the hotel for 8 nights and it was perfect for my needs on this business trip. The room amenities were excellent - very comfortable bed, good size and immaculate bathroom, good wardrobe space, a long desk for working and a fridge and microwave. As most reviewers agree, the location is outstanding. One minute walking and you are right in the thick of Trafalgar Square! The service from staff was excellent and they could not do enough to help. The restaurant for dinner was sublime and not expensive. The waiting staff were absolutely lovely. The laundry in the basement is an excellent option for guests as well.

title: Location, Location, Location
text: My friend and I have stayed at this hotel several times and love it. It is a great location and close to everything. We especially love that the hotel has free computers and printers to use. Another great amenity is that on each floor there are free water bottles you can fill up and take with you. The rooms are big and clean and the staff is very nice.

title: Perfect location, large room, great quality-price ratio
text: Stayed in this hotel during a business trip. Great location, 1 minute from Trafalgar Square and the subway. The room was large and pleasant, with a comfortable desk, and best of all, there is a free wireless network in the hotel - something really convenient and unfortunately seldom available in hotels nowadays. Fast electronic check-in and check-out. The only average point would be the breakfast, which was correct, but nothing extraordinary. I would strongly recommend this hotel, and intend to stay there during my next business trip to London.

title: So good Nelson would have stayed here!
text: What can I say that hasn't already been said? The perfect hotel in the perfect location for everything there is to see and do in London. Situated at number 8 Northumberland Avenue this 4 star luxury hotel has been restored to be elegant whilst still having a modern feel about it. With over 200 rooms fitted with the latest technology, and comfortable fittings this hotel is a must when visiting London. Lovely friendly staff, would definitely come back here again.

title: Ideal location
text: Ideal location for many main tourist attractions and public transport. The room was clean and comfortable with good soundproofing from street noises. Staff were helpful and friendly. The only downside was the lack of colour. everything was a bit drab but for an overnight stay it was a very good choice.

title: Love this Hotel
text: We have stayed at this hotel on two occasions and thoroughly enjoyed our stay both times. The location is fabulous as you can walk to theaters, parks, shopping, Buckingham Places and many great restaurants and pubs. Would highly recommend it to friends.

title: The Best Value For The Money In London
text: I booked this hotel on line and had no personal reference to go by. I booked for the location, but was concerned about the quality of the hotel based on the price of the rooms. When the taxi drove up I thought I was at the Fairmont Hotel in San Francisco, what an amazing surprise. Once inside, the lobby was beautiful, the staff were extremely helpful and my room was ready even though I arrived before noon. The rooms were large and equipped with everything you would need, including electronic A/C controls and free internet access. The bathroom was much bigger than expected, with mirrors everywhere, a huge shower and it was spotless. The location was more than perfect. We walked to the Horse Guard in five minutes, to Buckingham Palace in 10 minutes, the theatre in 15 minutes, the Tube in two minutes and the Charing Cross train station in five minutes. The tour busses were available in front of the hotel and it was the best value I have ever had in Europe.

title: Advance booking
text: We booked a superior room preferably with a bath several months before the occupation date but this was sought by staff only on arrival when no such rooms were left.. Make sure your booking preferences are confirmed.

title: Great Location for Business and Pleasure
text: Hotel Service was excellent, bar/restaurant was good, service a little slow at peak points (breakfast) if you chose a la carte. Continental breakfast was available. Excellent geographic location, you could walk to Piccadilly, excellent staff, very helpful, very safe, 5 star on that front. Rooms are small and not being accustomed to having the air conditioning turned off while you are out, makes a very hot welcome upon your return until the air kicks in. All in all I would return but would work on a room with a little larger square footage. I would give mine 3 Star on space, (washroom door hit the bed when it opened). In summary 5 star for check in/out and daily service and safety. 4 Star for location, 3 star for roominess and climate control, overall 3.5. Enjoy!

title: Great Get Away to London
text: We stayed for three nights in mid January and enjoyed the hotel. It was right in the heart of the city walking distance to all the sights. The staff treated us well and the room was very nice. Lots of wonderful pubs with great atmosphere and good pub food. The Sherlock Holmes is a must for a pint and Ye Olde Cheshire Cheese should not be over looked.

title: Three Day Stay at The Grand at Trafalgar in London
text: This hotel was about a 3-4 minute walk from the Charing Cross station right at Trafalgar Square. (It was about equidistant to the Embankment station as well.) The staff was INCREDIBLY polite and made us feel special. The room was a little on the small side, but not unexpectedly or disappointingly so. From our window, we could see the Eye, and just catch a glimpse of Big Ben. Rooms was clean and we had no problems or complaints at all during our stay. We had a mini-fridge, safe (large enough for laptops), wifi and cable TV. We didn't take advantage of any amenities like spa, gym, or restaurants, so I can't speak to those. I wouldn't not hesitate to stay here again.

title: Very impressed and great value for money, lovely hotel bar too.
text: After a last minute change of plan we needed a london hotel for 2 nights and wanted quality but not overpriced. After a little research we opted for the grand. We couldn't have been more impressed and will definitely stay here again. Very centrally located and the room was very modern, clean and well equipped. Comfortable beds too. Hotel bar is very good too, quite trendy. Will be back.

title: location location location...and a nice hotel
text: The location is awesome. The restaurant is very good - we had both breakfast and dinner. Did I mention the location was great. You are two blocks from Charing Cross, two blocks from The Mall, the opposite end of The Mall from Buckingham, lots of small cafe's and a 24 hour Tesco store...just all round good spot. The room is standard London. A bit tight but well appointed and clean....and quiet. It was the second time for my other half to stay there. The staff is friend but very busy. The Quarter Hotel is also part of the building..

title: Always a good welcome
text: We arrived @10 am and they let us check in straight away . Rooms are very clean and up to date . Have stayed here before. The only down side to me is the price of the breakfast but its only a short walk to Trafalgar Sq

title: I will be back soon
text: We had a nice stay at The Grand. The location is absolutely fantastic as you are in the middle of everything. The staff is great! They are really friendly and the most helpful I have met in London. The rooms are beautiful with a good size and a lot of space for our luggage. We also used the gym a few times and the restaurants which were authentic and very reasonably priced. This will be my first choice for my next visit in London.

title: Good value for money
text: Stayed here for a week in August. The twin room I shared with a friend was spacious and clean. Loved the large windows in the room, but can be stuffy on hot summer days as the windows cannot be opened fully. No ensuite but not a problem for us as there were enough shared bathrooms, hardly had to wait for an empty one. The location is excellent, fairly quiet neighbourhood but close enough to walk to various tube stations and places of interest (e.g. British Museum). Breakfast was good - generous portions, but do go early to avoid the crowd.

title: Recommended!
text: We stayed at Passfield Hall while on business sharing a twin room. The location couldn't have been better, plenty to do and see and close to our place of work. Reception was very helpful and friendly with the excellent facilities and open spaces providing a welcome rest-bite from a long day. Note on the room: For a budget accommodation, it was huge – two comfy beds, towels and toiletries, two desks and wardrobes made this real value for money. If you’re looking for somewhere quiet and picturesque that’s close to Museums, Universities and shops and on a budget, this is a good place to go.

title: We recommend staying here
text: Very clean, comfortable accommodation. Excellent breakfast and helpful staff. Excellent value.

title: Great location, large rooms. offbeat place to stay. Superb breakfast and great value for money
text: 4 of us stayed here as a base for the boxing at Wembley stadium. The place is about a 6 minute walk from Euston station. The rooms were very large with desks and wardrobes in them with plenty of plug sockets and are essentially standard student halls. The rooms were clean albeit very basic and has a sink in them. Check in was simple but the rooms were fairly difficult to find as the building is like a labrynth. Even with directions this took a good 10 - 15 minutes. It was one of the cheapest places to stay in London and with a free cooked breakfast buffet makes the value for money unbeatable really. The hotel has a large garden in the centre which would be great in the summer. Only gripe is that one of the rooms wouldn’t lock properly. I would definitely stay again when in central London

title: Absolutely Terrible
text: Passfield Halls is the worse hostel that I have ever stayed in, the rooms were absolutely filthy and we hardly slept because of the constant noise coming from the traffic and the numerous stag parties that were staying in the hostel. The attitude of the staff was well below standard and they were not in the least bit helpful. I would not recommend using this hostel

title: Dysfunctional bathroom, poor wifi
text: I was given a room equipped for a wheel chair user, so my review may not apply to all the rooms. It meant I had plenty of space, but the problems outweighed that. The bathroom sink was so small I barely had room to wash my hands. The only place to put anything was the top of the cistern. There were mirrors in the bathroom but no power point and power points in the main room but no mirrors. The only way to affect the temperature was to open the window. Since it had a complicated addition to the normal lock I suspect there was a limit on how far it would open. Some of the woodwork in the bathroom looked as it were disintegrating. The wifi was barely functional. The location is good if you are using Euston station (but don't go to Euston for the northbound Victoria line, it is a very long trek).

title: Close to London
text: Passfield Hall was easily accessible by train from Heathrow. Instructions provided on how to find the Hall were faultless. We easily walked into London central from Passsfield. In fact we did not use the train except for arrival and departure, all our destinations - including Buckingham Palace - were within walking distance. Our stay was for 3 nights. A twin room, comfortable beds, lovely and clean and plenty of windows

title: Worth staying
text: If you want to stay in central London at affordable prices, you can consider staying in this hall of residence. This hall has recently been refurbished. The rooms are large and clean. Toilets and shower rooms are to be shared, but they are very clean. One amazing thing to stay in this hall is the Internet access. Most halls of residence do not allow Internet access unless you are their students, or pay on hourly basis. Passfield Hall allows you to get free, wireless Internet access on your own laptop computer. You can also use the computers in the computer room. The breakfast they provide is really nice. There are great varieties in abundant supply, viz, fresh fruit, cereals, toasts, croissants, juice, etc. The location is perfect. The nearest underground station is Euston Station. It takes 5 minutes’ walk to get there. However, there is no lift or escalator in Passfield Hall annex except in the main building. It can be a headache if you are to carry your luggage walking up and down in narrow staircase. We did make a request, in person, to stay in the main building a couple of weeks before our check-in date. However, we were assigned to the annex on the third floor. It was the most annoying thing about our stay in Passfield.
