title: Brilliant location, nice staff, comfortable stay
text: Hotel is situated 2 mins from the underground station, and very close to Heathrow Airport. The stay was very good value for its price, and had everything required of a mid range hotel The room is a reasonable size, the bed was comfortable and large. Good wifi speed in rooms Bathroom a bit small but sufficient and functional The room and the hotel was themed with graphics and words that presented facts about this area of Kensington which is quite unique. Lobby has a funky interior and a touch of humour. Breakfast was included, continental with a nice choice. Staff service was quick, very friendly and gave helpful suggestion of local restaurants

title: Superb location for central London
text: Stayed for two nights in early March. The hotel is very close to Earls court tube station making it very convenient if coming from Heathrow. I was a bit concerned when I saw all of the scaffolding the covered the building, but all fears were allayed after entering the reception area, which was clean and bright. The staff were friendly and helpful. Within minutes I was settling into my room. As others have pointed out the room was tiny, but it was very clean and bright, and the temperature was just right. The room was brightly painted with quirky artwork, the intention is clearly to nullify the perception of the room size. It's true there was no room to swing the proverbial cat, and even less space for the one bag I was carrying. There was a decent sized flat screen TV in the room, with all the usual channels. Based on other reviews, I chose a room with a queen size bed, and to this day I am wondering how they managed to get it into the room? Having said that, it was very comfortable with a range of pillow types to suit all sleeping postures. The equally tiny bathroom was one step away from the end of the bed, but like the rest of the room, it was very clean. Best not be in a hurry for breakfast as you might pass away with hunger while waiting for the lift. Better to take the stairs. The breakfast room in the basement is large. At peak times it is very busy, but if you are prepared to wait, the crowd passes quickly. It is mostly a continental style breakfast, with adequate but not a huge selection on offer. The coffee dispensing machine probably wouldn't please many. If you fill up first with the muesli, then you wont be hungry until lunch. Bottom line, if you are visiting London for a few days and don't intend to spend much time in the room (other than to sleep) then this hotel is hard to beat. In those circumstances, all I wanted was a well-priced, clean, functioning, comfortable and quiet room with a decent breakfast. In this respect, it ticked all the boxes.The location is superb, with lots of good restaurants in the immediate vicinity, and good public transport to the nearby sights of central London. I intend to use it again for my next visit. I hope it is just as good next time.

title: Long weekend with my daughter
text: We had a double room for my daughter and I and we found it quite nice, not too small and very clean. My daughter requested we had a ground floor room due to my health and that's exactly what we got. The staff man the front desk 24 hours a day and are always there if you need anything.tea and coffee making facilities in the room andyoj can get more at reception.

title: Friendly Staff
text: A hotel ideally placed for access to the Tube on a quiet street. I was most impressed by the friendliness of all staff encountered including the maintenance chap who asked if I would like a drink whilst I waited for the door closure to be checked. A couple more things to be tidied up as this is a new hotel - cracked bathroom floor tile in 207 and carpet not caught under the strip in 217. As a single traveller I definitely look forward to using this hotel again and recommend it.

title: a bit small, no where to hang my coat!
text: Needs a few hooks for coats and towels. The tiny hanging space is too shallow to hang a dress and was right over the kettle. Incidentally when bothTea and coffee offered 2 tubs milk poor . The toilet stank of sewage and made for a very unpleasant night.... Just needs a few inexpensive tweaks. Staff fine and made them aware of v.poor toilet smells.

title: Beware
text: I don't normally take the time to write a review and I should! I read them and aoprecitate them. However, I really do wish I had been cautioned abut this hotel. I am a pretty relaxed guest and often stay in hostels, so believe me, my standards are not that high! But this hotel, while in a convenient location, is cheap, tiny tiny rooms (not room to open a small suitcase except on the bed!) and employs rude staff. While I say that, there is one male member or the staff at the desk who was vehpynhelpful, but the woman was actually rude! I had to go down in the middle of the night for written instructions on how to turn the heat off because my room was sweltering. My question is, if it's complicate enough to require written instructions, why don't they give those to you when you check in, rather than my laying awake all night and having to get dressed and go ask! The continental breakfast was nice, but, I would never never stay here again and likely will just steer away from ibis in general.

title: Not the best choice
text: Stayed for a two night break . The hotel us in a good location, very clean and tidy, but would have a problem enticing me back. Never managed to join the WIFI, room was tiny, a little larger after complaint and being moved, shower head fell off wall, and bar choice very limited. No wardrobe, clothes hung on clothes rail over kettle boiling area.Not a patch on other Ibis Styles I have stayed at.

title: Small room with large comfy bed
text: Great location close to earls court tube station with good pubs & eateries close by. The hotel has a theme of the near by attractions such as museums & Albert hall. Our room had big picture of a parrot on a bike & our friends room info about the Albert hall. There are space issues making it a bit of an assault course to get into bed with only one small case to negotiate. The only clothes hanging space was directly above the tea/coffee prep in room 205. The bed was large & comfy so once we were settled in it was fine. A good continental breakfast with fresh fruit, yoghurt, good cheese & ham plus breads fruit juices. Recommended for price, location & sleep quality

title: Surprisingly pleasant
text: Was dreading this stay after reading the reviews however was pleasantly surprised. Stayed in room 102 and was a good size for just the two of us, seems like we were lucky as pictures on here show much smaller rooms! We got a good deal on this hotel so can't complain for the price we paid. Good choice of food for the breakfast and literally over the road from earls court station, we also walked into the city most days so it is easy to do if you don't mind the walking. Modern rooms with hair dryer, ensuite, coffee facilities and air con are good touchs too.

title: Good, clean hotel
text: Good hotel, all the way good like you'd expect in IBIS. Nice and friendly staff who take the time to serve you. The single rooms are really small, but ok. Everything is clean and at hand. Comfortable stay!

title: Best Ibis available!
text: Best room I ever had at Ibis, with great shower. Breakfast was fine, with many options available. Really surprised me. Really close to earl's court tube and with many options around if you don't fell like paying for breakfast.

title: Appalling, still being renovated, rooms nothing like shown on website
text: I know the Accor group, and also have stayed in another Ibis Styles so was confident in booking this hotel. Wrong. The room shown on the website is frankly deception as they admitted the photograph was incorrect and had not been amended. The room we were given on the 2nd floor was so small, that the bed was against the wall on one side, so one of us could only get out of bed by crawling over the other. There was no room to get past the end of the bed, without breathing in and tripping over the chair, which would not go under the tiny shelf. the window had been frosted as it looked down a shaft, (through the tiny slit that the window opened) and it was like living in a small bathroom. We were very tired and stayed there that night. Couldn't stand it and next morning I complained and asked them to find us the room that was shown on the website, which is when it was admitted that wasn't possible. After 15 minutes and asking again, I was offered room 123 on the first floor. This was a small improvement, with at least access to both sides of the bed, and able to move past the end of the bed, but that was due to less storage space. So, move all our things, no help from the hotel, and lo and behold next morning, scaffolding was being erected onto the balcony outside the room. I complained again, and no work was started before we left. The final insult was after arriving back at midnight on our last night, very tired after a long day and a longish train journey to find that the lift was out of order. Says it all about this hotel. Feel sorry for the staff, who on the whole were very nice and were dealing with an impossible situation. Wi-Fi very slow, and had to buy a data card in order to do anything on the computer. Have given feedback on the Accor site, but no response.

title: Nice budget hotel
text: Located a walking distance from earls court station. Rooms are small but working. Staff is nice and helpful. Breakfast is very basic and no cooked option. Bed is comfortable and nice. Overall a nice stay. Ask for bigger rooms and staff will help.

title: Great Stay
text: Just wanted to say for the price we paid it was great value and a superb location. We had a twin room on the 4th floor and although a little hot it was more than ample. Clean and tidy with welcoming staff and also a great continental breakfast included.

title: Very basic hotel
text: I only stayed here for one night and it was an unexpected stay, so I booked it on the day. The room was very small and very basic. I do understand that it is in central London, but the price was quite high for what it was. Staying for one night was fine, but if I had a suitcase and were staying for longer, I think I would have been very disappointed. There are better places to stay in central London for the same money.

title: Clean and good location.
text: Arrived with family late evening. Nice staff checking me in. Only drawback no wi-fi but we were informed of it. Small room but all the essentials in it. Breakfast with a wide choice of options and room well lit and lots of space. Very easy access to tube, minutes away. Would come again when visiting London.

title: Does the job
text: Stayed for one night whilst with my 7 yr old. The room was small but very clean and comfortable. The staff were lovely and friendly. The free breakfast is simple but plenty. My only gripe is the walls are paper thin. Got woken up at 3 in the morning with tbe man in the next room shouting. On the whole great location and perfect for a night stay

title: Location or comfort
text: Looking for a central London location then this is a good choice. The earls court station is a 2 min walk. My first trip to London gave me an experience of the shocking size of the tiny rooms. I am sure the other hotels around are similar The breakfast is OK Staff is smiling and greets you well.

title: They helped me out of a pickle!
text: I stay in London every week in business and had booked a Wednesday evening at a different Ibis. That Wednesday evening my schedule suddenly changed and I had to find a room for the following evening and selected this hotel. I quickly booked online and the next day, packed up my bag and moved hotels. I arrived to discover that I had made a huge error. In my haste, I had booked for the same day as my other hotel. This meant I didn’t have a room for the night and I had been charged in full as a ‘no show’ for the night before. I stood there in despair! I had no time to try and find anywhere else but I had nowhere to stay. Within minutes the helpful team at the hotel transferred my incorrect booking to the correct night which meant I now had somewhere to stay. They strictly didn’t need to as it was my error. They did it to help me out. Thank you for being so flexible. Many other hotels wouldn’t be.

title: Well positioned
text: Located close to the Earls Court Tube station with good options for travel and amid a good range of places to eat. As with most Ibis Styles the rooms feature some good art work and are in immaculate condition

title: Very central clean hotel
text: Was impressed with hotel. Have stayed in several ibis hotels. Although compact it had everything a traveller needs. Clean rooms, staff incredibly friendly and location very close to Earls Court underground, so well connected to central London. Highly recommend as very well priced too!

title: Great location and staff but lose the butterflies
text: Room, facilities, staff and location excellent - but surprised to see the large collection of pinned butterflies in the foyer. Even if they were artificial this does not send the right messages about concern for sustainability.

title: Noise
text: A nice clean hotel, but so much noise. Guests shouting in the night, a fight in the room above mine and most importantly and annoyingly the stupid elevator "bing bong" chime which could clearly be disabled and would make the accommodation so much better. Would not recommend this hotel due to the excessive noise. Even asked for a different room further away from the elevator when I booked months in advance, only to be put in a room directly adjacent to the elevator shaft. Asked to be moved upon arrival and moved to another room in equal proximity to the awful lift.

title: Short break
text: Hotel was relatively clean and bed was very comfortable. Unfortunately not much more to be said that is good. Room was very small consisting of bed, dressing table and chair with 2 hooks on the wall with 4 coat hangers and Tv. Bathroom door hanging off hinges, bedroom door did not latch shut and air con pump made very loud noise throughout the day and night and sash windows rattled. Came back once to find cleaner had left bedroom door ajar. Doors soon fixed but had to complain twice and insist someone came to the room immediately to get air con fixed. Breakfast was terrible with minimal choice. Ham was wafer thin packet type. We knew we were going budget but not this budget. Will defiantly not return and won’t recommend.

title: Next time in LON I'll chose Airbnb
text: I'm a platinum tier of Accor and I wonder what's going on with those customer's who aren't. I've been relocate in other hotel due some kind of lick in Ibis. Hotel has rejected my early check-in and check-out requests. Breakfast consists mostly of Nutella and croissants... I think next time in London I'll chose Airbnb to avoid all these.

title: New hotel, still working things out
text: This is a new hotel, located close to the Earl Court underground (a few minutes walking), making this a very good base from which to explore all of London. We stayed here within approximately the first month of its opening, and it appeared they had not yet worked things out from the customer service aspect. Nearly all questions (internet not working, American credit card payment, using the printer) were met with confusion or the need to consult with someone else. The room I stayed in was plain (my travel partner stayed in a single room across from me with a sushi theme), with a set of stairs immediately inside the door of the room (not good for anyone with limited mobility!). The room smelled slightly of cigarette smoke, even though the hotel is non-smoking. I would imagine some previous occupant had smoked out the window, and the smell lingered inside. I expected the room to be small, but it was actually tinier than I had imagined! This wasn't really an issue, but just be prepared for limited space. The breakfast was a nice bonus - not gourmet, but nice that it was included. The internet was spotty, and the staff was reluctant to believe me when I reported a problem because no one else had reported it yet. I would stay there again for the location, reasonable price, and overall cleanliness, but I would hope that the hotel staff picks it up a notch in terms of customer service.

title: Tiniest room in London!!!
text: The hotel is in a convenient location near Earls Court tube station and walking distance to nicer parts of Kensington but do be warned - the rooms are TINY!!!! my husband and I had a double room and it was impossible to get in and around the room without having to step over bags or the bed and don't start me on the bathroom. I am fully aware of central London square meters but this really is the smallest room we've ever stayed in and for two of us it was quite uncomfortable. The air conditioning doesn't go below 20 (so during heatwave week it was hard to sleep) and the lift often didn't work or was incredibly slow - but the staff were really friendly and overall the hotel is clean and functional. I would say it is more of a trendy hostel rather than a hotel. It is a good base for the Piccadilly line.

title: Disappointing
text: Positives: well located, close to earls court tube stop. Looks great from outside. Staff were pleasant. Negatives: tiny room, barely space to move. Aircon leaked and was very noisy. Breakfast was not great at all. Bathroom smelt like it had serious drainage issues. Unfortunately cleaning staff left our room unlocked for a whole day.

title: Great location
text: We stayed for 1 night for our trip to watch the Marathon this year. The hotel is in an excellent location, short walk from Earls Court tube. Couldn't check in when we arrived so the hotel looked after our bags until after 2pm. We had a double room on the 4th (top) floor and it was tiny - the bathroom door couldn't open fully due to the bed, and the bathroom was smaller in total than some showers I've been in! I could rest my chin on the sink whilst sitting on the loo. Despite that, it was very clean and had everything we needed, we were barely in the room anyway. The other downside was the heat on the top floor, each room has aircon but its really noisy so we couldn't leave on all night, but we had to leave the window open as it was so hot (had been 15 degrees outside through the day). We were pleasantly surprised there was no noise from the street through the night, its a really quiet location. Breakfast was a continental, the room was packed full of people and there wasn't any plates or cutlery and a queue for everything - however the staff were really attentive and got us plates and cutlery really quickly. It was basic, but edible. Again, really clean. You can pay for a full cooked brekkie if you wanted. If we want somewhere to stay for a night, we'd come back, but any longer than that I would need more room and less heat. We ended up getting annoyed waiting for the 1 lift in the hotel so went up the stairs, and you can feel the heat rise as you climb - definitely cooler lower down in the hotel.

title: A charming new Hotel
text: We found this hotel by chance after a terrible experience in a nearby Apartment Hotel and decided to try it on our next visit which was a week later. The hotel had just opened and although we expected a few teething problems, surprisingly the hotel was running very well. The decor everywhere is very bright and happy, the staff are extremely helpful and polite and although the rooms were a bit small they were comfortable. The breakfast buffet was very adequate with surprisingly a big choice of items. The location of the hotel is 5 minutes away from Earl's Court Tube station which is ideal for accessing Heathrow Airport. We will certainly return. PS. Try and improve on the strength of the Wifi

title: Excellent value
text: Recently stayed here on my first trip to London for a few years. Hotel was only a couple of minutes walk from Earls Court tube station which is very handy for reaching most of London's attractions. Staff were very friendly and helpful. I stayed in a single room which was small but clean, quiet and it looked like it had been recently decorated. Continental breakfast was included, good value considering the price of the hotel. Wifi was included too. As budget hotels go I have found the Ibis Styles brand very good in comparison to its competitors. I've already booked to go back next year.

title: Just opened in October 2014
text: Like other ibis hotels, rooms are not large but clean and functional. Single rooms have shower only, but there is a hand shower and rain shower. The temperature and water pressure are perfect. You can have coffee and hot water 24-hour at the reception. However both were not always hot even in the morning. WIFI is unstable. Even though its signals were strong and it did not disconnected, the speed was slow. It took almost 2 minutes to upload one image to SNS. The connection was poor not only on the fourth floor of my room but also lobby. It was slightly better to connect WiFi in th cafeteria underground.

title: Ideal location to visit Kensington Palace
text: Pleasant, clean small hotel with friendly , helpful staff, only short walk from Earle's Court tube station. It was an ideal location to see Kensington, Knightsbridge and Holland Park. Ideal for us to come on the train to Kings Cross Station, and then get the Piccadilly line to Earle's Court.

title: Incredible experience!
text: From the moment I walked into the lobby I knew this was going to be a great stay. The staff are very friendly and they make everything they can to help you. The room I got was really nice and spacious compared to what I had previously read from other reviews. The location is very nice. Hogarth Road is a really pretty street and you are only a short walk away from Earl's Court tube station, which serves the Piccadilly and District lines. You've also got the Victoria & Albert and Natural History museums, and Harrods on a walking distance. On our last day we checked out early in the morning and since our flight was at 22:30 we asked at the front desk if they could keep our luggage in order for us to go out and profit the last day. Turns out that unlike many other hotels, they've got a room for this and they can keep your stuff! This kind of service really adds value to the hotel. It was a really nice experience overall and I am definitely coming back next time I'm in London.

title: Weekend London
text: The hotel is near the metrostation in walking distance. The room was too small and the bed nearly fits. The space around the bed was very narrow on both sides. The breakfast was very good and the service people are very kind.

title: Cheapish
text: On my confirmation check-in time was noon. In fact my room was not ready until after 2.30. The first room I was allocated, apart from being very small, had a window that could not be opened and was made of frosted glass. It might as well have been a cupboard. I rejected this one and was offered another, just as small, which did at least have a window. I had booked a single room and was not expecting the room to be big but both of these looked like linen cupboards that had been converted. Staff were not very apologetic about either of my issues.

title: Awful Hotel! Staff don't care. Waste of money.
text: We stayed at the ibis in Kensington for a birthday night away in London. I understand the hotel is classed as 'budget' but this hotel was awful! Please see pictures. We had the standard double room and paid nearly £100 for the room for one night, which after staying here I feel like I have been severely ripped off. When we arrived we immediately noticed the table was dirty. The carpet was ripped in several places and the loose bits of carpet/material just left dangerously on the floor. The roof above where the cups/kettle/spoons were kept had peeled and part of the roof had flaked onto the all of the cups etc, leaving them covered in plaster and dirt. Then in the bathroom, the roof in the shower was so low down we could not stand up fully whilst in the shower. We're not even that tall. The shower hose had a hole in and water was leaking everywhere! The shower holder wasn't fixed in place so the shower head was moving everywhere. Finally the whole shower unit was coming off the wall and was really loose, I only used it because I had too. We approached reception very unhappy with our room. The receptionist said you've paid for a standard room, as if to say you get what you pay for. She showed us another room which was equally as bad so we stayed where we were. Other things include damp/mouldy looking shower base, a very brown/black string light cord and flaking window sill. I would not recommend this hotel and I looking to get a refund. Please avoid staying here if you want to have a good time!

title: Bright, clean and functional
text: Stayed at the ibis styles in Kensington (Earls Court) for work. Hotel was very affordable for London, was clean bright and functional, served my purpose perfectly. Just a note that the rooms are pretty small and their has a small bar.

title: great location
text: The location is perfect, super close to the Tube and so easy to get there from Heathrow (only 30mins)! Nice and clean rooms and a good breakfast. We stayed here during our girls-trip to London and I would totally return!

title: Good location
text: The hotel is in a good location, a few minutes walk to the tube station. The rooms are TINY! but if you are not planning on spending time in the room other than to sleep, it is adequate. Breakfast was nice, good selection of fresh pastries, meat, cheese, cereal, yoghurt etc. Fine for one night but I wouldn't want to spend any longer here.

title: Good value, good location
text: Just a few steps away from Earls Court station, yet in a quiet location, the Ibis Styles offers you a comfortable stay in a modern and well appointed bedrooms. My room was on the top floor and it was to all intent and purpose fine. The bathrooms are a little on the small side, but hey, this is London, what do you expect? As far as I could tell there is only one lift, which at peak hours may make it a little slow to reach the lower floors (breakfast is in the basement in a pleasant, if very busy, dining area). I had problems with the WiFi but was told there was some ongoing maintenance in place so I can't verify whether this is a general problem, or just a sporadic one. With a warm welcome on arrival and departure, this is a very good base indeed for the West End.

title: Work in progress
text: A sign on the main door states "come in, let us surprise you" - sadly most of the surprises were bad. This hotel just re-opened as an Ibis and based on my two-day stay it's obvious that the operator jumped the gun and re-opened way too early, A big chunk of the building is still under renovation, which wasn't too annoying until the single elevator broke down forcing us to use the staircase, which sent us right into the work zone where we then got lectured by a security guard. My room was extra tiny but the layout somehow worked well, with the exception of a total lack of shelving or drawers, forcing the guest to literally live out of his suitcase. The said suitcase better not be too large because there is also little floor space available to park it. The bathroom was even tinier - it made me think of an airplane toilet. The hotel designer had a quirky sense of humor: my room was themed after sushi, and indeed it was about the same size as Tokyo's tiniest sushi bars. More gremlins: the phone didn't work and the air conditioning system had a life of its own, ignoring whatever you dialed in on the remote control. It would randomly switch on despite you (repeatedly) switching it off, and would pick whatever temperature it saw fit. The room's door was purely there for decorative purposes, with large gaps all around offering no sound insulation. Continental breakfast is included and served in the basement on the rhythm of what (bizarrely) looked like a boom-box incorporated into a coffee machine. This all being said, the location of the hotel is great, it's a 2-minute walk to Earls Court station and the upscale neighborhood is really nice. Staff was friendly but looked a bit like deer caught in the headlights. Much needs to be improved for this Ibis to survive and thrive...

title: Great location
text: The Ibis Kensington is a very pleasant hotel, attentive staff, and an excellent location, just minutes away from the Earl's Court underground station, which makes convenient connections to just about anywhere in London. The neighborhood has all kinds of places to eat, it's very diverse and lively.

title: Cold!!!!
text: Although in a great location,and a fine buffet breakfast....the tragedy is that this hotel is so so cold.Certainly in December,and given that the heat only works when your actually in the room,and it is a blower rather than central heating,is nothing short or terrible. The rooms,if i was generous,one would say compact...being truthful I would say small...doors don't fully open....impossible to use Bathroom comfortably....designed by the vertically challenged.....I checked out after my 2 day store,with the intentions of staying a few more days,but as I had succumbed to a heavy cold...i checked into a nearby hotel....who understood the meaning of customer satisfaction.

title: Shabby hotel - and not in a good way!
text: Hotel is in a good position and entrance and reception look good. Beyond this was pretty dire. The corridor to our room had fraying carpets and dirty, damaged walls. Our room was tiny with not even enough space to store suitcases. The hanging rail (no, no space for a wardrobe) was directly over the bed. The carpet was stained and dirty, the bathroom was stained and dirty, the shower door was almost falling off. The bathroom sink was tiny crushed into a corner, with a cupboard directly above it - interesting challenge to spit out your toothpaste and get it to land in the sink! I'm not kidding. We arrived after midnight and were too busy the next day to complain about the room. We also didn't sleep well as we could hear noises from other rooms including every time other guests visited the toilet. After two nights camping out in this horrible room we asked for something better. The staff member we spoke to was very helpful and she gave us a much better alternative room. This room was on the ground floor and although this corridor of named rooms was in much better condition there were still stains on the carpets at the doorways to each room. We've stayed at the excellent Ibis Styles in Glasgow so had reasonable expectations that the Kensington Ibis Styles would be in a similar condition. Sadly not. Won't be back to this hotel.

title: The smallest hole that was called a room ever
text: I stayed here in a single room and that was the smallest room I have ever seen. It's roughly 6 square meters including the bath...hmmm...cabin. The height is less than 2 meters. The furniture is broken, the bathroom is rusty. It's very far away from 3 stars. It would be a nice hostel but nothing else.

title: Fantastic Accomodation and Customer Service
text: Stayed here for four nights and can’t speak highly enough of this Accomodation. We arrived early and Diana assisted us with an early check in. Diana was helpful and went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable and we had everything we needed. The Earls Court tube station is at the end of the road which is only a 3 minute walk and there are many restaurants and pubs within walking distance.

title: Simple and Good
text: The hotel is located in a quiet street, very near tube and bus stations and with much shops and restaurants in the streets around. The only negative thing is the noise we eared for the other rooms and from the air conditioning system. Nevertheless this hotel has really good value for the money.

title: place to sleep
text: good location to a tube station, clean bed with very basic room. No thrills with this room. very small room, I wouldn't want to stay to many nights. All in one soap,shampoo etc very hard to get out of the bottle, no hairdryer. handle coming off the door. not sure what was going on with the one cup of tea they allow you, once poured looked very unpleasant. not sure if it was the water, cup or kettle. undrinkable. I wouldn't bother paying for breakfast, a cooked breakfast is available but the staff won't tell you that. As an Accor member I've stayed in several Ibis hotels and this one lets them down.

title: Another work stay
text: Hotel was clean & tidy but the room I stayed in was freezing the heating didn't work & when reported the considers just gave me the classic garlic shrug & shrugged her shoulders............ Breakfast layout was confusing on arrival but fine when explained but checkout was quick! Best part of that nights stop.

title: Well-located budget solution
text: London is a city where hotels are expensive. This hotel is a good budget solution if you want to be centrally located. Right next to Earl's Court station. Don't expect much from the breakfast, you'll find the basics to get the day starting.

title: Very handy to Earls Court Tube Station
text: I stayed at this hotel for one week. As an older women travelling alone I found it a very friendly and safe place to stay. Room 320 was small, clean and comfortable. It had a great view of the street scape. The T.V. and air conditioning worked well. I left early most mornings to sight see. The staff provided me with a take-a -way breakfast. I found the staff were very friendly and helpful. The fact that it is situated close to the tube station made it easy coming from Heathrow airport and handy for seeing the sights all over London. Thanks for making my stay a joyful one. Marie W. Canada

title: Dinky rooms, but everything you need.
text: The hotel is probably no more than 200metres away from the exit of the Earls Court tube station, (and a good selection of restaurants) which is brilliant when you are lugging about a suitcase (or lots of shopping). The reception is clean and tidy with a bar to the side (which we didn't utilise so I can't tell you about the prices). The reception staff were friendly and the service was spot on. We had a room on the 2nd floor with a window overlooking the road which is quite residential so no noise. The room is bijou in size, but we had 2 single beds, a beside table, a TV, kettle, a small open cupboard with 2 shelves, another pedestal desk that could be moved over either bed, an open wardrobe style hanger and a small seat that I used to put my small case on. The 'parrot on a bicycle' full wall mural was very entertaining. The bathroom again is bijou, but has a sink, toilet and proper shower and enough space to dry yourself (I'm almost 6 foot tall so this space is important when you don't want to flash your bits at your friend). The beds are comfy and clean. There is FREE wi-fi, but it isn't the fastest when everyone is up, but I found that in the night time it was better. The breakfast is continental style with cereals, fruit, toast, various meat slices (the mainland Europeans like this, but meat at breakfast is just not the English way so I stayed away from it), juice, tea & coffee and I think there were pastry bits, like croissants etc.(but I'm not sure on those). We weren't getting a train back until 11pm at night, but you have to vacate the room at 12 noon (very reasonable we thought), so we asked if we could leave our bags, and they are happy to. They give you a ticket, and they have a secure room, and they don't charge extra for this :) . The surrounding area is Kensington, and The Natural History and the V&A Museums can be walked to in approx. 10-15 minutes, and if you carry on walking another 10 mins you'll get to Harrods. If you are looking for the perfect London hotel for 2 or 3 days then this is perfect, if you were planning a long trip with quite a bit of luggage then you may find the rooms a little too limited in size. I would book this hotel again in a heartbeat, and am planning to in the very near future.

title: Disgraceful customer service
text: Working in an event organisation we tend to stay in a number of hotels around London throughout the year, and I have never had such terrible customer service. All rooms are advertised with a hair dryer - therefore I assumed there would be a hair dryer in the room. I woke up at 6am washed my hair and realised that I was lacking a hair dryer. I rang down to reception to ask them to bring me one up. I was told they would look for one and ring me back. 6.15am no call back - therefore I rang down again. This time I was told by the same guy that he won't be able to look for one until 7.30am when housekeeping arrive. I explained the situation and that I would be leaving the hotel at 7.20am for a business conference therefore I needed a hairdryer immediately. He just said they can't do anything until half 7 and put the phone down. Third time I rang down to ask if there was any rooms free that they could get me a hairdryer from - again nothing. At this point I couldn't wait any longer so went on my own adventure to find a hairdryer from another room. Kindly another hotel guest lent me theirs when I explained the situation. Between me finding a hairdryer and going back to my room I saw at least 3 people going down to reception - I assume checking out. I didnt ring down and see but waited to see if the receptionist was kind enough to get me a hairdresser from another room, again nothing. When checking out I wasn't greeted just asked for my key and they didn't even ask if I had a pleasant stay - which I certainly did not! Being a central London hotel, having business clients staying I do not see how they can not manage to have necessities available 24/7.

title: Great for the price
text: We stayed in this hotel this week for a trip to the Royal Albert Hotel which is a 10 minute walk away and opposite Gloucester Road tube station. The room we were in had been recently refurbished and was extremely comfortable. The staff were really pleasant and helpful. We had to leave early morning and couldn’t make breakfast, which was included in the price. We told the reception and when we checked out at 6am there was packed lunches for us. For the price we were very impressed with this hotel which is in a great location.

title: Overpriced for the level of comfort
text: Well, £ 117,50 for this room is a bit extreme. OK, it's in London, but it's in Earl's Court, not the fashionable / central areas. At that price, you would expect the rooms to be clean and modern - which they are not. You would expect to be able to shave without your backside hitting the wall due to the narrowness of the bathroom. You would expect that a switched-off aircon unit does not wake you up several times during the night with a very large vibration sound. You would expect to be able to walk round the bed without having to walk sideways. You would expect the soap over the bathroom sink to be filled and to work. OK, perhaps I should have complained at the time but I was dead tired. Not to be recommended, and a demonstration that the "Accor Group" is not always a badge of quality.

title: Solo trip to London for business
text: Just what I required cheap, simple, very clean and very handy. 2 mins from Earls Court tube with plenty of food possibilities literally on the door step. Staff were very courteous and helpful. I was expecting a single but was given a double. Room was very clean and comfortable and the quiet surroundings ensured a great night sleep. Breakfast was good with plenty of selection,toast, cereals, yoghurts, cold meats, pastries and juice, tea and coffee. Quick and easy check-in and check out. Well done Ibis Styles!

title: The Worst hotel I have ever stayed at.
text: An item of clothing went "missing" from our hotel room whilst my sister and I were on an all day tour. It was left folded on the ottoman at 8.00am and no longer on the ottoman upon our return at 3.00pm. Our belongings looked like they had been riffled through. On top of that, when we arrived we were accidentally given the key to another room (still occupied!), the aircon only worked on warm air (in summer). Plus our drains smelled badly in the bathroom.

title: Useful addition to the Ibis portfolio in London
text: As other reviews have observed this is a very new hotel, which has clearly experienced some work-up problems. Most of these seemed to have been resolved by the time I arrived, although I might have been less happy with the difficulty in controlling the room temperature if London had not been so mild. There was a warm welcome from reception and the efficiency and friendliness of the staff team were commendable. Moving through the hotel, there is still the smell of fresh paint in the corridors and the place has a bright feel. The rooms are small but sufficient for an overnight business trip and the en suite is compact even by Ibis standards. Guests of my height will have some difficulty in fitting onto the toilet. Breakfast is continental and served in a room that feels a little like a refectory but does at least mean that guests can sit at a proper table. I am not sure how well it would serve people with disabiliities - there are several steps at the street entrance and no indication as to how anyone with mobility issues would gain access. I noted the same problem recently at another Ibis Styles in Edinburgh and it does suggest that the chain does not take this matter as seriously as UK law would seem to require. The neighbourhood is interesting and rapidly gentrifying with some nice small restaurants. Would I come back? At current prices, it is a better deal than the Ibis at Euston, which is more expensive and has a less convenient breakfast space, although the rooms are a better size and the en suite pods offer a superior bathroom experience. It has better transport connections than Southwark but I think I prefer the ambience of Aldgate, although there are fewer dining options around there. However, I shall certainly keep this one on the list.

title: Very hip, but disappointing
text: I decided to try a new hotel in the Earl's Court area, and I chose this property. I've been disappointed from the moment I walked in the door. It's hip, happening, very modern and stark. The hotel website said check-in is at 2P (14H). I arrived around noon, stored my luggage, and returned to go to my room at 2P (14H). I finally was given a key at 3P (15H). Cesare, the desk clerk, was quite nice and helpful, but the delay was inexcusable. The room is miniscule, tiny with no place for luggage. There is one towel, one tiny plastic glass, and no room to turn around. This is quite different from the hotel photos on the website. I feel deceived. The website does not function well. It's slow, slow, slow, and you can never upload or download anything, much less look at your FaceBook. They advertise their internet access everywhere in the hotel, but it DOESN'T WORK properly. Finally, the breakfast room is more like a train station than a dining room. It's cramped, poorly set up and push, pull, shove and grab. If I had not prepaid for this room, I would have been gone by now. What a disappointment!

title: Nice, warm and welcoming hotel
text: The location was ideal for shopping in Central London. Rooms lovely and service was good. All staff were friendly and very helpful. Loved the colours and butterfly's in the reception area!! Would definately stay again.!!

title: Mr
text: Excelent! A very gentle reception, breakfast OK, and a .perfect localization in London! The underground is very next - it’s easy to take it if you want to go to museums, Trafalgar Square, Pically and Heathrow! It's a quiet street, and easy to find restaurants , banks, drugstores etc.

title: Simple details makes the difference
text: Not happy the way I have been treated by reception. I hope you do not take the rooms which are in the attached and cold building. Breakfast is great and people which work down there are also great. Very small and cold room. Toilette even small, window entering cold wind, shower not working properly. Maintenance stuff in the middle of the corridor, not settle or organized.

title: Consistently great service
text: This is my second review for the Ibis Styles Kensington but on the basis I stay there one to two nights most weeks I thought it was only fair! Unlike a lot of other hotels in this price bracket you are assured consistently great service from the staff as well as high levels of cleanliness and comfort within the rooms. I would like to especially mention staff members Florin and Diana who are both incredibly helpful and for whom nothing is ever too much trouble.

title: Best choice for a trip to London
text: This was not my first visit to London but this was definitely my best choice of a hotel. The hotel has a superb location especially for those arriving on the Heathrow airport. It took me about 40 minutes to get from the airport to the hotel as it was only a few minutes walk from the Earl's court underground station ( and 2,80 GBP cost or transfer :-) ). The hotel was a lovely mixture of traditional exterior and modern interior. Staff was nice, friendly and everything was ready for my check-in. Room was in perfect condition- EXTREMELY clean, air conditioning well functioning, Wi-Fi fast enough. There was simply nothing to complain about. Breakfast was tasty, really loved the espresso machine as i had never had such a coffee before in other hotels. I can only say two words to the staff- WELL DONE! The management of the hotel has really done a good job!

title: Ibis Styles made our stay in London amazing!
text: Ibis Styles hotel made my partner and my stay in London extremely comfortable. The location is walking distance to Earls Court tube station and is in central London where walking to places like Hyde Park or the National History Museum is made easy. It is also located near simple facilities like a grocery store and a launderette. The interior design of Ibis is very modern with a tinge of simplicity. The beds were incredibly comfortable and provided with a comfortable rest every night after a heavy day of sightseeing. They had staff whom are extremely helpful. We lost our credit card and they did all they could to help us locate it and return it to our possession. Our room was cleaned efficiently and effectively. And the continental breakfast provided daily was simple yet delightful. We highly recommend Ibis especially to first timers visiting London and we would definitely come back to Ibis should we return to London.

title: Always my choice
text: Very nice design. . Clean and nice rooms. Friendly staff , variety at breakfast, I love the croissants! ! Always is my choice in London! 2 minutes walk from earls Court station , near centre! ! I love the location

title: Comfortable at Earl's Court
text: Small room but very comfortable bed and super fast and free WiFi. Excellent heating throughout. As is the case in similar central London small hotels you can hear the other room if your neighbors watch tv and/or speak in the corridor but the fourth floor was very quiet from midnight to 7am. The free breakfast is not amazing (it never is in London) but there is an option to pay 3.50GBP and get a hearty full English breakfast or a vegetarian breakfast with eggs that is really good value and certainly worth it. You can't beat the location - 30 seconds walk to Earl's Court Underground Station that takes you to Heathrow Airport in 35 minutes, Paddington in 8 minutes etc. Staff is friendly and professional. The only slight downside is that the 'gym' is in fact a couple of exercise bikes, no weights. The TV channels are also limited (you can only watch BBC. The few other channels that did exist had very bad signal or no signal at all.

title: Earls Court Ibis Style-less
text: I am accustomed to Ibis Styles hotels, but this was really something else. For business on budget, and short notice they are good- usually. But this time, I really found the room exceptionally small, and wifi code was not provided, I had to ask, then it was some weird page for conference codes, whatever. OK it was ready and clean, but just functional...walls were paper thin, had to use ear-plugs. Trying to check in and check out was really crazy, the staff just don't care how long your there and waiting...the place is swamped with tourists, so its impossible for them to serve people in a hurry. Otherwise location is very good, which is what I needed on this trip, but I wont stay there again, because trying to sleep with the doors constantly opening and shutting is like being in haunted house!

title: Great location
text: Love the location easy walk form Tube station and then we had a 20 min walk to the Royal Albert Hall in the evening and walked back after the concert through a safe neighbourhood. The room is simple and neat , tight on space but we were only stopping one night. The breakfast was very good for London hotels a good deal for a cooked breakfast which set us up for the day of Christmas shopping. It was exactly what we needed for this stay, great value and great location. Would use it again for short stay.

title: Great base for London visit.
text: A 5 minute walk from Earls Court tube station with its easy access to all parts of London and surroundings. Based in a converted Georgian mansion, the hotel offers good, if quite simple facilities. The room size is quite adequate as is the bathroom. Beds are very comfortable. There is a basement breakfast room which serves a nice continental breakfast if required. Staff are friendly and helpful and the premises are clean. Being in a side road off the local main streets, the hotel is quiet. There are tea making facilities in the bedrooms. There is a small bar on the ground floor. There is a lift to all floors. The surrounding area is pleasant with small restaurants and pubs very near. Earls Court high street has all the shops and stores you might need. The only real criticism is that the bath has no slip mats nor wall grab handles which is a serious safety concern, and it really does need new carpets. Otherwise, the hotel is a good budget choice in an excellent location for a London visit.

title: great frontage not so good in bedrooms
text: Stayed here for one night on business got there about 7 30pm driven for 7 hours tired great looking frontage cannot say the same about the bedroom its the smallest twin bedroom in any hotel I have ever stayed in and I don't exaggerate bathroom was as bad and stunk did not take a shower noise all night from aircon really bad think we got the worse room in the Hotel for the money never go there again had no time to swap rooms but did report problems in the morning just got sorry good location very good breakfast

title: A Great Hotel with a funky feel.
text: A lovely hotel in a great location. Excellent Customer service especially from Diana in Reception. Excellent themed rooms with air con which is essential with the current weather and a great continental breakfast. 👍

title: Great location
text: Hotel was in a great Location, so close to the tube station but quiet enough to sleep. We had a Lovely stay, there is a lot of eateries and bars close by too. The hotel was very clean, staff were very friendly and the continental breakfast had plenty options, we ate a lot 😂. The only flaw was the tiny bedroom, no space for a wardrobe, so we had to hang your clothes on a rail beside the tv, no space for our cases so we kept tripping over them. Just as well we weren’t “big” as you wouldn’t fit the through the folding bathroom door 😄 but it didn’t spoil or trip

title: Pretentious, poor value - doesn't deserve one star.
text: Those of us who don't live in London are often amazed to hear the prices that Londoners pay to live in a shoebox - and those clever people at Ibis have come up with a chance for us to experience this at first hand. That's the only explanation I can come up with for this travesty of a hotel, a place where they apparently managed to carve an extra 16 rooms out of the previous residence by creating spaces that simply don't work. So you get stairs in the middle of rooms, spaces that serve no purpose, rooms that open onto stairs... and be warned, when I use the word 'rooms' I am being generous. Cupboards might be more appropriate. Indeed, I have friends with built in wardrobes bigger than the room we stayed in last night. But don't worry, because those clever people at Ibis have also ensured there is large lettering on the walls telling you facts. Two thirds of the earth's surface is covered in ocean. Yes, This apparently makes this a 'boutique' hotel. We had to telephone reception at 11.30pm to ask how we turned off the green lights in our room. We were told we couldn't because these lights 'were required under law'. They were fitted in 'all accor hotels'. No-one could tell me which law or why this was the first accor hotel I had found with such lights. Maybe because this was the first accor hotel that had a redundant set of steps in the room down which you might fall during the night. But don't worry - if you insist, they'll send a technician to deactivate the lights. Breakfast was dreadful and the staff on morning reception couldn't even be bothered to ask if we'd had a good stay. Maybe because they knew what the answer would be. Their colleagues had privately admitted to us that the design was a disaster. I must have stayed in around 40-50 accor hotels over the years. The worst two have been Ibis Styles. A rubbish brand.. Avoid it and go to the 'normal' Ibis at Euston/Kings Cross, which uses the space better and remembers that the important thing is looking after people not telling them how much of the earth's surface Is covered in water.

title: Great location not a bad hotel
text: This is a convenient location. Hotel rooms are small for 2 people. Try to book a triple. Staff is friendly and helpful. Management should put time into training staff in giving directions. We were given wrong directions. Hotel needs some maintenance. Thanks to Andrea who helped us fix our door. If the price is comparatively good I'd stay again.

title: Great hotel for a London base
text: I stayed here for 5 nights, great location, really close to central tube station, and shops/restaurants nearby. The room was on the ground floor, right next to reception, so I was a little worried about noise, as was facing onto the street as well. But the area was really quiet, even at the weekend. Room was a good size for 2 people, bathroom was very small, but standard for London. Breakfast was ok, nothing special, usual cereal, tinned fruit. yoghurt, tea/coffee etc. We did have some issues with our room key, it didn't work a few days, so we had to keep going back to reception to get it reset which got a bit annoying.

title: Disappointing
text: Good location for Earls Court Underground but that was about all. Rooms were small was just enough room to walk around bed and cold.. Bathroom freezing towel rail not working complained but nothing done. Our friends room was worse bed up against wall and if you were on the large side you would not be able to go to the bathroom cos the door stopped halfway against the foot of bed, there was no floor space was on about three different levels and like an assault course.Breakfast you were lucky to get a seat and staff were unhelpful and the food was whisked away before you even finished. Would not stay here again.

title: Helpful staff. Nice spacious room
text: Florin and Diana, the two staff on reception were particularly helpful. Because of their friendly manner we would definitely come back. Location a couple of minutes from the tube is great. Easy access to South Kensington on foot and by tube to everywhere else Enough shops nearby Quiet location away from the main road

title: If you don't have to then just don't
text: I believe I wouldn't be able to write this review if i was still in my tiny 227 room, i would have been stuck. The staff are friendly, willing to help. however, since i was in a weekend period i was given room 227 that i will always remember which half of it is stairs then a bed which wasn't clean enough (had stains) TV very close to your pillow with bad lighting (only one switch to have all lightened up as if you are in a party or live in complete darkness). The breakfast was really bad as well even the croissant was burnt.. I am really disappointed as well since there was ongoing maintenance i believe where starting from 7 am Saturday morning I heard a lot of hammer being used ..

title: Perfect
text: Some are hard to please and love to moan, some of the reviews are so petty..nothing wrong with this place, clean, great location, friendly staff, nice rooms, hot shower..what more you wanting from a budget hotel? Some folk pay budget and expext The Savoy..overall 10/10

title: Would definitely stay again
text: Stayed at the Ibis Styles Kensington with a friend in the same business as me. We were in London to attend a conference and decided to turn our trip into a mini 1 night break! The Ibis Styles Kensington is in a great location a few hundred metres from Earls Court underground. Plenty of pubs and restaurants in the immediate vicinity. We were greeted by very friendly faces at the front desk. The room, whilst small, was clean and served its purpose. Breakfast ample choice. Overall it is a friendly, clean, straightforward choice with an easy-going vibe in a convenient spot and I would definitely choose to stay here again

title: Good location and nice rooms
text: Stayed at the ibis styles for 5 nights and enjoyed it. It is a 2min walk to Earls court underground with access to the Piccadilly and District line. This means you can head straight from/to Heathrow airport without changing trains and also straight into Piccadilly Circus, Notting Hill Gate etc, which was super convenient. The beds were comfy and shower pressure was great. Heating was also good although it took a bit to heat the room up. The staff at the front desk and very friendly and always very happy so thank you to all of them. I requested gluten free bread and they were also able to accommodate which was nice. Breakfast was also great. Only disappointment was that they did not match the price of other hotels in the area. I did ask as it would have been easier to stay at the same hotel and not have to move, however once they advised no I did some research. The hotel next door was 40pounds cheaper and had a fridge and microwave and a safe in the room so that seemed like the better option. The area of Earls Court is culturally diverse with Thai, Italian, Lebanese and Indian food all along the main road as well as a mega sainsburys on cromwell road and a smaller one on earls court road. With Lloyds Bank, KFC, McDonalds, Pret a manger, Burger King, Boots, Marks and Spencer, Co-operative and Holland and Barrett all on the main road it is truly a perfect location.

title: Good hotel - just not really friendly and tiny rooms.
text: We arrived at this hotel about 15 minutes before check in time. We were quite surprised that they refused to let us check in slightly early. The staff seemed annoyed that we were even there which I found odd. But we thought no worries, they checked our bags at the front desk and we went off to a delightful pub for lunch down the road. Upon our return, we checked in and went up to our rooms. I knew the rooms were small, but I was unprepared for exactly how small. I could not open my suitcase unless it was on the bed or on the floor half under the bed. There was one small shelf that might fit a backpack or shoulder bag, but not a suitcase. (without falling off onto the bed). The shower smells a bit off, and if you are not fit, you will touch the sides or door. Not very pleasant. The free breakfast was acceptable. It wasn't a bad stay - not a warm and friendly stay. I was there for only 2 days so I just made the best of it.

title: Not impressed
text: very poor.... Reception staff not very helpful.... Would be easier if someone on there could speak English. Was waiting for a drink at the bar about 8 mins (reception in touching distance) while 2 staff stood chatting had to ask twice for drinks . Then no ice to go in the drinks. The rooms are tiny & the shower even smaller. Superman would even have a problem. Banging started at 8am today (Saturday morning) on the major building work that is being done. No mention of this when booking. Also very loud at night when trying to sleep at least a 3 inch gap under door so lights on & off all night in the corridor lighting the room up.Would not stay here again or recommend to anyone. Not cheap either. Very disgruntled couple 😐

title: Clean! Clean! Clean!
text: My daughter and I stayed at this hotel on 19 May and 20 May 2015 whilst visiting the Chelsea Flower Show! We loved it and although our room was not very big it was spotlessly clean and the beds were very comfortable! Continental Breakfast with a very good choice,was provided and was served in a clean and airy dining room !! Staff in the hotel were very efficient and friendly! Only downside was an inefficient WFI,it worked better in reception/ bar area! NB The hotel was a 2 minute walk to the Underground Station!

title: Somewhere a bit different in London Kensington
text: I have stayed a couple of times now at the Ibis styles in Kensington. It is based in Hogarth Road, a short walk from Earls Court tube station. The road is one way so tends to be lovely and quiet. The hotel looks like 4 or 5 townhouses knocked together so is a bit quirky. The rooms are based around London locations and are simply but comfortably furnished. Suits me down to the ground as I hate cluttered rooms. Small bathrooms but good showers and everything you need. Comfy beds. Basic hanging space but perfectly adequate for a few days stay and better than some I have stayed in! Quiet, clean, good location nice buffet breakfast, small bar and friendly staff. What more can you ask for. Will be staying again soon.

title: Save the money and go elsewhere
text: The most expensive out of the 3 ibis hotels I used this trip. Funnily enough the worst quality. The rooms are tiny and the bathroom even smaller. There was a funky smell in our room, both reading lamps were broken and the air conditioner made an awful sound. On the plus side, it is extremely close to the underground (district and Piccadilly lines). I wouldn't return here. Also, the first hotel ever around the world that has wanted a copy of my passport. When questioned staff stated it was law. When I questioned further after staying at other ibis and ibis styles this trip in the UK I could just write down the number...

title: I forgot my iPad in the room and cannot get it back!!!!
text: I have been stayed in the hotel, room no. 002, during 5th - 7th Mar and I found out that I forget my iPad in the room after we checked out. On 7th Mar evening, I called the hotel many times, first time to check if there's anything found in the room - the answer is the housekeeper is out so she asked me to call again tomorrow, second time which I'm sure that my iPad was left there (using find my iphone application) - the answer is nothing was found. So, my iPad was lost in the hotel and I cannot get it back. It's really terrible to face this issue during my holidays. I won't stay in Accor hotels anymore and sure to tell all of my friends about this!!!!

title: Terrible staff, will never return!!
text: As a member of the Accor group for 5 years, this has to be one of the worst experience. First check in, staff were not professional, 3 of them chit chatting in front of me while I stand there to check in. Room was a tiny box, the wall is that thin I could actually hear they guy next room heavy breathing, (not snoring). Then house keepers burst into the room at 7.30, while another one banging the wall with the Hoover at 8am!! Staff were not helpful throughout my stay!

title: Cold room
text: What makes me choose "Average" in stead of "Very Good" Is that our room was ice cold in spite of our complains three days in a row. The location of the hotel was very good 200 m from the Pickadilly Line. The rooms were small but accepatable. Breakfasts were also of good quality but could have been a little more English with for instance bacon and egg. xxxxxxx

title: Fair choice
text: This hotel is a good option if you are budget constraint. It is far from everything. But the price is very convenient. I will use it again if I face similar business trip requirements. The service and the rooms are okay

title: 5 stars only for the staff
text: Nice little place the rooms are tiny but cosy. The staff are fantastic, very friendly helpful and up for a laugh. Now to the bed. ---Ibiz... please check all your beds, the one I had was so loud that I felt bad for the people below me event sitting on the bed granted it was the only place to sit. For my next stay I would love and I mean really take this to heart sleep on a bed that I also don't wake myself up with every turn I make during the night. Also I would kindly request to give your staff a increase in wages as they are a great team and each and every one of them are very and I mean very very polite. So I will look forward to my next stay with them.

title: Great location nice rooms
text: Great location. Just a few stations away from the shopping locations such as Oxford and regent street. Two minutes walking distance from earls court underground station. Moreover that station is on the Piccadilly line which makes it even more easy to go to the airport and to the city centre. The room is nicely decorated and a very nice air condition which I can set it to the temperature I prefer and not like the other hotels where they have a centralized heating and not everyone prefer to sleep in a warm room even though it's winter season. The check in is quick, wifi speed is great and they even have a luggage storage service. The ibis bed quality is just perfect. One bad thing is the smell of the hotel. Once I enter the lobby it smelled so dull and damp. It's like wet carpets that are not properly cleaned or the floors are cleaned with a smelly mop.

title: Does exactly what it says on the tin
text: Stayed here with my eleven year old son, yes rooms are small but good value for this area of London and it was so handy just being two mins walk from tube. Staff very friendly. Loads of restaurants short walk away (two mins) and walking distance to museums. Loved the arty feel to the rooms. We were in an adjoining room and you could hear the neighbours clearly coughing and talking but it didn't impact on our sleep luckily. There isn't really a proper bar or restaurant but as somewhere clean to lay your head it was great. Breakfast was included, continental. Lovely coffee and selection of foods including fruit, yoghurt, pastries, cheeses, cereals and bread. Wifi worked well.

title: Three nights
text: As with other reviews we found the room quite small however everything else was fine. Close to underground nice area breakfast good staff very nice. Would stay here again just a shame the rooms are to small for the fantastic beds

title: Good location.
text: Extremely small room, not particularly well maintained, or comfortable. Confusing floor layout that I would be very concerned about in an evacuation situation. It wasn't helped by the hallways lack of natural lighting or signage. Basic breakfast..Good WIFI speed. Good location and friendly staff.

title: small but not perfectly formed
text: Arrived 40 minutes before check in time but decided to wait as my sister and I were going to the Ideal Home Show. With 10 minutes to go I asked if our room was ready yet (booked 6 weeks prior). After speaking to her colleague in a foreign language I was told they were trying to find me one. The room was lovely. Very spacious, clean but there was nowhere to put your clothes except for 5 coat hangers(we were staying for 3 days). The bathroom was very nice also with a large shower but nowhere to put your toiletries. Unfortunately, when we got back to the room in the evening the shower room was covered in water. We contacted reception and we're given the keys to a very small room, which we declined. Towels were put on the floor of our 1st room to mop the water up. The next day we arrived back very late (99 to be told we would have to move rooms as they could not fix the shower which had leaked. We were put on the 3rd floor (previously on the 2nd), the lift had broken so we had to walk up the stairs with our luggage. We asked for help carrying our luggage but was told no one was available, (we are both in our 60s). This room was smaller but the bathroom! The sink was very small and you walked into it when you opened the door. How this hotel passed health and safety and fire regulations I don't know. Lots of staircases leading to nowhere. On the plus side it is very clean in a good location and the staff friendly. Decor is not to my liking, very modern, with huge murals on the bedroom walls. Will not stay there again. Was not offered a discount for our inconvenience either. Also, lots of building work going on.

title: Excellent hotel in London
text: Very friendly staff. The hotel amenities are of excellent quality. Highly recommended. The hotel is just one block from Paddington station and 5 minutes walk to Hyde Park. Nice breakfast to start the day.

title: Stunning
text: We stayed here after winning afternoon tea through the park grand hotels group. This hotel has recently been refurbished and upon walking into the beautiful reception area we were treated with warm towels and fresh orange juice. Once checked in we made our way to q club double room The room was clean, tidy and spacious with fruit, wine and soft drinks. There was a mini bar too We enjoyed our afternoon tea with prosecco, chocolate afternoon tea with a gorgeous selection of sandwiches and chocolate scones and desserts. Breakfast was included and a buffet style selection was available, eggs and omelettes were cooked to order. The spaces in the hotel are beautiful and the staff really attentive. Would highly recommend this hotel. Parking is available outside and it is 5 minutes from Paddington station

title: Fantastic experience
text: I've stayed here loads of times, but this was the first time since the refit. Wow! from the first step into the hotel, it feels really 5 star. Wonderful staff who cannot do enough and a fantastic environment. The bedrooms are a delight - the beds unbelievably comfortable and plenty of toiletries and extras. I felt totally spoiled. The Chilworth really punches above its weight, five star experience in an intimate, boutique hotel. Location is ideal, just a few minutes walk from Paddington Station but in a quiet location.

title: Seamless five * amazing experience
text: The Chilworth was a fabulous awesome place to celebrate a special birthday tea. We were greeted so warmly and shown the utmost care. It was one of the best afternoon teas I have had ever! I really want to thank Anastasia for looking after us so well. I will return as soon as I can.

title: Chocolate High Tea
text: This was amazing. The setting was lovely and we had our own area. Decor was beautiful. Don't go here if you want views of London. We went to enjoy the sparling wine, choice of tea and delicous food. Were given hot towels and orange juice first before being shown to our table. We had a choice of four types of teas and sparling wine. The food came out on tiered stand and it had a chocolate theme. There were sandwhiches and a small bun followed by scone jam and clotted cream. Scones had chocolate bits in them Then to finish off mousse and delicate small cakes. Nothing was left and we thoroughly enjoyed it. Needed a long walk around the area (Paddington)afterwards😋😊

title: Excellent afternoon tea
text: Ok - I have to say we booked a groupon for the experience so it was insanely cheap and therefore we had low expectations, but I was so impressed! The hotel is very pretty and it looks really nice. The restaurant was beautiful with tables very well spaced out, despite the fact the dining room was busy it didnt' feel so. The restaurant is staffed very well. I don't like name dropping in reviews but I will in this instance, thanks to Laura and Cristina, you were great. The service is 5*. You won't get better service in fancier hotels. The waiters did everything perfectly. I am used to top up my afternoon tea with sparkling water (I detest tap water) and ordered it , but they would not charge me for it! Also they would not bill the tip at the end of the meal so left the place feeling guilty of how good everything was for the price! (I left change on the table for the tip, really deserved). Toilets nice,clean and staff nice and helpful pointing them out. Would go back in heartbeat for the groupon price.

title: Excellent place and service
text: The place is conveniently located walking distance from Paddington station. Rooms are in good shape with some technology gadgets for lighting and heat. Breakfast is fine. But what is really outstanding is the service. María, Alex, John, Francesco, they made every effort to make you feel comfortable. Extraordinary service. I made a mistake booking the room and they fixed everything when we arrived, printed our boarding passes at no cost (this may be simple but other places charge you for everything), they were all keen to help. Excellent place

title: Get’s the little details right
text: The room was small but very well presented and beautifully clean. All the amenities expected were present and the staff were attentive. The check-in was helped by complementary hot towel and fresh Orange Juice

title: Perfect for London Sightseeing & Shopping
text: So many reasons to love this little hotel! Here are just some of them: 1. Easy arrival from Heathrow into nearby Paddington station. 2. Nearby Paddington Underground station makes it easy to get around London 3. Nearby Paddington Station makes it easy to get out to Windsor/Eton and the tourist sights there. 4. Nearby restaurants are good and convenient if youre tired from a day of sightseeing and shopping. 5. Housekeeping does a great job. My room was always spotless. 6. The staff is VERY friendly and helpful

title: Best Stay
text: This was the best stay I've had in London. The hotel staff are extremely helpful and very courteous. Very clean and comfortable rooms. Highly recommend to stay here. The rooms are priced fairly well and their service is nothing less than a 5star.

title: Very good clean and modern hotel
text: Enjoyed our stay though the air con and lights took a few attempts to control Friendly staff. Good location 5 minutes from Paddington tube and not far from Lancaster Gate Big tv room small but good facilities

title: Good location
text: We spent two nights here while in London for a break, it’s a bit confusing when looking at pictures on trip advisor as the photos you show are not all for this hotel! We were welcomed with a hot towel and drink as we waited to check in which was a nice touch. The room was small but had all you could need and newly renovated. A nicely designed bathroom which was more spacious than the bedroom. Each evening we had a chocolate and gift left on the bed to return too. Included in the stay was continental breakfast, which had a nice choice of food, a cooked breakfast was available for a small price, although we had the cooked breakfast on the first morning at no charge. The hotels location is excellent being minutes from Paddington station and a short walk from Hyde Park, there is also plenty of places to eat within walking distance.

title: 2 Night Stay
text: Stayed for 2 nights, included breakfast. Reasonably priced for Paddingron. Room was very small for 2 people, almost couldn't walk round one side of the bed, bathroom also very small, partner had to dry himself in the room as not enough room in the bathroom. Good breakfast, location, clean and comfy bed.

title: Mrs
text: Beautiful and nice place , good and friendly welcome and tasty food . Plenty of time to enjoy the food and elegant atmosphere!!! We had and spa and was just great and relaxing! Bottle of bubbly wine cone just right in the end of all those tasty sandwiches and cookies! Thank you all for the nice time spend !

title: The Perfect Place to Stay Before a Flight the Next Morning From Heathrow
text: Unlike many airports, hotels near Heathrow are not very convenient, especially for Terminal 3, for early morning flights. The Chilworth London Paddington provides the perfect solution. It is a five minute walk from Paddington Station and the Heathrow Express with a 15 minute train ride to Heathrow. The staff at the hotel are very friendly and the rooms, while small, are modern, clean, well appointed with all of the conveniences. The room rates are very reasonable so it is a great value for the money as well. The hotel has its own restaurant and there are many restaurants in the area. It is the perfect place to stay! I highly recommend it.

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Stayed here last night in a deluxe single room. Lovely hotel with welcoming staff. Nice little touches like hot flannel and orange juice on arrival and courtesy call to check everything was ok with the room. The room itself was immaculate with modern bathroom. Would certainly stay here again and recommend to others.

title: A gem in the crowded scene of London Hotels
text: It was my first stay at the Chilworth London Paddington, and it definitely won't be the last. Since the first minutes, the pleasant welcoming assures you this is a kind of staff I didn't meet before although I'm very use to business travels and hotel in general and in the UK in particular. The issue is that here The Staff really care. The location is perfect for me. Less than 5 minutes walk from the Paddington station which is the center of my world while working with partners all over the UK. The room was perfect and very indulging. It was the last night of pretty tough travel, and I couldn't ask for a better place to stay.

title: From the moment we arrived
text: I booked online because of walking distance to train and wanted a little pampering after a rushed trip from oz for family reasons. Wheeling our luggage from Paddington we were greeted on the road in front of the hotel by a smiling face and willing porter who assisted us to the counter then presented an oj and hot refresher towel before we had checked in. When I enquired if the room had a bath the concierge, sensing my wifes exhaustion, immediately changed our room without question. The one night stay was absolutely superb and all staff exemplary.The website photos are exactly what you get. A feeling of luxury, comfort and peace. Even when I couldn't operate the plug in the bath the maintenance man was there in minutes to politely show me how to turn a dial. It had been a long day. Without question one of the most attentive and caring team of employees we have enjoyed. Thankyou for caring. We will stay longer next time.

title: Really nice hotel with those extra touches
text: On arrival our bags were carried from our waiting taxi into the hotel, we were presented with hot towels and juice whilst checking in. Our bags were then taken to our room for us.
