After our evening at the ritz we were greeted with little swans, petals and a birthday cupcake in our room. This is a beautiful hotel with staff going that extra mile. Good location for tube, short taxi journeys if you prefer which hotel staff are happy to arrange. I would most definitely stay again and would highly recommend to all.

title: Afternoon tea
text: Very good tea and food, excellent service. It is a bit out of the way but worth t - cute and individual. Attentive service who are happy to help with anything. Particularly enjoyed the sweet layer of the tea - some nice different items like chocolate mousse. Would recommend

title: Could not be better!
text: I stayed for 6 nights at the hotel, had a great experience! The location is awesome: behind Paddington station, surrounded by bars and restaurants, very close to the Hyde Park. I was a bit concerned about the street/station noise, but my room was pretty quiet. I got a street front room at the 5th floor. The service is the best, friendly and helpful staff. The room and premises are very clean. There is a small bar and restaurant at the ground floor with good food and drinks. Make your reservation now!

title: Indian Afternoon Tea - good value for money 💴
text: Today we had a surprise Indian afternoon tea for my mums 75th birthday for 10 people . It was excellent, arranged very well by all the staff, great ambience, tasty food, great drinks and great service. I would recommend this to all my friends and family, lovely warm welcoming hotel with parking facilities.

title: Location
text: Travelled up from Exeter and needed a place near Paddington for one night to get an 11:25am flight from Heathrow. 5 mins walk from Paddington Station. On arrival staff provided a warm face towel and a refreshing fruit drink. Very comfortable bed. Club room included complimentary fruit and red wine. Bathroom was small worked okay. Great selection of channels on the tv. Cost should have included breakfast (230 Pounds for one night). Enjoyed the use of the sauna and spa bath down in the basement.

title: Amazing Afternoon Tes
text: We visited The Chilworth with friends as a special treat and we weren’t disappointed. From the moment we arrived, we were made to feel welcome and looked after. Everyone was attentive and the food was delicious. I couldn’t fault it.

title: Afternoon tea at Chilworth Hotel
text: We went for the afternoon tea and spa. The service was good, it was what you would expect

title: Great little gem
text: Great service, good food and great location. What it lacks in size it more than makes up with friendly hotel staff and great, considerate service. Very comfortable rooms, great beds and well maintained too.

title: Spa and Afternoon Tea
text: A friend and I went for a spa package and afternoon tea for our birthday a few days ago, and we were amazed by the service. Joy attended to our every need, sang happy birthday to us and brought us a birthday cake too. I would definitely recommend this hotel, and would go back whenever I get the chance. Services and facilities are excellent, clean and of a high standard.

title: Afternoon Tea
text: Great value afternoon tea, which I found via Groupon. Nice selection of food and teas on offer, and generous portions. Exceptional service. Staff were very attentive and refilled our tea pots numerous times, which is important with all that food to eat! Lovely occasion.

title: An oasis of calm in the heart of London
text: By chance I cam across this hotel which is perfectly positioned five minute walk from London Paddington. It really is a haven which draws you in the moment you cross their threshold. A beautiful aroma welcomes you together with a hotel towel to wash off the grime of travel whether by car, train or on foot. Staff who genuinely welcome you and and ready to assist you with any aspect of your stay. Some of the rooms are compact however they do not feel small as they are designed to be comfortable for the single traveller.

title: just excellent!
text: from the time we arrived we were treated like royalty ! don’t change anything you were amazing ! we were not sure what to expect for the afternoon tea but everyone really enjoyed the entire experience

title: ‘A little Gem’
text: My wife’s birthday was made extra special by Connie & the team. Ideal for Paddington station, ideal for bst concerts in Hyde park, minutes from both. The deluxe room was fully equipped and a comfy bed. All the staff were fantastic,a lovely hotel. Would definitely recommend.

title: Rough start but ended Well
text: I found this hotel on Groupon, in order to check availability you have to call in, this feature isn't available on their website. I called them from 9am til 3pm and no one from the afternoon tea department called back or answered my email. I finally had to make a complaint in order to make an reservation which I found highly unprofessional for such a basic need. I had to talk to 3 people and send 2 emails in order for them to know the Birthday girls dietary needs (Hala) Only to find out when we got there that the meat is Hala, so the guys I spoke to gave me the incorrect information. When we got to the Hotel we were greeted with hot towels and had a lovely afternoon tea with a glass of bubbly. Very Nice dinning area and the serving staff were soo nice offering to take picture for us and topping up our teas and waters. My friend had a lovely Birthday and i'm happy this was her first experience of a Afternoon Tea. I would have given you a 5 start if it wasn't for the poor booking service.

title: Great Last Night in UK
text: My family needed a place to stay for our last night in London before catching an early train to Heathrow. My daughter saw the hotel on line and we booked. From the time we entered until we checked out, we were impressed by the staff, the accommodations, and all the extra touches. A great find and a perfect place for lasting memories.

title: Not very well managed
text: We stayed in this hotel recently, it's not a bad location being just around the corner from Paddington station. We had two rooms booked for the stay of two nights. We arrived very early paid for the rooms and dropped our bags off, we knew the rooms wouldn’t be ready before arrival so not faulting anything here. Later that evening we arrived back at the hotel and picked up our key cards. A staff member whom seemed to be more senior than person who give us the key cards warned us about the step into the room. We thought nothing of this but realised when we opened the doors of both rooms there was a staircase down into the room. One of the rooms was filthy the carpet needed cleaned and what made it worse there was a half-eaten apple sitting on the dressing table. The cleaners had the whole day to get this room ready and the apples were part of the service so how this could be missed is worrying. When we asked at the reception before leaving to go out for a meal about when the bar closed, the receptionist was a bit confused if it was even opened as she said they have staffing issues. But again, the same staff member who mentioned about the “steps” said it’s opened until 11 quite promptly, correcting the receptionist. That night we returned to the bar and the barman who was working seemed like he didn’t know anything about the job he was trying to do. He mentioned this was his first night. Very poor on management to leave someone untrained on their own like this. The guy clearly didn’t drink as the sprits he poured was full glasses rather than measures. Another couple that was in the bar had similar issues ordering drinks. When we got home after our stay, we noticed payment was taken out of the card used to book the hotel under. After spending the better part of the day then trying to get this sorted they finally admitted to their mistake and refunded the money. Our overall experience of this hotel is that the management clearly don’t care, and this travels down to the staff working there. Also, the rooms and bathrooms are tiny, the pictures of the rooms are taken in such a way to dramatically improve the size they look.

title: Pretty Chill
text: Stayed there recently in September . Its a really nice hotel , pretty fancy in fact. The design of the room and the lightning in the room was pretty high tech. The staff was courteous . I liked the color coordination and decoration of the halls.The buffet breakfast was amazing.It is near the paddington subway station which makes things a lot easier . The bar could be little bit better but I was truly amazed by this hotel, definitely coming back again .Say hi to guy with sore tooth for me :)

title: Afternoon Tea and glass of bubbly
text: Had a fantastic time at the Chilworth Hotel. Celebrated my 25th birthday with my sisters and cousins, it was a lovely afternoon. The staff were so politie and attentive! The afternoon tea was delicious and the glass of bubbly was a bonus. The staff even bought out a happy birthday cupcake as a surprise. Anything we needed they provided. Would highly recommend. The groupon offer I found was a bargain for what we were given! Thank you Chilworth hotel.

title: Afternoon tea
text: One of the nicest afternoon tea we experienced so far. We were greeted so warmly and welcomed in and given hot towels (most welcomed after traveling the tube) we were then taken promptly to be seated. Decor is beautiful and feels very relaxing. I was pleasantly surprised to hear they have halal options, and was also given a refreshing mocktail instead of champagne. Food was delicious and very filling. Their customer care however stood out to us the most, excellent service from the moment we walked in to when we left, even packed us two of the cakes which we couldn't finish. I would highly recommend the chilworth hotel, even my husband who doesn't usually like going for afternoon teas thoroughly enjoyed it and is eager to return.

title: Perfect location and perfect place to relax
text: Everything was really nice in this hotel! The bedroom, besides being a bit small. for one person fit perfectly. Bathroom was spacious. The room had a really big LCD and was equipped with everything one needs! There were a lots of pillows in the bed, which is very nice for us to choose from. The air condition is really silent! the room also had heated floor. There was a nice desk were one could work really nicely. the breakfast was really good. Eggs are cooked on the spot! Everything is really clean and the staff is really friendly! Negative feedback: The hotel does not accept Maestro. The view from the room was not nice.

title: Cannot fault this hotel
text: From the second we arrived the staff were very friendly without being at all overbearing, we were asked where we would like to sit, offered alternatives to tea and made to feel very special indeed. The selection of food was very good and possibly the best egg sandwich I had ever eaten! It is worth mentioning that we used a Groupon offer but did not receive any less level of service and even the bubbly included was good quality. We had a fabulous time and cannot recommend this hotel and their afternoon tea enough.

title: Miss
text: Absolutely fantastic, attentive service and very helpful. Value for money was amazing. Lovely staff , brilliant food, would definitely recommend. Location was good not far from Paddington station. Very good experience

title: Afternoon tea at The Chilworth
text: We had an amazing time, the service was awesome from taking our coats before we started through to being served the tea and bubbly. The afternoon tea itself was one of the best I’ve had in London, the sandwich’s and cakes were delicious and there was so much food! I will definitely be back again!

title: Anniversary Weekend
text: My husband and I had a lovely stay this weekend in this hotel. All of the staff were very friendly and helpful. We stayed in a club double room which was perfect and the shower was amazing. Ideal location to Paddington Station. We would like to thank all staff for making it such a special 1st wedding anniversary for us. We hope to visit again soon.

title: A charming tea and really great servcie
text: We were there for a traditional tea it was good and plentiful and the service was excellent - well recommended We were seated straight away and the hot towels on arrival are a great touch. Each member of staff was friendly and the food served was very good.

title: Ice cream Afternoon tea with spa
text: The chilworth hotel is a place I would recommend with the most perfect atmosphere, excellent staff and service throughout. The spa was so relaxing includes a steam room too and pool too. The afternoon tea was declious filled with different treats perfect way to celebrate my birthday.

title: Lovely afternoon tea for girlfriend's birthday
text: I've never experienced afternoon tea and I thought it would be great to experience one with my girlfriend on her birthday at the Chilworth. I chose to book the chocolate afternoon tea and it was faultless. The gf was super impressed also - in fact, out of all the afternoon teas she's been to, she mentioned this was the best one. The service was great, venue was clean and well put together, and to be honest there was nothing I could complain about. I'd highly recommend!

title: Pleasant stay at The Chilworth Paddington
text: Excellent hotel, friendly staff, very comfy bed, nice interior. I had a very pleasant stay (wish I could have stayed longer!). The room is very spacious and has a nice design. Location is perfect, 5-10 min walk to Paddington train station & tube underground.

title: Delicious afternoon tea
text: Lovely and delicious chocolate afternoon tea - All the sandwiches and desserts were so fresh that I can tell they were made on the day. The champagne was fantastic too. The service is definitely 5 Star from the booking to the meals. I bought a Groupon deal which was worth every penne.

title: Wedding anniversary trip
text: When it says the room is compact they are not wrong but it fits a doubke bed and desk however it was clean and tidy The staff were very attentive and the little touches to a long way it is our wedding anniversary which we only mentioned in passing and we came back to this

title: ice cream afternoon tea
text: Excellent food with quality prosseco. Both the service and presentation were outstanding. The birthday plate with backing music was a lovely touch. Thank you so much for a lovely afternoon on my daughters 19 th birthday.

title: Good hotel and nice staff
text: We stayed at The Chilworth for 3 nights. Loved the location! The hotel is located nearby Paddington station and Lancaster Gate station. Also Hyde park is a 5 minute walk away. Our room was located in the basement of the hotel. At first I was hesitant about the basement location but there was still a window and some natural light was coming in! Room was clean and kept clean during the days we stayed there. Also the amenities in the room were good!

title: Good location and friendly staff
text: We stayed one night at this hotel near Hyde park. The staff were very efficient, friendly and helpful. The hotel itself is clean and modern. The breakfast was very good. The only reason I haven’t rated it higher is the size of the room we were allocated was very small for a double room. Well designed in many respect with an excellent television. However there was very little room to move about.

title: Excellent hotel but...
text: Stayed at Chilworth while arrived for a few days to London on a business trip in January 2019. The hotel service is super, pleasant and quick. The room came with bottled water, fruits and more. I stayed in the deluxe double room. It is very nice but for someone travelling for work, there isn't much space to sit with the laptop other than the bed. The bathroom / shower area is very clear, but not rough room to put my shower on. Breakfat is lovely! My main disappointment was that I was in a room (103/113) across the lift that the heater did not work. The service team tried to help, but it wouldn't work. It was so cold in the room I had to ask for more blankets. I was offered to change rooms towards the end of trip, but decided not to. Although I had this cold experience, I will be coming again this Feb and will try it again. I hope I won't Ve disappointed and I will get a bigger room, and one with a heater.

title: Gorgeous atmosphere.
text: Nice place and very tasty! Friendly stuff and gorgeous atmosphere. For that money very good service. but, I really want more different type of tea, all other was very good. Also you can take something to go, it is really very useful, because is very difficult to eat everything. Thank you.

title: Indian Afternoon Tea
text: I came along with my girls for the Indian Afternoon Tea, it was such a lovely experience! From the service, to the food, to the hotel’s decor - everything was amazing! Really loved it, they made me feel extra special as it was my birthday - can’t recommend it enough!!

title: Excellent Service on a buisness trip and much needed rest
text: Slight difficulty placing a booking on the website, eventually placed over the phone. Arrived late in the day and was greeted by a very friendly and professional lady at reception. Quickly checked in with services clearly explained

title: Wonderful hotel and staff
text: Everything in this hotel is nice. From the check in, hotel service, housekeeping and etc. If I have a suggestion for the hotel is the accessibility for the entrance. Event though it was a fantastic experience.

title: Afternoon tea
text: We had a fantastic afternoon tea. The staff were lovely and helpful and the food was outstanding. It was my little one's birthday and they brought the kids a cupcake and candle. I would definitely go again!!

title: Loved it
text: We only stayed here one night and would loved to stayed longer. The club room we had was beautiful and had one of the most comfortable beds in all of Europe. We were also allowed to check in early which was a bonus. The staff were very helpful and the location is superb. We would recommend it.

title: Amazing afternoon tea
text: We had the best indian afternoon tea at the Chilworth London Paddington. The food was amazing, the service from the waitress and the manager was faultless, we will definitely be reccomending you to many people as we can. Thank you so much to the team that looked after the 14 people that came on the 12 Jan 2019. Everything was beyond our expectation

title: Pleasant surprise
text: This was not quite a last resort but it was getting close. The rather harness Egencia website the company uses has a limited choice and thus was one of the few remaining. Word has obviously not got around yet. So many hotels in this area are basic places dressed up in the hotel equivalent of sequins, with purple and orange velvet cushions, that sort thing, and with miserable and young staff with dirty collars and nose rings, looking like they don’t want to be there. That’s what I expected. What I got was an understated touch of style and elegance, pleasant and helpful staff, a room which has a big comfortable bed, a spacious and well equipped bathroom, little touches like a plug by the bed, an iron in the room, clean and pleasant smelling corridors (rather than musty, tatty and depressing). In short, a nice place to be. Four out of five rather than five because there is only one lift which can slow you down. So four and a half really. But well done Chilworth, a very good find

title: If You Are a Little Person, This Hotel Might be a Perfect Fit
text: This hotel is conveniently located next to Paddington Station and it's on a lovely tree-lined side street. The lobby is small but very well-appointed. There is a nice waiting area and a small restaurant and the service was terrific. The problem lies in the room size - it is so small - ridiculously small - that it feels like a well-decorated prison cell (well, a small prison cell). I am only 5'2" and my head touched one wall and my feet touched the other when lying on the bed. In addition, when I sat on the bed and bent over to put on my shoes, my head hit the desk. It's so tight, you can't open a suitcase and you have no counter space for any toiletries or to work if you are there on business. (I sat in a restaurant down the street with my laptop until 11pm because the room was too small to even sit at the ledge/desk they install.) Although it's relatively inexpensive, if you are claustrophobic, or just like to stretch your arms out occasionally, the it's not worth it.

title: Amazing, astonishing and astounding - all of the "A" words!
text: Fantastic service from the moment we stepped in. Warm towels, coats taken to the cloakroom and that was in the first minute. We were made to feel like a-listers who had spent a lot of money on the experience, far more than what we paid on GroupOn. Thoroughly impressed

title: Amazing Indian Afternoon Tea
text: I had booked an Indian Afternoon Tea for my wife's birthday and after reviewing the menu got in touch to see if they could make some changes. The hotel was prompt in replying and when we arrived on the day everything was just as requested. Would highly recommend them to anyone else who is looking for an alternative afternoon tea experience.

title: A wonderful find
text: I took my elderly parents away for a mini break in London taking in a couple of shows. I booked us into this hotel and wow I am so glad I did. The staff were courteous friendly and helpful, they were attentive without being intrusive. The hotel was stunning. My mother is OCD when it comes to cleaning and cleanliness and even she was impressed. We stayed in doubt rooms my parents room was on the front with doors opening onto a small balcony. They were pleasantly surprised that there was no road noise. My room was at the back of the hotel again no noise. Both rooms had large comfy beds and soothing decor. Chocolates and lip balm etc were left on the bed at night a lovely touch. The bathrooms were stocked with decent quality toiletries, although I did find the towel rail very high. The wardrobe had plenty of hangers including satin covered ones. Complimentary water tea and coffee was available as well as a microwave and small fridge. We had continental breakfast each morning and there was plenty of fresh fruit, pastries and cold meats / cheeses. White or brown toast although I would have preferred wholgrain but that’s a personal preference. There appeared to be a good hot English breakfast available. Air conditioned rooms was bliss in the hot weather. I would definitely stay here next time I visit London. All the staff I encountered were a credit to the hotel and took pride in their work and hotel. Thank you all for making our stay such a success.

title: Afternoon tea
text: Lovely food and great service definitely 5 star from me. The staff are super helpful and attend to all your needs and there's no rush or pressure to finish your food at all. I would definitely visit again.

title: Good hotel in west London
text: I had to stay in London for a week recently and was recommended to stay at the Chilworth. Impressed by the room, the service and the friendly staff. With the hotel set back from the road it’s a quiet location and doesn’t feel like busy west London

title: Modern, stylish but very small room
text: The only thing that drags the rating down here is the size of the room, which was barely big enough to fit the bed and a small desk. Otherwise this is a great location for Paddington, and everything is modern but with nice extra touches of luxury, including wonderful rain shower. Staff are attentive and friendly too.

title: Afternoon Tea
text: Myself and my boyfriend experienced the Chocolate Afternoon Tea this week and it was truly superb! Food was very delicious, fresh and plentiful and there's a wide selection of tea to choose from (you're also offered coffee/hot choc for those who don't want tea). Even the bubbly was delicious compared to some others we've had at such experiences. The staff cannot do enough for you and from the moment you walk in, till the very end, every member of staff is on hand and no request is too much. We were celebrating my birthday and the staff kindly brought out a cupcake with a candle and sang happy birthday. All in all, it was a wonderful experience and I'd love to return soon! Definitely recommend.

title: Amazing place, even better staff
text: Amazing place, even better staff. We only tried the afternoon tea, but it was perfect, the staff made sure everything was perfect, they even prepared a nice gift for our anniversary. Would definitely go back.

title: Afternoon tea
text: Amazing tea sandwiches . Definitely worth a visit. Good value for money and tasty food. Great for small occasions and group parties. Clean boutique hotel with contemporary interiors. Great service. Well worth it.

title: the chilworth
text: stayed at the chilworth Paddington 21/04/2018 this is a great little hotel just around the corner from Paddington station, All staff were very pleasant and couldnt have been more helpful the beds were very comfy and the breakfast was also great. thank you

title: Fantastic Afternoon Tea
text: I meet up with 2 old friends every January for Afternoon Tea in London - often using a Groupon or voucher. Sometimes using a deal means you get a different menu or are made to feel "lesser" in some way but not at The Chilworth. Here the staff are superb - they are courteous and helpful and the afternoon tea here is our best yet. We were offered a large variety of teas, coffees or even hot chocolate and these were topped up regularly. Our glass of Prosecco was large and tasty and the food was wonderful. Four different sandwiches, on intriguing flavours (and colours!) of bread. A large plain scone, jam and proper thick clotted cream. A delicious chocolate mousse with berries on top. Then a small ginger cake, a macaron, a baby chocolate éclair and a miniature lime tart! Everything we tried was lovely but we couldn't eat it all and the staff happily boxed up the leftovers to take home for the kids. We spent a thoroughly enjoyable afternoon here and there was no pressure to rush us to leave. I 100% recommend The Chilworth and will definitely return myself. (PS I didn't sleep here but couldn't get the sleep quality button to just not register so ignore that - although I bet it IS a lovely place to stay over!)

title: Excellent afternoon tea
text: Love this place. Excellent service and value for money. Would highly recommend.They had my partners vegetarian order waiting and I didn't need to tell them once arrived. This place is so good my partner has visited twice for the afternoon tea.

title: Really nice
text: Such an amazing hotel. Very friendly and helpful staff, nice clean rooms, very quiet, and the Tube is just 3 or 4 minutes walk. The local shops and diners are 5 minutes walk away. The breakfast is very nice and fresh. Parking is very restricted, but as we arrived by tube it wasn’t a problem. Overall very very good, recommend.

title: Would definitely recommend
text: My daughter and I visited for the ice-cream afternoon tea and cannot praise it enough. It was a very hot afternoon but it was very pleasant in the restaurant and we were greeted with a warm towel and a welcome glass of orange juice. The staff couldn't have been more attentive and the sandwiches, scones, cakes and champagne were delicious - topped off by three scoops of ice-cream. We will definitely return.

title: Lovely remodelled hotel with great customer service
text: The reception and the rooms are elegant comfy and welcoming. The rooms have everything you might need and the bathrooms are clean, well appointed with decent showers. The Wifi is usually stable and quite fast. The only negative is the green safety light which lights up the room during the night. If you contact reception they will cover it up for you. Breakfast is delicious with decent choices and a fully cooked to order hot option. The hotel is a few minutes walk away from Paddington in a quiet location and lots of restaurants nearby.

title: Cracking little find
text: Booked this through booking.com as was struggling to find a reasonable priced hotel on Wednesday night to watch Chelsea - this showed up on Booking.com and couldn’t have been more happy - bit of a chore to find only simply because I couldn’t read google maps but when you get your bearings it’s 5 mins away from Paddington When you get there it’s a joy to turn up they have this wonderful aroma in the reception and can’t say enough about the helpful staff at reception. Booked a single room and yes it is compact but certainly can live with it for one night Whilst I’m writing this in the bar there are a family having afternoon tea which looks stunning Can’t knock the price I paid probably would recommend getting a double room but certainly worth a look

title: Lovely afternoon tea
text: We visited on Saturday and used our groupon vouchers for 5 of us for the traditional afternoon tea (was a Christmas present). We were welcomed so warmly and shown to our table. Our lovely waitress bought our bubbly and then 3 stands of afternoon tea. The food was lovely, sandwiches fresh and was nice to have coloured bread... we had tea, hot choc and coffee. We weren’t rushed at all which was lovely. If there was anything to mention it would be maybe to have a round table for an odd number party as one person was at the end but didn’t bother us too much, and maybe offered to hang our coats somewhere. But no big deal. Lovely time! Thank you!

title: Ice Cream afternoon tea
text: I visited The Chilworth for the Ice Cream afternoon tea which was amazing! We were offered sandwiches and scones and then a range of different desserts. We were then given a bowl of three scoops of ice cream with wafers. Myself and my friend thoroughly enjoyed it. Joy was so lovely, always checking to see if we were ok and if we needed anything else. 10/10 for service. Would definitely recommend :)

title: Decent hotel but its certainly not 5star, more 3+
text: I was spending a day in London with a friend and was meant to spend the night at there house, but sadly this couldnt happen, so I booked this hotel last minute for a single room as it was highly discounted. Its a couple of mins stroll to the subway and Paddington itself is very lively with lots of bars and restaurants but as you know youre never far away from anywhere in London with the tube being so good. Ok so check in was easy (3pm) Id booked a single room as it was on 53% discount on a well know booking site so it was £85 which for London is decent I guess, they put me in a ground floor room which then appeared to be a disabled access room, this is where it went a bit pear shaped! the room was "freezing" after a 5hr trip I needed a hot shower and wanted to chill before I went out for the evening, the underfloor heating (advertised) wasnt working, the room heating wasnt working (I got the impression this room wasnt really in use) the TV wasnt working, there was no robe (as advertised) I returned to reception and they basically asked me to wait while the room warmed up! errrrr NO...... around 30 mins later and a visit from the handyman It confirmed what I suspected, this room dadnt been used for a while. I was eventually moved to another room on the 4th floor even though Id been told there were no more rooms to move too? It was a bit small but it was ok, what is it with hotels using dark furniture? oh well it was warm, the underfloor heating was working and I eventually got my shower so all good. NOTE, for a hotel claiming to be 5 star Im amazed its got this rating, using nescafe sachets for coffee is a cheap touch, not what you would expect, If Id have paid full price for this hotel I would have been asking for money back after the experience. Its a small hotel, converted from an old multistory house it seems, it has NO bar or at least I wasnt informed it had a bar (surely this is good practise to drive turnover) ?? it seems to have a small restaurant attached and apparently a spa?? again I wasnt informed it had one ?? however I didnt eat here, when there are so many good places around, why would you? Overall I was disapointed to be fair Ive stayed in better premier inns, if this were a 3star+ or 4star Id have given it a better score based on its limited ammenities, but to say its a 5star, no......as a 5star its way below other 3/4stars Ive stayed in on reflection.

title: Lovely Hotel, very good value
text: Definitely pleased I booked this hotel compared to my colleagues who stayed at a high end chain hotel in a tiny single room for over 50% more! The complementary wine, was a really nice treat. The room was large with a large TV and comfortable clean bed. Turndown service included eye cream which was much appreciated after the late night... Buffet style breakfast had just the right mix of service and self service, making it an easy and tasty quick breakfast. Only downside was the power in the room kept dipping out as the room card didn't quite fit in the slot properly. I managed to wedge it in so that I could make it through a shower in the light though so it wasn't that much of an inconvenience. Overall, a lovely stay and I will definitely come again.

title: Great little hotel
text: Really comfortable and well appointed quiet and relaxing. Very good check in. Food average but room lovely and clean and bed very comfy. Bathroom had a bath and shower. Would stay again Close to Paddington station too.

title: Very disappointing...
text: Looked for a nice small hotel i Paddington area as I was arriving late at night, had a meeting in the morning, and was leaving again from Heathrow. Reasoned that it was fairly near to Heathrow Express in and out. To be fair location was good in this case. The service was, however, not impressive at all. Lift was not working and I had carry my suitcase myself - probably because I arrived in the evening. I do not mind that if lift is working, but here it was not. There was also something wrong with doorlock and door was difficult to open. This hotel is a refurbishment of an old hotel and has not been successfull. Things look okay, but something is missing. Booked a double, single occupancy, but I have had bigger singlerooms in other London hotels. Stayed at this hotel because I fancied a hotel with some character. Next time I will stay at Novotel - they have many lifts and always one that is working and rooms are bigger and service more professional...

title: Aftenoon tea
text: Had a lovely time ewcommed it was all very gokd there were 3 of us we had a lovely time no kne was rushed. Good food and recommend it. Given a hot cloth to freshen up with on arrival it was very Good. Very good sérvice

title: Beautiful venue, very relaxing
text: The Chilworth is a venue not too far from Paddington Station, it's quiet and modern. Perfect for a business trip or a family holiday! The bar is well filled and the service is excellent. I would advice anyone that stays to had down to the spa and enjoy the facilities to the max!

title: Average
text: Having visited here on a couples break, it wasn’t necessarily what we expected, considering we actually payed more than the actual hotel reservation price!! We booked with lastminute.com and originally payed £179 (what we thought was perfectly reasonable for Greater London, 4*). However we got to the hotel, and we were charged a second time, as the receptionist wasn’t aware we prepaid. Moreover the price they asked for at the hotel directly was less than lastminute.com (£149.95). We explained we were angered by this, and the receptionist was cold and rude, and told us, ‘well now you know to book for next time.’ The room was clean, and we particularly enjoyed the shower and the bed, we slept well (it was not noisy, other than early in the morning), however our window looked out onto the communal outside stair well and staff entrance (which was used frequently at about 5:30am). Other guests used it throughout the evening and the late morning, so my partner and I had no privacy, or not with natural light (which really isn’t very nice, particularly if you want to be intimate). Hotel had some nice touches, like chocolates and Elemis skin care products when we arrived, on the bed.

title: Afternoon tea
text: On a girlie trip to London we decided to book a last minute afternoon tea! The staff went above and beyond to make sure it was an enjoyable experience.......From the booking, to the food, to the little details! Would highly recommend 😊

title: Wonderful experience!
text: Wonderful experience! Me and a friend went for afternoon tea on the 18/12 as a Christmas treat and had an absolutely wonderful time. To start off the hotel is elegant and the sofas we sat on were so comfortable. We were first served tea and coffee and we were offered top ups. We got our bubbly with our afternoon tea and the food was delicious and filled us up! Our waitress Andrea explained everything in the afternoon tea when she brought it over. The food was so good especially the scones! We were even allowed to take some of the little cakes we could not finish home. The service was 5*. Our lovely waitress Andrea was very attentive of us but also gave us our privacy. She always asked us if there was anything else she could do for us. We did not feel rushed to leave at any point and we were not treated different being groupon purchasers. We briefly spoke to some other staff members who were also very nice, to be honest everyone who worked there was smiling and looked happy. We will be coming back. Thank you so much!

title: New Years Stay
text: We have just checked out of the hotel after a very pleasant stay. The reception area and bedrooms are to a very high standard, closer to a 5 star, however, the reason I have to give the review a 4 is because the jacuzzi wasn’t working when we went to use it which meant the only thing left in the spa to use was the steam room - which whilst it was lovely was a real shame as I thought there would be more down there. The staff were incredibly friendly and the location is brilliant for Paddington station and Hyde Park. I would definitely recommend staying here.

title: Wonderful afternoon tea
text: We had booked for afternoon tea, the staff we meet were all very attentive and caring to our needs. The food was great especially the coconut lollies and the staff made sure we had a perfect experience. Will definately book again

title: Pretty good
text: I was aware the rooms were said to be small according to others' reviews but we really experienced how small it was when we arrived in the room. Good to spend one night with a small bag because there might not be enough space for two people and their belongings. We were also disappointed that the "indoor pool" was just the same small jacuzzi/whirlpool and there wasn't any big pool for swimming. That's could be quite confusing. The fitness centre was a small room with just a cycling machine and treadmill so it would be impossible to serve more guests at one time. We booked it mainly for the fitness centre and the indoor pool so we were a bit disappointed. Checking in we had to wait because only one receptionist was available and we were third in the queue but we waited for about 20 minutes before our turn. No mobile phone signal in the room because we were in the basement. The window in the room was tiny with scaffolding as our main view. The room and the hotel in general was clean and tidy. The staff were approachable and helpful. The breakfast was decent and had enough selections but may get boring if staying for more than two nights. The location 2as perfect for Hyde park and the underground and restaurants. Overall a good experience. Would consider staying here again.

title: Afternoon tea and spa day
text: Came here to use the spa facilities and have an ice cream afternoon tea with friends. We had exclusive use of the steam room and jacuzzi, towels, robes and slippers provided, which was lovely! Afternoon tea was an absolute delight and the service was professional and attentive. We even ordered a couple of extra things and when preparing to pay were told they were on the house. Thank you to all the staff at The Chilworth. You were great! Will definitely be returning!

title: Lovely stay
text: The hotel staff were very welcoming from the moment we got to the hotel the room was in amazing condition. Would highly recommend to all ages as it’s in a great location and there is use of in hotel spa facilities.

title: Amazing Location! Great Value For Money.
text: The hotel is located at a very short walk from the Paddington station (direct connection to London Heathrow) and Hyde Park making it super convenient to access it with public transport. The staff is extremely polite, cheerful and go out of their way to make you feel comfortable. Since I was travelling alone, I opted for a single room which is slightly on the smaller side but is clean, hygienic and has most of the amenities. Their breakfast spread is good and also offers Indian dishes. Would certainly recommend this property to tourists & business travellers alike.

title: Very Nice people and atmosphère
text: Nice réception. Looks Like business class ! Professionnal personnel with the right attention . The Rooms are ok , meaning the size . Very Good bed and very good insulation also. What else can you write about a Hotel ? Go there

title: Excellent Accommodation
text: Stayed here recently for a working holiday. The hotel is in a beautiful location,quiet and has a high standard of cleanliness. The concierge staff in particular were always friendly/attentive and the manager Prashant was also an impressive member of the team that I had the pleasure to meet. Thank you L A Hanson

title: Brilliant location for a night out in London before flying!
text: From the warm welcome with a face towel to the very well designed modern room, I knew I had found a great hotel. It was the perfect location for a night out in central London before getting up early to get the Heathrow Express from Paddington (about 5 minutes around the corner from hotel). The hotel staff were extremely helpful and friendly. I only wish we hadn’t needed to leave before breakfast as the menu looked delicious!

title: Business stay - good location
text: Last minute deal for 2 nights for business - staff were very friendly and hotel location was good just 5 minutes walk from station and not on busy road. Hotel is aiming for boutique experience and the rooms were nicely decorated/new, good shower. Would recommend for short stay and if on a deal, but if i had paid full rate i would have been a bit dissappointed mainly based on its size- tiny single room that you had to walk sideways if you used the suitcase stand (nowhere else to put a case), dining/bar and reception area too small really to meet group of colleagues without getting in the way and weirdly the Christmas decorations were poor compared with the stylish design of the rest of the hotel !

title: Business stay
text: I got last minute deal to stay here. I have to say it was a lovely experience. i was greeted by a hot towel and an orange juice on check-in. The room was small but built to a very high specification. It is very clean and modern with great facilities such as a very large TV and microwave. The breakfast was outstanding and the freshly prepared eggs were cooked to perfection. It is in a great location as it is s atones throw from Paddington Station and 20 mins walk from Oxford Street. Staff were very helpful and friendly. It was good value for the class of hotel. My only niggle was that I could not turn off the green light on the aircon grill which gave the room a green tinge. If this can be turned off easily it would be a great help.

title: Great hotel
text: Stayed for one night on business. Room was clean, good size (for London) and well equipped. Bed was very comfortable. Breakfast was also very nice. Staff were helpful and friendly. Great location, few mins walk from Paddington. Price was good for London (where hotel prices are generally too high) Highly recommended and will stay again.

title: Week end à Londres
text: Forget it ! And more , go anywhere else for a week end in London First , the welcoming of the host . Really really poor . Not a smile , rude way to talk to you ... you are not welcome for sure Then you have to pay before and not on leave ... why not ... but it’s not usual in an hotel . Normally , you just give the credit card as an insurance but the transaction is done at the end of the stay. The breakfast is ... let say so so. Eggs and bacon are good but the French pastries are not from the day nor the day before if you understand what I mean ! Orange juice is from a low price market bottle 8€99 is too expensive for that The location is not closed to the center of the city as it can be suggested by the name “tower bridge” . It s a 20mn of bus to join the Thames at Waterloo bridge each times !!! But the worst is to come . Each night , until 3am , every Friday and Saturday , you can hear the Latino club Nearby the hotel . Simply A Nightmare !!!

title: Very clean, friendly helpful staff and easy access to all London attractions
text: Myself and a friend stayed here for three nights, another friend decided she wanted to join for two nights so we called up on our day of arrival to see if this was possible. The staff were very helpful and at such short notice arranged an extra bed and only asked for an extra £10 a night. When we arrived the room was very clean and there was plenty of space for our three suitcases as well as plenty of room to walk around the room. The bathroom had a bath with shower over the top and a separate tap with drinking water and was very clean. Although the hotel was not exactly walking distance to any of the tourist attractions the hotel was located on a very good bus route, taking you either right past lots of the main attractions or to elephant and castle station and from there you can get anywhere you like. We purchased a day travel card each day, which providing you bought after 9.30am and travelled in zones 1 and 2 (which all attractions are within) it only cost £6.60 which you could use the bus, tubes and over ground trains. All in all I believe the location, cleanliness and friendliness of the staff at this hotel made our trip very enjoyable.

title: superb
text: Excellent location with very short amenities..But was nice to stay.. So from my side 4.5 star i would like to give this Hotel..Rooms was Quiet and calm so we can relax positively.. Thanks and Regards..

title: Nice bus connection with center of London, clear, good staff
text: Best thing in staying in this hotel is friendly staff and the fact that Bus 453 pass every 3 minutes for the bus station just 120 meters away from the hotel. 453 goes directly to the Picadilly circus in just 19 minutes. There was 2 problem in room, first remote control of tv had no batteries and even thought that we inform the reception about that, the issue was not solved (we stay for 3 days). Second, the shower head in the bathroom was really leaking, so the was not enough water presure to take a pleasant bath.

title: A basic relatively comfortable London hotel in an area not containing many hotels
text: This hotel is a reasonable value establishment in a South area of London with few other hotels in the vicinity. It is not a long bus ride into Central London or the City with all its attractions. The rooms are reasonably priced and comfortable and clean. The restaurant contained in the hotel is average but not expensive.

title: Nice hotel for good price
text: My mate and I stopped here yesterday, after booking through laterooms.com. Was a close location (approx. 1 mile) to the Ministry of Sound - our main reason for visiting - and was also only 1 mile away from Elephant & Castle station. Also only about 20 minute walk from The Shard and other attractions such as the River Thames and Tower Bridge. The hotel itself is nice, with a bar in the reception area, which was ideal for my mate and I to have a few drinks in the room before heading out. Staff were friendly and helpful too, as we had no idea how to get anywhere. The room was a twin room, which was a good size. They actually upgraded our room for free (just put more beds in so was basically a family room). Nice plasma tv with freeview to watch whilst we had a few drinks in the room. The bathroom was whay surprised me most. Spacious and well designed. Was quite impressed. Unfortunately the shower was rubbish. Good temperature but no power. May just have been our room that had this issue as oppose to a common theme in all of them. Only other complaint I have is the small fridge in the room absolutely reeked. Clearly the users before had kept some cheese in there for some reason ... and it stank the fridge out and half the room. Had to open the window fully to get rid of the smell. 4* rating overall from me.

title: Long way out
text: I was rather misled by the title of this hotel which claims to be near Tower Bridge. It isn't. It is on Old Kent Road - in a run down area of London with nearest Tube (Elephant and Castle) a long way away. I made use of the buses a lot which are good but nowhere near as good as the tube. Staff were fine but tended towards silence and non-engagement. The £10 English breakfast was appalling - a sea of cheap beans with a rather of bacon, two overdone eggs and a piece of fatty hash brown - admittedly nice toast. Poor service in the real fast room and not a patch on other hotels I have visited in London. I went for the price just to see - I won't be going back.

title: Very reasonable hotel
text: Very friendly and helpful staff. The place was clean with spacious rooms. The location looks a bit rough but didn’t encounter any problems. Bus stop just outside the hotel with good options to London attractions. Would stay here again.

title: Nice room in a poor location
text: I'm used to being charged ridiculous sums for London accommodation so it was great finding this bargain. A really modern, clean, large double room with a fridge and a TV that worked properly, climate control, big comfy bed, clean and modern shower room. I can't fault the room. Reception was a bit lacklustre but adequate. The location's not so good though - I couldn't find anywhere I wanted to take a drink nearby and it's about about quarter of an hour's brisk walk from the nearest tube.

title: Good for one night
text: Stayed for one night with my daughter and her friend. Multicultural area with some good eating places. Bus into City and other areas and close to the Shard. Rooms clean and simple. Staff very helpful. Only bug bear that you cannot sit at the bar as they have fold up tables used for breakfast! But not a deal breaker.

title: Great hotel
text: Just returned from London visiting family in hospital there, stayed at the Premier on Old Kent Rd which has been built quite recently , would definetely recommend it. Great price, very clean, well looked after rooms with nice decor and super comfy bed and pillows. We stayed three nights Sat-Tues had booked two rooms. Local ameneties i.e food not so great however bus stops right near hotel entrance and it's a 24hr bus service, not too expensive in a taxi either to centre of London-we were £14. People in local grocers very nice and helpful and sell the all day bus tickets which are great. Area not much to look at but I felt safe enough. My shower wasnt working so I had to move rooms after first night-staff were very helpful. Large TV on wall which had built in freeview-great. Kettle supplied in room for tea/coffee. Small fridge supplied in room. Only downside no wardrobe! Only a small clothes rail with few hangers on it. DO NOT use the Chinese adjoined to the building, worst meal i've ever had!! However my parents liked the food in Ozzies cafe just a few doors down. I recommend you eat before returning to hotel as local amenities are a bit scarce. There is a Tesco just along the road from hotel. Also people had chinese takeaway meals delivered to hotel from elsewhere which hotel staff were ok with and supplied plates, cutlery etc. If your looking for an above average hotel (I loved it and can be fussy) then this is it but I definetely recommend it and would return.

title: No customer service
text: We appreciate this is a low budget hotel, the rooms where large and clean. However, we had a couple of problems. Firstly I see room service menu.. great £1 for a bucket of ice fantastic! I phone to reception.. the response i get "we don't offer room service to this room". I would like to point out our room was the first room on the ground floor. I was confused but thought fine, if you don't want the extra money. Then the toilet facilities didn't work. My friend had a shower Friday evening and the water didn't drain. Herself and my other friend tried everything with the plug but nothing happened. We thought it was slow draining and went out. We went to the 02 academy got back 5am. Went to the toilet and it didn't flush. Went to clean my teeth cold water trickled then stopped and had to use hot water. As you can imagine at 5am in the morning us three women didn't want the security staff to come in our room, we where tiered. Next morning the bath water still hadn't drained toilet didn't flush and cleaning teeth with hot water again. As we checked out we complained but got a less than interested response as it was clear we weren't going to get anywhere we left. As I was going into the tube station I got a phone call from the hotel. I expected it to be an apology from the manager.. no. It was more a phone call to make a point to say the plumbing was working fine. what use was this information to me now as I was leaving London? Why would we all clean our teeth with hot water, Not flush the chain when three people where using the loo and not be able to shower after a night out. at £40 per person I thought initially great value for money.. after our stay no it is not. £40 for just a bed is a rip off. If we could of used the facilities great would recommend but after the uninterested response I received, I wouldn't bother.

title: Great value for money.
text: Although this hotel states it is Tower Bridge it is in fact located in the Old Kent Road. I was looking for a hotel near central London but was not prepared to pay £250 plus for bed and breakfast in hotels that did not particularly look great. The Old Kent Road, although not in the best of areas is only a short bus ride from the Elephant and Castle and Borough tube stations, or a five minute drive. What surprised me was the price. Just £89 for two people. ( Breakfast not included) There was parking at the back of the hotel (extra charge) which was secured throughout the night. The Hotel itself provided excellent accommodation for the price. It was immaculately clean. The room was large and very clean. The beds were very comfortable. There was a fridge and adequate items in the complimentary tea tray. The room was also air conditioned. I have stayed in many hotels which cost a lot more and were far less comfortable. The reception staff were efficient but quite formal. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone that did not want to pay central London prices. The only downside is its location. For travellers who are driving this is an ideal place to stay whilst visiting central London. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Atrocious
text: When the hotel state that its close to many of London's tourist attractions, they omitted to say that it's a bus journey away and in a very rough part of London. When we checked in, the lady was very polite and helpful. That's where the politeness ended. Our room was clean and tidy, however, it was too hot. You are unable to open the windows and the air conditioning is controlled from reception. We asked for assistance on a number of occasions and the air conditioning worked for a short time before being switched off again. All male staff members were rude and arrogant. Avoid this hotel

title: Dirty, noisy and nasty.
text: Old Kent Road itself isn't somewhere you want to be walking along at night. The entrance lobby was okay but the room itself was dirty, smelt horrible and the furnishings were cheap and nasty. We visited for a work trip in May and the air conditioning units didn't work which was horrendous as it was 28 degrees. Would definitely not stay here again and would not recommend. Ridiculously expensive for what you get.

title: Different
text: This hotel is on the main road in a not very delirious part of London. I was kept awake most of the night by the continual noise of sirens passing by. My room was apparently not a room bus was described as a cabin. More of a prison cell springs to mind. No privacy,as soon as you opened the main curtain you were looking on to a dirty main road. The wash basin was only the size of my dogs water bowl so no chance of a decent shave there. There were no carpeting at all in the room only tiled flooring and the room fittings were so basic and chipboard. The area is short on eating places unless you like kebabs or Lebanese food so the chines e restaurant attached to the hotel was a bonus.

title: Premier inn standard
text: I find accommodation can be very expensive, no matter when you travel. Unfortunately this can include the crap places dotted all over the place. I was burned once a number of years ago (before Tripadvisor) so am very careful what I'm booking in London (or elsewhere in the UK....) A very basic B&B can call its self a Hotel. (which does not appear to be the norm for the rest of the world.....) The good news is that there are chains of hotels like Premier. They are not the cheapest, but if I have any doubt at all in the quality of an alternative hotel I will go for the Premier (or travel lodge for that matter - though I think the Premier are a higher standard). So I found myself booking this hotel for a short stay in London in December 2014 to visit my Daughter who works in London. I am familiar with London and can get around no problem what so ever on the Tube. You can be anywhere in London within 20min! (well central London :-) ). This hotel is located on the Old Kent rd. but is a good distance from a tube stop. This was the only real concern for me as I have not done Buses in London since I was a child.... The good news is that with a little effort or research (or indeed ask reception) you can find out what bus to take and where from etc. (each bus stop has a letter or set of letters on the top of it). but better still is that there is an app for everything - including live arrival of buses. But I digress. suffice to say the location is not a big deal as long as you will have no problem with the public transport (which I found brilliant). The hotel was of the expected Premier standard - there was a surprise in that the floors were all tiled or marble tiles, not the usual purple carpet. If you think about this it makes the place a lot easier to keep clean and sparkling - so I approved of it even though it is a little cooler on your feet (which I actually forgot about soon after arrival). The reception was a little unusual as in one side was the Bar and the other side was the reception area. Staff were very friendly and helpful. check in was simple and fast. The rooms were smallish (but this is London) but very well maintained and modern. It must have been completely remodelled recently. The en-suite shower room was very good. In fact I would say it was above average for most hotels. one reason for this was that the shower was actually bigger than a closet :-). I'm not huge, but do need a little turning around space. The shower tray and cubicle was on the larger size of the scale a very welcome sight. the rest was very well cleaned and maintained. Little short on towels, but not a big deal if you shower only once a day - all towels were changed each day so fresh each morning for me :-) Premier make a big thing about their beds being comfortable and as I have stayed in a few Premiers I agree - they are all very comfortable. We only had 3 pillows the first night and the wife and I usually have 2 - so upon asking for one it was put in the room straight away (its the little things...). All in all this hotel is a very good option particularly when you balance the modest nightly rate to location. One bus from outside the door (well 300m up to the left) will deliver you to Big Ben within 15/20min off peak.) so I would not have a problem on the location. Highly recommended if you care about cleanliness and standards.

title: Reasonable hotel in London
text: Stayedfor 1 night. Business trip to london. Room was small but was ensuite. Shower pressure was poor. Mattress was not very comfortable as compared to ones at Premier inn. Location was good. Did not have breakfast so cannot comment.

title: Reasonable
text: Situated about 15 minutes walking from the Tower Bridge. Rooms were clean but not luxureous. Bring your adaptor with you if you come from the continent. Only english plug in.Breakfast is only continental, but although I did not try it there was a large selection. Parking space for 25 pounds is affordable for one day but not for a week.

title: Not what we expected...
text: Firstly let me be honest...as a first time traveler to London i was not at all familiar with what constitutes a good or not so nice part of town...so this review is VERY subjective. The price was good, and if traveling on a tight budget i guess this hotel might outrank some hostels in terms of comfort. The room was clean, but looked old and worn...also don't expect much of a view. The safe in the room didn't work and they couldn't get it fixed in the two days we stayed there, again not really helping me to feel any safer (or more comfortable). Late at night the hotel got very noisy with us being able to hear all the conversations from people getting out of the lift until they were in their rooms. Staff was helpful, but again maybe not as friendly as we expected. Location...not at all close to the centre of town, but we found several bus routes that run very close by. Here the hotel reception was helpful in providing us with a bus schedule for the area. The area itself...probably not that great, most definitely not "uptown" or tourist part of London, but there's a few shops and supermarkets in the vicinity. Would i go stay there again??? Probably not, personally I'm convinced that one could find a good B&B for the same price elsewhere.

title: Pleasant staff - Poor location and NOT near Tower Bridge
text: Booked this hotel vai booking,com listed as Eurotraveller Hotel - Premier - Tower Bridge We requested a quite room on arrival when realising how the busy the road was and were allocated a room at the back of the hotel which was very quite. The room was clean & basic, negatives the plastic/material mattress covers were very crinkled and uncomfortable to sleep on. We had tickets for the Globe theatre in the evening and an appointment at Guys hospital early the next morning, we have stayed in London bridge Southwark area before but this hotel was not in a nice area and a bit of a walk to say the least to get to the Southbank. We will check locations more closely before booking hotels in London Bridge again. an inexpensive hotel for London but you get what you pay. Could not fault the staff though very kind friendly

title: Girls weekend in London
text: Was pleasantly surprised by this hotel. Staff friendly and attentive. Rooms clean, spacious and comfy. Great price. Would recommend if you are looking for a reasonably priced hotel without the 5 star touches (and price tag!). WiFi free throughout. Will be back

title: Stay
text: This hotel was very clean, staff very pleasant. I stayed there one night & the room was very comfortable. En-suite, large flat screen tv, free wifi, large shower, comfortable bed. Iron etc, plug sockets with charger USB points which was great. Although on a busy road the traffic noise wasn't too bad. All in all a very good stay for a reasonable price.

title: Anniversary Trip to London
text: So my girlfriend booked this hotel for our 1 year anniversary and I have to say it was a great hotel. It was very clean, had comfortable beds, staff were friendly & very helpful. Also, there is a lovely Chinese restaurant called Reunion, which is next to the hotel. There is a bus stop only a 2 minute walk down the road with buses going to the main attractions(or close walking distance nearby), and a Tesco’s and Lidl’s a few minutes walk either side of the hotel. I highly recommend this hotel, we really enjoyed our stay and will 100% be staying here again.

title: Great location, nice bar, clean and comfortable
text: The hotel is not far from the Tower bridge, about 10-15 minutes walk. Location is nice, very calm, shops, cafes, restaurants are nearby. The bus stop is just next to the hotel entrance. The building is very nice, hotel is always clean, very nice atmosophere, quiet and comfortable. The rooms are bit small, but you have all you need there. If you are looking for a value for money, this is the place. Highly recommended.

title: Good enough
text: Hotel Staff: nice and helpful Room: spacious clean, all needed amenities present Breakfast buffet: very good, hot chocolate excellent Bus Stop close, 24h buses get you to everywhere you need to go to in London Nearest metro station: long walk to get to it You can use uber too

title: Night in London
text: The location is definitely mis-sold, it is in Walworth, not Tower Bridge (at least half an hour walk away), it was off our London map book so had difficulty finding it and it was a long walk. The nearest tube was Elephant and Castle which was a mile away - we won’t be returning.

title: Wouldn't recommend
text: Arrived on the Saturday morning, paid a surcharge of £20 to check in early. Room was clean with the following amenities: - Kettle - Ironing Board (No iron) - Hanger for clothes - Safe However, went to make a coffee only to find the UHT milk was off. There is a large mirror, but no plug nearby to use hair straighteners. Definitely not a power shower! There is no tube station nearby so it's a good 20 minute walk to the 'Tourist' area, this is definitely not recommended in the evening especially with children as this is not the nicest area. However, there is a bus stop very close to the hotel. On the whole it wasn't an unpleasant experience, but not somewhere I would stay again.

title: basic but clean
text: Are you looking for somewhere just to get your head down? Go here. The continental breakfast is bizzare but it's plentiful and there is the choice of full english if you want it. Next door is a really good quality chinese restaurant for evening food. The area isn't great no wonder it's the cheap street on the monopoly board!!!! Elephant and Castle isn't exactly the best area either. Lots of boarded up houses/flats and it's a run down area. However! You can get a zillion buses outside the door that go direct into central London in less than 15 minutes. Very close to Westminster and Trafalgar Square on the bus. Tube station at Elephant and Castle is a bus ride or 15 minute walk away. Greenwich a bus ride away. Would recommend it but if it's for a decent holiday or romantic break book somewehre else

title: Best hotel we've stayed at in London
text: Mycket trevlig, social och hjälpsam personal. Lite klurigt att hitta dit första gången, då vi kom fram tre på natten till hotellet. Men inga problem! Rena och fräscha hotell Loved my stay at this hotel! The staff was very helpfull, nice and social. We came to the hotel around 3 am, so it was kind of difficult to find at first, but the rest of the stay was just perfect. One minute to the bus which is 15 minutes from the Big Ben, and it's a lot of different buses, at all times, to all places so you barely need the Underground. I will definitely return!!! We had booked the hotel for four nights and needed to stay 10 nights, so the last day they told us they could have us the rest of the stay. Awesome. The bar in the hotel was very cozy and the staff hung out with us, really nice. And it's a very silent hotel, not much sound or anything. You can buy breakfast there, which we didn't. And if you walk down the street you find an enormous park where you can chill! Recommended age: Not kids. All other ages. The Chinese restaurant had awful staff.

title: Short break in London
text: My friend was over from Berlin and we wanted a London hotel that was reasonable and not at city centre prices. The Eurotraveller on the Old Kent Road fitted the bill. The rooms (aka cabins) were spacious, clean and comfortable with a decent shower and coffee/tea making facilities. My room was on the road side so there was some traffic noise but not enough to worry me and I did get a view of the Shard. The breakfast was ample with a hot and cold buffet and as much coffee as you like which is always a bonus! In the evening the bar is pretty limited and the area is functional rather than comfortable. I can recommend the Chinese restaurant Reunion which is conveniently next door. The staff were welcoming and helpful. Although the hotel isn't right in the Centre there are excellent bus links to central London and the main rail stations. Top tips for free 'birdseye' views of London. Go to the Sky Garden, Fenchurch Street near Bank tube station. There are 3 viewing floors and 2 cafes. You need to book and there may be queues but the view is worth it. Also go to the viewing level at Tate Modern on the South Bank - spectacular at sunset.

title: Less than expected
text: The location is a little bit unhappy. The area of London in not so good and far from any intresting place, also from undeground station (Elephant & Castle). Better to take a bus (53 drives you straight to Westminister). Rooms are ok but breaksfast is no high-level. Wi-Fi is really expensive. In general for the price they made me our stayinfg in London was ok but the sourrondings are not a good place for a walk, especially during night, anyway lot of police controls the main street (Old Kent Road).

title: budget
text: in a terrible area,no where near an underground station twenty minute walk to elephant and castle, room not cleaned well. had a disabled room the bathroom had good facilities but the bedroom itself had no disabled features and not enough room round bed for wheelchair. staff quite friendly and helpful.

title: Decent Accommodation, Bad Location
text: While the room is clean and the bath modern, it is not nearly as nice as they try to make it look on their web site. Internet is close to $19/24 hours. It is not close to anything. We had to go to a shop and by an Oyster card (£5 plus the money to travel -£4.40/day), then take a bus to the Underground, and then 2 different tube lines. Almost an hour later we made it to Victoria Station. The neighborhood is a bit dodgy. They charge to print boarding passes.

title: AVOID
text: My husband & I stayed here for one night to see our daughter perform in a play at a nearby theatre, so we booked this hotel as it was conveniently located. It was quite late when we checked in and I have to say we were seriously under impressed with the sullen and totally disinterested approach of the check in staff....a group of men behind the reception desk, talking amongst themselves in a different language. There was no interaction, no conversation or pleasantries during the check in process....it was really awkward and definitely not a great first impression which I commented on to my husband at the time. Arrived at 'cabin 111' and it was tiny, gloomy and felt grubby. Tiled floor in the bedroom area (which my bare feet stuck to). On the plus side the shower room was clean and the towels were also soft & clean. Sadly this was the only plus point.The bed linen was stained as was my pillow which had a big brown/ red mark on it.....I could clearly see this poking out of the pillow case. The bed was really uncomfortable and the pillows cheap & lumpy. My husband & I both had a very restless night made worse by the continual noise (paper thin walls and tiled floors in all the cabins mean you can hear everything). We decided to skip the breakfast included in the room rate we paid (£99 for the night) and instead have breakfast elsewhere. A good decision we decided as the breakfast area looked distinctly unwelcoming when we checked out. We thought however, we'd have a cup of tea in our room whilst getting ready to check out, but despite rinsing out the kettle (multiple times) and refilling it from the separate 'tap water' tap the tea tasted disgusting and was undrinkable. We really couldn't wait to leave..... Having recently returned from a holiday in Croatia, where they seem to have Customer Service spot on, our experience here was woefully lacking. The staff we encountered at this hotel without exception, could not have cared any less about their guests and need to have immediate training in providing even basic Customer Service. A budget hotel it may be, but surely this should not mean 'non existent' customer service, dirty rooms, sticky floors and stained bed linen. Definitely one to avoid.....our advice to other travellers would be to pay a little extra and have really nice memories to look back on when spending a night away in London.

title: Would stay there again!
text: I was very happy with my stay, we stayed in a family room, with a 1yr old. It was clean, a good size and the staff were friendly.

title: Small expensive triple room
text: For a triple room without breakfast with the size we got was on the expensive side (~130 pounds/night). We couldn´t open the toilet door completely, as the double bed was on its way. Regarding the space between the beds it was so narrow that we had to take turns to get into bed. If someone is a bit bigger I doubt he could really do it. The room also lacked a closet or some space to hang your jacket or coat. Luckily the toilet size was ok. Additionally you had to pay for wifi in your room, although it was free in the main hall. The location may not be the best, but after living in London for a long time I wasn´t really concerned about it, as it is well connected to London Bridge or Waterloo with the buses stopping just nearby. The room was heading to the backyard, so it was quiet, and you don´t really miss any view, because Old Kent Road is not a nice road. Cleanliness and staff atention were alright.

title: Great hotel and price for London
text: A friend and I (both in our late twenties) decided to have a weekend in London and were looking for a cheap (but half decent!) hotel, and this was perfect! Check in was smooth, rooms were fantastically clean and very modern and spacious, there was a bus stop only a minute away which takes you into central london (takes about 20mins or so). The location was the only slight downside as it a bit confusing to get to, the nearest tube is elephant and castle (not tower bridge as you might expect), but reception staff are very helpful with giving directions etc. Old Kent Road is not the best street in London (its the cheapest plot on the monopoly board after all!), but apart from that, lovely modern hotel and had a great nights stay :-)

title: Good secure parking, terrible breakfast, rooms not cleaned properly.
text: We stayed here recently for 2 nights as we were attending an event close by. The secure parking at the rear leads you into the back of the hotel where everything is clean tidy and presentable. Check in staff were efficient and friendly. Whilst checking in we booked breakfast for the following morning.The room that we were allocated on the 1st floor was located right next to a large extract duct from the kitchen below. It was not until we were unpacked and in bed that the constant drone from this, mixed with a metallic banging noise every minute or so could be heard. Fortunately it stopped at around midnight. The following morning we went down for breakfast and popped to look at what was available and I immediately asked for a refund of the £8 per person along with a request to be moved room. The chap on reception said that we would have to wait until after 8 a.m when the daytime staff arrived. We decided to out of the hotel to find breakfast. We walked the short distance to Tesco but unfortunately they do not have cafe facilities but 30 yes up the Old Kent Rd towards Tower Bridge there is a small cafe which serves variations of a cooked breakfast for £5. Perfectly adequate and good value. We returned to the hotel just after 8 , spoke to another person who said we would have to wait until 8:30 a.m when the supervisor would be available. We returned at 8:30 (now pushing time as we needed to leave for our event) and was told no problem in allocating another room and also that if we had any problems, whatever the time, to speak to reception. This was dealt with efficiently and with no problems. The breakfast was a different matter. I explained that despite the list of items available being on display, that the reality of seeing it led me to request a refund. This person couldn't authorise this and would have to speak later to the manager. I asked that they leave a msg on reception for me to collect later. We returned later this evening and went to our new room to unpack (we had previously packed and loaded everything into our vehicle due to lack of time). The room was large and spacious. My wife accidentally pulled the undersheet up with the duvet and was met with a large coffee/tea stain and long hair strand. The complimentary bottles in the bathroom had already been started. Waste products still in the bathroom bin. The room had a bath this time so we thought 'great' we can have a bath but after struggling to work out how to make the bath plug push down i pulled it up to be met with the sight of a large amount of hair wrapped around it!!! The plugs are not designed to be used for a bath meaning you can only use the shower facility. At this point we had a choice - go and complain, get moved again or grin and bear it thinking we will be out of here in a few hours. Looking around the room you can see that it has been refurbished a couple of times in a shoestring. Old light switch positions filled in with a different material rather than providing a new bedhead, holes in walls where different fittings used to be etc. The next morning we went down to breakfast and I asked at reception about my refund to be met with 'no idea what you are talking about'. I decided the easiest thing was to ask to have the breakfast that I had paid for but not used which was granted but I really wish I hadn't. The menu states that scrambled egg, sausages and beans are available along with toast, croissants etc. Being used to 'premier Inn' style buffet this could not be further from it. The hot food looked absolutely terrible and i could not bring myself to try it and so settled for toast which you do yourself in a domestic type toaster. There were small muffins, juice, hot drinks from a machine etc but if you want a good breakfast to start your day save your money. Overall - good parking although you do pay for it. Rooms hit and miss if it will be clean. Breakfast - don't bother. If you want Premier Inn, go to a Premier Inn. Would not stay here again.

title: Not bad at all for a stopover if you need to be near there - but not near tower bridge
text: Giving it four stars for what it is - cheap accommodation by London standards, don't go expecting a four star hotel.
