Our room was on the top floor so we had a great view. The room was spotlessly clean, plugs by the bed, good lighting in the bathroom for getting ready, opposite the train station with a co-op, Waitrose and Starbucks across the road. Free carpark and we were allowed to leave the car in the car park after we checkout out so we could head into central London!!

title: Rayners park travelodge
text: Clean comfortable rooms. Not spacious but adequate. Very comfortable bed. Very near station which is handy but does mean it can be quite noisy if window left open. The staff were polite smart and helpful. Breakfast was 'Ok' but pricey considering quality.

title: OK basic hotel and near railway station with plenty of trains into Waterloo Station
text: Room clean but lack of towels in bathroom which we did not notice until it was too late - already in shower. Charged us an extra £10 to book in early! Bar advertised as being open 24 hours but closes at midnight.

title: Don't expect a lie-in
text: I've stayed in the Travelodge several times whilst working for a nearby company. For me this is a hotel of choice as I know I can trust it to be clean, tidy and comfortable. One of the most frustrating bits of the hotel for me, which there aren't many, is the simple fact that every door in the corridors slams shut with a hefty bang which then reverberates up the corridor. If you are staying here make sure you request a room as far away from the main guest door as possible otherwise make sure you are ready for the 5:30 wake up, unfortunately no rooms were available for me on this occasion. The quiet "business floor" also makes no difference with people up and talking, banging around with no consideration of other guests. Other than the early wake up, staff are super friendly, breakfast is simple but just perfect to grab something. Will again happily stay here again- fingers crossed they will put some changes in top stop the constant banging!

title: Clean & good value for London
text: Perfect place to stay when you just need a bed for the night! Clean, helpful staff, next to station. Even booked the wrong night and they sorted me a bed for the sat night at short notice at no extra charge!

title: very clean and comfortbale
text: sorry to say i thing im not happy with is when i booked in i had to change my dates, and did not get a refund on the wifi why i dont know and no warning that i would not be refunded, i checked every where with no luck, so it would be nice for u to get in touch

title: Love Raynes Park Travelodge
text: Very friendly staff. Great location for me, especially easy to pop into Kingston for shopping. Great for transport links with the station opposite and plenty of buses to the tram stop. Easy to get into Surrey too.

title: Travelodge Raynes Park 10/10
text: Absolutely fantastic hotel, incredible value for money, staff were superb having the bar open serving drinks and pizza's when we returned at midnight. Very well kept and clean hotel, good size room, free wifi in room, fantastic comfortable mattress and pillows, great shower. What's not to love about this hotel? Added bonus, free parking on site!

title: Wimbledon Visit
text: Stayed for 2 nights during the Wimbledon Championship. Very clean room and a good size. Well supplied tea and coffee facilities. Very pleasant and helpful staff, particularly in the reception area. Iced water available in reception which was a nice touch. Breakfast was very good. Good position being opposite the railway station. Best Travelodge that we have visited. No complaints.

title: Very happy with our stay
text: Have stayed in Travelodge locally and not really impressed, thankfully this was a better experience! Came for Wimbledon tennis. Walked there, took about an hour but very nice walk part of it through Wimbledon Common. Room was absolutely spotless, and staff friendly and helpful. Didn't eat there so can't comment on that. Did notice though (although we didn't drive) that car park was always full.

title: first class
text: clean and friendly great location nothing was too much trouble, will return this summer and bring husband and travel into town from station over road and leave car. at site in secure carpark make travel much easier

title: Wimbledon Stay
text: We stayed at this travelodge and we were very pleased. The staff were extremely helpful and the hotel was clean and the rooms comfortable. We walked to Wimbledon Tennis which took about 40 mins but there are buses running from the door of the hotel to Wimbledon Village every few mins if you do not like to walk or a taxi would cost £10. We arrived by train and the hotel is just 2 mins from the station which is ideal. I would recommend this Travelodge and would happily stay there again.

my partner and I stayed here for two nights during Wimbledon champsionships. The staff were helpful with parking difficulties and tried to assist with heat issues in the room due to hot weather. Food was good. Would have been nice to have WiFi included in the price!

title: Disabled friendly
text: Easy access to car park, hotel and room for wheelchair. Friendly and helpful staff both on reception desk and bar/cafe. Room a bit hot and train noise loud if you open window but other than that enjoyed stay and would stay here for future hospital appointment in London.

title: Good stay
text: Stayed here after a trip to Wimbledon with work colleagues, good stay provided with fans for the rooms- well needed in this heat! Hearty breakfast with choice of continental or full english. Basic hotel, good for a nights stay, wouldn't stay any longer.

title: Good value
text: Was here on the 23rd,quick and easy check in and check out.Didn't like the 3pm check in time and fact that they use a premium phone number which meant I wasn't able to check if they allow an earlier check in .Nothing else to fault them but good clean place and good value for money.

title: Great stay and great location
text: Perfect for my needs, great value for money. Want to go again next year. Great location for buses and trains to underground and national rail. Need to book again for July 2017 but travelodge don't take bookings this far in advance ☹️

title: Unfortunate experience
text: Generally, I have good things to say about this Travelodge but I had a very unfortunate experience last week. I was unpacking and my toddler was pottering around me. Next thing I stepped on a big wet patch on the floor and my toddler was holding a cup (I'm guessing from the bar, certainly not the room) that had the remains of a substance that I couldn't identify. I'm not sure if he had managed to ingest any but I am horrified that this room was not cleaned properly and that it was left there for him to find! I spent the whole night worrying about whether he had consumed any of the unknown contents mainly for the germ factor but also of course for the possible alcohol factor! I have no idea how old it was either. Not impressed. Cleaners should probably check under beds.

title: Excellent Stau
text: Good service, Clean rooms, Value for Money, Courteous staff, Easy check-in and check out, Convenient location. Would stay here again and recommend to friends and relatives. Good alternative to staying in Central London.

title: Good location near station.
text: If you are visiting London this hotel is far out but good value for money. There is a Wetherspoons nearby the breakfasts are cheaper there. Service in the bar was slow but I think that is down to shortage of staff. Not far from Wimbledon for the tennis. Only way to get twin rooms is to book an accessible room. Quite a new Travelodge - fine for a short stay if you are planning to be out all day. When you arrive at Raynes Park station look for the Co-Op it is above it. There are 2 exits from the station so be careful which one you exit from.

title: Welcoming Accommodation
text: We have stayed a couple of times at the Raynes Park Travelodge and found the accommodation to be good. The staff have always excelled. A big thank you to Tracy Lenahan on reception, your friendly and generous attitude made our stay very comfortable. Nothing is ever to much trouble for you. The bed is comfortable, the shower hot. Location is excellent.

title: Parking issue!!
text: On Thurs 14th June I stayed at the Raynes Park Travel lodge. I was in London for 2 days with my young daughter and I knew we wouldn't be arriving until mid evening. I specifically picked Raynes Park even though it was a 45 drive from our London work address because, it had a car park and I didn't want to be walking around London late at night with a child after trying to find a close parking space. When we arrived at 9pm the car park was totally full with no outside road parking at all. I hung around for 10mins in the car park to see if a space would become available but it didnt. I had to double park and leave my daughter in the car whilst I ran into travel lodge to ask if they had any idea where I can park. Receptionist said there was nothing she could do and suggested I park in Waitrose carpark and walk back but she couldn't guarantee we wouldn't get a ticket. If I had known the parking was this terrible at your travel lodge, I could have stayed at one if the 4 travel lodges I drove past on the way to get to this one, all of which had no parking (which is why I didn't book them) In the end I had to take a risk and leave my car in a residential street quite far away, that had permit parking only and had to walk in the dim light across an area of London I didn't know with my daughter and our bags all the way back to the travel lodge! Our room was clean and tidy and how I would expect one of the rooms to look, however I didn't have a shower until 11pm and then realised the extractor fan in the bathroom wasn't working. It was too late to change rooms because my daughter was already in bed. This filled the room with steam which means we had to have the window open open all night which in turn kept us awake because the trains going past every 10 mins were very loud! The next morning we had to leave early and I explained the problems to reception on check out. He apologised and offered us a free breakfast but we didn't have time. I use travel lodges regually and have always picked the ones with onsite parking due to my daughter being with me in London regularly when we need to sleep over . I really can't take the risk of having to park elsewhere next time due to safety concerns so am seriously considering if I can use travel lodge again.

title: OVERNIGHT STAY WHILST VISITING FAMILY
text: this is a fairly new Travelodge in a busy London suburb.Rooms are quite small compared to other budget hotels. Our first allocated room did not have air conditioning and was very hot upon entry even though the curtains were closed. Upon complaint to reception, our room was changed to include air con. However, it took another visit to reception as only one set of hand/bath towels were provided. The one redeeming feature of this property was ample free parking at rear/side of hotel.

title: Travel lodge or travel bodge?
text: Came up with family for a couple of days seeing the sights of London so this place seemed good to Base ourselves from. Got early check in from 12 noon so managed to drop our stuff to our room nice and early. The free car park was adequate and we were allowed to leave our car there after we had checked out the next day which was a bonus. Railway station just 5 minutes walk from hotel which is ideal for getting in and out of London. Plenty of tea making facilities and overall price was good. There is WiFi but need to pay after 30 minutes. I found our room very hot. Had turned off the heating but it made no difference to the temperatures but fans were provided ìn the room. Breakfast was ok in the morning but a lack of fried eggs with a fry up was a bad point. All in all a good hotel for a short stay. Had the room temperature been better and fried egg with the breakfast I would have given a solid 5 star.

title: Much improvement needed
text: This Travelodge is newly built and in a good location for traveling to London by train. The rooms are small, stuffy and somewhat claustrophobic even by budget hotel standards. We stayed for 3 nights and the room was not vacuumed during our stay. Some of the staff were helpful but some were standoffish and less helpful. The hotel has a dinning room with a well stocked bar that serves breakfast and simple evening meals. The breakfast at £7.95 per person was good value offering an all you can eat self service buffet. The evening meals were pre cooked reheated food that were dry and not very appetising. The prices were reasonable but the food was poor. Close to the hotel is a Greene King pub/restaurant and also a Whetherspoon. Both of these offered much better quality, better value food. The Travelodge was reasonably cheap £40 per night, but the standard was much lower than Premier inns that we usually stay in. We gave Travelodge a try but probably won't stay here again

title: Great hotel, simple clean and cost effective
text: There are many cheap hotels in London but one good thing about the travelodge is you know what to expect. In this case, a clean, new, simply laid out hotel with free parking and great location for central London or other local attractions. Only downside is I had to take my wife with me.

title: All you need for an overnight stay!
text: A well priced hotel situated a short walk from the station. Good, clean and friendly. The reception staff were very helpful. Unfortunately the dining room was empty at dinner time which gave it no atmosphere.

title: Exactly what we were looking for!
text: We chose Travelodge Raynes Park as our base for a family weekend in London and were very pleased with our choice. The rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable, the location ideal for our trips into central London by rail, and the on-site free car parking added to our value for money experience.

title: Comfortable Stay
text: This hotel had everything we needed for a one night stay. Free on site parking near to all facilities is a plus. The place is clean, tidy and the bed comfortable. If your room is on the railway side and you leave the window open you can hear the trains.

title: Excellent hotel in a great location
text: We booked Travelodge Raynes Park for one night to start off a week of activities in London and were given a room on the business floor. The hotel is relatively new and is well looked after. Our room had air conditioning which was very powerful and made for a great nights sleep, as well as a newer spec shower room. Bed was extremely comfortable and the rooms have flat screen TV's. The train station is about a minute walk from the front door, and there is a Co-op as part of the hotel's building. Reception staff were very friendly as were the bar staff. Definitely going to come back to this hotel!

title: DOORS SLAMMING ALL THE TIME
text: Hotel came recommended by guest in another travelodge First impressions v gd Upkeep good comfortable bed and pillows Bathroom looked new if. V small BUT ENDED UP AS BEING WORST STAY EVER IN A TRAVELODGE DOORS SLAMMING ALL THE TIME BECAUSE HOTEL MAINANENCE HAS NIT RESET THE DOOR CLOSING MECHANISMS NOT CUSTOMERS FAULT : hotels fault Slammed so. Badly I don't think they have ever been adjusted You could even here them slamming on other floors Terrible With this in mined would like a refund please Stayed 27/05/ Confirmation number 1446303972 Mr A Von Harrach Stayed room 410 Shame because building upto scratch decor wise nice area and v gd reception staff Hotel should have sorted this over the 3 years it's been open

title: Last minute booking
text: Clean and comfortable hotel staff very friendly, great parking facility included in the price, good location for getting into London. We booked this hotel the night before our stay and was very satisfied.

title: Not bad for a Travelodge
text: Stayed one night for business. It was clean as it has recently been renovated, the bed was large and comfortable. The staff friendly. Only issue was the shower pressure which was a bit low, but for one night, was adequate.

title: New hotel. Nice and clean.
text: We stayed in April soon after opening. Very nice. We liked the new comfy bed. The room was very clean, nice bar and restaurant. Had a good night's sleep. Staff were eager, polite and friendly. Will use this Travelodge again.

title: A VERY SPARTAN FEEL TO THIS TRAVELODGE
text: This is a newly built Travelodge ...........and it showed. The rooms were pretty basic ~ beds / mattresses are very high off the ground and very difficult to get on / off

title: Raynes park
text: The hotel was newly built so clean and comfortable. Lovely staff but not sufficient to provide cover for both reception and cafe as the hotel was fully booked. The bedrooms did not have air conditioning and although a fan was provided in each room it was not sufficient for the family room we had which had one very small window in the corner so we had no breeze. My family also stayed in double rooms which were basic but small. They also struggled with the room temperature! Our ages were combined from 9 to 78!

title: A very unfortunate stay
text: A friend and I had a bag stolen which contained our house key so we were forced to stay overnight in the Travelodge before sourcing a spare key the next morning, so we ended up arriving at about 12.45am. There were some quite interesting characters hanging around outside, including a woman with white hair who was following us from the car park to reception, muttering at us. We asked at reception if there was a room available, and, for some reason, they laughed in our face. We asked again, and seemingly begrudgingly, they entered in our details. The person on the desk seemed to be being trained, so this took a long time and they seemed to be very amused the whole time, and not very professional. While waiting, we noticed the front desk was covered in spots of blood. I mentioned this to my friend and the lady behind the desk gave me a filthy look and then got out some tissues and wiped some of the blood up. After a long wait, we finally received a room key. There were a lot of drunk people all over the communal areas and one man was standing outside the door of the room we would be in which was very intimidating, especially since there is keycard entry to the corridor where the rooms are, but it clearly hadn't stopped this man. We double locked the door as soon as we had rushed in. There seemed to be something wrong with the plumbing, as there was a loud roaring sound every few minutes and we realised that after we had used the toilet or the sink, the roaring sound happened so we surmised that it was probably happening every time anyone else used the plumbing. It was very loud and disruptive, and unfortunate for the hour that it was. There were also a LOT of people talking loudly both at night and very early in the morning, but I can't really blame Travelodge for this. With regards to the room, it was pretty standard, although with very hard pillows. We left at around 8am the next morning and came out through the breakfast room/bar area where we found the strange white haired lady who had followed us to reception when we checked in, asleep on the sofa. The TV has clearly been on the 'BabeStation' channel as there was a screen stating that it would be back that evening. This was the cherry on the top. My friend found this hilarious, and so took a photo of the screen showing the Babe Station logo, however, one of the receptionists who had checked us is came over and began berating us as he thought we were photographing the woman asleep on the sofa. I don't know if this woman has some sort of arrangement with the Travelodge that she wanders around then sleeps on their communal sofas...but it was very disconcerting. This was, unfortunately, not the worst hotel I have ever stayed in, but it is right up there. We found the staff to be rude, unhelpful and it was such a horrific experience from start to finish that we couldn't help but laugh. And we were charged over £50 for the pleasure. Although we hadn't planned to stay in the first place, we just needed refuge, we will decidedly NEVER be returning! I am baffled as to how this has such good reviews!

title: Loved it
text: I was going to see Skindred at Brixton Academy & as this hotel is opposite the train station, & was a great price, I went for it. Lovely friendly greeting & a very clean room with a great shower. I didn't have time to eat dinner there but when I went into the bar when I returned at around midnight & asked for another couple of tea bags I was directed to reception where I could get all the supplies I wanted. I was concerned about train noise, but didn't hear anything & slept really well. Breakfast was fab with a great choice, some good veggie options & great staff. Great hotel at a great price.

title: Great visit at it's best
text: Booked this hotel beforehand for my sisters surprise birthday getaway. Can i just say how amazing the staff were especially Odi who was very attentive. I had to ring the hotel many times regarding a birthday cake ordering one getting it to the hotel for the staff to receive it without us checking in which was all done very well. We had rooms 327 and 332 both rooms lovely 332 with airport view of the planes and 327 was very big spacious and very clean. Transport easy access literally few seconds away. Breakfast fresh very decent yummy food. We were here for 2 nights and it was a pleasant stay. Will definately book this hotel when coming to visit London once again. Thank you so much

title: Great service
text: Hotel great location and great service from all the staff......from Jo and Pilar at reception to the bar staff everyone made you feel welcome and could not do enough for you. We enjoyed the complimentary breakfast and the atmosphere was great

title: Convenient for what we needed
text: I had booked a family room for an event at the Excel for 2 nights. DLR is 2 minutes walk at the Royal Albert stop, so easy to find the hotel. On arrival we were greeted by very friendly reception staff and given the keys to a second floor family room. The family room was extremely small and consisted of a double bed and a very small sofa bed. I was sharing with 3 teenagers, so there was not a lot of room for maneuvering. It was all clean, but not a lot of extras in the room for the money paid unfortunately. Bar was nice, good atmosphere but £20 for 2 drinks was a bit steep I thought, but I suppose that's London prices for you. Breakfast was good. Bacon, sausage, eggs, croissants, muffins, yogurts and cereals etc. Staff really lovely and made sure all was replenished. Plenty of seating. All in all it was ok for what we needed and was only a 10 minute (if that) walk to the Excel. Toying with the rating, just paid lot of money for what it was, enjoyable stay though.

title: Very Good Value Stay
text: My wife and I stayed here for one night whilst attending the Telegraph Cruise Show at London Excel. This was one of the best priced hotels in the area and although, obviously, lacking the amenities of the more expensive hotels, it met our needs perfectly. From the moment we checked in, to our departure, the staff were extremely friendly and went out of their way to be helpful. The room was comfortable and clean, as was the rest of the hotel. The restaurant, although not fine dining, had a good choice of evening meal at a reasonable price. Breakfast was included in the price of the room, and again had a good choice. The hotel is an easy 10 to 15 minute walk to the Excel and has good views over the river to London City Airport, which is a few minutes drive away, or a 20 minute walk. The hotel did not seem to suffer from noise from the airport, and I found it to be a most peaceful and restful hotel. Ideal for attending London Excel.

title: A little dissapointed
text: Im at the Holiday Inn Express Excel while writing this review. First room we ordered had a double bed but was tiny. So we asked for two single beds. Second room with two single beds was better but we had problems with the loud air-conditioning in our room. Air-conditioning was running from 06:45 in the morning until 23:00 at night so no chance of sleeping outside of this period. Breakfast was understaffed and chaotic with no real effort from the kitchen staff to be friendly or helpful. Fresh plates from the dishwasher that were dirty and wet. Attached a photo of the wall in the first room that we luckily changed from.. The staff at the front desk were friendly but seemed not really that well trained. Location is good. Bathroom and rooms are generally ok. Dissapointing as we had a different experience 2 years ago. Real room for improvement...

title: Brilliant hotel in a brilliant location.
text: Booked this hotel stay in for a few days with friends, with the purpose of visiting London for theatre trips. Initially, I was worried that the distance from central London would put me off, but in fact, I found the quietness of the area (despite being so near an airport) was very much worth the distance. With the DLR station being a couple of minutes walk from the hotel, I found it handy for the late nights I was arriving to the hotel each night. I was given a hotel room on the front of the hotel, so facing the airport and this gave me few doubts with noise levels. However, I was pleasantly surprised when I woke up in the morning and wasn't disturbed one bit. I experienced both the bed and sofa bed and found that both of them were extremely comfortable. One feature I particularly liked about the room was the size of the shower. Many hotels that I have stayed in are fitted with small shower cubicles yet this had enough room to actually move around in! The staff from the get go were extremely helpful and went out of their way to help in any way they possibly could. I enjoyed the range in items for breakfast and the staff were on their feet in replacing food items when they were low. I took advantage of the use of the restaurant in the evenings and one night, I arrived into the hotel when he restaurant was closed. However, the staff member on shift was quick to inform me that they were still able to make pizzas on the night and I couldn't have been more happier! The food you get is a great value for money, decent portions and incredibly handy when there are no nearby restaurants as alternatives. I'm due to return to the hotel very soon as I found no faults in my previous visit.

title: Clean comfy hotel
text: Wasn't quite Mallorca sat next to the pool with endless cocktails lol thanks to Monarch leaving us stranded in London forcing us to make a plan b city break,so on that plan we booked this hotel which was fairly priced and included breakfast,food was all ok,hotel is close to train station for hopping into the city,ok little pub at the end of the road,shame we hadn't flown to London city airport as it's just across from hotel,Jane was great and lively on the bar along night with Sam so nice to hear cockney accents,the young German girl on reception was great and extended our check out time which all helped,and thanks to Steph for helping us with info on sites in London

title: Terrible service
text: Terrible service left a gift bag with presents Inside in our hotel room called three times before anyone dealt with my situation, they called me back hours later to tell me nothing was found in the room which was lies staff clearly have sticky fingers won't be staying here again or recommending it to anyone!!

title: This hotel could be one if the most practical in London if you are traveling as a family with children.
text: This was a family visit to London, two adults, a three and a half year old and an eleven month old. We’re still finding our feet traveling as a foursome and everything you learned and perfected with one small person in tow needs to be relearned with one small person and another smaller person in tow. When travelling with children there is a huge benefit in somewhere that offers breakfast, preferably free. Or to couch that slightly more fairly, included in the cost. The Holiday Inn Express chain do just that, the price always includes breakfast. Big tick in the box there then! Then we come to the car. If you’re traveling with a very small baby then the benefit of having your car to hand to take and store baby stuff is massive. The Holiday Inn Express at London Excel ticks that box as well, a big, well lit and easily accessible car park right at the back of the hotel. You have to pay, which I think is £12 for 24 hours, but it’s London and your is right there. Incidentally if you’re staying at the Travelodge next door, the parking for 24 hours is £8 for guests. The hotel itself is relatively new, certainly in the last five years and it looks new. The reception area is very light and airy and the staff are very friendly, attentive and will do as much as they can to help and please. The reception blends into the bar and then the restaurant as an L shape off the reception area. Also in reception are a few vending machines. One of these has travel essentials that you may have forgotten, this one accepts cash and card payments. There is also a coffee machine and a traditional drinks and snacks vending machines. These only take cash, (coin), payment. The rooms are to a good standard for budget hotels in the U.K. at this Holiday Inn Express the bathrooms all how large power showers, so if you’re a bath lover you’ll need to look elsewhere, next door maybe at the Travelodge which does have baths! Shower gel and soaps are provided in the bathrooms. The bed is a double in size and is perfectly comfortable. However it is interesting that direct competitors, Premier Inn and Travelodge now provide king size beds as standard. This can really make a difference to your stay. There is a 22” or a 26” TV in the room which has standard UK Freeview. The television will also freely allow you to plug any HDMI connected device into it and use it to watch your own TV programs or films. Something, as per one of my previous reviews, the the higher end sister brand, Crowne Plaza, does not allow you to do, unless you know how to bypass it. Now the not so great bit is that having recently stated in a Premier Inn in London as a family, they provided a king size bed, two good size single fold out beds and a cot. All fitting in the room perfectly and there was still room to move around. Not so with the Holiday Inn Express room. Given that it’s a relatively new hotel, this surprises me. We made it work, but it was a faff and in comparison to the Premier Inn, there is a real choice to be made when booking if you’re traveling in this configuration. Interestingly the very helpful staff tried to put us in an accessible room to give us more space, which was and would have continued to have need great, but for the fact that there is no fold out sofa bed, but plenty of room for a cot! End result was that despite the best intentions of the staff to get us more space, it couldn’t be achieved so we ended up in a standard sized room. We ate in the restaurant the first night and I think that you know if before you start, but you are paying inflated prices for the convenience of eating in your hotel. For two children’s meals, and two burgers, two children’s drinks and two large diet colas the bull was just over £50. The food standard was fine, no complaints, but that’s at least £15 more than what you would normally pay for a compatible meal. Breakfast is great and always is at Holiday Inn Express. Bacon, sausages, scrambled egg, beans, toast, cornflakes, pastries, hot drinks, and fruit juice. It’s a world away from when the brand first started up, in the early days it consisted of toast and processed sliced cheese! For it always being included in the price, I think that it’s always very good! The location is an interesting one. It’s just down from the east end of Excel, about a two minute walk away from the Prince Albert DLR stop and just across the dock from London City Airport. If you love aeroplanes and watching them take off and land, then this is the hotel / area to stay for you! There is no small corner shop type supermarket within walking distance, but there is on at the opposite end of Excel which is three stops down on the DLR to Royal Victoria. The big plus point of this location is that it’s one of the cheaper places to stay in London, unless something is in at Excel and as I’ve already said, if you need your car close then I can’t think of anywhere better in the London area. It is around a 30 to 45 minute journey by DLR and Tube into central London. Four stops on the DLR gets you to the Jubilee Line and this will whisk you to the O2, London Bridge, Southwark, Westminster, or Green Park. Provided the Canning Town Station, where you have to change from DLR to Jubilee, have their lifts working, which so often is not the case and always best off to check, then the journey to those places is step free. Alternatively if you carry on to Stratford City on either the DLR, (platform and elevation change required), or change to Jubilee Line to be quicker. From Stratford you can get the Central Line or London Overground to many destinations in central London. The Central Line at Stratford is step free and whilst the majority of the line isn’t, Tottenham Court Road now is, so is Bond Street. Interestingly when the Queen Elizabeth Line is up and running it will stop at Prince Regent on the DLR, one stop away from the hotel. This will take you rapidly into central London and stops, amongst other places, at Stratford City, Farringdon, Tottenham Court Road and Bond Street. Just in case anyone isn’t familiar, Stratford City is not Stratford in Warwickshire, the home of William Shakespear. Also again if you didn’t know and you’re looking at the tube map, the Abbey Road DLR stop on the way up to Stratford from the hotel is not the Abbey Road of the Beatles fame, you need to be on the Bakerloo Line heading north and get off at Warwick Avenue. Summary of the positives: Great if you’re travelling with children and you need your car close by to carry and store associated kelt Breakfast is included Clean and tidy Great staff Very close to the DLR Great views of London City Airport Close to Stratford Westfield & Olympic Park Close to ExCel Can be cheap to stay here considering that you are in London Summary of the not so good points: It’s a relative trek into central London If you’re staying on a weekend, check with Transport for London to make sure that the DLR isn’t closed for maintenance. If it is, it’s a long walk, or a taxi / bus ride to get to and from the hotel without using your car If you’re staying as a family with the fold out bed and a cot then he room is small in comparison to direct competitors. So, all in all I really like the Holiday Inn Express at London Excel, for its ease of access to the DLR and wider transport network. For it’s parking facilities, for its dependable standard and it’s friendly staff.

title: Great place to stay for the Excel or City Airport
text: Stayed here while working at the Excel Centre for a conference and it was only a ten minute walk from reception to the Excel Centre East Entrance. It is a very modern hotel (they are still building more new hotels in the area) and has the usual Holiday Inn Express conveniences. Rooms are a good size, clean and well stocked - bathroom only has a shower no bath tub. There is a bar by reception but it does not have a great choice of drinks (No Stout on tap or even in a bottle/can when I stayed) but there is a good food choice from the restaurant. If you want to eat in your room you will have to come down to bring your tray to your room yourself. Irons and ironing boards can also be collected from reception if you need one. Breakfast was nice and has the usual choice of hot and cold foods but I was disappointed that there were no hot mushrooms available to go with your bacon/scrambled egg/sausage/baked beans. All in all a recommended place to stay while visiting the Excel centre or before/after a flight from London City airport. There is a DLR stop 2 minutes walk away, the Royal Albert.

title: Comfortable, quiet room
text: Stayed for one night with my husband and 7 and 11 year old girls. Girls had a double sofa bed which caused some arguments. Our bed was comfortable, discovered in the morning we could have selected soft pillows which would have been better! Lovely big shower which was easy to use. Enjoyed the breakfast, it filled us up for the day. Ideally situated for central London in zone 3, and you can opt for the emirates airline on the way. Handy to be able to park for 2 days. We paid £20 for both days on arrival and entered the car registration for parking eye. Credit card was debited again on second day, but this was fixed after phoning.

title: Nice hotel with breakfast included!
text: Stayed here for business, it's a little far out from what I would have called the docklands however this is reflected in the price. Nice rooms, clean, modern and spacious. Breakfast was really nice chose from fresh fruit, porridge pots, bacon, scrambled eggs, juices coffee etc. Really good. Would only stay here again if the crown plaza down the road was full or too expensive but only solely down to location

title: Ovi & Sam
text: What a combination! It’s a real treasure to find a hotel which is part of a major chain which is individual. The reason is quite simple - the staff! Having stayed there many times they were tonight’s stars! However, they are not alone as they are part of a great team. The hotel welcome is highly recommended!

title: Mr
text: What amazing people they have at this hotel. Jane, Susan, Paula, Molly and the rest of the team are truly amazing. Been here for 6 nights now and everyone makes you feel part of 'the family'. Thanks guys!

title: Excellent Hotel and great service
text: Lovely clean smart looking hotel in a great location. Shower excellent. Room big enough. Breakfast plentiful. Staff helpful. Would stay there again. Made use of the car park so it was easy in and out !!

title: Unbelievable quality from a "budget" hotel
text: The welcoming smile and instant impression of calm confidence at the front desk was apparent even before I spoke: I had an immediate impression of a hotel with a service ethos far above it's "budget" status - closer to Peninsula Hong Kong status. Tired from a long flight from the Far East and across London, it was very easy to get to, about 100 meters from the Docklands Light Railway station. The room was a very pleasant surprise, again probably because I was expecting "budget", very spacious with a bed slightly firm, promising a good nights' sleep. The bathroom was set up almost as a wet room, again very roomy with excellent modern fittings along with very ample and immediate hot water. The bar was quite busy with a very friendly and knowledgeable staff...I made it to the bar on the cusp of 22:00 when the restaurant closed and I was expecting to go hungry. Once again, I was very pleasantly surprised, as I was immediately reassured that I could eat. I have to make a special mention for Paula who gave the kind of service that, once again, one could usually only find in hotels charging five times the price...nothing was too difficult, without any hint of "being put out"...and to top everything, apple pie with custard AND ice cream...I was veritably spoiled! Breakfast was complementary, so I wasn't expecting that much but, again, I was very pleasantly surprised, a full English buffet with plenty of other fresh choices, even the coffee was great! My congratulations to all the staff at this jewel of a "budget" hotel, many can learn from your levels of service. Needless to say, my trips through London City will always include this hotel as my Hotel Of Choice.

title: Excellent Weekend With Family
text: We stayed at this hotel for a weekend break and had a family room for 2 adults and 2 children. Room was great and the kids loved the bed settee. Hotel is new and has excellent facilities. We went by car and found the hotel no problem, with direct access from the M11. Breakfast was basic but the staff ensured that everything ran smoothly. We had no issues checking in and found the staff both helpful and professional. The hotel is located on the DLR only a 2 minute walk from the Royal Albert Station, this links you to Canning Town Tube Station on the Jubilee Line which allows you access to Central London within 25 mins. Overall a excellent weekend away with my family

title: Sweet and short stay for one night
text: Stayed here for a day with my wife. Wonderful stay and helping and warm staff. The hotel is accessible to Dockland Rail and comes in handy if you have a flight from London City Airport. The food was good too... Thumps Up for this hotel.

title: Quiet and Enjoyable
text: Excellent view of the London City Airport, About 2 minutes walk from the train station. I stayed in a very clean and tidy room and I get the impression that this is same for all the other rooms. Staff were courteous and helpful. Enjoyed my stay.

title: Great Hotel for RideLondon or visiting London with Kids
text: Stayed with my family for RideLondon in a room with a Sofabed as have 2 small kids. Service was good and excellent touch that they laid on an early (4am!) breakfast for riders who had an early start. I was also able to check in to the room at 9.30 which was fantastic. Its a really nice modern recently built hotel with easy access from the M11 or M25 and good parking.

title: Budget hotel with a premium feel.
text: I stayed at this hotel very recently whilst attending a conference nearby. The hotel may be branded as a Holiday Inn Express but it certainly punches above its weight. Great location, great facilities and excellent rooms that are very clean and modern. The food in the restaurant was very nice indeed, although the menu is limited it certainly has a good variety of meals to choose from. All of the staff were absolutely superb, and I really can’t praise them enough. One person I think very worthy of a special mention, was Susan behind the bar. If IHG had awards for the best member of staff I would vote for her, as she really does go the extra mile to look after all of her customers. I shall definitely stay at this hotel on my next visit to the area.

title: Xmas present to each other
text: What an excellent holiday Inn. The staff were really helpful and friendly in particular Paula, such a funny and happy person. The room was clean and up to the usual standard. I will certainly stay here again.

title: Great Location, clean, modern. Bar staff - lovely!
text: Stayed here, as vistiing event at The O2. Easy access to where we needed to go. Car parking an absolute bonus and not too expensive, definatly cheaper than getting the train!. Hotel and rooms were clean, modern and functional. Check in/Check out very smooth process. Bar and restaurant staff Paula and Jane, an absolute delight. Very friendly and helpful. Would definatly stay here again if visiting the area.

title: Very good Hotel
text: I was last November in London in business and stayed in this hotel. It was very good for my needs, clean and professional team made my stay very comfortable. The breakfast was good, but the dinner could be better. I will use it again for sure.

title: Amazing friendly staff
text: My wife and I have just spent the Easter week-end staying in this hotel, from the moment we were greeted at reception by the very charming Andra we found the hotel staff were very happy to go out of their way to make you feel that they were happy that you chose their hotel and wanted to make your stay memorable. We were meeting up with family who were visiting London from their home in Germany and were flying into Stanstead very early on Easter Sunday. Because they wouldn't be able to check in until 2.00.PM we decided to stay overnight on the Saturday, so we would be at the hotel to meet them on arrival and they could use our room to store their luggage. Saturday night the hotel was fully booked and the restaurant very busy, but we were very pleased to find that once placing our order our food arrived fairly quickly. My wife had selected the Steak special and I had the burger special, all came to our satisfaction. The breakfast being a bank holiday was available from 7.30-11.00 and had a very good selection of hot and cold choices. On the Sunday night we ate in the Restaurant again with our German family and two had the steak special unfortunately one of the steaks was over cooked, and the waitress replaced it without any fuss, but sadly the second steak although cooked to perfection was very grisly which sadly spoilt my wife's evening. The hotel is literally a few minute walk from Royal Albert DLR station, but there is nothing around the hotel other than other hotels, it overlooks London City airport, but we were not disturbed by any noise. If you are just looking for a hotel on the outskirts of London and are happy to use DLR and the Underground system this hotel is ideal. We would certainly stay here again.

title: Great place with good staff
text: My room was of a good size. The hotel was clean and I did not find any issues with the beds or bathroom. I want to give a special shoutout to Neli from reception. She went the extra mile to make my stay comfortable, she was extremely knowledgeable of the services available and she helped me immensely with the planning of parking my van. Great employee and I would gladly come back to this property due to the special efforts she made to make me feel welcomed and at ease.

title: Several visits report - Very good value for money (at times!)
text: have stayed here a few times on business so my summary of those visits. Rooms are good, not too big but well designed so they feel bigger. Bathroom modern, and a touch I love at all HI Express the night light for the bathroom. For some reason the TV controls can be difficult and the last 2 times I couldn't find the radio. Surprised at good reviews of the bar and restaurant, the bar has limited wine list (2 or 3 reds) and short of staff. I ate one evening in the restaurant and my view is way over priced for what is effectively a cafeteria. Why not just offer a similar offer to breakfast, ie a buffet. Breakfast is included, and they even offer takeaways to facilitate that. I don't generally have breakfasts, but a sausage and bacon roll is too tempting!! My main gripe is parking fees. Why charge £15 per day for guests, especially when there is nothing on at excel. There is little obvious alternative if you don't know the area, as there is no on street parking, BUT having stayed a few time here and elsewhere my advice is that the excel car parks outside doubletree and premier inn are a better bet (free after 5.30pm).

title: Great place to stay
text: Very nice new hotel, very clean, comfortable, staff were very friendly & helpful, great price for hotel & breakfast, definitely good value for money, good regular tube link very close by, breakfast was good. Free WiFi. Would definitely stay there again.

title: Overnight stay near London City Airport
text: We stayed at the Holiday Inn Express due to its location in close proximity to London City Airport as we had an early morning flight the next day. This isn't a hotel that we would typically choose for leisure and I suspect this is true of most patrons. Overall, it definitely served its purpose. The staff were helpful and courteous. The lobby was very noisy. We did not take advantage of the complimentary breakfast so can't comment on the quality. Two things stand out in making your choice if you are looking for hotels: convenient location and comfort. In reference to the former, it is great. It is only a couple of minute taxi ride to the airport, and just a few minute walk to the DLR if you want to have dinner somewhere (there are few options close to the hotel). The comfort is not great, however. The room and the bed for our stay were tiny and the bed really couldn't accommodate two normal sized adults ( I spent the night feeling like I was going to fall out of the bed). So, if you stay here, opt for the largest room/bed that you can.

title: perfect visit and amzing staff
text: During my visit from the 1st sept till the 3rd sept when i was given my room key i went up to find a very nice room and accessible bathroom which was important as being in a wheelchair. Day 2 we used the meeting room downstairs. One member of staff Susan was amazing she made sure we had what we needed and the room we were in was very warm so she brought us all ice lollies in she made the weekend amazing and carnt thank her enough.

title: Excel Comic Con 2017
text: Well this is London so it's not cheap, but we had never been to comic con before the room was excellent the wifi was good and the breakfast very good, stayed over for one night. Staff was very good especially Virginia who was extremely helpful, the area is not too far away from the Excel but the lazy can jump on the DLR and go one stop right up to the door.

title: simon n dave.
text: great hotel .staff friendly.paula n samantha work great together..they know how treat you n have a laff n giggle but still profensonal.great chinese across rd n 8 mins in taxi.was here for 4 nights every night packed.

title: Review.
text: Hotel was perfect for our needs - the o2 was 20 mins in an uber, rooms were clean & what you would expect for a holiday inn. Breakfast was included in the rate and was just what was needed with hot & cold options there was plenty of variety. Paula in the dining area was brilliant - friendly,helpful & personable! My only real criticism was that the bar shut at 1am (Friday night) & we had to walk down to another hotel to get a drink.

title: location
text: The location is the biggest turnoff for me. It is very far away from the tourist areas and is located in a super shady area. The hotel personnel were very kind and helpful. The rooms were decent but if you're a tourist find somewhere closer.

title: Friendly, Helpful & Efficient
text: A very pleasant stay in this hotel. The Spanish front desk staff was very helpful from ensuring that all my billing details were right through to making a "breakfast to go" bag for me due to an early departure. Will definitely book here again.

title: Good Hotel
text: Good hotel in a great position for tourists. Staff are very friendly especially Paula who serves at the bar. She is a star , always got a smile on her face, chatty and witty. I stay here on a regular basis and service is consistently good.

title: Great hotel before flying from London City airport
text: Did not eat here as menu looked uninteresting, but Paula behind the bar is a star. So stay here just for her. An East End girl with loads of stories........ large bedroom, great shower. Very helpful staff at reception.

title: Handy!
text: A very handy location by the DLR and useful for various London attractions. Clean, good bar area, good breakfast, friendly staff, modern. Travel cot was a tight squeeze so that could have been better dealt with but otherwise good.

title: An ExCel-ent hotel!
text: A lovely new hotel, spotlessly clean. Really nice room, good size too. Friendly, helpful staff. Good food, but not a big selection. Great value, will definitely stay here again when in the area. Well done!

title: Comfortable one-night stay
text: This was a one-night stay whilst visiting friends in London. The hotel was clean and new. Check-in was straightforward. We did not really use the WiFi very much so I can't comment on the speed but we had a good connection in our room. Breakfast was much better than I remember Holiday Inn Express breakfast of the past. Fruit, eggs, bacon, cereal and porridge were all available. Overall it was a pleasant experience and I would repeat it. The hotel reception was busy and lively at 11:00 pm on a Saturday night when we checked in. I think many people use this hotel for layovers or as an airport hotel for London City airport.

title: Friendly staff make for a great stay
text: This is a typical Holiday Inn Express. It is scrupulously clean and well maintained. As a new example it is in excellent condition. It is all you might expect of the brand. Breakfast is not the best - especially for a vegetarian. As a vegan, well there is some fresh fruit or bread and jam. Maybe even beans on (dry) toast. The evening menu was extremely limited but we were assured a new one was due to be implemented in June. Room prices get really silly if there is an event at Excel (automated tracking) so book as early as you can. Even so why did I enjoy my stay and why will I happily return? Because the staff are very friendly, helpful, considerate and understanding. They are a credit to the brand and make you feel welcome, valued and are happy to strive to make your stay pleasant and work for you. If you want a hotel near Excel or London City Airport this place is ideal.

title: Immaculate, Quite and Safe Car Parking
text: I use this hotel regularly, for both me and my car. It is a great location, easy to find at the bottom of the M11, no traffic to contend with. Once parked up, you can relax, know you and your car are safe. Then just jump on the DLR which is right next door to access London without any hassle. Sound proofing in the Hotel is excellent, even when watching the planes at the airport from your room window. Courteous Service is provided by all staff at this Hotel, they are always happy to help and very welcoming.

title: Pretty impressed
text: At the time of booking I was a little scandalised at the price for a Holiday Inn Express but it was within walking distance of the ExCel and on arrival I was pretty impressed. Nice, bright hotel with a clean spacious room. (The only slight down side was the awful drain smell on opening the shower cabinet door. I'd suggest making sure you don't leave the shower cabinet door open or the entire bathroom stinks of bad drains.) Breakfast offered a variety of croissants, toasts, juices, fruit, yogurts and scrambled eggs with sausages. Easy walking distance to the ExCel and after some reassurance from the hotel staff that the walking route to London City Airport was safe and easy too, I gave that a go too for my journey home. All in all, none too shabby and pretty impressive as Holiday Inn Express go. Last year I stayed at the nearby Crowne Plaza which was now priced at double the cost of this HI Express. I'd definitely stay here again.

title: Jane in bar was great
text: Good hotel for a business stay. However the evening was made far better by Jane in the bar. A friendly face and smile that's most appreciated. Easy for airport and Excel. Rooms comfortable and clean. Thanks

title: Great but for one BIG issue ....
text: It took us a while to find this hotel as it wasn't anywhere as near to Excel as I had been led to believe. So we arrived as a very tired and cold bunch of 4 adults and 3 children. I had picked this hotel to take our son and his friends to the Brick Lego exhibition at Excel the next day. The hotel was full to the brim with adult lego fans, many of them exhibitors or traders at the show. This in itself wasn't a problem but for two reasons: 1) the hotel was understaffed for the number of guests, it took a while before anyone appeared at reception to check us in and 2) the 'organisers' had arranged for a Lego auction to take place in the hotel restaurant and lounge so every Lego geek within a 10 mile radius turned up at our hotel for this event. The auctioneer stood on a bar stool, was loud and used inappropriate language for our younger guests, for us older ones he was downright irritating. This should never have been allowed to take place in a residents area - it should have been in a private function room.. We could not get any cooked food as the kitchen was not geared up for the number of guests, same story for the bar. We ended up with take away pizzas and coke eaten in the reception area! To give them credit the hotel management did refund our rooms the next morning but it was so disappointing that our special occasion was affected in this way. I had been in contact with the hotel months in advance to organise a birthday cake for our son at breakfast, sadly that didn't happen as they had forgotten. The hotel is clean and when not so full and over run with fanatics I expect it is quite a nice out of the way spot. There is nothing nearby in the way of restaurants and shops so they really so need to provide whatever guests need. The beds were comfortable and rooms probably the nicest HI Express we have stayed in. So, just check what event(s) are on at Excel before booking and probably not the best choice for a special treat.

title: Great place to stay to see the sights!
text: Lovely building, very spacious and staff were very welcoming and friendly. Room was small but comfortable for 2 adults and 2 children (sofa bed) and bathroom was big! Breakfast was more that I bargained for - croissants, yogurt, granola, fresh fruit, cereal and hot items - bacon, sausage, beans and eggs Just to note this hotel is directly opposite London City airport, so if you like plane spotting this is the place to be! The noise stops at around 11pm and starts again around 6am it didn't bother me at at. Parking is£10 for 24 hours and DLR station is 100m away for all rites into London centre. Highly recommend!

title: Great Hotel
text: Staying here for a few nights on business. The hotel is located in a really good are, really near to the DLR network, London City Airport, the O2 arena and Canary Wharf. Rooms perfectly clean and a great welcome from the team too. I will be back!

title: Weeks stay
text: Very nice hotel, staff are friendly and professional, helpful and efficient. Ive given it 4 stars but the reason i didnt give it the full 5 was........ the breakfast is a real let down in fact downright diabolical. I would stay again though and i would recommend it, just dont expect a good brekkie.

title: Four night stay for convention at O2
text: Brand new hotel with no teething troubles I could see. Chosen as a budget option due to the high hotel prices more centrally and for proximity to O2. Location - right next to DLR Royal Albert. One minute walk to station with frequent trains to London (we mostly changed at Canning Town for Jubilee but you can stay on until Bank for more lines if you prefer). Given prices elsewhere, very happy with the compromise. Liked the view of planes taking off across the water - no plane noise. Room - standard sparkling new room, super shower (massive) and sufficient room with some organisation for two adult and two teens. Staff - very pleasant and helpful Food - standard HIE fare. Staff struggled to keep everything replenished quickly enough but I view that as a built in annoyance with this sort of breakfast set up when the hotel is full rather than a problem with this particular hotel For the right price I would book again. NB- not hotel's fault so not included in my rating, but all the street lights between the station and hotel are not working and the pavement a bit uneven. Not a good combo. I asked Reception if it had been reported to the council and they assured me it had.

title: Came for comicon 2017
text: Me and the family came for Comicon. Great location, close to the tube station. The staff were so helpful and despite the hotel being full it didn't feel it. Reception staff were fab, breakfast great and the place was spotless. I'd definitely recommend and will be stopping again.

title: Great Hotel, Great Location
text: Stayed here for 4 nights for a leisure break in London. The location was perfect with fantastic DLR/Tube links to get around the city and the outskirts.....within zone 3 so Oyster travel capped daily at £7.70 if you managed to get to it. Ideal for Excel, O2 and Emirates Cable Car.....5 minutes way. Rooms were very clean and spacious, nice toiletries in bathroom and shower. Breakfast buffet included in the room price with a great selection of either continental or cooked bacon, eggs etc fresh fruit and breads. The staff were lovely and friendly, a special mention to Virginia on reception with her warm friendly smile, nothing is too much trouble. Would definitely stay again and would recommend to family and friends.

title: Value for Money
text: I stayed here on two occasions, once with my children, once with my father. The hotel is easy to find, clean and tidy - staff couldnt be faulted on either occasion. The breakfast was very good, lots of choice. The rooms were as I would have expected and I would definitely stay again. The restaurant has a good choice of food for lunch or dinner. When visiting with my father I asked if he could have a room near the lift as he cant walk very far and he got a disabled room right next to the lift which made his day. I had a family room for me and three boys which was perfect for us. Parking is £14.00 overnight. No noise, a good nights sleep was had.

title: One night stay
text: This hotel was perfect for a one night stay for 7 of us before flying out of London City Airport. The reception / bar staff were very nice and chatty. The food and drinks were expensive but this is to be expected at a London hotel. You can take a 4 minute walk to the dock land and watch the planes land and take off. Rooms were adequate with air conditioning, and the bathroom was clean with a super powerful shower. If ever in the area I would stay again as 5 minute drive to the airport.

title: Very near to City Airport
text: Within a distance of the City Airport the location is ideal. However Apart from this hotel & a Traveldoge There is only one other place to eat. Which means the Bar/restaurant can tent to get busy with queues ordering food & drink. Rooms were excellent. Clean & Quite.

title: Good Hotel
text: Stayed 2 nights as visiting Excel. This hotel is very convenient for Excel, airport and visiting central London. Quick tube and DLR arrival from St Pancras. For return trip 15min walk to cable car over to 02 and then Thames Clipper to London eye. The hotel staff pleasant and helpful. Lady on desk printed map for me to show pharmacy as I not well. They also had settee bed made up in room for us. Hotel clean, breakfast good. Only gripe with this chain beds are far too small. Please buy King size!!

title: Excellent Hotel
text: We stayed here for 1 night while attending a concert at the O2 Arena. We had a family room which had a double bed and a double pull out sofa bed . The room was very spacious with a excellent bathroom The Breakfast was excellent with very good hot food and plenty of choice of cereals and pastries The hotel staff were very helpful and the hotel is a very short walk from the dockland railway station making it easy to get to the O2 or in to central London Would defiantly stay here again

title: Great👍⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
text: Stayed here on Wednesday 22nd Feb for the brits awards. Very clean. Thank you to Paula and Jane for Making us feel welcome and helping us with directions 😂both woman so lovely and friendly. Very happy with our stay, would deffo stay again and hope to see Paula and Jane again. Thanks

title: Very Pleasant Stay
text: We stayed here for a week as part of a family trip. The hotel was conveniently located right next to a DLR stop, making access to central London easy. The rooms were quite large, the beds comfortable and the bathroom large and clean. Breakfast was included in the room rate, and was plentiful and varied. Although LondonCity Airport is right next door there is no aircraft noise.

title: Average hotel with minimal service
text: First, there's nothing terrible about this hotel, and it's reasonably close to the Excel exhibition space (though several hotels are much closer). However, it's a "no frills" effort, and don't expect any special treatment if you're a gold or platinum IHG member. It's more like a Premier Inn experience, with good, basic rooms and an expectation that you'll pay for everything up front. It's quite modern, but no room safe and minimal amenities. I'd stay here again, but only if the price was right.

title: Busy but clean and tidy.
text: I stopped here for a couple of days whilst at a trade show being held at the Excel Arena. The hotel is easy to find and has a car park but there is a £12.00 cost for this. The reception staff are very polite and efficient. The room is standard Holiday Inn Express and a little on the small side. The room was clean comfortable and has everything you need. The sink was cracked but no major problem Breakfast was a bit busy but has everything you need. The staff were always around to ensure clean tables etc. Whilst the hotel is very close to London City Airport, I found the room quiet and well insulated from noise. To sum up, a clean, tidy and comfortable hotel. Easy to walk to the Excel Arena and good location.

title: Great Stay
text: Visited London for the recent round of NFL games and chose this hotel as it had excellent links to the city centre and O2 arena (tube station 2 mins walk away) and offered great value for money given the room rates included free breakfast. Rooms were modern and clean with great shower facilities. At breakfast there was a variety of continental and cooked options, which fuelled us for the day and the bar service was good in the evening for a night cap to rest the tired feet! Overall an excellent stay and I wouldn't hesitate to make this our hotel of choice for the 2018 NFL games

title: Another standard Holiday Inn Express, and none the worse for that.
text: We only stayed one night. This is a standard chain hotel, you get what you expect (no nasty surprises or quirky features) so there isn't much to say. We were pleased that, despite being near the railway and the airport, we hear no noises from either in our room - and it was fun watching the lit trains apparently charging along in mid-air after dark, when the viaduct couldn't be seen. Only a few niggles, none of which were major. We could have done with more hooks or towel rails in the bathroom. The washbasin taps were badly stained with limescale. There was only coat hook in a double room, so we had to compete for it. Breakfast was included, and perfectly ok without being exciting. There was a shortage of plates and trays, and cereals were mostly very sugary. We had an evening meal. As vegetarians we had little choice, but our chosen meals were, again, fine without being anything to write home about. On the menu, we spotted with interest that "fish and chips" came accompanied by chips. Double chips, then. Staff were friendly and polite, and check-in/out easy and straightforward. It is handy for ExCel, and there are bus stops nearby, as well as DLR. We would come back here.

title: Great stay
text: I was staying for a convention staying at the hotel, I had Very good service, every member of staff is very welcoming. One member of staff named Paula, is very bubbly and outstanding, she is an asset to your team.

title: Nice location
text: This hotel is near to excell london. If u have some meeting in excell, then this is a good hotel to stay. Royal Albert station on DLR line is 100 meter away. Very peaceful enviornment. But the rooms are small.No proper wardrobe in the room.No safety deposit locker. If u are on a leasure trip , it is better to stay in the city centre. There is no nearby attraction. No shopping mall nearby.

title: Nice New Hotel. Awful Food in the Restaurant
text: New, clean and comfortable. But the food is just awful. Just ordered the Cajun Chicken for £12.45. What came back probably cost £0.99 from Iceland. If you stay here, take yourself to the ExCel Centre for dinner.

title: Dreadful customer service from a member of hotel staff
text: I was walking from the DLR and took a wrong turn when I was approached by three men approx 18-20 years old. I am a sixty year old woman and had a large case but when I saw these men I called my son to stay on the line. I believed they were going to rob me and despite me shouting at them to go away as they were scaring me, they followed me into the hotel to intimidate me. I explained what had happened to the receptionist and that i couldn't stay there if they remained in the foyer and asked if they could be asked to leave. At this point Georgina the bar maid who had served one of them a glass of water starting having a go at me snd said they hadn't done snything wrong and they could stay if they wanted . I told her that she didn't know what had just happened to me at the dock pathway nearby but she carried on having a go at me, chewing gum visibly and arguing with me from behind the receptionist. I told her that I didn't want to speak to her and to go away so she went to speak to customers instead to argue her postion within my hearing. I can only imagine that she must have known these men as she showed no concern for my welfare at all and I was very shaken by the experience. The receptionist helped me to my room and was very kind, assisting me to call the police. Georgina the bar maid is exactly the kind of person to ruin the hotel experience and I chose this hotel as a solo business traveller for the good reviews in what I hoped would be a safe area. I would advise against staying here while she remains a member of staff as she has no understanding of how rude and antagonistic her manner was. I suspect she knows these individuals too defend their presence in the hotel foyer and bar. I am a midwife and a good judge of character.

title: Good value for money
text: Stayed here in the evening of the 7th, first impressions were very good, the hotel was very clean and all of the staff were very pleasant. We arrived at around 10am as we were attending the boat show and the excel center, popped in to reception to pay for parking (now gone up to £12 for 24hours) Arrived back at the hotel after the show and checked in with no problems, when booked by the father in law he had asked for 3 doubles close to each other, we couldn't have been further away!! The room was spotless and the bed comfortable, the showers are very good and very hot. The only downside is found was the temperature of the room for breakfast was so hot it was unpleasant to sit in (not sure if this was the plan?!) Over all a nice hotel and would stay again, just in summer when can sit outside for breakfast...

title: NICE AND CLEAN, STAFF FRIENDLY, BUT STANDARD BREAKFAST
text: We decided to try a Holiday Inn for the first time as we have tried quite a few other hotels in london, so we thought we would give it a go. I can say the rooms are spottless, with a lovely shower room, good size beds, and sofa bed was also great for the kids to sleep on. With a nice flat screen tv. The staff were very helpful and kind. But we were dissapointed with the breakfast. I feel that the could do with an extra member of staff. They kept running out of plates, so most of the time i had to use bowls for my toast. The juices also ran out. The cooked breakfast only gave us the option of 3 foods, being EGG, SAUSAGES, AND BEANS. I personally think they should offer more choice, I feel BACON should be an option as well as TOMOTOES and HASH BROWNS and Also VEGETERIAN SAUSAGES. I feel breakfast is one of the most important things to offer when you stay away in a hotel. And if this improves for the future it really would make a better hotel and will bring more people to stay at the Holiday Inn. I would happily stay here again and recommend this hotel if changes were to be made regarding breakfast. The hotel is only a 15 min drive to westfield shopping centre, stratford, and about 45 mins to central london which is great, and although we didnt use the DLR its handy to know its right there on your doorstep.

title: Paid for QUEEN bed with sofa bed as I am 6ft8
text: Arrived at hotel went to first room with a double bed went to reception lady tried to tell me thats our queensize bed size until I got desriptions of single,double,king size and queen size beds on google had to wait 90 minutes then said can you wait until house keeping make up your room I said no were not waiting another 30-60 mins .WHat am amazed about is the MANAGER was stood at the side of her while she was struggling to give me what I had paid for and never said a word the room we was given wasnt clean the dust made me cough all nicght I have ashtma and allegic to dust I took some pictures of the walls they were filthy The sofa bed we was supposed to get wasnt in the room the beds were 2 single beds nice for a romantic night away ! The morning after I asked for the manager the person in the blue suit who was there when we checked in said I am the manager I said you was there yesterday and you did nothing to help us I said I will complain to there head office stay in holiday inns all across europe regulary this is my last stay ever at 1 of there brands .

title: Great stay and staff
text: I've enjoyed a lovely stay at this hotel thanks to Paula the bar maid she's a great laugh and very helpful and alona was very nice and helped us to find a gym and even get us a discount on the price and Susan was very helpful and made sure all our needs were catered for and davide was very efficient and friendly

title: Immaculate rooms
text: Great stay at this hotel. Room and bathroom exceptionally clean. Paula behind the bar does the work of 2 people!! Really hard working lady who is fun and helpful. Nothing negative to say except get someone to help Paula!!

title: Absolutely wonderfull
text: Came her with my 13 year old son to see the car show at the excel glad we picked this hotel fabulously clean and very friendly staff highly recomed food was wonderful and breakfast was the best defiantly come again and a great working tv and had everything you could possibly dream of

title: Great Stay, Excellent Hotel, Fair Price
text: I unfortunately only had one night to stay. I am travelling frequently and usually are happy leaving any hotel - this time would have apreaciated to stay another day/night. Modern, friendly and clean Hotel. Rooms are above their price catagory. Perfect connection into City as well as walking distance to the London City Airport. Very friendly staff, nice breakfast. Sorry folks - I didn'T find anything to complain about ..

title: Good hotel, but breakfast is not brilliant.
text: We spent one night in that hotel, the place and rooms are comfy and convenient for a quick trip to London. The hotel is opposite to royal Albert DLR station which allows you to be in central London in 20-30 mins. The only disappointment was the breakfast open buffet, it was not impressive at all, they don't even offer cheese.

title: Good Hotel, but.......
text: I spend half of my life in IHG Hotels and that includes numerous Holiday Inn Expresses. This one was easy to find by car, is close to both Docklands Light Railway (Royal Albert Station) and London City Airport and there is a car park BUT I reluctantly had to park in a disabled space as the car park was solid and this was a Saturday! Check-in was smooth, friendly and welcoming and the receptionist wasn't fazed about me parking in a disabled space, so fair enough. We were given our room cards which are also used for lift access and I immediately had visions of being stuck in the lift at a HIE in Aberdeen through poorly programmed cards there. None of these problems at this HIE. Room is standard HIE Family Room, being just the right size, well equipped, spotlessly clean and a very comfortable bed. BUT the aircon has a mind of its own, for you sweat most of the night and at around 0630 the aircon kicks into life blasting you with ice-cold air!!!! Breakfast on the first morning was a shambles, I know that HIE Breakfasts are really nothing to write home about (no croissants). BUT even at 0800 on a Sunday morning I would like to see a breakfast and not look at 50+ Jehovah's Witnesses stuffing their faces having just invaded the breakfast area leaving us to starve Had a late night bite that night after being to a West End Show and we were very happy with our service, snack and its value. Monday morning breakfast was marginally better with less starving guests, BUT I do take offence at a waiter trying to remove plates away from us whilst we were still eating, he got a sharp rebuke from me. Still no croissants, obviously unheard of in this part of London!!! Left there after lunch to London City Airport. Would I stay there again? Only if breakfast service improves.

title: Very good hotel
text: We arrived at the hotel on 24 June 5am in the morning since our easyjet flight was delayed. From the moment of check in we enjoyed a wonderful service from all the staff. The most difficult thing was understanding how to operate the free wifi but the people at the front desk explained everything with a lot of patience. Breakfast was good and we got Soya milk for my vegan daughter everyday(they don't serve it but if you ask they will get it for you). The hotel location is close to Greenwich region and it takes approx 45 minutes to get to the center of London but the hotel is 3 minutes walk from Royal Albert station DLR. Most of the time we got off at canning town and took the jubilee subway but transportation in London is very efficient and you can get everywhere(too bad the trains are packed with zillions of people at rush hours). I loved the fact the the hotel was very clean and elegantly designed and of course air condition in the room was very good. You can ignore the fact the the hotel is near the city airport. The room windows are sealed and you will not hear any plane. After so many compliments one can wonder why only four stars and not five. I can assure you I very much wanted to give this great hotel a five perfect stars. I loved my stay and will be happy to return. However the hotel has only one fault but you will feel it every time you are in your room. The only fault is... storage!!! Usually we are not spoiled when it comes to storage space in the room. I can settle for a big drawer for my clothes. But in this hotel you will not find even a simple shelf to put your stuff. I admit I'm surprised that a good chain hotel like Holiday inn didn't find it a basic thing to supply some storage space in the rooms. We stayed for 10 nights in the hotel and most of the time had to leave our clothes in our suitcases. It can be done... But it's not convenient at all!!! I really hope that in the future the hotel will fix this. Just put at least a big shelf sticked to the wall and you will have a perfect room with some storage space. Overall,if you don't mind making a little effort with you belongings in the room,then I recommend this hotel with all my heart. I'm sure you will enjoy your stay there as much as we did. :) P.S. Don't worry if you forget to bring somthing. There is a great machine in the lobby with all the essntials(we bought there an electric adapter and some band aids).

title: Great economy hotel, very good breakfast, very close to the railway.
text: We chose this hotel because it was the only on in our price range with a queen bed. As it turns out it was a very nice hotel. A 3 minute walk to the DLR station, there was parking on site (this was extra, but worth it for us).

title: Pretty good
text: This hotel absolutely does the trick for a place to sleep. It's very close to LCY airport (£5 cab trip) - and you can also walk there in about 20 minutes. The rooms were exceptionally clean and modern, and I really liked the bathroom. The hotel is right next to a DLR stop which is very handy - but there isn't much else around the hotel.
