I am sure that in a few years time there will be development around the site. The reasons I gave it 4 rather than 5 stars: 1) the staff were a bit frosty - I didn't feel that welcome when I checked in 2) the breakfast (as with all HI expresses) is so depressing. No effort with presentation, all the food looks anaemic and reconstituted. However it is clean, the bed was comfy and it's perfect for the EXCEL or airport.

title: Great spot to rest before flying out
text: We overnighted here before flying out from London City Airport. It was a great. Nice a d quiet. We were able to order dinner ahead, and then come down and eat, and the food was wonderful. Breakfast was OK, choices a little limited, but wholesome!

title: A GREAT HOTEL WITH SOME MINOR LET DOWNS
text: I have to say I was gutted to find out I was staying here with work last week but I was very pleasantly surprised! The hotel is very nice, clean and tidy and the staff are very helpful and friendly. My room was a really good size, clean, well presented with tea/coffee, a hairdryer, TV and spacious bathroom - the only thing that let the room down for me was I was put in room 128 which has a disabled bathroom so no bath. Usually this wouldn't be an issue and a shower would be quite sufficient (it was like a wet room not a shower cubicle) but due to being there working hard for 5 days I would have loved a bath! Food & drinks were nice & very reasonable and the bar area is quite welcoming and comfortable although you had to pay by card after 11pm for drinks as they had closed the tills - strange?? The 1 big let down is the breakfast. Sausage, beans & scrambled egg but no bacon, mushrooms or tomatoes and no option to have a poached or fried egg. There was cereal, croissants, fruit and yogurts though but no bacon was a huge let down! I also want to give a special mention to Susan the duty manager! She was wonderful!! She was friendly, chatty, courteous and always went the extra mile to make sure all guests (not just us) had a great stay - thank you Susan :) I would definitely stay here again but we did say they needed bacon!!

title: Great Restaurant and Lounge.
text: We're stayed here for 4 nights attending PeatEx the at London Excel centre. See Paula in the lounge, she is absolutely lovely and has the best service around ! Holiday inn express - Excell is withig walking distance from the London excel centre and close to the underground rail. Rooms are clean and tidy. I would stay here again.

title: Great hotel..great location.
text: A fresh vibrant holiday inn express, great location across the water from London City Airport, and a two minute walk from the DLR. Excellent check in provided by Angelia who explained all we needed to know and more . Booked a Family Room, 2 Adults and 2 Children, the room for 4 was a squeeze once the sofa bed was down, but if just using as a base to explore its no problem, a bit of planning and moving of cases and it's fine, room was clean, with a large walk in power shower, the room had tea and coffee and hairdryer, so all good.our stay was for four nights and was cleaned daily and housekeeping were excellent. The hotel windows do not open and rooms have air con. Also free wifi throughout hotel. Breakfast is the all you can eat holiday inn continetal, Each day there was plenty of choice with the standard sasuage, eggs and beans, which was constantly replenished by staff, alongside chocolate croissants, the standard croissants all warm alongside muller yougherts, fresh yougherts, fresh fruit, bread and cereals and more alongside a good range of teas and coffees. Staff were constantly on the floor clearing tables and cleaning and good to see plenty of interaction with guests, a very hands on approach from staff with reception and back of house all assisting, which was great to see, with plenty of seating. As we were using the hotel as a base to explore London, DLR is right next door and perfect base to come and go( for those who have a freinds and family railcard- you get a 1/3 rd of zone 1-6 tickets) you're unable to purchase these at the machines, just get on the dlr and go to Canning Town and down the stairs to the manned ticket office. Best place to change to explore is Bank. The hotel is directly across from London City, and there is zero noise in your rooms. Perfect to go across the road and watch the planes, and is a perfect sunset ...walk along for 5 minutes and you will find a Chinese, walk past the excel along the river for 20 mins and you will walk into a superb area of shops, bars, restaurants, and more...right next to the Emirates skyline. There is plenty of space to relax in the hotel for a drink, but please clean the wooden door at the back of reception and bar face, finger prints and smears. Reception staff are all excellent and aim to please and offer plenty of local knowledge. Overall we will visit again as the rate was excellent, one of the better holiday inn express, highly recommend,

title: Great Hotel
text: Had another great stay at this clean, modern hotel in great location for O2 and Excel exhibition centre. Staff are good throughout, helpful, friendly, special mention for Rico on breakfast always smiling and very helpful. Paula on bar is also great for a chat and a bit of banter. Reasonable prices and clos to DLR.

title: Amazing service
text: One particular member of staff by the name of Renee went that extra mile during her break time to decorate a room as a surprise for my wife's 50th birthday. She was on hand every step of the way, and made the experience one to remember for my wife. Renee was extreamly helpful and very professional. She made our stay worth while and we strongly recommend using this hotel purely on this individuals personal service. A clean and friendly environment. Good standards all round!

title: Short Break
text: Spent 4 nights in London based here. Rooms were comfortable enough. Staff were very friendly. Breakfast was ok but nothing to write home about. Was very close to Docklands Rail station which took you to Tower Gateway in 15mins. Would stay here again as a base to explore London.

title: Simple hotel, expensive rooms.
text: We had to stay here for two nights as our flights were cancelled due to fog. We chose this hotel based on its location as it's only 1.5 miles from London City Airport. We booked very last minute and the rate was £220. The room was very basic which I found didn't reflect the price by any means. There were hardly any amenities in the room

title: nice location, poor breakfast management.
text: Stayed 3 nights, nice room, quite new and very clean. 1st breakfast both juice machines not working, muddy water from hot drinks machine, so I complained, 2nd breakfast , staff overload,!. One guy wrestling with juice machine, at least he tried! 3rd breakfast , no trays, ran out of cutlery, one member of staff struggling , this needs addressing as breakfast overall was very poor and badly manged, a proper breakfast set up would improve ratings! Parking great, transport links great as adjacent to DLR station, and close to airport. Also only a short walk to london Exel. Excellent chinese restaurant yi ban nearby.

title: Great!!!!
text: Lovely spot by the water, make sure you book the express excel and not the holiday Inn about a mile away from it as it's in an awful spot where as this one is by the water side where the cable cars are and the boats.Room was spacious clean and tidy with modern bathroom and fantastic shower!!. The staff were all friendly and helpful. Good choice at breakfast will stay here again.

title: quiet, comfortable, friendly, clean and well located
text: As a family of six of us stayed in two rooms. Understandably space in London is at a premium so we didn't have loads but we were comfortable enough. Breakfast was good enough and the rooms were spotlessly clean. All of the staff - reception, dinning area and the housekeeping team - were really friendly. There is no sign for the hotel if you approach by car so make sure you take the Prince Albert turn off the A1020 to avoid an extra half an hour driving around Docklands and Canning Town!

title: Terrific Accomodation .
text: Attending Excel and booked into this Holiday Inn Express close by. What a pleasant surprise to find,for the price, a terrific hotel. Spotlessly clean rooms, friendly staff, nice food, fantastic breakfast and a perfect location for Excel and London City Airport. All easily reached on foot. Nothing was a problem for the friendly staff. Will definitely stay here again.

title: very clean room, great receptionist from India! really helpful! not enough staff to handle breakfast!
text: really clean rooms if you are just to spend the night before going further in a trip.. we check out late, there was a receptionist from india, who was really helpful.. he welcomed us with a smile, gave candies to the kids.. later we found few insects in the room, he came and cleaned and changed the beds like a pro!!! we loved the hotel mainly because of him!!! really dedicated and helpful!! the morning breakfast was a mess!!!!! uncleaned tables, the service is soo slow, due to the lack of personnel...

title: Sparkling Clean and Handy for the O2
text: We booked this hotel for a one night stay when we went to a concert at the O2 Arena. We had reserved a room several months in advance. When we booked in I asked if we could have a room that had a view of London City Airport (my wife is an airplane geek) and our room was changed without fuss. We actually had a room designed for someone with a wheelchair. I hadn't asked for this but I guess that if they have an unused room then they will use it. This possibly explained why the room, and bathroom, was larger than usual. It was spotless and very comfortable. Breakfast was included. This was a decent buffet that had the makings for a full English plus cereals, cakes, bread, rolls, juice, coffee, tea etc. There was plenty of everything. As far as I could tell, there is not much to do in the immediate vicinity but it is a few minutes from Royal Albert DLR which gets you easily to Excel Centre and O2 Arena (via Canning Town).

title: Excellent! Excellent breakfast. Clean rooms. Excellent service.
text: Excellent breakfast. That was the best. Clean and modern rooms. Two blocks from undergroud station. Quiet rooms. Be careful if you use this undergroud exit and check our your oyster ticket because if you do not check out your oyster ticket its going to carge your more money.

title: Good enough
text: It is clean and safe along the river on the docks. The staff is efficient, and the room quiet for a good night while on business trip. A few restaurants with walking distance, and convenient if you are going to the Excel conference center. I did not experience the food there, but the menu seems basic with burgers, pizzas or pasta.

title: Amazing hotel
text: I loved my 2 day stay here. Very close to the LCY airport. And very close to the transportation. Love to ease of getting off the tube and getting the the hotel quickly. I love the food options and OT had very comfortable beds.

title: Group of 43 Children and Adults
text: Just back from a weekend away with my daughters dance crew. 43 of us stayed at this hotel for one night. The hotel is extremely well situated and is within walking distance of London City Airpot and ExCel where the crew performed on Sunday. The hotel is spotlessly clean throughout and the rooms and public areas are very comfortable. Having such a large group we arranged for the hotel to provide a hot buffet on Saturday night, not expecting too much we were pleasantly surprised to be presented with delicious homemade dishes, they even bought Easter treats for all of the Children in the group. Special mentions should go to Pat and Tracey, Pat for the fantastic menu and Tracey for her excellent customer service. I am Head of Account Management for a large TMC and will be recommending this hotel to any clients requiring accommodation in this area. Well done and thank you.

title: Marathon stay
text: Very poor customer service at reception from a temp at check in but the manager was lovely. Being an ex IHG employee myself she was trying to tell me something wasn't possible when I knew it was - thank God the duty manager sprung forward to interrupt her rudeness. No IHG gold benefits were given to us at all although I am an IHG gold member. Lady on bar was very rude too! Following running the London Marathon and being tired we went for dinner quite happy and then the lady on the bar was just pure rude. Wouldn't know what eye contact was if it hit her in the face. I understand this was a busy weekend, but it wasn't really acceptable. Probably the worst IHG hotel I've stayed in in terms of customer service. Shame - the marathon itself was incredible.

title: Near Excel
text: The room was spacious and I was given a free snack and drink as an IHG platinum member. It is very convenient since it is near Excel, where big conventions happen. Also, it is near train station. The only downside was breakfast during my last day (Sunday) was choatic. There were no more food (eggs and bacon). We had to wait a good 30 minutes before it was refilled.

title: Back to an old favourite
text: Returned again to the Holiday Inn Express at Excel- great to see the “old staff” still there! Zanas, Alex, Pilar and Jane. Sign of a good hotel that they can retain their staff - and even better when they recognise you! Although Pilar who is Spanish is convinced she was welcoming back Louis Walsh! Looking forward to my next visit.

title: Best London IHG Express
text: Check in was amazing Manager Virginia could not of been more friendly and helpfull It was my birthday and even got a Birthday Card That was a nice touch Location is perfect for DLR Breakfast was good first morning,but long wait for any sausages to arrive 2nd morning,not a problem as plenty other stuff to eat Very clean modern Express Inn Defo be back Keep up The good work

title: Beautiful little gem of a place
text: Needed a place to stay as I was attending a Halloween ball and this place came up as one of the closest and I cannot tell you how GLAD I am I booked here. The room was small but perfectly formed and the bed is to die for. I can honestly say was the best nights sleep I have ever had in a hotel room and I think it was down to the comfiest bed I've ever slept on and the fact the room felt so welcoming and like home from home. The shower was great (a proper jet of water!) and everything was finished to a high standard. And the breakfast was so nice!! Best cooked breakie I've had for a long time, with high quality (and very tasty) egg, sausage and bacon. fresh orange juice hit the spot and felt a very nice touch was proper doorstop bread (from a fresh uncut loaf rather than pre-sliced) and the tea and coffee pot we got. (rather than a cup of tea or coffee) Also, I'd like to thank Caroline for easing my worries about turning up late and the staff are lovely, very welcoming and helpful. I will be booking here again as a base to do some sightseeing in London and really looking forward to going back here.

title: Disgusting awful place
text: Awful place, not a good thing to say about it. If you want a decent place to stay, then find somewhere else. Broken items in the room and dirty. Electricity intermittent so hence no hot water and no one on hand to deal with it. Pigeon excrement and mice. The worst place I have ever seen.

title: just awful, don't stay here!!
text: The proprietors should be ashamed of themselves for misrepresentation! The bathroom had a leaky sink, loose taps and the shower turned the bathroom into a wet room, and it ran cold after a few minutes. No internet connection or T V channels and nothing was done about these problems when we tried to talk to someone, anyone, on the intercom in "reception". When we did get someone answering the intercom after it was call forwarded to a phone, the man hung up on me after I told him we were leaving.We had booked for 3 nights and left in disgust after two. Breakfast was basic continental with completely self serve-no staff in sight. Tiny room with no storage or even a small table to put a computer on. All the attempted modernization was the lowest form of DIY. No management ever on site, only cleaning staff, who abdicated all responsibility and did the minimum.

title: overpriced and dirty
text: i've chosen this hotel on the terms of the recommendation. what a rip off. the location is old however refurbished. the staff is not friendly and it all seemed as it's just a money making place and not a place where guests are welcome. we were very disappointed and wouldn't recommend this place to anybody. there are far better places also more centrally located with better services and prices.

title: Appalling place, scruffy cramped and very poor service
text: We stayed at one six two near Greenwich in September 2013 after reading excellent reviews on trip advisor. it was utterly appalling, lights did not work when we returned late at night

title: The worst place ever (and I had stayed in some nasty places before!)
text: I stayed in onesixtwo in October 2013. After my terrible stay there I emailed them with my complaint (they had, in fact, contacted me for my feedback!). Below is my email to them. I have since chased them up but never received a reply. AVOID AT ALL COST! "Unfortunately this was one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had and I am even more disappointed as I had looked for a special place for my partner's birthday and booked onesixtwo thinking that was the one! The first thing that we notices when we arrived was that the room (we were staying in room number 2) looked nothing like the pictures on your website which makes me think that your website is very misleading. It was dirty and dusty. On closer inspection we noticed that two of the little bedside lights did not work. There were additional 2 lamps next to them. Additionally one of the wall lamp had naked bulb and cables sticking out. The beadspread was stained. When we flushed the toilet, the water behind it started pouring out onto the floor. Initially I thought it was the waste water pouring out into the shower room (later I realised that it was, thankfully, clean water!). I have telephoned the number on my confirmation and was told it would be fixed later that day. When we returned to the room later that evening nothing has been done about it and, on closer inspection (the state of the tiles and grout) it seems that you must have had that problem for quite some time but it has not been addressed. The shower room was filthy and only one of us managed to have a shower in the morning. As I got into the shower (I was the second one), I only managed to use some shampoo when the water turned freezing cold. I had to finish washing myself in the sink. In addition to that the towels you provided were fraying and they did smell of food (I can only assume they are left to dry in a room where food is cooked). In addition to that the air con unit took so much space in the room that we had to pretty much roll onto the bed to get to the other side of it. The window was dirty and covered in droppings. I cannot even comment on the breakfast as we did not stay at onesixtwo any longer than necessary and had we not returned back to the hotel around midnight, we would have left the night before just to avoid that experience! I must say I am very disappointed by the state of this hotel (which was worse than many hostels I stayed in in the past), especially that we paid almost £100 for a room. I have taken some photos of the state of your rooms and would be happy to share them with you. I look forward to hearing from you."

title: Worst Place EVER!
text: I moved in here to a study apartment once the hotel closed down - what a bad move! I rented this place for 3 months but only stayed here about 6 weeks....There was no heating, there was water leaking through 2 parts of the ceiling. There were moths everywhere and at night you could here the rats running around in the floor boards above. To top it all off I was living next door to a call out girl who slept all day and was up all night, I got no sleep - this was the worst place I have every in my life stayed in not to mind say lived in! - STAY AWAY!!!!!!!!!!!!!

title: DEAD MOUSE
text: After spotting a dead mouse in the shower, we walked straight out. We were there for a total of around 15 minutes. We contacted the front desk, only to be told that they'd send a cleaner round! As if that would somehow make up for the dead mouse and the numerous mouse poos all around the skirting board in the hallway. And to make things worse, we asked for a refund and were fobbed off for months on end. So overall, the worst hotel experience I have ever had, and 100 pounds out of pocket too. This place needs to be shut down.

title: Not a good experience
text: This 'hotel' is unmanned, when the fire alarm went off one evening no one came to help us despite us calling several times. In the end we had to disconnect at the fuse. The toaster kept catching fire and the food ran out at breakfast. The bathroom was dirty and TV didn't work. I left something at the hotel which they confirmed they had found however despite sending 2 SAE (the first they didn't get) 5 weeks later and I still haven't been sent my belongings even though I have called several times to chase. I would not recommend this hotel under any circumstances.

title: Two many negatives to recommend this place
text: I booked this litttel B&B based on the reviews I saw, however, I think a lot of very important information was missing. Had I known I would have booked elseswhere. The positive stuff: , friendly staff, extremely helpful, breakfast is excellent bed very comfortable. The cons and these are important ones to keep in mind: 1). The location sucks! If you come from the US and are in London (and Europe for the first time even) then a here's a warning, if you are not renting a car, you will be on a tube and bus rides that will waste your time each day to get to the center of london in order. to see all the must see london sights which are not even remotely close to greenwich. 2)The only thing to me worth seeing in the area was the observatory which showed the GM clock and that took about 10 minutes as it was not much to see.3) There is no reastuarants around other than a chinese restaurant and a greasy looking hamburger place to go to if you are going to go to it on foot. 3) THERE IS NO PHONE in your room! I have a cell but it doesnt work in the UK. Why is there no phone in your room.? 4) the room came with little treats like water (which you paid for) and a few treats that were free which were not replaced each day. I paid for mulitple nights, why shouldn't I get the same little things to munch on each night if it was there on the first night? We did paid for it each day. The room came with two bottled waters in a tiny fridge which were not included in the price. The bottles were not replaced after we drank them. even though we stayed for for 4 days. I would not stay there again if I was ever to go back to the UK/london.

title: Boarding House
text: When we were booking the hotel the website, photos and reviews looked very promising. On arrival we found ourselves in a tiny hall way with no reception but the box where you input your surname and it spits out the keys. The rooms were ok but the star rating is no near to 4, it is maximum 3 and we found pubic hair on the linen in one of the rooms. Twin room are not inexistent even though advertised so we ended up with a double bed, which I had to share with my work colleague. The customer service is non-existent either, both on arrival and during entire stay, the manager did not show his face he spoke to a telecom and was very rude. Bfast as reception itself is absent. The photos on the website do not give justice to what is actually going on.

title: Lovely, comfortable, clean and friendly
text: We stayed here for one night as we were attending a friends wedding in Greenwich, so the location was perfect for us

title: Very surprised
text: After reading the reviews we was starting to regret booking the hotel but it was only really somewhere to sleep as we was going to the O2. When u arrive you check in on a machine which I thought was quite cool and we didn't have any problems in using it. Me Nd my partner And my dad and his partner had booked two rooms and was pleasantly surprised by how nice the hotel was inside. Nice decor, little garden on the second floor for smokers, lots of useful information available for getting around particularly in London. The only thing I will say is that there are lots of steep stairs we was on the top floor so had to climb all of these to get to our room. However it didn't bother us in the slightest and will only be a problem if u had small children or had problems walking. I'm sure you could request to stay on the ground floor though if this was the case. When we got into our room it was quite small but nicely decorated, nice bathroom, comfy bed, clean (except lots of dust behind the bed) and had everything we needed for our stay . In the morning we had the continental breakfast which was okay but could have done with a fry up! This is the only time we saw other guests and a member of staff as well which was strange. Also handy as you can park outside to drop in your luggage and then theres instructions on the wall on where to park thats free just a few minutes walk away. Overall perfect olace to stay in to visit Greenwich, London or the o2 especially as it is so cheap.

title: nice weekend
text: it would have been nice for a choice of full english as well as continental as its not me or the wifes thing. The only bad thing i can say about the hotel is dont expect a smiling happy face at check ITS COMPUTORISED would advise to wait till after 3pm on the day of arrival as your reservation would not be in the system but dont let that put you off i dont know about the rest of the hotel bur room 4 is excellent and when i finally met the lady who owns it shes very freindly and eager to make your stay better. you wont be dissapointed in room 4 that i can assure you.

title: Should be closed down!
text: Met by a faceless intercom and self check in spits out a key. Opened the door and the smell hit us! Really stale, disgusting smell. It was not pleasant to be in the room. The windows were filthy covered in pigeon droppings. The room overlooked the back of a take away. It was filthy and covered in pigeon droppings. There was noise from the take away shop until very late in the night. The plugs were visually unattractive and looked unsafe. The kettle would not work until the plug was fiddled with and left half hanging from the socket. Two wall lights by bed did not work. The shower switch was on as directed, however the shower did not work properly. It was freezing cold, eventually went scalding hot, then freezing cold and no more hot water came out of it. The shower head was dirty. There was hardly any space in the room..the air con unit took up a considerable part of the room. Did not stay for breakfast as we needed some fresh air away from the smelly, hot, grubby atmosphere. Didn't fancy eating anything in there. We felt totally ripped off having paid £120 for the night presumably because of Fleetwood Mac playing at O2. We will never stay in One Six Two again and will not recommend it to anyone. There was no one to complain to other than a faceless intercom that was difficult to hear. The place needs closing down.

title: A good base to explore
text: It was a convenient place to stay and there was a free on-street parking place about 6 minutes walk. But it could be a hassle if there are no places left. Hotel itself was on a busy main road and the room was on the small side. TV has no remote. Breakfast was basic. Apart from that it was a fairly good base to explore Greenwich, old Naval College, the painted house etc. Short stay recommended

title: worst experience ever
text: I booked this hotel for me and my daughter on 17th August 2013 through laterooms.com. I called the hotel as soon as I got the booking confirmation through email. No one answer the phone but a voice mail. I left message leaving my contact details and proximate arriving time. I never heard back from them. The hotel was very difficult to find. when I eventually arrived, through tube and bus, there was nobody in the hotel to check us in. I used the intercom system but was passed to the same voice mail. Again, I explained the situation, no one get back to me. Some guests were staying in the hotel, and they let me and my daughter into the small entrance, where there is a 24/7 check in system. I put in my name (the only thing it allows you to type in), and the system replied it could not find my reservation. I then called their phone number (which was on the booking confirmation) but no answer. I used the intercom again, no answer. Back and forth over three hours, I NEVER got an answer. My daughter was so tired that she was sleeping on the floor at the bottom of the stair. By midnight, I got help from next door Kabab shop, hired a taxi and went to another hotel. The next day, I received an email from onesixtwo asking me how was my stay. It was obvious that they had the booking information, but didn't bother to ensure the 24/7 check in system was working nor there is someone there should anything goes wrong. When I complained, the hotel denied there was any problem of their system. They also state that their CCTV didn't show any customer were having problem in their hotel that night, which implied I was never there. Talking to the guests stayed there, they had the same experience when they first arrived. Eventually they had to get someone from abroad to call to the hotel (oversea number) to get someone on the premises to check them in. Talking to the Kabab shop owner, he explained the hotel owner was a drunk and likes to sleep a lot. Never actually looked after the hotel. From my experience, this is a dishonest scumbag run desolated hotel feeding on unwitting oversea customers who are not likely to come back either to complain or visit again.

title: Perfect for me
text: I stayed here because I was running a 1/2 marathon at Greenwich Park. It was fast taxi ride from the North Greenwich tube station, buses are available but I prefer taxi. There is a 24 hour check-in machine as you walk in, it's walking distance to restaurants, bed was very cozy, breakfast was served in the morning, and Anna was very nice. Couldn't have asked for anything better.

title: Felt so ripped off
text: We stayed here the night before running the London Marathon. The price was £180 for one night per room (single occupancy). I think this is about double what it would normally cost and obviously prices had neen hiked up because of the marathon. We were prepared for this though. The good thing about the hotel was that it was as close as close could be to the marathon start.. The rooms were incredibly small and mine was very, very hot. A radiator just outside the room (room 6) was blasting out all the time and could not be turned off. There was an old fashioned air con unit in the corner of the room which was very noisy but did just about cool the room down to a bearable temperature. The windows did not open. The air con unit drowned out the noise of other guests as the walls were paper thin such that even a cough from next door sounded as if it was in the same room! There was no-one around in terms of staff until the next morning so thankfully there were no serious problems. I didn't try the shower but noted that the bathroom although apparently clean smelt very mouldy. The kettle would not fit under the trendy tap and the bathroom light did not work. Breakfast the next morning was fine but felt sorry for the couple who were counting on their pre marathon bowl of porridge that they'd been promised as they were told that the delivery hadn't come so no porridge. Didn't bother me too much as don't like porridge. I suppose that all I wanted was a comfortable night's rest before running the marathon so was hyper critical with regard to things that hindered this - noise and heat of room. However think if I'd been intending to have a relaxing break in London other things would have been more upsetting such as the size of the room, bathroom, lack of personal sevice and staff etc. All in all felt the website was totally misleading and wish I'd read the other reviews on here before booking. I expected to pay more than usual for a room so near the marathon start but this was not the trendy little boutique B+B with personal attention and service that I was expecting. Went to see a friends room at a chain hotel (Devere Group) down the road and that was much better for the same price - will aim to stay there next year.

title: Terrible customer service, poor rooms, no breakfast
text: Where to start, do not be fooled by the carefully taken photos, although only an £8 taxi ride from the O2, the 'hotel' is situated in a row of shops on a high street which is not particularly appealing. We had two rooms, neither had a shower that would provide a steady stream of warm water, either hot or cold. As for breakfast, that did not happen as the 'manager' was hungover and would not give the key to the store room/kitchen to the one member of staff that was on duty! To be fair to the staff member, she did go out and buy some bread for breakfast but there was only four plates so she had to use a guest room to wash the pots - surely against hygiene regulations! Ddrinks were to be served in mouth wash plastic cups as no glasses were available. On complaining nothing has been done, in fact the owner refuses to answer any messages and they have even ignored communication from the major online booking portal we used. Rude, poor, no customer service - AVOID!

title: Dirty, noisy, unclean with rude management.
text: The hotel is next to a kebab shop which made our room at the front of the hotel smell. The room was unclean and barely lit. The shower didn't work and when we tried to tell the manager he was rude and unhelpful and said it wasn't his problem. I would never go near this hotel again if you paid me. Disgusting service from start to finish.

title: Appalling customer service
text: The room itself was OK with the exception that there wasn't a functioning toilet! We weren't informed before we arrived and there were no other rooms for us to stay in - with the exception of a basement which was mouldy and damp... and also seemed to be used as the kitchen which could be another reason not to stay, or at least eat here!). So we either had to find somewhere else to stay (which would have proved difficult given we had a wedding to get to) or deal with it. The compromise was that OneSixTwo would refund half the price of the room for the inconvenience. Four months later we have seen no sign of the refund despite chasing on numerous occasions. A very disappointing service.

title: excellent hotel
text: Great hotel. Reasonable money, the room was small but clean and nicely decorated. Easy access to the o2 arena. Friendly staff, nice breakfast. Would definitely stay again, don't believe all the negative reviews.

title: unclean boudoir appearance with poor finish and no service
text: Photos make this place look lovely, but be warned appearances can be deceiving! The toilet had a nice brown rim in the bowl that looked like a cleaner had never seen it. The mirrors and glass was smeared with dirty cloth streaks. The tiles on the floor were loose and needed re grouting. The carpet was dirty. Our room hosted a combi boiler in a locked cupboard which kept us awake with its constant ignition and humming. The duvet was the cheapest quality I have ever seen- the hollow-fibres were separately attached in clumps and large spaces between. Under the sheets were the remaining hairs and stains of guests gone by. Saying all that the breakfast was fine, but nothing special with lukewarm coffee. Poor hospitality just a money spinner to con fools like us that look at nice pictures and book our stay. Cleverly they did not show the brothel like appearance that greets you as the entrance. Not the romantic getaway we expected!

title: Really Disappointing. AVOID
text: We were looking forward to our night in a ' boutique' hotel near the O2 and it looked lovely on the website. We thought we had missed it as we walked up the hill until we spotted a run down 'hotel' sandwiched between a shop and kebab house. Our heart sank but we assumed it was all hidden inside. Walked into a buzzer/ computer screen that gave us our keys. Found the room which smelt damp and was seriously small. Light shade was missing, iron marks on carpet. View out of window was metal mesh and pigeon poo. We left a window open and came back later to the reek of chip fat from the kebab house! At conditioning unit didn't work and made a horrendous noise. Shower ran from scalding to freezing. We didn't even attempt breakfast as we just wanted to leave, plus we had no idea what time it was served. Needless to say neither of us had much sleep with the noise of the air con and incessant pigeon cooing. Didn't see a single member of staff the whole time we were there. The website is a complete sham to the actual reality. I never write reviews but cannot explain how disappointed and upset we are. We want to warn others so they don't make the same mistake!

title: Convenient for the O2 !
text: This is my third stay here, we had a warm welcome from the manager when we arrived and he carried our cases up to the room which was up a lot of stairs some very narrow we were in room 11 which was quite large and had two double beds and a seating area whith two leather sofa's there was a jacuzzi bath which we did not use the shower was ok but not much water pressure more of a trickle also there was no lights working in the bathroom at night but we managed just by leaving the door open and then had light from the bedroom.beds were really comfortable rooms have tea&coffee and tv . Breakfast was not so great as previous years ! Only two cearel's to choose from other years it was about 5 or 6 , toast, which you do yourself with a toasting machine and muffins I really think they should provide a bit more maybe some yogurts ? They also have some ham & cheese and tea /coffee. But if I was going to the O2 I would still stay here you can get the bus no 422 from just up the road straight to the O2 and takes about 15 mins

title: very very dissapointing
text: The worst place I've ever stayed in. Thank the Lord we only had to endure 2 nights. Like living in a a sauna as air con in room didn't work as didn't the hairdryer or the bathroom light. The shower hose needs to be bereft of its mould. We were in the attic room which was quite spacious but the carpet smelled and the fire escape was covered in mesh to keep the pigeons out. Would not recommend this hell hole to anyone. The Manager greeted us in scruffy jeans and trainers (not very professional) and for some reason had to keep reminding guests that he was the manager. Maybe it's time to start actually managing the place instead of just bragging about it. So glad we didn't pay for breakfast. Cereal from dispensers doesn't really do it for me. The place hardly resembles the pictures on the website. In reality its more like a doss house in Amsterdam. Don't be fooled by the website.

title: Bail Hostel not a Hotel
text: The Hotel resembled a Bail Hostel. The area was rough and the Hotel (if you can call it that) was between two run down shops not the picture they displayed on the web site. The check in consisted of a buzzer system and a touch screen computer in the entrance hall. The system informed me "We have no record of your booking". The contact number is a mobile phone that goes straight to answer phone. You leave a message and they don't call you back. We waited and messed about 15 to 20 minutes. Eventually the receptionist who was not based on site said he would "come round with a key". There was no secure on site parking. We decided not to stay, however the hotel took the full amount of money £300. I was disappointed and frustrated. At least you can gain entrance to a Bail Hostel, however this proved impossible to check in.

title: Lovely Rooms at the One Six Two
text: Stayed here for two days and found the people running the guest house very friendly & helpful. The rooms are decorated very nicely and are spotlessly clean (well done to the cleaner, i know what it's like). A very good choice of breakfast is served, the omelette was delicious. Location of hotel is not too far from the O2 Arena, if you use taxis the prices vary between five pounds and the dearest we paid was nine pounds. I would definitely recommend this hotel. Fully enjoyed my stay there.

title: Simply the worst place I have ever stayed at
text: Depressing exterior, sandwiched between too tatty, rundown shops. No warning of completely incomprehensible self service check in - but that at least prepares you for the rest of your stay - self service. Dowdy decor, hardly any channels working on tiny tv, shower took ages to heat up and then nearly scalded me despite consisting of a few thin needle pricks of spray. "Cosy, boutique hotel?" The place should be condemned.

title: Absolutely Awful
text: Small cold room, unhelpful staff, very noisy, smelly room, we were so cross with the lack of customer service when we tried to complain about the noise from upstairs between 3 am and 5 am, the rooms should be insulated to reduce sound travel, would never stay here again and certainly would not recommend it to anyone!!

title: misleading website
text: Air conditioning unit did-not work so opened window only to be kept awake all night by pigeons calling and messing outside bedroom window, t.v kept losing signal,toilet did not flush properly,only one hard pillow each, light shade missing,shower temperture kept changing,no cooked breakfast,no mini fridge, Out side terrace space looks nothing like pictures on website,no blue lights on,not a inviting space at all.Front of property there is a door way right next to a hairdresser and takeaway premises no, up-lighters on front of property as website pictures shows.No communication on arrival or leaving drop keys in box for next person to be taken in by this misleading website,

title: Seriously dissapointed
text: On the plus side: friendly staff, free wifi and free parking nearish by. However the cons outweigh the pros. Expensive. No close tube stops. Inadequate parking drop off at the front. Automated entry system made me feel unwelcome and like i was entering a prison. No cooked breakfast despite the cost.

title: a treat
text: This was our first visit to London. 4 nights, 5 days. We wanted to stay in a B&B because it is more personal and less "touristy". The B&B's I searched for were all around 50 pounds, and they didn't sound very good, or the reviews were not good. I am used to traveling in the Netherlands where $100.- would get you the best B&B. I decided to "splurge". The 85 pounds we paid was comparatively reasonable, and still quite a bit cheaper than a hotel like the Airport Hilton. Hotels in the city were too expensive for us, for the quality that was available at the price I was willing to pay. The whole B&B had a modern bright new classy feel to it. Emailing and reserving the room was smooth and easy. The hostess was very accommodating and helpful on the phone, and promptly emailed us. The B&B was easily accessible from train/subway and bus. We walked up hill from the train station- a little much, after a 15 hr flight for two out of shape baby boomers and 2 suitcases and backpacks- too bad we didn't know which bus to take, there were plenty of them driving past us. (we didn't see people around that we could ask directions from at noon). We checked in early, we were allowed to leave the suitcases, but the rooms were not cleaned yet, so we left for an afternoon of sightseeing. (We had bought a 1 day pass on rail/tube/bus at the airport for our trip to the B&B) The bedroom was on the small side. Nice soft white linen and duvet. Bathroom was new , with a glass sink. It did not have enough horizontal surfaces to place toiletries though, and the design of the shower caused too much water spray. The night stand was very tiny, nor was there much room around the bed to place a suitcase. The Flatscreen TV was very small, but worked nicely, and the Host let us borrow the DVD "The Flood" about the Thames flooding. The bed was very comfortable (although too small for us- we asked for 2 beds, but that room was even smaller). Even though they were not booked full, they did not offer us other rooms, so I saw only these two. Everything had a new feel to it, carpets, tile floor, all was very clean and no unpleasant smells. I was surprised they didn't make the beds one day, I guess it was the weekend, and help hadn't shown up. Our host was very pleasant, helpful,cheerful with a great sense of humor. He was quick to give advise or search for things on the internet for us. There was a cozy dining room with about 9 tables nicely arranged. We had afternoon tea there with cookies. For dinner we used the room to eat our salad we had bought at the grocery store near there. (we cleaned up after ourselves) He prepared our breakfast daily- we went for the full English breakfast. Delicious, especially the omelet. Croissants and delicious coffee in individual presses was served. Several daily papers were available for us to read while we waited for the nice hot breakfast- a real leisurely treat we took advantage of. I had heard of Guy Fawkes firework celebration in early November, I thought it would be on Monday, but was corrected that it was on Saturday, and one of the biggest fireworks were within walking distance of the B&B. We walked to the park- we felt very safe walking around at night in the neighborhood. The fireworks were spectacular, the best public fireworks we had ever seen. It was fun observing the local people, and talking to them. They were surprised, I think, to hear Americans in their midst. We had a very nice stay. Our mode of transportation was the bus, we used a daily bus pass, which we bought next door at a convenience store. The owner was from India, he was super helpful, giving us advise on the least expensive, and/or fastest way to travel- very kind gentleman. We decided not to buy a pass that would cover the many attractions and transportation (in zone 1 and 2- that's all you need, unless you go to the airports, they require more zones). Because this was our first visit, just exploring the city and driving around in the busses didn't leave us with any time to go into any of the many indoor attractions. Also the weather was so beautiful, we didn't need to go indoors. Also, I would be surprised if you got your money's worth, since each attraction would take at least 1/2 a day.

title: Could be so nice, but just misses on so many things
text: We just stayed one night. The room was up three flights of stairs. The electrics are problematic . No lights at all in our bathroom, which had no window. We were kindly offered use of the bathroom in the room above, in the attic (very very steep steps), which was ok, but not so convenient! Also one bedside light didn't work. The kettle in the room would not stay on without you holding down the switch! The toaster in the breakfast room was not working, neither was the radiator. The breakfast room was freezing. Breakfast was basic, with no real coffee, only instant. Cereal was alright. It was an ok stay. It was good location for our needs and close to buses. Clearly there is a lot for the maintenance man to do here! The staff were helpful and welcoming.

title: delightful little gem
text: Stayed here only because we had a wedding to attend in Blackheath. Paid £120 for a double room on a saturday night. Hotel nothing to look at from the outside, it blends into a terraced row of grotty shops, next door is a kebab shop. Initial impression was 'oh my god!' We pressed the buzzer and were instantly welcomed in to a very well presented, clean and trendy little hotel/b&b. The owner was delightful. Efficient early check in. Room was small and compact but..perfectly formed -all you need and more for a good nights sleep in London. Only niggles were 1. a cold shower 2. a noisy aircon unit 3. no cooked full english! Ideal place to crash in London at a reasonable price. Would stay again. My car also survived the night in the public pay and display car park!(£1 for 24hrs!!!!!)

title: Disappointing experience in a below average B&B
text: I stayed here with my husband for one night only on 21 February 2013 and I can honestly say, this has been my worst experience in a B&B to date. The website is very misleading which I have noticed other reviewers have commented on. I was expecting a boutique-type B&B and what I got was more like a hostel-type accommodation. To give you an idea of the experiences we had at 162: on entry to the B&B you are greeted by a screen/monitor to check in. There is no person at reception and a type of vending machine that slots out your key to access your room. If I had a choice, I would prefer face to face contact rather than a screen with a phone to it. Nevertheless, it would not have been a problem if we didn’t need to speak to the manager about the appalling state of our room. Firstly the door was left open and the room hadn’t been cleaned as there was a toilet brush left in the middle of the loo, including evidence of faeces left for us to view too. Not including the stale croissants and Nescafe coffee offered at breakfast. One positive is that when we asked to move rooms, management did make this happen, but we still had problems with a leaky sink in the new room and to make matters worse was no hot water in the morning. It was like the hotel of horrors! To add insult to injury we paid £90 for our double room including breakfast - far too expensive for a below average B&B. I would rate this accommodation as 2/5 stars. A great amount of effort went into the website to make it “appear” like a boutique hotel but in actual fact it, experiences proved it was an over-priced hostel. Avoid at all costs – I certainly will be!

title: Disappointing stay
text: Was looking forward to our stay at the One Six Two after reading reviews of the nice rooms, etc. Whilst the decor was nice, it was not a great overnight stay. There was a mixture of very thoughtful staff and a feeling of getting in the way. We arrived to find the front door open and no staff. We then used the automated check-in system (would prefer to meet someone when arriving!) but the system had no record of our booking. We were then greeted by a member of staff who was clearly running around trying to get lots done. He was incredibly friendly and did all he could to take care of us, but this didn't seem to be his job. I think he was in charge of readying the rooms for new arrivals (changing bed sheets, cleaning the rooms, etc). But he was the only staff member around so he found our booking and room key and let us in. Only to see that he wasn't quite done cleaning the room! Again he was very friendly and apologetic for the hassle as he politely asked us to wait a few minutes while he finished with the room. Our night's stay was fine - went to the Standard Pub up the road. Good pub food, great value. The bed was comfortable and room quiet. There was a bit of strange smell in the bathroom, like mold or something but there was an extractor fan when we showered and just kept the door closed during the night. The next morning again did not see too many staff members. No real greeting or appreciation for our business. I had to ask if all was paid for as we departed. No one seemed to manage check-outs. But the staff member confirmed the billing and called us a taxi. Later that same day received a phonecall advising that we left a watch in our room. The hotel is mailing it for us, postage paid upon delivery. Overall, nice rooms but in a weird set-up with no staff members to greet and ensure guests are comfortable. I was told that they had a very bad water leak at the property during the past week so perhaps that explains the frazzled feel about the place. But personally I would prefer good customer service and attention to detail.

title: Very disappointing
text: We stayed one night at this guest house and will not be returning. The room was in the basement, though we were not told about this on booking, and the cost was the same as rooms on upper floors, which I do not feel was right, with a window which opened on to a ventilation shaft. The bed was uncomfortable with a mattress that had us rolling into the middle, with lumpy pillows. There was an unemptied bin in the bathroom. Breakfast was very poor, with stale croissants, dry mandarin oranges in the fruit salad and no sign of the soya milk I had requested. Check in was via a machine which gave up a key after checking details - very impersonal. The member or staff on duty at breakfast was helpful, but very scruffily attired.The room was pleasantly furnished with a good powerful shower, but overall very disappointing .

title: Nothing like the website, don't do it !
text: My partner and I booked this B & B along with three other couples, for 8th Dec 12. We arrived out side the 'hote'l expecting somewhere to pull up to unload the car, as advertised. There is no such facility. It is a 'doorway' on a parade of shops. As lots of the reviews have stated there are no staff to speak to. Once we finally got into the room we found a pokey hot room, without enough space to even walk around the bed. We looked out of the window onto three brick walls. The bed was clean, the towels smelt horrid, the shower was scalding or icey cold, the bathroom was not clean and i would say that we had about a centemetre of tissue on the toilet roll with no other in sight. The kettle did not work properly, lightshades were missing and having been concerned about what to wear to our function stop worrying because there was not a mirror big enough to see myself in anyway. The room was so hot we could not sleep, the radiator control did nothing. To top off our weekend the full english breakfast advertised turned out to be coffee and a croissant. One poor little waitress was the only member of staff anywhere. I would advise anyone to avoid this dreadful place like the plague. They should be reported for misleading potential guests, and misrepresentation on the website. It is a backstreet bedsit and not a boutique hotel.

title: A Total Rip Off - Don't Go!!!!
text: I wish I had read all the other reviews before I'd booked this hotel. On arriving, after 10 minutes or so, I discovered the self check in system. Not something that is advised on booking and had it been I definitely would not have booked. Its totally impersonal and the website describes this place as cosy but it is far from that. My room was the basement room. I felt like I'd been put in the dungeon. Immediately on arrival I wanted to complain but as there are no staff at all, there is noone to complain to. A great idea on the hotels part as who can complain if there's noone there? When I got into the room, I discovered is smelt damp, there was no phone signal, the window was open, obviously to get rid of the damp smell, but it was around 2deg outside. The shower, which is described as an ensuite on the website, was the size of a downstairs loo. The shower was worn and the water went from scalding to cold whilst I was under it. The towels, described as white and fluffy on the website, were threadbare. The only positive I can think of was the young girl who helped to clear away breakfast, she was very polite and personable but the only member of staff available and clearly not equipped to deal with the numerous complains she would have received. Overall this place is a rip off at £99 and would advise anyone thinking of staying to avoid it like the plague!

title: If you like confined spaces and freezing cold showers then this is the place for you!
text: Don't be fooled by the fantastic website, it is nothing like the reality. Firstly we were greeted by a computer who took our details and dispensed the room key. There were no directions to the room but it wasn't difficult to find, just confusing as there is two staircases and no signs that were visible. When we went into the room we were amazed at how small it was. It was very cramped, we could only walk around the bed sideways, the bathroom was tiny, and there was nowhere to put our case. We were constantly moving it out of our way. We had to take turns getting ready because there wasn't enough room for us to get ready at the same time. Unfortunately, there was no hot water either, the hot shower water ran out very quickly and we had to get cold showers on the first morning, and on the second morning there was no water at all! The one member of staff that was around was very apologetic but it didn't change the fact that we had freezing or worse, no water at all. On the positive side, the one member of staff we did see on rare occasions was polite and helpful, breakfast was good and there was plenty of choice, and the bed was very comfortable. The hotel is only 10 mins from the O2 (£8 in a taxi) and there is free wifi which is always useful.

title: Misleading Photographs dreadful
text: Main front door left open with no security. Dreadful location, Stairs to heave luggage up higher than Everest, with no lift availale. Not mentioned on website. No parking. Half a mile away if you can find it! Free parking if you're lucky. Also not mentioned. We checked out before check in>>>>refused refund or apology for inconvieience. Very misleading. We re-checked in a different hotel and lost our money. Apart from that we had a good time in London.

title: Small ,cosy onesixtwo
text: My husband and I recently visited London and stayed for 5 nights at this small but cosy guesthouse Onesixtwo.The location ,not being the centre of London but Greenwich( nice shopping/sightseeing area, walking distance ) ,was no problem because the public transport is practically on their doorstep.Friends of ours came by car and had no problem to free park around the corner. Our room was a bit on the small side but adequate,immaculately clean and the best feature was a very comfortable bed. Breakfast was as promised ,fresh,organic and varied.The full English breakfast is very good , we chose the Salmon scrambled eggs the second day, delicious.! The staff were very hospitable and made it clear that it was truly their pleasure to help you. We look forward to going to London again and we would certainly stay in the Onesixtwo .
