text: Good connectivity regarding trasport.. Tube station and Bus connectivity.. Nice Food Joints around.. For Shopping lovers also have good options many supermarkets, affordable outlets around the place..

title: Great bolt hole for the weekend
text: Absolutely immaculate studio apartment.Very close to everything you might need, including some great restaurants. Handover smooth with representative giving all information needed for a good stay in the studio. Only small negative was that in common with other reviewers, we didn't find the bed that comfortable. Given that we were only there for the weekend it wasn't something that would stop us from staying at this great value for money studio again

title: Okay for Price
text: Pros: Nice appliances Clean 5 Minute Walk to Tube 30 Minutes to Downtown Good Price Cons: Small - Be sure to check out the floor plans and think carefully about the square footage. The pictures they show are of the larger apartments Wi-Fi - incredibly spotty

title: Great Location!!
text: Wonderful place to stay, absolutely spotless! Conveniently located to the tube so it was easy to hop on the bus or the tube to get around. We were only a ten minute bus ride to our sons flat which made it quite nice that we did not have to travel far late at night after and evening together. Would stay here again as the people at the front office were very friendly and helpful when we arrived.

title: average apartment
text: They don't respond at time (before the travel) at my emails about the check-in hour. I had to pay 30£ for 30 minutes late at the check-in. is't a stealing! Wifi was terrible inside the apartment, at least using Apple. The bed was a sofa-bed and was also terrible. For 5 nights and after passed the days walking aroud the city, arrived home and sleep at a bed like this one was like, better sleep at the floor. It was super uncomfortable.

title: New, clean, but depressing
text: Location: good 25 min by tube to central London, popular area but not too risky. Small, very clean studio on the ground floor giving on a small garden, totally IKEA equipped kitchen

title: Great service
text: If you needed something they were right around the corner. They were very nice and polite helped out if needed. The house missed a couple thing listed but it did not bother at all. The sofa beds did hurt in your back but you can deal with that. overall it was the best service i ever had when booking a apartment or house on vacation

title: Highly Recommend
text: The apartment is clean and cozy. You have everything you need in the apartment. The position is great. It is 3 minutes walk to the closest underground and Turnpike Lane Station is on the Piccadilly line which is only 15-20 minutes to travel to city centre.

title: London visit
text: The location is great. Close to the Piccadilly line and enables you to get anywhere in the center of London. The apartment was brand new, fully equipped and very lovely. We enjoyed our stay and recommend it.

title: Nice but not described correct
text: Rooms were very clean however nothing like it showed on the pictures. We had a sofa bed instead of a luxury double that it described we would have. Our room also didn't have an oven which it also stated, was very disappointed as the room wasn't cheap. Clean and tidy just a shame the images shown were not accurate, after being very excited we felt extremely let down.

title: very beautiful apartament
text: Comfortable and very clean apartments, bathroom in order and clean, very close to the turnpike lane metro station, friendly and friendly staff, I would recommend it to everyone,check in and check out perfect. Claudio italy

title: London trip with friends
text: I spent with my friends good time here. We had the apartment for 8 people and it was very modern, tidy and beautifil. Accommodation is very close to underground and markets (Tesco, Poundland, Mall). I highly recommend this apartment.

title: Can be considered
text: The location is really nice. It's peaceful and really close to underground, shops, fast food chains at the same time. Price is a little bit lower than average. It was clean and fully furnished Photos on booking weren't quite correct. Bed was a little worse than on the photos. The apartments were very noisy (outdoors and neighbors sounds). Shower in bathroom should be repaired (water leeks out to the floor). The location of power sockets is unhandy (hard to use staff like hair dryer) Still, I recommend you to consider these apartments. Probably some other their room is better.

title: Central North London accommodation
text: Linton Apartments were well set up, secure, and close to Turnpike Lane Station. The office staff were helpful. As we had a late flight on the day we left we were able to leave our luggage in storage, which was a big help. We there during a hot spell. Unfortunately, there was no fan or air conditioning. We did have to purchase a fan!

title: Good location---that's all!!
text: Know nothing about customer service needs to work on better communication, and consistency. I was left swaltering in the heat for two days. Window was stuck and they didn't know how to open it for two days.

title: London trip
text: tis is a great place ta stay and very close 2the under ground train..about 20mins ta oxford street.aptment wazclean and tidy.and a good size but only fault abiut it is..the telly waz on the wall behind the bed..wot a le down if u wanted ta watch telly in bed..

title: Excellent place 15 minutes from central London!
text: Excellent place with modern standard. Two bathrooms in high standard. The kitchen is very modern and wellplanned. The beds are very comfort and so are the livingroom with TV and a nice sofa. The staff id very serviceminded and give an excellent service. We will recomend this place to all out friends and will soon come back.

title: Great Accommodation
text: We were here from 14 March to the 21st. It was more than what we expected. It felt like it was our own home. Facilities are new, the Kitchen and Bathroom are clean and well maintained. The apartment is secured with state-of-the-art security panels to give you a peace of mind while you're asleep. The place is walking distance from the mall and few establishments. Tube station is literally a few steps away from the apartment. We were actually sad when we left the place as it felt like home to us. Book this directly to their website to avail cheaper booking :)

title: Spacious and comfortable 1 bedroom
text: We booked a month early and Yaj answered all questions and concerns promptly through the booking site's messaging service. We flew in from the US overnight so we were pretty tired when we arrived. Our room was ready by check-in time. -Yaj gave a very thorough tour of the apartment's amenities -Anything we didnt have in the apartment were available just a few minutes walk to the store. Tescos, Sainsbury and Morrisons were all accessible. -The apartment was comfortable with a big corner window that let in lots of light. -We were able to keep the room at a comfortable temperature. -There is a washer/dryer in the unit that we used. We didnt have to pack as much knowing that we could wash our cloths. -Its a nice place to come back to after a long day of sightseeing. Its steps from both buses and trains.

title: Nothing outstanding but handy for the Tube...
text: Whilst the slats holding our bed in place seemed to fall out of their own accord for two nights running (including once at 3am), after reporting this the maintenance guy came and screwed in the slats to avoid this problem happening again. Good sized apartment, plenty of space, however the cheap furniture really let the place down (all seemed to be from IKEA). Also a bit unsure of where the line is drawn between hotel and apartment, with some basic amenities not being replenished at all during our five-night stay (such as bins, towels and toilet roll). Overall, nothing outstanding but offers great transport links with the Piccadilly line being less than 2 minutes walk. A great place for a shower and a bed, not great if you're planning a 'staycation' - and for the one night we did decide on a quiet night in, the WiFi was so slow it was absolutely unusable. 5/10 - will think twice about going again.

title: Look elsewhere.
text: The housekeeping lady breach into the room without warning, to ask if we leave that morning. The room had a wet, smelly ceiling. The bathroom had a strong moldy smell. The free wireless was very, very slow, to the point of being useless.

title: A Nice and Clean Apartment
text: The Apartment is nice and clean, they provide you with everything. Since no one is cleaning the toilets, better to provide us with toilet bowl clearer as well , we have to buy our own . It is about 3 minutes walk from Turnpike Lane Station. Located in a residential area facing a park, which is nice. There are many restaurants to choose from and supermarkets and fruits markets in the area. A nice big mall and 2 cinemas within walking distance, like 15 minutes walk, which is not bad.

title: Nice rooms, but the fee
text: Rooms were beautiful, outside of the london, in a kinda a quiet location with few restaurants and shops as well. The apartments are next to metro and bus stations. Everything was okay but the late check in fee, 75 pounds is crazy!!!! Next time I will think twice to come here.

title: Excellent
text: Very clean room with pleasant and reliable staff !!! In addition very close to the underground !!! I will suggest this accomodation to friends and collegues for any kind of trip either work or vacation.

title: Fabulous apartment
text: This apartment was fabulous and had everything that was required for a short stay. It was cheap, clean and quiet and really close to Kings X Station. Cinema close by and supermarket for buying foods etc. Would really recommend this to anyone. On arrival we were met very quickly and let into our apartment.

title: Nice place to stay, very kind people.
text: The appartment were we stayed was very nice and clean. It is nearby a metrostation, you will be in the centre of London within 30 minutes. The people were very kind. There is a good bakery were you can get a good breakfast.

title: Great place
text: Apartment is 2 minutes away from Turnpike Lane station (Picadilly underground line). The neighbourhood is packed with shops and food places. Local pub (sometimes very local

title: Very good choice!
text: Good location, 150m from the underground station. Near to the 2nd bigger market of London. It provides all the necessary equipment (utilities, towels etc). Very clean!! Strong WiFi signal. Friendly and safe environment.

title: Nice department
text: Nice decorate department. Kitchen full equipped. A bit small. The bad thing: too far away from Central London, although is nearby the metro. It's 20 minutes by subway. They also don't respond the messages in the web pages.

title: Fantastic
text: Fantastic apartments in the turnpike area. One apprtment had 4 rooms all with double beds and en suites. Very cheap for the London area. Only a few pubs and takeaways near by but superb or the working man. 100% recommend.

title: Best accommodation in London
text: Nice position, 2 minutes from. Piccadilly line tube station, friendly staff, excellent room. Very clean and new forniture. Place very quiet. Must to stay. We will return on next trip to London. Must to see.

title: Great accommodation
text: Great place and great price with spacious rooms and updated amenities in each apartment type. A short walk (1-2 minutes) away from train station. The office is staffed with friendly and helpful personnel. This is my second stay here and I will definitely be staying here in the future

title: Everyhing was OK !
text: Room was very convenient for our trip. It's very close to tube station. Clean and very modern room with all necessary equipment. The bed would be more confortable, but no problem for a short time. The staff was very frendly and we retrun next time.

title: Mirjana
text: Great accomodation on very good location. Metro is 2 min walking distance and in 20 min you are in London city centre. Near appartment you have shopping zone with bars and restaurants- prices 30-50% lover than in central London.

title: Perfect
text: Cosy and modern studio. Excellent for prize and location although neighbourhood perhaps is not very well known. Without a doubt I would repeat. Only 15 minutes to town center by tube. Staff talkative and always available to help.

title: Highly recommended
text: Nice and convenient place to stay ! Very close to tube station and all shops(2-3min to walk). Really nice park just in front of the house with outdoor gym, playground, basketball and football grounds and lovely cafe. Apartment itself is brand new, clean and beautiful! No problems with neighbors or anything else. All problems are very quickly solved and help is only one phone call away :) come, stay and enjoy London !

title: Disappointing
text: We have just stayed at the Melia White House hotel and returned home exhausted! Even though we booked a superior room the bed was so uncomfortable you could feel the springs! The aircon didn't work and the whole hotel was exhaustingly too hot! The Bathroom had a shower over the bath but the bath was way too high and I slipped and hurt my leg! Trying to step into it! Room was tired and noisy! But it was clean. My advise would be don't stay here find somewhere more comfortable with aircon that works.

title: Very impressive “The Level”
text: I arrived at the hotel after my flight had landed in LHR at 6am and impressively the hotel replied to my email and informed me that I could check in at the time and my room was ready. Incredible! I went to the hotel after I got ready at Plaza Premium Lounge at T2 LHR and checked in at the Level and got cold glass of water. The breakfast was incredible

title: good stay
text: great hotel with great staff, spacious room but the bathroom was small, clean and comfy beds breakfast was great, we had access to two restaurants for the breakfast because we booked a suit ,really enjoyed my time there

title: Excellent as always
text: We visit London 2 or 3 times a year and always stay at the Melia White House. It's location is ideal - close to bus stops and underground lines, but soundproofing is so good, noise is no problem. The staff couldn't be more helpful and we will look forward to our next visit.

title: Business meeting
text: Excellent place for meetings easy to locate I came in from Euston and was literally just a short walk 15mins approx. The customer service very good most helpful the staff. In the meeting room there was plenty of water still /sparkling plus there was sweets/savouries on he table . Plus coffee and pastries available . Lunch what an excellent choice they had thought of everything from making your own sandwich to full main meals . Well presented all looked delicious ! Good vegetarian options as well Nice friendly staff

title: Great family value
text: This hotel has an excellent meal package that Is great for families and very economical in London. The breakfast is very good and the evening tapas selections are excellent. The rooms are clean, and family rooms are a decent size. The staff is very friendly and seems to genuinely care about you. I would definitely stay here again.

title: Family get together (Room 808)
text: Since my last visit in January 2018 the hotel has undergone refurbishment which might take a few weeks longer. The reception area is now at the back whilst the front office is being blitzed. Level lounge has been completely redone and is now a warmer more attractive space. Room and contents still good although some more elderly guests might find over bath shower a trial. Good nights sleep in excellent bed and very good breakfast. Recent refurbishment of Level lounge meant that breakfast service was a little disorganised. After request face flannels were provided. Will go stay again.

title: Weekend city break
text: Gret hotel, great service, 24 hour room service, comfortable room, location is convenient, breakfast is served until 11am on weekends and is tasty, would stay again. Many thanks to melia white house hotel.

title: Just amazing!!!
text: Great accommodation with its private reception and restaurant for breakfast as well for some tapas in the afternoon when finishing working. Great staff all over.Guest Experience staff very thoughtful. THANKS

title: Fantastic stay
text: I have stayed in their apartments for several months and have gone back to stay for 2 weeks as well during the course of this year. Fabulous place and great service. Apartment is clean and modern. I have stayed in the standard flat as well as executive flat, both are great!

title: A gem
text: Beautiful hote with superb service - only wish we could have stayed longer!. Upgraded to The Level as we changed our booking from a double to a triple room. Tapas and breakfast were excellent but sadly we didn't have the opportunity to sample the food during the day. Mother's Day chocolates in the rooms were a nice touch. My only negative comment would be the prices of the cocktails

title: First impressions were not great!!!
text: So we arrived at the hotel around 2pm on 14th December staying for two nights with my partner. Arrvied at the check in desk and the lady asked for the card we paid with, I didn't have it with me as it was a CC and it was already paid over a month n advance so didn't think this would be an issue, turns out this was a HUGE issue and refused entry to the hotel. We asked for a manager as they had debited my card over a month ago when I booked the hotel over the phone direct nobody told me I cant get access to the room without the card. Spoke to a manager who was the most rude, arrogant person I have ever dealt with. We had travelled from north east to come for a weekend away and she was smirking at us telling us the only option is to refund the CC and pay again. I explained I didn't own the CC anymore so it couldn't be refunded and also we didn't have the funds to pay again. We then had to ask for a higher manager as we were getting no further forward. We the spoke with Lili and she helped us and sorted it all out for us, she was so lovely and couldn't do enough for us as a manager should! We didn't get a welcome drink or pillow menu also nothing was said about getting a shirt ironed as all was advertised when booking. The room was a little old for 4* hotel and the bathroom was tiny with a pitiful shower. The location was perfect and breakfast was lovely with so much choice! also the tapas and drinks were nice on an evening.

title: Not quite right
text: Stayed at the level on Dec 14th-16th with my 16 year old daughter as birthday treat. We had an executive twin room booked. Arrived at 3:30 pm and main reception attendant told us our room was not ready and to take a seat. She was very blasé about it and not at all empathic. I asked for a different room as we were both tired and hungry. We were given a room on same floor, 8. Room smelled of dreadful damp so had to phone and asked to me moved. At this stage I was told that I should have checked in at The Level reception desk which is not in the main lobby, ok, so went there and nice young man took our details and asked that we leave our bags in the damp room and when we returned we would have a new room. Arrived back that evening and indeed had a new room. Were told that we had all sorts of amenities as level guests including a pillow menu! We never got one. Room was ok, quite small. Beds were the hardest beds I have ever slept on. One bottle of water for a twin room to share! Next morning we went for breakfast at 09:30. Lovely breakfast area, no one came to offer us coffee and eventually I had to go and ask the lady at the entrance for some. Buffet breakfast was lovely but the hot food we had was tepid, scrambled eggs were cold but coffee was great. On Sunday we were up early but again the breakfast was tepid at best, but at least this time we had a pot of coffee brought to table. Bathroom was spacious. Shower in bath was very poor and not what one would expect from 4 star hotel. Wall above shower had cracked tiles and mould growing in them. Furniture in room had seen better days, lots of scratches and dings in the wood. Nice comfy robes and slippers and an espresso machine. No papers delivered on sat morning which was strange. Artwork and decorations were beautiful in the hotel, really tasteful. I will not return

title: Good service but...
text: Booked a junior suite with Melia points and got a very good deal. Service was very good and we got 1 of our rooms at 1.00pm (check in is 3.00pm). Room is OK with a large but uncomfortable bed, not just for me but the wife and both of our friends in their room. Bathroom was in the small side for a JS. We found the hotel quite noisy, this was more from inside the hotel than outside e.g. creaky floors, noisy ventilation etc. the Level lounge was pleasant with alcoholic drinks available from 6.00pm. The breakfast had a good selection with the usual favourites. Not a bad hotel by any means but a comfortable sleep is important and for a junior suite I expect a little more. Oh and great location.

title: Superior
text: I stayed at The Level at Meliá Whitehouse on a recent business trip Located in central London's Regent's Park area it provided superior accommodation, great access to restaurants, shops and parks. As a business traveller it had a comfortable lounge area for guests which was ideal for work etc.

title: Terrible service standards
text: I travelled with my wife and my daughter for this trip. It was a business trip for myself and a holiday trip for my family. I am currently into the third night of my four nights stay at The Level Family Room. Background - this is the first time that I am staying with the Melia hotel. I believe that this is a Spanish establishment. All the staff that I had come in contact with speaks Spanish. Their communication in English language is adequate but often carries with a strong accent. There are two check-in reception areas for this hotel. Guests staying at The Level (wing) has an exclusive check in area at the other end of the building. There is also a lounge adjacent to the check in area which is exclusive for guests at The Level. Room - the family room is a generous size (by London standards). It comes with a king size bed and a double size sofa bed. Our initial impression of the room was good. However, there are some major shortcomings. 1. Although the windows are double glazed, I could hear police/ambulance sirens the entire night. At times, this could be 4-5 times per hour. As a light sleeper, this can been quite disturbing. 2. The toilet seat design is flawed. It is built adjacent to a wall and the space allowance is inadequate. What this means is that a person cannot sit properly on the toilet seat - you have to sit in an awkward angle to do what you need to do. Btw, we are average size Asians. 3. Carpets are worn and has stains on it. And yes, the sofa bed is placed on the carpet. 4. The shower design is flawed. Whenever a person showers the entire toilet floor will be wet. Food - breakfast spread is good by any standards. I just came a 3 night stay from Hilton Opera Paris and i must say the breakfast at Melia surpasses that of Hilton in Paris. Service standards 1. Reception staff are courteous. However, the line seem to be engaged each time (at night) when we attempted to contact the reception. 2. Concierge/Guest experience is polite but may not always give the best advice. My wife and child wanted to go to Kidzania at Westfields mall but were directions to change two different tube lines when there was a direct tube to the mall - regent park to wood lane. 3. Housekeeping - cleaning standard is adequate but definitely not service oriented. Sofa bed is not kept during room servicing and is left on the floor the entire stay. We were informed by housekeeping that as guests of The Level Family room (which is mean to sleep up to 4 pax), we were entitled to one bottle of drinking water per room per day. We will be charge for any additional bottles. We did not received our supply of drinking water for two consecutive days. On the first occasion, I called the house keeping staff and was reminded that only one bottle will be provided. I waited for two hours in the night and the water was not delivered as promised. During the second occasion, I called the guest experience and shared with her my frustrations pertaining to the drinking water issue. I was reassured that the water will be delivered to my room immediately. It never came as I am typing this review. Come on, management of Melia! I can go to the lounge downstairs to drink as much as I want. I could also have gone to Tesco and buy 2 liters of Evian for 1 sterling pound (which I did). I paid 250 sterling pounds for the room and you are trying to fight with us over a bottle of drinking water?? Unbelievable! I can accept the first omission as a genuine mistake, but twice is considered as bad faith. I have stayed in so many different hotels but this is a the first time that I have come across one like the Melia. Others - we stayed in room 805. When we checked in, we cannot help but noticed several men sitting along the narrow corridor leading to our room. They appeared to be security personnel. They had chairs and a small table placed on the corridor. I believed that as guests of the hotel, we should have been informed that there are security personnel placed near our room. We should also have been given the option of staying in a different area as these guards made us uncomfortable. Given the corridor is already narrow, stationing guards with chairs and tables could have been a fire safety hazard to my family. In view of all the above, I reluctantly rate the Melia as a no no for me. I will be attending a conference in Spain in 2019. I have yet to decided which hotel I will be staying, but you can bet that I have decided which hotel I WILL NOT be staying with.

title: Superb Hotel in a great location
text: We have spent 4 nights here, using the Hotel as a Sightseeing base. There is a Tour Bus stop, directly across the Street, outside the Hotel. The Level Reception can be accessed either through the Hotel or a dedicated side entrance. The rooms are large and well furnished. As with all Melia Hotels the beds are Huge! Restaurants & Bars are very trendy & chic. Just be aware of the 'Automatic' 19% service charge added to your Bills. The Hotel from the external looks ok but walking into the Foyer it looks stunning. title: Superb quality Great stay and so well situated.
text: Stayed here while on business and had a grand suite room 693 which was really nice with a spacious lounge separate bedroom with an en suite bathroom and a separate toilet off the lounge. We also used the level lounge which offered drinks tapas and breakfast exclusive to Level guests. The place was spacious and extremely well appointed with staff on hand who really look after you. It is next to Regents Park and situated not far from Paddington station which has an express link to Heathrow Airport and also not far fro Euston and St Pancras stations with train links to the UK and Europe. An under ground station is situated immediately across the road. What a great place.

title: Fantastic hotel and service
text: Me and my wife have stayed in countless hotels worldwide over many years. I have to say The Level at Melia White House has reached new heights in hotel luxury and service. The staff were so helpful and friendly ( every single one of them ). The food selection and quality was first class and the rooms perfect. Even the lift system ensured there are no queues and direct to your floor with no stops. The location was ideal with 2 tube stations and Euston station close by. I really cant find a single fault with my hotel experience.

title: Wonderful stay
text: Excellent service, very friendly staff. Comfortable hotel for families. Large room (The Level family suit) with enough space for 2 adults and 2 children. Nice breakfast. The Level is worth it. Free tapas and refreshments in the afternoon. The hotel is well-located.

title: Great service
text: Clean rooms , nice people, location, excellent service. Quality food and breakfast, good restaurant and nice executive room. My hotel in London. Also nice location with a lot of transport and restaurants nearby. Walking distance to shopping areas.

title: Fabulous
text: I have previously stayed at the Meliá White House but this was my first experience of the Level. Check in was quick and easy with a complimentary glass of cava. Our room was spacious and light. The bed was amazing and after a couple of months of poor sleep, I finally enjoyed some much needed quality sleep. My only criticism of the room would be the bathrobes which were heavy and not pleasant to wear. Other than that, everything was perfect. Breakfast was amazing and we were truly spoilt for choice. We also enjoyed the complimentary drinks and snacks provided on an evening as part of the Level package. The hotel is ideally located for Euston if travelling by train, and has a number of tube stations close by although you can easily access many of the tourist attractions by foot. I highly recommend Iberica Marylebone is you are looking for a restaurant close by. All in all we had a fantastic two days and the Level will be our number one choice for future visits to London.

title: Pretty good stay
text: Standard romms are not very big

title: Excellent Hotel With Excellent Staff
text: We 'long-weekend' in London a couple of times each year and this is our third visit to the Level at the Melia White House. The hotel is in a good location and a comfortable 15 minute walk to 'attractions' such as Oxford Street, Madame Tussauds and London Zoo. We were welcomed back as return guests and the staff made us feel very welcome. Realistically many hotels offer similar physical standards and often the differentiator comes down to the staff and how they treat you. All the staff we had dealings with were, without exception, helpful, polite, cheerful and always managed to make us feel special by taking the time to engage. An excellent example of this behaviour was demonstrated by Roberto Palermo from Guest Services (who we had met on previous visits) who came and found us in the lounge to check everything was okay. The Level provides an enhanced feeling of luxury with its own check-in and a Level lounge adjacent where you can read the papers. The lounge also provides tea/coffee/soft drinks/biscuits/cakes all day and, in the evening, there are also tapas and alcoholic drinks available (gratis). Our junior suite was roomy and well appointed. The windows are not double glazed so there is a little bit of street noise to be heard, primarily police and emergency vehicles, but that's part of being in London (or New York). There is a turn down service in the evenings with towels replenished as necessary. We chose to eat in The Place as by the time we had taken advantage of the tapas and a couple of glasses of wine (thank you Reuben) in the lounge the buffet seemed a sensible option. The restaurant team continued the high standard we had seen elsewhere in the hotel and particular thanks to the restaurant manager Valerio Marchese who was an excellent host and very effectively sorted out a minor problem. We have already booked for next February and are looking forward to our next visit.

title: Good location... fab access to Great Portalnd St. Terrible service...
text: So...Its a great location good access to underground.... we stayed at club level... so we expected a little more... we have stayed at various Hiltons and 4 seasons etc and have been pleasantly surprised with the level of service there.. and expected similar here ( Melia Havana in Cuba was SUPERB) However... all we seemed to do was wait.... FOR EVERYTHING! Check In was supposed to be 3pm ... but we couldn't check in at 3pm...after waiting and waiting we were still pushed to the side and ignored. We had a reservation at Fortnum and Masons at 4:30 so thought we had ample time with a 3pm Check in..... No...we had to wait for our suite... " it will be ready in another 20 mins".... by this time it was 15:45pm- When you are given a time to check in .... this should be the time you check in! We are not concerned what the previous guests did in the room and I really don't want to get changed in the gym- this is the alternative we were offered! Not good enough! So ..to summarise... don't bother paying more for a suite... because its not worth hanging around all day to check in...and then be offered a gym changing room... when You have booked a suite... Lovely hotel... nice rooms... TERRIBLE SERVICE...

title: The Level probably worth the extra
text: We have stayed at the Melia White House several times before but this was our first stay in the Level. I love the location of the hotel, directly opposite Great Portland Street tube station with easy access to Kings Cross and Euston, and an easy walk to Oxford Street. The rooms in the Level are a little dated but comfortable and well appointed. The Level Lounge serves drinks and nibbles from 1800 to 2030 and, although the choice of wines is very limited, I tried both the Spanish red and white and both were very good. The Level has a separate check-in area where the staff were uniformly friendly and helpful (and almost exclusively Spanish. Perhaps my only criticism is the Level breakfast. The buffet choices of both hot and cold food are fine but the hot food is at best luke warm and frequently cold. Prices vary considerably but if you can get the Level at a reasonable price then highly recommended.

title: Just great
text: We have there for six very satisfying nights. Great location : Just near tube station and bus stops.Usually we walked few minutes to Oxford street.Many restaurants around and minimarkets if you need. The room is very comfortable.Everything in the room male you feel great.Full good wifi in the hotel and in the room The service is just perfect and very friendly. The business lounge is very spoiling: drinks and coffee along the day and on evening delicious tapas are serviced. The gym is fully equipped :you just have to go there and enjoy some training. The Dry Martini bar is just fabulous You get 20 pounds/night to spend on room serveice/bar/restaurant The only thing disturbing a bit was the thin walls between rooms or bad isolation:you could hear clearly your neighbors talking A perfect hotel

title: 9 days at Melia White House
text: We spend 9 days at this hotel during the August 2018 and we have only superb things to say about the Hotel. The hotel staff is very kind, attentive, patient, helpful and kid’s friendly. Breakfast was generous and delicious, very suitable for kids as well. The Level is a wonderful place to spend some time after a long day of traveling outside, enjoying light refreshments and wine. We have been in the junior suite , which was wide and comfy. Highly recommended hotel. We will surely come back here on our next visit to London.

title: This will be my hotel in London from now!
text: Excellent facilities but most importantly well trained staff that were always pleasant and helpful. The Level was well worth the upgrade for the value in the club room. This is a large hotel and the check in and out was very busy again the Level gave us priority.

title: Another fabulous stay at The White House
text: The White House is a brilliant hotel, we always upgrade to The Level as the extras it offers always makes our stay extra special. The staff are friendly & the service excellent. The rooms are very clean & comfortable. The position of the hotel is in a central position.

title: Great experience in this hotel
text: While this hotel is not in central London it is a 3 - 8 minute walk to three underground station that get you anywhere you want to go quickly and efficiently. We stayed 6 nights and were total satisfied with the spacious bedroom and bathroom including a great bed and wonderful air conditioning. The staff is excellent to deal with and very professional and friendly. The breakfast buffet is outstanding with its selection and freshness. The Dry Martini Bar is an great place to unwind after a day of sightseeing and in our case the hottest spell London has seen in many years. This hotel is great value for the cost we moved from a central London hotel costing twice as much and enjoyed the Melia a lot more

title: Four day vacation to London
text: The location of this hotel is excellent as it is close to Regent Park and three underground railway stations. My wife and I upgraded to a junior suite which gave access to the Level lounge. This provided us with a superb breakfast and availability of both hot and cold drinks for most of the day. From 6.00pm until approx 9.00pm a Tapis type buffet was available along with whatever drinks you desired. The welcome at the reception for the Level lounge was 1st class and the room excellent. The additional cost to upgrade was worth every penny and you were made to feel special.

title: Very good in parts, less so in others
text: The hotel is in a good location. Five minutes walk from Warren Street underground, which is 5 minutes from Oxford Circus. There is a big reception as you walk I the door, but this is where one of the poorer parts occurs. We were booked into a room in the Level, a better standard of room on a higher floor. However, this meant that we could not check in at the front desk, we HAD to walk to the back of the hotel where there was a separate check in for the level. I had previously checked in on-line (a waste of time, very long and tricky to use, don't bother is my opinion). When I got to the level reception I had to repeat all the information I had already entered in the online check-in. What was the point??? Check in was also slow - we just wanted to get to our room and unpack, but we were at the reception area for 15 minutes (and there was no-one queuing in front of us. Once that was finished we had to walk halfway back to the main reception to get the lift. In my opinion, scrap the separate check-in, do it at the front desk, and speed it up. My wife and I both walked away from the check-in saying "that was painful". The room was great, big bed, very comfortable. The bath/shower was small and a bit awkward to get into, but other than that, the room was really good. Breakfast in the Level lounge was excellent - really worth it, included in the price of the Level room. The bar was OK - a little bit disappointing in a hotel of this standard to be showing football on a big screen on a Saturday afternoon, but if the customers want it, then I guess its OK. The biggest problem was the fire alarm at 0510 on a sunday morning, caused by someone in one of the hotels apartments getting the room steamed up! Incidents happen, but I think the hotels response was poor - no sign of a fire marshall outside the front of the hotel, guests were just left to wander back in when they felt like it. Some guests even returned to the building even though the fire alarm started ringing again. I have written to the GM, and hopefully they will rectify it, but I was one of a number of guests complaining at check-out. Sadly, no-one at the hotel had the foresight to print off a letter of apology to give to guests checking out. It was badly handled, but hopefully they will learn from it. Sadly, nothing like the Premier Inn policy of issuing a refund if you suffer a fire alarm during your stay - not even an apology on the day. Overall, good but could be a lot better.

title: The level is the way to London
text: I stayed at white house for 4 nights after changing hotels looking for a nicer place with better sleep quality and that was a great choice we stayed at the level with access to the lounge where we enjoyed breakfast drinks and daily happy hour along the world cup games. the hotel is close to park and public transportation, the staff is very friendly and professional and the room are very clean and quiet.

title: London Weekend
text: This hotel is perfectly situated for a great London break, positioned on the edge of Regents Park with Main line stations and the Underground within easy walking distance. The rooms are very comfortable, spotlessly clean and well equipped. The LEVEL makes it very special offering a retreat at any time of the day, coffee and cakes during the day and Tapas with a few glasses of Cava before hitting the West End in the evening. What makes it extra special is the staff. We are regular visitors and have always received a warm welcome back and a fond farewell from the Guest Relations team.(Thank you Martina and Roberto for making our stay so good).

title: Excellent Hotel, Will Definitely Return!
text: After arriving at Euston, walked to the hotel along Euston Road (only a 15 mins walk). Location is very good with Gt Portland St tube across the road for circle line and Warren St around the corner for Northern and Victoria Lines. The welcome was very warm and the hotel lobby itself is very upmarket, lined in marble throughout. We had an executive room, which was well laid out and clean. On the 1st night we didn't try the tapas in the Level Lounge as we had a dinner appointment in Chelsea. On returning, we tried the Level Lounge for a drink and the wines offered were of excellent quality. The booking was for my wife's 50th Birthday and I had asked for a bottle of bubbly to be put in the room. When we returned to the room after visiting the lounge, there was the bottle of bubbly and a delicious birthday cake. They had also turned down the bed and switched all the lights for late evening. We had breakfast in the Level Lounge in the morning and it was an excellent selection of cold continental cuts, cereals, fruit and hot English breakfast items. After a busy sightseeing day we tried the Level Lounge in the evening for tapas and drinks. The selection was really good and we were disappointed we hadn't tried them the night before! After going out to dinner, we tried the lounge but they had stopped serving alcohol at 10pm and fancying a glass of wine, we looked in on the Dry Martini Bar. The prices were very high (£9 for a 175ml glass of red), so we decided against it. Overall a fantastic hotel in a good location. We will definitely return when we can.

title: Not the same...
text: Been a loyal customer of Melia White House (the Level) for many years.....but somewhat disappointed on this visit. Though some of the infrastructure has been upgraded over the years, the airconditioning is a persisting issue. We had excessive noise and erratic cooling (and in July this REALLY matters in London !) on all the three days we were there. The hotel was too crowded and all common areas are always teeming with people, which is a bit annoying. The concierge service is practically non existent and there is no porter or baggage assistance to speak of - watch out if you have big or heavy bags ! On the positive, the bar continues to be a good place. Overall, this is an expensive place and value for money is clearly questionable.

title: short stay
text: The hotelroom was small but had all the amenities expected. Location is great: though very central, reasonably quiet and subway nearby. The level service was ok, but we have seen better as far as food and beverage was considered. We would go here again for our next visit to London.

title: City break
text: I wanted a hotel not too far from Euston and close to Regent’s Park so I gave this place a try and I am glad I did. We booked a Level Jnr Suite which I recommend the hotel is lovely throughout , the staff are very helpful and pleasant. The option of the level was great to chill out and have some refreshments through the day and a glass of beer or wine later on with some nibbles after a bit of site seeing or shopping. It’s not as busy to other parts of London I’ve been to which was really nice also and the whole hotel has a Mediterranean feel which works well and is very nice. The breakfast at the level was great with lots of options ( except normal English bread for toast) 😂 but I won’t hold that against them. We also ate at the main restaurant in the evening which was a Mediterranean buffet style with quite a few options which was nice but not recommended if your looking for a intimate romantic high end meal , more of a group or family type of meal but it was still relaxed and nice. It was great location for sites like the park or zoo and there is always more bars and restaurants around the area and close to many train stations. I think this will now become my go to place when in London.

title: Perfect location and delicious food
text: I had a business lunch at The Level and I would definitely recommend it. Service was perfect, food really tasty, very quiet area, ideal for a business lunch or having a relaxing break and all in the middle of London!

title: Beautiful food and excellent service at The Level
text: Went there last Friday and I can't recommend it enough. Very quiet, great food and wonderful service. Had some starters to share and then a lobster burger and it was excellent. Had Spanish Rioja white wine and a selection of cakes for dessert and I just want to go back!

title: Excellent hotel on a central location
text: We experienced a wonderful time at the Meliá White House The Level. Perfect service, excellent breakfast, nice executive lounge with drinks and bites. The dinner included in half board could have some more variety (we got twice Leek-Potato soup in three days), but the quality and service was OK. The hotel bar (Dry Martini) was convinient, but because our daughter was under 18, we couldn't stay after 8PM. The hotel is located in a nice neighbourhood, near Regent's Park, right outside the London Congestion Zone. There are 3 underground stations near the hotel. Two stops from St Pancras international Railway station (Eurostar connection to Paris, Brussels and Amsterdam) and a good connection (one change) with London Heathrow. I would surely recommend this hotel for a stay in London.

title: Not so great
text: Normally myself and my family love this hotel and have come here for many years, yes it's extremely expensive for our pockets but after working hard all year it's a great but expensive treat to visit London. For the price though the level lounge experience is not how it used to be rude staff, the complimentary snacks fur example the cookies are burnt. And we get the feeling that just because we have children we are constantly being watched by the staff at the level lounge area. My children are well behaved and I find this quite upsetting. One member of staff was particularly rude to us and I feel he shouldn't be doing the job if he can't be polite. I've spend £1,350 for for this stay and feel maybe I should have home elsewhere As its true what they say on other reviews have said for the price paid for the room the bathroom us extremely small with no separate shower at all. I think maybe next time we may look for other options. Sorry

title: Wonderful stay
text: My family and I stayed in the grand suite for one night and our stay surpassed our expectations. We arrived early due to our train but were able to be checked in and phoned as soon as our room was ready. The new Level check in area was a lovely place to wait. The staff were all amazing. I sometimes worry about taking 2 young children to "nice" places, but everyone there was so great with them! Having the lounge for space and drinks/snacks was ideal. The room was spacious, a large bed and en suite in one half, then the lounge/diner with small toilet in the other where the children could sleep. TV in both areas. We did have to move the glass chess board and other lovely but breakable items out of reach of small hands though!! Then to add even more, we had a knock at the door and a lovely lady arrived with colouring sets for both children and afternoon tea plus champagne! Sandwiches, cakes and scones were lovely. Breakfast in the lounge was varied and fresh. Everything from cereals, pastries, pancakes, fresh fruit and yoghurt to a full english. Delicious! It was great that it wasn't crowded around there too. Overall one of the best hotels we've stayed in in the UK. Being a Spanish hotel most (if not all) the staff were Spanish but spoke perfect English. If it wasn't for the weather we could have pretended we were on holiday again!

title: Excellent Hotel in London!
text: Throughout the years I have stayed in many hotels in London and I have to say that this one has become one of my favourites. The level at Melia is never ever disappointing and their service in this branch in London was up to their usual standard! The location is perfect, with a choice of all transport or lovely walks nearby if you so desire. The staff are friendly and very efficient. We stayed in the junior suite which was very spacious and comfortable with all the pampering amenities. I have to say that the level lounge was excellent and after a long day on our feet we welcomed sitting around on the comfortable sofas sipping at the coctail of the day or their varied range of drinks and tapas. I really enjoyed this hotel and will definitely be staying here again when I next visit London!

title: The White House Wins
text: Arrived on 5th May as having a mini break with my family in London. we decided to leave our luggage with the reception until our room was ready later. We booked a room on the Level, the lovely reception team booked us in immediately in order to save time later in the day and escorted us to the Level area. This was very nice and we had some refreshments. Recently refurbished obvious much thought had gone into the guest experience, the team were excellent. Had our trip around London and headed back to the hotel at 15:00, went to the level guest check in area, totally different experience than we encountered in the morning, receptionist not very welcoming, my wife even commented. This though was the only negative aspect, apart from this blip it was very obvious the White House staff are working very hard. Room OK and comfortable, nice bath amenities available. Kids given complementary fruit bag and kids kit. Very quiet and comfortable nights sleep, very large beds. Breakfast in the Level was fantastic with professional staff, nothing too much trouble, nice concierge man entrance to Level. Would definitely stay again here

title: A wonderful experience
text: Stayed at the Level MELIA for 3 nights and was pleasantly surprised by the professionalism and attitude of the staff. Ive stayed in a lot of hotels worldwide and I rate the MELIA as one of the best for customer service. If there was any query, it was dealt with immediately. I mentioned that the mattress was a bit hard and queried whether a topper was available. One was provided as soon as possible. The room was very clean and spacious. Keep up the good work.

title: Amazing Stay in London
text: The Level at Melia White was a revelation to us as we had not stayed at a Melia group hotel before. The level is just what it says it takes service to another level! It is just so personal and so relaxed even though we had a hectic time in and around the sights. The level under the management of Fabian Ruiz ran like clockwork! He and all his staff, even the "trainees" at breakfast were all so service orientated that you could not but feel special. The food and drink were all of very high quality and the staff wherever you met them in the hotel could not do enough for you. Our stay of four days was too short! We met people who had been going there for 10 years and we can see why. We fully intend to return! Thank you Melia White and thank you The Level and specially Fabian.

title: Great Stay
text: The Level new area is nice and modern, very spacious. The new private Level lounge and breakfast area is really nice. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again. Located a short taxi ride from Paddington station(Heathrow express) and very close to subway system.

title: First class service at a whole new 'Level' fo me!
text: I have stayed at this hotel before but never at 'The Level'. the website will explain the difference to staying as a standard guest but suffice to say The Level, is a level above. from check in when we were met by a member of Hotel Relations, and shown round the Level dining and drinks area, to check out two nights later, the whole experience was superb, a larger bedroom, superbly finished came with the 'Level' package, and although the bathroom is still a tight fit to use the shower, the overall clean and fresh feel to the bedroom is something to enjoy. The Melia can be overwarm, but the air conditioning in the room worked a treat. Bed was comfortable too with inviting pillows and we were not disturbed by traffic noise.. But to the Level! Free drinks from 6.30 to 10.00 (I could be corrected on this, but the G&Ts were certainly free when we were in from 7.00-8.00pm, canapés too! Comfortable with very attentive staff, it was extremely relaxing. Breakfast was also served in this area and was plentiful, with great choice and again great service. Martin Bar is opulent in tits feel, but I would say pricey for its martinis - but its not my drink so what do I know! Overall, an experience that I will wish to savour again and again when I head to London.

title: The New ‘Level’ Lounge at The Melia Whitehouse
text: My wife and I have been visiting the Melia Whitehouse regularly for several years and have been happy to pay the extra cost to use ‘The Level’ facilities. The original ‘Level’ lounge was a place where you could have a quiet breakfast or drink, away from the usual hustle and bustle of hotel life. It had comfortable chairs, plush fittings and was carpeted, all of which gave the area a feeling of opulence, quality and charm. A place to relax. The refurbished ‘private’ ‘Level’ lounge has just re-opened. The new facilities are a cross between a kindergarten and an airport departure lounge. No longer private, it’s noisy, stark in decor with nothing but hard surfaces and uncomfortable chairs

title: Nice hotel with great staff!
text: We have stayed at the Melia Whitehouse several times now but decided to go for a room on the Level this time. On arrival we were upgraded to a junior suite. It was really nice with a huge bed. The Level gives you access to the club lounge. Breakfast offered everything you would want but unfortunately the hot part of the breakfast was just luke warm. Drinks and tapas are served from 6pm till 10pm each evening. Very good but more variety for the tapas is needed. The staff were excellent and were keen to meet your expectations. We have already booked to return to the Melia Whitehouse in 2017 and are looking forward to soaking up the whole ambience of the hotel. The real point that let the hotel down was the fact that there was no complimentary water in the rooms. For us this should be a given when you stay in a 4 or 5 star hotel now.

title: The wonderful staff make the Level at Melia White House my one and only hotel in London
text: Great service, pleasant and welcoming staff, very professional. A pleasure. Great dry martinis are served at the refurbished bar. And the level lounge is great for a tea of coffee at any time and drinks from 6pm.

title: A very nice hotel with an excellent location.
text: It was the second time at MWH for my mother's birthday. We had a beautiful surprise from the hotel. My mother received a cake inscribed with her name in the camera as a gift. We had a great family room at the 8th floor with a nice view. The lounge is absolutely great with snacks all day, juices and fruits. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Few steps to Regent's Park and only 15 min walk to Oxford street. Two tube stations nearby. We will definitely stay here.

title: Second visit, still good
text: This Hotel is in an amazing location, it so close to everything and very easy to get to. The Hotel is beautifully decorated and immaculate. We booked with our reward points from being members of Club Melia which meant we were given a room on the Level. There was some confusion on check in as to whether we had use of the Level lounge, my husband was led to believe we had to pay extra for this. As a result we did not spend any time in the hotel after dinner as the main bar is now a Martini bar and a little out of our price range. It was also packed and we struggled to find anywhere to sit. There are, however, some bars/pubs near by. The main hotel restaurant "The Place" is brilliant we used it for breakfast and dinner and the food was amazing. We were out all day so did not use it for lunch. On the whole this is a brilliant Hotel with excellent staff. The room was large and clean and well equipped. We will definitely be back.

title: Another up grade and the wife's not with me!
text: Great location for conference this morning. Got there early afternoon an was given an up grade!! Excellent room, just a shame I didn't get back till 8 in the evening to spend more time in it Also missed early evening canapes. Room service was effiecient and bed really comfortable Break was included, but was a bit of a with down as hot food a little tepid However not put off, will try and book the hotel next time the wife and I come for a weekend in London- hopefully will get another upgrade?

title: Beautiful hotel in a great locations
text: Vast hotel with beautiful decor and incredibly polite and helpful staff. Made our stay very pleasant and I would definitely be keen to return to this hotel. Didn’t get w chance to try the food or sample the bar but will make sure of Ito next time !

title: Reliable
text: We came here just before Christmas - which is a busy time in this hotel. We had a suite which was fine but smaller than usual - apparently the weekend we went coincides with a Spanish bank holiday & the bigger suites were used for families which was fair enough as we were only 2 people. Check in was smooth with a very nice & helpful girl - we were early so left our bags & went off to a family party & on our return she enquired about our day out in a genuine & lovely way. We did not use the Level lounge as we were pressed for time but we usually do & think it a real plus point for the hotel. Breakfast was super busy in The Level on the Sunday - but the man in charge was very efficient under pressure - ok it was not the normal relaxing ambiance but they were very busy & still very nice - we will be back!

title: Lovely hotel and friendly staff
text: Stayed here for a night out in the west end. As we checked in, the man behind the desk was very friendly. The room was nice and clean. Breakfast was nice and relaxed, not too crowded. And the staff couldn’t do enough for you. Only thing was the coffee machine only came with decaffeinated coffee. Apart from that, I can’t say a bad word. Would stay again.

title: Excellent!
text: It's a great option to stay in London, nice area near Regent's Park, Camden Town and a nice walk to Regent's St. You can visit many places of the city from here and still have a nice and quiet sleep in comfortable beds and clean rooms. Enjoy the lounge with drinks and snacks included.

title: comfortable, classy and plush!
text: I had a one night stay here on Saturday in a twin The Level room on the 8th floor with my daughter. We loved the Lounge, coffee on arrival, tea after shopping and then Happy Hour with cava and tapas! Service was excellent, staff were all very polite and charming. We had a late night cocktail also in the Martini Bar. Breakfast in the Lounge was high quality and plentiful. Our room was quiet, mostly very clean (just some crumbs on the desk on arrival), and we had a spacious bathroom. I would most definitely return to this hotel for The Level rooms. I hear the Level Lounge and Reception is about to be moved and renovated soon. We actually thought it was fine as it was!

title: Frequent guest
text: Always a very good choice! I've experienced over 60 nights in the Meliá White House in London and can recommend it completely. Especially the staff has always been very engaged and helpful. The next stay is already booked!

title: Very Relaxed Stay
text: We love Melia hotels in Spain and decided to spend a night at Melia White house after a recent theatre trip. Although not quite up to the very luxurious standard of the Tenerife hotel we had a great overall experience. The exclusively Spanish staff are pleasant and helpful. Our upgraded junior suite room was spacious although the shower in the bathroom was disappointingly small with a horrible shower curtain, the complimentary Tapas in the evening were not very appetising and my husband was disappointed that no real ale was available in the Level nor in the Dry Martini bar. The breakfast in the Level was very nice and at all times staff were very attentive.

title: A perfect hotel
text: Having stayed several times before, I decided to stay again for a short visit and as before stayed in a level room. As ever I was not disappointed, the hole stay was perfect, the room, the level lounge and all the staff were helpful and friendly. I will be back, thank you!

title: Christmas stay
text: We stayed in the Level. junior suite for three nights leaving on boxing day. Having stayed previously and really liked it we booked to go back for Xmas. It was however a very different experience this time. I appreciate they are extra busy at Xmas, and it was certainly not a terrible experience, but could have been much better with a tiny bit more attention. The room was ok, a bit shabby here and there and not as nice as the one we had previously. We had lots if issues trying to get the room keys to work, which were still not great after they had been changed. The room keys also tripped the heating apparently and we spent the first night quite cold, this happened again on the last night,(Xmas day evening) luckily we managed to catch the heating man before he went off duty, who fixed the fuse, but all that housekeeping could tell us while we were waiting, was that they had passed the message on with no idea if they could send someone. that's all they could do and no offer of a heater ( 11pm on a cold night) We had informed the hotel in advance that I was vegan and what this meant - no dairy, fish, meat, or animal products, we were told all staff were aware of this and they would make special arrangements. No special arrangements were made, no one knew about me or seemed to understand what vegan meant and kept suggesting I have cheese or fish instead . This made for an extremely limited amount of food, while I stayed, including a Xmas day meal that consisted of a few vegetables - no sauce, gravy veggie stuffing etc and no pudding of any sort. drinks were paid for extra so that made for a very expensive two parsnips some greens and carrots. I am not expecting individual special treatment, but buying a 1.99 tub of veg gravy or making some for a Xmas meal does not sound too much, especially considering the expensive service charges. Lots of people are choosing not to eat animal products or maybe they have health or religious dietary needs, so this is an area that really needs to be addressed My husband is not vegan but found breakfast to be really dry and not so fresh as when we came before there was heaps of it which was too much too eat and we would rather it were less but good quality. I must say the fruit was good and one breakfast waiter did try hard and made soya milk porridge for me We entertained guests in the bar a number of times and while the staff had our room number for the drinks to be put on the bill they still chased after us for signatures even though we were just walking a guest out to the taxi and coming back. Not a great move in front of our guests and other hotel guests in the bar. Its such a shame, as we were so impressed the first time.

title: At first it was like Fawlty Towers but it happened to be good at the end
text: I have been staying at the White House many times and always liked it. It is like home away from home. But this time there were some hiccups to begin with. We had booked a twin room at The Level and was appointed a room on the first floor. We were told that it was a very nice and quiet room. Room 190 was an ordinary twin room but as we were told all twin room at the 8th floor were fully booked. We started unpacking and all of a sudden staff were running in and out of our room trying to turn it into a The Level room. Bringing coffee maker, bath ropes etc. etc. Returning to the reception we had to make a "complaint" as this was not what we had paid for. The kind lady excused and said that she would do everything possible to change our room the day after. We accepted this. And thank God that we did.... Quiet room as we were inform. NOT at all... From very early in the morning we could hear chairs being moved around somewhere. The day after we were moved to room 806 and despite it not being a twin room it was exact as a The Level room should be. Thank you to the kind and efficient lady at the reception who made her utmost to make us enjoy the stay at the White House. Appart from the above I must say that all staff we met were doing their absolute best to make all the guests welcome. In the Level Lounge the staff were so kind and attentive all the time. Thank you all.

title: Another great Level stay
text: 8th floor Level executive room this time as we were only there for one night. Nice big bed and good coffee machine. Bathroom small Check-in was very good. Greeted by Customer Services who took care of our luggage on arrival as we were early and the room wasn't ready. Nice cup of tea and cake in The Level Lounge before heading up into town. By the time we got back, the room was ready and luggage in the room. A nice glass of complimentary Cava and tapas in The Level Lounge early evening. Breakfast was good quality and relaxing in The Lounge. Hotel location is very convenient. Service is very good.

title: Great location for London visit
text: Visited the hotel as a family of 4 and found the hotel location was excellent within walking distance to some of the attractions that we wanted to visit and short walk from underground when we wanted to go further. Even surprised that we could park our car on the street over the weekend at no extra charge. We were upgraded to a level room because of our Melia Reward membership and the level lounge was excellent place to relax after a long day out sightseeing or shopping. Good snacks for the kids and nice to get a drink in the evening too. Will definitely try to book here again next time we visit London.

title: Perfect stay !
text: I spend there 3 nights in End of September. Thanks to the Melia Reward Platinum Status, I did get upgrade to Level Room, and access to the Level Lounge. It was very nice, and very quiet. I did highly appreciate the Lounge with nice food and drinks, and excellent Breakfast. Only issue was to find a parking nearby...

title: Great facilities and Service!
text: I've know the hotel for many years, as it was across the Euston rd from my office for 20 years, and I can honestly say it's providing better service and facilities now at the LEVEL than at any other time...It' Level Lounge is really top-notch, service excellent and food and Drink first class. It has a mixture of business and family clients with many Spanish families which adds a lovely atmosphere to the hotel. I travel for home (USA) to London regularly and will only use this hotel. OH yes! Its literally a stones throw form one of the best parks in London - Regents Park!

title: Problems with Check In
text: Having stayed with The Melia group previously I was happy to book this Hotel. My Mum is disabled and whilst we arrived early at The Hotel her accessible Room wasn't ready until 15:50, this made it impossible to get ready ( as we'd have liked to have done) prior to our 17:30 dining reservation. After a difficult discussion the manager did agree to pay for a taxi to enable us to leave slightly later. On a positive note 'The Level' facilities were good and the breakfast was exceptional. Staff were very curtious and helpful. We both stayed in a Junior Suite the bed wasn't the most comfortable I've stayed in and the bathroom was exceptionally small. The bedroom area was large and the soft furnishings were of a good standard.

title: Start to visit London from a place close to everything
text: From the very start you arrive Heathrow and try to find your way to the hotel you feel that is very easy to get to this hotel. That is a good point specially if it's your first time. Afterwards during your stay you will realize that you are close to everything and an oasis after walking and walking. (Because is the way to know England). You have 1 underground station across the street, another 2 blocks to the left. With this you cover all London must see places. Also you have 3 more within 600 meters. All this connect with everyhing and Maine railway stations. I went with my two kids (14 & 6 years old) and was great to move. The area is beside the regent's park so is a very safe area. 600 meters to madame toussaud, Sherlock Holmes museum, Baker Street and regents street in order to walk to oxford st. For shopping. Now let's go inside the hotel. Very friendly people that you feel that they are trying to make your stay special. Most of them foreign so you find within the staff people from Spain, Italy, Macedonia, República Dominicana,France,so somebody will help you if your English is a problem. The hotel has restaurant, restaurant buffet, a bar with fast food, and an exterior bar with food and shishas to smoke just for adults. The rooms are excellent and full of amenities. The level service has a lounge were the oasis I said comes more real. Full of drinks and pastry,sandwiches, tea, coffee and after 1830 alcoholic drinks and tapas. All free, but most important with an excellent staff that makes the experience even better. Marie will receive you with a smile, Garcia, Raul,the girl from Macedonia, the girl from República Dominicana and the woman from Spain are all the time walking around to feel you are really at THE LEVEL SERVICE. the level check in has Lola Holgado and Penny that are always with a smile even when they have those travelers that seems they want to find problems. If you have a problem they will solve it with a smile and excellent manners. In the restaurant Albufera you will see the great Valerio Marchesi. He receives you and makes you feel comfortable from the very moment he shows you your table. Always trying to help you and make your dinner special. My kids felt at home every night we eat there all thanks to Valerio. Housekeeping there they have a little gap, but if you point out they quickly solve the problem and with good manners. Here we have a special thank to one of the best persons of this staff is Antonieta. She works a lot, with respect,friendly,in a certain way I think she put that little part of love for his work. Overview. Excellent hotel, excellent service, excellent Location.

title: The Level
text: This was the first time that I had stayed at the Melia White House, I had booked two Premium Rooms, one twin and one king bed. Being a Melia Platinum Rewards cardholder my family and I were given access to the Level and my wife and I were upgraded to a Level room. The hotel Staff could not have been more helpful and the Staff in the Level were excellent. the hotel is well placed with underground connections at Portland Street a very short walk away,10minutes walk to Regents Park a Haven of peace and beauty. Our stay was very pleasant and relaxing and I would use the hotel again. Thank you.

title: Melia White House - Hits n Misses - Part I
text: Smashing location next to Regents Park and within walking distance of Euston Station and other landmarks of London. Comfortable rooms with sad views, average service and average breakfasts leave you lacking. The service at the Lounge was pathetic. When it was pointed out, the management did take a serious view to get the damage rectified, but the episode left a bad taste. Maybe the whole staff needs to go to Dubai for some training where they have opened a fantastic hotel with superb service and an excellent Lounge which may well be perhaps one of the worlds best! For the price they charge, London offers better choices, and that's why this was a hit and miss - part I on a three Melia journey in a matter of 8 days. Wake up guys, Hilton, IHG and Marriott provide better service, so you people need to shape up or loose business. I am sure a worldwide chain of hotels cannot be run by loyalty of just Spanish people ?

title: A hidden gem
text: I love this place to pieces. It makes you feel comfortable like home. I use the lounge very often and I will for a long long time. Staff is very attentive to the details and this make a huge difference.. thank you!

title: Excellent location and good staff
text: Spent four nights using my hard earned bonus points. Had some issues booking using my points at Melia's website so I ended up calling. This was a great idea as I was whisked through the reservation and got everything I wanted and more. I was severely delayed (BA Brussels flight turned out nightmareish) on arrival and my only complain with the whole stay was front desk. As I arrived the floor was polished at a deafening level which turned the conversation with the front desk man into something of a guessing game. And I had booked a twin bed room but was provided with a double bed. It is of course annoying after a five hour delay (and 0110 pm arrival) having to go down to the lobby again after arriving at your room only to find it did not meet expectations. However, the front desk man sorted this out (after having found and consulted with his manager ) and I eventually boarded the lift with a new key to the 8th floor. Room clean, well sized and full of towels and toilet amenities (LOEWE) Hard beds but an excellent A/C that came in handy as the temperature soared to 30 C. Since we stayed at the Level breakfast was enjoyed in the designated ground floor area for Level guests. Breakfast was excellent and breakfast staff very friendly and accommodating. (Kudos to whoever made poached eggs the second day Saturday 17th). We also did some snacks before heading out Saturday night enjoying the services of an attentive member of staff. Depending on floor number and how the room is facing the street traffic noise can be heard. Initially I intended to swap room for a more quiet facing location but as my friend's snoring drowned out the traffic noise and I had to wear ear plugs, this did never happen. Checkout and bag storage was managed smoothly. Location is within 4-7 minutes walking distance to Regent's Park, Baker Street and Great Portland Street and there are plenty of buses that could take you to wherever you want to travel (C2 to Victoria) Will stay again!

title: A Good Hotel in a great Location
text: We have stayed here in the Level for 4 nights, Jnr Suite 499 which overlooks the main entrance and out to Great Portland st Station. The suite was nicely decorated & furnished. The bed, as with all Melia hotels we have used, was huge and very comfortable. Ensuite with a bath & walk-in Shower together with a dressing room. Breakfast in the Level Lounge was excellent. Staff are very pleasant and helpful.

title: Excellent room and staff
text: Had a great stay because of the clean & spacious room, excellent breakfast & exceptional staff Fabian, Marine, Rocio & Raul. Easy walk to all the sites in London. Second time there & would stay again.

title: Peaceful classy hotel, sooo relaxing
text: This was the hotel for a quick two night stay in London in transit to another location. I usually do not rest in London... apart from everything else going on the hotels can be impersonal, noisy, complicated... Not here. A very efficient check in. Room was immaculate. The lounge accessible if you stay at the Level was comfortable, friendly and generous. Breakfast... perfect. I'd stayed at the Meliá in Granada recently and tried the London hotel following a good stay there... This hotel group is grabbing my attention. Many many thanks.

title: Foodie Weekend
text: Back to the White House again, as a base for our weekend. stayed in the Level junior suite, excellent. On arrival had a Lovely Vermouth & nibbles as we waited for our room, as we arrived earlier than expected , but we were well looked after. In the evening Tapas and wine in the the lounge before going out for dinner, On our return The Dry Martini bar was closed for a Private Function, so had a glass of wine in the Albufera restaurant. As always fantastic fresh cooked breakfast in the lounge.In the morning. In the evening Dry Martin Bar open. Great cocktails. . If you book directly they give a daily room credit, (that helps.) In the morning a lovely walk thru Regents park. This is a great place to stay, it may look a long way from the centre of London, but everything is easily accessible by public transport & walking. The staff are fantastic Thank you for a great stay. Am back again in 4 weeks to see Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers in Hyde Park.

title: Great Hotel, Great People
text: The hotel has many elements that make it a solid 4 star hotel plus a good location (Subway stations, bus stops, restaurants, …etc). But the hotel has the best ingredient for a successful business… people that is. My wife & I have to give credit when credit is due…. The level desk receptionist Saray Diez was a real professional in addressing our complaints of the first room 377 we were assigned and moved us to a far better one 749. We checked out for one night as we had some business in Bicester village and came back. Saray again took us to an even better and bigger one 799. She had a talent communicating with others and defusing problems quickly! Though the breakfast menu did not change over the 12 days we stayed, however, it is fairly big and includes excellent verities. The late afternoon bites need can be improved by adding varieties such as club sandwich, juices, …etc.

title: Was very happy wirh my stay at the level.
text: Everyone was great especially Cynzia who was extremely helpful. She helped us with all of our request s and needs. I will recommend this place to my friends. The only problem we had was that there was misunderstanding regarding our taxi to the airport.

title: Yearly fun weekend
text: Well done again Melia, your hotel and staff made us very welcome, I recommend the level experience to everybody, such value for money, we will definitely come again, the level bar after 6pm is great, the food was excellent. Will be back next year .

title: Great experience
text: We stayed in a Junior Levels Suite for my husband's birthday for 4 nights on B&B basis. Only a short journey from Euston station (walkable 20 mins or a short taxi trip), and very near to Great Portland or Warren St tube stations, the hotel location is ideal for making the most of a trip to London. Breakfast is very good and served in the Levels lounge. We also used the lounge for a glass of Cava and canapés before going out in the evenings. Our room was spacious with a good sized bathroom, very clean and quiet for a city hotel. We used Dry Martini for a G&T which was nice. We missed the live jazz on both nights as we'd made other arrangements but I'm sure it would have been a nice atmosphere. The dinner menu at the restaurant looked good.
