The hotel is only two stops from kings cross which is good, and it was clean but out room was lacking little details which would of made it nicer, a few of the ceiling tiles needed putting back properly and the spotlight had fallen out and was hanging down, we weren't sure why the soaps and shampoos were in the wardrobe as there was plenty of room in the bathroom itself. We also were a bit shocked to find no window In the room as this wasn't very well advertised when we booked. Overall this hotel was okay and clean.

title: Not ready yet but they are open and charging full price
text: Fortunately I only booked for one night. They put me on the 3rd floor. The lift didn't work, so I had to struggle up 3 flights of stairs with my case. No hot water in the morning. Telephone in the room doesn't work. When I called the hotel on my mobile, they still never answered, so I had a cold wash and a cold shave. Builders all over the place. Don't pay any extra for the continental breakfast it's very poor. I ended up in Sainsburys a few doors down. Room was tiny. I had to step out of the bathroom and close the door so I could move in to the room. You can't open the dressing table drawers as they hit the bed. Sitting at the dresser is claustrophobic as you are right up against the wall on one side and the bed on the other. I would not go back even when it's technically ready to be open.

title: Nice hotel
text: Very good location, near subway station and Paddington station. Hotel was quite hard to find, because it looks like a cafe and there's no Best Western logon on the street. Only continental breakfast available

title: Choose an other hotel if you can!
text: When we arrive to the hotel it seemed to be overbooked since we got two rooms in the basement without windows! Next day we moved up to other rooms that it should be soundproof windows.. The AC didnt work and we couldn't close the door to the bathroom. When we talk to the staff that the AC were broken they suggested that we could have the window open (which we even could open).

title: Great location, basic rooms, friendly staff.
text: We booked through superbreaks so the price was very reasonable with travel included. Located really close to the Edgeware Road tube station in zone 1 (not to be confused with actual Edgeware) The staff on the reception were really friendly and helpful. The rooms were quite small and basic but for our trip that's all we needed really. Provided with shampoo,teabags,coffee, towels,hairdryer. However, in our particular room the toilet door had completely broken off and therefore unable to shut it and there was a big crack in the wallpaper. The rooms were very clean and were cleaned thoroughly each day. Overall it was a good stay in a good location. If you're looking for fancy, I wouldn't bother though.

title: Coffee shop/ hotel
text: When we arrived outside the maitrise we were a little confused as its a coffee shop, when we walked in the lady in the desk reassures us we were in the right place though. The staff were polite and very helpful. When we went into our room it was a good size and even though there were no windows the air con worked well so we never felt hot or too inclosed, the room was clean and comfortable. The upside to being in a coffee shop is getting up and getting a good cuppa at 6am👍 hubby loved this and all the fresh pastries were coming out the oven so he thought he was in heaven. Great hotel would stay again👍

title: Not an HOTEL, this is a CAFE with a few rooms!!!!
text: However this establishment is classed as a hotel is beyond me, the entrance is into a cafe, the reception desk is at the end of the counter were you pay for your coffee & snacks, Our room was 404 on the lower ground, the room was very very small but clean & looked newly refurbished, with no hairdryer, kettle & no window!!!! It was also a disappointment to discover that there was no alcoholic drinks at the CAFE, overall a strange experience one that we will not be experiencing again. The location is a 15 minute walk to Marble Arch/ Hyde Park or a short bus ride, the only plus for the Best Western Cafe.

title: Horrific, dishonest and rude staff....
text: The room was horrific no aircon, no cold water, curtain broken fell on top of my girlfriend fan in bathroom broken... When I reported all these defaults nothing got done when checking out I asked if anything was going to be done to my bill because of all these things wrong with the room I got brushed off by a very rude receptionist and manager never came out to talk to me just told me we not doing anything about it. This message sent to me by this very rude receptionest. Don't trust what you see on line or what the staff tell you both are very dishonest ....... P.S. the food in the cafe is really bad..... Don't bother.....

title: Brilliant
text: We stayed here recently as we came Toronto for my husbands 40th birthday and a theatre visit. Being a wheelchair user I should have really informed them of my needs when we booked but I forgot. I was pleasantly surprised to find this wasn't a problem, although quite full they found us a room big enough to accommodate all of the luggage needed for my care plus my powered wheelchair. The only issue we had was that workmen were working on two other rooms during the day but this couldn't be helped and didn't really disturb us too much. Our room was spotless, the bed was amazingly comfortable and I slept better than I do at home.the bathroom was gorgeous the rainfall shower amazing and the cubicle easily big enough for two 😉 The room was a little warm as being below ground there was no window but the air con soon cooled it down. TV worked fine and the WiFi was great The staff were brilliant, even when I crashed my wheelchair into the buffet breakfast and knocked most of it on the floor, they laughed and just sorted it out! We had a lovely stay and would definitely stay there again Thankyou all

title: Very good hotel!
text: We had a very nice experience of this hotel! Fresh and clean room, nice big beds. Very nice staff in the reception, they helped my boyfriend surprise me with flowers and champagne :) Only remark was the AC that wasn't as good as we wished. Overall very happy with our stay. Thank you for a nice week!

title: Cold room. Dishonesty?
text: After staying 1 night at the Maitrise Edgware Road. I am very disappointed. Room was cold and air con heating did not work. I left in the morning for work and in a hurry. I saw a cleaner as I was calling the lift and told her that I was leaving and it was ok for her to go in and clean the room. My iphone was running out of battery power during the afternoon and when I looked for my charger/dock, i'd remembered that I had definitely left it plugged in at the power point in the hotel room and forgotton to take it with me. My fault of course! However, I returned to the hotel after work that same evening and reported to the receptionist on duty that I had left my phone charger in the room after checkout that morning and that I needed it. She told me that 'she would have to contact the Housekeeper next morning' as she had not been told anything had been left behind in the room. The receptionist asked for my contact number and promised that she would call me the following morning after she had spoken with the Housekeeper about any items being left behind in the room. No one even bothered to call me from the hotel the next day? 2 days later, My Iphone had run out of power and I have recently had to buy a new charger/deck. Thank you Maitrise Edgware Road. I am so glad that I did not leave my passport or credit cards behind in the room. Would I have got those items returned, if left behind after checkout? .

title: Great value hotel with good transport links
text: Our room (standard) was a good size for London with a huge bathroom and set back from the road so very quiet. The only negative was the lack of curtains. The staff at both the hotel and attached coffee shop were very friendly when we checked in. Maitrise Hotel is in a very good location, about a minute from the Bakerloo Line at Edgware Road and two minutes or so from the District and Circle Line. Overall, brilliant value for money.

title: A good find
text: We needed a hotel in this area in order to attend a family event the following morning. Didn't want to pay over the odds for a Central London hotel if we could help it, so chose the Maitrese and we were pleasantly surprised. Room was compact, but everything we needed for a one-night stay. Comfortable and nicely-furnished, plus a decent shower. Didn't have time for breakfast but the options looked good. Would definitely stay here again.

title: Great service, nice room
text: My room its not big, but average, very confy bed and the recepción ladies very friendly. Nice rain shower. Breakfast its not amazing but ok. I do recommend this hotel, good price, close to tube and many buses. You are also at less 15 minutes to Marble Arch, so thats cool. I'm enjoying my stay a lot

title: Frustrating and noisy stay !
text: We stayed for two nights in room 002. It was boiling hot and airless with no window . We had to leave a keycard in the slot 24/7 to keep the aircon working which eventually took the edge off the heat ! Having to take cold showers at 1am to cool down in January is not my idea of relaxing stay ! When I finally did sleep a member of staff came crashing thorough the door at midnight and quickly retreated upon seeing me sprawled upon the bed trying to get some shut eye ! Very bizzare!!! On both the Saturday and Sunday Morning I was woken up at 9am sharp by workmen drilling and banging in the cafe area , the other side of my wall !! I was disgusted that they were so insensitive to us as their paging guests . Upon checkout the receptionist said sorry about the noise before I could even mention it ! It was too late by then for an apology ! The room itself is of good quality furniture and a lovely bathroom , but what's the point if your guests can't sleep ! Don't book people into rooms where there will be work directly affecting them , and please sort out the air conditioning !! And also to quickly mention that there is some weird water Heater type noise that adds to the stress all night whooshing away ! Will never return !!

title: Friendly, welcoming, helpful and comfortable.
text: Very nice hotel and lovely staff. I went with my partner for a romantic break and we arrived at the room to find champagne on the side and rose petals scattered across the bed. Very impressed. Bed was comfortable and everything was clean.

title: Amazing hotel..
text: I just went with my family there for 3 nights and everything was perfect. The hotel is close to the underground and to The famous Oxford street. The rooms are clean and worm, the price is ok and the staff is great..!! Definitely I will come back!!

title: Amazing hotel, amazing staff
text: The customer service is excellent. Also the coffee shop at the ground floor is nice and posh. The rooms are nice and cosy. The prices are really okay. And on top of that it's also really close to the central area. 5 minutes walk from Marble Arch.

title: Great hotel
text: Stayed here 4 nights very good location clean and modern rooms very nice and comfortable bed staff are very welcoming and make every effort to make your stay comfortable Additional benefit of coffee shop in the hotel Had no issues at all and will stay here on every visit to london Great management also very welcoming and ready to please and make your stay enjoyable

title: Itchy bite marks!!
text: I stayed at the hotel for 2 weeks for work. Pros: The location was good for me as is only a 20 minute walk from Oxford Street so would suit you if you're coming for shopping. The staff were friendly and polite and the rooms are modern. Showers are nice, powerful and warm. Cons: WiFi didn't work in the rooms. The first week I stayed on the first floor and it had a lot of street noise, also room 102 needs a blind for the bathroom window as at night everyone can see into the bathroom from the street - the window is frosted but you can still see from outside so I felt I couldn't shower in the evening unless I left the light off. Despite all of this I still would of returned until my second week... I had room 201 or 202 which seemed perfect as was much quieter than the floor below but in the first couple of days of my stay I had small bites appear all over my hands, arms, back and legs which are really itchy. They couldn't of come from anything else other than bed bugs. It's surprising as it seemed clean and new but it couldn't of been the laundry washing powder because I stayed the week before and was fine. It's a shame because I probably would of stayed again but I will ask my work not to book me here again, days after the bites are still itchy and seem to be getting worse :(

title: Clean but ropey WiFi and mobile signal
text: This is a newly developed hotel, the bed was comfortable and everything was clean. The bathroom was modern and pretty spacious for this price point. The downsides are that the WiFi was ropey and mobile signal on ee and Vodafone weren't great. The chair and desk were more decorative than functional as the bed was only 4 inches from the desk. I stood no chance of being able to sit down to work. I probably won't stay here again unless I have to.

title: No communication
text: We booked two rooms and requested "Twin rooms, not "Double rooms". We arrived at the hotel to be told that they don't do twin rooms. They had not emailed us after receiving our request to let us know that. They arranged for us to go to their sister hotel in Kilburn High Road, which they said was 10mins away by taxi, more accurately 20mins. Their reception desk is in a café on Edgeware Road, not a great first impression.

title: Amazing hotel 👌
text: This review is one of the best and it is written with such positive energy and gratefulness towards the staff at the hotel. The staff, all from cleaning to waitors and receptionist get high recommends and are so kind and helpful. Even printed out our vouchers to different booked activities. The rooms are very clean and comfortable while also being very stylish and beatiful decor/colours. The food at the hotels restaurant is very nice and affordable, and you even get a 10% discount if your a guest at the hotel. Its about 45min away from central London (borough market) by bus, but you can also easily access the tube from Leyton st. We will surely recommend it to any traveler to London ❤️ So thank you Lion & Key Hotel for contributing to an amazing vacation in London ❤️

title: Excellent!!
text: Lovely hotel in the heart of Leyton. The hotel is great quality, very clean and the service is excellent, the staff were very accommodating and nothing seemed to be too much trouble for them. All very friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again. The only problem I found was parking as the hotel only has a very small car park so spaces are at a premium. There is quite a lot of on-road parking in the area but watch out for the time restrictions. Overall very enjoyable stay and very friendly and helpful staff.

title: PERFECT. Very pleasantly surprised
text: I don't normally write many reviews. However I felt it would be unjust if I didn't for this hotel. I saw many good reviews on here so booked the hotel. However I didn't have huge expectations as booked it at a great price. Once we got here, I realised why it had so many 5 star reviews. It's perfect. From the fittings and fixtures to the shower and bed. Can't fault this hotel. Pleasant staff too. Would definitely use again. Everything is very modern and upto date. In fact the night before this we had a room at a well known hotel in London, and this is way better. Even though it's less than 1/3 of its price. Thanks to the team for a wonderful stay and look forward to staying with you again.

title: Nice hotel
text: nice hotel in Leyton, price ok for the hotel, breakfast and restaurant very good. friendly staff, clean modern rooms, very good comforable beds. check in and out fast, subway +/- 10 min from hotel,.....

title: Great family run hotel
text: Stayed here for a night whilst watching a football game at the Olympic park, the rooms are great, newly furnished, clean and modern, the hotel staff are so friendly, and the food they serve is fantastic. Would stay here again anytime, tube station a few mins away, and on the Central line direct into town

title: Very clean and new hotel
text: Lion & Key is one of the cleanest hotel I've ever stayed in. The hotel is newly opened but it doesn't smell newly renovated / painted. The carpets are so clean and free of the slightest dirt or stain, the toilet dry and stainless, even the kettle had no water stains inside. Price is great for London, only 4/5 as it is a rather long walk to Leyton station (around 15 mins).

title: really good Hotel to stay, clean and comfortable bed's. Good access for Disable people, lift to upper floors.
text: Excellent food, good choices on all menu's, even order food early or late. Vegetarian food on menu. plenty of room to eat. Rooms have ensuite with walk in shower and toilet area, ladies have air dryer. T.V. to all bedrooms.

title: Warm place in a cold season.
text: I spent 6 nights in Lion & Key hotel during Christmas holidays (28/12-3/01) and it was lovely. First of all, the staff is extremely polite and kind indeed we arrived out of the check-in time and they made it anyway offering us some fruit because we didn't have dinner. The room and bathroom were warm, elegant and big enough for those who stay outside all day long. The room was cleaned and the bed sheets were changed each morning, making the atmosphere comfy and pleasant. The zone is ok, 10 minutes from the metro station on foot. Moreover, it is well served with different supermarkets, fast food etc... In the end, I definitely recommend it.

title: Lovely
text: Stayed here for 2 nights, a beautifully fitted out hotel. Very clean and very comfortable. I've only got 2 problems and 1. Parking was an issue, had to park on the road as car park was shut and 2. No food available, such a shame as we would've liked a breakfast before we left but other than that we were happy X

title: I Love This Hotel
text: This is my second stay at this hotel, the first time was for the London 100 bike ride and they were amazing in accommodating all of the cyclists and their bikes. This time was just a flying visit whilst on business in the area, they were always polite on the phone and whilst at the hotel. The food is fantastic and the rooms are worthy of any five star hotel, the rooms are nothing short of perfect.

title: Lovely hotel in a down-to-earth London neighborhood
text: The hotel is in Leyton, East London, a (I would call it) working-class neighborhood with a lot of small restaurants, some pubs, and two supermarkets (Sainsbury, Tesco) as well as an impressively high number of hairdressers (if you feel like it's time for a new perm, you will find quite a number to choose from...). The next underground station is a ten minutes walk away and there are also some bus stations to choose from (at least two passing the underground station). If you want to do some shopping away from London’s shopping hotspots, there is a TK Maxx just across the street from the tube station. The Central Line (red) will take about 7 stations and 15 minutes to Holborn, which is close to Covent Garden, Leicester Square and some very interesting places (if you like to walk around town for a bit), and along the line there are a lot of opportunities to change lines and reach different destinations all over London. So even though the hotel is not in the center of London, thanks to the London public transportation it is well connected. The hotel opened just recently, so the rooms are in an excellent condition, everything is clean and neat and the maids did a very good job. The staff was always very friendly, welcoming and helpful. So if you don't mind the fact that it might take you some time to reach certain destinations because of the hotel being a bit outside of downtown London, this is defintitely a great place to stay.

title: Waqar Kayani
text: It’s a decent place to stay, carpark is a headache because of it’s size but the staff are helpful in sorting it out the rooms are nice and clean with a good shower facilitie. I wasn’t happy with the heating it was pretty cold in my room even though I had reported this to reception nothing was done to solve it.

title: Sleep like a log in comfort
text: I wish I'd found this hotel the last time I stayed in the area. It is solid, modern, well kept and such a reasonable price. Free wi-fi was good and the interactive TV with You Tube and Spotify on it was a new adventure. Best bit though was being able to have the air conditioning on all night whilst the hottest evening of the year was melting the streets outside. Quiet and smoke free.

title: HIGHLY recommend. Great value !
text: I Booked this hotel for my friend and i to stay at while visiting London for a concert at the O2. We booked in disbelief that it would be as nice as it looked for what it cost. When we arrived we were pleasantly surprised at the luxury we found. £80 for one night in a "small double room" we found two massive Windows, a double bed, a single bed, tv, dresser, plenty floor space, wardrobe, Tea & coffee station, walk in shower with rain fall shower head. The whole place was decorated lovely and modern and everything seemed to be nice and clean. There was no noise on our stay either. The hotel would be a 15 min uber drive to O2 with no traffic and a 12 minute walk to the train station which was easy to find. Downstairs there was a restaurant and bar which had a nice atmosphere, decor in keeping with the hotel and attentive staff. We didn't wait too long for food. When it arrived it was delicious and I would go as far to say the best meal I've had. Great flavours and cooked perfect. All in all I would highly recommend a stay there and was disappointed I wasn't there longer. If you have something to do near by definitely stay at this hotel and treat yourself to some dinner. You won't be disappointed.

title: A clean, modern and good value hotel - just a little out of the way
text: A really nice modern (recently refurbished) hotel. It has been converted from a pub and retains a nice bar/restaurant downstairs. The rooms are very clean, modern and everything works. They are large, by London standards. Bathrooms are equally clean and modern. The restaurant is great as well. Clean and spacious. The food is good, good value and plentiful, you won’t go hungry here. The staff were polite and particularly the restaurant staff were friendly. My only very slight issue is that the reception staff were a little brusque. A more chatty warm welcome would have been nice. The other thing to watch is that they need a form of ID when checking in. Quite why this is needed is not clear to me as no other hotel insists on it. The final drawback is that the hotel is a bit off the beaten track. It’s a good 10-15 min walk from Leyton Tube station. And the area of Leyton itself is a bit rough. But all in all it’s. nice modern good value and clean hotel that I will use again.

title: Meh...
text: The hotels pictures are misleading. The room it a lot smaller than their strategic photography! The TV didn’t work and the curtain was falling down. The one pillow might as well have not even been there and the bed is very small. At breakfast you get a different menu to the public that doesn’t have as much choice. The woman taking our order didn’t speak very good English and I ended up with a weird spinach smoothie when I asked for some apple juice which I was charged extra for!!

title: Easy, nice and cheap
text: We picked this hotel as it was on wowcher and were pleasantly surprised at how nice it was. Staff were all very friendly and welcoming and the rooms were large clean and have everything you need including a small kitchen (which we did not know we were getting). The bar downstairs was good and not bad price for drinks. Didn't have any food but it looked delicious. Not far from the tube station and very close to a tesco and a sainsburys express. Would definitely recommend.

title: Perfect spot for visiting the East End
text: We stayed here for 1 night whilst visiting friends in the Leyton area. The hotel proved to be a perfect spot for the visit, conveniently located for visiting the East of End of London, particularly Leyton, Hackney Wick, Stratford etc. The booking process was straight forward as was the check in when we arrived quite late on Friday evening. The hotel itself was friendly and welcoming. The reception was clean and well presented. The room was modern with a great bathroom and shower, plenty of plug sockets (usually an issue) and the usual faculties in the room. Everything worked perfectly and there were no issues at all. We didn’t opt for breakfast but the ones we saw looked very good. Overall a top spot for us and we’ll be returning when visiting the area again in the near future.

title: Undiscovered Gem - get it while you can
text: Found this via Booking.com and very glad we did. Will be shortly opening their restaurant here and then providing breakfast and prices are then bound to rise - so if you are happy to travel the single tube stop to Westfield to get breakfast (plenty of choice there) this is a great place to stay to visit London - 10 minutes walk to Central Line. Fab hotel also - rooms are simple but stylish and very clean and have everything you could want - our bathroom had a fab shower. Everything is well built too and we heard no other noise from adjoining rooms. All staff very friendly and efficient and the manager took the time to chat with us about the hotel. We would definitely stay here again if we are in the area and can get a good price - but these may well be in short supply when the hotel blossoms - so stay whilst you can get the chance!!

title: very nice clean hotel great surprise!
text: The hotel was very clean nice rooms and bathrooms WiFi works great my room had smart T.V that could connect to my phone. Location is comfortable for public transportation to and from "hot" London areas.

title: Excellent Breakfast !!!
text: We been here for recommended by friends Modern decoration perfect opens buffet nicely presented also hot and cold mezze breakfast and brunch our first time here I will recommend for everyone we definitely come back

title: Amazing stay!
text: Me and my girlfriend stayed here for one night. We really enjoyed this hotel which I can confirm is full refurbished inside out with good standard rooms, which make you feel welcomed and cosy. Great bathroom and shower, amazing interiors light blue tones in the room, and Egyptian cotton linen. Spotless cleaned everywhere. £5 if you want to buy the entire Mini Bar which contains a few soft drinks cans and still water bottles. Great TV with hundreds of TV channels, weather, YouTube etc. Tea and coffee facilities available in the room with small cookies, which we much enjoyed. Fluffy white towels, safe, and good lighting. They now have a small restaurant/bar next to reception which we did not tried but looked good enough. Many eating places around the hotel. I work in Hospitality Industry too, so I have a great attention to details, however this hotel did not disappoint and was great stay and great value for money! Thank you, Daniel

title: Perfect Stay
text: Stayed here a few weeks ago and couldnt fault it. Spotlessly clean rooms and superb shower! Staff were great and couldnt do enough. We ate breakfast at a deli called Deeneys just down the road, also lovely. A good 15 min walk to the tube but it was good just to walk through and see Leyton, walk didnt bother us. Great tube service and you can get on the standstead express to Stratford then leyton is only 1 stop away. We normally stay in centre of London but we wont be again, will definitely return to the Lion and Key

title: Wow
text: we travel from North Yorkshire to watch Leyton Orient fc every home game and usually do the trip in one day,but now we have found this little treasure will be stopping over a lot more now. It is a 5star hotel at 3 star prices, spotlessly clean, modern, well thought out and as for the staff they are in a league of their own. Looking forward to when the bar/restaurant opens then it will have the full package. Looking forward to next stop over

title: Lovely Hotel
text: Travelled down to London for the Hockey Champions Trophy at Olympic Park. So was a good location for us to walk from. Stayed in a 3 bedroom room but only two of us as one friend dropped out. Still was great value for two of us. Very friendly staff, room was lovely, comfortable and clean. The shower was fantastic. It is a very nicely finished hotel, agree with the comments on it being in a down-to-earth area. Highly recommend the Sangria Tapas place for authentic Spanish food nearby!

title: Excellent Hotel!
text: This hotel bills itself as a piece of the west end in the East End and this is very true! The only downside is the lack of parking and the cost of parking if you can get in. We stayed overnight, but could have stayed longer! The rooms are lovely and comfortable, really calm decor and well equipped. The reception, bar and restaurant are bright and modern, the latter has a lovely clean open kitchen. All the staff are very pleasant and helpful, and the food is lovely...prepared and presented well. The waiter was particularly friendly and this really made for a pleasant meal! This hotel has so much potential, it’s nice and close to Stratford and would be a great place for a shopping weekend, or theatre trip, public transport is close by and I am sure reception would order a cab! This is a high end hotel, but is cheap enough for a comfortable stay....excellent!

title: First rate
text: Chose this place due to the reviews and I must say it lived up to expectations. Room was great, the staff too. The restaurant was a revelation. Try the Turk breakfast, very impressive and great value too. Forget the full English, no comparison. Evening menu gives a wide range of options, fit for all tastes. Good location for Leyton and the tube. Parking is limited though and at £15 per night a little on the high side but worth it in my opinion as its secure. You need to book it in advance. Highly recommended.

title: Good
text: Hotel was lovely and modern all mod cons, everything you would expect. Complimentary toiletries in case you forget anything, which can come in handy! Room was on the small side but very comfortable. Will use again if the need arises!

title: Warm welcome from staff
text: Stayed here for one night recently,lovely hotel,everywhere was very clean,staff hardworking and very helpful and friendly,would stay here again if in the area, and would recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: Great hotel
text: I stayed in this hotel for a total of 4 nights and I was amazed. This hotel surpassed my expectations. It new, clean and modern. The staff are very friendly and helpful. I'll definitely be coming back again. The only downfall at the moment is that the bar is still under construction, but It will be completed in a few months. Until then there's a small shop up the road that sells wine and sprits.

title: Tidy, but smelly
text: From the outside the hotel is very modest, but the interior is superb. Everything is new, clean and stylish. Would have awarded 5 stars, if it wasn't for the smell of marijuana that lingered in the first floor room non-stop. It made the stay quite uncomfortable, had to keep the window open all the time, in the middle of the winter.

title: Lovely new and clean hotel
text: Every thing about the room is shiny and new. It is close to Leyton train station so easy to get into tourist areas on the Central Line. We stayed here twice while visiting family in the area. On our second visit we had our room upgraded when they recognised us. That was great service. The room has a bar fridge that you can use after paying £10 for the soft drinks in it.

title: Breakfast visit
text: I have been to the Lion & Key on a few mornings for breakfast and each visit has been excellent. There is a decent choice on the menu ranging from traditional English through to more modern choices. There is also a massive range of teas available. On my last visit I ordered the Turkish and for an excellent price I received enough food to last all day. Three different cheeses, Turkish sausage, cold meats, eggs, bread and preserves. Delicious.

title: Brand New Fabulous Hotel with Amazing Staff
text: Never stayed here, arrived Friday 1st to a brand spanking hotel, greeted with a smile and a warm welcome, even asking how we slept and giving us a quieter room was so nice. Hotel is decorated to an amazing standard, the rooms are brand new, airy, light, air conditioned, bathroom was beautiful, WiFi in the room was easy to set up and the smart TV was a great feature. We even decided to stay an extra night, again no issue, asked for an extra pillow, no issue. This hotel is fantastically decorated but that's the easy bit, this hotel is ran by wonderful people who make your stay enjoyable. The price was again excellent value for money, but its the staff at the Lion and Key who make it a great place to stay.

title: Great find!
text: Lovely little hotel in East London. Modern decor, clean and well presented. First room I was given was cold and uninviting, nothing like the room I’d booked. I spoke to reception who then showed me 3 rooms. Found the one I’d booked, it was lovely, spacious with floor to celing windows. Stylish bathroom. Lots of places to eat as well as at the hotel. We found Five Lads! A chicken and burger place. Food very nice with good service. Great value.

title: Was just 'ok'
text: Prices for rooms were in my opinion very good for London. But weren't all they were cracked up to be. They weren't the cleanest. Found a few stray hairs in bedding, shower etc. The carpet needed a good hover, and rubbish was left beside the bed. Bedding also had some wholes in, and the towel holder was broken hanging off the wall, and for being a relatively new hotel I was rather surprised with the standard. The room was rather dingy, with a small window. The rooms also lacked personality. Staff helpfulness & friendliness was variable and communication wasn't great whether it be face to face or telephone. Was 'OK' but would not choose to go back.

title: Very Impressed!!
text: I stayed at this hotel for 1 night and was blown away by how beautiful it was. My partner and myself had a double room it was clean, modern and way more value than the price we paid. The decor was of a very high standard and the bed was very comfy indeed. The staff were efficient and friendly. I must admit I felt like I was in the middle of west end it was so nicely put together. The standards are high and I will most definitely be staying again. I totally found this hotel by accident but I will not be losing it. I would recommend it to anyone. Thank you.

title: Stayed one night for concert - Lovely Hotel
text: Stayed here early June as we were attending a concert at the London Stadium. Property looks to be a recently converted former pub. It is extremely modern throughout with up to date rooms which have good aircon and USB sockets at each side of the bed. Staff were very helpful and prices of the drinks in the bar were not excessive for London. The locality however, is not as close to the Stadium as stated online. You can either take a bus trip of c30 mins and then there is a walk of c15 mins or you need to go by taxi. In our opinion it is not walkable - especially at night. Overall a lovely hotel.

title: C lewis
text: What a place! Great service, rooms are modern and very clean! food is superb try the homemade spicy chilli sauce 👍 Eddie looked after me and he was brilliant!! Very impressed thx guys top job! By the way I never comment!

title: Friendly Staff and Great Experience
text: Really enjoyed our six nights at The Lion and Key Hotel. Our room was very clean and spacious for sleeping three of us and the food was great. We liked the food so much it was difficult to venture out when such good food was so conveniently located downstairs. We didn't use room service, but the entire menu was available that way too. One note, the shower in the room we were in was small, but everything else was so great that we'll stay here again.

title: Better than expected
text: Room only hotel but with much better decor than we expected

title: Foo Fighters
text: Stayed here last minute after a dreadful room with booking.com So glad . The staff was absolutely great , room was really modern and clean. Food in restaurant. Wow .very very good . Recommend to anyone visiting London

title: Perfect
text: Stayed here for the weekend after having to make a last minute booking following the previous hotel being awful. This place on the other hand was lovely. Very clean, staff were helpful and the rooms were really nice. The shower was amazing! Would definitely stay here again. Can't believe it's so cheap. Easy access to the underground as leyton station is only about a 10 minute walk. Regular night buses also go past the hotel making getting about really easy.

title: Modern, Stylish and Friendly
text: Very nice hotel, well decorated and maintained with spacious rooms. Staff were friendly and helpful

title: Lovely Hotel
text: This hotel was beautiful from the outside and then when we stepped inside it was the same. We stayed in room 203 and it was gorgeous. Very clean and still the new smell to it. Bathroom was stunning also. Very very modern rooms and for what we paid a very high standard. There was only a few things we could fault which was the noise in the room at night. Through no fault of the hotel but with it being on a main road there was sirens going all through the night. I managed fine as I am a deep sleeper but my partner did struggle to get a decent sleep due to this. The shower was very nice but not very big and there was no shelf to put your toiletries on. It was small bars of soap to wash your hands no liquid soap. There is no restaurant or bar in hotel so do have to go out and find places. The parking was fine for us as we phoned the hotel and they reserved a space for us with no issues for an extra charge. There was also good points which was the overground was just a short walk away and was great for getting around. You were provided with slippers. There was a lovely flatscreen TV up on the wall which provided you with free wifi.The room had a fridge for your juice and there was a safe which was free of charge to use. Would recommend highly but if you struggle to sleep would suggest you ask for a back room. Overall great hotel.

title: Really lovely and modern
text: This hotel is great close to wherever u nerd to go in london. Rooms r lovely. Modern clean an surprisingly quiet for london! Staff helpful too! Will def stay again. Litterally a 5 minute walk to nearest station.

title: little gem
text: Hotel is modern and comfortable. Room was spacious and clean, furnished to high standard, towels changed daily, wi-fi access throughout the hotel. Food in the restaurant delicious, plates are full and everything I tried was delicious. Hotel is located close to Leyton Underground, 30 minutes by car from city centre.

title: This Turkish themed gem, Lion and Key hotel
text: I stayed there for 5 nights and it was comfortable clean and food was fantastic. The location is very close to central London (15 mins tube ride), but be prepared to walk for 20 mins to the nearest tube station (Layton Station) or take the 69 bus for a 5 mins ride to the station (or back to the hotel). Staff were very friendly, and offer help all the time. It's a top of the range 3 star hotel, but do not compare to 5 star places, and you won't be disappointed.

title: Girlie Night
text: We arrived at The Lion & Key Hotel on a Saturday about 3pm, check in was so easy and the lady on reception was so nice, happy and cheerful. She advised that if we just paid for 1 hours parking it is then free until 10am on Monday. We were in a triple room, which was really good, clean and plenty of room. We would defiantly stay here again if we needed a room in the area. Considering the hotel is located on the corner on junction of a busy road you might think that the rooms were going to be noisy but far from it, you wouldn't even know you were on a main road. Plus the air con was really good and quite.

title: Brilliant Hotel
text: We stayed here when we went to see the Rolling Stones at the London Stadium. Absolutely faultless, room great, staff great, food excellent. Would definately stay here again. Thanks to all at the Lion and Key .

title: Beautiful recently new Hotel very high standard
text: I'm a wheelchair user and found the disabled first floor room easy to get into, had a disabled friendly bathroom including a wet room shower and low level sink. Room also had a single bed extra bed so great for family use and still room to charge my wheelchair overnight. Room as lots of sockets and charger points Two entrances one from gated small car park 3/4 cars which you pay extra for ( ask about when booking) otherwise parking is in the local streets unless it's a Sunday when you can park on single yellow lines. Restaurant adjoining it is being built, but we found two lovely restaurants within easy walking distance that were lovely (one serving Malaysian food and a grill restaurant) Area very diverse but we always felt safe and everyone was friendly. Staff very very helpful and chatty would highly recommend. Traffic into city very busy at the weekend so allow plenty of time if going to a show for example ...

title: Everything was beautifully clean
text: Stayed here when we visited our daughter and to be honest wasn't expecting much as Leyton is more residential. However, everything was new and sparkling clan with marble floors. Very nice inside. There are no eating facilities as yet but these are being completed at the moment.

title: Gorgeous hotel at an amazing price
text: I stayed at the Lion and Key the night before a job interview in London. I had such a hard time finding a cheaper hotel that didn't look absolutely awful, most of them had shared toilets or the rooms were tiny and looked run down. So I thought there must be a catch when I found this hotel, but there wasn't at all! I was so pleased when I first came into the hotel. It looks so new and is really nicely decorated. I stayed in a double room and the room was such a good size, with a lovely en suite bathroom. I was really impressed with how clean everything was, and I felt so relaxed and at home. There was a flat screen TV in the room that worked well and had apps on it like youtube/itv, and wi-fi as well. The staff were really nice and welcoming. It was easy to get in and out of London, the hotel is a short walk from Leyton station. I also found Leyton quite a nice area and felt safe walking through to the hotel, which was my only concern when booking as a female travelling alone. There are a few shops close by like a Tesco express and a Sainsbury's which came in handy too. After a fabulous nights sleep I felt so relaxed for my job interview the next day and ended up getting the job! I will definitely be recommending this hotel to family/friends who are visiting London.

title: An Oasis in East London
text: This is an Oasis in the middle of East London. superb Hotel and Restaurant with more than helpful staff, rooms above average, good prices superb Turkish and English food and although I doubted the General Manager the Fish and Chips were the largest and best I have had in years.Situated not far from the local Police Station flashing Blue lights and sirens were quite common on Saturday night but the food, room and ambience more than made up for this. When I am next in East London I will visit again. Car Parking is a problem so book early. Give it a try, we loved it. Jennifer and Denis.

title: Amazing Staff - Wonderful hotel
text: Booked this Hotel for my Daughters 21st birthday as a surprise, the staff were simply amazing and very helpful. They decorated my Daughters room with balloons, card, chocolates and towel origami, nothing was too much bother. My Daughter & her friends loved every minute of their stay in London (shopping/Attractions), the staff, the food, the hotel, the whole package...wonderful, cant thank Giorgio and the staff enough for all of their help. Recommended ***** Thank you all so much.

title: Excellent hotel and staff - highly recommended.
text: A most unexpected jewel in Leyton! Attractive, excellently furnished and decorated rooms with all the facilities needed for a short stay. Everything looks brand new and is tastefully done. Free Wi-Fi, air-conditioned rooms, plenty of tea/coffee facilities and very reasonably priced. The staff are very welcoming and friendly.Breakfast in the restaurant was excellent and also very reasonable priced. For anyone travelling to London, especially to the East end/Stratford/Olympic Park, I would highly recommend this hotel.

title: Amazing gem of a hotel.
text: What a fantastic hotel. Booked at the last minute for 3 nights, as a wheelchair user I phoned the hotel directly to make sure a wheelchair accessible room was available and that the hotels access met my personal requirements. The room was excellent, everything you needed and more, including a fridge, WiFi, freeview and it was all accessible from my chair. The whole hotel was so clean with great upto date decor and staff were so friendly, helpful, professional, accommodating and went out of their way for me making sure that any extra needs I had were met and more. The bed was so comfortable and although i was in a ground floor level room next to a road you couldn't hear a thing from outside, that along with the brilliant blind and curtain combination sleeping was a dream. Although a little way out of central London, the central line can be caught at the underground a 4 min walk away or there are plenty of buses. On the whole the hotel surprised me so much with how good it was, decor, cleanliness, staff, atmosphere, amenities. I cannot fault it and would definitely stay again and recommend to friends and family, it really is a gem of a hotel and much more than you expect. I also must say a huge thank you to the staff for looking after me so well - thank you all for being so caring and helpful.

title: I am in love with the friendly owners of the hotel :)
text: Lovely location, fabulous shef!!! (breakfast menu, steaks, mezze and the yum list goes on and on). Clean rooms, lovely room service.Staff very friendly and always helpful. Hasan and his brother are the best hosts, guys basically make you feel like you are at home! Highly recommended. Becides very convinient location wise both from buses and the tube side(15 min walk and you at Leyton station) it took me 30 minutes for the overall trip to get to Ofxford street. Highly recommended.

title: Will recommend - excellent stay
text: We had an opportunity to stay at the Lion and Key in late July 2016 for just one night. Since our flight had arrived at 6 am we could not check in to the hotel right away but they took our luggage, logged them into the concierge closet and the woman at the counter (I wish I had written down her name) was very helpful in pointing us to some good restaurants where we could get breakfast and then she did everything she could to get us into our rooms well before regular check in time. The rooms were VERY clean, and recently renovated. Everything was new and worked perfectly. We were treated well and the front desk staff were always very easy to get along with and informative as well as helpful. This was our first visit from America to London and the Lion and Key made a very good first impression. The neighborhood is very diverse and peaceful.

title: a haven
text: we stayed in leyton at this hotel and it was a great place every thing was tastfully done i would call it a boutique type hotel ,,very friendly and helpful ,nice place to stay in not such a nice area ,there adding a restaurant to the hotel which will make a big difference also although there not short of restaurants in the area

title: Hidden gem
text: An older building in an ethnic neighbourhood that has been tastefully renovated on the inside to give it a modern and elegant look. Rooms are key card activated. When you enter, you need to insert your card into the slot near the door to turn on bathroom lights, etc. Comfortable beds, good use of natural lighting, wi-fi activated through the TV, handy USB chargers in every room. Bathroom was small but clean. My wife thought the shower stall was a little tight. I didn't mind personally and I liked the gentle rainfall-style shower head. The neighbourhood has some small markets where you can pick up breakfast items and what not. There are some restaurants and an affordable Chinese takeout across the street. A few blocks down is a beautiful park with gardens and an open air market that draws locals on the weekends. A bit beyond that is a subway station that'll take you right downtown. There are also frequent buses going right past the hotel, though I preferred to walk most of the time. I would definitely stay there again. The place is a bargain for what you get, and the management is intent on improving it further by adding a restaurant which sadly wasn't open yet when we visited. I noted in the review that the building is accessible. There are two entrances, one of which I seem to recall had a ramp. Our room was in a wing where there were several steps after you left the elevator, however, so if you are in a wheelchair, you should make sure they book you a room without such steps.

title: Friendly staff, immaculate and a great price!
text: The Lion and Key has a major strength and that is the quality of its staff. Friendly from check in to check out and at all levels of staff. The place is very clean and seems well maintained. However there is nowhere in the bathroom to put make up and other toiletries even whilst in use. This includes nowhere in the shower to put soap, shampoo etc whilst showering, so a wash bag roll which you can hang on the back of the door would be very handy! I felt the rooms were designed for a man by a man since to make matters worse there is no full length mirror! But given the excellent price we paid and the super obliging staff these were only minor niggles. This was an excellent base for us to visited relatives in Leyton, it is not in a pretty location and the area may feel rather rough after dark if you are not used to urban areas although we walked everywhere or used cabs and at no time felt worried. We will definitely return...with our hanging wash bag!

title: Greatly appreciated hotel
text: I want to really give my thanks (and a great review) to all of the people at the Lion and Key for the kindness and enjoyable stay afforded me in my recent visit. I was in London for 8 nights (my first time in the winter) and was lucky enough to find this little jewel. The staff was always friendly and helpful. True, it is not in a touristy area, but I walked around the area and the short distance to the underground station, day and night, without any hint of problem. There are a variety of bars and restaurants in the vicinity. My room was quiet, cleaned daily, and larger than many I've had in Europe. The bar and restaurant we're quite good also, both affordable and good. I left sad to leave, and I don't always have that feeling. Thanks to everyone for my wonderful stay!

title: Excellent Stay
text: This is a late review, but my boyfriend and I stayed at Lion and Key in October and had a great experience with both the staff and our room. The TV stations can be a bit touch and go but there are a lot of great things about this hotel that make up for it. The staff were very helpful. I emailed the hotel a couple of weeks before our stay to see if we could get our oyster cards sent to the hotel and pick them up upon arrival. I did not end up needing to do this, but I got a prompt reply giving me the information I needed in order to do so. They also were helpful in allowing me to print off my airline tickets for our quick getaway to Scotland and if we ever had any questions, they were very quick to help us out. The hotel is outside of Central London, but there are buses that can take you to the station, or if you are really active, it is about a 15-20 minute walk. Getting to Central London takes about 20 minutes by Tube. When you stay there, make sure you check out the restaurants in the area. There is a Malaysian restaurant across the street that had absolutely amazing food. So good, we went there twice during our 10 day stay. There is also a little hole in the wall breakfast place with a huge portion. Kept us full almost all day. Leyton Technical Pub was very good food and a nice relaxing night. The area can seem a little bit sketchy at night. We suffered from jetlag for the first part of the trip, so we didn't go out much at night. There is a 24 hour store that sells liquor and allows you to re-up your oyster card just up the street opposite the hotel.

title: Great Hotel
text: We stayed for 3 nights at the hotel and the overall stay was comfortable with spacious room. The rooms had a modern interior with good cleanliness. The staff was courteous and helpful. Highly recommended for business and family travellers. Well connected with tube services was a great value for money!

title: Beautiful hotel, had a fantastic stay
text: This hotel was beautiful and classy throughout and exceeded our expectations. Location is ideal as so close to Westfield and the staff were amazing. They even posted an item of clothing I had left behind back to me. Our room was a double and single and was massive. The bathroom was total luxury. Couldn't recommend this hotel enough and will definitely be back. Only thing I'd mention is lack of parking, Booking.com had it listed with parking but that's a mistake although that is a problem with Booking.com and not the hotel itself. You can easily park for free nearby after a certain time. Cant believe what a bargain this hotel was for such luxury.

title: Clean and friendly
text: Our second stay here this time for Christmas with our daughter and her partner who live nearby. The hotel is small, clean and very good value. The staff are all very friendly and helpful. The rooms are a good size with modern fittings. We will certainly stay here again.

title: Excellent service and a beautiful hotel
text: The hotel is immaculate and the food is fantastic! Husband said it's the best poached egg he has ever had! The owners cannot do more for you, really helpful. The rooms are beautiful, clean and everything you need. A truly lovely family run hotel! Definitely recommend it

title: A pleasant surprise
text: For a 3 star hotel I was pleasantly surprised. The room was spacious and clean and looked very modern. The staff were very friendly and best of all, I think the hotel was very reasonably priced. It's a 12 min walk to Leyton station. I would definitely recommend and visit again.

title: Clean, simple.
text: Room was very modern, clean, all was new, sheets, bed, shower. Had USB-sockets for your phone and iPad. Safe. Good place. It took 10 minutes walk from Tube to get there, not through the nicest neighborhood. Good, relatively fast internet, all well thought out.

title: Good Value for Money
text: We stayed in a triple room for two nights and found it to be very reasonably priced for London. It is in Zone 3 in East London and so a little further from the centre and main attractions. The tube station is a 15 minute walk for the Central line and there is a bus stop where two buses stop directly outside the hotel. The area is not particularly desirable late at night. The hotel is well placed for exploring the developments in East London, particularly Stratford with the Olympic Park and Westfield Shopping. The hotel was clean and newly refurbished. There is not currently a restaurant on site. The bathroom is small with just a shower but is adequate. The shower would benefit from a small shelf and a shower cap. The heating / air conditioning has no instructions and can be a little difficult to operate. Tea and coffee making facilities are available but there are no glasses or beakers for water. Photo ID is copied on arrival and £50 taken for breakages etc which will be refunded after your stay (we were advised this could take 10 days). It is a basic hotel which is clean and good value for London.

title: Spacious rooms
text: Rooms are spacious and modern, but bathroom is small. This hotel is bit far from Central London, but it's easy to get public transport and there are restaurants close by. Hotels restaurant and bar are also good. For shopping you can easily go to Westfield by a short cab or bus ride.

title: What a little gem this is !
text: My friend and stayed here on the night of a concert we attended at the London Stadium. It's ideally situated for that venue, just a 10 minute ride on the 97 bus to Stratford City & the stadium is right in front of you. The hotel is very fresh, the rooms well appointed and nicely decorated. The bathroom was good, and the shower very invigorating and seemingly endless hot water. The reception staff were very welcoming, helpful and offered tips to get to the stadium and a suggestion for breakfast in the morning. There are currently (June 2017) no catering facilities at the hotel, but for breakfast I can recommend Deeney's cafe, just up the road. 10% discount for hotel guests too. My friend and I really felt relaxed and enjoyed our stay. A return visit is a definite, next time we go to a concert at the London Stadium.

title: Best Value For Money In London
text: I stayed last week when my normal weekly London hotel was full it booked When I saw my reservation from work I was a bit worried . I arrive and was given room & parking Hotel look good on first view reception very helpful got to my room could not believe the quality of room size and fixtures shower is amazing had great nights sleep Air Con free Wi-Fi great TV system loads of power point toiletries towel mini safe and fridge half the cost of my normal London Hotel .This would be a great Hotel for Away Fans visiting West Ham just get 97 bus from outside hotel 5 mins £1.50 and your there cant big this hotel up enough its a great Value Stay don't look at Premier Inns or Travelodges or Hiltons or Holiday Inns just book you will be pleasantly surprised GREAT HOTEL GREAT STAFF Carmen on reception is great and full of local knowledge JUST BOOK IT

title: Great value for money
text: Booked the hotel room last minute for a very decent price. Bed and bathroom were comfortable, and staff very welcoming. Location-wise it's very practical as buses come regularly to drop you at Leyton Underground. Nice restaurants in the area.

title: Fantastic hotel 5*
text: I have stayed in the lion and key hotel with my wife. We had a fantastic time. Hotel is new and only 2 months old. Everything is new and the staff are very polite and helpful. The hotel location is nearer to everything specially the Westfield Stratford and the Olympic village. There is busses all the time and Lyton tube station is closer. There is parking facility run by the hotel on extra charges, but just outside the hotel you can park for free from 4pm till 10am The next day any other time is charges £2.60 for 2 hrs maximum. There is in the area where you can park for free. Ask in the reception. The room was very clean and you feel Like you are the 5* hotel, beautiful bathroom and smart TV with free wifi none stop. I couldn't not ask for more.5* for me.nabil

title: A Little Gem
text: An East London hotel that exceeds all expectations. I thought that this would be just an OK place to spend a night but it was far better than that. The hotel was ideally placed for us - about half an hour's walk from Olympic Park. It is very clean and tidy with very good quality fittings. The room was surprisingly quiet given the busy road outside. The staff were very good and friendly too. This is a room only hotel - no dining room and no breakfast facilities but they will recommend places to eat. Their recommendation for breakfast was just perfect.

title: Modern and very clean
text: We got a great deal on this hotel for 2 nights and thought it was really nice. The rooms are modern and very clean. The staff were great and the location isn't too bad either so can't complain. It is around 5-10min walk from Leyton underground and there are restaurants, take-aways and eateries nearby which is convenient.

title: Smart & clean accommodation.
text: The hotel was well appointed and very clean. However, considering the quite high price of the rooms, we were disappointed with the size of the room & the facilities. The room was very cold & the only heating had to be switched on using a system with no instructions. There was no heating at all in the shower room so stepping out of the very nice shower was a bit traumatic! As the hotel is a considerable distance from the nearest tube station - requiring a bus ride particularly if you have luggage to carry - it is not very conveniently located for most tourist purposes. Having no dining facilities at present is also a huge drawback. Information about local eateries would have improved the situation.

title: Lovely hotel
text: We stayed here in a last minute trip and got a really good price. The hotel is quite new so therefore everything is up to a very good standard. We got a great price and it's a 5min walk too leyton tube station. The bed was very comfy and we had a smart TV in our room. The area isn't the best but the hotel is lovely. Probably wouldn't want to stay here being a lone female if I had to get back here late at night on my own but I felt very safe with my partner.

title: First time in London - Excellent Hotel
text: Well, I don't know how to star. This hotel is incredible, the staff, the rooms are very clean and modern. ( I stayed in Triple Room and Double Room). The location is quiet and the Leyton Metro Station is about 10 min walk. Nearby there are places to eat and some good pubs.I really want to come back to this hotel.

title: 4 stops from London, Fabulous Hotel Great staff, lovely restaurant
text: This is a new hotel just 4 stops along on the Central Line from Liverpool Street so great for Stansted Airport or Gatwick Leyton area is very up & coming with lovely parks, open spaces, quiet streets and plenty of cafes and small shops - Tesco Metro right close by and a Sainsbury's Local too. The rooms are spotless and all new beds, bathrooms and fitting. A great place for a budget price. The Lion & Key is an old Victorian building steeped in history which the current owners are respectful to observe. The name may be hard to remember but they didn't want to compromise the history - think Lion King holding the keys - and look out for the lions holding the keys in their mouths protection and the gatekeeper of heaven all around the hotel. There is a small car park, you probably have to book it but we use the tube (3 mins walk to Leyton tube) or the very frequent buses into town. The restaurant is modern & comfortable with a great menu for breakfast, lunch or supper - we love the speciality 'Pide' stuffed breads, they are huge. We go with friends, grandchildren and all enjoy eating there. The staff are so friendly and caring, they love children and ours feel very at home. Good wine list, chilled beers and all in all a great stay.

title: Great value, friendly staff
text: All looks brand new and modern. Good value and so easy to get bus to/from Stratford to the QE Stadium and Westfield. Staff were really friendly and breakfast was very good and not expensive. Drinks at the bar weren't expensive for London either

title: Perfect
text: Possibly the cleanest hotel I have stayed at in the London area. Everything you need in a hotel room and more. Our only downside was noisy room on floor below but was dealt with very well when reported to reception. The attention to detail is almost perfect. The only thing that was missing way a shelf in the shower but very minor thing. Staff were very friendly and would not hesitate in booking again in the future.

title: Daughters Wedding
text: 3 person family room. Spacious, comfortable and clean. Excellent bathroom. Good choice and nice breakfast. ( we didn't have dinner during our stay) It's a bit far out from centre of London but good value and wonderful service.

title: Rooms cosy & parking limited
text: The hotel itself is kept clean & the staff are very welcoming however we had two triple rooms which were both very small inside and the parking is a tiny courtyard with just four spaces which is inconvenient to get in and out of.

title: Very Nice and classy
text: Really loved this hotel. The area is allright and only minutes from Westfield by bus. The owner has a very good taste. From the moment you enter in the lobby everything is classy. Was very pleased with the bathroom and the comfortable bed... Kettle, biscuits, teabags and coffee... What else !? Will definitely book this hotel again.

title: Overnight
text: A great little hotel. Nice and clean, friendly staff and real good value. We had a room for 3 adults loads of towels fridge tv internet shower and wc. A few shops and bars nearby. We parked for free just around the corner from 5pm -6am.

title: Perfect
text: The hotel was a wonderful price, easy to find and fabulously decorated.. and even pleased my decorater boyfriend who is rather particular! Comfy bed, soft sheets! Abit of a noisy area at night but I suppose I'm not used to that being from Cambridge! Will definitely visit again!

title: A great new modern hotel.
text: This is a great new hotel and grill/bar. The rooms are modern and clean. Extremely comfortable bed and air con to help sleep at the correct temperature. Although the rooms are of average size and the bathrooms small (but not tiny) the layout is good and enough room to get around easily. A lift for easy access with baggage and a small car park, first come first serve basis. I stayed 2 nights arrived around 7 pm and the staff moved a staffs car to allow me to park. The food is great, freshly made in the open to view kitchen and plenty to choose from. Breakfast is also very nice I had the Spanish omelet and an awesome coffee (costa eat ya heart out). The staff are friendly and fully helpful to get you what you need. I would recommend this hotel to all if you need to stay in the area, ill be back again soon without a doubt I'll probably become a regular guest here when I'm working in the area. If I could I would give 10 stars. Prices are reasonable at £75/night with £15/parking per night which I think is reasonable since you are safe in the knowledge that the gates are locked at 10 pm and your car is secure.

title: Amazing!
text: It was better than we excepted. Great personal and services, wifi connection, bus stops around and underground station is really near. We slept here for four nights and we had no problem. Asda was really near too. Air conditioning and mini bar worked well (we used mini bar as little fridge)

title: Better than 3*, it is a fact!
text: I made this last minute booking for 3 people in a room so i was limited on choices, but it proved to be a good one. When we arrived very late at the hotel we were greeted warmly, by the friendly man at reception. We checked in and went to the room, it was actually more spacious than it first looked in the pictures, it was very clean and tidy and the decor, it was certainly of my taste. The location is ok, 15 minute walk to the station on a normal pace which could have been better, it is on central line though which was convenient for the 24h trains on weekends. it took 20-25 minutes to get to oxford circus station. The only down side that there was on the hotel, was on the check out date the lift was broken, and no sign or warning was given, so i had to carry three floors down, 100kgs of luggages overall it was a good stay, i would say a 6.8/10

title: Perfect Modern Styled Hotel
text: Just 1 tube stop away from Stratford Olympic Park, this little hotel is great value for money with great facilities including modern bathrooms, smart TV, clean & tidy decor. Although Breakfast is additional, it's something of high restaurant quality and definitely worth the money. Staff are friendly and fulfilled all our requests with great generousity. Will definitely be staying here again!

title: Lovely hotel
text: Lovely rooms, very modern and a good size. Good prices. Lots of shops. Downside is parking, had to drive round a while but managed to find a spot in the end and it's free after 4 and all day Sunday. Good transport links too into city centre. Would definitely book again

title: Brilliant hotel
text: Just stayed here for a week on business, not too central (but we didn't need it to be) area not the greatest directly outside the hotel but 200 yard walk to some nice places to eat. Breakfast was ok but only had it once as the menu wasn't really to my liking (no bacon!?!?), evening meal was very nice! Staff very pleasant and the view from my room (303) of The Shard/Gherkin etc was a lovely little bonus! Would stop again

title: Fabulous hotel
text: We booked 2 rooms here for the Ride London event. Staff couldn't have been more helpful. Room spotlessly clean, beautifully furnished and very comfortable. We ate in the restaurant and the meal was spot on. Very pleasantly surprised and great value too. Close to Olympic Park, Westfield Stratford. Would def recommend 😀

title: Little gem in the east end
text: Stayed for one night as we were attending the Para-athletics at the Olympic Stadium and can't fault the place. Stayed in room 304 which is top floor triple room and it was very spacious and clean. Plenty of towels and toiletries, tea and coffee making facilities (inc biscuits). There were soft drinks available in the fridge but we didn't use these nor did we eat here but the food we did see looked lovely and from the menu was well priced. All the staff were friendly and polite. There was some traffic noise but it's what you would expect being in the middle of a city. We used their car park for £15 which is quite small but served the purpose. Would use this hotel again if we needed to be that side of London.

title: nice hotel
text: stayed here at this hotel through work and the rooms are fantastic but if you are traveling by car it is definitely a no as there is no parking facilities I had to park about half a mile away during to the location the other downside was no facilities to have any breakfast or a meal th0ere is plenty of local fast food places but not a decent 0lacevto get a meal without getting a taxi into Leyton must admit I did enjoy the hotel apparently from eating from the local tesco express

title: Spotlessly clean and comfortable
text: An fabulous hotel and facilities. Only downfall is no restaurant or dining area. Quite expensive as breakfast isn't included. Had it been included I would have rated it excellent. Definitely would use this hotel again.

title: Quality stay
text: One night stay for business. Booked by my company. Arrived tired and irritable. Not happy when I'm told I've been allocated a basement room. This place has had some serious money spent on it. All the mod cons. Loads of space. Not at all disappointed. Lower floor garden and natural light into the room. Will definitely consider another stay if we're working in London. Pretty good transport links. Food reasonably priced and fantastic quality. Go steady when ordering multiple courses as the portion sizes are more than generous. If you're seriously hungry try a "pide". You won't be if you can finish it. All the staff were extremely helpful and polite. Rare indeed these days. Keep up the good work !

title: Clean, but small room
text: I booked a single room for two nights. Everything was ok, the staff was polite and helpful, the room, and toilet, was clean. The only problem, room and toilet was small. It has a double bed so the remaining space was small, also the toilet was small. There was no a/c in the room so in summer it will be hot.

title: to forget
text: four people left out for one night because they arrived late. no one cared if they spoke English, if they knew London, they knew where to go, if they were okay, etc. the only thing they could say was sorry check in was until 11

title: Booking Cancelled for no reasons
text: At the end of November I made a reservation for 3 people.I received an email saying that my booking is confirmed. A week later, while we were at the airport, waiting to board I received an email saying that my reservation was cancelled and that "you don't need to take any further action" (!!!!), but if I have any queries I can call the property. I called at least 10 times, NOBODY answered, I sent two emails, but I haven't received a reply "YET" and when a friend from London called they answered in a second. They said my card was invalid and they didn't have any other free rooms. On the day we left I bought the National Express tickets by card, and my card was alright. I felt discriminated because they didn't answer my phone or my emails, but they answered a phone call from London. Imagine arriving in London at 7 pm and having no place to stay. Think twice before booking this hotel! I will certainly not recommend it! For airbnb my card was valid!

title: Great value for money.
text: Clean, cozy room, nicely furnished and decorated. Comfortable beds. Helpful crew. The combo booking.com+paypal made a mess: Stuart, the manager, didn't receive the money from them, so I had to pay a second time directly to him. But he was kind enough to keep the room despite that, to explain the situation to me and to help me with the refund from booking. Definitely recommend. Really not much to complain about. At some point I had some noisy neighbours at late night, but I guess this depends on people being impolite, rather than on the structure itself.

title: Super Hotel
text: We was helped out by this establishment after being let down by the windmill hotel nearby , excellent service by manager and we will be using this hotel again , rooms clean , tea and coffee , very nice not the usual cheaper brands but select .

title: Okay place to stay. Standard according to price
text: good location with shops and eateries and the tube nearby. You get what you pay for and the place is good and clean. Okay for a short stay in that area. I would comeback and recommend to friends and colleagues.

title: Okay Couple of Nights
text: Stayed here for a couple of nights to attend an event at the Excel Centre. Hotel was about 45 minutes away by tube but was the only affordable hotel in the area for that particular weekend. Got off to a good start, hotel was a decent price, guy on reception was really friendly when I arrived and the room was larger and looked nicer than I had expected. The surrounding area felt safe – about ten minute walk away from tube station and two minutes up the road was a Wetherspoons so decent area. There were a couple of issues though, the main one being that the main light in my room didn’t work. To be 100% fair to the hotel I chose not to report this because I didn’t want to cause a nuisance and I just wanted to settle into the room so I made do with the one working bed light and the bathroom light. It could just be a case of several people before me also not choosing to report the problem so the hotel genuinely have no idea. I don’t know. There was a large mirror in the room which at first glance looked very fancy but was also quite grimy, it sort of let down the room because everything else seemed spotless but the mirror could definitely do with a good wipe. The last one was that the door kept rattling, I’m not sure what caused this – potentially the traffic outside or other guests walking around but in the end I shoved the tub chair against it and luckily it stopped. One of the legs from the tub chair fell off when I nudged it an inch so it can’t have been secured in. So although this was annoying there was a solution to it. These didn’t ruin my stay though and I feel like for the price I did get a decent hotel. The bed was comfortable, I felt safe (travelled solo so this is important for me) and everything else was of a good standard. Would stay here again. Also - saw a show in Central London on the first night, didn't take too long to get into Central London by tube, maybe about 20 minutes.

title: Cricklewood lodge
text: Room clean and tidy bedding and towels also clean had the family room on the first floor room 1 two showers and two double beds TVs also kettle and tea coffee and biscuits in the room not far from railway station after reading reviews was pleasantly surprised with the room I was in man on reception very helpful

title: Great value
text: On a busy Broadway convenient to lots of small shops and a good Wetherspoons. Lovely clean room and modern ensuite.You can book in until 11pm at night. The best value for money in this part of London. The best Wi-fi of any hotel anywhere !

title: A Complete Disappointment
text: First of all, when we walked in and throughout our stay we found clumps of hair on the floor as seen in the pictures. We arrived during the extreme heat which is completely out of the Cricklewood’s Control, but they offered no fans or anything and we were on the third floor. Our room was almost 90 degrees when we checked in to the place. When we checked in and checked out was the only time the front desk was available. The shower was extremely small. I’m 5 feet and 7 inches tall and weigh 127 pounds. Every time I’d move I’d turn the water off or to hot or cold. It also took approximately 5 minutes every morning to get any hot water. Our last night we had no internet. We tried calling as that was a necessity for our family to stay in contact with family and plan the next day. Myself and daughters went down at 9:07 pm to talk to someone about the issue and of course no one was at the front desk. We rang the bell multiple times and no one answered. The next day when we checked out we actually saw someone...we asked about the internet and he said it was out of his control. A sign letting us know that there was no internet would have been helpful!!! Lastly this place is cheap...however it is also about a $15-20 Uber ride one way, to everything you will want to see and that’s only 4 Miles! So we would have been much better off paying an extra $40 a night. Please beware!!

title: Not the best
text: When checking in, the guy on reception was extremely helpful, and a lovely guy to chat to too! The room itself was the only downside to this hotel! Looking past the dated decor, it still needs a makeover! Parts of the carpet are worn down, head board falling off (wouldn’t like to think why), lack of black out curtains waking me up at an ungodly hour! Upon closer inspection, I found around the skirting boards hadn’t been cleaned thoroughly in quite some time, leaving a build up of dust... and a previous guests finger nail clipping! This hotel is in fantastic location for Wembley Stadium, however is on a busy road, with lots of traffic, causing noise through the night (which is of course no ones fault).
